chapters.ml: ആദിയിൽ ദൈവം ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും സൃഷ്ടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
chapters.nkjv: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
chapters.kjv: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമി പാഴായും ശൂന്യമായും ഇരുന്നു; ആഴത്തിന്മീതെ ഇരുൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആത്മാവു വെള്ളത്തിൻ മീതെ പരിവർത്തിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.
chapters.nkjv: The earth was without form, and void; and darkness was on the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters.
chapters.kjv: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

chapters.ml: വെളിച്ചം ഉണ്ടാകട്ടെ എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു; വെളിച്ചം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let there be light"; and there was light.
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

chapters.ml: വെളിച്ചം നല്ലതു എന്നു ദൈവം കണ്ടു ദൈവം വെളിച്ചവും ഇരുളും തമ്മിൽ വേർപിരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.
chapters.nkjv: And God saw the light, that itwas good; and God divided the light from the darkness.
chapters.kjv: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നു പകൽ എന്നും ഇരുളിന്നു രാത്രി എന്നും പേരിട്ടു. സന്ധ്യയായി ഉഷസ്സുമായി, ഒന്നാം ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: God called the light "day," and the darkness he called "night." And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
chapters.nkjv: God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. So the evening and the morning were the first day.
chapters.kjv: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം വെള്ളങ്ങളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഒരു വിതാനം ഉണ്ടാകട്ടെ; അതു വെള്ളത്തിന്നും വെള്ളത്തിന്നും തമ്മിൽ വേർപിരിവായിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And God said, "Let there be a vault between the waters to separate water from water."
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters."
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

chapters.ml: വിതാനം ഉണ്ടാക്കീട്ടു ദൈവം വിതാനത്തിൻ കീഴുള്ള വെള്ളവും വിതാനത്തിൻ മീതെയുള്ള വെള്ളവും തമ്മിൽ വേർപിരിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So God made the vault and separated the water under the vault from the water above it. And it was so.
chapters.nkjv: Thus God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament; and it was so.
chapters.kjv: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം വിതാനത്തിന്നു ആകാശം എന്നു പേരിട്ടു. സന്ധ്യയായി ഉഷസ്സുമായി, രണ്ടാം ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: God called the vault "sky." And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
chapters.nkjv: And God called the firmament Heaven. So the evening and the morning were the second day.
chapters.kjv: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം: ആകാശത്തിൻ കീഴുള്ള വെള്ളം ഒരു സ്ഥലത്തു കൂടട്ടെ; ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലം കാണട്ടെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And God said, "Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear." And it was so.
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear"; and it was so.
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

chapters.ml: ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തിന്നു ദൈവം ഭൂമി എന്നും വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു സമുദ്രം എന്നും പേരിട്ടു; നല്ലതു എന്നു ദൈവം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: God called the dry ground "land," and the gathered waters he called "seas." And God saw that it was good.
chapters.nkjv: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of the waters He called Seas. And God saw that itwas good.
chapters.kjv: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു പുല്ലും വിത്തുള്ള സസ്യങ്ങളും ഭൂമിയിൽ അതതു തരം വിത്തുള്ള ഫലം കായിക്കുന്ന വൃക്ഷങ്ങളും മുളെച്ചുവരട്ടെ എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then God said, "Let the land produce vegetation: seed-bearing plants and trees on the land that bear fruit with seed in it, according to their various kinds." And it was so.
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb that yields seed, and the fruit tree that yields fruit according to its kind, whose seed is in itself, on the earth"; and it was so.
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു പുല്ലും അതതു തരം വിത്തുള്ള ഫലം കായിക്കുന്ന വൃക്ഷങ്ങളും മുളെച്ചുവന്നു; നല്ലതു എന്നു ദൈവം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The land produced vegetation: plants bearing seed according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.nkjv: And the earth brought forth grass, the herb that yields seed according to its kind, and the tree that yields fruit, whose seed is in itself according to its kind. And God saw that itwas good.
chapters.kjv: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യയായി ഉഷസ്സുമായി, മൂന്നാം ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
chapters.nkjv: So the evening and the morning were the third day.
chapters.kjv: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

chapters.ml: പകലും രാവും തമ്മിൽ വേർപിരിവാൻ ആകാശവിതാനത്തിൽ വെളിച്ചങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാകട്ടെ; അവ അടയാളങ്ങളായും കാലം, ദിവസം, സംവത്സരം എന്നിവ തിരിച്ചറിവാനായും ഉതകട്ടെ;
chapters.niv: And God said, "Let there be lights in the vault of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them serve as signs to mark sacred times, and days and years,
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament of the heavens to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs and seasons, and for days and years;
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയെ പ്രകാശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ആകാശവിതാനത്തിൽ അവ വെളിച്ചങ്ങളായിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and let them be lights in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth." And it was so.
chapters.nkjv: and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth"; and it was so.
chapters.kjv: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

chapters.ml: പകൽ വാഴേണ്ടതിന്നു വലിപ്പമേറിയ വെളിച്ചവും രാത്രി വാഴേണ്ടതിന്നു വലിപ്പം കുറഞ്ഞ വെളിച്ചവും ആയി രണ്ടു വലിയ വെളിച്ചങ്ങളെ ദൈവം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: God made two great lights—the greater light to govern the day and the lesser light to govern the night. He also made the stars.
chapters.nkjv: Then God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. Hemade the stars also.
chapters.kjv: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയെ പ്രകാശിപ്പിപ്പാനും പകലും രാത്രിയും വാഴുവാനും വെളിച്ചത്തെയും ഇരുളിനെയും തമ്മിൽ വേർപിരിപ്പാനുമായി
chapters.niv: God set them in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth,
chapters.nkjv: God set them in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth,
chapters.kjv: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവയെ ആകാശവിതാനത്തിൽ നിർത്തി; നല്ലതു എന്നു ദൈവം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.nkjv: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. And God saw that itwas good.
chapters.kjv: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യയായി ഉഷസ്സുമായി, നാലാം ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
chapters.nkjv: So the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
chapters.kjv: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളത്തിൽ ജലജന്തുക്കൾ കൂട്ടമായി ജനിക്കട്ടെ; ഭൂമിയുടെ മീതെ ആകാശവിതാനത്തിൽ പറവജാതി പറക്കട്ടെ എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And God said, "Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of the sky."
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let the waters abound with an abundance of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the face of the firmament of the heavens."
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം വലിയ തിമിംഗലങ്ങളെയും വെള്ളത്തിൽ കൂട്ടമായി ജനിച്ചു ചരിക്കുന്ന അതതുതരം ജീവജന്തുക്കളെയും അതതു തരം പറവജാതിയെയും സൃഷ്ടിച്ചു; നല്ലതു എന്നു ദൈവം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: So God created the great creatures of the sea and every living thing with which the water teems and that moves about in it, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.nkjv: So God created great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters abounded, according to their kind, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that itwas good.
chapters.kjv: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ വർദ്ധിച്ചു പെരുകി സമുദ്രത്തിലെ വെള്ളത്തിൽ നിറവിൻ; പറവജാതി ഭൂമിയിൽ പെരുകട്ടെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു ദൈവം അവയെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the water in the seas, and let the birds increase on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: And God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യയായി ഉഷസ്സുമായി, അഞ്ചാം ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
chapters.nkjv: So the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
chapters.kjv: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

chapters.ml: അതതുതരം കന്നുകാലി, ഇഴജാതി, കാട്ടുമൃഗം ഇങ്ങനെ അതതു തരം ജീവജന്തുക്കൾ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ഉളവാകട്ടെ എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And God said, "Let the land produce living creatures according to their kinds: the livestock, the creatures that move along the ground, and the wild animals, each according to its kind." And it was so.
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth the living creature according to its kind: cattle and creeping thing and beast of the earth, each according to its kind"; and it was so.
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദൈവം അതതു തരം കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളെയും അതതു തരം കന്നുകാലികളെയും അതതു തരം ഭൂചരജന്തുക്കളെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; നല്ലതു എന്നു ദൈവം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and all the creatures that move along the ground according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.nkjv: And God made the beast of the earth according to its kind, cattle according to its kind, and everything that creeps on the earth according to its kind. And God saw that itwas good.
chapters.kjv: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദൈവം: നാം നമ്മുടെ സ്വരൂപത്തിൽ നമ്മുടെ സാദൃശ്യപ്രകാരം മനുഷ്യനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കുക; അവർ സമുദ്രത്തിലുള്ള മത്സ്യത്തിന്മേലും ആകാശത്തിലുള്ള പറവജാതിയിന്മേലും മൃഗങ്ങളിന്മേലും സർവ്വഭൂമിയിന്മേലും ഭൂമിയിൽ ഇഴയുന്ന എല്ലാ ഇഴജാതിയിന്മേലും വാഴട്ടെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then God said, "Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky, over the livestock and all the wild animals, and over all the creatures that move along the ground."
chapters.nkjv: Then God said, "Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness; let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദൈവം തന്റെ സ്വരൂപത്തിൽ മനുഷ്യനെ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചു, ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സ്വരൂപത്തിൽ അവനെ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചു, ആണും പെണ്ണുമായി അവരെ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
chapters.nkjv: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
chapters.kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾ സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവരായി പെരുകി ഭൂമിയിൽ നിറഞ്ഞു അതിനെ അടക്കി സമുദ്രത്തിലെ മത്സ്യത്തിന്മേലും ആകാശത്തിലെപറവജാതിയിന്മേലും സകലഭൂചരജന്തുവിന്മേലും വാഴുവിൻ എന്നു അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky and over every living creature that moves on the ground."
chapters.nkjv: Then God blessed them, and God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it; have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over every living thing that moves on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ എങ്ങും വിത്തുള്ള സസ്യങ്ങളും വൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെ വിത്തുള്ള ഫലം കായ്ക്കുന്ന സകലവൃക്ഷങ്ങളും ഇതാ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആഹാരമായിരിക്കട്ടെ;
chapters.niv: Then God said, "I give you every seed-bearing plant on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They will be yours for food.
chapters.nkjv: And God said, "See, I have given you every herb that yields seed which is on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit yields seed; to you it shall be for food.
chapters.kjv: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലമൃഗങ്ങൾക്കും ആകാശത്തിലെ എല്ലാ പറവകൾക്കും ഭൂമിയിൽ ചരിക്കുന്ന സകല ഭൂചരജന്തുക്കൾക്കും ആഹാരമായിട്ടു പച്ചസസ്യം ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And to all the beasts of the earth and all the birds in the sky and all the creatures that move along the ground—everything that has the breath of life in it—I give every green plant for food." And it was so.
chapters.nkjv: Also, to every beast of the earth, to every bird of the air, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which thereis life, Ihavegiven every green herb for food"; and it was so.
chapters.kjv: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.

chapters.ml: താൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതിനെ ഒക്കെയും ദൈവം നോക്കി, അതു എത്രയും നല്ലതു എന്നു കണ്ടു. സന്ധ്യയായി ഉഷസ്സുമായി, ആറാം ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
chapters.nkjv: Then God saw everything that He had made, and indeed itwas very good. So the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
chapters.kjv: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും അവയിലുള്ള ചരാചരങ്ങളൊക്കെയും തികഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
chapters.nkjv: Thus the heavens and the earth, and all the host of them, were finished.
chapters.kjv: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

chapters.ml: താൻ ചെയ്ത പ്രവൃത്തി ഒക്കെയും ദൈവം തീർത്തശേഷം താൻ ചെയ്ത സകലപ്രവൃത്തിയിൽനിന്നും ഏഴാം ദിവസം നിവൃത്തനായി
chapters.niv: By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work.
chapters.nkjv: And on the seventh day God ended His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.
chapters.kjv: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

chapters.ml: താൻ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചുണ്ടാക്കിയ സകല പ്രവൃത്തിയിൽനിന്നും അന്നു നിവൃത്തനായതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവം ഏഴാം ദിവസത്തെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done.
chapters.nkjv: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it He rested from all His work which God had created and made.
chapters.kjv: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം ഭൂമിയും ആകാശവും സൃഷ്ടിച്ച നാളിൽ ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും സൃഷ്ടിച്ചതിന്റെ ഉല്പത്തിവിവരം: വയലിലെ ചെടി ഒന്നും അതുവരെ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; വയലിലെ സസ്യം ഒന്നും മുളെച്ചിരുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, when the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.
chapters.nkjv: This is the history of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,
chapters.kjv: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം ഭൂമിയിൽ മഴ പെയ്യിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല; നിലത്തു വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ മനുഷ്യനും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now no shrub had yet appeared on the earth and no plant had yet sprung up, for the Lord God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no one to work the ground,
chapters.nkjv: before any plant of the field was in the earth and before any herb of the field had grown. For the Lord God had not caused it to rain on the earth, and therewas no man to till the ground;
chapters.kjv: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു മഞ്ഞു പൊങ്ങി, നിലം ഒക്കെയും നനെച്ചുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: but streams came up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
chapters.nkjv: but a mist went up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground.
chapters.kjv: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം നിലത്തെ പൊടികൊണ്ടു മനുഷ്യനെ നിർമ്മിച്ചിട്ടു അവന്റെ മൂക്കിൽ ജീവശ്വാസം ഊതി, മനുഷ്യൻ ജീവനുള്ള ദേഹിയായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living being.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവയായ ദൈവം കിഴക്കു ഏദെനിൽ ഒരു തോട്ടം ഉണ്ടാക്കി, താൻ സൃഷ്ടിച്ച മനുഷ്യനെ അവിടെ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: Now the Lord God had planted a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man he had formed.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden, and there He put the man whom He had formed.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

chapters.ml: കാണ്മാൻ ഭംഗിയുള്ളതും തിന്മാൻ നല്ല ഫലമുള്ളതുമായ ഓരോ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളും തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ നടുവിൽ ജീവവൃക്ഷവും നന്മതിന്മകളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള അറിവിന്റെ വൃക്ഷവും യഹോവയായ ദൈവം നിലത്തുനിന്നു മുളെപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord God made all kinds of trees grow out of the ground—trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
chapters.nkjv: And out of the ground the Lord God made every tree grow that is pleasant to the sight and good for food. The tree of life was also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
chapters.kjv: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

chapters.ml: തോട്ടം നനെപ്പാൻ ഒരു നദി ഏദെനിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അതു അവിടെനിന്നു നാലു ശാഖയായി പിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: A river watering the garden flowed from Eden; from there it was separated into four headwaters.
chapters.nkjv: Now a river went out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it parted and became four riverheads.
chapters.kjv: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തേതിന്നു പീശോൻ എന്നു പേർ; അതു ഹവീലാദേശമൊക്കെയും ചുറ്റുന്നു; അവിടെ പൊന്നുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The name of the first is the Pishon; it winds through the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold.
chapters.nkjv: The name of the first is Pishon; it is the one which skirts the whole land of Havilah, where thereis gold.
chapters.kjv: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

chapters.ml: ആ ദേശത്തിലെ പൊന്നു മേത്തരമാകുന്നു; അവിടെ ഗുല്ഗുലുവും ഗോമേദകവും ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: (The gold of that land is good; aromatic resin and onyx are also there.)
chapters.nkjv: And the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and the onyx stone are there.
chapters.kjv: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം നദിക്കു ഗീഹോൻ എന്നു പേർ; അതു കൂശ് ദേശമൊക്കെയും ചുറ്റുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the entire land of Cush.
chapters.nkjv: The name of the second river is Gihon; it is the one which goes around the whole land of Cush.
chapters.kjv: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം നദിക്കു ഹിദ്ദേക്കെൽ എന്നു പേർ; അതു അശ്ശൂരിന്നു കിഴക്കോട്ടു ഒഴുകുന്നു; നാലാം നദി ഫ്രാത്ത് ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Ashur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
chapters.nkjv: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it is the one which goes toward the east of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
chapters.kjv: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം മനുഷ്യനെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോയി ഏദെൻ തോട്ടത്തിൽ വേല ചെയ്‍വാനും അതിനെ കാപ്പാനും അവിടെ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: The Lord God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to tend and keep it.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം മനുഷ്യനോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: തോട്ടത്തിലെ സകലവൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെയും ഫലം നിനക്കു ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ തിന്നാം.
chapters.niv: And the Lord God commanded the man, "You are free to eat from any tree in the garden;
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, "Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat;
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നന്മതിന്മകളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള അറിവിന്റെ വൃക്ഷത്തിൻ ഫലം തിന്നരുതു; തിന്നുന്ന നാളിൽ നീ മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die."
chapters.nkjv: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die."
chapters.kjv: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവയായ ദൈവം: മനുഷ്യൻ ഏകനായിരിക്കുന്നതു നന്നല്ല; ഞാൻ അവന്നു തക്കതായൊരു തുണ ഉണ്ടാക്കിക്കൊടുക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord God said, "Itis not good that man should be alone; I will make him a helper comparable to him."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം ഭൂമിയിലെ സകല മൃഗങ്ങളെയും ആകാശത്തിലെ എല്ലാ പറവകളെയും നിലത്തു നിന്നു നിർമ്മിച്ചിട്ടു മനുഷ്യൻ അവെക്കു എന്തു പേരിടുമെന്നു കാണ്മാൻ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വരുത്തി; സകല ജീവജന്തുക്കൾക്കും മനുഷ്യൻ ഇട്ടതു അവെക്കു പേരായി;
chapters.niv: Now the Lord God had formed out of the ground all the wild animals and all the birds in the sky. He brought them to the man to see what he would name them; and whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
chapters.nkjv: Out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and brought them to Adam to see what he would call them. And whatever Adam called each living creature, that was its name.
chapters.kjv: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ എല്ലാ കന്നുകാലികൾക്കും ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവകൾക്കും എല്ലാ കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങൾക്കും പേരിട്ടു; എങ്കിലും മനുഷ്യന്നു തക്കതായൊരു തുണ കണ്ടുകിട്ടിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds in the sky and all the wild animals. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
chapters.nkjv: So Adam gave names to all cattle, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam there was not found a helper comparable to him.
chapters.kjv: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവയായ ദൈവം മനുഷ്യന്നു ഒരു ഗാഢനിദ്ര വരുത്തി; അവൻ ഉറങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ വാരിയെല്ലുകളിൽ ഒന്നു എടുത്തു അതിന്നു പകരം മാംസം പിടിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man’s ribs and then closed up the place with flesh.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall on Adam, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം മനുഷ്യനിൽനിന്നു എടുത്ത വാരിയെല്ലിനെ ഒരു സ്ത്രീയാക്കി, അവളെ മനുഷ്യന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man.
chapters.nkjv: Then the rib which the Lord God had taken from man He made into a woman, and He brought her to the man.
chapters.kjv: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മനുഷ്യൻ; ഇതു ഇപ്പോൾ എന്റെ അസ്ഥിയിൽ നിന്നു അസ്ഥിയും എന്റെ മാംസത്തിൽനിന്നു മാംസവും ആകുന്നു. ഇവളെ നരനിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തിരിക്കയാൽ ഇവൾക്കു നാരി എന്നു പേരാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The man said, "This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for she was taken out of man."
chapters.nkjv: And Adam said: "This is now bone of my bones And flesh of my flesh; She shall be called Woman, Because she was taken out of Man."
chapters.kjv: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു പുരുഷൻ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും വിട്ടുപിരിഞ്ഞു ഭാര്യയോടു പറ്റിച്ചേരും; അവർ ഏക ദേഹമായി തീരും.
chapters.niv: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.
chapters.kjv: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യനും ഭാര്യയും ഇരുവരും നഗ്നരായിരുന്നു; അവർക്കു നാണം തോന്നിയില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Adam and his wife were both naked, and they felt no shame.
chapters.nkjv: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
chapters.kjv: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ എല്ലാ കാട്ടുജന്തുക്കളെക്കാളും പാമ്പു കൌശലമേറിയതായിരുന്നു. അതു സ്ത്രീയോടു: തോട്ടത്തിലെ യാതൊരു വൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെ ഫലവും നിങ്ങൾ തിന്നരുതെന്നു ദൈവം വാസ്തവമായി കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now the serpent was more crafty than any of the wild animals the Lord God had made. He said to the woman, "Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden’?"
chapters.nkjv: Now the serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman, "Has God indeed said, ‘You shall not eat of every tree of the garden’?"
chapters.kjv: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ പാമ്പിനോടു: തോട്ടത്തിലെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെ ഫലം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തിന്നാം;
chapters.niv: The woman said to the serpent, "We may eat fruit from the trees in the garden,
chapters.nkjv: And the woman said to the serpent, "We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden;
chapters.kjv: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ മരിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ നടുവിലുള്ള വൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെ ഫലം തിന്നരുതു, തൊടുകയും അരുതു എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but God did say, ‘You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden, and you must not touch it, or you will die.’ "
chapters.nkjv: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God has said, ‘You shall not eat it, nor shall you touch it, lest you die.’ "
chapters.kjv: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

chapters.ml: പാമ്പു സ്ത്രീയോടു: നിങ്ങൾ മരിക്കയില്ല നിശ്ചയം;
chapters.niv: "You will not certainly die," the serpent said to the woman.
chapters.nkjv: Then the serpent said to the woman, "You will not surely die.
chapters.kjv: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

chapters.ml: അതു തിന്നുന്ന നാളിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ കണ്ണു തുറക്കയും നിങ്ങൾ നന്മതിന്മകളെ അറിയുന്നവരായി ദൈവത്തെപ്പോലെ ആകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു ദൈവം അറിയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "For God knows that when you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."
chapters.nkjv: For God knows that in the day you eat of it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."
chapters.kjv: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

chapters.ml: ആ വൃക്ഷഫലം തിന്മാൻ നല്ലതും കാണ്മാൻ ഭംഗിയുള്ളതും ജ്ഞാനം പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ കാമ്യവും എന്നു സ്ത്രീ കണ്ടു ഫലം പറിച്ചു തിന്നു ഭർത്താവിന്നും കൊടുത്തു; അവന്നും തിന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the woman saw that the fruit of the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eye, and also desirable for gaining wisdom, she took some and ate it. She also gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it.
chapters.nkjv: So when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree desirable to make one wise, she took of its fruit and ate. She also gave to her husband with her, and he ate.
chapters.kjv: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ഇരുവരുടെയും കണ്ണു തുറന്നു തങ്ങൾ നഗ്നരെന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു, അത്തിയില കൂട്ടിത്തുന്നി തങ്ങൾക്കു അരയാട ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.
chapters.nkjv: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves coverings.
chapters.kjv: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

chapters.ml: വെയിലാറിയപ്പോൾ യഹോവയായ ദൈവം തോട്ടത്തിൽ നടക്കുന്ന ഒച്ച അവർ കേട്ടു; മനുഷ്യനും ഭാര്യയും യഹോവയായ ദൈവം തങ്ങളെ കാണാതിരിപ്പാൻ തോട്ടത്തിലെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
chapters.nkjv: And they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
chapters.kjv: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം മനുഷ്യനെ വിളിച്ചു: നീ എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord God called to the man, "Where are you?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord God called to Adam and said to him, "Where are you?"
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?

chapters.ml: തോട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്റെ ഒച്ച കേട്ടിട്ടു ഞാൻ നഗ്നനാകകൊണ്ടു ഭയപ്പെട്ടു ഒളിച്ചു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He answered, "I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid."
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "I heard Your voice in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; and I hid myself."
chapters.kjv: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

chapters.ml: നീ നഗ്നനെന്നു നിന്നോടു ആർ പറഞ്ഞു? തിന്നരുതെന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ച വൃക്ഷഫലം നീ തിന്നുവോ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And he said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?"
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you that you should not eat?"
chapters.kjv: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മനുഷ്യൻ: എന്നോടു കൂടെ ഇരിപ്പാൻ നീ തന്നിട്ടുള്ള സ്ത്രീ വൃക്ഷഫലം തന്നു; ഞാൻ തിന്നുകയും ചെയ്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The man said, "The woman you put here with me—she gave me some fruit from the tree, and I ate it."
chapters.nkjv: Then the man said, "The woman whom You gave tobe with me, she gave me of the tree, and I ate."
chapters.kjv: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം സ്ത്രീയോടു: നീ ഈ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: പാമ്പു എന്നെ വഞ്ചിച്ചു, ഞാൻ തിന്നുപോയി എന്നു സ്ത്രീ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം പാമ്പിനോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: നീ ഇതു ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു എല്ലാ കന്നുകാലികളിലും എല്ലാ കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളിലുംവെച്ചു നീ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ ഉരസ്സുകൊണ്ടു ഗമിച്ചു നിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലമൊക്കെയും പൊടി തിന്നും.
chapters.niv: So the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, "Cursed are you above all livestock and all wild animals! You will crawl on your belly and you will eat dust all the days of your life.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord God said to the serpent: "Because you have done this, You are cursed more than all cattle, And more than every beast of the field; On your belly you shall go, And you shall eat dust All the days of your life.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കും സ്ത്രീക്കും നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും അവളുടെ സന്തതിക്കും തമ്മിൽ ശത്രുത്വം ഉണ്ടാക്കും. അവൻ നിന്റെ തല തകർക്കും; നീ അവന്റെ കുതികാൽ തകർക്കും.
chapters.niv: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel."
chapters.nkjv: And I will put enmity Between you and the woman, And between your seed and her Seed; He shall bruise your head, And you shall bruise His heel."
chapters.kjv: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: ഞാൻ നിനക്കു കഷ്ടവും ഗർഭധാരണവും ഏറ്റവും വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കും; നീ വേദനയോടെ മക്കളെ പ്രസവിക്കും; നിന്റെ ആഗ്രഹം നിന്റെ ഭർത്താവിനോടു ആകും; അവൻ നിന്നെ ഭരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: To the woman he said, "I will make your pains in childbearing very severe; with painful labor you will give birth to children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you."
chapters.nkjv: To the woman He said: "I will greatly multiply your sorrow and your conception; In pain you shall bring forth children; Your desire shallbe for your husband, And he shall rule over you."
chapters.kjv: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യനോടു കല്പിച്ചതോ: നീ നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ വാക്കു അനുസരിക്കയും തിന്നരുതെന്നു ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ച വൃക്ഷഫലം തിന്നുകയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ നിമിത്തം ഭൂമി ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലമൊക്കെയും നീ കഷ്ടതയോടെ അതിൽനിന്നു അഹോവൃത്തി കഴിക്കും.
chapters.niv: To Adam he said, "Because you listened to your wife and ate fruit from the tree about which I commanded you, ‘You must not eat from it,’ "Cursed is the ground because of you; through painful toil you will eat food from it all the days of your life.
chapters.nkjv: Then to Adam He said, "Because you have heeded the voice of your wife, and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it’: "Cursed is the ground for your sake; In toil you shall eat of it All the days of your life.
chapters.kjv: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;

chapters.ml: മുള്ളും പറക്കാരയും നിനക്കു അതിൽനിന്നു മുളെക്കും; വയലിലെ സസ്യം നിനക്കു ആഹാരമാകും.
chapters.niv: It will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
chapters.nkjv: Both thorns and thistles it shall bring forth for you, And you shall eat the herb of the field.
chapters.kjv: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

chapters.ml: നിലത്തുനിന്നു നിന്നെ എടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അതിൽ തിരികെ ചേരുവോളം മുഖത്തെ വിയർപ്പോടെ നീ ഉപജീവനം കഴിക്കും; നീ പൊടിയാകുന്നു, പൊടിയിൽ തിരികെ ചേരും.
chapters.niv: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your food until you return to the ground, since from it you were taken; for dust you are and to dust you will return."
chapters.nkjv: In the sweat of your face you shall eat bread Till you return to the ground, For out of it you were taken; For dust you are, And to dust you shall return."
chapters.kjv: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art , and unto dust shalt thou return.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ തന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു ഹവ്വാ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; അവൾ ജീവനുള്ളവർക്കെല്ലാം മാതാവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.
chapters.nkjv: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve, because she was the mother of all living.
chapters.kjv: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം ആദാമിന്നും അവന്റെഭാര്യക്കും തോൽകൊണ്ടു ഉടുപ്പു ഉണ്ടാക്കി അവരെ ഉടുപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.
chapters.nkjv: Also for Adam and his wife the Lord God made tunics of skin, and clothed them.
chapters.kjv: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ദൈവം: മനുഷ്യൻ നന്മതിന്മകളെ അറിവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നമ്മിൽ ഒരുത്തനെപ്പോലെ ആയിത്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ അവൻ കൈനീട്ടി ജീവവൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെ ഫലംകൂടെ പറിച്ചു തിന്നു എന്നേക്കും ജീവിപ്പാൻ സംഗതിവരരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And the Lord God said, "The man has now become like one of us, knowing good and evil. He must not be allowed to reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat, and live forever."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord God said, "Behold, the man has become like one of Us, to know good and evil. And now, lest he put out his hand and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever"—
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

chapters.ml: അവനെ എടുത്തിരുന്ന നിലത്തു കൃഷി ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവയായ ദൈവം അവനെ ഏദെൻ തോട്ടത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി.
chapters.niv: So the Lord God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
chapters.nkjv: therefore the Lord God sent him out of the garden of Eden to till the ground from which he was taken.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൻ മനുഷ്യനെ ഇറക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; ജീവന്റെ വൃക്ഷത്തിങ്കലേക്കുള്ള വഴികാപ്പാൻ അവൻ ഏദെൻ തോട്ടത്തിന്നു കിഴക്കു കെരൂബുകളെ തിരിഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്ന വാളിന്റെ ജ്വാലയുമായി നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: After he drove the man out, he placed on the east side of the Garden of Eden cherubim and a flaming sword flashing back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.
chapters.nkjv: So He drove out the man; and He placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
chapters.kjv: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം മനുഷ്യൻ തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ഹവ്വയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവൾ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു കയീനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു: യഹോവയാൽ എനിക്കു ഒരു പുരുഷപ്രജ ലഭിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Adam made love to his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, "With the help of the Lord I have brought forth a man."
chapters.nkjv: Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and said, "I have acquired a man from the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD .

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൾ അവന്റെ അനുജനായ ഹാബെലിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു. ഹാബെൽ ആട്ടിടയനും കയീൻ കൃഷിക്കാരനും ആയിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.
chapters.nkjv: Then she bore again, this time his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
chapters.kjv: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

chapters.ml: കുറെക്കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു കയീൻ നിലത്തെ അനുഭവത്തിൽനിന്നു യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And in the process of time it came to pass that Cain brought an offering of the fruit of the ground to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഹാബെലും ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിലെ കടിഞ്ഞൂലുകളിൽനിന്നു, അവയുടെ മേദസ്സിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ, ഒരു വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു. യഹോവ ഹാബെലിലും അവന്റെ വഴിപാടിലും പ്രസാദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Abel also brought an offering—fat portions from some of the firstborn of his flock. The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
chapters.nkjv: Abel also brought of the firstborn of his flock and of their fat. And the Lord respected Abel and his offering,
chapters.kjv: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

chapters.ml: കയീനിലും അവന്റെ വഴിപാടിലും പ്രസാദിച്ചില്ല. കയീന്നു ഏറ്റവും കോപമുണ്ടായി, അവന്റെ മുഖം വാടി.
chapters.niv: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.
chapters.nkjv: but He did not respect Cain and his offering. And Cain was very angry, and his countenance fell.
chapters.kjv: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യഹോവ കയീനോടു: നീ കോപിക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? നിന്റെ മുഖം വാടുന്നതും എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why is your face downcast?
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord said to Cain, "Why are you angry? And why has your countenance fallen?
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

chapters.ml: നീ നന്മചെയ്യുന്നു എങ്കിൽ പ്രസാദമുണ്ടാകയില്ലയോ? നീ നന്മ ചെയ്യുന്നില്ലെങ്കിലോ പാപം വാതിൽക്കൽ കിടക്കുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ആഗ്രഹം നിങ്കലേക്കു ആകുന്നു; നീയോ അതിനെ കീഴടക്കേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires to have you, but you must rule over it."
chapters.nkjv: If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin lies at the door. And its desire is for you, but you should rule over it."
chapters.kjv: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ കയീൻ തന്റെ അനുജനായ ഹാബെലിനോടു: (നാം വയലിലേക്കു പോക എന്നു) പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ വയലിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ കയീൻ തന്റെ അനുജനായ ഹാബെലിനോടു കയർത്തു അവനെ കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let’s go out to the field." While they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.
chapters.nkjv: Now Cain talked with Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
chapters.kjv: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യഹോവ കയീനോടു: നിന്റെ അനുജനായ ഹാബെൽ എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല; ഞാൻ എന്റെ അനുജന്റെ കാവൽക്കാരനോ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" "I don’t know," he replied. "Am I my brother’s keeper?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Where is Abel your brother?" He said, "I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?"
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു. നീ എന്തു ചെയ്തു? നിന്റെ അനുജന്റെ രക്തത്തിന്റെ ശബ്ദം ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു എന്നോടു നിലവിളിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood cries out to me from the ground.
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.
chapters.kjv: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ അനുജന്റെ രക്തം നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു ഏറ്റുകൊൾവാൻ വായിതുറന്ന ദേശം നീ വിട്ടു ശാപഗ്രസ്തനായി പോകേണം.
chapters.niv: Now you are under a curse and driven from the ground, which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
chapters.nkjv: So now you are cursed from the earth, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
chapters.kjv: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand;

chapters.ml: നീ കൃഷി ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ നിലം ഇനിമേലാൽ തന്റെ വീര്യം നിനക്കു തരികയില്ല; നീ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഉഴന്നലയുന്നവൻ ആകും.
chapters.niv: When you work the ground, it will no longer yield its crops for you. You will be a restless wanderer on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: When you till the ground, it shall no longer yield its strength to you. A fugitive and a vagabond you shall be on the earth."
chapters.kjv: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

chapters.ml: കയീൻ യഹോവയോടു: എന്റെ കുറ്റം പൊറുപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ വലിയതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Cain said to the Lord , "My punishment is more than I can bear.
chapters.nkjv: And Cain said to the Lord, "My punishment is greater than I can bear!
chapters.kjv: And Cain said unto the LORD , My punishment is greater than I can bear.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, നീ ഇന്നു എന്നെ ആട്ടിക്കളയുന്നു; ഞാൻ തിരുസന്നിധിവിട്ടു ഒളിച്ചു ഭൂമിയിൽ ഉഴന്നലയുന്നവൻ ആകും; ആരെങ്കിലും എന്നെ കണ്ടാൽ, എന്നെ കൊല്ലും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Today you are driving me from the land, and I will be hidden from your presence; I will be a restless wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."
chapters.nkjv: Surely You have driven me out this day from the face of the ground; I shall be hidden from Your face; I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond on the earth, and it will happen that anyone who finds me will kill me."
chapters.kjv: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവനോടു: അതുകൊണ്ടു ആരെങ്കിലും കയീനെ കൊന്നാൽ അവന്നു ഏഴിരട്ടി പകരം കിട്ടും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു; കയീനെ കാണുന്നവർ ആരും കൊല്ലാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ അവന്നു ഒരു അടയാളം വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord said to him, "Not so ; anyone who kills Cain will suffer vengeance seven times over." Then the Lord put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would kill him.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to him, "Therefore, whoever kills Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold." And the Lord set a mark on Cain, lest anyone finding him should kill him.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ കയീൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഏദെന്നു കിഴക്കു നോദ് ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Cain went out from the Lord ’s presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
chapters.nkjv: Then Cain went out from the presence of the Lord and dwelt in the land of Nod on the east of Eden.
chapters.kjv: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD , and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

chapters.ml: കയീൻ തന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവൾ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഹാനോക്കിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു. അവൻ ഒരു പട്ടണം പണിതു, ഹാനോക്ക് എന്നു തന്റെ മകന്റെ പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Cain made love to his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was then building a city, and he named it after his son Enoch.
chapters.nkjv: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Ē´noch. And he built a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son—Ē´noch.
chapters.kjv: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

chapters.ml: ഹാനോക്കിന്നു ഈരാദ് ജനിച്ചു; ഈരാദ് മെഹൂയയേലിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; മെഹൂയയേൽ മെഥൂശയേലിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; മെഥൂശയേൽ ലാമെക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.
chapters.nkjv: To Ē´noch was born Irad; and Irad begot Mehujael, and Mehujael begot Methushael, and Methushael begot Lamech.
chapters.kjv: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

chapters.ml: ലാമെക്ക് രണ്ടു ഭാര്യമാരെ എടുത്തു; ഒരുത്തിക്കു ആദാ എന്നും മറ്റവൾക്കു സില്ലാ എന്നും പേർ.
chapters.niv: Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Lamech took for himself two wives: the name of one was Adah, and the name of the second was Zillah.
chapters.kjv: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

chapters.ml: ആദാ യാബാലിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവൻ കൂടാരവാസികൾക്കും പശുപാലകന്മാർക്കും പിതാവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.
chapters.nkjv: And Adah bore Jabal. He was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
chapters.kjv: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്നു യൂബാൽ എന്നു പേർ. ഇവൻ കിന്നരവും വേണുവും പ്രയോഗിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവർക്കും പിതാവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play stringed instruments and pipes.
chapters.nkjv: His brother’s name was Jubal. He was the father of all those who play the harp and flute.
chapters.kjv: And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

chapters.ml: സില്ലാ തൂബൽകയീനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവൻ ചെമ്പുകൊണ്ടും ഇരിമ്പുകൊണ്ടുമുള്ള ആയുധങ്ങളെ തീർക്കുന്നവനായ്തീർന്നു; തൂബൽകയീന്റെ പെങ്ങൾ നയമാ.
chapters.niv: Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.
chapters.nkjv: And as for Zillah, she also bore Tubal-Cain, an instructor of every craftsman in bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-Cain was Naamah.
chapters.kjv: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

chapters.ml: ലാമെക്ക് തന്റെ ഭാര്യമാരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ആദയും സില്ലയും ആയുള്ളോരേ, എന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾപ്പിൻ; ലാമെക്കിൻ ഭാര്യമാരേ, എന്റെ വചനത്തിന്നു ചെവി തരുവിൻ! എന്റെ മുറിവിന്നു പകരം ഞാൻ ഒരു പുരുഷനെയും, എന്റെ പരിക്കിന്നു പകരം ഒരു യുവാവിനെയും കൊല്ലും.
chapters.niv: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, listen to me; wives of Lamech, hear my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Lamech said to his wives: "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Wives of Lamech, listen to my speech! For I have killed a man for wounding me, Even a young man for hurting me.
chapters.kjv: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

chapters.ml: കയീന്നുവേണ്ടി ഏഴിരട്ടി പകരം ചെയ്യുമെങ്കിൽ, ലാമെക്കിന്നുവേണ്ടി എഴുപത്തേഴു ഇരട്ടി പകരം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech seventy-seven times."
chapters.nkjv: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Then Lamech seventy-sevenfold."
chapters.kjv: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

chapters.ml: ആദാം തന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ പിന്നെയും പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവൾ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു: കയീൻ കൊന്ന ഹാബെലിന്നു പകരം ദൈവം എനിക്കു മറ്റൊരു സന്തതിയെ തന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു ശേത്ത് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Adam made love to his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, "God has granted me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him."
chapters.nkjv: And Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and named him Seth, "For God has appointed another seed for me instead of Abel, whom Cain killed."
chapters.kjv: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

chapters.ml: ശേത്തിന്നും ഒരു മകൻ ജനിച്ചു; അവന്നു എനോശ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു. ആ കാലത്തു യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിലുള്ള ആരാധന തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And as for Seth, to him also a son was born; and he named him Ē´nosh. Then men began to call on the name of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ആദാമിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു: ദൈവം മനുഷ്യനെ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സാദൃശ്യത്തിൽ അവനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ആണും പെണ്ണുമായി അവരെ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: This is the written account of Adam’s family line. When God created mankind, he made them in the likeness of God.
chapters.nkjv: This is the book of the genealogy of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.
chapters.kjv: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

chapters.ml: സൃഷ്ടിച്ച നാളിൽ അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കയും അവർക്കു ആദാമെന്നു പേരിടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He created them male and female and blessed them. And he named them "Mankind" when they were created.
chapters.nkjv: He created them male and female, and blessed them and called them Mankind in the day they were created.
chapters.kjv: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

chapters.ml: ആദാമിനു നൂറ്റിമുപ്പതു വയസ്സായാപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ സാദൃശ്യത്തിൽ തന്റെ സ്വരൂപപ്രകാരം ഒരു മകനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അവന്നു ശേത്ത് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his own likeness, in his own image; and he named him Seth.
chapters.nkjv: And Adam lived one hundred and thirty years, and begot ason in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
chapters.kjv: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

chapters.ml: ശേത്തിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം ആദാം എണ്ണൂറു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരേയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Seth, the days of Adam were eight hundred years; and he had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: ആദാമിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ തൊള്ളായിരത്തി മുപ്പതു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

chapters.ml: ശേത്തിന്നു നൂറ്റഞ്ചു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ എനോശിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.
chapters.nkjv: Seth lived one hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.
chapters.kjv: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

chapters.ml: എനോശിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം ശേത്ത് എണ്ണൂറ്റേഴു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Enosh, Seth lived eight hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: ശേത്തിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ തൊള്ളായിരത്തി പന്ത്രണ്ടു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

chapters.ml: എനോശിന്നു തൊണ്ണൂറു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ കേനാനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.
chapters.nkjv: Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.
chapters.kjv: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

chapters.ml: കേനാനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം എനോശ് എണ്ണൂറ്റിപതിനഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he became the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Cainan, Enosh lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: എനോശിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ തൊള്ളായിരത്തഞ്ചു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

chapters.ml: കേനാന്നു എഴുപതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ മഹലലേലിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.
chapters.nkjv: Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalalel.
chapters.kjv: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

chapters.ml: മഹലലേലിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം കേനാൻ എണ്ണൂറ്റിനാല്പതു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Mahalalel, Cainan lived eight hundred and forty years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: കേനാന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ തൊള്ളായിരത്തി പത്തു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

chapters.ml: മഹലലേലിന്നു അറുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ യാരെദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.
chapters.nkjv: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and begot Jared.
chapters.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

chapters.ml: യാരെദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം മഹലലേൽ എണ്ണൂറ്റിമുപ്പതു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Jared, Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: മഹലലേലിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ എണ്ണൂറ്റി തൊണ്ണൂറ്റഞ്ചു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

chapters.ml: യാരെദിന്നു നൂറ്ററുപത്തിരണ്ടു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഹാനോക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.
chapters.nkjv: Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Enoch.
chapters.kjv: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

chapters.ml: ഹാനോക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം യാരെദ് എണ്ണൂറു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Enoch, Jared lived eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: യാരെദിന്റെ ആയൂഷ്കാലം ആകെ തൊള്ളായിരത്തറുപത്തിരണ്ടു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

chapters.ml: ഹാനോക്കിന്നു അറുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ മെഥൂശലഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.
chapters.nkjv: Enoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Methuselah.
chapters.kjv: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

chapters.ml: മെഥൂശലഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം ഹാനോക്ക് മൂന്നൂറു സംവത്സരം ദൈവത്തോടുകൂടെ നടക്കയും പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: After he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked faithfully with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Methuselah, Enoch walked with God three hundred years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: ഹനോക്കിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ മുന്നൂറ്ററുപത്തഞ്ചു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

chapters.ml: ഹാനോക്ക് ദൈവത്തോടുകൂടെ നടന്നു, ദൈവം അവനെ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടതിനാൽ കാണാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: Enoch walked faithfully with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.
chapters.nkjv: And Enoch walked with God; and he was not, for God took him.
chapters.kjv: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

chapters.ml: മെഥൂശലഹിന്നു നൂറ്റെണ്പത്തേഴു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ലാമേക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.
chapters.nkjv: Methuselah lived one hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lamech.
chapters.kjv: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

chapters.ml: ലാമേക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം മെഥൂശലഹ് എഴുനൂറ്റെണ്പത്തിരണ്ടു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Lamech, Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: മെഥൂശലഹിന്റെ ആയൂഷ്കാലം ആകെ തൊള്ളായിരത്തറുപത്തൊമ്പതു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

chapters.ml: ലാമേക്കിന്നു നൂറ്റെണ്പത്തിരണ്ടു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഒരു മകനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.
chapters.nkjv: Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-two years, and had a son.
chapters.kjv: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ശപിച്ച ഭൂമിയിൽ നമ്മുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിയിലും നമ്മുടെ കൈകളുടെ പ്രയത്നത്തിലും ഇവൻ നമ്മെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കുമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു നോഹ എന്നു പേർ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He named him Noah and said, "He will comfort us in the labor and painful toil of our hands caused by the ground the Lord has cursed."
chapters.nkjv: And he called his name Noah, saying, "This one will comfort us concerning our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord has cursed."
chapters.kjv: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

chapters.ml: നോഹയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം ലാമേക്ക് അഞ്ഞൂറ്റി തൊണ്ണൂറ്റഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Noah, Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five years, and had sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

chapters.ml: ലാമേക്കിന്റെ ആയൂഷ്കാലം ആകെ എഴുനൂറ്റെഴുപത്തേഴു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Altogether, Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

chapters.ml: നോഹെക്കു അഞ്ഞൂറു വയസ്സായശേഷം നോഹ ശേമിനെയും ഹാമിനെയും യാഫെത്തിനെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
chapters.nkjv: And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
chapters.kjv: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ പെരുകിത്തുടങ്ങി അവർക്കു പുത്രിമാർ ജനിച്ചപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: When human beings began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born to them,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ മനുഷ്യരുടെ പുത്രിമാരെ സൌന്ദര്യമുള്ളവരെന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു തങ്ങൾക്കു ബോധിച്ച ഏവരെയും ഭാര്യമാരായി എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: the sons of God saw that the daughters of humans were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.
chapters.nkjv: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men, that they were beautiful; and they took wives for themselves of all whom they chose.
chapters.kjv: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ: മനുഷ്യനിൽ എന്റെ ആത്മാവു സദാകാലവും വാദിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കയില്ല; അവൻ ജഡം തന്നേയല്ലോ; എങ്കിലും അവന്റെ കാലം നൂറ്റിരുപതു സംവത്സരമാകും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said, "My Spirit will not contend with humans forever, for they are mortal ; their days will be a hundred and twenty years."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "My Spirit shall not strive with man forever, for he is indeed flesh; yet his days shall be one hundred and twenty years."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു ഭൂമിയിൽ മല്ലന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ശേഷവും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ മനുഷ്യരുടെ പുത്രിമാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നിട്ടു അവർ മക്കളെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; ഇവരാകുന്നു പുരാതനകാലത്തെ വീരന്മാർ, കീർത്തിപ്പെട്ട പുരുഷന്മാർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and also afterward—when the sons of God went to the daughters of humans and had children by them. They were the heroes of old, men of renown.
chapters.nkjv: There were giants on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men and they bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
chapters.kjv: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ മനുഷ്യന്റെ ദുഷ്ടത വലിയതെന്നും അവന്റെ ഹൃദയവിചാരങ്ങളുടെ നിരൂപണമൊക്കെയും എല്ലായ്പോഴും ദോഷമുള്ളതത്രേ എന്നും യഹോവ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The Lord saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intent of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
chapters.kjv: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

chapters.ml: താൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ മനുഷ്യനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കുകകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ അനുതപിച്ചു; അതു അവന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിന്നു ദുഃഖമായി:
chapters.niv: The Lord regretted that he had made human beings on the earth, and his heart was deeply troubled.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord was sorry that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
chapters.kjv: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള മനുഷ്യനെ ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളയും; മനുഷ്യനെയും മൃഗത്തെയും ഇഴജാതിയെയും ആകാശത്തിലെ പക്ഷികളെയും തന്നേ; അവയെ ഉണ്ടാക്കുകകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അനുതപിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord said, "I will wipe from the face of the earth the human race I have created—and with them the animals, the birds and the creatures that move along the ground—for I regret that I have made them."
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord said, "I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth, both man and beast, creeping thing and birds of the air, for I am sorry that I have made them."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നോഹെക്കു യഹോവയുടെ കൃപ ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD .

chapters.ml: നോഹയുടെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യം എന്തെന്നാൽ: നോഹ നീതിമാനും തന്റെ തലമുറയിൽ നിഷ്കളങ്കനുമായിരുന്നു; നോഹ ദൈവത്തോടുകൂടെ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is the account of Noah and his family. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, and he walked faithfully with God.
chapters.nkjv: This is the genealogy of Noah. Noah was a just man, perfect in his generations. Noah walked with God.
chapters.kjv: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

chapters.ml: ശേം, ഹാം, യാഫെത്ത് എന്ന മൂന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെ നോഹ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
chapters.nkjv: And Noah begot three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
chapters.kjv: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഭൂമി ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ വഷളായി; ഭൂമി അതിക്രമംകൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight and was full of violence.
chapters.nkjv: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
chapters.kjv: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ഭൂമിയെ നോക്കി, അതു വഷളായി എന്നു കണ്ടു; സകലജഡവും ഭൂമിയിൽ തന്റെ വഴി വഷളാക്കിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.
chapters.nkjv: So God looked upon the earth, and indeed it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നോഹയോടു കല്പിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ: സകലജഡത്തിന്റെയും അവസാനം എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഭൂമി അവരാൽ അതിക്രമംകൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ അവരെ ഭൂമിയോടുകൂടെ നശിപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: So God said to Noah, "I am going to put an end to all people, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am surely going to destroy both them and the earth.
chapters.nkjv: And God said to Noah, "The end of all flesh has come before Me, for the earth is filled with violence through them; and behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
chapters.kjv: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

chapters.ml: നീ ഗോഫർമരംകൊണ്ടു ഒരു പെട്ടകംഉണ്ടാക്കുക; പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു അറകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി, അകത്തും പുറത്തും കീൽ തേക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: So make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in it and coat it with pitch inside and out.
chapters.nkjv: Make yourself an ark of gopherwood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and outside with pitch.
chapters.kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

chapters.ml: അതു ഉണ്ടാക്കേണ്ടതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നാൽ: പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ നീളം മുന്നൂറു മുഴം; വീതി അമ്പതു മുഴം; ഉയരം മുപ്പതു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: This is how you are to build it: The ark is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.
chapters.nkjv: And this is how you shall make it: The length of the ark shallbe three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
chapters.kjv: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
