chapters.ml: പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു കിളിവാതിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കേണം; മേൽനിന്നു ഒരു മുഴം താഴെ അതിനെ വെക്കേണം; പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽ അതിന്റെ വശത്തുവെക്കേണം: താഴത്തെയും രണ്ടാമത്തെയും മൂന്നാമത്തെയും തട്ടായി അതിനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Make a roof for it, leaving below the roof an opening one cubit high all around. Put a door in the side of the ark and make lower, middle and upper decks.
chapters.nkjv: You shall make a window for the ark, and you shall finish it to a cubit from above; and set the door of the ark in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third decks.
chapters.kjv: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.

chapters.ml: ആകാശത്തിൻ കീഴിൽനിന്നു ജീവശ്വാസമുള്ള സർവ്വജഡത്തെയും നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഒരു ജലപ്രളയം വരുത്തും; ഭൂമിയിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും നശിച്ചുപോകും.
chapters.niv: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all life under the heavens, every creature that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will perish.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, I Myself am bringing floodwaters on the earth, to destroy from under heaven all flesh in which is the breath of life; everything that is on the earth shall die.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

chapters.ml: നിന്നോടോ ഞാൻ ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്യും; നീയും നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും ഭാര്യയും പുത്രന്മാരുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കടക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
chapters.nkjv: But I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall go into the ark—you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
chapters.kjv: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons’ wives with thee.

chapters.ml: സകല ജീവികളിൽനിന്നും, സർവ്വജഡത്തിൽനിന്നും തന്നേ, ഈരണ്ടീരണ്ടിനെ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ജീവരക്ഷെക്കായിട്ടു പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കയറ്റേണം; അവ ആണും പെണ്ണുമായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to bring into the ark two of all living creatures, male and female, to keep them alive with you.
chapters.nkjv: And of every living thing of all flesh you shall bring two of every sort into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.
chapters.kjv: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

chapters.ml: അതതു തരം പക്ഷികളിൽനിന്നും അതതു തരം മൃഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും ഭൂമിയിലെ അതതു തരം ഇഴജാതികളിൽനിന്നൊക്കെയും ഈരണ്ടീരണ്ടു ജീവ രക്ഷെക്കായിട്ടു നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരേണം.
chapters.niv: Two of every kind of bird, of every kind of animal and of every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you to be kept alive.
chapters.nkjv: Of the birds after their kind, of animals after their kind, and of every creeping thing of the earth after its kind, two of every kind will come to you to keep them alive.
chapters.kjv: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.

chapters.ml: നീയോ സകലഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും വേണ്ടുന്നതു എടുത്തു സംഗ്രഹിച്ചുകൊള്ളേണം; അതു നിനക്കും അവെക്കും ആഹാരമായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to take every kind of food that is to be eaten and store it away as food for you and for them."
chapters.nkjv: And you shall take for yourself of all food that is eaten, and you shall gather it to yourself; and it shall be food for you and for them."
chapters.kjv: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും നോഹ ചെയ്തു; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവൻ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Noah did; according to all that God commanded him, so he did.
chapters.kjv: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ നോഹയോടു കല്പിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നീയും സർവ്വകുടുംബവുമായി പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കടക്ക; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ഈ തലമുറയിൽ എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നീതിമാനായി കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord then said to Noah, "Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Noah, "Come into the ark, you and all your household, because I have seen that you are righteous before Me in this generation.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

chapters.ml: ശുദ്ധിയുള്ള സകലമൃഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും ആണും പെണ്ണുമായി ഏഴേഴും, ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത മൃഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു ആണും പെണ്ണുമായി ഈരണ്ടും,
chapters.niv: Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate,
chapters.nkjv: You shall take with you seven each of every clean animal, a male and his female; two each of animals that are unclean, a male and his female;
chapters.kjv: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

chapters.ml: ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവകളിൽനിന്നു പൂവനും പിടയുമായി ഏഴേഴും, ഭൂമിയിലൊക്കെയും സന്തതി ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ ചേർത്തുകൊള്ളേണം.
chapters.niv: and also seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth.
chapters.nkjv: also seven each of birds of the air, male and female, to keep the species alive on the face of all the earth.
chapters.kjv: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

chapters.ml: ഇനി ഏഴുദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഞാൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ നാല്പതു രാവും നാല്പതു പകലും മഴ പെയ്യിക്കും; ഞാൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കീട്ടുള്ള സകല ജീവജാലങ്ങളെയും ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു നശിപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living creature I have made."
chapters.nkjv: For after seven more days I will cause it to rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will destroy from the face of the earth all living things that I have made."
chapters.kjv: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചപ്രകാരമൊക്കെയും നോഹ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And Noah did all that the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: And Noah did according to all that the Lord commanded him.
chapters.kjv: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ ജലപ്രളയം ഉണ്ടായപ്പോൾ നോഹെക്കു അറുനൂറു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters were on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

chapters.ml: നോഹയും പുത്രന്മാരും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയും പുത്രന്മാരുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും ജലപ്രളയം നിമിത്തം പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
chapters.nkjv: So Noah, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, went into the ark because of the waters of the flood.
chapters.kjv: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

chapters.ml: ശുദ്ധിയുള്ള മൃഗങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത മൃഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും പറവകളിൽനിന്നും ഭൂമിയിലുള്ള ഇഴജാതിയിൽനിന്നൊക്കെയും,
chapters.niv: Pairs of clean and unclean animals, of birds and of all creatures that move along the ground,
chapters.nkjv: Of clean animals, of animals that are unclean, of birds, and of everything that creeps on the earth,
chapters.kjv: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നോഹയോടു കല്പിച്ചപ്രകാരം ഈരണ്ടീരണ്ടു ആണും പെണ്ണുമായി നോഹയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: male and female, came to Noah and entered the ark, as God had commanded Noah.
chapters.nkjv: two by two they went into the ark to Noah, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
chapters.kjv: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം ഭൂമിയിൽ ജലപ്രളയം തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: And after the seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass after seven days that the waters of the flood were on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

chapters.ml: നോഹയുടെ ആയുസ്സിന്റെ അറുനൂറാം സംവത്സരത്തിൽ രണ്ടാം മാസം പതിനേഴാം തിയ്യതി, അന്നുതന്നേ ആഴിയുടെ ഉറവുകൾ ഒക്കെയും പിളർന്നു; ആകാശത്തിന്റെ കിളിവാതിലുകളും തുറന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month—on that day all the springs of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
chapters.nkjv: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
chapters.kjv: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

chapters.ml: നാല്പതു രാവും നാല്പതു പകലും ഭൂമിയിൽ മഴ പെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.
chapters.nkjv: And the rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.
chapters.kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

chapters.ml: അന്നുതന്നേ നോഹയും നോഹയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ശേമും ഹാമും യാഫേത്തും നോഹയുടെ ഭാര്യയും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ മൂന്നു ഭാര്യമാരും പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons, entered the ark.
chapters.nkjv: On the very same day Noah and Noah’s sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark—
chapters.kjv: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

chapters.ml: അവരും അതതു തരം കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളും അതതു തരം കന്നുകാലികളും നിലത്തിഴയുന്ന അതതുതരം ഇഴജാതിയും അതതു തരം പറവകളും അതതു തരം പക്ഷികളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: They had with them every wild animal according to its kind, all livestock according to their kinds, every creature that moves along the ground according to its kind and every bird according to its kind, everything with wings.
chapters.nkjv: they and every beast after its kind, all cattle after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
chapters.kjv: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

chapters.ml: ജീവശ്വാസമുള്ള സർവ്വജഡത്തിൽനിന്നും ഈരണ്ടീരണ്ടു നോഹയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Pairs of all creatures that have the breath of life in them came to Noah and entered the ark.
chapters.nkjv: And they went into the ark to Noah, two by two, of all flesh in which is the breath of life.
chapters.kjv: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അകത്തുകടന്നവ സർവ്വജഡത്തിൽനിന്നും ആണും പെണ്ണുമായി കടന്നു; യഹോവ വാതിൽ അടെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The animals going in were male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the Lord shut him in.
chapters.nkjv: So those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him; and the Lord shut him in.
chapters.kjv: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ നാല്പതു ദിവസം ജലപ്രളയം ഉണ്ടായി, വെള്ളം വർദ്ധിച്ചു പെട്ടകം പൊങ്ങി, നിലത്തുനിന്നു ഉയർന്നു.
chapters.niv: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and as the waters increased they lifted the ark high above the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Now the flood was on the earth forty days. The waters increased and lifted up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.
chapters.kjv: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം പൊങ്ങി ഭൂമിയിൽ ഏറ്റവും പെരുകി; പെട്ടകം വെള്ളത്തിൽ ഒഴുകിത്തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
chapters.nkjv: The waters prevailed and greatly increased on the earth, and the ark moved about on the surface of the waters.
chapters.kjv: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം ഭൂമിയിൽഅത്യധികം പൊങ്ങി, ആകാശത്തിൻ കീഴെങ്ങമുള്ള ഉയർന്ന പർവ്വതങ്ങളൊക്കെയും മൂടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.
chapters.nkjv: And the waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth, and all the high hills under the whole heaven were covered.
chapters.kjv: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.

chapters.ml: പർവ്വതങ്ങൾ മൂടുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം വെള്ളം പതിനഞ്ചു മുഴം അവെക്കു മീതെ പൊങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The waters rose and covered the mountains to a depth of more than fifteen cubits.
chapters.nkjv: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.
chapters.kjv: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

chapters.ml: പറവകളും കന്നുകാലികളും കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളും നിലത്തു ഇഴയുന്ന എല്ലാ ഇഴജാതിയുമായി ഭൂചരജഡമൊക്കെയും സകലമനുഷ്യരും ചത്തുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Every living thing that moved on land perished—birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all mankind.
chapters.nkjv: And all flesh died that moved on the earth: birds and cattle and beasts and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
chapters.kjv: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

chapters.ml: കരയിലുള്ള സകലത്തിലും മൂക്കിൽ ജീവശ്വാസമുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ചത്തു.
chapters.niv: Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
chapters.nkjv: All in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, all that was on the dry land, died.
chapters.kjv: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land , died.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ മനുഷ്യനും മൃഗങ്ങളും ഇഴജാതിയും ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവകളുമായി ഭൂമിയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന സകലജീവജാലങ്ങളും നശിച്ചുപോയി; അവ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു നശിച്ചുപോയി; നോഹയും അവനോടുകൂടെ പെട്ടകത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നവരും മാത്രം ശേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Every living thing on the face of the earth was wiped out; people and animals and the creatures that move along the ground and the birds were wiped from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.
chapters.nkjv: So He destroyed all living things which were on the face of the ground: both man and cattle, creeping thing and bird of the air. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah and those who were with him in the ark remained alive.
chapters.kjv: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive , and they that were with him in the ark.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം ഭൂമിയിൽ നൂറ്റമ്പതു ദിവസം പൊങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.
chapters.nkjv: And the waters prevailed on the earth one hundred and fifty days.
chapters.kjv: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നോഹയെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ പെട്ടകത്തിൽ ഉള്ള സകല ജീവികളെയും സകലമൃഗങ്ങളെയും ഓർത്തു; ദൈവം ഭൂമിമേൽ ഒരു കാറ്റു അടിപ്പിച്ചു; വെള്ളം നിലെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and the livestock that were with him in the ark, and he sent a wind over the earth, and the waters receded.
chapters.nkjv: Then God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the animals that were with him in the ark. And God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.
chapters.kjv: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

chapters.ml: ആഴിയുടെ ഉറവുകളും ആകാശത്തിന്റെ കിളിവാതിലുകളും അടഞ്ഞു; ആകാശത്തുനിന്നുള്ള മഴയും നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens had been closed, and the rain had stopped falling from the sky.
chapters.nkjv: The fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were also stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.
chapters.kjv: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം ഇടവിടാതെ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; നൂറ്റമ്പതു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം വെള്ളം കുറഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The water receded steadily from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the water had gone down,
chapters.nkjv: And the waters receded continually from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters decreased.
chapters.kjv: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം മാസം പതിനേഴാം തിയ്യതി പെട്ടകം അരരാത്ത് പർവ്വതത്തിൽ ഉറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
chapters.nkjv: Then the ark rested in the seventh month, the seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.
chapters.kjv: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

chapters.ml: പത്താം മാസം വരെ വെള്ളം ഇടവിടാതെ കുറഞ്ഞു; പത്താം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി പർവ്വതശിഖരങ്ങൾ കാണായി.
chapters.niv: The waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.
chapters.nkjv: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.
chapters.kjv: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month , on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

chapters.ml: നാല്പതു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം നോഹ താൻ പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന കിളിവാതിൽ തുറന്നു.
chapters.niv: After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark
chapters.nkjv: So it came to pass, at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു മലങ്കാക്കയെ പുറത്തു വിട്ടു; അതു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഭൂമിയിൽ വെള്ളം വറ്റിപ്പോയതു വരെ പോയും വന്നും കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Then he sent out a raven, which kept going to and fro until the waters had dried up from the earth.
chapters.kjv: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ വെള്ളം കുറഞ്ഞുവോ എന്നു അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ഒരു പ്രാവിനെയും തന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു പുറത്തു വിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.
chapters.nkjv: He also sent out from himself a dove, to see if the waters had receded from the face of the ground.
chapters.kjv: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സർവ്വഭൂമിയിലും വെള്ളം കിടക്കകൊണ്ടു പ്രാവു കാൽ വെപ്പാൻ സ്ഥലം കാണാതെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പെട്ടകത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവന്നു; അവൻ കൈനീട്ടി അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പെട്ടകത്തിൽ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark.
chapters.nkjv: But the dove found no resting place for the sole of her foot, and she returned into the ark to him, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took her, and drew her into the ark to himself.
chapters.kjv: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ വീണ്ടും ആ പ്രാവിനെ പെട്ടകത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറത്തു വിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.
chapters.nkjv: And he waited yet another seven days, and again he sent the dove out from the ark.
chapters.kjv: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

chapters.ml: പ്രാവു വൈകുന്നേരത്തു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അതിന്റെ വായിൽ അതാ, ഒരു പച്ച ഒലിവില; അതിനാൽ ഭൂമിയിൽ വെള്ളം കുറഞ്ഞു എന്നു നോഹ അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Then the dove came to him in the evening, and behold, a freshly plucked olive leaf was in her mouth; and Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.
chapters.kjv: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ഏഴു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ ആ പ്രാവിനെ പുറത്തു വിട്ടു; അതു പിന്നെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങി വന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.
chapters.nkjv: So he waited yet another seven days and sent out the dove, which did not return again to him anymore.
chapters.kjv: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

chapters.ml: ആറുനൂറ്റൊന്നാം സംവത്സരം ഒന്നാം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി ഭൂമിയിൽ വെള്ളം വറ്റിപ്പോയിരുന്നു; നോഹ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മേല്ത്തട്ടു നീക്കി, ഭൂതലം ഉണങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: By the first day of the first month of Noah’s six hundred and first year, the water had dried up from the earth. Noah then removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, that the waters were dried up from the earth; and Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and indeed the surface of the ground was dry.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month , the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം മാസം ഇരുപത്തേഴാം തിയ്യതി ഭൂമി ഉണങ്ങിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.
chapters.nkjv: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dried.
chapters.kjv: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നോഹയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: Then God said to Noah,
chapters.nkjv: Then God spoke to Noah, saying,
chapters.kjv: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

chapters.ml: നീയും നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയും പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രന്മാരുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും പെട്ടകത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറത്തിറങ്ങുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and their wives.
chapters.nkjv: "Go out of the ark, you and your wife, and your sons and your sons’ wives with you.
chapters.kjv: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.

chapters.ml: പറവകളും മൃഗങ്ങളും നിലത്തു ഇഴയുന്ന ഇഴജാതിയുമായ സർവ്വജഡത്തിൽനിന്നും നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കുന്ന സകല ജീവികളെയും പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരിക; അവ ഭൂമിയിൽ അനവധിയായി വർദ്ധിക്കയും പെറ്റു പെരുകുകയും ചെയ്യട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Bring out every kind of living creature that is with you—the birds, the animals, and all the creatures that move along the ground—so they can multiply on the earth and be fruitful and increase in number on it."
chapters.nkjv: Bring out with you every living thing of all flesh that is with you: birds and cattle and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, so that they may abound on the earth, and be fruitful and multiply on the earth."
chapters.kjv: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നോഹയും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും ഭാര്യയും പുത്രന്മാരുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും പുറത്തിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: So Noah came out, together with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
chapters.nkjv: So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives with him.
chapters.kjv: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:

chapters.ml: സകല മൃഗങ്ങളും ഇഴജാതികൾ ഒക്കെയും എല്ലാ പറവകളും ഭൂചരങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ജാതിജാതിയായി പെട്ടകത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: All the animals and all the creatures that move along the ground and all the birds—everything that moves on land—came out of the ark, one kind after another.
chapters.nkjv: Every animal, every creeping thing, every bird, and whatever creeps on the earth, according to their families, went out of the ark.
chapters.kjv: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

chapters.ml: നോഹ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു, ശുദ്ധിയുള്ള സകല മൃഗങ്ങളിലും ശുദ്ധിയുള്ള എല്ലാപറവകളിലും ചിലതു എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ഹോമയാഗം അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord and, taking some of all the clean animals and clean birds, he sacrificed burnt offerings on it.
chapters.nkjv: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord, and took of every clean animal and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD ; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സൌരഭ്യവാസന മണത്തപ്പോൾ യഹോവ തന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: ഞാൻ മനുഷ്യന്റെ നിമിത്തം ഇനി ഭൂമിയെ ശപിക്കയില്ല. മനുഷ്യന്റെ മനോനിരൂപണം ബാല്യംമുതൽ ദോഷമുള്ളതു ആകുന്നു; ഞാൻ ചെയ്തതു പോലെ സകല ജീവികളെയും ഇനി നശിപ്പിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Lord smelled the pleasing aroma and said in his heart: "Never again will I curse the ground because of humans, even though every inclination of the human heart is evil from childhood. And never again will I destroy all living creatures, as I have done.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord smelled a soothing aroma. Then the Lord said in His heart, "I will never again curse the ground for man’s sake, although the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; nor will I again destroy every living thing as I have done.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയുള്ള കാലത്തോളം വിതയും കൊയിത്തും, ശീതവും ഉഷ്ണവും, വേനലും വർഷവും, രാവും പകലും നിന്നുപോകയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease."
chapters.nkjv: "While the earth remains, Seedtime and harvest, Cold and heat, Winter and summer, And day and night Shall not cease."
chapters.kjv: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നോഹയെയും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവരോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവരായി പെരുകി ഭൂമിയിൽ നിറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.
chapters.nkjv: So God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them: "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.
chapters.kjv: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെയുള്ള പേടിയും നടുക്കവും ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലമൃഗങ്ങൾക്കും ആകാശത്തിലെ എല്ലാ പറവകൾക്കും സകല ഭൂചരങ്ങൾക്കും സുമദ്രത്തിലെ സകലമത്സ്യങ്ങൾക്കും ഉണ്ടാകും; അവയെ നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The fear and dread of you will fall on all the beasts of the earth, and on all the birds in the sky, on every creature that moves along the ground, and on all the fish in the sea; they are given into your hands.
chapters.nkjv: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be on every beast of the earth, on every bird of the air, on all that move on the earth, and on all the fish of the sea. They are given into your hand.
chapters.kjv: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

chapters.ml: ഭൂചരജന്തുക്കളൊക്കെയും നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആഹാരം ആയിരിക്കട്ടെ; പച്ച സസ്യംപോലെ ഞാൻ സകലവും നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Everything that lives and moves about will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.
chapters.nkjv: Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you. I have given you all things, even as the green herbs.
chapters.kjv: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

chapters.ml: പ്രാണനായിരിക്കുന്ന രക്തത്തോടുകൂടെ മാത്രം നിങ്ങൾ മാംസം തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: "But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it.
chapters.nkjv: But you shall not eat flesh with its life, thatis, its blood.
chapters.kjv: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാണാനായിരിക്കുന്ന നിങ്ങളുടെ രക്തത്തിന്നു ഞാൻ പകരം ചോദിക്കും; സകലമൃഗത്തോടും മനുഷ്യനോടും ചോദിക്കും; അവനവന്റെ സഹോദരനോടും ഞാൻ മനുഷ്യന്റെ പ്രാണന്നു പകരം ചോദിക്കും.
chapters.niv: And for your lifeblood I will surely demand an accounting. I will demand an accounting from every animal. And from each human being, too, I will demand an accounting for the life of another human being.
chapters.nkjv: Surely for your lifeblood I will demand areckoning; from the hand of every beast I will require it, and from the hand of man. From the hand of every man’s brother I will require the life of man.
chapters.kjv: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും മനുഷ്യന്റെ രക്തം ചൊരിയിച്ചാൽ അവന്റെ രക്തം മനുഷ്യൻ ചൊരിയിക്കും; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സ്വരൂപത്തിലല്ലോ മനുഷ്യനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതു.
chapters.niv: "Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made mankind.
chapters.nkjv: "Whoever sheds man’s blood, By man his blood shall be shed; For in the image of God He made man.
chapters.kjv: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവരായി പെരുകുവിൻ; ഭൂമിയിൽ അനവധിയായി പെറ്റു പെരുകുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: As for you, be fruitful and increase in number; multiply on the earth and increase upon it."
chapters.nkjv: And as for you, be fruitful and multiply; Bring forth abundantly in the earth And multiply in it."
chapters.kjv: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം പിന്നെയും നോഹയോടും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:
chapters.nkjv: Then God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying:
chapters.kjv: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ, ഇതാ, നിങ്ങളോടും നിങ്ങളുടെ സന്തതിയോടും
chapters.niv: "I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you
chapters.nkjv: "And as for Me, behold, I establish My covenant with you and with your descendants after you,
chapters.kjv: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉള്ള പക്ഷികളും കന്നുകാലികളും കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളുമായ സകല ജീവജന്തുക്കളോടും പെട്ടകത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട സകലവുമായി ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലമൃഗങ്ങളോടും ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you—every living creature on earth.
chapters.nkjv: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the cattle, and every beast of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ark, every beast of the earth.
chapters.kjv: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

chapters.ml: ഇനി സകലജഡവും ജലപ്രളയത്താൽ നശിക്കയില്ല; ഭൂമിയെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ഇനി ജലപ്രളയം ഉണ്ടാകയുമില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I establish my covenant with you: Never again will all life be destroyed by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth."
chapters.nkjv: Thus I establish My covenant with you: Never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood; never again shall there be a flood to destroy the earth."
chapters.kjv: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ദൈവം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: ഞാനും നിങ്ങളും നിങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ ഉള്ള സകലജീവജന്തുക്കളും തമ്മിൽ തലമുറതലമുറയോളം സദാകാലത്തേക്കും ചെയ്യുന്ന നിയമത്തിന്റെ അടയാളം ആവിതു:
chapters.niv: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:
chapters.nkjv: And God said: "This is the sign of the covenant which I make between Me and you, and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
chapters.kjv: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ വില്ലു മേഘത്തിൽ വെക്കുന്നു; അതു ഞാനും ഭൂമിയും തമ്മിലുള്ള നിയമത്തിന്നു അടയാളമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
chapters.nkjv: I set My rainbow in the cloud, and it shall be for the sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
chapters.kjv: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഭൂമിയുടെ മീതെ മേഘം വരുത്തുമ്പോൾ മേഘത്തിൽ വില്ലു കാണും.
chapters.niv: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
chapters.nkjv: It shall be, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow shall be seen in the cloud;
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഞാനും നിങ്ങളും സർവ്വജഡവുമായ സകലജീവജന്തുക്കളും തമ്മിലുള്ള എന്റെ നിയമം ഞാൻ ഓർക്കും; ഇനി സകല ജഡത്തെയും നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ വെള്ളം ഒരു പ്രളയമായി തീരുകയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
chapters.nkjv: and I will remember My covenant which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; the waters shall never again become a flood to destroy all flesh.
chapters.kjv: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

chapters.ml: വില്ലു മേഘത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടാകും; ദൈവവും ഭൂമിയിലെ സർവ്വ ജഡവുമായ സകല ജീവികളും തമ്മിൽ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ള നിയമം ഓർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അതിനെ നോക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and all living creatures of every kind on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: The rainbow shall be in the cloud, and I will look on it to remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഭൂമിയിലുള്ള സർവ്വ ജഡത്തോടും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന നിയമത്തിന്നു ഇതു അടയാളം എന്നും ദൈവം നോഹയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all life on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: And God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടകത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടവരായ നോഹയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ ശേമും ഹാമും യാഫെത്തും ആയിരുന്നു; ഹാം എന്നവനോ കനാന്റെ പിതാവു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)
chapters.nkjv: Now the sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ മൂവരും നോഹയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ; അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു ഭൂമി ഒക്കെയും നിറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the whole earth.
chapters.nkjv: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
chapters.kjv: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

chapters.ml: നോഹ കൃഷിചെയ്‍വാൻ തുടങ്ങി; ഒരു മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടം നട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
chapters.nkjv: And Noah began tobe a farmer, and he planted a vineyard.
chapters.kjv: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിലെ വീഞ്ഞുകുടിച്ചു ലഹരിപിടിച്ചു തന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ വസ്ത്രം നീങ്ങി കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and lay uncovered inside his tent.
chapters.nkjv: Then he drank of the wine and was drunk, and became uncovered in his tent.
chapters.kjv: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

chapters.ml: കനാന്റെ പിതാവായ ഹാം പിതാവിന്റെ നഗ്നത കണ്ടു വെളിയിൽ ചെന്നു തന്റെ രണ്ടു സഹോദരന്മാരെയും അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father naked and told his two brothers outside.
chapters.nkjv: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
chapters.kjv: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

chapters.ml: ശേമും യാഫെത്തും ഒരു വസ്ത്രം എടുത്തു, ഇരുവരുടെയും തോളിൽ ഇട്ടു വിമുഖരായി ചെന്നു പിതാവിന്റെ നഗ്നത മറെച്ചു; അവരുടെ മുഖം തിരിഞ്ഞിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ പിതാവിന്റെ നഗ്നത കണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it across their shoulders; then they walked in backward and covered their father’s naked body. Their faces were turned the other way so that they would not see their father naked.
chapters.nkjv: But Shem and Japheth took a garment, laid it on both their shoulders, and went backward and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father’s nakedness.
chapters.kjv: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.

chapters.ml: നോഹ ലഹരിവിട്ടുണർന്നപ്പോൾ തന്റെ ഇളയ മകൻ ചെയ്തതു അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Noah awoke from his wine and found out what his youngest son had done to him,
chapters.nkjv: So Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done to him.
chapters.kjv: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: കനാൻ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ; അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു അധമദാസനായ്തീരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he said, "Cursed be Canaan! The lowest of slaves will he be to his brothers."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said: "Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants He shall be to his brethren."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

chapters.ml: ശേമിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ സ്തുതിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ; കനാൻ അവരുടെ ദാസനാകും.
chapters.niv: He also said, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Shem! May Canaan be the slave of Shem.
chapters.nkjv: And he said: "Blessed be the Lord, The God of Shem, And may Canaan be his servant.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം യാഫെത്തിനെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ; അവൻ ശേമിന്റെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിൽ വസിക്കും; കനാൻ അവരുടെ ദാസനാകും എന്നും അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: May God extend Japheth’s territory; may Japheth live in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be the slave of Japheth."
chapters.nkjv: May God enlarge Japheth, And may he dwell in the tents of Shem; And may Canaan be his servant."
chapters.kjv: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

chapters.ml: ജലപ്രളയത്തിന്റെ ശേഷം നോഹ മുന്നൂറ്റമ്പതു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.
chapters.nkjv: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
chapters.kjv: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

chapters.ml: നോഹയുടെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ തൊള്ളായിരത്തമ്പതു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
chapters.nkjv: So all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years; and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

chapters.ml: നോഹയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ശേം, ഹാം, യാഫെത്ത് എന്നവരുടെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു: ജലപ്രളയത്തിന്റെ ശേഷം അവർക്കു പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This is the account of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah’s sons, who themselves had sons after the flood.
chapters.nkjv: Now this is the genealogy of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.
chapters.kjv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

chapters.ml: യാഫെത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഗോമെർ, മാഗോഗ്, മാദായി, യാവാൻ, തൂബൽ, മേശെക്, തീരാസ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

chapters.ml: ഗോമെരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അസ്കെനാസ്, രീഫത്ത്, തോഗർമ്മാ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

chapters.ml: യാവാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: എലീശാ, തർശീശ്, കിത്തീം, ദോദാനീം.
chapters.niv: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

chapters.ml: ഇവരാൽ ജാതികളുടെ ദ്വീപുകൾ അതതു ദേശത്തിൽ ഭാഷഭാഷയായും ജാതിജാതിയായും കുലംകുലമായും പിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: (From these the maritime peoples spread out into their territories by their clans within their nations, each with its own language.)
chapters.nkjv: From these the coastland peoples of the Gentiles were separated into their lands, everyone according to his language, according to their families, into their nations.
chapters.kjv: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

chapters.ml: ഹാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: കൂശ്, മിസ്രയീം, പൂത്ത്, കനാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

chapters.ml: കൂശിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സെബാ, ഹവീലാ, സബ്താ, രമാ, സബ്തെക്കാ; രമയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശെബയും ദെദാനും.
chapters.niv: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabtechah; and the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

chapters.ml: കൂശ് നിമ്രോദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അവൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ആദ്യവീരനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നായാട്ടു വീരനായിരുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു: യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നിമ്രോദിനെപ്പോലെ നായാട്ടു വീരൻ എന്നു പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലായി.
chapters.niv: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord ; that is why it is said, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord; therefore it is said, "Like Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord."
chapters.kjv: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD : wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭം ശിനാർദേശത്തു ബാബേൽ, ഏരെക്ക്, അക്കാദ്, കൽനേ എന്നിവ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The first centers of his kingdom were Babylon, Uruk, Akkad and Kalneh, in Shinar.
chapters.nkjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
chapters.kjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

chapters.ml: ആ ദേശത്തനിന്നു അശ്ശൂർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു നീനവേ, രെഹോബോത്ത്‌ പട്ടണം, കാലഹ്,
chapters.niv: From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah
chapters.nkjv: From that land he went to Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
chapters.kjv: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

chapters.ml: നീനവെക്കും കാലഹിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ മഹാനഗരമായ രേശെൻ എന്നിവ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah—which is the great city.
chapters.nkjv: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (that is the principal city).
chapters.kjv: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമോ; ലൂദീം, അനാമീം, ലെഹാബീം, നഫ്തൂഹീം, പത്രൂസീം, കസ്ളൂഹീം--
chapters.niv: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
chapters.nkjv: Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
chapters.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

chapters.ml: ഇവരിൽനിന്നു ഫെലിസ്ഥ്യർ ഉത്ഭവിച്ചു-- കഫ്തോരീം എന്നിവരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.
chapters.nkjv: Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines and Caphtorim).
chapters.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.

chapters.ml: കനാൻ തന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ സീദോൻ, ഹേത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
chapters.nkjv: Canaan begot Sidon his firstborn, and Heth;
chapters.kjv: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

chapters.ml: യെബൂസ്യൻ, അമോർയ്യൻ,
chapters.niv: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
chapters.nkjv: the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite;
chapters.kjv: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

chapters.ml: ഗിർഗ്ഗശ്യൻ, ഹിവ്യൻ, അർക്ക്യൻ, സീന്യൻ,
chapters.niv: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
chapters.nkjv: the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite;
chapters.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

chapters.ml: അർവ്വാദ്യൻ, സെമാർയ്യൻ, ഹമാത്യൻ എന്നിവരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. പിന്നീടു കനാന്യവംശങ്ങൾ പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans scattered
chapters.nkjv: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were dispersed.
chapters.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

chapters.ml: കനാന്യരുടെ അതിർ സീദോൻ തുടങ്ങി ഗെരാർവഴിയായി ഗസ്സാവരെയും സൊദോമും ഗൊമോരയും ആദ്മയും സെബോയീമും വഴിയായി ലാശവരെയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and the borders of Canaan reached from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, as far as Lasha.
chapters.nkjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon as you go toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; then as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
chapters.kjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ അതതു ദേശത്തിൽ ജാതിജാതിയായും കുലംകുലമായും ഭാഷഭാഷയായും ഹാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: These are the sons of Ham by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Ham, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands and in their nations.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

chapters.ml: ഏബെരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കൊക്കെയും പിതാവും യാഫെത്തിന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠനുമായ ശേമിന്നും പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Sons were also born to Shem, whose older brother was Japheth; Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.
chapters.nkjv: And children were born also to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.
chapters.kjv: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

chapters.ml: ശേമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഏലാം, അശ്ശൂർ, അർപ്പക്ഷാദ്, ലൂദ്, അരാം.
chapters.niv: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
chapters.kjv: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

chapters.ml: അരാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഊസ്, ഹൂൾ, ഗേഥെർ, മശ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

chapters.ml: അർപ്പക്ഷാദ് ശാലഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ശാലഹ് ഏബെരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
chapters.nkjv: Arphaxad begot Salah, and Salah begot Eber.
chapters.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

chapters.ml: ഏബെരിന്നു രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിച്ചു; ഒരുത്തുന്നു പേലെഗ് എന്നു പേർ; അവന്റെ കാലത്തായിരുന്നു ഭൂവാസികൾ പിരിഞ്ഞുപോയതു; അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്നു യൊക്താൻ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.
chapters.nkjv: To Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
chapters.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

chapters.ml: യൊക്താനോ: അല്മോദാദ്,
chapters.niv: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.nkjv: Joktan begot Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

chapters.ml: ശാലെഫ്, ഹസർമ്മാവെത്ത്, യാരഹ്, ഹദോരാം,
chapters.niv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.nkjv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.kjv: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

chapters.ml: ഊസാൽ, ദിക്ളാ, ഓബാൽ, അബീമയേൽ,
chapters.niv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.nkjv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.kjv: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

chapters.ml: ശെബാ, ഓഫീർ, ഹവീലാ, യോബാബ് എന്നിവരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഇവർ എല്ലാവരും യൊക്താന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
chapters.nkjv: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
chapters.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ വാസസ്ഥലം മേശാതുടങ്ങി കിഴക്കൻ മലയായ സെഫാർവരെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The region where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
chapters.nkjv: And their dwelling place was from Mesha as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
chapters.kjv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ അതതു ദേശത്തിൽ ജാതിജാതിയായും കുലംകുലമായും ഭാഷഭാഷയായും ശേമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: These are the sons of Shem by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Shem, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands, according to their nations.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ തന്നേ ജാതിജാതിയായും കുലംകുലമായും നോഹയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ വംശങ്ങൾ. അവരിൽനിന്നാകുന്നു ജലപ്രളയത്തിന്റെശേഷം ഭൂമിയിൽ ജാതികൾ പിരിഞ്ഞുപോയതു.
chapters.niv: These are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their lines of descent, within their nations. From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood.
chapters.nkjv: These were the families of the sons of Noah, according to their generations, in their nations; and from these the nations were divided on the earth after the flood.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ ഒക്കെയും ഒരേ ഭാഷയും ഒരേ വാക്കും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the whole world had one language and a common speech.
chapters.nkjv: Now the whole earth had one language and one speech.
chapters.kjv: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ കിഴക്കോട്ടു യാത്ര ചെയ്തു, ശിനാർദേശത്തു ഒരു സമഭൂമി കണ്ടു അവിടെ കുടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they dwelt there.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

chapters.ml: അവർ തമ്മിൽ: വരുവിൻ, നാം ഇഷ്ടക അറുത്തു ചുടുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഇഷ്ടക കല്ലായും പശമണ്ണു കുമ്മായമായും ഉപയോഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They said to each other, "Come, let’s make bricks and bake them thoroughly." They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to one another, "Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly." They had brick for stone, and they had asphalt for mortar.
chapters.kjv: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.

chapters.ml: വരുവിൻ, നാം ഭൂതലത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും ചിതറിപ്പോകാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഒരു പട്ടണവും ആകാശത്തോളം എത്തുന്ന ഒരു ഗോപുരവും പണിക; നമുക്കു ഒരു പേരുമുണ്ടാക്കുക എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves; otherwise we will be scattered over the face of the whole earth."
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top is in the heavens; let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad over the face of the whole earth."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യർ പണിത പട്ടണവും ഗോപുരവും കാണേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower which the sons of men had built.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ: ഇതാ, ജനം ഒന്നു അവർക്കെല്ലാവർക്കും ഭാഷയും ഒന്നു; ഇതും അവർ ചെയ്തു തുടങ്ങുന്നു; അവർ ചെയ്‍വാൻ നിരൂപിക്കുന്നതൊന്നും അവർക്കു അസാദ്ധ്യമാകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Lord said, "If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "Indeed the people are one and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do; now nothing that they propose to do will be withheld from them.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

chapters.ml: വരുവിൻ; നാം ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു, അവർ തമ്മിൽ ഭാഷതിരിച്ചറിയാതിരിപ്പാൻ അവരുടെ ഭാഷ കലക്കിക്കളക എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other."
chapters.nkjv: Come, let Us go down and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech."
chapters.kjv: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവ അവരെ അവിടെനിന്നു ഭൂതലത്തിലെങ്ങും ചിന്നിച്ചു; അവർ പട്ടണം പണിയുന്നതു വിട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord scattered them abroad from there over the face of all the earth, and they ceased building the city.
chapters.kjv: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

chapters.ml: സർവ്വഭൂമിയിലെയും ഭാഷ യഹോവ അവിടെവെച്ചു കലക്കിക്കളകയാൽ അതിന്നു ബാബേൽ എന്നു പേരായി; യഹോവ അവരെ അവിടെനിന്നു ഭൂതലത്തിൽ എങ്ങും ചിന്നിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: That is why it was called Babel —because there the Lord confused the language of the whole world. From there the Lord scattered them over the face of the whole earth.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore its name is called Babel, because there the Lord confused the language of all the earth; and from there the Lord scattered them abroad over the face of all the earth.
chapters.kjv: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

chapters.ml: ശേമിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു: ശേമിന്നു നൂറു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ജലപ്രളയത്തിന്നു പിമ്പു രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം അർപ്പക്ഷാദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This is the account of Shem’s family line. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
chapters.nkjv: This is the genealogy of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old, and begot Arphaxad two years after the flood.
chapters.kjv: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

chapters.ml: അർപ്പക്ഷാദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം ശേം അഞ്ഞൂറു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Arphaxad, Shem lived five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: അർപ്പക്ഷാദിന്നു മുപ്പത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശാലഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Arphaxad had lived 35 years, he became the father of Shelah.
chapters.nkjv: Arphaxad lived thirty-five years, and begot Salah.
chapters.kjv: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

chapters.ml: ശാലഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം അർപ്പക്ഷാദ് നാനൂറ്റിമൂന്നു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Salah, Arphaxad lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: ശാലഹിന്നു മുപ്പതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഏബെരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he became the father of Eber.
chapters.nkjv: Salah lived thirty years, and begot Eber.
chapters.kjv: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

chapters.ml: ഏബെരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം ശാലഹ് നാനൂറ്റി മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Eber, Salah lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: ഏബെരിന്നു മുപ്പത്തിനാലു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ പേലെഗിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Eber had lived 34 years, he became the father of Peleg.
chapters.nkjv: Eber lived thirty-four years, and begot Peleg.
chapters.kjv: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

chapters.ml: പേലെഗിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം ഏബെർ നാനൂറ്റിമുപ്പതു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Peleg, Eber lived four hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: പേലെഗിന്നു മുപ്പതു വയ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ രെയൂവിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he became the father of Reu.
chapters.nkjv: Peleg lived thirty years, and begot Reu.
chapters.kjv: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

chapters.ml: രെയൂവിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം പേലെഗ് ഇരൂനൂറ്റൊമ്പതു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Reu, Peleg lived two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: രെയൂവിന്നു മുപ്പത്തിരണ്ടു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശെരൂഗിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Reu had lived 32 years, he became the father of Serug.
chapters.nkjv: Reu lived thirty-two years, and begot Serug.
chapters.kjv: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

chapters.ml: ശെരൂഗിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം രെയൂ ഇരുനൂറ്റേഴു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Serug, Reu lived two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: ശെരൂഗിന്നു മുപ്പതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ നാഹോരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Serug had lived 30 years, he became the father of Nahor.
chapters.nkjv: Serug lived thirty years, and begot Nahor.
chapters.kjv: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

chapters.ml: നാഹോരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം ശേരൂഗ് ഇരുനൂറു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Nahor, Serug lived two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: നാഹോരിന്നു ഇരുപത്തൊമ്പതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ തേരഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he became the father of Terah.
chapters.nkjv: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and begot Terah.
chapters.kjv: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

chapters.ml: തേരഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം നാഹോർ നൂറ്റി പത്തൊമ്പതു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And after he became the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: After he begot Terah, Nahor lived one hundred and nineteen years, and begot sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: തേരഹിന്നു എഴുപതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ അബ്രാം, നാഹോർ, ഹാരാൻ എന്നിവരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Terah had lived 70 years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran.
chapters.nkjv: Now Terah lived seventy years, and begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
chapters.kjv: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

chapters.ml: തേരഹിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു: തേരഹ് അബ്രാമിനെയും നാഹോരിനെയും ഹാരാനെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഹാരാൻ ലോത്തിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This is the account of Terah’s family line. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
chapters.nkjv: This is the genealogy of Terah: Terah begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran begot Lot.
chapters.kjv: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹാരാൻ തന്റെ ജന്മദേശത്തുവെച്ചു, കൽദയരുടെ ഒരു പട്ടണമായ ഊരിൽവെച്ചു തന്നേ, തന്റെ അപ്പനായ തേരഹിന്നു മുമ്പെ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: While his father Terah was still alive, Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in the land of his birth.
chapters.nkjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
chapters.kjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാമും നാഹോരും ഭാര്യമാരെ എടുത്തു; അബ്രാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു സാറായി എന്നും നാഹോരിന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു മിൽക്കാ എന്നും പേർ. ഇവൾ മിൽക്കയുടെയും യിസ്കയുടെയും അപ്പനായ ഹാരാന്റെ മകൾ തന്നെ.
chapters.niv: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milkah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milkah and Iskah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abram and Nahor took wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran the father of Milcah and the father of Iscah.
chapters.kjv: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

chapters.ml: സാറായി മച്ചിയായിരുന്നു; അവൾക്കു സന്തതി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now Sarai was childless because she was not able to conceive.
chapters.nkjv: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
chapters.kjv: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

chapters.ml: തേരഹ് തന്റെ മകനായ അബ്രാമിനെയും ഹാരാന്റെ മകനായ തന്റെ പൌത്രൻ ലോത്തിനെയും തന്റെ മകനായ അബ്രാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായി മരുമകളായ സാറായിയെയും കൂട്ടി കൽദയരുടെ പട്ടണമായ ഊരിൽനിന്നു കനാൻ ദേശത്തേക്കു പോകുവാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവർ ഹാരാൻ വരെ വന്നു അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, the wife of his son Abram, and together they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to Canaan. But when they came to Harran, they settled there.
chapters.nkjv: And Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, his son Abram’s wife, and they went out with them from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran and dwelt there.
chapters.kjv: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

chapters.ml: തേരഹിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ഇരുനൂറ്റഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം ആയിരുന്നു; തേരഹ് ഹാരാനിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Harran.
chapters.nkjv: So the days of Terah were two hundred and five years, and Terah died in Haran.
chapters.kjv: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അബ്രാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ നിന്റെ ദേശത്തെയും ചാർച്ചക്കാരെയും പിതൃഭവനത്തെയും വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കാണിപ്പാനിരിക്കുന്ന ദേശത്തെക്കു പോക.
chapters.niv: The Lord had said to Abram, "Go from your country, your people and your father’s household to the land I will show you.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord had said to Abram: "Get out of your country, From your family And from your father’s house, To a land that I will show you.
chapters.kjv: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വലിയോരു ജാതിയാക്കും; നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു നിന്റെ പേർ വലുതാക്കും; നീ ഒരു അനുഗ്രഹമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.
chapters.nkjv: I will make you a great nation; I will bless you And make your name great; And you shall be a blessing.
chapters.kjv: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

chapters.ml: നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നവരെ ഞാൻ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കും. നിന്നെ ശപിക്കുന്നവരെ ഞാൻ ശപിക്കും; നിന്നിൽ ഭൂമിയിലെ സകല വംശങ്ങളും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you."
chapters.nkjv: I will bless those who bless you, And I will curse him who curses you; And in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed."
chapters.kjv: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അബ്രാം പുറപ്പെട്ടു; ലോത്തും അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി; ഹാരാനിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ അബ്രാമിന്നു എഴുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Abram went, as the Lord had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he set out from Harran.
chapters.nkjv: So Abram departed as the Lord had spoken to him, and Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
chapters.kjv: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാം തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറായിയെയും സഹോദരന്റെ മകനായ ലോത്തിനെയും തങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ സമ്പത്തുകളെയൊക്കെയും തങ്ങൾ ഹാരാനിൽ വെച്ചു സമ്പാദിച്ച ആളുകളെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു കനാൻ ദേശത്തേക്കു പോകുവാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു കനാൻ ദേശത്തു എത്തി.
chapters.niv: He took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all the possessions they had accumulated and the people they had acquired in Harran, and they set out for the land of Canaan, and they arrived there.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abram took Sarai his wife and Lot his brother’s son, and all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they departed to go to the land of Canaan. So they came to the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാം ശേഖേമെന്ന സ്ഥലംവരെയും ഏലോൻ മോരെവരെയും ദേശത്തുകൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു. അന്നു കനാന്യൻ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the great tree of Moreh at Shechem. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.
chapters.nkjv: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, as far as the terebinth tree of Moreh. And the Canaanites were then in the land.
chapters.kjv: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അബ്രാമിന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി: നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കു ഞാൻ ഈ ദേശം കൊടുക്കുമെന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു. തനിക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായ യഹോവെക്കു അവൻ അവിടെ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു.
chapters.niv: The Lord appeared to Abram and said, "To your offspring I will give this land." So he built an altar there to the Lord , who had appeared to him.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord appeared to Abram and said, "To your descendants I will give this land." And there he built an altar to the Lord, who had appeared to him.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD , who appeared unto him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെനിന്നു ബേഥേലിന്നു കിഴക്കുള്ള മലെക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; ബേഥേൽ പടിഞ്ഞാറും ഹായി കിഴക്കുമായി കൂടാരം അടിച്ചു; അവിടെ അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ ആരാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: From there he went on toward the hills east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the Lord and called on the name of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And he moved from there to the mountain east of Bethel, and he pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; there he built an altar to the Lord and called on the name of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD , and called upon the name of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അബ്രാം പിന്നെയും തെക്കോട്ടു യാത്രചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Abram set out and continued toward the Negev.
chapters.nkjv: So Abram journeyed, going on still toward the South.
chapters.kjv: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തു ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായി; ദേശത്തു ക്ഷാമം കഠിനമായി തീർന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അബ്രാം മിസ്രയീമിൽ ചെന്നുപാർപ്പാൻ അവിടേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to dwell there, for the famine was severe in the land.
chapters.kjv: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ എത്തുമാറായപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ ഭാര്യ സാറായിയോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇതാ, നീ സൌന്ദര്യമുള്ള സ്ത്രീയെന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, "I know what a beautiful woman you are.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when he was close to entering Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife, "Indeed I know that you are a woman of beautiful countenance.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമ്യർ നിന്നെ കാണുമ്പോൾ ഇവൾ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നെകൊല്ലുകയും നിന്നെ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore it will happen, when the Egyptians see you, that they will say, ‘This is his wife’; and they will kill me, but they will let you live.
chapters.kjv: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ സഹോദരിയെന്നു പറയേണം; എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ നിമിത്തം എനിക്കു നന്മവരികയും ഞാൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you."
chapters.nkjv: Please say you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that I may live because of you."
chapters.kjv: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അബ്രാം മിസ്രയീമിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ സ്ത്രീ അതി സുന്ദരി എന്നു മിസ്രയീമ്യർ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Abram came to Egypt, the Egyptians saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when Abram came into Egypt, that the Egyptians saw the woman, that she was very beautiful.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്റെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും അവളെ കണ്ടു, ഫറവോന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അവളെ പ്രശംസിച്ചു; സ്ത്രീ ഫറവോന്റെ അരമനയിൽ പോകേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when Pharaoh’s officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.
chapters.nkjv: The princes of Pharaoh also saw her and commended her to Pharaoh. And the woman was taken to Pharaoh’s house.
chapters.kjv: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ നിമിത്തം അവൻ അബ്രാമിന്നു നന്മ ചെയ്തു; അവന്നു ആടുമാടുകളും ആൺകഴുതകളും ദാസന്മാരും ദാസിമാരും പെൺകഴുതകളും ഒട്ടകങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.
chapters.nkjv: He treated Abram well for her sake. He had sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male and female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
chapters.kjv: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറായിനിമിത്തം യഹോവ ഫറവോനെയും അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെയും അത്യന്തം ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഫറവോൻ അബ്രാമിനെ വിളിച്ചു: നീ എന്നോടു ഈ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? അവൾ നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയെന്നു എന്നെ അറിയിക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു?
