chapters.niv: So Pharaoh summoned Abram. "What have you done to me?" he said. "Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, "What is this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

chapters.ml: അവൾ എന്റെ സഹോദരിയെന്നു എന്തിന്നു പറഞ്ഞു? ഞാൻ അവളെ ഭാര്യയായിട്ടു എടുപ്പാൻ സംഗതി വന്നുപോയല്ലോ; ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, നിന്റെ ഭാര്യ; അവളെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!"
chapters.nkjv: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’? I might have taken her as my wife. Now therefore, here is your wife; take her and go your way."
chapters.kjv: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her , and go thy way.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു തന്റെ ആളുകളോടു കല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അവനെയും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെയും അവന്നുള്ള സകലവുമായി പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.
chapters.nkjv: So Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him; and they sent him away, with his wife and all that he had.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അബ്രാമും ഭാര്യയും അവന്നുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ ലോത്തും മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു തെക്കെ ദേശത്തു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had, and Lot with him, to the South.
chapters.kjv: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

chapters.ml: കന്നുകാലി, വെള്ളി, പൊന്നു ഈ വകയിൽ അബ്രാം ബഹുസമ്പന്നനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.
chapters.nkjv: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
chapters.kjv: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ യാത്രയിൽ തെക്കുനിന്നു ബേഥേൽവരെയും ബേഥേലിന്നും ഹായിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ തനിക്കു ആദിയിൽ കൂടാരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതും താൻ ആദിയിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ യാഗപീഠമിരുന്നതുമായ സ്ഥലംവരെയും ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: From the Negev he went from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been earlier
chapters.nkjv: And he went on his journey from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
chapters.kjv: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai;

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അബ്രാം യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ ആരാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: to the place of the altar which he had made there at first. And there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അബ്രാമിനോടുകൂടെവന്ന ലോത്തിന്നും ആടുമാടുകളും കൂടാരങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Lot, who was moving about with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
chapters.nkjv: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks and herds and tents.
chapters.kjv: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒന്നിച്ചുപാർപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ദേശത്തിന്നു അവരെ വഹിച്ചു കൂടാഞ്ഞു; സമ്പത്തു വളരെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു ഒന്നിച്ചുപാർപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: But the land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.
chapters.nkjv: Now the land was not able to support them, that they might dwell together, for their possessions were so great that they could not dwell together.
chapters.kjv: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാമിന്റെ കന്നുകാലികളുടെ ഇടയന്മാർക്കും ലോത്തിന്റെ കന്നുകാലികളുടെ ഇടയന്മാർക്കും തമ്മിൽ പിണക്കമുണ്ടായി; കനാന്യരും പെരിസ്യരും അന്നു ദേശത്തു പാർത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And quarreling arose between Abram’s herders and Lot’s. The Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land at that time.
chapters.nkjv: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites then dwelt in the land.
chapters.kjv: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

chapters.ml: അതു കൊണ്ടു അബ്രാം ലോത്തിനോടു: എനിക്കും നിനക്കും എന്റെ ഇടയന്മാർക്കും നിന്റെ ഇടയന്മാർക്കും തമ്മിൽ പിണക്കം ഉണ്ടാകരുതേ; നാം സഹോദരന്മാരല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: So Abram said to Lot, "Let’s not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herders and mine, for we are close relatives.
chapters.nkjv: So Abram said to Lot, "Please let there be no strife between you and me, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we are brethren.
chapters.kjv: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

chapters.ml: ദേശമെല്ലാം നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഇല്ലയോ? എന്നെ വിട്ടുപിരിഞ്ഞാലും. നീ ഇടത്തോട്ടെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ വലത്തോട്ടു പൊയ്ക്കൊള്ളാം; നീ വലത്തോട്ടെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ ഇടത്തോട്ടു പൊയ്ക്കൊള്ളാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Is not the whole land before you? Let’s part company. If you go to the left, I’ll go to the right; if you go to the right, I’ll go to the left."
chapters.nkjv: Is not the whole land before you? Please separate from me. If youtake the left, then I will go to the right; or, if yougo to the right, then I will go to the left."
chapters.kjv: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ലോത്ത് നോക്കി, യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെയുള്ള പ്രദേശം ഒക്കെയും നീരോട്ടമുള്ളതെന്നു കണ്ടു; യഹോവ സൊദോമിനെയും ഗൊമോരയെയും നശിപ്പിച്ചതിന്നു മുമ്പെ അതു യഹോവയുടെ തോട്ടംപോലെയും സോവർവരെ മിസ്രയീംദേശംപോലെയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Lot looked around and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan toward Zoar was well watered, like the garden of the Lord , like the land of Egypt. (This was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
chapters.nkjv: And Lot lifted his eyes and saw all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered everywhere (before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah) like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt as you go toward Zoar.
chapters.kjv: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD , like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

chapters.ml: ലോത്ത് യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെയുള്ള പ്രദേശം ഒക്കെയും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു; ഇങ്ങനെ ലോത്ത് കിഴക്കോട്ടു യാത്രയായി; അവർ തമ്മിൽ പിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan and set out toward the east. The two men parted company:
chapters.nkjv: Then Lot chose for himself all the plain of Jordan, and Lot journeyed east. And they separated from each other.
chapters.kjv: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാം കനാൻ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു; ലോത്ത് ആ പ്രദേശത്തിലെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ പാർത്തു സൊദോംവരെ കൂടാരം നീക്കി നീക്കി അടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tents near Sodom.
chapters.nkjv: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent even as far as Sodom.
chapters.kjv: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

chapters.ml: സൊദോംനിവാസികൾ ദുഷ്ടന്മാരും യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ മഹാപാപികളും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the people of Sodom were wicked and were sinning greatly against the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: But the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinful against the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

chapters.ml: ലോത്ത് അബ്രാമിനെ വിട്ടു പിരിഞ്ഞശേഷം യഹോവ അബ്രാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: തലപൊക്കി, നീ ഇരിക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു നിന്നു വടക്കോട്ടും തെക്കോട്ടും കിഴക്കോട്ടും പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടും നോക്കുക.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Abram after Lot had parted from him, "Look around from where you are, to the north and south, to the east and west.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him: "Lift your eyes now and look from the place where you are— northward, southward, eastward, and westward;
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

chapters.ml: നീ കാണുന്ന ഭൂമി ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ നിനക്കും നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും ശാശ്വതമായി തരും.
chapters.niv: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.
chapters.nkjv: for all the land which you see I give to you and your descendants forever.
chapters.kjv: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ ഭൂമിയിലെ പൊടിപോലെ ആക്കും: ഭൂമിയിലെ പൊടിയെ എണ്ണുവാൻ കഴിയുമെങ്കിൽ നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെയും എണ്ണാം.
chapters.niv: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.
chapters.nkjv: And I will make your descendants as the dust of the earth; so that if a man could number the dust of the earth, then your descendants also could be numbered.
chapters.kjv: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

chapters.ml: നീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ദേശത്തു നെടുകെയും കുറുകെയും സഞ്ചരിക്ക; ഞാൻ അതു നിനക്കു തരും.
chapters.niv: Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you."
chapters.nkjv: Arise, walk in the land through its length and its width, for I give it to you."
chapters.kjv: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്രാം കൂടാരം നീക്കി ഹെബ്രോനിൽ മമ്രേയുടെ തോപ്പിൽ വന്നു പാർത്തു; അവിടെ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു.
chapters.niv: So Abram went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he pitched his tents. There he built an altar to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then Abram moved his tent, and went and dwelt by the terebinth trees of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ശിനാർ രാജാവായ അമ്രാഫെൽ, എലാസാർരാജാവായ അർയ്യോക്, ഏലാം രാജാവായ കെദൊർലായോമെർ, ജാതികളുടെ രാജാവായ തീദാൽ എന്നിവരുടെ കാലത്തു
chapters.niv: At the time when Amraphel was king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Kedorlaomer king of Elam and Tidal king of Goyim,
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

chapters.ml: ഇവർ സൊദോം രാജാവായ ബേരാ, ഗൊമോരാരാജാവായ ബിർശാ, ആദ്മാരാജാവായ ശിനാബ്, സെബോയീം രാജാവായ ശെമേബെർ, സോവർ എന്ന ബേലയിലെ രാജാവു എന്നിവരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: these kings went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboyim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
chapters.nkjv: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
chapters.kjv: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

chapters.ml: ഇവരെല്ലാവരും സിദ്ദീംതാഴ്വരയിൽ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി. അതു ഇപ്പോൾ ഉപ്പുകടലാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All these latter kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Dead Sea Valley).
chapters.nkjv: All these joined together in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea).
chapters.kjv: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

chapters.ml: അവർ പന്ത്രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം കെദൊർലായോമെരിന്നു കീഴടങ്ങിയിരിന്നു; പതിമൂന്നാം സംവത്സരത്തിൽ മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For twelve years they had been subject to Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
chapters.nkjv: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
chapters.kjv: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു പതിനാലാം സംവത്സരത്തിൽ കെദൊർലായോമെരും അവനോടുകൂടെയുള്ള രാജാക്കന്മാരുംവന്നു, അസ്തെരോത്ത് കർന്നയീമിലെ രെഫായികളെയും ഹാമിലെ സൂസ്യരെയും ശാവേകിർയ്യാത്തയീമിലെ ഏമ്യരെയും
chapters.niv: In the fourteenth year, Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh Kiriathaim
chapters.nkjv: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him came and attacked the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
chapters.kjv: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

chapters.ml: സേയീർമലയിലെ ഹോർയ്യരെയും മരുഭൂമിക്കു സമീപമുള്ള ഏൽപാരാൻ വരെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and the Horites in the hill country of Seir, as far as El Paran near the desert.
chapters.nkjv: and the Horites in their mountain of Seir, as far as El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെഅവർ തിരിഞ്ഞു കാദേശ് എന്ന ഏൻ മിശ്പാത്തിൽവന്നു അമലേക്യരുടെ ദേശമൊക്കെയും ഹസെസോൻ-താമാരിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യരെയും കൂടെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they turned back and went to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who were living in Hazezon Tamar.
chapters.nkjv: Then they turned back and came to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and attacked all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who dwelt in Hazezon Tamar.
chapters.kjv: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സൊദോംരാജാവും ഗൊമോരാരാജാവും ആദ്മാരാജാവും സെബോയീംരാജാവും സോവർ എന്ന ബേലയിലെ രാജാവും പുറപ്പെട്ടു സിദ്ധീംതാഴ്വരയിൽ വെച്ചു
chapters.niv: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboyim and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim
chapters.nkjv: And the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) went out and joined together in battle in the Valley of Siddim
chapters.kjv: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

chapters.ml: ഏലാംരാജാവായ കെദൊർലായോമെർ, ജാതികളുടെ രാജാവായ തീദാൽ, ശിനാർരാജാവായ അമ്രാഫെൽ, എലാസാർ രാജാവായ അർയ്യോക്ക് എന്നിവരുടെ നേരെ പട നിരത്തി; നാലു രാജാക്കന്മാർ അഞ്ചു രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ നേരെ തന്നെ.
chapters.niv: against Kedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goyim, Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
chapters.nkjv: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of nations, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
chapters.kjv: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

chapters.ml: സിദ്ദീംതാഴ്വരയിൽ കീൽകുഴികൾ വളരെയുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; സൊദോംരാജാവും ഗൊമോരാ രാജാവും ഓടിപ്പോയി അവിടെ വീണു; ശേഷിച്ചവർ പർവ്വതത്തിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and when the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some of the men fell into them and the rest fled to the hills.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Valley of Siddim wasfullof asphalt pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled; some fell there, and the remainder fled to the mountains.
chapters.kjv: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

chapters.ml: സൊദോമിലും ഗൊമോരയിലും ഉള്ള സമ്പത്തും ഭക്ഷണ സാധനങ്ങളും എല്ലാം അവർഎടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food; then they went away.
chapters.nkjv: Then they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their provisions, and went their way.
chapters.kjv: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാമിന്റെ സഹോദരന്റെ മകനായി സൊദോമിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന ലോത്തിനെയും അവന്റെ സമ്പത്തിനെയും അവർ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.
chapters.nkjv: They also took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
chapters.kjv: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

chapters.ml: ഓടിപ്പോന്ന ഒരുത്തൻ വന്നു എബ്രായനായ അബ്രാമിനെ അറിയിച്ചു. അവൻ എശ്ക്കോലിന്റെയും ആനേരിന്റെയും സഹോദരനായി അമോർയ്യനായ മമ്രേയുടെ തോപ്പിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്നു; അവർ അബ്രാമിനോടു സഖ്യത ചെയ്തവർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A man who had escaped came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the great trees of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshkol and Aner, all of whom were allied with Abram.
chapters.nkjv: Then one who had escaped came and told Abram the Hebrew, for he dwelt by the terebinth trees of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were allies with Abram.
chapters.kjv: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ സഹോദരനെ ബദ്ധനാക്കികൊണ്ടു പോയി എന്നു അബ്രാം കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ജനിച്ചവരും അഭ്യാസികളുമായ മുന്നൂറ്റിപതിനെട്ടു പേരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ദാൻവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Abram heard that his relative had been taken captive, he called out the 318 trained men born in his household and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his three hundred and eighteen trained servants who were born in his own house, and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
chapters.kjv: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants , born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിൽ അവനും അവന്റെ ദാസന്മാരും അവരുടെ നേരെ ഭാഗംഭാഗമായി പിരിഞ്ഞു ചെന്നു അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു ദമ്മേശെക്കിന്റെ ഇടത്തുഭാഗത്തുള്ള ഹോബാവരെ അവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
chapters.nkjv: He divided his forces against them by night, and he and his servants attacked them and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is north of Damascus.
chapters.kjv: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സമ്പത്തൊക്കെയും മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു വന്നു; തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ലോത്തിനെയും അവന്റെ സമ്പത്തിനെയും സ്ത്രീകളെയും ജനത്തെയും കൂടെ മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: He recovered all the goods and brought back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other people.
chapters.nkjv: So he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot and his goods, as well as the women and the people.
chapters.kjv: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കെദൊർലായോമെരിനെയും കൂടെയുള്ള രാജാക്കന്മാരെയും തോല്പിച്ചിട്ടു മടങ്ങിവന്നപ്പോൾ സൊദോംരാജാവു രാജതാഴ്വര എന്ന ശാവേതാഴ്വരവരെ അവനെ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: After Abram returned from defeating Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom came out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
chapters.nkjv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley), after his return from the defeat of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king’s dale.

chapters.ml: ശാലേംരാജാവായ മൽക്കീസേദെക്ക് അപ്പവും വീഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവൻ അത്യുന്നതനായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുരോഹിതനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High,
chapters.nkjv: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine; he was the priest of God Most High.
chapters.kjv: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്നും ഭൂമിക്കും നാഥനായി അത്യുന്നതനായ ദൈവത്താൽ അബ്രാം അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ;
chapters.niv: and he blessed Abram, saying, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
chapters.nkjv: And he blessed him and said: "Blessed be Abram of God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth;
chapters.kjv: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ നിന്റെ കൈയില്‍ ഏല്പിച്ച അത്യുന്നതനായ ദൈവംസ്തുതിക്കപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവന്നു അബ്രാം സകലത്തിലും ദശാംശം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And praise be to God Most High, who delivered your enemies into your hand." Then Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
chapters.nkjv: And blessed be God Most High, Who has delivered your enemies into your hand." And he gave him a tithe of all.
chapters.kjv: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

chapters.ml: സൊദോംരാജാവു അബ്രാമിനോടു: ആളുകളെ എനിക്കു തരിക; സമ്പത്തു നീ എടുത്തുകൊൾക എന്നുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the people and keep the goods for yourself."
chapters.nkjv: Now the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the persons, and take the goods for yourself."
chapters.kjv: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അബ്രാം സൊദോംരാജാവിനോടുപറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ അബ്രാമിനെ സമ്പന്നനാക്കിയെന്നു നീ പറയാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ ഒരു ചരടാകട്ടെ ചെരിപ്പുവാറാകട്ടെ നിനക്കുള്ളതിൽ യാതൊന്നുമാകട്ടെ എടുക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ
chapters.niv: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "With raised hand I have sworn an oath to the Lord , God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
chapters.nkjv: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I have raised my hand to the Lord, God Most High, the Possessor of heaven and earth,
chapters.kjv: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD , the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്നും ഭൂമിക്കും നാഥനായി അത്യുന്നതദൈവമായ യഹോവയിങ്കലേക്കു കൈ ഉയർത്തിസത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: that I will accept nothing belonging to you, not even a thread or the strap of a sandal, so that you will never be able to say, ‘I made Abram rich.’
chapters.nkjv: that I willtake nothing, from a thread to a sandal strap, and that I will not take anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich’—
chapters.kjv: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

chapters.ml: ബാല്യക്കാർ ഭക്ഷിച്ചതും എന്നോടുകൂടെ വന്ന ആനേർ, എശ്ക്കോൽ, മമ്രേ എന്നീ പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ ഓഹരിയും മാത്രമേ വേണ്ടു; ഇവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ഓഹരി എടുത്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who went with me—to Aner, Eshkol and Mamre. Let them have their share."
chapters.nkjv: except only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion."
chapters.kjv: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അബ്രാമിന്നു ദർശനത്തിൽ യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ: അബ്രാമേ, ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പരിചയും നിന്റെ അതി മഹത്തായ പ്രതിഫലവും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After this, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward. "
chapters.nkjv: After these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward."
chapters.kjv: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അബ്രാം: കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ എനിക്കു എന്തു തരും? ഞാൻ മക്കളില്ലാത്തവനായി നടക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; എന്റെ അവകാശി ദമ്മേശെക്കുകാരനായ ഈ എല്യേസർ അത്രേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Abram said, "Sovereign Lord , what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?"
chapters.nkjv: But Abram said, "Lord God, what will You give me, seeing I go childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?"
chapters.kjv: And Abram said, Lord GOD , what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

chapters.ml: നീ എനിക്കു സന്തതിയെ തന്നിട്ടില്ല, എന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ജനിച്ച ദാസൻ എന്റെ അവകാശിയാകുന്നു എന്നും അബ്രാം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Abram said, "You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir."
chapters.nkjv: Then Abram said, "Look, You have given me no offspring; indeed one born in my house is my heir!"
chapters.kjv: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിന്റെ അവകാശിയാകയില്ല; നിന്റെ ഉദരത്തിൽനിന്നുപുറപ്പെടുന്നവൻ തന്നേ നിന്റെ അവകാശിയാകും. എന്നു അവന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to him: "This man will not be your heir, but a son who is your own flesh and blood will be your heir."
chapters.nkjv: And behold, the word of the Lordcame to him, saying, "This one shall not be your heir, but one who will come from your own body shall be your heir."
chapters.kjv: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവനെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു: നീ ആകാശത്തേക്കു നോക്കുക; നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളെ എണ്ണുവാൻ കഴിയുമെങ്കിൽ എണ്ണുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. നിന്റെ സന്തതിഇങ്ങനെ ആകും എന്നും അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He took him outside and said, "Look up at the sky and count the stars—if indeed you can count them." Then he said to him, "So shall your offspring be."
chapters.nkjv: Then He brought him outside and said, "Look now toward heaven, and count the stars if you are able to number them." And He said to him, "So shall your descendants be."
chapters.kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു; അതു അവൻ അവന്നു നീതിയായി കണക്കിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Abram believed the Lord , and he credited it to him as righteousness.
chapters.nkjv: And he believed in the Lord, and He accounted it to him for righteousness.
chapters.kjv: And he believed in the LORD ; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവനോടു: ഈ ദേശത്തെ നിനക്കു അവകാശമായി തരുവാൻ കൽദയപട്ടണമായ ഊരിൽനിന്നു നിന്നെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്ന യഹോവ ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He also said to him, "I am the Lord , who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to him, "I am the Lord, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans, to give you this land to inherit it."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ അതിനെ അവകാശമാക്കുമെന്നുള്ളതുഎനിക്കു എന്തൊന്നിനാൽ അറിയാം എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Abram said, "Sovereign Lord , how can I know that I will gain possession of it?"
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Lord God, how shall I know that I will inherit it?"
chapters.kjv: And he said, Lord GOD , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: നീ മൂന്നു വയസ്സുള്ള ഒരു പശുക്കിടാവിനെയും മൂന്നുവയസ്സുള്ള ഒരു കോലാടിനെയും മൂന്നു വയസ്സുള്ള ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു കുറുപ്രാവിനെയും ഒരു പ്രാവിൻ കുഞ്ഞിനെയും കൊണ്ടുവരിക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord said to him, "Bring me a heifer, a goat and a ram, each three years old, along with a dove and a young pigeon."
chapters.nkjv: So He said to him, "Bring Me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

chapters.ml: ഇവയെയൊക്കെയും അവൻ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ഒത്തനടുവെ പിളർന്നു ഭാഗങ്ങളെ നേർക്കുനേരെ വെച്ചു; പക്ഷികളെയോ അവൻ പിളർന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought all these to Him and cut them in two, down the middle, and placed each piece opposite the other; but he did not cut the birds in two.
chapters.kjv: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

chapters.ml: ഉടലുകളിന്മേൽ റാഞ്ചൻ പക്ഷികൾഇറങ്ങി വന്നപ്പോൾ അബ്രാം അവയെ ആട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then birds of prey came down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
chapters.nkjv: And when the vultures came down on the carcasses, Abram drove them away.
chapters.kjv: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിക്കുമ്പോൾ അബ്രാമിന്നു ഒരു ഗാഢനിദ്ര വന്നു; ഭീതിയും അന്ധതമസ്സും അവന്റെ മേൽ വീണു.
chapters.niv: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and dreadful darkness came over him.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and behold, horror and great darkness fell upon him.
chapters.kjv: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ അബ്രാമിനോടു: നിന്റെ സന്തതി സ്വന്തമല്ലാത്ത ദേശത്തു നാനൂറു സംവത്സരം പ്രവാസികളായിരുന്നു ആ ദേശക്കാരെ സേവിക്കും; അവർ അവരെ പീഡിപ്പിക്കുമെന്നു നീ അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to him, "Know for certain that for four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own and that they will be enslaved and mistreated there.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to Abram: "Know certainly that your descendants will be strangers in a land thatis not theirs, and will serve them, and they will afflict them four hundred years.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ സേവിക്കുന്ന ജാതിയെ ഞാൻ വിധിക്കും; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവർ വളരെ സമ്പത്തോടുംകൂടെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോരും.
chapters.niv: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.
chapters.nkjv: And also the nation whom they serve I will judge; afterward they shall come out with great possessions.
chapters.kjv: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

chapters.ml: നീയോ സമാധാനത്തോടെ നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ചേരും; നല്ല വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിൽ അടക്കപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: You, however, will go to your ancestors in peace and be buried at a good old age.
chapters.nkjv: Now as for you, you shall go to your fathers in peace; you shall be buried at a good old age.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

chapters.ml: നാലാം തലമുറക്കാർ ഇവിടേക്കു മടങ്ങിവരും; അമോർയ്യരുടെ അക്രമം ഇതുവരെ തികഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ല എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: In the fourth generation your descendants will come back here, for the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure."
chapters.nkjv: But in the fourth generation they shall return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete."
chapters.kjv: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിച്ചു ഇരുട്ടായശേഷം ഇതാ, പുകയുന്ന ഒരു തീച്ചൂള; ആ ഭാഗങ്ങളുടെ നടുവെ ജ്വലിക്കുന്ന ഒരു പന്തം കടന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, a smoking firepot with a blazing torch appeared and passed between the pieces.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when the sun went down and it was dark, that behold, there appeared a smoking oven and a burning torch that passed between those pieces.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യഹോവ അബ്രാമിനോടു ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്തു: നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കു ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീംനദി തുടങ്ങി ഫ്രാത്ത് നദിയായ മഹാനദിവരെയുള്ള ഈ ദേശത്തെ,
chapters.niv: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram and said, "To your descendants I give this land, from the Wadi of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—
chapters.nkjv: On the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying: "To your descendants I have given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the River Euphrates—
chapters.kjv: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

chapters.ml: കേന്യർ, കെനിസ്യർ, കദ്മോന്യർ, ഹിത്യർ,
chapters.niv: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,
chapters.nkjv: the Kenites, the Kenezzites, the Kadmonites,
chapters.kjv: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

chapters.ml: പെറിസ്യർ, രെഫായീമ്യർ, അമോർയ്യർ,
chapters.niv: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,
chapters.nkjv: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
chapters.kjv: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

chapters.ml: കനാന്യർ, ഗിർഗ്ഗശ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ എന്നിവരുടെ ദേശത്തെ തന്നേ, തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites."
chapters.nkjv: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."
chapters.kjv: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറായി മക്കളെ പ്രസവിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല; എന്നാൽ അവൾക്കു ഹാഗാർ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു മിസ്രയീമ്യദാസി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. But she had an Egyptian slave named Hagar;
chapters.nkjv: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. And she had an Egyptian maidservant whose name was Hagar.
chapters.kjv: Now Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

chapters.ml: സാറായി അബ്രാമിനോടു: ഞാൻ പ്രസവിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ യഹോവ എന്റെ ഗർഭം അടെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ. എന്റെ ദാസിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നാലും; പക്ഷേ അവളാൽ എനിക്കു മക്കൾ ലഭിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അബ്രാം സാറായിയുടെ വാക്കു അനുസരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: so she said to Abram, "The Lord has kept me from having children. Go, sleep with my slave; perhaps I can build a family through her." Abram agreed to what Sarai said.
chapters.nkjv: So Sarai said to Abram, "See now, the Lord has restrained me from bearing children. Please, go in to my maid; perhaps I shall obtain children by her." And Abram heeded the voice of Sarai.
chapters.kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാം കനാൻ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു പത്തു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അബ്രാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറായി മിസ്രയീമ്യദാസിയായ ഹാഗാറിനെ തന്റെ ഭർത്താവായ അബ്രാമിന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So after Abram had been living in Canaan ten years, Sarai his wife took her Egyptian slave Hagar and gave her to her husband to be his wife.
chapters.nkjv: Then Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹാഗാരിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; അവൾ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു; താൻ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു എന്നു അവൾ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യജമാനത്തി അവളുടെ കണ്ണിന്നു നിന്ദിതയായി.
chapters.niv: He slept with Hagar, and she conceived. When she knew she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
chapters.nkjv: So he went in to Hagar, and she conceived. And when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress became despised in her eyes.
chapters.kjv: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സാറായി അബ്രാമിനോടു: എനിക്കു ഭവിച്ച അന്യായത്തിന്നു നീ ഉത്തരവാദി; ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദാസിയെ നിന്റെ മാർവ്വിടത്തിൽ തന്നു; എന്നാൽ താൻ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു എന്നു അവൾ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ അവളുടെ കണ്ണിന്നു നിന്ദിതയായി; യഹോവ എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ന്യായം വിധിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Sarai said to Abram, "You are responsible for the wrong I am suffering. I put my slave in your arms, and now that she knows she is pregnant, she despises me. May the Lord judge between you and me."
chapters.nkjv: Then Sarai said to Abram, "My wrong be upon you! I gave my maid into your embrace; and when she saw that she had conceived, I became despised in her eyes. The Lord judge between you and me."
chapters.kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാം സാറായിയോടു: നിന്റെ ദാസി നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു: ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ അവളോടു ചെയ്തുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. സാറായി അവളോടു കാഠിന്യം തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവൾ അവളെ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: "Your slave is in your hands," Abram said. "Do with her whatever you think best." Then Sarai mistreated Hagar; so she fled from her.
chapters.nkjv: So Abram said to Sarai, "Indeed your maid is in your hand; do to her as you please." And when Sarai dealt harshly with her, she fled from her presence.
chapters.kjv: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഒരു നീരുറവിന്റെ അരികെ, ശൂരിന്നു പോകുന്ന വഴിയിലെ നീരുറവിന്റെ അരികെ വെച്ചു തന്നേ അവളെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord found Hagar near a spring in the desert; it was the spring that is beside the road to Shur.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Angel of the Lord found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

chapters.ml: സാറായിയുടെ ദാസിയായ ഹാഗാരേ, നീ എവിടെ നിന്നു വരുന്നു? എങ്ങോട്ടു പോകുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൾ: ഞാൻ എന്റെ യജമാനത്തി സാറായിയെ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോകയാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he said, "Hagar, slave of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?" "I’m running away from my mistress Sarai," she answered.
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Hagar, Sarai’s maid, where have you come from, and where are you going?" She said, "I am fleeing from the presence of my mistress Sarai."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Hagar, Sarai’s maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ അവളോടു: നിന്റെ യജമാനത്തിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു അവൾക്കു കീഴടങ്ങിയിരിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the angel of the Lord told her, "Go back to your mistress and submit to her."
chapters.nkjv: The Angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hand."
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ പിന്നെയും അവളോടു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ ഏറ്റവും വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കും; അതു എണ്ണിക്കൂടാതവണ്ണം പെരുപ്പമുള്ളതായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The angel added, "I will increase your descendants so much that they will be too numerous to count."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord said to her, "I will multiply your descendants exceedingly, so that they shall not be counted for multitude."
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

chapters.ml: നീ ഗർഭിണിയല്ലോ; നീ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിക്കും; യഹോവ നിന്റെ സങ്കടം കേൾക്കകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു യിശ്മായേൽ എന്നു പേർ വിളിക്കേണം;
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord also said to her: "You are now pregnant and you will give birth to a son. You shall name him Ishmael, for the Lord has heard of your misery.
chapters.nkjv: And the Angel of the Lord said to her: "Behold, you are with child, And you shall bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, Because the Lord has heard your affliction.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കാട്ടുകഴുതയെപ്പോലെയുള്ള മനുഷ്യൻ ആയിരിക്കും: അവന്റെ കൈ എല്ലാവർക്കും വിരോധമായും എല്ലാവരുടെയും കൈ അവന്നു വിരോധമായും ഇരിക്കും; അവൻ തന്റെ സകല സഹോദരന്മാർക്കും എതിരെ പാർക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He will be a wild donkey of a man; his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers."
chapters.nkjv: He shall be a wild man; His hand shallbe against every man, And every man’s hand against him. And he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren."
chapters.kjv: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവൾ: എന്നെ കാണുന്നവനെ ഞാൻ ഇവിടെയും കണ്ടുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത യഹോവെക്കു: ദൈവമേ, നീ എന്നെ കാണുന്നു എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: She gave this name to the Lord who spoke to her: "You are the God who sees me," for she said, "I have now seen the One who sees me."
chapters.nkjv: Then she called the name of the Lord who spoke to her, You-Are-the-God-Who-Sees; for she said, "Have I also here seen Him who sees me?"
chapters.kjv: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ കിണറ്റിന്നു ബേർ-ലഹയീ-രോയീ എന്നു പേരായി; അതു കാദേശിന്നും ബേരെദിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That is why the well was called Beer Lahai Roi ; it is still there, between Kadesh and Bered.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi; observe, itis between Kadesh and Bered.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഹാഗാർ അബ്രാമിന്നു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു: ഹാഗാർ പ്രസവിച്ച തന്റെ മകന്നു അബ്രാം യിശ്മായേൽ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.
chapters.nkjv: So Hagar bore Abram a son; and Abram named his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
chapters.kjv: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

chapters.ml: ഹാഗാർ അബ്രാമിന്നു യിശ്മായേലിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചപ്പോൾ അബ്രാമിന്നു എണ്പത്താറു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.
chapters.nkjv: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
chapters.kjv: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാമിന്നു തൊണ്ണൂറ്റൊമ്പതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ യഹോവ അബ്രാമിന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി അവനോടു: ഞാൻ സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവം ആകന്നു; നീ എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നടന്നു നിഷ്കളങ്കനായിരിക്ക.
chapters.niv: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty ; walk before me faithfully and be blameless.
chapters.nkjv: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am Almighty God; walk before Me and be blameless.
chapters.kjv: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ഞാൻ എന്റെ നിയമം സ്ഥാപിക്കും; നിന്നെ അധികമധികമായി വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then I will make my covenant between me and you and will greatly increase your numbers."
chapters.nkjv: And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly."
chapters.kjv: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്രാം സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു; ദൈവം അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
chapters.nkjv: Then Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, saying:
chapters.kjv: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു നിന്നോടു ഒരു നിയമമുണ്ടു; നീ ബഹുജാതികൾക്കു പിതാവാകും;
chapters.niv: "As for me, this is my covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
chapters.nkjv: "As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many nations.
chapters.kjv: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

chapters.ml: ഇനി നിന്നെ അബ്രാം എന്നല്ല വിളിക്കേണ്ടതു; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ബഹു ജാതികൾക്കു പിതാവാക്കിയിരിക്കയാൽ നിന്റെ പേർ അബ്രാഹാം എന്നിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: No longer will you be called Abram ; your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
chapters.nkjv: No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham; for I have made you a father of many nations.
chapters.kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അധികമധികമായി വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു, അനേകജാതികളാക്കും; നിന്നിൽ നിന്നു രാജാക്കന്മാരും ഉത്ഭവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.
chapters.nkjv: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; and I will make nations of you, and kings shall come from you.
chapters.kjv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കും നിന്റെ ശേഷം നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും ദൈവമായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ എനിക്കും നിനക്കും നിന്റെ ശേഷം തലമുറതലമുറയായി നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ എന്റെ നിയമത്തെ നിത്യനിയമമായി സ്ഥാപിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you for the generations to come, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
chapters.nkjv: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you in their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and your descendants after you.
chapters.kjv: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കും നിന്റെ ശേഷം നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും നീ പ്രവാസം ചെയ്യുന്ന ദേശമായ കനാൻ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും ശാശ്വതാവകാശമായി തരും; ഞാൻ അവർക്കു ദൈവമായുമിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The whole land of Canaan, where you now reside as a foreigner, I will give as an everlasting possession to you and your descendants after you; and I will be their God."
chapters.nkjv: Also I give to you and your descendants after you the land in which you are a stranger, all the land of Canaan, as an everlasting possession; and I will be their God."
chapters.kjv: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം പിന്നെയും അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: നീയും നിന്റെശേഷം തലമുറതലമുറയായി നിന്റെ സന്തതിയും എന്റെ നിയമം പ്രമാണിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Then God said to Abraham, "As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you for the generations to come.
chapters.nkjv: And God said to Abraham: "As for you, you shall keep My covenant, you and your descendants after you throughout their generations.
chapters.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കും നിങ്ങൾക്കും നിന്റെ ശേഷം നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേയുള്ളതും നിങ്ങൾ പ്രമാണിക്കേണ്ടതുമായ എന്റെ നിയമം ആവിതു: നിങ്ങളിൽ പുരുഷപ്രജയൊക്കെയും പരിച്ഛേദന ഏൽക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, the covenant you are to keep: Every male among you shall be circumcised.
chapters.nkjv: This is My covenant which you shall keep, between Me and you and your descendants after you: Every male child among you shall be circumcised;
chapters.kjv: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ അഗ്രചർമ്മം പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്യേണം; അതു എനിക്കും നിങ്ങൾക്കും മദ്ധ്യേയുള്ള നിയമത്തിന്റെ അടയാളം ആകും.
chapters.niv: You are to undergo circumcision, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and you.
chapters.nkjv: and you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskins, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

chapters.ml: തലമുറതലമുറയായി നിങ്ങളിൽ പുരുഷപ്രജയൊക്കെയും എട്ടുദിവസം പ്രായമാകുമ്പോൾ പരിച്ഛേദനഏൽക്കേണം; വീട്ടിൽ ജനിച്ച ദാസനായാലും നിന്റെ സന്തതിയല്ലാത്തവനായി അന്യനോടുവിലയ്ക്കു വാങ്ങിയവനായാലും ശരി.
chapters.niv: For the generations to come every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised, including those born in your household or bought with money from a foreigner—those who are not your offspring.
chapters.nkjv: He who is eight days old among you shall be circumcised, every male child in your generations, he who is born in your house or bought with money from any foreigner who is not your descendant.
chapters.kjv: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ജനിച്ച ദാസനും നീ വിലകൊടുത്തു വാങ്ങിയവനും പരിച്ഛേദന ഏറ്റേകഴിയൂ; എന്റെ നിയമം നിങ്ങളുടെ ദേഹത്തിൽ നിത്യനിയമമായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Whether born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh is to be an everlasting covenant.
chapters.nkjv: He who is born in your house and he who is bought with your money must be circumcised, and My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
chapters.kjv: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

chapters.ml: അഗ്രചർമ്മിയായ പുരുഷപ്രജയെ പരിച്ഛേദന ഏൽക്കാതിരുന്നാൽ ജനത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണം; അവൻ എന്റെ നിയമം ലംഘിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Any uncircumcised male, who has not been circumcised in the flesh, will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant."
chapters.nkjv: And the uncircumcised male child, who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that person shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant."
chapters.kjv: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം പിന്നെയും അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു: നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറായിയെ സാറായി എന്നല്ല വിളിക്കേണ്ടതു; അവളുടെ പേർ സാറാ എന്നു ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: God also said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you are no longer to call her Sarai; her name will be Sarah.
chapters.nkjv: Then God said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shallbe her name.
chapters.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be .

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവളെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവളിൽനിന്നു നിനക്കു ഒരു മകനെ തരും; ഞാൻ അവളെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കയും അവൾ ജാതികൾക്കു മാതാവായി തീരുകയും ജാതികളുടെ രാജാക്കന്മാർ അവളിൽനിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിക്കയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her so that she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her."
chapters.nkjv: And I will bless her and also give you a son by her; then I will bless her, and she shall be amother of nations; kings of peoples shall be from her."
chapters.kjv: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്രാഹാം കവിണ്ണുവീണു ചിരിച്ചു: നൂറു വയസ്സുള്ളവന്നു മകൻ ജനിക്കുമോ? തൊണ്ണൂറു വയസ്സുള്ള സാറാ പ്രസവിക്കുമോ? എന്നു തന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Abraham fell facedown; he laughed and said to himself, "Will a son be born to a man a hundred years old? Will Sarah bear a child at the age of ninety?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, "Shall achild be born to a man who is one hundred years old? And shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear achild?"
chapters.kjv: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

chapters.ml: യിശ്മായേൽ നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നാൽമതി എന്നു അബ്രാഹാം ദൈവത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Abraham said to God, "If only Ishmael might live under your blessing!"
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham said to God, "Oh, that Ishmael might live before You!"
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ദൈവം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: അല്ല, നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറാ തന്നേ നിനക്കൊരു മകനെ പ്രസവിക്കും; നീ അവന്നു യിസ്ഹാക്ക് എന്നു പേരിടേണം; ഞാൻ അവനോടും അവന്റെ ശേഷം അവന്റെ സന്തതിയോടും എന്റെ നിയമത്തെ നിത്യനിയമമായി ഉറപ്പിക്കും
chapters.niv: Then God said, "Yes, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you will call him Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
chapters.nkjv: Then God said: "No, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his descendants after him.
chapters.kjv: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

chapters.ml: യിശ്മായേലിനെ കുറിച്ചും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു അത്യന്തം സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവനാക്കി വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കും. അവൻ പന്ത്രണ്ടു പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെ ജനിപ്പിക്കും; ഞാൻ അവനെ വലിയോരു ജാതിയാക്കും.
chapters.niv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you: I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and will greatly increase his numbers. He will be the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
chapters.nkjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He shall beget twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
chapters.kjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നിയമം ഞാൻ ഉറപ്പിക്കുന്നതോ, ഇനിയത്തെ ആണ്ടു ഈ സമയത്തു സാറാ നിനക്കു പ്രസവിപ്പാനുള്ള യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you by this time next year."
chapters.nkjv: But My covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this set time next year."
chapters.kjv: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു തീർന്നശേഷം അവനെ വിട്ടു കയറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When he had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
chapters.nkjv: Then He finished talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
chapters.kjv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അബ്രാഹാം തന്റെ മകനായ യിശ്മായേലിനെയും തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ജനിച്ച സകല ദാസന്മാരെയും താൻ വിലയ്ക്കു വാങ്ങിയവരെ ഒക്കെയും അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ വീട്ടിലുള്ള സകല പുരുഷന്മാരെയും കൂട്ടി ദൈവം തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവരുടെ അഗ്രചർമ്മത്തെ അന്നുതന്നേ പരിച്ഛേദന കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or bought with his money, every male in his household, and circumcised them, as God told him.
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house and all who were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskins that very same day, as God had said to him.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം പരിച്ഛേദനയേറ്റപ്പോൾ അവന്നു തൊണ്ണൂറ്റൊമ്പതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
chapters.nkjv: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകനായ യിശ്മായേൽ പരിച്ഛേദനയേറ്റപ്പോൾ അവന്നു പതിമൂന്നു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;
chapters.nkjv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
chapters.kjv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമും അവന്റെ മകനായ യിശ്മായേലും ഒരേ ദിവസത്തിൽപരിച്ഛേദന ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that very day.
chapters.nkjv: That very same day Abraham was circumcised, and his son Ishmael;
chapters.kjv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

chapters.ml: വീട്ടിൽ ജനിച്ച ദാസന്മാരും അന്യരോടു അവൻ വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങിയവരുമായി അവന്റെ വീട്ടിലുള്ളവർ എല്ലാവരും അവനോടുകൂടെ പരിച്ഛേദന ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: And every male in Abraham’s household, including those born in his household or bought from a foreigner, was circumcised with him.
chapters.nkjv: and all the men of his house, born in the house or bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
chapters.kjv: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ അവന്നു മമ്രേയുടെ തോപ്പിൽവെച്ചു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി; വെയിലുറെച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ കൂടാരവാതിൽക്കൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord appeared to Abraham near the great trees of Mamre while he was sitting at the entrance to his tent in the heat of the day.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord appeared to him by the terebinth trees of Mamre, as he was sitting in the tent door in the heat of the day.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

chapters.ml: അവൻ തലപൊക്കി നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ മൂന്നു പുരുഷന്മാർ തന്റെ നേരെ നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അവരെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ കൂടാരവാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു അവരെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു നിലംവരെ കുനിഞ്ഞു:
chapters.niv: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: So he lifted his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing by him; and when he saw them, he ran from the tent door to meet them, and bowed himself to the ground,
chapters.kjv: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

chapters.ml: യജമാനനേ, എന്നോടു കൃപയുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അടിയനെ കടന്നുപോകരുതേ.
chapters.niv: He said, "If I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, do not pass your servant by.
chapters.nkjv: and said, "My Lord, if I have now found favor in Your sight, do not pass on by Your servant.
chapters.kjv: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

chapters.ml: അസാരം വെള്ളം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ കാലുകളെ കഴുകട്ടെ; വൃക്ഷത്തിൻ കീഴിൽ ഇരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Let a little water be brought, and then you may all wash your feet and rest under this tree.
chapters.nkjv: Please let a little water be brought, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
chapters.kjv: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഒരു മുറി അപ്പം കൊണ്ടുവരാം; വിശപ്പു അടക്കീട്ടു നിങ്ങൾക്കു പോകാം; ഇതിന്നായിട്ടല്ലോ നിങ്ങൾ അടിയന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കയറിവന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. നീ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ആകട്ടെ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Let me get you something to eat, so you can be refreshed and then go on your way—now that you have come to your servant." "Very well," they answered, "do as you say."
chapters.nkjv: And I will bring a morsel of bread, that you may refresh your hearts. After that you may pass by, inasmuch as you have come to your servant." They said, "Do as you have said."
chapters.kjv: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

chapters.ml: അബ്രഹാം ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു കൂടാരത്തിൽ സാറയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: നീ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ മൂന്നിടങ്ങഴി മാവു എടുത്തു കുഴെച്ചു അപ്പമുണ്ടാക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah. "Quick," he said, "get three seahs of the finest flour and knead it and bake some bread."
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said, "Quickly, make ready three measures of fine meal; knead it and make cakes."
chapters.kjv: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it , and make cakes upon the hearth.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം പശുക്കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു ഇളയതും നല്ലതുമായൊരു കാളക്കുട്ടിയെ പിടിച്ചു ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരന്റെ പക്കൽ കൊടുത്തു; അവൻ അതിനെ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ പാകം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he ran to the herd and selected a choice, tender calf and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham ran to the herd, took a tender and good calf, gave it to a young man, and he hastened to prepare it.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ വെണ്ണയും പാലും താൻ പാകം ചെയ്യിച്ച കാളക്കുട്ടിയെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു. അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വൃക്ഷത്തിൻ കീഴിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചു നിന്നു; അവർ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He then brought some curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and set these before them. While they ate, he stood near them under a tree.
chapters.nkjv: So he took butter and milk and the calf which he had prepared, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree as they ate.
chapters.kjv: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ ഭാര്യ സാറാ എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: കൂടാരത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Where is your wife Sarah?" they asked him. "There, in the tent," he said.
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to him, "Where is Sarah your wife?" So he said, "Here, in the tent."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ആണ്ടു കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവരും; അപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ ഭാര്യ സാറെക്കു ഒരു മകൻ ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. സാറാ കൂടാരവാതിൽക്കൽ അവന്റെ പിൻവശത്തു കേട്ടുകൊണ്ടു നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then one of them said, "I will surely return to you about this time next year, and Sarah your wife will have a son." Now Sarah was listening at the entrance to the tent, which was behind him.
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "I will certainly return to you according to the time of life, and behold, Sarah your wife shall have a son." (Sarah was listening in the tent door which was behind him.)
chapters.kjv: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അബ്രാഹാമും സാറയും വയസ്സു ചെന്നു വൃദ്ധരായിരുന്നു. സ്ത്രീകൾക്കുള്ള പതിവു സാറെക്കു നിന്നു പോയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abraham and Sarah were already very old, and Sarah was past the age of childbearing.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age; and Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
chapters.kjv: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ സാറാ ഉള്ളുകൊണ്ടു ചിരിച്ചു: വൃദ്ധയായിരിക്കുന്ന എനിക്കു സുഖഭോഗമുണ്ടാകുമോ? എന്റെ ഭർത്താവും വൃദ്ധനായിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Sarah laughed to herself as she thought, "After I am worn out and my lord is old, will I now have this pleasure?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, "After I have grown old, shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?"
chapters.kjv: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു: വൃദ്ധയായ ഞാൻ പ്രസവിക്കുന്നതു വാസ്തവമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു സാറാ ചിരിച്ചതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Will I really have a child, now that I am old?’
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Shall I surely bear achild, since I am old?’
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

chapters.ml: യഹോവയാൽ കഴിയാത്ത കാര്യം ഉണ്ടോ? ഒരു ആണ്ടു കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഈ സമയമാകുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവരും; സാറെക്കു ഒരു മകൻ ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? I will return to you at the appointed time next year, and Sarah will have a son."
chapters.nkjv: Is anything too hard for the Lord? At the appointed time I will return to you, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son."
chapters.kjv: Is any thing too hard for the LORD ? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

chapters.ml: സാറാ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു: ഇല്ല, ഞാൻ ചിരിച്ചില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെയല്ല, നീ ചിരിച്ചു എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, "I did not laugh." But he said, "Yes, you did laugh."
chapters.nkjv: But Sarah denied it, saying, "I did not laugh," for she was afraid. And He said, "No, but you did laugh!"
chapters.kjv: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

chapters.ml: ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു സൊദോംവഴിക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു; അബ്രാഹാം അവരെ യാത്ര അയപ്പാൻ അവരോടുകൂടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: When the men got up to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them on their way.
chapters.nkjv: Then the men rose from there and looked toward Sodom, and Abraham went with them to send them on the way.
chapters.kjv: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: ഞാൻ ചെയ്‍വാനിരിക്കുന്നതു അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു മറെച്ചുവെക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം വലിയതും ബലമുള്ളതുമായ ജാതിയായി തീരുകയും അവനിൽ ഭൂമിയിലെ ജാതികളൊക്കെയും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്യുമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him.
chapters.nkjv: since Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
chapters.kjv: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അബ്രാഹാമിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു അവന്നു നിവൃത്തിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അബ്രാഹാം തന്റെ മക്കളോടും തനിക്കു പിമ്പുള്ള കുടുംബത്തോടും നീതിയും ന്യായവും പ്രവൃത്തിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ വഴിയിൽ നടപ്പാൻ കല്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അവനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing what is right and just, so that the Lord will bring about for Abraham what he has promised him."
chapters.nkjv: For I have known him, in order that he may command his children and his household after him, that they keep the way of the Lord, to do righteousness and justice, that the Lord may bring to Abraham what He has spoken to him."
chapters.kjv: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD , to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യഹോവ: സൊദോമിന്റെയും ഗൊമോരയുടെയും നിലവിളി വലിയതും അവരുടെ പാപം അതി കഠിനവും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said, "The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is so great and their sin so grievous
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grave,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ചെന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നെത്തിയ നിലവിളിപോലെ അവർ കേവലം പ്രവൃത്തിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു നോക്കി അറിയും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: that I will go down and see if what they have done is as bad as the outcry that has reached me. If not, I will know."
chapters.nkjv: I will go down now and see whether they have done altogether according to the outcry against it that has come to Me; and if not, I will know."
chapters.kjv: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ അവിടെനിന്നു തിരിഞ്ഞു സൊദോമിലേക്കു പോയി. അബ്രാഹാമോ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ തന്നേ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then the men turned away from there and went toward Sodom, but Abraham still stood before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം അടുത്തുചെന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു: ദുഷ്ടനോടുകൂടെ നീതിമാനെയും നീ സംഹരിക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: Then Abraham approached him and said: "Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham came near and said, "Would You also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
chapters.kjv: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

chapters.ml: പക്ഷേ ആ പട്ടണത്തിൽ അമ്പതു നീതിമാന്മാർ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നീ അതിനെ സംഹരിക്കുമോ? അതിലെ അമ്പതു നീതിമാന്മാർ നിമിത്തം ആ സ്ഥലത്തോടു ക്ഷമിക്കയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: What if there are fifty righteous people in the city? Will you really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous people in it?
chapters.nkjv: Suppose there were fifty righteous within the city; would You also destroy the place and not spare it for the fifty righteous that were in it?
chapters.kjv: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ നീ ഒരുനാളും ചെയ്യുന്നതല്ലല്ലോ? നീതിമാൻ ദുഷ്ടനെപ്പോലെ ആകത്തക്കവണ്ണം ദുഷ്ടനോടുകൂടെ നീതിമാനെ നീ ഒരുനാളും കൊല്ലുകയില്ല. സർവ്വ ഭൂമിക്കും ന്യായാധിപതിയായവൻ നീതി പ്രവൃത്തിക്കാതിരിക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: Far be it from you to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, treating the righteous and the wicked alike. Far be it from you! Will not the Judge of all the earth do right?"
chapters.nkjv: Far be it from You to do such a thing as this, to slay the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be as the wicked; far be it from You! Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?"
chapters.kjv: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യഹോവ: ഞാൻ സൊദോമിൽ, പട്ടണത്തിന്നകത്തു, അമ്പതു നീതിമാന്മാരെ കാണുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവരുടെ നിമിത്തം ആ സ്ഥലത്തോടൊക്കെയും ക്ഷമിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said, "If I find fifty righteous people in the city of Sodom, I will spare the whole place for their sake."
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord said, "If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

chapters.ml: പൊടിയും വെണ്ണീറുമായ ഞാൻ കർത്താവിനോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Then Abraham spoke up again: "Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, though I am nothing but dust and ashes,
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham answered and said, "Indeed now, I who am but dust and ashes have taken it upon myself to speak to the Lord:
chapters.kjv: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

chapters.ml: അമ്പതു നീതിമാന്മാരിൽ പക്ഷേ അഞ്ചുപേർ കുറഞ്ഞു പോയെങ്കിലോ? അഞ്ചുപേർ കുറഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു നീ ആ പട്ടണം മുഴുവനും നശിപ്പിക്കുമോ എന്നു അബ്രാഹാം പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: നാല്പത്തഞ്ചു പേരെ ഞാൻ അവിടെ കണ്ടാൽ അതിനെ നശിപ്പിക്കയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: what if the number of the righteous is five less than fifty? Will you destroy the whole city for lack of five people?" "If I find forty-five there," he said, "I will not destroy it."
chapters.nkjv: Suppose there were five less than the fifty righteous; would You destroy all of the city for lackof five?" So He said, "If I find there forty-five, I will not destroy it."
chapters.kjv: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it .

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും അവനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: പക്ഷേ നാല്പതുപേരെ അവിടെ കണ്ടാലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: ഞാൻ നാല്പതുപേരുടെ നിമിത്തം നശിപ്പിക്കയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Once again he spoke to him, "What if only forty are found there?" He said, "For the sake of forty, I will not do it."
chapters.nkjv: And he spoke to Him yet again and said, "Suppose there should be forty found there?" So He said, "I will not do it for the sake of forty."
chapters.kjv: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty’s sake.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞാൻ പിന്നെയും സംസാരിക്കുന്നു; കർത്താവു കോപിക്കരുതേ; പക്ഷേ മുപ്പതുപേരെ അവിടെ കണ്ടാലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഞാൻ മുപ്പതുപേരെ അവിടെ കണ്ടാൽ നശിപ്പിക്കയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak. What if only thirty can be found there?" He answered, "I will not do it if I find thirty there."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Suppose thirty should be found there?" So He said, "I will not do it if I find thirty there."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it , if I find thirty there.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കർത്താവിനോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ; പക്ഷേ ഇരുപതുപേരെ അവിടെ കണ്ടാലോ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: ഞാൻ ഇരുപതുപേരുടെ നിമിത്തം നശിപ്പിക്കയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Abraham said, "Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, what if only twenty can be found there?" He said, "For the sake of twenty, I will not destroy it."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Indeed now, I have taken it upon myself to speak to the Lord: Suppose twenty should be found there?" So He said, "I will not destroy it for the sake of twenty."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty’s sake.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: കർത്താവു കോപിക്കരുതേ; ഞാൻ ഇനി ഒരു പ്രാവശ്യം മാത്രം സംസാരിക്കും; പക്ഷേ പത്തു പേരെ അവിടെ കണ്ടാലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഞാൻ പത്തുപേരുടെ നിമിത്തം നശിപ്പിക്കയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak just once more. What if only ten can be found there?" He answered, "For the sake of ten, I will not destroy it."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak but once more: Suppose ten should be found there?" And He said, "I will not destroy it for the sake of ten."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten’s sake.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു തീർന്നശേഷം അവിടെനിന്നു പോയി. അബ്രാഹാമും തന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When the Lord had finished speaking with Abraham, he left, and Abraham returned home.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord went His way as soon as He had finished speaking with Abraham; and Abraham returned to his place.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
