chapters.ml: ആ രണ്ടുദൂതന്മാർ വൈകുന്നേരത്തു സൊദോമിൽ എത്തി; ലോത്ത് സൊദോംപട്ടണ വാതിൽക്കൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു; അവരെ കാണ്ടിട്ടു ലോത്ത് എഴുന്നേറ്റു എതിരേറ്റു ചെന്നു നിലംവരെ കുനിഞ്ഞു നമസ്കരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: The two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When he saw them, he got up to meet them and bowed down with his face to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: Now the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gate of Sodom. When Lot saw them, he rose to meet them, and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground.
chapters.kjv: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

chapters.ml: യജമാനന്മാരേ, അടിയന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ കാലുകളെ കഴുകി രാപാർപ്പിൻ; കാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിങ്ങളുടെ വഴിക്കു പോകയുമാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: അല്ല, ഞങ്ങൾ വീഥിയിൽ തന്നേ രാപാർക്കും എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "My lords," he said, "please turn aside to your servant’s house. You can wash your feet and spend the night and then go on your way early in the morning." "No," they answered, "we will spend the night in the square."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Here now, my lords, please turn in to your servant’s house and spend the night, and wash your feet; then you may rise early and go on your way." And they said, "No, but we will spend the night in the open square."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ ഏറ്റവും നിർബന്ധിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ അവർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ തിരിഞ്ഞു അവന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു; അവൻ അവർക്കു വിരുന്നൊരുക്കി, പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പം ചുട്ടു; അവർ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But he insisted so strongly that they did go with him and entered his house. He prepared a meal for them, baking bread without yeast, and they ate.
chapters.nkjv: But he insisted strongly; so they turned in to him and entered his house. Then he made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
chapters.kjv: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഉറങ്ങുവാൻ പോകുമ്മുമ്പെ സൊദോംപട്ടണത്തിലെ പുരുഷന്മാർ സകല ഭാഗത്തുനിന്നും ആബാലവൃദ്ധം എല്ലാവരുംവന്നു വീടു വളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Before they had gone to bed, all the men from every part of the city of Sodom—both young and old—surrounded the house.
chapters.nkjv: Now before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, both old and young, all the people from every quarter, surrounded the house.
chapters.kjv: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

chapters.ml: അവർ ലോത്തിനെ വിളിച്ചു: ഈരാത്രി നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്ന പുരുഷന്മാർ എവിടെ? ഞങ്ങൾ അവരെ ഭോഗിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവാ എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They called to Lot, "Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us so that we can have sex with them."
chapters.nkjv: And they called to Lot and said to him, "Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us that we may know them carnally."
chapters.kjv: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

chapters.ml: ലോത്ത് വാതിൽക്കൽ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു ചെന്നു, കതകു അടെച്ചുംവെച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Lot went outside to meet them and shut the door behind him
chapters.nkjv: So Lot went out to them through the doorway, shut the door behind him,
chapters.kjv: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, ഇങ്ങനെ ദോഷം ചെയ്യരുതേ.
chapters.niv: and said, "No, my friends. Don’t do this wicked thing.
chapters.nkjv: and said, "Please, my brethren, do not do so wickedly!
chapters.kjv: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷൻ തൊടാത്ത രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാർ എനിക്കുണ്ടു; അവരെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരാം; നിങ്ങൾക്കു ബോധിച്ചതുപോലെ അവരോടു ചെയ്തുകൊൾവിൻ; ഈ പുരുഷന്മാരോടു മാത്രം ഒന്നും ചെയ്യരുതേ; ഇതിന്നായിട്ടല്ലോ അവർ എന്റെ വീട്ടിന്റെ നിഴലിൽ വന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them out to you, and you can do what you like with them. But don’t do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof."
chapters.nkjv: See now, I have two daughters who have not known a man; please, let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them as you wish; only do nothing to these men, since this is the reason they have come under the shadow of my roof."
chapters.kjv: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

chapters.ml: മാറിനിൽക്ക എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു. ഇവനൊരുത്തൻ പരദേശിയായി വന്നു പാർക്കുന്നു; ന്യായംവിധിപ്പാനും ഭാവിക്കുന്നു. ഇപ്പോൾ ഞങ്ങൾ അവരോടു ഭാവിച്ചതിലധികം നിന്നോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്യും എന്നും അവർ പറഞ്ഞു ലോത്തിനെ ഏറ്റവും തിക്കി വാതിൽ പൊളിപ്പാൻ അടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "Get out of our way," they replied. "This fellow came here as a foreigner, and now he wants to play the judge! We’ll treat you worse than them." They kept bringing pressure on Lot and moved forward to break down the door.
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "Stand back!" Then they said, "This one came in to stay here, and he keeps acting as a judge; now we will deal worse with you than with them." So they pressed hard against the man Lot, and came near to break down the door.
chapters.kjv: And they said, Stand back. And they said again , This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ കൈ പുറത്തോട്ടു നീട്ടി ലോത്തിനെ തങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ അകത്തു കയറ്റി വാതിൽഅടെച്ചു,
chapters.niv: But the men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door.
chapters.nkjv: But the men reached out their hands and pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
chapters.kjv: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

chapters.ml: വാതിൽക്കൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പുരുഷന്മാർക്കു അബാലവൃദ്ധം അന്ധത പിടിപ്പിച്ചു. അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ വാതിൽ തപ്പി നടന്നു വിഷമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they struck the men who were at the door of the house, young and old, with blindness so that they could not find the door.
chapters.nkjv: And they struck the men who were at the doorway of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they became weary trying to find the door.
chapters.kjv: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

chapters.ml: ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ ലോത്തിനോടു: ഇവിടെ നിനക്കു മറ്റു വല്ലവരുമുണ്ടോ? മരുമക്കളോ പുത്രന്മാരോ പുത്രിമാരോ ഇങ്ങനെ പട്ടണത്തിൽ നിനക്കുള്ളവരെയൊക്കെയും ഈ സ്ഥലത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപൊയ്ക്കൊൾക;
chapters.niv: The two men said to Lot, "Do you have anyone else here—sons-in-law, sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,
chapters.nkjv: Then the men said to Lot, "Have you anyone else here? Son-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city— take them out of this place!
chapters.kjv: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

chapters.ml: ഇവരെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ആവലാധി യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ വലുതായിത്തീർന്നിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങൾ ഈ സ്ഥലത്തെ നശിപ്പിക്കും. അതിനെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ യഹോവ ഞങ്ങളെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: because we are going to destroy this place. The outcry to the Lord against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it."
chapters.nkjv: For we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown great before the face of the Lord, and the Lord has sent us to destroy it."
chapters.kjv: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD ; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ലോത്ത് ചെന്നു തന്റെ പുത്രിമാരെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ള മരുമക്കളോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഈ സ്ഥലം വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെടുവിൻ; യഹോവ ഈ പട്ടണം നശിപ്പിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ അവൻ കളി പറയുന്നു എന്നു അവന്റെ മരുമക്കൾക്കു തോന്നി.
chapters.niv: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters. He said, "Hurry and get out of this place, because the Lord is about to destroy the city!" But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
chapters.nkjv: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had married his daughters, and said, "Get up, get out of this place; for the Lord will destroy this city!" But to his sons-in-law he seemed to be joking.
chapters.kjv: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

chapters.ml: ഉഷസ്സായപ്പോൾ ദൂതന്മാർ ലോത്തിനെ ബദ്ധപ്പെടുത്തി: ഈ പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ അകൃത്യത്തിൽ നശിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയെയും ഇവിടെ കാണുന്ന നിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാരെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപൊയ്ക്കൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: With the coming of dawn, the angels urged Lot, saying, "Hurry! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away when the city is punished."
chapters.nkjv: When the morning dawned, the angels urged Lot to hurry, saying, "Arise, take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the punishment of the city."
chapters.kjv: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

chapters.ml: അവൻ താമസിച്ചപ്പോൾ, യഹോവ അവനോടു കരുണ ചെയ്കയാൽ, ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ അവനെയും ഭാര്യയെയും രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാരെയും കൈക്കു പിടിച്ചു പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയിആക്കി.
chapters.niv: When he hesitated, the men grasped his hand and the hands of his wife and of his two daughters and led them safely out of the city, for the Lord was merciful to them.
chapters.nkjv: And while he lingered, the men took hold of his hand, his wife’s hand, and the hands of his two daughters, the Lord being merciful to him, and they brought him out and set him outside the city.
chapters.kjv: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

chapters.ml: അവരെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ശേഷം അവൻ: ജീവരക്ഷെക്കായി ഓടിപ്പോക: പുറകോട്ടു നോക്കരുതു; ഈ പ്രദേശത്തെങ്ങും നിൽക്കയുമരുതു; നിനക്കു നാശം ഭവിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ പർവ്വതത്തിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോക എന്നുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As soon as they had brought them out, one of them said, "Flee for your lives! Don’t look back, and don’t stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!"
chapters.nkjv: So it came to pass, when they had brought them outside, that he said, "Escape for your life! Do not look behind you nor stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be destroyed."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

chapters.ml: ലോത്ത് അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: അങ്ങനെയല്ല കർത്താവേ;
chapters.niv: But Lot said to them, "No, my lords, please!
chapters.nkjv: Then Lot said to them, "Please, no, my lords!
chapters.kjv: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു അടിയനോടു കൃപ തോന്നിയല്ലോ; എന്റെ ജീവനെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു വലിയ കൃപ നീ കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; പർവ്വതത്തിൽ ഓടി എത്തുവാൻ എനിക്കു കഴികയില്ല; പക്ഷേ എനിക്കു ദോഷം തട്ടി മരണം ഭവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Your servant has found favor in your eyes, and you have shown great kindness to me in sparing my life. But I can’t flee to the mountains; this disaster will overtake me, and I’ll die.
chapters.nkjv: Indeed now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have increased your mercy which you have shown me by saving my life; but I cannot escape to the mountains, lest some evil overtake me and I die.
chapters.kjv: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഈ പട്ടണം സമീപമാകുന്നു; അവിടേക്കു എനിക്കു ഓടാം; അതു ചെറിയതുമാകുന്നു; ഞാൻ അവിടേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോകട്ടെ. അതു ചെറിയതല്ലോ; എന്നാൽ എനിക്കു ജീവരക്ഷ ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: Look, here is a town near enough to run to, and it is small. Let me flee to it—it is very small, isn’t it? Then my life will be spared."
chapters.nkjv: See now, this city is near enough to flee to, and it is a little one; please let me escape there (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live."
chapters.kjv: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, ( is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: ഇക്കാര്യത്തിലും ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ പറഞ്ഞ പട്ടണം ഞാൻ മറിച്ചുകളകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He said to him, "Very well, I will grant this request too; I will not overthrow the town you speak of.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to him, "See, I have favored you concerning this thing also, in that I will not overthrow this city for which you have spoken.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

chapters.ml: ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു അവിടേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോക; നീ അവിടെ എത്തുവോളം എനിക്കു ഒന്നും ചെയ്‍വാൻ കഴികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതു കൊണ്ടു ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു സോവർ എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: But flee there quickly, because I cannot do anything until you reach it." (That is why the town was called Zoar. )
chapters.nkjv: Hurry, escape there. For I cannot do anything until you arrive there." Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
chapters.kjv: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

chapters.ml: ലോത്ത് സോവരിൽ കടന്നപ്പോൾ സൂര്യൻ ഉദിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By the time Lot reached Zoar, the sun had risen over the land.
chapters.nkjv: The sun had risen upon the earth when Lot entered Zoar.
chapters.kjv: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സൊദോമിന്റെയും ഗൊമോരയുടെയും മേൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു, ആകാശത്തു നിന്നു തന്നെ, ഗന്ധകവും തീയും വർഷിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the Lord out of the heavens.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah, from the Lord out of the heavens.
chapters.kjv: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

chapters.ml: ആ പട്ടണങ്ങൾക്കും പ്രദേശത്തിന്നും മുഴുവനും ആ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലെ സകലനിവാസികൾക്കും നിലത്തെ സസ്യങ്ങൾക്കും ഉന്മൂലനാശം വരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, destroying all those living in the cities—and also the vegetation in the land.
chapters.nkjv: So He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.
chapters.kjv: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

chapters.ml: ലോത്തിന്റെ ഭാര്യ അവന്റെ പിന്നിൽനിന്നു തിരിഞ്ഞുനോക്കി ഉപ്പുതൂണായി ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
chapters.nkjv: But his wife looked back behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
chapters.kjv: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം രാവിലെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു താൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നിരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു ചെന്നു,
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham went early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD :

chapters.ml: സൊദോമിന്നും ഗൊമോരെക്കും ആ പ്രദേശത്തിലെ സകലദിക്കിന്നും നേരെ നോക്കി, ദേശത്തിലെ പുക തീച്ചൂളയിലെ പുകപോലെ പൊങ്ങുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, toward all the land of the plain, and he saw dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.
chapters.nkjv: Then he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain; and he saw, and behold, the smoke of the land which went up like the smoke of a furnace.
chapters.kjv: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആ പ്രദേശത്തിലെപട്ടണങ്ങളെ നശിപ്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനെ ഓർത്തു ലോത്ത് പാർത്ത പട്ടണങ്ങൾക്കു ഉന്മൂലനാശം വരുത്തുകയിൽ ലോത്തിനെ ആ ഉന്മൂലനാശത്തിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, he remembered Abraham, and he brought Lot out of the catastrophe that overthrew the cities where Lot had lived.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot had dwelt.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ലോത്ത് സോവർ വിട്ടുപോയി; അവനും അവന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാരും പർവ്വതത്തിൽ ചെന്നു പാർത്തു; സോവരിൽ പാർപ്പാൻ അവൻ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു; അവനും അവന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാരും ഒരു ഗുഹയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains, for he was afraid to stay in Zoar. He and his two daughters lived in a cave.
chapters.nkjv: Then Lot went up out of Zoar and dwelt in the mountains, and his two daughters were with him; for he was afraid to dwell in Zoar. And he and his two daughters dwelt in a cave.
chapters.kjv: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ മൂത്തവൾ ഇളയവളോടു: നമ്മുടെ അപ്പൻ വൃദ്ധനായിരിക്കുന്നു; ഭൂമിയിൽ എല്ലാടവും ഉള്ള നടപ്പുപോലെ നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഒരു പുരുഷനും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: One day the older daughter said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is no man around here to give us children—as is the custom all over the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Now the firstborn said to the younger, "Our father is old, and thereis no man on the earth to come in to us as is the custom of all the earth.
chapters.kjv: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

chapters.ml: വരിക; അപ്പനാൽ സന്തതി ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ വീഞ്ഞുകുടിപ്പിച്ചു അവനോടുകൂടെ ശയിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Let’s get our father to drink wine and then sleep with him and preserve our family line through our father."
chapters.nkjv: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve the lineage of our father."
chapters.kjv: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അന്നു രാത്രി അവർ അപ്പനെ വീഞ്ഞുകുടിപ്പിച്ചു; മൂത്തവൾ അകത്തു ചെന്നു അപ്പനോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചു; അവൾ ശയിച്ചതും എഴുന്നേറ്റതും അവൻ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and slept with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.
chapters.nkjv: So they made their father drink wine that night. And the firstborn went in and lay with her father, and he did not know when she lay down or when she arose.
chapters.kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ മൂത്തവൾ ഇളയവളോടു: ഇന്നലെ രാത്രി ഞാൻ അപ്പനോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചു; നാം അവനെ ഇന്നു രാത്രിയും വീഞ്ഞു കുടിപ്പിക്ക; അപ്പനാൽ സന്തതി ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീയും അകത്തുചെന്നു അവനോടു കൂടെ ശയിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, "Last night I slept with my father. Let’s get him to drink wine again tonight, and you go in and sleep with him so we can preserve our family line through our father."
chapters.nkjv: It happened on the next day that the firstborn said to the younger, "Indeed I lay with my father last night; let us make him drink wine tonight also, and you go in and lie with him, that we may preserve the lineage of our father."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അന്നു രാത്രിയും അവർ അപ്പനെ വീഞ്ഞു കുടിപ്പിച്ചു; ഇളയവൾ ചെന്നു അവനോടു കൂടെ ശയിച്ചു; അവൾ ശയിച്ചതും എഴുന്നേറ്റതും അവൻ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: So they got their father to drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him. Again he was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.
chapters.nkjv: Then they made their father drink wine that night also. And the younger arose and lay with him, and he did not know when she lay down or when she arose.
chapters.kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ലോത്തിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാരും അപ്പനാൽ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.
chapters.nkjv: Thus both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father.
chapters.kjv: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

chapters.ml: മൂത്തവൾ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു അവന്നു മോവാബ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; അവൻ ഇന്നുള്ള മോവാബ്യർക്കു പിതാവു.
chapters.niv: The older daughter had a son, and she named him Moab ; he is the father of the Moabites of today.
chapters.nkjv: The firstborn bore a son and called his name Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

chapters.ml: ഇളയവളും ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവന്നു ബെൻ-അമ്മീ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; അവൻ ഇന്നുള്ള അമ്മോന്യർക്കു പിതാവു.
chapters.niv: The younger daughter also had a son, and she named him Ben-Ammi ; he is the father of the Ammonites of today.
chapters.nkjv: And the younger, she also bore a son and called his name Ben-Ammi; he is the father of the people of Ammon to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അബ്രാഹാം അവിടെനിന്നു തെക്കെ ദേശത്തേക്കു യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു കാദേശിന്നും സൂരിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ കുടിയിരുന്നു ഗെരാരിൽ പരദേശിയായി പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Now Abraham moved on from there into the region of the Negev and lived between Kadesh and Shur. For a while he stayed in Gerar,
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham journeyed from there to the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and stayed in Gerar.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറയെക്കുറിച്ചു: അവൾ എന്റെ പെങ്ങൾ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഗെരാർ രാജാവായ അബീമേലെക്ക് ആളയച്ചു സാറയെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: and there Abraham said of his wife Sarah, "She is my sister." Then Abimelek king of Gerar sent for Sarah and took her.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abraham said of Sarah his wife, "She is my sister." And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാത്രിയിൽ ദൈവം സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: നീ എടുത്ത സ്ത്രീയുടെ നിമിത്തം നീ മരിക്കും; അവൾ ഒരു പുരുഷന്റെ ഭാര്യ എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But God came to Abimelek in a dream one night and said to him, "You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman."
chapters.nkjv: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, "Indeed you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken, for she is a man’s wife."
chapters.kjv: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man’s wife.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അബീമേലെക്ക് അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നിരുന്നില്ല: ആകയാൽ അവൻ: കർത്താവേ, നീതിയുള്ള ജാതിയെയും നീ കൊല്ലുമോ?
chapters.niv: Now Abimelek had not gone near her, so he said, "Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?
chapters.nkjv: But Abimelech had not come near her; and he said, "Lord, will You slay a righteous nation also?
chapters.kjv: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

chapters.ml: ഇവൾ എന്റെ പെങ്ങളാകുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ. അവൻ എന്റെ ആങ്ങള എന്നു അവളും പറഞ്ഞു. ഹൃദയപരമാർത്ഥതയോടും കയ്യുടെ നിർമ്മലതയോടും കൂടെ ഞാൻ ഇതു ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Did he not say to me, ‘She is my sister,’ and didn’t she also say, ‘He is my brother’? I have done this with a clear conscience and clean hands."
chapters.nkjv: Did he not say to me, ‘She is my sister’? And she, even she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and innocence of my hands I have done this."
chapters.kjv: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ദൈവം സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ അവനോടു: നീ ഇതു ഹൃദയപരമാർത്ഥതയോടെ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; നീ എന്നോടു പാപം ചെയ്യാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ തടുത്തു; അതുകൊണ്ടാകുന്നു അവളെ തൊടുവാൻ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സമ്മതിക്കാതിരുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: Then God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
chapters.nkjv: And God said to him in a dream, "Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart. For I also withheld you from sinning against Me; therefore I did not let you touch her.
chapters.kjv: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ ആ പുരുഷന്നു അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ മടക്കിക്കൊടുക്ക; അവൻ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ ആകുന്നു; നീ ജീവനോടിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ നിനക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കട്ടെ. അവളെ മടക്കിക്കൊടുക്കാതിരുന്നാലോ, നീയും നിനക്കുള്ളവരൊക്കെയും മരിക്കേണ്ടിവരും എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾക എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, you may be sure that you and all who belong to you will die."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife; for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you shall live. But if you do not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you and all who are yours."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു തന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരെയും വരുത്തി ഈ കാര്യം ഒക്കെയും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Abimelek summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.
chapters.nkjv: So Abimelech rose early in the morning, called all his servants, and told all these things in their hearing; and the men were very much afraid.
chapters.kjv: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് അബ്രാഹാമിനെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു അവനോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളോടു ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? നീ എന്റെ മേലും എന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിന്മേലും ഒരു മഹാപാപം വരുത്തുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു എന്തു ദോഷം ചെയ്തു? ചെയ്യരുതാത്ത കാര്യം നീ എന്നോടു ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Abimelek called Abraham in and said, "What have you done to us? How have I wronged you that you have brought such great guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should never be done."
chapters.nkjv: And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What have you done to us? How have I offended you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done."
chapters.kjv: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്തു കണ്ടിട്ടാകുന്നു ഇക്കാര്യം ചെയ്തതു എന്നു അബീമേലെക്ക് അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അബ്രാഹാം പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: And Abimelek asked Abraham, "What was your reason for doing this?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you have in view, that you have done this thing?"
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

chapters.ml: ഈ സ്ഥലത്തു ദൈവഭയം ഇല്ല നിശ്ചയം; എന്റെ ഭാര്യനിമിത്തം അവർ എന്നെ കൊല്ലും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിരൂപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abraham replied, "I said to myself, ‘There is surely no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.’
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham said, "Because I thought, surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will kill me on account of my wife.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.

chapters.ml: വാസ്തവത്തിൽ അവൾ എന്റെ പെങ്ങളാകുന്നു; എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ മകൾ; എന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ മകളല്ല താനും; അവൾ എനിക്കു ഭാര്യയായി.
chapters.niv: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not of my mother; and she became my wife.
chapters.nkjv: But indeed sheis truly my sister. She is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
chapters.kjv: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവം എന്നെ എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ അവളോടു: നീ എനിക്കു ഒരു ദയ ചെയ്യേണം: നാം ഏതൊരു ദിക്കിൽ ചെന്നാലും അവിടെ: അവൻ എന്റെ ആങ്ങള എന്നു എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when God had me wander from my father’s household, I said to her, ‘This is how you can show your love to me: Everywhere we go, say of me, "He is my brother." ’ "
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said to her, ‘This is your kindness that you should do for me: in every place, wherever we go, say of me, "He is my brother." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു ആടുമാടുകളെയും ദാസീദാസന്മാരെയും കൊടുത്തു; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറയെയും അവന്നു മടക്കിക്കൊടുത്തു:
chapters.niv: Then Abimelek brought sheep and cattle and male and female slaves and gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah his wife to him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech took sheep, oxen, and male and female servants, and gave them to Abraham; and he restored Sarah his wife to him.
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, എന്റെ രാജ്യം നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; നിനക്കു ബോധിച്ചേടത്തു പാർത്തുകൊൾക എന്നു അബീമേലെക്ക് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Abimelek said, "My land is before you; live wherever you like."
chapters.nkjv: And Abimelech said, "See, my land is before you; dwell where it pleases you."
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

chapters.ml: സാറയോടു അവൻ: നിന്റെ ആങ്ങളെക്കു ഞാൻ ആയിരം വെള്ളിക്കാശു കൊടുത്തിട്ടുണ്ടു; നിന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള എല്ലാവരുടെയും മുമ്പാകെ ഇതു നിനക്കു ഒരു പ്രതിശാന്തി; നീ എല്ലാവർക്കും മുമ്പാകെ നീതീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ടുമിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: To Sarah he said, "I am giving your brother a thousand shekels of silver. This is to cover the offense against you before all who are with you; you are completely vindicated."
chapters.nkjv: Then to Sarah he said, "Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver; indeed this vindicates you before all who are with you and before everybody." Thus she was rebuked.
chapters.kjv: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം ദൈവത്തോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ ദൈവം അബീമേലെക്കിനെയും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെയും അവന്റെ ദാസിമാരെയും സൌഖ്യമാക്കി, അവർ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek, his wife and his female slaves so they could have children again,
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham prayed to God; and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants. Then they bore children;
chapters.kjv: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children .

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറയുടെ നിമിത്തം യഹോവ അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ ഭവനത്തിലെ ഗർഭം ഒക്കെയും അടെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: for the Lord had kept all the women in Abimelek’s household from conceiving because of Abraham’s wife Sarah.
chapters.nkjv: for the Lord had closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham’s wife.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ താൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരുന്നതുപോലെ സാറയെ സന്ദർശിച്ചു; താൻ വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തിരുന്നതു യഹോവ സാറെക്കു നിവൃത്തിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Now the Lord was gracious to Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did for Sarah what he had promised.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord visited Sarah as He had said, and the Lord did for Sarah as He had spoken.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിൽ ദൈവം അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരുന്ന അവധിക്കു സാറാ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Sarah became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised him.
chapters.nkjv: For Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
chapters.kjv: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

chapters.ml: സാറാ അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച മകന്നു അവൻ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore him.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to him—whom Sarah bore to him— Isaac.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നതുപോലെ അവൻ തന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു എട്ടാം ദിവസം പരിച്ഛേദന കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ജനിച്ചപ്പോൾ അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു നൂറു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abraham was one hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം എനിക്കു ചിരിയുണ്ടാക്കി; കേൾക്കുന്നവരെല്ലാം എന്നെച്ചൊല്ലി ചിരിക്കും എന്നു സാറാ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Sarah said, "God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me."
chapters.nkjv: And Sarah said, "God has made me laugh, and all who hear will laugh with me."
chapters.kjv: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

chapters.ml: സാറാ മക്കൾക്കു മുലകൊടുക്കുമെന്നു അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു ആർ പറയുമായിരുന്നു. അവന്റെ വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിലല്ലോ ഞാൻ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചതു എന്നും അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And she added, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age."
chapters.nkjv: She also said, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age."
chapters.kjv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

chapters.ml: പൈതൽ വളർന്നു മുലകുടി മാറി; യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ മുലകുടി മാറിയ നാളിൽ അബ്രാഹാം ഒരു വലിയ വിരുന്നു കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The child grew and was weaned, and on the day Isaac was weaned Abraham held a great feast.
chapters.nkjv: So the child grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the same day that Isaac was weaned.
chapters.kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമ്യദാസി ഹാഗാർ അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച മകൻ പരിഹാസി എന്നു സാറാ കണ്ടു അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു:
chapters.niv: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking,
chapters.nkjv: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, scoffing.
chapters.kjv: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

chapters.ml: ഈ ദാസിയെയുംമകനെയും പുറത്താക്കിക്കളക; ഈ ദാസിയുടെ മകൻ എന്റെ മകൻ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു കൂടെ അവകാശിയാകരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and she said to Abraham, "Get rid of that slave woman and her son, for that woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore she said to Abraham, "Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, namely with Isaac."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ മകൻ നിമിത്തം ഈ കാര്യം അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു അനിഷ്ടമായി.
chapters.niv: The matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son.
chapters.nkjv: And the matter was very displeasing in Abraham’s sight because of his son.
chapters.kjv: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു: ബാലന്റെ നിമിത്തവും ദാസിയുടെ നിമിത്തവും നിനക്കു അനിഷ്ടം തോന്നരുതു; സാറാ നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞതിലൊക്കെയുംഅവളുടെ വാക്കു കേൾക്ക; യിസ്ഹാക്കിൽനിന്നുള്ളവരല്ലോ നിന്റെ സാക്ഷാൽ സന്തതിയെന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: But God said to him, "Do not be so distressed about the boy and your slave woman. Listen to whatever Sarah tells you, because it is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.
chapters.nkjv: But God said to Abraham, "Do not let it be displeasing in your sight because of the lad or because of your bondwoman. Whatever Sarah has said to you, listen to her voice; for in Isaac your seed shall be called.
chapters.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

chapters.ml: ദാസിയുടെമകനെയും ഞാൻ ഒരു ജാതിയാക്കും; അവൻ നിന്റെ സന്തതിയല്ലോ എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: I will make the son of the slave into a nation also, because he is your offspring."
chapters.nkjv: Yet I will also make a nation of the son of the bondwoman, because he is your seed."
chapters.kjv: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അപ്പവും ഒരു തുരുത്തി വെള്ളവും എടുത്തു ഹാഗാരിന്റെ തോളിൽവെച്ചു, കുട്ടിയെയും കൊടുത്തു അവളെ അയച്ചു; അവൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി ബേർ-ശേബ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഉഴന്നു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Abraham took some food and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar. He set them on her shoulders and then sent her off with the boy. She went on her way and wandered in the Desert of Beersheba.
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham rose early in the morning, and took bread and a skin of water; and putting it on her shoulder, he gave it and the boy to Hagar, and sent her away. Then she departed and wandered in the Wilderness of Beersheba.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

chapters.ml: തുരുത്തിയിലെ വെള്ളം ചെലവായശേഷം അവൾ കുട്ടിയെ ഒരു കുറുങ്കാട്ടിൻ തണലിൽ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the boy under one of the bushes.
chapters.nkjv: And the water in the skin was used up, and she placed the boy under one of the shrubs.
chapters.kjv: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പോയി അതിന്നെതിരെ ഒരു അമ്പിൻ പാടു ദൂരത്തു ഇരുന്നു: കുട്ടിയുടെ മരണം എനിക്കു കാണേണ്ടാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു എതിരെ ഇരുന്നു ഉറക്കെ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then she went off and sat down about a bowshot away, for she thought, "I cannot watch the boy die." And as she sat there, she began to sob.
chapters.nkjv: Then she went and sat down across from him at a distance of about a bowshot; for she said to herself, "Let me not see the death of the boy." So she sat opposite him, and lifted her voice and wept.
chapters.kjv: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice, and wept.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ബാലന്റെ നിലവിളി കേട്ടു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദൂതൻ ആകാശത്തു നിന്നു ഹാഗാരിനെ വിളിച്ചു അവളോടു: ഹാഗാരേ, നിനക്കു എന്തു? നീ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ബാലൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നേടത്തുനിന്നു അവന്റെ നിലവിളികേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, "What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid; God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.
chapters.nkjv: And God heard the voice of the lad. Then the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said to her, "What ails you, Hagar? Fear not, for God has heard the voice of the lad where he is.
chapters.kjv: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു ബാലനെ താങ്ങി എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചുകൊൾക; ഞാൻ അവനെ ഒരു വലിയ ജാതിയാക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Lift the boy up and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation."
chapters.nkjv: Arise, lift up the lad and hold him with your hand, for I will make him a great nation."
chapters.kjv: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവളുടെ കണ്ണു തുറന്നു; അവൾ ഒരു നീരുറവു കണ്ടു, ചെന്നു തുരുത്തിയിൽ വെള്ളം നിറച്ചു ബാലനെ കുടിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
chapters.nkjv: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. And she went and filled the skin with water, and gave the lad a drink.
chapters.kjv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ബാലനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ പാർത്തു, മുതിർന്നപ്പോൾ ഒരു വില്ലാളിയായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.
chapters.nkjv: So God was with the lad; and he grew and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
chapters.kjv: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പാരാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ പാർത്തു; അവന്റെ അമ്മ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു അവന്നു ഒരു ഭാര്യയെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: While he was living in the Desert of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: He dwelt in the Wilderness of Paran; and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു അബിമേലെക്കും അവന്റെ സേനാപതിയായ പീക്കോലും അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: നിന്റെ സകലപ്രവൃത്തിയിലും ദൈവം നിന്നോടുകൂടെയുണ്ടു;
chapters.niv: At that time Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, "God is with you in everything you do.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass at that time that Abimelech and Phichol, the commander of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, "God is with you in all that you do.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ എന്നോടോ എന്റെ സന്തതിയോടോ എന്റെ കുലത്തോടോ വ്യാജം പ്രവൃത്തിക്കാതെ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ദയ കാണിച്ചതുപോലെ നീ എന്നോടും നീ പാർത്തുവരുന്ന ദേശത്തോടും ദയകാണിക്കുമെന്നു ദൈവത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി ഇവിടെവെച്ചു എന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or my descendants. Show to me and the country where you now reside as a foreigner the same kindness I have shown to you."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, swear to me by God that you will not deal falsely with me, with my offspring, or with my posterity; but that according to the kindness that I have done to you, you will do to me and to the land in which you have dwelt."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

chapters.ml: സത്യം ചെയ്യാം എന്നു അബ്രാഹാം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Abraham said, "I swear it."
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham said, "I will swear."
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said, I will swear.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ അപഹരിച്ച കിണർനിമിത്തം അബ്രാഹാം അബീമേലെക്കിനോടു ഭത്സിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Abraham complained to Abimelek about a well of water that Abimelek’s servants had seized.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham rebuked Abimelech because of a well of water which Abimelech’s servants had seized.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അബീമേലെക്; ഇക്കാര്യം ചെയ്തതു ആരെന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല; നീ എന്നെ അറിയിച്ചിട്ടില്ല; ഇന്നല്ലാതെ ഞാൻ അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു കേട്ടിട്ടുമില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Abimelek said, "I don’t know who has done this. You did not tell me, and I heard about it only today."
chapters.nkjv: And Abimelech said, "I do not know who has done this thing; you did not tell me, nor had I heard ofit until today."
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it , but to day.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അബ്രാഹാം അബീമേലെക്കിന്നു ആടുമാടുകളെ കൊടുത്തു; അവർ ഇരുവരും തമ്മിൽ ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelek, and the two men made a treaty.
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made a covenant.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം ഏഴു പെണ്ണാട്ടുകുട്ടികളെ വേറിട്ടു നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബീമേലെക്ക് അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു: നീ വേറിട്ടു നിർത്തിയ ഈ ഏഴു പെണ്ണാട്ടുകുട്ടികൾ എന്തിന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and Abimelek asked Abraham, "What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs you have set apart by themselves?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech asked Abraham, "What isthemeaningof these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves?"
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഈ കിണർ കുഴിച്ചു എന്നതിന്നു സാക്ഷിയായി നീ ഈ ഏഴു പെണ്ണാട്ടുകുട്ടികളെ എന്നോടു വാങ്ങേണം എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "You will take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that they may be my witness that I have dug this well."
chapters.kjv: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇരുവരും അവിടെവെച്ചു സത്യം ചെയ്ക കൊണ്ടു അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ബേർ-ശേബ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So that place was called Beersheba, because the two men swore an oath there.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because the two of them swore an oath there.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ ബേർ-ശേബയിൽവെച്ചു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്തു. അബീമേലെക്കും അവന്റെ സേനാപതിയായ പീക്കോലും എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ ദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: After the treaty had been made at Beersheba, Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces returned to the land of the Philistines.
chapters.nkjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba. So Abimelech rose with Phichol, the commander of his army, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം ബേർ-ശേബയിൽ ഒരു പിചുലവൃക്ഷം നട്ടു, നിത്യദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ അവിടെവെച്ചു ആരാധന കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the Lord , the Eternal God.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there called on the name of the Lord, the Everlasting God.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD , the everlasting God.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം കുറേക്കാലം ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines for a long time.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines many days.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചതു എങ്ങനെയെന്നാൽ: അബ്രാഹാമേ, എന്നു വിളിച്ചതിന്നു: ഞാൻ ഇതാ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, "Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass after these things that God tested Abraham, and said to him, "Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: നിന്റെ മകനെ, നീ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ ഏകജാതനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ തന്നേ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു മോരിയാദേശത്തു ചെന്നു, അവിടെ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്ന ഒരു മലയിൽ അവനെ ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്ക എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then God said, "Take your son, your only son, whom you love—Isaac—and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on a mountain I will show you."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said, "Take now your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I shall tell you."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു കഴുതെക്കു കോപ്പിട്ടു കെട്ടി ബാല്യക്കാരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരെയും തന്റെ മകൻ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെയും കൂട്ടി ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നു വിറകു കീറി എടുത്തുംകൊണ്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു, ദൈവം തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ച സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Abraham got up and loaded his donkey. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. When he had cut enough wood for the burnt offering, he set out for the place God had told him about.
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he split the wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം ദിവസം അബ്രാഹാം നോക്കി ദൂരത്തു നിന്നു ആ സ്ഥലം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
chapters.nkjv: Then on the third day Abraham lifted his eyes and saw the place afar off.
chapters.kjv: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം ബാല്യക്കാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ കഴുതയുമായി ഇവിടെ ഇരിപ്പിൻ; ഞാനും ബാലനും അവിടത്തോളം ചെന്നു ആരാധന കഴിച്ചു മടങ്ങിവരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to his servants, "Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you."
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham said to his young men, "Stay here with the donkey; the lad and I will go yonder and worship, and we will come back to you."
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള വിറകു എടുത്തു തന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ചുമലിൽ വെച്ചു; തീയും കത്തിയും താൻ എടുത്തു; ഇരുവരും ഒന്നിച്ചു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife, and the two of them went together.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് തന്റെ അപ്പനായ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു: അപ്പാ, എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു അവൻ: എന്താകുന്നു മകനേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. തീയും വിറകുമുണ്ടു; എന്നാൽ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടി എവിടെ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, "Father?" "Yes, my son?" Abraham replied. "The fire and wood are here," Isaac said, "but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"
chapters.nkjv: But Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, "My father!" And he said, "Here I am, my son." Then he said, "Look, the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?"
chapters.kjv: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

chapters.ml: ദൈവം തനിക്കു ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ നോക്കിക്കൊള്ളും, മകനേ, എന്നു അബ്രാഹാം പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഇരുവരും ഒന്നിച്ചു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abraham answered, "God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son." And the two of them went on together.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham said, "My son, God will provide for Himself the lamb for a burnt offering." So the two of them went together.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചിരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു അവർ എത്തി; അബ്രാഹാം ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു, വിറകു അടുക്കി, തന്റെ മകൻ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ കെട്ടി യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ വിറകിന്മീതെ കിടത്തി.
chapters.niv: When they reached the place God had told him about, Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to the place of which God had told him. And Abraham built an altar there and placed the wood in order; and he bound Isaac his son and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.
chapters.kjv: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അബ്രാഹാം കൈ നീട്ടി തന്റെ മകനെ അറുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു കത്തി എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham stretched out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു: അബ്രാഹാമേ, അബ്രാഹാമേ, എന്നു വിളിച്ചു; ഞാൻ ഇതാ, എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the angel of the Lord called out to him from heaven, "Abraham! Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: But the Angel of the Lord called to him from heaven and said, "Abraham, Abraham!" So he said, "Here I am."
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

chapters.ml: ബാലന്റെ മേൽ കൈവെക്കരുതു; അവനോടു ഒന്നും ചെയ്യരുതു; നിന്റെ ഏകജാതനായ മകനെ തരുവാൻ നീ മടിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു നീ ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ അറിയുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "Do not lay a hand on the boy," he said. "Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son."
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Do not lay your hand on the lad, or do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from Me."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം തലപൊക്കി നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ പിമ്പുറത്തു ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ കൊമ്പു കാട്ടിൽ പിടിപെട്ടു കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അബ്രാഹാം ചെന്നു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ പിടിച്ചു തന്റെ മകന്നു പകരം ഹോമയാഗം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham lifted his eyes and looked, and there behind himwas a ram caught in a thicket by its horns. So Abraham went and took the ram, and offered it up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു യഹോവ-യിരേ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു. യഹോവയുടെ പർവ്വതത്തിൽ അവൻ പ്രത്യക്ഷനാകും എന്നു ഇന്നുവരെയും പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide. And to this day it is said, "On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided."
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham called the name of the place, The-Lord-Will-Provide; as it is said to this day, "In the Mount of the Lord it shall be provided."
chapters.kjv: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ രണ്ടാമതും ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു വിളിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord called to Abraham from heaven a second time
chapters.nkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time out of heaven,
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

chapters.ml: നീ ഈ കാര്യം ചെയ്തു, നിന്റെ ഏകജാതനായ മകനെ തരുവാൻ മടിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: and said, "I swear by myself, declares the Lord , that because you have done this and have not withheld your son, your only son,
chapters.nkjv: and said: "By Myself I have sworn, says the Lord, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son—
chapters.kjv: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD , for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ഐശ്വര്യമായി അനുഗ്രഹിക്കും; നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ ആകാശത്തിലെ നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾപോലെയും കടൽക്കരയിലെ മണൽപോലെയും അത്യന്തം വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കും; നിന്റെ സന്തതി ശത്രുക്കളുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളെ കൈവശമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies,
chapters.nkjv: blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply your descendants as the stars of the heaven and as the sand which is on the seashore; and your descendants shall possess the gate of their enemies.
chapters.kjv: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ വാക്കു അനുസരിച്ചതു കൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ സന്തതി മുഖാന്തരം ഭൂമിയിലുള്ള സകലജാതികളും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടും എന്നു ഞാൻ എന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു തന്നേ സത്യം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me."
chapters.nkjv: In your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice."
chapters.kjv: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അബ്രാഹാം ബാല്യക്കാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നു; അവർ ഒന്നിച്ചു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ബേർ--ശേബയിലേക്കു പോന്നു; അബ്രാഹാം ബേർ-ശേബയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
chapters.kjv: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം മിൽക്കയും നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ നാഹോരിന്നു മക്കളെ പ്രസവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു വർത്തമാനം കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Some time later Abraham was told, "Milkah is also a mother; she has borne sons to your brother Nahor:
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass after these things that it was told Abraham, saying, "Indeed Milcah also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

chapters.ml: അവർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ആദ്യജാതൻ ഊസ്, അവന്റെ അനുജൻ ബൂസ്, അരാമിന്റെ പിതാവായ കെമൂവേൽ,
chapters.niv: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel (the father of Aram),
chapters.nkjv: Huz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
chapters.kjv: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

chapters.ml: കേശെദ്, ഹസോ, പിൽദാശ്, യിദലാഫ്, ബെഥൂവേൽ.
chapters.niv: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph and Bethuel."
chapters.nkjv: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel."
chapters.kjv: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

chapters.ml: ബെഥൂവേൽ റിബെക്കയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. ഈ എട്ടു പേരെ മിൽക്കാ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ നാഹോരിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milkah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.
chapters.nkjv: And Bethuel begot Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
chapters.kjv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടി രെയൂമാ എന്നവളും തേബഹ്, ഗഹാം, തഹശ്, മാഖാ എന്നിവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maakah.
chapters.nkjv: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Thahash, and Maachah.
chapters.kjv: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

chapters.ml: സാറെക്കു നൂറ്റിരുപത്തേഴു വയസ്സു ആയിരുന്നു: ഇതു സാറയുടെ ആയുഷ്കാലം.
chapters.niv: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.
chapters.nkjv: Sarah lived one hundred and twenty-seven years; thesewere the years of the life of Sarah.
chapters.kjv: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

chapters.ml: സാറാ കനാൻ ദേശത്തു ഹെബ്രോൻ എന്ന കിർയ്യത്തർബ്ബയിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചു; അബ്രാഹാം സാറയെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലപിച്ചു കരവാൻ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.
chapters.nkjv: So Sarah died in Kirjath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her.
chapters.kjv: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അബ്രാഹാം മരിച്ചവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഹിത്യരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
chapters.kjv: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പരദേശിയും വന്നു പാർക്കുന്നവനും ആകുന്നു; ഞാൻ എന്റെ മരിച്ചവളെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി അടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എനിക്കു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒരു ശ്മശാനഭൂമി അവകാശമായി തരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I am a foreigner and stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead."
chapters.nkjv: "I am a foreigner and a visitor among you. Give me property for a burial place among you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight."
chapters.kjv: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

chapters.ml: ഹിത്യർ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു: യജമാനനേ, കേട്ടാലും:
chapters.niv: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
chapters.kjv: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

chapters.ml: നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ഒരു പ്രഭുവാകുന്നു; ഞങ്ങളുടെ ശ്മശാനസ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽവെച്ചു വിശേഷമായതിൽ മരിച്ചവളെ അടക്കിക്കൊൾക; മരിച്ചവളെ അടക്കുവാൻ ഞങ്ങളിൽ ആരും ശ്മശാനസ്ഥലം നിനക്കു തരാതിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead."
chapters.nkjv: "Hear us, my lord: You are a mighty prince among us; bury your dead in the choicest of our burial places. None of us will withhold from you his burial place, that you may bury your dead."
chapters.kjv: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്രാഹാം എഴുന്നേറ്റു ആ ദേശക്കാരായ ഹിത്യരെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham stood up and bowed himself to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മരിച്ചവളെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി അടക്കുവാൻ സമ്മതമുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി സോഹരിന്റെ മകനായ എഫ്രോനോടു,
chapters.niv: He said to them, "If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me and intercede with Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
chapters.nkjv: And he spoke with them, saying, "If it is your wish that I bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and meet with Ephron the son of Zohar for me,
chapters.kjv: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ നിലത്തിന്റെ അറുതിയിൽ തനിക്കുള്ള മക്ക്പേലാ എന്ന ഗുഹ എനിക്കു തരേണ്ടതിന്നു അപേക്ഷിപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ശ്മശാനാവകാശമായിട്ടു അവൻ അതിനെ പിടിപ്പതു വിലെക്കു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: so he will sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price as a burial site among you."
chapters.nkjv: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah which he has, which is at the end of his field. Let him give it to me at the full price, as property for a burial place among you."
chapters.kjv: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എഫ്രോൻ ഹിത്യരുടെ നടുവിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു; ഹിത്യനായ എഫ്രോൻ തന്റെ നഗരവാസികളായ ഹിത്യർ എല്ലാവരും കേൾക്കെ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു:
chapters.niv: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
chapters.nkjv: Now Ephron dwelt among the sons of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the presence of the sons of Heth, all who entered at the gate of his city, saying,
chapters.kjv: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയല്ല, യജമാനനേ, കേൾക്കേണമേ; നിലം ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തരുന്നു; അതിലെ ഗുഹയും നിനക്കു തരുന്നു; എന്റെ സ്വജനം കാൺകെ തരുന്നു; മരിച്ചവളെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടാലും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "No, my lord," he said. "Listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead."
chapters.nkjv: "No, my lord, hear me: I give you the field and the cave that is in it; I give it to you in the presence of the sons of my people. I give it to you. Bury your dead!"
chapters.kjv: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്രാഹാം ദേശത്തിലെ ജനത്തെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land;
chapters.kjv: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തിലെ ജനം കേൾക്കെ അവൻ എഫ്രോനോടു: ദയ ചെയ്തു കേൾക്കേണം; നിലത്തിന്റെ വില ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തരുന്നതു എന്നോടു വാങ്ങേണം; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ മരിച്ചവളെ അവിടെ അടക്കം ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and he said to Ephron in their hearing, "Listen to me, if you will. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me so I can bury my dead there."
chapters.nkjv: and he spoke to Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, saying, "If you willgiveit, please hear me. I will give you money for the field; take it from me and I will bury my dead there."
chapters.kjv: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it , I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രോൻ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു: യജമാനനേ, കേട്ടാലും:
chapters.niv: Ephron answered Abraham,
chapters.nkjv: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
chapters.kjv: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

chapters.ml: നാനൂറു ശേക്കെൽ വെള്ളി വിലയുള്ള ഒരു ഭൂമി, അതു എനിക്കും നിനക്കും എന്തുള്ളു? മരിച്ചവളെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തുകൊൾക എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead."
chapters.nkjv: "My lord, listen to me; the land isworth four hundred shekels of silver. What is that between you and me? So bury your dead."
chapters.kjv: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം എഫ്രോന്റെ വാക്കു സമ്മതിച്ചു ഹിത്യർ കേൾക്കെ എഫ്രോൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ കച്ചവടക്കാർക്കു നടപ്പുള്ള വെള്ളിശേക്കെൽ നാനൂറു അവന്നു തൂക്കിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham listened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed out the silver for Ephron which he had named in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, currency of the merchants.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മമ്രേക്കരികെ എഫ്രോന്നുള്ള മക്ക്പേലാനിലവും അതിലെ ഗുഹയും നിലത്തിന്റെ അതിർക്കകത്തുള്ള സകലവൃക്ഷങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: So Ephron’s field in Machpelah near Mamre—both the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the borders of the field—was deeded
chapters.nkjv: So the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field and the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, which were within all the surrounding borders, were deeded
chapters.kjv: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ നഗരവാസികളായ ഹിത്യരുടെ മുമ്പാകെ അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു അവകാശമായി ഉറെച്ചുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: to Abraham as his property in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.
chapters.nkjv: to Abraham as a possession in the presence of the sons of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
chapters.kjv: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അബ്രാഹാം തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറയെ കനാൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ഹെബ്രോൻ എന്ന മമ്രേക്കരികെയുള്ള മക്ക്പേലാനിലത്തിലെ ഗുഹയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah, before Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ഹിത്യർ ആ നിലവും അതിലെ ഗുഹയും അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു ശ്മശാനാവകാശമായി ഉറപ്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.
chapters.nkjv: So the field and the cave that is in it were deeded to Abraham by the sons of Heth as property for a burial place.
chapters.kjv: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം വയസ്സുചെന്നു വൃദ്ധനായി; യഹോവ അബ്രാഹാമിനെ സകലത്തിലും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abraham was now very old, and the Lord had blessed him in every way.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abraham was old, well advanced in age; and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ മൂപ്പനും തനിക്കുള്ളതിന്നൊക്കെയും വിചാരകനുമായ ദാസനോടു അബ്രാഹാം പറഞ്ഞതു: നിന്റെ കൈ എന്റെ തുടയിൻ കീഴിൽ വെക്കുക;
chapters.niv: He said to the senior servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, "Put your hand under my thigh.
chapters.nkjv: So Abraham said to the oldest servant of his house, who ruled over all that he had, "Please, put your hand under my thigh,
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

chapters.ml: ചുറ്റും പാർക്കുന്ന കനാന്യരുടെ കന്യകമാരിൽനിന്നു നീ എന്റെ മകന്നു ഭാര്യയെ എടുക്കാതെ,
chapters.niv: I want you to swear by the Lord , the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I am living,
chapters.nkjv: and I will make you swear by the Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell;
chapters.kjv: And I will make thee swear by the LORD , the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദേശത്തും എന്റെ ചാർച്ചക്കാരുടെ അടുക്കലും ചെന്നു എന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു ഭാര്യയെ എടുക്കുമെന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്നും ഭൂമിക്കും ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിക്കും.
chapters.niv: but will go to my country and my own relatives and get a wife for my son Isaac."
chapters.nkjv: but you shall go to my country and to my family, and take a wife for my son Isaac."
chapters.kjv: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

chapters.ml: ദാസൻ അവനോടു: പക്ഷേ സ്ത്രീക്കു എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഈ ദേശത്തേക്കു വരുവാൻ മനസ്സില്ലെങ്കിലോ? നീ വിട്ടുപോന്ന ദേശത്തേക്കു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മകനെ മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടുപോകേണമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The servant asked him, "What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?"
chapters.nkjv: And the servant said to him, "Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land. Must I take your son back to the land from which you came?"
chapters.kjv: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ മകനെ അവിടെക്കു മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു പോകാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: "Make sure that you do not take my son back there," Abraham said.
chapters.nkjv: But Abraham said to him, "Beware that you do not take my son back there.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
