chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽനിന്നും ജന്മദേശത്തുനിന്നും എന്നെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നവനും എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തവനും നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കു ഞാൻ ഈ ദേശം കൊടുക്കുമെന്നു എന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തവനുമായി സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ എന്റെ മകന്നു നീ ഒരു ഭാര്യയെ അവിടെനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിനക്കു മുമ്പായി തന്റെ ദൂതനെ അയക്കും.
chapters.niv: "The Lord , the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father’s household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house and from the land of my family, and who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, ‘To your descendants I give this land,’ He will send His angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
chapters.kjv: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സ്ത്രീക്കു നിന്നോടുകൂടെ വരുവാൻ മനസ്സില്ലെങ്കിൽ നീ ഈ സത്യത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കും; എന്റെ മകനെ അവിടേക്കു മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടുപോക മാത്രം അരുതു.
chapters.niv: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there."
chapters.nkjv: And if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you will be released from this oath; only do not take my son back there."
chapters.kjv: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാസൻ തന്റെ യജമാനനായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ തുടയിൻ കീഴിൽ കൈവെച്ചു അങ്ങനെ അവനോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
chapters.nkjv: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
chapters.kjv: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ആ ദാസൻ തന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങളിൽ പത്തു ഒട്ടകങ്ങളെയും യജമാനന്നുള്ള വിവിധമായ വിശേഷവസ്തുക്കളെയും കൊണ്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു മെസൊപ്പൊത്താമ്യയിൽ നാഹോരിന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the servant left, taking with him ten of his master’s camels loaded with all kinds of good things from his master. He set out for Aram Naharaim and made his way to the town of Nahor.
chapters.nkjv: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels and departed, for all his master’s goods werein his hand. And he arose and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
chapters.kjv: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

chapters.ml: വൈകുന്നേരം സ്ത്രീകൾ വെള്ളം കോരുവാൻ വരുന്ന സമയത്തു അവൻ ഒട്ടകങ്ങളെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു ഒരു കിണറ്റിന്നരികെ നിറുത്തി പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.
chapters.nkjv: And he made his camels kneel down outside the city by a well of water at evening time, the time when women go out to draw water.
chapters.kjv: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water .

chapters.ml: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, എന്റെ യജമാനനായ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു കൃപചെയ്തു ഇന്നുതന്നെ കാര്യം സാധിപ്പിച്ചുതരേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Then he prayed, " Lord , God of my master Abraham, make me successful today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "O Lord God of my master Abraham, please give me success this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
chapters.kjv: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ കിണറ്റിന്നരികെ നില്ക്കുന്നു; ഈ പട്ടണക്കാരുടെ കന്യകമാർ വെള്ളം കോരുവാൻ വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, here I stand by the well of water, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പാത്രം ഇറക്കി എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ തരേണം എന്നു ഞാൻ പറയുമ്പോൾ: കുടിക്ക; നിന്റെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കും കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുക്കാമെന്നു പറയുന്ന സ്ത്രീ തന്നേ നീ നിന്റെ ദാസനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു നിയമിച്ചവളായിരിക്കട്ടെ; നീ എന്റെ യജമാനനോടു കൃപ ചെയ്തു എന്നു ഞാൻ അതിനാൽ ഗ്രഹിക്കും.
chapters.niv: May it be that when I say to a young woman, ‘Please let down your jar that I may have a drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too’—let her be the one you have chosen for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master."
chapters.nkjv: Now let it be that the young woman to whom I say, ‘Please let down your pitcher that I may drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink’—let her betheone You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. And by this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master."
chapters.kjv: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു തീരുംമുമ്പെ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ നാഹോരിന്റെ ഭാര്യ മിൽക്കയുടെ മകൻ ബെഥൂവേലിന്റെ മകൾ റിബെക്കാ തോളിൽ പാത്രവുമായി വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milkah, who was the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, came out with her pitcher on her shoulder.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

chapters.ml: ബാല അതിസുന്ദരിയും പുരുഷൻ തൊടാത്ത കന്യകയും ആയിരുന്നു; അവൾ കിണറ്റിൽ ഇറങ്ങി പാത്രം നിറച്ചു കയറിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The woman was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever slept with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.
chapters.nkjv: Now the young woman was very beautiful to behold, a virgin; no man had known her. And she went down to the well, filled her pitcher, and came up.
chapters.kjv: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

chapters.ml: ദാസൻ വേഗത്തിൽ അവളെ എതിരേറ്റു ചെന്നു: നിന്റെ പാത്രത്തിലെ വെള്ളം കുറെ എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The servant hurried to meet her and said, "Please give me a little water from your jar."
chapters.nkjv: And the servant ran to meet her and said, "Please let me drink a little water from your pitcher."
chapters.kjv: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

chapters.ml: യജമാനനേ, കുടിക്ക എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു വേഗം പാത്രം കയ്യിൽ ഇറക്കി അവന്നു കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "Drink, my lord," she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
chapters.nkjv: So she said, "Drink, my lord." Then she quickly let her pitcher down to her hand, and gave him a drink.
chapters.kjv: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുത്ത ശേഷം: നിന്റെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കും വേണ്ടുവോളം ഞാൻ കോരിക്കൊടുക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു,
chapters.niv: After she had given him a drink, she said, "I’ll draw water for your camels too, until they have had enough to drink."
chapters.nkjv: And when she had finished giving him a drink, she said, "I will draw water for your camels also, until they have finished drinking."
chapters.kjv: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

chapters.ml: പാത്രത്തിലെ വെള്ളം വേഗം തൊട്ടിയിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു, പിന്നെയും കോരിക്കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ കിണറ്റിലേക്കു ഓടി ഇറങ്ങി അവന്റെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കും എല്ലാം കോരിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough, ran back to the well to draw more water, and drew enough for all his camels.
chapters.nkjv: Then she quickly emptied her pitcher into the trough, ran back to the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
chapters.kjv: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels.

chapters.ml: ആ പുരുഷൻ അവളെ ഉറ്റുനോക്കി, യഹോവ തന്റെ യാത്രയെ സഫലമാക്കിയോ ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the Lord had made his journey successful.
chapters.nkjv: And the man, wondering at her, remained silent so as to know whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
chapters.kjv: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

chapters.ml: ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾ കുടിച്ചു തീർന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ അര ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കമുള്ള ഒരു പൊന്മൂക്കുത്തിയും അവളുടെ കൈക്കിടുവാൻ പത്തു ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കമുള്ള രണ്ടു പൊൻവളയും എടുത്തു അവളോടു:
chapters.niv: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the camels had finished drinking, that the man took a golden nose ring weighing half a shekel, and two bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels of gold,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

chapters.ml: നീ ആരുടെ മകൾ? പറക; നിന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാപാർപ്പാൻ സ്ഥലമുണ്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he asked, "Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?"
chapters.nkjv: and said, "Whose daughter are you? Tell me, please, is there room in your father’s house for us to lodge?"
chapters.kjv: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനോടു: നാഹോരിന്നു മിൽക്കാ പ്രസവിച്ച മകനായ ബെഥൂവേലിന്റെ മകൾ ആകുന്നു ഞാൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She answered him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milkah bore to Nahor."
chapters.nkjv: So she said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s son, whom she bore to Nahor."
chapters.kjv: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെയവിടെ വയ്ക്കോലും തീനും വേണ്ടുവോളം ഉണ്ടു; രാപാർപ്പാൻ സ്ഥലവും ഉണ്ടു എന്നും അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And she added, "We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night."
chapters.nkjv: Moreover she said to him, "We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge."
chapters.kjv: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആ പുരുഷൻ കുനിഞ്ഞു യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: Then the man bowed down his head and worshiped the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ; അവൻ എന്റെ യജമാനനോടുള്ള ദയയും വിശ്വസ്തതയും ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചിട്ടില്ല. ഈ യാത്രയിൽ യഹോവ എന്നെ എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു നടത്തിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: saying, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the Lord has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken His mercy and His truth toward my master. As for me, being on the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master’s brethren."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

chapters.ml: ബാല ഓടിച്ചെന്നു അമ്മയുടെ വീട്ടുകാരെ ഈ വസ്തുത അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
chapters.nkjv: So the young woman ran and told her mother’s household these things.
chapters.kjv: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.

chapters.ml: റിബെക്കെക്കു ഒരു സഹോദരൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു ലാബാൻ എന്നു പേർ. ലാബാൻ പുറത്തു കിണറ്റിങ്കൽ ആ പുരുഷന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.
chapters.nkjv: Now Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban, and Laban ran out to the man by the well.
chapters.kjv: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂക്കുത്തിയും സഹോദരിയുടെ കൈമേൽ വളയും കാണുകയും ആ പുരുഷൻ ഇന്നപ്രകാരം എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു തന്റെ സഹോദരിയായ റിബെക്കയുടെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കയും ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ ആ പുരുഷന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; അവൻ കിണറ്റിങ്കൽ ഒട്ടകങ്ങളുടെ അരികെ നിൽക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As soon as he had seen the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s arms, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man said to her, he went out to the man and found him standing by the camels near the spring.
chapters.nkjv: So it came to pass, when he saw the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists, and when he heard the words of his sister Rebekah, saying, "Thus the man spoke to me," that he went to the man. And there he stood by the camels at the well.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: യഹോവയാൽ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവനേ, അകത്തു വരിക; എന്തിന്നു പുറത്തു നില്ക്കുന്നു? വീടും ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കു സ്ഥലവും ഞാൻ ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Come, you who are blessed by the Lord ," he said. "Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Come in, O blessed of the Lord! Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD ; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ആ പുരുഷൻ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു. അവൻ ഒട്ടകങ്ങളെ കോപ്പഴിച്ചു ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കു വയ്ക്കോലും തീനും അവന്നും കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും കാലുകളെ കഴുകുവാൻ വെള്ളവും കൊടുത്തു, അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഭക്ഷണം വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet.
chapters.nkjv: Then the man came to the house. And he unloaded the camels, and provided straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
chapters.kjv: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വന്ന കാര്യം അറിയിക്കും മുമ്പെ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. പറക എന്നു അവനും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then food was set before him, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say." "Then tell us," Laban said.
chapters.nkjv: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told about my errand." And he said, "Speak on."
chapters.kjv: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദാസൻ.
chapters.niv: So he said, "I am Abraham’s servant.
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "I am Abraham’s servant.
chapters.kjv: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എന്റെ യജമാനനെ ഏറ്റവും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവൻ മഹാനായിത്തീർന്നു; അവൻ അവന്നു ആടു, മാടു, പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, ദാസീദാസന്മാർ, ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾ കഴുതകൾ എന്നീവകയൊക്കെയും കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord has blessed my master abundantly, and he has become wealthy. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has blessed my master greatly, and he has become great; and He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറാ വൃദ്ധയായശേഷം എന്റെ യജമാനന്നു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവൻ തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അവന്നു കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.
chapters.nkjv: And Sarah my master’s wife bore a son to my master when she was old; and to him he has given all that he has.
chapters.kjv: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പാർക്കുന്ന കനാൻ ദേശത്തിലെ കനാന്യ കന്യകമാരിൽനിന്നു നീ എന്റെ മകന്നു ഭാര്യയെ എടുക്കാതെ,
chapters.niv: And my master made me swear an oath, and said, ‘You must not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
chapters.nkjv: Now my master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell;
chapters.kjv: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിലും വംശക്കാരുടെ അടുക്കലും ചെന്നു എന്റെ മകന്നു ഭാര്യയെ എടുക്കേണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു യജമാനൻ എന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: but go to my father’s family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.’
chapters.nkjv: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my family, and take a wife for my son.’
chapters.kjv: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യജമാനനോടു: പക്ഷേ സ്ത്രീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ പേരുന്നില്ലെങ്കിലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു അവൻ എന്നോടു:
chapters.niv: "Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’
chapters.nkjv: And I said to my master, ‘Perhaps the woman will not follow me.’
chapters.kjv: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സേവിച്ചുപോരുന്ന യഹോവ തന്റെ ദൂതനെ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ അയച്ചു, നീ എന്റെ വംശത്തിൽനിന്നും പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽനിന്നും എന്റെ മകന്നു ഭാര്യയെ എടുപ്പാന്തക്കവണ്ണം നിന്റെ യാത്രയെ സഫലമാക്കും;
chapters.niv: "He replied, ‘The Lord , before whom I have walked faithfully, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you can get a wife for my son from my own clan and from my father’s family.
chapters.nkjv: But he said to me, ‘The Lord, before whom I walk, will send His angel with you and prosper your way; and you shall take a wife for my son from my family and from my father’s house.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, The LORD , before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വംശക്കാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നാൽ നീ ഈ സത്യത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കും; അവർ നിനക്കു തരുന്നില്ല എന്നു വരികിലും നീ ഈ സത്യത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You will be released from my oath if, when you go to my clan, they refuse to give her to you—then you will be released from my oath.’
chapters.nkjv: You will be clear from this oath when you arrive among my family; for if they will not give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.’
chapters.kjv: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one , thou shalt be clear from my oath.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇന്നു കിണറ്റിന്നരികെ വന്നപ്പോൾ പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ യാത്രയെ നീ സഫലമാക്കി എങ്കിൽ--
chapters.niv: "When I came to the spring today, I said, ‘ Lord , God of my master Abraham, if you will, please grant success to the journey on which I have come.
chapters.nkjv: "And this day I came to the well and said, ‘O Lord God of my master Abraham, if You will now prosper the way in which I go,
chapters.kjv: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ കിണറ്റിന്നരികെ നില്ക്കുന്നു; വെള്ളം കോരുവാൻ ഒരു കന്യക വരികയും ഞാൻ അവളോടു: നിന്റെ പാത്രത്തിലെ വെള്ളം കുറെ എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ തരിക എന്നു പറയുമ്പോൾ, അവൾ എന്നോടു: കുടിക്ക,
chapters.niv: See, I am standing beside this spring. If a young woman comes out to draw water and I say to her, "Please let me drink a little water from your jar,"
chapters.nkjv: behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass that when the virgin comes out to draw water, and I say to her, "Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,"
chapters.kjv: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water , and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കും കോരി കൊടുക്കാമെന്നു പറകയും ചെയ്താൽ അവൾ തന്നേ യഹോവ എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ മകന്നു നിയമിച്ച സ്ത്രീയായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: and if she says to me, "Drink, and I’ll draw water for your camels too," let her be the one the Lord has chosen for my master’s son.’
chapters.nkjv: and she says to me, "Drink, and I will draw for your camels also,"—let her be the woman whom the Lord has appointed for my master’s son.’
chapters.kjv: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master’s son.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇങ്ങനെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞു തീരുമ്മുമ്പെ ഇതാ, റിബെക്കാ തോളിൽ പാത്രവുമായി വന്നു കിണറ്റിൽ ഇറങ്ങി വെള്ളം കോരി; ഞാൻ അവളോടു: എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Before I finished praying in my heart, Rebekah came out, with her jar on her shoulder. She went down to the spring and drew water, and I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’
chapters.nkjv: "But before I had finished speaking in my heart, there was Rebekah, coming out with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down to the well and drew water. And I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’
chapters.kjv: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

chapters.ml: അവൾ വേഗം തോളിൽനിന്നു പാത്രം ഇറക്കി: കുടിക്ക, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കും കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ കുടിച്ചു; അവൾ ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾക്കും കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too.’ So I drank, and she watered the camels also.
chapters.nkjv: And she made haste and let her pitcher down from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will give your camels a drink also.’ So I drank, and she gave the camels a drink also.
chapters.kjv: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവളോടു: നീ ആരുടെ മകൾ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവൾ: മിൽക്കാ നാഹോറിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച മകനായ ബെഥൂവേലിന്റെ മകൾ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഞാൻ അവളുടെ മൂക്കിന്നു മൂക്കുത്തിയും കൈകൾക്കു വളയും ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: "I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ "She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milkah bore to him.’ "Then I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms,
chapters.nkjv: Then I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ And she said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ So I put the nose ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.
chapters.kjv: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കുനിഞ്ഞു യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു, എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ സഹോദരന്റെ മകളെ അവന്റെ മകന്നായിട്ടു എടുപ്പാൻ എന്നെ നേർവ്വഴിക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നവനായി എന്റെ യജമാനൻ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: and I bowed down and worshiped the Lord . I praised the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who had led me on the right road to get the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son.
chapters.nkjv: And I bowed my head and worshiped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the way of truth to take the daughter of my master’s brother for his son.
chapters.kjv: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD , and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ യജമാനനോടു ദയയും വിശ്വസ്തതയും കാണിക്കുമെങ്കിൽ എന്നോടു പറവിൻ; അല്ല എന്നു വരികിൽ അതും പറവിൻ; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഇടത്തോട്ടോ വലത്തോട്ടോ തിരിഞ്ഞുകൊള്ളാം.
chapters.niv: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; and if not, tell me, so I may know which way to turn."
chapters.nkjv: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. And if not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand or to the left."
chapters.kjv: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ലാബാനും ബെഥൂവേലും: ഈ കാര്യം യഹോവയാൽ വരുന്നു; നിന്നോടു ഗുണമെങ്കിലും ദോഷമെങ്കിലും പറവാൻ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു കഴികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Laban and Bethuel answered, "This is from the Lord ; we can say nothing to you one way or the other.
chapters.nkjv: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, "The thing comes from the Lord; we cannot speak to you either bad or good.
chapters.kjv: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, റിബെക്കാ നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; അവളെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോക; യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവൾ നിന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ മകന്നു ഭാര്യയാകട്ടെ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Here is Rebekah; take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, as the Lord has directed."
chapters.nkjv: Here is Rebekah before you; take her and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as the Lord has spoken."
chapters.kjv: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her , and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദാസൻ അവരുടെ വാക്കു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ യഹോവയെ സാഷ്ടാംഗം നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Abraham’s servant heard what they said, he bowed down to the ground before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, that he worshiped the Lord, bowinghimself to the earth.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD , bowing himself to the earth.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാസൻ വെള്ളിയാഭരണങ്ങളും പൊന്നാഭരണങ്ങളും വസ്ത്രങ്ങളും എടുത്തു റിബെക്കെക്കു കൊടുത്തു; അവളുടെ സഹോദരന്നും അമ്മെക്കും വിശേഷവസ്തുക്കൾ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the servant brought out gold and silver jewelry and articles of clothing and gave them to Rebekah; he also gave costly gifts to her brother and to her mother.
chapters.nkjv: Then the servant brought out jewelry of silver, jewelry of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and to her mother.
chapters.kjv: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

chapters.ml: അവനും കൂടെയുള്ളവരും ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്തു രാപാർത്തു. രാവിലെ അവർ എഴുന്നേറ്റശേഷം അവൻ: എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എന്നെ അയക്കേണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he and the men who were with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, "Send me on my way to my master."
chapters.nkjv: And he and the men who were with him ate and drank and stayed all night. Then they arose in the morning, and he said, "Send me away to my master."
chapters.kjv: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവളുടെ സഹോദരനും അമ്മയും: ബാല ഒരു പത്തുദിവസമെങ്കിലും ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തിട്ടു പിന്നെ പോരട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But her brother and her mother replied, "Let the young woman remain with us ten days or so; then you may go."
chapters.nkjv: But her brother and her mother said, "Let the young woman stay with us afew days, at least ten; after that she may go."
chapters.kjv: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: എന്നെ താമസിപ്പിക്കരുതേ; യഹോവ എന്റെ യാത്ര സഫലമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; യജമാനന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോകുവാൻ എന്നെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he said to them, "Do not detain me, now that the Lord has granted success to my journey. Send me on my way so I may go to my master."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to them, "Do not hinder me, since the Lord has prospered my way; send me away so that I may go to my master."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ബാലയെ വിളിച്ചു അവളോടു ചോദിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they said, "Let’s call the young woman and ask her about it."
chapters.nkjv: So they said, "We will call the young woman and ask her personally."
chapters.kjv: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

chapters.ml: അവർ റിബെക്കയെ വിളിച്ചു അവളോടു: നീ ഈ പുരുഷനോടുകൂടെ പോകുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. ഞാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So they called Rebekah and asked her, "Will you go with this man?" "I will go," she said.
chapters.nkjv: Then they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" And she said, "I will go."
chapters.kjv: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരിയായ റിബെക്കയെയും അവളുടെ ധാത്രിയെയും അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദാസനെയും അവന്റെ ആളുകളെയും പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.
chapters.nkjv: So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant and his men.
chapters.kjv: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.

chapters.ml: അവർ റിബെക്കയെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവളോടു: സഹോദരീ, നീ അനേകായിരമായി തീരുക; നിന്റെ സന്തതി, തന്നെ ദ്വേഷിക്കുന്നവരുടെ പടിവാതിൽ കൈവശമാക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, "Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the cities of their enemies."
chapters.nkjv: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her: "Our sister, may you become Themotherof thousands of ten thousands; And may your descendants possess The gates of those who hate them."
chapters.kjv: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ റിബെക്കയും അവളുടെ ദാസിമാരും എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഒട്ടകപ്പുറത്തു കയറി ആ പുരുഷനോടുകൂടെ പോയി; അങ്ങനെ ദാസൻ റിബെക്കയെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Rebekah and her attendants got ready and mounted the camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.
chapters.nkjv: Then Rebekah and her maids arose, and they rode on the camels and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and departed.
chapters.kjv: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ബേർലഹയിരോയീവരെ വന്നു; അവൻ തെക്കേദേശത്തു പാർക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.
chapters.nkjv: Now Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he dwelt in the South.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

chapters.ml: വൈകുന്നേരത്തു യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ധ്യാനിപ്പാൻ വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തു പോയിരുന്നു; അവൻ തലപൊക്കി നോക്കി ഒട്ടകങ്ങൾ വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.
chapters.nkjv: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field in the evening; and he lifted his eyes and looked, and there, the camels were coming.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

chapters.ml: റിബെക്കയും തലപൊക്കി യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു ഒട്ടകപ്പുറത്തുനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel
chapters.nkjv: Then Rebekah lifted her eyes, and when she saw Isaac she dismounted from her camel;
chapters.kjv: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ദാസനോടു: വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തു നമ്മെ എതിരേറ്റു വരുന്ന പുരുഷൻ ആരെന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു എന്റെ യജമാനൻ തന്നേ എന്നു ദാസൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ അവൾ ഒരു മൂടുപടം എടുത്തു തന്നെ മൂടി.
chapters.niv: and asked the servant, "Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?" "He is my master," the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.
chapters.nkjv: for she had said to the servant, "Who is this man walking in the field to meet us?" The servant said, "It is my master." So she took a veil and covered herself.
chapters.kjv: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

chapters.ml: താൻ ചെയ്ത കാര്യം ഒക്കെയും ദാസൻ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു വിവരിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.
chapters.nkjv: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
chapters.kjv: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവളെ തന്റെ അമ്മയായ സാറയുടെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടു പോയി. അവൻ റിബെക്കയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവൾ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായിത്തീർന്നു; അവന്നു അവളിൽ സ്നേഹമായി. ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു തന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ മരണദുഃഖം തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah, and he married Rebekah. So she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent; and he took Rebekah and she became his wife, and he loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death .

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം വേറൊരു ഭാര്യയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവൾക്കു കെതൂറാ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Abraham had taken another wife, whose name was Keturah.
chapters.nkjv: Abraham again took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
chapters.kjv: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

chapters.ml: അവൾ സിമ്രാൻ, യൊക്ശാൻ, മെദാൻ, മിദ്യാൻ, യിശ്ബാക്, ശൂവഹ് എന്നിവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.
chapters.nkjv: And she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
chapters.kjv: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

chapters.ml: യൊക്ശാൻ ശെബയെയും ദെദാനെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ദെദാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അശ്ശൂരീം, ലെത്തൂശീം, ലെയുമ്മീം എന്നിവർ.
chapters.niv: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Ashurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.
chapters.nkjv: Jokshan begot Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
chapters.kjv: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

chapters.ml: മിദ്യാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഏഫാ, ഏഫെർ, ഹനോക്, അബീദാ, എൽദാഗാ എന്നിവർ. ഇവർ എല്ലാവരും കെതൂറയുടെ മക്കൾ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അബ്രാഹാം തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന വെപ്പാട്ടികളുടെ മക്കൾക്കോ അബ്രാഹാം ദാനങ്ങൾ കൊടുത്തു; താൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ അവരെ തന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു കിഴക്കോട്ടു കിഴക്കുദേശത്തേക്കു അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But while he was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.
chapters.nkjv: But Abraham gave gifts to the sons of the concubines which Abraham had; and while he was still living he sent them eastward, away from Isaac his son, to the country of the east.
chapters.kjv: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം നൂറ്റെഴുപത്തഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abraham lived a hundred and seventy-five years.
chapters.nkjv: This is the sum of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred and seventy-five years.
chapters.kjv: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം വയോധികനും കാലസമ്പൂർണ്ണനുമായി നല്ല വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിൽ പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു മരിച്ചു, തന്റെ ജനത്തോടു ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abraham breathed his last and died in a good old age, an old man and full ofyears, and was gathered to his people.
chapters.kjv: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ യിസ്ഹാക്കും യിശ്മായേലും കൂടി മമ്രേക്കരികെ സോഹരിന്റെ മകനായ എഫ്രോനെന്ന ഹിത്യന്റെ നിലത്തു മക്ക്പേലാഗുഹയിൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite,
chapters.nkjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite,
chapters.kjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം ഹിത്യരോടു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങിയ നിലത്തു തന്നേ; അവിടെ അബ്രാഹാമിനെയും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറയെയും അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.
chapters.nkjv: the field which Abraham purchased from the sons of Heth. There Abraham was buried, and Sarah his wife.
chapters.kjv: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം മരിച്ചശേഷം ദൈവം അവന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു; യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ബേർലഹയിരോയീക്കരികെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac dwelt at Beer Lahai Roi.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.

chapters.ml: സാറയുടെ മിസ്രയീമ്യദാസി ഹാഗാർ അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച മകനായ യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യം അവരുടെ വംശാവലിപ്രകാരം പേരുപേരായി യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ ആവിതു:
chapters.niv: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Sarah’s slave, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.
chapters.nkjv: Now this is the genealogy of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
chapters.kjv: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

chapters.ml: യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ നെബായോത്ത്,
chapters.niv: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.nkjv: And these were the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

chapters.ml: കേദാർ, അദ്ബെയേൽ, മിബ്ശാം, മിശ്മാ, ദൂമാ,
chapters.niv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
chapters.nkjv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
chapters.kjv: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

chapters.ml: മശ്ശാ, ഹദാദ്, തേമാ, യെതൂർ, നാഫീശ്, കേദെമാ.
chapters.niv: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.
chapters.nkjv: Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
chapters.kjv: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

chapters.ml: പന്ത്രണ്ടു പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരായ യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അവരുടെ ഊരുകളിലും പാളയങ്ങളിലും വംശംവംശമായി ഇവർ ആകുന്നു; അവരുടെ പേരുകൾ ഇവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Ishmael and these were their names, by their towns and their settlements, twelve princes according to their nations.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

chapters.ml: യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം നൂറ്റി മുപ്പത്തേഴു സംവത്സരം ആയിരുന്നു; അവൻ പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു മരിച്ചു, തന്റെ ജനത്തോടു ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.
chapters.nkjv: These were the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred and thirty-seven years; and he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
chapters.kjv: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

chapters.ml: ഹവീലാ തുടങ്ങി അശ്ശൂരിലേക്കു പോകുന്ന വഴിയിൽ മിസ്രയീമിന്നു കിഴക്കുള്ള ശൂർവരെ അവർ കുടിയിരുന്നു; അവൻ തന്റെ സകലസഹോദരന്മാർക്കും എതിരെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: His descendants settled in the area from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt, as you go toward Ashur. And they lived in hostility toward all the tribes related to them.
chapters.nkjv: (They dwelt from Havilah as far as Shur, which is east of Egypt as you go toward Assyria.) He died in the presence of all his brethren.
chapters.kjv: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു: അബ്രാഹാം യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
chapters.nkjv: This is the genealogy of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham begot Isaac.
chapters.kjv: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു നാല്പതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിലുള്ള അരാമ്യനായ ബെഥൂവേലിന്റെ പുത്രിയും അരാമ്യനായ ലാബാന്റെ സഹോദരിയുമായ റിബെക്കയെ ഭാര്യയായി പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.
chapters.nkjv: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah as wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ഭാര്യ മച്ചിയായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവൾക്കു വേണ്ടി യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു; യഹോവ അവന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടു; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ റിബെക്കാ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was childless. The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.
chapters.nkjv: Now Isaac pleaded with the Lord for his wife, because she was barren; and the Lord granted his plea, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ ശിശുക്കൾ തമ്മിൽ തിക്കിയപ്പോൾ അവൾ: ഇങ്ങനെയായാൽ ഞാൻ എന്തിന്നു ജീവിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു യഹോവയോടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: The babies jostled each other within her, and she said, "Why is this happening to me?" So she went to inquire of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: But the children struggled together within her; and she said, "If allis well, why amIlike this?" So she went to inquire of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവളോടു: രണ്ടുജാതികൾ നിന്റെ ഗർഭത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടു. രണ്ടു വംശങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ ഉദരത്തിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ പിരിയും; ഒരു വംശം മറ്റേ വംശത്തിലും ശക്തിപ്പെടും മൂത്തവൻ ഇളയവനെ സേവിക്കും. എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to her: "Two nations are in your womb, Two peoples shall be separated from your body; One people shall be stronger than the other, And the older shall serve the younger."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

chapters.ml: അവൾക്കു പ്രസവകാലം തികഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ഇരട്ടപ്പിള്ളകൾ അവളുടെ ഗർഭത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.
chapters.nkjv: So when her days were fulfilled forher to give birth, indeed therewere twins in her womb.
chapters.kjv: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തവൻ ചുവന്നവനായി പുറത്തുവന്നു, മേൽ മുഴുവനും രോമംകൊണ്ടുള്ള വസ്ത്രംപോലെ ഇരുന്നു; അവന്നു ഏശാവ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.
chapters.nkjv: And the first came out red. Hewas like a hairy garment all over; so they called his name Esau.
chapters.kjv: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ പുറത്തുവന്നു; അവന്റെ കൈ ഏശാവിന്റെ കുതികാൽ പിടിച്ചിരുന്നു; അവന്നു യാക്കോബ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു. അവൾ അവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചപ്പോൾ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു അറുപതു വയസ്സു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After this, his brother came out, with his hand grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah gave birth to them.
chapters.nkjv: Afterward his brother came out, and his hand took hold of Esau’s heel; so his name was called Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
chapters.kjv: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

chapters.ml: കുട്ടികൾ വളർന്നു; ഏശാവ് വേട്ടയിൽ സമർത്ഥനും വനസഞ്ചാരിയും യാക്കോബ് സാധുശീലനും കൂടാരവാസിയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the open country, while Jacob was content to stay at home among the tents.
chapters.nkjv: So the boys grew. And Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field; but Jacob was a mild man, dwelling in tents.
chapters.kjv: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവിന്റെ വേട്ടയിറച്ചിയിൽ രുചിപിടിച്ചരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു; റിബെക്കയോ യാക്കോബിനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: And Isaac loved Esau because he ate ofhis game, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

chapters.ml: ഒരിക്കൽ യാക്കോബ് ഒരു പായസം വെച്ചു; ഏശാവ് വെളിമ്പ്രദേശത്തു നിന്നു വന്നു; അവൻ നന്നാ ക്ഷീണിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob cooked a stew; and Esau came in from the field, and he was weary.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

chapters.ml: ഏശാവ്‌ യാക്കോബിനോട്: ആ ചുവന്ന പായസം കുറെ എനിക്കു തരേണം; ഞാൻ നന്നാ ക്ഷീണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു ഏദോം (ചുവന്നവൻ ) എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: He said to Jacob, "Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I’m famished!" (That is why he was also called Edom. )
chapters.nkjv: And Esau said to Jacob, "Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am weary." Therefore his name was called Edom.
chapters.kjv: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശം ഇന്നു എനിക്കു വില്ക്കുക എന്നു യാക്കോബ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jacob replied, "First sell me your birthright."
chapters.nkjv: But Jacob said, "Sell me your birthright as of this day."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഏശാവ്: ഞാൻ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവരുമല്ലോ; ഈ ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശം എനിക്കു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Look, I am about to die," Esau said. "What good is the birthright to me?"
chapters.nkjv: And Esau said, "Look, I am about to die; so what is this birthright to me?"
chapters.kjv: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

chapters.ml: ഇന്നു എന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്ക എന്നു യാക്കോബ് പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവനോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തു; തന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശം യാക്കോബിന്നു വിറ്റു.
chapters.niv: But Jacob said, "Swear to me first." So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob said, "Swear to me as of this day." So he swore to him, and sold his birthright to Jacob.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ഏശാവിന്നു അപ്പവും പയറുകൊണ്ടുള്ള പായസവും കൊടുത്തു; അവൻ ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്തു, എഴുന്നേറ്റുപോയി; ഇങ്ങനെ ഏശാവ് ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശത്തെ അലക്ഷ്യമാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and some lentil stew. He ate and drank, and then got up and left. So Esau despised his birthright.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils; then he ate and drank, arose, and went his way. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
chapters.kjv: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ കാലത്തുണ്ടായ മുമ്പിലത്തെ ക്ഷാമം കൂടാതെ പിന്നെയും ആ ദേശത്തു ഒരു ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായി. അപ്പോൾ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ഗെരാരിൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ രാജാവായ അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Now there was a famine in the land—besides the previous famine in Abraham’s time—and Isaac went to Abimelek king of the Philistines in Gerar.
chapters.nkjv: There was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, in Gerar.
chapters.kjv: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു പോകരുതു; ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്ന ദേശത്തു പാർക്ക.
chapters.niv: The Lord appeared to Isaac and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord appeared to him and said: "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land of which I shall tell you.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

chapters.ml: ഈ ദേശത്തു താമസിക്ക; ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കും; നിനക്കും നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും ഈ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും തരും; നിന്റെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു ഞാൻ ചെയ്ത സത്യം നിവർത്തിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Stay in this land for a while, and I will be with you and will bless you. For to you and your descendants I will give all these lands and will confirm the oath I swore to your father Abraham.
chapters.nkjv: Dwell in this land, and I will be with you and bless you; for to you and your descendants I give all these lands, and I will perform the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
chapters.kjv: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം എന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടു എന്റെ നിയോഗവും കല്പനകളും ചട്ടങ്ങളും പ്രമാണങ്ങളും ആചരിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed,
chapters.nkjv: And I will make your descendants multiply as the stars of heaven; I will give to your descendants all these lands; and in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed;
chapters.kjv: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ ആകാശത്തിലെ നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കു ഈ ദേശമൊക്കെയും കൊടുക്കും; നിന്റെ സന്തതിമുഖാന്തരം ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലജാതികളും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: because Abraham obeyed me and did everything I required of him, keeping my commands, my decrees and my instructions."
chapters.nkjv: because Abraham obeyed My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws."
chapters.kjv: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ഗെരാരിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.
chapters.nkjv: So Isaac dwelt in Gerar.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ഥലത്തെ ജനം അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെക്കുറിച്ചു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു; അവൾ എന്റെ സഹോദരിയെന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു; റിബെക്കാ സൌന്ദര്യമുള്ളവളാകകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തെ ജനം അവളുടെ നിമിത്തം തന്നേ കൊല്ലാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൾ എന്റെ ഭാര്യ എന്നു പറവാൻ അവൻ ശങ്കിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the men of that place asked him about his wife, he said, "She is my sister," because he was afraid to say, "She is my wife." He thought, "The men of this place might kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is beautiful."
chapters.nkjv: And the men of the place asked about his wife. And he said, "She is my sister"; for he was afraid to say, "Sheis my wife," becausehethought, "lest the men of the place kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to behold."
chapters.kjv: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെ ഏറെക്കാലം പാർത്തശേഷം ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ രാജാവായ അബീമേലെക്ക് കിളിവാതിൽക്കൽ കൂടി നോക്കി യിസ്ഹാക്ക് തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ റിബെക്കയോടുകൂടെ വിനോദിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelek king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked through a window, and saw, and there was Isaac, showing endearment to Rebekah his wife.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ വിളിച്ചു: അവൾ നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയാകുന്നു നിശ്ചയം; പിന്നെ എന്റെ സഹോദരിയെന്നു നീ പറഞ്ഞതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവനോടു: അവളുടെ നിമിത്തം മരിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ ആകുന്നു ഞാൻ അങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Abimelek summoned Isaac and said, "She is really your wife! Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?" Isaac answered him, "Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her."
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech called Isaac and said, "Quite obviously she is your wife; so how could you say, ‘She is my sister’?" Isaac said to him, "Because I said, ‘Lest I die on account of her.’ "
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബീമേലെക്: നീ ഞങ്ങളോടു ഈ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? ജനത്തിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും നിന്റെ ഭാര്യയോടുകൂടെ ശയിപ്പാനും നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ കുറ്റം വരുത്തുവാനും സംഗതി വരുമായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Abimelek said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us."
chapters.nkjv: And Abimelech said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the people might soon have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us."
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അബീമേലെക്: ഈ പുരുഷനെയോ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെയോ തൊടുന്നവന്നു മരണശിക്ഷ ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു സകലജനത്തോടും കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Abimelek gave orders to all the people: "Anyone who harms this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."
chapters.nkjv: So Abimelech charged all his people, saying, "He who touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ആ ദേശത്തു വിതെച്ചു; ആയാണ്ടിൽ നൂറുമേനി വിളവു കിട്ടി; യഹോവ അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year a hundredfold; and the Lord blessed him.
chapters.kjv: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വർദ്ധിച്ചു വർദ്ധിച്ചു മഹാധനവാനായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The man became rich, and his wealth continued to grow until he became very wealthy.
chapters.nkjv: The man began to prosper, and continued prospering until he became very prosperous;
chapters.kjv: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

chapters.ml: അവന്നു ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടങ്ങളും മാട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടങ്ങളും വളരെ ദാസീദാസന്മാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കു അവനോടു അസൂയ തോന്നി.
chapters.niv: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.
chapters.nkjv: for he had possessions of flocks and possessions of herds and a great number of servants. So the Philistines envied him.
chapters.kjv: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ കാലത്തു അവന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ കുഴിച്ചിരുന്ന കിണറൊക്കെയും ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ മണ്ണിട്ടു നികത്തിക്കളഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Philistines had stopped up all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, and they had filled them with earth.
chapters.kjv: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളെക്കാൾ ഏറ്റവും ബലവാനാകകൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങളെ വിട്ടു പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Abimelek said to Isaac, "Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us."
chapters.nkjv: And Abimelech said to Isaac, "Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we."
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഗേരാർതാഴ്വരയിൽ കൂടാരമടിച്ചു, അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Isaac moved away from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar, where he settled.
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaac departed from there and pitched his tent in the Valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ കാലത്തു കുഴിച്ചതും അബ്രാഹാം മരിച്ചശേഷം ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ നികത്തിക്കളഞ്ഞതുമായ കിണറുകൾ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് പിന്നെയും കുഴിച്ചു തന്റെ പിതാവു അവെക്കു ഇട്ടിരുന്ന പേർ തന്നേ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the time of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died, and he gave them the same names his father had given them.
chapters.nkjv: And Isaac dug again the wells of water which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them up after the death of Abraham. He called them by the names which his father had called them.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ ആ താഴ്വരയിൽ കുഴിച്ചു നീരുറവുള്ള ഒരു കിണറ് കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.
chapters.nkjv: Also Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found a well of running water there.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഗെരാർദേശത്തിലെ ഇടയന്മാർ: ഈ വെള്ളം ഞങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ഇടയന്മാരോടു ശണ്ഠയിട്ടു; അവർ തന്നോടു ശണ്ഠയിട്ടതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ആ കിണറ്റിനു ഏശെക്ക് എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the herders of Gerar quarreled with those of Isaac and said, "The water is ours!" So he named the well Esek, because they disputed with him.
chapters.nkjv: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, "The water is ours." So he called the name of the well Esek, because they quarreled with him.
chapters.kjv: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

chapters.ml: അവർ മറ്റൊരു കിണറു കുഴിച്ചു; അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചും അവർ ശണ്ഠയിട്ടതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അതിന്നു സിത്നാ എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they dug another well, but they quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
chapters.nkjv: Then they dug another well, and they quarreled over that one also. So he called its name Sitnah.
chapters.kjv: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെനിന്നു മാറിപ്പോയി മറ്റൊരു കിണറ് കുഴിച്ചു; അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അവർ ശണ്ഠയിട്ടില്ല. യഹോവ ഇപ്പോൾ നമുക്കു ഇടം ഉണ്ടാക്കി നാം ദേശത്തു വർദ്ധിക്കുമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൻ അതിന്നു രെഹോബോത്ത് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He moved on from there and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth, saying, "Now the Lord has given us room and we will flourish in the land."
chapters.nkjv: And he moved from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. So he called its name Rehoboth, because he said, "For now the Lord has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land."
chapters.kjv: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നു അവൻ ബേർ-ശേബെക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: From there he went up to Beersheba.
chapters.nkjv: Then he went up from there to Beersheba.
chapters.kjv: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

chapters.ml: അന്നു രാത്രി യഹോവ അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവം ആകുന്നു; നീ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു; എന്റെ ദാസനായ അബ്രാഹാംനിമിത്തം ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: That night the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bless you and will increase the number of your descendants for the sake of my servant Abraham."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord appeared to him the same night and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham; do not fear, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants for My servant Abraham’s sake."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവൻ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു, യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ ആരാധിച്ചു. അവിടെ തന്റെ കൂടാരം അടിച്ചു; അവിടെയും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ ഒരു കിണറ് കുഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord . There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.
chapters.nkjv: So he built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord, and he pitched his tent there; and there Isaac’s servants dug a well.
chapters.kjv: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD , and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അബീമേലെക്കും സ്നേഹിതനായ അഹൂസത്തും സേനാപതിയായ ഫീക്കോലും ഗെരാരിൽനിന്നു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, Abimelek had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his personal adviser and Phicol the commander of his forces.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech came to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath, one of his friends, and Phichol the commander of his army.
chapters.kjv: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്തിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നു? നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ദ്വേഷിച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു അയച്ചുകളഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Isaac asked them, "Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?"
chapters.nkjv: And Isaac said to them, "Why have you come to me, since you hate me and have sent me away from you?"
chapters.kjv: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: യഹോവ നിന്നോടുകൂടെയുണ്ടു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ സ്പഷ്ടമായി കണ്ടു; അതുകൊണ്ടു നമുക്കു തമ്മിൽ, ഞങ്ങൾക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ തന്നെ, ഒരു സത്യബന്ധമുണ്ടായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: They answered, "We saw clearly that the Lord was with you; so we said, ‘There ought to be a sworn agreement between us’—between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you
chapters.nkjv: But they said, "We have certainly seen that the Lord is with you. So we said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, between you and us; and let us make a covenant with you,
chapters.kjv: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ തൊട്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്തതുപോലെയും നന്മമാത്രം നിനക്കു ചെയ്തു നിന്നെ സമാധാനത്തോടെ അയച്ചതുപോലെയും നീ ഞങ്ങളോടു ഒരു ദോഷവും ചെയ്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞങ്ങളും നീയും തമ്മിൽ ഒരു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്ക. നീ യഹോവയാൽ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവനല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not harm you but always treated you well and sent you away peacefully. And now you are blessed by the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: that you will do us no harm, since we have not touched you, and since we have done nothing to you but good and have sent you away in peace. You are now the blessed of the Lord.’ "
chapters.kjv: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവർക്കു ഒരു വിരുന്നു ഒരുക്കി; അവർ ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
chapters.nkjv: So he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
chapters.kjv: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

chapters.ml: അവർ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു, തമ്മിൽ സത്യം ചെയ്തശേഷം യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവരെ യാത്രയയച്ചു അവർ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പിരിഞ്ഞുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they went away peacefully.
chapters.nkjv: Then they arose early in the morning and swore an oath with one another; and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
chapters.kjv: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

chapters.ml: ആ ദിവസം തന്നേ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ വന്നു തങ്ങൾ കുഴിച്ച കിണറ്റിന്റെ വസ്തുത അവനെ അറിയിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: That day Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, "We’ve found water!"
chapters.nkjv: It came to pass the same day that Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well which they had dug, and said to him, "We have found water."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ വെള്ളം കണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അതിന്നു ശിബാ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു ഇന്നുവരെ ബേർ-ശേബ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.
chapters.nkjv: So he called it Shebah. Therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.
chapters.kjv: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവിന്നു നാല്പതു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഹിത്യനായ ബേരിയുടെ മകൾ യെഹൂദീത്തിനെയും ഹിത്യനായ ഏലോന്റെ മകൾ ബാസമത്തിനെയും ഭാര്യമാരായി പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Esau was forty years old, he married Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and also Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.
chapters.nkjv: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wives Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
chapters.kjv: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

chapters.ml: ഇവർ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നും റിബെക്കെക്കും മനോവ്യസനകാരണമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were a source of grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
chapters.nkjv: And they were a grief of mind to Isaac and Rebekah.
chapters.kjv: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് വൃദ്ധനായി അവന്റെ കണ്ണു കാണ്മാൻ വഹിയാതവണ്ണം മങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഒരു ദിവസം മൂത്ത മകനായ ഏശാവിനെ വിളിച്ചു അവനോടു: മകനേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവനോടു: ഞാൻ ഇതാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called for Esau his older son and said to him, "My son." "Here I am," he answered.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when Isaac was old and his eyes were so dim that he could not see, that he called Esau his older son and said to him, "My son." And he answered him, "Here I am."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: ഞാൻ വൃദ്ധനായിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ മരണദിവസം അറിയുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Isaac said, "I am now an old man and don’t know the day of my death.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Behold now, I am old. I do not know the day of my death.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

chapters.ml: നീ ഇപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ ആയുധങ്ങളായ വില്ലും പൂണിയും എടുത്തു കാട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു എനിക്കു വേണ്ടി വേട്ടതേടി
chapters.niv: Now then, get your equipment—your quiver and bow—and go out to the open country to hunt some wild game for me.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field and hunt game for me.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടവും രുചികരവുമായ ഭോജനം ഉണ്ടാക്കി, ഞാൻ മരിക്കുമ്മുമ്പെ തിന്നു നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Prepare me the kind of tasty food I like and bring it to me to eat, so that I may give you my blessing before I die."
chapters.nkjv: And make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me that I may eat, that my soul may bless you before I die."
chapters.kjv: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് തന്റെ മകനായ ഏശാവിനോടു പറയുമ്പോൾ റിബെക്കാ കേട്ടു ഏശാവോ വേട്ട തേടി കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ കാട്ടിൽ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau left for the open country to hunt game and bring it back,
chapters.nkjv: Now Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game and to bring it.
chapters.kjv: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it .

chapters.ml: റിബെക്കാ തന്റെ മകനായ യാക്കോബിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, "Look, I overheard your father say to your brother Esau,
chapters.nkjv: So Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, "Indeed I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,
chapters.kjv: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ മരണത്തിന്നു മുമ്പെ തിന്നു നിന്നെ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ വേട്ടയിറച്ചി കൊണ്ടുവന്നു രുചികരമായ ഭോജനം ഉണ്ടാക്കിത്തരിക എന്നു പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me some tasty food to eat, so that I may give you my blessing in the presence of the Lord before I die.’
chapters.nkjv: ‘Bring me game and make savory food for me, that I may eat it and bless you in the presence of the Lord before my death.’
chapters.kjv: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ മകനേ, നീ എന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നതു ചെയ്ക.
chapters.niv: Now, my son, listen carefully and do what I tell you:
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to what I command you.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

chapters.ml: ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെനിന്നു രണ്ടു നല്ല കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടികളെ കൊണ്ടുവരിക; ഞാൻ അവയെക്കൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ അപ്പന്നു ഇഷ്ടവും രുചികരവുമായ ഭോജനം ഉണ്ടാക്കും.
chapters.niv: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so I can prepare some tasty food for your father, just the way he likes it.
chapters.nkjv: Go now to the flock and bring me from there two choice kids of the goats, and I will make savory food from them for your father, such as he loves.
chapters.kjv: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ തിന്നു തന്റെ മരണത്തിന്നു മുമ്പെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ അതു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെല്ലേണം.
chapters.niv: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may give you his blessing before he dies."
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall take it to your father, that he may eat it, and that he may bless you before his death."
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ അമ്മയായ റിബെക്കയോടു: എന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവു രോമമുള്ളവനും ഞാൻ രോമമില്ലാത്തവനും ആകുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "But my brother Esau is a hairy man while I have smooth skin.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "Look, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth-skinned man.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

chapters.ml: പക്ഷേ അപ്പൻ എന്നെ തപ്പിനോക്കും; ഞാൻ ഉപായി എന്നു അവന്നു തോന്നീട്ടു ഞാൻ എന്റെ മേൽ അനുഗ്രഹമല്ല ശാപം തന്നേ വരുത്തും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: What if my father touches me? I would appear to be tricking him and would bring down a curse on myself rather than a blessing."
chapters.nkjv: Perhaps my father will feel me, and I shall seem to be a deceiver to him; and I shall bring a curse on myself and not a blessing."
chapters.kjv: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അമ്മ അവനോടു: മകനേ, നിന്റെ ശാപം എന്റെ മേൽ വരട്ടെ; എന്റെ വാക്കു മാത്രം കേൾക്ക; പോയി കൊണ്ടുവാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His mother said to him, "My son, let the curse fall on me. Just do what I say; go and get them for me."
chapters.nkjv: But his mother said to him, "Let your curse be on me, my son; only obey my voice, and go, get them for me."
chapters.kjv: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them .

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെന്നു പിടിച്ചു അമ്മയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അമ്മ അവന്റെ അപ്പന്നു ഇഷ്ടവും രുചികരവുമായ ഭോജനം ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and she prepared some tasty food, just the way his father liked it.
chapters.nkjv: And he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
chapters.kjv: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ റിബെക്കാ വീട്ടിൽ തന്റെ പക്കൽ ഉള്ളതായ മൂത്തമകൻ ഏശാവിന്റെ വിശേഷ വസ്ത്രം എടുത്തു ഇളയമകൻ യാക്കോബിനെ ധരിപ്പിച്ചു.
