chapters.niv: Then Rebekah took the best clothes of Esau her older son, which she had in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: Then Rebekah took the choice clothes of her elder son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob her younger son.
chapters.kjv: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

chapters.ml: അവൾ കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടികളുടെ തോൽകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ കൈകളും രോമമില്ലാത്ത കഴുത്തും പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She also covered his hands and the smooth part of his neck with the goatskins.
chapters.nkjv: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.
chapters.kjv: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

chapters.ml: താൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ രുചികരമായ ഭോജനവും അപ്പവും തന്റെ മകനായ യാക്കോബിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then she handed to her son Jacob the tasty food and the bread she had made.
chapters.nkjv: Then she gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
chapters.kjv: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: അപ്പാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: ഞാൻ ഇതാ; നീ ആർ, മകനേ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He went to his father and said, "My father." "Yes, my son," he answered. "Who is it?"
chapters.nkjv: So he went to his father and said, "My father." And he said, "Here I am. Who are you, my son?"
chapters.kjv: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് അപ്പനോടു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ ഏശാവു; എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു ഞാൻ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഇരുന്നു എന്റെ വേട്ടയിറച്ചി തിന്നു എന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."
chapters.nkjv: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn; I have done just as you told me; please arise, sit and eat of my game, that your soul may bless me."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് തന്റെ മകനോടു: മകനേ, നിനക്കു ഇത്ര വേഗത്തിൽ കിട്ടിയതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ എന്റെ നേർക്കു വരുത്തിത്തന്നു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Isaac asked his son, "How did you find it so quickly, my son?" "The Lord your God gave me success," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: But Isaac said to his son, "How isit that you have found it so quickly, my son?" And he said, "Because the Lord your God brought it to me."
chapters.kjv: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് യാക്കോബിനോടു: മകനെ, അടുത്തുവരിക; നീ എന്റെ മകനായ ഏശാവു തന്നേയോ അല്ലയോ എന്നു ഞാൻ തപ്പിനോക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not."
chapters.nkjv: Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not."
chapters.kjv: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു അടുത്തു ചെന്നു; അവൻ അവനെ തപ്പിനോക്കി: ശബ്ദം യാക്കോബിന്റെ ശബ്ദം; കൈകൾ ഏശാവിന്റെ കൈകൾ തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau."
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob went near to Isaac his father, and he felt him and said, "The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കൈകൾ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവിന്റെ കൈകൾ പോലെ രോമമുള്ളവയാകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ തിരിച്ചറിയാതെ അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he proceeded to bless him.
chapters.nkjv: And he did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau’s hands; so he blessed him.
chapters.kjv: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ മകൻ ഏശാവ് തന്നേയോ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അതേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Are you really my son Esau?" he asked. "I am," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Are you really my son Esau?" He said, "I am."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവാ; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ മകന്റെ വേട്ടയിറച്ചി ഞാൻ തിന്നാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു, അവൻ തിന്നു; അവൻ വീഞ്ഞും കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു, അവൻ കുടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing." Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank.
chapters.nkjv: He said, "Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s game, so that my soul may bless you." So he brought it near to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവനോടു: മകനേ, നീ അടുത്തുവന്നു എന്നെ ചുംബിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come here, my son, and kiss me."
chapters.nkjv: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come near now and kiss me, my son."
chapters.kjv: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അടുത്തുചെന്നു അവനെ ചുംബിച്ചു; അവൻ അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രങ്ങളുടെ വാസന മണത്തു അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇതാ, എന്റെ മകന്റെ വാസന യഹോവ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന വയലിലെ വാസനപോലെ.
chapters.niv: So he went to him and kissed him. When Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he blessed him and said, "Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed.
chapters.nkjv: And he came near and kissed him; and he smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him and said: "Surely, the smell of my son Is like the smell of a field Which the Lord has blessed.
chapters.kjv: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ആകാശത്തിന്റെ മഞ്ഞും ഭൂമിയുടെ പുഷ്ടിയും അനവധി ധന്യവും വീഞ്ഞും നിനക്കു തരുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May God give you heaven’s dew and earth’s richness— an abundance of grain and new wine.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore may God give you Of the dew of heaven, Of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and wine.
chapters.kjv: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

chapters.ml: വംശങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ സേവിക്കട്ടെ; ജാതികൾ നിന്നെ വണങ്ങട്ടെ; നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു നീ പ്രഭുവായിരിക്ക; നിന്റെ മാതാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ നിന്നെ വണങ്ങട്ടെ. നിന്നെ ശപിക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ; നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ.
chapters.niv: May nations serve you and peoples bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed."
chapters.nkjv: Let peoples serve you, And nations bow down to you. Be master over your brethren, And let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you, And blessed be those who bless you!"
chapters.kjv: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് യാക്കോബിനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചുകഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; ഉടനെ അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ ഏശാവ് വേട്ടകഴിഞ്ഞു മടങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: After Isaac finished blessing him, and Jacob had scarcely left his father’s presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had scarcely gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

chapters.ml: അവനും രുചികരമായ ഭോജനം ഉണ്ടാക്കി അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു അപ്പനോടു: അപ്പൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു മകന്റെ വേട്ടയിറച്ചി തിന്നു എന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, "My father, please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."
chapters.nkjv: He also had made savory food, and brought it to his father, and said to his father, "Let my father arise and eat of his son’s game, that your soul may bless me."
chapters.kjv: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അവനോടു: നീ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മകൻ, നിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ ഏശാവ് എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His father Isaac asked him, "Who are you?" "I am your son," he answered, "your firstborn, Esau."
chapters.nkjv: And his father Isaac said to him, "Who are you?" So he said, "I am your son, your firstborn, Esau."
chapters.kjv: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അത്യന്തം ഭ്രമിച്ചു നടുങ്ങി: എന്നാൽ വേട്ടതേടി എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നവൻ ആർ? നീ വരുംമുമ്പെ ഞാൻ സകലവും തിന്നു അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവനുമാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Isaac trembled violently and said, "Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him—and indeed he will be blessed!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaac trembled exceedingly, and said, "Who? Where is the one who hunted game and brought it to me? I ate all ofit before you came, and I have blessed him— and indeed he shall be blessed."
chapters.kjv: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവ് അപ്പന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അതി ദുഃഖിതനായി ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു: അപ്പാ, എന്നെ, എന്നെയും കൂടെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണമേ എന്നു അപ്പനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Esau heard his father’s words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, "Bless me—me too, my father!"
chapters.nkjv: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, "Bless me—me also, O my father!"
chapters.kjv: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നിന്റെ സഹോദരൻ ഉപായത്തോടെ വന്നു നിന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹം അപഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he said, "Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing."
chapters.nkjv: But he said, "Your brother came with deceit and has taken away your blessing."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

chapters.ml: ശരി, യാക്കോബ് എന്നല്ലോ അവന്റെ പേർ; രണ്ടു പ്രാവശ്യം അവൻ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു; അവൻ എന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശം അപഹരിച്ചു; ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, എന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹവും അപഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. നീ എനിക്കു ഒരു അനുഗ്രഹവും കരുതിവെച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Esau said, "Isn’t he rightly named Jacob ? This is the second time he has taken advantage of me: He took my birthright, and now he’s taken my blessing!" Then he asked, "Haven’t you reserved any blessing for me?"
chapters.nkjv: And Esau said, "Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright, and now look, he has taken away my blessing!" And he said, "Have you not reserved a blessing for me?"
chapters.kjv: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ഏശാവിനോടു: ഞാൻ അവനെ നിനക്കു പ്രഭുവാക്കി അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും അവന്നു ദാസന്മാരാക്കി; അവന്നു ധാന്യവും വീഞ്ഞുംകൊടുത്തു; ഇനി നിനക്കു ഞാൻ എന്തു തരേണ്ടു മകനേ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Isaac answered Esau, "I have made him lord over you and have made all his relatives his servants, and I have sustained him with grain and new wine. So what can I possibly do for you, my son?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaac answered and said to Esau, "Indeed I have made him your master, and all his brethren I have given to him as servants; with grain and wine I have sustained him. What shall I do now for you, my son?"
chapters.kjv: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

chapters.ml: ഏശാവ് പിതാവിനോടു: നിനക്കു ഒരു അനുഗ്രഹം മാത്രമേ ഉള്ളുവോ, അപ്പാ? എന്നെ, എന്നെയും കൂടെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണമേ, അപ്പാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു പൊട്ടിക്കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Esau said to his father, "Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!" Then Esau wept aloud.
chapters.nkjv: And Esau said to his father, "Have you only one blessing, my father? Bless me—me also, O my father!" And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.
chapters.kjv: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് ഉത്തരമായിട്ടു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിന്റെ വാസം ഭൂമിയിലെ പുഷ്ടിക്കുടാതെയും മീതെ ആകാശത്തിലെ മഞ്ഞു കൂടാതെയും ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: His father Isaac answered him, "Your dwelling will be away from the earth’s richness, away from the dew of heaven above.
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaac his father answered and said to him: "Behold, your dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, And of the dew of heaven from above.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വാളുകൊണ്ടു നീ ഉപജീവിക്കും; നിന്റെ സഹോദരനെ നീ സേവിക്കും. നിന്റെ കെട്ടു അഴിഞ്ഞുപോകുമ്പോൾ നീ അവന്റെ നുകം കഴുത്തിൽനിന്നു കുടഞ്ഞുകളയും.
chapters.niv: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck."
chapters.nkjv: By your sword you shall live, And you shall serve your brother; And it shall come to pass, when you become restless, That you shall break his yoke from your neck."
chapters.kjv: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അപ്പൻ യാക്കോബിനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ച അനുഗ്രഹം നിമിത്തം ഏശാവു അവനെ ദ്വേഷിച്ചു: അപ്പനെക്കുറിച്ചു ദുഃഖിക്കുന്ന കാലം അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ എന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യാക്കോബിനെ കൊല്ലും എന്നു ഏശാവു ഹൃദയത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. He said to himself, "The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob."
chapters.nkjv: So Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, "The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob."
chapters.kjv: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

chapters.ml: മൂത്തമകനായ ഏശാവിന്റെ വാക്കു റിബെക്കാ അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ, അവൾ ഇളയമകനായ യാക്കോബിനെ ആളയച്ചു വിളിപ്പിച്ചു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിന്റെ സഹോദരൻ ഏശാവ് നിന്നെ കൊന്നു പകവീട്ടുവാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Rebekah was told what her older son Esau had said, she sent for her younger son Jacob and said to him, "Your brother Esau is planning to avenge himself by killing you.
chapters.nkjv: And the words of Esau her older son were told to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, "Surely your brother Esau comforts himself concerning you byintending to kill you.
chapters.kjv: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ മകനേ: എന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്ക: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഹാരാനിൽ എന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ലാബാന്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോക.
chapters.niv: Now then, my son, do what I say: Flee at once to my brother Laban in Harran.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice: arise, flee to my brother Laban in Haran.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്റെ ക്രോധം ശമിക്കുവോളം കുറെ നാൾ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പാർക്ക.
chapters.niv: Stay with him for a while until your brother’s fury subsides.
chapters.nkjv: And stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away,
chapters.kjv: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്നു നിന്നോടുള്ള കോപം മാറി നീ അവനോടു ചെയ്തതു അവൻ മറക്കുംവരെ അവിടെ താമസിക്ക; പിന്നെ ഞാൻ ആളയച്ചു നിന്നെ അവിടെ നിന്നു വരുത്തിക്കൊള്ളാം; ഒരു ദിവസം തന്നേ നിങ്ങൾ ഇരുവരും എനിക്കു ഇല്ലാതെയാകുന്നതു എന്തിനു?
chapters.niv: When your brother is no longer angry with you and forgets what you did to him, I’ll send word for you to come back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?"
chapters.nkjv: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him; then I will send and bring you from there. Why should I be bereaved also of you both in one day?"
chapters.kjv: Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ റിബെക്കാ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു: ഈ ഹിത്യസ്ത്രീകൾ നിമിത്തം എന്റെ ജീവൻ എനിക്കു അസഹ്യമായിരിക്കുന്നു; ഈ ദേശക്കാരത്തികളായ ഇവരെപ്പോലെയുള്ള ഒരു ഹിത്യ സ്ത്രീയെ യാക്കോബ് വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചാൽ ഞാൻ എന്തിന്നു ജീവിക്കുന്നു? എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I’m disgusted with living because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a wife from among the women of this land, from Hittite women like these, my life will not be worth living."
chapters.nkjv: And Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth; if Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, like these whoare the daughters of the land, what good will my life be to me?"
chapters.kjv: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്ഹാക്ക് യാക്കോബിനെ വിളിച്ചു, അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു, അവനോടു ആജ്ഞാപിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ കനാന്യ സ്ത്രീകളിൽനിന്നു ഭാര്യയെ എടുക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. Then he commanded him: "Do not marry a Canaanite woman.
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaac called Jacob and blessed him, and charged him, and said to him: "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

chapters.ml: പുറപ്പെട്ടു പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽ നിന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ അപ്പനായ ബെഥൂവേലിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു നിന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ സഹോദരനായ ലാബാന്റെ പുത്രിമാരിൽ നിന്നു നിനക്കു ഒരു ഭാര്യയെ എടുക്ക.
chapters.niv: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
chapters.nkjv: Arise, go to Padan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father; and take yourself a wife from there of the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother.
chapters.kjv: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.

chapters.ml: സർവ്വശക്തനായ ദൈവം നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കയും നീ ജനസമൂഹമായി തീരത്തക്കവണ്ണം നിന്നെ സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവനായി പെരുക്കുകയും
chapters.niv: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples.
chapters.nkjv: "May God Almighty bless you, And make you fruitful and multiply you, That you may be an assembly of peoples;
chapters.kjv: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു കൊടുത്തതും നീ പരദേശിയായി പാർക്കുന്നതുമായ ദേശം നീ കൈവശമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹം നിനക്കും നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും തരികയും ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now reside as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham."
chapters.nkjv: And give you the blessing of Abraham, To you and your descendants with you, That you may inherit the land In which you are a stranger, Which God gave to Abraham."
chapters.kjv: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് യാക്കോബിനെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു; അവൻ പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽ അരാമ്യനായ ബെഥൂവേലിന്റെ മകനും യാക്കോബിന്റെയും ഏശാവിന്റെയും അമ്മയായ റിബെക്കയുടെ സഹോദരനുമായ ലാബാന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.
chapters.nkjv: So Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Padan Aram, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് യാക്കോബിനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ഭാര്യയെ എടുപ്പാൻ അവനെ അവിടെക്കു അയച്ചതും, അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കുമ്പോൾ: നീ കനാന്യസ്ത്രീകളിൽനിന്നു ഭാര്യയെ എടുക്കരുതെന്നു അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചതും
chapters.niv: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, "Do not marry a Canaanite woman,"
chapters.nkjv: Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Padan Aram to take himself a wife from there, andthat as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,"
chapters.kjv: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും അനുസരിച്ചു പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിലേക്കു പോയതും ഏശാവ് അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ,
chapters.niv: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.
chapters.nkjv: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother and had gone to Padan Aram.
chapters.kjv: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;

chapters.ml: കനാന്യസ്ത്രീകൾ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു ഇഷ്ടമുള്ളവരല്ല എന്നു കണ്ടു
chapters.niv: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;
chapters.nkjv: Also Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan did not please his father Isaac.
chapters.kjv: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

chapters.ml: ഏശാവ് യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു തനിക്കുള്ള ഭാര്യമാരെ കൂടാതെ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ മകനായ യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ മകളും നെബായോത്തിന്റെ സഹോദരിയുമായ മഹലത്തിനെയും വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.
chapters.nkjv: So Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.
chapters.kjv: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യാക്കോബ് ബേർ-ശേബയിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഹാരാനിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Harran.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob went out from Beersheba and went toward Haran.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു സ്ഥലത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവിടെ രാപാർത്തു; അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തെ കല്ലുകളിൽ ഒന്നു എടുത്തു തലയണയായി വെച്ചു അവിടെ കിടന്നുറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When he reached a certain place, he stopped for the night because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones there, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
chapters.nkjv: So he came to a certain place and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. And he took one of the stones of that place and put it at his head, and he lay down in that place to sleep.
chapters.kjv: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു: ഇതാ, ഭൂമിയിൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു കോവണി; അതിന്റെ തല സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തോളം എത്തിയിരുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാർ അതിന്മേൽകൂടി കയറുകയും ഇറങ്ങുകയുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
chapters.nkjv: Then he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth, and its top reached to heaven; and there the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
chapters.kjv: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

chapters.ml: അതിന്മീതെ യഹോവ നിന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും, യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദൈവവുമായ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു; നീ കിടക്കുന്ന ഭൂമിയെ ഞാൻ നിനക്കും നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും തരും.
chapters.niv: There above it stood the Lord , and he said: "I am the Lord , the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, the Lord stood above it and said: "I am the Lord God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac; the land on which you lie I will give to you and your descendants.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സന്തതി ഭൂമിയിലെ പൊടിപോലെ ആകും; നീ പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടും കിഴക്കോട്ടും വടക്കോട്ടും തെക്കോട്ടും പരക്കും; നീ മുഖാന്തരവും നിന്റെ സന്തതി മുഖാന്തരവും ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലവംശങ്ങളും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
chapters.nkjv: Also your descendants shall be as the dust of the earth; you shall spread abroad to the west and the east, to the north and the south; and in you and in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.
chapters.kjv: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെയുണ്ടു; നീ പോകുന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും നിന്നെ കാത്തു ഈ രാജ്യത്തേക്കു നിന്നെ മടക്കിവരുത്തും; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കൈവിടാതെ നിന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു നിവർത്തിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."
chapters.nkjv: Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done what I have spoken to you."
chapters.kjv: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് ഉറക്കമുണർന്നു: യഹോവ ഈ സ്ഥലത്തുണ്ടു സത്യം; ഞാനോ അതു അറിഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I was not aware of it."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I did not know it."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു: ഈ സ്ഥലം എത്ര ഭയങ്കരം! ഇതു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയമല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊന്നല്ല; ഇതു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽ തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven."
chapters.nkjv: And he was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven!"
chapters.kjv: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു തലയണയായി വെച്ചിരുന്ന കല്ലു എടുത്തു തൂണായി നിർത്തി, അതിന്മേൽ എണ്ണ ഒഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone he had placed under his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on top of it.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob rose early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put at his head, set it up as a pillar, and poured oil on top of it.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ബേഥേൽ എന്നു പേർവിളിച്ചു; ആദ്യം ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു ലൂസ് എന്നു പേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.
chapters.nkjv: And he called the name of that place Bethel; but the name of that city had been Luz previously.
chapters.kjv: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ഒരു നേർച്ചനേർന്നു: ദൈവം എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കയും ഞാൻ പോകുന്ന ഈ യാത്രയിൽ എന്നെ കാക്കുകയും ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ആഹാരവും ധരിപ്പാൻ വസ്ത്രവും എനിക്കു തരികയും
chapters.niv: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me, and keep me in this way that I am going, and give me bread to eat and clothing to put on,
chapters.kjv: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

chapters.ml: എന്നെ എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു സൌഖ്യത്തോടെ മടക്കി വരുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുമെങ്കിൽ യഹോവ എനിക്കു ദൈവമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: so that I return safely to my father’s household, then the Lord will be my God
chapters.nkjv: so that I come back to my father’s house in peace, then the Lord shall be my God.
chapters.kjv: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ തൂണായി നിർത്തിയ ഈ കല്ലു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയവും ആകും. നീ എനിക്കു തരുന്ന സകലത്തിലും ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ദശാംശം തരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and this stone that I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that you give me I will give you a tenth."
chapters.nkjv: And this stone which I have set as a pillar shall be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give a tenth to You."
chapters.kjv: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യാക്കോബ് പ്രയാണം ചെയ്തു കിഴക്കരുടെ ദേശത്തു എത്തി.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob went on his journey and came to the land of the people of the East.
chapters.kjv: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തു ഒരു കിണർ കണ്ടു. അതിന്നരികെ മൂന്നു ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടം കിടക്കുന്നു. ആ കിണറ്റിൽനിന്നു ആയിരുന്നു ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടങ്ങൾക്കു വെള്ളം കൊടുക്കുന്നതു; എന്നാൽ കിണറ്റിന്റെ വായ്ക്കലുള്ള കല്ലു വലുതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There he saw a well in the open country, with three flocks of sheep lying near it because the flocks were watered from that well. The stone over the mouth of the well was large.
chapters.nkjv: And he looked, and saw a well in the field; and behold, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks. A large stone was on the well’s mouth.
chapters.kjv: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ഥലത്തു കൂട്ടങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെ കൂടുകയും അവർ കിണറ്റിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽനിന്നു കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടി ആടുകൾക്കു വെള്ളം കൊടുക്കയും കല്ലു കിണറ്റിന്റെ വായക്ക്ൽ അതിന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തു തന്നേ തിരികെ വെക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone away from the well’s mouth and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.
chapters.nkjv: Now all the flocks would be gathered there; and they would roll the stone from the well’s mouth, water the sheep, and put the stone back in its place on the well’s mouth.
chapters.kjv: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് അവരോടു: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, നിങ്ങൾ എവിടുത്തുകാർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾ ഹാരാന്യർ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jacob asked the shepherds, "My brothers, where are you from?" "We’re from Harran," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob said to them, "My brethren, where are you from?" And they said, "We are from Haran."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ നാഹോരിന്റെ മകനായ ലാബാനെ അറിയുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അറിയും എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Do you know Laban, Nahor’s grandson?" "Yes, we know him," they answered.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to them, "Do you know Laban the son of Nahor?" And they said, "We know him."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: അവൻ സുഖമായിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. സുഖം തന്നേ; അവന്റെ മകൾ റാഹേൽ അതാ ആടുകളോടു കൂടെ വരുന്നു എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob asked them, "Is he well?" "Yes, he is," they said, "and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep."
chapters.nkjv: So he said to them, "Is he well?" And they said, "Heis well. And look, his daughter Rachel is coming with the sheep."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

chapters.ml: പകൽ ഇനിയും വളരെയുണ്ടല്ലോ; കൂട്ടം ഒന്നിച്ചു കൂടുന്ന നേരമായിട്ടില്ല; ആടുകൾക്കു വെള്ളം കൊടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി തീറ്റുവിൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു
chapters.niv: "Look," he said, "the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Look, itis still high day; itis not time for the cattle to be gathered together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them .

chapters.ml: അവർ: കൂട്ടങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും കൂടുവോളം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വഹിയാ; അവർ കിണറ്റിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽനിന്നു കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടും; പിന്നെ ഞങ്ങൾ ആടുകൾക്കു വെള്ളം കൊടുക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "We can’t," they replied, "until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep."
chapters.nkjv: But they said, "We cannot until all the flocks are gathered together, and they have rolled the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep."
chapters.kjv: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ റാഹേൽ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ആടുകളോടുകൂടെ വന്നു. അവളായിരുന്നു അവയെ മേയിച്ചുവന്നതു.
chapters.niv: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherd.
chapters.nkjv: Now while he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
chapters.kjv: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ സഹോദരനായ ലാബാന്റെ മകൾ റാഹേലിനെയും അമ്മയുടെ സഹോദരനായ ലാബാന്റെ ആടുകളെയും കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് അടുത്തു ചെന്നു കണറ്റിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽനിന്നു കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടി, അമ്മയുടെ സഹോദരനായ ലാബാന്റെ ആടുകൾക്കു വെള്ളം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: When Jacob saw Rachel daughter of his uncle Laban, and Laban’s sheep, he went over and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് റാഹേലിനെ ചുംബിച്ചു പൊട്ടിക്കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice and wept.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

chapters.ml: താൻ അവളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ സഹോദരൻ എന്നും റിബെക്കയുടെ മകനെന്നും യാക്കോബ് റാഹേലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൾ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു തന്റെ അപ്പനെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative and that he was Rebekah’s son. So she ran and told her father.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരിയുടെ മകനായ യാക്കോബിന്റെ വസ്തുത കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു അവനെ ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്തു ചുംബിച്ചു വീട്ടിൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവൻ ലാബാനോടു വിവരം ഒക്കെയും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister’s son, he hurried to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, and there Jacob told him all these things.
chapters.nkjv: Then it came to pass, when Laban heard the report about Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him and kissed him, and brought him to his house. So he told Laban all these things.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ അവനോടു: നീ എന്റെ അസ്ഥിയും മാംസവും തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ ഒരു മാസകാലം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Laban said to him, "You are my own flesh and blood." After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,
chapters.nkjv: And Laban said to him, "Surely you are my bone and my flesh." And he stayed with him for a month.
chapters.kjv: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ലാബാൻ യാക്കോബിനോടു: നീ എന്റെ സഹോദരനാകകൊണ്ടു വെറുതെ എന്നെ സേവിക്കേണമോ? നിനക്കു എന്തു പ്രതിഫലം വേണം? എന്നോടു പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Laban said to him, "Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be."
chapters.nkjv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what should your wages be?"
chapters.kjv: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be ?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ലാബാന്നു രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു: മൂത്തവൾക്കു ലേയാ എന്നും ഇളയവൾക്കു റാഹേൽ എന്നും പേർ.
chapters.niv: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
chapters.nkjv: Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
chapters.kjv: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

chapters.ml: ലേയയുടെ കണ്ണു ശോഭ കുറഞ്ഞതായിരുന്നു; റാഹേലോ സുന്ദരിയും മനോഹരരൂപിണിയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel had a lovely figure and was beautiful.
chapters.nkjv: Leah’s eyes were delicate, but Rachel was beautiful of form and appearance.
chapters.kjv: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് റാഹേലിനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു; നിന്റെ ഇളയമകൾ റാഹേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി ഞാൻ ഏഴു സംവത്സരം നിന്നെ സേവിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, "I’ll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel."
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob loved Rachel; so he said, "I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ലാബാൻ: ഞാൻ അവളെ അന്യപുരുഷന്നുകൊടുക്കുന്നതിലും നിനക്കു തരുന്നതു നല്ലതു; എന്നോടുകൂടെ പാർക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Laban said, "It’s better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me."
chapters.nkjv: And Laban said, "Itis better that I give her to you than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me."
chapters.kjv: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യാക്കോബ് റാഹേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി ഏഴു സംവത്സരം സേവ ചെയ്തു; അവൻ അവളെ സ്നേഹിക്കകൊണ്ടു അതു അവന്നു അല്പകാലം പോലെ തോന്നി.
chapters.niv: So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed only a few days to him because of the love he had for her.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യാക്കോബ് ലാബാനോടു: എന്റെ സമയം തികഞ്ഞിരിക്കയാൽ ഞാൻ എന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുവാൻ അവളെ തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to make love to her."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ലാബാൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തെ ജനങ്ങളെ എല്ലാം ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂട്ടി ഒരു വിരുന്നു കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place and made a feast.
chapters.kjv: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാത്രിയിൽ അവൻ തന്റെ മകൾ ലേയയെ കൂട്ടി അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു പോയി ആക്കി; അവൻ അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob made love to her.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter and brought her to Jacob; and he went in to her.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ തന്റെ മകൾ ലേയെക്കു തന്റെ ദാസി സില്പയെ ദാസിയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And Laban gave his servant Zilpah to his daughter as her attendant.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban gave his maid Zilpah to his daughter Leah as a maid.
chapters.kjv: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

chapters.ml: നേരം വെളുത്തപ്പോൾ അതു ലേയാ എന്നു കണ്ടു അവൻ ലാബാനോടു: നീ എന്നോടു ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? റാഹേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി അല്ലയോ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സേവിച്ചതു? നീ എന്തിന്നു എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn’t I? Why have you deceived me?"
chapters.nkjv: So it came to pass in the morning, that behold, it was Leah. And he said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? Was it not for Rachel that I served you? Why then have you deceived me?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ലാബാൻ: മൂത്തവൾക്കു മുമ്പെ ഇളയവളെ കൊടുക്ക ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദിക്കിൽ നടപ്പില്ല.
chapters.niv: Laban replied, "It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban said, "It must not be done so in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
chapters.kjv: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

chapters.ml: ഇവളുടെ ആഴ്ചവട്ടം നിവർത്തിക്ക; എന്നാൽ നീ ഇനിയും ഏഴു സംവത്സരം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെയ്യുന്ന സേവെക്കു വേണ്ടി ഞങ്ങൾ അവളെയും നിനക്കു തരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Finish this daughter’s bridal week; then we will give you the younger one also, in return for another seven years of work."
chapters.nkjv: Fulfill her week, and we will give you this one also for the service which you will serve with me still another seven years."
chapters.kjv: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു, അവളുടെ ആഴ്ചവട്ടം നിവർത്തിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ മകൾ റാഹേലിനെയും അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And Jacob did so. He finished the week with Leah, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob did so and fulfilled her week. So he gave him his daughter Rachel as wife also.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ മകൾ റാഹേലിന്നു ലാബാൻ തന്റെ ദാസി ബിൽഹയെ ദാസിയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Laban gave his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her attendant.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as a maid.
chapters.kjv: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

chapters.ml: അവൻ റാഹേലിന്റെ അടുക്കലും ചെന്നു; റാഹേലിനെ ലേയയെക്കാൾ അധികം സ്നേഹിച്ചു; പിന്നെയും ഏഴു സംവത്സരം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ സേവചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Jacob made love to Rachel also, and his love for Rachel was greater than his love for Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob also went in to Rachel, and he also loved Rachel more than Leah. And he served with Laban still another seven years.
chapters.kjv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

chapters.ml: ലേയാ അനിഷ്ടയെന്നു യഹോവ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവളുടെ ഗർഭത്തെ തുറന്നു; റാഹേലോ മച്ചിയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Lord saw that Leah was not loved, he enabled her to conceive, but Rachel remained childless.
chapters.nkjv: When the Lord saw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
chapters.kjv: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

chapters.ml: ലേയാ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു: യഹോവ എന്റെ സങ്കടം കണ്ടു; ഇപ്പോൾ എന്റെ ഭർത്താവു എന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൾ അവന്നു രൂബേൻ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, "It is because the Lord has seen my misery. Surely my husband will love me now."
chapters.nkjv: So Leah conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Reuben; for she said, "The Lord has surely looked on my affliction. Now therefore, my husband will love me."
chapters.kjv: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പിന്നെയും ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു: ഞാൻ അനിഷ ്ടഎന്നു യഹോവ കേട്ടതുകൊണ്ടു ഇവനെയും എനിക്കു തന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു ശിമെയോൻ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Because the Lord heard that I am not loved, he gave me this one too." So she named him Simeon.
chapters.nkjv: Then she conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Because the Lord has heard that I am unloved, He has therefore given me this son also." And she called his name Simeon.
chapters.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പിന്നെയും ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു: ഇപ്പോൾ ഈ സമയം എന്റെ ഭർത്താവു എന്നോടു പറ്റിച്ചേരും; ഞാൻ അവന്നു മൂന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെ പ്രസവിച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൾ അവന്നു ലേവി എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Again she conceived, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." So he was named Levi.
chapters.nkjv: She conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Now this time my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." Therefore his name was called Levi.
chapters.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പിന്നെയും ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; ഇപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിക്കും എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൾ അവന്നു യെഹൂദാ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു. പിന്നെ അവൾക്കു പ്രസവം നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "This time I will praise the Lord ." So she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.
chapters.nkjv: And she conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Now I will praise the Lord." Therefore she called his name Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
chapters.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD : therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

chapters.ml: താൻ യാക്കോബിന്നു മക്കളെ പ്രസവിക്കുന്നില്ല എന്നു റാഹേൽ കണ്ടു തന്റെ സഹോദരിയോടു അസൂയപ്പെട്ടു യാക്കോബിനോടു: എനിക്കു മക്കളെ തരേണം; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ മരിച്ചുപോകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, "Give me children, or I’ll die!"
chapters.nkjv: Now when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister, and said to Jacob, "Give me children, or else I die!"
chapters.kjv: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബിന്നു റാഹേലിനോടു കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചു: നിനക്കു ഗർഭഫലം തരാതിരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സ്ഥാനത്തോ ഞാൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jacob became angry with her and said, "Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?"
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob’s anger was aroused against Rachel, and he said, "Am I in the place of God, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?"
chapters.kjv: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൾ: എന്റെ ദാസി ബിൽഹാ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുക; അവൾ എന്റെ മടിയിൽ പ്രസവിക്കട്ടെ; അവളാൽ എനിക്കും മക്കൾ ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then she said, "Here is Bilhah, my servant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and I too can build a family through her."
chapters.nkjv: So she said, "Here is my maid Bilhah; go in to her, and she will bear achild on my knees, that I also may have children by her."
chapters.kjv: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൾ തന്റെ ദാസി ബിൽഹയെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു; യാക്കോബ് അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife. Jacob slept with her,
chapters.nkjv: Then she gave him Bilhah her maid as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
chapters.kjv: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

chapters.ml: ബിൽഹാ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു യാക്കേബിന്നു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.
chapters.nkjv: And Bilhah conceived and bore Jacob a son.
chapters.kjv: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ റാഹേൽ: ദൈവം എനിക്കു ന്യായം നടത്തി എന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു എനിക്കു ഒരു മകനെ തന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതു കൊണ്ടു അവന്നു ദാൻ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Rachel said, "God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son." Because of this she named him Dan.
chapters.nkjv: Then Rachel said, "God has judged my case; and He has also heard my voice and given me a son." Therefore she called his name Dan.
chapters.kjv: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

chapters.ml: റാഹേലിന്റെ ദാസി ബിൽഹാ പിന്നെയും ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു യാക്കോബിന്നു രണ്ടാമതൊരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
chapters.nkjv: And Rachel’s maid Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
chapters.kjv: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ സഹോദരിയോടു വലിയോരു പോർ പൊരുതു ജയിച്ചുമിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു റാഹേൽ പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു നഫ്താലി എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Rachel said, "I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won." So she named him Naphtali.
chapters.nkjv: Then Rachel said, "With great wrestlings I have wrestled with my sister, and indeed I have prevailed." So she called his name Naphtali.
chapters.kjv: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

chapters.ml: തനിക്കു പ്രസവം നിന്നുപോയി എന്നു ലേയാ കണ്ടാറെ തന്റെ ദാസി സില്പയെ വിളിച്ചു അവളെ യാക്കോബിന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
chapters.nkjv: When Leah saw that she had stopped bearing, she took Zilpah her maid and gave her to Jacob as wife.
chapters.kjv: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

chapters.ml: ലേയയുടെ ദാസി സില്പാ യാക്കോബിന്നു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
chapters.nkjv: And Leah’s maid Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
chapters.kjv: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ലേയാ: ഭാഗ്യം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു ഗാദ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Leah said, "What good fortune!" So she named him Gad.
chapters.nkjv: Then Leah said, "A troop comes!" So she called his name Gad.
chapters.kjv: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

chapters.ml: ലേയയുടെ ദാസി സില്പാ യാക്കോബിന്നു രണ്ടാമതു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
chapters.nkjv: And Leah’s maid Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
chapters.kjv: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഭാഗ്യവതി; സ്ത്രികൾ എന്നെ ഭാഗ്യവതിയെന്നു പറയും എന്നു ലേയാ പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു ആശേർ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Leah said, "How happy I am! The women will call me happy." So she named him Asher.
chapters.nkjv: Then Leah said, "I am happy, for the daughters will call me blessed." So she called his name Asher.
chapters.kjv: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

chapters.ml: കോതമ്പുകൊയിത്തുകാലത്തു രൂബേൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വയലിൽ ദൂദായിപ്പഴം കണ്ടു തന്റെ അമ്മയായ ലേയയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു. റാഹേൽ ലേയയോടു: നിന്റെ മകന്റെ ദൂദായിപ്പഴം കുറെ എനിക്കു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."
chapters.nkjv: Now Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."
chapters.kjv: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവളോടു: നീ എന്റെ ഭർത്താവിനെ എടുത്തതു പോരയോ? എന്റെ മകന്റെ ദൂദായിപ്പഴവും കൂടെ വേണമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു റാഹേൽ: ആകട്ടെ; നിന്റെ മകന്റെ ദൂദായിപ്പഴത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി ഇന്നു രാത്രി അവൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചുകൊള്ളട്ടേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But she said to her, "Wasn’t it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son’s mandrakes too?" "Very well," Rachel said, "he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son’s mandrakes."
chapters.nkjv: But she said to her, "Isit a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes also?" And Rachel said, "Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes."
chapters.kjv: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് വൈകുന്നേരം വയലിൽനിന്നു വരുമ്പോൾ ലേയാ അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു ചെന്നു: നീ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരേണം; എന്റെ മകന്റെ ദൂദായിപ്പഴം കൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കൂലിക്കു വാങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അന്നു രാത്രി അവൻ അവളോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. "You must sleep with me," she said. "I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes." So he slept with her that night.
chapters.nkjv: When Jacob came out of the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, "You must come in to me, for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes." And he lay with her that night.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ലേയയുടെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു; അവൾ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു യാക്കോബിന്നു അഞ്ചാമതു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.
chapters.nkjv: And God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore Jacob a fifth son.
chapters.kjv: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ലേയാ: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദാസിയെ എന്റെ ഭർത്താവിന്നു കൊടുത്തതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവം എനിക്കു കൂലി തന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു യിസ്സാഖാർ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Leah said, "God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband." So she named him Issachar.
chapters.nkjv: Leah said, "God has given me my wages, because I have given my maid to my husband." So she called his name Issachar.
chapters.kjv: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

chapters.ml: ലേയാ പിന്നെയും ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു, യാക്കോബിന്നു ആറാമതു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.
chapters.nkjv: Then Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.
chapters.kjv: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം എനിക്കു ഒരു നല്ലദാനം തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ എന്റെ ഭർത്താവു എന്നോടുകൂടെ വസിക്കും; ഞാൻ അവന്നു ആറു മക്കളെ പ്രസവിച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു ലേയാ പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു സെബൂലൂൻ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Leah said, "God has presented me with a precious gift. This time my husband will treat me with honor, because I have borne him six sons." So she named him Zebulun.
chapters.nkjv: And Leah said, "God has endowed me with a good endowment; now my husband will dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons." So she called his name Zebulun.
chapters.kjv: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവൾ ഒരു മകളെ പ്രസവിച്ചു അവൾക്കു ദീനാ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.
chapters.nkjv: Afterward she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
chapters.kjv: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം റാഹേലിനെ ഓർത്തു; ദൈവം അവളുടെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു അവളുടെ ഗർഭത്തെ തുറന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and enabled her to conceive.
chapters.nkjv: Then God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and opened her womb.
chapters.kjv: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; ദൈവം എന്റെ നിന്ദ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, "God has taken away my disgrace."
chapters.nkjv: And she conceived and bore a son, and said, "God has taken away my reproach."
chapters.kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എനിക്കു ഇനിയും ഒരു മകനെ തരുമെന്നും പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു യോസേഫ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: She named him Joseph, and said, "May the Lord add to me another son."
chapters.nkjv: So she called his name Joseph, and said, "The Lord shall add to me another son."
chapters.kjv: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.

chapters.ml: റാഹേൽ യോസേഫിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചശേഷം യാക്കോബ് ലാബാനോടു: ഞാൻ എന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കും ദേശത്തേക്കും പോകുവാൻ എന്നെ അയക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, "Send me away, that I may go to my own place and to my country.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സേവിച്ചതിന്റെ പ്രതിഫലമായ എന്റെ ഭാര്യമാരേയും മക്കളെയും എനിക്കു തരേണം; ഞാൻ പോകട്ടെ; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സേവിച്ച സേവ നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Give me my wives and children, for whom I have served you, and I will be on my way. You know how much work I’ve done for you."
chapters.nkjv: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service which I have done for you."
chapters.kjv: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ അവനോടു: നിനക്കു എന്നോടു ദയ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ പോകരുതേ; നിന്റെ നിമിത്തം യഹോവ എന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു എന്നു എനിക്കു ബോദ്ധ്യമായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Laban said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you."
chapters.nkjv: And Laban said to him, "Please stay, if I have found favor in your eyes, for I have learned by experience that the Lord has blessed me for your sake."
chapters.kjv: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു എന്തു പ്രതിഫലം വേണം എന്നു പറക; ഞാൻ തരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He added, "Name your wages, and I will pay them."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Name me your wages, and I will give it."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ എങ്ങനെ സേവിച്ചു എന്നും നിന്റെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടം എന്റെ പക്കൽ എങ്ങനെ ഇരുന്നു എന്നും നീ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jacob said to him, "You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob said to him, "You know how I have served you and how your livestock has been with me.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വരുംമുമ്പെ നിനക്കു അല്പമേ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുള്ളു; ഇപ്പോൾ അതു അത്യന്തം വർദ്ധിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ കാൽ വെച്ചേടത്തൊക്കെയും യഹോവ നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. ഇനി എന്റെ സ്വന്തഭവനത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി ഞാൻ എപ്പോൾ കരുതും എന്നും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?"
chapters.nkjv: For what you had before I camewas little, and it has increased to a great amount; the Lord has blessed you since my coming. And now, when shall I also provide for my own house?"
chapters.kjv: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കു എന്തു തരേണം എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യാക്കോബ് പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ ഒന്നും തരേണ്ടാ; ഈ കാര്യം നീ ചെയ്തുതന്നാൽ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തെ ഇനിയും മേയിച്ചു പാലിക്കാം.
chapters.niv: "What shall I give you?" he asked. "Don’t give me anything," Jacob replied. "But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them:
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "What shall I give you?" And Jacob said, "You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep your flocks:
chapters.kjv: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇന്നു നിന്റെ എല്ലാ കൂട്ടങ്ങളിലും കൂടി കടന്നു, അവയിൽനിന്നു പുള്ളിയും മറുവുമുള്ള ആടുകളെ ഒക്കെയും ചെമ്മരിയാടുകളിൽ കറുത്തതിനെയൊക്കെയും കോലാടുകളിൽ പുള്ളിയും മറുവുമുള്ളതിനെയും വേർതിരിക്കാം; അതു എന്റെ പ്രതിഫലമായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages.
chapters.nkjv: Let me pass through all your flock today, removing from there all the speckled and spotted sheep, and all the brown ones among the lambs, and the spotted and speckled among the goats; and these shall be my wages.
chapters.kjv: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

chapters.ml: നാളെ ഒരിക്കൽ എന്റെ പ്രതിഫലം സംബന്ധിച്ചു നീ നോക്കുവാൻ വരുമ്പോൾ എന്റെ നീതി തെളിവായിരിക്കും; കോലാടുകളിൽ പുള്ളിയും മറുവുമില്ലാത്തതും ചെമ്മരിയാടുകളിൽ കറുത്തനിറമില്ലാത്തതും എല്ലാം മോഷ്ടിച്ചതായി എണ്ണാം.
chapters.niv: And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen."
chapters.nkjv: So my righteousness will answer for me in time to come, when the subject of my wages comes before you: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the lambs, will be considered stolen, if itis with me."
chapters.kjv: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ലാബാൻ: നീ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ആകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Agreed," said Laban. "Let it be as you have said."
chapters.nkjv: And Laban said, "Oh, that it were according to your word!"
chapters.kjv: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

chapters.ml: അന്നു തന്നേ അവൻ വരയും മറുവുമുള്ള മുട്ടാടുകളെയും പുള്ളിയും മറുവുമുള്ള പെൺകോലാടുകളെ ഒക്കെയും വെണ്മയുള്ളതിനെ ഒക്കെയും ചെമ്മരിയാടുകളിൽ കറുത്തനിറമുള്ളതിനെ ഒക്കെയും വേർതിരിച്ചു അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: That same day he removed all the male goats that were streaked or spotted, and all the speckled or spotted female goats (all that had white on them) and all the dark-colored lambs, and he placed them in the care of his sons.
chapters.nkjv: So he removed that day the male goats that were speckled and spotted, all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had some white in it, and all the brown ones among the lambs, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
chapters.kjv: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തനിക്കും യാക്കോബിന്നും ഇടയിൽ മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തെ വഴിയകലം വെച്ചു; ലാബാന്റെ ശേഷമുള്ള ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടങ്ങളെ യാക്കോബ് മേയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban’s flocks.
chapters.nkjv: Then he put three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
chapters.kjv: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യാക്കോബ് പുന്നവൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെയും ബദാംവൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെയും അരിഞ്ഞിൽവൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെയും പച്ചക്കൊമ്പുകളെ എടുത്തു അവയിൽ വെള്ള കാണത്തക്കവണ്ണം വെള്ളവരയായി തോലുരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob took for himself rods of green poplar and of the almond and chestnut trees, peeled white strips in them, and exposed the white which was in the rods.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

chapters.ml: ആടുകൾ കുടിപ്പാൻ വന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ, താൻ തോലുരിച്ച കൊമ്പുകളെ പാത്തികളിലും വെള്ളം പകരുന്ന തൊട്ടികളിലും ആടുകളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു; അവ വെള്ളം കുടിപ്പാൻ വന്നപ്പോൾ ചനയേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Then he placed the peeled branches in all the watering troughs, so that they would be directly in front of the flocks when they came to drink. When the flocks were in heat and came to drink,
chapters.nkjv: And the rods which he had peeled, he set before the flocks in the gutters, in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink, so that they should conceive when they came to drink.
chapters.kjv: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

chapters.ml: ആടുകൾ കൊമ്പുകളെ കണ്ടുകൊണ്ടു ചനയേറ്റു വരയും പുള്ളിയും മറുവുമുള്ള കുട്ടികളെ പെറ്റു.
chapters.niv: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.
chapters.nkjv: So the flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks brought forth streaked, speckled, and spotted.
chapters.kjv: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

chapters.ml: ആ ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടികളെ യാക്കോബ് വേർതിരിച്ചു ആടുകളെ ലാബാന്റെ ആടുകളിൽ വരയും മറുവുമുള്ള എല്ലാറ്റിന്നും അഭിമുഖമായി നിർത്തി; തന്റെ സ്വന്തകൂട്ടങ്ങളെ ലാബാന്റെ ആടുകളോടു ചേർക്കാതെ വേറെയാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Jacob set apart the young of the flock by themselves, but made the rest face the streaked and dark-colored animals that belonged to Laban. Thus he made separate flocks for himself and did not put them with Laban’s animals.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob separated the lambs, and made the flocks face toward the streaked and all the brown in the flock of Laban; but he put his own flocks by themselves and did not put them with Laban’s flock.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

chapters.ml: ബലമുള്ള ആടുകൾ ചനയേല്ക്കുമ്പോഴൊക്കെയും കൊമ്പുകളെ കണ്ടുകൊണ്ടു ചനയേൽക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യാക്കോബ് ആ കൊമ്പുകളെ പാത്തികളിൽ ആടുകളുടെ കണ്ണിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Whenever the stronger females were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs in front of the animals so they would mate near the branches,
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, whenever the stronger livestock conceived, that Jacob placed the rods before the eyes of the livestock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

chapters.ml: ബലമില്ലാത്ത ആടുകൾ ചനയേല്ക്കുമ്പോൾ അവയെ വെച്ചില്ല; അങ്ങനെ ബലമില്ലാത്തവ ലാബാന്നും ബലമുള്ളവ യാക്കോബിന്നും ആയിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put them in; so the feebler were Laban’s and the stronger Jacob’s.
chapters.kjv: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മഹാസമ്പന്നനായി അവന്നു വളരെ ആടുകളും ദാസീദാസന്മാരും ഒട്ടകങ്ങളും കഴുതകളും ഉണ്ടാകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
chapters.nkjv: Thus the man became exceedingly prosperous, and had large flocks, female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
chapters.kjv: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്നുള്ളതൊക്കെയും യാക്കോബ് എടുത്തുകളഞ്ഞു ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ വകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ഈ ധനം ഒക്കെയും സമ്പാദിച്ചു എന്നു ലാബാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കുകളെ അവൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, "Jacob has taken everything our father owned and has gained all this wealth from what belonged to our father."
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, "Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s, and from what was our father’s he has acquired all this wealth."
chapters.kjv: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ലാബാന്റെ മുഖത്തു നോക്കിയാറെ അതു തന്റെ നേരെ മുമ്പെ ഇരുന്നതു പോലെ അല്ല എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: And Jacob noticed that Laban’s attitude toward him was not what it had been.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and indeed it was not favorable toward him as before.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ യാക്കോബിനോടു: നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദേശത്തേക്കും നിന്റെ ചാർച്ചക്കാരുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കും മടങ്ങിപ്പോക; ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers and to your family, and I will be with you."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ആളയച്ചു റാഹേലിനേയും ലേയയെയും വയലിൽ തന്റെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to his flock,
chapters.kjv: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

chapters.ml: അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ മുഖം എന്റെ നേരെ മുമ്പെപ്പോലെ അല്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ കാണുന്നു; എങ്കിലും എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ദൈവം എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "I see that your father’s attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.
chapters.nkjv: and said to them, "I see your father’s countenance, that it is not favorable toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനെ ഞാൻ എന്റെ സർവ്വബലത്തോടും കൂടെ സേവിച്ചു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നെ അറിയാമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You know that I’ve worked for your father with all my strength,
chapters.nkjv: And you know that with all my might I have served your father.
chapters.kjv: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനോ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു എന്റെ പ്രതിഫലം പത്തു പ്രാവശ്യം മാറ്റി; എങ്കിലും എന്നോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ദൈവം അവനെ സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.
chapters.nkjv: Yet your father has deceived me and changed my wages ten times, but God did not allow him to hurt me.
chapters.kjv: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

chapters.ml: പുള്ളിയുള്ളവ നിന്റെ പ്രതിഫലം ആയിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു എങ്കിൽ കൂട്ടമൊക്കെയും പുള്ളിയുള്ള കുട്ടികളെ പെറ്റു; വരയുള്ളവ നിന്റെ പ്രതിഫലം ആയിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു എങ്കിൽ കൂട്ടമൊക്കെയും വരയുള്ള കുട്ടികളെ പെറ്റു.
chapters.niv: If he said, ‘The speckled ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks gave birth to speckled young; and if he said, ‘The streaked ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore streaked young.
chapters.nkjv: If he said thus: ‘The speckled shall be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore speckled. And if he said thus: ‘The streaked shall be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore streaked.
chapters.kjv: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
