chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദൈവം നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തെ എടുത്തു എനിക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and has given them to me.
chapters.nkjv: So God has taken away the livestock of your father and given them to me.
chapters.kjv: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

chapters.ml: ആടുകൾ ചനയേല്ക്കുന്ന കാലത്തു ഞാൻ സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ ആടുകളിന്മേൽ കയറുന്ന മുട്ടാടുകൾ വരയും പുള്ളിയും മറുവും ഉള്ളവ എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: "In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted.
chapters.nkjv: "And it happened, at the time when the flocks conceived, that I lifted my eyes and saw in a dream, and behold, the rams which leaped upon the flocks were streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദൂതൻ സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ എന്നോടു: യാക്കോബേ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു; ഞാൻ ഇതാ, എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ I answered, ‘Here I am.’
chapters.nkjv: Then the Angel of God spoke to me in a dream, saying, ‘Jacob.’ And I said, ‘Here I am.’
chapters.kjv: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying , Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: നീ തലപൊക്കി നോക്കുക; ആടുകളുടെ മേൽ കയറുന്ന മുട്ടാടുകൾ ഒക്കെയും വരയും പുള്ളിയും മറുവുമുള്ളവയല്ലോ; ലാബാൻ നിന്നോടു ചെയ്യുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he said, ‘Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you.
chapters.nkjv: And He said, ‘Lift your eyes now and see, all the rams which leap on the flocks are streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted; for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

chapters.ml: നീ തൂണിനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്കയും എന്നോടു നേർച്ചനേരുകയും ചെയ്ത സ്ഥലമായ ബേഥേലിന്റെ ദൈവം ആകുന്നു ഞാൻ; ആകയാൽ നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു, ഈ ദേശംവിട്ടു നിന്റെ ജന്മദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land.’ "
chapters.nkjv: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and where you made a vow to Me. Now arise, get out of this land, and return to the land of your family.’ "
chapters.kjv: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

chapters.ml: റാഹേലും ലേയയും അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഇനി ഓഹരിയും അവകാശവും ഉണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Then Rachel and Leah replied, "Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father’s estate?
chapters.nkjv: Then Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, "Is there still any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
chapters.kjv: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഞങ്ങളെ അന്യരായിട്ടല്ലയോ വിചാരിക്കുന്നതു? ഞങ്ങളെ വിറ്റു വിലയും എല്ലാം തിന്നു കളഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.
chapters.nkjv: Are we not considered strangers by him? For he has sold us, and also completely consumed our money.
chapters.kjv: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ പക്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തുകളഞ്ഞ സമ്പത്തൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങൾക്കും ഞങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾക്കും ഉള്ളതല്ലോ; ആകയാൽ ദൈവം നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്തുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you."
chapters.nkjv: For all these riches which God has taken from our father are really ours and our children’s; now then, whatever God has said to you, do it."
chapters.kjv: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children’s: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യാക്കോബ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു തന്റെ ഭാര്യമാരെയും പുത്രന്മാരെയും ഒട്ടകപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels,
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob rose and set his sons and his wives on camels.
chapters.kjv: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

chapters.ml: തന്റെ കന്നുകാലികളെ ഒക്കെയും താൻ സമ്പാദിച്ച സമ്പത്തു ഒക്കെയും താൻ പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽ സമ്പാദിച്ച മൃഗസമ്പത്തു ഒക്കെയും ചേർത്തുകൊണ്ടു കനാൻ ദേശത്തു തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോകുവാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: And he carried away all his livestock and all his possessions which he had gained, his acquired livestock which he had gained in Padan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ തന്റെ ആടുകളെ രോമം കത്രിപ്പാൻ പോയിരുന്നു; റാഹേൽ തന്റെ അപ്പന്നുള്ള ഗൃഹവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ മോഷ്ടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household gods.
chapters.nkjv: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel had stolen the household idols that were her father’s.
chapters.kjv: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.

chapters.ml: താൻ ഓടിപ്പോകുന്നതു യാക്കോബ് അരാമ്യനായ ലാബാനോടു അറിയിക്കായ്കയാൽ അവനെ തോല്പിച്ചായിരുന്നു പോയതു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob stole away, unknown to Laban the Syrian, in that he did not tell him that he intended to flee.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൻ തനിക്കുള്ള സകലവുമായി ഓടിപ്പോയി; അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു നദി കടന്നു. ഗിലെയാദ് പർവ്വതത്തിന്നു നേരെ തിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So he fled with all he had, crossed the Euphrates River, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: So he fled with all that he had. He arose and crossed the river, and headed toward the mountains of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ഓടിപ്പോയി എന്നു ലാബാന്നു മൂന്നാം ദിവസം അറിവു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
chapters.kjv: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ഏഴു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി അവനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു ഗിലെയാദ് പർവ്വതത്തിൽ അവനോടു ഒപ്പം എത്തി.
chapters.niv: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took his brethren with him and pursued him for seven days’ journey, and he overtook him in the mountains of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവം രാത്രി സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ അരാമ്യനായ ലാബാന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: നീ യാക്കോബിനോടു ഗുണമെങ്കിലും ദോഷമെങ്കിലും പറയാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, "Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad."
chapters.nkjv: But God had come to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, "Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad."
chapters.kjv: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ യാക്കോബിനോടു ഒപ്പം എത്തി; യാക്കോബ് പർവ്വതത്തിൽ കൂടാരം അടിച്ചിരുന്നു; ലാബാനും തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുമായി ഗിലെയാദ് പർവ്വതത്തിൽ കൂടാരം അടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.
chapters.nkjv: So Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountains, and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mountains of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ യാക്കോബിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ എന്നെ ഒളിച്ചു പോയ്ക്കളകയും എന്റെ പുത്രിമാരെ വാളാൽ പിടിച്ചവരെപ്പോലെ കൊണ്ടുപോകയും ചെയ്തതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? You’ve deceived me, and you’ve carried off my daughters like captives in war.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban said to Jacob: "What have you done, that you have stolen away unknown to me, and carried away my daughters like captives taken with the sword?
chapters.kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

chapters.ml: നീ എന്നെ തോല്പിച്ചു രഹസ്യമായിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോകയും ഞാൻ സന്തോഷത്തോടും സംഗീതത്തോടും മുരജത്തോടും വീണയോടുംകൂടെ നിന്നെ അയപ്പാന്തക്കവണ്ണം എന്നെ അറിയിക്കാതിരിക്കയും
chapters.niv: Why did you run off secretly and deceive me? Why didn’t you tell me, so I could send you away with joy and singing to the music of timbrels and harps?
chapters.nkjv: Why did you flee away secretly, and steal away from me, and not tell me; for I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with timbrel and harp?
chapters.kjv: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ചുംബിപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു ഇടതരാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? ഭോഷത്വമാകുന്നു നീ ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: You didn’t even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. You have done a foolish thing.
chapters.nkjv: And you did not allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters. Now you have done foolishly in so doing.
chapters.kjv: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാൻ എന്റെ പക്കൽ ശക്തിയുണ്ടു; എങ്കിലും നീ യാക്കോബിനോടു ഗുണമെങ്കിലും ദോഷമെങ്കിലും ചെയ്യാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവിന്റെ ദൈവം കഴിഞ്ഞ രാത്രി എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I have the power to harm you; but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’
chapters.nkjv: It is in my power to do you harm, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad.’
chapters.kjv: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

chapters.ml: ആകട്ടെ, നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നായുള്ള അതിവാഞ്ഛയാൽ നീ പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോന്നു; എന്നാൽ എന്റെ ദേവന്മാരെ മോഷ്ടിച്ചതു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: Now you have gone off because you longed to return to your father’s household. But why did you steal my gods?"
chapters.nkjv: And now you have surely gone because you greatly long for your father’s house, but why did you steal my gods?"
chapters.kjv: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ലാബാനോടു: പക്ഷെ നിന്റെ പുത്രിമാരെ നീ എന്റെ പക്കൽനിന്നു അപഹരിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Jacob answered Laban, "I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob answered and said to Laban, "Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Perhaps you would take your daughters from me by force.’
chapters.kjv: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ ആരുടെ പക്കൽ എങ്കിലും നിന്റെ ദേവന്മാരെ കണ്ടാൽ അവൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കരുതു; എന്റെ പക്കൽ നിന്റെ വക വല്ലതും ഉണ്ടോ എന്നു നീ നമ്മുടെ സഹോദരന്മാർ കാൺകെ നോക്കി എടുക്ക എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. റാഹേൽ അവയെ മോഷ്ടിച്ചതു യാക്കോബ് അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: But if you find anyone who has your gods, that person shall not live. In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself whether there is anything of yours here with me; and if so, take it." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the gods.
chapters.nkjv: With whomever you find your gods, do not let him live. In the presence of our brethren, identify what I have of yours and take it with you." For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.
chapters.kjv: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ലാബാൻ യാക്കോബിന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിലും ലേയയുടെ കൂടാരത്തിലും രണ്ടു ദാസിമാരുടെ കൂടാരത്തിലും ചെന്നു നോക്കി, ഒന്നും കണ്ടില്ല താനും; അവൻ ലേയയുടെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി റാഹേലിന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent and into Leah’s tent and into the tent of the two female servants, but he found nothing. After he came out of Leah’s tent, he entered Rachel’s tent.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the two maids’ tents, but he did not find them. Then he went out of Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s tent.
chapters.kjv: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the two maidservants’ tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ റാഹേൽ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ എടുത്തു ഒട്ടകക്കോപ്പിനകത്തു ഇട്ടു അതിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു. ലാബാൻ കൂടാരത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും തിരഞ്ഞു നോക്കി, കണ്ടില്ല താനും.
chapters.niv: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them inside her camel’s saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched through everything in the tent but found nothing.
chapters.nkjv: Now Rachel had taken the household idols, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. And Laban searched all about the tent but did not find them.
chapters.kjv: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel’s furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അപ്പനോടു: യജമാനൻ കോപിക്കരുതേ; നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ എഴുന്നേല്പാൻ എനിക്കു കഴിവില്ല; സ്ത്രീകൾക്കുള്ള മുറ എനിക്കു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ശോധന കഴിച്ചു; ഗൃഹവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ കണ്ടില്ല താനും.
chapters.niv: Rachel said to her father, "Don’t be angry, my lord, that I cannot stand up in your presence; I’m having my period." So he searched but could not find the household gods.
chapters.nkjv: And she said to her father, "Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise before you, for the manner of women is with me." And he searched but did not find the household idols.
chapters.kjv: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബിന്നു കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചു, അവൻ ലാബാനോടു വാദിച്ചു. യാക്കോബ് ലാബാനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: എന്റെ കുറ്റം എന്തു? നീ ഇത്ര ഉഗ്രതയോടെ എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ഓടി വരേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ തെറ്റു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Jacob was angry and took Laban to task. "What is my crime?" he asked Laban. "How have I wronged you that you hunt me down?
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob was angry and rebuked Laban, and Jacob answered and said to Laban: "What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have so hotly pursued me?
chapters.kjv: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ സാമാനം ഒക്കെയും ശോധന കഴിച്ചുവല്ലോ; നിന്റെ വീട്ടിലെ സാമാനം വല്ലതും കണ്ടുവോ? എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കും നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കും മുമ്പാകെ ഇവിടെ വെക്കുക; അവർ നമുക്കിരുവർക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ വിധിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Now that you have searched through all my goods, what have you found that belongs to your household? Put it here in front of your relatives and mine, and let them judge between the two of us.
chapters.nkjv: Although you have searched all my things, what part of your household things have you found? Set it here before my brethren and your brethren, that they may judge between us both!
chapters.kjv: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

chapters.ml: ഈ ഇരുപതു സംവത്സരം ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പാർത്തു; നിന്റെ ചെമ്മരിയാടുകൾക്കും കോലാടുകൾക്കും ചനനാശം വന്നിട്ടില്ല. നിന്റെ കൂട്ടത്തിലെ ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരെ ഞാൻ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞിട്ടുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten rams from your flocks.
chapters.nkjv: These twenty years I havebeen with you; your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried their young, and I have not eaten the rams of your flock.
chapters.kjv: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

chapters.ml: ദുഷ്ടമൃഗം കടിച്ചുകീറിയതിനെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരാതെ ഞാൻ അതിന്നു ഉത്തരവാദിയായിരുന്നു; പകൽ കളവു പോയതിനെയും രാത്രി കളവുപോയതിനെയും നീ എന്നോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: I did not bring you animals torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for whatever was stolen by day or night.
chapters.nkjv: That which was torn bybeasts I did not bring to you; I bore the loss of it. You required it from my hand, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
chapters.kjv: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെയായിരുന്നു എന്റെ വസ്തുത; പകൽ വെയിൽകൊണ്ടും രാത്രി ശീതംകൊണ്ടും ഞാൻ ക്ഷയിച്ചു; എന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നു ഉറക്കമില്ലാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
chapters.nkjv: There I was! In the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.
chapters.kjv: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

chapters.ml: ഈ ഇരുപതു സംവത്സരം ഞാൻ നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പാർത്തു; പതിന്നാലു സംവത്സരം നിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാർക്കായിട്ടും ആറു സംവത്സരം നിന്റെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിന്നായിട്ടും നിന്നെ സേവിച്ചു; പത്തു പ്രാവശ്യം നീ എന്റെ പ്രതിഫലം മാറ്റി.
chapters.niv: It was like this for the twenty years I was in your household. I worked for you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks, and you changed my wages ten times.
chapters.nkjv: Thus I have been in your house twenty years; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
chapters.kjv: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ദൈവമായി അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ഭയവുമായവൻ എനിക്കു ഇല്ലാതിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നീ ഇപ്പോൾ എന്നെ വെറുതെ അയച്ചുകളയുമായിരുന്നു; ദൈവം എന്റെ കഷ്ടതയും എന്റെ കൈകളുടെ പ്രയത്നവും കണ്ടു കഴിഞ്ഞ രാത്രി ന്യായം വിധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would surely have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my hardship and the toil of my hands, and last night he rebuked you."
chapters.nkjv: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night."
chapters.kjv: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ യാക്കോബിനോടു: പുത്രിമാർ എന്റെ പുത്രിമാർ, മക്കൾ എന്റെ മക്കൾ, ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടം എന്റെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടം; നീ കാണുന്നതൊക്കെയും എനിക്കുള്ളതു തന്നേ; ഈ എന്റെ പുത്രിമാരോടോ അവർ പ്രസവിച്ച മക്കളോടോ ഞാൻ ഇന്നു എന്തു ചെയ്യും?
chapters.niv: Laban answered Jacob, "The women are my daughters, the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks. All you see is mine. Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine, or about the children they have borne?
chapters.nkjv: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, "These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and this flock is my flock; all that you see is mine. But what can I do this day to these my daughters or to their children whom they have borne?
chapters.kjv: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ വരിക, ഞാനും നീയും തമ്മിൽ ഒരു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്ക; അതു എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ സാക്ഷിയായിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Come now, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, come, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it be a witness between you and me."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് ഒരു കല്ലു എടുത്തു തൂണായി നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

chapters.ml: കല്ലു കൂട്ടുവിൻ എന്നു യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ കല്ലു എടുത്തു ഒരു കൂമ്പാരമുണ്ടാക്കി; കൂമ്പാരത്തിന്മേൽ വെച്ചു അവർ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He said to his relatives, "Gather some stones." So they took stones and piled them in a heap, and they ate there by the heap.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob said to his brethren, "Gather stones." And they took stones and made a heap, and they ate there on the heap.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ അതിന്നു യെഗർ-സഹദൂഥാ (സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്റെ കൂമ്പാരം) എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; യാക്കോബ് അതിന്നു ഗലേദ് (സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്റെ കൂമ്പാരം) എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.
chapters.nkjv: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
chapters.kjv: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

chapters.ml: ഈ കൂമ്പാരം ഇന്നു എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ സാക്ഷി എന്നു ലാബാൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അതുകൊണ്ടു അതിന്നു ഗലേദ് എന്നും മിസ്പാ (കാവൽ മാടം) എന്നും പേരായി:
chapters.niv: Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me today." That is why it was called Galeed.
chapters.nkjv: And Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me this day." Therefore its name was called Galeed,
chapters.kjv: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

chapters.ml: നാം തമ്മിൽ അകന്നിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ യഹോവ എനിക്കും നിനക്കും നടുവെ കാവലായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: It was also called Mizpah, because he said, "May the Lord keep watch between you and me when we are away from each other.
chapters.nkjv: also Mizpah, because he said, "May the Lord watch between you and me when we are absent one from another.
chapters.kjv: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ പുത്രിമാരെ ഉപദ്രവിക്കയോ എന്റെ പുത്രിമാരെയല്ലാതെ വേറെ സ്ത്രീകളെ പരിഗ്രഹിക്കയോ ചെയ്യുമെങ്കിൽ നമ്മോടുകൂടെ ആരും ഇല്ല; നോക്കുക, ദൈവം തന്നേ എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ സാക്ഷി എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If you mistreat my daughters or if you take any wives besides my daughters, even though no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me."
chapters.nkjv: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take other wives besides my daughters, although no man is with us—see, God is witness between you and me!"
chapters.kjv: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ പിന്നെയും യാക്കോബിനോടു: ഇതാ, ഈ കൂമ്പാരം; ഇതാ, എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ നിർത്തിയ തൂൺ.
chapters.niv: Laban also said to Jacob, "Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Here is this heap and here is this pillar, which I have placed between you and me.
chapters.kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

chapters.ml: ദോഷത്തിന്നായി ഞാൻ ഈ കൂമ്പാരം കടന്നു നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരാതെയും നീ ഈ കൂമ്പാരവും ഈ തൂണും കടന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരാതെയും ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഈ കൂമ്പാരവും സാക്ഷി, ഈ തൂണും സാക്ഷി.
chapters.niv: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this heap to your side to harm you and that you will not go past this heap and pillar to my side to harm me.
chapters.nkjv: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not pass beyond this heap to you, and you will not pass beyond this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
chapters.kjv: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും നാഹോരിന്റെ ദൈവവും അവരുടെ പിതാവിന്റെ ദൈവവുമായവൻ നമുക്കു മദ്ധ്യേ വിധിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ പിതാവായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ഭയമായവനെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us." So Jacob took an oath in the name of the Fear of his father Isaac.
chapters.nkjv: The God of Abraham, the God of Nahor, and the God of their father judge between us." And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
chapters.kjv: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യാക്കോബ് പർവ്വതത്തിൽ യാഗം അർപ്പിച്ചു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിപ്പാൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ വിളിച്ചു; അവർ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചു പർവ്വതത്തിൽ രാപാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: He offered a sacrifice there in the hill country and invited his relatives to a meal. After they had eaten, they spent the night there.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread. And they ate bread and stayed all night on the mountain.
chapters.kjv: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

chapters.ml: ലാബാൻ അതി കാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ചുംബിക്കയും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കയും ചെയ്തശേഷം അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു സ്വദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.
chapters.nkjv: And early in the morning Laban arose, and kissed his sons and daughters and blessed them. Then Laban departed and returned to his place.
chapters.kjv: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ വഴിക്കു പോയി; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാർ അവന്റെ എതിരെ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് അവരെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: ഇതു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സേന എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു മഹനയീം എന്നു പേർ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is the camp of God!" So he named that place Mahanaim.
chapters.nkjv: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is God’s camp." And he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
chapters.kjv: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യാക്കോബ് എദോംനാടായ സേയീർദേശത്തു തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ തനിക്കു മുമ്പായി ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ ഏശാവിനോടു ഇങ്ങനെ പറവിൻ: നിന്റെ അടിയാൻ യാക്കോബ് ഇപ്രകാരം പറയുന്നു: ഞാൻ ലാബാന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പരദേശിയായി പാർത്തു ഇന്നുവരെ അവിടെ താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He instructed them: "This is what you are to say to my lord Esau: ‘Your servant Jacob says, I have been staying with Laban and have remained there till now.
chapters.nkjv: And he commanded them, saying, "Speak thus to my lord Esau, ‘Thus your servant Jacob says: "I have dwelt with Laban and stayed there until now.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു കാളയും കഴുതയും ആടും ദാസീദാസന്മാരും ഉണ്ടു; നിനക്കു എന്നൊടു കൃപ തോന്നേണ്ടതിന്നാകുന്നു യജമാനനെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ ആളയക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: I have cattle and donkeys, sheep and goats, male and female servants. Now I am sending this message to my lord, that I may find favor in your eyes.’ "
chapters.nkjv: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, and male and female servants; and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

chapters.ml: ദൂതന്മാർ യാക്കോബിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങി വന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോയി വന്നു; അവൻ നാനൂറു ആളുമായി നിന്നെ എതിരേല്പാൻ വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, "We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."
chapters.nkjv: Then the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and he also is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."
chapters.kjv: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് ഏറ്റവും ഭ്രമിച്ചു ഭയവശനായി, തന്നോടു കൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന ജനത്തെയും ആടുകളെയും കന്നുകാലികളെയും ഒട്ടകങ്ങളെയും രണ്ടു കൂട്ടമായി വിഭാഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In great fear and distress Jacob divided the people who were with him into two groups, and the flocks and herds and camels as well.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed; and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks and herds and camels, into two companies.
chapters.kjv: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

chapters.ml: ഏശാവ് ഒരു കൂട്ടത്തിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു അതിനെ നശിപ്പിച്ചാൽ മറ്റേ കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോകാമല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He thought, "If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "If Esau comes to the one company and attacks it, then the other company which is left will escape."
chapters.kjv: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യാക്കോബ് പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചതു: എന്റെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും എന്റെ പിതാവായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദൈവവുമായുള്ളോവേ, നിന്റെ ദേശത്തേക്കും നിന്റെ ചാർച്ചക്കാരുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കും മടങ്ങിപ്പോക; ഞാൻ നിനക്കു നന്മ ചെയ്യുമെന്നു എന്നൊടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത യഹോവേ,
chapters.niv: Then Jacob prayed, "O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, Lord , you who said to me, ‘Go back to your country and your relatives, and I will make you prosper,’
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob said, "O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, the Lord who said to me, ‘Return to your country and to your family, and I will deal well with you’:
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

chapters.ml: അടിയനോടു കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന സകലദയെക്കും സകലവിശ്വസ്തതെക്കും ഞാൻ അപാത്രമത്രേ; ഒരു വടിയോടുകൂടെ മാത്രമല്ലോ ഞാൻ ഈ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നതു; ഇപ്പോഴോ ഞാൻ രണ്ടു കൂട്ടമായി തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness you have shown your servant. I had only my staff when I crossed this Jordan, but now I have become two camps.
chapters.nkjv: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies and of all the truth which You have shown Your servant; for I crossed over this Jordan with my staff, and now I have become two companies.
chapters.kjv: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ; പക്ഷേ അവൻ വന്നു എന്നെയും മക്കളോടുകൂടെ തള്ളയെയും നശിപ്പിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ ഭയപ്പെടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Save me, I pray, from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid he will come and attack me, and also the mothers with their children.
chapters.nkjv: Deliver me, I pray, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and attack me and the mother with the children.
chapters.kjv: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

chapters.ml: നീയോ: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു നന്മ ചെയ്യും; നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ പെരുപ്പംകൊണ്ടു എണ്ണിക്കൂടാത്ത കടൽകരയിലെ മണൽപോലെ ആക്കുമെന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: But you have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.’ "
chapters.nkjv: For You said, ‘I will surely treat you well, and make your descendants as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.’ "
chapters.kjv: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

chapters.ml: അന്നു രാത്രി അവൻ അവിടെ പാർത്തു; തന്റെ പക്കൽ ഉള്ളതിൽ തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവിന്നു സമ്മാനമായിട്ടു
chapters.niv: He spent the night there, and from what he had with him he selected a gift for his brother Esau:
chapters.nkjv: So he lodged there that same night, and took what came to his hand as a present for Esau his brother:
chapters.kjv: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

chapters.ml: ഇരുനൂറു കോലാടിനെയും ഇരുപതു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഇരുനൂറു ചെമ്മരിയാടിനെയും ഇരുപതു ചെമ്മരിയാട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും
chapters.niv: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
chapters.nkjv: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
chapters.kjv: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

chapters.ml: കറവുള്ള മുപ്പതു ഒട്ടകത്തെയും അവയുടെ കുട്ടികളെയും നാല്പതു പശുവിനെയും പത്തു കാളയെയും ഇരുപതു പെൺകഴുതയെയും പത്തു കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെയും വേർതിരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: thirty female camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.
chapters.nkjv: thirty milk camels with their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
chapters.kjv: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ പക്കൽ ഓരോ കൂട്ടത്തെപ്രത്യേകം പ്രത്യേകമായി ഏല്പിച്ചു, തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എനിക്കു മുമ്പായി കടന്നുപോയി അതതു കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു മദ്ധ്യേ ഇടയിടുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He put them in the care of his servants, each herd by itself, and said to his servants, "Go ahead of me, and keep some space between the herds."
chapters.nkjv: Then he delivered them to the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said to his servants, "Pass over before me, and put some distance between successive droves."
chapters.kjv: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമതു പോകുന്നവനോടു അവൻ: എന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവ് നിന്നെ കണ്ടു: നീ ആരുടെ ആൾ? എവിടെ പോകുന്നു? നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ പോകുന്ന ഇവ ആരുടെ വക എന്നിങ്ങനെ നിന്നോടു ചോദിച്ചാൽ:
chapters.niv: He instructed the one in the lead: "When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘Who do you belong to, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?’
chapters.nkjv: And he commanded the first one, saying, "When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, saying, ‘To whom do you belong, and where are you going? Whose are these in front of you?’
chapters.kjv: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അടിയാൻ യാക്കോബിന്റെ വക ആകുന്നു; ഇതു യജമാനനായ ഏശാവിന്നു അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന സമ്മാനം; അതാ, അവനും പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു എന്നു നീ പറയേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he is coming behind us.’ "
chapters.nkjv: then you shall say, ‘They are your servant Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord Esau; and behold, he also is behind us.’ "
chapters.kjv: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തവനോടും മൂന്നാമത്തവനോടും കൂട്ടങ്ങളെ നടത്തിക്കൊണ്ടു പോകുന്ന എല്ലാവരോടും: നിങ്ങൾ ഏശാവിനെ കാണുമ്പോൾ ഇപ്രകാരം അവനോടുപറവിൻ;
chapters.niv: He also instructed the second, the third and all the others who followed the herds: "You are to say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.
chapters.nkjv: So he commanded the second, the third, and all who followed the droves, saying, "In this manner you shall speak to Esau when you find him;
chapters.kjv: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

chapters.ml: അതാ, നിന്റെ അടിയാൻ യാക്കോബ് പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു എന്നും പറവിൻ എന്നു അവൻ കല്പിച്ചു. എനിക്കു മുമ്പായിപോകുന്ന സമ്മാനംകൊണ്ടു അവനെ ശാന്തമാക്കീട്ടു പിന്നെ ഞാൻ അവന്റെ മുഖം കണ്ടുകൊള്ളാം; പക്ഷേ അവന്നു എന്നോടു ദയ തോന്നുമായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And be sure to say, ‘Your servant Jacob is coming behind us.’ " For he thought, "I will pacify him with these gifts I am sending on ahead; later, when I see him, perhaps he will receive me."
chapters.nkjv: and also say, ‘Behold, your servant Jacob is behind us.’ " For he said, "I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; perhaps he will accept me."
chapters.kjv: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ സമ്മാനം അവന്റെ മുമ്പായി പോയി; അവനോ അന്നു രാത്രി കൂട്ടത്തോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Jacob’s gifts went on ahead of him, but he himself spent the night in the camp.
chapters.nkjv: So the present went on over before him, but he himself lodged that night in the camp.
chapters.kjv: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിൽ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു. തന്റെ രണ്ടു ഭാര്യമാരെയും രണ്ടു ദാസിമാരെയും പതിനൊന്നു പുത്രന്മാരയും കൂട്ടി യബ്ബോക് കടവു കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: That night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two female servants and his eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
chapters.nkjv: And he arose that night and took his two wives, his two female servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of Jabbok.
chapters.kjv: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അവരെ കൂട്ടി ആറ്റിന്നക്കരെ കടത്തി; തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അക്കരെ കടത്തിയശേഷം യാക്കോബ് തനിയേ ശേഷിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.
chapters.nkjv: He took them, sent them over the brook, and sent over what he had.
chapters.kjv: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഒരു പുരുഷൻ ഉഷസ്സാകുവോളം അവനോടു മല്ലു പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob was left alone; and a Man wrestled with him until the breaking of day.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ജയിക്കയില്ല എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവന്റെ തുടയുടെ തടം തൊട്ടു; ആകയാൽ അവനോടു മല്ലുപിടിക്കയിൽ യാക്കോബിന്റെ തുടയുടെ തടം ഉളുക്കിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When the man saw that he could not overpower him, he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip so that his hip was wrenched as he wrestled with the man.
chapters.nkjv: Now when He saw that He did not prevail against him, He touched the socket of his hip; and the socket of Jacob’s hip was out of joint as He wrestled with him.
chapters.kjv: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ വിടുക; ഉഷസ്സു ഉദിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: നീ എന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചല്ലാതെ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വിടുകയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the man said, "Let me go, for it is daybreak." But Jacob replied, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Let Me go, for the day breaks." But he said, "I will not let You go unless You bless me!"
chapters.kjv: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പേർ എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: യാക്കോബ് എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The man asked him, "What is your name?" "Jacob," he answered.
chapters.nkjv: So He said to him, "What is your name?" He said, "Jacob."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

chapters.ml: നീ ദൈവത്തോടും മനുഷ്യരോടും മല്ലുപിടിച്ചു ജയിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ പേർ ഇനി യാക്കോബ് എന്നല്ല യിസ്രായേൽ എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടും എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the man said, "Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome."
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have struggled with God and with men, and have prevailed."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് അവനോടു: നിന്റെ പേർ എനിക്കു പറഞ്ഞുതരേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു: നീ എന്റെ പേർ ചോദിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു, അവിടെവെച്ചു അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jacob said, "Please tell me your name." But he replied, "Why do you ask my name?" Then he blessed him there.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob asked, saying, "Tell me Your name, I pray." And He said, "Why is it that you ask about My name?" And He blessed him there.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob asked him , and said, Tell me , I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തെ മുഖാമുഖമായി കണ്ടിട്ടും എനിക്കു ജീവഹാനി വിന്നില്ല എന്നു യാക്കോബ് പറഞ്ഞു, ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു പെനീയേൽ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So Jacob called the place Peniel, saying, "It is because I saw God face to face, and yet my life was spared."
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: "For I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പെനീയേൽ കടന്നു പോകുമ്പോൾ സൂര്യൻ ഉദിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ തുടയുടെ ഉളുക്കുനിമിത്തം അവൻ മുടന്തിനടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.
chapters.nkjv: Just as he crossed over Penuel the sun rose on him, and he limped on his hip.
chapters.kjv: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യാക്കോബിന്റെ തുടയുടെ തടത്തിലെ ഞരമ്പു തൊടുകകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഇന്നുവരെയും തുടയുടെ തടത്തിലെ ഞരമ്പു തിന്നാറില്ല.
chapters.niv: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was touched near the tendon.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore to this day the children of Israel do not eat the muscle that shrank, which is on the hip socket, because He touched the socket of Jacob’s hip in the muscle that shrank.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യാക്കോബ് തലപൊക്കി നോക്കി, ഏശാവും അവനോടുകൂടെ നാനൂറു ആളും വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു; തന്റെ മക്കളെ ലേയയുടെ അടുക്കലും റാഹേലിന്റെ അടുക്കലും രണ്ടു ദാസിമാരുടെ അടുക്കലും വിഭാഗിച്ചു നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: Jacob looked up and there was Esau, coming with his four hundred men; so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel and the two female servants.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob lifted his eyes and looked, and there, Esau was coming, and with him were four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദാസിമാരെയും അവരുടെ മക്കളെയും മുമ്പായും ലേയെയും അവളുടെ മക്കളെയും പിന്നാലെയും റാഹേലിനെയും യോസേഫിനെയും ഒടുക്കമായും നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: He put the female servants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph in the rear.
chapters.nkjv: And he put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.
chapters.kjv: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവർക്കു മുമ്പായി കടന്നു ഏഴു പ്രാവശ്യം സാഷ്ടാംഗം നമസ്കരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു തന്റെ സഹോദരനോടു അടുത്തുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
chapters.nkjv: Then he crossed over before them and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
chapters.kjv: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവ് ഓടിവന്നു അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു, ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ കഴുത്തിൽ വീണു അവനെ ചുംബിച്ചു, രണ്ടുപേരും കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.
chapters.nkjv: But Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.
chapters.kjv: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തലപൊക്കി സ്ത്രീകളെയും കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെയും കണ്ടു: നിന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള ഇവർ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ദൈവം അടിയന്നു നല്കിയിരിക്കുന്ന മക്കൾ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Esau looked up and saw the women and children. "Who are these with you?" he asked. Jacob answered, "They are the children God has graciously given your servant."
chapters.nkjv: And he lifted his eyes and saw the women and children, and said, "Who are these with you?" So he said, "The children whom God has graciously given your servant."
chapters.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാസിമാരും മക്കളും അടുത്തുവന്നു നമസ്കരിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Then the female servants and their children approached and bowed down.
chapters.nkjv: Then the maidservants came near, they and their children, and bowed down.
chapters.kjv: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

chapters.ml: ലേയയും മക്കളും അടുത്തുവന്നു നമസ്കരിച്ചു; ഒടുവിൽ യോസേഫും റാഹേലും അടുത്തുവന്നു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.
chapters.nkjv: And Leah also came near with her children, and they bowed down. Afterward Joseph and Rachel came near, and they bowed down.
chapters.kjv: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വഴിക്കു കണ്ട ആ കൂട്ടമൊക്കെയും എന്തിന്നു എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: യജമാനന്നു എന്നോടു കൃപതോന്നേണ്ടതിന്നു ആകുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Esau asked, "What’s the meaning of all these flocks and herds I met?" "To find favor in your eyes, my lord," he said.
chapters.nkjv: Then Esau said, "What do you meanby all this company which I met?" And he said, "Theseare to find favor in the sight of my lord."
chapters.kjv: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഏശാവ്: സഹോദരാ, എനിക്കു വേണ്ടുന്നതു ഉണ്ടു; നിനക്കുള്ളതു നിനക്കു ഇരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Esau said, "I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself."
chapters.nkjv: But Esau said, "I have enough, my brother; keep what you have for yourself."
chapters.kjv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യാക്കോബ്: അങ്ങനെയല്ല, എന്നോടു കൃപ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ എന്റെ സമ്മാനം എന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വാങ്ങേണമേ; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുഖം കാണുന്നതുപോലെ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മുഖം കാണുകയും നിനക്കു എന്നോടു ദയ തോന്നുകയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ;
chapters.niv: "No, please!" said Jacob. "If I have found favor in your eyes, accept this gift from me. For to see your face is like seeing the face of God, now that you have received me favorably.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob said, "No, please, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present from my hand, inasmuch as I have seen your face as though I had seen the face of God, and you were pleased with me.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന കാഴ്ച വാങ്ങേണമേ; ദൈവം എന്നോടു കൃപ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; എനിക്കു വേണ്ടുവോളം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ നിർബ്ബന്ധിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അതു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Please accept the present that was brought to you, for God has been gracious to me and I have all I need." And because Jacob insisted, Esau accepted it.
chapters.nkjv: Please, take my blessing that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough." So he urged him, and he took it.
chapters.kjv: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it .

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ: നാം പ്രയാണംചെയ്തു പോക; ഞാൻ നിനക്കു മുമ്പായി നടക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Esau said, "Let us be on our way; I’ll accompany you."
chapters.nkjv: Then Esau said, "Let us take our journey; let us go, and I will go before you."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ അവനോടു: കുട്ടികൾ നന്നാ ഇളയവർ എന്നും കറവയുള്ള ആടുകളും കന്നുകാലികളും കൂടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നും യജമാനൻ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ; അവയെ ഒരു ദിവസം അധികമായി ഓടിച്ചാൽ കൂട്ടമെല്ലാം ചത്തുപോകും.
chapters.niv: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are tender and that I must care for the ewes and cows that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard just one day, all the animals will die.
chapters.nkjv: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are weak, and the flocks and herds which are nursing are with me. And if the men should drive them hard one day, all the flock will die.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ അടിയന്നു മുമ്പായി പോയാലും; എന്റെ കൂടെയുള്ള കന്നുകാലികളുടെയും കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളുടെയും പ്രാപ്തിക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം ഞാൻ സാവധാനത്തിൽ അവയെ നടത്തിക്കൊണ്ടു സേയീരിൽ യജമാനന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുകൊള്ളാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So let my lord go on ahead of his servant, while I move along slowly at the pace of the flocks and herds before me and the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir."
chapters.nkjv: Please let my lord go on ahead before his servant. I will lead on slowly at a pace which the livestock that go before me, and the children, are able to endure, until I come to my lord in Seir."
chapters.kjv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ആളുകളിൽ ചിലരെ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിർത്തട്ടെ എന്നു ഏശാവു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: എന്തിന്നു? യജമാനന്റെ കൃപയുണ്ടായാൽ മതി എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Esau said, "Then let me leave some of my men with you." "But why do that?" Jacob asked. "Just let me find favor in the eyes of my lord."
chapters.nkjv: And Esau said, "Now let me leave with you some of the people who are with me." But he said, "What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord."
chapters.kjv: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഏശാവ് അന്നു തന്റെ വഴിക്കു സേയീരിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir.
chapters.nkjv: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
chapters.kjv: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബോ സുക്കോത്തിന്നു യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ടു; തനിക്കു ഒരു വീടു പണിതു; കന്നുകാലിക്കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു തൊഴുത്തുകളും കെട്ടി; അതു കൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു സുക്കോത്ത് എന്നു പേർ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jacob, however, went to Sukkoth, where he built a place for himself and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place is called Sukkoth.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, built himself a house, and made booths for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽനിന്നു വന്നശേഷം കനാൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ശേഖേംപട്ടണത്തിൽ സമാധാനത്തോടെ എത്തി പട്ടണത്തിന്നരികെ പാളയമടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Jacob came from Paddan Aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in Canaan and camped within sight of the city.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan Aram; and he pitched his tent before the city.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

chapters.ml: താൻ കൂടാരമടിച്ച നിലം ശെഖേമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹമോരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടു നൂറു വെള്ളിക്കാശിന്നു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: For a hundred pieces of silver, he bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, the plot of ground where he pitched his tent.
chapters.nkjv: And he bought the parcel of land, where he had pitched his tent, from the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
chapters.kjv: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവൻ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു, അതിന്നു ഏൽ-എലോഹേ-യിസ്രായേൽ എന്നു പേർ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Then he erected an altar there and called it El Elohe Israel.
chapters.kjv: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.

chapters.ml: ലേയാ യാക്കോബിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച മകളായ ദീനാ ദേശത്തിലെ കന്യകമാരെ കാണ്മാൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.
chapters.nkjv: Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
chapters.kjv: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ഹിവ്യനായ ഹമോരിന്റെ മകനായി ദേശത്തിന്റെ പ്രഭുവായ ശെഖേം അവളെ കണ്ടിട്ടു പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുപോയി അവളോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചു അവൾക്കു പോരായ്കവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the ruler of that area, saw her, he took her and raped her.
chapters.nkjv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her and lay with her, and violated her.
chapters.kjv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഉള്ളം യാക്കോബിന്റെ മകളായ ദീനയൊടുപറ്റിച്ചേർന്നു; അവൻ ബാലയെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു, ബാലയോടു ഹൃദ്യമായി സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob; he loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.
chapters.nkjv: His soul was strongly attracted to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young woman and spoke kindly to the young woman.
chapters.kjv: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

chapters.ml: ശെഖേം തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹമോരിനോടു: ഈ ബാലയെ എനിക്കു ഭാര്യയായിട്ടു എടുക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Shechem said to his father Hamor, "Get me this girl as my wife."
chapters.nkjv: So Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, "Get me this young woman as a wife."
chapters.kjv: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ മകളായ ദീനയെ അവൻ വഷളാക്കിഎന്നു യാക്കോബ് കേട്ടു; അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തോടുകൂടെ വയലിൽ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ വരുവോളം യാക്കോബ് മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jacob heard that his daughter Dinah had been defiled, his sons were in the fields with his livestock; so he did nothing about it until they came home.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter. Now his sons were with his livestock in the field; so Jacob held his peace until they came.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

chapters.ml: ശെഖേമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹമോർ യാക്കോബിനോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Shechem’s father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
chapters.kjv: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ വസ്തുത കേട്ടു വയലിൽ നിന്നു വന്നു. അവൻ യാക്കോബിന്റെ മകളോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചു, അങ്ങനെ അരുതാത്ത കാര്യം ചെയ്തു യിസ്രായേലിൽ വഷളത്വം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ആ പുരുഷന്മാർക്കു വ്യസനം തോന്നി മഹാകോപവും ജ്വലിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, Jacob’s sons had come in from the fields as soon as they heard what had happened. They were shocked and furious, because Shechem had done an outrageous thing in Israel by sleeping with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it; and the men were grieved and very angry, because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing which ought not to be done.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

chapters.ml: ഹമോർ അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: എന്റെ മകൻ ശെഖേമിന്റെ ഉള്ളം നിങ്ങളുടെ മകളോടു പറ്റിയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: But Hamor said to them, "My son Shechem has his heart set on your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
chapters.nkjv: But Hamor spoke with them, saying, "The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
chapters.kjv: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളോടു വിവാഹസംബന്ധം കൂടി നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്ത്രീകളെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തരികയും ഞങ്ങളുടെ സ്ത്രീകളെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എടുക്കയും ചെയ്‍വിൻ.
chapters.niv: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.
chapters.nkjv: And make marriages with us; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters to yourselves.
chapters.kjv: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കാം; ദേശത്തു നിങ്ങൾക്കു സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യമുണ്ടാകും; അതിൽ പാർത്തു വ്യാപാരം ചെയ്തു വസ്തു സമ്പാദിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You can settle among us; the land is open to you. Live in it, trade in it, and acquire property in it."
chapters.nkjv: So you shall dwell with us, and the land shall be before you. Dwell and trade in it, and acquire possessions for yourselves in it."
chapters.kjv: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

chapters.ml: ശെഖേമും അവളുടെ അപ്പനോടും സഹോദരന്മാരോടും: നിങ്ങൾക്കുഎന്നോടു കൃപ തോന്നിയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ തരാം.
chapters.niv: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and I will give you whatever you ask.
chapters.nkjv: Then Shechem said to her father and her brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you say to me I will give.
chapters.kjv: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

chapters.ml: എന്നോടു സ്ത്രീധനവും ദാനവും എത്രയെങ്കിലും ചോദിപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ പറയുംപോലെ ഞാൻ തരാം; ബാലയെ എനിക്കു ഭാര്യയായിട്ടു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Make the price for the bride and the gift I am to bring as great as you like, and I’ll pay whatever you ask me. Only give me the young woman as my wife."
chapters.nkjv: Ask me ever so much dowry and gift, and I will give according to what you say to me; but give me the young woman as a wife."
chapters.kjv: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരിയായ ദീനയെ ഇവൻ വഷളാക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ശെഖേമിനോടും അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹമോരിനോടും സംസാരിച്ചു കപടമായി ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Because their sister Dinah had been defiled, Jacob’s sons replied deceitfully as they spoke to Shechem and his father Hamor.
chapters.nkjv: But the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father, and spoke deceitfully, because he had defiled Dinah their sister.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരിയെ അഗ്രചർമ്മിയായ പുരുഷനു കൊടുക്കുന്ന കാര്യം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പാടുള്ളതല്ല; അതു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അവമാനമാകുന്നു. എങ്കിലും ഒന്നു ചെയ്താൽ ഞങ്ങൾ സമ്മതിക്കാം.
chapters.niv: They said to them, "We can’t do such a thing; we can’t give our sister to a man who is not circumcised. That would be a disgrace to us.
chapters.nkjv: And they said to them, "We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that wouldbe a reproach to us.
chapters.kjv: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിലുള്ള ആണെല്ലാം പരിച്ഛേദന ഏറ്റു നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ ആയ്തീരുമെങ്കിൽ
chapters.niv: We will enter into an agreement with you on one condition only: that you become like us by circumcising all your males.
chapters.nkjv: But on this condition we will consent to you: If you will become as we are, if every male of you is circumcised,
chapters.kjv: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised;

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ സ്ത്രീകളെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തരികയും നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്ത്രീകളെ ഞങ്ങൾ എടുക്കയും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു ഒരു ജനമായ്തീരുകയും ചെയ്യാം.
chapters.niv: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We’ll settle among you and become one people with you.
chapters.nkjv: then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us; and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
chapters.kjv: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

chapters.ml: പരിച്ഛേദന ഏല്ക്കുന്നതിൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ വാക്കു സമ്മതിക്കാഞ്ഞാലോ ഞങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ബാലയെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോരും.
chapters.niv: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we’ll take our sister and go."
chapters.nkjv: But if you will not heed us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and be gone."
chapters.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ വാക്കു ഹമോരിന്നും ഹാമോരിന്റെ മകനായ ശെഖേമിന്നും ബോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
chapters.nkjv: And their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
chapters.kjv: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

chapters.ml: ആ യൌവനക്കാരന്നു യാക്കോബിന്റെ മകളോടു അനുരാഗം വർദ്ധിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ആ കാര്യം നടത്തുവാൻ താമസം ചെയ്തില്ല; അവൻ തന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽ എല്ലാവരിലും ശ്രേഷ്ഠനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The young man, who was the most honored of all his father’s family, lost no time in doing what they said, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.
chapters.nkjv: So the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he delighted in Jacob’s daughter. He was more honorable than all the household of his father.
chapters.kjv: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഹമോരും അവന്റെ മകനായ ശെഖേമും തങ്ങളുടെ പട്ടണഗോപുരത്തിങ്കൽ ചെന്നു, പട്ടണത്തിലെ പുരുഷന്മാരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city to speak to the men of their city.
chapters.nkjv: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying:
chapters.kjv: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

chapters.ml: ഈ മനുഷ്യർ നമ്മോടു സമാധാനമായിരിക്കുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു വ്യാപാരം ചെയ്യട്ടെ; അവർക്കും നമുക്കും മതിയാകുംവണ്ണം ദേശം വിസ്താരമുള്ളതല്ലോ; അവരുടെ സ്ത്രീകളെ നാം വിവാഹം കഴിക്കയും നമ്മുടെ സ്ത്രീകളെ അവർക്കു കൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്ക.
chapters.niv: "These men are friendly toward us," they said. "Let them live in our land and trade in it; the land has plenty of room for them. We can marry their daughters and they can marry ours.
chapters.nkjv: "These men are at peace with us. Therefore let them dwell in the land and trade in it. For indeed the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us as wives, and let us give them our daughters.
chapters.kjv: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവർ പരിച്ഛേദനയുള്ളവരായിരിക്കുംപോലെ നമ്മിലുള്ള ആണെല്ലാം പരിച്ഛേദന ഏറ്റാൽ മാത്രമേ അവർ നമ്മോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു ഒരു ജനമായിരിപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിക്കയുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: But the men will agree to live with us as one people only on the condition that our males be circumcised, as they themselves are.
chapters.nkjv: Only on this condition will the men consent to dwell with us, to be one people: if every male among us is circumcised as they are circumcised.
chapters.kjv: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടവും സമ്പത്തും മൃഗങ്ങളൊക്കെയും നമുക്കു ആകയില്ലയോ? അവർ പറയുംവണ്ണം സമ്മതിച്ചാൽ മതി; എന്നാൽ അവർ നമ്മോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Won’t their livestock, their property and all their other animals become ours? So let us agree to their terms, and they will settle among us."
chapters.nkjv: Will not their livestock, their property, and every animal of theirs be ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us."
chapters.kjv: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഹമോരിന്റെ പട്ടണക്കാർ എല്ലാവരും അവന്റെയും മകൻ ശെഖേമിന്റെയും വാക്കു കേട്ടു പട്ടണക്കാരിൽ ആണെല്ലാം പരിച്ഛേദനം ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: All the men who went out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male in the city was circumcised.
chapters.nkjv: And all who went out of the gate of his city heeded Hamor and Shechem his son; every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
chapters.kjv: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം ദിവസം അവർ വേദനപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ യാക്കോബിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായി ദീനയുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ശിമെയോനും ലേവിയും താന്താന്റെ വാൾ എടുത്തു നിർഭയമായിരുന്ന പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ചെന്നു ആണിനെയൊക്കെയും കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Three days later, while all of them were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, took their swords and attacked the unsuspecting city, killing every male.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword and came boldly upon the city and killed all the males.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഹമോരിനെയും അവന്റെ മകനായ ശേഖേമിനെയും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽകൊന്നു ദീനയെ ശെഖേമിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They put Hamor and his son Shechem to the sword and took Dinah from Shechem’s house and left.
chapters.nkjv: And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah from Shechem’s house, and went out.
chapters.kjv: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ നിഹതന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ചെന്നു,തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരിയെ അവർ വഷളാക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു പട്ടണത്തെ കൊള്ളയിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Jacob came upon the dead bodies and looted the city where their sister had been defiled.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because their sister had been defiled.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

chapters.ml: അവർഅവരുടെ ആടു, കന്നുകാലി, കഴുത ഇങ്ങനെ പട്ടണത്തിലും വെളിയിലുമുള്ളവയൊക്കെയും അപഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They seized their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else of theirs in the city and out in the fields.
chapters.nkjv: They took their sheep, their oxen, and their donkeys, what was in the city and what was in the field,
chapters.kjv: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

chapters.ml: അവരുടെസമ്പത്തൊക്കെയും എല്ലാപൈതങ്ങളെയും സ്ത്രീകളെയും അവർ കൊണ്ടുപോയി; വീടുകളിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും കൊള്ളയിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They carried off all their wealth and all their women and children, taking as plunder everything in the houses.
chapters.nkjv: and all their wealth. All their little ones and their wives they took captive; and they plundered even all that was in the houses.
chapters.kjv: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് ശിമെയോനോടും ലേവിയോടും: ഈ ദേശനിവാസികളായ കനാന്യരുടെയും പെരിസ്യരുടെയും ഇടയിൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ നാറ്റിച്ചു വിഷമത്തിലാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ ആൾ ചുരുക്കമുള്ളവനല്ലോ; അവർ എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടംകൂടി എന്നെ തോല്പിക്കയും ഞാനും എന്റെ ഭവനവും നശിക്കയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me obnoxious to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people living in this land. We are few in number, and if they join forces against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have troubled me by making me obnoxious among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and since I am few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and kill me. I shall be destroyed, my household and I."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: ഞങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരിയോടു അവന്നു ഒരു വേശ്യയോടു എന്നപോലെ പെരുമാറാമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they replied, "Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?"
chapters.nkjv: But they said, "Should he treat our sister like a harlot?"
chapters.kjv: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദൈവം യാക്കോബിനോടു: നീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ബേഥേലിൽ ചെന്നു പാർക്ക; നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഏശാവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീ ഓടിപ്പോകുമ്പോൾ നിനക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായ ദൈവത്തിന്നു അവിടെ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം ഉണ്ടാക്കുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then God said to Jacob, "Go up to Bethel and settle there, and build an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from your brother Esau."
chapters.nkjv: Then God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel and dwell there; and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother."
chapters.kjv: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ കുടുംബത്തോടും കൂടെയുള്ള എല്ലാവരോടും: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിലുള്ള അന്യദേവന്മാരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു നിങ്ങളെ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു വസ്ത്രം മാറുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Get rid of the foreign gods you have with you, and purify yourselves and change your clothes.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
chapters.kjv: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

chapters.ml: നാം പുറപ്പെട്ടു ബേഥേലിലേക്കു പോക; എന്റെ കഷ്ടകാലത്തു എന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേൾക്കയും ഞാൻ പോയ വഴിയിൽ എന്നോടു കൂടെയിരിക്കയും ചെയ്ത ദൈവത്തിന്നു ഞാൻ അവിടെ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം ഉണ്ടാക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then come, let us go up to Bethel, where I will build an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and who has been with me wherever I have gone."
chapters.nkjv: Then let us arise and go up to Bethel; and I will make an altar there to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and has been with me in the way which I have gone."
chapters.kjv: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പക്കലുള്ള അന്യദേവന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും കാതുകളിലെ കുണുക്കുകളെയും യാക്കോബിന്റെ പക്കൽ കൊടുത്തു; യാക്കോബ് അവയെ ശെഖേമിന്നരികെയുള്ള കരുവേലകത്തിൻ കീഴിൽ കുഴിച്ചിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods they had and the rings in their ears, and Jacob buried them under the oak at Shechem.
chapters.nkjv: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth tree which was by Shechem.
chapters.kjv: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവരുടെ ചുറ്റുമിരുന്ന പട്ടണങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ഭീതി വീണതു കൊണ്ടു യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ ആരും പിന്തുടർന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then they set out, and the terror of God fell on the towns all around them so that no one pursued them.
chapters.nkjv: And they journeyed, and the terror of God was upon the cities that were all around them, and they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.
chapters.kjv: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനമൊക്കെയും കനാൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ലൂസ് എന്ന ബേഥേലിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
chapters.kjv: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is , Beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവൻ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു; തന്റെ സഹോദരന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോകുമ്പോൾ അവന്നു അവിടെവെച്ചു ദൈവം പ്രത്യക്ഷനായതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ഏൽ-ബേഥേൽ എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: There he built an altar, and he called the place El Bethel, because it was there that God revealed himself to him when he was fleeing from his brother.
chapters.nkjv: And he built an altar there and called the place El Bethel, because there God appeared to him when he fled from the face of his brother.
chapters.kjv: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

chapters.ml: റിബെക്കയുടെ ധാത്രിയായ ദെബോരാ മരിച്ചു, അവളെ ബേഥേലിന്നു താഴെ ഒരു കരുവേലകത്തിൻ കീഴിൽ അടക്കി; അതിന്നു അല്ലോൻ-ബാഖൂത്ത് (വിലാപവൃക്ഷം)എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
