chapters.niv: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak outside Bethel. So it was named Allon Bakuth.
chapters.nkjv: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the terebinth tree. So the name of it was called Allon Bachuth.
chapters.kjv: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽനിന്നു വന്ന ശേഷം ദൈവം അവന്നു പിന്നെയും പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Padan Aram, and blessed him.
chapters.kjv: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവനോടു: നിന്റെ പേർ യാക്കോബ് എന്നല്ലോ; ഇനി നിനക്കു യാക്കോബ് എന്നല്ല യിസ്രായേൽ എന്നു തന്നെ പേരാകേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു അവന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel. " So he named him Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And God said to him, "Your name is Jacob; your name shall not be called Jacob anymore, but Israel shall be your name." So He called his name Israel.
chapters.kjv: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം പിന്നെയും അവനോടു: ഞാൻ സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവം ആകുന്നു; നീ സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവനായി പെരുകുക; ഒരു ജാതിയും ജാതികളുടെ കൂട്ടവും നിന്നിൽ നിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിക്കും; രാജാക്കന്മാരും നിന്റെ കടിപ്രദേശത്തു നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: And God said to him, "I am God Almighty ; be fruitful and increase in number. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants.
chapters.nkjv: Also God said to him: "I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall proceed from you, and kings shall come from your body.
chapters.kjv: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അബ്രാഹാമിന്നും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നും കൊടുത്തദേശം നിനക്കു തരും; നിന്റെ ശേഷം നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും ഈ ദേശം കൊടുക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I also give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you."
chapters.nkjv: The land which I gave Abraham and Isaac I give to you; and to your descendants after you I give this land."
chapters.kjv: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു സംസാരിച്ച സ്ഥലത്തുനിന്നു ദൈവം അവനെ വിട്ടു കയറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.
chapters.nkjv: Then God went up from him in the place where He talked with him.
chapters.kjv: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചേടത്തു യാക്കോബ് ഒരു കൽത്തൂൺ നിർത്തി; അതിന്മേൽ ഒരു പാനീയയാഗം ഒഴിച്ചു എണ്ണയും പകർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jacob set up a stone pillar at the place where God had talked with him, and he poured out a drink offering on it; he also poured oil on it.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He talked with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം തന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ച സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു യാക്കോബ് ബേഥേൽ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Bethel.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.

chapters.ml: അവർ ബേഥേലിൽനിന്നു യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു, എഫ്രാത്തയിൽ എത്തുവാൻ അല്പദൂരം മാത്രമുള്ളപ്പോൾ റാഹേൽ പ്രസവിച്ചു; പ്രസവിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൾക്കു കഠിന വേദനയുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then they moved on from Bethel. While they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty.
chapters.nkjv: Then they journeyed from Bethel. And when there was but a little distance to go to Ephrath, Rachel labored inchildbirth, and she had hard labor.
chapters.kjv: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പ്രസവത്തിൽ അവൾക്കു കഠിനവേദനയായിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ സൂതികർമ്മിണി അവളോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഇതും ഒരു മകനായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And as she was having great difficulty in childbirth, the midwife said to her, "Don’t despair, for you have another son."
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said to her, "Do not fear; you will have this son also."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൾ മരിച്ചുപോയി; ജീവൻ പോകുന്ന സമയം അവൾ അവന്നു ബെനോനീ എന്നു പേർ ഇട്ടു; അവന്റെ അപ്പനോ അവന്നു ബെന്യാമീൻ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: As she breathed her last—for she was dying—she named her son Ben-Oni. But his father named him Benjamin.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-Oni; but his father called him Benjamin.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

chapters.ml: റാഹേൽ മരിച്ചിട്ടു അവളെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെം എന്ന എഫ്രാത്തിന്നു പോകുന്ന വഴിയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
chapters.nkjv: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
chapters.kjv: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ കല്ലറയിന്മേൽ യാക്കോബ് ഒരു തൂൺ നിർത്തി അതു റാഹേലിന്റെ കല്ലറത്തൂൺ എന്ന പേരോടെ ഇന്നുവരെയും നില്ക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Over her tomb Jacob set up a pillar, and to this day that pillar marks Rachel’s tomb.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob set a pillar on her grave, which is the pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യിസ്രായേൽ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു, ഏദെർഗോപുരത്തിന്നു അപ്പുറം കൂടാരം അടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel journeyed and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
chapters.kjv: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ ആ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ രൂബേൻ ചെന്നു തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയായ ബിൽഹയോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേൽ അതുകേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard of it. Jacob had twelve sons:
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine; and Israel heard aboutit. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ പന്ത്രണ്ടു പേരായിരുന്നു. ലേയയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യാക്കോബിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ രൂബേൻ, ശിമെയോൻ, ലേവി, യെഹൂദാ, യിസ്സാഖാർ, സെബൂലൂൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.
chapters.nkjv: the sons of Leah were Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun;
chapters.kjv: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

chapters.ml: റാഹേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യോസേഫും ബെന്യാമീനും.
chapters.niv: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.nkjv: the sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin;
chapters.kjv: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

chapters.ml: റാഹേലിന്റെ ദാസിയായ ബിൽഹയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ദാനും നഫ്താലിയും.
chapters.niv: The sons of Rachel’s servant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.
chapters.nkjv: the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maidservant, were Dan and Naphtali;
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

chapters.ml: ലേയയുടെ ദാസിയായ സില്പയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഗാദും ആശേരും. ഇവർ യാക്കോബിന്നു പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽവെച്ചു ജനിച്ച പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Leah’s servant Zilpah: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
chapters.nkjv: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maidservant, were Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Padan Aram.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യാക്കോബ് കിര്യാത്തർബ്ബാ എന്ന മമ്രേയിൽ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അബ്രാഹാമും യിസ്ഹാക്കും പാർത്തിരുന്നഹെബ്രോൻ ഇതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Jacob came home to his father Isaac in Mamre, near Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kirjath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had dwelt.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ആയുസ്സു നൂറ്റെണ്പതു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.
chapters.nkjv: Now the days of Isaac were one hundred and eighty years.
chapters.kjv: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്ക് വയോധികനും കാലസമ്പൂർണ്ണനുമായി പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു മരിച്ചു തന്റെ ജനത്തോടു ചേർന്നു; അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ഏശാവും യാക്കോബും കൂടി അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
chapters.nkjv: So Isaac breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people, being old and full of days. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
chapters.kjv: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

chapters.ml: എദോം എന്ന ഏശാവിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു:
chapters.niv: This is the account of the family line of Esau (that is, Edom).
chapters.nkjv: Now this is the genealogy of Esau, who is Edom.
chapters.kjv: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവ് ഹിത്യനായ ഏലോന്റെ മകൾ ആദാ, ഹിവ്യനായ സിബെയോന്റെ മകളായ അനയുടെ മകൾ ഒഹൊലീബാ എന്നീ കനാന്യകന്യകമാരെയും
chapters.niv: Esau took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite—
chapters.nkjv: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite; Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
chapters.kjv: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

chapters.ml: യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ മകളും നെബായോത്തിന്റെ സഹോദരിയുമായ ബാസമത്തിനെയും ഭാര്യമാരായി പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.
chapters.nkjv: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
chapters.kjv: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

chapters.ml: ആദാ ഏശാവിന്നു എലീഫാസിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; ബാസമത്ത് രെയൂവേലിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,
chapters.nkjv: Now Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.
chapters.kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

chapters.ml: ഒഹൊലീബാമാ യെയൂശിനെയും യലാമിനെയും കോരഹിനെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു; ഇവർ ഏശാവിന്നു കനാൻ ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു ജനിച്ച പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: And Aholibamah bore Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏശാവ് തന്റെ ഭാര്യമാരെയും പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും വീട്ടിലുള്ളവരെയൊക്കെയും തന്റെ ആടുമാടുകളെയും സകലമൃഗങ്ങളെയും കനാൻ ദേശത്തു സമ്പാദിച്ച സമ്പത്തൊക്കെയും കൊണ്ടു തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യാക്കോബിന്റെ സമീപത്തുനിന്നു ദൂരെ ഒരു ദേശത്തേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the members of his household, as well as his livestock and all his other animals and all the goods he had acquired in Canaan, and moved to a land some distance from his brother Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the persons of his household, his cattle and all his animals, and all his goods which he had gained in the land of Canaan, and went to a country away from the presence of his brother Jacob.
chapters.kjv: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു ഒന്നിച്ചു പാർപ്പാൻ വഹിയാതവണ്ണം അവരുടെ സമ്പത്തു അധികമായിരുന്നു; അവരുടെ ആടുമാടുകൾ ഹേതുവായി അവർ പരദേശികളായി പാർത്തിരുന്ന ദേശത്തിന്നു അവരെ വഹിച്ചുകൂടാതെയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their possessions were too great for them to remain together; the land where they were staying could not support them both because of their livestock.
chapters.nkjv: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land where they were strangers could not support them because of their livestock.
chapters.kjv: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ എദോം എന്നും പേരുള്ള ഏശാവ് സേയീർ പർവ്വതത്തിൽ കുടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.
chapters.nkjv: So Esau dwelt in Mount Seir. Esau is Edom.
chapters.kjv: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

chapters.ml: സേയീർപർവ്വതത്തിലുള്ള എദോമ്യരുടെ പിതാവായ ഏശാവിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു:
chapters.niv: This is the account of the family line of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
chapters.nkjv: And this is the genealogy of Esau the father of the Edomites in Mount Seir.
chapters.kjv: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

chapters.ml: ഏശാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ ഇവ: ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ആദയുടെ മകൻ എലീഫാസ്; ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ബാസമത്തിന്റെ മകൻ രെയൂവേൽ.
chapters.niv: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.nkjv: These were the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, and Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
chapters.kjv: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

chapters.ml: എലീഫാസിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: തേമാൻ, ഓമാർ, സെഫോ, ഗത്ഥാം, കെനസ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

chapters.ml: തിമ്നാ എന്നവൾ ഏശാവിന്റെ മകനായ എലീഫാസിന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടി ആയിരുന്നു. അവൾ എലീഫാസിന്നു അമാലേക്കിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; ഇവർ ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ആദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Esau’s son Eliphaz also had a concubine named Timna, who bore him Amalek. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.
chapters.nkjv: Now Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, Esau’s son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These were the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
chapters.kjv: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.

chapters.ml: രെയൂവേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: നഹത്ത്, സേറഹ്, ശമ്മാ, മിസ്സാ; ഇവർ ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ബാസമത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
chapters.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

chapters.ml: സിബെയോന്റെ മകളായ അനയുടെ മകൾ ഒഹൊലീബാമാ എന്ന ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: അവൾ ഏശാവിന്നു യെയൂശ്, യലാം, കോരഹ് എന്നിവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon. And she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.
chapters.kjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ഏശാവിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ എലീഫാസിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: തേമാൻ പ്രഭു, ഓമാർപ്രഭു, സെഫോപ്രഭു, കെനസ്പ്രഭു,
chapters.niv: These were the chiefs among Esau’s descendants: The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
chapters.nkjv: These were the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn son of Esau, were Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz,
chapters.kjv: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

chapters.ml: കോരഹ്പ്രഭു, ഗത്ഥാംപ്രഭു, അമാലേക്പ്രഭു; ഇവർ ഏദോംദേശത്തു എലീഫാസിൽനിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിച്ച പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ; ഇവർ ആദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.
chapters.nkjv: Chief Korah, Chief Gatam, and Chief Amalek. These were the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. They were the sons of Adah.
chapters.kjv: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവിന്റെ മകനായ രെയൂവേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: നഹത്ത്പ്രഭു, സേരഹ്പ്രഭു, ശമ്മാപ്രഭു, മിസ്സാപ്രഭു, ഇവർ എദോംദേശത്തു രെയൂവേലിൽ നിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിച്ച പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ, ഇവർ ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യ ബാസമത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the chiefs descended from Reuel in Edom; they were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, and Chief Mizzah. These were the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
chapters.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ഒഹൊലീബാമയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: യെയൂശ്പ്രഭു, യലാംപ്രഭു, കോരഹ്പ്രഭു; ഇവർ അനയുടെ മകളായി ഏശാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ഒഹൊലീബാമയിൽ നിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിച്ച പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
chapters.nkjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife: Chief Jeush, Chief Jaalam, and Chief Korah. These were the chiefs whodescended from Aholibamah, Esau’s wife, the daughter of Anah.
chapters.kjv: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ എദോം എന്നും പേരുള്ള ഏശാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും അവരിൽനിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിച്ച പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these were their chiefs.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

chapters.ml: ഹോർയ്യനായ സേയീരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായി ദേശത്തിലെ പൂർവ്വനിവാസികളായവർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ലോതാൻ, ശോബാൽ, സിബെയോൻ,
chapters.niv: These were the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the region: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

chapters.ml: അനാ, ദീശോൻ, ഏസെർ, ദീശാൻ; ഇവർ എദോംദേശത്തു സേയീരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ഹോര്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These sons of Seir in Edom were Horite chiefs.
chapters.nkjv: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.
chapters.kjv: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

chapters.ml: ലോതാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഹോരിയും ഹേമാമും ആയിരുന്നു. ലോതാന്റെ സഹോദരി തിമ്നാ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.

chapters.ml: ശോബാലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: അൽവാൻ, മാനഹത്ത്, ഏബാൽ, ശെഫോ, ഓനാം.
chapters.niv: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

chapters.ml: സിബെയോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അയ്യാവും അനാവും ആയിരുന്നു; മരുഭൂമിയിൽ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ സിബെയോന്റെ കഴുതകളെ മേയ്ക്കുമ്പോൾ ചൂടുറവുകൾ കണ്ടെത്തിയ അനാ ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was grazing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Zibeon: both Ajah and Anah. This wasthe Anah who found the water in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
chapters.kjv: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

chapters.ml: അനാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ ഇവർ: ദീശോനും അനാവിന്റെ മകൾ ഒഹൊലീബാമയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
chapters.nkjv: These were the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

chapters.ml: ദീശോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ഹൊദാൻ, എശ്ബാൻ, യിത്രാൻ, കെരാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Dishon : Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Dishon:Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
chapters.kjv: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

chapters.ml: ഏസെരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ബിൽഹാൻ, സാവാൻ, അക്കാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
chapters.kjv: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

chapters.ml: ദീശാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഊസും അരാനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
chapters.kjv: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

chapters.ml: ഹോർയ്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ലോതാൻ പ്രഭു, ശോബാൽ പ്രഭു, സിബെയോൻ പ്രഭു, അനാപ്രഭു,
chapters.niv: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
chapters.nkjv: These were the chiefs of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,
chapters.kjv: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

chapters.ml: ദീശോൻ പ്രഭു, ഏസെർപ്രഭു, ദീശാൻ പ്രഭു, ഇവർ സേയീർദേശത്തു വാണ ഹോർയ്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.
chapters.nkjv: Chief Dishon, Chief Ezer, and Chief Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
chapters.kjv: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു രാജാവുണ്ടാകുംമുമ്പെ എദോംദേശത്തു വാണ രാജാക്കന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned:
chapters.nkjv: Now these were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel:
chapters.kjv: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ബെയോരിന്റെ പുത്രനായ ബേല എദോമിൽ രാജാവായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു ദിൻ ഹാബാ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Bela son of Beor became king of Edom. His city was named Dinhabah.
chapters.nkjv: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
chapters.kjv: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

chapters.ml: ബേല മരിച്ചശേഷം ബൊസ്രക്കാരനായ സേരഹിന്റെ മകൻ യോബാബ്, അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യോബാബ് മരിച്ച ശേഷം തേമാന്യദേശക്കാരനായ ഹൂശാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ഹൂശാം മരിച്ചശേഷം മോവാബ് സമഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു മിദ്യാനെ തോല്പിച്ച ബെദദിന്റെ മകൻ ഹദദ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി; അവന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു അവീത്ത് എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.
chapters.nkjv: And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who attacked Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
chapters.kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

chapters.ml: ഹദദ് മരിച്ച ശേഷം മസ്രേക്കക്കാരൻ സമ്ളാ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: സമ്ളാ മരിച്ചശേഷം നദീതീരത്തുള്ള രെഹോബോത്ത് പട്ടണക്കാരനായ ശൌൽ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: And when Samlah died, Saul of Rehoboth-by-the-River reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ശൊൽ മരിച്ചശേഷം അക്ബോരിന്റെ മകൻ ബാൽഹാനാൻ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: When Saul died, Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: അക്ബോരിന്റെ മകനായ ബാൽഹാനാൻ മരിച്ചശേഷം ഹദർ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി. അവന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പാവൂ എന്നു പേർ. അവന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു മെഹെതബേൽ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ മേസാഹാബിന്റെ മകളായ മത്രേദിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Baal-Hanan son of Akbor died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.
chapters.nkjv: And when Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor died, Hadar reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
chapters.kjv: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

chapters.ml: വംശംവംശമായും ദേശംദേശമായും പേരുപേരായും ഏശാവിൽ നിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിച്ച പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ ആവിതു: തിമ്നാ പ്രഭു, അൽവാ പ്രഭു, യെഥേത്ത് പ്രഭു, ഒഹൊലീബാമാ പ്രഭു,
chapters.niv: These were the chiefs descended from Esau, by name, according to their clans and regions: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
chapters.nkjv: And these were the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families and their places, by their names: Chief Timnah, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,
chapters.kjv: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

chapters.ml: ഏലാപ്രഭു, പീനോൻ പ്രഭു, കെനസ്പ്രഭു, തേമാൻ പ്രഭു;
chapters.niv: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
chapters.nkjv: Chief Aholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
chapters.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

chapters.ml: മിബ്സാർ പ്രഭു, മഗ്ദീയേൽ പ്രഭു, ഈരാംപ്രഭു;
chapters.niv: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
chapters.nkjv: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,
chapters.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

chapters.ml: ഇവർ താന്താങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശദേശത്തും വാസസ്ഥലങ്ങളിലും വാണ എദോമ്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ആകുന്നു; എദോമ്യരുടെ പിതാവു ഏശാവ് തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they occupied. This is the family line of Esau, the father of the Edomites.
chapters.nkjv: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession. Esau was the father of the Edomites.
chapters.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ പിതാവു പരദേശിയായി പാർത്ത ദേശമായ കനാൻ ദേശത്തു വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jacob lived in the land where his father had stayed, the land of Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob dwelt in the land where his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യം എന്തെന്നാൽ: യോസേഫിന്നു പതിനേഴുവയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ആടുകളെ മേയിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു ബാലനായി തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ഭാര്യമാരായ ബിൽഹയുടെയും സില്പയുടെയും പുത്രന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു അവരെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ദുഃശ്രുതി യോസേഫ് അപ്പനോടു വന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: This is the account of Jacob’s family line. Joseph, a young man of seventeen, was tending the flocks with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives, and he brought their father a bad report about them.
chapters.nkjv: This is the history of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. And the lad was with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives; and Joseph brought a bad report of them to his father.
chapters.kjv: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിലെ മകനാകകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേൽ എല്ലാമക്കളിലുംവെച്ചു അവനെ അധികം സ്നേഹിച്ചു ഒരു നിലയങ്കി അവന്നു ഉണ്ടാക്കിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he had been born to him in his old age; and he made an ornate robe for him.
chapters.nkjv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age. Also he made him a tunic of many colors.
chapters.kjv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൻ തങ്ങളെ എല്ലാവരെക്കാളും അവനെ അധികം സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവനെ പകെച്ചു; അവനോടു സമാധാനമായി സംസാരിപ്പാൻ അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
chapters.nkjv: But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him and could not speak peaceably to him.
chapters.kjv: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് ഒരു സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു; അതു തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു അറിയിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ അവനെ പിന്നെയും അധികം പകെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him all the more.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joseph had a dream, and he told it to his brothers; and they hated him even more.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ കണ്ട സ്വപ്നം കേട്ടുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Listen to this dream I had:
chapters.nkjv: So he said to them, "Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

chapters.ml: നാം വയലിൽ കറ്റകെട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; അപ്പോൾ എന്റെ കറ്റ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിവിർന്നുനിന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ കറ്റകൾ ചുറ്റും നിന്നു എന്റെ കറ്റയെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: We were binding sheaves of grain out in the field when suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around mine and bowed down to it."
chapters.nkjv: There we were, binding sheaves in the field. Then behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and indeed your sheaves stood all around and bowed down to my sheaf."
chapters.kjv: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ അവനോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവാകുമോ? നീ ഞങ്ങളെ വാഴുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, അവന്റെ സ്വപ്നങ്ങൾ നിമിത്തവും അവന്റെ വാക്കുനിമിത്തവും അവനെ പിന്നെയും അധികം ദ്വേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: His brothers said to him, "Do you intend to reign over us? Will you actually rule us?" And they hated him all the more because of his dream and what he had said.
chapters.nkjv: And his brothers said to him, "Shall you indeed reign over us? Or shall you indeed have dominion over us?" So they hated him even more for his dreams and for his words.
chapters.kjv: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മറ്റൊരു സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു അറിയിച്ചു: ഞാൻ പിന്നെയും ഒരു സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു; സൂര്യനും ചന്ദ്രനും പതിനൊന്നു നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളും എന്നെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he had another dream, and he told it to his brothers. "Listen," he said, "I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me."
chapters.nkjv: Then he dreamed still another dream and told it to his brothers, and said, "Look, I have dreamed another dream. And this time, the sun, the moon, and the eleven stars bowed down to me."
chapters.kjv: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതു അപ്പനോടും സഹോദരന്മാരോടും അറിയിച്ചപ്പോൾ അപ്പൻ അവനെ ശാസിച്ചു അവനോടു: നീ ഈ കണ്ട സ്വപ്നം എന്തു? ഞാനും നിന്റെ അമ്മയും നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നിന്നെ നമസ്കരിപ്പാൻ വരുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he told his father as well as his brothers, his father rebuked him and said, "What is this dream you had? Will your mother and I and your brothers actually come and bow down to the ground before you?"
chapters.nkjv: So he told it to his father and his brothers; and his father rebuked him and said to him, "What is this dream that you have dreamed? Shall your mother and I and your brothers indeed come to bow down to the earth before you?"
chapters.kjv: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു അവനോടു അസൂയ തോന്നി; അപ്പനോ ഈ വാക്കു മനസ്സിൽ സംഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.
chapters.nkjv: And his brothers envied him, but his father kept the matter inmind.
chapters.kjv: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ അപ്പന്റെ ആടുകളെ മേയ്പാൻ ശെഖേമിൽ പോയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father’s flocks near Shechem,
chapters.nkjv: Then his brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
chapters.kjv: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ യോസേഫിനോടു: നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ ശെഖേമിൽ ആടുമേയിക്കുന്നുണ്ടല്ലോ; വരിക, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു അവൻ അവനോടു: ഞാൻ പോകാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and Israel said to Joseph, "As you know, your brothers are grazing the flocks near Shechem. Come, I am going to send you to them." "Very well," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: And Israel said to Joseph, "Are not your brothers feeding theflock in Shechem? Come, I will send you to them." So he said to him, "Here I am."
chapters.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: നീ ചെന്നു നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു സുഖം തന്നേയോ? ആടുകൾ നന്നായിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു നോക്കി, വന്നു വസ്തുത അറിയിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഹെബ്രോൻ താഴ്വരയിൽ നിന്നു അവനെ അയച്ചു; അവൻ ശെഖേമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: So he said to him, "Go and see if all is well with your brothers and with the flocks, and bring word back to me." Then he sent him off from the Valley of Hebron. When Joseph arrived at Shechem,
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to him, "Please go and see if it is well with your brothers and well with the flocks, and bring back word to me." So he sent him out of the Valley of Hebron, and he went to Shechem.
chapters.kjv: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തു ചുറ്റിനടക്കുന്നതു ഒരുത്തൻ കണ്ടു: നീ എന്തു അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: a man found him wandering around in the fields and asked him, "What are you looking for?"
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain man found him, and there he was, wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying, "What are you seeking?"
chapters.kjv: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞാൻ എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; അവർ എവിടെ ആടു മേയിക്കുന്നു എന്നു എന്നോടു അറിയിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "I’m looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?"
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "I am seeking my brothers. Please tell me where they are feeding theirflocks."
chapters.kjv: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks .

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇവിടെ നിന്നു പോയി; നാം ദോഥാനിലേക്കു പോക എന്നു അവർ പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ യോസേഫ് തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ അന്വേഷിച്ചു ചെന്നു ദോഥാനിൽവെച്ചു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: "They have moved on from here," the man answered. "I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them near Dothan.
chapters.nkjv: And the man said, "They have departed from here, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’ " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan.
chapters.kjv: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ ദൂരത്തു നിന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവനെ കൊല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ അടുത്തുവരുംമുമ്പെ അവന്നു വിരോധമായി ദുരാലോചന ചെയ്തു:
chapters.niv: But they saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted to kill him.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they saw him afar off, even before he came near them, they conspired against him to kill him.
chapters.kjv: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

chapters.ml: അതാ, സ്വപ്നക്കാരൻ വരുന്നു; വരുവിൻ, നാം അവനെ കൊന്നു ഒരു കുഴിയിൽ ഇട്ടുകളക;
chapters.niv: "Here comes that dreamer!" they said to each other.
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to one another, "Look, this dreamer is coming!
chapters.kjv: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദുഷ്ടമൃഗം അവനെ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറയാം; അവന്റെ സ്വപ്നങ്ങൾ എന്താകുമെന്നു നമുക്കു കാണാമല്ലോ എന്നു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Come now, let’s kill him and throw him into one of these cisterns and say that a ferocious animal devoured him. Then we’ll see what comes of his dreams."
chapters.nkjv: Come therefore, let us now kill him and cast him into some pit; and we shall say, ‘Some wild beast has devoured him.’ We shall see what will become of his dreams!"
chapters.kjv: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

chapters.ml: രൂബേൻ അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു: നാം അവന്നു ജീവഹാനി വരുത്തരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. "Let’s not take his life," he said.
chapters.nkjv: But Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands, and said, "Let us not kill him."
chapters.kjv: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു അവനെ വിടുവിച്ചു അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു പോകേണമെന്നു കരുതിക്കൊണ്ടു രൂബേൻ അവരോടു: രക്തം ചൊരിയിക്കരുതു; നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെമേൽ കൈ വെക്കാതെ മരുഭൂമിയിലുള്ള ആ കുഴിയിൽ അവനെ ഇടുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Don’t shed any blood. Throw him into this cistern here in the wilderness, but don’t lay a hand on him." Reuben said this to rescue him from them and take him back to his father.
chapters.nkjv: And Reuben said to them, "Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit which is in the wilderness, and do not lay a hand on him"—that he might deliver him out of their hands, and bring him back to his father.
chapters.kjv: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ്‌ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഉടുത്തിരുന്ന നിലയങ്കി അവർ ഊരി, അവനെ എടുത്തു ഒരു കുഴിയിൽ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the ornate robe he was wearing—
chapters.nkjv: So it came to pass, when Joseph had come to his brothers, that they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

chapters.ml: അതു വെള്ളമില്ലാത്ത പൊട്ടക്കുഴി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. The cistern was empty; there was no water in it.
chapters.nkjv: Then they took him and cast him into a pit. And the pit was empty; therewas no water in it.
chapters.kjv: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിപ്പാൻ ഇരുന്നപ്പോൾ തലപൊക്കി നോക്കി, ഗിലെയാദിൽനിന്നു സാമ്പ്രാണിയും സുഗന്ധപ്പശയും സന്നിനായകവും ഒട്ടകപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്ന യിശ്മായേല്യരുടെ ഒരു യാത്രക്കൂട്ടം വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: As they sat down to eat their meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with spices, balm and myrrh, and they were on their way to take them down to Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: And they sat down to eat a meal. Then they lifted their eyes and looked, and there was a company of Ishmaelites, coming from Gilead with their camels, bearing spices, balm, and myrrh, on their way to carry them down to Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു: നാം നമ്മുടെ സഹോദരനെ കൊന്നു അവന്റെ രക്തം മറെച്ചിട്ടു എന്തു ഉപകാരം?
chapters.niv: Judah said to his brothers, "What will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?
chapters.nkjv: So Judah said to his brothers, "What profit isthere if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
chapters.kjv: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

chapters.ml: വരുവിൻ, നാം അവനെ യിശ്മായേല്യർക്കു വില്ക്കുക; നാം അവന്റെ മേൽ കൈ വെക്കരുതു; അവൻ നമ്മുടെ സഹോദരനും നമ്മുടെ മാംസവുമല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവന്റെ സാഹോദരന്മാർ അതിന്നു സമ്മതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Come, let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood." His brothers agreed.
chapters.nkjv: Come and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him, for he is our brother and our flesh." And his brothers listened.
chapters.kjv: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

chapters.ml: മിദ്യാന്യകച്ചവടക്കാർ കടന്നുപോകുമ്പോൾ അവർ യോസേഫിനെ കുഴിയിൽനിന്നു വലിച്ചു കയറ്റി, യിശ്മായേല്യർക്കു ഇരുപതു വെള്ളിക്കാശിന്നു വിറ്റു. അവർ യോസേഫിനെ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: So when the Midianite merchants came by, his brothers pulled Joseph up out of the cistern and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: Then Midianite traders passed by; so thebrothers pulled Joseph up and lifted him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. And they took Joseph to Egypt.
chapters.kjv: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

chapters.ml: രൂബേൻ തിരികെ കുഴിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ യോസേഫ് കുഴിയിൽ ഇല്ല എന്നു കണ്ടു തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം കീറി,
chapters.niv: When Reuben returned to the cistern and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes.
chapters.nkjv: Then Reuben returned to the pit, and indeed Joseph was not in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
chapters.kjv: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: ബാലനെ കാണുന്നില്ലല്ലോ; ഞാൻ ഇനി എവിടെ പോകേണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He went back to his brothers and said, "The boy isn’t there! Where can I turn now?"
chapters.nkjv: And he returned to his brothers and said, "The lad is no more; and I, where shall I go?"
chapters.kjv: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ കൊന്നു, യോസേഫിന്റെ അങ്കി എടുത്തു രക്തത്തിൽ മുക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then they got Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.
chapters.nkjv: So they took Joseph’s tunic, killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the tunic in the blood.
chapters.kjv: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

chapters.ml: അവർ നിലയങ്കി തങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊടുത്തയച്ചു: ഇതു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു കണ്ടുകിട്ടി; ഇതു നിന്റെ മകന്റെ അങ്കിയോ അല്ലയോ എന്നു നോക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They took the ornate robe back to their father and said, "We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe."
chapters.nkjv: Then they sent the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father and said, "We have found this. Do you know whether it is your son’s tunic or not?"
chapters.kjv: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son’s coat or no.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതു തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞു: ഇതു എന്റെ മകന്റെ അങ്കി തന്നേ; ഒരു ദുഷ്ടമൃഗം അവനെ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു: യോസേഫിനെ പറിച്ചുകീറിപ്പോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He recognized it and said, "It is my son’s robe! Some ferocious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces."
chapters.nkjv: And he recognized it and said, "Itis my son’s tunic. A wild beast has devoured him. Without doubt Joseph is torn to pieces."
chapters.kjv: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് വസ്ത്രം കീറി, അരയിൽ രട്ടുശീല ചുറ്റി ഏറിയനാൾ തന്റെ മകനെച്ചൊല്ലി ദുഃഖിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു
chapters.niv: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and mourned for his son many days.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരും എല്ലാം അവനെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാൻ വന്നു; അവനോ ആശ്വാസം കൈക്കൊൾവാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ: ഞാൻ ദുഃഖത്തോടെ എന്റെ മകന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പാതാളത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങുമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഇങ്ങനെ അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All his sons and daughters came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. "No," he said, "I will continue to mourn until I join my son in the grave." So his father wept for him.
chapters.nkjv: And all his sons and all his daughters arose to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted, and he said, "For I shall go down into the grave to my son in mourning." Thus his father wept for him.
chapters.kjv: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മിദ്യാന്യർ അവനെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ഫറവോന്റെ ഒരു ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥനായി അകമ്പടി നായകനായ പോത്തീഫറിന്നു വിറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Midianites had sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
chapters.kjv: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, and captain of the guard.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ വിട്ടു ഹീരാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു അദുല്ലാമ്യന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു;
chapters.niv: At that time, Judah left his brothers and went down to stay with a man of Adullam named Hirah.
chapters.nkjv: It came to pass at that time that Judah departed from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite whose name was Hirah.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ശൂവാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു കനാന്യന്റെ മകളെ കണ്ടു; അവളെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and made love to her;
chapters.nkjv: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua, and he married her and went in to her.
chapters.kjv: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവന്നു ഏർ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.
chapters.nkjv: So she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Er.
chapters.kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പിന്നെയും ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവന്നു ഓനാൻ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.
chapters.nkjv: She conceived again and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.
chapters.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പിന്നെയും ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവന്നു ശേലാ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു. അവൾ ഇവനെ പ്രസവിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ കെസീബിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.
chapters.nkjv: And she conceived yet again and bore a son, and called his name Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
chapters.kjv: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ ഏരിന്നു താമാർ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു ഭാര്യയെ എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
chapters.kjv: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ ആദ്യജാതനായ ഏർ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടനായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ അവനെ മരിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.
chapters.nkjv: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord killed him.
chapters.kjv: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD ; and the LORD slew him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാ ഓനാനോടു: നിന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവളോടു ദേവരധർമ്മം അനുഷ്ഠിച്ചു, ജ്യേഷ്ഠന്റെ പേർക്കു സന്തതിയെ ഉളവാക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Judah said to Onan, "Sleep with your brother’s wife and fulfill your duty to her as a brother-in-law to raise up offspring for your brother."
chapters.nkjv: And Judah said to Onan, "Go in to your brother’s wife and marry her, and raise up an heir to your brother."
chapters.kjv: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആ സന്തതി തന്റേതായിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഓനാൻ അറികകൊണ്ടു ജ്യേഷ്ഠന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ ജ്യേഷ്ഠന്നു സന്തതിയെ കൊടുക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിലത്തു വീഴ്ത്തിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Onan knew that the child would not be his; so whenever he slept with his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to keep from providing offspring for his brother.
chapters.nkjv: But Onan knew that the heir would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in to his brother’s wife, that he emitted on the ground, lest he should give an heir to his brother.
chapters.kjv: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെയ്തതു യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ഇവനെയും മരിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: What he did was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death also.
chapters.nkjv: And the thing which he did displeased the Lord; therefore He killed him also.
chapters.kjv: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD : wherefore he slew him also.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ മരുമകളായ താമാരോടു: എന്റെ മകൻ ശേലാ പ്രാപ്തിയാകുവോളം നീ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വിധവയായി പാർക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; ഇവനും സഹോദരന്മാരെപ്പോലെ മരിച്ചുപോകരുതു എന്നു അവൻ വിചാരിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ താമാർ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽപോയി പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Judah then said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, "Live as a widow in your father’s household until my son Shelah grows up." For he thought, "He may die too, just like his brothers." So Tamar went to live in her father’s household.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law, "Remain a widow in your father’s house till my son Shelah is grown." For he said, "Lest he also die like his brothers." And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
chapters.kjv: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

chapters.ml: കുറെ കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ശൂവയുടെ മകൾ യെഹൂദയുടെ ഭാര്യ മരിച്ചു; യെഹൂദയുടെ ദുഃഖം മാറിയശേഷം അവൻ തന്റെ സ്നേഹിതൻ അദുല്ലാമ്യനായ ഹീരയോടുകൂടെ തന്റെ ആടുകളെ രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്ന അടിയന്തരത്തിന്നു പോയി.
chapters.niv: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had recovered from his grief, he went up to Timnah, to the men who were shearing his sheep, and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went with him.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the process of time the daughter of Shua, Judah’s wife, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
chapters.kjv: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അമ്മായപ്പൻ തന്റെ ആടുകളെ രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്ന അടിയന്തരത്തിന്നു തിമ്നെക്കു പോകുന്നു എന്നു താമാരിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When Tamar was told, "Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,"
chapters.nkjv: And it was told Tamar, saying, "Look, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep."
chapters.kjv: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

chapters.ml: ശേലാ പ്രാപ്തിയായിട്ടും തന്നെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തില്ല എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവൾ വൈധവ്യവസ്ത്രം മാറ്റിവെച്ചു, ഒരു മൂടുപടം മൂടി പുതെച്ചു തിമ്നെക്കു പോകുന്ന വഴിക്കുള്ള എനയീംപട്ടണത്തിന്റെ ഗോപുരത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: she took off her widow’s clothes, covered herself with a veil to disguise herself, and then sat down at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. For she saw that, though Shelah had now grown up, she had not been given to him as his wife.
chapters.nkjv: So she took off her widow’s garments, covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place which was on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given to him as a wife.
chapters.kjv: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ അവളെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവൾ മുഖം മൂടിയിരുന്നതു കൊണ്ടു ഒരു വേശ്യ എന്നു നിരൂപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
chapters.nkjv: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a harlot, because she had covered her face.
chapters.kjv: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വഴിയരികെ അവളുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞുതന്റെ മരുമകൾ എന്നു അറിയാതെ: വരിക, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നതിന്നു നീ എനിക്കു എന്തു തരും എന്നു അവൾ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her by the roadside and said, "Come now, let me sleep with you." "And what will you give me to sleep with you?" she asked.
chapters.nkjv: Then he turned to her by the way, and said, "Please let me come in to you"; for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. So she said, "What will you give me, that you may come in to me?"
chapters.kjv: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒരു കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ നിനക്കു കൊടുത്തയക്കാം എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. നീ കൊടുത്തയക്കുവോളത്തിന്നു ഒരു പണയം തരുമോ എന്നു അവൾ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "I’ll send you a young goat from my flock," he said. "Will you give me something as a pledge until you send it?" she asked.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "I will send a young goat from the flock." So she said, "Will you give me a pledge till you send it?"
chapters.kjv: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it ?

chapters.ml: എന്തു പണയം തരേണം എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു നിന്റെ മുദ്രമോതിരവും മോതിരച്ചരടും നിന്റെ കയ്യിലെ വടിയും എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു. ഇവ അവൾക്കു കൊടുത്തു, അവൻ അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; അവൾ ഗർഭം ധരിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He said, "What pledge should I give you?" "Your seal and its cord, and the staff in your hand," she answered. So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "What pledge shall I give you?" So she said, "Your signet and cord, and your staff that is in your hand." Then he gave them to her, and went in to her, and she conceived by him.
chapters.kjv: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പോയി, തന്റെ മൂടുപടം നീക്കി വൈധവ്യവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow’s clothes again.
chapters.nkjv: So she arose and went away, and laid aside her veil and put on the garments of her widowhood.
chapters.kjv: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീയുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു പണയം മടക്കിവാങ്ങേണ്ടതിന്നു യെഹൂദാ അദുല്ലാമ്യനായ സ്നേഹിതന്റെ കൈവശം ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ കൊടുത്തയച്ചു; അവൻ അവളെ കണ്ടില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite in order to get his pledge back from the woman, but he did not find her.
chapters.nkjv: And Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand, but he did not find her.
chapters.kjv: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തെ ആളുകളോടു: ഏനയീമിൽ വഴിയരികെ ഇരുന്ന വേശ്യ എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഇവിടെ ഒരു വേശ്യയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He asked the men who lived there, "Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?" "There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here," they said.
chapters.nkjv: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, "Where is the harlot who was openly by the roadside?" And they said, "There was no harlot in this place."
chapters.kjv: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place .

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹൂദയുടെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നു: ഞാൻ അവളെ കണ്ടില്ല; ഈ സ്ഥലത്തു ഒരു വേശ്യയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല എന്നു അവിടെയുള്ള ആളുകൾ പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: So he went back to Judah and said, "I didn’t find her. Besides, the men who lived there said, ‘There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here.’ "
chapters.nkjv: So he returned to Judah and said, "I cannot find her. Also, the men of the place said there was no harlot in this place."
chapters.kjv: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാ നമുക്കു അപകീർത്തി ഉണ്ടാകാതിരിപ്പാൻ അവൾ അതു എടുത്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ; ഞാൻ ഈ ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ കൊടുത്തയച്ചുവല്ലോ; നീ അവളെ കണ്ടില്ലതാനും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Judah said, "Let her keep what she has, or we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you didn’t find her."
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah said, "Let her take them for herself, lest we be shamed; for I sent this young goat and you have not found her."
chapters.kjv: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

chapters.ml: ഏകദേശം മൂന്നുമാസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു: നിന്റെ മരുമകൾ താമാർ പരസംഗംചെയ്തു, പരസംഗത്താൽ ഗർഭിണിയായിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യെഹൂദെക്കു അറിവുകിട്ടി. അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാ: അവളെ പുറത്തുകൊണ്ടു വരുവിൻ; അവളെ ചുട്ടുകളയേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: About three months later Judah was told, "Your daughter-in-law Tamar is guilty of prostitution, and as a result she is now pregnant." Judah said, "Bring her out and have her burned to death!"
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, about three months after, that Judah was told, saying, "Tamar your daughter-in-law has played the harlot; furthermore she is with child by harlotry." So Judah said, "Bring her out and let her be burned!"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

chapters.ml: അവളെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നപ്പോൾ അവൾ അമ്മായപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: ഇവയുടെ ഉടമസ്ഥനായ പുരുഷനാൽ ആകുന്നു ഞാൻ ഗർഭിണിയായിരിക്കുന്നതു; ഈ മുദ്രമോതിരവും മോതിരച്ചരടും വടിയും ആർക്കുള്ളതു എന്നു നോക്കി അറിയേണം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As she was being brought out, she sent a message to her father-in-law. "I am pregnant by the man who owns these," she said. And she added, "See if you recognize whose seal and cord and staff these are."
chapters.nkjv: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, "By the man to whom these belong, I am with child." And she said, "Please determine whose these are—the signet and cord, and staff."
chapters.kjv: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ അവയെ അറിഞ്ഞു: അവൾ എന്നിലും നീതിയുള്ളവൾ; ഞാൻ അവളെ എന്റെ മകൻ ശേലാവിന്നു കൊടുത്തില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതിൽ പിന്നെ അവളെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Judah recognized them and said, "She is more righteous than I, since I wouldn’t give her to my son Shelah." And he did not sleep with her again.
chapters.nkjv: So Judah acknowledged them and said, "She has been more righteous than I, because I did not give her to Shelah my son." And he never knew her again.
chapters.kjv: And Judah acknowledged them , and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

chapters.ml: അവൾക്കു പ്രസവകാലം ആയപ്പോൾ അവളുടെ ഗർഭത്തിൽ ഇരട്ടപ്പിള്ളകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, at the time for giving birth, that behold, twins were in her womb.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പ്രസവിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒരു പിള്ള കൈ പുറത്തു നീട്ടി; അപ്പോൾ സൂതികർമ്മിണി ഒരു ചുവന്ന നൂൽ എടുത്തു അവന്റെ കൈക്കു കെട്ടി; ഇവൻ ആദ്യം പുറത്തുവന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his wrist and said, "This one came out first."
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when she was giving birth, that theone put out his hand; and the midwife took a scarlet thread and bound it on his hand, saying, "This one came out first."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

chapters.ml: അവനോ കൈ പിന്നെയും അകത്തേക്കു വലിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ പുറത്തുവന്നു: നീ ഛിദ്രം ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതു എന്തു എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു. അതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു പെരെസ്സ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: But when he drew back his hand, his brother came out, and she said, "So this is how you have broken out!" And he was named Perez.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, as he drew back his hand, that his brother came out unexpectedly; and she said, "How did you break through? This breach be upon you!" Therefore his name was called Perez.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം കൈമേൽ ചുവന്ന നൂലുള്ള അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ പുറത്തുവന്നു; അവന്നു സേരഹ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then his brother, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, came out. And he was named Zerah.
chapters.nkjv: Afterward his brother came out who had the scarlet thread on his hand. And his name was called Zerah.
chapters.kjv: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോസേഫിനെ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവനെ അവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവന്ന യിശ്മായേല്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഫറവോന്റെ ഒരു ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥനായി അകമ്പടിനായകനായ പോത്തീഫർ എന്ന ഒരു മിസ്രയീമ്യൻ അവനെ വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. Potiphar, an Egyptian who was one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. And Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him down there.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോസേഫിനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ കൃതാർത്ഥനായി, മിസ്രയീമ്യനായ യജമാനന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord was with Joseph, and he was a successful man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നും അവൻ ചെയ്യുന്നതൊക്കെയും യഹോവ സാധിപ്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നും അവന്റെ യജമാനൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord gave him success in everything he did,
chapters.nkjv: And his master saw that the Lordwas with him and that the Lord made all he did to prosper in his hand.
chapters.kjv: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യോസേഫ്‌ അവന്നു ഇഷ്ടനായി ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്തു; അവൻ അവനെ ഗൃഹവിചാരകനാക്കി, തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph found favor in his eyes and became his attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household, and he entrusted to his care everything he owned.
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph found favor in his sight, and served him. Then he made him overseer of his house, and all that he had he put under his authority.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നും തനിക്കുള്ള സകലത്തിന്നും അവനെ വിചാരകനാക്കിയതുമുതൽ യഹോവ യോസേഫിന്റെ നിമിത്തം മിസ്രയീമ്യന്റെ വീട്ടിനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു; വീട്ടിലും വയലിലും അവന്നുള്ള സകലത്തിന്മേലും യഹോവയുടെ അനുഗ്രഹം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: From the time he put him in charge of his household and of all that he owned, the Lord blessed the household of the Egyptian because of Joseph. The blessing of the Lord was on everything Potiphar had, both in the house and in the field.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, from the time that he had made him overseer of his house and all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the Lord was on all that he had in the house and in the field.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും യോസേഫിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; താൻ ഭക്ഷിക്കുന്ന ഭക്ഷണം ഒഴികെ അവന്റെ വൈശം ഉള്ള മറ്റു യാതൊന്നും അവൻ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: So Potiphar left everything he had in Joseph’s care; with Joseph in charge, he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,
chapters.nkjv: Thus he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand, and he did not know what he had except for the bread which he ate. Now Joseph was handsome in form and appearance.
chapters.kjv: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് കോമളനും മനോഹരരൂപിയും ആയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു യജമാനന്റെ ഭാര്യ യോസേഫിന്മേൽ കണ്ണു പതിച്ചു: എന്നോടുകൂടെ ശയിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and after a while his master’s wife took notice of Joseph and said, "Come to bed with me!"
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass after these things that his master’s wife cast longing eyes on Joseph, and she said, "Lie with me."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിന്നു സമ്മതിക്കാതെ യജമാനന്റെ ഭാര്യയോടു: ഇതാ, വീട്ടിൽ എന്റെ കൈവശമുള്ള യാതൊന്നും എന്റെ യജമാനൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല; തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But he refused. "With me in charge," he told her, "my master does not concern himself with anything in the house; everything he owns he has entrusted to my care.
chapters.nkjv: But he refused and said to his master’s wife, "Look, my master does not know what is with me in the house, and he has committed all that he has to my hand.
chapters.kjv: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

chapters.ml: ഈ വീട്ടിൽ എന്നെക്കാൾ വലിയവനില്ല; നീ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയാകയാൽ നിന്നെയല്ലാതെ മറ്റു യാതൊന്നും അവൻ എനിക്കു വിരോധിച്ചിട്ടുമില്ല; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ ഈ മഹാദോഷം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു ദൈവത്തോടു പാപം ചെയ്യുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: No one is greater in this house than I am. My master has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How then could I do such a wicked thing and sin against God?"
chapters.nkjv: Thereis no one greater in this house than I, nor has he kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?"
chapters.kjv: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

chapters.ml: അവൾ ദിനം പ്രതിയും യോസേഫിനോടു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടും അവളോടുകൂടെ ശയിപ്പാനോ അവളുടെ അരികെ ഇരിപ്പാനോ അവൻ അവളെ അനുസരിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: And though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be with her.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he did not heed her, to lie with her or to be with her.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദിവസം അവൻ തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്‍വാൻ വീട്ടിന്നകത്തു ചെന്നു; വീട്ടിലുള്ളവർ ആരും അവിടെ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.
chapters.nkjv: But it happened about this time, when Joseph went into the house to do his work, and none of the men of the house was inside,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം പിടിച്ചു: എന്നോടു കൂടെ ശയിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു: എന്നാൽ അവൻ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം അവളുടെ കയ്യിൽ വിട്ടേച്ചു പുറത്തേക്കു ഓടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She caught him by his cloak and said, "Come to bed with me!" But he left his cloak in her hand and ran out of the house.
chapters.nkjv: that she caught him by his garment, saying, "Lie with me." But he left his garment in her hand, and fled and ran outside.
chapters.kjv: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വസ്ത്രം തന്റെ കയ്യിൽ വിട്ടേച്ചു പുറത്തേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ,
chapters.niv: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and fled outside,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

chapters.ml: അവൾ വീട്ടിലുള്ളവരെ വിളിച്ചു അവരോടു: കണ്ടോ, നമ്മെ ഹാസ്യമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ഒരു എബ്രായനെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ എന്നോടുകൂടെ ശയിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: she called her household servants. "Look," she said to them, "this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us! He came in here to sleep with me, but I screamed.
chapters.nkjv: that she called to the men of her house and spoke to them, saying, "See, he has brought in to us a Hebrew to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried out with a loud voice.
chapters.kjv: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വിട്ടേച്ചു ഓടി പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when he heard that I lifted my voice and cried out, that he left his garment with me, and fled and went outside."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ വീട്ടിൽ വരുവോളം അവൾ ആ വസ്ത്രം തന്റെ പക്കൽ വെച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.
chapters.nkjv: So she kept his garment with her until his master came home.
chapters.kjv: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു അവൾ അവ്വണ്ണം തന്നേ സംസാരിച്ചു: നീ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്ന എബ്രായദാസൻ എന്നെ ഹാസ്യമാക്കുവാൻ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then she told him this story: "That Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me.
chapters.nkjv: Then she spoke to him with words like these, saying, "The Hebrew servant whom you brought to us came in to me to mock me;
chapters.kjv: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വിട്ടേച്ചു പുറത്തേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But as soon as I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."
chapters.nkjv: so it happened, as I lifted my voice and cried out, that he left his garment with me and fled outside."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദാസൻ ഇങ്ങനെ എന്നോടു ചെയ്തു എന്നു തന്റെ ഭാര്യ പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു യജമാനൻ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവന്നു കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചു.
