chapters.niv: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, "This is how your slave treated me," he burned with anger.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when his master heard the words which his wife spoke to him, saying, "Your servant did to me after this manner," that his anger was aroused.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ യജമാനൻ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു രാജാവിന്റെ ബദ്ധന്മാർ കിടക്കുന്ന കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ ആക്കി; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joseph’s master took him and put him in prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined. But while Joseph was there in the prison,
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph’s master took him and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were confined. And he was there in the prison.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ യോസേഫിനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു, കാരാഗൃഹപ്രമാണിക്കു അവനോടു ദയ തോന്നത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവന്നു കൃപ നല്കി.
chapters.niv: the Lord was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord was with Joseph and showed him mercy, and He gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
chapters.kjv: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

chapters.ml: കാരാഗൃഹത്തിലെ സകലബദ്ധന്മാരെയും കാരാഗൃഹപ്രമാണി യോസേഫിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കൊക്കെയും അവൻ വിചാരകനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.
chapters.nkjv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison; whatever they did there, it was his doing.
chapters.kjv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും സഫലമാക്കുകകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ കൈക്കീഴുള്ള യാതൊന്നും കാരാഗൃഹ പ്രമാണി നോക്കിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The warden paid no attention to anything under Joseph’s care, because the Lord was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.
chapters.nkjv: The keeper of the prison did not look into anything thatwas under Joseph’s authority, because the Lord was with him; and whatever he did, the Lord made it prosper.
chapters.kjv: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം മിസ്രയീം രാജാവിന്റെ പാനപാത്രവാഹകനും അപ്പക്കാരനും മിസ്രയീം രാജാവായ തങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനനോടു കുറ്റം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: It came to pass after these things that the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ പാനപാത്രവാഹകന്മാരുടെ പ്രമാണിയും അപ്പക്കാരുടെ പ്രമാണിയുമായ തന്റെ രണ്ടു ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥന്മാരോടു കോപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief butler and the chief baker.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

chapters.ml: അവരെ അകമ്പടിനായകന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ യോസേഫ് ബദ്ധനായി കിടന്ന കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined.
chapters.nkjv: So he put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the prison, the place where Joseph was confined.
chapters.kjv: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

chapters.ml: അകമ്പടിനായകൻ അവരെ യോസേഫിന്റെ പക്കൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവൻ അവർക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്തു; അവർ കുറെക്കാലം തടവിൽ കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he attended them. After they had been in custody for some time,
chapters.nkjv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them; so they were in custody for a while.
chapters.kjv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീം രാജാവിന്റെ പാനപാത്രവാഹകനും അപ്പക്കാരനും ഇങ്ങനെ കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ ബദ്ധന്മാരായിരുന്ന രണ്ടുപേരും ഒരു രാത്രിയിൽ തന്നേ വെവ്വേറെ അർത്ഥമുള്ള ഓരോ സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: each of the two men—the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were being held in prison—had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.
chapters.nkjv: Then the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were confined in the prison, had a dream, both of them, each man’s dream in one night and each man’s dream with its own interpretation.
chapters.kjv: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ യോസേഫ് അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ അവർ വിഷാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Joseph came to them the next morning, he saw that they were dejected.
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph came in to them in the morning and looked at them, and saw that they were sad.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യജമാനന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ തന്നോടുകൂടെ തടവിൽ കിടക്കുന്നവരായ ഫറവോന്റെ ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു വിഷാദഭാവത്തോടിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he asked Pharaoh’s officials who were in custody with him in his master’s house, "Why do you look so sad today?"
chapters.nkjv: So he asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in the custody of his lord’s house, saying, "Why do you look so sad today?"
chapters.kjv: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു; വ്യാഖ്യാനിച്ചുതരുവാൻ ആരുമില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. യോസേഫ് അവരോടു: സ്വപ്നവ്യാഖ്യാനം ദൈവത്തിന്നുള്ളതല്ലയോ? അതു എന്നോടു പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "We both had dreams," they answered, "but there is no one to interpret them." Then Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams."
chapters.nkjv: And they said to him, "We each have had a dream, and thereis no interpreter of it." So Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell them to me, please."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them , I pray you.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പാനപാത്രവാഹകന്മാരുടെ പ്രമാണി യോസേഫിനെ തന്റെ സ്വപ്നം അറിയിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ ഇതാ, എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഒരു മുന്തിരി വള്ളി.
chapters.niv: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream. He said to him, "In my dream I saw a vine in front of me,
chapters.nkjv: Then the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, "Behold, in my dream a vine was before me,
chapters.kjv: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

chapters.ml: മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയിൽ മൂന്നു കൊമ്പു; അതു തളിർത്തു പൂത്തു; കുലകളിൽ മുന്തിരിങ്ങാ പഴുത്തു.
chapters.niv: and on the vine were three branches. As soon as it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters ripened into grapes.
chapters.nkjv: and in the vine were three branches; it was as though it budded, its blossoms shot forth, and its clusters brought forth ripe grapes.
chapters.kjv: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്റെ പാനപാത്രം എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഞാൻ മുന്തിരിപ്പഴം പറിച്ചു ഫറവോന്റെ പാനപാത്രത്തിൽ പിഴിഞ്ഞു: പാനപാത്രം ഫറവോന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into Pharaoh’s cup and put the cup in his hand."
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand."
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: അതിന്റെ അർത്ഥം ഇതാകുന്നു: മൂന്നു കൊമ്പു മൂന്നു ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: "This is what it means," Joseph said to him. "The three branches are three days.
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph said to him, "This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തിന്നകം ഫറവോൻ നിന്നെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു, വീണ്ടും നിന്റെ സ്ഥാനത്തു ആക്കും. നീ പാനപാത്രവാഹകനായി മുമ്പിലത്തെ പതിവു പോലെ ഫറവോന്റെ കയ്യിൽ പാനപാത്രം കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your position, and you will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you used to do when you were his cupbearer.
chapters.nkjv: Now within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your place, and you will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand according to the former manner, when you were his butler.
chapters.kjv: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ ശുഭമായിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ എന്നെ ഓർത്തു എന്നോടു ദയ ചെയ്തു ഫറവോനെ എന്റെ വസ്തുത ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു എന്നെ ഈ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: But when all goes well with you, remember me and show me kindness; mention me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison.
chapters.nkjv: But remember me when it is well with you, and please show kindness to me; make mention of me to Pharaoh, and get me out of this house.
chapters.kjv: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

chapters.ml: എന്നെ എബ്രായരുടെ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു കട്ടുകൊണ്ടുപോന്നതാകുന്നു; ഈ കുണ്ടറയിൽ എന്നെ ഇടേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ ഇവിടെയും യാതൊന്നും ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: I was forcibly carried off from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing to deserve being put in a dungeon."
chapters.nkjv: For indeed I was stolen away from the land of the Hebrews; and also I have done nothing here that they should put me into the dungeon."
chapters.kjv: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

chapters.ml: അർത്ഥം നല്ലതെന്നു അപ്പക്കാരുടെ പ്രമാണി കണ്ടിട്ടു യോസേഫിനോടു: ഞാനും സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ എന്റെ തലയിൽ വെളുത്ത അപ്പമുള്ള മൂന്നു കൊട്ട കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the chief baker saw that Joseph had given a favorable interpretation, he said to Joseph, "I too had a dream: On my head were three baskets of bread.
chapters.nkjv: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, "I also was in my dream, and there were three white baskets on my head.
chapters.kjv: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

chapters.ml: മേലത്തെ കൊട്ടയിൽ ഫറവോന്റെ വക അപ്പത്തരങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; പക്ഷികൾ എന്റെ തലയിലെ കൊട്ടയിൽ നിന്നു അവയെ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: In the top basket were all kinds of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head."
chapters.nkjv: In the uppermost basket were all kinds of baked goods for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head."
chapters.kjv: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോസേഫ്: അതിന്റെ അർത്ഥം ഇതാകുന്നു: മൂന്നു കൊട്ട മൂന്നു ദിവസം.
chapters.niv: "This is what it means," Joseph said. "The three baskets are three days.
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph answered and said, "This is the interpretation of it: The three baskets are three days.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തിന്നകം ഫറവോൻ നിന്റെ തല വെട്ടി നിന്നെ ഒരു മരത്തിന്മേൽ തൂക്കും; പക്ഷികൾ നിന്റെ മാംസം തിന്നുകളയും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and impale your body on a pole. And the birds will eat away your flesh."
chapters.nkjv: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head from you and hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from you."
chapters.kjv: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം നാളിൽ ഫറവോന്റെ തിരുനാളിൽ അവൻ തന്റെ സകലദാസന്മാർക്കും ഒരു വിരുന്നുകഴിച്ചു. തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ പാനപാത്ര വാഹകന്മാരുടെ പ്രമാണിയെയും അപ്പക്കാരുടെ പ്രമാണിയെയും ഓർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Now the third day was Pharaoh’s birthday, and he gave a feast for all his officials. He lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker in the presence of his officials:
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass on the third day, whichwas Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast for all his servants; and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

chapters.ml: പാനപാത്രവാഹകന്മാരുടെ പ്രമാണിയെ ഫറവോന്റെ കയ്യിൽ പാനപാത്രം കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വീണ്ടും അവന്റെ സ്ഥാനത്തു ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: He restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again put the cup into Pharaoh’s hand—
chapters.nkjv: Then he restored the chief butler to his butlership again, and he placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand.
chapters.kjv: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:

chapters.ml: അപ്പക്കാരുടെ പ്രമാണിയെയോ അവൻ തൂക്കിച്ചു; യോസേഫ് അർത്ഥം പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ തന്നെ.
chapters.niv: but he impaled the chief baker, just as Joseph had said to them in his interpretation.
chapters.nkjv: But he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
chapters.kjv: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും പാനപാത്രവാഹകന്മാരുടെ പ്രമാണി യോസേഫിനെ ഓർക്കാതെ അവനെ മറന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot him.
chapters.nkjv: Yet the chief butler did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
chapters.kjv: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം ഫറവോൻ ഒരു സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: When two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing by the Nile,
chapters.nkjv: Then it came to pass, at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh had a dream; and behold, he stood by the river.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നദീതീരത്തു നിന്നു. അപ്പോൾ രൂപഗുണവും മാംസപുഷ്ടിയുമുള്ള ഏഴു പശുനദിയിൽ നിന്നു കയറി, ഞാങ്ങണയുടെ ഇടയിൽ മേഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: when out of the river there came up seven cows, sleek and fat, and they grazed among the reeds.
chapters.nkjv: Suddenly there came up out of the river seven cows, fine looking and fat; and they fed in the meadow.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ പിന്നാലെ മെലിഞ്ഞും വിരൂപമായുമുള്ള വേറെ ഏഴു പശു നദിയിൽ നിന്നു കയറി, നദീതീരത്തു മറ്റേ പശുക്കളുടെ അരികെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: After them, seven other cows, ugly and gaunt, came up out of the Nile and stood beside those on the riverbank.
chapters.nkjv: Then behold, seven other cows came up after them out of the river, ugly and gaunt, and stood by the other cows on the bank of the river.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

chapters.ml: മെലിഞ്ഞും വിരൂപമായുമുള്ള പശുക്കൾ രൂപ ഗുണവും മാംസപുഷ്ടിയുമുള്ള ഏഴു പശുക്കളെ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു; അപ്പോൾ ഫറവോൻ ഉണർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.
chapters.nkjv: And the ugly and gaunt cows ate up the seven fine looking and fat cows. So Pharaoh awoke.
chapters.kjv: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും ഉറങ്ങി, രണ്ടാമതും ഒരു സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു; പുഷ്ടിയുള്ളതും നല്ലതുമായ ഏഴു കതിർ ഒരു തണ്ടിൽ നിന്നു പൊങ്ങി വന്നു.
chapters.niv: He fell asleep again and had a second dream: Seven heads of grain, healthy and good, were growing on a single stalk.
chapters.nkjv: He slept and dreamed a second time; and suddenly seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, plump and good.
chapters.kjv: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ പിന്നാലെ നേർത്തും കിഴക്കൻ കാറ്റിനാൽ കരിഞ്ഞുമിരിക്കുന്ന ഏഴു കതിർ പൊങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—thin and scorched by the east wind.
chapters.nkjv: Then behold, seven thin heads, blighted by the east wind, sprang up after them.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

chapters.ml: നേർത്ത ഏഴു കതിരുകൾ പുഷ്ടിയും മണിക്കരുത്തുമുള്ള ഏഴു കതിരുകളെ വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ ഫറവോൻ ഉണർന്നു, അതു സ്വപ്നം എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy, full heads. Then Pharaoh woke up; it had been a dream.
chapters.nkjv: And the seven thin heads devoured the seven plump and full heads. So Pharaoh awoke, and indeed, itwas a dream.
chapters.kjv: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

chapters.ml: പ്രാതഃകാലത്തു അവൻ വ്യാകുലപ്പെട്ടു മിസ്രയീമിലെ മന്ത്രവാദികളെയും ജ്ഞാനികളെയും എല്ലാം ആളയച്ചു വരുത്തി അവരോടു തന്റെ സ്വപ്നം പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ വ്യാഖ്യാനിപ്പാൻ ആർക്കും കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: In the morning his mind was troubled, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dreams, but therewas no one who could interpret them for Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പാനപാത്രവാഹകന്മാരുടെ പ്രമാണി ഫറവോനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇന്നു ഞാൻ എന്റെ കുറ്റം ഓർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, "Today I am reminded of my shortcomings.
chapters.nkjv: Then the chief butler spoke to Pharaoh, saying: "I remember my faults this day.
chapters.kjv: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ അടിയങ്ങളോടു കോപിച്ചു, എന്നെയും അപ്പക്കാരുടെ പ്രമാണിയെയും അകമ്പടിനായകന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ തടവിലാക്കിയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he imprisoned me and the chief baker in the house of the captain of the guard.
chapters.nkjv: When Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, both me and the chief baker,
chapters.kjv: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both me and the chief baker:

chapters.ml: അവിടെവെച്ചു ഞാനും അവനും ഒരു രാത്രിയിൽ തന്നേ സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു; വെവ്വേറെ അർത്ഥമുള്ള സ്വപ്നം ആയിരുന്നു ഓരോരുത്തൻ കണ്ടതു.
chapters.niv: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.
chapters.nkjv: we each had a dream in one night, he and I. Each of us dreamed according to the interpretation of his own dream.
chapters.kjv: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അകമ്പടി നായകന്റെ ദാസനായ ഒരു എബ്രായ യൌവനക്കാരൻ ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചാറെ അവൻ സ്വപ്നങ്ങളെ വ്യാഖ്യാനിച്ചു; ഓരോരുത്തന്നു താന്താന്റെ സ്വപ്നത്തിന്റെ അർത്ഥം പറഞ്ഞുതന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us, giving each man the interpretation of his dream.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a young Hebrew man with us there, a servant of the captain of the guard. And we told him, and he interpreted our dreams for us; to each man he interpreted according to his own dream.
chapters.kjv: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അർത്ഥം പറഞ്ഞതു പോലെ തന്നേ സംഭവിച്ചു; എന്നെ വീണ്ടും സ്ഥാനത്തു ആക്കുകയും മറ്റവനെ തൂക്കിക്കളകയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And things turned out exactly as he interpreted them to us: I was restored to my position, and the other man was impaled."
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, just as he interpreted for us, so it happened. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ഫറവോൻ ആളയച്ചു യോസേഫിനെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു. അവർ അവനെ വേഗത്തിൽ കുണ്ടറയിൽനിന്നു ഇറക്കി; അവൻ ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്യിച്ചു, വസ്ത്രം മാറി, ഫറവോന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was quickly brought from the dungeon. When he had shaved and changed his clothes, he came before Pharaoh.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him quickly out of the dungeon; and he shaved, changed his clothing, and came to Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിനോടു: ഞാൻ ഒരു സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടു; അതിനെ വ്യാഖ്യനിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ല; എന്നാൽ നീ ഒരു സ്വപ്നം കേട്ടാൽ വ്യാഖ്യാനിക്കുമെന്നു നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I have had a dream, and thereis no one who can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that you can understand a dream, to interpret it."
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോസേഫ് ഫറവോനോടു: ഞാനല്ല ദൈവം തന്നേ ഫറവോന്നു ശുഭമായോരു ഉത്തരം നല്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I cannot do it," Joseph replied to Pharaoh, "but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires."
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, "Itis not in me; God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ ഞാൻ നദീതീരത്തു നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph: "Behold, in my dream I stood on the bank of the river.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മാംസപുഷ്ടിയും രൂപഗുണവുമുള്ള ഏഴു പശു നദിയിൽനിന്നു കയറി ഞാങ്ങണയുടെ ഇടയിൽ മേഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: when out of the river there came up seven cows, fat and sleek, and they grazed among the reeds.
chapters.nkjv: Suddenly seven cows came up out of the river, fine looking and fat; and they fed in the meadow.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ പിന്നാലെ ക്ഷീണിച്ചും മെലിഞ്ഞും എത്രയും വിരൂപമായുമുള്ള വേറെ ഏഴു പശു കയറി വന്നു; അത്ര വിരൂപമായവയെ ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു എങ്ങും കണ്ടിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: After them, seven other cows came up—scrawny and very ugly and lean. I had never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: Then behold, seven other cows came up after them, poor and very ugly and gaunt, such ugliness as I have never seen in all the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മെലിഞ്ഞും വിരൂപമായുമുള്ള പശുക്കൾ പുഷ്ടിയുള്ള മുമ്പിലത്തെ ഏഴു പശുക്കളെ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.
chapters.nkjv: And the gaunt and ugly cows ate up the first seven, the fat cows.
chapters.kjv: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

chapters.ml: ഇവ അവയുടെ വയറ്റിൽ ചെന്നിട്ടും വയറ്റിൽ ചെന്നു എന്നു അറിവാനില്ലായിരന്നു; അവ മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ വിരൂപമുള്ളവ ആയിരുന്നു. അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ ഉണർന്നു.
chapters.niv: But even after they ate them, no one could tell that they had done so; they looked just as ugly as before. Then I woke up.
chapters.nkjv: When they had eaten them up, no one would have known that they had eaten them, for they were just as ugly as at the beginning. So I awoke.
chapters.kjv: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ഞാൻ സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ കണ്ടതു: നിറഞ്ഞതും നല്ലതുമായ ഏഴു കതിർ ഒരു തണ്ടിൽ പൊങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: "In my dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, growing on a single stalk.
chapters.nkjv: Also I saw in my dream, and suddenly seven heads came up on one stalk, full and good.
chapters.kjv: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ പിന്നാലെ ഉണങ്ങിയും നേർത്തും കിഴക്കൻ കാറ്റിനാൽ കരിഞ്ഞുമിരിക്കുന്ന ഏഴു കതിർ പൊങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: After them, seven other heads sprouted—withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.
chapters.nkjv: Then behold, seven heads, withered, thin, and blighted by the east wind, sprang up after them.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

chapters.ml: നേർത്ത കതിരുകൾ ഏഴു നല്ല കതിരുകളെ വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളഞ്ഞു. ഇതു ഞാൻ മന്ത്രവാദികളോടു പറഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ വ്യാഖ്യാനിപ്പാൻ ആർക്കും കഴഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads. I told this to the magicians, but none of them could explain it to me."
chapters.nkjv: And the thin heads devoured the seven good heads. So I told this to the magicians, but therewas no one who could explain it to me."
chapters.kjv: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോസേഫ് ഫറവോനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഫറവോന്റെ സ്വപ്നം ഒന്നുതന്നേ; താൻ ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നതു ദൈവം ഫറവോന്നു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one; God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do:
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു നല്ല പശു ഏഴു സംവത്സരം; നല്ല കതിരും ഏഴു സംവത്സരം; സ്വപ്നം ഒന്നു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream.
chapters.nkjv: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads are seven years; the dreams are one.
chapters.kjv: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ പിന്നാലെ കയറിവന്ന മെലിഞ്ഞും വിരൂപമായുമുള്ള ഏഴു പശുവും കിഴക്കൻ കാറ്റിനാൽ കരിഞ്ഞു പതിരായുള്ള ഏഴു കതിരും ഏഴു സംവത്സരം; അവ ക്ഷാമമുള്ള ഏഴു സംവത്സരം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The seven lean, ugly cows that came up afterward are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind: They are seven years of famine.
chapters.nkjv: And the seven thin and ugly cows which came up after them are seven years, and the seven empty heads blighted by the east wind are seven years of famine.
chapters.kjv: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നതു ഫറവോന്നു കാണിച്ചു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു അതാകുന്നു ഞാൻ ഫറവോനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: "It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
chapters.nkjv: This is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.
chapters.kjv: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു ഒക്കെയും ബഹു സുഭിക്ഷമായ ഏഴു സംവത്സരം വരും.
chapters.niv: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,
chapters.nkjv: Indeed seven years of great plenty will come throughout all the land of Egypt;
chapters.kjv: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

chapters.ml: അതു കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ക്ഷാമമുള്ള ഏഴു സംവത്സരം വരും; അപ്പോൾ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു ആ സുഭിക്ഷതയൊക്കെയും മറന്നിരിക്കും; ക്ഷാമത്താൽ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും ക്ഷയിച്ചുപോകും.
chapters.niv: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will ravage the land.
chapters.nkjv: but after them seven years of famine will arise, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine will deplete the land.
chapters.kjv: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

chapters.ml: പിൻവരുന്ന ക്ഷാമം അതികഠിനമായിരിക്കയാൽ ദേശത്തുണ്ടായിരുന്ന സുഭിക്ഷത അറിയാതെയായിപ്പോകും.
chapters.niv: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.
chapters.nkjv: So the plenty will not be known in the land because of the famine following, for it willbe very severe.
chapters.kjv: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്നു സ്വപ്നം രണ്ടുവട്ടം ഉണ്ടായതോ കാര്യം ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കകൊണ്ടും ദൈവം അതിനെ വേഗത്തിൽ വരുത്തുവാനിരിക്കകൊണ്ടും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.
chapters.nkjv: And the dream was repeated to Pharaoh twice because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
chapters.kjv: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഫറവോൻ വിവേകവും ജ്ഞാനവുമുള്ള ഒരുത്തനെ അന്വേഷിച്ചു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിന്നു മേലധികാരി ആക്കി വെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: "Now therefore, let Pharaoh select a discerning and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: അതുകൂടാതെ ഫറവോൻ ദേശത്തിന്മേൽ വിചാരകന്മാരെ ആക്കി, സുഭിക്ഷതയുള്ള ഏഴു സംവത്സരത്തിൽ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിലെ വിളവിൽ അഞ്ചിലൊന്നു വാങ്ങേണം.
chapters.niv: Let Pharaoh appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.
chapters.nkjv: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, to collect one-fifth oftheproduce of the land of Egypt in the seven plentiful years.
chapters.kjv: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

chapters.ml: ഈ വരുന്ന നല്ല സംവത്സരങ്ങളിലെ വിളവൊക്കെയും ശേഖരിച്ചു പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ ഫറവോന്റെ അധീനത്തിൽ ധാന്യം സൂക്ഷിച്ചുവെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: They should collect all the food of these good years that are coming and store up the grain under the authority of Pharaoh, to be kept in the cities for food.
chapters.nkjv: And let them gather all the food of those good years that are coming, and store up grain under the authority of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
chapters.kjv: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

chapters.ml: ആ ധാന്യം മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു വരുവാൻ പോകുന്ന ക്ഷാമമുള്ള ഏഴുസംവത്സരത്തേക്കു ദേശത്തിന്നു സംഗ്രഹമായിട്ടിരിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ ദേശം ക്ഷാമം കൊണ്ടു നശിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: This food should be held in reserve for the country, to be used during the seven years of famine that will come upon Egypt, so that the country may not be ruined by the famine."
chapters.nkjv: Then that food shall be as a reserve for the land for the seven years of famine which shall be in the land of Egypt, that the land may not perish during the famine."
chapters.kjv: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു ഫറവോന്നും അവന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാർക്കും ബോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials.
chapters.nkjv: So the advice was good in the eyes of Pharaoh and in the eyes of all his servants.
chapters.kjv: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു: ദൈവാത്മാവുള്ള ഈ മനുഷ്യനെപ്പോലെ ഒരുത്തനെ കണ്ടുകിട്ടുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Pharaoh asked them, "Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God ?"
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh said to his servants, "Can we find suchaone as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?"
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിനോടു: ദൈവം ഇതൊക്കെയും നിനക്കു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തി തന്നതു കൊണ്ടു നിന്നെപ്പോലെ വിവേകവും ജ്ഞാനവുമുള്ളവൻ ഒരുത്തനുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Inasmuch as God has shown you all this, thereis no one as discerning and wise as you.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു മേലധികാരിയാകും; നിന്റെ വാക്കു എന്റെ ജനമെല്ലാം അനുസരിച്ചു നടക്കും; സിംഹാസനംകൊണ്ടു മാത്രം ഞാൻ നിന്നെക്കാൾ വലിയവനായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you."
chapters.nkjv: You shall be over my house, and all my people shall be ruled according to your word; only in regard to the throne will I be greater than you."
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ നിന്നെ മേലധികാരി ആക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു, എന്നും ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I hereby put you in charge of the whole land of Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt."
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ തന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു മുദ്രമോതിരം ഊരി, യോസേഫിന്റെ കൈക്കു ഇട്ടു, അവനെ നേർമ്മയുള്ള വസ്ത്രംധരിപ്പിച്ചു, ഒരു സ്വർണ്ണസരപ്പളിയും അവന്റെ കഴുത്തിൽ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his finger and put it on Joseph’s finger. He dressed him in robes of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring off his hand and put it on Joseph’s hand; and he clothed him in garments of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

chapters.ml: തന്റെ രണ്ടാം രഥത്തിൽ അവനെ കയറ്റി: മുട്ടുകുത്തുവിൻ എന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വിളിച്ചു പറയിച്ചു; ഇങ്ങനെ അവനെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും മേലധികാരിയാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He had him ride in a chariot as his second-in-command, and people shouted before him, "Make way !" Thus he put him in charge of the whole land of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: And he had him ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried out before him, "Bow the knee!" So he set him over all the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിനോടു: ഞാൻ ഫറവോൻ ആകുന്നു; നിന്റെ കല്പന കൂടാതെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു എങ്ങും യാതൊരുത്തനും കയ്യോ കാലോ അനക്കുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, but without your word no one will lift hand or foot in all Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: Pharaoh also said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, and without your consent no man may lift his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt."
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിന്നു സാപ്നത്ത് പനേഹ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; ഓനിലെ പുരോഹിതനായ പോത്തിഫേറയുടെ മകൾ ആസ്നത്തിനെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു. പിന്നെ യോസേഫ് മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went throughout the land of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-Paaneah. And he gave him as a wife Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On. So Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ അവന്നു മുപ്പതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു യോസേഫ് ഫറവോന്റെ സന്നിധാനത്തിൽ നിന്നു പറപ്പെട്ടു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു ഒക്കെയും സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സുഭിക്ഷമായ ഏഴു സംവത്സരവും ദേശം സമൃദ്ധിയായി വിളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the seven plentiful years the ground brought forth abundantly.
chapters.kjv: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു സുഭിക്ഷത ഉണ്ടായ ഏഴു സംവത്സരത്തിലെ ധാന്യം ഒക്കെയും അവൻ ശേഖരിച്ചു പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു; ഓരോ പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചുറ്റുവട്ടത്തുള്ള നിലത്തിലെ ധാന്യം സൂക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph collected all the food produced in those seven years of abundance in Egypt and stored it in the cities. In each city he put the food grown in the fields surrounding it.
chapters.nkjv: So he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities; he laid up in every city the food of the fields which surrounded them.
chapters.kjv: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോസേഫ് കടൽകരയിലെ മണൽപോലെ എത്രയും വളരെ ധാന്യം ശേഖരിച്ചു വെച്ചു; അളപ്പാൻ കഴിവില്ലായ്കയാൽ അളവു നിർത്തിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure.
chapters.nkjv: Joseph gathered very much grain, as the sand of the sea, until he stopped counting, for itwas immeasurable.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷാമകാലം വരുംമുമ്പെ യോസേഫിന്നു രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിച്ചു; അവരെ ഓനിലെ പുരോഹിതനായ പോത്തിഫേറയുടെ മകൾ ആസ്നത്ത് പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
chapters.nkjv: And to Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On, bore to him.
chapters.kjv: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ സകല കഷ്ടതയും എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനം ഒക്കെയും ദൈവം എന്നെ മറക്കുമാറാക്കി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു യോസേഫ് തന്റെ ആദ്യജാതന്നു മനശ്ശെ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, "It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father’s household."
chapters.nkjv: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: "For God has made me forget all my toil and all my father’s house."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he , hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

chapters.ml: സങ്കടദേശത്തു ദൈവം എന്നെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, അവൻ രണ്ടാമത്തവന്നു എഫ്രയീം എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The second son he named Ephraim and said, "It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering."
chapters.nkjv: And the name of the second he called Ephraim: "For God has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction."
chapters.kjv: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുണ്ടായ സുഭിക്ഷതയുള്ള ഏഴു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,
chapters.nkjv: Then the seven years of plenty which were in the land of Egypt ended,
chapters.kjv: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ക്ഷാമമുള്ള ഏഴു സംവത്സരം തുടങ്ങി; സകലദേശങ്ങളിലും ക്ഷാമമുണ്ടായി; എന്നാൽ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു എല്ലാടവും ആഹാരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the other lands, but in the whole land of Egypt there was food.
chapters.nkjv: and the seven years of famine began to come, as Joseph had said. The famine was in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
chapters.kjv: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു എല്ലാടവും ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായപ്പോൾ ജനങ്ങൾ ആഹാരത്തിന്നായി ഫറവോനോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു; ഫറവോൻ മിസ്രയീമ്യരോടു ഒക്കെയും: നിങ്ങൾ യോസേഫിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; അവൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുംപോലെ ചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When all Egypt began to feel the famine, the people cried to Pharaoh for food. Then Pharaoh told all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph and do what he tells you."
chapters.nkjv: So when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. Then Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph; whatever he says to you, do."
chapters.kjv: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷാമം ഭൂതലത്തിലൊക്കെയും ഉണ്ടായി; യോസേഫ് പാണ്ടികശാലകൾ ഒക്കെയും തുറന്നു, മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു ധാന്യം വിറ്റു; ക്ഷാമം മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തും കഠിനമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the famine had spread over the whole country, Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: The famine was over all the face of the earth, and Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold to the Egyptians. And the famine became severe in the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ എങ്ങും ക്ഷാമം കഠിനമായയ്തീർന്നതുകൊണ്ടു സകലദേശക്കാരും ധാന്യം കൊള്ളുവാൻ മിസ്രയീമിൽ യോസേഫിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: And all the world came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe everywhere.
chapters.nkjv: So all countries came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all lands.
chapters.kjv: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ ധാന്യം ഉണ്ടെന്നു യാക്കോബ് അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ നോക്കിനില്ക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, "Why do you just keep looking at each other?"
chapters.nkjv: When Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, Jacob said to his sons, "Why do you look at one another?"
chapters.kjv: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ ധാന്യം ഉണ്ടെന്നു ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; നാം മരിക്കാതെ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവിടെ ചെന്നു അവിടെ നിന്നു നമുക്കു ധാന്യം കൊള്ളുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He continued, "I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Indeed I have heard that there is grain in Egypt; go down to that place and buy for us there, that we may live and not die."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ പത്തുപേർ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ധാന്യം കൊള്ളുവാൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോസേഫിന്റെ അനുജനായ ബെന്യാമീന്നു പക്ഷേ വല്ല ആപത്തും ഭവിക്കും എന്നുവെച്ചു യാക്കോബ് അവനെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടുകൂടെ അയച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with the others, because he was afraid that harm might come to him.
chapters.nkjv: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, "Lest some calamity befall him."
chapters.kjv: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ധാന്യം കൊള്ളുവാൻ വന്നവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും വന്നു; കനാൻ ദേശത്തും ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: So Israel’s sons were among those who went to buy grain, for there was famine in the land of Canaan also.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Israel went to buy grain among those who journeyed, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് ദേശത്തിന്നു അധിപതിയായിരുന്നു; അവൻ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു ദേശത്തിലെ സകല ജനങ്ങൾക്കും ധാന്യം വിറ്റതു; യോസേഫിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും വന്നു അവനെ സാഷ്ടാംഗം നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Joseph was the governor of the land, the person who sold grain to all its people. So when Joseph’s brothers arrived, they bowed down to him with their faces to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joseph was governor over the land; and it was he who sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brothers came and bowed down before him with their faces to the earth.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ്‌ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ കണ്ടാറെ അവരെ അറിഞ്ഞു എങ്കിലും അറിയാത്ത ഭാവം നടിച്ചു അവരോടു കഠിനമായി സംസാരിച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾ എവിടെ നിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ആഹാരം കൊള്ളുവാൻ കനാൻ ദേശത്തു നിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. "Where do you come from?" he asked. "From the land of Canaan," they replied, "to buy food."
chapters.nkjv: Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he acted as a stranger to them and spoke roughly to them. Then he said to them, "Where do you come from?" And they said, "From the land of Canaan to buy food."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ്‌ സഹോദരന്മാരെ അറിഞ്ഞു എങ്കിലും അവർ അവനെ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അവരെക്കുറിച്ചു കണ്ടിരുന്ന സ്വപ്നങ്ങൾ ഓർത്തു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റുകാരാകുന്നു; ദേശത്തിന്റെ ദുർബ്ബലഭാഗം നോക്കുവാൻ നിങ്ങൾ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph remembered the dreams which he had dreamed about them, and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land!"
chapters.kjv: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: അല്ല, യജമാനനേ, അടിയങ്ങൾ ആഹാരം കൊള്ളുവാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: "No, my lord," they answered. "Your servants have come to buy food.
chapters.nkjv: And they said to him, "No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും ഒരാളുടെ മക്കൾ; ഞങ്ങൾ പരമാർത്ഥികളാകുന്നു; അടിയങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റുകാരല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies."
chapters.nkjv: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men; your servants are not spies."
chapters.kjv: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men , thy servants are no spies.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: അല്ല, നിങ്ങൾ ദേശത്തിന്റെ ദുർബ്ബലഭാഗം നോക്കുവാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "No!" he said to them. "You have come to see where our land is unprotected."
chapters.nkjv: But he said to them, "No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: അടിയങ്ങൾ കനാൻ ദേശത്തുള്ള ഒരാളുടെ മക്കൾ; പന്ത്രണ്ടു സഹോദരന്മാർ ആകുന്നു; ഇളയവൻ ഇന്നു ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഉണ്ടു; ഒരുത്തൻ ഇപ്പോൾ ഇല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they replied, "Your servants were twelve brothers, the sons of one man, who lives in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more."
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and in fact, the youngest is with our father today, and one is no more."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ നിങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റുകാർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Joseph said to them, "It is just as I told you: You are spies!
chapters.nkjv: But Joseph said to them, "It is as I spoke to you, saying, ‘You are spies!’
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

chapters.ml: ഇതിനാൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ പരീക്ഷിക്കും; നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇളയസഹോദരൻ ഇവിടെ വന്നല്ലാതെ, ഫറവോനാണ, നിങ്ങൾ ഇവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
chapters.nkjv: In this manner you shall be tested: By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
chapters.kjv: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരനെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ അയപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളോ ബദ്ധന്മാരായിരിക്കേണം; നിങ്ങൾ നേരുള്ളവരോ എന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ വാക്കു പരീക്ഷിച്ചറിയാമല്ലോ; അല്ലെന്നുവരികിൽ; ഫറവോനാണ, നിങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റുകാർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are telling the truth. If you are not, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!"
chapters.nkjv: Send one of you, and let him bring your brother; and you shall be kept in prison, that your words may be tested to see whether thereis any truth in you; or else, by the life of Pharaoh, surely you are spies!"
chapters.kjv: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അവരെ മൂന്നു ദിവസം തടവിൽ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: And he put them all in custody for three days.
chapters.nkjv: So he put them all together in prison three days.
chapters.kjv: And he put them all together into ward three days.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം ദിവസം യോസേഫ് അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇതു ചെയ്‍വിൻ:
chapters.niv: On the third day, Joseph said to them, "Do this and you will live, for I fear God:
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph said to them the third day, "Do this and live, for I fear God:
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പരമാർത്ഥികൾ എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഒരു സഹോദരൻ കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ കിടക്കട്ടെ; നിങ്ങൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു, നിങ്ങളുടെ വീടുകളിലെ ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടിന്നു ധാന്യം കൊണ്ടുപോകുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers stay here in prison, while the rest of you go and take grain back for your starving households.
chapters.nkjv: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers be confined to your prison house; but you, go and carry grain for the famine of your houses.
chapters.kjv: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇളയസഹോദരനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം; അതിനാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ വാക്കു നേരെന്നു തെളിയും; നിങ്ങൾ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവരികയില്ല; അവർ അങ്ങനെ സമ്മതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But you must bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified and that you may not die." This they proceeded to do.
chapters.nkjv: And bring your young est brother to me; so your words will be verified, and you shall not die." And they did so.
chapters.kjv: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

chapters.ml: ഇതു നമ്മുടെ സഹോദരനോടു നാം ചെയ്ത ദ്രോഹമാകുന്നു; അവൻ നമ്മോടു കെഞ്ചിയപ്പോൾ നാം അവന്റെ പ്രാണസങ്കടം കണ്ടാറെയും അവന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടില്ലല്ലോ; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഈ സങ്കടം നമുക്കു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവർ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They said to one another, "Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that’s why this distress has come on us."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to one another, "We are truly guilty concerning our brother, for we saw the anguish of his soul when he pleaded with us, and we would not hear; therefore this distress has come upon us."
chapters.kjv: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു രൂബേൻ: ബാലനോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്യരുതെന്നും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞില്ലയോ? എന്നിട്ടും നിങ്ങൾ കേട്ടില്ല; ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, അവന്റെ രക്തം നമ്മോടു ചോദിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Reuben replied, "Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn’t listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood."
chapters.nkjv: And Reuben answered them, saying, "Did I not speak to you, saying, ‘Do not sin against the boy’; and you would not listen? Therefore behold, his blood is now required of us."
chapters.kjv: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചതു ദ്വിഭാഷിമുഖാന്തരം ആയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ഇതു ഗ്രഹിച്ചു എന്നു അവർ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: They did not realize that Joseph could understand them, since he was using an interpreter.
chapters.nkjv: But they did not know that Joseph understood them, for he spoke to them through an interpreter.
chapters.kjv: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ വിട്ടു മാറിപ്പോയി കരഞ്ഞു; പിന്നെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്നു ശിമെയോനെ പിടിച്ചു അവർ കാൺകെ ബന്ധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He turned away from them and began to weep, but then came back and spoke to them again. He had Simeon taken from them and bound before their eyes.
chapters.nkjv: And he turned himself away from them and wept. Then he returned to them again, and talked with them. And he took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.
chapters.kjv: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ചാക്കിൽ ധാന്യം നിറെപ്പാനും അവരുടെ ദ്രവ്യം അവനവന്റെ ചാക്കിൽ തിരികെ വെപ്പാനും വഴിക്കു വേണ്ടിയ ആഹാരം അവർക്കു കൊടുപ്പാനും യോസേഫ് കല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവർക്കു ചെയ്തുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to put each man’s silver back in his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. After this was done for them,
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their sacks with grain, to restore every man’s money to his sack, and to give them provisions for the journey. Thus he did for them.
chapters.kjv: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

chapters.ml: അവർ ധാന്യം കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: they loaded their grain on their donkeys and left.
chapters.nkjv: So they loaded their donkeys with the grain and departed from there.
chapters.kjv: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

chapters.ml: വഴിയമ്പലത്തിൽവെച്ചു അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ കഴുതെക്കു തീൻ കൊടുപ്പാൻ ചാക്കു അഴിച്ചപ്പോൾ തന്റെ ദ്രവ്യം ചാക്കിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: At the place where they stopped for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of his sack.
chapters.nkjv: But as one ofthem opened his sack to give his donkey feed at the encampment, he saw his money; and there it was, in the mouth of his sack.
chapters.kjv: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു: എന്റെ ദ്രവ്യം എനിക്കു തിരികെ കിട്ടി അതു ഇതാ, എന്റെ ചാക്കിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ ഉള്ളം തളർന്നു, അവർ വിറെച്ചു: ദൈവം നമ്മോടു ഈ ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "My silver has been returned," he said to his brothers. "Here it is in my sack." Their hearts sank and they turned to each other trembling and said, "What is this that God has done to us?"
chapters.nkjv: So he said to his brothers, "My money has been restored, and there it is, in my sack!" Then their hearts failed them and they were afraid, saying to one another, "What is this that God has done to us?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them , and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

chapters.ml: അവർ കനാൻ ദേശത്തു തങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനായ യാക്കോബിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയാറെ, തങ്ങൾക്കു സംഭവിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them. They said,
chapters.nkjv: Then they went to Jacob their father in the land of Canaan and told him all that had happened to them, saying:
chapters.kjv: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തിലെ അധിപതിയായവൻ ഞങ്ങൾ ദേശത്തെ ഒറ്റുനോക്കുന്നവർ എന്നു വിചാരിച്ചു ഞങ്ങളോടു കഠിനമായി സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.
chapters.nkjv: "The man whois lord of the land spoke roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
chapters.kjv: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ പരമാർത്ഥികളാകുന്നു, ഞങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റുകാരല്ല.
chapters.niv: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.
chapters.nkjv: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.
chapters.kjv: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ഒരു അപ്പന്റെ മക്കൾ; പന്ത്രണ്ടു സഹോരന്മാരാകുന്നു; ഒരുത്തൻ ഇപ്പോൾ ഇല്ല; ഇളയവൻ കനാൻ ദേശത്തു ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We were twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in Canaan.’
chapters.nkjv: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is with our father this day in the land of Canaan.’
chapters.kjv: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ദേശത്തിലെ അധിപതിയായവൻ ഞങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾ പരമാർത്ഥികൾ എന്നു ഞാൻ ഇതിനാൽ അറിയും: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഒരു സഹോദരനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വിട്ടേച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ വീടുകളിലെ ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടിന്നു ധാന്യം വാങ്ങി കൊണ്ടുപോകുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Then the man who is lord over the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, and take food for your starving households and go.
chapters.nkjv: Then the man, the lord of the country, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, take foodfor the famine of your households, and be gone.
chapters.kjv: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇളയസഹോദരനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ; അതിനാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റുകാരല്ല, പരമാർത്ഥികൾ തന്നേ എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയും; നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരനെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുതരും; നിങ്ങൾക്കു ദേശത്തു വ്യാപാരവും ചെയ്യാം.
chapters.niv: But bring your youngest brother to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And bring your youngest brother to me; so I shall know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. I will grant your brother to you, and you may trade in the land.’ "
chapters.kjv: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ ചാക്കു ഒഴിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഇതാ, ഓരോരുത്തന്റെ ചാക്കിൽ അവനവന്റെ പണക്കെട്ടു ഇരിക്കുന്നു; അവരും അവരുടെ അപ്പനും പണക്കെട്ടു കണ്ടാറെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: As they were emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his pouch of silver! When they and their father saw the money pouches, they were frightened.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened as they emptied their sacks, that surprisingly each man’s bundle of money was in his sack; and when they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അപ്പനായ യാക്കോബ് അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ മക്കളില്ലാത്തവനാക്കുന്നു; യോസേഫ് ഇല്ല, ശിമെയോൻ ഇല്ല; ബെന്യാമീനെയും നിങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ടുപോകും; സകലവും എനിക്കു പ്രതികൂലം തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Their father Jacob said to them, "You have deprived me of my children. Joseph is no more and Simeon is no more, and now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is against me!"
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob their father said to them, "You have bereaved me: Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin. All these things are against me."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു രൂബേൻ അപ്പനോടു: എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ അവനെ ഏല്പിക്ക; ഞാൻ അവനെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടക്കി കൊണ്ടുവരും; ഞാൻ അവനെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരാത്തപക്ഷം എന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരെ കൊന്നുകളക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Reuben said to his father, "You may put both of my sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him back."
chapters.nkjv: Then Reuben spoke to his father, saying, "Kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you; put him in my hands, and I will bring him back to you."
chapters.kjv: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ: എന്റെ മകൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പോരികയില്ല; അവന്റെ ജ്യോഷ്ഠൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി, അവൻ ഒരുത്തനേ ശേഷിപ്പുള്ളു; നിങ്ങൾ പോകുന്ന വഴിയിൽ അവന്നു വല്ല ആപത്തും വന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ നരയെ ദുഃഖത്തോടെ പാതാളത്തിലേക്കു ഇറങ്ങുമാറാക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jacob said, "My son will not go down there with you; his brother is dead and he is the only one left. If harm comes to him on the journey you are taking, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in sorrow."
chapters.nkjv: But he said, "My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he is left alone. If any calamity should befall him along the way in which you go, then you would bring down my gray hair with sorrow to the grave."
chapters.kjv: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ക്ഷാമം ദേശത്തു കഠിനമായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the famine was still severe in the land.
chapters.nkjv: Now the famine was severe in the land.
chapters.kjv: And the famine was sore in the land.

chapters.ml: അവർ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നുകൊണ്ടുവന്ന ധാന്യം തിന്നു തീർന്നപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ അപ്പൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഇനിയും പോയി കുറെ ആഹാരം കൊള്ളുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So when they had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, "Go back and buy us a little more food."
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought from Egypt, that their father said to them, "Go back, buy us a little food."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യെഹൂദാ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇല്ലാതിരുന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ മുഖം കാണുകയില്ല എന്നു അദ്ദേഹം തീർച്ചയായി ഞങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Judah said to him, "The man warned us solemnly, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’
chapters.nkjv: But Judah spoke to him, saying, "The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.’
chapters.kjv: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

chapters.ml: നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരനെ ഞങ്ങളുടെക്കുടെ അയച്ചാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു ആഹാരം വാങ്ങി കൊണ്ടുവരാം;
chapters.niv: If you will send our brother along with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
chapters.nkjv: If you send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.
chapters.kjv: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

chapters.ml: അയക്കാഞ്ഞാലോ ഞങ്ങൾ പോകയില്ല. നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇല്ല എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ മുഖം കാണുകയില്ല എന്നു അദ്ദേഹം ഞങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, because the man said to us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: But if you will not send him, we will not go down; for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.’ "
chapters.kjv: But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഇനിയും ഒരു സഹോദരൻ ഉണ്ടെന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞു എനിക്കു ഈ ദോഷം വരുത്തിയതു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Israel asked, "Why did you bring this trouble on me by telling the man you had another brother?"
chapters.nkjv: And Israel said, "Why did you deal so wrongfully with me as to tell the man whether you had still another brother?"
chapters.kjv: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവോ? നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഇനിയും ഒരു സഹോദരൻ ഉണ്ടോ എന്നിങ്ങനെ അദ്ദേഹം ഞങ്ങളെയും ഞങ്ങളുടെ വംശത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു താല്പര്യമായി ചോദിച്ചതു കൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങൾ ഇതൊക്കെയും അറിയിക്കേണ്ടിവന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരനെ ഇവിടെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു അദ്ദേഹം പറയുമെന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "The man questioned us closely about ourselves and our family. ‘Is your father still living?’ he asked us. ‘Do you have another brother?’ We simply answered his questions. How were we to know he would say, ‘Bring your brother down here’?"
chapters.nkjv: But they said, "The man asked us pointedly about ourselves and our family, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ And we told him according to these words. Could we possibly have known that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?"
chapters.kjv: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞങ്ങളും നീയും ഞങ്ങളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളും മരിക്കാതെ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ബാലനെ എന്നോടുകൂടെ അയക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ പോകാം.
chapters.niv: Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the boy along with me and we will go at once, so that we and you and our children may live and not die.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go, that we may live and not die, both we and you and also our little ones.
chapters.kjv: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്നു വേണ്ടി ഉത്തരവാദിയായിരിക്കാം; നീ അവനെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ചോദിക്കേണം; ഞാൻ അവനെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവനെ നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിർത്തുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ സദാകാലം നിനക്കു കുറ്റക്കാരനായിക്കൊള്ളാം.
chapters.niv: I myself will guarantee his safety; you can hold me personally responsible for him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him here before you, I will bear the blame before you all my life.
chapters.nkjv: I myself will be surety for him; from my hand you shall require him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever.
chapters.kjv: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ താമസിച്ചിരുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ ഇപ്പോൾ രണ്ടുപ്രാവശ്യം പോയി വരുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice."
chapters.nkjv: For if we had not lingered, surely by now we would have returned this second time."
chapters.kjv: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്രായേൽ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: അങ്ങനെയെങ്കിൽ ഇതു ചെയ്‍വിൻ: നിങ്ങളുടെ പാത്രങ്ങളിൽ കുറെ സുഗന്ധപ്പശ, കുറെ തേൻ, സാമ്പ്രാണിയും, സന്നിനായകം, ബോടനണ്ടി, ബദാമണ്ടി എന്നിങ്ങനെ ദേശത്തിലെ വിശേഷവസ്തുക്കളിൽ ചിലതൊക്കെയും കൊണ്ടുപോയി അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്നു കാഴ്ചവെപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your bags and take them down to the man as a gift—a little balm and a little honey, some spices and myrrh, some pistachio nuts and almonds.
chapters.nkjv: And their father Israel said to them, "If itmustbe so, then do this: Take some of the best fruits of the land in your vessels and carry down a present for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachio nuts and almonds.
chapters.kjv: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

chapters.ml: ഇരട്ടിദ്രവ്യവും കയ്യിൽ എടുത്തുകൊൾവിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ ചാക്കിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്ന ദ്രവ്യവും കയ്യിൽ തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുപോകുവിൻ; പക്ഷേ അതു കൈമറിച്ചലായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Take double the amount of silver with you, for you must return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
chapters.nkjv: Take double money in your hand, and take back in your hand the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks; perhaps it was an oversight.
chapters.kjv: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരനെയും കൂട്ടി പുറപ്പെട്ടു അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വീണ്ടും ചെല്ലുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.
chapters.nkjv: Take your brother also, and arise, go back to the man.
chapters.kjv: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ മറ്റേ സഹോദരനെയും ബെന്യാമീനെയും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ അയക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവം അവന്നു നിങ്ങളോടു കരുണ തോന്നിക്കട്ടെ; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ മക്കളില്ലാത്തവനാകേണമെങ്കിൽ ആകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: And may God Almighty grant you mercy before the man so that he will let your other brother and Benjamin come back with you. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved."
chapters.nkjv: And may God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved, I am bereaved!"
chapters.kjv: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children , I am bereaved.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ആ കാഴ്ചയും ഇരട്ടിദ്രവ്യവും എടുത്തു ബെന്യാമീനെയും കൂട്ടി പുറപ്പെട്ടു മിസ്രയീമിൽ ചെന്നു യോസേഫിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the men took the gifts and double the amount of silver, and Benjamin also. They hurried down to Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.
chapters.nkjv: So the men took that present and Benjamin, and they took double money in their hand, and arose and went down to Egypt; and they stood before Joseph.
chapters.kjv: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

chapters.ml: അവരോടുകൂടെ ബെന്യാമീനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ ഗൃഹ വിചാരകനോടു: നീ ഈ പുരുഷന്മാരെ വീട്ടിൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോക; അവർ ഉച്ചെക്കു എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കേണ്ടതാകയാൽ മൃഗത്തെ അറുത്തു ഒരുക്കിക്കൊൾക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my house, slaughter an animal and prepare a meal; they are to eat with me at noon."
chapters.nkjv: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my home, and slaughter an animal and make ready; for these men will dine with me at noon."
chapters.kjv: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവൻ ചെയ്തു; അവരെ യോസേഫിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: The man did as Joseph told him and took the men to Joseph’s house.
chapters.nkjv: Then the man did as Joseph ordered, and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.
chapters.kjv: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളെ യോസേഫിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോകയാൽ അവർ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു: ആദ്യത്തെ പ്രാവശ്യം നമ്മുടെ ചാക്കിൽ മടങ്ങിവന്ന ദ്രവ്യം നിമിത്തം നമ്മെ പിടിച്ചു അടിമകളാക്കി നമ്മുടെ കഴുതകളെയും എടുത്തുകൊള്ളേണ്ടതിന്നാകുന്നു നമ്മെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now the men were frightened when they were taken to his house. They thought, "We were brought here because of the silver that was put back into our sacks the first time. He wants to attack us and overpower us and seize us as slaves and take our donkeys."
chapters.nkjv: Now the men were afraid because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, "Itis because of the money, which was returned in our sacks the first time, that we are brought in, so that he may make a case against us and seize us, to take us as slaves with our donkeys."
