chapters.kjv: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോസേഫിന്റെ ഗൃഹവിചാരകന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു, വീട്ടുവാതിൽക്കൽവെച്ചു അവനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: So they went up to Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.
chapters.nkjv: When they drew near to the steward of Joseph’s house, they talked with him at the door of the house,
chapters.kjv: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

chapters.ml: യജമാനനേ, ആഹാരം കൊള്ളുവാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ മുമ്പെ വന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "We beg your pardon, our lord," they said, "we came down here the first time to buy food.
chapters.nkjv: and said, "O sir, we indeed came down the first time to buy food;
chapters.kjv: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ വഴിയമ്പലത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ചാക്കു അഴിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഓരോരുത്തന്റെ ദ്രവ്യം മുഴുവനും അവനവന്റെ ചാക്കിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതു ഞങ്ങൾ വീണ്ടും കൊണ്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But at the place where we stopped for the night we opened our sacks and each of us found his silver—the exact weight—in the mouth of his sack. So we have brought it back with us.
chapters.nkjv: but it happened, when we came to the encampment, that we opened our sacks, and there, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight; so we have brought it back in our hand.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

chapters.ml: ആഹാരം കൊള്ളുവാൻ വേറെ ദ്രവ്യവും ഞങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിട്ടുണ്ടു; ദ്രവ്യം ഞങ്ങളുടെ ചാക്കിൽ വെച്ചതു ആരെന്നു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അറിഞ്ഞുകൂടാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We have also brought additional silver with us to buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our sacks."
chapters.nkjv: And we have brought down other money in our hands to buy food. We do not know who put our money in our sacks."
chapters.kjv: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമാധാനം; നിങ്ങൾ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവം, നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ ദൈവം തന്നേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ ചാക്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു നിക്ഷേപം തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ ദ്രവ്യം എനിക്കു കിട്ടി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ശിമെയോനെയും അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: "It’s all right," he said. "Don’t be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks; I received your silver." Then he brought Simeon out to them.
chapters.nkjv: But he said, "Peace be with you, do not be afraid. Your God and the God of your father has given you treasure in your sacks; I had your money." Then he brought Simeon out to them.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരെ യോസേഫിന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നകത്തു കെണ്ടുപോയി; അവർക്കു വെള്ളം കൊടുത്തു, അവർ കാലുകളെ കഴുകി; അവരുടെ കഴുതകൾക്കു അവൻ തീൻ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet and provided fodder for their donkeys.
chapters.nkjv: So the man brought the men into Joseph’s house and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their donkeys feed.
chapters.kjv: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

chapters.ml: ഉച്ചെക്കു യോസേഫ് വരുമ്പോഴേക്കു അവർ കാഴ്ച ഒരുക്കിവെച്ചു; തങ്ങൾക്കു ഭക്ഷണം അവിടെ എന്നു അവർ കേട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They prepared their gifts for Joseph’s arrival at noon, because they had heard that they were to eat there.
chapters.nkjv: Then they made the present ready for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they would eat bread there.
chapters.kjv: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് വീട്ടിൽവന്നപ്പോൾ അവർ കൈവശമുള്ള കാഴ്ച അകത്തുകൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ വെച്ചു അവനെ സാഷ്ടാംഗം നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Joseph came home, they presented to him the gifts they had brought into the house, and they bowed down before him to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed down before him to the earth.
chapters.kjv: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു കുശലപ്രശ്നം ചെയ്തു: നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞ വൃദ്ധൻ, നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പൻ സൌഖ്യമായിരിക്കുന്നുവോ? അവൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He asked them how they were, and then he said, "How is your aged father you told me about? Is he still living?"
chapters.nkjv: Then he asked them about their well-being, and said, "Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he still alive?"
chapters.kjv: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനായ നിന്റെ അടിയാന്നു സുഖം തന്നേ; അവൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു കുനിഞ്ഞു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "Your servant our father is still alive and well." And they bowed down, prostrating themselves before him.
chapters.nkjv: And they answered, "Your servant our father is in good health; he is still alive." And they bowed their heads down and prostrated themselves.
chapters.kjv: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തല ഉയർത്തി, തന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ മകനും തന്റെ അനുജനുമായ ബെന്യാമീനെ കണ്ടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇളയസഹോദരനോ ഇവൻ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു: ദൈവം നിനക്കു കൃപനല്കട്ടെ മകനേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As he looked about and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother’s son, he asked, "Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?" And he said, "God be gracious to you, my son."
chapters.nkjv: Then he lifted his eyes and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, "Is this your younger brother of whom you spoke to me?" And he said, "God be gracious to you, my son."
chapters.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

chapters.ml: അനുജനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു യോസേഫിന്റെ മനസ്സു ഇരുകിയതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ കരയേണ്ടതിന്നു ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു സ്ഥലം അന്വേഷിച്ചു, അറയിൽചെന്നു അവിടെവെച്ചു കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Deeply moved at the sight of his brother, Joseph hurried out and looked for a place to weep. He went into his private room and wept there.
chapters.nkjv: Now his heart yearned for his brother; so Joseph made haste and sought somewhere to weep. And he went into his chamber and wept there.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ മുഖം കഴുകി പുറത്തു വന്നു തന്നെത്താൻ അടക്കി: ഭക്ഷണം കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he had washed his face, he came out and, controlling himself, said, "Serve the food."
chapters.nkjv: Then he washed his face and came out; and he restrained himself, and said, "Serve the bread."
chapters.kjv: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്നു പ്രത്യേകവും അവർക്കു പ്രത്യേകവും, അവനോടുകൂടെ ഭക്ഷിക്കുന്ന മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു പ്രത്യേകവും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു വെച്ചു; മിസ്രയീമ്യർ എബ്രായരോടു കൂടെ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കയില്ല; അതു മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു വെറുപ്പു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They served him by himself, the brothers by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because Egyptians could not eat with Hebrews, for that is detestable to Egyptians.
chapters.nkjv: So they set him a place by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves; because the Egyptians could not eat food with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.
chapters.kjv: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

chapters.ml: മൂത്തവൻ മുതൽ ഇളയവൻ വരെ പ്രായത്തിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം അവരെ അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഇരുത്തി; അവർ അന്യോന്യം നോക്കി ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The men had been seated before him in the order of their ages, from the firstborn to the youngest; and they looked at each other in astonishment.
chapters.nkjv: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright and the youngest according to his youth; and the men looked in astonishment at one another.
chapters.kjv: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു അവർക്കു ഓഹരികൊടുത്തയച്ചു; ബെന്യാമീന്റെ ഓഹരി മറ്റവരുടെ ഓഹരിയുടെ അഞ്ചിരട്ടിയായിരുന്നു; അവർ പാനംചെയ്തു അവനോടുകൂടെ ആഹ്ളാദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as anyone else’s. So they feasted and drank freely with him.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took servings to them from before him, but Benjamin’s serving was five times as much as any of theirs. So they drank and were merry with him.
chapters.kjv: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ തന്റെ ഗൃഹവിചാരകനോടു: നീ ഇവരുടെ ചാക്കിൽ പിടിപ്പതു ധാന്യം നിറച്ചു, ഓരോരുത്തന്റെ ദ്രവ്യം അവനവന്റെ ചാക്കിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽ വെക്കുക.
chapters.niv: Now Joseph gave these instructions to the steward of his house: "Fill the men’s sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each man’s silver in the mouth of his sack.
chapters.nkjv: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, "Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in the mouth of his sack.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

chapters.ml: ഇളയവന്റെ ചാക്കിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽ വെള്ളികൊണ്ടുള്ള എന്റെ പാനപാത്രവും അവന്റെ ധാന്യവിലയും വെക്കുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; യോസേഫ് കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവൻ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with the silver for his grain." And he did as Joseph said.
chapters.nkjv: Also put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the sack of the youngest, and his grain money." So he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
chapters.kjv: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

chapters.ml: നേരം വെളുത്തപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ കഴുതകളുമായി അവരെ യാത്രഅയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As morning dawned, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
chapters.nkjv: As soon as the morning dawned, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.
chapters.kjv: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

chapters.ml: അവർ പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ദൂരത്താകുംമുമ്പെ, യോസേഫ് തന്റെ ഗൃഹവിചാരകനോടു: എഴുന്നേറ്റു ആ പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ പിന്നാലെ ഓടിച്ചെല്ലുക; ഒപ്പം എത്തുമ്പോൾ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ നന്മെക്കു പകരം തിന്മ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph said to his steward, "Go after those men at once, and when you catch up with them, say to them, ‘Why have you repaid good with evil?
chapters.nkjv: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, "Get up, follow the men; and when you overtake them, say to them, ‘Why have you repaid evil for good?
chapters.kjv: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

chapters.ml: അതിലല്ലയോ എന്റെ യജമാനൻ കുടിക്കുന്നതു? നിങ്ങൾ ഈ ചെയ്തതു ഒട്ടും നന്നല്ല എന്നു പറക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Isn’t this the cup my master drinks from and also uses for divination? This is a wicked thing you have done.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Is not this theone from which my lord drinks, and with which he indeed practices divination? You have done evil in so doing.’ "
chapters.kjv: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഈ വാക്കുകൾ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he caught up with them, he repeated these words to them.
chapters.nkjv: So he overtook them, and he spoke to them these same words.
chapters.kjv: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യജമാനൻ ഇങ്ങനെ പറയുന്നതു എന്തു? ഈ വക കാര്യം അടിയങ്ങൾ ഒരുനാളും ചെയ്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But they said to him, "Why does my lord say such things? Far be it from your servants to do anything like that!
chapters.nkjv: And they said to him, "Why does my lord say these words? Far be it from us that your servants should do such a thing.
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ചാക്കിന്റെ വായ്ക്കൽ കണ്ട ദ്രവ്യം ഞങ്ങൾ കനാൻ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വീണ്ടും കൊണ്ടുവന്നുവല്ലോ; പിന്നെ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും മോഷ്ടിക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found inside the mouths of our sacks. So why would we steal silver or gold from your master’s house?
chapters.nkjv: Look, we brought back to you from the land of Canaan the money which we found in the mouth of our sacks. How then could we steal silver or gold from your lord’s house?
chapters.kjv: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?

chapters.ml: അടിയങ്ങളിൽ ആരുടെ പക്കൽ എങ്കിലും അതു കണ്ടാൽ അവൻ മരിക്കട്ടെ; ഞങ്ങളും യജമാനന്നു അടിമകളായിക്കൊള്ളാം.
chapters.niv: If any of your servants is found to have it, he will die; and the rest of us will become my lord’s slaves."
chapters.nkjv: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves."
chapters.kjv: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ആകട്ടെ; അതു ആരുടെ പക്കൽ കാണുന്നുവോ അവൻ എനിക്കു അടിമയാകും; നിങ്ങളോ കുറ്റമില്ലാത്തവരായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Very well, then," he said, "let it be as you say. Whoever is found to have it will become my slave; the rest of you will be free from blame."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Now also let it be according to your words; he with whom it is found shall be my slave, and you shall be blameless."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

chapters.ml: അവർ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ചാക്കു നിലത്തു ഇറക്കി: ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ ചാക്കു അഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Each of them quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
chapters.nkjv: Then each man speedily let down his sack to the ground, and each opened his sack.
chapters.kjv: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂത്തവന്റെ ചാക്കുതുടങ്ങി ഇളയവന്റേതുവരെ ശോധന കഴിച്ചു. ബെന്യാമീന്റെ ചാക്കിൽ പാനപാത്രം കണ്ടുപിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the steward proceeded to search, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest. And the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
chapters.nkjv: So he searched. He began with the oldest and left off with the youngest; and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
chapters.kjv: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ വസ്ത്രം കീറി, ചുമടു കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: At this, they tore their clothes. Then they all loaded their donkeys and returned to the city.
chapters.nkjv: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey and returned to the city.
chapters.kjv: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും യോസേഫിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു; അവൻ അതുവരെയും അവിടെത്തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു.
chapters.niv: Joseph was still in the house when Judah and his brothers came in, and they threw themselves to the ground before him.
chapters.nkjv: So Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there; and they fell before him on the ground.
chapters.kjv: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഈ ചെയ്ത പ്രവൃത്തി എന്തു? എന്നെപ്പോലെയുള്ള ഒരുത്തന്നു ലക്ഷണവിദ്യ അറിയാമെന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph said to them, "What is this you have done? Don’t you know that a man like me can find things out by divination?"
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph said to them, "What deed is this you have done? Did you not know that such a man as I can certainly practice divination?"
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യെഹൂദാ: യജമാനനോടു ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തു പറയേണ്ടു? എന്തു ബോധിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടു? എങ്ങനെ ഞങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ നീതീകരിക്കേണ്ടു? ദൈവം അടിയങ്ങളുടെ അകൃത്യം കണ്ടെത്തി; ഇതാ ഞങ്ങൾ യജമാനന്നു അടിമകൾ; ഞങ്ങളും ആരുടെ കയ്യിൽ പാത്രം കണ്ടുവോ അവനും തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What can we say to my lord?" Judah replied. "What can we say? How can we prove our innocence? God has uncovered your servants’ guilt. We are now my lord’s slaves—we ourselves and the one who was found to have the cup."
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah said, "What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how shall we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants; here we are, my lord’s slaves, both we and he also with whom the cup was found."
chapters.kjv: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ ഒരുനാളും ചെയ്കയില്ല; ആരുടെ പക്കൽ പാത്രം കണ്ടുവോ അവൻ തന്നേ എനിക്കു അടിമയായിരിക്കും; നിങ്ങളോ സമാധാനത്തോടെ നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Joseph said, "Far be it from me to do such a thing! Only the man who was found to have the cup will become my slave. The rest of you, go back to your father in peace."
chapters.nkjv: But he said, "Far be it from me that I should do so; the man in whose hand the cup was found, he shall be my slave. And as for you, go up in peace to your father."
chapters.kjv: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാ അടുത്തുചെന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു: യജമാനനേ, അടിയൻ യജമാനനോടു ഒന്നു ബോധിപ്പിച്ചുകൊള്ളട്ടെ; അടിയന്റെ നേരെ കോപം ജ്വലിക്കരുതേ;
chapters.niv: Then Judah went up to him and said: "Pardon your servant, my lord, let me speak a word to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, though you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah came near to him and said: "O my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s hearing, and do not let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even like Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ ഫറവോനെപ്പോലെയല്ലോ; നിങ്ങൾക്കു അപ്പനോ സഹോദരനോ ഉണ്ടോ എന്നു യജമാനൻ അടിയങ്ങളോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’
chapters.nkjv: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father or a brother?’
chapters.kjv: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ യജമാനനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വൃദ്ധനായോരു അപ്പനും അവന്നു വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിൽ ജനിച്ച ഒരു മകനും ഉണ്ടു; അവന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി; അവന്റെ അമ്മ പ്രസവിച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ ഒരുത്തനെ ശേഷിപ്പുള്ളു; അവൻ അപ്പന്റെ ഇഷ്ടനാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And we answered, ‘We have an aged father, and there is a young son born to him in his old age. His brother is dead, and he is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’
chapters.nkjv: And we said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, whois young; his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother’s children, and his father loves him.’
chapters.kjv: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യജമാനൻ അടിയിങ്ങളോടു: എനിക്കു കാണേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.’
chapters.nkjv: Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
chapters.kjv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ യജമാനനോടു: ബാലന്നു അപ്പനെ പിരിഞ്ഞുകൂടാ; പിരിഞ്ഞാൽ അപ്പൻ മരിച്ചുപോകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves him, his father will die.’
chapters.nkjv: And we said to my lord, ‘The lad cannot leave his father, for if he should leave his father, hisfather would die.’
chapters.kjv: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യജമാനൻ അടിയങ്ങളോടു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇളയസഹോദരൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ വരാതിരുന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ മുഖം ഇനി കാണുകയില്ല എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But you told your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
chapters.nkjv: But you said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall see my face no more.’
chapters.kjv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

chapters.ml: അവിടത്തെ അടിയാനായ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഞങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു യജമാനന്റെ വാക്കുകളെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.
chapters.nkjv: "So it was, when we went up to your servant my father, that we told him the words of my lord.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പൻ നിങ്ങൾ ഇനിയും പോയി കുറെ ധാന്യം നമുക്കു കൊള്ളുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy a little more food.’
chapters.nkjv: And our father said, ‘Go back and buy us a little food.’
chapters.kjv: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ: ഞങ്ങൾ പൊയ്ക്കൂടാ; അനുജൻ കൂടെ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ പോകാം; അനുജൻ ഇല്ലാതെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ മുഖം കാണ്മാൻ പാടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But we said, ‘We cannot go down. Only if our youngest brother is with us will we go. We cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
chapters.nkjv: But we said, ‘We cannot go down; if our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down; for we may not see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
chapters.kjv: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവിടത്തെ അടിയാനായ അപ്പൻ ഞങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ ഭാര്യ എനിക്കു രണ്ടുപുത്രന്മാരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു അറിയാമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
chapters.nkjv: Then your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons;
chapters.kjv: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു പോയി; അവനെ പറിച്ചു കീറിപ്പോയി നിശ്ചയം എന്നു ഞാൻ ഉറെച്ചു; ഇതുവരെ ഞാൻ അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: One of them went away from me, and I said, "He has surely been torn to pieces." And I have not seen him since.
chapters.nkjv: and the one went out from me, and I said, "Surely he is torn to pieces"; and I have not seen him since.
chapters.kjv: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഇവനെയും കൊണ്ടുപോയിട്ടു അവന്നു വല്ല ആപത്തും വന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ നരയെ ദുഃഖത്തോടെ പാതാളത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങുമാറാക്കും.
chapters.niv: If you take this one from me too and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in misery.’
chapters.nkjv: But if you take this one also from me, and calamity befalls him, you shall bring down my gray hair with sorrow to the grave.’
chapters.kjv: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഇപ്പോൾ ബാലൻ കൂടെയില്ലാതെ ഞാൻ അവിടത്തെ അടിയാനായ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ, അവന്റെ പ്രാണൻ ഇവന്റെ പ്രാണനോടു പറ്റിയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: "So now, if the boy is not with us when I go back to your servant my father, and if my father, whose life is closely bound up with the boy’s life,
chapters.nkjv: "Now therefore, when I come to your servant my father, and the lad is not with us, since his life is bound up in the lad’s life,
chapters.kjv: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

chapters.ml: ബാലൻ ഇല്ലെന്നു കണ്ടാൽ അവൻ മരിച്ചുപോകും; അങ്ങനെ അടിയങ്ങൾ അവിടെത്തെ അടിയാനായ അപ്പന്റെ നരയെ ദുഃഖത്തോടെ പാതാളത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങുമാറാക്കും.
chapters.niv: sees that the boy isn’t there, he will die. Your servants will bring the gray head of our father down to the grave in sorrow.
chapters.nkjv: it will happen, when he sees that the lad is not withus, that he will die. So your servants will bring down the gray hair of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
chapters.kjv: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

chapters.ml: അടിയൻ അപ്പനോടു: അവനെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരാതിരുന്നാൽ ഞാൻ എന്നും അപ്പന്നു കുറ്റക്കാരനായിക്കൊള്ളാമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, അപ്പനോടു ബാലന്നുവേണ്ടി ഉത്തരവാദിയായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father. I said, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, I will bear the blame before you, my father, all my life!’
chapters.nkjv: For your servant became surety for the lad to my father, saying, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, then I shall bear the blame before my father forever.’
chapters.kjv: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ബാലന്നു പകരം അടിയൻ യജമാനന്നു അടിമയായിരിപ്പാനും ബാലൻ സഹോദരന്മാരോടുകൂടെ പൊയ്ക്കൊൾയവാനും അനുവദിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: "Now then, please let your servant remain here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, please let your servant remain instead of the lad as a slave to my lord, and let the lad go up with his brothers.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

chapters.ml: ബാലൻ കൂടെ ഇല്ലാതെ ഞാൻ എങ്ങനെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോകും? അപ്പന്നു ഭവിക്കുന്ന ദോഷം ഞാൻ കാണേണ്ടിവരുമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: How can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? No! Do not let me see the misery that would come on my father."
chapters.nkjv: For how shall I go up to my father if the lad is not with me, lest perhaps I see the evil that would come upon my father?"
chapters.kjv: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ചുറ്റും നില്ക്കുന്നവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ തന്നെത്താൻ അടക്കുവാൻ വഹിയാതെ: എല്ലാവരെയും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നു പുറത്താക്കുവിൻ എന്നു യോസേഫ് വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു. ഇങ്ങനെ യോസേഫ് തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു തന്നെ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിയപ്പോൾ ആരും അടുക്കൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, "Have everyone leave my presence!" So there was no one with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph could not restrain himself before all those who stood by him, and he cried out, "Make everyone go out from me!" So no one stood with him while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
chapters.kjv: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉച്ചത്തിൽ കരഞ്ഞു; മിസ്രയീമ്യരും ഫറവോന്റെ ഗൃഹവും അതു കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household heard about it.
chapters.nkjv: And he wept aloud, and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard it.
chapters.kjv: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് സഹോദരന്മാരോടു: ഞാൻ യോസേഫ് ആകുന്നു; എന്റെ അപ്പൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഭ്രമിച്ചുപോയതുകൊണ്ടു അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറവാൻ അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still living?" But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph; does my father still live?" But his brothers could not answer him, for they were dismayed in his presence.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് സഹോദരന്മാരോടു: ഇങ്ങോട്ടു അടുത്തുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ അടുത്തുചെന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു; നിങ്ങൾ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു വിറ്റുകളഞ്ഞ നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരൻ യോസേഫ് ആകുന്നു ഞാൻ.
chapters.niv: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "Come close to me." When they had done so, he said, "I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt!
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph said to his brothers, "Please come near to me." So they came near. Then he said: "I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ ഇവിടെ വിറ്റതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ വ്യസനിക്കേണ്ടാ, വിഷാദിക്കയും വേണ്ടാ; ജീവരക്ഷക്കായി ദൈവം എന്നെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പെ അയച്ചതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And now, do not be distressed and do not be angry with yourselves for selling me here, because it was to save lives that God sent me ahead of you.
chapters.nkjv: But now, do not therefore be grieved or angry with yourselves because you sold me here; for God sent me before you to preserve life.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തു ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായിട്ടു ഇപ്പോൾ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരമായി; ഉഴവും കൊയ്ത്തും ഇല്ലാത്ത അഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം ഇനിയും ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will be no plowing and reaping.
chapters.nkjv: For these two years the famine hasbeen in the land, and thereare still five years in which therewillbe neither plowing nor harvesting.
chapters.kjv: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു സന്തതി ശേഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും വലിയോരു രക്ഷയാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവനെ രക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും ദൈവം എന്നെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
chapters.nkjv: And God sent me before you to preserve a posterity for you in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
chapters.kjv: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ അല്ല, ദൈവം അത്രേ എന്നെ ഇവിടെ അയച്ചതു; അവൻ എന്നെ ഫറവോന്നു പിതാവും അവന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു ഒക്കെയും യജമാനനും മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും അധിപതിയും ആക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "So then, it was not you who sent me here, but God. He made me father to Pharaoh, lord of his entire household and ruler of all Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: So now itwas not you who sent me here, but God; and He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിന്റെ മകനായ യോസേഫ് ഇപ്രകാരം പറയുന്നു: ദൈവം എന്നെ മിസ്രയീമിന്നൊക്കെയും അധിപതിയാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ താമസിയാതെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരേണം.
chapters.niv: Now hurry back to my father and say to him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; don’t delay.
chapters.nkjv: "Hurry and go up to my father, and say to him, ‘Thus says your son Joseph: "God has made me lord of all Egypt; come down to me, do not tarry.
chapters.kjv: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

chapters.ml: നീ ഗോശെൻ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു എനിക്കു സമീപമായിരിക്കും; നീയും മക്കളും മക്കളുടെ മക്കളും നിന്റെ ആടുകളും കന്നുകാലികളും നിനക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: You shall live in the region of Goshen and be near me—you, your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and all you have.
chapters.nkjv: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near to me, you and your children, your children’s children, your flocks and your herds, and all that you have.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

chapters.ml: നിനക്കും കുടുംബത്തിന്നും നിനക്കുള്ള സകലത്തിന്നും ദാരിദ്ര്യം നേരിടാതവണ്ണം ഞാൻ അവിടെ നിന്നെ പോഷിപ്പിക്കും; ക്ഷാമം ഇനിയും അഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം നില്ക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will provide for you there, because five years of famine are still to come. Otherwise you and your household and all who belong to you will become destitute.’
chapters.nkjv: There I will provide for you, lest you and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty; for thereare still five years of famine." ’
chapters.kjv: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ തന്നേ നിങ്ങളോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങളും എന്റെ അനുജൻ ബെന്യാമീനും കണ്ണാലെ കാണുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that it is really I who am speaking to you.
chapters.nkjv: "And behold, your eyes and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see that itis my mouth that speaks to you.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ എനിക്കുള്ള മഹത്വവും നിങ്ങൾ കണ്ടതൊക്കെയും അപ്പനെ അറിയിക്കേണം; എന്റെ അപ്പനെ വേഗത്തിൽ ഇവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവരികയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Tell my father about all the honor accorded me in Egypt and about everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly."
chapters.nkjv: So you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and you shall hurry and bring my father down here."
chapters.kjv: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അനുജൻ ബെന്യാമീനെ കെട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചു കരഞ്ഞു; ബെന്യാമീൻ അവനെയും കെട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചു കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin embraced him, weeping.
chapters.nkjv: Then he fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
chapters.kjv: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സഹോദരന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും ചുംബിച്ചു കെട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചു കരഞ്ഞു; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം സഹോദരന്മാർ അവനുമായി സല്ലാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterward his brothers talked with him.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover he kissed all his brothers and wept over them, and after that his brothers talked with him.
chapters.kjv: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നുള്ള കേൾവി ഫറവോന്റെ അരമനയിൽ എത്തി; അതു ഫറവോന്നും അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർക്കും സന്തോഷമായി.
chapters.niv: When the news reached Pharaoh’s palace that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and all his officials were pleased.
chapters.nkjv: Now the report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, "Joseph’s brothers have come." So it pleased Pharaoh and his servants well.
chapters.kjv: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു നീ പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ ഇതു ചെയ്‍വിൻ: നിങ്ങളുടെ മൃഗങ്ങളുടെ പുറത്തു ചുമടുകയറ്റി പുറപ്പെട്ടു കനാൻ ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ
chapters.niv: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan,
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and depart; go to the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

chapters.ml: അപ്പനെയും കുടുംബങ്ങളെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവിൻ; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മിസ്രയീംരാജ്യത്തിലെ നന്മ തരും; ദേശത്തിന്റെ പുഷ്ടി നിങ്ങൾ അനുഭവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: and bring your father and your families back to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt and you can enjoy the fat of the land.’
chapters.nkjv: Bring your father and your households and come to me; I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.
chapters.kjv: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു കല്പന തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇതാകുന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതു: നിങ്ങളുടെ പൈതങ്ങൾക്കും ഭാര്യമാർക്കും വേണ്ടി മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു നിന്നു രഥങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ടുപോയി നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനെ കയറ്റി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: "You are also directed to tell them, ‘Do this: Take some carts from Egypt for your children and your wives, and get your father and come.
chapters.nkjv: Now you are commanded—do this: Take carts out of the land of Egypt for your little ones and your wives; bring your father and come.
chapters.kjv: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സാമാനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു ചിന്തിക്കേണ്ടാ; മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തെങ്ങുമുള്ള നന്മ നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Never mind about your belongings, because the best of all Egypt will be yours.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Also do not be concerned about your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’ "
chapters.kjv: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു; യോസേഫ്‌ അവർക്കു ഫറവോന്റെ കല്പന പ്രകാരം രഥങ്ങൾ കൊടുത്തു; വഴിക്കു വേണ്ടുന്ന ആഹാരവും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them carts, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sons of Israel did so; and Joseph gave them carts, according to the command of Pharaoh, and he gave them provisions for the journey.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്നു ഓരോ വസ്ത്രവും ബെന്യാമീന്നോ മുന്നൂറു വെള്ളിക്കാശും അഞ്ചു വസ്ത്രവും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: To each of them he gave new clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
chapters.nkjv: He gave to all of them, to each man, changes of garments; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of garments.
chapters.kjv: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പന്നു പത്തു കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു മിസ്രയീമിലെ വിശേഷ സാധനങ്ങളും പത്തു പെൺകഴുതപ്പുറത്തു വഴിച്ചെലവിന്നു ധാന്യവും ആഹാരവും കയറ്റി അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And this is what he sent to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the best things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other provisions for his journey.
chapters.nkjv: And he sent to his father these things: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and food for his father for the journey.
chapters.kjv: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ യാത്ര അയച്ചു; അവർ പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ: നിങ്ങൾ വഴിയിൽ വെച്ചു ശണ്ഠകൂടരുതെന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, "Don’t quarrel on the way!"
chapters.nkjv: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed; and he said to them, "See that you do not become troubled along the way."
chapters.kjv: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

chapters.ml: അവർ മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു കനാൻ ദേശത്തു അപ്പനായ യാക്കോബിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: Then they went up out of Egypt, and came to the land of Canaan to Jacob their father.
chapters.kjv: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

chapters.ml: അവനോടു: യോസേഫ് ജീവനോടിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും അധിപതിയാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ യാക്കോബ് സ്തംഭിച്ചുപോയി; അവർ പറഞ്ഞതു വിശ്വസിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: They told him, "Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is ruler of all Egypt." Jacob was stunned; he did not believe them.
chapters.nkjv: And they told him, saying, "Joseph is still alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt." And Jacob’s heart stood still, because he did not believe them.
chapters.kjv: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞവാക്കുകളൊക്കെയും അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു; തന്നെ കയറ്റികൊണ്ടു പോകുവാൻ യോസേഫ് അയച്ച രഥങ്ങളെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ അപ്പനായ യാക്കോബിന്നു വീണ്ടും ചൈതന്യം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: But when they told him everything Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.
chapters.nkjv: But when they told him all the words which Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.
chapters.kjv: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

chapters.ml: മതി; എന്റെ മകൻ യോസേഫ്‌ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ മരിക്കുംമുമ്പെ അവനെ പോയി കാണും എന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Israel said, "I’m convinced! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel said, "Itis enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."
chapters.kjv: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്രായേൽ തനിക്കുള്ള സകലവുമായി യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു ബേർ-ശേബയിൽ എത്തി തന്റെ പിതാവായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു യാഗം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Israel set out with all that was his, and when he reached Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
chapters.nkjv: So Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
chapters.kjv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം യിസ്രായേലിനോടു രാത്രി ദർശനങ്ങളിൽ: യാക്കോബേ, യാക്കോബേ എന്നു വിളിച്ചതിന്നു ഞാൻ ഇതാ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And God spoke to Israel in a vision at night and said, "Jacob! Jacob!" "Here I am," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, "Jacob, Jacob!" And he said, "Here I am."
chapters.kjv: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: ഞാൻ ദൈവം ആകുന്നു; നിന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ദൈവം തന്നേ; മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; അവിടെ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വലിയ ജാതിയാക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "I am God, the God of your father," he said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
chapters.nkjv: So He said, "I am God, the God of your father; do not fear to go down to Egypt, for I will make of you a great nation there.
chapters.kjv: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു പോരും; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ മടക്കി വരുത്തും; യോസേഫ് സ്വന്തകൈകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ കണ്ണു അടെക്കും എന്നും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I will surely bring you back again. And Joseph’s own hand will close your eyes."
chapters.nkjv: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also surely bring you up again; and Joseph will put his hand on your eyes."
chapters.kjv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യാക്കോബ് ബേർ-ശേബയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അപ്പനായ യാക്കോബിനെ കയറ്റുവാൻ ഫറവോൻ അയച്ച രഥങ്ങളിൽ അവനെയും തങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളെയും ഭാര്യമാരെയും കയറ്റി കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob left Beersheba, and Israel’s sons took their father Jacob and their children and their wives in the carts that Pharaoh had sent to transport him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob arose from Beersheba; and the sons of Israel carried their father Jacob, their little ones, and their wives, in the carts which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ ആടുമാടുകളെയും കനാൻ ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു സമ്പാദിച്ച സമ്പത്തുകളെയും കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അങ്ങനെ യാക്കോബും സന്തതികളുമെല്ലാം മിസ്രയീമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: So Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt, taking with them their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: So they took their livestock and their goods, which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went to Egypt, Jacob and all his descendants with him.
chapters.kjv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പുത്രിപുത്രന്മാരെയും പൌത്രിപൌത്രന്മാരെയും തന്റെ സന്തതികളെയൊക്കെയും കൂട്ടി മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Jacob brought with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring.
chapters.nkjv: His sons and his sons’ sons, his daughters and his sons’ daughters, and all his descendants he brought with him to Egypt.
chapters.kjv: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ വന്ന യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ പേരുകൾ ആവിതു: യാക്കോബും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും; യാക്കോബിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ രൂബേൻ.
chapters.niv: These are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: Now these were the names of the children of Israel, Jacob and his sons, who went to Egypt: Reuben was Jacob’s firstborn.
chapters.kjv: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

chapters.ml: രൂബേന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഹാനോക്, ഫല്ലൂ, ഹെസ്രോൻ, കർമ്മി.
chapters.niv: The sons of Reuben: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Reuben were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യെമൂവേൽ, യാമീൻ, ഓഹദ്, യാഖീൻ, സോഹർ, കനാന്യക്കാരത്തിയുടെ മകനായ ശൌൽ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

chapters.ml: ലേവിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഗേർശോൻ, കഹാത്ത്, മെരാരി.
chapters.niv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഏർ, ഓനാൻ, ശേലാ, പേരെസ്, സേരഹ്; എന്നാൽ ഏർ ഓനാൻ എന്നിവർ കനാൻ ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി. പേരെസിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ:
chapters.niv: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez and Zerah (but Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

chapters.ml: ഹെസ്രോൻ, ഹാമൂൽ. യിസ്സാഖാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: തോലാ, പുവ്വാ, യോബ്, ശിമ്രോൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സേരെദ്, ഏലോൻ, യഹ്ളെയേൽ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Zebulun were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ ലേയയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ; അവൾ അവരെയും യാക്കോബിന്റെ മകളായ ദീനയെയും അവന്നു പദ്ദൻ-അരാമിൽവെച്ചു പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരും എല്ലാം കൂടെ മുപ്പത്തുമൂന്നു പേർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These were the sons Leah bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, besides his daughter Dinah. These sons and daughters of his were thirty-three in all.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the persons, his sons and his daughters, were thirty-three.
chapters.kjv: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

chapters.ml: ഗാദിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സിഫ്യോൻ, ഹഗ്ഗീ, ശൂനീ, എസ്ബോൻ, ഏരി, അരോദീ, അരേലീ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Gad were Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

chapters.ml: ആശേരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യിമ്നാ, യിശ്വാ, യിശ്വീ, ബെരീയാ; ഇവരുടെ സഹോദരി സേരഹ്. ബെരീയാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ:
chapters.niv: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Asher were Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui, Beriah, and Serah, their sister. And the sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

chapters.ml: ഹേബെർ, മൽക്കീയേൽ. ഇവർ ലാബാൻ തന്റെ മകളായ ലേയെക്കു കൊടുത്ത സില്പയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ; അവൾ യാക്കോബിന്നു ഈ പതിനാറു പേരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: These were the children born to Jacob by Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bore to Jacob: sixteen persons.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ റാഹേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ:
chapters.niv: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ്, ബെന്യാമീൻ. യോസേഫിന്നു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു മനശ്ശെയും എഫ്രയീമും ജനിച്ചു; അവരെ ഓനിലെ പുരോഹിതനായ പോത്തിഫേറയുടെ മകളായ ആസ്നത്ത് അവന്നു പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
chapters.nkjv: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On, bore to him.
chapters.kjv: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ബേല, ബേഖെർ, അശ്ബെൽ, ഗേരാ, നാമാൻ, ഏഹീ, രോശ്, മുപ്പീം, ഹുപ്പീം, ആരെദ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Benjamin were Belah, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ റാഹേൽ യാക്കോബിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച പുത്രന്മാർ; എല്ലാംകൂടെ പതിന്നാലു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob—fourteen in all.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: fourteen persons in all.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

chapters.ml: ദാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഹൂശീം.
chapters.niv: The son of Dan: Hushim.
chapters.nkjv: The son of Dan was Hushim.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യഹസേൽ, ഗൂനീ, യേസെർ, ശില്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Naphtali were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ ലാബാൻ തന്റെ മകളായ റാഹേലിന്നു കൊടുത്ത ബിൽഹയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ; അവൾ യാക്കോബിന്നു ഇവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; എല്ലാംകൂടെ ഏഴുപേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the sons born to Jacob by Bilhah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob: seven persons in all.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ ഭാര്യമാരെ കൂടാതെ അവന്റെ കടിപ്രദേശത്തുനിന്നു ജനിച്ചവരായി അവനോടുകൂടെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ വന്നവർ ആകെ അറുപത്താറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: All those who went to Egypt with Jacob—those who were his direct descendants, not counting his sons’ wives—numbered sixty-six persons.
chapters.nkjv: All the persons who went with Jacob to Egypt, who came from his body, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, were sixty-six persons in all.
chapters.kjv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്നു മിസ്രയീമിൽവെച്ചു ജനിച്ച പുത്രന്മാർ രണ്ടുപേർ; മിസ്രയീമിൽ വന്നരായ യാക്കോബിന്റെ കുടുംബം ആകെ എഴുപതു പേർ.
chapters.niv: With the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family, which went to Egypt, were seventy in all.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Joseph who were born to him in Egypt were two persons. All the persons of the house of Jacob who went to Egypt were seventy.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഗോശെനിലേക്കു യോസേഫ് തനിക്കു വഴി കാണിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ യെഹൂദയെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മുമ്പിട്ടു അയച്ചു; ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ ഗോശെൻ ദേശത്തു എത്തി.
chapters.niv: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When they arrived in the region of Goshen,
chapters.nkjv: Then he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to point out before him theway to Goshen. And they came to the land of Goshen.
chapters.kjv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് രഥം കെട്ടിച്ചു അപ്പനായ യിസ്രായേലിനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ഗോശെനിലേക്കു പോയി, അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ കെട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചു ഏറെനേരം കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joseph had his chariot made ready and went to Goshen to meet his father Israel. As soon as Joseph appeared before him, he threw his arms around his father and wept for a long time.
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph made ready his chariot and went up to Goshen to meet his father Israel; and he presented himself to him, and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a good while.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായെൽ യോസേഫിനോടു: നീ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മുഖം കണ്ടറിഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നേ മരിച്ചാലും വേണ്ടതില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Israel said to Joseph, "Now I am ready to die, since I have seen for myself that you are still alive."
chapters.nkjv: And Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you are still alive."
chapters.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോസേഫ് സഹോദരന്മാരോടും അപ്പന്റെ കുടുംബത്തോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ ചെന്നു ഫറവോനോടു: കനാൻ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും അപ്പന്റെ കുടുംബവും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിയിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, "I will go up and speak to Pharaoh and will say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household, who were living in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, "I will go up and tell Pharaoh, and say to him, ‘My brothers and those of my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇടയന്മാർ ആകുന്നു; കന്നുകാലികളെ മേയ്ക്കുന്നത് അവരുടെ തൊഴിൽ; അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ആടുകളെയും കന്നുകാലികളെയും തങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നിട്ടുണ്ടു എന്നു അവനോടു പറയും.
chapters.niv: The men are shepherds; they tend livestock, and they have brought along their flocks and herds and everything they own.’
chapters.nkjv: And the men are shepherds, for their occupation has been to feed livestock; and they have brought their flocks, their herds, and all that they have.’
chapters.kjv: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഫറവോൻ നിങ്ങളെ വിളിച്ചു: നിങ്ങളുടെ തൊഴിൽ എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിക്കുമ്പോൾ:
chapters.niv: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
chapters.nkjv: So it shall be, when Pharaoh calls you and says, ‘What is your occupation?’
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

chapters.ml: അടിയങ്ങൾ ബാല്യംമുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെയും, ഞങ്ങളും ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരും ഗോപാലകന്മാരാകുന്നു എന്നു പറവിൻ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഗോശെനിൽ പാർപ്പാൻ സംഗതിയാകും; ഇടയന്മാരെല്ലാം മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു വെറുപ്പല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: you should answer, ‘Your servants have tended livestock from our boyhood on, just as our fathers did.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the region of Goshen, for all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians."
chapters.nkjv: that you shall say, ‘Your servants’ occupation has been with livestock from our youth even till now, both we and also our fathers,’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians."
chapters.kjv: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോസേഫ് ചെന്നു: എന്റെ അപ്പനും സഹോദരന്മാരും അവരുടെ ആടുകളും കന്നുകാലികളും അവർക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും കനാൻ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു വന്നു; ഗോശെൻ ദേശത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഫറവോനെ ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph went and told Pharaoh, "My father and brothers, with their flocks and herds and everything they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph went and told Pharaoh, and said, "My father and my brothers, their flocks and their herds and all that they possess, have come from the land of Canaan; and indeed they are in the land of Goshen."
chapters.kjv: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ അഞ്ചുപേരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു ഫറവോന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.
chapters.nkjv: And he took five men from among his brothers and presented them to Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഫറവോൻ അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങളുടെ തൊഴിൽ എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവർ ഫറവോനോടു: അടിയങ്ങളും അടിയങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരും ഇടയന്മാരാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh asked the brothers, "What is your occupation?" "Your servants are shepherds," they replied to Pharaoh, "just as our fathers were."
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh said to his brothers, "What is your occupation?" And they said to Pharaoh, "Your servants are shepherds, both we and also our fathers."
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തു താമസിപ്പാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; കനാൻ ദേശത്തു ക്ഷാമം കഠിനമായിരിക്കയാൽ അടിയങ്ങളുടെ ആടുകൾക്കു മേച്ചലില്ല; അടിയങ്ങൾ ഗോശെൻ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ എന്നും അവർ ഫറവോനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They also said to him, "We have come to live here for a while, because the famine is severe in Canaan and your servants’ flocks have no pasture. So now, please let your servants settle in Goshen."
chapters.nkjv: And they said to Pharaoh, "We have come to dwell in the land, because your servants have no pasture for their flocks, for the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen."
chapters.kjv: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ യോസേഫിനോടു: നിന്റെ അപ്പനും സഹോദരന്മാരും നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Your father and your brothers have come to you,
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, "Your father and your brothers have come to you.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംദേശം നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; ദേശത്തിലേക്കും നല്ലഭാഗത്തു നിന്റെ അപ്പനെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും പാർപ്പിക്ക; അവർ ഗോശെൻ ദേശത്തുതന്നേ പാർത്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ. അവരിൽ പ്രാപ്തന്മാർ ഉണ്ടെന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവരെ എന്റെ ആടുമാടുകളുടെ മേൽ വിചാരകന്മാരാക്കി വെക്കുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and your brothers in the best part of the land. Let them live in Goshen. And if you know of any among them with special ability, put them in charge of my own livestock."
chapters.nkjv: The land of Egypt is before you. Have your father and brothers dwell in the best of the land; let them dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know any competent men among them, then make them chief herdsmen over my livestock."
chapters.kjv: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ്‌ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യാക്കോബിനെയും അകത്തു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു, അവനെ ഫറവോന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിർത്തി,
chapters.niv: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ഫറവോനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു. ഫറവോൻ യാക്കോബിനോടു: എത്ര വയസ്സായി എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh asked him, "How old are you?"
chapters.nkjv: Pharaoh said to Jacob, "How old are you?"
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ഫറവോനോടു: എന്റെ പരദേശപ്രയാണത്തിന്റെ കാലം നൂറ്റിമുപ്പതു സംവത്സരം ആയിരിക്കുന്നു. എന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ചുരുക്കവും കഷ്ടമുള്ളതും അത്രേ; എന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ പരദേശപ്രയാണമായ ആയുഷ്കാലത്തോളം എത്തീട്ടുമില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty. My years have been few and difficult, and they do not equal the years of the pilgrimage of my fathers."
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The days of the years of my pilgrimage are one hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage."
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് ഫറവോനെ പിന്നെയും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു ഫറവോന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോസേഫ് തന്റെ അപ്പനെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും കുടിപാർപ്പിച്ചു; ഫറവോൻ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർക്കു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിലേക്കും നല്ല ഭാഗമായ രമെസേസ് ദേശത്തു അവകാശവും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Joseph settled his father and his brothers in Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh directed.
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph situated his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

chapters.ml: യോസെഫ് തന്റെ അപ്പനെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും അപ്പന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെ ഒക്കെയും കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളുടെ എണ്ണത്തിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം ആഹാരം കൊടുത്തു രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father’s household with food, according to the number of their children.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all his father’s household with bread, according to the number in their families.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ക്ഷാമം ഏറ്റവും കഠിനമായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ദേശത്തെങ്ങും ആഹാരമില്ലാതെയായി മിസ്രയീംദേശവും കനാൻ ദേശവും ക്ഷാമംകൊണ്ടു വലഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: There was no food, however, in the whole region because the famine was severe; both Egypt and Canaan wasted away because of the famine.
chapters.nkjv: Now therewas no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished because of the famine.
chapters.kjv: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

chapters.ml: ജനങ്ങൾ വാങ്ങിയ ധാന്യത്തിന്നു വിലയായി യോസേഫ് മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തും കനാൻ ദേശത്തുമുള്ള പണം ഒക്കെയും ശേഖരിച്ചു; പണം യോസേഫ് ഫറവോന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh’s palace.
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought; and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തും കനാൻ ദേശത്തും പണം ഇല്ലാതെയായപ്പോൾ മിസ്രയീമ്യർ ഒക്കെയും യോസേഫിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ആഹാരം തരേണം; ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കിടന്നു മരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? പണം തീർന്നുപോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the money of the people of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all Egypt came to Joseph and said, "Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? Our money is all gone."
chapters.nkjv: So when the money failed in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, "Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For the money has failed."
chapters.kjv: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോസേഫ്: നിങ്ങളുടെ ആടുമാടുകളെ തരുവിൻ; പണം തീർന്നുപോയെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ആടുമാടുകളെ വിലയായി വാങ്ങി ഞാൻ തരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Then bring your livestock," said Joseph. "I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock, since your money is gone."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph said, "Give your livestock, and I will give you bread for your livestock, if the money is gone."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ കന്നുകാലികളെ യോസേഫിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; കുതിര, ആടു, കന്നുകാലി, കഴുത എന്നിവയെ യോസേഫ് വിലയായി വാങ്ങി അവർക്കു ആഹാരം കൊടുത്തു; ആയാണ്ടിൽ അവരുടെ കന്നുകാലികളെ എല്ലാം വാങ്ങി ആഹാരം കൊടുത്തു അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their sheep and goats, their cattle and donkeys. And he brought them through that year with food in exchange for all their livestock.
chapters.nkjv: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread inexchange for the horses, the flocks, the cattle of the herds, and for the donkeys. Thus he fed them with bread inexchange for all their livestock that year.
chapters.kjv: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

chapters.ml: ആ ആണ്ടു കഴിഞ്ഞു പിറ്റെ ആണ്ടിൽ അവർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പണം ചെലവായി, മൃഗക്കൂട്ടങ്ങളും യജമാനന്നു ചേർന്നു; ഞങ്ങളുടെ ശരീരങ്ങളും നിലങ്ങളുമല്ലാതെ യജമാനന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഒന്നും ശേഷിപ്പില്ല എന്നുള്ളതു യജമാനനെ ഞങ്ങൾ മറെക്കുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: When that year was over, they came to him the following year and said, "We cannot hide from our lord the fact that since our money is gone and our livestock belongs to you, there is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.
chapters.nkjv: When that year had ended, they came to him the next year and said to him, "We will not hide from my lord that our money is gone; my lord also has our herds of livestock. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord but our bodies and our lands.
chapters.kjv: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളും ഞങ്ങളുടെ നിലവും നിന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ എന്തിന്നു നശിക്കുന്നു? നീ ഞങ്ങളെയും നിലത്തെയും ആഹാരത്തിന്നു വിലയായി വാങ്ങേണം. ഞങ്ങൾ നിലവുമായി ഫറവോന്നു അടിമകൾ ആകട്ടെ. ഞങ്ങൾ മരിക്കാതെ ജീവനോടിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും നിലം ശൂന്യമായി പോകാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വിത്തു തരേണം.
chapters.niv: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Buy us and our land in exchange for food, and we with our land will be in bondage to Pharaoh. Give us seed so that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate."
chapters.nkjv: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants of Pharaoh; give us seed, that we may live and not die, that the land may not be desolate."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോസേഫ് മിസ്രയീമിലെ നിലം ഒക്കെയും ഫറവോന്നു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങി; ക്ഷാമം പ്രബലപ്പെടുകകൊണ്ടു മിസ്രയീമ്യർ തങ്ങളുടെ നിലം വിറ്റു; നിലമെല്ലാം ഫറവോന്നു ആയി.
chapters.niv: So Joseph bought all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh. The Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields, because the famine was too severe for them. The land became Pharaoh’s,
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe upon them. So the land became Pharaoh’s.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

chapters.ml: ജനങ്ങളേയോ അവൻ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിന്റെ അറ്റംമുതൽ അറ്റംവരെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലേക്കു കുടിനീക്കി പാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.
chapters.nkjv: And as for the people, he moved them into the cities, from one end of the borders of Egypt to the other end.
chapters.kjv: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ നിലം മാത്രം അവൻ വാങ്ങിയില്ല; പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കു ഫറവോൻ അവകാശം കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു; ഫറവോൻ അവർക്കു കൊടുത്ത അവകാശം കൊണ്ടു അവർ ഉപജീവനം കഴിച്ചതിനാൽ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ നിലം വിറ്റില്ല.
chapters.niv: However, he did not buy the land of the priests, because they received a regular allotment from Pharaoh and had food enough from the allotment Pharaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.
chapters.nkjv: Only the land of the priests he did not buy; for the priests had rations allottedtothem by Pharaoh, and they ate their rations which Pharaoh gave them; therefore they did not sell their lands.
chapters.kjv: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് ജനങ്ങളോടു: ഞാൻ ഇന്നു നിങ്ങളെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ നിലത്തെയും ഫറവോന്നു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾക്കു വിത്തു ഇതാ; നിലം വിതെച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Joseph said to the people, "Now that I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh, here is seed for you so you can plant the ground.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph said to the people, "Indeed I have bought you and your land this day for Pharaoh. Look, hereis seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
chapters.kjv: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

chapters.ml: വിളവെടുക്കുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ ഫറവോന്നു അഞ്ചിലൊന്നു കൊടുക്കേണം; നാലോഹരിയോ, വിത്തിന്നു വിത്തായിട്ടും നിങ്ങൾക്കും നിങ്ങളുടെ വീടുകളിലുള്ളവർക്കും നിങ്ങളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികൾക്കും ആഹാരമായിട്ടും നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നേ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But when the crop comes in, give a fifth of it to Pharaoh. The other four-fifths you may keep as seed for the fields and as food for yourselves and your households and your children."
chapters.nkjv: And it shall come to pass in the harvest that you shall give one-fifth to Pharaoh. Four-fifths shall be your own, as seed for the field and for your food, for those of your households and as food for your little ones."
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവനെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; യജമാനന്നു ഞങ്ങളോടു ദയയുണ്ടായാൽ മതി; ഞങ്ങൾ ഫറവോന്നു അടിമകളായിക്കൊള്ളാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You have saved our lives," they said. "May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh."
chapters.nkjv: So they said, "You have saved our lives; let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.
