chapters.ml: അഞ്ചിലൊന്നു ഫറവൊന്നു ചെല്ലേണം എന്നിങ്ങിനെ യോസേഫ് മിസ്രയീമിലെ നിലങ്ങളെ സംബന്ധിച്ചുവെച്ച ചട്ടം ഇന്നുവരെയും നടപ്പാകുന്നു. പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ നിലം മാത്രം ഫറവോന്നു ചേർന്നിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: So Joseph established it as a law concerning land in Egypt—still in force today—that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh. It was only the land of the priests that did not become Pharaoh’s.
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have one-fifth, except for the land of the priests only, which did not become Pharaoh’s.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ മിസ്രയീംരാജ്യത്തിലെ ഗോശെൻ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു; അവിടെ അവകാശം സമ്പാദിച്ചു, ഏറ്റവും സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവരായി പെരുകിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the Israelites settled in Egypt in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and were fruitful and increased greatly in number.
chapters.nkjv: So Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions there and grew and multiplied exceedingly.
chapters.kjv: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു വന്നിട്ടു പതിനേഴു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു; യാക്കോബിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം ആകെ നൂറ്റിനാല്പത്തേഴു സംവത്സരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, and the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the length of Jacob’s life was one hundred and forty-seven years.
chapters.kjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ മരിപ്പാനുള്ള കാലം അടുത്തപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ മകനായ യോസേഫിനെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു അവനോടു: നിനക്കു എന്നോടു കൃപയുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിന്റെ കൈ എന്റെ തുടയിൽകീഴിൽ വെക്കുക; എന്നോടു ദയയും വിശ്വസ്തതയും കാണിച്ചു എന്നെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ അടക്കാതെ,
chapters.niv: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called for his son Joseph and said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise that you will show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,
chapters.nkjv: When the time drew near that Israel must die, he called his son Joseph and said to him, "Now if I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please do not bury me in Egypt,
chapters.kjv: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രകൊള്ളുമ്പോൾ എന്നെ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി അവരുടെ ശ്മശാനഭൂമിയിൽ അടക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. നിന്റെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം ഞാൻ ചെയ്യാം എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but when I rest with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried." "I will do as you say," he said.
chapters.nkjv: but let me lie with my fathers; you shall carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burial place." And he said, "I will do as you have said."
chapters.kjv: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

chapters.ml: എന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്ക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ സത്യവും ചെയ്തു; അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽ കട്ടിലിന്റെ തലെക്കൽ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Swear to me," he said. Then Joseph swore to him, and Israel worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Swear to me." And he swore to him. So Israel bowed himself on the head of the bed.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോസേഫിന്നു: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ദീനമായി കിടക്കുന്നു എന്നു വർത്തമാനം വന്നു; ഉടനെ അവൻ മനശ്ശെ, എഫ്രയീം എന്ന രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു:
chapters.niv: Some time later Joseph was told, "Your father is ill." So he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim along with him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass after these things that Joseph was told, "Indeed your father is sick"; and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ മകൻ യോസേഫ് ഇതാവരുന്നു എന്നു യാക്കോബിനെ അറിയിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽ തന്നെത്താൻ ഉറപ്പിച്ചു കട്ടിലിന്മേൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jacob was told, "Your son Joseph has come to you," Israel rallied his strength and sat up on the bed.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob was told, "Look, your son Joseph is coming to you"; and Israel strengthened himself and sat up on the bed.
chapters.kjv: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് യോസേഫിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവം കനാൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ലൂസ്സിൽവെച്ചു എനിക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി എന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me
chapters.nkjv: Then Jacob said to Joseph: "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me,
chapters.kjv: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

chapters.ml: എന്നോടു: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സന്താനപുഷ്ടിയുള്ളവനാക്കി പെരുക്കി നിന്നെ ജനസമൂഹമാക്കുകയും നിന്റെ ശേഷം നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കു ഈ ദേശം ശാശ്വതാവകാശമായി കൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: and said to me, ‘I am going to make you fruitful and increase your numbers. I will make you a community of peoples, and I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants after you.’
chapters.nkjv: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will make of you a multitude of people, and give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
chapters.kjv: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഞാൻ വരുംമുമ്പെ നിനക്കു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുവെച്ചു ജനിച്ച രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായ മനശ്ശെയും എഫ്രയീമും എനിക്കുള്ളവർ ആയിരിക്കട്ടെ; രൂബേനും ശിമെയോനും എന്നപോലെ അവർ എനിക്കുള്ളവരായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "Now then, your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here will be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
chapters.nkjv: And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you in Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
chapters.kjv: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

chapters.ml: ഇവരുടെ ശേഷം നിനക്കു ജനിക്കുന്ന സന്തതിയോ നിനക്കുള്ളവരായിരിക്കട്ടെ; അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശത്തിൽ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ പേരിൻ പ്രകാരം വിളിക്കപ്പെടട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Any children born to you after them will be yours; in the territory they inherit they will be reckoned under the names of their brothers.
chapters.nkjv: Your offspring whom you beget after them shall be yours; they will be called by the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
chapters.kjv: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പദ്ദനിൽനിന്നു വരുമ്പോൾ, കനാൻ ദേശത്തു എഫ്രാത്തിൽ എത്തുവാൻ അല്പം ദൂരം മാത്രമുള്ളപ്പോൾ വഴിയിൽവെച്ചു റാഹേൽ മരിച്ചു; ഞാൻ അവളെ അവിടെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെം എന്ന എഫ്രാത്തിന്നുള്ള വഴിയരികെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: As I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan while we were still on the way, a little distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath" (that is, Bethlehem).
chapters.nkjv: But as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when therewas but a little distance to go to Ephrath; and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)."
chapters.kjv: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ യോസേഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ കണ്ടുപ്പോൾ: ഇവർ ആരെന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, "Who are these?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, "Who are these?"
chapters.kjv: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ഇവിടെ എനിക്കു തന്നിട്ടുള്ള പുത്രന്മാർ എന്നു യോസേഫ് അപ്പനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. അവരെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരിക; ഞാൻ അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കും എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "They are the sons God has given me here," Joseph said to his father. Then Israel said, "Bring them to me so I may bless them."
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph said to his father, "They are my sons, whom God has given me in this place." And he said, "Please bring them to me, and I will bless them."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place . And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കണ്ണു വയസ്സുകൊണ്ടു മങ്ങി കാണ്മാൻ വഹിയാതിരുന്നു; അവരെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരെ ചുംബിച്ചു ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Now Israel’s eyes were failing because of old age, and he could hardly see. So Joseph brought his sons close to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
chapters.nkjv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim with age, sothat he could not see. Then Joseph brought them near him, and he kissed them and embraced them.
chapters.kjv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ യോസേഫിനോടു: നിന്റെ മുഖം കാണുമെന്നു ഞാൻ വിചാരിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല; എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെയും കാണ്മാൻ ദൈവം എനിക്കു സംഗതിവരുത്തിയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Israel said to Joseph, "I never expected to see your face again, and now God has allowed me to see your children too."
chapters.nkjv: And Israel said to Joseph, "I had not thought to see your face; but in fact, God has also shown me your offspring!"
chapters.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അവരെ അവന്റെ മുഴങ്കാലുകൾക്കിടയിൽ നിന്നു മാറ്റി സാഷ്ടാംഗം നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Joseph removed them from Israel’s knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph brought them from beside his knees, and he bowed down with his face to the earth.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോസേഫ് എഫ്രയീമിനെ വലങ്കൈകൊണ്ടു പിടിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ഇടങ്കൈക്കു നേരെയും മനശ്ശെയെ ഇടങ്കൈകൊണ്ടു പിടിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ വലങ്കൈക്കു നേരെയുമായി ഇങ്ങനെ രണ്ടുപേരെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Joseph took both of them, Ephraim on his right toward Israel’s left hand and Manasseh on his left toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them close to him.
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim with his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh with his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near him.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ വലങ്കൈ നീട്ടി ഇളയവനായ എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ തലയിലും ഇടങ്കൈ മൂത്തവനായ മനശ്ശെയുടെ തലയിലുമായി അങ്ങനെ തന്റെ കൈകളെ പിണെച്ചുവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Israel reached out his right hand and put it on Ephraim’s head, though he was the younger, and crossing his arms, he put his left hand on Manasseh’s head, even though Manasseh was the firstborn.
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel stretched out his right hand and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
chapters.kjv: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ യോസേഫിനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു: എന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരായ അബ്രാഹാമും യിസ്ഹാക്കും ഭജിച്ചുപോന്ന ദൈവം, ഞാൻ ജനിച്ച നാൾമുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെയും എന്നെ പുലർത്തിയിരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവം,
chapters.niv: Then he blessed Joseph and said, "May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked faithfully, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
chapters.nkjv: And he blessed Joseph, and said: "God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, The God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
chapters.kjv: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

chapters.ml: എന്നെ സകലദോഷങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും വിടുവിച്ച ദൂതൻ ഈ കുട്ടികളെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ; എന്റെ പേരും എന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെയും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെയും പേരും ഇവരിൽ നിലനില്ക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ; അവർ ഭൂമിയിൽ കൂട്ടമായി വർദ്ധിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: the Angel who has delivered me from all harm —may he bless these boys. May they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they increase greatly on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: The Angel who has redeemed me from all evil, Bless the lads; Let my name be named upon them, And the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; And let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth."
chapters.kjv: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൻ വലങ്കൈ എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ തലയിൽവെച്ചു എന്നു യോസേഫ് കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവന്നു അനിഷ്ടം തോന്നി; അപ്പന്റെ കൈ എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ തലയിൽനിന്നു മനശ്ശെയുടെ തലയിൽ മാറ്റിവെപ്പാൻ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Joseph saw his father placing his right hand on Ephraim’s head he was displeased; so he took hold of his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him; so he took hold of his father’s hand to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
chapters.kjv: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അപ്പനോടു: അങ്ങനെയല്ല, എന്റെ അപ്പാ; ഇവനല്ലോ ആദ്യജാതൻ; ഇവന്റെ തലയിൽ വലങ്കൈ വെക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joseph said to him, "No, my father, this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph said to his father, "Not so, my father, for this oneis the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ സമ്മതിക്കാതെ എനിക്കു അറിയാം; മകനേ, എനിക്കു അറിയാം; ഇവനും ഒരു വലിയ ജനമായിത്തീരും, ഇവനും വർദ്ധിക്കും; എങ്കിലും അനുജൻ അവനെക്കാൾ അധികം വർദ്ധിക്കും; അവന്റെ സന്തതി ജനസമൂഹമായ്തീരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He too will become a people, and he too will become great. Nevertheless, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become a group of nations."
chapters.nkjv: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He also shall become a people, and he also shall be great; but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his descendants shall become a multitude of nations."
chapters.kjv: And his father refused, and said, I know it , my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അന്നു അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു: ദൈവം നിന്നെ എഫ്രയീമിനെയും മനശ്ശെയെയുംപോലെ ആക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു യിസ്രായേല്യർ നിന്റെ പേർ ചൊല്ലി അനുഗ്രഹിക്കും. എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു എഫ്രയീമിനെ മനശ്ശെക്കു മുമ്പാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He blessed them that day and said, "In your name will Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’ " So he put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.
chapters.nkjv: So he blessed them that day, saying, "By you Israel will bless, saying, ‘May God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh!’ " And thus he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
chapters.kjv: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിനോടു യിസ്രായേൽ പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ മരിക്കുന്നു; ദൈവം നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു നിങ്ങളെ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദേശത്തേക്കു മടക്കി കൊണ്ടുപോകും.
chapters.niv: Then Israel said to Joseph, "I am about to die, but God will be with you and take you back to the land of your fathers.
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel said to Joseph, "Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
chapters.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വാളും വില്ലുംകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അമോർയ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു പിടിച്ചടക്കിയ മലഞ്ചരിവു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ ഓഹരിയിൽ കവിഞ്ഞതായി നിനക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And to you I give one more ridge of land than to your brothers, the ridge I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow."
chapters.nkjv: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amorite with my sword and my bow."
chapters.kjv: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ വിളിച്ചു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: കൂടിവരുവിൻ, ഭാവികാലത്തു നിങ്ങൾക്കു സംഭവിപ്പാനുള്ളതു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ അറിയിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob called for his sons and said: "Gather around so I can tell you what will happen to you in days to come.
chapters.nkjv: And Jacob called his sons and said, "Gather together, that I may tell you what shall befall you in the last days:
chapters.kjv: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരേ: കൂടിവന്നു കേൾപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനായ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മൊഴിക്കു ചെവിതരുവിൻ!
chapters.niv: "Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
chapters.nkjv: "Gather together and hear, you sons of Jacob, And listen to Israel your father.
chapters.kjv: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

chapters.ml: രൂബേനേ, നീ എന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ, എന്റെ വീര്യവും എന്റെ ശക്തിയുടെ ആദ്യഫലവും ശ്രേഷ്ഠതയുടെ വൈശിഷ്ട്യവും ബലത്തിന്റെ വൈശിഷ്ട്യവും തന്നേ
chapters.niv: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, the first sign of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.
chapters.nkjv: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, My might and the beginning of my strength, The excellency of dignity and the excellency of power.
chapters.kjv: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

chapters.ml: വെള്ളംപോലെ തുളുമ്പുന്നവനേ, നീ ശ്രേഷ്ഠനാകയില്ല; നീ അപ്പന്റെ കിടക്കമേൽ കയറി അതിനെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കി; എന്റെ ശയ്യമേൽ അവൻ കയറിയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Turbulent as the waters, you will no longer excel, for you went up onto your father’s bed, onto my couch and defiled it.
chapters.nkjv: Unstable as water, you shall not excel, Because you went up to your father’s bed; Then you defiled it— He went up to my couch.
chapters.kjv: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

chapters.ml: ശിമയോനും ലേവിയും സഹോദരന്മാർ; അവരുടെ വാളുകൾ സാഹസത്തിന്റെ ആയുധങ്ങൾ.
chapters.niv: "Simeon and Levi are brothers— their swords are weapons of violence.
chapters.nkjv: "Simeon and Levi are brothers; Instruments of cruelty arein their dwelling place.
chapters.kjv: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

chapters.ml: എൻ ഉള്ളമേ, അവരുടെ മന്ത്രണത്തിൽ കൂടരുതേ; എൻ മനമേ, അവരുടെ യോഗത്തിൽ ചേരരുതേ; തങ്ങളുടെ കോപത്തിൽ അവർ പുരുഷന്മാരെ കൊന്നു; തങ്ങളുടെ ശാഠ്യത്തിൽ കൂറ്റന്മാരുടെ വരിയുടെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Let me not enter their council, let me not join their assembly, for they have killed men in their anger and hamstrung oxen as they pleased.
chapters.nkjv: Let not my soul enter their council; Let not my honor be united to their assembly; For in their anger they slew a man, And in their self-will they hamstrung an ox.
chapters.kjv: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ഉഗ്രകോപവും കഠിനക്രോധവും ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടതു; ഞാൻ അവരെ യാക്കോബിൽ പകക്കയും യിസ്രായേലിൽ ചിതറിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Cursed be their anger, so fierce, and their fury, so cruel! I will scatter them in Jacob and disperse them in Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Cursed be their anger, for itis fierce; And their wrath, for it is cruel! I will divide them in Jacob And scatter them in Israel.
chapters.kjv: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയേ, സഹോദരന്മാർ നിന്നെ പുകഴ്ത്തും; നിന്റെ കൈ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കഴുത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കും; അപ്പന്റെ മക്കൾ നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നമസ്കരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons will bow down to you.
chapters.nkjv: "Judah, you arehe whom your brothers shall praise; Your hand shallbe on the neck of your enemies; Your father’s children shall bow down before you.
chapters.kjv: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

chapters.ml: യഹൂദാ ഒരു ബാലസിംഹം; മകനേ, നീ ഇരപിടിച്ചു കയറിയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ കുനിഞ്ഞു, സിംഹംപോലെയും സിംഹിപോലെയും പതുങ്ങിക്കിടക്കുന്നു; ആർ അവനെ എഴുന്നേല്പിക്കും?
chapters.niv: You are a lion’s cub, Judah; you return from the prey, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse him?
chapters.nkjv: Judah is a lion’s whelp; From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He bows down, he lies down as a lion; And as a lion, who shall rouse him?
chapters.kjv: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

chapters.ml: അവകാശമുള്ളവൻ വരുവോളം ചെങ്കോൽ യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നും രാജദണ്ഡു അവന്റെ കാലുകളുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നും നീങ്ങിപ്പോകയില്ല; ജാതികളുടെ അനുസരണം അവനോടു ആകും.
chapters.niv: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his.
chapters.nkjv: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, Nor a lawgiver from between his feet, Until Shiloh comes; And to Him shallbe the obedience of the people.
chapters.kjv: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be .

chapters.ml: അവൻ മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയോടു ചെറുകഴുതയെയും വിശിഷ്ടമുന്തിരിവള്ളിയോടു കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെയും കെട്ടുന്നു; അവൻ വീഞ്ഞിൽ തന്റെ ഉടുപ്പും ദ്രാക്ഷാരസത്തിൽ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രവും അലക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He will tether his donkey to a vine, his colt to the choicest branch; he will wash his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
chapters.nkjv: Binding his donkey to the vine, And his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, He washed his garments in wine, And his clothes in the blood of grapes.
chapters.kjv: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കണ്ണു വീഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു ചുവന്നും അവന്റെ പല്ലു പാലുകൊണ്ടു വെളുത്തും ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: His eyes will be darker than wine, his teeth whiter than milk.
chapters.nkjv: His eyes are darker than wine, And his teeth whiter than milk.
chapters.kjv: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂൻ സമുദ്രതീരത്തു വസിക്കും; അവൻ കപ്പൽതുറമുഖത്തു പാർക്കും; അവന്റെ പാർശ്വം സീദോൻ വരെ ആകും.
chapters.niv: "Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.
chapters.nkjv: "Zebulun shall dwell by the haven of the sea; He shallbecome a haven for ships, And his border shall adjoin Sidon.
chapters.kjv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാർ അസ്ഥിബലമുള്ള കഴുത; അവൻ തൊഴുത്തുകളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ കിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down among the sheep pens.
chapters.nkjv: "Issachar is a strong donkey, Lying down between two burdens;
chapters.kjv: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

chapters.ml: വിശ്രാമം നല്ലതെന്നും ദേശം ഇമ്പമുള്ളതെന്നും കണ്ടു, അവൻ ചുമടിന്നു ചുമൽ കൊടുത്തു ഊഴിയത്തിന്നു ദാസനായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he sees how good is his resting place and how pleasant is his land, he will bend his shoulder to the burden and submit to forced labor.
chapters.nkjv: He saw that rest was good, And that the land was pleasant; He bowed his shoulder to bear aburden, And became a band of slaves.
chapters.kjv: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

chapters.ml: ദാൻ ഏതൊരു യിസ്രായേല്യഗോത്രവുംപോലെ സ്വജനത്തിന്നു ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: "Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: "Dan shall judge his people As one of the tribes of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

chapters.ml: ദാൻ വഴിയിൽ ഒരു പാമ്പും പാതയിൽ ഒരു സർപ്പവും ആകുന്നു; അവൻ കുതിരയുടെ കുതികാൽ കടിക്കും; പുറത്തു കയറിയവൻ മലർന്നു വീഴും.
chapters.niv: Dan will be a snake by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
chapters.nkjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, A viper by the path, That bites the horse’s heels So that its rider shall fall backward.
chapters.kjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ രക്ഷക്കായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I look for your deliverance, Lord .
chapters.nkjv: I have waited for your salvation, O Lord!
chapters.kjv: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD .

chapters.ml: ഗാദോ കവർച്ചപ്പട അവനെ ഞെരുക്കും; അവനോ അവരുടെ പിമ്പടയെ ഞെരുക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.
chapters.nkjv: "Gad, a troop shall tramp upon him, But he shall triumph at last.
chapters.kjv: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

chapters.ml: ആശേരോ, അവന്റെ ആഹാരം പുഷ്ടിയുള്ളതു; അവൻ രാജകീയസ്വാദുഭോജനം നല്കും.
chapters.niv: "Asher’s food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.
chapters.nkjv: "Bread from Asher shallbe rich, And he shall yield royal dainties.
chapters.kjv: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലി സ്വതന്ത്രയായി നടക്കുന്ന പേടമാൻ; അവൻ ലാവണ്യവാക്കുകൾ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
chapters.nkjv: "Naphtali is a deer let loose; He uses beautiful words.
chapters.kjv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് ഫലപ്രദമായോരു വൃക്ഷം, നീരുറവിന്നരികെ ഫലപ്രദമായോരു വൃക്ഷം തന്നേ; അതിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകൾ മതിലിന്മേൽ പടരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.
chapters.nkjv: "Joseph is a fruitful bough, A fruitful bough by a well; His branches run over the wall.
chapters.kjv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

chapters.ml: വില്ലാളികൾ അവനെ വിഷമിപ്പിച്ചു; അവർ എയ്തു, അവനോടു പൊരുതു.
chapters.niv: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.
chapters.nkjv: The archers have bitterly grieved him, Shot athim and hated him.
chapters.kjv: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him , and hated him:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വില്ലു ഉറപ്പോടെ നിന്നു; അവന്റെ ഭുജം യാക്കോബിൻ വല്ലഭന്റെ കയ്യാൽ ബലപ്പെട്ടു; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പാറയായ ഇടയന്റെ നാമത്താൽ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: But his bow remained steady, his strong arms stayed limber, because of the hand of the Mighty One of Jacob, because of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
chapters.nkjv: But his bow remained in strength, And the arms of his hands were made strong By the hands of the Mighty God of Jacob (From there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel),
chapters.kjv: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

chapters.ml: നിൻ പിതാവിന്റെ ദൈവത്താൽ - അവൻ നിന്നെ സഹായിക്കും സർവ്വശക്തനാൽ തന്നേ - അവൻ മീതെ ആകാശത്തിന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങളാലും താഴെ കിടക്കുന്ന ആഴത്തിന്റെ അനുഗ്രങ്ങളാലും മുലയുടെയും ഗർഭത്തിന്റെയും അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങളാലും നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കും.
chapters.niv: because of your father’s God, who helps you, because of the Almighty, who blesses you with blessings of the skies above, blessings of the deep springs below, blessings of the breast and womb.
chapters.nkjv: By the God of your father who will help you, And by the Almighty who will bless you With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that lies beneath, Blessings of the breasts and of the womb.
chapters.kjv: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

chapters.ml: നിൻ പിതാവിന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ എൻ ജനകന്മാരുടെ അനുഗ്രഹങ്ങൾക്കു മീതെ ശാശ്വതഗിരികളുടെ അറ്റത്തോളം പ്രബലപ്പെട്ടു. അവ യോസേഫിന്റെ തലയിലും തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ പ്രഭുവായവന്റെ നെറുകയിലും വരും.
chapters.niv: Your father’s blessings are greater than the blessings of the ancient mountains, than the bounty of the age-old hills. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.
chapters.nkjv: The blessings of your father Have excelled the blessings of my ancestors, Up to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills. They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him who was separate from his brothers.
chapters.kjv: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ കടിച്ചു കീറുന്ന ചെന്നായി; രാവിലേ അവൻ ഇരപിടിച്ചു വിഴുങ്ങും; വൈകുന്നേരത്തു അവൻ കവർച്ച പങ്കിടും.
chapters.niv: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder."
chapters.nkjv: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; In the morning he shall devour the prey, And at night he shall divide the spoil."
chapters.kjv: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായെൽ ഗോത്രം പന്ത്രണ്ടും ഇവ ആകുന്നു; അവരുടെ പിതാവു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു ഇതു തന്നേ; അവൻ അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്നു അവനവന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹം കൊടുത്തു അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, giving each the blessing appropriate to him.
chapters.nkjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them. And he blessed them; he blessed each one according to his own blessing.
chapters.kjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു ആജ്ഞാപിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ജനത്തോടു ചേരുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ ഹിത്യനായ എഫ്രോന്റെ നിലത്തിലെ ഗുഹയിൽ എന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ എന്നെ അടക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Then he gave them these instructions: "I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
chapters.nkjv: Then he charged them and said to them: "I am to be gathered to my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
chapters.kjv: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

chapters.ml: കനാൻ ദേശത്തു മമ്രേക്കു സമീപം, അബ്രാഹാം ഹിത്യനായ എഫ്രോനോടു നിലത്തോടുകൂടെ ശ്മശാനഭൂമിയായി ജന്മം വാങ്ങിയ മക്ക്പേലാ എന്ന നിലത്തിലെ ഗുഹയിൽ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.
chapters.nkjv: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite as a possession for a burial place.
chapters.kjv: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവർ അബ്രാഹാമിനെയും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സാറയെയും യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെയും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ റിബെക്കയെയും അടക്കി; അവിടെ ഞാൻ ലേയയെയും അടക്കി.
chapters.niv: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.
chapters.nkjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife, there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I buried Leah.
chapters.kjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

chapters.ml: ആ നിലവും അതിലെ ഗുഹയും ഹിത്യരോടു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങിയതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. "
chapters.nkjv: The field and the cave that is there were purchased from the sons of Heth."
chapters.kjv: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടു ആജ്ഞാപിച്ചു തീർന്നശേഷം അവൻ കാൽ കട്ടിലിന്മേൽ എടുത്തു വെച്ചിട്ടു പ്രാണനെവിട്ടു തന്റെ ജനത്തോടു ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.
chapters.nkjv: And when Jacob had finished commanding his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed and breathed his last, and was gathered to his people.
chapters.kjv: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോസേഫ് തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ മുഖത്തു വീണു കരഞ്ഞു അവനെ ചുംബിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph fell on his father’s face, and wept over him, and kissed him.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ തന്റെ അപ്പന്നു സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം ഇടുവാൻ യോസേഫ് തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരായ വൈദ്യന്മാരോടു കല്പിച്ചു; വൈദ്യന്മാർ യിസ്രായേലിനു സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നാല്പതു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞു; സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം ഇടുവാൻ അത്ര ദിവസം വേണ്ടി വരും. മിസ്രയീമ്യർ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുപതു ദിവസം വിലാപം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
chapters.nkjv: Forty days were required for him, for such are the days required for those who are embalmed; and the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
chapters.kjv: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

chapters.ml: അവന്നായുള്ള വിലാപകാലം കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ യോസേഫ് ഫറവോന്റെ ഗൃഹക്കാരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്നോടു ദയ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഫറവോനോടു:
chapters.niv: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, "If I have found favor in your eyes, speak to Pharaoh for me. Tell him,
chapters.nkjv: Now when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the household of Pharaoh, saying, "If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the hearing of Pharaoh, saying,
chapters.kjv: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അപ്പൻ: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ മരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ കനാൻ ദേശത്തു എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി വെട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്ന കല്ലറയിൽ തന്നേ നീ എന്നെ അടക്കേണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു. ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ പോയി എന്റെ അപ്പനെ അടക്കി മടങ്ങി വരുവാൻ അനുവാദത്തിന്നു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉണർത്തിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: ‘My father made me swear an oath and said, "I am about to die; bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan." Now let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.’ "
chapters.nkjv: ‘My father made me swear, saying, "Behold, I am dying; in my grave which I dug for myself in the land of Canaan, there you shall bury me." Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come back.’ "
chapters.kjv: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചതു പോലെ നീ പോയി അവനെ അടക്കുക എന്നു ഫറവോൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do."
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear."
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോസേഫ് അപ്പനെ അടക്കുവാൻ പൊയി; ഫറവോന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരും കോവിലധികാരികളും
chapters.niv: So Joseph went up to bury his father. All Pharaoh’s officials accompanied him—the dignitaries of his court and all the dignitaries of Egypt—
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
chapters.kjv: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിലെ പ്രമാണികളും യോസേഫിന്റെ കുടുംബം ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും പിതൃഭവനവും അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി; തങ്ങളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളെയും ആടുമാടുകളെയും മാത്രം അവർ ഗോശെൻ ദേശത്തു വിട്ടേച്ചുപോയി
chapters.niv: besides all the members of Joseph’s household and his brothers and those belonging to his father’s household. Only their children and their flocks and herds were left in Goshen.
chapters.nkjv: as well as all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds they left in the land of Goshen.
chapters.kjv: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

chapters.ml: രഥങ്ങളും കുതിരയാളുകളും അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി; അതു എത്രയും വലിയ കൂട്ടമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.
chapters.nkjv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen, and it was a very great gathering.
chapters.kjv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെയുള്ള ഗോരെൻ-ആതാദിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവിടെവെച്ചു എത്രയും ഗൌരവമായ പ്രലാപം കഴിച്ചു; ഇങ്ങനെ അവൻ ഏഴു ദിവസം തന്റെ അപ്പനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലാപം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan, they lamented loudly and bitterly; and there Joseph observed a seven-day period of mourning for his father.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and they mourned there with a great and very solemn lamentation. He observed seven days of mourning for his father.
chapters.kjv: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

chapters.ml: ദേശനിവാസികളായ കനാന്യർ ഗോരെൻ-ആതാദിലെ വിലാപം കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഇതു മിസ്രയീമ്യരുടെ മഹാവിലാപം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ആബേൽ-മിസ്രയീം എന്നു പേരായി; അതു യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Canaanites who lived there saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "The Egyptians are holding a solemn ceremony of mourning." That is why that place near the Jordan is called Abel Mizraim.
chapters.nkjv: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "This is a deep mourning of the Egyptians." Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നതു പോലെ പുത്രന്മാർ അവന്നു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:
chapters.nkjv: So his sons did for him just as he had commanded them.
chapters.kjv: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അവനെ കനാൻ ദേശത്തേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി, മമ്രേക്കു സമീപം അബ്രാഹാം ഹിത്യനായ എഫ്രോനോടു നിലത്തോടു കൂടെ ശ്മശാനഭൂമിയായി ജന്മം വാങ്ങിയ മക്ക്പേലയെന്ന നിലത്തിലെ ഗുഹയിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre, which Abraham had bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.
chapters.nkjv: For his sons carried him to the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, before Mamre, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as property for a burial place.
chapters.kjv: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അപ്പനെ അടക്കിയശേഷം അവനും സഹോദരനും അവന്റെ അപ്പനെ അടക്കുവാൻ കൂടെ പോയിരുന്ന എല്ലാവരും മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.
chapters.nkjv: And after he had buried his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers and all who went up with him to bury his father.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു യോസേഫിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ കണ്ടിട്ടു: പക്ഷേ യോസേഫ് നമ്മെ ദ്വേഷിച്ചു, നാം അവനോടു ചെയ്ത സകലദോഷത്തിന്നും നമ്മോടു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യുമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?"
chapters.nkjv: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "Perhaps Joseph will hate us, and may actually repay us for all the evil which we did to him."
chapters.kjv: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോസേഫിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: അപ്പൻ മരിക്കും മുമ്പെ: നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ നിന്നോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്തു; അവർ ചെയ്ത അതിക്രമവും പാപവും നീ ക്ഷമിക്കേണം എന്നു യോസേഫിനോടു പറവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, "Your father left these instructions before he died:
chapters.nkjv: So they sent messengers to Joseph, saying, "Before your father died he commanded, saying,
chapters.kjv: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അപ്പന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ ദ്രോഹം ക്ഷമിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറയിച്ചു. അവർ യോസേഫിനോടു സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I ask you to forgive your brothers the sins and the wrongs they committed in treating you so badly.’ Now please forgive the sins of the servants of the God of your father." When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Thus you shall say to Joseph: "I beg you, please forgive the trespass of your brothers and their sin; for they did evil to you." ’ Now, please, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of your father." And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
chapters.kjv: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ ചെന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ വീണു: ഇതാ, ഞങ്ങൾ നിനക്കു അടിമകൾ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His brothers then came and threw themselves down before him. "We are your slaves," they said.
chapters.nkjv: Then his brothers also went and fell down before his face, and they said, "Behold, we are your servants."
chapters.kjv: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സ്ഥാനത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: But Joseph said to them, "Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God?
chapters.nkjv: Joseph said to them, "Do not be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ നേരെ ദോഷം വിചാരിച്ചു; ദൈവമോ, ഇന്നുള്ളതുപോലെ ബഹുജനത്തിന്നു ജീവരക്ഷ വരുത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിനെ ഗുണമാക്കിത്തീർത്തു.
chapters.niv: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.
chapters.nkjv: But as for you, you meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, in order to bring it about as itis this day, to save many people alive.
chapters.kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളെയും പോറ്റി രക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവരെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിച്ചു ധൈര്യപ്പെടുത്തി.
chapters.niv: So then, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your children." And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, do not be afraid; I will provide for you and your little ones." And he comforted them and spoke kindly to them.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫും അവന്റെ പിതൃഭവനവും മിസ്രയീമിൽ പാർത്തു, യോസേഫ് നൂറ്റിപ്പത്തു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father’s family. He lived a hundred and ten years
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his father’s household. And Joseph lived one hundred and ten years.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ മൂന്നാം തലമുറയിലെ മക്കളെയും കണ്ടു; മനശ്ശെയുടെ മകനായ മാഖീരിന്റെ മക്കളും യോസേഫിന്റെ മടിയിൽ വളർന്നു.
chapters.niv: and saw the third generation of Ephraim’s children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph’s knees.
chapters.nkjv: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were also brought up on Joseph’s knees.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോസേഫ് തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു: ഞാൻ മരിക്കുന്നു;എന്നാൽ ദൈവം നിങ്ങളെ സന്ദർശിക്കയും ഈ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു താൻ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടും യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടും യാക്കോബിനോടും സത്യംചെയ്ത ദേശത്തേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die. But God will surely come to your aid and take you up out of this land to the land he promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob."
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph said to his brethren, "I am dying; but God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land to the land of which He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നിങ്ങളെ സന്ദർശിക്കുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ അസ്ഥികളെ ഇവിടെനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപോകേണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു യോസേഫ് യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Joseph made the Israelites swear an oath and said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, "God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here."
chapters.kjv: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് നൂറ്റിപ്പത്തു വയസ്സുള്ളവനായി മരിച്ചു. അവർ അവന്നു സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം ഇട്ടു അവനെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ഒരു ശവപ്പെട്ടിയിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten. And after they embalmed him, he was placed in a coffin in Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: So Joseph died, being one hundred and ten years old; and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
chapters.kjv: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിനോടുകൂടെ താന്താന്റെ കുടുംബസഹിതം മിസ്രയീമിൽ വന്ന യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളുടെ പേരുകൾ ആവിതു:
chapters.niv: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the names of the children of Israel who came to Egypt; each man and his household came with Jacob:
chapters.kjv: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

chapters.ml: രൂബേൻ, ശിമെയോൻ, ലേവി,
chapters.niv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah;
chapters.nkjv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;
chapters.kjv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ, യിസ്സാഖാർ, സെബൂലൂൻ, ബെന്യാമീൻ
chapters.niv: Issachar, Zebulun and Benjamin;
chapters.nkjv: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;
chapters.kjv: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

chapters.ml: ദാൻ, നഫ്താലി, ഗാദ്, ആശേർ.
chapters.niv: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.
chapters.nkjv: Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
chapters.kjv: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ കടിപ്രദേശത്തുനിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിച്ച ദേഹികൾ എല്ലാം കൂടെ എഴുപതു പേർ ആയിരുന്നു; യോസേഫോ മുമ്പെ തന്നേ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all; Joseph was already in Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: All those who were descendants of Jacob were seventy persons (for Joseph was in Egypt already).
chapters.kjv: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already .

chapters.ml: യോസേഫും സഹോദരന്മാരെല്ലാവരും ആ തലമുറ ഒക്കെയും മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph died, all his brothers, and all that generation.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ സന്താനസമ്പന്നരായി അത്യന്തം വർദ്ധിച്ചു പെരുകി ബലപ്പെട്ടു; ദേശം അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but the Israelites were exceedingly fruitful; they multiplied greatly, increased in numbers and became so numerous that the land was filled with them.
chapters.nkjv: But the children of Israel were fruitful and increased abundantly, multiplied and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോസേഫിനെ അറിയാത്ത പുതിയോരു രാജാവു മിസ്രയീമിൽ ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.
chapters.kjv: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ജനത്തോടു: യിസ്രായേൽ ജനം നമ്മെക്കാൾ ബാഹുല്യവും ശക്തിയുമുള്ളവരാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Look," he said to his people, "the Israelites have become far too numerous for us.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to his people, "Look, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we;
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:

chapters.ml: അവർ പെരുകീട്ടു ഒരു യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന പക്ഷം നമ്മുടെ ശത്രുക്കളോടു ചേർന്നു നമ്മോടു പൊരുതു ഈ രാജ്യം വിട്ടു പൊയ്ക്കളവാൻ സംഗതി വരാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നാം അവരോടു ബുദ്ധിയായി പെരുമാറുക.
chapters.niv: Come, we must deal shrewdly with them or they will become even more numerous and, if war breaks out, will join our enemies, fight against us and leave the country."
chapters.nkjv: come, let us deal shrewdly with them, lest they multiply, and it happen, in the event of war, that they also join our enemies and fight against us, and so go up out of the land."
chapters.kjv: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ കഠിനവേലകളാൽ അവരെ പീഡിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെമേൽ ഊഴിയവിചാരകന്മാരെ ആക്കി; അവർ പീഥോം, റയംസേസ് എന്ന സംഭാരനഗരങ്ങളെ ഫറവോന്നു പണിതു.
chapters.niv: So they put slave masters over them to oppress them with forced labor, and they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh supply cities, Pithom and Raamses.
chapters.kjv: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ പീഡിപ്പിക്കുന്തോറും ജനം പെരുകി വർദ്ധിച്ചു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾനിമിത്തം പേടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites
chapters.nkjv: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were in dread of the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമ്യർ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെക്കൊണ്ടു കഠിനവേല ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and worked them ruthlessly.
chapters.nkjv: So the Egyptians made the children of Israel serve with rigor.
chapters.kjv: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

chapters.ml: കളിമണ്ണും ഇഷ്ടികയും വയലിലെ സകലവിധവേലയും സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള കഠിനപ്രവർത്തിയാലും അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു കാഠിന്യത്തോടെ ചെയ്യിച്ച സകലപ്രയത്നത്താലും അവർ അവരുടെ ജീവനെ കൈപ്പാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made their lives bitter with harsh labor in brick and mortar and with all kinds of work in the fields; in all their harsh labor the Egyptians worked them ruthlessly.
chapters.nkjv: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage— in mortar, in brick, and in all manner of service in the field. All their service in which they made them serve was with rigor.
chapters.kjv: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവു ശിപ്രാ എന്നും പൂവാ എന്നും പേരുള്ള എബ്രായസൂതികർമ്മിണികളോടു:
chapters.niv: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of one was Shiphrah and the name of the other Puah;
chapters.kjv: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

chapters.ml: എബ്രായസ്ത്രീകളുടെ അടുക്കൽ നിങ്ങൾ സൂതികർമ്മത്തിന്നു ചെന്നു പ്രസവശയ്യയിൽ അവരെ കാണുമ്പോൾ കുട്ടി ആണാകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ അതിനെ കൊല്ലേണം; പെണ്ണാകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ജീവനോടിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "When you are helping the Hebrew women during childbirth on the delivery stool, if you see that the baby is a boy, kill him; but if it is a girl, let her live."
chapters.nkjv: and he said, "When you do the duties of a midwife for the Hebrew women, and see them on the birthstools, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live."
chapters.kjv: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

chapters.ml: സൂതികർമ്മിണികളോ ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു, മിസ്രയീം രാജാവു തങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ചെയ്യാതെ ആൺ കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do what the king of Egypt had told them to do; they let the boys live.
chapters.nkjv: But the midwives feared God, and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the male children alive.
chapters.kjv: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മിസ്രയീം രാജാവു സൂതികർമ്മിണികളെ വരുത്തി; ഇതെന്തൊരു പ്രവൃത്തി? നിങ്ങൾ ആൺകുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, "Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?"
chapters.nkjv: So the king of Egypt called for the midwives and said to them, "Why have you done this thing, and saved the male children alive?"
chapters.kjv: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

chapters.ml: സൂതികർമ്മിണികൾ ഫറവോനോടു: എബ്രായസ്ത്രീകൾ മിസ്രയീമ്യസ്ത്രീകളെപ്പോലെ അല്ല; അവർ നല്ല തിറമുള്ളവർ; സൂതികർമ്മിണികൾ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തുമ്മുമ്പെ അവർ പ്രസവിച്ചു കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The midwives answered Pharaoh, "Hebrew women are not like Egyptian women; they are vigorous and give birth before the midwives arrive."
chapters.nkjv: And the midwives said to Pharaoh, "Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women; for they are lively and give birth before the midwives come to them."
chapters.kjv: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവം സൂതികർമ്മിണികൾക്കു നന്മചെയ്തു; ജനം വർദ്ധിച്ചു ഏറ്റവം ബലപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So God was kind to the midwives and the people increased and became even more numerous.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied and grew very mighty.
chapters.kjv: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

chapters.ml: സൂതി കർമ്മിണികൾ ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടുകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവർക്കു കുടുംബവർദ്ധന നല്കി.
chapters.niv: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families of their own.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, because the midwives feared God, that He provided households for them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഫറവോൻ തന്റെ സകലജനത്തോടും: ജനിക്കുന്ന ഏതു ആൺകുട്ടിയെയും നദിയിൽ ഇട്ടുകളയേണമെന്നും ഏതു പെൺകുട്ടിയെയും ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമെന്നും കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: "Every Hebrew boy that is born you must throw into the Nile, but let every girl live."
chapters.nkjv: So Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, "Every son who is born you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive."
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ലേവികുടുംബത്തിലെ ഒരു പുരുഷൻ പോയി ഒരു ലേവ്യകന്യകയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now a man of the tribe of Levi married a Levite woman,
chapters.nkjv: And a man of the house of Levi went and took aswife a daughter of Levi.
chapters.kjv: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു. അവൻ സൌന്ദര്യമുള്ളവൻ എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവനെ മൂന്നു മാസം ഒളിച്ചുവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him for three months.
chapters.nkjv: So the woman conceived and bore a son. And when she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him three months.
chapters.kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child , she hid him three months.

chapters.ml: അവനെ പിന്നെ ഒളിച്ചുവെപ്പാൻ കഴിയാതെ ആയപ്പോൾ അവൾ ഒരു ഞാങ്ങണപ്പെട്ടകം വാങ്ങി, അതിന്നു പശയും കീലും തേച്ചു, പൈതലിനെ അതിൽ കിടത്തി, നദിയുടെ അരികിൽ ഞാങ്ങണയുടെ ഇടയിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But when she could hide him no longer, she got a papyrus basket for him and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in it and put it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.
chapters.nkjv: But when she could no longer hide him, she took an ark of bulrushes for him, daubed it with asphalt and pitch, put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
chapters.kjv: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു എന്തു ഭവിക്കുമെന്നു അറിവാൻ അവന്റെ പെങ്ങൾ ദൂരത്തു നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: His sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.
chapters.nkjv: And his sister stood afar off, to know what would be done to him.
chapters.kjv: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഫറവോന്റെ പുത്രി നദിയിൽ കുളിപ്പാൻ വന്നു; അവളുടെ ദാസിമാർ നദീതീരത്തുകൂടി നടന്നു; അവൾ ഞാങ്ങണയുടെ ഇടയിൽ പെട്ടകം കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അതിനെ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ ദാസിയെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Pharaoh’s daughter went down to the Nile to bathe, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. She saw the basket among the reeds and sent her female slave to get it.
chapters.nkjv: Then the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river. And her maidens walked along the riverside; and when she saw the ark among the reeds, she sent her maid to get it.
chapters.kjv: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അതു തുറന്നാറെ പൈതലിനെ കണ്ടു: കുട്ടി ഇതാ, കരയുന്നു. അവൾക്കു അതിനോടു അലിവുതോന്നി: ഇതു എബ്രായരുടെ പൈതങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She opened it and saw the baby. He was crying, and she felt sorry for him. "This is one of the Hebrew babies," she said.
chapters.nkjv: And when she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the baby wept. So she had compassion on him, and said, "This is one of the Hebrews’ children."
chapters.kjv: And when she had opened it , she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പെങ്ങൾ ഫറവോന്റെ പുത്രിയോടു: ഈ പൈതലിന്നു മുലകൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഒരു എബ്രായസ്ത്രീയെ ഞാൻ ചെന്നു വിളിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവരേണമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then his sister asked Pharaoh’s daughter, "Shall I go and get one of the Hebrew women to nurse the baby for you?"
chapters.nkjv: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, "Shall I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?"
chapters.kjv: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്റെ പുത്രി അവളോടു: ചെന്നു കൊണ്ടു വരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. കന്യക ചെന്നു പൈതലിന്റെ അമ്മയെ വിളിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Yes, go," she answered. So the girl went and got the baby’s mother.
chapters.nkjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Go." So the maiden went and called the child’s mother.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്റെ പുത്രി അവളോടു: നീ ഈ പൈതലിനെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി മുലകൊടുത്തു വളർത്തേണം; ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ശമ്പളം തരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. സ്ത്രി പൈതലിനെ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി മുലകൊടുത്തു വളർത്തി.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you." So the woman took the baby and nursed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Take this child away and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages." So the woman took the child and nursed him.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

chapters.ml: പൈതൽ വളർന്നശേഷം അവൾ അവനെ ഫറവോന്റെ പുത്രിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു പോയി, അവൻ അവൾക്കു മകനായി: ഞാൻ അവനെ വെള്ളത്തിൽ നിന്നു വലിച്ചെടുത്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൾ അവന്നു മോശെ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the child grew older, she took him to Pharaoh’s daughter and he became her son. She named him Moses, saying, "I drew him out of the water."
chapters.nkjv: And the child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. So she called his name Moses, saying, "Because I drew him out of the water."
chapters.kjv: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു മോശെ മുതിർന്നശേഷം അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവരുടെ ഭാരമുള്ള വേല നോക്കി, തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ ഒരു എബ്രായനെ ഒരു മിസ്രയീമ്യൻ അടിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to where his own people were and watched them at their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out to his brethren and looked at their burdens. And he saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his brethren.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അങ്ങോട്ടും ഇങ്ങോട്ടും നോക്കീട്ടു ആരും ഇല്ലെന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ മിസ്രയീമ്യനെ അടിച്ചു കൊന്നു മണലിൽ മറവുചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Looking this way and that and seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
chapters.nkjv: So he looked this way and that way, and when he saw no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
chapters.kjv: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റേ ദിവസവും അവൻ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ രണ്ടു എബ്രായ പുരുഷന്മാർ തമ്മിൽ ശണ്ഠയിടുന്നതു കണ്ടു, അന്യായം ചെയ്തവനോടു: നിന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരനെ അടിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The next day he went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, "Why are you hitting your fellow Hebrew?"
chapters.nkjv: And when he went out the second day, behold, two Hebrew men were fighting, and he said to the one who did the wrong, "Why are you striking your companion?"
chapters.kjv: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നിന്നെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പ്രഭുവും ന്യായാധിപതിയും ആക്കിയവൻ ആർ? മിസ്രയീമ്യനെ കൊന്നതുപോലെ എന്നെയും കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ കാര്യം പ്രസിദ്ധമായിപ്പോയല്ലോ എന്നു മോശെ പറഞ്ഞു പേടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The man said, "Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian?" Then Moses was afraid and thought, "What I did must have become known."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you intend to kill me as you killed the Egyptian?" So Moses feared and said, "Surely this thing is known!"
chapters.kjv: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ ഈ കാര്യം കേട്ടാറെ മോശെയെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അന്വേഷിച്ചു. മോശെ ഫറവോന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോയി, മിദ്യാൻ ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു പാർത്തു; അവൻ ഒരു കിണറ്റിന്നരികെ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Pharaoh heard of this, he tried to kill Moses, but Moses fled from Pharaoh and went to live in Midian, where he sat down by a well.
chapters.nkjv: When Pharaoh heard of this matter, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh and dwelt in the land of Midian; and he sat down by a well.
chapters.kjv: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

chapters.ml: മിദ്യാനിലെ പുരോഹിതന്നു ഏഴു പുത്രിമാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവർ വന്നു അപ്പന്റെ ആടുകൾക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ വെള്ളം കോരി തൊട്ടികൾ നിറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
chapters.nkjv: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. And they came and drew water, and they filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
chapters.kjv: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇടയന്മാർ വന്നു അവരെ ആട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരെ സഹായിച്ചു അവരുടെ ആടുകളെ കുടിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some shepherds came along and drove them away, but Moses got up and came to their rescue and watered their flock.
chapters.nkjv: Then the shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
chapters.kjv: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനായ റെഗൂവേലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ: നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു ഇത്രവേഗം വന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the girls returned to Reuel their father, he asked them, "Why have you returned so early today?"
chapters.nkjv: When they came to Reuel their father, he said, "How isitthat you have come so soon today?"
chapters.kjv: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

chapters.ml: ഒരു മിസ്രയീമ്യൻ ഇടയന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ വിടുവിച്ചു, ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വെള്ളം കോരിത്തന്നു ആടുകളെ കുടിപ്പിച്ചു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They answered, "An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds. He even drew water for us and watered the flock."
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "An Egyptian delivered us from the hand of the shepherds, and he also drew enough water for us and watered the flock."
chapters.kjv: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പുത്രിമാരോടു: അവൻ എവിടെ? നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ വിട്ടേച്ചു പോന്നതെന്തു? ഭക്ഷണം കഴിപ്പാൻ അവനെ വിളിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "And where is he?" Reuel asked his daughters. "Why did you leave him? Invite him to have something to eat."
chapters.nkjv: So he said to his daughters, "And where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

chapters.ml: മോശെക്കു അവനോടുകൂടെ പാർപ്പാൻ സമ്മതമായി; അവൻ മോശെക്കു തന്റെ മകൾ സിപ്പോറയെ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Moses agreed to stay with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses was content to live with the man, and he gave Zipporah his daughter to Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു: ഞാൻ അന്യദേശത്തു പരദേശി ആയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു ഗേർശോം എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Zipporah gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, "I have become a foreigner in a foreign land."
chapters.nkjv: And she bore him a son. He called his name Gershom, for he said, "I have been a stranger in a foreign land."
chapters.kjv: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

chapters.ml: ഏറെ നാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു മിസ്രയീംരാജാവു മരിച്ചു. യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അടിമവേല നിമിത്തം നെടുവീർപ്പിട്ടു നിലവിളിച്ചു; അടിമവേല ഹേതുവായുള്ള നിലവിള ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: During that long period, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned in their slavery and cried out, and their cry for help because of their slavery went up to God.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened in the process of time that the king of Egypt died. Then the children of Israel groaned because of the bondage, and they cried out; and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവരുടെ നിലവിളി കേട്ടു; ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനോടും യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടും യാക്കോബിനോടും തനിക്കുള്ള നിയമവും ഓർത്തു.
chapters.niv: God heard their groaning and he remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: So God heard their groaning, and God remembered His covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
chapters.kjv: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു; ദൈവം അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So God looked on the Israelites and was concerned about them.
chapters.nkjv: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God acknowledged them.
chapters.kjv: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them .

chapters.ml: മോശെ മിദ്യാനിലെ പുരോഹിതനും തന്റെ അമ്മായപ്പനുമായ യിത്രോവിന്റെ ആടുകളെ മോയിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; അവൻ ആടുകളെ മരുഭൂമിക്കു അപ്പുറത്തു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പർവ്വതമായ ഹോരേബ് വരെ കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
chapters.nkjv: Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian. And he led the flock to the back of the desert, and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
chapters.kjv: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ ഒരു മുൾപടർപ്പിന്റെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു അഗ്നിജ്വാലയിൽ അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി. അവൻ നോക്കിയാറെ മുൾപടർപ്പു തീ പിടിച്ചു കത്തുന്നതും മുൾപടർപ്പു വെന്തുപോകാതിരിക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: There the angel of the Lord appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up.
chapters.nkjv: And the Angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire from the midst of a bush. So he looked, and behold, the bush was burning with fire, but the bush was not consumed.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

chapters.ml: മുൾപടർപ്പു വെന്തുപോകാതിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ വലിയ കാഴ്ച എന്തെന്നു ഞാൻ ചെന്നു നോക്കട്ടെ എന്നു മോശെ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Moses thought, "I will go over and see this strange sight—why the bush does not burn up."
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses said, "I will now turn aside and see this great sight, why the bush does not burn."
chapters.kjv: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

chapters.ml: നോക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ വരുന്നതു യഹോവ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ദൈവം മുൾപടർപ്പിന്റെ നടുവിൽ നിന്നു അവനെ മോശേ, മോശെ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the Lord saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, "Moses! Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."
chapters.nkjv: So when the Lord saw that he turned aside to look, God called to him from the midst of the bush and said, "Moses, Moses!" And he said, "Here I am."
chapters.kjv: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: ഇങ്ങോട്ടു അടുക്കരുതു; നീ നില്ക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലം വിശുദ്ധഭൂമിയാകയാൽ കാലിൽനിന്നു ചെരിപ്പു അഴിച്ചുകളക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Do not come any closer," God said. "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said, "Do not draw near this place. Take your sandals off your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദൈവവും യാക്കോബിന്റെ ദൈവവുമായി, നിന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ദൈവം ആകുന്നു എന്നും അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു. മോശെ ദൈവത്തെ നോക്കുവാൻ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു മുഖം മൂടി.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob." At this, Moses hid his face, because he was afraid to look at God.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover He said, "I am the God of your father—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look upon God.
chapters.kjv: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: മിസ്രയീമിലുള്ള എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ കഷ്ടത ഞാൻ കണ്ടു കണ്ടു; ഊഴിയവിചാരകന്മാർ നിമിത്തമുള്ള അവരുടെ നിലവിളിയും കേട്ടു; ഞാൻ അവരുടെ സങ്കടങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു.
