chapters.nkjv: And it shall be, when your children say to you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമ്യരെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കയിൽ മിസ്രയീമിലിരുന്ന യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ വീടുകളെ ഒഴിഞ്ഞു കടന്നു നമ്മുടെ വീടുകളെ രക്ഷിച്ച യഹോവയുടെ പെസഹയാഗം ആകുന്നു ഇതു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയേണം. അപ്പോൾ ജനം കുമ്പിട്ടു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: then tell them, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice to the Lord , who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt and spared our homes when he struck down the Egyptians.’ " Then the people bowed down and worshiped.
chapters.nkjv: that you shall say, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice of the Lord, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt when He struck the Egyptians and delivered our households.’ " So the people bowed their heads and worshiped.
chapters.kjv: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD’s passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പോയി അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു. യഹോവ മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ അവർ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites did just what the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel went away and did so; just as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

chapters.ml: അർദ്ധരാത്രിയിലോ, സിംഹാസനത്തിലിരുന്ന ഫറവോന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ മുതൽ കുണ്ടറയിൽ കിടന്ന തടവുകാരന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ വരെയും മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിലെ ആദ്യജാതന്മാരെയും മൃഗങ്ങളുടെ കടിഞ്ഞൂലുകളെയും എല്ലാം യഹോവ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At midnight the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on the throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner, who was in the dungeon, and the firstborn of all the livestock as well.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass at midnight that the Lord struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോനും അവന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരും സകല മിസ്രയീമ്യരും രാത്രിയിൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു; മിസ്രയീമിൽ വലിയോരു നിലവിളി ഉണ്ടായി; ഒന്നു മരിക്കാതെ ഒരു വീടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh and all his officials and all the Egyptians got up during the night, and there was loud wailing in Egypt, for there was not a house without someone dead.
chapters.nkjv: So Pharaoh rose in the night, he, all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for therewas not a house where therewas not one dead.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ മോശെയെയും അഹരോനെയും രാത്രിയിൽ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുമായി എഴുന്നേറ്റു എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു, നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ പോയി യഹോവയെ ആരാധിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: During the night Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Up! Leave my people, you and the Israelites! Go, worship the Lord as you have requested.
chapters.nkjv: Then he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, "Rise, go out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel. And go, serve the Lord as you have said.
chapters.kjv: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD , as ye have said.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ആടുകളെയും കന്നുകാലികളെയും കൂടെ കൊണ്ടുപോയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ; എന്നെയും അനുഗ്രഹിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Take your flocks and herds, as you have said, and go. And also bless me."
chapters.nkjv: Also take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also."
chapters.kjv: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമ്യർ ജനത്തെ നിർബന്ധിച്ചു വേഗത്തിൽ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു അയച്ചു: ഞങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും മരിച്ചു പോകുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Egyptians urged the people to hurry and leave the country. "For otherwise," they said, "we will all die!"
chapters.nkjv: And the Egyptians urged the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste. For they said, "We shall all be dead."
chapters.kjv: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men .

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ജനം കുഴെച്ച മാവു പുളിക്കുന്നതിന്നു മുമ്പെ തൊട്ടികളോടുകൂടെ ശീലകളിൽ കെട്ടി ചുമലിൽ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: So the people took their dough before the yeast was added, and carried it on their shoulders in kneading troughs wrapped in clothing.
chapters.nkjv: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, having their kneading bowls bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.
chapters.kjv: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മോശെയുടെ വചനം അനുസരിച്ചു മിസ്രയീമ്യരോടു വെള്ളിയാഭരണങ്ങളും പൊന്നാഭരണങ്ങളും വസ്ത്രങ്ങളും ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites did as Moses instructed and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold and for clothing.
chapters.nkjv: Now the children of Israel had done according to the word of Moses, and they had asked from the Egyptians articles of silver, articles of gold, and clothing.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു ജനത്തോടു കൃപ തോന്നിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ചോദിച്ചതൊക്കെയും അവർ അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു; അങ്ങനെ അവർ മിസ്രയീമ്യരെ കൊള്ളയിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The Lord had made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and they gave them what they asked for; so they plundered the Egyptians.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they granted them whattheyrequested. Thus they plundered the Egyptians.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required . And they spoiled the Egyptians.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ, കുട്ടികൾ ഒഴികെ ഏകദേശം ആറുലക്ഷം പുരുഷന്മാർ കാൽനടയായി റമസേസിൽനിന്നു സുക്കോത്തിലേക്കു യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Sukkoth. There were about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides children.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

chapters.ml: വലിയോരു സമ്മിശ്രപുരുഷാരവും ആടുകളും കന്നുകാലികളുമായി അനവധി മൃഗങ്ങളും അവരോടു കൂടെ പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Many other people went up with them, and also large droves of livestock, both flocks and herds.
chapters.nkjv: A mixed multitude went up with them also, and flocks and herds—a great deal of livestock.
chapters.kjv: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു കൊണ്ടു പോന്ന കുഴെച്ച മാവുകൊണ്ടു അവർ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത ദോശ ചുട്ടു; അവരെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ഒട്ടും താമസിപ്പിക്കാതെ ഓടിച്ചുകളകയാൽ അതു പുളിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല; അവർ വഴിക്കു ആഹാരം ഒന്നും ഒരുക്കിയിരുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: With the dough the Israelites had brought from Egypt, they baked loaves of unleavened bread. The dough was without yeast because they had been driven out of Egypt and did not have time to prepare food for themselves.
chapters.nkjv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they had brought out of Egypt; for it was not leavened, because they were driven out of Egypt and could not wait, nor had they prepared provisions for themselves.
chapters.kjv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മിസ്രയീമിൽ കഴിച്ച പരദേശവാസം നാനൂറ്റി മുപ്പതു സംവത്സരമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the length of time the Israelite people lived in Egypt was 430 years.
chapters.nkjv: Now the sojourn of the children of Israel who lived in Egypt was four hundred and thirty years.
chapters.kjv: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.

chapters.ml: നാനൂറ്റി മുപ്പതു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു, ആ ദിവസം തന്നെ, യഹോവയുടെ ഗണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the Lord ’s divisions left Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years—on that very same day—it came to pass that all the armies of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവരെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചതിനാൽ ഇതു അവന്നു പ്രത്യേകമായി ആചരിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന രാത്രി ആകുന്നു; ഇതു തന്നേ യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾ ഒക്കെയും തലമുറതലമുറയായി യഹോവെക്കു പ്രത്യേകം ആചരിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന രാത്രി.
chapters.niv: Because the Lord kept vigil that night to bring them out of Egypt, on this night all the Israelites are to keep vigil to honor the Lord for the generations to come.
chapters.nkjv: It is a night of solemn observance to the Lord for bringing them out of the land of Egypt. This is that night of the Lord, a solemn observance for all the children of Israel throughout their generations.
chapters.kjv: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും കല്പിച്ചതു: പെസഹയുടെ ചട്ടം ഇതു ആകുന്നു: അന്യജാതിക്കാരനായ ഒരുത്തനും അതു തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "These are the regulations for the Passover meal: "No foreigner may eat it.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "This is the ordinance of the Passover: No foreigner shall eat it.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദ്രവ്യം കൊടുത്തു വാങ്ങിയ ദാസന്നു ഒക്കെയും പരിച്ഛേദന ഏറ്റശേഷം അതു തിന്നാം.
chapters.niv: Any slave you have bought may eat it after you have circumcised him,
chapters.nkjv: But every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then he may eat it.
chapters.kjv: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

chapters.ml: പരദേശിയും കൂലിക്കാരനും അതു തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: but a temporary resident or a hired worker may not eat it.
chapters.nkjv: A sojourner and a hired servant shall not eat it.
chapters.kjv: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

chapters.ml: അതതു വീട്ടിൽവെച്ചു തന്നേ അതു തിന്നേണം; ആ മാംസം ഒട്ടും വീട്ടിന്നു പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകരുതു; അതിൽ ഒരു അസ്ഥിയും ഒടിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: "It must be eaten inside the house; take none of the meat outside the house. Do not break any of the bones.
chapters.nkjv: In one house it shall be eaten; you shall not carry any of the flesh outside the house, nor shall you break one of its bones.
chapters.kjv: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽസഭ ഒക്കെയും അതു ആചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The whole community of Israel must celebrate it.
chapters.nkjv: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
chapters.kjv: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

chapters.ml: ഒരു അന്യജാതിക്കാരൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു യഹോവെക്കു പെസഹ ആചരിക്കേണമെങ്കിൽ, അവന്നുള്ള ആണൊക്കെയും പരിച്ഛേദന ഏൽക്കേണം. അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അതു ആചരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്നു അടുത്തുവരാം; അവൻ സ്വദേശിയെപ്പോലെ ആകും. പരിച്ഛേദനയില്ലാത്ത ഒരുത്തനും അതു തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: "A foreigner residing among you who wants to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover must have all the males in his household circumcised; then he may take part like one born in the land. No uncircumcised male may eat it.
chapters.nkjv: And when a stranger dwells with you andwants to keep the Passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as a native of the land. For no uncircumcised person shall eat it.
chapters.kjv: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD , let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

chapters.ml: സ്വദേശിക്കും നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന പരദേശിക്കും ഒരു ന്യായപ്രമാണം തന്നേ ആയിരിക്കേണം; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഒക്കെയും അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The same law applies both to the native-born and to the foreigner residing among you."
chapters.nkjv: One law shall be for the native-born and for the stranger who dwells among you."
chapters.kjv: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ അവർ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: All the Israelites did just what the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.
chapters.nkjv: Thus all the children of Israel did; as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
chapters.kjv: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

chapters.ml: അന്നു തന്നേ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ ഗണം ഗണമായി മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And on that very day the Lord brought the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, on that very same day, that the Lord brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt according to their armies.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽ മനുഷ്യരിലും മൃഗങ്ങളിലും കടിഞ്ഞൂലായി പിറക്കുന്നതിന്നെ ഒക്കെയും എനിക്കായി ശുദ്ധീകരിക്ക; അതു എനിക്കുള്ളതാകുന്നു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: "Consecrate to me every firstborn male. The first offspring of every womb among the Israelites belongs to me, whether human or animal."
chapters.nkjv: "Consecrate to Me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and beast; it is Mine."
chapters.kjv: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾ അടിമവീടായ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോന്ന ഈ ദിവസത്തെ ഓർത്തു കൊൾവിൻ; യഹോവ ബലമുള്ള കൈകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളെ അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു; അതുകൊണ്ടു പുളിപ്പുള്ള അപ്പം തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses said to the people, "Commemorate this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery, because the Lord brought you out of it with a mighty hand. Eat nothing containing yeast.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said to the people: "Remember this day in which you went out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the Lord brought you out of this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

chapters.ml: ആബീബ് മാസം ഈ തിയ്യതി നിങ്ങൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Today, in the month of Aviv, you are leaving.
chapters.nkjv: On this day you are going out, in the month Abib.
chapters.kjv: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കനാന്യർ, ഹിത്യർ, അമോർയ്യർ, ഹിവ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ എന്നിവരുടെ ദേശമായി യഹോവ നിനക്കു തരുമെന്നു നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തതും പാലും തേനും ഒഴുകുന്നതുമായ ദേശത്തേക്കു നിന്നെ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നശേഷം നീ ഈ മാസത്തിൽ ഈ കർമ്മം ആചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: When the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites—the land he swore to your ancestors to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you are to observe this ceremony in this month:
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be, when the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Amorites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, which He swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.
chapters.kjv: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ദിവസം നീ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പം തിന്നേണം; ഏഴാം ദിവസം യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു ഉത്സവം ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: For seven days eat bread made without yeast and on the seventh day hold a festival to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day thereshallbe a feast to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ദിവസവും പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പം തിന്നേണം; നിന്റെ പക്കൽ പുളിപ്പുള്ള അപ്പം കാണരുതു; നിന്റെ അരികത്തെങ്ങും പുളിച്ചമാവും കാണരുതു.
chapters.niv: Eat unleavened bread during those seven days; nothing with yeast in it is to be seen among you, nor shall any yeast be seen anywhere within your borders.
chapters.nkjv: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days. And no leavened bread shall be seen among you, nor shall leaven be seen among you in all your quarters.
chapters.kjv: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ യഹോവ എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി ചെയ്ത കാര്യം നിമിത്തം ആകുന്നു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്നു നീ ആ ദിവസത്തിൽ നിന്റെ മകനോടു അറിയിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: On that day tell your son, ‘I do this because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
chapters.nkjv: And you shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘Thisisdone because of what the Lord did for me when I came up from Egypt.’
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം നിന്റെ വായിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇതു നിനക്കു നിന്റെ കയ്യിന്മേൽ അടയാളമായും നിന്റെ കണ്ണുകളുടെ നടുവിൽ ജ്ഞാപകലക്ഷ്യമായും ഇരിക്കെണം. ബലമുള്ള കൈകൊണ്ടല്ലോ യഹോവ നിന്നെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: This observance will be for you like a sign on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that this law of the Lord is to be on your lips. For the Lord brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand.
chapters.nkjv: It shall be as a sign to you on your hand and as a memorial between your eyes, that the Lord’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand the Lord has brought you out of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD’s law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.

chapters.ml: അതു കൊണ്ടു നീ ആണ്ടുതോറും നിശ്ചയിക്കപ്പെട്ട സമയത്തു ഈ ചട്ടം ആചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You must keep this ordinance at the appointed time year after year.
chapters.nkjv: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നിന്നോടും നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടും സത്യം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ നിന്നെ കനാന്യരുടെ ദേശത്തു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു അതു നിനക്കു തരുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: "After the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you, as he promised on oath to you and your ancestors,
chapters.nkjv: "And it shall be, when the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, as He swore to you and your fathers, and gives it to you,
chapters.kjv: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

chapters.ml: കടിഞ്ഞൂലിനെ ഒക്കെയും, നിനക്കുള്ള മൃഗങ്ങളുടെ കടിഞ്ഞൂൽപിറവിയെ ഒക്കെയും നീ യഹോവെക്കായി വേർതിരിക്കേണം; ആണൊക്കെയും യഹോവക്കുള്ളതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: you are to give over to the Lord the first offspring of every womb. All the firstborn males of your livestock belong to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: that you shall set apart to the Lord all that open the womb, that is, every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have; the males shallbe the Lord’s.
chapters.kjv: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD’s .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കഴുതയുടെ കടിഞ്ഞൂലിനെ ഒക്കെയും ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെക്കൊണ്ടു വീണ്ടുകൊള്ളേണം; അതിനെ വീണ്ടുകൊള്ളുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ അതിന്റെ കഴുത്തു ഒടിച്ചുകളയേണം. നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ആദ്യജാതനെ ഒക്കെയും നീ വീണ്ടുകൊള്ളേണം.
chapters.niv: Redeem with a lamb every firstborn donkey, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem every firstborn among your sons.
chapters.nkjv: But every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. And all the firstborn of man among your sons you shall redeem.
chapters.kjv: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇതു എന്തു എന്നു നാളെ നിന്റെ മകൻ നിന്നോടു ചോദിക്കുമ്പോൾ: യഹോവ ബലമുള്ള കൈകൊണ്ടു അടിമവീടായ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: "In days to come, when your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ say to him, ‘With a mighty hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
chapters.nkjv: So it shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall say to him, ‘By strength of hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
chapters.kjv: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ കഠിനപ്പെട്ടു ഞങ്ങളെ വിട്ടയക്കാതിരുന്നപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു മനുഷ്യന്റെ കടിഞ്ഞൂൽമുതൽ മൃഗത്തിന്റെ കടിഞ്ഞൂൽവരെയുള്ള കടിഞ്ഞൂൽപിറവിയെ ഒക്കെയും കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു. അതുകൊണ്ടു കടിഞ്ഞൂലായ ആണിനെ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗം അർപ്പിക്കുന്നു; എന്നാൽ എന്റെ മക്കളിൽ കടിഞ്ഞൂലിനെ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ വീണ്ടുകൊള്ളുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the Lord killed the firstborn of both people and animals in Egypt. This is why I sacrifice to the Lord the first male offspring of every womb and redeem each of my firstborn sons.’
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh was stubborn about letting us go, that the Lord killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man and the firstborn of beast. Therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all males that open the womb, but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

chapters.ml: അതു നിന്റെ കയ്യിന്മേൽ അടയാളമായും നിന്റെ കണ്ണുകളുടെ നടുവിൽ നെറ്റിപ്പട്ടമായും ഇരിക്കേണം. യഹോവ ഞങ്ങളെ ബലമുള്ള കൈകൊണ്ടു മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു എന്നു നീ അവനോടു പറയേണം.
chapters.niv: And it will be like a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead that the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand."
chapters.nkjv: It shall be as a sign on your hand and as frontlets between your eyes, for by strength of hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt."
chapters.kjv: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ ജനത്തെ വിട്ടയച്ച ശേഷം ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ ദേശത്തു കൂടിയുള്ള വഴി അടുത്തതു എന്നു വരികിലും ജനം യുദ്ധം കാണുമ്പോൾ പക്ഷേ അനുതപിച്ചു മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുമെന്നുവെച്ചു ദൈവം അവരെ അതിലെ കൊണ്ടുപോയില്ല;
chapters.niv: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them on the road through the Philistine country, though that was shorter. For God said, "If they face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: Then it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God did not lead them by way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, "Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and return to Egypt."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

chapters.ml: ചെങ്കടലരികെയുള്ള മരുഭൂമിയിൽകൂടി ദൈവം ജനത്തെ ചുറ്റിനടത്തി. യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So God led the people around by the desert road toward the Red Sea. The Israelites went up out of Egypt ready for battle.
chapters.nkjv: So God led the people around by way of the wilderness of the Red Sea. And the children of Israel went up in orderly ranks out of the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: മോശെ യോസേഫിന്റെ അസ്ഥികളും എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു പോന്നു. ദൈവം നിങ്ങളെ സന്ദർശിക്കും നിശ്ചയം; അപ്പോൾ എന്റെ അസ്ഥികളും നിങ്ങൾ ഇവിടെനിന്നു എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോകേണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെക്കൊണ്ടു ഉറപ്പായി സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the Israelites swear an oath. He had said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up with you from this place."
chapters.nkjv: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had placed the children of Israel under solemn oath, saying, "God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here with you."
chapters.kjv: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

chapters.ml: അവർ സുക്കോത്തിൽ നിന്നു യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ടു മരുഭൂമിക്കരികെ ഏഥാമിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: After leaving Sukkoth they camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.
chapters.nkjv: So they took their journey from Succoth and camped in Etham at the edge of the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അവർ പകലും രാവും യാത്രചെയ്‍വാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവർക്കു വഴികാണിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പകൽ മേഘസ്തംഭത്തിലും അവർക്കു വെളിച്ചം കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു രാത്രി അഗ്നിസ്തംഭത്തിലും യഹോവ അവർക്കു മുമ്പായി പൊയ്ക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By day the Lord went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel by day or night.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so as to go by day and night.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

chapters.ml: പകൽ മേഘസ്തംഭവും രാത്രി അഗ്നിസ്തംഭവും ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു മാറിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place in front of the people.
chapters.nkjv: He did not take away the pillar of cloud by day or the pillar of fire by night from before the people.
chapters.kjv: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ തിരിഞ്ഞു മിഗ്ദോലിന്നും കടലിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ ബാൽസെഫോന്നു സമീപത്തുള്ള പീഹഹീരോത്തിന്നരികെ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങേണമെന്നു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറക; അതിന്റെ സമീപത്തു സമുദ്രത്തിന്നരികെ നിങ്ങൾ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങേണം.
chapters.niv: "Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp near Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. They are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal Zephon.
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn and camp before Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, opposite Baal Zephon; you shall camp before it by the sea.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ ദേശത്തു ഉഴലുന്നു; മരുഭൂമിയിൽ കുടുങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഫറവോൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയും.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh will think, ‘The Israelites are wandering around the land in confusion, hemmed in by the desert.’
chapters.nkjv: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are bewildered by the land; the wilderness has closed them in.’
chapters.kjv: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ അവരെ പിന്തുടരുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഞാൻ അവന്റെഹൃദയം കഠിനമാക്കും. ഞാൻ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു എന്നു മിസ്രയീമ്യർ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു ഫറവോനിലും അവന്റെ സകലസൈന്യങ്ങളിലും ഞാൻ എന്നെ തന്നേ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തും.
chapters.niv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will pursue them. But I will gain glory for myself through Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord ." So the Israelites did this.
chapters.nkjv: Then I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, so that he will pursue them; and I will gain honor over Pharaoh and over all his army, that the Egyptians may know that I am the Lord." And they did so.
chapters.kjv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD . And they did so.

chapters.ml: അവർ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു. ജനം ഓടിപ്പോയി എന്നു മിസ്രയീംരാജാവിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ ജനത്തെ സംബന്ധിച്ചു ഫറവോന്റെയും അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുടെയും മനസ്സുമാറി: യിസ്രായേല്യരെ നമ്മുടെ അടിമവേലയിൽനിന്നു വിട്ടയച്ചുകളഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ; നാം ഈ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, "What have we done? We have let the Israelites go and have lost their services!"
chapters.nkjv: Now it was told the king of Egypt that the people had fled, and the heart of Pharaoh and his servants was turned against the people; and they said, "Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?"
chapters.kjv: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ രഥം കെട്ടിച്ചു പടജ്ജനത്തെയും
chapters.niv: So he had his chariot made ready and took his army with him.
chapters.nkjv: So he made ready his chariot and took his people with him.
chapters.kjv: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

chapters.ml: വിശേഷപ്പെട്ട അറുനൂറു രഥങ്ങളെയും മിസ്രയീമിലെ സകലരഥങ്ങളെയും അവെക്കു വേണ്ടുന്ന തേരാളികളെയും കൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: He took six hundred of the best chariots, along with all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.
chapters.nkjv: Also, he took six hundred choice chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt with captains over every one of them.
chapters.kjv: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോന്റെ ഹൃദയം കഠിനമാക്കിയതിനാൽ അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ പിന്തുടർന്നു. എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി പുറപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, so that he pursued the Israelites, who were marching out boldly.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; and the children of Israel went out with boldness.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്റെ എല്ലാ കുതിരയും രഥവും കുതിരപ്പടയും സൈന്യവുമായി മിസ്രയീമ്യർ അവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു; കടൽക്കരയിൽ ബാൽസെഫോന്നു സമീപത്തുള്ള പീഹഹീരോത്തിന്നു അരികെ അവർ പാളയമിറങ്ങിയിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവരോടു അടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The Egyptians—all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots, horsemen and troops—pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi Hahiroth, opposite Baal Zephon.
chapters.nkjv: So the Egyptians pursued them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen and his army, and overtook them camping by the sea beside Pi Hahiroth, before Baal Zephon.
chapters.kjv: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ അടുത്തുവരുമ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ തലഉയർത്തി മിസ്രയീമ്യർ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up, and there were the Egyptians, marching after them. They were terrified and cried out to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And when Pharaoh drew near, the children of Israel lifted their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians marched after them. So they were very afraid, and the children of Israel cried out to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവർ മോശെയോടു: മിസ്രയീമിൽ ശവക്കുഴിയില്ലാഞ്ഞിട്ടോ നീ ഞങ്ങളെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ മരിപ്പാൻ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു? നീ ഞങ്ങളെ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചതിനാൽ ഞങ്ങളോടു ഈ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: They said to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us to the desert to die? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt?
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to Moses, "Because therewere no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you so dealt with us, to bring us up out of Egypt?
chapters.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഞങ്ങളെ വിടേണം എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ മിസ്രയീമിൽവെച്ചു നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞില്ലയോ? മരുഭൂമിയിൽ മരിക്കുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു വേല ചെയ്യുന്നതായിരുന്നു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു നല്ലതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Didn’t we say to you in Egypt, ‘Leave us alone; let us serve the Egyptians’? It would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the desert!"
chapters.nkjv: Is this not the word that we told you in Egypt, saying, ‘Let us alone that we may serve the Egyptians’? For itwouldhavebeen better for us to serve the Egyptians than that we should die in the wilderness."
chapters.kjv: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മോശെ ജനത്തോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഉറച്ചുനില്പിൻ; യഹോവ ഇന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ചെയ്‍വാനിരിക്കുന്ന രക്ഷ കണ്ടുകൊൾവിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടുള്ള മിസ്രയീമ്യരെ ഇനി ഒരുനാളും കാണുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Moses answered the people, "Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the Lord will bring you today. The Egyptians you see today you will never see again.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which He will accomplish for you today. For the Egyptians whom you see today, you shall see again no more forever.
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD , which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി യുദ്ധംചെയ്യും; നിങ്ങൾ മിണ്ടാതിരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still."
chapters.nkjv: The Lord will fight for you, and you shall hold your peace."
chapters.kjv: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: നീ എന്നോടു നിലവിളിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? മുമ്പോട്ടു പോകുവാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറക.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Why are you crying out to me? Tell the Israelites to move on.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Why do you cry to Me? Tell the children of Israel to go forward.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

chapters.ml: വടി എടുത്തു നിന്റെ കൈ കടലിന്മേൽ നീട്ടി അതിനെ വിഭാഗിക്ക; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കടലിന്റെ നടുവെ ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടി കടന്നുപോകും.
chapters.niv: Raise your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea to divide the water so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.
chapters.nkjv: But lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. And the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
chapters.kjv: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീമ്യരുടെ ഹൃദയത്തെ കഠിനമാക്കും; അവർ ഇവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ ചെല്ലും; ഞാൻ ഫറവോനിലും അവന്റെ സകല സൈന്യത്തിലും അവന്റെ രഥങ്ങളിലും കുതിരപ്പടയിലും എന്നെത്തന്നെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തും.
chapters.niv: I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them. And I will gain glory through Pharaoh and all his army, through his chariots and his horsemen.
chapters.nkjv: And I indeed will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them. So I will gain honor over Pharaoh and over all his army, his chariots, and his horsemen.
chapters.kjv: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ ഫറവോനിലും അവന്റെ രഥങ്ങളിലും കുതിരപ്പടയിലും എന്നെത്തന്നെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു എന്നു മിസ്രയീമ്യർ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: The Egyptians will know that I am the Lord when I gain glory through Pharaoh, his chariots and his horsemen."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I have gained honor for Myself over Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen."
chapters.kjv: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്രായേല്യരുടെ സൈന്യത്തിന്നു മുമ്പായി നടന്ന ദൈവദൂതൻ അവിടെനിന്നു മാറി അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ നടന്നു; മേഘസ്തംഭവും അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു മാറി അവരുടെ പിമ്പിൽ പോയി നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the angel of God, who had been traveling in front of Israel’s army, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from in front and stood behind them,
chapters.nkjv: And the Angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud went from before them and stood behind them.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

chapters.ml: രാത്രി മുഴുവനും മിസ്രയീമ്യരുടെ സൈന്യവും യിസ്രായേല്യരുടെ സൈന്യവും തമ്മിൽ അടുക്കാതവണ്ണം അതു അവയുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ വന്നു; അവർക്കു മേഘവും അന്ധകാരവും ആയിരുന്നു; ഇവർക്കോ രാത്രിയെ പ്രകാശമാക്കിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: coming between the armies of Egypt and Israel. Throughout the night the cloud brought darkness to the one side and light to the other side; so neither went near the other all night long.
chapters.nkjv: So it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel. Thus it was a cloud and darkness totheone, and it gave light by night totheother, so that the one did not come near the other all that night.
chapters.kjv: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them , but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

chapters.ml: മോശെ കടലിന്മേൽ കൈനീട്ടി; യഹോവ അന്നു രാത്രി മുഴുവനും മഹാശക്തിയുള്ള ഒരു കിഴക്കൻ കാറ്റുകൊണ്ടു കടലിനെ പിൻവാങ്ങിച്ചു ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലം ആക്കി; അങ്ങനെ വെള്ളം തമ്മിൽ വേർപിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the Lord drove the sea back with a strong east wind and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided,
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea into dry land, and the waters were divided.
chapters.kjv: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land , and the waters were divided.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കടലിന്റെ നടുവിൽ ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടി നടന്നുപോയി; അവരുടെ ഇടത്തും വലത്തും വെള്ളം മതിലായി നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea on the dry ground, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമ്യർ പിന്തുടർന്നു; ഫറവോന്റെ കുതിരയും രഥങ്ങളും കുതിരപ്പടയും എല്ലാം അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ കടലിന്റെ നടുവിലേക്കു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Egyptians pursued them, and all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots and horsemen followed them into the sea.
chapters.nkjv: And the Egyptians pursued and went after them into the midst of the sea, all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
chapters.kjv: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

chapters.ml: പ്രഭാതയാമത്തിൽ യഹോവ അഗ്നിമേഘസ്തംഭത്തിൽനിന്നു മിസ്രയീമ്യസൈന്യത്തെ നോക്കി മിസ്രയീമ്യസൈന്യത്തെ താറുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: During the last watch of the night the Lord looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud at the Egyptian army and threw it into confusion.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, in the morning watch, that the Lord looked down upon the army of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and cloud, and He troubled the army of the Egyptians.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ രഥചക്രങ്ങളെ തെറ്റിച്ചു ഓട്ടം പ്രായസമാക്കി. അതുകൊണ്ടു മിസ്രയീമ്യർ: നാം യിസ്രായേലിനെ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോക; യഹോവ അവർക്കു വേണ്ടി മിസ്രയീമ്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He jammed the wheels of their chariots so that they had difficulty driving. And the Egyptians said, "Let’s get away from the Israelites! The Lord is fighting for them against Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: And He took off their chariot wheels, so that they drove them with difficulty; and the Egyptians said, "Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians."
chapters.kjv: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: വെള്ളം മിസ്രയീമ്യരുടെ മേലും അവരുടെ രഥങ്ങളിൻ മേലും കുതിരപ്പടയുടെമേലും മടങ്ങി വരേണ്ടതിന്നു കടലിന്മേൽ കൈനീട്ടുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come back upon the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

chapters.ml: മോശെ കടലിന്മേൽ കൈ നീട്ടി; പുലർച്ചെക്കു കടൽ അതിന്റെ സ്ഥിതിയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവന്നു. മിസ്രയീമ്യർ അതിന്നു എതിരായി ഓടി; യഹോവ മിസ്രയീമ്യരെ കടലിന്റെ നടുവിൽ തള്ളിയിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea went back to its place. The Egyptians were fleeing toward it, and the Lord swept them into the sea.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and when the morning appeared, the sea returned to its full depth, while the Egyptians were fleeing into it. So the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
chapters.kjv: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം മടങ്ങിവന്നു അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ കടലിലേക്കു ചെന്നിരുന്ന രഥങ്ങളെയും കുതിരപ്പടയെയും ഫറവോന്റെ സൈന്യത്തെയും എല്ലാം മുക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ പോലും ശേഷിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: The water flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen—the entire army of Pharaoh that had followed the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.
chapters.nkjv: Then the waters returned and covered the chariots, the horsemen, and all the army of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them. Not so much as one of them remained.
chapters.kjv: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കടലിന്റെ നടുവെ ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടി കടന്നുപോയി; വെള്ളം അവരുടെ ഇടത്തും വലത്തും മതിലായി നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.
chapters.nkjv: But the children of Israel had walked on dry land in the midst of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
chapters.kjv: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവ ആ ദിവസം യിസ്രായേല്യരെ മിസ്രയീമ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിച്ചു; മിസ്രയീമ്യർ കടൽക്കരയിൽ ചത്തടിഞ്ഞു കിടക്കുന്നതു യിസ്രായേല്യർ കാണുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: That day the Lord saved Israel from the hands of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians lying dead on the shore.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
chapters.kjv: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മിസ്രയീമ്യരിൽ ചെയ്ത ഈ മഹാപ്രവൃത്തി യിസ്രായേല്യർ കണ്ടു; ജനം യഹോവയെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു, യഹോവയിലും അവന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെയിലും വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And when the Israelites saw the mighty hand of the Lord displayed against the Egyptians, the people feared the Lord and put their trust in him and in Moses his servant.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Israel saw the great work which the Lord had done in Egypt; so the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord and His servant Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD , and believed the LORD , and his servant Moses.

chapters.ml: മോശെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളും അന്നു യഹോവെക്കു സങ്കീർത്തനം പാടി ചൊല്ലിയതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: ഞാൻ യഹോവെക്കു പാട്ടുപാടും, അവൻ മഹോന്നതൻ: കുതിരയെയും അതിന്മേൽ ഇരുന്നവനെയും അവൻ കടലിൽ തള്ളിയിട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the Lord : "I will sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. Both horse and driver he has hurled into the sea.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the Lord, and spoke, saying: "I will sing to the Lord, For He has triumphed gloriously! The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea!
chapters.kjv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD , and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD , for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ബലവും എന്റെ ഗീതവും യഹോവയത്രേ; അവൻ എനിക്കു രക്ഷയായ്തീർന്നു. അവൻ എന്റെ ദൈവം; ഞാൻ അവനെ സ്തുതിക്കും; അവൻ എന്റെ പിതാവിൻ ദൈവം; ഞാൻ അവനെ പുകഴ്ത്തും.
chapters.niv: "The Lord is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise him, my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
chapters.nkjv: The Lordis my strength and song, And He has become my salvation; He is my God, and I will praise Him; My father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
chapters.kjv: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യുദ്ധവീരൻ; യഹോവ എന്നു അവന്റെ നാമം.
chapters.niv: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.
chapters.nkjv: The Lordis a man of war; The Lordis His name.
chapters.kjv: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്റെ രഥങ്ങളെയും സൈന്യത്തെയും അവൻ കടലിൽ തള്ളിയിട്ടു; അവന്റെ രഥിപ്രവരന്മാർ ചെങ്കടലിൽ മുങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his army he has hurled into the sea. The best of Pharaoh’s officers are drowned in the Red Sea.
chapters.nkjv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his army He has cast into the sea; His chosen captains also are drowned in the Red Sea.
chapters.kjv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

chapters.ml: ആഴി അവരെ മൂടി; അവർ കല്ലുപോലെ ആഴത്തിൽ താണു.
chapters.niv: The deep waters have covered them; they sank to the depths like a stone.
chapters.nkjv: The depths have covered them; They sank to the bottom like a stone.
chapters.kjv: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, നിന്റെ വലങ്കൈ ബലത്തിൽ മഹത്വപ്പെട്ടു; യഹോവേ, നിന്റെ വലങ്കൈ ശത്രുവിനെ തകർത്തുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Your right hand, Lord , was majestic in power. Your right hand, Lord , shattered the enemy.
chapters.nkjv: "Your right hand, O Lord, has become glorious in power; Your right hand, O Lord, has dashed the enemy in pieces.
chapters.kjv: Thy right hand, O LORD , is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD , hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

chapters.ml: നീ എതിരാളികളെ മഹാപ്രഭാവത്താൽ സംഹരിക്കുന്നു; നീ നിന്റെ ക്രോധം അയക്കുന്നു; അതു അവരെ താളടിയെപ്പോലെ ദഹിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "In the greatness of your majesty you threw down those who opposed you. You unleashed your burning anger; it consumed them like stubble.
chapters.nkjv: And in the greatness of Your excellence You have overthrown those who rose against You; You sent forth Your wrath; It consumed them like stubble.
chapters.kjv: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ മൂക്കിലെ ശ്വാസത്താൽ വെള്ളം കുന്നിച്ചുകൂടി; പ്രവാഹങ്ങൾ ചിറപോലെ നിന്നു; ആഴങ്ങൾ കടലിന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ ഉറെച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: By the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up. The surging waters stood up like a wall; the deep waters congealed in the heart of the sea.
chapters.nkjv: And with the blast of Your nostrils The waters were gathered together; The floods stood upright like a heap; The depths congealed in the heart of the sea.
chapters.kjv: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പിന്തുടരും, പിടിക്കും, കൊള്ള പങ്കിടും; എന്റെ ആശ അവരാൽ പൂർത്തിയാകും; ഞാൻ എന്റെ വാൾ ഊരും; എന്റെ കൈ അവരെ നിഗ്രഹിക്കും എന്നു ശത്രു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The enemy boasted, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake them. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword and my hand will destroy them.’
chapters.nkjv: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; My desire shall be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword, My hand shall destroy them.’
chapters.kjv: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കാറ്റിനെ നീ ഊതിച്ചു, കടൽ അവരെ മൂടി; അവർ ഈയംപോലെ പെരുവെള്ളത്തിൽ താണു.
chapters.niv: But you blew with your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
chapters.nkjv: You blew with Your wind, The sea covered them; They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
chapters.kjv: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ദേവന്മാരിൽ നിനക്കു തുല്യൻ ആർ? വിശുദ്ധിയിൽ മഹിമയുള്ളവനേ, സ്തുതികളിൽ ഭയങ്കരനേ, അത്ഭുതങ്ങളെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നവനേ, നിനക്കു തുല്യൻ ആർ?
chapters.niv: Who among the gods is like you, Lord ? Who is like you— majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, working wonders?
chapters.nkjv: "Who is like You, O Lord, among the gods? Who is like You, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
chapters.kjv: Who is like unto thee, O LORD , among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

chapters.ml: നീ വലങ്കൈ നീട്ടി, ഭൂമി അവരെ വിഴുങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: "You stretch out your right hand, and the earth swallows your enemies.
chapters.nkjv: You stretched out Your right hand; The earth swallowed them.
chapters.kjv: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

chapters.ml: നീ വീണ്ടെടുത്ത ജനത്തെ ദയയാൽ നടത്തി; നിന്റെ വിശുദ്ധനിവാസത്തിലേക്കു നിന്റെ ബലത്താൽ അവരെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: In your unfailing love you will lead the people you have redeemed. In your strength you will guide them to your holy dwelling.
chapters.nkjv: You in Your mercy have led forth The people whom You have redeemed; You have guided them in Your strength To Your holy habitation.
chapters.kjv: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

chapters.ml: ജാതികൾ കേട്ടു നടങ്ങുന്നു. ഫെലിസ്ത്യനിവാസികൾക്കു ഭീതിപിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the people of Philistia.
chapters.nkjv: "The people will hear and be afraid; Sorrow will take hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
chapters.kjv: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

chapters.ml: എദോമ്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ഭ്രമിച്ചു; മോവാബ്യമുമ്പന്മാർക്കു കമ്പം പിടിച്ചു; കനാന്യ നിവാസികളെല്ലാം ഉരുകിപ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The chiefs of Edom will be terrified, the leaders of Moab will be seized with trembling, the people of Canaan will melt away;
chapters.nkjv: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; The mighty men of Moab, Trembling will take hold of them; All the inhabitants of Canaan will melt away.
chapters.kjv: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

chapters.ml: ഭയവും ഭീതിയും അവരുടെമേൽ വീണു, നിൻഭുജമാഹാത്മ്യത്താൽ അവർ കല്ലുപോലെ ആയി; അങ്ങനെ, യഹോവേ, നിന്റെ ജനം കടന്നു, നീ സമ്പാദിച്ച ജനം കടന്നു പോയി.
chapters.niv: terror and dread will fall on them. By the power of your arm they will be as still as a stone— until your people pass by, Lord , until the people you bought pass by.
chapters.nkjv: Fear and dread will fall on them; By the greatness of Your arm They will be as still as a stone, Till Your people pass over, O Lord, Till the people pass over Whom You have purchased.
chapters.kjv: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD , till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

chapters.ml: നീ അവരെ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നൊരുക്കിയ സ്ഥാനത്തു, യഹോവേ, നിന്നവകാശപർവ്വതത്തിൽ നീ അവരെ നട്ടു, കർത്താവേ, തൃക്കൈ സ്ഥാപിച്ച വിശുദ്ധ മന്ദിരത്തിങ്കൽ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your inheritance— the place, Lord , you made for your dwelling, the sanctuary, Lord, your hands established.
chapters.nkjv: You will bring them in and plant them In the mountain of Your inheritance, In the place, O Lord, which You have made For Your own dwelling, The sanctuary, O Lord, which Your hands have established.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എന്നും എന്നേക്കും രാജാവായി വാഴും.
chapters.niv: "The Lord reigns for ever and ever."
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord shall reign forever and ever."
chapters.kjv: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഫറവോന്റെ കുതിര അവന്റെ രഥവും കുതിരപ്പടയുമായി കടലിന്റെ നടുവിൽ ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെന്നപ്പോൾ യഹോവ കടലിലെ വെള്ളം അവരുടെ മേൽ മടക്കി വരുത്തി; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോ കടലിന്റെ നടുവിൽ ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടി കടന്നു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Pharaoh’s horses, chariots and horsemen went into the sea, the Lord brought the waters of the sea back over them, but the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.
chapters.nkjv: For the horses of Pharaoh went with his chariots and his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought back the waters of the sea upon them. But the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
chapters.kjv: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ സഹോദരി മിർയ്യാം എന്ന പ്രവാചകി കയ്യിൽ തപ്പു എടുത്തു, സ്ത്രീകൾ എല്ലാവരും തപ്പുകളോടും നൃത്തങ്ങളോടും കൂടെ അവളുടെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Miriam the prophet, Aaron’s sister, took a timbrel in her hand, and all the women followed her, with timbrels and dancing.
chapters.nkjv: Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took the timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
chapters.kjv: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

chapters.ml: മിർയ്യാം അവരോടും പ്രതിഗാനമായി ചൊല്ലിയതു: യഹോവെക്കു പാട്ടുപാടുവിൻ, അവൻ മഹോന്നതൻ: കുതിരയെയും അതിന്മേൽ ഇരുന്നവനെയും അവൻ കടലിൽ തള്ളിയിട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Miriam sang to them: "Sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. Both horse and driver he has hurled into the sea."
chapters.nkjv: And Miriam answered them: "Sing to the Lord, For He has triumphed gloriously! The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea!"
chapters.kjv: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD , for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം മോശെ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ചെങ്കടലിൽനിന്നു പ്രയാണം ചെയ്യിച്ചു; അവർ ശൂർമരുഭൂമിയിൽ ചെന്നു, മൂന്നു ദിവസം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വെള്ളം കിട്ടാതെ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea and they went into the Desert of Shur. For three days they traveled in the desert without finding water.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses brought Israel from the Red Sea; then they went out into the Wilderness of Shur. And they went three days in the wilderness and found no water.
chapters.kjv: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

chapters.ml: മാറയിൽ എത്തിയാറെ, മാറയിലെ വെള്ളം കുടിപ്പാൻ അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല; അതു കൈപ്പുള്ളതായിരുന്നു. അതുകൊണ്ടു അതിന്നു മാറാ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When they came to Marah, they could not drink its water because it was bitter. (That is why the place is called Marah. )
chapters.nkjv: Now when they came to Marah, they could not drink the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore the name of it was called Marah.
chapters.kjv: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ജനം: ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തു കുടിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു മോശെയുടെ നേരെ പിറുപിറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the people grumbled against Moses, saying, "What are we to drink?"
chapters.nkjv: And the people complained against Moses, saying, "What shall we drink?"
chapters.kjv: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; യഹോവ അവന്നു ഒരു വൃക്ഷം കാണിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു. അവൻ അതു വെള്ളത്തിൽ ഇട്ടപ്പോൾ വെള്ളം മധുരമായി തീർന്നു. അവിടെവെച്ചു അവൻ അവർക്കു ഒരു ചട്ടവും പ്രമാണവും നിയമിച്ചു; അവിടെവെച്ചു അവൻ അവരെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , and the Lord showed him a piece of wood. He threw it into the water, and the water became fit to drink. There the Lord issued a ruling and instruction for them and put them to the test.
chapters.nkjv: So he cried out to the Lord, and the Lord showed him a tree. When he cast it into the waters, the waters were made sweet. There He made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there He tested them,
chapters.kjv: And he cried unto the LORD ; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ വാക്കു നീ ശ്രദ്ധയോടെ കേട്ടു അവന്നു പ്രസാദമുള്ളതു ചെയ്കയും അവന്റെ കല്പനകളെ അനുസരിച്ചു അവന്റെ സകല വിധികളും പ്രമാണിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കു വരുത്തിയ വ്യാധികളിൽ ഒന്നും നിനക്കു വരുത്തുകയില്ല; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുന്ന യഹോവ ആകുന്നു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He said, "If you listen carefully to the Lord your God and do what is right in his eyes, if you pay attention to his commands and keep all his decrees, I will not bring on you any of the diseases I brought on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord , who heals you."
chapters.nkjv: and said, "If you diligently heed the voice of the Lord your God and do what is right in His sight, give ear to His commandments and keep all His statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have brought on the Egyptians. For I am the Lord who heals you."
chapters.kjv: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ ഏലീമിൽ എത്തി; അവിടെ പന്ത്രണ്ടു നീരുറവും എഴുപതു ഈത്തപ്പനയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർ അവിടെ വെള്ളത്തിന്നരികെ പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there near the water.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve wells of water and seventy palm trees; so they camped there by the waters.
chapters.kjv: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഏലീമിൽനിന്നു യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ടു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട രണ്ടാം മാസം പതിനഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി അവരുടെ സംഘം ഒക്കെയും ഏലീമിന്നും സീനായിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ഉള്ള സീൻമരുഭൂമിയിൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The whole Israelite community set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had come out of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: And they journeyed from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the Wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they departed from the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: ആ മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളുടെ സംഘം ഒക്കെയും മോശെക്കും അഹരോന്നും വിരോധമായി പിറുപിറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: In the desert the whole community grumbled against Moses and Aaron.
chapters.nkjv: Then the whole congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അവരോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ ഇറച്ചിക്കലങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കലിരിക്കയും തൃപ്തിയാകുംവണ്ണം ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കയും ചെയ്ത മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു വെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ കയ്യാൽ മരിച്ചിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു. നിങ്ങൾ ഈ സംഘത്തെ മുഴുവനും പട്ടിണിയിട്ടു കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഈ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites said to them, "If only we had died by the Lord ’s hand in Egypt! There we sat around pots of meat and ate all the food we wanted, but you have brought us out into this desert to starve this entire assembly to death."
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel said to them, "Oh, that we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the pots of meat and when we ate bread to the full! For you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger."
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു അപ്പം വർഷിപ്പിക്കും; ജനം എന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം അനുസരിക്കുമോ ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു ഞാൻ അവരെ പരീക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഓരോ ദിവസത്തേക്കു വേണ്ടതു അന്നന്നു പെറുക്കി ക്കൊള്ളേണം.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test them and see whether they will follow my instructions.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you. And the people shall go out and gather a certain quota every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in My law or not.
chapters.kjv: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആറാം ദിവസം അവർ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നതു ഒരുക്കുമ്പോൾ ദിവസംപ്രതി പെറുക്കുന്നതിന്റെ ഇരട്ടി കാണും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: On the sixth day they are to prepare what they bring in, and that is to be twice as much as they gather on the other days."
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be on the sixth day that they shall prepare what they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily."
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

chapters.ml: മോശെയും അഹരോനും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു ഒക്കെയും: നിങ്ങളെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു യഹോവ തന്നേ എന്നു ഇന്നു വൈകുന്നേരം നിങ്ങൾ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, "In the evening you will know that it was the Lord who brought you out of Egypt,
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, "At evening you shall know that the Lord has brought you out of the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

chapters.ml: പ്രഭാതകാലത്തു നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു കാണും; യഹോവയുടെ നേരെയുള്ള നിങ്ങളുടെ പിറുപിറുപ്പു അവൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ നേരെ പിറുപിറുക്കുവാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തുള്ളു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and in the morning you will see the glory of the Lord , because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we, that you should grumble against us?"
chapters.nkjv: And in the morning you shall see the glory of the Lord; for He hears your complaints against the Lord. But what are we, that you complain against us?"
chapters.kjv: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD ; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD : and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

chapters.ml: മോശെ പിന്നെയും: യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തിന്നുവാൻ വൈകുന്നേരത്തു മാംസവും പ്രഭാതകാലത്തു തൃപ്തിയാകുംവണ്ണം അപ്പവും തരുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ അറിയും; യഹോവയുടെ നേരെ നിങ്ങൾ പിറുപിറുക്കുന്നതു അവൻ കേൾക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തുള്ളു? നിങ്ങളുടെ പിറുപിറുപ്പു ഞങ്ങളുടെ നേരെയല്ല, യഹോവയുടെ നേരെയത്രേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Moses also said, "You will know that it was the Lord when he gives you meat to eat in the evening and all the bread you want in the morning, because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we? You are not grumbling against us, but against the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: Also Moses said, "Thisshallbeseen when the Lord gives you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to the full; for the Lord hears your complaints which you make against Him. And what are we? Your complaints are not against us but against the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And Moses said, This shall be , when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD .

chapters.ml: അഹരോനോടു: മോശെ: യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ അടുത്തുവരുവിൻ; അവൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിറുപിറുപ്പു കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസംഘത്തോടും പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses told Aaron, "Say to the entire Israelite community, ‘Come before the Lord , for he has heard your grumbling.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses spoke to Aaron, "Say to all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come near before the Lord, for He has heard your complaints.’ "
chapters.kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD : for he hath heard your murmurings.

chapters.ml: അഹരോൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസംഘത്തോടും സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവർ മരുഭൂമിക്കു നേരെ തിരിഞ്ഞു നോക്കി, യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു മേഘത്തിൽ വെളിപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: While Aaron was speaking to the whole Israelite community, they looked toward the desert, and there was the glory of the Lord appearing in the cloud.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ പിറുപിറുപ്പു ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾ വൈകുന്നേരത്തു മാംസം തിന്നും; പ്രഭാതകാലത്തു അപ്പംകൊണ്ടു തൃപ്തരാകും; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയും എന്നു പറക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, ‘At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At twilight you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. And you shall know that I am the Lord your God.’ "
chapters.kjv: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.

chapters.ml: വൈകുന്നേരം കാടകൾ വന്നു പാളയത്തെ മൂടി; പ്രഭാതകാലത്തു പാളയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റും മഞ്ഞു വീണുകിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.
chapters.nkjv: So it was that quails came up at evening and covered the camp, and in the morning the dew lay all around the camp.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

chapters.ml: വീണുകിടന്ന മഞ്ഞു മാറിയ ശേഷം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ എല്ലാടവും ചെതുമ്പലിന്റെ മാതിരിയിൽ ഒരു നേരിയ വസ്തു ഉറെച്ച മഞ്ഞുപോലെ നിലത്തു കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor.
chapters.nkjv: And when the layer of dew lifted, there, on the surface of the wilderness, was a small round substance, as fine as frost on the ground.
chapters.kjv: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അതുകണ്ടാറെ എന്തെന്നു അറിയായ്കയാൽ ഇതെന്തു എന്നു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ ചോദിച്ചു. മോശെ അവരോടു: ഇതു യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ തന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ആഹാരം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, "It is the bread the Lord has given you to eat.
chapters.nkjv: So when the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. And Moses said to them, "This is the bread which the Lord has given you to eat.
chapters.kjv: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

chapters.ml: ഓരോരുത്തന്നു ഭക്ഷിക്കാകുന്നെടത്തോളം പെറുക്കിക്കൊൾവിൻ; താന്താന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിലുള്ളവരുടെ എണ്ണത്തിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം ആളൊന്നിന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴിവീതം എടുത്തുകൊള്ളേണം എന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Everyone is to gather as much as they need. Take an omer for each person you have in your tent.’ "
chapters.nkjv: This is the thing which the Lord has commanded: ‘Let every man gather it according to each one’s need, one omer for each person, accordingtothe number of persons; let every man take for those who are in his tent.’ "
chapters.kjv: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു. ചിലർ ഏറെയും ചിലർ കുറെയും പെറുക്കി.
chapters.niv: The Israelites did as they were told; some gathered much, some little.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel did so and gathered, some more, some less.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

chapters.ml: ഇടങ്ങഴികൊണ്ടു അളന്നപ്പോൾ ഏറെ പെറുക്കിയവന്നു ഏറെയും കുറെ പെറുക്കിയവന്നു കുറവും കണ്ടില്ല; ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്നു ഭക്ഷിക്കാകുന്നെടത്തോളം പെറുക്കിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when they measured it by the omer, the one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little. Everyone had gathered just as much as they needed.
chapters.nkjv: So when they measured it by omers, he who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack. Every man had gathered according to each one’s need.
chapters.kjv: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാളേക്കു ആരും ഒട്ടും ശേഷിപ്പിക്കരുതെന്നു മോശെ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses said to them, "No one is to keep any of it until morning."
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said, "Let no one leave any of it till morning."
chapters.kjv: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ചിലർ മോശെയെ അനുസരിക്കാതെ പിറ്റെന്നാളേക്കു കുറെ ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചു; അതു കൃമിച്ചു നാറി; മോശെ അവരോടു കോപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: However, some of them paid no attention to Moses; they kept part of it until morning, but it was full of maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.
chapters.nkjv: Notwithstanding they did not heed Moses. But some of them left part of it until morning, and it bred worms and stank. And Moses was angry with them.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

chapters.ml: അവർ രാവിലെതോറും അവനവന്നു ഭക്ഷിക്കാകുന്നേടത്തോളം പെറുക്കും; വെയിൽ മൂക്കുമ്പോൾ അതു ഉരുകിപ്പോകും.
chapters.niv: Each morning everyone gathered as much as they needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.
chapters.nkjv: So they gathered it every morning, every man according to his need. And when the sun became hot, it melted.
chapters.kjv: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആറാം ദിവസം അവർ ആളൊന്നിന്നു ഈരണ്ടിടങ്ങഴിവീതം ഇരട്ടി ആഹാരം ശേഖരിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ സംഘപ്രമാണികൾ എല്ലാവരും വന്നു മൊശെയോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much—two omers for each person—and the leaders of the community came and reported this to Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, on the sixth day, that they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one. And all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: അതു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതു തന്നേ; നാളെ സ്വസ്ഥത ആകുന്നു; യഹോവെക്കു വിശുദ്ധമായുള്ള ശബ്ബത്തു. ചുടുവാനുള്ളതു ചുടുവിൻ; പാകം ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ളതു പാകം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; ശേഷിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും നാളത്തേക്കു സൂക്ഷിച്ചുവെപ്പിൻ.
