chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കാതെയും വെള്ളം കുടിക്കാതെയും നാല്പതു പകലും നാല്പതു രാവും യഹോവയോടു കൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു; അവൻ പത്തു കല്പനയായ നിയമത്തിന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെ പലകയിൽ എഴുതിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Moses was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.
chapters.nkjv: So he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread nor drank water. And He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.
chapters.kjv: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു നിമിത്തം തന്റെ മുഖത്തിന്റെ ത്വക്ക്ക് പ്രകാശിച്ചു എന്നു മോശെ സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്റെ പലക രണ്ടും കയ്യിൽ പടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു സീനായിപർവ്വതത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Now it was so, when Moses came down from Mount Sinai (and the two tablets of the Testimony were in Moses’ hand when he came down from the mountain), that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone while he talked with Him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

chapters.ml: അഹരോനും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ എല്ലാവരും മോശെയെ നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ മുഖത്തിന്റെ ത്വക്ക്ക് പ്രകാശിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അതു കൊണ്ടു അവർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുവാൻ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, his face was radiant, and they were afraid to come near him.
chapters.nkjv: So when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to come near him.
chapters.kjv: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അവരെ വിളിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ അഹരോനും സഭയിലെ പ്രമാണികൾ ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങി വന്നു; മോശെ അവരോടു സംസാരിചു.
chapters.niv: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses talked with them.
chapters.kjv: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു. സീനായി പർവ്വതത്തിൽവെച്ചു യഹോവ തന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവൻ അവരോടു ആജ്ഞാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
chapters.nkjv: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them as commandments all that the Lord had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
chapters.kjv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ മുഖത്തു ഒരു മൂടുപടം ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.
chapters.nkjv: And when Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
chapters.kjv: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

chapters.ml: മോശെ യഹോവയോടു സംസാരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്റെ സന്നിധാനത്തിൽ കടക്കുമ്പോൾ പുറത്തു വരുവോളം മൂടുപടം നീക്കിയിരിക്കും; തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു അവൻ പുറത്തുവന്നു യിസ്രയേൽമക്കളോടു പറയും.
chapters.niv: But whenever he entered the Lord ’s presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,
chapters.nkjv: But whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with Him, he would take the veil off until he came out; and he would come out and speak to the children of Israel whatever he had been commanded.
chapters.kjv: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മോശെയുടെ മുഖത്തിന്റെ ത്വക്ക്ക് പ്രകാശിക്കുന്നതായി കണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടു മോശെ അവനോടു സംസാരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അകത്തു കടക്കുവോളം മൂടുപടം പിന്നെയും തന്റെ മുഖത്തു ഇട്ടുകൊള്ളും.
chapters.niv: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And whenever the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone, then Moses would put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with Him.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം മോശെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സംഘത്തെ ഒക്കെയും കൂട്ടി അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്‍വാൻ യഹോവ കല്പിച്ച വചനങ്ങൾ ആവിതു:
chapters.niv: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, "These are the things the Lord has commanded you to do:
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said to them, "These are the words which the Lord has commanded you to do:
chapters.kjv: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.

chapters.ml: ആറു ദിവസം വേല ചെയ്യേണം; ഏഴാം ദിവസം നിങ്ങൾക്കു വിശുദ്ധമായി യഹോവയുടെ മഹാസ്വസ്ഥതയുള്ള ശബ്ബത്ത് ആയിരിക്കേണം; അന്നു വേല ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം മരണ ശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a day of sabbath rest to the Lord . Whoever does any work on it is to be put to death.
chapters.nkjv: Work shall be done for six days, but the seventh day shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of rest to the Lord. Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
chapters.kjv: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD : whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

chapters.ml: ശബ്ബത്ത നാളിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ വാസസ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ എങ്ങും തീ കത്തിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day."
chapters.nkjv: You shall kindle no fire throughout your dwellings on the Sabbath day."
chapters.kjv: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

chapters.ml: മോശെ പിന്നെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസഭയോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, "This is what the Lord has commanded:
chapters.nkjv: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, "This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying:
chapters.kjv: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നു യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു വഴിപാടു എടുപ്പിൻ. നല്ല മനസ്സുള്ളവനെല്ലാം യഹോവെക്കു വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: From what you have, take an offering for the Lord . Everyone who is willing is to bring to the Lord an offering of gold, silver and bronze;
chapters.nkjv: ‘Take from among you an offering to the Lord. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as an offering to the Lord: gold, silver, and bronze;
chapters.kjv: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD : whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD ; gold, and silver, and brass,

chapters.ml: പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, താമ്രം, നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ, കോലാട്ടുരോമം,
chapters.niv: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;
chapters.nkjv: blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair;
chapters.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair ,

chapters.ml: ചുവപ്പിച്ച ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്തോൽ തഹശൂതോൽ, ഖദിരമരം,
chapters.niv: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather ; acacia wood;
chapters.nkjv: ram skins dyed red, badger skins, and acacia wood;
chapters.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

chapters.ml: വിളക്കിന്നു എണ്ണ, അഭിഷേകതൈലത്തിന്നും പരിമളധൂപത്തിന്നും സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം,
chapters.niv: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
chapters.nkjv: oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense;
chapters.kjv: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

chapters.ml: ഗോമേദകക്കല്ലു, ഏഫോദിന്നു പതക്കത്തിന്നും പതിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന കല്ലു എന്നിവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
chapters.nkjv: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate.
chapters.kjv: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിൽ ജ്ഞാനികളായ എല്ലാവരും വന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the Lord has commanded:
chapters.nkjv: ‘All whoare gifted artisans among you shall come and make all that the Lord has commanded:
chapters.kjv: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസം, അതിന്റെ മൂടുവരി, പുറമൂടി, കൊളുത്തുകൾ, പലകകൾ, അന്താഴങ്ങൾ
chapters.niv: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;
chapters.nkjv: the tabernacle, its tent, its covering, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
chapters.kjv: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

chapters.ml: തൂണുകൾ, ചുവടുകൾ, പെട്ടകം, അതിന്റെ തണ്ടുകൾ, കൃപാസനം, മറയുടെ തിരശ്ശീല,
chapters.niv: the ark with its poles and the atonement cover and the curtain that shields it;
chapters.nkjv: the ark and its poles, with the mercy seat, and the veil of the covering;
chapters.kjv: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,

chapters.ml: മേശ, അതിന്റെ തണ്ടുകൾ, ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും, കാഴ്ചയപ്പം,
chapters.niv: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;
chapters.nkjv: the table and its poles, all its utensils, and the showbread;
chapters.kjv: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,

chapters.ml: വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നു നിലവിളക്കു, അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ, അതിന്റെ ദീപങ്ങൾ, വിളക്കിന്നു എണ്ണ,
chapters.niv: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;
chapters.nkjv: also the lampstand for the light, its utensils, its lamps, and the oil for the light;
chapters.kjv: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

chapters.ml: ധൂപപീഠം, അതിന്റെ തണ്ടുകൾ, അഭിഷേകതൈലം, സുഗന്ധധൂപവർഗ്ഗം, തിരുനിവാസത്തിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രവേശന വാതിലിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല,
chapters.niv: the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;
chapters.nkjv: the incense altar, its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, and the screen for the door at the entrance of the tabernacle;
chapters.kjv: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗപീഠം, അതിന്റെ താമ്രജാലം, തണ്ടുകൾ, അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും, തൊട്ടി, അതിന്റെ കാൽ,
chapters.niv: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the bronze basin with its stand;
chapters.nkjv: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles, all its utensils, and the laver and its base;
chapters.kjv: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

chapters.ml: പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മറശ്ശീലകൾ, അതിന്റെ തൂണുകൾ, ചുവടുകൾ, പ്രാകാര വാതിലിന്റെ മറ,
chapters.niv: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;
chapters.nkjv: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
chapters.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ കുറ്റികൾ, പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ കുറ്റികൾ,
chapters.niv: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;
chapters.nkjv: the pegs of the tabernacle, the pegs of the court, and their cords;
chapters.kjv: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ കയറുകൾ, വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്‍വാൻ വിശേഷവസ്ത്രങ്ങൾ, പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ വിശുദ്ധവസ്ത്രം, പുരോഹിതശുശ്രൂഷെക്കായി അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ വസ്ത്രങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary—both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests."
chapters.nkjv: the garments of ministry, for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to minister as priests.’ "
chapters.kjv: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസഭയും മോശെയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses’ presence,
chapters.nkjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
chapters.kjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

chapters.ml: ഹൃദയത്തിൽ ഉത്സാഹവും മനസ്സിൽ താല്പര്യവും തോന്നിയവൻ എല്ലാം സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കും അതിന്റെ സകല ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കും വിശുദ്ധവസ്ത്രങ്ങൾക്കും വേണ്ടി യഹോവെക്കു വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved them came and brought an offering to the Lord for the work on the tent of meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.
chapters.nkjv: Then everyone came whose heart was stirred, and everyone whose spirit was willing, and they brought the Lord’s offering for the work of the tabernacle of meeting, for all its service, and for the holy garments.
chapters.kjv: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളുമായി ഔദാര്യമനസ്സുള്ളവർ എല്ലാവരും യഹോവെക്കു പൊൻവഴിപാടു കൊടുപ്പാൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ചവരൊക്കെയും വള, കുണുക്കു, മോതിരം, മാല മുതലായ സകലവിധ പൊന്നാഭരണങ്ങളും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: They came, both men and women, as many as had a willing heart, and brought earrings and nose rings, rings and necklaces, all jewelry of gold, that is, every man who made an offering of gold to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ, കോലാട്ടു രോമം, ചുവപ്പിച്ച ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്തോൽ, തഹശൂതോൽ എന്നിവ കൈവശമുള്ളവർ അതു കൊണ്ടു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Everyone who had blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen, or goat hair, ram skins dyed red or the other durable leather brought them.
chapters.nkjv: And every man, with whom was found blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair, red skins of rams, and badger skins, brought them.
chapters.kjv: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair , and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought them .

chapters.ml: വെള്ളിയും താമ്രവും വഴിപാടുകൊടുപ്പാൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ചവനെല്ലാം യഹോവെക്കു വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു. ശുശ്രൂഷയിലെ എല്ലാപണിക്കുമായി ഖദിരമരം കൈവശമുള്ളവൻ അതുകൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the Lord , and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.
chapters.nkjv: Everyone who offered an offering of silver or bronze brought the Lord’s offering. And everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
chapters.kjv: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’s offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it .

chapters.ml: സാമർത്ഥ്യമുള്ള സ്ത്രീകൾ ഒക്കെയും തങ്ങളുടെ കൈകൊണ്ടു നൂറ്റ നീലനൂലും ധൂമ്രനൂലും ചുവപ്പു നൂലും പഞ്ഞിനൂലും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun—blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.
chapters.nkjv: All the women whowere gifted artisans spun yarn with their hands, and brought what they had spun, of blue, purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
chapters.kjv: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

chapters.ml: സാമർത്ഥ്യത്താൽ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ ഉത്സാഹം തോന്നിയ സ്ത്രീകൾ ഒക്കെയും കോലാട്ടുരോമം നൂറ്റു.
chapters.niv: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.
chapters.nkjv: And all the women whose hearts stirred with wisdom spun yarn of goats’ hair.
chapters.kjv: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ hair .

chapters.ml: പ്രമാണികൾ ഏഫോദിന്നും പതക്കത്തിനും പതിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന കല്ലുകളും ഗോമേദകക്കല്ലുകളും
chapters.niv: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
chapters.nkjv: The rulers brought onyx stones, and the stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate,
chapters.kjv: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

chapters.ml: വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നും അഭിഷേകതൈലത്തിന്നും സുഗന്ധ ധൂപത്തിന്നുമായി പരിമളവർഗ്ഗവും എണ്ണയും കൊണ്ടു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.
chapters.nkjv: and spices and oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
chapters.kjv: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

chapters.ml: മോശെ മുഖാന്തരം യഹോവ കല്പിച്ച സകലപ്രവൃത്തിക്കുമായി കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ഔദാര്യമനസ്സുള്ള സകല പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളും യഹോവെക്കു സ്വമേധാദാനം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the Lord freewill offerings for all the work the Lord through Moses had commanded them to do.
chapters.nkjv: The children of Israel brought a freewill offering to the Lord, all the men and women whose hearts were willing to bring material for all kinds of work which the Lord, by the hand of Moses, had commanded to be done.
chapters.kjv: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD , every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മോശെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നോക്കുവിൻ; യഹോവ യെഹൂദാ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഹൂരിന്റെ മകനായ ഊരിയുടെ മകൻ ബെസലേലിനെ പേർചൊല്ലി വിളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses said to the Israelites, "See, the Lord has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said to the children of Israel, "See, the Lord has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

chapters.ml: കൌശലപ്പണികളെ സങ്കല്പിച്ചുണ്ടാക്കുവാനും പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, താമ്രം എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു പണി ചെയ്‍വാനും
chapters.niv: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—
chapters.nkjv: and He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom and understanding, in knowledge and all manner of workmanship,
chapters.kjv: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

chapters.ml: രത്നം വെട്ടി പതിപ്പാനും മരത്തിൽ കൊത്തുപണിയായ സകലവിധ കൌശലപ്പണിയും ചെയ്‍വാനും
chapters.niv: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,
chapters.nkjv: to design artistic works, to work in gold and silver and bronze,
chapters.kjv: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദിവ്യാത്മാവിനാൽ അവനെ ജ്ഞാനവും ബുദ്ധിയും അറിവും സകലവിധ സാമർത്ഥ്യവുംകൊണ്ടു നിറെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic crafts.
chapters.nkjv: in cutting jewels for setting, in carving wood, and to work in all manner of artistic workmanship.
chapters.kjv: And in the cutting of stones, to set them , and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മനസ്സിലും ദാൻഗോത്രത്തിൽ അഹീസാമാക്കിന്റെ മകനായ ഒഹൊലീയാബിന്റെ മനസ്സിലും മറ്റുള്ളവരെ പഠിപ്പിപ്പാൻ അവൻ തോന്നിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
chapters.nkjv: "And He has put in his heart the ability to teach, in him and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
chapters.kjv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

chapters.ml: കൊത്തുപണിക്കാരന്റെയും കൌശലപ്പണിക്കാരന്റെയും നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു പണിചെയ്യുന്ന തയ്യൽക്കാരന്റെയും നെയ്ത്തുകാരന്റെയും ഏതുതരം ശില്പപ്പണി ചെയ്യുന്നവരുടെയും കൌശലപ്പണികൾ സങ്കല്പിച്ചു ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നവരുടെയും സകലവിധപ്രവൃത്തിയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ അവൻ അവരെ മനസ്സിൽ ജ്ഞാനം കൊണ്ടു നിറെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers—all of them skilled workers and designers.
chapters.nkjv: He has filled them with skill to do all manner of work of the engraver and the designer and the tapestry maker, in blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine linen, and of the weaver—those who do every work and those who design artistic works.
chapters.kjv: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

chapters.ml: ബെസലേലും ഒഹൊലീയാബും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും സകലപ്രവൃത്തിയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ ജ്ഞാനവും ബുദ്ധിയും നല്കിയ സകലജ്ഞാനികളും പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the Lord has commanded."
chapters.nkjv: "And Bezalel and Aholiab, and every gifted artisan in whom the Lord has put wisdom and understanding, to know how to do all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, shall do according to all that the Lord has commanded."
chapters.kjv: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മോശെ ബെസലേലിനെയും ഒഹൊലീയാബിനെയും യഹോവ മനസ്സിൽ ജ്ഞാനം നല്കിയിരുന്ന എല്ലാവരെയും പ്രവൃത്തിയിൽ ചേരുവാൻ മനസ്സിൽ ഉത്സാഹം തോന്നിയ എല്ലാവരെയും വിളിച്ചുവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses called Bezalel and Aholiab, and every gifted artisan in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, everyone whose heart was stirred, to come and do the work.
chapters.kjv: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷയുടെ പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്‍വാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കൊണ്ടുവന്ന വഴിപാടു ഒക്കെയും അവർ മോശെയുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നു വാങ്ങി; എന്നാൽ അവർ പിന്നെയും രാവിലെതോറും സ്വമേധാദാനങ്ങളെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.
chapters.nkjv: And they received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of making the sanctuary. So they continued bringing to him freewill offerings every morning.
chapters.kjv: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal . And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ സകല പ്രവൃത്തിയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ജ്ഞാനികൾ ഒക്കെയും താന്താൻ ചെയ്തുവന്ന പണി നിർത്തി വന്നു മോശെയോടു:
chapters.niv: So all the skilled workers who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left what they were doing
chapters.nkjv: Then all the craftsmen who were doing all the work of the sanctuary came, each from the work he was doing,
chapters.kjv: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ചെയ്‍വാൻ കല്പിച്ച ശുശ്രൂഷയുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു വേണ്ടതിലധികമായി ജനം കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said to Moses, "The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the Lord commanded to be done."
chapters.nkjv: and they spoke to Moses, saying, "The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which the Lord commanded us to do."
chapters.kjv: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മോശെ: പുരുഷന്മാരാകട്ടെ സ്ത്രീകളാകട്ടെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ വഴിപാടു വകെക്കു മേലാൽ പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്യേണ്ട എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അതു പാളയത്തിൽ പ്രസിദ്ധമാക്കി. അങ്ങനെ ജനം കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നതു നിർത്തലായി.
chapters.niv: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: "No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary." And so the people were restrained from bringing more,
chapters.nkjv: So Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, "Let neither man nor woman do any more work for the offering of the sanctuary." And the people were restrained from bringing,
chapters.kjv: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

chapters.ml: കിട്ടിയ സാമാനങ്ങളോ സകല പ്രവൃത്തിയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ വേണ്ടുവോളവും അധികവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.
chapters.nkjv: for the material they had was sufficient for all the work to be done—indeed too much.
chapters.kjv: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

chapters.ml: പണി ചെയ്യുന്നവരിൽ ജ്ഞാനികളായ എല്ലാവരും പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പു നൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടുള്ള പത്തു മൂടുശീലകൊണ്ടു തിരുനിവാസം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; നെയ്ത്തുകാരന്റെ ചിത്രപ്പണിയായ കെരൂബുകളുള്ളതായിട്ടു അതിനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: All those who were skilled among the workers made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by expert hands.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the gifted artisans among them who worked on the tabernacle made ten curtains woven of fine linen, and of blue, purple, and scarlet thread; with artistic designs of cherubim they made them.
chapters.kjv: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

chapters.ml: ഓരോ മൂടുശീലെക്കു ഇരുപത്തെട്ടു മുഴം നീളവും ഓരോ മൂടുശീലെക്കു നാലു മുഴം വീതിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; എല്ലാ മൂടുശീലകൾക്കും ഒരു അളവു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: All the curtains were the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the curtains were all the same size.
chapters.kjv: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചു മൂടുശീല ഒന്നോടൊന്നു ഇണെച്ചു; മറ്റെ അഞ്ചു മൂടുശീല ഒന്നോടൊന്നു ഇണെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They joined five of the curtains together and did the same with the other five.
chapters.nkjv: And he coupled five curtains to one another, and theother five curtains he coupled to one another.
chapters.kjv: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഇണെച്ചുണ്ടാക്കിയ ഒന്നാമത്തെ വിരിയുടെ അറ്റത്തുള്ള മൂടുശീലയുടെ വിളുമ്പിൽ നീലനൂൽ കൊണ്ടു കണ്ണികൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; രണ്ടാമത്തെ വിരിയുടെ പുറത്തെ മൂടുശീലയുടെ വിളുമ്പിലും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.
chapters.nkjv: He made loops of blue yarn on the edge of the curtain on the selvedge of one set; likewise he did on the outer edge of theother curtain of the second set.
chapters.kjv: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

chapters.ml: ഒരു മൂടുശീലയിൽ അമ്പതു കണ്ണി ഉണ്ടാക്കി; രണ്ടാമത്തെ വിരിയുടെ പുറത്തെ മൂടുശീലയുടെ വിളുമ്പിലും അമ്പതു കണ്ണി ഉണ്ടാക്കി; കണ്ണികൾ നേർക്കുനേരെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.
chapters.nkjv: Fifty loops he made on one curtain, and fifty loops he made on the edge of the curtain on the end of the second set; the loops held one curtain to another.
chapters.kjv: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു അമ്പതു കൊളുത്തും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; കൊളുത്തുകൊണ്ടു മൂടുശീലകളെ ഒന്നോടൊന്നു ഇണെച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ തിരുനിവാസം ഒന്നായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.
chapters.nkjv: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps, that it might be one tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ മൂടുവരിയായി കോലാട്ടുരോമംകൊണ്ടുള്ള മൂടുശീലകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി, പതിനൊന്നു മൂടുശീലയായി അവയെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.
chapters.nkjv: He made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle; he made eleven curtains.
chapters.kjv: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

chapters.ml: ഓരോ മൂടുശീലെക്കു മുപ്പതു മുഴം നീളവും ഓരോ മൂടുശീലെക്കു നാലു മുഴം വീതിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; മൂടുശീല പതിനൊന്നിന്നും ഒരു അളവു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: All eleven curtains were the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains were the same size.
chapters.kjv: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഞ്ചു മൂടുശീല ഒന്നായും ആറു മൂടുശീല ഒന്നായും ഇണെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another set.
chapters.nkjv: He coupled five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves.
chapters.kjv: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ഇണെച്ചുണ്ടാക്കിയ ഒന്നാമത്തെ വിരിയുടെ അറ്റത്തുള്ള മൂടുശീലയുടെ വിളുമ്പിൽ അമ്പതു കണ്ണിയും രണ്ടാമത്തെ വിരിയുടെ അറ്റത്തുള്ള മൂടുശീലയുടെ വിളുമ്പിൽ അമ്പതു കണ്ണിയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.
chapters.nkjv: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops he made on the edge of the curtain of the second set.
chapters.kjv: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

chapters.ml: കൂടാരം ഒന്നായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതു ഇണെപ്പാൻ താമ്രംകൊണ്ടു അമ്പതു കൊളുത്തും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the tent together as a unit.
chapters.nkjv: He also made fifty bronze clasps to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
chapters.kjv: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

chapters.ml: ചുവപ്പിച്ച ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്തോൽകൊണ്ടു കൂടാരത്തിന്നു ഒരു പുറമൂടിയും അതിന്റെ മീതെ തഹശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടു ഒരു പുറമൂടിയും അവൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.
chapters.nkjv: Then he made a covering for the tent of ram skins dyed red, and a covering of badger skins above that.
chapters.kjv: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that .

chapters.ml: ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നു നിവിരെ നില്ക്കുന്ന പലകകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: For the tabernacle he made boards of acacia wood, standing upright.
chapters.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

chapters.ml: ഓരോ പലകെക്കു പത്തുമുഴം നീളവും ഓരോ പലകെക്കു ഒന്നര മുഴം വീതിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,
chapters.nkjv: The length of each board was ten cubits, and the width of each board a cubit and a half.
chapters.kjv: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

chapters.ml: ഓരോ പലകെക്കു തമ്മിൽ ചേർന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ഈരണ്ടു കുടുമ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ എല്ലാപലകെക്കും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
chapters.nkjv: Each board had two tenons for binding one to another. Thus he made for all the boards of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നു പലക ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതു തെക്കുവശത്തേക്കു ഇരുപതു പലക:
chapters.niv: They made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle
chapters.nkjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side.
chapters.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

chapters.ml: ഒരു പലകയുടെ അടിയിൽ രണ്ടു കുടുമെക്കു രണ്ടു ചുവടും മറ്റൊരു പലകയുടെ അടിയിൽ രണ്ടു കുടുമെക്കു രണ്ടു ചുവടും ഇങ്ങനെ ഇരുപതു പലകയുടെ അടിയിൽ വെള്ളികൊണ്ടു നാല്പതു ചുവടു അവൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: and made forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.
chapters.nkjv: Forty sockets of silver he made to go under the twenty boards: two sockets under each of the boards for its two tenons.
chapters.kjv: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ മറുപുറത്തു വടക്കുവശത്തേക്കും ഇരുപതു പലക ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames
chapters.nkjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty boards
chapters.kjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

chapters.ml: ഒരു പലകയുടെ അടിയിൽ രണ്ടു ചുവടും മറ്റൊരു പലകയുടെ അടിയിൽ രണ്ടു ചുവടും ഇങ്ങനെ അവെക്കു നാല്പതു വെള്ളിച്ചുവടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.
chapters.nkjv: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under each of the boards.
chapters.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ പടിഞ്ഞാറെ വശത്തേക്കു ആറു പലക ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,
chapters.nkjv: For the west side of the tabernacle he made six boards.
chapters.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ ഇരുവശത്തുമുള്ള കോണുകൾക്കു ഈരണ്ടു പലക ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: and two frames were made for the corners of the tabernacle at the far end.
chapters.nkjv: He also made two boards for the two back corners of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

chapters.ml: അവ താഴെ ഇരട്ടയായും മേലറ്റത്തു ഒന്നാമത്തെ വളയം വരെ തമ്മിൽ ചേർന്നു ഒറ്റയായും ഇരുന്നു. രണ്ടു മൂലയിലുള്ള രണ്ടിന്നും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.
chapters.nkjv: And they were coupled at the bottom and coupled together at the top by one ring. Thus he made both of them for the two corners.
chapters.kjv: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ എട്ടു പലകയും ഓരോ പലകയുടെ അടിയിൽ ഈരണ്ടു ചുവടായി പതിനാറു വെള്ളിച്ചുവടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
chapters.nkjv: So there were eight boards and their sockets—sixteen sockets of silver—two sockets under each of the boards.
chapters.kjv: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു അന്താഴങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ ഒരു വശത്തെ പലകെക്കു അഞ്ചു അന്താഴം;
chapters.niv: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
chapters.nkjv: And he made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards on one side of the tabernacle,
chapters.kjv: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ മറുവശത്തെ പലകെക്കു അഞ്ചു അന്താഴം; തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ പടിഞ്ഞാറെ ഭാഗത്തു പിൻവശത്തെ പലകെക്കു അഞ്ചു അന്താഴം.
chapters.niv: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: five bars for the boards on the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle on the far side westward.
chapters.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

chapters.ml: നടുവിലത്തെ അന്താഴം പലകയുടെ ഒത്ത നടുവിൽ ഒരു അറ്റത്തുനിന്നു മറ്റെ അറ്റത്തോളം ചെല്ലുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made the center crossbar so that it extended from end to end at the middle of the frames.
chapters.nkjv: And he made the middle bar to pass through the boards from one end to the other.
chapters.kjv: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

chapters.ml: പലകകൾ പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു; അന്താഴം ചെലുത്തുവാനുള്ള അവയുടെ വളയങ്ങൾ പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി, അന്താഴം പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
chapters.nkjv: He overlaid the boards with gold, made their rings of gold tobe holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
chapters.kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

chapters.ml: നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ഒരു തിരശ്ശീലയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി: നെയ്ത്തുകാരന്റെ ചിത്രപ്പണിയായ കെരൂബുകളുള്ളതായിട്ടു അതിനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made the curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.
chapters.nkjv: And he made a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen; it was worked with an artistic design of cherubim.
chapters.kjv: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു നാലു തൂണും ഉണ്ടാക്കി, പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു; അവയുടെ കൊളുത്തുകൾ പൊന്നു കൊണ്ടു ആയിരുന്നു; അവെക്കു വെള്ളികൊണ്ടു നാലു ചുവടു വാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold. They made gold hooks for them and cast their four silver bases.
chapters.nkjv: He made for it four pillars of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, with their hooks of gold; and he cast four sockets of silver for them.
chapters.kjv: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

chapters.ml: കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നു നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു ചിത്രത്തയ്യൽക്കാരന്റെ പണിയായ ഒരു മറശ്ശീലയും
chapters.niv: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer;
chapters.nkjv: He also made a screen for the tabernacle door, of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver,
chapters.kjv: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അഞ്ചു തൂണും അവെക്കു കൊളുത്തും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അവയുടെ കുമിഴുകളും മേൽ ചുറ്റുപടികളും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ അവയുടെ ചുവടു അഞ്ചും താമ്രം കൊണ്ടു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.
chapters.nkjv: and its five pillars with their hooks. And he overlaid their capitals and their rings with gold, but their five sockets were bronze.
chapters.kjv: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

chapters.ml: ബെസലേൽ പെട്ടകം ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി. അതിന്നു രണ്ടരമുഴം നീളവും ഒന്നരമുഴം വീതിയും ഒന്നരമുഴം ഉയരവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.nkjv: Then Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood; two and a half cubits was its length, a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
chapters.kjv: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

chapters.ml: അതു അകവും പുറവും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു, ചുറ്റും അതിന്നു പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു വക്കുഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
chapters.nkjv: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold all around it.
chapters.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ നാലു കാലിന്നും ഇപ്പുറത്തു രണ്ടു വളയം അപ്പുറത്തു രണ്ടു വളയം ഇങ്ങനെ നാലു പൊൻവളയം വാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.
chapters.nkjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold tobeset in its four corners: two rings on one side, and two rings on the other side of it.
chapters.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു തണ്ടുകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
chapters.nkjv: He made poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
chapters.kjv: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടകം ചുമക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആ തണ്ടു പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വങ്ങളിലുള്ള വളയങ്ങളിൽ ചെലുത്തി.
chapters.niv: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.
chapters.nkjv: And he put the poles into the rings at the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
chapters.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തങ്കം കൊണ്ടു കൃപാസനം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതിന്നു രണ്ടര മുഴം നീളവും ഒന്നര മുഴം വീതിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He made the atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
chapters.nkjv: He also made the mercy seat of pure gold; two and a half cubits was its length and a cubit and a half its width.
chapters.kjv: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു രണ്ടു കെരൂബുകളെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി കൃപാസനത്തിന്റെ രണ്ടു അറ്റത്തും അവയെ അടിപ്പുപണിയായി ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.
chapters.nkjv: He made two cherubim of beaten gold; he made them of one piece at the two ends of the mercy seat:
chapters.kjv: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

chapters.ml: ഒരു കെരൂബ് ഒരു അറ്റത്തും മറ്റെ കെരൂബ് മറ്റെ അറ്റത്തും ഇങ്ങനെ കെരൂബുകളെ കൃപാസനത്തിന്റെ രണ്ടു അറ്റത്തും അതിൽ നിന്നു തന്നേ ഉള്ളവയായിട്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.
chapters.nkjv: one cherub at one end on this side, and the other cherub at the other end on that side. He made the cherubim at the two ends ofonepiece with the mercy seat.
chapters.kjv: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

chapters.ml: കെരൂബുകൾ മേലോട്ടു ചിറകു വിടർത്തു ചിറകുകൊണ്ടു കൃപാസനത്തെ മൂടുകയും തമ്മിൽ അഭിമുഖമായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്തു; കെരൂബുകളുടെ മുഖം കൃപാസനത്തിന്നു നേരെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the cover.
chapters.nkjv: The cherubim spread out their wings above, and covered the mercy seat with their wings. They faced one another; the faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
chapters.kjv: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു മേശ ഉണ്ടാക്കി. അതിന്നു രണ്ടുമുഴം നീളവും ഒരു മുഴം വീതിയും ഒന്നരമുഴം ഉയരവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They made the table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.nkjv: He made the table of acacia wood; two cubits was its length, a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
chapters.kjv: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

chapters.ml: അതു തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു ചുറ്റും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു വക്കുഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
chapters.nkjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made a molding of gold all around it.
chapters.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

chapters.ml: ചുറ്റും അതിന്നു നാലു വിരൽ വീതിയുള്ള ഒരു ചട്ടവും ഉണ്ടാക്കി. ചട്ടത്തിന്നു ചുറ്റും പൊന്നു കൊണ്ടു ഒരു വക്കുഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
chapters.nkjv: Also he made a frame of a handbreadth all around it, and made a molding of gold for the frame all around it.
chapters.kjv: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു നാലു പൊൻവളയം വാർത്തു നാലു കാലിന്റെയും ഓരോ പാർശ്വത്തിൽ തറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners, where the four legs were.
chapters.nkjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that were at its four legs.
chapters.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.

chapters.ml: മേശ ചുമക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തണ്ടുകൾ ചെലുത്തുവാൻ വളയങ്ങൾ ചട്ടത്തോടു ചേർന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
chapters.nkjv: The rings were close to the frame, as holders for the poles to bear the table.
chapters.kjv: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

chapters.ml: മേശചുമക്കേണ്ടതിന്നുള്ള തണ്ടുകൾ ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The poles for carrying the table were made of acacia wood and were overlaid with gold.
chapters.nkjv: And he made the poles of acacia wood to bear the table, and overlaid them with gold.
chapters.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

chapters.ml: മേശമേലുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങളായ തളികകളും കരണ്ടികളും കിണ്ടികളും പകരുവാൻ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്ന കുടങ്ങളും തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: And they made from pure gold the articles for the table—its plates and dishes and bowls and its pitchers for the pouring out of drink offerings.
chapters.nkjv: He made of pure gold the utensils which were on the table: its dishes, its cups, its bowls, and its pitchers for pouring.
chapters.kjv: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു നിലവിളക്കു ഉണ്ടാക്കി; വിളക്കു അടിപ്പുപണിയായി ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതിന്റെ ചുവടും തണ്ടും പുഷ്പപുടങ്ങളും മുട്ടുകളും പൂക്കളും അതിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They made the lampstand of pure gold. They hammered out its base and shaft, and made its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.
chapters.nkjv: He also made the lampstand of pure gold; of hammered work he made the lampstand. Its shaft, its branches, its bowls, its ornamental knobs, and its flowers were of the same piece.
chapters.kjv: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

chapters.ml: നിലവിളക്കിന്റെ ഒരു വശത്തു നിന്നു മൂന്നു ശാഖ, അതിന്റെ മറ്റെവശത്തു നിന്നും മൂന്നു ശാഖ, ഇങ്ങനെ ആറു ശാഖ അതിന്റെ പാർശ്വങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
chapters.nkjv: And six branches came out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.
chapters.kjv: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

chapters.ml: ഒരു ശാഖയിൽ ഓരോ മുട്ടും ഓരോ പൂവുമായി ബദാംപൂപോലെ മൂന്നു പുഷ്പപുടവും മറ്റൊരു ശാഖയിൽ ഓരോ മുട്ടും ഓരോ പൂവുമായി ബദാംപൂപോലെ മൂന്നു പുഷ്പപുടവും ഇങ്ങനെ നിലവിളക്കിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട ശാഖ ആറിലും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.
chapters.nkjv: There were three bowls made like almond blossoms on one branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower, and three bowls made like almond blossoms on the other branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower—and so for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.
chapters.kjv: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

chapters.ml: വിളക്കു തണ്ടിലോ മുട്ടുകളും പൂക്കളുമായി ബദാം പൂപോലെ നാലു പുഷ്പപുടം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.
chapters.nkjv: And on the lampstand itself were four bowls made like almond blossoms, each with its ornamental knob and flower.
chapters.kjv: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

chapters.ml: അതിൽ നിന്നുള്ള രണ്ടു ശാഖെക്കു കീഴെ ഒരു മുട്ടും അതിൽനിന്നുള്ള മറ്റെ രണ്ടു ശാഖെക്കു കീഴെ ഒരു മുട്ടും അതിൽനിന്നുള്ള ശേഷം രണ്ടു ശാഖെക്കു കീഴെ ഒരു മുട്ടും ഇങ്ങനെ അതിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുന്ന ശാഖ ആറിന്നും കീഴെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One bud was under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.
chapters.nkjv: Therewas a knob under the first two branches of the same, a knob under the second two branches of the same, and a knob under the third two branches of the same, according to the six branches extending from it.
chapters.kjv: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

chapters.ml: മുട്ടുകളും ശാഖകളും അതിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു; അതു മുഴുവനും തങ്കം കൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒറ്റ അടിപ്പു പണിയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The buds and the branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
chapters.nkjv: Their knobs and their branches were of one piece; all of it was one hammered piece of pure gold.
chapters.kjv: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിന്റെ ഏഴു ദീപവും അതിന്റെ ചവണകളും കരിന്തിരിപ്പാത്രങ്ങളും തങ്കം കൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made its seven lamps, as well as its wick trimmers and trays, of pure gold.
chapters.nkjv: And he made its seven lamps, its wick-trimmers, and its trays of pure gold.
chapters.kjv: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

chapters.ml: ഒരു താലന്തു തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അതും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made the lampstand and all its accessories from one talent of pure gold.
chapters.nkjv: Of a talent of pure gold he made it, with all its utensils.
chapters.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു ധൂപപീഠം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതു ഒരു മുഴം നീളവും ഒരു മുഴം വീതിയും ഇങ്ങനെ സമചതുരം ആയിരുന്നു. അതിന്നു ഉയരം രണ്ടു മുഴം ആയിരുന്നു. അതിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകൾ അതിൽ നിന്നു തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high —its horns of one piece with it.
chapters.nkjv: He made the incense altar of acacia wood. Its length was a cubit and its width a cubit—itwas square—and two cubits was its height. Its horns were ofonepiece with it.
chapters.kjv: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതും അതിന്റെ മേല്പലകളയും ചുറ്റും അതിന്റെ പാർശ്വങ്ങളും കൊമ്പുകളും തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു; അതിന്നു ചുറ്റും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു വക്കുഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They overlaid the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
chapters.nkjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides all around, and its horns. He also made for it a molding of gold all around it.
chapters.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

chapters.ml: അതു ചുമക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തണ്ടു ചെലുത്തുവാൻ വക്കിന്നു കീഴെ രണ്ടു പാർശ്വത്തിലുള്ള ഓരോ കോണിങ്കലും ഓരോ പൊൻവളയം ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made two gold rings below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.
chapters.nkjv: He made two rings of gold for it under its molding, by its two corners on both sides, as holders for the poles with which to bear it.
chapters.kjv: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

chapters.ml: ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു തണ്ടുകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
chapters.nkjv: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
chapters.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വിശുദ്ധമായ അഭിഷേകതൈലവും നല്ല സുഗന്ധമുള്ള നിർമ്മല ധൂപവർഗ്ഗവും തൈലക്കാരന്റെ വിദ്യപ്രകാരം ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense—the work of a perfumer.
chapters.nkjv: He also made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the perfumer.
chapters.kjv: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു ഹോമയാഗപീഠം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതു അഞ്ചു മുഴം നീളവും അഞ്ചുമുഴം വീതിയും ഇങ്ങനെ സമചതുരവും മൂന്നു മുഴം ഉയരവുമുള്ളതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They built the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, three cubits high; it was square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood; five cubits was its length and five cubits its width—itwas square—and its height was three cubits.
chapters.kjv: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ നാലു കോണിലും നാലു കൊമ്പു ഉണ്ടാക്കി; കൊമ്പുകൾ അതിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു. താമ്രംകൊണ്ടു അതു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They made a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar were of one piece, and they overlaid the altar with bronze.
chapters.nkjv: He made its horns on its four corners; the horns were ofonepiece with it. And he overlaid it with bronze.
chapters.kjv: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

chapters.ml: ചട്ടി, ചട്ടുകം, കലശം, മുൾകൊളുത്തു, തീക്കലശം ഇങ്ങനെ പീഠത്തിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും താമ്രംകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made all its utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.
chapters.nkjv: He made all the utensils for the altar: the pans, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the firepans; all its utensils he made of bronze.
chapters.kjv: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നു വലപ്പണിയായ ഒരു താമ്രജാലം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതു താഴെ അതിന്റെ ചുറ്റുപടിക്കു കീഴെ അതിന്റെ പാതിയോളം എത്തി.
chapters.niv: They made a grating for the altar, a bronze network, to be under its ledge, halfway up the altar.
chapters.nkjv: And he made a grate of bronze network for the altar, under its rim, midway from the bottom.
chapters.kjv: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

chapters.ml: താമ്രജാലത്തിന്റെ നാലു അറ്റത്തിന്നും തണ്ടു ചെലുത്തുവാൻ നാലു വളയം വാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: They cast bronze rings to hold the poles for the four corners of the bronze grating.
chapters.nkjv: He cast four rings for the four corners of the bronze grating, as holders for the poles.
chapters.kjv: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

chapters.ml: ഖദിരമരംകൊണ്ടു തണ്ടുകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി താമ്രംകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
chapters.nkjv: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
chapters.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠം ചുമക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിന്റെ പാർശ്വങ്ങളിലുള്ള വളയങ്ങളിൽ ആ തണ്ടുകൾ ചെലുത്തി; യാഗപീഠം പലകകൊണ്ടു പൊള്ളയായി ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They inserted the poles into the rings so they would be on the sides of the altar for carrying it. They made it hollow, out of boards.
chapters.nkjv: Then he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to bear it. He made the altar hollow with boards.
chapters.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ സേവ ചെയ്തുവന്ന സ്ത്രീകളുടെ ദർപ്പണങ്ങൾകൊണ്ടു അവൻ താമ്രത്തൊട്ടിയും അതിന്റെ താമ്രക്കാലും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: He made the laver of bronze and its base of bronze, from the bronze mirrors of the serving women who assembled at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പ്രാകാരവും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; തെക്കുവശത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നു പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞി നൂൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള നൂറു മുഴം മറശ്ശീല ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Next they made the courtyard. The south side was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely twisted linen,
chapters.nkjv: Then he made the court on the south side; the hangings of the court wereof fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long.
chapters.kjv: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഇരുപതു തൂണും തൂണുകൾക്കു ഇരുപതു താമ്രച്ചുവടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. തൂണുകളുടെ കൊളുത്തും മേൽചുറ്റുപടിയും വെള്ളി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
chapters.nkjv: There were twenty pillars for them, with twenty bronze sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
chapters.kjv: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

chapters.ml: വടക്കുവശത്തു നൂറു മുഴം മറശ്ശീലയും അതിന്നു ഇരുപതു തൂണും തൂണുകൾക്കു ഇരുപതു താമ്രച്ചുവടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; തൂണുകളുടെ കൊളുത്തും മേൽ ചുറ്റുപടിയും വെള്ളി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The north side was also a hundred cubits long and had twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
chapters.nkjv: On the north side thehangingswere one hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars and their twenty bronze sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
chapters.kjv: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

chapters.ml: പടിഞ്ഞാറുവശത്തു അമ്പതു മുഴം മറശ്ശീലയും അതിന്നു പത്തു തൂണും തൂണുകൾക്കു പത്തു ചുവടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; തൂണുകളുടെ കൊളുത്തും മേൽചുറ്റുപടിയും വെള്ളി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The west end was fifty cubits wide and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
chapters.nkjv: And on the west side therewere hangings of fifty cubits, with ten pillars and their ten sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
chapters.kjv: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

chapters.ml: കിഴക്കുവശത്തു മറശ്ശീല അമ്പതു മുഴം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The east end, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: For the east side thehangingswere fifty cubits.
chapters.kjv: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

chapters.ml: വാതിലിന്റെ ഒരു വശത്തു മറശ്ശീല പതിനഞ്ചു മുഴവും അതിന്നു മൂന്നു തൂണും അവെക്കു മൂന്നു ചുവടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Curtains fifteen cubits long were on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,
chapters.nkjv: The hangings of one side ofthegatewere fifteen cubits long, with their three pillars and their three sockets,
chapters.kjv: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

chapters.ml: മറ്റെവശത്തും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ; ഇങ്ങനെ പ്രാകാരവാതിലിന്റെ ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തും പതിനഞ്ചീതു മുഴം മറശ്ശീലയും അതിന്നു മുമ്മൂന്നു തൂണും മുമ്മൂന്നു ചുവടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and curtains fifteen cubits long were on the other side of the entrance to the courtyard, with three posts and three bases.
chapters.nkjv: and the same for the other side of the court gate; on this side and that were hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three sockets.
chapters.kjv: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

chapters.ml: ചുറ്റും പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല ഒക്കെയും പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the curtains around the courtyard were of finely twisted linen.
chapters.nkjv: All the hangings of the court all around wereof fine woven linen.
chapters.kjv: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

chapters.ml: തൂണുകൾക്കുള്ള ചുവടു താമ്രംകൊണ്ടും തൂണുകളുടെ കൊളുത്തും മേൽചുറ്റുപടിയും വെള്ളികൊണ്ടും കുമിഴുകൾ വെള്ളിപൊതിഞ്ഞവയും പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ തൂണുകൾ ഒക്കെയും വെള്ളികൊണ്ടു മേൽചുറ്റുപടിയുള്ളവയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The bases for the posts were bronze. The hooks and bands on the posts were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver; so all the posts of the courtyard had silver bands.
chapters.nkjv: The sockets for the pillars were bronze, the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver, and the overlay of their capitals was silver; and all the pillars of the court had bands of silver.
chapters.kjv: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പ്രാകാരവാതിലിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു ചിത്രത്തയ്യൽപണി ആയിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ നീളം ഇരുപതു മുഴവും അതിന്റെ ഉയരമായ വീതി പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മറശ്ശീലെക്കു സമമായി അഞ്ചു മുഴവും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was made of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,
chapters.nkjv: The screen for the gate of the court was woven of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen. The length was twenty cubits, and the height along its width was five cubits, corresponding to the hangings of the court.
chapters.kjv: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ തൂണു നാലും അവയുടെ ചുവടു നാലും താമ്രമായിരുന്നു; കൊളുത്തും കുമിഴുകൾ പൊതിഞ്ഞിരുന്ന തകിടും മേൽചുറ്റുപടിയും വെള്ളി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks and bands were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver.
chapters.nkjv: And therewere four pillars with their four sockets of bronze; their hooks were silver, and the overlay of their capitals and their bands was silver.
chapters.kjv: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നും പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നും നാലു പുറവുമുള്ള കുറ്റികൾ ഒക്കെയും താമ്രം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the tent pegs of the tabernacle and of the surrounding courtyard were bronze.
chapters.nkjv: All the pegs of the tabernacle, and of the court all around, were bronze.
chapters.kjv: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ കല്പന അനുസരിച്ചു പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ മകൻ ഈഥാമാർ മുഖാന്തരം ലേവ്യരുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷയാൽ കണക്കു കൂട്ടിയതുപോലെ സാക്ഷ്യകൂടാരമെന്ന തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നുണ്ടായ ചെലവു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: These are the amounts of the materials used for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the covenant law, which were recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.
chapters.nkjv: This is the inventory of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, which was counted according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.
chapters.kjv: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഹൂരിന്റെ മകനായ ഊരിയുടെ മകൻ ബെസലേൽ മോശെയോടു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: (Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything the Lord commanded Moses;
chapters.nkjv: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ ദാൻഗോത്രത്തിൽ അഹീസാമാക്കിന്റെ മകനായി കൊത്തുപണിക്കാരനും കൌശലപ്പണിക്കാരനും നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവ കൊണ്ടു ചിത്രത്തയ്യൽപണി ചെയ്യുന്നവനുമായ ഒഹൊലീയാബും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan—an engraver and designer, and an embroiderer in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen.)
chapters.nkjv: And with him was Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and designer, a weaver of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine linen.
chapters.kjv: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ സകലപ്രവൃത്തിയുടെയും പണിക്കു വഴിപാടായി വന്നു ഉപയോഗിച്ച പൊന്നു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം ആകെ ഇരുപത്തൊമ്പതു താലന്തും എഴുനൂറ്റിമുപ്പതു ശേക്കെലും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The total amount of the gold from the wave offering used for all the work on the sanctuary was 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
chapters.nkjv: All the gold that was used in all the work of the holy place, that is, the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place , even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: സഭയിൽ ചാർത്തപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ വെള്ളി വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം നൂറു താലന്തും ആയിരത്തെഴുനൂറ്റെഴുപത്തഞ്ചു ശേക്കെലും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The silver obtained from those of the community who were counted in the census was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—
chapters.nkjv: And the silver from those who were numbered of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
chapters.kjv: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

chapters.ml: ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ളവരായി ചാർത്തപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ എണ്ണത്തിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ട ആറുലക്ഷത്തിമൂവായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറ്റമ്പതു പേരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്നു ഓരോ ബെക്കാ വീതമായിരുന്നു; അതു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം അരശേക്കെൽ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: one beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone who had crossed over to those counted, twenty years old or more, a total of 603,550 men.
chapters.nkjv: a bekah for each man (thatis, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary), for everyone included in the numbering from twenty years old and above, for six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty men.
chapters.kjv: A bekah for every man, that is , half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men .

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ ചുവടുകളും മറശ്ശീലയുടെ ചുവടുകളും വാർക്കുന്നതിന്നു ഒരു ചുവടിന്നു ഒരു താലന്തു വീതം നൂറു ചുവടിന്നു നൂറു താലന്തു വെള്ളി ചെലവായി.
chapters.niv: The 100 talents of silver were used to cast the bases for the sanctuary and for the curtain—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent for each base.
chapters.nkjv: And from the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil: one hundred sockets from the hundred talents, one talent for each socket.
chapters.kjv: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

chapters.ml: ശേഷിപ്പുള്ള ആയിരത്തെഴുനൂറ്റെഴുപത്തഞ്ചു ശേക്കെൽകൊണ്ടു അവൻ തൂണുകൾക്കു കൊളുത്തു ഉണ്ടാക്കുകയും കുമിഴ് പൊതികയും മേൽചുറ്റുപടി ഉണ്ടാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They used the 1,775 shekels to make the hooks for the posts, to overlay the tops of the posts, and to make their bands.
chapters.nkjv: Then from the one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made bands for them.
chapters.kjv: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

chapters.ml: വഴിപാടു വന്ന താമ്രം എഴുപതു താലന്തും രണ്ടായിരത്തിനാനൂറു ശേക്കെലും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The bronze from the wave offering was 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.
chapters.nkjv: The offering of bronze was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
chapters.kjv: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നുള്ള ചുവടുകളും താമ്രയാഗപീഠവും അതിന്റെ താമ്രജാലവും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും
chapters.niv: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the tent of meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,
chapters.nkjv: And with it he made the sockets for the door of the tabernacle of meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, and all the utensils for the altar,
chapters.kjv: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

chapters.ml: ചുറ്റും പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ ചുവടുകളും പ്രാകാരവാതിലിന്നുള്ള ചുവടുകളും തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ എല്ലാകുറ്റികളും ചുറ്റും പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ കുറ്റികളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and those for its entrance and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and those for the surrounding courtyard.
chapters.nkjv: the sockets for the court all around, the bases for the court gate, all the pegs for the tabernacle, and all the pegs for the court all around.
chapters.kjv: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർ നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കായി വിശേഷവസ്ത്രവും അഹരോന്നു വിശുദ്ധവസ്ത്രവും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: From the blue, purple and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. They also made sacred garments for Aaron, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet thread they made garments of ministry, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: പൊന്നു, നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു ഏഫോദ് ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.
chapters.nkjv: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen.
chapters.kjv: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

chapters.ml: നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവയുടെ ഇടയിൽ ചിത്രപ്പണിയായി നെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർ പൊന്നു അടിച്ചു നേരിയ തകിടാക്കി നൂലായി കണ്ടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut strands to be worked into the blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen—the work of skilled hands.
chapters.nkjv: And they beat the gold into thin sheets and cut itinto threads, to work it in with the blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and the fine linen, into artistic designs.
chapters.kjv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

chapters.ml: അവർ അതിന്നു തമ്മിൽ ഇണെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ചുമൽക്കണ്ടങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി: അതു രണ്ടു അറ്റത്തും ഇണെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached to two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
chapters.nkjv: They made shoulder straps for it to couple it together; it was coupled together at its two edges.
chapters.kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

chapters.ml: അതു കെട്ടി മുറുക്കുവാൻ അതിന്മേലുള്ളതായി ചിത്രപ്പണിയായ നടുക്കെട്ടു, യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അതിൽ നിന്നു തന്നേ, അതിന്റെ പണിപോലെ പൊന്നു, നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its skillfully woven waistband was like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen, as the Lord commanded Moses.
