chapters.nkjv: And the intricately woven band of his ephod that was on it was of the same workmanship, wovenof gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: മുദ്രക്കൊത്തായിട്ടു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെപേർ കൊത്തിയ ഗോമേദകക്കല്ലുകളെ അവർ പൊന്തടങ്ങളിൽ പതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings and engraved them like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And they set onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold; they were engraved, as signets are engraved, with the names of the sons of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു വേണ്ടി ഏഫോദിന്റെ ചുമക്കണ്ടങ്ങളിന്മേൽ ഓർമ്മക്കല്ലുകൾ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: He put them on the shoulders of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഏഫോദിന്റെ പണിപോലെ ചിത്രപ്പണിയായിട്ടു പൊന്നു, നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു പതക്കവും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They fashioned the breastpiece—the work of a skilled craftsman. They made it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.
chapters.nkjv: And he made the breastplate, artistically woven like the workmanship of the ephod, of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen.
chapters.kjv: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

chapters.ml: അതു സമചതുരമായിരുന്നു; പതക്കം ഇരട്ടയായി ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതു ഒരു ചാൺ നീളവും ഒരു ചാൺ വീതിയും ഉള്ളതായി ഇരട്ട ആയിരന്നു.
chapters.niv: It was square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.
chapters.nkjv: They made the breastplate square by doubling it; a span was its length and a span its width when doubled.
chapters.kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

chapters.ml: അവർ അതിൽ നാലു നിര രത്നം പതിച്ചു: താമ്രമണി, പീതരത്നം, മരതകം; ഇതു ഒന്നാമത്തെ നിര.
chapters.niv: Then they mounted four rows of precious stones on it. The first row was carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;
chapters.nkjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: a row with a sardius, a topaz, and an emerald was the first row;
chapters.kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തെ നിര: മാണിക്യം, നിലക്കല്ലു, വജ്രം,
chapters.niv: the second row was turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;
chapters.nkjv: the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
chapters.kjv: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമത്തെ നിര: പത്മരാഗം, വൈഡൂര്യം, സുഗന്ധിക്കല്ലു.
chapters.niv: the third row was jacinth, agate and amethyst;
chapters.nkjv: the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
chapters.kjv: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

chapters.ml: നാലാമത്തെ നിര: ഗോമേദകം, പുഷ്പരാഗം, സൂര്യകാന്തം; അവ അതതു തടത്തിൽ പൊന്നിൽ പതിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: the fourth row was topaz, onyx and jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.
chapters.nkjv: the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Theywere enclosed in settings of gold in their mountings.
chapters.kjv: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

chapters.ml: ഈ കല്ലുകൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ പേരുകളോടുകൂടെ അവരുടെ പേർപോലെ പന്ത്രണ്ടു ആയിരുന്നു; പന്ത്രണ്ടു ഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്റെ പേർ അവയിൽ മുദ്രക്കൊത്തായി കൊത്തിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There were twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
chapters.nkjv: Therewere twelve stones according to the names of the sons of Israel: according to their names, engravedlike a signet, each one with its own name according to the twelve tribes.
chapters.kjv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

chapters.ml: പതക്കത്തിന്നു ചരടുപോലെ മുറിച്ചുകുത്തുപണിയായി തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു സരപ്പളികളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: For the breastpiece they made braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.
chapters.nkjv: And they made chains for the breastplate at the ends, like braided cords of pure gold.
chapters.kjv: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

chapters.ml: പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു രണ്ടു വളയവും രണ്ടു കണ്ണിയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; വളയം രണ്ടും പതക്കത്തിന്റെ രണ്ടു അറ്റത്തും വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the rings to two of the corners of the breastpiece.
chapters.nkjv: They also made two settings of gold and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
chapters.kjv: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

chapters.ml: പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടുള്ള രണ്ടു സരപ്പളി അവർ പതക്കത്തിന്റെ അറ്റത്തു രണ്ടു വളയത്തിലും കൊളുത്തി.
chapters.niv: They fastened the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
chapters.nkjv: And they put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
chapters.kjv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു സരപ്പളിയുടെയും അറ്റം രണ്ടും അവർ കണ്ണി രണ്ടിലും കൊളുത്തി ഏഫോദിന്റെ ചുമൽക്കണ്ടങ്ങളിന്മേൽ മുൻഭാഗത്തു വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
chapters.nkjv: The two ends of the two braided chains they fastened in the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in the front.
chapters.kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

chapters.ml: അവർ പൊന്നു കൊണ്ടു വേറെ രണ്ടു കണ്ണി ഉണ്ടാക്കി പതക്കത്തിന്റെ മറ്റെ രണ്ടു അറ്റത്തും ഏഫോദിന്റെ കീഴറ്റത്തിന്നു നേരെ അകത്തെ വിളുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They made two gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.
chapters.nkjv: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the edge of it, which was on the inward side of the ephod.
chapters.kjv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

chapters.ml: അവർ വേറെ രണ്ടു പൊൻകണ്ണി ഉണ്ടാക്കി ഏഫോദിന്റെ മുൻഭാഗത്തു രണ്ടു ചുമൽക്കണ്ടങ്ങളിൽ താഴെ അതിന്റെ ഇണെപ്പിന്നരികെ എഫോദിന്റെ നടുക്കെട്ടിന്നു മേലായി വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.
chapters.nkjv: They made two other gold rings and put them on the two shoulder straps, underneath the ephod toward its front, right at the seam above the intricately woven band of the ephod.
chapters.kjv: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

chapters.ml: പതക്കം ഏഫോദിന്റെ നടുക്കെട്ടിന്നു മേലായി ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും അതു ഏഫോദിൽ ആടാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും ദൈവം മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർ അതു കണ്ണികളാൽ ഏഫോദിന്റെ കണ്ണികളോടു നീലനാടകൊണ്ടു കെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: They tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband so that the breastpiece would not swing out from the ephod—as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And they bound the breastplate by means of its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it would be above the intricately woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate would not come loose from the ephod, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഏഫോദിന്റെ അങ്കി മുഴുവനും നീലനൂൽകൊണ്ടു നെയ്ത്തുപണിയായി ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth—the work of a weaver—
chapters.nkjv: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
chapters.kjv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

chapters.ml: അങ്കിയുടെ നടുവിൽ കവചത്തിന്റെ ദ്വാരംപോലെ ഒരു ദ്വാരവും അതു കീറാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ചുറ്റും ഒരു നാടയും വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: with an opening in the center of the robe like the opening of a collar, and a band around this opening, so that it would not tear.
chapters.nkjv: And therewas an opening in the middle of the robe, like the opening in a coat of mail, with a woven binding all around the opening, so that it would not tear.
chapters.kjv: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

chapters.ml: അങ്കിയുടെ വിളുമ്പിൽ നീലനൂൽ ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ, പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ, എന്നിവ കൊണ്ടു മാതളപ്പഴങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They made pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen around the hem of the robe.
chapters.nkjv: They made on the hem of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet, and of fine woven linen.
chapters.kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen .

chapters.ml: തങ്കം കൊണ്ടു മണികളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; മണികൾ അങ്കിയുടെ വിളുമ്പിൽ ചുറ്റും മാതളപ്പഴങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And they made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates.
chapters.nkjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates on the hem of the robe all around between the pomegranates:
chapters.kjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

chapters.ml: ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള അങ്കിയുടെ വിളുമ്പിൽ ചുറ്റും ഒരു മണിയും ഒരു മാതളപ്പഴവും ഒരു മണിയും ഒരു മാതളപ്പഴവും ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The bells and pomegranates alternated around the hem of the robe to be worn for ministering, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, all around the hem of the robe to minister in, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്നും പുത്രന്മാർക്കും പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടു നെയ്ത്തുപണിയായ അങ്കിയും
chapters.niv: For Aaron and his sons, they made tunics of fine linen—the work of a weaver—
chapters.nkjv: They made tunics, artistically woven of fine linen, for Aaron and his sons,
chapters.kjv: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

chapters.ml: പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടു മുടിയും പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടു അലങ്കാരമുള്ള തലപ്പാവും പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടു കാൽച്ചട്ടയും
chapters.niv: and the turban of fine linen, the linen caps and the undergarments of finely twisted linen.
chapters.nkjv: a turban of fine linen, exquisite hats of fine linen, short trousers of fine woven linen,
chapters.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

chapters.ml: പിരിച്ച പഞ്ഞിനൂൽ, നീലനൂൽ, ധൂമ്രനൂൽ, ചുവപ്പുനൂൽ എന്നിവ കൊണ്ടു ചിത്രത്തയ്യൽപണിയായ നടുക്കെട്ടും യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: The sash was made of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn—the work of an embroiderer—as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: and a sash of fine woven linen with blue, purple, and scarlet thread, made by a weaver, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു വിശുദ്ധമുടിയുടെ നെറ്റിപ്പട്ടം ഉണ്ടാക്കി, അതിൽ “യഹോവെക്കു വിശുദ്ധം” എന്നു മുദ്രക്കൊത്തായുള്ള ഒരു എഴുത്തു കൊത്തി.
chapters.niv: They made the plate, the sacred emblem, out of pure gold and engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: Holy to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription like the engraving of a signet: HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
chapters.kjv: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD .

chapters.ml: അതു മുടിമേൽ കെട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിൽ നീലനൂൽനാട കോർത്തു: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then they fastened a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And they tied to it a blue cord, to fasten it above on the turban, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരമെന്ന തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ പണി ഒക്കെയും തീർന്നു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ചെയ്തു. അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവർ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So all the work on the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was finished. And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord had commanded Moses; so they did.
chapters.kjv: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

chapters.ml: അവർ തിരുനിവാസം മോശെയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; കൂടാരവും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും കൊളുത്തു, പലക,
chapters.niv: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;
chapters.nkjv: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its furnishings: its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
chapters.kjv: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

chapters.ml: അന്താഴം, തൂൺ, ചുവടു, ചുവപ്പിച്ച ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്തോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള പുറമൂടി, തഹശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള പുറമൂടി, മറയുടെ തിരശ്ശീല,
chapters.niv: the covering of ram skins dyed red and the covering of another durable leather and the shielding curtain;
chapters.nkjv: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of badger skins, and the veil of the covering;
chapters.kjv: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

chapters.ml: സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകം, അതിന്റെ തണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: the ark of the covenant law with its poles and the atonement cover;
chapters.nkjv: the ark of the Testimony with its poles, and the mercy seat;
chapters.kjv: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

chapters.ml: കൃപാസനം, മേശ, അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും,
chapters.niv: the table with all its articles and the bread of the Presence;
chapters.nkjv: the table, all its utensils, and the showbread;
chapters.kjv: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

chapters.ml: കാഴ്ചയപ്പം, തങ്കംകൊണ്ടുള്ള നിലവിളക്കു, കത്തിച്ചുവെപ്പാനുള്ള ദീപങ്ങൾ, അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും,
chapters.niv: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its accessories, and the olive oil for the light;
chapters.nkjv: the pure gold lampstand with its lamps (the lamps set in order), all its utensils, and the oil for light;
chapters.kjv: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

chapters.ml: വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നു എണ്ണ, പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ധൂപപീഠം, അഭിഷേകതൈലം, സുഗന്ധ ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം, കൂടാരവാതിലിന്നുള്ള മറശ്ശീല,
chapters.niv: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
chapters.nkjv: the gold altar, the anointing oil, and the sweet incense; the screen for the tabernacle door;
chapters.kjv: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

chapters.ml: താമ്രംകൊണ്ടുള്ള യാഗപീഠം, അതിന്റെ താമ്രജാലം, തണ്ടു, അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും, തൊട്ടി, അതിന്റെ കാൽ,
chapters.niv: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;
chapters.nkjv: the bronze altar, its grate of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the laver with its base;
chapters.kjv: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

chapters.ml: പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല, തൂൺ, അതിന്റെ ചുവടു, പ്രാകാരവാതിലിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല, അതിന്റെ കയറു, കുറ്റി, സമാഗമനക്കുടാരമെന്ന തിരുനിവാസത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും,
chapters.niv: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs for the courtyard; all the furnishings for the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;
chapters.nkjv: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its sockets, the screen for the court gate, its cords, and its pegs; all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
chapters.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കായി വിശേഷവസ്ത്രം, പുരോഹിതശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള അഹരോന്റെ വിശുദ്ധവസ്ത്രം, അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ വസ്ത്രം
chapters.niv: and the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when serving as priests.
chapters.nkjv: and the garments of ministry, to minister in the holy place: the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister as priests.
chapters.kjv: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ എല്ലാപണിയും തീർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites had done all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: According to all that the Lord had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
chapters.kjv: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

chapters.ml: മോശെ പണി ഒക്കെയും നോക്കി, യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ അവർ അതു ചെയ്തു തീർത്തിരുന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടു മോശെ അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Moses inspected the work and saw that they had done it just as the Lord had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses looked over all the work, and indeed they had done it; as the Lord had commanded, just so they had done it. And Moses blessed them.
chapters.kjv: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses:
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി നീ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരമെന്ന തിരുനിവാസം നിവിർക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, on the first day of the first month.
chapters.nkjv: "On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
chapters.kjv: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

chapters.ml: സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകം അതിൽ വെച്ചു തിരശ്ശീലകൊണ്ടു പെട്ടകം മറെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Place the ark of the covenant law in it and shield the ark with the curtain.
chapters.nkjv: You shall put in it the ark of the Testimony, and partition off the ark with the veil.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

chapters.ml: മേശ കോണ്ടുവന്നു അതിന്റെ സാധനങ്ങൾ ക്രമത്തിൽ വെക്കേണം. നിലവിളക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അതിന്റെ ദീപം കൊളുത്തേണം.
chapters.niv: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.
chapters.nkjv: You shall bring in the table and arrange the things that are to be set in order on it; and you shall bring in the lampstand and light its lamps.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

chapters.ml: ധൂപത്തിന്നുള്ള പൊമ്പീഠം സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകത്തിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു തിരുനിവാസവാതിലിന്റെ മിറശ്ശീല തൂക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the covenant law and put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: You shall also set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the Testimony, and put up the screen for the door of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരമെന്ന തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ ഹോമയാഗപീഠം വെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്നും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും നടുവിൽ തൊട്ടി വെച്ചു അതിൽ വെള്ളം ഒഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

chapters.ml: ചുറ്റും പ്രാകാരം നിവിർത്തു പ്രാകാരവാതിലിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല തൂക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.
chapters.nkjv: You shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen at the court gate.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

chapters.ml: അഭിഷേകതൈലം എടുത്തു തിരുനിവാസവും അതിലുള്ള സകലവും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു അതും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കേണം;
chapters.niv: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.
chapters.nkjv: "And you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it; and you shall hallow it and all its utensils, and it shall be holy.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗപീഠവും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു യാഗപീഠം ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കേണം; യാഗപീഠം അതിവിശുദ്ധമായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Then anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.
chapters.nkjv: You shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar. The altar shall be most holy.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

chapters.ml: തൊട്ടിയും അതിന്റെ കാലും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall anoint the laver and its base, and consecrate it.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

chapters.ml: അഹരോനെയും പുത്രന്മാരെയും സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവരെ വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടു കഴുകേണം.
chapters.niv: "Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
chapters.nkjv: "Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of meeting and wash them with water.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

chapters.ml: അഹരോനെ വിശുദ്ധവസ്ത്രം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു, എനിക്കു പുരോഹിതശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Then dress Aaron in the sacred garments, anoint him and consecrate him so he may serve me as priest.
chapters.nkjv: You shall put the holy garments on Aaron, and anoint him and consecrate him, that he may minister to Me as priest.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ വരുത്തി അങ്കി ധരിപ്പിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു പുരോഹിത ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ അപ്പനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അവരെയും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്യേണം; അവരുടെ അഭിഷേകം ഹേതുവായി അവർക്കു തലമുറതലമുറയോളം നിത്യ പൌരോഹിത്യം ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue throughout their generations."
chapters.nkjv: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to Me as priests; for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations."
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു; യഹോവ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അവൻ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Moses did everything just as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Moses did; according to all that the Lord had commanded him, so he did.
chapters.kjv: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ രണ്ടാം സംവത്സരം ഒന്നാം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി തിരുനിവാസം നിവിർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass in the first month of the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was raised up.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

chapters.ml: മോശെ തിരുനിവാസം നിവിർക്കുകയും അതിന്റെ ചുവടു ഉറപ്പിക്കയും പലക നിറുത്തുകയും അന്താഴം ചെലുത്തുകയും തൂൺ നാട്ടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses raised up the tabernacle, fastened its sockets, set up its boards, put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
chapters.kjv: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂടുവിരി തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ വിരിച്ചു അതിന്മീതെ മൂടുവിരിയുടെ പുറമൂടിയും വിരിച്ചു; യഹോവാ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent on top of it, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സാക്ഷ്യം എടുത്തു പെട്ടകത്തിൽ വെച്ചു; പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു തണ്ടു ചെലുത്തി പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു മീതെ കൃപാസനം വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He took the tablets of the covenant law and placed them in the ark, attached the poles to the ark and put the atonement cover over it.
chapters.nkjv: He took the Testimony and put it into the ark, inserted the poles through the rings of the ark, and put the mercy seat on top of the ark.
chapters.kjv: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

chapters.ml: പെട്ടകം തിരുനിവാസത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു മറയുടെ തിരശ്ശീല തൂക്കി സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകം മറെച്ചു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the shielding curtain and shielded the ark of the covenant law, as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, hung up the veil of the covering, and partitioned off the ark of the Testimony, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ വടക്കുവശത്തു തിരശ്ശീലെക്കു പുറത്തായി മേശവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Moses placed the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain
chapters.nkjv: He put the table in the tabernacle of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil;
chapters.kjv: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

chapters.ml: അതിന്മേൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അപ്പം അടുക്കിവെച്ചു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: and set out the bread on it before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: and he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD ; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ മോശെക്കു നേരെ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ തെക്കുവശത്തു നിലവിളക്കു വെക്കയും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ദീപം കൊളുത്തുകയും ചെയ്തു;
chapters.niv: He placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle
chapters.nkjv: He put the lampstand in the tabernacle of meeting, across from the table, on the south side of the tabernacle;
chapters.kjv: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: and set up the lamps before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: and he lit the lamps before the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD ; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ തിരശ്ശീലയുടെ മുൻ വശത്തു പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ധൂപപീഠം വെക്കയും അതിന്മേൽ സുഗന്ധ ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം ധൂപിക്കയും ചെയ്തു;
chapters.niv: Moses placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the curtain
chapters.nkjv: He put the gold altar in the tabernacle of meeting in front of the veil;
chapters.kjv: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: and he burned sweet incense on it, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നുള്ള മറശ്ശീല തൂക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: He hung up the screen at the door of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗപീഠം സമാഗമനക്കുടാരമെന്ന തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നു മുൻ വശത്തു വെക്കയും അതിന്മേൽ ഹോമയാഗവും ഭോജനയാഗവും അർപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തു. യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: He set the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്നും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും നടുവിൽ അവൻ തൊട്ടിവെക്കയും കഴുകേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിൽ വെള്ളം ഒഴിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,
chapters.nkjv: He set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water there for washing;
chapters.kjv: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal .

chapters.ml: മോശെയും അഹരോനും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും അതിൽ കയ്യും കാലും കഴുകി.
chapters.niv: and Moses and Aaron and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet.
chapters.nkjv: and Moses, Aaron, and his sons would wash their hands and their feet withwater from it.
chapters.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

chapters.ml: അവർ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ കടക്കുമ്പോഴും യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ ചെല്ലുമ്പോഴും കൈകാലുകൾ കഴുകും; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: They washed whenever they entered the tent of meeting or approached the altar, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Whenever they went into the tabernacle of meeting, and when they came near the altar, they washed, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും ചുറ്റം പ്രാകാരം നിറുത്തി; പ്രാകാരവാതിലിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല തൂക്കി. ഇങ്ങനെ മോശെ പ്രവൃത്തി സമാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and altar and put up the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. And so Moses finished the work.
chapters.nkjv: And he raised up the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the screen of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
chapters.kjv: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മേഘം സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തെ മൂടി, യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു തിരുനിവാസത്തെ നിറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: Then the cloud covered the tabernacle of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: മേഘം സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്മേൽ അധിവസിക്കയും യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു തിരുനിവാസത്തെ നിറെക്കയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു മോശെക്കു അകത്തു കടപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses was not able to enter the tabernacle of meeting, because the cloud rested above it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ തങ്ങളുടെ സകലപ്രയാണങ്ങളിലും മേഘം തിരുനിവസത്തിന്മേൽനിന്നു ഉയരുമ്പോൾ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: In all the travels of the Israelites, whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, they would set out;
chapters.nkjv: Whenever the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle, the children of Israel would go onward in all their journeys.
chapters.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

chapters.ml: മേഘം ഉയരാതിരുന്നാൽ അതു ഉയരുംനാൾവരെ അവർ യാത്രപുറപ്പെടാതിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out—until the day it lifted.
chapters.nkjv: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not journey till the day that it was taken up.
chapters.kjv: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യരുടെ സകലപ്രയാണങ്ങളിലും അവരെല്ലാവരും കാൺകെ പകൽ സമയത്തു തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവയുടെ മേഘവും രാത്രിസമയത്തു അതിൽ അഗ്നിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the cloud of the Lord was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the Israelites during all their travels.
chapters.nkjv: For the cloud of the Lordwas above the tabernacle by day, and fire was over it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
chapters.kjv: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽവെച്ചു മോശെയെ വിളിച്ചു അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting. He said,
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord called to Moses, and spoke to him from the tabernacle of meeting, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു സംസാരിച്ചു അവരോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങളിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും യഹോവെക്കു വഴിപാടു കഴിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കന്നുകാലികളോ ആടുകളോ ആയ മൃഗങ്ങളെ വഴിപാടു കഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When anyone among you brings an offering to the Lord , bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When any one of you brings an offering to the Lord, you shall bring your offering of the livestock—of the herd and of the flock.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD , ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

chapters.ml: അവർ വഴിപാടായി കന്നുകാലികളിൽ ഒന്നിനെ ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ആണിനെ അർപ്പിക്കേണം; യഹോവയുടെ പ്രസാദം ലഭിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവൻ അതിനെ സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ വെച്ചു അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you are to offer a male without defect. You must present it at the entrance to the tent of meeting so that it will be acceptable to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: ‘If his offering is a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish; he shall offer it of his own free will at the door of the tabernacle of meeting before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്റെ തലയിൽ കൈവെക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം വരുത്തുവാൻ അവന്റെ പേർക്കു സുഗ്രാഹ്യമാകും.
chapters.niv: You are to lay your hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on your behalf to make atonement for you.
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall put his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.
chapters.kjv: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കാളക്കിടാവിനെ അറുക്കേണം; അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ അതിന്റെ രക്തം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ ഉള്ള യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ചുറ്റും തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to slaughter the young bull before the Lord , and then Aaron’s sons the priests shall bring the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: He shall kill the bull before the Lord; and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood and sprinkle the blood all around on the altar that isby the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD : and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹോമയാഗമൃഗത്തെ തോലുരിച്ചു ഖണ്ഡംഖണ്ഡമായി മുറിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.
chapters.kjv: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ തീ ഇട്ടു തീയുടെ മേൽ വിറകു അടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay the wood in order on the fire.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ഖണ്ഡങ്ങളും തലയും മേദസ്സും യാഗപീഠത്തിൽ തീയുടെ മേലുള്ള വിറകിന്മീതെ അടുക്കിവെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire upon the altar;
chapters.kjv: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ കുടലും കാലും അവൻ വെള്ളത്തിൽ കഴുകേണം. പുരോഹിതൻ സകലവും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ഹോമയാഗമായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗം.
chapters.niv: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: but he shall wash its entrails and its legs with water. And the priest shall burn all on the altar as a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള അവന്റെ വഴിപാടു ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിലെ ഒരു ചെമ്മരിയാടോ കോലാടോ ആകുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ആണിനെ അവൻ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, you are to offer a male without defect.
chapters.nkjv: ‘If his offering is of the flocks—of the sheep or of the goats—as a burnt sacrifice, he shall bring a male without blemish.
chapters.kjv: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely , of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ വടക്കുവശത്തുവെച്ചു അതിനെ അറുക്കേണം; അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ അതിന്റെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ചുറ്റും തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the Lord , and Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the Lord; and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD : and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിനെ തലയോടും മേദസ്സോടുംകൂടെ ഖണ്ഡംഖണ്ഡമായി മുറിക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ അവയെ യാഗപീഠത്തിൽ തീയുടെമേലുള്ള വിറകിന്മീതെ അടുക്കിവെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat; and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire upon the altar;
chapters.kjv: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

chapters.ml: കുടലും കാലും അവൻ വെള്ളത്തിൽ കഴുകേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ സകലവും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ഹോമയാഗമായി യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയുള്ള ദഹനയാഗമായി യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of them and burn them on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: but he shall wash the entrails and the legs with water. Then the priest shall bring it all and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു അവന്റെ വഴിപാടു പറവ ജാതിയിൽ ഒന്നിനെക്കൊണ്ടുള്ള ഹോമയാഗമാകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ കുറുപ്രാവിനെയോ പ്രാവിൻ കുഞ്ഞിനെയോ വഴിപാടായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If the offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, you are to offer a dove or a young pigeon.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And if the burnt sacrifice of his offering to the Lordis of birds, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves or young pigeons.
chapters.kjv: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അതിനെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു തല പിരിച്ചുപറിച്ചു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതിന്റെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വത്തിങ്കൽ പിഴിഞ്ഞുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out at the side of the altar.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ തീൻ പണ്ടം മലത്തോടുകൂടെ പറിച്ചെടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ അരികെ കിഴക്കുവശത്തു വെണ്ണീരിടുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു ഇടേണം.
chapters.niv: He is to remove the crop and the feathers and throw them down east of the altar where the ashes are.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall remove its crop with its feathers and cast it beside the altar on the east side, into the place for ashes.
chapters.kjv: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

chapters.ml: അതിനെ രണ്ടാക്കാതെ ചിറകോടുകൂടെ പിളർക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ അതിനെ യാഗപീഠത്തിൽ തീയുടെമേലുള്ള വിറകിന്മീതെ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു ഹോമയാഗമായി യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗം.
chapters.niv: He shall tear it open by the wings, not dividing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is burning on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall split it at its wings, but shall not divide it completely; and the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും യഹോവെക്കു ഭോജനയാഗമായ വഴിപാടു കഴിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ വഴിപാടു നേരിയ മാവു ആയിരിക്കേണം; അവൻ അതിന്മേൽ എണ്ണ ഒഴിച്ചു കുന്തുരുക്കവും ഇടേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘When anyone brings a grain offering to the Lord , their offering is to be of the finest flour. They are to pour olive oil on it, put incense on it
chapters.nkjv: ‘When anyone offers a grain offering to the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour. And he shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.
chapters.kjv: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD , his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ അടു ക്കൽ അതുകൊണ്ടു വരേണം. അവൻ മാവും എണ്ണയും ഒരു കൈ നിറച്ചും കുന്തുരുക്കം മുഴുവനും എടുക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ അതു നിവേദ്യമായി യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹന യാഗം.
chapters.niv: and take it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests, one of whom shall take from it his handful of fine flour and oil with all the frankincense. And the priest shall burn itas a memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD :

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്റെ ശേഷിപ്പു അഹരോന്നും പുത്രന്മാർക്കും ഇരിക്കേണം. യഹോവെക്കുള്ള ദഹനയാഗങ്ങളിൽ അതു അതിവിശുദ്ധം.
chapters.niv: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: The rest of the grain offering shallbe Aaron’s and his sons’. Itis most holy of the offerings to the Lord made by fire.
chapters.kjv: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

chapters.ml: അടുപ്പത്തുവെച്ചു ചുട്ടതു നീ ഭോജനയാഗമായി കഴിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അതു നേരിയ മാവു കൊണ്ടുണ്ടാക്കിയതായി എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത ദോശകളോ എണ്ണ പുരട്ടിയ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത വടകളോ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of the finest flour: either thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in or thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with olive oil.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And if you bring as an offering a grain offering baked in the oven, itshallbe unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
chapters.kjv: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വഴിപാടു ചട്ടിയിൽ ചുട്ട ഭോജനയാഗം ആകുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ അതു എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത നേരിയ മാവുകൊണ്ടു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If your grain offering is prepared on a griddle, it is to be made of the finest flour mixed with oil, and without yeast.
chapters.nkjv: But if your offering is a grain offering baked in a pan, itshallbeof fine flour, unleavened, mixed with oil.
chapters.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

chapters.ml: അതു കഷണംകഷണമായി നുറക്കി അതിന്മേൽ എണ്ണ ഒഴിക്കേണം; അതു ഭോജനയാഗം.
chapters.niv: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
chapters.nkjv: You shall break it in pieces and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വഴിപാടു ഉരുളിയിൽ ചുട്ട ഭോജനയാഗം ആകുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ അതു എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത നേരിയ മാവുകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If your grain offering is cooked in a pan, it is to be made of the finest flour and some olive oil.
chapters.nkjv: ‘If your offering is a grain offering baked in a covered pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
chapters.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

chapters.ml: ഇവകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ഭോജനയാഗം നീ യഹോവെക്കു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം; അതു പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെല്ലുകയും അവൻ അതു യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ കൊണ്ടുപോകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the Lord ; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.
chapters.nkjv: You shall bring the grain offering that is made of these things to the Lord. And when it is presented to the priest, he shall bring it to the altar.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD : and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്റെ നിവേദ്യം എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗമായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest shall take from the grain offering a memorial portion, and burn it on the altar. Itis an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്റെ ശേഷിപ്പു അഹരോന്നും പുത്രന്മാർക്കും ഇരിക്കേണം; അതു യഹോവെക്കുള്ള ദഹനയാഗങ്ങളിൽ അതിവിശുദ്ധം.
chapters.niv: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And what is left of the grain offering shallbe Aaron’s and his sons’. Itis most holy of the offerings to the Lord made by fire.
chapters.kjv: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു കഴിക്കുന്ന യാതൊരു ഭോജനയാഗവും പുളിപ്പുള്ളതായി ഉണ്ടാക്കരുതു; പുളിച്ചതു ഒന്നും യാതൊരു വക തേനും യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗമായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Every grain offering you bring to the Lord must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in a food offering presented to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: ‘No grain offering which you bring to the Lord shall be made with leaven, for you shall burn no leaven nor any honey in any offering to the Lord made by fire.
chapters.kjv: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD , shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

chapters.ml: അവ ആദ്യഫലങ്ങളുടെ വഴിപാടായി യഹോവെക്കു അർപ്പിക്കാം. എങ്കിലും സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ അവ കയറരുതു.
chapters.niv: You may bring them to the Lord as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.
chapters.nkjv: As for the offering of the firstfruits, you shall offer them to the Lord, but they shall not be burned on the altar for a sweet aroma.
chapters.kjv: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD : but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നു ഒക്കെയും ഉപ്പു ചേർക്കേണം; നിന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നിയമത്തിൻ ഉപ്പു ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നു ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കരുതു; എല്ലവഴിപാടിന്നും ഉപ്പു ചേർക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.
chapters.nkjv: And every offering of your grain offering you shall season with salt; you shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your grain offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
chapters.kjv: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ആദ്യഫലങ്ങളുടെ ഭോജനയാഗം യഹോവെക്കു കഴിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കതിർ ചുട്ടു ഉതിർത്ത മണികൾ ആദ്യഫലങ്ങളുടെ ഭോജനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the Lord , offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.
chapters.nkjv: ‘If you offer a grain offering of your firstfruits to the Lord, you shall offer for the grain offering of your firstfruits green heads of grain roasted on the fire, grain beaten from full heads.
chapters.kjv: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD , thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

chapters.ml: അതിന്മേൽ എണ്ണ ഒഴിച്ചു അതിൻ മീതെ കുന്തുരുക്കവും ഇടേണം; അതു ഒരു ഭോജനയാഗം.
chapters.niv: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall put oil on it, and lay frankincense on it. It is a grain offering.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.

chapters.ml: ഉതിർത്ത മണിയിലും എണ്ണയിലും കുറേശ്ശയും കുന്തുരുക്കം മുഴുവനും പുരോഹിതൻ നിവേദ്യമായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു ദഹനയാഗം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as a food offering presented to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest shall burn the memorial portion: part of its beaten grain and part of its oil, with all the frankincense, as an offering made by fire to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഒരുവന്റെ വഴിപാടു സാമാധാനയാഗം ആകുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ കന്നുകാലികളിൽ ഒന്നിനെ അർപ്പിക്കുന്നതായാൽ ആണാകട്ടെ പെണ്ണാകട്ടെ ഊനമില്ലാത്തതിനെ അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If your offering is a fellowship offering, and you offer an animal from the herd, whether male or female, you are to present before the Lord an animal without defect.
chapters.nkjv: ‘When his offering is a sacrifice of a peace offering, if he offers it of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD .

chapters.ml: തന്റെ വഴിപാടിന്റെ തലയിൽ അവൻ കൈവെച്ചു സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽവെച്ചു അതിനെ അറുക്കേണം; അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ അതിന്റെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ചുറ്റും തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to lay your hand on the head of your offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash the blood against the sides of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of meeting; and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood all around on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സമാധാനയാഗത്തിൽനിന്നു കുടൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന മേദസ്സും കുടലിന്മേലിരിക്കുന്ന സകലമേദസ്സും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡം രണ്ടും
chapters.niv: From the fellowship offering you are to bring a food offering to the Lord : the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall offer from the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire to the Lord. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
chapters.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD ; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ മേൽ കടിപ്രദേശത്തുള്ള മേദസ്സും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡത്തോടുകൂടെ കരളിന്മേലുള്ള വപയും നീക്കി യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.
chapters.nkjv: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
chapters.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ യാഗപീഠത്തിൽ തീയുടെ മേലുള്ള വിറകിന്മേൽ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്മീതെ അതു ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗം.
chapters.niv: Then Aaron’s sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is lying on the burning wood; it is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: and Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is on the wood that is on the fire, as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു സമാധാനയാഗമായുള്ള വഴിപാടു ആടു ആകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ആണാകട്ടെ പെണ്ണാകട്ടെ ഊനമില്ലാത്തതിനെ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If you offer an animal from the flock as a fellowship offering to the Lord , you are to offer a male or female without defect.
chapters.nkjv: ‘If his offering as a sacrifice of a peace offering to the Lord is of the flock, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
chapters.kjv: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

chapters.ml: ഒരു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെ വഴിപാടായിട്ടു അർപ്പിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അതിനെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If you offer a lamb, you are to present it before the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: If he offers a lamb as his offering, then he shall offer it before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD .

chapters.ml: തന്റെ വഴിപാടിന്റെ തലയിൽ അവൻ കൈവെച്ചു സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അതിനെ അറുക്കേണം; അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അതിന്റെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ചുറ്റും തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: lay your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of meeting; and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സമാധാനയാഗത്തിൽനിന്നു അതിന്റെ മേദസ്സും തടിച്ചവാൽ മുഴുവനും - ഇതു തണ്ടെല്ലിങ്കൽ നിന്നു പറിച്ചുകളയേണം - കുടൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന മേദസ്സും കുടലിന്മേലുള്ള സകലമേദസ്സും
chapters.niv: From the fellowship offering you are to bring a food offering to the Lord : its fat, the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,
chapters.nkjv: ‘Then he shall offer from the sacrifice of the peace offering, as an offering made by fire to the Lord, its fat and the whole fat tail which he shall remove close to the backbone. And the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
chapters.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD ; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

chapters.ml: മൂത്രപിണ്ഡം രണ്ടും അവയുടെ മേൽ കടിപ്രദേശത്തുള്ള മേദസ്സും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡത്തോടുകൂടെ കരളിന്മേലുള്ള വപയും നീക്കി യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.
chapters.nkjv: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
chapters.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അതു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗഭോജനം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: and the priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വഴിപാടു കോലാടു ആകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ അതിനെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If your offering is a goat, you are to present it before the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: ‘And if his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ തലയിൽ അവൻ കൈവെച്ചു സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അതിനെ അറുക്കേണം; അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അതിന്റെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ചുറ്റും തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: lay your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: He shall lay his hand on its head and kill it before the tabernacle of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

chapters.ml: അതിൽനിന്നു കുടൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന മേദസ്സും കുടലിന്മേലുള്ള സകല മേദസ്സും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡം രണ്ടും
chapters.niv: From what you offer you are to present this food offering to the Lord : the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall offer from it his offering, as an offering made by fire to the Lord. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
chapters.kjv: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD ; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ മേൽ കടിപ്രദേശത്തുള്ള മേദസ്സം മൂത്രപിണ്ഡങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ കരളിന്മേലുള്ള വപയും നീക്കി അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗമായി തന്റെ വഴിപാടു അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.
chapters.nkjv: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
chapters.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അതു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹന യാഗഭോജനം; മേദസ്സൊക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കുള്ളതു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the Lord ’s.
chapters.nkjv: and the priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma; all the fat is the Lord’s.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD’s .

chapters.ml: മേദസ്സും രക്തവും തിന്നരുതു എന്നുള്ളതു നിങ്ങളുടെ സകലവാസസ്ഥലങ്ങളിലും നിങ്ങൾക്കു തലമുറതലമുറയായി എന്നേക്കുമുള്ള ചട്ടം ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.’ "
chapters.nkjv: ‘This shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings: you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’ "
chapters.kjv: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: ചെയ്യരുതെന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള വല്ല കാര്യത്തിലും ആരെങ്കിലും അബദ്ധവശാൽ പിഴെച്ചു ആ വക വല്ലതും ചെയ്താൽ -
chapters.niv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands—
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If a person sins unintentionally against any of the commandments of the Lord in anything which ought not to be done, and does any of them,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

chapters.ml: അഭിഷിക്തനായ പുരോഹിതൻ ജനത്തിന്മേൽ കുറ്റം വരത്തക്കവണ്ണം പാപം ചെയ്തു എങ്കിൽ താൻ ചെയ്ത പാപം നിമിത്തം അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു പാപയാഗമായി ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the Lord a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.
chapters.nkjv: if the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, then let him offer to the Lord for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without blemish as a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ കാളയെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു കാളയുടെ തലയിൽ കൈവെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കാളയെ അറുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He is to present the bull at the entrance to the tent of meeting before the Lord . He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it there before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: He shall bring the bull to the door of the tabernacle of meeting before the Lord, lay his hand on the bull’s head, and kill the bull before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock’s head, and kill the bullock before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അഭിഷിക്തനായ പുരോഹിതൻ കാളയുടെ രക്തം കുറെ എടുത്തു സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and carry it into the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and bring it to the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock’s blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ രക്തത്തിൽ വിരൽ മുക്കി യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ തിരശ്ശീലെക്കു മുമ്പിൽ ഏഴു പ്രാവശ്യം തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the Lord , in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD , before the vail of the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ രക്തം കുറെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിലുള്ള സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗത്തിൻ ധൂപപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽ പുരട്ടേണം; കാളയുടെ ശേഷം രക്തം മുഴുവനും സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ ഉള്ള ഹോമയാഗ പീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ ഒഴിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the bull’s blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of meeting; and he shall pour the remaining blood of the bull at the base of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD , which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: പാപയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള കാളയുടെ സകല മേദസ്സും കുടൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന മേദസ്സും കുടലിന്മേലുള്ള സകലമേദസ്സും അതിൽനിന്നു നീക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—all the fat that is connected to the internal organs,
chapters.nkjv: He shall take from it all the fat of the bull as the sin offering. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat which is on the entrails,
chapters.kjv: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

chapters.ml: മൂത്രപിണ്ഡം രണ്ടും അവയുടെ മേൽ കടിപ്രദേശത്തുള്ള മേദസ്സും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ കരളിന്മേലുള്ള വപയും അവൻ എടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys—
chapters.nkjv: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove,
chapters.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

chapters.ml: സമാധാനയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള കാളയിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ; പുരോഹിതൻ ഹോമയാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ അതു ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
chapters.nkjv: as it was taken from the bull of the sacrifice of the peace offering; and the priest shall burn them on the altar of the burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

chapters.ml: കാളയുടെ തോലും മാംസം മുഴുവനും തലയും കാലുകളും കുടലും ചാണകവുമായി കാളയെ മുഴുവനും
chapters.niv: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the internal organs and the intestines—
chapters.nkjv: But the bull’s hide and all its flesh, with its head and legs, its entrails and offal—
chapters.kjv: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

chapters.ml: അവൻ പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു വെണ്ണീർ ഇടുന്ന വെടിപ്പുള്ള സ്ഥലത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി വിറകിന്മേൽ വെച്ചു തീയിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം; വെണ്ണീർ ഇടുന്നേടത്തു വെച്ചുതന്നേ അതു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: that is, all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it there in a wood fire on the ash heap.
chapters.nkjv: the whole bull he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.
chapters.kjv: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽസഭ മുഴുവനും അബദ്ധവശാൽ പിഴെക്കയും ആ കാര്യം സഭയുടെ കണ്ണിന്നു മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കയും, ചെയ്യരുതെന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള വല്ലകാര്യത്തിലും അവർ പാപം ചെയ്തു കുറ്റക്കാരായി തീരുകയും ചെയ്താൽ,
chapters.niv: " ‘If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, when they realize their guilt
chapters.nkjv: ‘Now if the whole congregation of Israel sins unintentionally, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done something against any of the commandments of the Lord in anything which should not be done, and are guilty;
chapters.kjv: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

chapters.ml: ചെയ്ത പാപം അവർ അറിയുമ്പോൾ സഭ ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെ പാപയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം; സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അതിനെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിട്ടു
chapters.niv: and the sin they committed becomes known, the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: when the sin which they have committed becomes known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for the sin, and bring it before the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: സഭയുടെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കാളയുടെ തലയിൽ കൈ വെക്കേണം; യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കാളയെ അറുക്കയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: The elders of the community are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the Lord , and the bull shall be slaughtered before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the Lord. Then the bull shall be killed before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD : and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അഭിഷിക്തനായ പുരോഹിതൻ കാളയുടെ രക്തം കുറെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: Then the anointed priest is to take some of the bull’s blood into the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: The anointed priest shall bring some of the bull’s blood to the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ രക്തത്തിൽ വിരൽ മുക്കി യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ തിരശ്ശീലെക്കു മുമ്പിൽ ഏഴു പ്രാവശ്യം തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it before the Lord seven times in front of the curtain.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, in front of the veil.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD , even before the vail.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിലുള്ള പീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽ കുറെ പുരട്ടേണം; ശേഷം രക്തം മുഴുവനും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കലുള്ള ഹോമയാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ ഒഴിച്ചുകളയേണം.
