chapters.niv: He is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of meeting; and he shall pour the remaining blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD , that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മേദസ്സു ഒക്കെയും അവൻ അതിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He shall remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar,
chapters.nkjv: He shall take all the fat from it and burn it on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

chapters.ml: പാപയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള കാളയെ അവൻ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ ഈ കാളയെയും ചെയ്യേണം; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ഇതിനെയും ചെയ്യേണം; ഇങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതൻ അവർക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവരോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: and do with this bull just as he did with the bull for the sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the community, and they will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall do with the bull as he did with the bull as a sin offering; thus he shall do with it. So the priest shall make atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
chapters.kjv: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ കാളയെ പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി മുമ്പിലത്തെ കാളയെ ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ഇതിനെയും ചുട്ടുകളയേണം; ഇതു സഭെക്കുവേണ്ടിയുള്ള പാപയാഗം.
chapters.niv: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is a sin offering for the assembly.
chapters.kjv: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

chapters.ml: ഒരു പ്രമാണി പാപം ചെയ്കയും, ചെയ്യരുതെന്നു തന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള വല്ല കാര്യത്തിലും അബദ്ധവശാൽ പിഴെച്ചു കുറ്റക്കാരനായി തീരുകയും ചെയ്താൽ
chapters.niv: " ‘When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the commands of the Lord his God, when he realizes his guilt
chapters.nkjv: ‘When a ruler has sinned, and done something unintentionally against any of the commandments of the Lord his God in anything which should not be done, and is guilty,
chapters.kjv: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെയ്ത പാപം അവന്നു ബോദ്ധ്യമായി എങ്കിൽ അവൻ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ആൺ കോലാട്ടിനെ വഴിപാടായി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: and the sin he has committed becomes known, he must bring as his offering a male goat without defect.
chapters.nkjv: or if his sin which he has committed comes to his knowledge, he shall bring as his offering a kid of the goats, a male without blemish.
chapters.kjv: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആട്ടിന്റെ തലയിൽ കൈവെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഹോമയാഗമൃഗത്തെ അറുക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു അതിനെ അറുക്കേണം; അതു ഒരു പാപയാഗം.
chapters.niv: He is to lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the Lord . It is a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it at the place where they kill the burnt offering before the Lord. It is a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD : it is a sin offering.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പുരോഹിതൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്റെ രക്തം വിരൽകൊണ്ടു കുറെ എടുത്തു ഹോമയാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽ പുരട്ടി ശേഷം രക്തം ഹോമയാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ ഒഴിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മേദസ്സു ഒക്കെയും അവൻ സമാധാനയാഗത്തിന്റെ മേദസ്സുപോലെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; ഇങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതൻ അവന്റെ പാപം നിമിത്തം അവന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the leader’s sin, and he will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of the peace offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
chapters.kjv: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തെ ജനത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ചെയ്യരുതെന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള വല്ലകാര്യത്തിലും അബദ്ധവശാൽ പിഴെച്ചു കുറ്റക്കാരനായി തീർന്നാൽ
chapters.niv: " ‘If any member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, when they realize their guilt
chapters.nkjv: ‘If anyone of the common people sins unintentionally by doing something against any of the commandments of the Lord in anything which ought not to be done, and is guilty,
chapters.kjv: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

chapters.ml: പാപം അവന്നു ബോദ്ധ്യമായി എങ്കിൽ അവൻ ചെയ്ത പാപം നിമിത്തം ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു പെൺകോലാട്ടിനെ വഴിപാടായി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: and the sin they have committed becomes known, they must bring as their offering for the sin they committed a female goat without defect.
chapters.nkjv: or if his sin which he has committed comes to his knowledge, then he shall bring as his offering a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has committed.
chapters.kjv: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

chapters.ml: പാപയാഗമൃഗത്തിന്റെ തലയിൽ അവൻ കൈ വെച്ചിട്ടു ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു പാപയാഗമൃഗത്തെ അറുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: They are to lay their hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering at the place of the burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അതിന്റെ രക്തം വിരൽകൊണ്ടു കുറെ എടുത്തു ഹോമയാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽ പുരട്ടി, ശേഷം രക്തം ഒക്കെയും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ ഒഴിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മേദസ്സു ഒക്കെയും സമാധാനയാഗത്തിൽനിന്നു മേദസ്സു എടുക്കുന്നതുപോലെ എടുത്തു പുരോഹിതൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; ഇങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതൻ അവന്നു വേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: He shall remove all its fat, as fat is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offering; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a sweet aroma to the Lord. So the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
chapters.kjv: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പാപയാഗമായി ഒരു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത പെണ്ണാട്ടിനെ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If someone brings a lamb as their sin offering, they are to bring a female without defect.
chapters.nkjv: ‘If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish.
chapters.kjv: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

chapters.ml: പാപയാഗമൃഗത്തിന്റെ തലയിൽ അവൻ കൈവെച്ചു ഹോമയാഗമൃഗത്തെ അറുക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു അതിനെ പാപയാഗമായി അറുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: They are to lay their hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it as a sin offering at the place where they kill the burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്റെ രക്തം വിരൽകൊണ്ടു കുറെ എടുത്തു ഹോമയാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽ പുരട്ടി, ശേഷം രക്തം ഒക്കെയും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ ഒഴിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മേദസ്സു ഒക്കെയും സമാധാനയാഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയുടെ മേദസ്സു എടുക്കുന്നതുപോലെ അവൻ എടുക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവയുടെ ദഹനയാഗങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ അവയെ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അവൻ ചെയ്ത പാപത്തിന്നു പുരോഹിതൻ ഇങ്ങനെ പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: He shall remove all its fat, as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire to the Lord. So the priest shall make atonement for his sin that he has committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
chapters.kjv: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD : and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തൻ സത്യവാചകം കേട്ടിട്ടു, താൻ സാക്ഷിയായി കാണുകയോ അറികയോ ചെയ്തതു അറിയിക്കാതെ അങ്ങനെ പാപം ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ തന്റെ കുറ്റം വഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If anyone sins because they do not speak up when they hear a public charge to testify regarding something they have seen or learned about, they will be held responsible.
chapters.nkjv: ‘If a person sins in hearing the utterance of an oath, and is a witness, whether he has seen or known of the matter—if he does not tell it, he bears guilt.
chapters.kjv: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity.

chapters.ml: ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത കാട്ടുമൃഗത്തിന്റെ പിണമോ ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത നാട്ടുമൃഗത്തിന്റെ പിണമോ ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത ഇഴജാതിയുടെ പിണമോ ഇങ്ങനെ വല്ല അശുദ്ധവസ്തുവും ഒരുത്തൻ തൊടുകയും അതു അവന്നു മറവായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ അശുദ്ധനും കുറ്റക്കാരനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘If anyone becomes aware that they are guilty—if they unwittingly touch anything ceremonially unclean (whether the carcass of an unclean animal, wild or domestic, or of any unclean creature that moves along the ground) and they are unaware that they have become unclean, but then they come to realize their guilt;
chapters.nkjv: ‘Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean beast, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and he is unaware of it, he also shall be unclean and guilty.
chapters.kjv: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

chapters.ml: അല്ലെങ്കിൽ യാതൊരു അശുദ്ധിയാലെങ്കിലും അശുദ്ധനായ ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ അശുദ്ധിയെ ഒരുത്തൻ തൊടുകയും അതു അവന്നു മറവായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ അതു അറിയുമ്പോൾ അവൻ കുറ്റക്കാരനാകും.
chapters.niv: or if they touch human uncleanness (anything that would make them unclean) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt;
chapters.nkjv: Or if he touches human uncleanness—whatever uncleanness with which a man may be defiled, and he is unaware of it—when he realizes it, then he shall be guilty.
chapters.kjv: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty.

chapters.ml: അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മനുഷ്യൻ നിർവ്വിചാരമായി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നതുപോലെ ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാനോ ഗുണം ചെയ്‍വാനോ ഒരുത്തൻ തന്റെ അധരങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ടു നിർവ്വിചാരമായി സത്യം ചെയ്കയും അതു അവന്നു മറവായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ അതു അറിയുമ്പോൾ അങ്ങനെയുള്ള കാര്യത്തിൽ അവൻ കുറ്റക്കാരനാകും.
chapters.niv: or if anyone thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil (in any matter one might carelessly swear about) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt—
chapters.nkjv: ‘Or if a person swears, speaking thoughtlessly with his lips to do evil or to do good, whatever it is that a man may pronounce by an oath, and he is unaware of it—when he realizes it, then he shall be guilty in any of these matters.
chapters.kjv: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these.

chapters.ml: ആ വക കാര്യത്തിൽ അവൻ കുറ്റക്കാരനാകുമ്പോൾ താൻ പാപം ചെയ്തു എന്നു അവൻ ഏറ്റുപറയേണം.
chapters.niv: when anyone becomes aware that they are guilty in any of these matters, they must confess in what way they have sinned.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And it shall be, when he is guilty in any of these matters, that he shall confess that he has sinned in that thing;
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things , that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

chapters.ml: താൻ ചെയ്ത പാപം നിമിത്തം അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അകൃത്യയാഗമായി ചെമ്മരിയാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയോ കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയോ ആയ ഒരു പെണ്ണാട്ടിനെ പാപയാഗമായി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി അവന്റെ പാപം നിമിത്തം പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: As a penalty for the sin they have committed, they must bring to the Lord a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering ; and the priest shall make atonement for them for their sin.
chapters.nkjv: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the Lord for his sin which he has committed, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats as a sin offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.
chapters.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

chapters.ml: ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിക്കു അവന്നു വകയില്ലെങ്കിൽ താൻ ചെയ്ത പാപം നിമിത്തം അവൻ രണ്ടു കുറുപ്രാവിനെയോ രണ്ടു പ്രാവിൻ കുഞ്ഞിനെയോ ഒന്നിനെ പാപയാഗമായും മറ്റേതിനെ ഹോമയാഗമായും യഹോവെക്കു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘Anyone who cannot afford a lamb is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the Lord as a penalty for their sin—one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.
chapters.nkjv: ‘If he is not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring to the Lord, for his trespass which he has committed, two turtledoves or two young pigeons: one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD ; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവയെ പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു വരേണം; അവൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ളതിനെ മുമ്പെ അർപ്പിച്ചു അതിന്റെ തല കഴുത്തിൽനിന്നു പിരിച്ചുപറിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ രണ്ടായി പിളർക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: They are to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not dividing it completely,
chapters.nkjv: And he shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off its head from its neck, but shall not divide it completely.
chapters.kjv: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

chapters.ml: അവൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്റെ രക്തം കുറെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വത്തിൽ തളിക്കേണം; ശേഷം രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ പിഴിഞ്ഞുകളയേണം; ഇതു പാപയാഗം.
chapters.niv: and is to splash some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തെതിനെ അവൻ നിയമപ്രകാരം ഹോമയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം; ഇങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതൻ അവൻ ചെയ്ത പാപംനിമിത്തം അവന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall offer the second as a burnt offering according to the prescribed manner. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf for his sin which he has committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
chapters.kjv: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു കുറുപ്രാവിന്നോ രണ്ടു പ്രാവിൻ കുഞ്ഞിന്നോ അവന്നു വകയില്ലെങ്കിൽ പാപം ചെയ്തവൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നു ഒരിടങ്ങഴി നേരിയ മാവു വഴിപാടായി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം; അതു പാപയാഗം ആകകൊണ്ടു അതിന്മേൽ എണ്ണ ഒഴിക്കരുതു; കുന്തുരുക്കം ഇടുകയും അരുതു.
chapters.niv: " ‘If, however, they cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, they are to bring as an offering for their sin a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour for a sin offering. They must not put olive oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: ‘But if he is not able to bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he who sinned shall bring for his offering one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, nor shall he put frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതു പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം: പുരോഹിതൻ നിവേദ്യമായി അതിൽനിന്നു കൈ നിറച്ചെടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവെക്കുള്ള ദഹനയാഗങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; ഇതു പാപയാഗം.
chapters.niv: They are to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . It is a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as a memorial portion, and burn it on the altar according to the offerings made by fire to the Lord. It is a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD : it is a sin offering.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതൻ ആവക കാര്യത്തിൽ അവൻ ചെയ്ത പാപം നിമിത്തം അവന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും; ശേഷിപ്പുള്ളതു ഭോജനയാഗം പോലെ പുരോഹിതന്നു ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: In this way the priest will make atonement for them for any of these sins they have committed, and they will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.’ "
chapters.nkjv: The priest shall make atonement for him, for his sin that he has committed in any of these matters; and it shall be forgiven him. The rest shall be the priest’s as a grain offering.’ "
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as a meat offering.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses:
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും യഹോവയുടെ വിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളെ സംബന്ധിച്ചു അബദ്ധവശാൽ അതിക്രമം ചെയ്തു പിഴെച്ചു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ തന്റെ അകൃത്യത്തിന്നു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം നീ മതിക്കുന്ന വിലെക്കുള്ളതായി ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ അകൃത്യയാഗമായി യഹോവെക്കു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: "When anyone is unfaithful to the Lord by sinning unintentionally in regard to any of the Lord ’s holy things, they are to bring to the Lord as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.
chapters.nkjv: "If a person commits a trespass, and sins unintentionally in regard to the holy things of the Lord, then he shall bring to the Lord as his trespass offering a ram without blemish from the flocks, with your valuation in shekels of silver according to the shekel of the sanctuary, as a trespass offering.
chapters.kjv: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളെ സംബന്ധിച്ചു താൻ പിഴെച്ചതിന്നു പകരം മുതലും അതിനോടു അഞ്ചിലൊന്നു കൂട്ടിയും അവൻ പുരോഹിതന്നു കൊടുക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ അകൃത്യയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെക്കൊണ്ടു അവന്നു വേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: They must make restitution for what they have failed to do in regard to the holy things, pay an additional penalty of a fifth of its value and give it all to the priest. The priest will make atonement for them with the ram as a guilt offering, and they will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall make restitution for the harm that he has done in regard to the holy thing, and shall add one-fifth to it and give it to the priest. So the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
chapters.kjv: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

chapters.ml: ചെയ്യരുതെന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള വല്ലകാര്യത്തിലും ആരെങ്കിലും പിഴെച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ അറിയാതിരുന്നാലും കുറ്റക്കാരനാകുന്നു; അവൻ തന്റെ കുറ്റം വഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "If anyone sins and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though they do not know it, they are guilty and will be held responsible.
chapters.nkjv: "If a person sins, and commits any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the Lord, though he does not know it, yet he is guilty and shall bear his iniquity.
chapters.kjv: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD ; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അകൃത്യയാഗത്തിന്നായി നിന്റെ മതിപ്പുപോലെ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു വരേണം; അവൻ അബദ്ധവശാൽ പിഴെച്ചതും അറിയാതിരുന്നതുമായ പിഴെക്കായി പുരോഹിതൻ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: They are to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the wrong they have committed unintentionally, and they will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall bring to the priest a ram without blemish from the flock, with your valuation, as a trespass offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him regarding his ignorance in which he erred and did not know it, and it shall be forgiven him.
chapters.kjv: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

chapters.ml: ഇതു അകൃത്യയാഗം; അവൻ യഹോവയോടു അകൃത്യം ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: It is a guilt offering; they have been guilty of wrongdoing against the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: It is a trespass offering; he has certainly trespassed against the Lord."
chapters.kjv: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses:
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും പിഴെച്ചു യഹോവയോടു അതിക്രമം ചെയ്തു തന്റെ പക്കൽ ഏല്പിച്ച വസ്തുവിനെയോ പണയം വെച്ചതിനെയോ മോഷണകാര്യത്തെയോ സംബന്ധിച്ചു കൂട്ടുകാരനോടു ഭോഷ്കു പറക എങ്കിലും കൂട്ടുകാരനോടു വഞ്ചന ചെയ്ക എങ്കിലും
chapters.niv: "If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the Lord by deceiving a neighbor about something entrusted to them or left in their care or about something stolen, or if they cheat their neighbor,
chapters.nkjv: "If a person sins and commits a trespass against the Lord by lying to his neighbor about what was delivered to him for safekeeping, or about a pledge, or about a robbery, or if he has extorted from his neighbor,
chapters.kjv: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD , and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

chapters.ml: കണാതെപോയ വസ്തു കണ്ടിട്ടു അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഭോഷ്കുപറഞ്ഞു മനുഷ്യൻ പിഴെക്കുന്ന ഈ വക വല്ല കാര്യത്തിലും കള്ളസ്സത്യം ചെയ്കയെങ്കിലും ചെയ്തിട്ടു
chapters.niv: or if they find lost property and lie about it, or if they swear falsely about any such sin that people may commit—
chapters.nkjv: or if he has found what was lost and lies concerning it, and swears falsely—in any one of these things that a man may do in which he sins:
chapters.kjv: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിഴെച്ചു കുറ്റക്കാരനായാൽ താൻ മോഷ്ടിച്ചതോ വഞ്ചിച്ചെടുത്തതോ തന്റെ പക്കൽ ഏല്പിച്ചതോ കാണാതെ പോയിട്ടു താൻ കണ്ടാതോ
chapters.niv: when they sin in any of these ways and realize their guilt, they must return what they have stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to them, or the lost property they found,
chapters.nkjv: then it shall be, because he has sinned and is guilty, that he shall restore what he has stolen, or the thing which he has extorted, or what was delivered to him for safekeeping, or the lost thing which he found,
chapters.kjv: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

chapters.ml: താൻ കള്ളസ്സത്യം ചെയ്തു എടുത്തതോ ആയതൊക്കെയും മുതലോടു അഞ്ചിലൊന്നു കൂട്ടി പകരം കൊടുക്കേണം; അകൃത്യയാഗം കഴിക്കുന്ന നാളിൽ അവൻ അതു ഉടമസ്ഥന്നു കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: or whatever it was they swore falsely about. They must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day they present their guilt offering.
chapters.nkjv: or all that about which he has sworn falsely. He shall restore its full value, add one-fifth more to it, and give it to whomever it belongs, on the day of his trespass offering.
chapters.kjv: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

chapters.ml: അകൃത്യയാഗത്തിന്നായിട്ടു അവൻ നിന്റെ മതിപ്പുപോലെ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ യഹോവെക്കു അകൃത്യയാഗമായി പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: And as a penalty they must bring to the priest, that is, to the Lord , their guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the Lord, a ram without blemish from the flock, with your valuation, as a trespass offering, to the priest.
chapters.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD , a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അവൻ അകൃത്യമായി ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: In this way the priest will make atonement for them before the Lord , and they will be forgiven for any of the things they did that made them guilty."
chapters.nkjv: So the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and he shall be forgiven for any one of these things that he may have done in which he trespasses."
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD : and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses:
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ അഹരോനോടും പുത്രന്മാരോടും കല്പിക്കേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: ഹോമ യാഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണമാവിതു: ഹോമയാഗം രാത്രി മുഴുവനും ഉഷസ്സുവരെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേലുള്ള വിറകിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കയും യാഗപീഠത്തിലെ തീ അതിനാൽ കത്തിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: "Give Aaron and his sons this command: ‘These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.
chapters.nkjv: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering shall be on the hearth upon the altar all night until morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
chapters.kjv: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള അങ്കി ധരിച്ചു പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള കാൽ ചട്ടയാൽ തന്റെ നഗ്നത മറെച്ചുകൊണ്ടു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ഹോമയാഗം ദഹിച്ചുണ്ടായ വെണ്ണീർ എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ഒരു വശത്തു ഇടേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.
chapters.nkjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen trousers he shall put on his body, and take up the ashes of the burnt offering which the fire has consumed on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വസ്ത്രം മാറി വേറെ വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു വെടിപ്പുള്ള ഒരു സ്ഥലത്തു വെണ്ണീർ കൊണ്ടുപോകേണം.
chapters.niv: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.
chapters.nkjv: Then he shall take off his garments, put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
chapters.kjv: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠത്തിൽ തീ കെട്ടുപോകാതെ കത്തിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ ഉഷസ്സുതോറും അതിന്മേൽ വിറകു കത്തിച്ചു ഹോമയാഗം അടുക്കി വെച്ചു അതിൻ മീതെ സാമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളുടെ മേദസ്സു ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.
chapters.nkjv: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not be put out. And the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order on it; and he shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
chapters.kjv: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ തീ കെട്ടുപോകാതെ എപ്പോഴും കത്തിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.
chapters.nkjv: A fire shall always be burning on the altar; it shall never go out.
chapters.kjv: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

chapters.ml: ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണമാവിതു: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ അതു അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron’s sons are to bring it before the Lord , in front of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: ‘This is the law of the grain offering: The sons of Aaron shall offer it on the altar before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD , before the altar.

chapters.ml: ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്റെ നേരിയ മാവിൽനിന്നും എണ്ണയിൽനിന്നും കൈനിറച്ചും ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്മേലുള്ള കുന്തുരുക്കം മുഴുവനും എടുത്തു നിവേദ്യമായി യാഗ പീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest is to take a handful of the finest flour and some olive oil, together with all the incense on the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: He shall take from it his handful of the fine flour of the grain offering, with its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the grain offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a sweet aroma, as a memorial to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷിപ്പു അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മാരും തിന്നേണം; ഒരു വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തു വെച്ചു അതു പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്തതായി തിന്നേണം; സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ പ്രാകാരത്തിൽവെച്ചു അതു തിന്നേണം.
chapters.niv: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in the sanctuary area; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: And the remainder of it Aaron and his sons shall eat; with unleavened bread it shall be eaten in a holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of meeting they shall eat it.
chapters.kjv: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

chapters.ml: അതു പുളിച്ച മാവു കൂട്ടി ചുടരുതു; എന്റെ ദഹനയാഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു അതു ഞാൻ അവരുടെ ഓഹരിയായി കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു പാപയാഗംപോലെയും അകൃത്യ യാഗംപോലെയും അതിവിശുദ്ധം.
chapters.niv: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the food offerings presented to me. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.
chapters.nkjv: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion of My offerings made by fire; it is most holy, like the sin offering and the trespass offering.
chapters.kjv: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ മക്കളിൽ ആണുങ്ങൾക്കു ഒക്കെയും അതു തിന്നാം; യഹോവയുടെ ദഹനയാഗങ്ങളിൽ അതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു തലമുറതലമുറയായി ശാശ്വതാവകാശം ആകുന്നു; അതിനെ തൊടുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം വിശുദ്ധനായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. For all generations to come it is his perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord . Whatever touches them will become holy. ’ "
chapters.nkjv: All the males among the children of Aaron may eat it. It shall be a statute forever in your generations concerning the offerings made by fire to the Lord. Everyone who touches them must be holy.’ "
chapters.kjv: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord also said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്നു അഭിഷേകം കഴിയുന്ന ദിവസം അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും യഹോവെക്കു കഴിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന വഴിപാടാവിതു: ഒരു ഇടങ്ങഴി നേരിയ മാവിൽ പാതി രാവിലേയും പാതി വൈകുന്നേരവും നിരന്തരഭോജനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the Lord on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.
chapters.nkjv: "This is the offering of Aaron and his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord, beginning on the day when he is anointed: one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a daily grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it at night.
chapters.kjv: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

chapters.ml: അതു എണ്ണ ചേർത്തു ചട്ടിയിൽ ചുടേണം; അതു കുതിർത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം; ചുട്ട കഷണങ്ങൾ ഭോജനയാഗമായി യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: It must be prepared with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: It shall be made in a pan with oil. When it is mixed, you shall bring it in. The baked pieces of the grain offering you shall offer for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ അവന്നു പകരം അഭിഷേകം പ്രാപിക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതനും അതു അർപ്പിക്കേണം; എന്നേക്കുമുള്ള ചട്ടമായി അതു മുഴുവനും യഹോവെക്കു ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം;
chapters.niv: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the Lord ’s perpetual share and is to be burned completely.
chapters.nkjv: The priest from among his sons, who is anointed in his place, shall offer it. It is a statute forever to the Lord. It shall be wholly burned.
chapters.kjv: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD ; it shall be wholly burnt.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗം മുഴുവനും ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം അതു തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: Every grain offering of a priest shall be burned completely; it must not be eaten."
chapters.nkjv: For every grain offering for the priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten."
chapters.kjv: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Also the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ അഹരോനോടും പുത്രന്മാരോടും പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: പാപയാഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണമാവിതു: ഹോമയാഗമൃഗത്തെ അറുക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു പാപയാഗമൃഗത്തെയും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അറുക്കേണം; അതു അതിവിശുദ്ധം.
chapters.niv: "Say to Aaron and his sons: ‘These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the Lord in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before the Lord. It is most holy.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD : it is most holy.

chapters.ml: പാപത്തിന്നുവേണ്ടി അതു അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതൻ അതു തിന്നേണം; സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ പ്രാകാരത്തിൽ ഒരു വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു അതു തിന്നേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in the sanctuary area, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. In a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മാംസം തൊടുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം വിശുദ്ധനായിരിക്കേണം; അതിന്റെ രക്തം ഒരു വസ്ത്രത്തിൽ തെറിച്ചാൽ അതു വീണതു ഒരു വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു കഴുകേണം.
chapters.niv: Whatever touches any of the flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in the sanctuary area.
chapters.nkjv: Everyone who touches its flesh must be holy. And when its blood is sprinkled on any garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled, in a holy place.
chapters.kjv: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

chapters.ml: അതു വേവിച്ച മൺപാത്രം ഉടെച്ചുകളയേണം; ചെമ്പുകലത്തിൽ വേവിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ അതു തേച്ചു മഴക്കി വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടു കഴുകേണം.
chapters.niv: The clay pot the meat is cooked in must be broken; but if it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot is to be scoured and rinsed with water.
chapters.nkjv: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken. And if it is boiled in a bronze pot, it shall be both scoured and rinsed in water.
chapters.kjv: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതകുലത്തിലെ ആണുങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അതു തിന്നേണം; അതു അതിവിശുദ്ധം.
chapters.niv: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it; it is most holy.
chapters.nkjv: All the males among the priests may eat it. It is most holy.
chapters.kjv: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിപ്പാൻ സാമഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്നകത്തു രക്തം കൊണ്ടുവരുന്ന പാപയാഗത്തെ തിന്നരുതു; അതു തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned up.
chapters.nkjv: But no sin offering from which any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of meeting, to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned in the fire.
chapters.kjv: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place , shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

chapters.ml: അകൃത്യയാഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണമാവിതു: അതു അതിവിശുദ്ധം
chapters.niv: " ‘These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:
chapters.nkjv: ‘Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering (it is most holy):
chapters.kjv: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗമൃഗത്തെ അറുക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു അകൃത്യയാഗമൃഗത്തെയും അറുക്കേണം; അതിന്റെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ചുറ്റും തളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be splashed against the sides of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering they shall kill the trespass offering. And its blood he shall sprinkle all around on the altar.
chapters.kjv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ സകലമേദസ്സും തടിച്ചവാലും കുടൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന മേദസ്സും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡം രണ്ടും
chapters.niv: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the internal organs,
chapters.nkjv: And he shall offer from it all its fat. The fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails,
chapters.kjv: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ മേൽ കടിപ്രദേശത്തുള്ള മേദസ്സും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ കരളിന്മേലുള്ള വപയും എടുത്തു
chapters.niv: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.
chapters.nkjv: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
chapters.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗമായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു അകൃത്യയാഗം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord . It is a guilt offering.
chapters.nkjv: and the priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made by fire to the Lord. It is a trespass offering.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD : it is a trespass offering.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതകുലത്തിലെ ആണുങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അതു തിന്നേണം; ഒരു വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു അതു തിന്നേണം; അതു അതിവിശുദ്ധം.
chapters.niv: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it, but it must be eaten in the sanctuary area; it is most holy.
chapters.nkjv: Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
chapters.kjv: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

chapters.ml: പാപയാഗം പോലെ തന്നേ അകൃത്യയാഗവും ആകുന്നു; അവെക്കു പ്രമാണവും ഒന്നു തന്നേ; പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്നു അതു ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.
chapters.nkjv: The trespass offering is like the sin offering; there is one law for them both: the priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.
chapters.kjv: As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ ഒരുത്തന്റെ ഹോമയാഗം അർപ്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ അർപ്പിച്ച പുരോഹിതന്നു ഹോമയാഗമൃഗത്തിന്റെ തോൽ ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.
chapters.nkjv: And the priest who offers anyone’s burnt offering, that priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
chapters.kjv: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

chapters.ml: അടുപ്പത്തുവെച്ചു ചുടുന്ന ഭോജനയാഗം ഒക്കെയും ഉരുളിയിലും ചട്ടിയിലും ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്നു ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Every grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who offers it,
chapters.nkjv: Also every grain offering that is baked in the oven and all that is prepared in the covered pan, or in a pan, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
chapters.kjv: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.

chapters.ml: എണ്ണ ചേർത്തതോ ചേർക്കാത്തതോ ആയ സകല ഭോജനയാഗവും അഹരോന്റെ സകലപുത്രന്മാർക്കും ഒരുപോലെ ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and every grain offering, whether mixed with olive oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.
chapters.nkjv: Every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, to one as much as the other.
chapters.kjv: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന സമാധാനയാഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണം ആവിതു:
chapters.niv: " ‘These are the regulations for the fellowship offering anyone may present to the Lord :
chapters.nkjv: ‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which he shall offer to the Lord:
chapters.kjv: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതിനെ സ്തോത്രമായി അർപ്പിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ സ്തോത്രയാഗത്തോടുകൂടെ എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത ദോശകളും എണ്ണ പുരട്ടിയ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത വടകളും എണ്ണ ചേർത്തു കുതിർത്ത നേരിയ മാവുകൊണ്ടുണ്ടാക്കിയ ദോശകളും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If they offer it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering they are to offer thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with oil, and thick loaves of the finest flour well-kneaded and with oil mixed in.
chapters.nkjv: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer, with the sacrifice of thanksgiving, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, or cakes of blended flour mixed with oil.
chapters.kjv: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

chapters.ml: സ്തോത്രമായുള്ള സമാധാനയാഗത്തോടുകൂടെ പുളിച്ച മാവുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ദോശകളും ഭോജനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Along with their fellowship offering of thanksgiving they are to present an offering with thick loaves of bread made with yeast.
chapters.nkjv: Besides the cakes, as his offering he shall offer leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offering.
chapters.kjv: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

chapters.ml: ആ എല്ലാവഴിപാടിലും അതതു വകയിൽ നിന്നു ഒരോന്നു യഹോവെക്കു നീരാജനാർപ്പണമായിട്ടു അർപ്പിക്കേണം; അതു സമാധാന യാഗത്തിന്റെ രക്തം തളിക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്നു ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: They are to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the Lord ; it belongs to the priest who splashes the blood of the fellowship offering against the altar.
chapters.nkjv: And from it he shall offer one cake from each offering as a heave offering to the Lord. It shall belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offering.
chapters.kjv: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD , and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സ്തോത്രമായുള്ള സമാധാനയാഗത്തിന്റെ മാംസം, അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന ദിവസത്തിൽ തന്നേ തിന്നേണം; അതിൽ ഒട്ടും പ്രഭാതംവരെ ശേഷിപ്പിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: The meat of their fellowship offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered; they must leave none of it till morning.
chapters.nkjv: ‘The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offering for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day it is offered. He shall not leave any of it until morning.
chapters.kjv: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

chapters.ml: അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന യാഗം ഒരു നേർച്ചയോ സ്വമേധാദാനമോ ആകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ യാഗം അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന ദിവസത്തിൽ തന്നേ അതു തിന്നേണം; അതിൽ ശേഷിപ്പുള്ളതു പിറ്റെന്നാളും തിന്നാം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If, however, their offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day they offer it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.
chapters.nkjv: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offers his sacrifice; but on the next day the remainder of it also may be eaten;
chapters.kjv: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

chapters.ml: യാഗമാംസത്തിൽ മൂന്നാം ദിവസംവരെ ശേഷിക്കുന്നതു തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.
chapters.nkjv: the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day must be burned with fire.
chapters.kjv: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

chapters.ml: സമാധാനയാഗത്തിന്റെ മാംസത്തിൽ ഏതാനും മൂന്നാം ദിവസം തിന്നാൽ അതു പ്രസാദമായിരിക്കയില്ല; അർപ്പിക്കുന്നവന്നു കണക്കിടുകയുമില്ല; അതു അറെപ്പായിരിക്കും; അതു തിന്നുന്നവൻ കുറ്റം വഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, the one who offered it will not be accepted. It will not be reckoned to their credit, for it has become impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.
chapters.nkjv: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offering is eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, nor shall it be imputed to him; it shall be an abomination to him who offers it, and the person who eats of it shall bear guilt.
chapters.kjv: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

chapters.ml: ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത വല്ലതിനെയും തൊട്ടുപോയ മാംസം തിന്നരുതു; അതു തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം; ശേഷം മാംസമോ ശുദ്ധിയുള്ളവന്നെല്ലാം തിന്നാം.
chapters.niv: " ‘Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.
chapters.nkjv: ‘The flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. And as for the clean flesh, all who are clean may eat of it.
chapters.kjv: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അശുദ്ധി തന്റെ മേൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ആരെങ്കിലും യഹോവെക്കുള്ള സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളുടെ മാംസം തിന്നാൽ അവനെ അവന്റെ ജനത്തിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord , they must be cut off from their people.
chapters.nkjv: But the person who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offering that belongs to the Lord, while he is unclean, that person shall be cut off from his people.
chapters.kjv: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD , having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യന്റെ അശുദ്ധിയെയോ അശുദ്ധമൃഗത്തെയോ ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത വല്ല അറെപ്പിനെയോ ഇങ്ങനെ ശുദ്ധിയില്ലാത്ത യാതൊന്നിനെയും ആരെങ്കിലും തൊട്ടിട്ടു യഹോവെക്കുള്ള സാമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളുടെ മാംസം തിന്നാൽ അവനെ അവന്റെ ജനത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Anyone who touches something unclean—whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean creature that moves along the ground —and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord must be cut off from their people.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the person who touches any unclean thing, such as human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any abominable unclean thing, and who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offering that belongs to the Lord, that person shall be cut off from his people.’ "
chapters.kjv: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD , even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: ചെമ്മരിയാട്ടിന്റെയോ കോലാട്ടിന്റെയോ കാളയുടെയോ മേദസ്സും നിങ്ങൾ അശേഷം തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘You shall not eat any fat, of ox or sheep or goat.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

chapters.ml: താനേ ചത്തതിന്റെ മേദസ്സും പറിച്ചുകീറിപ്പോയതിന്റെ മേദസ്സും മറ്റു എന്തിന്നെങ്കിലും കൊള്ളിക്കാം; തിന്നുക മാത്രം അരുതു.
chapters.niv: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.
chapters.nkjv: And the fat of an animal that dies naturally, and the fat of what is torn by wild beasts, may be used in any other way; but you shall by no means eat it.
chapters.kjv: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിച്ച മൃഗത്തിന്റെ മേദസ്സു ആരെങ്കിലും തിന്നാൽ അവനെ അവന്റെ ജനത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which a food offering may be presented to the Lord must be cut off from their people.
chapters.nkjv: For whoever eats the fat of the animal of which men offer an offering made by fire to the Lord, the person who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
chapters.kjv: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD , even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ വാസസ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ എങ്ങും യാതൊരു പക്ഷിയുടെയും മൃഗത്തിന്റെയും രക്തം നിങ്ങൾ ഭക്ഷിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover you shall not eat any blood in any of your dwellings, whether of bird or beast.
chapters.kjv: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

chapters.ml: വല്ല രക്തവും ഭക്ഷിക്കുന്നവനെ എല്ലാം അവന്റെ ജനത്തിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Anyone who eats blood must be cut off from their people.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Whoever eats any blood, that person shall be cut off from his people.’ "
chapters.kjv: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: യഹോവെക്കു സമാധാനയാഗം അർപ്പിക്കുന്നവൻ തന്റെ സമാധാനയാഗത്തിൽനിന്നു യഹോവെക്കു വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the Lord is to bring part of it as their sacrifice to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offering to the Lord shall bring his offering to the Lord from the sacrifice of his peace offering.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

chapters.ml: സ്വന്തകയ്യാൽ അവൻ അതു യഹോവയുടെ ദഹനയാഗമായി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം; യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നീരാജനാർപ്പണമായി നീരാജനം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു നെഞ്ചോടുകൂടെ മേദസ്സും കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: With their own hands they are to present the food offering to the Lord ; they are to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the Lord as a wave offering.
chapters.nkjv: His own hands shall bring the offerings made by fire to the Lord. The fat with the breast he shall bring, that the breast may be waved as a wave offering before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD .

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ മേദസ്സു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ നെഞ്ചു അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മർക്കും ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.
chapters.nkjv: And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളിൽ വലത്തെ കൈക്കുറകു ഉദർച്ചാർപ്പണത്തിന്നായി നിങ്ങൾ പുരോഹിതന്റെ പക്കൽ കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.
chapters.nkjv: Also the right thigh you shall give to the priest as a heave offering from the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
chapters.kjv: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളുടെ രക്തവും മേദസ്സും അർപ്പിക്കുന്നവന്നു തന്നേ വലത്തെ കൈക്കുറകു ഓഹരിയായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.
chapters.nkjv: He among the sons of Aaron, who offers the blood of the peace offering and the fat, shall have the right thigh for his part.
chapters.kjv: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു നീരാജനത്തിന്റെ നെഞ്ചും ഉദർച്ചയുടെ കൈക്കുറകും ഞാൻ എടുത്തു പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്നും പുത്രന്മാർക്കും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽനിന്നുള്ള ശാശ്വതാവകാശമായി കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their perpetual share from the Israelites.’ "
chapters.nkjv: For the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering I have taken from the children of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons from the children of Israel by a statute forever.’ "
chapters.kjv: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ഇതു അഹരോനെയും പുത്രന്മാരെയും യഹോവെക്കു പുരോഹിതശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്‍വാൻ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ച നാൾമുതൽ യഹോവയുടെ ദഹനയാഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു അഹരോന്നുള്ള ഓഹരിയും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കുള്ള ഓഹരിയും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is the portion of the food offerings presented to the Lord that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the Lord as priests.
chapters.nkjv: This is the consecrated portion for Aaron and his sons, from the offerings made by fire to the Lord, on the day when Moses presented them to minister to the Lord as priests.
chapters.kjv: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest’s office;

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അതു അവർക്കു കൊടുക്കേണമെന്നു താൻ അവരെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തനാളിൽ യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചു; അതു അവർക്കു തലമുറതലമുറയായി ശാശ്വതാവകാശം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On the day they were anointed, the Lord commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their perpetual share for the generations to come.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord commanded this to be given to them by the children of Israel, on the day that He anointed them, by a statute forever throughout their generations.
chapters.kjv: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

chapters.ml: ദഹനയാഗം, ഭോജനയാഗം, പാപയാഗം, അകൃത്യയാഗം, കരപൂരണയാഗം, സമാധാനയാഗം എന്നിവയെ സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള പ്രമാണം ഇതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,
chapters.nkjv: This is the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecrations, and the sacrifice of the peace offering,
chapters.kjv: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു തങ്ങളുടെ വഴിപാടുകൾ കഴിപ്പാൻ അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത നാളിൽ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു സീനായിപർവ്വതത്തിൽ വെച്ചു ഇവ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: which the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai in the Desert of Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: which the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when He commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the Lord in the Wilderness of Sinai.
chapters.kjv: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD , in the wilderness of Sinai.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു: നീ അഹരോനെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും വസ്ത്രം, അഭിഷേകതൈലം, പാപയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള കാള, രണ്ടു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാർ, കൊട്ടയിൽ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പം എന്നിവയുമായി കൊണ്ടുവരികയും
chapters.niv: "Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,
chapters.nkjv: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, the anointing oil, a bull as the sin offering, two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
chapters.kjv: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

chapters.ml: സഭയെ മുഴുവനും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ കൂട്ടുകയും ചെയ്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting."
chapters.nkjv: and gather all the congregation together at the door of the tabernacle of meeting."
chapters.kjv: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെ ചെയ്തു; സഭ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ വന്നുകൂടി.
chapters.niv: Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses did as the Lord commanded him. And the congregation was gathered together at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: മോശെ സഭയോടു: യഹോവ കല്പിച്ച കാര്യം ഇതാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Moses said to the assembly, "This is what the Lord has commanded to be done."
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said to the congregation, "This is what the Lord commanded to be done."
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അഹരോനെയും പുത്രന്മാരെയും അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തി അവരെ വെള്ളം കൊണ്ടു കഴുകി.
chapters.niv: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.
chapters.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ഉള്ളങ്കി ഇടുവിച്ചു നടക്കെട്ടു കെട്ടിച്ചു അങ്കി ധരിപ്പിച്ചു ഏഫോദ് ഇടുവിച്ചു ഏഫോദിന്റെ ചിത്രപ്പണിയായ നടക്കെട്ടു കെട്ടിച്ചു അതിനാൽ അതു മുറുക്കി.
chapters.niv: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also fastened the ephod with a decorative waistband, which he tied around him.
chapters.nkjv: And he put the tunic on him, girded him with the sash, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him; and he girded him with the intricately woven band of the ephod, and with it tied the ephod on him.
chapters.kjv: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

chapters.ml: അവനെ പതക്കം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു; പതക്കത്തിൽ ഊറീമും തുമ്മീമും വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He placed the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.
chapters.nkjv: Then he put the breastplate on him, and he put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastplate.
chapters.kjv: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ തലയിൽ മുടി വെച്ചു; മുടിയുടെ മേൽ മുൻ വശത്തു വിശുദ്ധകിരീടമായ പൊൻ പട്ടം വെച്ചു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then he placed the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the sacred emblem, on the front of it, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And he put the turban on his head. Also on the turban, on its front, he put the golden plate, the holy crown, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അഭിഷേകതൈലം എടുത്തു കൂടാരവും അതിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and so consecrated them.
chapters.nkjv: Also Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and consecrated them.
chapters.kjv: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

chapters.ml: അതിൽ കുറെ അവൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ഏഴു പ്രാവശ്യം തളിച്ചു യാഗപീഠവും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും തൊട്ടിയും അതിന്റെ കാലും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.
chapters.nkjv: He sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the laver and its base, to consecrate them.
chapters.kjv: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഹരോന്റെ തലയിൽ അഭിഷേകതൈലം ഒഴിച്ചു അവനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.
chapters.nkjv: And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him, to consecrate him.
chapters.kjv: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ വരുത്തി, അങ്കി ധരിപ്പിച്ചു നടുക്കെട്ടു കെട്ടിച്ചു തലപ്പാവും ഇടുവിച്ചു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then he brought Aaron’s sons forward, put tunics on them, tied sashes around them and fastened caps on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses brought Aaron’s sons and put tunics on them, girded them with sashes, and put hats on them, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള കാളയെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു: പാപയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള കാളയുടെ തലയിൽ അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മാരും കൈ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He then presented the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
chapters.nkjv: And he brought the bull for the sin offering. Then Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull for the sin offering,
chapters.kjv: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിനെ അറുത്തു; മോശെ അതിന്റെ രക്തം എടുത്തു വിരൽകൊണ്ടു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽ ചുറ്റും പുരട്ടി യാഗപീഠം ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു; ശേഷം രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു, അതിന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രാശ്ചിത്തം കഴിച്ചു അതിനെ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Moses slaughtered the bull and took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to purify the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it to make atonement for it.
chapters.nkjv: and Moses killed it. Then he took the blood, and put some on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar. And he poured the blood at the base of the altar, and consecrated it, to make atonement for it.
chapters.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

chapters.ml: കുടലിന്മേലുള്ള സകലമേദസ്സും കരളിന്മേലുള്ള വപയും മൂത്രപിണ്ഡം രണ്ടും അവയുടെ മേദസ്സും മോശെ എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Moses also took all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it on the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took all the fat that was on the entrails, the fatty lobe attached to the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, and Moses burned them on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കാളയെയും അതിന്റെ തോൽ, മാംസം, ചാണകം എന്നിവയെയും അവൻ പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its intestines he burned up outside the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: But the bull, its hide, its flesh, and its offal, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു: അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മാരും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്റെ തലയിൽ കൈ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He then presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought the ram as the burnt offering. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram,
chapters.kjv: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിനെ അറുത്തു; മോശെ അതിന്റെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ചുറ്റും തളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses slaughtered the ram and splashed the blood against the sides of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: and Moses killed it. Then he sprinkled the blood all around on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

chapters.ml: ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ ഖണ്ഡംഖണ്ഡമായി ഖണ്ഡിച്ചു; മോശെ തലയും ഖണ്ഡങ്ങളും മേദസ്സും ദഹിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces and the fat.
chapters.nkjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burned the head, the pieces, and the fat.
chapters.kjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിന്റെ കുടലും കാലും വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടുകഴുകി; മോശെ ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ മുഴുവനും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചു; ഇതു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ഹോമയാഗമായി യഹോവെക്കുള്ള ധഹനയാഗം; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: He washed the internal organs and the legs with water and burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord , as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Then he washed the entrails and the legs in water. And Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
