chapters.kjv: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’s : it is holy unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും തന്റെ ദശാംശത്തിൽ ഏതാനും വീണ്ടെടുക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അതിനോടു അഞ്ചിലൊന്നുകൂടെ ചേർത്തു കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Whoever would redeem any of their tithe must add a fifth of the value to it.
chapters.nkjv: If a man wants at all to redeem any of his tithes, he shall add one-fifth to it.
chapters.kjv: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

chapters.ml: മാടാകട്ടെ ആടാകട്ടെ കോലിൻ കീഴെ കടന്നുപോകുന്ന എല്ലാറ്റിലും പത്തിലൊന്നു യഹോവെക്കു വിശുദ്ധമായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Every tithe of the herd and flock—every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd’s rod—will be holy to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd or the flock, of whatever passes under the rod, the tenth one shall be holy to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതു നല്ലതോ തീയതോ എന്നു ശോധനചെയ്യരുതു; വെച്ചുമാറുകയും അരുതു; വെച്ചുമാറുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അതും വെച്ചുമാറിയതും വിശുദ്ധമായിരിക്കേണം. അവയെ വീണ്ടെടുത്തുകൂടാ.
chapters.niv: No one may pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If anyone does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.’ "
chapters.nkjv: He shall not inquire whether it is good or bad, nor shall he exchange it; and if he exchanges it at all, then both it and the one exchanged for it shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.’ "
chapters.kjv: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കുവേണ്ടി യഹോവ സീനായിപർവ്വതത്തിൽവെച്ചു മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ച കല്പനകൾ ഇവതന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These are the commands the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai for the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: These are the commandments which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
chapters.kjv: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

chapters.ml: അവർ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടതിന്റെ രണ്ടാം സംവത്സരം രണ്ടാം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി യഹോവ സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽവെച്ചു മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord spoke to Moses in the tent of meeting in the Desert of Sinai on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. He said:
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ഗോത്രംഗോത്രമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും സകലപുരുഷന്മാരെയും ആളാംപ്രതി പേർവഴി ചാർത്തി സംഘത്തിന്റെ ആകത്തുക എടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.
chapters.nkjv: "Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of names, every male individually,
chapters.kjv: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

chapters.ml: നീയും അഹരോനും യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു, യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവാൻ പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും ഗണംഗണമായി എണ്ണേണം.
chapters.niv: You and Aaron are to count according to their divisions all the men in Israel who are twenty years old or more and able to serve in the army.
chapters.nkjv: from twenty years old and above—all who areableto go to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
chapters.kjv: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

chapters.ml: ഓരോ ഗോത്രത്തിൽനിന്നു തന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിൽ തലവനായ ഒരുത്തൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: One man from each tribe, each of them the head of his family, is to help you.
chapters.nkjv: And with you there shall be a man from every tribe, each one the head of his father’s house.
chapters.kjv: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ നിൽക്കേണ്ടുന്ന പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ പേരാവിതു: രൂബേൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ശെദേയൂരിന്റെ മകൻ എലീസൂർ;
chapters.niv: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
chapters.nkjv: "These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: from Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur;
chapters.kjv: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ സൂരീശദ്ദായിയുടെ മകൻ ശെലൂമീയേൽ;
chapters.niv: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
chapters.nkjv: from Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;
chapters.kjv: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ അമ്മീനാദാബിന്റെ മകൻ നഹശോൻ;
chapters.niv: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
chapters.nkjv: from Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab;
chapters.kjv: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാർ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ സൂവാരിന്റെ മകൻ നെഥനയേൽ;
chapters.niv: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
chapters.nkjv: from Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar;
chapters.kjv: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഹോലോന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാബ്;
chapters.niv: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
chapters.nkjv: from Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon;
chapters.kjv: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കളിൽ എഫ്രയീംഗോത്രത്തിൽ അമ്മീഹൂദിന്റെ മകൻ എലീശാമാ; മനശ്ശെഗോത്രത്തിൽ പെദാസൂരിന്റെ മകൻ ഗമലീയേൽ;
chapters.niv: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
chapters.nkjv: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഗിദെയോനിയുടെ മകൻ അബീദാൻ;
chapters.niv: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
chapters.nkjv: from Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni;
chapters.kjv: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

chapters.ml: ദാൻഗോത്രത്തിൽ അമ്മീശദ്ദായിയുടെ മകൻ അഹീയേസെർ;
chapters.niv: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
chapters.nkjv: from Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;
chapters.kjv: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

chapters.ml: ആശേർഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഒക്രാന്റെ മകൻ പഗീയേൽ;
chapters.niv: from Asher, Pagiel son of Okran;
chapters.nkjv: from Asher, Pagiel the son of Ocran;
chapters.kjv: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

chapters.ml: ഗാദ്ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ദെയൂവേലിന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാസാഫ്;
chapters.niv: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;
chapters.nkjv: from Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel;
chapters.kjv: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഏനാന്റെ മകൻ അഹീര.
chapters.niv: from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan."
chapters.nkjv: from Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan."
chapters.kjv: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ സംഘത്തിൽനിന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരും തങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും യിസ്രായേലിൽ സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These were the men appointed from the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes. They were the heads of the clans of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: These were chosen from the congregation, leaders of their fathers’ tribes, heads of the divisions in Israel.
chapters.kjv: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

chapters.ml: കുറിക്കപ്പെട്ട ഈ പുരുഷന്മാരെ മോശെയും അഹരോനും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Moses and Aaron took these men whose names had been specified,
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses and Aaron took these men who had been mentioned by name,
chapters.kjv: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി അവർ സർവ്വസഭയെയും വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി; അവർ ഗോത്രം ഗോത്രമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ആളാംപ്രതി ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മോലോട്ടു പേരു പേരായി താന്താങ്ങളുടെ വംശവിവരം അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and they called the whole community together on the first day of the second month. The people registered their ancestry by their clans and families, and the men twenty years old or more were listed by name, one by one,
chapters.nkjv: and they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they recited their ancestry by families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, each one individually.
chapters.kjv: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ അവൻ സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു അവരുടെ എണ്ണമെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: as the Lord commanded Moses. And so he counted them in the Desert of Sinai:
chapters.nkjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai.
chapters.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മൂത്തമകനായ രൂബേന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികൾ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ആളാംപ്രതി ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു, യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: Now the children of Reuben, Israel’s oldest son, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, every male individually, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: പേരുപേരായി രൂബേൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പത്താറായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Reuben was 46,500.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Reuben were forty-six thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ആളാംപ്രതി ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Simeon: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were counted and listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the children of Simeon, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, of those who were numbered, according to the number of names, every male individually, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: പേരുപേരായി ശിമെയോൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ അമ്പത്തൊമ്പതിനായിരത്തി മുന്നൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Simeon was 59,300.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Simeon were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

chapters.ml: ഗാദിന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Gad: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the children of Gad, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: ഗാദ്ഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പത്തയ്യായിരത്തറുനൂറ്റമ്പതു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Gad was 45,650.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Judah: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the children of Judah, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ എഴുപത്തുനാലായിരത്തറുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Judah was 74,600.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Judah were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാരിന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Issachar: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the children of Issachar, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാർഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ അമ്പത്തുനാലായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.

chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Issachar were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Zebulun was 57,400.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Zebulun were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കളിൽ എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും
chapters.niv: From the sons of Joseph: From the descendants of Ephraim: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the sons of Joseph, the children of Ephraim, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Joseph, namely , of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: പേരുപേരായി എഫ്രയീംഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പതിനായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Ephraim was 40,500.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Ephraim were forty thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി

chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Manasseh was 32,200.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Manasseh were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി

chapters.nkjv: From the children of Benjamin, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ മുപ്പത്തയ്യായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Benjamin was 35,400.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Benjamin were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: ദാന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Dan: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the children of Dan, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: ദാൻഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ അറുപത്തീരായിരത്തെഴുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Dan was 62,700.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Dan were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

chapters.ml: ആശേരിന്റെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Asher: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the children of Asher, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: ആശേർഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പത്തോരായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Asher was 41,500.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Asher were forty-one thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിയുടെ മക്കളുടെ സന്തതികളിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും പേരുപേരായി
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Naphtali: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: From the children of Naphtali, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war:
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ അമ്പത്തുമൂവായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number from the tribe of Naphtali was 53,400.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered of the tribe of Naphtali were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: മോശെയും അഹരോനും ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു ഒരുവൻ വീതം യിസ്രായേൽപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരായ പന്ത്രണ്ടു പുരുഷന്മാരും കൂടി എണ്ണമെടുത്തവർ ഇവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
chapters.nkjv: These are the ones who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, with the leaders of Israel, twelve men, each one representing his father’s house.
chapters.kjv: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ഗോത്രംഗോത്രമായി ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള സകലപുരുഷന്മാരുമായി
chapters.niv: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
chapters.nkjv: So all who were numbered of the children of Israel, by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war in Israel—
chapters.kjv: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

chapters.ml: എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകെ ആറു ലക്ഷത്തി മൂവായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറ്റമ്പതു പേർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The total number was 603,550.
chapters.nkjv: all who were numbered were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
chapters.kjv: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

chapters.ml: ഇവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ലേവ്യരെ പിതൃഗോത്രമായി എണ്ണിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The ancestral tribe of the Levites, however, was not counted along with the others.
chapters.nkjv: But the Levites were not numbered among them by their fathers’ tribe;
chapters.kjv: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

chapters.ml: ലേവിഗോത്രത്തെ മാത്രം എണ്ണരുതു;
chapters.niv: The Lord had said to Moses:
chapters.nkjv: for the Lord had spoken to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അവരുടെ സംഖ്യ എടുക്കയും അരുതു എന്നു യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: "Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, nor take a census of them among the children of Israel;
chapters.kjv: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരെ സാക്ഷ്യനിവാസത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾക്കും വസ്തുക്കൾക്കും ഒക്കെ വിചാരകന്മാരായി നിയമിക്കേണം; അവർ തിരുനിവാസവും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും വഹിക്കേണം; അവർ അതിന്നു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്കയും തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റും പാളയമടിച്ചു പാർക്കയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the covenant law—over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.
chapters.nkjv: but you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, over all its furnishings, and over all things that belong to it; they shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they shall attend to it and camp around the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസം പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ ലേവ്യർ അതു അഴിച്ചെടുക്കേണം; തിരുനിവാസം അടിക്കുമ്പോൾ ലേവ്യർ അതു നിവിർത്തേണം; ഒരന്യൻ അടുത്തുവന്നാൽ മരണ ശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who approaches it is to be put to death.
chapters.nkjv: And when the tabernacle is to go forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
chapters.kjv: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഗണംഗണമായി ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ പാളയത്തിലും ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ കൊടിക്കരികെയും ഇങ്ങനെ കൂടാരം അടിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard.
chapters.nkjv: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, everyone by his own camp, everyone by his own standard, according to their armies;
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സംഘത്തിന്മേൽ ക്രോധം ഉണ്ടാകാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ലേവ്യർ സാക്ഷ്യനിവാസത്തിന്നു ചുറ്റം പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; ലേവ്യർ സാക്ഷ്യ നിവാസത്തിന്റെ കാര്യം നോക്കേണം
chapters.niv: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the covenant law so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the covenant law."
chapters.nkjv: but the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep charge of the tabernacle of the Testimony."
chapters.kjv: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

chapters.ml: എന്നു യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ എല്ലാം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ചെയ്തു; അതു പോലെ തന്നെ അവർ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Thus the children of Israel did; according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so they did.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളിൽ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ അടയാളത്തോടുകൂടിയ കൊടിക്കരികെ പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്നെതിരായി ചുറ്റും അവർ പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം.
chapters.niv: "The Israelites are to camp around the tent of meeting some distance from it, each of them under their standard and holding the banners of their family."
chapters.nkjv: "Everyone of the children of Israel shall camp by his own standard, beside the emblems of his father’s house; they shall camp some distance from the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാപാളയത്തിന്റെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ളവർ ഗണംഗണമായി കിഴക്കു സൂര്യോദയത്തിന്നു നേരെ പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; യെഹൂദയുടെ മക്കൾക്കു അമ്മീനാദാബിന്റെ മകൻ നഹശോൻ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.
chapters.nkjv: On the east side, toward the rising of the sun, those of the standard of the forces with Judah shall camp according to their armies; and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shallbe the leader of the children of Judah."
chapters.kjv: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ എഴുപത്തുനാലായിരത്തറുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 74,600.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at seventy-four thousand six hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അരികെ യിസ്സാഖാർഗോത്രം പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; യിസ്സാഖാരിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു സൂവാരിന്റെ മകൻ നെഥനയേൽ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.
chapters.nkjv: "Those who camp next to him shallbe the tribe of Issachar, and Nethanel the son of Zuar shallbe the leader of the children of Issachar."
chapters.kjv: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ അമ്പത്തുനാലായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 54,400.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at fifty-four thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ സെബൂലൂൻ ഗോത്രം; സെബൂലൂന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു ഹേലോന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാബ് പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Zebulun will be next. The leader of the people of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.
chapters.nkjv: "Then comes the tribe of Zebulun, and Eliab the son of Helon shallbe the leader of the children of Zebulun."
chapters.kjv: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ അമ്പത്തേഴായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 57,400.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാപാളയത്തിലെ ഗണങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകെ ലക്ഷത്തെൺപത്താറായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ. ഇവർ ആദ്യം പുറപ്പെടേണം.
chapters.niv: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.
chapters.nkjv: "All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Judah, one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred— these shall break camp first.
chapters.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

chapters.ml: രൂബേൻ പാളയത്തിന്റെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ളവർ ഗണംഗണമായി തെക്കുഭാഗത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; രൂബേന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു ശെദേയൂരിന്റെ മകൻ എലീസൂർ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.
chapters.nkjv: "On the south side shallbe the standard of the forces with Reuben according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Reuben shallbe Elizur the son of Shedeur."
chapters.kjv: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ നാല്പത്താറായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 46,500.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at forty-six thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അരികെ ശിമെയോൻ ഗോത്രം പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; ശിമെയോന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു സൂരീശദ്ദായിയുടെ മകൻ ശെലൂമീയേൽ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
chapters.nkjv: "Those who camp next to him shallbe the tribe of Simeon, and the leader of the children of Simeon shallbe Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai."
chapters.kjv: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ അമ്പത്തൊമ്പതിനായിരത്തി മുന്നൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 59,300.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഗാദ്ഗോത്രം; ഗാദിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു രെയൂവേലിന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാസാഫ് പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Gad will be next. The leader of the people of Gad is Eliasaph son of Deuel.
chapters.nkjv: "Then comes the tribe of Gad, and the leader of the children of Gad shallbe Eliasaph the son of Reuel."
chapters.kjv: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ നാല്പത്തയ്യായിരത്തറുനൂറ്റമ്പതു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 45,650.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

chapters.ml: രൂബേൻ പാളയത്തിലെ ഗണങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകെ ഒരു ലക്ഷത്തമ്പത്തോരായിരത്തി നാനൂറ്റമ്പതു പേർ. അവർ രണ്ടാമതായി പുറപ്പെടേണം.
chapters.niv: All the men assigned to the camp of Reuben, according to their divisions, number 151,450. They will set out second.
chapters.nkjv: "All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Reuben, one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty— they shall be the second to break camp.
chapters.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരം പാളയത്തിന്റെ നടുവിൽ ലേവ്യരുടെ പാളയവുമായി യാത്രചെയ്യേണം; അവർ പാളയമിറങ്ങുന്നതു പോലെ തന്നേ താന്താങ്ങളുടെ കൊടിക്കരികെ യഥാക്രമം പുറപ്പെടേണം.
chapters.niv: Then the tent of meeting and the camp of the Levites will set out in the middle of the camps. They will set out in the same order as they encamp, each in their own place under their standard.
chapters.nkjv: "And the tabernacle of meeting shall move out with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps; as they camp, so they shall move out, everyone in his place, by their standards.
chapters.kjv: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീംപാളയത്തിന്റെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ളവർ ഗണംഗണമായി പടിഞ്ഞാറെഭാഗത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു അമ്മീഹൂദിന്റെ മകൻ എലീശാമാ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: On the west will be the divisions of the camp of Ephraim under their standard. The leader of the people of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.
chapters.nkjv: "On the west side shallbe the standard of the forces with Ephraim according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Ephraim shallbe Elishama the son of Ammihud."
chapters.kjv: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ നാല്പതിനായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 40,500.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at forty thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അരികെ മനശ്ശെഗോത്രം പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; മനശ്ശെയുടെ മക്കൾക്കു പെദാസൂരിന്റെ മകൻ ഗമലീയേൽ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to them. The leader of the people of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
chapters.nkjv: "Next to him comes the tribe of Manasseh, and the leader of the children of Manasseh shallbe Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur."
chapters.kjv: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ മുപ്പത്തീരായിരത്തിരുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 32,200.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at thirty-two thousand two hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രം പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; ബെന്യാമീന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു ഗിദെയോനിയുടെ മകൻ അബീദാൻപ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Benjamin will be next. The leader of the people of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.
chapters.nkjv: "Then comes the tribe of Benjamin, and the leader of the children of Benjamin shallbe Abidan the son of Gideoni."
chapters.kjv: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ മുപ്പത്തയ്യായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 35,400.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at thirty-five thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീംപാളയത്തിലെ ഗണങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകെ ഒരു ലക്ഷത്തെണ്ണായിരത്തൊരുനൂറു പേർ. അവർ മൂന്നാമതായി പുറപ്പെടേണം.
chapters.niv: All the men assigned to the camp of Ephraim, according to their divisions, number 108,100. They will set out third.
chapters.nkjv: "All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Ephraim, one hundred and eight thousand one hundred— they shall be the third to break camp.
chapters.kjv: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

chapters.ml: ദാൻപാളയത്തിന്റെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ളവർ ഗണംഗണമായി വടക്കെഭാഗത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; ദാന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു അമ്മീശദ്ദായിയുടെ മകൻ അഹീയേസർ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: On the north will be the divisions of the camp of Dan under their standard. The leader of the people of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
chapters.nkjv: "The standard of the forces with Dan shallbe on the north side according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Dan shallbe Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai."
chapters.kjv: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ അറുപത്തീരായിരത്തെഴുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 62,700.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അരികെ ആശേർഗോത്രം പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; ആശേരിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു ഒക്രാന്റെ മകൻ പഗീയേൽ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Asher will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Asher is Pagiel son of Okran.
chapters.nkjv: "Those who camp next to him shallbe the tribe of Asher, and the leader of the children of Asher shallbe Pagiel the son of Ocran."
chapters.kjv: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ നാല്പത്തോരായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 41,500.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at forty-one thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ നഫ്താലിഗോത്രം പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം; നഫ്താലിയുടെ മക്കൾക്കു ഏനാന്റെ മകൻ അഹീര പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The tribe of Naphtali will be next. The leader of the people of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.
chapters.nkjv: "Then comes the tribe of Naphtali, and the leader of the children of Naphtali shallbe Ahira the son of Enan."
chapters.kjv: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഗണം ആകെ അമ്പത്തുമൂവായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: His division numbers 53,400.
chapters.nkjv: And his army was numbered at fifty-three thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: ദാൻപാളയത്തിലെ ഗണങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകെ ഒരു ലക്ഷത്തമ്പത്തേഴായിരത്തറുനൂറു പേർ. അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ കൊടികളോടുകൂടെ ഒടുവിൽ പുറപ്പെടേണം.
chapters.niv: All the men assigned to the camp of Dan number 157,600. They will set out last, under their standards.
chapters.nkjv: "All who were numbered of the forces with Dan, one hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred— they shall break camp last, with their standards."
chapters.kjv: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ഗോത്രം ഗോത്രമായി എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ഇവർ തന്നേ. പാളയങ്ങളിൽ ഗണംഗണമായി എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകെ ആറുലക്ഷത്തി മൂവായിരത്തഞ്ഞുറ്റമ്പതു പേർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These are the Israelites, counted according to their families. All the men in the camps, by their divisions, number 603,550.
chapters.nkjv: These are the ones who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
chapters.kjv: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ലേവ്യരെ എണ്ണിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ചെയ്തു; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവർ താന്താങ്ങളുടെ കൊടിക്കരികെ പാളയമിറങ്ങി; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും കുലം കുലമായും പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So the Israelites did everything the Lord commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each of them with their clan and family.
chapters.nkjv: Thus the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses; so they camped by their standards and so they broke camp, each one by his family, according to their fathers’ houses.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സീനായി പർവ്വതത്തിൽവെച്ചു മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത കാലത്തു അഹരോന്റെയും മോശെയുടെയും വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു:
chapters.niv: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai.
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the records of Aaron and Moses when the Lord spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
chapters.kjv: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ ഇവ: ആദ്യജാതൻ നാദാബ്, അബീഹൂ, എലെയാസാർ, ഈഥാമാർ.
chapters.niv: The names of the sons of Aaron were Nadab the firstborn and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.nkjv: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab, the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
chapters.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്‍വാൻ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരായി അഭിഷേകം ലഭിച്ച പുരോഹിതന്മാരായ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ ഇവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Those were the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
chapters.nkjv: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whom he consecrated to minister as priests.
chapters.kjv: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നാദാബും അബീഹൂവും സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അന്യാഗ്നി കത്തിച്ചപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി; അവർക്കു മക്കൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; എലെയാസാരും ഈഥാമാരും അപ്പനായ അഹരോന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ പുരോഹിത ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Nadab and Abihu, however, died before the Lord when they made an offering with unauthorized fire before him in the Desert of Sinai. They had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.
chapters.nkjv: Nadab and Abihu had died before the Lord when they offered profane fire before the Lord in the Wilderness of Sinai; and they had no children. So Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priests in the presence of Aaron their father.
chapters.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD , when they offered strange fire before the LORD , in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ ലേവിഗോത്രത്തെ അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തി പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്നു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിർത്തുക.
chapters.niv: "Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
chapters.nkjv: "Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may serve him.
chapters.kjv: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

chapters.ml: അവർ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ അവന്റെ കാര്യവും സർവ്വസഭയുടെ കാര്യവും നോക്കി തിരുനിവാസത്തിലെ വേല ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the tent of meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: And they shall attend to his needs and the needs of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of meeting, to do the work of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: അവർ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്നുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ കാര്യവും നോക്കി കൂടാരം സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള വേല ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: Also they shall attend to all the furnishings of the tabernacle of meeting, and to the needs of the children of Israel, to do the work of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: നീ ലേവ്യരെ അഹരോന്നും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കും കൊടുക്കേണം; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽനിന്നു അവർ അവന്നു സാക്ഷാൽ ദാനമായുള്ളവർ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are given entirely to him from among the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അഹരോനെയും പുത്രന്മാരെയും പൌരോഹിത്യം നടത്തുവാൻ നിയമിച്ചാക്കേണം; അടുത്തുവരുന്ന അന്യൻ മരണശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests; anyone else who approaches the sanctuary is to be put to death."
chapters.nkjv: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall attend to their priesthood; but the outsider who comes near shall be put to death."
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord also said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പിറക്കുന്ന എല്ലാ കടിഞ്ഞൂലിന്നും പകരം ഞാൻ ലേവ്യരെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; ലേവ്യർ എനിക്കുള്ളവരായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of the first male offspring of every Israelite woman. The Levites are mine,
chapters.nkjv: "Now behold, I Myself have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of every firstborn who opens the womb among the children of Israel. Therefore the Levites shall be Mine,
chapters.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

chapters.ml: കടിഞ്ഞൂലെല്ലാം എനിക്കുള്ളതു; ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു കടിഞ്ഞൂലിനെ ഒക്കെയും കൊന്നനാളിൽ യിസ്രായേലിൽ മനുഷ്യന്റെയും മൃഗത്തിന്റെയും കടിഞ്ഞൂലിനെയെല്ലാം എനിക്കായിട്ടു ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു; അതു എനിക്കുള്ളതായിരിക്കേണം; ഞാൻ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: for all the firstborn are mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, whether human or animal. They are to be mine. I am the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: because all the firstborn are Mine. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They shall be Mine: I am the Lord."
chapters.kjv: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരെ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും എണ്ണുക; അവരിൽ ഒരു മാസംമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ള ആണിനെ ഒക്കെയും നീ എണ്ണേണം.
chapters.niv: "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more."
chapters.nkjv: "Number the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families; you shall number every male from a month old and above."
chapters.kjv: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

chapters.ml: തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെ യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം അവരെ എണ്ണി.
chapters.niv: So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.
chapters.kjv: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD , as he was commanded.

chapters.ml: ലേവിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ: ഗേർശോൻ, കെഹാത്ത്, മെരാരി.
chapters.niv: These were the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.kjv: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

chapters.ml: കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ഗേർശോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ:
chapters.niv: These were the names of the Gershonite clans: Libni and Shimei.
chapters.nkjv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
chapters.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

chapters.ml: ലിബ്നി, ശിമെയി. കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കെഹാത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അമ്രാം, യിസ്ഹാർ, ഹെബ്രോൻ, ഉസ്സീയേൽ.
chapters.niv: The Kohathite clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

chapters.ml: കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി മെരാരിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മഹ്ളി, മൂശി. ഇവർ തന്നേ കുലംകുലമായി ലേവിയുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങൾ.
chapters.niv: The Merarite clans: Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans, according to their families.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites by their fathers’ houses.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോനിൽനിന്നു ലിബ്നിയരുടെ കുടുംബവും ശിമ്യരുടെ കുടുംബവും ഉത്ഭവിച്ചു; ഇവ ഗേർശോന്യ കുടുംബങ്ങൾ.
chapters.niv: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.
chapters.nkjv: From Gershon came the family of the Libnites and the family of the Shimites; these were the families of the Gershonites.
chapters.kjv: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരു മാസം മുതൽ മേലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ള ആണുങ്ങളുടെ സംഖ്യയിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ ആകത്തുക ഏഴായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു.
chapters.niv: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.
chapters.nkjv: Those who were numbered, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above—of those who were numbered therewere seven thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോന്യകുടുംബങ്ങൾ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ പുറകിൽ പടിഞ്ഞാറെ ഭാഗത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം.
chapters.niv: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: The families of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle westward.
chapters.kjv: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോന്യരുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നു ലായേലിന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാസാഫ് പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
chapters.nkjv: And the leader of the father’s house of the Gershonites was Eliasaph the son of Lael.
chapters.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ ഗേർശോന്യർ നോക്കേണ്ടതു തിരുനിവാസവും കൂടാരവും അതിന്റെ പുറമൂടിയും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നുള്ള മറശ്ശീലയും
chapters.niv: At the tent of meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the tent of meeting,
chapters.nkjv: The duties of the children of Gershon in the tabernacle of meeting included the tabernacle, the tent with its covering, the screen for the door of the tabernacle of meeting,
chapters.kjv: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും ചുറ്റുമുള്ള പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മറശ്ശീലയും പ്രാകാരവാതിലിന്റെ മറശ്ശീലയും അതിന്റെ എല്ലാവേലെക്കും ഉള്ള കയറുകളും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes—and everything related to their use.
chapters.nkjv: the screen for the door of the court, the hangings of the court which are around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, according to all the work relating to them.
chapters.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്തിൽനിന്നു അമ്രാമ്യരുടെ കുടുംബവും യിസ്ഹാർയ്യരുടെ കുടുംബവും ഹെബ്രോന്യരുടെ കുടുംബവും ഉസ്സീയേല്യരുടെ കുടുംബവും ഉത്ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites; these were the Kohathite clans.
chapters.nkjv: From Kohath came the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites; these were the families of the Kohathites.
chapters.kjv: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

chapters.ml: ഇവ കെഹാത്യരുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങൾ. ഒരു മാസംമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ള എല്ലാ ആണുങ്ങളുടെയും സംഖ്യയിൽ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ കാര്യം നോക്കുന്നവർ എണ്ണായിരത്തറുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. The Kohathites were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and above, therewere eight thousand six hundred keeping charge of the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്യകുടുംബങ്ങൾ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ തെക്കെ ഭാഗത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം.
chapters.niv: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: The families of the children of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്യ കുടുംബങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നു ഉസ്സീയേലിന്റെ മകൻ എലീസാഫാൻ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
chapters.nkjv: And the leader of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
chapters.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

chapters.ml: അവർ നോക്കേണ്ടതു പെട്ടകം, മേശ, നിലവിളക്കു, പീഠങ്ങൾ, വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ, തിരശ്ശീല എന്നിവയും അവെക്കുള്ള വേല ഒക്കെയും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were responsible for the care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used in ministering, the curtain, and everything related to their use.
chapters.nkjv: Their duty included the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the utensils of the sanctuary with which they ministered, the screen, and all the work relating to them.
chapters.kjv: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ മകൻ എലെയാസാർ ലേവ്യർക്കു പ്രധാനപ്രഭുവും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ കാര്യം നോക്കുന്നവരുടെ മേൽവിചാരകനും ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest. He was appointed over those who were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest wastobe chief over the leaders of the Levites, with oversight of those who kept charge of the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിയിൽനിന്നു മഹ്ളിയരുടെ കുടുംബവും മൂശ്യരുടെ കുടുംബവും ഉത്ഭവിച്ചു; മെരാർയ്യകുടുംബങ്ങൾ ഇവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
chapters.nkjv: From Merari came the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites; these were the families of Merari.
chapters.kjv: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരു മാസംമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ള ആണുങ്ങളുടെ സംഖ്യയിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആറായിരത്തിരുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 6,200.
chapters.nkjv: And those who were numbered, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above, were six thousand two hundred.
chapters.kjv: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

chapters.ml: മെരാർയ്യകുടുംബങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നു അബീഹയിലിന്റെ മകൻ സൂരിയേൽ പ്രഭു ആയിരിക്കേണം; ഇവർ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ വടക്കെ ഭാഗത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങേണം.
chapters.niv: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: The leader of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. These were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

chapters.ml: മെരാർയ്യർ നോക്കുവാൻ നിയമിച്ചിട്ടുള്ളതു തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ പലക, അന്താഴം, തൂൺ, ചുവട്, അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും, അതു സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള എല്ലാവേലയും,
chapters.niv: The Merarites were appointed to take care of the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts, bases, all its equipment, and everything related to their use,
chapters.nkjv: And the appointed duty of the children of Merari included the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, its utensils, all the work relating to them,
chapters.kjv: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

chapters.ml: പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റും ഉള്ള തൂൺ, അവയുടെ ചുവടു, കുറ്റി, കയറു എന്നിവ.
chapters.niv: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.
chapters.nkjv: and the pillars of the court all around, with their sockets, their pegs, and their cords.
chapters.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ മുൻ വശത്തു കിഴക്കു, സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ മുൻ വശത്തു തന്നേ, സൂര്യോദയത്തിന്നു നേരെ മോശെയും അഹരോനും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും പാളയമിറങ്ങുകയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ കാര്യമായ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ കാര്യം നോക്കുകയും വേണം; അന്യൻ അടുത്തുവന്നാൽ മരണ ശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Moses and Aaron and his sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, in front of the tent of meeting. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites. Anyone else who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover those who were to camp before the tabernacle on the east, before the tabernacle of meeting, were Moses, Aaron, and his sons, keeping charge of the sanctuary, to meet the needs of the children of Israel; but the outsider who came near was to be put to death.
chapters.kjv: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

chapters.ml: മോശെയും അഹരോനും യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി എണ്ണിയ ലേവ്യരിൽ ഒരു മാസംമുതൽ മോലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ള ആണുങ്ങൾ ആകെ ഇരുപത്തീരായിരം പേർ.
chapters.niv: The total number of Levites counted at the Lord ’s command by Moses and Aaron according to their clans, including every male a month old or more, was 22,000.
chapters.nkjv: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, by their families, all the males from a month old and above, were twenty-two thousand.
chapters.kjv: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD , throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ഒരു മാസംമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ള ആദ്യജാതന്മാരായ ആണുങ്ങളെ ഒക്കെയും എണ്ണി പേരുപേരായി അവരുടെ സംഖ്യ എടുക്കുക.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses, "Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses: "Number all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and above, and take the number of their names.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിലെ എല്ലാകടിഞ്ഞൂലുകൾക്കും പകരം ലേവ്യരുടെ മൃഗങ്ങളെയും എനിക്കായിട്ടു എടുക്കേണം; ഞാൻ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: And you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the Lord—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel."
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD ) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ എല്ലാകടിഞ്ഞൂലുകളെയും എണ്ണി.
chapters.niv: So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses numbered all the firstborn among the children of Israel, as the Lord commanded him.
chapters.kjv: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ഒരു മാസംമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു പ്രായമുള്ള ആദ്യജാതന്മാരായ എല്ലാ ആണുങ്ങളെയും പേരുപേരായി എണ്ണിയ ആകത്തുക ഇരുപത്തീരായിരത്തിരുനൂറ്റെഴുപത്തുമൂന്നു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
chapters.nkjv: And all the firstborn males, according to the number of names from a month old and above, of those who were numbered of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
chapters.kjv: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord also said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ എല്ലാ കടിഞ്ഞൂലുകൾക്കും പകരം ലേവ്യരെയും അവരുടെ മൃഗങ്ങൾക്കു പകരം ലേവ്യരുടെ മൃഗങ്ങളെയും എടുക്ക; ലേവ്യർ എനിക്കുള്ളവരായിരിക്കേണം; ഞാൻ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites are to be mine. I am the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: "Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock. The Levites shall be Mine: I am the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD .

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ കടിഞ്ഞൂലുകളിൽ ലേവ്യരുടെ എണ്ണത്തെ കവിഞ്ഞുള്ള ഇരുനൂറ്റെഴുപത്തുമൂന്നു പേരുടെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പിന്നായി തലക്കു അഞ്ചു ശേക്കെൽ വീതം വാങ്ങേണം;
chapters.niv: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,
chapters.nkjv: And for the redemption of the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who are more than the number of the Levites,
chapters.kjv: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം ശേക്കെൽ ഒന്നിന്നു ഇരുപതു ഗേരാവെച്ചു വാങ്ങേണം.
chapters.niv: collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.
chapters.nkjv: you shall take five shekels for each one individually; you shall take them in the currency of the shekel of the sanctuary, the shekel of twenty gerahs.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ എണ്ണത്തെ കവിയുന്നവരുടെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുവില അഹരോന്നും അവന്റെ മക്കൾക്കും കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Give the money for the redemption of the additional Israelites to Aaron and his sons."
chapters.nkjv: And you shall give the money, with which the excess number of them is redeemed, to Aaron and his sons."
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരെക്കൊണ്ടു വീണ്ടെടുത്തവരുടെ എണ്ണത്തെ കവിഞ്ഞുള്ളവരുടെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുവില മോശെ വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: So Moses collected the redemption money from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were over and above those who were redeemed by the Levites.
chapters.kjv: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ആദ്യജാതന്മാരോടു അവൻ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം ഒരായിരത്തി മൂന്നൂറ്ററുപത്തഞ്ചു ശേക്കെൽ പണം വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: From the firstborn of the Israelites he collected silver weighing 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
chapters.nkjv: From the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ വീണ്ടെടുത്തവരുടെ വില മോശെ അഹരോന്നും അവന്റെ മക്കൾക്കും യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And Moses gave their redemption money to Aaron and his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD , as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരിൽ വെച്ചു കെഹാത്യരിൽ മുപ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ അമ്പതു വയസ്സുവരെയുള്ളവരായി സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ
chapters.niv: "Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: "Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the children of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ house,
chapters.kjv: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

chapters.ml: വേലചെയ്‍വാൻ സേവയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരെയും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും കുലംകുലമായും എണ്ണി തുക എടുപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to do the work in the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ അതിവിശുദ്ധകാര്യങ്ങളെ സംബന്ധിച്ചു കെഹാത്യരുടെ വേല എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: "This is the work of the Kohathites at the tent of meeting: the care of the most holy things.
chapters.nkjv: "This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of meeting, relatingto the most holy things:
chapters.kjv: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

chapters.ml: പാളയം യാത്രപുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മാരും വന്നു തിരശ്ശീല ഇറക്കി അതുകൊണ്ടു സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകം മൂടേണം.
chapters.niv: When the camp is to move, Aaron and his sons are to go in and take down the shielding curtain and put it over the ark of the covenant law.
chapters.nkjv: When the camp prepares to journey, Aaron and his sons shall come, and they shall take down the covering veil and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
chapters.kjv: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

chapters.ml: തഹശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള മൂടി അതിന്മേൽ ഇട്ടു അതിന്നു മീതെ നീലശ്ശീല വിരിച്ചു തണ്ടു ചെലുത്തേണം.
chapters.niv: Then they are to cover the curtain with a durable leather, spread a cloth of solid blue over that and put the poles in place.
chapters.nkjv: Then they shall put on it a covering of badger skins, and spread over that a cloth entirely of blue; and they shall insert its poles.
chapters.kjv: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

chapters.ml: കാഴ്ചയപ്പത്തിന്റെ മേശമേലും ഒരു നീലശ്ശീല വിരിച്ചു അതിന്മേൽ തളികകളും കരണ്ടികളും കിണ്ടികളും പകരുന്നതിന്നുള്ള കുടങ്ങളും വെക്കേണം; നിരന്തരമായ അപ്പവും അതിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes and bowls, and the jars for drink offerings; the bread that is continually there is to remain on it.
chapters.nkjv: "On the table of showbread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the pans, the bowls, and the pitchers for pouring; and the showbread shall be on it.
chapters.kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ മേൽ ഒരു ചുവപ്പുശീല വിരിച്ചു തഹശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള മൂടുവിരിയാൽ അതു മൂടുകയും തണ്ടു ചെലുത്തുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: They are to spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.
chapters.nkjv: They shall spread over them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of badger skins; and they shall insert its poles.
chapters.kjv: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

chapters.ml: ഒരു നീലശ്ശീല എടുത്തു വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നുള്ള നിലവിളക്കും അതിന്റെ ദീപങ്ങളും ചവണകളും കരിന്തിരി മുറിച്ചിടുന്ന പാത്രങ്ങളും അതിന്റെ ഉപയോഗത്തിന്നുള്ള എല്ലാ എണ്ണകൂടങ്ങളും മൂടേണം.
chapters.niv: "They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that is for light, together with its lamps, its wick trimmers and trays, and all its jars for the olive oil used to supply it.
chapters.nkjv: And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand of the light, with its lamps, its wick-trimmers, its trays, and all its oil vessels, with which they service it.
chapters.kjv: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

chapters.ml: അതും അതിന്റെ പാത്രങ്ങളൊക്കെയും തഹശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു വിരിയിൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞു ഒരു തണ്ടിന്മേൽ വെച്ചുകെട്ടേണം.
chapters.niv: Then they are to wrap it and all its accessories in a covering of the durable leather and put it on a carrying frame.
chapters.nkjv: Then they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of badger skins, and put it on a carrying beam.
chapters.kjv: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

chapters.ml: സ്വർണ്ണ പീഠത്തിന്മേൽ അവർ ഒരു നീലശ്ശീല വിരിച്ചു തഹശ്ശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു വിരിയാൽ മൂടുകയും തണ്ടു ചെലുത്തുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: "Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth and cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.
chapters.nkjv: "Over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of badger skins; and they shall insert its poles.
chapters.kjv: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അവർ എടുത്തു ഒരു നീലശ്ശീലയിൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞു തഹശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു വിരിയാൽ മൂടുകയും ഒരു തണ്ടിന്മേൽ വെച്ചു കെട്ടുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: "They are to take all the articles used for ministering in the sanctuary, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with the durable leather and put them on a carrying frame.
chapters.nkjv: Then they shall take all the utensils of service with which they minister in the sanctuary, put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of badger skins, and put them on a carrying beam.
chapters.kjv: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:

chapters.ml: അവർ യാഗപീഠത്തിൽനിന്നു വെണ്ണീർ നീക്കി അതിന്മേൽ ഒരു ധൂമ്രശീല വിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.
chapters.nkjv: Also they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it.
chapters.kjv: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
