chapters.ml: അവർ അതിന്മേൽ ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങളായ കലശം, മുൾക്കൊളുത്തു, ചട്ടുകം, കലം എന്നിങ്ങനെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അതിന്മേൽ വെക്കേണം; തഹശൂതോൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു വിരി അതിന്മേൽ വിരിക്കയും തണ്ടു ചെലുത്തുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Then they are to place on it all the utensils used for ministering at the altar, including the firepans, meat forks, shovels and sprinkling bowls. Over it they are to spread a covering of the durable leather and put the poles in place.
chapters.nkjv: They shall put on it all its implements with which they minister there—the firepans, the forks, the shovels, the basins, and all the utensils of the altar—and they shall spread on it a covering of badger skins, and insert its poles.
chapters.kjv: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.

chapters.ml: പാളയം യാത്രപുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മാരും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരവും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും മൂടി തീർന്നശേഷം കെഹാത്യർ ചുമപ്പാൻ വരേണം; എന്നാൽ അവർ മരിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വിശുദ്ധമായതൊന്നും തൊടരുതു; സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ കെഹാത്യരുടെ ചുമടു ഇവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "After Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy furnishings and all the holy articles, and when the camp is ready to move, only then are the Kohathites to come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy things or they will die. The Kohathites are to carry those things that are in the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, when the camp is set to go, then the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them; but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. " These are the things in the tabernacle of meeting which the sons of Kohath are to carry.
chapters.kjv: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ മകൻ എലെയാസാർ നോക്കേണ്ടതു: വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നുള്ള എണ്ണ, സുഗന്ധധൂപവർഗ്ഗം, നിരന്തരഭോജനയാഗം, അഭിഷേകതൈലം എന്നിവയും തിരുനിവാസം മുഴുവനും അതിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരവും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, is to have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering and the anointing oil. He is to be in charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including its holy furnishings and articles."
chapters.nkjv: "The appointed duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest is the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the daily grain offering, the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle, of all that is in it, with the sanctuary and its furnishings."
chapters.kjv: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ കെഹാത്യകുടുംബങ്ങളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തെ ലേവ്യരിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയരുതു.
chapters.niv: "See that the Kohathite tribal clans are not destroyed from among the Levites.
chapters.nkjv: "Do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
chapters.kjv: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

chapters.ml: അവർ അതിവിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളോടു അടുക്കുമ്പോൾ മരിക്കാതെ ജീവനോടിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്‍വിൻ: അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മാരും അകത്തു കടന്നു അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തനെ അവനവന്റെ വേലെക്കും അവനവന്റെ ചുമട്ടിന്നും ആക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: So that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go into the sanctuary and assign to each man his work and what he is to carry.
chapters.nkjv: but do this in regard to them, that they may live and not die when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint each of them to his service and his task.
chapters.kjv: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരം കണ്ടിട്ടു മരിച്ചുപോകാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ക്ഷണനേരംപോലും അകത്തു കടക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: But the Kohathites must not go in to look at the holy things, even for a moment, or they will die."
chapters.nkjv: But they shall not go in to watch while the holy things are being covered, lest they die."
chapters.kjv: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോന്യരെയും കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും എണ്ണി തുക എടുക്കുക.
chapters.niv: "Take a census also of the Gershonites by their families and clans.
chapters.nkjv: "Also take a census of the sons of Gershon, by their fathers’ house, by their families.
chapters.kjv: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ അമ്പതു വയസ്സുവരെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ സേവയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരെയും എണ്ണേണം.
chapters.niv: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: From thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, you shall number them, all who enter to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: സേവ ചെയ്യുന്നതിലും ചുമടെടുക്കുന്നതിലും ഗേർശോന്യകുടുംബങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള വേല എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: "This is the service of the Gershonite clans in their carrying and their other work:
chapters.nkjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and carrying:
chapters.kjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ തിരശ്ശീല, സമാഗമനക്കുടാരം, അതിന്റെ മൂടുവിരി, തഹശുതോൽകൊണ്ടു അതിന്മേലുള്ള പുറമൂടി, സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നുള്ള മറശ്ശീല,
chapters.niv: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, that is, the tent of meeting, its covering and its outer covering of durable leather, the curtains for the entrance to the tent of meeting,
chapters.nkjv: They shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tabernacle of meeting with its covering, the covering of badger skins that is on it, the screen for the door of the tabernacle of meeting,
chapters.kjv: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

chapters.ml: പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മറശ്ശീല, തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്നും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും ചുറ്റുമുള്ള പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിലിന്നുള്ള മറശ്ശീല, അവയുടെ കയറു എന്നിവയും അവയുടെ ഉപയോഗത്തിന്നുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും അവർ ചുമക്കേണം; അവയെ സംബന്ധിച്ചു ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ള വേലയൊക്കെയും അവർ ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: the curtains of the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard, the ropes and all the equipment used in the service of the tent. The Gershonites are to do all that needs to be done with these things.
chapters.nkjv: the screen for the door of the gate of the court, the hangings of the court which are around the tabernacle and altar, and their cords, all the furnishings for their service and all that is made for these things: so shall they serve.
chapters.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോന്യരുടെ എല്ലാ ചുമടുകളും എല്ലാവേലയും സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അഹരോന്റെയും പുത്രന്മാരുടെയും കല്പന പ്രകാരം ആയിരിക്കേണം; അവരുടെ എല്ലാ ചുമടും നിങ്ങൾ അവരുടെ വിചാരണയിൽ ഏല്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: All their service, whether carrying or doing other work, is to be done under the direction of Aaron and his sons. You shall assign to them as their responsibility all they are to carry.
chapters.nkjv: "Aaron and his sons shall assign all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, all their tasks and all their service. And you shall appoint to them all their tasks as their duty.
chapters.kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ ഗേർശോന്യരുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള വേല ഇതു തന്നേ; അവരുടെ സേവ പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ മകൻ ഈഥാമാരിന്റെ കൈക്കീഴായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the tent of meeting. Their duties are to be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.
chapters.nkjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of meeting. And their duties shallbe under the authority of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
chapters.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

chapters.ml: മെരാർയ്യരെയും കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും എണ്ണേണം.
chapters.niv: "Count the Merarites by their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: "Asfor the sons of Merari, you shall number them by their families and by their fathers’ house.
chapters.kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ അമ്പതു വയസ്സുവരെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിലെ വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ സേവയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരെയും നീ എണ്ണേണം.
chapters.niv: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: From thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, you shall number them, everyone who enters the service to do the work of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ അവർക്കുള്ള എല്ലാവേലയുടെയും മുറെക്കു അവർ എടുക്കേണ്ടുന്ന ചുമടു എന്തെന്നാൽ: തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ പലക, അന്താഴം, തൂൺ, ചുവടു,
chapters.niv: As part of all their service at the tent, they are to carry the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts and bases,
chapters.nkjv: And this is what they must carry as all their service for the tabernacle of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
chapters.kjv: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

chapters.ml: ചുറ്റുമുള്ള പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ തൂൺ, ചുവടു, കുറ്റി, കയറു എന്നിവയും അവയുടെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അവ സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള എല്ലാ വേലയും തന്നേ; അവർ എടുക്കേണ്ടുന്ന ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങൾ പേർവിവരമായി അവരെ ഏല്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, ropes, all their equipment and everything related to their use. Assign to each man the specific things he is to carry.
chapters.nkjv: and the pillars around the court with their sockets, pegs, and cords, with all their furnishings and all their service; and you shall assign toeachman by name the items he must carry.
chapters.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ മകൻ ഈഥാമാരിന്റെ കൈക്കീഴെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ മെരാർയ്യരുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള സകലസേവയുടെയും മുറെക്കു അവർ ചെയ്യേണ്ടുന്ന വേല ഇതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: This is the service of the Merarite clans as they work at the tent of meeting under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest."
chapters.nkjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, as all their service for the tabernacle of meeting, under the authority of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest."
chapters.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

chapters.ml: മോശെയും അഹരോനും സഭയിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും മെഹാത്യരിൽ മുപ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ അമ്പതു വയസ്സുവരെ
chapters.niv: Moses, Aaron and the leaders of the community counted the Kohathites by their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families and by their fathers’ house,
chapters.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ സേവയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരെയും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും കുലംകുലമായും എണ്ണി.
chapters.niv: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting,
chapters.nkjv: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tabernacle of meeting;
chapters.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ രണ്ടായിരത്തെഴുനൂറ്റമ്പതു പേർ.
chapters.niv: counted by clans, were 2,750.
chapters.nkjv: and those who were numbered by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
chapters.kjv: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

chapters.ml: മോശെമുഖാന്തരം യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെയും അഹരോനും കെഹാത്യകുടുംബങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണിയവരായി സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിൽ വേല ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ളവർ എല്ലാം ഇവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: This was the total of all those in the Kohathite clans who served at the tent of meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord ’s command through Moses.
chapters.nkjv: These were the ones who were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all who might serve in the tabernacle of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
chapters.kjv: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോന്യരിൽ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും കുലംകുലമായും എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരോ
chapters.niv: The Gershonites were counted by their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: And those who were numbered of the sons of Gershon, by their families and by their fathers’ house,
chapters.kjv: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതുവയസ്സുമുതൽ അമ്പതു വയസ്സുവരെ സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിൽ വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ സേവയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്നവരായി
chapters.niv: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting,
chapters.nkjv: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tabernacle of meeting—
chapters.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

chapters.ml: കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും കുലംകുലമായും എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ രണ്ടായിരത്തറുനൂറ്റി മുപ്പതു പേർ.
chapters.niv: counted by their clans and families, were 2,630.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered by their families, by their fathers’ house, were two thousand six hundred and thirty.
chapters.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെയും അഹരോനും ഗേർശോന്യകുടുംബങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണിയവരായി സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ വേല ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ളവർ എല്ലാം ഇവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: This was the total of those in the Gershonite clans who served at the tent of meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord ’s command.
chapters.nkjv: These are the ones who were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all who might serve in the tabernacle of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD .

chapters.ml: മെരാർയ്യകുടുംബങ്ങളിൽ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും കുലംകുലമായും എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരോ
chapters.niv: The Merarites were counted by their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: Those of the families of the sons of Merari who were numbered, by their families, by their fathers’ house,
chapters.kjv: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ അമ്പതു വയസ്സുവരെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ സേവയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്നവരായി
chapters.niv: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting,
chapters.nkjv: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tabernacle of meeting—
chapters.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകെ മൂവായിരത്തിരുനൂറുപേർ.
chapters.niv: counted by their clans, were 3,200.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered by their families were three thousand two hundred.
chapters.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെമുഖാന്തരം കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെയും അഹരോനും മെരാർയ്യ കുടുംബങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണിയവർ ഇവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: This was the total of those in the Merarite clans. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord ’s command through Moses.
chapters.nkjv: These are the ones who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
chapters.kjv: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

chapters.ml: മോശെയും അഹരോനും യിസ്രായേൽ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ലേവ്യരിൽ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായും കുലംകുലമായും എണ്ണിയവരായി മുപ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ അമ്പതുവയസ്സുവരെ
chapters.niv: So Moses, Aaron and the leaders of Israel counted all the Levites by their clans and families.
chapters.nkjv: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,
chapters.kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

chapters.ml: സമാഗമന കൂടാരത്തിലെ സേവയും ചുമട്ടുവേലയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ പ്രവേശിച്ചവർ ആകെ
chapters.niv: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to do the work of serving and carrying the tent of meeting
chapters.nkjv: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who came to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the tabernacle of meeting—
chapters.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

chapters.ml: എണ്ണായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറ്റെൺപതു പേർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: numbered 8,580.
chapters.nkjv: those who were numbered were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
chapters.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം അവർ മോശെ മുഖാന്തരം ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വേലയ്ക്കും താന്താന്റെ ചുമട്ടിന്നും തക്കവണ്ണം എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ച പോലെ അവൻ അവരെ എണ്ണി.
chapters.niv: At the Lord ’s command through Moses, each was assigned his work and told what to carry. Thus they were counted, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, each according to his service and according to his task; thus were they numbered by him, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: സകല കുഷ്ഠരോഗിയെയും സകല സ്രവക്കാരനെയും ശവത്താൽ അശുദ്ധനായ ഏവനെയും പാളയത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറത്താക്കുവാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു കല്പിക്ക.
chapters.niv: "Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone who has a defiling skin disease or a discharge of any kind, or who is ceremonially unclean because of a dead body.
chapters.nkjv: "Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever becomes defiled by a corpse.
chapters.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

chapters.ml: ആണായാലും പെണ്ണായാലും അവരെ പാളയത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറത്താക്കേണം; ഞാൻ അവരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ വസിക്കയാൽ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പാളയം അശുദ്ധമാക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them."
chapters.nkjv: You shall put out both male and female; you shall put them outside the camp, that they may not defile their camps in the midst of which I dwell."
chapters.kjv: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു അവരെ പാളയത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites did so; they sent them outside the camp. They did just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel did so, and put them outside the camp; as the Lord spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറക: ഒരു പുരുഷനോ സ്ത്രീയോ യഹോവയോടു ദ്രോഹിച്ചു മനുഷ്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നടപ്പുള്ള വല്ല പാപവും ചെയ്തിട്ടു കുറ്റക്കാരായാൽ ചെയ്ത പാപം
chapters.niv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Any man or woman who wrongs another in any way and so is unfaithful to the Lord is guilty
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit in unfaithfulness against the Lord, and that person is guilty,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD , and that person be guilty;

chapters.ml: അവർ ഏറ്റുപറകയും തങ്ങളുടെ അകൃത്യത്തിന്നു പ്രതിശാന്തിയായി മുതലും അതിന്റെ അഞ്ചിലൊന്നും കൂട്ടി, തങ്ങൾ അകൃത്യം ചെയ്തവന്നു പകരം കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and must confess the sin they have committed. They must make full restitution for the wrong they have done, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the person they have wronged.
chapters.nkjv: then he shall confess the sin which he has committed. He shall make restitution for his trespass in full, plus one-fifth of it, and give it to the one he has wronged.
chapters.kjv: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അകൃത്യത്തിന്നു പ്രതിശാന്തി വാങ്ങുവാൻ അവന്നു ചാർച്ചക്കാരൻ ഇല്ലെങ്കിൽ അകൃത്യത്തിന്നുള്ള പ്രതിശാന്തി യഹോവെക്കു കൊടുക്കുന്നതു പുരോഹിതന്നു ഇരിക്കേണം; അതുകൂടാതെ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിപ്പാനുള്ള പ്രായശ്ചിത്തത്തിന്റെ ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: But if that person has no close relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the Lord and must be given to the priest, along with the ram with which atonement is made for the wrongdoer.
chapters.nkjv: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution for the wrong mustgo to the Lord for the priest, in addition to the ram of the atonement with which atonement is made for him.
chapters.kjv: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD , even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്ന സകലവിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളിലും ഉദർച്ചയായതൊക്കെയും അവന്നു ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: All the sacred contributions the Israelites bring to a priest will belong to him.
chapters.nkjv: Every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring to the priest, shall be his.
chapters.kjv: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചർപ്പിക്കുന്ന വസ്തുക്കൾ അവന്നുള്ളവയായിരിക്കേണം; ആരെങ്കിലും പുരോഹിതന്നു കൊടുക്കുന്നതെല്ലാം അവന്നുള്ളതായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Sacred things belong to their owners, but what they give to the priest will belong to the priest.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest shall be his.’ "
chapters.kjv: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: വല്ല പുരുഷന്റെയും ഭാര്യ പിഴെച്ചു അവനോടു ദ്രോഹിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘If a man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and behaves unfaithfully toward him,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തൻ അവളോടുകൂടെ ശയിക്കയും അതു അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവിന്നു വെളിപ്പെടാതെ മറവായിരിക്കയും അവൾ അശുദ്ധയാകയും അവൾക്കു വിരോധമായി സാക്ഷിയില്ലാതിരക്കയും
chapters.niv: so that another man has sexual relations with her, and this is hidden from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act),
chapters.nkjv: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and it is concealed that she has defiled herself, and therewas no witness against her, nor was she caught—
chapters.kjv: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

chapters.ml: അവൾ ക്രിയയിൽ പിടിപെടാതിരിക്കയും ശങ്കാവിഷം അവനെ ബാധിച്ചു അവൻ ഭാര്യയെ സംശയിക്കയും അവൾ അശുദ്ധയായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ശങ്കാവിഷം അവനെ ബാധിച്ചു അവൻ ഭാര്യയെ സംശയിക്കയും അവൾ അശുദ്ധയല്ലാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ
chapters.niv: and if feelings of jealousy come over her husband and he suspects his wife and she is impure—or if he is jealous and suspects her even though she is not impure—
chapters.nkjv: if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, who has defiled herself; or if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, although she has not defiled herself—
chapters.kjv: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

chapters.ml: ആ പുരുഷൻ ഭാര്യയെ പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെല്ലേണം; അവൾക്കുവേണ്ടി വഴിപാടായിട്ടു ഒരിടങ്ങഴി യവപ്പൊടിയും കൊണ്ടുചെല്ലേണം; അതിന്മേൽ എണ്ണ ഒഴിക്കരുതു; കുന്തുരുക്കം ഇടുകയും അരുതു; അതു സംശയത്തിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗമല്ലോ, അപരാധജ്ഞാപകമായ ഭോജനയാഗം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: then he is to take his wife to the priest. He must also take an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour on her behalf. He must not pour olive oil on it or put incense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, a reminder-offering to draw attention to wrongdoing.
chapters.nkjv: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest. He shall bring the offering required for her, one-tenth of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil on it and put no frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, an offering for remembering, for bringing iniquity to remembrance.
chapters.kjv: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അവളെ അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തി യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിർത്തേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘The priest shall bring her and have her stand before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: ‘And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD :

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ ഒരു മൺപാത്രത്തിൽ വിശുദ്ധജലം എടുക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ നിലത്തെ പൊടി കുറെ എടുത്തു ആ വെള്ളത്തിൽ ഇടേണം.
chapters.niv: Then he shall take some holy water in a clay jar and put some dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.
chapters.nkjv: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel, and take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ സ്ത്രീയെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിർത്തി അവളുടെ തലമുടി അഴിച്ചു അപരാധജ്ഞാപകത്തിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗം അവളുടെ കയ്യിൽ വെക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ശാപകരമായ കൈപ്പുവെള്ളവും ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: After the priest has had the woman stand before the Lord , he shall loosen her hair and place in her hands the reminder-offering, the grain offering for jealousy, while he himself holds the bitter water that brings a curse.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest shall stand the woman before the Lord, uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering for remembering in her hands, which is the grain offering of jealousy. And the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that brings a curse.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD , and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അവളെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചു അവളോടു പറയേണ്ടതു: ആരും നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ശയിക്കയും നിനക്കു ഭർത്താവുണ്ടായിരിക്കെ നീ അശുദ്ധിയിലേക്കു തിരികയും ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല എങ്കിൽ ശാപകരമായ ഈ കൈപ്പുവെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ദോഷം നിനക്കു വരാതിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Then the priest shall put the woman under oath and say to her, "If no other man has had sexual relations with you and you have not gone astray and become impure while married to your husband, may this bitter water that brings a curse not harm you.
chapters.nkjv: And the priest shall put her under oath, and say to the woman, "If no man has lain with you, and if you have not gone astray to uncleanness while under your husband’s authority, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിനക്കു ഭാർത്താവുണ്ടായിരിക്കെ നീ പിഴെച്ചു അശുദ്ധയാകയും നിന്റെ ഭർത്താവല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊരു പുരുഷൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ശയിക്കയും ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ -
chapters.niv: But if you have gone astray while married to your husband and you have made yourself impure by having sexual relations with a man other than your husband"—
chapters.nkjv: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority, and if you have defiled yourself and some man other than your husband has lain with you"—
chapters.kjv: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പുരോഹിതൻ സ്ത്രീയെക്കൊണ്ടു ശാപസത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചു അവളോടു: യഹോവ നിന്റെ നിതംബം ക്ഷയിപ്പിക്കയും ഉദരം വീർപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തു നിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നെ ശാപവും പ്രാക്കും ആക്കിത്തീർക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: here the priest is to put the woman under this curse—"may the Lord cause you to become a curse among your people when he makes your womb miscarry and your abdomen swell.
chapters.nkjv: then the priest shall put the woman under the oath of the curse, and he shall say to the woman— "the Lord make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the Lord makes your thigh rot and your belly swell;
chapters.kjv: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

chapters.ml: ശാപകരമായ ഈ വെള്ളം നിന്റെ കുടലിൽ ചെന്നു നിന്റെ ഉദരം വീർപ്പിക്കയും നിന്റെ നിതംബം ക്ഷിയിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറയേണം. അതിന്നു സ്ത്രീ: ആമെൻ, ആമെൻ എന്നു പറയേണം.
chapters.niv: May this water that brings a curse enter your body so that your abdomen swells or your womb miscarries." " ‘Then the woman is to say, "Amen. So be it."
chapters.nkjv: and may this water that causes the curse go into your stomach, and make your belly swell and your thigh rot." ‘ Then the woman shall say, "Amen, so be it."
chapters.kjv: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ ഈ ശാപങ്ങൾ ഒരു പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതി കൈപ്പുവെള്ളത്തിൽ കഴുകി കലക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘The priest is to write these curses on a scroll and then wash them off into the bitter water.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Then the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall scrape them off into the bitter water.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശാപകരമായ കൈപ്പുവെള്ളം സ്ത്രീയെ കുടിപ്പിക്കേണം; ശാപകരമായ വെള്ളം അവളുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ ചെന്നു കൈപ്പായ്തീരും;
chapters.niv: He shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and this water that brings a curse and causes bitter suffering will enter her.
chapters.nkjv: And he shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and the water that brings the curse shall enter her tobecome bitter.
chapters.kjv: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ സ്ത്രീയുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു സംശയത്തിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗം വാങ്ങി യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നീരാജനം ചെയ്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest is to take from her hands the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the Lord and bring it to the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, shall wave the offering before the Lord, and bring it to the altar;
chapters.kjv: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD , and offer it upon the altar:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പുരോഹിതൻ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിൽ ഒരു പിടി എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ നിവേദ്യമായി ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം സ്ത്രീയെ ആ വെള്ളം കുടിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest is then to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial offering and burn it on the altar; after that, he is to have the woman drink the water.
chapters.nkjv: and the priest shall take a handful of the offering, as its memorial portion, burn it on the altar, and afterward make the woman drink the water.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അശുദ്ധയായി തന്റെ ഭർത്താവോടു ദ്രോഹം ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അവളെ വെള്ളം കുടിപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം ശാപകരമായ വെള്ളം അവളുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ ചെന്നു കൈപ്പായ്തീരും; അവളുടെ ഉദരം വീർക്കയും നിതംബം ക്ഷയിക്കയും സ്ത്രീ തന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ ശാപഗ്രസ്തയായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: If she has made herself impure and been unfaithful to her husband, this will be the result: When she is made to drink the water that brings a curse and causes bitter suffering, it will enter her, her abdomen will swell and her womb will miscarry, and she will become a curse.
chapters.nkjv: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall be, if she has defiled herself and behaved unfaithfully toward her husband, that the water that brings a curse will enter her andbecome bitter, and her belly will swell, her thigh will rot, and the woman will become a curse among her people.
chapters.kjv: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that , if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സ്ത്രീ അശുദ്ധയാകാതെ നിർമ്മല ആകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൾക്കു ദോഷം വരികയില്ല; അവൾ ഗർഭം ധരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: If, however, the woman has not made herself impure, but is clean, she will be cleared of guilt and will be able to have children.
chapters.nkjv: But if the woman has not defiled herself, and is clean, then she shall be free and may conceive children.
chapters.kjv: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

chapters.ml: ഇതാകുന്നു പാതിവ്രത്യസംശയം സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള പ്രമാണം;
chapters.niv: " ‘This, then, is the law of jealousy when a woman goes astray and makes herself impure while married to her husband,
chapters.nkjv: ‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, while under her husband’s authority, goes astray and defiles herself,
chapters.kjv: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

chapters.ml: ഒരു സ്ത്രീ ഭർത്താവുണ്ടായിരിക്കെ പിഴെച്ചു അശുദ്ധയാകയോ ശങ്കാവിഷം അവനെ ബാധിച്ചു, അവൻ ഭാര്യയെ സംശയിക്കയോ ചെയ്തിട്ടു അവളെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിർത്തുമ്പോൾ പുരോഹിതൻ ഈ പ്രമാണമൊക്കെയും അവളിൽ നടത്തേണം.
chapters.niv: or when feelings of jealousy come over a man because he suspects his wife. The priest is to have her stand before the Lord and is to apply this entire law to her.
chapters.nkjv: or when the spirit of jealousy comes upon a man, and he becomes jealous of his wife; then he shall stand the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute all this law upon her.
chapters.kjv: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD , and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പുരുഷൻ അകൃത്യത്തിൽ ഓഹരിക്കാരനാകയില്ല; സ്ത്രീയോ തന്റെ അകൃത്യം വഹിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The husband will be innocent of any wrongdoing, but the woman will bear the consequences of her sin.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then the man shall be free from iniquity, but that woman shall bear her guilt.’ "
chapters.kjv: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ഒരു പുരുഷനാകട്ടെ സ്ത്രീയാകട്ടെ യഹോവെക്കു തന്നെത്താൻ സമർപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നാസീർവ്രതം എന്ന വിശേഷ വിധിയായുള്ള വ്രതം ദീക്ഷിക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘If a man or woman wants to make a special vow, a vow of dedication to the Lord as a Nazirite,
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When either a man or woman consecrates an offering to take the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the Lord,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD :

chapters.ml: വീഞ്ഞും മദ്യവും വർജ്ജിച്ചിരിക്കേണം: വീഞ്ഞിന്റെ കാടിയും മദ്യത്തിന്റെ കാടിയും കുടിക്കരുതു; മുന്തിരിപ്പഴത്തിന്റെ യാതൊരു രസവും കുടിക്കരുതു; മുന്തിരിങ്ങ പഴുത്തതാകട്ടെ ഉണങ്ങിയതാകട്ടെ തിന്നുകയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: they must abstain from wine and other fermented drink and must not drink vinegar made from wine or other fermented drink. They must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.
chapters.nkjv: he shall separate himself from wine and similar drink; he shall drink neither vinegar made from wine nor vinegar made from similar drink; neither shall he drink any grape juice, nor eat fresh grapes or raisins.
chapters.kjv: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ നാസീർവ്രതകാലത്തു ഒക്കെയും കുരുതൊട്ടു തൊലിവരെ മുന്തിരിങ്ങാകൊണ്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നതു ഒന്നും അവൻ തിന്നരുതു.
chapters.niv: As long as they remain under their Nazirite vow, they must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.
chapters.nkjv: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is produced by the grapevine, from seed to skin.
chapters.kjv: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

chapters.ml: നാസീർവ്രതകാലത്തൊക്കെയും ക്ഷൌരക്കത്തി അവന്റെ തലയിൽ തൊടരുതു; യഹോവെക്കു തന്നെത്താൻ സമർപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന കാലം തികയുവോളം അവൻ വിശുദ്ധനായിരിക്കേണം: തലമുടി വളർത്തേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘During the entire period of their Nazirite vow, no razor may be used on their head. They must be holy until the period of their dedication to the Lord is over; they must let their hair grow long.
chapters.nkjv: ‘All the days of the vow of his separation no razor shall come upon his head; until the days are fulfilled for which he separated himself to the Lord, he shall be holy. Then he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
chapters.kjv: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD , he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു തന്നെത്താൻ സമർപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന കാലത്തൊക്കെയും ശവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലരുതു;
chapters.niv: " ‘Throughout the period of their dedication to the Lord , the Nazirite must not go near a dead body.
chapters.nkjv: All the days that he separates himself to the Lord he shall not go near a dead body.
chapters.kjv: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൻ, അമ്മ, സഹോദരൻ, സഹോദരി എന്നിവരിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും മരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവരാൽ അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ അശുദ്ധനാകരുതു; അവന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നാസീർവ്രതം അവന്റെ തലയിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Even if their own father or mother or brother or sister dies, they must not make themselves ceremonially unclean on account of them, because the symbol of their dedication to God is on their head.
chapters.nkjv: He shall not make himself unclean even for his father or his mother, for his brother or his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.
chapters.kjv: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

chapters.ml: നാസീർവ്രതകാലത്തു ഒക്കെയും അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു വിശുദ്ധൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Throughout the period of their dedication, they are consecrated to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: All the days of his separation he shall be holy to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽവെച്ചു വല്ലവനും പെട്ടെന്നു മരിക്കയും അവന്റെ നാസീർവ്രതമുള്ള തലയെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ തന്റെ ശുദ്ധീകരണദിവസത്തിൽ തല ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്യേണം; ഏഴാം ദിവസം അവൻ ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘If someone dies suddenly in the Nazirite’s presence, thus defiling the hair that symbolizes their dedication, they must shave their head on the seventh day—the day of their cleansing.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And if anyone dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles his consecrated head, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
chapters.kjv: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

chapters.ml: എട്ടാം ദിവസം അവൻ രണ്ടു കുറുപ്രാവിനെയോ രണ്ടു പ്രാവിൻ കുഞ്ഞിനെയോ പുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: Then on the eighth day they must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: Then on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting;
chapters.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ ഒന്നിനെ പാപയാഗമായിട്ടും മറ്റേതിനെ ഹോമയാഗമായിട്ടും അർപ്പിച്ചു ശവത്താൽ അവൻ പിഴെച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു വേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിച്ചു അവന്റെ തല അന്നുതന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for the Nazirite because they sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. That same day they are to consecrate their head again.
chapters.nkjv: and the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned in regard to the corpse; and he shall sanctify his head that same day.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വീണ്ടും തന്റെ നാസീർ വ്രതത്തിന്റെ കാലം യഹോവെക്കു വേർതിരിച്ചു ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഒരു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ അകൃത്യയാഗമായി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം അവന്റെ നാസീർവ്രതം അശുദ്ധമായിപ്പോയതുകൊണ്ടു മുമ്പിലത്തെ കാലം തള്ളിപ്പോകേണം.
chapters.niv: They must rededicate themselves to the Lord for the same period of dedication and must bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The previous days do not count, because they became defiled during their period of dedication.
chapters.nkjv: He shall consecrate to the Lord the days of his separation, and bring a male lamb in its first year as a trespass offering; but the former days shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
chapters.kjv: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

chapters.ml: വ്രതസ്ഥന്റെ പ്രമാണം ആവിതു: അവന്റെ നാസീർവ്രതത്തിന്റെ കാലം തികയുമ്പോൾ അവനെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite when the period of their dedication is over. They are to be brought to the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite: When the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു വഴിപാടായി ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നു ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ആണാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടി, പാപയാഗത്തിന്നു ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഒരു പെണ്ണാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടി, സമാധാനയാഗത്തിന്നു ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ,
chapters.niv: There they are to present their offerings to the Lord : a year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a year-old ewe lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a fellowship offering,
chapters.nkjv: And he shall present his offering to the Lord: one male lamb in its first year without blemish as a burnt offering, one ewe lamb in its first year without blemish as a sin offering, one ram without blemish as a peace offering,
chapters.kjv: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD , one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

chapters.ml: ഒരു കൊട്ടയിൽ, എണ്ണചേർത്തു നേരിയ മാവുകൊണ്ടുണ്ടാക്കിയ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത ദോശ, എണ്ണപുരട്ടിയ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത വട എന്നിവയും അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗവും പാനീയയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and a basket of bread made with the finest flour and without yeast—thick loaves with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves brushed with olive oil.
chapters.nkjv: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their grain offering with their drink offerings.
chapters.kjv: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അവയെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവന്റെ പാപയാഗവും ഹോമയാഗവും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘The priest is to present all these before the Lord and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest shall bring them before the Lord and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering;
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD , and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ കൊട്ടയിലെ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തോടുകൂടെ യഹോവെക്കു സമാധാന യാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം; പുരോഹിതൻ അതിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗവും പാനീയയാഗവും കൂടെ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He is to present the basket of unleavened bread and is to sacrifice the ram as a fellowship offering to the Lord , together with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.nkjv: and he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of a peace offering to the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest shall also offer its grain offering and its drink offering.
chapters.kjv: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD , with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ വ്രതസ്ഥൻ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽവെച്ചു തന്റെ വ്രതമുള്ള തല ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്തു തന്റെ വ്രതമുള്ള തലമുടി എടുത്തു സമാധാനയാഗത്തിൻ കീഴുള്ള തീയിൽ ഇടേണം;
chapters.niv: " ‘Then at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the Nazirite must shave off the hair that symbolizes their dedication. They are to take the hair and put it in the fire that is under the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Nazirite shall shave his consecrated head at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and shall take the hair from his consecrated head and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offering.
chapters.kjv: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

chapters.ml: വ്രതസ്ഥൻ തന്റെ വ്രതമുള്ള തല ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്തശേഷം പുരോഹിതൻ ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്റെ വേവിച്ച കൈക്കുറകും കൊട്ടയിൽനിന്നു പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ദോശയും പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത ഒരു വടയും എടുത്തു അവയെ വ്രതസ്ഥന്റെ കൈയിൽ വെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘After the Nazirite has shaved off the hair that symbolizes their dedication, the priest is to place in their hands a boiled shoulder of the ram, and one thick loaf and one thin loaf from the basket, both made without yeast.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them upon the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved his consecrated hair,
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അവയെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നീരാജനം ചെയ്യേണം; ഇതു നീരാജനം ചെയ്ത നെഞ്ചോടും ഉദർച്ച ചെയ്ത കൈക്കുറകോടും കൂടെ പുരോഹിതന്നു വേണ്ടി വിശുദ്ധമാകുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം വ്രതസ്ഥന്നു വീഞ്ഞു കുടിക്കാം.
chapters.niv: The priest shall then wave these before the Lord as a wave offering; they are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.
chapters.nkjv: and the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the Lord; they are holy for the priest, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.’
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD : this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

chapters.ml: നാസീർവ്രതം ദീക്ഷിക്കുന്ന വ്രതസ്ഥന്റെയും അവൻ തന്റെ പ്രാപ്തിപോലെ കൊടുക്കുന്നതു കൂടാതെ തന്റെ നാസീർവ്രതം ഹേതുവായി യഹോവെക്കു കഴിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന വഴിപാടിന്റെയും പ്രമാണം ഇതു തന്നേ. അവൻ ദീക്ഷിച്ച വ്രതംപോലെ തന്റെ നാസീർവ്രതത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണത്തിന്നു അനുസരണയായി തന്നേ അവൻ ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows offerings to the Lord in accordance with their dedication, in addition to whatever else they can afford. They must fulfill the vows they have made, according to the law of the Nazirite.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "This is the law of the Nazirite who vows to the Lord the offering for his separation, and besides that, whatever else his hand is able to provide; according to the vow which he takes, so he must do according to the law of his separation."
chapters.kjv: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ അഹരോനോടും പുത്രന്മാരോടും പറയേണ്ടതു: നിങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു ചൊല്ലേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: "Tell Aaron and his sons, ‘This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the way you shall bless the children of Israel. Say to them:
chapters.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു കാക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ;
chapters.niv: " ‘ "The Lord bless you and keep you;
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord bless you and keep you;
chapters.kjv: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തിരുമുഖം നിന്റെ മേൽ പ്രകാശിപ്പിച്ചു നിന്നോടു കൃപയുള്ളവനാകട്ടെ;
chapters.niv: the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you;
chapters.nkjv: The Lord make His face shine upon you, And be gracious to you;
chapters.kjv: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തിരുമുഖം നിന്റെ മേൽ ഉയർത്തി നിനക്കു സമാധാനം നല്കുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace." ’
chapters.nkjv: The Lord lift up His countenance upon you, And give you peace." ’
chapters.kjv: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മേൽ എന്റെ നാമം വെക്കേണം; ഞാൻ അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them."
chapters.nkjv: "So they shall put My name on the children of Israel, and I will bless them."
chapters.kjv: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

chapters.ml: മോശെ തിരുനിവാസം നിവിർത്തുകഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അതും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കയും യാഗപീഠത്തെയും അതിന്റെ സകലപാത്രങ്ങളെയും അഭിഷേകം കഴിച്ചു ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കയും ചെയ്ത ദിവസം
chapters.niv: When Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings. He also anointed and consecrated the altar and all its utensils.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, that he anointed it and consecrated it and all its furnishings, and the altar and all its utensils; so he anointed them and consecrated them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങളിൽ പ്രധാനികളും ഗോത്രപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ മേൽവിചാരകന്മാരും ആയ യിസ്രായേൽപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ വഴിപാടു കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of families who were the tribal leaders in charge of those who were counted, made offerings.
chapters.nkjv: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, who were the leaders of the tribes and over those who were numbered, made an offering.
chapters.kjv: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

chapters.ml: അവർ വഴിപാടായിട്ടു ഈരണ്ടു പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ഓരോ വണ്ടിയും ഓരോരുത്തൻ ഓരോ കാളയും ഇങ്ങനെ കൂടുള്ള ആറു വണ്ടിയും പന്ത്രണ്ടു കാളയും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: They brought as their gifts before the Lord six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two. These they presented before the tabernacle.
chapters.nkjv: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered carts and twelve oxen, a cart for every two of the leaders, and for each one an ox; and they presented them before the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And they brought their offering before the LORD , six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നു അവയെ വാങ്ങുക. അവ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ ഉപയോഗത്തിന്നു ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; അവയെ ലേവ്യരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്നു അവനവന്റെ വേലക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം കൊടുക്കേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in the work at the tent of meeting. Give them to the Levites as each man’s work requires."
chapters.nkjv: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the work of the tabernacle of meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service."
chapters.kjv: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

chapters.ml: മോശെ വണ്ടികളെയും കാളകളെയും വാങ്ങി ലേവ്യർക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses took the carts and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
chapters.kjv: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു വണ്ടിയും നാലു കാളയെയും അവൻ ഗേർശോന്യർക്കു അവരുടെ വേലെക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required,
chapters.nkjv: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service;
chapters.kjv: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

chapters.ml: നാലുവണ്ടിയും എട്ടുകാളയെയും അവൻ മെരാർയ്യർക്കു പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രൻ ഈഥാമാരിന്റെ കൈക്കീഴ് അവർക്കുള്ള വേലെക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: and he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. They were all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.
chapters.nkjv: and four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the authority of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
chapters.kjv: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്യർക്കു അവൻ ഒന്നും കൊടുത്തില്ല; അവരുടെ വേല വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരം സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ളതും തോളിൽ ചുമക്കുന്നതും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were to carry on their shoulders the holy things, for which they were responsible.
chapters.nkjv: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because theirs was the service of the holy things, which they carried on their shoulders.
chapters.kjv: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠം അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്ത ദിവസം പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ പ്രതിഷ്ഠെക്കുള്ള വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ തങ്ങളുടെ വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the altar was anointed, the leaders brought their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Now the leaders offered the dedication offering for the altar when it was anointed; so the leaders offered their offering before the altar.
chapters.kjv: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ പ്രതിഷ്ഠെക്കായി ഓരോ പ്രഭു ഓരോ ദിവസം താന്താന്റെ വഴിപാടു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Each day one leader is to bring his offering for the dedication of the altar."
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord said to Moses, "They shall offer their offering, one leader each day, for the dedication of the altar."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം ദിവസം വഴിപാടു കഴിച്ചവൻ യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ അമ്മീനാദാബിന്റെ മകനായ നഹശോൻ.
chapters.niv: The one who brought his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab of the tribe of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: And the one who offered his offering on the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, from the tribe of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വഴിപാടു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം നൂറ്റിമുപ്പതു ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കമുള്ള ഒരു വെള്ളിത്തളിക, എഴുപതു ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കമുള്ള ഒരു വെള്ളിക്കിണ്ണം - അവ രണ്ടും ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നായി എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത നേരിയ മാവുകൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു -
chapters.niv: His offering was one silver plate weighing a hundred and thirty shekels and one silver sprinkling bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel, each filled with the finest flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering;
chapters.nkjv: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;
chapters.kjv: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

chapters.ml: ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം നിറഞ്ഞതും പത്തു ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കം ഉള്ളതുമായ ഒരു പൊൻകലശം,
chapters.niv: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
chapters.nkjv: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

chapters.kjv: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:

chapters.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels , full of incense:

chapters.nkjv: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb in its first year, as a burnt offering;

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠം അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്ത ദിവസം യിസ്രായേൽ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെ പ്രതിഷ്ഠവഴിപാടു ഇതു ആയിരുന്നു; വെള്ളിത്തളിക പന്ത്രണ്ടു, വെള്ളിക്കിണ്ണം പന്ത്രണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: These were the offerings of the Israelite leaders for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver plates, twelve silver sprinkling bowls and twelve gold dishes.
chapters.nkjv: This was the dedication offering for the altar from the leaders of Israel, when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold pans.
chapters.kjv: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

chapters.ml: പൊൻകലശം പന്ത്രണ്ടു, വെള്ളിത്തളിക ഒന്നിന്നു തൂക്കം നൂറ്റിമുപ്പതു ശേക്കെൽ; കിണ്ണം ഒന്നിന്നു എഴുപതു ശേക്കെൽ; ഇങ്ങനെ വെള്ളിപ്പാത്രങ്ങൾ ആകെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം രണ്ടായിരത്തി നാനൂറു ശേക്കെൽ.
chapters.niv: Each silver plate weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each sprinkling bowl seventy shekels. Altogether, the silver dishes weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
chapters.nkjv: Each silver platter weighed one hundred and thirty shekels and each bowl seventy shekels. All the silver of the vessels weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels , each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary:

chapters.ml: ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം നിറഞ്ഞ പൊൻകലശം പന്ത്രണ്ടു; ഓരോന്നു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തൂക്കപ്രകാരം പത്തു ശേക്കെൽ വീതം കലശങ്ങളുടെ പൊന്നു ആകെ നൂറ്റിരുപതു ശേക്കെൽ.
chapters.niv: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. Altogether, the gold dishes weighed a hundred and twenty shekels.
chapters.nkjv: The twelve gold pans full of incense weighed ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the pans weighed one hundred and twenty shekels.
chapters.kjv: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels .

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള നാൽക്കാലികൾ എല്ലാംകൂടി കാളക്കിടാവു പന്ത്രണ്ടു, ആട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ പന്ത്രണ്ടു, ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള കുഞ്ഞാടു പന്ത്രണ്ടു, അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗം, പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ പന്ത്രണ്ടു;
chapters.niv: The total number of animals for the burnt offering came to twelve young bulls, twelve rams and twelve male lambs a year old, together with their grain offering. Twelve male goats were used for the sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve young bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs in their first year twelve, with their grain offering, and the kids of the goats as a sin offering twelve.
chapters.kjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

chapters.ml: സമാധാനയാഗത്തിന്നായി നാൽക്കാലികൾ എല്ലാംകൂടി കാള ഇരുപത്തിനാലു, ആട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ അറുപതു, കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ അറുപതു, ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള കുഞ്ഞാടു അറുപതു; യാഗപീഠത്തെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തശേഷം അതിന്റെ പ്രതിഷ്ഠെക്കുള്ള വഴിപാടു ഇതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The total number of animals for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering came to twenty-four oxen, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old. These were the offerings for the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.
chapters.nkjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace offerings were twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, and the lambs in their first year sixty. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
chapters.kjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

chapters.ml: മോശെ തിരുമുമ്പിൽ സംസാരിപ്പാൻ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ കടക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകത്തിന്മേലുള്ള കൃപാസനത്തിങ്കൽ നിന്നു രണ്ടു കെരൂബുകളുടെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു തന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്ന തിരുശബ്ദം കേട്ടു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അവനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Moses entered the tent of meeting to speak with the Lord , he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law. In this way the Lord spoke to him.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Moses went into the tabernacle of meeting to speak with Him, he heard the voice of One speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; thus He spoke to him.
chapters.kjv: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ദീപം കൊളുത്തുമ്പോൾ ദീപം ഏഴും നിലവിളക്കിന്റെ മുൻ വശത്തോട്ടു വെളിച്ചംകൊടുക്കേണം എന്നു അഹരോനോടു പറക.
chapters.niv: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, ‘When you set up the lamps, see that all seven light up the area in front of the lampstand.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to Aaron, and say to him, ‘When you arrange the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.’ "
chapters.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

chapters.ml: അഹരോൻ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ അവൻ നിലവിളക്കിന്റെ ദീപം മുൻ വശത്തേക്കു തിരിച്ചുകൊളുത്തി.
chapters.niv: Aaron did so; he set up the lamps so that they faced forward on the lampstand, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And Aaron did so; he arranged the lamps to face toward the front of the lampstand, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: നിലവിളക്കിന്റെ പണിയോ, അതു പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു അടിച്ചുണ്ടാക്കിയതായിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ചുവടുമുതൽ പുഷ്പംവരെ അടിപ്പുപണി തന്നേ; യഹോവ മോശെയെ കാണിച്ച മാതൃകപോലെ തന്നേ അവൻ നിലവിളക്കു ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: This is how the lampstand was made: It was made of hammered gold—from its base to its blossoms. The lampstand was made exactly like the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Now this workmanship of the lampstand was hammered gold; from its shaft to its flowers it was hammered work. According to the pattern which the Lord had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
chapters.kjv: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses:
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു ശുചീകരിക്ക.
chapters.niv: "Take the Levites from among all the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
chapters.nkjv: "Take the Levites from among the children of Israel and cleanse them ceremonially.
chapters.kjv: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

chapters.ml: അവരെ ശുചീകരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യേണം: പാപപരിഹാരജലം അവരുടെ മേൽ തളിക്കേണം; അവർ സർവ്വാംഗം ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്തു വസ്ത്രം അലക്കി ഇങ്ങനെ തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ശുചീകരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: To purify them, do this: Sprinkle the water of cleansing on them; then have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes. And so they will purify themselves.
chapters.nkjv: Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purification on them, and let them shave all their body, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
chapters.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവർ ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും അതിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗമായി എണ്ണചേർത്ത നേരിയ മാവും എടുക്കേണം; പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി നീ വേറെ ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും എടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Have them take a young bull with its grain offering of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; then you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: Then let them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take another young bull as a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ വരുത്തേണം; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സഭയെ മുഴുവനും ഒരുമിച്ചു കൂട്ടേണം.
chapters.niv: Bring the Levites to the front of the tent of meeting and assemble the whole Israelite community.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall bring the Levites before the tabernacle of meeting, and you shall gather together the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ലേവ്യരെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിർത്തേണം; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ലേവ്യരുടെ മേൽ കൈ വെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to bring the Levites before the Lord , and the Israelites are to lay their hands on them.
chapters.nkjv: So you shall bring the Levites before the Lord, and the children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites;
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD : and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ വേല ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അഹരോൻ ലേവ്യരെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ നീരാജനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Aaron is to present the Levites before the Lord as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may be ready to do the work of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lordlike a wave offering from the children of Israel, that they may perform the work of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യർ കാളക്കിടാക്കളുടെ തലയിൽ കൈ വെക്കേണം; പിന്നെ ലേവ്യർക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ യഹോവെക്കു ഒന്നിനെ പാപയാഗമായിട്ടും മറ്റേതിനെ ഹോമയാഗമായിട്ടും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Then the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, using one for a sin offering to the Lord and the other for a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls, and you shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the Lord, to make atonement for the Levites.
chapters.kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD , to make an atonement for the Levites.

chapters.ml: നീ ലേവ്യരെ അഹരോന്റെയും പുത്രന്മാരുടെയും മുമ്പാകെ നിർത്തി യഹോവെക്കു നീരാജനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons and then present them as a wave offering to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: "And you shall stand the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and then offer them like a wave offering to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ലേവ്യരെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു വേർതിരിക്കയും ലേവ്യർ എനിക്കുള്ളവരായിരിക്കയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: In this way you are to set the Levites apart from the other Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.
chapters.nkjv: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
chapters.kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം സമാഗമനക്കുടാരം സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള വേല ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു ലേവ്യർക്കു അടുത്തു ചെല്ലാം; നീ അവരെ ശുചീകരിച്ചു നീരാജനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "After you have purified the Levites and presented them as a wave offering, they are to come to do their work at the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: After that the Levites shall go in to service the tabernacle of meeting. So you shall cleanse them and offer them like a wave offering.
chapters.kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

chapters.ml: അവർ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു എനിക്കു സാക്ഷാൽ ദാനമായുള്ളവർ; എല്ലാ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിലുമുള്ള ആദ്യജാതന്മാർക്കു പകരം ഞാൻ അവരെ എനിക്കായി എടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to me. I have taken them as my own in place of the firstborn, the first male offspring from every Israelite woman.
chapters.nkjv: For they are wholly given to Me from among the children of Israel; I have taken them for Myself instead of all who open the womb, the firstborn of all the children of Israel.
