chapters.kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരിലാകട്ടെ മൃഗങ്ങളിലാകട്ടെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കുള്ള കടിഞ്ഞൂൽ ഒക്കെയും എനിക്കുള്ളതു; ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുള്ള കടിഞ്ഞൂലുകളെ ഒക്കെയും സംഹരിച്ച നാളിൽ അവയെ എനിക്കായി ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Every firstborn male in Israel, whether human or animal, is mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set them apart for myself.
chapters.nkjv: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are Mine, both man and beast; on the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them to Myself.
chapters.kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ഉള്ള എല്ലാ കടിഞ്ഞൂലുകൾക്കും പകരം ഞാൻ ലേവ്യരെ എടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons in Israel.
chapters.nkjv: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്നു അടുത്തു വരുമ്പോൾ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ബാധയുണ്ടാകാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ വേല ചെയ്‍വാനും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിപ്പാനും ലേവ്യരെ ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു അഹരോന്നും പുത്രന്മാർക്കും ദാനം ചെയ്തുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From among all the Israelites, I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons to do the work at the tent of meeting on behalf of the Israelites and to make atonement for them so that no plague will strike the Israelites when they go near the sanctuary."
chapters.nkjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the work for the children of Israel in the tabernacle of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, that there be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near the sanctuary."
chapters.kjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മോശെയും അഹരോനും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സഭ മുഴുവനും ലേവ്യരെക്കുറിച്ചു യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെയൊക്കെയും ലേവ്യർക്കു ചെയ്തു; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അവർക്കു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Moses, Aaron and the whole Israelite community did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel did to the Levites; according to all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
chapters.kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യർ തങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നേ പാപശുദ്ധിവരുത്തി വസ്ത്രം അലക്കി; അഹരോൻ അവരെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നീരാജനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിച്ചു; അവരെ ശുചീകരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അഹരോൻ അവർക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the Lord and made atonement for them to purify them.
chapters.nkjv: And the Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes; then Aaron presented them like a wave offering before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
chapters.kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD ; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം ലേവ്യർ അഹരോന്റെയും പുത്രന്മാരുടെയും മുമ്പാകെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ തങ്ങളുടെ വേലചെയ്‍വാൻ അടുത്തുചെന്നു; യഹോവ ലേവ്യരെക്കുറിച്ചു മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ അവർ അവർക്കു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the tent of meeting under the supervision of Aaron and his sons. They did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: After that the Levites went in to do their work in the tabernacle of meeting before Aaron and his sons; as the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
chapters.kjv: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യർക്കുള്ള പ്രമാണം ആവിതു: ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സുമുതൽ അവർ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിലെ വേലചെയ്യുന്ന സേവയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years old or more shall come to take part in the work at the tent of meeting,
chapters.nkjv: "This is what pertains to the Levites: From twenty-five years old and above one may enter to perform service in the work of the tabernacle of meeting;
chapters.kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

chapters.ml: അമ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതലോ അവർ വേലചെയ്യുന്ന സേവയിൽനിന്നു ഒഴിയേണം; പിന്നെ സേവിക്കേണ്ടാ;
chapters.niv: but at the age of fifty, they must retire from their regular service and work no longer.
chapters.nkjv: and at the age of fifty years they must cease performing this work, and shall work no more.
chapters.kjv: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof , and shall serve no more:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിലെ കാര്യംനോക്കുന്നതിൽ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ സഹായിക്കേണം; വേല ഒന്നും ചെയ്യേണ്ടാ. ലേവ്യരുടെ കാര്യം സംബന്ധിച്ചു നീ ഇങ്ങനെ അവർക്കു ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: They may assist their brothers in performing their duties at the tent of meeting, but they themselves must not do the work. This, then, is how you are to assign the responsibilities of the Levites."
chapters.nkjv: They may minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of meeting, to attend to needs, but they themselves shall do no work. Thus you shall do to the Levites regarding their duties."
chapters.kjv: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

chapters.ml: അവർ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോന്നതിന്റെ രണ്ടാം സംവത്സരം ഒന്നാം മാസം യഹോവ സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord spoke to Moses in the Desert of Sinai in the first month of the second year after they came out of Egypt. He said,
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പെസഹ അതിന്നു നിശ്ചയിച്ച സമയത്തു ആചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Have the Israelites celebrate the Passover at the appointed time.
chapters.nkjv: "Let the children of Israel keep the Passover at its appointed time.
chapters.kjv: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു നിശ്ചയിച്ച സമയമായ ഈ മാസം പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതി വൈകുന്നേരം അതു ആചരിക്കേണം; അതിന്റെ എല്ലാചട്ടങ്ങൾക്കും നിയമങ്ങൾക്കും അനുസരണയായി നിങ്ങൾ അതു ആചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Celebrate it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with all its rules and regulations."
chapters.nkjv: On the fourteenth day of this month, at twilight, you shall keep it at its appointed time. According to all its rites and ceremonies you shall keep it."
chapters.kjv: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

chapters.ml: പെസഹ ആചരിക്കേണമെന്നു മോശെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Moses told the Israelites to celebrate the Passover,
chapters.nkjv: So Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.
chapters.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഒന്നാം മാസം പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതി സന്ധ്യാസമയത്തു സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു പെസഹ ആചരിച്ചു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: and they did so in the Desert of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month, at twilight, in the Wilderness of Sinai; according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.
chapters.kjv: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ ശവത്താൽ അശുദ്ധരായിത്തീർന്നിട്ടു ആ നാളിൽ പെസഹ ആചരിപ്പാൻ കഴിയാത്ത ചിലർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർ അന്നുതന്നേ മോശെയുടെയും അഹരോന്റെയും മുമ്പാകെ വന്നു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: But some of them could not celebrate the Passover on that day because they were ceremonially unclean on account of a dead body. So they came to Moses and Aaron that same day
chapters.nkjv: Now there were certain men who were defiled by a human corpse, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day; and they came before Moses and Aaron that day.
chapters.kjv: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ഒരുത്തന്റെ ശവത്താൽ അശുദ്ധരായിരിക്കുന്നു; നിശ്ചയിക്കപ്പെട്ട സമയത്തു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽ യഹോവയുടെ വഴിപാടു കഴിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഞങ്ങളെ മുടക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and said to Moses, "We have become unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be kept from presenting the Lord ’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?"
chapters.nkjv: And those men said to him, "We became defiled by a human corpse. Why are we kept from presenting the offering of the Lord at its appointed time among the children of Israel?"
chapters.kjv: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

chapters.ml: മോശെ അവരോടു: നില്പിൻ; യഹോവ നിങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു കല്പിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ഞാൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Moses answered them, "Wait until I find out what the Lord commands concerning you."
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said to them, "Stand still, that I may hear what the Lord will command concerning you."
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങളിലോ നിങ്ങളുടെ സന്തതികളിലോ വല്ലവനും ശവത്താൽ അശുദ്ധനാകയോ ദൂരയാത്രയിൽ ആയിരിക്കയോ ചെയ്താലും അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു പെസഹ ആചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Tell the Israelites: ‘When any of you or your descendants are unclean because of a dead body or are away on a journey, they are still to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover,
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If anyone of you or your posterity is unclean because of a corpse, or is far away on a journey, he may still keep the Lord’s Passover.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം മാസം പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതി സന്ധ്യാസമയത്തു അവർ അതു ആചരിച്ചു പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തോടും കൈപ്പുചീരയോടും കൂടെ അതു ഭക്ഷിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: but they are to do it on the fourteenth day of the second month at twilight. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
chapters.nkjv: On the fourteenth day of the second month, at twilight, they may keep it. They shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
chapters.kjv: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs .

chapters.ml: രാവിലത്തേക്കു അതിൽ ഒന്നും ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചുവെക്കരുതു; അതിന്റെ അസ്ഥിയൊന്നും ഒടിക്കയും അരുതു; പെസഹയുടെ ചട്ടപ്രകാരമൊക്കെയും അവർ അതു ആചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: They must not leave any of it till morning or break any of its bones. When they celebrate the Passover, they must follow all the regulations.
chapters.nkjv: They shall leave none of it until morning, nor break one of its bones. According to all the ordinances of the Passover they shall keep it.
chapters.kjv: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശുദ്ധിയുള്ളവനും പ്രയാണത്തിൽ അല്ലാത്തവനുമായ ഒരുത്തൻ പെസഹ ആചരിക്കാതെ വീഴ്ച വരുത്തിയാൽ അവനെ അവന്റെ ജനത്തിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണം; നിശ്ചയിച്ച സമയത്തു യഹോവയുടെ വഴിപാടു കഴിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ തന്റെ പാപം വഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: But if anyone who is ceremonially clean and not on a journey fails to celebrate the Passover, they must be cut off from their people for not presenting the Lord ’s offering at the appointed time. They will bear the consequences of their sin.
chapters.nkjv: But the man who is clean and is not on a journey, and ceases to keep the Passover, that same person shall be cut off from among his people, because he did not bring the offering of the Lord at its appointed time; that man shall bear his sin.
chapters.kjv: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ വന്നുപാർക്കുന്ന ഒരു പരദേശിക്കു യഹോവയുടെ പെസഹ ആചരിക്കേണമെങ്കിൽ പെസഹയുടെ ചട്ടത്തിന്നും നിയമത്തിന്നും അനുസരണയായി അവൻ ആചരിക്കേണം; പരദേശിക്കാകട്ടെ സ്വദേശിക്കാകട്ടെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു ചട്ടം തന്നേ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘A foreigner residing among you is also to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover in accordance with its rules and regulations. You must have the same regulations for both the foreigner and the native-born.’ "
chapters.nkjv: ‘And if a stranger dwells among you, and would keep the Lord’s Passover, he must do so according to the rite of the Passover and according to its ceremony; you shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger and the native of the land.’ "
chapters.kjv: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD ; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസം നിവിർത്തുനിർത്തിയ നാളിൽ മേഘം സാക്ഷ്യകൂടാരമെന്ന തിരുനിവാസത്തെ മൂടി; സന്ധ്യാസമയംതൊട്ടു രാവിലെവരെ അതു തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ അഗ്നിപ്രകാശംപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On the day the tabernacle, the tent of the covenant law, was set up, the cloud covered it. From evening till morning the cloud above the tabernacle looked like fire.
chapters.nkjv: Now on the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the Testimony; from evening until morning it was above the tabernacle like the appearance of fire.
chapters.kjv: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely , the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

chapters.ml: അതു എല്ലായ്പോഴും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു; പകൽ മേഘവും രാത്രി അഗ്നിരൂപവും അതിനെ മൂടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That is how it continued to be; the cloud covered it, and at night it looked like fire.
chapters.nkjv: So it was always: the cloud covered it byday, and the appearance of fire by night.
chapters.kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day , and the appearance of fire by night.

chapters.ml: മേഘം കൂടാരത്തിന്മേൽ നിന്നു പൊങ്ങുമ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടും; മേഘം നില്ക്കുന്നേടത്തു അവർ പാളയമിറങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped.
chapters.nkjv: Whenever the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle, after that the children of Israel would journey; and in the place where the cloud settled, there the children of Israel would pitch their tents.
chapters.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപോലെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടുകയും യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപോലെ പാളയമിറങ്ങുകയും ചെയ്തു; മേഘം തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒക്കെയും അവർ പാളയമടിച്ചു താമസിക്കും,
chapters.niv: At the Lord ’s command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.
chapters.nkjv: At the command of the Lord the children of Israel would journey, and at the command of the Lord they would camp; as long as the cloud stayed above the tabernacle they remained encamped.
chapters.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

chapters.ml: മേഘം തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ ഏറെനാൾ ഇരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യാത്രപുറപ്പെടാതെ യഹോവയുടെ ആജ്ഞ കാത്തുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: When the cloud remained over the tabernacle a long time, the Israelites obeyed the Lord ’s order and did not set out.
chapters.nkjv: Even when the cloud continued long, many days above the tabernacle, the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord and did not journey.
chapters.kjv: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD , and journeyed not.

chapters.ml: ചിലപ്പോൾ മേഘം തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ കുറെനാൾ ഇരിക്കും; അപ്പോൾ അവർ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപോലെ പാളയമിറങ്ങിയിരിക്കും; പിന്നെ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പന പോലെ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: Sometimes the cloud was over the tabernacle only a few days; at the Lord ’s command they would encamp, and then at his command they would set out.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the cloud was above the tabernacle a few days: according to the command of the Lord they would remain encamped, and according to the command of the Lord they would journey.
chapters.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.

chapters.ml: ചിലപ്പോൾ മേഘം സന്ധ്യമുതൽ ഉഷസ്സുവരെ ഇരിക്കും; ഉഷഃകാലത്തു മേഘം പൊങ്ങി എങ്കിൽ അവർ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടും. ചിലപ്പോൾ പകലും രാവും ഇരിക്കും; പിന്നെ മേഘം പൊങ്ങിയെങ്കിൽ അവർ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening till morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they set out. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud lifted, they set out.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the cloud remained only from evening until morning: when the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they would journey; whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud was taken up, they would journey.
chapters.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു ദിവസമോ ഒരു മാസമോ ഒരു സംവത്സരമോ മേഘം തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽ ആവസിച്ചിരുന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പുറപ്പെടാതെ പാളയമടിച്ചു താമസിക്കും; അതു പൊങ്ങുമ്പോഴോ അവർ പുറപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a year, the Israelites would remain in camp and not set out; but when it lifted, they would set out.
chapters.nkjv: Whetheritwas two days, a month, or a year that the cloud remained above the tabernacle, the children of Israel would remain encamped and not journey; but when it was taken up, they would journey.
chapters.kjv: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപോലെ അവർ പാളയമിറങ്ങുകയും യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപോലെ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്യും; മോശെമുഖാന്തരം യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർ യഹോവയുടെ ആജ്ഞ പ്രമാണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At the Lord ’s command they encamped, and at the Lord ’s command they set out. They obeyed the Lord ’s order, in accordance with his command through Moses.
chapters.nkjv: At the command of the Lord they remained encamped, and at the command of the Lord they journeyed; they kept the charge of the Lord, at the command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
chapters.kjv: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD , at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses:
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: വെള്ളികൊണ്ടു രണ്ടു കാഹളം ഉണ്ടാക്കുക; അടിപ്പു പണിയായി അവയെ ഉണ്ടാക്കേണം; അവ നിനക്കു സഭയെ വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടുവാനും പാളയത്തെ പുറപ്പെടുവിപ്പാനും ഉതകേണം.
chapters.niv: "Make two trumpets of hammered silver, and use them for calling the community together and for having the camps set out.
chapters.nkjv: "Make two silver trumpets for yourself; you shall make them of hammered work; you shall use them for calling the congregation and for directing the movement of the camps.
chapters.kjv: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

chapters.ml: അവ ഊതുമ്പോൾ സഭ മുഴുവനും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂടേണം.
chapters.niv: When both are sounded, the whole community is to assemble before you at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: When they blow both of them, all the congregation shall gather before you at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: ഒരു കാഹളം മാത്രം ഊതിയാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരായ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂടേണം.
chapters.niv: If only one is sounded, the leaders—the heads of the clans of Israel—are to assemble before you.
chapters.nkjv: But if they blow only one, then the leaders, the heads of the divisions of Israel, shall gather to you.
chapters.kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet , then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

chapters.ml: ഗംഭീരധ്വനി ഊതുമ്പോൾ കിഴക്കെ പാളയങ്ങൾ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടേണം.
chapters.niv: When a trumpet blast is sounded, the tribes camping on the east are to set out.
chapters.nkjv: When you sound the advance, the camps that lie on the east side shall then begin their journey.
chapters.kjv: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം പ്രാവശ്യം ഗംഭീരധ്വനി ഊതുമ്പോൾ തെക്കെ പാളയങ്ങൾ യാത്രപുറപ്പെടേണം; ഇങ്ങനെ ഇവരുടെ പുറപ്പാടുകൾക്കായി ഗംഭീരധ്വനി ഊതേണം:
chapters.niv: At the sounding of a second blast, the camps on the south are to set out. The blast will be the signal for setting out.
chapters.nkjv: When you sound the advance the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall begin their journey; they shall sound the call for them to begin their journeys.
chapters.kjv: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

chapters.ml: സഭയെ കൂട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു ഊതുമ്പോൾ ഗംഭീരധ്വനി ഊതരുതു.
chapters.niv: To gather the assembly, blow the trumpets, but not with the signal for setting out.
chapters.nkjv: And when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but not sound the advance.
chapters.kjv: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ആകുന്നു കാഹളം ഊതേണ്ടതു; ഇതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു തലമുറതലമുറയായി എന്നേക്കുമുള്ള ചട്ടം ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to blow the trumpets. This is to be a lasting ordinance for you and the generations to come.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and these shall be to you as an ordinance forever throughout your generations.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ദേശത്തു നിങ്ങളെ ഞെരുക്കുന്ന ശത്രുവിന്റെ നേരെ നിങ്ങൾ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പോകുമ്പോൾ ഗംഭീരധ്വനിയായി കാഹളം ഊതേണം; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിങ്ങളെ ഓർത്തു ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: When you go into battle in your own land against an enemy who is oppressing you, sound a blast on the trumpets. Then you will be remembered by the Lord your God and rescued from your enemies.
chapters.nkjv: "When you go to war in your land against the enemy who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the Lord your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
chapters.kjv: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സന്തോഷദിവസങ്ങളിലും ഉത്സവങ്ങളിലും മാസാരംഭങ്ങളിലും നിങ്ങൾ ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും കഴിക്കുമ്പോൾ കാഹളം ഊതേണം; അവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ജ്ഞാപകമായിരിക്കും; യഹോവയായ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Also at your times of rejoicing—your appointed festivals and New Moon feasts—you are to sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, and they will be a memorial for you before your God. I am the Lord your God."
chapters.nkjv: Also in the day of your gladness, in your appointed feasts, and at the beginning of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be a memorial for you before your God: I am the Lord your God."
chapters.kjv: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം രണ്ടാം സംവത്സരം രണ്ടാം മാസം ഇരുപതാം തിയ്യതി മേഘം സാക്ഷ്യനിവാസത്തിന്മേൽനിന്നു പൊങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle of the covenant law.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle of the Testimony.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ടു; മേഘം പാറാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Israelites set out from the Desert of Sinai and traveled from place to place until the cloud came to rest in the Desert of Paran.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel set out from the Wilderness of Sinai on their journeys; then the cloud settled down in the Wilderness of Paran.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെമുഖാന്തരം കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർ ഇങ്ങനെ ആദ്യമായി യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They set out, this first time, at the Lord ’s command through Moses.
chapters.nkjv: So they started out for the first time according to the command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
chapters.kjv: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ള പാളയം ഗണംഗണമായി ആദ്യം പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവരുടെ സേനാപതി അമ്മീനാദാബിന്റെ മകൻ നഹശോൻ.
chapters.niv: The divisions of the camp of Judah went first, under their standard. Nahshon son of Amminadab was in command.
chapters.nkjv: The standard of the camp of the children of Judah set out first according to their armies; over their army was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
chapters.kjv: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാർമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി സൂവാരിന്റെ മകൻ നെഥനയേൽ.
chapters.niv: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
chapters.nkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂൻ മക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി ഹേലോന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാബ്.
chapters.niv: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
chapters.nkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ തിരുനിവാസം അഴിച്ചു താഴ്ത്തി; ഗേർശോന്യരും മെരാർയ്യരും തിരുനിവാസം ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites, who carried it, set out.
chapters.nkjv: Then the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set out, carrying the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രൂബേന്റെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ള പാളയം ഗണംഗണമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവരുടെ സേനാപതി ശെദേയൂരിന്റെ മകൻ എലീസൂർ.
chapters.niv: The divisions of the camp of Reuben went next, under their standard. Elizur son of Shedeur was in command.
chapters.nkjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set out according to their armies; over their army was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
chapters.kjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോൻമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി സൂരിശദ്ദായിയുടെ മകൻ ശെലൂമിയേൽ.
chapters.niv: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
chapters.nkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

chapters.ml: ഗാദ് മക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി ദെയൂവേലിന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാസാഫ്.
chapters.niv: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
chapters.nkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ കെഹാത്യർ വിശുദ്ധസാധനങ്ങൾ ചമന്നുകൊണ്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; ഇവർ എത്തുമ്പോഴേക്കു തിരുനിവാസം നിവിർത്തുകഴിയും.
chapters.niv: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. The tabernacle was to be set up before they arrived.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. (The tabernacle would be prepared for their arrival.)
chapters.kjv: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ എഫ്രയീംമക്കളുടെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ള പാളയം ഗണംഗണമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവരുടെ സേനാപതി അമ്മീഹൂദിന്റെ മകൻ എലീശാമാ.
chapters.niv: The divisions of the camp of Ephraim went next, under their standard. Elishama son of Ammihud was in command.
chapters.nkjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set out according to their armies; over their army was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
chapters.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി പെദാസൂരിന്റെ മകൻ ഗമലീയേൽ.
chapters.niv: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
chapters.nkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി ഗിദെയോനിയുടെ മകൻ അബീദാൻ.
chapters.niv: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
chapters.nkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരുടെ എല്ലാപാളയങ്ങളിലും ഒടുവിലത്തേതായിരുന്ന ദാൻമക്കളുടെ കൊടിക്കീഴുള്ള പാളയം ഗണംഗണമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവരുടെ സേനാപതി അമ്മീശദ്ദായിയുടെ മകനായ അഹീയേസേർ.
chapters.niv: Finally, as the rear guard for all the units, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was in command.
chapters.nkjv: Then the standard of the camp of the children of Dan (the rear guard of all the camps) set out according to their armies; over their army was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
chapters.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

chapters.ml: ആശേർമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി ഒക്രാന്റെ മകൻ പഗീയേൽ.
chapters.niv: Pagiel son of Okran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
chapters.nkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ സേനാപതി ഏനാന്റെ മകൻ അഹീര.
chapters.niv: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
chapters.nkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
chapters.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ ഗണംഗണമായുള്ള അവരുടെ യാത്ര ഇങ്ങനെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
chapters.nkjv: Thus was the order of march of the children of Israel, according to their armies, when they began their journey.
chapters.kjv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മോശെ തന്റെ അമ്മായപ്പനായ രെയൂവേൽ എന്ന മിദ്യാനന്റെ മകനായ ഹോബാബിനോടു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഞാൻ തരുമെന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത ദേശത്തേക്കു ഞങ്ങൾ യാത്രചെയ്യുന്നു; യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു നന്മ ചൊല്ലിയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു നീ ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ വരിക; ഞങ്ങൾ നിനക്കു നന്മചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place about which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will treat you well, for the Lord has promised good things to Israel."
chapters.nkjv: Now Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place of which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the Lord has promised good things to Israel."
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: ഞാൻ വരുന്നില്ല; എന്റെ സ്വദേശത്തേക്കും ചാർച്ചക്കാരുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കും ഞാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He answered, "No, I will not go; I am going back to my own land and my own people."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to him, "I will not go, but I will depart to my own land and to my relatives."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞങ്ങളെ വിട്ടുപോകരുതേ; മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ പാളയമിറങ്ങേണ്ടതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നു; നീ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു കണ്ണായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But Moses said, "Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses said, "Please do not leave, inasmuch as you know how we are to camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പോന്നാൽ യഹോവ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ചെയ്യുന്ന നന്മപോലെ തന്നേ ഞങ്ങൾ നിനക്കും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the Lord gives us."
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be, if you go with us—indeed it shall be—that whatever good the Lord will do to us, the same we will do to you."
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ യഹോവയുടെ പർവ്വതം വിട്ടു മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി പോയി; യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം അവർക്കു വിശ്രാമസ്ഥലം അന്വേഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി മുമ്പോട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: So they set out from the mountain of the Lord and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest.
chapters.nkjv: So they departed from the mountain of the Lord on a journey of three days; and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them for the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.
chapters.kjv: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.

chapters.ml: പാളയം പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ മേഘം പകൽ സമയം അവർക്കു മീതെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The cloud of the Lord was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
chapters.nkjv: And the cloud of the Lordwas above them by day when they went out from the camp.
chapters.kjv: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടകം പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ മോശെ: യഹോവേ, എഴുന്നേൽക്കേണമേ; നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾ ചിതറുകയും നിന്നെ പകെക്കുന്നവർ നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോകയും ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു പറയും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the ark set out, Moses said, "Rise up, Lord ! May your enemies be scattered; may your foes flee before you."
chapters.nkjv: So it was, whenever the ark set out, that Moses said: "Rise up, O Lord! Let Your enemies be scattered, And let those who hate You flee before You."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD , and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

chapters.ml: അതു വിശ്രമിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ: യഹോവേ, അനേകായിരമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവരേണമേ എന്നു പറയും.
chapters.niv: Whenever it came to rest, he said, "Return, Lord , to the countless thousands of Israel."
chapters.nkjv: And when it rested, he said: "Return, O Lord, To the many thousands of Israel."
chapters.kjv: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD , unto the many thousands of Israel.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ജനം യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടം തോന്നുമാറു പിറുപിറുത്തു; യഹോവ കേട്ടു അവന്റെ കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചു; യഹോവയുടെ തീ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ കത്തി പാളയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റങ്ങളിലുള്ളവരെ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now the people complained about their hardships in the hearing of the Lord , and when he heard them his anger was aroused. Then fire from the Lord burned among them and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the people complained, it displeased the Lord; for the Lord heard it, and His anger was aroused. So the fire of the Lord burned among them, and consumed some in the outskirts of the camp.
chapters.kjv: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD : and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

chapters.ml: ജനം മോശെയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു; മോശെ യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു: അപ്പോൾ തീ കെട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When the people cried out to Moses, he prayed to the Lord and the fire died down.
chapters.nkjv: Then the people cried out to Moses, and when Moses prayed to the Lord, the fire was quenched.
chapters.kjv: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD , the fire was quenched.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ തീ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ കത്തുകയാൽ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു തബേരാ എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: So that place was called Taberah, because fire from the Lord had burned among them.
chapters.nkjv: So he called the name of the place Taberah, because the fire of the Lord had burned among them.
chapters.kjv: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരുടെ ഇടയിലുള്ള സമ്മിശ്രജാതി ദുരാഗ്രഹികളായി, യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളും വീണ്ടും കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തിന്മാൻ ഇറച്ചി ആർ തരും?
chapters.niv: The rabble with them began to crave other food, and again the Israelites started wailing and said, "If only we had meat to eat!
chapters.nkjv: Now the mixed multitude who were among them yielded to intense craving; so the children of Israel also wept again and said: "Who will give us meat to eat?
chapters.kjv: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ മിസ്രയീമിൽ വെച്ചു വിലകൂടാതെ തിന്നിട്ടുള്ള മത്സ്യം, വെള്ളരിക്കാ, മത്തെങ്ങാ, ഉള്ളി, ചുവന്നുള്ളി, ചിറ്റുള്ളി എന്നിവ ഞങ്ങൾ ഓർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt at no cost—also the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic.
chapters.nkjv: We remember the fish which we ate freely in Egypt, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic;
chapters.kjv: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴോ ഞങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാണൻ പൊരിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; ഈ മന്നാ അല്ലാതെ ഒന്നും കാണ്മാനില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But now we have lost our appetite; we never see anything but this manna!"
chapters.nkjv: but now our whole being is dried up; thereis nothing at all except this manna before our eyes!"
chapters.kjv: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

chapters.ml: മന്നയോ കൊത്തമ്പാലരിപോലെയും അതിന്റെ നിറം ഗുല്ഗുലുവിന്റേതുപോലെയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The manna was like coriander seed and looked like resin.
chapters.nkjv: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its color like the color of bdellium.
chapters.kjv: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

chapters.ml: ജനം നടന്നു പെറുക്കി തിരികല്ലിൽ പൊടിച്ചിട്ടോ ഉരലിൽ ഇടിച്ചിട്ടോ കലത്തിൽ പുഴുങ്ങി അപ്പം ഉണ്ടാക്കും. അതിന്റെ രുചി എണ്ണചേർത്തുണ്ടാക്കിയ ദോശപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The people went around gathering it, and then ground it in a hand mill or crushed it in a mortar. They cooked it in a pot or made it into loaves. And it tasted like something made with olive oil.
chapters.nkjv: The people went about and gathered it, ground it on millstones or beat it in the mortar, cooked it in pans, and made cakes of it; and its taste was like the taste of pastry prepared with oil.
chapters.kjv: And the people went about, and gathered it , and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

chapters.ml: രാത്രി പാളയത്തിൽ മഞ്ഞു പൊഴിയുമ്പോൾ മന്നയും പൊഴിയും.
chapters.niv: When the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna also came down.
chapters.nkjv: And when the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
chapters.kjv: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

chapters.ml: ജനം കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ കൂടാരവാതിൽക്കൽവെച്ചു കരയുന്നതു മോശെ കേട്ടു; യഹോവയുടെ കോപം ഏറ്റവും ജ്വലിച്ചു; മോശെക്കും അനിഷ്ടമായി.
chapters.niv: Moses heard the people of every family wailing at the entrance to their tents. The Lord became exceedingly angry, and Moses was troubled.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, everyone at the door of his tent; and the anger of the Lord was greatly aroused; Moses also was displeased.
chapters.kjv: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ യഹോവയോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ അടിയനെ വലെച്ചതു എന്തു? നിനക്കു എന്നോടു കൃപ തോന്നാതെ ഈ സർവ്വജനത്തിന്റെയും ഭാരം എന്റെമേൽ വെച്ചതെന്തു?
chapters.niv: He asked the Lord , "Why have you brought this trouble on your servant? What have I done to displease you that you put the burden of all these people on me?
chapters.nkjv: So Moses said to the Lord, "Why have You afflicted Your servant? And why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid the burden of all these people on me?
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

chapters.ml: മുലകുടിക്കുന്ന കുഞ്ഞിനെ ഒരു ധാത്രി എടുക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഞാൻ അവരെ നീ അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു സത്യം ചെയ്ത ദേശത്തേക്കു എന്റെ മാറത്തെടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു പോകേണമെന്നു എന്നോടു കല്പിപ്പാൻ ഈ ജനത്തെ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചുവോ? ഞാൻ അവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചുവോ?
chapters.niv: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their ancestors?
chapters.nkjv: Did I conceive all these people? Did I beget them, that You should say to me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a guardian carries a nursing child,’ to the land which You swore to their fathers?
chapters.kjv: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

chapters.ml: ഈ ജനത്തിന്നു ഒക്കെയും കൊടുപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു എവിടെനിന്നു ഇറച്ചി കിട്ടും? അവർ ഇതാ: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തിന്മാൻ ഇറച്ചി തരിക എന്നു എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു കരയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Where can I get meat for all these people? They keep wailing to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
chapters.nkjv: Where am I to get meat to give to all these people? For they weep all over me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
chapters.kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

chapters.ml: ഏകനായി ഈ സർവ്വജനത്തെയും വഹിപ്പാൻ എന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു കഴിയുന്നതല്ല; അതു എനിക്കു അതിഭാരം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.
chapters.nkjv: I am not able to bear all these people alone, because the burden is too heavy for me.
chapters.kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ എന്നോടു ചെയ്യുന്ന പക്ഷം ദയവിചാരിച്ചു എന്നെ കൊന്നുകളയേണമേ. എന്റെ അരിഷ്ടത ഞാൻ കാണരുതേ.
chapters.niv: If this is how you are going to treat me, please go ahead and kill me—if I have found favor in your eyes—and do not let me face my own ruin."
chapters.nkjv: If You treat me like this, please kill me here and now—if I have found favor in Your sight—and do not let me see my wretchedness!"
chapters.kjv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരിൽവെച്ചു ജനത്തിന്നു പ്രമാണികളും മേൽവിചാരകന്മാരും എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്ന എഴുപതു പുരുഷന്മാരെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്നരികെ നിന്നോടു കൂടെ നിൽക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വരിക.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses: "Bring me seventy of Israel’s elders who are known to you as leaders and officials among the people. Have them come to the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with you.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord said to Moses: "Gather to Me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; bring them to the tabernacle of meeting, that they may stand there with you.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ഞാൻ ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു നിന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യും; ഞാൻ നിന്റെമേലുള്ള ആത്മാവിൽ കുറെ എടുത്തു അവരുടെ മേൽ പകരും. നീ ഏകനായി വഹിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഭാരം വഹിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the power of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them. They will share the burden of the people with you so that you will not have to carry it alone.
chapters.nkjv: Then I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit that is upon you and will put thesame upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you may not bear it yourself alone.
chapters.kjv: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനത്തോടു നീ പറയേണ്ടതു: നാളത്തേക്കു നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിപ്പിൻ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഇറച്ചി തിന്നും; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തിന്മാൻ ഇറച്ചി ആർ തരും? മിസ്രയീമിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു നന്നായിരുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞു യഹോവ കേൾക്കെ കരഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ; ആകയാൽ യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഇറച്ചി തരികയും നിങ്ങൾ തിന്നുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: "Tell the people: ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The Lord heard you when you wailed, "If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the Lord will give you meat, and you will eat it.
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall say to the people, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat; for you have wept in the hearing of the Lord, saying, "Who will give us meat to eat? For itwas well with us in Egypt." Therefore the Lord will give you meat, and you shall eat.
chapters.kjv: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD , saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദിവസമല്ല, രണ്ടു ദിവസമല്ല, അഞ്ചു ദിവസമല്ല, പത്തു ദിവസമല്ല, ഇരുപതു ദിവസവുമല്ല, ഒരു മാസം മുഴുവനും തന്നേ;
chapters.niv: You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days,
chapters.nkjv: You shall eat, not one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days,
chapters.kjv: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

chapters.ml: അതു നിങ്ങളുടെ മൂക്കിൽകൂടി പുറപ്പെട്ടു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഓക്കാനം വരുവോളം നിങ്ങൾ തിന്നും; നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഉള്ള യഹോവയെ നിങ്ങൾ നിരസിക്കയും: ഞങ്ങൾ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു എന്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കരകയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it—because you have rejected the Lord , who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?" ’ "
chapters.nkjv: but for a whole month, until it comes out of your nostrils and becomes loathsome to you, because you have despised the Lord who is among you, and have wept before Him, saying, "Why did we ever come up out of Egypt?" ’ "
chapters.kjv: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ: എന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള ജനം ആറുലക്ഷം കാലാൾ ഉണ്ടു; ഒരു മാസം മുഴുവൻ തിന്മാൻ ഞാൻ അവർക്കു ഇറച്ചി കൊടുക്കുമെന്നു നീ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Moses said, "Here I am among six hundred thousand men on foot, and you say, ‘I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!’
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said, "The people whom I am among are six hundred thousand men on foot; yet You have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat for a whole month.’
chapters.kjv: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am , are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു മതിയാകുംവണ്ണം ആടുകളെയും മാടുകളെയും അവർക്കുവേണ്ടി അറുക്കുമോ? അവർക്കു മതിയാകുംവണ്ണം സമുദ്രത്തിലെ മത്സ്യത്തെ ഒക്കെയും അവർക്കു വേണ്ടി പിടിച്ചുകൂട്ടുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Would they have enough if flocks and herds were slaughtered for them? Would they have enough if all the fish in the sea were caught for them?"
chapters.nkjv: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to provide enough for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to provide enough for them?"
chapters.kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: യഹോവയുടെ കൈ കുറുതായിപ്പോയോ? എന്റെ വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാകുമോ ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു നീ ഇപ്പോൾ കാണും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord answered Moses, "Is the Lord ’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not what I say will come true for you."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Has the Lord’s arm been shortened? Now you shall see whether what I say will happen to you or not."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മോശെ ചെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ വചനങ്ങളെ ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞു, ജനത്തിന്റെ മൂപ്പന്മാരിൽ എഴുപതു പുരുഷന്മാരെ കൂട്ടി കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലും നിറുത്തി.
chapters.niv: So Moses went out and told the people what the Lord had said. He brought together seventy of their elders and had them stand around the tent.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses went out and told the people the words of the Lord, and he gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people and placed them around the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യഹോവ ഒരു മേഘത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങി അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു, അവന്മേലുള്ള ആത്മാവിൽ കുറെ എടുത്തു മൂപ്പന്മാരായ ആ എഴുപതു പുരുഷന്മാർക്കു കൊടുത്തു; ആത്മാവു അവരുടെ മേൽ ആവസിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ പ്രവചിച്ചു; പിന്നെ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took some of the power of the Spirit that was on him and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but did not do so again.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him, and placed thesame upon the seventy elders; and it happened, when the Spirit rested upon them, that they prophesied, although they never did so again.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that , when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആ പുരഷന്മാരിൽ രണ്ടു പേർ പാളയത്തിൽ തന്നേ താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു; ഒരുത്തന്നു എൽദാദ് എന്നും മറ്റവന്നു മേദാദ് എന്നും പേർ. ആത്മാവു അവരുടെമേലും ആവസിച്ചു; അവരും പേരെഴുതിയവരിൽ ഉള്ളവർ ആയിരുന്നു എങ്കിലും കൂടാരത്തിലേക്കു ചെന്നിരുന്നില്ല; അവർ പാളയത്തിൽ വെച്ചു പ്രവചിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.
chapters.nkjv: But two men had remained in the camp: the name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad. And the Spirit rested upon them. Now they were among those listed, but who had not gone out to the tabernacle; yet they prophesied in the camp.
chapters.kjv: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരൻ മോശെയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു: എൽദാദും മേദാദും പാളയത്തിൽവെച്ചു പ്രവചിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A young man ran and told Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
chapters.nkjv: And a young man ran and told Moses, and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
chapters.kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ നൂന്റെ മകനായി ബാല്യംമുതൽ മോശെയുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരനായിരുന്ന യോശുവ: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ മോശെയേ, അവരെ വിരോധിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses’ aide since youth, spoke up and said, "Moses, my lord, stop them!"
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, one of his choice men, answered and said, "Moses my lord, forbid them!"
chapters.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അവനോടു: എന്നെ വിചാരിച്ചു നീ അസൂയപ്പെടുന്നുവോ? യഹോവയുടെ ജനം ഒക്കെയും പ്രവാചകന്മാരാകയും യഹോവ തന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെ അവരുടെമേൽ പകരുകയും ചെയ്തെങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Moses replied, "Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the Lord ’s people were prophets and that the Lord would put his Spirit on them!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses said to him, "Are you zealous for my sake? Oh, that all the Lord’s people were prophets and that the Lord would put His Spirit upon them!"
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD’s people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മോശെയും യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരും പാളയത്തിൽ വന്നു ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses returned to the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ അയച്ച ഒരു കാറ്റു ഊതി കടലിൽനിന്നു കാടയെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പാളയത്തിന്റെ സമീപത്തു ഒരു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി ഇങ്ങോട്ടും ഒരു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി അങ്ങോട്ടും ഇങ്ങനെ പാളയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലും നിലത്തോടു ഏകദേശം രണ്ടു മുഴം അടുത്തു പറന്നുനില്ക്കുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Now a wind went out from the Lord and drove quail in from the sea. It scattered them up to two cubits deep all around the camp, as far as a day’s walk in any direction.
chapters.nkjv: Now a wind went out from the Lord, and it brought quail from the sea and left them fluttering near the camp, about a day’s journey on this side and about a day’s journey on the other side, all around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the ground.
chapters.kjv: And there went forth a wind from the LORD , and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

chapters.ml: ജനം എഴുന്നേറ്റു അന്നു പകൽ മുഴുവനും രാത്രി മുഴുവനും പിറ്റെന്നാൾ മുഴുവനും കാടയെ പിടിച്ചു കൂട്ടി; നന്നാ കുറെച്ചു പിടിച്ചവൻ പത്തു പറ പിടിച്ചുകൂട്ടി; അവർ അവയെ പാളയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലും ചിക്കി.
chapters.niv: All that day and night and all the next day the people went out and gathered quail. No one gathered less than ten homers. Then they spread them out all around the camp.
chapters.nkjv: And the people stayed up all that day, all night, and all the next day, and gathered the quail (he who gathered least gathered ten homers); and they spread them out for themselves all around the camp.
chapters.kjv: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇറച്ചി അവരുടെ പല്ലിന്നിടയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അതു ചവെച്ചിറക്കും മുമ്പെ തന്നേ യഹോവയുടെ കോപം ജനത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു, യഹോവ ജനത്തെ ഒരു മഹാബാധകൊണ്ടു സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But while the meat was still between their teeth and before it could be consumed, the anger of the Lord burned against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.
chapters.nkjv: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was aroused against the people, and the Lord struck the people with a very great plague.
chapters.kjv: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.

chapters.ml: ദുരാഗ്രഹികളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തെ അവിടെ കുഴിച്ചിട്ടതുകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു കിബ്രോത്ത്-ഹത്താവ എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: Therefore the place was named Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
chapters.nkjv: So he called the name of that place Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had yielded to craving.
chapters.kjv: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

chapters.ml: കിബ്രോത്ത്-ഹത്താവ വിട്ടു ജനം ഹസേരോത്തിലേക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ചെന്നു ഹസേരോത്തിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.
chapters.nkjv: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people moved to Hazeroth, and camped at Hazeroth.
chapters.kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

chapters.ml: മോശെ ഒരു കൂശ്യസ്ത്രീയെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്തിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു കൂശ്യസ്ത്രീനിമിത്തം മിർയ്യാമും അഹരോനും അവന്നു വിരോധമായി സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses because of his Cushite wife, for he had married a Cushite.
chapters.nkjv: Then Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married; for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
chapters.kjv: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെ മുഖാന്തരം മാത്രമേ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ളുവോ? ഞങ്ങൾ മുഖാന്തരവും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; യഹോവ അതു കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: "Has the Lord spoken only through Moses?" they asked. "Hasn’t he also spoken through us?" And the Lord heard this.
chapters.nkjv: So they said, "Has the Lord indeed spoken only through Moses? Has He not spoken through us also?" And the Lord heard it.
chapters.kjv: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it .

chapters.ml: മോശെ എന്ന പുരുഷനോ ഭൂതലത്തിൽ ഉള്ള സകലമനുഷ്യരിലും അതിസൌമ്യനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Now Moses was a very humble man, more humble than anyone else on the face of the earth.)
chapters.nkjv: (Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all men who were on the face of the earth.)
chapters.kjv: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു യഹോവ മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും മിർയ്യാമിനോടും: നിങ്ങൾ മൂവരും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിങ്കൽ വരുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; അവർ മൂവരും ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: At once the Lord said to Moses, Aaron and Miriam, "Come out to the tent of meeting, all three of you." So the three of them went out.
chapters.nkjv: Suddenly the Lord said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, "Come out, you three, to the tabernacle of meeting!" So the three came out.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മേഘസ്തംഭത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങി കൂടാരവാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു അഹരോനെയും മിർയ്യാമിനെയും വിളിച്ചു; അവർ ഇരുവരും അങ്ങോട്ടു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud; he stood at the entrance to the tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When the two of them stepped forward,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord came down in the pillar of cloud and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam. And they both went forward.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: എന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെ കേൾപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ യഹോവയായ ഞാൻ അവന്നു ദർശനത്തിൽ എന്നെ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുകയും സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: he said, "Listen to my words: "When there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord , reveal myself to them in visions, I speak to them in dreams.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said, "Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord, make Myself known to him in a vision; I speak to him in a dream.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെയോ അങ്ങനെയല്ല; അവൻ എന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും വിശ്വസ്തൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house.
chapters.nkjv: Not so with My servant Moses; He is faithful in all My house.
chapters.kjv: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു ഞാൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു മറപൊരുളായിട്ടല്ല അഭിമുഖമായിട്ടും സ്പഷ്ടമായിട്ടും അത്രേ; അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ രൂപം കാണുകയും ചെയ്യും. അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെക്കു വിരോധമായി സംസാരിപ്പാൻ ശങ്കിക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the Lord . Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?"
chapters.nkjv: I speak with him face to face, Even plainly, and not in dark sayings; And he sees the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid To speak against My servant Moses?"
chapters.kjv: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കോപം അവരുടെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു അവൻ മറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The anger of the Lord burned against them, and he left them.
chapters.nkjv: So the anger of the Lord was aroused against them, and He departed.
chapters.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

chapters.ml: മേഘവും കൂടാരത്തിന്മേൽ നിന്നു നീങ്ങിപ്പോയി. മിർയ്യാം ഹിമംപോലെ വെളുത്തു കുഷ്ഠരോഗിണിയായി; അഹരോൻ മിർയ്യാമിനെ നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ അവൾ കുഷ്ടരോഗിണി എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the cloud lifted from above the tent, Miriam’s skin was leprous —it became as white as snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had a defiling skin disease,
chapters.nkjv: And when the cloud departed from above the tabernacle, suddenly Miriam became leprous, as whiteas snow. Then Aaron turned toward Miriam, and there she was, a leper.
chapters.kjv: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

chapters.ml: അഹരോൻ മോശെയോടു: അയ്യോ യജമാനനേ, ഞങ്ങൾ ഭോഷത്വമായി ചെയ്തുപോയ ഈ പാപം ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെക്കരുതേ.
chapters.niv: and he said to Moses, "Please, my lord, I ask you not to hold against us the sin we have so foolishly committed.
chapters.nkjv: So Aaron said to Moses, "Oh, my lord! Please do not lay this sin on us, in which we have done foolishly and in which we have sinned.
chapters.kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

chapters.ml: അമ്മയുടെ ഗർഭത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ മാംസം പകുതി അഴുകിയിരിക്കുന്ന ചാപിള്ളയെപ്പോലെ ഇവൾ ആകരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Do not let her be like a stillborn infant coming from its mother’s womb with its flesh half eaten away."
chapters.nkjv: Please do not let her be as one dead, whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb!"
chapters.kjv: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ യഹോവയോടു: ദൈവമേ, അവളെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കേണമേ എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Moses cried out to the Lord , "Please, God, heal her!"
chapters.nkjv: So Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, "Please heal her, O God, I pray!"
chapters.kjv: And Moses cried unto the LORD , saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: അവളുടെ അപ്പൻ അവളുടെ മുഖത്തു തുപ്പിയെങ്കിൽ അവൾ ഏഴുദിവസം ലജ്ജിച്ചിരിക്കയില്ലയോ? അവളെ ഏഴു ദിവസത്തേക്കു പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു അടെച്ചിടേണം; പിന്നത്തേതിൽ അവളെ ചേർത്തുകൊള്ളാം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord replied to Moses, "If her father had spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Confine her outside the camp for seven days; after that she can be brought back."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "If her father had but spit in her face, would she not be shamed seven days? Let her be shut out of the camp seven days, and afterward she may be received again."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again .

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മിർയ്യാമിനെ ഏഴു ദിവസം പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു ആക്കി അടെച്ചിട്ടു; അവളെ വീണ്ടും അംഗീകരിച്ചതുവരെ ജനം യാത്ര ചെയ്യാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on till she was brought back.
chapters.nkjv: So Miriam was shut out of the camp seven days, and the people did not journey till Miriam was brought in again.
chapters.kjv: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again .

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം ജനം ഹസേരോത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പാരാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: After that, the people left Hazeroth and encamped in the Desert of Paran.
chapters.nkjv: And afterward the people moved from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
chapters.kjv: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു ഞാൻ കൊടുപ്പാനിരിക്കുന്ന കനാൻ ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആളുകളെ അയക്ക; അതതു ഗോത്രത്തിൽനിന്നു ഓരോ ആളെ അയക്കേണം; അവരെല്ലാവരും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders."
chapters.nkjv: "Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from each tribe of their fathers you shall send a man, every one a leader among them."
chapters.kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മോശെ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം പാരാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു അവരെ അയച്ചു; ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ തലവന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So at the Lord ’s command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses sent them from the Wilderness of Paran according to the command of the Lord, all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പേർ ആവിതു: രൂബേൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ സക്കൂറിന്റെ മകൻ ശമ്മൂവ.
chapters.niv: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zakkur;
chapters.nkjv: Now these were their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
chapters.kjv: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

chapters.ml: ശിമേയോൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഹോരിയുടെ മകൻ ശഫാത്ത്.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ യെഫുന്നയുടെ മകൻ കാലേബ്.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാർഗോത്രത്തിൽ യോസേഫിന്റെ മകൻ ഈഗാൽ.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീംഗോത്രത്തിൽ നൂന്റെ മകൻ ഹോശേയ.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ രാഫൂവിന്റെ മകൻ പൽതി.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ സോദിയുടെ മകൻ ഗദ്ദീയേൽ.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ ഗോത്രമായ മനശ്ശെഗോത്രത്തിൽ സൂസിയുടെ മകൻ ഗദ്ദി.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Joseph, thatis, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely , of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

chapters.ml: ദാൻഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഗെമല്ലിയുടെ മകൻ അമ്മീയേൽ.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

chapters.ml: ആശേർഗോത്രത്തിൽ മിഖായേലിന്റെ മകൻ സെഥൂർ.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിഗോത്രത്തിൽ വൊപ്സിയുടെ മകൻ നഹ്ബി.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

chapters.ml: ഗാദ്ഗോത്രത്തിൽ മാഖിയുടെ മകൻ ഗയൂവേൽ.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.
chapters.nkjv: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

chapters.ml: ദേശം ഒറ്റു നോക്കുവാൻ മോശെ അയച്ച പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ പേർ ഇവ തന്നേ. എന്നാൽ മോശെ നൂന്റെ മകനായ ഹോശേയെക്കു യോശുവ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)
chapters.nkjv: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.
chapters.kjv: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

chapters.ml: മോശെ കനാൻ ദേശം ഒറ്റു നോക്കുവാൻ അവരെ അയച്ചു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഈ വഴി തെക്കെ ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു മലയിൽ കയറി:
chapters.niv: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, "Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, "Go up this way into the South, and go up to the mountains,
chapters.kjv: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

chapters.ml: ദേശം ഏതുവിധമുള്ളതു, അതിൽ കുടിയിരിക്കുന്ന ജനം ബലവാന്മാരോ ബലഹീനരോ, ചുരുക്കമോ അധികമോ;
chapters.niv: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.
chapters.nkjv: and see what the land is like: whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, few or many;
chapters.kjv: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

chapters.ml: അവർ പാർക്കുന്ന ദേശം നല്ലതോ ആകാത്തതോ, അവർ വസിക്കുന്ന പട്ടണങ്ങൾ പാളയങ്ങളോ കോട്ടകളോ,
chapters.niv: What kind of land do they live in? Is it good or bad? What kind of towns do they live in? Are they unwalled or fortified?
chapters.nkjv: whether the land they dwell in is good or bad; whether the cities they inhabit are like camps or strongholds;
chapters.kjv: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

chapters.ml: ദേശം പുഷ്ടിയുള്ളതോ പുഷ്ടിയില്ലാത്തതോ, അതിൽ വൃക്ഷം ഉണ്ടോ ഇല്ലയോ എന്നിങ്ങനെ നോക്കിയറിവിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ ധൈര്യപ്പെട്ടു ദേശത്തിലെ ഫലങ്ങളും കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതു മുന്തിരിങ്ങ പഴുത്തുതുടങ്ങുന്ന കാലം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: How is the soil? Is it fertile or poor? Are there trees in it or not? Do your best to bring back some of the fruit of the land." (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
chapters.nkjv: whether the land is rich or poor; and whether there are forests there or not. Be of good courage. And bring some of the fruit of the land." Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
chapters.kjv: And what the land is , whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ കയറിപ്പോയി, സീൻമരുഭൂമിമുതൽ ഹാമാത്തിന്നുപോകുന്ന വഴിയായി രഹോബ് വരെ ദേശത്തെ ശോധനചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.
chapters.nkjv: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, near the entrance of Hamath.
