chapters.kjv: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

chapters.ml: അവർ തെക്കെ, ദേശത്തുകൂടി ചെന്നു ഹെബ്രോനിൽ എത്തി; അവിടെ അനാക്കിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ അഹീമാനും ശേശായിയും തൽമായിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഹെബ്രോൻ മിസ്രയീമിലെ സോവാരിന്നു ഏഴു സംവത്സരം മുമ്പെ പണിതതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
chapters.nkjv: And they went up through the South and came to Hebron; Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
chapters.kjv: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were . (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

chapters.ml: അവർ എസ്കോൽതാഴ്വരയോളം ചെന്നു അവിടെനിന്നു ഒരു മുന്തിരിവള്ളി കുലയോടെ പറിച്ചെടുത്തു ഒരു തണ്ടിന്മേൽ കെട്ടി രണ്ടുപേർകൂടി ചുമന്നു; അവർ മാതളപ്പഴവും അത്തിപ്പഴവും കൂടെ കൊണ്ടുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they reached the Valley of Eshkol, they cut off a branch bearing a single cluster of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them, along with some pomegranates and figs.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to the Valley of Eshcol, and there cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes; they carried it between two of them on a pole. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
chapters.kjv: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അവിടെനിന്നു മുറിച്ചെടുത്ത മുന്തിരിക്കുലനിമിത്തം ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു എസ്കോൽതാഴ്വര എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: That place was called the Valley of Eshkol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.
chapters.nkjv: The place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the men of Israel cut down there.
chapters.kjv: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

chapters.ml: അവർ നാല്പതു ദിവസംകൊണ്ടു ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കിക്കഴിഞ്ഞു മടങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.
chapters.nkjv: And they returned from spying out the land after forty days.
chapters.kjv: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

chapters.ml: അവർ യാത്രചെയ്തു പാറാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിലെ കാദേശിൽ മോശെയുടെയും അഹരോന്റെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസഭയുടെയും അടുക്കൽവന്നു അവരോടും സർവ്വസഭയോടും വർത്തമാനം അറിയിച്ചു; ദേശത്തിലെ ഫലങ്ങളും അവരെ കാണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.
chapters.nkjv: Now they departed and came back to Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
chapters.kjv: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു വിവരിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ ഞങ്ങളെ അയച്ച ദേശത്തേക്കു ഞങ്ങൾ പോയി; അതു പാലും തേനും ഒഴുകുന്ന ദേശം തന്നേ; അതിലെ ഫലങ്ങൾ ഇതാ.
chapters.niv: They gave Moses this account: "We went into the land to which you sent us, and it does flow with milk and honey! Here is its fruit.
chapters.nkjv: Then they told him, and said: "We went to the land where you sent us. It truly flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
chapters.kjv: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ദേശത്തു പാർക്കുന്ന ജനങ്ങൾ ബലവാന്മാരും പട്ടണങ്ങൾ ഏറ്റവും ഉറപ്പും വലിപ്പവും ഉള്ളവയും ആകുന്നു. ഞങ്ങൾ അനാക്കിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും അവിടെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless the people who dwell in the land are strong; the cities are fortified and very large; moreover we saw the descendants of Anak there.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

chapters.ml: അമാലേക്യർ തെക്കെ ദേശത്തു പാർക്കുന്നു; ഹിത്യരും യെബൂസ്യരും അമോർയ്യരും പർവ്വതങ്ങളിൽ പാർക്കുന്നു; കനാന്യർ കടൽക്കരയിലും യോർദ്ദാൻ നദീതീരത്തും പാർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan."
chapters.nkjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the South; the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the mountains; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea and along the banks of the Jordan."
chapters.kjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കാലേബ് മോശെയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ജനത്തെ അമർത്തി: നാം ചെന്നു അതു കൈവശമാക്കുക; അതു ജയിപ്പാൻ നമുക്കു കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, "We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it."
chapters.nkjv: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses, and said, "Let us go up at once and take possession, for we are well able to overcome it."
chapters.kjv: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയിരുന്ന പുരുഷന്മാർ: ആ ജനത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ചെല്ലുവാൻ നമുക്കു കഴികയില്ല; അവർ നമ്മിലും ബലവാന്മാർ ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We can’t attack those people; they are stronger than we are."
chapters.nkjv: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we."
chapters.kjv: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റു നോക്കിയ ദേശത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അവർ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു ദുർവ്വർത്തമാനമായി പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ഞങ്ങൾ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു ഒറ്റുനോക്കിയ ദേശം നിവാസികളെ തിന്നുകളയുന്ന ദേശം ആകുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ അവിടെ കണ്ട ജനം ഒക്കെയും അതികായന്മാർ;
chapters.niv: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, "The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.
chapters.nkjv: And they gave the children of Israel a bad report of the land which they had spied out, saying, "The land through which we have gone as spies is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in it are men of great stature.
chapters.kjv: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ഞങ്ങൾ മല്ലന്മാരുടെ സന്തികളായ അനാക്യമല്ലന്മാരെയും കണ്ടു; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നേ ഞങ്ങൾ വെട്ടുക്കിളികളെപ്പോലെ തോന്നി; അവരുടെ കാഴ്ചെക്കും ഞങ്ങൾ അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them."
chapters.nkjv: There we saw the giants ( the descendants of Anak came from the giants); and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight."
chapters.kjv: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സഭയൊക്കെയും ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു, ജനം ആ രാത്രി മുഴുവനും കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: That night all the members of the community raised their voices and wept aloud.
chapters.nkjv: So all the congregation lifted up their voices and cried, and the people wept that night.
chapters.kjv: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ എല്ലാവരും മോശെക്കും അഹരോന്നും വിരോധമായി പിറുപിറുത്തു; സഭ ഒക്കെയും അവരോടു: മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുവെച്ചു ഞങ്ങൾ മരിച്ചുപോയിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു. അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഈ മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു ഞങ്ങൾ മരിച്ചുപോയിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, "If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this wilderness!
chapters.nkjv: And all the children of Israel complained against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, "If only we had died in the land of Egypt! Or if only we had died in this wilderness!
chapters.kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

chapters.ml: വാളാൽ വീഴേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ ഞങ്ങളെ ആ ദേശത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും മക്കളും കൊള്ളയായ്പോകുമല്ലോ; മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകയല്ലയോ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു നല്ലതു? എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Why is the Lord bringing us to this land only to let us fall by the sword? Our wives and children will be taken as plunder. Wouldn’t it be better for us to go back to Egypt?"
chapters.nkjv: Why has the Lord brought us to this land to fall by the sword, that our wives and children should become victims? Would it not be better for us to return to Egypt?"
chapters.kjv: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

chapters.ml: നാം ഒരു തലവനെ നിശ്ചയിച്ചു മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോക എന്നും അവർ തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And they said to each other, "We should choose a leader and go back to Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: So they said to one another, "Let us select a leader and return to Egypt."
chapters.kjv: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെയും അഹരോനും യിസ്രായേൽസഭയുടെ സർവ്വസംഘത്തിന്റെയും മുമ്പാകെ കവിണ്ണുവീണു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown in front of the whole Israelite assembly gathered there.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തെ ഒറ്റുനോക്കിയവരിൽ നൂന്റെ മകൻ യോശുവയും യെഫുന്നയുടെ മകൻ കാലേബും വസ്ത്രം കീറി,
chapters.niv: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes
chapters.nkjv: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, whowere among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes;
chapters.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസഭയോടും പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: ഞങ്ങൾ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു ഒറ്റുനോക്കിയ ദേശം എത്രയും നല്ല ദേശം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and said to the entire Israelite assembly, "The land we passed through and explored is exceedingly good.
chapters.nkjv: and they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying: "The land we passed through to spy out is an exceedingly good land.
chapters.kjv: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നമ്മിൽ പ്രസാദിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ നമ്മെ പാലും തേനും ഒഴുകുന്ന ആ ദേശത്തേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു നമുക്കു അതു തരും.
chapters.niv: If the Lord is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and will give it to us.
chapters.nkjv: If the Lord delights in us, then He will bring us into this land and give it to us, ‘a land which flows with milk and honey.’
chapters.kjv: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയോടു നിങ്ങൾ മത്സരിക്കമാത്രം അരുതു; ആ ദേശത്തിലെ ജനത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടരുതു; അവർ നമുക്കു ഇരയാകുന്നു; അവരുടെ ശരണം പോയ്പോയിരിക്കുന്നു; നമ്മോടുകൂടെ യഹോവ ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു അവരെ ഭയപ്പെടരുതു.
chapters.niv: Only do not rebel against the Lord . And do not be afraid of the people of the land, because we will devour them. Their protection is gone, but the Lord is with us. Do not be afraid of them."
chapters.nkjv: Only do not rebel against the Lord, nor fear the people of the land, for they are our bread; their protection has departed from them, and the Lordis with us. Do not fear them."
chapters.kjv: Only rebel not ye against the LORD , neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവരെ കല്ലെറിയേണം എന്നു സഭയെല്ലാം പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിൽ എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽമക്കളും കാൺകെ പ്രത്യക്ഷമായി.
chapters.niv: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting to all the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: And all the congregation said to stone them with stones. Now the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of meeting before all the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: ഈ ജനം എത്രത്തോളം എന്നെ നിരസിക്കും? ഞാൻ അവരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള അടയാളങ്ങളൊക്കെയും കണ്ടിട്ടും അവർ എത്രത്തോളം എന്നെ വിശ്വസിക്കാതിരിക്കും?
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses, "How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs I have performed among them?
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses: "How long will these people reject Me? And how long will they not believe Me, with all the signs which I have performed among them?
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവരെ മഹാമാരിയാൽ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചു സംഹരിച്ചുകളകയും നിന്നെ അവരെക്കാൾ വലിപ്പവും ബലവുമുള്ള ജാതിയാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: I will strike them down with a plague and destroy them, but I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they."
chapters.nkjv: I will strike them with the pestilence and disinherit them, and I will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they."
chapters.kjv: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

chapters.ml: മോശെ യഹോവയോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്നാൽ മിസ്രയീമ്യർ അതു കേൾക്കും; നീ ഈ ജനത്തെ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു നിന്റെ ശക്തിയാൽ കൊണ്ടുപോന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Moses said to the Lord , "Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said to the Lord: "Then the Egyptians will hear it, for by Your might You brought these people up from among them,
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

chapters.ml: അവർ അതു ഈ ദേശനിവാസികളോടും പറയും; യഹോവയായ നീ ഈ ജനത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഉണ്ടെന്നു അവർ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; യഹോവയായ നിന്നെ ഇവർ കണ്ണാലേ കാണുകയും നിന്റെ മേഘം ഇവർക്കു മീതെ നില്ക്കുകയും പകൽ മേഘസ്തംഭത്തിലും രാത്രി അഗ്നിസ്തംഭത്തിലും നീ ഇവർക്കു മുമ്പായി നടക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land about it. They have already heard that you, Lord , are with these people and that you, Lord , have been seen face to face, that your cloud stays over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.
chapters.nkjv: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, Lord, are among these people; that You, Lord, are seen face to face and Your cloud stands above them, and You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
chapters.kjv: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

chapters.ml: നീ ഇപ്പോൾ ഈ ജനത്തെ ഒക്കെയും ഒരു ഒറ്റമനുഷ്യനെപ്പോലെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞാൽ നിന്റെ കീർത്തി കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന ജാതികൾ:
chapters.niv: If you put all these people to death, leaving none alive, the nations who have heard this report about you will say,
chapters.nkjv: Now if You kill these people as one man, then the nations which have heard of Your fame will speak, saying,
chapters.kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

chapters.ml: ഈ ജനത്തോടു സത്യം ചെയ്ത ദേശത്തേക്കു അവരെ കൊണ്ടു പോകുവാൻ യഹോവെക്കു കഴിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവരെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നു കളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറയും.
chapters.niv: ‘The Lord was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath, so he slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
chapters.nkjv: ‘Because the Lord was not able to bring this people to the land which He swore to give them, therefore He killed them in the wilderness.’
chapters.kjv: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദീർഘക്ഷമയും മഹാദയയും ഉള്ളവൻ; അകൃത്യവും ലംഘനവും ക്ഷമിക്കുന്നവൻ; കുറ്റക്കാരനെ വെറുതെ വിടാതെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അകൃത്യം മൂന്നാമത്തെയും നാലാമത്തെയും തലമുറയോളം മക്കളുടെ മേൽ സന്ദർശിക്കുന്നവൻ
chapters.niv: "Now may the Lord’s strength be displayed, just as you have declared:
chapters.nkjv: And now, I pray, let the power of my Lord be great, just as You have spoken, saying,
chapters.kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

chapters.ml: എന്നിങ്ങനെ നീ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ കർത്താവേ, ഇപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ ശക്തി വലുതായിരിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: ‘The Lord is slow to anger, abounding in love and forgiving sin and rebellion. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation.’
chapters.nkjv: ‘The Lord is longsuffering and abundant in mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression; but He by no means clears theguilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation.’
chapters.kjv: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ മഹാദയെക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം മിസ്രയീംമുതൽ ഇവിടംവരെ ഈ ജനത്തോടു നീ ക്ഷമിച്ചുവന്നതുപോലെ ഈ ജനത്തിന്റെ അകൃത്യം ക്ഷമിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: In accordance with your great love, forgive the sin of these people, just as you have pardoned them from the time they left Egypt until now."
chapters.nkjv: Pardon the iniquity of this people, I pray, according to the greatness of Your mercy, just as You have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now."
chapters.kjv: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: നിന്റെ അപേക്ഷപ്രകാരം ഞാൻ ക്ഷമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord replied, "I have forgiven them, as you asked.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said: "I have pardoned, according to your word;
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും എന്നാണ, ഭൂമിയെല്ലാം യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സുകൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, as surely as I live and as surely as the glory of the Lord fills the whole earth,
chapters.nkjv: but truly, as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord—
chapters.kjv: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്റെ തേജസ്സും മിസ്രയീമിലും മരുഭൂമിയിലുംവെച്ചു ഞാൻ ചെയ്ത അടയാളങ്ങളും കണ്ടിട്ടുള്ള പുരുഷന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും ഇപ്പോൾ പത്തു പ്രാവശ്യം എന്നെ പരീക്ഷിക്കയും എന്റെ വാക്കു കൂട്ടാക്കാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: not one of those who saw my glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness but who disobeyed me and tested me ten times—
chapters.nkjv: because all these men who have seen My glory and the signs which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have put Me to the test now these ten times, and have not heeded My voice,
chapters.kjv: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ഞാൻ സത്യം ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള ദേശം അവർ കാൺകയില്ല; എന്നെ നിരസിച്ചവർ ആരും അതു കാൺകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: not one of them will ever see the land I promised on oath to their ancestors. No one who has treated me with contempt will ever see it.
chapters.nkjv: they certainly shall not see the land of which I swore to their fathers, nor shall any of those who rejected Me see it.
chapters.kjv: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദാസനായ കാലേബോ, അവന്നു വേറൊരു സ്വഭാവമുള്ളതുകൊണ്ടും എന്നെ പൂർണ്ണമായി അനുസരിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടും അവൻ പോയിരുന്ന ദേശത്തേക്കു ഞാൻ അവനെ എത്തിക്കും; അവന്റെ സന്തതി അതു കൈവശമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it.
chapters.nkjv: But My servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit in him and has followed Me fully, I will bring into the land where he went, and his descendants shall inherit it.
chapters.kjv: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അമാലേക്യരും കനാന്യരും താഴ്വരയിൽ പാർക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ നാളെ ചെങ്കടലിങ്കലേക്കുള്ള വഴിയായി മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Since the Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea. "
chapters.nkjv: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwell in the valley; tomorrow turn and move out into the wilderness by the Way of the Red Sea."
chapters.kjv: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

chapters.ml: ഈ ദുഷ്ടസഭ എത്രത്തോളം എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി പിറുപിറുക്കും? യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി പിറുപിറുക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: "How long shallIbearwith this evil congregation who complain against Me? I have heard the complaints which the children of Israel make against Me.
chapters.kjv: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു പറവിൻ: ഞാൻ കേൾക്കെ നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ തന്നേ, എന്നാണ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ചെയ്യുമെന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So tell them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord , I will do to you the very thing I heard you say:
chapters.nkjv: Say to them, ‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘just as you have spoken in My hearing, so I will do to you:
chapters.kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD , as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

chapters.ml: ഈ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ശവം വീഴും; യെഫുന്നയുടെ മകൻ കാലേബും നൂന്റെ മകൻ യോശുവയും ഒഴികെ ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരായി
chapters.niv: In this wilderness your bodies will fall—every one of you twenty years old or more who was counted in the census and who has grumbled against me.
chapters.nkjv: The carcasses of you who have complained against Me shall fall in this wilderness, all of you who were numbered, according to your entire number, from twenty years old and above.
chapters.kjv: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നേരെ പിറുപിറുത്തവരായ നിങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തിൽ ആരും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ പാർപ്പിക്കുമെന്നു സത്യം ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള ദേശത്തു കടക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Not one of you will enter the land I swore with uplifted hand to make your home, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.nkjv: Except for Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun, you shall by no means enter the land which I swore I would make you dwell in.
chapters.kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കൊള്ളയായ്പോകുമെന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുള്ള നിങ്ങളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളെ ഞാൻ അതിൽ കടക്കുമാറാക്കും; നിങ്ങൾ നിരസിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ദേശം അവർ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: As for your children that you said would be taken as plunder, I will bring them in to enjoy the land you have rejected.
chapters.nkjv: But your little ones, whom you said would be victims, I will bring in, and they shall know the land which you have despised.
chapters.kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ, നിങ്ങളുടെ ശവം ഈ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വീഴും.
chapters.niv: But as for you, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: But asfor you, your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness.
chapters.kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ശവം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഒടുങ്ങുംവരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം ഇടയരായി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ പാതിവ്രത്യഭംഗം വഹിക്കും;
chapters.niv: Your children will be shepherds here for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: And your sons shall be shepherds in the wilderness forty years, and bear the brunt of your infidelity, until your carcasses are consumed in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കിയ നാല്പതു ദിവസത്തിന്റെ എണ്ണത്തിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം, ഒരു ദിവസത്തിന്നു ഒരു സംവത്സരം വീതം, നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ അകൃത്യങ്ങൾ വഹിച്ചു എന്റെ അകല്ച അറിയും.
chapters.niv: For forty years—one year for each of the forty days you explored the land—you will suffer for your sins and know what it is like to have me against you.’
chapters.nkjv: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, for each day you shall bear your guilt one year, namely forty years, and you shall know My rejection.
chapters.kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടംകൂടിയ ഈ ദുഷ്ടസഭയോടു ഞാൻ ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യും: ഈ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ അവർ ഒടുങ്ങും; ഇവിടെ അവർ മരിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവയായ ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this whole wicked community, which has banded together against me. They will meet their end in this wilderness; here they will die."
chapters.nkjv: I the Lord have spoken this. I will surely do so to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against Me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.’ "
chapters.kjv: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

chapters.ml: ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ മോശെ അയച്ചവരും, മടങ്ങിവന്നു ദേശത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ദുർവ്വർത്തമാനം പറഞ്ഞു സഭ മുഴുവനും അവന്നു വിരോധമായി പിറുപിറുപ്പാൻ സംഗതി വരുത്തിയ വരും,
chapters.niv: So the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who returned and made the whole community grumble against him by spreading a bad report about it—
chapters.nkjv: Now the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation complain against him by bringing a bad report of the land,
chapters.kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ദുർവ്വർത്തമാനം പറഞ്ഞവരുമായ പുരുഷന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ഒരു ബാധകൊണ്ടു മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: these men who were responsible for spreading the bad report about the land were struck down and died of a plague before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: those very men who brought the evil report about the land, died by the plague before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ പോയ പുരുഷന്മാരിൽ നൂന്റെ മകൻ യോശുവയും യെഫുന്നയുടെ പുത്രൻ കാലേബും മരിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Of the men who went to explore the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh survived.
chapters.nkjv: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive, of the men who went to spy out the land.
chapters.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still .

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മോശെ ഈ വാക്കുകൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടൊക്കെയും പറഞ്ഞു; ജനം ഏറ്റവും ദുഃഖിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Moses reported this to all the Israelites, they mourned bitterly.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
chapters.kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റേന്നു അവർ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു: ഇതാ, യഹോവ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ചൊല്ലിയിരിക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു ഞങ്ങൾ കയറിപ്പോകുന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾ പാപം ചെയ്തുപോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു മലമുകളിൽ കയറി.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning they set out for the highest point in the hill country, saying, "Now we are ready to go up to the land the Lord promised. Surely we have sinned!"
chapters.nkjv: And they rose early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, "Here we are, and we will go up to the place which the Lord has promised, for we have sinned!"
chapters.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here , and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ: നിങ്ങൾ എന്തിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ കല്പന ലംഘിക്കുന്നു? അതു സാദ്ധ്യമാകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But Moses said, "Why are you disobeying the Lord ’s command? This will not succeed!
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said, "Now why do you transgress the command of the Lord? For this will not succeed.
chapters.kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD ? but it shall not prosper.

chapters.ml: ശത്രുക്കളാൽ തോൽക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ കയറരുതു; യഹോവ നിങ്ങളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Do not go up, because the Lord is not with you. You will be defeated by your enemies,
chapters.nkjv: Do not go up, lest you be defeated by your enemies, for the Lordis not among you.
chapters.kjv: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

chapters.ml: അമാലേക്യരും കനാന്യരും അവിടെ നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ ഉണ്ടു; നിങ്ങൾ വാളാൽ വീഴും; നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയെ വിട്ടു പിന്തിരിഞ്ഞിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: for the Amalekites and the Canaanites will face you there. Because you have turned away from the Lord , he will not be with you and you will fall by the sword."
chapters.nkjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword; because you have turned away from the Lord, the Lord will not be with you."
chapters.kjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD , therefore the LORD will not be with you.

chapters.ml: എന്നിട്ടും അവർ ധാർഷ്ട്യം പൂണ്ടു മലമുകളിൽ കയറി; യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകവും മോശെയും പാളയത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, in their presumption they went up toward the highest point in the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the Lord ’s covenant moved from the camp.
chapters.nkjv: But they presumed to go up to the mountaintop. Nevertheless, neither the ark of the covenant of the Lord nor Moses departed from the camp.
chapters.kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ മലയിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന അമാലേക്യരും കനാന്യരും ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു ഹോർമ്മാവരെ അവരെ ഛിന്നിച്ചു ഓടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and attacked them and beat them down all the way to Hormah.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who dwelt in that mountain came down and attacked them, and drove them back as far as Hormah.
chapters.kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തരുന്ന നിങ്ങളുടെ നിവാസദേശത്തു നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നിട്ടു
chapters.niv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘After you enter the land I am giving you as a home
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you have come into the land you are to inhabit, which I am giving to you,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

chapters.ml: ഒരു നേർച്ച നിവർത്തിപ്പാനോ സ്വമേധാദാനമായിട്ടോ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉത്സവങ്ങളിലോ യഹോവെക്കു മാടിനെയാകട്ടെ ആടിനെയാകട്ടെ ഹോമയാഗമായിട്ടെങ്കിലും ഹനനയാഗമായിട്ടെങ്കിലും യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയാകുമാറു ഒരു ദഹനയാഗം അർപ്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: and you present to the Lord food offerings from the herd or the flock, as an aroma pleasing to the Lord —whether burnt offerings or sacrifices, for special vows or freewill offerings or festival offerings—
chapters.nkjv: and you make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or in your appointed feasts, to make a sweet aroma to the Lord, from the herd or the flock,
chapters.kjv: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD , a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD , of the herd, or of the flock:

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു വഴിപാടു കഴിക്കുന്നവൻ കാൽഹീൻ എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത ഒരിടങ്ങഴി മാവു ഭോജനയാഗമായി കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: then the person who brings an offering shall present to the Lord a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of olive oil.
chapters.nkjv: then he who presents his offering to the Lord shall bring a grain offering of one-tenth ofanephah of fine flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil;
chapters.kjv: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും ഹനനയാഗത്തിന്നും പാനീയയാഗമായി നീ ആടൊന്നിന്നു കാൽഹീൻ വീഞ്ഞു കൊണ്ടുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: With each lamb for the burnt offering or the sacrifice, prepare a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.
chapters.nkjv: and one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering you shall prepare with the burnt offering or the sacrifice, for each lamb.
chapters.kjv: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

chapters.ml: ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനായാൽ ഹീനിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത രണ്ടിടങ്ങഴി മാവു ഭോജനയാഗമായി കൊണ്ടു വരേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘With a ram prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,
chapters.nkjv: Or for a ram you shall prepare as a grain offering two-tenths ofanephah of fine flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil;
chapters.kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗത്തിന്നു ഹീനിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു വീഞ്ഞും യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering. Offer it as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: and as a drink offering you shall offer one-third of a hin of wine as a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: നേർച്ച നിവർത്തിപ്പാനോ യഹോവെക്കു സമാധാനയാഗം കഴിപ്പാനോ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നാകട്ടെ ഹനനയാഗത്തിന്നാകട്ടെ ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെ കൊണ്ടുവരുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: " ‘When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, for a special vow or a fellowship offering to the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: And when you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering, or as a sacrifice to fulfill a vow, or as a peace offering to the Lord,
chapters.kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD :

chapters.ml: കിടാവിനോടുകൂടെ അരഹീൻ എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത മൂന്നിടങ്ങഴി മാവു ഭോജനയാഗമായിട്ടു അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: bring with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil,
chapters.nkjv: then shall be offered with the young bull a grain offering of three-tenths ofanephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
chapters.kjv: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗമായി അരഹീൻ വീഞ്ഞു യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and also bring half a hin of wine as a drink offering. This will be a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: and you shall bring as the drink offering half a hin of wine as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: കാളക്കിടാവു, ആട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ, കുഞ്ഞാടു, കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടി എന്നിവയിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നും ഇങ്ങനെ തന്നേ വേണം.
chapters.niv: Each bull or ram, each lamb or young goat, is to be prepared in this manner.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Thus it shall be done for each young bull, for each ram, or for each lamb or young goat.
chapters.kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന യാഗമൃഗങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തിന്നും ഒത്തവണ്ണം ഓരോന്നിന്നും ഇങ്ങനെ തന്നേ വേണം.
chapters.niv: Do this for each one, for as many as you prepare.
chapters.nkjv: According to the number that you prepare, so you shall do with everyone according to their number.
chapters.kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

chapters.ml: സ്വദേശിയായവനൊക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗം അർപ്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഇതെല്ലാം ഇങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അനുഷ്ഠിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘Everyone who is native-born must do these things in this way when they present a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: All who are native-born shall do these things in this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കുന്ന പരദേശിയോ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ സ്ഥിരവാസം ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരുത്തനോ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗം കഴിക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ അനുഷ്ഠിക്കുംവണ്ണം തന്നേ അവനും അനുഷ്ഠിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: For the generations to come, whenever a foreigner or anyone else living among you presents a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , they must do exactly as you do.
chapters.nkjv: And if a stranger dwells with you, or whoever is among you throughout your generations, and would present an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord, just as you do, so shall he do.
chapters.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD ; as ye do, so he shall do.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കാകട്ടെ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന പരദേശിക്കാകട്ടെ സർവ്വസഭെക്കും തലമുറതലമുറയായി എന്നേക്കും ഒരു ചട്ടം തന്നേ ആയിരിക്കേണം; യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ പരദേശി നിങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ ഇരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The community is to have the same rules for you and for the foreigner residing among you; this is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the Lord :
chapters.nkjv: One ordinance shallbe for you of the assembly and for the stranger who dwells withyou, an ordinance forever throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the LORD .

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കും വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന പരദേശിക്കും പ്രമാണവും നിയമവും ഒന്നുതന്നേ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The same laws and regulations will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing among you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: One law and one custom shall be for you and for the stranger who dwells with you.’ "
chapters.kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്ന ദേശത്തു നിങ്ങൾ എത്തിയശേഷം
chapters.niv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land to which I am taking you
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you come into the land to which I bring you,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തിലെ ആഹാരം ഭക്ഷിക്കുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു ഉദർച്ചാർപ്പണം കഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and you eat the food of the land, present a portion as an offering to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: then it will be, when you eat of the bread of the land, that you shall offer up a heave offering to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ആദ്യത്തെ തരിമാവുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു വട ഉദർച്ചാർപ്പണമായി കഴിക്കേണം; മെതിക്കളത്തിന്റെ ഉദർച്ചാർപ്പണംപോലെ തന്നേ അതു ഉദർച്ച ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: Present a loaf from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.
chapters.nkjv: You shall offer up a cake of the first of your ground meal as a heave offering; as a heave offering of the threshing floor, so shall you offer it up.
chapters.kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ തലമുറതലമുറയായി ആദ്യത്തെ തരിമാവുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവെക്കു ഉദർച്ചാർപ്പണം കഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the Lord from the first of your ground meal.
chapters.nkjv: Of the first of your ground meal you shall give to the Lord a heave offering throughout your generations.
chapters.kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ച ഈ സകലകല്പനകളിലും
chapters.niv: " ‘Now if you as a community unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the Lord gave Moses—
chapters.nkjv: ‘If you sin unintentionally, and do not observe all these commandments which the Lord has spoken to Moses—
chapters.kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,

chapters.ml: യാതൊന്നെങ്കിലും യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ച നാൾമുതൽ തലമുറതലമുറയായി യഹോവ മോശെമുഖാന്തരം നിങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ച സകലത്തിലും യാതൊന്നെങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾ പ്രമാണിക്കാതെ തെറ്റു ചെയ്താൽ,
chapters.niv: any of the Lord ’s commands to you through him, from the day the Lord gave them and continuing through the generations to come—
chapters.nkjv: all that the Lord has commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day the Lord gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
chapters.kjv: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses , and henceforward among your generations;

chapters.ml: അറിയാതെ കണ്ടു അബദ്ധവശാൽ സഭ വല്ലതും ചെയ്തുപോയാൽ സഭയെല്ലാം കൂടെ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നായി ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ചട്ടപ്രകാരം അതിന്നുള്ള ഭോജനയാഗത്തോടും പാനീയയാഗത്തോടുംകൂടെ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: then it will be, if it is unintentionally committed, without the knowledge of the congregation, that the whole congregation shall offer one young bull as a burnt offering, as a sweet aroma to the Lord, with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one kid of the goats as a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD , with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസഭെക്കും വേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവരോടു ക്ഷമിക്കപ്പെടും; അതു അബദ്ധവശാൽ സംഭവിക്കയും അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ അബദ്ധത്തിന്നായിട്ടു യഹോവെക്കു ദഹനയാഗമായി തങ്ങളുടെ വഴിപാടും പാപയാഗവും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അർപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The priest is to make atonement for the whole Israelite community, and they will be forgiven, for it was not intentional and they have presented to the Lord for their wrong a food offering and a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: So the priest shall make atonement for the whole congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for it was unintentional; they shall bring their offering, an offering made by fire to the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their unintended sin.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD , and their sin offering before the LORD , for their ignorance:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അതു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസഭയോടും അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന പരദേശിയോടും ക്ഷമിക്കപ്പെടും; തെറ്റു സർവ്വജനത്തിന്നുമുള്ളതായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The whole Israelite community and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, because all the people were involved in the unintentional wrong.
chapters.nkjv: It shall be forgiven the whole congregation of the children of Israel and the stranger who dwells among them, because all the people didit unintentionally.
chapters.kjv: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

chapters.ml: ഒരാൾ അബദ്ധവശാൽ പാപം ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ തനിക്കുവേണ്ടി പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഒരു പെൺകോലാട്ടിനെ അർപ്പിക്കണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘But if just one person sins unintentionally, that person must bring a year-old female goat for a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And if a person sins unintentionally, then he shall bring a female goat in its first year as a sin offering.
chapters.kjv: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

chapters.ml: അബദ്ധവശാൽ പാപം ചെയ്തവന്നു പാപപരിഹാരം വരുത്തുവാൻ പുരോഹിതൻ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ പ്രായശ്ചിത്തകർമ്മം അനുഷ്ഠിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: The priest is to make atonement before the Lord for the one who erred by sinning unintentionally, and when atonement has been made, that person will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: So the priest shall make atonement for the person who sins unintentionally, when he sins unintentionally before the Lord, to make atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
chapters.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD , to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അബദ്ധവശാൽ പാപം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ സ്വദേശിയോ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന പരദേശിയോ ആയാലും പ്രമാണം ഒന്നുതന്നേ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: One and the same law applies to everyone who sins unintentionally, whether a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.
chapters.nkjv: You shall have one law for him who sins unintentionally, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel and for the stranger who dwells among them.
chapters.kjv: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സ്വദേശികളിലോ പരദേശികളിലോ ആരെങ്കിലും കരുതിക്കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ യഹോവയെ ദുഷിക്കുന്നു; അവനെ അവന്റെ ജനത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘But anyone who sins defiantly, whether native-born or foreigner, blasphemes the Lord and must be cut off from the people of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: ‘But the person who does anything presumptuously, whetherheis native-born or a stranger, that one brings reproach on the Lord, and he shall be cut off from among his people.
chapters.kjv: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ വചനം ധിക്കരിച്ചു അവന്റെ കല്പന ലംഘിച്ചു; അവനെ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കിക്കളയേണം; അവന്റെ അകൃത്യം അവന്റെമേൽ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Because they have despised the Lord ’s word and broken his commands, they must surely be cut off; their guilt remains on them.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Because he has despised the word of the Lord, and has broken His commandment, that person shall be completely cut off; his guilt shallbe upon him.’ "
chapters.kjv: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD , and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ശബ്ബത്ത് നാളിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ വിറകു പെറുക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
chapters.nkjv: Now while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
chapters.kjv: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വിറകു പെറുക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടവർ അവനെ മോശെയുടെയും അഹരോന്റെയും സർവ്വസഭയുടെയും അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly,
chapters.nkjv: And those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
chapters.kjv: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു ചെയ്യേണ്ടതു ഇന്നതെന്നു വിധിച്ചിട്ടില്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവർ അവനെ തടവിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and they kept him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.
chapters.nkjv: They put him under guard, because it had not been explained what should be done to him.
chapters.kjv: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു: ആ മരുഷ്യൻ മരണശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണം; സർവ്വസഭയും പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തുവെച്ചു അവനെ കല്ലെറിയേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The man must surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ സർവ്വസഭയും അവനെ പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞുകൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the assembly took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: So, as the Lord commanded Moses, all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died.
chapters.kjv: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ: അവർ തലമുറതലമുറയായി വസ്ത്രത്തിന്റെ കോൺതലെക്കു പൊടിപ്പു ഉണ്ടാക്കുകയും കോൺതലെക്കലെ പൊടിപ്പിൽ നീലച്ചരടു കെട്ടുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel: Tell them to make tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and to put a blue thread in the tassels of the corners.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ സകലകല്പനകളും ഓർത്തു അനുസരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്തഹൃദയത്തിന്നും സ്വന്തകണ്ണിന്നും തോന്നിയവണ്ണം പരസംഗമായി നടക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും ആ പൊടിപ്പു ജ്ഞാപകം ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the Lord , that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by chasing after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall have the tassel, that you may look upon it and remember all the commandments of the Lord and do them, and that you may not follow the harlotry to which your own heart and your own eyes are inclined,
chapters.kjv: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD , and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ സകല കല്പനകളും ഓർത്തു അനുസരിച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു വിശുദ്ധരായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then you will remember to obey all my commands and will be consecrated to your God.
chapters.nkjv: and that you may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy for your God.
chapters.kjv: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങളെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ആകുന്നു; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord your God.’ "
chapters.nkjv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God."
chapters.kjv: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ലേവിയുടെ മകനായ കെഹാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യിസ്ഹാരിന്റെ മകൻ കോരഹ്, രൂബേൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ എലീയാബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ദാഥാൻ, അബീരാം, പേലെത്തിന്റെ മകനായ ഓൻ എന്നിവർ
chapters.niv: Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and certain Reubenites—Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth—became insolent
chapters.nkjv: Now Korah the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, and On the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men;
chapters.kjv: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ സഭാപ്രധാനികളും സംഘസദസ്യന്മാരും പ്രമാണികളുമായ ഇരുനൂറ്റമ്പതു പുരുഷന്മാരെ കൂട്ടി മോശെയോടു മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and rose up against Moses. With them were 250 Israelite men, well-known community leaders who had been appointed members of the council.
chapters.nkjv: and they rose up before Moses with some of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty leaders of the congregation, representatives of the congregation, men of renown.
chapters.kjv: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

chapters.ml: അവൻ മോശെക്കും അഹരോന്നും വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടംകൂടി അവരോടു: മതി, മതി; സഭയ ഒട്ടൊഴിയാതെ എല്ലാവരും വിശുദ്ധരാകുന്നു; യഹോവ അവരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഉണ്ടു; പിന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ സഭെക്കു മീതെ നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ഉയർത്തുന്നതു എന്തു? എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They came as a group to oppose Moses and Aaron and said to them, "You have gone too far! The whole community is holy, every one of them, and the Lord is with them. Why then do you set yourselves above the Lord ’s assembly?"
chapters.nkjv: They gathered together against Moses and Aaron, and said to them, "You take too much upon yourselves, for all the congregation is holy, every one of them, and the Lordis among them. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the Lord?"
chapters.kjv: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD ?

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ മോശെ കവിണ്ണുവീണു.
chapters.niv: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.
chapters.nkjv: So when Moses heard it, he fell on his face;
chapters.kjv: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face:

chapters.ml: അവൻ കോരഹിനോടും അവന്റെ എല്ലാ കൂട്ടരോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: നാളെ രാവിലെ യഹോവ തനിക്കുള്ളവൻ ആരെന്നും തന്നോടടുപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം വിശുദ്ധൻ ആരെന്നും കാണിക്കും; താൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നവനെ തന്നോടു അടുക്കുമാറാക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: "In the morning the Lord will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.
chapters.nkjv: and he spoke to Korah and all his company, saying, "Tomorrow morning the Lord will show who is His and whois holy, and will cause him to come near to Him. That one whom He chooses He will cause to come near to Him.
chapters.kjv: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

chapters.ml: കോരഹും അവന്റെ എല്ലാ കൂട്ടവുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾ ഇതു ചെയ്‍വിൻ:
chapters.niv: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do this: Take censers
chapters.nkjv: Do this: Take censers, Korah and all your company;
chapters.kjv: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

chapters.ml: ധൂപകലശം എടുത്തു നാളെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അതിൽ തീയിട്ടു ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം ഇടുവിൻ; യഹോവ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നവൻ തന്നേ വിശുദ്ധൻ; ലേവിപുത്രന്മാരേ, മതി, മതി!
chapters.niv: and tomorrow put burning coals and incense in them before the Lord . The man the Lord chooses will be the one who is holy. You Levites have gone too far!"
chapters.nkjv: put fire in them and put incense in them before the Lord tomorrow, and it shall be that the man whom the Lord chooses is the holy one. Youtake too much upon yourselves, you sons of Levi!"
chapters.kjv: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മോശെ കോരഹിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ലേവിപുത്രന്മാരേ, കേൾപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Moses also said to Korah, "Now listen, you Levites!
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you sons of Levi:
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ തിരുനിവാസത്തിലെ വേലചെയ്‍വാനും സഭയുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കായി അവരുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നില്പാനും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവം നിങ്ങളെ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽസഭയിൽനിന്നു നിങ്ങളെ വേറുതിരിച്ചതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു പോരായോ?
chapters.niv: Isn’t it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the Lord ’s tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?
chapters.nkjv: Isit a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to Himself, to do the work of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to serve them;
chapters.kjv: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിന്നെയും ലേവിപുത്രന്മാരായ നിന്റെ സകല സഹോദരന്മാരെയും തന്നോടു അടുക്കുമാറാക്കിയല്ലോ; നിങ്ങൾ പൌരോഹിത്യംകൂടെ കാംക്ഷിക്കുവോ?
chapters.niv: He has brought you and all your fellow Levites near himself, but now you are trying to get the priesthood too.
chapters.nkjv: and that He has brought you near toHimself, you and all your brethren, the sons of Levi, with you? And are you seeking the priesthood also?
chapters.kjv: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഹേതുവായിട്ടു നീയും നിന്റെ കൂട്ടക്കാർ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടംകൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ അഹരോന്റെ നേരെ പിറുപിറുപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവൻ എന്തുമാത്രമുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: It is against the Lord that you and all your followers have banded together. Who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against the Lord. And what is Aaron that you complain against him?"
chapters.kjv: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD : and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മോശെ എലിയാബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ദാഥാനെയും അബീരാമിനെയും വിളിപ്പാൻ ആളയച്ചു; അതിന്നു അവർ:
chapters.niv: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, "We will not come!
chapters.nkjv: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, but they said, "We will not come up!
chapters.kjv: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ വരികയില്ല; മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഞങ്ങളെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ നീ ഞങ്ങളെ പാലും തേനും ഒഴുകുന്ന ദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നരിക്കുന്നതു പോരാഞ്ഞിട്ടു നിന്നെത്തന്നെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അധിപതിയും ആക്കുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: Isn’t it enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? And now you also want to lord it over us!
chapters.nkjv: Isit a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you should keep acting like a prince over us?
chapters.kjv: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

chapters.ml: അത്രയുമല്ല, നീ ഞങ്ങളെ പാലും തേനും ഒഴുകുന്ന ദേശത്തേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവരികയോ നിലങ്ങളും മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളും അവകാശമായി തരികയോ ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല; നീ ഇവരുടെ കണ്ണു ചുഴന്നുകളയുമോ? ഞങ്ങൾ വരികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Do you want to treat these men like slaves ? No, we will not come!"
chapters.nkjv: Moreover you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up!"
chapters.kjv: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ ഏറ്റവും കോപിച്ചു അവൻ യഹോവയോടു: അവരുടെ വഴിപാടു കടാക്ഷിക്കരുതേ; ഞാൻ അവരുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നു ഒരു കഴുതയെപ്പോലും വാങ്ങീട്ടില്ല; അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനോടും ഒരു ദോഷം ചെയ്തിട്ടുമില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Moses became very angry and said to the Lord , "Do not accept their offering. I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, nor have I wronged any of them."
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses was very angry, and said to the Lord, "Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, nor have I hurt one of them."
chapters.kjv: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD , Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

chapters.ml: മോശെ കോരഹനോടു: നീയും നിന്റെ എല്ലാകൂട്ടവും നാളെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വരേണം; നീയും അവരും അഹരോനും കൂടെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Moses said to Korah, "You and all your followers are to appear before the Lord tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said to Korah, "Tomorrow, you and all your company be present before the Lord—you and they, as well as Aaron.
chapters.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD , thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ ധൂപകലശം എടുത്തു അവയിൽ ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം ഇട്ടു ഒരോരുത്തൻ ഓരോ ധൂപകലശമായി ഇരുനൂറ്റമ്പതു കലശവും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ; നീയും അഹരോനും കൂടെ താന്താന്റെ ധൂപകലശവുമായി വരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Each man is to take his censer and put incense in it—250 censers in all—and present it before the Lord . You and Aaron are to present your censers also."
chapters.nkjv: Let each take his censer and put incense in it, and each of you bring his censer before the Lord, two hundred and fifty censers; both you and Aaron, each with his censer."
chapters.kjv: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ ധൂപകലശം എടുത്തു തീയിട്ടു അതിൽ ധൂപവർഗ്ഗവും ഇട്ടു മോശെയും അഹരോനുമായി സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: So each of them took his censer, put burning coals and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: So every man took his censer, put fire in it, laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the tabernacle of meeting with Moses and Aaron.
chapters.kjv: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

chapters.ml: കോരഹ് അവർക്കു വിരോധമായി സർവ്വസഭയെയും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി; അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു സർവ്വസഭെക്കും പ്രത്യക്ഷമായി.
chapters.niv: When Korah had gathered all his followers in opposition to them at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the glory of the Lord appeared to the entire assembly.
chapters.nkjv: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them at the door of the tabernacle of meeting. Then the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
chapters.kjv: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടും അഹരോനോടും:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

chapters.ml: ഈ സഭയുടെ മദ്ധ്യേനിന്നു മാറിപ്പോകുവിൻ; ഞാൻ അവരെ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ സംഹരിക്കും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Separate yourselves from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once."
chapters.nkjv: "Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment."
chapters.kjv: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ കവിണ്ണുവീണു: സകലജനത്തിന്റെയും ആത്മാക്കൾക്കു ഉടയവനാകുന്ന ദൈവമേ, ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ പാപം ചെയ്തതിന്നു നീ സർവ്വസഭയോടും കോപിക്കുമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and cried out, "O God, the God who gives breath to all living things, will you be angry with the entire assembly when only one man sins?"
chapters.nkjv: Then they fell on their faces, and said, "O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and You be angry with all the congregation?"
chapters.kjv: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യഹോവ മോശെയോടു:
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: കോരഹ്, ദാഥാൻ, അബീരാം എന്നിവരുടെ വാസസ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലും നിന്നു മാറിക്കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു സഭയോടു പറക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Say to the assembly, ‘Move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.’ "
chapters.kjv: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

chapters.ml: മോശെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ദാഥാന്റെയും അബീരാമിന്റെയും അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരും അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses rose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
chapters.kjv: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സഭയോടു: ഈ ദുഷ്ടമനുഷ്യരുടെ സകലപാപങ്ങളാലും നിങ്ങൾ സംഹരിക്കപ്പെടാതിരിക്കെണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു മാറിപ്പോകുവിൻ; അവർക്കുള്ള യാതൊന്നിനെയും തൊടരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He warned the assembly, "Move back from the tents of these wicked men! Do not touch anything belonging to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins."
chapters.nkjv: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Depart now from the tents of these wicked men! Touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins."
chapters.kjv: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ കോരഹ്, ദാഥാൻ, അബീരാം എന്നവരുടെ വാസസ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലുംനിന്നു മാറിപ്പോയി. എന്നാൽ ദാഥാനും അബീരാമും പുറത്തു വന്നു: അവരും അവരുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും പുത്രന്മാരും കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളും താന്താങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരവാതിൽക്കൽനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing with their wives, children and little ones at the entrances to their tents.
chapters.nkjv: So they got away from around the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little children.
chapters.kjv: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ പറഞ്ഞതു: ഈ സകലപ്രവൃത്തികളും ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ എന്നെ അയച്ചു; ഞാൻ സ്വമേധയായി ഒന്നും ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇതിനാൽ അറിയും:
chapters.niv: Then Moses said, "This is how you will know that the Lord has sent me to do all these things and that it was not my idea:
chapters.nkjv: And Moses said: "By this you shall know that the Lord has sent me to do all these works, for Ihave not donethem of my own will.
chapters.kjv: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

chapters.ml: സകലമനുഷ്യരും മരിക്കുന്നതു പോലെ ഇവർ മരിക്കയോ സകലമനുഷ്യർക്കും ഭവിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഇവർക്കു ഭവിക്കയോ ചെയ്താൽ യഹോവ എന്നെ അയച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: If these men die a natural death and suffer the fate of all mankind, then the Lord has not sent me.
chapters.nkjv: If these men die naturally like all men, or if they are visited by the common fate of all men, then the Lord has not sent me.
chapters.kjv: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ ഒരു അപൂർവ്വകാര്യം പ്രവർത്തിക്കയും ഭൂമി വായ് പിളർന്നു അവരെയും അവർക്കുള്ള സകലത്തെയും വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളകയും അവർ ജീവനോടു പാതാളത്തിലേക്കു ഇറങ്ങുകയും ചെയ്താൽ അവർ യഹോവയെ നിരസിച്ചു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: But if the Lord brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the realm of the dead, then you will know that these men have treated the Lord with contempt."
chapters.nkjv: But if the Lord creates a new thing, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the pit, then you will understand that these men have rejected the Lord."
chapters.kjv: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഈ വാക്കുകളെല്ലാം പറഞ്ഞു തീർന്നപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ കീഴെ ഭൂമി പിളർന്നു.
chapters.niv: As soon as he finished saying all this, the ground under them split apart
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, as he finished speaking all these words, that the ground split apart under them,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:

chapters.ml: ഭൂമി വായ്തുറന്നു അവരെയും അവരുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങളെയും കോരഹിനോടു ചേർന്നിട്ടുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും അവരുടെ സർവ്വസമ്പത്തിനെയും വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, and all those associated with Korah, together with their possessions.
chapters.nkjv: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the men with Korah, with all their goods.
chapters.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

chapters.ml: അവരും അവരോടു ചേർന്നിട്ടുള്ള എല്ലാവരും ജീവനോടെ പാതാളത്തിലേക്കു ഇറങ്ങി; ഭൂമി അവരുടെമേൽ അടകയും അവർ സഭയുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു നശിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They went down alive into the realm of the dead, with everything they owned; the earth closed over them, and they perished and were gone from the community.
chapters.nkjv: So they and all those with them went down alive into the pit; the earth closed over them, and they perished from among the assembly.
chapters.kjv: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ചുറ്റും ഇരുന്ന യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഒക്കെയും അവരുടെ നിലവിളി കേട്ടു: ഭൂമി നമ്മെയും വഴുങ്ങിക്കളയരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: At their cries, all the Israelites around them fled, shouting, "The earth is going to swallow us too!"
chapters.nkjv: Then all Israel who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, "Lest the earth swallow us up also!"
chapters.kjv: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയിങ്കൽനിന്നു തീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ധൂപം കാട്ടിയ ഇരുനൂറ്റമ്പതുപേരെയും ദഹിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.
chapters.nkjv: And a fire came out from the Lord and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who were offering incense.
chapters.kjv: And there came out a fire from the LORD , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതനായ അഹരോന്റെ മകൻ എലെയാസാരിനോടു അവൻ എരിതീയുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു ധൂപകലശങ്ങൾ എടുപ്പാൻ പറക; അവ വിശുദ്ധമാകുന്നു; തീ അങ്ങോട്ടു തട്ടിക്കളകയും ചെയ്ക;
chapters.niv: "Tell Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, to remove the censers from the charred remains and scatter the coals some distance away, for the censers are holy—
chapters.nkjv: "Tell Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, to pick up the censers out of the blaze, for they are holy, and scatter the fire some distance away.
chapters.kjv: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

chapters.ml: പാപം ചെയ്തു തങ്ങൾക്കു ജീവനാശം വരുത്തിയ ഇവരുടെ ധൂപകലശങ്ങൾ യാഗപീഠം, പൊതിവാൻ അടിച്ചു തകിടാക്കണം; അതു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതിനാൽ വിശുദ്ധമാകുന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു അതു ഒരു അടയാളമായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: the censers of the men who sinned at the cost of their lives. Hammer the censers into sheets to overlay the altar, for they were presented before the Lord and have become holy. Let them be a sign to the Israelites."
