chapters.niv: The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were: through Hanok, the Hanokite clan; through Pallu, the Palluite clan;
chapters.nkjv: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. The children of Reuben were: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
chapters.kjv: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

chapters.ml: ഹെസ്രോനിൽനിന്നു ഹെസ്രോന്യ കുടുംബം; കർമ്മിയിൽനിന്നു കർമ്മ്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Karmi, the Karmite clan.
chapters.nkjv: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
chapters.kjv: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

chapters.ml: ഇവയാകുന്നു രൂബേന്യകുടുംബങ്ങൾ; അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പത്തിമൂവായിരത്തെഴുനൂറ്റി മുപ്പതു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Reuben; those numbered were 43,730.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of the Reubenites: those who were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

chapters.ml: പല്ലൂവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: എലീയാബ്.
chapters.niv: The son of Pallu was Eliab,
chapters.nkjv: And the son of Pallu was Eliab.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

chapters.ml: എലീയാബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: നെമൂവേൽ, ദാഥാൻ, അബീരാം. യഹോവെക്കു വിരോധമായി കലഹിച്ചപ്പോൾ കോരഹിന്റെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ മോശെക്കും അഹരോന്നും വിരോധമായി കലഹിച്ച സംഘ സദസ്യന്മാരായ ദാഥാനും അബീരാമും ഇവർ തന്നേ;
chapters.niv: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. The same Dathan and Abiram were the community officials who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and were among Korah’s followers when they rebelled against the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram, representatives of the congregation, who contended against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah, when they contended against the Lord;
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD :

chapters.ml: ഭൂമി വായി തുറന്നു അവരെയും കേരഹിനെയും വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളകയും തീ ഇരുനൂറ്റമ്പതു പേരെ ദഹിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്ത സമയം ആ കൂട്ടം മരിച്ചു; അവർ ഒരു അടയാളമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.
chapters.nkjv: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died, when the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men; and they became a sign.
chapters.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കോരഹിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ മരിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: The line of Korah, however, did not die out.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless the children of Korah did not die.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: നെമൂവേലിൽനിന്നു നെമൂവേല്യകുടുംബം; യാമീനിൽനിന്നു യാമീന്യകുടുംബം; യാഖീനിൽനിന്നു യാഖീന്യകുടുംബം;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Simeon by their clans were: through Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; through Jamin, the Jaminite clan; through Jakin, the Jakinite clan;
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Simeon according to their families were: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
chapters.kjv: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

chapters.ml: സേരഹിൽനിന്നു സേരഹ്യകുടുംബം; ശാവൂലിൽനിന്നു ശാവൂല്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: through Zerah, the Zerahite clan; through Shaul, the Shaulite clan.
chapters.nkjv: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
chapters.kjv: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോന്യകുടുംബങ്ങളായ ഇവർ ഇരുപത്തീരായിരത്തിരുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Simeon; those numbered were 22,200.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of the Simeonites: twenty-two thousand two hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

chapters.ml: ഗാദിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: സെഫോനിൽനിന്നു സെഫോന്യകുടുംബം; ഹഗ്ഗിയിൽനിന്നു ഹഗ്ഗീയകുടുംബം; ശൂനിയിൽനിന്നു ശൂനീയകുടുംബം;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Gad by their clans were: through Zephon, the Zephonite clan; through Haggi, the Haggite clan; through Shuni, the Shunite clan;
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Gad according to their families were: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
chapters.kjv: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

chapters.ml: ഒസ്നിയിൽനിന്നു ഒസ്നീയകുടുംബം; ഏരിയിൽനിന്നു ഏർയ്യകുടുംബം;
chapters.niv: through Ozni, the Oznite clan; through Eri, the Erite clan;
chapters.nkjv: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
chapters.kjv: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

chapters.ml: അരോദിൽനിന്നു അരോദ്യകുടുംബം; അരേലിയിൽനിന്നു അരേല്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: through Arodi, the Arodite clan; through Areli, the Arelite clan.
chapters.nkjv: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
chapters.kjv: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരായി ഗാദ് പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങളായ ഇവർ നാല്പതിനായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Gad; those numbered were 40,500.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them: forty thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഏരും ഓനാനും ആയിരുന്നു; ഏരും ഒനാനും കനാൻ ദേശത്തു വെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Er and Onan were sons of Judah, but they died in Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: ശേലയിൽനിന്നു ശേലാന്യകുടുംബം; ഫേരെസിൽനിന്നു ഫേരെസ്യകുടുംബം; സേരഹിൽനിന്നു സേരഹ്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Judah by their clans were: through Shelah, the Shelanite clan; through Perez, the Perezite clan; through Zerah, the Zerahite clan.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Judah according to their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Parzites; of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

chapters.ml: ഫേരെസിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഹെസ്രോനിൽനിന്നു ഹെസ്രോന്യകുടുംബം; ഹാമൂലിൽനിന്നു ഹാമൂല്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Perez were: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Hamul, the Hamulite clan.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരായി യെഹൂദാകുടുംബങ്ങളായ ഇവർ എഴുപത്താറായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of Judah according to those who were numbered of them: seventy-six thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബം കുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: തോലാവിൽ നിന്നു തോലാവ്യകുടുംബം; പൂവയിൽനിന്നു പൂവ്യകുടുംബം;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Issachar by their clans were: through Tola, the Tolaite clan; through Puah, the Puite clan;
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Issachar according to their families were: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puah, the family of the Punites;
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

chapters.ml: യാശൂബിൽനിന്നു യാശൂബ്യകുടുംബം; ശിമ്രോനിൽനിന്നു ശിമ്രോന്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: through Jashub, the Jashubite clan; through Shimron, the Shimronite clan.
chapters.nkjv: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
chapters.kjv: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരായി യിസ്സാഖാർകുടുംബങ്ങളായ ഇവർ അറുപത്തു നാലായിരത്തി മുന്നൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Issachar; those numbered were 64,300.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were numbered of them: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: സേരെദിൽനിന്നു സേരെദ്യകുടുംബം; ഏലോനിൽനിന്നു ഏലോന്യ കുടുംബം; യഹ്ളേലിൽനിന്നു യഹ്ളേല്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Zebulun by their clans were: through Sered, the Seredite clan; through Elon, the Elonite clan; through Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Zebulun according to their families were: of Sered, the family of the Sardites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരായി സെബൂലൂന്യകുടുംബങ്ങളായ ഇവർ അറുപതിനായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were numbered of them: sixty thousand five hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബം കുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: മനശ്ശെയും എഫ്രയീമും.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Joseph according to their families, by Manasseh and Ephraim, were:
chapters.kjv: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മാഖീരിൽനിന്നു മാഖീർയ്യകുടുംബം; മാഖീർ ഗിലെയാദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഗിലെയാദിൽനിന്നു ഗിലെയാദ്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Manasseh: through Makir, the Makirite clan (Makir was the father of Gilead); through Gilead, the Gileadite clan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir begot Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ഈയേസെരിൽ നിന്നു ഈയേസെർയ്യകുടുംബം; ഹേലെക്കിൽനിന്നു ഹേലെക്ക്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: These were the descendants of Gilead: through Iezer, the Iezerite clan; through Helek, the Helekite clan;
chapters.nkjv: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

chapters.ml: അസ്രീയേലിൽനിന്നു അസ്രീയേല്യകുടുംബം; ശേഖെമിൽ നിന്നാു ശേഖെമ്യകുടുംബം;
chapters.niv: through Asriel, the Asrielite clan; through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;
chapters.nkjv: of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
chapters.kjv: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

chapters.ml: ശെമീദാവിൽനിന്നു ശെമീദാവ്യകുടുംബം; ഹേഫെരിൽ നിന്നു ഹേഫെർയ്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.
chapters.nkjv: of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
chapters.kjv: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

chapters.ml: ഹേഫെരിന്റെ മകനായ സെലോഫഹാദിന്നു പുത്രിമാർ അല്ലാതെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായില്ല; സെലോഫഹാദിന്റെ പുത്രിമാർ മഹ്ളാ, നോവാ, ഹൊഗ്ള, മിൽക്കാ, തിർസാ എന്നിവരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons; he had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.)
chapters.nkjv: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരായി മനശ്ശെകുടുംബങ്ങളായ ഇവർ അമ്പത്തീരായിരത്തെഴുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: ശൂഥേലഹിൽനിന്നു ശൂഥേലഹ്യകുടുംബം; ബേഖെരിൽനിന്നു ബേഖെർയ്യകുടുംബം; തഹനിൽ നിന്നു തഹന്യകുടുംബം,
chapters.niv: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: through Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; through Beker, the Bekerite clan; through Tahan, the Tahanite clan.
chapters.nkjv: These are the sons of Ephraim according to their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites; of Becher, the family of the Bachrites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

chapters.ml: ശൂഥേലഹിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ഏരാനിൽനിന്നു ഏരാന്യകടുംബം.
chapters.niv: These were the descendants of Shuthelah: through Eran, the Eranite clan.
chapters.nkjv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
chapters.kjv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവരായി എഫ്രയീമ്യകുടുംബങ്ങളായ ഇവർ മുപ്പത്തീരായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറുപേർ. ഇവർ കുടുംബം കുടുംബമായി യോസേഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500. These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were numbered of them: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph according to their families.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: ബേലയിൽനിന്നു ബേലാവ്യകുടുംബം; അസ്ബേലിൽനിന്നു അസ്ബേല്യകുടുംബം; അഹീരാമിൽനിന്നു അഹീരാമ്യകുടുംബം;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were: through Bela, the Belaite clan; through Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; through Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Benjamin according to their families were: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
chapters.kjv: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

chapters.ml: ശെഫൂമിൽനിന്നു ശെഫൂമ്യകുടുംബം; ഹൂഫാമിൽനിന്നു ഹൂഫാമ്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.
chapters.nkjv: of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
chapters.kjv: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

chapters.ml: ബേലിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ അർദ്ദും നാമാനും ആയിരുന്നു; അർദ്ദിൽനിന്നു അർദ്ദ്യകുടുംബം; നാമാനിൽനിന്നു നാമാന്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Bela through Ard and Naaman were: through Ard, the Ardite clan; through Naaman, the Naamite clan.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: ofArd, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard , the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ബേന്യാമീന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ; അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പത്തയ്യായിരത്തറുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.
chapters.nkjv: These are the sons of Benjamin according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

chapters.ml: ദാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: ശൂഹാമിൽനിന്നു ശൂഹാമ്യ കുടുംബം; ഇവർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ദാന്യ കുടുംബങ്ങൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan:
chapters.nkjv: These are the sons of Dan according to their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan according to their families.
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

chapters.ml: ശൂഹാമ്യകുടുംബങ്ങളിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ എല്ലാംകൂടി അറുപത്തുനാലായിരത്തി നാനാറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.
chapters.nkjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: ആശേരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: യിമ്നയിൽനിന്നു യിമ്നീയകുടുംബം; യിശ്വയിൽനിന്നു യിശ്വീയ കുടുംബം; ബെരീയാവിൽനിന്നു ബെരീയാവ്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Asher by their clans were: through Imnah, the Imnite clan; through Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; through Beriah, the Beriite clan;
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Asher according to their families were: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites; of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

chapters.ml: ബെരീയാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കുടുംബംങ്ങൾ ആരെന്നാൽ: ഹേബെരിൽനിന്നു ഹേബെർയ്യകുടുംബം; മൽക്കീയേലിൽനിന്നു മൽക്കീയേല്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: and through the descendants of Beriah: through Heber, the Heberite clan; through Malkiel, the Malkielite clan.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

chapters.ml: ആശേരിന്റെ പുത്രിക്കു സാറാ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)
chapters.nkjv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
chapters.kjv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ ആശേർപുത്രന്മാരുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങൾ. അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ അമ്പത്തുമൂവായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were numbered of them: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: യഹ്സേലിൽനിന്നു യഹ്സേല്യകുടുംബം; ഗൂനിയിൽനിന്നു ഗൂന്യകുടുംബം;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans were: through Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; through Guni, the Gunite clan;
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Naphtali according to their families were: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

chapters.ml: യേസെരിൽനിന്നു യേസെർയ്യകുടുംബം. ശില്ലോമിൽനിന്നു ശില്ലോമ്യ കുടുംബം
chapters.niv: through Jezer, the Jezerite clan; through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.
chapters.nkjv: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
chapters.kjv: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ കുടുംബം കുടുംബമായി നഫ്താലികുടുംബങ്ങൾ ആകുന്നു; അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പത്തയ്യായിരത്തി നാനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ട ഇവർ ആറു ലക്ഷത്തോരായിരത്തെഴുനൂറ്റി മുപ്പതു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.
chapters.nkjv: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
chapters.kjv: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: ഇവർക്കു ആളെണ്ണത്തിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം ദേശത്തെ അവകാശമായി വിഭാഗിച്ചു കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.
chapters.nkjv: "To these the land shall be divided as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
chapters.kjv: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

chapters.ml: ആളേറെയുള്ളവർക്കു അവകാശം ഏറെയും ആൾ കുറവുള്ളവർക്കു അവകാശം കുറെച്ചും കൊടുക്കേണം; ഓരോരുത്തന്നു അവനവന്റെ ആളെണ്ണത്തിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം അവകാശം കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.
chapters.nkjv: To a large tribe you shall give a larger inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a smaller inheritance. Each shall be given its inheritance according to those who were numbered of them.
chapters.kjv: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തെ ചീട്ടിട്ടു വിഭാഗിക്കേണം; അതതു പിതൃഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ പേരിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം അവർക്കു അവകാശം ലഭിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.
chapters.nkjv: But the land shall be divided by lot; they shall inherit according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

chapters.ml: ആൾ ഏറെയുള്ളവർക്കും കുറെയുള്ളവർക്കും അവകാശം ചീട്ടിട്ടു വിഭാഗിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups."
chapters.nkjv: According to the lot their inheritance shall be divided between the larger and the smaller."
chapters.kjv: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടവർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആരെന്നാൽ: ഗേർശോനിൽനിന്നു ഗേർശോന്യകുടുംബം; കെഹാത്തിൽനിന്നു കെഹാത്യകുടുംബം; മെരാരിയിൽനിന്നു മെരാർയ്യകുടുംബം.
chapters.niv: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.
chapters.nkjv: And these are those who were numbered of the Levites according to their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
chapters.kjv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യകുടുംബങ്ങൾ ആവിതു: ലിബ്നീയകുടുംബം; ഹെബ്രോന്യകുടുംബം; മഹ്ളീയകുടുംബം; മൂശ്യകുടുംബം; കോരഹ്യ കുടുംബം. കെഹാത്ത് അമ്രാമിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: These also were Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, the Korahite clan. (Kohath was the forefather of Amram;
chapters.nkjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begot Amram.
chapters.kjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

chapters.ml: അമ്രാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു യോഖേബേദ് എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുവെച്ചു ലേവിക്കു ജനിച്ച മകൾ; അവൾ അമ്രാമിന്നു അഹരോനെയും മോശെയെയും അവരുടെ സഹോദരിയായ മിർയ്യാമിനെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, who was born to the Levites in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.
chapters.nkjv: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and to Amram she bore Aaron and Moses and their sister Miriam.
chapters.kjv: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്നു നാദാബ്, അബീഹൂ, എലെയാസാർ, ഈഥാമാർ എന്നിവർ ജനിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.nkjv: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.kjv: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നാദാബും അബീഹൂവും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അന്യാഗ്നി കത്തിച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the Lord with unauthorized fire.)
chapters.nkjv: And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered profane fire before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഒരു മാസം പ്രായംമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു അവരിൽ എണ്ണപ്പെട്ട ആണുങ്ങൾ ആകെ ഇരുപത്തുമൂവായിരം പേർ; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അവർക്കു അവകാശം കൊടുക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവരെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ എണ്ണിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.
chapters.nkjv: Now those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and above; for they were not numbered among the other children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given to them among the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യെരീഹോവിന്റെ സമീപത്തു യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെ മോവാബ് സമഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ എണ്ണിയപ്പോൾ മോശെയും പുരോഹിതനായ എലെയാസാരും എണ്ണിയവർ ഇവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.nkjv: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, acrossfrom Jericho.
chapters.kjv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മോശെയും അഹരോൻ പുരോഹിതനും സീനായിമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ എണ്ണിയപ്പോൾ അവർ എണ്ണിയവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും ഇവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.
chapters.nkjv: But among these there was not a man of those who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they numbered the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Sinai.
chapters.kjv: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

chapters.ml: അവർ മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോകും എന്നു യഹോവ അവരെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരുന്നു. യെഫുന്നെയുടെ മകൻ കാലേബും നൂന്റെ മകൻ യോശുവയും ഒഴികെ അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും ശേഷിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: For the Lord had told those Israelites they would surely die in the wilderness, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord had said of them, "They shall surely die in the wilderness." So there was not left a man of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോസേഫിന്റെ മകനായ മനശ്ശെയുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങളിൽ മനശ്ശെയുടെ മകനായ മാഖീരിന്റെ മകനായ ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ മകനായ ഹേഫെരിന്റെ മകനായ സെലോഫഹാദിന്റെ പുത്രിമാർ അടുത്തുവന്നു. അവന്റെ പുത്രിമാർ മഹ്ളാ, നോവ, ഹോഗ്ള, മിൽക്കാ, തിർസാ, എന്നിവരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah. They came forward
chapters.nkjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, from the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

chapters.ml: അവർ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ മോശെയുടെയും എലെയാസാർപുരോഹിതന്റെയും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെയും സർവ്വ സഭയുടെയും മുമ്പാകെ നിന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting and said,
chapters.nkjv: And they stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the leaders and all the congregation, by the doorway of the tabernacle of meeting, saying:
chapters.kjv: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പൻ മരുഭൂമിയില വെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി; എന്നാൽ അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു വിരോധമായി കോരഹിനോടു കൂടിയവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ചേർന്നിരുന്നില്ല; അവൻ സ്വന്തപാപത്താൽ അത്രേ മരിച്ചതു; അവന്നു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among Korah’s followers, who banded together against the Lord , but he died for his own sin and left no sons.
chapters.nkjv: "Our father died in the wilderness; but he was not in the company of those who gathered together against the Lord, in company with Korah, but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.
chapters.kjv: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്നു മകൻ ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ പേർ കുടുംബത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇല്ലാതെയാകുന്നതു എന്തു? അപ്പന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു അവകാസം തരേണം.
chapters.niv: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s relatives."
chapters.nkjv: Why should the name of our father be removed from among his family because he had no son? Give us a possession among our father’s brothers."
chapters.kjv: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

chapters.ml: മോശെ അവരുടെ കാര്യം യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Moses brought their case before the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: So Moses brought their case before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയേൂടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: and the Lord said to him,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: സെലോഫ ഹാദിന്റെ പുത്രിമാർ പറയുന്നതു ശരിതന്നേ; അവരുടെ അപ്പന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ അവർക്കു ഒരു അവകാശം കൊടുക്കേണം; അവരുടെ അപ്പന്റെ അവകാശം അവർക്കു കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "What Zelophehad’s daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father’s relatives and give their father’s inheritance to them.
chapters.nkjv: "The daughters of Zelophehad speak whatis right; you shall surely give them a possession of inheritance among their father’s brothers, and cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
chapters.kjv: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: ഒരുത്തൻ മകനില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചാൽ അവന്റെ അവകാശം അവന്റെ മകൾക്കു കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, give his inheritance to his daughter.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു മകൾ ഇല്ലാതിരുന്നാൽ അവന്റെ അവകാശം അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
chapters.nkjv: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
chapters.kjv: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു സഹോദരന്മാർ ഇല്ലാതിരുന്നാൽ അവന്റെ അവകാശം അവന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു കൊടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
chapters.nkjv: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
chapters.kjv: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അപ്പന്നു സഹോദരന്മാർ ഇല്ലാതിരുന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിൽ അവന്റെ അടുത്ത ചാർച്ചക്കാരന്നു അവന്റെ അവകാശം കൊടുക്കേണം അവൻ അതു കൈവശമാക്കേണം; ഇതു യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു ന്യായപ്രമാണം ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to have the force of law for the Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the relative closest to him in his family, and he shall possess it.’ " And it shall be to the children of Israel a statute of judgment, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: ഈ അബാരീംമലയിൽ കയറി ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന ദേശം നോക്കുക.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go up this mountain in the Abarim Range and see the land I have given the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord said to Moses: "Go up into this Mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അതു കണ്ട ശേഷം നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അഹരോനെപ്പോലെ നീയും നിന്റെ ജനത്തോടു ചേരും.
chapters.niv: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,
chapters.nkjv: And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered.
chapters.kjv: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

chapters.ml: സഭയുടെ കലഹത്തിങ്കൽ നിങ്ങൾ സീൻമരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു അവർ കാൺകെ വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ എന്നെ ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കാതെ എന്റെ കല്പനയെ മറുത്തതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ. സീൻമരുഭൂമിയിൽ കാദേശിലെ കലഹജലം അതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes." (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)
chapters.nkjv: For in the Wilderness of Zin, during the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against My command to hallow Me at the waters before their eyes." (These are the waters of Meribah, at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.)
chapters.kjv: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മോശെ യഹോവയോടു:
chapters.niv: Moses said to the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses spoke to the Lord, saying:
chapters.kjv: And Moses spake unto the LORD , saying,

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ സഭ ഇടയനില്ലാത്ത ആടുകളെപ്പോലെ ആകാതിരിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവർക്കു മുമ്പായി പോകുവാനും അവർക്കു മുമ്പായി വരുവാനും അവരെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകുവാനും
chapters.niv: "May the Lord , the God who gives breath to all living things, appoint someone over this community
chapters.nkjv: "Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
chapters.kjv: Let the LORD , the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

chapters.ml: അകത്തുകൊണ്ടു പോകുവാനും സകല ജഡത്തിന്റെയും ആത്മാക്കളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ സഭയുടെ മേൽ ഒരാളെ നിയമിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: to go out and come in before them, one who will lead them out and bring them in, so the Lord ’s people will not be like sheep without a shepherd."
chapters.nkjv: who may go out before them and go in before them, who may lead them out and bring them in, that the congregation of the Lord may not be like sheep which have no shepherd."
chapters.kjv: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: എന്റെ ആത്മാവുള്ള പുരുഷനായി നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവയെ വിളിച്ചു
chapters.niv: So the Lord said to Moses, "Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit of leadership, and lay your hand on him.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Moses: "Take Joshua the son of Nun with you, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him;
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചു അവനെ പുരോഹിതനായ എലെയാസാരിന്റെയും സർവ്വസഭയുടെയും മുമ്പാകെ നിർത്തി അവർ കാൺകെ അവന്നു ആജ്ഞകൊടുക്ക.
chapters.niv: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.
chapters.nkjv: set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and inaugurate him in their sight.
chapters.kjv: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സഭയെല്ലാം അനുസരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്റെ മഹിമയിൽ ഒരംശം അവന്റെ മേൽ വെക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall give some of your authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുരോഹിതനായ എലെയാസാരിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിൽക്കേണം; അവൻ അവന്നു വേണ്ടി യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഊരീംമുഖാന്തരം അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിക്കേണം; അവനും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സർവ്വസഭയും അവന്റെ വാക്കുപ്രകാരം വരികയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the Lord . At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in."
chapters.nkjv: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire before the Lord for him by the judgment of the Urim. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and all the children of Israel with him—all the congregation."
chapters.kjv: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD : at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെ ചെയ്തു; അവൻ യോശുവയെ വിളിച്ചു പുരോഹിതനായ എലെയാസാരിന്റെയും സർവ്വസഭയുടെയു മുമ്പാകെ നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
chapters.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെമേൽ കൈവെച്ചു യഹോവ മോശെമുഖാന്തരം കല്പിച്ചതുപേലെ അവന്നു ആജ്ഞ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the Lord instructed through Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And he laid his hands on him and inaugurated him, just as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
chapters.kjv: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Moses,
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള എന്റെ ഭോജനമായ വഴിപാടു തക്കസമയത്തു എനിക്കു അർപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ജാഗ്രതയായിരിപ്പാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു കല്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Make sure that you present to me at the appointed time my food offerings, as an aroma pleasing to me.’
chapters.nkjv: "Command the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire as a sweet aroma to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.’
chapters.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

chapters.ml: നീ അവരോടു പറയേണ്ടതു: നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു അർപ്പിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന ദഹനയാഗം എന്തെന്നാൽ: നാൾതോറും നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നായി: ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഊനമില്ലാത്ത രണ്ടു കുഞ്ഞാടു.
chapters.niv: Say to them: ‘This is the food offering you are to present to the Lord : two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.
chapters.nkjv: "And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the Lord: two male lambs in their first year without blemish, day by day, as a regular burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD ; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

chapters.ml: ഒരു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെ രാവിലേയും മറ്റെ കുഞ്ഞാടിനെ വൈകുന്നേരത്തും യാഗം കഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
chapters.nkjv: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, the other lamb you shall offer in the evening,
chapters.kjv: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

chapters.ml: ഇടിച്ചെടുത്ത എണ്ണ കാൽ ഹീൻ ചേർത്ത ഒരിടങ്ങഴി മാവു ഭോജനയാഗമായും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.
chapters.nkjv: and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil.
chapters.kjv: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

chapters.ml: ഇതു യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗമായി സീനായിപർവ്വതത്തിൽവെച്ചു നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ട നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗം.
chapters.niv: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Itis a regular burnt offering which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗം കുഞ്ഞാടൊന്നിന്നു കാൽ ഹീൻ മദ്യം ആയിരിക്കേണം; അതു യഹോവെക്കു പാനീയയാഗമായി വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ ഒഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the Lord at the sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: And its drink offering shallbe one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in a holy place you shall pour out the drink to the Lord as an offering.
chapters.kjv: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.

chapters.ml: മറ്റെ കുഞ്ഞാടിനെ വൈകുന്നേരത്തു യാഗം കഴിക്കേണം; അതിനെ രാവിലത്തെ ഭോജനയാഗവും അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗവുംപോലെ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Offer the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you offer in the morning. This is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: The other lamb you shall offer in the evening; as the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you shall offer it as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it , a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ശബ്ബത്ത് നാളിലോ ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഊനമില്ലാത്ത രണ്ടു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നായി എണ്ണചേർത്ത രണ്ടിടങ്ങഴി മാവും അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗവും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And on the Sabbath day two lambs in their first year, without blemish, and two-tenths ofanephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering—
chapters.kjv: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

chapters.ml: നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗത്തിന്നും പുറമെ ഇതു ശബ്ബത്തുതോറുമുള്ള ഹോമയാഗം.
chapters.niv: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
chapters.nkjv: thisis the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering.
chapters.kjv: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ മാസാരംഭങ്ങളിൽ നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നായി രണ്ടു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും
chapters.niv: " ‘On the first of every month, present to the Lord a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.nkjv: ‘At the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the Lord: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish;
chapters.kjv: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD ; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

chapters.ml: കാള ഒന്നിന്നു ഭോജനയാഗമായി എണ്ണചേർത്ത മൂന്നിടങ്ങഴി മാവും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്നു ഭോജനയാഗമായി എണ്ണചേർത്ത രണ്ടിടങ്ങഴി മാവും
chapters.niv: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil;
chapters.nkjv: three-tenths ofanephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths ofanephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
chapters.kjv: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

chapters.ml: കുഞ്ഞാടൊന്നിന്നു ഭോജനയാഗമായി എണ്ണചേർത്ത ഒരിടങ്ങഴി മാവും അർപ്പിക്കേണം. അതു ഹോമയാഗം; യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: and one-tenth ofanephah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ പാനീയയാഗം കാളയൊന്നിന്നു അര ഹീൻ വീഞ്ഞും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്നു ഹീനിന്റെ മൂന്നിൽ ഒന്നും കുഞ്ഞാടൊന്നിന്നു കാൽ ഹീനും ആയിരിക്കേണം; ഇതു മാസാന്തരം അമാവാസിതോറുമുള്ള ഹോമയാഗം.
chapters.niv: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin ; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.
chapters.nkjv: Their drink offering shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.
chapters.kjv: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

chapters.ml: നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗത്തിന്നും പുറമെ പാപയാഗമായി യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the Lord as a sin offering.
chapters.nkjv: Also one kid of the goats as a sin offering to the Lord shall be offered, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
chapters.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം മാസം പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതി യഹോവയുടെ പെസഹ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the Lord ’s Passover is to be held.
chapters.nkjv: ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month is the Passover of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ആമാസം പതിനഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി പെരുനാൾ ആയിരിക്കേണം. ഏഴു ദിവസം പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പം തിന്നേണം.
chapters.niv: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.
chapters.nkjv: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
chapters.kjv: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം ദിവസം വിശുദ്ധസഭായോഗം കൂടേണം; അന്നു സാമാന്യവേലയൊന്നും ചെയ്യരുതു.
chapters.niv: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.nkjv: On the first day youshallhave a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.
chapters.kjv: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നായി രണ്ടു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും ദഹനയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം; അവ ഊനമില്ലാത്തവ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Present to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.nkjv: And you shall present an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to the Lord: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.
chapters.kjv: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD ; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗം എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത മാവു ആയിരിക്കേണം; കാള ഒന്നിന്നു മൂന്നിടങ്ങഴിയും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്നു രണ്ടിടങ്ങഴിയും
chapters.niv: With each bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
chapters.nkjv: Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths ofanephah you shall offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;
chapters.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

chapters.ml: ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാട്ടിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നു ഓരോ ഇടങ്ങഴിയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.nkjv: you shall offer one-tenth ofanephah for each of the seven lambs;
chapters.kjv: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിപ്പാൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി ഒരു കോലാട്ടിനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
chapters.nkjv: also one goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
chapters.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

chapters.ml: നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗമായ രാവിലത്തെ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നു പുറമെ ഇവ അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
chapters.nkjv: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a regular burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ഏഴു നാളും യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി ദഹനയാഗത്തിന്റെ ഭോജനം ദിവസംപ്രതി അർപ്പിക്കേണം. നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗത്തിന്നും പുറമെ ഇതു അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: In this way present the food offering every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the Lord ; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
chapters.nkjv: In this manner you shall offer the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet aroma to the Lord; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
chapters.kjv: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD : it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം ദിവസം വിശുദ്ധസഭായോഗം കൂടേണം; അന്നു സാമാന്യവേലയൊന്നും ചെയ്യരുതു.
chapters.niv: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.nkjv: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.
chapters.kjv: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

chapters.ml: വാരോത്സവമായ ആദ്യഫലദിവസത്തിൽ പുതിയധാന്യംകൊണ്ടു ഒരു ഭോജനയാഗം കൊണ്ടുവരുമ്പോഴും വിശുദ്ധസഭായോഗം കൂടേണം. അന്നു സാമാന്യവേലയൊന്നും ചെയ്യരുതു.
chapters.niv: " ‘On the day of firstfruits, when you present to the Lord an offering of new grain during the Festival of Weeks, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new grain offering to the Lord at your Feastof Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.
chapters.kjv: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD , after your weeks be out , ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നായി രണ്ടു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: You shall present a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to the Lord: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year,
chapters.kjv: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗമായി എണ്ണചേർത്ത മാവു, കാള ഒന്നിന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി മൂന്നും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി രണ്ടും
chapters.niv: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
chapters.nkjv: with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths ofanephah for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
chapters.kjv: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

chapters.ml: ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാട്ടിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി ഓരോന്നും
chapters.niv: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.nkjv: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
chapters.kjv: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിപ്പാൻ ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.
chapters.nkjv: also one kid of the goats, to make atonement for you.
chapters.kjv: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

chapters.ml: നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നും അവയുടെ പാനീയയാഗത്തിന്നും പുറമെ നിങ്ങൾ ഇവ അർപ്പിക്കേണം; അവ ഊനമില്ലാത്തവ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Offer these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect.
chapters.nkjv: Be sure they are without blemish. You shall present them with their drink offerings, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering.
chapters.kjv: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി വിശുദ്ധ സഭായോഗം കൂടേണം; അന്നു സാമാന്യ വേലയൊന്നും ചെയ്യരുതു; അതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു കാഹളനാദോത്സവം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘On the first day of the seventh month hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. It is a day for you to sound the trumpets.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work. For you it is a day of blowing the trumpets.
chapters.kjv: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.

chapters.ml: അന്നു നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു സൊരഭ്യവാസനയായ ഹോമയാഗമായി ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: As an aroma pleasing to the Lord , offer a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.nkjv: You shall offer a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to the Lord: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗം എണ്ണചേർത്ത മാവു കാളെക്കു ഇടങ്ങഴി മൂന്നും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി രണ്ടും,
chapters.niv: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; with the ram, two-tenths ;
chapters.nkjv: Their grain offering shallbe fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths ofanephah for the bull, two-tenths for the ram,
chapters.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,

chapters.ml: ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാട്ടിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി ഓരോന്നും ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.nkjv: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
chapters.kjv: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം കഴിപ്പാൻ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
chapters.nkjv: also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
chapters.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:

chapters.ml: അമാവാസിയിലെ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നും നാൾതോറുമുള്ള ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നും അവെക്കു നിയമപ്രകാരമുള്ള പാനീയയാഗങ്ങൾക്കും പുറമെ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗമായി തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are food offerings presented to the Lord , a pleasing aroma.
chapters.nkjv: besides the burnt offering with its grain offering for the New Moon, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, as a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം മാസം പത്താം തിയ്യതി വിശുദ്ധസഭായോഗം കൂടേണം; അന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ആത്മതപനം ചെയ്യേണം; വേലയൊന്നും ചെയ്യരുതു.
chapters.niv: " ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.
chapters.nkjv: ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls; you shall not do any work.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവെക്കു സുഗന്ധവാസനയായ ഹോമയാഗമായി ഒരു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം; അവ ഊനമില്ലാത്തവ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.nkjv: You shall present a burnt offering to the Lordas a sweet aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.
chapters.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗം എണ്ണ ചേർത്ത മാവു കാളെക്കു ഇടങ്ങഴി മൂന്നും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി രണ്ടും
chapters.niv: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
chapters.nkjv: Their grain offering shallbeof fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths ofanephah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
chapters.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,

chapters.ml: ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാട്ടിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി ഓരോന്നും ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.nkjv: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
chapters.kjv: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

chapters.ml: പ്രായശ്ചിത്തയാഗത്തിന്നും നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നും പാനീയയാഗങ്ങൾക്കും പുറമെ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റന്നും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
chapters.nkjv: also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the sin offering for atonement, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
chapters.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം മാസം പതിനഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി വിശുദ്ധസഭായോഗം കൂടേണം; അന്നു സാമാന്യ വേലയൊന്നും ചെയ്യരുതു; ഏഴു ദിവസം യഹോവെക്കു ഉത്സവം അചരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the Lord for seven days.
chapters.nkjv: ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work, and you shall keep a feast to the Lord seven days.
chapters.kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗമായി പതിമൂന്നു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും രണ്ടു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള പതിന്നാലു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കേണം; അവ ഊനമില്ലാത്തവ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.nkjv: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to the Lord: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year. They shall be without blemish.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD ; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗം പതിമൂന്നു കാളയിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നു എണ്ണചേർത്ത മാവു ഇടങ്ങഴി മുമ്മൂന്നും രണ്ടു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നു ഇടങ്ങഴി ഈരണ്ടും
chapters.niv: With each of the thirteen bulls offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with each of the two rams, two-tenths;
chapters.nkjv: Their grain offering shallbeof fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths ofanephah for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for each of the two rams,
chapters.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,

chapters.ml: പതിന്നാലു കുഞ്ഞാട്ടിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്നും ഇടങ്ങഴി ഓരോന്നും ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and with each of the fourteen lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.nkjv: and one-tenth for each of the fourteen lambs;
chapters.kjv: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

chapters.ml: നിരന്തരഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നും അതിന്റെ പാനീയയാഗങ്ങൾക്കും പുറമെ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായി ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.nkjv: also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
chapters.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം ദിവസം നിങ്ങൾ പന്ത്രണ്ടു കാളക്കിടാവിനെയും രണ്ടു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഊനമില്ലാത്ത പതിന്നാലു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘On the second day offer twelve young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.nkjv: ‘On the second day present twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,
chapters.kjv: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ഭോജനയാഗവും പാനീയയാഗങ്ങളും കാള, ആട്ടുകൊറ്റൻ, കുഞ്ഞാടു എന്നിവയുടെ എണ്ണംപോലെയും നിയമംപോലെയും ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

chapters.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

chapters.nkjv: also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
chapters.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.

chapters.niv: " ‘On the eighth day hold a closing special assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.nkjv: ‘On the eighth day you shall have a sacred assembly. You shall do no customary work.
chapters.kjv: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവെക്കു സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായ ദഹനയാഗമായി ഒരു കാളയെയും ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഒരു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of one bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.nkjv: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to the Lord: one bull, one ram, seven lambs in their first year without blemish,
chapters.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD : one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

chapters.kjv: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

chapters.nkjv: also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
chapters.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

chapters.ml: ഇവയെ നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ നേർച്ചകളും സ്വമേധാദാനങ്ങളുമായ ഹോമയാഗങ്ങൾക്കും ഭോജനയാഗങ്ങൾക്കും പാനീയയാഗങ്ങൾക്കും പുറമെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉത്സവങ്ങളിൽ യഹോവെക്കു അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘In addition to what you vow and your freewill offerings, offer these to the Lord at your appointed festivals: your burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings and fellowship offerings.’ "
chapters.nkjv: ‘These you shall present to the Lord at your appointed feasts (besides your vowed offerings and your freewill offerings) as your burnt offerings and your grain offerings, as your drink offerings and your peace offerings.’ "
chapters.kjv: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും മോശെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Moses told the Israelites all that the Lord commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses told the children of Israel everything, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: മോശെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രപ്രധാനികളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന കാര്യം എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel: "This is what the Lord commands:
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, "This is the thing which the Lord has commanded:
chapters.kjv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു നേർച്ച നേരുകയോ ഒരു പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതം ദീക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ശപഥംചെയ്കയോ ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ വാക്കിന്നു ഭംഗം വരുത്താതെ തന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും നിവർത്തിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: When a man makes a vow to the Lord or takes an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word but must do everything he said.
chapters.nkjv: If a man makes a vow to the Lord, or swears an oath to bind himself by some agreement, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
chapters.kjv: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

chapters.ml: ഒരു സ്ത്രീ ബാല്യപ്രായത്തിൽ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു നേർച്ചനേർന്നു ഒരു പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതം നിശ്ചയിക്കയും
chapters.niv: "When a young woman still living in her father’s household makes a vow to the Lord or obligates herself by a pledge
chapters.nkjv: "Or if a woman makes a vow to the Lord, and binds herself by some agreement while in her father’s house in her youth,
chapters.kjv: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD , and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ അപ്പൻ അവളുടെ നേർച്ചയെയും അവൾ നിശ്ചയിച്ച പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു കേട്ടിട്ടു മിണ്ടാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ അവളുടെ എല്ലാനേർച്ചകളും അവൾ നിശ്ചയിച്ച പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതമൊക്കെയും സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.
chapters.nkjv: and her father hears her vow and the agreement by which she has bound herself, and her father holds his peace, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement with which she has bound herself shall stand.
chapters.kjv: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവളുടെ അപ്പൻ അവളുടെ എല്ലാനേർച്ചയെയും അവൾ നിശ്ചയിച്ച പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു കേൾക്കുന്ന നാളിൽ അവളോടു വിലക്കിയാൽ അവ സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കയില്ല; അവളുടെ അപ്പൻ അവളോടു വിലക്കുകകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ അവളോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the Lord will release her because her father has forbidden her.
chapters.nkjv: But if her father overrules her on the day that he hears, then none of her vows nor her agreements by which she has bound herself shall stand; and the Lord will release her, because her father overruled her.
chapters.kjv: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

chapters.ml: അവൾക്കു ഒരു നേർച്ചയോ വിചാരിക്കാതെ നിശ്ചയിച്ചുപോയ പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതമോ ഉള്ളപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: "If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself
chapters.nkjv: "If indeed she takes a husband, while bound by her vows or by a rash utterance from her lips by which she bound herself,
chapters.kjv: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഒരുത്തന്നു ഭാര്യയാകയും ഭർത്താവു അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു കേൾക്കുന്ന നാളിൽ മിണ്ടാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ അവളുടെ നേർച്ചകളും അവൾ നിശ്ചയിച്ച പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതവും സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.
chapters.nkjv: and her husband hears it, and makes no response to her on the day that he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her agreements by which she bound herself shall stand.
chapters.kjv: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഭർത്താവു അതു കേട്ട നാളിൽ അവളോടു വിലക്കിയാൽ അവളുടെ നേർച്ചയും അവൾ വിചാരിക്കാതെ നിശ്ചയിച്ചുപോയ പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതവും അവൻ ദുർബ്ബലപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു; യഹോവ അവളോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the Lord will release her.
chapters.nkjv: But if her husband overrules her on the day that he hears it, he shall make void her vow which she took and what she uttered with her lips, by which she bound herself, and the Lord will release her.
chapters.kjv: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.

chapters.ml: വിധവയോ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ടവളോ ചെയ്യുന്ന നേർച്ചയും പരിവർജ്ജനവ്രതവും എല്ലാം അവളുടെ മേൽ സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.
chapters.nkjv: "Also any vow of a widow or a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, shall stand against her.
chapters.kjv: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഭർത്താവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽവെച്ചു നേരുകയോ ഒരു പരിവർജ്ജനശപഥം ചെയ്കയോ ചെയ്തിട്ടു
chapters.niv: "If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath
chapters.nkjv: "If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound herself by an agreement with an oath,
chapters.kjv: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
