chapters.ml: ധാന്യവും വീഞ്ഞുമുള്ള ദേശത്തു യിസ്രായേൽ നിർഭയമായും യാക്കോബിൻ ഉറവു തനിച്ചും വസിക്കുന്നു; ആകാശം അവന്നു മഞ്ഞു പൊഴിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Israel will live in safety; Jacob will dwell secure in a land of grain and new wine, where the heavens drop dew.
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel shall dwell in safety, The fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine; His heavens shall also drop dew.
chapters.kjv: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലേ, നീ ഭാഗ്യവാൻ; നിനക്കു തുല്യൻ ആർ? യഹോവയാൽ രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ട ജനമേ, അവൻ നിന്റെ സഹായത്തിൻ പരിചയും നിന്റെ മഹിമയുടെ വാളും ആകുന്നു. നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾ നിന്നോടു അനുസരണം നടിക്കും. നീ അവരുടെ ഉന്നതങ്ങളിന്മേൽ നടകൊള്ളും.
chapters.niv: Blessed are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord ? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will tread on their heights."
chapters.nkjv: Happy are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord, The shield of your help And the sword of your majesty! Your enemies shall submit to you, And you shall tread down their high places."
chapters.kjv: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD , the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം മോശെ മോവാബ്സമഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു യെരീഹോവിന്നെതിരെയുള്ള നെബോപർവ്വതത്തിൽ ‌പിസ്ഗാമുകളിൽ കയറി; യഹോവ ദാൻവരെ ഗിലെയാദ്‌ദേശം ഒക്കെയും
chapters.niv: Then Moses climbed Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab to the top of Pisgah, across from Jericho. There the Lord showed him the whole land—from Gilead to Dan,
chapters.nkjv: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is across from Jericho. And the Lord showed him all the land of Gilead as far as Dan,
chapters.kjv: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിദേശമൊക്കെയും എഫ്രയീമിന്റെയും മനശ്ശെയുടെയും ദേശവും പടിഞ്ഞാറെ കടൽവരെ യെഹൂദാദേശം ഒക്കെയും
chapters.niv: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Mediterranean Sea,
chapters.nkjv: all Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea,
chapters.kjv: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

chapters.ml: തെക്കെദേശവും ഈന്തനഗരമായ യെരീഹോവിന്റെ താഴ്വീതിമുതൽ സോവാർവരെയുള്ള സമഭൂമിയും അവനെ കാണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: the Negev and the whole region from the Valley of Jericho, the City of Palms, as far as Zoar.
chapters.nkjv: the South, and the plain of the Valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar.
chapters.kjv: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിനോടും യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടും യാക്കോബിനോടും: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കു കൊടുക്കുമെന്നു സത്യംചെയ്ത ദേശം ഇതു തന്നേ; ഞാൻ അതു നിന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നു കാണിച്ചു തന്നു; എന്നാൽ നീ അവിടേക്കു കടന്നുപോകയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to him, "This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not cross over into it."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to him, "This is the land of which I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not cross over there."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം അവിടെ മോവാബ്ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Moses the servant of the Lord died there in Moab, as the Lord had said.
chapters.nkjv: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനെ മോവാബ്ദേശത്തു ബെത്ത്പെയോരിന്നെതിരെയുള്ള താഴ്വരയിൽ അടക്കി; എങ്കിലും ഇന്നുവരെയും അവന്റെ ശവക്കുഴിയുടെ സ്ഥലം ആരും അറിയുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.
chapters.nkjv: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth Peor; but no one knows his grave to this day.
chapters.kjv: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

chapters.ml: മോശെ മരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവന്നു നൂറ്റിരുപതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു. അവന്റെ കണ്ണു മങ്ങാതെയും അവന്റെ ദേഹബലം ക്ഷയിക്കാതെയും ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak nor his strength gone.
chapters.nkjv: Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eyes were not dim nor his natural vigor diminished.
chapters.kjv: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മോശെയെക്കുറിച്ചു മോവാബ്സമഭൂമിയിൽ മുപ്പതുദിവസം കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; അങ്ങനെ മോശെയെക്കുറിച്ചു കരഞ്ഞു വിലപിക്കുന്ന കാലം തികഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning was over.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. So the days of weeping and mourning for Moses ended.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

chapters.ml: നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവയെ മോശെ കൈവെച്ചനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ജ്ഞാനാത്മപൂർണ്ണനായ്തീർന്നു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അവനെ അനുസരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to him and did what the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him; so the children of Israel heeded him, and did as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു ഫറവോനോടും അവന്റെ സകല ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടും അവന്റെ സർവ്വദേശത്തോടും ചെയ്‌വാൻ യഹോവ മോശെയെ നിയോഗിച്ചയച്ച സകല അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും ഭുജവീര്യവും
chapters.niv: Since then, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
chapters.nkjv: But since then there has not arisen in Israel a prophet like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
chapters.kjv: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

chapters.ml: എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും കാൺകെ മോശെ പ്രവർത്തിച്ച ഭയങ്കര കാര്യമൊക്കെയും വിചാരിച്ചാൽ
chapters.niv: who did all those signs and wonders the Lord sent him to do in Egypt—to Pharaoh and to all his officials and to his whole land.
chapters.nkjv: in all the signs and wonders which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt, before Pharaoh, before all his servants, and in all his land,
chapters.kjv: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അഭിമുഖമായി അറിഞ്ഞ മോശെയെപ്പോലെ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ യിസ്രായേലിൽ പിന്നെ ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: For no one has ever shown the mighty power or performed the awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
chapters.nkjv: and by all that mighty power and all the great terror which Moses performed in the sight of all Israel.
chapters.kjv: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെയുടെ മരണശേഷം യഹോവ നൂന്റെ മകനായി മോശെയുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷകനായ യോശുവയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു:
chapters.niv: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord , the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ aide:
chapters.nkjv: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord, it came to pass that the Lord spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying:
chapters.kjv: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെ മരിച്ചു; ആകയാൽ നീയും ഈ ജനമൊക്കെയും പുറപ്പെട്ടു യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു കൊടുക്കുന്ന ദേശത്തേക്കു കടന്നുപോകുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them—to the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: "Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore, arise, go over this Jordan, you and all this people, to the land which I am giving to them—the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉള്ളങ്കാൽ ചവിട്ടുന്ന സ്ഥലമൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon I have given you, as I said to Moses.
chapters.kjv: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

chapters.ml: മരുഭൂമിയും ഈ ലെബാനോനും തുടങ്ങി ഫ്രാത്ത് എന്ന മഹാനദിവരെയും ഹിത്യരുടെ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും പടിഞ്ഞാറു മഹാസമുദ്രംവരെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ അതിരായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates—all the Hittite country—to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
chapters.nkjv: From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the River Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your territory.
chapters.kjv: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തു ഒരിക്കലും ഒരു മനുഷ്യനും നിന്റെ നേരെ നിൽക്കയില്ല; ഞാൻ മോശെയോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നതു പോലെ നിന്നോടുകൂടെയും ഇരിക്കും; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കൈ വിടുകയില്ല, ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.
chapters.nkjv: No man shall beableto stand before you all the days of your life; as I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not leave you nor forsake you.
chapters.kjv: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

chapters.ml: ഉറപ്പും ധൈര്യവും ഉള്ളവനായിരിക്ക; ഞാൻ അവർക്കു കൊടുക്കുമെന്നു അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു സത്യം ചെയ്ത ദേശം നീ ഈ ജനത്തിന്നു അവകാശമായി വിഭാഗിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.
chapters.nkjv: Be strong and of good courage, for to this people you shall divide as an inheritance the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
chapters.kjv: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള ന്യായപ്രമാണമൊക്കെയും അനുസരിച്ചു നടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നല്ല ഉറപ്പും ധൈര്യവും ഉള്ളവനായി മാത്രം ഇരിക്ക; ചെല്ലുന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും നീ ശുഭമായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതു വിട്ടു ഇടത്തോട്ടോ വലത്തോട്ടോ മാറരുതു.
chapters.niv: "Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.
chapters.nkjv: Only be strong and very courageous, that you may observe to do according to all the law which Moses My servant commanded you; do not turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may prosper wherever you go.
chapters.kjv: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

chapters.ml: ഈ ന്യായപ്രാമണപുസ്തകത്തിലുള്ളതു നിന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു നീങ്ങിപ്പോകരുതു; അതിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും പ്രമാണിച്ചുനടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ രാവും പകലും അതു ധ്യാനിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി സാധിക്കും; നീ കൃതാർത്ഥനായും ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.
chapters.nkjv: This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate in it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success.
chapters.kjv: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നീ പോകുന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു ഉറപ്പും ധൈര്യവുമുള്ളവനായിരിക്ക; ഭയപ്പെടരുതു, ഭ്രമിക്കയും അരുതു എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go."
chapters.nkjv: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go."
chapters.kjv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യോശുവ ജനത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണികളോടു കല്പിച്ചതു:
chapters.niv: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
chapters.kjv: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

chapters.ml: പാളയത്തിൽ കൂടി കടന്നു ജനത്തോടു: നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അവകാശമായി തരുന്ന ദേശം കൈവശമാക്കുവാൻ ചെല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ മൂന്നു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ കടക്കേണ്ടതാകയാൽ ഭക്ഷണസാധനം ഒരുക്കിക്കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Get your provisions ready. Three days from now you will cross the Jordan here to go in and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you for your own.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "Pass through the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you will cross over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess.’ "
chapters.kjv: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവ രൂബേന്യരോടും ഗാദ്യരോടും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രത്തോടും പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
chapters.nkjv: And to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh Joshua spoke, saying,
chapters.kjv: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ നിങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ച വചനം ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു സ്വസ്ഥത നല്കി ഈ ദേശവും തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Remember the command that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you after he said, ‘The Lord your God will give you rest by giving you this land.’
chapters.nkjv: "Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, ‘The Lord your God is giving you rest and is giving you this land.’
chapters.kjv: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളും നിങ്ങളുടെ കന്നുകാലികളും യോർദ്ദാന്നിക്കരെ മോശെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിട്ടുള്ള ദേശത്തിരിക്കട്ടെ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളിൽ യുദ്ധപ്രാപ്തന്മാരായവർ ഒക്കെയും സന്നദ്ധരായി നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു മുമ്പായി കടന്നുചെന്നു
chapters.niv: Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, ready for battle, must cross over ahead of your fellow Israelites. You are to help them
chapters.nkjv: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But you shall pass before your brethren armed, all your mighty men of valor, and help them,
chapters.kjv: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്നപോലെ നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കും സ്വസ്ഥത നല്കുകയും നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അവർക്കു കൊടുക്കുന്ന ദേശം അവർ കൈവശമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുവോളം അവരെ സഹായിക്കേണം; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ കിഴക്കു യോർദ്ദാന്നിക്കരെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിട്ടുള്ള അവകാശദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങി വന്നു അതിനെ അനുഭവിച്ചുകൊള്ളേണം.
chapters.niv: until the Lord gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land the Lord your God is giving them. After that, you may go back and occupy your own land, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you east of the Jordan toward the sunrise."
chapters.nkjv: until the Lord has given your brethren rest, as He gave you, and they also have taken possession of the land which the Lord your God is giving them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and enjoy it, which Moses the Lord’s servant gave you on this side of the Jordan toward the sunrise."
chapters.kjv: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’s servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോശുവയോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യും; ഞങ്ങളെ അയക്കുന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങൾ പോകും.
chapters.niv: Then they answered Joshua, "Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
chapters.nkjv: So they answered Joshua, saying, "All that you command us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
chapters.kjv: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ മോശെയെ സകലത്തിലും അനുസരിച്ചതുപോലെ നിന്നെയും അനുസരിക്കും; നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ മോശെയോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നതുപോലെ നിന്നോടുകൂടെയും ഇരുന്നാൽ മതി.
chapters.niv: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Just as we heeded Moses in all things, so we will heed you. Only the Lord your God be with you, as He was with Moses.
chapters.kjv: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും നിന്റെ കല്പന മറുക്കയും നീ കല്പിക്കുന്ന യാതൊന്നിലും നിന്റെ വാക്കു അനുസരിക്കാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ മരിക്കേണം; ഉറപ്പും ധൈര്യവുമുള്ളവനായി മാത്രംഇരുന്നാലും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey it, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!"
chapters.nkjv: Whoever rebels against your command and does not heed your words, in all that you command him, shall be put to death. Only be strong and of good courage."
chapters.kjv: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവ രഹസ്യമായി ഒറ്റുനോക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ശിത്തീമിൽനിന്നു രണ്ടുപേരെ അയച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾ പോയി ദേശവും യെരീഹോപട്ടണവും നോക്കിവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു രാഹാബ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു വേശ്യയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. "Go, look over the land," he said, "especially Jericho." So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua the son of Nun sent out two men from Acacia Grove to spy secretly, saying, "Go, view the land, especially Jericho." So they went, and came to the house of a harlot named Rahab, and lodged there.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ചിലർ ദേശത്തെ ശോധനചെയ്‍വാൻ രാത്രിയിൽ ഇവിടെ വന്നരിക്കന്നു എന്നു യെരീഹോരാജാവിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: The king of Jericho was told, "Look, some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land."
chapters.nkjv: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, "Behold, men have come here tonight from the children of Israel to search out the country."
chapters.kjv: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

chapters.ml: യെരീഹോരാജാവു രാഹാബിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു വീട്ടിൽ കയറിയിരിക്കുന്ന മനുഷ്യരെ പുറത്തിറക്കിത്തരിക; അവർ ദേശമൊക്കെയും ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ വന്നവരാകുന്നു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: "Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land."
chapters.nkjv: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered your house, for they have come to search out all the country."
chapters.kjv: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ത്രീ അവരെ രണ്ടുപേരെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി ഒളിപ്പിച്ചിട്ടു: അവർ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരുന്നു എങ്കിലും എവിടത്തുകാർ എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല;
chapters.niv: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they had come from.
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman took the two men and hid them. So she said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
chapters.kjv: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

chapters.ml: ഇരുട്ടായപ്പോൾ പട്ടണവാതിൽ അടെക്കുന്ന സമയത്തു, അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി; എവിടേക്കു പോയി എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല; വേഗത്തിൽ അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; എന്നാൽ അവരെ കണ്ടുപിടിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At dusk, when it was time to close the city gate, they left. I don’t know which way they went. Go after them quickly. You may catch up with them."
chapters.nkjv: And it happened as the gate was being shut, when it was dark, that the men went out. Where the men went I do not know; pursue them quickly, for you may overtake them."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൾ അവരെ വീട്ടിൻ മുകളിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി അവിടെ അടുക്കിവെച്ചിരുന്ന ചണത്തണ്ടുകളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒളിപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.)
chapters.nkjv: (But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order on the roof.)
chapters.kjv: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

chapters.ml: ആ ആളുകൾ യോർദ്ദാനിലേക്കുള്ള വഴിയായി കടവുകൾവരെ അവരെ തിരഞ്ഞുചെന്നു; തിരഞ്ഞുചെന്നവർ പുറപ്പെട്ട ഉടനെ പട്ടണവാതിൽ അടെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.
chapters.nkjv: Then the men pursued them by the road to the Jordan, to the fords. And as soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.
chapters.kjv: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ കിടപ്പാൻ പോകുംമുമ്പെ അവൾ മുകളിൽ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof
chapters.nkjv: Now before they lay down, she came up to them on the roof,
chapters.kjv: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഈ ദേശം നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളെയുള്ള ഭീതി ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വീണിരിക്കുന്നു; ഈ ദേശത്തിലെ നിവാസികൾ എല്ലാവരും നിങ്ങളുടെ നിമിത്തം ഉരുകിപ്പോകുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and said to them, "I know that the Lord has given you this land and that a great fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who live in this country are melting in fear because of you.
chapters.nkjv: and said to the men: "I know that the Lord has given you the land, that the terror of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land are fainthearted because of you.
chapters.kjv: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരുമ്പോൾ യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി ചെങ്കടലിലെ വെള്ളം വറ്റിച്ചതും യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെവെച്ചു നിങ്ങൾ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കിയ സീഹോൻ, ഓഗ് എന്ന രണ്ടു അമോർയ്യരാജാക്കന്മാരോടു ചെയ്തതും ഞങ്ങൾ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: We have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.
chapters.nkjv: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites who were on the other side of the Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
chapters.kjv: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

chapters.ml: കേട്ടപ്പോൾ തന്നേ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയം ഉരുകി; നിങ്ങളുടെ നിമിത്തം എല്ലാവർക്കും ധൈര്യം കെട്ടുപോയി; നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ തന്നേ മീതെ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലും താഴെ ഭൂമിയിലും ദൈവം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When we heard of it, our hearts melted in fear and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the Lord your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.
chapters.nkjv: And as soon as we heard thesethings, our hearts melted; neither did there remain any more courage in anyone because of you, for the Lord your God, He is God in heaven above and on earth beneath.
chapters.kjv: And as soon as we had heard these things , our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ദയ ചെയ്ക കൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളും എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തോടു ദയ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "Now then, please swear to me by the Lord that you will show kindness to my family, because I have shown kindness to you. Give me a sure sign
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, I beg you, swear to me by the Lord, since I have shown you kindness, that you also will show kindness to my father’s house, and give me a true token,
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD , since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെയും സഹോദരിമാരെയും അവർക്കുള്ള സകലത്തെയും ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിച്ചു ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവനെ മരണത്തിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിക്കുമെന്നു യഹോവയെച്ചൊല്ലി എന്നോടു സത്യംചെയ്കയും ഉറപ്പുള്ള ഒരു ലക്ഷ്യം തരികയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them—and that you will save us from death."
chapters.nkjv: and spare my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death."
chapters.kjv: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവളോടു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഈ കാര്യം നിങ്ങൾ അറിയിക്കാതെയിരുന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവന്നു പകരം ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവൻ വെച്ചുകൊടുക്കും. യഹോവ ഈ ദേശം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തരുമ്പോൾ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നോടു ദയയും വിശ്വസ്തതയും കാണിക്കും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Our lives for your lives!" the men assured her. "If you don’t tell what we are doing, we will treat you kindly and faithfully when the Lord gives us the land."
chapters.nkjv: So the men answered her, "Our lives for yours, if none of you tell this business of ours. And it shall be, when the Lord has given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you."
chapters.kjv: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവൾ അവരെ കിളിവാതിലൂടെ ഒരു കയറുകെട്ടി ഇറക്കി; അവളുടെ വീടു കോട്ടമതിലിന്മേൽ ആയിരുന്നു; അവൾ മതിലിന്മേൽ പാർത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.
chapters.nkjv: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the city wall; she dwelt on the wall.
chapters.kjv: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവരോടു: തിരിഞ്ഞുപോയവർ നിങ്ങളെ കണ്ടുപിടിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പർവ്വതത്തിൽ കയറി അവർ മടങ്ങിപ്പോരുവോളം മൂന്നു ദിവസം അവിടെ ഒളിച്ചിരിപ്പിൻ; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം നിങ്ങളുടെ വഴിക്കു പോകാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She said to them, "Go to the hills so the pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there three days until they return, and then go on your way."
chapters.nkjv: And she said to them, "Get to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you. Hide there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward you may go your way."
chapters.kjv: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞങ്ങൾ ഈ ദേശത്തു വരുമ്പോൾ നീ ഞങ്ങളെ ഇറക്കിവിട്ട ഈ കിളിവാതിൽക്കൽ
chapters.niv: Now the men had said to her, "This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us
chapters.nkjv: So the men said to her: "We willbe blameless of this oath of yours which you have made us swear,
chapters.kjv: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

chapters.ml: ഈ ചുവപ്പു ചരടു കെട്ടുകയും നിന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും പിതൃഭവനത്തെയൊക്കെയും നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വീട്ടിൽ വരുത്തിക്കൊള്ളുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.
chapters.nkjv: unless, when we come into the land, you bind this line of scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you bring your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household to your own home.
chapters.kjv: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.

chapters.ml: അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നീ ഞങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ച സത്യത്തിൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ ഒഴിവുള്ളവരാകും. ആരെങ്കിലും വീട്ടുവാതിലിന്നു പുറത്തിറങ്ങിയാൽ അവന്റെ രക്തം അവന്റെ തലമേൽ ഇരിക്കും; ഞങ്ങൾ കുറ്റമില്ലാത്തവർ ആകും; നിന്നോടുകൂടെ വീട്ടിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ വല്ലവനും അവന്റെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചാൽ അവന്റെ രക്തം ഞങ്ങളുടെ തലമേൽ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: If any of them go outside your house into the street, their blood will be on their own heads; we will not be responsible. As for those who are in the house with you, their blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on them.
chapters.nkjv: So it shall be that whoever goes outside the doors of your house into the street, his blood shallbe on his own head, and we willbe guiltless. And whoever is with you in the house, his blood shallbe on our head if a hand is laid on him.
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ കാര്യം അറിയിച്ചാൽ നീ ഞങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ച സത്യത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ ഒഴിവുള്ളവർ ആകും.
chapters.niv: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear."
chapters.nkjv: And if you tell this business of ours, then we will be free from your oath which you made us swear."
chapters.kjv: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൾ: നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ആകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവരെ അയച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അവർ പോയി; അവൾ ആ ചുവപ്പുചരടു കിളിവാതിൽക്കൽ കെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: "Agreed," she replied. "Let it be as you say." So she sent them away, and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
chapters.nkjv: Then she said, "According to your words, so be it." And she sent them away, and they departed. And she bound the scarlet cord in the window.
chapters.kjv: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പർവ്വതത്തിൽ ചെന്നു; തിരഞ്ഞുപോയവർ മടങ്ങിപ്പോരുംവരെ മൂന്നു ദിവസം അവിടെ താമസിച്ചു; തിരഞ്ഞുപോയവർ വഴിനീളേ അവരെ അന്വേഷിച്ചു; കണ്ടില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: When they left, they went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had searched all along the road and returned without finding them.
chapters.nkjv: They departed and went to the mountain, and stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but did not find them.
chapters.kjv: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഇരുവരും പർവ്വതത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി അക്കരെ കടന്നു നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു തങ്ങൾക്കു സംഭവിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും അവനെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.
chapters.nkjv: So the two men returned, descended from the mountain, and crossed over; and they came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all that had befallen them.
chapters.kjv: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദേശമൊക്കെയും നമ്മുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു നിശ്ചയം; ദേശത്തിലെ നിവാസികൾ എല്ലാവരും നമ്മുടെ നിമിത്തം ഉരുകിപ്പോകുന്നു എന്നു അവർ യോശുവയോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They said to Joshua, "The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us."
chapters.nkjv: And they said to Joshua, "Truly the Lord has delivered all the land into our hands, for indeed all the inhabitants of the country are fainthearted because of us."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോശുവ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു, അവനും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ എല്ലാവരും ശിത്തീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെ വന്നു മറുകര കടക്കുംമുമ്പെ അവിടെ താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites set out from Shittim and went to the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua rose early in the morning; and they set out from Acacia Grove and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they crossed over.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു പ്രമാണികൾ പാളയത്തിൽകൂടി നടന്നു ജനത്തോടു കല്പിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,
chapters.nkjv: So it was, after three days, that the officers went through the camp;
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകത്തെയും അതിനെ ചുമക്കുന്ന ലേവ്യരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും നിങ്ങൾ കാണുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്ഥലം വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു അതിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെല്ലേണം.
chapters.niv: giving orders to the people: "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the Levitical priests carrying it, you are to move out from your positions and follow it.
chapters.nkjv: and they commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the priests, the Levites, bearing it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.
chapters.kjv: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കും അതിന്നും ഇടയിൽ രണ്ടായിരം മുഴം അകലം ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കേണം; അതിനോടു അടുക്കരുതു; അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ പോകേണ്ടുന്ന വഴി അറിയും; ഈ വഴിക്കു നിങ്ങൾ മുമ്പെ പോയിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Then you will know which way to go, since you have never been this way before. But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between you and the ark; do not go near it."
chapters.nkjv: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, that you may know the way by which you must go, for you have not passed this way before."
chapters.kjv: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവ ജനത്തോടു നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിപ്പിൻ; യഹോവ നാളെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അതിശയം പ്രവർത്തിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you."
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua said to the people, "Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടു യോശുവ: നിങ്ങൾ നിയമപെട്ടകം എടുത്തു ജനത്തിന്നു മുമ്പായി അക്കരെ കടപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ നിയമപ്പെട്ടകം എടുത്തു ജനത്തിന്നു മുമ്പായി നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people." So they took it up and went ahead of them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, "Take up the ark of the covenant and cross over before the people." So they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു: ഞാൻ മോശെയോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നതുപോലെ നിന്നോടുകൂടെയും ഇരിക്കും എന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ എല്ലാം അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ ഇന്നു അവർ കാൺകെ നിന്നെ വലിയവനാക്കുവാൻ തുടങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you as I was with Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "This day I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

chapters.ml: നിയമപെട്ടകം ചുമക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ വക്കത്തു എത്തുമ്പോൾ യോർദ്ദാനിൽ നില്പാൻ കല്പിക്ക എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the Jordan’s waters, go and stand in the river.’ "
chapters.nkjv: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you have come to the edge of the water of the Jordan, you shall stand in the Jordan.’ "
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു: ഇവിടെ വന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ വചനം കേൾപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joshua said to the Israelites, "Come here and listen to the words of the Lord your God.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua said to the children of Israel, "Come here, and hear the words of the Lord your God."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവം നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഉണ്ടു; അവൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു കനാന്യർ, ഹിത്യർ, ഹിവ്യർ, പെരിസ്യർ, ഗിർഗ്ഗശ്യർ, അമോർയ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ എന്നിവരെ നീക്കിക്കളയും എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇതിനാൽ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that he will certainly drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua said, "By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that He will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Hivites and the Perizzites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Jebusites:
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, സർവ്വഭൂമിക്കും നാഥനായവന്റെ നിയമപെട്ടകം നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പായി യോർദ്ദാനിലേക്കു കടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: See, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go into the Jordan ahead of you.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is crossing over before you into the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഓരോ ഗോത്രത്തിൽനിന്നു ഓരോ ആൾവീതം യിസ്രായേൽ ഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടു ആളെ കൂട്ടുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Now then, choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man from every tribe.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

chapters.ml: സർവ്വഭൂമിയുടെയും നാഥനായ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ചുമക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ ഉള്ളങ്കാൽ യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളത്തിൽ ചവിട്ടുമ്പോൾ ഉടനെ യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളം രണ്ടായി പിരിഞ്ഞിട്ടു മേൽനിന്നു ഒഴുകുന്ന വെള്ളം ചിറപോലെ നില്ക്കും.
chapters.niv: And as soon as the priests who carry the ark of the Lord —the Lord of all the earth—set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off and stand up in a heap."
chapters.nkjv: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan shall be cut off, the waters that come down from upstream, and they shall stand as a heap."
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD , the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ജനം യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ കടപ്പാൻ തങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; നിയമപെട്ടകം ചുമക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ജനത്തിന്നു മുമ്പായി പെട്ടകം ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carrying the ark of the covenant went ahead of them.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the people set out from their camp to cross over the Jordan, with the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

chapters.ml: കൊയിത്തുകാലത്തൊക്കെയും യോർദ്ദാൻ തീരമെല്ലാം കവിഞ്ഞു ഒഴുകും. പെട്ടകം ചുമന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ കാൽ വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ വക്കത്തു മുങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ മേൽ വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഒഴുക്കു നിന്നു;
chapters.niv: Now the Jordan is at flood stage all during harvest. Yet as soon as the priests who carried the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge,
chapters.nkjv: and as those who bore the ark came to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks during the whole time of harvest),
chapters.kjv: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

chapters.ml: സാരെഥാന്നു സമീപത്തുള്ള ആദാംപട്ടണത്തിന്നരികെ ബഹുദൂരത്തോളം ചിറപോലെ പൊങ്ങി; അരാബയിലെ കടലായ ഉപ്പുകടലിലേക്കു ഒഴുകിയ വെള്ളം വാർന്നുപോയി; ജനം യെരീഹോവിന്നു നേരെ മറുകര കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: the water from upstream stopped flowing. It piled up in a heap a great distance away, at a town called Adam in the vicinity of Zarethan, while the water flowing down to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
chapters.nkjv: that the waters which came down from upstream stood still, and rose in a heap very far away at Adam, the city that is beside Zaretan. So the waters that went down into the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, failed, and were cut off; and the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
chapters.kjv: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം ചുമന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യോർദ്ദാന്റെ നടുവിൽ ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തു ഉറെച്ചുനിന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽജനമൊക്കെയും യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നുതീരുവോളം ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടിത്തന്നേ നടന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord stopped in the middle of the Jordan and stood on dry ground, while all Israel passed by until the whole nation had completed the crossing on dry ground.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood firm on dry ground in the midst of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the people had crossed completely over the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

chapters.ml: ജനമൊക്കെയും യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നുതീർന്നശേഷം യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua,
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when all the people had completely crossed over the Jordan, that the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying:
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഓരോ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഓരോ ആൾ വീതം ജനത്തിൽനിന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേരെ കൂട്ടി അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: "Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,
chapters.nkjv: "Take for yourselves twelve men from the people, one man from every tribe,
chapters.kjv: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

chapters.ml: യോർദ്ദാന്റെ നടുവിൽ പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ കാൽ ഉറച്ചുനിന്ന സ്ഥലത്തുനിന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടു കല്ലു എടുത്തു കരെക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ഈ രാത്രി നിങ്ങൾ പാർക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു വെപ്പാൻ കല്പിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: and tell them to take up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, from right where the priests are standing, and carry them over with you and put them down at the place where you stay tonight."
chapters.nkjv: and command them, saying, ‘Take for yourselves twelve stones from here, out of the midst of the Jordan, from the place where the priests’ feet stood firm. You shall carry them over with you and leave them in the lodging place where you lodge tonight.’ "
chapters.kjv: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോശുവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഓരോ ഗോത്രത്തിൽനിന്നു ഓരോ ആൾ വീതം നിയമിച്ചിരുന്ന പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേരെ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua called together the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe,
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had appointed from the children of Israel, one man from every tribe;
chapters.kjv: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

chapters.ml: യോശുവ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യോർദ്ദാന്റെ നടുവിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ ചെന്നു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രസംഖ്യക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം നിങ്ങളിൽ ഓരോരുത്തൻ ഓരോ കല്ലു ചുമലിൽ എടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and said to them, "Go over before the ark of the Lord your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites,
chapters.nkjv: and Joshua said to them: "Cross over before the ark of the Lord your God into the midst of the Jordan, and each one of you take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel,
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

chapters.ml: ഇതു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒരു അടയാളമായിരിക്കേണം; ഈ കല്ലു എന്തു എന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾ വരുങ്കാലത്തു ചോദിക്കുമ്പോൾ:
chapters.niv: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask you, ‘What do these stones mean?’
chapters.nkjv: that this may be a sign among you when your children ask in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’
chapters.kjv: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

chapters.ml: യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളം യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ രണ്ടായി പിരിഞ്ഞതുനിമിത്തം തന്നേ എന്നു അവരോടു പറയേണം. അതു യോർദ്ദാനെ കടന്നപ്പോൾ യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളം രണ്ടായി പിരിഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു ഈ കല്ലു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു എന്നേക്കും ജ്ഞാപകമായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: tell them that the flow of the Jordan was cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord . When it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones are to be a memorial to the people of Israel forever."
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall answer them that the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord; when it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. And these stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever."
chapters.kjv: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD ; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ചെയ്തു; യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രസംഖ്യെക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം പന്ത്രണ്ടു കല്ലു യോർദ്ദാന്റെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു തങ്ങൾ പാർത്ത സ്ഥലത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the Israelites did as Joshua commanded them. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites, as the Lord had told Joshua; and they carried them over with them to their camp, where they put them down.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel did so, just as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones from the midst of the Jordan, as the Lord had spoken to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them to the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

chapters.ml: യോർദ്ദാന്റെ നടുവിലും നിയമപെട്ടകം ചുമന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ കാൽ നിന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു യോശുവ പന്ത്രണ്ടു കല്ലു നാട്ടി; അവ ഇന്നുവരെ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Joshua set up the twelve stones that had been in the middle of the Jordan at the spot where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant had stood. And they are there to this day.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

chapters.ml: മോശെ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും ജനത്തോടു പറവാൻ യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും ചെയ്തുതീരുവോളം പെട്ടകം ചുമന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യോർദ്ദാന്റെ നടുവിൽ നിന്നു; ജനം വേഗത്തിൽ മറുകര കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything the Lord had commanded Joshua was done by the people, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried over,
chapters.nkjv: So the priests who bore the ark stood in the midst of the Jordan until everything was finished that the Lord had commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses had commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and crossed over.
chapters.kjv: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

chapters.ml: ജനമൊക്കെയും കടന്നു തീർന്നപ്പോൾ ജനം കാൺകെ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകവും പുരോഹിതന്മാരും മറുകര കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the Lord and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.
chapters.nkjv: Then it came to pass, when all the people had completely crossed over, that the ark of the Lord and the priests crossed over in the presence of the people.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

chapters.ml: മോശെ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നതുപോലെ രൂബേന്യരും ഗാദ്യരും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രവും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു മുമ്പായി യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over, ready for battle, in front of the Israelites, as Moses had directed them.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Reuben, the men of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses had spoken to them.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

chapters.ml: ഏകദേശം നാല്പതിനായിരം പേർ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു യെരീഹോസമഭൂമിയിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the Lord to the plains of Jericho for war.
chapters.nkjv: About forty thousand prepared for war crossed over before the Lord for battle, to the plains of Jericho.
chapters.kjv: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യഹോവ യോശുവയെ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്റെയും മുമ്പാകെ വലിയവനാക്കി;
chapters.niv: That day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they stood in awe of him all the days of his life, just as they had stood in awe of Moses.
chapters.nkjv: On that day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they had feared Moses, all the days of his life.
chapters.kjv: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

chapters.ml: അവർ മോശെയെ ബഹുമാനിച്ചതുപോലെ അവനെയും അവന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലമൊക്കെയും ബഹുമാനിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Joshua,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു: സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകം ചുമക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടു യോർദ്ദാനിൽനിന്നു കയറുവാൻ കല്പിക്ക എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant law to come up out of the Jordan."
chapters.nkjv: "Command the priests who bear the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan."
chapters.kjv: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോശുവ പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടു യോർദ്ദാനിൽനിന്നു കയറുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua commanded the priests, "Come up out of the Jordan."
chapters.nkjv: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, "Come up from the Jordan."
chapters.kjv: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ സാക്ഷ്യപെട്ടകം ചുമക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യോർദ്ദാന്റെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു കയറി; പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ ഉള്ളങ്കാൽ കരെക്കു പൊക്കിവെച്ച ഉടനെ യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളം വീണ്ടും അതിന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു വന്നു മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ തീരം കവിഞ്ഞു ഒഴുകി.
chapters.niv: And the priests came up out of the river carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord . No sooner had they set their feet on the dry ground than the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and ran at flood stage as before.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord had come from the midst of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet touched the dry land, that the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and overflowed all its banks as before.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം മാസം പത്താം തിയ്യതി ജനം യോർദ്ദാനിൽനിന്നു കയറി യെരീഹോവിന്റെ കിഴക്കെ അതിരിലുള്ള ഗില്ഗാലിൽ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.
chapters.nkjv: Now the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and they camped in Gilgal on the east border of Jericho.
chapters.kjv: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

chapters.ml: യോർദ്ദാനിൽനിന്നു എടുത്ത പന്ത്രണ്ടു കല്ലു യോശുവ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ നാട്ടി,
chapters.niv: And Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken out of the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: And those twelve stones which they took out of the Jordan, Joshua set up in Gilgal.
chapters.kjv: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ; ഈ കല്ലു എന്തു എന്നു വരുങ്കാലത്തു നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ചോദിച്ചാൽ:
chapters.niv: He said to the Israelites, "In the future when your descendants ask their parents, ‘What do these stones mean?’
chapters.nkjv: Then he spoke to the children of Israel, saying: "When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What are these stones?’
chapters.kjv: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടി ഈ യോർദ്ദാന്നിക്കരെ കടന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളോടു പറയേണം.
chapters.niv: tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’
chapters.nkjv: then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel crossed over this Jordan on dry land’;
chapters.kjv: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലജാതികളും യഹോവയുടെ കൈ ശക്തിയുള്ളതെന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ എന്നേക്കും ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: For the Lord your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The Lord your God did to the Jordan what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over.
chapters.nkjv: for the Lord your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed over, as the Lord your God did to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed over,
chapters.kjv: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ഇക്കരെ കടപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ ചെങ്കടൽ വറ്റിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞതുപോലെ നിങ്ങൾ ഇക്കരെ കടപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളം വറ്റിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful and so that you might always fear the Lord your God."
chapters.nkjv: that all the peoples of the earth may know the hand of the Lord, that it is mighty, that you may fear the Lord your God forever."
chapters.kjv: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD , that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഇക്കരെ കടപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം യഹോവ അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ യോർദ്ദാനിലെ വെള്ളം വറ്റിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു യോർദ്ദാന്റെ പടിഞ്ഞാറെ ഭാഗത്തുള്ള അമോർയ്യരാജാക്കന്മാരൊക്കെയും സമുദ്രതീരത്തുള്ള കനാന്യരാജാക്കന്മാരൊക്കെയും കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ ഹൃദയം ഉരുകി; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ നിമിത്തം അവരിൽ അശേഷം ചൈതന്യമില്ലാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over, their hearts melted in fear and they no longer had the courage to face the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when all the kings of the Amorites who were on the west side of the Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, that their heart melted; and there was no spirit in them any longer because of the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു: തീക്കല്ലുകൊണ്ടു കത്തി ഉണ്ടാക്കി യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ രണ്ടാമതും പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again."
chapters.nkjv: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make flint knives for yourself, and circumcise the sons of Israel again the second time."
chapters.kjv: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ തീക്കല്ലുകൊണ്ടു കത്തി ഉണ്ടാക്കി യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ അഗ്രചർമ്മഗിരിയിങ്കൽവെച്ചു പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelites at Gibeath Haaraloth.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua made flint knives for himself, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ള കാരണമോ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട ആണുങ്ങളായ ജനമൊക്കെയും യോദ്ധാക്കളെല്ലാവരും മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോന്നശേഷം പ്രയാണത്തിൽ മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി;
chapters.niv: Now this is why he did so: All those who came out of Egypt—all the men of military age—died in the wilderness on the way after leaving Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: And this is the reason why Joshua circumcised them: All the people who came out of Egypt whowere males, all the men of war, had died in the wilderness on the way, after they had come out of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

chapters.ml: പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോന്ന ജനത്തിനെല്ലാം പരിച്ഛേദന കഴിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു എങ്കിലും മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടശേഷം മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു പ്രയാണത്തിൽ ജനിച്ചവരിൽ ആരെയും പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്തിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: All the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness during the journey from Egypt had not.
chapters.nkjv: For all the people who came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness, on the way as they came out of Egypt, had not been circumcised.
chapters.kjv: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട യോദ്ധാക്കളായവരൊക്കെയും യഹോവയുടെ വാക്കു അനുസരിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവർ മരിച്ചൊടുങ്ങുംവരെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ സഞ്ചരിക്കേണ്ടിവന്നു; നമുക്കു തരുമെന്നു യഹോവ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു സത്യംചെയ്ത ദേശമായി പാലും തേനും ഒഴുകുന്ന ദേശം അവരെ കാണിക്കയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ അവരോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites had moved about in the wilderness forty years until all the men who were of military age when they left Egypt had died, since they had not obeyed the Lord . For the Lord had sworn to them that they would not see the land he had solemnly promised their ancestors to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
chapters.nkjv: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people whowere men of war, who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they did not obey the voice of the Lord—to whom the Lord swore that He would not show them the land which the Lord had sworn to their fathers that He would give us, "a land flowing with milk and honey."
chapters.kjv: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD : unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർക്കു പകരം അവൻ എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ച പുത്രന്മാരെ യോശുവ പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്തു; അവരെ പ്രയാണത്തിൽ പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്യായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവർ അഗ്രചർമ്മികളായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua circumcised their sons whom He raised up in their place; for they were uncircumcised, because they had not been circumcised on the way.
chapters.kjv: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

chapters.ml: അവർ സർവ്വജനത്തെയും പരിച്ഛേദനചെയ്തു തീർന്നശേഷം അവർക്കു സൌഖ്യമായതുവരെ അവർ പാളയത്തിൽ താന്താങ്ങളുടെ സ്ഥലത്തു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when they had finished circumcising all the people, that they stayed in their places in the camp till they were healed.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു: ഇന്നു ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീമിന്റെ നിന്ദ നിങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു ഉരുട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ഇന്നുവരെ ഗില്ഗാൽ (ഉരുൾ) എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "This day I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." Therefore the name of the place is called Gilgal to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി; ആ മാസം പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതി സന്ധ്യാസമയത്തു യെരീഹോസമഭൂമിയിൽ വെച്ചു പെസഹ കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.
chapters.nkjv: Now the children of Israel camped in Gilgal, and kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at twilight on the plains of Jericho.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

chapters.ml: പെസഹയുടെ പിറ്റെ ദിവസം തന്നേ അവർ ദേശത്തെ വിളവുകൊണ്ടുള്ള പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പവും മലരും തിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.
chapters.nkjv: And they ate of the produce of the land on the day after the Passover, unleavened bread and parched grain, on the very same day.
chapters.kjv: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

chapters.ml: അവർ ദേശത്തെ വിളവു അനുഭവിച്ചതിന്റെ പിറ്റെ ദിവസം മന്ന നിന്നുപോയി; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു പിന്നെ മന്ന കിട്ടിയതുമില്ല; ആയാണ്ടു അവർ കനാൻ ദേശത്തെ വിളവുകൊണ്ടു ഉപജീവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The manna stopped the day after they ate this food from the land; there was no longer any manna for the Israelites, but that year they ate the produce of Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: Then the manna ceased on the day after they had eaten the produce of the land; and the children of Israel no longer had manna, but they ate the food of the land of Canaan that year.
chapters.kjv: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ യെരീഹോവിന്നു സമീപത്തു ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തല ഉയർത്തി നോക്കി; ഒരു ആൾ കയ്യിൽ വാൾ ഊരിപ്പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ നേരെ നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; യോശുവ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ പക്ഷക്കാരനോ ശത്രുപക്ഷക്കാരനോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in his hand. Joshua went up to him and asked, "Are you for us or for our enemies?"
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted his eyes and looked, and behold, a Man stood opposite him with His sword drawn in His hand. And Joshua went to Him and said to Him, "Are You for us or for our adversaries?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: അല്ല, ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ സൈന്യത്തിന്റെ അധിപതിയായി ഇപ്പോൾ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ യോശുവ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു അവനോടു: കർത്താവിന്നു അടിയനോടുള്ള കല്പന എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Neither," he replied, "but as commander of the army of the Lord I have now come." Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence, and asked him, "What message does my Lord have for his servant?"
chapters.nkjv: So He said, "No, but as Commander of the army of the Lord I have now come." And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and worshiped, and said to Him, "What does my Lord say to His servant?"
chapters.kjv: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ സൈന്യത്തിന്റെ അധിപതി യോശുവയോടു: നിന്റെ കാലിൽനിന്നു ചെരിപ്പു അഴിച്ചുകളക; നീ നില്ക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലം വിശുദ്ധമാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; യോശുവ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The commander of the Lord ’s army replied, "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy." And Joshua did so.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Commander of the Lord’s army said to Joshua, "Take your sandal off your foot, for the place where you stand is holy." And Joshua did so.
chapters.kjv: And the captain of the LORD’s host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെരീഹോവിനെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ നിമിത്തം അടെച്ചു ഉറപ്പാക്കിയിരുന്നു; ആരും പുറത്തിറങ്ങിയില്ല, അകത്തു കയറിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now the gates of Jericho were securely barred because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jericho was securely shut up because of the children of Israel; none went out, and none came in.
chapters.kjv: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: ഞാൻ യെരീഹോവിനെയും അതിന്റെ രാജാവിനെയും യുദ്ധവീരന്മാരെയും നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Joshua: "See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിൽ യോദ്ധാക്കളായ എല്ലാവരും ഒരുവട്ടം പട്ടണത്തെ ചുറ്റിനടക്കേണം; ഇങ്ങനെ ആറു ദിവസം ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: March around the city once with all the armed men. Do this for six days.
chapters.nkjv: You shall march around the city, all you men of war; you shall go all around the city once. This you shall do six days.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ആട്ടിൻ കൊമ്പുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഏഴു കാഹളം പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നടക്കേണം; ഏഴാം ദിവസം ഏഴു പ്രാവശ്യം പട്ടണത്തെ ചുറ്റുകയും പുരോഹിതന്മാർ കാഹളം ഊതുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Have seven priests carry trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark. On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.
chapters.nkjv: And seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. But the seventh day you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.
chapters.kjv: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആട്ടിൻ കൊമ്പു നീട്ടിയൂതുകയും നിങ്ങൾ കാഹളനാദം കേൾക്കയും ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ ജനമൊക്കെയും ഉച്ചത്തിൽ ആർപ്പിടേണം; അപ്പോൾ പട്ടണമതിൽ വീഴും; ജനം ഓരോരുത്തൻ നേരെ കയറുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: When you hear them sound a long blast on the trumpets, have the whole army give a loud shout; then the wall of the city will collapse and the army will go up, everyone straight in."
chapters.nkjv: It shall come to pass, when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, that all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the wall of the city will fall down flat. And the people shall go up every man straight before him."
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

chapters.ml: നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ വിളിച്ചു അവരോടു: നിയമപെട്ടകം എടുപ്പിൻ; ഏഴു പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ ആട്ടിൻ കൊമ്പുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഏഴു കാഹളം പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നടക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and have seven priests carry trumpets in front of it."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ജനത്തോടു അവൻ: നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു പട്ടണത്തെ ചുറ്റിനടപ്പിൻ; ആയുധപാണികൾ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നടക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he ordered the army, "Advance! March around the city, with an armed guard going ahead of the ark of the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to the people, "Proceed, and march around the city, and let him who is armed advance before the ark of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD .
