chapters.ml: യോശുവ ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞുതീർന്നപ്പോൾ ആട്ടിൻ കൊമ്പുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഏഴു കാഹളം പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ഏഴു പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നടന്നു കാഹളം ഊതി; യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപ്പെട്ടകം അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets before the Lord went forward, blowing their trumpets, and the ark of the Lord ’s covenant followed them.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when Joshua had spoken to the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the Lord advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the LORD , and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

chapters.ml: ആയുധപാണികൾ കാഹളം ഊതുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നടന്നു; ശേഷമുള്ള കൂട്ടം പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ കാഹളം ഊതിക്കൊണ്ടു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The armed guard marched ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard followed the ark. All this time the trumpets were sounding.
chapters.nkjv: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard came after the ark, while thepriests continued blowing the trumpets.
chapters.kjv: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ജനത്തോടു: ആർപ്പിടുവിൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു കല്പിക്കുന്ന നാൾവരെ നിങ്ങൾ ആർപ്പിടരുതു; ഒച്ചകേൾപ്പിക്കരുതു; വായിൽനിന്നു ഒരു വാക്കും പുറപ്പെടുകയും അരുതു; അതിന്റെശേഷം ആർപ്പിടാം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Joshua had commanded the army, "Do not give a war cry, do not raise your voices, do not say a word until the day I tell you to shout. Then shout!"
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua had commanded the people, saying, "You shall not shout or make any noise with your voice, nor shall a word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I say to you, ‘Shout!’ Then you shall shout."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ഒരു പ്രാവശ്യം പട്ടണത്തെ ചുറ്റിനടന്നു; പിന്നെ അവർ പാളയത്തിലേക്കു വന്നു പാളയത്തിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So he had the ark of the Lord carried around the city, circling it once. Then the army returned to camp and spent the night there.
chapters.nkjv: So he had the ark of the Lord circle the city, going around it once. Then they came into the camp and lodged in the camp.
chapters.kjv: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ അതികാലത്തേ എഴുന്നേറ്റു; പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Joshua got up early the next morning and the priests took up the ark of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഏഴു പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ആട്ടിൻ കൊമ്പുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഏഴു കാഹളം പിടിച്ചു കാഹളം ഊതിക്കൊണ്ടു നടന്നു; ആയുധപാണികൾ അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നടന്നു; ശേഷമുള്ള കൂട്ടം യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ നടന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ കാഹളം ഊതിക്കൊണ്ടു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went forward, marching before the ark of the Lord and blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the Lord , while the trumpets kept sounding.
chapters.nkjv: Then seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord went on continually and blew with the trumpets. And the armed men went before them. But the rear guard came after the ark of the Lord, while thepriests continued blowing the trumpets.
chapters.kjv: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD , the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം ദിവസം അവർ പട്ടണത്തെ ഒരു പ്രാവശ്യം ചുറ്റീട്ടു പാളയത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു. ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ ആറു ദിവസം ചെയ്തു;
chapters.niv: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.
chapters.nkjv: And the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. So they did six days.
chapters.kjv: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം ദിവസമോ അവർ അതികാലത്തു അരുണോദയത്തിങ്കൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പട്ടണത്തെ ആ വിധത്തിൽ തന്നേ ഏഴുപ്രവാശ്യം ചുറ്റി; അന്നുമാത്രം അവർ പട്ടണത്തെ ഏഴു പ്രാവശ്യം ചുറ്റി.
chapters.niv: On the seventh day, they got up at daybreak and marched around the city seven times in the same manner, except that on that day they circled the city seven times.
chapters.nkjv: But it came to pass on the seventh day that they rose early, about the dawning of the day, and marched around the city seven times in the same manner. On that day only they marched around the city seven times.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാംപ്രാവശ്യം പുരോഹിതന്മാർ കാഹളം ഊതിയപ്പോൾ യോശുവ ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ആർപ്പിടുവിൻ; യഹോവ പട്ടണം നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the trumpet blast, Joshua commanded the army, "Shout! For the Lord has given you the city!
chapters.nkjv: And the seventh time it happened, when the priests blew the trumpets, that Joshua said to the people: "Shout, for the Lord has given you the city!
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

chapters.ml: ഈ പട്ടണവും അതിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു ശപഥാർപ്പിതമായിരിക്കുന്നു; എങ്കിലും രാഹാബ് എന്ന വേശ്യ നാം അയച്ച ദൂതന്മാരെ ഒളിപ്പിച്ചതിനാൽ അവളും അവളോടുകൂടെ വീട്ടിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരും ജീവനോടിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: The city and all that is in it are to be devoted to the Lord . Only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in her house shall be spared, because she hid the spies we sent.
chapters.nkjv: Now the city shall be doomed by the Lord to destruction, it and all who are in it. Only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
chapters.kjv: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD : only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ശപഥംചെയ്തിരിക്കെ ശപഥാർപ്പിതത്തിൽ വല്ലതും എടുത്തിട്ടു യിസ്രായേൽപാളയത്തിന്നു ശാപവും അനർത്ഥവും വരുത്താതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ശപഥാർപ്പിതമായ വസ്തുവൊന്നും തൊടാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: But keep away from the devoted things, so that you will not bring about your own destruction by taking any of them. Otherwise you will make the camp of Israel liable to destruction and bring trouble on it.
chapters.nkjv: And you, by all means abstain from the accursed things, lest you become accursed when you take of the accursed things, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.
chapters.kjv: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും ഒക്കെയും ചെമ്പും ഇരിമ്പുംകൊണ്ടുള്ള പാത്രങ്ങളും യഹോവെക്കു വിശുദ്ധം; അവ യഹോവയുടെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽ ചേരേണം.
chapters.niv: All the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron are sacred to the Lord and must go into his treasury."
chapters.nkjv: But all the silver and gold, and vessels of bronze and iron, are consecrated to the Lord; they shall come into the treasury of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD : they shall come into the treasury of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ജനം ആർപ്പിടുകയും പുരോഹിതന്മാർ കാഹളം ഊതുകയും ചെയ്തു; ജനം കാഹളനാദംകേട്ടു അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ ആർപ്പിട്ടപ്പോൾ മതിൽ വീണു; ജനം ഓരോരുത്തൻ നേരെ മുമ്പോട്ടു പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു കടന്നു പട്ടണം പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the trumpets sounded, the army shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the men gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so everyone charged straight in, and they took the city.
chapters.nkjv: So the people shouted when thepriests blew the trumpets. And it happened when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat. Then the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
chapters.kjv: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷൻ, സ്ത്രീ, ബാലൻ, വൃദ്ധൻ, ആടു, മാടു, കഴുത എന്നിങ്ങനെ പട്ടണത്തിലുള്ള സകലത്തെയും അവർ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ അശേഷം സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They devoted the city to the Lord and destroyed with the sword every living thing in it—men and women, young and old, cattle, sheep and donkeys.
chapters.nkjv: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, ox and sheep and donkey, with the edge of the sword.
chapters.kjv: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാജ്യത്തെ ഒറ്റുനോക്കിയ രണ്ടു പുരുഷന്മാരോടു യോശുവ: വേശ്യയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ നിന്നു ആ സ്ത്രീയെയും അവൾക്കുള്ള സകലത്തെയും നിങ്ങൾ അവളോടു സത്യംചെയ്തതുപോലെ പുറത്തുകൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, "Go into the prostitute’s house and bring her out and all who belong to her, in accordance with your oath to her."
chapters.nkjv: But Joshua had said to the two men who had spied out the country, "Go into the harlot’s house, and from there bring out the woman and all that she has, as you swore to her."
chapters.kjv: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഒറ്റുകാരായിരുന്ന യൌവനക്കാർ ചെന്നു രാഹാബിനെയും അവളുടെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും അവൾക്കുള്ള സകലത്തെയും പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടു വന്നു; അവളുടെ എല്ലാ ചാർച്ചക്കാരെയും പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു യിസ്രായേൽപാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു പാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother, her brothers and sisters and all who belonged to her. They brought out her entire family and put them in a place outside the camp of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And the young men who had been spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. So they brought out all her relatives and left them outside the camp of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ പട്ടണവും അതിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും തീവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും ചെമ്പുകൊണ്ടും ഇരിമ്പുകൊണ്ടുമുള്ള പാത്രങ്ങളും അവർ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they burned the whole city and everything in it, but they put the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the Lord ’s house.
chapters.nkjv: But they burned the city and all that was in it with fire. Only the silver and gold, and the vessels of bronze and iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യെരീഹോവിനെ ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ അയച്ച ദൂതന്മാരെ രാഹാബ് എന്ന വേശ്യ ഒളിപ്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു യോശുവ അവളെയും അവളുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തെയും അവൾക്കുള്ള സകലത്തെയും ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിച്ചു; അവൾ ഇന്നുവരെയും യിസ്രായേലിൽ പാർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her family and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent as spies to Jericho—and she lives among the Israelites to this day.
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua spared Rahab the harlot, her father’s household, and all that she had. So she dwells in Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു യോശുവ ശപഥം ചെയ്തു: ഈ യെരീഹോപട്ടണത്തെ പണിയുവാൻ തുനിയുന്ന മനുഷ്യൻ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ശപീക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ; അവൻ അതിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനമിടുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ മൂത്തമകൻ നഷ്ടമാകും; അതിന്റെ കതകു തൊടുക്കുമ്പോൾ ഇളയമകനും നഷ്ടമാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: "Cursed before the Lord is the one who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: "At the cost of his firstborn son he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua charged them at that time, saying, "Cursed be the man before the Lord who rises up and builds this city Jericho; he shall lay its foundation with his firstborn, and with his youngest he shall set up its gates."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവ യോശുവയോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ കീർത്തി ദേശത്തു എല്ലാടവും പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout all the country.
chapters.kjv: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ശപഥാർപ്പിതവസ്തു സംബന്ധിച്ചു ഒരു അകൃത്യംചെയ്തു; യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ സേരഹിന്റെ മകനായ സബ്ദിയുടെ മകനായ കർമ്മിയുടെ മകൻ ആഖാൻ ശപഥാർപ്പിതവസ്തുവിൽ ചിലതു എടുത്തു; യഹോവയുടെ കോപം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the Israelites were unfaithful in regard to the devoted things ; Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of them. So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel.
chapters.nkjv: But the children of Israel committed a trespass regarding the accursed things, for Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed things; so the anger of the Lord burned against the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ യെരീഹോവിൽനിന്നു ബേഥേലിന്നു കിഴക്കു ബേഥാവെന്റെ സമീപത്തുള്ള ഹായിയിലേക്കു ആളുകളെ അയച്ചു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ ചെന്നു ഹായിയെ ഒറ്റുനോക്കി,
chapters.niv: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth Aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, "Go up and spy out the region." So the men went up and spied out Ai.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, "Go up and spy out the country." So the men went up and spied out Ai.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നു അവനോടു: ജനം എല്ലാം പോകേണമെന്നില്ല; ഹായിയെ ജയിച്ചടക്കുവാൻ രണ്ടായിരമോ മൂവായിരമോ പോയാൽ മതി; സർവ്വജനത്തെയും അവിടേക്കു അയച്ചു കഷ്ടപ്പെടുത്തേണ്ടാ; അവർ ആൾ ചുരുക്കമത്രേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they returned to Joshua, they said, "Not all the army will have to go up against Ai. Send two or three thousand men to take it and do not weary the whole army, for only a few people live there."
chapters.nkjv: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, "Do not let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and attack Ai. Do not weary all the people there, for thepeopleofAiare few."
chapters.kjv: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ജനത്തിൽ ഏകദേശം മൂവായിരം പേർ അവിടേക്കു പോയി; എന്നാൽ അവർ ഹായിപട്ടണക്കാരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു തോറ്റു ഓടി.
chapters.niv: So about three thousand went up; but they were routed by the men of Ai,
chapters.nkjv: So about three thousand men went up there from the people, but they fled before the men of Ai.
chapters.kjv: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

chapters.ml: ഹായിപട്ടണക്കാർ അവരിൽ മുപ്പത്താറോളം പേരെ കൊന്നു, അവരെ പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽ തുടങ്ങി ശെബാരീംവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു മലഞ്ചരിവിൽവെച്ചു അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു. അതുകൊണ്ടു ജനത്തിന്റെ ഹൃദയം ഉരുകി വെള്ളംപോലെ ആയ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: who killed about thirty-six of them. They chased the Israelites from the city gate as far as the stone quarries and struck them down on the slopes. At this the hearts of the people melted in fear and became like water.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Ai struck down about thirty-six men, for they chased them from before the gate as far as Shebarim, and struck them down on the descent; therefore the hearts of the people melted and became like water.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ വസ്ത്രം കീറി യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ അവനും യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരും തലയിൽ മണ്ണുവാരിയിട്ടുകൊണ്ടു സന്ധ്യവരെ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു കിടന്നു:
chapters.niv: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown to the ground before the ark of the Lord , remaining there till evening. The elders of Israel did the same, and sprinkled dust on their heads.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before the ark of the Lord until evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, ഞങ്ങളെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ അമോർയ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ ഈ ജനത്തെ യോർദ്ദാന്നിക്കരെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു എന്തു? ഞങ്ങൾ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ പാർത്തിരുന്നെങ്കിൽ മതിയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Joshua said, "Alas, Sovereign Lord , why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua said, "Alas, Lord God, why have You brought this people over the Jordan at all—to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? Oh, that we had been content, and dwelt on the other side of the Jordan!
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD , wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, യിസ്രായേൽ ശത്രുക്കൾക്കു പുറം കാട്ടിയശേഷം ഞാൻ എന്തു പറയേണ്ടു!
chapters.niv: Pardon your servant, Lord. What can I say, now that Israel has been routed by its enemies?
chapters.nkjv: O Lord, what shall I say when Israel turns its back before its enemies?
chapters.kjv: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

chapters.ml: കനാന്യരും ദേശനിവാസികൾ ഒക്കെയും കേട്ടിട്ടു ഞങ്ങളെ ചുറ്റിവളഞ്ഞു ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങളുടെ പേർ മായിച്ചു കളയുമല്ലോ; എന്നാൽ നീ നിന്റെ മഹത്തായ നാമത്തിന്നുവേണ്ടി എന്തുചെയ്യും എന്നു യോശുവ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Canaanites and the other people of the country will hear about this and they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. What then will you do for your own great name?"
chapters.nkjv: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear it, and surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?"
chapters.kjv: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: എഴുന്നേൽക്ക; നീ ഇങ്ങനെ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണുകിടക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Stand up! What are you doing down on your face?
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord said to Joshua: "Get up! Why do you lie thus on your face?
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ പാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള എന്റെ നിയമം അവർ ലംഘിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ മോഷ്ടിച്ചു മറവുചെയ്തു തങ്ങളുടെ സാമാനങ്ങൾക്കിടയിൽ അതു വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have lied, they have put them with their own possessions.
chapters.nkjv: Israel has sinned, and they have also transgressed My covenant which I commanded them. For they have even taken some of the accursed things, and have both stolen and deceived; and they have also put it among their own stuff.
chapters.kjv: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ശാപഗ്രസ്തരായി തീർന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ശത്രുക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നില്പാൻ കഴിയാതെ ശത്രുക്കൾക്കു പുറം കാട്ടേണ്ടിവന്നു. ശാപം നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു നീക്കാതിരുന്നാൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: That is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs and run because they have been made liable to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy whatever among you is devoted to destruction.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they have become doomed to destruction. Neither will I be with you anymore, unless you destroy the accursed from among you.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

chapters.ml: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ജനത്തെ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു അവരോടു പറക: നാളത്തേക്കു നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിപ്പിൻ; യിസ്രായേലേ, നിന്റെ നടുവിൽ ഒരു ശാപം ഉണ്ടു; ശാപം നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളയുംവരെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നില്പാൻ നിനക്കു കഴികയില്ല എന്നിങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ കല്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Go, consecrate the people. Tell them, ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow; for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: There are devoted things among you, Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.
chapters.nkjv: Get up, sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, because thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Thereis an accursed thing in your midst, O Israel; you cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the accursed thing from among you."
chapters.kjv: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ രാവിലെ ഗോത്രം ഗോത്രമായി അടുത്തുവരേണം; യഹോവ പിടിക്കുന്ന ഗോത്രം കുലംകുലമായി അടുത്തുവരേണം; യഹോവ പിടിക്കുന്ന കുലം കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായിട്ടു അടുത്തുവരേണം; യഹോവ പിടിക്കുന്ന കുടുംബം ആളാംപ്രതി അടുത്തുവരേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe the Lord chooses shall come forward clan by clan; the clan the Lord chooses shall come forward family by family; and the family the Lord chooses shall come forward man by man.
chapters.nkjv: In the morning therefore you shall be brought according to your tribes. And it shall be that the tribe which the Lord takes shall come according to families; and the family which the Lord takes shall come by households; and the household which the Lord takes shall come man by man.
chapters.kjv: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

chapters.ml: ശപഥാർപ്പിതവസ്തുവോടുകൂടെ പിടിപെടുന്നവനെയും അവന്നുള്ള സകലത്തെയും തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം; അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ നിയമം ലംഘിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിൽ വഷളത്വം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Whoever is caught with the devoted things shall be destroyed by fire, along with all that belongs to him. He has violated the covenant of the Lord and has done an outrageous thing in Israel!’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then it shall be that he who is taken with the accursed thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed the covenant of the Lord, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’ "
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോശുവ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഗോത്രംഗോത്രമായി വരുത്തി; യെഹൂദാഗോത്രം പിടിക്കപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes, and Judah was chosen.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua rose early in the morning and brought Israel by their tribes, and the tribe of Judah was taken.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തെ കുലംകുലമായി വരുത്തി; സർഹ്യകുലം പിടിക്കപ്പെട്ടു; അവൻ സർഹ്യകുലത്തെ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി വരുത്തി; സബ്ദി പിടിക്കപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The clans of Judah came forward, and the Zerahites were chosen. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward by families, and Zimri was chosen.
chapters.nkjv: He brought the clan of Judah, and he took the family of the Zarhites; and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man, and Zabdi was taken.
chapters.kjv: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെ ആളാംപ്രതി വരുത്തി; യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ സേരഹിന്റെ മകനായ സബ്ദിയുടെ മകനായ കർമ്മിയുടെ മകൻ ആഖാൻ പിടിക്കപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Joshua had his family come forward man by man, and Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was chosen.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought his household man by man, and Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
chapters.kjv: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ആഖാനോടു: മകനേ, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു മഹത്വം കൊടുത്തു അവനോടു ഏറ്റുപറക; നീ എന്തു ചെയ്തു എന്നു പറക; എന്നോടു മറെച്ചുവെക്കരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory to the Lord , the God of Israel, and honor him. Tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me."
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua said to Achan, "My son, I beg you, give glory to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession to Him, and tell me now what you have done; do not hide it from me."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

chapters.ml: ആഖാൻ യോശുവയോടു: ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു പിഴെച്ചു ഇന്നിന്നതു ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു സത്യം.
chapters.niv: Achan replied, "It is true! I have sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel. This is what I have done:
chapters.nkjv: And Achan answered Joshua and said, "Indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel, and this is what I have done:
chapters.kjv: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കൊള്ളയുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ വിശേഷമായോരു ബാബിലോന്യ മേലങ്കിയും ഇരുനൂറു ശേക്കെൽ വെള്ളിയും അമ്പതു ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കമുള്ള ഒരു പൊൻകട്ടിയും കണ്ടു മോഹിച്ചു എടുത്തു; അവ എന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ നടുവിൽ നിലത്തു കുഴിച്ചിട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; വെള്ളി അടിയിൽ ആകന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When I saw in the plunder a beautiful robe from Babylonia, two hundred shekels of silver and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath."
chapters.nkjv: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful Babylonian garment, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. And there they are, hidden in the earth in the midst of my tent, with the silver under it."
chapters.kjv: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; അവർ കൂടാരത്തിൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു; കൂടാരത്തിൽ അതും അടിയിൽ വെള്ളിയും കുഴിച്ചിട്ടിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവയെ കൂടാരത്തിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു യോശുവയുടെയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളുടെയും അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And they took them from the midst of the tent, brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോശുവയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലുംകൂടെ സേരെഹിന്റെ പുത്രനായ ആഖാനെ വെള്ളി, മേലങ്കി, പൊൻകട്ടി, അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ, പുത്രിമാർ, അവന്റെ കാള, കഴുത, ആടു, കൂടാരം ഇങ്ങനെ അവന്നുള്ള സകലവുമായി ആഖോർതാഴ്വരയിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി:
chapters.niv: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the gold bar, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent and all that he had, to the Valley of Achor.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the garment, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his oxen, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had, and they brought them to the Valley of Achor.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

chapters.ml: നീ ഞങ്ങളെ വലെച്ചതു എന്തിന്നു? യഹോവ ഇന്നു നിന്നെ വലെക്കും എന്നു യോശുവ പറഞ്ഞു. പിന്നെ യിസ്രായേലെല്ലാം അവനെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു, അവരെ തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളകയും കല്ലെറികയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Joshua said, "Why have you brought this trouble on us? The Lord will bring trouble on you today." Then all Israel stoned him, and after they had stoned the rest, they burned them.
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua said, "Why have you troubled us? The Lord will trouble you this day." So all Israel stoned him with stones; and they burned them with fire after they had stoned them with stones.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മേൽ അവർ ഒരു വലിയ കല്ക്കുന്നു കൂട്ടി; അതു ഇന്നുവരെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു. ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ ഉഗ്രകോപം മാറി; അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ആഖോർതാഴ്വര എന്നു ഇന്നുവരെ പേർ പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Over Achan they heaped up a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Then the Lord turned from his fierce anger. Therefore that place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.
chapters.nkjv: Then they raised over him a great heap of stones, still there to this day. So the Lord turned from the fierceness of His anger. Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Achor to this day.
chapters.kjv: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: ഭയപ്പെടരുതു, വിഷാദിക്കയും അരുതു; പടജ്ജനത്തെയൊക്കെയും കൂട്ടിപുറപ്പെട്ടു ഹായിയിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുക; ഞാൻ ഹായിരാജാവിനെയും അവന്റെ ജനത്തെയും പട്ടണത്തെയും ദേശത്തെയും നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. For I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai, his people, his city and his land.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord said to Joshua: "Do not be afraid, nor be dismayed; take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

chapters.ml: യെരീഹോവിനോടും അതിന്റെ രാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്തതുപോലെ നീ ഹായിയോടും അതിന്റെ രാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്യേണം: എന്നാൽ അതിലെ കൊള്ളയെയും കന്നുകാലികളെയും നിങ്ങൾക്കു എടുത്തു കൊള്ളാം. പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ പിൻഭാഗത്തു പതിയിരിപ്പു ആക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the city."
chapters.nkjv: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king. Only its spoil and its cattle you shall take as booty for yourselves. Lay an ambush for the city behind it."
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോശുവയും പടജ്ജനമൊക്കെയും ഹായിയിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു: പരാക്രമശാലികളായ മുപ്പതിനായിരംപേരെ യോശുവ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു രാത്രിയിൽ അയച്ചു,
chapters.niv: So Joshua and the whole army moved out to attack Ai. He chose thirty thousand of his best fighting men and sent them out at night
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai; and Joshua chose thirty thousand mighty men of valor and sent them away by night.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ പിൻഭാഗത്തു പതിയിരിക്കേണം; പട്ടണത്തോടു ഏറെ അകലാതെ എല്ലാവരും ഒരുങ്ങിയിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: with these orders: "Listen carefully. You are to set an ambush behind the city. Don’t go very far from it. All of you be on the alert.
chapters.nkjv: And he commanded them, saying: "Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Do not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

chapters.ml: ഞാനും എന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള സകലജനവും പട്ടണത്തോടു അടുക്കും; അവർ മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ ഞങ്ങളുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരുമ്പോൾ ഞങ്ങൾ അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടും.
chapters.niv: I and all those with me will advance on the city, and when the men come out against us, as they did before, we will flee from them.
chapters.nkjv: Then I and all the people who are with me will approach the city; and it will come about, when they come out against us as at the first, that we shall flee before them.
chapters.kjv: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

chapters.ml: അവർ ഞങ്ങളെ പിന്തുടർന്നു പട്ടണം വിട്ടു പുറത്താകും. അവർ മുമ്പെപ്പോലെ നമ്മുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോകുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറയും; അങ്ങനെ ഞങ്ങൾ അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടും.
chapters.niv: They will pursue us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are running away from us as they did before.’ So when we flee from them,
chapters.nkjv: For they will come out after us till we have drawn them from the city, for they will say, ‘Theyare fleeing before us as at the first.’ Therefore we will flee before them.
chapters.kjv: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ നിങ്ങൾ പതിയിരിപ്പിൽനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു പട്ടണം പിടിക്കേണം; നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അതു നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: you are to rise up from ambush and take the city. The Lord your God will give it into your hand.
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall rise from the ambush and seize the city, for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.
chapters.kjv: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണം പിടിച്ചശേഷം നിങ്ങൾ അതിന്നു തീ വെക്കേണം; യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യേണം; സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do what the Lord has commanded. See to it; you have my orders."
chapters.nkjv: And it will be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire. According to the commandment of the Lord you shall do. See, I have commanded you."
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോശുവ അവരെ അയച്ചു അവർ പതിയിരിപ്പിന്നു ചെന്നു ബേഥേലിന്നും ഹായിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ഹായിക്കു പടിഞ്ഞാറു അമർന്നു, യോശുവയോ ആ രാത്രി ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua sent them off, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai—but Joshua spent that night with the people.
chapters.nkjv: Joshua therefore sent them out; and they went to lie in ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai; but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
chapters.kjv: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ജനത്തെ പരിശോധിച്ചു. അവനും യിസ്രായേൽ മൂപ്പന്മാരും ജനത്തിന്നു മുമ്പായി ഹായിക്കു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning Joshua mustered his army, and he and the leaders of Israel marched before them to Ai.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua rose up early in the morning and mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പടജ്ജനമൊക്കെയും പുറപ്പെട്ടു അടുത്തുചെന്നു പട്ടണത്തിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ എത്തി ഹായിക്കു വടക്കു പാളയമിറങ്ങി; അവർക്കും ഹായിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ഒരു താഴ്വര ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The entire force that was with him marched up and approached the city and arrived in front of it. They set up camp north of Ai, with the valley between them and the city.
chapters.nkjv: And all the people of war who were with him went up and drew near; and they came before the city and camped on the north side of Ai. Now a valley lay between them and Ai.
chapters.kjv: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഏകദേശം അയ്യായിരം പേരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു ബേഥേലിന്നും ഹായിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പടിഞ്ഞാറു പതിയിരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.
chapters.nkjv: So he took about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
chapters.kjv: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.

chapters.ml: അവർ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു വടക്കു പടജ്ജനമായ സൈന്യത്തെ ഒക്കെയും പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പടിഞ്ഞാറു പതിയിരിപ്പുകാരെയും നിറുത്തി; യോശുവ ആ രാത്രി താഴ്വരയുടെ നടുവിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: So the soldiers took up their positions—with the main camp to the north of the city and the ambush to the west of it. That night Joshua went into the valley.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had set the people, all the army that was on the north of the city, and its rear guard on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
chapters.kjv: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

chapters.ml: ഹായിരാജാവു അതു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവനും നഗരവാസികളായ അവന്റെ ജനമൊക്കെയും ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരുന്ന സമയത്തു സമഭൂമിക്കു മുമ്പിൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ പടെക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു. പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ പിൻവശത്തു തനിക്കു വിരോധമായി പതിയിരിപ്പു ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അവൻ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: When the king of Ai saw this, he and all the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set against him behind the city.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when the king of Ai saw it, that the men of the city hurried and rose early and went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at an appointed place before the plain. But he did not know that therewas an ambush against him behind the city.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it , that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും അവരോടു തോറ്റ ഭാവത്തിൽ മരുഭൂമിവഴിയായി ഓടി.
chapters.niv: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be driven back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അവരെ പിന്തുടരേണ്ടതിന്നു പട്ടണത്തിലെ ജനത്തെ ഒക്കെയും വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി അവർ യോശുവയെ പിന്തുടർന്നു പട്ടണം വിട്ടു പുറത്തായി.
chapters.niv: All the men of Ai were called to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.
chapters.nkjv: So all the people who were in Ai were called together to pursue them. And they pursued Joshua and were drawn away from the city.
chapters.kjv: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

chapters.ml: ഹായിയിലും ബേഥേലിലും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ പുറപ്പെടാതെ ഒരുത്തനും ശേഷിച്ചില്ല; അവർ പട്ടണം തുറന്നിട്ടേച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel. So they left the city open and pursued Israel.
chapters.kjv: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു: നിന്റെ കയ്യിലുള്ള കുന്തം ഹായിക്കുനേരെ ഏന്തുക; ഞാൻ അതു നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു. അങ്ങനെ യോശുവ തന്റെ കയ്യിലുള്ള കുന്തം ഹായിക്കു നേരെ ഏന്തി.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Hold out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city." So Joshua held out toward the city the javelin that was in his hand.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Stretch out the spear that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand." And Joshua stretched out the spear that was in his hand toward the city.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കൈ നീട്ടിയ ഉടനെ പിതയിരിപ്പുകാർ തങ്ങളുടെ സ്ഥലത്തു നിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഓടി പട്ടണത്തിൽ കയറി അതു പിടിച്ചു ക്ഷണത്തിൽ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു തീവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As soon as he did this, the men in the ambush rose quickly from their position and rushed forward. They entered the city and captured it and quickly set it on fire.
chapters.nkjv: So thosein ambush arose quickly out of their place; they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand, and they entered the city and took it, and hurried to set the city on fire.
chapters.kjv: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

chapters.ml: ഹായിപട്ടണക്കാർ പുറകോട്ടു നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ പട്ടണത്തിലെ പുക ആകാശത്തേക്കു പൊങ്ങുന്നതുകണ്ടു; അവർക്കു ഇങ്ങോട്ടോ അങ്ങോട്ടോ ഓടുവാൻ കഴിവില്ലാതെയായി; മരുഭൂമിവഴിയായി ഓടിയ ജനവും തങ്ങളെ പിന്തുടരുന്നവരുടെ നേരെ തിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising up into the sky, but they had no chance to escape in any direction; the Israelites who had been fleeing toward the wilderness had turned back against their pursuers.
chapters.nkjv: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended to heaven. So they had no power to flee this way or that way, and the people who had fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.
chapters.kjv: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

chapters.ml: പതിയിരിപ്പുകാർ പട്ടണം പിടിച്ചു. പട്ടണത്തിലെ പുക മേലോട്ടു പൊങ്ങുന്നു എന്നു യോശുവയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും കണ്ടപ്പോൾ മടങ്ങിവന്നു പട്ടണക്കാരെ വെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that smoke was going up from it, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that the smoke of the city ascended, they turned back and struck down the men of Ai.
chapters.kjv: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

chapters.ml: മറ്റവരും പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു അവരുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽ ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തും അവർ നടുവിലും ആയി; ഒരുത്തനും ശേഷിക്കയോ വഴുതിപ്പോകയോ ചെയ്യാതവണ്ണം അവരെ വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Those in the ambush also came out of the city against them, so that they were caught in the middle, with Israelites on both sides. Israel cut them down, leaving them neither survivors nor fugitives.
chapters.nkjv: Then the others came out of the city against them; so they were caught in the midst of Israel, some on this side and some on that side. And they struck them down, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
chapters.kjv: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

chapters.ml: ഹായിരാജാവിനെ അവർ ജീവനോടെ പിടിച്ചു യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
chapters.nkjv: But the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ തങ്ങളെ പിന്തുടർന്ന ഹായിപട്ടണക്കാരെ ഒക്കെയും വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തു മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നുതീർക്കയും അവർ ഒട്ടൊഴിയാതെ എല്ലാവരും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വീണൊടുങ്ങുകയും ചെയ്തശേഷം യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഒക്കെയും ഹായിയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ അതിനെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai in the fields and in the wilderness where they had chased them, and when every one of them had been put to the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and killed those who were in it.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness where they pursued them, and when they all had fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

chapters.ml: അന്നു പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളുമായി വീണൊടുങ്ങിയവർ ആകെ പന്തീരായിരം പേർ; ഹായിപട്ടണക്കാർ എല്ലാവരും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.
chapters.nkjv: So it was that all who fell that day, both men and women, were twelve thousand—all the people of Ai.
chapters.kjv: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

chapters.ml: ഹായിപട്ടണക്കാരെ ഒക്കെയും നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കുംവരെ കുന്തം ഏന്തിയ കൈ യോശുവ പിൻവലിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: For Joshua did not draw back the hand that held out his javelin until he had destroyed all who lived in Ai.
chapters.nkjv: For Joshua did not draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
chapters.kjv: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ച വചനപ്രകാരം യിസ്രായേല്യർ പട്ടണത്തിലെ കന്നുകാലികളെയും കൊള്ളയെയും തങ്ങൾക്കായിട്ടു തന്നേ എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: But Israel did carry off for themselves the livestock and plunder of this city, as the Lord had instructed Joshua.
chapters.nkjv: Only the livestock and the spoil of that city Israel took as booty for themselves, according to the word of the Lord which He had commanded Joshua.
chapters.kjv: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവ ഹായിപട്ടണം ചുട്ടു സദാകാലത്തേക്കും ഒരു മൺക്കുന്നും ശൂന്യഭൂമിയുമാക്കിത്തീർത്തു; അതു ഇന്നുവരെയും അങ്ങിനെ കിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolate place to this day.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, a desolation to this day.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.

chapters.ml: ഹായിരാജാവിനെ അവൻ സന്ധ്യവരെ ഒരു മരത്തിൽ തൂക്കി; സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിച്ചപ്പോൾ യോശുവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം ശവം മരത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറക്കി പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽ ഇടുകയും അതിന്മേൽ ഇന്നുവരെ നില്ക്കുന്ന ഒരു വലിയ കൽക്കുന്നു കൂട്ടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He impaled the body of the king of Ai on a pole and left it there until evening. At sunset, Joshua ordered them to take the body from the pole and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And they raised a large pile of rocks over it, which remains to this day.
chapters.nkjv: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until evening. And as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his corpse down from the tree, cast it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raise over it a great heap of stones thatremains to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോശുവ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു ഏബാൽപർവ്വതത്തിൽ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel,
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua built an altar to the Lord God of Israel in Mount Ebal,
chapters.kjv: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെയും മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെയും ചെത്തുകയോ ഇരിമ്പു തൊടുവിക്കയോ ചെയ്യാത്ത കല്ലുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു യാഗപീഠം തന്നേ. അവർ അതിന്മേൽ യഹോവെക്കു ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses—an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron tool had been used. On it they offered to the Lord burnt offerings and sacrificed fellowship offerings.
chapters.nkjv: as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses: "an altar of whole stones over which no man has wielded an iron tool." And they offered on it burnt offerings to the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.
chapters.kjv: As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD , and sacrificed peace offerings.

chapters.ml: മോശെ എഴുതിയിരുന്ന ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്റെ ഒരു പകർപ്പു അവൻ അവിടെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കാൺകെ ആ കല്ലുകളിൽ എഴുതി.
chapters.niv: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua wrote on stones a copy of the law of Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And there, in the presence of the children of Israel, he wrote on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he had written.
chapters.kjv: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും അവരുടെ മൂപ്പന്മാരും പ്രമാണികളും ന്യായാധിപന്മാരും യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം ചുമന്ന ലേവ്യരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പാകെ സ്വദേശിയും പരദേശിയും ഒരു പോലെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തും നിന്നു; അവരിൽ പാതിപേർ ഗെരിസീംപർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ വശത്തും പാതിപേർ ഏബാൽപർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ വശത്തും നിന്നു; അവർ യിസ്രായേൽജനത്തെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണമെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ മുമ്പെ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: All the Israelites, with their elders, officials and judges, were standing on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the Lord , facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Both the foreigners living among them and the native-born were there. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord had formerly commanded when he gave instructions to bless the people of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Then all Israel, with their elders and officers and judges, stood on either side of the ark before the priests, the Levites, who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, the stranger as well as he who was born among them. Half of them were in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവർ ന്യായപ്രമാണപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അനുഗ്രഹവും ശാപവുമായ ന്യായപ്രമാണവചനങ്ങളെല്ലാം വായിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Afterward, Joshua read all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—just as it is written in the Book of the Law.
chapters.nkjv: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and the cursings, according to all that is written in the Book of the Law.
chapters.kjv: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

chapters.ml: മോശെ കല്പിച്ച സകലത്തിലും സ്ത്രീകളും കുട്ടികളും ഉൾപ്പെടെ യിസ്രായേൽസഭ മുഴുവനും അവരോടു കൂടെ വന്നിരുന്ന പരദേശികളും കേൾക്കെ യോശുവ മോശെ കല്പിച്ച സകലത്തിലും യാതൊന്നും വായിക്കാതെ വിട്ടുകളഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read to the whole assembly of Israel, including the women and children, and the foreigners who lived among them.
chapters.nkjv: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded which Joshua did not read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the strangers who were living among them.
chapters.kjv: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹിത്യർ, അമോർയ്യർ, കനാന്യർ, പെരിസ്യർ, ഹിവ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ എന്നിങ്ങനെ യോർദ്ദാന്നിക്കരെ മലകളിലും താഴ്വരകളിലും ലെബാനോന്നെതിരെ വലിയ കടലിന്റെ തീരങ്ങളിലുള്ള രാജാക്കന്മാർ ഒക്കെയും വസ്തുത കേട്ടപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: Now when all the kings west of the Jordan heard about these things—the kings in the hill country, in the western foothills, and along the entire coast of the Mediterranean Sea as far as Lebanon (the kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites)—
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass when all the kings who were on this side of the Jordan, in the hills and in the lowland and in all the coasts of the Great Sea toward Lebanon— the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—heard aboutit,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;

chapters.ml: യോശുവയോടും യിസ്രായേലിനോടും യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഏകമനസ്സോടെ യോജിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: they came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.
chapters.nkjv: that they gathered together to fight with Joshua and Israel with one accord.
chapters.kjv: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോശുവ യെരീഹോവിനോടും ഹായിയോടും ചെയ്തതു ഗിബെയോൻ നിവാസികൾ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
chapters.nkjv: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
chapters.kjv: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒരു ഉപായം പ്രയോഗിച്ചു: ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങളൊരുക്കി പഴയ ചാക്കുകളും പഴയതും കീറിയതും തുന്നിക്കെട്ടിയതുമായ വീഞ്ഞുതുരുത്തികളും കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി,
chapters.niv: they resorted to a ruse: They went as a delegation whose donkeys were loaded with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.
chapters.nkjv: they worked craftily, and went and pretended to be ambassadors. And they took old sacks on their donkeys, old wineskins torn and mended,
chapters.kjv: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

chapters.ml: പഴക്കംചെന്നു കണ്ടംവെച്ച ചെരിപ്പു കാലിലും പഴയവസ്ത്രം ദേഹത്തിന്മേലും ധരിച്ചു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവരുടെ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നുള്ള അപ്പവും എല്ലാം ഉണങ്ങി പൂത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They put worn and patched sandals on their feet and wore old clothes. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.
chapters.nkjv: old and patched sandals on their feet, and old garments on themselves; and all the bread of their provision was dry and moldy.
chapters.kjv: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ പാളയത്തിലേക്കു യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടും യിസ്രായേൽപുരഷന്മാരോടും: ഞങ്ങൾ ദൂരദേശത്തുനിന്നു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ ഞങ്ങളോടു ഒരു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the Israelites, "We have come from a distant country; make a treaty with us."
chapters.nkjv: And they went to Joshua, to the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, "We have come from a far country; now therefore, make a covenant with us."
chapters.kjv: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽപുരുഷന്മാർ ആ ഹിവ്യരോടു: പക്ഷേ നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർക്കുന്നവരായിരിക്കും; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളോടു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites said to the Hivites, "But perhaps you live near us, so how can we make a treaty with you?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of Israel said to the Hivites, "Perhaps you dwell among us; so how can we make a covenant with you?"
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

chapters.ml: അവർ യോശുവയോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ യോശുവ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ആർ? എവിടെനിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "We are your servants," they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, "Who are you and where do you come from?"
chapters.nkjv: But they said to Joshua, "We are your servants." And Joshua said to them, "Who are you, and where do you come from?"
chapters.kjv: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: അടിയങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമംനിമിത്തം ഏറ്റവും ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ കീർത്തിയും അവൻ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും
chapters.niv: They answered: "Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the Lord your God. For we have heard reports of him: all that he did in Egypt,
chapters.nkjv: So they said to him: "From a very far country your servants have come, because of the name of the Lord your God; for we have heard of His fame, and all that He did in Egypt,
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

chapters.ml: ഹെശ്ബോൻ രാജാവായ സീഹോൻ, അസ്തരോത്തിലെ ബാശാൻ രാജാവായ ഓഗ് ഇങ്ങനെ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെയുള്ള അമോർയ്യരുടെ രണ്ടു രാജാക്കന്മാരോടും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങൾ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.
chapters.nkjv: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan—to Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.
chapters.kjv: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങളുടെ മൂപ്പന്മാരും ദേശനിവാസികൾ എല്ലാവരും ഞങ്ങളോടു വഴിക്കു വേണ്ടുന്ന ഭക്ഷണസാധനം എടുത്തു അവരെ ചെന്നുകണ്ടു: ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദാസന്മാർ ആയിക്കൊള്ളാം എന്നു അവരോടു പറയേണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളോടു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: And our elders and all those living in our country said to us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go and meet them and say to them, "We are your servants; make a treaty with us." ’
chapters.nkjv: Therefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take provisions with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say to them, "We are your servants; now therefore, make a covenant with us." ’
chapters.kjv: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ട നാളിൽ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നായിട്ടു ഈ അപ്പം ചൂടോടെ ഞങ്ങളുടെ വീടുകളിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തതാകുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, അതു ഉണങ്ങി പൂത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But now see how dry and moldy it is.
chapters.nkjv: This bread of ours we took hot for our provision from our houses on the day we departed to come to you. But now look, it is dry and moldy.
chapters.kjv: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ വീഞ്ഞു നിറെച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോന്ന ഈ തുരുത്തികൾ പുത്തനായിരുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, അവ കീറിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഈ വസ്ത്രവും ചെരിപ്പും അതിദീർഘയാത്രയാൽ പഴക്കമായുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And these wineskins that we filled were new, but see how cracked they are. And our clothes and sandals are worn out by the very long journey."
chapters.nkjv: And these wineskins which we filled were new, and see, they are torn; and these our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey."
chapters.kjv: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽപുരുഷന്മാർ യഹോവയോടു ചോദിക്കാതെ അവരുടെ ഭക്ഷണസാധനം വാങ്ങി ആസ്വദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of Israel took some of their provisions; but they did not ask counsel of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യോശുവ അവരോടു സഖ്യതയും അവരെ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിക്കുമെന്നു ഉടമ്പടിയും ചെയ്തു; സഭയിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും അവരോടു സത്യംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the assembly ratified it by oath.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them to let them live; and the rulers of the congregation swore to them.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

chapters.ml: ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്തിട്ടു മൂന്നു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം അവർ സമീപസ്ഥന്മാർ എന്നും തങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർക്കുന്നവർ എന്നും അവർ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Three days after they made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were neighbors, living near them.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened at the end of three days, after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were their neighbors who dwelt near them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ടതിന്റെ മൂന്നാം ദിവസം അവരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ എത്തി. അവരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ ഗിബെയോൻ, കെഫീര, ബേരോത്ത്, കിർയ്യത്ത്--യെയാരീം എന്നിവ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel journeyed and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kirjath Jearim.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

chapters.ml: സഭയിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെക്കൊണ്ടു അവരോടു സത്യംചെയ്തിരിക്കയാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അവരെ സംഹരിച്ചില്ല; എന്നാൽ സഭ മുഴുവനും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെ നേരെ പിറുപിറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the assembly had sworn an oath to them by the Lord , the God of Israel. The whole assembly grumbled against the leaders,
chapters.nkjv: But the children of Israel did not attack them, because the rulers of the congregation had sworn to them by the Lord God of Israel. And all the congregation complained against the rulers.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

chapters.ml: പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും സർവ്വസഭയോടും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെക്കൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങൾ അവരോടു സത്യംചെയ്തിരിക്കയാൽ നമുക്കു അവരെ തൊട്ടുകൂടാ.
chapters.niv: but all the leaders answered, "We have given them our oath by the Lord , the God of Israel, and we cannot touch them now.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the rulers said to all the congregation, "We have sworn to them by the Lord God of Israel; now therefore, we may not touch them.
chapters.kjv: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

chapters.ml: നാം അവരോടു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു അവരെ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിക്കേണം. അല്ലാഞ്ഞാൽ ചെയ്തുപോയ സത്യംനിമിത്തം കോപം നമ്മുടെമേൽ വരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that God’s wrath will not fall on us for breaking the oath we swore to them."
chapters.nkjv: This we will do to them: We will let them live, lest wrath be upon us because of the oath which we swore to them."
chapters.kjv: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു വാക്കുകൊടുത്തതുപോലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ അവരോടു: ഇവർ ജീവനോടെ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; എങ്കിലും അവർ സർവ്വസഭെക്കും വിറകുകീറുന്നവരും വെള്ളംകോരുന്നവരും ആയിരിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They continued, "Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers in the service of the whole assembly." So the leaders’ promise to them was kept.
chapters.nkjv: And the rulers said to them, "Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers for all the congregation, as the rulers had promised them."
chapters.kjv: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവ അവരെ വിളിച്ചു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർത്തിരിക്കെ ബഹുദൂരസ്ഥന്മാർ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഞങ്ങളെ വഞ്ചിച്ചതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, "Why did you deceive us by saying, ‘We live a long way from you,’ while actually you live near us?
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, "Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you dwell near us?
chapters.kjv: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ: എന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി വിറകുകീറുന്നവരും വെള്ളംകോരുന്നവരുമായ അടിമകൾ നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒരിക്കലും ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You are now under a curse: You will never be released from service as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, you are cursed, and none of you shall be freed from being slaves—woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോശുവയോടു: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ തന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെയോടു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഈ ദേശമെല്ലാം തരുമെന്നും നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഈ ദേശനിവാസികളെ ഒക്കെയും നശിപ്പിക്കുമെന്നും കല്പിച്ചപ്രകാരം അടിയങ്ങൾക്കു അറിവുകിട്ടിയതിനാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ നിമിത്തം ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഞങ്ങൾ ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു ഈ കാര്യം ചെയ്തിരക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They answered Joshua, "Your servants were clearly told how the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you the whole land and to wipe out all its inhabitants from before you. So we feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we did this.
chapters.nkjv: So they answered Joshua and said, "Because your servants were clearly told that the Lord your God commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you; therefore we were very much afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
chapters.kjv: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; നിനക്കു ഹിതവും യുക്തവുമായി തോന്നുന്നതുപോലെ ഞങ്ങളോടു ചെയ്തുകൊൾക എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We are now in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you."
chapters.nkjv: And now, here we are, in your hands; do with us as it seems good and right to do to us."
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അവരോടു ചെയ്തു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അവരെ കൊല്ലാതവണ്ണം അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua saved them from the Israelites, and they did not kill them.
chapters.nkjv: So he did to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they did not kill them.
chapters.kjv: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യോശുവ അവരെ സഭെക്കും യഹോവ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു അവന്റെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും വേണ്ടി വിറകുകീറുന്നവരും വെള്ളംകോരുന്നവരുമായി നിയമിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ ഇന്നുവരെയും ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the assembly, to provide for the needs of the altar of the Lord at the place the Lord would choose. And that is what they are to this day.
chapters.nkjv: And that day Joshua made them woodcutters and water carriers for the congregation and for the altar of the Lord, in the place which He would choose, even to this day.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD , even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ഹായിപട്ടണം പിടിച്ചു നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി എന്നും അവൻ യെരീഹോവിനോടും അതിന്റെ രാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഹായിയോടും അതിന്റെ രാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്തു എന്നും ഗിബെയോൻ നിവാസികൾ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു സഖ്യത ചെയ്തു അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലായി എന്നും യെരൂശലേംരാജാവായ അദോനീ-സേദെക്ക് കേട്ടപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: Now Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and totally destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the people of Gibeon had made a treaty of peace with Israel and had become their allies.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai and had utterly destroyed it— as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king—and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

chapters.ml: ഗിബെയോൻ രാജനഗരങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നുപോലെ വലിയോരു പട്ടണവും ഹായിയെക്കാൾ വലിയതും അവിടത്തെ പുരുഷന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും പരാക്രമശാലികളും ആയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He and his people were very much alarmed at this, because Gibeon was an important city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were good fighters.
chapters.nkjv: that they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
chapters.kjv: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യെരൂശലേംരാജാവായ അദോനീ-സേദെക്ക് ഹെബ്രോൻ രാജാവായ ഹോഹാമിന്റെയും യർമ്മൂത്ത്‌രാജാവായ പിരാമിന്റെയും ലാഖീശ്‌രാജാവായ യാഹീയയുടെയും എഗ്ളോൻ രാജാവായ ദെബീരിന്റെയും അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു:
chapters.niv: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem appealed to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

chapters.ml: ഗിബെയോൻ യോശുവയോടും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടും സഖ്യതചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു നാം അതിനെ നശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നെ സഹായിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Come up and help me attack Gibeon," he said, "because it has made peace with Joshua and the Israelites."
chapters.nkjv: "Come up to me and help me, that we may attack Gibeon, for it has made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel."
