chapters.kjv: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യെരൂശലേംരാജാവു, ഹെബ്രോൻ രാജാവു, യർമ്മൂത്ത്‌രാജാവു, ലാഖീശ്‌രാജാവു, എഗ്ളോൻ രാജാവു എന്നീ അഞ്ചു അമോർയ്യരാജാക്കന്മാരും ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി; അവരും അവരുടെ സൈന്യങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ചെന്നു ഗിബെയോന്നുനേരെ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി അതിനോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon—joined forces. They moved up with all their troops and took up positions against Gibeon and attacked it.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered together and went up, they and all their armies, and camped before Gibeon and made war against it.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഗിബെയോന്യർ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ പാളയത്തിലേക്കു യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: അടിയങ്ങളെ കൈവിടാതെ വേഗം ഞങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ സഹായിച്ചു രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ; പർവ്വതങ്ങളിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന അമോർയ്യരാജാക്കന്മാർ ഒക്കെയും ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വിരോധമായിട്ടു ഒന്നിച്ചു കൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: "Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us."
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, "Do not forsake your servants; come up to us quickly, save us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the mountains have gathered together against us."
chapters.kjv: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യോശുവയും പടജ്ജനം ഒക്കെയും സകലപരാക്രമശാലികളും ഗില്ഗാലിൽനിന്നു പറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army, including all the best fighting men.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valor.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു: അവരെ ഭയപ്പെടരുതു; ഞാൻ അവരെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിൽക്കയില്ല എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them; I have given them into your hand. Not one of them will be able to withstand you."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for I have delivered them into your hand; not a man of them shall stand before you."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ഗില്ഗാലിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു രാത്രി മുഴുവനും നടന്നു പെട്ടെന്നു അവരെ എതിർത്തു.
chapters.niv: After an all-night march from Gilgal, Joshua took them by surprise.
chapters.nkjv: Joshua therefore came upon them suddenly, having marched all night from Gilgal.
chapters.kjv: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവരെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കുഴക്കി ഗിബെയോനിൽവെച്ചു അവരെ കഠിനമായി തോല്പിച്ചു ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോനിലേക്കുള്ള കയറ്റംവഴിയായി അവരെ ഓടിച്ചു അസേക്കവരെയും മക്കേദവരെയും അവരെ വെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: The Lord threw them into confusion before Israel, so Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely at Gibeon. Israel pursued them along the road going up to Beth Horon and cut them down all the way to Azekah and Makkedah.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord routed them before Israel, killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, chased them along the road that goes to Beth Horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി; ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോൻ ഇറക്കത്തിൽവെച്ചു അസേക്കവരെ യഹോവ ആകാശത്തിൽനിന്നു വലിയ കല്ലു അവരുടെ മേൽ പെയ്യിച്ചു അവരെ കൊന്നു. യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്നവരെക്കാൾ കല്മഴയാൽ മരിച്ചുപോയവർ അധികം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As they fled before Israel on the road down from Beth Horon to Azekah, the Lord hurled large hailstones down on them, and more of them died from the hail than were killed by the swords of the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, as they fled before Israel and were on the descent of Beth Horon, that the Lord cast down large hailstones from heaven on them as far as Azekah, and they died. Therewere more who died from the hailstones than the children of Israel killed with the sword.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ അമോർയ്യരെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്ത ദിവസം യോശുവ യഹോവയോടു സംസാരിച്ചു, യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കേൾക്കെ: സൂര്യാ, നീ ഗിബെയോനിലും ചന്ദ്രാ, നീ അയ്യാലോൻ താഴ്വരയിലും നിൽക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On the day the Lord gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua said to the Lord in the presence of Israel: "Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and you, moon, over the Valley of Aijalon."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel: "Sun, stand still over Gibeon; And Moon, in the Valley of Aijalon."
chapters.kjv: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

chapters.ml: ജനം തങ്ങളുടെ ശത്രുക്കളോടു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യുവോളം സൂര്യൻ നിന്നു, ചന്ദ്രനും നിശ്ചലമായി. ശൂരന്മാരുടെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ അങ്ങനെ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ. ഇങ്ങനെ സൂര്യൻ ആകാശമദ്ധ്യേ ഒരു ദിവസം മുഴുവൻ അസ്തമിക്കാതെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies, as it is written in the Book of Jashar. The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.
chapters.nkjv: So the sun stood still, And the moon stopped, Till the people had revenge Upon their enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and did not hasten to go down for about a whole day.
chapters.kjv: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടനുസരിച്ച ആ ദിവസം പോലെ ഒരു ദിവസം അതിന്നു മുമ്പും പിമ്പും ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ല; യഹോവ തന്നേയായിരുന്നു യിസ്രായേലിന്നുവേണ്ടി യുദ്ധംചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the Lord listened to a human being. Surely the Lord was fighting for Israel!
chapters.nkjv: And there has been no day like that, before it or after it, that the Lord heeded the voice of a man; for the Lord fought for Israel.
chapters.kjv: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോശുവയും യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും ഗില്ഗാലിൽ പാളയത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആ രാജാക്കന്മാർ ഐവരും ഓടി മക്കേദയിലെ ഗുഹയിൽ ചെന്നു ഒളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
chapters.nkjv: But these five kings had fled and hidden themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
chapters.kjv: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

chapters.ml: രാജാക്കന്മാർ ഐവരും മക്കേദയിലെ ഗുഹയിൽ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതായി കണ്ടു എന്നു യോശുവെക്കു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,
chapters.nkjv: And it was told Joshua, saying, "The five kings have been found hidden in the cave at Makkedah."
chapters.kjv: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യോശുവ: ഗുഹയുടെ ദ്വാരത്തിങ്കൽ വലിയ കല്ലുകൾ ഉരുട്ടിവെച്ചു അവരെ കാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവിടെ ആളെയാക്കുവിൻ;
chapters.niv: he said, "Roll large rocks up to the mouth of the cave, and post some men there to guard it.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua said, "Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and set men by it to guard them.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ നിൽക്കാതെ ശത്രുക്കളെ പിന്തുടർന്നു അവരുടെ പിൻപടയെ സംഹരിപ്പിൻ; പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ കടപ്പാൻ അവരെ സമ്മതിക്കരുതു; നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അവരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But don’t stop; pursue your enemies! Attack them from the rear and don’t let them reach their cities, for the Lord your God has given them into your hand."
chapters.nkjv: And do not stay there yourselves, but pursue your enemies, and attack their rear guard. Do not allow them to enter their cities, for the Lord your God has delivered them into your hand."
chapters.kjv: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഒടുങ്ങുംവരെ യോശുവയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളും അവരിൽ ഒരു മഹാസംഹാരം നടത്തിക്കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ശേഷിച്ചവർ ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ ശരണം പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely, but a few survivors managed to reach their fortified cities.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, while Joshua and the children of Israel made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they had finished, that those who escaped entered fortified cities.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

chapters.ml: ജനമൊക്കെയും സമാധാനത്തോടെ മക്കേദയിലെ പാളയത്തിൽ യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ യാതൊരുത്തന്റെയും നേരെ ആരും തന്റെ നാവു അനക്കിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: The whole army then returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one uttered a word against the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: And all the people returned to the camp, to Joshua at Makkedah, in peace. No one moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവ: ഗുഹയുടെ ദ്വാരത്തെ തുറന്നു രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ഐവരെയും ഗുഹയിൽനിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings to me from the cave."
chapters.kjv: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

chapters.ml: അവർ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു; യെരൂശലേംരാജാവു, ഹെബ്രോൻ രാജാവു, യർമ്മൂത്ത്‌രാജാവു, ലാഖീശ്‌രാജാവു, എഗ്ളോൻ രാജാവു എന്നീ അഞ്ചുരാജാക്കന്മാരെയും ഗുഹയിൽനിന്നു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.
chapters.nkjv: And they did so, and brought out those five kings to him from the cave: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
chapters.kjv: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

chapters.ml: രാജാക്കന്മാരെ യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നപ്പോൾ യോശുവ യിസ്രായേൽപുരുഷന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും വിളിപ്പിച്ചു തന്നോടുകൂടെ പോയ പടജ്ജനത്തിന്റെ അധിപതിമാരോടു: അടുത്തുവന്നു ഈ രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ കഴുത്തിൽ കാൽ വെപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അടുത്തുചെന്നു അവരുടെ കഴുത്തിൽ കാൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they had brought these kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had come with him, "Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings." So they came forward and placed their feet on their necks.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when they brought out those kings to Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the captains of the men of war who went with him, "Come near, put your feet on the necks of these kings." And they drew near and put their feet on their necks.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ അവരോടു: ഭയപ്പെടരുതു, ശങ്കിക്കരുതു; ഉറപ്പും ധൈര്യവും ഉള്ളവരായിരിപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ യുദ്ധംചെയ്യുന്ന സകലശത്രുക്കളോടും യഹോവ ഇങ്ങനെ തന്നെ ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Be strong and courageous. This is what the Lord will do to all the enemies you are going to fight."
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid, nor be dismayed; be strong and of good courage, for thus the Lord will do to all your enemies against whom you fight."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യോശുവ അവരെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു അഞ്ചു മരത്തിന്മേൽ തൂക്കി. അവർ സന്ധ്യവരെ തൂങ്ങിക്കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua put the kings to death and exposed their bodies on five poles, and they were left hanging on the poles until evening.
chapters.nkjv: And afterward Joshua struck them and killed them, and hanged them on five trees; and they were hanging on the trees until evening.
chapters.kjv: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിക്കുന്ന സമയത്തു യോശുവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം അവരെ മരത്തിന്മേൽനിന്നു ഇറക്കി അവർ ഒളിച്ചിരുന്ന ഗുഹയിൽ ഇട്ടു; ഗുഹയുടെ ദ്വാരത്തിങ്കൽ വലിയ കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടിവെച്ചു; അതു ഇന്നുവരെയും അവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the poles and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.
chapters.nkjv: So it was at the time of the going down of the sun that Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees, cast them into the cave where they had been hidden, and laid large stones against the cave’s mouth, whichremain until this very day.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യോശുവ മക്കേദ പിടിച്ചു വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചു അതിനെയും അതിലെ രാജാവിനെയും അവിടെയുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി; ഒരുത്തനെയും ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചില്ല; അവൻ യെരീഹോരാജാവിനോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ മക്കേദാരാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.nkjv: On that day Joshua took Makkedah, and struck it and its king with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed them—all the people who were in it. He let none remain. He also did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.kjv: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയും അവനോടുകൂടെ യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും മക്കേദയിൽനിന്നു ലിബ്നെക്കുചെന്നു ലിബ്നെയോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah; and they fought against Libnah.
chapters.kjv: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അതിനെയും അതിലെ രാജാവിനെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അതിനെയും അതിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചു; അവിടെ ഒരുത്തനെയും ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചില്ല; യെരീഹോരാജാവിനോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അവർ അവിടത്തെ രാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord also gave that city and its king into Israel’s hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord also delivered it and its king into the hand of Israel; he struck it and all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword. He let none remain in it, but did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയും അവനോടുകൂടെ യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും ലിബ്നയിൽനിന്നു ലാഖീശിന്നു ചെന്നു അതിന്റെ നേരെ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി അതിനോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish; and they encamped against it and fought against it.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ലാഖീശിനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അതിനെ രണ്ടാം ദിവസം പിടിച്ചു; ലിബ്നയോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അതിനെയും അതിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord gave Lachish into Israel’s hands, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, who took it on the second day, and struck it and all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഗേസെർരാജാവായ ഹോരാം ലാഖീശിനെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ വന്നു; എന്നാൽ യോശുവ അവനെയും അവന്റെ ജനത്തെയും ആരും ശേഷിക്കാതവണ്ണം സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, Horam king of Gezer had come up to help Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army—until no survivors were left.
chapters.nkjv: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he left him none remaining.
chapters.kjv: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയും യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും ലാഖീശിൽനിന്നു എഗ്ളോന്നു ചെന്നു അതിന്റെ നേരെ പാളയമിറങ്ങി അതിനോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.
chapters.nkjv: From Lachish Joshua passed to Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it and fought against it.
chapters.kjv: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

chapters.ml: അവർ അന്നു തന്നേ അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചു; ലാഖീശിനോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അവൻ അതിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും അന്നു നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish.
chapters.nkjv: They took it on that day and struck it with the edge of the sword; all the people who were in it he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
chapters.kjv: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയും യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും എഗ്ളോനിൽനിന്നു ഹെബ്രോന്നു ചെന്നു; അതിന്റെ നേരെ യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

chapters.ml: അവർ അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ അതിനെയും അതിലെ രാജാവിനെയും അതിന്റെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളെയും അതിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും സംഹരിച്ചു; അവൻ എഗ്ളോനോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അതിനെയും അതിലുള്ള സകലമനുഷ്യരെയും ആരും ശേഷിക്കാതവണ്ണം നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.
chapters.nkjv: And they took it and struck it with the edge of the sword—its king, all its cities, and all the people who were in it; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon, but utterly destroyed it and all the people who were in it.
chapters.kjv: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും തിരിഞ്ഞു ദെബീരിന്നു ചെന്നു അതിന്റെ നേരെ യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and they fought against it.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിനെയും അതിലെ രാജാവിനെയും അതിന്റെ എല്ലാ പട്ടണങ്ങളെയും പിടിച്ചു വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചു; അതിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരെയും ആരും ശേഷിക്കാതവണ്ണം നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി; അവൻ ഹെബ്രോനോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെയും ലിബ്നയോടും അതിലെ രാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്തതുപോലെയും ദെബീരിനോടും അതിലെ രാജാവിനോടും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.
chapters.nkjv: And he took it and its king and all its cities; they struck them with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed all the people who were in it. He left none remaining; as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir and its king, as he had done also to Libnah and its king.
chapters.kjv: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യോശുവ മലനാടു, തെക്കേ ദേശം, താഴ്വീതി, മലഞ്ചരിവുകൾ എന്നിങ്ങനെയുള്ള ദേശം ഒക്കെയും അവിടങ്ങളിലെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരെയും ജയിച്ചടക്കി; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവൻ ഒരുത്തനെയും ശേഷിപ്പിക്കാതെ സകലജീവികളെയും നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua conquered all the land: the mountain country and the South and the lowland and the wilderness slopes, and all their kings; he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ കാദേശ് ബർന്നേയമുതൽ ഗസ്സാവരെയും ഗിബെയോൻ വരെയും ഗോശെൻ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും ജയിച്ചടക്കി.
chapters.niv: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua conquered them from Kadesh Barnea as far as Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even as far as Gibeon.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

chapters.ml: ഈ രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും അവരുടെ ദേശത്തെയും യോശുവ ഒരേ സമയത്തു പിടിച്ചു. യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയായിരുന്നു യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the Lord , the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
chapters.nkjv: All these kings and their land Joshua took at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
chapters.kjv: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും ഗില്ഗാലിൽ പാളയത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഹാസോർരാജാവായ യാബീൻ ഇതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ മാദോൻ രാജാവായ യോബാബ്, ശിമ്രോൻ രാജാവു, അക്കശാഫ്രാജാവു എന്നിവരുടെ അടുക്കലും
chapters.niv: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Akshaph,
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor heard thesethings, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

chapters.ml: വടക്കു മലൻ പ്രദേശത്തും കിന്നെരോത്തിന്നു തെക്കു സമഭൂമിയിലും താഴ്വീതിയിലും പടിഞ്ഞാറു ദോർമേടുകളിലും ഉള്ള രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കലും
chapters.niv: and to the northern kings who were in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills and in Naphoth Dor on the west;
chapters.nkjv: and to the kings who were from the north, in the mountains, in the plain south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,
chapters.kjv: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

chapters.ml: കിഴക്കും പടിഞ്ഞാറുമുള്ള കനാന്യർ, പർവ്വതങ്ങളിലെ അമോർയ്യർ, ഹിത്യർ, പെരിസ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ, മിസ്പെദേശത്തു ഹെർമ്മോന്റെ അടിവാരത്തുള്ള ഹിവ്യർ എന്നിവരുടെ അടുക്കലും ആളയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah.
chapters.nkjv: to the Canaanites in the east and in the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the mountains, and the Hivite below Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
chapters.kjv: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

chapters.ml: അവർ പെരുപ്പത്തിൽ കടൽക്കരയിലെ മണൽപോലെ അനവധി ജനവും എത്രയും വളരെ കുതിരകളും രഥങ്ങളുംകൂടിയ സൈന്യങ്ങളുമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They came out with all their troops and a large number of horses and chariots—a huge army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.
chapters.nkjv: So they went out, they and all their armies with them, as many people as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.
chapters.kjv: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

chapters.ml: ആ രാജാക്കന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി യിസ്രായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ മേരോംതടാകത്തിന്നരികെ വന്നു ഒരുമിച്ചു പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: All these kings joined forces and made camp together at the Waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And when all these kings had met together, they came and camped together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
chapters.kjv: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു: അവരെ പേടിക്കേണ്ടാ; ഞാൻ നാളെ ഈ നേരം അവരെ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ചത്തുവീഴുമാറാക്കും; നീ അവരുടെ കുതിരകളുടെ കുതിഞരമ്പു വെട്ടി രഥങ്ങൾ തീയിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, because by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them, slain, over to Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots."
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow about this time I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോശുവയും പടജ്ജനം ഒക്കെയും മേരോംതടാകത്തിന്നരികെ പെട്ടെന്നു അവരുടെ നേരെ വന്നു അവരെ ആക്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua and his whole army came against them suddenly at the Waters of Merom and attacked them,
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua and all the people of war with him came against them suddenly by the waters of Merom, and they attacked them.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവരെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു; മഹാനഗരമായ സീദോൻ വരെയും, മിസ്രെഫോത്ത് മയീംവരെയും കിഴക്കോട്ടു മിസ്പെതാഴ്വീതിവരെയും അവരെ ഓടിച്ചു, ആരും ശേഷിക്കാതവണ്ണം സംഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and the Lord gave them into the hand of Israel. They defeated them and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon, to Misrephoth Maim, and to the Valley of Mizpah on the east, until no survivors were left.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who defeated them and chased them to Greater Sidon, to the Brook Misrephoth, and to the Valley of Mizpah eastward; they attacked them until they left none of them remaining.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ യോശുവ അവരോടു ചെയ്തു: അവരുടെ കുതിരകളുടെ കുതിഞരമ്പു വെട്ടി രഥങ്ങൾ തീയിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joshua did to them as the Lord had directed: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua did to them as the Lord had told him: he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ആ സമയം തിരിഞ്ഞു ഹാസോർ പിടിച്ചു അതിലെ രാജാവിനെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്നു; ഹാസോർ മുമ്പെ ആ രാജ്യങ്ങൾക്കു ഒക്കെയും മൂലസ്ഥാനമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword. (Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.)
chapters.nkjv: Joshua turned back at that time and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor was formerly the head of all those kingdoms.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

chapters.ml: അവർ അതിലെ സകലമനുഷ്യരെയും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വെട്ടി നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി; ആരും ജീവനോടെ ശേഷിച്ചില്ല; അവൻ ഹാസോരിനെ തീകൊടുത്തു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Everyone in it they put to the sword. They totally destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed, and he burned Hazor itself.
chapters.nkjv: And they struck all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was none left breathing. Then he burned Hazor with fire.
chapters.kjv: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

chapters.ml: ആ രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളെയും അവയിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും യോശുവ പിടിച്ചു വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വെട്ടി നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു. യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Joshua took all these royal cities and their kings and put them to the sword. He totally destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.
chapters.nkjv: So all the cities of those kings, and all their kings, Joshua took and struck with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.
chapters.kjv: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കുന്നുകളിലെ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ ഒന്നും യിസ്രായേൽ ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞില്ല; ഹാസോർ മാത്രമേ യോശുവ ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds—except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
chapters.nkjv: But asfor the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only, which Joshua burned.
chapters.kjv: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

chapters.ml: ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലെ കൊള്ള ഒക്കെയും കന്നുകാലികളെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ തങ്ങൾക്കുതന്നേ എടുത്തു; എങ്കിലും മനുഷ്യരെ ഒക്കെയും അവർ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചു; ആരെയും ജീവനോടെ ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Israelites carried off for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but all the people they put to the sword until they completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed.
chapters.nkjv: And all the spoil of these cities and the livestock, the children of Israel took as booty for themselves; but they struck every man with the edge of the sword until they had destroyed them, and they left none breathing.
chapters.kjv: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ മോശെ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ചു; യോശുവ അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു; യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതിൽ ഒന്നും അവൻ ചെയ്യാതെ വിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did it; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: As the Lord had commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did. He left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മലനാടും തെക്കേദേശമൊക്കെയും ഗോശേൻ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും താഴ്വീതിയും അരാബയും യിസ്രായേൽമലനാടും അതിന്റെ താഴ്വീതിയും സേയീരിലേക്കുള്ള കയറ്റത്തിലെ മൊട്ടക്കുന്നു തുടങ്ങി ഹെർമ്മോൻ പർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ അടിവാരത്തുള്ള ലെബാനോൻ താഴ്വരയിലെ ബാൽ-ഗാദ്വരെയുള്ള ദേശമൊക്കെയും യോശുവ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua took this entire land: the hill country, all the Negev, the whole region of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah and the mountains of Israel with their foothills,
chapters.nkjv: Thus Joshua took all this land: the mountain country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, and the Jordan plain—the mountains of Israel and its lowlands,
chapters.kjv: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

chapters.ml: അവിടങ്ങളിലെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരെയും അവൻ പിടിച്ചു വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and put them to death.
chapters.nkjv: from Mount Halak and the ascent to Seir, even as far as Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings, and struck them down and killed them.
chapters.kjv: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

chapters.ml: ആ രാജാക്കന്മാരോടു ഒക്കെയും യോശുവ ഏറിയ കാലം യുദ്ധംചെയ്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.
chapters.nkjv: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
chapters.kjv: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

chapters.ml: ഗിബയോൻ നിവാസികളായ ഹിവ്യർ ഒഴികെ ഒരു പട്ടണക്കാരും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു സഖ്യതചെയ്തില്ല; ശേഷമൊക്കെയും അവർ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ പിടിച്ചടക്കി.
chapters.niv: Except for the Hivites living in Gibeon, not one city made a treaty of peace with the Israelites, who took them all in battle.
chapters.nkjv: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. All theothers they took in battle.
chapters.kjv: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവരെ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കുകയും കരുണകൂടാതെ നശിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവർ നെഞ്ചുറപ്പിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ സംഗതിവരുത്തിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For it was the Lord himself who hardened their hearts to wage war against Israel, so that he might destroy them totally, exterminating them without mercy, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that He might utterly destroy them, and that they might receive no mercy, but that He might destroy them, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു യോശുവ ചെന്നു മലനാടായ ഹെബ്രോൻ, ദെബീർ, അനാബ്, യെഹൂദാ മലനാടു, യിസ്രായേല്യമലനാടു എന്നീ ഇടങ്ങളിൽനിന്നൊക്കെയും അനാക്യരെ സംഹരിച്ചു; അവരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ യോശുവ അവരെ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: At that time Joshua went and destroyed the Anakites from the hill country: from Hebron, Debir and Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua totally destroyed them and their towns.
chapters.nkjv: And at that time Joshua came and cut off the Anakim from the mountains: from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel; Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
chapters.kjv: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

chapters.ml: ഗസ്സയിലും ഗത്തിലും അസ്തോദിലും മാത്രമല്ലാതെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ദേശത്തെങ്ങും ഒരു അനാക്യനും ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: No Anakites were left in Israelite territory; only in Gaza, Gath and Ashdod did any survive.
chapters.nkjv: None of the Anakim were left in the land of the children of Israel; they remained only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod.
chapters.kjv: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യോശുവ ദേശം മുഴുവനും പിടിച്ചു; യോശുവ അതിനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഗോത്രവിഭാഗപ്രകാരം ഭാഗിച്ചു കൊടുത്തു; ഇങ്ങനെ യുദ്ധം തീർന്നു ദേശത്തിന്നു സ്വസ്ഥത വന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Joshua took the entire land, just as the Lord had directed Moses, and he gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal divisions. Then the land had rest from war.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord had said to Moses; and Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land rested from war.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ കിഴക്കു അർന്നോൻ താഴ്വരമുതൽ ഹെർമ്മോൻ പർവ്വതംവരെയുള്ള രാജ്യവും കിഴക്കെ അരാബ മുഴുവനും കൈവശമാക്കുകയിൽ സംഹരിച്ചു കളഞ്ഞ തദ്ദേശരാജാക്കന്മാർ ഇവർ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:
chapters.nkjv: These are the kings of the land whom the children of Israel defeated, and whose land they possessed on the other side of the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the River Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the eastern Jordan plain:
chapters.kjv: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

chapters.ml: ഹെശ്ബോനിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യരാജാവായ സീഹോൻ; അവൻ അർന്നോൻ ആറ്റുവക്കത്തുള്ള അരോവേർമുതൽ താഴ്വരയുടെ മദ്ധ്യഭാഗവും ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ പാതിയും അമ്മോന്യരുടെ അതിരായ യബ്ബോക്ക് നദിവരെയും
chapters.niv: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge—from the middle of the gorge—to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: Onekingwas Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon and ruled half of Gilead, from Aroer, which is on the bank of the River Arnon, from the middle of that river, even as far as the River Jabbok, whichis the border of the Ammonites,
chapters.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

chapters.ml: കിന്നെരോത്ത് കടലും അരാബയിലെ കടലായ ഉപ്പുകടലും വരെ ബേത്ത്-യെശീമോത്തോളം ഉള്ള കിഴക്കെ അരാബയും പിസ്ഗച്ചരിവിന്റെ താഴെ തേമാനും വാണിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Galilee to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
chapters.nkjv: and the eastern Jordan plain from the Sea of Chinneroth as far as the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), the road to Beth Jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
chapters.kjv: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:

chapters.ml: ബാശാൻ രാജാവായ ഓഗിന്റെ ദേശവും അവർ പിടിച്ചടക്കി; മല്ലന്മാരിൽ ശേഷിച്ച ഇവർ അസ്തരോത്തിലും എദ്രെയിലും പാർത്തു,
chapters.niv: And the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
chapters.nkjv: Theotherkingwas Og king of Bashan and his territory, whowas of the remnant of the giants, who dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
chapters.kjv: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

chapters.ml: ഹെർമ്മോൻ പർവ്വതവും സൽക്കയും ബാശാൻ മുഴുവനും ഗെശൂർയ്യരുടെയും മാഖാത്യരുടെയും ദേശവും ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ പാതിയും ഹെശ്ബോൻ രാജാവായ സീഹോന്റെ അതിർവരെയും വാണിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salekah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maakah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
chapters.nkjv: and reigned over Mount Hermon, over Salcah, over all Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and over half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
chapters.kjv: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

chapters.ml: അവരെ യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുംകൂടെ സംഹരിച്ചു; യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ അവരുടെ ദേശം രൂബേന്യർക്കും ഗാദ്യർക്കും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതി ഗോത്രത്തിന്നും അവകാശമായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the Lord gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.
chapters.nkjv: These Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel had conquered; and Moses the servant of the Lord had given it as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.kjv: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോശുവയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളും യോർദ്ദാന്നിക്കരെ പടിഞ്ഞാറു ലെബാനോന്റെ താഴ്വരയിലെ ബാൽ-ഗാദ് മുതൽ സേയീരിലേക്കുള്ള കയറ്റത്തിലെ മൊട്ടക്കുന്നുവരെ ജയിച്ചടക്കുകയും യോശുവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഗോത്രവിഭാഗപ്രകാരം അവകാശമായി കൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്ത ദേശത്തിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാർ ഇവർ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Here is a list of the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir. Joshua gave their lands as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions.
chapters.nkjv: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel conquered on this side of the Jordan, on the west, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon as far as Mount Halak and the ascent to Seir, which Joshua gave to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their divisions,
chapters.kjv: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

chapters.ml: മലനാട്ടിലും താഴ്വീതിയിലും അരാബയിലും മലഞ്ചരിവുകളിലും മരുഭൂമിയിലും തെക്കേ ദേശത്തും ഉള്ള ഹിത്യൻ, അമോർയ്യൻ, കനാന്യൻ, പെരിസ്യൻ, ഹിവ്യൻ, യെബൂസ്യൻ എന്നിവർതന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The lands included the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the wilderness and the Negev. These were the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites. These were the kings:
chapters.nkjv: in the mountain country, in the lowlands, in the Jordan plain, in the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the South— the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
chapters.kjv: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

chapters.ml: യെരീഹോരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ബേഥേലിന്നരികെയുള്ള ഹായിരാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Jericho onethe king of Ai (near Bethel) one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേംരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ഹെബ്രോൻ രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Jerusalem onethe king of Hebron one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

chapters.ml: യർമ്മൂത്ത് രാജാവു ഒന്നു; ലാഖീശിലെ രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Jarmuth onethe king of Lachish one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

chapters.ml: എഗ്ളോനിലെ രാജാവു ഒന്നു; ഗേസർ രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Eglon onethe king of Gezer one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

chapters.ml: ദെബീർരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ഗേദെർരാജാവു ഒന്നു
chapters.niv: the king of Debir onethe king of Geder one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

chapters.ml: ഹോർമ്മരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ആരാദ്‍രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Hormah onethe king of Arad one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

chapters.ml: ലിബ്നരാജാവു ഒന്നു; അദുല്ലാംരാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Libnah onethe king of Adullam one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

chapters.ml: മക്കേദാരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ബേഥേൽരാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Makkedah onethe king of Bethel one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;

chapters.ml: തപ്പൂഹരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ഹേഫെർരാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Tappuah onethe king of Hepher one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

chapters.ml: അഫേക്രാജാവു ഒന്നു; ശാരോൻ രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Aphek onethe king of Lasharon one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

chapters.ml: മാദോൻ രാജാവു ഒന്നു; ഹാസോർരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ശിമ്രോൻ-മെരോൻ രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Madon onethe king of Hazor one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

chapters.ml: അക്ശാപ്പുരാജാവു ഒന്നു; താനാക്രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Shimron Meron onethe king of Akshaph one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

chapters.ml: മെഗിദ്ദോ രാജാവു ഒന്നു; കാദേശ് രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Taanach onethe king of Megiddo one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

chapters.ml: കർമ്മേലിലെ യൊക്നെയാംരാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Kedesh onethe king of Jokneam in Carmel one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

chapters.ml: ദോർമേട്ടിലെ ദോർരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ഗില്ഗാലിലെ ജാതികളുടെ രാജാവു ഒന്നു;
chapters.niv: the king of Dor (in Naphoth Dor) onethe king of Goyim in Gilgal one
chapters.nkjv: the king of Dor in the heights of Dor, one; the king of the people of Gilgal, one;
chapters.kjv: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

chapters.ml: തിർസാരാജാവു ഒന്നു; ആകെ മുപ്പത്തൊന്നു രാജാക്കന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: the king of Tirzah onethirty-one kings in all.
chapters.nkjv: the king of Tirzah, one— all the kings, thirty-one.
chapters.kjv: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ വയസ്സുചെന്നു വൃദ്ധനായപ്പോൾ യഹോവ അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: നീ വയസ്സുചെന്നു വൃദ്ധനായിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇനി ഏറ്റവും വളരെ ദേശം കൈവശമാക്കുവാനുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Joshua had grown old, the Lord said to him, "You are now very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua was old, advanced in years. And the Lord said to him: "You are old, advanced in years, and there remains very much land yet to be possessed.
chapters.kjv: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.

chapters.ml: ഇനിയും ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ദേശം ഏതെന്നാൽ: മിസ്രയീമിന്റെ കിഴക്കുള്ള സീഹോർമുതൽ വടക്കോട്ടു കനാന്യർക്കുള്ളതെന്നു എണ്ണിവരുന്ന എക്രോന്റെ അതിർവരെയുള്ള ഫെലിസ്ത്യദേശങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും ഗെശൂർയ്യരും;
chapters.niv: "This is the land that remains: All the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites,
chapters.nkjv: This is the land that yet remains: all the territory of the Philistines and all thatof the Geshurites,
chapters.kjv: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

chapters.ml: ഗസ്സാത്യൻ, അസ്തോദ്യൻ, അസ്കലോന്യൻ, ഗിത്ത്യൻ, എക്രോന്യൻ എന്നീ അഞ്ചു ഫെലിസ്ത്യ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും;
chapters.niv: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite though held by the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron; the territory of the Avvites
chapters.nkjv: from Sihor, which is east of Egypt, as far as the border of Ekron northward (which is counted as Canaanite); the five lords of the Philistines—the Gazites, the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites;
chapters.kjv: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:

chapters.ml: തെക്കുള്ള അവ്യരും അഫേക്വരെയും അമോർയ്യരുടെ അതിർവരെയുമുള്ള കനാന്യരുടെ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും
chapters.niv: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek and the border of the Amorites;
chapters.nkjv: from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians as far as Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;
chapters.kjv: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:

chapters.ml: സീദോന്യർക്കുള്ള മെയാരയും ഗിബെല്യരുടെ ദേശവും കിഴക്കു ഹെർമ്മോൻ പർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ അടിവരാത്തിലെ ബാൽ-ഗാദ് മുതൽ ഹമാത്തിലേക്കു തിരിയുന്ന സ്ഥലംവരെയുള്ള ലെബാനോൻ ഒക്കെയും;
chapters.niv: the area of Byblos; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.
chapters.nkjv: the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon as far as the entrance to Hamath;
chapters.kjv: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.

chapters.ml: ലെബാനോൻ മുതൽ മിസ്രെഫോത്ത് മയീംവരെയുള്ള പർവ്വതവാസികൾ ഒക്കെയും എല്ലാസീദോന്യരും തന്നേ; ഇവരെ ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളയും; ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ നീ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു അതു അവകാശമായി വിഭാഗിച്ചാൽ മതി.
chapters.niv: "As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,
chapters.nkjv: all the inhabitants of the mountains from Lebanon as far as the Brook Misrephoth, and all the Sidonians—them I will drive out from before the children of Israel; only divide it by lot to Israel as an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
chapters.kjv: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഈ ദേശം ഒമ്പതു ഗോത്രങ്ങൾക്കും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രത്തിന്നും അവകാശമായി വിഭാഗിക്ക.
chapters.niv: and divide it as an inheritance among the nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ രൂബേന്യരും ഗാദ്യരും മോശെ അവർക്കു യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ കിഴക്കു കൊടുത്തിട്ടുള്ള അവകാശം യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ കൊടുത്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ പ്രാപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had received the inheritance that Moses had given them east of the Jordan, as he, the servant of the Lord , had assigned it to them.
chapters.nkjv: With the other half-tribe the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses had given them, beyond the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the Lord had given them:
chapters.kjv: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;

chapters.ml: അർന്നോൻ താഴ്വരയുടെ അറ്റത്തുള്ള അരോവേരും താഴ്വരയുടെ നടുവിലുള്ള പട്ടണംമുതൽ ദീബോൻ വരെയുള്ള മേദെബാസമഭൂമി മുഴുവനും;
chapters.niv: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
chapters.nkjv: from Aroer which is on the bank of the River Arnon, and the town that is in the midst of the ravine, and all the plain of Medeba as far as Dibon;
chapters.kjv: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യരുടെ അതിർവരെ ഹെശ്ബോനിൽ വാണിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യ രാജാവായ സീഹോന്റെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the children of Ammon;
chapters.kjv: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദും ഗെശൂർയ്യരുടെയും മാഖാത്യരുടെയും ദേശവും ഹെർമ്മോൻ പർവ്വതം ഒക്കെയും സൽക്കാവരെയുള്ള ബാശാൻ മുഴുവനും;
chapters.niv: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maakah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salekah—
chapters.nkjv: Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salcah;
chapters.kjv: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;

chapters.ml: അസ്താരോത്തിലും എദ്രെയിലും വാണവനും മല്ലന്മാരിൽ ശേഷിച്ചവനുമായ ബാശാനിലെ ഓഗിന്റെ രാജ്യം ഒക്കെയും തന്നേ; ഇവരെ മോശെ തോല്പിച്ചു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei. (He was the last of the Rephaites.) Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.
chapters.nkjv: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants; for Moses had defeated and cast out these.
chapters.kjv: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഗെശൂർയ്യരെയും മാഖാത്യരെയും നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ല; അവർ ഇന്നുവരെയും യിസ്രായേല്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർത്തുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maakah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless the children of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maachathites, but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

chapters.ml: ലേവിഗോത്രത്തിന്നു അവൻ ഒരു അവകാശവും കൊടുത്തില്ല; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ദഹനയാഗങ്ങൾ താൻ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവരുടെ അവകാശം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the food offerings presented to the Lord , the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.
chapters.nkjv: Only to the tribe of Levi he had given no inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as He said to them.
chapters.kjv: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മോശെ രൂബേൻ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി അവകാശം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, according to its clans:
chapters.nkjv: And Moses had given to the tribe of the children of Reuben aninheritance according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശം അർന്നോൻ താഴ്വരയുടെ അറ്റത്തെ അരോവേരും താഴ്വരയുടെ നടുവിലെ പട്ടണവും മുതൽ മേദബയോടു ചേർന്ന സമഭൂമി മുഴുവനും ഹെശ്ബോനും സമഭൂമിയിലുള്ള
chapters.niv: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba
chapters.nkjv: Their territory was from Aroer, which is on the bank of the River Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the ravine, and all the plain by Medeba;
chapters.kjv: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളും ദീബോനും ബാമോത്ത്-ബാലും ബേത്ത്-ബാൽ-മേയോനും
chapters.niv: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
chapters.nkjv: Heshbon and all its cities that are in the plain: Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
chapters.kjv: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

chapters.ml: യഹ്സയും കെദേമോത്തും മേഫാത്തും കിർയ്യത്തയീമും
chapters.niv: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
chapters.nkjv: Jahaza, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
chapters.kjv: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

chapters.ml: സിബ്മയും സമഭൂമിയിലെ മലയിലുള്ള സേരെത്ത്-ശഹരും
chapters.niv: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,
chapters.nkjv: Kirjathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the mountain of the valley,
chapters.kjv: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,

chapters.ml: ബേത്ത്-പെയോരും പിസ്ഗച്ചരിവുകളും ബേത്ത്-യെശീമോത്തും
chapters.niv: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth—
chapters.nkjv: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth—
chapters.kjv: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

chapters.ml: സമഭൂമിയിലെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളും ഹെശ്ബോനിൽ വാണിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യരാജാവായ സീഹോന്റെ രാജ്യം ഒക്കെയും തന്നേ; അവനെയും സീഹോന്റെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരായി ദേശത്തു പാർത്തിരുന്ന ഏവി, രേക്കെം, സൂർ, ഹൂർ, രേബ എന്നീ മിദ്യാന്യ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെയും മോശെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: all the towns on the plateau and the entire realm of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled at Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the Midianite chiefs, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—princes allied with Sihon—who lived in that country.
chapters.nkjv: all the cities of the plain and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses had struck with the princes of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, who were princes of Sihon dwelling in the country.
chapters.kjv: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കൊന്നവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ബെയോരിന്റെ മകനായ ബിലെയാം എന്ന പ്രശ്നക്കാരനെയും വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.
chapters.nkjv: The children of Israel also killed with the sword Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, among those who were killed by them.
chapters.kjv: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

chapters.ml: രൂബേന്യരുടെ അതിർ യോർദ്ദാൻ ആയിരുന്നു; ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളുൾപ്പെടെ രൂബേന്യർക്കു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം.
chapters.niv: The boundary of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites, according to their clans.
chapters.nkjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and their villages.
chapters.kjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മോശെ ഗാദ്ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു, കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ഗാദ്യർക്കു തന്നേ, അവകാശം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, according to its clans:
chapters.nkjv: Moses also had given aninheritance to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശം യസേരും ഗിലെയാദിലെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളും രബ്ബയുടെ നേരെയുള്ള അരോവേർവരെ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ പാതിദേശവും;
chapters.niv: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;
chapters.nkjv: Their territory was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, which is before Rabbah,
chapters.kjv: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;

chapters.ml: ഹെശ്ബോൻ മുതൽ രാമത്ത്-മിസ്പെയും ബെതോനീമുംവരെയും മഹനയീംമുതൽ ദെബീരിന്റെ അതിർവരെയും;
chapters.niv: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;
chapters.nkjv: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir,
chapters.kjv: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

chapters.ml: താഴ്വരയിൽ ഹെശ്ബോൻ രാജാവായ സീഹോന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിൽ ശേഷിപ്പുള്ള ബേത്ത്-ഹാരാം, ബേത്ത്-നിമ്രാം, സുക്കോത്ത്, സാഫോൻ എന്നിവയും തന്നേ; യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ കിഴക്കു കിന്നെരോത്ത് തടാകത്തിന്റെ അറുതിവരെ യോർദ്ദാൻ അതിന്നു അതിരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Sukkoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Galilee ).
chapters.nkjv: and in the valley Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, with the Jordan as its border, as far as the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth, on the other side of the Jordan eastward.
chapters.kjv: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.

chapters.ml: ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളുൾപ്പെടെ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ഗാദ്യർക്കു കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം.
chapters.niv: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, according to their clans.
chapters.nkjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and their villages.
chapters.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മോശെ മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രത്തിന്നു അവകാശം കൊടുത്തു; കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രത്തിന്നുള്ള അവകാശം ഇതു:
chapters.niv: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, according to its clans:
chapters.nkjv: Moses also had given aninheritance to half the tribe of Manasseh; it was for half the tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families:
chapters.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശം മഹനയീംമുതൽ ബാശാൻ മുഴുവനും ബാശാൻ രാജാവായ ഓഗിന്റെ രാജ്യമൊക്കെയും ബാശാനിൽ യായീരിന്റെ ഊരുകൾ എല്ലാംകൂടി അറുപതു പട്ടണങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan—all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,
chapters.nkjv: Their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair which are in Bashan, sixty cities;
chapters.kjv: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:

chapters.ml: പാതിഗിലെയാദും ബാശാനിലെ ഓഗിന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിലെ പട്ടണങ്ങളായ അസ്തരോത്ത്, എദ്രെയി എന്നിവയും തന്നേ; ഇവ മനശ്ശെയുടെ മകനായ മാഖീരിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു, മാഖീരിന്റെ മക്കളിൽ പാതിപ്പേർക്കു തന്നേ, കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh—for half of the sons of Makir, according to their clans.
chapters.nkjv: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, for half of the children of Machir according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

chapters.ml: ഇതു മോശെ യെരീഹോവിന്നു കിഴക്കു യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ മോവാബ് സമഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു ഭാഗിച്ചുകൊടുത്ത അവകാശം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.
chapters.nkjv: These aretheareas which Moses had distributed as an inheritance in the plains of Moab on the other side of the Jordan, by Jericho eastward.
chapters.kjv: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

chapters.ml: ലേവിഗോത്രത്തിന്നോ മോശെ ഒരു അവകാശവും കൊടുത്തില്ല; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ താൻ തന്നേ അവരുടെ അവകാശം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the Lord , the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.
chapters.nkjv: But to the tribe of Levi Moses had given no inheritance; the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as He had said to them.
chapters.kjv: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.

chapters.ml: കനാൻ ദേശത്തു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു അവകാശമായി ലഭിച്ച ദേശങ്ങൾ ആവിതു: പുരോഹിതനായ എലെയാസാരും നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവയും യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രപിതാക്കന്മാരിൽ തലവന്മാരും ഇവ അവർക്കു വിഭാഗിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Now these are the areas the Israelites received as an inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel allotted to them.
chapters.nkjv: These aretheareas which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel distributed as an inheritance to them.
chapters.kjv: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെമുഖാന്തരം കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒമ്പതര ഗോത്രങ്ങൾക്കും ചീട്ടിട്ടായിരുന്നു അവകാശം ഭാഗിച്ചുകൊടുത്തതു.
chapters.niv: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Their inheritance was by lot, as the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
chapters.kjv: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടര ഗോത്രങ്ങൾക്കു മോശെ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ അവകാശം കൊടുത്തിരുന്നു; ലേവ്യർക്കോ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒരു അവകാശവും കൊടുത്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,
chapters.nkjv: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe on the other side of the Jordan; but to the Levites he had given no inheritance among them.
chapters.kjv: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കൾ മനശ്ശെ, എഫ്രയീം എന്നു രണ്ടു ഗോത്രം ആയിരുന്നു. ലേവ്യർക്കു പാർപ്പാൻ പട്ടണങ്ങളും അവരുടെ കന്നുകാലികൾക്കും മൃഗസമ്പത്തിന്നും വേണ്ടി പുല്പുറങ്ങളും അല്ലാതെ ദേശത്തിൽ ഓഹരിയൊന്നും കൊടുത്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: for Joseph’s descendants had become two tribes—Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
chapters.nkjv: For the children of Joseph were two tribes: Manasseh and Ephraim. And they gave no part to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their common-lands for their livestock and their property.
chapters.kjv: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അനുസരിച്ചു ദേശം വിഭാഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.nkjv: As the Lord had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did; and they divided the land.
chapters.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യെഹൂദാമക്കൾ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; കെനിസ്യനായ യെഫുന്നെയുടെ മകൻ കാലേബ് അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവ എന്നെയും നിന്നെയും കുറിച്ചു ദൈവപുരുഷനായ മോശെയോടു കാദേശ് ബർന്നേയയിൽവെച്ചു പറഞ്ഞ കാര്യം നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Now the people of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know what the Lord said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea about you and me.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal. And Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him: "You know the word which the Lord said to Moses the man of God concerning you and me in Kadesh Barnea.
chapters.kjv: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ കാദേശ്ബർന്നേയയിൽനിന്നു ദേശത്തെ ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചപ്പോൾ എനിക്കു നാല്പതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; ഞാൻ വന്നു എന്റെ മനോബോധപ്രകാരം അവനോടു മറുപടി പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,
chapters.nkjv: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back word to him as itwas in my heart.
chapters.kjv: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.

chapters.ml: എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോന്നിരുന്ന സഹോദരന്മാർ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഹൃദയം ഉരുകുമാറാക്കി; ഞാനോ എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു പൂർണ്ണമായി പറ്റിനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: but my fellow Israelites who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt in fear. I, however, followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless my brethren who went up with me made the heart of the people melt, but I wholly followed the Lord my God.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു പൂർണ്ണമായി പറ്റിനിന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നീ കാൽവെച്ച ദേശം നിനക്കും നിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കും എന്നേക്കും അവകാശമായിരിക്കും എന്നു മോശെ അന്നു സത്യംചെയ്തു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So on that day Moses swore to me, ‘The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.’
chapters.nkjv: So Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where your foot has trodden shall be your inheritance and your children’s forever, because you have wholly followed the Lord my God.’
chapters.kjv: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

chapters.ml: മരുഭൂമിയിൽ സഞ്ചരിച്ച കാലത്തു യഹോവ മോശെയോടു ഈ വാക്കു കല്പിച്ചതു മുതൽ ഈ നാല്പത്തഞ്ചു സംവത്സരത്തോളവും എന്നെ ഇതാ, താൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരുന്നതു പോലെ ജീവനോടെ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ എനിക്കു എണ്പത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായി.
chapters.niv: "Now then, just as the Lord promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!
chapters.nkjv: And now, behold, the Lord has kept me alive, as He said, these forty-five years, ever since the Lord spoke this word to Moses while Israel wandered in the wilderness; and now, here I am this day, eighty-five years old.
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

chapters.ml: മോശെ എന്നെ അയച്ച നാളിലെപ്പോലെ ഇന്നും എനിക്കു ആരോഗ്യം ഉണ്ടു; പടവെട്ടുവാനും പോകയും വരികയും ചെയ്‍വാനും എന്റെ ആരോഗ്യം അന്നത്തെപ്പോലെതന്നെ ഇന്നും ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
