chapters.niv: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I’m just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.
chapters.nkjv: As yet I amas strong this day as on the day that Moses sent me; just as my strength was then, so now is my strength for war, both for going out and for coming in.
chapters.kjv: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവ അന്നു കല്പിച്ച ഈ മല ഇപ്പോൾ എനിക്കു തരിക; അനാക്യർ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നും പട്ടണങ്ങൾ വലിപ്പവും ഉറപ്പും ഉള്ളവ എന്നും നീ അന്നു കേട്ടിട്ടുണ്ടല്ലോ; യഹോവ എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ താൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഞാൻ അവരെ ഓടിച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the Lord helping me, I will drive them out just as he said."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, give me this mountain of which the Lord spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and that the cities were great and fortified. It may be that the Lordwillbe with me, and I shall be able to drive them out as the Lord said."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോശുവ അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു; ഹെബ്രോൻ മല യെഫുന്നെയുടെ മകനായ കാലേബിന്നു അവകാശമായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as an inheritance.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഹെബ്രോൻ ഇന്നുവരെ കെനിസ്യനായ യെഫുന്നെയുടെ മകൻ കാലേബിന്നു അവകാശമായിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ പൂർണ്ണമായി പറ്റിനിന്നതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the Lord , the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.
chapters.nkjv: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോന്നു പണ്ടു കിർയ്യത്ത്-അർബ്ബാ എന്നു പേരായിരുന്നു; അർബ്ബാ എന്നവൻ അനാക്യരിൽ വെച്ചു അതിമഹാൻ ആയിരുന്നു. അങ്ങനെ യുദ്ധം തീർന്നു ദേശത്തിന്നു സ്വസ്ഥത വന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.
chapters.nkjv: And the name of Hebron formerly was Kirjath Arba (Arbawas the greatest man among the Anakim). Then the land had rest from war.
chapters.kjv: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ ഓഹരി തെക്കെദേശത്തിന്റെ തെക്കെ അറ്റത്തു എദോമിന്റെ അതിരായ സീൻമരുഭൂമിവരെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The allotment for the tribe of Judah, according to its clans, extended down to the territory of Edom, to the Desert of Zin in the extreme south.
chapters.nkjv: So this was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families: The border of Edom at the Wilderness of Zin southward was the extreme southern boundary.
chapters.kjv: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ തെക്കെ അതിർ ഉപ്പുകടലിന്റെ അറ്റംമുതൽ തെക്കോട്ടു നീണ്ടിരിക്കുന്ന ഇടക്കടൽമുതൽതന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Dead Sea,
chapters.nkjv: And their southern border began at the shore of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.
chapters.kjv: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

chapters.ml: അതു അക്രബ്ബീംകയറ്റത്തിന്നു തെക്കോട്ടു ചെന്നു സീനിലേക്കു കടന്നു കാദേശ് ബർന്നേയയുടെ തെക്കു കൂടി കയറി ഹെസ്രോൻ കടന്നു ആദാരിലേക്കു കയറി കാർക്കയിലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.
chapters.nkjv: Then it went out to the southern side of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed along to Zin, ascended on the south side of Kadesh Barnea, passed along to Hezron, went up to Adar, and went around to Karkaa.
chapters.kjv: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

chapters.ml: അസ്മോനിലേക്കു കടന്നു മിസ്രയീംതോടുവരെ ചെല്ലുന്നു; ആ അതിർ സമുദ്രത്തിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു; ഇതു നിങ്ങളുടെ തെക്കെ അതിർ ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the Mediterranean Sea. This is their southern boundary.
chapters.nkjv: Fromthere it passed toward Azmon and went out to the Brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your southern border.
chapters.kjv: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

chapters.ml: കിഴക്കെ അതിർ യോർദ്ദാന്റെ അഴിമുഖംവരെ ഉപ്പുകടൽ തന്നേ; വടക്കെ അതിർ യോർദ്ദാന്റെ അഴിമുഖമായ
chapters.niv: The eastern boundary is the Dead Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,
chapters.nkjv: The east border was the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. And the border on the northern quarter began at the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:

chapters.ml: ഇടക്കടൽ തുടങ്ങി ബേത്ത്-ഹൊഗ്ളയിലേക്കു കയറി ബേത്ത്-അരാബയുടെ വടക്കുകൂടി കടന്നു, രൂബേന്റെ മകനായ ബോഹാന്റെ കല്ലുവരെ കയറിച്ചെല്ലുന്നു.
chapters.niv: went up to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
chapters.nkjv: The border went up to Beth Hoglah and passed north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
chapters.kjv: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ ആഖോർതാഴ്വരമുതൽ ദെബീരിലേക്കു കയറി വടക്കോട്ടു തോട്ടിന്റെ തെക്കുവശത്തുള്ള അദുമ്മീംകയറ്റത്തിന്നെതിരെയുള്ള ഗില്ഗാലിന്നു ചെന്നു ഏൻ-ശേമെശ് വെള്ളത്തിങ്കലേക്കു കടന്നു ഏൻ-രോഗേലിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel.
chapters.nkjv: Then the border went up toward Debir from the Valley of Achor, and it turned northward toward Gilgal, which is before the Ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the valley. The border continued toward the waters of En Shemesh and ended at En Rogel.
chapters.kjv: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ ബെൻ-ഹിന്നോംതാഴ്വരയിൽകൂടി കയറി യെരൂശലേം എന്ന യെബൂസ്യഗിരിയുടെ തെക്കോട്ടു കടന്നു ഹിന്നോം താഴ്വരയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടും രെഫായീംതാഴ്വരയുടെ അറ്റത്തു വടക്കോട്ടും ഉള്ള മലയുടെ മുകളിലേക്കു കയറിച്ചെല്ലുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.nkjv: And the border went up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom to the southern slope of the Jebusite city (which is Jerusalem). The border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the Valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the Valley of Rephaim northward.
chapters.kjv: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ മലയുടെ മുകളിൽനിന്നു നെപ്തോഹയിലെ നീരുറവിലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു എഫ്രോൻ മലയിലെ പട്ടണങ്ങൾവരെ ചെന്നു കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീം എന്ന ബാലയിലേക്കു തിരിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).
chapters.nkjv: Then the border went around from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and extended to the cities of Mount Ephron. And the border went around to Baalah (which is Kirjath Jearim).
chapters.kjv: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ ബാലാമുതൽ പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു സേയീർമലവരെ തിരിഞ്ഞു കെസാലോൻ എന്ന യെയാരീംമലയുടെ പാർശ്വംവരെ വടക്കോട്ടു കടന്നു, ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശിലേക്കു ഇറങ്ങി തിമ്നയിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.
chapters.nkjv: Then the border turned westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, passed along to the side of Mount Jearim on the north (which is Chesalon), went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed on to Timnah.
chapters.kjv: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ വടക്കോട്ടു എക്രോന്റെ പാർശ്വംവരെ ചെന്നു ശിക്രോനിലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു ബാലാമലയിലേക്കു കടന്നു യബ്നേലിൽ ചെന്നു സമുദ്രത്തിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.
chapters.nkjv: And the border went out to the side of Ekron northward. Then the border went around to Shicron, passed along to Mount Baalah, and extended to Jabneel; and the border ended at the sea.
chapters.kjv: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

chapters.ml: പടിഞ്ഞാറെ അതിർ നെടുകെ മഹാസമുദ്രം തന്നേ; ഇതു യെഹൂദാമക്കൾക്കു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള അതിർ.
chapters.niv: The western boundary is the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea. These are the boundaries around the people of Judah by their clans.
chapters.nkjv: The west border was the coastline of the Great Sea. This is the boundary of the children of Judah all around according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യോശുവയോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവൻ യെഫുന്നെയുടെ മകനായ കാലേബിന്നു യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഓഹരിയായിട്ടു അനാക്കിന്റെ അപ്പനായ അർബ്ബയുടെ പട്ടണമായ ഹെബ്രോൻ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: In accordance with the Lord ’s command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah—Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
chapters.nkjv: Now to Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a share among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, namely, Kirjath Arba, which is Hebron (Arbawas the father of Anak).
chapters.kjv: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.

chapters.ml: അവിടെനിന്നു കാലേബ് അനാക്കിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ശേശായി, അഹീമാൻ, തൽമായി എന്നീ മൂന്നു അനാക്യരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites—Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai, the sons of Anak.
chapters.nkjv: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak from there: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
chapters.kjv: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

chapters.ml: അവിടെനിന്നു അവൻ ദെബീർനിവാസികളുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു; ദെബീരിന്റെ പേർ മുമ്പെ കിർയ്യത്ത്-സേഫെർ എന്നായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).
chapters.nkjv: Then he went up from there to the inhabitants of Debir (formerly the name of Debir was Kirjath Sepher).
chapters.kjv: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.

chapters.ml: കിർയ്യത്ത്-സേഫെർ ജയിക്കുന്നവന്നു ഞാൻ എന്റെ മകൾ അക്സയെ ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുക്കും എന്നു കാലേബ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."
chapters.nkjv: And Caleb said, "He who attacks Kirjath Sepher and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife."
chapters.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

chapters.ml: കാലേബിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ കെനസിന്റെ മകൻ ഒത്നീയേൽ അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ മകൾ അക്സയെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.
chapters.nkjv: So Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
chapters.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

chapters.ml: അവൾ വന്നാറെ തന്റെ അപ്പനോടു ഒരു നിലം ചോദിപ്പാൻ അവനെ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിച്ചു; അവൾ കഴുതപ്പുറത്തുനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ കാലേബ് അവളോടു: നിനക്കു എന്തു വേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"
chapters.nkjv: Now it was so, when she came tohim, that she persuaded him to ask her father for a field. So she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you wish?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു ഒരു അനുഗ്രഹം തരേണം; നീ എന്നെ തെക്കെ ദേശത്തേക്കല്ലോ കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നതു; നീരുറവുകളെയുംകൂടെ എനിക്കു തരേണം എന്നു അവൾ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു അവൻ അവൾക്കു മലയിലും താഴ്വരയിലും നീരുറവുകളെ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
chapters.nkjv: She answered, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me land in the South, give me also springs of water." So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
chapters.kjv: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം ഇതത്രേ.
chapters.niv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, according to its clans:
chapters.nkjv: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families:
chapters.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

chapters.ml: എദോമിന്റെ അതിർക്കരികെ തെക്കെ അറ്റത്തു യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിന്നുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങൾ:
chapters.niv: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
chapters.nkjv: The cities at the limits of the tribe of the children of Judah, toward the border of Edom in the South, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
chapters.kjv: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

chapters.ml: കെബ്സെയേൽ, ഏദെർ, യാഗൂർ,
chapters.niv: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
chapters.nkjv: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
chapters.kjv: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

chapters.ml: കീന, ദിമോന, അദാദ, കേദെശ്,
chapters.niv: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
chapters.nkjv: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
chapters.kjv: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

chapters.ml: ഹാസോർ, യിത്നാൻ, സീഫ്, തേലെം,
chapters.niv: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
chapters.nkjv: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
chapters.kjv: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

chapters.ml: ബയാലോത്ത്, ഹാസോർ, ഹദത്ഥ, കെരീയോത്ത്-ഹാസോർ, എന്ന കെരീയോത്ത്--ഹെസ്രോൻ,
chapters.niv: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that is, Hazor),
chapters.nkjv: Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron (which is Hazor),
chapters.kjv: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,

chapters.ml: അമാം, ശെമ, മോലാദ,
chapters.niv: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
chapters.nkjv: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
chapters.kjv: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

chapters.ml: ഹസർ-ഗദ്ദ, ഹെശ്മോൻ, ബേത്ത്-പേലെത്,
chapters.niv: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
chapters.nkjv: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
chapters.kjv: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

chapters.ml: ഹസർ-ശൂവാൽ, ബേർ-ശേബ, ബിസോത്യ,
chapters.niv: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
chapters.nkjv: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Bizjothjah,
chapters.kjv: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

chapters.ml: ബാല, ഇയ്യീം, ഏസെം,
chapters.niv: Baalah, Iyim, Ezem,
chapters.nkjv: Baalah, Ijim, Ezem,
chapters.kjv: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

chapters.ml: എൽതോലദ്, കെസീൽ, ഹോർമ്മ,
chapters.niv: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,
chapters.nkjv: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
chapters.kjv: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

chapters.ml: സിക്ളാഗ്, മദ്മന്ന, സൻസന്ന,
chapters.niv: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
chapters.nkjv: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
chapters.kjv: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

chapters.ml: ലെബായോത്ത, ശിൽഹീം, ആയിൻ, രിമ്മോൻ; ഇങ്ങനെ ആകെ ഇരുപത്തൊമ്പതു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain and Rimmon—a total of twenty-nine towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.
chapters.kjv: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:

chapters.ml: താഴ്‍വീതിയിൽ എസ്തായോൽ, സൊരാ,
chapters.niv: In the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
chapters.nkjv: In the lowland: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
chapters.kjv: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

chapters.ml: അശ്ന, സനോഹ, ഏൻ-ഗന്നീം, തപ്പൂഹ,
chapters.niv: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
chapters.nkjv: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
chapters.kjv: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

chapters.ml: ഏനാം, യർമ്മൂത്ത്, അദുല്ലാം, സോഖോ,
chapters.niv: Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,
chapters.nkjv: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
chapters.kjv: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

chapters.ml: അസേക്ക, ശാരയീം, അദീഥയീം, ഗെദേരാ, ഗെദെരോഥയീം;
chapters.niv: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim) —fourteen towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Sharaim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim: fourteen cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പതിനാലു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും; സെനാൻ,
chapters.niv: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
chapters.nkjv: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
chapters.kjv: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

chapters.ml: ഹദാശ, മിഗ്ദൽ-ഗാദ്, ദിലാൻ, മിസ്പെ, യൊക്തെയേൽ,
chapters.niv: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
chapters.nkjv: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
chapters.kjv: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

chapters.ml: ലാഖിശ്, ബൊസ്കത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
chapters.nkjv: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
chapters.kjv: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

chapters.ml: എഗ്ളോൻ, കബ്ബോൻ, ലപ്മാസ്, കിത്ത്ളീശ്,
chapters.niv: Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,
chapters.nkjv: Cabbon, Lahmas, Kithlish,
chapters.kjv: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

chapters.ml: ഗെദേരോത്ത്, ബേത്ത്-ദാഗോൻ, നാമ, മക്കേദ; ഇങ്ങനെ പതിനാറു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah and Makkedah—sixteen towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah: sixteen cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: ലിബ്ന, ഏഥെർ, ആശാൻ,
chapters.niv: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
chapters.nkjv: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
chapters.kjv: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

chapters.ml: യിപ്താഹ്, അശ്ന, നെസീബ്,
chapters.niv: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
chapters.nkjv: Jiphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
chapters.kjv: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

chapters.ml: കെയില, അക്ളീബ്, മാരേശ; ഇങ്ങനെ ഒമ്പതു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Keilah, Akzib and Mareshah—nine towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah: nine cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: എക്രോനും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Ekron, with its surrounding settlements and villages;
chapters.nkjv: Ekron, with its towns and villages;
chapters.kjv: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:

chapters.ml: എക്രോൻ മുതൽ സമുദ്രംവരെ അസ്തോദിന്നു സമീപത്തുള്ളവ ഒക്കെയും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: west of Ekron, all that were in the vicinity of Ashdod, together with their villages;
chapters.nkjv: from Ekron to the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages;
chapters.kjv: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:

chapters.ml: അസ്തോദും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും ഗസ്സയും മിസ്രയീംതോടുവരെയുള്ള അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും; മഹാസമുദ്രം അതിന്നു നെടുകെ അതിരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ashdod, its surrounding settlements and villages; and Gaza, its settlements and villages, as far as the Wadi of Egypt and the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea.
chapters.nkjv: Ashdod with its towns and villages, Gaza with its towns and villages—as far as the Brook of Egypt and the Great Sea with its coastline.
chapters.kjv: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:

chapters.ml: മലനാട്ടിൽ ശാമീർ, യത്ഥീർ, സോഖോ,
chapters.niv: In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,
chapters.nkjv: And in the mountain country: Shamir, Jattir, Sochoh,
chapters.kjv: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

chapters.ml: ദന്ന, ദെബീർ എന്ന കിർയ്യത്ത്-സന്ന,
chapters.niv: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (that is, Debir),
chapters.nkjv: Dannah, Kirjath Sannah (which is Debir),
chapters.kjv: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,

chapters.ml: അനാബ്, എസ്തെമോ, ആനീം, ഗോശെൻ,
chapters.niv: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
chapters.nkjv: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
chapters.kjv: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

chapters.ml: ഹോലോൻ, ഗീലോ; ഇങ്ങനെ പതിനൊന്നുപട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Goshen, Holon and Giloh—eleven towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh: eleven cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: അരാബ്, ദൂമ, എശാൻ,
chapters.niv: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
chapters.nkjv: Arab, Dumah, Eshean,
chapters.kjv: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

chapters.ml: യാനീം, ബേത്ത്-തപ്പൂഹ, അഫേക്ക, ഹുമ്ത,
chapters.niv: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
chapters.nkjv: Janum, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
chapters.kjv: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോൻ എന്ന കിർയ്യത്ത്-അർബ്ബ, സീയോർ ഇങ്ങനെ ഒമ്പതു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും.
chapters.niv: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) and Zior—nine towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Humtah, Kirjath Arba (which is Hebron), and Zior: nine cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: മാവോൻ, കർമ്മോൽ, സീഫ്, യൂത,
chapters.niv: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,
chapters.nkjv: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,
chapters.kjv: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രെയേൽ, യോക്ക്ക് ദെയാം, സാനോഹ,
chapters.niv: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
chapters.nkjv: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
chapters.kjv: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

chapters.ml: കയീൻ, ഗിബെയ, തിമ്ന; ഇങ്ങനെ പത്തു പട്ടണവും
chapters.niv: Kain, Gibeah and Timnah—ten towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah: ten cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും; ഹൽഹൂൽ ബേത്ത്--സൂർ
chapters.niv: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
chapters.nkjv: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
chapters.kjv: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

chapters.ml: ഗെദോർ, മാരാത്ത്, ബേത്ത്-അനോത്ത്, എൽതെക്കോൻ; ഇങ്ങനെ ആറു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Maarath, Beth Anoth and Eltekon—six towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon: six cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീം എന്ന കിർയ്യത്ത്-ബാൽ, രബ്ബ; ഇങ്ങനെ രണ്ടു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah—two towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Kirjath Baal (which is Kirjath Jearim) and Rabbah: two cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ബേത്ത്-അരാബ,
chapters.niv: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
chapters.nkjv: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,
chapters.kjv: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

chapters.ml: മിദ്ദീൻ, സെഖാഖ, നിബ്ശാൻ, ഈർ-ഹമേലഹ്, ഏൻ-ഗെദി; ഇങ്ങനെ ആറു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും.
chapters.niv: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi—six towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi: six cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന യെബൂസ്യരെയോ യെഹൂദാമക്കൾക്കു നീക്കിക്കളവാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല; അങ്ങനെ യെബൂസ്യർ ഇന്നുവരെ യെഹൂദാമക്കളോടുകൂടെ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർത്തുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
chapters.kjv: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം: യെരീഹോവിന്റെ സമീപത്തു യോർദ്ദാൻ തുടങ്ങി കിഴക്കു യെരീഹോവെള്ളത്തിങ്കൽ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ തന്നേ തുടങ്ങി യെരീഹോവിൽനിന്നു മലനാടുവഴിയായി ബേഥേലിലേക്കു കയറി
chapters.niv: The allotment for Joseph began at the Jordan, east of the springs of Jericho, and went up from there through the desert into the hill country of Bethel.
chapters.nkjv: The lot fell to the children of Joseph from the Jordan, by Jericho, to the waters of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goes up from Jericho through the mountains to Bethel,
chapters.kjv: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el,

chapters.ml: ബേഥേലിൽനിന്നു ലൂസിന്നു ചെന്നു അർക്ക്യരുടെ അതിരായ അതാരോത്തിന്നു കടന്നു
chapters.niv: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,
chapters.nkjv: then went out from Bethel to Luz, passed along to the border of the Archites at Ataroth,
chapters.kjv: And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

chapters.ml: പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു യഫ്ളേത്യരുടെ അതിരിലേക്കു താഴത്തെ ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോന്റെ അതിർവരെ, ഗേസെർവരെ തന്നേ, ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു സമുദ്രത്തിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the Mediterranean Sea.
chapters.nkjv: and went down westward to the boundary of the Japhletites, as far as the boundary of Lower Beth Horon to Gezer; and it ended at the sea.
chapters.kjv: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോസേഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ മനശ്ശെക്കും എഫ്രയീമിന്നും അവകാശം ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
chapters.kjv: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ ദേശം ഏതെന്നാൽ: കിഴക്കു അവരുടെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ അതിർ മേലത്തെ ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോൻ വരെ അതെരോത്ത്-അദ്ദാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was the territory of Ephraim, according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon
chapters.nkjv: The border of the children of Ephraim, according to their families, was thus: The border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth Addar as far as Upper Beth Horon.
chapters.kjv: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;

chapters.ml: ആ അതിർ മിഖ് മെഥാത്തിന്റെ വടക്കുകൂടി പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു ചെന്നു താനത്ത്-ശീലോവരെ കിഴക്കോട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞു അതിന്നരികത്തുകൂടി
chapters.niv: and continued to the Mediterranean Sea. From Mikmethath on the north it curved eastward to Taanath Shiloh, passing by it to Janoah on the east.
chapters.nkjv: And the border went out toward the sea on the north side of Michmethath; then the border went around eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed by it on the east of Janohah.
chapters.kjv: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

chapters.ml: യാനോഹയുടെ കിഴക്കു കടന്നു യാനോഹയിൽനിന്നു അതെരോത്തിന്നും നാരാത്തിന്നും ഇറങ്ങി യെരീഹോവിൽ എത്തി യോർദ്ദാങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: Then it went down from Janohah to Ataroth and Naarah, reached to Jericho, and came out at the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

chapters.ml: തപ്പൂഹയിൽനിന്നു ആ അതിർ പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു കാനാതോടുവരെ ചെന്നു സമുദ്രത്തിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു. എഫ്രയീംഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ ഈ അവകാശം കൂടാതെ
chapters.niv: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, according to its clans.
chapters.nkjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward to the Brook Kanah, and it ended at the sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families.
chapters.kjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെമക്കളുടെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ എഫ്രയീംമക്കൾക്കു വേർതിരിച്ചുകൊടുത്ത പട്ടണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളുംകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.
chapters.nkjv: The separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ ഗെസേരിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന കനാന്യരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ല; കനാന്യർ ഇന്നുവരെ എഫ്രയീമ്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഊഴിയവേല ചെയ്തു പാർത്തു വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They did not dislodge the Canaanites living in Gezer; to this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim but are required to do forced labor.
chapters.nkjv: And they did not drive out the Canaanites who dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day and have become forced laborers.
chapters.kjv: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ മനശ്ശെയുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നും ഓഹരി കിട്ടി; മനശ്ശെയുടെ ആദ്യജാതനും ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ അപ്പനും ആയ മാഖീർ യുദ്ധവീരനായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു ഗിലെയാദും ബാശാനും ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh’s firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.
chapters.nkjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph: namely for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war; therefore he was given Gilead and Bashan.
chapters.kjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ ശേഷം പുത്രന്മാരായ അബീയേസെരിന്റെ മക്കൾ, ഹേലെക്കിന്റെ മക്കൾ, അസ്രീയേലിന്റെ മക്കൾ, ശേഖെമിന്റെ മക്കൾ, ഹേഫെരിന്റെ മക്കൾ, ശെമീദാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ എന്നിവർക്കും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ഓഹരി കിട്ടി; ഇവർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി യോസേഫിന്റെ മകനായ മനശ്ശെയുടെ മക്കൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.
chapters.nkjv: And there was alot for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, the children of Helek, the children of Asriel, the children of Shechem, the children of Hepher, and the children of Shemida; these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
chapters.kjv: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മനശ്ശെയുടെ മകനായ മാഖീരിന്റെ മകനായ ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ മകനായ ഹേഫെരിന്റെ മകൻ ശെലോഫഹാദിന്നു പുത്രിമാരല്ലാതെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ പുത്രിമാർക്കും: മഹ്ള, നോവ, ഹൊഗ്ള, മിൽക്ക, തിർസ എന്നു പേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons but only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.
chapters.nkjv: But Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters. And these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുരോഹിതനായ എലെയാസരിന്റെയും നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവയുടെയും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെയും മുമ്പിൽ അടുത്തുചെന്നു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ഒരു അവകാശം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തരുവാൻ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം അവരുടെ അപ്പന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ അവർക്കു ഒരു അവകാശം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our relatives." So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the Lord ’s command.
chapters.nkjv: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the rulers, saying, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." Therefore, according to the commandment of the Lord, he gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers.
chapters.kjv: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മനശ്ശെയുടെ പുത്രിമാർക്കു അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ അവകാശം ലഭിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു മനശ്ശെക്കു യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ ഗിലെയാദ് ദേശവും ബാശാനും കൂടാതെ പത്തു ഓഹരി കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Manasseh’s share consisted of ten tracts of land besides Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan,
chapters.nkjv: Ten shares fell to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side of the Jordan,
chapters.kjv: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ ശേഷം പുത്രന്മാർക്കു ഗിലെയാദ് ദേശം കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.
chapters.nkjv: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons; and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ അതിരോ ആശേർമുതൽ ശേഖെമിന്നു കിഴക്കുള്ള മിഖ്മെഥാത്ത്‌വരെ ചെന്നു വലത്തോട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞു ഏൻ-തപ്പൂഹയിലെ നിവാസികളുടെ അടുക്കലോളം നീണ്ടുകിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Mikmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.
chapters.nkjv: And the territory of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, that lies east of Shechem; and the border went along south to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
chapters.kjv: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

chapters.ml: തപ്പൂഹദേശം മനശ്ശെക്കുള്ളതായിരുന്നു; എങ്കിലും മനശ്ശെയുടെ അതിരിലുള്ള തപ്പൂഹപട്ടണം എഫ്രയീമ്യർക്കു ഉള്ളതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah itself, on the boundary of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.)
chapters.nkjv: Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
chapters.kjv: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ കാനാതോട്ടിങ്കലേക്കു തോട്ടിന്റെ തെക്കുകൂടി ഇറങ്ങുന്നു. ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ മനശ്ശെയുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങൾക്കിടയിൽ എഫ്രയീമിന്നുള്ളവ; മനശ്ശെയുടെ അതിർ തോട്ടിന്റെ വടക്കുവശത്തുകൂടി ചെന്നു സമുദ്രത്തിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.
chapters.nkjv: And the border descended to the Brook Kanah, southward to the brook. These cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook; and it ended at the sea.
chapters.kjv: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

chapters.ml: തെക്കുഭാഗം എഫ്രയീമിന്നും വടക്കുഭാഗം മനശ്ശെക്കും ഉള്ളതു. സമുദ്രം അവന്റെ അതിർ ആകുന്നു;
chapters.niv: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the Mediterranean Sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
chapters.nkjv: Southward itwas Ephraim’s, northward itwas Manasseh’s, and the sea was its border. Manasseh’s territory was adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
chapters.kjv: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

chapters.ml: അതു വടക്കു ആശേരിനോടും കിഴക്കു യിസ്സാഖാരിനോടും തൊട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു. യിസ്സാഖാരിലും ആശേരിലും മനശ്ശെക്കു ബേത്ത്-ശെയാനും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും യിബ്ളെയാമും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും ദോർനിവാസികളും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും ഏൻ-ദോർനിവാസികളും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും താനാക്ക് നിവാസികളും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും മെഗിദ്ദോനിവാസികളും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; മൂന്നു മേടുകൾ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth ).
chapters.nkjv: And in Issachar and in Asher, Manasseh had Beth Shean and its towns, Ibleam and its towns, the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, the inhabitants of En Dor and its towns, the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns—three hilly regions.
chapters.kjv: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മനശ്ശെയുടെ മക്കൾക്കു ആ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലെ നിവാസികളെ നീക്കിക്കളവാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല; കനാന്യർക്കു ആ ദേശത്തിൽ തന്നേ പാർപ്പാനുള്ള താല്പര്യം സാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.
chapters.nkjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out theinhabitantsof those cities, but the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
chapters.kjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ബലവാന്മാരായി തീർന്നപ്പോൾ അവരെ നീക്കിക്കളയാതെ അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു ഊഴിയവേല ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when the children of Israel grew strong, that they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out.
chapters.kjv: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കൾ യോശുവയോടു: യഹോവ ഇതുവരെ ഞങ്ങളെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു ഞങ്ങൾ ഒരു വലിയ ജനമായി തീർന്നിരിക്കെ ഒരു നറുക്കും ഓഹരിയും മാത്രം നീ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, "Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people, and the Lord has blessed us abundantly."
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given us only one lot and one share to inherit, since we are a great people, inasmuch as the Lord has blessed us until now?"
chapters.kjv: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?

chapters.ml: യോശുവ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ വലിയൊരു ജനം എങ്കിൽ എഫ്രയീംപർവ്വതം നിങ്ങൾക്കു വിസ്താരം പോരാത്തതാകകൊണ്ടു കാട്ടുപ്രദേശത്തു ചെന്നു പെരിസ്യരുടെയും മല്ലന്മാരുടെയും ദേശത്തു കാടുവെട്ടി സ്ഥലം എടുത്തു കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "If you are so numerous," Joshua answered, "and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites."
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua answered them, "If you are a great people, then go up to the forest country and clear a place for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and the giants, since the mountains of Ephraim are too confined for you."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കൾ: മലനാടു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പോരാ; ബേത്ത്-ശെയാനിലും അതിന്റെ അധീനനഗരങ്ങളിലും യിസ്രായേൽ താഴ്വരയിലും ഇങ്ങനെ താഴ്‍വീതി പ്രദേശത്തു പാർക്കുന്ന കനാന്യർക്കൊക്കെയും ഇരിമ്പു രഥങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The people of Joseph replied, "The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites who live in the plain have chariots fitted with iron, both those in Beth Shan and its settlements and those in the Valley of Jezreel."
chapters.nkjv: But the children of Joseph said, "The mountain country is not enough for us; and all the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, boththose who are of Beth Shean and its towns and those who are of the Valley of Jezreel."
chapters.kjv: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ യോസേഫിന്റെ കുലമായ എഫ്രയീമിനോടും മനശ്ശെയോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾ വലിയോരു ജനം തന്നേ; മഹാശക്തിയും ഉണ്ടു; നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു ഓഹരിമാത്രമല്ല വരേണ്ടതു.
chapters.niv: But Joshua said to the tribes of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—"You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—saying, "You are a great people and have great power; you shall not have only one lot,
chapters.kjv: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:

chapters.ml: മലനാടു നിനക്കുള്ളതു ആയിരിക്കേണം; അതു കാടാകുന്നു എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾ അതു വെട്ടിത്തെളിക്കേണം അതിന്റെ അറുതിപ്രദേശങ്ങളും നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളവ തന്നേ; കനാന്യർ ഇരിമ്പുരഥങ്ങൾ ഉള്ളവരും ബലവാന്മാരും ആകുന്നു എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾ അവരെ നീക്കിക്കളയും.
chapters.niv: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have chariots fitted with iron and though they are strong, you can drive them out."
chapters.nkjv: but the mountain country shall be yours. Although it is wooded, you shall cut it down, and its farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots and are strong."
chapters.kjv: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സഭ മുഴുവനും ശീലോവിൽ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി അവിടെ സമാഗമനക്കുടാരം നിർത്തി; ദേശം അവർക്കു കീഴടങ്ങിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The whole assembly of the Israelites gathered at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The country was brought under their control,
chapters.nkjv: Now the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of meeting there. And the land was subdued before them.
chapters.kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ അവകാശം ഭാഗിച്ചു കിട്ടാതിരുന്ന ഏഴു ഗോത്രങ്ങൾ ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: But there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes which had not yet received their inheritance.
chapters.kjv: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ദേശം കൈവശമാക്കുവാൻ പോകുന്നതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എത്രത്തോളം മടിച്ചിരിക്കും?
chapters.niv: So Joshua said to the Israelites: "How long will you wait before you begin to take possession of the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you?
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua said to the children of Israel: "How long will you neglect to go and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers has given you?
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

chapters.ml: ഓരോ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു മുമ്മൂന്നു പേരെ നിയമിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ അവരെ അയക്കും; അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ദേശത്തുകൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു തങ്ങൾക്കു അവകാശം കിട്ടേണ്ടുംപ്രകാരം കണ്ടെഴുതി എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവരേണം.
chapters.niv: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.
chapters.nkjv: Pick out from among you three men for each tribe, and I will send them; they shall rise and go through the land, survey it according to their inheritance, and come back to me.
chapters.kjv: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

chapters.ml: അതു ഏഴു പങ്കായി ഭാഗിക്കേണം: യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ അതിർക്കകത്തു തെക്കു പാർത്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ; യോസേഫിന്റെ കുലവും തന്റെ അതിർക്കകത്തു വടക്കു പാർത്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the tribes of Joseph in their territory on the north.
chapters.nkjv: And they shall divide it into seven parts. Judah shall remain in their territory on the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory on the north.
chapters.kjv: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ ദേശം ഏഴുഭാഗമായി കണ്ടെഴുതി ഇവിടെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ. ഞാൻ ഇവിടെ നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽവെച്ചു നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി ചീട്ടിടും.
chapters.niv: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the Lord our God.
chapters.nkjv: You shall therefore survey the land in seven parts and bring thesurvey here to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
chapters.kjv: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യർക്കു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഓഹരി ഇല്ലല്ലോ; യഹോവയുടെ പൌരോഹിത്യം അവരുടെ അവകാശം ആകുന്നു; ഗാദും രൂബേനും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രവും യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തിട്ടുള്ള അവകാശം യോർദ്ദാന്നു കിഴക്കു വാങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them."
chapters.nkjv: But the Levites have no part among you, for the priesthood of the Lordis their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them."
chapters.kjv: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു; ദേശം കണ്ടെഴുതുവാൻ പോയവരോടു യോശുവ: നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു ദേശത്തുകൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു കണ്ടെഴുതുകയും ഞാൻ ഇവിടെ ശീലോവിൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽവെച്ചു നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി ചീട്ടിടേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവരികയും ചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, "Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: Then the men arose to go away; and Joshua charged those who went to survey the land, saying, "Go, walk through the land, survey it, and come back to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord in Shiloh."
chapters.kjv: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോയി ദേശത്തുകൂടി കടന്നു നഗരവിവരത്തോടുകൂടെ ഒരു പുസ്തകത്തിൽ അതു ഏഴു ഭാഗമായി എഴുതി ശീലോവിൽ യോശുവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ പാളയത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.
chapters.nkjv: So the men went, passed through the land, and wrote the survey in a book in seven parts by cities; and they came to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
chapters.kjv: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോശുവ ശീലോവിൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽവെച്ചു അവർക്കു വേണ്ടി ചീട്ടിട്ടു; അവിടെവെച്ചു യോശുവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു ഗോത്രവിഭാഗപ്രകാരം ദേശം വിഭാഗിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the Lord , and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord, and there Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി നറുക്കു വന്നു; അവരുടെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ അതിർ യെഹൂദയുടെ മക്കളുടെയും യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കളുടെയും മദ്ധ്യേ കിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The first lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin according to its clans. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:
chapters.nkjv: Now the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families, and the territory of their lot came out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
chapters.kjv: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

chapters.ml: വടക്കുഭാഗത്തു അവരുടെ വടക്കെ അതിർ യോർദ്ദാങ്കൽ തുടങ്ങി വടക്കു യെരീഹോവിന്റെ പാർശ്വംവരെ ചെന്നു പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു മലനാട്ടിൽകൂടി കയറി ബേത്ത്-ആവെൻ മരുഭൂമിയിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
chapters.nkjv: Their border on the north side began at the Jordan, and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the mountains westward; it ended at the Wilderness of Beth Aven.
chapters.kjv: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

chapters.ml: അവിടെനിന്നു ആ അതിർ ബേഥേൽ എന്ന ലൂസിന്റെ തെക്കുവശംവരെ കടന്നു താഴത്തെ ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോന്റെ തെക്കുവശത്തുള്ള മലവഴിയായി അതെരോത്ത്-അദാരിലേക്കു ഇറങ്ങുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.
chapters.nkjv: The border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz (which is Bethel) southward; and the border descended to Ataroth Addar, near the hill that lies on the south side of Lower Beth Horon.
chapters.kjv: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Beth-el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ വളഞ്ഞു പടിഞ്ഞാറെ വശത്തു ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോന്നു എതിരെയുള്ള മലമുതൽ തെക്കോട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞു യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ പട്ടണമായ കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീം എന്ന കിർയ്യത്ത്-ബാലയിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു. ഇതു തന്നെ പടിഞ്ഞാറെ ഭാഗം
chapters.niv: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.
chapters.nkjv: Then the border extended around the west side to the south, from the hill that lies before Beth Horon southward; and it ended at Kirjath Baal (which is Kirjath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west side.
chapters.kjv: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

chapters.ml: തെക്കെഭാഗം കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീമിന്റെ അറ്റത്തുള്ള തുടങ്ങി പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു നെപ്തോഹവെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഉറവുവരെ ചെല്ലുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
chapters.nkjv: The south side began at the end of Kirjath Jearim, and the border extended on the west and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
chapters.kjv: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ ബെൻ-ഹിന്നോംതാഴ്വരക്കെതിരെയും രെഫായീംതാഴ്വരയുടെ വടക്കുവശത്തും ഉള്ള മലയുടെ അറ്റംവരെ ചെന്നു ഹിന്നോംതാഴ്വരയിൽ കൂടി തെക്കോട്ടു യെബൂസ്യപർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വംവരെയും ഏൻ-രോഗേൽവരെയും ഇറങ്ങി
chapters.niv: The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel.
chapters.nkjv: Then the border came down to the end of the mountain that lies before the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is in the Valley of the Rephaim on the north, descended to the Valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite city on the south, and descended to En Rogel.
chapters.kjv: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,

chapters.ml: വടക്കോട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞു ഏൻ-ശേമെശിലേക്കും അദുമ്മീംകയറ്റത്തിന്നെതിരെയുള്ള ഗെലീലോത്തിലേക്കും ചെന്നു രൂബേന്റെ മകനായ ബോഹാന്റെ കല്ലുവരെ ഇറങ്ങി
chapters.niv: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
chapters.nkjv: And it went around from the north, went out to En Shemesh, and extended toward Geliloth, which is before the Ascent of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
chapters.kjv: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

chapters.ml: അരാബെക്കെതിരെയുള്ള മലഞ്ചരിവിലേക്കു കടന്നു അരാബയിലേക്കു ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെല്ലുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.
chapters.nkjv: Then it passed along toward the north side of Arabah, and went down to Arabah.
chapters.kjv: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ വടക്കോട്ടു ബേത്ത്-ഹൊഗ്ളയുടെ മലഞ്ചരിവുവരെ കടന്നു തെക്കു യോർദ്ദാന്റെ അഴിമുഖത്തു ഉപ്പുകടലിന്റെ വടക്കെ അറ്റത്തു അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.
chapters.nkjv: And the border passed along to the north side of Beth Hoglah; then the border ended at the north bay at the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the southern boundary.
chapters.kjv: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

chapters.ml: ഇതു തെക്കെ അതിർ, അതിന്റെ കിഴക്കെ അതിർ യോർദ്ദാൻ ആകുന്നു; ഇതു ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കൾക്കു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള അതിരുകൾ.
chapters.niv: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.
chapters.nkjv: The Jordan was its border on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, according to its boundaries all around, according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ: യെരീഹോ, ബേത്ത്-ഹൊഗ്ള, ഏമെക്-കെയെരീഹോ, ബേത്ത്-ഹെഗ്ള, ഏമെക്-കെസീസ്,
chapters.niv: The tribe of Benjamin, according to its clans, had the following towns: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
chapters.nkjv: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, according to their families, were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
chapters.kjv: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

chapters.ml: ബേത്ത്-അരാബ, സെമാറയീം, ബേഥേൽ,
chapters.niv: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
chapters.nkjv: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
chapters.kjv: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,

chapters.ml: അവ്വീം, പാര, ഒഫ്ര,
chapters.niv: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
chapters.nkjv: Avim, Parah, Ophrah,
chapters.kjv: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

chapters.ml: കെഫാർ-അമ്മോനീ, ഒഫ്നി, ഗേബ; ഇങ്ങനെ പന്ത്രണ്ടു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni and Geba—twelve towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Chephar Haammoni, Ophni, and Gaba: twelve cities with their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:

chapters.ml: ഗിബെയോൻ, രാമ, ബേരോത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
chapters.nkjv: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
chapters.kjv: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

chapters.ml: മിസ്പെ, കെഫീര, മോസ,
chapters.niv: Mizpah, Kephirah, Mozah,
chapters.nkjv: Mizpah, Chephirah, Mozah,
chapters.kjv: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

chapters.ml: രേക്കെം, യിർപ്പേൽ, തരല,
chapters.niv: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
chapters.nkjv: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
chapters.kjv: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

chapters.ml: സേല, ഏലെഫ്, യെരൂശാലേം എന്ന യെബൂസ്യനഗരം, ശിബെയത്ത്, കിർയ്യത്ത്; ഇങ്ങനെ പതിന്നാലു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും ഇതു ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കൾക്കു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം.
chapters.niv: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath—fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.
chapters.nkjv: Zelah, Eleph, Jebus (which is Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kirjath: fourteen cities with their villages. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തെ നറുക്കു ശിമെയോന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ശിമെയോൻമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു വന്നു; അവരുടെ അവകാശം യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon according to its clans. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: The second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. And their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു തങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശത്തിൽ
chapters.niv: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
chapters.nkjv: They had in their inheritance Beersheba (Sheba), Moladah,
chapters.kjv: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

chapters.ml: ബേർ-ശേബ, ശേബ, മോലാദ,
chapters.niv: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
chapters.nkjv: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
chapters.kjv: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

chapters.ml: ഹസർ-ശൂവാൽ, ബാലാ, ഏസെം, എല്തോലദ്, ബേഥൂൽ, ഹൊർമ്മ, സിക്ളാഗ്, ബേത്ത്-മർക്കാബോത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
chapters.nkjv: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
chapters.kjv: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

chapters.ml: ഹസർ-സൂസ, ബേത്ത്-ലെബായോത്ത്- ശാരൂഹെൻ;
chapters.niv: Ziklag, Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susah,
chapters.nkjv: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
chapters.kjv: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പതിമൂന്നു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen—thirteen towns and their villages;
chapters.nkjv: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen: thirteen cities and their villages;
chapters.kjv: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

chapters.ml: അയീൻ, രിമ്മോൻ, ഏഥെർ, ആശാൻ; ഇങ്ങനെ നാലു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan—four towns and their villages—
chapters.nkjv: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan: four cities and their villages;
chapters.kjv: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

chapters.ml: ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങൾക്കു ചുറ്റം തെക്കെ ദേശത്തിലെ രാമ എന്ന ബാലത്ത്-ബേർവരെയുള്ള സകലഗ്രാമങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇതു ശിമെയോൻമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം.
chapters.niv: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, according to its clans.
chapters.nkjv: and all the villages that were all around these cities as far as Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോൻമക്കളുടെ അവകാശം യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ ഓഹരിയിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു; യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ ഓഹരി അവർക്കു അധികമായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവരുടെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ ശിമെയോൻമക്കൾക്കു അവകാശം ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah’s portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: The inheritance of the children of Simeon wasincluded in the share of the children of Judah, for the share of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of that people.
chapters.kjv: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂൻ മക്കൾക്കു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി മൂന്നാമത്തെ നറുക്കു വന്നു; അവരുടെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ അതിർ സാരീദ്വരെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The third lot came up for Zebulun according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.
chapters.nkjv: The third lot came out for the children of Zebulun according to their families, and the border of their inheritance was as far as Sarid.
chapters.kjv: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അതിർ പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു മരലയിലേക്കു കയറി ദബ്ബേശെത്ത്‌വരെ ചെന്നു യൊക്നെയാമിന്നെതിരെയുള്ള തോടുവരെ എത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.
chapters.nkjv: Their border went toward the west and to Maralah, went to Dabbasheth, and extended along the brook that is east of Jokneam.
chapters.kjv: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;

chapters.ml: സാരീദിൽനിന്നു അതു കിഴക്കോട്ടു സൂര്യോദയത്തിന്റെ നേരെ കിസ്ളോത്ത് താബോരിന്റെ അതിരിലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു ദാബെരത്തിന്നു ചെന്നു യാഫീയയിലേക്കു കയറുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.
chapters.nkjv: Then from Sarid it went eastward toward the sunrise along the border of Chisloth Tabor, and went out toward Daberath, bypassing Japhia.
chapters.kjv: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

chapters.ml: അവിടെനിന്നു കിഴക്കോട്ടു ഗത്ത്-ഹേഫെരിലേക്കും ഏത്ത്-കാസീനിലേക്കും കടന്നു നേയാവരെ നീണ്ടുകിടക്കുന്ന രിമ്മോനിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.
chapters.nkjv: And from there it passed along on the east of Gath Hepher, toward Eth Kazin, and extended to Rimmon, which borders on Neah.
chapters.kjv: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ ഹന്നാഥോന്റെ വടക്കുവശത്തു തിരിഞ്ഞു യിഫ്താഹ്-ഏൽതാഴ്വരയിൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.
chapters.nkjv: Then the border went around it on the north side of Hannathon, and it ended in the Valley of Jiphthah El.
chapters.kjv: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:

chapters.ml: കത്താത്ത്, നഹല്ലാൽ, ശിമ്രോൻ, യിദല, ബേത്ത്-ലേഹെം മുതലായ പന്ത്രണ്ടു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും അവർക്കുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Included were Kattath, Nahallal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.

chapters.ml: ഇതു സെബൂലൂൻ മക്കൾക്കു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശമായ പട്ടണങ്ങളും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, according to its clans.
chapters.nkjv: This was the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

chapters.ml: നാലാമത്തെ നറുക്കു യിസ്സാഖാരിന്നു, കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി യിസ്സാഖാർമക്കൾക്കു തന്നേ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The fourth lot came out for Issachar according to its clans.
chapters.nkjv: The fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശം യിസ്രെയേൽ, കെസുല്ലോത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,
chapters.nkjv: And their territory went to Jezreel, and included Chesulloth, Shunem,
chapters.kjv: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

chapters.ml: ശൂനേം, ഹഫാരയീം, ശീയോൻ,
chapters.niv: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
chapters.nkjv: Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath,
chapters.kjv: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

chapters.ml: അനാഹരാത്ത്, രബ്ബീത്ത്, കിശ്യോൻ,
chapters.niv: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
chapters.nkjv: Rabbith, Kishion, Abez,
chapters.kjv: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

chapters.ml: ഏബെസ്, രേമെത്ത്, ഏൻ-ഗന്നീം, ഏൻ-ഹദ്ദ, ബേത്ത്-പസ്സേസ് എന്നിവ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.
chapters.nkjv: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
chapters.kjv: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അതിർ താബോർ, ശഹസൂമ, ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശ്, എന്നിവയിൽ എത്തി യോർദ്ദാങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു. ഇങ്ങനെ പതിനാറു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: And the border reached to Tabor, Shahazimah, and Beth Shemesh; their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

chapters.ml: ഇതു യിസ്സാഖാർമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം; ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങളും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, according to its clans.
chapters.nkjv: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
chapters.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

chapters.ml: ആശേർമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി അഞ്ചാമത്തെ നറുക്കു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher according to its clans.
chapters.nkjv: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
chapters.kjv: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശം ഹെല്കത്ത്, ഹലി, ബേതെൻ,
chapters.niv: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,
chapters.nkjv: And their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
chapters.kjv: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

chapters.ml: അക്ശാഫ്, അല്ലമ്മേലെക്, അമാദ്, മിശാൽ എന്നിവ ആയിരുന്നു; അതു പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു കർമ്മേലും ശീഹോർ-ലിബ്നാത്തുംവരെ എത്തി,
chapters.niv: Allammelek, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.
chapters.nkjv: Alammelech, Amad, and Mishal; it reached to Mount Carmel westward, along theBrook Shihor Libnath.
chapters.kjv: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

chapters.ml: സൂര്യോദയത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ബേത്ത്-ദാഗോനിലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു വടക്കു സെബൂലൂനിലും ബേത്ത്-ഏമെക്കിലും നെയീയേലിലും യിഫ്താഹ്-ഏൽതാഴ്വരയിലും എത്തി ഇടത്തോട്ടു കാബൂൽ,
chapters.niv: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Kabul on the left.
chapters.nkjv: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon; and it reached to Zebulun and to the Valley of Jiphthah El, then northward beyond Beth Emek and Neiel, bypassing Cabul whichwas on the left,
chapters.kjv: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോൻ, രെഹോബ്, ഹമ്മോൻ, കാനാ, എന്നിവയിലും മഹാനഗരമായ സീദോൻ വരെയും ചെല്ലുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
chapters.nkjv: including Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
chapters.kjv: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ രാമയിലേക്കും ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണമായ സോരിലേക്കും തിരിയുന്നു. പിന്നെ ആ അതിർ ഹോസയിലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു സക്സീബ് ദേശത്തു സമുദ്രത്തിങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the Mediterranean Sea in the region of Akzib,
chapters.nkjv: And the border turned to Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre; then the border turned to Hosah, and ended at the sea by the region of Achzib.
chapters.kjv: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

chapters.ml: ഉമ്മ, അഫേക്, രെഹോബ് മുതലായ ഇരുപത്തുരണ്ടു പട്ടണവും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും അവർക്കുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.
chapters.nkjv: Also Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob wereincluded: twenty-two cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ആശേർമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിന്നു കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി കിട്ടിയ അവകാശം; ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങളും അവയുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, according to its clans.
chapters.nkjv: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
chapters.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

chapters.ml: ആറാമത്തെ നറുക്കു നഫ്താലിമക്കൾക്കു, കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി നഫ്താലിമക്കൾക്കു തന്നേ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali according to its clans:
chapters.nkjv: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
chapters.kjv: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അതിർ ഹേലെഫും സാനന്നീമിലെ കരുവേലകവും തുടങ്ങി അദാമീ-നേക്കെബിലും യബ്നോലിലും കൂടി ലക്കൂംവരെ ചെന്നു യോർദ്ദാങ്കൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: And their border began at Heleph, enclosing the territory from the terebinth tree in Zaanannim, Adami Nekeb, and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum; it ended at the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
