chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിനെ നദിക്കക്കരെനിന്നുകൊണ്ടുവന്നു കനാൻ ദേശത്തൊക്കെയും സഞ്ചരിപ്പിച്ചു അവന്റെ സന്തതിയെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കയും അവന്നു യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ കൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But I took your father Abraham from the land beyond the Euphrates and led him throughout Canaan and gave him many descendants. I gave him Isaac,
chapters.nkjv: Then I took your father Abraham from the other side of the River, led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his descendants and gave him Isaac.
chapters.kjv: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്നു ഞാൻ യാക്കോബിനെയും ഏശാവിനെയും കൊടുത്തു; ഏശാവിന്നു ഞാൻ സേയീർപർവ്വതം അവകാശമായി കൊടുത്തു; എന്നാൽ യാക്കോബും അവന്റെ മക്കളും മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I assigned the hill country of Seir to Esau, but Jacob and his family went down to Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: To Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. To Esau I gave the mountains of Seir to possess, but Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഞാൻ മോശെയെയും അഹരോനെയും അയച്ചു; ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീമിൽ പ്രവർത്തിച്ച പ്രവൃത്തികളാൽ അതിനെ ബാധിച്ചു; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം നിങ്ങളെ പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and I brought you out.
chapters.nkjv: Also I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to what I did among them. Afterward I brought you out.
chapters.kjv: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു; നിങ്ങൾ കടലിന്നരികെ എത്തി; മിസ്രയീമ്യർ രഥങ്ങളോടും കുതിരകളോടുംകൂടെ ചെങ്കടൽവരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു;
chapters.niv: When I brought your people out of Egypt, you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Then I brought your fathers out of Egypt, and you came to the sea; and the Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Red Sea.
chapters.kjv: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

chapters.ml: അവർ യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കും മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ അന്ധകാരം വെച്ചു കടൽ അവരുടെമേൽ വരുത്തി അവരെ മുക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; ഇങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ മിസ്രയീമ്യരോടു ചെയ്തതു നിങ്ങൾ കണ്ണാലെ കണ്ടു; നിങ്ങൾ ഏറിയ കാലം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But they cried to the Lord for help, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians; he brought the sea over them and covered them. You saw with your own eyes what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.
chapters.nkjv: So they cried out to the Lord; and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, brought the sea upon them, and covered them. And your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. Then you dwelt in the wilderness a long time.
chapters.kjv: And when they cried unto the LORD , he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ പാർത്തിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യരുടെ ദേശത്തേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവൻ നിങ്ങളോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു; നിങ്ങൾ അവരുടെ ദേശം കൈവശമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അവരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു, നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: " ‘I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan. They fought against you, but I gave them into your hands. I destroyed them from before you, and you took possession of their land.
chapters.nkjv: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, who dwelt on the other side of the Jordan, and they fought with you. But I gave them into your hand, that you might possess their land, and I destroyed them from before you.
chapters.kjv: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സിപ്പോരിന്റെ മകൻ മോവാബ്യരാജാവായ ബാലാക്ക് പുറപ്പെട്ടു യിസ്രായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു; നിങ്ങളെ ശപിപ്പാൻ ബെയോരിന്റെ മകനായ ബിലെയാമിനെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you.
chapters.nkjv: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose to make war against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you.
chapters.kjv: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും എനിക്കു ബിലെയാമിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേൾപ്പാൻ മനസ്സില്ലായ്കയാൽ അവൻ നിങ്ങളെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു; ഇങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you out of his hand.
chapters.nkjv: But I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he continued to bless you. So I delivered you out of his hand.
chapters.kjv: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു യെരീഹോവിലേക്കു വന്നു; യെരീഹോ നിവാസികൾ, അമോർയ്യർ, പെരിസ്യർ, കനാന്യർ, ഹിത്യർ, ഗിർഗ്ഗസ്യർ, ഹിവ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ എന്നിവർ നിങ്ങളോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു; ഞാൻ അവരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The citizens of Jericho fought against you, as did also the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites, but I gave them into your hands.
chapters.nkjv: Then you went over the Jordan and came to Jericho. And the men of Jericho fought against you—also the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I delivered them into your hand.
chapters.kjv: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ കടുന്നലിനെ അയച്ചു; അതു നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു അമോർയ്യരുടെ ആ രണ്ടു രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ഓടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; നിന്റെ വാളുകൊണ്ടല്ല, നിന്റെ വില്ലുകെണ്ടും അല്ല.
chapters.niv: I sent the hornet ahead of you, which drove them out before you—also the two Amorite kings. You did not do it with your own sword and bow.
chapters.nkjv: I sent the hornet before you which drove them out from before you, also the two kings of the Amorites, but not with your sword or with your bow.
chapters.kjv: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പ്രയത്നം ചെയ്യാത്ത ദേശവും നിങ്ങൾ പണിയാത്ത പട്ടണങ്ങളും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ അവയിൽ പാർക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ നട്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്ത മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളും ഒലിവുതോട്ടങ്ങളും നിങ്ങൾക്കു അനുഭവമായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build; and you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’
chapters.nkjv: I have given you a land for which you did not labor, and cities which you did not build, and you dwell in them; you eat of the vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant.’
chapters.kjv: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു അവനെ പരമാർത്ഥതയോടും വിശ്വസ്തതയോടുംകൂടെ സേവിപ്പിൻ. നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ നദിക്കക്കരെയും മിസ്രയീമിലുംവെച്ചു സേവിച്ച ദേവന്മാരെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയും യഹോവയെത്തന്നേ സേവിക്കയും ചെയ്‍വിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Now fear the Lord and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your ancestors worshiped beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: "Now therefore, fear the Lord, serve Him in sincerity and in truth, and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the River and in Egypt. Serve the Lord!
chapters.kjv: Now therefore fear the LORD , and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെ സേവിക്കുന്നതു നന്നല്ലെന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു തോന്നുന്നെങ്കിൽ നദിക്കക്കരെവെച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ സേവിച്ച ദേവന്മാരെയോ നിങ്ങൾ പാർത്തുവരുന്ന ദേശത്തിലെ അമോർയ്യരുടെ ദേവന്മാരെയോ ആരെ സേവിക്കും എന്നു ഇന്നു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തുകൊൾവിൻ. ഞാനും എന്റെ കുടുംബവുമോ, ഞങ്ങൾ യഹോവയെ സേവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But if serving the Lord seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: And if it seems evil to you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell. But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD , choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ജനം ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ സേവിപ്പാൻ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു സംഗതി വരരുതേ.
chapters.niv: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us to forsake the Lord to serve other gods!
chapters.nkjv: So the people answered and said: "Far be it from us that we should forsake the Lord to serve other gods;
chapters.kjv: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD , to serve other gods;

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളെയും ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെയും അടിമവീടായ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു ഞങ്ങൾ കാൺകെ ആ വലിയ അടയാളങ്ങൾ പ്രവർത്തിക്കയും ഞങ്ങൾ നടന്ന എല്ലാവഴിയിലും ഞങ്ങൾ കടന്നുപോന്ന സകലജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിലും ഞങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിക്കയും ചെയ്തവൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ തന്നേയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: It was the Lord our God himself who brought us and our parents up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
chapters.nkjv: for the Lord our God is He who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way that we went and among all the people through whom we passed.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തു പാർത്തിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യർ മുതലായ സകലജാതികളെയും യഹോവ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; ആകയാൽ ഞങ്ങളും യഹോവയെ സേവിക്കും; അവനല്ലോ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവം.
chapters.niv: And the Lord drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the Lord , because he is our God."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord drove out from before us all the people, including the Amorites who dwelt in the land. We also will serve the Lord, for He is our God."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD ; for he is our God.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു യഹോവയെ സേവിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നതല്ല; അവൻ പരിശുദ്ധദൈവം; അവൻ തീക്ഷ്ണതയുള്ള ദൈവം; അവൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ അതിക്രമങ്ങളെയും പാപങ്ങളെയും ക്ഷമിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve the Lord . He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.
chapters.nkjv: But Joshua said to the people, "You cannot serve the Lord, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD : for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ സേവിച്ചാൽ മുമ്പെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു നന്മചെയ്തതുപോലെ അവൻ തിരിഞ്ഞു നിങ്ങൾക്കു തിന്മചെയ്തു നിങ്ങളെ സംഹരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster on you and make an end of you, after he has been good to you."
chapters.nkjv: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, then He will turn and do you harm and consume you, after He has done you good."
chapters.kjv: If ye forsake the LORD , and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

chapters.ml: ജനം യോശുവയോടു: അല്ല, ഞങ്ങൾ യഹോവയെത്തന്നേ സേവിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the people said to Joshua, "No! We will serve the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: And the people said to Joshua, "No, but we will serve the Lord!"
chapters.kjv: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD .

chapters.ml: യോശുവ ജനത്തോടു: യഹോവയെ സേവിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ സാക്ഷികൾ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതേ, ഞങ്ങൾ തന്നേ സാക്ഷികൾ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua said, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the Lord ." "Yes, we are witnesses," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua said to the people, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the Lord for yourselves, to serve Him." And they said, "Weare witnesses!"
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD , to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിലുള്ള അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിങ്കലേക്കു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയം ചായിപ്പിൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Now then," said Joshua, "throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the Lord , the God of Israel."
chapters.nkjv: "Now therefore," hesaid, "put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the Lord God of Israel."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore put away, said he , the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

chapters.ml: ജനം യോശുവയോടു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ ഞങ്ങൾ സേവിക്കും; അവന്റെ വാക്കു ഞങ്ങൾ അനുസരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And the people said to Joshua, "We will serve the Lord our God and obey him."
chapters.nkjv: And the people said to Joshua, "The Lord our God we will serve, and His voice we will obey!"
chapters.kjv: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോശുവ അന്നു ജനവുമായി ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്തു; അവർക്കു ശെഖേമിൽ വെച്ചു ഒരു ചട്ടവും പ്രമാണവും നിശ്ചയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he reaffirmed for them decrees and laws.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോശുവ ഈ വചനങ്ങൾ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതി; ഒരു വലിയ കല്ലെടുത്തു അവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്നരികെയുള്ള കരുവേലകത്തിൻ കീഴെ നാട്ടിയുംവെച്ചു യോശുവ സകലജനത്തോടും:
chapters.niv: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then Joshua wrote these words in the Book of the Law of God. And he took a large stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഈ കല്ലു നമുക്കു സാക്ഷിയായിരിക്കട്ടെ; അതു യഹോവ നമ്മോടു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള വചനങ്ങളൊക്കെയും കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവത്തെ നിങ്ങൾ നിഷേധിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു സാക്ഷിയായിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "See!" he said to all the people. "This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the Lord has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God."
chapters.nkjv: And Joshua said to all the people, "Behold, this stone shall be a witness to us, for it has heard all the words of the Lord which He spoke to us. It shall therefore be a witness to you, lest you deny your God."
chapters.kjv: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യോശുവ ജനത്തെ താന്താങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശത്തിലേക്കു പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Joshua dismissed the people, each to their own inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: So Joshua let the people depart, each to his own inheritance.
chapters.kjv: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായി നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവ നൂറ്റിപ്പത്തു വയസ്സുള്ളവനായി മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass after these things that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being one hundred and ten years old.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD , died, being an hundred and ten years old.

chapters.ml: അവനെ എഫ്രയീംപർവ്വതത്തിലുള്ള തിമ്നാത്ത്-സേരഹിൽ ഗായശ് മലയുടെ വടക്കുവശത്തു അവന്റെ അവകാശഭൂമിയിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
chapters.nkjv: And they buried him within the border of his inheritance at Timnath Serah, which is in the mountains of Ephraim, on the north side of Mount Gaash.
chapters.kjv: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയുടെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും യോശുവ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നവരായി യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള സകലപ്രവൃത്തികളും അറിഞ്ഞവരായ മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽ യഹോവയെ സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Israel served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the Lord had done for Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had known all the works of the Lord which He had done for Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD , that he had done for Israel.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപോന്ന യോസേഫിന്റെ അസ്ഥികളെ അവർ ശെഖേമിൽ, യാക്കോബ് ശെഖേമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹാമോരിന്റെ മക്കളോടു നൂറു വെള്ളിക്കാശിന്നു വാങ്ങിയിരുന്ന നിലത്തു, അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അതു യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു അവകാശമായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Joseph’s bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph’s descendants.
chapters.nkjv: The bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel had brought up out of Egypt, they buried at Shechem, in the plot of ground which Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for one hundred pieces of silver, and which had become an inheritance of the children of Joseph.
chapters.kjv: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ മകൻ എലെയാസാരും മരിച്ചു; അവനെ അവന്റെ മകനായ ഫീനെഹാസിന്നു എഫ്രയീംപർവ്വതത്തിൽ കൊടുത്തിരുന്ന കുന്നിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, which had been allotted to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.nkjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in a hill belongingto Phinehas his son, which was given to him in the mountains of Ephraim.
chapters.kjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയുടെ മരണശേഷം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ: ഞങ്ങളിൽ ആരാകുന്നു കനാന്യരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ ആദ്യം പുറപ്പെടേണ്ടതു എന്നു യഹോവയോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord , "Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Canaanites?"
chapters.nkjv: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass that the children of Israel asked the Lord, saying, "Who shall be first to go up for us against the Canaanites to fight against them?"
chapters.kjv: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD , saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ പുറപ്പെടട്ടെ; ഞാൻ ദേശം അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord answered, "Judah shall go up; I have given the land into their hands."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "Judah shall go up. Indeed I have delivered the land into his hand."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ശിമെയോനോടു: എന്റെ അവകാശദേശത്തു കനാന്യരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ നീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരേണം; നിന്റെ അവകാശദേശത്തു നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഞാനും വരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ശിമെയോൻ അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: The men of Judah then said to the Simeonites their fellow Israelites, "Come up with us into the territory allotted to us, to fight against the Canaanites. We in turn will go with you into yours." So the Simeonites went with them.
chapters.nkjv: So Judah said to Simeon his brother, "Come up with me to my allotted territory, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I will likewise go with you to your allotted territory." And Simeon went with him.
chapters.kjv: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യെഹൂദാ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; യഹോവ കനാന്യരെയും പെരിസ്യരെയും അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ ബേസെക്കിൽവെച്ചു അവരിൽ പതിനായിരംപോരെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Judah attacked, the Lord gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah went up, and the Lord delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand; and they killed ten thousand men at Bezek.
chapters.kjv: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

chapters.ml: ബേസെക്കിൽവെച്ചു അവർ അദോനി-ബേസെക്കിനെ കണ്ടു, അവനോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു കനാന്യരെയും പെരിസ്യരെയും സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was there that they found Adoni-Bezek and fought against him, putting to rout the Canaanites and Perizzites.
chapters.nkjv: And they found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and fought against him; and they defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
chapters.kjv: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അദോനീ-ബേസെക്ക് ഓടിപ്പോയി; അവർ അവനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു പിടിച്ചു അവന്റെ കൈകാലുകളുടെ പെരുവിരൽ മുറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Adoni-Bezek fled, but they chased him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
chapters.nkjv: Then Adoni-Bezek fled, and they pursued him and caught him and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
chapters.kjv: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

chapters.ml: കൈകാലുകളുടെ പെരുവിരൽ മുറിച്ചു എഴുപതു രാജാക്കന്മാർ എന്റെ മേശയിൻ കീഴിൽനിന്നു പെറുക്കിത്തിന്നിരുന്നു; ഞാൻ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ ദൈവം എനിക്കു പകരം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അദോനീ--ബേസെക്ക് പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അവനെ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി അവിടെവെച്ചു അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
chapters.nkjv: And Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off used to gather scraps under my table; as I have done, so God has repaid me." Then they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
chapters.kjv: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാമക്കൾ യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വെട്ടി നഗരം തീയിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The men of Judah attacked Jerusalem also and took it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.
chapters.nkjv: Now the children of Judah fought against Jerusalem and took it; they struck it with the edge of the sword and set the city on fire.
chapters.kjv: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യെഹൂദാമക്കൾ മലനാട്ടിലും തെക്കെ ദേശത്തിലും താഴ്വീതിയിലും പാർത്തിരുന്ന കനാന്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: After that, Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev and the western foothills.
chapters.nkjv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who dwelt in the mountains, in the South, and in the lowland.
chapters.kjv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ ഹെബ്രോനിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന കനാന്യരുടെ നേരെയും ചെന്നു; ഹെബ്രോന്നു പണ്ടു കിർയ്യത്ത്-അബ്ബാ എന്നു പേർ. അവർ ശേശായി, അഹിമാൻ, തൽമായി എന്നവരെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They advanced against the Canaanites living in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath Arba) and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judah went against the Canaanites who dwelt in Hebron. (Now the name of Hebron was formerly Kirjath Arba.) And they killed Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
chapters.kjv: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നു അവർ ദെബീർ നിവാസികളുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു; ദെബീരിന്നു പണ്ടു കിർയ്യത്ത്--സേഫെർ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).
chapters.nkjv: From there they went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir was formerly Kirjath Sepher.)
chapters.kjv: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher:

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ കാലേബ്: കിർയ്യത്ത്--സേഫെർ ജയിച്ചടക്കുന്നവന്നു ഞാൻ എന്റെ മകൾ അക്സയെ ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."
chapters.nkjv: Then Caleb said, "Whoever attacks Kirjath Sepher and takes it, to him I will give my daughter Achsah as wife."
chapters.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

chapters.ml: കാലേബിന്റെ അനുജനായ കെനസിന്റെ മകൻ ഒത്നീയേൽ അതു പിടിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ മകൾ അക്സയെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.
chapters.nkjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; so he gave him his daughter Achsah as wife.
chapters.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

chapters.ml: അവൾ വന്നപ്പോൾ തന്റെ അപ്പനോടു ഒരു വയൽ ചോദിപ്പാൻ അവനെ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിച്ചു; അവൾ കഴുതപ്പുറത്തുനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ കാലേബ് അവളോടു: നിനക്കു എന്തുവേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when she came tohim, that she urged him to ask her father for a field. And she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you wish?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനോടു ഒരു അനുഗ്രഹം എനിക്കു തരേണമേ; നീ എന്നെ തെക്കൻ നാട്ടിലേക്കല്ലോ കൊടുത്തതു; നീരുറവുകളും എനിക്കു തരേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; കാലേബ് അവൾക്കു മലയിലും താഴ്വരയിലും നീരുറവുകൾ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
chapters.nkjv: So she said to him, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me land in the South, give me also springs of water." And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
chapters.kjv: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ അളിയനായ കേന്യന്റെ മക്കൾ യെഹൂദാമക്കളോടുകൂടെ ഈന്തപ്പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു അരാദിന്നു തെക്കുള്ള യെഹൂദാ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു പോയി; അവർ ചെന്നു ജനത്തോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up from the City of Palms with the people of Judah to live among the inhabitants of the Desert of Judah in the Negev near Arad.
chapters.nkjv: Now the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms with the children of Judah into the Wilderness of Judah, which lies in the South near Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
chapters.kjv: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ശിമെയോനോടു കൂടെ പോയി, അവർ സെഫാത്തിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന കനാന്യരെ വെട്ടി അതിനെ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി; ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു ഹോർമ്മ എന്നു പേർ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the men of Judah went with the Simeonites their fellow Israelites and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they totally destroyed the city. Therefore it was called Hormah.
chapters.nkjv: And Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they attacked the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. So the name of the city was called Hormah.
chapters.kjv: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ ഗസ്സയും അതിന്റെ അതിർനാടും അസ്കലോനും അതിന്റെ അതിർനാടും എക്രോനും അതിന്റെ അതിർനാടും പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Judah also took Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron—each city with its territory.
chapters.nkjv: Also Judah took Gaza with its territory, Ashkelon with its territory, and Ekron with its territory.
chapters.kjv: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യെഹൂദയോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ മലനാടു കൈവശമാക്കി; എന്നാൽ താഴ്വരയിലെ നിവാസികൾക്കു ഇരിമ്പുരഥങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവരെ നീക്കിക്കളവാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Lord was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country, but they were unable to drive the people from the plains, because they had chariots fitted with iron.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord was with Judah. And they drove out the mountaineers, but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the lowland, because they had chariots of iron.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

chapters.ml: മോശെ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർ കാലേബിന്നു ഹെബ്രോൻ കൊടുത്തു; അവൻ അവിടെനിന്നു അനാക്കിന്റെ മൂന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.
chapters.nkjv: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said. Then he expelled from there the three sons of Anak.
chapters.kjv: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കൾ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന യെബൂസ്യരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ല; യെബൂസ്യർ ഇന്നുവരെ ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കളോടു കൂടെ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർത്തുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Benjamites, however, did not drive out the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the Benjamites.
chapters.nkjv: But the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem; so the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ ഗൃഹം ബേഥേലിലേക്കു കയറിച്ചെന്നു; യഹോവ അവരോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the tribes of Joseph attacked Bethel, and the Lord was with them.
chapters.nkjv: And the house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the Lordwas with them.
chapters.kjv: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el: and the LORD was with them.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ ഗൃഹം ബേഥേൽ ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ ആളയച്ചു; ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു മുമ്പെ ലൂസ് എന്നു പേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they sent men to spy out Bethel (formerly called Luz),
chapters.nkjv: So the house of Joseph sent men to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city was formerly Luz.)
chapters.kjv: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth-el. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

chapters.ml: പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവരുന്ന ഒരുത്തനെ ഒറ്റുകാർ കണ്ടു അവനോടു: പട്ടണത്തിൽ കടപ്പാൻ ഒരു വഴി കാണിച്ചു തരേണം; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നോടു ദയചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: the spies saw a man coming out of the city and they said to him, "Show us how to get into the city and we will see that you are treated well."
chapters.nkjv: And when the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, "Please show us the entrance to the city, and we will show you mercy."
chapters.kjv: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പട്ടണത്തിൽ കടപ്പാനുള്ള വഴി അവർക്കു കാണിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു; അവർ പട്ടണത്തെ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു, ആ മനുഷ്യനെയും അവന്റെ സകല കുടുംബത്തെയും വിട്ടയച്ചു;
chapters.niv: So he showed them, and they put the city to the sword but spared the man and his whole family.
chapters.nkjv: So he showed them the entrance to the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
chapters.kjv: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹിത്യരുടെ ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു ഒരു പട്ടണം പണിതു അതിന്നു ലൂസ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; അതിന്നു ഇന്നുവരെ അതു തന്നേ പേർ.
chapters.niv: He then went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a city and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
chapters.nkjv: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെ ബേത്ത്--ശെയാനിലും അതിന്റെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിലും താനാക്കിലും അതിന്റെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിലും ദോരിലും അതിന്റെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിലും യിബ്ളെയാമിലും അതിന്റെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിലും മെഗിദ്ദോവിലും അതിന്റെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിലും പാർത്തിരുന്നവരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ല. കനാന്യർക്കു ആ ദേശത്തു തന്നേ പാർപ്പാനുള്ള താല്പര്യം സാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth Shan or Taanach or Dor or Ibleam or Megiddo and their surrounding settlements, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.
chapters.nkjv: However, Manasseh did not drive out theinhabitantsof Beth Shean and its villages, or Taanach and its villages, or the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its villages, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
chapters.kjv: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ബലം കൂടിയപ്പോൾ അവർ കന്യാന്യരെ മുഴുവനും നീക്കിക്കളയാതെ അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു ഊഴിയവേല ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Israel became strong, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor but never drove them out completely.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites under tribute, but did not completely drive them out.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീം ഗേസെരിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന കനാന്യരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ല; കനാന്യർ ഗേസെരിൽ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, but the Canaanites continued to live there among them.
chapters.nkjv: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites who dwelt in Gezer; so the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
chapters.kjv: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂൻ കിത്രോനിലും നഹലോലിലും പാർത്തിരുന്നവരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ല; കനാന്യർ ഊഴിയവേലക്കാരായിത്തീർന്നു അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Neither did Zebulun drive out the Canaanites living in Kitron or Nahalol, so these Canaanites lived among them, but Zebulun did subject them to forced labor.
chapters.nkjv: Nor did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron or the inhabitants of Nahalol; so the Canaanites dwelt among them, and were put under tribute.
chapters.kjv: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

chapters.ml: ആശേർ അക്കോവിലും സീദോനിലും അഹ്ളാബിലും അക്സീബിലും ഹെൽബയിലും അഫീക്കിലും രെഹോബിലും പാർത്തിരുന്നവരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Akko or Sidon or Ahlab or Akzib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob.
chapters.nkjv: Nor did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Acco or the inhabitants of Sidon, or of Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, or Rehob.
chapters.kjv: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

chapters.ml: അവരെ നീക്കിക്കളയാതെ ആശേർയ്യർ ദേശനിവാസികളായ കനാന്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land because they did not drive them out.
chapters.nkjv: So the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
chapters.kjv: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലി ബേത്ത്--ശേമെശിലും ബേത്ത്--അനാത്തിലും പാർത്തിരുന്നവരെ നീക്കിക്കളയാതെ ദേശനിവാസികളായ കനാന്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർത്തു; എന്നാൽ ബേത്ത്--ശേമെശിലെയും ബേത്ത്--അനാത്തിലെയും നിവാസികൾ അവർക്കു ഊഴിയവേലക്കാരായിത്തിർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Neither did Naphtali drive out those living in Beth Shemesh or Beth Anath; but the Naphtalites too lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and those living in Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath became forced laborers for them.
chapters.nkjv: Nor did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh or the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but they dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath were put under tribute to them.
chapters.kjv: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.

chapters.ml: അമോർയ്യർ ദാൻ മക്കളെ തിക്കിത്തള്ളി മലനാട്ടിൽ കയറ്റി; താഴ്വരയിലേക്കു ഇറങ്ങുവാൻ അവരെ സമ്മതിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Amorites confined the Danites to the hill country, not allowing them to come down into the plain.
chapters.nkjv: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountains, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
chapters.kjv: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അമേർയ്യർക്കു ഹർഹേരെസിലും അയ്യാലോനിലും ശാൽബീമിലും പാർപ്പാനുള്ള താല്പര്യം സാധിച്ചു. എന്നാൽ യോസേഫിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു ബലംകൂടിയപ്പോൾ അവരെ ഊഴിയ വേലക്കാരാക്കിത്തീർത്തു.
chapters.niv: And the Amorites were determined also to hold out in Mount Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim, but when the power of the tribes of Joseph increased, they too were pressed into forced labor.
chapters.nkjv: and the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim; yet when the strength of the house of Joseph became greater, they were put under tribute.
chapters.kjv: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

chapters.ml: അമോർയ്യരുടെ അതിർ അക്രബ്ബിംകയറ്റവും സേലയും മുതൽ പിന്നെയും മേലോട്ടുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The boundary of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and beyond.
chapters.nkjv: Now the boundary of the Amorites was from the Ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela, and upward.
chapters.kjv: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവയുടെ ഒരു ദൂതൻ ഗില്ഗാലിൽനിന്നു ബോഖീമിലേക്കു വന്നുപറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു; നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു സത്യംചെയ്ത ദേശത്തേക്കു നിങ്ങളെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു: നിങ്ങളോടുള്ള എന്റെ നിയമം ഞാൻ ഒരിക്കലും ലംഘിക്കയില്ല എന്നും
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, "I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land I swore to give to your ancestors. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said: "I led you up from Egypt and brought you to the land of which I swore to your fathers; and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you.
chapters.kjv: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഈ ദേശനിവാസികളോടു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യാതെ അവരുടെ ബലിപീഠങ്ങൾ ഇടിച്ചുകളയേണമെന്നും കല്പിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ വാക്കു അനുസരിച്ചില്ല; ഇങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: and you shall not make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall break down their altars.’ Yet you have disobeyed me. Why have you done this?
chapters.nkjv: And you shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land; you shall tear down their altars.’ But you have not obeyed My voice. Why have you done this?
chapters.kjv: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അവരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളകയില്ല; അവർ നിങ്ങളുടെ വിലാപ്പുറത്തു മുള്ളായിരിക്കും; അവരുടെ ദേവന്മാർ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കണിയായും ഇരിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And I have also said, ‘I will not drive them out before you; they will become traps for you, and their gods will become snares to you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out before you; but they shall be thorns in your side, and their gods shall be a snare to you.’ "
chapters.kjv: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ ഈ വചനം എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടും പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ജനം ഉച്ചത്തിൽ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the angel of the Lord had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the Angel of the Lord spoke these words to all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voices and wept.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ബോഖീം (കരയുന്നവർ) എന്നു പേരിട്ടു; അവിടെ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then they called the name of that place Bochim; and they sacrificed there to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോശുവ ജനത്തെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു. യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ദേശം കൈവശമാക്കുവാൻ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ അവകാശത്തിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to their own inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: And when Joshua had dismissed the people, the children of Israel went each to his own inheritance to possess the land.
chapters.kjv: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

chapters.ml: യോശുവയുടെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും യോശുവ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഏറിയനാൾ ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നവരായി യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി ചെയ്ത മഹാപ്രവൃത്തികളൊക്കെയും കണ്ടിട്ടുള്ളവരായ മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും ജനം യഹോവയെ സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The people served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had seen all the great things the Lord had done for Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the Lord which He had done for Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD , that he did for Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായി നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവ നൂറ്റിപ്പത്തു വയസ്സുള്ളവനായി മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.
chapters.nkjv: Now Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died whenhewas one hundred and ten years old.
chapters.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD , died, being an hundred and ten years old.

chapters.ml: അവനെ എഫ്രയീംപർവ്വതത്തിലെ തിമ്നാത്ത്--ഹേരെസിൽ ഗായശ് മലയുടെ വടക്കുവശത്തു അവന്റെ അവകാശഭൂമിയിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
chapters.nkjv: And they buried him within the border of his inheritance at Timnath Heres, in the mountains of Ephraim, on the north side of Mount Gaash.
chapters.kjv: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ തലമുറ ഒക്കെയും തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ചേർന്നു; അവരുടെ ശേഷം യഹോവയെയും അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള പ്രവൃത്തികളെയും അറിയാത്ത വേറൊരു തലമുറ ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: After that whole generation had been gathered to their ancestors, another generation grew up who knew neither the Lord nor what he had done for Israel.
chapters.nkjv: When all that generation had been gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who did not know the Lord nor the work which He had done for Israel.
chapters.kjv: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD , nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു ബാൽവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ സേവിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord and served the Baals.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served the Baals;
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD , and served Baalim:

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ജാതികളുടെ ദേവന്മാരായ അന്യ ദൈവങ്ങളെ ചെന്നു നമസ്കരിച്ചു യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They forsook the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who had brought them out of Egypt. They followed and worshiped various gods of the peoples around them. They aroused the Lord ’s anger
chapters.nkjv: and they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt; and they followed other gods from among the gods of the people who were all around them, and they bowed down to them; and they provoked the Lord to anger.
chapters.kjv: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

chapters.ml: അവർ യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു ബാലിനെയും അസ്തൊരെത്ത് പ്രതിഷ്ഠകളെയും സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
chapters.nkjv: They forsook the Lord and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
chapters.kjv: And they forsook the LORD , and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കോപം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവരെ കവർച്ചചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ അവരെ കവർച്ചക്കാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു, ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ശത്രുക്കൾക്കു അവരെ വിറ്റുകളഞ്ഞു; ശത്രുക്കളുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നില്പാൻ അവർക്കു പിന്നെ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: In his anger against Israel the Lord gave them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.
chapters.nkjv: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel. So He delivered them into the hands of plunderers who despoiled them; and He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
chapters.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരുന്നതുപോലെയും യഹോവ അവരോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തിരുന്നതുപോലെയും യഹോവയുടെ കൈ അവർ ചെന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും അനർത്ഥം വരത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവർക്കു വിരോധമായിരുന്നു; അവർക്കു മഹാകഷ്ടം ഉണ്ടാകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Whenever Israel went out to fight, the hand of the Lord was against them to defeat them, just as he had sworn to them. They were in great distress.
chapters.nkjv: Wherever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for calamity, as the Lord had said, and as the Lord had sworn to them. And they were greatly distressed.
chapters.kjv: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ ന്യായാധിപന്മാരെ എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു; അവർ കവർച്ചക്കാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless, the Lord raised up judges who delivered them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

chapters.ml: അവരോ തങ്ങളുടെ ന്യായാധിപന്മാരെയും അനുസരിക്കാതെ അന്യദൈവങ്ങളോടു പരസംഗംചെയ്തു അവയെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു, തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ നടന്ന വഴിയിൽനിന്നു വേഗം മാറിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അവർ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനകൾ അനുസരിച്ചു നടന്നതുപോലെ നടന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet they would not listen to their judges but prostituted themselves to other gods and worshiped them. They quickly turned from the ways of their ancestors, who had been obedient to the Lord ’s commands.
chapters.nkjv: Yet they would not listen to their judges, but they played the harlot with other gods, and bowed down to them. They turned quickly from the way in which their fathers walked, in obeying the commandments of the Lord; they did not do so.
chapters.kjv: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD ; but they did not so.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവർക്കു ന്യായാധിപന്മാരെ എഴുന്നേല്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ യഹോവ അതതു ന്യായധിപനോടു കൂടെയിരുന്നു അവന്റെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും അവരെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കും; തങ്ങളെ ഉപദ്രവിച്ചു പീഡിപ്പിക്കുന്നവരുടെ നിമിത്തം ഉള്ള അവരുടെ നിലിവിളിയിങ്കൽ യഹോവെക്കു മനസ്സിലിവു തോന്നും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the Lord raised up a judge for them, he was with the judge and saved them out of the hands of their enemies as long as the judge lived; for the Lord relented because of their groaning under those who oppressed and afflicted them.
chapters.nkjv: And when the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for the Lord was moved to pity by their groaning because of those who oppressed them and harassed them.
chapters.kjv: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആ ന്യായാധിപൻ മരിച്ചശേഷം അവർ തിരിഞ്ഞു അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ ചെന്നു സേവിച്ചും നമസ്കരിച്ചും കൊണ്ടു തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെക്കാൾ അധികം വഷളത്വം പ്രവർത്തിക്കും; അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികളും ദുശ്ശാഠ്യനടപ്പും വിടാതിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But when the judge died, the people returned to ways even more corrupt than those of their ancestors, following other gods and serving and worshiping them. They refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they reverted and behaved more corruptly than their fathers, by following other gods, to serve them and bow down to them. They did not cease from their own doings nor from their stubborn way.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ കോപം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു: ഈ ജാതി അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള എന്റെ നിയമം ലംഘിച്ചു എന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കായ്കയാൽ
chapters.niv: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel and said, "Because this nation has violated the covenant I ordained for their ancestors and has not listened to me,
chapters.nkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and He said, "Because this nation has transgressed My covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not heeded My voice,
chapters.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ അനുസരിച്ചു നടന്ന യഹോവയുടെ വഴിയിൽ ഇവരും അനസരിച്ചു നടക്കുമോ ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു യിസ്രായേലിനെ പരീക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാനും,
chapters.niv: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
chapters.nkjv: I also will no longer drive out before them any of the nations which Joshua left when he died,
chapters.kjv: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

chapters.ml: യോശുവ മരിക്കുമ്പോൾ വിട്ടേച്ചുപോയ ജാതികളിൽ ഒന്നിനെയും ഇനി അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളകയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: I will use them to test Israel and see whether they will keep the way of the Lord and walk in it as their ancestors did."
chapters.nkjv: so that through them I may test Israel, whether they will keep the ways of the Lord, to walk in them as their fathers kept them, or not."
chapters.kjv: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it , or not.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവ ആ ജാതികളെ വേഗത്തിൽ നീക്കിക്കളയാതെയും യോശുവയുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കാതെയും വെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord had allowed those nations to remain; he did not drive them out at once by giving them into the hands of Joshua.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Lord left those nations, without driving them out immediately; nor did He deliver them into the hand of Joshua.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

chapters.ml: കനാനിലെ യുദ്ധങ്ങളൊന്നും അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ലാത്ത യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഒക്കെയും പരീക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും
chapters.niv: These are the nations the Lord left to test all those Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars in Canaan
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the nations which the Lord left, that He might test Israel by them, thatis, all who had not known any of the wars in Canaan
chapters.kjv: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധം അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ലാത്ത യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ തലമുറകളെ യുദ്ധം അഭ്യസിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നുമായി യഹോവ വെച്ചിരുന്ന ജാതികളാവിതു:
chapters.niv: (he did this only to teach warfare to the descendants of the Israelites who had not had previous battle experience):
chapters.nkjv: (thiswas only so that the generations of the children of Israel might be taught to know war, at least those who had not formerly known it),
chapters.kjv: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ അഞ്ചു പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും എല്ലാ കനാന്യരും സീദോന്യരും ബാൽ ഹെർമ്മോൻ പർവ്വതംമുതൽ ഹമാത്തിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രവേശനംവരെ ലെബാനോൻ പർവ്വതത്തിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന ഹിവ്യരും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.
chapters.nkjv: namely, five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who dwelt in Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
chapters.kjv: Namely , five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

chapters.ml: മോശെമുഖാന്തരം യഹോവ അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു കല്പിച്ച കല്പനകൾ അനുസരിക്കുമോ എന്നു അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേലിനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചറിവാൻ ആയിരുന്നു ഇവരെ വെച്ചിരുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: They were left to test the Israelites to see whether they would obey the Lord ’s commands, which he had given their ancestors through Moses.
chapters.nkjv: And they were left, that He might test Israel by them, to know whether they would obey the commandments of the Lord, which He had commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
chapters.kjv: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

chapters.ml: കനാന്യർ, ഹിത്യർ, അമോർയ്യർ, പെരിസ്യർ, ഹിവ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ എന്നിവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
chapters.nkjv: Thus the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പുത്രിമാരെ തങ്ങൾക്കു ഭാര്യമാരായിട്ടു എടുക്കയും തങ്ങളുടെ പുത്രിമാരെ അവരുടെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കു കൊടുക്കയും അവരുടെ ദേവന്മാരെ സേവിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
chapters.nkjv: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons; and they served their gods.
chapters.kjv: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ മറന്നു ബാൽവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും അശേരപ്രതിഷ്ഠകളെയും സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; they forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord. They forgot the Lord their God, and served the Baals and Asherahs.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD , and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ കോപം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവൻ അവരെ മെസോപൊത്താമ്യയിലെ ഒരു രാജാവായ കൂശൻ രീശാഥയീമിന്നു വിറ്റുകളഞ്ഞു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ കൂശൻ രിശാഥയീമിനെ എട്ടു സംവത്സരം സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The anger of the Lord burned against Israel so that he sold them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram Naharaim, to whom the Israelites were subject for eight years.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and He sold them into the hand of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan-Rishathaim eight years.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ യഹോവ കാലേബിന്റെ അനുജനായ കെനസിന്റെ മകൻ ഒത്നിയേലിനെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു രക്ഷകനായി എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു; അവൻ അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But when they cried out to the Lord , he raised up for them a deliverer, Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, who saved them.
chapters.nkjv: When the children of Israel cried out to the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer for the children of Israel, who delivered them: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
chapters.kjv: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD , the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മേൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു വന്നു; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ന്യായാധിപനായി യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടാറെ യഹോവ മെസോപൊത്താമ്യയിലെ രാജാവായ കൂശൻ രിശാഥയീമിനെ അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവൻ കൂശൻ രീശാഥയീമിനെ ജയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Spirit of the Lord came on him, so that he became Israel’s judge and went to war. The Lord gave Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram into the hands of Othniel, who overpowered him.
chapters.nkjv: The Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel. He went out to war, and the Lord delivered Cushan-Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed over Cushan-Rishathaim.
chapters.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തിന്നു നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം സ്വസ്ഥത ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.
chapters.nkjv: So the land had rest for forty years. Then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
chapters.kjv: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

chapters.ml: കെനസിന്റെ മകനായ ഒത്നീയേൽ മരിച്ചശേഷം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ വീണ്ടും യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; അവർ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ മോവാബ്‌രാജാവായ എഗ്ളോനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വിരോധമായി ബലപ്പെടുത്തി.
chapters.niv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , and because they did this evil the Lord gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord. So the Lord strengthened Eglon king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD : and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അമ്മോന്യരെയും അമാലേക്യരെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു യിസ്രായേലിനെ തോല്പിച്ചു, അവർ ഈന്തപട്ടണവും കൈവശമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.
chapters.nkjv: Then he gathered to himself the people of Ammon and Amalek, went and defeated Israel, and took possession of the City of Palms.
chapters.kjv: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾ മോവാബ് രാജാവായ എഗ്ളോനെ പതിനെട്ടു സംവത്സരം സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel served Eglon king of Moab eighteen years.
chapters.kjv: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾ യഹോയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ യഹോവ അവർക്കു ബെന്യാമീന്യനായ ഗേരയുടെ മകനായി ഇടങ്കയ്യനായ ഏഹൂദിനെ രക്ഷകനായി എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു; അവന്റെ കൈവശം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മോവാബ് രാജാവായ എഗ്ളോന്നു കാഴ്ച കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Again the Israelites cried out to the Lord , and he gave them a deliverer—Ehud, a left-handed man, the son of Gera the Benjamite. The Israelites sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
chapters.nkjv: But when the children of Israel cried out to the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. By him the children of Israel sent tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
chapters.kjv: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD , the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏഹൂദ്, ഇരുവായ്ത്തലയും ഒരു മുഴം നീളവും ഉള്ള ഒരു ചുരിക ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതു വസ്ത്രത്തിന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ വലത്തെ തുടെക്കു കെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Now Ehud had made a double-edged sword about a cubit long, which he strapped to his right thigh under his clothing.
chapters.nkjv: Now Ehud made himself a dagger (it was double-edged and a cubit in length) and fastened it under his clothes on his right thigh.
chapters.kjv: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മോവാബ് രാജാവായ എഗ്ളോന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കാഴ്ച കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു; എഗ്ളോൻ ഏറ്റവും സ്ഥൂലിച്ചവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.
chapters.nkjv: So he brought the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. (Now Eglon was a very fat man.)
chapters.kjv: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.

chapters.ml: കാഴ്ചവെച്ചു കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം കാഴ്ച ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു വന്നവരെ അവൻ അയച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way those who had carried it.
chapters.nkjv: And when he had finished presenting the tribute, he sent away the people who had carried the tribute.
chapters.kjv: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ ഗില്ഗാലിന്നരികെയുള്ള വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു: രാജാവേ, എനിക്കു ഒരു സ്വകാര്യം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ക്ഷമിക്ക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു; ഉടനെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നിരുന്ന എല്ലാവരും അവനെ വിട്ടു പുറത്തുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But on reaching the stone images near Gilgal he himself went back to Eglon and said, "Your Majesty, I have a secret message for you." The king said to his attendants, "Leave us!" And they all left.
chapters.nkjv: But he himself turned back from the stone images that were at Gilgal, and said, "I have a secret message for you, O king." He said, "Keep silence!" And all who attended him went out from him.
chapters.kjv: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

chapters.ml: ഏഹൂദ് അടുത്തുചെന്നു. എന്നാൽ അവൻ തന്റെ ഗ്രീഷ്മഗൃഹത്തിൽ തനിച്ചു ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു. എനിക്കു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു അറിയിപ്പാൻ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഏഹൂദ് പറഞ്ഞു; ഉടനെ അവൻ ആസനത്തിൽനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Ehud then approached him while he was sitting alone in the upper room of his palace and said, "I have a message from God for you." As the king rose from his seat,
chapters.nkjv: So Ehud came to him (now he was sitting upstairs in his cool private chamber). Then Ehud said, "I have a message from God for you." So he arose from his seat.
chapters.kjv: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ഏഹൂദ് ഇടങ്കൈ നീട്ടി വലത്തെ തുടയിൽ നിന്നു ചുരിക ഊരി അവന്റെ വയറ്റിൽ കുത്തിക്കടത്തി.
chapters.niv: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king’s belly.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ehud reached with his left hand, took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly.
chapters.kjv: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

chapters.ml: അലകോടുകൂടെ പിടിയും അകത്തു ചെന്നു; അവന്റെ വയറ്റിൽനിന്നു ചുരിക അവൻ വലിച്ചെടുക്കായ്കയാൽ മേദസ്സു അലകിന്മേൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞടെഞ്ഞു, അതു പൃഷ്ഠഭാഗത്തു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and his bowels discharged. Ehud did not pull the sword out, and the fat closed in over it.
chapters.nkjv: Even the hilt went in after the blade, and the fat closed over the blade, for he did not draw the dagger out of his belly; and his entrails came out.
chapters.kjv: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഏഹൂദ് പൂമുഖത്തു ഇറങ്ങി പുറകെ മാളികയുടെ വാതിൽ അടെച്ചുപൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Then Ehud went out to the porch ; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ehud went out through the porch and shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.
chapters.kjv: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുറത്തു ഇറങ്ങിപ്പോയശേഷം എഗ്ളോന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ വന്നു; അവർ നോക്കി മാളികയുടെ വാതിൽ പൂട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: അവൻ ഗ്രീഷ്മഗൃഹത്തിൽ വിസർജ്ജനത്തിന്നു ഇരിക്കയായിരിക്കും എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After he had gone, the servants came and found the doors of the upper room locked. They said, "He must be relieving himself in the inner room of the palace."
chapters.nkjv: When he had gone out, Eglon’s servants came to look, and totheir surprise, the doors of the upper room were locked. So they said, "He is probably attending to his needs in the cool chamber."
chapters.kjv: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

chapters.ml: അവർ കാത്തിരുന്നു വിഷമിച്ചു; അവൻ മുറിയുടെ വാതിൽ തുറക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവർ താക്കോൽ എടുത്തു തുറന്നു;
chapters.niv: They waited to the point of embarrassment, but when he did not open the doors of the room, they took a key and unlocked them. There they saw their lord fallen to the floor, dead.
chapters.nkjv: So they waited till they were embarrassed, and still he had not opened the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them. And there was their master, fallen dead on the floor.
chapters.kjv: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

chapters.ml: തമ്പുരാൻ നിലത്തു മരിച്ചുകിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു. എന്നാൽ അവർ കാത്തിരുന്നതിന്നിടയിൽ ഏഹൂദ് ഓടിപ്പോയി വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ കടന്നു സെയീരയിൽ ചെന്നുചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the stone images and escaped to Seirah.
chapters.nkjv: But Ehud had escaped while they delayed, and passed beyond the stone images and escaped to Seirah.
chapters.kjv: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ എത്തിയശേഷം അവൻ എഫ്രയീംപർവ്വതത്തിൽ കാഹളം ഊതി; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അവനോടുകൂടെ പർവ്വതത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി അവൻ അവർക്കു നായകനായി.
chapters.niv: When he arrived there, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the hills, with him leading them.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when he arrived, that he blew the trumpet in the mountains of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mountains; and he led them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുവിൻ; ശത്രുക്കളായ മോവാബ്യരെ യഹോവ നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു മോവാബിന്നു നേരെയുള്ള യോർദ്ദാന്റെ കടവുകൾ പിടിച്ചു; ആരെയും കടപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Follow me," he ordered, "for the Lord has given Moab, your enemy, into your hands." So they followed him down and took possession of the fords of the Jordan that led to Moab; they allowed no one to cross over.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to them, "Follow me, for the Lord has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand." So they went down after him, seized the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab, and did not allow anyone to cross over.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആ സമയം മോവാബ്യരിൽ ഏകദേശം പതിനായിരം പേരെ വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും ബലവാന്മാരും യുദ്ധവീരന്മാരും ആയിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not one escaped.
chapters.nkjv: And at that time they killed about ten thousand men of Moab, all stout men of valor; not a man escaped.
chapters.kjv: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തനും ചാടിപ്പോയില്ല. അങ്ങനെ ആ കാലത്തു മോവാബ് യിസ്രായേലിന്നു കീഴടങ്ങി; ദേശത്തിന്നു എണ്പതു സംവത്സരം സ്വസ്ഥതയുണ്ടാകയും ചെയ്തു..
chapters.niv: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.
chapters.nkjv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest for eighty years.
chapters.kjv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശേഷം അനാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ ശംഗർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു; അവൻ ഒരു മുടിങ്കോൽകൊണ്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരിൽ അറുനൂറുപേരെ കൊന്നു; അവനും യിസ്രായേലിനെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.
chapters.nkjv: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who killed six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad; and he also delivered Israel.
chapters.kjv: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

chapters.ml: ഏഹൂദ് മരിച്ചശേഷം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ വീണ്ടും യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , now that Ehud was dead.
chapters.nkjv: When Ehud was dead, the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD , when Ehud was dead.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവരെ ഹാസോരിൽവാണ കനാന്യരാജാവായ യാബീന്നു വിറ്റുകളഞ്ഞു; അവന്റെ സേനാപതി ജാതികളുടെ ഹരോശെത്തിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന സീസെരാ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord sold them into the hands of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. Sisera, the commander of his army, was based in Harosheth Haggoyim.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who dwelt in Harosheth Hagoyim.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു തൊള്ളായിരം ഇരിമ്പുരഥം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ ഇരുപതു സംവത്സരം കഠിനമായി ഞെരുക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Because he had nine hundred chariots fitted with iron and had cruelly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years, they cried to the Lord for help.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel cried out to the Lord; for Jabin had nine hundred chariots of iron, and for twenty years he had harshly oppressed the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ലപ്പീദോത്തിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ദെബോരാ എന്ന പ്രവാചകി യിസ്രായേലിൽ ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.
chapters.nkjv: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
chapters.kjv: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

chapters.ml: അവൾ എഫ്രയീംപർവ്വതത്തിൽ രാമെക്കും ബേഥേലിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേയുള്ള ദെബോരയുടെ ഈന്തപ്പനയുടെ കീഴിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ന്യായവിസ്താരത്തിന്നു അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുക പതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went up to her to have their disputes decided.
