chapters.nkjv: God has delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. And what was I able to do in comparison with you?" Then their anger toward him subsided when he said that.
chapters.kjv: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഗിദെയോൻ യോർദ്ദാങ്കൽ എത്തി; അവന്നും കൂടെയുള്ള മുന്നൂറുപേരും ക്ഷീണിച്ചിരുന്നിട്ടും അവരെ പിന്തുടരുവാൻ അക്കരെ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit, came to the Jordan and crossed it.
chapters.nkjv: When Gideon came to the Jordan, he and the three hundred men who were with him crossed over, exhausted but still in pursuit.
chapters.kjv: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them .

chapters.ml: അവൻ സുക്കോത്തിലെ നിവാസികളോടു എന്റെ കൂടെയുള്ള പടജ്ജനത്തിന്നു അപ്പംകൊടുക്കേണമേ; അവർ ക്ഷീണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ മിദ്യാന്യരാജാക്കന്മാരായ സേബഹിനെയും സൽമുന്നയെയും പിന്തുടരുകയാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to the men of Sukkoth, "Give my troops some bread; they are worn out, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to the men of Succoth, "Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me, for they are exhausted, and I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സൈന്യത്തിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അപ്പം കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു സേബഹിന്റെയും സൽമുന്നയുടെയും കൈകൾ നിന്റെ കക്ഷത്തിൽ ആകുന്നുവോ എന്നു സുക്കോത്തിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the officials of Sukkoth said, "Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your troops?"
chapters.nkjv: And the leaders of Succoth said, "Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?"
chapters.kjv: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഗിദെയോൻ: ആകട്ടെ; യഹോവ സേബഹിനെയും സൽമുന്നയെയും എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചശേഷം ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ മാംസം കാട്ടിലെ മുള്ളകൊണ്ടും പരക്കാരകൊണ്ടും തല്ലിക്കീറും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Gideon replied, "Just for that, when the Lord has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with desert thorns and briers."
chapters.nkjv: So Gideon said, "For this cause, when the Lord has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers!"
chapters.kjv: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

chapters.ml: അവിടെനിന്നു അവൻ പെനൂവേലിലേക്കു ചെന്നു അവരോടും അങ്ങനെ ചോദിച്ചു; സുക്കോത്ത് നിവാസികൾ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ തന്നേ പെനൂവേൽനിവാസികളും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: From there he went up to Peniel and made the same request of them, but they answered as the men of Sukkoth had.
chapters.nkjv: Then he went up from there to Penuel and spoke to them in the same way. And the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
chapters.kjv: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .

chapters.ml: അവൻ പെനൂവേൽനിവാസികളോടു: ഞാൻ സമാധാനത്തോടെ മടങ്ങിവരുമ്പോൾ ഈ ഗോപുരം ഇടിച്ചുകളയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So he said to the men of Peniel, "When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower."
chapters.nkjv: So he also spoke to the men of Penuel, saying, "When I come back in peace, I will tear down this tower!"
chapters.kjv: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സേബഹും സൽമുന്നയും അവരോടുകൂടെ കിഴക്കുദേശക്കാരുടെ സൈന്യത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്ന ഏകദേശം പതിനയ്യായിരം പേരായ അവരുടെ സൈന്യവും കർക്കോരിൽ ആയിരുന്നു; വാളൂരിപ്പിടിച്ചവരായ ലക്ഷത്തിരുപതിനായിരം പേർ വീണുപോയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with a force of about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of the armies of the eastern peoples; a hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had fallen.
chapters.nkjv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were at Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand, all who were left of all the army of the people of the East; for one hundred and twenty thousand men who drew the sword had fallen.
chapters.kjv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

chapters.ml: ഗിദെയോൻ നോബഹിന്നും യൊഗ്ബെഹെക്കും കിഴക്കുള്ള കൂടാരവാസികളുടെ വഴിയായി ചെന്നു നിർഭയമായിരുന്ന ആ സൈന്യത്തെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Gideon went up by the route of the nomads east of Nobah and Jogbehah and attacked the unsuspecting army.
chapters.nkjv: Then Gideon went up by the road of those who dwell in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah; and he attacked the army while the camp felt secure.
chapters.kjv: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

chapters.ml: സേബഹും സൽമുന്നയും ഓടിപ്പോയി; അവൻ അവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു, സേബഹ് സൽമുന്നാ എന്ന രണ്ടു മിദ്യാന്യരാജാക്കന്മാരെയും പിടിച്ചു, സൈന്യത്തെ ഒക്കെയും പേടിപ്പിച്ചു ചിതറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, fled, but he pursued them and captured them, routing their entire army.
chapters.nkjv: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued them; and he took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and routed the whole army.
chapters.kjv: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യോവാശിന്റെ മകനായ ഗിദെയോൻ യുദ്ധം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഹേരെസ് കയറ്റത്തിൽനിന്നു മടങ്ങിവരുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: Gideon son of Joash then returned from the battle by the Pass of Heres.
chapters.nkjv: Then Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle, from the Ascent of Heres.
chapters.kjv: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up ,

chapters.ml: സുക്കോത്ത നിവാസികളിൽ ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരനെ പിടിച്ചു അവനോടു അന്വേഷിച്ചു; അവൻ സുക്കോത്തിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരുമായ എഴുപത്തേഴു ആളുടെ പേർ അവന്നു എഴുതിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: He caught a young man of Sukkoth and questioned him, and the young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven officials of Sukkoth, the elders of the town.
chapters.nkjv: And he caught a young man of the men of Succoth and interrogated him; and he wrote down for him the leaders of Succoth and its elders, seventy-seven men.
chapters.kjv: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സുക്കോത്ത് നിവാസികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: ക്ഷീണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ ആളുകൾക്കു ഞങ്ങൾ അപ്പം കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു സേബഹിന്റെയും സൽമുന്നയുടെയും കൈകൾ നിന്റെ കക്ഷത്തിൽ ആകുന്നുവോ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ധിക്കരിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞ സേബഹും സൽമുന്നയും ഇതാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Gideon came and said to the men of Sukkoth, "Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me by saying, ‘Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your exhausted men?’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then he came to the men of Succoth and said, "Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you ridiculed me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your weary men?’ "
chapters.kjv: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?

chapters.ml: അവൻ പട്ടണത്തിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു കാട്ടിലെ മുള്ളും പറക്കാരയുംകൊണ്ടു സുക്കോത്ത് നിവാസികളെ ബുദ്ധിപഠിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He took the elders of the town and taught the men of Sukkoth a lesson by punishing them with desert thorns and briers.
chapters.nkjv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
chapters.kjv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പെനൂവേലിലെ ഗോപുരം ഇടിച്ചു പട്ടണക്കാരെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He also pulled down the tower of Peniel and killed the men of the town.
chapters.nkjv: Then he tore down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
chapters.kjv: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ സേബഹിനോടും സൽമുന്നയോടും: നിങ്ങൾ താബോരിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്ന പുരുഷന്മാർ എങ്ങനെയുള്ളവർ ആയിരുന്നു എന്നു ചേദിച്ചു. അവർ നിന്നെപ്പോലെ ഓരോരുത്തൻ രാജകുമാരന്നു തുല്യൻ ആയിരുന്നു എന്നു അവർ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, "What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?" "Men like you," they answered, "each one with the bearing of a prince."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, "What kind of men werethey whom you killed at Tabor?" So they answered, "As you are, so were they; each one resembled the son of a king."
chapters.kjv: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art , so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: അവർ എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ, എന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ മക്കൾ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു; അവരെ നിങ്ങൾ ജീവനോടെ വെച്ചിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, യഹോവയാണ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ കൊല്ലുകയില്ലായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Gideon replied, "Those were my brothers, the sons of my own mother. As surely as the Lord lives, if you had spared their lives, I would not kill you."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the Lord lives, if you had let them live, I would not kill you."
chapters.kjv: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ യേഥെരിനോടു: എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരെ കൊല്ലുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ അവൻ ചെറുപ്പക്കാരനാകകൊണ്ടു പേടിച്ചു വാൾ ഊരാതെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Turning to Jether, his oldest son, he said, "Kill them!" But Jether did not draw his sword, because he was only a boy and was afraid.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to Jether his firstborn, "Rise, kill them!" But the youth would not draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was still a youth.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സേബഹും സൽമുന്നയും: നീ തന്നേ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഞങ്ങളെ വെട്ടുക; ആളെപ്പോലെയല്ലോ അവന്റെ ബലം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ഗിദെയോൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സേബഹിനെയും സൽമുന്നയെയും കൊന്നു; അവരുടെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങളുടെ കഴുത്തിലെ ചന്ദ്രക്കലകൾ എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Come, do it yourself. ‘As is the man, so is his strength.’ " So Gideon stepped forward and killed them, and took the ornaments off their camels’ necks.
chapters.nkjv: So Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Rise yourself, and kill us; for as a man is, so is his strength." So Gideon arose and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescent ornaments that were on their camels’ necks.
chapters.kjv: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels’ necks.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഗിദെയോനോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളെ മിദ്യാന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്കേണം; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ നിന്റെ മകനും മകന്റെ മകനും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites said to Gideon, "Rule over us—you, your son and your grandson—because you have saved us from the hand of Midian."
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, "Rule over us, both you and your son, and your grandson also; for you have delivered us from the hand of Midian."
chapters.kjv: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.

chapters.ml: ഗിദെയോൻ അവരോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവാകയില്ല; എന്റെ മകനും ആകയില്ല; യഹോവയത്രേ നിങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Gideon told them, "I will not rule over you, nor will my son rule over you. The Lord will rule over you."
chapters.nkjv: But Gideon said to them, "I will not rule over you, nor shall my son rule over you; the Lord shall rule over you."
chapters.kjv: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഗിദെയോൻ അവരോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ഒന്നു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ ഓരോരുത്തൻ കൊള്ളയിൽ കിട്ടിയ കടുക്കൻ എനിക്കു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ യിശ്മായേല്യർ ആയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു പൊൻകടുക്കൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he said, "I do have one request, that each of you give me an earring from your share of the plunder." (It was the custom of the Ishmaelites to wear gold earrings.)
chapters.nkjv: Then Gideon said to them, "I would like to make a request of you, that each of you would give me the earrings from his plunder." For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.
chapters.kjv: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ സന്തോഷത്തോടെ തരാം എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു, ഒരു വസ്ത്രം വിരിച്ചു ഒരോരുത്തന്നു കൊള്ളയിൽ കിട്ടിയ കടുക്കൻ അതിൽ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They answered, "We’ll be glad to give them." So they spread out a garment, and each of them threw a ring from his plunder onto it.
chapters.nkjv: So they answered, "We will gladly give them." And they spread out a garment, and each man threw into it the earrings from his plunder.
chapters.kjv: And they answered, We will willingly give them . And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു വാങ്ങിയ പൊൻ കടുക്കന്റെ തൂക്കം ആയിരത്തെഴുനൂറു ശേക്കെൽ ആയിരുന്നു; ഇതല്ലാതെ ചന്ദ്രക്കലകളും കുണ്ഡലങ്ങളും മിദ്യാന്യരാജാക്കന്മാർ ധരിച്ചിരുന്ന രക്താംബരങ്ങളും അവരുടെ ഒട്ടകങ്ങളുടെ കഴുത്തിലെ മാലകളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The weight of the gold rings he asked for came to seventeen hundred shekels, not counting the ornaments, the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian or the chains that were on their camels’ necks.
chapters.nkjv: Now the weight of the gold earrings that he requested was one thousand seven hundred shekels of gold, besides the crescent ornaments, pendants, and purple robes which were on the kings of Midian, and besides the chains that were around their camels’ necks.
chapters.kjv: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

chapters.ml: ഗിദെയോൻ അതുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു എഫോദ് ഉണ്ടാക്കി തന്റെ പട്ടണമായ ഒഫ്രയിൽ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേലെല്ലാം അവിടേക്കു പരസംഗമായി അതിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; അതു ഗിദെയോന്നും അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിന്നും ഒരു കണിയായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Gideon made the gold into an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his town. All Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his family.
chapters.nkjv: Then Gideon made it into an ephod and set it up in his city, Ophrah. And all Israel played the harlot with it there. It became a snare to Gideon and to his house.
chapters.kjv: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മിദ്യാൻ തലപൊക്കാതവണ്ണം യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾക്കു കീഴടങ്ങിപ്പോയി. ഗിദെയോന്റെ കാലത്തു ദേശത്തിന്നു നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം സ്വസ്ഥതയുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Thus Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. During Gideon’s lifetime, the land had peace forty years.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted their heads no more. And the country was quiet for forty years in the days of Gideon.
chapters.kjv: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.

chapters.ml: യോവാശിന്റെ മകനായ യെരുബ്ബാൽ തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു സുഖമായി പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Jerub-Baal son of Joash went back home to live.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
chapters.kjv: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.

chapters.ml: ഗിദെയോന്നു വളരെ ഭാര്യമാരുണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു സ്വന്തമക്കളായിട്ടു തന്നേ എഴുപതു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.
chapters.nkjv: Gideon had seventy sons who were his own offspring, for he had many wives.
chapters.kjv: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

chapters.ml: ശെഖേമിലുള്ള അവന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയും അവന്നു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു. അവന്നു അബീമേലെക്ക് എന്നു അവൻ പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: His concubine, who lived in Shechem, also bore him a son, whom he named Abimelek.
chapters.nkjv: And his concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
chapters.kjv: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.

chapters.ml: യോവാശിന്റെ മകനായ ഗിദെയോൻ നല്ല വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിൽ മരിച്ചു; അവനെ അബീയേസ്രിയർക്കുള്ള ഒഫ്രയിൽ അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ യോവാശിന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
chapters.nkjv: Now Gideon the son of Joash died at a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
chapters.kjv: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

chapters.ml: ഗിദെയോൻ മരിച്ചശേഷം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ വീണ്ടും പരസംഗമായി ബാൽവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു ബാൽബെരീത്തിനെ തങ്ങൾക്കു ദേവനായി പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: No sooner had Gideon died than the Israelites again prostituted themselves to the Baals. They set up Baal-Berith as their god
chapters.nkjv: So it was, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel again played the harlot with the Baals, and made Baal-Berith their god.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baal-berith their god.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള സകലശത്രുക്കളുടെയും കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു തങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിച്ച തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ ഓർത്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: and did not remember the Lord their God, who had rescued them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.
chapters.nkjv: Thus the children of Israel did not remember the Lord their God, who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side;
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:

chapters.ml: ഗിദെയോൻ എന്ന യെരുബ്ബാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ചെയ്ത എല്ലാനന്മെക്കും തക്കവണ്ണം അവന്റെ കടുംബത്തോടു ദയ ചെയ്തതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: They also failed to show any loyalty to the family of Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) in spite of all the good things he had done for them.
chapters.nkjv: nor did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (Gideon) in accordance with the good he had done for Israel.
chapters.kjv: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely , Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യെരുബ്ബാലിന്റെ മകനായ അബീമേലെക്ക് ശെഖേമിൽ തന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവരോടും തന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ പിതൃഭവനമായ സർവ്വകുടുംബത്തോടും സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Abimelek son of Jerub-Baal went to his mother’s brothers in Shechem and said to them and to all his mother’s clan,
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem, to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

chapters.ml: യെരുബ്ബാലിന്റെ എഴുപതു പുത്രന്മാരുംകൂടെ നിങ്ങളെ ഭരിക്കുന്നതോ ഒരുത്തൻ നിങ്ങളെ ഭരിക്കുന്നതോ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഏതു നല്ലതു? ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ അസ്ഥിയും മാംസവും ആകുന്നു എന്നു ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു ശെഖേമിലെ സകലപൌരന്മാരോടും പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Ask all the citizens of Shechem, ‘Which is better for you: to have all seventy of Jerub-Baal’s sons rule over you, or just one man?’ Remember, I am your flesh and blood."
chapters.nkjv: "Please speak in the hearing of all the men of Shechem: ‘Which is better for you, that all seventy of the sons of Jerubbaal reign over you, or that one reign over you?’ Remember that I am your own flesh and bone."
chapters.kjv: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ സഹോദരന്മാർ ശെഖേമിലെ സകലപൌരന്മാരോടും ഈ വാക്കുകളൊക്കെയും അവന്നു വേണ്ടി സംസാരിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ ഹൃദയം അബീമേലെക്കിങ്കൽ ചാഞ്ഞു: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ സഹോദരനല്ലോ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the brothers repeated all this to the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelek, for they said, "He is related to us."
chapters.nkjv: And his mother’s brothers spoke all these words concerning him in the hearing of all the men of Shechem; and their heart was inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, "He is our brother."
chapters.kjv: And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ ബാൽബെരീത്തിന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽനിന്നു എഴുപതു വെള്ളിക്കാശു എടുത്തു അവന്നു കൊടുത്തു; അതിനെക്കൊണ്ടു അബീമേലെക്ക് തുമ്പുകെട്ടവരും നിസ്സാരന്മാരുമായ ആളുകളെ കൂലിക്കു വാങ്ങി അവർക്കു നായകനായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: They gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-Berith, and Abimelek used it to hire reckless scoundrels, who became his followers.
chapters.nkjv: So they gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-Berith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless men; and they followed him.
chapters.kjv: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒഫ്രയിൽ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു യെരുബ്ബാലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായി തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ എഴുപതുപേരെയും ഒരു കല്ലിന്മേൽ വെച്ചു കൊന്നു; എന്നാൽ യെരുബ്ബാലിന്റെ ഇളയമകനായ യോഥാം ഒളിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു ശേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He went to his father’s home in Ophrah and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerub-Baal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerub-Baal, escaped by hiding.
chapters.nkjv: Then he went to his father’s house at Ophrah and killed his brothers, the seventy sons of Jerubbaal, on one stone. But Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, because he hid himself.
chapters.kjv: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം ശെഖേമിലെ സകല പൌരന്മാരും മില്ലോഗൃഹമൊക്കെയും ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി ചെന്നു ശെഖേമിലെ ജ്ഞാപകസ്തംഭത്തിന്നരികെയുള്ള കരുവേലകത്തിങ്കൽവെച്ചു അബീമേലെക്കിനെ രാജാവാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then all the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo gathered beside the great tree at the pillar in Shechem to crown Abimelek king.
chapters.nkjv: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, all of Beth Millo, and they went and made Abimelech king beside the terebinth tree at the pillar that was in Shechem.
chapters.kjv: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.

chapters.ml: ഇതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു യോഥാമിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഗെരിസ്സീംമലമുകളിൽ ചെന്നു ഉച്ചത്തിൽ അവരോടു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാരേ, ദൈവം നിങ്ങളുടെ സങ്കടം കേൾക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ സങ്കടം കേൾപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: When Jotham was told about this, he climbed up on the top of Mount Gerizim and shouted to them, "Listen to me, citizens of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they told Jotham, he went and stood on top of Mount Gerizim, and lifted his voice and cried out. And he said to them: "Listen to me, you men of Shechem, That God may listen to you!
chapters.kjv: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.

chapters.ml: പണ്ടൊരിക്കൽ വൃക്ഷങ്ങൾ തങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു രാജാവിനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പോയി; അവ ഒലിവു വൃക്ഷത്തോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: One day the trees went out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Be our king.’
chapters.nkjv: "The trees once went forth to anoint a king over them. And they said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us!’
chapters.kjv: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഒലിവു വൃക്ഷം: ദൈവവും മനുഷ്യരും എന്നെ പുകഴ്ത്തുവാൻ ഹേതുവായിരിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ പുഷ്ടി ഞാൻ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു വൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെമേൽ ആടുവാൻ പോകുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But the olive tree answered, ‘Should I give up my oil, by which both gods and humans are honored, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.nkjv: But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I cease giving my oil, With which they honor God and men, And go to sway over trees?’
chapters.kjv: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങൾ അത്തിവൃക്ഷത്തോടു: നീ വന്നു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Next, the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and be our king.’
chapters.nkjv: "Then the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You come and reign over us!’
chapters.kjv: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അത്തിവൃക്ഷം: എന്റെ മധുരവും വിശേഷപ്പെട്ട പഴവും ഞാൻ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു വൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ ആടുവാൻ പോകുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I give up my fruit, so good and sweet, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.nkjv: But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I cease my sweetness and my good fruit, And go to sway over trees?’
chapters.kjv: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങൾ മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയോടു: നീ വന്നു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Then the trees said to the vine, ‘Come and be our king.’
chapters.nkjv: "Then the trees said to the vine, ‘You come and reign over us!’
chapters.kjv: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.

chapters.ml: മുന്തിരിവള്ളി അവയോടു: ദൈവത്തെയും മനുഷ്യനെയും ആനന്ദിപ്പിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ രസം ഞാൻ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു വൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെമേൽ ആടുവാൻ പോകുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But the vine answered, ‘Should I give up my wine, which cheers both gods and humans, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.nkjv: But the vine said to them, ‘Should I cease my new wine, Which cheers both God and men, And go to sway over trees?’
chapters.kjv: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളെല്ലാംകൂടെ മുൾപടർപ്പിനോടു: നീ വന്നു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and be our king.’
chapters.nkjv: "Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘You come and reign over us!’
chapters.kjv: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.

chapters.ml: മുൾപടർപ്പു വൃക്ഷങ്ങളോടു: നിങ്ങൾ യഥാർത്ഥമായി എന്നെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായി അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്യുന്നു എങ്കിൽ വന്നു എന്റെ നിഴലിൽ ആശ്രയിപ്പിൻ; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മുൾപടർപ്പിൽനിന്നു തീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ലെബാനോനിലെ ദേവദാരുക്കളെ ദഹിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The thornbush said to the trees, ‘If you really want to anoint me king over you, come and take refuge in my shade; but if not, then let fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon!’
chapters.nkjv: And the bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me as king over you, Then come and take shelter in my shade; But if not, let fire come out of the bramble And devour the cedars of Lebanon!’
chapters.kjv: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ അബീമേലെക്കിനെ രാജാവാക്കിയതിൽ വിശ്വസ്തതയും പരമാർത്ഥതയുമാകുന്നുവോ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചതു? നിങ്ങൾ യെരുബ്ബാലിനോടും അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തോടും നന്മയാകുന്നുവോ ചെയ്തതു? അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിയുടെ യോഗ്യതെക്കു തക്കവണ്ണമോ അവനോടു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചതു?
chapters.niv: "Have you acted honorably and in good faith by making Abimelek king? Have you been fair to Jerub-Baal and his family? Have you treated him as he deserves?
chapters.nkjv: "Now therefore, if you have acted in truth and sincerity in making Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him as he deserves—
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അപ്പൻ തന്റെ ജീവനെ ഗണ്യമാക്കാതെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു മിദ്യാന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു നിങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കെ
chapters.niv: Remember that my father fought for you and risked his life to rescue you from the hand of Midian.
chapters.nkjv: for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;
chapters.kjv: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു വിരോധമായി എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ എഴുപതുപേരെയും ഒരു കല്ലിന്മേൽവെച്ചു കൊല്ലുകയും അവന്റെ ദാസിയുടെ മകനായ അബീമേലെക്ക് നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരൻ ആയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവനെ ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാർക്കു രാജാവാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: But today you have revolted against my father’s family. You have murdered his seventy sons on a single stone and have made Abimelek, the son of his female slave, king over the citizens of Shechem because he is related to you.
chapters.nkjv: but you have risen up against my father’s house this day, and killed his seventy sons on one stone, and made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother—
chapters.kjv: And ye are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു യെരുബ്ബാലിനോടും അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തോടും ചെയ്തതു വിശ്വസ്തതയും പരമാർത്ഥതയും എന്നുവരികിൽ നിങ്ങൾ അബീമേലെക്കിൽ സന്തോഷിപ്പിൻ; അവൻ നിങ്ങളിലും സന്തോഷിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: So have you acted honorably and in good faith toward Jerub-Baal and his family today? If you have, may Abimelek be your joy, and may you be his, too!
chapters.nkjv: if then you have acted in truth and sincerity with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you.
chapters.kjv: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:

chapters.ml: അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അബീമേലെക്കിൽനിന്നു തീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാരെയും മില്ലോഗൃഹത്തെയും ദഹിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ; ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാരിൽനിന്നും മില്ലോഗൃഹത്തിൽനിന്നും തീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അബീമേലെക്കിനെയും ദഹിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: But if you have not, let fire come out from Abimelek and consume you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and let fire come out from you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and consume Abimelek!"
chapters.nkjv: "But if not, let fire come from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and Beth Millo; and let fire come from the men of Shechem and from Beth Millo and devour Abimelech!"
chapters.kjv: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു യോഥാം ഓടിപ്പോയി ബേരിലേക്കു ചെന്നു തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബീമേലെക്കിനെ പേടിച്ചു അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelek.
chapters.nkjv: And Jotham ran away and fled; and he went to Beer and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
chapters.kjv: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

chapters.ml: അബിമേലെക്ക് യിസ്രായേലിനെ മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം ഭരിച്ചശേഷം
chapters.niv: After Abimelek had governed Israel three years,
chapters.nkjv: After Abimelech had reigned over Israel three years,
chapters.kjv: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അബീമേലെക്കിന്നും ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാർക്കും തമ്മിൽ ഛിദ്രബുദ്ധി വരുത്തി; ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാർ അബീമേലെക്കിനോടു ദ്രോഹം തുടങ്ങി;
chapters.niv: God stirred up animosity between Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem so that they acted treacherously against Abimelek.
chapters.nkjv: God sent a spirit of ill will between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
chapters.kjv: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യെരുബ്ബാലിന്റെ എഴുപതു പുത്രന്മാരോടും ചെയ്ത പാതകത്തിന്നു പ്രതികാരം വരികയും അവരുടെ രക്തം അവരെ കൊന്നവനായ അവരുടെ സഹോദരൻ അബീമേലെക്കും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അവന്നു തുണയായിരുന്ന ശെഖേം പൌരന്മാരും ചുമക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: God did this in order that the crime against Jerub-Baal’s seventy sons, the shedding of their blood, might be avenged on their brother Abimelek and on the citizens of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
chapters.nkjv: that the crime done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might be settled and their blood be laid on Abimelech their brother, who killed them, and on the men of Shechem, who aided him in the killing of his brothers.
chapters.kjv: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.

chapters.ml: ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാർ മലമുകളിൽ അവന്നു വിരോധമായി പതിയിരിപ്പുകാരെ ആക്കി, ഇവർ തങ്ങളുടെ സമീപത്തുകൂടി വഴിപേുകന്ന എല്ലാവരോടും കവർച്ച തുടങ്ങി; ഇതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അബീമേലെക്കിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: In opposition to him these citizens of Shechem set men on the hilltops to ambush and rob everyone who passed by, and this was reported to Abimelek.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Shechem set men in ambush against him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who passed by them along that way; and it was told Abimelech.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഏബെദിന്റെ മകനായ ഗാലും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും വന്നു ശെഖേമിൽ കടന്നു; ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാർ അവനെ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.
chapters.nkjv: Now Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
chapters.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

chapters.ml: അവർ വയലിൽ ചെന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളിലെ കുല അറുത്തു ഉത്സവം കൊണ്ടാടി; തങ്ങളുടെ ദേവന്റെ ക്ഷേത്ത്രിൽ ചെന്നു തിന്നുകുടിക്കയും അബീമേലെക്കിനെ ശപിക്കയും ചെയ്തു
chapters.niv: After they had gone out into the fields and gathered the grapes and trodden them, they held a festival in the temple of their god. While they were eating and drinking, they cursed Abimelek.
chapters.nkjv: So they went out into the fields, and gathered grapes from their vineyards and trod them, and made merry. And they went into the house of their god, and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.
chapters.kjv: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes , and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

chapters.ml: ഏബെദിന്റെ മകനായ ഗാൽ പറഞ്ഞതു: അബീമേലെക്കിനെ നാം സേവിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ആർ? ശെഖേം ആർ? അവൻ യെരുബ്ബാലിന്റെ മകനും സെബൂൽ അവന്റെ കാര്യസ്ഥനും അല്ലയോ? അവൻ ശെഖേമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹാമോരിന്റെ ആളുകളുമായി അവനെ സേവിക്കട്ടെ; നാം അവനെ സേവിക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelek, and why should we Shechemites be subject to him? Isn’t he Jerub-Baal’s son, and isn’t Zebul his deputy? Serve the family of Hamor, Shechem’s father! Why should we serve Abimelek?
chapters.nkjv: Then Gaal the son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Ishe not the son of Jerubbaal, and isnot Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem; but why should we serve him?
chapters.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

chapters.ml: ഈ ജനം എന്റെ കൈക്കീഴായിരുന്നെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ അബീമേലെക്കിനെ നീക്കിക്കളകയും അബീമേലെക്കിനോടു: നിന്റെ സൈന്യത്തെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരിക എന്നു പറകയും ചെയ്യുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: If only this people were under my command! Then I would get rid of him. I would say to Abimelek, ‘Call out your whole army!’ "
chapters.nkjv: If only this people were under my authority! Then I would remove Abimelech." So he said to Abimelech, "Increase your army and come out!"
chapters.kjv: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.

chapters.ml: ഏബേദിന്റെ മകനായ ഗാലിന്റെ വാക്കുകളെ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ നഗരാധിപനായ സെബൂലിന്റെ കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Zebul the governor of the city heard what Gaal son of Ebed said, he was very angry.
chapters.nkjv: When Zebul, the ruler of the city, heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was aroused.
chapters.kjv: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രഹസ്യമായിട്ടു അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: ഇതാ, ഏബെദിന്റെ മകനായ ഗാലും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും ശെഖേമിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ പട്ടണത്തെ നിന്നോടു മത്സരപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Under cover he sent messengers to Abimelek, saying, "Gaal son of Ebed and his clan have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
chapters.nkjv: And he sent messengers to Abimelech secretly, saying, "Take note! Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and here they are, fortifying the city against you.
chapters.kjv: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീയും നിന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള പടജ്ജനവും രാത്രിയിൽ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വയലിൽ പതിയിരിന്നുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Now then, during the night you and your men should come and lie in wait in the fields.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, get up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ സൂര്യൻ ഉദിക്കുമ്പോൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പട്ടണത്തെ ആക്രമിക്ക; എന്നാൽ അവനും കൂടെയുള്ള പടജ്ജനവും നിന്റെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ തരംപോലെ അവരോടു പ്രവർത്തിക്കാം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the morning at sunrise, advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, seize the opportunity to attack them."
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be, as soon as the sun is up in the morning, that you shall rise early and rush upon the city; and when he and the people who are with him come out against you, you may then do to them as you find opportunity."
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അബീമേലെക്കും കൂടെയുള്ള പടജ്ജനമൊക്കെയും രാത്രിയിൽ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശെഖേമിന്നരികെ നാലു കൂട്ടമായി പതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Abimelek and all his troops set out by night and took up concealed positions near Shechem in four companies.
chapters.nkjv: So Abimelech and all the people who were with him rose by night, and lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

chapters.ml: ഏബെദിന്റെ മകനായ ഗാൽ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ ഗോപുരത്തിങ്കൽ നിന്നപ്പോൾ അബീമേലെക്കും കൂടെ ഉള്ള പടജ്ജനവും പതിയിരിപ്പിൽനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Now Gaal son of Ebed had gone out and was standing at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelek and his troops came out from their hiding place.
chapters.nkjv: When Gaal the son of Ebed went out and stood in the entrance to the city gate, Abimelech and the people who were with him rose from lying in wait.
chapters.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.

chapters.ml: ഗാൽ പടജ്ജനത്തെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: അതാ, പർവ്വതങ്ങളുടെ മകളിൽനിന്നു പടജ്ജനം ഇറങ്ങിവരുന്നു എന്നു സെബൂലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. സെബൂൽ അവനോടു: പർവ്വതങ്ങളുടെ നിഴൽ കണ്ടിട്ടു മനുഷ്യരെന്നു നിനക്കു തോന്നുകയാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Gaal saw them, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains!" Zebul replied, "You mistake the shadows of the mountains for men."
chapters.nkjv: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains!" But Zebul said to him, "You see the shadows of the mountains as iftheywere men."
chapters.kjv: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.

chapters.ml: ഗാൽ പിന്നെയും: അതാ, പടജ്ജനം ദേശമദ്ധ്യേ ഇറങ്ങിവരുന്നു; മറ്റൊരു കൂട്ടവും പ്രാശ്നികന്മാരുടെ കരുവേലകത്തിന്റെ സമീപത്തുകൂടി വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Gaal spoke up again: "Look, people are coming down from the central hill, and a company is coming from the direction of the diviners’ tree."
chapters.nkjv: So Gaal spoke again and said, "See, people are coming down from the center of the land, and another company is coming from the Diviners’ Terebinth Tree."
chapters.kjv: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.

chapters.ml: സെബൂൽ അവനോടു: നാം അബീമേലെക്കിനെ സേവിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ആരെന്നു പറഞ്ഞ നിന്റെ വായ് ഇപ്പോൾ എവിടെ? ഇതു നീ പുച്ഛിച്ച പടജ്ജനം അല്ലയോ? ഇപ്പോൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അവരോടു പെരുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Zebul said to him, "Where is your big talk now, you who said, ‘Who is Abimelek that we should be subject to him?’ Aren’t these the men you ridiculed? Go out and fight them!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Zebul said to him, "Where indeed is your mouth now, with which you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Are not these the people whom you despised? Go out, if you will, and fight with them now."
chapters.kjv: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഗാൽ ശെഖേംപൌരന്മാരുമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു അബീമേലക്കിനോടു പടവെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: So Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelek.
chapters.nkjv: So Gaal went out, leading the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
chapters.kjv: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ അവൻ തോറ്റോടി; അവൻ അവനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു പടിവാതിൽവരെ അനേകംപേർ ഹതന്മാരായി വീണു.
chapters.niv: Abimelek chased him all the way to the entrance of the gate, and many were killed as they fled.
chapters.nkjv: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled from him; and many fell wounded, to the very entrance of the gate.
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് അരൂമയിൽ താമസിച്ചു; സെബൂൽ ഗാലിനെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും ശെഖേമിൽ പാർപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിക്കാതെ അവിടെനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Abimelek stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his clan out of Shechem.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech dwelt at Arumah, and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, so that they would not dwell in Shechem.
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ജനം വയലിലേക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അബീമേലെക്കിന്നു അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: The next day the people of Shechem went out to the fields, and this was reported to Abimelek.
chapters.nkjv: And it came about on the next day that the people went out into the field, and they told Abimelech.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പടജ്ജനത്തെ കൂട്ടി മൂന്നു കൂട്ടമായി ഭാഗിച്ചു വയലിൽ പതിയിരുന്നു; ജനം പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരുന്നതു കണ്ടു അവരുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു അവരെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he took his men, divided them into three companies and set an ambush in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose to attack them.
chapters.nkjv: So he took his people, divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the field. And he looked, and there were the people, coming out of the city; and he rose against them and attacked them.
chapters.kjv: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അബീമേലെക്കും കൂടെയുള്ള കൂട്ടവും പാഞ്ഞുചെന്നു പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു; മറ്റെ കൂട്ടം രണ്ടും വയലിലുള്ള സകലജനത്തിന്റെയും നേരെ പാഞ്ഞുചെന്നു അവരെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abimelek and the companies with him rushed forward to a position at the entrance of the city gate. Then two companies attacked those in the fields and struck them down.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech and the company that was with him rushed forward and stood at the entrance of the gate of the city; and the other two companies rushed upon all who were in the fields and killed them.
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് അന്നു മുഴുവനും പട്ടണത്തോടു പൊരുതു പട്ടണം പിടിച്ചു അതിലെ ജനത്തെ കൊന്നു, പട്ടണത്തെ ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു അതിൽ ഉപ്പു വിതറി.
chapters.niv: All that day Abimelek pressed his attack against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he destroyed the city and scattered salt over it.
chapters.nkjv: So Abimelech fought against the city all that day; he took the city and killed the people who were in it; and he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

chapters.ml: ശെഖേംഗോപുരവാസികൾ എല്ലാവരും ഇതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ ഏൽബെരീത്തിന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രമണ്ഡപത്തിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: On hearing this, the citizens in the tower of Shechem went into the stronghold of the temple of El-Berith.
chapters.nkjv: Now when all the men of the tower of Shechem had heard that, they entered the stronghold of the temple of the god Berith.
chapters.kjv: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that , they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.

chapters.ml: ശെഖേംഗോപുരവാസികൾ എല്ലാവരും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അബീമേലെക്കിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When Abimelek heard that they had assembled there,
chapters.nkjv: And it was told Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
chapters.kjv: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്കും കൂടെയുള്ള പടജ്ജനമൊക്കെയും സല്മോൻ മലയിൽ കയറി; അബീമേലെക്ക് കോടാലി എടുത്തു ഒരു മരക്കൊമ്പു വെട്ടി ചുമലിൽ വെച്ചു, തന്റെ പടജ്ജനത്തോടു: ഞാൻ ചെയ്തതു നോക്കി നിങ്ങളും വേഗം അതുപോലെ ചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he and all his men went up Mount Zalmon. He took an ax and cut off some branches, which he lifted to his shoulders. He ordered the men with him, "Quick! Do what you have seen me do!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him. And Abimelech took an ax in his hand and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it and laid it on his shoulder; then he said to the people who were with him, "What you have seen me do, make haste and do as I havedone."
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done .

chapters.ml: പടജ്ജനമെല്ലാം അതുപോലെ ഓരോരുത്തൻ ഓരോ കൊമ്പു വെട്ടി അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു മണ്ഡപത്തിന്നരികെ ഇട്ടു തീ കൊടുത്തു മണ്ഡപത്തോടു കൂടെ അവരെ ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ശെഖേംഗോപുരവാസികളൊക്കെയും പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളുമായി ഏകദേശം ആയിരം പേർ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: So all the men cut branches and followed Abimelek. They piled them against the stronghold and set it on fire with the people still inside. So all the people in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women, also died.
chapters.nkjv: So each of the people likewise cut down his own bough and followed Abimelech, put them against the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire above them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died, about a thousand men and women.
chapters.kjv: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അബീമേലെക്ക് തേബെസിലേക്കു ചെന്നു തേബെസിന്നു വിരോധമായി പാളയമിറങ്ങി അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Next Abimelek went to Thebez and besieged it and captured it.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, and he encamped against Thebez and took it.
chapters.kjv: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണത്തിന്നകത്തു ഉറപ്പുള്ള ഒരു ഗോപുരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവിടേക്കു സകലപുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളും പട്ടണത്തിലുള്ളവർ ഒക്കെയും ഓടിക്കടന്നു വാതിൽ അടെച്ചു ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ മുകളിൽ കയറി.
chapters.niv: Inside the city, however, was a strong tower, to which all the men and women—all the people of the city—had fled. They had locked themselves in and climbed up on the tower roof.
chapters.nkjv: But there was a strong tower in the city, and all the men and women—all the people of the city—fled there and shut themselves in; then they went up to the top of the tower.
chapters.kjv: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് ഗോപുരത്തിന്നരികെ എത്തി അതിനെ ആക്രമിച്ചു; അതിന്നു തീ കൊടുത്തു ചുട്ടുകളയേണ്ടതിന്നു ഗോപുരവാതിലിന്നടുത്തു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abimelek went to the tower and attacked it. But as he approached the entrance to the tower to set it on fire,
chapters.nkjv: So Abimelech came as far as the tower and fought against it; and he drew near the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
chapters.kjv: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ തിരികല്ലിന്റെ പിള്ള അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ തലയിൽ ഇട്ടു അവന്റെ തലയോടു തകർത്തുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head and cracked his skull.
chapters.nkjv: But a certain woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head and crushed his skull.
chapters.kjv: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവൻ തന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനായ ബാല്യക്കാരനെ വിളിച്ചു: ഒരു സ്ത്രീ എന്നെ കൊന്നു എന്നു പറയാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്റെ വാൾ ഊരി എന്നെ കൊല്ലുക എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. അവന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരൻ അവനെ കുത്തി, അങ്ങനെ അവൻ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Hurriedly he called to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and kill me, so that they can’t say, ‘A woman killed him.’ " So his servant ran him through, and he died.
chapters.nkjv: Then he called quickly to the young man, his armorbearer, and said to him, "Draw your sword and kill me, lest men say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ " So his young man thrust him through, and he died.
chapters.kjv: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേല്യർ താന്താങ്ങളുടെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When the Israelites saw that Abimelek was dead, they went home.
chapters.nkjv: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed, every man to his place.
chapters.kjv: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്ക് തന്റെ എഴുപതു സഹോദരന്മാരെ കൊന്നതിനാൽ തന്റെ അപ്പനോടു ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള പാതകത്തിന്നു ദൈവം ഇങ്ങനെ പകരം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Thus God repaid the wickedness that Abimelek had done to his father by murdering his seventy brothers.
chapters.nkjv: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he had done to his father by killing his seventy brothers.
chapters.kjv: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

chapters.ml: ശെഖേംനിവാസികളുടെ സകലപാതകങ്ങളും ദൈവം അവരുടെ തലമേൽ വരുത്തി; അങ്ങനെ യെരുബ്ബാലിന്റെ മകനായ യോഥാമിന്റെ ശാപം അവരുടെമേൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: God also made the people of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.
chapters.nkjv: And all the evil of the men of Shechem God returned on their own heads, and on them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
chapters.kjv: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

chapters.ml: അബീമേലെക്കിന്റെ ശേഷം ദോദോവിന്റെ മകനായ പൂവാവിന്റെ മകൻ തോലാ എന്ന യിസ്സാഖാർഗോത്രക്കാരൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു; എഫ്രയീംനാട്ടിലെ ശാമീരിൽ ആയിരുന്നു അവൻ പാർത്തതു.
chapters.niv: After the time of Abimelek, a man of Issachar named Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.nkjv: After Abimelech there arose to save Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in the mountains of Ephraim.
chapters.kjv: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഇരുപത്തുമൂന്നു സംവത്സരം ന്യായാധിപനായിരുന്ന ശേഷം മരിച്ചു; ശാമീരിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.
chapters.nkjv: He judged Israel twenty-three years; and he died and was buried in Shamir.
chapters.kjv: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശേഷം ഗിലെയാദ്യനായ യായീർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഇരുപത്തുരണ്ടു സംവത്സരം ന്യായാധിപനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was followed by Jair of Gilead, who led Israel twenty-two years.
chapters.nkjv: After him arose Jair, a Gileadite; and he judged Israel twenty-two years.
chapters.kjv: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു മുപ്പതു കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറി ഓടിക്കുന്ന മുപ്പതു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർക്കു മുപ്പതു ഊരുകളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവെക്കു ഇന്നുവരെയും ഹവ്വോത്ത്--യായീർ എന്നു പേർ പറയുന്നു; അവ ഗിലെയാദ് ദേശത്തു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had thirty sons, who rode thirty donkeys. They controlled thirty towns in Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth Jair.
chapters.nkjv: Now he had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys; they also had thirty towns, which are called "Havoth Jair" to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

chapters.ml: യായീർ മരിച്ചു കാമോനിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
chapters.nkjv: And Jair died and was buried in Camon.
chapters.kjv: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പിന്നെയും യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു ബാൽ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും അസ്തോരെത്ത് പ്രതിഷ്ഠകളെയും അരാമ്യദേവന്മാരെയും സീദോന്യദേവന്മാരെയും മോവാബ്യദേവന്മാരെയും അമ്മോന്യദേവന്മാരെയും ഫെലിസ്ത്യദേവന്മാരെയും സേവിച്ചു, യഹോവയെ സേവിക്കാതെ അവനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord . They served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites and the gods of the Philistines. And because the Israelites forsook the Lord and no longer served him,
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the people of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines; and they forsook the Lord and did not serve Him.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD , and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD , and served not him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ കോപം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു, അവൻ അവരെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിലും അമ്മോന്യരുടെ കയ്യിലും ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: he became angry with them. He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and the Ammonites,
chapters.nkjv: So the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the people of Ammon.
chapters.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: അവർ അന്നുമുതൽ പതിനെട്ടു സംവത്സരത്തോളം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ ഗിലെയാദ് എന്ന അമോർയ്യദേശത്തുള്ള എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെയും തന്നേ ഉപദ്രവിച്ചു ഞെരുക്കി.
chapters.niv: who that year shattered and crushed them. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites on the east side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.
chapters.nkjv: From that year they harassed and oppressed the children of Israel for eighteen years—all the children of Israel who were on the other side of the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, in Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യർ യെഹൂദയോടും ബെന്യാമീനോടും എഫ്രയീംഗൃഹത്തോടും യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേൽ വളരെ കഷ്ടത്തിൽ ആയി.
chapters.niv: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin and Ephraim; Israel was in great distress.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the people of Ammon crossed over the Jordan to fight against Judah also, against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was severely distressed.
chapters.kjv: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾ യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു: ഞങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവത്തെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയും ബാൽ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ സേവിക്കയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു നിന്നോടു പാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord , "We have sinned against you, forsaking our God and serving the Baals."
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel cried out to the Lord, saying, "We have sinned against You, because we have both forsaken our God and served the Baals!"
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD , saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: മിസ്രയീമ്യർ, അമോർയ്യർ, അമ്മോന്യർ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ എന്നിവരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: The Lord replied, "When the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines,
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord said to the children of Israel, "DidI not deliveryou from the Egyptians and from the Amorites and from the people of Ammon and from the Philistines?
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

chapters.ml: സീദോന്യരും അമാലേക്യരും മാവോന്യരും നിങ്ങളെ ഞെരുക്കി; നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: the Sidonians, the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you and you cried to me for help, did I not save you from their hands?
chapters.nkjv: Also the Sidonians and Amalekites and Maonites oppressed you; and you cried out to Me, and I delivered you from their hand.
chapters.kjv: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ സേവിച്ചു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഇനി ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.
chapters.nkjv: Yet you have forsaken Me and served other gods. Therefore I will deliver you no more.
chapters.kjv: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിട്ടുള്ള ദേവന്മാരോടു നിലവിളിപ്പിൻ; അവർ നിങ്ങളുടെ കഷ്ടകാലത്തു നിങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you when you are in trouble!"
chapters.nkjv: "Go and cry out to the gods which you have chosen; let them deliver you in your time of distress."
chapters.kjv: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവയോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ പാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെയൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങളോടു ചെയ്തുകൊൾക; ഇന്നു മാത്രം ഞങ്ങളെ വിടുവിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the Israelites said to the Lord , "We have sinned. Do with us whatever you think best, but please rescue us now."
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, "We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems best to You; only deliver us this day, we pray."
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD , We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു. യഹോവയെ സേവിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ അരിഷ്ടതയിൽ അവന്നു സഹതാപം തോന്നി.
chapters.niv: Then they got rid of the foreign gods among them and served the Lord . And he could bear Israel’s misery no longer.
chapters.nkjv: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the Lord. And His soul could no longer endure the misery of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

chapters.ml: അന്നേരം അമ്മോന്യർ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി ഗിലെയാദിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി; യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളും ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി മിസ്പയിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.
chapters.nkjv: Then the people of Ammon gathered together and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled together and encamped in Mizpah.
chapters.kjv: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ജനവും തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ: അമ്മോന്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ആരംഭിക്കുന്നവൻ ആർ? അവൻ ഗിലെയാദിലെ സകലനിവാസികൾക്കും തലവനാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The leaders of the people of Gilead said to each other, "Whoever will take the lead in attacking the Ammonites will be head over all who live in Gilead."
chapters.nkjv: And the people, the leaders of Gilead, said to one another, "Who is the man who will begin the fight against the people of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
chapters.kjv: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദ്യനായ യിഫ്താഹ് പരാക്രമശാലി എങ്കിലും വേശ്യാപുത്രൻ ആയിരുന്നു; യിഫ്താഹിന്റെ ജനകനോ ഗിലെയാദ് ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. His father was Gilead; his mother was a prostitute.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor, but he was the son of a harlot; and Gilead begot Jephthah.
chapters.kjv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ ഭാര്യയും അവന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ വളർന്നശേഷം അവർ യിഫ്താഹിനോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽ അവകാശം പ്രാപിക്കയില്ല; നീ പരസ്ത്രീയുടെ മകനല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Gilead’s wife also bore him sons, and when they were grown up, they drove Jephthah away. "You are not going to get any inheritance in our family," they said, "because you are the son of another woman."
chapters.nkjv: Gilead’s wife bore sons; and when his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out, and said to him, "You shall have no inheritance in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman."
chapters.kjv: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിഫ്താഹ് തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ വിട്ടു തോബ് ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു പാർത്തു; നിസ്സാരന്മാരായ ചിലർ യിഫ്താഹിനോടു ചേർന്നു അവനുമായി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where a gang of scoundrels gathered around him and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and dwelt in the land of Tob; and worthless men banded together with Jephthah and went out raiding with him.
chapters.kjv: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

chapters.ml: കുറെക്കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അമ്മോന്യർ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Some time later, when the Ammonites were fighting against Israel,
chapters.nkjv: It came to pass after a time that the people of Ammon made war against Israel.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യർ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധം തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ ഗിലെയാദിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ യിഫ്താഹിനെ തോബ് ദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when the people of Ammon made war against Israel, that the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
chapters.kjv: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

chapters.ml: അവർ യിഫ്താഹിനോടു: അമ്മോന്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ വന്നു ഞങ്ങളുടെ സേനാപതിയായിരിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Come," they said, "be our commander, so we can fight the Ammonites."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to Jephthah, "Come and be our commander, that we may fight against the people of Ammon."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: യിഫ്താഹ് ഗിലെയാദ്യരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ പകെച്ചു പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽ നിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞില്ലയോ? ഇപ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ കഷ്ടത്തിൽ ആയ സമയം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എന്തിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jephthah said to them, "Didn’t you hate me and drive me from my father’s house? Why do you come to me now, when you’re in trouble?"
chapters.nkjv: So Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "Did you not hate me, and expel me from my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?"
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ യിഫ്താഹിനോടു: നീ ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ വന്നു അമ്മോന്യരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്കയും ഗിലെയാദിലെ സകല നിവാസികൾക്കും തലവനായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഇങ്ങോട്ടു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The elders of Gilead said to him, "Nevertheless, we are turning to you now; come with us to fight the Ammonites, and you will be head over all of us who live in Gilead."
chapters.nkjv: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "That is why we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight against the people of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
chapters.kjv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

chapters.ml: യിഫ്താഹ് ഗിലെയാദിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാരോടു: അമ്മോന്യരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ കൊണ്ടുപോയിട്ടു യഹോവ അവരെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ തലവനാക്കുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jephthah answered, "Suppose you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the Lord gives them to me—will I really be your head?"
chapters.nkjv: So Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "If you take me back home to fight against the people of Ammon, and the Lord delivers them to me, shall I be your head?"
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ യിഫ്താഹിനോടു: യഹോവ നമ്മുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ സാക്ഷി; നീ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ഞങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The elders of Gilead replied, "The Lord is our witness; we will certainly do as you say."
chapters.nkjv: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "The Lord will be a witness between us, if we do not do according to your words."
chapters.kjv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിഫ്താഹ് ഗിലെയാദിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാരോടുകൂടെ പോയി; ജനം അവനെ തലവനും സേനാപതിയുമാക്കി; യിഫ്താഹ് മിസ്പയിൽവെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ തന്റെ കാര്യമെല്ലാം പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them. And he repeated all his words before the Lord in Mizpah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them; and Jephthah spoke all his words before the Lord in Mizpah.
chapters.kjv: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിഫ്താഹ് അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: നീ എന്നോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ എന്റെ ദേശത്തു വരേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നോടു നിനക്കെന്തു കാര്യം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the Ammonite king with the question: "What do you have against me that you have attacked my country?"
chapters.nkjv: Now Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the people of Ammon, saying, "What do you have against me, that you have come to fight against me in my land?"
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവു യിഫ്താഹിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരോടു: യിസ്രായേൽ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നപ്പോൾ അവർ അർന്നോൻ മുതൽ യബ്ബോക്വരെയും യോർദ്ദാൻ വരെയും ഉള്ള എന്റെ ദേശം അടക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ; ഇപ്പോൾ ആ ദേശങ്ങളെ സമാധാനത്തോടെ മടക്കിത്തരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah’s messengers, "When Israel came up out of Egypt, they took away my land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, all the way to the Jordan. Now give it back peaceably."
chapters.nkjv: And the king of the people of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, "Because Israel took away my land when they came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore, restore those lands peaceably."
chapters.kjv: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.

chapters.ml: യിഫ്താഹ് പിന്നെയും അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Jephthah sent back messengers to the Ammonite king,
chapters.nkjv: So Jephthah again sent messengers to the king of the people of Ammon,
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

chapters.ml: അവനോടു പറയിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ: യിഫ്താഹ് ഇപ്രകാരം പറയുന്നു;
chapters.niv: saying: "This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: and said to him, "Thus says Jephthah: ‘Israel did not take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the people of Ammon;
chapters.kjv: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ മോവാബ് ദേശമോ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ ദേശമോ അടക്കീട്ടില്ല. യിസ്രായേൽ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു മരുഭൂമിയിൽകൂടി ചെങ്കടൽവരെ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു കാദേശിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: But when they came up out of Egypt, Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea and on to Kadesh.
chapters.nkjv: for when Israel came up from Egypt, they walked through the wilderness as far as the Red Sea and came to Kadesh.
chapters.kjv: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ എദോം രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ദേശത്തുകൂടി കടന്നുപോകുവാൻ അനുവാദം തരേണമെന്നു പറയിച്ചു എങ്കിലും എദോംരാജാവു കേട്ടില്ല; മോവാബ് രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കലും അവർ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു, അവനും സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല; അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽ കാദേശിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Give us permission to go through your country,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. They sent also to the king of Moab, and he refused. So Israel stayed at Kadesh.
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, "Please let me pass through your land." But the king of Edom would not heed. And in like manner they sent to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel remained in Kadesh.
chapters.kjv: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

chapters.ml: അവർ മരുഭൂമിയിൽകൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു എദോംദേശവും മോവാബ്ദേശവും ചുറ്റിച്ചെന്നു മോവാബ് ദേശത്തിന്റെ കിഴക്കു എത്തി അർന്നോന്നക്കരെ പാളയമിറങ്ങി; അർന്നോൻ മോവാബിന്റെ അതിരായിരുന്നു. മോവാബിന്റെ അതിർക്കകത്തു അവർ കടന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Next they traveled through the wilderness, skirted the lands of Edom and Moab, passed along the eastern side of the country of Moab, and camped on the other side of the Arnon. They did not enter the territory of Moab, for the Arnon was its border.
chapters.nkjv: And they went along through the wilderness and bypassed the land of Edom and the land of Moab, came to the east side of the land of Moab, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon. But they did not enter the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
chapters.kjv: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യിസ്രായേൽ ഹെശ്ബോനിൽ വാണിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യരാജാവായ സീഹോന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: നിന്റെ ദേശത്തുകൂടി എന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു കടന്നുപോകുവാൻ അനുവാദം തരേണമെന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, ‘Let us pass through your country to our own place.’
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, "Please let us pass through your land into our place."
chapters.kjv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും സീഹോൻ യിസ്രായേൽ തന്റെ ദേശത്തുകൂടി കടന്നുപോകുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവരെ വിശ്വസിക്കാതെ തന്റെ ജനത്തെ ഒക്കെയും വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി, യഹസിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി യിസ്രായേലിനോടു പടയേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Sihon, however, did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. He mustered all his troops and encamped at Jahaz and fought with Israel.
chapters.nkjv: But Sihon did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. So Sihon gathered all his people together, encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
