chapters.kjv: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ സീഹോനെയും അവന്റെ സകലജനത്തെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു; ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽ ആദേശനിവാസികളായ അമോർയ്യരുടെ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും കൈവശമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: "Then the Lord , the God of Israel, gave Sihon and his whole army into Israel’s hands, and they defeated them. Israel took over all the land of the Amorites who lived in that country,
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they defeated them. Thus Israel gained possession of all the land of the Amorites, who inhabited that country.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

chapters.ml: അർന്നോൻ മുതൽ യബ്ബോക്വരെയും മരുഭൂമിയിൽ യോർദ്ദാൻ വരെയുമുള്ള അമോർയ്യരുടെ ദേശം ഒക്കെയും അവർ പിടിച്ചടക്കി.
chapters.niv: capturing all of it from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the desert to the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: They took possession of all the territory of the Amorites, from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ തന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു അമോർയ്യരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞിരിക്കെ നീ അവരുടെ അവകാശം അടക്കുവാൻ പോകുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: "Now since the Lord , the God of Israel, has driven the Amorites out before his people Israel, what right have you to take it over?
chapters.nkjv: ‘And now the Lord God of Israel has dispossessed the Amorites from before His people Israel; should you then possess it?
chapters.kjv: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദേവനായ കെമോശ് നിനക്കു അവകാശമായി തരുന്ന ദേശത്തെ നീ അടക്കി അനുഭവിക്കയില്ലയോ? അങ്ങനെ തന്നെ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളയുന്നവരുടെ അവകാശം ഞങ്ങളും അടക്കി അനുഭവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Will you not take what your god Chemosh gives you? Likewise, whatever the Lord our God has given us, we will possess.
chapters.nkjv: Will you not possess whatever Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whatever the Lord our God takes possession of before us, we will possess.
chapters.kjv: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

chapters.ml: സിപ്പോരിന്റെ മകനായ ബാലാക്ക് എന്ന മോവാബ് രാജാവിനെക്കാളും നീ യോഗ്യനോ? അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു എപ്പോഴെങ്കിലും വാഗ്വാദം ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടോ? എപ്പോഴെങ്കിലും അവരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Are you any better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever quarrel with Israel or fight with them?
chapters.nkjv: And now, are you any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel? Did he ever fight against them?
chapters.kjv: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ ഹെശ്ബോനിലും അതിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും അരോവേരിലും അതിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും അർന്നോൻ തീരത്തുള്ള എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളിലും മുന്നൂറു സംവത്സരത്തോളം പാർത്തിരിക്കെ ആ കാലത്തിന്നിടയിൽ നിങ്ങൾ അവയെ ഒഴിപ്പിക്കാതിരുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: For three hundred years Israel occupied Heshbon, Aroer, the surrounding settlements and all the towns along the Arnon. Why didn’t you retake them during that time?
chapters.nkjv: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and its villages, in Aroer and its villages, and in all the cities along the banks of the Arnon, for three hundred years, why did you not recover them within that time?
chapters.kjv: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു അന്യായം ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല; എന്നോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുന്നതിനാൽ നീ എന്നോടാകുന്നു അന്യായം ചെയ്യുന്നതു; ന്യായാധിപനായ യഹോവ ഇന്നു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെയും അമ്മോന്യരുടെയും മദ്ധ്യേ ന്യായം വിധിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: I have not wronged you, but you are doing me wrong by waging war against me. Let the Lord , the Judge, decide the dispute this day between the Israelites and the Ammonites."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you wronged me by fighting against me. May the Lord, the Judge, render judgment this day between the children of Israel and the people of Ammon.’ "
chapters.kjv: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിഫ്താഹ് പറഞ്ഞയച്ച വാക്കു അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവു കൂട്ടാക്കിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The king of Ammon, however, paid no attention to the message Jephthah sent him.
chapters.nkjv: However, the king of the people of Ammon did not heed the words which Jephthah sent him.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു യിഫ്താഹിൻ മേൽ വന്നു; അവൻ ഗിലെയാദിലും മനശ്ശെയിലും കൂടി കടന്നു ഗിലെയാദിലെ മിസ്പയിൽ എത്തി ഗിലെയാദിലെ മിസ്പയിൽനിന്നു അമ്മോന്യരുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah. He crossed Gilead and Manasseh, passed through Mizpah of Gilead, and from there he advanced against the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh, and passed through Mizpah of Gilead; and from Mizpah of Gilead he advanced toward the people of Ammon.
chapters.kjv: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: യിഫ്താഹ് യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു നേർച്ച നേർന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ അമ്മോന്യരെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കുമെങ്കിൽ
chapters.niv: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord : "If you give the Ammonites into my hands,
chapters.nkjv: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord, and said, "If You will indeed deliver the people of Ammon into my hands,
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD , and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അമ്മോന്യരെ ജയിച്ചു സമാധാനത്തോടെ മടങ്ങിവരുമ്പോൾ എന്റെ വീട്ടുവാതിൽക്കൽനിന്നു എന്നെ എതിരേറ്റുവരുന്നതു യഹോവെക്കുള്ളതാകും; അതു ഞാൻ ഹോമയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: whatever comes out of the door of my house to meet me when I return in triumph from the Ammonites will be the Lord ’s, and I will sacrifice it as a burnt offering."
chapters.nkjv: then it will be that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the people of Ammon, shall surely be the Lord’s, and I will offer it up as a burnt offering."
chapters.kjv: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’s , and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യിഫ്താഹ് അമ്മോന്യരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ അവരുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു; യഹോവ അവരെ അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Jephthah went over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave them into his hands.
chapters.nkjv: So Jephthah advanced toward the people of Ammon to fight against them, and the Lord delivered them into his hands.
chapters.kjv: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവർക്കു അരോവേർമുതൽ മിന്നീത്ത്‌വരെയും ആബേൽ-കെരാമീംവരെയും ഒരു മഹാസംഹാരം വരുത്തി, ഇരുപതു പട്ടണം ജയിച്ചടക്കി.
chapters.niv: He devastated twenty towns from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith, as far as Abel Keramim. Thus Israel subdued Ammon.
chapters.nkjv: And he defeated them from Aroer as far as Minnith—twenty cities—and to Abel Keramim, with a very great slaughter. Thus the people of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിഫ്താഹ് മിസ്പയിൽ തന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ ഇതാ, അവന്റെ മകൾ തപ്പോടും നൃത്തത്തോടുംകൂടെ അവനെ എതിരേറ്റുവരുന്നു; അവൾ അവന്നു ഏകപുത്രി ആയിരുന്നു; അവളല്ലാതെ അവന്നു മകനുമില്ല മകളുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: When Jephthah returned to his home in Mizpah, who should come out to meet him but his daughter, dancing to the sound of timbrels! She was an only child. Except for her he had neither son nor daughter.
chapters.nkjv: When Jephthah came to his house at Mizpah, there was his daughter, coming out to meet him with timbrels and dancing; and she washis only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

chapters.ml: അവളെ കണ്ടയുടനെ അവൻ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം കീറി: അയ്യോ എന്റെ മകളേ, നീ എന്റെ തല കുനിയിച്ചു, നീ എന്നെ വ്യസനിപ്പിക്കുന്നവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ആക്കിയല്ലോ; യഹോവയോടു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞുപോയി; എനിക്കു പിന്മാറിക്കൂടാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he saw her, he tore his clothes and cried, "Oh no, my daughter! You have brought me down and I am devastated. I have made a vow to the Lord that I cannot break."
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he tore his clothes, and said, "Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low! You are among those who trouble me! For I have given my word to the Lord, and I cannot go back on it."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD , and I cannot go back.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനോടു: അപ്പാ, നീ യഹോവയോടു പറഞ്ഞുപോയിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ യഹോവ നിനക്കുവേണ്ടി നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളായ അമ്മോന്യരോടു പ്രതികാരം നടത്തിയിരിക്കയാൽ നിന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടതുപോലെ എന്നോടു ചെയ്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "My father," she replied, "you have given your word to the Lord . Do to me just as you promised, now that the Lord has avenged you of your enemies, the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: So she said to him, "My father, if you have given your word to the Lord, do to me according to what has gone out of your mouth, because the Lord has avenged you of your enemies, the people of Ammon."
chapters.kjv: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD , do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒരു കാര്യം എനിക്കു വേണ്ടിയിരുന്നു; ഞാൻ പർവ്വതങ്ങളിൽ ചെന്നു എന്റെ സഖിമാരുമായി എന്റെ കന്യാത്വത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലാപം കഴിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എനിക്കു രണ്ടു മാസത്തെ അവധി തരേണം എന്നു അവൾ തന്റെ അപ്പനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But grant me this one request," she said. "Give me two months to roam the hills and weep with my friends, because I will never marry."
chapters.nkjv: Then she said to her father, "Let this thing be done for me: let me alone for two months, that I may go and wander on the mountains and bewail my virginity, my friends and I."
chapters.kjv: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവളെ രണ്ടു മാസത്തേക്കു അയച്ചു; അവൾ തന്റെ സഖിമാരുമായി ചെന്നു തന്റെ കന്യാത്വത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു പർവ്വതങ്ങളിൽ വിലാപംകഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "You may go," he said. And he let her go for two months. She and her friends went into the hills and wept because she would never marry.
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "Go." And he sent her away for two months; and she went with her friends, and bewailed her virginity on the mountains.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു മാസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൾ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവന്നു; അവൻ നേർന്നിരുന്ന നേർച്ചപോലെ അവളോടു ചെയ്തു; അവൾ ഒരു പുരുഷനെ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: After the two months, she returned to her father, and he did to her as he had vowed. And she was a virgin. From this comes the Israelite tradition
chapters.nkjv: And it was so at the end of two months that she returned to her father, and he carried out his vow with her which he had vowed. She knew no man. And it became a custom in Israel
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആണ്ടുതോറും യിസ്രായേലിലെ കന്യകമാർ നാലു ദിവസം ഗിലെയാദ്യനായ യിഫ്താഹിന്റെ മകളെ കീർത്തിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നതു യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരു ആചാരമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: that each year the young women of Israel go out for four days to commemorate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.
chapters.nkjv: that the daughters of Israel went four days each year to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.
chapters.kjv: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം എഫ്രയീമ്യർ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി വടക്കോട്ടു ചെന്നു യിഫ്താഹിനോടു: നീ അമ്മോന്യരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ പോയപ്പോൾ കൂടെ പോരേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ വിളിക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു? ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ അകത്തിട്ടു വീട്ടിന്നു തീ വെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Ephraimite forces were called out, and they crossed over to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, "Why did you go to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We’re going to burn down your house over your head."
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of Ephraim gathered together, crossed over toward Zaphon, and said to Jephthah, "Why did you cross over to fight against the people of Ammon, and did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house down on you with fire!"
chapters.kjv: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.

chapters.ml: യിഫ്താഹ് അവരോടു: എനിക്കും എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്നും അമ്മോന്യരോടു വലിയ കലഹം ഉണ്ടായി; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ വളിച്ചപ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു എന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jephthah answered, "I and my people were engaged in a great struggle with the Ammonites, and although I called, you didn’t save me out of their hands.
chapters.nkjv: And Jephthah said to them, "My people and I were in a great struggle with the people of Ammon; and when I called you, you did not deliver me out of their hands.
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കയില്ലെന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ എന്റെ ജീവനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു അമ്മോന്യരുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു; യഹോവ അവരെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു. ഇങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്‍വാൻ ഇന്നു എന്റെ നേരെ വരുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When I saw that you wouldn’t help, I took my life in my hands and crossed over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave me the victory over them. Now why have you come up today to fight me?"
chapters.nkjv: So when I saw that you would not deliver me, I took my life in my hands and crossed over against the people of Ammon; and the Lord delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me this day to fight against me?"
chapters.kjv: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിഫ്താഹ് ഗിലെയാദ്യരെ ഒക്കെയും വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി, എഫ്രയീമ്യരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു; ഗിലെയാദ്യരായ നിങ്ങൾ എഫ്രയീമിന്റെയും മനശ്ശെയുടെയും മദ്ധ്യേ എഫ്രയീമ്യപലായിതന്മാർ ആകുന്നു എന്നു എഫ്രയീമ്യർ പറകകൊണ്ടു ഗിലെയാദ്യർ അവരെ സംഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jephthah then called together the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. The Gileadites struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, "You Gileadites are renegades from Ephraim and Manasseh."
chapters.nkjv: Now Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. And the men of Gilead defeated Ephraim, because they said, "You Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites and among the Manassites."
chapters.kjv: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദ്യർ എഫ്രയീംഭാഗത്തുള്ള യോർദ്ദാന്റെ കടവുകൾ പിടിച്ചു; എഫ്രയീമ്യപലായിതന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ: ഞാൻ അക്കരെക്കു കടക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറയുമ്പോൾ ഗിലെയാദ്യർ അവനോടു: നീ എഫ്രയീമ്യനോ എന്നു ചോദിക്കും; അല്ല, എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞാൽ
chapters.niv: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a survivor of Ephraim said, "Let me cross over," the men of Gilead asked him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he replied, "No,"
chapters.nkjv: The Gileadites seized the fords of the Jordan before the Ephraimites arrived. And when any Ephraimite who escaped said, "Let me cross over," the men of Gilead would say to him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he said, "No,"
chapters.kjv: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so , that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു ശിബ്ബോലെത്ത് എന്നു പറക എന്നു പറയും; അതു അവന്നു ശരിയായി ഉച്ചരിപ്പാൻ കഴിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ സിബ്ബോലെത്ത് എന്നു പറയും. അപ്പോൾ അവർ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു യോർദ്ദാന്റെ കടവുകളിൽവെച്ചു കൊല്ലും; അങ്ങനെ ആ കാലത്തു എഫ്രയീമ്യരിൽ നാല്പത്തീരായിരം പേർ വീണു.
chapters.niv: they said, "All right, say ‘Shibboleth.’ " If he said, "Sibboleth," because he could not pronounce the word correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. Forty-two thousand Ephraimites were killed at that time.
chapters.nkjv: then they would say to him, "Then say, ‘Shibboleth’!" And he would say, "Sibboleth," for he could not pronounce it right. Then they would take him and kill him at the fords of the Jordan. There fell at that time forty-two thousand Ephraimites.
chapters.kjv: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

chapters.ml: യിഫ്താഹ് യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ആറു സംവത്സരം ന്യായാധിപനായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ ഗിലെയാദ്യനായ യിഫ്താഹ് മരിച്ചു, ഗിലെയാദ്യപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in a town in Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in among the cities of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശേഷം ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമ്യനായ ഇബ്സാൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ന്യായാധിപനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.
chapters.nkjv: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
chapters.kjv: And after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Israel.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു മുപ്പതു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ മുപ്പതു പുത്രിമാരെ കെട്ടിച്ചയക്കയും തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കു മുപ്പതു കന്യകമാരെകൊണ്ടുവരികയും ചെയ്തു. അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഏഴു സംവത്സരം ന്യായാധിപനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He gave his daughters away in marriage to those outside his clan, and for his sons he brought in thirty young women as wives from outside his clan. Ibzan led Israel seven years.
chapters.nkjv: He had thirty sons. And he gave away thirty daughters in marriage, and brought in thirty daughters from elsewhere for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.
chapters.kjv: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഇബ്സാൻ മരിച്ചു ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ibzan died and was buried at Bethlehem.
chapters.kjv: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Beth-lehem.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെശേഷം സെബൂലൂന്യനായ ഏലോൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ന്യായാധിപനായി പത്തു സംവത്സരം യിസ്രായേലിൽ ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel ten years.
chapters.nkjv: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel. He judged Israel ten years.
chapters.kjv: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ സെബൂലൂന്യനായ ഏലോൻ മരിച്ചു; അവനെ സെബൂലൂൻ നാട്ടിൽ അയ്യാലോനിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Elon died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
chapters.nkjv: And Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried at Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
chapters.kjv: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെശേഷം ഹില്ലേലിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്ദോൻ എന്ന ഒരു പിരാഥോന്യൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ന്യായാധിപനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After him, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, led Israel.
chapters.nkjv: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
chapters.kjv: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

chapters.ml: എഴുപതു കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറി ഓടിക്കുന്ന നാല്പതു പുത്രന്മാരും മുപ്പതു പൌത്രന്മാരും അവന്നുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു എട്ടു സംവത്സരം ന്യായധിപനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. He led Israel eight years.
chapters.nkjv: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy young donkeys. He judged Israel eight years.
chapters.kjv: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഹില്ലേലിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്ദോൻ എന്ന പിരാഥോന്യൻ മരിച്ചു; അവനെ എഫ്രയീംദേശത്തു അമാലേക്യരുടെ മലനാട്ടിലെ പിരാഥോനിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Abdon son of Hillel died and was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mountains of the Amalekites.
chapters.kjv: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പിന്നെയും യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; യഹോവ അവരെ നാല്പതു സംവത്സരത്തോളം ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , so the Lord delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.
chapters.nkjv: Again the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord delivered them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD ; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാൻഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഉള്ളവനായി സോരാഥ്യനായ ഒരു പുരുഷൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു മാനോഹ എന്നു പേർ; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ മച്ചിയായിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു പ്രസവിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: A certain man of Zorah, named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, had a wife who was childless, unable to give birth.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a certain man from Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren and had no children.
chapters.kjv: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ത്രീക്കു യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ മച്ചിയല്ലോ, പ്രസവിച്ചിട്ടുമില്ല; എങ്കിലും നീ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord appeared to her and said, "You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.
chapters.nkjv: And the Angel of the Lord appeared to the woman and said to her, "Indeed now, you are barren and have borne no children, but you shall conceive and bear a son.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു കൊൾക, വീഞ്ഞും മദ്യവും കുടിക്കരുതു; അശുദ്ധമായതൊന്നും തിന്നുകയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: Now see to it that you drink no wine or other fermented drink and that you do not eat anything unclean.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, please be careful not to drink wine or similar drink, and not to eat anything unclean.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

chapters.ml: നീ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിക്കും; അവന്റെ തലയിൽ ക്ഷൌരക്കത്തി തൊടുവിക്കരുതു; ബാലൻ ഗർഭംമുതൽ ദൈവത്തിന്നു നാസീരായിരിക്കും; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ തുടങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: You will become pregnant and have a son whose head is never to be touched by a razor because the boy is to be a Nazirite, dedicated to God from the womb. He will take the lead in delivering Israel from the hands of the Philistines."
chapters.nkjv: For behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. And no razor shall come upon his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb; and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines."
chapters.kjv: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ ചെന്നു ഭർത്താവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഒരു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അവന്റെ ആകൃതി ഒരു ദൈവദൂതന്റെ ആകൃതിപോലെ അതിഭയങ്കരം ആയിരുന്നു; അവൻ എവിടെനിന്നെന്നു ഞാൻ അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചില്ല; തന്റെ പേർ അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞതും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Then the woman went to her husband and told him, "A man of God came to me. He looked like an angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he came from, and he didn’t tell me his name.
chapters.nkjv: So the woman came and told her husband, saying, "A Man of God came to me, and His countenance was like the countenance of the Angel of God, very awesome; but I did not ask Him where He was from, and He did not tell me His name.
chapters.kjv: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was , neither told he me his name:

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു നീ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിക്കും; ആകയാൽ നീ വീഞ്ഞും മദ്യവും കുടിക്കരുതു; അശുദ്ധമായതൊന്നും തിന്നുകയും അരുതു; ബാലൻ ഗർഭംമുതൽ ജീവപര്യന്തം ദൈവത്തിന്നു നാസീരായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he said to me, ‘You will become pregnant and have a son. Now then, drink no wine or other fermented drink and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite of God from the womb until the day of his death.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And He said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. Now drink no wine or similar drink, nor eat anything unclean, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’ "
chapters.kjv: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

chapters.ml: മാനോഹ യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു: കർത്താവേ, നീ അയച്ച ദൈവപുരുഷൻ വീണ്ടും ഞങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു, ജനിപ്പാനിരിക്കുന്ന ബാലന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഉപദേശിച്ചുതരുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord : "Pardon your servant, Lord. I beg you to let the man of God you sent to us come again to teach us how to bring up the boy who is to be born."
chapters.nkjv: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord, and said, "O my Lord, please let the Man of God whom You sent come to us again and teach us what we shall do for the child who will be born."
chapters.kjv: Then Manoah intreated the LORD , and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം മാനോഹയുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടു; ദൈവദൂതൻ വീണ്ടും അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അവൾ വയലിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു; അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവു മാനോഹ കൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: God heard Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was out in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.
chapters.nkjv: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the Angel of God came to the woman again as she was sitting in the field; but Manoah her husband was not with her.
chapters.kjv: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ സ്ത്രീ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു ഭർത്താവിനെ അറിയിച്ചു; അന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്ന ആൾ ഇതാ, എനിക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായിവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The woman hurried to tell her husband, "He’s here! The man who appeared to me the other day!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman ran in haste and told her husband, and said to him, "Look, the Man who came to me the other day has just now appeared to me!"
chapters.kjv: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.

chapters.ml: മാനോഹ ഉടനെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഭാര്യയോടുകൂടെ ചെന്നു ആ പുരുഷന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തി; ഈ സ്ത്രീയോടു സംസാരിച്ച ആൾ നീയോ എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു; ഞാൻ തന്നേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he said, "Are you the man who talked to my wife?" "I am," he said.
chapters.nkjv: So Manoah arose and followed his wife. When he came to the Man, he said to Him, "Are You the Man who spoke to this woman?" And He said, "I am."
chapters.kjv: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am .

chapters.ml: മാനോഹ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാകുമ്പോൾ ബാലന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ എങ്ങനെ ആചരിക്കേണം? അവനെ സംബന്ധിച്ചു എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Manoah asked him, "When your words are fulfilled, what is to be the rule that governs the boy’s life and work?"
chapters.nkjv: Manoah said, "Now let Your words come topass! What will be the boy’s rule of life, and his work?"
chapters.kjv: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ മാനോഹയോടു: ഞാൻ സ്ത്രീയോടു പറഞ്ഞതൊക്കെയും അവൾ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊള്ളട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord answered, "Your wife must do all that I have told her.
chapters.nkjv: So the Angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "Of all that I said to the woman let her be careful.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

chapters.ml: മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയിൽ ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന യാതൊന്നും അവൾ തിന്നരുതു; വീഞ്ഞും മദ്യവും കുടിക്കരുതു; അശുദ്ധമായതൊന്നും തിന്നുകയും അരുതു; ഞാൻ അവളോടു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും അവൾ ആചരിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, nor drink any wine or other fermented drink nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her."
chapters.nkjv: She may not eat anything that comes from the vine, nor may she drink wine or similar drink, nor eat anything unclean. All that I commanded her let her observe."
chapters.kjv: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

chapters.ml: മാനോഹ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ ഒരു കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ നിനക്കായി പാകം ചെയ്യുംവരെ നീ താമസിക്കേണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , "We would like you to stay until we prepare a young goat for you."
chapters.nkjv: Then Manoah said to the Angel of the Lord, "Please let us detain You, and we will prepare a young goat for You."
chapters.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD , I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ മാനോഹയോടു: നീ എന്നെ താമസിപ്പിച്ചാലും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ആഹാരം കഴിക്കയില്ല; ഒരു ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കുമെങ്കിൽ അതു യഹോവെക്കു കഴിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ എന്നു മാനോഹ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord replied, "Even though you detain me, I will not eat any of your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the Lord ." (Manoah did not realize that it was the angel of the Lord .)
chapters.nkjv: And the Angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "Though you detain Me, I will not eat your food. But if you offer a burnt offering, you must offer it to the Lord." (For Manoah did not know He was the Angel of the Lord.)
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD .

chapters.ml: മാനോഹ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതനോടു: നിന്റെ വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാകുമ്പോൾ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ ബഹുമാനിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്റെ പേരെന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Manoah inquired of the angel of the Lord , "What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes true?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Manoah said to the Angel of the Lord, "What is Your name, that when Your words come topass we may honor You?"
chapters.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD , What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ അവനോടു: എന്റെ പേർ ചോദിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? അതു അതിശയമുള്ളതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding. "
chapters.nkjv: And the Angel of the Lord said to him, "Why do you ask My name, seeing it is wonderful?"
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മാനോഹ ഒരു കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെയും ഭോജനയാഗത്തെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ഒരു പാറമേൽ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗം കഴിച്ചു; മാനോഹയും ഭാര്യയും നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കെ അവൻ ഒരു അതിശയം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Manoah took a young goat, together with the grain offering, and sacrificed it on a rock to the Lord . And the Lord did an amazing thing while Manoah and his wife watched:
chapters.nkjv: So Manoah took the young goat with the grain offering, and offered it upon the rock to the Lord. And He did a wondrous thing while Manoah and his wife looked on—
chapters.kjv: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD : and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

chapters.ml: അഗ്നിജ്വാല യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽനിന്നു ആകാശത്തിലേക്കു പൊങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ജ്വാലയോടുകൂടെ കയറിപ്പോയി; മാനോഹയും ഭാര്യയും കണ്ടു സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു.
chapters.niv: As the flame blazed up from the altar toward heaven, the angel of the Lord ascended in the flame. Seeing this, Manoah and his wife fell with their faces to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: it happened as the flame went up toward heaven from the altar—the Angel of the Lord ascended in the flame of the altar! When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell on their faces to the ground.
chapters.kjv: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it , and fell on their faces to the ground.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ മാനോഹെക്കും ഭാര്യക്കും പിന്നെ പ്രത്യക്ഷനായില്ല; അങ്ങനെ അതു യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ എന്നു മാനോഹ അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the angel of the Lord did not show himself again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it was the angel of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: When the Angel of the Lord appeared no more to Manoah and his wife, then Manoah knew that He was the Angel of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തെ കണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടു നാം മരിച്ചുപോകും എന്നു മാനോഹ ഭാര്യയോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "We are doomed to die!" he said to his wife. "We have seen God!"
chapters.nkjv: And Manoah said to his wife, "We shall surely die, because we have seen God!"
chapters.kjv: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

chapters.ml: ഭാര്യ അവനോടു: നമ്മെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ യഹോവെക്കു ഇഷ്ടമായിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ നമ്മുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഹോമയാഗവും ഭോജനയാഗവും കൈക്കൊൾകയോ ഇവ ഒക്കെയും നമുക്കു കാണിച്ചുതരികയോ ഈ സമയത്തു ഇതുപോലെയുള്ള കാര്യം നമ്മെ അറിയിക്കയോ ചെയ്കയില്ലായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But his wife answered, "If the Lord had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and grain offering from our hands, nor shown us all these things or now told us this."
chapters.nkjv: But his wife said to him, "If the Lord had desired to kill us, He would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering from our hands, nor would He have shown us all these things, nor would He have told us suchthings as these at this time."
chapters.kjv: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things , nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സ്ത്രീ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു, അവന്നു ശിംശോൻ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു ബാലൻ വളർന്നു; യഹോവ അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The woman gave birth to a boy and named him Samson. He grew and the Lord blessed him,
chapters.nkjv: So the woman bore a son and called his name Samson; and the child grew, and the Lord blessed him.
chapters.kjv: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

chapters.ml: സോരെക്കും എസ്തായോലിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേയുള്ള മഹനേ--ദാനിൽവെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു അവനെ ഉദ്യമിപ്പിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: and the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him while he was in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
chapters.nkjv: And the Spirit of the Lord began to move upon him at Mahaneh Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
chapters.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശിംശോൻ തിമ്നയിലേക്കു ചെന്നു തിമ്നയിൽ ഒരു ഫെലിസ്ത്യകന്യകയെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Samson went down to Timnah and saw there a young Philistine woman.
chapters.nkjv: Now Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വന്നു തന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും അറിയിച്ചു: ഞാൻ തിമ്നയിൽ ഒരു ഫെലിസ്ത്യകന്യകയെ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളെ എനിക്കു ഭാര്യയായിട്ടു എടുക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he returned, he said to his father and mother, "I have seen a Philistine woman in Timnah; now get her for me as my wife."
chapters.nkjv: So he went up and told his father and mother, saying, "I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines; now therefore, get her for me as a wife."
chapters.kjv: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അപ്പനും അമ്മയും അവനോടു: അഗ്രചർമ്മികളായ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരിൽനിന്നു നീ ഒരു ഭാര്യയെ എടുപ്പാൻ പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ കന്യകമാരിലും നമ്മുടെ സകലജനത്തിലും യാതൊരുത്തിയും ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ശിംശോൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനോടു: അവളെ എനിക്കു എടുക്കേണം; അവളെ എനിക്കു ബോധിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His father and mother replied, "Isn’t there an acceptable woman among your relatives or among all our people? Must you go to the uncircumcised Philistines to get a wife?" But Samson said to his father, "Get her for me. She’s the right one for me."
chapters.nkjv: Then his father and mother said to him, "Isthere no woman among the daughters of your brethren, or among all my people, that you must go and get a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?" And Samson said to his father, "Get her for me, for she pleases me well."
chapters.kjv: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

chapters.ml: ഇതു യഹോവയാൽ ഉണ്ടായതു എന്നു അവന്റെ അപ്പനും അമ്മയും അറിഞ്ഞില്ല; അവൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നേരെ അവസരം അന്വേഷിക്കയായിരുന്നു. ആ കാലത്തു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരായിരുന്നു യിസ്രായേലിനെ വാണിരുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: (His parents did not know that this was from the Lord , who was seeking an occasion to confront the Philistines; for at that time they were ruling over Israel.)
chapters.nkjv: But his father and mother did not know that it was of the Lord—that He was seeking an occasion to move against the Philistines. For at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
chapters.kjv: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശിംശോനും അവന്റെ അപ്പനും അമ്മയും തിമ്നയിലേക്കു പോയി തിമ്നെക്കരികെയുള്ള മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഒരു ബാലസിംഹം അവന്റെ നേരെ അലറിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Samson went down to Timnah together with his father and mother. As they approached the vineyards of Timnah, suddenly a young lion came roaring toward him.
chapters.nkjv: So Samson went down to Timnah with his father and mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah. Now tohis surprise, a young lion came roaring against him.
chapters.kjv: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു അവന്റെമേൽ വന്നു; കയ്യിൽ ഒന്നും ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കെ അവൻ അതിനെ ഒരു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെപ്പോലെ കീറിക്കളഞ്ഞു; താൻ ചെയ്തതു അപ്പനോടും അമ്മയോടും പറഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him so that he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as he might have torn a young goat. But he told neither his father nor his mother what he had done.
chapters.nkjv: And the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and he tore the lion apart as one would have torn apart a young goat, though hehad nothing in his hand. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.
chapters.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ചെന്നു ആ സ്ത്രീയോടു സംസാരിച്ചു; അവളെ ശീംശോന്നു ബോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and he liked her.
chapters.nkjv: Then he went down and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
chapters.kjv: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

chapters.ml: കുറെക്കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഹം അവൻ അവളെ വിവാഹം കഴിപ്പാൻ തിരികെ പോകയിൽ സിംഹത്തിന്റെ ഉടൽ നോക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മാറിച്ചെന്നു; സിംഹത്തിന്റെ ഉടലിന്നകത്തു ഒരു തേനീച്ചക്കൂട്ടവും തേനും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Some time later, when he went back to marry her, he turned aside to look at the lion’s carcass, and in it he saw a swarm of bees and some honey.
chapters.nkjv: After some time, when he returned to get her, he turned aside to see the carcass of the lion. And behold, a swarm of bees and honey were in the carcass of the lion.
chapters.kjv: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

chapters.ml: അതു അവൻ കയ്യിൽ എടുത്തു തിന്നുംകൊണ്ടു നടന്നു, അപ്പന്റെയും അമ്മയുടെയും അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവർക്കും കൊടുത്തു അവരും തിന്നു; എന്നാൽ തേൻ ഒരു സിംഹത്തിന്റെ ഉടലിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: He scooped out the honey with his hands and ate as he went along. When he rejoined his parents, he gave them some, and they too ate it. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the lion’s carcass.
chapters.nkjv: He took some of it in his hands and went along, eating. When he came to his father and mother, he gave some to them, and they also ate. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey out of the carcass of the lion.
chapters.kjv: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ ആ സ്ത്രീയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു; ശിംശോൻ അവിടെ ഒരു വിരുന്നുകഴിച്ചു; യൌവനക്കാർ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്ക പതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now his father went down to see the woman. And there Samson held a feast, as was customary for young men.
chapters.nkjv: So his father went down to the woman. And Samson gave a feast there, for young men used to do so.
chapters.kjv: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഇരിപ്പാൻ മുപ്പതു തോഴന്മാരെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the people saw him, they chose thirty men to be his companions.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

chapters.ml: ശിംശോൻ അവരോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ഒരു കടം പറയാം; വിരുന്നിന്റെ ഏഴു ദിവസത്തിന്നകം നിങ്ങൾ അതു വീട്ടിയാൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുപ്പതു ഉള്ളങ്കിയും മുപ്പതു വിശേഷവസ്ത്രവും തരാം.
chapters.niv: "Let me tell you a riddle," Samson said to them. "If you can give me the answer within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samson said to them, "Let me pose a riddle to you. If you can correctly solve and explain it to me within the seven days of the feast, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.
chapters.kjv: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

chapters.ml: വീട്ടുവാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ലെങ്കിലോ നിങ്ങൾ എനിക്കു മുപ്പതു ഉള്ളങ്കിയും മുപ്പതു വിശേഷവസ്ത്രവും തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ കടം പറക; ഞങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If you can’t tell me the answer, you must give me thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes." "Tell us your riddle," they said. "Let’s hear it."
chapters.nkjv: But if you cannot explain it to me, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing." And they said to him, "Pose your riddle, that we may hear it."
chapters.kjv: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു ഭോക്താവിൽനിന്നു ഭോജനവും മല്ലനിൽനിന്നു മധുരവും പുറപ്പെട്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ കടം വീട്ടുവാൻ മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തോളം അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: He replied, "Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet." For three days they could not give the answer.
chapters.nkjv: So he said to them: "Out of the eater came something to eat, And out of the strong came something sweet." Now for three days they could not explain the riddle.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം ദിവസത്തിലോ അവർ ശിംശോന്റെ ഭാര്യയോടു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പറഞ്ഞുതരുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിന്റെ ഭർത്താവിനെ വശീകരിക്ക; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെയും നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തെയും തീവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളയും; ഞങ്ങളുടെ വസ്തു കരസ്ഥമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നോ നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളെ വിളിച്ചതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On the fourth day, they said to Samson’s wife, "Coax your husband into explaining the riddle for us, or we will burn you and your father’s household to death. Did you invite us here to steal our property?"
chapters.nkjv: But it came to pass on the seventh day that they said to Samson’s wife, "Entice your husband, that he may explain the riddle to us, or else we will burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you invited us in order to take what is ours? Isthat not so?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson’s wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father’s house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so ?

chapters.ml: ശിംശോന്റെ ഭാര്യ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കരഞ്ഞു: നീ എന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നില്ല, എന്നെ ദ്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ അസ്മാദികളോടു ഒരു കടം പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു എനിക്കു അതു പറഞ്ഞുതന്നില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവളോടു: എന്റെ അപ്പന്നും അമ്മെക്കും ഞാൻ അതു പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുത്തിട്ടില്ല; പിന്നെ നിനക്കു പറഞ്ഞുതരുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Samson’s wife threw herself on him, sobbing, "You hate me! You don’t really love me. You’ve given my people a riddle, but you haven’t told me the answer." "I haven’t even explained it to my father or mother," he replied, "so why should I explain it to you?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Samson’s wife wept on him, and said, "You only hate me! You do not love me! You have posed a riddle to the sons of my people, but you have not explained it to me." And he said to her, "Look, I have not explained it to my father or my mother; so should I explain it to you?"
chapters.kjv: And Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?

chapters.ml: വിരുന്നിന്റെ ഏഴു ദിവസവും അവൾ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; ഏഴാം ദിവസം അവൾ അവനെ അസഹ്യപ്പെടുത്തുകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുത്തു; അവൾ തന്റെ അസ്മാദികൾക്കും കടം പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: She cried the whole seven days of the feast. So on the seventh day he finally told her, because she continued to press him. She in turn explained the riddle to her people.
chapters.nkjv: Now she had wept on him the seven days while their feast lasted. And it happened on the seventh day that he told her, because she pressed him so much. Then she explained the riddle to the sons of her people.
chapters.kjv: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം ദിവസം സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിക്കുംമുമ്പെ പട്ടണക്കാർ അവനോടു: തേനിനെക്കാൾ മധുരമുള്ളതു എന്തു? സിംഹത്തെക്കാൾ ബലമുള്ളതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ പശുക്കിടാവിനെ പൂട്ടി ഉഴുതില്ലെങ്കിൽ എന്റെ കടം വീട്ടുകയില്ലായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Before sunset on the seventh day the men of the town said to him, "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" Samson said to them, "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle."
chapters.nkjv: So the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down: "What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion?" And he said to them: "If you had not plowed with my heifer, You would not have solved my riddle!"
chapters.kjv: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ, യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു അവന്റെ മേൽ വന്നു; അവൻ അസ്കലോനിലേക്കു ചെന്നു മുപ്പതുപേരെ കൊന്നു അവരുടെ ഉടുപ്പൂരി കടംവീട്ടിയവർക്കു വസ്ത്രംകൊടുത്തു അവന്റെ കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. He went down to Ashkelon, struck down thirty of their men, stripped them of everything and gave their clothes to those who had explained the riddle. Burning with anger, he returned to his father’s home.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon him mightily, and he went down to Ashkelon and killed thirty of their men, took their apparel, and gave the changes ofclothing to those who had explained the riddle. So his anger was aroused, and he went back up to his father’s house.
chapters.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father’s house.

chapters.ml: ശിംശോന്റെ ഭാര്യ അവന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരനായിരുന്ന തോഴന്നു ഭാര്യയായിയ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Samson’s wife was given to one of his companions who had attended him at the feast.
chapters.nkjv: And Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his best man.
chapters.kjv: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

chapters.ml: കുറെക്കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു കോതമ്പുകെയ്ത്തുകാലത്തു ശിംശോൻ ഒരു കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെയുംകൊണ്ടു തന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ കാണ്മാൻ ചെന്നു: ശയനഗൃഹത്തിൽ എന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഞാൻ കടന്നുചെല്ലട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവളുടെ അപ്പനോ അവനെ അകത്തു കടപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിക്കാതെ:
chapters.niv: Later on, at the time of wheat harvest, Samson took a young goat and went to visit his wife. He said, "I’m going to my wife’s room." But her father would not let him go in.
chapters.nkjv: After a while, in the time of wheat harvest, it happened that Samson visited his wife with a young goat. And he said, "Let me go in to my wife, into her room." But her father would not permit him to go in.
chapters.kjv: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു അവളിൽ കേവലം അനിഷ്ടമായി എന്നു ഞാൻ വിചാരിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവളെ നിന്റെ തോഴന്നു കൊടുത്തുപോയി; അവളുടെ അനുജത്തി അവളെക്കാൾ സുന്ദരിയല്ലോ? അവൾ മറ്റവൾക്കു പകരം നിനക്കു ഇരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I was so sure you hated her," he said, "that I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister more attractive? Take her instead."
chapters.nkjv: Her father said, "I really thought that you thoroughly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Is not her younger sister better than she? Please, take her instead."
chapters.kjv: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശിംശോൻ: ഇപ്പോൾ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കു ഒരു ദോഷം ചെയ്താൽ ഞാൻ കുറ്റക്കാരനല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Samson said to them, "This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them."
chapters.nkjv: And Samson said to them, "This time I shall be blameless regarding the Philistines if I harm them!"
chapters.kjv: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

chapters.ml: ശിംശോൻ പോയി മുന്നൂറു കുറുക്കന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു വാലോടുവാൽ ചേർത്തു പന്തം എടുത്തു ഈരണ്ടു വാലിന്നിടയിൽ ഓരോ പന്തംവെച്ചു കെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: So he went out and caught three hundred foxes and tied them tail to tail in pairs. He then fastened a torch to every pair of tails,
chapters.nkjv: Then Samson went and caught three hundred foxes; and he took torches, turned thefoxes tail to tail, and put a torch between each pair of tails.
chapters.kjv: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

chapters.ml: പന്തത്തിന്നു തീ കൊളുത്തി ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ വിളവിലേക്കു വിട്ടു, കറ്റയും വിളവും ഒലിവുതോട്ടങ്ങളും എല്ലാം ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: lit the torches and let the foxes loose in the standing grain of the Philistines. He burned up the shocks and standing grain, together with the vineyards and olive groves.
chapters.nkjv: When he had set the torches on fire, he let thefoxes go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain, as well as the vineyards and olive groves.
chapters.kjv: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ചെയ്തതു ആർ എന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ അന്വേഷിച്ചാറെ തിമ്നക്കാരന്റെ മരുകൻ ശിംശോൻ; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ അവൻ എടുത്തു തോഴന്നു കൊടുത്തുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു അവർക്കു അറിവുകിട്ടി; ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ചെന്നു അവളെയും അവളുടെ അപ്പനെയും തീയിലിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the Philistines asked, "Who did this?" they were told, "Samson, the Timnite’s son-in-law, because his wife was given to his companion." So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father to death.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines said, "Who has done this?" And they answered, "Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion." So the Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire.
chapters.kjv: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശിംശോൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഈവിധം ചെയ്യുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യാതെ വിടുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Samson said to them, "Since you’ve acted like this, I swear that I won’t stop until I get my revenge on you."
chapters.nkjv: Samson said to them, "Since you would do a thing like this, I will surely take revenge on you, and after that I will cease."
chapters.kjv: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

chapters.ml: അവരെ കഠിനമായി അടിച്ചു തുടയും നടുവും തകർത്തുകളഞ്ഞു. പിന്നെ അവൻ ചെന്നു ഏതാംപാറയുടെ ഗഹ്വരത്തിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: He attacked them viciously and slaughtered many of them. Then he went down and stayed in a cave in the rock of Etam.
chapters.nkjv: So he attacked them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; then he went down and dwelt in the cleft of the rock of Etam.
chapters.kjv: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ചെന്നു യെഹൂദയിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി ലേഹിയിൽ എല്ലാം പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Philistines went up and camped in Judah, spreading out near Lehi.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and deployed themselves against Lehi.
chapters.kjv: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ നേരെ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു യെഹൂദ്യർ ചോദിച്ചു. ശിംശോൻ ഞങ്ങളോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഞങ്ങൾ അവനോടും ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടുവാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവർ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The people of Judah asked, "Why have you come to fight us?" "We have come to take Samson prisoner," they answered, "to do to him as he did to us."
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Judah said, "Why have you come up against us?" So they answered, "We have come up to arrest Samson, to do to him as he has done to us."
chapters.kjv: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നു മൂവായിരംപേർ ഏതാംപാറയുടെ ഗഹ്വരത്തിങ്കൽ ചെന്നു ശിംശോനോടു: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ നമ്മെ വാഴുന്നു എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ? നീ ഞങ്ങളോടു ഇച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അവർ എന്നോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഞാൻ അവരോടും ചെയ്തു എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then three thousand men from Judah went down to the cave in the rock of Etam and said to Samson, "Don’t you realize that the Philistines are rulers over us? What have you done to us?" He answered, "I merely did to them what they did to me."
chapters.nkjv: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cleft of the rock of Etam, and said to Samson, "Do you not know that the Philistines rule over us? What is this you have done to us?" And he said to them, "As they did to me, so I have done to them."
chapters.kjv: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്നെ പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടുവാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ശിംശോൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ എന്നെ കൊല്ലുകയില്ല എന്നു എന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They said to him, "We’ve come to tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines." Samson said, "Swear to me that you won’t kill me yourselves."
chapters.nkjv: But they said to him, "We have come down to arrest you, that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines." Then Samson said to them, "Swear to me that you will not kill me yourselves."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഇല്ല; ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ കൊല്ലുകയില്ല; നിന്നെ പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടി അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കേയുള്ളു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ രണ്ടു പുതിയ കയർകൊണ്ടു അവനെ കെട്ടി പാറയിൽനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: "Agreed," they answered. "We will only tie you up and hand you over to them. We will not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.
chapters.nkjv: So they spoke to him, saying, "No, but we will tie you securely and deliver you into their hand; but we will surely not kill you." And they bound him with two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.
chapters.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ലേഹിയിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു ആർത്തു. അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു അവന്റെമേൽ വന്നു അവന്റെ കൈ കെട്ടിയിരുന്ന കയർ തീകൊണ്ടു കരിഞ്ഞ ചണനൂൽപോലെ ആയി; അവന്റെ ബന്ധനങ്ങൾ കൈമേൽനിന്നു ദ്രവിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: As he approached Lehi, the Philistines came toward him shouting. The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. The ropes on his arms became like charred flax, and the bindings dropped from his hands.
chapters.nkjv: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines came shouting against him. Then the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him; and the ropes that were on his arms became like flax that is burned with fire, and his bonds broke loose from his hands.
chapters.kjv: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു കഴുതയുടെ പച്ചത്താടിയെല്ലു കണ്ടു കൈ നീട്ടി എടുത്തു അതുകൊണ്ടു ആയിരം പേരെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Finding a fresh jawbone of a donkey, he grabbed it and struck down a thousand men.
chapters.nkjv: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached out his hand and took it, and killed a thousand men with it.
chapters.kjv: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

chapters.ml: കഴുതയുടെ താടിയെല്ലുകൊണ്ടു കുന്നു ഒന്നു, കുന്നു രണ്ടു; കഴുതയുടെ താടിയെല്ലുകൊണ്ടു ആയിരം പേരെ ഞാൻ സംഹരിച്ചു എന്നു ശിംശോൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Samson said, "With a donkey’s jawbone I have made donkeys of them. With a donkey’s jawbone I have killed a thousand men."
chapters.nkjv: Then Samson said: "With the jawbone of a donkey, Heaps upon heaps, With the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men!"
chapters.kjv: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞുകഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ താടിയെല്ലു കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞു; ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു രാമത്ത്--ലേഹി എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: When he finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and the place was called Ramath Lehi.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when he had finished speaking, that he threw the jawbone from his hand, and called that place Ramath Lehi.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramath-lehi.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ വളരെ ദാഹിച്ചിട്ടു യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു: അടിയന്റെ കയ്യാൽ ഈ മഹാജയം നീ നല്കിയല്ലോ; ഇപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ ദാഹംകൊണ്ടു മരിച്ചു അഗ്രചർമ്മികളുടെ കയ്യിൽ വീഴേണമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Because he was very thirsty, he cried out to the Lord , "You have given your servant this great victory. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"
chapters.nkjv: Then he became very thirsty; so he cried out to the Lord and said, "You have given this great deliverance by the hand of Your servant; and now shall I die of thirst and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?"
chapters.kjv: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD , and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദൈവം ലേഹിയിൽ ഒരു കുഴി പിളരുമാറാക്കി, അതിൽനിന്നു വെള്ളം പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവൻ കുടിച്ചു ചൈതന്യം പ്രാപിച്ചുവീണ്ടു ജീവിച്ചു. അതുകൊണ്ടു അതിന്നു ഏൻ-ഹക്കോരേ എന്നു പേരായി; അതു ഇന്നുവരെയും ലേഹിയിൽ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned and he revived. So the spring was called En Hakkore, and it is still there in Lehi.
chapters.nkjv: So God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out, and he drank; and his spirit returned, and he revived. Therefore he called its name En Hakkore, which is in Lehi to this day.
chapters.kjv: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കാലത്തു യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഇരുപതു സംവത്സരം ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
chapters.nkjv: And he judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശിംശോൻ ഗസ്സയിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ ഒരു വേശ്യയെ കണ്ടു അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute. He went in to spend the night with her.
chapters.nkjv: Now Samson went to Gaza and saw a harlot there, and went in to her.
chapters.kjv: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.

chapters.ml: ശിംശോൻ ഇവിടെ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഗസ്യർക്കു അറിവുകിട്ടി; അവർ വന്നു വളഞ്ഞു അവനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ രാത്രിമുഴുവനും പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽ പതിയിരുന്നു; നേരം വെളുക്കുമ്പോൾ അവനെ കൊന്നുകളയാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു രാത്രിമുഴുവനും അനങ്ങാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The people of Gaza were told, "Samson is here!" So they surrounded the place and lay in wait for him all night at the city gate. They made no move during the night, saying, "At dawn we’ll kill him."
chapters.nkjv: When the Gazites weretold, "Samson has come here!" they surrounded theplace and lay in wait for him all night at the gate of the city. They were quiet all night, saying, "In the morning, when it is daylight, we will kill him."
chapters.kjv: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

chapters.ml: ശിംശോൻ അർദ്ധരാത്രിവരെ കിടന്നുറങ്ങി അർദ്ധരാത്രിയിൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പട്ടണവാതിലിന്റെ കതകും കട്ടളക്കാൽ രണ്ടും ഓടാമ്പലോടുകൂടെ പറിച്ചെടുത്തു ചുമലിൽവെച്ചു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഹെബ്രോന്നെതിരെയുള്ള മലമുകളിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But Samson lay there only until the middle of the night. Then he got up and took hold of the doors of the city gate, together with the two posts, and tore them loose, bar and all. He lifted them to his shoulders and carried them to the top of the hill that faces Hebron.
chapters.nkjv: And Samson lay low till midnight; then he arose at midnight, took hold of the doors of the gate of the city and the two gateposts, pulled them up, bar and all, put them on his shoulders, and carried them to the top of the hill that faces Hebron.
chapters.kjv: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെശേഷം അവൻ സോരേക്ക് താഴ്വരയിൽ ദെലീലാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു സ്ത്രീയെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some time later, he fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah.
chapters.nkjv: Afterward it happened that he loved a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവളോടു: നീ അവനെ വശീകരിച്ചു അവന്റെ മഹാശക്തി ഏതിൽ എന്നും ഞങ്ങൾ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു കെട്ടി ഒതുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എങ്ങനെ സാധിക്കും എന്നും അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾക; ഞങ്ങൾ ഓരോരുത്തൻ ആയിരത്തൊരുനൂറു വെള്ളിപ്പണം വീതം നിനക്കു തരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The rulers of the Philistines went to her and said, "See if you can lure him into showing you the secret of his great strength and how we can overpower him so we may tie him up and subdue him. Each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver."
chapters.nkjv: And the lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, "Entice him, and find out where his great strength lies, and by what means we may overpower him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and every one of us will give you eleven hundred pieces of silver."
chapters.kjv: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദെലീലാ ശിംശോനോടു: നിന്റെ മഹാശക്തി ഏതിൽ ആകുന്നു? ഏതിനാൽ നിന്നെ ബന്ധിച്ചു ഒതുക്കാം? എനിക്കു പറഞ്ഞുതരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Delilah said to Samson, "Tell me the secret of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued."
chapters.nkjv: So Delilah said to Samson, "Please tell me where your great strength lies, and with what you may be bound to afflict you."
chapters.kjv: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth , and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

chapters.ml: ശിംശോൻ അവളോടു: ഒരിക്കലും ഉണങ്ങാതെ പച്ചയായ ഏഴു ഞാണുകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ ബന്ധിച്ചാൽ എന്റെ ബലം ക്ഷയിച്ചു ഞാൻ ശേഷം മനുഷ്യരെപ്പോലെ ആകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Samson answered her, "If anyone ties me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, I’ll become as weak as any other man."
chapters.nkjv: And Samson said to her, "If they bind me with seven fresh bowstrings, not yet dried, then I shall become weak, and be like any other man."
chapters.kjv: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ഉണങ്ങാത്ത ഏഴു പച്ച ഞാണു അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവകൊണ്ടു അവൾ അവനെ ബന്ധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the rulers of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried, and she tied him with them.
chapters.nkjv: So the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh bowstrings, not yet dried, and she bound him with them.
chapters.kjv: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ ഉൾമുറിയിൽ പതിയിരിപ്പുകാർ പാർത്തിരുന്നു. അവൾ അവനോടു: ശിംശോനേ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഇതാ വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഉടനെ അവൻ തീ തൊട്ട ചണനൂൽപോലെ ഞാണുകളെ പൊട്ടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; അവന്റെ ശക്തിയുടെ രഹസ്യം വെളിപ്പെട്ടതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: With men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the bowstrings as easily as a piece of string snaps when it comes close to a flame. So the secret of his strength was not discovered.
chapters.nkjv: Now menwere lying in wait, staying with her in the room. And she said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he broke the bowstrings as a strand of yarn breaks when it touches fire. So the secret of his strength was not known.
chapters.kjv: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദെലീലാ ശിംശോനോടു: നീ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു എന്നോടു ഭോഷ്കു പറഞ്ഞു; നിന്നെ ഏതിനാൽ ബന്ധിക്കാം എന്നു ഇപ്പോൾ എനിക്കു പറഞ്ഞുതരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Delilah said to Samson, "You have made a fool of me; you lied to me. Come now, tell me how you can be tied."
chapters.nkjv: Then Delilah said to Samson, "Look, you have mocked me and told me lies. Now, please tell me what you may be bound with."
chapters.kjv: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളോടു: ഒരിക്കലും പെരുമാറീട്ടില്ലാത്ത പുതിയ കയർകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ ബന്ധിച്ചാൽ എന്റെ ബലം ക്ഷയിച്ചു ഞാൻ ശേഷം മനുഷ്യരെപ്പോലെ ആകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said, "If anyone ties me securely with new ropes that have never been used, I’ll become as weak as any other man."
chapters.nkjv: So he said to her, "If they bind me securely with new ropes that have never been used, then I shall become weak, and be like any other man."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

chapters.ml: ദെലീലാ പുതിയ കയർ വാങ്ങി അവനെ ബന്ധിച്ചിട്ടു: ശിംശോനേ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഇതാ വരുന്നു എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. പതിയിരിപ്പുകാർ ഉൾമുറിയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവനോ ഒരു നൂൽപോലെ തന്റെ കൈമേൽനിന്നു അതു പൊട്ടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Delilah took new ropes and tied him with them. Then, with men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the ropes off his arms as if they were threads.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" And menwere lying in wait, staying in the room. But he broke them off his arms like a thread.
chapters.kjv: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.

chapters.ml: ദെലീലാ ശിംശോനോടു: ഇതുവരെ നീ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു എന്നോടു ഭോഷ്കു പറഞ്ഞു; നിന്നെ ഏതിനാൽ ബന്ധിക്കാമെന്നു എനിക്കു പറഞ്ഞു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവളോടു: എന്റെ തലയിലെ ഏഴു ജട നൂല്പാവിൽ ചേർത്തു നെയ്താൽ സാധിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Delilah then said to Samson, "All this time you have been making a fool of me and lying to me. Tell me how you can be tied." He replied, "If you weave the seven braids of my head into the fabric on the loom and tighten it with the pin, I’ll become as weak as any other man." So while he was sleeping, Delilah took the seven braids of his head, wove them into the fabric
chapters.nkjv: Delilah said to Samson, "Until now you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me what you may be bound with." And he said to her, "If you weave the seven locks of my head into the web of the loom"—
chapters.kjv: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു കുറ്റി അടിച്ചുറപ്പിച്ചുംവെച്ചു അവനോടു: ശിംശോനേ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഇതാ വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൻ ഉറക്കമുണർന്നു നെയ്ത്തുതടിയുടെ കുറ്റിയും പാവും പറിച്ചെടുത്തുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and tightened it with the pin. Again she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and pulled up the pin and the loom, with the fabric.
chapters.nkjv: So she wove it tightly with the batten of the loom, and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he awoke from his sleep, and pulled out the batten and the web from the loom.
chapters.kjv: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൾ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ ഹൃദയം എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കെ നീ എന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ? ഈ മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം നീ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു; നിന്റെ മഹാശക്തി ഏതിൽ ആകന്നു എന്നു എനിക്കു പറഞ്ഞുതന്നില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then she said to him, "How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when you won’t confide in me? This is the third time you have made a fool of me and haven’t told me the secret of your great strength."
chapters.nkjv: Then she said to him, "How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies."
chapters.kjv: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth .

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൾ അവനെ ദിവസംപ്രതി വാക്കുകളാൽ ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടിച്ചു അസഹ്യപ്പെടുത്തി; അവൻ മരിപ്പാന്തക്കവണ്ണം വ്യസനപരവശനായി തീർന്നിട്ടു തന്റെ ഉള്ളം മുഴുവനും അവളെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: With such nagging she prodded him day after day until he was sick to death of it.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when she pestered him daily with her words and pressed him, so that his soul was vexed to death,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;

chapters.ml: ക്ഷൌരക്കത്തി എന്റെ തലയിൽ തൊട്ടിട്ടില്ല; ഞാൻ അമ്മയുടെ ഗർഭംമുതൽ ദൈവത്തിന്നു വ്രതസ്ഥൻ ആകുന്നു; ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്താൽ എന്റെ ബലം എന്നെ വിട്ടുപോകും; ഞാൻ ബലഹീനനായി ശേഷം മനുഷ്യരെപ്പോലെ ആകും എന്നു അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So he told her everything. "No razor has ever been used on my head," he said, "because I have been a Nazirite dedicated to God from my mother’s womb. If my head were shaved, my strength would leave me, and I would become as weak as any other man."
