chapters.nkjv: that he told her all his heart, and said to her, "No razor has ever come upon my head, for I havebeen a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaven, then my strength will leave me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man."
chapters.kjv: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother’s womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ഉള്ളം മുഴുവനും അവൻ അറിയിച്ചു എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ദെലീലാ ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെ വിളിപ്പാൻ ആളയച്ചു: ഇന്നു വരുവിൻ; അവൻ തന്റെ ഉള്ളം മുഴുവനും എന്നെ അറിയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു. ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു, പണവും കയ്യിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Delilah saw that he had told her everything, she sent word to the rulers of the Philistines, "Come back once more; he has told me everything." So the rulers of the Philistines returned with the silver in their hands.
chapters.nkjv: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, "Come up once more, for he has told me all his heart." So the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.
chapters.kjv: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനെ മടിയിൽ ഉറക്കി, ഒരു ആളെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു തലയിലെ ജട ഏഴും കളയിച്ചു; അവൾ അവനെ ഒതുക്കിത്തുടങ്ങി; അവന്റെ ശക്തി അവനെ വിട്ടുപോയി. പിന്നെ അവൾ: ശിംശോനേ,
chapters.niv: After putting him to sleep on her lap, she called for someone to shave off the seven braids of his hair, and so began to subdue him. And his strength left him.
chapters.nkjv: Then she lulled him to sleep on her knees, and called for a man and had him shave off the seven locks of his head. Then she began to torment him, and his strength left him.
chapters.kjv: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഇതാ വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഉടനെ അവൻ ഉറക്കമുണർന്നു; യഹോവ തന്നെ വിട്ടു എന്നറിയാതെ: ഞാൻ മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ കുടഞ്ഞൊഴിഞ്ഞുകളയും എന്നു വിചാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then she called, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and thought, "I’ll go out as before and shake myself free." But he did not know that the Lord had left him.
chapters.nkjv: And she said, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" So he awoke from his sleep, and said, "I will go out as before, at other times, and shake myself free!" But he did not know that the Lord had departed from him.
chapters.kjv: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു കണ്ണു കുത്തിപ്പൊട്ടിച്ചു ഗസ്സയിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി ചെമ്പുചങ്ങലകൊണ്ടു ബന്ധിച്ചു; അവൻ കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ മാവു പൊടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Philistines seized him, gouged out his eyes and took him down to Gaza. Binding him with bronze shackles, they set him to grinding grain in the prison.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines took him and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza. They bound him with bronze fetters, and he became a grinder in the prison.
chapters.kjv: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ തലമുടി കളഞ്ഞശേഷം വീണ്ടും വളർന്നുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: But the hair on his head began to grow again after it had been shaved.
chapters.nkjv: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after it had been shaven.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ: നമ്മുടെ വൈരിയായ ശിംശോനെ നമ്മുടെ ദേവൻ നമ്മുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തങ്ങളുടെ ദേവനായ ദാഗോന്നു ഒരു വലിയ ബലികഴിപ്പാനും ഉത്സവം ഘോഷിപ്പാനും ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി.
chapters.niv: Now the rulers of the Philistines assembled to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god and to celebrate, saying, "Our god has delivered Samson, our enemy, into our hands."
chapters.nkjv: Now the lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice. And they said: "Our god has delivered into our hands Samson our enemy!"
chapters.kjv: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: നമ്മുടെ ദേശം ശൂന്യമാക്കുകയും നമ്മിൽ അനേകരെ കൊല്ലുകയും ചെയ്ത നമ്മുടെ വൈരിയെ നമ്മുടെ ദേവൻ നമ്മുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തങ്ങളുടെ ദേവനെ പുകഴ്ത്തി.
chapters.niv: When the people saw him, they praised their god, saying, "Our god has delivered our enemy into our hands, the one who laid waste our land and multiplied our slain."
chapters.nkjv: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said: "Our god has delivered into our hands our enemy, The destroyer of our land, And the one who multiplied our dead."
chapters.kjv: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആനന്ദത്തിലായപ്പോൾ: നമ്മുടെ മുമ്പിൽ കളിപ്പാൻ ശിംശോനെ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ശിംശോനെ കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽനിന്നു വരുത്തി; അവൻ അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ കളിച്ചു; തൂണുകളുടെ ഇടയിലായിരുന്നു അവനെ നിർത്തിയിരുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: While they were in high spirits, they shouted, "Bring out Samson to entertain us." So they called Samson out of the prison, and he performed for them. When they stood him among the pillars,
chapters.nkjv: So it happened, when their hearts were merry, that they said, "Call for Samson, that he may perform for us." So they called for Samson from the prison, and he performed for them. And they stationed him between the pillars.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.

chapters.ml: ശിംശോൻ തന്നെ കൈക്കു പിടിച്ച ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: ക്ഷേത്രം നില്ക്കുന്ന തൂണു ചാരിയിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അവയെ തപ്പിനോക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Samson said to the servant who held his hand, "Put me where I can feel the pillars that support the temple, so that I may lean against them."
chapters.nkjv: Then Samson said to the lad who held him by the hand, "Let me feel the pillars which support the temple, so that I can lean on them."
chapters.kjv: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളും നിറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു; സകല ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ശിംശോൻ കളിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടുകൊണ്ടിരുന്ന പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളുമായി ഏകദേശം മൂവായിരം പേർ മാളികയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the temple was crowded with men and women; all the rulers of the Philistines were there, and on the roof were about three thousand men and women watching Samson perform.
chapters.nkjv: Now the temple was full of men and women. All the lords of the Philistines were there—about three thousand men and women on the roof watching while Samson performed.
chapters.kjv: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശിംശോൻ യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു: കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, എന്നെ ഓർക്കേണമേ; ദൈവമേ, ഞാൻ എന്റെ രണ്ടുകണ്ണിന്നും വേണ്ടി ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു ഈ ഒരു പ്രാവശ്യം മാത്രം എനിക്കു ശക്തി നല്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Samson prayed to the Lord , "Sovereign Lord , remember me. Please, God, strengthen me just once more, and let me with one blow get revenge on the Philistines for my two eyes."
chapters.nkjv: Then Samson called to the Lord, saying, "O Lord God, remember me, I pray! Strengthen me, I pray, just this once, O God, that I may with one blow take vengeance on the Philistines for my two eyes!"
chapters.kjv: And Samson called unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷേത്രം നില്ക്കുന്ന രണ്ടു നടുത്തുണും ഒന്നു വലങ്കൈകൊണ്ടും മറ്റേതു ഇടങ്കൈകൊണ്ടും ശിംശോൻ പിടിച്ചു അവയോടു ചാരി:
chapters.niv: Then Samson reached toward the two central pillars on which the temple stood. Bracing himself against them, his right hand on the one and his left hand on the other,
chapters.nkjv: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars which supported the temple, and he braced himself against them, one on his right and the other on his left.
chapters.kjv: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടുകൂടെ മരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു ശിംശോൻ പറഞ്ഞു ശക്തിയോടെ കുനിഞ്ഞു; ഉടനെ ക്ഷേത്രം അതിലുള്ള പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെയും സകലജനത്തിന്റെയും മേൽ വീണു. അങ്ങനെ അവൻ മരണസമയത്തുകൊന്നവർ ജീവകാലത്തു കൊന്നവരെക്കാൾ അധികമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Samson said, "Let me die with the Philistines!" Then he pushed with all his might, and down came the temple on the rulers and all the people in it. Thus he killed many more when he died than while he lived.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samson said, "Let me die with the Philistines!" And he pushed with allhis might, and the temple fell on the lords and all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than he had killed in his life.
chapters.kjv: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും പിതൃഭവനമൊക്കെയും ചെന്നു അവനെ എടുത്തു സോരെക്കും എസ്തായോലിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ മാനോഹയുടെ ശ്മശാനസ്ഥലത്തു അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഇരുപതു സംവത്സരം ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then his brothers and his father’s whole family went down to get him. They brought him back and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father. He had led Israel twenty years.
chapters.nkjv: And his brothers and all his father’s household came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah. He had judged Israel twenty years.
chapters.kjv: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ മീഖാവു എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു പുരുഷൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a man from the mountains of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
chapters.kjv: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അമ്മയോടു: നിനക്കു കളവുപോയതും നീ ഒരു ശപഥം ചെയ്തു ഞാൻ കേൾക്കെ പറഞ്ഞതുമായ ആയിരത്തൊരുനൂറു വെള്ളിപ്പണം ഇതാ, എന്റെ പക്കൽ ഉണ്ടു; ഞാനാകുന്നു അതു എടുത്തതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്റെ മകനേ, നീ യഹോവയാൽ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു അവന്റെ അമ്മ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: said to his mother, "The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse—I have that silver with me; I took it." Then his mother said, "The Lord bless you, my son!"
chapters.nkjv: And he said to his mother, "The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you, and on which you put a curse, even saying it in my ears—here is the silver with me; I took it." And his mother said, "Mayyoube blessed by the Lord, my son!"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD , my son.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ ആയിരത്തൊരുനൂറു വെള്ളിപ്പണം അമ്മെക്കു മടക്കിക്കൊടുത്തപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ അമ്മ: കൊത്തുപണിയും വാർപ്പുപണിയുമായ ഒരു വിഗ്രഹം ഉണ്ടാക്കുവാൻ ഞാൻ ഈ വെള്ളി എന്റെ മകന്നുവേണ്ടി യഹോവെക്കു നേർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ അതു നിനക്കു മടക്കിത്തരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, "I solemnly consecrate my silver to the Lord for my son to make an image overlaid with silver. I will give it back to you."
chapters.nkjv: So when he had returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, "I had wholly dedicated the silver from my hand to the Lord for my son, to make a carved image and a molded image; now therefore, I will return it to you."
chapters.kjv: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വെള്ളി തന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു മടക്കിക്കൊടുത്തപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ അമ്മ ഇരുനൂറു വെള്ളിപ്പണം എടുത്തു തട്ടാന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തു; അവൻ അതുകൊണ്ടു കൊത്തുപണിയും വാർപ്പുപണിയുമായ ഒരു വിഗ്രഹം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അതു മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So after he returned the silver to his mother, she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who used them to make the idol. And it was put in Micah’s house.
chapters.nkjv: Thus he returned the silver to his mother. Then his mother took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to the silversmith, and he made it into a carved image and a molded image; and they were in the house of Micah.
chapters.kjv: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.

chapters.ml: മീഖാവിന്നു ഒരു ദേവമന്ദിരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ഒരു ഏഫോദും ഗൃഹബിംബവും ഉണ്ടാക്കിച്ചു തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ കരപൂരണം കഴിച്ചു; അവൻ അവന്റെ പുരോഹിതനായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household gods and installed one of his sons as his priest.
chapters.nkjv: The man Micah had a shrine, and made an ephod and household idols; and he consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
chapters.kjv: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവില്ലായിരുന്നു; ഓരോരുത്തൻ ബോധിച്ചതു പോലെ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.
chapters.nkjv: In those days therewas no king in Israel; everyone did whatwas right in his own eyes.
chapters.kjv: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്--ലേഹെമ്യനായി യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽനിന്നു വന്നിരുന്ന ഒരു യുവാവു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ലേവ്യനും അവിടെ വന്നുപാർത്തവനുമത്രേ.
chapters.niv: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a young man from Bethlehem in Judah, of the family of Judah; he was a Levite, and was staying there.
chapters.kjv: And there was a young man out of Beth-lehem-judah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.

chapters.ml: തരംകിട്ടുന്നേടത്തു ചെന്നു പാർപ്പാൻ വേണ്ടി അവൻ യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെംപട്ടണം വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു തന്റെ പ്രയാണത്തിൽ എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ മീഖാവിന്റെ വീടുവരെ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: left that town in search of some other place to stay. On his way he came to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.nkjv: The man departed from the city of Bethlehem in Judah to stay wherever he could find aplace. Then he came to the mountains of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
chapters.kjv: And the man departed out of the city from Beth-lehem-judah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

chapters.ml: മീഖാവു അവനോടു: നീ എവിടെനിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. ഞാൻ യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽനിന്നു വരുന്ന ഒരു ലേവ്യൻ ആകുന്നു; തരം കിട്ടുന്നേടത്തു പാർപ്പാൻ പോകയാകുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Micah asked him, "Where are you from?" "I’m a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah," he said, "and I’m looking for a place to stay."
chapters.nkjv: And Micah said to him, "Where do you come from?" So he said to him, "I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, and I am on my way to find aplace to stay."
chapters.kjv: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Beth-lehem-judah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .

chapters.ml: മീഖാവു അവനോടു: നീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു എനിക്കു പിതാവും പുരോഹിതനുമായിരിക്ക; ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ആണ്ടിൽ പത്തു വെള്ളിപ്പണവും ഉടുപ്പും ഭക്ഷണവും തരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അങ്ങനെ ലേവ്യൻ അകത്തു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Micah said to him, "Live with me and be my father and priest, and I’ll give you ten shekels of silver a year, your clothes and your food."
chapters.nkjv: Micah said to him, "Dwell with me, and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten shekels of silver per year, a suit of clothes, and your sustenance." So the Levite went in.
chapters.kjv: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ പാർപ്പാൻ ലേവ്യന്നു സമ്മതമായി; ആ യുവാവു അവന്നു സ്വന്തപുത്രന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെപ്പോലെ ആയ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man became like one of his sons to him.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man became like one of his sons to him.
chapters.kjv: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.

chapters.ml: മീഖാവു ലേവ്യനെ കരപൂരണം കഴിപ്പിച്ചു; യുവാവു അവന്നു പുരോഹിതനായ്തീർന്നു മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.
chapters.nkjv: So Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and lived in the house of Micah.
chapters.kjv: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ലേവ്യൻ എനിക്കു പുരോഹിതനായിരിക്കയാൽ യഹോവ എനിക്കു നന്മചെയ്യുമെന്നു ഇപ്പോൾ തീർച്ചതന്നേ എന്നു മീഖാവു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Micah said, "Now I know that the Lord will be good to me, since this Levite has become my priest."
chapters.nkjv: Then Micah said, "Now I know that the Lord will be good to me, since I have a Levite as priest!"
chapters.kjv: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവില്ലായിരുന്നു. ദാൻഗോത്രക്കാർ അക്കാലം തങ്ങൾക്കു കുടിപാർപ്പാൻ ഒരു അവകാശം അന്വേഷിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അവർക്കു അന്നുവരെ അവകാശം സ്വാധീനമായ്‍വന്നിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: In those days Israel had no king. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking a place of their own where they might settle, because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: In those days therewas no king in Israel. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking an inheritance for itself to dwell in; for until that day their inheritance among the tribes of Israel had not fallen to them.
chapters.kjv: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കേ ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കി പരിശോധിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദാന്യർ തങ്ങളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ നിന്നു കൂട്ടത്തിൽ പരാക്രമശാലികളായ അഞ്ചുപേരെ സോരയിൽനിന്നും എസ്തായോലിൽ നിന്നും അയച്ചു, അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു ദേശം ശോധനചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the Danites sent five of their leading men from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land and explore it. These men represented all the Danites. They told them, "Go, explore the land." So they entered the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah, where they spent the night.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Dan sent five men of their family from their territory, men of valor from Zorah and Eshtaol, to spy out the land and search it. They said to them, "Go, search the land." So they went to the mountains of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

chapters.ml: അവർ എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ മീഖാവിന്റെ വീടുവരെ എത്തി രാത്രി അവിടെ പാർത്തു. മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നരികെ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവർ ആ ലേവ്യയുവാവിന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടറിഞ്ഞു അവിടെ കയറിച്ചെന്നു അവനോടു: നിന്നെ ഇവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു ആർ? നീ ഇവിടെ എന്തു ചെയ്യുന്നു? നിനക്കു ഇവിടെ എന്തു കിട്ടും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they were near Micah’s house, they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?"
chapters.nkjv: While they were at the house of Micah, they recognized the voice of the young Levite. They turned aside and said to him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? What do you have here?"
chapters.kjv: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: മീഖാവു എനിക്കു ഇന്നിന്നതു ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ എന്നെ ശമ്പളത്തിന്നു നിർത്തി; ഞാൻ അവന്റെ പുരോഹിതൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, "He has hired me and I am his priest."
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "Thus and so Micah did for me. He has hired me, and I have become his priest."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ പോകുന്ന യാത്ര ശുഭമാകുമോ എന്നു അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവത്തോടു ചോദിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they said to him, "Please inquire of God to learn whether our journey will be successful."
chapters.nkjv: So they said to him, "Please inquire of God, that we may know whether the journey on which we go will be prosperous."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ അവരോടു: സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോകുവിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ പോകുന്ന യാത്ര യഹോവെക്കു സമ്മതം തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The priest answered them, "Go in peace. Your journey has the Lord ’s approval."
chapters.nkjv: And the priest said to them, "Go in peace. The presence of the Lordbe with you on your way."
chapters.kjv: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ആ അഞ്ചു പുരുഷന്മാരും പുറപ്പെട്ടു ലയീശിലേക്കു ചെന്നു; അവിടത്തെ ജനം സീദോന്യരെപ്പോലെ സ്വൈരവും സ്വസ്ഥതയും ഉള്ളവരായി നിർഭയം വസിക്കുന്നു; യാതൊരു കാര്യത്തിലും അവർക്കു ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ളവൻ ദേശത്തു ആരുമില്ല; അവർ സീദോന്യർക്കു അകലെ പാർക്കുന്നു; മറ്റുള്ള മനുഷ്യരുമായി അവർക്കു സംസർഗ്ഗവുമില്ല എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: So the five men left and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living in safety, like the Sidonians, at peace and secure. And since their land lacked nothing, they were prosperous. Also, they lived a long way from the Sidonians and had no relationship with anyone else.
chapters.nkjv: So the five men departed and went to Laish. They saw the people who were there, how they dwelt safely, in the manner of the Sidonians, quiet and secure. Therewere no rulers in the land who might put them to shame for anything. They were far from the Sidonians, and they had no ties with anyone.
chapters.kjv: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ സോരയിലും എസ്തായോലിലും തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; സഹോദരന്മാർ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്തു വർത്തമാനം കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവർ: എഴുന്നേല്പിൻ; നാം അവരുടെ നേരെ ചെല്ലുക;
chapters.niv: When they returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, their fellow Danites asked them, "How did you find things?"
chapters.nkjv: Then thespies came back to their brethren at Zorah and Eshtaol, and their brethren said to them, "What is your report?"
chapters.kjv: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?

chapters.ml: ആ ദേശം ബഹുവിശേഷം എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ അനങ്ങാതിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? ആ ദേശം കൈവശമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പോകുവാൻ മടിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: They answered, "Come on, let’s attack them! We have seen the land, and it is very good. Aren’t you going to do something? Don’t hesitate to go there and take it over.
chapters.nkjv: So they said, "Arise, let us go up against them. For we have seen the land, and indeed it is very good. Would you do nothing? Do not hesitate to go, and enter to possess the land.
chapters.kjv: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ നിർഭയമായിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു ജനത്തെ കാണും; ദേശം വിശാലമാകുന്നു; ദൈവം അതു നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ തിന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു ഭൂമിയിലുള്ള യാതൊന്നിന്നും കുറവില്ലാത്ത സ്ഥലം തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When you get there, you will find an unsuspecting people and a spacious land that God has put into your hands, a land that lacks nothing whatever."
chapters.nkjv: When you go, you will come to a secure people and a large land. For God has given it into your hands, a place where thereis no lack of anything that is on the earth."
chapters.kjv: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സോരയിലും എസ്തായോലിലും ഉള്ള ദാൻ ഗോത്രക്കാരിൽ അറുനൂറു പേർ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then six hundred men of the Danites, armed for battle, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.
chapters.nkjv: And six hundred men of the family of the Danites went from there, from Zorah and Eshtaol, armed with weapons of war.
chapters.kjv: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

chapters.ml: അവർ ചെന്നു യെഹൂദയിലെ കിർയ്യത്ത്-യയാരീമിൽ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി; അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ഇന്നുവരെയും മഹനേ--ദാൻ എന്നു പേർ പറയുന്നു; അതു കിർയ്യത്ത്--യയാരീമിന്റെ പിൻവശത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On their way they set up camp near Kiriath Jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is called Mahaneh Dan to this day.
chapters.nkjv: Then they went up and encamped in Kirjath Jearim in Judah. (Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. There itis, west of Kirjath Jearim.)
chapters.kjv: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjath-jearim.

chapters.ml: അവിടെനിന്നു അവർ എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിലേക്കു ചെന്നു മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നരികെ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.
chapters.nkjv: And they passed from there to the mountains of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
chapters.kjv: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ലയീശ് ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ പോയിരുന്ന ആ അഞ്ചു പുരുഷന്മാരും തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു: ഈ വീടുകളിൽ ഒരു ഏഫോദും ഒരു ഗൃഹബിംബവും കൊത്തുപണിയും വാർപ്പുപണിയുമായ ഒരു വിഗ്രഹവും ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞുവോ? ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നു വിചാരിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Then the five men who had spied out the land of Laish said to their fellow Danites, "Do you know that one of these houses has an ephod, some household gods and an image overlaid with silver? Now you know what to do."
chapters.nkjv: Then the five men who had gone to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brethren, "Do you know that there are in these houses an ephod, household idols, a carved image, and a molded image? Now therefore, consider what you should do."
chapters.kjv: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

chapters.ml: അവർ അങ്ങോട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞു മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിനോടു ചേർന്ന ലേവ്യയുവാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടു കുശലം ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah’s place and greeted him.
chapters.nkjv: So they turned aside there, and came to the house of the young Levite man—to the house of Micah—and greeted him.
chapters.kjv: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായ ദാന്യർ അറുനൂറുപേരും വാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The six hundred Danites, armed for battle, stood at the entrance of the gate.
chapters.nkjv: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.
chapters.kjv: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

chapters.ml: ദേശം ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാൻ പോയിരുന്നവർ അഞ്ചുപേരും അകത്തുകടന്നു കൊത്തുപണിയായ വിഗ്രഹവും ഏഫോദും ഗൃഹബിംബവും വാർപ്പുപണിയായ വിഗ്രഹവും എടുത്തു; പുരോഹിതൻ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായ അറുനൂറുപേരുടെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The five men who had spied out the land went inside and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods while the priest and the six hundred armed men stood at the entrance of the gate.
chapters.nkjv: Then the five men who had gone to spy out the land went up. Entering there, they took the carved image, the ephod, the household idols, and the molded image. The priest stood at the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men whowere armed with weapons of war.
chapters.kjv: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നകത്തു കടന്നു കൊത്തുപണിയായ വിഗ്രഹവും ഏഫോദും ഗൃഹബിംബവും വാർപ്പുപണിയായ വിഗ്രഹവും എടുത്തപ്പോൾ പുരോഹിതൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്തു ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the five men went into Micah’s house and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"
chapters.nkjv: When these went into Micah’s house and took the carved image, the ephod, the household idols, and the molded image, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"
chapters.kjv: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: മിണ്ടരുതു; നിന്റെ വായ് പൊത്തി ഞങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ വന്നു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പിതാവും പുരോഹിതനുമായിരിക്ക; ഒരുവന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നു മാത്രം പുരോഹിതനായിരിക്കുന്നതോ യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരു ഗോത്രത്തിന്നും കുലത്തിന്നും പുരോഹിതനായിരിക്കുന്നതോ ഏതു നിനക്കു നല്ലതു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They answered him, "Be quiet! Don’t say a word. Come with us, and be our father and priest. Isn’t it better that you serve a tribe and clan in Israel as priest rather than just one man’s household?"
chapters.nkjv: And they said to him, "Be quiet, put your hand over your mouth, and come with us; be a father and a priest to us. Isit better for you to be a priest to the household of one man, or that you be a priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?"
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പുരോഹിതന്റെ മനം തെളിഞ്ഞു; അവൻ ഏഫോദും ഗൃഹബിംബവും കൊത്തുപണിയായ വിഗ്രഹവും എടുത്തു പടജ്ജനത്തിന്റെ നടുവിൽ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The priest was very pleased. He took the ephod, the household gods and the idol and went along with the people.
chapters.nkjv: So the priest’s heart was glad; and he took the ephod, the household idols, and the carved image, and took his place among the people.
chapters.kjv: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളെയും ആടുമാടുകളെയും സമ്പത്തുകളെയും തങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിലാക്കി പ്രയാണം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.
chapters.nkjv: Then they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods in front of them.
chapters.kjv: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

chapters.ml: അവർ മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു കുറെ ദൂരത്തായപ്പേൾ മീഖാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിനോടു ചേർന്ന വീടുകളിലുള്ളവർ ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി ദാന്യരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they had gone some distance from Micah’s house, the men who lived near Micah were called together and overtook the Danites.
chapters.nkjv: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.
chapters.kjv: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

chapters.ml: അവർ ദാന്യരെ ക്കുകിവിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ തിരിഞ്ഞുനോക്കി മീഖാവിനോടു: നീ ഇങ്ങനെ ആൾക്കൂട്ടത്തോടുകൂടെ വരുവാൻ എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As they shouted after them, the Danites turned and said to Micah, "What’s the matter with you that you called out your men to fight?"
chapters.nkjv: And they called out to the children of Dan. So they turned around and said to Micah, "What ails you, that you have gathered such a company?"
chapters.kjv: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ എന്റെ ദേവന്മാരെയും എന്റെ പുരോഹിതനെയും നിങ്ങൾ അപഹരിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു; ഇനി എനിക്കു എന്തുള്ളു? നിനക്കു എന്തു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു ചോദിക്കുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "You took the gods I made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you ask, ‘What’s the matter with you?’ "
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and you have gone away. Now what more do I have? How can you say to me, ‘What ails you?’ "
chapters.kjv: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?

chapters.ml: ദാന്യർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ ഒച്ച ഇവിടെ കേൾക്കരുതു: അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ദ്വേഷ്യക്കാർ നിങ്ങളോടു കയർത്തിട്ടു നിന്റെ ജീവനും നിന്റെ വീട്ടുകാരുടെ ജീവനും നഷ്ടമാകുവാൻ നീ സംഗതിവരുത്തും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Danites answered, "Don’t argue with us, or some of the men may get angry and attack you, and you and your family will lose your lives."
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Dan said to him, "Do not let your voice be heard among us, lest angry men fall upon you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household!"
chapters.kjv: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാന്യർ തങ്ങളുടെ വഴിക്കു പോയി; അവർ തന്നിലും ബലവാന്മാർ എന്നു മീഖാവു കണ്ടു വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the Danites went their way, and Micah, seeing that they were too strong for him, turned around and went back home.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Dan went their way. And when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

chapters.ml: മീഖാവു തീർപ്പിച്ചവയെയും അവന്നു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പുരോഹിതനെയും അവർ കൊണ്ടുപോയി, ലയീശിൽ സ്വൈരവും നിർഭയവുമായിരുന്ന ജനത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തി അവരെ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വെട്ടി, പട്ടണം തീവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they took what Micah had made, and his priest, and went on to Laish, against a people at peace and secure. They attacked them with the sword and burned down their city.
chapters.nkjv: So they took thethings Micah had made, and the priest who had belonged to him, and went to Laish, to a people quiet and secure; and they struck them with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.
chapters.kjv: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

chapters.ml: അതു സീദോന്നു അകലെ ആയിരുന്നു; മറ്റു മനുഷ്യരുമായി അവർക്കു സംസർഗ്ഗം ഇല്ലായ്കയാൽ അവരെ വിടുവിപ്പാൻ ആരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല. അതു ബേത്ത്--രെഹോബ് താഴ്വരയിൽ ആയിരുന്നു. അവർ പട്ടണം വീണ്ടും പണിതു അവിടെ കുടിപാർക്കയും
chapters.niv: There was no one to rescue them because they lived a long way from Sidon and had no relationship with anyone else. The city was in a valley near Beth Rehob. The Danites rebuilt the city and settled there.
chapters.nkjv: Therewas no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no ties with anyone. It was in the valley that belongs to Beth Rehob. So they rebuilt the city and dwelt there.
chapters.kjv: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Beth-rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ജനിച്ച തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവായ ദാന്റെ പേരിൻ പ്രകാരം നഗരത്തിന്നു ദാൻ എന്നു പേരിടുകയും ചെയ്തു; പണ്ടു ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു ലയീശ് എന്നു പേർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They named it Dan after their ancestor Dan, who was born to Israel—though the city used to be called Laish.
chapters.nkjv: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel. However, the name of the city formerly was Laish.
chapters.kjv: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.

chapters.ml: ദാന്യർ കൊത്തുപണിയായ ആ വിഗ്രഹം പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു; മോശെയുടെ മകനായ ഗേർശോമിന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാനും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും ആ ദേശത്തിന്റെ പ്രവാസകാലംവരെ ദാൻഗോത്രക്കാർക്കു പുരോഹിതന്മാരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There the Danites set up for themselves the idol, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan until the time of the captivity of the land.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Dan set up for themselves the carved image; and Jonathan the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയം ശീലോവിൽ ആയിരുന്ന കാലത്തൊക്കെയും മീഖാവു തീർപ്പിച്ച വിഗ്രഹം അവർ വെച്ചു പൂജിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They continued to use the idol Micah had made, all the time the house of God was in Shiloh.
chapters.nkjv: So they set up for themselves Micah’s carved image which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
chapters.kjv: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവില്ലാത്ത ആ കാലത്തു എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ ഉൾപ്രദേശത്തു വന്നു പാർത്തിരുന്ന ഒരു ലേവ്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽനിന്നു ഒരു വെപ്പാട്ടിയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In those days Israel had no king. Now a Levite who lived in a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim took a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass in those days, when therewas no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite staying in the remote mountains of Ephraim. He took for himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Beth-lehem-judah.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടി അവനോടു ദ്രോഹിച്ചു വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്തു അവനെ വിട്ടു യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പോയി നാലു മാസത്തോളം അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: But she was unfaithful to him. She left him and went back to her parents’ home in Bethlehem, Judah. After she had been there four months,
chapters.nkjv: But his concubine played the harlot against him, and went away from him to her father’s house at Bethlehem in Judah, and was there four whole months.
chapters.kjv: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Beth-lehem-judah, and was there four whole months.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവു പുറപ്പെട്ടു അവളോടു നല്ലവാക്കു പറഞ്ഞു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ അവളെ അന്വേഷിച്ചുചെന്നു; അവനോടുകൂടെ ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരനും രണ്ടു കഴുതയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൾ അവനെ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു; യുവതിയുടെ അപ്പൻ അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ വരവിങ്കൽ സന്തോഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: her husband went to her to persuade her to return. He had with him his servant and two donkeys. She took him into her parents’ home, and when her father saw him, he gladly welcomed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then her husband arose and went after her, to speak kindly to her and bring her back, having his servant and a couple of donkeys with him. So she brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young woman saw him, he was glad to meet him.
chapters.kjv: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

chapters.ml: യുവതിയുടെ അപ്പനായ അവന്റെ അമ്മാവിയപ്പൻ അവനെ പാർപ്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ മൂന്നു ദിവസം അവനോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു. അവർ തിന്നുകുടിച്ചു അവിടെ രാപാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: His father-in-law, the woman’s father, prevailed on him to stay; so he remained with him three days, eating and drinking, and sleeping there.
chapters.nkjv: Now his father-in-law, the young woman’s father, detained him; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank and lodged there.
chapters.kjv: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

chapters.ml: നാലാം ദിവസം അവൻ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു യാത്ര പുറപ്പെടുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചപ്പോൾ യുവതിയുടെ അപ്പൻ മരുമകനോടു: അല്പം വല്ലതും കഴിച്ചിട്ടു പോകാമല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On the fourth day they got up early and he prepared to leave, but the woman’s father said to his son-in-law, "Refresh yourself with something to eat; then you can go."
chapters.nkjv: Then it came to pass on the fourth day that they arose early in the morning, and he stood to depart; but the young woman’s father said to his son-in-law, "Refresh your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഇരുന്നു രണ്ടുപേരും കൂടെ തിന്നുകയും കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തു; യുവതിയുടെ അപ്പൻ അവനോടു: ദയചെയ്തു രാപാർത്തു സുഖിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the two of them sat down to eat and drink together. Afterward the woman’s father said, "Please stay tonight and enjoy yourself."
chapters.nkjv: So they sat down, and the two of them ate and drank together. Then the young woman’s father said to the man, "Please be content to stay all night, and let your heart be merry."
chapters.kjv: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel’s father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ അമ്മാവിയപ്പൻ അവനെ നിർബ്ബന്ധിച്ചു; ആ രാത്രിയും അവൻ അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: And when the man got up to go, his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.
chapters.nkjv: And when the man stood to depart, his father-in-law urged him; so he lodged there again.
chapters.kjv: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാം ദിവസം അവൻ പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ യുവതിയുടെ അപ്പൻ: അല്പം വല്ലതും കഴിച്ചിട്ടു വെയിലാറുംവരെ താമസിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ രണ്ടുപേരും ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the morning of the fifth day, when he rose to go, the woman’s father said, "Refresh yourself. Wait till afternoon!" So the two of them ate together.
chapters.nkjv: Then he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart, but the young woman’s father said, "Please refresh your heart." So they delayed until afternoon; and both of them ate.
chapters.kjv: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel’s father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവനും അവന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയും ബാല്യക്കാരനും എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ യുവതിയുടെ അപ്പനായ അവന്റെ അമ്മാവിയപ്പൻ അവനോടു: ഇതാ, നേരം അസ്തമിപ്പാറായി, ഈ രാത്രിയും താമസിക്ക; നേരം വൈകിയല്ലോ; രാപാർത്തു സുഖിക്ക; നാളെ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോകാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then when the man, with his concubine and his servant, got up to leave, his father-in-law, the woman’s father, said, "Now look, it’s almost evening. Spend the night here; the day is nearly over. Stay and enjoy yourself. Early tomorrow morning you can get up and be on your way home."
chapters.nkjv: And when the man stood to depart—he and his concubine and his servant—his father-in-law, the young woman’s father, said to him, "Look, the day is now drawing toward evening; please spend the night. See, the day is coming to an end; lodge here, that your heart may be merry. Tomorrow go your way early, so that you may get home."
chapters.kjv: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel’s father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അന്നും രാപാർപ്പാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; യെരൂശലേമെന്ന യെബൂസിന്നു സമീപം എത്തി; കോപ്പിട്ട രണ്ടു കഴുതയും അവന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയും അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But, unwilling to stay another night, the man left and went toward Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.
chapters.nkjv: However, the man was not willing to spend that night; so he rose and departed, and came opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem). With him were the two saddled donkeys; his concubine was also with him.
chapters.kjv: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെബൂസിന്നു സമീപം എത്തിയപ്പോൾ നേരം നന്നാവൈകിയിരുന്നു; ബാല്യക്കാരൻ യജമാനനോടു: നാം ഈ യെബൂസ്യനഗരത്തിൽ കയറി രാപാർക്കരുതോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they were near Jebus and the day was almost gone, the servant said to his master, "Come, let’s stop at this city of the Jebusites and spend the night."
chapters.nkjv: They were near Jebus, and the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, "Come, please, and let us turn aside into this city of the Jebusites and lodge in it."
chapters.kjv: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ അവനോടു: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളില്ലാത്ത ഈ അന്യനഗരത്തിൽ നാം കയറരുതു; നമുക്കു ഗിബെയയിലേക്കു പോകാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His master replied, "No. We won’t go into any city whose people are not Israelites. We will go on to Gibeah."
chapters.nkjv: But his master said to him, "We will not turn aside here into a city of foreigners, who are not of the children of Israel; we will go on to Gibeah."
chapters.kjv: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും തന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: നമുക്കു ഈ ഊരുകളിൽ ഒന്നിൽ ഗിബെയയിലോ രാമയിലോ രാപാർക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He added, "Come, let’s try to reach Gibeah or Ramah and spend the night in one of those places."
chapters.nkjv: So he said to his servant, "Come, let us draw near to one of these places, and spend the night in Gibeah or in Ramah."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ മുമ്പോട്ടു പോയി ബെന്യാമീൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ഗിബെയെക്കു സമീപം എത്തിയപ്പോൾ സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they went on, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.
chapters.nkjv: And they passed by and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.
chapters.kjv: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഗിബെയയിൽ രാപാർപ്പാൻ കയറി; അവൻ ചെന്നു നഗരവീഥിയിൽ ഇരുന്നു; രാപാർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരെ വീട്ടിൽ കൈക്കൊൾവാൻ ആരെയും കണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: There they stopped to spend the night. They went and sat in the city square, but no one took them in for the night.
chapters.nkjv: They turned aside there to go in to lodge in Gibeah. And when he went in, he sat down in the open square of the city, for no one would take them into his house to spend the night.
chapters.kjv: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഇതാ, ഒരു വൃദ്ധൻ വൈകുന്നേരം വേലകഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു വയലിൽനിന്നു വരുന്നു; അവൻ എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടുകാരനും ഗിബെയയിൽ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്നവനും ആയിരുന്നു; ആ ദേശക്കാരോ ബെന്യാമീന്യർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was living in Gibeah (the inhabitants of the place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the fields.
chapters.nkjv: Just then an old man came in from his work in the field at evening, who also was from the mountains of Ephraim; he was staying in Gibeah, whereas the men of the place were Benjamites.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.

chapters.ml: വൃദ്ധൻ തലയുയർത്തി നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ നഗരവീഥിയിൽ വഴിയാത്രക്കാരനെ കണ്ടു: നീ എവിടെനിന്നു വരുന്നു? എവിടേക്കു പോകുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he looked and saw the traveler in the city square, the old man asked, "Where are you going? Where did you come from?"
chapters.nkjv: And when he raised his eyes, he saw the traveler in the open square of the city; and the old man said, "Where are you going, and where do you come from?"
chapters.kjv: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽനിന്നു എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ ഉൾപ്രദേശത്തേക്കു പോകുന്നു; ഞാൻ അവിടത്തുകാരൻ ആകുന്നു; ഞാൻ യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിനോളം പോയിരുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു പോകയാകുന്നു; എന്നെ വീട്ടിൽ കൈക്കൊൾവാൻ ഇവിടെ ആരും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: He answered, "We are on our way from Bethlehem in Judah to a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim where I live. I have been to Bethlehem in Judah and now I am going to the house of the Lord . No one has taken me in for the night.
chapters.nkjv: So he said to him, "We are passing from Bethlehem in Judah toward the remote mountains of Ephraim; I am from there. I went to Bethlehem in Judah; now I am going to the house of the Lord. But there is no one who will take me into his house,
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, We are passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Beth-lehem-judah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD ; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ കഴുതകൾക്കു വൈക്കോലും തീനും ഉണ്ടു; എനിക്കും നിന്റെ ദാസിക്കും അടിയങ്ങളോടുകൂടെയുള്ള ബാല്യക്കാരന്നും അപ്പവും വീഞ്ഞും കൈവശം ഉണ്ടു, ഒന്നിന്നും കുറവില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We have both straw and fodder for our donkeys and bread and wine for ourselves your servants—me, the woman and the young man with us. We don’t need anything."
chapters.nkjv: although we have both straw and fodder for our donkeys, and bread and wine for myself, for your female servant, and for the young man whois with your servant; thereis no lack of anything."
chapters.kjv: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു വൃദ്ധൻ: നിനക്കു സമാധാനം; നിനക്കു വേണ്ടതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ തരും; വീഥിയിൽ രാപാർക്കമാത്രമരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു,
chapters.niv: "You are welcome at my house," the old man said. "Let me supply whatever you need. Only don’t spend the night in the square."
chapters.nkjv: And the old man said, "Peace be with you! However, let all your needs be my responsibility; only do not spend the night in the open square."
chapters.kjv: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

chapters.ml: അവനെ തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി കഴുതകൾക്കു തീൻ കൊടുത്തു; അവരും കാലുകൾ കഴുകി ഭക്ഷണപാനീയങ്ങൾ കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he took him into his house and fed his donkeys. After they had washed their feet, they had something to eat and drink.
chapters.nkjv: So he brought him into his house, and gave fodder to the donkeys. And they washed their feet, and ate and drank.
chapters.kjv: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ സുഖിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ പട്ടണത്തിലെ ചില നീചന്മാർ വീടു വളഞ്ഞു വാതിലിന്നു മുട്ടി: നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്ന പുരുഷനെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവാ; ഞങ്ങൾ അവനെ ഭോഗിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു വീട്ടുടയവനായ വൃദ്ധനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While they were enjoying themselves, some of the wicked men of the city surrounded the house. Pounding on the door, they shouted to the old man who owned the house, "Bring out the man who came to your house so we can have sex with him."
chapters.nkjv: As they were enjoying themselves, suddenly certain men of the city, perverted men, surrounded the house and beat on the door. They spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, "Bring out the man who came to your house, that we may know him carnally!"
chapters.kjv: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.

chapters.ml: വീട്ടുടയവനായ പുരുഷൻ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു ചെന്നു അവരോടു: അരുതേ, എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരേ, ഇങ്ങനെ ദോഷം ചെയ്യരുതേ; ഈ ആൾ എന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു ഈ വഷളത്വം പ്രവർത്തിക്കരുതേ.
chapters.niv: The owner of the house went outside and said to them, "No, my friends, don’t be so vile. Since this man is my guest, don’t do this outrageous thing.
chapters.nkjv: But the man, the master of the house, went out to them and said to them, "No, my brethren! I beg you, do not act so wickedly! Seeing this man has come into my house, do not commit this outrage.
chapters.kjv: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay , I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, കന്യകയായ എന്റെ മകളും ഈയാളുടെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയും ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടു; അവരെ ഞാൻ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരാം; അവരെ എടുത്തു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ബോധിച്ചതുപോലെ അവരോടു ചെയ്‍വിൻ; ഈ ആളോടോ ഈവക വഷളത്വം പ്രവർത്തിക്കരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Look, here is my virgin daughter, and his concubine. I will bring them out to you now, and you can use them and do to them whatever you wish. But as for this man, don’t do such an outrageous thing."
chapters.nkjv: Look, hereis my virgin daughter and theman’s concubine; let me bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them as you please; but to this man do not do such a vile thing!"
chapters.kjv: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ അവനെ കൂട്ടാക്കിയില്ല; ആകയാൽ ആ പുരുഷൻ തന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയെ പിടിച്ചു അവളെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്താക്കിക്കൊടുത്തു, അവർ അവളെ പുണർന്നു; രാത്രി മുഴുവനും പ്രഭാതംവരെ അവളെ ബലാൽക്കാരം ചെയ്തു; നേരം വെളുപ്പാറായപ്പോൾ അവളെ വിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But the men would not listen to him. So the man took his concubine and sent her outside to them, and they raped her and abused her throughout the night, and at dawn they let her go.
chapters.nkjv: But the men would not heed him. So the man took his concubine and brought her out to them. And they knew her and abused her all night until morning; and when the day began to break, they let her go.
chapters.kjv: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

chapters.ml: പ്രഭാതത്തിങ്കൽ സ്ത്രീ വന്നു തന്റെ യജമാനൻ പാർത്ത ആ പുരുഷന്റെ വീട്ടുവാതിൽക്കൽ വീണുകിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: At daybreak the woman went back to the house where her master was staying, fell down at the door and lay there until daylight.
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman came as the day was dawning, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her master was, till it was light.
chapters.kjv: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was , till it was light.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ യജമാനൻ രാവിലെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു വീട്ടിന്റെ വാതിൽ തുറന്നു തന്റെ വഴിക്കു പോകുവാൻ പുറത്തിറങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, അവന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടി വീട്ടുവാതിൽക്കൽ കൈ ഉമ്മരപ്പടിമേലായി വീണുകിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When her master got up in the morning and opened the door of the house and stepped out to continue on his way, there lay his concubine, fallen in the doorway of the house, with her hands on the threshold.
chapters.nkjv: When her master arose in the morning, and opened the doors of the house and went out to go his way, there was his concubine, fallen at the door of the house with her hands on the threshold.
chapters.kjv: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളോടു: എഴുന്നേൽക്ക, നാം പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു മറുപടി ഉണ്ടായില്ല. അവൻ അവളെ കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു വെച്ചു പുറപ്പെട്ടു തന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു പോയി,
chapters.niv: He said to her, "Get up; let’s go." But there was no answer. Then the man put her on his donkey and set out for home.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to her, "Get up and let us be going." But there was no answer. So the man lifted her onto the donkey; and the man got up and went to his place.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.

chapters.ml: വീട്ടിൽ എത്തിയശേഷം ഒരു കത്തിയെടുത്തു അംഗമംഗമായി തന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയെ പന്ത്രണ്ടു ഖണ്ഡമാക്കി വിഭാഗിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകലദിക്കുകളിലും കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he reached home, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, limb by limb, into twelve parts and sent them into all the areas of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: When he entered his house he took a knife, laid hold of his concubine, and divided her into twelve pieces, limb by limb, and sent her throughout all the territory of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.

chapters.ml: അതു കണ്ടവർ എല്ലാവരും: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്ന നാൾ മുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെയും ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള പ്രവൃത്തി നടന്നിട്ടില്ല, കണ്ടിട്ടുമില്ല; ഇതിനെപ്പറ്റി ചിന്തിച്ചു ആലോചിച്ചു അഭിപ്രായം പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Everyone who saw it was saying to one another, "Such a thing has never been seen or done, not since the day the Israelites came up out of Egypt. Just imagine! We must do something! So speak up!"
chapters.nkjv: And so it was that all who saw it said, "No such deed has been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up from the land of Egypt until this day. Consider it, confer, and speak up!"
chapters.kjv: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds .

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഒക്കെയും പുറപ്പെട്ടു ദാൻ മുതൽ ബേർ--ശേബവരെയും ഗിലെയാദ്‌ദേശത്തും ഉള്ള സഭയൊക്കെയും ഏകമനസ്സോടെ മിസ്പയിൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വന്നുകൂടി.
chapters.niv: Then all Israel from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came together as one and assembled before the Lord in Mizpah.
chapters.nkjv: So all the children of Israel came out, from Dan to Beersheba, as well as from the land of Gilead, and the congregation gathered together as one man before the Lord at Mizpah.
chapters.kjv: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകലഗോത്രങ്ങളുമായ സർവ്വജനത്തിന്റെയും പ്രധാനികളും ആയുധപാണികളായ നാലുലക്ഷം കാലാളും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ജനസംഘത്തിൽ വന്നുനിന്നു--
chapters.niv: The leaders of all the people of the tribes of Israel took their places in the assembly of God’s people, four hundred thousand men armed with swords.
chapters.nkjv: And the leaders of all the people, all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand foot soldiers who drew the sword.
chapters.kjv: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾ മിസ്പയിലേക്കു പോയി എന്നു ബെന്യാമീന്യർ കേട്ടു--അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ: ഈ ദോഷം എങ്ങിനെ സംഭവിച്ചു എന്നു പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു
chapters.niv: (The Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) Then the Israelites said, "Tell us how this awful thing happened."
chapters.nkjv: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) Then the children of Israel said, "Tell us, how did this wicked deed happen?"
chapters.kjv: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us , how was this wickedness?

chapters.ml: കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ട സ്ത്രീയുടെ ഭർത്താവായ ലേവ്യൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാനും എന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയും ബെന്യാമീൻ ദേശത്തു ഗിബെയയിൽ രാപാർപ്പാൻ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, said, "I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.
chapters.nkjv: So the Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered and said, "My concubine and I went into Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin, to spend the night.
chapters.kjv: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ഗിബെയാനിവാസികൾ എന്റെ നേരെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു രാത്രിയിൽ എന്റെ നിമിത്തം വീടുവളഞ്ഞു എന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു; എന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയെ അവർ ബലാൽക്കാരം ചെയ്തതിനാൽ അവൾ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: During the night the men of Gibeah came after me and surrounded the house, intending to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house at night because of me. They intended to kill me, but instead they ravished my concubine so that she died.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

chapters.ml: അവർ യിസ്രായേലിൽ ദുഷ്കർമ്മവും വഷളത്വവും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ എന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയെ ഖണ്ഡംഖണ്ഡമാക്കി യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ അവകാശദേശത്തൊക്കെയും കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: I took my concubine, cut her into pieces and sent one piece to each region of Israel’s inheritance, because they committed this lewd and outrageous act in Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So I took hold of my concubine, cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the territory of the inheritance of Israel, because they committed lewdness and outrage in Israel.
chapters.kjv: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും യിസ്രായേല്യരല്ലോ; ഇതിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ അഭിപ്രായവും ആലോചനയും പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Now, all you Israelites, speak up and tell me what you have decided to do."
chapters.nkjv: Look! All of you are children of Israel; give your advice and counsel here and now!"
chapters.kjv: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സർവ്വജനവും ഒന്നായിട്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു പറഞ്ഞതു: നമ്മിൽ ആരും തന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിലേക്കു പോകരുതു; ആരും വീട്ടിലേക്കു തിരികയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: All the men rose up together as one, saying, "None of us will go home. No, not one of us will return to his house.
chapters.nkjv: So all the people arose as one man, saying, "None ofus will go to his tent, nor will any turn back to his house;
chapters.kjv: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.

chapters.ml: നാം ഇപ്പോൾ ഗിബെയയോടു ചെയ്യേണ്ടുന്ന കാര്യമാവിതു: നാം അതു സംബന്ധിച്ചു ചീട്ടിടേണം;
chapters.niv: But now this is what we’ll do to Gibeah: We’ll go up against it in the order decided by casting lots.
chapters.nkjv: but now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: Wewillgoup against it by lot.
chapters.kjv: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;

chapters.ml: അവർ യിസ്രായേലിൽ പ്രവർത്തിച്ച സകലവഷളത്വത്തിന്നും പകരം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു ജനം ഗിബെയയിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ അവർക്കു വേണ്ടി ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങൾ പോയി കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ നൂറ്റിൽ പത്തുപേരെയും ആയിരത്തിൽ നൂറുപേരെയും പതിനായിരത്തിൽ ആയിരംപേരെയും എടുക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: We’ll take ten men out of every hundred from all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred from a thousand, and a thousand from ten thousand, to get provisions for the army. Then, when the army arrives at Gibeah in Benjamin, it can give them what they deserve for this outrageous act done in Israel."
chapters.nkjv: We will take ten men out of every hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, a hundred out of every thousand, and a thousand out of every ten thousand, to make provisions for the people, that when they come to Gibeah in Benjamin, they may repay all the vileness that they have done in Israel."
chapters.kjv: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഒക്കെയും ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു വിരോധമായി ഏകമനസ്സോടെ യോജിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So all the Israelites got together and united as one against the city.
chapters.nkjv: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, united together as one man.
chapters.kjv: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങൾ ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രത്തിലെങ്ങും ആളയച്ചു: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഇങ്ങനെ ഒരു ദോഷം നടന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: The tribes of Israel sent messengers throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What about this awful crime that was committed among you?
chapters.nkjv: Then the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What is this wickedness that has occurred among you?
chapters.kjv: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?

chapters.ml: ഗിബെയയിലെ ആ നീചന്മാരെ ഞങ്ങൾ കൊന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു ദോഷം നീക്കിക്കളയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരെ ഏല്പിച്ചു തരുവിൻ എന്നു പറയിച്ചു. ബെന്യാമീന്യരോ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളായ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ വാക്കു കേട്ടനുസരിപ്പാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു
chapters.niv: Now turn those wicked men of Gibeah over to us so that we may put them to death and purge the evil from Israel." But the Benjamites would not listen to their fellow Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, deliver up the men, the perverted men who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and remove the evil from Israel!" But the children of Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brethren, the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെടത്തക്കവണ്ണം തങ്ങളുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു ഗിബെയയിൽ വന്നുകൂടി.
chapters.niv: From their towns they came together at Gibeah to fight against the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: Instead, the children of Benjamin gathered together from their cities to Gibeah, to go to battle against the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ഗിബെയാനിവാസികളിൽ എണ്ണിത്തിരിച്ച എഴുനൂറു വിരുതന്മാരെ കൂടാതെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നു വന്ന ബെന്യാമീന്യർ ഇരുപത്താറയിരം ആയുധപാണികൾ ഉണ്ടെന്നു എണ്ണം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: At once the Benjamites mobilized twenty-six thousand swordsmen from their towns, in addition to seven hundred able young men from those living in Gibeah.
chapters.nkjv: And from their cities at that time the children of Benjamin numbered twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who numbered seven hundred select men.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

chapters.ml: ഈ ജനത്തിലെല്ലാം ഇടത്തു കയ്യന്മാരായ എഴുനൂറു വിരുതന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും ഒരു രോമത്തിന്നു പോലും ഏറുപിഴെക്കാത്ത കവിണക്കാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred select troops who were left-handed, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.
chapters.nkjv: Among all this people were seven hundred select men whowere left-handed; every one could sling a stone at a hair’s breadth and not miss.
chapters.kjv: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ ഒഴികെയുള്ള യിസ്രായേല്യരോ നാലുലക്ഷം ആയുധപാണികൾ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും യോദ്ധാക്കൾ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Israel, apart from Benjamin, mustered four hundred thousand swordsmen, all of them fit for battle.
chapters.nkjv: Now besides Benjamin, the men of Israel numbered four hundred thousand men who drew the sword; all of these were men of war.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ബേഥേലിലേക്കു ചെന്നു: ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടു പടവെട്ടുവാൻ ഞങ്ങളിൽ ആർ മുമ്പനായി ചെല്ലേണ്ടു എന്നു ദൈവത്തോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിച്ചു. യെഹൂദാ മുമ്പനായി ചെല്ലട്ടെ എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites went up to Bethel and inquired of God. They said, "Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Benjamites?" The Lord replied, "Judah shall go first."
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel arose and went up to the house of God to inquire of God. They said, "Which of us shall go up first to battle against the children of Benjamin?" The Lord said, "Judah first!"
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah shall go up first.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ രാവിലെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഗിബെയെക്കു നേരെ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The next morning the Israelites got up and pitched camp near Gibeah.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel rose in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഗിബെയയിൽ അവരുടെ നേരെ അണിനിരന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites went out to fight the Benjamites and took up battle positions against them at Gibeah.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin, and the men of Israel put themselves in battle array to fight against them at Gibeah.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്യരോ ഗിബെയയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു യിസ്രായേല്യരിൽ ഇരുപത്തീരായിരംപേരെ അന്നു സംഹരിച്ചു വീഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down twenty-two thousand Israelites on the battlefield that day.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day cut down to the ground twenty-two thousand men of the Israelites.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ചെന്നു സന്ധ്യവരെ കരഞ്ഞു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടു ഞങ്ങൾ ഇനിയും യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പോകേണമോ എന്നു യഹോവയോടുചോദിച്ചു. അവരുടെ നേരെ ചെല്ലുവിൻ എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But the Israelites encouraged one another and again took up their positions where they had stationed themselves the first day.
chapters.nkjv: And the people, that is, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves and again formed the battle line at the place where they had put themselves in array on the first day.
chapters.kjv: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേല്യരായ പടജ്ജനം ധൈര്യപ്പെട്ടു ഒന്നാം ദിവസം അണിനിരന്ന സ്ഥലത്തുതന്നേ പിന്നെയും പടെക്കു അണിനിരന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites went up and wept before the Lord until evening, and they inquired of the Lord . They said, "Shall we go up again to fight against the Benjamites, our fellow Israelites?" The Lord answered, "Go up against them."
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel went up and wept before the Lord until evening, and asked counsel of the Lord, saying, "Shall I again draw near for battle against the children of my brother Benjamin?" And the Lord said, "Go up against him."
chapters.kjv: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ രണ്ടാം ദിവസവും ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടു അടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel approached the children of Benjamin on the second day.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്യർ രണ്ടാം ദിവസവും ഗിബെയയിൽനിന്നു അവരുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളിൽ പിന്നെയും പതിനെണ്ണായിരംപേരെ സംഹരിച്ചു വീഴിച്ചു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും യോദ്ധാക്കൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This time, when the Benjamites came out from Gibeah to oppose them, they cut down another eighteen thousand Israelites, all of them armed with swords.
chapters.nkjv: And Benjamin went out against them from Gibeah on the second day, and cut down to the ground eighteen thousand more of the children of Israel; all these drew the sword.
chapters.kjv: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഒക്കെയും സർവ്വജനവും കയറി ബേഥേലിലേക്കു ചെന്നു; അവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു അന്നു സന്ധ്യവരെ ഉപവസിച്ചുപാർത്തു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then all the Israelites, the whole army, went up to Bethel, and there they sat weeping before the Lord . They fasted that day until evening and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then all the children of Israel, that is, all the people, went up and came to the house of God and wept. They sat there before the Lord and fasted that day until evening; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD , and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .
