chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യഹോവയോടു ചോദിച്ചു; അക്കാലത്തു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നിയമപെട്ടകം അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the Israelites inquired of the Lord . (In those days the ark of the covenant of God was there,
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel inquired of the Lord ( the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD , (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ മകനായ എലെയാസാരിന്റെ മകൻ ഫീനെഹാസ് ആയിരുന്നു അക്കാലത്തു തിരുസന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നിരുന്നതു. ഞങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടു ഞങ്ങൾ ഇനിയും പടയെടുക്കേണമോ? ഒഴിഞ്ഞുകളയേണമേ എന്നു അവർ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ചെല്ലുവിൻ; നാളെ ഞാൻ അവരെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, ministering before it.) They asked, "Shall we go up again to fight against the Benjamites, our fellow Israelites, or not?" The Lord responded, "Go, for tomorrow I will give them into your hands."
chapters.nkjv: and Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, "Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of my brother Benjamin, or shall I cease?" And the Lord said, "Go up, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hand."
chapters.kjv: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഗിബെയെക്കു ചുറ്റും പതിയിരിപ്പുകാരെ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Israel set men in ambush all around Gibeah.
chapters.kjv: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മൂന്നാം ദിവസവും ബെന്യാമീന്യരുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ ഗിബെയയുടെ നേരെ പടെക്കു അണിനിരന്നു.
chapters.niv: They went up against the Benjamites on the third day and took up positions against Gibeah as they had done before.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in battle array against Gibeah as at the other times.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്യർ പടജ്ജനത്തിന്റെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പട്ടണം വിട്ടു പുറത്തായി; ബേഥേലിലേക്കും വയലിൽക്കൂടി ഗിബെയയിലേക്കും പോകുന്ന രണ്ടു പെരുവഴികളിൽവെച്ചു മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ പടജ്ജനത്തിൽ ചിലരെ വെട്ടിത്തുടങ്ങി; യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഏകദേശം മുപ്പതുപേരെ കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Benjamites came out to meet them and were drawn away from the city. They began to inflict casualties on the Israelites as before, so that about thirty men fell in the open field and on the roads—the one leading to Bethel and the other to Gibeah.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city. They began to strike down and kill some of the people, as at the other times, in the highways (one of which goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah) and in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവർ മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ നമ്മുടെ മുമ്പിൽ തോറ്റോടുന്നു എന്നു ബെന്യാമീന്യർ പറഞ്ഞു. യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോ: നാം ഓടി അവരെ പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു പെരുവഴികളിലേക്കു ആകർഷിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: While the Benjamites were saying, "We are defeating them as before," the Israelites were saying, "Let’s retreat and draw them away from the city to the roads."
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Benjamin said, "They are defeated before us, as at first." But the children of Israel said, "Let us flee and draw them away from the city to the highways."
chapters.kjv: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഒക്കെയും തങ്ങളുടെ സ്ഥലത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ബാൽ--താമാരിൽ പടെക്കു അണിനിരന്നു; യിസ്രായേല്യരുടെ പതിയിരിപ്പുകാരം ഗിബെയയുടെ പുല്പുറത്തു തങ്ങൾ ഇരുന്നേടത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: All the men of Israel moved from their places and took up positions at Baal Tamar, and the Israelite ambush charged out of its place on the west of Gibeah.
chapters.nkjv: So all the men of Israel rose from their place and put themselves in battle array at Baal Tamar. Then Israel’s men in ambush burst forth from their position in the plain of Geba.
chapters.kjv: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

chapters.ml: എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരുന്ന പതിനായിരംപേർ ഗിബെയയുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു; പട കഠിനമായി മുറുകി; എങ്കിലും ആപത്തു അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവർ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then ten thousand of Israel’s able young men made a frontal attack on Gibeah. The fighting was so heavy that the Benjamites did not realize how near disaster was.
chapters.nkjv: And ten thousand select men from all Israel came against Gibeah, and the battle was fierce. But theBenjamites did not know that disaster was upon them.
chapters.kjv: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ബെന്യാമീന്യരെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ തോല്ക്കുമാറാക്കി; അന്നു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ബെന്യമീന്യരിൽ ഇരുപത്തയ്യായിരത്തൊരുനൂറുപേരെ സംഹരിച്ചു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും ആയുധപാണികൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord defeated Benjamin before Israel, and on that day the Israelites struck down 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord defeated Benjamin before Israel. And the children of Israel destroyed that day twenty-five thousand one hundred Benjamites; all these drew the sword.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ബെന്യാമീന്യർ തങ്ങൾ തോറ്റു എന്നു കണ്ടു; എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഗിബെയെക്കരികെ ആക്കിയിരുന്ന പതിയിരിപ്പുകാരെ വിശ്വസിച്ചിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ബെന്യാമീന്യർക്കു സ്ഥലം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the Benjamites saw that they were beaten. Now the men of Israel had given way before Benjamin, because they relied on the ambush they had set near Gibeah.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were defeated. The men of Israel had given ground to the Benjamites, because they relied on the men in ambush whom they had set against Gibeah.
chapters.kjv: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ പതിയിരിപ്പുകാർ ഗിബെയയിൽ പാഞ്ഞുകയറി; പതിയിരിപ്പുകാർ നീളെ നടന്നു പട്ടണത്തെയൊക്കെയും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Those who had been in ambush made a sudden dash into Gibeah, spread out and put the whole city to the sword.
chapters.nkjv: And the men in ambush quickly rushed upon Gibeah; the men in ambush spread out and struck the whole city with the edge of the sword.
chapters.kjv: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു അടയാളമായിട്ടു ഒരു വലിയ പുക പൊങ്ങുമാറാക്കേണമെന്നു യിസ്രായേല്യർ പതിയിരിപ്പുകാരുമായി പറഞ്ഞൊത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites had arranged with the ambush that they should send up a great cloud of smoke from the city,
chapters.nkjv: Now the appointed signal between the men of Israel and the men in ambush was that they would make a great cloud of smoke rise up from the city,
chapters.kjv: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ പടയിൽ പിൻവാങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ ബെന്യാമീന്യർ യിസ്രായേല്യരെ വെട്ടിത്തുടങ്ങി ഏകദേശം മുപ്പതുപേരെ കൊന്നു; മുൻ കഴിഞ്ഞ പടയിലെപ്പോലെ അവർ നമ്മുടെ മുമ്പിൽ തോറ്റോടുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and then the Israelites would counterattack. The Benjamites had begun to inflict casualties on the Israelites (about thirty), and they said, "We are defeating them as in the first battle."
chapters.nkjv: whereupon the men of Israel would turn in battle. Now Benjamin had begun to strike and kill about thirty of the men of Israel. For they said, "Surely they are defeated before us, as in the first battle."
chapters.kjv: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു അടയാളം ഒരു വലിയ പുകത്തൂണായി പൊങ്ങിത്തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ ബെന്യാമീന്യർ പിന്നോട്ടു നോക്കി; പട്ടണം മുഴുവനും ആകാശത്തോളം കത്തിപ്പൊങ്ങുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: But when the column of smoke began to rise from the city, the Benjamites turned and saw the whole city going up in smoke.
chapters.nkjv: But when the cloud began to rise from the city in a column of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and there was the whole city going up insmoke to heaven.
chapters.kjv: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ തിരിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ബെന്യാമീന്യർ തങ്ങൾക്കു ആപത്തു ഭവിച്ചു എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the Israelites counterattacked, and the Benjamites were terrified, because they realized that disaster had come on them.
chapters.nkjv: And when the men of Israel turned back, the men of Benjamin panicked, for they saw that disaster had come upon them.
chapters.kjv: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

chapters.ml: അവർ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കുള്ള വഴിക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു; പട അവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു; പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽനിന്നുള്ളവരെ അവർ അതതിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യേവെച്ചു സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they fled before the Israelites in the direction of the wilderness, but they could not escape the battle. And the Israelites who came out of the towns cut them down there.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they turned theirbacks before the men of Israel in the direction of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them, and whoever came out of the cities they destroyed in their midst.
chapters.kjv: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

chapters.ml: അവർ ബെന്യാമീന്യരെ വളഞ്ഞു ഓടിച്ചു ഗിബെയെക്കെതിരെ കിഴക്കു അവരുടെ വിശ്രാമസ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു പിടിക്കുടി.
chapters.niv: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them and easily overran them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.
chapters.nkjv: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and easily trampled them down as far as the front of Gibeah toward the east.
chapters.kjv: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ബെന്യാമീന്യരിൽ പതിനെണ്ണായിരംപേർ പട്ടുപോയി; അവർ എല്ലാവരും പരാക്രമശാലികൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.
chapters.nkjv: And eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.
chapters.kjv: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ തിരിഞ്ഞു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ രിമ്മോൻ പാറെക്കു ഓടി; അവരിൽ അയ്യായിരംപേരെ പെരുവഴികളിൽവെച്ചു ഒറ്റയൊറ്റയായി പിടിച്ചു കൊന്നു; മറ്റവരെ ഗിദോമോളം പിന്തുടർന്നു അവരിലും രണ്ടായിരം പേരെ വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, the Israelites cut down five thousand men along the roads. They kept pressing after the Benjamites as far as Gidom and struck down two thousand more.
chapters.nkjv: Then they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon; and they cut down five thousand of them on the highways. Then they pursued them relentlessly up to Gidom, and killed two thousand of them.
chapters.kjv: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ബെന്യാമീന്യരിൽ ആകെ ഇരുപത്തയ്യായിരം ആയുധപാണികൾ അന്നു പട്ടുപോയി; അവർ എല്ലാവരും പരാക്രമശാലികൾ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: On that day twenty-five thousand Benjamite swordsmen fell, all of them valiant fighters.
chapters.nkjv: So all who fell of Benjamin that day were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword; all these were men of valor.
chapters.kjv: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അറുനൂറുപേർ തിരിഞ്ഞു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ രിമ്മോൻ പാറവരെ ഓടി, അവിടെ നാലു മാസം പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: But six hundred of them turned and fled into the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.
chapters.nkjv: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and they stayed at the rock of Rimmon for four months.
chapters.kjv: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ പിന്നെയും ബെന്യാമീന്യരുടെ നേരെ തിരിഞ്ഞു ഓരോ പട്ടണം മുഴുവനെയും മൃഗങ്ങളെയും കണ്ട സകലത്തെയും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ സംഹരിച്ചു; അവർ കണ്ട എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളും തീവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The men of Israel went back to Benjamin and put all the towns to the sword, including the animals and everything else they found. All the towns they came across they set on fire.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Israel turned back against the children of Benjamin, and struck them down with the edge of the sword—from every city, men and beasts, all who were found. They also set fire to all the cities they came to.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നമ്മിൽ ആരും തന്റെ മകളെ ഒരു ബെന്യാമീന്യന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുക്കരുതു എന്നു യിസ്രായേല്യർ മിസ്പയിൽവെച്ചു ശപഥം ചെയ്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: "Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite."
chapters.nkjv: Now the men of Israel had sworn an oath at Mizpah, saying, "None of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife."
chapters.kjv: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ജനം ബേഥേലിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ സന്ധ്യവരെ ഇരുന്നു ഉച്ചത്തിൽ മഹാവിലാപം കഴിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: The people went to Bethel, where they sat before God until evening, raising their voices and weeping bitterly.
chapters.nkjv: Then the people came to the house of God, and remained there before God till evening. They lifted up their voices and wept bitterly,
chapters.kjv: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, ഇന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരുഗോത്രം ഇല്ലാതെപോകുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഇങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: " Lord , God of Israel," they cried, "why has this happened to Israel? Why should one tribe be missing from Israel today?"
chapters.nkjv: and said, "O Lord God of Israel, why has this come to pass in Israel, that today there should be one tribe missing in Israel?"
chapters.kjv: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ജനം അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവിടെ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Early the next day the people built an altar and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, on the next morning, that the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ: എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിലും യഹോവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ സഭെക്കു വരാതെ ആരെങ്കിലും ഉണ്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. മിസ്പയിൽ യഹോവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വരാത്തവൻ മരണശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണം എന്നു അവർ ഒരു ഉഗ്രശപഥം ചെയ്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Israelites asked, "Who from all the tribes of Israel has failed to assemble before the Lord ?" For they had taken a solemn oath that anyone who failed to assemble before the Lord at Mizpah was to be put to death.
chapters.nkjv: The children of Israel said, "Who isthere among all the tribes of Israel who did not come up with the assembly to the Lord?" For they had made a great oath concerning anyone who had not come up to the Lord at Mizpah, saying, "He shall surely be put to death."
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ബെന്യാമീന്യരെക്കുറിച്ചു അനുതപിച്ചു: ഇന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ഗോത്രം അറ്റുപോയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the Israelites grieved for the tribe of Benjamin, their fellow Israelites. "Today one tribe is cut off from Israel," they said.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, "One tribe is cut off from Israel today.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

chapters.ml: ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവർക്കു നമ്മുടെ പുത്രിമാരെ ഭാര്യമാരായി കൊടുക്കരുതു എന്നു നാം യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ സത്യംചെയ്തിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു ഭാര്യമാരെ കിട്ടുവാൻ നാം എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "How can we provide wives for those who are left, since we have taken an oath by the Lord not to give them any of our daughters in marriage?"
chapters.nkjv: What shall we do for wives for those who remain, seeing we have sworn by the Lord that we will not give them our daughters as wives?"
chapters.kjv: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു മിസ്പയിൽ യഹോവയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വരാതെ ആരെങ്കിലും ഉണ്ടോ എന്നു അവർ അന്വേഷിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശിൽ നിന്നു ആരും പാളയത്തിൽ സഭെക്കു വന്നിട്ടില്ല എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then they asked, "Which one of the tribes of Israel failed to assemble before the Lord at Mizpah?" They discovered that no one from Jabesh Gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "What one isthere from the tribes of Israel who did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord?" And, in fact, no one had come to the camp from Jabesh Gilead to the assembly.
chapters.kjv: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD ? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

chapters.ml: ജനത്തെ എണ്ണിനോക്കിയാറെ ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശ് നിവാസികളിൽ ആരും അവിടെ ഇല്ല എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.
chapters.nkjv: For when the people were counted, indeed, not one of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead was there.
chapters.kjv: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സഭ പരാക്രമശാലികളായ പന്തീരായിരംപേരെ അവിടേക്കു അയച്ചു അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശ് നിവാസികളെ സ്ത്രീകളും പൈതങ്ങളും ഉൾപടെ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ കൊല്ലുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: So the assembly sent twelve thousand fighting men with instructions to go to Jabesh Gilead and put to the sword those living there, including the women and children.
chapters.nkjv: So the congregation sent out there twelve thousand of their most valiant men, and commanded them, saying, "Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, including the women and children.
chapters.kjv: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

chapters.ml: അതിൽ നിങ്ങൾ പ്രവർത്തിക്കേണ്ടതു ഇവ്വണ്ണം: സകലപുരുഷന്മാരെയും പുരുഷനോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ച സകലസ്ത്രീകളെയും നിങ്ങൾ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "This is what you are to do," they said. "Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin."
chapters.nkjv: And this is the thing that you shall do: You shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has known a man intimately."
chapters.kjv: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തതിൽ ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശ് നിവാസികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പുരുഷനുമായി ശയിച്ചു പുരുഷസംസർഗ്ഗം ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ലാത്ത നാനൂറു കന്യകമാരെ കണ്ടെത്തി അവരെ കനാൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ശീലോവിൽ പാളയത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: They found among the people living in Jabesh Gilead four hundred young women who had never slept with a man, and they took them to the camp at Shiloh in Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: So they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known a man intimately; and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
chapters.kjv: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

chapters.ml: സർവ്വസഭയും രിമ്മോൻ പാറയിലെ ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു സമാധാനം അറിയിപ്പാൻ ആളയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the whole assembly sent an offer of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.
chapters.nkjv: Then the whole congregation sent word to the children of Benjamin who were at the rock of Rimmon, and announced peace to them.
chapters.kjv: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ബെന്യാമീന്യർ മടങ്ങിവന്നു; ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശിലുള്ള സ്ത്രീകളിൽവെച്ചു അവർ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരുന്നവരെ അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു;
chapters.niv: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.
chapters.nkjv: So Benjamin came back at that time, and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead; and yet they had not found enough for them.
chapters.kjv: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു തികെഞ്ഞില്ല. യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ ഒരു ഛേദം വരുത്തിയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു ജനം ബെന്യാമീന്യരെക്കുറിച്ചു ദുഃഖിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And the people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a void in the tribes of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

chapters.ml: ശേഷിച്ചവർക്കു സ്ത്രീകളെ കിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു നാം എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു? ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽനിന്നു സ്ത്രീകൾ അറ്റുപോയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു സഭയിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And the elders of the assembly said, "With the women of Benjamin destroyed, how shall we provide wives for the men who are left?
chapters.nkjv: Then the elders of the congregation said, "What shall we do for wives for those who remain, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?"
chapters.kjv: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ഗോത്രം നശിച്ചു പോകാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ബെന്യാമീന്യരിൽ രക്ഷപ്പെട്ടവർക്കു അവരുടെ അവകാശം നിൽക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The Benjamite survivors must have heirs," they said, "so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "Theremustbe an inheritance for the survivors of Benjamin, that a tribe may not be destroyed from Israel.
chapters.kjv: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നമുക്കു നമ്മുടെ പുത്രിമാരെ അവർക്കു ഭാര്യമാരായി കൊടുത്തുകൂടാ; ബെന്യാമീന്യർക്കു സ്ത്രീയെ കൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ശപഥം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നും അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We can’t give them our daughters as wives, since we Israelites have taken this oath: ‘Cursed be anyone who gives a wife to a Benjamite.’
chapters.nkjv: However, we cannot give them wives from our daughters, for the children of Israel have sworn an oath, saying, ‘Cursed be the one who gives a wife to Benjamin.’ "
chapters.kjv: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ: ബേഥേലിന്നു വടക്കും ബേഥേലിൽനിന്നു ശെഖേമിലേക്കു പോകുന്ന പെരുവഴിക്കു കിഴക്കും ലെബോനെക്കു തെക്കും ശീലോവിൽ ആണ്ടുതോറും യഹോവയുടെ ഉത്സവം ഉണ്ടല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But look, there is the annual festival of the Lord in Shiloh, which lies north of Bethel, east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said, "In fact, thereis a yearly feast of the Lord in Shiloh, which is north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."
chapters.kjv: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവർ ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളിൽ പതിയിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, "Go and hide in the vineyards
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they instructed the children of Benjamin, saying, "Go, lie in wait in the vineyards,
chapters.kjv: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

chapters.ml: ശീലോവിലെ കന്യകമാർ നിരനിരയായി നൃത്തംചെയ്‍വാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വരുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾ കാണുമ്പോൾ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഓരോരുത്തൻ ശീലോവിലെ കന്യകമാരിൽനിന്നു ഭാര്യയെ പിടിച്ചു ബെന്യാമീൻ ദേശത്തേക്കു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and watch. When the young women of Shiloh come out to join in the dancing, rush from the vineyards and each of you seize one of them to be your wife. Then return to the land of Benjamin.
chapters.nkjv: and watch; and just when the daughters of Shiloh come out to perform their dances, then come out from the vineyards, and every man catch a wife for himself from the daughters of Shiloh; then go to the land of Benjamin.
chapters.kjv: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അപ്പന്മാരോ ആങ്ങളമാരോ ഞങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു സങ്കടം പറഞ്ഞാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ അവരോടു: അവരെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ദാനം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; നാം പടയിൽ അവർക്കെല്ലാവർക്കും ഭാര്യമാരെ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവന്നില്ല; നിങ്ങൾ കുറ്റക്കാരാകുവാൻ നിങ്ങൾ ഇക്കാലത്തു അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തിട്ടും ഇല്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു കൊള്ളാം.
chapters.niv: When their fathers or brothers complain to us, we will say to them, ‘Do us the favor of helping them, because we did not get wives for them during the war. You will not be guilty of breaking your oath because you did not give your daughters to them.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then it shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to us to complain, that we will say to them, ‘Be kind to them for our sakes, because we did not take a wife for any of them in the war; for itis not asthough you have given the women to them at this time, making yourselves guilty of your oath.’ "
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമിന്യർ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു; നൃത്തംചെയ്യുന്ന സ്ത്രീകളെ തങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം പിടിച്ചു, തങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു പട്ടണങ്ങളെ വീണ്ടും പണിതു അവയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So that is what the Benjamites did. While the young women were dancing, each man caught one and carried her off to be his wife. Then they returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the towns and settled in them.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Benjamin did so; they took enough wives for their number from those who danced, whom they caught. Then they went and returned to their inheritance, and they rebuilt the cities and dwelt in them.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളും ആ കാലത്തു അവിടം വിട്ടു ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ ഗോത്രത്തിലേക്കും വീട്ടിലേക്കും പോയി; അങ്ങനെ അവർ അവിടം വിട്ടു ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ അവകാശത്തിലേക്കു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: At that time the Israelites left that place and went home to their tribes and clans, each to his own inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and family; they went out from there, every man to his inheritance.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവില്ലായിരുന്നു; ഓരോരുത്തൻ തനിക്കു ബോധിച്ചതുപോലെ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.
chapters.nkjv: In those days therewas no king in Israel; everyone did whatwas right in his own eyes.
chapters.kjv: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

chapters.ml: ന്യായാധിപന്മാർ ന്യായപാലനം നടത്തിയ കാലത്തു ഒരിക്കൽ ദേശത്തു ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായി; യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിലുള്ള ഒരു ആൾ തന്റെ ഭാര്യയും രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരുമായി മോവാബ്‌ദേശത്ത് പരദേശിയായി പാർപ്പാൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. So a man from Bethlehem in Judah, together with his wife and two sons, went to live for a while in the country of Moab.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehem, Judah, went to dwell in the country of Moab, he and his wife and his two sons.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു എലീമേലെക്ക് എന്നും ഭാര്യക്കു നൊവൊമി എന്നും രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാർക്കു മഹ്ളോൻ എന്നും കില്യോൻ എന്നും പേർ. അവർ യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളഹെമിൽനിന്നുള്ള എഫ്രാത്യർ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ മോവാബ്‌ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു അവിടെ താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The man’s name was Elimelek, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Kilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to Moab and lived there.
chapters.nkjv: The name of the man was Elimelech, the name of his wife was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion— Ephrathites of Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to the country of Moab and remained there.
chapters.kjv: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നൊവൊമിയുടെ ഭർത്താവായ എലീമേലെക്ക് മരിച്ചു; അവളും രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരും ശേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Elimelek, Naomi’s husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left, and her two sons.
chapters.kjv: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

chapters.ml: അവർ മോവാബ്യസ്ത്രീകളെ വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചു. ഒരുത്തിക്കു ഒർപ്പാ എന്നും മറ്റവൾക്കു രൂത്ത് എന്നും പേർ; അവർ ഏകദേശം പത്തു സംവത്സരം അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: They married Moabite women, one named Orpah and the other Ruth. After they had lived there about ten years,
chapters.nkjv: Now they took wives of the women of Moab: the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth. And they dwelt there about ten years.
chapters.kjv: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മഹ്ളോനും കില്യോനും ഇരുവരും മരിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരും ഭർത്താവും കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ആ സ്ത്രീ മാത്രം ശേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: both Mahlon and Kilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and her husband.
chapters.nkjv: Then both Mahlon and Chilion also died; so the woman survived her two sons and her husband.
chapters.kjv: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ ജനത്തെ സന്ദർശിച്ചു ആഹാരം കൊടുത്തപ്രകാരം അവൾ മോവാബ്‌ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു കേട്ടിട്ടു മോവാബ്‌ദേശം വിട്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവാൻ തന്റെ മരുമക്കളോടുകൂടെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Naomi heard in Moab that the Lord had come to the aid of his people by providing food for them, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to return home from there.
chapters.nkjv: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law that she might return from the country of Moab, for she had heard in the country of Moab that the Lord had visited His people by giving them bread.
chapters.kjv: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൾ മരുമക്കളുമായി പാർത്തിരുന്ന സ്ഥലം വിട്ടു യെഹൂദാദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവാൻ യാത്രയായി.
chapters.niv: With her two daughters-in-law she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore she went out from the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നൊവൊമി മരുമക്കൾ ഇരുവരോടും: നിങ്ങൾ താന്താന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവിൻ; മരിച്ചവരോടും എന്നോടും നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ യഹോവ നിങ്ങളോടും ദയചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go back, each of you, to your mother’s home. May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.
chapters.nkjv: And Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go, return each to her mother’s house. The Lord deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
chapters.kjv: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ താന്താന്റെ ഭർത്താവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വിശ്രാമം പ്രാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കൃപ നല്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവരെ ചുംബിച്ചു; അവർ ഉച്ചത്തിൽ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: May the Lord grant that each of you will find rest in the home of another husband." Then she kissed them goodbye and they wept aloud
chapters.nkjv: The Lord grant that you may find rest, each in the house of her husband." So she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices and wept.
chapters.kjv: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവളോടു: ഞങ്ങളും നിന്നോടുകൂടെ നിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said to her, "We will go back with you to your people."
chapters.nkjv: And they said to her, "Surely we will return with you to your people."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു നൊവൊമി പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ മക്കളേ, നിങ്ങൾ മടങ്ങിപ്പൊയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ; എന്തിന്നു എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരുന്നു? നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഭർത്താക്കന്മാരായിരിപ്പാൻ ഇനി എന്റെ ഉദരത്തിൽ പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: But Naomi said, "Return home, my daughters. Why would you come with me? Am I going to have any more sons, who could become your husbands?
chapters.nkjv: But Naomi said, "Turn back, my daughters; why will you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
chapters.kjv: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മക്കളേ, മടങ്ങിപ്പൊയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ; ഒരു പുരുഷന്നു ഭാര്യയായിരിപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു പ്രായം കഴിഞ്ഞുപോയി; അല്ല, അങ്ങനെ ഒരു ആശ എനിക്കുണ്ടായിട്ടു ഈ രാത്രി തന്നേ ഒരു പുരുഷന്നു ഭാര്യയായി പുത്രന്മാരെ പ്രസവിച്ചാലും
chapters.niv: Return home, my daughters; I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was still hope for me—even if I had a husband tonight and then gave birth to sons—
chapters.nkjv: Turn back, my daughters, go—for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say I have hope, if I should have a husband tonight and should also bear sons,
chapters.kjv: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു പ്രായമാകുവോളം നിങ്ങൾ അവർക്കായിട്ടു കാത്തിരിക്കുമോ? നിങ്ങൾ ഭർത്താക്കന്മാരെ എടുക്കാതെ നില്ക്കുമോ? അതു വേണ്ടാ, എന്റെ മക്കളേ; യഹോവയുടെ കൈ എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കയാൽ നിങ്ങളെ വിചാരിച്ചു ഞാൻ വളരെ വ്യസനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: would you wait until they grew up? Would you remain unmarried for them? No, my daughters. It is more bitter for me than for you, because the Lord ’s hand has turned against me!"
chapters.nkjv: would you wait for them till they were grown? Would you restrain yourselves from having husbands? No, my daughters; for it grieves me very much for your sakes that the hand of the Lord has gone out against me!"
chapters.kjv: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.

chapters.ml: അവർ പിന്നെയും പൊട്ടിക്കരഞ്ഞു; ഒർപ്പാ അമ്മാവിയമ്മയെ ചുംബിച്ചു പിരിഞ്ഞു; രൂത്തോ അവളോടു പറ്റിനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: At this they wept aloud again. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.
chapters.nkjv: Then they lifted up their voices and wept again; and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clung to her.
chapters.kjv: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൾ: നിന്റെ സഹോദരി തന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെയും തന്റെ ദേവന്റെയും അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിപ്പോയല്ലോ; നീയും നിന്റെ സഹോദരിയുടെ പിന്നാലെ പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Look," said Naomi, "your sister-in-law is going back to her people and her gods. Go back with her."
chapters.nkjv: And she said, "Look, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods; return after your sister-in-law."
chapters.kjv: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു രൂത്ത്: നിന്നെ വിട്ടുപിരിവാനും നിന്റെ കൂടെ വരാതെ മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവാനും എന്നോടു പറയരുതേ; നീ പോകുന്നേടത്തു ഞാനും പോരും; നീ പാർക്കുന്നേടത്തു ഞാനും പാർക്കും; നിന്റെ ജനം എന്റെ ജനം, നിന്റെ ദൈവം എന്റെ ദൈവം.
chapters.niv: But Ruth replied, "Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.
chapters.nkjv: But Ruth said: "Entreat me not to leave you, Orto turn back from following after you; For wherever you go, I will go; And wherever you lodge, I will lodge; Your people shallbe my people, And your God, my God.
chapters.kjv: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

chapters.ml: നീ മരിക്കുന്നേടത്തു ഞാനും മരിച്ചു അടക്കപ്പെടും; മരണത്താലല്ലാതെ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വിട്ടുപിരിഞ്ഞാൽ യഹോവ തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും എന്നോടു ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Where you die I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord deal with me, be it ever so severely, if even death separates you and me."
chapters.nkjv: Where you die, I will die, And there will I be buried. The Lord do so to me, and more also, If anythingbut death parts you and me."
chapters.kjv: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.

chapters.ml: തന്നോടു കൂടെ പോരുവാൻ അവൾ ഉറെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവൾ അവളോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു മതിയാക്കി.
chapters.niv: When Naomi realized that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.
chapters.nkjv: When she saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped speaking to her.
chapters.kjv: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ രണ്ടുപേരും ബേത്ത്ളേഹെംവരെ നടന്നു; അവർ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ പട്ടണം മുഴുവനും അവരുടെനിമിത്തം ഇളകി; ഇവൾ നൊവൊമിയോ എന്നു സ്ത്രീജനം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the two women went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women exclaimed, "Can this be Naomi?"
chapters.nkjv: Now the two of them went until they came to Bethlehem. And it happened, when they had come to Bethlehem, that all the city was excited because of them; and the women said, "Is this Naomi?"
chapters.kjv: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നൊവൊമി എന്നല്ല മാറാ എന്നു എന്നെ വിളിപ്പിൻ; സർവ്വശക്തൻ എന്നോടു ഏറ്റവും കൈപ്പായുള്ളതു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Don’t call me Naomi, " she told them. "Call me Mara, because the Almighty has made my life very bitter.
chapters.nkjv: But she said to them, "Do not call me Naomi; call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
chapters.kjv: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

chapters.ml: നിറഞ്ഞവളായി ഞാൻ പോയി, ഒഴിഞ്ഞവളായി യഹോവ എന്നെ മടക്കിവരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു; യഹോവ എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി സാക്ഷീകരിക്കയും സർവ്വശക്തൻ എന്നെ ദുഃഖിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കെ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ നൊവൊമി എന്നു വിളിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? The Lord has afflicted me; the Almighty has brought misfortune upon me."
chapters.nkjv: I went out full, and the Lord has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the Lord has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?"
chapters.kjv: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ നൊവൊമി മോവാബ്‌ദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൂടെ പോന്ന മരുമകൾ രൂത്ത് എന്ന മോവാബ്യസ്ത്രീയുമായി മടങ്ങിവന്നു; അവർ യവക്കൊയ്ത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭത്തിൽ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: So Naomi returned from Moab accompanied by Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, arriving in Bethlehem as the barley harvest was beginning.
chapters.nkjv: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess her daughter-in-law with her, who returned from the country of Moab. Now they came to Bethlehem at the beginning of barley harvest.
chapters.kjv: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

chapters.ml: നൊവൊമിക്കു തന്റെ ഭർത്താവായ എലീമേലെക്കിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിൽ മഹാധനവാനായ ഒരു ചാർച്ചക്കാരൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു ബോവസ് എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a man of standing from the clan of Elimelek, whose name was Boaz.
chapters.nkjv: There was a relative of Naomi’s husband, a man of great wealth, of the family of Elimelech. His name was Boaz.
chapters.kjv: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മോവാബ്യസ്ത്രീയായ രൂത്ത് നൊവൊമിയോടു: ഞാൻ വയലിൽ ചെന്നു എന്നോടു ദയ കാണിക്കുന്നവനെ ആശ്രയിച്ചു കതിർ പെറുക്കട്ടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക മകളേ എന്നു അവൾ അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, "Let me go to the fields and pick up the leftover grain behind anyone in whose eyes I find favor." Naomi said to her, "Go ahead, my daughter."
chapters.nkjv: So Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, "Please let me go to the field, and glean heads of grain after him in whose sight I may find favor." And she said to her, "Go, my daughter."
chapters.kjv: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൾ പോയി; വയലിൽ കൊയ്ത്തുകാരുടെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു പെറുക്കി; ഭാഗ്യവശാൽ അവൾ എലീമേലെക്കിന്റെ കുടുംബക്കാരനായ ബോവസിന്നുള്ള വയലിൽ ആയിരുന്നു ചെന്നതു.
chapters.niv: So she went out, entered a field and began to glean behind the harvesters. As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelek.
chapters.nkjv: Then she left, and went and gleaned in the field after the reapers. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
chapters.kjv: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, ബോവസ് ബേത്ത്ളെഹെമിൽനിന്നു വരുന്നു; അവൻ കൊയ്ത്തുകാരോടു: യഹോവ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. യഹോവ നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു അവർ അവനോടും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters, "The Lord be with you!" "The Lord bless you!" they answered.
chapters.nkjv: Now behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, "The Lordbe with you!" And they answered him, "The Lord bless you!"
chapters.kjv: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.

chapters.ml: കൊയ്ത്തുകാരുടെ മേലാളായിരുന്ന ഭൃത്യനോടു: ഈ യുവതി ഏതു എന്നു ബോവസ് ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Boaz asked the overseer of his harvesters, "Who does that young woman belong to?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Boaz said to his servant who was in charge of the reapers, "Whose young woman is this?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?

chapters.ml: കൊയ്ത്തുകാരുടെ മേലാളായ ഭൃത്യൻ: ഇവൾ മോവാബ്ദേശത്തുനിന്നു നൊവൊമിയോടുകൂടെ വന്ന മോവാബ്യയുവതിയാകുന്നു;
chapters.niv: The overseer replied, "She is the Moabite who came back from Moab with Naomi.
chapters.nkjv: So the servant who was in charge of the reapers answered and said, "It is the young Moabite woman who came back with Naomi from the country of Moab.
chapters.kjv: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കൊയ്ത്തുകാരുടെ പിന്നാലെ കറ്റകളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പെറുക്കിക്കൊള്ളട്ടെ എന്നു അവൾ ചോദിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അവൾ കാലത്തു വന്നു ഇതുവരെ പെറുക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; വീട്ടിൽ അല്പനേരമേ താമസിച്ചുള്ളു എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.’ She came into the field and has remained here from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter."
chapters.nkjv: And she said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came and has continued from morning until now, though she rested a little in the house."
chapters.kjv: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

chapters.ml: ബോവസ് രൂത്തിനോടു: കേട്ടോ മകളേ, പെറുക്കുവാൻ വേറൊരു വയലിൽ പോകേണ്ടാ; ഇവിടം വിടുകയും വേണ്ടാ; ഇവിടെ എന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരത്തികളോടു ചേർന്നുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: So Boaz said to Ruth, "My daughter, listen to me. Don’t go and glean in another field and don’t go away from here. Stay here with the women who work for me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Boaz said to Ruth, "You will listen, my daughter, will you not? Do not go to glean in another field, nor go from here, but stay close by my young women.
chapters.kjv: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:

chapters.ml: അവർ കൊയ്യുന്ന നിലത്തിന്മേൽ ദൃഷ്ടിവെച്ചു അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; ബാല്യക്കാർ നിന്നെ തൊടരുതെന്നു ഞാൻ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു. നിനക്കു ദാഹിക്കുമ്പോൾ പാത്രങ്ങൾക്കരികെ ചെന്നു ബാല്യക്കാർ കോരിവെച്ചതിൽനിന്നു കുടിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the women. I have told the men not to lay a hand on you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and get a drink from the water jars the men have filled."
chapters.nkjv: Let your eyes be on the field which they reap, and go after them. Have I not commanded the young men not to touch you? And when you are thirsty, go to the vessels and drink from what the young men have drawn."
chapters.kjv: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവൾ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു അവനോടു: ഞാൻ അന്യദേശക്കാരത്തി ആയിരിക്കെ നീ എന്നെ വിചാരിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിനക്കു എന്നോടു ദയതോന്നിയതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground. She asked him, "Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me—a foreigner?"
chapters.nkjv: So she fell on her face, bowed down to the ground, and said to him, "Why have I found favor in your eyes, that you should take notice of me, since I am a foreigner?"
chapters.kjv: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger?

chapters.ml: ബോവസ് അവളോടു: നിന്റെ ഭർത്താവു മരിച്ചശേഷം അമ്മാവിയമ്മെക്കു നീ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതും നിന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും സ്വദേശത്തെയും വിട്ടു, മുമ്പെ അറിയാത്ത ജനത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതുമായ വിവരമൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Boaz replied, "I’ve been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband—how you left your father and mother and your homeland and came to live with a people you did not know before.
chapters.nkjv: And Boaz answered and said to her, "It has been fully reported to me, all that you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father and your mother and the land of your birth, and have come to a people whom you did not know before.
chapters.kjv: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു യഹോവ പകരം നല്കട്ടെ; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ചിറകിൻ കീഴെ ആശ്രയിച്ചുവന്നിരിക്കുന്ന നിനക്കു അവൻ പൂർണ്ണപ്രതിഫലം തരുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord , the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge."
chapters.nkjv: The Lord repay your work, and a full reward be given you by the Lord God of Israel, under whose wings you have come for refuge."
chapters.kjv: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൾ: യജമാനനേ, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ദാസിമാരിൽ ഒരുത്തിയെപ്പോലെയല്ല എന്നുവരികിലും നീ എന്നെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കയും അടിയനോടു ദയയായി സംസാരിക്കയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം എന്നോടു നിനക്കു കൃപതോന്നിയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord," she said. "You have put me at ease by speaking kindly to your servant—though I do not have the standing of one of your servants."
chapters.nkjv: Then she said, "Let me find favor in your sight, my lord; for you have comforted me, and have spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your maidservants."
chapters.kjv: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.

chapters.ml: ഭക്ഷണസമയത്തു ബോവസ് അവളോടു: ഇവിടെ വന്നു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്ക; കഷണം ചാറ്റിൽ മുക്കിക്കൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൾ കൊയ്ത്തുകാരുടെ അരികെ ഇരുന്നു; അവൻ അവൾക്കു മലർ കൊടുത്തു; അവൾ തിന്നു തൃപ്തയായി ശേഷിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: At mealtime Boaz said to her, "Come over here. Have some bread and dip it in the wine vinegar." When she sat down with the harvesters, he offered her some roasted grain. She ate all she wanted and had some left over.
chapters.nkjv: Now Boaz said to her at mealtime, "Come here, and eat of the bread, and dip your piece of bread in the vinegar." So she sat beside the reapers, and he passed parched grain to her; and she ate and was satisfied, and kept some back.
chapters.kjv: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn , and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പെറുക്കുവാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ ബോവസ് തന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരോടു: അവൾ കറ്റകളുടെ ഇടയിൽതന്നേ പെറുക്കിക്കൊള്ളട്ടെ; അവളെ ഉപദ്രവിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: As she got up to glean, Boaz gave orders to his men, "Let her gather among the sheaves and don’t reprimand her.
chapters.nkjv: And when she rose up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, "Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not reproach her.
chapters.kjv: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:

chapters.ml: പെറുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൾക്കായിട്ടു കറ്റകളിൽനിന്നു വലിച്ചിട്ടേക്കേണം; അവളെ ശകാരിക്കരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Even pull out some stalks for her from the bundles and leave them for her to pick up, and don’t rebuke her."
chapters.nkjv: Also let grain from the bundles fall purposely for her; leave it that she may glean, and do not rebuke her."
chapters.kjv: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൾ വൈകുന്നേരംവരെ പെറുക്കി; പെറുക്കിയതു മെതിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഏകദേശം ഒരുപറ യവം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Ruth gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.
chapters.nkjv: So she gleaned in the field until evening, and beat out what she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
chapters.kjv: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അതു എടുത്തുംകൊണ്ടു പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു പോയി; അവൾ പെറുക്കിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു അമ്മാവിയമ്മ കണ്ടു; താൻ തിന്നു ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നതും അവൾ എടുത്തു അവൾക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.
chapters.nkjv: Then she took it up and went into the city, and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. So she brought out and gave to her what she had kept back after she had been satisfied.
chapters.kjv: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.

chapters.ml: അമ്മാവിയമ്മ അവളോടു: നീ ഇന്നു എവിടെയായിരുന്നു പെറുക്കിയതു? എവിടെയായിരുന്നു വേല ചെയ്തതു? നിന്നോടു ആദരവു കാണിച്ചവൻ ആനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. താൻ ഇന്ന ആളുടെ അടുക്കലായിരുന്നു വേല ചെയ്തതു എന്നു അവൾ അമ്മാവിയമ്മയോടു അറിയിച്ചു: ബോവസ് എന്നൊരു ആളുടെ അടുക്കലായിരുന്നു ഞാൻ ഇന്നു വേല ചെയ്തതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Her mother-in-law asked her, "Where did you glean today? Where did you work? Blessed be the man who took notice of you!" Then Ruth told her mother-in-law about the one at whose place she had been working. "The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz," she said.
chapters.nkjv: And her mother-in-law said to her, "Where have you gleaned today? And where did you work? Blessed be the one who took notice of you." So she told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, and said, "The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz."
chapters.kjv: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man’s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.

chapters.ml: നൊവൊമി മരുമകളോടു: ജീവനുള്ളവരോടും മരിച്ചവരോടും ദയവിടാതിരിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയാൽ അവൻ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അയാൾ നമുക്കു അടുത്ത ചാർച്ചക്കാരനും നമ്മുടെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും ആകുന്നു എന്നും നൊവൊമി അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The Lord bless him!" Naomi said to her daughter-in-law. "He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead." She added, "That man is our close relative; he is one of our guardian-redeemers. "
chapters.nkjv: Then Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, "Blessed be he of the Lord, who has not forsaken His kindness to the living and the dead!" And Naomi said to her, "This man is a relation of ours, one of our close relatives."
chapters.kjv: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of the LORD , who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാർ കൊയ്ത്തെല്ലാം തീർക്കുവോളം അവരോടു ചേന്നിരിക്ക എന്നുകൂടെ അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു മോവാബ്യസ്ത്രീയായ രൂത്ത് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Ruth the Moabite said, "He even said to me, ‘Stay with my workers until they finish harvesting all my grain.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Ruth the Moabitess said, "He also said to me, ‘You shall stay close by my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’ "
chapters.kjv: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.

chapters.ml: നൊവൊമി തന്റെ മരുമകളായ രൂത്തിനോടു: മകളേ, വെറൊരു വയലിൽവെച്ചു ആരും നിന്നെ ഉപദ്രവിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ അവന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരത്തികളോടുകൂടെ തന്നേ പോകുന്നതു നന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, "It will be good for you, my daughter, to go with the women who work for him, because in someone else’s field you might be harmed."
chapters.nkjv: And Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, "Itis good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, and that people do not meet you in any other field."
chapters.kjv: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൾ യവക്കൊയ്ത്തും കോതമ്പുകൊയ്ത്തും തീരുവോളം പെറുക്കുവാൻ ബോവസിന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരത്തികളോടു ചേർന്നിരിക്കയും അമ്മാവിയമ്മയോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
chapters.nkjv: So she stayed close by the young women of Boaz, to glean until the end of barley harvest and wheat harvest; and she dwelt with her mother-in-law.
chapters.kjv: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവളുടെ അമ്മാവിയമ്മയായ നൊവൊമി അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: മകളേ, നിനക്കു നന്നായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിനക്കു വേണ്ടി ഒരു വിശ്രാമസ്ഥലം അന്വേഷിക്കേണ്ടയോ?
chapters.niv: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her, "My daughter, I must find a home for you, where you will be well provided for.
chapters.nkjv: Then Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, "My daughter, shall I not seek security for you, that it may be well with you?
chapters.kjv: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?

chapters.ml: നീ ചേർന്നിരുന്ന ബാല്യക്കാരത്തികളുടെ യജമാനനായ ബോവസ് നമ്മുടെ ചാർച്ചക്കാരനല്ലയോ? അവൻ ഇന്നു രാത്രി കളത്തിൽ യവം തൂറ്റുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Boaz, with whose women you have worked, is a relative of ours. Tonight he will be winnowing barley on the threshing floor.
chapters.nkjv: Now Boaz, whose young women you were with, ishe not our relative? In fact, he is winnowing barley tonight at the threshing floor.
chapters.kjv: And now is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ കുളിച്ചു തൈലം പൂശി വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു കളത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുക; ആയാൾ തിന്നു കുടിച്ചു കഴിയുംവരെ നിന്നെ കാണരുതു.
chapters.niv: Wash, put on perfume, and get dressed in your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but don’t let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore wash yourself and anoint yourself, put on your best garment and go down to the threshing floor; but do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
chapters.kjv: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.

chapters.ml: ഉറങ്ങുവാൻ പോകുമ്പോൾ അവൻ കിടക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലം മനസ്സിലാക്കി ചെന്നു അവന്റെ കാലിന്മേലുള്ള പുതപ്പു പൊക്കി അവിടെ കിടന്നു കൊൾക; എന്നാൽ നീ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണമെന്നു അവൻ നിനക്കു പറഞ്ഞുതരും.
chapters.niv: When he lies down, note the place where he is lying. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down. He will tell you what to do."
chapters.nkjv: Then it shall be, when he lies down, that you shall notice the place where he lies; and you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down; and he will tell you what you should do."
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൾ: നീ പറയുന്നതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ ചെയ്യാം എന്നു അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I will do whatever you say," Ruth answered.
chapters.nkjv: And she said to her, "All that you say to me I will do."
chapters.kjv: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൾ കളത്തിൽ ചെന്നു അമ്മാവിയമ്മ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law told her to do.
chapters.nkjv: So she went down to the threshing floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law instructed her.
chapters.kjv: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.

chapters.ml: ബോവസ് തിന്നു കുടിച്ചു ഹൃദയം തെളിഞ്ഞശേഷം യവക്കൂമ്പാരത്തിന്റെ ഒരു വശത്തു ചെന്നു കിടന്നു; അവളും പതുക്കെ ചെന്നു അവന്റെ കാലിന്മേലുള്ള പുതപ്പു പൊക്കി അവിടെ കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.
chapters.nkjv: And after Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was cheerful, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain; and she came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
chapters.kjv: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.

chapters.ml: അർദ്ധരാത്രിയിൽ അവൻ ഞെട്ടിത്തിരിഞ്ഞു, തന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു. നീ ആർ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the middle of the night something startled the man; he turned—and there was a woman lying at his feet!
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened at midnight that the man was startled, and turned himself; and there, a woman was lying at his feet.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ദാസിയായ രൂത്ത്; നിന്റെ പുതപ്പു അടിയന്റെ മേൽ ഇടേണമേ; നീ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരനല്ലോ എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Who are you?" he asked. "I am your servant Ruth," she said. "Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer of our family."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Who are you?" So she answered, "I am Ruth, your maidservant. Take your maidservant under your wing, for you are a close relative."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: മകളേ, നീ യഹോവയാൽ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൾ; ദരിദ്രന്മാരോ ധനവാന്മാരോ ആയ ബാല്യക്കാരെ നീ പിന്തുടരാതിരിക്കയാൽ ആദ്യത്തേതിൽ അധികം ദയ ഒടുവിൽ കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The Lord bless you, my daughter," he replied. "This kindness is greater than that which you showed earlier: You have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Blessed are you of the Lord, my daughter! For you have shown more kindness at the end than at the beginning, in that you did not go after young men, whether poor or rich.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Blessed be thou of the LORD , my daughter: for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ മകളേ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; നീ ചോദിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ ചെയ്തുതരാം; നീ ഉത്തമ സ്ത്രീ എന്നു എന്റെ ജനമായ പട്ടണക്കാർക്കും എല്ലാവർക്കും അറിയാം.
chapters.niv: And now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.
chapters.nkjv: And now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do for you all that you request, for all the people of my town know that you are a virtuous woman.
chapters.kjv: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരൻ എന്നതു സത്യം തന്നേ; എങ്കിലും എന്നെക്കാൾ അടുത്ത ഒരു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരൻ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Although it is true that I am a guardian-redeemer of our family, there is another who is more closely related than I.
chapters.nkjv: Now it is true that I am a close relative; however, there is a relative closer than I.
chapters.kjv: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.

chapters.ml: ഈ രാത്രി താമസിക്ക; നാളെ അവൻ നിനക്കു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരന്റെ മുറ നിവർത്തിച്ചാൽ കൊള്ളാം; അവൻ നിവർത്തിക്കട്ടെ; വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരന്റെ മുറ നിവർത്തിപ്പാൻ അവന്നു മനസ്സില്ലെങ്കിലോ യഹോവയാണ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരന്റെ മുറ നിർവർത്തിച്ചുതരും; രാവിലെവരെ കിടന്നുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: Stay here for the night, and in the morning if he wants to do his duty as your guardian-redeemer, good; let him redeem you. But if he is not willing, as surely as the Lord lives I will do it. Lie here until morning."
chapters.nkjv: Stay this night, and in the morning it shall be that if he will perform the duty of a close relative for you—good; let him do it. But if he does not want to perform the duty for you, then I will perform the duty for you, as the Lord lives! Lie down until morning."
chapters.kjv: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the LORD liveth: lie down until the morning.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൾ രാവിലെവരെ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ കിടന്നു; ഒരു സ്ത്രീ കളത്തിൽ വന്നതു ആരും അറിയരുതെന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ആളറിയാറാകുംമുമ്പെ അവൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: So she lay at his feet until morning, but got up before anyone could be recognized; and he said, "No one must know that a woman came to the threshing floor."
chapters.nkjv: So she lay at his feet until morning, and she arose before one could recognize another. Then he said, "Do not let it be known that the woman came to the threshing floor."
chapters.kjv: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.

chapters.ml: നീ ധരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന പുതപ്പു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പിടിക്ക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവൾ അതു പിടിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ ആറിടങ്ങഴി യവം അതിൽ അളന്നുകൊടുത്തു; അവൾ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: He also said, "Bring me the shawl you are wearing and hold it out." When she did so, he poured into it six measures of barley and placed the bundle on her. Then he went back to town.
chapters.nkjv: Also he said, "Bring the shawl that is on you and hold it." And when she held it, he measured six ephahs of barley, and laid it on her. Then she went into the city.
chapters.kjv: Also he said, Bring the vail that thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അമ്മാവിയമ്മയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ: നിന്റെ കാര്യം എന്തായി മകളേ എന്നു അവൾ ചോദിച്ചു; ആയാൾ തനിക്കു ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവൾ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Ruth came to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, "How did it go, my daughter?" Then she told her everything Boaz had done for her
chapters.nkjv: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, "Is that you, my daughter?" Then she told her all that the man had done for her.
chapters.kjv: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

chapters.ml: അമ്മാവിയമ്മയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വെറുങ്കയ്യായി പോകരുതു എന്നു അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു ഈ ആറിടങ്ങഴി യവവും എനിക്കു തന്നു എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and added, "He gave me these six measures of barley, saying, ‘Don’t go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And she said, "These six ephahs of barley he gave me; for he said to me, ‘Do not go empty-handed to your mother-in-law.’ "
chapters.kjv: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൾ: എന്റെ മകളേ, ഈ കാര്യം എന്താകുമെന്നു അറിയുവോളം നീ അനങ്ങാതിരിക്ക; ഇന്നു ഈ കാര്യം തീർക്കുംവരെ ആയാൾ സ്വസ്ഥമായിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Naomi said, "Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today."
chapters.nkjv: Then she said, "Sit still, my daughter, until you know how the matter will turn out; for the man will not rest until he has concluded the matter this day."
chapters.kjv: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ബോവസ് പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ ഇരുന്നു; ബോവസ് പറഞ്ഞിരുന്ന വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരൻ കടന്നുപോകുന്നതു കണ്ടു: എടോ, ഇങ്ങോട്ടു വന്നു ഇവിടെ ഇരിക്ക എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ ചെന്നു അവിടെ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there just as the guardian-redeemer he had mentioned came along. Boaz said, "Come over here, my friend, and sit down." So he went over and sat down.
chapters.nkjv: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there; and behold, the close relative of whom Boaz had spoken came by. So Boaz said, "Come aside, friend, sit down here." So he came aside and sat down.
chapters.kjv: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പട്ടണത്തിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാരിൽ പത്തുപേരെ വരുത്തി; ഇവിടെ ഇരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവരും ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, "Sit here," and they did so.
chapters.nkjv: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, "Sit down here." So they sat down.
chapters.kjv: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ ആ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: മോവാബ്ദേശത്തുനിന്നു മടങ്ങിവന്നിരിക്കുന്ന നൊവൊമി നമ്മുടെ സഹോദരനായ എലീമേലെക്കിന്റെ വയൽ വില്ക്കുന്നു. ആകയാൽ നിന്നോടു അതു അറിയിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ വിചാരിച്ചു; ഇവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നവരുടെയും ജനത്തിന്റെ മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെയും മുമ്പാകെ നീ അതു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങുക;
chapters.niv: Then he said to the guardian-redeemer, "Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to the close relative, "Naomi, who has come back from the country of Moab, sold the piece of land which belonged to our brother Elimelech.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s:

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പാൻ മനസ്സുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ വീണ്ടെടുക്ക; വീണ്ടെടുപ്പാൻ നിനക്കു മനസ്സില്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നോടു പറക; നീയും നീ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഞാനും അല്ലാതെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പാൻ ആരും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: I thought I should bring the matter to your attention and suggest that you buy it in the presence of these seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. For no one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line." "I will redeem it," he said.
chapters.nkjv: And I thought to inform you, saying, ‘Buy it back in the presence of the inhabitants and the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know; for thereis no one but you to redeem it, and I am next after you.’ " And he said, "I will redeem it."
chapters.kjv: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it , redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it .

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞാൻ വീണ്ടെടുക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ ബോവസ്: നീ നൊവൊമിയോടു വയൽ വാങ്ങുന്ന നാളിൽ മരിച്ചവന്റെ അവകാശത്തിന്മേൽ അവന്റെ പേർ നിലനിർത്തുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം മരിച്ചവന്റെ ഭാര്യ മോവാബ്യസ്ത്രീയായ രൂത്തിനെയും വാങ്ങേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead man’s widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property."
chapters.nkjv: Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must also buy it from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to perpetuate the name of the dead through his inheritance."
chapters.kjv: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരൻ: എനിക്കു അതു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല; എന്റെ സ്വന്ത അവകാശം നഷ്ടമാക്കേണ്ടിവരും; ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ വീണ്ടെടുക്കേണ്ടതു നീ വീണ്ടെടുത്തുകൊൾക; എനിക്കു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At this, the guardian-redeemer said, "Then I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it."
chapters.nkjv: And the close relative said, "I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I ruin my own inheritance. You redeem my right of redemption for yourself, for I cannot redeem it."
chapters.kjv: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പും കൈമാറ്റവും സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള കാര്യം ഉറപ്പാക്കുവാൻ ഒരുത്തൻ തന്റെ ചെരിപ്പൂരി മറ്റേവന്നു കൊടുക്കുന്നതു യിസ്രായേലിൽ പണ്ടു നടപ്പായിരുന്നു; ഇതായിരുന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്ന വിധം.
chapters.niv: (Now in earlier times in Israel, for the redemption and transfer of property to become final, one party took off his sandal and gave it to the other. This was the method of legalizing transactions in Israel.)
chapters.nkjv: Now this wasthecustom in former times in Israel concerning redeeming and exchanging, to confirm anything: one man took off his sandal and gave it to the other, and this was a confirmation in Israel.
chapters.kjv: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ആ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരൻ ബോവസിനോടു: നീ അതു വാങ്ങിക്കൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തന്റെ ചെരിപ്പൂരിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the guardian-redeemer said to Boaz, "Buy it yourself." And he removed his sandal.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the close relative said to Boaz, "Buy it for yourself." So he took off his sandal.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ബോവസ് മൂപ്പന്മാരോടും സകല ജനത്തോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: എലീമേലെക്കിന്നുള്ളതൊക്കെയും കില്യോന്നും മഹ്ളോന്നും ഉള്ളതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ നൊവൊമിയോടു വാങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, "Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon.
chapters.nkjv: And Boaz said to the elders and all the people, "You are witnesses this day that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.
chapters.kjv: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.

chapters.ml: അത്രയുമല്ല മരിച്ചവന്റെ പേർ അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നും അവന്റെ പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽനിന്നും മാഞ്ഞുപോകാതവണ്ണം മരിച്ചവന്റെ പേർ അവന്റെ അവകാശത്തിന്മേൽ നിലനിർത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു മഹ്ളോന്റെ ഭാര്യ മോവാബ്യസ്ത്രീയായ രൂത്തിനെയും എനിക്കു ഭാര്യയായി വാങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നതിന്നും നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു.
