chapters.niv: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property, so that his name will not disappear from among his family or from his hometown. Today you are witnesses!"
chapters.nkjv: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the widow of Mahlon, I have acquired as my wife, to perpetuate the name of the dead through his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brethren and from his position at the gate. You are witnesses this day."
chapters.kjv: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽ ഇരുന്ന സകലജനവും മൂപ്പന്മാരും പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞങ്ങൾ സാക്ഷികൾ തന്നേ; നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്ന സ്ത്രീയെ യഹോവ റാഹേലിനെപ്പോലെയും ലേയയെപ്പോലെയും ആക്കട്ടെ; അവർ ഇരുവരുമല്ലോ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹം പണിതതു; എഫ്രാത്തയിൽ നീ പ്രബലനും ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ വിശ്രുതനുമായിരിക്ക.
chapters.niv: Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, "We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the family of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
chapters.nkjv: And all the people who were at the gate, and the elders, said, "Weare witnesses. The Lord make the woman who is coming to your house like Rachel and Leah, the two who built the house of Israel; and may you prosper in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
chapters.kjv: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Beth-lehem:

chapters.ml: ഈ യുവതിയിൽനിന്നു യഹോവ നിനക്കു നല്കുന്ന സന്തതിയാൽ നിന്റെ ഗൃഹം താമാർ യെഹൂദെക്കു പ്രസവിച്ച ഫേരെസിന്റെ ഗൃഹം പോലെ ആയ്തീരട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Through the offspring the Lord gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah."
chapters.nkjv: May your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring which the Lord will give you from this young woman."
chapters.kjv: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ബോവസ് രൂത്തിനെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവൾ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി; അവൻ അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ യഹോവ അവൾക്കു ഗർഭംനല്കി; അവൾ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When he made love to her, the Lord enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
chapters.nkjv: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and when he went in to her, the Lord gave her conception, and she bore a son.
chapters.kjv: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ സ്ത്രീകൾ നൊവൊമിയോടു: ഇന്നു നിനക്കു ഒരു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരനെ നല്കിയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ; അവന്റെ പേർ യിസ്രായേലിൽ വിശ്രുതമായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: The women said to Naomi: "Praise be to the Lord , who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer. May he become famous throughout Israel!
chapters.nkjv: Then the women said to Naomi, "Blessed be the Lord, who has not left you this day without a close relative; and may his name be famous in Israel!
chapters.kjv: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD , which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിനക്കു ആശ്വാസപ്രദനും നിന്റെ വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിങ്കൽ പോഷകനും ആയിരിക്കും. നിന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവളും ഏഴു പുത്രന്മാരെക്കാൾ നിനക്കു ഉത്തമയുമായിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ മരുമകളല്ലോ അവനെ പ്രസവിച്ചതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth."
chapters.nkjv: And may he be to you a restorer of life and a nourisher of your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has borne him."
chapters.kjv: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.

chapters.ml: നൊവൊമി കുഞ്ഞിനെ എടുത്തു മടിയിൽ കിടത്തി അവന്നു ധാത്രിയായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Naomi took the child in her arms and cared for him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Naomi took the child and laid him on her bosom, and became a nurse to him.
chapters.kjv: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ അയൽക്കാരത്തികൾ: നൊവൊമിക്കു ഒരു മകൻ ജനിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു ഓബേദ് എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു; ദാവീദിന്റെ അപ്പനായ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ അപ്പൻ ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The women living there said, "Naomi has a son!" And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.
chapters.nkjv: Also the neighbor women gave him a name, saying, "There is a son born to Naomi." And they called his name Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
chapters.kjv: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

chapters.ml: ഫേരെസിന്റെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു: ഫേരെസ് ഹെസ്രോനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. ഹെസ്രോൻ രാമിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This, then, is the family line of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,
chapters.nkjv: Now this is the genealogy of Perez: Perez begot Hezron;
chapters.kjv: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,

chapters.ml: രാം അമ്മീനാദാബിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Hezron the father of Ram, Ram the father of Amminadab,
chapters.nkjv: Hezron begot Ram, and Ram begot Amminadab;
chapters.kjv: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,

chapters.ml: അമ്മീനാദാബ് നഹശോനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; നഹശോൻ സല്മോനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,
chapters.nkjv: Amminadab begot Nahshon, and Nahshon begot Salmon;
chapters.kjv: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

chapters.ml: സല്മോൻ ബോവസിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ബോവസ് ഓബേദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Salmon the father of Boaz, Boaz the father of Obed,
chapters.nkjv: Salmon begot Boaz, and Boaz begot Obed;
chapters.kjv: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,

chapters.ml: ഓബേദ് യിശ്ശായിയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; യിശ്ശായി ദാവീദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.
chapters.nkjv: Obed begot Jesse, and Jesse begot David.
chapters.kjv: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീം മലനാട്ടിലെ രാമാഥയീം-സോഫീമിൽ എൽക്കാനാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു പുരുഷൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ എലീഹൂവിന്റെ മകനായ യെരോഹാമിന്റെ മകൻ ആയിരുന്നു; എലീഹൂ എഫ്രയീമ്യനായ സൂഫിന്റെ മകനായ തോഹൂവിന്റെ മകൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There was a certain man from Ramathaim, a Zuphite from the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the mountains of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
chapters.kjv: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:

chapters.ml: എൽക്കാനെക്കു രണ്ടു ഭാര്യമാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഒരുത്തിക്കു ഹന്നാ എന്നും മറ്റേവൾക്കു പെനിന്നാ എന്നും പേർ; പെനിന്നെക്കു മക്കൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഹന്നെക്കോ മക്കൾ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had two wives; one was called Hannah and the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.
chapters.nkjv: And he had two wives: the name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
chapters.kjv: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശീലോവിൽ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിപ്പാനും അവന്നു യാഗം കഴിപ്പാനും തന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു ആണ്ടുതോറും ശീലോവിലേക്കു പോക പതിവായിരുന്നു; ഏലിയുടെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായി യഹോവെക്കു പുരോഹിതന്മാരായിരുന്ന ഹൊഫ്നിയും ഫീനെഹാസും അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Year after year this man went up from his town to worship and sacrifice to the Lord Almighty at Shiloh, where Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were priests of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: This man went up from his city yearly to worship and sacrifice to the Lord of hosts in Shiloh. Also the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.
chapters.kjv: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD , were there.

chapters.ml: എൽക്കാനാ യാഗം കഴിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒക്കെയും തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ പെനിന്നെക്കും അവളുടെ സകലപുത്രന്മാർക്കും പുത്രിമാർക്കും ഓഹരികൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the day came for Elkanah to sacrifice, he would give portions of the meat to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: And whenever the time came for Elkanah to make an offering, he would give portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

chapters.ml: ഹന്നെക്കോ അവൻ ഹന്നയെ സ്നേഹിക്കകൊണ്ടു ഇരട്ടി ഓഹരി കൊടുക്കും. എന്നാൽ യഹോവ അവളുടെ ഗർഭം അടെച്ചിരിന്നു.
chapters.niv: But to Hannah he gave a double portion because he loved her, and the Lord had closed her womb.
chapters.nkjv: But to Hannah he would give a double portion, for he loved Hannah, although the Lord had closed her womb.
chapters.kjv: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവളുടെ ഗർഭം അടെച്ചിരുന്നതിനാൽ അവളുടെ പ്രതിയോഗി അവളെ വ്യസനിപ്പിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം വളരെ മുഷിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Because the Lord had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival kept provoking her in order to irritate her.
chapters.nkjv: And her rival also provoked her severely, to make her miserable, because the Lord had closed her womb.
chapters.kjv: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

chapters.ml: അവൾ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു പോകുന്ന സമയത്തൊക്കെയും ആണ്ടുതോറും അവൾ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തുപോന്നു. അവൾ അവളെ മുഷിപ്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവൾ കരഞ്ഞു പട്ടിണി കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: This went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the Lord , her rival provoked her till she wept and would not eat.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, year by year, when she went up to the house of the Lord, that she provoked her; therefore she wept and did not eat.
chapters.kjv: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD , so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവായ എൽക്കാനാ അവളോടു: ഹന്നേ, നീ എന്തിന്നു കരയുന്നു? എന്തിന്നു പട്ടിണികിടക്കുന്നു? നീ വ്യസനിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? ഞാൻ നിനക്കു പത്തു പുത്രന്മാരെക്കാൾ നന്നല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Her husband Elkanah would say to her, "Hannah, why are you weeping? Why don’t you eat? Why are you downhearted? Don’t I mean more to you than ten sons?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Elkanah her husband said to her, "Hannah, why do you weep? Why do you not eat? And why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?

chapters.ml: അവർ ശീലോവിൽവെച്ചു തിന്നുകയും കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തശേഷം ഹന്നാ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പോയി. പുരോഹിതനായ ഏലി യഹോവയുടെ മന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ ആസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Once when they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his chair by the doorpost of the Lord ’s house.
chapters.nkjv: So Hannah arose after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on the seat by the doorpost of the tabernacle of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൾ മനോവ്യസനത്തോടെ യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു വളരെ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: In her deep anguish Hannah prayed to the Lord , weeping bitterly.
chapters.nkjv: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the Lord and wept in anguish.
chapters.kjv: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD , and wept sore.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഒരു നേർച്ചനേർന്നു; സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവേ, അടിയന്റെ സങ്കടം നോക്കി അടിയനെ ഓർക്കയും അടിയനെ മറക്കാതെ ഒരു പുരുഷസന്താനത്തെ നല്കുകയും ചെയ്താൽ അടിയൻ അവനെ അവന്റെ ജീവപര്യന്തം യഹോവെക്കു കൊടുക്കും; അവന്റെ തലയിൽ ക്ഷൌരക്കത്തി തൊടുകയുമില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And she made a vow, saying, " Lord Almighty, if you will only look on your servant’s misery and remember me, and not forget your servant but give her a son, then I will give him to the Lord for all the days of his life, and no razor will ever be used on his head."
chapters.nkjv: Then she made a vow and said, "O Lord of hosts, if You will indeed look on the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, and not forget Your maidservant, but will give Your maidservant a male child, then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and no razor shall come upon his head."
chapters.kjv: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൾ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഏലി അവളുടെ വായെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: As she kept on praying to the Lord , Eli observed her mouth.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, as she continued praying before the Lord, that Eli watched her mouth.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD , that Eli marked her mouth.

chapters.ml: ഹന്നാ ഹൃദയംകൊണ്ടു സംസാരിച്ചതിനാൽ അവളുടെ അധരം അനങ്ങിയതല്ലാതെ ശബ്ദം കേൾപ്പാനില്ലായിരുന്നു; ആകയാൽ അവൾക്കു ലഹരിപിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഏലിക്കു തോന്നിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Hannah was praying in her heart, and her lips were moving but her voice was not heard. Eli thought she was drunk
chapters.nkjv: Now Hannah spoke in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
chapters.kjv: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

chapters.ml: ഏലി അവളോടു: നീ എത്രത്തോളം ലഹരി പിടിച്ചിരിക്കും? നിന്റെ വീഞ്ഞു ഇറങ്ങട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said to her, "How long are you going to stay drunk? Put away your wine."
chapters.nkjv: So Eli said to her, "How long will you be drunk? Put your wine away from you!"
chapters.kjv: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഹന്നാ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: അങ്ങനെയല്ല, യജമാനനേ; ഞാൻ മനോവ്യസനമുള്ളൊരു സ്ത്രീ; ഞാൻ വീഞ്ഞോ മദ്യമോ കുടിച്ചിട്ടില്ല; യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ എന്റെ ഹൃദയം പകരുകയത്രേ ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: "Not so, my lord," Hannah replied, "I am a woman who is deeply troubled. I have not been drinking wine or beer; I was pouring out my soul to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: But Hannah answered and said, "No, my lord, I am a woman of sorrowful spirit. I have drunk neither wine nor intoxicating drink, but have poured out my soul before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD .

chapters.ml: അടിയനെ ഒരു നീചസ്ത്രീയായി വിചാരിക്കരുതേ; അടിയൻ സങ്കടത്തിന്റെയും വ്യസനത്തിന്റെയും ആധിക്യംകൊണ്ടാകുന്നു സംസാരിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; I have been praying here out of my great anguish and grief."
chapters.nkjv: "Do not consider your maidservant a wicked woman, for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief I have spoken until now."
chapters.kjv: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഏലി: സമാധാനത്തോടെ പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവത്തോടു നീ കഴിച്ച അപേക്ഷ അവൻ നിനക്കു നല്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Eli answered, "Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant you what you have asked of him."
chapters.nkjv: Then Eli answered and said, "Go in peace, and the God of Israel grant your petition which you have asked of Him."
chapters.kjv: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

chapters.ml: അടിയന്നു തൃക്കണ്ണിൽ കൃപ ലഭിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു സ്ത്രീ തന്റെ വഴിക്കു പോയി ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചു; അവളുടെ മുഖം പിന്നെ വാടിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: She said, "May your servant find favor in your eyes." Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.
chapters.nkjv: And she said, "Let your maidservant find favor in your sight." So the woman went her way and ate, and her face was no longer sad.
chapters.kjv: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad .

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നമസ്കരിച്ചശേഷം രാമയിൽ തങ്ങളുടെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി. എന്നാൽ എൽക്കാനാ തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ ഹന്നയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; യഹോവ അവളെ ഓർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning they arose and worshiped before the Lord and then went back to their home at Ramah. Elkanah made love to his wife Hannah, and the Lord remembered her.
chapters.nkjv: Then they rose early in the morning and worshiped before the Lord, and returned and came to their house at Ramah. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife, and the Lord remembered her.
chapters.kjv: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD , and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ആണ്ടു കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഹന്നാ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; ഞാൻ അവനെ യഹോവയോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചുവാങ്ങി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു ശമൂവേൽ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So in the course of time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, "Because I asked the Lord for him."
chapters.nkjv: So it came to pass in the process of time that Hannah conceived and bore a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, "Because I have asked for him from the Lord."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying , Because I have asked him of the LORD .

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ എൽക്കാനാ എന്ന പുരുഷനും അവന്റെ കുടുംബമൊക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു വർഷാന്തരയാഗവും നേർച്ചയും കഴിപ്പാൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: When her husband Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the annual sacrifice to the Lord and to fulfill his vow,
chapters.nkjv: Now the man Elkanah and all his house went up to offer to the Lord the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
chapters.kjv: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹന്നാ കൂടെപോയില്ല; അവൾ ഭർത്താവിനോടു: ശിശുവിന്റെ മുലകുടി മാറട്ടെ; പിന്നെ അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ എന്നു പാർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അവനെയും കൊണ്ടുപോരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Hannah did not go. She said to her husband, "After the boy is weaned, I will take him and present him before the Lord , and he will live there always."
chapters.nkjv: But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, "Not until the child is weaned; then I will take him, that he may appear before the Lord and remain there forever."
chapters.kjv: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD , and there abide for ever.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവായ എൽക്കാനാ അവളോടു: നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെയാകട്ടെ; അവന്റെ മുലകുടിമാറുംവരെ താമസിക്ക; യഹോവ തന്റെ വചനം നിവർത്തിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൾ വീട്ടിൽ താമസിച്ചു മുലകുടി മാറുംവരെ മകന്നു മുലകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "Do what seems best to you," her husband Elkanah told her. "Stay here until you have weaned him; only may the Lord make good his word." So the woman stayed at home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.
chapters.nkjv: So Elkanah her husband said to her, "Do what seems best to you; wait until you have weaned him. Only let the Lord establish His word." Then the woman stayed and nursed her son until she had weaned him.
chapters.kjv: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു മുലകുടി മാറിയശേഷം അവൾ മൂന്നു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള ഒരു കാളയും ഒരു പറമാവും ഒരു തുരുത്തി വീഞ്ഞുമായി അവനെ ശീലോവിൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു: ബാലനോ ചെറുപ്പമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After he was weaned, she took the boy with her, young as he was, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh.
chapters.nkjv: Now when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, one ephah of flour, and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the Lord in Shiloh. And the child was young.
chapters.kjv: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child was young.

chapters.ml: അവർ കാളയെ അറുത്തിട്ടു ബാലനെ ഏലിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the bull had been sacrificed, they brought the boy to Eli,
chapters.nkjv: Then they slaughtered a bull, and brought the child to Eli.
chapters.kjv: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യജമാനനേ; യജമാനനാണ, യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ഇവിടെ സമീപത്തു നിന്നിരുന്ന സ്ത്രീ ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and she said to him, "Pardon me, my lord. As surely as you live, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And she said, "O my lord! As your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഈ ബാലന്നായിട്ടു ഞാൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു; ഞാൻ യഹോവയോടു കഴിച്ച അപേക്ഷ യഹോവ എനിക്കു നല്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me what I asked of him.
chapters.nkjv: For this child I prayed, and the Lord has granted me my petition which I asked of Him.
chapters.kjv: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അവനെ യഹോവെക്കു നിവേദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ ജീവപര്യന്തം യഹോവെക്കു നിവേദിതനായിരിക്കും. അവർ അവിടെ യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So now I give him to the Lord . For his whole life he will be given over to the Lord ." And he worshiped the Lord there.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I also have lent him to the Lord; as long as he lives he shall be lent to the Lord." So they worshiped the Lord there.
chapters.kjv: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD ; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD . And he worshipped the LORD there.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഹന്നാ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: എന്റെ ഹൃദയം യഹോവയിൽ ആനന്ദിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ കൊമ്പു യഹോവയാൽ ഉയർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ വായ് ശത്രുക്കളുടെ നേരെ വിശാലമാകുന്നു; നിന്റെ രക്ഷയിൽ ഞാൻ സന്തോഷിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Hannah prayed and said: "My heart rejoices in the Lord ; in the Lord my horn is lifted high. My mouth boasts over my enemies, for I delight in your deliverance.
chapters.nkjv: And Hannah prayed and said: "My heart rejoices in the Lord; My horn is exalted in the Lord. I smile at my enemies, Because I rejoice in Your salvation.
chapters.kjv: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD , mine horn is exalted in the LORD : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെപ്പോലെ പരിശുദ്ധൻ ഇല്ല; നീ അല്ലാതെ ഒരുത്തനുമില്ലല്ലോ; നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തെപ്പോലെ ഒരു പാറയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: "There is no one holy like the Lord ; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.
chapters.nkjv: "No one is holy like the Lord, For thereis none besides You, Nor isthere any rock like our God.
chapters.kjv: There is none holy as the LORD : for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.

chapters.ml: ഡംഭിച്ചു ഡംഭിച്ചു ഇനി സംസാരിക്കരുതു; നിങ്ങളുടെ വായിൽനിന്നു അഹങ്കാരം പുറപ്പെടരുതു. യഹോവ ജ്ഞാനമുള്ള ദൈവം; അവൻ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ തൂക്കിനോക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Do not keep talking so proudly or let your mouth speak such arrogance, for the Lord is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.
chapters.nkjv: "Talk no more so very proudly; Let no arrogance come from your mouth, For the Lordis the God of knowledge; And by Him actions are weighed.
chapters.kjv: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.

chapters.ml: വീരന്മാരുടെ വില്ലു ഒടിഞ്ഞുപോകുന്നു; ഇടറിയവരോ ബലം ധരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The bows of the warriors are broken, but those who stumbled are armed with strength.
chapters.nkjv: "The bows of the mighty men are broken, And those who stumbled are girded with strength.
chapters.kjv: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

chapters.ml: സമ്പന്നർ ആഹാരത്തിന്നായി കൂലിക്കു നില്ക്കുന്നു; വിശന്നവർ വിശ്രമം പ്രാപിക്കുന്നു; മച്ചി ഏഴു പ്രസവിക്കുന്നു; പുത്രസമ്പന്നയോ ക്ഷയിച്ചു പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those who were full hire themselves out for food, but those who were hungry are hungry no more. She who was barren has borne seven children, but she who has had many sons pines away.
chapters.nkjv: Thosewhowere full have hired themselves out for bread, And the hungry have ceased tohunger. Even the barren has borne seven, And she who has many children has become feeble.
chapters.kjv: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ കൊല്ലുകയും ജീവിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. പാതാളത്തിൽ ഇറക്കുകയും ഉദ്ധരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു;
chapters.niv: "The Lord brings death and makes alive; he brings down to the grave and raises up.
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord kills and makes alive; He brings down to the grave and brings up.
chapters.kjv: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദാരിദ്ര്യവും ഐശ്വര്യവും നല്കുന്നു; അവൻ താഴ്ത്തുകയും ഉയർത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord makes poor and makes rich; He brings low and lifts up.
chapters.kjv: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദരിദ്രനെ പൊടിയിൽനിന്നു നിവിർത്തുന്നു; അഗതിയെ കുപ്പയിൽനിന്നു ഉയർത്തുന്നു; പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ഇരുത്തുവാനും മഹിമാസനം അവകാശമായി നല്കുവാനും തന്നേ. ഭൂധരങ്ങൾ യഹോവെക്കുള്ളവ; ഭൂമണ്ഡലത്തെ അവയുടെമേൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap; he seats them with princes and has them inherit a throne of honor. "For the foundations of the earth are the Lord ’s; on them he has set the world.
chapters.nkjv: He raises the poor from the dust And lifts the beggar from the ash heap, To set them among princes And make them inherit the throne of glory. "For the pillars of the earth are the Lord’s, And He has set the world upon them.
chapters.kjv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s , and he hath set the world upon them.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ കാലുകളെ അവൻ കാക്കുന്നു; ദുഷ്ടന്മാർ അന്ധകാരത്തിൽ മിണ്ടാതെയാകുന്നു; സ്വശക്തിയാൽ ഒരുത്തനും ജയിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He will guard the feet of his faithful servants, but the wicked will be silenced in the place of darkness. "It is not by strength that one prevails;
chapters.nkjv: He will guard the feet of His saints, But the wicked shall be silent in darkness. "For by strength no man shall prevail.
chapters.kjv: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയോടു എതിർക്കുന്നവൻ തകർന്നുപോകുന്നു; അവൻ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു അവരുടെമേൽ ഇടി വെട്ടിക്കുന്നു. യഹോവ ഭൂസീമാവാസികളെ വിധിക്കുന്നു; തന്റെ രാജാവിന്നു ശക്തി കൊടുക്കുന്നു; തന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തന്റെ കൊമ്പു ഉയർത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: those who oppose the Lord will be broken. The Most High will thunder from heaven; the Lord will judge the ends of the earth. "He will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his anointed."
chapters.nkjv: The adversaries of the Lord shall be broken in pieces; From heaven He will thunder against them. The Lord will judge the ends of the earth. "He will give strength to His king, And exalt the horn of His anointed."
chapters.kjv: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ എൽക്കാനാ രാമയിൽ തന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി. ബാലൻ പുരോഹിതനായ ഏലിയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ യഹോവെക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്തു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy ministered before the Lord under Eli the priest.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elkanah went to his house at Ramah. But the child ministered to the Lord before Eli the priest.
chapters.kjv: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏലിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ നീചന്മാരും യഹോവയെ ഓർക്കാത്തവരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they had no regard for the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Now the sons of Eli were corrupt; they did not know the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഈ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ജനത്തോടു ആചരിച്ച വിധം എങ്ങനെയെന്നാൽ: വല്ലവരും ഒരു യാഗം കഴിക്കുമ്പോൾ മാംസം വേവിക്കുന്ന സമയത്തു പുരോഹിതന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരൻ കയ്യിൽ മുപ്പല്ലിയുമായി വന്നു
chapters.niv: Now it was the practice of the priests that, whenever any of the people offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come with a three-pronged fork in his hand while the meat was being boiled
chapters.nkjv: And the priests’ custom with the people wasthat when any man offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come with a three-pronged fleshhook in his hand while the meat was boiling.
chapters.kjv: And the priests’ custom with the people was, that , when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;

chapters.ml: കലത്തിലോ ഉരുളിയിലോ കുട്ടകത്തിലോ ചട്ടിയിലോ കുത്തും; മുപ്പല്ലിയിൽ പിടിച്ചതൊക്കെയും പുരോഹിതൻ എടുത്തുകൊള്ളും. ശീലോവിൽ വരുന്ന എല്ലായിസ്രായേല്യരോടും അവർ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: and would plunge the fork into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot. Whatever the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.
chapters.nkjv: Then he would thrust it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; and the priest would take for himself all that the fleshhook brought up. So they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.
chapters.kjv: And he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.

chapters.ml: മേദസ്സു ദഹിപ്പിക്കുംമുമ്പെ പുരോഹിതന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരൻ വന്നു യാഗം കഴിക്കുന്നവനോടു: പുരോഹിതന്നു വറുപ്പാൻ മാംസം തരിക; പച്ചമാംസമല്ലാതെ വേവിച്ചതു അവൻ വാങ്ങുകയില്ല എന്നു പറയും.
chapters.niv: But even before the fat was burned, the priest’s servant would come and say to the person who was sacrificing, "Give the priest some meat to roast; he won’t accept boiled meat from you, but only raw."
chapters.nkjv: Also, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant would come and say to the man who sacrificed, "Give meat for roasting to the priest, for he will not take boiled meat from you, but raw."
chapters.kjv: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.

chapters.ml: മേദസ്സു ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകഴിയട്ടെ; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം നീ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നേടത്തോളം എടുത്തുകൊൾക എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അവൻ അവനോടു: അല്ല, ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നേ തരേണം; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ ബലാൽക്കാരേണ എടുക്കും എന്നു പറയും.
chapters.niv: If the person said to him, "Let the fat be burned first, and then take whatever you want," the servant would answer, "No, hand it over now; if you don’t, I’ll take it by force."
chapters.nkjv: And if the man said to him, "They should really burn the fat first; then you may take asmuch as your heart desires," he would then answer him, "No, but you must give it now; and if not, I will take it by force."
chapters.kjv: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ആ യൌവനക്കാർ യഹോവയുടെ വഴിപാടു നിന്ദിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവരുടെ പാപം യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഏറ്റവും വലിയതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This sin of the young men was very great in the Lord ’s sight, for they were treating the Lord ’s offering with contempt.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the sin of the young men was very great before the Lord, for men abhorred the offering of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD : for men abhorred the offering of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ എന്ന ബാലനോ പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള അങ്കി ധരിച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Samuel was ministering before the Lord —a boy wearing a linen ephod.
chapters.nkjv: But Samuel ministered before the Lord, evenas a child, wearing a linen ephod.
chapters.kjv: But Samuel ministered before the LORD , being a child, girded with a linen ephod.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അമ്മ ആണ്ടുതോറും ഒരു ചെറിയ അങ്കി ഉണ്ടാക്കി തന്റെ ഭർത്താവിനോടുകൂടെ വർഷാന്തരയാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ വരുമ്പോൾ അവന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: Each year his mother made him a little robe and took it to him when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover his mother used to make him a little robe, and bring it to him year by year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
chapters.kjv: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏലി എൽക്കാനയെയും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെയും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു; ഈ സ്ത്രീ യഹോവെക്കു കഴിച്ച നീവേദ്യത്തിന്നു പകരം യഹോവ അവളിൽ നിന്നു നിനക്കു സന്തതിയെ നല്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. പിന്നെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, "May the Lord give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she prayed for and gave to the Lord ." Then they would go home.
chapters.nkjv: And Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say, "The Lord give you descendants from this woman for the loan that was given to the Lord." Then they would go to their own home.
chapters.kjv: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD . And they went unto their own home.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഹന്നയെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു; അവൾ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു മൂന്നു പുത്രന്മാരെയും രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാരെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു. ശമൂവേൽബാലനോ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വളർന്നുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the Lord was gracious to Hannah; she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord visited Hannah, so that she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile the child Samuel grew before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഏലി വൃദ്ധനായാറെ അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനോടും ചെയ്യുന്നതൊക്കെയും സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽക്കൽ സേവ ചെയ്യുന്ന സ്ത്രീകളോടുകൂടെ ശയിക്കുന്നതും അവൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Now Eli, who was very old, heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they slept with the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.nkjv: Now Eli was very old; and he heard everything his sons did to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who assembled at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
chapters.kjv: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഈവക ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു? നിങ്ങളുടെ ദുഷ്‌പ്രവൃത്തികളെക്കുറിച്ചു ഈ ജനമൊക്കെയും പറഞ്ഞു ഞാൻ കേൾക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he said to them, "Why do you do such things? I hear from all the people about these wicked deeds of yours.
chapters.nkjv: So he said to them, "Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all the people.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അരുതു, എന്റെ മക്കളേ, യഹോവയുടെ ജനം നിങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു പരത്തുന്നതായി ഞാൻ കേൾക്കുന്ന കേൾവി നന്നല്ല.
chapters.niv: No, my sons; the report I hear spreading among the Lord ’s people is not good.
chapters.nkjv: No, my sons! For itis not a good report that I hear. You make the Lord’s people transgress.
chapters.kjv: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD’s people to transgress.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ മനുഷ്യനോടു പാപം ചെയ്താൽ അവന്നു വേണ്ടി ദൈവത്തോടു അപേക്ഷിക്കാം; മനുഷ്യൻ യഹോവയോടു പാപം ചെയ്താലോ അവന്നു വേണ്ടി ആർ അപേക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എങ്കിലും അവരെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ യഹോവ നിശ്ചയിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ അപ്പന്റെ വാക്കു കൂട്ടാക്കിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: If one person sins against another, God may mediate for the offender; but if anyone sins against the Lord , who will intercede for them?" His sons, however, did not listen to their father’s rebuke, for it was the Lord ’s will to put them to death.
chapters.nkjv: If one man sins against another, God will judge him. But if a man sins against the Lord, who will intercede for him?" Nevertheless they did not heed the voice of their father, because the Lord desired to kill them.
chapters.kjv: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD , who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽബാലനോ വളരുന്തോറും യഹോവെക്കും മനുഷ്യർക്കും പ്രീതിയുള്ളവനായി വളർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the Lord and with people.
chapters.nkjv: And the child Samuel grew in stature, and in favor both with the Lord and men.
chapters.kjv: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD , and also with men.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഒരു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ ഏലിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനം മിസ്രയീമിൽ ഫറവോന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു അടിമകളായിരുന്നപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ അവർക്കു വെളിപ്പെട്ടു നിശ്ചയം.
chapters.niv: Now a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal myself to your ancestor’s family when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh?
chapters.nkjv: Then a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Did I not clearly reveal Myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?
chapters.kjv: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ കയറുവാനും ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാനും എന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഏഫോദ് ധരിപ്പാനും ഞാൻ അവനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകലഗോത്രത്തിൽനിന്നും എനിക്കു പുരോഹിതനായി തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സകലദഹനയാഗങ്ങളെയും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: I chose your ancestor out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in my presence. I also gave your ancestor’s family all the food offerings presented by the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: Did I not choose him out of all the tribes of Israel tobe My priest, to offer upon My altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod before Me? And did I not give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?
chapters.kjv: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?

chapters.ml: തിരുനിവാസത്തിൽ അർപ്പിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള എന്റെ യാഗവും വഴിപാടും നിങ്ങൾ ചവിട്ടുകയും എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ എല്ലാവഴിപാടുകളിലും പ്രധാനഭാഗംകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ കൊഴുപ്പിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നീ നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ എന്നെക്കാൾ ബഹുമാനിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Why do you scorn my sacrifice and offering that I prescribed for my dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choice parts of every offering made by my people Israel?’
chapters.nkjv: Why do you kick at My sacrifice and My offering which I have commanded inMy dwelling place, and honor your sons more than Me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel My people?’
chapters.kjv: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നിന്റെ ഭവനവും നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനവും എന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിത്യം പരിചരിക്കുമെന്നു ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു നിശ്ചയം; ഇപ്പോഴോ യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു: അങ്ങനെ ഒരിക്കലും ആകയില്ല; എന്നെ മാനിക്കുന്നവരെ ഞാൻ മാനിക്കും; എന്നെ നിന്ദിക്കുന്നവർ നിന്ദിതരാകും.
chapters.niv: "Therefore the Lord , the God of Israel, declares: ‘I promised that members of your family would minister before me forever.’ But now the Lord declares: ‘Far be it from me! Those who honor me I will honor, but those who despise me will be disdained.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Lord God of Israel says: ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father would walk before Me forever.’ But now the Lord says: ‘Far be it from Me; for those who honor Me I will honor, and those who despise Me shall be lightly esteemed.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഭവനത്തിൽ ഒരു വൃദ്ധനും ഉണ്ടാകാതവണ്ണം ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ഭുജവും നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്റെ ഭുജവും തകർത്തുകളയുന്ന നാളുകൾ ഇതാ വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The time is coming when I will cut short your strength and the strength of your priestly house, so that no one in it will reach old age,
chapters.nkjv: Behold, the days are coming that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, so that there will not be an old man in your house.
chapters.kjv: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father’s house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ലഭിപ്പാനുള്ള എല്ലാനന്മകളുടെയും മദ്ധ്യേ നീ തിരുനിവാസത്തിൽ ഒരു പ്രതിയോഗിയെ കാണും; നിന്റെ ഭവനത്തിൽ ഒരുനാളും ഒരു വൃദ്ധൻ ഉണ്ടാകയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: and you will see distress in my dwelling. Although good will be done to Israel, no one in your family line will ever reach old age.
chapters.nkjv: And you will see an enemy inMy dwelling place, despite all the good which God does for Israel. And there shall not be an old man in your house forever.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കണ്ണു ക്ഷയിപ്പിപ്പാനും നിന്റെ ഹൃദയം വ്യസനിപ്പിപ്പാനും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ഭവനത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ എന്റെ യാഗപീഠത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയാതെ വെച്ചേക്കും; നിന്റെ ഭവനത്തിലെ സന്താനമൊക്കെയും പുരുഷപ്രായത്തിൽ മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Every one of you that I do not cut off from serving at my altar I will spare only to destroy your sight and sap your strength, and all your descendants will die in the prime of life.
chapters.nkjv: But any of your men whom I do not cut off from My altar shall consume your eyes and grieve your heart. And all the descendants of your house shall die in the flower of their age.
chapters.kjv: And the man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായ ഹൊഫ്നിക്കും ഫീനെഹാസിന്നും ഭവിപ്പാനിരിക്കുന്നതു നിനക്കു ഒരു അടയാളം ആകും; അവർ ഇരുവരും ഒരു ദിവസത്തിൽ തന്നേ മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: " ‘And what happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be a sign to you—they will both die on the same day.
chapters.nkjv: Now this shallbe a sign to you that will come upon your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they shall die, both of them.
chapters.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എന്റെ പ്രസാദവും ഹിതവും അനുഷ്ഠിക്കുന്ന ഒരു വിശ്വസ്തപുരോഹിതനെ ഞാൻ എനിക്കു എഴുന്നേല്പിക്കും; അവന്നു ഞാൻ സ്ഥിരമായോരു ഭവനം പണിയും; അവൻ എന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിത്യം പരിചരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who will do according to what is in my heart and mind. I will firmly establish his priestly house, and they will minister before my anointed one always.
chapters.nkjv: Then I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest who shall do according to what is in My heart and in My mind. I will build him a sure house, and he shall walk before My anointed forever.
chapters.kjv: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഭവനത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവനെല്ലാം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു ഒരു വെള്ളിക്കാശിന്നും ഒരു അപ്പത്തിന്നുമായിട്ടു അവനെ കുമ്പിട്ടു: ഒരു കഷണം അപ്പം തിന്മാൻ ഇടവരേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നെ ഒരു പുരോഹിതന്റെ വേലെക്കാക്കേണമേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then everyone left in your family line will come and bow down before him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread and plead, "Appoint me to some priestly office so I can have food to eat." ’ "
chapters.nkjv: And it shall come to pass that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and say, "Please, put me in one of the priestly positions, that I may eat a piece of bread." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽബാലൻ ഏലിയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ യഹോവെക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തുപോന്നു; ആ കാലത്തു യഹോവയുടെ വചനം ദുർല്ലഭമായിരുന്നു; ദർശനം ഏറെ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The boy Samuel ministered before the Lord under Eli. In those days the word of the Lord was rare; there were not many visions.
chapters.nkjv: Now the boy Samuel ministered to the Lord before Eli. And the word of the Lord was rare in those days; therewas no widespread revelation.
chapters.kjv: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഒരിക്കൽ ഏലി തന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തു കിടന്നുറങ്ങി; കാണ്മാൻ വഹിയാതവണ്ണം അവന്റെ കണ്ണു മങ്ങിത്തുടങ്ങിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass at that time, while Eli was lying down in his place, and when his eyes had begun to grow so dim that he could not see,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ഇരിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയുടെ മന്ദിരത്തിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വിളക്കു കെടുന്നതിന്നു മുമ്പെ ചെന്നു കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the house of the Lord , where the ark of God was.
chapters.nkjv: and before the lamp of God went out in the tabernacle of the Lord where the ark of God was, and while Samuel was lying down,
chapters.kjv: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD , where the ark of God was , and Samuel was laid down to sleep;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ശമൂവേലിനെ വിളിച്ചു: അടിയൻ എന്നു അവൻ വിളികേട്ടു ഏലിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു: അടിയൻ ഇതാ; എന്നെ വിളിച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord called Samuel. Samuel answered, "Here I am."
chapters.nkjv: that the Lord called Samuel. And he answered, "Here I am!"
chapters.kjv: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വിളിച്ചില്ല; പോയി കിടന്നുകൊൾക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ പോയി കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." But Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down." So he went and lay down.
chapters.nkjv: So he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." And he said, "I did not call; lie down again." And he went and lay down.
chapters.kjv: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ പിന്നെയും: ശമൂവേലേ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു. ശമൂവേൽ എഴന്നേറ്റു ഏലിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: അടിയൻ ഇതാ; എന്നെ വിളിച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഞാൻ വിളിച്ചില്ല, മകനേ; പോയി കിടന്നുകൊൾക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Again the Lord called, "Samuel!" And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." "My son," Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord called yet again, "Samuel!" So Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, "Here I am, for you called me." He answered, "I did not call, my son; lie down again."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ അന്നുവരെ യഹോവയെ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല; യഹോവയുടെ വചനം അവന്നു അന്നുവരെ വെളിപ്പെട്ടതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord : The word of the Lord had not yet been revealed to him.
chapters.nkjv: (Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord, nor was the word of the Lord yet revealed to him.)
chapters.kjv: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD , neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him. , and before the word of the LORD was revealed unto him

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ശമൂവേലിനെ മൂന്നാം പ്രാവശ്യം വിളിച്ചു. അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഏലിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: അടിയൻ ഇതാ; എന്നെ വിളിച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയായിരുന്നു ബാലനെ വിളിച്ചതു എന്നു ഏലിക്കു മനസ്സിലായി.
chapters.niv: A third time the Lord called, "Samuel!" And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." Then Eli realized that the Lord was calling the boy.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord called Samuel again the third time. So he arose and went to Eli, and said, "Here I am, for you did call me." Then Eli perceived that the Lord had called the boy.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

chapters.ml: ഏലി ശമൂവേലിനോടു: പോയി കിടന്നുകൊൾക; ഇനിയും നിന്നെ വിളിച്ചാൽ: യഹോവേ, അരുളിച്ചെയ്യേണമേ; അടിയൻ കേൾക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു കൊള്ളേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ശമൂവേൽ തന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തു ചെന്നുകിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Eli told Samuel, "Go and lie down, and if he calls you, say, ‘Speak, Lord , for your servant is listening.’ " So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, "Go, lie down; and it shall be, if He calls you, that you must say, ‘Speak, Lord, for Your servant hears.’ " So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
chapters.kjv: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD ; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ വന്നുനിന്നു മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ: ശമൂവേലേ, ശമൂവേലേ, എന്നു വിളിച്ചു. അതിന്നു ശമൂവേൽ: അരുളിച്ചെയ്യേണമേ; അടിയൻ കേൾക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Lord came and stood there, calling as at the other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" Then Samuel said, "Speak, for your servant is listening."
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord came and stood and called as at other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" And Samuel answered, "Speak, for Your servant hears."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ശമൂവേലിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരു കാര്യം ചെയ്യും; അതു കേൾക്കുന്നവന്റെ ചെവി രണ്ടും മുഴങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: And the Lord said to Samuel: "See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears about it tingle.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Samuel: "Behold, I will do something in Israel at which both ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഏലിയുടെ ഭവനത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ അന്നു അവന്റെമേൽ ആദ്യന്തം നിവർത്തിക്കും.
chapters.niv: At that time I will carry out against Eli everything I spoke against his family—from beginning to end.
chapters.nkjv: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from beginning to end.
chapters.kjv: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ദൈവദൂഷണം പറയുന്ന അകൃത്യം അവൻ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടും അവരെ ശാസിച്ചമർത്തായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അവന്റെ ഭവനത്തിന്നു എന്നേക്കും ശിക്ഷവിധിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For I told him that I would judge his family forever because of the sin he knew about; his sons blasphemed God, and he failed to restrain them.
chapters.nkjv: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knows, because his sons made themselves vile, and he did not restrain them.
chapters.kjv: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.

chapters.ml: ഏലിയുടെ ഭവനത്തിന്റെ അകൃത്യത്തിന്നു യാഗത്താലും വഴിപാടിനാലും ഒരു നാളും പരിഹാരം വരികയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ ഏലിയുടെ ഭവനത്തോടു സത്യംചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore I swore to the house of Eli, ‘The guilt of Eli’s house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be atoned for by sacrifice or offering forever."
chapters.kjv: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശമൂവേൽ രാവിലെവരെ കിടന്നുറങ്ങി; രാവിലെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ വാതിലുകളെ തുറന്നു. എന്നാൽ ഈ ദർശനം ഏലിയെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ ശമൂവേൽ ശങ്കിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Samuel lay down until morning and then opened the doors of the house of the Lord . He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel lay down until morning, and opened the doors of the house of the Lord. And Samuel was afraid to tell Eli the vision.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD . And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.

chapters.ml: ഏലി ശമൂവേലിനെ വിളിച്ചു: ശമൂവേലേ, മകനേ, എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അടിയൻ ഇതാ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but Eli called him and said, "Samuel, my son." Samuel answered, "Here I am."
chapters.nkjv: Then Eli called Samuel and said, "Samuel, my son!" He answered, "Here I am."
chapters.kjv: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: നിനക്കുണ്ടായ അരുളപ്പാടു എന്തു? എന്നെ ഒന്നും മറെക്കരുതേ; നിന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത സകലത്തിലും ഒരു വാക്കെങ്കിലും മറെച്ചാൽ ദൈവം നിന്നോടു തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും ചെയ്യട്ടേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What was it he said to you?" Eli asked. "Do not hide it from me. May God deal with you, be it ever so severely, if you hide from me anything he told you."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "What is the word that theLord spoke to you? Please do not hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that He said to you."
chapters.kjv: And he said, What is the thing that the Lord hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശമൂവേൽ സകലവും അവനെ അറിയിച്ചു; ഒന്നും മറെച്ചില്ല. എന്നാറെ അവൻ: യഹോവയല്ലോ; തന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ചെയ്യട്ടേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Samuel told him everything, hiding nothing from him. Then Eli said, "He is the Lord ; let him do what is good in his eyes."
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel told him everything, and hid nothing from him. And he said, "It is the Lord. Let Him do what seems good to Him."
chapters.kjv: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the LORD : let him do what seemeth him good.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശമൂവേൽ വളർന്നു, യഹോവ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ വചനങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നും നിഷ്ഫലമാകുവാൻ ഇടവരുത്തിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Lord was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.

chapters.ml: ദാൻ മുതൽ ബേർ-ശേബാവരെ ഉള്ള യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും ശമൂവേൽ യഹോവയുടെ വിശ്വസ്തപ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു ഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was attested as a prophet of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel hadbeen established as a prophet of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവ ശീലോവിൽ വെച്ചു ശമൂവേലിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ വചനത്താൽ വെളിപ്പെട്ടശേഷം യഹോവ വീണ്ടും വീണ്ടും ശീലോവിൽവെച്ചു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: The Lord continued to appear at Shiloh, and there he revealed himself to Samuel through his word.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord appeared again in Shiloh. For the Lord revealed Himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേലിന്റെ വചനം എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും വന്നിട്ടു: യിസ്രായേൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നേരെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു, ഏബെൻ-ഏസെരിന്നരികെ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ അഫേക്കിലും പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: And Samuel’s word came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to fight against the Philistines. The Israelites camped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines at Aphek.
chapters.nkjv: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out to battle against the Philistines, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.
chapters.kjv: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Eben-ezer: and the Philistines pitched in Aphek.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ അണിനിരന്നു; പട പരന്നപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു തോറ്റുപോയി; സൈന്യത്തിൽ ഏകദേശം നാലായിരംപേരെ അവർ പോർക്കളത്തിൽ വെച്ചു സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Philistines deployed their forces to meet Israel, and as the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand of them on the battlefield.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines put themselves in battle array against Israel. And when they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.

chapters.ml: പടജ്ജനം പാളയത്തിൽ വന്നാറെ യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാർ: ഇന്നു യഹോവ നമ്മെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു തോല്ക്കുമാറാക്കിയതു എന്തു? നാം ശീലോവിൽനിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തുക; അതു നമ്മുടെ ഇടയിൽ വന്നാൽ നമ്മെ നമ്മുടെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the soldiers returned to camp, the elders of Israel asked, "Why did the Lord bring defeat on us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Shiloh, so that he may go with us and save us from the hand of our enemies."
chapters.nkjv: And when the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, "Why has the Lord defeated us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Shiloh to us, that when it comes among us it may save us from the hand of our enemies."
chapters.kjv: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath the LORD smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh unto us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ജനം ശീലോവിലേക്കു ആളയച്ചു. അവർ കെരൂബുകളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ അധിവസിക്കുന്നവനായ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം അവിടെനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു. ഏലിയുടെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായ ഹൊഫ്നിയും ഫീനെഹാസും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നിയമപെട്ടകത്തോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim. And Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
chapters.nkjv: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from there the ark of the covenant of the Lord of hosts, who dwells between the cherubim. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
chapters.kjv: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth between the cherubims: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ നിമയപെട്ടകം പാളയത്തിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഭൂമി കുലുങ്ങുംവണ്ണം യിസ്രായേലെല്ലാം ഉച്ചത്തിൽ ആർപ്പിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the ark of the Lord ’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel raised such a great shout that the ground shook.
chapters.nkjv: And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord came into the camp, all Israel shouted so loudly that the earth shook.
chapters.kjv: And when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ആർപ്പിന്റെ ഒച്ച കേട്ടിട്ടു: എബ്രായരുടെ പാളയത്തിൽ ഈ വലിയ ആർപ്പിന്റെ കാരണം എന്തു എന്നു അന്വേഷിച്ചു, യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം പാളയത്തിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Hearing the uproar, the Philistines asked, "What’s all this shouting in the Hebrew camp?" When they learned that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp,
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, "What does the sound of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?" Then they understood that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp.
chapters.kjv: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of the LORD was come into the camp.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം പാളയത്തിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ പറഞ്ഞു ഭയപ്പെട്ടു: നമുക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം! ഇങ്ങനെ ഒരു കാര്യം ഇതുവരെ ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: the Philistines were afraid. "A god has come into the camp," they said. "Oh no! Nothing like this has happened before.
chapters.nkjv: So the Philistines were afraid, for they said, "God has come into the camp!" And they said, "Woe to us! For such a thing has never happened before.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.

chapters.ml: നമുക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം! ശക്തിയുള്ള ഈ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു നമ്മെ ആർ രക്ഷിക്കും? മിസ്രയീമ്യരെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ സകലവിധബാധകളാലും ബാധിച്ച ദൈവം ഇതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: We’re doomed! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? They are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: Woe to us! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യരേ, ധൈര്യം പൂണ്ടു പുരുഷത്വം കാണിപ്പിൻ; എബ്രായർ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ദാസന്മാരായിരുന്നതുപോലെ നിങ്ങൾ അവർക്കു ആകരുതു; പുരുഷത്വം കാണിച്ചു പൊരുതുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Be strong, Philistines! Be men, or you will be subject to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Be men, and fight!"
chapters.nkjv: Be strong and conduct yourselves like men, you Philistines, that you do not become servants of the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Conduct yourselves like men, and fight!"
chapters.kjv: Be strong, and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ പട തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽ തോറ്റു; ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു ഓടി; യിസ്രായേലിൽ മുപ്പതിനായിരം കാലാൾ വീണുപോകത്തക്കവണ്ണം ഒരു മഹാ സംഹാരം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: So the Philistines fought, and the Israelites were defeated and every man fled to his tent. The slaughter was very great; Israel lost thirty thousand foot soldiers.
chapters.nkjv: So the Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and every man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter, and there fell of Israel thirty thousand foot soldiers.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man into his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം പിടിപെട്ടു; ഏലിയുടെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായ ഹൊഫ്നിയും ഫീനെഹാസും പട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
chapters.nkjv: Also the ark of God was captured; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
chapters.kjv: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

chapters.ml: പോർക്കളത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ബെന്യാമീന്യൻ വസ്ത്രം കീറിയും തലയിൽ പൂഴി വാരിയിട്ടുംകൊണ്ടു ഓടി അന്നു തന്നെ ശീലോവിൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line and went to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dust on his head.
chapters.nkjv: Then a man of Benjamin ran from the battle line the same day, and came to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dirt on his head.
chapters.kjv: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army, and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent, and with earth upon his head.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വരുമ്പോൾ ഏലി നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു വഴിയരികെ തന്റെ ആസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അവന്റെ ഹൃദയം വ്യാകുലപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു; ആ മനുഷ്യൻ പട്ടണത്തിൽ എത്തി വസ്തുത പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ പട്ടണത്തിലെല്ലാം നിലവിളിയായി.
chapters.niv: When he arrived, there was Eli sitting on his chair by the side of the road, watching, because his heart feared for the ark of God. When the man entered the town and told what had happened, the whole town sent up a cry.
chapters.nkjv: Now when he came, there was Eli, sitting on a seat by the wayside watching, for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city and told it, all the city cried out.
chapters.kjv: And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it , all the city cried out.

chapters.ml: ഏലി നിലവിളികേട്ടപ്പോൾ ഈ ആരവം എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. ആ മനുഷ്യൻ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു വന്നു ഏലിയോടും അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Eli heard the outcry and asked, "What is the meaning of this uproar?" The man hurried over to Eli,
chapters.nkjv: When Eli heard the noise of the outcry, he said, "What does the sound of this tumult mean?" And the man came quickly and told Eli.
chapters.kjv: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What meaneth the noise of this tumult? And the man came in hastily, and told Eli.

chapters.ml: ഏലിയോ തൊണ്ണൂറ്റെട്ടു വയസ്സുള്ളവനും കാണ്മാൻ വഹിയാതവണ്ണം കണ്ണു മങ്ങിയവനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: who was ninety-eight years old and whose eyes had failed so that he could not see.
chapters.nkjv: Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his eyes were so dim that he could not see.
chapters.kjv: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.

chapters.ml: ആ മനുഷ്യൻ ഏലിയോടു: ഞാൻ പോർക്കളത്തിൽനിന്നു വന്നവൻ ആകുന്നു; ഇന്നു തന്നേ ഞാൻ പോർക്കളത്തിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. വർത്തമാനം എന്താകുന്നു, മകനേ, എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He told Eli, "I have just come from the battle line; I fled from it this very day." Eli asked, "What happened, my son?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the man said to Eli, "I am he who came from the battle. And I fled today from the battle line." And he said, "What happened, my son?"
chapters.kjv: And the man said unto Eli, I am he that came out of the army, and I fled to day out of the army. And he said, What is there done, my son?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ആ ദൂതൻ: യിസ്രായേൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ തോറ്റോടി; ജനത്തിൽ ഒരു മഹാസംഹാരം ഉണ്ടായി; നിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായ ഹൊഫ്നിയും ഫീനെഹാസും പട്ടുപോയി; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകവും പിടിപെട്ടുപോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The man who brought the news replied, "Israel fled before the Philistines, and the army has suffered heavy losses. Also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God has been captured."
chapters.nkjv: So the messenger answered and said, "Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been a great slaughter among the people. Also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead; and the ark of God has been captured."
chapters.kjv: And the messenger answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ വസ്തുത പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ഏലി പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ ആസനത്തിൽ നിന്നു പിറകോട്ടു വീണു കഴുത്തൊടിഞ്ഞു മരിച്ചു; അവൻ വൃദ്ധനും സ്ഥൂലിച്ചവനും ആയിരുന്നു. അവൻ നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell backward off his chair by the side of the gate. His neck was broken and he died, for he was an old man, and he was heavy. He had led Israel forty years.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, when he made mention of the ark of God, that Eli fell off the seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck was broken and he died, for the man was old and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ മരുമകൾ ഫീനെഹാസിന്റെ ഭാര്യ പ്രസവം അടുത്ത ഗർഭിണിയായിരുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം പിടിപെട്ടുപോയതും അമ്മാവിയപ്പനും ഭർത്താവും മരിച്ചതും കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവൾക്കു പ്രസവവേദന തുടങ്ങി; അവൾ നിലത്തു വീണു പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: His daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant and near the time of delivery. When she heard the news that the ark of God had been captured and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she went into labor and gave birth, but was overcome by her labor pains.
chapters.nkjv: Now his daughter-in-law, Phinehas’s wife, was with child, due to be delivered; and when she heard the news that the ark of God was captured, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth, for her labor pains came upon her.
chapters.kjv: And his daughter in law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to be delivered: and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken, and that her father in law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed; for her pains came upon her.

chapters.ml: അവൾ മരിപ്പാറായപ്പോൾ അരികെ നിന്ന സ്ത്രീകൾ അവളോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; നീ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ അവൾ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞില്ല, ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: As she was dying, the women attending her said, "Don’t despair; you have given birth to a son." But she did not respond or pay any attention.
chapters.nkjv: And about the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, "Do not fear, for you have borne a son." But she did not answer, nor did she regard it.
chapters.kjv: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said unto her, Fear not; for thou hast born a son. But she answered not, neither did she regard it .

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം പിടിപെട്ടുപോകകൊണ്ടും അമ്മാവിയപ്പനെയും ഭർത്താവിനെയും ഓർത്തിട്ടും: മഹത്വം യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു പൊയ്പോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൾ കുഞ്ഞിന്നു ഈഖാബോദ് എന്നു പേർ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: She named the boy Ichabod, saying, "The Glory has departed from Israel"—because of the capture of the ark of God and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband.
chapters.nkjv: Then she named the child Ichabod, saying, "The glory has departed from Israel!" because the ark of God had been captured and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
chapters.kjv: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം പിടിപെട്ടുപോകകൊണ്ടു മഹത്വം യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു പൊയ്പോയി എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She said, "The Glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured."
chapters.nkjv: And she said, "The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured."
chapters.kjv: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം എടുത്തു അതിനെ ഏബെൻ-ഏസെരിൽനിന്നു അസ്തോദിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Eben-ezer unto Ashdod.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം എടുത്തു ദാഗോന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു ദാഗോന്റെ അരികെ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they carried the ark into Dagon’s temple and set it beside Dagon.
chapters.nkjv: When the Philistines took the ark of God, they brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.
chapters.kjv: When the Philistines took the ark of God, they brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it by Dagon.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ രാവിലെ അസ്തോദ്യർ എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ ദാഗോൻ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കവിണ്ണുവീണു കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു. അവർ ദാഗോനെ എടുത്തു വീണ്ടും അവന്റെ സ്ഥാനത്തു നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: When the people of Ashdod rose early the next day, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! They took Dagon and put him back in his place.
chapters.nkjv: And when the people of Ashdod arose early in the morning, there was Dagon, fallen on its face to the earth before the ark of the Lord. So they took Dagon and set it in its place again.
chapters.kjv: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD . And they took Dagon, and set him in his place again.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ രാവിലെ അവർ എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ ദാഗോൻ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കവിണ്ണുവീണു കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു. ദാഗോന്റെ തലയും അവന്റെ കൈപ്പത്തികളും ഉമ്മരപ്പടിമേൽ മുറിഞ്ഞുകിടന്നു; ദാഗോന്റെ ഉടൽമാത്രം ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the following morning when they rose, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! His head and hands had been broken off and were lying on the threshold; only his body remained.
chapters.nkjv: And when they arose early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on its face to the ground before the ark of the Lord. The head of Dagon and both the palms of its hands were broken off on the threshold; only Dagon’s torso was left of it.
chapters.kjv: And when they arose early on the morrow morning, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the LORD ; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold; only the stump of Dagon was left to him.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ദാഗോന്റെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ദാഗോന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നവരും അസ്തോദിൽ ദാഗോന്റെ ഉമ്മരപ്പടിമേൽ ഇന്നും ചവിട്ടുമാറില്ല.
chapters.niv: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon’s temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
chapters.kjv: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon’s house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod unto this day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ കൈ അസ്തോദ്യരുടെമേൽ ഭാരമായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അവരെ ശൂന്യമാക്കി അസ്തോദിലും അതിന്റെ അതിരുകളിലും ഉള്ളവരെ മൂലരോഗത്താൽ ബാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord ’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity; he brought devastation on them and afflicted them with tumors.
chapters.nkjv: But the hand of the Lord was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and He ravaged them and struck them with tumors, both Ashdod and its territory.
chapters.kjv: But the hand of the LORD was heavy upon them of Ashdod, and he destroyed them, and smote them with emerods, even Ashdod and the coasts thereof.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഭവിച്ചതു അസ്തോദ്യർ കണ്ടിട്ടു: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഇരിക്കരുതു; അവന്റെ കൈ നമ്മുടെമേലും നമ്മുടെ ദേവനായ ദാഗോന്റെ മേലും കഠിനമായിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the people of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, "The ark of the god of Israel must not stay here with us, because his hand is heavy on us and on Dagon our god."
