chapters.kjv: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.

chapters.ml: അവർ പിന്നെയും യഹോവയോടു: ആയാൾ ഇവിടെ വന്നിട്ടുണ്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു യഹോവ: അവൻ സാമാനങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So they inquired further of the Lord , "Has the man come here yet?" And the Lord said, "Yes, he has hidden himself among the supplies."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they inquired of the Lord further, "Has the man come here yet?" And the Lord answered, "There he is, hidden among the equipment."
chapters.kjv: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു അവിടെനിന്നു അവനെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു. ജനമദ്ധ്യേ നിന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ ജനത്തിൽ എല്ലാവരെക്കാളും തോൾമുതൽ പൊക്കമേറിയവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They ran and brought him out, and as he stood among the people he was a head taller than any of the others.
chapters.nkjv: So they ran and brought him from there; and when he stood among the people, he was taller than any of the people from his shoulders upward.
chapters.kjv: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശമൂവേൽ സർവ്വജനത്തോടും: യഹോവ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തവനെ നിങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നുവോ? സർവ്വജനത്തിലും അവനെപ്പോലെ ഒരുത്തനും ഇല്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ജനമെല്ലാം: രാജാവേ, ജയ ജയ എന്നു ആർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Samuel said to all the people, "Do you see the man the Lord has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people." Then the people shouted, "Long live the king!"
chapters.nkjv: And Samuel said to all the people, "Do you see him whom the Lord has chosen, that thereis no one like him among all the people?" So all the people shouted and said, "Long live the king!"
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം ശമൂവേൽ രാജധർമ്മം ജനത്തെ പറഞ്ഞുകേൾപ്പിച്ചു; അതു ഒരു പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതി യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വെച്ചു. പിന്നെ ശമൂവേൽ ജനത്തെയെല്ലാം വീട്ടിലേക്കു പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Samuel explained to the people the rights and duties of kingship. He wrote them down on a scroll and deposited it before the Lord . Then Samuel dismissed the people to go to their own homes.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel explained to the people the behavior of royalty, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before the Lord. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
chapters.kjv: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD . And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

chapters.ml: ശൌലും ഗിബെയയിൽ തന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി; ദൈവം മനസ്സിൽ തോന്നിച്ച ഒരു ആൾക്കൂട്ടവും അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, accompanied by valiant men whose hearts God had touched.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and valiant men went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
chapters.kjv: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ചില നീചന്മാർ: ഇവൻ നമ്മെ എങ്ങനെ രക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ ധിക്കരിച്ചു, അവന്നു കാഴ്ച കൊണ്ടുവരാതിരുന്നു. അവനോ അതു ഗണ്യമാക്കിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But some scoundrels said, "How can this fellow save us?" They despised him and brought him no gifts. But Saul kept silent.
chapters.nkjv: But some rebels said, "How can this man save us?" So they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.
chapters.kjv: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അമ്മോന്യനായ നാഹാശ് പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശിന്നു നേരെ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി; യാബേശ് നിവാസികൾ ഒക്കെയും നാഹാശിനോടു: ഞങ്ങളോടു ഒരു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യേണം; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ സേവിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Nahash the Ammonite went up and besieged Jabesh Gilead. And all the men of Jabesh said to him, "Make a treaty with us, and we will be subject to you."
chapters.nkjv: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, "Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you."
chapters.kjv: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യനായ നാഹാശ് അവരോടു: നിങ്ങളുടെ വലങ്കണ്ണൊക്കെയും ചുഴന്നെടുക്കയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്മേലും ഈ നിന്ദ വരുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നുള്ള സമ്മതത്തിന്മേൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Nahash the Ammonite replied, "I will make a treaty with you only on the condition that I gouge out the right eye of every one of you and so bring disgrace on all Israel."
chapters.nkjv: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, "On this condition I will make acovenant with you, that I may put out all your right eyes, and bring reproach on all Israel."
chapters.kjv: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.

chapters.ml: യാബേശിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽദേശത്തെല്ലാടവും ദൂതന്മാരെ അയപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഏഴു ദിവസത്തെ ഇട തരേണം; ഞങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഇറങ്ങിവരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The elders of Jabesh said to him, "Give us seven days so we can send messengers throughout Israel; if no one comes to rescue us, we will surrender to you."
chapters.nkjv: Then the elders of Jabesh said to him, "Hold off for seven days, that we may send messengers to all the territory of Israel. And then, if thereis no one to save us, we will come out to you."
chapters.kjv: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days’ respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.

chapters.ml: ദൂതന്മാർ ശൌലിന്റെ ഗിബെയയിൽ ചെന്നു ആ വർത്തമാനം ജനത്തെ പറഞ്ഞു കേൾപ്പിച്ചു; ജനമെല്ലാം ഉറക്കെ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and reported these terms to the people, they all wept aloud.
chapters.nkjv: So the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and told the news in the hearing of the people. And all the people lifted up their voices and wept.
chapters.kjv: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, ശൌൽ കന്നുകാലികളെയും കൊണ്ടു വയലിൽനിന്നു വരുന്നു. ജനം കരയുന്ന സംഗതി എന്തു എന്നു ശൌൽ ചോദിച്ചു. അവർ യാബേശ്യരുടെ വർത്തമാനം അവനെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Just then Saul was returning from the fields, behind his oxen, and he asked, "What is wrong with everyone? Why are they weeping?" Then they repeated to him what the men of Jabesh had said.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was Saul, coming behind the herd from the field; and Saul said, "What troubles the people, that they weep?" And they told him the words of the men of Jabesh.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ വർത്തമാനം കേട്ടപ്പോൾ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആത്മാവു അവന്റെമേൽ ശക്തിയോടെ വന്നു; അവന്റെ കോപം ഏറ്റവും ജ്വലിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God came powerfully upon him, and he burned with anger.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard this news, and his anger was greatly aroused.
chapters.kjv: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരേർ കാളയെ പിടിച്ചു കഷണംകഷണമായി ഖണ്ഡിച്ചു ദൂതന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ യിസ്രായേൽദേശത്തെല്ലാടവും കൊടുത്തയച്ചു: ആരെങ്കിലും ശൌലിന്റെയും ശമൂവേലിന്റെയും പിന്നാലെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരാതിരുന്നാൽ അവന്റെ കാളകളെ ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറയിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ ഭീതി ജനത്തിന്മേൽ വീണു, അവർ ഏകമനസ്സോടെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He took a pair of oxen, cut them into pieces, and sent the pieces by messengers throughout Israel, proclaiming, "This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not follow Saul and Samuel." Then the terror of the Lord fell on the people, and they came out together as one.
chapters.nkjv: So he took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the territory of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, "Whoever does not go out with Saul and Samuel to battle, so it shall be done to his oxen." And the fear of the Lord fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.
chapters.kjv: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബേസെക്കിൽവെച്ചു അവരെ എണ്ണി; യിസ്രായേല്യർ മൂന്നു ലക്ഷവും യെഹൂദ്യർ മുപ്പതിനായിരവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Saul mustered them at Bezek, the men of Israel numbered three hundred thousand and those of Judah thirty thousand.
chapters.nkjv: When he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
chapters.kjv: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

chapters.ml: വന്ന ദൂതന്മാരോടു അവർ: നിങ്ങൾ ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശ്യരോടു: നാളെ വെയിൽ മൂക്കുമ്പോഴേക്കു നിങ്ങൾക്കു രക്ഷ ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ദൂതന്മാർ ചെന്നു യാബേശ്യരോടു അറിയിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ സന്തോഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They told the messengers who had come, "Say to the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘By the time the sun is hot tomorrow, you will be rescued.’ " When the messengers went and reported this to the men of Jabesh, they were elated.
chapters.nkjv: And they said to the messengers who came, "Thus you shall say to the men of Jabesh Gilead: ‘Tomorrow, by thetime the sun is hot, you shall have help.’ " Then the messengers came and reported it to the men of Jabesh, and they were glad.
chapters.kjv: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യാബേശ്യർ: നാളെ ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഇറങ്ങിവരും; നിങ്ങൾക്കു ബോധിച്ചതൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങളോടു ചെയ്തുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They said to the Ammonites, "Tomorrow we will surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you like."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, "Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you may do with us whatever seems good to you."
chapters.kjv: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ശൌൽ ജനത്തെ മൂന്നു കൂട്ടമായി വിഭാഗിച്ചു; അവർ പ്രഭാതയാമത്തിൽ പാളയത്തിന്റെ നടുവിലേക്കു ചെന്നു വെയിൽ മൂക്കുംവരെ അമ്മോന്യരെ സംഹരിച്ചു; ശേഷിച്ചവരോ രണ്ടു പേർ ഒന്നിച്ചിരിക്കാതവണ്ണം ചിതറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: The next day Saul separated his men into three divisions; during the last watch of the night they broke into the camp of the Ammonites and slaughtered them until the heat of the day. Those who survived were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, on the next day, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the camp in the morning watch, and killed Ammonites until the heat of the day. And it happened that those who survived were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.
chapters.kjv: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ജനം ശമൂവേലിനോടു: ശൌൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്കുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു ആർ? അവരെ ഏല്പിച്ചുതരേണം; ഞങ്ങൾ അവരെ കൊന്നുകളയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The people then said to Samuel, "Who was it that asked, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Turn these men over to us so that we may put them to death."
chapters.nkjv: Then the people said to Samuel, "Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring the men, that we may put them to death."
chapters.kjv: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശൌൽ: ഇന്നു ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെയും കൊല്ലരുതു; ഇന്നു യഹോവ യസ്രായേലിന്നു രക്ഷ വരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Saul said, "No one will be put to death today, for this day the Lord has rescued Israel."
chapters.nkjv: But Saul said, "Not a man shall be put to death this day, for today the Lord has accomplished salvation in Israel."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശമൂവേൽ ജനത്തോടു: വരുവിൻ; നാം ഗില്ഗാലിൽ ചെന്നു, അവിടെവെച്ചു രാജത്വം പുതുക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Samuel said to the people, "Come, let us go to Gilgal and there renew the kingship."
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel said to the people, "Come, let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingdom there."
chapters.kjv: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ജനമെല്ലാം ഗില്ഗാലിൽ ചെന്നു; അവർ ശൌലിനെ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽവെച്ചു രാജാവാക്കി. അവർ അവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങൾ കഴിച്ചു; ശൌലും യിസ്രായേല്യരൊക്കെയും ഏറ്റവും സന്തോഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So all the people went to Gilgal and made Saul king in the presence of the Lord . There they sacrificed fellowship offerings before the Lord , and Saul and all the Israelites held a great celebration.
chapters.nkjv: So all the people went to Gilgal, and there they made Saul king before the Lord in Gilgal. There they made sacrifices of peace offerings before the Lord, and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
chapters.kjv: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശമൂവേൽ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനോടും പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞതിൽ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു രാജാവിനെയും വാഴിച്ചുതന്നു.
chapters.niv: Samuel said to all Israel, "I have listened to everything you said to me and have set a king over you.
chapters.nkjv: Now Samuel said to all Israel: "Indeed I have heeded your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ രാജാവു നിങ്ങളുടെ നായകനായിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാനോ വൃദ്ധനും നരച്ചവനുമായി; എന്റെ മക്കൾ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു; എന്റെ ബാല്യം മുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെയും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു നായകനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now you have a king as your leader. As for me, I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have been your leader from my youth until this day.
chapters.nkjv: And now here is the king, walking before you; and I am old and grayheaded, and look, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my childhood to this day.
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇതാ, ഇവിടെ നില്ക്കുന്നു: ഞാൻ ഒരുത്തന്റെ കാളയെ അപഹരിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ? ഒരുത്തന്റെ കഴുതയെ അപഹരിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ? ഞാൻ വല്ലവനെയും ചതിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ? വല്ലവനെയും പീഡിപ്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ? ഞാൻ വല്ലവന്റെയും കയ്യിൽനിന്നു കൈക്കൂലി വാങ്ങി എന്റെ കണ്ണു കുരുടാക്കീട്ടുണ്ടോ? യഹോവയുടെയും അവന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തന്റെയും മുമ്പാകെ എന്റെ നേരെ സാക്ഷീകരിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ അതു മടക്കിത്തരാം.
chapters.niv: Here I stand. Testify against me in the presence of the Lord and his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated? Whom have I oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe to make me shut my eyes? If I have done any of these things, I will make it right."
chapters.nkjv: Here I am. Witness against me before the Lord and before His anointed: Whose ox have I taken, or whose donkey have I taken, or whom have I cheated? Whom have I oppressed, or from whose hand have I received any bribe with which to blind my eyes? I will restore it to you."
chapters.kjv: Behold, here I am: witness against me before the LORD , and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: നീ ഞങ്ങളെ ചതിക്കയോ പീഡിപ്പിക്കയോ യാതൊരുത്തന്റെയും കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വല്ലതും അപഹരിക്കയോ ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You have not cheated or oppressed us," they replied. "You have not taken anything from anyone’s hand."
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "You have not cheated us or oppressed us, nor have you taken anything from any man’s hand."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man’s hand.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ പേരിൽ ഒന്നും കണ്ടില്ല എന്നുള്ളതിന്നു യഹോവ സാക്ഷി; അവന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തനും ഇന്നു സാക്ഷി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Samuel said to them, "The Lord is witness against you, and also his anointed is witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand." "He is witness," they said.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to them, "The Lordis witness against you, and His anointed is witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand." And they answered, "Heis witness."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശമൂവേൽ ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: മോശെയെയും അഹരോനെയും കല്പിച്ചാക്കുകയും നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവരികയും ചെയ്തവൻ യഹോവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then Samuel said to the people, "It is the Lord who appointed Moses and Aaron and brought your ancestors up out of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel said to the people, "Itis the Lord who raised up Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up from the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഒത്തുനില്പിൻ; യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കും നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കും ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള സകലനീതികളെയും കുറിച്ചു ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നിങ്ങളോടു വ്യവഹരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Now then, stand here, because I am going to confront you with evidence before the Lord as to all the righteous acts performed by the Lord for you and your ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, stand still, that I may reason with you before the Lord concerning all the righteous acts of the Lord which He did to you and your fathers:
chapters.kjv: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD , which he did to you and to your fathers.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ് മിസ്രയീമിൽചെന്നു പാർത്തു; അവിടെവെച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ യഹോവ മോശെയെയും അഹരോനെയും അയച്ചു; അവർ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ഈ സ്ഥലത്തു പാർക്കുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: "After Jacob entered Egypt, they cried to the Lord for help, and the Lord sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your ancestors out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
chapters.nkjv: When Jacob had gone into Egypt, and your fathers cried out to the Lord, then the Lord sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and made them dwell in this place.
chapters.kjv: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD , then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ മറന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരെ ഹാസോരിലെ സേനാപതിയായ സീസെരയുടെ കയ്യിലും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിലും മോവാബ്‌രാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിലും ഏല്പിച്ചു, അവർ അവരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "But they forgot the Lord their God; so he sold them into the hand of Sisera, the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.
chapters.nkjv: And when they forgot the Lord their God, He sold them into the hand of Sisera, commander of the army of Hazor, into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.
chapters.kjv: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു: ഞങ്ങൾ യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു ബാൽവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും അസ്തോരെത്ത് പ്രതിഷ്ഠകളെയും സേവിച്ചു പാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ ഞങ്ങളെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ സേവിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They cried out to the Lord and said, ‘We have sinned; we have forsaken the Lord and served the Baals and the Ashtoreths. But now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, and we will serve you.’
chapters.nkjv: Then they cried out to the Lord, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken the Lord and served the Baals and Ashtoreths; but now deliver us from the hand of our enemies, and we will serve You.’
chapters.kjv: And they cried unto the LORD , and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD , and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യഹോവ യെരുബ്ബാൽ, ബെദാൻ, യിഫ്താഹ്, ശമൂവേൽ എന്നിവരെ അയച്ചു ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു നിങ്ങളെ വിടുവിച്ചു; നിങ്ങൾ നിർഭയമായി വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord sent Jerub-Baal, Barak, Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from the hands of your enemies all around you, so that you lived in safety.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you dwelt in safety.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവായ നാഹാശ് നിങ്ങളുടെ നേരെ വരുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്കെ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു: ഒരു രാജാവു ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വാഴേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we want a king to rule over us’—even though the Lord your God was your king.
chapters.nkjv: And when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall reign over us,’ when the Lord your God was your king.
chapters.kjv: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God was your king.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, നിങ്ങൾ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തവനും ആഗ്രഹിച്ചവനുമായ രാജാവു; യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു രാജാവിനെ കല്പിച്ചാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you asked for; see, the Lord has set a king over you.
chapters.nkjv: "Now therefore, here is the king whom you have chosen and whom you have desired. And take note, the Lord has set a king over you.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനയെ മറുക്കാതെ യഹോവയെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു അവനെ സേവിച്ചു അവന്റെ വാക്കു അനുസരിക്കയും നിങ്ങളും നിങ്ങളെ വാഴുന്ന രാജാവും നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു ചേർന്നിരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ കൊള്ളാം.
chapters.niv: If you fear the Lord and serve and obey him and do not rebel against his commands, and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow the Lord your God—good!
chapters.nkjv: If you fear the Lord and serve Him and obey His voice, and do not rebel against the commandment of the Lord, then both you and the king who reigns over you will continue following the Lord your God.
chapters.kjv: If ye will fear the LORD , and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD , then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ വാക്കു അനുസരിക്കാതെ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനയെ മറുത്താൽ യഹോവയുടെ കൈ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കു വിരോധമായിരുന്നതുപോലെ നിങ്ങൾക്കും വിരോധമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But if you do not obey the Lord , and if you rebel against his commands, his hand will be against you, as it was against your ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: However, if you do not obey the voice of the Lord, but rebel against the commandment of the Lord, then the hand of the Lord will be against you, as itwas against your fathers.
chapters.kjv: But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD , but rebel against the commandment of the LORD , then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as it was against your fathers.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ നിന്നു യഹോവ നിങ്ങൾ കാൺകെ ചെയ്‍വാൻ പോകുന്ന ഈ വലിയ കാര്യം കണ്ടുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Now then, stand still and see this great thing the Lord is about to do before your eyes!
chapters.nkjv: "Now therefore, stand and see this great thing which the Lord will do before your eyes:
chapters.kjv: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കോതമ്പുകൊയ്ത്തിന്റെ കാലമല്ലോ; ഞാൻ യഹോവയോടു അപേക്ഷിക്കും; അവൻ ഇടിയും മഴയും അയക്കും; നിങ്ങൾ ഒരു രാജാവിനെ ചോദിക്കയാൽ യഹോവയോടു ചെയ്ത ദോഷം എത്ര വലിയതെന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അതിനാൽ കണ്ടറിയും.
chapters.niv: Is it not wheat harvest now? I will call on the Lord to send thunder and rain. And you will realize what an evil thing you did in the eyes of the Lord when you asked for a king."
chapters.nkjv: Is today not the wheat harvest? I will call to the Lord, and He will send thunder and rain, that you may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the sight of the Lord, in asking a king for yourselves."
chapters.kjv: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD , and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD , in asking you a king.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശമൂവേൽ യഹോവയോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; യഹോവ അന്നു ഇടിയും മഴയും അയച്ചു; ജനമെല്ലാം യഹോവയെയും ശമൂവേലിനെയും ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Samuel called on the Lord , and that same day the Lord sent thunder and rain. So all the people stood in awe of the Lord and of Samuel.
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel called to the Lord, and the Lord sent thunder and rain that day; and all the people greatly feared the Lord and Samuel.
chapters.kjv: So Samuel called unto the LORD ; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

chapters.ml: ജനമെല്ലാം ശമൂവേലിനോടു: അടിയങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കേണമേ; ഞങ്ങൾ മരിച്ചുപോകരുതേ; ഒരു രാജാവിനെ അപേക്ഷിച്ചതിൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ സകലപാപങ്ങളോടും ഞങ്ങൾ ഈ ഒരു ദോഷവും കൂട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The people all said to Samuel, "Pray to the Lord your God for your servants so that we will not die, for we have added to all our other sins the evil of asking for a king."
chapters.nkjv: And all the people said to Samuel, "Pray for your servants to the Lord your God, that we may not die; for we have added to all our sins the evil of asking a king for ourselves."
chapters.kjv: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഭയപ്പെടായ്‍വിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ ഈ ദോഷമൊക്കെയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; എങ്കിലും യഹോവയെ വിട്ടുമാറാതെ പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടെ യഹോവയെ സേവിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Do not be afraid," Samuel replied. "You have done all this evil; yet do not turn away from the Lord , but serve the Lord with all your heart.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel said to the people, "Do not fear. You have done all this wickedness; yet do not turn aside from following the Lord, but serve the Lord with all your heart.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD , but serve the LORD with all your heart;

chapters.ml: വിട്ടുമാറി, ഉപകാരമില്ലാത്തവയും രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കഴിയാത്തവയുമായ മിത്ഥ്യാമൂർത്തികളോടു നിങ്ങൾ ചേരരുതു; അവ മിത്ഥ്യാവസ്തു തന്നേയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Do not turn away after useless idols. They can do you no good, nor can they rescue you, because they are useless.
chapters.nkjv: And do not turn aside; for thenyouwouldgo after empty things which cannot profit or deliver, for they are nothing.
chapters.kjv: And turn ye not aside: for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ മഹത്തായ നാമംനിമിത്തം തന്റെ ജനത്തെ കൈവിടുകയില്ല; നിങ്ങളെ തന്റെ ജനമാക്കിക്കൊൾവാൻ യഹോവെക്കു ഇഷ്ടം തോന്നിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the sake of his great name the Lord will not reject his people, because the Lord was pleased to make you his own.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord will not forsake His people, for His great name’s sake, because it has pleased the Lord to make you His people.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കാതിരിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ യഹോവയോടു പാപം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഇടവരരുതേ; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു നല്ലതും ചൊവ്വുള്ളതുമായ വഴി ഉപദേശിക്കും.
chapters.niv: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the Lord by failing to pray for you. And I will teach you the way that is good and right.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the Lord in ceasing to pray for you; but I will teach you the good and the right way.
chapters.kjv: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പരമാർത്ഥതയോടുംകൂടെ സേവിക്കമാത്രം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എത്ര വലിയ കാര്യം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: But be sure to fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.
chapters.nkjv: Only fear the Lord, and serve Him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things He has done for you.
chapters.kjv: Only fear the LORD , and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഇനിയും ദോഷം ചെയ്താൽ നിങ്ങളും നിങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവും നശിച്ചുപോകും.
chapters.niv: Yet if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will perish."
chapters.nkjv: But if you still do wickedly, you shall be swept away, both you and your king."
chapters.kjv: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ രാജാവായപ്പോൾ (മുപ്പതു) വയസ്സുള്ളവനായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിൽ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty- two years.
chapters.nkjv: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,
chapters.kjv: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ യിസ്രായേലിൽ മൂവായിരം പേരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു; രണ്ടായിരംപേർ ശൌലിനോടുകൂടെ മിക്മാസിലും ബേഥേൽമലയിലും ആയിരം പേർ യോനാഥാനോടുകൂടെ ബെന്യാമീനിലെ ഗിബെയയിലും ആയിരുന്നു; ശേഷം ജനത്തെ അവൻ അവനവന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul chose three thousand men from Israel; two thousand were with him at Mikmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah in Benjamin. The rest of the men he sent back to their homes.
chapters.nkjv: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel. Two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the mountains of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. The rest of the people he sent away, every man to his tent.
chapters.kjv: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോനാഥാൻ ഗേബയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്പട്ടാളത്തെ തോല്പിച്ചു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ അതു കേട്ടു. എബ്രായർ കേൾക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ശൌൽ ദേശത്തെല്ലാടവും കാഹളം ഊതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul had the trumpet blown throughout the land and said, "Let the Hebrews hear!"
chapters.nkjv: And Jonathan attacked the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard ofit. Then Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, "Let the Hebrews hear!"
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്പട്ടാളത്തെ തോല്പിച്ചു എന്നും യിസ്രായേൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കു നാറ്റമായി എന്നും യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും കേട്ടിട്ടു ജനം ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ വന്നു കൂടി.
chapters.niv: So all Israel heard the news: "Saul has attacked the Philistine outpost, and now Israel has become obnoxious to the Philistines." And the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.
chapters.nkjv: Now all Israel heard it said that Saul had attacked a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel had also become an abomination to the Philistines. And the people were called together to Saul at Gilgal.
chapters.kjv: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ മുപ്പതിനായിരം രഥവും ആറായിരം കുതിരച്ചേവകരും കടല്പുറത്തെ മണൽപോലെ അസംഖ്യം ജനവുമായി ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി; അവർ വന്നു ബേത്ത്-ആവെന്നു കിഴക്കു മിക്മാസിൽ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The Philistines assembled to fight Israel, with three thousand chariots, six thousand charioteers, and soldiers as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Mikmash, east of Beth Aven.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines gathered together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. And they came up and encamped in Michmash, to the east of Beth Aven.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനം ഉപദ്രവിക്കപ്പെട്ടതുകൊണ്ടു തങ്ങൾ വിഷമത്തിലായി എന്നു യിസ്രായേല്യർ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ജനം ഗുഹകളിലും പള്ളക്കാടുകളിലും പാറകളിലും ഗഹ്വരങ്ങളിലും കുഴികളിലും ചെന്നു ഒളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the Israelites saw that their situation was critical and that their army was hard pressed, they hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in pits and cisterns.
chapters.nkjv: When the men of Israel saw that they were in danger (for the people were distressed), then the people hid in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in holes, and in pits.
chapters.kjv: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

chapters.ml: എബ്രായർ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു ഗാദ്‌ദേശത്തും ഗിലെയാദിലും പോയി; ശൌലോ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു; ജനമെല്ലാം പേടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul remained at Gilgal, and all the troops with him were quaking with fear.
chapters.nkjv: And someof the Hebrews crossed over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was still in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
chapters.kjv: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരുന്ന അവധിഅനുസരിച്ചു അവൻ ഏഴു ദിവസം കാത്തിരുന്നു എങ്കിലും ശമൂവേൽ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ എത്തിയില്ല; ജനവും അവനെ വിട്ടു ചിതറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: He waited seven days, the time set by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and Saul’s men began to scatter.
chapters.nkjv: Then he waited seven days, according to the time set by Samuel. But Samuel did not come to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
chapters.kjv: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ: ഹോമയാഗവും സമാധാനയാഗവും ഇവിടെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്നേ ഹോമയാഗം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he said, "Bring me the burnt offering and the fellowship offerings." And Saul offered up the burnt offering.
chapters.nkjv: So Saul said, "Bring a burnt offering and peace offerings here to me." And he offered the burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗം കഴിച്ചു തീർന്ന ഉടനെ ഇതാ, ശമൂവേൽ വരുന്നു; ശൌൽ അവനെ വന്ദനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Just as he finished making the offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as soon as he had finished presenting the burnt offering, that Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

chapters.ml: നീ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു എന്നു ശമൂവേൽ ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു ശൌൽ: ജനം എന്നെ വിട്ടു ചിതറുന്നു എന്നും നിശ്ചയിച്ച അവധിക്കു നീ എത്തിയില്ല എന്നും ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ മിക്മാസിൽ കൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നും ഞാൻ കണ്ടിട്ടു:
chapters.niv: "What have you done?" asked Samuel. Saul replied, "When I saw that the men were scattering, and that you did not come at the set time, and that the Philistines were assembling at Mikmash,
chapters.nkjv: And Samuel said, "What have you done?" Saul said, "When I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you did not come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered together at Michmash,
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഇപ്പോൾ ഇങ്ങു ഗില്ഗാലിൽ വന്നു എന്നെ ആക്രമിക്കും; ഞാൻ യഹോവയോടു കൃപെക്കായി അപേക്ഷിച്ചതുമില്ലല്ലോ എന്നുവെച്ചു ഞാൻ ധൈര്യപ്പെട്ടു ഹോമയാഗം കഴിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the Lord ’s favor.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering."
chapters.nkjv: then I said, ‘The Philistines will now come down on me at Gilgal, and I have not made supplication to the Lord.’ Therefore I felt compelled, and offered a burnt offering."
chapters.kjv: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD : I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ ചെയ്തതു ഭോഷത്വം; നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ച കല്പന നീ പ്രമാണിച്ചില്ല; യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്മേൽ നിന്റെ രാജത്വം എന്നേക്കുമായി സ്ഥിരമാക്കുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "You have done a foolish thing," Samuel said. "You have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you; if you had, he would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.
chapters.nkjv: And Samuel said to Saul, "You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the Lord your God, which He commanded you. For now the Lord would have established your kingdom over Israel forever.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴോ നിന്റെ രാജത്വം നിലനിൽക്കയില്ല; യഹോവ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതിനെ നീ പ്രമാണിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു തനിക്കു ബോധിച്ച ഒരു പുരുഷനെ യഹോവ അന്വേഷിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു; അവനെ യഹോവ തന്റെ ജനത്തിന്നു പ്രഭുവായി നിയമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But now your kingdom will not endure; the Lord has sought out a man after his own heart and appointed him ruler of his people, because you have not kept the Lord ’s command."
chapters.nkjv: But now your kingdom shall not continue. The Lord has sought for Himself a man after His own heart, and the Lord has commanded him tobe commander over His people, because you have not kept what the Lord commanded you."
chapters.kjv: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശമൂവേൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഗില്ഗാലിൽനിന്നു ബെന്യാമീനിലെ ഗിബെയയിലേക്കു പോയി. ശൌൽ തന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള പടജ്ജനത്തെ എണ്ണി ഏകദേശം അറുനൂറു പേർ എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Samuel left Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin, and Saul counted the men who were with him. They numbered about six hundred.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people present with him, about six hundred men.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.

chapters.ml: ശൌലും അവന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാനും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനവും ബെന്യാമീനിലെ ഗിബെയയിൽ പാർത്തു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോ മിക്മാസിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Saul and his son Jonathan and the men with them were staying in Gibeah in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Mikmash.
chapters.nkjv: Saul, Jonathan his son, and the people present with them remained in Gibeah of Benjamin. But the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
chapters.kjv: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പാളയത്തിൽനിന്നു കവർച്ചക്കാർ മൂന്നു കൂട്ടമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു; ഒരു കൂട്ടം ഒഫ്രെക്കുള്ള വഴിയായി ശൂവാൽദേശത്തേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: Raiding parties went out from the Philistine camp in three detachments. One turned toward Ophrah in the vicinity of Shual,
chapters.nkjv: Then raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies. One company turned onto the road to Ophrah, to the land of Shual,
chapters.kjv: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരുകൂട്ടം ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോനിലേക്കുള്ള വഴിക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു; മറ്റേ കൂട്ടം മരുഭൂമിക്കു നേരേ സെബോയീംതാഴ്വരെക്കെതിരെയുള്ള ദേശം വഴിയായും തിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: another toward Beth Horon, and the third toward the borderland overlooking the Valley of Zeboyim facing the wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: another company turned to the road to Beth Horon, and another company turned to the road of the border that overlooks the Valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And another company turned the way to Beth-horon: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽദേശത്തെങ്ങും ഒരു കൊല്ലനെ കാണ്മാനില്ലായിരുന്നു; എബ്രായർ വാളോ കുന്തമോ തീർപ്പിക്കരുതു എന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Not a blacksmith could be found in the whole land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, "Otherwise the Hebrews will make swords or spears!"
chapters.nkjv: Now there was no blacksmith to be found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, "Lest the Hebrews make swords or spears."
chapters.kjv: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ തങ്ങളുടെ കൊഴു, കലപ്പ, മഴു, മൺവെട്ടി എന്നിവ കാച്ചിപ്പാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: So all Israel went down to the Philistines to have their plow points, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened.
chapters.nkjv: But all the Israelites would go down to the Philistines to sharpen each man’s plowshare, his mattock, his ax, and his sickle;
chapters.kjv: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മൺവെട്ടി, കലപ്പ, മുപ്പല്ലി, മഴു എന്നിവെക്കായും മുടിങ്കോൽ കൂർപ്പിപ്പാനും അവർക്കു അരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The price was two-thirds of a shekel for sharpening plow points and mattocks, and a third of a shekel for sharpening forks and axes and for repointing goads.
chapters.nkjv: and the charge for a sharpening was a pim for the plowshares, the mattocks, the forks, and the axes, and to set the points of the goads.
chapters.kjv: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യുദ്ധസമയത്തു ശൌലിനോടും യോനാഥാനോടും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തന്നും വാളും കുന്തവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; ശൌലിന്നും അവന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാന്നും മാത്രമേ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: So on the day of the battle not a soldier with Saul and Jonathan had a sword or spear in his hand; only Saul and his son Jonathan had them.
chapters.nkjv: So it came about, on the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan. But they were found with Saul and Jonathan his son.
chapters.kjv: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പട്ടാളമോ മിക്മാസിലെ ചുരംവരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now a detachment of Philistines had gone out to the pass at Mikmash.
chapters.nkjv: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.
chapters.kjv: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദിവസം ശൌലിന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാൻ തന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനായ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: വരിക, നാം അങ്ങോട്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പട്ടാളത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ചെല്ലുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ അപ്പനോടു പറഞ്ഞില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to his young armor-bearer, "Come, let’s go over to the Philistine outpost on the other side." But he did not tell his father.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened one day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, "Come, let us go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side." But he did not tell his father.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines’ garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ഗിബെയയുടെ അതിരിങ്കൽ മിഗ്രോനിലെ മാതളനാരകത്തിൻ കീഴിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു. അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പടജ്ജനം ഏകദേശം അറുനൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron. With him were about six hundred men,
chapters.nkjv: And Saul was sitting in the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron. The people who were with him were about six hundred men.
chapters.kjv: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

chapters.ml: ശീലോവിൽ യഹോവയുടെ പുരോഹിതനായിരുന്ന ഏലിയുടെ മകനായ ഫീനെഹാസിന്റെ മകനായ ഈഖാബോദിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അഹീതൂബിന്റെ മകൻ അഹീയാവു ആയിരുന്നു അന്നു ഏഫോദ് ധരിച്ചിരുന്നതു. യോനാഥാൻ പോയതു ജനം അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: among whom was Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was a son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord ’s priest in Shiloh. No one was aware that Jonathan had left.
chapters.nkjv: Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord’s priest in Shiloh, was wearing an ephod. But the people did not know that Jonathan had gone.
chapters.kjv: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, I-chabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD’s priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പട്ടാളത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ചെല്ലുവാൻ നോക്കിയ വഴിയിൽ ഇപ്പുറവും അപ്പുറവും കടുന്തൂക്കമായ ഓരോ പാറ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഒന്നിന്നു ബോസേസ് എന്നും മറ്റേതിന്നു സേനെ എന്നും പേർ.
chapters.niv: On each side of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost was a cliff; one was called Bozez and the other Seneh.
chapters.nkjv: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, therewas a sharp rock on one side and a sharp rock on the other side. And the name of one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
chapters.kjv: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നു വടക്കുവശം മിക്മാസിന്നു മുഖമായും മറ്റേതു തെക്കുവശം ഗിബെയെക്കു മുഖമായും തൂക്കെ നിന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One cliff stood to the north toward Mikmash, the other to the south toward Geba.
chapters.nkjv: The front of one faced northward opposite Michmash, and the other southward opposite Gibeah.
chapters.kjv: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ തന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനായ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: വരിക, നമുക്കു ഈ അഗ്രചർമ്മികളുടെ പട്ടാളത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ചെല്ലാം; പക്ഷെ യഹോവ നമുക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രവർത്തിക്കും; അധികംകൊണ്ടോ അല്പംകൊണ്ടോ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രായസമില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan said to his young armor-bearer, "Come, let’s go over to the outpost of those uncircumcised men. Perhaps the Lord will act in our behalf. Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, "Come, let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised; it may be that the Lord will work for us. For nothing restrains the Lord from saving by many or by few."
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

chapters.ml: ആയുധവാഹകൻ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ മനസ്സുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്ക; നടന്നുകൊൾക; നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Do all that you have in mind," his armor-bearer said. "Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul."
chapters.nkjv: So his armorbearer said to him, "Do all that is in your heart. Go then; here I am with you, according to your heart."
chapters.kjv: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോനാഥാൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: നാം അവരുടെ നേരെ ചെന്നു അവർക്കു നമ്മെത്തന്നെ കാണിക്കാം;
chapters.niv: Jonathan said, "Come on, then; we will cross over toward them and let them see us.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan said, "Very well, let us cross over to these men, and we will show ourselves to them.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവോളം നില്പിൻ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞാൽ നാം അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ കയറിപ്പോകാതെ നിന്നേടത്തുതന്നേ നിൽക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If they say to us, ‘Wait there until we come to you,’ we will stay where we are and not go up to them.
chapters.nkjv: If they say thus to us, ‘Wait until we come to you,’ then we will stand still in our place and not go up to them.
chapters.kjv: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങോട്ടു കയറിവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാലോ നമുക്കു കയറിച്ചെല്ലാം; യഹോവ അവരെ നമ്മുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നതിന്നു ഇതു നമുക്കു അടയാളം ആയിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ we will climb up, because that will be our sign that the Lord has given them into our hands."
chapters.nkjv: But if they say thus, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up. For the Lord has delivered them into our hand, and this willbe a sign to us."
chapters.kjv: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ ഇരുവരും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പട്ടാളത്തിന്നു തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ കാണിച്ചപ്പോൾ: ഇതാ, എബ്രായർ ഒളിച്ചിരുന്ന പൊത്തുകളിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു വരുന്നു എന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So both of them showed themselves to the Philistine outpost. "Look!" said the Philistines. "The Hebrews are crawling out of the holes they were hiding in."
chapters.nkjv: So both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines. And the Philistines said, "Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they have hidden."
chapters.kjv: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

chapters.ml: പട്ടാളക്കാർ യോനാഥാനോടും അവന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനോടും: ഇങ്ങോട്ടു കയറിവരുവിൻ; ഞങ്ങൾ ഒന്നു കാണിച്ചുതരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ യോനാഥാൻ തന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനോടു: എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ കയറിവരിക; യഹോവ അവരെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, "Come up to us and we’ll teach you a lesson." So Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, "Climb up after me; the Lord has given them into the hand of Israel."
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of the garrison called to Jonathan and his armorbearer, and said, "Come up to us, and we will show you something." Jonathan said to his armorbearer, "Come up after me, for the Lord has delivered them into the hand of Israel."
chapters.kjv: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോനാഥാനും അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ആയുധവാഹകനും തത്തിപ്പിടിച്ചു കയറി; അവർ യോനാഥന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വീണു; ആയുധവാഹകൻ അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ കൊന്നുംകൊണ്ടു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan climbed up, using his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer right behind him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and killed behind him.
chapters.nkjv: And Jonathan climbed up on his hands and knees with his armorbearer after him; and they fell before Jonathan. And as he came after him, his armorbearer killed them.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാനും ആയുധവാഹകനും ചെയ്ത ഈ ആദ്യസംഹാരത്തിൽ ഒരു കാണിനിലത്തിന്റെ പാതി നീളത്തിന്നകം ഇരുപതുപേർ വീണു.
chapters.niv: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.
chapters.nkjv: That first slaughter which Jonathan and his armorbearer made was about twenty men within about half an acre of land.
chapters.kjv: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow .

chapters.ml: പാളയത്തിലും പോർക്കളത്തിലും സർവ്വജനത്തിലും നടുക്കമുണ്ടായി പട്ടാളവും കവർച്ചക്കാരും കൂടെ വിറച്ചു, ഭൂമി കുലുങ്ങി, വലിയോരു നടുക്കം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then panic struck the whole army—those in the camp and field, and those in the outposts and raiding parties—and the ground shook. It was a panic sent by God.
chapters.nkjv: And there was trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people. The garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so that it was a very great trembling.
chapters.kjv: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ബെന്യാമീനിലെ ഗിബെയയിൽനിന്നു ശൌലിന്റെ കാവൽക്കാർ നോക്കി പുരുഷാരം ചിന്നി അങ്ങുമിങ്ങും ഓടുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Saul’s lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the army melting away in all directions.
chapters.nkjv: Now the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and there was the multitude, melting away; and they went here and there.
chapters.kjv: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another .

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ കൂടെയുള്ള ജനത്തോടു: എണ്ണിനോക്കി നമ്മിൽനിന്നു പോയവർ ആരെന്നറിവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അവർ എണ്ണിനോക്കിയപ്പോൾ യോനാഥാനും അവന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനും ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul said to the men who were with him, "Muster the forces and see who has left us." When they did, it was Jonathan and his armor-bearer who were not there.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, "Now call the roll and see who has gone from us." And when they had called the roll, surprisingly, Jonathan and his armorbearer were not there.
chapters.kjv: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there .

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ അഹീയാവിനോടു: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ഇവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ആ കാലത്തു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God." (At that time it was with the Israelites.)
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God here" (for at that time the ark of God was with the children of Israel).
chapters.kjv: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ പുരോഹിതനോടു സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പാളയത്തിലെ കലാപം മേല്ക്കുമേൽ വർദ്ധിച്ചുവന്നു. അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ പുരോഹിതനോടു: നിന്റെ കൈ വലിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the Philistine camp increased more and more. So Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, while Saul talked to the priest, that the noise which was in the camp of the Philistines continued to increase; so Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

chapters.ml: ശൌലും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനമൊക്കെയും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി പടെക്കു ചെന്നു, അവിടെ അവർ അന്യോന്യം വെട്ടി വലിയ കലക്കമായിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul and all his men assembled and went to the battle. They found the Philistines in total confusion, striking each other with their swords.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul and all the people who were with him assembled, and they went to the battle; and indeed every man’s sword was against his neighbor, andtherewas very great confusion.
chapters.kjv: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

chapters.ml: മുമ്പെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു ചേർന്നു ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ദേശത്തുനിന്നു അവരോടുകൂടെ പാളയത്തിൽവന്നിരുന്ന എബ്രായരും ശൌലിനോടും യോനാഥാനോടും കൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന യിസ്രായേല്യരുടെ പക്ഷം തിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Those Hebrews who had previously been with the Philistines and had gone up with them to their camp went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before that time, who went up with them into the camp fromthe surrounding country, they also joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
chapters.kjv: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ ഒളിച്ചിരുന്ന യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഒക്കെയും ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ തോറ്റോടി എന്നു കേട്ടയുടനെ അവരും പടയിൽ ചേർന്നു അവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When all the Israelites who had hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were on the run, they joined the battle in hot pursuit.
chapters.nkjv: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden in the mountains of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, they also followed hard after them in the battle.
chapters.kjv: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവ അന്നു യിസ്രായേലിനെ രക്ഷിച്ചു; പട ബേത്ത്-ആവെൻ വരെ പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: So on that day the Lord saved Israel, and the battle moved on beyond Beth Aven.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord saved Israel that day, and the battle shifted to Beth Aven.
chapters.kjv: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth-aven.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യെക്കു മുമ്പും ഞാൻ എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളോടു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യുവോളവും ആഹാരം കഴിക്കുന്നവൻ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു ശൌൽ പറഞ്ഞു ജനത്തെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചിരുന്നതിനാൽ യിസ്രായേല്യർ അന്നു വിഷമത്തിലായി; ജനത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തനും ആഹാരം ആസ്വദിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now the Israelites were in distress that day, because Saul had bound the people under an oath, saying, "Cursed be anyone who eats food before evening comes, before I have avenged myself on my enemies!" So none of the troops tasted food.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Israel were distressed that day, for Saul had placed the people under oath, saying, "Cursed is the man who eats any food until evening, before I have taken vengeance on my enemies." So none of the people tasted food.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

chapters.ml: ജനമൊക്കെയും ഒരു കാട്ടുപ്രദേശത്തു എത്തി; അവിടെ നിലത്തു തേൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The entire army entered the woods, and there was honey on the ground.
chapters.nkjv: Now all thepeople of the land came to a forest; and there was honey on the ground.
chapters.kjv: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

chapters.ml: ജനം കാട്ടിൽ കടന്നപ്പോൾ തേൻ ഇറ്റിറ്റു വീഴുന്നതു കണ്ടു: എങ്കിലും സത്യത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു ആരും തന്റെ കൈ വായിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയില്ല.
chapters.niv: When they went into the woods, they saw the honey oozing out; yet no one put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.
chapters.nkjv: And when the people had come into the woods, there was the honey, dripping; but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.
chapters.kjv: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാനോ തന്റെ അപ്പൻ ജനത്തെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചതു കേൾക്കാതിരുന്നതിനാൽ വടിയുടെ അറ്റം നീട്ടി ഒരു തേൻ കട്ടയിൽ കുത്തി അതു എടുത്തു തന്റെ കൈ വായിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി, അവന്റെ കണ്ണു തെളിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jonathan had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath, so he reached out the end of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it into the honeycomb. He raised his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.
chapters.nkjv: But Jonathan had not heard his father charge the people with the oath; therefore he stretched out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in a honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his countenance brightened.
chapters.kjv: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ജനത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ: ഇന്നു യാതൊരു ആഹാരമെങ്കിലും കഴിക്കുന്നവൻ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ജനത്തെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു; ജനം ക്ഷീണിച്ചുമിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then one of the soldiers told him, "Your father bound the army under a strict oath, saying, ‘Cursed be anyone who eats food today!’ That is why the men are faint."
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the people said, "Your father strictly charged the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food this day.’ " And the people were faint.
chapters.kjv: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോനാഥാൻ: എന്റെ അപ്പൻ ദേശത്തെ കഷ്ടത്തിലാക്കി; ഞാൻ ഈ തേൻ ഒരല്പം ആസ്വദിക്കകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ കണ്ണു തെളിഞ്ഞതു കണ്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Jonathan said, "My father has made trouble for the country. See how my eyes brightened when I tasted a little of this honey.
chapters.nkjv: But Jonathan said, "My father has troubled the land. Look now, how my countenance has brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

chapters.ml: ജനത്തിന്നു കണ്ടുകിട്ടിയ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കൊള്ളയിൽനിന്നു അവർ എടുത്തു ഇന്നു വേണ്ടുംപോലെ ഭക്ഷിച്ചിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ എത്രനന്നായിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ അപജയം അത്ര വലുതായില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: How much better it would have been if the men had eaten today some of the plunder they took from their enemies. Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been even greater?"
chapters.nkjv: How much better if the people had eaten freely today of the spoil of their enemies which they found! For now would there not have been a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?"
chapters.kjv: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

chapters.ml: അവർ അന്നു മിക്മാസ് തുടങ്ങി അയ്യാലോൻ വരെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ സംഹരിച്ചു, ജനം ഏറ്റവും തളർന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Mikmash to Aijalon, they were exhausted.
chapters.nkjv: Now they had driven back the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. So the people were very faint.
chapters.kjv: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ജനം കൊള്ളകൂ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു ആടുകളെയും കാളകളെയും കിടാക്കളെയും പിടിച്ചു നിലത്തു വെച്ചു അറുത്തു രക്തത്തോടുകൂടെ തിന്നു.
chapters.niv: They pounced on the plunder and, taking sheep, cattle and calves, they butchered them on the ground and ate them, together with the blood.
chapters.nkjv: And the people rushed on the spoil, and took sheep, oxen, and calves, and slaughtered them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.
chapters.kjv: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.

chapters.ml: ജനം രക്തത്തോടെ തിന്നുന്നതിനാൽ യഹോവയോടു പാപം ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു ശൊലിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ: നിങ്ങൾ ഇന്നു ദ്രോഹം ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഒരു വലിയ കല്ലു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഉരുട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then someone said to Saul, "Look, the men are sinning against the Lord by eating meat that has blood in it." "You have broken faith," he said. "Roll a large stone over here at once."
chapters.nkjv: Then they told Saul, saying, "Look, the people are sinning against the Lord by eating with the blood!" So he said, "You have dealt treacherously; roll a large stone to me this day."
chapters.kjv: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD , in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ശൌൽ: നിങ്ങൾ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ എല്ലാടവും ചെന്നു അവരോടു ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ കാളയെയും ആടിനെയും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ഇവിടെവെച്ചു അറുത്തു തിന്നു കൊൾവിൻ; രക്തത്തോടെ തിന്നുന്നതിനാൽ യഹോവയോടു പാപം ചെയ്യരുതു എന്നു പറവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അങ്ങനെ ജനമെല്ലാം കാളകളെ അന്നു രാത്രി കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവിടെവെച്ചു അറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "Go out among the men and tell them, ‘Each of you bring me your cattle and sheep, and slaughter them here and eat them. Do not sin against the Lord by eating meat with blood still in it.’ " So everyone brought his ox that night and slaughtered it there.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said, "Disperse yourselves among the people, and say to them, ‘Bring me here every man’s ox and every man’s sheep, slaughter them here, and eat; and do not sin against the Lord by eating with the blood.’ " So every one of the people brought his ox with him that night, and slaughtered it there.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു; അതു അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു ആദ്യം പണിത യാഗപീഠം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first time he had done this.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord. This was the first altar that he built to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD : the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശൌൽ: നാം രാത്രിയിൽ തന്നേ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു പുലരുവോളം അവരെ കൊള്ളയിടുക; അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെയും ശേഷിപ്പിക്കരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. നിനക്കു ബോധിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്തുകൊൾക എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ: നാം ഇവിടെ ദൈവത്തോടു അടുത്തുചെല്ലുക എന്നു പുരോഹിതൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul said, "Let us go down and pursue the Philistines by night and plunder them till dawn, and let us not leave one of them alive." "Do whatever seems best to you," they replied. But the priest said, "Let us inquire of God here."
chapters.nkjv: Now Saul said, "Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and plunder them until the morning light; and let us not leave a man of them." And they said, "Do whatever seems good to you." Then the priest said, "Let us draw near to God here."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശൌൽ ദൈവത്തോടു: ഞാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ പിന്തുടരേണമോ? നീ അവരെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കുമോ എന്നു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിച്ചു. എന്നാൽ അന്നു അവന്നു അരുളപ്പാടു ലഭിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: So Saul asked God, "Shall I go down and pursue the Philistines? Will you give them into Israel’s hand?" But God did not answer him that day.
chapters.nkjv: So Saul asked counsel of God, "Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You deliver them into the hand of Israel?" But He did not answer him that day.
chapters.kjv: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ: ജനത്തിന്റെ പ്രധാനികൾ ഒക്കെയും ഇവിടെ അടുത്തുവരട്ടെ; ഇന്നു പാപം സംഭവിച്ചതു ഏതു കാര്യത്തിൽ എന്നു അന്വേഷിച്ചറിവിൻ;
chapters.niv: Saul therefore said, "Come here, all you who are leaders of the army, and let us find out what sin has been committed today.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said, "Come over here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see what this sin was today.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിനെ രക്ഷിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയാണ, അതു എന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാനിൽ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നാലും അവൻ മരിക്കേണം നിശ്ചയം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറവാൻ സർവ്വ ജനത്തിലും ഒരുത്തനും തുനിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: As surely as the Lord who rescues Israel lives, even if the guilt lies with my son Jonathan, he must die." But not one of them said a word.
chapters.nkjv: For as the Lord lives, who saves Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die." But not a man among all the people answered him.
chapters.kjv: For, as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനോടും: നിങ്ങൾ ഒരു ഭാഗത്തു നില്പിൻ; ഞാനും എന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാനും മറുഭാഗത്തു നിൽക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ആകട്ടെ എന്നു ജനം ശൌലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul then said to all the Israelites, "You stand over there; I and Jonathan my son will stand over here." "Do what seems best to you," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to all Israel, "You be on one side, and my son Jonathan and I will be on the other side." And the people said to Saul, "Do what seems good to you."
chapters.kjv: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശൌൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു: നേർ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിത്തരേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്നു യോനാഥാന്നും ചീട്ടുവീണു; ജനം ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Saul prayed to the Lord , the God of Israel, "Why have you not answered your servant today? If the fault is in me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the men of Israel are at fault, respond with Thummim." Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the men were cleared.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Saul said to the Lord God of Israel, "Give a perfect lot." So Saul and Jonathan were taken, but the people escaped.
chapters.kjv: Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot . And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശൌൽ: എനിക്കും എന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാന്നും ചീട്ടിടുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; ചീട്ടു യോനാഥാന്നു വീണു.
chapters.niv: Saul said, "Cast the lot between me and Jonathan my son." And Jonathan was taken.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said, "Cast lots between my son Jonathan and me." So Jonathan was taken.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ യോനാഥാനോടു: നീ എന്തു ചെയ്തു? എന്നോടു പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. യോനാഥാൻ അവനോടു: ഞാൻ എന്റെ വടിയുടെ അറ്റംകൊണ്ടു അല്പം തേൻ ആസ്വദിച്ചതേയുള്ളു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഇതാ, ഞാൻ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." So Jonathan told him, "I tasted a little honey with the end of my staff. And now I must die!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." And Jonathan told him, and said, "I only tasted a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand. So now I must die!"
chapters.kjv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and , lo, I must die.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശൌൽ: ദൈവം എന്നോടു തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും ചെയ്യട്ടെ യോനാഥാനേ, നീ മരിക്കേണം എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul said, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you do not die, Jonathan."
chapters.nkjv: Saul answered, "God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan."
chapters.kjv: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനം ശൌലിനോടു: യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഈ മഹാരക്ഷ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന യോനാഥാൻ മരിക്കേണമോ? ഒരിക്കലും അരുതു; യഹോവയാണ, അവന്റെ തലയിലെ ഒരു രോമവും നിലത്തു വീഴുകയില്ല; അവൻ ഇന്നു ദൈവത്തോടുകൂടെയല്ലോ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ജനം യോനാഥാനെ വീണ്ടെടുത്തു; അവൻ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: But the men said to Saul, "Should Jonathan die—he who has brought about this great deliverance in Israel? Never! As surely as the Lord lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for he did this today with God’s help." So the men rescued Jonathan, and he was not put to death.
chapters.nkjv: But the people said to Saul, "Shall Jonathan die, who has accomplished this great deliverance in Israel? Certainly not! As the Lord lives, not one hair of his head shall fall to the ground, for he has worked with God this day." So the people rescued Jonathan, and he did not die.
chapters.kjv: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ പിന്തുടരാതെ മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി; ഫെലിസ്ത്യരും തങ്ങളുടെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they withdrew to their own land.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, and the Philistines went to their own place.
chapters.kjv: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജത്വം ഏറ്റശേഷം മോവാബ്യർ, അമ്മോന്യർ, എദോമ്യർ, സോബാരാജാക്കന്മാർ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ എന്നിങ്ങനെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള സകലജാതികളോടും യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു; അവൻ ചെന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും ജയംപ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Saul had assumed rule over Israel, he fought against their enemies on every side: Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he inflicted punishment on them.
chapters.nkjv: So Saul established his sovereignty over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, against the people of Ammon, against Edom, against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he harassed them.
chapters.kjv: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them .

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശൌര്യം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു അമാലേക്യരെ ജയിച്ചു, യിസ്രായേല്യരെ കവർച്ചക്കാരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of those who had plundered them.
chapters.nkjv: And he gathered an army and attacked the Amalekites, and delivered Israel from the hands of those who plundered them.
chapters.kjv: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.
