chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ യോനാഥാൻ, യിശ്വി, മൽക്കീശുവ എന്നിവർ ആയിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാർക്കോ, മൂത്തവൾക്കു മേരബ് എന്നും ഇളയവൾക്കു മീഖാൾ എന്നും പേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Saul’s sons were Jonathan, Ishvi and Malki-Shua. The name of his older daughter was Merab, and that of the younger was Michal.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Saul were Jonathan, Jishui, and Malchishua. And the names of his two daughters werethese: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
chapters.kjv: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchi-shua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു അഹീനോവം എന്നു പേർ ആയിരുന്നു; അവൾ അഹീമാസിന്റെ മകൾ. അവന്റെ സേനാധിപതിക്കു അബ്നേർ എന്നു പേർ; അവൻ ശൌലിന്റെ ഇളയപ്പനായ നേരിന്റെ മകൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of Saul’s army was Abner son of Ner, and Ner was Saul’s uncle.
chapters.nkjv: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
chapters.kjv: And the name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ അപ്പനായ കീശും അബ്നേരിന്റെ അപ്പനായ നേരും അബീയേലിന്റെ മക്കൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel.
chapters.nkjv: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
chapters.kjv: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു കഠിനയുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ ശൌൽ യാതൊരു വീരനെയോ ശൂരനെയോ കണ്ടാൽ അവനെ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചേർത്തുകൊള്ളും.
chapters.niv: All the days of Saul there was bitter war with the Philistines, and whenever Saul saw a mighty or brave man, he took him into his service.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was fierce war with the Philistines all the days of Saul. And when Saul saw any strong man or any valiant man, he took him for himself.
chapters.kjv: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: യഹോവ നിന്നെ തന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകംചെയ്‍വാൻ എന്നെ നിയോഗിച്ചുവല്ലോ; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഇപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ വചനങ്ങളെ കേട്ടുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: Samuel said to Saul, "I am the one the Lord sent to anoint you king over his people Israel; so listen now to the message from the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Samuel also said to Saul, "The Lord sent me to anoint you king over His people, over Israel. Now therefore, heed the voice of the words of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD .

chapters.ml: സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: യിസ്രായേൽ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരുമ്പോൾ വഴിയിൽവെച്ചു അമാലേക്ക് അവരെ ആക്രമിച്ചു അവരോടു ചെയ്തതിനെ ഞാൻ കുറിച്ചുവെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they waylaid them as they came up from Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘I will punish Amalek for what he did to Israel, how he ambushed him on the way when he came up from Egypt.
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ ചെന്നു അമാലേക്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചു അവർക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കിക്കളക; അവരോടു കനിവു തോന്നരുതു; പുരുഷന്മാരെയും സ്ത്രീകളെയും കുട്ടികളെയും മുലകുടിക്കുന്നവരെയും കാള, ആടു, ഒട്ടകം, കഴുത എന്നിവയെയും സംഹരിച്ചുകളക.
chapters.niv: Now go, attack the Amalekites and totally destroy all that belongs to them. Do not spare them; put to death men and women, children and infants, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Now go and attack Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and do not spare them. But kill both man and woman, infant and nursing child, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’ "
chapters.kjv: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ശൌൽ ജനത്തെ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂട്ടി തെലായീമിൽ വെച്ചു അവരെ എണ്ണി; യെഹൂദാഗോത്രക്കാരായ പതിനായിരം പേർ ഒഴികെ രണ്ടുലക്ഷം കാലാൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Saul summoned the men and mustered them at Telaim—two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand from Judah.
chapters.nkjv: So Saul gathered the people together and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand men of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശൌൽ അമാലേക്യരുടെ പ്രധാന നഗരംവരെ ചെന്നു തോട്ടിന്നരികെ പതിയിരിപ്പാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Saul went to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the ravine.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and lay in wait in the valley.
chapters.kjv: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌൽ കേന്യരോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ അമാലേക്യരോടുകൂടെ നശിപ്പിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോകുവിൻ; യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നപ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ അവർക്കു ദയചെയ്തുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ കേന്യർ അമാലേക്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Then he said to the Kenites, "Go away, leave the Amalekites so that I do not destroy you along with them; for you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said to the Kenites, "Go, depart, get down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them. For you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശൌൽ ഹവീലാമുതൽ മിസ്രയീമിന്നു കിഴക്കുള്ള ശൂർവരെ അമാലേക്യരെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul attacked the Amalekites, from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is east of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.

chapters.ml: അമാലേക്യരുടെ രാജാവായ ആഗാഗിനെ ജീവനോടെ പിടിച്ചു, ജനങ്ങളെ ഒക്കെയും വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and all his people he totally destroyed with the sword.
chapters.nkjv: He also took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
chapters.kjv: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌലും ജനവും ആഗാഗിനെയും ആടു, മാടു, തടിച്ചമൃഗം എന്നിവയിൽ മേത്തരമായവയെയും കുഞ്ഞാടുകളെയും ഉത്തമമായവയെ ഒക്കെയും നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കുവാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ ജീവനോടെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു; ഹീനവും നിസ്സാരവുമായവയെ ഒക്കെയും അവർ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Saul and the army spared Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs—everything that was good. These they were unwilling to destroy completely, but everything that was despised and weak they totally destroyed.
chapters.nkjv: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, the oxen, the fatlings, the lambs, and all thatwas good, and were unwilling to utterly destroy them. But everything despised and worthless, that they utterly destroyed.
chapters.kjv: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ശമൂവേലിന്നുണ്ടായതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to Samuel:
chapters.nkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to Samuel, saying,
chapters.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ശൌലിനെ രാജാവായി വാഴിച്ചതിനാൽ എനിക്കു മനസ്താപമായിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ എന്നെ വിട്ടുമാറിയിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ കല്പനകളെ നിവൃത്തിച്ചതുമില്ല. ഇതിങ്കൽ ശമൂവേലിന്നു വ്യസനമായി; അവൻ രാത്രി മുഴുവനും യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "I regret that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me and has not carried out my instructions." Samuel was angry, and he cried out to the Lord all that night.
chapters.nkjv: "I greatly regret that I have set up Saul as king, for he has turned back from following Me, and has not performed My commandments." And it grieved Samuel, and he cried out to the Lord all night.
chapters.kjv: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ കർമ്മേലിൽ എത്തിയെന്നും ഒരു ജ്ഞാപകസ്തംഭം നാട്ടി ഘോഷയാത്ര കഴിച്ചു തിരിഞ്ഞു ഗില്ഗാലിലേക്കു പോയി എന്നും ശമൂവേലിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Early in the morning Samuel got up and went to meet Saul, but he was told, "Saul has gone to Carmel. There he has set up a monument in his own honor and has turned and gone on down to Gilgal."
chapters.nkjv: So when Samuel rose early in the morning to meet Saul, it was told Samuel, saying, "Saul went to Carmel, and indeed, he set up a monument for himself; and he has gone on around, passed by, and gone down to Gilgal."
chapters.kjv: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ അവനോടു: യഹോവയാൽ നീ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ; ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പന നിവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Samuel reached him, Saul said, "The Lord bless you! I have carried out the Lord ’s instructions."
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel went to Saul, and Saul said to him, "Blessed are you of the Lord! I have performed the commandment of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the LORD : I have performed the commandment of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശമൂവേൽ: എന്റെ ചെവിയിൽ എത്തുന്ന ആടുകളുടെ ഈ കരച്ചലും ഞാൻ കേൾക്കുന്ന കാളകളുടെ മുക്കുറയും എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears? What is this lowing of cattle that I hear?"
chapters.nkjv: But Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?"
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

chapters.ml: അവയെ അമാലേക്യരുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നു അവർ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതാകുന്നു; ജനം ആടുകളിലും കാളകളിലും മേത്തരമായവയെ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗംകഴിപ്പാൻ ജീവനോടെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു; ശേഷമുള്ളവയെ ഞങ്ങൾ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു എന്നു ശൌൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul answered, "The soldiers brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best of the sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the Lord your God, but we totally destroyed the rest."
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said, "They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and the oxen, to sacrifice to the Lord your God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിനോടു: നിൽക്ക; യഹോവ ഈ കഴിഞ്ഞ രാത്രി എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അറിയിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവനോടു: പറഞ്ഞാലും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Enough!" Samuel said to Saul. "Let me tell you what the Lord said to me last night." "Tell me," Saul replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Be quiet! And I will tell you what the Lord said to me last night." And he said to him, "Speak on."
chapters.kjv: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശമൂവേൽ പറഞ്ഞതു: നിന്റെ സ്വന്തകാഴ്ചയിൽ നീ ചെറിയവനായിരുന്നിട്ടും യഹോവ നിന്നെ യിസ്രായേൽ ഗോത്രങ്ങൾക്കു തലവനാക്കുകയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാവായി നിന്നെ അഭിഷേകം കഴിക്കയും ചെയ്തില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Samuel said, "Although you were once small in your own eyes, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The Lord anointed you king over Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel said, "When you were little in your own eyes, were you not head of the tribes of Israel? And did not the Lord anoint you king over Israel?
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യഹോവ നിന്നെ ഒരു വഴിക്കു അയച്ചു: നീ ചെന്നു അമാലേക്യരായ പാപികളെ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കുകയും അവർ നശിക്കുംവരെ അവരോടു പൊരുതുകയും ചെയ്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And he sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and completely destroy those wicked people, the Amalekites; wage war against them until you have wiped them out.’
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord sent you on a mission, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners, the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’
chapters.kjv: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ നീ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പന അനുസരിക്കാതെ കൊള്ളെക്കു ചാടി യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായതു ചെയ്തതെന്തു?
chapters.niv: Why did you not obey the Lord ? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do evil in the eyes of the Lord ?"
chapters.nkjv: Why then did you not obey the voice of the Lord? Why did you swoop down on the spoil, and do evil in the sight of the Lord?"
chapters.kjv: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD , but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD ?

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ശമൂവേലിനോടു: ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പന അനുസരിച്ചു യഹോവ എന്നെ അയച്ചവഴിക്കു പോയി അമാലേക്രാജാവായ ആഗാഗിനെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അമാലേക്യരെ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But I did obey the Lord ," Saul said. "I went on the mission the Lord assigned me. I completely destroyed the Amalekites and brought back Agag their king.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said to Samuel, "But I have obeyed the voice of the Lord, and gone on the mission on which the Lord sent me, and brought back Agag king of Amalek; I have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD , and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനം ശപഥാർപ്പിതവസ്തുക്കളിൽ വിശേഷമായ ആടുമാടുകളെ കൊള്ളയിൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു ഗില്ഗാലിൽ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of what was devoted to God, in order to sacrifice them to the Lord your God at Gilgal."
chapters.nkjv: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and oxen, the best of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice to the Lord your God in Gilgal."
chapters.kjv: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവയുടെ കല്പന അനുസരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും ഹനനയാഗങ്ങളും യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമാകുമോ? ഇതാ, അനുസരിക്കുന്നതു യാഗത്തെക്കാളും ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുന്നതു മുട്ടാടുകളുടെ മേദസ്സിനെക്കാളും നല്ലതു.
chapters.niv: But Samuel replied: "Does the Lord delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obeying the Lord ? To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel said: "Has the Lordasgreat delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, As in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, And to heed than the fat of rams.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD ? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

chapters.ml: മത്സരം ആഭിചാരദോഷംപോലെയും ശാഠ്യം മിത്ഥ്യാപൂജയും വിഗ്രഹാരാധനയും പോലെയും ആകുന്നു; നീ യഹോവയുടെ വചനത്തെ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ നിന്നെയും രാജസ്ഥാനത്തിൽനിന്നു തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance like the evil of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord , he has rejected you as king."
chapters.nkjv: For rebellion isas the sin of witchcraft, And stubbornness isas iniquity and idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord, He also has rejected you from being king."
chapters.kjv: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD , he hath also rejected thee from being king.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ശമൂവേലിനോടു: ഞാൻ ജനത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു അവരുടെ വാക്കു അനുസരിച്ചതിനാൽ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനയും നിന്റെ വാക്കും ലംഘിച്ചു പാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned. I violated the Lord ’s command and your instructions. I was afraid of the men and so I gave in to them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned, for I have transgressed the commandment of the Lord and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD , and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും എന്റെ പാപം ക്ഷമിച്ചു ഞാൻ യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now I beg you, forgive my sin and come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and return with me, that I may worship the Lord."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD .

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിനോടു: ഞാൻ പോരികയില്ല; നീ യഹോവയുടെ വചനത്തെ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ നിന്നെയും യിസ്രായേലിലെ രാജസ്ഥാനത്തുനിന്നു തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Samuel said to him, "I will not go back with you. You have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you as king over Israel!"
chapters.nkjv: But Samuel said to Saul, "I will not return with you, for you have rejected the word of the Lord, and the Lord has rejected you from being king over Israel."
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD , and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശമൂവേൽ പോകുവാൻ തിരിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവന്റെ നിലയങ്കിയുടെ വിളുമ്പു പിടിച്ചു വലിച്ചു; അതു കീറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: As Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.
chapters.nkjv: And as Samuel turned around to go away, Saul seized the edge of his robe, and it tore.
chapters.kjv: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ അവനോടു: യഹോവ ഇന്നു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജത്വം നിങ്കൽ നിന്നു കീറി നിന്നെക്കാൾ ഉത്തമനായ നിന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരന്നു കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to one of your neighbors—to one better than you.
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours, whois better than you.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മഹത്വമായവൻ ഭോഷ്കു പറകയില്ല, അനുതപിക്കയുമില്ല; അനുതപിപ്പാൻ അവൻ മനുഷ്യനല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He who is the Glory of Israel does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a human being, that he should change his mind."
chapters.nkjv: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor relent. For He is not a man, that He should relent."
chapters.kjv: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: ഞാൻ പാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; എങ്കിലും ജനത്തിന്റെ മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെയും മുമ്പാകെ ഇപ്പോൾ എന്നെ മാനിച്ചു, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നോടു കൂടെ പോരേണമേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul replied, "I have sinned. But please honor me before the elders of my people and before Israel; come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord your God."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "I have sinned; yet honor me now, please, before the elders of my people and before Israel, and return with me, that I may worship the Lord your God."
chapters.kjv: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു; ശൌൽ യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel turned back after Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord.
chapters.kjv: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD .

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശമൂവേൽ: അമാലേക്രാജാവായ ആഗാഗിനെ ഇവിടെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. ആഗാഗ് സന്തോഷഭാവത്തോടെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: മരണഭീതി നീങ്ങപ്പോയി എന്നു ആഗാഗ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Samuel said, "Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites." Agag came to him in chains. And he thought, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel said, "Bring Agag king of the Amalekites here to me." So Agag came to him cautiously. And Agag said, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."
chapters.kjv: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വാൾ സ്ത്രീകളെ മക്കളില്ലാത്തവരാക്കിയതുപോലെ നിന്റെ അമ്മയും സ്ത്രീകളുടെ ഇടയിൽ മക്കളില്ലാത്തവളാകും എന്നു ശമൂവേൽ പറഞ്ഞു, ഗില്ഗാലിൽവെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ആഗാഗിനെ തുണ്ടംതുണ്ടമായി വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so will your mother be childless among women." And Samuel put Agag to death before the Lord at Gilgal.
chapters.nkjv: But Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women." And Samuel hacked Agag in pieces before the Lord in Gilgal.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശമൂവേൽ രാമയിലേക്കു പോയി; ശൌലും ശൌലിന്റെ ഗിബെയയിൽ അരമനയിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Samuel left for Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel went to Ramah, and Saul went up to his house at Gibeah of Saul.
chapters.kjv: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ ജീവപര്യന്തം ശൌലിനെ പിന്നെ കണ്ടില്ല; എങ്കിലും ശമൂവേൽ ശൌലിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ദുഃഖിച്ചു; യഹോവയും താൻ ശൌലിനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവാക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു അനുതപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Until the day Samuel died, he did not go to see Saul again, though Samuel mourned for him. And the Lord regretted that he had made Saul king over Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And Samuel went no more to see Saul until the day of his death. Nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul, and the Lord regretted that He had made Saul king over Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യഹോവ ശമൂവേലിനോടു: യിസ്രായേലിലെ രാജസ്ഥാനത്തിൽനിന്നു ഞാൻ ശൌലിനെ തള്ളിയെന്നറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കെ നീ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു എത്രത്തോളം ദുഃഖിക്കും? കൊമ്പിൽ തൈലം നിറെച്ചു പുറപ്പെടുക; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമ്യനായ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയക്കും; അവന്റെ മക്കളിൽ ഞാൻ ഒരു രാജാവിനെ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Samuel, "How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and be on your way; I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem. I have chosen one of his sons to be king."
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord said to Samuel, "How long will you mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go; I am sending you to Jesse the Bethlehemite. For I have provided Myself a king among his sons."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശമൂവേൽ: ഞാൻ എങ്ങനെ പോകും? ശൌൽ കേട്ടാൽ എന്നെ കൊല്ലും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാറെ യഹോവ: നീ ഒരു പശുക്കിടാവിനെയും കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു: ഞാൻ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറക.
chapters.niv: But Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears about it, he will kill me." The Lord said, "Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord .’
chapters.nkjv: And Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me." But the Lord said, "Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord.’
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it , he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the LORD .

chapters.ml: യിശ്ശായിയെയും യാഗത്തിന്നു ക്ഷണിക്ക; നീ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നു ഞാൻ അന്നേരം നിന്നോടു അറിയിക്കും; ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞുതരുന്നവനെ നീ എനിക്കായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what to do. You are to anoint for me the one I indicate."
chapters.nkjv: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do; you shall anoint for Me the one I name to you."
chapters.kjv: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ശമൂവേൽ ചെയ്തു, ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ ചെന്നു; പട്ടണത്തിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ അവന്റെ വരവിങ്കൽ വിറെച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു: നിന്റെ വരവു ശുഭം തന്നേയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Samuel did what the Lord said. When he arrived at Bethlehem, the elders of the town trembled when they met him. They asked, "Do you come in peace?"
chapters.nkjv: So Samuel did what the Lord said, and went to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, "Do you come peaceably?"
chapters.kjv: And Samuel did that which the LORD spake, and came to Beth-lehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ശുഭം തന്നേ; ഞാൻ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളെ തന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു എന്നോടുകൂടെ യാഗത്തിന്നു വരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ യിശ്ശായിയെയും അവന്റെ മക്കളെയും ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു അവരെയും യാഗത്തിന്നു ക്ഷണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Samuel replied, "Yes, in peace; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord . Consecrate yourselves and come to the sacrifice with me." Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice." Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons, and invited them to the sacrifice.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD : sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

chapters.ml: അവർ വന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ എലീയാബിനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു: യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ അവന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തൻ ഇതാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and thought, "Surely the Lord ’s anointed stands here before the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when they came, that he looked at Eliab and said, "Surely the Lord’s anointed is before Him!"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD’s anointed is before him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ശമൂവേലിനോടു: അവന്റെ മുഖമോ പൊക്കമോ നോക്കരുതു; ഞാൻ അവനെ തള്ളിയിരിക്കുന്നു. മുനഷ്യൻ നോക്കുന്നതുപോലെയല്ല; മനുഷ്യൻ കണ്ണിന്നു കാണുന്നതു നോക്കുന്നു; യഹോവയോ ഹൃദയത്തെ നോക്കുന്നു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Do not consider his appearance or his height, for I have rejected him. The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Do not look at his appearance or at his physical stature, because I have refused him. For theLorddoes not see as man sees; for man looks at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."
chapters.kjv: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യിശ്ശായി അബീനാദാബിനെ വിളിച്ചു ശമൂവേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വരുത്തി; എന്നാറെ അവൻ: യഹോവ ഇവനെയും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, "The Lord has not chosen this one either."
chapters.nkjv: So Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, "Neither has the Lord chosen this one."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യിശ്ശായി ശമ്മയെയും വരുത്തി. ഇവനെയും യഹോവ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesse then had Shammah pass by, but Samuel said, "Nor has the Lord chosen this one."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesse made Shammah pass by. And he said, "Neither has the Lord chosen this one."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിശ്ശായി ഏഴു പുത്രന്മാരെ ശമൂവേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വരുത്തി; എന്നാൽ ശമൂവേൽ യിശ്ശായിയോടു: യഹോവ ഇവരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesse had seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel said to him, "The Lord has not chosen these."
chapters.nkjv: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, "The Lord has not chosen these."
chapters.kjv: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ എല്ലാവരുമായോ എന്നു ശമൂവേൽ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവൻ: ഇനി, ഉള്ളതിൽ ഇളയവൻ ഉണ്ടു; അവൻ ആടുകളെ മേയ്ക്കയാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ശമൂവേൽ യിശ്ശായിയോടു: ആളയച്ചു അവനെ വരുത്തുക; അവൻ വന്നിട്ടല്ലാതെ നാം പന്തിക്കിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So he asked Jesse, "Are these all the sons you have?" "There is still the youngest," Jesse answered. "He is tending the sheep." Samuel said, "Send for him; we will not sit down until he arrives."
chapters.nkjv: And Samuel said to Jesse, "Are all the young men here?" Then he said, "There remains yet the youngest, and there he is, keeping the sheep." And Samuel said to Jesse, "Send and bring him. For we will not sit down till he comes here."
chapters.kjv: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവൻ ആളയച്ചു അവനെ വരുത്തി; എന്നാൽ അവൻ പവിഴനിറമുള്ളവനും സുനേത്രനും കോമളരൂപിയും ആയിരുന്നു. അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ: എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഇവനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്ക; ഇവൻ തന്നേ ആകുന്നു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he sent for him and had him brought in. He was glowing with health and had a fine appearance and handsome features. Then the Lord said, "Rise and anoint him; this is the one."
chapters.nkjv: So he sent and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with bright eyes, and good-looking. And the Lord said, "Arise, anoint him; for this is the one!"
chapters.kjv: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശമൂവേൽ തൈലക്കൊമ്പു എടുത്തു അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ നടുവിൽ വെച്ചു അവനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു; യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു അന്നുമുതൽ ദാവീദിന്മേൽ വന്നു. ശമൂവേൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു രാമയിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David. Samuel then went to Ramah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers; and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel arose and went to Ramah.
chapters.kjv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു ശൌലിനെ വിട്ടുമാറി; യഹോവ അയച്ച ഒരു ദൂരാത്മാവു അവനെ ബാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now the Spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him.
chapters.nkjv: But the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and a distressing spirit from the Lord troubled him.
chapters.kjv: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: ദൈവം അയച്ച ഒരു ദൂരാത്മാവു നിന്നെ ബാധിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Saul’s attendants said to him, "See, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul’s servants said to him, "Surely, a distressing spirit from God is troubling you.
chapters.kjv: And Saul’s servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ കിന്നരവായനയിൽ നിപുണനായ ഒരുത്തനെ അന്വേഷിപ്പാൻ തിരുമനസ്സുകൊണ്ടു അടിയങ്ങൾക്കു കല്പന തരേണം; എന്നാൽ ദൈവത്തിങ്കൽ നിന്നു ദുരാത്മാവു തിരുമേനിമേൽ വരുമ്പോൾ അവൻ കൈകൊണ്ടു വായിക്കയും തിരുമേനിക്കു ഭേദം വരികയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Let our lord command his servants here to search for someone who can play the lyre. He will play when the evil spirit from God comes on you, and you will feel better."
chapters.nkjv: Let our master now command your servants, whoare before you, to seek out a man whois a skillful player on the harp. And it shall be that he will play it with his hand when the distressing spirit from God is upon you, and you shall be well."
chapters.kjv: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു: കിന്നരവായനയിൽ നിപുണനായ ഒരുത്തനെ അന്വേഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Saul said to his attendants, "Find someone who plays well and bring him to me."
chapters.nkjv: So Saul said to his servants, "Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

chapters.ml: ബാല്യക്കാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ: ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമ്യനായ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ ഒരു മകനെ ഞാൻ കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ടു; അവൻ കിന്നരവായനയിൽ നിപുണനും പരാക്രമശാലിയും യോദ്ധാവും വാക്ചാതുര്യമുള്ളവനും കോമളനും ആകുന്നു; യഹോവയും അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: One of the servants answered, "I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the lyre. He is a brave man and a warrior. He speaks well and is a fine-looking man. And the Lord is with him."
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the servants answered and said, "Look, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, whois skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and the Lordis with him."
chapters.kjv: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth-lehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the LORD is with him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ശൌൽ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: ആടുകളോടു കൂടെ ഇരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ മകൻ ദാവീദിനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയക്കേണം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.

chapters.ml: യിശ്ശായി ഒരു കഴുതയെ വരുത്തി, അതിന്റെ പുറത്തു അപ്പം, ഒരു തുരുത്തി വീഞ്ഞു, ഒരു കോലാട്ടിൻ കുട്ടി എന്നിവ കയറ്റി തന്റെ മകൻ ദാവീദ്‌വശം ശൌലിന്നു കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them with his son David to Saul.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesse took a donkey loadedwith bread, a skin of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by his son David to Saul.
chapters.kjv: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിന്നു; അവന്നു അവനോടു വളരെ സ്നേഹമായി; അവൻ അവന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked him very much, and David became one of his armor-bearers.
chapters.nkjv: So David came to Saul and stood before him. And he loved him greatly, and he became his armorbearer.
chapters.kjv: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ശൌൽ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: ദാവീദിനോടു എനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടം തോന്നിയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ താമസിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, "Allow David to remain in my service, for I am pleased with him."
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul sent to Jesse, saying, "Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight."
chapters.kjv: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പക്കൽനിന്നു ദുരാത്മാവു ശൌലിന്മേൽ വരുമ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് കിന്നരം എടുത്തു വായിക്കും; ശൌലിന്നു ആശ്വാസവും സുഖവും ഉണ്ടാകും; ദുരാത്മാവു അവനെ വിട്ടുമാറും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the spirit from God came on Saul, David would take up his lyre and play. Then relief would come to Saul; he would feel better, and the evil spirit would leave him.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, whenever the spirit from God was upon Saul, that David would take a harp and play it with his hand. Then Saul would become refreshed and well, and the distressing spirit would depart from him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ സൈന്യങ്ങളെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂട്ടി; അവൻ യെഹൂദെക്കുള്ള സോഖോവിൽ ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി സോഖോവിന്നും അസേക്കെക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ഏഫെസ്-ദമ്മീമിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Now the Philistines gathered their forces for war and assembled at Sokoh in Judah. They pitched camp at Ephes Dammim, between Sokoh and Azekah.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Philistines gathered their armies together to battle, and were gathered at Sochoh, which belongs to Judah; they encamped between Sochoh and Azekah, in Ephes Dammim.
chapters.kjv: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.

chapters.ml: ശൌലും യിസ്രായേല്യരും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി, ഏലാതാഴ്വരയിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു പടെക്കു അണിനിരത്തി;
chapters.niv: Saul and the Israelites assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah and drew up their battle line to meet the Philistines.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and they encamped in the Valley of Elah, and drew up in battle array against the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഇപ്പുറത്തു ഒരു മലഞ്ചരിവിലും യിസ്രായേല്യർ അപ്പുറത്തു ഒരു മലഞ്ചരിവിലും നിന്നു; അവരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഒരു താഴ്വര ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Philistines occupied one hill and the Israelites another, with the valley between them.
chapters.nkjv: The Philistines stood on a mountain on one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side, with a valley between them.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പാളയത്തിൽനിന്നു ഗഥ്യനായ ഗൊല്യാത്ത് എന്ന ഒരു മല്ലൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവൻ ആറു മുഴവും ഒരു ചാണും നെടുപ്പമുള്ളവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out of the Philistine camp. His height was six cubits and a span.
chapters.nkjv: And a champion went out from the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, from Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
chapters.kjv: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു തലയിൽ ഒരു താമ്രശിരസ്ത്രം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അയ്യായിരം ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കമുള്ള ഒരു താമ്രകവചവും ധരിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore a coat of scale armor of bronze weighing five thousand shekels ;
chapters.nkjv: Hehad a bronze helmet on his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail, and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.
chapters.kjv: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു താമ്രംകൊണ്ടുള്ള കാൽചട്ടയും ചുമലിൽ താമ്രം കൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു വേലും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: on his legs he wore bronze greaves, and a bronze javelin was slung on his back.
chapters.nkjv: And hehad bronze armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.
chapters.kjv: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കുന്തത്തിന്റെ തണ്ടു നെയ്ത്തുകാരന്റെ പടപ്പുതടിപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; കുന്തത്തിന്റെ അലകു അറുനൂറു ശേക്കെൽ ഇരിമ്പു ആയിരുന്നു; ഒരു പരിചക്കാരൻ അവന്റെ മുമ്പെ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: His spear shaft was like a weaver’s rod, and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels. His shield bearer went ahead of him.
chapters.nkjv: Now the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam, and his iron spearhead weighed six hundred shekels; and a shield-bearer went before him.
chapters.kjv: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ നിരകളോടു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾ വന്നു പടെക്കു അണിനിരന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? ഞാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യനും നിങ്ങൾ ശൌലിന്റെ ചേവകരും അല്ലയോ? നിങ്ങൾ ഒരുത്തനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തുകൊൾവിൻ; അവൻ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഇറങ്ങിവരട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, "Why do you come out and line up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not the servants of Saul? Choose a man and have him come down to me.
chapters.nkjv: Then he stood and cried out to the armies of Israel, and said to them, "Why have you come out to line up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and you the servants of Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.
chapters.kjv: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു അങ്കം പൊരുതു എന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ പ്രാപ്തനായാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അടിമകൾ ആകാം; ഞാൻ അവനെ ജയിച്ചു കൊന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അടിമകളായി ഞങ്ങളെ സേവിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If he is able to fight and kill me, we will become your subjects; but if I overcome him and kill him, you will become our subjects and serve us."
chapters.nkjv: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then we will be your servants. But if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our servants and serve us."
chapters.kjv: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ പിന്നെയും: ഞാൻ ഇന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ നിരകളെ വെല്ലുവിളിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ തമ്മിൽ അങ്കം പൊരുതേണ്ടതിന്നു ഒരുത്തനെ വിട്ടു തരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Philistine said, "This day I defy the armies of Israel! Give me a man and let us fight each other."
chapters.nkjv: And the Philistine said, "I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together."
chapters.kjv: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യന്റെ ഈ വാക്കുകൾ ശൌലും എല്ലായിസ്രായേല്യരും കേട്ടപ്പോൾ ഭ്രമിച്ചു ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: On hearing the Philistine’s words, Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and terrified.
chapters.nkjv: When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.
chapters.kjv: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് യെഹൂദയിലെ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ യിശ്ശായി എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു എഫ്രാത്യന്റെ മകൻ ആയിരുന്നു; യിശ്ശായിക്കു എട്ടു മക്കൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ശൌലിന്റെ കാലത്തു വയസ്സുചെന്നു വൃദ്ധനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite named Jesse, who was from Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons, and in Saul’s time he was very old.
chapters.nkjv: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse, and who had eight sons. And the man was old, advanced inyears, in the days of Saul.
chapters.kjv: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

chapters.ml: യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മൂത്ത മക്കൾ മൂവരും പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശൌലിന്റെ കൂടെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു ചെന്നിരുന്നു. യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പോയ മൂന്നു മക്കൾ ആദ്യജാതൻ ഏലീയാബും അവന്റെ അനുജൻ അബീനാദാബും മൂന്നാമത്തെവൻ ശമ്മയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesse’s three oldest sons had followed Saul to the war: The firstborn was Eliab; the second, Abinadab; and the third, Shammah.
chapters.nkjv: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone to follow Saul to the battle. The names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
chapters.kjv: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദോ എല്ലാവരിലും ഇളയവൻ; മൂത്തവർ മൂവരും ശൌലിന്റെ കൂടെ പോയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: David was the youngest. The three oldest followed Saul,
chapters.nkjv: David was the youngest. And the three oldest followed Saul.
chapters.kjv: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

chapters.ml: ദാവിദ് ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നു തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ആടുകളെ മേയിപ്പാൻ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ പോയിവരിക പതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
chapters.nkjv: But David occasionally went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
chapters.kjv: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Beth-lehem.

chapters.ml: ആ ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ നാല്പതു ദിവസം മുടങ്ങാതെ രാവിലെയും വൈകുന്നേരവും മുമ്പോട്ടു വന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening and took his stand.
chapters.nkjv: And the Philistine drew near and presented himself forty days, morning and evening.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

chapters.ml: യിശ്ശായി തന്റെ മകനായ ദാവീദിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഈ ഒരു പറ മലരും അപ്പം പത്തും എടുത്തു പാളയത്തിൽ നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വേഗം കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു കൊടുക്ക.
chapters.niv: Now Jesse said to his son David, "Take this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesse said to his son David, "Take now for your brothers an ephah of this dried grain and these ten loaves, and run to your brothers at the camp.
chapters.kjv: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn , and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren;

chapters.ml: ഈ പാൽക്കട്ട പത്തും സഹസ്രാധിപന്നു കൊടുക്ക; നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ ക്ഷേമം ചോദിച്ചു ലക്ഷ്യവും വാങ്ങി വരിക.
chapters.niv: Take along these ten cheeses to the commander of their unit. See how your brothers are and bring back some assurance from them.
chapters.nkjv: And carry these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers fare, and bring back news of them."
chapters.kjv: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.

chapters.ml: ശൌലും അവരും യിസ്രായേല്യർ ഒക്കെയും ഏലാതാഴ്വരയിൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുന്നുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines."
chapters.nkjv: Now Saul and they and all the men of Israel were in the Valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് അതികാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ആടുകളെ കാവൽക്കാരന്റെ പക്കൽ വിട്ടേച്ചു, യിശ്ശായി തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും എടുത്തുംകൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു കൈനിലയിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ സൈന്യം പടെക്കു ആർത്തുവിളിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പുറപ്പെടുകയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Early in the morning David left the flock in the care of a shepherd, loaded up and set out, as Jesse had directed. He reached the camp as the army was going out to its battle positions, shouting the war cry.
chapters.nkjv: So David rose early in the morning, left the sheep with a keeper, and took thethings and went as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the camp as the army was going out to the fight and shouting for the battle.
chapters.kjv: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരും നേർക്കുനേരെ അണിനിരന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Israel and the Philistines were drawing up their lines facing each other.
chapters.nkjv: For Israel and the Philistines had drawn up in battle array, army against army.
chapters.kjv: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തന്റെ സാമാനം പടക്കോപ്പു സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നവന്റെ പക്കൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുംവെച്ചു അണിയിൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു കുശലം ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David left his things with the keeper of supplies, ran to the battle lines and asked his brothers how they were.
chapters.nkjv: And David left his supplies in the hand of the supply keeper, ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.
chapters.kjv: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ ഗഥ്യനായ ഗൊല്യാത്ത് എന്ന ഫെലിസ്ത്യമല്ലൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നിരകളിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു വന്നു മുമ്പിലത്തെ വാക്കുകൾതന്നേ പറയുന്നതു ദാവീദ് കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: As he was talking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, stepped out from his lines and shouted his usual defiance, and David heard it.
chapters.nkjv: Then as he talked with them, there was the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, coming up from the armies of the Philistines; and he spoke according to the same words. So David heard them.
chapters.kjv: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them .

chapters.ml: അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേല്യരൊക്കെയും ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി.
chapters.niv: Whenever the Israelites saw the man, they all fled from him in great fear.
chapters.nkjv: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were dreadfully afraid.
chapters.kjv: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യിസ്രായേല്യർ: വന്നു നില്ക്കുന്ന ഇവനെ കണ്ടുവോ? അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ നിന്ദിപ്പാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവനെ കൊല്ലുന്നവനെ രാജാവു മഹാസമ്പന്നനാക്കുകയും തന്റെ മകളെ അവന്നു കൊടുക്കുകയും അവന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽ കരമൊഴിവു കല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now the Israelites had been saying, "Do you see how this man keeps coming out? He comes out to defy Israel. The king will give great wealth to the man who kills him. He will also give him his daughter in marriage and will exempt his family from taxes in Israel."
chapters.nkjv: So the men of Israel said, "Have you seen this man who has come up? Surely he has come up to defy Israel; and it shall be that the man who kills him the king will enrich with great riches, will give him his daughter, and give his father’s house exemption fromtaxes in Israel."
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Israel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നില്ക്കുന്നവരോടു: ഈ ഫെലിസ്ത്യനെകൊന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു നിന്ദയെ നീക്കിക്കളയുന്നവന്നു എന്തു കൊടുക്കും? ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സേനകളെ നിന്ദിപ്പാൻ ഈ അഗ്രചർമ്മിയായ ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ ആർ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David asked the men standing near him, "What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel? Who is this uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God?"
chapters.nkjv: Then David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, "What shall be done for the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?"
chapters.kjv: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ജനം: അവനെ കൊല്ലുവന്നു ഇന്നിന്നതൊക്കെയും കൊടുക്കും എന്നു അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They repeated to him what they had been saying and told him, "This is what will be done for the man who kills him."
chapters.nkjv: And the people answered him in this manner, saying, "So shall it be done for the man who kills him."
chapters.kjv: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു അവൻ സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു അവന്റെ മൂത്ത ജ്യേഷ്ഠൻ എലീയാബ് കേട്ടു ദാവീദിനോടു കോപിച്ചു: നീ ഇവിടെ എന്തിന്നു വന്നു? മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ആ കുറെ ആടുള്ളതു നീ ആരുടെ പക്കൽ വിട്ടേച്ചുപോന്നു? നിന്റെ അഹങ്കാരവും നിഗളഭാവവും എനിക്കറിയാം; പട കാണ്മാനല്ലേ നീ വന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Eliab, David’s oldest brother, heard him speaking with the men, he burned with anger at him and asked, "Why have you come down here? And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness? I know how conceited you are and how wicked your heart is; you came down only to watch the battle."
chapters.nkjv: Now Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger was aroused against David, and he said, "Why did you come down here? And with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the insolence of your heart, for you have come down to see the battle."
chapters.kjv: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ദാവീദ്: ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ എന്തു ചെയ്തു? ഒരു വാക്കല്ലേ പറഞ്ഞുള്ളു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Now what have I done?" said David. "Can’t I even speak?"
chapters.nkjv: And David said, "What have I done now? Is there not a cause?"
chapters.kjv: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനെ വിട്ടുമാറി മറ്റൊരുത്തനോടു അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചോദിച്ചു; ജനം മുമ്പിലത്തേപ്പോലെ തന്നേ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He then turned away to someone else and brought up the same matter, and the men answered him as before.
chapters.nkjv: Then he turned from him toward another and said the same thing; and these people answered him as the first ones did.
chapters.kjv: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കുകൾ പരസ്യമായപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്നും അറിവു കിട്ടി; അവൻ അവനെ വിളിച്ചുവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: What David said was overheard and reported to Saul, and Saul sent for him.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the words which David spoke were heard, they reported them to Saul; and he sent for him.
chapters.kjv: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ശൌലിനോടു: ഇവന്റെ നിമിത്തം ആരും അധൈര്യപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; അടിയൻ ചെന്നു ഈ ഫെലിസ്ത്യനോടു അങ്കം പൊരുതും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David said to Saul, "Let no one lose heart on account of this Philistine; your servant will go and fight him."
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to Saul, "Let no man’s heart fail because of him; your servant will go and fight with this Philistine."
chapters.kjv: And David said to Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനോടു: ഈ ഫെലിസ്ത്യനോടു ചെന്നു അങ്കം പൊരുതുവാൻ നിനക്കു പ്രാപ്തിയില്ല; നീ ബാലൻ അത്രേ; അവനോ, ബാല്യംമുതൽ യോദ്ധാവാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul replied, "You are not able to go out against this Philistine and fight him; you are only a young man, and he has been a warrior from his youth."
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said to David, "You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are a youth, and he a man of war from his youth."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ശൌലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: അടിയൻ അപ്പന്റെ ആടുകളെ മേയിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒരിക്കൽ ഒരു സിംഹവും ഒരിക്കൽ ഒരു കരടിയും വന്നു കൂട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്നു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But David said to Saul, "Your servant has been keeping his father’s sheep. When a lion or a bear came and carried off a sheep from the flock,
chapters.nkjv: But David said to Saul, "Your servant used to keep his father’s sheep, and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പിന്തുടർന്നു അതിനെ അടിച്ചു അതിന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു ആട്ടിൻ കുട്ടിയെ വിടുവിച്ചു, അതു എന്റെ നേരെ വന്നപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ അതിനെ താടിക്കു പിടിച്ചു അടിച്ചു കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: I went after it, struck it and rescued the sheep from its mouth. When it turned on me, I seized it by its hair, struck it and killed it.
chapters.nkjv: I went out after it and struck it, and delivered thelamb from its mouth; and when it arose against me, I caught it by its beard, and struck and killed it.
chapters.kjv: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അടിയൻ സിംഹത്തെയും കരടിയെയും കൊന്നു; ഈ അഗ്രചർമ്മിയായ ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സൈന്യത്തെ നിന്ദിച്ചിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവനും അവയിൽ ഒന്നിനെപ്പോലെ ആകും.
chapters.niv: Your servant has killed both the lion and the bear; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, because he has defied the armies of the living God.
chapters.nkjv: Your servant has killed both lion and bear; and this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, seeing he has defied the armies of the living God."
chapters.kjv: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പിന്നെയും: സിംഹത്തിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും കരടിയുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും എന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ച യഹോവ ഈ ഫെലിസ്ത്യന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനോടു: ചെല്ലുക; യഹോവ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Lord who rescued me from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear will rescue me from the hand of this Philistine." Saul said to David, "Go, and the Lord be with you."
chapters.nkjv: Moreover David said, "The Lord, who delivered me from the paw of the lion and from the paw of the bear, He will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine." And Saul said to David, "Go, and the Lord be with you!"
chapters.kjv: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ തന്റെ പടയങ്കി ദാവീദിനെ ധരിപ്പിച്ചു അവന്റെ തലയിൽ താമ്രശിരസ്ത്രംവെച്ചു; തന്റെ കവചവും അവനെ ഇടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul dressed David in his own tunic. He put a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.
chapters.nkjv: So Saul clothed David with his armor, and he put a bronze helmet on his head; he also clothed him with a coat of mail.
chapters.kjv: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

chapters.ml: പടയങ്കിമേൽ അവന്റെ വാളും കെട്ടി ദാവീദ് നടപ്പാൻ നോക്കി; എന്നാൽ അവന്നു ശീലമില്ലായിരുന്നു; ദാവീദ് ശൌലിനോടു: ഞാൻ ശീലിച്ചിട്ടില്ലായ്കയാൽ ഇവ ധരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു നടപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു കഴികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, അവയെ ഊരിവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David fastened on his sword over the tunic and tried walking around, because he was not used to them. "I cannot go in these," he said to Saul, "because I am not used to them." So he took them off.
chapters.nkjv: David fastened his sword to his armor and tried to walk, for he had not tested them. And David said to Saul, "I cannot walk with these, for I have not tested them." So David took them off.
chapters.kjv: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it . And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them . And David put them off him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തന്റെ വടി എടുത്തു, തോട്ടിൽനിന്നു മിനുസമുള്ള അഞ്ചു കല്ലും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു ഇടയസ്സഞ്ചിയായ പൊക്കണത്തിൽ ഇട്ടു, കയ്യിൽ കവിണയുമായി ഫെലിസ്ത്യനോടു അടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he took his staff in his hand, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag and, with his sling in his hand, approached the Philistine.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took his staff in his hand; and he chose for himself five smooth stones from the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag, in a pouch which he had, and his sling was in his hand. And he drew near to the Philistine.
chapters.kjv: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യനും ദാവീദിനോടു അടുത്തു; പരിചക്കാരനും അവന്റെ മുമ്പെ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, the Philistine, with his shield bearer in front of him, kept coming closer to David.
chapters.nkjv: So the Philistine came, and began drawing near to David, and the man who bore the shield went before him.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ നോക്കി ദാവീദിനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവനെ നിന്ദിച്ചു; അവൻ തീരെ ബാലനും പവിഴനിറമുള്ളവനും കോമളരൂപനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He looked David over and saw that he was little more than a boy, glowing with health and handsome, and he despised him.
chapters.nkjv: And when the Philistine looked about and saw David, he disdained him; for he was only a youth, ruddy and good-looking.
chapters.kjv: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: നീ വടികളുമായി എന്റെ നേരെ വരുവാൻ ഞാൻ നായോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു, തന്റെ ദേവന്മാരുടെ നാമം ചൊല്ലി ദാവീദിനെ ശപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
chapters.nkjv: So the Philistine said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ പിന്നെയും ദാവീദിനോടു: ഇങ്ങോട്ടു വാ; ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മാംസം ആകാശത്തിലെ പക്ഷികൾക്കും കാട്ടിലെ മൃഗങ്ങൾക്കും ഇരയാക്കുന്നുണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Come here," he said, "and I’ll give your flesh to the birds and the wild animals!"
chapters.nkjv: And the Philistine said to David, "Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field!"
chapters.kjv: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ വാളും കുന്തവും വേലുമായി എന്റെ നേരെ വരുന്നു; ഞാനോ നീ നിന്ദിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള യിസ്രായേൽനിരകളുടെ ദൈവമായ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ നിന്റെ നേരെ വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: David said to the Philistine, "You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to the Philistine, "You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin. But I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
chapters.kjv: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഇന്നു നിന്നെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കൊന്നു നിന്റെ തല ഛേദിച്ചുകളയും; അത്രയുമല്ല ഞാൻ ഇന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ ശവങ്ങളെ ആകാശത്തിലെ പക്ഷികൾക്കും ഭൂമിയിലെ മൃഗങ്ങൾക്കും ഇരയാക്കും; യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരു ദൈവം ഉണ്ടെന്നു സർവ്വഭൂമിയും അറിയും.
chapters.niv: This day the Lord will deliver you into my hands, and I’ll strike you down and cut off your head. This very day I will give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds and the wild animals, and the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.
chapters.nkjv: This day the Lord will deliver you into my hand, and I will strike you and take your head from you. And this day I will give the carcasses of the camp of the Philistines to the birds of the air and the wild beasts of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
chapters.kjv: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ വാൾകൊണ്ടും കുന്തംകൊണ്ടുമല്ല രക്ഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു ഈ സംഘമെല്ലാം അറിവാൻ ഇടവരും; യുദ്ധം യഹോവെക്കുള്ളതു; അവൻ നിങ്ങളെ ഞങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുതരും.
chapters.niv: All those gathered here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the Lord saves; for the battle is the Lord ’s, and he will give all of you into our hands."
chapters.nkjv: Then all this assembly shall know that the Lord does not save with sword and spear; for the battle is the Lord’s, and He will give you into our hands."
chapters.kjv: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s , and he will give you into our hands.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യൻ ദാവീദിനോടു എതിർപ്പാൻ നേരിട്ടടുത്തപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യനോടു എതിർപ്പാൻ അണിക്കു നേരെ ഓടി.
chapters.niv: As the Philistine moved closer to attack him, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the Philistine arose and came and drew near to meet David, that David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് സഞ്ചിയിൽ കയ്യിട്ടു ഒരു കല്ലു എടുത്തു കവിണയിൽവെച്ചു വീശി ഫെലിസ്ത്യന്റെ നെറ്റിക്കു എറിഞ്ഞു. കല്ലു അവന്റെ നെറ്റിയിൽ കൊണ്ടു പതിഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: Reaching into his bag and taking out a stone, he slung it and struck the Philistine on the forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.
chapters.nkjv: Then David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone; and he slung it and struck the Philistine in his forehead, so that the stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.
chapters.kjv: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it , and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കവിണ്ണുവീണു. ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ഒരു കവിണയും ഒരു കല്ലുംകൊണ്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യനെ ജയിച്ചു, ഫെലിസ്ത്യനെ കൊന്നു മുടിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ വാൾ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David triumphed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone; without a sword in his hand he struck down the Philistine and killed him.
chapters.nkjv: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him. But therewas no sword in the hand of David.
chapters.kjv: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ദാവീദ് ഓടിച്ചെന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യന്റെ പുറത്തു കയറിനിന്നു അവന്റെ വാൾ ഉറയിൽനിന്നു ഊരിയെടുത്തു അവനെ കൊന്നു, അവന്റെ തല വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു. തങ്ങളുടെ മല്ലൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ കണ്ടിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: David ran and stood over him. He took hold of the Philistine’s sword and drew it from the sheath. After he killed him, he cut off his head with the sword. When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they turned and ran.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore David ran and stood over the Philistine, took his sword and drew it out of its sheath and killed him, and cut off his head with it. And when the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
chapters.kjv: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യരും യെഹൂദ്യരും പുറപ്പെട്ടു ആർത്തുംകൊണ്ടു ഗത്തും എക്രോൻ വാതിലുകളുംവരെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ പിന്തുടർന്നു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യഹതന്മാർ ശയരയീമിന്നുള്ള വഴിയിൽ ഗത്തും എക്രോനുംവരെ വീണുകിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the men of Israel and Judah surged forward with a shout and pursued the Philistines to the entrance of Gath and to the gates of Ekron. Their dead were strewn along the Shaaraim road to Gath and Ekron.
chapters.nkjv: Now the men of Israel and Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as the entrance of the valley and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell along the road to Shaaraim, even as far as Gath and Ekron.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ ഓടിക്കയും മടങ്ങിവന്നു അവരുടെ പാളയം കൊള്ളയിടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.
chapters.nkjv: Then the children of Israel returned from chasing the Philistines, and they plundered their tents.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യന്റെ തല എടുത്തു അതിനെ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവന്റെ ആയുധവർഗ്ഗമോ തന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David took the Philistine’s head and brought it to Jerusalem; he put the Philistine’s weapons in his own tent.
chapters.nkjv: And David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.
chapters.kjv: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യന്റെ നേരെ ചെല്ലുന്നതു ശൌൽ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ സേനാധിപതിയായ അബ്നേരിനോടു: അബ്നേരേ, ഈ ബാല്യക്കാരൻ ആരുടെ മകൻ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അബ്നേർ: രാജാവേ, തിരുമേനിയാണ ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As Saul watched David going out to meet the Philistine, he said to Abner, commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is that young man?" Abner replied, "As surely as you live, Your Majesty, I don’t know."
chapters.nkjv: When Saul saw David going out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is this youth?" And Abner said, "As your soul lives, O king, I do not know."
chapters.kjv: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

chapters.ml: ഈ ബാല്യക്കാരൻ ആരുടെ മകൻ എന്നു നീ അന്വേഷിക്കേണം എന്നു രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king said, "Find out whose son this young man is."
chapters.nkjv: So the king said, "Inquire whose son this young man is."
chapters.kjv: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is .

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യനെ സംഹരിച്ചു മടങ്ങിവരുമ്പോൾ അബ്നേർ അവനെ കൂട്ടി ശൌലിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യന്റെ തലയും അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As soon as David returned from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with David still holding the Philistine’s head.
chapters.nkjv: Then, as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
chapters.kjv: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ അവനോടു: ബാല്യക്കാരാ, നീ ആരുടെ മകൻ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു; ഞാൻ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമ്യനായ നിന്റെ ദാസൻ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ എന്നു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Whose son are you, young man?" Saul asked him. David said, "I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem."
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said to him, "Whose son are you, young man?" So David answered, "Iam the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth-lehemite.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശൌലിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു തീർന്നപ്പോൾ യോനാഥാന്റെ മനസ്സു ദാവീദിന്റെ മനസ്സോടു പറ്റിച്ചേർന്നു; യോനാഥാൻ അവനെ സ്വന്തപ്രാണനെപ്പോലെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathan became one in spirit with David, and he loved him as himself.
chapters.nkjv: Now when he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ അന്നു അവനെ ചേർത്തു കൊണ്ടു; അവന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവാൻ പിന്നെ അനുവദിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: From that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return home to his family.
chapters.nkjv: Saul took him that day, and would not let him go home to his father’s house anymore.
chapters.kjv: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനെ സ്വന്തപ്രാണനെപ്പോലെ സ്നേഹിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവനുമായി സഖ്യതചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
chapters.kjv: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ താൻ ധരിച്ചിരുന്ന മേലങ്കി ഊരി അതും തന്റെ വസ്ത്രവും വാളും വില്ലും അരക്കച്ചയും ദാവീദിന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, and even his sword, his bow and his belt.
chapters.nkjv: And Jonathan took off the robe that was on him and gave it to David, with his armor, even to his sword and his bow and his belt.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ അയക്കുന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും ദാവീദ് പോയി കാര്യാദികളെ വിവേകത്തോടെ നടത്തും; അതുകൊണ്ടു ശൌൽ അവനെ പടജ്ജനത്തിന്നു മേധാവി ആക്കി; ഇതു സർവ്വജനത്തിന്നും ശൌലിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർക്കും ബോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Whatever mission Saul sent him on, David was so successful that Saul gave him a high rank in the army. This pleased all the troops, and Saul’s officers as well.
chapters.nkjv: So David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved wisely. And Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
chapters.kjv: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യനെ സംഹരിച്ചശേഷം അവർ മടങ്ങിവരുമ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേല്യപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽനിന്നൊക്കെയും സ്ത്രീകൾ പാടിയും നൃത്തംചെയ്തുംകൊണ്ടു തപ്പും തംബുരുവുമായി സന്തോഷത്തോടെ ശൌൽരാജാവിനെ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the men were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out from all the towns of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs and with timbrels and lyres.
