chapters.nkjv: Now it had happened as they were coming home, when David was returning from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women had come out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul, with tambourines, with joy, and with musical instruments.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീകൾ വാദ്യഘോഷത്തോടെ ഗാനപ്രതിഗാനമായി: ശൌൽ ആയിരത്തെ കൊന്നു ദാവീദോ പതിനായിരത്തെ എന്നു പാടി.
chapters.niv: As they danced, they sang: "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands."
chapters.nkjv: So the women sang as they danced, and said: "Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands."
chapters.kjv: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ ഏറ്റവും കോപിച്ചു; ഈ വാക്കു അവന്നു അനിഷ്ടമായി: അവർ ദാവീദിന്നു പതിനായിരം കൊടുത്തു എനിക്കു ആയിരം മാത്രമേ തന്നുള്ളു; ഇനി രാജത്വമല്ലാതെ അവന്നു കിട്ടുവാൻ എന്തുള്ളു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul was very angry; this refrain displeased him greatly. "They have credited David with tens of thousands," he thought, "but me with only thousands. What more can he get but the kingdom?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul was very angry, and the saying displeased him; and he said, "They have ascribed to David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed only thousands. Now what more can he have but the kingdom?"
chapters.kjv: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?

chapters.ml: അന്നുമുതൽ ശൌലിന്നു ദാവീദിനോടു കണ്ണുകടി തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: And from that time on Saul kept a close eye on David.
chapters.nkjv: So Saul eyed David from that day forward.
chapters.kjv: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പക്കൽ നിന്നുള്ള ദുരാത്മാവു ശൌലിന്മേൽ വന്നു; അവൻ അരമനക്കകത്തു ഉറഞ്ഞുപറഞ്ഞു; ദാവീദോ പതിവുപോലെ കിന്നരം വായിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; ശൌലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഒരു കുന്തം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The next day an evil spirit from God came forcefully on Saul. He was prophesying in his house, while David was playing the lyre, as he usually did. Saul had a spear in his hand
chapters.nkjv: And it happened on the next day that the distressing spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied inside the house. So David played music with his hand, as at other times; but therewas a spear in Saul’s hand.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul’s hand.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിനെ ചുവരോടുചേർത്തു കുത്തുവാൻ വിചാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ശൌൽ കുന്തം ചാടി; എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് രണ്ടു പ്രാവശ്യം അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു മാറിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and he hurled it, saying to himself, "I’ll pin David to the wall." But David eluded him twice.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul cast the spear, for he said, "I will pin David to the wall!" But David escaped his presence twice.
chapters.kjv: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it . And David avoided out of his presence twice.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദാവീദിനോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കയും ശൌലിനെ വിട്ടുമാറുകയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with David but had departed from Saul.
chapters.nkjv: Now Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him, but had departed from Saul.
chapters.kjv: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ശൌൽ അവനെ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു മാറ്റി സഹസ്രാധിപനാക്കി; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ജനത്തിന്നു നായകനായി പെരുമാറിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he sent David away from him and gave him command over a thousand men, and David led the troops in their campaigns.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
chapters.kjv: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തന്റെ എല്ലാവഴികളിലും വിവേകത്തോടെ നടന്നു; യഹോവ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In everything he did he had great success, because the Lord was with him.
chapters.nkjv: And David behaved wisely in all his ways, and the Lordwas with him.
chapters.kjv: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഏറ്റവും വിവേകത്തോടെ നടക്കുന്നു എന്നു ശൌൽ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവങ്കൽ ആശങ്കിതനായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Saul saw how successful he was, he was afraid of him.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when Saul saw that he behaved very wisely, he was afraid of him.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് യിസ്രായേലിന്നും യെഹൂദെക്കും നായകനായി പെരുമാറിയതുകൊണ്ടു അവരൊക്കെയും അവനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he led them in their campaigns.
chapters.nkjv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
chapters.kjv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനോടു: എന്റെ മൂത്ത മകൾ മേരബുണ്ടല്ലോ; ഞാൻ അവളെ നിനക്കു ഭാര്യയായി തരും; നീ ശൂരനായി എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി യഹോവയുടെ യുദ്ധങ്ങൾ നടത്തിയാൽ മതി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്റെ കയ്യല്ല ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കൈ അവന്റെമേൽ വീഴുവാൻ സംഗതിവരട്ടെ എന്നു ശൌൽ വിചാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab. I will give her to you in marriage; only serve me bravely and fight the battles of the Lord ." For Saul said to himself, "I will not raise a hand against him. Let the Philistines do that!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab; I will give her to you as a wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight the Lord’s battles." For Saul thought, "Let my hand not be against him, but let the hand of the Philistines be against him."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD’s battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്, ശൌലിനോടു: രാജാവിന്റെ മരുമകനായിരിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ ആർ? യിസ്രായേലിൽ എന്റെ അസ്മാദികളും എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനവും എന്തുള്ളു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But David said to Saul, "Who am I, and what is my family or my clan in Israel, that I should become the king’s son-in-law?"
chapters.nkjv: So David said to Saul, "Who am I, and what is my life or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?"
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മേരബിനെ ദാവീദിന്നു കൊടുക്കേണ്ടിയിരുന്ന സമയത്തു അവളെ മെഹോലാത്യനായ അദ്രിയേലിന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So when the time came for Merab, Saul’s daughter, to be given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah.
chapters.nkjv: But it happened at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, that she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as a wife.
chapters.kjv: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul’s daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖളോ ദാവീദിനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു. അതു ശൌലിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി; കാര്യം അവന്നു ഇഷ്ടമായി.
chapters.niv: Now Saul’s daughter Michal was in love with David, and when they told Saul about it, he was pleased.
chapters.nkjv: Now Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David. And they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
chapters.kjv: And Michal Saul’s daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവന്നു ഒരു കണിയായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കൈ അവന്റെമേൽ വീഴേണ്ടതിന്നും ഞാൻ അവളെ അവന്നു കൊടുക്കും എന്നു ശൌൽ വിചാരിച്ചു ദാവീദിനോടു: നീ ഈ രണ്ടാം പ്രാവശ്യം എനിക്കു മരുമകനായി തീരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I will give her to him," he thought, "so that she may be a snare to him and so that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." So Saul said to David, "Now you have a second opportunity to become my son-in-law."
chapters.nkjv: So Saul said, "I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." Therefore Saul said to David a second time, "You shall be my son-in-law today."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശൌൽ തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ സ്വകാര്യമായി ദാവീദിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: ഇതാ, രാജാവിന്നു നിന്നെ പ്രിയമാകുന്നു; അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ ഒക്കെയും നിന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ നീ രാജാവിന്റെ മരുമകനായ്തീരേണം എന്നു പറവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul ordered his attendants: "Speak to David privately and say, ‘Look, the king likes you, and his attendants all love you; now become his son-in-law.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And Saul commanded his servants, "Communicate with David secretly, and say, ‘Look, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore, become the king’s son-in-law.’ "
chapters.kjv: And Saul commanded his servants, saying , Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king’s son in law.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ ആ വാക്കു ദാവീദിനോടു പറഞ്ഞാറെ ദാവീദ്: രാജാവിന്റെ മരുമകനാകുന്നതു അല്പകാര്യമെന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു തോന്നുന്നുവോ? ഞാൻ ദരിദ്രനും എളിയവനും ആകുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They repeated these words to David. But David said, "Do you think it is a small matter to become the king’s son-in-law? I’m only a poor man and little known."
chapters.nkjv: So Saul’s servants spoke those words in the hearing of David. And David said, "Does it seem to you a light thing to be a king’s son-in-law, seeing I am a poor and lightly esteemed man?"
chapters.kjv: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king’s son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ ദൃത്യന്മാർ: ദാവീദ് ഇപ്രകാരം പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Saul’s servants told him what David had said,
chapters.nkjv: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, "In this manner David spoke."
chapters.kjv: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശൌൽ: രാജാവിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾക്കു പ്രതികാരം ആകുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നൂറു അഗ്രചർമ്മമല്ലാതെ രാജാവു യാതൊരു സ്ത്രീധനവും ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നില്ല എന്നിങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ ദാവീദിനോടു പറയേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യാൽ ദാവീദിനെ വീഴുമാറാക്കേണമെന്നു ശൌൽ കരുതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Saul replied, "Say to David, ‘The king wants no other price for the bride than a hundred Philistine foreskins, to take revenge on his enemies.’ " Saul’s plan was to have David fall by the hands of the Philistines.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said, "Thus you shall say to David: ‘The king does not desire any dowry but one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to take vengeance on the king’s enemies.’ " But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: ഭൃത്യന്മാർ ദാവീദിനോടു ഈ വാക്കു അറിയിച്ചപ്പോൾ രാജാവിന്റെ മരുമകനാകുവാൻ ദാവീദിന്നു സന്തോഷമായി;
chapters.niv: When the attendants told David these things, he was pleased to become the king’s son-in-law. So before the allotted time elapsed,
chapters.nkjv: So when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to become the king’s son-in-law. Now the days had not expired;
chapters.kjv: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son in law: and the days were not expired.

chapters.ml: അവധി കഴിയുന്നതിന്നു മുമ്പെ ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും പുറപ്പെട്ടുചെന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരിൽ ഇരുനൂറു പേരെ കൊന്നു, അവരുടെ അഗ്രചർമ്മംകൊണ്ടുവന്നു താൻ രാജാവിന്റെ മരുമകനാകേണ്ടതിന്നു രാജാവിന്നു എണ്ണം കൊടുത്തു. ശൌൽ തന്റെ മകളായ മീഖളിനെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: David took his men with him and went out and killed two hundred Philistines and brought back their foreskins. They counted out the full number to the king so that David might become the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him his daughter Michal in marriage.
chapters.nkjv: therefore David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. And David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full count to the king, that he might become the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as a wife.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king’s son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദാവീദിനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നും ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖൾ അവനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു എന്നും ശൌൽ കണ്ടറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ,
chapters.niv: When Saul realized that the Lord was with David and that his daughter Michal loved David,
chapters.nkjv: Thus Saul saw and knew that the Lordwas with David, and that Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him;
chapters.kjv: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul’s daughter loved him.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനെ പിന്നെയും അധികം ഭയപ്പെട്ടു; ശൌൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ നിത്യശത്രുവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Saul became still more afraid of him, and he remained his enemy the rest of his days.
chapters.nkjv: and Saul was still more afraid of David. So Saul became David’s enemy continually.
chapters.kjv: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David’s enemy continually.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവർ പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോഴൊക്കെയും ദാവീദ് ശൌലിന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരെക്കാളും കൃതാർത്ഥനായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ പേർ വിശ്രുതമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Philistine commanders continued to go out to battle, and as often as they did, David met with more success than the rest of Saul’s officers, and his name became well known.
chapters.nkjv: Then the princes of the Philistines went out towar. And so it was, whenever they went out, that David behaved more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name became highly esteemed.
chapters.kjv: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശൌൽ തന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാനോടും സകല ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടും ദാവീദിനെ കൊല്ലേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul told his son Jonathan and all the attendants to kill David. But Jonathan had taken a great liking to David
chapters.nkjv: Now Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David; but Jonathan, Saul’s son, delighted greatly in David.
chapters.kjv: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാന്നു ദാവീദിനോടു വളരെ ഇഷ്ടമായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശൌൽ നിന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ നീ രാവിലെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു ഗൂഢമായോരു സ്ഥലത്തു ഒളിച്ചുപാർക്ക.
chapters.niv: and warned him, "My father Saul is looking for a chance to kill you. Be on your guard tomorrow morning; go into hiding and stay there.
chapters.nkjv: So Jonathan told David, saying, "My father Saul seeks to kill you. Therefore please be on your guard until morning, and stay in a secret place and hide.
chapters.kjv: But Jonathan Saul’s son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു നീ ഇരിക്കുന്ന വയലിൽ എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു എന്റെ അപ്പനോടു സംസാരിക്കും; ഞാൻ ഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നതു നിന്നെ അറിയിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I will go out and stand with my father in the field where you are. I’ll speak to him about you and will tell you what I find out."
chapters.nkjv: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will speak with my father about you. Then what I observe, I will tell you."
chapters.kjv: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art , and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോനാഥാൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശൌലിനോടു ദാവീദിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഗുണമായി സംസാരിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു: രാജാവു തന്റെ ഭൃത്യനായ ദാവീദിനോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്യരുതേ; അവൻ നിന്നോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല; അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ നിനക്കു ഏറ്റവും ഗുണകരമായിരുന്നതേയുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father and said to him, "Let not the king do wrong to his servant David; he has not wronged you, and what he has done has benefited you greatly.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father, and said to him, "Let not the king sin against his servant, against David, because he has not sinned against you, and because his works havebeen very good toward you.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ജീവനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടല്ലോ ആ ഫെലിസ്ത്യനെ സംഹരിക്കയും അങ്ങനെ യഹോവ എല്ലാ യിസ്രായേലിന്നും വലിയോരു രക്ഷവരുത്തുകയും ചെയ്തതു; നീ അതു കണ്ടു സന്തോഷിച്ചു. ആകയാൽ നീ വെറുതെ ദാവീദിനെ കൊന്നു കുറ്റമില്ലാത്ത രക്തം ചൊരിഞ്ഞു പാപം ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: He took his life in his hands when he killed the Philistine. The Lord won a great victory for all Israel, and you saw it and were glad. Why then would you do wrong to an innocent man like David by killing him for no reason?"
chapters.nkjv: For he took his life in his hands and killed the Philistine, and the Lord brought about a great deliverance for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?"
chapters.kjv: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the LORD wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it , and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടു: യഹോവയാണ അവനെ കൊല്ലുകയില്ല എന്നു ശൌൽ സത്യം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Saul listened to Jonathan and took this oath: "As surely as the Lord lives, David will not be put to death."
chapters.nkjv: So Saul heeded the voice of Jonathan, and Saul swore, "As the Lord lives, he shall not be killed."
chapters.kjv: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the LORD liveth, he shall not be slain.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനെ വിളിച്ചു കാര്യമെല്ലാം അറിയിച്ചു. യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനെ ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവൻ മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിൽക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Jonathan called David and told him the whole conversation. He brought him to Saul, and David was with Saul as before.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him all these things. So Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as in times past.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായാറെ ദാവീദ് പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു പടവെട്ടി അവരെ കഠിനമായി തോല്പിച്ചു. അവർ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി.
chapters.niv: Once more war broke out, and David went out and fought the Philistines. He struck them with such force that they fled before him.
chapters.nkjv: And there was war again; and David went out and fought with the Philistines, and struck them with a mighty blow, and they fled from him.
chapters.kjv: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നു ദുരാത്മാവു പിന്നെയും ശൌലിന്റെമേൽ വന്നു; അവൻ കയ്യിൽ കുന്തവും പിടിച്ചു തന്റെ അരമനയിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു; ദാവീദ് കിന്നരം വായിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul as he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand. While David was playing the lyre,
chapters.nkjv: Now the distressing spirit from the Lord came upon Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand. And David was playing music with his hand.
chapters.kjv: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനെ കുന്തംകൊണ്ടു ചുവരോടുചേർത്തു കുത്തുവാൻ നോക്കി; അവനോ ശൌലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു മാറിക്കളഞ്ഞു. കുന്തം ചുവരിൽ തറെച്ചു; ദാവീദ് ആ രാത്രിയിൽതന്നേ ഓടിപ്പോയി രക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Saul tried to pin him to the wall with his spear, but David eluded him as Saul drove the spear into the wall. That night David made good his escape.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away from Saul’s presence; and he drove the spear into the wall. So David fled and escaped that night.
chapters.kjv: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിനെ കാത്തുനിന്നു രാവിലെ കൊന്നുകളയേണ്ടതിന്നു ശൌൽ അവന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ മീഖൾ അവനോടു: ഈ രാത്രിയിൽ നിന്റെ ജീവനെ രക്ഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടില്ലെങ്കിൽ നാളെ നിന്നെ കൊന്നുപോകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul sent men to David’s house to watch it and to kill him in the morning. But Michal, David’s wife, warned him, "If you don’t run for your life tonight, tomorrow you’ll be killed."
chapters.nkjv: Saul also sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. And Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, "If you do not save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed."
chapters.kjv: Saul also sent messengers unto David’s house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David’s wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മീഖൾ ദാവീദിനെ കിളിവാതിൽകൂടി ഇറക്കിവിട്ടു; അവൻ ഓടിപ്പോയി രക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So Michal let David down through a window, and he fled and escaped.
chapters.nkjv: So Michal let David down through a window. And he went and fled and escaped.
chapters.kjv: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.

chapters.ml: മീഖൾ ഒരു ബിംബം എടുത്തു കട്ടിലിന്മേൽ കിടത്തി, അതിന്റെ തലെക്കു കോലാട്ടുരോമംകൊണ്ടുള്ള മൂടിയും ഇട്ടു ഒരു വസ്ത്രംകൊണ്ടു പുതപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed, covering it with a garment and putting some goats’ hair at the head.
chapters.nkjv: And Michal took an image and laid it in the bed, put a cover of goats’ hair for his head, and covered it with clothes.
chapters.kjv: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ ശൌൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ ദീനമായി കിടക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Saul sent the men to capture David, Michal said, "He is ill."
chapters.nkjv: So when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, "He is sick."
chapters.kjv: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ശൌൽ: ഞാൻ അവനെ കൊല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു കിടക്കയോടെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Saul sent the men back to see David and told them, "Bring him up to me in his bed so that I may kill him."
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul sent the messengers back to see David, saying, "Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him."
chapters.kjv: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിനെ ചെന്നു നോക്കുവാൻ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു. ദൂതന്മാർ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ കട്ടിലിന്മേൽ ഒരു ബിംബം തലെക്കു കോലാട്ടുരോമംകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു മൂടിയുമായി കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: But when the men entered, there was the idol in the bed, and at the head was some goats’ hair.
chapters.nkjv: And when the messengers had come in, there was the image in the bed, with a cover of goats’ hair for his head.
chapters.kjv: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ശൌൽ മീഖളിനോടു: നീ ഇങ്ങനെ എന്നെ ചതിക്കയും എന്റെ ശത്രു ചാടിപ്പോകുവാൻ അവനെ വിട്ടയക്കയും ചെയ്തതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: എന്നെ വിട്ടയക്ക; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കൊല്ലും എന്നു അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു മീഖൾ ശൌലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul said to Michal, "Why did you deceive me like this and send my enemy away so that he escaped?" Michal told him, "He said to me, ‘Let me get away. Why should I kill you?’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said to Michal, "Why have you deceived me like this, and sent my enemy away, so that he has escaped?" And Michal answered Saul, "He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’ "
chapters.kjv: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ഓടിപ്പോയി രക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു, രാമയിൽ ശമൂവേലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു ശൌൽ തന്നോടു ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു. പിന്നെ അവനും ശമൂവേലും പുറപ്പെട്ടു നയ്യോത്തിൽ ചെന്നു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: When David had fled and made his escape, he went to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.
chapters.nkjv: So David fled and escaped, and went to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and stayed in Naioth.
chapters.kjv: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് രാമയിലെ നയ്യോത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ശൌലിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Word came to Saul: "David is in Naioth at Ramah";
chapters.nkjv: Now it was told Saul, saying, "Take note, David is at Naioth in Ramah!"
chapters.kjv: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; അവർ പ്രവാചകസംഘം പ്രവചിക്കുന്നതും ശമൂവേൽ അവരുടെ തലവനായിരിക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആത്മാവു ശൌലിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരുടെ മേലും വന്നു, അവരും പ്രവചിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: so he sent men to capture him. But when they saw a group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel standing there as their leader, the Spirit of God came on Saul’s men, and they also prophesied.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul sent messengers to take David. And when they saw the group of prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as leader over them, the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
chapters.kjv: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ അതു അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ വേറെ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; അവരും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ പ്രവചിച്ചു. ശൌൽ പിന്നെയും മൂന്നാം പ്രാവശ്യം ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; അവരും പ്രവചിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul was told about it, and he sent more men, and they prophesied too. Saul sent men a third time, and they also prophesied.
chapters.nkjv: And when Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. Then Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
chapters.kjv: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തന്നേ രാമയിലേക്കു പോയി, സേക്കൂവിലെ വലിയ കിണറ്റിങ്കൽ എത്തി: ശമൂവേലും ദാവീദും എവിടെയാകുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അവർ രാമയിലെ നയ്യോത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഒരുത്തൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Finally, he himself left for Ramah and went to the great cistern at Seku. And he asked, "Where are Samuel and David?" "Over in Naioth at Ramah," they said.
chapters.nkjv: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is at Sechu. So he asked, and said, "Where are Samuel and David?" And someone said, "Indeed theyare at Naioth in Ramah."
chapters.kjv: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ രാമയിലെ നയ്യോത്തിന്നു ചെന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആത്മാവു അവന്റെമേലും വന്നു; അവൻ രാമയിലെ നയ്യോത്തിൽ എത്തുംവരെ പ്രവചിച്ചു കൊണ്ടു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Saul went to Naioth at Ramah. But the Spirit of God came even on him, and he walked along prophesying until he came to Naioth.
chapters.nkjv: So he went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on and prophesied until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
chapters.kjv: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം ഉരിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ശമൂവേലിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ പ്രവചിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അന്നു രാപകൽ മുഴുവനും നഗ്നനായി കിടന്നു. ആകയാൽ ശൌലും ഉണ്ടോ പ്രവാചകഗണത്തിൽ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He stripped off his garments, and he too prophesied in Samuel’s presence. He lay naked all that day and all that night. This is why people say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
chapters.nkjv: And he also stripped off his clothes and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
chapters.kjv: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് രാമയിലെ നയ്യോത്തിൽനിന്നു ഓടി യോനാഥാന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: ഞാൻ എന്തു ചെയ്തു? എന്റെ കുറ്റം എന്തു? നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ എന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അന്വേഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനോടു ഞാൻ ചെയ്ത പാപം എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then David fled from Naioth at Ramah and went to Jonathan and asked, "What have I done? What is my crime? How have I wronged your father, that he is trying to kill me?"
chapters.nkjv: Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and went and said to Jonathan, "What have I done? What is my iniquity, and what is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?"
chapters.kjv: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: അങ്ങനെ ഭവിക്കരുതേ, നീ മരിക്കയില്ല; എന്റെ അപ്പൻ എന്നെ അറിയിക്കാതെ വലുതോ ചെറുതോ യാതൊന്നും ചെയ്‍വാറില്ല; പിന്നെ ഈ കാര്യം എന്നെ മറെപ്പാൻ സംഗതി എന്തു? അങ്ങനെ വരികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Never!" Jonathan replied. "You are not going to die! Look, my father doesn’t do anything, great or small, without letting me know. Why would he hide this from me? It isn’t so!"
chapters.nkjv: So Jonathan said to him, "By no means! You shall not die! Indeed, my father will do nothing either great or small without first telling me. And why should my father hide this thing from me? It is not so!"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so .

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പിന്നെയും അവനോടു: എന്നോടു നിനക്കു പ്രിയമാകുന്നുവെന്നു നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ നല്ലവണ്ണം അറികയാൽ യോനാഥാൻ ദുഃഖിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ഇതു ഗ്രഹിക്കരുതു എന്നു അവൻ വിചാരിക്കുന്നു; എന്നാൽ യഹോവയാണ, നിന്നാണ, എനിക്കും മരണത്തിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ ഒരടി അകലം മാത്രമേയുള്ളു എന്നു സത്യംചെയ്തു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But David took an oath and said, "Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said to himself, ‘Jonathan must not know this or he will be grieved.’ Yet as surely as the Lord lives and as you live, there is only a step between me and death."
chapters.nkjv: Then David took an oath again, and said, "Your father certainly knows that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said, ‘Do not let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved.’ But truly, as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, thereis but a step between me and death."
chapters.kjv: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: നിന്റെ ആഗ്രഹം എന്തു? ഞാൻ അതു ചെയ്തുതരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you want me to do, I’ll do for you."
chapters.nkjv: So Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you yourself desire, I will do it for you."
chapters.kjv: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യോനാഥാനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നാളെ അമാവാസ്യയാകുന്നു; ഞാനും രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ പന്തിഭോജനത്തിന്നു ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതല്ലോ; എങ്കിലും മറ്റെന്നാൾ വൈകുന്നേരംവരെ വയലിൽ ഒളിച്ചിരിപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു അനുവാദം തരേണം.
chapters.niv: So David said, "Look, tomorrow is the New Moon feast, and I am supposed to dine with the king; but let me go and hide in the field until the evening of the day after tomorrow.
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Jonathan, "Indeed tomorrow is the New Moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king to eat. But let me go, that I may hide in the field until the third day at evening.
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ എന്നെ കാണാഞ്ഞിട്ടു അന്വേഷിച്ചാൽ: ദാവീദ് സ്വന്തപട്ടണമായ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിലേക്കു ഒന്നു പോയിവരേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നോടു താല്പര്യമായി അനുവാദം ചോദിച്ചു; അവന്റെ കുലത്തിന്നെല്ലാം അവിടെ വർഷാന്തരയാഗം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ബോധിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: If your father misses me at all, tell him, ‘David earnestly asked my permission to hurry to Bethlehem, his hometown, because an annual sacrifice is being made there for his whole clan.’
chapters.nkjv: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked permission of me that he might run over to Bethlehem, his city, for thereis a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’
chapters.kjv: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth-lehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

chapters.ml: കൊള്ളാമെന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞാൽ അടിയന്നു ശുഭം; അല്ല, കോപിച്ചാൽ: അവൻ ദോഷം നിർണ്ണയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞുകൊള്ളേണം.
chapters.niv: If he says, ‘Very well,’ then your servant is safe. But if he loses his temper, you can be sure that he is determined to harm me.
chapters.nkjv: If he says thus: ‘Itis well,’ your servant will be safe. But if he is very angry, be sure that evil is determined by him.
chapters.kjv: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അങ്ങുന്നു അടിയനോടു ദയ ചെയ്യേണം; അടിയനുമായി യഹോവയെ സാക്ഷിയാക്കി സഖ്യത ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടല്ലോ; വല്ല കുറ്റവും എന്നിൽ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിലോ അങ്ങുന്നു തന്നേ എന്നെ കൊല്ലുക; അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എന്നെ കൊണ്ടുപോകുവാൻ എന്തൊരാവശ്യം?
chapters.niv: As for you, show kindness to your servant, for you have brought him into a covenant with you before the Lord . If I am guilty, then kill me yourself! Why hand me over to your father?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore you shall deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the Lord with you. Nevertheless, if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?"
chapters.kjv: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോനാഥാൻ: അങ്ങനെ നിനക്കു വരാതിരിക്കട്ടെ; എന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിനക്കു ദോഷം വരുത്തുവാൻ നിർണ്ണയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞാൽ നിന്നെ അറിയിക്കാതിരിക്കുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Never!" Jonathan said. "If I had the least inkling that my father was determined to harm you, wouldn’t I tell you?"
chapters.nkjv: But Jonathan said, "Far be it from you! For if I knew certainly that evil was determined by my father to come upon you, then would I not tell you?"
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യോനാഥാനോടു: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിന്നോടു കഠിനമായി ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞാലോ അതു ആർ എന്നെ അറിയിക്കും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David asked, "Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?"
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to Jonathan, "Who will tell me, or what if your father answers you roughly?"
chapters.kjv: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: വരിക, നമുക്കു വയലിലേക്കു പോകാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ ഇരുവരും വയലിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: "Come," Jonathan said, "let’s go out into the field." So they went there together.
chapters.nkjv: And Jonathan said to David, "Come, let us go out into the field." So both of them went out into the field.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ സാക്ഷി: നാളെ ഈ നേരത്തോ മറ്റെന്നാളോ എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ അന്തർഗ്ഗതമറിഞ്ഞു നിനക്കു ഗുണമെന്നു കണ്ടാൽ ഞാൻ ആളയച്ചു നിന്നെ അറിയിക്കാതിരിക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: Then Jonathan said to David, "I swear by the Lord , the God of Israel, that I will surely sound out my father by this time the day after tomorrow! If he is favorably disposed toward you, will I not send you word and let you know?
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan said to David: "The Lord God of Israel iswitness! When I have sounded out my father sometime tomorrow, or the third day, and indeed thereis good toward David, and I do not send to you and tell you,
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day , and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിന്നോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാനാകുന്നു എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ഭാവമെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ അതു നിന്നെ അറിയിച്ചു നീ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്നെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കാതിരുന്നാൽ യഹോവ യോനാഥാനോടു തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും ചെയ്യട്ടെ; യഹോവ എന്റെ അപ്പനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നതുപോലെ നിന്നോടു കൂടെയും ഇരിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: But if my father intends to harm you, may the Lord deal with Jonathan, be it ever so severely, if I do not let you know and send you away in peace. May the Lord be with you as he has been with my father.
chapters.nkjv: may the Lord do so and much more to Jonathan. But if it pleases my father todo you evil, then I will report it to you and send you away, that you may go in safety. And the Lord be with you as He has been with my father.
chapters.kjv: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇനി ജീവനോടിരിക്കയാകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ മരിക്കാതവണ്ണം യഹോവയുടെ ദയ നീ കാണിക്കേണ്ടതു എന്നോടു മാത്രമല്ല;
chapters.niv: But show me unfailing kindness like the Lord ’s kindness as long as I live, so that I may not be killed,
chapters.nkjv: And you shall not only show me the kindness of the Lord while I still live, that I may not die;
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD , that I die not:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തോടും നിന്റെ ദയ ഒരിക്കലും അറ്റുപോകരുതു; യഹോവ ദാവീദിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ ഒട്ടൊഴിയാതെ ഭൂതലത്തിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയുംകാലത്തും അറ്റുപോകരുതു.
chapters.niv: and do not ever cut off your kindness from my family—not even when the Lord has cut off every one of David’s enemies from the face of the earth."
chapters.nkjv: but you shall not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when the Lord has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the face of the earth."
chapters.kjv: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തോടെ സഖ്യതചെയ്തു. ദാവീദിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളോടു യഹോവ ചോദിച്ചുകൊള്ളും.
chapters.niv: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, "May the Lord call David’s enemies to account."
chapters.nkjv: So Jonathan made acovenant with the house of David, saying, "Let the Lord require it at the hand of David’s enemies."
chapters.kjv: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying , Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ സ്വന്തപ്രാണനെപ്പോലെ ദാവീദിനെ സ്നേഹിക്കയാൽ തന്നോടുള്ള സ്നേഹത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി അവനെക്കൊണ്ടു പിന്നെയും സത്യംചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Jonathan had David reaffirm his oath out of love for him, because he loved him as he loved himself.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jonathan again caused David to vow, because he loved him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നാളെ അമാവാസ്യയാകുന്നുവല്ലോ; നിന്റെ ഇരിപ്പിടം ഒഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ നീ ഇല്ലെന്നു കാണും.
chapters.niv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Tomorrow is the New Moon feast. You will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Tomorrow is the New Moon; and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
chapters.kjv: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു കാര്യം നടന്ന അന്നു നീ ഒളിച്ചിരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു വേഗത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു ഏസെൽകല്ലിന്റെ അരികെ താമസിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The day after tomorrow, toward evening, go to the place where you hid when this trouble began, and wait by the stone Ezel.
chapters.nkjv: And when you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid on the day of the deed; and remain by the stone Ezel.
chapters.kjv: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand , and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ അതിന്റെ ഒരുവശത്തു ഒരു ലാക്കിന്നു എയ്യുന്നഭാവത്തിൽ മൂന്നു അമ്പു എയ്യും.
chapters.niv: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I were shooting at a target.
chapters.nkjv: Then I will shoot three arrows to the side, as though I shot at a target;
chapters.kjv: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof , as though I shot at a mark.

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു അമ്പു നോക്കി എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു വരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരനെ അയക്കും. അമ്പുകൾ നിന്റെ ഇപ്പുറത്തു ഇതാ, എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു വരിക എന്നു ഞാൻ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു പറഞ്ഞാൽ നീ അവ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു വരിക; യഹോവയാണ, നിനക്കു ശുഭമല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊന്നും വരികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then I will send a boy and say, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I say to him, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them here,’ then come, because, as surely as the Lord lives, you are safe; there is no danger.
chapters.nkjv: and there I will send a lad, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I expressly say to the lad, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; get them and come’—then, as the Lord lives, thereis safety for you and no harm.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying , Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: അമ്പു നിന്റെ അപ്പുറത്തു അതാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ നിന്റെ വഴിക്കു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; യഹോവ നിന്നെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But if I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then you must go, because the Lord has sent you away.
chapters.nkjv: But if I say thus to the young man, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you’—go your way, for the Lord has sent you away.
chapters.kjv: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.

chapters.ml: ഞാനും നീയും തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന കാര്യത്തിലോ, യഹോവ എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ എന്നേക്കും സാക്ഷി.
chapters.niv: And about the matter you and I discussed—remember, the Lord is witness between you and me forever."
chapters.nkjv: And as for the matter which you and I have spoken of, indeed the Lordbe between you and me forever."
chapters.kjv: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് വയലിൽ ഒളിച്ചു; അമാവാസ്യയായപ്പോൾ രാജാവു പന്തിഭോജനത്തിന്നു ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon feast came, the king sat down to eat.
chapters.nkjv: Then David hid in the field. And when the New Moon had come, the king sat down to eat the feast.
chapters.kjv: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു പതിവുപോലെ ചുവരിന്നരികെയുള്ള തന്റെ ആസനത്തിന്മേൽ ഇരുന്നു; യോനാഥാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റുനിന്നു. അബ്നേർ ശൌലിന്റെ അരികെ ഇരുന്നു; ദാവീദിന്റെ സ്ഥലമോ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുകിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He sat in his customary place by the wall, opposite Jonathan, and Abner sat next to Saul, but David’s place was empty.
chapters.nkjv: Now the king sat on his seat, as at other times, on a seat by the wall. And Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
chapters.kjv: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ശൌൽ ഒന്നും പറഞ്ഞില്ല; അവന്നു എന്തോ ഭവിച്ചു അവന്നു ശുദ്ധിയില്ലായിരിക്കും; അതേ, അവന്നു ശുദ്ധിയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ വിചാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul said nothing that day, for he thought, "Something must have happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean—surely he is unclean."
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless Saul did not say anything that day, for he thought, "Something has happened to him; he is unclean, surely he is unclean."
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.

chapters.ml: അമാവാസ്യയുടെ പിറ്റെന്നാളും ദാവീദിന്റെ സ്ഥലം ഒഴിഞ്ഞുകിടന്നു; ശൌൽ തന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാനോടു: യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ ഇന്നലെയും ഇന്നും പന്തിഭോജനത്തിന്നു വരാതിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the next day, the second day of the month, David’s place was empty again. Then Saul said to his son Jonathan, "Why hasn’t the son of Jesse come to the meal, either yesterday or today?"
chapters.nkjv: And it happened the next day, the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty. And Saul said to Jonathan his son, "Why has the son of Jesse not come to eat, either yesterday or today?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ ശൌലിനോടു: ദാവീദ് ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ പോകുവാൻ എന്നോടു താല്പര്യമായി അനുവാദം ചോദിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Jonathan answered, "David earnestly asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem.
chapters.nkjv: So Jonathan answered Saul, "David earnestly asked permission of me togo to Bethlehem.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ കുലത്തിന്നു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ഒരു യാഗമുള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ വിട്ടയക്കേണമേ; എന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠൻ തന്നേ എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ നിനക്കു എന്നോടു കൃപയുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ ചെന്നുകാണ്മാൻ അനുവദിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതുകൊണ്ടാകുന്നു അവൻ രാജാവിന്റെ പന്തിഭോജനത്തിന്നു വരാതിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said, ‘Let me go, because our family is observing a sacrifice in the town and my brother has ordered me to be there. If I have found favor in your eyes, let me get away to see my brothers.’ That is why he has not come to the king’s table."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has commanded me tobethere. And now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me get away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ കോപം യോനാഥാന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവൻ അവനോടു: വക്രതയും ദുശ്ശാഠ്യവും ഉള്ളവളുടെ മകനേ, നിന്റെ സ്വന്തലജ്ജെക്കും നിന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ നഗ്നതയുടെ ലജ്ജെക്കുമായി നീ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകനോടു കൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു എനിക്കു അറിഞ്ഞുകൂടയോ?
chapters.niv: Saul’s anger flared up at Jonathan and he said to him, "You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Don’t I know that you have sided with the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you?
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul’s anger was aroused against Jonathan, and he said to him, "You son of a perverse, rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
chapters.kjv: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman , do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?

chapters.ml: യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന കാലത്തൊരിക്കലും നീയും നിന്റെ രാജത്വവും ഉറെക്കയില്ല. ഉടനെ ആളയച്ചു അവനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തുക; അവൻ മരണയോഗ്യനാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As long as the son of Jesse lives on this earth, neither you nor your kingdom will be established. Now send someone to bring him to me, for he must die!"
chapters.nkjv: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you shall not be established, nor your kingdom. Now therefore, send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die."
chapters.kjv: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശൌലിനോടു: അവനെ എന്തിന്നു കൊല്ലുന്നു? അവൻ എന്തു ചെയ്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Why should he be put to death? What has he done?" Jonathan asked his father.
chapters.nkjv: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, "Why should he be killed? What has he done?"
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അവന്റെ നേരെ കുന്തം ചാടി; അതിനാൽ തന്റെ അപ്പൻ ദാവീദിനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ നിർണ്ണയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യോനാഥാൻ അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Saul hurled his spear at him to kill him. Then Jonathan knew that his father intended to kill David.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul cast a spear at him to kill him, by which Jonathan knew that it was determined by his father to kill David.
chapters.kjv: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ അതികോപത്തോടെ പന്തിഭോജനത്തിൽനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു; അമാവാസ്യയുടെ പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ഭക്ഷണം ഒന്നും കഴിച്ചതുമില്ല; തന്റെ അപ്പൻ ദാവീദിനെ അപമാനിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു അവൻ വ്യസനിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan got up from the table in fierce anger; on that second day of the feast he did not eat, because he was grieved at his father’s shameful treatment of David.
chapters.nkjv: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month, for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.
chapters.kjv: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ രാവിലെ, ദാവീദുമായി നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരുന്ന സമയത്തു, യോനാഥാൻ ഒരു ചെറിയ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടുകൂടെ വയലിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field for his meeting with David. He had a small boy with him,
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad was with him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: ഓടിച്ചെന്നു ഞാൻ എയ്യുന്ന അമ്പു എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുവാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ബാല്യക്കാരൻ ഓടുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ അപ്പുറത്തേക്കു ഒരു അമ്പു എയ്തു.
chapters.niv: and he said to the boy, "Run and find the arrows I shoot." As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to his lad, "Now run, find the arrows which I shoot." As the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ എയ്ത അമ്പു വീണേടത്തു ബാല്യക്കാരൻ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ യോനാഥാൻ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: അമ്പു നിന്റെ അപ്പുറത്തല്ലയോ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the boy came to the place where Jonathan’s arrow had fallen, Jonathan called out after him, "Isn’t the arrow beyond you?"
chapters.nkjv: When the lad had come to the place where the arrow was which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried out after the lad and said, "Is not the arrow beyond you?"
chapters.kjv: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും യോനാഥാൻ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ഓടിവരിക, നിൽക്കരുതു എന്നു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു. യോനാഥാന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരൻ അമ്പുകളെ പെറുക്കി യജമാനന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he shouted, "Hurry! Go quickly! Don’t stop!" The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master.
chapters.nkjv: And Jonathan cried out after the lad, "Make haste, hurry, do not delay!" So Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows and came back to his master.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോനാഥാനും ദാവീദും അല്ലാതെ ബാല്യക്കാരൻ കാര്യം ഒന്നും അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: (The boy knew nothing about all this; only Jonathan and David knew.)
chapters.nkjv: But the lad did not know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew of the matter.
chapters.kjv: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോനാഥാൻ തന്റെ ആയുധങ്ങളെ ബാല്യക്കാരന്റെ പക്കൽ കൊടുത്തു: പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said, "Go, carry them back to town."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to his lad, and said to him, "Go, carry them to the city."
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.

chapters.ml: ബാല്യക്കാരൻ പോയ ഉടനെ ദാവീദ് തെക്കുവശത്തുനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റുവന്നു മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു; അവർ തമ്മിൽ ചുംബനംചെയ്തു കരഞ്ഞു; ദാവീദോ ഉച്ചത്തിൽ കരഞ്ഞുപോയി.
chapters.niv: After the boy had gone, David got up from the south side of the stone and bowed down before Jonathan three times, with his face to the ground. Then they kissed each other and wept together—but David wept the most.
chapters.nkjv: As soon as the lad had gone, David arose from aplace toward the south, fell on his face to the ground, and bowed down three times. And they kissed one another; and they wept together, but David more so.
chapters.kjv: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: യഹോവ എനിക്കും നിനക്കും എന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും നിന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ എന്നേക്കും സാക്ഷി എന്നിങ്ങനെ നാം ഇരുവരും യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ സത്യം ചെയ്തിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പോയി; യോനാഥാനോ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, for we have sworn friendship with each other in the name of the Lord , saying, ‘The Lord is witness between you and me, and between your descendants and my descendants forever.’ " Then David left, and Jonathan went back to the town.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, since we have both sworn in the name of the Lord, saying, ‘May the Lord be between you and me, and between your descendants and my descendants, forever.’ " So he arose and departed, and Jonathan went into the city.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD , saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city. be witness of that which etc

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് നോബിൽ പുരോഹിതനായ അഹീമേലെക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; അഹീമേലെക്ക് ദാവീദിനെ സംഭ്രമത്തോടെ എതിരേറ്റു അവനോടു: ആരും കൂടെ ഇല്ലാതെ തനിച്ചുവരുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David went to Nob, to Ahimelek the priest. Ahimelek trembled when he met him, and asked, "Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?"
chapters.nkjv: Now David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest. And Ahimelech was afraid when he met David, and said to him, "Why are you alone, and no one is with you?"
chapters.kjv: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പുരോഹിതനായ അഹീമേലെക്കിനോടു: രാജാവു എന്നെ ഒരു കാര്യം ഏല്പിച്ചു: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അയക്കുന്നതും നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നതുമായ കാര്യം ഒന്നും ആരും അറിയരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. എന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാർ ഇന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു വരേണമെന്നു ഞാൻ ചട്ടം കെട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: David answered Ahimelek the priest, "The king sent me on a mission and said to me, ‘No one is to know anything about the mission I am sending you on.’ As for my men, I have told them to meet me at a certain place.
chapters.nkjv: So David said to Ahimelech the priest, "The king has ordered me on some business, and said to me, ‘Do not let anyone know anything about the business on which I send you, or what I have commanded you.’ And I have directed my young men to such and such a place.
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിന്റെ കൈവശം വല്ലതും ഉണ്ടോ? ഒരഞ്ചപ്പം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ തൽക്കാലം കൈവശമുള്ളതെന്തെങ്കിലും എനിക്കു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever you can find."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, what have you on hand? Give me five loavesof bread in my hand, or whatever can be found."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പുരോഹിതൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: വിശുദ്ധമായ അപ്പം അല്ലാതെ സാമാന്യമായതു കൈവശം ഇല്ല; ബാല്യക്കാർ സ്ത്രീകളോടു അകന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ തരാമെന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the priest answered David, "I don’t have any ordinary bread on hand; however, there is some consecrated bread here—provided the men have kept themselves from women."
chapters.nkjv: And the priest answered David and said, "Thereis no common bread on hand; but there is holy bread, if the young men have at least kept themselves from women."
chapters.kjv: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പുരോഹിതനോടു: ഈ മൂന്നു ദിവസമായി സ്ത്രീകൾ ഞങ്ങളോടു അകന്നിരിക്കുന്നു. ഇതു ഒരു സാമാന്യയാത്ര എങ്കിലും ഞാൻ പുറപ്പെടുമ്പേൾ തന്നേ ബാല്യക്കാരുടെ യാത്രക്കോപ്പുകൾ ശുദ്ധമായിരുന്നു; ഇന്നോ അവരുടെ കോപ്പുകൾ എത്ര അധികം ശുദ്ധമായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David replied, "Indeed women have been kept from us, as usual whenever I set out. The men’s bodies are holy even on missions that are not holy. How much more so today!"
chapters.nkjv: Then David answered the priest, and said to him, "Truly, women havebeen kept from us about three days since I came out. And the vessels of the young men are holy, and thebreadis in effect common, even though it was consecrated in the vessel this day."
chapters.kjv: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതൻ അവന്നു വിശുദ്ധമായ അപ്പം കൊടുത്തു; അപ്പം മാറ്റുന്ന ദിവസം ചൂടുള്ള അപ്പം വെക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നു നീക്കിയ കാഴ്ചയപ്പം അല്ലാതെ അവിടെ വേറെ അപ്പം ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the priest gave him the consecrated bread, since there was no bread there except the bread of the Presence that had been removed from before the Lord and replaced by hot bread on the day it was taken away.
chapters.nkjv: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the showbread which had been taken from before the Lord, in order to put hot bread initsplace on the day when it was taken away.
chapters.kjv: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the LORD , to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അന്നു ശൌലിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരിൽ ദോവേഗ് എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു എദോമ്യനെ അവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അടെച്ചിട്ടിരുന്നു; അവൻ ശൌലിന്റെ ഇടയന്മാർക്കു പ്രമാണി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained before the Lord ; he was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief shepherd.
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord. And his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chief of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.
chapters.kjv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD ; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അഹീമേലെക്കിനോടു: ഇവിടെ നിന്റെ കൈവശം കുന്തമോ വാളോ ഉണ്ടോ? രാജാവിന്റെ കാര്യം തിടുക്കമായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ എന്റെ വാളും ആയുധങ്ങളും കൊണ്ടുപോന്നില്ല, എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David asked Ahimelek, "Don’t you have a spear or a sword here? I haven’t brought my sword or any other weapon, because the king’s mission was urgent."
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Ahimelech, "Is there not here on hand a spear or a sword? For I have brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste."
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പുരോഹിതൻ: ഏലാ താഴ്വരയിൽവെച്ചു നീ കൊന്ന ഫെലിസ്ത്യനായ ഗൊല്യാത്തിന്റെ വാൾ ഏഫോദിന്റെ പുറകിൽ ഒരു ശീലയിൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞു വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു വേണമെങ്കിൽ എടുത്തുകൊൾക; അതല്ലാതെ വേറെ ഒന്നുമില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു തുല്യം മറ്റൊന്നുമില്ല; അതു എനിക്കു തരേണം എന്നു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The priest replied, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want it, take it; there is no sword here but that one." David said, "There is none like it; give it to me."
chapters.nkjv: So the priest said, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, there it is, wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you will take that, take it. For thereis no other except that one here." And David said, "Thereis none like it; give it to me."
chapters.kjv: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് പുറപ്പെട്ടു അന്നു തന്നേ ശൌലിന്റെ നിമിത്തം ഗത്ത്‌രാജാവായ ആഖീശിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.
chapters.nkjv: Then David arose and fled that day from before Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
chapters.kjv: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആഖീശിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: ഇവൻ ദേശത്തിലെ രാജാവായ ദാവീദ് അല്ലയോ? ശൌൽ ആയിരത്തെ കൊന്നു ദാവീദോ പതിനായിരത്തെ എന്നു അവർ നൃത്തങ്ങളിൽ ഗാനപ്രതിഗാനം ചെയ്തതു ഇവനെക്കുറിച്ചല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the servants of Achish said to him, "Isn’t this David, the king of the land? Isn’t he the one they sing about in their dances: " ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?"
chapters.nkjv: And the servants of Achish said to him, "Is this not David the king of the land? Did they not sing of him to one another in dances, saying: ‘Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands’?"
chapters.kjv: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഈ വാക്കുകളെ മനസ്സിലാക്കീട്ടു ഗത്ത് രാജാവായ ആഖീശിനെ ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish king of Gath.
chapters.nkjv: Now David took these words to heart, and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
chapters.kjv: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ മുമ്പാകെ തന്റെ പ്രകൃതി മാറ്റി, അവരുടെ കൈകളിൽ ഇരിക്കെ ബുദ്ധിഭ്രമം നടിച്ചു വാതിലിന്റെ കതകുകളിൽ വരെച്ചു താടിമേൽ തുപ്പൽ ഒലിപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he pretended to be insane in their presence; and while he was in their hands he acted like a madman, making marks on the doors of the gate and letting saliva run down his beard.
chapters.nkjv: So he changed his behavior before them, pretended madness in their hands, scratched on the doors of the gate, and let his saliva fall down on his beard.
chapters.kjv: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

chapters.ml: ആഖീശ് തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു: ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ ഭ്രാന്തൻ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നില്ലയോ? അവനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: Achish said to his servants, "Look at the man! He is insane! Why bring him to me?
chapters.nkjv: Then Achish said to his servants, "Look, you see the man is insane. Why have you brought him to me?
chapters.kjv: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഭ്രാന്തു കളിപ്പാൻ ഇവനെ കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടതിന്നു എനിക്കു ഇവിടെ ഭ്രാന്തന്മാർ കുറവുണ്ടോ? എന്റെ അരമനയിലോ ഇവൻ വരേണ്ടതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Am I so short of madmen that you have to bring this fellow here to carry on like this in front of me? Must this man come into my house?"
chapters.nkjv: Have I need of madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Shall this fellow come into my house?"
chapters.kjv: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് അവിടം വിട്ടു അദുല്ലാംഗുഹയിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി; അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും അവന്റെ പിതൃഭവനമൊക്കെയും അതു കേട്ടു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: David left Gath and escaped to the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and his father’s household heard about it, they went down to him there.
chapters.nkjv: David therefore departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam. So when his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
chapters.kjv: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it , they went down thither to him.

chapters.ml: ഞെരുക്കമുള്ളവർ, കടമുള്ളവർ, സന്തുഷ്ടിയില്ലാത്തവർ എന്നീവകക്കാർ ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുകൂടി; അവൻ അവർക്കു തലവനായിത്തീർന്നു; അവനോടുകൂടെ ഏകദേശം നാനൂറുപേർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All those who were in distress or in debt or discontented gathered around him, and he became their commander. About four hundred men were with him.
chapters.nkjv: And everyone whowas in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone whowas discontented gathered to him. So he became captain over them. And there were about four hundred men with him.
chapters.kjv: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് അവിടം വിട്ടു മോവാബിലെ മിസ്പയിൽ ചെന്നു, മോവാബ്‌രാജാവിനോടു: ദൈവം എനിക്കു വേണ്ടി എന്തുചെയ്യും എന്നു അറിയുവോളം എന്റെ അപ്പനും അമ്മയും നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു പാർപ്പാൻ അനുവദിക്കേണമേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: From there David went to Mizpah in Moab and said to the king of Moab, "Would you let my father and mother come and stay with you until I learn what God will do for me?"
chapters.nkjv: Then David went from there to Mizpah of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, "Please let my father and mother come here with you, till I know what God will do for me."
chapters.kjv: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ മോവാബ്‌രാജാവിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; ദാവീദ് ദുർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ താമസിച്ച കാലമൊക്കെയും അവർ അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as long as David was in the stronghold.
chapters.nkjv: So he brought them before the king of Moab, and they dwelt with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
chapters.kjv: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഗാദ്പ്രവാചകൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: ദുർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ പാർക്കാതെ യെഹൂദാദേശത്തേക്കു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഹേരെത്ത് കാട്ടിൽവന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not stay in the stronghold. Go into the land of Judah." So David left and went to the forest of Hereth.
chapters.nkjv: Now the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not stay in the stronghold; depart, and go to the land of Judah." So David departed and went into the forest of Hereth.
chapters.kjv: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിനെയും കൂടെയുള്ളവരെയും കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ശൌൽ കേട്ടു; അന്നു ശൌൽ കയ്യിൽ കുന്തവുമായി ഗിബെയയിലെ കുന്നിന്മേലുള്ള പിചുലവൃക്ഷത്തിൻ ചുവട്ടിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും അവന്റെ ചുറ്റും നിന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Saul heard that David and his men had been discovered. And Saul was seated, spear in hand, under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, with all his officials standing at his side.
chapters.nkjv: When Saul heard that David and the men who were with him had been discovered—now Saul was staying in Gibeah under a tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants standing about him—
chapters.kjv: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ചുറ്റും നില്ക്കുന്ന തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ബെന്യാമീന്യരേ, കേട്ടുകൊൾവിൻ; യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കൊക്കെയും നിലങ്ങളും മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളും തന്നു നിങ്ങളെ എല്ലാവരെയും സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരും ശതാധിപന്മാരും ആക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Listen, men of Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give all of you fields and vineyards? Will he make all of you commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?
chapters.nkjv: then Saul said to his servants who stood about him, "Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?
chapters.kjv: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു. എന്റെ മകൻ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകനോടു സഖ്യത ചെയ്തതു എന്നെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ ആരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല. എന്റെ മകൻ എന്റെ ദാസനെ ഇന്നു എനിക്കായി പതിയിരിപ്പാൻ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതിങ്കൽ മനസ്താപമുള്ളവരോ അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു എനിക്കു അറിവു തരുന്നവരോ നിങ്ങളിൽ ആരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Is that why you have all conspired against me? No one tells me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse. None of you is concerned about me or tells me that my son has incited my servant to lie in wait for me, as he does today."
chapters.nkjv: All of you have conspired against me, and thereis no one who reveals to me that my son has made a covenant with the son of Jesse; and thereis not one of you who is sorry for me or reveals to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as itis this day."
chapters.kjv: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്നിരുന്ന എദോമ്യനായ ദോവേഗ്: നോബിൽ അഹീതൂബിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമേലക്കിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ വന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: But Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Saul’s officials, said, "I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelek son of Ahitub at Nob.
chapters.nkjv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who was set over the servants of Saul, and said, "I saw the son of Jesse going to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
chapters.kjv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി യഹോവയോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിച്ചു, അവന്നു ഭക്ഷണസാധനവും ഫെലിസ്ത്യനായ ഗൊല്യാത്തിന്റെ വാളും കൊടുത്തു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Ahimelek inquired of the Lord for him; he also gave him provisions and the sword of Goliath the Philistine."
chapters.nkjv: And he inquired of the Lord for him, gave him provisions, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine."
chapters.kjv: And he enquired of the LORD for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ രാജാവു അഹീതൂബിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമേലെക്ക് പുരോഹിതനെയും അവന്റെ പിതൃഭവനക്കാരായ നോബിലെ സകല പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും വിളിപ്പിച്ചു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the king sent for the priest Ahimelek son of Ahitub and all the men of his family, who were the priests at Nob, and they all came to the king.
chapters.nkjv: So the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob. And they all came to the king.
chapters.kjv: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ: അഹീതൂബിന്റെ മകനേ, കേൾക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. തിരുമേനീ, അടിയൻ എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul said, "Listen now, son of Ahitub." "Yes, my lord," he answered.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said, "Hear now, son of Ahitub!" He answered, "Here I am, my lord."
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am , my lord.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ അവനോടു: യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ ഇന്നു എനിക്കായി പതിയിരിപ്പാൻ തുനിയത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവന്നു അപ്പവും വാളും കൊടുക്കയും അവന്നു വേണ്ടി ദൈവത്തോടു ചോദിക്കയും ചെയ്തതിനാൽ നീയും അവനും എനിക്കു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കിയതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, giving him bread and a sword and inquiring of God for him, so that he has rebelled against me and lies in wait for me, as he does today?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is this day?"
chapters.kjv: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

chapters.ml: അഹീമേലെക്ക് രാജാവിനോടു: തിരുമനസ്സിലെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരിലും വെച്ചു ദാവീദിനോളം വിശ്വസ്തൻ ആരുള്ളു? അവൻ രാജാവിന്റെ മരുമകനും അവിടത്തെ ആലോചനയിൽ ചേരുന്നവനും രാജധാനിയിൽ മാന്യനും ആകുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Ahimelek answered the king, "Who of all your servants is as loyal as David, the king’s son-in-law, captain of your bodyguard and highly respected in your household?
chapters.nkjv: So Ahimelech answered the king and said, "And who among all your servants isas faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, who goes at your bidding, and is honorable in your house?
chapters.kjv: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?

chapters.ml: അവന്നു വേണ്ടി ദൈവത്തോടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോഴോ തുടങ്ങിയതു? അങ്ങനെയല്ല. രാജാവു അടിയന്റെമേലും അടിയന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്മേലും കുറ്റം ഒന്നും ചുമത്തരുതേ; അടിയൻ ഇതിലെങ്ങും യാതൊന്നും അറിഞ്ഞവനല്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him? Of course not! Let not the king accuse your servant or any of his father’s family, for your servant knows nothing at all about this whole affair."
