chapters.nkjv: Did I then begin to inquire of God for him? Far be it from me! Let not the king impute anything to his servant, or to any in the house of my father. For your servant knew nothing of all this, little or much."
chapters.kjv: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു: അഹീമേലെക്കേ, നീ മരിക്കേണം; നീയും നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനമൊക്കെയും തന്നെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the king said, "You will surely die, Ahimelek, you and your whole family."
chapters.nkjv: And the king said, "You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house!"
chapters.kjv: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father’s house.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രാജാവു അരികെ നില്ക്കുന്ന അകമ്പടികളോടു: ചെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ കൊല്ലുവിൻ; അവരും ദാവീദിനോടു ചേർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ ഓടിപ്പോയതു അവർ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടും എന്നെ അയിറിച്ചില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ കൈ നീട്ടുന്നതിന്നു രാജാവിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ തുനിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then the king ordered the guards at his side: "Turn and kill the priests of the Lord , because they too have sided with David. They knew he was fleeing, yet they did not tell me." But the king’s officials were unwilling to raise a hand to strike the priests of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to the guards who stood about him, "Turn and kill the priests of the Lord, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled and did not tell it to me." But the servants of the king would not lift their hands to strike the priests of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the LORD ; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു ദോവേഗിനോടു: നീ ചെന്നു പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ കൊല്ലുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. എദോമ്യനായ ദോവേഗ് ചെന്നു പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ വെട്ടി പഞ്ഞിനൂൽകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഏഫോദ് ധരിച്ച എണ്പത്തഞ്ചുപേരെ അന്നു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king then ordered Doeg, "You turn and strike down the priests." So Doeg the Edomite turned and struck them down. That day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.
chapters.nkjv: And the king said to Doeg, "You turn and kill the priests!" So Doeg the Edomite turned and struck the priests, and killed on that day eighty-five men who wore a linen ephod.
chapters.kjv: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതനഗരമായ നോബിന്റെ പുരുഷന്മാർ, സ്ത്രീകൾ, ബാലന്മാർ, ശിശുക്കൾ, കാള, കഴുത, ആടു എന്നിങ്ങനെ ആസകലം വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ അവൻ സംഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He also put to the sword Nob, the town of the priests, with its men and women, its children and infants, and its cattle, donkeys and sheep.
chapters.nkjv: Also Nob, the city of the priests, he struck with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and nursing infants, oxen and donkeys and sheep—with the edge of the sword.
chapters.kjv: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അഹീതൂബിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമേലെക്കിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ അബ്യാഥാർ എന്നൊരുത്തൻ തെറ്റിയൊഴിഞ്ഞു ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: But one son of Ahimelek son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled to join David.
chapters.nkjv: Now one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
chapters.kjv: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ യഹോവയുടെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ കൊന്ന വിവരം അബ്യാഥാർ ദാവീദിനെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the Lord’s priests.
chapters.kjv: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD’s priests.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അബ്യാഥാരിനോടു: എദോമ്യനായ ദോവേഗ് അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ശൌലിനോടു അറിയിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ അന്നു തന്നേ നിശ്ചയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then David said to Abiathar, "That day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, I knew he would be sure to tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of your whole family.
chapters.nkjv: So David said to Abiathar, "I knew that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I have caused thedeath of all the persons of your father’s house.
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father’s house.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ മരണത്തിന്നു കാരണമായല്ലോ. എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പാർക്ക; ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; എനിക്കു ജീവഹാനി വരുത്തുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നവൻ നിനക്കും ജീവഹാനി വരുത്തുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നു; എങ്കിലും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിനക്കു നിർഭയവാസം ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Stay with me; don’t be afraid. The man who wants to kill you is trying to kill me too. You will be safe with me."
chapters.nkjv: Stay with me; do not fear. For he who seeks my life seeks your life, but with me you shallbe safe."
chapters.kjv: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ കെയീലയുടെ നേരെ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നും അവർ കളങ്ങളിൽ കവർച്ച ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നും ദാവീദിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When David was told, "Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are looting the threshing floors,"
chapters.nkjv: Then they told David, saying, "Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and they are robbing the threshing floors."
chapters.kjv: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യഹോവയോടു; ഞാൻ ഈ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ ചെന്നു തോല്പിക്കേണമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. യഹോവ ദാവീദിനോടു: ചെന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചു കെയീലയെ രക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: he inquired of the Lord , saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" The Lord answered him, "Go, attack the Philistines and save Keilah."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" And the Lord said to David, "Go and attack the Philistines, and save Keilah."
chapters.kjv: Therefore David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the LORD said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ ആളുകൾ അവനോടു: നാം ഇവിടെ യെഹൂദയിൽ തന്നേ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു പാർക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; പിന്നെ കെയീലയിൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ സൈന്യത്തിന്റെ നേരെ എങ്ങനെ ചെല്ലും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But David’s men said to him, "Here in Judah we are afraid. How much more, then, if we go to Keilah against the Philistine forces!"
chapters.nkjv: But David’s men said to him, "Look, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?"
chapters.kjv: And David’s men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് വീണ്ടും യഹോവയോടു ചോദിച്ചു. യഹോവ അവനോടു: എഴുന്നേറ്റു കെയീലയിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുക; ഞാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Once again David inquired of the Lord , and the Lord answered him, "Go down to Keilah, for I am going to give the Philistines into your hand."
chapters.nkjv: Then David inquired of the Lord once again. And the Lord answered him and said, "Arise, go down to Keilah. For I will deliver the Philistines into your hand."
chapters.kjv: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും കെയീലയിലേക്കു പോയി ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു പൊരുതു അവരുടെ ആടുമാടുകളെ അപഹരിച്ചു അവരെ കഠനിമായി തോല്പിച്ചു കെയീലാനിവാസികളെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So David and his men went to Keilah, fought the Philistines and carried off their livestock. He inflicted heavy losses on the Philistines and saved the people of Keilah.
chapters.nkjv: And David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, struck them with a mighty blow, and took away their livestock. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
chapters.kjv: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

chapters.ml: അഹീമേലെക്കിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്യാഥാർ കെയീലയിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിവന്നപ്പോൾ കൈവശം ഏഫോദ് കൂടെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelek had brought the ephod down with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, that he went down with an ephod in his hand.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് കെയീലയിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ശൌലിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി; ദൈവം അവനെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; വാതിലും ഓടാമ്പലും ഉള്ള പട്ടണത്തിൽ കടന്നിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ കുടുങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ശൌൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, and he said, "God has delivered him into my hands, for David has imprisoned himself by entering a town with gates and bars."
chapters.nkjv: And Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah. So Saul said, "God has delivered him into my hand, for he has shut himself in by entering a town that has gates and bars."
chapters.kjv: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനേയും അവന്റെ ആളുകളെയും വളയേണ്ടതിന്നു കെയീലയിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ സകലജനത്തേയും യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: And Saul called up all his forces for battle, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul called all the people together for war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.
chapters.kjv: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ തന്റെ നേരെ ദോഷം ആലോചിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ദാവീദ് അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ പുരോഹിതനായ അബ്യാഥാരിനോടു: ഏഫോദ് ഇവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When David learned that Saul was plotting against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod."
chapters.nkjv: When David knew that Saul plotted evil against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."
chapters.kjv: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ്: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, ശൌൽ കെയീലയിലേക്കു വന്നു എന്റെ നിമിത്തം ഈ പട്ടണം നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു അടിയൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: David said, " Lord , God of Israel, your servant has heard definitely that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town on account of me.
chapters.nkjv: Then David said, "O Lord God of Israel, Your servant has certainly heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.
chapters.kjv: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

chapters.ml: കെയീലപൌരന്മാർ എന്നെ അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുമോ? അടിയൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ശൌൽ വരുമോ? യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, അടിയനെ അറിയിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ വരും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me to him? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Lord , God of Israel, tell your servant." And the Lord said, "He will."
chapters.nkjv: Will the men of Keilah deliver me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as Your servant has heard? O Lord God of Israel, I pray, tell Your servant." And the Lord said, "He will come down."
chapters.kjv: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പിന്നെയും: കെയീലപൌരന്മാർ എന്നെയും എന്റെ ആളുകളെയും ശൌലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അവർ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Again David asked, "Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men to Saul?" And the Lord said, "They will."
chapters.nkjv: Then David said, "Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?" And the Lord said, "They will deliver you."
chapters.kjv: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will deliver thee up.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദും അറുനൂറുപേരോളം ഉള്ള അവന്റെ ആളുകളും കെയീലയെ വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു തരം കണ്ടേടത്തുസഞ്ചരിച്ചു. ദാവീദ് കെയീല വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയി എന്നു ശൌൽ അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവൻ യാത്ര നിർത്തിവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So David and his men, about six hundred in number, left Keilah and kept moving from place to place. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he did not go there.
chapters.nkjv: So David and his men, about six hundred, arose and departed from Keilah and went wherever they could go. Then it was told Saul that David had escaped from Keilah; so he halted the expedition.
chapters.kjv: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് മരുഭൂമിയിലെ ദുർഗ്ഗങ്ങളിൽ താമസിച്ചു. സീഫ് മരുഭൂമയിയിലെ മലനാട്ടിൽ പാർത്തു; ഇക്കാലത്തൊക്കെയും ശൌൽ അവനെ തിരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; എങ്കിലും ദൈവം അവനെ അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hills of the Desert of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God did not give David into his hands.
chapters.nkjv: And David stayed in strongholds in the wilderness, and remained in the mountains in the Wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God did not deliver him into his hand.
chapters.kjv: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ജീവനെ തേടി ശൌൽ പുറപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ദാവീദ് കണ്ടു; അന്നു ദാവീദ് സീഫ് മരുഭൂമിയിലെ ഒരു കാട്ടിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: While David was at Horesh in the Desert of Ziph, he learned that Saul had come out to take his life.
chapters.nkjv: So David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. And David was in the Wilderness of Ziph in a forest.
chapters.kjv: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ആ കാട്ടിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനെ ദൈവത്തിൽ ധൈര്യപ്പെടുത്തി അവനോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ,
chapters.niv: And Saul’s son Jonathan went to David at Horesh and helped him find strength in God.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David in the woods and strengthened his hand in God.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശൌലിന്നു നിന്നെ പിടികിട്ടുകയില്ല; നീ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവാകും; അന്നു ഞാൻ നിനക്കു രണ്ടാമനും ആയിരിക്കും; അതു എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശൌലും അറിയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Don’t be afraid," he said. "My father Saul will not lay a hand on you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be second to you. Even my father Saul knows this."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to him, "Do not fear, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. You shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you. Even my father Saul knows that."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ തമ്മിൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്തു; ദാവീദ് കാട്ടിൽ താമസിക്കയും യോനാഥാൻ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The two of them made a covenant before the Lord . Then Jonathan went home, but David remained at Horesh.
chapters.nkjv: So the two of them made a covenant before the Lord. And David stayed in the woods, and Jonathan went to his own house.
chapters.kjv: And they two made a covenant before the LORD : and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സീഫ്യർ ഗിബെയയിൽ ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: ദാവീദ് ഞങ്ങളുടെ സമീപം മരുഭൂമിക്കു തെക്കുള്ള ഹഖീലാമലയിലെ വനദുർഗ്ഗങ്ങളിൽ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hakilah, south of Jeshimon?
chapters.nkjv: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not hiding with us in strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
chapters.kjv: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ രാജാവേ, തിരുമനസ്സിലെ ആഗ്രഹംപോലെ വന്നുകൊള്ളേണം; അവനെ രാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുതരുന്ന കാര്യം ഞങ്ങൾ ഏറ്റിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now, Your Majesty, come down whenever it pleases you to do so, and we will be responsible for giving him into your hands."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part shallbe to deliver him into the king’s hand."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king’s hand.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശൌൽ പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്നോടു മനസ്സലിവു തോന്നിയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയാൽ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ.
chapters.niv: Saul replied, "The Lord bless you for your concern for me.
chapters.nkjv: And Saul said, "Blessed are you of the Lord, for you have compassion on me.
chapters.kjv: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the LORD ; for ye have compassion on me.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പോയി ഇനിയും സൂക്ഷ്മമായി അന്വേഷിച്ചു അവന്റെ സഞ്ചാരം എവിടെയൊക്കെ ആകുന്നു എന്നും അവിടങ്ങളിൽ അവനെ കണ്ടവർ ആരെല്ലാമെന്നും അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ; അവൻ വലിയ ഉപായി ആകുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Go and get more information. Find out where David usually goes and who has seen him there. They tell me he is very crafty.
chapters.nkjv: Please go and find out for sure, and see the place where his hideout is, and who has seen him there. For I am told he is very crafty.
chapters.kjv: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവൻ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഒളിപ്പിടങ്ങളെല്ലാം കണ്ടറിഞ്ഞുവന്നു സൂക്ഷ്മവിവരം എന്നെ അറിയിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പോരും; അവൻ ദേശത്തു എങ്ങാനും ഉണ്ടെന്നു വരികിൽ ഞാൻ അവനെ യെഹൂദാസഹസ്രങ്ങളിലൊക്കെയും അന്വേഷിച്ചു പിടിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Find out about all the hiding places he uses and come back to me with definite information. Then I will go with you; if he is in the area, I will track him down among all the clans of Judah."
chapters.nkjv: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides; and come back to me with certainty, and I will go with you. And it shall be, if he is in the land, that I will search for him throughout all the clans of Judah."
chapters.kjv: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശൌലിന്നു മുമ്പെ സീഫിലേക്കു പോയി; എന്നാൽ ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും മരുഭൂമിയുടെ തെക്കു അരാബയിലെ മാവോൻ മരുവിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Desert of Maon, in the Arabah south of Jeshimon.
chapters.nkjv: So they arose and went to Ziph before Saul. But David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
chapters.kjv: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

chapters.ml: ശൌലും അവന്റെ പടജ്ജനവും അവനെ തിരയുവാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു. അതു ദാവീദിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ മാവോൻ മരുവിലെ സേലയിൽ ചെന്നു താമസിച്ചു. ശൌൽ അതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ മാവോൻ മരുവിൽ ദാവീദിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Saul and his men began the search, and when David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Desert of Maon. When Saul heard this, he went into the Desert of Maon in pursuit of David.
chapters.nkjv: When Saul and his men went to seek him, they told David. Therefore he went down to the rock, and stayed in the Wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued David in the Wilderness of Maon.
chapters.kjv: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ പർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ ഇപ്പുറത്തും ദാവീദും ആളുകളും പർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ അപ്പുറത്തുംകൂടി നടന്നു; ശൌലിനെ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകുവാൻ ദാവീദ് ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു; ശൌലും പടജ്ജനവും ദാവീദിനെയും അവന്റെ ആളുകളെയും വളഞ്ഞുപിടിപ്പാൻ അടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Saul was going along one side of the mountain, and David and his men were on the other side, hurrying to get away from Saul. As Saul and his forces were closing in on David and his men to capture them,
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men on the other side of the mountain. So David made haste to get away from Saul, for Saul and his men were encircling David and his men to take them.
chapters.kjv: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരു ദൂതൻ വന്നു: ക്ഷണം വരേണം; ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ദേശത്തെ ആക്രമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Come quickly! The Philistines are raiding the land."
chapters.nkjv: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have invaded the land!"
chapters.kjv: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ശൌൽ ദാവീദിനെ പിന്തുടരുന്നതു വിട്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നേരെ പോയി; ആകയാൽ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു സേലഹമ്മാഹ്ളെക്കോത്ത് എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: Then Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why they call this place Sela Hammahlekoth.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines; so they called that place the Rock of Escape.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദോ അവിടം വിട്ടു കയറിപ്പോയി ഏൻ-ഗെദിയിലെ ദുർഗ്ഗങ്ങളിൽ ചെന്നു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
chapters.nkjv: Then David went up from there and dwelt in strongholds at En Gedi.
chapters.kjv: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En-gedi.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ ഓടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞിട്ടു മടങ്ങിവന്നപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് ഏൻ- ഗെദിമരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഉണ്ടെന്നു അവന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: After Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told, "David is in the Desert of En Gedi."
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when Saul had returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, "Take note! David is in the Wilderness of En Gedi."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരുന്ന മൂവായിരംപേരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ദാവീദിനെയും അവന്റെ ആളുകളെയും തിരയുവാൻ കാട്ടാട്ടിൻ പാറകളിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Saul took three thousand able young men from all Israel and set out to look for David and his men near the Crags of the Wild Goats.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the Rocks of the Wild Goats.
chapters.kjv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വഴിയരികെയുള്ള ആട്ടിൻ തൊഴുത്തിങ്കൽ എത്തി; അവിടെ ഒരു ഗുഹ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ശൌൽ കാൽമടക്കത്തിന്നു അതിൽ കടന്നു; എന്നാൽ ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും ഗുഹയുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He came to the sheep pens along the way; a cave was there, and Saul went in to relieve himself. David and his men were far back in the cave.
chapters.nkjv: So he came to the sheepfolds by the road, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to attend to his needs. ( David and his men were staying in the recesses of the cave.)
chapters.kjv: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ ആളുകൾ അവനോടു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ശത്രുവിനെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും; നിനക്കു ബോധിച്ചതുപോലെ അവനോടു ചെയ്യാം എന്നു യഹോവ നിന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത ദിവസം ഇതാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു ശൌലിന്റെ മേലങ്കിയുടെ അറ്റം പതുക്കെ മുറിച്ചെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The men said, "This is the day the Lord spoke of when he said to you, ‘I will give your enemy into your hands for you to deal with as you wish.’ " Then David crept up unnoticed and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of David said to him, "This is the day of which the Lord said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, that you may do to him as it seems good to you.’ " And David arose and secretly cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
chapters.kjv: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ വസ്ത്രാഗ്രം മുറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു പിന്നത്തേതിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ മനസ്സാക്ഷി കുത്തിത്തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Afterward, David was conscience-stricken for having cut off a corner of his robe.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened afterward that David’s heart troubled him because he had cut Saul’s robe.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ആളുകളോടു: യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തനായ എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ നേരെ കയ്യെടുക്കുന്നതായ ഈ കാര്യം ചെയ്‍വാൻ യഹോവ എനിക്കു ഇടവരുത്തരുതേ; അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തനല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to his men, "The Lord forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the Lord ’s anointed, or lay my hand on him; for he is the anointed of the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to his men, "The Lord forbid that I should do this thing to my master, the Lord’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് തന്റെ ആളുകളെ ശാസിച്ചു അമർത്തി; ശൌലിനെ ദ്രോഹിപ്പാൻ അവരെ അനുവദിച്ചതുമില്ല. ശൌൽ ഗുഹയിൽനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു തന്റെ വഴിക്കുപോയി.
chapters.niv: With these words David sharply rebuked his men and did not allow them to attack Saul. And Saul left the cave and went his way.
chapters.nkjv: So David restrained his servants with these words, and did not allow them to rise against Saul. And Saul got up from the cave and went on his way.
chapters.kjv: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദും എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഗുഹയിൽനിന്നു പുറത്തിറങ്ങി ശൌലിനോടു: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ എന്നു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു. ശൌൽ തിരിഞ്ഞുനോക്കിയപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then David went out of the cave and called out to Saul, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: David also arose afterward, went out of the cave, and called out to Saul, saying, "My lord the king!" And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed down.
chapters.kjv: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ശൌലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ദാവീദ് നിനക്കു ദോഷം വിചാരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയുന്നവരുടെ വാക്കു നീ കേൾക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: He said to Saul, "Why do you listen when men say, ‘David is bent on harming you’?
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Saul: "Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Indeed David seeks your harm’?
chapters.kjv: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഇന്നു ഗുഹയിൽവെച്ചു നിന്നെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു എന്നു നിന്റെ കണ്ണാലെ കാണുന്നുവല്ലോ; നിന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ചിലർ പറഞ്ഞെങ്കിലും ഞാൻ ചെയ്തില്ല; എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ നേരെ ഞാൻ കയ്യെടുക്കയില്ല; അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തനല്ലോ എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: This day you have seen with your own eyes how the Lord delivered you into my hands in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you; I said, ‘I will not lay my hand on my lord, because he is the Lord ’s anointed.’
chapters.nkjv: Look, this day your eyes have seen that the Lord delivered you today into my hand in the cave, and someone urged me to kill you. But myeye spared you, and I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is the Lord’s anointed.’
chapters.kjv: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD’s anointed.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിതാവേ, കാൺക, എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്റെ മേലങ്കിയുടെ അറ്റം ഇതാ കാൺക; നിന്റെ മേലങ്കിയുടെ അറ്റം ഞാൻ മുറിക്കയും നിന്നെ കൊല്ലാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്തതിനാൽ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ദോഷവും ദ്രോഹവും ഇല്ല; ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പാപം ചെയ്തിട്ടുമില്ല എന്നു കണ്ടറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾക. നീയോ എനിക്കു പ്രാണഹാനി വരുത്തുവാൻ തേടിനടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: See, my father, look at this piece of your robe in my hand! I cut off the corner of your robe but did not kill you. See that there is nothing in my hand to indicate that I am guilty of wrongdoing or rebellion. I have not wronged you, but you are hunting me down to take my life.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover, my father, see! Yes, see the corner of your robe in my hand! For in that I cut off the corner of your robe, and did not kill you, know and see that thereis neither evil nor rebellion in my hand, and I have not sinned against you. Yet you hunt my life to take it.
chapters.kjv: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ന്യായം വിധിക്കട്ടെ; യഹോവ എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി നിന്നോടു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യട്ടെ; എന്നാൽ എന്റെ കൈ നിന്റെമേൽ വീഴുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: May the Lord judge between you and me. And may the Lord avenge the wrongs you have done to me, but my hand will not touch you.
chapters.nkjv: Let the Lord judge between you and me, and let the Lord avenge me on you. But my hand shall not be against you.
chapters.kjv: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

chapters.ml: ദുഷ്ടത ദുഷ്ടനിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുന്നു എന്നല്ലോ പഴഞ്ചൊൽ പറയുന്നതു; എന്നാൽ എന്റെ കൈ നിന്റെമേൽ വീഴുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: As the old saying goes, ‘From evildoers come evil deeds,’ so my hand will not touch you.
chapters.nkjv: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Wickedness proceeds from the wicked.’ But my hand shall not be against you.
chapters.kjv: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

chapters.ml: ആരെ തേടിയാകുന്നു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു പുറപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നതു? ആരെയാകുന്നു പിന്തുടരുന്നതു? ഒരു ചത്തനായെ, ഒരു ചെള്ളിനെ അല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Who are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?
chapters.nkjv: After whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
chapters.kjv: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവ ന്യായാധിപനായി എനിക്കും നിനക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ ന്യായം വിധിക്കയും എന്റെ കാര്യം നോക്കി വ്യവഹരിച്ചു എന്നെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു വിടുവിക്കയും ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May the Lord be our judge and decide between us. May he consider my cause and uphold it; may he vindicate me by delivering me from your hand."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore let the Lord be judge, and judge between you and me, and see and plead my case, and deliver me out of your hand."
chapters.kjv: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ശൌലിനോടു ഈ വാക്കുകൾ സംസാരിച്ചു തീർന്നശേഷം ശൌൽ: എന്റെ മകനേ, ദാവീദേ, ഇതു നിന്റെ ശബ്ദമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു പൊട്ടിക്കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When David finished saying this, Saul asked, "Is that your voice, David my son?" And he wept aloud.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ദാവീദിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ എന്നെക്കാൾ നീതിമാൻ; ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തിന്മചെയ്തതിന്നു നീ എനിക്കു നന്മ പകരം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "You are more righteous than I," he said. "You have treated me well, but I have treated you badly.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to David: "You are more righteous than I; for you have rewarded me with good, whereas I have rewarded you with evil.
chapters.kjv: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എന്നെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചാറെയും നീ എന്നെ കൊല്ലാതെ വിട്ടതിനാൽ നീ എനിക്കു ഗുണം ചെയ്തതായി ഇന്നു കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You have just now told me about the good you did to me; the Lord delivered me into your hands, but you did not kill me.
chapters.nkjv: And you have shown this day how you have dealt well with me; for when the Lord delivered me into your hand, you did not kill me.
chapters.kjv: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.

chapters.ml: ശത്രുവിനെ കണ്ടുകിട്ടിയാൽ ആരെങ്കിലും അവനെ വെറുതെ വിട്ടയക്കുമോ? നീ ഇന്നു എനിക്കു ചെയ്തതിന്നു യഹോവ നിനക്കു നന്മ പകരം ചെയ്യട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him get away unharmed? May the Lord reward you well for the way you treated me today.
chapters.nkjv: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him get away safely? Therefore may the Lord reward you with good for what you have done to me this day.
chapters.kjv: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the LORD reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ രാജാവാകും; യിസ്രായേൽരാജത്വം നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ സ്ഥിരമാകും എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I know that you will surely be king and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.
chapters.nkjv: And now I know indeed that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ എന്റെ ശേഷം എന്റെ സന്തതിയെ നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കി എന്റെ പേർ എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽ നിന്നു മായിച്ചുകളകയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ ഇപ്പോൾ എന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്യേണം.
chapters.niv: Now swear to me by the Lord that you will not kill off my descendants or wipe out my name from my father’s family."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore swear now to me by the Lord that you will not cut off my descendants after me, and that you will not destroy my name from my father’s house."
chapters.kjv: Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father’s house.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ശൌലിനോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തു; ശൌൽ അരമനയിലേക്കു പോയി; ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും ദുർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കും പോയി.
chapters.niv: So David gave his oath to Saul. Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
chapters.nkjv: So David swore to Saul. And Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
chapters.kjv: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേൽ മരിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേൽ ഒക്കെയും ഒരുമിച്ചുകൂടി അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലപിച്ചു, രാമയിൽ അവന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നരികെ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. ദാവീദ് പുറപ്പെട്ടു പാരാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ പോയി പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Now Samuel died, and all Israel assembled and mourned for him; and they buried him at his home in Ramah. Then David moved down into the Desert of Paran.
chapters.nkjv: Then Samuel died; and the Israelites gathered together and lamented for him, and buried him at his home in Ramah. And David arose and went down to the Wilderness of Paran.
chapters.kjv: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

chapters.ml: കർമ്മേലിൽ വ്യാപാരമുള്ള ഒരു മാവോന്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ മഹാ ധനികനായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു മൂവായിരം ചെമ്മരിയാടും ആയിരം കോലാടും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു കർമ്മേലിൽ ആടുകളെ രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്ന അടിയന്തരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A certain man in Maon, who had property there at Carmel, was very wealthy. He had a thousand goats and three thousand sheep, which he was shearing in Carmel.
chapters.nkjv: Now therewas a man in Maon whose business was in Carmel, and the man was very rich. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. And he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
chapters.kjv: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു നാബാൽ എന്നും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു അബീഗയിൽഎന്നും പേർ. അവൾ നല്ല വിവേകമുള്ളവളും സുന്ദരിയും അവനോ നിഷ്ഠൂരനും ദുഷ്കർമ്മിയും ആയിരുന്നു. അവൻ കാലേബ് വംശക്കാരൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: His name was Nabal and his wife’s name was Abigail. She was an intelligent and beautiful woman, but her husband was surly and mean in his dealings—he was a Calebite.
chapters.nkjv: The name of the man was Nabal, and the name of his wife Abigail. And shewas a woman of good understanding and beautiful appearance; but the man was harsh and evil in his doings. He wasofthehouseof Caleb.
chapters.kjv: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

chapters.ml: നാബാലിന്നു ആടുകളെ രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്ന അടിയന്തരം ഉണ്ടെന്നു ദാവീദ് മരുഭൂമിയിൽ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: While David was in the wilderness, he heard that Nabal was shearing sheep.
chapters.nkjv: When David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep,
chapters.kjv: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പത്തു ബാല്യക്കാരെ അയച്ചു, അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾ കർമ്മേലിൽ നാബാലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു എന്റെ പേരിൽ അവന്നു വന്ദനം ചൊല്ലി:
chapters.niv: So he sent ten young men and said to them, "Go up to Nabal at Carmel and greet him in my name.
chapters.nkjv: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, "Go up to Carmel, go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.
chapters.kjv: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

chapters.ml: നന്നായിരിക്കട്ടെ; നിനക്കും നിന്റെ ഭവനത്തിന്നും നന്നായിരിക്കട്ടെ; നിനക്കുള്ള സകലത്തിന്നും നന്നായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Say to him: ‘Long life to you! Good health to you and your household! And good health to all that is yours!
chapters.nkjv: And thus you shall say to him who lives inprosperity: ‘Peace be to you, peace to your house, and peace to all that you have!
chapters.kjv: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു ആടുകളെ രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്ന അടിയന്തരം ഉണ്ടെന്നു ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു. നിന്റെ ഇടയന്മാർ ഞങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ ഇരുന്നപ്പോൾ ഞങ്ങൾ അവരെ ഉപദ്രവിച്ചില്ല; അവർ കർമ്മേലിൽ ഇരുന്ന കാലത്തൊക്കെയും അവർക്കു ഒന്നും കാണാതെ പോയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: " ‘Now I hear that it is sheep-shearing time. When your shepherds were with us, we did not mistreat them, and the whole time they were at Carmel nothing of theirs was missing.
chapters.nkjv: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds were with us, and we did not hurt them, nor was there anything missing from them all the while they were in Carmel.
chapters.kjv: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരോടു ചോദിച്ചാൽ അവരും നിന്നോടു പറയും; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഈ ബാല്യക്കാരോടു ദയതോന്നേണം; നല്ല നാളിലല്ലോ ഞങ്ങൾ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു; നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ വരുന്നതു അടിയങ്ങൾക്കും നിന്റെ മകനായ ദാവീദിന്നും തരേണമേ എന്നു അവനോടു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Ask your own servants and they will tell you. Therefore be favorable toward my men, since we come at a festive time. Please give your servants and your son David whatever you can find for them.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let my young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a feast day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’ "
chapters.kjv: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാർ ചെന്നു നാബാലിനോടു ഈ വാക്കുകളെല്ലാം ദാവീദിന്റെ പേരിൽ അറിയിച്ചു കാത്തുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: When David’s men arrived, they gave Nabal this message in David’s name. Then they waited.
chapters.nkjv: So when David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal according to all these words in the name of David, and waited.
chapters.kjv: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

chapters.ml: നാബാൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു: ദാവീദ് ആർ? യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ ആർ? യജമാനന്മാരെ വിട്ടു പൊയ്ക്കളയുന്ന ദാസന്മാർ ഇക്കാലത്തു വളരെ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Nabal answered David’s servants, "Who is this David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants are breaking away from their masters these days.
chapters.nkjv: Then Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, "Who is David, and who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants nowadays who break away each one from his master.
chapters.kjv: And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ അപ്പവും വെള്ളവും എന്റെ ആടുകളെ രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്നവർക്കായി ഒരുക്കിയ മാംസവും എടുത്തു എവിടുത്തുകാർ എന്നു അറിയാത്തവർക്കു കൊടുക്കുമോ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Why should I take my bread and water, and the meat I have slaughtered for my shearers, and give it to men coming from who knows where?"
chapters.nkjv: Shall I then take my bread and my water and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men when I do not know where they are from?"
chapters.kjv: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be ?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാർ മടങ്ങിവന്നു വിവരമൊക്കെയും അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David’s men turned around and went back. When they arrived, they reported every word.
chapters.nkjv: So David’s young men turned on their heels and went back; and they came and told him all these words.
chapters.kjv: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് തന്റെ ആളുകളോടു: എല്ലാവരും വാൾ അരെക്കു കെട്ടിക്കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ എല്ലാവരും വാൾ അരെക്കു കെട്ടി; ദാവീദും വാൾ അരെക്കു കെട്ടി; ഏകദേശം നാനൂറുപേർ ദാവീദിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി; ഇരുനൂറുപേർ സാമാനങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: David said to his men, "Each of you strap on your sword!" So they did, and David strapped his on as well. About four hundred men went up with David, while two hundred stayed with the supplies.
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to his men, "Every man gird on his sword." So every man girded on his sword, and David also girded on his sword. And about four hundred men went with David, and two hundred stayed with the supplies.
chapters.kjv: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ബാല്യക്കാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ നാബാലിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ അബീഗയിലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ദാവീദ് നമ്മുടെ യജമാനന്നു വന്ദനം ചൊല്ലുവാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; അവനോ അവരെ ശകാരിച്ചു അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One of the servants told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, "David sent messengers from the wilderness to give our master his greetings, but he hurled insults at them.
chapters.nkjv: Now one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, "Look, David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master; and he reviled them.
chapters.kjv: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഏറ്റവും ഉപകാരമുള്ളവരായിരുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ വയലിൽ അവരുമായി സഹവാസം ചെയ്തിരുന്ന കാലത്തൊരിക്കലും അവർ ഞങ്ങളെ ഉപദ്രവിച്ചില്ല; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഒന്നും കാണാതെ പോയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet these men were very good to us. They did not mistreat us, and the whole time we were out in the fields near them nothing was missing.
chapters.nkjv: But the men were very good to us, and we were not hurt, nor did we miss anything as long as we accompanied them, when we were in the fields.
chapters.kjv: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ആടുകളെ മേയിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അവരോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നപ്പോഴൊക്കെയും രാവും പകലും അവർ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു മതിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Night and day they were a wall around us the whole time we were herding our sheep near them.
chapters.nkjv: They were a wall to us both by night and day, all the time we were with them keeping the sheep.
chapters.kjv: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നു ആലോചിച്ചുനോക്കേണം; നമ്മുടെ യജമാനന്നും അവന്റെ സകലഭവനത്തിന്നും ദോഷം നിർണ്ണയിച്ചുപോയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവനോ ദുസ്സ്വഭാവിയാകകൊണ്ടു അവനോടു ആർക്കും ഒന്നും മിണ്ടിക്കൂടാ.
chapters.niv: Now think it over and see what you can do, because disaster is hanging over our master and his whole household. He is such a wicked man that no one can talk to him."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, know and consider what you will do, for harm is determined against our master and against all his household. For he issuch a scoundrel that one cannot speak to him."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അബീഗയിൽ ഇരുനൂറു അപ്പവും രണ്ടു തുരുത്തി വീഞ്ഞും പാകം ചെയ്ത അഞ്ചു ആടും അഞ്ചു പറ മലരും നൂറു ഉണക്ക മുന്തിരിക്കുലയും ഇരുനൂറു അത്തിയടയും എടുത്തു കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി ബാല്യക്കാരോടു;
chapters.niv: Abigail acted quickly. She took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred cakes of raisins and two hundred cakes of pressed figs, and loaded them on donkeys.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abigail made haste and took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five sheep already dressed, five seahs of roasted grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and loaded them on donkeys.
chapters.kjv: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എനിക്കു മുമ്പായി പോകുവിൻ; ഞാൻ ഇതാ, പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. തന്റെ ഭർത്താവായ നാബാലിനോടു അവൾ ഒന്നും അറിയിച്ചില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Then she told her servants, "Go on ahead; I’ll follow you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
chapters.nkjv: And she said to her servants, "Go on before me; see, I am coming after you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
chapters.kjv: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

chapters.ml: അവൾ കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറി മലയുടെ മറവിൽകൂടി ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ ഇതാ, ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും അവളുടെ നേരെ വരുന്നു; അവൾ അവരെ എതിരേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: As she came riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, there were David and his men descending toward her, and she met them.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, as she rode on the donkey, that she went down under cover of the hill; and there were David and his men, coming down toward her, and she met them.
chapters.kjv: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ്: മരുഭൂമിയിൽ അവന്നു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ വെറുതെയല്ലോ കാത്തതു; അവന്റെ വക ഒന്നും കാണാതെ പോയതുമില്ല; അവനോ നന്മെക്കു പകരം എനിക്കു തിന്മചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: David had just said, "It’s been useless—all my watching over this fellow’s property in the wilderness so that nothing of his was missing. He has paid me back evil for good.
chapters.nkjv: Now David had said, "Surely in vain I have protected all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that belongs to him. And he has repaid me evil for good.
chapters.kjv: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.

chapters.ml: അവന്നുള്ള സകലത്തിലും പുരുഷപ്രജയായ ഒന്നിനെയെങ്കിലും പുലരുംവരെ ഞാൻ ജീവനോടെ വെച്ചേച്ചാൽ ദൈവം ദാവീദിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾക്കു തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: May God deal with David, be it ever so severely, if by morning I leave alive one male of all who belong to him!"
chapters.nkjv: May God do so, and more also, to the enemies of David, if I leave one male of all who belong to him by morning light."
chapters.kjv: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

chapters.ml: അബീഗയിൽ ദാവീദിനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ കഴുതപ്പുറത്തുനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി ദാവീദിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and bowed down before David with her face to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Abigail saw David, she dismounted quickly from the donkey, fell on her face before David, and bowed down to the ground.
chapters.kjv: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു പറഞ്ഞതു: യജമാനനേ, കുറ്റം എന്റെമേൽ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; അടിയൻ ഒന്നു ബോധിപ്പിച്ചുകൊള്ളട്ടെ; അടിയന്റെ വാക്കുകളെ കേൾക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: She fell at his feet and said: "Pardon your servant, my lord, and let me speak to you; hear what your servant has to say.
chapters.nkjv: So she fell at his feet and said: "On me, my lord, on me let this iniquity be! And please let your maidservant speak in your ears, and hear the words of your maidservant.
chapters.kjv: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.

chapters.ml: ദുസ്സ്വഭാവിയായ ഈ നാബാലിനെ യജമാനൻ ഗണ്യമാക്കരുതേ; അവൻ തന്റെ പേർപോലെ തന്നെ ആകുന്നു; നാബാൽ എന്നല്ലോ അവന്റെ പേർ; ഭോഷത്വം അത്രേ അവന്റെ പക്കൽ ഉള്ളതു. അടിയനോ, യജമാനൻ അയച്ച ബാല്യക്കാരെ കണ്ടിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Please pay no attention, my lord, to that wicked man Nabal. He is just like his name—his name means Fool, and folly goes with him. And as for me, your servant, I did not see the men my lord sent.
chapters.nkjv: Please, let not my lord regard this scoundrel Nabal. For as his name is, so is he: Nabal is his name, and folly is with him! But I, your maidservant, did not see the young men of my lord whom you sent.
chapters.kjv: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is , so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യജമാനനേ, യഹോവയാണ, നിന്നാണ, രക്തപാതകവും സ്വന്തകയ്യാൽ പ്രതികാരവും ചെയ്യാതവണ്ണം യഹോവ നിന്നെ തടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളും യജമാനന്നു ദോഷം വിചാരിക്കുന്നവരും നാബാലിനെപ്പോലെ ആകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: And now, my lord, as surely as the Lord your God lives and as you live, since the Lord has kept you from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hands, may your enemies and all who are intent on harming my lord be like Nabal.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, my lord, as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, since the Lord has held you back from coming to bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now then, let your enemies and those who seek harm for my lord be as Nabal.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ യജമാനന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അടിയൻ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ കാഴ്ച യജമാനന്റെ പരിചാരകരായ ബാല്യക്കാർക്കു ഇരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: And let this gift, which your servant has brought to my lord, be given to the men who follow you.
chapters.nkjv: And now this present which your maidservant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.
chapters.kjv: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

chapters.ml: അടിയന്റെ കുറ്റം ക്ഷമിക്കേണമേ, യഹോവ യജമാനന്നു സ്ഥിരമായോരു ഭവനം പണിയും; യഹോവയുടെ യുദ്ധങ്ങളെയല്ലോ യജമാനൻ നടത്തുന്നതു. ആയുഷ്കാലത്തൊരിക്കലും നിന്നിൽ ദോഷം കാണുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Please forgive your servant’s presumption. The Lord your God will certainly make a lasting dynasty for my lord, because you fight the Lord ’s battles, and no wrongdoing will be found in you as long as you live.
chapters.nkjv: Please forgive the trespass of your maidservant. For the Lord will certainly make for my lord an enduring house, because my lord fights the battles of the Lord, and evil is not found in you throughout your days.
chapters.kjv: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ നിന്നെ പിന്തുർന്നു നിനക്കു ജീവഹാനി വരുത്തുവാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റാലും യജമാനന്റെ പ്രാണൻ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ പക്കൽ ജീവഭാണ്ഡത്തിൽ കെട്ടപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കും; നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ പ്രാണങ്ങളെയോ അവൻ കവിണയുടെ തടത്തിൽനിന്നു എന്നപോലെ എറിഞ്ഞുകളയും.
chapters.niv: Even though someone is pursuing you to take your life, the life of my lord will be bound securely in the bundle of the living by the Lord your God, but the lives of your enemies he will hurl away as from the pocket of a sling.
chapters.nkjv: Yet a man has risen to pursue you and seek your life, but the life of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of the living with the Lord your God; and the lives of your enemies He shall sling out, asfrom the pocket of a sling.
chapters.kjv: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ യജമാനന്നു വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാ നന്മയും നിവൃത്തിച്ചുതന്നു നിന്നെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു പ്രഭുവാക്കിവെക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: When the Lord has fulfilled for my lord every good thing he promised concerning him and has appointed him ruler over Israel,
chapters.nkjv: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord has done for my lord according to all the good that He has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you ruler over Israel,
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;

chapters.ml: അകാരണമായി രക്തം ചിന്നുകയും യജമാനൻ താൻ തന്നേ പ്രതികാരം നടത്തുകയും ചെയ്തുപോയി എന്നുള്ള ചഞ്ചലവും മനോവ്യഥയും യജമാനന്നു ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല; എന്നാൽ യഹോവ യജമാനന്നു നന്മ ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ അടിയനെയും ഓർത്തുകൊള്ളേണമേ.
chapters.niv: my lord will not have on his conscience the staggering burden of needless bloodshed or of having avenged himself. And when the Lord your God has brought my lord success, remember your servant."
chapters.nkjv: that this will be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. But when the Lord has dealt well with my lord, then remember your maidservant."
chapters.kjv: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അബീഗയിലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്നെ എതിരേല്പാൻ നിന്നെ ഇന്നു അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം.
chapters.niv: David said to Abigail, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has sent you today to meet me.
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to Abigail: "Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me!
chapters.kjv: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വിവേകം സ്തുത്യം; രക്തപാതകവും സ്വന്തകയ്യാൽ പ്രതികാരവും ചെയ്യാതവണ്ണം എന്നെ ഇന്നു തടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന നീയും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൾ.
chapters.niv: May you be blessed for your good judgment and for keeping me from bloodshed this day and from avenging myself with my own hands.
chapters.nkjv: And blessed is your advice and blessed are you, because you have kept me this day from coming to bloodshed and from avenging myself with my own hand.
chapters.kjv: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

chapters.ml: നിന്നോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്യാതവണ്ണം എന്നെ തടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയാണ, നീ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു എന്നെ എതിരേറ്റു വന്നിരുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ നേരം പുലരുമ്പോഴേക്കു പുരുഷപ്രജയൊന്നും നാബാലിന്നു ശേഷിക്കയില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Otherwise, as surely as the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, who has kept me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, not one male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by daybreak."
chapters.nkjv: For indeed, as the Lord God of Israel lives, who has kept me back from hurting you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely by morning light no males would have been left to Nabal!"
chapters.kjv: For in very deed, as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൾ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു ദാവീദ് അവളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വാങ്ങി അവളോടു: സമാധാനത്തോടെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോക; ഇതാ, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടു നിന്റെ മുഖം ആദരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then David accepted from her hand what she had brought him and said, "Go home in peace. I have heard your words and granted your request."
chapters.nkjv: So David received from her hand what she had brought him, and said to her, "Go up in peace to your house. See, I have heeded your voice and respected your person."
chapters.kjv: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.

chapters.ml: അബീഗയിൽ നാബാലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ രാജവിരുന്നുപോലെ ഒരു വിരുന്നു കഴിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; നാബാലിന്റെ ഹൃദയം ആനന്ദത്തിലായി അവന്നു നന്നാ ലഹരിപിടിച്ചിരുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൾ നേരം വെളുക്കുംവരെ വിവരം ഒന്നും അവനെ അറിയിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: When Abigail went to Nabal, he was in the house holding a banquet like that of a king. He was in high spirits and very drunk. So she told him nothing at all until daybreak.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abigail went to Nabal, and there he was, holding a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. And Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk; therefore she told him nothing, little or much, until morning light.
chapters.kjv: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാവിലെ നാബാലിന്റെ വീഞ്ഞു ഇറങ്ങിയശേഷം അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ അവനോടു വിവരം അറിയിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ഹൃദയം അവന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ നിർജ്ജീവമായി അവൻ കല്ലിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Then in the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him all these things, and his heart failed him and he became like a stone.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, in the morning, when the wine had gone from Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became like a stone.
chapters.kjv: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

chapters.ml: പത്തുദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം യഹോവ നാബാലിനെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചു, അവൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: About ten days later, the Lord struck Nabal and he died.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, after about ten days, that the Lord struck Nabal, and he died.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.

chapters.ml: നാബാൽ മരിച്ചു എന്നു ദാവീദ് കേട്ടപ്പോൾ: എന്നെ നിന്ദിച്ച നിന്ദെക്കായിട്ടു നാബാലിനോടു വ്യവഹരിക്കയും തന്റെ ദാസനെ തിന്മചെയ്യാതവണ്ണം തടുക്കയും ചെയ്ത യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം. നാബാലിന്റെ ദുഷ്ടത യഹോവ അവന്റെ തലയിൽ തന്നേ വരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് അബീഗയിലിനെ തനിക്കു ഭാര്യയായിപരിഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവളോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ ആളയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Praise be to the Lord , who has upheld my cause against Nabal for treating me with contempt. He has kept his servant from doing wrong and has brought Nabal’s wrongdoing down on his own head." Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.
chapters.nkjv: So when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Blessed be the Lord, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept His servant from evil! For the Lord has returned the wickedness of Nabal on his own head." And David sent and proposed to Abigail, to take her as his wife.
chapters.kjv: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD , that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ കർമ്മേലിൽ അബീഗയിലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവളോടു: നീ ദാവീദിന്നു ഭാര്യയായ്തീരുവാൻ നിന്നെ കൊണ്ടുചെല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ അവൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His servants went to Carmel and said to Abigail, "David has sent us to you to take you to become his wife."
chapters.nkjv: When the servants of David had come to Abigail at Carmel, they spoke to her saying, "David sent us to you, to ask you to become his wife."
chapters.kjv: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.

chapters.ml: അവൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിലംവരെ തല കുനിച്ചു: ഇതാ, അടിയൻ യജമാനന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ കാലുകളെ കഴുകുന്ന ദാസി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She bowed down with her face to the ground and said, "I am your servant and am ready to serve you and wash the feet of my lord’s servants."
chapters.nkjv: Then she arose, bowed her face to the earth, and said, "Here is your maidservant, a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord."
chapters.kjv: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അബീഗയിൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു തന്റെ പരിചാരകികളായ അഞ്ചു ബാല്യക്കാരത്തികളുമായി കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറി ദാവീദിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ചെന്നു അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abigail quickly got on a donkey and, attended by her five female servants, went with David’s messengers and became his wife.
chapters.nkjv: So Abigail rose in haste and rode on a donkey, attended by five of her maidens; and she followed the messengers of David, and became his wife.
chapters.kjv: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു ദാവീദ് അഹീനോവമിനെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവർ ഇരുവരും അവന്നു ഭാര്യമാരായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both were his wives.
chapters.nkjv: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel, and so both of them were his wives.
chapters.kjv: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

chapters.ml: ശൌലോ തന്റെ മകളും ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭാര്യയുമായിരുന്ന മീഖളിനെ ഗല്ലീമ്യനായ ലയീശിന്റെ മകൻ ഫല്തിക്കു കൊടുത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Paltiel son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
chapters.nkjv: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
chapters.kjv: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സീഫ്യർ ഗിബെയയിൽ ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; ദാവീദ് മരുഭൂമിക്കു തെക്കുള്ള ഹഖീലാക്കുന്നിൽ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Is not David hiding on the hill of Hakilah, which faces Jeshimon?"
chapters.nkjv: Now the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not hiding in the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon?"
chapters.kjv: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ദാവീദിനെ തിരയുവാൻ സീഫ് മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു ചെന്നു; യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരുന്ന മൂവായിരംപേരും അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Saul went down to the Desert of Ziph, with his three thousand select Israelite troops, to search there for David.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul arose and went down to the Wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the Wilderness of Ziph.
chapters.kjv: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ മരുഭൂമിക്കു തെക്കുള്ള ഹഖീലാക്കുന്നിൽ പെരുവഴിക്കരികെ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി. ദാവീദോ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ പാർത്തു, ശൌൽ തന്നേ തേടി മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Saul made his camp beside the road on the hill of Hakilah facing Jeshimon, but David stayed in the wilderness. When he saw that Saul had followed him there,
chapters.nkjv: And Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is opposite Jeshimon, by the road. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ദാവീദ് ചാരന്മാരെ അയച്ചു ശൌൽ ഇന്നേടത്തു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he sent out scouts and learned that Saul had definitely arrived.
chapters.nkjv: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had indeed come.
chapters.kjv: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു ശൌൽ പാളയം ഇറങ്ങിയിരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു ചെന്നു; ശൌലും അവന്റെ സേനാപതിയായ നേരിന്റെ മകൻ അബ്നേരും കിടക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലം ദാവീദ് കണ്ടു; ശൌൽ കൈനിലയുടെ നടുവിൽ കിടന്നുറങ്ങി; പടജ്ജനം അവന്റെ ചുറ്റും പാളയമിറങ്ങിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then David set out and went to the place where Saul had camped. He saw where Saul and Abner son of Ner, the commander of the army, had lain down. Saul was lying inside the camp, with the army encamped around him.
chapters.nkjv: So David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped. And David saw the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the commander of his army. Now Saul lay within the camp, with the people encamped all around him.
chapters.kjv: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഹിത്യനായ അഹീമേലെക്കിനോടും സെരൂയയുടെ മകനും യോവാബിന്റെ സഹോദരനുമായ അബീശായിയോടും: പാളയത്തിൽ ശൌലിന്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കു ആർ എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കൂടെ പോരും എന്നു അബീശായി പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David then asked Ahimelek the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, "Who will go down into the camp with me to Saul?" "I’ll go with you," said Abishai.
chapters.nkjv: Then David answered, and said to Ahimelech the Hittite and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, "Who will go down with me to Saul in the camp?" And Abishai said, "I will go down with you."
chapters.kjv: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദും അബീശായിയും രാത്രിയിൽ പടജ്ജനത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; ശൌൽ കൈനിലെക്കകത്തു കിടന്നുറങ്ങുകയായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ കുന്തം അവന്റെ തലെക്കൽ നിലത്തു തറെച്ചിരുന്നു; അബ്നേരും പടജ്ജനവും അവന്നു ചുറ്റും കിടന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David and Abishai went to the army by night, and there was Saul, lying asleep inside the camp with his spear stuck in the ground near his head. Abner and the soldiers were lying around him.
chapters.nkjv: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and there Saul lay sleeping within the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. And Abner and the people lay all around him.
chapters.kjv: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

chapters.ml: അബീശായി ദാവീദിനോടു: ദൈവം നിന്റെ ശത്രുവിനെ ഇന്നു നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ അവനെ കുന്തംകൊണ്ടു നിലത്തോടു ചേർത്തു ഒരു കുത്തായിട്ടു കുത്തട്ടെ; രണ്ടാമതു കുത്തുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Abishai said to David, "Today God has delivered your enemy into your hands. Now let me pin him to the ground with one thrust of the spear; I won’t strike him twice."
chapters.nkjv: Then Abishai said to David, "God has delivered your enemy into your hand this day. Now therefore, please, let me strike him at once with the spear, right to the earth; and I will not havetostrike him a second time!"
chapters.kjv: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അബീശായിയോടു: അവനെ നശിപ്പിക്കരുതു; യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തന്റെ മേൽ കൈ വെച്ചിട്ടു ആർ ശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കാതെപോകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But David said to Abishai, "Don’t destroy him! Who can lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed and be guiltless?
chapters.nkjv: But David said to Abishai, "Do not destroy him; for who can stretch out his hand against the Lord’s anointed, and be guiltless?"
chapters.kjv: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD’s anointed, and be guiltless?

chapters.ml: യഹോവയാണ, യഹോവ അവനെ സംഹരിക്കും; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അവൻ മരിപ്പാനുള്ള ദിവസം വരും; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അവൻ പടെക്കു ചെന്നു നശിക്കും;
chapters.niv: As surely as the Lord lives," he said, "the Lord himself will strike him, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.
chapters.nkjv: David said furthermore, "As the Lord lives, the Lord shall strike him, or his day shall come to die, or he shall go out to battle and perish.
chapters.kjv: David said furthermore, As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തന്റെമേൽ കൈ വെപ്പാൻ യഹോവ സംഗതിവരുത്തരുതേ; എങ്കിലും അവന്റെ തലെക്കൽ ഉള്ള കുന്തവും ജലപാത്രവും എടുത്തുകൊൾക; നമുക്കു പോകാം എന്നു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord forbid that I should lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed. Now get the spear and water jug that are near his head, and let’s go."
chapters.nkjv: The Lord forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the Lord’s anointed. But please, take now the spear and the jug of water that are by his head, and let us go."
chapters.kjv: The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’s anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് കുന്തവും ജലപാത്രവും ശൌലിന്റെ തലെക്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു അവർ പോകയും ചെയ്തു; ആരും കണ്ടില്ല, ആരും അറിഞ്ഞില്ല, ആരും ഉണർന്നതുമില്ല; അവർ എല്ലാവരും ഉറങ്ങുകയായിരുന്നു; യഹോവയാൽ ഗാഢനിദ്ര അവരുടെമേൽ വീണിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David took the spear and water jug near Saul’s head, and they left. No one saw or knew about it, nor did anyone wake up. They were all sleeping, because the Lord had put them into a deep sleep.
chapters.nkjv: So David took the spear and the jug of water by Saul’s head, and they got away; and no man saw or knew it or awoke. For they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from the Lord had fallen on them.
chapters.kjv: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അപ്പുറം കടന്നുചെന്നു ദൂരത്തു ഒരു മലമുകളിൽ നിന്നു; അവർക്കു മദ്ധ്യേ മതിയായ അകലമുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of the hill some distance away; there was a wide space between them.
chapters.nkjv: Now David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of a hill afar off, a great distance being between them.
chapters.kjv: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ജനത്തോടും നേരിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്നേരിനോടും: അബ്നേരേ, നീ ഉത്തരം പറയുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അബ്നേർ: രാജസന്നിധിയിൽ ക്കുകുന്ന നീ ആർ എന്നു അങ്ങോട്ടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He called out to the army and to Abner son of Ner, "Aren’t you going to answer me, Abner?" Abner replied, "Who are you who calls to the king?"
chapters.nkjv: And David called out to the people and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, "Do you not answer, Abner?" Then Abner answered and said, "Who are you, calling out to the king?"
chapters.kjv: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അബ്നേരിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ ഒരു പുരുഷൻ അല്ലയോ? യിസ്രായേലിൽ നിനക്കു തുല്യൻ ആരുള്ളു? അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ നിന്റെ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനെ നീ കാത്തുകൊള്ളാതിരുന്നതു എന്തു? നിന്റെ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ജനത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ അവിടെ വന്നിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: David said, "You’re a man, aren’t you? And who is like you in Israel? Why didn’t you guard your lord the king? Someone came to destroy your lord the king.
chapters.nkjv: So David said to Abner, "Are you not a man? And who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not guarded your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.
chapters.kjv: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.

chapters.ml: നീ ചെയ്ത കാര്യം നന്നായില്ല; യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തനായ നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനനെ കാത്തുകൊള്ളാതിരിക്കയാൽ യഹോവയാണ നിങ്ങൾ മരണയോഗ്യർ ആകുന്നു. രാജാവിന്റെ കുന്തവും അവന്റെ തലെക്കൽ ഇരുന്ന ജലപാത്രവും എവിടെ എന്നു നോക്കുക.
chapters.niv: What you have done is not good. As surely as the Lord lives, you and your men must die, because you did not guard your master, the Lord ’s anointed. Look around you. Where are the king’s spear and water jug that were near his head?"
chapters.nkjv: This thing that you have done is not good. As the Lord lives, you deserve to die, because you have not guarded your master, the Lord’s anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is, and the jug of water that was by his head."
chapters.kjv: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the LORD liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the LORD’s anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is , and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ ശബ്ദം തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞു: എന്റെ മകനെ, ദാവീദേ, ഇതു നിന്റെ ശബ്ദമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ദാവീദ് എന്റെ ശബ്ദം തന്നേ, യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
