chapters.kjv: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലേ, നിന്റെ പ്രതാപമായവർ നിന്റെ ഗിരികളിൽ നിഹതന്മാരായി; വീരന്മാർ പട്ടുപോയതു എങ്ങനെ!
chapters.niv: "A gazelle lies slain on your heights, Israel. How the mighty have fallen!
chapters.nkjv: "The beauty of Israel is slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
chapters.kjv: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

chapters.ml: ഗത്തിൽ അതു പ്രസിദ്ധമാക്കരുതേ; അസ്കലോൻ വീഥികളിൽ ഘോഷിക്കരുതേ; ഫെലിസ്ത്യപുത്രിമാർ സന്തോഷിക്കരുതേ; അഗ്രചർമ്മികളുടെ കന്യകമാർ ഉല്ലസിക്കരുതേ.
chapters.niv: "Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines be glad, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised rejoice.
chapters.nkjv: Tell it not in Gath, Proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon— Lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, Lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
chapters.kjv: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

chapters.ml: ഗിൽബോവപർവ്വതങ്ങളേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ മഞ്ഞോ മഴയോ പെയ്യാതെയും വഴിപാടുനിലങ്ങൾ ഇല്ലാതെയും പോകട്ടെ. അവിടെയല്ലോ വീരന്മാരുടെ പരിച എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞതു; ശൌലിന്റെ തൈലാഭിഷേകമില്ലാത്ത പരിച തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "Mountains of Gilboa, may you have neither dew nor rain, may no showers fall on your terraced fields. For there the shield of the mighty was despised, the shield of Saul—no longer rubbed with oil.
chapters.nkjv: "O mountains of Gilboa, Lettherebe no dew nor rain upon you, Nor fields of offerings. For the shield of the mighty is cast away there! The shield of Saul, not anointed with oil.
chapters.kjv: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

chapters.ml: നിഹതന്മാരുടെ രക്തവും വീരന്മാരുടെ മേദസ്സും വിട്ടു യോനാഥാന്റെ വില്ലു പിന്തിരിഞ്ഞില്ല; ശൌലിന്റെ വാൾ വൃഥാ പോന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "From the blood of the slain, from the flesh of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, the sword of Saul did not return unsatisfied.
chapters.nkjv: From the blood of the slain, From the fat of the mighty, The bow of Jonathan did not turn back, And the sword of Saul did not return empty.
chapters.kjv: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

chapters.ml: ശൌലും യോനാഥാനും ജീവകാലത്തു പ്രീതിയും വാത്സല്യവും പൂണ്ടിരുന്നു; മരണത്തിലും അവർ വേർപിരിഞ്ഞില്ല. അവർ കഴുകനിലും വേഗവാന്മാർ. സിംഹത്തിലും വീര്യവാന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Saul and Jonathan— in life they were loved and admired, and in death they were not parted. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
chapters.nkjv: "Saul and Jonathan were beloved and pleasant in their lives, And in their death they were not divided; They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than lions.
chapters.kjv: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽപുത്രിമാരേ, ശൌലിനെച്ചൊല്ലി കരവിൻ അവൻ നിങ്ങളെ ഭംഗിയായി രക്താംബരം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രത്തിന്മേൽ പൊന്നാഭരണം അണിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and finery, who adorned your garments with ornaments of gold.
chapters.nkjv: "O daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, Who clothed you in scarlet, with luxury; Who put ornaments of gold on your apparel.
chapters.kjv: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധമദ്ധ്യേ വീരന്മാർ പട്ടുപോയതെങ്ങിനെ! നിന്റെ ഗിരികളിൽ യോനാഥാൻ നിഹതനായല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
chapters.nkjv: "How the mighty have fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan was slain in your high places.
chapters.kjv: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാനേ, എന്റെ സഹോദരാ, നിന്നെച്ചൊല്ലി ഞാൻ ദുഃഖിക്കുന്നു; നീ എനിക്കു അതിവത്സലൻ ആയിരുന്നു; നിൻ പ്രേമം കളത്രപ്രേമത്തിലും വിസ്മയമേറിയതു.
chapters.niv: I grieve for you, Jonathan my brother; you were very dear to me. Your love for me was wonderful, more wonderful than that of women.
chapters.nkjv: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan; You have been very pleasant to me; Your love to me was wonderful, Surpassing the love of women.
chapters.kjv: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

chapters.ml: വീരന്മാർ പട്ടുപോയതു എങ്ങനെ; യുദ്ധായുധങ്ങൾ നശിച്ചുപോയല്ലോ!
chapters.niv: "How the mighty have fallen! The weapons of war have perished!"
chapters.nkjv: "How the mighty have fallen, And the weapons of war perished!"
chapters.kjv: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് യഹോവയോടു: ഞാൻ യെഹൂദ്യനഗരങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നിലേക്കു ചെല്ലേണമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. യഹോവ അവനോടു: ചെല്ലുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. ഞാൻ എവിടേക്കു ചെല്ലേണ്ടു എന്നു ദാവീദ് ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഹെബ്രോനിലേക്കു എന്നു അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: In the course of time, David inquired of the Lord . "Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?" he asked. The Lord said, "Go up." David asked, "Where shall I go?" "To Hebron," the Lord answered.
chapters.nkjv: It happened after this that David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go up to any of the cities of Judah?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up." David said, "Where shall I go up?" And He said, "To Hebron."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് യിസ്രെയേൽക്കാരത്തി അഹീനോവം, കർമ്മേല്യൻ നാബാലിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായിരുന്ന അബീഗയിൽ എന്നീ രണ്ടു ഭാര്യമാരുമായി അവിടേക്കു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
chapters.nkjv: So David went up there, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite.
chapters.kjv: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal’s wife the Carmelite.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന ആളുകളെ ഒക്കെയും കുടുംബസഹിതം കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവർ ഹെബ്രോന്യപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: David also took the men who were with him, each with his family, and they settled in Hebron and its towns.
chapters.nkjv: And David brought up the men who were with him, every man with his household. So they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
chapters.kjv: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാർ വന്നു അവിടെവെച്ചു ദാവീദിനെ യെഹൂദാഗൃഹത്തിന്നു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the tribe of Judah. When David was told that it was the men from Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul,
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, "The men of Jabesh Gilead weretheones who buried Saul."
chapters.kjv: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശ് നിവാസികൾ ആയിരുന്നു ശൌലിനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തതു എന്നു ദാവീദിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടി. ദാവീദ്, ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശ് നിവാസികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനനായ ശൌലിനോടു ഇങ്ങനെ ദയകാണിച്ചു അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയാൽ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ.
chapters.niv: he sent messengers to them to say to them, "The Lord bless you for showing this kindness to Saul your master by burying him.
chapters.nkjv: So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, "You are blessed of the Lord, for you have shown this kindness to your lord, to Saul, and have buried him.
chapters.kjv: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നിങ്ങളോടു ദയയും വിശ്വസ്തതയും കാണിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ; നിങ്ങൾ ഈ കാര്യം ചെയ്തിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു ഞാനും നിങ്ങൾക്കു നന്മ ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: May the Lord now show you kindness and faithfulness, and I too will show you the same favor because you have done this.
chapters.nkjv: And now may the Lord show kindness and truth to you. I also will repay you this kindness, because you have done this thing.
chapters.kjv: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ധൈര്യപ്പെട്ടു ശൂരന്മാരായിരിപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനനായ ശൌൽ മരിച്ചുപോയല്ലോ; യെഹൂദാഗൃഹം എന്നെ തങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now then, be strong and brave, for Saul your master is dead, and the people of Judah have anointed me king over them."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, let your hands be strengthened, and be valiant; for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah has anointed me king over them."
chapters.kjv: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌലിന്റെ സേനാപതിയായ നേരിന്റെ മകൻ അബ്നേർ ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിനെ മഹനയീമിലേക്കു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി,
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, had taken Ish-Bosheth son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
chapters.nkjv: But Abner the son of Ner, commander of Saul’s army, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim;
chapters.kjv: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

chapters.ml: അവനെ ഗിലെയാദ്, അശൂരി, യിസ്രെയേൽ, എഫ്രയീം, ബെന്യാമീൻ എന്നിങ്ങനെ എല്ലായിസ്രായേല്യർക്കും രാജാവാക്കി,
chapters.niv: He made him king over Gilead, Ashuri and Jezreel, and also over Ephraim, Benjamin and all Israel.
chapters.nkjv: and he made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
chapters.kjv: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ ഈശ്-ബോശെത്ത് യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവായപ്പോൾ അവന്നു നാല്പതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു. യെഹൂദാഗൃഹമോ ദാവീദിനോടു ചേർന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ish-Bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. The tribe of Judah, however, remained loyal to David.
chapters.nkjv: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. Only the house of Judah followed David.
chapters.kjv: Ish-bosheth Saul’s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഹെബ്രോനിൽ യെഹൂദാഗൃഹത്തിന്നു രാജാവായിരുന്ന കാലം ഏഴു സംവത്സരവും ആറു മാസവും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The length of time David was king in Hebron over Judah was seven years and six months.
chapters.nkjv: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
chapters.kjv: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

chapters.ml: നേരിന്റെ മകൻ അബ്നേരും ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ ഈശ്-ബേശെത്തിന്റെ ചേവകരും മഹനയീമിൽനിന്നു ഗിബെയോനിലേക്കു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
chapters.kjv: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ യോവാബും ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകരും പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഗിബെയോനിലെ കുളത്തിന്നരികെവെച്ചു അവരെ നേരിട്ടു; അവർ കുളത്തിന്റെ ഇപ്പുറത്തും മറ്റേവർ കുളത്തിന്റെ അപ്പുറത്തും ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joab son of Zeruiah and David’s men went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat down on one side of the pool and one group on the other side.
chapters.nkjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out and met them by the pool of Gibeon. So they sat down, one on one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.
chapters.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ യോവാബിനോടു: ബാല്യക്കാർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നമ്മുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ഒന്നു കളിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let’s have some of the young men get up and fight hand to hand in front of us." "All right, let them do it," Joab said.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let the young men now arise and compete before us." And Joab said, "Let them arise."
chapters.kjv: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയാകട്ടെ എന്നു യോവാബും പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ബെന്യാമീന്യരുടെയും ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിന്റെയും ഭാഗത്തുനിന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേരും ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകരിൽ പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേരും എണ്ണമൊത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു തമ്മിൽ അടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So they stood up and were counted off—twelve men for Benjamin and Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.
chapters.nkjv: So they arose and went over by number, twelve from Benjamin, followers of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve from the servants of David.
chapters.kjv: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

chapters.ml: ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ എതിരാളിയെ മുടിക്കു പിടിച്ചു വിലാപ്പുറത്തു വാൾ കുത്തിക്കടത്തി ഒരുമിച്ചു വീണു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഗിബെയോനിലെ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ഹെൽക്കത്ത്-ഹസ്സൂരീം എന്നു പേരായി.
chapters.niv: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his dagger into his opponent’s side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.
chapters.nkjv: And each one grasped his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his opponent’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place was called the Field of Sharp Swords, which is in Gibeon.
chapters.kjv: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യുദ്ധം ഏറ്റവും കഠിനമായി, അബ്നേരും യിസ്രായേല്യരും ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകരോടു തോറ്റുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The battle that day was very fierce, and Abner and the Israelites were defeated by David’s men.
chapters.nkjv: So there was a very fierce battle that day, and Abner and the men of Israel were beaten before the servants of David.
chapters.kjv: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ യോവാബ്, അബീശായി, അസാഹേൽ ഇങ്ങനെ സെരൂയയുടെ മൂന്നു പുത്രന്മാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അസാഹേൽ കാട്ടുകലയെപ്പോലെ ശീഘ്രഗാമി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Now Asahel was as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle.
chapters.nkjv: Now the three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab and Abishai and Asahel. And Asahel was as fleet of foot as a wild gazelle.
chapters.kjv: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

chapters.ml: അസാഹേൽ അബ്നേരിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു; അബ്നേരിനെ പിന്തുടരുന്നതിൽ വലത്തോട്ടോ ഇടത്തോട്ടോ മാറിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.
chapters.nkjv: So Asahel pursued Abner, and in going he did not turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.
chapters.kjv: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ പിറകോട്ടു നോക്കി: നീ അസാഹേലോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അതേ എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Abner looked behind him and asked, "Is that you, Asahel?" "It is," he answered.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abner looked behind him and said, "Are you Asahel?" He answered, "I am."
chapters.kjv: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am .

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ അവനോടു: നീ വലത്തോട്ടോ ഇടത്തോട്ടോ തിരിഞ്ഞു, ബാല്യക്കാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ പിടിച്ചു അവന്റെ ആയുധവർഗ്ഗം എടുത്തുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എങ്കിലും അസാഹേലിന്നു അവനെ വിട്ടുമാറുവാൻ മനസ്സായില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then Abner said to him, "Turn aside to the right or to the left; take on one of the young men and strip him of his weapons." But Asahel would not stop chasing him.
chapters.nkjv: And Abner said to him, "Turn aside to your right hand or to your left, and lay hold on one of the young men and take his armor for yourself." But Asahel would not turn aside from following him.
chapters.kjv: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ അസാഹേലിനോടു: എന്നെ വിട്ടുപോക; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വെട്ടിവീഴിക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? പിന്നെ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യോവാബിന്റെ മുഖത്തു എങ്ങനെ നോക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Again Abner warned Asahel, "Stop chasing me! Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?"
chapters.nkjv: So Abner said again to Asahel, "Turn aside from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I face your brother Joab?"
chapters.kjv: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെയും വിട്ടുമാറുവാൻ അവന്നു മനസ്സായില്ല; അബ്നേർ അവനെ കുന്തംകൊണ്ടു പിറകോട്ടു വയറ്റത്തു കുത്തി; കുന്തം മറുവശത്തു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവൻ അവിടെ തന്നെ വീണു മരിച്ചു. അസാഹേൽ മരിച്ചുകിടന്നേടത്തു വന്നവർ ഒക്കെയും നിന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But Asahel refused to give up the pursuit; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into Asahel’s stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He fell there and died on the spot. And every man stopped when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.
chapters.nkjv: However, he refused to turn aside. Therefore Abner struck him in the stomach with the blunt end of the spear, so that the spear came out of his back; and he fell down there and died on the spot. So it was that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died, stood still.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

chapters.ml: യോവാബും അബീശായിയും അബ്നോരിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു; അവർ ഗിബെയോൻ മരുഭൂമിയിലെ വഴിയരികെ ഗീഹിന്റെ മുമ്പിലുള്ള അമ്മാക്കുന്നിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and as the sun was setting, they came to the hill of Ammah, near Giah on the way to the wasteland of Gibeon.
chapters.nkjv: Joab and Abishai also pursued Abner. And the sun was going down when they came to the hill of Ammah, which is before Giah by the road to the Wilderness of Gibeon.
chapters.kjv: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്യർ അബ്നേരിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരേ കൂട്ടമായി കൂടി ഒരു കുന്നിൻ മുകളിൽനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the men of Benjamin rallied behind Abner. They formed themselves into a group and took their stand on top of a hill.
chapters.nkjv: Now the children of Benjamin gathered together behind Abner and became a unit, and took their stand on top of a hill.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്നേർ യോവാബിനോടു: വാൾ എന്നും സംഹരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കേണമോ? ഒടുവിൽ കൈപ്പുണ്ടാകുമെന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ? സഹോരദന്മാരെ പിന്തുടരുന്നതു മതിയാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ജനത്തോടു കല്പിപ്പാൻ നീ എത്രത്തോളം താമസിക്കും എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Abner called out to Joab, "Must the sword devour forever? Don’t you realize that this will end in bitterness? How long before you order your men to stop pursuing their fellow Israelites?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Abner called to Joab and said, "Shall the sword devour forever? Do you not know that it will be bitter in the latter end? How long will it be then until you tell the people to return from pursuing their brethren?"
chapters.kjv: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോവാബ്: ദൈവത്താണ, നീ പറഞ്ഞില്ലെങ്കിൽ ജനം രാവിലെ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ പിന്തുടരാതെ മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുമായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joab answered, "As surely as God lives, if you had not spoken, the men would have continued pursuing them until morning."
chapters.nkjv: And Joab said, "As God lives, unless you had spoken, surely then by morning all the people would have given up pursuing their brethren."
chapters.kjv: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ യോവാബ് കാഹളം ഊതിച്ചു, ജനം ഒക്കെയും നിന്നു, യിസ്രായേലിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നില്ല പൊരുതതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the troops came to a halt; they no longer pursued Israel, nor did they fight anymore.
chapters.nkjv: So Joab blew a trumpet; and all the people stood still and did not pursue Israel anymore, nor did they fight anymore.
chapters.kjv: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേരും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും അന്നു രാത്രിമുഴുവനും അരാബയിൽകൂടി നടന്നു യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു ബിത്രോനിൽകൂടി ചെന്നു മഹനയീമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: All that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, continued through the morning hours and came to Mahanaim.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abner and his men went on all that night through the plain, crossed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron; and they came to Mahanaim.
chapters.kjv: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

chapters.ml: യോവാബും അബ്നേരിനെ പിന്തുടരുന്നതു വിട്ടു മടങ്ങി, ജനത്തെ ഒക്കെയും ഒന്നിച്ചു കൂട്ടിയപ്പോൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവരകരിൽ പത്തൊമ്പതുപേരും അസാഹേലും ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Joab stopped pursuing Abner and assembled the whole army. Besides Asahel, nineteen of David’s men were found missing.
chapters.nkjv: So Joab returned from pursuing Abner. And when he had gathered all the people together, there were missing of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.
chapters.kjv: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകർ ബെന്യാമീന്യരെയും അബ്നേരിന്റെ ആളുകളെയും തോല്പിക്കയും അവരിൽ മുന്നൂറ്ററുപതുപേരെ സംഹരിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But David’s men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.
chapters.nkjv: But the servants of David had struck down, of Benjamin and Abner’s men, three hundred and sixty men who died.
chapters.kjv: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner’s men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

chapters.ml: അസാഹേലിനെ അവർ എടുത്തു ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ അവന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; യോവാബും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും രാത്രി മുഴുവനും നടന്നു പുലർച്ചെക്കു ഹെബ്രോനിൽ എത്തി
chapters.niv: They took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb at Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and arrived at Hebron by daybreak.
chapters.nkjv: Then they took up Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb, which wasin Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at daybreak.
chapters.kjv: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹവും ദാവീദിന്റെ ഗൃഹവും തമ്മിൽ ദീർഘകാലം യുദ്ധം നടന്നു; എന്നാൽ ദാവീദിന്നു ബലം കൂടിക്കൂടിയും ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹം ക്ഷയിച്ചു ക്ഷയിച്ചും വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The war between the house of Saul and the house of David lasted a long time. David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of David. But David grew stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
chapters.kjv: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്നു ഹെബ്രോനിൽവെച്ചു പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിച്ചു; യിസ്രെയേൽക്കാരത്തിയായ അഹീനോവം പ്രസവിച്ച അമ്നോൻ അവന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ.
chapters.niv: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;
chapters.nkjv: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
chapters.kjv: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

chapters.ml: കർമ്മേല്യൻ നാബാലിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായിരുന്ന അബീഗയിൽ പ്രസവിച്ച കിലെയാബ് രണ്ടാമത്തവൻ; ഗെശൂർരാജാവായ തൽമയിയുടെ മകൾ മയഖയുടെ മകനായ അബ്ശാലോം മൂന്നാമത്തവൻ;
chapters.niv: his second, Kileab the son of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
chapters.nkjv: his second, Chileab, by Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite; the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur;
chapters.kjv: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

chapters.ml: ഹഗ്ഗീത്തിന്റെ മകനായ അദോനീയാവു നാലാമത്തവൻ; അബീതാലിന്റെ മകനായ ശെഫത്യാവു അഞ്ചാമത്തവൻ;
chapters.niv: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
chapters.nkjv: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
chapters.kjv: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ എഗ്ളാ പ്രസവിച്ച യിത്രെയാം ആറാമത്തവൻ. ഇവരാകുന്നു ഹെബ്രോനിൽവെച്ചു ദാവീദിന്നു ജനിച്ചവർ.
chapters.niv: and the sixth, Ithream the son of David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.
chapters.nkjv: and the sixth, Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.
chapters.kjv: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹവും ദാവീദിന്റെ ഗൃഹവും തമ്മിൽ യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന കാലത്തു അബ്നേർ ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽ തന്നെത്താൻ ബലപ്പെടുത്തിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had been strengthening his own position in the house of Saul.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was so, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner was strengthening hishold on the house of Saul.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌലിന്നു അയ്യാവിന്റെ മകളായി രിസ്പാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു വെപ്പാട്ടി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഈശ്-ബോശെത്ത് അബ്നേരിനോടു: നീ എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ish-Bosheth said to Abner, "Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?"
chapters.nkjv: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. So Ishbosheth said to Abner, "Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?"
chapters.kjv: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father’s concubine?

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിന്റെ വാക്കുനിമിത്തം ഏറ്റവും കോപിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ യെഹൂദാ പക്ഷത്തിലുള്ള ഒരു നായ്ത്തലയോ? ഇന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തോടും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടും സ്നേഹിതന്മാരോടും ദയ കാണിക്കയും നിന്നെ ദാവീദിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കെ ഇന്നു ഈ സ്ത്രീ നിമിത്തം നീ എന്നെ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said. So he answered, "Am I a dog’s head—on Judah’s side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven’t handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!
chapters.nkjv: Then Abner became very angry at the words of Ishbosheth, and said, "Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show loyalty to the house of Saul your father, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman?
chapters.kjv: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said, Am I a dog’s head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽനിന്നു രാജത്വം മാറ്റുകയും ദാവീദിന്റെ സിംഹാസനം ദാൻമുതൽ ബേർ-ശേബവരെ യിസ്രായേലിലും യെഹൂദയിലും സ്ഥാപിക്കയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം
chapters.niv: May God deal with Abner, be it ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the Lord promised him on oath
chapters.nkjv: May God do so to Abner, and more also, if I do not do for David as the Lord has sworn to him—
chapters.kjv: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദാവീദിനോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഞാൻ അവന്നു സാധിപ്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കാതിരുന്നാൽ ദൈവം അബ്നേരിനോടു തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും ചെയ്യട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: and transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David’s throne over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beersheba."
chapters.nkjv: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul, and set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan to Beersheba."
chapters.kjv: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അബ്നേരിനെ ഭയപ്പെടുകകൊണ്ടു അവനോടു പിന്നെ ഒരു വാക്കും പറവാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.
chapters.nkjv: And he could not answer Abner another word, because he feared him.
chapters.kjv: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അബ്നേർ ഹെബ്രോനിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: ദേശം ആർക്കുള്ളതു? എന്നോടു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്ക; എന്നാൽ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും നിന്റെ പക്ഷത്തിൽ വരുത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ സഹായം നിനക്കു ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, "Whose land is it? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you bring all Israel over to you."
chapters.nkjv: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to David, saying, "Whose is the land?" saying also, "Make your covenant with me, and indeed my hand shallbe with you to bring all Israel to you."
chapters.kjv: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also , Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നല്ലതു; ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യാം; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഒരു കാര്യം നിന്നോടു ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു: നീ എന്നെ കാണ്മാൻ വരുമ്പോൾ ആദ്യം തന്നേ ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖളിനെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വരാതിരുന്നാൽ നീ എന്റെ മുഖം കാൺകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Good," said David. "I will make an agreement with you. But I demand one thing of you: Do not come into my presence unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see me."
chapters.nkjv: And David said, "Good, I will make a covenant with you. But one thing I require of you: you shall not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: ഞാൻ വിവാഹനിശ്ചയത്തിന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നൂറു അഗ്രചർമ്മംകൊടുത്തു വാങ്ങിയ എന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ മീഖളിനെ ഏല്പിച്ചുതരിക എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins."
chapters.nkjv: So David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred foreskins of the Philistines."
chapters.kjv: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: ഈശ്-ബോശെത്ത് അവളെ ലയീശിന്റെ മകനായി അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവായ ഫല്തിയേലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു വരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.
chapters.nkjv: And Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, from Paltiel the son of Laish.
chapters.kjv: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവു കരഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടു ബഹൂരീംവരെ അവളുടെ പിന്നാലെ വന്നു. അബ്നേർ അവനോടു: നീ മടങ്ങിപ്പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Her husband, however, went with her, weeping behind her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go back home!" So he went back.
chapters.nkjv: Then her husband went along with her to Bahurim, weeping behind her. So Abner said to him, "Go, return!" And he returned.
chapters.kjv: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി, എന്നാൽ അബ്നേർ യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: ദാവീദിനെ രാജാവായി കിട്ടുവാൻ കുറെ കാലമായല്ലോ നിങ്ങൾ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, "For some time you have wanted to make David your king.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abner had communicated with the elders of Israel, saying, "In time past you were seeking for David tobe king over you.
chapters.kjv: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്‍വിൻ; ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ കൈകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ മുതലായ സകലശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും രക്ഷിക്കുമെന്നു യഹോവ ദാവീദിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലൊ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now do it! For the Lord promised David, ‘By my servant David I will rescue my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Now then, do it! For the Lord has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of My servant David, I will save My people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and the hand of all their enemies.’ "
chapters.kjv: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അബ്നേർ ബെന്യാമീന്യരോടും പറഞ്ഞു; പിന്നെ അബ്നേർ യിസ്രായേലിന്നും ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും സമ്മതമായതെല്ലാം ദാവീദിനോടു അറിയിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഹെബ്രോനിൽ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites in person. Then he went to Hebron to tell David everything that Israel and the whole tribe of Benjamin wanted to do.
chapters.nkjv: And Abner also spoke in the hearing of Benjamin. Then Abner also went to speak in the hearing of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and the whole house of Benjamin.
chapters.kjv: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അബ്നേരും അവനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുപതു പുരുഷന്മാരും ഹെബ്രോനിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു. ദാവീദ് അബ്നേരിന്നും കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും വേണ്ടി ഒരു വിരുന്നു കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Abner, who had twenty men with him, came to David at Hebron, David prepared a feast for him and his men.
chapters.nkjv: So Abner and twenty men with him came to David at Hebron. And David made a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.
chapters.kjv: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ ദാവീദിനോടു: ഞാൻ ചെന്നു യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനോടു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തും; അപ്പോൾ നീ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ എല്ലാവർക്കും രാജാവായിരിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് അബ്നേരിനെ യാത്ര അയച്ചു; അവൻ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Abner said to David, "Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abner said to David, "I will arise and go, and gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.
chapters.kjv: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

chapters.ml: അപ്പേൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകരും യോവാബും ഒരു കവർച്ചപ്പട കഴിഞ്ഞു വളരെ കൊള്ളയുമായി മടങ്ങിവന്നു; എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് അബ്നേരിനെ യാത്രയയക്കയും അവൻ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോകയും ചെയ്തിരുന്നതിനാൽ അവൻ അന്നേരം ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Just then David’s men and Joab returned from a raid and brought with them a great deal of plunder. But Abner was no longer with David in Hebron, because David had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
chapters.nkjv: At that moment the servants of David and Joab came from a raid and brought much spoil with them. But Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

chapters.ml: യോവാബും കൂടെയുള്ള സൈന്യമൊക്കെയും വന്നപ്പോൾ: നേരിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്നേർ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു, അവൻ അവനെ യാത്രയയച്ചു, അവൻ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോയി എന്നിങ്ങനെ യോവാബിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When Joab and all the soldiers with him arrived, he was told that Abner son of Ner had come to the king and that the king had sent him away and that he had gone in peace.
chapters.nkjv: When Joab and all the troops that were with him had come, they told Joab, saying, "Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he sent him away, and he has gone in peace."
chapters.kjv: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: എന്താകുന്നു ഈ ചെയ്തതു? അബ്നേർ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരുന്നല്ലോ; അവനെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചതെന്തു?
chapters.niv: So Joab went to the king and said, "What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you let him go? Now he is gone!
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab came to the king and said, "What have you done? Look, Abner came to you; why is it that you sent him away, and he has already gone?
chapters.kjv: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോയല്ലോ! നേരിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്നേരിനെ നീ അറികയില്ലേ? നിന്നെ ചതിപ്പാനും നിന്റെ പോക്കും വരവും ഗ്രഹിപ്പാനും നീ ചെയ്യുന്നതൊക്കെയും അറിവാനുമല്ലോ അവൻ വന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You know Abner son of Ner; he came to deceive you and observe your movements and find out everything you are doing."
chapters.nkjv: Surely you realize that Abner the son of Ner came to deceive you, to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you are doing."
chapters.kjv: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു പുറത്തിറങ്ങി അബ്നേരിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; അവർ അവനെ സീരാകിണറ്റിങ്കൽനിന്നു മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ദാവീദ് അതു അറിഞ്ഞില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Joab then left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern at Sirah. But David did not know it.
chapters.nkjv: And when Joab had gone from David’s presence, he sent messengers after Abner, who brought him back from the well of Sirah. But David did not know it.
chapters.kjv: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ ഹെബ്രോനിലേക്കു മടങ്ങി വന്നപ്പോൾ യോവാബ് സ്വകാര്യം പറവാൻ അവനെ പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ ഒരു ഭാഗത്തേക്കു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അസാഹേലിന്റെ രക്തപ്രതികാരത്തിന്നായി അവിടെവെച്ചു അവനെ വയറ്റത്തു കുത്തികൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into an inner chamber, as if to speak with him privately. And there, to avenge the blood of his brother Asahel, Joab stabbed him in the stomach, and he died.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him privately, and there stabbed him in the stomach, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.
chapters.kjv: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ നേരിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്നേരിന്റെ രക്തം സംബന്ധിച്ചു എനിക്കും എന്റെ രാജത്വത്തിന്നും യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ഒരിക്കലും കുറ്റം ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Later, when David heard about this, he said, "I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the Lord concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.
chapters.nkjv: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, "My kingdom and I are guiltless before the Lord forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.
chapters.kjv: And afterward when David heard it , he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

chapters.ml: അതു യോവാബിന്റെ തലമേലും അവന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്മേലൊക്കെയും ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; യോവാബിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽ സ്രവക്കാരനോ കുഷ്ഠരോഗിയോ വടികുത്തി നടക്കുന്നവനോ വാളിനാൽ വീഴുന്നവനോ ആഹാരത്തിന്നു മുട്ടുള്ളവനോ വിട്ടൊഴിയാതിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: May his blood fall on the head of Joab and on his whole family! May Joab’s family never be without someone who has a running sore or leprosy or who leans on a crutch or who falls by the sword or who lacks food."
chapters.nkjv: Let it rest on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house; and let there never fail to be in the house of Joab one who has a discharge or is a leper, who leans on a staff or falls by the sword, or who lacks bread."
chapters.kjv: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ ഗിബെയോനിലെ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ തങ്ങളുടെ അനുജനായ അസാഹേലിനെ കൊന്നതു നിമിത്തം യോവാബും അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബീശായിയും ഇങ്ങനെ അവനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)
chapters.nkjv: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
chapters.kjv: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യോവാബിനോടും അവനോടു കൂടെയുള്ള സകലജനത്തോടും: നിങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം കീറി ചാക്കുശീല ഉടുത്തു അബ്നേരിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നടന്നു വിലപിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു ശവമഞ്ചത്തിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then David said to Joab and all the people with him, "Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and walk in mourning in front of Abner." King David himself walked behind the bier.
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, "Tear your clothes, gird yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn for Abner." And King David followed the coffin.
chapters.kjv: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.

chapters.ml: അവർ അബ്നേരിനെ ഹെബ്രോനിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ രാജാവു അബ്നേരിന്റെ ശവക്കുഴിക്കൽ ഉറക്കെ കരഞ്ഞു; സകലജനവും കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb. All the people wept also.
chapters.nkjv: So they buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at the grave of Abner, and all the people wept.
chapters.kjv: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അബ്നേരിനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലാപഗീതം ചൊല്ലിയതെന്തെന്നാൽ: അബ്നേർ ഒരു നീചനെപ്പോലെയോ മരിക്കേണ്ടതു?
chapters.niv: The king sang this lament for Abner: "Should Abner have died as the lawless die?
chapters.nkjv: And the king sang alament over Abner and said: "Should Abner die as a fool dies?
chapters.kjv: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കൈ ബന്ധിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല; നിന്റെ കാലിന്നു ചങ്ങല ഇട്ടിരുന്നില്ല; നീതികെട്ടവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ പട്ടുപോകുമ്പോലെ നീ പട്ടുപോയല്ലോ. സകലജനവും അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. You fell as one falls before the wicked." And all the people wept over him again.
chapters.nkjv: Your hands were not bound Nor your feet put into fetters; As a man falls before wicked men, so you fell." Then all the people wept over him again.
chapters.kjv: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

chapters.ml: നേരം വൈകുംമുമ്പേ ജനമെല്ലാം ദാവീദിനെ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വന്നപ്പോൾ: സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിക്കും മുമ്പെ ഞാൻ അപ്പം എങ്കിലും മറ്റു യാതൊന്നെങ്കിലും ആസ്വദിച്ചാൽ ദൈവം എന്നോടു തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു ദാവീദ് സത്യം ചെയ്തു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they all came and urged David to eat something while it was still day; but David took an oath, saying, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!"
chapters.nkjv: And when all the people came to persuade David to eat food while it was still day, David took an oath, saying, "God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else till the sun goes down!"
chapters.kjv: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ജനമെല്ലാം അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ: രാജാവു ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും സർവ്വജനത്തിന്നും ബോധിച്ചിരുന്നതുപോലെ ഇതും അവർക്കു ബോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: All the people took note and were pleased; indeed, everything the king did pleased them.
chapters.nkjv: Now all the people took note ofit, and it pleased them, since whatever the king did pleased all the people.
chapters.kjv: And all the people took notice of it , and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

chapters.ml: നേരിന്റെ പുത്രനായ അബ്നേരിനെ കൊന്നതു രാജാവിന്റെ അറിവോടെയല്ല എന്നു സകലജനത്തിന്നും യിസ്രായേലിന്നൊക്കെയും അന്നു ബോധ്യമായി.
chapters.niv: So on that day all the people there and all Israel knew that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.
chapters.nkjv: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it had not been the king’s intent to kill Abner the son of Ner.
chapters.kjv: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു: ഇന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരു പ്രഭുവും മഹാനുമായവൻ പട്ടുപോയി എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Then the king said to his men, "Do you not realize that a commander and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to his servants, "Do you not know that a prince and a great man has fallen this day in Israel?
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ രാജാഭിഷേകം പ്രാപിച്ചവൻ എങ്കിലും ഇന്നു ബലഹിനനാകുന്നു; സെരൂയയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ഈ പുരുഷന്മാർ എനിക്കു ഒതുങ്ങാത്ത കഠനിന്മാരത്രേ; ദുഷ്ടത പ്രവർത്തിച്ചവന്നു അവന്റെ ദുഷ്ടതെക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം യഹോവ പകരം കൊടുക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And today, though I am the anointed king, I am weak, and these sons of Zeruiah are too strong for me. May the Lord repay the evildoer according to his evil deeds!"
chapters.nkjv: And I am weak today, though anointed king; and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are too harsh for me. The Lord shall repay the evildoer according to his wickedness."
chapters.kjv: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

chapters.ml: അബ്നേർ ഹെബ്രോനിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചു പോയതു ശൌലിന്റെ മകൻ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ധൈര്യം ക്ഷയിച്ചു യിസ്രായേല്യരൊക്കെയും ഭ്രമിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When Ish-Bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel became alarmed.
chapters.nkjv: When Saul’s son heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost heart, and all Israel was troubled.
chapters.kjv: And when Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌലിന്റെ മകന്നു പടനായകന്മാരായ രണ്ടു പുരുഷന്മാരുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഒരുത്തന്നു ബാനാ എന്നും മറ്റവന്നു രേഖാബ് എന്നും പേർ. അവൻ ബെന്യാമീന്യരിൽ ബെരോത്യനായ രിമ്മോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു; ബെരോത്ത് ബെന്യാമീനിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ടതായി വിചാരിച്ചുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding bands. One was named Baanah and the other Rekab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin—Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,
chapters.nkjv: Now Saul’s son had two men whowere captains of troops. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin. (For Beeroth also was part of Benjamin,
chapters.kjv: And Saul’s son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:

chapters.ml: ബെരോത്യർ ഗിത്ഥയീമിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി, ഇന്നുവരെയും അവിടെ പരദേശികളായി പാർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: because the people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim and have resided there as foreigners to this day.
chapters.nkjv: because the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have been sojourners there until this day.)
chapters.kjv: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാന്നു രണ്ടു കാലും മുടന്തായിട്ടു ഒരു മകൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; യിസ്രെയേലിൽനിന്നു ശൌലിന്റെയും യോനാഥാന്റെയും വർത്തമാനം എത്തിയ സമയം അവന്നു അഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു. അപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ധാത്രി അവനെ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു ഓടി; അവൾ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ഓടുമ്പോൾ അവൻ വീണു മുടന്തനായിപ്പോയി. അവന്നു മെഫീബോശെത്ത് എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: (Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in both feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled, but as she hurried to leave, he fell and became disabled. His name was Mephibosheth.)
chapters.nkjv: Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son whowas lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel; and his nurse took him up and fled. And it happened, as she made haste to flee, that he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

chapters.ml: ബെരോത്യർ രിമ്മോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ രേഖാബും ബാനയും വെയിൽ മൂത്തപ്പോഴേക്കു ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നെത്തി; അവൻ ഉച്ചസമയത്തു ആശ്വസിച്ചു കിടക്കുകയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Rekab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out for the house of Ish-Bosheth, and they arrived there in the heat of the day while he was taking his noonday rest.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, set out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who was lying on his bed at noon.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

chapters.ml: അവർ കോതമ്പു എടുപ്പാൻ വരുന്ന ഭാവത്തിൽ വീട്ടിന്റെ നടുവിൽ കടന്നു അവനെ വയറ്റത്തു കുത്തി; രേഖാബും സഹോദരനായ ബാനയും ഓടിപ്പോയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They went into the inner part of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rekab and his brother Baanah slipped away.
chapters.nkjv: And they came there, all the way into the house, asthough to get wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
chapters.kjv: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

chapters.ml: അവർ അകത്തു കടന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശയനഗൃഹത്തിൽ കട്ടിലിന്മേൽ കിടക്കുകയായിരുന്നു: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ അവനെ കുത്തിക്കൊന്നു തല വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു തലയും എടുത്തു രാത്രി മുഴുവനും അരാബയിൽകൂടി നടന്നു
chapters.niv: They had gone into the house while he was lying on the bed in his bedroom. After they stabbed and killed him, they cut off his head. Taking it with them, they traveled all night by way of the Arabah.
chapters.nkjv: For when they came into the house, he was lying on his bed in his bedroom; then they struck him and killed him, beheaded him and took his head, and were all night escaping through the plain.
chapters.kjv: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോനിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിന്റെ തല കൊണ്ടുവന്നു രാജാവിനോടു: നിനക്കു പ്രാണഹാനി വരുത്തുവാൻ നോക്കിയ നിന്റെ ശത്രുവായ ശൌലിന്റെ മകൻ ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിന്റെ തല ഇതാ; ഇന്നു യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്നു വേണ്ടി ശൌലിനോടും അവന്റെ സന്തതിയോടും യഹോവ പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They brought the head of Ish-Bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, "Here is the head of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, your enemy, who tried to kill you. This day the Lord has avenged my lord the king against Saul and his offspring."
chapters.nkjv: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth to David at Hebron, and said to the king, "Here is the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul your enemy, who sought your life; and the Lord has avenged my lord the king this day of Saul and his descendants."
chapters.kjv: And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ദാവീദ് ബെരോത്യനായ രിമ്മോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ രേഖാബിനോടും അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ ബാനയോടും ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ സകല ആപത്തിൽനിന്നും വീണ്ടെടുത്ത യഹോവയാണ,
chapters.niv: David answered Rekab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, "As surely as the Lord lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,
chapters.nkjv: But David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, "As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my life from all adversity,
chapters.kjv: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു ഒരുത്തൻ എന്നെ അറിയിച്ചു താൻ ശുഭവർത്തമാനം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു എന്നു വിചാരിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു സിക്ളാഗിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നു. ഇതായിരുന്നു ഞാൻ അവന്റെ വർത്തമാനത്തിന്നുവേണ്ടി അവന്നു കൊടുത്ത പ്രതിഫലം.
chapters.niv: when someone told me, ‘Saul is dead,’ and thought he was bringing good news, I seized him and put him to death in Ziklag. That was the reward I gave him for his news!
chapters.nkjv: when someone told me, saying, ‘Look, Saul is dead,’ thinking to have brought good news, I arrested him and had him executed in Ziklag—the one who thought I would give him a reward for his news.
chapters.kjv: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദുഷ്ടന്മാർ ഒരു നീതിമാനെ അവന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ മെത്തയിൽവെച്ചു കുലചെയ്താൽ എത്ര അധികം? ഞാൻ അവന്റെ രക്തം നിങ്ങളോടു ചോദിച്ചു നിങ്ങളെ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളയാതിരിക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: How much more—when wicked men have killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed—should I not now demand his blood from your hand and rid the earth of you!"
chapters.nkjv: How much more, when wicked men have killed a righteous person in his own house on his bed? Therefore, shall I not now require his blood at your hand and remove you from the earth?"
chapters.kjv: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് തന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാർക്കു കല്പനകൊടുത്തു; അവർ അവരെ കൊന്നു അവരുടെ കൈകാലുകൾ വെട്ടി അവരെ ഹെബ്രോനിലെ കുളത്തിന്നരികെ തൂക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു. ഈശ്-ബോശെത്തിന്റെ തല അവർ എടുത്തു ഹെബ്രോനിൽ അബ്നേരിന്റെ ശവക്കുഴിയിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So David gave an order to his men, and they killed them. They cut off their hands and feet and hung the bodies by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-Bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb at Hebron.
chapters.nkjv: So David commanded his young men, and they executed them, cut off their hands and feet, and hanged them by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in the tomb of Abner in Hebron.
chapters.kjv: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ഹെബ്രോനിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ അസ്ഥിയും മാംസവും ആകുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, "Indeed we are your bone and your flesh.
chapters.kjv: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

chapters.ml: മുമ്പു ശൌൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവായിരുന്നപ്പോഴും നായകനായി യിസ്രായേലിനെ നടത്തിയതു നീ ആയിരുന്നു. നീ എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിനെ മേയ്ക്കയും യിസ്രായേലിന്നു പ്രഭുവായിരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുമെന്നു യഹോവ നിന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിട്ടുമുണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: In the past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the Lord said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Also, in time past, when Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them in; and the Lord said to you, ‘You shall shepherd My people Israel, and be ruler over Israel.’ "
chapters.kjv: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരൊക്കെയും ഹെബ്രോനിൽ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു ഹെബ്രോനിൽവെച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അവരോടു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്തു; അവർ ദാവീദിനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, the king made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord. And they anointed David king over Israel.
chapters.kjv: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD : and they anointed David king over Israel.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു മുപ്പതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
chapters.nkjv: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
chapters.kjv: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹെബ്രോനിൽ യെഹൂദെക്കു ഏഴു സംവത്സരവും ആറു മാസവും യെരൂശലേമിൽ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും യെഹൂദെക്കും മുപ്പത്തിമൂന്നു സംവത്സരവും രാജാവായി വാണു.
chapters.niv: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.
chapters.nkjv: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
chapters.kjv: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

chapters.ml: രാജാവും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു ആ ദേശത്തെ നിവാസികളായ യെബൂസ്യരുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു. ദാവീദിന്നു അവിടെ കടപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ലെന്നുവെച്ചു അവർ ദാവീദിനോടു: നീ ഇവിടെ കടക്കയില്ല; നിന്നെ തടുപ്പാൻ കുരുടരും മുടന്തരും മതി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem to attack the Jebusites, who lived there. The Jebusites said to David, "You will not get in here; even the blind and the lame can ward you off." They thought, "David cannot get in here."
chapters.nkjv: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, "You shall not come in here; but the blind and the lame will repel you," thinking, "David cannot come in here."
chapters.kjv: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

chapters.ml: എന്നിട്ടും ദാവീദ് സീയോൻ കോട്ട പിടിച്ചു; അതു തന്നെ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരം.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion (that is, the City of David).
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ദാവീദ്: ആരെങ്കിലും യെബൂസ്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചാൽ അവൻ നീർപ്പാത്തിയിൽകൂടി കയറി ദാവീദിന്നു വെറുപ്പായുള്ള മുടന്തരെയും കുരുടരെയും പിടിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതു കൊണ്ടു കുരുടരും മുടന്തരും വീട്ടിൽ വരരുതു എന്നൊരു ചൊല്ലു നടപ്പായി.
chapters.niv: On that day David had said, "Anyone who conquers the Jebusites will have to use the water shaft to reach those ‘lame and blind’ who are David’s enemies. " That is why they say, "The ‘blind and lame’ will not enter the palace."
chapters.nkjv: Now David said on that day, "Whoever climbs up by way of the water shaft and defeats the Jebusites (the lame and the blind, whoare hated by David’s soul), heshallbechiefandcaptain." Therefore they say, "The blind and the lame shall not come into the house."
chapters.kjv: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് കോട്ടയിൽ വസിച്ചു, അതിന്നു ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരമെന്നു പേരിട്ടു. ദാവീദ് അതിനെ മില്ലോ തുടങ്ങി ചുറ്റിലും ഉള്ളിലോട്ടും പണിതുറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David then took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built up the area around it, from the terraces inward.
chapters.nkjv: Then David dwelt in the stronghold, and called it the City of David. And David built all around from the Millo and inward.
chapters.kjv: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

chapters.ml: സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ തന്നോടുകൂടെയുണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ദാവീദ് മേല്ക്കുമേൽ പ്രബലനായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he became more and more powerful, because the Lord God Almighty was with him.
chapters.nkjv: So David went on and became great, and the Lord God of hosts was with him.
chapters.kjv: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.

chapters.ml: സോർരാജാവായ ഹീരാം ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെയും ദേവദാരുക്കളെയും ആശാരികളെയും കല്പണിക്കാരെയും അയച്ചു; അവർ ദാവീദിന്നു ഒരു അരമന പണിതു.
chapters.niv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs and carpenters and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters and masons. And they built David a house.
chapters.kjv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിൽ തന്നെ രാജാവായി സ്ഥിരപ്പെടുത്തുകയും അവന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേൽ നിമിത്തം തന്റെ രാജത്വം ഉന്നതമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു എന്നു ദാവീദ് അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel, and that He had exalted His kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
chapters.kjv: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോനിൽനിന്നു വന്നശേഷം ദാവീദ് യെരൂശലേമിൽവെച്ചു അധികം വെപ്പാട്ടികളെയും ഭാര്യമാരെയും പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; ദാവീദിന്നു പിന്നെയും പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരും ജനിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.
chapters.nkjv: And David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron. Also more sons and daughters were born to David.
chapters.kjv: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽവെച്ചു അവന്നു ജനിച്ചവരുടെ പേരുകളാവിതു: ശമ്മൂവ, ശോബാബ്, നാഥാൻ, ശലോമോൻ,
chapters.niv: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
chapters.kjv: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

chapters.ml: യിബ്ഹാർ, എലിശൂവ, നേഫെഗ്, യാഫീയ,
chapters.niv: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.nkjv: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.kjv: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

chapters.ml: എലീശാമാ, എല്യാദാവു, എലീഫേലെത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.
chapters.nkjv: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
chapters.kjv: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദിനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു എന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഒക്കെയും ദാവീദിനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ വന്നു; ദാവീദ് അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു ദുർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ കടന്നു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. And David heard ofit and went down to the stronghold.
chapters.kjv: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ വന്നു രെഫായീം താഴ്വരയിൽ പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
chapters.nkjv: The Philistines also went and deployed themselves in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.kjv: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് യഹോവയോടു: ഞാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെടേണമോ? അവരെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുതരുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. പുറപ്പെടുക; ഞാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവ ദാവീദിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: so David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?" The Lord answered him, "Go, for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hands."
chapters.nkjv: So David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?" And the Lord said to David, "Go up, for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into your hand."
chapters.kjv: And David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ബാൽ-പെരാസീമിൽ ചെന്നു; അവിടെവെച്ചു ദാവീദ് അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു; വെള്ളച്ചാട്ടംപോലെ യഹോവ എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ തകർത്തുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ബാൽ-പെരാസീം എന്നു പേർ പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David went to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, the Lord has broken out against my enemies before me." So that place was called Baal Perazim.
chapters.nkjv: So David went to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there; and he said, "The Lord has broken through my enemies before me, like a breakthrough of water." Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
chapters.kjv: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ ഇട്ടേച്ചുപോയി; ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും അവയെ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them off.
chapters.nkjv: And they left their images there, and David and his men carried them away.
chapters.kjv: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ പിന്നെയും വന്നു രെഫായീംതാഴ്വരിയിൽ പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines went up once again and deployed themselves in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യഹോവയോടു ചോദിച്ചപ്പോൾ: നീ നേരെ ചെല്ലാതെ അവരുടെ പിമ്പുറത്തുകൂടി വളഞ്ഞുചെന്നു ബാഖാവൃക്ഷങ്ങൾക്കു എതിരെവെച്ചു അവരെ നേരിടുക.
chapters.niv: so David inquired of the Lord , and he answered, "Do not go straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore David inquired of the Lord, and He said, "You shall not go up; circle around behind them, and come upon them in front of the mulberry trees.
chapters.kjv: And when David enquired of the LORD , he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

chapters.ml: ബാഖാവൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെ അഗ്രങ്ങളിൽകൂടി അണിനടക്കുന്ന ഒച്ചപോലെ കേൾക്കും; അപ്പോൾ വേഗത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുക; ഫെലിസ്ത്യസൈന്യത്തെ തോല്പിപ്പാൻ യഹോവ നിനക്കു മുമ്പായി പുറപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move quickly, because that will mean the Lord has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then you shall advance quickly. For then the Lord will go out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines."
chapters.kjv: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ദാവീദ് ചെയ്തു, ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ ഗേബമുതൽ ഗേസെർവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So David did as the Lord commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
chapters.nkjv: And David did so, as the Lord commanded him; and he drove back the Philistines from Geba as far as Gezer.
chapters.kjv: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു സകലവിരുതന്മാരുമായി മുപ്പതിനായിരം പേരെ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി
chapters.niv: David again brought together all the able young men of Israel—thirty thousand.
chapters.nkjv: Again David gathered all the choice men of Israel, thirty thousand.
chapters.kjv: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

chapters.ml: കെരൂബുകളുടെ മീതെ അധിവസിക്കുന്നവനായ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ എന്ന നാമത്താൽ വിളിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ബാലേ-യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടതിന്നു ദാവീദും കൂടെയുള്ള സകലജനവും അവിടേക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: He and all his men went to Baalah in Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name, the name of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim on the ark.
chapters.nkjv: And David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, whose name is called by the Name, the Lord of Hosts, who dwells between the cherubim.
chapters.kjv: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims. of hosts, was called upon

chapters.ml: അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ഒരു പുതിയ വണ്ടിയിൽ കയറ്റി, കുന്നിന്മേലുള്ള അബീനാദാബിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ നിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അബീനാദാബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ഉസ്സയും അഹ്യോവും ആ പുതിയവണ്ടി തെളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart
chapters.nkjv: So they set the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
chapters.kjv: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

chapters.ml: കുന്നിന്മേലുള്ള അബീനാദാബിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു അവർ അതിനെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകവുമായി കൊണ്ടു പോരുമ്പോൾ അഹ്യോ പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു മുമ്പായി നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.
chapters.nkjv: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill, accompanying the ark of God; and Ahio went before the ark.
chapters.kjv: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദും യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമൊക്കെയും സരളമരംകൊണ്ടുള്ള സകലവിധവാദിത്രങ്ങളോടും കിന്നരം, വീണ, തപ്പ്, മുരജം, കൈത്താളം എന്നിവയോടുംകൂടെ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നൃത്തം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: David and all Israel were celebrating with all their might before the Lord , with castanets, harps, lyres, timbrels, sistrums and cymbals.
chapters.nkjv: Then David and all the house of Israel played music before the Lord on all kinds of instrumentsof fir wood, on harps, on stringed instruments, on tambourines, on sistrums, and on cymbals.
chapters.kjv: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

chapters.ml: അവർ നാഖോന്റെ കളത്തിങ്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ കാള വിരണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടു ഉസ്സാ കൈ നീട്ടി ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they came to the threshing floor of Nakon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen stumbled.
chapters.nkjv: And when they came to Nachon’s threshing floor, Uzzah put out his hand to the ark of God and took hold of it, for the oxen stumbled.
chapters.kjv: And when they came to Nachon’s threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ കോപം ഉസ്സയുടെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവന്റെ അവിവേകം നിമിത്തം ദൈവം അവിടെവെച്ചു അവനെ സംഹരിച്ചു; അവൻ അവിടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord ’s anger burned against Uzzah because of his irreverent act; therefore God struck him down, and he died there beside the ark of God.
chapters.nkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by the ark of God.
chapters.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഉസ്സയെ ഛേദിച്ച ഛേദംനിമിത്തം ദാവീദിന്നു വ്യസനമായി അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു പേരെസ്-ഉസ്സാ എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു. അതു ഇന്നുവരെയും പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.
chapters.nkjv: And David became angry because of the Lord’s outbreak against Uzzah; and he called the name of the place Perez Uzzah to this day.
chapters.kjv: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.
