chapters.ml: അന്നു ദാവീദ് യഹോവയെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടുപോയി. യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എങ്ങനെ കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David was afraid of the Lord that day and said, "How can the ark of the Lord ever come to me?"
chapters.nkjv: David was afraid of the Lord that day; and he said, "How can the ark of the Lord come to me?"
chapters.kjv: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തുവാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ ദാവീദ് അതിനെ ഗിത്യനായ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He was not willing to take the ark of the Lord to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
chapters.nkjv: So David would not move the ark of the Lord with him into the City of David; but David took it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
chapters.kjv: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ഗിത്യനായ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ മൂന്നുമാസം ഇരുന്നു; യഹോവ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിനെയും അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെ ഒക്കെയും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite for three months, and the Lord blessed him and his entire household.
chapters.nkjv: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite three months. And the Lord blessed Obed-Edom and all his household.
chapters.kjv: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obed-edom, and all his household.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം നിമിത്തം യഹോവ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെയും അവന്നുള്ള സകലത്തെയും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു എന്നു ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് പുറപ്പെട്ടു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ നിന്നു ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിലേക്കു സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now King David was told, "The Lord has blessed the household of Obed-Edom and everything he has, because of the ark of God." So David went to bring up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with rejoicing.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was told King David, saying, "The Lord has blessed the house of Obed-Edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God." So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with gladness.
chapters.kjv: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ചുമന്നവർ ആറു ചുവടു നടന്നശേഷം അവൻ ഒരു കാളയെയും തടിപ്പിച്ച കിടാവിനെയും യാഗംകഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When those who were carrying the ark of the Lord had taken six steps, he sacrificed a bull and a fattened calf.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when those bearing the ark of the Lord had gone six paces, that he sacrificed oxen and fatted sheep.
chapters.kjv: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പഞ്ഞിനൂലങ്കി ധരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പൂർണ്ണശക്തിയോടെ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നൃത്തം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Wearing a linen ephod, David was dancing before the Lord with all his might,
chapters.nkjv: Then David danced before the Lord with all his might; and David was wearing a linen ephod.
chapters.kjv: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദും യിസ്രായേൽ ഗൃഹമൊക്കെയും ആർപ്പോടും കാഹളനാദത്തോടുംകൂടെ യാഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: while he and all Israel were bringing up the ark of the Lord with shouts and the sound of trumpets.
chapters.nkjv: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.
chapters.kjv: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ കടക്കുമ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖൾ കിളിവാതിലിൽകൂടി നോക്കി, ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ കുതിച്ചു നൃത്തം ചെയ്യുന്നതു കണ്ടു തന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ അവനെ നിന്ദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As the ark of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord , she despised him in her heart.
chapters.nkjv: Now as the ark of the Lord came into the City of David, Michal, Saul’s daughter, looked through a window and saw King David leaping and whirling before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart.
chapters.kjv: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD ; and she despised him in her heart.

chapters.ml: അവർ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ദാവീദ് അതിന്നായിട്ടു അടിച്ചിരുന്ന കൂടാരത്തിന്റെ നടുവിൽ അതിന്റെ സ്ഥാനത്തുവെച്ചു; പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They brought the ark of the Lord and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: So they brought the ark of the Lord, and set it in its place in the midst of the tabernacle that David had erected for it. Then David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And they brought in the ark of the LORD , and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്, ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചു തീർന്നശേഷം അവൻ ജനത്തെ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord Almighty.
chapters.nkjv: And when David had finished offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts.
chapters.kjv: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സർവ്വസംഘവുമായ സകലജനത്തിലും പുരുഷന്മാർക്കും സ്ത്രീകൾക്കും ആളൊന്നിന്നു ഒരു അപ്പവും ഒരു കഷണം മാംസവും ഒരു മുന്തിരിയടയും വീതം പങ്കിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു, ജനമൊക്കെയും താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each person in the whole crowd of Israelites, both men and women. And all the people went to their homes.
chapters.nkjv: Then he distributed among all the people, among the whole multitude of Israel, both the women and the men, to everyone a loaf of bread, a piece ofmeat, and a cake of raisins. So all the people departed, everyone to his house.
chapters.kjv: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine . So all the people departed every one to his house.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് തന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മടങ്ങിവന്നപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖൾ ദാവീദിനെ എതിരേറ്റു ചെന്നു: നിസ്സാരന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ തന്നെത്താൻ അനാവൃതനാക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഇന്നു തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ ദാസികൾ കാൺകെ തന്നെത്താൻ അനാവൃതനാക്കിയ യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാവു ഇന്നു എത്ര മഹത്വമുള്ളവൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When David returned home to bless his household, Michal daughter of Saul came out to meet him and said, "How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today, going around half-naked in full view of the slave girls of his servants as any vulgar fellow would!"
chapters.nkjv: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, "How glorious was the king of Israel today, uncovering himself today in the eyes of the maids of his servants, as one of the base fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!"
chapters.kjv: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് മീഖളിനോടു: യഹോവയുടെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു പ്രഭുവായിനിയമിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിന്റെ അപ്പനിലും അവന്റെ സകലഗൃഹത്തിലും ഉപരിയായി എന്നെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ, അതേ, യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ഞാൻ നൃത്തം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: David said to Michal, "It was before the Lord , who chose me rather than your father or anyone from his house when he appointed me ruler over the Lord ’s people Israel—I will celebrate before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: So David said to Michal, "Itwas before the Lord, who chose me instead of your father and all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the Lord, over Israel. Therefore I will play music before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD , which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD , over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇനിയും ഇതിലധികം ഹീനനും എന്റെ കാഴ്ചെക്കു എളിയവനും ആയിരിക്കും; നീ പറഞ്ഞ ദാസികളാലോ എനിക്കു മഹത്വമുണ്ടാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes. But by these slave girls you spoke of, I will be held in honor."
chapters.nkjv: And I will be even more undignified than this, and will be humble in my own sight. But as for the maidservants of whom you have spoken, by them I will be held in honor."
chapters.kjv: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖളിന്നു ജീവപര്യന്തം ഒരു കുട്ടിയും ഉണ്ടായില്ല.
chapters.niv: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
chapters.kjv: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള സകലശത്രുക്കളെയും അടക്കി രാജാവിന്നു സ്വസ്ഥത നല്കിയശേഷം രാജാവു തന്റെ അരമനയിൽ വസിക്കുംകാലത്തു
chapters.niv: After the king was settled in his palace and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies around him,
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass when the king was dwelling in his house, and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies all around,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

chapters.ml: ഒരിക്കൽ രാജാവു നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകനോടു: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ ദേവദാരുകൊണ്ടുള്ള അരമനയിൽ വസിക്കുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകമോ തിരശ്ശീലെക്കകത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent."
chapters.nkjv: that the king said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwells inside tent curtains."
chapters.kjv: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

chapters.ml: നാഥാൻ രാജാവിനോടു: നീ ചെന്നു നിന്റെ മനസ്സിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ചെയ്തുകൊൾക; യഹോവ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Nathan replied to the king, "Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the Lord is with you."
chapters.nkjv: Then Nathan said to the king, "Go, do all that is in your heart, for the Lordis with you."
chapters.kjv: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അന്നു രാത്രി യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു നാഥാന്നു ഉണ്ടായതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: But that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying:
chapters.nkjv: But it happened that night that the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിനോടു നീ ചെന്നു പറക: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഞാൻ അധിവസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ എനിക്കു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയുമോ?
chapters.niv: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: Are you the one to build me a house to dwell in?
chapters.nkjv: "Go and tell My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Would you build a house for Me to dwell in?
chapters.kjv: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD , Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ച നാൾമുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെയും ഞാൻ ഒരു ആലയത്തിൽ അധിവസിക്കാതെ കൂടാരത്തിലും നിവാസത്തിലുമല്ലോ സഞ്ചരിച്ചുവരുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt to this day. I have been moving from place to place with a tent as my dwelling.
chapters.nkjv: For I have not dwelt in a house since the time that I brought the children of Israel up from Egypt, even to this day, but have moved about in a tent and in a tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിനെ മേയ്പാൻ ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചാക്കിയ യിസ്രായേൽ ഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നിനോടു എനിക്കു ദേവദാരുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയാതിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടുംകൂടെ ഞാൻ സഞ്ചരിച്ചുവന്ന സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ എവിടെ വെച്ചെങ്കിലും ഒരു വാക്കു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their rulers whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" ’
chapters.nkjv: Wherever I have moved about with all the children of Israel, have I ever spoken a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?’ " ’
chapters.kjv: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിനോടു പറയേണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ: സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്മേൽ പ്രഭുവായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ പുല്പുറത്തു നിന്നു ആടുകളെ നോക്കിനടക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "I took you from the sheepfold, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people, over Israel.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

chapters.ml: നീ സഞ്ചരിച്ചുവന്ന എല്ലായിടത്തും ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു നിന്റെ സകലശത്രുക്കളെയും നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; ഭൂമിയിലുള്ള മഹാന്മാരുടെ പേർ പോലെ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പേർ വലുതാക്കും.
chapters.niv: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name great, like the names of the greatest men on earth.
chapters.nkjv: And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a great name, like the name of the great men who are on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഒരു സ്ഥലം കല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കയും അവർ സ്വന്തസ്ഥലത്തു പാർത്തു അവിടെനിന്നു ഇളകാതിരിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവരെ നടുകയും ചെയ്യും. പണ്ടത്തെപ്പോലെയും എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഞാൻ ന്യായാധിപന്മാരെ കല്പിച്ചാക്കിയ കാലത്തെപ്പോലെയും ഇനി ദുഷ്ടന്മാർ അവരെ പീഡിപ്പിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning
chapters.nkjv: Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own and move no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness oppress them anymore, as previously,
chapters.kjv: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സകലശത്രുക്കളെയും അടക്കി നിനക്കു സ്വസ്ഥത നല്കും. അത്രയുമല്ല, യഹോവ നിനക്കു ഒരു ഗൃഹം ഉണ്ടാക്കുമെന്നു യഹോവ നിന്നോടു അറിയിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also give you rest from all your enemies. " ‘The Lord declares to you that the Lord himself will establish a house for you:
chapters.nkjv: since the time that I commanded judges tobe over My people Israel, and have caused you to rest from all your enemies. Also the Lord tells you that He will make you a house.
chapters.kjv: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഉദരത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവാനിരിക്കുന്ന സന്തതിയെ നിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലം തികഞ്ഞിട്ടു നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടുകൂടെ നീ നിദ്രകൊള്ളുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു പിന്തുടർച്ചയായി സ്ഥിരപ്പെടുത്തുകയും അവന്റെ രാജത്വം ഉറപ്പാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: When your days are over and you rest with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, your own flesh and blood, and I will establish his kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: "When your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will set up your seed after you, who will come from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
chapters.kjv: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയും; ഞാൻ അവന്റെ രാജത്വത്തിന്റെ സിംഹാസനം എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
chapters.nkjv: He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
chapters.kjv: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്നു പിതാവും അവൻ എനിക്കു പുത്രനും ആയിരിക്കും; അവൻ കുറ്റം ചെയ്താൽ ഞാൻ അവനെ മനുഷ്യരുടെ വടികൊണ്ടും മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്മാരുടെ അടികൊണ്ടും ശിക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with a rod wielded by men, with floggings inflicted by human hands.
chapters.nkjv: I will be his Father, and he shall be My son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.
chapters.kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഞാൻ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞ ശൌലിങ്കൽനിന്നു ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദയ നീക്കിയതുപോലെ അതു അവങ്കൽനിന്നു നീങ്ങിപ്പോകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But my love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
chapters.nkjv: But My mercy shall not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
chapters.kjv: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഗൃഹവും നിന്റെ രാജത്വവും എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കും; നിന്റെ സിംഹാസനവും എന്നേക്കും ഉറെച്ചിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me ; your throne will be established forever.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And your house and your kingdom shall be established forever before you. Your throne shall be established forever." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

chapters.ml: ഈ സകലവാക്കുകൾക്കും ദർശനത്തിന്നും ഒത്തവണ്ണം നാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
chapters.nkjv: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
chapters.kjv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു അകത്തു ചെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഇരുന്നു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ എന്നെ ഇത്രത്തോളം കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ ഞാൻ ആർ? എന്റെ ഗൃഹവും എന്തുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, Sovereign Lord , and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
chapters.nkjv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord; and he said: "Who am I, O Lord God? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
chapters.kjv: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD , and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD ? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

chapters.ml: കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, ഇതും പോരാ എന്നു നിനക്കു തോന്നീട്ടു വരുവാനുള്ള ദീർഘകാലത്തേക്കു അടിയന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും നീ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു. കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, ഇതു മനുഷ്യർക്കു ഉപദേശമല്ലോ?
chapters.niv: And as if this were not enough in your sight, Sovereign Lord , you have also spoken about the future of the house of your servant—and this decree, Sovereign Lord , is for a mere human!
chapters.nkjv: And yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O Lord God; and You have also spoken of Your servant’s house for a great while to come. Is this the manner of man, O Lord God?
chapters.kjv: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant’s house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD ?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഇനി നിന്നോടു എന്തു പറയേണ്ടു? കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ അടിയനെ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Sovereign Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Now what more can David say to You? For You, Lord God, know Your servant.
chapters.kjv: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD , knowest thy servant.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വചനംനിമിത്തവും നിന്റെ പ്രസാദപ്രകാരവും അല്ലോ നീ ഈ വൻകാര്യം ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്തു അടിയനെ അറിയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For the sake of your word and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made it known to your servant.
chapters.nkjv: For Your word’s sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all these great things, to make Your servant know them.
chapters.kjv: For thy word’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them .

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ വലിയവൻ ആകുന്നു; നിന്നെപ്പോലെ ഒരുത്തനുമില്ല; ഞങ്ങൾ സ്വന്തചെവികൊണ്ടു കേട്ടതൊക്കെയും ഓർത്താൽ നീ അല്ലാതെ ഒരു ദൈവവും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: "How great you are, Sovereign Lord ! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore You are great, O Lord God. For thereis none like You, nor isthereany God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു ജനമായി വീണ്ടെടുപ്പാനും നിനക്കു ഒരു നാമം സമ്പാദിപ്പാനും നീ ചെന്നിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു തുല്യമായി ഭൂമിയിൽ ഏതൊരു ജാതിയുള്ളു? ദൈവമേ, നീ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നും ജാതികളുടെയും അവരുടെ ദേവന്മാരുടെയും കൈവശത്തുനിന്നും നിനക്കായി വീണ്ടെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ ജനം കാൺകെ അവർക്കുവേണ്ടി വൻകാര്യവും അവരുടെ ദേശത്തിന്നുവേണ്ടി ഭയങ്കരകാര്യങ്ങളും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth that God went out to redeem as a people for himself, and to make a name for himself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?
chapters.nkjv: And who is like Your people, like Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people, to make for Himself a name—and to do for Yourself great and awesome deeds for Your land—before Your people whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt, the nations, and their gods?
chapters.kjv: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിനെ നിനക്കു എന്നേക്കും ജനമായിരിപ്പാൻ നീ നിനക്കായി സ്ഥിരപ്പെടുത്തി, യഹോവേ, നീ അവർക്കു ദൈവമായ്തീർന്നുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You have established your people Israel as your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.
chapters.nkjv: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own people forever; and You, Lord, have become their God.
chapters.kjv: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD , art become their God.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴും കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ അടിയനെയും അടിയന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനത്തെ എന്നേക്കും ഉറപ്പാക്കി അരുളപ്പാടുപോലെ ചെയ്യേണമേ.
chapters.niv: "And now, Lord God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house. Do as you promised,
chapters.nkjv: "Now, O Lord God, the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house, establish it forever and do as You have said.
chapters.kjv: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.

chapters.ml: സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ദൈവം എന്നിങ്ങനെ നിന്റെ നാമം എന്നേക്കും മഹത്വീകരിക്കപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ; നിന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഗൃഹം നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ സ്ഥരിമായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: so that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty is God over Israel!’ And the house of your servant David will be established in your sight.
chapters.nkjv: So let Your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The Lord of hosts is the God over Israel.’ And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.
chapters.kjv: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ഒരു ഗൃഹം പണിയുമെന്നു നീ അടിയന്നു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിയതുകൊണ്ടു, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവേ, നിന്നോടു ഈ പ്രാർത്ഥന കഴിപ്പാൻ അടിയൻ ധൈര്യം പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: " Lord Almighty, God of Israel, you have revealed this to your servant, saying, ‘I will build a house for you.’ So your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to you.
chapters.nkjv: For You, O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, have revealed this to Your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore Your servant has found it in his heart to pray this prayer to You.
chapters.kjv: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ തന്നേ ദൈവം; നിന്റെ വചനങ്ങൾ സത്യം ആകുന്നു; അടിയന്നു ഈ നന്മയെ നീ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്തുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Sovereign Lord , you are God! Your covenant is trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.
chapters.nkjv: "And now, O Lord God, You are God, and Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
chapters.kjv: And now, O Lord GOD , thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അടിയന്റെ ഗൃഹം തിരുമുമ്പിൽ എന്നേക്കും ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പ്രസാദം തോന്നി അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണമേ; കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ അങ്ങനെ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടല്ലോ; നിന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹത്താൽ അടിയന്റെ ഗൃഹം എന്നേക്കും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Now be pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Sovereign Lord , have spoken, and with your blessing the house of your servant will be blessed forever."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, let it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue before You forever; for You, O Lord God, have spoken it, and with Your blessing let the house of Your servant be blessed forever."
chapters.kjv: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD , hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ ജയിച്ചടക്കി, മൂലസ്ഥാനത്തിന്റെ ഭരണം ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു കരസ്ഥമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Metheg Ammah from the control of the Philistines.
chapters.nkjv: After this it came to pass that David attacked the Philistines and subdued them. And David took Metheg Ammah from the hand of the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മോവാബ്യരെയും തോല്പിച്ചു അവരെ നിലത്തു കിടത്തി ചരടുകൊണ്ടു അളന്നു; കൊല്ലുവാൻ രണ്ടു ചരടും ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ഒരു ചരടുമായി അവൻ അളന്നു. അങ്ങനെ മോവാബ്യർ ദാവീദിന്നു ദാസന്മാരായി കപ്പം കൊടുത്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: David also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground and measured them off with a length of cord. Every two lengths of them were put to death, and the third length was allowed to live. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
chapters.nkjv: Then he defeated Moab. Forcing them down to the ground, he measured them off with a line. With two lines he measured off those to be put to death, and with one full line those to be kept alive. So the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought tribute.
chapters.kjv: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

chapters.ml: രെഹോബിന്റെ മകനായി സോബരാജാവായ ഹദദേസെർ നദീതീരത്തുള്ള തന്റെ ആധിപത്യം യഥാസ്ഥാനപ്പെടുത്തുവാൻ പോയപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് അവനെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.
chapters.nkjv: David also defeated Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his territory at the River Euphrates.
chapters.kjv: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വക ആയിരത്തെഴുനൂറു കുതിരച്ചേവകരെയും ഇരുപതിനായിരം കാലാളുകളെയും ദാവീദ് പിടിച്ചു; രഥകൂതിരകളിൽ നൂറു മാത്രംവെച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു ശേഷം കുതിരകളെ ഒക്കെയും കുതിഞരമ്പു വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.
chapters.nkjv: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Also David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except that he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.
chapters.kjv: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

chapters.ml: സോബരാജാവായ ഹദദേസെരിനെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ ദമ്മേശെക്കിനോടു ചേർന്ന അരാമ്യർ വന്നപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് അരാമ്യരിൽ ഇരുപത്തീരായിരംപേരെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.
chapters.nkjv: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand of the Syrians.
chapters.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് ദമ്മേശെക്കിനോടു ചേർന്ന അരാമിൽ കാവല്പട്ടാളങ്ങളെ പാർപ്പിച്ചു; അരാമ്യരും ദാവീദിന്നു ദാസന്മാരായിത്തീർന്നു കപ്പം കൊടുത്തുവന്നു. ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ചെന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും യഹോവ അവന്നു ജയം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
chapters.nkjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought tribute. So the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
chapters.kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

chapters.ml: ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർക്കു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പൊൻപരിചകളെ ദാവീദ് എടുത്തു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And David took the shields of gold that had belonged to the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളായ ബേതഹിൽനിന്നും ബെരോതായിൽനിന്നും ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു അനവധി താമ്രവും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
chapters.nkjv: Also from Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a large amount of bronze.
chapters.kjv: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ സർവ്വസൈന്യത്തെയും തോല്പിച്ചു എന്നു ഹമാത്ത്‌രാജാവായ തോയി കേട്ടപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
chapters.nkjv: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had defeated all the army of Hadadezer,
chapters.kjv: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിനോടു കുശലം ചോദിപ്പാനും അവൻ ഹദദേസെരിനോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു അവനെ തോല്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ അഭിനന്ദിപ്പാനും തോയി തന്റെ മകൻ യോരാമിനെ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു; ഹദദേസെരിന്നു തോയിയോടു കൂടക്കൂടെ യുദ്ധമുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. യോരാം വെള്ളി, പൊന്നു, താമ്രം എന്നിവകൊണ്ടുള്ള സാധനങ്ങളെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: he sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Joram brought with him articles of silver, of gold and of bronze.
chapters.nkjv: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David, to greet him and bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him (for Hadadezer had been at war with Toi); and Joram brought with him articles of silver, articles of gold, and articles of bronze.
chapters.kjv: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു ഇവയെ അരാമ്യർ, മോവാബ്യർ, അമ്മോന്യർ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ, അമാലേക്യർ എന്നിങ്ങനെ താൻ കീഴടക്കിയ സകല ജാതികളുടെയും പക്കൽനിന്നും
chapters.niv: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold from all the nations he had subdued:
chapters.nkjv: King David also dedicated these to the Lord, along with the silver and gold that he had dedicated from all the nations which he had subdued—
chapters.kjv: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

chapters.ml: രെഹോബിന്റെ മകനായി സോബരാജാവായ ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ കൊള്ളയിൽനിന്നും എടുത്തു വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ച വെള്ളിയോടും പൊന്നിനോടും കൂടെ യഹോവെക്കു വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek. He also dedicated the plunder taken from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
chapters.nkjv: from Syria, from Moab, from the people of Ammon, from the Philistines, from Amalek, and from the spoil of Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
chapters.kjv: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് ഉപ്പുതാഴ്വരയിൽവെച്ചു പതിനെണ്ണായിരം അരാമ്യരെ സംഹരിച്ചു മടങ്ങിവന്നപ്പോൾ തനിക്കു കീർത്തി സമ്പാദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And David became famous after he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
chapters.nkjv: And David made himself a name when he returned from killing eighteen thousand Syrians in the Valley of Salt.
chapters.kjv: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men .

chapters.ml: അവൻ എദോമിൽ കാവല്പട്ടാളങ്ങളെ ആക്കി; എദോമിൽ എല്ലാടത്തും അവൻ കാവല്പട്ടാളങ്ങളെ പാർപ്പിച്ചു; എദോമ്യരൊക്കെയും ദാവീദിന്നു ദാസന്മാരായിത്തീർന്നു; ദാവീദ് ചെന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും യഹോവ അവന്നു ജയം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: He put garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
chapters.nkjv: He also put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became David’s servants. And the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
chapters.kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David’s servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും വാണു; ദാവീദ് തന്റെ സകലജനത്തിന്നും നീതിയും ന്യായവും നടത്തിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.
chapters.nkjv: So David reigned over all Israel; and David administered judgment and justice to all his people.
chapters.kjv: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

chapters.ml: സെരൂയയുടെ മകൻ യോവാബ് സേനാധിപതിയും അഹീലൂദിന്റെ മകൻ യെഹോശാഫാത് മന്ത്രിയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
chapters.nkjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
chapters.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

chapters.ml: അഹീതൂബിന്റെ മകൻ സാദോക്കും അബ്യാഥാരിന്റെ മകൻ അഹീമേലെക്കും പുരോഹിതന്മാരും സെരായാ രായസക്കാരനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;
chapters.nkjv: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests; Seraiah was the scribe;
chapters.kjv: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

chapters.ml: യഹോയാദയുടെ മകൻ ബെനായാവു ക്രേത്യർക്കും പ്ളേത്യർക്കും അധിപതി ആയിരുന്നു; ദാവീദിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോ പുരോഹിതന്മാരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada wasover both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
chapters.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief rulers.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ്: ഞാൻ യോനാഥാന്റെ നിമിത്തം ദയ കാണിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ശൌലിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു അന്വേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David asked, "Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"
chapters.nkjv: Now David said, "Is there still anyone who is left of the house of Saul, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"
chapters.kjv: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽ സീബാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു ഭൃത്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവനെ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വിളിച്ചുവരുത്തി; രാജാവു അവനോടു: നീ സീബയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അടിയൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now there was a servant of Saul’s household named Ziba. They summoned him to appear before David, and the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" "At your service," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: And therewas a servant of the house of Saul whose name was Ziba. So when they had called him to David, the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" He said, "At your service!"
chapters.kjv: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he .

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദയ കാണിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ശൌലിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും ഉണ്ടോ എന്നു രാജാവു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: രണ്ടു കാലും മുടന്തായിട്ടു യോനാഥാന്റെ ഒരു മകൻ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു സീബാ രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king asked, "Is there no one still alive from the house of Saul to whom I can show God’s kindness?" Ziba answered the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan; he is lame in both feet."
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said, "Is there not still someone of the house of Saul, to whom I may show the kindness of God?" And Ziba said to the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan whois lame in his feet."
chapters.kjv: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എവിടെ എന്നു രാജാവു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ലോദെബാരിൽ അമ്മീയേലിന്റെ മകനായ മാഖീരിന്റെ വീട്ടിലുണ്ടു എന്നു സീബാ രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Where is he?" the king asked. Ziba answered, "He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar."
chapters.nkjv: So the king said to him, "Where is he?" And Ziba said to the king, "Indeed he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar."
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു ആളയച്ചു, ലോദെബാരിൽ അമ്മീയേലിന്റെ മകനായ മാഖീരിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ നിന്നു അവനെ വരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: So King David had him brought from Lo Debar, from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.
chapters.nkjv: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
chapters.kjv: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാന്റെ മകൻ മെഫീബോശെത്ത് ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു. ദാവീദ്: മെഫീബോശെത്തേ എന്നു വിളിച്ചതിന്നു അടിയൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he bowed down to pay him honor. David said, "Mephibosheth!" "At your service," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, had come to David, he fell on his face and prostrated himself. Then David said, "Mephibosheth?" And he answered, "Here is your servant!"
chapters.kjv: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അവനോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; നിന്റെ അപ്പനായ യോനാഥാന്റെ നിമിത്തം ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ദയകാണിച്ചു നിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശൌലിന്റെ നിലം ഒക്കെയും നിനക്കു മടക്കിത്തരുന്നു; നീയോ നിത്യം എന്റെ മേശയിങ്കൽ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചുകൊള്ളേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Don’t be afraid," David said to him, "for I will surely show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table."
chapters.nkjv: So David said to him, "Do not fear, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your grandfather; and you shall eat bread at my table continually."
chapters.kjv: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നമസ്കരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു: ചത്ത നായെപ്പോലെ ഇരിക്കുന്ന അടിയനെ നീ കടാക്ഷിപ്പാൻ അടിയൻ എന്തുള്ളു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, "What is your servant, that you should notice a dead dog like me?"
chapters.nkjv: Then he bowed himself, and said, "What is your servant, that you should look upon such a dead dog as I?"
chapters.kjv: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am ?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു ശൌലിന്റെ ഭൃത്യനായ സീബയെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: ശൌലിന്നു അവന്റെ സകലഗൃഹത്തിന്നുമുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ മകന്നു കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the king summoned Ziba, Saul’s steward, and said to him, "I have given your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.
chapters.nkjv: And the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, "I have given to your master’s son all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
chapters.kjv: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master’s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

chapters.ml: നീയും നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും വേലക്കാരും നിന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ മകന്നു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ആഹാരമുണ്ടാകേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്നുവേണ്ടി ആ നിലം കൃഷിചെയ്തു അനുഭവം എടുക്കേണം; നിന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ മകനായ മെഫീബോശെത്ത് നിത്യം എന്റെ മേശയിങ്കൽ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചുകൊള്ളും. എന്നാൽ സീബെക്കു പതിനഞ്ചുപുത്രന്മാരും ഇരുപതു വേലക്കാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You and your sons and your servants are to farm the land for him and bring in the crops, so that your master’s grandson may be provided for. And Mephibosheth, grandson of your master, will always eat at my table." (Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.)
chapters.nkjv: You therefore, and your sons and your servants, shall work the land for him, and you shall bring in theharvest, that your master’s son may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth your master’s son shall eat bread at my table always." Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
chapters.kjv: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master’s son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

chapters.ml: രാജാവായ യജമാനൻ അടിയനോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും അടിയൻ ചെയ്യും എന്നു സീബാ രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. മെഫീബോശെത്തോ രാജകുമാരന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ എന്നപോലെ ദാവീദിന്റെ മേശയിങ്കൽ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Ziba said to the king, "Your servant will do whatever my lord the king commands his servant to do." So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s sons.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ziba said to the king, "According to all that my lord the king has commanded his servant, so will your servant do." "As for Mephibosheth," saidtheking, "he shall eat at my table like one of the king’s sons."
chapters.kjv: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king , he shall eat at my table, as one of the king’s sons.

chapters.ml: മെഫീബോശെത്തിന്നു ഒരു ചെറിയ മകൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു മീഖാ എന്നു പേർ. സീബയുടെ വീട്ടിലുള്ളവരൊക്കെയും മെഫീബോശെത്തിന്നു ഭൃത്യന്മാരായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mika, and all the members of Ziba’s household were servants of Mephibosheth.
chapters.nkjv: Mephibosheth had a young son whose name was Micha. And all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
chapters.kjv: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മെഫീബോശെത്ത് യെരൂശലേമിൽ തന്നേ വസിച്ചു രാജാവിന്റെ മേശയിങ്കൽ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചുപോന്നു; അവന്നു കാലു രണ്ടും മുടന്തായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table; he was lame in both feet.
chapters.nkjv: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. And he was lame in both his feet.
chapters.kjv: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king’s table; and was lame on both his feet.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവു മരിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകനായ ഹാനൂൻ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: It happened after this that the king of the people of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ്: ഹാനൂന്റെ അപ്പനായ നാഹാശ് എനിക്കു ദയ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അവന്റെ മകന്നു ഞാനും ദയ ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്റെ അപ്പനെക്കുറിച്ചു അവനോടു ആശ്വാസവാക്കു പറവാൻ തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s men came to the land of the Ammonites,
chapters.nkjv: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent by the hand of his servants to comfort him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the people of Ammon.
chapters.kjv: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ ദേശത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അമ്മോന്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ തങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനനായ ഹാനൂനോടു: ദാവീദ് നിന്റെ അപ്പനെ ബഹുമാനിച്ചിട്ടാകുന്നു ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കുന്നവരെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചതു എന്നു തോന്നുന്നുവോ? പട്ടണത്തെ ശോധനചെയ്തു ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാനും അതിനെ നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളവാനും അല്ലയോ ദാവീദ് ഭൃത്യന്മാരെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Hasn’t David sent them to you only to explore the city and spy it out and overthrow it?"
chapters.nkjv: And the princes of the people of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think that David really honors your father because he has sent comforters to you? Has David not rather sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?"
chapters.kjv: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഹാനൂൻ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു അവരുടെ താടിയെ പാതി ചിരപ്പിച്ചു അവരുടെ അങ്കികളെ നടുവിൽ ആസനംവരെ മുറിപ്പിച്ചു അവരെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off half of their beards, cut off their garments in the middle, at their buttocks, and sent them away.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു ഇതു അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ ഏറ്റവും ലജ്ജിച്ചിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: നിങ്ങളുടെ താടി വളരുംവരെ യെരീഹോവിൽ താമസിപ്പിൻ; പിന്നെ മടങ്ങിവരാം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When David was told about this, he sent messengers to meet the men, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."
chapters.nkjv: When they told David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, "Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."
chapters.kjv: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾ ദാവീദിന്നു വെറുപ്പുള്ളവരായ്തീർന്നു എന്നു അമ്മോന്യർ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ ആളയച്ചു ബേത്ത്-രെഹോബിലെ അരാമ്യരിൽനിന്നും സോബയിലെ അരാമ്യരിൽനിന്നും ഇരുപതിനായിരം കാലാളുകളെയും ആയിരംപേരുമായി മാഖാരാജാവിനെയും തോബിൽനിന്നു പന്തീരായിരംപേരെയും കൂലിക്കു വരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth Rehob and Zobah, as well as the king of Maakah with a thousand men, and also twelve thousand men from Tob.
chapters.nkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that they had made themselves repulsive to David, the people of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand foot soldiers; and from the king of Maacah one thousand men, and from Ish-Tob twelve thousand men.
chapters.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ish-tob twelve thousand men.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ യോവാബിനെയും ശൂരന്മാരുടെ സകലസൈന്യത്തെയും അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
chapters.nkjv: Now when David heard ofit, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
chapters.kjv: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യരും പുറപ്പെട്ടു പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽ പടെക്കു അണിനിരന്നു; എന്നാൽ സോബയിലെയും രെഹോബിലെയും അരാമ്യരും തോബ്യരും മാഖ്യരും തനിച്ചു വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance of their city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maakah were by themselves in the open country.
chapters.nkjv: Then the people of Ammon came out and put themselves in battle array at the entrance of the gate. And the Syrians of Zoba, Beth Rehob, Ish-Tob, and Maacah were by themselves in the field.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ish-tob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ മുമ്പിലും പിമ്പിലും പടനിരന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യോവാബ് യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകലവീരന്മാരിൽനിന്നും ഒരു കൂട്ടത്തെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു അരാമ്യരുടെ നേരെ അണിനിരത്തി.
chapters.niv: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.
chapters.nkjv: When Joab saw that the battle line was against him before and behind, he chose some of Israel’s best and put them in battle array against the Syrians.
chapters.kjv: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

chapters.ml: ശേഷം പടജ്ജനത്തെ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ നേരെ നിരത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബീശായിയെ ഏല്പിച്ചു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother and deployed them against the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: And the rest of the people he put under the command of Abishai his brother, that he might set them in battle array against the people of Ammon.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: അരാമ്യർ എന്റെ നേരെ പ്രാബല്യം പ്രാപിച്ചാൽ നീ എനിക്കു സഹായം ചെയ്യേണം; അമ്മോന്യർ നിന്റെ നേരെ പ്രാബല്യം പ്രാപിച്ചാൽ ഞാൻ വന്നു നിനക്കു സഹായം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to come to my rescue; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to rescue you.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the people of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.
chapters.kjv: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

chapters.ml: ധൈര്യമായിരിക്ക; നാം നമ്മുടെ ജനത്തിന്നും നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങൾക്കും വേണ്ടി പുരുഷത്വം കാണിക്കുക; യഹോവയോ തനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടമായതു ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."
chapters.nkjv: Be of good courage, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the Lord do whatis good in His sight."
chapters.kjv: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോവാബും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനവും അരാമ്യരോടു പടെക്കു അടുത്തു; അവർ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.
chapters.nkjv: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near for the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
chapters.kjv: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

chapters.ml: അരാമ്യർ ഓടിപ്പോയി എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അമ്മോന്യരും അബീശായിയുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി പട്ടണത്തിൽ കടന്നു. യോവാബ് അമ്മോന്യരെ വിട്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they fled before Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fleeing, they also fled before Abishai, and entered the city. So Joab returned from the people of Ammon and went to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു തോറ്റുപോയി എന്നു അരാമ്യർ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവർ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി.
chapters.niv: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.
chapters.nkjv: When the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they gathered together.
chapters.kjv: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

chapters.ml: ഹദദേസെർ ആളയച്ചു നദിക്കു അക്കരെയുള്ള അരാമ്യരെ വരുത്തി; അവർ ഹേലാമിലേക്കു വന്നു; ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ സേനാപതിയായ ശോബക്ക് അവരുടെ നായകനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Hadadezer had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River; they went to Helam, with Shobak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River, and they came to Helam. And Shobach the commander of Hadadezer’s army went before them.
chapters.kjv: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

chapters.ml: അതു ദാവീദിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ എല്ലായിസ്രായേല്യരെയും കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു ഹേലാമിൽചെന്നു. എന്നാറെ അരാമ്യർ ദാവീദിന്റെ നേരെ അണിനിരന്നു പടയേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan and went to Helam. The Arameans formed their battle lines to meet David and fought against him.
chapters.nkjv: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel, crossed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in battle array against David and fought with him.
chapters.kjv: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

chapters.ml: അരാമ്യർ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോയി; ദാവീദ് അരാമ്യരിൽ എഴുനൂറു തേരാളികളെയും നാല്പതിനായിരം കുതിരപ്പടയാളികളെയും കൊന്നു, അവരുടെ സേനാപതിയായ ശോബക്കിനെയും വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobak the commander of their army, and he died there.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand horsemen of the Syrians, and struck Shobach the commander of their army, who died there.
chapters.kjv: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ ആശ്രിതന്മാരായ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരും തങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു തോറ്റു എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു യിസ്രായേല്യരുമായി സന്ധിചെയ്തു അവരെ സേവിച്ചു. അതിൽപിന്നെ അമ്മോന്യർക്കു സഹായം ചെയ്‍വാൻ അരാമ്യർ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When all the kings who were vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with the Israelites and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.
chapters.nkjv: And when all the kings whowere servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the people of Ammon anymore.
chapters.kjv: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെ ആണ്ടിൽ രാജാക്കന്മാർ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുംകാലം ദാവീദ് യോവാബിനെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ തന്റെ ചേവകരെയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും അയച്ചു; അവർ അമ്മോന്യദേശം ശൂന്യമാക്കി രബ്ബാപട്ടണം നിരോധിച്ചു. ദാവീദോ യെരൂശലേമിൽ തന്നെ താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, David sent Joab out with the king’s men and the whole Israelite army. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: It happened in the spring of the year, at the time when kings go out tobattle, that David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the people of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഒരുനാൾ സന്ധ്യയാകാറായ സമയത്തു ദാവീദ് മെത്തയിൽ നിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു രാജധാനിയുടെ മാളികമേൽ ഉലാവിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ കുളിക്കുന്നതു മാളികയിൽ നിന്നു കണ്ടു; ആ സ്ത്രീ അതിസുന്ദരി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One evening David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing. The woman was very beautiful,
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened one evening that David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to behold.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ആളയച്ചു ആ സ്ത്രീയെപ്പറ്റി അന്വേഷിപ്പിച്ചു. അവൾ എലീയാമിന്റെ മകളും ഹിത്യനായ ഊരിയാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയുമായ ബത്ത്-ശേബ എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and David sent someone to find out about her. The man said, "She is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite."
chapters.nkjv: So David sent and inquired about the woman. And someone said, "Is this not Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?"
chapters.kjv: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു അവളെ വരുത്തി; അവൾ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അവൾക്കു ഋതുശുദ്ധി വന്നിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവളോടുകൂടെ ശയിച്ചു; അവൾ തന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then David sent messengers to get her. She came to him, and he slept with her. (Now she was purifying herself from her monthly uncleanness.) Then she went back home.
chapters.nkjv: Then David sent messengers, and took her; and she came to him, and he lay with her, for she was cleansed from her impurity; and she returned to her house.
chapters.kjv: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ത്രീ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു, താൻ ഗർഭിണി ആയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ദാവീദിന്നു വർത്തമാനം അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, "I am pregnant."
chapters.nkjv: And the woman conceived; so she sent and told David, and said, "I am with child."
chapters.kjv: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് ഹിത്യനായ ഊരീയാവെ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയപ്പാൻ യോവാബിന്നു കല്പന അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So David sent this word to Joab: "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent him to David.
chapters.nkjv: Then David sent to Joab, saying, "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent Uriah to David.
chapters.kjv: And David sent to Joab, saying , Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

chapters.ml: ഊരീയാവു തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് അവനോടു യോവാബിന്റെയും പടജ്ജനത്തിന്റെയും സുഖവർത്തമാനവും യുദ്ധത്തിന്റെ വസ്തുതയും ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab was, how the soldiers were and how the war was going.
chapters.nkjv: When Uriah had come to him, David asked how Joab was doing, and how the people were doing, and how the war prospered.
chapters.kjv: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് ഊരിയാവോടു: നീ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു കാലുകളെ കഴുകുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഊരീയാവു രാജധാനിയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ രാജാവിന്റെ സമ്മാനം അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah departed from the king’s house, and a gift offood from the king followed him.
chapters.kjv: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

chapters.ml: ഊരീയാവോ തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പോകാതെ യജമാനന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരോടുംകൂടെ രാജധാനിയുടെ വാതിൽക്കൽ കിടന്നുറിങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: But Uriah slept at the entrance to the palace with all his master’s servants and did not go down to his house.
chapters.nkjv: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and did not go down to his house.
chapters.kjv: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

chapters.ml: ഊരീയാവു വീട്ടിൽ പോയില്ല എന്നറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് ഊരീയാവിനോടു: നീ യാത്രയിൽനിന്നു വന്നവനല്ലയോ? നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പോകാതെ ഇരുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David was told, "Uriah did not go home." So he asked Uriah, "Haven’t you just come from a military campaign? Why didn’t you go home?"
chapters.nkjv: So when they told David, saying, "Uriah did not go down to his house," David said to Uriah, "Did you not come from a journey? Why did you not go down to your house?"
chapters.kjv: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?

chapters.ml: ഊരീയാവു ദാവീദിനോടു: പെട്ടകവും യിസ്രായേലും യെഹൂദയും കൂടാരങ്ങളിൽ വസിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ യജമാനനായ യോവാബും യജമാനന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരും വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങിക്കിടക്കുന്നു; അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ ഞാൻ ഭക്ഷിപ്പാനും കുടിപ്പാനും എന്റെ ഭാര്യയോടുകൂടെ ശയിപ്പാനും എന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കടക്കുമോ? നിന്നാണ, നിന്റെ ജിവനാണ, അതു ഞാൻ ചെയ്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are staying in tents, and my commander Joab and my lord’s men are camped in the open country. How could I go to my house to eat and drink and make love to my wife? As surely as you live, I will not do such a thing!"
chapters.nkjv: And Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are dwelling in tents, and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open fields. Shall I then go to my house to eat and drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing."
chapters.kjv: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് ഊരീയാവിനോടു: നീ ഇന്നും ഇവിടെ താമസിക്ക; നാളെ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ഊരിയാവു അന്നും യെരൂശലേമിൽ താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then David said to him, "Stay here one more day, and tomorrow I will send you back." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to Uriah, "Wait here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.
chapters.kjv: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ദാവീദ് അവനെ വിളിച്ചു; അവൻ അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്തു; അവൻ അവനെ ലഹരിപിടിപ്പിച്ചു; എങ്കിലും അവൻ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോകാതെ സന്ധ്യെക്കു ചെന്നു യജമാനന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടുകൂടെ തന്റെ വിരിപ്പിൽ കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: At David’s invitation, he ate and drank with him, and David made him drunk. But in the evening Uriah went out to sleep on his mat among his master’s servants; he did not go home.
chapters.nkjv: Now when David called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. And at evening he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but he did not go down to his house.
chapters.kjv: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ ദാവീദ് യോവാബിന്നു ഒരു എഴുത്തു എഴുതി ഊരീയാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
chapters.nkjv: In the morning it happened that David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

chapters.ml: എഴുത്തിൽ: പട കഠിനമായിരിക്കുന്നേടത്തു ഊരീയാവെ മുന്നണിയിൽ നിർത്തി അവൻ വെട്ടുകൊണ്ടു മരിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവനെ വിട്ടു പിൻമാറുവിൻ എന്നു എഴുതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In it he wrote, "Put Uriah out in front where the fighting is fiercest. Then withdraw from him so he will be struck down and die."
chapters.nkjv: And he wrote in the letter, saying, "Set Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck down and die."
chapters.kjv: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ യോവാബ് ആ പട്ടണത്തെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുനോക്കീട്ടു ശൂരന്മാർ നില്ക്കുന്നതായി കണ്ട സ്ഥലത്തു ഊരീയാവെ നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: So while Joab had the city under siege, he put Uriah at a place where he knew the strongest defenders were.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, while Joab besieged the city, that he assigned Uriah to a place where he knew there were valiant men.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .

chapters.ml: പട്ടണക്കാർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു യോവാബിനോടു പട വെട്ടിയപ്പോൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകരായ പടജ്ജനത്തിൽ ചിലർ പട്ടുപോയി; ഹിത്യനായ ഊരിയാവും മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of the men in David’s army fell; moreover, Uriah the Hittite died.
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of the city came out and fought with Joab. And some of the people of the servants of David fell; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
chapters.kjv: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോവാബ് ആ യുദ്ധവർത്തമാനം ഒക്കെയും ദാവീദിനോടു അറിയിപ്പാൻ ആളയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war,
chapters.kjv: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൂതനോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ യുദ്ധവർത്തമാനം ഒക്കെയും രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു തീരുമ്പോൾ രാജാവിന്റെ കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: He instructed the messenger: "When you have finished giving the king this account of the battle,
chapters.nkjv: and charged the messenger, saying, "When you have finished telling the matters of the war to the king,
chapters.kjv: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പട്ടണത്തോടു ഇത്ര അടുത്തുചെന്നു പടവെട്ടിയതു എന്തു? മതിലിന്മേൽ നിന്നു അവർ എയ്യുമെന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു അറിഞ്ഞുകൂടയോ?
chapters.niv: the king’s anger may flare up, and he may ask you, ‘Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn’t you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?
chapters.nkjv: if it happens that the king’s wrath rises, and he says to you: ‘Why did you approach so near to the city when you fought? Did you not know that they would shoot from the wall?
chapters.kjv: And if so be that the king’s wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?

chapters.ml: യെരൂബ്ബേശെത്തിന്റെ മകനായ അബീമേലെക്കിനെ കൊന്നതു ആർ? ഒരു സ്ത്രീ മതിലിന്മേൽനിന്നു തിരിക്കല്ലിൽപിള്ള അവന്റെ മേൽ ഇട്ടതുകൊണ്ടല്ലേയോ അവൻ തേബെസിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചതു? നിങ്ങൾ മതിലിനോടു ഇത്ര അടുത്തുചെന്നതു എന്തു എന്നിങ്ങനെ നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞാൽ: നിന്റെ ഭൃത്യൻ ഹിത്യനായ ഊരീയാവും മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു പറക.
chapters.niv: Who killed Abimelek son of Jerub-Besheth ? Didn’t a woman drop an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?’ If he asks you this, then say to him, ‘Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Was it not a woman who cast a piece of a millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you go near the wall?’—then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.’ "
chapters.kjv: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ ചെന്നു യോവാബ് പറഞ്ഞയച്ച വർത്തമാനമൊക്കെയും ദാവീദിനെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The messenger set out, and when he arrived he told David everything Joab had sent him to say.
chapters.nkjv: So the messenger went, and came and told David all that Joab had sent by him.
chapters.kjv: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ ദാവീദിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: ആ കൂട്ടർ പ്രാബല്യം പ്രാപിച്ചു വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തേക്കു ഞങ്ങളുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വന്നതിനാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കലോളം അവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നടുത്തുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The messenger said to David, "The men overpowered us and came out against us in the open, but we drove them back to the entrance of the city gate.
chapters.nkjv: And the messenger said to David, "Surely the men prevailed against us and came out to us in the field; then we drove them back as far as the entrance of the gate.
chapters.kjv: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ വില്ലാളികൾ മതിലിന്മേൽനിന്നു നിന്റെ ചേവകരെ എയ്തു, രാജാവിന്റെ ചേവകരിൽ ചിലർ പട്ടുപോയി, നിന്റെ ഭൃത്യൻ ഹിത്യനായ ഊരീയാവും മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the archers shot arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king’s men died. Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead."
chapters.nkjv: The archers shot from the wall at your servants; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also."
chapters.kjv: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king’s servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ദാവീദ് ദൂതനോടു: ഈ കാര്യത്തിൽ വ്യസനം തോന്നരുതു; വാൾ അങ്ങും ഇങ്ങും നാശം ചെയ്യും; പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ശക്തിയോടെ പൊരുതു അതിനെ നശിപ്പിച്ചു കളക എന്നു നീ യോവാബിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ ധൈര്യപ്പെടുത്തേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David told the messenger, "Say this to Joab: ‘Don’t let this upset you; the sword devours one as well as another. Press the attack against the city and destroy it.’ Say this to encourage Joab."
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to the messenger, "Thus you shall say to Joab: ‘Do not let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Strengthen your attack against the city, and overthrow it.’ So encourage him."
chapters.kjv: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.

chapters.ml: ഊരീയാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യ തന്റെ ഭർത്താവായ ഊരീയാവു മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ ഭർത്താവിനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.
chapters.nkjv: When the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
chapters.kjv: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

chapters.ml: വിലാപകാലം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം ദാവീദ് ആളയച്ചു അവളെ അരമനയിൽ വരുത്തി; അവൾ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയായി, അവന്നു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു. എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് ചെയ്തതു യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing David had done displeased the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And when her mourning was over, David sent and brought her to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD .
