chapters.kjv: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

chapters.ml: രാജഭൃത്യന്മാർ രാജാവിനോടു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ ഹിതമൊക്കെയും അടിയങ്ങൾക്കു സമ്മതം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king’s officials answered him, "Your servants are ready to do whatever our lord the king chooses."
chapters.nkjv: And the king’s servants said to the king, "We are your servants, readytodo whatever my lord the king commands."
chapters.kjv: And the king’s servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ രാജാവു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവന്റെ ഗൃഹമൊക്കെയും അവനെ പിഞ്ചെന്നു; എന്നാൽ രാജധാനി സൂക്ഷിപ്പാൻ രാജാവു പത്തു വെപ്പാട്ടികളെ താമസിപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king set out, with his entire household following him; but he left ten concubines to take care of the palace.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king went out with all his household after him. But the king left ten women, concubines, to keep the house.
chapters.kjv: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ രാജാവു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ജനമൊക്കെയും പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു; അവർ ബേത്ത്-മെർഹാക്കിൽ നിന്നു;
chapters.niv: So the king set out, with all the people following him, and they halted at the edge of the city.
chapters.nkjv: And the king went out with all the people after him, and stopped at the outskirts.
chapters.kjv: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരും അവന്റെ അരികത്തുകൂടി കടന്നുപോയി; എല്ലാക്രേത്യരും എല്ലാപ്ളേത്യരും അവനോടുകൂടെ ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു പോന്നിരുന്ന അറുനൂറുപേരായ എല്ലാഗിത്യരും രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കടന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: All his men marched past him, along with all the Kerethites and Pelethites; and all the six hundred Gittites who had accompanied him from Gath marched before the king.
chapters.nkjv: Then all his servants passed before him; and all the Cherethites, all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who had followed him from Gath, passed before the king.
chapters.kjv: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ഗിത്യനായ ഇത്ഥായിയോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നീയും ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ വരുന്നതു എന്തിനു? നീ മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ പാർക്ക; നീ പരദേശിയും സ്വദേശഭ്രഷ്ടനും അല്ലോ; നിന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു തന്നേ പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക;
chapters.niv: The king said to Ittai the Gittite, "Why should you come along with us? Go back and stay with King Absalom. You are a foreigner, an exile from your homeland.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, "Why are you also going with us? Return and remain with the king. For you are a foreigner and also an exile from your own place.
chapters.kjv: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.

chapters.ml: നീ ഇന്നലെ വന്നതേയുള്ളു; ഇന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ഞങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ അലഞ്ഞുനടക്കുമാറാക്കുമോ? ഞാൻ തരം കാണുന്നേടത്തേക്കു പോകുന്നു; നീ നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെയും കൂട്ടി മടങ്ങിപ്പോക; ദയയും വിശ്വസ്തതയും നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: You came only yesterday. And today shall I make you wander about with us, when I do not know where I am going? Go back, and take your people with you. May the Lord show you kindness and faithfulness."
chapters.nkjv: In fact, you came only yesterday. Should I make you wander up and down with us today, since I go I know not where? Return, and take your brethren back. Mercy and truth be with you."
chapters.kjv: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഇത്ഥായി രാജാവിനോടു: യഹോവയാണ, യജമാനനായ രാജാവാണ, യജമാനനായ രാജാവു എവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നുവോ അവിടെത്തന്നെ മരണമോ ജീവനോ എന്തു വന്നാലും അടിയനും ഇരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Ittai replied to the king, "As surely as the Lord lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king may be, whether it means life or death, there will your servant be."
chapters.nkjv: But Ittai answered the king and said, "As the Lord lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in whatever place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also your servant will be."
chapters.kjv: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the LORD liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഇത്ഥായിയോടു: നീ കൂടെ പോരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അങ്ങനെ ഗിത്യനായ ഇത്ഥായിയും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും അവനോടുകൂടെയുള്ള കുഞ്ഞുകുട്ടികളും എല്ലാം കടന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: David said to Ittai, "Go ahead, march on." So Ittai the Gittite marched on with all his men and the families that were with him.
chapters.nkjv: So David said to Ittai, "Go, and cross over." Then Ittai the Gittite and all his men and all the little ones who were with him crossed over.
chapters.kjv: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തൊക്കെയും വലിയ കരച്ചലായി; ജനമെല്ലാം കടന്നുപായി; രാജാവും കിദ്രോൻ തോടു കടന്നു; ജനമൊക്കെയും മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കുള്ള വഴിക്കുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The whole countryside wept aloud as all the people passed by. The king also crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the people moved on toward the wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people crossed over. The king himself also crossed over the Brook Kidron, and all the people crossed over toward the way of the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

chapters.ml: സാദോക്കും അവനോടുകൂടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നിയമപ്പെട്ടകം ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു എല്ലാ ലേവ്യരും വന്നു. അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം താഴെ വെച്ചു, ജനമൊക്കെയും പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു കടന്നുതീരുംവരെ അബ്യാഥാർ മല കയറി ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Zadok was there, too, and all the Levites who were with him were carrying the ark of the covenant of God. They set down the ark of God, and Abiathar offered sacrifices until all the people had finished leaving the city.
chapters.nkjv: There was Zadok also, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God. And they set down the ark of God, and Abiathar went up until all the people had finished crossing over from the city.
chapters.kjv: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു സാദോക്കിനോടു: നീ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുപോക; യഹോവെക്കു എന്നോടു കൃപ തോന്നിയാൽ അവൻ എന്നെ മടിക്കവരുത്തും; ഇതും തിരുനിവാസവും കാണ്മാൻ എനിക്കു ഇടയാകും.
chapters.niv: Then the king said to Zadok, "Take the ark of God back into the city. If I find favor in the Lord ’s eyes, he will bring me back and let me see it and his dwelling place again.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to Zadok, "Carry the ark of God back into the city. If I find favor in the eyes of the Lord, He will bring me back and show me both it and His dwelling place.
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD , he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:

chapters.ml: അല്ല, എനിക്കു നിന്നിൽ പ്രസാദമില്ല എന്നു അവൻ കല്പിക്കുന്നെങ്കിൽ, ഇതാ, ഞാൻ ഒരുക്കം; അവൻ തനിക്കു ഹിതമാകുംവണ്ണം എന്നോടു ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But if he says, ‘I am not pleased with you,’ then I am ready; let him do to me whatever seems good to him."
chapters.nkjv: But if He says thus: ‘I have no delight in you,’ here I am, let Him do to me as seems good to Him."
chapters.kjv: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു പിന്നെയും പുരോഹിതനായ സാദോക്കിനോടു: ദർശകാ, നീ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോക; നിങ്ങളുടെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാർ, നിന്റെ മകൻ അഹീമാസും അബ്യാഥാരിന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാനും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The king also said to Zadok the priest, "Do you understand? Go back to the city with my blessing. Take your son Ahimaaz with you, and also Abiathar’s son Jonathan. You and Abiathar return with your two sons.
chapters.nkjv: The king also said to Zadok the priest, "Are you not a seer? Return to the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
chapters.kjv: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു സൂക്ഷ്മവർത്തമാനം കിട്ടുംവരെ ഞാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കുള്ള കടവിങ്കൽ താമസിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I will wait at the fords in the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me."
chapters.nkjv: See, I will wait in the plains of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me."
chapters.kjv: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ സാദോക്കും അബ്യാഥാരും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി, അവിടെ താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Zadok and Abiathar took the ark of God back to Jerusalem and stayed there.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Zadok and Abiathar carried the ark of God back to Jerusalem. And they remained there.
chapters.kjv: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തല മൂടിയും ചെരിപ്പിടാതെയും നടന്നു കരഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടു ഒലിവുമലയുടെ കയറ്റംകയറി; കൂടെയുള്ള ജനമൊക്കെയും തല മൂടി കരഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടു കയറിച്ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: But David continued up the Mount of Olives, weeping as he went; his head was covered and he was barefoot. All the people with him covered their heads too and were weeping as they went up.
chapters.nkjv: So David went up by the Ascent of the Mountof Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. And all the people who were with him covered their heads and went up, weeping as they went up.
chapters.kjv: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

chapters.ml: അബ്ശാലോമിനോടുകൂടെയുള്ള കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുകാരിൽ അഹീഥോഫെലും ഉണ്ടെന്നു ദാവീദിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ: യഹോവ, അഹീഥോഫെലിന്റെ ആലോചനയെ അബദ്ധമാക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now David had been told, "Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom." So David prayed, " Lord , turn Ahithophel’s counsel into foolishness."
chapters.nkjv: Then someone told David, saying, "Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom." And David said, "O Lord, I pray, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!"
chapters.kjv: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD , I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് മലമുകളിൽ ദൈവത്തെ ആരാധിച്ചുവന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അർഖ്യനായ ഹൂശായി അങ്കി കീറിയും തലയിൽ മണ്ണു വാരിയിട്ടുംകൊണ്ടു അവന്നെതിരെ വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When David arrived at the summit, where people used to worship God, Hushai the Arkite was there to meet him, his robe torn and dust on his head.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened when David had come to the top ofthemountain, where he worshiped God—there was Hushai the Archite coming to meet him with his robe torn and dust on his head.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount , where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

chapters.ml: അവനോടു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ എന്നോടു കൂടെ പോന്നാൽ എനിക്കു ഭാരമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: David said to him, "If you go with me, you will be a burden to me.
chapters.nkjv: David said to him, "If you go on with me, then you will become a burden to me.
chapters.kjv: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു അബ്ശാലോമിനോടു: രാജാവേ, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ദാസനായിരുന്നുകൊള്ളാം; ഞാൻ ഇതുവരെ നിന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ദാസൻ ആയിരുന്നതുപോലെ ഇപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ ദാസനായിരിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ നിനക്കു അഹീഥോഫെലിന്റെ ആലോചനയെ വ്യർത്ഥമാക്കുവാൻ കഴിയും.
chapters.niv: But if you return to the city and say to Absalom, ‘Your Majesty, I will be your servant; I was your father’s servant in the past, but now I will be your servant,’ then you can help me by frustrating Ahithophel’s advice.
chapters.nkjv: But if you return to the city, and say to Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king; as I was your father’s servant previously, so I will now also be your servant,’ then you may defeat the counsel of Ahithophel for me.
chapters.kjv: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father’s servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരായ സാദോക്കും അബ്യാഥാരും ഉണ്ടു. അതുകൊണ്ടു രാജധാനിയിൽനിന്നു കേൾക്കുന്നവർത്തമാനമൊക്കെയും നീ പുരോഹിതന്മാരായ സാദോക്കിനെയും അബ്യാഥാരിനെയും അറിയിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Won’t the priests Zadok and Abiathar be there with you? Tell them anything you hear in the king’s palace.
chapters.nkjv: And do you not have Zadok and Abiathar the priests with you there? Therefore it will be that whatever you hear from the king’s house, you shall tell to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
chapters.kjv: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king’s house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവരോടു കൂടെ അവരുടെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാർ, സാദോക്കിന്റെ മകൻ അഹീമാസും അബ്യാഥാരിന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാനും ഉണ്ടു; നിങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കുന്ന വർത്തമാനം ഒക്കെയും അവർ മുഖാന്തരം എന്നെ അറിയിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Their two sons, Ahimaaz son of Zadok and Jonathan son of Abiathar, are there with them. Send them to me with anything you hear."
chapters.nkjv: Indeed theyhave there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son; and by them you shall send me everything you hear."
chapters.kjv: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok’s son , and Jonathan Abiathar’s son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദിന്റെ സ്നേഹിതനായ ഹൂശായി പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെന്നു. അബ്ശാലോമും യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: So Hushai, David’s confidant, arrived at Jerusalem as Absalom was entering the city.
chapters.nkjv: So Hushai, David’s friend, went into the city. And Absalom came into Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: So Hushai David’s friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് മലമുകൾ കടന്നു കുറെ അപ്പുറം ചെന്നപ്പോൾ മെഫീബോശെത്തിന്റെ ഭൃത്യനായ സീബാ കോപ്പിട്ട രണ്ടുകഴുതയുമായി എതിരെ വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അവയുടെ പുറത്തു ഇരുനൂറു അപ്പവും നൂറു ഉണക്കമുന്തിരിക്കുലയും നൂറു അത്തിയടയും ഒരു തുരുത്തി വീഞ്ഞും കയറ്റിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When David had gone a short distance beyond the summit, there was Ziba, the steward of Mephibosheth, waiting to meet him. He had a string of donkeys saddled and loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred cakes of raisins, a hundred cakes of figs and a skin of wine.
chapters.nkjv: When David was a little past the top ofthemountain, there was Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth, who met him with a couple of saddled donkeys, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, one hundred clusters of raisins, one hundred summer fruits, and a skin of wine.
chapters.kjv: And when David was a little past the top of the hill , behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു സീബയോടു: ഇതു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു സീബാ: കഴുതകൾ രാജാവിന്റെ കുടുംബക്കാർക്കു കയറുവാനും അപ്പവും പഴവും ബാല്യക്കാർക്കു തിന്മാനും വീഞ്ഞു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ക്ഷീണിച്ചവർക്കു കുടിപ്പാനും തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king asked Ziba, "Why have you brought these?" Ziba answered, "The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on, the bread and fruit are for the men to eat, and the wine is to refresh those who become exhausted in the wilderness."
chapters.nkjv: And the king said to Ziba, "What do you mean to do with these?" So Ziba said, "The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on, the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat, and the wine for those who are faint in the wilderness to drink."
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ മകൻ എവിടെ എന്നു രാജാവു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു സീബാ രാജാവിനോടു: അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർക്കുന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹം എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ രാജത്വം ഇന്നു എനിക്കു തിരികെ തരുമെന്നു അവൻ പറയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king then asked, "Where is your master’s grandson?" Ziba said to him, "He is staying in Jerusalem, because he thinks, ‘Today the Israelites will restore to me my grandfather’s kingdom.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said, "And where is your master’s son?" And Ziba said to the king, "Indeed he is staying in Jerusalem, for he said, ‘Today the house of Israel will restore the kingdom of my father to me.’ "
chapters.kjv: And the king said, And where is thy master’s son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു സീബയോടു: ഇതാ, മെഫീബോശെത്തിന്നുള്ളതൊക്കെയും നിനക്കുള്ളതാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു സീബാ: യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ, ഞാൻ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നു; തിരുമുമ്പിൽ എനിക്കു ദയ ലഭിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the king said to Ziba, "All that belonged to Mephibosheth is now yours." "I humbly bow," Ziba said. "May I find favor in your eyes, my lord the king."
chapters.nkjv: So the king said to Ziba, "Here, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours." And Ziba said, "I humbly bow before you, that I may find favor in your sight, my lord, O king!"
chapters.kjv: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു ബഹൂരീമിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ കുലത്തിൽ ഗേരയുടെ മകൻ ശീമെയി എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരുത്തൻ അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശപിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: As King David approached Bahurim, a man from the same clan as Saul’s family came out from there. His name was Shimei son of Gera, and he cursed as he came out.
chapters.nkjv: Now when King David came to Bahurim, there was a man from the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei the son of Gera, coming from there. He came out, cursing continuously as he came.
chapters.kjv: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദാവീദിനെയും രാജഭൃത്യന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും കല്ലുവാരി എറിഞ്ഞു; ജനവും വീരന്മാരുമെല്ലാം ഇടത്തും വലത്തുമായി നടക്കുകയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He pelted David and all the king’s officials with stones, though all the troops and the special guard were on David’s right and left.
chapters.nkjv: And he threw stones at David and at all the servants of King David. And all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
chapters.kjv: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയി ശപിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു ഇവ്വണം പറഞ്ഞു: രക്തപാതകാ, നീചാ, പോ, പോ.
chapters.niv: As he cursed, Shimei said, "Get out, get out, you murderer, you scoundrel!
chapters.nkjv: Also Shimei said thus when he cursed: "Come out! Come out! You bloodthirsty man, you rogue!
chapters.kjv: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ രക്തം യഹോവ നിന്റെമേൽ വരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്നു പകരമല്ലോ നീ രാജാവയതു; യഹോവ രാജത്വം നിന്റെ മകനായ അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ രക്തപാതകനായിരിക്കയാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, നിന്റെ ദോഷത്തിന്റെ ഫലം നിനക്കു വന്നുഭവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord has repaid you for all the blood you shed in the household of Saul, in whose place you have reigned. The Lord has given the kingdom into the hands of your son Absalom. You have come to ruin because you are a murderer!"
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has brought upon you all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose place you have reigned; and the Lord has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son. So now you arecaught in your own evil, because you are a bloodthirsty man!"
chapters.kjv: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ അബീശായി രാജാവിനോടു: ഈ ചത്ത നായി എന്റെ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനെ ശപിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? ഞാൻ ചെന്നു അവന്റെ തല വെട്ടിക്കളയട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head."
chapters.nkjv: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please, let me go over and take off his head!"
chapters.kjv: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു രാജാവു: സെരൂയയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരേ, എനിക്കും നിങ്ങൾക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? അവൻ ശപിക്കട്ടെ; ദാവീദിനെ ശപിക്ക എന്നു യഹോവ അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; പിന്നെ നീ ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ആർ ചോദിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the king said, "What does this have to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? If he is cursing because the Lord said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who can ask, ‘Why do you do this?’ "
chapters.nkjv: But the king said, "What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? So let him curse, because the Lord has said to him, ‘Curse David.’ Who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’ "
chapters.kjv: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് അബീശായിയോടും തന്റെ സകല ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ ഉദരത്തിൽ നിന്നു പറപ്പെട്ട മകൻ എനിക്കു പ്രാണഹാനി വരുത്തുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ഈ ബെന്യാമീന്യൻ ചെയ്യുന്നതു ആശ്ചര്യമോ? അവനെ വിടുവിൻ; അവൻ ശപിക്കട്ടെ; യഹോവ അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: David then said to Abishai and all his officials, "My son, my own flesh and blood, is trying to kill me. How much more, then, this Benjamite! Leave him alone; let him curse, for the Lord has told him to.
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Abishai and all his servants, "See how my son who came from my own body seeks my life. How much more now maythis Benjamite? Let him alone, and let him curse; for so the Lord has ordered him.
chapters.kjv: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it ? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.

chapters.ml: പക്ഷേ യഹോവ എന്റെ സങ്കടം നോക്കി ഇന്നത്തെ ഇവന്റെ ശാപത്തിന്നു പകരം എനിക്കു അനുഗ്രഹം നല്കും.
chapters.niv: It may be that the Lord will look upon my misery and restore to me his covenant blessing instead of his curse today."
chapters.nkjv: It may be that the Lord will look on my affliction, and that the Lord will repay me with good for his cursing this day."
chapters.kjv: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും വഴിനടന്നു പോകുമ്പോൾ ശിമെയിയും മലഞ്ചരിവിൽ കൂടി അടുത്തു നടന്നു; നടന്നുകൊണ്ടു ശപിക്കയും കല്ലും പൂഴിയും വാരി അവനെ എറികയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So David and his men continued along the road while Shimei was going along the hillside opposite him, cursing as he went and throwing stones at him and showering him with dirt.
chapters.nkjv: And as David and his men went along the road, Shimei went along the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him and kicked up dust.
chapters.kjv: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill’s side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

chapters.ml: രാജാവും കൂടെയുള്ള സകല ജനവും ക്ഷീണിച്ചവരായി എത്തി അവിടെ ആശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king and all the people with him arrived at their destination exhausted. And there he refreshed himself.
chapters.nkjv: Now the king and all the people who were with him became weary; so they refreshed themselves there.
chapters.kjv: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അബ്ശാലോമും യിസ്രായേല്യരായ ജനമൊക്കെയും അഹീഥോഫെലുമായി യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
chapters.nkjv: Meanwhile Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem; and Ahithophel was with him.
chapters.kjv: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ സ്നേഹിതൻ അർഖ്യനായ ഹൂശായി അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിട്ടു അബ്ശാലോമിനോടു: രാജാവേ, ജയ ജയ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Hushai the Arkite, David’s confidant, went to Absalom and said to him, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, came to Absalom, that Hushai said to Absalom, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്ശാലോം ഹൂശായിയോടു: ഇതാകുന്നുവോ നിന്റെ സ്നേഹിതനോടു നിനക്കുള്ള സ്നേഹം? സ്നേഹിതനോടുകൂടെ പോകാതിരുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Absalom said to Hushai, "So this is the love you show your friend? If he’s your friend, why didn’t you go with him?"
chapters.nkjv: So Absalom said to Hushai, "Is this your loyalty to your friend? Why did you not go with your friend?"
chapters.kjv: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഹൂശായി അബ്ശാലോമിനോടു: അങ്ങനെയല്ല, യഹോവയും ഈ ജനവും യിസ്രായേല്യരൊക്കെയും ആരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നുവോ അവന്നുള്ളവൻ ആകന്നു ഞാൻ; അവന്റെ പക്ഷത്തിൽ ഞാൻ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Hushai said to Absalom, "No, the one chosen by the Lord , by these people, and by all the men of Israel—his I will be, and I will remain with him.
chapters.nkjv: And Hushai said to Absalom, "No, but whom the Lord and this people and all the men of Israel choose, his I will be, and with him I will remain.
chapters.kjv: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD , and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ആരെ ആകുന്നു സേവിക്കേണ്ടതു? അവന്റെ മകനെ അല്ലയോ? ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അപ്പനെ സേവിച്ചതുപോലെ നിന്നെയും സേവിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Furthermore, whom should I serve? Should I not serve the son? Just as I served your father, so I will serve you."
chapters.nkjv: Furthermore, whom should I serve? ShouldI not serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so will I be in your presence."
chapters.kjv: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father’s presence, so will I be in thy presence.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അബ്ശാലോം അഹിഥോഫെലിനോടു: നാം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതു എന്തു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ആലോചിച്ചു പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give us your advice. What should we do?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give advice as to what we should do."
chapters.kjv: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

chapters.ml: അഹീഥോഫെൽ അബ്ശാലോമിനോടു: രാജധാനി സൂക്ഷിപ്പാൻ നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ പാർപ്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള അവന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ നീ ചെല്ലുക; എന്നാൽ നീ നിന്റെ അപ്പന്നു നിന്നെത്തന്നെ വെറുപ്പാക്കി എന്നു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും കേൾക്കും; നിന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ളവർ ഒക്കെയും ധൈര്യപ്പെടും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Ahithophel answered, "Sleep with your father’s concubines whom he left to take care of the palace. Then all Israel will hear that you have made yourself obnoxious to your father, and the hands of everyone with you will be more resolute."
chapters.nkjv: And Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Go in to your father’s concubines, whom he has left to keep the house; and all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong."
chapters.kjv: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father’s concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ അബ്ശാലോമിന്നു വെൺമാടിത്തിന്മേൽ ഒരു കൂടാരം അടിച്ചു; അവിടെ അബ്ശാലോം എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും കാൺകെ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
chapters.kjv: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു അഹീഥോഫെൽ പറയുന്ന ആലോചന ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടുപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; ദാവീദിന്നും അബ്ശാലോമിന്നും അഹീഥോഫെലിന്റെ ആലോചനയെല്ലാം അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now in those days the advice Ahithophel gave was like that of one who inquires of God. That was how both David and Absalom regarded all of Ahithophel’s advice.
chapters.nkjv: Now the advice of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if one had inquired at the oracle of God. So was all the advice of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.
chapters.kjv: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അഹീഥോഫെൽ അബ്ശാലോമിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ പന്തീരായിരം പേരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഇന്നു രാത്രി തന്നേ ദാവീദിനെ പിന്തുടരട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Ahithophel said to Absalom, "I would choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Now let me choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue David tonight.
chapters.kjv: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

chapters.ml: ക്ഷീണിച്ചും അധൈര്യപ്പെട്ടും ഇരിക്കുന്ന അവനെ ഞാൻ ആക്രമിച്ചു ഭ്രമിപ്പിക്കും; അപ്പോൾ അവനോടുകൂടെയുള്ള ജനമൊക്കെയും ഓടിപ്പോകും; ഞാൻ രാജാവിനെ മാത്രം വെട്ടിക്കളയും.
chapters.niv: I would attack him while he is weary and weak. I would strike him with terror, and then all the people with him will flee. I would strike down only the king
chapters.nkjv: I will come upon him while he is weary and weak, and make him afraid. And all the people who are with him will flee, and I will strike only the king.
chapters.kjv: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഞാൻ സകലജനത്തെയും നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടക്കിവരുത്തും; നീ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ എല്ലാവരും മടങ്ങിവരുമ്പോൾ സകലജനവും സമാധാനത്തോടെ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: and bring all the people back to you. The death of the man you seek will mean the return of all; all the people will be unharmed."
chapters.nkjv: Then I will bring back all the people to you. When all return except the man whom you seek, all the people will be at peace."
chapters.kjv: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു അബ്ശാലോമിന്നും യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാർക്കൊക്കെയും വളരെ ബോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This plan seemed good to Absalom and to all the elders of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And the saying pleased Absalom and all the elders of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അബ്ശാലോം: അർഖ്യനായ ഹൂശായിയെ വിളിക്ക; അവന്റെ അഭിപ്രായവും കേൾക്കാമല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Absalom said, "Summon also Hushai the Arkite, so we can hear what he has to say as well."
chapters.nkjv: Then Absalom said, "Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear what he says too."
chapters.kjv: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

chapters.ml: ഹൂശായി അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ അബ്ശാലോം അവനോടു: ഇന്നിന്നപ്രാകരം അഹീഥോഫെൽ പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ നാം ചെയ്കയോ? അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നീ പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Hushai came to him, Absalom said, "Ahithophel has given this advice. Should we do what he says? If not, give us your opinion."
chapters.nkjv: And when Hushai came to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, "Ahithophel has spoken in this manner. Shall we do as he says? If not, speak up."
chapters.kjv: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.

chapters.ml: ഹൂശായി അബ്ശാലോമിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: അഹീഥോഫെൽ ഈ പ്രാവശ്യം പറഞ്ഞ ആലോചന നന്നല്ല.
chapters.niv: Hushai replied to Absalom, "The advice Ahithophel has given is not good this time.
chapters.nkjv: So Hushai said to Absalom: "The advice that Ahithophel has given is not good at this time.
chapters.kjv: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പനും അവന്റെ ആളുകളും വീരന്മാരും കാട്ടിൽ കുട്ടികൾ കവർന്നുപോയ കരടിയെപ്പോലെ ഉഗ്രമാനസന്മാരും ആകുന്നു എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ. നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ യോദ്ധാവാകുന്നു. അവൻ ജനത്തോടുകൂടെ രാപാർക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: You know your father and his men; they are fighters, and as fierce as a wild bear robbed of her cubs. Besides, your father is an experienced fighter; he will not spend the night with the troops.
chapters.nkjv: For," said Hushai, "you know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are enraged in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field; and your father is a man of war, and will not camp with the people.
chapters.kjv: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇപ്പോൾ ഒരു ഗുഹയിലോ മറ്റു വല്ല സ്ഥലത്തോ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കയായിരിക്കും; ആരംഭത്തിങ്കൽ തന്നേ ഇവരിൽ ചിലർ പട്ടുപോയാൽ അതു കേൾക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരും അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ പക്ഷക്കാരിൽ സംഹാരമുണ്ടായി എന്നു പറയും.
chapters.niv: Even now, he is hidden in a cave or some other place. If he should attack your troops first, whoever hears about it will say, ‘There has been a slaughter among the troops who follow Absalom.’
chapters.nkjv: Surely by now he is hidden in some pit, or in some other place. And it will be, when some of them are overthrown at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom.’
chapters.kjv: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സീംഹഹൃദയംപോലെ ഹൃദയമുള്ള ശൂരനും കൂടെ അശേഷം ഉരുകിപ്പോകും; നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ വീരനും അവനോടുകൂടെയുള്ളവർ ശൂരന്മാരും എന്നു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then even the bravest soldier, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will melt with fear, for all Israel knows that your father is a fighter and that those with him are brave.
chapters.nkjv: And even he whois valiant, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will melt completely. For all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.
chapters.kjv: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ പറയുന്ന ആലോചന എന്തെന്നാൽ: ദാൻമുതൽ ബേർ-ശേബവരെ കടൽക്കരയിലെ മണൽപോലെ അസംഖ്യമായിരിക്കുന്ന യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒന്നിച്ചു കൂടുകയും തിരുമേനി തന്നേ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു എഴുന്നെള്ളുകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: "So I advise you: Let all Israel, from Dan to Beersheba—as numerous as the sand on the seashore—be gathered to you, with you yourself leading them into battle.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I advise that all Israel be fully gathered to you, from Dan to Beersheba, like the sand that is by the sea for multitude, and that you go to battle in person.
chapters.kjv: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കാണുന്നേടത്തു നാം അവനെ ആക്രമിച്ചു മഞ്ഞു ഭൂമിയിൽ പൊഴിയുന്നതുപോലെ അവന്റെമേൽ ചെന്നു വീഴും; പിന്നെ അവനാകട്ടെ അവനോടു കൂടെയുള്ള എല്ലാവരിലും ഒരുത്തൻ പോലും ആകട്ടെ ശേഷിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then we will attack him wherever he may be found, and we will fall on him as dew settles on the ground. Neither he nor any of his men will be left alive.
chapters.nkjv: So we will come upon him in some place where he may be found, and we will fall on him as the dew falls on the ground. And of him and all the men who are with him there shall not be left so much as one.
chapters.kjv: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു പട്ടണത്തിൽ കടന്നുകൂടി എങ്കിലോ യിസ്രായേലെല്ലാം ആ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു കയറുകെട്ടി അവിടെ ഒരു ചെറിയ കല്ലുപോലും കാണാതാകുംവരെ അതിനെ നദിയിൽ വലിച്ചിട്ടുകളയും.
chapters.niv: If he withdraws into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it down to the valley until not so much as a pebble is left."
chapters.nkjv: Moreover, if he has withdrawn into a city, then all Israel shall bring ropes to that city; and we will pull it into the river, until there is not one small stone found there."
chapters.kjv: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അബ്ശാലോമും എല്ലാ യിസ്രായേല്യരും: അഹീഥോഫെലിന്റെ ആലോചനയെക്കാൾ അർഖ്യനായ ഹൂശായിയുടെ ആലോചന നല്ലതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അബ്ശാലോമിന്നു അനർത്ഥം വരേണ്ടതിന്നു അഹീഥോഫെലിന്റെ നല്ല ആലോചനയെ വ്യർത്ഥമാക്കുവാൻ യഹോവ നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The advice of Hushai the Arkite is better than that of Ahithophel." For the Lord had determined to frustrate the good advice of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom.
chapters.nkjv: So Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than the advice of Ahithophel." For the Lord had purposed to defeat the good advice of Ahithophel, to the intent that the Lord might bring disaster on Absalom.
chapters.kjv: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഹൂശായി പുരോഹിതന്മാരായ സാദോക്കിനോടും അബ്യാഥാരിനോടു: ഇന്നിന്നപ്രാകരം അഹീഥോഫെൽ അബ്ശാലോമിനോടും യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരോടും ആലോചന പറഞ്ഞു; ഇന്നിന്നപ്രകാരം ഞാനും ആലോചന പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, "Ahithophel has advised Absalom and the elders of Israel to do such and such, but I have advised them to do so and so.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hushai said to Zadok and Abiathar the priests, "Thus and so Ahithophel advised Absalom and the elders of Israel, and thus and so I have advised.
chapters.kjv: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ വേഗത്തിൽ ആളയച്ചു: ഈ രാത്രി മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കുള്ള കടവിങ്കൽ പാർക്കരുതു; രാജാവിന്നും കൂടെയുള്ള സകലജനത്തിന്നും നാശം വരാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഏതു വിധേനയും അക്കരെ കടന്നുപോകേണം എന്നു ദാവീദിനെ അറിയിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now send a message at once and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the fords in the wilderness; cross over without fail, or the king and all the people with him will be swallowed up.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, send quickly and tell David, saying, ‘Do not spend this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily cross over, lest the king and all the people who are with him be swallowed up.’ "
chapters.kjv: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോനാഥാനും അഹീമാസും പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെന്നു തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ കാണിപ്പാൻ പാടില്ലാതിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ഏൻ-രോഗെലിന്നരികെ കാത്തുനില്ക്കും; ഒരു വേലക്കാരത്തി ചെന്നു അവരെ അറിയിക്കയും അവർ ചെന്നു ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിനെ അറിയിക്കയും ചെയ്യും;
chapters.niv: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En Rogel. A female servant was to go and inform them, and they were to go and tell King David, for they could not risk being seen entering the city.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed at En Rogel, for they dared not be seen coming into the city; so a female servant would come and tell them, and they would go and tell King David.
chapters.kjv: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En-rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരൻ അവരെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അബ്ശാലോമിന്നു അറിവു കൊടുത്തു. ആകയാൽ അവർ ഇരുവരും വേഗം പോയി ബഹുരീമിൽ ഒരു ആളുടെ വീട്ടിൽ കയറി; അവന്റെ മുറ്റത്തു ഒരു കിണറുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർ അതിൽ ഇറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: But a young man saw them and told Absalom. So the two of them left at once and went to the house of a man in Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom. But both of them went away quickly and came to a man’s house in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down into it.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man’s house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

chapters.ml: വീട്ടുകാരത്തി മൂടുവിരി എടുത്തു കിണറ്റിന്റെ വായിന്മേൽ വിരിച്ചു അതിൽ കോതമ്പുതരി ചിക്കി; ഇങ്ങനെ കാര്യം അറിവാൻ ഇടയായില്ല.
chapters.niv: His wife took a covering and spread it out over the opening of the well and scattered grain over it. No one knew anything about it.
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground grain on it; and the thing was not known.
chapters.kjv: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

chapters.ml: അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ ആ സ്ത്രീയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു: അഹീമാസും യോനാഥാനും എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അവർ നീർതോടു കടന്നുപോയി എന്നു സ്ത്രീ പറഞ്ഞു അവർ അന്വേഷിച്ചിട്ടു കാണായ്കയാൽ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When Absalom’s men came to the woman at the house, they asked, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" The woman answered them, "They crossed over the brook." The men searched but found no one, so they returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And when Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house, they said, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" So the woman said to them, "They have gone over the water brook." And when they had searched and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And when Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them , they returned to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോയശേഷം അവർ കിണറ്റിൽ നിന്നു കയറിച്ചെന്നു ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിനെ അറിയിച്ചു: നിങ്ങൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു വേഗം നദികടന്നു പോകുവിൻ; ഇന്നിന്നപ്രാകരം അഹീഥോഫെൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു വിരോധമായിട്ടു ആലോചന പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After they had gone, the two climbed out of the well and went to inform King David. They said to him, "Set out and cross the river at once; Ahithophel has advised such and such against you."
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, after they had departed, that they came up out of the well and went and told King David, and said to David, "Arise and cross over the water quickly. For thus has Ahithophel advised against you."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ദാവീദും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനമൊക്കെയും എഴുന്നേറ്റു യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു; നേരം വെളുക്കുമ്പോഴെക്കു യോർദ്ദാൻ കടക്കാതെ ഒരുത്തൻ പോലും ശേഷിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: So David and all the people with him set out and crossed the Jordan. By daybreak, no one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: So David and all the people who were with him arose and crossed over the Jordan. By morning light not one of them was left who had not gone over the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അഹീഥോഫെൽ തന്റെ ആലോചന നടന്നില്ല എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കോപ്പിട്ടു കയറി തന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിൽ വീട്ടിലേക്കു ചെന്നു വീട്ടുകാര്യം ക്രമപ്പെടുത്തിയശേഷം കെട്ടി ഞാന്നു മരിച്ചു; അവന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he saddled his donkey and set out for his house in his hometown. He put his house in order and then hanged himself. So he died and was buried in his father’s tomb.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Ahithophel saw that his advice was not followed, he saddled a donkey, and arose and went home to his house, to his city. Then he put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died; and he was buried in his father’s tomb.
chapters.kjv: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് മഹനയീമിൽ എത്തി. അബ്ശാലോമും കൂടെയുള്ള യിസ്രായേൽജനമൊക്കെയും യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: David went to Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Then David went to Mahanaim. And Absalom crossed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
chapters.kjv: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

chapters.ml: അബ്ശാലോം യോവാബിന്നു പകരം അമാസയെ സേനാധിപതി ആക്കി; അമാസയോ നാഹാശിന്റെ മകളും യോവാബിന്റെ അമ്മ സെരൂയയുടെ സഹോദരിയും ആയ അബീഗലിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ യിത്രാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു യിശ്മായേല്യൻ ചെന്നിട്ടു ഉണ്ടായ മകൻ.
chapters.niv: Absalom had appointed Amasa over the army in place of Joab. Amasa was the son of Jether, an Ishmaelite who had married Abigail, the daughter of Nahash and sister of Zeruiah the mother of Joab.
chapters.nkjv: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the army instead of Joab. This Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Jithra, an Israelite, who had gone in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
chapters.kjv: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man’s son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab’s mother.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേലും അബ്ശാലോമും ഗിലെയാദ് ദേശത്തു പാളയമിറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The Israelites and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: So Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് മഹനയീമിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രബ്ബയിൽനിന്നു നാഹാശിന്റെ മകൻ ശോബി, ലോ-ദെബാരിൽനിന്നു അമ്മീയേലിന്റെ മകൻ മാഖീർ, രോഗെലീമിൽനിന്നു ഗിലെയാദ്യൻ ബർസില്ലായി എന്നിവർ
chapters.niv: When David came to Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, and Makir son of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when David had come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash from Rabbah of the people of Ammon, Machir the son of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

chapters.ml: കിടക്കകളും കിണ്ണങ്ങളും മൺപാത്രങ്ങളും ദാവീദിന്നും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനത്തിന്നും ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ, കോതമ്പു, യവം, മാവു, മലർ, അമരക്ക, പയർ, പരിപ്പു, തേൻ,
chapters.niv: brought bedding and bowls and articles of pottery. They also brought wheat and barley, flour and roasted grain, beans and lentils,
chapters.nkjv: brought beds and basins, earthen vessels and wheat, barley and flour, parched grain and beans, lentils and parched seeds,
chapters.kjv: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn , and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse ,

chapters.ml: വെണ്ണ, ആടു, പശുവിൻ പാൽക്കട്ട എന്നിവയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ജനം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വിശന്നും ദാഹിച്ചും ഇരിക്കുമല്ലോ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: honey and curds, sheep, and cheese from cows’ milk for David and his people to eat. For they said, "The people have become exhausted and hungry and thirsty in the wilderness."
chapters.nkjv: honey and curds, sheep and cheese of the herd, for David and the people who were with him to eat. For they said, "The people are hungry and weary and thirsty in the wilderness."
chapters.kjv: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് തന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള ജനത്തെ എണ്ണിനോക്കി; അവർക്കു സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരെയും ശതാധിപന്മാരെയും നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David mustered the men who were with him and appointed over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
chapters.nkjv: And David numbered the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
chapters.kjv: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ജനത്തിൽ മൂന്നിൽ ഒരു പങ്കു യോവാബിന്റെ കൈക്കീഴും മൂന്നിൽ ഒരു പങ്കു സെരൂയയുടെ മകനും യോവാബിന്റെ സഹോദരനും ആയ അബീശായിയുടെ കൈക്കീഴും മൂന്നിൽ ഒരു പങ്കു ഗിത്യനായ ഇത്ഥായിയുടെ കൈക്കീഴും അയച്ചു: ഞാനും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ വരും എന്നു രാജാവു ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David sent out his troops, a third under the command of Joab, a third under Joab’s brother Abishai son of Zeruiah, and a third under Ittai the Gittite. The king told the troops, "I myself will surely march out with you."
chapters.nkjv: Then David sent out one third of the people under the hand of Joab, one third under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and one third under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said to the people, "I also will surely go out with you myself."
chapters.kjv: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനം: നീ വരേണ്ടാ; ഞങ്ങൾ തോറ്റോടി എന്നു വരികിൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ കാര്യം ആരും ഗണ്യമാക്കുകയില്ല; ഞങ്ങളിൽ പാതിപേർ പട്ടുപോയി എന്നുവരികിലും അതാരും ഗണ്യമാക്കുകയില്ല; നീയോ ഞങ്ങളിൽ പതിനായിരം പേർക്കു തുല്യൻ. ആകയാൽ നീ പട്ടണത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു സഹായം ചെയ്യുന്നതു നല്ലതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the men said, "You must not go out; if we are forced to flee, they won’t care about us. Even if half of us die, they won’t care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It would be better now for you to give us support from the city."
chapters.nkjv: But the people answered, "You shall not go out! For if we flee away, they will not care about us; nor if half of us die, will they care about us. But youare worth ten thousand of us now. For you are now more help to us in the city."
chapters.kjv: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉത്തമം എന്നു തോന്നുന്നതു ഞാൻ ചെയ്യാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. പിന്നെ രാജാവു പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു; ജനമൊക്കെയും നൂറുനൂറായും ആയിരമായിരമായും പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The king answered, "I will do whatever seems best to you." So the king stood beside the gate while all his men marched out in units of hundreds and of thousands.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to them, "Whatever seems best to you I will do." So the king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

chapters.ml: അബ്ശാലോംകുമാരനോടു എന്നെ ഓർത്തു കനിവോടെ പെരുമാറുവിൻ എന്നു രാജാവു യോവാബിനോടും അബീശായിയോടും ഇത്ഥായിയോടും കല്പിച്ചു. രാജാവു അധിപതിമാരോടൊക്കെയും അബ്ശാലോമിനെക്കുറിച്ചു കല്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ ജനമെല്ലാം കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The king commanded Joab, Abishai and Ittai, "Be gentle with the young man Absalom for my sake." And all the troops heard the king giving orders concerning Absalom to each of the commanders.
chapters.nkjv: Now the king had commanded Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, saying, "Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom." And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains orders concerning Absalom.
chapters.kjv: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ജനം പടനിലത്തേക്കു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; എഫ്രയീംവനത്തിൽവെച്ചു പടയുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: David’s army marched out of the city to fight Israel, and the battle took place in the forest of Ephraim.
chapters.nkjv: So the people went out into the field of battle against Israel. And the battle was in the woods of Ephraim.
chapters.kjv: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ ജനം ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകരോടു തോറ്റു. അന്നു അവിടെ ഒരു മഹാസംഹാരം നടന്നു ഇരുപതിനായിരം പേർ പട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: There Israel’s troops were routed by David’s men, and the casualties that day were great—twenty thousand men.
chapters.nkjv: The people of Israel were overthrown there before the servants of David, and a great slaughter of twenty thousand took place there that day.
chapters.kjv: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .

chapters.ml: പട ആ ദേശത്തെല്ലാടവും പരന്നു; അന്നു വാളിന്നിരയായതിലും അധികം പേർ വനത്തിന്നിരയായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The battle spread out over the whole countryside, and the forest swallowed up more men that day than the sword.
chapters.nkjv: For the battle there was scattered over the face of the whole countryside, and the woods devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
chapters.kjv: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

chapters.ml: അബ്ശാലോം ദാവീദിന്റെ ചേവകർക്കു എതിർപ്പെട്ടു; അബ്ശാലോം കോവർകഴുതപ്പുറത്തു ഓടിച്ചുപോകുമ്പോൾ കോവർകഴുത കൊമ്പു തിങ്ങിനില്ക്കുന്ന ഒരു വലിയ കരുവേലകത്തിൻ കീഴെ എത്തി; അവന്റെ തലമുടി കരുവേലകത്തിൽ പിടിപെട്ടിട്ടു അവൻ ആകാശത്തിന്നും ഭൂമിക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ തൂങ്ങി; അവന്റെ കീഴിൽനിന്നു കോവർകഴുത ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Now Absalom happened to meet David’s men. He was riding his mule, and as the mule went under the thick branches of a large oak, Absalom’s hair got caught in the tree. He was left hanging in midair, while the mule he was riding kept on going.
chapters.nkjv: Then Absalom met the servants of David. Absalom rode on a mule. The mule went under the thick boughs of a great terebinth tree, and his head caught in the terebinth; so he was left hanging between heaven and earth. And the mule which was under him went on.
chapters.kjv: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തൻ അതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: അബ്ശാലോം ഒരു കരുവേലകത്തിൽ തൂങ്ങിക്കിടക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു എന്നു യോവാബിനോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When one of the men saw what had happened, he told Joab, "I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree."
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain man saw it and told Joab, and said, "I just saw Absalom hanging in a terebinth tree!"
chapters.kjv: And a certain man saw it , and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് തന്നെ അറിയിച്ചവനോടു: നീ അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവിടെവെച്ചുതന്നേ വെട്ടിക്കളയാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു? ഞാൻ നിനക്കു പത്തു ശേക്കെൽ വെള്ളിയും ഒരു അരക്കച്ചയും തരുമായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joab said to the man who had told him this, "What! You saw him? Why didn’t you strike him to the ground right there? Then I would have had to give you ten shekels of silver and a warrior’s belt."
chapters.nkjv: So Joab said to the man who told him, "You just saw him! And why did you not strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten shekels of silver and a belt."
chapters.kjv: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോവാബിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ആയിരം ശേക്കെൽ വെള്ളി എനിക്കു തന്നാലും ഞാൻ രാജകുമാരന്റെ നേരെ കൈ നീട്ടുകയില്ല; അബ്ശാലോംകുമാരനെ ആരും തൊടാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു രാജാവു നിന്നോടും അബീശായിയോടും ഇത്ഥായിയോടും ഞങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കെയല്ലോ കല്പിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: But the man replied, "Even if a thousand shekels were weighed out into my hands, I would not lay a hand on the king’s son. In our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘Protect the young man Absalom for my sake. ’
chapters.nkjv: But the man said to Joab, "Though I were to receive a thousand shekels of silver in my hand, I would not raise my hand against the king’s son. For in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware lest anyone touch the young man Absalom!’
chapters.kjv: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king’s son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

chapters.ml: അല്ല, ഞാൻ അവന്റെ പ്രാണനെ ദ്രോഹിച്ചിരുന്നെങ്കിൽ--രാജാവിന്നു ഒന്നും മറവായിരിക്കയില്ലല്ലോ--നീ തന്നേ എന്നോടു അകന്നു നില്ക്കുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And if I had put my life in jeopardy —and nothing is hidden from the king—you would have kept your distance from me."
chapters.nkjv: Otherwise I would have dealt falsely against my own life. For there is nothing hidden from the king, and you yourself would have set yourself against me."
chapters.kjv: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോവാബ്: ഞാൻ ഇങ്ങനെ നിന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചു നേരം കളകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു മൂന്നു കുന്തം കയ്യിൽ എടുത്തു അബ്ശാലോം കരുവേലകത്തിൽ ജീവനോടു തൂങ്ങിക്കിടക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ അവയെ അവന്റെ നെഞ്ചിന്നകത്തു കുത്തിക്കടത്തി.
chapters.niv: Joab said, "I’m not going to wait like this for you." So he took three javelins in his hand and plunged them into Absalom’s heart while Absalom was still alive in the oak tree.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab said, "I cannot linger with you." And he took three spears in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart, while he was still alive in the midst of the terebinth tree.
chapters.kjv: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

chapters.ml: യോവാബിന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകന്മാരായ പത്തു ബാല്യക്കാർ വളഞ്ഞു നിന്നു അബ്ശാലോമിനെ അടിച്ചുകൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: And ten of Joab’s armor-bearers surrounded Absalom, struck him and killed him.
chapters.nkjv: And ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded Absalom, and struck and killed him.
chapters.kjv: And ten young men that bare Joab’s armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോവാബ് കാഹളം ഊതി; യോവാബ് ജനത്തെ വിലക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ യിസ്രായേലിനെ പിന്തുടരുന്നതു വിട്ടുമടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops stopped pursuing Israel, for Joab halted them.
chapters.nkjv: So Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing Israel. For Joab held back the people.
chapters.kjv: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

chapters.ml: അബ്ശാലോമിനെ അവർ എടുത്തു വനത്തിൽ ഒരു വലിയ കുഴിയിൽ ഇട്ടു; അവന്റെ മേൽ ഏറ്റവും വലിയോരു കൽക്കൂമ്പാരം കൂട്ടി; യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: They took Absalom, threw him into a big pit in the forest and piled up a large heap of rocks over him. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled to their homes.
chapters.nkjv: And they took Absalom and cast him into a large pit in the woods, and laid a very large heap of stones over him. Then all Israel fled, everyone to his tent.
chapters.kjv: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

chapters.ml: അബ്ശാലോം ജീവനോടിരുന്ന സമയം: എന്റെ പേർ നിലനിർത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു എനിക്കു മകനില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, രാജാവിൻ താഴ്വരയിലെ തൂൺ എടുത്തു നാട്ടി അതിന്നു തന്റെ പേർ വിളിച്ചിരുന്നു; അതിന്നു ഇന്നുവരെ അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ ജ്ഞാപക സ്തംഭം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: During his lifetime Absalom had taken a pillar and erected it in the King’s Valley as a monument to himself, for he thought, "I have no son to carry on the memory of my name." He named the pillar after himself, and it is called Absalom’s Monument to this day.
chapters.nkjv: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and set up a pillar for himself, which is in the King’s Valley. For he said, "I have no son to keep my name in remembrance." He called the pillar after his own name. And to this day it is called Absalom’s Monument.
chapters.kjv: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king’s dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom’s place.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സാദോക്കിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമാസ്: ഞാൻ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു രാജാവിനോടു, യഹോവ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി ശത്രുക്കളോടു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന സദ്വർത്തമാനം അറിയിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, "Let me run and take the news to the king that the Lord has vindicated him by delivering him from the hand of his enemies."
chapters.nkjv: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, "Let me run now and take the news to the king, how the Lord has avenged him of his enemies."
chapters.kjv: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് അവനോടു: നീ ഇന്നു സദ്വർത്തമാന ദൂതനാകയില്ല; ഇനി ഒരു ദിവസം സദ്വർത്തമാനം കൊണ്ടുപോകാം; രാജകുമാരൻ മരിച്ചിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു നീ ഇന്നു സദ്വർത്തമാന ദൂതനാകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You are not the one to take the news today," Joab told him. "You may take the news another time, but you must not do so today, because the king’s son is dead."
chapters.nkjv: And Joab said to him, "You shall not take the news this day, for you shall take the news another day. But today you shall take no news, because the king’s son is dead."
chapters.kjv: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king’s son is dead.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോവാബ് കൂശ്യനോടു: നി കണ്ടതു രാജാവിനെ ചെന്നു അറിയിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. കൂശ്യൻ യോവാബിനെ വണങ്ങി ഓടി. സാദോക്കിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമാസ് പിന്നെയും യോവാബിനോടു: ഏതായാലും ഞാനും കൂശ്യന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ഓടട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Joab said to a Cushite, "Go, tell the king what you have seen." The Cushite bowed down before Joab and ran off.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab said to the Cushite, "Go, tell the king what you have seen." So the Cushite bowed himself to Joab and ran.
chapters.kjv: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോവാബ്: എന്റെ മകനേ, നീ എന്തിന്നു ഓടുന്നു? നിനക്കു പ്രതിഫലം കിട്ടുകയില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Ahimaaz son of Zadok again said to Joab, "Come what may, please let me run behind the Cushite." But Joab replied, "My son, why do you want to go? You don’t have any news that will bring you a reward."
chapters.nkjv: And Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said again to Joab, "But whatever happens, please let me also run after the Cushite." So Joab said, "Why will you run, my son, since you have no news ready?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും: ഏതായാലും ഞാൻ ഓടും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: എന്നാൽ ഓടിക്കൊൾക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അഹീമാസ് സമഭൂമിവഴിയായി ഓടി കൂശ്യനെ കടന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: He said, "Come what may, I want to run." So Joab said, "Run!" Then Ahimaaz ran by way of the plain and outran the Cushite.
chapters.nkjv: "But whatever happens," hesaid, "let me run." So he said to him, "Run." Then Ahimaaz ran by way of the plain, and outran the Cushite.
chapters.kjv: But howsoever, said he , let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് രണ്ടു പടിവാതിലിന്നു മദ്ധ്യേ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു. കാവൽക്കാരൻ പടിവാതിലിന്നും മീതെ മതിലിന്റെ മുകളിൽ കയറി തല ഉയർത്തിനോക്കി ഒരുത്തൻ തനിച്ചു ഓടിവരുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: While David was sitting between the inner and outer gates, the watchman went up to the roof of the gateway by the wall. As he looked out, he saw a man running alone.
chapters.nkjv: Now David was sitting between the two gates. And the watchman went up to the roof over the gate, to the wall, lifted his eyes and looked, and there was a man, running alone.
chapters.kjv: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

chapters.ml: കാവൽക്കാരൻ രാജാവിനോടു വിളിച്ചു അറിയിച്ചു. അവൻ ഏകൻ എങ്കിൽ സദ്വർത്തമാനവും കൊണ്ടാകുന്നു വരുന്നതു എന്നു രാജാവു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The watchman called out to the king and reported it. The king said, "If he is alone, he must have good news." And the runner came closer and closer.
chapters.nkjv: Then the watchman cried out and told the king. And the king said, "If he is alone, thereis news in his mouth." And he came rapidly and drew near.
chapters.kjv: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നടന്നു അടുത്തു. പിന്നെ കാവൽക്കാരൻ മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ ഓടിവരുന്നതു കണ്ടു; കാവൽക്കാരൻ വാതിൽ കാക്കുന്നവനോടു: ഇതാ, പിന്നെയും ഒരു ആൾ തനിച്ചു ഓടി വരുന്നു എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു. അവനും സദ്വർത്തമാനദൂതനാകുന്നു എന്നു രാജാവു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the watchman saw another runner, and he called down to the gatekeeper, "Look, another man running alone!" The king said, "He must be bringing good news, too."
chapters.nkjv: Then the watchman saw another man running, and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, "There is another man, running alone!" And the king said, "He also brings news."
chapters.kjv: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തവന്റെ ഓട്ടം സാദോക്കിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമാസിന്റെ ഓട്ടം പോലെ എനിക്കു തോന്നുന്നു എന്നു കാവൽക്കാരൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു രാജാവു: അവൻ നല്ലവൻ; നല്ലവർത്തമാനം കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The watchman said, "It seems to me that the first one runs like Ahimaaz son of Zadok." "He’s a good man," the king said. "He comes with good news."
chapters.nkjv: So the watchman said, "I think the running of the first is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok." And the king said, "He is a good man, and comes with good news."
chapters.kjv: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

chapters.ml: അഹീമാസ് രാജാവിനോടു ശുഭം, ശുഭം എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ നേരെ കൈ ഓങ്ങിയവരെ ഏല്പിച്ചുതന്ന നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ സ്തുതിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Ahimaaz called out to the king, "All is well!" He bowed down before the king with his face to the ground and said, "Praise be to the Lord your God! He has delivered up those who lifted their hands against my lord the king."
chapters.nkjv: So Ahimaaz called out and said to the king, "All is well!" Then he bowed down with his face to the earth before the king, and said, "Blessed be the Lord your God, who has delivered up the men who raised their hand against my lord the king!"
chapters.kjv: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു അബ്ശാലോംകുമാരൻ സുഖമായിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അഹീമാസ്: യോവാബ് രാജാവിന്റെ ഭൃത്യനെയും അടിയനെയും അയക്കുമ്പോൾ വലിയോരു കലഹം കണ്ടു; എന്നാൽ അതു എന്തെന്നു ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king asked, "Is the young man Absalom safe?" Ahimaaz answered, "I saw great confusion just as Joab was about to send the king’s servant and me, your servant, but I don’t know what it was."
chapters.nkjv: The king said, "Is the young man Absalom safe?" Ahimaaz answered, "When Joab sent the king’s servant and me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I did not know what itwasabout."
chapters.kjv: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king’s servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was .

chapters.ml: നീ അവിടെ മാറി നിൽക്ക എന്നു രാജാവു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ മാറിനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king said, "Stand aside and wait here." So he stepped aside and stood there.
chapters.nkjv: And the king said, "Turn aside and stand here." So he turned aside and stood still.
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto him , Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ കൂശ്യൻ വന്നു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്നു ഇതാ നല്ല വർത്തമാനം; നിന്നോടു എതിർത്ത എല്ലാവരോടും യഹോവ ഇന്നു നിനക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കൂശ്യൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Cushite arrived and said, "My lord the king, hear the good news! The Lord has vindicated you today by delivering you from the hand of all who rose up against you."
chapters.nkjv: Just then the Cushite came, and the Cushite said, "There is good news, my lord the king! For the Lord has avenged you this day of all those who rose against you."
chapters.kjv: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു കൂശ്യനോടു: അബ്ശാലോംകുമാരൻ സുഖമായിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു കൂശ്യൻ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളും നിന്നോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാൻ എഴുന്നേല്ക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരും ആ കുമാരനെപ്പോലെ ആകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king asked the Cushite, "Is the young man Absalom safe?" The Cushite replied, "May the enemies of my lord the king and all who rise up to harm you be like that young man."
chapters.nkjv: And the king said to the Cushite, "Is the young man Absalom safe?" So the Cushite answered, "May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise against you to do harm, be like that young man!"
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is .

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ രാജാവു നടുങ്ങി പടിപ്പുരമാളികയിൽ കയറി: എന്റെ മകനേ, അബ്ശാലോമേ, എന്റെ മകനേ, എന്റെ മകനേ, അബ്ശാലോമേ, ഞാൻ നിനക്കു പകരം മരിച്ചെങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു; അബ്ശാലോമേ, എന്റെ മകനേ, എന്റെ മകനേ! എന്നിങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞു കരഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king was shaken. He went up to the room over the gateway and wept. As he went, he said: "O my son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you—O Absalom, my son, my son!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the king was deeply moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept. And as he went, he said thus: "O my son Absalom—my son, my son Absalom—if only I had died in your place! O Absalom my son, my son!"
chapters.kjv: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അബ്ശാലോമിനെച്ചൊല്ലി ദുഃഖിച്ചുകരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യോവാബ് കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Joab was told, "The king is weeping and mourning for Absalom."
chapters.nkjv: And Joab was told, "Behold, the king is weeping and mourning for Absalom."
chapters.kjv: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാജാവു തന്റെ മകനെക്കുറിച്ചു വ്യസനിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ആ ദിവസം ജനം കേട്ടതുകൊണ്ടു അന്നത്തേ ജയം ജനത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും ദുഃഖമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And for the whole army the victory that day was turned into mourning, because on that day the troops heard it said, "The king is grieving for his son."
chapters.nkjv: So the victory that day was turned into mourning for all the people. For the people heard it said that day, "The king is grieved for his son."
chapters.kjv: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ തോറ്റിട്ടു നാണിച്ചു ഒളിച്ചുവരുംപോലെ ജനം അന്നു പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു ഒളിച്ചുകടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The men stole into the city that day as men steal in who are ashamed when they flee from battle.
chapters.nkjv: And the people stole back into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
chapters.kjv: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു മുഖം മൂടി: എന്റെ മകനേ, അബ്ശാലോമേ, അബ്ശാലോമേ, എന്റെ മകനേ! എന്നു ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king covered his face and cried aloud, "O my son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!"
chapters.nkjv: But the king covered his face, and the king cried out with a loud voice, "O my son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!"
chapters.kjv: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോവാബ് അരമനയിൽ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇന്നു നിന്റെയും നിന്റെ പുത്രീപുത്രന്മാരുടെയും നിന്റെ ഭാര്യമാരുടെയും വെപ്പാട്ടികളുടെയും ജീവനെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരെയും നീ ഇന്നു ലജ്ജിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്നെ പാകെക്കുന്നവരെ നീ സ്നേഹീക്കുന്നു; നിന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവരെ നീ പകെക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Then Joab went into the house to the king and said, "Today you have humiliated all your men, who have just saved your life and the lives of your sons and daughters and the lives of your wives and concubines.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab came into the house to the king, and said, "Today you have disgraced all your servants who today have saved your life, the lives of your sons and daughters, the lives of your wives and the lives of your concubines,
chapters.kjv: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

chapters.ml: പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ഭൃത്യന്മാരും നിനക്കു ഏതുമില്ല എന്നു നീ ഇന്നു കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അബ്ശാലോം ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കയും ഞങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും ഇന്നു മരിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിനക്കു നല്ല പ്രസാദമാകുമായിരുന്നു എന്നു എനിക്കു ഇന്നു മനസ്സിലായി.
chapters.niv: You love those who hate you and hate those who love you. You have made it clear today that the commanders and their men mean nothing to you. I see that you would be pleased if Absalom were alive today and all of us were dead.
chapters.nkjv: in that you love your enemies and hate your friends. For you have declared today that you regard neither princes nor servants; for today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and all of us had died today, then it would have pleased you well.
chapters.kjv: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പുറത്തുവന്നു നിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു സന്തോഷമായി സംസാരിക്ക; നീ പുറത്തു വരാത്തപക്ഷം യഹോവയാണ, ഈ രാത്രി ആരും നിന്നോടുകൂടെ താമസിക്കയില്ല; അതു നിന്റെ ബാല്യംമുതൽ ഇതുവരെ നിനക്കു ഭവിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള സകല അനർത്ഥത്തെക്കാളും വലിയ അനർത്ഥമായ്തീരും.
