chapters.niv: Now go out and encourage your men. I swear by the Lord that if you don’t go out, not a man will be left with you by nightfall. This will be worse for you than all the calamities that have come on you from your youth till now."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, arise, go out and speak comfort to your servants. For I swear by the Lord, if you do not go out, not one will stay with you this night. And that will be worse for you than all the evil that has befallen you from your youth until now."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD , if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ രാജാവു എഴുന്നേറ്റു പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ ഇരുന്നു. രാജാവു പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ജനത്തിനെല്ലാം അറിവു കിട്ടി; സകലജനവും രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the king got up and took his seat in the gateway. When the men were told, "The king is sitting in the gateway," they all came before him. Meanwhile, the Israelites had fled to their homes.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. And they told all the people, saying, "There is the king, sitting in the gate." So all the people came before the king. For everyone of Israel had fled to his tent.
chapters.kjv: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ താന്താങ്ങളുടെ വീടുകളിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയിരുന്നു. എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽ ഗോത്രങ്ങളിലുമുള്ള ജനം ഒക്കെയും തമ്മിൽ തർക്കിച്ചു: രാജാവു നമ്മെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു രക്ഷിച്ചു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു നമ്മെ വിടുവിച്ചതും അവൻ തന്നേ. ഇപ്പോഴോ അബ്ശാലോംനിമിത്തം അവൻ നാടുവിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Throughout the tribes of Israel, all the people were arguing among themselves, saying, "The king delivered us from the hand of our enemies; he is the one who rescued us from the hand of the Philistines. But now he has fled the country to escape from Absalom;
chapters.nkjv: Now all the people were in a dispute throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, "The king saved us from the hand of our enemies, he delivered us from the hand of the Philistines, and now he has fled from the land because of Absalom.
chapters.kjv: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

chapters.ml: നമുക്കു രാജാവായി നാം അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തിരുന്ന അബ്ശാലോമോ പടയിൽ പട്ടുപോയി. ആകയാൽ രാജാവിനെ തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്ന കാര്യത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾ അനങ്ങാതിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and Absalom, whom we anointed to rule over us, has died in battle. So why do you say nothing about bringing the king back?"
chapters.nkjv: But Absalom, whom we anointed over us, has died in battle. Now therefore, why do you say nothing about bringing back the king?"
chapters.kjv: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു പുരോഹിതന്മാരായ സാദോക്കിന്റെയും അബ്യാഥാരിന്റെയും അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു പറയിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദാമൂപ്പന്മാരോടു പറയേണ്ടതു: രാജാവിനെ അരമനയിലേക്കു തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്ന കാര്യത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾ പിമ്പന്മാരായി നില്ക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? രാജാവിനെ അരമനയിലേക്കു തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്ന കാര്യത്തിൽ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്റെയും സംസാരം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: King David sent this message to Zadok and Abiathar, the priests: "Ask the elders of Judah, ‘Why should you be the last to bring the king back to his palace, since what is being said throughout Israel has reached the king at his quarters?
chapters.nkjv: So King David sent to Zadok and Abiathar the priests, saying, "Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the words of all Israel have come to the king, to his very house?
chapters.kjv: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ; എന്റെ അസ്ഥിയും മാംസവും അല്ലോ. രാജാവിനെ മടക്കി വരുത്തുന്ന കാര്യത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾ പിമ്പരായി നില്ക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: You are my relatives, my own flesh and blood. So why should you be the last to bring back the king?’
chapters.nkjv: You are my brethren, you are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’
chapters.kjv: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ അമാസയോടു: നീ എന്റെ അസ്ഥിയും മാംസവും അല്ലോ? നീ യോവാബിന്നു പകരം എപ്പോഴും എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ സേനാപതിയായിരിക്കുന്നില്ല എങ്കിൽ ദൈവം തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും എന്നോടു ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: And say to Amasa, ‘Are you not my own flesh and blood? May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you are not the commander of my army for life in place of Joab.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And say to Amasa, ‘Are you not my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you are not commander of the army before me continually in place of Joab.’ "
chapters.kjv: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൻ സകല യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരുടെയും ഹൃദയം ഒന്നുപോലെ ആകർഷിച്ചു. ആകയാൽ അവർ: നീയും നിന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാരും മടങ്ങിവരുവിൻ എന്നു രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He won over the hearts of the men of Judah so that they were all of one mind. They sent word to the king, "Return, you and all your men."
chapters.nkjv: So he swayed the hearts of all the men of Judah, just as theheartof one man, so that they sent thisword to the king: "Return, you and all your servants!"
chapters.kjv: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ രാജാവു മടങ്ങി യോർദ്ദാങ്കൽ എത്തി. രാജാവിനെ എതിരേറ്റു യോർദ്ദാൻ കടത്തിക്കൊണ്ടുപോരേണ്ടതിന്നു യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാർ ഗില്ഗാലിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the king returned and went as far as the Jordan. Now the men of Judah had come to Gilgal to go out and meet the king and bring him across the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king returned and came to the Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to escort the king across the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

chapters.ml: ബഹൂരീമിലെ ബെന്യാമീന്യനായ ഗേരയുടെ മകൻ ശിമെയിയും യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവിനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
chapters.nkjv: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, who was from Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
chapters.kjv: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ ആയിരം ബെന്യാമീന്യരും ശൌലിന്റെ ഗൃഹവിചാരകനായ സീബയും അവന്റെ പതിനഞ്ചു പുത്രന്മാരും ഇരുപതു ഭൃത്യന്മാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർ രാജാവു കാൺകെ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: With him were a thousand Benjamites, along with Ziba, the steward of Saul’s household, and his fifteen sons and twenty servants. They rushed to the Jordan, where the king was.
chapters.nkjv: Therewere a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over the Jordan before the king.
chapters.kjv: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

chapters.ml: രാജാവിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെ ഇക്കരെ കടത്തേണ്ടതിന്നും അവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നും ചങ്ങാടം അക്കരെ ചെന്നിരുന്നു. അപ്പോൾ ഗേരയുടെ മകനായ ശിമെയി യോർദ്ദാൻ കടപ്പാൻ പോകുന്ന രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വീണു രാജാവിനോടു:
chapters.niv: They crossed at the ford to take the king’s household over and to do whatever he wished. When Shimei son of Gera crossed the Jordan, he fell prostrate before the king
chapters.nkjv: Then a ferryboat went across to carry over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Now Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had crossed the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ യജമാനൻ എന്റെ കുറ്റം എനിക്കു കണക്കിടരുതേ; യജമാനനായ രാജാവു യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട ദിവസം അടിയൻ ചെയ്ത ദോഷം രാജാവു മനസ്സിൽ വെക്കയും ഓർക്കയും അരുതേ.
chapters.niv: and said to him, "May my lord not hold me guilty. Do not remember how your servant did wrong on the day my lord the king left Jerusalem. May the king put it out of his mind.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to the king, "Do not let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember what wrong your servant did on the day that my lord the king left Jerusalem, that the king should take it to heart.
chapters.kjv: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

chapters.ml: അടിയൻ പാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിയുന്നു; അതു കൊണ്ടു ഇതാ, യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനെ എതിരേൽക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി വരുവാൻ യോസേഫിന്റെ സകലഗൃഹത്തിലുംവെച്ചു അടിയൻ ഇന്നു മുമ്പനായി വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For I your servant know that I have sinned, but today I have come here as the first from the tribes of Joseph to come down and meet my lord the king."
chapters.nkjv: For I, your servant, know that I have sinned. Therefore here I am, the first to come today of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king."
chapters.kjv: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ അബീശായി: യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തനെ ശപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ശിമെയി അതുനിമിത്തം മരണശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണ്ടയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said, "Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this? He cursed the Lord ’s anointed."
chapters.nkjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, "Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the Lord’s anointed?"
chapters.kjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ദാവീദ്: സെരൂയയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരേ, ഇന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എനിക്കു എതിരികളാകേണ്ടതിന്നു എനിക്കും നിങ്ങൾക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? ഇന്നു യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ കൊല്ലാമോ? ഇന്നു ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവെന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David replied, "What does this have to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? What right do you have to interfere? Should anyone be put to death in Israel today? Don’t I know that today I am king over Israel?"
chapters.nkjv: And David said, "What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For do I not know that today I am king over Israel?"
chapters.kjv: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശിമെയിയോടു: നീ മരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, രാജാവു അവനോടു സത്യവും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the king said to Shimei, "You shall not die." And the king promised him on oath.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the king said to Shimei, "You shall not die." And the king swore to him.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ മെഫീബോശെത്തും രാജാവിനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ വന്നു; രാജാവു പോയ ദിവസം മുതൽ സമാധാനത്തോടെ മടങ്ങിവന്ന ദിവസംവരെ അവൻ തന്റെ കാലിന്നു രക്ഷചെയ്കയോ താടി ഒതുക്കുകയോ വസ്ത്രം അലക്കിക്കയോ ചെയ്തിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Mephibosheth, Saul’s grandson, also went down to meet the king. He had not taken care of his feet or trimmed his mustache or washed his clothes from the day the king left until the day he returned safely.
chapters.nkjv: Now Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king. And he had not cared for his feet, nor trimmed his mustache, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he returned in peace.
chapters.kjv: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ രാജാവിനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നു വന്നപ്പോൾ രാജാവു അവനോടു: മെഫീബോശെത്തേ, നീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ വരാതെയിരുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, the king asked him, "Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?"
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said to him, "Why did you not go with me, Mephibosheth?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ, എന്റെ ഭൃത്യൻ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു; കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറി, രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു കോപ്പിടേണമെന്നു അടിയൻ പറഞ്ഞു; അടിയൻ മുടന്തനല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: He said, "My lord the king, since I your servant am lame, I said, ‘I will have my donkey saddled and will ride on it, so I can go with the king.’ But Ziba my servant betrayed me.
chapters.nkjv: And he answered, "My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go to the king,’ because your servant is lame.
chapters.kjv: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനോടു അടിയനെക്കൊണ്ടു നുണയും പറഞ്ഞു; എങ്കിലും യജമാനനായ രാജാവു ദൈവദൂതന്നു തുല്യൻ ആകുന്നു; തിരുമനസ്സിലെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ചെയ്തുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: And he has slandered your servant to my lord the king. My lord the king is like an angel of God; so do whatever you wish.
chapters.nkjv: And he has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is like the angel of God. Therefore do whatis good in your eyes.
chapters.kjv: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

chapters.ml: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അടിയന്റെ പിതൃഭവനമൊക്കെയും മരണയോഗ്യർ ആയിരുന്നു; എങ്കിലും അടിയനെ അവിടത്തെ മേശയിങ്കൽ ഭക്ഷിക്കുന്നവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ആക്കി; രാജാവിനോടു ആവലാധി പറവാൻ അടിയന്നു ഇനി എന്തു അവകാശമുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: All my grandfather’s descendants deserved nothing but death from my lord the king, but you gave your servant a place among those who eat at your table. So what right do I have to make any more appeals to the king?"
chapters.nkjv: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king. Yet you set your servant among those who eat at your own table. Therefore what right have I still to cry out anymore to the king?"
chapters.kjv: For all of my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അവനോടു: നീ നിന്റെ കാര്യം ഇനി അധികം പറയുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? നീയും സീബയും നിലം പകുത്തെടുത്തുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ കല്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king said to him, "Why say more? I order you and Ziba to divide the land."
chapters.nkjv: So the king said to him, "Why do you speak anymore of your matters? I have said, ‘You and Ziba divide the land.’ "
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

chapters.ml: മെഫീബോശെത്ത് രാജാവിനോടു: അല്ല, അവൻ തന്നേ മുഴുവനും എടുത്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ; യജമാനനായ രാജാവു സമാധാനത്തോടെ അരമനയിൽ എത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Mephibosheth said to the king, "Let him take everything, now that my lord the king has returned home safely."
chapters.nkjv: Then Mephibosheth said to the king, "Rather, let him take it all, inasmuch as my lord the king has come back in peace to his own house."
chapters.kjv: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദ്യനായ ബർസില്ലായിയും രോഗെലീമിൽനിന്നു വന്നു, രാജാവിനെ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ കടത്തി യാത്ര അയപ്പാൻ അവനോടുകൂടെ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Barzillai the Gileadite also came down from Rogelim to cross the Jordan with the king and to send him on his way from there.
chapters.nkjv: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim and went across the Jordan with the king, to escort him across the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

chapters.ml: ബർസില്ലായിയോ എണ്പതു വയസ്സുള്ളോരു വയോധികനായിരുന്നു; രാജാവു മഹനയീമിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന കാലത്തു അവൻ ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങൾ അയച്ചുകൊടുത്തു; അവൻ മഹാധനികൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Barzillai was very old, eighty years of age. He had provided for the king during his stay in Mahanaim, for he was a very wealthy man.
chapters.nkjv: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, eighty years old. And he had provided the king with supplies while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very rich man.
chapters.kjv: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ബർസില്ലായിയോടു: എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരിക; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ യെരൂശലേമിൽ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പാർപ്പിച്ചു രക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king said to Barzillai, "Cross over with me and stay with me in Jerusalem, and I will provide for you."
chapters.nkjv: And the king said to Barzillai, "Come across with me, and I will provide for you while you are with me in Jerusalem."
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ബർസില്ലായി രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ഞാൻ രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ യെരൂശലേമിൽ വരുന്നതെന്തിന്നു? ഞാൻ ഇനി എത്ര നാൾ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കും?
chapters.niv: But Barzillai answered the king, "How many more years will I live, that I should go up to Jerusalem with the king?
chapters.nkjv: But Barzillai said to the king, "How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
chapters.kjv: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു ഇന്നു എണ്പതു വയസ്സായിരിക്കുന്നു; നല്ലതും ആകാത്തതും എനിക്കു തിരിച്ചറിയാമോ? ഭക്ഷണപാനങ്ങളുടെ സ്വാദു അടിയന്നു അറിയാമോ? സംഗീതക്കാരുടെയും സംഗീതക്കാരത്തികളുടെയും സ്വരം എനിക്കു ഇനി കേട്ടു രസിക്കാമോ? അടിയൻ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്നു ഭാരമായ്തീരുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: I am now eighty years old. Can I tell the difference between what is enjoyable and what is not? Can your servant taste what he eats and drinks? Can I still hear the voices of male and female singers? Why should your servant be an added burden to my lord the king?
chapters.nkjv: I am today eighty years old. Can I discern between the good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear any longer the voice of singing men and singing women? Why then should your servant be a further burden to my lord the king?
chapters.kjv: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

chapters.ml: അടിയൻ രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടപ്പാനേ വിചാരിച്ചുള്ളൂ; രാജാവു ഇതിന്നായി എനിക്കു ഈ വിധം പ്രത്യുപകാരം ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തിനു?
chapters.niv: Your servant will cross over the Jordan with the king for a short distance, but why should the king reward me in this way?
chapters.nkjv: Your servant will go a little way across the Jordan with the king. And why should the king repay me with such a reward?
chapters.kjv: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിൽ എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെയും അമ്മയുടെയും കല്ലറയുടെ അടുക്കൽവെച്ചു മരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അടിയൻ വിടകൊള്ളട്ടെ; എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ ദാസനായ കിംഹാം ഇതാ; അവൻ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ പോരട്ടെ; നിനക്കു പ്രസാദമായതു അവന്നു ചെയ്തു കൊടുത്താലും.
chapters.niv: Let your servant return, that I may die in my own town near the tomb of my father and mother. But here is your servant Kimham. Let him cross over with my lord the king. Do for him whatever you wish."
chapters.nkjv: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, near the grave of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham; let him cross over with my lord the king, and do for him what seems good to you."
chapters.kjv: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു രാജാവു: കിംഹാം എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരട്ടെ; നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടപ്രകാരം ഞാൻ അവന്നു ചെയ്തുകൊടുക്കാം; നീ എന്നോടു ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ നിനക്കായി ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king said, "Kimham shall cross over with me, and I will do for him whatever you wish. And anything you desire from me I will do for you."
chapters.nkjv: And the king answered, "Chimham shall cross over with me, and I will do for him what seems good to you. Now whatever you request of me, I will do for you."
chapters.kjv: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ സകലജനവും യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു. രാജാവു യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നശേഷം ബർസില്ലായിയെ ചുംബനംചെയ്തു അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവൻ സ്വദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: So all the people crossed the Jordan, and then the king crossed over. The king kissed Barzillai and bid him farewell, and Barzillai returned to his home.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the people went over the Jordan. And when the king had crossed over, the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and he returned to his own place.
chapters.kjv: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ഗില്ഗാലിൽ ചെന്നു; കീംഹാമും അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി; യെഹൂദാജനമൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽജനം പാതിയും കൂടി രാജാവിനെ ഇക്കരെകൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the king crossed over to Gilgal, Kimham crossed with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel had taken the king over.
chapters.nkjv: Now the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him. And all the people of Judah escorted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽപുരുഷന്മാർ ഒക്കെയും രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു രാജാവിനോടു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാർ രാജാവിനെയും അവന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെയും ദാവീദിന്റെ സകലപരിചാരകന്മാരെയും മോഷ്ടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു യോർദ്ദാൻ കടത്തിയതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Soon all the men of Israel were coming to the king and saying to him, "Why did our brothers, the men of Judah, steal the king away and bring him and his household across the Jordan, together with all his men?"
chapters.nkjv: Just then all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, "Why have our brethren, the men of Judah, stolen you away and brought the king, his household, and all David’s men with him across the Jordan?"
chapters.kjv: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David’s men with him, over Jordan?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാർ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽ പുരുഷന്മാരോടു: രാജാവു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അടുത്ത ചാർച്ചക്കാരൻ ആകകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ; അതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ കോപിക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? ഞങ്ങൾ രാജാവിന്റെ വക വല്ലതും തിന്നുവോ? അവൻ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വല്ല സമ്മാനവും തന്നുവോ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, "We did this because the king is closely related to us. Why are you angry about it? Have we eaten any of the king’s provisions? Have we taken anything for ourselves?"
chapters.nkjv: So all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, "Because the king is a close relative of ours. Why then are you angry over this matter? Have we ever eaten at the king’s expense? Or has he given us any gift?"
chapters.kjv: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king’s cost ? or hath he given us any gift?

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽപുരുഷന്മാർ യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരോടു: രാജാവിങ്കൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പത്തു ഓഹരി ഉണ്ടു; ദാവീദിങ്കൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു നിങ്ങളെക്കാൾ അധികം അവകാശവും ഉണ്ടു; നിങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളെ ധിക്കരിച്ചതു എന്തു? ഞങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവിനെ തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളല്ലയോ അദ്യം പറഞ്ഞതു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരുടെ വാക്കു യിസ്രായേൽ പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ വാക്കിനെക്കാൾ അധികം കഠിനമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, "We have ten shares in the king; so we have a greater claim on David than you have. Why then do you treat us with contempt? Weren’t we the first to speak of bringing back our king?" But the men of Judah pressed their claims even more forcefully than the men of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, "We have ten shares in the king; therefore we also have more right to David than you. Why then do you despise us—were we not the first to advise bringing back our king?" Yet the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ബെന്യാമീന്യനായി ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു നീചൻ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ കാഹളം ഊതി: ദാവീദിങ്കൽ നമുക്കു ഓഹരി ഇല്ല; യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകങ്കൽ അവകാശവും ഇല്ല; യിസ്രായേലേ നിങ്ങൾ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now a troublemaker named Sheba son of Bikri, a Benjamite, happened to be there. He sounded the trumpet and shouted, "We have no share in David, no part in Jesse’s son! Every man to his tent, Israel!"
chapters.nkjv: And there happened to be there a rebel, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite. And he blew a trumpet, and said: "We have no share in David, Nor do we have inheritance in the son of Jesse; Every man to his tents, O Israel!"
chapters.kjv: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽ ഒക്കെയും ദാവീദിനെ വിട്ടു പിന്മാറി ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബയുടെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നു; യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരോ യോർദ്ദാൻ തുടങ്ങി യെരൂശലേംവരെ തങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവിനോടു ചേർന്നു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: So all the men of Israel deserted David to follow Sheba son of Bikri. But the men of Judah stayed by their king all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: So every man of Israel deserted David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri. But the men of Judah, from the Jordan as far as Jerusalem, remained loyal to their king.
chapters.kjv: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യെരൂശലേമിൽ അരമനയിൽ എത്തി; അരമന സൂക്ഷിപ്പാൻ പാർപ്പിച്ചിരുന്ന പത്തു വെപ്പാട്ടികളെയും രാജാവു അന്തഃപുരത്തിൽ ആക്കി രക്ഷിച്ചു എങ്കിലും അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നില്ല. അങ്ങനെ അവർ ജീവപര്യന്തം കാവലിലിരുന്നു വൈധവ്യം ആചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When David returned to his palace in Jerusalem, he took the ten concubines he had left to take care of the palace and put them in a house under guard. He provided for them but had no sexual relations with them. They were kept in confinement till the day of their death, living as widows.
chapters.nkjv: Now David came to his house at Jerusalem. And the king took the ten women, his concubines whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in seclusion and supported them, but did not go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.
chapters.kjv: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം രാജാവു അമാസയോടു: നീ മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തിന്നകം യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മരെ വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി അവരുമായി ഇവിടെ വരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the king said to Amasa, "Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself."
chapters.nkjv: And the king said to Amasa, "Assemble the men of Judah for me within three days, and be present here yourself."
chapters.kjv: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അമാസാ യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മരെ വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടുവാൻ പോയി; എന്നാൽ കല്പിച്ച അവധിയിലധികം അവൻ താമസിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But when Amasa went to summon Judah, he took longer than the time the king had set for him.
chapters.nkjv: So Amasa went to assemble themenof Judah. But he delayed longer than the set time which David had appointed him.
chapters.kjv: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ ദാവീദ് അബീശായിയോടു: അബ്ശാലോം ചെയ്തതിനെക്കാളും ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബ ഇപ്പോൾ നമുക്കു അധികം ദോഷം ചെയ്യും; അവൻ ഉറപ്പുള്ള വല്ല പട്ടണത്തിലും കടന്നു നമ്മുടെ ദൃഷ്ടിയിൽനിന്നു തെറ്റിപ്പോകാതാരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ നിന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ ചേവകരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു അവനെ പിന്തുടരുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba son of Bikri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your master’s men and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and escape from us."
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. Take your lord’s servants and pursue him, lest he find for himself fortified cities, and escape us."
chapters.kjv: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോവാബിന്റെ ആളുകളും ക്രോത്യരും പ്ളേത്യരും സകലവീരന്മാരും ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബയെ പിന്തുടരുവാൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So Joab’s men and the Kerethites and Pelethites and all the mighty warriors went out under the command of Abishai. They marched out from Jerusalem to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.
chapters.nkjv: So Joab’s men, with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men, went out after him. And they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
chapters.kjv: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഗിബെയോനിലെ വലിയ പാറയുടെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അമാസാ അവർക്കെതിരെ വന്നു. എന്നാൽ യോവാബ് ധരിച്ചിരുന്ന പടയങ്കിമേൽ ഒരു കച്ചയിൽ ഉറയോടുകൂടെ ഒരു വാൾ അരെക്കു കെട്ടിയിരിന്നു; അവൻ നടക്കുമ്പോൾ അതു വീണുപോയി.
chapters.niv: While they were at the great rock in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was wearing his military tunic, and strapped over it at his waist was a belt with a dagger in its sheath. As he stepped forward, it dropped out of its sheath.
chapters.nkjv: When they were at the large stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came before them. Now Joab was dressed in battle armor; on it was a belt with a sword fastened in its sheath at his hips; and as he was going forward, it fell out.
chapters.kjv: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് അമാസയോടു: സഹോദരാ, സുഖം തന്നേയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അമാസയെ ചുംബനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ വലത്തുകൈകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ താടിക്കു പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Joab said to Amasa, "How are you, my brother?" Then Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab said to Amasa, "Are you in health, my brother?" And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
chapters.kjv: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോവാബിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ വാൾ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു അമാസാ സൂക്ഷിച്ചില്ല; യോവാബ് അവനെ അതു കൊണ്ടു വയറ്റത്തു കുത്തി കുടൽ ചോർത്തിക്കളഞ്ഞു; രണ്ടാമതു കുത്തേണ്ടിവന്നില്ല; അവൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി. യോവാബും അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബീശായിയും ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബയെ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Amasa was not on his guard against the dagger in Joab’s hand, and Joab plunged it into his belly, and his intestines spilled out on the ground. Without being stabbed again, Amasa died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bikri.
chapters.nkjv: But Amasa did not notice the sword that was in Joab’s hand. And he struck him with it in the stomach, and his entrails poured out on the ground; and he did not strike him again. Thus he died. Then Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
chapters.kjv: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib , and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

chapters.ml: യോവാബിന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ അതിന്നരികെ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു യോവാബിനോടു ഇഷ്ടമുള്ളവനും ദാവീദിന്റെ പക്ഷക്കാരനും യോവാബിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെല്ലട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: One of Joab’s men stood beside Amasa and said, "Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!"
chapters.nkjv: Meanwhile one of Joab’s men stood near Amasa, and said, "Whoever favors Joab and whoever is for David—follow Joab!"
chapters.kjv: And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

chapters.ml: അമാസാ വഴിനടുവിൽ രക്തത്തിൽ മുഴുകി കിടന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ജനമൊക്കെയും നില്ക്കുന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവൻ അമാസയെ വഴിയിൽനിന്നു വയലിലേക്കു മാറ്റി; അവിടെ എത്തുന്നവനെല്ലാം നില്ക്കുന്നു എന്നു കാൺകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ഒരു വസ്ത്രം അവന്റെമേൽ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the road, and the man saw that all the troops came to a halt there. When he realized that everyone who came up to Amasa stopped, he dragged him from the road into a field and threw a garment over him.
chapters.nkjv: But Amasa wallowed in his blood in the middle of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he moved Amasa from the highway to the field and threw a garment over him, when he saw that everyone who came upon him halted.
chapters.kjv: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

chapters.ml: അവനെ പെരുവഴിയിൽനിന്നു മാറ്റിയശേഷം എല്ലാവരും ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബയെ പിന്തുടരുവാൻ യോവാബിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: After Amasa had been removed from the road, everyone went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.
chapters.nkjv: When he was removed from the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
chapters.kjv: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശേബ എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിലും കൂടി കടന്നു ആബേലിലും ബേത്ത്-മാഖയിലും എല്ലാബേർയ്യരുടെ അടുക്കലും ചെന്നു; അവരും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel Beth Maakah and through the entire region of the Bikrites, who gathered together and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: And he went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel and Beth Maachah and all the Berites. So they were gathered together and also went after Sheba.
chapters.kjv: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

chapters.ml: മറ്റവർ വന്നു ബേത്ത്-മാഖയോടു ചേർന്ന ആബേലിൽ അവനെ നിരോധിച്ചു പട്ടണത്തിന്നു നേരെ വാടകോരി; അതു കിടങ്ങിന്റെ വക്കത്തായിരുന്നു; യോവാബിനോടുകൂടെയുള്ള എല്ലാ പടജ്ജനവും മതിൽ തള്ളിയിടുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഇടിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: All the troops with Joab came and besieged Sheba in Abel Beth Maakah. They built a siege ramp up to the city, and it stood against the outer fortifications. While they were battering the wall to bring it down,
chapters.nkjv: Then they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maachah; and they cast up a siege mound against the city, and it stood by the rampart. And all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.
chapters.kjv: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ജ്ഞാനമുള്ള ഒരു സ്ത്രീ: കേൾപ്പിൻ, കേൾപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ യോവാബിനോടു സംസാരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇവിടെ അടുത്തുവരുവാൻ അവനോടു പറവിൻ എന്നു പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: a wise woman called from the city, "Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come here so I can speak to him."
chapters.nkjv: Then a wise woman cried out from the city, "Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come nearby, that I may speak with you.’ "
chapters.kjv: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അടുത്തുചെന്നപ്പോൾ: നീ യോവാബോ എന്നു ആ സ്ത്രീ ചോദിച്ചു. അതേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവൾ അവനോടു: അടിയന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഞാൻ കേൾക്കാം എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He went toward her, and she asked, "Are you Joab?" "I am," he answered. She said, "Listen to what your servant has to say." "I’m listening," he said.
chapters.nkjv: When he had come near to her, the woman said, "Are you Joab?" He answered, "I am." Then she said to him, "Hear the words of your maidservant." And he answered, "I am listening."
chapters.kjv: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he . Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവൾ ആബേലിൽ ചെന്നുചോദിക്കേണം എന്നു പണ്ടൊക്കെ പറകയും അങ്ങനെ കാര്യം തീർക്കുകയും ചെയ്ക പതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: She continued, "Long ago they used to say, ‘Get your answer at Abel,’ and that settled it.
chapters.nkjv: So she spoke, saying, "They used to talk in former times, saying, ‘They shall surely seek guidance at Abel,’ and so they would end disputes.
chapters.kjv: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter .

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിൽ സമാധാനവും വിശ്വസ്തതയും ഉള്ളവരിൽ ഒരുത്തി ആകുന്നു; നീ യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരു പട്ടണത്തെയും ഒരു മാതാവിനെയും നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ നോക്കുന്നു; നീ യഹോവയുടെ അവകാശം മുടിച്ചുകളയുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We are the peaceful and faithful in Israel. You are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why do you want to swallow up the Lord ’s inheritance?"
chapters.nkjv: I amamongthe peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the inheritance of the Lord?"
chapters.kjv: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD ?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോവാബ്: മുടിച്ചുകളകയോ നശിപ്പിക്കയോ ചെയ്‍വാൻ എനിക്കു ഒരിക്കലും സംഗതിയാകരുതേ.
chapters.niv: "Far be it from me!" Joab replied, "Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!
chapters.nkjv: And Joab answered and said, "Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy!
chapters.kjv: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

chapters.ml: കാര്യം അങ്ങനെയല്ല; ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബ എന്നൊരു എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടുകാരൻ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിനോടു മത്സരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവനെ ഏല്പിച്ചുതന്നാൽ മാത്രം മതി; ഞാൻ പട്ടണത്തെ വിട്ടുപോകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. സ്ത്രീ യോവാബിനോടു: അവന്റെ തല മതിലിന്റെ മുകളിൽനിന്നു നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഇട്ടുതരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: That is not the case. A man named Sheba son of Bikri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Hand over this one man, and I’ll withdraw from the city." The woman said to Joab, "His head will be thrown to you from the wall."
chapters.nkjv: That is not so. But a man from the mountains of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has raised his hand against the king, against David. Deliver him only, and I will depart from the city." So the woman said to Joab, "Watch, his head will be thrown to you over the wall."
chapters.kjv: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ സ്ത്രീ ചെന്നു തന്റെ ജ്ഞാനത്താൽ സകലജനത്തെയും സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചു; അവർ ബിക്രിയുടെ മകനായ ശേബയുടെ തല വെട്ടി യോവാബിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഇട്ടുകൊടുത്തു; അപ്പോൾ അവൻ കാഹളം ഊതി, എല്ലാവരും പട്ടണം വിട്ടു വീടുകളിലേക്കു പോയി. യോവാബ് യെരൂശലേമിൽ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise advice, and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bikri and threw it to Joab. So he sounded the trumpet, and his men dispersed from the city, each returning to his home. And Joab went back to the king in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman in her wisdom went to all the people. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. Then he blew a trumpet, and they withdrew from the city, every man to his tent. So Joab returned to the king at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് യിസ്രായേൽസൈന്യത്തിന്നൊക്കെയും അധിപതി ആയിരുന്നു; യെഹോയാദായുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവു ക്രേത്യരുടെയും പ്ളേത്യരുടെയും നായകൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joab was over Israel’s entire army; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites;
chapters.nkjv: And Joab was over all the army of Israel; Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites;
chapters.kjv: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

chapters.ml: അദോരാം ഊഴിയവേലക്കാർക്കു മേൽ വിചാരകൻ; അഹിലൂദിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് മന്ത്രി;
chapters.niv: Adoniram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
chapters.nkjv: Adoram was in charge of revenue; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
chapters.kjv: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

chapters.ml: ശെവാ രായസക്കാരൻ; സാദോക്കും അബ്യാഥാരും പുരോഹിതന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
chapters.nkjv: Sheva was scribe; Zadok and Abiathar were the priests;
chapters.kjv: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

chapters.ml: യായീർയ്യനായ ഈരയും ദാവീദിന്റെ പുരോഹിതൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest.
chapters.nkjv: and Ira the Jairite was a chief minister under David.
chapters.kjv: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ കാലത്തു മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം തുടരെത്തുടരെ ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായി; ദാവീദ് യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിച്ചപ്പോൾ ശൌൽ ഗിബെയോന്യരെ കൊല്ലുകകൊണ്ടു അതു അവൻ നിമിത്തവും രാക്തപാതകമുള്ള അവന്റെ ഗൃഹം നിമിത്തവും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: During the reign of David, there was a famine for three successive years; so David sought the face of the Lord . The Lord said, "It is on account of Saul and his blood-stained house; it is because he put the Gibeonites to death."
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David inquired of the Lord. And the Lord answered, "Itis because of Saul and his bloodthirsty house, because he killed the Gibeonites."
chapters.kjv: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD . And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ഗിബെയോന്യരെ വിളിച്ചു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു:--ഗിബെയോന്യർ യിസ്രായേല്യരല്ല അമോർയ്യരിൽ ശേഷിച്ചവരത്രേ; അവരോടു യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾ സത്യം ചെയ്തിരുന്നു; എങ്കിലും ശൌൽ യിസ്രായേല്യർക്കും യെഹൂദ്യർക്കും വേണ്ടി തനിക്കുണ്ടായിരുന്ന എരിവിൽ അവരെ സംഹരിച്ചുകളവാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു--
chapters.niv: The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them. (Now the Gibeonites were not a part of Israel but were survivors of the Amorites; the Israelites had sworn to spare them, but Saul in his zeal for Israel and Judah had tried to annihilate them.)
chapters.nkjv: So the king called the Gibeonites and spoke to them. Now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; the children of Israel had sworn protection to them, but Saul had sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah.
chapters.kjv: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഗിബെയോന്യരോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ചെയ്തുതരേണം; നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ അവകാശത്തെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ എന്തു പ്രതിശാന്തി ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David asked the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? How shall I make atonement so that you will bless the Lord ’s inheritance?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore David said to the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? And with what shall I make atonement, that you may bless the inheritance of the Lord?"
chapters.kjv: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD ?

chapters.ml: ഗിബെയോന്യർ അവനോടു: ശൌലിനോടും അവന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തോടും ഞങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള കാര്യം പൊന്നും വെള്ളിയുംകൊണ്ടു തീരുന്നതല്ല; യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ കൊല്ലുന്നതും ഞങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ ചെയ്തുതരാം എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Gibeonites answered him, "We have no right to demand silver or gold from Saul or his family, nor do we have the right to put anyone in Israel to death." "What do you want me to do for you?" David asked.
chapters.nkjv: And the Gibeonites said to him, "We will have no silver or gold from Saul or from his house, nor shall you kill any man in Israel for us." So he said, "Whatever you say, I will do for you."
chapters.kjv: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

chapters.ml: അവർ രാജാവിനോടു: ഞങ്ങളെ നശിപ്പിക്കയും യിസ്രായേൽ ദേശത്തെങ്ങും ഞങ്ങൾ ശേഷിക്കാതെ മുടിഞ്ഞുപോകത്തക്കവണ്ണം ഉപായം ചിന്തിക്കയും ചെയ്തവന്റെ മക്കളിൽ ഏഴുപേരെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുതരേണം.
chapters.niv: They answered the king, "As for the man who destroyed us and plotted against us so that we have been decimated and have no place anywhere in Israel,
chapters.nkjv: Then they answered the king, "As for the man who consumed us and plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the territories of Israel,
chapters.kjv: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ അവരെ യഹോവയുടെ വൃതനായ ശൌലിന്റെ ഗിബെയയിൽ യഹോവെക്കു തൂക്കിക്കളയും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. ഞാൻ അവരെ തരാമെന്നു രാജാവു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: let seven of his male descendants be given to us to be killed and their bodies exposed before the Lord at Gibeah of Saul—the Lord ’s chosen one." So the king said, "I will give them to you."
chapters.nkjv: let seven men of his descendants be delivered to us, and we will hang them before the Lord in Gibeah of Saul, whom the Lord chose." And the king said, "I will give them."
chapters.kjv: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give them .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദും ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാനും തമ്മിൽ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ ചെയ്ത സത്യംനിമിത്തം രാജാവു ശൌലിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാഥാന്റെ മകൻ മെഫീബോശെത്തിനെ ഒഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath before the Lord between David and Jonathan son of Saul.
chapters.nkjv: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the Lord’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
chapters.kjv: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

chapters.ml: അയ്യാവിന്റെ മകൾ രിസ്പാ ശൌലിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരായ അർമ്മോനിയെയും മെഫീബോശെത്തിനെയും ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖൾ മെഹോലാത്യൻ ബർസില്ലായിയുടെ മകനായ അദ്രീയേലിന്നു പ്രസവിച്ച അഞ്ചു പുത്രന്മാരെയും രാജാവു പിടിച്ചു ഗിബെയോന്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons of Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, whom she had borne to Saul, together with the five sons of Saul’s daughter Merab, whom she had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
chapters.nkjv: So the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite;
chapters.kjv: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

chapters.ml: അവർ അവരെ മലയിൽ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ തൂക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഏഴുപേരും ഒരുമിച്ചു മരിച്ചു; കൊയ്ത്തുകാലത്തിന്റെ ആദ്യദിവസങ്ങളായ യവക്കൊയ്ത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭത്തിലായിരുന്നു അവരെ കൊന്നതു.
chapters.niv: He handed them over to the Gibeonites, who killed them and exposed their bodies on a hill before the Lord . All seven of them fell together; they were put to death during the first days of the harvest, just as the barley harvest was beginning.
chapters.nkjv: and he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill before the Lord. So they fell, all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
chapters.kjv: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD : and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest.

chapters.ml: അയ്യാവിന്റെ മകളായ രിസ്പാ ചാകൂശീല എടുത്തു പാറമേൽ വിരിച്ചു കൊയ്ത്തുകാലത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭം മുതൽ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു അവരുടെ മേൽ മഴപെയ്തതുവരെ പകൽ ആകാശത്തിലെ പക്ഷികളോ രാത്രി കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളോ അവരെ തൊടുവാൻ സമ്മതിക്കാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on a rock. From the beginning of the harvest till the rain poured down from the heavens on the bodies, she did not let the birds touch them by day or the wild animals by night.
chapters.nkjv: Now Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until the late rains poured on them from heaven. And she did not allow the birds of the air to rest on them by day nor the beasts of the field by night.
chapters.kjv: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയായി അയ്യാവിന്റെ മകളായ രിസ്പാ ചെയ്തതു ദാവീദ് കേട്ടിട്ടു
chapters.niv: When David was told what Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, Saul’s concubine, had done,
chapters.nkjv: And David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
chapters.kjv: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ചെന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഗിൽബോവയിൽവെച്ചു ശൌലിനെ കൊന്ന നാളിൽ ബേത്ത്-ശാൻ നഗരവീഥിയിൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ തൂക്കിക്കളകയും ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാബേശ് പൌരന്മാർ അവിടെനിന്നു മോഷ്ടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവരികയും ചെയ്തിരുന്ന ശൌലിന്റെയും അവന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാന്റെയും അസ്ഥികളെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: he went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh Gilead. (They had stolen their bodies from the public square at Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hung them after they struck Saul down on Gilboa.)
chapters.nkjv: Then David went and took the bones of Saul, and the bones of Jonathan his son, from the men of Jabesh Gilead who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hung them up, after the Philistines had struck down Saul in Gilboa.
chapters.kjv: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ശൌലിന്റെയും അവന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാന്റെയും അസ്ഥികളെ അവിടെനിന്നു വരുത്തി; തൂക്കിക്കൊന്നവരുടെ അസ്ഥികളെയും അവർ പെറുക്കിയെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there, and the bones of those who had been killed and exposed were gathered up.
chapters.nkjv: So he brought up the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from there; and they gathered the bones of those who had been hanged.
chapters.kjv: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെയും അവന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാന്റെയും അസ്ഥികളെ അവർ ബെന്യാമീൻ ദേശത്തു സേലയിൽ അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ കീശിന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും അവർ ചെയ്തു. അതിന്റെ ശേഷം ദൈവം ദേശത്തിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥനയെ കേട്ടരുളി.
chapters.niv: They buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish, at Zela in Benjamin, and did everything the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer in behalf of the land.
chapters.nkjv: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the tomb of Kish his father. So they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God heeded the prayer for the land.
chapters.kjv: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കു യിസ്രായേലിനോടു വീണ്ടും യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായി; ദാവീദ് തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുമായി ചെന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു പടയേറ്റു; ദാവീദ്, തളർന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Once again there was a battle between the Philistines and Israel. David went down with his men to fight against the Philistines, and he became exhausted.
chapters.nkjv: When the Philistines were at war again with Israel, David and his servants with him went down and fought against the Philistines; and David grew faint.
chapters.kjv: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മുന്നൂറു ശേക്കെൽ തൂക്കമുള്ള താമ്രശൂലം ധരിച്ചവനും പുതിയ വാൾ അരെക്കു കെട്ടിയവനുമായി രാഫാമക്കളിൽ യിശ്ബിബെനോബ് എന്നൊരുവൻ ദാവീദിനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Ishbi-Benob, one of the descendants of Rapha, whose bronze spearhead weighed three hundred shekels and who was armed with a new sword, said he would kill David.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ishbi-Benob, who was one of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose bronze spear was three hundred shekels, who was bearing a new sword, thought he could kill David.
chapters.kjv: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword , thought to have slain David.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ അബീശായി അവന്നു തുണയായ്‍വന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു; അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: നീ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദീപം കെടുക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മേലാൽ ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പറപ്പെടരുതു എന്നു സത്യംചെയ്തു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, saying, "Never again will you go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel will not be extinguished."
chapters.nkjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah came to his aid, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, "You shall go out no more with us to battle, lest you quench the lamp of Israel."
chapters.kjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെശേഷം ഗോബിൽവെച്ചു വീണ്ടും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു യുദ്ധംഉണ്ടായി; അപ്പോൾ ഹൂശാത്യനായ സിബ്ബെഖായി മല്ലന്മാരുടെ മക്കളിൽ ഒരുത്തനായ സഫിനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the course of time, there was another battle with the Philistines, at Gob. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened afterward that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was one of the sons of the giant.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

chapters.ml: ഗോബിൽവെച്ചു പിന്നെയും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായി; അവിടെവെച്ചു ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമ്യനായ യാരെ-ഓരെഗീമിന്റെ മകൻ എൽഹാനാൻ ഗിത്യനായ ഗൊല്യാത്തിനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു; അവന്റെ കുന്തത്തണ്ടു നെയ്ത്തുകാരുടെ പടപ്പുതടിപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In another battle with the Philistines at Gob, Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.
chapters.nkjv: Again there was war at Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed thebrotherof Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
chapters.kjv: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ഗത്തിൽ വെച്ചു യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായി; അവിടെ ഒരു ദീർഘകായൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ ഓരോ കൈക്കു ആറാറുവിരലും ഓരോ കാലിന്നു ആറാറുവിരലും ആകെ ഇരുപത്തുനാലു വിരൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇവനും രാഫെക്കു ജനിച്ചവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.
chapters.nkjv: Yet again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number; and he also was born to the giant.
chapters.kjv: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ധിക്കരിച്ചപ്പോൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ശിമെയയുടെ മകൻ യോനാഥാൻ അവനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David’s brother, killed him.
chapters.nkjv: So when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
chapters.kjv: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.

chapters.ml: ഈ നാലു പേരും ഗത്തിൽ രാഫെക്കു ജനിച്ചവരായിരുന്നു. അവർ ദാവീദിന്റെയും അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുടെയും കയ്യാൽ പട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.
chapters.nkjv: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
chapters.kjv: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദാവീദിനെ സകലശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും ശൌലിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നും വിടുവിച്ചശേഷം അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു സംഗീതംപാടി ചൊല്ലിയതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: David sang to the Lord the words of this song when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
chapters.nkjv: Then David spoke to the Lord the words of this song, on the day when the Lord had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul.
chapters.kjv: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എന്റെ ശൈലവും എൻ കോട്ടയും എന്റെ രക്ഷകനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said: "The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer;
chapters.nkjv: And he said: "The Lordis my rock and my fortress and my deliverer;
chapters.kjv: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പാറയായ ദൈവം; അവനിൽ ഞാൻ ആശ്രയിക്കും; എന്റെ പരിചയും എന്റെ രക്ഷയായ കൊമ്പും എന്റെ ഗോപുരവും എന്റെ സങ്കേതവും തന്നേ. എന്റെ രക്ഷിതാവേ, നീ എന്നെ സാഹസത്തിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation. He is my stronghold, my refuge and my savior— from violent people you save me.
chapters.nkjv: The God of my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, My stronghold and my refuge; My Savior, You save me from violence.
chapters.kjv: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

chapters.ml: സ്തുത്യനായ യഹോവയെ ഞാൻ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കും; എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളിൽനിന്നു താൻ എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and have been saved from my enemies.
chapters.nkjv: I will call upon the Lord, whoisworthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
chapters.kjv: I will call on the LORD , who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

chapters.ml: മരണത്തിന്റെ തിരമാല എന്നെ വളഞ്ഞു; ദുഷ്ടതയുടെ പ്രവാഹങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ഭ്രമിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: The waves of death swirled about me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.
chapters.nkjv: "When the waves of death surrounded me, The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
chapters.kjv: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

chapters.ml: പാതാളപാശങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ചുഴന്നു; മരണത്തിന്റെ കണികൾ എന്റെമേൽ വീണു.
chapters.niv: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
chapters.nkjv: The sorrows of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
chapters.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ കഷ്ടതയിൽ ഞാൻ യഹോവയെ വിളിച്ചു, എന്റെ ദൈവത്തോടു തന്നേ നിലവിളിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ മന്ദിരത്തിൽനിന്നു എന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു; എന്റെ നിലവിളി അവന്റെ ചെവികളിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: "In my distress I called to the Lord ; I called out to my God. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came to his ears.
chapters.nkjv: In my distress I called upon the Lord, And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry entered His ears.
chapters.kjv: In my distress I called upon the LORD , and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമി ഞെട്ടി വിറെച്ചു, ആകാശത്തിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ ഇളകി, അവൻ കോപിക്കയാൽ അവ കുലുങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.
chapters.nkjv: "Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry.
chapters.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മൂക്കിൽനിന്നു പുക പൊങ്ങി, അവന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു തീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ദഹിപ്പിച്ചു, തീക്കനൽ അവങ്കൽനിന്നു ജ്വലിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.
chapters.nkjv: Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it.
chapters.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആകാശം ചായിച്ചിറങ്ങി; കൂരിരുൾ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കീഴുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.
chapters.nkjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet.
chapters.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കെരൂബിനെ വാഹനമാക്കി പറന്നു, കാറ്റിൻ ചിറകിന്മേൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.
chapters.nkjv: He rode upon a cherub, and flew; And He was seen upon the wings of the wind.
chapters.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അന്ധകാരം തനിക്കു ചുറ്റും മണ്ഡപമാക്കി; ജലാശയവും കനത്ത മേഘങ്ങളും കൂടെ.
chapters.niv: He made darkness his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.
chapters.nkjv: He made darkness canopies around Him, Dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
chapters.kjv: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മുമ്പിലുള്ള പ്രകാശത്താൽ തീക്കനൽ ജ്വലിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Out of the brightness of his presence bolts of lightning blazed forth.
chapters.nkjv: From the brightness before Him Coals of fire were kindled.
chapters.kjv: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ആകാശത്തിൽ ഇടിമുഴക്കി, അത്യുന്നതൻ തന്റെ നാദം കേൾപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice.
chapters.kjv: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അസ്ത്രം എയ്തു അവരെ ചിതറിച്ചു, മിന്നൽ അയച്ചു അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.
chapters.nkjv: He sent out arrows and scattered them; Lightning bolts, and He vanquished them.
chapters.kjv: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ഭത്സനത്താൽ, തിരുമൂക്കിലെ ശ്വാസത്തിന്റെ ഊത്തിനാൽ കടലിന്റെ ചാലുകൾ കാണായ്‍വന്നു ഭൂതലത്തിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ വെളിപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of breath from his nostrils.
chapters.nkjv: Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered, At the rebuke of the Lord, At the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
chapters.kjv: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉയരത്തിൽനിന്നു കൈനീട്ടി എന്നെ പിടിച്ചു, പെരുവെള്ളത്തിൽനിന്നു എന്നെ വലിച്ചെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.
chapters.nkjv: "He sent from above, He took me, He drew me out of many waters.
chapters.kjv: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

chapters.ml: ബലമുള്ള ശത്രുവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും എന്നെ പകെച്ചവരുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നും എന്നെ വിടുവിച്ചു; അവർ എന്നിലും ബലമേറിയവർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.
chapters.nkjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me; For they were too strong for me.
chapters.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അനർത്ഥദിവസത്തിൽ അവർ എന്നെ ആക്രമിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ യഹോവ എനിക്കു തുണയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.
chapters.nkjv: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But the Lord was my support.
chapters.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നെ വിശാലതയിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു, എന്നിൽ പ്രസാദിച്ചിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ വിടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.
chapters.nkjv: He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.
chapters.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എന്റെ നീതിക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം എനിക്കു പ്രതിഫലം നല്കി, എന്റെ കൈകളുടെ വെടിപ്പിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം എനിക്കു പകരം തന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.
chapters.kjv: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ വഴികളെ പ്രമാണിച്ചു, എന്റെ ദൈവത്തോടു ദ്രോഹം ചെയ്തതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.
chapters.nkjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
chapters.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the LORD , and have not wickedly departed from my God.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വിധികൾ ഒക്കെയും എന്റെ മുമ്പിലുണ്ടു; അവന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങൾ ഞാൻ വിട്ടുനടന്നിട്ടുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.
chapters.nkjv: For all His judgments were before me; And asfor His statutes, I did not depart from them.
chapters.kjv: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിഷ്കളങ്കനായിരുന്നു, അകൃത്യം ചെയ്യാതെ എന്നെ തന്നേ കാത്തു.
chapters.niv: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.
chapters.nkjv: I was also blameless before Him, And I kept myself from my iniquity.
chapters.kjv: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എന്റെ നീതിക്കു തക്കവണ്ണവും അവന്റെ കാഴ്ചയിൽ എന്റെ നിർമ്മലതെക്കൊത്തവണ്ണവും എനിക്കു പകരം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Lord has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in His eyes.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

chapters.ml: ദയാലുവോടു നീ ദയാലുവാകുന്നു; നിഷ്കളങ്കനോടു നീ നിഷ്കളങ്കൻ.
chapters.niv: "To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,
chapters.nkjv: "With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;
chapters.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

chapters.ml: നിർമ്മലനോടു നീ നിർമ്മലനാകുന്നു; വക്രനോടു നീ വക്രത കാണിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.
chapters.nkjv: With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.
chapters.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

chapters.ml: എളിയ ജനത്തെ നീ രക്ഷിക്കും; നിഗളിച്ചു നടക്കുന്നവരെ താഴ്ത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ ദൃഷ്ടിവെക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You save the humble, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them low.
chapters.nkjv: You will save the humble people; But Your eyes are on the haughty, that You may bring them down.
chapters.kjv: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, നീ എന്റെ ദീപം ആകുന്നു; യഹോവ എന്റെ അന്ധകാരത്തെ പ്രകാശമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: You, Lord , are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.
chapters.nkjv: "For You are my lamp, O Lord; The Lord shall enlighten my darkness.
chapters.kjv: For thou art my lamp, O LORD : and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

chapters.ml: നിന്നാൽ ഞാൻ പടക്കൂട്ടത്തിന്റെ നേരെ പാഞ്ഞുചെല്ലും; എന്റെ ദൈവത്താൽ ഞാൻ മതിൽ ചാടിക്കടക്കും.
chapters.niv: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.
chapters.nkjv: For by You I can run against a troop; By my God I can leap over a wall.
chapters.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വഴി തികവുള്ളതു, യഹോവയുടെ വചനം ഊതിക്കഴിച്ചതു; തന്നെ ശരണമാക്കുന്ന ഏവർക്കും അവൻ പരിച ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.
chapters.nkjv: Asfor God, His way is perfect; The word of the Lordis proven; He is a shield to all who trust in Him.
chapters.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയല്ലാതെ ദൈവം ആരുള്ളു? നമ്മുടെ ദൈവം ഒഴികെ പാറ ആരുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?
chapters.nkjv: "For who is God, except the Lord? And who is a rock, except our God?
chapters.kjv: For who is God, save the LORD ? and who is a rock, save our God?

chapters.ml: ദൈവം എന്റെ ഉറപ്പുള്ള കോട്ട, നിഷ്കളങ്കനെ അവൻ വഴി നടത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
chapters.nkjv: God is my strength and power, And He makes my way perfect.
chapters.kjv: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്റെ കാലുകളെ മാൻ പേടക്കാല്ക്കു തുല്യമാക്കി എന്റെ ഗിരികളിൽ എന്നെ നില്ക്കുമാറാക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.
chapters.nkjv: He makes my feet like the feet of deer, And sets me on my high places.
chapters.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്റെ കൈകൾക്കു യുദ്ധാഭ്യാസം വരുത്തുന്നു; എന്റെ ഭുജങ്ങൾ താമ്രചാപം കുലെക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
chapters.nkjv: He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
chapters.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ രക്ഷ എന്ന പരിചയെ നീ എനിക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ സൌമ്യത എന്നെ വലിയവനാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You make your saving help my shield; your help has made me great.
chapters.nkjv: "You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your gentleness has made me great.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കാലടി വെക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ വിശാലത വരുത്തി; എന്റെ നരിയാണികൾ വഴുതിപ്പോയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.
chapters.nkjv: You enlarged my path under me; So my feet did not slip.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ പിന്തുടർന്നൊടുക്കി അവരെ മുടിക്കുവോളം ഞാൻ പിന്തിരിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: "I pursued my enemies and crushed them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.
chapters.nkjv: "I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.
chapters.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു എഴുന്നേറ്റുകൂടാതവണ്ണം ഞാൻ അവരെ തകർത്തൊടുക്കി; അവർ എന്റെ കാൽക്കീഴിൽ വീണിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I crushed them completely, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
chapters.nkjv: And I have destroyed them and wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.
chapters.kjv: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധത്തിന്നായി നീ എന്റെ അരെക്കു ശക്തി കെട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്നോടു എതിർത്തവരെ എനിക്കു കീഴടക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.
chapters.nkjv: For You have armed me with strength for the battle; You have subdued under me those who rose against me.
chapters.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ പകെക്കുന്നവരെ ഞാൻ സംഹരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ എനിക്കു പുറം കാട്ടുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.
chapters.nkjv: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

chapters.ml: അവർ ചുറ്റും നോക്കിയെങ്കിലും രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ആരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; യഹോവയിങ്കലേക്കു നോക്കി, അവൻ ഉത്തരം അരുളിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.
chapters.nkjv: They looked, but therewas none to save; Even to the Lord, but He did not answer them.
chapters.kjv: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD , but he answered them not.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവരെ നിലത്തിലെ പൊടിപോലെ പൊടിച്ചു, വീഥികളിലെ ചെളിയെപ്പോലെ ഞാൻ അവരെ ചവിട്ടി ചിതറിച്ചു.
