chapters.niv: I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I pounded and trampled them like mud in the streets.
chapters.nkjv: Then I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I trod them like dirt in the streets, And I spread them out.
chapters.kjv: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ കലഹങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും നീ എന്നെ വിടുവിച്ചു, ജാതികൾക്കു എന്നെ തലവനാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ അറിയാത്ത ജനം എന്നെ സേവിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "You have delivered me from the attacks of the peoples; you have preserved me as the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,
chapters.nkjv: "You have also delivered me from the strivings of my people; You have kept me as the head of the nations. A people I have not known shall serve me.
chapters.kjv: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.

chapters.ml: അന്യജാതിക്കാർ എന്നോടു അനസരണഭാവം കാണിക്കും; അവർ കേട്ട മാത്രെക്കു എന്നെ അനുസരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.
chapters.nkjv: The foreigners submit to me; As soon as they hear, they obey me.
chapters.kjv: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

chapters.ml: അന്യജാതിക്കാർ ക്ഷയിച്ചുപോകുന്നു; തങ്ങളുടെ ദുർഗ്ഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു അവർ വിറെച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.
chapters.nkjv: The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.
chapters.kjv: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ജീവിക്കുന്നു; എൻ പാറ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ. എൻ രക്ഷയുടെ പാറയായ ദൈവം ഉന്നതൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be my God, the Rock, my Savior!
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord lives! Blessed be my Rock! Let God be exalted, The Rock of my salvation!
chapters.kjv: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്കയും ജാതികളെ എനിക്കു കീഴാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He is the God who avenges me, who puts the nations under me,
chapters.nkjv: Itis God who avenges me, And subdues the peoples under me;
chapters.kjv: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശത്രുവശത്തുനിന്നു എന്നെ വിടുവിക്കുന്നു; എന്നോടു എതിർക്കുന്നവർക്കു മീതെ നീ എന്നെ ഉയർത്തുന്നു; സാഹസക്കാരന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു നീ എന്നെ വിടുവിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: who sets me free from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.
chapters.nkjv: He delivers me from my enemies. You also lift me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.
chapters.kjv: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു, യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ ജാതികളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ നിനക്കു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്യും, നിന്റെ നാമത്തെ ഞാൻ കീർത്തിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I will give thanks to You, O Lord, among the Gentiles, And sing praises to Your name.
chapters.kjv: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD , among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ രാജാവിന്നു മഹാരക്ഷ നല്കുന്നു; തന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തന്നു ദയ കാണിക്കുന്നു; ദാവീദിന്നും അവന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും എന്നെന്നേക്കും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever."
chapters.nkjv: "He is the tower of salvation to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forevermore."
chapters.kjv: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ അന്ത്യവാക്യങ്ങളാവിതു: യിശ്ശായിപ്പുത്രൻ ദാവീദ് ചൊല്ലുന്നു; ഓന്നത്യം പ്രാപിച്ച പുരുഷൻ ചൊല്ലുന്നു; യാക്കോബിൻ ദൈവത്താൽ അഭിഷിക്തൻ, യിസ്രായേലിൻ മധുരഗായകൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These are the last words of David: "The inspired utterance of David son of Jesse, the utterance of the man exalted by the Most High, the man anointed by the God of Jacob, the hero of Israel’s songs:
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the last words of David. Thus says David the son of Jesse; Thus says the man raised up on high, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel:
chapters.kjv: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു എന്നിൽ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ വചനം എന്റെ നാവിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.
chapters.nkjv: "The Spirit of the Lord spoke by me, And His word was on my tongue.
chapters.kjv: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേലിൻ പാറ എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു: മനുഷ്യരെ നീതിമാനായി ഭരിക്കുന്നവൻ,
chapters.niv: The God of Israel spoke, the Rock of Israel said to me: ‘When one rules over people in righteousness, when he rules in the fear of God,
chapters.nkjv: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spoke to me: ‘He who rules over men mustbe just, Ruling in the fear of God.
chapters.kjv: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

chapters.ml: ദൈവഭയത്തോടെ വാഴുന്നവൻ, മേഘമില്ലാത്ത പ്രഭാതകാലത്തു സുര്യോദയത്തിങ്കലെ പ്രകാശത്തിന്നു തുല്യൻ; മഴെക്കു പിമ്പു സൂര്യകാന്തിയാൽ ഭൂമിയിൽ മുളെക്കുന്ന ഇളമ്പുല്ലിന്നു തുല്യൻ.
chapters.niv: he is like the light of morning at sunrise on a cloudless morning, like the brightness after rain that brings grass from the earth.’
chapters.nkjv: And heshallbe like the light of the morning when the sun rises, A morning without clouds, Like the tender grass springing out of the earth, By clear shining after rain.’
chapters.kjv: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

chapters.ml: ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ എന്റെ ഗൃഹം അതു പോലെയല്ലയോ? അവൻ എന്നോടു ഒരു ശാശ്വതനിയമം ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ: അതു എല്ലാറ്റിലും സ്ഥാപിതവും സ്ഥിരവുമായിരിക്കുന്നു. അവൻ എനിക്കു സകലരക്ഷയും വാഞ്ഛയും തഴെപ്പിക്കയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "If my house were not right with God, surely he would not have made with me an everlasting covenant, arranged and secured in every part; surely he would not bring to fruition my salvation and grant me my every desire.
chapters.nkjv: "Although my house is not so with God, Yet He has made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in all things and secure. For thisis all my salvation and all my desire; Will He not make it increase?
chapters.kjv: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things , and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സകലനീചന്മാരും എറിഞ്ഞുകിടക്കുന്നതും കൈകൊണ്ടു പിടിച്ചുകൂടാത്തതുമായ മുള്ളുപോലെ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But evil men are all to be cast aside like thorns, which are not gathered with the hand.
chapters.nkjv: But thesons of rebellion shall all be as thorns thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with hands.
chapters.kjv: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

chapters.ml: അവയെ തൊടുവാൻ തുനിയുന്നവൻ ഇരിമ്പും കുന്തപ്പിടിയും ധരിച്ചിരിക്കേണം; അവയെ അവ കിടക്കുന്നേടത്തു തന്നേ തീ വെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: Whoever touches thorns uses a tool of iron or the shaft of a spear; they are burned up where they lie."
chapters.nkjv: But the man who touches them Must be armed with iron and the shaft of a spear, And they shall be utterly burned with fire in their place."
chapters.kjv: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്നു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന വീരന്മാരുടെ പേരുകളാവിതു: തഹ്കെമോന്യൻ യോശേബ്-ബശ്ശേബെത്ത്; അവൻ നായകന്മാരിൽ തലവൻ; എണ്ണൂറുപേരെ ഒരേ സമയത്തു ആക്രമിച്ചു കൊന്ന എസ്ന്യൻ അദീനോ ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These are the names of David’s mighty warriors: Josheb-Basshebeth, a Tahkemonite, was chief of the Three; he raised his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.
chapters.nkjv: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-Basshebeth the Tachmonite, chief among the captains. He was called Adino the Eznite, because he had killed eight hundred men at one time.
chapters.kjv: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശേഷം ഒരു അഹോഹ്യന്റെ മകനായ ദോദായിയുടെ മകൻ എലെയാസാർ; അവൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു കൂടിയിരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തുനിന്നു യിസ്രായേല്യർ പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ദാവീദിനോടുകൂടെ നിന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ വെല്ലുവിളിച്ച മൂന്നു വീരന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty warriors, he was with David when they taunted the Philistines gathered at Pas Dammim for battle. Then the Israelites retreated,
chapters.nkjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel had retreated.
chapters.kjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

chapters.ml: അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു കൈതളർന്നു വാളോടു പറ്റിപ്പോകുംവരെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ വെട്ടി; അന്നു യഹോവ വലിയോരു ജയം നല്കി; കൊള്ളയിടുവാൻ മാത്രമേ പടജ്ജനം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: but Eleazar stood his ground and struck down the Philistines till his hand grew tired and froze to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day. The troops returned to Eleazar, but only to strip the dead.
chapters.nkjv: He arose and attacked the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand stuck to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to plunder.
chapters.kjv: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

chapters.ml: അവന്റ ശേഷം ഹാരാർയ്യനായ ആഗേയുടെ മകനായ ശമ്മാ; ഒരിക്കൽ; ചെറുപയർ ഉള്ളോരു വയലിൽ കവർച്ചെക്കു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ കൂടിവന്നപ്പോൾ ജനം ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Next to him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines banded together at a place where there was a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.
chapters.nkjv: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a piece of ground full of lentils. So the people fled from the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

chapters.ml: അവനോ വയലിന്റെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു അതിനെ കാത്തു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ വെട്ടി; യഹോവ വലിയോരു ജയം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field. He defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.
chapters.nkjv: But he stationed himself in the middle of the field, defended it, and killed the Philistines. So the Lord brought about a great victory.
chapters.kjv: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതു നായകന്മാരിൽ മൂന്നുപേർ കൊയ്ത്തുകാലത്തു അദുല്ലാംഗുഹയിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ സൈന്യം രെഫായീംതാഴ്വരയിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: During harvest time, three of the thirty chief warriors came down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.nkjv: Then three of the thirty chief men went down at harvest time and came to David at the cave of Adullam. And the troop of Philistines encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.kjv: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ദാവീദ് ദുർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ആയിരുന്നു; ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കു ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽ അക്കാലത്തു ഒരു കാവൽപട്ടാളം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.
chapters.nkjv: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
chapters.kjv: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.

chapters.ml: ബേത്ത്ളേഹെംപട്ടണവാതിൽക്കലെ കിണറ്റിൽനിന്നു വെള്ളം എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ ആർ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു തരും എന്നു ദാവീദ് ആർത്തിപൂണ്ടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David longed for water and said, "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"
chapters.nkjv: And David said with longing, "Oh, that someone would give me a drink of the water from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!"
chapters.kjv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആ മൂന്നു വീരന്മാരും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ പാളയത്തിൽകൂടി കടന്നുചെന്നു ബേത്ത്ളേഹെംപട്ടണവാതിൽക്കലെ കിണറ്റിൽ നിന്നു വെള്ളം കോരി ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവനോ അതു കുടിപ്പാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ യഹോവെക്കു നിവേദിച്ചു ഒഴിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: So the three mighty warriors broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: So the three mighty men broke through the camp of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, and took it and brought it to David. Nevertheless he would not drink it, but poured it out to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it , and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാണനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുപോയ പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ രക്തം ഞാൻ കുടിക്കയോ? ഇതു ചെയ്‍വാൻ എനിക്കു സംഗതിവരരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതു കുടിപ്പാൻ അവന്നു മനസ്സില്ലായിരുന്നു. ഇതാകുന്നു ഈ മൂന്നു വീരന്മാർ ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: "Far be it from me, Lord , to do this!" he said. "Is it not the blood of men who went at the risk of their lives?" And David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Far be it from me, O Lord, that I should do this! Is thisnot the blood of the men who went in jeopardyof their lives?" Therefore he would not drink it. These things were done by the three mighty men.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD , that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

chapters.ml: യോവാബിന്റെ സഹോദരനും സെരൂയയുടെ മകനുമായ അബീശായി മൂന്നുപേരിൽ തലവൻ ആയിരുന്നു. അവൻ തന്റെ കുന്തത്തെ മന്നൂറുപേരുടെ നേരെ ഓങ്ങി, അവരെ കൊന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ മൂവരിൽവെച്ചു കീർത്തി പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abishai the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.
chapters.nkjv: Now Abishai the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of another three. He lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name among these three.
chapters.kjv: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them , and had the name among three.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂവരിലും മാനം ഏറിയവൻ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർക്കു തലവനായ്തീർന്നു. എന്നാൽ അവൻ മറ്റെ മൂവരോളം വരികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Was he not held in greater honor than the Three? He became their commander, even though he was not included among them.
chapters.nkjv: Was he not the most honored of three? Therefore he became their captain. However, he did not attain to the first three.
chapters.kjv: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

chapters.ml: കബ്സേലിൽ ഒരു പരാക്രമശാലിയുടെ മകനായ യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകൻ ബെനായാവും വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികൾ ചെയ്തു; അവൻ മോവാബിലെ അരീയേലിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരെ സംഹരിച്ചതുമല്ലാതെ ഹിമകാലത്തു ഒരു ഗുഹയിൽ ചെന്നു ഒരു സിംഹത്തെയും കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man from Kabzeel, who had done many deeds. He had killed two lion-like heroes of Moab. He also had gone down and killed a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.
chapters.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

chapters.ml: അവൻ കോമളനായ ഒരു മിസ്രയീമ്യനെയും സംഹരിച്ചു; മിസ്രയീമ്യന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഒരു കുന്തം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവനോ ഒരു വടിയുംകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു മിസ്രയീമ്യന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നും കുന്തം പിടിച്ചുപറിച്ചു കുന്തംകൊണ്ടു അവനെ കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he struck down a huge Egyptian. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
chapters.nkjv: And he killed an Egyptian, a spectacular man. The Egyptian had a spear in his hand; so he went down to him with a staff, wrested the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
chapters.kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

chapters.ml: ഇതു യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവു ചെയ്തു, മൂന്നു വീരന്മാരിൽ കീർത്തി പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.
chapters.nkjv: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and won a name among three mighty men.
chapters.kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മുപ്പതുപേരിൽ മാനമേറിയവനായിരുന്നു എങ്കിലും മറ്റെ മൂന്നുപേരോളം വരികയില്ല. ദാവീദ് അവനെ അകമ്പടിനായകനാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
chapters.nkjv: He was more honored than the thirty, but he did not attain to the first three. And David appointed him over his guard.
chapters.kjv: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.

chapters.ml: യോവാബിയന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അസാഹേൽ മുപ്പതുപേരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമ്യനായ ദോദോവിന്റെ മകൻ എൽഹാനാൻ, ഹരോദ്യൻ, ശമ്മാ, ഹരോദ്യൻ, എലീക്കാ,
chapters.niv: Among the Thirty were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,
chapters.nkjv: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
chapters.kjv: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

chapters.ml: പൽത്യൻ ഹേലെസ്, തെക്കോവ്യനായ ഇക്കേശിന്റെ മകൻ ഈരാ,
chapters.niv: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
chapters.nkjv: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
chapters.kjv: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

chapters.ml: അനഥോത്യൻ, അബീയേസെർ, ഹൂശാത്യൻ, മെബുന്നായി, അഹോഹ്യൻ, സൽമോൻ,
chapters.niv: Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa,
chapters.nkjv: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
chapters.kjv: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

chapters.ml: നെത്തോഫാത്യൻ മഹരായി,
chapters.niv: Abiezer from Anathoth, Sibbekai the Hushathite,
chapters.nkjv: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
chapters.kjv: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

chapters.ml: നെത്തോഫാത്യനായ ബാനയുടെ മകൻ ഹേലെബ്,
chapters.niv: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
chapters.nkjv: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
chapters.kjv: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്യരുടെ ഗിബെയയിൽനിന്നുള്ള രീബായിയുടെ മകൻ ഇത്ഥായി,
chapters.niv: Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin,
chapters.nkjv: Heleb the son of Baanah (the Netophathite), Ittai the son of Ribai from Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
chapters.kjv: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

chapters.ml: പിരാതോന്യൻ ബെനായ്യാവു,
chapters.niv: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai from the ravines of Gaash,
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash,
chapters.kjv: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

chapters.ml: നഹലേഗാശുകാരൻ ഹിദ്ദായി, അർബാത്യൻ, അബീ-അല്ബോൻ, ബർഹൂമ്യൻ, അസ്മാവെത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Abi-Albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
chapters.nkjv: Abi-Albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
chapters.kjv: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

chapters.ml: ശാൽബോന്യൻ എല്യഹ്ബാ, യാശേന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ:
chapters.niv: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan
chapters.nkjv: Eliahba the Shaalbonite (of the sons of Jashen), Jonathan,
chapters.kjv: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ, ഹരാർയ്യൻ, ശമ്മ, അരാർയ്യനായ ശാരാരിന്റെ മകൻ അഹീരാം,
chapters.niv: son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite,
chapters.nkjv: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
chapters.kjv: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

chapters.ml: മാഖാത്യന്റെ മകനായ അഹശ്ബായിയുടെ മകൻ എലീഫേലെത്, ഗിലോന്യനായ അഹീഥോഫെലിന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാം,
chapters.niv: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maakathite, Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
chapters.nkjv: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
chapters.kjv: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

chapters.ml: കർമ്മേല്യൻ ഹെസ്രോ, അർബ്യൻ പാറായി,
chapters.niv: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
chapters.nkjv: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
chapters.kjv: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

chapters.ml: സോബക്കാരനായ നാഥാന്റെ മകൻ യിഗാൽ,
chapters.niv: Igal son of Nathan from Zobah, the son of Hagri,
chapters.nkjv: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
chapters.kjv: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

chapters.ml: ഗാദ്യൻ ബാനി, സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ യോവാബിന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകന്മാരായ അമ്മോന്യൻ സേലെക്ക്, ബെരോത്യൻ നഹരായി.
chapters.niv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
chapters.nkjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite (armorbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),
chapters.kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

chapters.ml: യിത്രിയൻ ഈരാ, യിത്രിയൻ ഗാരേബ്,
chapters.niv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite
chapters.nkjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
chapters.kjv: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

chapters.ml: ഹിത്യൻ ഊരീയാവു ഇങ്ങനെ ആകെ മുപ്പത്തേഴുപേർ.
chapters.niv: and Uriah the Hittite. There were thirty-seven in all.
chapters.nkjv: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
chapters.kjv: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കോപം വീണ്ടും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു: നീ ചെന്നു യിസ്രായേലിനെയും യെഹൂദയെയും എണ്ണുക എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവർക്കു വിരോധമായി ദാവീദിന്നു തോന്നിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Again the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, "Go and take a census of Israel and Judah."
chapters.nkjv: Again the anger of the Lord was aroused against Israel, and He moved David against them to say, "Go, number Israel and Judah."
chapters.kjv: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ രാജാവു തന്റെ സേനാധിപതിയായ യോവാബിനോടു: ദാൻമുതൽ ബേർ-ശേബവരെ യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ ഒക്കെയും നിങ്ങൾ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു ജനത്തെ എണ്ണി ജനസംഖ്യ എന്നെ അറിയിപ്പിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the king said to Joab and the army commanders with him, "Go throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and enroll the fighting men, so that I may know how many there are."
chapters.nkjv: So the king said to Joab the commander of the army who was with him, "Now go throughout all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the number of the people."
chapters.kjv: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോവാബ് രാജാവിനോടു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ കാലത്തു തന്നേ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ജനത്തെ ഇപ്പോൾ ഉള്ളതിൽ നൂറിരട്ടി വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ; എങ്കിലും യജമാനനായ രാജാവു ഈ കാര്യത്തിന്നു താല്പര്യപ്പെടുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Joab replied to the king, "May the Lord your God multiply the troops a hundred times over, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing?"
chapters.nkjv: And Joab said to the king, "Now may the Lord your God add to the people a hundred times more than there are, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king desire this thing?"
chapters.kjv: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും യോവാബും പടനായകന്മാരും രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പന അനുസരിക്കേണ്ടിവന്നു. അങ്ങനെ യോവാബും പടനായകന്മാരും യിസ്രായേൽജനത്തെ എണ്ണുവാൻ രാജസന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab and the army commanders; so they left the presence of the king to enroll the fighting men of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Therefore Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു ഗാദ് താഴ്വരയുടെ മദ്ധ്യേയുള്ള പട്ടണത്തിന്നു വലത്തു വശത്തു അരോവേരിലും യസേരിന്നു നേരെയും കൂടാരം അടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After crossing the Jordan, they camped near Aroer, south of the town in the gorge, and then went through Gad and on to Jazer.
chapters.nkjv: And they crossed over the Jordan and camped in Aroer, on the right side of the town which is in the midst of the ravine of Gad, and toward Jazer.
chapters.kjv: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ ഗിലെയാദിലും തഹ്തീം-ഹൊദ്ശിദേശത്തും ചെന്നു; പിന്നെ അവർ ദാൻ-യാനിലും ചുറ്റി സീദോനിലും ചെന്നു;
chapters.niv: They went to Gilead and the region of Tahtim Hodshi, and on to Dan Jaan and around toward Sidon.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon;
chapters.kjv: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and about to Zidon,

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ സോർകോട്ടെക്കും ഹിവ്യരുടെയും കനാന്യരുടെയും എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളിലും ചെന്നിട്ടു യെഹൂദയുടെ തെക്കുഭാഗത്തു ബേർ-ശേബയിലേക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then they went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the towns of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went on to Beersheba in the Negev of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: and they came to the stronghold of Tyre and to all the cities of the Hivites and the Canaanites. Then they went out to South Judah asfaras Beersheba.
chapters.kjv: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beer-sheba.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ ദേശത്തെല്ലാടവും സഞ്ചരിച്ചു, ഒമ്പതുമാസവും ഇരുപതു ദിവസവും കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: After they had gone through the entire land, they came back to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
chapters.kjv: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് ജനത്തെ എണ്ണിയതിന്റെ ആകത്തുക രാജാവിന്നു കൊടുത്തു: യിസ്രായേലിൽ ആയുധപാണികളായ യോദ്ധാക്കൾ എട്ടുലക്ഷവും യെഹൂദ്യർ അഞ്ചുലക്ഷവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to the king: In Israel there were eight hundred thousand able-bodied men who could handle a sword, and in Judah five hundred thousand.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to the king. And there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
chapters.kjv: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് ജനത്തെ എണ്ണിയശേഷം തന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ കുത്തുകൊണ്ടിട്ടു യഹോവയോടു: ഞാൻ ഈ ചെയ്തതു മഹാപാപം; എന്നാൽ യഹോവേ, അടിയന്റെ കുറ്റം ക്ഷമിക്കേണമേ; ഞാൻ വലിയ ഭോഷത്വം ചെയ്തുപോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David was conscience-stricken after he had counted the fighting men, and he said to the Lord , "I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, Lord , I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."
chapters.nkjv: And David’s heart condemned him after he had numbered the people. So David said to the Lord, "I have sinned greatly in what I have done; but now, I pray, O Lord, take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have done very foolishly."
chapters.kjv: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD , I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD , take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് രാവിലെ എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ ദർശകനായ ഗാദ്പ്രവാചകന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Before David got up the next morning, the word of the Lord had come to Gad the prophet, David’s seer:
chapters.nkjv: Now when David arose in the morning, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
chapters.kjv: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു ദാവീദിനോടു: ഞാൻ മൂന്നു കാര്യം നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വെക്കുന്നു; അതിൽ ഒന്നു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തുകൊൾക; അതു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ചെയ്യും എന്നിപ്രകാരം യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറക.
chapters.niv: "Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "Go and tell David, ‘Thus says the Lord: "I offer you three things; choose one of them for yourself, that I may do it to you." ’ "
chapters.kjv: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD , I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

chapters.ml: ഗാദ് ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു: നിന്റെ ദേശത്തു ഏഴു സംവത്സരത്തെ ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടാകയൊ? അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മൂന്നു മാസം നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾ നിന്നെ പിന്തുടരുകയും നീ അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോകയും ചെയ്കയോ? അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നിന്റെ ദേശത്തു മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തെ മഹാമാരി ഉണ്ടാകയോ? എന്തുവേണം? എന്നെ അയച്ചവനോടു ഞാൻ മറുപടി പറയേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ ആലോചിച്ചുനോക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Gad went to David and said to him, "Shall there come on you three years of famine in your land? Or three months of fleeing from your enemies while they pursue you? Or three days of plague in your land? Now then, think it over and decide how I should answer the one who sent me."
chapters.nkjv: So Gad came to David and told him; and he said to him, "Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or shall you flee three months before your enemies, while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ plague in your land? Now consider and see what answer I should take back to Him who sent me."
chapters.kjv: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days’ pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഗാദിനോടു: ഞാൻ വലിയ വിഷമത്തിൽ ആയിരിക്കുന്നു; നാം യഹോവയുടെ കയ്യിൽ തന്നേ വീഴുക; അവന്റെ കരുണ വലിയതല്ലോ; മനുഷ്യന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഞാൻ വീഴരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let us fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is great; but do not let me fall into human hands."
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Please let us fall into the hand of the Lord, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into the hand of man."
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD ; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാവിലേ തുടങ്ങി നിശ്ചയിച്ച അവധിവരെ മഹാമാരി അയച്ചു; ദാൻ മുതൽ ബേർ-ശേബവരെ ജനത്തിൽ എഴുപതിനായിരം പേർ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel from that morning until the end of the time designated, and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to Beersheba died.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel from the morning till the appointed time. From Dan to Beersheba seventy thousand men of the people died.
chapters.kjv: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവദൂതൻ യെരൂശലേമിനെ ബാധിപ്പാൻ അതിന്മേൽ കൈനീട്ടിയപ്പോൾ യഹോവ അനർത്ഥത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അനുതപിച്ചു ജനത്തിൽ നാശം ചെയ്യുന്ന ദൂതനോടു: മതി, നിന്റെ കൈ പിൻവലിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അന്നേരം യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ, യെബൂസ്യൻ അരവ്നയുടെ മെതിക്കളത്തിന്നരികെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the angel stretched out his hand to destroy Jerusalem, the Lord relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was afflicting the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the Lord was then at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
chapters.nkjv: And when the angel stretched out His hand over Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord relented from the destruction, and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "It is enough; now restrain your hand." And the angel of the Lord was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
chapters.kjv: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

chapters.ml: ജനത്തെ ബാധിക്കുന്ന ദൂതനെ ദാവീദ് കണ്ടിട്ടു യഹോവയോടു: ഞാനല്ലോ പാപം ചെയ്തതു; ഞാനല്ലോ കുറ്റം ചെയ്തതു; ഈ ആടുകൾ എന്തു ചെയ്തു? നിന്റെ കൈ എനിക്കും എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നും വിരോധമായിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When David saw the angel who was striking down the people, he said to the Lord , "I have sinned; I, the shepherd, have done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Let your hand fall on me and my family."
chapters.nkjv: Then David spoke to the Lord when he saw the angel who was striking the people, and said, "Surely I have sinned, and I have done wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Let Your hand, I pray, be against me and against my father’s house."
chapters.kjv: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father’s house.

chapters.ml: അന്നുതന്നേ ഗാദ് ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: നീ ചെന്നു യെബൂസ്യനായ അരവ്നയുടെ കളത്തിൽ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം ഉണ്ടാക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On that day Gad went to David and said to him, "Go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."
chapters.nkjv: And Gad came that day to David and said to him, "Go up, erect an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."
chapters.kjv: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം ഗാദ് പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ദാവീദ് അവിടേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: So David went up, as the Lord had commanded through Gad.
chapters.nkjv: So David, according to the word of Gad, went up as the Lord commanded.
chapters.kjv: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

chapters.ml: അരവ്നാ നോക്കി; രാജാവും അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരും തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നതു കണ്ടാറെ അരവ്നാ പുറപ്പെട്ടുചെന്നു രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Araunah looked and saw the king and his officials coming toward him, he went out and bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: Now Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming toward him. So Araunah went out and bowed before the king with his face to the ground.
chapters.kjv: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

chapters.ml: യജമാനനായ രാജാവു അടിയന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു അരവ്നാ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ദാവീദ്: ബാധ ജനത്തെ വിട്ടുമാറുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിയേണ്ടതിന്നു ഈ കളം നിന്നോടു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങുവാൻ തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" "To buy your threshing floor," David answered, "so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped."
chapters.nkjv: Then Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" And David said, "To buy the threshing floor from you, to build an altar to the Lord, that the plague may be withdrawn from the people."
chapters.kjv: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD , that the plague may be stayed from the people.

chapters.ml: അരവ്നാ ദാവീദിനോടു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്നു ബോധിച്ചതു എടുത്തു യാഗം കഴിച്ചാലും; ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നു കാളകളും വിറകിന്നു മെതിവണ്ടികളും കാളക്കോപ്പുകളും ഇതാ.
chapters.niv: Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take whatever he wishes and offer it up. Here are oxen for the burnt offering, and here are threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood.
chapters.nkjv: Now Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take and offer up whatever seems good to him. Look, hereare oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing implements and the yokes of the oxen for wood.
chapters.kjv: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

chapters.ml: രാജാവേ, ഇതൊക്കെയും അരവ്നാ രാജാവിന്നു തരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിന്നിൽ പ്രസാദിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നും അരവ്നാ രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Your Majesty, Araunah gives all this to the king." Araunah also said to him, "May the Lord your God accept you."
chapters.nkjv: All these, O king, Araunah has given to the king." And Araunah said to the king, "May the Lord your God accept you."
chapters.kjv: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അരവ്നയോടു: അങ്ങനെയല്ല, ഞാൻ അതു നിന്നോടു വിലെക്കേ വാങ്ങുകയുള്ളു; എനിക്കു ഒന്നും ചെലവില്ലാതെ ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് കളത്തെയും കാളകളെയും അമ്പതു ശേക്കൽ വെള്ളിക്കു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: But the king replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying you for it. I will not sacrifice to the Lord my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen and paid fifty shekels of silver for them.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to Araunah, "No, but I will surely buy it from you for a price; nor will I offer burnt offerings to the Lord my God with that which costs me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യഹോവെക്കു അവിടെ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും കഴിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ ദേശത്തിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടു; ബാധ യിസ്രായേലിനെ വിട്ടുമാറുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then the Lord answered his prayer in behalf of the land, and the plague on Israel was stopped.
chapters.nkjv: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the Lord heeded the prayers for the land, and the plague was withdrawn from Israel.
chapters.kjv: And David built there an altar unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു വയസ്സുചെന്നു വൃദ്ധനായപ്പോൾ അവനെ കമ്പിളി പുതപ്പിച്ചിട്ടും കുളിർ മാറിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: When King David was very old, he could not keep warm even when they put covers over him.
chapters.nkjv: Now King David was old, advanced in years; and they put covers on him, but he could not get warm.
chapters.kjv: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്നുവേണ്ടി കന്യകയായൊരു യുവതിയെ അന്വേഷിക്കട്ടെ; അവൾ രാജസന്നിധിയിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചുനിൽക്കയും യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ കുളിർ മാറേണ്ടതിന്നു തിരുമാർവ്വിൽ കിടക്കയും ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So his attendants said to him, "Let us look for a young virgin to serve the king and take care of him. She can lie beside him so that our lord the king may keep warm."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore his servants said to him, "Let a young woman, a virgin, be sought for our lord the king, and let her stand before the king, and let her care for him; and let her lie in your bosom, that our lord the king may be warm."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ സൌന്ദര്യമുള്ള ഒരു യുവതിയെ യിസ്രായേൽദേശത്തെല്ലാടവും അന്വേഷിച്ചു ശൂനേംകാരത്തിയായ അബീശഗിനെ കണ്ടു രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful young woman and found Abishag, a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
chapters.nkjv: So they sought for a lovely young woman throughout all the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
chapters.kjv: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

chapters.ml: ആ യുവതി അതിസുന്ദരിയായിരുന്നു; അവൾ രാജാവിന്നു പരിചാരകിയായി ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്തു; എന്നാൽ രാജാവു അവളെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: The woman was very beautiful; she took care of the king and waited on him, but the king had no sexual relations with her.
chapters.nkjv: The young woman was very lovely; and she cared for the king, and served him; but the king did not know her.
chapters.kjv: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഹഗ്ഗീത്തിന്റെ മകനായ അദോനീയാവു നിഗളിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു: ഞാൻ രാജാവാകുമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞു രഥങ്ങളെയും കുതിരച്ചേവകരെയും തനിക്കു മുമ്പായി ഓടുവാൻ അമ്പതു അകമ്പടികളെയും സമ്പാദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, put himself forward and said, "I will be king." So he got chariots and horses ready, with fifty men to run ahead of him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, "I will be king"; and he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
chapters.kjv: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ അവനെ മുഷിപ്പിക്കരുതെന്നുവെച്ചു അവന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തൊരിക്കലും: നീ ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല; അവനും ബഹുസുന്ദരനായിരുന്നു. അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ ശേഷം ആയിരുന്നു അവൻ ജനിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: (His father had never rebuked him by asking, "Why do you behave as you do?" He was also very handsome and was born next after Absalom.)
chapters.nkjv: (And his father had not rebuked him at any time by saying, "Why have you done so?" He was also very good-looking. Hismother had borne him after Absalom.)
chapters.kjv: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ യോവാബിനോടും പുരോഹിതനായ അബ്യാഥാരിനോടും ആലോചിച്ചുവന്നു; ഇവർ അദോനീയാവിന്നു പിന്തുണയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Adonijah conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they gave him their support.
chapters.nkjv: Then he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they followed and helped Adonijah.
chapters.kjv: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പുരോഹിതനായ സാദോക്കും യഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവും പ്രവാചകനായ നാഥാനും ശിമെയിയും രേയിയും ദാവീദിന്റെ വീരന്മാരും അദോനീയാവിന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei and Rei and David’s special guard did not join Adonijah.
chapters.nkjv: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David were not with Adonijah.
chapters.kjv: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

chapters.ml: അദോനീയാവു ഏൻ-രോഗേലിന്നു സമീപത്തു സോഹേലെത്ത് എന്ന കല്ലിന്നരികെ വെച്ചു ആടുമാടുകളെയും തടിപ്പിച്ച മൃഗങ്ങളെയും അറുത്തു രാജകുമാരന്മാരായ തന്റെ സകലസഹോദരന്മാരെയും രാജഭൃത്യന്മാരായ യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരെയൊക്കെയും ക്ഷണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Adonijah then sacrificed sheep, cattle and fattened calves at the Stone of Zoheleth near En Rogel. He invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the royal officials of Judah,
chapters.nkjv: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep and oxen and fattened cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En Rogel; he also invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants.
chapters.kjv: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകനെയും ബെനായാവെയും വീരന്മാരെയും തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ശലോമോനെയും അവൻ ക്ഷണിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: but he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the special guard or his brother Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, the mighty men, or Solomon his brother.
chapters.kjv: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നാഥാൻ ശലോമോന്റെ അമ്മയായ ബത്ത്-ശേബയോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഹഗ്ഗീത്തിന്റെ മകനായ അദോനീയാവു രാജാവായിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നീ കേട്ടില്ലയോ? നമ്മുടെ യജമാനനായ ദാവീദ് അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then Nathan asked Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, "Have you not heard that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has become king, and our lord David knows nothing about it?
chapters.nkjv: So Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, "Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king, and David our lord does not know it?
chapters.kjv: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ വരിക; നിന്റെ ജീവനെയും നിന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോന്റെ ജീവനെയും രക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ആലോചന പറഞ്ഞുതരാം.
chapters.niv: Now then, let me advise you how you can save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: Come, please, let me now give you advice, that you may save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

chapters.ml: നീ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ, നിന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോൻ എന്റെ അനന്തരവനായിവാണു എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു നീ അടിയനോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തില്ലയോ? പിന്നെ അദോനീയാവു വാഴുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിക്ക.
chapters.niv: Go in to King David and say to him, ‘My lord the king, did you not swear to me your servant: "Surely Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
chapters.nkjv: Go immediately to King David and say to him, ‘Did you not, my lord, O king, swear to your maidservant, saying, "Assuredly your son Solomon shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
chapters.kjv: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

chapters.ml: നീ അവിടെ രാജാവിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ, ഞാനും നിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വന്നു നിന്റെ വാക്കു ഉറപ്പിച്ചുകൊള്ളാം.
chapters.niv: While you are still there talking to the king, I will come in and add my word to what you have said."
chapters.nkjv: Then, while you are still talking there with the king, I also will come in after you and confirm your words."
chapters.kjv: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ബത്ത്-ശേബ പള്ളിയറയിൽ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; രാജാവു വയോധികനായിരുന്നു; ശൂനേംകാരത്തിയായ അബീശഗ് രാജാവിന്നു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Bathsheba went to see the aged king in his room, where Abishag the Shunammite was attending him.
chapters.nkjv: So Bathsheba went into the chamber to the king. (Now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.)
chapters.kjv: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

chapters.ml: ബത്ത്-ശേബ കുനിഞ്ഞു രാജാവിനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു നിനക്കു എന്തു വേണം എന്നു രാജാവു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Bathsheba bowed down, prostrating herself before the king. "What is it you want?" the king asked.
chapters.nkjv: And Bathsheba bowed and did homage to the king. Then the king said, "What is your wish?"
chapters.kjv: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്റെ യജമാനനേ, നിന്റെ മകൻ ശലോമോൻ എന്റെ അനന്തരവനായി വാണു എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു നീ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ അടിയനോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: She said to him, "My lord, you yourself swore to me your servant by the Lord your God: ‘Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne.’
chapters.nkjv: Then she said to him, "My lord, you swore by the Lord your God to your maidservant, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
chapters.kjv: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ, അദോനീയാവു രാജാവായിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ യജമാനനായ രാജാവു അറിയുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: But now Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, do not know about it.
chapters.nkjv: So now, look! Adonijah has become king; and now, my lord the king, you do not know about it.
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:

chapters.ml: അവൻ അനവധി കാളകളെയും തടിപ്പിച്ച മൃഗങ്ങളെയും ആടുകളെയും അറുത്തു, രാജകുമാരന്മാരെയൊക്കെയും പുരോഹിതനായ അബ്യാഥാരിനെയും സേനാധിപതിയായ യോവാബിനെയും ക്ഷണിച്ചു. എങ്കിലും നിന്റെ ദാസനായ ശലോമോനെ അവൻ ക്ഷണിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: He has sacrificed great numbers of cattle, fattened calves, and sheep, and has invited all the king’s sons, Abiathar the priest and Joab the commander of the army, but he has not invited Solomon your servant.
chapters.nkjv: He has sacrificed oxen and fattened cattle and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the commander of the army; but Solomon your servant he has not invited.
chapters.kjv: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

chapters.ml: യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ, യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ അനന്തരവനായി സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതു ആരെന്നു നീ അറിയിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്റെയും കണ്ണു നിന്നെ നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: My lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, to learn from you who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
chapters.nkjv: And as for you, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
chapters.kjv: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

chapters.ml: അല്ലാഞ്ഞാൽ, യജമാനനായ രാജാവു തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചശേഷം, ഞാനും എന്റെ മകൻ ശലോമോനും കുറ്റക്കാരായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Otherwise, as soon as my lord the king is laid to rest with his ancestors, I and my son Solomon will be treated as criminals."
chapters.nkjv: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king rests with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be counted as offenders."
chapters.kjv: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

chapters.ml: അവൾ രാജാവിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഇതാ, നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകൻ വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: While she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet arrived.
chapters.nkjv: And just then, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
chapters.kjv: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

chapters.ml: നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു രാജാവിനോടു അറിയിച്ചു. അവൻ രാജസന്നിധിയിൽ ചെന്നു രാജാവിനെ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And the king was told, "Nathan the prophet is here." So he went before the king and bowed with his face to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: So they told the king, saying, "Here is Nathan the prophet." And when he came in before the king, he bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.
chapters.kjv: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

chapters.ml: നാഥാൻ പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ, അദോനീയാവു എന്റെ അനന്തരവനായി വാണു എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു നീ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Nathan said, "Have you, my lord the king, declared that Adonijah shall be king after you, and that he will sit on your throne?
chapters.nkjv: And Nathan said, "My lord, O king, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?
chapters.kjv: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇന്നു ചെന്നു അനവധി കാളകളെയും തടിപ്പിച്ച മൃഗങ്ങളെയും ആടുകളെയും അറുത്തു, രാജകുമാരന്മാരെയൊക്കെയും സേനാധിപതിമാരെയും പുരോഹിതനായ അബ്യാഥാരിനെയും ക്ഷണിച്ചു. അവർ അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനംചെയ്തു: അദോനീയാരാജാവേ, ജയജയ എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Today he has gone down and sacrificed great numbers of cattle, fattened calves, and sheep. He has invited all the king’s sons, the commanders of the army and Abiathar the priest. Right now they are eating and drinking with him and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
chapters.nkjv: For he has gone down today, and has sacrificed oxen and fattened cattle and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the king’s sons, and the commanders of the army, and Abiathar the priest; and look! They are eating and drinking before him; and they say, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
chapters.kjv: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അടിയനെയും പുരോഹിതനായ സാദോക്കിനെയും യഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവെയും നിന്റെ ദാസനായ ശലോമോനെയും അവൻ ക്ഷണിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: But me your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon he did not invite.
chapters.nkjv: But he has not invited me—me your servant—nor Zadok the priest, nor Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, nor your servant Solomon.
chapters.kjv: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

chapters.ml: യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ അനന്തരവനായി സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതു ആരെന്നു അടിയങ്ങളെ നീ അറിയിക്കാതെ ഇരിക്കെ ഈ കാര്യം യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പനയാലോ നടന്നതു?
chapters.niv: Is this something my lord the king has done without letting his servants know who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?"
chapters.nkjv: Has this thing been done by my lord the king, and you have not told your servant who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?"
chapters.kjv: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

chapters.ml: ബത്ത്-ശേബയെ വിളിപ്പിൻ എന്നു ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചു. അവൾ രാജസന്നിധിയിൽചെന്നു രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then King David said, "Call in Bathsheba." So she came into the king’s presence and stood before him.
chapters.nkjv: Then King David answered and said, "Call Bathsheba to me." So she came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.
chapters.kjv: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ രാജാവു: എന്റെ ജീവനെ സകലകഷ്ടത്തിൽനിന്നും വീണ്ടെുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയാണ,
chapters.niv: The king then took an oath: "As surely as the Lord lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,
chapters.nkjv: And the king took an oath and said, "As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my life from every distress,
chapters.kjv: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോൻ എന്റെ അനന്തരവനായി വാണു എനിക്കു പകരം എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ സത്യംചെയ്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ ഞാൻ ഇന്നു നിവർത്തിക്കും എന്നു സത്യംചെയ്തു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I will surely carry out this very day what I swore to you by the Lord , the God of Israel: Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne in my place."
chapters.nkjv: just as I swore to you by the Lord God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place,’ so I certainly will do this day."
chapters.kjv: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ബത്ത്-ശേബ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു രാജാവിനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു ദീർഘായുസ്സായിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Bathsheba bowed down with her face to the ground, prostrating herself before the king, and said, "May my lord King David live forever!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and paid homage to the king, and said, "Let my lord King David live forever!"
chapters.kjv: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ്: പുരോഹിതനായ സാദോക്കിനെയും പ്രവാചകനായ നാഥാനെയും യഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവെയും വിളിപ്പിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അവർ രാജസന്നിധിയിൽ ചെന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: King David said, "Call in Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada." When they came before the king,
chapters.nkjv: And King David said, "Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada." So they came before the king.
chapters.kjv: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു എന്റെ മകനായ ശാലോമോനെ എന്റെ കോവർകഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി താഴെ ഗീഹോനിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോകുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: he said to them: "Take your lord’s servants with you and have Solomon my son mount my own mule and take him down to Gihon.
chapters.nkjv: The king also said to them, "Take with you the servants of your lord, and have Solomon my son ride on my own mule, and take him down to Gihon.
chapters.kjv: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

chapters.ml: അവിടെവെച്ചു സാദോക്ക് പുരോഹിതനും നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകനും അവനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്യേണം; പിന്നെ കാഹളം ഊതി: ശലമോൻ രാജാവേ, ജയജയ എന്നു ഘോഷിച്ചുപറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: There have Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him king over Israel. Blow the trumpet and shout, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
chapters.nkjv: There let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him king over Israel; and blow the horn, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
chapters.kjv: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെശേഷം നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുവിൻ; അവൻ വന്നു എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു എനിക്കു പകരം വാഴേണം; യിസ്രായേലിന്നും യെഹൂദെക്കും പ്രഭുവായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അവനെ നിയമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then you are to go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah."
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne, and he shall be king in my place. For I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and Judah."
chapters.kjv: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകൻ ബെനായാവു രാജാവിനോടു: ആമേൻ; യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ കല്പിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king, "Amen! May the Lord , the God of my lord the king, so declare it.
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king and said, "Amen! May the Lord God of my lord the king say so too.
chapters.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യജമാനനായ രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നതുപോലെ ശലോമോനോടുംകൂടെ ഇരിക്കയും യജമാനനായ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തെക്കാളും അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തെ ശ്രേഷ്ഠമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As the Lord was with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon to make his throne even greater than the throne of my lord King David!"
chapters.nkjv: As the Lord has been with my lord the king, even so may He be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David."
chapters.kjv: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ സാദോക്ക് പുരോഹിതനും നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകനും യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവും ക്രേത്യരും പ്ളേത്യരും ചെന്നു ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിന്റെ കോവർകഴുതപ്പുറത്തു ശലോമേനെ കയറ്റി ഗീഹോനിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി,
chapters.niv: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon mount King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.
chapters.nkjv: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and took him to Gihon.
chapters.kjv: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

chapters.ml: സാദോക്ക് പുരോഹിതൻ തൃക്കൂടാരത്തിൽനിന്നു തൈലക്കൊമ്പു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു ശലോമോനെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു. അവർ കാഹളം ഊതി, ജനമൊക്കെയും ശലോമോൻ രാജാവേ, ജയജയ എന്നു ഘോഷിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon. Then they sounded the trumpet and all the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Zadok the priest took a horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon. And they blew the horn, and all the people said, "Long live King Solomon!"
chapters.kjv: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ജനമൊക്കയും അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു; ജനം കുഴലൂതി; അവരുടെ ഘോഷംകൊണ്ടു ഭൂമികുലുങ്ങുമാറു അത്യന്തം സന്തോഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And all the people went up after him, playing pipes and rejoicing greatly, so that the ground shook with the sound.
chapters.nkjv: And all the people went up after him; and the people played the flutes and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth seemedto split with their sound.
chapters.kjv: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

chapters.ml: അദോനീയാവും കൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന സകല വിരുന്നുകാരും ഭക്ഷണം കഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അതു കേട്ടു. കാഹളനാദം കേട്ടപ്പോൾ യോവാബ്: പട്ടണം കലങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ ആരവം എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they were finishing their feast. On hearing the sound of the trumpet, Joab asked, "What’s the meaning of all the noise in the city?"
chapters.nkjv: Now Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they finished eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the horn, he said, "Why is the city in such a noisy uproar?"
chapters.kjv: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

chapters.ml: അവൻ പറയുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ ഇതാ, പുരോഹിതനായ അബ്യാഥാരിന്റെ മകൻ യോനാഥാൻ വരുന്നു; അദോനീയാവു അവനോടു: അകത്തുവരിക; നീ യോഗ്യപുരുഷൻ; നീ നല്ലവർത്തമാനം കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Even as he was speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. Adonijah said, "Come in. A worthy man like you must be bringing good news."
chapters.nkjv: While he was still speaking, there came Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest. And Adonijah said to him, "Come in, for you are a prominent man, and bring good news."
chapters.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാൻ അദോനീയാവോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: നമ്മുടെ യജമാനനായ ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു ശലോമോനെ രാജാവാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Not at all!" Jonathan answered. "Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, "No! Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
chapters.kjv: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു സാദോക്ക് പുരോഹിതനെയും നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകനെയും യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവെയും ക്രേത്യരെയും പ്ളേത്യരെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ അയച്ചു. അവർ അവനെ രാജാവിന്റെ കോവർകഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി.
chapters.niv: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites, and they have put him on the king’s mule,
chapters.nkjv: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites; and they have made him ride on the king’s mule.
chapters.kjv: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:

chapters.ml: സാദോക്ക് പുരോഹിതനും നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകനും അവനെ ഗീഹോനിൽവെച്ചു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു. അവർ പട്ടണം മുഴങ്ങുംവണ്ണം സന്തോഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അവിടെനിന്നു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി. ഇതാകുന്നു നിങ്ങൾ കേട്ട ഘോഷം.
chapters.niv: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon. From there they have gone up cheering, and the city resounds with it. That’s the noise you hear.
chapters.nkjv: So Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon; and they have gone up from there rejoicing, so that the city is in an uproar. This is the noise that you have heard.
chapters.kjv: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

chapters.ml: അത്രയുമല്ല ശലോമോൻ രാജസിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.
chapters.nkjv: Also Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
chapters.kjv: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

chapters.ml: രാജഭൃത്യന്മാരും നമ്മുടെ യജമാനനായ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിനെ അഭിവന്ദനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ചെന്നു; നിന്റെ ദൈവം ശലോമോന്റെ നാമത്തെ നിന്റെ നാമത്തെക്കാൾ ഉൽകൃഷ്ടവും അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തെ നിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തെക്കാൾ ശ്രേഷ്ഠവും ആക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Also, the royal officials have come to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make Solomon’s name more famous than yours and his throne greater than yours!’ And the king bowed in worship on his bed
chapters.nkjv: And moreover the king’s servants have gone to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ Then the king bowed himself on the bed.
chapters.kjv: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു തന്റെ കട്ടിലിന്മേൽ നമസ്കരിച്ചു: ഇന്നു എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ എന്റെ സന്തതി ഇരിക്കുന്നതു എന്റെ കണ്ണുകൊണ്ടു കാണ്മാൻ സംഗതി വരുത്തിയ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ സ്തുതിക്കപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said, ‘Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has allowed my eyes to see a successor on my throne today.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Also the king said thus, ‘Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne this day, while my eyes see it!’ "
chapters.kjv: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it .

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അദോനീയാവിന്റെ വിരുന്നുകാർ ഒക്കെയും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വഴിക്കുപോയി.
chapters.niv: At this, all Adonijah’s guests rose in alarm and dispersed.
chapters.nkjv: So all the guests who were with Adonijah were afraid, and arose, and each one went his way.
chapters.kjv: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

chapters.ml: അദോനീയാവും ശലോമോനെ പേടിച്ചു ചെന്നു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went and took hold of the horns of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Now Adonijah was afraid of Solomon; so he arose, and went and took hold of the horns of the altar.
chapters.kjv: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

chapters.ml: അദോനീയാവു ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിനെ പേടിക്കുന്നു; ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു അടിയനെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊല്ലുകയില്ല എന്നു ഇന്നു എന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളെ പിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ശലോമോൻ വർത്തമാനം കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Solomon was told, "Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon and is clinging to the horns of the altar. He says, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And it was told Solomon, saying, "Indeed Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon; for look, he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ "
chapters.kjv: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോഗ്യനായിരുന്നാൽ അവന്റെ തലയിലെ ഒരു രോമവും നിലത്തു വീഴുകയില്ല; അവനിൽ കുറ്റം കണ്ടാലോ അവൻ മരിക്കേണം എന്നു ശലോമോൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Solomon replied, "If he shows himself to be worthy, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground; but if evil is found in him, he will die."
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon said, "If he proves himself a worthy man, not one hair of him shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die."
chapters.kjv: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു ആളയച്ചു അവർ അവനെ യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽനിന്നു ഇറക്കി കൊണ്ടുവന്നു. അവൻ വന്നു ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു. ശലോമോൻ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And Adonijah came and bowed down to King Solomon, and Solomon said, "Go to your home."
chapters.nkjv: So King Solomon sent them to bring him down from the altar. And he came and fell down before King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, "Go to your house."
chapters.kjv: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്നു മരണകാലം അടുത്തുവന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോനോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: When the time drew near for David to die, he gave a charge to Solomon his son.
chapters.nkjv: Now the days of David drew near that he should die, and he charged Solomon his son, saying:
chapters.kjv: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സകലഭൂവാസികളുടെയും വഴിയായി പോകുന്നു; നീ ധൈര്യംപൂണ്ടു പുരുഷനായിരിക്ക.
chapters.niv: "I am about to go the way of all the earth," he said. "So be strong, act like a man,
chapters.nkjv: "I go the way of all the earth; be strong, therefore, and prove yourself a man.
chapters.kjv: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

chapters.ml: നീ എന്തു ചെയ്താലും എവിടേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞാലും സകലത്തിലും നീ കൃതാർത്ഥനാകേണ്ടതിന്നും നിന്റെ മക്കൾ പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണ മനസ്സോടുംകൂടെ എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ സത്യമായി നടന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ വഴി സൂക്ഷിച്ചാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിപ്പാൻ ഒരു പുരുഷൻ നിനക്കു ഇല്ലാതെ പോകയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനം താൻ ഉറപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നുമായി
chapters.niv: and observe what the Lord your God requires: Walk in obedience to him, and keep his decrees and commands, his laws and regulations, as written in the Law of Moses. Do this so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you go
chapters.nkjv: And keep the charge of the Lord your God: to walk in His ways, to keep His statutes, His commandments, His judgments, and His testimonies, as it is written in the Law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn;
chapters.kjv: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ വഴികളിൽ നടന്നു അവന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളും കല്പനകളും വിധികളും സാക്ഷ്യങ്ങളും പ്രമാണിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ ആജ്ഞ അനുസരിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: and that the Lord may keep his promise to me: ‘If your descendants watch how they live, and if they walk faithfully before me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’
chapters.nkjv: that the Lord may fulfill His word which He spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your sons take heed to their way, to walk before Me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul,’ He said, ‘you shall not lack a man on the throne of Israel.’
chapters.kjv: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

chapters.ml: വിശേഷിച്ചു സെരൂയയുടെ മകൻ യോവാബ് എന്നോടു ചെയ്തതു, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രണ്ടു സേനാധിപന്മാരായ നേരിന്റെ മകൻ അബ്നേരിനോടും യേഥെരിന്റെ മകൻ അമാസയോടും ചെയ്തതു തന്നേ നീയും അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ; അവൻ അവരെ കൊന്നു സമാധാനസമയത്തു യുദ്ധരക്തം ചൊരിഞ്ഞു യുദ്ധരക്തം തന്റെ അരക്കച്ചയിലും കാലിലെ ചെരിപ്പിലും ആക്കിയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Now you yourself know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to the two commanders of Israel’s armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He killed them, shedding their blood in peacetime as if in battle, and with that blood he stained the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.
chapters.nkjv: "Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two commanders of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed.
