And he shed the blood of war in peacetime, and put the blood of war on his belt that was around his waist, and on his sandals that were on his feet.
chapters.kjv: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ ജ്ഞാനം പ്രയോഗിച്ചു അവന്റെ നരയെ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പാതാളത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങുവാൻ സമ്മതിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Deal with him according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to the grave in peace.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore do according to your wisdom, and do not let his gray hair go down to the grave in peace.
chapters.kjv: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഗിലെയാദ്യനായ ബർസില്ലായിയുടെ മക്കൾക്കു നീ ദയകാണിക്കേണം; അവർ നിന്റെ മേശയിങ്കൽ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കുന്നവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഞാൻ ഓടിപ്പോകുമ്പോൾ അവർ അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ എന്നോടും പെരുമാറി.
chapters.niv: "But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead and let them be among those who eat at your table. They stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
chapters.nkjv: "But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.
chapters.kjv: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ബഹൂരീമിലെ ബെന്യാമീന്യനായ ഗേരയുടെ മകൻ ശിമെയി എന്നൊരുവൻ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; ഞാൻ മഹനയീമിലേക്കു പോകുന്ന ദിവസം അവൻ എന്നെ കഠിനശാപത്തോടെ ശപിച്ചു; എങ്കിലും അവൻ യോർദ്ദാങ്കൽ എന്നെ എതിരേറ്റുവന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊല്ലുകയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ യഹോവാനാമത്തിൽ അവനോടു സത്യംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "And remember, you have with you Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, who called down bitter curses on me the day I went to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the Lord : ‘I will not put you to death by the sword.’
chapters.nkjv: "And see, youhave with you Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, who cursed me with a malicious curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim. But he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’
chapters.kjv: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD , saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ അവനെ ശിക്ഷിക്കാതെ വിടരുതു; നീ ബുദ്ധിമാനല്ലോ; അവനോടു എന്തു ചെയ്യേണമെന്നു നീ അറിയും; അവന്റെ നരയെ രക്തത്തോടെ പാതാളത്തിലേക്കു അയക്കുക.
chapters.niv: But now, do not consider him innocent. You are a man of wisdom; you will know what to do to him. Bring his gray head down to the grave in blood."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, do not hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man and know what you ought to do to him; but bring his gray hair down to the grave with blood."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then David rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David.
chapters.nkjv: So David rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David.
chapters.kjv: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യിസ്രായേലിൽ വാണ കാലം നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം. അവൻ ഹെബ്രോനിൽ ഏഴു സംവത്സരവും യെരൂശലേമിൽ മുപ്പത്തുമൂന്നു സംവത്സരവും വാണു.
chapters.niv: He had reigned forty years over Israel—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: The period that David reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years he reigned in Hebron, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.
chapters.kjv: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു; അവന്റെ രാജത്വം ഏറ്റവും സ്ഥിരമായിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his rule was firmly established.
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon sat on the throne of his father David; and his kingdom was firmly established.
chapters.kjv: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹഗ്ഗീത്തിന്റെ മകനായ അദോനീയാവു ശലോമോന്റെ അമ്മയായ ബത്ത്-ശേബയെ ചെന്നുകണ്ടു; നിന്റെ വരവു ശുഭമോ എന്നു അവൾ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ശുഭം തന്നേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now Adonijah, the son of Haggith, went to Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother. Bathsheba asked him, "Do you come peacefully?" He answered, "Yes, peacefully."
chapters.nkjv: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. So she said, "Do you come peaceably?" And he said, "Peaceably."
chapters.kjv: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു നിന്നോടു ഒരു കാര്യം പറവാനുണ്ടു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. പറക എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he added, "I have something to say to you." "You may say it," she replied.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover he said, "I have something tosay to you." And she said, "Say it."
chapters.kjv: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: രാജത്വം എനിക്കുള്ളതായിരുന്നു; ഞാൻ വാഴേണ്ടതിന്നു യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും പ്രതീക്ഷിച്ചിരുന്നു എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ; എന്നാൽ രാജത്വം മറിഞ്ഞു എന്റെ സഹോദരന്നു ആയിപ്പോയി; യഹോവയാൽ അതു അവന്നു ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "As you know," he said, "the kingdom was mine. All Israel looked to me as their king. But things changed, and the kingdom has gone to my brother; for it has come to him from the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "You know that the kingdom was mine, and all Israel had set their expectations on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom has been turned over, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ഒരു കാര്യം അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു; അതു തള്ളിക്കളയരുതേ. നീ പറക എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now I have one request to make of you. Do not refuse me." "You may make it," she said.
chapters.nkjv: Now I ask one petition of you; do not deny me." And she said to him, "Say it."
chapters.kjv: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: ശൂനേംകാരത്തിയായ അബീശഗിനെ എനിക്കു ഭാര്യയായിട്ടു തരുവാൻ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിനോടു പറയേണമേ; അവൻ നിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ തള്ളുകയില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So he continued, "Please ask King Solomon—he will not refuse you—to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Please speak to King Solomon, for he will not refuse you, that he may give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

chapters.ml: ആകട്ടെ; ഞാൻ നിനക്കുവേണ്ടി രാജാവിനോടു സംസാരിക്കാം എന്നു ബത്ത്-ശേബ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Very well," Bathsheba replied, "I will speak to the king for you."
chapters.nkjv: So Bathsheba said, "Very well, I will speak for you to the king."
chapters.kjv: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ബത്ത്-ശേബ അദോനീയാവിന്നുവേണ്ടി ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിനോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു. രാജാവു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവളെ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു വന്ദനം ചെയ്തു തന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു രാജമാതാവിന്നു ഇരിപ്പാൻ കൊടുപ്പിച്ചു; അവൾ അവന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah, the king stood up to meet her, bowed down to her and sat down on his throne. He had a throne brought for the king’s mother, and she sat down at his right hand.
chapters.nkjv: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her and bowed down to her, and sat down on his throne and had a throne set for the king’s mother; so she sat at his right hand.
chapters.kjv: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ഒരു ചെറിയ കാര്യം അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ അപേക്ഷ തള്ളിക്കളയരുതു എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു. രാജാവു അവളോടു: എന്റെ അമ്മേ, ചോദിച്ചാലും; ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ തള്ളുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I have one small request to make of you," she said. "Do not refuse me." The king replied, "Make it, my mother; I will not refuse you."
chapters.nkjv: Then she said, "I desire one small petition of you; do not refuse me." And the king said to her, "Ask it, my mother, for I will not refuse you."
chapters.kjv: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee , say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൾ: ശൂനേംകാരത്തിയായ അബീശഗിനെ നിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അദോനീയാവിന്നു ഭാര്യയായിട്ടു കൊടുക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So she said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given in marriage to your brother Adonijah."
chapters.nkjv: So she said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife."
chapters.kjv: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു തന്റെ അമ്മയോടു: ശൂനേംകാരത്തിയായ അബീശഗിനെ അദോനീയാവിന്നു വേണ്ടി ചോദിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? രാജത്വത്തെയും അവന്നുവേണ്ടി ചോദിക്കരുതോ? അവൻ എന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠനല്ലോ; അവന്നും പുരോഹിതൻ അബ്യാഥാരിന്നും സെരൂയയുടെ മകൻ യോവാബിന്നും വേണ്ടി തന്നേ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon answered his mother, "Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? You might as well request the kingdom for him—after all, he is my older brother—yes, for him and for Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah!"
chapters.nkjv: And King Solomon answered and said to his mother, "Now why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also—for he is my older brother—for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah."
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

chapters.ml: അദോനീയാവു ഈ കാര്യം ചോദിച്ചതു തന്റെ ജീവനാശത്തിന്നായിട്ടല്ലെങ്കിൽ ദൈവം തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും എന്നോടു ചെയ്യട്ടെ;
chapters.niv: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord : "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if Adonijah does not pay with his life for this request!
chapters.nkjv: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord, saying, "May God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life!
chapters.kjv: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD , saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ എന്നെ സ്ഥിരപ്പെടുത്തിയവനും എന്നെ എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുത്തി തന്റെ വാഗ്ദാനപ്രകാരം എനിക്കു ഒരു ഗൃഹം പണിതവനുമായ യഹോവയാണ, ഇന്നു തന്നേ അദോനീയാവു മരിക്കേണം എന്നു ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചു യഹോവനാമത്തിൽ സത്യം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And now, as surely as the Lord lives—he who has established me securely on the throne of my father David and has founded a dynasty for me as he promised—Adonijah shall be put to death today!"
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, as the Lord lives, who has confirmed me and set me on the throne of David my father, and who has established a house for me, as He promised, Adonijah shall be put to death today!"
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവെ അയച്ചു; അവൻ അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So King Solomon gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he struck down Adonijah and he died.
chapters.nkjv: So King Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he struck him down, and he died.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

chapters.ml: അബ്യാഥാർപുരോഹിതനോടു രാജാവു: നീ അനാഥോത്തിലെ നിന്റെ ജന്മഭൂമിയിലേക്കു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; നീ മരണയോഗ്യനാകുന്നു; എങ്കിലും നീ എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കർത്താവായ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ചുമന്നതുകൊണ്ടും എന്റെ അപ്പൻ അനുഭവിച്ച സകലകഷ്ടങ്ങളെയും നീ കൂടെ അനുഭവിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടും ഞാൻ ഇന്നു നിന്നെ കൊല്ലുന്നില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: To Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go back to your fields in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not put you to death now, because you carried the ark of the Sovereign Lord before my father David and shared all my father’s hardships."
chapters.nkjv: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are deserving of death; but I will not put you to death at this time, because you carried the ark of the Lord God before my father David, and because you were afflicted every time my father was afflicted."
chapters.kjv: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യഹോവ ശീലോവിൽവെച്ചു ഏലിയുടെ കുടുംബത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനത്തിന്നു നിവൃത്തിവരേണ്ടതിന്നു ശലോമോൻ അബ്യാഥാരിനെ യഹോവയുടെ പൌരോഹിത്യത്തിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Solomon removed Abiathar from the priesthood of the Lord , fulfilling the word the Lord had spoken at Shiloh about the house of Eli.
chapters.nkjv: So Solomon removed Abiathar from being priest to the Lord, that he might fulfill the word of the Lord which He spoke concerning the house of Eli at Shiloh.
chapters.kjv: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD ; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD , which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

chapters.ml: ഈ വർത്തമാനം യോവാബിന്നു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ--യോവാബ് അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നിരുന്നില്ലെങ്കിലും അദോനീയാവിന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നിരുന്നു--അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah though not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Then news came to Joab, for Joab had defected to Adonijah, though he had not defected to Absalom. So Joab fled to the tabernacle of the Lord, and took hold of the horns of the altar.
chapters.kjv: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD , and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് യഹോവയുടെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നില്ക്കുന്നു എന്നു ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടി. അപ്പോൾ ശലോമോൻ യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവെ അയച്ചു: നീ ചെന്നു അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കളക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the tent of the Lord and was beside the altar. Then Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada, "Go, strike him down!"
chapters.nkjv: And King Solomon was told, "Joab has fled to the tabernacle of the Lord; there heis, by the altar." Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, "Go, strike him down."
chapters.kjv: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD ; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

chapters.ml: ബെനായാവു യെഹോവയുടെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു: നീ പുറത്തുവരിക എന്നു രാജാവു കല്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. ഇല്ല; ഞാൻ ഇവിടെ തന്നെ മരിക്കും എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. ബെനായാവു ചെന്നു: യോവാബ് ഇങ്ങനെ പറയുന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ അവൻ എന്നോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു രാജാവിനെ ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Benaiah entered the tent of the Lord and said to Joab, "The king says, ‘Come out!’ " But he answered, "No, I will die here." Benaiah reported to the king, "This is how Joab answered me."
chapters.nkjv: So Benaiah went to the tabernacle of the Lord, and said to him, "Thus says the king, ‘Come out!’ " And he said, "No, but I will die here." And Benaiah brought back word to the king, saying, "Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me."
chapters.kjv: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD , and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ നീ ചെയ്ക; അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു കുഴിച്ചിടുക; യോവാബ് കാരണം കൂടാതെ ചിന്നിയ രക്തം നീ ഇങ്ങനെ എങ്കൽ നിന്നും എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിങ്കൽനിന്നും നീക്കിക്കളക.
chapters.niv: Then the king commanded Benaiah, "Do as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so clear me and my whole family of the guilt of the innocent blood that Joab shed.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to him, "Do as he has said, and strike him down and bury him, that you may take away from me and from the house of my father the innocent blood which Joab shed.
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ രക്തപാതകം യഹോവ അവന്റെ തലമേൽ തന്നേ വരുത്തും; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സേനാധിപതിയായ നേരിന്റെ മകൻ അബ്നേർ, യെഹൂദയുടെ സേനാധിപതിയായ യേഥെരിന്റെ മകൻ അമാസാ എന്നിങ്ങനെ തന്നെക്കാൾ നീതിയും സൽഗുണവുമുള്ള രണ്ടു പുരുഷന്മാരെ അവൻ എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദ് അറിയാതെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The Lord will repay him for the blood he shed, because without my father David knowing it he attacked two men and killed them with the sword. Both of them—Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army—were better men and more upright than he.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord will return his blood on his head, because he struck down two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword— Abner the son of Ner, the commander of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, the commander of the army of Judah—though my father David did not know it.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit , Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ രക്തം എന്നേക്കും യോവാബിന്റെയും അവന്റെ സന്തതിയുടെയും തലമേൽ ഇരിക്കും; ദാവീദിന്നും അവന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും ഗൃഹത്തിന്നും സിംഹാസനത്തിന്നും യഹോവയിങ്കൽനിന്നു എന്നേക്കും സമാധാനം ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: May the guilt of their blood rest on the head of Joab and his descendants forever. But on David and his descendants, his house and his throne, may there be the Lord ’s peace forever."
chapters.nkjv: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab and upon the head of his descendants forever. But upon David and his descendants, upon his house and his throne, there shall be peace forever from the Lord."
chapters.kjv: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD .

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവു ചെന്നു അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു; മരുഭൂമിയിലെ അവന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck down Joab and killed him, and he was buried at his home out in the country.
chapters.nkjv: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and struck and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അവന്നു പകരം യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവെ സേനാധിപതിയാക്കി അബ്യാഥാരിന്നു പകരം സാദോക്ക് പുരോഹിതനെയും നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king put Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the army in Joab’s position and replaced Abiathar with Zadok the priest.
chapters.nkjv: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army, and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.
chapters.kjv: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രാജാവു ആളയച്ചു ശിമെയിയെ വരുത്തി അവനോടു: നീ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിനക്കു ഒരു വീടു പണിതു പാർത്തുകൊൾക; അവിടെനിന്നു പുറത്തെങ്ങും പോകരുതു.
chapters.niv: Then the king sent for Shimei and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and dwell there, and do not go out from there anywhere.
chapters.kjv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

chapters.ml: പുറത്തിറങ്ങി കിദ്രോൻ തോടു കടക്കുന്ന നാളിൽ നീ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവരും എന്നു തീർച്ചയായി അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾക; നിന്റെ രക്തം നിന്റെ തലമേൽ തന്നേ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The day you leave and cross the Kidron Valley, you can be sure you will die; your blood will be on your own head."
chapters.nkjv: For it shall be, on the day you go out and cross the Brook Kidron, know for certain you shall surely die; your blood shall be on your own head."
chapters.kjv: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയി രാജാവിനോടു: അതു നല്ലവാക്കു; യജമാനനായ രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അടിയൻ ചെയ്തുകൊള്ളാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ശിമെയി കുറെക്കാലം യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Shimei answered the king, "What you say is good. Your servant will do as my lord the king has said." And Shimei stayed in Jerusalem for a long time.
chapters.nkjv: And Shimei said to the king, "The saying is good. As my lord the king has said, so your servant will do." So Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
chapters.kjv: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ശിമെയിയുടെ രണ്ടു അടിമകൾ മാഖയുടെ മകനായ ആഖീശ് എന്ന ഗത്ത്‌രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിപ്പോയി; തന്റെ അടിമകൾ ഗത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടെന്നു ശിമെയിക്കു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: But three years later, two of Shimei’s slaves ran off to Achish son of Maakah, king of Gath, and Shimei was told, "Your slaves are in Gath."
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened at the end of three years, that two slaves of Shimei ran away to Achish the son of Maachah, king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, "Look, your slaves are in Gath!"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശിമെയി എഴുന്നേറ്റു കഴുതെക്കു കോപ്പിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു അടിമകളെ അന്വേഷിപ്പാൻ ഗത്തിൽ ആഖീശിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോയി; അങ്ങനെ ശിമെയി ചെന്നു അടിമകളെ ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു കൊണ്ടു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: At this, he saddled his donkey and went to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves. So Shimei went away and brought the slaves back from Gath.
chapters.nkjv: So Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Achish at Gath to seek his slaves. And Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.
chapters.kjv: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയി യെരൂശലേം വിട്ടു ഗത്തിൽ പോയി മടങ്ങിവന്നു എന്നു ശലോമോന്നു അറിവുകിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had come back.
chapters.kjv: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു ആളയച്ചു ശിമെയിയെ വരുത്തി അവനോടു: നീ പുറത്തിറങ്ങി എവിടെയെങ്കിലും പോകുന്നനാളിൽ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവരുമെന്നു തീർച്ചയായി അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾക എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു യഹോവാനാമത്തിൽ സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചു സാക്ഷീകരിക്കയും ഞാൻ കേട്ട വാക്കു നല്ലതെന്നു നീ എന്നോടു പറകയും ചെയ്തില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord and warn you, ‘On the day you leave to go anywhere else, you can be sure you will die’? At that time you said to me, ‘What you say is good. I will obey.’
chapters.nkjv: Then the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord, and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and travel anywhere, you shall surely die’? And you said to me, ‘The word I have heard is good.’
chapters.kjv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD , and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ നീ യഹോവയുടെ ആണയും ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ച കല്പനയും പ്രമാണിക്കാതെ ഇരുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Why then did you not keep your oath to the Lord and obey the command I gave you?"
chapters.nkjv: Why then have you not kept the oath of the Lord and the commandment that I gave you?"
chapters.kjv: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD , and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രാജാവു ശിമെയിയോടു: നീ എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിനോടു ചെയ്തതും നിനക്കു ഓർമ്മയുള്ളതും ആയ ദോഷമൊക്കെയും നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ; യഹോവ നിന്റെ ദോഷം നിന്റെ തലമേൽ തന്നേ വരുത്തും.
chapters.niv: The king also said to Shimei, "You know in your heart all the wrong you did to my father David. Now the Lord will repay you for your wrongdoing.
chapters.nkjv: The king said moreover to Shimei, "You know, as your heart acknowledges, all the wickedness that you did to my father David; therefore the Lord will return your wickedness on your own head.
chapters.kjv: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവനും ദാവീദിന്റെ സിംഹാസനം യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരവുമായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു
chapters.niv: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will remain secure before the Lord forever."
chapters.nkjv: But King Solomon shallbe blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord forever."
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകൻ ബെനായാവോടു കല്പിച്ചു; അവൻ ചെന്നു അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു. അങ്ങനെ രാജത്വം ശലോമോന്റെ കയ്യിൽ സ്ഥിരമായി.
chapters.niv: Then the king gave the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down and he died. The kingdom was now established in Solomon’s hands.
chapters.nkjv: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out and struck him down, and he died. Thus the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
chapters.kjv: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ശലോമോൻ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോനോടു സംബന്ധംകൂടി, ഫറവോന്റെ മകളെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്തു; തന്റെ അരമനയും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയവും യെരൂശലേമിന്നു ചുറ്റും മതിലും പണിതു തീരുവോളം അവളെ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt and married his daughter. He brought her to the City of David until he finished building his palace and the temple of the Lord , and the wall around Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now Solomon made a treaty with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and married Pharaoh’s daughter; then he brought her to the City of David until he had finished building his own house, and the house of the Lord, and the wall all around Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD , and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആ കാലംവരെ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയാതെ ഇരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ജനം പൂജാഗിരികളിൽവെച്ചു യാഗം കഴിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: The people, however, were still sacrificing at the high places, because a temple had not yet been built for the Name of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Meanwhile the people sacrificed at the high places, because there was no house built for the name of the Lord until those days.
chapters.kjv: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD , until those days.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യഹോവയെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു, തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെ അനുസരിച്ചുനടന്നു എങ്കിലും അവൻ പൂജാഗിരികളിൽവെച്ചു യാഗം കഴിക്കയും ധൂപം കാട്ടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Solomon showed his love for the Lord by walking according to the instructions given him by his father David, except that he offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of his father David, except that he sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon loved the LORD , walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ഗിബെയോനിൽ യാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ പോയി; അതു പ്രധാനപൂജാഗിരിയായിരുന്നു; അവിടത്തെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ശലോമോൻ ആയിരം ഹോമയാഗം അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices, for that was the most important high place, and Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
chapters.nkjv: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place: Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
chapters.kjv: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

chapters.ml: ഗിബെയോനിൽവെച്ചു യഹോവ രാത്രിയിൽ ശലോമോന്നു സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി; നിനക്കു വേണ്ടുന്ന വരം ചോദിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു ദൈവം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: At Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon during the night in a dream, and God said, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."
chapters.nkjv: At Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, "Ask! What shall I give you?"
chapters.kjv: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശലോമോൻ പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദ് എന്ന നിന്റെ ദാസൻ സത്യത്തോടും നീതിയോടും ഹൃദയപരമാർത്ഥതയോടും കൂടെ നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നടന്നതിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം നീ അവന്നു വലിയ കൃപ ചെയ്തു ഈ വലിയ കൃപ അവന്നായി പാലിക്കയും ഇന്നുള്ളതുപോലെ അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിപ്പാൻ അവന്നു ഒരു മകനെ നല്കുകയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon answered, "You have shown great kindness to your servant, my father David, because he was faithful to you and righteous and upright in heart. You have continued this great kindness to him and have given him a son to sit on his throne this very day.
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon said: "You have shown great mercy to Your servant David my father, because he walked before You in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with You; You have continued this great kindness for him, and You have given him a son to sit on his throne, as itis this day.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, നീ അടിയനെ ഇപ്പോൾ എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്നു പകരം രാജാവാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു. ഞാനോ ഒരു ബാലനത്രേ; കാര്യാദികൾ നടത്തുവാൻ എനിക്കു അറിവില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Now, Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of my father David. But I am only a little child and do not know how to carry out my duties.
chapters.nkjv: Now, O Lord my God, You have made Your servant king instead of my father David, but I am a little child; I do not know how to go out or come in.
chapters.kjv: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.

chapters.ml: നീ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തതും പെരുപ്പംനിമിത്തം എണ്ണവും കണക്കും ഇല്ലാത്തതുമായി വലിയോരു മഹാജാതിയായ നിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യേ അടിയൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Your servant is here among the people you have chosen, a great people, too numerous to count or number.
chapters.nkjv: And Your servant is in the midst of Your people whom You have chosen, a great people, too numerous to be numbered or counted.
chapters.kjv: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഗുണവും ദോഷവും തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞു നിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്നു ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ വിവേകമുള്ളോരു ഹൃദയം എനിക്കു തരേണമേ; അതുകൂടാതെ നിന്റെ ഈ വലിയ ജനത്തിന്നു ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ആർക്കു കഴിയും.
chapters.niv: So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore give to Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people, that I may discern between good and evil. For who is able to judge this great people of Yours?"
chapters.kjv: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ ഈ കാര്യം ചോദിച്ചതു കർത്താവിന്നു പ്രസാദമായി.
chapters.niv: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.
chapters.nkjv: The speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
chapters.kjv: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ ദീർഘായുസ്സോ സമ്പത്തോ ശത്രുസംഹാരമോ ഒന്നും അപേക്ഷിക്കാതെ ന്യായപാലനത്തിന്നുള്ള വിവേകം എന്ന ഈ കാര്യം മാത്രം അപേക്ഷിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: So God said to him, "Since you have asked for this and not for long life or wealth for yourself, nor have asked for the death of your enemies but for discernment in administering justice,
chapters.nkjv: Then God said to him: "Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked long life for yourself, nor have asked riches for yourself, nor have asked the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,
chapters.kjv: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അപേക്ഷപ്രകാരം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; ജ്ഞാനവും വിവേകമുള്ളോരു ഹൃദയം ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; നിനക്കു സമനായവൻ നിനക്കു മുമ്പു ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ല; നിനക്കു സമനായവൻ നിന്റെശേഷം ഉണ്ടാകയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there will never have been anyone like you, nor will there ever be.
chapters.nkjv: behold, I have done according to your words; see, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has not been anyone like you before you, nor shall any like you arise after you.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

chapters.ml: ഇതിന്നുപുറമെ, നീ അപേക്ഷിക്കാത്തതായ സമ്പത്തും മഹത്വവും കൂടെ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലത്തൊക്കെയും രാജാക്കന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും നിനക്കു സമനാകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Moreover, I will give you what you have not asked for—both wealth and honor—so that in your lifetime you will have no equal among kings.
chapters.nkjv: And I have also given you what you have not asked: both riches and honor, so that there shall not be anyone like you among the kings all your days.
chapters.kjv: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദ് നടന്നതുപോലെ നീ എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളും കല്പനകളും പ്രമാണിച്ചു എന്റെ വഴികളിൽ നടന്നാൽ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ദീർഘായുസ്സും തരും.
chapters.niv: And if you walk in obedience to me and keep my decrees and commands as David your father did, I will give you a long life."
chapters.nkjv: So if you walk in My ways, to keep My statutes and My commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days."
chapters.kjv: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ ഉറക്കം ഉണർന്നപ്പോൾ അതു സ്വപനം എന്നു കണ്ടു. പിന്നെ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവന്നു യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെനിന്നു ഹോമയാഗങ്ങൾ കഴിച്ചു സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചു തന്റെ സകലഭൃത്യന്മാർക്കും വിരുന്നു കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Solomon awoke—and he realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the Lord’s covenant and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then he gave a feast for all his court.
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon awoke; and indeed it had been a dream. And he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം വേശ്യമാരായ രണ്ടു സ്ത്രീകൾ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.
chapters.nkjv: Now two women whowere harlots came to the king, and stood before him.
chapters.kjv: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തി പറഞ്ഞതു: തമ്പുരാനെ, അടിയനും, ഇവളും ഒരു വീട്ടിൽ പാർക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ പാർക്കുന്ന വീട്ടിൽവെച്ചു ഞാൻ ഒരു കുഞ്ഞിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One of them said, "Pardon me, my lord. This woman and I live in the same house, and I had a baby while she was there with me.
chapters.nkjv: And one woman said, "O my lord, this woman and I dwell in the same house; and I gave birth while she was in the house.
chapters.kjv: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പ്രസവിച്ചതിന്റെ മൂന്നാം ദിവസം ഇവളും പ്രസവിച്ചു; ഞങ്ങൾ ഒന്നിച്ചായിരുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ രണ്ടുപോരും ഒഴികെ ആ വീട്ടിൽ മറ്റാരും ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: The third day after my child was born, this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there was no one in the house but the two of us.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, the third day after I had given birth, that this woman also gave birth. And we were together; no one was with us in the house, except the two of us in the house.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാത്രി ഇവൾ തന്റെ മകന്റെ മേൽ കിടന്നുപോയതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ മരിച്ചു പോയി.
chapters.niv: "During the night this woman’s son died because she lay on him.
chapters.nkjv: And this woman’s son died in the night, because she lay on him.
chapters.kjv: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അർദ്ധരാത്രി എഴുന്നേറ്റു, അടിയൻ ഉറങ്ങുന്ന സമയം, അടിയന്റെ അരികെനിന്നു അടിയന്റെ മകനെ എടുത്തു അവളുടെ പള്ളെക്കലും അവളുടെ മരിച്ച മകനെ അടിയന്റെ പള്ളെക്കലും കിടത്തി.
chapters.niv: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I your servant was asleep. She put him by her breast and put her dead son by my breast.
chapters.nkjv: So she arose in the middle of the night and took my son from my side, while your maidservant slept, and laid him in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
chapters.kjv: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ കുഞ്ഞിന്നു മുലകൊടുപ്പാൻ അടിയൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ അതു മരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; വെളിച്ചമായശേഷം അടിയൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുനോക്കിയാറെ അതു അടിയൻ പ്രസവിച്ച കുഞ്ഞല്ല.
chapters.niv: The next morning, I got up to nurse my son—and he was dead! But when I looked at him closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn’t the son I had borne."
chapters.nkjv: And when I rose in the morning to nurse my son, there he was, dead. But when I had examined him in the morning, indeed, he was not my son whom I had borne."
chapters.kjv: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മറ്റെ സ്ത്രീ: അങ്ങനെയല്ല; ജീവനുള്ളതു എന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു; മരിച്ചതു നിന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഇവളോ: മരിച്ചതു നിന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു; ജീവനുള്ളതു എന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ രാജാവിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ തമ്മിൽ വാദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The other woman said, "No! The living one is my son; the dead one is yours." But the first one insisted, "No! The dead one is yours; the living one is mine." And so they argued before the king.
chapters.nkjv: Then the other woman said, "No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son." And the first woman said, "No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son." Thus they spoke before the king.
chapters.kjv: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചതു: ജീവനുള്ളതു എന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു, മരിച്ചതു നിന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു എന്നു ഇവൾ പറയുന്നു; അങ്ങനെയല്ല, മരിച്ചതു നിന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു, ജീവനുള്ളതു എന്റെ കുഞ്ഞു എന്നു മറ്റേവൾ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king said, "This one says, ‘My son is alive and your son is dead,’ while that one says, ‘No! Your son is dead and mine is alive.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And the king said, "The one says, ‘This is my son, who lives, and your son is the dead one’; and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’ "
chapters.kjv: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

chapters.ml: ഒരു വാൾ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചു. അവർ ഒരു വാൾ രാജസന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the king said, "Bring me a sword." So they brought a sword for the king.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said, "Bring me a sword." So they brought a sword before the king.
chapters.kjv: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു: ജീവനുള്ള കുഞ്ഞിനെ രണ്ടായി പിളർന്നു പാതി ഒരുത്തിക്കും പാതി മറ്റേവൾക്കും കൊടുപ്പിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He then gave an order: "Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other."
chapters.nkjv: And the king said, "Divide the living child in two, and give half to one, and half to the other."
chapters.kjv: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ജീവനുള്ള കുഞ്ഞിന്റെ അമ്മ തന്റെ കുഞ്ഞിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഉള്ളു കത്തുകകൊണ്ടു രാജാവിനോടു: അയ്യോ! എന്റെ തമ്പുരാനേ ജീവനുള്ള കുഞ്ഞിനെ കൊല്ലരുതേ; അതിനെ അവൾക്കു കൊടുത്തുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. മറ്റേവളോ: എനിക്കും വേണ്ടാ, നിനക്കും വേണ്ടാ; അതിനെ പിളർക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The woman whose son was alive was deeply moved out of love for her son and said to the king, "Please, my lord, give her the living baby! Don’t kill him!" But the other said, "Neither I nor you shall have him. Cut him in two!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman whose son was living spoke to the king, for she yearned with compassion for her son; and she said, "O my lord, give her the living child, and by no means kill him!" But the other said, "Let him be neither mine nor yours, but divide him."
chapters.kjv: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു: ജീവനുള്ള കുഞ്ഞിനെ കൊല്ലരുതു; അവൾക്കു കൊടുപ്പിൻ; അവൾ തന്നേ അതിന്റെ തള്ള എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the king gave his ruling: "Give the living baby to the first woman. Do not kill him; she is his mother."
chapters.nkjv: So the king answered and said, "Give the first woman the living child, and by no means kill him; she is his mother."
chapters.kjv: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു കല്പിച്ച വിധി യിസ്രായേൽ ഒക്കെയും കേട്ടു. ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ജ്ഞാനം രാജാവിന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു കണ്ടു അവനെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When all Israel heard the verdict the king had given, they held the king in awe, because they saw that he had wisdom from God to administer justice.
chapters.nkjv: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had rendered; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice.
chapters.kjv: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു എല്ലാ യിസ്രായേലിന്നും രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: So King Solomon ruled over all Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So King Solomon was king over all Israel.
chapters.kjv: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

chapters.ml: അവന്നുണ്ടായിരുന്ന പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: സാദോക്കിന്റെ മകൻ അസര്യാവു പുരോഹിതൻ.
chapters.niv: And these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok—the priest;
chapters.nkjv: And these were his officials: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
chapters.kjv: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

chapters.ml: ശീശയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരായ എലീഹോരെഫും അഹീയാവും രായസക്കാർ; അഹീലൂദിന്റെ മകൻ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് മന്ത്രി;
chapters.niv: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha—secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud—recorder;
chapters.nkjv: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
chapters.kjv: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകൻ ബെനായാവു സേനാധിപതി, സാദോക്കും അബ്യാഥാരും പുരോഹിതന്മാർ;
chapters.niv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada—commander in chief; Zadok and Abiathar—priests;
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, over the army; Zadok and Abiathar, the priests;
chapters.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

chapters.ml: നാഥാന്റെ മകനായ അസര്യാവു കാര്യക്കാരന്മാരുടെ മേധാവി; നാഥാന്റെ മകനായ സാബൂദ് പുരോഹിതനും രാജാവിന്റെ സ്നേഹിതനുമായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Azariah son of Nathan—in charge of the district governors; Zabud son of Nathan—a priest and adviser to the king;
chapters.nkjv: Azariah the son of Nathan, over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan, a priest and the king’s friend;
chapters.kjv: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king’s friend:

chapters.ml: അഹീശാർ രാജഗൃഹവിചാരകൻ; അബ്ദയുടെ കെൻ അദോനീരാം ഊഴിയവേലക്കാരുടെ മേധാവി.
chapters.niv: Ahishar—palace administrator; Adoniram son of Abda—in charge of forced labor.
chapters.nkjv: Ahishar, over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda, over the labor force.
chapters.kjv: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

chapters.ml: രാജാവിന്നും രാജഗൃഹത്തിന്നും ഭോജന പദാർത്ഥങ്ങൾ എത്തിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാൻ ശലോമോന്നു യിസ്രായേലിലൊക്കെയും പന്ത്രണ്ടു കാര്യക്കാരന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തൻ ആണ്ടിൽ ഓരോമാസത്തേക്കു ഭോജനപദാർത്ഥങ്ങൾ എത്തിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: Solomon had twelve district governors over all Israel, who supplied provisions for the king and the royal household. Each one had to provide supplies for one month in the year.
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household; each one made provision for one month of the year.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പേരാവിതു: എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ ബെൻ-ഹൂർ;
chapters.niv: These are their names: Ben-Hur—in the hill country of Ephraim;
chapters.nkjv: These are their names: Ben-Hur, in the mountains of Ephraim;
chapters.kjv: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

chapters.ml: മാക്കസ്, ശാൽബീം, ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശ്, ഏലോൻ-ബേത്ത്-ഹാനാൻ എന്നീ സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ ബെൻ-ദേക്കെർ;
chapters.niv: Ben-Deker—in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh and Elon Bethhanan;
chapters.nkjv: Ben-Deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
chapters.kjv: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan:

chapters.ml: അരുബ്ബോത്തിൽ ബെൻ-ഹേസെർ; സോഖോവും ഹേഫെർദേശം മുഴുവനും അവന്റെ ഇടവക ആയിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Ben-Hesed—in Arubboth (Sokoh and all the land of Hepher were his);
chapters.nkjv: Ben-Hesed, in Arubboth; to him belonged Sochoh and all the land of Hepher;
chapters.kjv: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

chapters.ml: നാഫത്ത്-ദോറിൽ ബെൻ-അബീനാദാബ്; അവന്നു ശലോമോന്റെ മകളായ താഫത്ത് ഭാര്യയായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Ben-Abinadab—in Naphoth Dor (he was married to Taphath daughter of Solomon);
chapters.nkjv: Ben-Abinadab, in all the regions of Dor; he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as wife;
chapters.kjv: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

chapters.ml: അഹീലൂദിന്റെ മകനായ ബാനയുടെ ഇടവക താനാക്കും മെഗിദ്ദോവും സാരെഥാന്നരികെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു താഴെ ബേത്ത്-ശെയാൻ മുതൽ ആബേൽ-മെഹോലാവരെയും യൊക്ക് മെയാമിന്റെ അപ്പുറംവരെയുമുള്ള ബേത്ത്-ശെയാൻ മുഴുവനും ആയിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Baana son of Ahilud—in Taanach and Megiddo, and in all of Beth Shan next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth Shan to Abel Meholah across to Jokmeam;
chapters.nkjv: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach, Megiddo, and all Beth Shean, which is beside Zaretan below Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as the other side of Jokneam;
chapters.kjv: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:

chapters.ml: ഗിലെയാദിലെ രാമോത്തിൽ ബെൻ-ഗേബെർ; അവന്റെ ഇടവക മനശ്ശെയുടെ മകനായ യായീരിന്നു ഗിലെയാദിലുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളും മതിലുകളും ചെമ്പോടാമ്പലുകളും ഉള്ള അറുപതു വലിയ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ ഉൾപ്പെട്ട ബാശാനിലെ അര്ഗ്ഗോബ് ദേശവും ആയിരുന്നു,
chapters.niv: Ben-Geber—in Ramoth Gilead (the settlements of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead were his, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan and its sixty large walled cities with bronze gate bars);
chapters.nkjv: Ben-Geber, in Ramoth Gilead; to him belonged the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, in Gilead; to him alsobelonged the region of Argob in Bashan—sixty large cities with walls and bronze gate-bars;
chapters.kjv: The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

chapters.ml: മഹനയീമിൽ ഇദ്ദോവിന്റെ മകൻ അഹീനാദാബ്;
chapters.niv: Ahinadab son of Iddo—in Mahanaim;
chapters.nkjv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
chapters.kjv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിയിൽ അഹീമാസ്; അവൻ ശലോമോന്റെ മകളായ ബാശെമത്തിനെ ഭാര്യയായി പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Ahimaaz—in Naphtali (he had married Basemath daughter of Solomon);
chapters.nkjv: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali; he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife;
chapters.kjv: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

chapters.ml: ആശേരിലും ബെയാലോത്തിലും ഹൂശയിയുടെ മകൻ ബാനാ;
chapters.niv: Baana son of Hushai—in Asher and in Aloth;
chapters.nkjv: Baanah the son of Hushai, in Asher and Aloth;
chapters.kjv: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാരിൽ പാരൂഹിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത്;
chapters.niv: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah—in Issachar;
chapters.nkjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
chapters.kjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീനിൽ ഏലയുടെ മകനായ ശിമെയി; അമോര്യ രാജാവായ സീഹോന്റെയും
chapters.niv: Shimei son of Ela—in Benjamin;
chapters.nkjv: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin;
chapters.kjv: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

chapters.ml: ബാശാൻ രാജാവായ ഓഗിന്റെയും രാജ്യമായിരുന്ന ഗിലെയദ് ദേശത്തു ഹൂരിന്റെ മകൻ ഗേബെർ; ആ ദേശത്തു ഒരു കാര്യക്കാരൻ മാത്രമേ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: Geber son of Uri—in Gilead (the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and the country of Og king of Bashan). He was the only governor over the district.
chapters.nkjv: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan. Hewas the only governor who was in the land.
chapters.kjv: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയും യിസ്രായേലും കടൽക്കരയിലെ മണൽപോലെ അസംഖ്യമായിരുന്നു; അവർ തിന്നുകയും കുടിക്കയും സന്തോഷിക്കയും ചെയ്തു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore; they ate, they drank and they were happy.
chapters.nkjv: Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and rejoicing.
chapters.kjv: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

chapters.ml: നദിമുതൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യദേശംവരെയും മിസ്രയീമിന്റെ അതിർവരെയും ഉള്ള സകലരാജ്യങ്ങളെയും ശലോമോൻ വാണു; അവർ കപ്പം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ശലോമോനെ അവന്റെ ജീവപര്യന്തം സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These countries brought tribute and were Solomon’s subjects all his life.
chapters.nkjv: So Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ നിത്യച്ചെലവു ദിവസം ഒന്നിന്നു മുപ്പതു പറ നേരിയ മാവും അറുപതു പറ സാധാരണമാവും
chapters.niv: Solomon’s daily provisions were thirty cors of the finest flour and sixty cors of meal,
chapters.nkjv: Now Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty kors of fine flour, sixty kors of meal,
chapters.kjv: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

chapters.ml: മാൻ, ഇളമാൻ, മ്ളാവു, പുഷ്ടിവരുത്തിയ പക്ഷികൾ എന്നിവ കൂടാതെ തടിപ്പിച്ച പത്തു കാളയും മേച്ചൽപുറത്തെ ഇരുപതു കാളയും നൂറു ആടും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: ten head of stall-fed cattle, twenty of pasture-fed cattle and a hundred sheep and goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks and choice fowl.
chapters.nkjv: ten fatted oxen, twenty oxen from the pastures, and one hundred sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fatted fowl.
chapters.kjv: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.

chapters.ml: നദിക്കു ഇക്കരെ തിഫ്സഹ് മുതൽ ഗസ്സാവരെയുള്ള സകലദേശത്തെയും നദിക്കു ഇക്കരെയുള്ള സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരെയും അവൻ വാണു. ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ദിക്കിൽ ഒക്കെയും അവന്നു സമാധാനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For he ruled over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and had peace on all sides.
chapters.nkjv: For he had dominion over all theregion on this side of the River from Tiphsah even to Gaza, namely over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on every side all around him.
chapters.kjv: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദയും യിസ്രായേലും ദാൻമുതൽ ബേർ-ശേബവരെയും ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയുടെ കീഴിലും അത്തിവൃക്ഷത്തിൻ കീഴിലും നിർഭയം വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: During Solomon’s lifetime Judah and Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, lived in safety, everyone under their own vine and under their own fig tree.
chapters.nkjv: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, each man under his vine and his fig tree, from Dan as far as Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്നു തന്റെ രഥങ്ങൾക്കു നാല്പതിനായിരം കുതിരലായവും പന്തീരായിരം കുതിരച്ചേവകരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon had four thousand stalls for chariot horses, and twelve thousand horses.
chapters.nkjv: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

chapters.ml: കാര്യക്കാരന്മാർ ഓരോരുത്തൻ ഓരോ മാസത്തേക്കു ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ പന്തിഭോജനത്തിന്നു കൂടുന്ന എല്ലാവർക്കും വേണ്ടുന്ന ഭോജനപദാർത്ഥങ്ങൾ കുറവുകൂടാതെ എത്തിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: The district governors, each in his month, supplied provisions for King Solomon and all who came to the king’s table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.
chapters.nkjv: And these governors, each man in his month, provided food for King Solomon and for all who came to King Solomon’s table. There was no lack in their supply.
chapters.kjv: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

chapters.ml: അവർ കുതിരകൾക്കും തുരഗങ്ങൾക്കും വേണ്ടുന്ന യവവും വയ്ക്കോലും താന്താന്റെ മുറപ്രകാരം അവൻ ഇരിക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ എത്തിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: They also brought to the proper place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and the other horses.
chapters.nkjv: They also brought barley and straw to the proper place, for the horses and steeds, each man according to his charge.
chapters.kjv: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ശലോമോന്നു ഏറ്റവും വളരെ ജ്ഞാനവും ബുദ്ധിയും കടൽക്കരയിലെ മണൽപോലെ ഹൃദയവിശാലതയും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.
chapters.nkjv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and exceedingly great understanding, and largeness of heart like the sand on the seashore.
chapters.kjv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.

chapters.ml: സകലപൂർവ്വ ദിഗ്വാസികളുടെയും ജ്ഞാനത്തെക്കാളും മിസ്രയീമ്യരുടെ സകലജ്ഞാനത്തെക്കാളും ശലോമോന്റെ ജ്ഞാനം ശ്രേഷ്ഠമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the people of the East, and greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the men of the East and all the wisdom of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

chapters.ml: സകലമനുഷ്യരെക്കാളും എസ്രാഹ്യനായ ഏഥാൻ, മാഹോലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ ഹേമാൻ, കൽക്കോൽ, ദർദ്ദ എന്നിവരെക്കാളും അവൻ ജ്ഞാനിയായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ കീർത്തി ചുറ്റുമുള്ള സകലജാതികളിലും പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was wiser than anyone else, including Ethan the Ezrahite—wiser than Heman, Kalkol and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread to all the surrounding nations.
chapters.nkjv: For he was wiser than all men— than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the surrounding nations.
chapters.kjv: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂവായിരം സദൃശവാക്യം പറഞ്ഞു; അവന്റെ ഗീതങ്ങൾ ആയിരത്തഞ്ചു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He spoke three thousand proverbs and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
chapters.nkjv: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were one thousand and five.
chapters.kjv: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

chapters.ml: ലെബാനോനിലെ ദേവദാരുമുതൽ ചുവരിന്മേൽ മുളെക്കുന്ന ഈസോപ്പുവരെയുള്ള വൃക്ഷാദികളെക്കുറിച്ചും മൃഗം, പക്ഷി, ഇഴജാതി, മത്സ്യം എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ചും അവൻ പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He spoke about plant life, from the cedar of Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of walls. He also spoke about animals and birds, reptiles and fish.
chapters.nkjv: Also he spoke of trees, from the cedar tree of Lebanon even to the hyssop that springs out of the wall; he spoke also of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.
chapters.kjv: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ ജ്ഞാനത്തെപ്പറ്റി കേട്ട സകലഭൂപാലകന്മാരുടെയും അടുക്കൽ നിന്നു നാനാജാതിക്കാരായ പലരും അവന്റെ ജ്ഞാനം കേൾപ്പാൻ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: From all nations people came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the world, who had heard of his wisdom.
chapters.nkjv: And men of all nations, from all the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom, came to hear the wisdom of Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോനെ അവന്റെ അപ്പന്നു പകരം രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തു എന്നു സോർരാജാവായ ഹീരാം കേട്ടിട്ടു ഭൃത്യന്മാരെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു. ഹീരാം എല്ലായ്പോഴും ദാവീദിന്റെ സ്നേഹിതനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king to succeed his father David, he sent his envoys to Solomon, because he had always been on friendly terms with David.
chapters.nkjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, because he heard that they had anointed him king in place of his father, for Hiram had always loved David.
chapters.kjv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ ഹീരാമിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു പറയിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Solomon sent back this message to Hiram:
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon sent to Hiram, saying:
chapters.kjv: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ യഹോവ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കീഴാക്കുംവരെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള യുദ്ധം ഹേതുവായി തന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിവാൻ അവന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "You know that because of the wars waged against my father David from all sides, he could not build a temple for the Name of the Lord his God until the Lord put his enemies under his feet.
chapters.nkjv: You know how my father David could not build a house for the name of the Lord his God because of the wars which were fought against him on every side, until the Lord put hisfoes under the soles of his feet.
chapters.kjv: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഒരു പ്രതിയോഗിയോ വിഘ്നമോ ഇല്ല; എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ചുറ്റും എനിക്കു സ്വസ്ഥത നല്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or disaster.
chapters.nkjv: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side; thereis neither adversary nor evil occurrence.
chapters.kjv: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇതാ, ഞാൻ നിനക്കു പകരം നിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുത്തുന്ന നിന്റെ മകൻ എന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയുമെന്നു യഹോവ എന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു പോലെ എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിവാൻ ഞാൻ വിചാരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I intend, therefore, to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God, as the Lord told my father David, when he said, ‘Your son whom I will put on the throne in your place will build the temple for my Name.’
chapters.nkjv: And behold, I propose to build a house for the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord spoke to my father David, saying, "Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place, he shall build the house for My name."
chapters.kjv: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ലെബാനോനിൽനിന്നു എനിക്കായി ദേവദാരുമരം മുറിപ്പാൻ കല്പന കൊടുക്കേണം; എന്റെ വേലക്കാർ നിന്റെ വേലക്കാരോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കും; നിന്റെ വേലക്കാർക്കും നീ പറയുന്ന കൂലി ഞാൻ എത്തിച്ചു തരാം; സീദോന്യരെപ്പോലെ മരം മുറിപ്പാൻ പരിചയമുള്ളവർ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ആരും ഇല്ല എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "So give orders that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. My men will work with yours, and I will pay you for your men whatever wages you set. You know that we have no one so skilled in felling timber as the Sidonians."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, command that they cut down cedars for me from Lebanon; and my servants will be with your servants, and I will pay you wages for your servants according to whatever you say. For you know thereis none among us who has skill to cut timber like the Sidonians.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

chapters.ml: ഹീരാം ശലോമോന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ ഏറ്റവും സന്തോഷിച്ചു: ഈ മഹാജനത്തെ വാഴുവാൻ ദാവീദിന്നു ജ്ഞാനമുള്ളോരു മകനെ കൊടുത്ത യഹോവ ഇന്നു വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was greatly pleased and said, "Praise be to the Lord today, for he has given David a wise son to rule over this great nation."
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly and said, Blessed be the Lord this day, for He has given David a wise son over this great people!
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

chapters.ml: ഹീരാം ശലോമോന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു പറയിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ പറഞ്ഞയച്ച വസ്തുത ഞാൻ കേട്ടു; ദേവദാരുവിന്റെയും സരളമരത്തിന്റെയും കാര്യത്തിൽ നീ ഇച്ഛിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ ചെയ്യാം.
chapters.niv: So Hiram sent word to Solomon: "I have received the message you sent me and will do all you want in providing the cedar and juniper logs.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hiram sent to Solomon, saying: I have considered themessage which you sent me, and I will do all you desire concerning the cedar and cypress logs.
chapters.kjv: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വേലക്കാർ ലെബാനോനിൽനിന്നു കടലിലേക്കു അവയെ ഇറക്കിയശേഷം ഞാൻ ചങ്ങാടം കെട്ടിച്ചു നീ പറയുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു കടൽ വഴിയായി എത്തിച്ചു കെട്ടഴിപ്പിച്ചുതരാം; നീ ഏറ്റുവാങ്ങേണം; എന്നാൽ എന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു ആഹാരം എത്തിച്ചുതരുന്ന കാര്യത്തിൽ നീ എന്റെ ഇഷ്ടവും നിവർത്തിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: My men will haul them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate them and you can take them away. And you are to grant my wish by providing food for my royal household."
chapters.nkjv: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon to the sea; I will float them in rafts by sea to the place you indicate to me, and will have them broken apart there; then you can take them away. And you shall fulfill my desire by giving food for my household.
chapters.kjv: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഹീരാം ശലോമോന്നു ദേവദാരുവും സരളമരവും അവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ഒക്കെയും കൊടുത്തു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: In this way Hiram kept Solomon supplied with all the cedar and juniper logs he wanted,
chapters.nkjv: Then Hiram gave Solomon cedar and cypress logs accordingto all his desire.
chapters.kjv: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ ഹീരാമിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിലേക്കു ആഹാരംവകെക്കു ഇരുപതിനായിരം പറ കോതമ്പും ഇരുപതു പറ ഇടിച്ചെടുത്ത എണ്ണയും കൊടുത്തു; ഇങ്ങനെ ശലോമോൻ ഹീരാമിന്നു ആണ്ടുതോറും കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: and Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat as food for his household, in addition to twenty thousand baths of pressed olive oil. Solomon continued to do this for Hiram year after year.
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand kors of wheat as food for his household, and twenty kors of pressed oil. Thus Solomon gave to Hiram year by year.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ശലോമോനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അവന്നു ജ്ഞാനം നൽകി; ഹീരാമും ശലോമോനും തമ്മിൽ സമാധാനമായിരുന്നു; അവർ ഇരുവരും തമ്മിൽ ഉടമ്പടിയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord gave Solomon wisdom, just as he had promised him. There were peaceful relations between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നൊക്കെയും ഊഴിയവേലക്കാരെ വരിയിട്ടെടുത്തു; ഊഴിയ വേലക്കാർ മുപ്പതിനായിരംപേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon conscripted laborers from all Israel—thirty thousand men.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Solomon raised up a labor force out of all Israel; and the labor force was thirty thousand men.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ മാസംതോറും പതിനായിരംപേർവീതം മാറി മാറി ലെബാനോനിലേക്കു അയച്ചു; അവർ ഒരു മാസം ലെബാനോനിലും രണ്ടുമാസം വീട്ടിലും ആയിരുന്നു; അദോനീരാം ഊഴിയവേലക്കാർക്കു മേധാവി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He sent them off to Lebanon in shifts of ten thousand a month, so that they spent one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
chapters.nkjv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month in shifts: they were one month in Lebanon and two months at home; Adoniram was in charge of the labor force.
chapters.kjv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

chapters.ml: വേല ചെയ്യുന്ന ജനത്തെ ഭരിച്ചു വേല നടത്തുന്ന മൂവായിരത്തിമുന്നൂറു പ്രധാനകാര്യക്കാരന്മാരൊഴികെ
chapters.niv: Solomon had seventy thousand carriers and eighty thousand stonecutters in the hills,
chapters.nkjv: Solomon had seventy thousand who carried burdens, and eighty thousand who quarried stone in the mountains,
chapters.kjv: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്നു എഴുപതിനായിരം ചുമട്ടുകാരും മലയിൽ എണ്പതിനായിരം കല്ലുവെട്ടുകാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: as well as thirty-three hundred foremen who supervised the project and directed the workers.
chapters.nkjv: besides three thousand three hundred from the chiefs of Solomon’s deputies, who supervised the people who labored in the work.
chapters.kjv: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

chapters.ml: ആലയത്തിന്നു ചെത്തിയ കല്ലുകൊണ്ടു അടിസ്ഥാനം ഇടുവാൻ അവർ രാജകല്പനപ്രകാരം വിശേഷപ്പെട്ട വലിയകല്ലു വെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: At the king’s command they removed from the quarry large blocks of high-grade stone to provide a foundation of dressed stone for the temple.
chapters.nkjv: And the king commanded them to quarry large stones, costly stones, and hewn stones, to lay the foundation of the temple.
chapters.kjv: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ ശില്പികളും, ഹീരാമിന്റെ ശില്പികളും ഗെബാല്യരും ആലയപ്പണിക്കായി മരവും കല്ലും ചെത്തി ഒരുക്കി.
chapters.niv: The craftsmen of Solomon and Hiram and workers from Byblos cut and prepared the timber and stone for the building of the temple.
chapters.nkjv: So Solomon’s builders, Hiram’s builders, and the Gebalites quarried them; and they prepared timber and stones to build the temple.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടതിന്റെ നാനൂറ്റെണ്പതാം സംവത്സരത്തിൽ യിസ്രായേലിൽ ശലോമോന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ നാലാം ആണ്ടിൽ രണ്ടാം മാസമായ സീവ് മാസത്തിൽ അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം പണിവാൻ തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, the second month, he began to build the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു യഹോവെക്കു പണിത ആലയം അറുപതു മുഴം നീളവും ഇരുപതു മുഴം വീതിയും മുപ്പതു മുഴം ഉയരവും ഉള്ളതായിരുന്നു
chapters.niv: The temple that King Solomon built for the Lord was sixty cubits long, twenty wide and thirty high.
chapters.nkjv: Now the house which King Solomon built for the Lord, its length was sixty cubits, its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.
chapters.kjv: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD , the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits , and the height thereof thirty cubits.

chapters.ml: ആലയമായ മന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ മുഖമണ്ഡപം ആലയവീതിക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം ഇരുപതു മുഴം നീളവും ആലയത്തിന്റെ മുൻ വശത്തു പത്തു മുഴം വീതിയും ഉള്ളതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple extended the width of the temple, that is twenty cubits, and projected ten cubits from the front of the temple.
chapters.nkjv: The vestibule in front of the sanctuary of the house was twenty cubits long across the width of the house, and the width of thevestibuleextended ten cubits from the front of the house.
chapters.kjv: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആലയത്തിന്നു ജാലം ഇണക്കിയ കിളിവാതിലുകളെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He made narrow windows high up in the temple walls.
chapters.nkjv: And he made for the house windows with beveled frames.
chapters.kjv: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

chapters.ml: മന്ദിരവും അന്തർമ്മന്ദിരവും കൂടിയ ആലയത്തിന്റെ ചുവരിനോടു ചേർത്തു ചുറ്റും തട്ടുതട്ടായി പുറവാരങ്ങളും പണിതു അവയിൽ ചുറ്റും അറകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Against the walls of the main hall and inner sanctuary he built a structure around the building, in which there were side rooms.
chapters.nkjv: Against the wall of the temple he built chambers all around, against the walls of the temple, all around the sanctuary and the inner sanctuary. Thus he made side chambers all around it.
chapters.kjv: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

chapters.ml: താഴത്തെ പുറവാരം അഞ്ചു മുഴവും നടുവിലത്തേതു ആറു മുഴവും മൂന്നാമത്തേതു ഏഴു മുഴവും വീതിയുള്ളതായിരുന്നു; തുലാങ്ങൾ ആലയഭിത്തികളിൽ അകത്തു ചെല്ലാതിരിപ്പാൻ അവൻ ആലയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റും പുറമെ ഗളം പണിതു.
chapters.niv: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits and the third floor seven. He made offset ledges around the outside of the temple so that nothing would be inserted into the temple walls.
chapters.nkjv: The lowest chamber was five cubits wide, the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for he made narrow ledges around the outside of the temple, so that thesupportbeams would not be fastened into the walls of the temple.
chapters.kjv: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
