chapters.kjv: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:

chapters.ml: നീ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ അവരുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥനയും യാചനയും കേട്ടു അവർക്കു ന്യായം പാലിച്ചുകൊടുക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
chapters.nkjv: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
chapters.kjv: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

chapters.ml: അവർ നിന്നോടു പാപം ചെയ്കയും--പാപം ചെയ്യാത്ത മനുഷ്യൻ ഇല്ലല്ലോ--നീ അവരോടു കോപിച്ചു അവരെ ശത്രുവിന്നു ഏല്പിക്കയും അവർ അവരെ ദൂരത്തോ സമീപത്തോ ഉള്ള ശത്രുവിന്റെ ദേശത്തേക്കു ബദ്ധരാക്കി കൊണ്ടുപോകയും ചെയ്താൽ
chapters.niv: "When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to their enemies, who take them captive to their own lands, far away or near;
chapters.nkjv: "When they sin against You (for thereis no one who does not sin), and You become angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, and they take them captive to the land of the enemy, far or near;
chapters.kjv: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

chapters.ml: അവരെ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോയിരിക്കുന്ന ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു അവർ ഉണർന്നു മനംതിരിഞ്ഞു, അവരെ ബദ്ധരായി കൊണ്ടുപോയ ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു: ഞങ്ങൾ പാപം ചെയ്തു അകൃത്യവും ദുഷ്ടതയും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captors and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly’;
chapters.nkjv: yet when they come to themselves in the land where they were carried captive, and repent, and make supplication to You in the land of those who took them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong, we have committed wickedness’;
chapters.kjv: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

chapters.ml: നിന്നോടു യാചിക്കയും അവരെ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോയ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു അവർ പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടുംകൂടെ നിങ്കലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു, നീ അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കു കൊടുത്ത ദേശത്തേക്കു, നീ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത നഗരത്തിങ്കലേക്കും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു പണിതിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ ആലയത്തിങ്കലേക്കും നോക്കി നിന്നോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ
chapters.niv: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their enemies who took them captive, and pray to you toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name;
chapters.nkjv: and when they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who led them away captive, and pray to You toward their land which You gave to their fathers, the city which You have chosen and the temple which I have built for Your name:
chapters.kjv: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

chapters.ml: നീ നിന്റെ വാസസ്ഥലമായ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ അവരുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥനയും യാചനയും കേട്ടു അവർക്കു ന്യായം പാലിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു,
chapters.niv: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
chapters.nkjv: then hear in heaven Your dwelling place their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause,
chapters.kjv: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

chapters.ml: നിന്നോടു പാപം ചെയ്ത നിന്റെ ജനത്തോടു, അവർ നിന്നോടു ചെയ്ത ദ്രോഹങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ക്ഷമിക്കയും അവരെ ബദ്ധന്മാരായി കൊണ്ടുപോയവർക്കു അവരോടു കരുണതോന്നത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവർക്കു അവരോടു കരുണ ലഭിക്കുമാറാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യേണമേ.
chapters.niv: And forgive your people, who have sinned against you; forgive all the offenses they have committed against you, and cause their captors to show them mercy;
chapters.nkjv: and forgive Your people who have sinned against You, and all their transgressions which they have transgressed against You; and grant them compassion before those who took them captive, that they may have compassion on them
chapters.kjv: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

chapters.ml: അവർ മിസ്രയീം എന്ന ഇരുമ്പുലയുടെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു നീ കൊണ്ടുവന്ന നിന്റെ ജനവും നിന്റെ അവകാശവും ആകുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: for they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out of Egypt, out of that iron-smelting furnace.
chapters.nkjv: (for they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out of Egypt, out of the iron furnace),
chapters.kjv: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

chapters.ml: അവർ നിന്നെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒക്കെയും നീ കേൾക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അടിയന്റെ യാചനയും നിന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ യാചനയും തൃക്കൺ പാർത്തരുളേണമേ.
chapters.niv: "May your eyes be open to your servant’s plea and to the plea of your people Israel, and may you listen to them whenever they cry out to you.
chapters.nkjv: that Your eyes may be open to the supplication of Your servant and the supplication of Your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they call to You.
chapters.kjv: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവായ യഹോവേ, നീ ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ മിസ്രയീമിൽ നിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെമുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലജാതികളിൽനിന്നും നീ അവരെ നിനക്കു അവകാശമായി വേറുതിരിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For you singled them out from all the nations of the world to be your own inheritance, just as you declared through your servant Moses when you, Sovereign Lord , brought our ancestors out of Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: For You separated them from among all the peoples of the earth tobe Your inheritance, as You spoke by Your servant Moses, when You brought our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God."
chapters.kjv: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD .

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യഹോവയോടു ഈ പ്രാർത്ഥനയും യാചനയും എല്ലാം കഴിച്ചുതീർന്നശേഷം അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ യാഗപീഠത്തിൽ മുമ്പിൽ മുഴങ്കാൽ കുത്തിയിരുന്നതും കൈ ആകാശത്തേക്കു മലർത്തിയിരുന്നതും വിട്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: When Solomon had finished all these prayers and supplications to the Lord , he rose from before the altar of the Lord , where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out toward heaven.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the Lord, that he arose from before the altar of the Lord, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
chapters.kjv: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD , he arose from before the altar of the LORD , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേൽസഭയെ ഒക്കെയും ഉച്ചത്തിൽ ആശീർവ്വദിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: He stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:
chapters.nkjv: Then he stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying:
chapters.kjv: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

chapters.ml: താൻ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും തന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു സ്വസ്ഥത നല്കിയിരിക്കുന്ന യഹോവ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ; അവൻ തന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെമുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത അവന്റെ നല്ല വാഗ്ദാനങ്ങളെല്ലാറ്റിലും വെച്ചു ഒന്നെങ്കിലും നിഷ്ഫലമായിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Praise be to the Lord , who has given rest to his people Israel just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.
chapters.nkjv: "Blessed be the Lord, who has given rest to His people Israel, according to all that He promised. There has not failed one word of all His good promise, which He promised through His servant Moses.
chapters.kjv: Blessed be the LORD , that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ഇരുന്നതുപോലെ നമ്മോടുകൂടെയും ഇരിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ അവൻ നമ്മെ കൈവിടുകയോ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയോ ചെയ്യരുതെ.
chapters.niv: May the Lord our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us nor forsake us.
chapters.nkjv: May the Lord our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He not leave us nor forsake us,
chapters.kjv: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

chapters.ml: നാം അവന്റെ എല്ലാവഴികളിലും നടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും അവൻ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു കല്പിച്ച അവന്റെ കല്പനകളും ചട്ടങ്ങളും വിധികളും പ്രമാണിച്ചു നടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും നമ്മുടെ ഹൃദയത്തെ തങ്കലേക്കു ചായുമാറാക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May he turn our hearts to him, to walk in obedience to him and keep the commands, decrees and laws he gave our ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: that He may incline our hearts to Himself, to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments, which He commanded our fathers.
chapters.kjv: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നെ ദൈവം; മറ്റൊരുത്തനുമില്ല എന്നു ഭൂമിയിലെ സകല ജാതികളും അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: And may these words of mine, which I have prayed before the Lord , be near to the Lord our God day and night, that he may uphold the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel according to each day’s need,
chapters.nkjv: And may these words of mine, with which I have made supplication before the Lord, be near the Lord our God day and night, that He may maintain the cause of His servant and the cause of His people Israel, as each day may require,
chapters.kjv: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD , be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ദാസന്നും തന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നും അന്നന്നു ആവശ്യമുള്ളതുപോലെ ന്യായം പാലിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ആപേക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ ഈ വചനങ്ങൾ രാവും പകലും നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധാനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord is God and that there is no other.
chapters.nkjv: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lordis God; thereis no other.
chapters.kjv: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇന്നുള്ളതുപോലെ നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങൾ അനുസരിച്ചുനടപ്പാനും അവന്റെ കല്പനകൾ പ്രമാണിപ്പാനും നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയം നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിങ്കൽ ഏകാഗ്രമായിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: And may your hearts be fully committed to the Lord our God, to live by his decrees and obey his commands, as at this time."
chapters.nkjv: Let your heart therefore be loyal to the Lord our God, to walk in His statutes and keep His commandments, as at this day."
chapters.kjv: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രാജാവും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ യാഗം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD .

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യഹോവെക്കു ഇരുപത്തീരായിരം കാളയെയും ലക്ഷത്തിരുപതിനായിരം ആടിനെയും സമാധാനയാഗമായിട്ടു അർപ്പിച്ചു. ഇങ്ങനെ രാജാവും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളൊക്കെയും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തെ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Solomon offered a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to the Lord : twenty-two thousand cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the Lord, twenty-two thousand bulls and one hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD , two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന താമ്ര യാഗപീഠം ഹോമയാഗം, ഭോജനയാഗം, സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളുടെ മേദസ്സ് എന്നിവ കൊള്ളുന്നതിന്നു പോരാതിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു രാജാവു അന്നു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിലുള്ള പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യഭാഗം ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു അവിടെ ഹോമയാഗവും ഭോജനയാഗവും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളുടെ മേദസ്സും അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On that same day the king consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar that stood before the Lord was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings.
chapters.nkjv: On the same day the king consecrated the middle of the court that was in front of the house of the Lord; for there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the Lordwas too small to receive the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
chapters.kjv: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD : for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോനും അവനോടുകൂടെ ഹമാത്തിന്റെ അതിർമുതൽ മിസ്രയീംതോടുവരെയുള്ള എല്ലാ യിസ്രായേലും വലിയൊരു സഭയായി ആ സമയത്തു നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഏഴു ദിവസവും പിന്നെയും ഏഴു ദിവസവും ഇങ്ങനെ പതിന്നാലും ദിവസം ഉത്സവം ആചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Solomon observed the festival at that time, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt. They celebrated it before the Lord our God for seven days and seven days more, fourteen days in all.
chapters.nkjv: At that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great assembly from the entrance of Hamath to the Brook of Egypt, before the Lord our God, seven days and seven more days—fourteen days.
chapters.kjv: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

chapters.ml: എട്ടാംദിവസം അവൻ ജനത്തെ വിട്ടയച്ചു; അവർ രാജാവിനെ അഭിനന്ദിച്ചു, യഹോവ തന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്നു, തന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നും ചെയ്ത എല്ലാനന്മയെയും കുറിച്ചു സന്തോഷവും ആനന്ദവുമുള്ളവരായി തങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: On the following day he sent the people away. They blessed the king and then went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.
chapters.nkjv: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the good that the Lord had done for His servant David, and for Israel His people.
chapters.kjv: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയവും രാജധാനിയും മറ്റും തനിക്കു ഉണ്ടാക്കുവാൻ മനസ്സും താല്പര്യവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതൊക്കെയും ശലോമോൻ പണിതു തീർന്നശേഷം
chapters.niv: When Solomon had finished building the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had achieved all he had desired to do,
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he wanted to do,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD , and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഗിബെയോനിൽവെച്ചു ശലോമോന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായതുപോലെ രണ്ടാം പ്രാവശ്യവും അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: the Lord appeared to him a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
chapters.nkjv: that the Lord appeared to Solomon the second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.
chapters.kjv: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കഴിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥനയും യാചനയും ഞാൻ കേട്ടു; നീ പണിതിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ ആലയത്തെ എന്റെ നാമം അതിൽ എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥാപിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഞാൻ വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ കണ്ണും ഹൃദയവും എല്ലായ്പോഴും അവിടെ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to him: "I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me; I have consecrated this temple, which you have built, by putting my Name there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to him: "I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before Me; I have consecrated this house which you have built to put My name there forever, and My eyes and My heart will be there perpetually.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഹൃദയനിർമ്മലതയോടും പരമാർത്ഥതയോടും കൂടെ നിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദ് നടന്നതുപോലെ നടക്കുകയും എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: "As for you, if you walk before me faithfully with integrity of heart and uprightness, as David your father did, and do all I command and observe my decrees and laws,
chapters.nkjv: Now if you walk before Me as your father David walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and My judgments,
chapters.kjv: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

chapters.ml: വിധികളും പ്രമാണിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിപ്പാൻ ഒരു പുരുഷൻ നിനക്കു ഇല്ലാതെപോകയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേലിലുള്ള നിന്റെ രാജത്വത്തിന്റെ സിംഹാസനം ഞാൻ എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’
chapters.nkjv: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised David your father, saying, ‘You shall not fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’
chapters.kjv: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ നിങ്ങളുടെ പുത്രന്മാരോ എന്നെ വിട്ടുമാറി നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ കല്പനകളും ചട്ടങ്ങളും പ്രമാണിക്കാതെ ചെന്നു അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ സേവിച്ചു നമസ്കരിച്ചാൽ
chapters.niv: "But if you or your descendants turn away from me and do not observe the commands and decrees I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,
chapters.nkjv: But if you or your sons at all turn from following Me, and do not keep My commandments and My statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,
chapters.kjv: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന ദേശത്തുനിന്നു അവരെ പറിച്ചുകളയും; എന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി ഞാൻ വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ ആലയവും ഞാൻ എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളയും; യിസ്രായേൽ സകലജാതികളുടെയും ഇടയിൽ പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലും പരിഹാസവും ആയിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: then I will cut off Israel from the land I have given them and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. Israel will then become a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.
chapters.nkjv: then I will cut off Israel from the land which I have given them; and this house which I have consecrated for My name I will cast out of My sight. Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
chapters.kjv: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

chapters.ml: ഈ ആലയം എത്ര ഉന്നതമായിരുന്നാലും കടന്നുപോകുന്ന ഏവനും അതിനെ കണ്ടു സ്തംഭിച്ചു ചൂളകുത്തി: യഹോവ ഈ ദേശത്തിന്നും ഈ ആലയത്തിന്നും ഇങ്ങനെ വരുത്തിയതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിക്കും.
chapters.niv: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
chapters.nkjv: And asfor this house, which is exalted, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and will hiss, and say, ‘Why has the Lord done thus to this land and to this house?’
chapters.kjv: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു നിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയും അന്യദൈവങ്ങളോടു ചേർന്നു അവയെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു സേവിക്കയും ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ ഈ അനർത്ഥം ഒക്കെയും അവർക്കു വരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അതിന്നു ഉത്തരം പറയും.
chapters.niv: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why the Lord brought all this disaster on them.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then they will answer, ‘Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, and worshiped them and served them; therefore the Lord has brought all this calamity on them.’ "
chapters.kjv: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം, രാജധാനി എന്നീ രണ്ടു ഭവനവും ഇരുപതു സംവത്സരംകൊണ്ടു പണിതശേഷം
chapters.niv: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built these two buildings—the temple of the Lord and the royal palace—
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the king’s house
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD , and the king’s house,

chapters.ml: സോർരാജാവായ ഹീരാം ശലോമോന്നു അവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ഒക്കെയും ദേവദാരുവും സരളമരവും സ്വർണ്ണവും കൊടുത്തിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു ഹീരാമിന്നു ഗലീലദേശത്തു ഇരുപതു പട്ടണം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon gave twenty towns in Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, because Hiram had supplied him with all the cedar and juniper and gold he wanted.
chapters.nkjv: (Hiram the king of Tyre had supplied Solomon with cedar and cypress and gold, as much as he desired), that King Solomon then gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
chapters.kjv: ( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ ഹീരാമിന്നു കൊടുത്ത പട്ടണങ്ങളെ കാണേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ സോരിൽനിന്നു വന്നു; എന്നാൽ അവ അവന്നു ബോധിച്ചില്ല, സഹോദരാ,
chapters.niv: But when Hiram went from Tyre to see the towns that Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hiram went from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him, but they did not please him.
chapters.kjv: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

chapters.ml: നീ എനിക്കു തന്ന ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവെക്കു ഇന്നുവരെയും കാബൂൽദേശം എന്നു പേരായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "What kind of towns are these you have given me, my brother?" he asked. And he called them the Land of Kabul, a name they have to this day.
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "What kindof cities are these which you have given me, my brother?" And he called them the land of Cabul, as they are to this day.
chapters.kjv: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

chapters.ml: ഹീരാമോ രാജാവിന്നു നൂറ്റിരുപതു താലന്തു പൊന്നു കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Hiram had sent to the king 120 talents of gold.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hiram sent the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold.
chapters.kjv: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം, അരമന, മില്ലോ, യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ മതിൽ, ഹാസോർ, മെഗിദ്ദോ, ഗേസെർ എന്നിവ പണിയേണ്ടതിന്നു ഊഴിയവേല ചെയ്യിച്ച വിവരം:
chapters.niv: Here is the account of the forced labor King Solomon conscripted to build the Lord ’s temple, his own palace, the terraces, the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, Megiddo and Gezer.
chapters.nkjv: And this is the reason for the labor force which King Solomon raised: to build the house of the Lord, his own house, the Millo, the wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
chapters.kjv: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD , and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോൻ ചെന്നു, ഗേസെർ പിടിച്ചു തീവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു, അതിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന കനാന്യരെ കൊന്നു, അതിനെ ശലോമോന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ തന്റെ മകൾക്കു സ്ത്രീധനമായി കൊടുത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire. He killed its Canaanite inhabitants and then gave it as a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
chapters.nkjv: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up and taken Gezer and burned it with fire, had killed the Canaanites who dwelt in the city, and had given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.)
chapters.kjv: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശലോമോൻ ഗേസെരും
chapters.niv: And Solomon rebuilt Gezer.) He built up Lower Beth Horon,
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon built Gezer, Lower Beth Horon,
chapters.kjv: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,

chapters.ml: താഴത്തെ ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോനും ബാലാത്തും ദേശത്തിലെ മരുഭൂമിയിലുള്ള
chapters.niv: Baalath, and Tadmor in the desert, within his land,
chapters.nkjv: Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land ofJudah,
chapters.kjv: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

chapters.ml: തദ്മോരും ശലോമോന്നു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന സകലസംഭാരനഗരങ്ങളും രഥനഗരങ്ങളും കുതിരച്ചേവകർക്കുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളും ശലോമോൻ യെരൂശലേമിലും ലെബാനോനിലും തന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിൽ എല്ലാടവും പണിവാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചതൊക്കെയും പണിതു
chapters.niv: as well as all his store cities and the towns for his chariots and for his horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.
chapters.nkjv: all the storage cities that Solomon had, cities for his chariots and cities for his cavalry, and whatever Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
chapters.kjv: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

chapters.ml: അമോര്യർ, ഹിത്യർ, പെരിസ്യർ, ഹിവ്യർ, യെബൂസ്യർ എന്നിങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടാത്ത ശേഷിപ്പുള്ള സകലജാതിയെയും
chapters.niv: There were still people left from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites).
chapters.nkjv: All the people whowere left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—
chapters.kjv: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു നിർമ്മൂലമാക്കുവാൻ കഴിയാതെ പിന്നീടും ദേശത്തു ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്ന അവരുടെ മക്കളെയും ശലോമോൻ ഊഴിയവേലക്കാരാക്കി; അവർ ഇന്നുവരെ അങ്ങനെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these peoples remaining in the land—whom the Israelites could not exterminate —to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.
chapters.nkjv: that is, their descendants who were left in the land after them, whom the children of Israel had not been able to destroy completely— from these Solomon raised forced labor, as it is to this day.
chapters.kjv: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ നിന്നോ ശലോമോൻ ആരെയും ദാസ്യവേലക്കാക്കിയില്ല; അവർ അവന്റെ യോദ്ധാക്കളും ഭൃത്യന്മാരും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും പടനായകന്മാരും അവന്റെ രഥങ്ങൾക്കും കുതിരച്ചേവകർക്കും അധിപതിമാരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Solomon did not make slaves of any of the Israelites; they were his fighting men, his government officials, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and charioteers.
chapters.nkjv: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no forced laborers, because they were men of war and his servants: his officers, his captains, commanders of his chariots, and his cavalry.
chapters.kjv: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ഞൂറ്റമ്പതുപേർ ശലോമോന്റെ വേലയെടുത്ത ജനത്തിന്നു മേധാവികളായ മേലുദ്യോഗസ്ഥന്മാരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were also the chief officials in charge of Solomon’s projects—550 officials supervising those who did the work.
chapters.nkjv: Others were chiefs of the officials who were over Solomon’s work: five hundred and fifty, who ruled over the people who did the work.
chapters.kjv: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്റെ മകൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽനിന്നു ശലോമോൻ അവൾക്കുവേണ്ടി പണിതിരുന്ന അരമനയിൽ പാർപ്പാൻ വന്നശേഷം അവൻ മില്ലോ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: After Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace Solomon had built for her, he constructed the terraces.
chapters.nkjv: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up from the City of David to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built the Millo.
chapters.kjv: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യഹോവെക്കു പണിതിരുന്ന യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ അവർ ആണ്ടിൽ മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ധൂപം കാട്ടും. ഇങ്ങനെ അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം തീർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Three times a year Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar he had built for the Lord , burning incense before the Lord along with them, and so fulfilled the temple obligations.
chapters.nkjv: Now three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he had built for the Lord, and he burned incense with them onthealtar that was before the Lord. So he finished the temple.
chapters.kjv: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD , and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD . So he finished the house.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു എദോംദേശത്തു ചെങ്കടല്കരയിൽ ഏലോത്തിന്നു സമീപത്തുള്ള എസ്യോൻ-ഗേബെരിൽവെച്ചു കപ്പലുകൾ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.
chapters.nkjv: King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

chapters.ml: ആ കപ്പലുകളിൽ ശലോമോന്റെ ദാസന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ഹീരാം സമുദ്രപരിചയമുള്ള കപ്പൽക്കാരായ തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Hiram sent his men—sailors who knew the sea—to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s men.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hiram sent his servants with the fleet, seamen who knew the sea, to work with the servants of Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഓഫീരിലേക്കു ചെന്നു അവിടെനിന്നു നാനൂറ്റിരുപതു താലന്തു പൊന്നു ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: They sailed to Ophir and brought back 420 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: And they went to Ophir, and acquired four hundred and twenty talents of gold from there, and brought it to King Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

chapters.ml: ശെബാരാജ്ഞി യഹോവയുടെ നാമം സംബന്ധിച്ചു ശലോമോന്നുള്ള കീർത്തികേട്ടിട്ടു കടമൊഴികളാൽ അവനെ പരീക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon and his relationship to the Lord , she came to test Solomon with hard questions.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the Lord, she came to test him with hard questions.
chapters.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD , she came to prove him with hard questions.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അതിമഹത്തായ പരിവാരത്തോടും സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗവും അനവധി പൊന്നും രത്നവും ചുമന്ന ഒട്ടകളങ്ങളോടുംകൂടെ യെരൂശലേമിൽവന്നു; അവൾ ശലോമോന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നശേഷം തന്റെ മനോരഥമൊക്കെയും അവനോടു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Arriving at Jerusalem with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all that she had on her mind.
chapters.nkjv: She came to Jerusalem with a very great retinue, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she came to Solomon, she spoke with him about all that was in her heart.
chapters.kjv: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ സകലചോദ്യങ്ങൾക്കും ശലോമോൻ സമാധാനം പറഞ്ഞു. സമാധാനം പറവാൻ കഴിയാതെ ഒന്നും രാജാവിന്നു മറപൊരുളായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.
chapters.nkjv: So Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing so difficult for the king that he could not explain it to her.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

chapters.ml: ശെബാരാജ്ഞി ശലോമോന്റെ സകലജ്ഞാനവും അവൻ പണിത അരമനയും
chapters.niv: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon and the palace he had built,
chapters.nkjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
chapters.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മേശയിലെ ഭക്ഷണവും അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുടെ ഇരിപ്പും അവന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷകന്മാരുടെ നിലയും അവരുടെ ഉടുപ്പും അവന്റെ പാനപാത്രവാഹകന്മാരെയും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കുള്ള അവന്റെ എഴുന്നെള്ളത്തും കണ്ടിട്ടു അമ്പരന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.
chapters.nkjv: the food on his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his waiters and their apparel, his cupbearers, and his entryway by which he went up to the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.
chapters.kjv: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD ; there was no more spirit in her.

chapters.ml: അവൾ രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിന്റെ കാര്യങ്ങളെയും ജ്ഞാനത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു കേട്ട വർത്തമാനം സത്യം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.
chapters.nkjv: Then she said to the king: "It was a true report which I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom.
chapters.kjv: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വന്നു എന്റെ കണ്ണുകൊണ്ടു കാണുന്നതുവരെ ആ വർത്തമാനം വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല. എന്നാൽ പാതിപോലും ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നില്ല. ഞാൻ കേട്ട കീർത്തിയെക്കാൾ നിന്റെ ജ്ഞാനവും ധനവും അധികമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.
chapters.nkjv: However I did not believe the words until I came and saw with my own eyes; and indeed the half was not told me. Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame of which I heard.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഭാര്യമാർ ഭാഗ്യവതികൾ; നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ എപ്പോഴും നിന്നു നിന്റെ ജ്ഞാനം കേൾക്കുന്ന ഈ നിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരും ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.nkjv: Happy are your men and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.kjv: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.

chapters.ml: നിന്നെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുത്തുവാൻ നിന്നിൽ പ്രസാദിച്ച നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ; യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിനെ എന്നേക്കും സ്നേഹിക്കകൊണ്ടു നീതിയും ന്യായവും നടത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്നെ രാജാവാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the Lord ’s eternal love for Israel, he has made you king to maintain justice and righteousness."
chapters.nkjv: Blessed be the Lord your God, who delighted in you, setting you on the throne of Israel! Because the Lord has loved Israel forever, therefore He made you king, to do justice and righteousness."
chapters.kjv: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

chapters.ml: അവൾ രാജാവിന്നു നൂറ്റിരുപതു താലന്ത് പൊന്നും അനവധി സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗവും രത്നവും കൊടുത്തു; ശെബാരാജ്ഞി ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്നു കൊടുത്ത സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗംപോലെ അത്ര വളരെ പിന്നെ ഒരിക്കലും വന്നിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: And she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: Then she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great quantity, and precious stones. There never again came such abundance of spices as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

chapters.ml: ഓഫീരിൽനിന്നു പൊന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ഹീരാമിന്റെ കപ്പലുകൾ ഓഫീരിൽനിന്നു അനവധി ചന്ദനവും രത്നവും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Hiram’s ships brought gold from Ophir; and from there they brought great cargoes of almugwood and precious stones.
chapters.nkjv: Also, the ships of Hiram, which brought gold from Ophir, brought great quantities of almug wood and precious stones from Ophir.
chapters.kjv: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ചന്ദനംകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്നും രാജധാനിക്കും അഴികളും സംഗീതക്കാർക്കു കിന്നരങ്ങളും വീണകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അങ്ങനെയുള്ള ചന്ദനമരം ഇന്നുവരെ വന്നിട്ടില്ല, കണ്ടിട്ടുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: The king used the almugwood to make supports for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. So much almugwood has never been imported or seen since that day.)
chapters.nkjv: And the king made steps of the almug wood for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, also harps and stringed instruments for singers. There never again came such almug wood, nor has the like been seen to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD , and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു സ്വമേധയാ ശെബാരാജ്ഞിക്കു രാജൌചിത്യംപോലെ കൊടുത്തതുകൂടാതെ അവൾ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചതുമെല്ലാം ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു അവൾക്കു കൊടുത്തു. അങ്ങനെ അവൾ തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുമായി സ്വദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for, besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.
chapters.nkjv: Now King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired, whatever she asked, besides what Solomon had given her according to the royal generosity. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്നു സഞ്ചാരവ്യാപാരികളാലും വർത്തകന്മാരുടെ കച്ചവടത്താലും സമ്മിശ്രജാതികളുടെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരാലും ദേശാധിപതിമാരാലും വന്നതു കൂടാതെ
chapters.niv: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,
chapters.nkjv: The weight of gold that came to Solomon yearly was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,
chapters.kjv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

chapters.ml: ആണ്ടുതോറും വന്ന പൊന്നിന്റെ തൂക്കം അറുനൂറ്ററുപത്താറു താലന്തായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: not including the revenues from merchants and traders and from all the Arabian kings and the governors of the territories.
chapters.nkjv: besides that from the traveling merchants, from the income of traders, from all the kings of Arabia, and from the governors of the country.
chapters.kjv: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു, അടിച്ചുപരത്തിയ പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഇരുനൂറു വൻ പരിച ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ഓരോ പരിചെക്കു അറുനൂറുശേക്കൽ പൊന്നു ചെലവായി.
chapters.niv: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.
chapters.nkjv: And King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

chapters.ml: അടിച്ചുപരത്തിയ പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ മുന്നൂറു ചെറുപരിചയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ഓരോ ചെറു പരിചെക്കു മൂന്നു മാനേ പൊന്നു ചെലവായി; അവയെ രാജാവു ലെബാനോൻ വനഗൃഹത്തിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three minas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.nkjv: He also made three hundred shields of hammered gold; three minas of gold went into each shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.kjv: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ദന്തംകൊണ്ടു ഒരു വലിയ സിംഹാസനം ഉണ്ടാക്കി തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
chapters.kjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

chapters.ml: സിംഹാസനത്തിന്നു ആറു പതനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ തലപുറകോട്ടു വളഞ്ഞിരുന്നു; ഇരിപ്പിടത്തിന്റെ ഇരുഭാഗത്തും കൈത്താങ്ങലും കൈത്താങ്ങലിന്നരികെ നില്ക്കുന്ന രണ്ടു സിംഹവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.
chapters.nkjv: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round at the back; therewere armrests on either side of the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the armrests.
chapters.kjv: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

chapters.ml: ആറു പതനത്തിൽ ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തുമായി പന്ത്രണ്ടു സിംഹം നിന്നിരുന്നു. ഒരു രാജ്യത്തും ഇങ്ങനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: Twelve lions stood there, one on each side of the six steps; nothing like this had been made for any other kingdom.
chapters.kjv: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ സകലപാനപാത്രങ്ങളും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടും ലെബാനോൻ വനഗൃഹത്തിലെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും തങ്കംകൊണ്ടും ആയിരുന്നു; ഒന്നും വെള്ളികൊണ്ടല്ല; അതിന്നു ശലോമോന്റെ കാലത്തു വിലയില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s days.
chapters.nkjv: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Not onewas silver, for this was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

chapters.ml: രാജാവിന്നു സമുദ്രത്തിൽ ഹീരാമിന്റെ കപ്പലുകളോടുകൂടെ തർശീശ് കപ്പലുകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; തർശീശ് കപ്പലുകൾ മൂന്നു സംവത്സരത്തിൽ ഒരിക്കൽ പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, ആനക്കൊമ്പു, കുരങ്ങു, മയിൽ എന്നിവ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king had a fleet of trading ships at sea along with the ships of Hiram. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.
chapters.nkjv: For the king had merchant ships at sea with the fleet of Hiram. Once every three years the merchant ships came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and monkeys.
chapters.kjv: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരിലുംവെച്ചു ധനംകൊണ്ടും ജ്ഞാനംകൊണ്ടും മികെച്ചവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
chapters.kjv: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ശലോമോന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ കൊടുത്ത ജ്ഞാനം കേൾക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു സകലദേശക്കാരും അവന്റെ മുഖദർശനം അന്വേഷിച്ചുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The whole world sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.
chapters.nkjv: Now all the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
chapters.kjv: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തനും ആണ്ടുതോറും താന്താന്റെ കാഴ്ചയായി വെള്ളിപ്പാത്രം, പൊൻ പാത്രം, വസ്ത്രം, ആയുധം, സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം, കുതിര, കോവർകഴുത എന്നിവ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.
chapters.nkjv: Each man brought his present: articles of silver and gold, garments, armor, spices, horses, and mules, at a set rate year by year.
chapters.kjv: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രഥങ്ങളെയും കുതിരച്ചേവകരെയും ശേഖരിച്ചു: അവന്നു ആയിരത്തിനാനൂറു രഥങ്ങളും പന്തീരായിരം കുതിരച്ചേവകരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവരെ അവൻ രാജാവിന്റെ രഥനഗരങ്ങളിലും യെരൂശലേമിൽ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കലും പാർപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു യെരൂശലേമിൽ വെള്ളിയെ പെരുപ്പംകൊണ്ടു കല്ലുപോലെയും ദേവദാരുവിനെ താഴ്വീതിയിലെ കാട്ടത്തിമരംപോലെയുമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
chapters.nkjv: The king made silver ascommon in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar trees as abundant as the sycamores which are in the lowland.
chapters.kjv: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്നു കുതിരകളെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നായിരുന്നു; രാജാവിന്റെ കച്ചവടക്കാർ അവയെ കൂട്ടമായിട്ടു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ടുവരും.
chapters.niv: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue —the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.
chapters.nkjv: Also Solomon had horses imported from Egypt and Keveh; the king’s merchants bought them in Keveh at the current price.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

chapters.ml: അവർ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു രഥം ഒന്നിന്നു അറുനൂറും കുതിര ഒന്നിന്നു നൂറ്റമ്പതും വെള്ളിശേക്കൽ വില കൊടുത്തു വാങ്ങികൊണ്ടുവരും; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവർ ഹിത്യരുടെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാർക്കും അരാംരാജാക്കന്മാർക്കും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.
chapters.nkjv: Now a chariot that was imported from Egypt cost six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse one hundred and fifty; and thus, through their agents, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.
chapters.kjv: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു ഫറവോന്റെ മകളെ കൂടാതെ മോവാബ്യർ, അമ്മോന്യർ, എദോമ്യർ, സീദോന്യർ, ഹിത്യർ എന്നിങ്ങനെ അന്യാജാതിക്കാരത്തികളായ അനേക സ്ത്രീകളെയും സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women besides Pharaoh’s daughter—Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians and Hittites.
chapters.nkjv: But King Solomon loved many foreign women, as well as the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites—
chapters.kjv: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു അവരോടു കൂടിക്കലർച്ച അരുതു; അവർക്കു നിങ്ങളോടും കൂടിക്കലർച്ച അരുതു; അവർ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയത്തെ തങ്ങളുടെ ദേവന്മാരിലേക്കു വശീകരിച്ചുകളയും എന്നു യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത അന്യജാതികളിൽനിന്നുള്ളവരെ തന്നേ; അവരോടു ശലോമോൻ സ്നേഹത്താൽ പറ്റിച്ചേർന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were from nations about which the Lord had told the Israelites, "You must not intermarry with them, because they will surely turn your hearts after their gods." Nevertheless, Solomon held fast to them in love.
chapters.nkjv: from the nations of whom the Lord had said to the children of Israel, "You shall not intermarry with them, nor they with you. Surely they will turn away your hearts after their gods." Solomon clung to these in love.
chapters.kjv: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു എഴുനൂറു കുലീനപത്നികളും മുന്നൂറു വെപ്പാട്ടികളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യമാർ അവന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തെ വശീകരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines, and his wives led him astray.
chapters.nkjv: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned away his heart.
chapters.kjv: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

chapters.ml: എങ്ങനെയെന്നാൽ: ശലോമോൻ വയോധികനായപ്പോൾ ഭാര്യമാർ അവന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തെ അന്യദേവന്മാരിലേക്കു വശീകരിച്ചു; അവന്റെ ഹൃദയം അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഹൃദയംപോലെ തന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിങ്കൽ ഏകാഗ്രമായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: As Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father had been.
chapters.nkjv: For it was so, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned his heart after other gods; and his heart was not loyal to the Lord his God, as was the heart of his father David.
chapters.kjv: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ സീദോന്യദേവിയായ അസ്തോരെത്തിനെയും അമ്മോന്യരുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛവിഗ്രഹമായ മിൽക്കോമിനെയും ചെന്നു സേവിച്ചു
chapters.niv: He followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
chapters.kjv: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിനെപ്പോലെ യഹോവയെ പൂർണ്ണമായി അനുസരിക്കാതെ ശലോമോൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So Solomon did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; he did not follow the Lord completely, as David his father had done.
chapters.nkjv: Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, and did not fully follow the Lord, as did his father David.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD , and went not fully after the LORD , as did David his father.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ശലോമോൻ യെരൂശലേമിന്നു എതിരെയുള്ള മലയിൽ മോവാബ്യരുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛവിഗ്രഹമായ കെമോശിന്നും അമ്മോന്യരുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛവിഗ്രഹമായ മോലേക്കിന്നും ഓരോ പൂജാഗിരി പണിതു.
chapters.niv: On a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the detestable god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the hill that is east of Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the people of Ammon.
chapters.kjv: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ ദേവന്മാർക്കു ധൂപം കാട്ടിയും ബലികഴിച്ചുംപോന്ന അന്യജാതിക്കാരത്തികളായ സകലഭാര്യമാർക്കും വേണ്ടി അവൻ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and offered sacrifices to their gods.
chapters.nkjv: And he did likewise for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
chapters.kjv: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

chapters.ml: തനിക്കു രണ്ടുപ്രാവശ്യം പ്രത്യക്ഷനാകയും അന്യദേവന്മാരെ ചെന്നു സേവിക്കരുതെന്ന കാര്യത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു തന്നോടു കല്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരുന്ന യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ വിട്ടു ശലോമോൻ തന്റെ ഹൃദയം തിരിക്കയും
chapters.niv: The Lord became angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the Lord , the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord became angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned from the Lord God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതു പ്രമാണിക്കാതെ ഇരിക്കയും ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ അവനോടു കോപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Although he had forbidden Solomon to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the Lord ’s command.
chapters.nkjv: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he did not keep what the Lord had commanded.
chapters.kjv: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ശലോമോനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: എന്റെ നിയമവും ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ച കല്പനകളും നീ പ്രമാണിച്ചില്ല എന്നുള്ള സംഗതി നിന്റെ പേരിൽ ഇരിക്കകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ രാജത്വം നിങ്കൽ നിന്നു നിശ്ചയമായി പറിച്ചു നിന്റെ ദാസന്നു കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: So the Lord said to Solomon, "Since this is your attitude and you have not kept my covenant and my decrees, which I commanded you, I will most certainly tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your subordinates.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Lord said to Solomon, "Because you have done this, and have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിൻ നിമിത്തം ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തു അതു ചെയ്കയില്ല; എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ മകന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു അതിനെ പറിച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, for the sake of David your father, I will not do it during your lifetime. I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless I will not do it in your days, for the sake of your father David; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും രാജത്വം മുഴുവനും പറിച്ചുകളയാതെ എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിൻ നിമിത്തവും ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത യെരൂശലേമിൻ നിമിത്തവും ഒരു ഗോത്രത്തെ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മകന്നു കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom from him, but will give him one tribe for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen."
chapters.nkjv: However I will not tear away the whole kingdom; I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David, and for the sake of Jerusalem which I have chosen."
chapters.kjv: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എദോമ്യനായ ഹദദ് എന്ന ഒരു പ്രതിയോഗിയെ ശലോമോന്റെ നേരെ എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു. അവൻ എദോം രാജസന്തതിയിൽ ഉള്ളവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was a descendant of the king in Edom.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് എദോമ്യരെ നിഗ്രഹിച്ചകാലത്തു സേനാധിപതിയായ യോവാബ് പട്ടുപോയവരെ അടക്കംചെയ്‍വാൻ ചെന്നു എദോമിലെ പുരുഷപ്രജയെ ഒക്കെയും നിഗ്രഹിച്ചപ്പോൾ--
chapters.niv: Earlier when David was fighting with Edom, Joab the commander of the army, who had gone up to bury the dead, had struck down all the men in Edom.
chapters.nkjv: For it happened, when David was in Edom, and Joab the commander of the army had gone up to bury the slain, after he had killed every male in Edom
chapters.kjv: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

chapters.ml: എദോമിലെ പുരുഷപ്രജയെ ഒക്കെയും നിഗ്രഹിക്കുവോളം യോവാബും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും അവിടെ ആറുമാസം പാർത്തിരുന്നു--
chapters.niv: Joab and all the Israelites stayed there for six months, until they had destroyed all the men in Edom.
chapters.nkjv: (because for six months Joab remained there with all Israel, until he had cut down every male in Edom),
chapters.kjv: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

chapters.ml: ഹദദ് എന്നവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരിൽ ചില എദോമ്യരുമായി മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി; ഹദദ് അന്നു പൈതൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Hadad, still only a boy, fled to Egypt with some Edomite officials who had served his father.
chapters.nkjv: that Hadad fled to go to Egypt, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him. Hadad was still a little child.
chapters.kjv: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

chapters.ml: അവർ മിദ്യാനിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പാറാനിൽ എത്തി; പാറാനിൽനിന്നു ആളുകളെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു മിസ്രയീമിൽ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; അവൻ അവന്നു ഒരു വീടു കൊടുത്തു ആഹാരം കല്പിച്ചു ഒരു ദേശവും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. Then taking people from Paran with them, they went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.
chapters.nkjv: Then they arose from Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them from Paran and came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, apportioned food for him, and gave him land.
chapters.kjv: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോന്നു ഹദദിനോടു വളരെ ഇഷ്ടം തോന്നി; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ തഹ്പെനേസ്രാജ്ഞിയുടെ സഹോദരിയെ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh was so pleased with Hadad that he gave him a sister of his own wife, Queen Tahpenes, in marriage.
chapters.nkjv: And Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, that is, the sister of Queen Tahpenes.
chapters.kjv: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

chapters.ml: തഹ്പെനേസിന്റെ സഹോദരി അവന്നു ഗെനൂബത്ത് എന്നൊരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; അവനെ തഹ്പെനേസ് മുലകുടി മാറ്റി ഫറവോന്റെ അരമനയിൽ വളർത്തി; അങ്ങനെ ഗെനൂബത്ത് ഫറവോന്റെ അരമനയിൽ ഫറവോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son named Genubath, whom Tahpenes brought up in the royal palace. There Genubath lived with Pharaoh’s own children.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house. And Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു എന്നും സേനാധിപതിയായ യോവാബും മരിച്ചു എന്നും ഹദദ് മിസ്രയീമിൽ കേട്ടിട്ടു ഫറവോനോടു: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദേശത്തേക്കു യാത്രയാകേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നെ അയക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While he was in Egypt, Hadad heard that David rested with his ancestors and that Joab the commander of the army was also dead. Then Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me go, that I may return to my own country."
chapters.nkjv: So when Hadad heard in Egypt that David rested with his fathers, and that Joab the commander of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me depart, that I may go to my own country."
chapters.kjv: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ അവനോടു: നീ സ്വദേശത്തേക്കു പോകുവാൻ താല്പര്യപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിനക്കു എന്തു കുറവുള്ള എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു; അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഒന്നുമുണ്ടായിട്ടല്ല; എങ്കിലും എന്നെ ഒന്നയക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What have you lacked here that you want to go back to your own country?" Pharaoh asked. "Nothing," Hadad replied, "but do let me go!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh said to him, "But what have you lacked with me, that suddenly you seek to go to your own country?" So he answered, "Nothing, but do let me go anyway."
chapters.kjv: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവന്റെ നേരെ എല്യാദാവിന്റെ മകനായ രെസോൻ എന്ന മറ്റൊരു പ്രതിയോഗിയെയും എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു; അവൻ സോബാരാജാവായ ഹദദേസർ എന്ന തന്റെ യജമാനനെ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
chapters.nkjv: And God raised up another adversary against him, Rezon the son of Eliadah, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
chapters.kjv: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് സോബക്കാരെ നിഗ്രഹിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ തനിക്കു ആളുകളെ ശേഖരിച്ചു അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു നായകനായ്തീർന്നു; അവർ ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ പാർത്തു ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽ വാണു.
chapters.niv: When David destroyed Zobah’s army, Rezon gathered a band of men around him and became their leader; they went to Damascus, where they settled and took control.
chapters.nkjv: So he gathered men to him and became captain over a band ofraiders, when David killed those ofZobah. And they went to Damascus and dwelt there, and reigned in Damascus.
chapters.kjv: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

chapters.ml: ഹദദ് ചെയ്ത ദോഷം കൂടാതെ ഇവനും ശലോമോന്റെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്നു പ്രതിയോഗി ആയിരുന്നു; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ വെറുത്തു അരാമിൽ രാജാവായിവാണു.
chapters.niv: Rezon was Israel’s adversary as long as Solomon lived, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled in Aram and was hostile toward Israel.
chapters.nkjv: He was an adversary of Israel all the days of Solomon (besides the trouble that Hadad caused); and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
chapters.kjv: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

chapters.ml: സെരേദയിൽനിന്നുള്ള എഫ്രയീമ്യനായ നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ യൊരോബെയാം എന്ന ശലോമോന്റെ ദാസനും രാജാവിനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു; അവന്റെ അമ്മ സെരൂയാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു വിധവ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Also, Jeroboam son of Nebat rebelled against the king. He was one of Solomon’s officials, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, and his mother was a widow named Zeruah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon’s servant, Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zereda, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also rebelled against the king.
chapters.kjv: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാജാവിനോടു മത്സരിപ്പാനുള്ള കാരണം എന്തെന്നാൽ: ശലോമോൻ മില്ലോ പണിതു, തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Here is the account of how he rebelled against the king: Solomon had built the terraces and had filled in the gap in the wall of the city of David his father.
chapters.nkjv: And this is what caused him to rebel against the king: Solomon had built the Millo and repaired the damages to the City of David his father.
chapters.kjv: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യൊരോബെയാം ബഹു പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള പുരുഷൻ ആയിരുന്നു; ഈ യൌവനക്കാരൻ പരിശ്രമശീലൻ എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു ശലോമോൻ യോസേഫ്ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ കാര്യാദികളൊക്കെയും അവന്റെ വിചാരണയിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Jeroboam was a man of standing, and when Solomon saw how well the young man did his work, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the tribes of Joseph.
chapters.nkjv: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon, seeing that the young man was industrious, made him the officer over all the labor force of the house of Joseph.
chapters.kjv: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഒരിക്കൽ യൊരോബെയാം യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നു വരുമ്പോൾ ശിലോന്യനായ അഹിയാപ്രവാചകൻ വഴിയിൽവെച്ചു അവനെ കണ്ടു; അവൻ ഒരു പുതിയ അങ്കി ധരിച്ചിരുന്നു; രണ്ടുപേരും വയലിൽ തനിച്ചായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: About that time Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, and Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh met him on the way, wearing a new cloak. The two of them were alone out in the country,
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite met him on the way; and he had clothed himself with a new garment, and the two were alone in the field.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

chapters.ml: അഹിയാവു താൻ ധരിച്ചിരുന്ന പുതിയ അങ്കി പിടിച്ചു പന്ത്രണ്ടു ഖണ്ഡമായി കീറി:
chapters.niv: and Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ahijah took hold of the new garment that was on him, and tore it into twelve pieces.
chapters.kjv: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാമിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: പത്തു ഖണ്ഡം നീ എടുത്തുകൊൾക; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഇതാ ഞാൻ രാജത്വം ശലോമോന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു പറിച്ചുകീറി, പത്തു ഗോത്രം നിനക്കു തരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to Jeroboam, "Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘See, I am going to tear the kingdom out of Solomon’s hand and give you ten tribes.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to Jeroboam, "Take for yourself ten pieces, for thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
chapters.kjv: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിൻ നിമിത്തവും ഞാൻ എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത യെരൂശലേം നഗരം നിമിത്തവും ഒരു ഗോത്രം അവന്നു ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But for the sake of my servant David and the city of Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, he will have one tribe.
chapters.nkjv: (but he shall have one tribe for the sake of My servant David, and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),
chapters.kjv: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

chapters.ml: അവർ എന്നെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു, സീദോന്യദേവിയായ അസ്തോരെത്തിനെയും മോവാബ്യദേവനായ കെമോശിനെയും അമ്മോന്യദേവനായ മിൽക്കോമിനെയും നമസ്കരിക്കയും അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദ് എന്നപോലെ എനിക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്‍വാനും എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളും വിധികളും പ്രമാണിപ്പാനും അവർ എന്റെ വഴികളിൽ നടക്കാതെ ഇരിക്കയും ചെയ്തതു കൊണ്ടു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: I will do this because they have forsaken me and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Molek the god of the Ammonites, and have not walked in obedience to me, nor done what is right in my eyes, nor kept my decrees and laws as David, Solomon’s father, did.
chapters.nkjv: because they have forsaken Me, and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the people of Ammon, and have not walked in My ways to do whatis right in My eyes and keep My statutes and My judgments, as did his father David.
chapters.kjv: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാജത്വം മുഴുവനും ഞാൻ അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു എടുക്കയില്ല; ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തവനും എന്റെ കല്പനകളെയും ചട്ടങ്ങളെയും പ്രമാണിച്ചവനും ആയ എന്റെ ദാസൻ ദാവീദ് നിമിത്തം ഞാൻ അവനെ അവന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തൊക്കെയും പ്രഭുവായി വെച്ചേക്കും.
chapters.niv: " ‘But I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand; I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose and who obeyed my commands and decrees.
chapters.nkjv: However I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, because I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of My servant David, whom I chose because he kept My commandments and My statutes.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവന്റെ മകന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഞാൻ രാജത്വം എടുത്തു നിനക്കു തരും; പത്തു ഗോത്രങ്ങളെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: I will take the kingdom from his son’s hands and give you ten tribes.
chapters.nkjv: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and give it to you—ten tribes.
chapters.kjv: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നാമം സ്ഥാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത യെരൂശലേംനഗരത്തിൽ എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്നു എന്നേക്കും ഒരു ദീപം ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം ഞാൻ അവന്റെ മകന്നു ഒരു ഗോത്രത്തെ കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will give one tribe to his son so that David my servant may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put my Name.
chapters.nkjv: And to his son I will give one tribe, that My servant David may always have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for Myself, to put My name there.
chapters.kjv: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

chapters.ml: നീയോ നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ഒക്കെയും വാണു യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ എടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: However, as for you, I will take you, and you will rule over all that your heart desires; you will be king over Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So I will take you, and you shall reign over all your heart desires, and you shall be king over Israel.
chapters.kjv: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും നീ കേട്ടു എന്റെ വഴികളിൽ നടന്നു എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദ് ചെയ്തതു പോലെ എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളും കല്പനകളും പ്രമാണിച്ചു കൊണ്ടു എനിക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്താൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കും; ഞാൻ ദാവീദിന്നു പണിതതുപോലെ നിനക്കു സ്ഥിരമായോരു ഗൃഹം പണിതു യിസ്രായേലിനെ നിനക്കു തരും.
chapters.niv: If you do whatever I command you and walk in obedience to me and do what is right in my eyes by obeying my decrees and commands, as David my servant did, I will be with you. I will build you a dynasty as enduring as the one I built for David and will give Israel to you.
chapters.nkjv: Then it shall be, if you heed all that I command you, walk in My ways, and do whatis right in My sight, to keep My statutes and My commandments, as My servant David did, then I will be with you and build for you an enduring house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ സന്തതിയെയോ ഞാൻ ഇതു നിമിത്തം താഴ്ത്തും; സദാകാലത്തേക്കല്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: I will humble David’s descendants because of this, but not forever.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And I will afflict the descendants of David because of this, but not forever.’ "
chapters.kjv: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ശലോമോൻ യൊരോബെയാമിനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അന്വേഷിച്ചു. എന്നാൽ യൊരോബെയാം എഴുന്നേറ്റു മിസ്രയീമിൽ ശീശക്ക്ക് എന്ന മിസ്രയീംരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിപ്പോയി; ശലോമോന്റെ മരണംവരെ അവൻ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam fled to Egypt, to Shishak the king, and stayed there until Solomon’s death.
chapters.nkjv: Solomon therefore sought to kill Jeroboam. But Jeroboam arose and fled to Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
