chapters.kjv: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവന്റെ ജ്ഞാനവും ശലോമോന്റെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign—all he did and the wisdom he displayed—are they not written in the book of the annals of Solomon?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ എല്ലാ യിസ്രായേലിനെയും വാണകാലം നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
chapters.nkjv: And the period that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
chapters.kjv: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ രെഹബെയാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David his father. And Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാമിനെ രാജാവാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും ശെഖേമിൽ വന്നിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവനും ശെഖേമിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
chapters.nkjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone to Shechem to make him king.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

chapters.ml: നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാം മിസ്രയീമിൽ അതു കേട്ടാറെ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു യൊരോബെയാം മിസ്രയീമിൽ ഓടിപ്പോയി അവിടെ പാർത്തിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: So it happened, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard it (he was still in Egypt, for he had fled from the presence of King Solomon and had been dwelling in Egypt ),
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it , (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

chapters.ml: അവർ ആളയച്ചു അവനെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നു--യൊരോബെയാമും യിസ്രായേൽസഭയൊക്കെയും വന്നു രെഹബെയാമിനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:
chapters.nkjv: that they sent and called him. Then Jeroboam and the whole assembly of Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
chapters.kjv: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെച്ചു; നിന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ കഠിനവേലയും അവൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഭാരമുള്ള നുകവും നീ ഭാരം കുറെച്ചുതരേണം; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ സേവിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."
chapters.nkjv: "Your father made our yoke heavy; now therefore, lighten the burdensome service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you."
chapters.kjv: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ പോയി മൂന്നു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു വീണ്ടും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ജനം പോയി.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam answered, "Go away for three days and then come back to me." So the people went away.
chapters.nkjv: So he said to them, "Depart for three days, then come back to me." And the people departed.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം രാജാവു തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശലോമോന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തു അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നിരുന്ന വൃദ്ധന്മാരോടു ആലോചിച്ചു: ഈ ജനത്തോടു ഉത്തരം പറയേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്താലോചന പറയുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who stood before his father Solomon while he still lived, and he said, "How do you advise me to answer these people?"
chapters.kjv: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ അവനോടു: നീ ഇന്നു ഈ ജനത്തിന്നു വഴിപ്പെട്ടു അവരെ സേവിച്ചു അവരോടു നല്ലവാക്കു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അവർ എന്നും നിനക്കു ദാസന്മാരായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "If today you will be a servant to these people and serve them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."
chapters.nkjv: And they spoke to him, saying, "If you will be a servant to these people today, and serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever."
chapters.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വൃദ്ധന്മാർ തന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ ആലോചന അവൻ ത്യജിച്ചു, തന്നോടുകൂടെ വളർന്നവരായി തന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നില്ക്കുന്ന യൌവ്വനക്കാരോടു ആലോചിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.
chapters.nkjv: But he rejected the advice which the elders had given him, and consulted the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
chapters.kjv: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നുകം ഭാരം കുറെച്ചു തരേണം എന്നിങ്ങനെ എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള ഈ ജനത്തോടു നാം ഉത്തരം പറയേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്താലോചന പറയുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?"
chapters.nkjv: And he said to them, "What advice do you give? How should we answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ വളർന്നിരുന്ന യൌവ്വനക്കാർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെച്ചു; നീ അതു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഭാരം കുറെച്ചുതരേണമെന്നു നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ ഈ ജനത്തോടു: എന്റെ ചെറുവിരൽ എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ അരയെക്കാൾ വണ്ണമുള്ളതായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The young men who had grown up with him replied, "These people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
chapters.nkjv: Then the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, "Thus you should speak to this people who have spoken to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you make it lighter on us’—thus you shall say to them: ‘My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s waist!
chapters.kjv: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിങ്ങളുടെമേൽ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം വെച്ചിരിക്കെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ നുകത്തിന്നു ഭാരം കൂട്ടും; എന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിങ്ങളെ ചമ്മട്ടികൊണ്ടു ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചു; ഞാനോ തേളുകളെക്കൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കും എന്നിങ്ങനെ നീ ഉത്തരം പറയേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And now, whereas my father put a heavy yoke on you, I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scourges!’ "
chapters.kjv: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം ദിവസം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വീണ്ടും വരുവിൻ എന്നു രാജാവു പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ യൊരോബെയാമും സകലജനവും മൂന്നാം ദിവസം രെഹബെയാമിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."
chapters.nkjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had directed, saying, "Come back to me the third day."
chapters.kjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാജാവു ജനത്തോടു കഠിനമായി ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു; വൃദ്ധന്മാർ തന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ ആലോചനയെ അവൻ ത്യജിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king answered the people harshly. Rejecting the advice given him by the elders,
chapters.nkjv: Then the king answered the people roughly, and rejected the advice which the elders had given him;
chapters.kjv: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;

chapters.ml: യൌവ്വനക്കാരുടെ ആലോചനപോലെ അവരോടു: എന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം നിങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെച്ചു; ഞാനോ നിങ്ങളുടെ നുകത്തിന്നു ഭാരം കൂട്ടും; എന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിങ്ങളെ ചമ്മട്ടികൊണ്ടു ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചു; ഞാനോ തേളുകളെക്കൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."
chapters.nkjv: and he spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scourges!"
chapters.kjv: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ രാജാവു ജനത്തിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടില്ല; യഹോവ ശിലോന്യനായ അഹിയാവുമുഖാന്തരം നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാകേണ്ടതിന്നു ഈ കാര്യം യഹോവയുടെ ഹിതത്താൽ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from the Lord , to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
chapters.nkjv: So the king did not listen to the people; for the turn ofevents was from the Lord, that He might fulfill His word, which the Lord had spoken by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD , that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു തങ്ങളുടെ അപേക്ഷ കേൾക്കയില്ലെന്നു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ജനം രാജാവിനോടു: ദാവീദിങ്കൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ഓഹരി ഉള്ളു? യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകങ്കൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അവകാശമില്ലല്ലോ; യിസ്രായേലേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിലേക്കു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ; ദാവീദേ, നിന്റെ ഗൃഹം നോക്കിക്കൊൾക എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു, യിസ്രായേൽ തങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!" So the Israelites went home.
chapters.nkjv: Now when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, saying: "What share have we in David? Wehave no inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, O Israel! Now, see to your own house, O David!" So Israel departed to their tents.
chapters.kjv: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാനഗരങ്ങളിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന യിസ്രായേല്യർക്കോ രെഹബെയാം രാജാവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.
chapters.nkjv: But Rehoboam reigned over the children of Israel who dwelt in the cities of Judah.
chapters.kjv: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു ഊഴിയവേലെക്കു മേൽവിചാരകനായ അദോരാമിനെ അയച്ചു; എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും അവനെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു; രെഹബെയാംരാജാവോ വേഗത്തിൽ രഥം കയറി യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was in charge of the revenue; but all Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. Therefore King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste to flee to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽ ഇന്നുവരെ ദാവീദ് ഗൃഹത്തോടു മതസരിച്ചു നില്ക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
chapters.nkjv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
chapters.kjv: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം മടങ്ങിവന്നു എന്നു യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ ആളയച്ചു അവനെ സഭയിലേക്കു വിളിപ്പിച്ചു അവനെ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും രാജാവാക്കി; യെഹൂദാഗോത്രം മാത്രം അല്ലാതെ മറ്റാരും ദാവീദ് ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: When all the Israelites heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the house of David.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had come back, they sent for him and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was none who followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വന്നശേഷം യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു രാജത്വം ശലോമോന്റെ മകനായ രെഹബെയാമിന്നു വീണ്ടുകൊള്ളേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ യെഹൂദാഗൃഹം മുഴുവനിലും ബെന്യാമീന്റെ ഗോത്രത്തിലുംനിന്നു ശ്രേഷ്ഠയോദ്ധാക്കളായ ഒരു ലക്ഷത്തെണ്പതിനായിരംപേരെ ശേഖരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered all Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam son of Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: And when Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah with the tribe of Benjamin, one hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, that he might restore the kingdom to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവപുരുഷനായ ശെമയ്യാവിന്നു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: But this word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:
chapters.nkjv: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
chapters.kjv: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ ശലോമോന്റെ മകനായി യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ രെഹബെയാമിനോടും യെഹൂദയുടെയും ബെന്യാമീന്റെയും സകലഗൃഹത്തോടും ശേഷം ജനത്തോടും പറക; നിങ്ങൾ പുറപ്പെടരുതു;
chapters.niv: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, to all Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്കയുമരുതു; ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവിൻ; ഈ കാര്യം എന്റെ ഹിതത്താൽ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നിപ്രകാരം യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു. അവർ യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു അനുസരിച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ " So they obeyed the word of the Lord and went home again, as the Lord had ordered.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord: "You shall not go up nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel. Let every man return to his house, for this thing is from Me." ’ " Therefore they obeyed the word of the Lord, and turned back, according to the word of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD , and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യൊരോബെയാം എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിൽ ശെഖേം പണിതു അവിടെ പാർത്തു. അവൻ അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പെനൂവേലും പണിതു.
chapters.niv: Then Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and built up Peniel.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the mountains of Ephraim, and dwelt there. Also he went out from there and built Penuel.
chapters.kjv: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യൊരോബെയാം തന്റെ മനസ്സിൽ: രാജത്വം വീണ്ടും ദാവീദ്ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു ആയിപ്പോകും;
chapters.niv: Jeroboam thought to himself, "The kingdom will now likely revert to the house of David.
chapters.nkjv: And Jeroboam said in his heart, "Now the kingdom may return to the house of David:
chapters.kjv: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

chapters.ml: ഈ ജനം യെരൂശലേമിൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ യാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ ചെന്നാൽ ഈ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഹൃദയം യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ രെഹബെയാം എന്ന തങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനങ്കലേക്കു തിരികയും അവർ എന്നെ കൊന്നു യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ രെഹബെയാമിന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേരുകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If these people go up to offer sacrifices at the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem, they will again give their allegiance to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah. They will kill me and return to King Rehoboam."
chapters.nkjv: If these people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn back to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me and go back to Rehoboam king of Judah."
chapters.kjv: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ രാജാവു ആലോചിച്ചു പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു രണ്ടു കാളക്കുട്ടിയെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; നിങ്ങൾ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പോയതു മതി; യിസ്രായേലേ, ഇതാ നിന്നെ മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന നിന്റെ ദൈവം എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves. He said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the king asked advice, made two calves of gold, and said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, O Israel, which brought you up from the land of Egypt!"
chapters.kjv: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒന്നിനെ ബേഥേലിലും മറ്റേതിനെ ദാനിലും പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.
chapters.nkjv: And he set up one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
chapters.kjv: And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.

chapters.ml: ഈ കാര്യം പാപഹേതുവായിത്തീർന്നു; ജനം ഒന്നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നമസ്കരിപ്പാൻ ദാൻവരെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: And this thing became a sin; the people came to worship the one at Bethel and went as far as Dan to worship the other.
chapters.nkjv: Now this thing became a sin, for the people went toworship before the one as far as Dan.
chapters.kjv: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൂജാഗിരിക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി സർവ്വജനത്തിൽനിന്നും ലേവ്യരല്ലാത്തവരെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരായി നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jeroboam built shrines on high places and appointed priests from all sorts of people, even though they were not Levites.
chapters.nkjv: He made shrines on the high places, and made priests from every class of people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
chapters.kjv: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയിൽ ആചരിച്ചുവന്ന ഉത്സവംപോലെ യൊരോബെയാം എട്ടാം മാസം പതിനഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി ഒരു ഉത്സവം നിശ്ചയിച്ചു യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ ചെന്നു; താൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ കാളക്കുട്ടികൾക്കു യാഗം കഴിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ബേഥേലിലും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു; താൻ നിയമിച്ച പൂജാഗിരിപുരോഹിതന്മാരെ അവൻ ബേഥേലിൽ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: He instituted a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the festival held in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. This he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves he had made. And at Bethel he also installed priests at the high places he had made.
chapters.nkjv: Jeroboam ordained a feast on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the feast that was in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. So he did at Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made. And at Bethel he installed the priests of the high places which he had made.
chapters.kjv: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Beth-el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places which he had made.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സ്വമേധയായി നിശ്ചയിച്ച എട്ടാം മാസം പതിനഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി താൻ ബേഥേലിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ ചെന്നു യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു ഒരു ഉത്സവം നിയമിച്ചു, പീഠത്തിന്നരികെ ചെന്നു ധൂപം കാട്ടി.
chapters.niv: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, he offered sacrifices on the altar he had built at Bethel. So he instituted the festival for the Israelites and went up to the altar to make offerings.
chapters.nkjv: So he made offerings on the altar which he had made at Bethel on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, in the month which he had devised in his own heart. And he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and offered sacrifices on the altar and burned incense.
chapters.kjv: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാൻ പീഠത്തിന്നരികെ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ ഒരു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനയാൽ യെഹൂദയിൽ നിന്നു ബേഥേലിലേക്കു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: By the word of the Lord a man of God came from Judah to Bethel, as Jeroboam was standing by the altar to make an offering.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, a man of God went from Judah to Bethel by the word of the Lord, and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനയാൽ യാഗപീഠത്തോടു: യാഗപീഠമേ, യാഗപീഠമേ, യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ദാവീദ്ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു യോശീയാവു എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു മകൻ ജനിക്കും; അവൻ നിന്റെ മേൽ ധൂപം കാട്ടുന്ന പൂജാഗിരിപുരോഹിതന്മാരെ നിന്റെമേൽ വെച്ചു അറുക്കയും മനുഷ്യാസ്ഥികളെ നിന്റെമേൽ ചുട്ടുകളകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: By the word of the Lord he cried out against the altar: "Altar, altar! This is what the Lord says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then he cried out against the altar by the word of the Lord, and said, "O altar, altar! Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, a child, Josiah by name, shall be born to the house of David; and on you he shall sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and men’s bones shall be burned on you.’ "
chapters.kjv: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD , and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD ; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അന്നു ഒരു അടയാളവും കൊടുത്തു; ഇതാ, ഈ യാഗപീഠം പിളർന്നു അതിന്മേലുള്ള ചാരം തൂകിപ്പോകും; ഇതു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ച അടയാളം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: That same day the man of God gave a sign: "This is the sign the Lord has declared: The altar will be split apart and the ashes on it will be poured out."
chapters.nkjv: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, "This is the sign which the Lord has spoken: Surely the altar shall split apart, and the ashes on it shall be poured out."
chapters.kjv: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

chapters.ml: ദൈവപുരുഷൻ ബേഥേലിലെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നു വിരോധമായി വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞ വചനം യൊരോബെയാംരാജാവു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽനിന്നു കൈ നീട്ടി: അവനെ പിടിപ്പിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; എങ്കിലും അവന്റെ നേരെ നിട്ടിയ കൈ വരണ്ടുപോയിട്ടു തിരികെ മടക്കുവാൻ കഴിവില്ലാതെ ആയി.
chapters.niv: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, "Seize him!" But the hand he stretched out toward the man shriveled up, so that he could not pull it back.
chapters.nkjv: So it came to pass when King Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, who cried out against the altar in Bethel, that he stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, "Arrest him!" Then his hand, which he stretched out toward him, withered, so that he could not pull it back to himself.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Beth-el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

chapters.ml: ദൈവപുരുഷൻ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനയാൽ കൊടുത്തിരുന്ന അടയാളപ്രകാരം യാഗപീഠം പിളർന്നു ചാരം യാഗപീഠത്തിൽനിന്നു തൂകിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Also, the altar was split apart and its ashes poured out according to the sign given by the man of God by the word of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: The altar also was split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ദൈവപുരുഷനോടു: നീ നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു കൃപെക്കായി അപേക്ഷിച്ചു എന്റെ കൈമടങ്ങുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ദൈവപുരുഷൻ യഹോവയോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; എന്നാറെ രാജാവിന്റെ കൈ മടങ്ങി മുമ്പിലത്തെപ്പോലെ ആയി.
chapters.niv: Then the king said to the man of God, "Intercede with the Lord your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored." So the man of God interceded with the Lord , and the king’s hand was restored and became as it was before.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king answered and said to the man of God, "Please entreat the favor of the Lord your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me." So the man of God entreated the Lord, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as before.
chapters.kjv: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD , and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before. , and: Heb. the face of the LORD , etc

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ദൈവപുരുഷനോടു: നീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ അരമനയിൽ വന്നു അല്പം ആശ്വസിച്ചുകൊൾക; ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ഒരു സമ്മാനം തരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king said to the man of God, "Come home with me for a meal, and I will give you a gift."
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to the man of God, "Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward."
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

chapters.ml: ദൈവപുരുഷൻ രാജാവിനോടു: നിന്റെ അരമനയിൽ പകുതി തന്നാലും ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ വരികയില്ല; ഈ സ്ഥലത്തു വെച്ചു ഞാൻ അപ്പം തിന്നുകയില്ല, വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: But the man of God answered the king, "Even if you were to give me half your possessions, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water here.
chapters.nkjv: But the man of God said to the king, "If you were to give me half your house, I would not go in with you; nor would I eat bread nor drink water in this place.
chapters.kjv: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

chapters.ml: നീ അപ്പം തിന്നരുതു, വെള്ളം കുടിക്കരുതു; പോയ വഴിയായി മടങ്ങിവരികയും അരുതു എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളപ്പാടായി എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For I was commanded by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’ "
chapters.nkjv: For so it was commanded me by the word of the Lord, saying, ‘You shall not eat bread, nor drink water, nor return by the same way you came.’ "
chapters.kjv: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD , saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ബേഥേലിലേക്കു വന്ന വഴിയായി മടങ്ങാതെ മറ്റൊരുവഴിയായി പോയി.
chapters.niv: So he took another road and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
chapters.nkjv: So he went another way and did not return by the way he came to Bethel.
chapters.kjv: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.

chapters.ml: ബേഥേലിൽ വൃദ്ധനായൊരു പ്രവാചകൻ പാർത്തിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ വന്നു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ ബേഥേലിൽ ചെയ്ത കാര്യമൊക്കെയും അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കുകളും അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പനെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now there was a certain old prophet living in Bethel, whose sons came and told him all that the man of God had done there that day. They also told their father what he had said to the king.
chapters.nkjv: Now an old prophet dwelt in Bethel, and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel; they also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.
chapters.kjv: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അപ്പൻ അവരോടു: അവൻ ഏതു വഴിക്കു പോയി എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു; യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നു വന്നു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ പോയ വഴി അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ കണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their father asked them, "Which way did he go?" And his sons showed him which road the man of God from Judah had taken.
chapters.nkjv: And their father said to them, "Which way did he go?" For his sons had seen which way the man of God went who came from Judah.
chapters.kjv: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടു: കഴുതെക്കു കോപ്പിട്ടുതരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, അവർ കഴുതെക്കു കോപ്പിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു; അവൻ അതിന്റെ പുറത്തു കയറി ദൈവപുരുഷന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു;
chapters.niv: So he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." And when they had saddled the donkey for him, he mounted it
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it,
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു കരുവേലകത്തിൻ കീഴെ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു: നീ യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നു വന്ന ദൈവപുരുഷനോ എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and rode after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" "I am," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: and went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. Then he said to him, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" And he said, "I am."
chapters.kjv: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവനോടു: നീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the prophet said to him, "Come home with me and eat."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to him, "Come home with me and eat bread."
chapters.kjv: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: എനിക്കു നിന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരികയോ നിന്റെ വിട്ടിൽ കയറുകയോ ചെയ്തുകൂടാ; ഞാൻ ഈ സ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു നിന്നോടുകൂടെ അപ്പം തിന്നുകയില്ല വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: The man of God said, "I cannot turn back and go with you, nor can I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "I cannot return with you nor go in with you; neither can I eat bread nor drink water with you in this place.
chapters.kjv: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

chapters.ml: നീ അവിടെവെച്ചു അപ്പം തിന്നരുതു, വെള്ളം കുടിക്കരുതു, പോയ വഴിയായി മടങ്ങിവരികയും അരുതു എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളപ്പാടായി എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I have been told by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’ "
chapters.nkjv: For I have been told by the word of the Lord, ‘You shall not eat bread nor drink water there, nor return by going the way you came.’ "
chapters.kjv: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞാനും നിന്നെപ്പോലെ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ ആകുന്നു; അപ്പം തിന്നുകയും വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ അവനെ നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വരിക എന്നു ഒരു ദൂതൻ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനയാൽ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതോ ഭോഷ്കായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The old prophet answered, "I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the Lord : ‘Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.’ " (But he was lying to him.)
chapters.nkjv: He said to him, "I too am a prophet as you are, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the Lord, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’ " (He was lying to him.)
chapters.kjv: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD , saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അവനോടുകൂടെ ചെന്നു, അവന്റെ വീട്ടിൽവെച്ചു അപ്പം തിന്നുകയും വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the man of God returned with him and ate and drank in his house.
chapters.nkjv: So he went back with him, and ate bread in his house, and drank water.
chapters.kjv: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവനെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്ന പ്രവാചകന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the Lord came to the old prophet who had brought him back.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as they sat at the table, that the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had brought him back;
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:

chapters.ml: അവർ യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നു വന്ന ദൈവപുരുഷനോടു: നീ യഹോവയുടെ വചനം മറുത്തു നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചിരുന്ന
chapters.niv: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, "This is what the Lord says: ‘You have defied the word of the Lord and have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you.
chapters.nkjv: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Because you have disobeyed the word of the Lord, and have not kept the commandment which the Lord your God commanded you,
chapters.kjv: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD , Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD , and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,

chapters.ml: കല്പന പ്രമാണിക്കാതെ അപ്പം തിന്നുകയും വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്യരുതെന്നു അവൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ച സ്ഥലത്തു നീ മടങ്ങിവന്നു അപ്പം തിന്നുകയും വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ ശവം നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ കല്ലറയിൽ വരികയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You came back and ate bread and drank water in the place where he told you not to eat or drink. Therefore your body will not be buried in the tomb of your ancestors.’ "
chapters.nkjv: but you came back, ate bread, and drank water in the place of which theLord said to you, "Eat no bread and drink no water," your corpse shall not come to the tomb of your fathers.’ "
chapters.kjv: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

chapters.ml: അപ്പം തിന്നുകയും വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തശേഷം അവൻ താൻ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്ന പ്രവാചകന്നുവേണ്ടി കഴുതെക്കു കോപ്പിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു;
chapters.niv: When the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, after he had eaten bread and after he had drunk, that he saddled the donkey for him, the prophet whom he had brought back.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit , for the prophet whom he had brought back.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോകുമ്പോൾ വഴിയിൽ ഒരു സിംഹം അവനെ കണ്ടു അവനെ കൊന്നു; അവന്റെ ശവം വഴിയിൽ കിടന്നു, കഴുത അതിന്റെ അരികെ നിന്നു; സിംഹവും ശവത്തിന്റെ അരികെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was left lying on the road, with both the donkey and the lion standing beside it.
chapters.nkjv: When he was gone, a lion met him on the road and killed him. And his corpse was thrown on the road, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the corpse.
chapters.kjv: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

chapters.ml: വഴിപോകുന്ന ആളുകൾ ശവം വഴിയിൽ കിടക്കുന്നതും ശവത്തിന്റെ അരികെ സിംഹം നില്ക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു; വൃദ്ധനായ പ്രവാചകൻ പാർക്കുന്ന പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെന്നു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some people who passed by saw the body lying there, with the lion standing beside the body, and they went and reported it in the city where the old prophet lived.
chapters.nkjv: And there, men passed by and saw the corpse thrown on the road, and the lion standing by the corpse. Then they went and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

chapters.ml: അവനെ വഴിയിൽ നിന്നു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വന്ന പ്രവാചകൻ അതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ വചനം മറുത്ത ദൈവപുരുഷൻ തന്നേ; യഹോവ അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനപ്രകാരം യഹോവ അവനെ സിംഹത്തിന്നു ഏല്പിച്ചു; അതു അവനെ കീറി കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard of it, he said, "It is the man of God who defied the word of the Lord . The Lord has given him over to the lion, which has mauled him and killed him, as the word of the Lord had warned him."
chapters.nkjv: Now when the prophet who had brought him back from the way heard it, he said, "It is the man of God who was disobedient to the word of the Lord. Therefore the Lord has delivered him to the lion, which has torn him and killed him, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke to him."
chapters.kjv: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD : therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake unto him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടു: കഴുതെക്കു കോപ്പിട്ടുതരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The prophet said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me," and they did so.
chapters.nkjv: And he spoke to his sons, saying, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled it.
chapters.kjv: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him .

chapters.ml: അവർ കോപ്പിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു. അവൻ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ ശവം വഴിയിൽ കിടക്കുന്നതും ശവത്തിന്റെ അരികെ കഴുതയും സിംഹവും നില്ക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു; സിംഹം ശവത്തെ തിന്നുകയോ കഴുതയെ കീറിക്കളകയോ ചെയ്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then he went out and found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had neither eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.
chapters.nkjv: Then he went and found his corpse thrown on the road, and the donkey and the lion standing by the corpse. The lion had not eaten the corpse nor torn the donkey.
chapters.kjv: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

chapters.ml: പ്രവാചകൻ ദൈവപുരുഷന്റെ ശവം എടുത്തു കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു വെച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; വൃദ്ധനായ പ്രവാചകൻ തന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിൽ എത്തി അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലപിച്ചു അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
chapters.nkjv: And the prophet took up the corpse of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. So the old prophet came to the city to mourn, and to bury him.
chapters.kjv: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശവം അവൻ തന്റെ സ്വന്ത കല്ലറയിൽ വെച്ചിട്ടു അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു: അയ്യോ എന്റെ സഹോദരാ, എന്നിങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞു അവർ വിലാപം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they mourned over him and said, "Alas, my brother!"
chapters.nkjv: Then he laid the corpse in his own tomb; and they mourned over him, saying, "Alas, my brother!"
chapters.kjv: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying , Alas, my brother!

chapters.ml: അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തശേഷം അവൻ തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോടു: ഞാൻ മരിച്ചശേഷം നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ദൈവപുരുഷനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന കല്ലറയിൽ തന്നേ അടക്കം ചെയ്യേണം; അവന്റെ അസ്ഥികളുടെ അരികെ എന്റെ അസ്ഥികളും ഇടേണം.
chapters.niv: After burying him, he said to his sons, "When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, after he had buried him, that he spoke to his sons, saying, "When I am dead, then bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബേഥേലിലെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും ശമര്യപട്ടണങ്ങളിലെ സകലപൂജാഗിരിക്ഷേത്രങ്ങൾക്കും വിരോധമായി യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞ വചനം നിശ്ചയമായി സംഭവിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true."
chapters.nkjv: For the saying which he cried out by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel, and against all the shrines on the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely come to pass."
chapters.kjv: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

chapters.ml: ഈ കാര്യം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടും യൊരോബെയാം തന്റെ ദുർമ്മാർഗ്ഗം വിട്ടുതിരിയാതെ പിന്നെയും സർവ്വജനത്തിൽനിന്നും പൂജാഗിരിപുരോഹിതന്മാരെ നിയമിച്ചു; തനിക്കു ബോധിച്ചവരെ കരപൂരണം കഴിപ്പിച്ചു; അവർ പൂജാഗിരിപുരോഹിതന്മാരായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.
chapters.nkjv: After this event Jeroboam did not turn from his evil way, but again he made priests from every class of people for the high places; whoever wished, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
chapters.kjv: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാംഗൃഹത്തെ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചു മുടിച്ചുകളയത്തക്കവണ്ണം ഈ കാര്യം അവർക്കു പാപമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its downfall and to its destruction from the face of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: And this thing was the sin of the house of Jeroboam, so as to exterminate and destroy it from the face of the earth.
chapters.kjv: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ മകനായ അബീയാവു ദീനം പിടിച്ചു കിടപ്പിലായി.
chapters.niv: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill,
chapters.nkjv: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.
chapters.kjv: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം തന്റെ ഭാര്യയോടു: നീ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യ എന്നു ആരും അറിയാതവണ്ണം വേഷംമാറി ശീലോവിലേക്കു, പോകേണം; ഈ ജനത്തിന്നു ഞാൻ രാജാവാകും എന്നു എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ അഹീയാപ്രവാചകൻ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: and Jeroboam said to his wife, "Go, disguise yourself, so you won’t be recognized as the wife of Jeroboam. Then go to Shiloh. Ahijah the prophet is there—the one who told me I would be king over this people.
chapters.nkjv: And Jeroboam said to his wife, "Please arise, and disguise yourself, that they may not recognize you as the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh. Indeed, Ahijah the prophet is there, who told me that Iwouldbe king over this people.
chapters.kjv: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ പത്തു അപ്പവും കുറെ അടകളും ഒരു തുരുത്തി തേനും എടുത്തു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുക. കുട്ടിയുടെ കാര്യം എന്താകും എന്നു അവൻ നിന്നെ അറിയിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Take ten loaves of bread with you, some cakes and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy."
chapters.nkjv: Also take with you ten loaves, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him; he will tell you what will become of the child."
chapters.kjv: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യ അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു; അവൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശീലോവിൽ അഹീയാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു; എന്നാൽ അഹീയാവിന്നു വാർദ്ധക്യം നിമിത്തം കണ്ണു മങ്ങിയിരിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു കാണ്മാൻ വഹിയാതെയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Jeroboam’s wife did what he said and went to Ahijah’s house in Shiloh. Now Ahijah could not see; his sight was gone because of his age.
chapters.nkjv: And Jeroboam’s wife did so; she arose and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were glazed by reason of his age.
chapters.kjv: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ അഹീയാവോടു: യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യ തന്റെ മകനെക്കുറിച്ചു നിന്നോടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ വരുന്നു; അവൻ ദീനമായി കിടക്കുന്നു; നീ അവളോടു ഇന്നിന്നപ്രകാരം സംസാരിക്കേണം; അവൾ അകത്തു വരുമ്പോൾ അന്യസ്ത്രീയുടെ ഭാവം നടിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord had told Ahijah, "Jeroboam’s wife is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill, and you are to give her such and such an answer. When she arrives, she will pretend to be someone else."
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord had said to Ahijah, "Here is the wife of Jeroboam, coming to ask you something about her son, for he is sick. Thus and thus you shall say to her; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend tobe another woman."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman .

chapters.ml: അവൾ വാതിൽ കടക്കുമ്പോൾ അവളുടെ കാലൊച്ച അഹിയാവു കേട്ടിട്ടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നൽ: യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യയേ, അകത്തു വരിക; നീ ഒരു അന്യസ്ത്രീ എന്നു നടിക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? കഠിനവർത്തമാനം നിന്നെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു നിയോഗം ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps at the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why this pretense? I have been sent to you with bad news.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps as she came through the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why do you pretend tobe another person? For I havebeen sent to you with bad news.
chapters.kjv: And it was so , when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings .

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു യൊരോബെയാമിനോടു പറയേണ്ടുന്നതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഞാൻ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു നിന്നെ ഉയർത്തി, എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു പ്രഭുവാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you ruler over My people Israel,
chapters.kjv: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

chapters.ml: രാജത്വം ദാവീദ് ഗൃഹത്തിൽനിന്നു കീറിയെടുത്തു നിനക്കുതന്നു; എങ്കിലും എന്റെ കല്പനകളെ പ്രമാണിക്കയും എനിക്കു പ്രസാദമുള്ളതു മാത്രം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടുകൂടെ എന്നെ അനുസരിക്കയും ചെയ്ത എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിനെപ്പോലെ നീ ഇരിക്കാതെ
chapters.niv: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, but you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.
chapters.nkjv: and tore the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as My servant David, who kept My commandments and who followed Me with all his heart, to do only whatwas right in My eyes;
chapters.kjv: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു മുമ്പുണ്ടായിരുന്ന എല്ലാവരെക്കാളും അധികം ദോഷം ചെയ്തു; എന്നെ കോപിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ചെന്നു നിനക്കു അന്യദേവന്മാരെയും വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി എന്നെ നിന്റെ പുറകിൽ എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You have done more evil than all who lived before you. You have made for yourself other gods, idols made of metal; you have aroused my anger and turned your back on me.
chapters.nkjv: but you have done more evil than all who were before you, for you have gone and made for yourself other gods and molded images to provoke Me to anger, and have cast Me behind your back—
chapters.kjv: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

chapters.ml: അതു കൊണ്ടു ഇതാ, ഞാൻ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു അനർത്ഥം വരുത്തി, യൊരോബെയാമിന്നുള്ള സ്വതന്ത്രനും അസ്വതന്ത്രനും ആയ പുരുഷപ്രജയെ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിക്കയും കാഷ്ഠം കോരിക്കളയുന്നതു പോലെ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഗൃഹം തീരെ മുടിഞ്ഞുപോകുംവരെ അതിനെ കോരിക്കളകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: " ‘Because of this, I am going to bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every last male in Israel—slave or free. I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns dung, until it is all gone.
chapters.nkjv: therefore behold! I will bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam every male in Israel, bond and free; I will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as one takes away refuse until it is all gone.
chapters.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ സന്തതിയിൽ പട്ടണത്തിൽവെച്ചു മരിക്കുന്നവനെ നായ്ക്കൾ തിന്നും; വയലിൽ വെച്ചു മരിക്കുന്നവനെ ആകാശത്തിലെ പക്ഷികൾ തിന്നും; യഹോവ അതു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Dogs will eat those belonging to Jeroboam who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country. The Lord has spoken!’
chapters.nkjv: The dogs shall eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam and dies in the city, and the birds of the air shall eat whoever dies in the field; for the Lord has spoken!" ’
chapters.kjv: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it .

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോക; നിന്റെ കാൽ പട്ടണത്തിന്നകത്തു ചവിട്ടുമ്പോൾ കുട്ടി മരിച്ചു പോകും.
chapters.niv: "As for you, go back home. When you set foot in your city, the boy will die.
chapters.nkjv: Arise therefore, go to your own house. When your feet enter the city, the child shall die.
chapters.kjv: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലപിച്ചു അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്യും; യെരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽവെച്ചു അവനിൽമാത്രം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമുള്ള കാര്യം അല്പം കാണുകയാൽ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ സന്തതിയിൽ അവനെ മാത്രം കല്ലറയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be buried, because he is the only one in the house of Jeroboam in whom the Lord , the God of Israel, has found anything good.
chapters.nkjv: And all Israel shall mourn for him and bury him, for he is the only one of Jeroboam who shall come to the grave, because in him there is found something good toward the Lord God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
chapters.kjv: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തനിക്കു യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഒരു രാജാവിനെ എഴുന്നേല്പിക്കും; അവൻ അന്നു യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെ ഛേദിച്ചുകളയും; എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നേ എന്തു?
chapters.niv: "The Lord will raise up for himself a king over Israel who will cut off the family of Jeroboam. Even now this is beginning to happen.
chapters.nkjv: "Moreover the Lord will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam; this is the day. What? Even now!
chapters.kjv: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠകളെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി യഹോയെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ഓട വെള്ളത്തിൽ ആടുന്നതുപോലെ അവർ ആടത്തക്കവണ്ണം യഹോവ അവരെ ആടിച്ചു അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കു താൻ കൊടുത്ത ഈ നല്ല ദേശത്തുനിന്നു യിസ്രായേലിനെ പറിച്ചെടുത്തു നദിക്കക്കരെ ചിതറിച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: And the Lord will strike Israel, so that it will be like a reed swaying in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that he gave to their ancestors and scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they aroused the Lord ’s anger by making Asherah poles.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land which He gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their wooden images, provoking the Lord to anger.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.

chapters.ml: പാപം ചെയ്കയും യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിക്കയും ചെയ്ത യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപംനിമിത്തം അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: And he will give Israel up because of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit."
chapters.nkjv: And He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who sinned and who made Israel sin."
chapters.kjv: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഭാര്യ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പുറപ്പെട്ടു തിർസ്സയിൽവന്നു; അവൾ അരമനയുടെ ഉമ്മരപ്പടി കടക്കുമ്പോൾ കുട്ടി മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and left and went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. When she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
chapters.kjv: And Jeroboam’s wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ ദാസനായ അഹീയാപ്രവാചകൻ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനപ്രകാരം അവർ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിലാപം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, as the Lord had said through his servant the prophet Ahijah.
chapters.nkjv: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke through His servant Ahijah the prophet.
chapters.kjv: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തതും രാജ്യം വാണതുമായ അവന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, his wars and how he ruled, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he made war and how he reigned, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം വാണകാലം ഇരുപത്തുരണ്ടു സംവത്സരം ആയിരുന്നു; അവൻ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകനായ നാദാബ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: He reigned for twenty-two years and then rested with his ancestors. And Nadab his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: The period that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years. So he rested with his fathers. Then Nadab his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ മകനായ രെഹബെയാം യെഹൂദയിൽ വാണു. രെഹബെയാം വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു നാല്പത്തൊന്നു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; യഹോവ തന്റെ നാമം സ്ഥാപിപ്പാൻ എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളിലും നിന്നു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത നഗരമായ യെരൂശലേമിൽ അവൻ പതിനേഴു സംവത്സരം വാണു. അമ്മോന്യസ്ത്രീയായ അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു നയമാ എന്നുപേർ.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam son of Solomon was king in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.
chapters.nkjv: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king. He reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there. His mother’s name was Naamah, an Ammonitess.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; അവർ ചെയ്ത പാപങ്ങൾകൊണ്ടു അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ചെയ്തതിനെക്കാൾ അധികം അവനെ ക്രുദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Judah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . By the sins they committed they stirred up his jealous anger more than those who were before them had done.
chapters.nkjv: Now Judah did evil in the sight of the Lord, and they provoked Him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, more than all that their fathers had done.
chapters.kjv: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

chapters.ml: എങ്ങനെയെന്നാൽ അവർ ഉയർന്ന കുന്നിന്മേലൊക്കെയും പച്ചമരത്തിൻ കീഴിലൊക്കെയും പൂജാഗിരികളും സ്തംഭവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളും അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They also set up for themselves high places, sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.
chapters.nkjv: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and wooden images on every high hill and under every green tree.
chapters.kjv: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷമൈഥുനക്കാരും ദേശത്തു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞ ജാതികളുടെ സകലമ്ളേച്ഛതളും അവർ അനുകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land; the people engaged in all the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: And there were also perverted persons in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രെഹബെയാംരാജാവിന്റെ അഞ്ചാം ആണ്ടിൽ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ശീശക്ക് യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു,
chapters.niv: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: It happened in the fifth year of King Rehoboam that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരവും രാജധാനയിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരവും എല്ലാം കവർന്നു; അവൻ ആസകലം കവർന്നു; ശലോമോൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ പൊൻ പരിചകളും എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: He carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.
chapters.nkjv: And he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house; he took away everything. He also took away all the gold shields which Solomon had made.
chapters.kjv: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

chapters.ml: ഇവെക്കു പകരം രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു താമ്രം കൊണ്ടു പരിചകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി രാജധാനിയുടെ വാതിൽ കാക്കുന്ന അകമ്പടിനായകന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the doorway of the king’s house.
chapters.kjv: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ അകമ്പടികൾ അവയെ ധരിക്കയും പിന്നെ അകമ്പടികളുടെ അറയിൽ തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു വെക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards bore the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.
chapters.nkjv: And whenever the king entered the house of the Lord, the guards carried them, then brought them back into the guardroom.
chapters.kjv: And it was so , when the king went into the house of the LORD , that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ?
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Rehoboam’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാമിന്നും യൊരോബെയാമിന്നും തമ്മിൽ ജീവപര്യന്തം യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
chapters.nkjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
chapters.kjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

chapters.ml: രെഹെബെയാം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. അമ്മോന്യസ്ത്രീയായ അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു നയമാ എന്നു പേർ. അവന്റെ മകനായ അബീയാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: And Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Rehoboam rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David. His mother’s name was Naamah, an Ammonitess. Then Abijam his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാം രാജാവിന്റെ പതിനെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ അബിയാം യെഹൂദയിൽ വാണുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijah became king of Judah,
chapters.nkjv: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.
chapters.kjv: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു മയഖാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ അബീശാലോമിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.
chapters.nkjv: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maachah the granddaughter of Abishalom.
chapters.kjv: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അപ്പൻ മുമ്പെ ചെയ്തിരുന്ന സകലപാപങ്ങളിലും അവൻ നടന്നു; അവന്റെ ഹൃദയം അവന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഹൃദയംപോലെ അവന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിങ്കൽ ഏകാഗ്രമായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: He committed all the sins his father had done before him; his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his forefather had been.
chapters.nkjv: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; his heart was not loyal to the Lord his God, as was the heart of his father David.
chapters.kjv: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ദാവീദിൻ നിമിത്തം അവന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അവന്റെ മകനെ അവന്റെ അനന്തരവനായി ഉയർത്തിയും യെരൂശലേമിനെ നിലനിർത്തിയുംകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഒരു ദീപം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and by making Jerusalem strong.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, by setting up his son after him and by establishing Jerusalem;
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless for David’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; ഹിത്യനായ ഊരീയാവിന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ മാത്രമല്ലാതെ അവൻ തന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതിൽ ഒന്നും തന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലത്തൊരിക്കലും വിട്ടുമാറീട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the Lord and had not failed to keep any of the Lord ’s commands all the days of his life—except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.
chapters.nkjv: because David did whatwas right in the eyes of the Lord, and had not turned aside from anything that He commanded him all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
chapters.kjv: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD , and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാമും യൊരോബെയാമും തമ്മിൽ ജീവപര്യന്തം യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam throughout Abijah’s lifetime.
chapters.nkjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
chapters.kjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

chapters.ml: അബീയാമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ. അബീയാമും യൊരോബെയാമും തമ്മിലും യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Abijah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

chapters.ml: അബിയാം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവർ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ ആസാ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Asa his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Abijam rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David. Then Asa his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഇരുപതാം ആണ്ടിൽ ആസാ യെഹൂദയിൽ രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king of Judah,
chapters.nkjv: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king over Judah.
chapters.kjv: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നാല്പത്തൊന്നു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു മയഖാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ അബിശാലോമിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.
chapters.nkjv: And he reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His grandmother’s name was Maachah the granddaughter of Abishalom.
chapters.kjv: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

chapters.ml: ആസാ തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിനെപ്പോലെ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , as his father David had done.
chapters.nkjv: Asa did whatwas right in the eyes of the Lord, as did his father David.
chapters.kjv: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD , as did David his father.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുരുഷമൈഥുനക്കാരെ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി, തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന സകലവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He expelled the male shrine prostitutes from the land and got rid of all the idols his ancestors had made.
chapters.nkjv: And he banished the perverted persons from the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
chapters.kjv: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അമ്മയായ മയഖ അശേരെക്കു ഒരു മ്ളേച്ഛവിഗ്രഹം ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്നതു കൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവളെ രാജ്ഞിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; ആസാ അവളുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛവിഗ്രഹം വെട്ടിമുറിച്ചു കിദ്രോൻ തോട്ടിന്നരികെവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He even deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
chapters.nkjv: Also he removed Maachah his grandmother from being queen mother, because she had made an obscene image of Asherah. And Asa cut down her obscene image and burned it by the Brook Kidron.
chapters.kjv: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പൂജാഗിരികൾക്കു നീക്കംവന്നില്ല. എങ്കിലും ആസയുടെ ഹൃദയം അവന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തൊക്കെയും യഹോവയിങ്കൽ ഏകാഗ്രമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Although he did not remove the high places, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.
chapters.nkjv: But the high places were not removed. Nevertheless Asa’s heart was loyal to the Lord all his days.
chapters.kjv: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളി, പൊന്നു, ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ എന്നിങ്ങനെ തന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിവേദിച്ചതും താൻ തന്നേ നിവേദിച്ചതുമായ വസ്തുക്കളെ അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: He brought into the temple of the Lord the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
chapters.nkjv: He also brought into the house of the Lord the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which he himself had dedicated: silver and gold and utensils.
chapters.kjv: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD , silver, and gold, and vessels.

chapters.ml: ആസയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ബയെശയും തമ്മിൽ ജീവപര്യന്തം യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
chapters.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ബയെശാ യെഹൂദയുടെ നേരെ വന്നു, യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ അടുക്കൽ പോക്കുവരുത്തിന്നു ആരെയും സമ്മതിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു രാമയെ പണിതു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: And Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആസാ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്ന എല്ലാ വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും രാജധാനിയിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരവും എടുത്തു തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; ആസാരാജാവു ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽ പാർത്ത ഹെസ്യോന്റെ മകനായ തബ്രിമ്മോന്റെ മകൻ ബെൻ-ഹദദ് എന്ന അരാംരാജാവിന്നു അവയെ കൊടുത്തയച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Asa then took all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple and of his own palace. He entrusted it to his officials and sent them to Ben-Hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.
chapters.nkjv: Then Asa took all the silver and gold thatwas left in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and the treasuries of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants. And King Asa sent them to Ben-Hadad the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who dwelt in Damascus, saying,
chapters.kjv: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

chapters.ml: എനിക്കും നിനക്കും, എന്റെ അപ്പന്നും നിന്റെ അപ്പന്നും തമ്മിൽ സഖ്യത ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; ഇതാ, ഞാൻ നിനക്കു സമ്മാനമായി വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും കൊടുത്തയക്കുന്നു; യിസ്രയേൽരാജാവായ ബയെശാ എന്നെ വിട്ടുപോകേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ ചെന്നു അവനോടുള്ള നിന്റെ സഖ്യത ത്യജിക്കേണം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you a gift of silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."
