chapters.nkjv: "Lettherebe a treaty between you and me, as there was between my father and your father. See, I have sent you a present of silver and gold. Come and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me."
chapters.kjv: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

chapters.ml: ബെൻ-ഹദദ് ആസാരാജാവിന്റെ അപേക്ഷകേട്ടു, തന്റെ സേനാപതികളെ യിസ്രായേൽപട്ടണങ്ങൾക്കു നേരെ അയച്ചു ഈയോനും ദാനും ആബേൽ-ബേത്ത്-മയഖയും കിന്നെരോത്ത് മുഴുവനും നഫ്താലിദേശമൊക്കെയും പിടിച്ചടക്കി.
chapters.niv: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. He conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maakah and all Kinnereth in addition to Naphtali.
chapters.nkjv: So Ben-Hadad heeded King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel. He attacked Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maachah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
chapters.kjv: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

chapters.ml: ബയെശാ അതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ രാമാ പണിയുന്നതു നിർത്തി തിർസ്സയിൽ തന്നേ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when Baasha heard it, that he stopped building Ramah, and remained in Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

chapters.ml: ആസാരാജാവു ഒരു വിളംബരം പ്രസിദ്ധമാക്കി ഒട്ടൊഴിയാതെ യെഹൂദയെ മുഴുവനും വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി; അവർ ചെന്നു ബയെശാ പണിതു ഉറപ്പിച്ച രാമയുടെ കല്ലും മരവും എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ആസാരാജാവു അവകൊണ്ടു ബെന്യാമീനിലെ ഗേബയും മിസ്പയും പണിതു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then King Asa issued an order to all Judah—no one was exempt—and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using there. With them King Asa built up Geba in Benjamin, and also Mizpah.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted. And they took away the stones and timber of Ramah, which Baasha had used for building; and with them King Asa built Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
chapters.kjv: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

chapters.ml: ആസയുടെ മറ്റുള്ള സകല വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവന്റെ സകലപരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തികളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവൻ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ പണിതതും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ. എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ വാർദ്ധക്യകാലത്തു അവന്റെ കാലുകൾക്കു ദീനംപിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As for all the other events of Asa’s reign, all his achievements, all he did and the cities he built, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? In his old age, however, his feet became diseased.
chapters.nkjv: The rest of all the acts of Asa, all his might, all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
chapters.kjv: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

chapters.ml: ആസാ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Then Asa rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of his father David. And Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Asa rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father. Then Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ മകനായ നാദാബ് യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവായി; അവൻ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം യിസ്രായേലിൽ വാണു.
chapters.niv: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
chapters.nkjv: Now Nadab the son of Jeroboam became king over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
chapters.kjv: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വഴിയിലും അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ച പാപത്തിലും നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of his father and committing the same sin his father had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin by which he had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്സാഖാർഗോത്രക്കാരനായ അഹിയാവിന്റെ മകനായ ബയെശാ അവന്നു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി; ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കുള്ള ഗിബ്ബെഥോനിൽവെച്ചു അവനെ കൊന്നു; നാദാബും എല്ലാ യിസ്രായേലും ഗിബ്ബെഥോനെ വളഞ്ഞിരിക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Baasha son of Ahijah from the tribe of Issachar plotted against him, and he struck him down at Gibbethon, a Philistine town, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging it.
chapters.nkjv: Then Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him. And Baasha killed him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
chapters.kjv: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

chapters.ml: ബയെശാ അവനെ യെഹൂദാ രാജാവായ ആസയുടെ മൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ കൊന്നു; അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of Asa king of Judah and succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: Baasha killed him in the third year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാജാവായ ഉടനെ യൊരോബെയാം ഗൃഹത്തെ മുഴുവനും നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; യഹോവ ശിലോന്യനായ അഹിയാവു എന്ന തന്റെ ദാസൻ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനപ്രകാരം അവൻ യൊരോബെയാമിന്നു ശ്വാസമുള്ള ഒന്നിനെയും ശേഷിപ്പിക്കാതെ അശേഷം മുടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As soon as he began to reign, he killed Jeroboam’s whole family. He did not leave Jeroboam anyone that breathed, but destroyed them all, according to the word of the Lord given through his servant Ahijah the Shilonite.
chapters.nkjv: And it was so, when he became king, that he killed all the house of Jeroboam. He did not leave to Jeroboam anyone that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the word of the Lord which He had spoken by His servant Ahijah the Shilonite,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD , which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം ചെയ്തതും യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ചതുമായ പാപങ്ങൾ നിമിത്തവും അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചതുനിമിത്തവും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: This happened because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he had sinned and by which he had made Israel sin, because of his provocation with which he had provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.
chapters.kjv: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

chapters.ml: നാദാബിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Nadab’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: ആസയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ബയെശയും തമ്മിൽ ജീവപര്യന്തം യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.
chapters.nkjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
chapters.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ മൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ അഹീയാവിന്റെ മകനായ ബയെശാ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും രാജാവായി തിർസ്സയിൽ ഇരുപത്തുനാലു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.
chapters.nkjv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah became king over all Israel in Tirzah, and reigned twenty-four years.
chapters.kjv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു. യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ വഴിയിലും അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ച പാപത്തിലും നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin by which he had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: ബയെശകൂ വിരോധമായി ഹനാനിയുടെ മകൻ യേഹൂവിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu son of Hanani concerning Baasha:
chapters.nkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani, against Baasha, saying:
chapters.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ പൊടിയിൽനിന്നു ഉയർത്തി എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു പ്രഭുവാക്കിവെച്ചു; നീയോ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ വഴിയിൽ നടക്കയും തങ്ങളുടെ പാപങ്ങളാൽ എന്നെ കോപിപ്പിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിക്കയും ചെയ്കയാൽ
chapters.niv: "I lifted you up from the dust and appointed you ruler over my people Israel, but you followed the ways of Jeroboam and caused my people Israel to sin and to arouse my anger by their sins.
chapters.nkjv: "Inasmuch as I lifted you out of the dust and made you ruler over My people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have made My people Israel sin, to provoke Me to anger with their sins,
chapters.kjv: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

chapters.ml: ഇതാ ഞാൻ ബയെശയെയും അവന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെയും അശേഷം അടിച്ചുവാരിക്കളയും; നിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെ നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെപ്പോലെ ആക്കും.
chapters.niv: So I am about to wipe out Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
chapters.nkjv: surely I will take away the posterity of Baasha and the posterity of his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

chapters.ml: ബയെശയുടെ സന്തതിയിൽ പട്ടണത്തിൽവെച്ചു മരിക്കുന്നവനെ നായ്ക്കൾ തിന്നും; വയലിൽവെച്ചു മരിക്കുന്നവനെ ആകാശത്തിലെ പക്ഷികൾ തിന്നും.
chapters.niv: Dogs will eat those belonging to Baasha who die in the city, and birds will feed on those who die in the country."
chapters.nkjv: The dogs shall eat whoever belongs to Baasha and dies in the city, and the birds of the air shall eat whoever dies in the fields."
chapters.kjv: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

chapters.ml: ബയെശയുടെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതും അവന്റെ പരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തികളും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Baasha’s reign, what he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: ബയെശാ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവനെ തിർസ്സയിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഏലാ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Baasha rested with his ancestors and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. Then Elah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ബയെശാ യൊരോബെയാംഗൃഹത്തെപ്പോലെ ഇരുന്നു തന്റെ കൈകളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിയാൽ യഹോവയെ ക്രുദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ചെയ്കയും അവരെ കൊന്നുകളകയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്നും അവന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നും വിരോധമായി ഹനാനിയുടെ മകനായ യേഹൂപ്രവാചകൻ മുഖാന്തരം യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani to Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger by the things he did, becoming like the house of Jeroboam—and also because he destroyed it.
chapters.nkjv: And also the word of the Lord came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and his house, because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord in provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he killed them.
chapters.kjv: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ ഇരുപത്താറാം ആണ്ടിൽ ബയെശയുടെ മകൻ ഏലാ യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവായി തിർസ്സയിൽ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.
chapters.nkjv: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha became king over Israel, andreigned two years in Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രഥങ്ങളിൽ പകുതിക്കു അധിപതിയായ സിമ്രി എന്ന അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യൻ അവന്നു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി, അവൻ തിർസ്സയിൽ തിർസ്സാരാജധാനിവിചാരകനായ അർസ്സയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ കുടിച്ചു ലഹരിപിടിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: Zimri, one of his officials, who had command of half his chariots, plotted against him. Elah was in Tirzah at the time, getting drunk in the home of Arza, the palace administrator at Tirzah.
chapters.nkjv: Now his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him as he was in Tirzah drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, steward of his house in Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

chapters.ml: സിമ്രി അകത്തു കടന്നു യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ ഇരുപത്തേഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Zimri came in, struck him down and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah. Then he succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: And Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാജാവായി സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്ന ഉടനെ ബയെശയുടെ ഗൃഹത്തെ മുഴുവനും നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവന്നാകട്ടെ അവന്റെ ചാർച്ചക്കാർക്കാകട്ടെ പുരുഷപ്രജയായ ഒന്നിനെയും അവൻ ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: As soon as he began to reign and was seated on the throne, he killed off Baasha’s whole family. He did not spare a single male, whether relative or friend.
chapters.nkjv: Then it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he was seated on his throne, that he killed all the household of Baasha; he did not leave him one male, neither of his relatives nor of his friends.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ബയെശയും അവന്റെ മകൻ ഏലയും തങ്ങളുടെ മിത്ഥ്യാമൂർത്തികളാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചു, തങ്ങൾ ചെയ്തതും യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ചതുമായ സകല പാപങ്ങളും നിമിത്തം
chapters.niv: So Zimri destroyed the whole family of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken against Baasha through the prophet Jehu—
chapters.nkjv: Thus Zimri destroyed all the household of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord, which He spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
chapters.kjv: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യേഹൂപ്രവാചകൻ മുഖാന്തരം ബയെശകൂ വിരോധമായി അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനപ്രകാരം സിമ്രി ബയെശയുടെ ഭവനത്തെ മുഴുവനും നിഗ്രഹിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.
chapters.nkjv: for all the sins of Baasha and the sins of Elah his son, by which they had sinned and by which they had made Israel sin, in provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
chapters.kjv: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

chapters.ml: ഏലയുടെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Elah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ ഇരുപത്തേഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ സിമ്രി തിർസ്സയിൽ ഏഴു ദിവസം രാജാവായിരുന്നു; അന്നു പടജ്ജനം ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കുള്ള ഗിബ്ബെഥോൻ നിരോധിച്ചിരിക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned in Tirzah seven days. The army was encamped near Gibbethon, a Philistine town.
chapters.nkjv: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri had reigned in Tirzah seven days. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

chapters.ml: സിമ്രി കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി രാജാവിനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു പാളയം ഇറങ്ങിയിരുന്ന പടജ്ജനം കേട്ടപ്പോൾ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും അന്നു തന്നേ പാളയത്തിൽവെച്ചു സേനാധിപതിയായ ഒമ്രിയെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവാക്കി വാഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the Israelites in the camp heard that Zimri had plotted against the king and murdered him, they proclaimed Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that very day there in the camp.
chapters.nkjv: Now the people whowere encamped heard it said, "Zimri has conspired and also has killed the king." So all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
chapters.kjv: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ഒമ്രി എല്ലായിസ്രായേലുമായി ഗിബ്ബെഥോൻ വിട്ടുചെന്നു തിർസ്സയെ നിരോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Omri and all the Israelites with him withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to Tirzah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Omri and all Israel with him went up from Gibbethon, and they besieged Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണം പിടിപെട്ടു എന്നു സിമ്രി കണ്ടപ്പോൾ രാജധാനിയുടെ ഉൾമുറിയിൽ കടന്നു രാജധാനിക്കു തീവെച്ചു അതിൽ മരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the royal palace and set the palace on fire around him. So he died,
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the citadel of the king’s house and burned the king’s house down upon himself with fire, and died,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരോബെയാമിന്റെ വഴിയിലും അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ച പാപത്തിലും നടന്നു യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു പ്രവൃത്തിച്ചു, ഇങ്ങനെ താൻ ചെയ്ത പാപങ്ങൾനിമിത്തം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: because of the sins he had committed, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord and following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: because of the sins which he had committed in doing evil in the sight of the Lord, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he had committed to make Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD , in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: സിമ്രിയുടെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടും യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Zimri’s reign, and the rebellion he carried out, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the treason he committed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: അന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ ജനം രണ്ടു ഭാഗമായി പിരിഞ്ഞു; പാതി ജനം ഗീനത്തിന്റെ മകനായ തിബ്നിയെ രാജാവാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നു; പാതി ജനം ഒമ്രിയുടെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the people of Israel were split into two factions; half supported Tibni son of Ginath for king, and the other half supported Omri.
chapters.nkjv: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
chapters.kjv: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒമ്രിയുടെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്ന ജനം ഗീനത്തിന്റെ മകനായ തിബ്നിയുടെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്ന ജനത്തെ തോല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ തിബ്നി പട്ടുപോകയും ഒമ്രി രാജാവാകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But Omri’s followers proved stronger than those of Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri became king.
chapters.nkjv: But the people who followed Omri prevailed over the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri reigned.
chapters.kjv: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ മുപ്പത്തൊന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ ഒമ്രി യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവായി പന്ത്രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു; തിർസ്സയിൽ അവൻ ആറു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.
chapters.nkjv: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king over Israel, andreigned twelve years. Six years he reigned in Tirzah.
chapters.kjv: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ശേമെരിനോടു ശമര്യാമല രണ്ടു താലന്തു വെള്ളിക്കു വാങ്ങി ആ മലമുകളിൽ പട്ടണം പണിതു; താൻ പണിത പട്ടണത്തിന്നു മലയുടമസ്ഥനായിരുന്ന ശേമെരിന്റെ പേരിൻ പ്രകാരം ശമര്യാ എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city on the hill, calling it Samaria, after Shemer, the name of the former owner of the hill.
chapters.nkjv: And he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver; then he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill.
chapters.kjv: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

chapters.ml: ഒമ്രി യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; തനിക്കു മുമ്പുണ്ടായിരുന്ന എല്ലാവരെക്കാളും അധികം ദോഷം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord and sinned more than all those before him.
chapters.nkjv: Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did worse than all who were before him.
chapters.kjv: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD , and did worse than all that were before him.

chapters.ml: എങ്ങനെയെന്നാൽ: അവൻ നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ എല്ലാവഴിയിലും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ തങ്ങളുടെ മിത്ഥ്യാമൂർത്തികളാൽ കോപിപ്പിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച പാപങ്ങളിലും നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He followed completely the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.
chapters.nkjv: For he walked in all the ways of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin by which he had made Israel sin, provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
chapters.kjv: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

chapters.ml: ഒമ്രി ചെയ്ത മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്ത പരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തികളും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Omri’s reign, what he did and the things he achieved, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and the might that he showed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: ഒമ്രി തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; ശമര്യയിൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. അവന്റെ മകനായ ആഹാബ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Omri rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Ahab his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Omri rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. Then Ahab his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആസയുടെ മുപ്പത്തെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ ഒമ്രിയുടെ മകനായ ആഹാബ് യിസ്രായേലിൽ രാജാവായി; ഒമ്രിയുടെ മകനായ ആഹാബ് ശമര്യയിൽ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഇരുപത്തുരണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria over Israel twenty-two years.
chapters.nkjv: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri became king over Israel; and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
chapters.kjv: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

chapters.ml: ഒമ്രിയുടെ മകനായ ആഹാബ് തനിക്കു മുമ്പുണ്ടായിരുന്ന എല്ലാവരെക്കാളും അധികം യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Ahab son of Omri did more evil in the eyes of the Lord than any of those before him.
chapters.nkjv: Now Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord, more than all who were before him.
chapters.kjv: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.

chapters.ml: നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളിൽ നടക്കുന്നതു പോരാ എന്നു തോന്നുമാറു അവൻ സീദോന്യരാജാവായ എത്ത്-ബാലിന്റെ മകളായ ഈസേബെലിനെ ഭാര്യയായി പരിഗ്രഹിക്കയും ബാലിനെ ചെന്നു സേവിച്ചു നമസ്കരിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He not only considered it trivial to commit the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, but he also married Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and began to serve Baal and worship him.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, as though it had been a trivial thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Sidonians; and he went and served Baal and worshiped him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

chapters.ml: താൻ ശമര്യയിൽ പണിത ബാലിന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ അവൻ ബാലിന്നു ഒരു ബലിപീഠം ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he built in Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: Then he set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബ് ഒരു അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; അങ്ങനെ ആഹാബ് യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം തനിക്കു മുമ്പുണ്ടായിരുന്ന എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരെക്കാളും അധികം ദോഷം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Ahab also made an Asherah pole and did more to arouse the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, than did all the kings of Israel before him.
chapters.nkjv: And Ahab made a wooden image. Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
chapters.kjv: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കാലത്തു ബേഥേല്യനായ ഹീയേൽ യെരീഹോ പണിതു; യഹോവ നൂന്റെ മകനായ യോശുവമുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനപ്രകാരം അതിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനം ഇട്ടപ്പോൾ അവന്നു അബീറാം എന്ന മൂത്തമകനും അതിന്റെ പടിവാതിൽ വെച്ചപ്പോൾ ശെഗൂബു എന്ന ഇളയമകനും നഷ്ടംവന്നു.
chapters.niv: In Ahab’s time, Hiel of Bethel rebuilt Jericho. He laid its foundations at the cost of his firstborn son Abiram, and he set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken by Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.nkjv: In his days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho. He laid its foundation with Abiram his firstborn, and with his youngest son Segub he set up its gates, according to the word of the Lord, which He had spoken through Joshua the son of Nun.
chapters.kjv: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഗിലെയാദിലെ തിശ്ബിയിൽനിന്നുള്ള തിശ്ബ്യനായ ഏലീയാവു അഹാബിനോടു: ഞാൻ സേവിച്ചുനില്ക്കുന്ന യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയാണ, ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞല്ലാതെ ഈയാണ്ടുകളിൽ മഞ്ഞും മഴയും ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now Elijah the Tishbite, from Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, whom I serve, there will be neither dew nor rain in the next few years except at my word."
chapters.nkjv: And Elijah the Tishbite, of the inhabitants of Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the Lord God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, except at my word."
chapters.kjv: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah:
chapters.nkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ ഇവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു കിഴക്കോട്ടു ചെന്നു യോർദ്ദാന്നു കിഴക്കുള്ള കെരീത്ത് തോട്ടിന്നരികെ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്ക.
chapters.niv: "Leave here, turn eastward and hide in the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: "Get away from here and turn eastward, and hide by the Brook Cherith, which flows into the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

chapters.ml: തോട്ടിൽനിന്നു നീ കുടിച്ചുകൊള്ളേണം; അവിടെ നിനക്കു ഭക്ഷണം തരേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ കാക്കയോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You will drink from the brook, and I have directed the ravens to supply you with food there."
chapters.nkjv: And it will be that you shall drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there."
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ പോയി യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം ചെയ്തു; അവൻ ചെന്നു യോർദ്ദാന്നു കിഴക്കുള്ള കെരീത്ത് തോട്ടിന്നരികെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So he did what the Lord had told him. He went to the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan, and stayed there.
chapters.nkjv: So he went and did according to the word of the Lord, for he went and stayed by the Brook Cherith, which flows into the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

chapters.ml: കാക്ക അവന്നു രാവിലെ അപ്പവും ഇറച്ചിയും വൈകുന്നേരത്തു അപ്പവും ഇറച്ചിയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു കൊടുക്കും; തോട്ടിൽനിന്നു അവൻ കുടിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.
chapters.nkjv: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
chapters.kjv: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദേശത്തു മഴ പെയ്യായ്കയാൽ കുറെ ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം തോടു വറ്റിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Some time later the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened after a while that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to him:
chapters.nkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സീദോനോടു ചേർന്ന സാരെഫാത്തിലേക്കു ചെന്നു അവിടെ പാർക്ക; നിന്നെ പുലർത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു അവിടെ ഉള്ള ഒരു വിധവയോടു ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Go at once to Zarephath in the region of Sidon and stay there. I have directed a widow there to supply you with food."
chapters.nkjv: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there. See, I have commanded a widow there to provide for you."
chapters.kjv: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സാരെഫാത്തിന്നു പോയി. അവൻ പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവിടെ ഒരു വിധവ വിറകു പെറുക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു. അവൻ അവളെ വിളിച്ചു: എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ ഒരു പാത്രത്തിൽ കുറെ വെള്ളം കൊണ്ടുവരേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So he went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and asked, "Would you bring me a little water in a jar so I may have a drink?"
chapters.nkjv: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, indeed a widow was there gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, "Please bring me a little water in a cup, that I may drink."
chapters.kjv: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

chapters.ml: അവൾ കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ പോകുമ്പോൾ ഒരു കഷണം അപ്പവും കൂടെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോരേണമേ എന്നു അവൻ അവളോടു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As she was going to get it, he called, "And bring me, please, a piece of bread."
chapters.nkjv: And as she was going to get it, he called to her and said, "Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand."
chapters.kjv: And as she was going to fetch it , he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൾ: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയാണ, കലത്തിൽ ഒരു പിടി മാവും തുരുത്തിയിൽ അല്പം എണ്ണയും മാത്രമല്ലാതെ എനിക്കു ഒരു അപ്പവും ഇല്ല. ഞാൻ ഇതാ, രണ്ടു വിറകു പെറുക്കുന്നു; ഇതു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു എനിക്കും മകന്നും വേണ്ടി ഒരുക്കി അതു ഞങ്ങൾ തിന്നിട്ടു മരിപ്പാനിരിക്കയാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "As surely as the Lord your God lives," she replied, "I don’t have any bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I am gathering a few sticks to take home and make a meal for myself and my son, that we may eat it—and die."
chapters.nkjv: So she said, "As the Lord your God lives, I do not have bread, only a handful of flour in a bin, and a little oil in a jar; and see, I am gathering a couple of sticks that I may go in and prepare it for myself and my son, that we may eat it, and die."
chapters.kjv: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു അവളോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ചെന്നു നീ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ചെയ്ക; എന്നാൽ ആദ്യം എനിക്കു ചെറിയോരു അട ഉണ്ടാക്കി കൊണ്ടുവരിക; പിന്നെ നിനക്കും നിന്റെ മകന്നും വേണ്ടി ഉണ്ടാക്കിക്കൊൾക.
chapters.niv: Elijah said to her, "Don’t be afraid. Go home and do as you have said. But first make a small loaf of bread for me from what you have and bring it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.
chapters.nkjv: And Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go and do as you have said, but make me a small cake from it first, and bring it to me; and afterward make some for yourself and your son.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഭൂമിയിൽ മഴ പെയ്യിക്കുന്ന നാൾവരെ കലത്തിലെ മാവു തീർന്നുപോകയില്ല; ഭരണിയിലെ എണ്ണ കുറഞ്ഞുപോകയും ഇല്ല എന്നു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be used up and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the Lord sends rain on the land.’ "
chapters.nkjv: For thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘The bin of flour shall not be used up, nor shall the jar of oil run dry, until the day the Lord sends rain on the earth.’ "
chapters.kjv: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ചെന്നു ഏലീയാവു പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ചെയ്തു; അങ്ങനെ അവളും അവനും അവളുടെ വീട്ടുകാരും ഏറിയനാൾ അഹോവൃത്തികഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: She went away and did as Elijah had told her. So there was food every day for Elijah and for the woman and her family.
chapters.nkjv: So she went away and did according to the word of Elijah; and she and he and her household ate for many days.
chapters.kjv: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഏലീയാവുമുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചന പ്രകാരം കലത്തിലെ മാവു തീർന്നുപോയില്ല, ഭരണിയിലെ എണ്ണ കുറഞ്ഞുപോയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: For the jar of flour was not used up and the jug of oil did not run dry, in keeping with the word of the Lord spoken by Elijah.
chapters.nkjv: The bin of flour was not used up, nor did the jar of oil run dry, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke by Elijah.
chapters.kjv: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by Elijah.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം വീട്ടുടമക്കാരത്തിയായ സ്ത്രീയുടെ മകൻ ദീനം പിടിച്ചു കിടപ്പിലായി; ദീനം കടുത്തിട്ടു അവനിൽ ശ്വാസം ഇല്ലാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house became ill. He grew worse and worse, and finally stopped breathing.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened after these things that the son of the woman who owned the house became sick. And his sickness was so serious that there was no breath left in him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൾ ഏലീയാവോടു: അയ്യോ ദൈവപുരുഷനേ, എനിക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? എന്റെ പാപം ഓർപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും എന്റെ മകനെ കൊല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നും ആകുന്നുവോ നീ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She said to Elijah, "What do you have against me, man of God? Did you come to remind me of my sin and kill my son?"
chapters.nkjv: So she said to Elijah, "What have I to do with you, O man of God? Have you come to me to bring my sin to remembrance, and to kill my son?"
chapters.kjv: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളോടു: നിന്റെ മകനെ ഇങ്ങു തരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവനെ അവളുടെ മടിയിൽനിന്നെടുത്തു താൻ പാർത്തിരുന്ന മാളികമുറിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു തന്റെ കട്ടിലിന്മേൽ കിടത്തി.
chapters.niv: "Give me your son," Elijah replied. He took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his bed.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to her, "Give me your son." So he took him out of her arms and carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his own bed.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയോടു: എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന ഇവിടത്തെ വിധവയുടെ മകനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നീ അവൾക്കു അനർത്ഥം വരുത്തിയോ എന്നു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he cried out to the Lord , " Lord my God, have you brought tragedy even on this widow I am staying with, by causing her son to die?"
chapters.nkjv: Then he cried out to the Lord and said, "O Lord my God, have You also brought tragedy on the widow with whom I lodge, by killing her son?"
chapters.kjv: And he cried unto the LORD , and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ കുട്ടിയുടെ മേൽ മൂന്നുപ്രാവശ്യം കവിണ്ണുകിടന്നു: എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, ഈ കുട്ടിയുടെ പ്രാണൻ അവനിൽ മടങ്ങിവരുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he stretched himself out on the boy three times and cried out to the Lord , " Lord my God, let this boy’s life return to him!"
chapters.nkjv: And he stretched himself out on the child three times, and cried out to the Lord and said, "O Lord my God, I pray, let this child’s soul come back to him."
chapters.kjv: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD , and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഏലീയാവിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടു; കുട്ടിയുടെ പ്രാണൻ അവനിൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നു അവൻ ജീവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord heard Elijah’s cry, and the boy’s life returned to him, and he lived.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came back to him, and he revived.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു കുട്ടിയെ എടുത്തു മാളികയിൽനിന്നു താഴെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു കൊടുത്തു: ഇതാ, നിന്റെ മകൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഏലിയാവു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elijah picked up the child and carried him down from the room into the house. He gave him to his mother and said, "Look, your son is alive!"
chapters.nkjv: And Elijah took the child and brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother. And Elijah said, "See, your son lives!"
chapters.kjv: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ ഏലീയാവോടു: നീ ദൈവപുരുഷൻ എന്നും നിന്റെ നാവിന്മേലുള്ള യഹോവയുടെ വചനം സത്യമെന്നും ഞാൻ ഇതിനാൽ അറിയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the Lord from your mouth is the truth."
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now by this I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is the truth."
chapters.kjv: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.

chapters.ml: ഏറിയനാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു മൂന്നാം സംവത്സരത്തിൽ ഏലീയാവിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായി: നീ ചെന്നു ആഹാബിന്നു നിന്നെത്തന്നേ കാണിക്ക; ഞാൻ ഭൂതലത്തിൽ മഴ പെയ്യിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After a long time, in the third year, the word of the Lord came to Elijah: "Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the land."
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass after many days that the word of the Lord came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, "Go, present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു ആഹാബിന്നു തന്നെത്താൻ കാണിപ്പാൻ പോയി; ക്ഷാമമോ ശമര്യയിൽ കഠിനമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria,
chapters.nkjv: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab; and therewas a severe famine in Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ആഹാബ് തന്റെ ഗൃഹവിചാരകനായ ഓബദ്യാവെ ആളയച്ചുവരുത്തി; ഓബദ്യാവോ യഹോവയിങ്കൽ മഹാഭക്തനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Ahab had summoned Obadiah, his palace administrator. (Obadiah was a devout believer in the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And Ahab had called Obadiah, who was in charge of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly.
chapters.kjv: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:

chapters.ml: ഈസേബെൽ യഹോവയുടെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെ കൊല്ലുമ്പോൾ ഓബദ്യാവു നൂറു പ്രവാചകന്മാരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു ഓരോ ഗുഹയിൽ അമ്പതീതുപേരായി ഒളിപ്പിച്ചു അപ്പവും വെള്ളവും കൊടുത്തു രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: While Jezebel was killing off the Lord ’s prophets, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them in two caves, fifty in each, and had supplied them with food and water.)
chapters.nkjv: For so it was, while Jezebel massacred the prophets of the Lord, that Obadiah had taken one hundred prophets and hidden them, fifty to a cave, and had fed them with bread and water.)
chapters.kjv: For it was so , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD , that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

chapters.ml: ആഹാബ് ഓബദ്യാവോടു: നീ നാട്ടിലുള്ള എല്ലാ നീരുറവുകളുടെയും തോടുകളുടെയും അരികത്തു ചെന്നു നോക്കുക; പക്ഷേ മൃഗങ്ങൾ എല്ലാം നശിച്ചുപോകാതെ കുതിരകളെയും കോവർകഴുതകളെയും എങ്കിലും ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ നമുക്കു പുല്ലു കിട്ടും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs and valleys. Maybe we can find some grass to keep the horses and mules alive so we will not have to kill any of our animals."
chapters.nkjv: And Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go into the land to all the springs of water and to all the brooks; perhaps we may find grass to keep the horses and mules alive, so that we will not have to kill any livestock."
chapters.kjv: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

chapters.ml: അവർ ദേശത്തുകൂടി സഞ്ചരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിനെ തമ്മിൽ പകുത്തു; ആഹാബ് തനിച്ചു ഒരു വഴിക്കു പോയി, ഓബദ്യാവും തനിച്ചു മറ്റൊരു വഴിക്കു പോയി,
chapters.niv: So they divided the land they were to cover, Ahab going in one direction and Obadiah in another.
chapters.nkjv: So they divided the land between them to explore it; Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
chapters.kjv: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

chapters.ml: ഓബദ്യാവു വഴിയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഏലീയാവു എതിരേറ്റുവരുന്നതു കണ്ടു അവനെ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു: എന്റെ യജമാനനായ ഏലീയാവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Obadiah was walking along, Elijah met him. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down to the ground, and said, "Is it really you, my lord Elijah?"
chapters.nkjv: Now as Obadiah was on his way, suddenly Elijah met him; and he recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, "Is that you, my lord Elijah?"
chapters.kjv: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: അതേ, ഞാൻ തന്നേ; നീ ചെന്നു ഏലീയാവു ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നു നിന്റെ യജമാനനോടു ബോധിപ്പിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Yes," he replied. "Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And he answered him, "Itis I. Go, tell your master, ‘Elijah ishere.’ "
chapters.kjv: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here .

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: അടിയനെ കൊല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു അഹാബിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിപ്പാൻ അടിയൻ എന്തു പാപം ചെയ്തു?
chapters.niv: "What have I done wrong," asked Obadiah, "that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to be put to death?
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "How have I sinned, that you are delivering your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
chapters.kjv: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയാണ, നിന്നെ അന്വേഷിപ്പാൻ എന്റെ യജമാനൻ ആളെ അയക്കാത്ത ജാതിയും രാജ്യവും ഇല്ല; നീ അവിടെ ഇല്ല എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവൻ ആ രാജ്യത്തെയും ജാതിയെയുംകൊണ്ടു നിന്നെ കണ്ടിട്ടില്ല എന്നു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As surely as the Lord your God lives, there is not a nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to look for you. And whenever a nation or kingdom claimed you were not there, he made them swear they could not find you.
chapters.nkjv: As the Lord your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to hunt for you; and when they said, ‘Heis not here,’ he took an oath from the kingdom or nation that they could not find you.
chapters.kjv: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ നീ എന്നോടു: ചെന്നു നിന്റെ യജമാനനോടു: ഏലീയാവു ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നു ബോധിപ്പിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: But now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’
chapters.nkjv: And now you say, ‘Go, tell your master, "Elijah ishere" ’!
chapters.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here .

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ പിരിഞ്ഞുപോയ ഉടനെ യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു നിന്നെ ഞാൻ അറിയാത്ത ഒരു സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകും; ഞാൻ ആഹാബിനോടു ചെന്നറിയിക്കയും അവൻ നിന്നെ കണ്ടെത്താതെ ഇരിക്കയും ചെയ്താൽ അവൻ എന്നെ കൊല്ലുമല്ലോ; അടിയനോ ബാല്യംമുതൽ യഹോവഭക്തൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I don’t know where the Spirit of the Lord may carry you when I leave you. If I go and tell Ahab and he doesn’t find you, he will kill me. Yet I your servant have worshiped the Lord since my youth.
chapters.nkjv: And it shall come to pass, assoonas I am gone from you, that the Spirit of the Lord will carry you to a place I do not know; so when I go and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he will kill me. But I your servant have feared the Lord from my youth.
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.

chapters.ml: ഈസേബെൽ യഹോവയുടെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെ കൊല്ലുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരിൽ നൂറുപേരെ ഓരോ ഗുഹയിൽ അമ്പതീതുപേരായി ഒളിപ്പിച്ചു അപ്പവും വെള്ളവും കൊടുത്തു രക്ഷിച്ച വസ്തുത യജമാനൻ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Haven’t you heard, my lord, what I did while Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord ? I hid a hundred of the Lord ’s prophets in two caves, fifty in each, and supplied them with food and water.
chapters.nkjv: Was it not reported to my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the Lord, how I hid one hundred men of the Lord’s prophets, fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
chapters.kjv: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD , how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’s prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയിരിക്കെ നീ എന്നോടു: ചെന്നു നിന്റെ യജമാനനോടു: ഏലീയാവു ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നു ബോധിപ്പിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിക്കുന്നുവോ? അവൻ എന്നെ കൊല്ലുമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’ He will kill me!"
chapters.nkjv: And now you say, ‘Go, tell your master, "Elijah ishere." ’ He will kill me!"
chapters.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഏലീയാവു: ഞാൻ സേവിച്ചുനില്ക്കുന്ന സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവയാണ, ഞാൻ ഇന്നു അവന്നു എന്നെത്തന്നേ കാണിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elijah said, "As the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, I will surely present myself to Ahab today."
chapters.nkjv: Then Elijah said, "As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will surely present myself to him today."
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഓബദ്യാവു ആഹാബിനെ ചെന്നു കണ്ടു വസ്തുത അറിയിച്ചു; ആഹാബ് ഏലീയാവെ കാണ്മാൻ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
chapters.nkjv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
chapters.kjv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബ് ഏലീയാവെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവനോടു: ആർ ഇതു? യിസ്രായേലിനെ കഷ്ടപ്പെടുത്തുന്നവനോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he saw Elijah, he said to him, "Is that you, you troubler of Israel?"
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said to him, "Isthat you, O troubler of Israel?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: യിസ്രായേലിനെ കഷ്ടപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതു ഞാനല്ല, നീയും നിന്റെ പിതൃഭവനവുമത്രേ. നിങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനകളെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയും നീ ബാൽവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ ചെന്നു സേവിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "I have not made trouble for Israel," Elijah replied. "But you and your father’s family have. You have abandoned the Lord ’s commands and have followed the Baals.
chapters.nkjv: And he answered, "I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house have, in that you have forsaken the commandments of the Lord and have followed the Baals.
chapters.kjv: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD , and thou hast followed Baalim.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ആളയച്ചു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും ബാലിന്റെ നാനൂറ്റമ്പതു പ്രവാചകന്മാരെയും ഈസേബെലിന്റെ മേശയിങ്കൽ ഭക്ഷിച്ചുവരുന്ന നാനൂറു അശേരാപ്രവാചകന്മാരെയും കർമ്മേൽപർവ്വതത്തിൽ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തുക.
chapters.niv: Now summon the people from all over Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel. And bring the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, send and gather all Israel to me on Mount Carmel, the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal, and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ആഹാബ് എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെയും അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു കർമ്മേൽപർവ്വതത്തിൽ ആ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: So Ahab sent word throughout all Israel and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.
chapters.nkjv: So Ahab sent for all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together on Mount Carmel.
chapters.kjv: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഏലീയാവു അടുത്തുചെന്നു സർവ്വജനത്തോടും: നിങ്ങൾ എത്രത്തോളം രണ്ടു തോണിയിൽ കാൽവെക്കും? യഹോവ ദൈവം എങ്കിൽ അവനെ അനുഗമിപ്പിൻ; ബാൽ എങ്കിലോ അവനെ അനുഗമിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ ജനം അവനോടു ഉത്തരം ഒന്നും പറഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Elijah went before the people and said, "How long will you waver between two opinions? If the Lord is God, follow him; but if Baal is God, follow him." But the people said nothing.
chapters.nkjv: And Elijah came to all the people, and said, "How long will you falter between two opinions? If the Lordis God, follow Him; but if Baal, follow him." But the people answered him not a word.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഏലീയാവു ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവയുടെ പ്രവാചകനായി ഞാൻ ഒരുത്തൻ മാത്രമേ ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുള്ളു; ബാലിന്റെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരോ നാനൂറ്റമ്പതുപേരുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Elijah said to them, "I am the only one of the Lord ’s prophets left, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elijah said to the people, "I alone am left a prophet of the Lord; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
chapters.kjv: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD ; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രണ്ടു കാളയെ തരട്ടെ; ഒരു കാളയെ അവർ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു ഖണ്ഡംഖണ്ഡമാക്കി തീ ഇടാതെ വിറകിന്മേൽ വെക്കട്ടെ; മറ്റേ കാളയെ ഞാനും ഒരുക്കി തീ ഇടാതെ വിറകിന്മേൽ വെക്കാം;
chapters.niv: Get two bulls for us. Let Baal’s prophets choose one for themselves, and let them cut it into pieces and put it on the wood but not set fire to it. I will prepare the other bull and put it on the wood but not set fire to it.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore let them give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, but put no fire underit; and I will prepare the other bull, and lay it on the wood, but put no fire underit.
chapters.kjv: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദേവന്റെ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കാം; തീകൊണ്ടു ഉത്തരം അരുളുന്ന ദൈവം തന്നേ ദൈവമെന്നു ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; അതിന്നു ജനം എല്ലാം:
chapters.niv: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the Lord . The god who answers by fire—he is God." Then all the people said, "What you say is good."
chapters.nkjv: Then you call on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord; and the God who answers by fire, He is God." So all the people answered and said, "It is well spoken."
chapters.kjv: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD : and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

chapters.ml: അതു നല്ലവാക്കു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. പിന്നെ ഏലീയാവു ബാലിന്റെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഒരു കാളയെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു ആദ്യം ഒരുക്കിക്കൊൾവിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ അധികം പേരുണ്ടല്ലോ; എന്നിട്ടു തീ ഇടാതെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദേവന്റെ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose one of the bulls and prepare it first, since there are so many of you. Call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire."
chapters.nkjv: Now Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose one bull for yourselves and prepare it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire underit."
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under .

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർക്കു കൊടുത്ത കാളയെ അവർ എടുത്തു ഒരുക്കി: ബാലേ, ഉത്തരമരുളേണമേ എന്നു രാവിലെ തുടങ്ങി ഉച്ചവരെ ബാലിന്റെ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിച്ചു. ഒരു ശബ്ദമോ ഉത്തരമോ ഉണ്ടായില്ല. തങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ബലിപീഠത്തിന്നു ചുറ്റും അവർ തുള്ളിച്ചാടിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So they took the bull given them and prepared it. Then they called on the name of Baal from morning till noon. "Baal, answer us!" they shouted. But there was no response; no one answered. And they danced around the altar they had made.
chapters.nkjv: So they took the bull which was given them, and they prepared it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even till noon, saying, "O Baal, hear us!" But therewas no voice; no one answered. Then they leaped about the altar which they had made.
chapters.kjv: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it , and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

chapters.ml: ഉച്ചയായപ്പോൾ ഏലീയാവു അവരെ പരിഹസിച്ചു: ഉറക്കെ വിളിപ്പിൻ; അവൻ ദേവനല്ലോ; അവൻ ധ്യാനിക്കയാകുന്നു; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ വെളിക്കു പോയിരിക്കയാകുന്നു; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ യാത്രയിലാകുന്നു; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പക്ഷെ ഉറങ്ങുകയാകുന്നു; അവനെ ഉണർത്തേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At noon Elijah began to taunt them. "Shout louder!" he said. "Surely he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or busy, or traveling. Maybe he is sleeping and must be awakened."
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, at noon, that Elijah mocked them and said, "Cry aloud, for he is a god; either he is meditating, or he is busy, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചു പതിവുപോലെ രക്തം ഒഴുകുവോളം വാൾകൊണ്ടും കുന്തംകൊണ്ടും തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ മുറിവേല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they shouted louder and slashed themselves with swords and spears, as was their custom, until their blood flowed.
chapters.nkjv: So they cried aloud, and cut themselves, as was their custom, with knives and lances, until the blood gushed out on them.
chapters.kjv: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

chapters.ml: ഉച്ചതിരിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഭോജനയാഗം കഴിക്കുന്ന സമയംവരെ അവർ വെളിച്ചപ്പെട്ടുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; എന്നിട്ടും ഒരു ശബ്ദമോ ഉത്തരമോ ശ്രദ്ധയോ ഉണ്ടായില്ല.
chapters.niv: Midday passed, and they continued their frantic prophesying until the time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no response, no one answered, no one paid attention.
chapters.nkjv: And when midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice. But therewas no voice; no one answered, no one paid attention.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഏലീയാവു: എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവിൻ എന്നു സർവ്വജനത്തോടും പറഞ്ഞു. സർവ്വജനവും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചേർന്നു. അവൻ ഇടിഞ്ഞുകിടന്ന യഹോവയുടെ യാഗപീഠം നന്നാക്കി;
chapters.niv: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come here to me." They came to him, and he repaired the altar of the Lord , which had been torn down.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come near to me." So all the people came near to him. And he repaired the altar of the Lordthatwas broken down.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു യിസ്രായേൽ എന്നു പേരാകും എന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ലഭിച്ച യാക്കോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ ഗോത്രസംഖ്യെക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം പന്ത്രണ്ടു കല്ലു എടുത്തു,
chapters.niv: Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes descended from Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord had come, saying, "Your name shall be Israel."
chapters.nkjv: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord had come, saying, "Israel shall be your name."
chapters.kjv: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

chapters.ml: കല്ലുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു; യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റും രണ്ടു സെയാ വിത്തു വിതെപ്പാൻ മതിയായ വിസ്താരത്തിൽ ഒരു തോടു ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: With the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord , and he dug a trench around it large enough to hold two seahs of seed.
chapters.nkjv: Then with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord; and he made a trench around the altar large enough to hold two seahs of seed.
chapters.kjv: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD : and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ വിറകു അടുക്കി കാളയെ ഖണ്ഡംഖണ്ഡമാക്കി വിറകിൻ മീതെ വെച്ചു; നാലു തൊട്ടിയിൽ വെള്ളം നിറെച്ചു ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്മേലും വിറകിന്മേലും ഒഴിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces and laid it on the wood. Then he said to them, "Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the offering and on the wood."
chapters.nkjv: And he put the wood in order, cut the bull in pieces, and laid it on the wood, and said, "Fill four waterpots with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice and on the wood."
chapters.kjv: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം പ്രാവശ്യവും അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ രണ്ടാം പ്രാവശ്യവും ചെയ്തു; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം: മൂന്നാം പ്രാവശ്യവും അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ മൂന്നാം പ്രാവശ്യവും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "Do it again," he said, and they did it again. "Do it a third time," he ordered, and they did it the third time.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Do it a second time," and they did it a second time; and he said, "Do it a third time," and they did it a third time.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റം ഒഴുകി; അവൻ തോട്ടിലും വെള്ളം നിറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.
chapters.nkjv: So the water ran all around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.
chapters.kjv: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

chapters.ml: ഭോജനയാഗം കഴിക്കുന്ന നേരമായപ്പോൾ ഏലീയാപ്രവാചകൻ അടുത്തുചെന്നു: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെയും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെയും ദൈവയമായ യഹോവേ, യിസ്രയേലിൽ നീ ദൈവമെന്നും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ദാസൻ എന്നും ഈ കാര്യങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ നിന്റെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം ചെയ്തു എന്നും ഇന്നു വെളിപ്പെട്ടുവരട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: At the time of sacrifice, the prophet Elijah stepped forward and prayed: " Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant and have done all these things at your command.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, at thetimeof the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near and said, "Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that You are God in Israel and I am Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your word.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, എനിക്കു ഉത്തരമരുളേണമേ; നീ ദൈവം തന്നേ യഹോവേ; നീ തങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയം വീണ്ടും തിരിച്ചു എന്നു ഈ ജനം അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു എനിക്കു ഉത്തരമരുളേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Answer me, Lord , answer me, so these people will know that you, Lord , are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again."
chapters.nkjv: Hear me, O Lord, hear me, that this people may know that You are the Lord God, and that You have turned their hearts back toYou again."
chapters.kjv: Hear me, O LORD , hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ യഹോവയുടെ തീ ഇറങ്ങി ഹോമയാഗവും വിറകും മണ്ണും ദഹിപ്പിച്ചു തോട്ടിലെ വെള്ളവും വറ്റിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the fire of the Lord fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench.
chapters.nkjv: Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood and the stones and the dust, and it licked up the water that was in the trench.
chapters.kjv: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

chapters.ml: ജനം എല്ലാം അതു കണ്ടു കവിണ്ണുവീണു: യഹോവ തന്നേ ദൈവം, യഹോവ തന്നേ ദൈവം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, "The Lord —he is God! The Lord —he is God!"
chapters.nkjv: Now when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces; and they said, "The Lord, He is God! The Lord, He is God!"
chapters.kjv: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD , he is the God; the LORD , he is the God.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു അവരോടു: ബാലിന്റെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെ പിടിപ്പിൻ; അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും ചാടിപ്പോകരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അവരെ പിടിച്ചു; ഏലീയാവു അവരെ താഴെ കീശോൻ തോട്ടിന്നരികെ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു അവിടെവെച്ചു വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Elijah commanded them, "Seize the prophets of Baal. Don’t let anyone get away!" They seized them, and Elijah had them brought down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered there.
chapters.nkjv: And Elijah said to them, "Seize the prophets of Baal! Do not let one of them escape!" So they seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the Brook Kishon and executed them there.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഏലീയാവു ആഹാബിനോടു: നീ ചെന്നു ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്ക; വലിയ മഴയുടെ മുഴക്കം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And Elijah said to Ahab, "Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain."
chapters.nkjv: Then Elijah said to Ahab, "Go up, eat and drink; for thereis the sound of abundance of rain."
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബ് ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു മല കയറിപ്പോയി. ഏലീയാവോ കർമ്മേൽ പർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ മുകളിൽ കയറി നിലത്തു കുനിഞ്ഞു മുഖം തന്റെ മുഴങ്കാലുകളുടെ നടുവിൽ വെച്ചു തന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു:
chapters.niv: So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees.
chapters.nkjv: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; then he bowed down on the ground, and put his face between his knees,
chapters.kjv: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു കടലിന്നു നേരെ നോക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ ചെന്നു നോക്കീട്ടു: ഒന്നും ഇല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: പിന്നെയും ഏഴുപ്രാവശ്യം ചെല്ലുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Go and look toward the sea," he told his servant. And he went up and looked. "There is nothing there," he said. Seven times Elijah said, "Go back."
chapters.nkjv: and said to his servant, "Go up now, look toward the sea." So he went up and looked, and said, "Thereis nothing." And seven times he said, "Go again."
chapters.kjv: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം പ്രാവശ്യമോ അവൻ: ഇതാ, കടലിൽനിന്നു ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ കൈപോലെ ഒരു ചെറിയ മേഘം പൊങ്ങുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: നീ ചെന്നു ആഹാബിനോടു: മഴ നിന്നെ തടുക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു രഥം പൂട്ടി ഇറങ്ങിപ്പോക എന്നു ബോധിപ്പിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The seventh time the servant reported, "A cloud as small as a man’s hand is rising from the sea." So Elijah said, "Go and tell Ahab, ‘Hitch up your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then it came to pass the seventh time, that he said, "There is a cloud, as small as a man’s hand, rising out of the sea!" So he said, "Go up, say to Ahab, ‘Prepare yourchariot, and go down before the rain stops you.’ "
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot , and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷണത്തിൽ ആകാശം മേഘവും കാറ്റുംകൊണ്ടു കറുത്തു വന്മഴ പെയ്തു. ആഹാബ് രഥം കയറി യിസ്രായേലിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, the sky grew black with clouds, the wind rose, a heavy rain started falling and Ahab rode off to Jezreel.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened in the meantime that the sky became black with clouds and wind, and there was a heavy rain. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ കൈ ഏലീയാവിന്മേൽ വന്നു; അവൻ അര മുറുക്കിയുംകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേലിൽ എത്തുംവരെ ആഹാബിന്നു മുമ്പായി ഓടി.
chapters.niv: The power of the Lord came on Elijah and, tucking his cloak into his belt, he ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.
chapters.nkjv: Then the hand of the Lord came upon Elijah; and he girded up his loins and ran ahead of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
chapters.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവൻ സകല പ്രവാചകന്മാരെയും വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്ന വിവരമൊക്കെയും ആഹാബ് ഈസേബെലിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
chapters.nkjv: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, also how he had executed all the prophets with the sword.
chapters.kjv: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

chapters.ml: ഈസേബെൽ ഏലീയാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരു ദൂതനെ അയച്ചു: നാളെ ഈ നേരത്തു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ജീവനെ അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തന്റെ ജീവനെപ്പോലെ ആക്കുന്നില്ല എങ്കിൽ ദേവന്മാർ എന്നോടു തക്കവണ്ണവും അധികവും ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah to say, "May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if by this time tomorrow I do not make your life like that of one of them."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, "So let the gods do tome, and more also, if I do not make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time."
chapters.kjv: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me , and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ജീവരക്ഷെക്കായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു യെഹൂദെക്കുൾപ്പെട്ട ബേർ-ശേബയിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ തന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരനെ താമസിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,
chapters.nkjv: And when he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and went to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.
chapters.kjv: And when he saw that , he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

chapters.ml: താനോ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഒരു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി ചെന്നു ഒരു ചൂരച്ചെടിയുടെ തണലിൽ ഇരുന്നു മരിപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചു; ഇപ്പോൾ മതി, യഹോവേ, എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ എടുത്തുകൊള്ളേണമേ; ഞാൻ എന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെക്കാൾ നല്ലവനല്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: while he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a broom bush, sat down under it and prayed that he might die. "I have had enough, Lord ," he said. "Take my life; I am no better than my ancestors."
chapters.nkjv: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a broom tree. And he prayed that he might die, and said, "It is enough! Now, Lord, take my life, for I am no better than my fathers!"
chapters.kjv: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD , take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ചൂരച്ചെടിയുടെ തണലിൽ കിടന്നുറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ പെട്ടെന്നു ഒരു ദൂതൻ അവനെ തട്ടി അവനോടു: എഴുന്നേറ്റു തിന്നുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he lay down under the bush and fell asleep. All at once an angel touched him and said, "Get up and eat."
