chapters.nkjv: Now Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go from me to speak to you?"
chapters.kjv: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മീഖായാവു: നീ ഒളിപ്പാനായിട്ടു അറ തേടി നടക്കുന്ന ദിവസത്തിൽ നീ കാണും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Micaiah replied, "You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room."
chapters.nkjv: And Micaiah said, "Indeed, you shall see on that day when you go into an inner chamber to hide!"
chapters.kjv: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു പറഞ്ഞതു: മീഖായാവെ പിടിച്ചു നഗരാധിപതിയായ ആമോന്റെയും രാജകുമാരനായ യോവാശിന്റെയും അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു ഇവനെ കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ ആക്കി,
chapters.niv: The king of Israel then ordered, "Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king’s son
chapters.nkjv: So the king of Israel said, "Take Micaiah, and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son;
chapters.kjv: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സമാധാനത്തോടെ വരുവോളം ഞെരുക്കത്തിന്റെ അപ്പവും ഞെരുക്കത്തിന്റെ വെള്ളവും കൊടുത്തു പോഷിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു പറക.
chapters.niv: and say, ‘This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.’ "
chapters.nkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the king: "Put this fellow in prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and water of affliction, until I come in peace." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മീഖായാവു: നീ സമാധാനത്തോടെ മടങ്ങിവരുന്നുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ യഹോവ എന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. സകലജാതികളുമായുള്ളോരേ, കേട്ടുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നും അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Micaiah declared, "If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me." Then he added, "Mark my words, all you people!"
chapters.nkjv: But Micaiah said, "If you ever return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me." And he said, "Take heed, all you people!"
chapters.kjv: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവും യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തും ഗിലെയാദിലെ രാമോത്തിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.kjv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു യെഹോശാഫാത്തിനോടു: ഞാൻ വേഷംമാറി പടയിൽ കടക്കും; നീയോ രാജവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു വോഷംമാറി പടയിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
chapters.nkjv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into battle; but you put on your robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അരാംരാജാവു തന്റെ മുപ്പത്തിരണ്ടു രഥനായകന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാവിനോടു മാത്രമല്ലാതെ ചെറിയവരോടോ വലിയവരോടോ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the king of Aram had ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders, "Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel."
chapters.nkjv: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, "Fight with no one small or great, but only with the king of Israel."
chapters.kjv: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ രഥനായകന്മാർ യെഹോശാഥാത്തിനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: ഇവൻ തന്നേ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനോടു പൊരുതുവാൻ തിരിഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "Surely this is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but when Jehoshaphat cried out,
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, "Surely it is the king of Israel!" Therefore they turned aside to fight against him, and Jehoshaphat cried out.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽരാജവല്ല എന്നു രഥനായകന്മാർ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവനെ വിട്ടുമാറി പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel and stopped pursuing him.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒരുത്തൻ യദൃച്ഛയാ വില്ലു കുലെച്ചു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിനെ കവചത്തിന്നും പതക്കത്തിന്നും ഇടെക്കു എയ്തു; അവൻ തന്റെ സാരഥിയോടു: നിന്റെ കൈ തിരിച്ചു എന്നെ പടയിൽ നിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപോക; ഞാൻ കഠിനമായി മുറിവേറ്റിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told his chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded."
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain man drew a bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of his armor. So he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am wounded."
chapters.kjv: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

chapters.ml: അന്നു പട കഠിനമായി തീർന്നതുകൊണ്ടു രാജാവു അരാമ്യർക്കു എതിരെ രഥത്തിൽ നിവിർന്നുനിന്നു; സന്ധ്യാസമയത്തു അവൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി. മുറിവിൽനിന്നു രക്തം രഥത്തിന്നകത്തു ഒഴുകിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All day long the battle raged, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound ran onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.
chapters.nkjv: The battle increased that day; and the king was propped up in his chariot, facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out from the wound onto the floor of the chariot.
chapters.kjv: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കും താന്താന്റെ ദേശത്തേക്കും പോകട്ടെ എന്നു പാളയത്തിൽ ഒരു പരസ്യം പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: As the sun was setting, a cry spread through the army: "Every man to his town. Every man to his land!"
chapters.nkjv: Then, as the sun was going down, a shout went throughout the army, saying, "Every man to his city, and every man to his own country!"
chapters.kjv: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ രാജാവു മരിച്ചു; അവനെ ശമര്യയിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവർ രാജാവിനെ ശമര്യയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the king died and was brought to Samaria, and they buried him there.
chapters.nkjv: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria. And they buried the king in Samaria.
chapters.kjv: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

chapters.ml: രഥം ശമര്യയിലെ കുളത്തിൽ കഴുകിയപ്പോൾ യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്ന വചനപ്രകാരം നായ്ക്കൾ അവന്റെ രക്തം നക്കി; വേശ്യാസ്ത്രീകളും അവിടെ കുളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria (where the prostitutes bathed), and the dogs licked up his blood, as the word of the Lord had declared.
chapters.nkjv: Then someone washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood while the harlots bathed, according to the word of the Lord which He had spoken.
chapters.kjv: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവൻ ആനക്കൊമ്പുകൊണ്ടു പണിത അരമനയുടെയും അവൻ പണിത എല്ലാ പട്ടണങ്ങളുടെയും വിവരവും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Ahab’s reign, including all he did, the palace he built and adorned with ivory, and the cities he fortified, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, the ivory house which he built and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: ആഹാബ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകനായ അഹസ്യാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Ahab rested with his ancestors. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Ahab rested with his fathers. Then Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ആസയുടെ മകനായ യഹോശാഫാത്ത് യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ആഹാബിന്റെ നാലാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദയിൽ രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa had become king over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

chapters.ml: യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു മുപ്പത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു അസൂബാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ ശിൽഹിയുടെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
chapters.kjv: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ആസയുടെ എല്ലാവഴിയിലും നടന്നു; അതു വിട്ടുമാറാതെ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായതു ചെയ്തു. പൂജാഗിരികൾക്കുമാത്രം നീക്കം വന്നില്ല; ജനം പൂജാഗിരികളിൽ യാഗം കഴിക്കയും ധൂപം കാട്ടുകയും ചെയ്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: In everything he followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord . The high places, however, were not removed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
chapters.nkjv: And he walked in all the ways of his father Asa. He did not turn aside from them, doing whatwas right in the eyes of the Lord. Nevertheless the high places were not taken away, for the people offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.
chapters.kjv: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD : nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

chapters.ml: യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിനോടു സഖ്യത ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Jehoshaphat was also at peace with the king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Also Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

chapters.ml: യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവന്റെ പരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തികളും അവൻ ചെയ്ത യുദ്ധവും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, the things he achieved and his military exploits, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, the might that he showed, and how he made war, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ആസയുടെ കാലത്തു ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്ന പുരുഷമൈഥുനക്കാരെ അവൻ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He rid the land of the rest of the male shrine prostitutes who remained there even after the reign of his father Asa.
chapters.nkjv: And the rest of the perverted persons, who remained in the days of his father Asa, he banished from the land.
chapters.kjv: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു എദോമിൽ രാജാവില്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഒരു ദേശാധിപതി രാജസ്ഥാനം വഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: There was then no king in Edom; a provincial governor ruled.
chapters.nkjv: Therewas then no king in Edom, only a deputy of the king.
chapters.kjv: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

chapters.ml: ഓഫീരിൽ പൊന്നിന്നു പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് തർശീശ് കപ്പലുകളെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; എന്നാൽ കപ്പലുകൾ എസ്യോൻ-ഗേബരൽവെച്ചു ഉടഞ്ഞുപോയതുകൊണ്ടു അവെക്കു പോകുവാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now Jehoshaphat built a fleet of trading ships to go to Ophir for gold, but they never set sail—they were wrecked at Ezion Geber.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoshaphat made merchant ships to go to Ophir for gold; but they never sailed, for the ships were wrecked at Ezion Geber.
chapters.kjv: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

chapters.ml: അന്നേരം ആഹാബിന്റെ മകനായ അഹസ്യാവു യെഹോശാഫാത്തിനോടു: എന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരോടുകൂടെ കപ്പലുകളിൽ പോരട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്നു മനസ്സില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At that time Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my men sail with yours," but Jehoshaphat refused.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants go with your servants in the ships." But Jehoshaphat would not.
chapters.kjv: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

chapters.ml: യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു കൂടെ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോരാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of David his father. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: And Jehoshaphat rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father. Then Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബിന്റെ മകനായ അഹസ്യാവു യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ പതിനേഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ ശമര്യയിൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി; യിസ്രായേലിൽ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
chapters.nkjv: Ahaziah the son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
chapters.kjv: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ വഴിയിലും അമ്മയുടെ വഴിയിലും യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ വഴിയിലും നടന്നു യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , because he followed the ways of his father and mother and of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.
chapters.nkjv: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father and in the way of his mother and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin;
chapters.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബാലിനെ സേവിച്ചു നമസ്കരിച്ചു; തന്റെ അപ്പൻ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He served and worshiped Baal and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, just as his father had done.
chapters.nkjv: for he served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger, according to all that his father had done.
chapters.kjv: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബ് മരിച്ചശേഷം മോവാബ്യർ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Ahab’s death, Moab rebelled against Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
chapters.kjv: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

chapters.ml: അഹസ്യാവു ശമർയ്യയിലെ തന്റെ മാളികയുടെ കിളിവാതിലിൽകൂടി വീണു ദീനംപിടിച്ചു; അവൻ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: ഈ ദീനം മാറി എനിക്കു സൌഖ്യം വരുമോ എന്നു എക്രോനിലെ ദേവനായ ബാൽ സെബൂബിനോടു ചെന്നു ചോദിപ്പിൻ എന്നു അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and injured himself. So he sent messengers, saying to them, "Go and consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, to see if I will recover from this injury."
chapters.nkjv: Now Ahaziah fell through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria, and was injured; so he sent messengers and said to them, "Go, inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover from this injury."
chapters.kjv: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ തിശ്ബ്യനായ ഏലീയാവോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ശമർയ്യാരാജാവിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരെ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു അവരോടു: യിസ്രായേലിൽ ദൈവം ഇല്ലാഞ്ഞിട്ടോ നിങ്ങൾ എക്രോനിലെ ദേവനായ ബാൽ സെബൂബിനോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നതു?
chapters.niv: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Go up and meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going off to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron?’
chapters.nkjv: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say to them, ‘Isit because thereis no God in Israel that you are going to inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron?’
chapters.kjv: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

chapters.ml: ഇതുനിമിത്തം നീ കയറിയിരിക്കുന്ന കട്ടിലിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങാതെ നിശ്ചയമായി മരിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറക. അങ്ങനെ ഏലീയാവു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘You will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!’ " So Elijah went.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, thus says the Lord: ‘You shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’ " So Elijah departed.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore thus saith the LORD , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.

chapters.ml: ദൂതന്മാർ മടങ്ങിവന്നാറെ അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ മടങ്ങിവന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, "Why have you come back?"
chapters.nkjv: And when the messengers returned to him, he said to them, "Why have you come back?"
chapters.kjv: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഒരാൾ ഞങ്ങളെ എതിരേറ്റുവന്നു ഞങ്ങളോടു: നിങ്ങളെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു: യിസ്രായേലിൽ ദൈവം ഇല്ലാഞ്ഞിട്ടോ നീ എക്രോനിലെ ദേവനായ ബാൽസെബൂബിനോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ അയക്കുന്നതു? ഇതുനിമിത്തം നീ കയറിയിരിക്കുന്ന കട്ടിലിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങാതെ നിശ്ചയമായി മരിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു അവനോടു പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "A man came to meet us," they replied. "And he said to us, ‘Go back to the king who sent you and tell him, "This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!" ’ "
chapters.nkjv: So they said to him, "A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and say to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Isit because thereis no God in Israel that you are sending to inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’ " ’ "
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങളെ എതിരേറ്റുവന്നു ഈ വാക്കു നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞ ആളുടെ വേഷം എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king asked them, "What kind of man was it who came to meet you and told you this?"
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to them, "What kind of man wasit who came up to meet you and told you these words?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?

chapters.ml: അവൻ രോമവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു അരെക്കു തോൽവാറു കെട്ടിയ ആളായിരുന്നു എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ തിശ്ബ്യനായ ഏലീയാവു തന്നേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "He had a garment of hair and had a leather belt around his waist." The king said, "That was Elijah the Tishbite."
chapters.nkjv: So they answered him, "A hairy man wearing a leather belt around his waist." And he said, "It is Elijah the Tishbite."
chapters.kjv: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രാജാവു അമ്പതുപേർക്കു അധിപതിയായ ഒരുവനെയും അവന്റെ അമ്പതു ആളെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു; അവൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു; അവൻ ഒരു മലമുകളിൽ ഇരിക്കയായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അവനോടു: ദൈവപുരുഷാ, ഇറങ്ങിവരുവാൻ രാജാവു കല്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. The captain went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, "Man of God, the king says, ‘Come down!’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then the king sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty men. So he went up to him; and there he was, sitting on the top of a hill. And he spoke to him: "Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’ "
chapters.kjv: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു അമ്പതുപേർക്കു അധിപതിയായവനോടു: ഞാൻ ദൈവപുരുഷനെങ്കിൽ ആകശത്തുനിന്നു തീ ഇറങ്ങി നിന്നെയും നിന്റെ അമ്പതു ആളെയും ദഹിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഉടനെ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു തീ ഇറങ്ങി അവനെയും അവന്റെ അമ്പതു ആളെയും ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elijah answered the captain, "If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then fire fell from heaven and consumed the captain and his men.
chapters.nkjv: So Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, "If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men." And fire came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അമ്പതുപേർക്കു അധിപതിയായ മറ്റൊരുത്തനെയും അവന്റെ അമ്പതു ആളെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു; അവനും അവനോടു: ദൈവപുരുഷാ, വേഗത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങിവരുവാൻ രാജാവു കല്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At this the king sent to Elijah another captain with his fifty men. The captain said to him, "Man of God, this is what the king says, ‘Come down at once!’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty men. And he answered and said to him: "Man of God, thus has the king said, ‘Come down quickly!’ "
chapters.kjv: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു അവനോടു: ഞാൻ ദൈവപുരുഷനെങ്കിൽ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു തീ ഇറങ്ങി നിന്നെയും നിന്റെ അമ്പതു ആളെയും ദഹിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു; ഉടനെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ തീ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി അവനെയും അവന്റെ അമ്പതു ആളെയും ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "If I am a man of God," Elijah replied, "may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then the fire of God fell from heaven and consumed him and his fifty men.
chapters.nkjv: So Elijah answered and said to them, "If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men." And the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമതും അവൻ അമ്പതുപേർക്കു അധിപതിയായ ഒരുത്തനെയും അവന്റെ അമ്പതു ആളെയും അയച്ചു; ഈ മൂന്നാമത്തെ അമ്പതുപേർക്കു അധിപതിയായവൻ ചെന്നു ഏലീയാവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ മുട്ടുകുത്തി അവനോടു: ദൈവപുരുഷനായുള്ളോവേ, എന്റെ പ്രാണനെയും നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരായ ഈ അമ്പതു ആളുടെ പ്രാണനെയും ആദരിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: So the king sent a third captain with his fifty men. This third captain went up and fell on his knees before Elijah. "Man of God," he begged, "please have respect for my life and the lives of these fifty men, your servants!
chapters.nkjv: Again, he sent a third captain of fifty with his fifty men. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and pleaded with him, and said to him: "Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty servants of yours be precious in your sight.
chapters.kjv: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

chapters.ml: ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു തീ ഇറങ്ങി അമ്പതുപേർക്കധിപതിമാരായ മുമ്പിലത്തെ രണ്ടുപേരെയും അവരുടെ അമ്പതീതു ആളെയും ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ; എന്നാൽ എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ ആദരിക്കേണമേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: See, fire has fallen from heaven and consumed the first two captains and all their men. But now have respect for my life!"
chapters.nkjv: Look, fire has come down from heaven and burned up the first two captains of fifties with their fifties. But let my life now be precious in your sight."
chapters.kjv: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ ഏലീയാവോടു: ഇവനോടുകൂടെ പോക; അവനെ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവനോടുകൂടെ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: The angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So Elijah got up and went down with him to the king.
chapters.nkjv: And the angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So he arose and went down with him to the king.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ യിസ്രായേലിൽ ദൈവം ഇല്ലാഞ്ഞിട്ടോ നീ എക്രോനിലെ ദേവനായ ബാൽസെബൂബിനോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചതു? ഇതുനിമിത്തം നീ കയറിയിരിക്കുന്ന കട്ടിലിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങാതെ നിശ്ചയമായി മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: He told the king, "This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel for you to consult that you have sent messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Because you have done this, you will never leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!"
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, isit because thereis no God in Israel to inquire of His word? Therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’ "
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു പറഞ്ഞ യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം തന്നേ അവൻ മരിച്ചു പോയി; അവന്നു മകനില്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു പകരം യെഹോരാം യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോരാമിന്റെ രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: So he died, according to the word of the Lord that Elijah had spoken. Because Ahaziah had no son, Joram succeeded him as king in the second year of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: So Ahaziah died according to the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken. Because he had no son, Jehoram became king in his place, in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.
chapters.kjv: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.

chapters.ml: അഹസ്യാവു ചെയ്ത മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for all the other events of Ahaziah’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഏലീയാവെ ചുഴലിക്കാറ്റിൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കു എടുത്തുകൊൾവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഏലീയാവു എലീശയോടു കൂടെ ഗിൽഗാലിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the Lord was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when the Lord was about to take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു എലീശയോടു: നീ ഇവിടെ താമസിച്ചു കൊൾക: യഹോവ എന്നെ ബേഥേലിലേക്കു അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എലീശാ അവനോടു: യഹോവയാണ, നിന്റെ ജീവനാണ, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വിടുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ ബേഥേലിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here; the Lord has sent me to Bethel." But Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went down to Bethel.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here, please, for the Lord has sent me on to Bethel." But Elisha said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you!" So they went down to Bethel.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Beth-el. And Elisha said unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Beth-el.

chapters.ml: ബേഥേലിലെ പ്രവാചകശിഷ്യന്മാർ എലീശയുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തുവന്നു അവനോടു: യഹോവ ഇന്നു നിന്റെ യജമാനനെ നിന്റെ തലെക്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തുകൊള്ളും എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: അതേ, ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ മിണ്ടാതിരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The company of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and asked, "Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?" "Yes, I know," Elisha replied, "so be quiet."
chapters.nkjv: Now the sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, "Do you know that the Lord will take away your master from over you today?" And he said, "Yes, I know; keep silent!"
chapters.kjv: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth-el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു അവനോടു: എലീശയേ, നീ ഇവിടെ താമസിച്ചുകൊൾക; യഹോവ എന്നെ യെരീഹോവിലേക്കു അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: യഹോവയാണ, നിന്റെ ജീവനാണ, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വിടുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ യെരീഹോവിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here, Elisha; the Lord has sent me to Jericho." And he replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went to Jericho.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elijah said to him, "Elisha, stay here, please, for the Lord has sent me on to Jericho." But he said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you!" So they came to Jericho.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

chapters.ml: യെരീഹോവിലെ പ്രവാചകശിഷ്യന്മാർ എലീശയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: യഹോവ ഇന്നു നിന്റെ യജമാനനെ നിന്റെ തലെക്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തുകൊള്ളും എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു; അതിന്നു അവൻ: അതേ, ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ മിണ്ടാതിരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The company of the prophets at Jericho went up to Elisha and asked him, "Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?" "Yes, I know," he replied, "so be quiet."
chapters.nkjv: Now the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came to Elisha and said to him, "Do you know that the Lord will take away your master from over you today?" So he answered, "Yes, I know; keep silent!"
chapters.kjv: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവു അവനോടു: നീ ഇവിടെ താമസിച്ചുകൊൾക; യഹോവ എന്നെ യോർദ്ദാങ്കലേക്കു അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതിന്നു അവൻ യഹോവയാണ, നിന്റെ ജീവനാണ, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വിടുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഇരുവരുംകൂടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here; the Lord has sent me to the Jordan." And he replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So the two of them walked on.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here, please, for the Lord has sent me on to the Jordan." But he said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you!" So the two of them went on.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.

chapters.ml: പ്രവാചകശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ അമ്പതുപേർ ചെന്നു അവർക്കെതിരെ ദൂരത്തു നിന്നു; അവർ ഇരുവരും യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Fifty men from the company of the prophets went and stood at a distance, facing the place where Elijah and Elisha had stopped at the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood facing them at a distance, while the two of them stood by the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഏലീയാവു തന്റെ പുതപ്പു എടുത്തു മടക്കി വെള്ളത്തെ അടിച്ചു; അതു അങ്ങോട്ടും ഇങ്ങോട്ടും പിരിഞ്ഞു; അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഇരുവരും ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടി അക്കരെക്കു കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up and struck the water with it. The water divided to the right and to the left, and the two of them crossed over on dry ground.
chapters.nkjv: Now Elijah took his mantle, rolled it up, and struck the water; and it was divided this way and that, so that the two of them crossed over on dry ground.
chapters.kjv: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

chapters.ml: അവർ അക്കരെ കടന്നശേഷം ഏലീയാവു എലീശയോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തുകൊള്ളപ്പെടുംമുമ്പെ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു എന്തു ചെയ്തു തരേണം? ചോദിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു എലീശാ: നിന്റെ ആത്മാവിൽ ഇരട്ടി പങ്കു എന്റെമേൽ വരുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, "Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken from you?" "Let me inherit a double portion of your spirit," Elisha replied.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when they had crossed over, that Elijah said to Elisha, "Ask! What may I do for you, before I am taken away from you?" Elisha said, "Please let a double portion of your spirit be upon me."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നീ പ്രയാസമുള്ള കാര്യമാകുന്നു ചോദിച്ചതു; ഞാൻ നിങ്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തുകൊള്ളപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ നീ എന്നെ കാണുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ നിനക്കു അങ്ങനെ ഉണ്ടാകും; അല്ലെന്നുവരികിൽ ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You have asked a difficult thing," Elijah said, "yet if you see me when I am taken from you, it will be yours—otherwise, it will not."
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "You have asked a hard thing. Nevertheless, if you see me whenIam taken from you, it shall be so for you; but if not, it shall not be so."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless , if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so .

chapters.ml: അവർ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നടക്കുമ്പോൾ അഗ്നിരഥവും അഗ്ന്യശ്വങ്ങളും വന്നു അവരെ തമ്മിൽ വേർപിരിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ ഏലീയാവു ചുഴലിക്കാറ്റിൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കു കയറി.
chapters.niv: As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them, and Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, as they continued on and talked, that suddenly a chariot of fire appeared with horses of fire, and separated the two of them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

chapters.ml: എലീശാ അതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: എന്റെ പിതാവേ, എന്റെ പിതാവേ, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ തേരും തേരാളികളും എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു, പിന്നെ അവനെ കണ്ടില്ല; അപ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം പിടിച്ചു രണ്ടു ഖണ്ഡമായി കീറിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elisha saw this and cried out, "My father! My father! The chariots and horsemen of Israel!" And Elisha saw him no more. Then he took hold of his garment and tore it in two.
chapters.nkjv: And Elisha saw it, and he cried out, "My father, my father, the chariot of Israel and its horsemen!" So he saw him no more. And he took hold of his own clothes and tore them into two pieces.
chapters.kjv: And Elisha saw it , and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ഏലീയാവിന്മേൽനിന്നു വീണ പുതപ്പു എടുത്തു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Elisha then picked up Elijah’s cloak that had fallen from him and went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: He also took up the mantle of Elijah that had fallen from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

chapters.ml: ഏലീയാവിന്മേൽനിന്നു വീണ പുതപ്പുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ വെള്ളത്തെ അടിച്ചു: ഏലീയാവിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ എവിടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ വെള്ളത്തെ അടിച്ചപ്പോൾ അതു അങ്ങോട്ടും ഇങ്ങോട്ടും പിരിഞ്ഞു. എലീശാ ഇക്കരെക്കു കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He took the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and struck the water with it. "Where now is the Lord , the God of Elijah?" he asked. When he struck the water, it divided to the right and to the left, and he crossed over.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took the mantle of Elijah that had fallen from him, and struck the water, and said, "Where is the Lord God of Elijah?" And when he also had struck the water, it was divided this way and that; and Elisha crossed over.
chapters.kjv: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

chapters.ml: യെരീഹോവിൽ അവന്നെതിരെ നിന്നിരുന്നു പ്രവാചകശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഏലീയാവിന്റെ ആത്മാവു എലീശയുടെ മേൽ അധിവസിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു.
chapters.niv: The company of the prophets from Jericho, who were watching, said, "The spirit of Elijah is resting on Elisha." And they went to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the sons of the prophets who were from Jericho saw him, they said, "The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha." And they came to meet him, and bowed to the ground before him.
chapters.kjv: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഇതാ, അടിയങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ അമ്പതു ബലശാലികൾ ഉണ്ടു; അവർ ചെന്നു നിന്റെ യജമാനനെ അന്വേഷിക്കട്ടെ; പക്ഷേ യഹോവയുടെ ആത്മാവു അവനെ എടുത്തു വല്ല മലയിലോ താഴ്വരയിലോ എങ്ങാനും ഇട്ടിട്ടുണ്ടായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: നിങ്ങൾ അയക്കരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Look," they said, "we your servants have fifty able men. Let them go and look for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the Lord has picked him up and set him down on some mountain or in some valley." "No," Elisha replied, "do not send them."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to him, "Look now, there are fifty strong men with your servants. Please let them go and search for your master, lest perhaps the Spirit of the Lord has taken him up and cast him upon some mountain or into some valley." And he said, "You shall not send anyone."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ അത്യന്തം നിർബ്ബന്ധിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ: എന്നാൽ അയച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അമ്പതുപേരെ അയച്ചു; അവർ മൂന്നുദിവസം അന്വേഷിച്ചിട്ടും അവനെ കണ്ടെത്തിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But they persisted until he was too embarrassed to refuse. So he said, "Send them." And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find him.
chapters.nkjv: But when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, "Send them!" Therefore they sent fifty men, and they searched for three days but did not find him.
chapters.kjv: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരീഹോവിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നു; അവൻ അവരോടു: പോകരുതു എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞില്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, "Didn’t I tell you not to go?"
chapters.nkjv: And when they came back to him, for he had stayed in Jericho, he said to them, "Did I not say to you, ‘Do not go’?"
chapters.kjv: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ആ പട്ടണക്കാർ എലീശയോടു: ഈ പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ ഇരിപ്പു മനോഹരമായതെന്നു യജമാനൻ കാണുന്നുവല്ലോ; എന്നാൽ വെള്ളം ചീത്തയും ദേശം ഗർഭനാശകവും ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The people of the city said to Elisha, "Look, our lord, this town is well situated, as you can see, but the water is bad and the land is unproductive."
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of the city said to Elisha, "Please notice, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the ground barren."
chapters.kjv: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഒരു പുതിയ തളിക കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അതിൽ ഉപ്പു ഇടുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അതു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Bring me a new bowl," he said, "and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Bring me a new bowl, and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നീരുറവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അതിൽ ഉപ്പു ഇട്ടു. ഞാൻ ഈ വെള്ളം പഥ്യമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇനി ഇതിനാൽ മരണവും ഗർഭനാശവും ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he went out to the spring and threw the salt into it, saying, "This is what the Lord says: ‘I have healed this water. Never again will it cause death or make the land unproductive.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then he went out to the source of the water, and cast in the salt there, and said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘I have healed this water; from it there shall be no more death or barrenness.’ "
chapters.kjv: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD , I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .

chapters.ml: എലീശാ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ആ വെള്ളം ഇന്നുവരെ പഥ്യമായിത്തന്നേ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the water has remained pure to this day, according to the word Elisha had spoken.
chapters.nkjv: So the water remains healed to this day, according to the word of Elisha which he spoke.
chapters.kjv: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവിടെനിന്നു ബേഥേലിലേക്കു പോയി; അവൻ വഴിയിൽ നടക്കുമ്പോൾ ബാലന്മാർ പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു വന്നു അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു അവനോടു: മൊട്ടത്തലയാ, കയറി വാ; മൊട്ടത്തലയാ, കയറി വാ; എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: From there Elisha went up to Bethel. As he was walking along the road, some boys came out of the town and jeered at him. "Get out of here, baldy!" they said. "Get out of here, baldy!"
chapters.nkjv: Then he went up from there to Bethel; and as he was going up the road, some youths came from the city and mocked him, and said to him, "Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!"
chapters.kjv: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നോക്കം തിരിഞ്ഞു അവനെ നോക്കി യഹോവനാമത്തിൽ അവരെ ശപിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ കാട്ടിൽനിന്നു രണ്ടു പെൺകരടി ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു അവരിൽ നാല്പത്തിരണ്ടു ബാലന്മാരെ കീറിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He turned around, looked at them and called down a curse on them in the name of the Lord . Then two bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.
chapters.nkjv: So he turned around and looked at them, and pronounced a curse on them in the name of the Lord. And two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the youths.
chapters.kjv: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടംവിട്ടു കർമ്മേൽപർവ്വതത്തിലേക്കു പോയി; അവിടെനിന്നു ശമർയ്യയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he went on to Mount Carmel and from there returned to Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: Then he went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ പതിനെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ ആഹാബിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോരാം ശമർയ്യയിൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി; അവൻ പന്ത്രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned twelve years.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab became king over Israel at Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
chapters.kjv: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായതു ചെയ്തു; തന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയേയും പോലെ അല്ലതാനും; തന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ബാൽവിഗ്രഹം അവൻ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father and mother had done. He got rid of the sacred stone of Baal that his father had made.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, but not like his father and mother; for he put away the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had made.
chapters.kjv: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD ; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

chapters.ml: എന്നാലും യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ അവൻ വിട്ടുമാറാതെ മുറുകെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless he clung to the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless he persisted in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin; he did not depart from them.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

chapters.ml: മോവാബ് രാജാവായ മേശെക്കു അനവധി ആടുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിന്നു ഒരു ലക്ഷം കുഞ്ഞാടുകളുടെയും ഒരു ലക്ഷം ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരുടെയും രോമം കൊടുത്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Mesha king of Moab raised sheep, and he had to pay the king of Israel a tribute of a hundred thousand lambs and the wool of a hundred thousand rams.
chapters.nkjv: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheepbreeder, and he regularly paid the king of Israel one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
chapters.kjv: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആഹാബ് മരിച്ചശേഷം മോവാബ് രാജാവു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But after Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: But it happened, when Ahab died, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യെഹോരാം രാജാവു ശമർയ്യയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഒക്കെയും എണ്ണിനോക്കി.
chapters.niv: So at that time King Joram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time and mustered all Israel.
chapters.kjv: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ: മോവാബ്‌രാജാവു എന്നോടു മത്സരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; മോവാബ്യരോടു യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു നീ കൂടെ പോരുമോ എന്നു യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിനോടു ആളയച്ചു ചോദിപ്പിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞാൻ പോരാം; നീയും ഞാനും എന്റെ ജനവും നിന്റെ ജനവും എന്റെ കുതിരകളും നിന്റെ കുതിരകളും ഒരുപോലെയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He also sent this message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah: "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?" "I will go with you," he replied. "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
chapters.nkjv: Then he went and sent to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, saying, "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?" And he said, "I will go up; I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
chapters.kjv: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art , my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.

chapters.ml: നാം ഏതു വഴിയായി പോകേണം എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: എദോംമരുഭൂമിവഴിയായി തന്നേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "By what route shall we attack?" he asked. "Through the Desert of Edom," he answered.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Which way shall we go up?" And he answered, "By way of the Wilderness of Edom."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു യെഹൂദാരാജാവും എദോംരാജാവുമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവർ ഏഴു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി ചുറ്റിനടന്നശേഷം അവരോടുകൂടെയുള്ള സൈന്യത്തിന്നും മൃഗങ്ങൾക്കും വെള്ളം കിട്ടാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: So the king of Israel set out with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. After a roundabout march of seven days, the army had no more water for themselves or for the animals with them.
chapters.nkjv: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched on that roundabout route seven days; and there was no water for the army, nor for the animals that followed them.
chapters.kjv: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days’ journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു: അയ്യോ, ഈ മൂന്നു രാജാക്കന്മാരെയും യഹോവ വിളിച്ചുവരുത്തിയതു അവരെ മോവാബ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What!" exclaimed the king of Israel. "Has the Lord called us three kings together only to deliver us into the hands of Moab?"
chapters.nkjv: And the king of Israel said, "Alas! For the Lord has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab."
chapters.kjv: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോശാഫാത്ത്: നാം യഹോവയോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ പ്രവാചകൻ ആരുമില്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാവിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ: ഏലീയാവിന്റെ കൈക്കു വെള്ളം ഒഴിച്ച ശാഫാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ എലീശാ ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no prophet of the Lord here, through whom we may inquire of the Lord ?" An officer of the king of Israel answered, "Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah. "
chapters.nkjv: But Jehoshaphat said, "Isthere no prophet of the Lord here, that we may inquire of the Lord by him?" So one of the servants of the king of Israel answered and said, "Elisha the son of Shaphat is here, who poured water on the hands of Elijah."
chapters.kjv: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD , that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel’s servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പക്കൽ യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടു എന്നു യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവും യെഹോശാഫാത്തും എദോംരാജാവും കൂടെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
chapters.nkjv: And Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

chapters.ml: എലീശാ യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാവിനോടു: എനിക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? നീ നിന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കലും നിന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കലും ചെല്ലുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവു അവനോടു: അങ്ങനെയല്ല; ഈ മൂന്നു രാജാക്കന്മാരെയും മോവാബ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ അവരെ വിളിച്ചുവരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Elisha said to the king of Israel, "Why do you want to involve me? Go to the prophets of your father and the prophets of your mother." "No," the king of Israel answered, "because it was the Lord who called us three kings together to deliver us into the hands of Moab."
chapters.nkjv: Then Elisha said to the king of Israel, "What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father and the prophets of your mother." But the king of Israel said to him, "No, for the Lord has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab."
chapters.kjv: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു എലീശാ: ഞാൻ സേവിച്ചുനില്ക്കുന്ന സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവയാണ, യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ മുഖം ഞാൻ ആദരിച്ചില്ല എങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ നോക്കുകയോ കടാക്ഷിക്കയോ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, if I did not have respect for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not pay any attention to you.
chapters.nkjv: And Elisha said, "As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, surely were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you, nor see you.
chapters.kjv: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഒരു വീണക്കാരനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. വീണക്കാരൻ വായിക്കുമ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ കൈ അവന്റെമേൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: But now bring me a harpist." While the harpist was playing, the hand of the Lord came on Elisha
chapters.nkjv: But now bring me a musician." Then it happened, when the musician played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.
chapters.kjv: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഈ താഴ്വരയിൽ അനേകം കുഴികൾ വെട്ടുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: and he said, "This is what the Lord says: I will fill this valley with pools of water.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Make this valley full of ditches.’
chapters.kjv: And he said, Thus saith the LORD , Make this valley full of ditches.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ കാറ്റു കാണുകയില്ല, മഴയും കാണുകയില്ല; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളും നിങ്ങളുടെ ആടുമാടുകളും നിങ്ങളുടെ മൃഗവാഹനങ്ങളും കുടിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം ഈ താഴ്വര വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടു നിറയും.
chapters.niv: For this is what the Lord says: You will see neither wind nor rain, yet this valley will be filled with water, and you, your cattle and your other animals will drink.
chapters.nkjv: For thus says the Lord: ‘You shall not see wind, nor shall you see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, so that you, your cattle, and your animals may drink.’
chapters.kjv: For thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പോരാ എന്നു യഹോവെക്കു തോന്നീട്ടു അവൻ മോവാബ്യരെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുതരും.
chapters.niv: This is an easy thing in the eyes of the Lord ; he will also deliver Moab into your hands.
chapters.nkjv: And this is a simple matter in the sight of the Lord; He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
chapters.kjv: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളും ശ്രേഷ്ഠനഗരങ്ങളുമെല്ലാം ജയിച്ചടക്കുകയും നല്ലവൃക്ഷങ്ങളെല്ലാം മുറിക്കയും നീരുറവുകളെല്ലാം അടെച്ചുകളകയും നല്ല നിലങ്ങളെല്ലാം കല്ലുവാരിയിട്ടു ചീത്തയാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: You will overthrow every fortified city and every major town. You will cut down every good tree, stop up all the springs, and ruin every good field with stones."
chapters.nkjv: Also you shall attack every fortified city and every choice city, and shall cut down every good tree, and stop up every spring of water, and ruin every good piece of land with stones."
chapters.kjv: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ രാവിലെ ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്റെ സമയത്തു വെള്ളം എദോംവഴിയായി വരുന്നതുകണ്ടു; ദേശം വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The next morning, about the time for offering the sacrifice, there it was—water flowing from the direction of Edom! And the land was filled with water.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened in the morning, when the grain offering was offered, that suddenly water came by way of Edom, and the land was filled with water.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഈ രാജാക്കന്മാർ തങ്ങളോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു എന്നു മോവാബ്യരൊക്കെയും കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ ആയുധം ധരിപ്പാൻ തക്ക പ്രായത്തിലും മേലോട്ടുമുള്ളവരെ വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി അതിരിങ്കൽ ചെന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come to fight against them; so every man, young and old, who could bear arms was called up and stationed on the border.
chapters.nkjv: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, all who were able to bear arms and older were gathered; and they stood at the border.
chapters.kjv: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ അവർ എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ സൂര്യൻ വെള്ളത്തിന്മേൽ ഉദിച്ചിട്ടു മോവാബ്യർക്കു തങ്ങളുടെ നേരെയുള്ള വെള്ളം രക്തംപോലെ ചുവപ്പായി തോന്നി:
chapters.niv: When they got up early in the morning, the sun was shining on the water. To the Moabites across the way, the water looked red—like blood.
chapters.nkjv: Then they rose up early in the morning, and the sun was shining on the water; and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood.
chapters.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

chapters.ml: അതു രക്തമാകുന്നു; ആ രാജാക്കന്മാർ തമ്മിൽ പൊരുതു അന്യോന്യം സംഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; ആകയാൽ മോവാബ്യരേ, കൊള്ളെക്കു വരുവിൻ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "That’s blood!" they said. "Those kings must have fought and slaughtered each other. Now to the plunder, Moab!"
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "This is blood; the kings have surely struck swords and have killed one another; now therefore, Moab, to the spoil!"
chapters.kjv: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

chapters.ml: അവർ യിസ്രായേൽപാളയത്തിങ്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേല്യർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു മോവാബ്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചോടിച്ചു; അവർ ദേശത്തിൽ കടന്നുചെന്നു മോവാബ്യരെ പിന്നെയും തോല്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and fought them until they fled. And the Israelites invaded the land and slaughtered the Moabites.
chapters.nkjv: So when they came to the camp of Israel, Israel rose up and attacked the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they entered their land, killing the Moabites.
chapters.kjv: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണങ്ങളെ അവർ ഇടിച്ചു നല്ലനിലമൊക്കെയും ഓരോരുത്തൻ ഓരോ കല്ലു ഇട്ടു നികത്തി നീരുറവുകളെല്ലാം അടെച്ചു നല്ലവൃക്ഷങ്ങളെല്ലാം മുറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; കീർഹരേശെത്തിൽ മാത്രം അവർ അതിന്റെ കല്ലു അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ വിട്ടേച്ചു. എന്നാൽ കവിണക്കാർ അതിനെ വളഞ്ഞു നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They destroyed the towns, and each man threw a stone on every good field until it was covered. They stopped up all the springs and cut down every good tree. Only Kir Hareseth was left with its stones in place, but men armed with slings surrounded it and attacked it.
chapters.nkjv: Then they destroyed the cities, and each man threw a stone on every good piece of land and filled it; and they stopped up all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees. But they left the stones of Kir Haraseth intact. However the slingers surrounded and attacked it.
chapters.kjv: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir-haraseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it.

chapters.ml: മോവാബ്‌രാജാവു പട തനിക്കു അതിവിഷമമായി എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ എദോംരാജാവിനെ അണിമുറിച്ചാക്രമിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എഴുനൂറു ആയുധ പാണികളെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു; എങ്കിലും സാധിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: When the king of Moab saw that the battle had gone against him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through to the king of Edom, but they failed.
chapters.nkjv: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too fierce for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew swords, to break through to the king of Edom, but they could not.
chapters.kjv: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവൻ തന്റെ ശേഷം വാഴുവാനുള്ള ആദ്യജാതനെ പിടിച്ചു മതിലിന്മേൽ ദഹനയാഗം കഴിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേല്യരുടെമേൽ മഹാകോപം വന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ അവനെ വിട്ടു സ്വദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he took his firstborn son, who was to succeed him as king, and offered him as a sacrifice on the city wall. The fury against Israel was great; they withdrew and returned to their own land.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took his eldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him as a burnt offering upon the wall; and there was great indignation against Israel. So they departed from him and returned to theirown land.
chapters.kjv: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

chapters.ml: പ്രവാചകശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ ഭാര്യമാരിൽ ഒരുത്തി എലീശയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു: നിന്റെ ദാസനായ എന്റെ ഭർത്താവു മരിച്ചുപോയി; നിന്റെ ദാസൻ യഹോവാഭക്തനായിരുന്നു എന്നു നിനക്കറിയാമല്ലോ; ഇപ്പോൾ കടക്കാരൻ എന്റെ രണ്ടു മക്കളെ പിടിച്ചു അടിമകളാക്കുവാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The wife of a man from the company of the prophets cried out to Elisha, "Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that he revered the Lord . But now his creditor is coming to take my two boys as his slaves."
chapters.nkjv: A certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, "Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that your servant feared the Lord. And the creditor is coming to take my two sons to be his slaves."
chapters.kjv: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD : and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

chapters.ml: എലീശ അവളോടു: ഞാൻ നിനക്കു വേണ്ടി എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം? പറക; വീട്ടിൽ നിനക്കു എന്തുള്ളു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. ഒരു ഭരണി എണ്ണയല്ലാതെ അടിയന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ മറ്റൊന്നും ഇല്ല എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elisha replied to her, "How can I help you? Tell me, what do you have in your house?" "Your servant has nothing there at all," she said, "except a small jar of olive oil."
chapters.nkjv: So Elisha said to her, "What shall I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?" And she said, "Your maidservant has nothing in the house but a jar of oil."
chapters.kjv: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നീ ചെന്നു നിന്റെ അയൽക്കാരോടൊക്കെയും വെറുമ്പാത്രങ്ങൾ വായ്പ വാങ്ങുക; പാത്രങ്ങൾ കുറവായിരിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Elisha said, "Go around and ask all your neighbors for empty jars. Don’t ask for just a few.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Go, borrow vessels from everywhere, from all your neighbors—empty vessels; do not gather just a few.
chapters.kjv: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ നീയും നിന്റെ മക്കളും അകത്തു കയറി വാതിൽ അടെച്ചു പാത്രങ്ങളിലൊക്കെയും പകർന്നു, നിറഞ്ഞതു നിറഞ്ഞതു ഒരു ഭാഗത്തുമാറ്റിവെക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then go inside and shut the door behind you and your sons. Pour oil into all the jars, and as each is filled, put it to one side."
chapters.nkjv: And when you have come in, you shall shut the door behind you and your sons; then pour it into all those vessels, and set aside the full ones."
chapters.kjv: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനെ വിട്ടു ചെന്നു തന്റെ മക്കളോടുകൂടെ അകത്തു കടന്നു വാതിൽ അടെച്ചു; അവർ അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ പാത്രങ്ങളെ വെച്ചുകൊടുക്കയും അവൾ പകരുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: She left him and shut the door behind her and her sons. They brought the jars to her and she kept pouring.
chapters.nkjv: So she went from him and shut the door behind her and her sons, who brought thevessels to her; and she poured it out.
chapters.kjv: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

chapters.ml: പാത്രങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞശേഷം അവൾ തന്റെ മകനോടു: ഇനിയും പാത്രം കൊണ്ടുവരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവളോടു: പാത്രം ഒന്നും ഇല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ എണ്ണ നിന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When all the jars were full, she said to her son, "Bring me another one." But he replied, "There is not a jar left." Then the oil stopped flowing.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said to her son, "Bring me another vessel." And he said to her, "Thereis not another vessel." So the oil ceased.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ചെന്നു ദൈവപുരുഷനോടു വസ്തുത അറിയിച്ചു. നീ പോയി എണ്ണ വിറ്റു കടം വീട്ടി ശേഷിപ്പുകൊണ്ടു നീയും മക്കളും ഉപജീവനും കഴിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She went and told the man of God, and he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debts. You and your sons can live on what is left."
chapters.nkjv: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest."
chapters.kjv: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദിവസം എലീശാ ശൂനേമിലേക്കു പോയി; അവിടെ ധനികയായോരു സ്ത്രി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൾ അവനെ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നു വരേണം എന്നു നിർബ്ബന്ധിച്ചു. പിന്നെത്തേതിൽ അവൻ ആ വഴി പോകുമ്പോഴൊക്കെയും ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നു അവിടെ കയറും.
chapters.niv: One day Elisha went to Shunem. And a well-to-do woman was there, who urged him to stay for a meal. So whenever he came by, he stopped there to eat.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened one day that Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a notable woman, and she persuaded him to eat some food. So it was, as often as he passed by, he would turn in there to eat some food.
chapters.kjv: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

chapters.ml: അവൾ തന്റെ ഭർത്താവിനോടു: നമ്മുടെ വഴിയായി കൂടക്കൂടെ കടന്നുപോകുന്ന ഈയാൾ വിശുദ്ധനായോരു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: She said to her husband, "I know that this man who often comes our way is a holy man of God.
chapters.nkjv: And she said to her husband, "Look now, I know that this is a holy man of God, who passes by us regularly.
chapters.kjv: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

chapters.ml: നാം ചുവരോടുകൂടിയ ചെറിയോരു മാളികമുറി പണിതുണ്ടാക്കുക; അതിൽ അവന്നു ഒരു കട്ടിലും ഒരു മേശയും ഒരു നാൽക്കാലിയും ഒരു നിലവിളക്കും വെക്കുക; അവൻ നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ വരുമ്പോൾ അവന്നു അവിടെ കയറി പാർക്കാമല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Let’s make a small room on the roof and put in it a bed and a table, a chair and a lamp for him. Then he can stay there whenever he comes to us."
chapters.nkjv: Please, let us make a small upper room on the wall; and let us put a bed for him there, and a table and a chair and a lampstand; so it will be, whenever he comes to us, he can turn in there."
chapters.kjv: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഒരു ദിവസം അവൻ അവിടെ വരുവാൻ ഇടയായി; അവൻ ആ മാളികമുറിയിൽ കയറി അവിടെ കിടന്നുറങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: One day when Elisha came, he went up to his room and lay down there.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened one day that he came there, and he turned in to the upper room and lay down there.
chapters.kjv: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരനായ ഗേഹസിയോടു: ശൂനേംകാരത്തിയെ വിളിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവളെ വിളിച്ചു. അവൾ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said to his servant Gehazi, "Call the Shunammite." So he called her, and she stood before him.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to Gehazi his servant, "Call this Shunammite woman." When he had called her, she stood before him.
chapters.kjv: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: നീ ഇത്ര താല്പര്യത്തോടെയൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി കരുതിയല്ലോ? നിനക്കു വേണ്ടി എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം? രാജാവിനോടോ സേനാധിപതിയോടോ നിനക്കു വേണ്ടി വല്ലതും പറയേണ്ടതുണ്ടോ എന്നു നീ അവളോടു ചോദിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അവൾ: ഞാൻ സ്വജനത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യേ വസിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elisha said to him, "Tell her, ‘You have gone to all this trouble for us. Now what can be done for you? Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army?’ " She replied, "I have a home among my own people."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to him, "Say now to her, ‘Look, you have been concerned for us with all this care. What canI do for you? Do you want me to speak on your behalf to the king or to the commander of the army?’ " She answered, "I dwell among my own people."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൾക്കു വേണ്ടി എന്തുചെയ്യാമെന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ഗേഹസി: അവൾക്കു മകനില്ലല്ലോ; അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവു വൃദ്ധനും ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What can be done for her?" Elisha asked. Gehazi said, "She has no son, and her husband is old."
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "What then is to be done for her?" And Gehazi answered, "Actually, she has no son, and her husband is old."
chapters.kjv: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

chapters.ml: അവളെ വിളിക്ക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവളെ വിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൾ വാതിൽക്കൽ വന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Elisha said, "Call her." So he called her, and she stood in the doorway.
chapters.nkjv: So he said, "Call her." When he had called her, she stood in the doorway.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: വരുന്ന ആണ്ടിൽ ഈ സമയമാകുമ്പോഴേക്കു നീ ഒരു മകനെ അണെച്ചുകൊള്ളും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു അവൾ: അല്ല, ദൈവപുരുഷനായ എന്റെ യജമാനനേ, അടിയനോടു ഭോഷ്കു പറയരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "About this time next year," Elisha said, "you will hold a son in your arms." "No, my lord!" she objected. "Please, man of God, don’t mislead your servant!"
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "About this time next year you shall embrace a son." And she said, "No, my lord. Man of God, do not lie to your maidservant!"
chapters.kjv: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ത്രീ ഗർഭംധരിച്ചു പിറ്റെ ആണ്ടിൽ എലീശാ അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞ സമയത്തു തന്നേ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the woman became pregnant, and the next year about that same time she gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had told her.
chapters.nkjv: But the woman conceived, and bore a son when the appointed time had come, of which Elisha had told her.
chapters.kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

chapters.ml: ബാലൻ വളർന്നപ്പോൾ ഒരു ദിവസം അവൻ കൊയ്ത്തുകാരോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്ന തന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: The child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the reapers.
chapters.nkjv: And the child grew. Now it happened one day that he went out to his father, to the reapers.
chapters.kjv: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അപ്പനോടു: എന്റെ തല, എന്റെ തല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരനോടു: ഇവനെ എടുത്തു അമ്മയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to his father, "My head! My head!" His father told a servant, "Carry him to his mother."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to his father, "My head, my head!" So he said to a servant, "Carry him to his mother."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനെ എടുത്തു അവന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ അടുക്കൽ കെണ്ടുചെന്നു; അവൻ ഉച്ചവരെ അവളുടെ മടിയിൽ ഇരുന്നശേഷം മരിച്ചുപോയി.
