chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു സ്ത്രീയോടു ചോദിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവളും അതു വിവരിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു രാജാവു ഒരു ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥനെ നിയമിച്ചു: അവൾക്കുണ്ടായിരുന്നതൊക്കെയും അവൾ ദേശം വിട്ടുപോയ നാൾമുതൽ ഇതുവരെയുള്ള നിലത്തിന്റെ ആദായവും അവൾക്കു കൊടുപ്പിക്കേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king asked the woman about it, and she told him. Then he assigned an official to her case and said to him, "Give back everything that belonged to her, including all the income from her land from the day she left the country until now."
chapters.nkjv: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed a certain officer for her, saying, "Restore all that was hers, and all the proceeds of the field from the day that she left the land until now."
chapters.kjv: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം എലീശാ ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽ ചെന്നു; അന്നു അരാംരാജാവായ ബെൻ-ഹദദ് ദീനംപിടിച്ചു കിടക്കുകയായിരുന്നു; ദൈവപുരുഷൻ വന്നിട്ടുണ്ടു എന്നു അവന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Elisha went to Damascus, and Ben-Hadad king of Aram was ill. When the king was told, "The man of God has come all the way up here,"
chapters.nkjv: Then Elisha went to Damascus, and Ben-Hadad king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, "The man of God has come here."
chapters.kjv: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ഹസായേലിനോടു: ഒരു സമ്മാനം എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവപുരുഷനെ ചെന്നുകണ്ടു: ഈ ദീനം മാറി എനിക്കു സൌഖ്യം വരുമോ എന്നു അവൻ മുഖാന്തരം യഹോവയോടു ചോദിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he said to Hazael, "Take a gift with you and go to meet the man of God. Consult the Lord through him; ask him, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’ "
chapters.nkjv: And the king said to Hazael, "Take a present in your hand, and go to meet the man of God, and inquire of the Lord by him, saying, ‘Shall I recover from this disease?’ "
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഹസായേൽ ദമ്മേശെക്കിലെ വിശേഷവസ്തുക്കളിൽനിന്നൊക്കെയും എടുത്തു നാല്പതു ഒട്ടകച്ചുമടുമായി അവനെ ചെന്നുകണ്ടു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു: നിന്റെ മകൻ അരാം രാജാവായ ബെൻ-ഹദദ് എന്നെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു: ഈ ദീനം മാറി എനിക്കു സൌഖ്യം വരുമോ എന്നു ചോദിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു എലീശാ;
chapters.niv: Hazael went to meet Elisha, taking with him as a gift forty camel-loads of all the finest wares of Damascus. He went in and stood before him, and said, "Your son Ben-Hadad king of Aram has sent me to ask, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’ "
chapters.nkjv: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, of every good thing of Damascus, forty camel-loads; and he came and stood before him, and said, "Your son Ben-Hadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Shall I recover from this disease?’ "
chapters.kjv: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben-hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു അവനോടു: നിനക്കു നിശ്ചയമായിട്ടു സൌഖ്യം വരും എന്നു പറക; എന്നാൽ അവൻ നിശ്ചയമായി മരിച്ചുപോകുമെന്നു യഹോവ എനിക്കു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിത്തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Elisha answered, "Go and say to him, ‘You will certainly recover.’ Nevertheless, the Lord has revealed to me that he will in fact die."
chapters.nkjv: And Elisha said to him, "Go, say to him, ‘You shall certainly recover.’ However the Lord has shown me that he will really die."
chapters.kjv: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the LORD hath shewed me that he shall surely die.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവന്നു ലജ്ജ തോന്നുവോളം അവൻ കണ്ണുപറിക്കാതെ അവനെ ഉറ്റുനോക്കി ദൈവപുരുഷൻ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He stared at him with a fixed gaze until Hazael was embarrassed. Then the man of God began to weep.
chapters.nkjv: Then he set his countenance in a stare until he was ashamed; and the man of God wept.
chapters.kjv: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ കരയുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ഹസായേൽ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവൻ: നീ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളോടു ചെയ്‍വാനിരിക്കുന്ന ദോഷം ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ; നീ അവരുടെ ദുർഗ്ഗങ്ങളെ തീയിട്ടു ചുടുകയും അവരുടെ യൌവനക്കാരെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊല്ലുകയും അവരുടെ കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെ അടിച്ചു തകർക്കയും അവരുടെ ഗർഭിണികളെ പിളർക്കയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Why is my lord weeping?" asked Hazael. "Because I know the harm you will do to the Israelites," he answered. "You will set fire to their fortified places, kill their young men with the sword, dash their little children to the ground, and rip open their pregnant women."
chapters.nkjv: And Hazael said, "Why is my lord weeping?" He answered, "Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel: Their strongholds you will set on fire, and their young men you will kill with the sword; and you will dash their children, and rip open their women with child."
chapters.kjv: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

chapters.ml: ഈ മഹാകാര്യം ചെയ്‍വാൻ നായായിരിക്കുന്ന അടിയൻ എന്തു മാത്രമുള്ളു എന്നു ഹസായേൽ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു എലീശാ: നീ അരാമിൽ രാജാവാകും എന്നു യഹോവ എനിക്കു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിത്തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Hazael said, "How could your servant, a mere dog, accomplish such a feat?" "The Lord has shown me that you will become king of Aram," answered Elisha.
chapters.nkjv: So Hazael said, "But what is your servant—a dog, that he should do this gross thing?" And Elisha answered, "The Lord has shown me that you willbecome king over Syria."
chapters.kjv: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എലീശയെ വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു തന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ: എലീശാ നിന്നോടു എന്തു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു. നിനക്കു നിശ്ചയമായി സൌഖ്യം വരും എന്നു അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരംപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Hazael left Elisha and returned to his master. When Ben-Hadad asked, "What did Elisha say to you?" Hazael replied, "He told me that you would certainly recover."
chapters.nkjv: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, "What did Elisha say to you?" And he answered, "He told me you would surely recover."
chapters.kjv: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവൻ ഒരു കമ്പിളി എടുത്തു വെള്ളത്തിൽ മുക്കി അവന്റെ മുഖത്തിട്ടു; അതിനാൽ അവൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി; ഹസായേൽ അവന്നുപകരം രാജാവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the next day he took a thick cloth, soaked it in water and spread it over the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: But it happened on the next day that he took a thick cloth and dipped it in water, and spread it over his face so that he died; and Hazael reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ആഹാബിന്റെ മകനായ യോരാമിന്റെ അഞ്ചാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് യെഹൂദയിൽ രാജാവായിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ യെഹോരാം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the fifth year of Joram son of Ahab king of Israel, when Jehoshaphat was king of Judah, Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat began his reign as king of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab, king of Israel, Jehoshaphat havingbeen king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat began to reign as king of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു മുപ്പത്തിരണ്ടു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ എട്ടു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു.
chapters.niv: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
chapters.nkjv: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബിന്റെ മകൾ അവന്നു ഭാര്യയായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ആഹാബിന്റെ ഗൃഹം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വഴിയിൽ നടന്നു യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, just as the house of Ahab had done, for the daughter of Ahab was his wife; and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD .

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും യഹോവ തന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിനോടു അവന്നും അവന്റെ മക്കൾക്കും എന്നേക്കും ഒരു ദീപം നല്കും എന്നു വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്തിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ നിമിത്തം യെഹൂദയെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ തനിക്കു മനസ്സായില്ല.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, for the sake of his servant David, the Lord was not willing to destroy Judah. He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever.
chapters.nkjv: Yet the Lord would not destroy Judah, for the sake of His servant David, as He promised him to give a lamp to him and his sons forever.
chapters.kjv: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കാലത്തു എദോമ്യർ യെഹൂദയുടെ മേലധികാരത്തോടു മത്സരിച്ചു തങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു രാജാവിനെ വാഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.
chapters.nkjv: In his days Edom revolted against Judah’s authority, and made a king over themselves.
chapters.kjv: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹോരാം സകലരഥങ്ങളുമായി സായിരിലേക്കു ചെന്നു; എന്നാൽ രാത്രിയിൽ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു തന്നെ വളഞ്ഞിരുന്ന എദോമ്യരെയും രഥനായകന്മാരെയും തോല്പിച്ചു; ജനം തങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: So Jehoram went to Zair with all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but he rose up and broke through by night; his army, however, fled back home.
chapters.nkjv: So Joram went to Zair, and all his chariots with him. Then he rose by night and attacked the Edomites who had surrounded him and the captains of the chariots; and the troops fled to their tents.
chapters.kjv: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങിനെ എദോമ്യർ യെഹൂദയുടെ മേലധികാരത്തോടു ഇന്നുവരെ മത്സരിച്ചുനില്ക്കുന്നു; ആ കാലത്തു തന്നേ ലിബ്നയും മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Edom has been in revolt against Judah’s authority to this day. And Libnah revolted at that time.
chapters.kjv: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

chapters.ml: യെഹോരാമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാ രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Jehoram’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: യെഹോരാം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ അഹസ്യാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jehoram rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Joram rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David. Then Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ആഹാബിന്റെ മകൻ യോരാമിന്റെ പന്ത്രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോരാമിന്റെ മകൻ അഹസ്യാവു രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the twelfth year of Joram son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.nkjv: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab, king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, began to reign.
chapters.kjv: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.

chapters.ml: അഹസ്യാവു വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തിരണ്ടു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ഒരു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു അഥല്യാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ഒമ്രിയുടെ പൌത്രി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the granddaughter of Omri, king of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആഹാബ്ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ വഴിയിൽ നടന്നു ആഹാബ്ഗൃഹം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; അവൻ ആഹാബിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തോടു സംബന്ധമുള്ളവൻ ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: He followed the ways of the house of Ahab and did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as the house of Ahab had done, for he was related by marriage to Ahab’s family.
chapters.nkjv: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the Lord, like the house of Ahab, for he was the son-in-law of the house of Ahab.
chapters.kjv: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD , as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആഹാബിന്റെ മകനായ യോരാമിനോടുകൂടെ ഗിലെയാദിലെ രാമോത്തിലേക്കു അരാംരാജാവായ ഹസായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പോയി; എന്നാൽ അരാമ്യർ യോരാമിനെ മുറിവേല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;
chapters.nkjv: Now he went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
chapters.kjv: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

chapters.ml: അരാംരാജാവായ ഹസായേലിനോടുള്ള യുദ്ധത്തിൽ രാമയിൽവെച്ചു അരാമ്യർ തന്നെ വെട്ടിയ മുറിവുകൾക്കു യിസ്രെയേലിൽവെച്ചു ചികിത്സചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു യോരാംരാജാവു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി; ആഹാബിന്റെ മകനായ യോരാം രോഗിയാകകൊണ്ടു യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോരാമിന്റെ മകൻ അഹസ്യാവു യിസ്രെയേലിൽ അവനെ കാണ്മാൻ ചെന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: so King Joram returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds the Arameans had inflicted on him at Ramoth in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab, because he had been wounded.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Joram went back to Jezreel to recover from the wounds which the Syrians had inflicted on him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
chapters.kjv: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

chapters.ml: എലീശാപ്രവാചകൻ ഒരു പ്രവാചകശിഷ്യനെ വിളിച്ചു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ അരകെട്ടി ഈ തൈലപാത്രം എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു ഗിലെയാദിലെ രാമോത്തിലേക്കു പോക.
chapters.niv: The prophet Elisha summoned a man from the company of the prophets and said to him, "Tuck your cloak into your belt, take this flask of olive oil with you and go to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: And Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, "Get yourself ready, take this flask of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:

chapters.ml: അവിടെ എത്തിയശേഷം നിംശിയുടെ മകനായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ യേഹൂ എവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നോക്കി അകത്തു ചെന്നു അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു അവനെ എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു ഉൾമുറിയിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോക.
chapters.niv: When you get there, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. Go to him, get him away from his companions and take him into an inner room.
chapters.nkjv: Now when you arrive at that place, look there for Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his associates, and take him to an inner room.
chapters.kjv: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ തൈലപാത്രം എടുത്തു അവന്റെ തലയിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു വാതിൽ തുറന്നു താമസിക്കാതെ ഓടിപ്പോരിക.
chapters.niv: Then take the flask and pour the oil on his head and declare, ‘This is what the Lord says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the door and run; don’t delay!"
chapters.nkjv: Then take the flask of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: "I have anointed you king over Israel." ’ Then open the door and flee, and do not delay."
chapters.kjv: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD , I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പ്രവാചകനായ ആ യൌവനക്കാരൻ ഗിലെയാദിലെ രാമോത്തിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: So the young prophet went to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: So the young man, the servant of the prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.kjv: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ പടനായകന്മാർ മരുമിച്ചു ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു: നായകാ, എനിക്കു നിന്നോടു ഒരു കാര്യം അറിയിപ്പാനുണ്ടു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരിലുംവെച്ചു ആരോടു എന്നു യേഹൂ ചോദിച്ചു. നിന്നോടു തന്നേ, നായകാ എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he arrived, he found the army officers sitting together. "I have a message for you, commander," he said. "For which of us?" asked Jehu. "For you, commander," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: And when he arrived, there were the captains of the army sitting; and he said, "I have a message for you, Commander." Jehu said, "For which one of us?" And he said, "For you, Commander."
chapters.kjv: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു മുറിക്കകത്തു കടന്നു; അപ്പോൾ അവൻ തൈലം അവന്റെ തലയിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ യഹോവയുടെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jehu got up and went into the house. Then the prophet poured the oil on Jehu’s head and declared, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I anoint you king over the Lord ’s people Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Then he arose and went into the house. And he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘I have anointed you king over the people of the Lord, over Israel.
chapters.kjv: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD , even over Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദാസന്മാരായ പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ രക്തത്തിന്നും യഹോവയുടെ സകലദാസന്മാരുടെയും രക്തത്തിന്നും ഈസേബെലിനോടു ഞാൻ പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്റെ യജമാനനായ ആഹാബിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെ നീ സംഹരിച്ചുകളയേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to destroy the house of Ahab your master, and I will avenge the blood of my servants the prophets and the blood of all the Lord ’s servants shed by Jezebel.
chapters.nkjv: You shall strike down the house of Ahab your master, that I may avenge the blood of My servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezebel.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD , at the hand of Jezebel.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബ്ഗൃഹം അശേഷം മുടിഞ്ഞുപോകേണം; യിസ്രായേലിൽ ആഹാബിന്നുള്ള സ്വതന്ത്രനും അസ്വതന്ത്രനുമായ പുരുഷപ്രജയെ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ ഛേദിച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: The whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab every last male in Israel—slave or free.
chapters.nkjv: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish; and I will cut off from Ahab all the males in Israel, both bond and free.
chapters.kjv: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ആഹാബ്ഗൃഹത്തെ നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെപ്പോലെയും അഹീയാവിന്റെ മകനായ ബയെശയുടെ ഗൃഹത്തെപ്പോലെയും ആക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.
chapters.nkjv: So I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.
chapters.kjv: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

chapters.ml: ഈസേബെലിനെ യിസ്രെയേൽ പ്രദേശത്തുവെച്ചു നായ്ക്കൾ തിന്നുകളയും; അവളെ അടക്കം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ആരും ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല. പിന്നെ അവൻ വാതിൽ തുറന്നു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: As for Jezebel, dogs will devour her on the plot of ground at Jezreel, and no one will bury her.’ " Then he opened the door and ran.
chapters.nkjv: The dogs shall eat Jezebel on the plot ofground at Jezreel, and thereshallbe none to bury her.’ " And he opened the door and fled.
chapters.kjv: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her . And he opened the door, and fled.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂതന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു വന്നപ്പോൾ ഒരുത്തൻ അവനോടു: എന്താകുന്നു വിശേഷം? ആ ഭ്രാന്തൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നതെന്തിന്നു? എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ആ പുരുഷനെയും അവൻ പറഞ്ഞകാര്യത്തെയും അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jehu went out to his fellow officers, one of them asked him, "Is everything all right? Why did this maniac come to you?" "You know the man and the sort of things he says," Jehu replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehu came out to the servants of his master, and one said to him, "Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?" And he said to them, "You know the man and his babble."
chapters.kjv: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവർ: അതു നേരല്ല; നീ ഞങ്ങളോടു പറയേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായിട്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നാദിയായി ഇന്നിന്ന കാര്യങ്ങൾ അവൻ എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "That’s not true!" they said. "Tell us." Jehu said, "Here is what he told me: ‘This is what the Lord says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "A lie! Tell us now." So he said, "Thus and thus he spoke to me, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "I have anointed you king over Israel." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD , I have anointed thee king over Israel.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവർ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വസ്ത്രം എടുത്തു കോവണിപ്പടികളിന്മേൽ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വിരിച്ചു. കാഹളം ഊതി: യേഹൂ രാജാവായി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They quickly took their cloaks and spread them under him on the bare steps. Then they blew the trumpet and shouted, "Jehu is king!"
chapters.nkjv: Then each man hastened to take his garment and put it under him on the top of the steps; and they blew trumpets, saying, "Jehu is king!"
chapters.kjv: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നിംശിയുടെ മകനായ യെഹോശാഫാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ യേഹൂ യോരാമിന്നു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി. യോരാമും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും അരാംരാജാവായ ഹസായേൽനിമിത്തം ഗിലെയാദിലെ രാമോത്തിനെ കാവൽ ആക്കി സൂക്ഷിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, conspired against Joram. (Now Joram and all Israel had been defending Ramoth Gilead against Hazael king of Aram,
chapters.nkjv: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had been defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, against Hazael king of Syria.
chapters.kjv: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.

chapters.ml: അരാംരാജാവായ ഹസായേലിനോടുള്ള യുദ്ധത്തിൽ അരാമ്യർ തനിക്കു ഏല്പിച്ച മുറിവുകൾക്കു യിസ്രെയേലിൽവെച്ചു ചികിത്സചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു യോരാംരാജാവു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ യേഹൂ: നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമ്മതമെങ്കിൽ യിസ്രെയേലിൽ ചെന്നു ഇതു അറിയിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആരും പട്ടണം വിട്ടുപോകാതെ സൂക്ഷിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but King Joram had returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds the Arameans had inflicted on him in the battle with Hazael king of Aram.) Jehu said, "If you desire to make me king, don’t let anyone slip out of the city to go and tell the news in Jezreel."
chapters.nkjv: But King Joram had returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds which the Syrians had inflicted on him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, "If you are so minded, let no one leave or escape from the city to go and tell it in Jezreel."
chapters.kjv: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യേഹൂ രഥം കയറി യിസ്രെയേലിലേക്കു പോയി; യോരാം അവിടെ കിടക്കുകയായിരുന്നു. യോരാമിനെ കാണ്മാൻ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അഹസ്യാവും അവിടെ വന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he got into his chariot and rode to Jezreel, because Joram was resting there and Ahaziah king of Judah had gone down to see him.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram was laid up there; and Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.
chapters.kjv: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രെയേലിലെ ഗോപുരമുകളിൽ ഒരു കാവൽക്കാരൻ നിന്നിരുന്നു; അവൻ യേവഹൂവിന്റെ കൂട്ടം വരുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഞാൻ ഒരു കൂട്ടത്തെ കാണുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ യോരാം: നീ ഒരു കുതിരച്ചേവകനെ വിളിച്ചു അവരുടെ നേരെ അയക്കേണം; അവൻ ചെന്നു: സമാധാനമോ എന്നു ചോദിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the lookout standing on the tower in Jezreel saw Jehu’s troops approaching, he called out, "I see some troops coming." "Get a horseman," Joram ordered. "Send him to meet them and ask, ‘Do you come in peace?’ "
chapters.nkjv: Now a watchman stood on the tower in Jezreel, and he saw the company of Jehu as he came, and said, "I see a company of men." And Joram said, "Get a horseman and send him to meet them, and let him say, ‘Isit peace?’ "
chapters.kjv: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഒരുത്തൻ കുതിരപ്പുറത്തു കയറി അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു ചെന്നു: സമാധാനമോ എന്നു രാജാവു ചോദിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. സമാധാനം കൊണ്ടു നിനക്കു എന്തു കാര്യം? തിരിഞ്ഞു എന്റെ പുറകിൽ വരിക എന്നു യേഹൂ പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ കാവൽക്കാരൻ: ദൂതൻ അവരുടെ അടുക്കലോളം ചെന്നിട്ടും മടങ്ങിവരുന്നില്ല എന്നു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The horseman rode off to meet Jehu and said, "This is what the king says: ‘Do you come in peace?’ " "What do you have to do with peace?" Jehu replied. "Fall in behind me." The lookout reported, "The messenger has reached them, but he isn’t coming back."
chapters.nkjv: So the horseman went to meet him, and said, "Thus says the king: ‘Isit peace?’ " And Jehu said, "What have you to do with peace? Turn around and follow me." So the watchman reported, saying, "The messenger went to them, but is not coming back."
chapters.kjv: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മറ്റൊരുത്തനെ കുതിരപ്പുറത്തു അയച്ചു; അവനും അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: സമാധാനമോ എന്നു രാജാവു ചോദിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. സമാധാനംകൊണ്ടു നിനക്കു എന്തു കാര്യം? തിരിഞ്ഞു എന്റെ പുറകിൽ വരിക എന്നു യേഹൂ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the king sent out a second horseman. When he came to them he said, "This is what the king says: ‘Do you come in peace?’ " Jehu replied, "What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me."
chapters.nkjv: Then he sent out a second horseman who came to them, and said, "Thus says the king: ‘Isit peace?’ " And Jehu answered, "What have you to do with peace? Turn around and follow me."
chapters.kjv: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ കാവൽക്കാരൻ: അവനും അവരുടെ അടുക്കലോളം ചെന്നിട്ടു മടങ്ങിവരുന്നില്ല; ആ ഓടിക്കുന്നതു നിംശിയുടെ മകനായ യേഹൂ ഓടിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; ഭ്രന്തനപ്പോലെയല്ലോ അവൻ ഓടിച്ചുവരുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The lookout reported, "He has reached them, but he isn’t coming back either. The driving is like that of Jehu son of Nimshi—he drives like a maniac."
chapters.nkjv: So the watchman reported, saying, "He went up to them and is not coming back; and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously!"
chapters.kjv: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ യോരാം: രഥം പൂട്ടുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; രഥം പൂട്ടിയശേഷം യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാവായ യോരാമും യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അഹസ്യാവും താന്താന്റെ രഥത്തിൽ കയറി യേഹൂവിന്റെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു, യിസ്രെയേല്യനായ നാബോത്തിന്റെ നിലത്തിങ്കൽവെച്ചു അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: "Hitch up my chariot," Joram ordered. And when it was hitched up, Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah rode out, each in his own chariot, to meet Jehu. They met him at the plot of ground that had belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joram said, "Make ready." And his chariot was made ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and met him on the property of Naboth the Jezreelite.
chapters.kjv: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂവിനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യോരാം: യേഹൂവേ, സമാധാനമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു യേഹൂ: നിന്റെ അമ്മയായ ഈസേബെലിന്റെ പരസംഗവും ക്ഷുദ്രവും ഇത്ര അധികമായിരിക്കുന്നേടത്തോളം എന്തു സമാധാനം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Joram saw Jehu he asked, "Have you come in peace, Jehu?" "How can there be peace," Jehu replied, "as long as all the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?"
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, "Isit peace, Jehu?" So he answered, "What peace, as long as the harlotries of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft areso many?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോരാം രഥം തിരിച്ചു ഓടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അഹസ്യാവോടു: അഹസ്യാവേ, ഇതു ദ്രോഹം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Joram turned about and fled, calling out to Ahaziah, "Treachery, Ahaziah!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Joram turned around and fled, and said to Ahaziah, "Treachery, Ahaziah!"
chapters.kjv: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂ വില്ലുകുലെച്ചു യോരാമിനെ ഭുജങ്ങളുടെ നടുവെ എയ്തു; അമ്പു അവന്റെ ഹൃദയം തുളഞ്ഞു മറുപുറം കടന്നു; അവൻ രഥത്തിൽ ചുരുണ്ടു വീണു.
chapters.niv: Then Jehu drew his bow and shot Joram between the shoulders. The arrow pierced his heart and he slumped down in his chariot.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jehu drew his bow with full strength and shot Jehoram between his arms; and the arrow came out at his heart, and he sank down in his chariot.
chapters.kjv: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂ തന്റെ പടനായകനായ ബിദ്കാരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: അവനെ എടുത്തു യിസ്രെയേല്യനായ നാബോത്തിന്റെ നിലത്തിൽ എറിഞ്ഞുകളക; ഞാനും നീയും ഒരുമിച്ചു അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ ആഹാബിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ കുതിരയേറി പോകുമ്പോൾ:
chapters.niv: Jehu said to Bidkar, his chariot officer, "Pick him up and throw him on the field that belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite. Remember how you and I were riding together in chariots behind Ahab his father when the Lord spoke this prophecy against him:
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, "Pick him up, and throw him into the tract of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember, when you and I were riding together behind Ahab his father, that the Lord laid this burden upon him:
chapters.kjv: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

chapters.ml: നാബോത്തിന്റെ രക്തവും അവന്റെ മക്കളുടെ രക്തവും ഇന്നലെ ഞാൻ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു സത്യം എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഈ നിലത്തുവെച്ചു ഞാൻ നിനക്കു പകരം വീട്ടുമെന്നും യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നിങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ ഈ അരുപ്പാടു അവന്നു വിരോധമായി ഉണ്ടായെന്നു ഓർത്തുകൊൾക; അവനെ എടുത്തു യഹോവയുടെ വചന പ്രകാരം തന്നേ ഈ നിലത്തിൽ എറിഞ്ഞുകളക.
chapters.niv: ‘Yesterday I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons, declares the Lord , and I will surely make you pay for it on this plot of ground, declares the Lord .’ Now then, pick him up and throw him on that plot, in accordance with the word of the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: ‘Surely I saw yesterday the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons,’ says the Lord, ‘and I will repay you in this plot,’ says the Lord. Now therefore, take and throw him on the plot ofground, according to the word of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD ; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അഹസ്യാവു ഇതു കണ്ടിട്ടു ഉദ്യാനഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ വഴിയായി ഓടിപ്പോയി. യേഹൂ അവനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു: അവനെയും രഥത്തിൽ വെട്ടിക്കളവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അവർ യിബ്ളെയാമിന്നു സമീപത്തുള്ള ഗൂർകയറ്റത്തിങ്കൽവെച്ചു അവനെ വെട്ടി; അവൻ മെഗിദ്ദോവിലേക്കു ഓടിച്ചെന്നു അവിടെവെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When Ahaziah king of Judah saw what had happened, he fled up the road to Beth Haggan. Jehu chased him, shouting, "Kill him too!" They wounded him in his chariot on the way up to Gur near Ibleam, but he escaped to Megiddo and died there.
chapters.nkjv: But when Ahaziah king of Judah saw this, he fled by the road to Beth Haggan. So Jehu pursued him, and said, "Shoot him also in the chariot." Andtheyshothim at the Ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. Then he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
chapters.kjv: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ അവനെ രഥത്തിൽവെച്ചു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കെണ്ടുപോയി ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടുകൂടെ അവന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: His servants took him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his ancestors in his tomb in the City of David.
chapters.nkjv: And his servants carried him in the chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in the City of David.
chapters.kjv: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബിന്റെ മകനായ യോരാമിന്റെ പതിനൊന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ ആയിരുന്നു അഹസ്യാവു യെഹൂദയിൽ രാജാവായതു.
chapters.niv: (In the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king of Judah.)
chapters.nkjv: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king over Judah.
chapters.kjv: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂ യിസ്രായേലിൽ വന്നതു ഈസേബെൽ കേട്ടിട്ടു തന്റെ കണ്ണിൽ മഷിയെഴുതി തലചീകി മിനുക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു കിളിവാതിൽക്കൽകൂടി നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then Jehu went to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard about it, she put on eye makeup, arranged her hair and looked out of a window.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard ofit; and she put paint on her eyes and adorned her head, and looked through a window.
chapters.kjv: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂ പടിവാതിൽ കടന്നപ്പോൾ അവൾ: യജമാനനെ കൊന്നവനായ സിമ്രിക്കു സമാധാനമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Jehu entered the gate, she asked, "Have you come in peace, you Zimri, you murderer of your master?"
chapters.nkjv: Then, as Jehu entered at the gate, she said, "Isit peace, Zimri, murderer of your master?"
chapters.kjv: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ മുഖം കിളിവാതിൽക്കലേക്കു ഉയർത്തി: ആരുള്ളു എന്റെ പക്ഷത്തു? ആരുള്ളു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. എന്നാറെ രണ്ടുമൂന്നു ഷണ്ഡന്മാർ പുറത്തേക്കു നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: He looked up at the window and called out, "Who is on my side? Who?" Two or three eunuchs looked down at him.
chapters.nkjv: And he looked up at the window, and said, "Who is on my side? Who?" So two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
chapters.kjv: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.

chapters.ml: അവളെ താഴെ തള്ളിയിടുവിൻ എന്നു അവൻ കല്പിച്ചു. ഉടനെ അവർ അവളെ താഴെ തള്ളിയിട്ടു; അവളുടെ രക്തം ചുവരിന്മേലും കുതിരകളിന്മേലും തെറിച്ചു; അവൻ അവളെ ചവിട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Throw her down!" Jehu said. So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered the wall and the horses as they trampled her underfoot.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Throw her down." So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses; and he trampled her underfoot.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെന്നു ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്തശേഷം: ആ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവളെ ചെന്നു നോക്കി അടക്കം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവൾ രാജകുമാരിയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jehu went in and ate and drank. "Take care of that cursed woman," he said, "and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter."
chapters.nkjv: And when he had gone in, he ate and drank. Then he said, "Go now, see to this accursed woman, and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter."
chapters.kjv: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman , and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവളെ അടക്കം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ചെന്നാറെ അവളുടെ തലമണ്ടയും കാലുകളും കൈപ്പത്തികളും അല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊന്നും കണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing except her skull, her feet and her hands.
chapters.nkjv: So they went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull and the feet and the palms of her hands.
chapters.kjv: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

chapters.ml: അവർ മടങ്ങിവന്നു അവനോടു അതു അറിയിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: യിസ്രെയേൽ പ്രദേശത്തുവെച്ചു നായ്ക്കൾ ഈസേബെലിന്റെ മാംസം തിന്നുകളയും;
chapters.niv: They went back and told Jehu, who said, "This is the word of the Lord that he spoke through his servant Elijah the Tishbite: On the plot of ground at Jezreel dogs will devour Jezebel’s flesh.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they came back and told him. And he said, "This is the word of the Lord, which He spoke by His servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘On the plot ofground at Jezreel dogs shall eat the flesh of Jezebel;
chapters.kjv: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

chapters.ml: അതു ഈസേബെൽ എന്നു പറവാൻ കഴിയാതവണ്ണം ഈസേബെലിന്റെ പിണം യിസ്രെയേൽപ്രദേശത്തു വയലിലെ ചാണകം പോലെ ആകും എന്നിങ്ങനെ യഹോവ തിശ്ബ്യനായ എലീയാവു എന്ന തന്റെ ദാസൻ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനം തന്നേ ഇതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jezebel’s body will be like dung on the ground in the plot at Jezreel, so that no one will be able to say, ‘This is Jezebel.’ "
chapters.nkjv: and the corpse of Jezebel shall be as refuse on the surface of the field, in the plot at Jezreel, so that they shall not say, "Here lies Jezebel." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

chapters.ml: ആഹാബിന്നു ശമർയ്യയിൽ എഴുപതു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. യേഹൂ യിസ്രായേൽ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർക്കും മൂപ്പന്മാർക്കും ആഹാബിന്റെ പുത്രപാലകന്മാർക്കും ശമർയ്യയിലേക്കു എഴുത്തുകളെ എഴുതി അയച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Now there were in Samaria seventy sons of the house of Ahab. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria: to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders and to the guardians of Ahab’s children. He said,
chapters.nkjv: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote and sent letters to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to those who reared Ahab’s sons, saying:
chapters.kjv: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s children , saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും രഥങ്ങളും കുതിരകളും ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണവും ആയുധങ്ങളും നിങ്ങളുടെ കൈവശം ഉണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "You have your master’s sons with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weapons. Now as soon as this letter reaches you,
chapters.nkjv: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and weapons,
chapters.kjv: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഈ എഴുത്തു നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയ ഉടനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ഉത്തമനും യോഗ്യനുമായവനെ നോക്കിയെടുത്തു അവന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുത്തി നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിന്നുവേണ്ടി യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വിൻ.
chapters.niv: choose the best and most worthy of your master’s sons and set him on his father’s throne. Then fight for your master’s house."
chapters.nkjv: choose the best qualified of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.
chapters.kjv: Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.

chapters.ml: അവരോ ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു: രണ്ടു രാജാക്കന്മാർക്കും അവനോടു എതിർത്തുനില്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ലല്ലോ; പിന്നെ നാം എങ്ങനെ നില്ക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they were terrified and said, "If two kings could not resist him, how can we?"
chapters.nkjv: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, "Look, two kings could not stand up to him; how then can we stand?"
chapters.kjv: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ രാജധാനിവിചാരകനും നഗരാധിപതിയും മൂപ്പന്മാരും പുത്രപാലകന്മാരും യേഹൂവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ; ഞങ്ങളോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യാം; ഞങ്ങൾ ഒരുത്തനെയും രാജാവാക്കുന്നില്ല; നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ ചെയ്തുകൊൾക എന്നു പറയിച്ചു. അവൻ രണ്ടാമതും എഴുത്തു എഴുതിയതു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേന്നു എന്റെ കല്പന കേൾക്കുമെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ തല നാളെ ഈ നേരത്തു യിസ്രെയേലിൽ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: So the palace administrator, the city governor, the elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: "We are your servants and we will do anything you say. We will not appoint anyone as king; you do whatever you think best."
chapters.nkjv: And he who was in charge of the house, and he who was in charge of the city, the elders also, and those who reared thesons, sent to Jehu, saying, "We are your servants, we will do all you tell us; but we will not make anyone king. Do whatis good in your sight."
chapters.kjv: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാജകുമാരന്മാർ എഴുപതു പേരും തങ്ങളെ വളർത്തുന്ന നഗരപ്രധാനികളോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter, saying, "If you are on my side and will obey me, take the heads of your master’s sons and come to me in Jezreel by this time tomorrow." Now the royal princes, seventy of them, were with the leading men of the city, who were rearing them.
chapters.nkjv: Then he wrote a second letter to them, saying: If you are for me and will obey my voice, take the heads of the men, your master’s sons, and come to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow. Now the king’s sons, seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who were rearing them.
chapters.kjv: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

chapters.ml: ഈ എഴുത്തു അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവർ രാജകുമാരന്മാരെ എഴുപതുപേരെയും പിടിച്ചു കൊന്നു അവരുടെ തലകൊട്ടയിൽ ആക്കി യിസ്രെയേലിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the letter arrived, these men took the princes and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu in Jezreel.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons and slaughtered seventy persons, put their heads in baskets and sent them to him at Jezreel.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദൂതൻ വന്നു അവനോടു: അവർ രാജകുമാരന്മാരുടെ തലകൊണ്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിയിച്ചു. അവയെ പടിപ്പുരവാതിൽക്കൽ രണ്ടു കൂമ്പാരമായി കൂട്ടി രാവിലെവരെ വെച്ചേക്കുവിൻ എന്നു അവൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, "They have brought the heads of the princes." Then Jehu ordered, "Put them in two piles at the entrance of the city gate until morning."
chapters.nkjv: Then a messenger came and told him, saying, "They have brought the heads of the king’s sons." And he said, "Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning."
chapters.kjv: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ രാവിലെ അവൻ പുറത്തു ചെന്നുനിന്നു സർവ്വജനത്തോടും പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ നീതിമാന്മാർ; ഞാനോ എന്റെ യജമാനന്നു വിരോധമായി കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി അവനെ കൊന്നു കളഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ ഇവരെ ഒക്കെയും കൊന്നതു ആർ?
chapters.niv: The next morning Jehu went out. He stood before all the people and said, "You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?
chapters.nkjv: So it was, in the morning, that he went out and stood, and said to all the people, "You are righteous. Indeed I conspired against my master and killed him; but who killed all these?
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവ ആഹാബ് ഗൃഹത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത യഹോവയുടെ വചനങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നും നിഷ്ഫലമാകയില്ല എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ; യഹോവ തന്റെ ദാസനായ ഏലീയാവുമുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു നിവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Know, then, that not a word the Lord has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail. The Lord has done what he announced through his servant Elijah."
chapters.nkjv: Know now that nothing shall fall to the earth of the word of the Lord which the Lord spoke concerning the house of Ahab; for the Lord has done what He spoke by His servant Elijah."
chapters.kjv: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD , which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യേഹൂ യിസ്രെയേലിൽ ആഹാബ് ഗൃഹത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചവരെ ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ സകല മഹത്തുക്കളെയും ബന്ധുക്കളെയും പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും ആരും ശേഷിക്കാതവണ്ണം സംഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his chief men, his close friends and his priests, leaving him no survivor.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehu killed all who remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men and his close acquaintances and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
chapters.kjv: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശമർയ്യയിൽ ചെന്നു വഴിയിൽ ഇടയന്മാർ രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്ന വീട്ടിന്നരികെ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ യോഹൂ
chapters.niv: Jehu then set out and went toward Samaria. At Beth Eked of the Shepherds,
chapters.nkjv: And he arose and departed and went to Samaria. On the way, at Beth Eked of the Shepherds,
chapters.kjv: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അഹസ്യാവിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ കണ്ടിട്ടു: നിങ്ങൾ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. ഞങ്ങൾ അഹസ്യാവിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ; രാജാവിന്റെ മക്കളെയും രാജ്ഞിയുടെ മക്കളെയും അഭിവന്ദനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പോകയാകുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, "Who are you?" They said, "We are relatives of Ahaziah, and we have come down to greet the families of the king and of the queen mother."
chapters.nkjv: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, "Who are you?" So they answered, "We are the brothers of Ahaziah; we have come down to greet the sons of the king and the sons of the queen mother."
chapters.kjv: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: അവരെ ജീവനോടെ പിടിപ്പിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അവരെ ജീവനോടെ പിടിച്ചു; അവരെ നാല്പത്തിരണ്ടുപേരെയും രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്ന വീട്ടിന്റെ കളത്തിങ്കൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നു; അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെയും ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Take them alive!" he ordered. So they took them alive and slaughtered them by the well of Beth Eked—forty-two of them. He left no survivor.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Take them alive!" So they took them alive, and killed them at the well of Beth Eked, forty-two men; and he left none of them.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ തന്നെ എതിരേല്പാൻ വരുന്ന രേഖാബിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാദാബിനെ കണ്ടു വന്ദനം ചെയ്തു അവനോടു: എന്റെ ഹൃദയം നിന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തോടു ചേർന്നിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ നിന്റെ ഹൃദയം പരമാർത്ഥമായിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു യോനാദാബ് അതെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ എങ്കിൽ കൈ തരിക. അവൻ കൈ കൊടുത്തു; അവൻ അവനെ തന്റെ രഥത്തിൽ കയറ്റി.
chapters.niv: After he left there, he came upon Jehonadab son of Rekab, who was on his way to meet him. Jehu greeted him and said, "Are you in accord with me, as I am with you?" "I am," Jehonadab answered. "If so," said Jehu, "give me your hand." So he did, and Jehu helped him up into the chariot.
chapters.nkjv: Now when he departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab, coming to meet him; and he greeted him and said to him, "Is your heart right, as my heart is toward your heart?" And Jehonadab answered, "It is." Jehusaid, "If it is, give me your hand." So he gave him his hand, and he took him up to him into the chariot.
chapters.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ വന്നു യഹോവയെക്കുറിച്ചു എനിക്കുള്ള ശുഷ്കാന്തി കാൺക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു; അങ്ങനെ അവനെ രഥത്തിൽ കയറ്റി അവർ ഓടിച്ചു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Jehu said, "Come with me and see my zeal for the Lord ." Then he had him ride along in his chariot.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Come with me, and see my zeal for the Lord." So they had him ride in his chariot.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD . So they made him ride in his chariot.

chapters.ml: ശമർയ്യയിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശമർയ്യയിൽ ആഹാബിന്നു ശേഷിച്ചവരെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവ ഏലീയാവോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനപ്രകാരം ഒട്ടൊഴിയാതെ സംഹരിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jehu came to Samaria, he killed all who were left there of Ahab’s family; he destroyed them, according to the word of the Lord spoken to Elijah.
chapters.nkjv: And when he came to Samaria, he killed all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed them, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke to Elijah.
chapters.kjv: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD , which he spake to Elijah.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യേഹൂ സകലജനത്തെയും കൂട്ടി അവരോടു: ആഹാബ് ബാലിനെ അല്പമേ സേവിച്ചുള്ളു; യേഹൂവോ അവനെ അധികം സേവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu will serve him much.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little, Jehu will serve him much.
chapters.kjv: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ബാലിന്റെ സകലപ്രവാചകന്മാരെയും സകലപൂജകന്മാരെയും സകലപുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുത്തുവിൻ; ഒരുത്തനും വരാതിരിക്കരുതു; ഞാൻ ബാലിന്നു ഒരു മഹായാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നു; വരാത്തവർ ആരും ജീവനോടിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ ബാലിന്റെ പൂജകന്മാരെ നശിപ്പിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം യേഹൂ ഈ ഉപായം പ്രയോഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now summon all the prophets of Baal, all his servants and all his priests. See that no one is missing, because I am going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Anyone who fails to come will no longer live." But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. Let no one be missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing shall not live." But Jehu acted deceptively, with the intent of destroying the worshipers of Baal.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

chapters.ml: ബാലിന്നു ഒരു വിശുദ്ധസഭായോഗം ഘോഷിപ്പിൻ എന്നു യേഹൂ കല്പിച്ചു. അവർ അങ്ങനെ ഘേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jehu said, "Call an assembly in honor of Baal." So they proclaimed it.
chapters.nkjv: And Jehu said, "Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal." So they proclaimed it.
chapters.kjv: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it .

chapters.ml: യേഹൂ യിസ്രായേൽ ദേശത്തു എല്ലാടവും ആളയച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ബാലിന്റെ സകല പൂജകന്മാരും വന്നു; ഒരുത്തനും വരാതിരുന്നില്ല; അവർ ബാലിന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ കൂടി; ബാൽക്ഷേത്രം ഒരു അറ്റംമുതൽ മറ്റേ അറ്റംവരെ തിങ്ങിനിറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; not one stayed away. They crowded into the temple of Baal until it was full from one end to the other.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehu sent throughout all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left who did not come. So they came into the temple of Baal, and the temple of Baal was full from one end to the other.
chapters.kjv: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വസ്ത്ര വിചാരകനോടു: ബാലിന്റെ സകലപൂജകന്മാർക്കും വസ്ത്രം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു കൊടുക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അവൻ വസ്ത്രം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, "Bring robes for all the servants of Baal." So he brought out robes for them.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to the one in charge of the wardrobe, "Bring out vestments for all the worshipers of Baal." So he brought out vestments for them.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യേഹൂവും രേഖാബിന്റെ മകനായ യോനാദാബും ബാലിന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ കടന്നു ബാലിന്റെ പൂജകന്മാരോടു: ബാലിന്റെ പൂജകന്മാർ മാത്രമല്ലാതെ യഹോവയുടെ പൂജകന്മാർ ആരും ഇവിടെ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തിരഞ്ഞു നോക്കുവിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rekab went into the temple of Baal. Jehu said to the servants of Baal, "Look around and see that no one who serves the Lord is here with you—only servants of Baal."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehu and Jehonadab the son of Rechab went into the temple of Baal, and said to the worshipers of Baal, "Search and see that no servants of the Lord are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal."
chapters.kjv: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD , but the worshippers of Baal only.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഹനനയാഗങ്ങളും ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും കഴിപ്പാൻ അകത്തു ചെന്നശേഷം യേഹൂ പുറത്തു എണ്പതു പേരെ നിർത്തി: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കുന്ന ആളുകളിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ചാടിപ്പോയാൽ അവന്റെ ജീവന്നു പകരം അവനെ വിട്ടയച്ചവന്റെ ജീവൻ ആയിരിക്കും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they went in to make sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had posted eighty men outside with this warning: "If one of you lets any of the men I am placing in your hands escape, it will be your life for his life."
chapters.nkjv: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men on the outside, and had said, "If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escapes, whoeverletshimescape, it shall be his life for the life of the other."
chapters.kjv: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him.

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗം കഴിച്ചുതീർന്നപ്പോൾ യേഹൂ അകമ്പടികളോടും പടനായകന്മാരോടും: അകത്തു കടന്നു അവരെ കൊല്ലുവിൻ; ഒരുത്തനും പുറത്തു പോകരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ അവരെ കൊന്നു; അകമ്പടികളും പടനായകന്മാരും അവരെ പുറത്തു എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞു; ബാൽക്ഷേത്രത്തിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു
chapters.niv: As soon as Jehu had finished making the burnt offering, he ordered the guards and officers: "Go in and kill them; let no one escape." So they cut them down with the sword. The guards and officers threw the bodies out and then entered the inner shrine of the temple of Baal.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, "Go in and kill them; let no one come out!" And they killed them with the edge of the sword; then the guards and the officers threw them out, and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

chapters.ml: ബാൽക്ഷേത്രത്തിലെ സ്തംഭവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They brought the sacred stone out of the temple of Baal and burned it.
chapters.nkjv: And they brought the sacred pillars out of the temple of Baal and burned them.
chapters.kjv: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

chapters.ml: അവർ ബാൽസ്തംഭത്തെ തകർത്തു ബാൽക്ഷേത്രത്തെ ഇടിച്ചു അതിനെ മറപ്പുരയാക്കിത്തീർത്തു; അതു ഇന്നുവരെ അങ്ങനെതന്നേ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They demolished the sacred stone of Baal and tore down the temple of Baal, and people have used it for a latrine to this day.
chapters.nkjv: Then they broke down the sacred pillar of Baal, and tore down the temple of Baal and made it a refuse dump to this day.
chapters.kjv: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യേഹൂ ബാലിനെ യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നു നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Jehu destroyed Baal worship in Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal from Israel.
chapters.kjv: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ബേഥേലിലും ദാനിലും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പൊൻകാളക്കുട്ടികളെക്കൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേലിനെ പാപം ചെയ്യുമാറാക്കിയ നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ യേഹൂ വിട്ടുമാറിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: However, he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
chapters.nkjv: However Jehu did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin, thatis, from the golden calves that were at Bethel and Dan.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യേഹൂവിനോടു: എനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടമുള്ളതു നീ നല്ലവണ്ണം അനുഷ്ഠിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടും എന്റെ ഹിതപ്രകാരം ഒക്കെയും ആഹാബ്ഗൃഹത്തോടു ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടും നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാസനത്തിൽ നാലാം തലമുറവരെ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in accomplishing what is right in my eyes and have done to the house of Ahab all I had in mind to do, your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in doing whatis right in My sight, and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart, your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും യേഹൂ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണപ്രകാരം പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടെ നടക്കുന്നതിന്നു ജാഗ്രത കാണിച്ചില്ല; യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ അവൻ വിട്ടുമാറിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet Jehu was not careful to keep the law of the Lord , the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart; for he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam, who had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിനെ കുറെച്ചുകളവാൻ തുടങ്ങി; ഹസായേൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ അതിരുകളിലൊക്കെയും അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael overpowered the Israelites throughout their territory
chapters.nkjv: In those days the Lord began to cut off parts of Israel; and Hazael conquered them in all the territory of Israel
chapters.kjv: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോർദ്ദാന്നു കിഴക്കു ഗാദ്യർ, രൂബേന്യർ, മനശ്ശേയർ എന്നിവരുടെ ദേശമായ ഗിലെയാദ് മുഴുവനും ജയിച്ചടക്കി അർന്നോൻ തോട്ടിന്നരികെയുള്ള അരോവേർ മുതൽ ഗിലെയാദും ബാശാനും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: east of the Jordan in all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben and Manasseh), from Aroer by the Arnon Gorge through Gilead to Bashan.
chapters.nkjv: from the Jordan eastward: all the land of Gilead—Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh—from Aroer, which is by the River Arnon, including Gilead and Bashan.
chapters.kjv: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവന്റെ സകലപരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തികളും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Jehu’s reign, all he did, and all his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: യേഹൂ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവനെ ശമർയ്യയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. അവന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാഹാസ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jehu rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehu rested with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. Then Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂ ശമർയ്യയിൽ യിസ്രായേലിനെ വാണ കാലം ഇരുപത്തെട്ടു സംവത്സരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
chapters.nkjv: And the period that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
chapters.kjv: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

chapters.ml: അഹസ്യാവിന്റെ അമ്മയായ അഥല്യാ തന്റെ മകൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു രാജസന്തതിയെ ഒക്കെയും നശിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family.
chapters.nkjv: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal heirs.
chapters.kjv: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോരാംരാജാവിന്റെ മകളും അഹസ്യാവിന്റെ സഹോദരിയുമായ യെഹോശേബ കൊല്ലപ്പെടുന്ന രാജാകുമാരന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നു അഹസ്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ യോവാശിനെ മോഷ്ടിച്ചെടുത്തു അവനെയും അവന്റെ ധാത്രിയെയും അഥല്യാ കണാതെ ഒരു ശയനഗൃഹത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി ഒളിപ്പിച്ചു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഇടയായില്ല.
chapters.niv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes, who were about to be murdered. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom to hide him from Athaliah; so he was not killed.
chapters.nkjv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons whowere being murdered; and they hid him and his nurse in the bedroom, from Athaliah, so that he was not killed.
chapters.kjv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

chapters.ml: അവനെ അവളോടുകൂടെ ആറു സംവത്സരം യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ഒളിപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ അഥല്യാ ദേശം വാണു.
chapters.niv: He remained hidden with his nurse at the temple of the Lord for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
chapters.nkjv: So he was hidden with her in the house of the Lord for six years, while Athaliah reigned over the land.
chapters.kjv: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹോയാദാ ആളയച്ചു കാര്യരുടെയും അകമ്പടികളുടെയും ശതാധിപന്മാരെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ വരുത്തി അവരോടു സഖ്യത ചെയ്തു; അവൻ അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽവെച്ചു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചിട്ടു അവർക്കു രാജകുമാരെനെ കാണിച്ചു അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent for the commanders of units of a hundred, the Carites and the guards and had them brought to him at the temple of the Lord . He made a covenant with them and put them under oath at the temple of the Lord . Then he showed them the king’s son.
chapters.nkjv: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and brought the captains of hundreds—of the bodyguards and the escorts—and brought them into the house of the Lord to him. And he made a covenant with them and took an oath from them in the house of the Lord, and showed them the king’s son.
chapters.kjv: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD , and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD , and shewed them the king’s son.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യേണ്ടുന്ന കാര്യം ആവിതു: ശബ്ബത്തിൽ തവണമാറിവരുന്ന നിങ്ങളിൽ മൂന്നിൽ ഒരു ഭാഗം രാജധാനിക്കും
chapters.niv: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you are to do: You who are in the three companies that are going on duty on the Sabbath—a third of you guarding the royal palace,
chapters.nkjv: Then he commanded them, saying, "This is what you shall do: one-third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall be keeping watch over the king’s house,
chapters.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

chapters.ml: മൂന്നിൽ ഒരു ഭാഗം സൂർപടിവാതിൽക്കലും മൂന്നിൽ ഒരു ഭാഗം അകമ്പടികളുടെ സ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ പിമ്പുറത്തുള്ള പടിവാതിൽക്കലും കാവൽ നിൽക്കേണം; ഇങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ അരമനെക്കു കിടങ്ങുപോലെ കാവലായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: a third at the Sur Gate, and a third at the gate behind the guard, who take turns guarding the temple—
chapters.nkjv: one-third shallbe at the gate of Sur, and one-third at the gate behind the escorts. You shall keep the watch of the house, lest it be broken down.
chapters.kjv: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

chapters.ml: ശബ്ബത്തിൽ തവണ മാറിപോകുന്ന നിങ്ങളിൽ രണ്ടു കൂട്ടങ്ങൾ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കാവലായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: and you who are in the other two companies that normally go off Sabbath duty are all to guard the temple for the king.
chapters.nkjv: The two contingents of you who go off duty on the Sabbath shall keep the watch of the house of the Lord for the king.
chapters.kjv: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും താന്താന്റെ ആയുധം ധരിച്ചു രാജാവിന്റെ ചുറ്റും നിൽക്കേണം; അണിക്കകത്തു കടക്കുന്നവനെ കൊന്നുകളയേണം; രാജാവു പോകയും വരികയും ചെയ്യുമ്പോഴൊക്കെയും. നിങ്ങൾ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കേണം. യെഹോയാദാപുരോഹിതൻ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും ശതാധിപന്മാർ ചെയ്തു;
chapters.niv: Station yourselves around the king, each of you with weapon in hand. Anyone who approaches your ranks is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."
chapters.nkjv: But you shall surround the king on all sides, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whoever comes within range, let him be put to death. You are to be with the king as he goes out and as he comes in."
chapters.kjv: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.

chapters.ml: അവർ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ തവണമാറി വരുന്നവരിലും ശബ്ബത്തിന്റെ തവണമാറി പോകുന്നവരിലും താന്താന്റെ ആളുകളെ യെഹോയാദാപുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The commanders of units of a hundred did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—and came to Jehoiada the priest.
chapters.nkjv: So the captains of the hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. Each of them took his men who were to be on duty on the Sabbath, with those who were going off duty on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
chapters.kjv: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതൻ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിന്റെ വകയായി യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന കുന്തങ്ങളും പരിചകളും ശതാധിപന്മാർക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he gave the commanders the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And the priest gave the captains of hundreds the spears and shields which hadbelonged to King David, that were in the temple of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that were in the temple of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അകമ്പടികൾ ഒക്കെയും കയ്യിൽ ആയുധവുമായി ആലയത്തിന്റെ വലത്തുവശംമുതൽ ഇടത്തുവശംവരെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും ആലയത്തിന്നും നേരെ രാജാവിന്റെ ചുറ്റും നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The guards, each with weapon in hand, stationed themselves around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
chapters.nkjv: Then the escorts stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, all around the king, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, by the altar and the house.
chapters.kjv: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാജകുമാരനെ പുറത്തുകൊണ്ടുവന്നു കിരീടും ധരിപ്പിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യപുസ്തകവും അവന്നു കൊടുത്തു; ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ അവനെ രാജാവാക്കി അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തിട്ടു കൈകൊട്ടി; രാജാവേ, ജയജയ എന്നു ആർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Jehoiada brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; he presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him, and the people clapped their hands and shouted, "Long live the king!"
chapters.nkjv: And he brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, and gavehim the Testimony; they made him king and anointed him, and they clapped their hands and said, "Long live the king!"
chapters.kjv: And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.

chapters.ml: അഥല്യാ അകമ്പടികളുടെയും ജനത്തിന്റെയും ആരവം കേട്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ജനത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guards and the people, she went to the people at the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the escorts and the people, she came to the people in the temple of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ആചാരപ്രകാരം തൂണിന്റെ അരികെ രാജാവും രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും കാഹളക്കാരും നില്ക്കുന്നതും ദേശത്തെ ജനം ഉല്ലസിച്ചു കാഹളം ഊതുന്നതും കണ്ടിട്ടു അഥല്യാ വസ്ത്രം കീറി: ദ്രോഹം, ദ്രോഹം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She looked and there was the king, standing by the pillar, as the custom was. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her robes and called out, "Treason! Treason!"
chapters.nkjv: When she looked, there was the king standing by a pillar according to custom; and the leaders and the trumpeters were by the king. All the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. So Athaliah tore her clothes and cried out, "Treason! Treason!"
chapters.kjv: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was , and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹോയാദാപുരോഹിതൻ പടനായകന്മാരായ ശതാധിപന്മാർക്കു കല്പന കൊടുത്തു; അവളെ അണികളിൽകൂടി പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകുവിൻ; അവളെ അനുഗമിക്കുന്നവനെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊല്ലുവിൻ എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു. യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽവെച്ചു അവളെ കൊല്ലരുതു എന്നു പുരോഹിതൻ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
