chapters.niv: Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "She must not be put to death in the temple of the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: And Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the army, and said to them, "Take her outside under guard, and slay with the sword whoever follows her." For the priest had said, "Do not let her be killed in the house of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവർ അവൾക്കു വഴി ഉണ്ടാക്കിക്കൊടുത്തു; അവൾ കുതിരവാതിൽ വഴിയായി രാജധാനിയിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവളെ അവിടെവെച്ചു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So they seized her as she reached the place where the horses enter the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.
chapters.nkjv: So they seized her; and she went by way of the horses’ entrance into the king’s house, and there she was killed.
chapters.kjv: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ യഹോവയുടെ ജനമായിരിക്കുമെന്നു യെഹോയാദാ യഹോവെക്കും രാജാവിന്നും ജനത്തിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേയും രാജാവിന്നും ജനത്തിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേയും നിയമം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Jehoiada then made a covenant between the Lord and the king and people that they would be the Lord ’s people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people, that they should be the Lord’s people, and also between the king and the people.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; between the king also and the people.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദേശത്തെ ജനമൊക്കെയും ബാൽക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ ചെന്നു അതു ഇടിച്ചു അവന്റെ ബലിപീഠങ്ങളും വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളും അശേഷം ഉടെച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; ബാലിന്റെ പുരോഹിതനായ മത്ഥാനെ ബിലപീഠങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നു കളഞ്ഞു. പുരോഹിതൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കാര്യവിചാരകന്മാരെയും നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: All the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars. Then Jehoiada the priest posted guards at the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal, and tore it down. They thoroughly broke in pieces its altars and images, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശതാധിപന്മാരെയും കാര്യരെയും അകമ്പടികളെയും ദേശത്തെ സകല ജനത്തെയും വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി രാജാവിനെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറക്കി അകമ്പടികളുടെ പടിവാതിൽവഴിയായി രാജധാനിയിലേക്കു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോയി; അവൻ രാജാസനം പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards and all the people of the land, and together they brought the king down from the temple of the Lord and went into the palace, entering by way of the gate of the guards. The king then took his place on the royal throne.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took the captains of hundreds, the bodyguards, the escorts, and all the people of the land; and they brought the king down from the house of the Lord, and went by way of the gate of the escorts to the king’s house. Then he sat on the throne of the kings.
chapters.kjv: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തിലെ സകല ജനവും സന്തോഷിച്ചു; നഗരം സ്വസ്ഥമായിരുന്നു; അഥല്യയെ അവർ രാജധാനിക്കരികെവെച്ചു വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword at the palace.
chapters.nkjv: So all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was quiet, for they had slain Athaliah with the sword in the king’s house.
chapters.kjv: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king’s house.

chapters.ml: യെഹോവാശ് രാജാവായപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഏഴു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoash was seven years old when he became king.
chapters.kjv: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.

chapters.ml: യേഹൂവിന്റെ ഏഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹോവാശ് വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങി; അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം വാണു. ബേർ-ശേബക്കാരത്തിയായ അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു സിബ്യാ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
chapters.nkjv: In the seventh year of Jehu, Jehoash became king, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
chapters.kjv: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാദാപുരോഹിതൻ യെഹോവാശിനെ ഉപദേശിച്ചുപോന്ന കാലത്തൊക്കെയും അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു ഇഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the years Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoash did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord all the days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും പൂജാഗിരികൾക്കു നീക്കം വന്നില്ല; ജനം പൂജാഗിരികളിൽ യാഗം കഴിച്ചും ധൂപം കാട്ടിയും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
chapters.nkjv: But the high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
chapters.kjv: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

chapters.ml: യെഹോവാശ് പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടു: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ നിവേദിതമായി പിരിഞ്ഞുകിട്ടുന്ന ദ്രവ്യമൊക്കെയും ഓരോ ആളെ മതിച്ച വിലയും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ഓരോരുത്തൻ കൊണ്ടുവരുന്ന സ്വമേധാദാനമായ ദ്രവ്യമൊക്കെയും
chapters.niv: Joash said to the priests, "Collect all the money that is brought as sacred offerings to the temple of the Lord —the money collected in the census, the money received from personal vows and the money brought voluntarily to the temple.
chapters.nkjv: And Jehoash said to the priests, "All the money of the dedicated gifts that are brought into the house of the Lord—each man’s census money, each man’s assessment money—and all the money that a man purposes in his heart to bring into the house of the Lord,
chapters.kjv: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man’s heart to bring into the house of the LORD ,

chapters.ml: ഓരോ പുരോഹിതനും താന്താന്റെ പരിചയക്കാരോടു വാങ്ങി ആലയത്തിന്നു അറ്റകുറ്റം കാണുന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർക്കേണം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Let every priest receive the money from one of the treasurers, then use it to repair whatever damage is found in the temple."
chapters.nkjv: let the priests take it themselves, each from his constituency; and let them repair the damages of the temple, wherever any dilapidation is found."
chapters.kjv: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെഹോവാശ് രാജാവിന്റെ ഇരുപത്തിമൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർത്തിട്ടില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But by the twenty-third year of King Joash the priests still had not repaired the temple.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was so, by the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, that the priests had not repaired the damages of the temple.
chapters.kjv: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യെഹോവാശ് രാജാവു യെഹോയാദാപുരോഹിതനെയും ശേഷം പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും വരുത്തി അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർക്കാതിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? ഇനി നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ പരിചയക്കാരോടു ദ്രവ്യം വാങ്ങാതെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതു കൊടുപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Therefore King Joash summoned Jehoiada the priest and the other priests and asked them, "Why aren’t you repairing the damage done to the temple? Take no more money from your treasurers, but hand it over for repairing the temple."
chapters.nkjv: So King Jehoash called Jehoiada the priest and the other priests, and said to them, "Why have you not repaired the damages of the temple? Now therefore, do not take more money from your constituency, but deliver it for repairing the damages of the temple."
chapters.kjv: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ തങ്ങൾ മേലാൽ ജനത്തോടു ദ്രവ്യം വാങ്ങാതിരിപ്പാനും ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർക്കാതിരിപ്പാനും സമ്മതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves.
chapters.nkjv: And the priests agreed that they would neither receive more money from the people, nor repair the damages of the temple.
chapters.kjv: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹോയാദാപുരോഹിതൻ ഒരു പെട്ടകം എടുത്തു അതിന്റെ മൂടിയിൽ ഒരു ദ്വാരം ഉണ്ടാക്കി യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നരികെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രവേശനത്തിന്റെ വലത്തു ഭാഗത്തു വെച്ചു; വാതിൽ കാക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു വരുന്ന ദ്രവ്യം ഒക്കെയും അതിൽ ഇടും.
chapters.niv: Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. He placed it beside the altar, on the right side as one enters the temple of the Lord . The priests who guarded the entrance put into the chest all the money that was brought to the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehoiada the priest took a chest, bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of the Lord; and the priests who kept the door put there all the money brought into the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: പെട്ടകത്തിൽ ദ്രവ്യം വളരെയായി എന്നു കാണുമ്പോൾ രാജാവിന്റെ രായസക്കാരനും മഹാപുരോഹിതനും കൂടെച്ചെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കണ്ട ദ്രവ്യം എണ്ണി സഞ്ചികളിൽ കെട്ടും.
chapters.niv: Whenever they saw that there was a large amount of money in the chest, the royal secretary and the high priest came, counted the money that had been brought into the temple of the Lord and put it into bags.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, whenever they saw that therewas much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up and put it in bags, and counted the money that was found in the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And it was so , when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവർ ദ്രവ്യം യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ പണി നടത്തുന്ന വിചാരകന്മാരുടെ പക്കൽ തൂക്കിക്കൊടുക്കും; അവർ അതു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ പണിചെയ്യുന്ന ആശാരിമാർക്കും ശില്പികൾക്കും
chapters.niv: When the amount had been determined, they gave the money to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. With it they paid those who worked on the temple of the Lord —the carpenters and builders,
chapters.nkjv: Then they gave the money, which had been apportioned, into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the house of the Lord; and they paid it out to the carpenters and builders who worked on the house of the Lord,
chapters.kjv: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD : and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD ,

chapters.ml: കല്പണിക്കാർക്കും കല്ലുവെട്ടുകാർക്കും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർപ്പാൻ വേണ്ടുന്ന മരവും ചെത്തിയ കല്ലും വാങ്ങുന്നതിന്നും ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർപ്പാൻ വേണ്ടുന്ന ചെലവൊക്കെയും കഴിക്കുന്നതിന്നും കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: the masons and stonecutters. They purchased timber and blocks of dressed stone for the repair of the temple of the Lord , and met all the other expenses of restoring the temple.
chapters.nkjv: and to masons and stonecutters, and for buying timber and hewn stone, to repair the damage of the house of the Lord, and for all that was paid out to repair the temple.
chapters.kjv: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ പിരിഞ്ഞുകിട്ടിയ ദ്രവ്യംകൊണ്ടു വെള്ളിക്കിണ്ണം, കത്രിക, കലം കാഹളം എന്നിങ്ങനെ പൊന്നും വെള്ളിയുംകൊണ്ടുള്ള യാതൊരു ഉപകരണങ്ങളും അവർ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയംവകെക്കു ഉണ്ടാക്കാതെ
chapters.niv: The money brought into the temple was not spent for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets or any other articles of gold or silver for the temple of the Lord ;
chapters.nkjv: However there were not made for the house of the Lord basins of silver, trimmers, sprinkling-bowls, trumpets, any articles of gold or articles of silver, from the money brought into the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD :

chapters.ml: പണിചെയ്യുന്നവർക്കു മാത്രം അതു കൊടുക്കും; അങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്നു അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർക്കും.
chapters.niv: it was paid to the workers, who used it to repair the temple.
chapters.nkjv: But they gave that to the workmen, and they repaired the house of the Lord with it.
chapters.kjv: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പണിചെയ്യുന്നവർക്കു കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദ്രവ്യം ഏറ്റുവാങ്ങിയവരോടു അവർ കണക്കു ചോദിച്ചില്ല; വിശ്വാസത്തിന്മേൽ ആയിരുന്നു അവർ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചുപോന്നതു.
chapters.niv: They did not require an accounting from those to whom they gave the money to pay the workers, because they acted with complete honesty.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover they did not require an account from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to be paid to workmen, for they dealt faithfully.
chapters.kjv: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

chapters.ml: അകൃത്യയാഗത്തിന്റെ ദ്രവ്യവും പാപയാഗത്തിന്റെ ദ്രവ്യവും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നില്ല; അതു പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കുള്ളതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the temple of the Lord ; it belonged to the priests.
chapters.nkjv: The money from the trespass offerings and the money from the sin offerings was not brought into the house of the Lord. It belonged to the priests.
chapters.kjv: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD : it was the priests’.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു അരാംരാജാവായ ഹസായേൽ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഗത്തിനെ യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു പിടിച്ചു; ഹസായേൽ യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെയും വരേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: About this time Hazael king of Aram went up and attacked Gath and captured it. Then he turned to attack Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; then Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ദൃഷ്ടിവെച്ചാറെ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോവാശ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരായ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത്, യെഹോരാം, അഹസ്യാവു എന്നീ യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാർ നിവേദിച്ചിരുന്ന സകലനിവേദിതവസ്തുക്കളും താൻ നിവേദിച്ചിരുന്ന വസ്തുക്കളും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിലും രാജധാനിയിലും ഉള്ള പൊന്നൊക്കെയും എടുത്തു അരാം രാജാവായ ഹസായേലിന്നു കൊടുത്തു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിനെ വിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But Joash king of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his predecessors—Jehoshaphat, Jehoram and Ahaziah, the kings of Judah—and the gifts he himself had dedicated and all the gold found in the treasuries of the temple of the Lord and of the royal palace, and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram, who then withdrew from Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the sacred things that his fathers, Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own sacred things, and all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and in the king’s house, and sent them to Hazael king of Syria. Then he went away from Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and in the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: യോവാശിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of the reign of Joash, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: യോവാശിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ മത്സരിച്ചു കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി സില്ലായിലേക്കു പോകുന്ന വഴിക്കലുള്ള മില്ലോഗൃഹത്തിൽ വെച്ചു അവനെ കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: His officials conspired against him and assassinated him at Beth Millo, on the road down to Silla.
chapters.nkjv: And his servants arose and formed a conspiracy, and killed Joash in the house of the Millo, which goes down to Silla.
chapters.kjv: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യോസാഖാർ, ശോമേരിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോസാബാദ് എന്നീ ഭൃത്യന്മരായിരുന്നു അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നതു. ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടുകൂടെ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ അമസ്യാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The officials who murdered him were Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him. So he died, and they buried him with his fathers in the City of David. Then Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അഹസ്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ യോവാശിന്റെ ഇരുപത്തിമൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ യേഹൂവിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാഹാസ് യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ പതിനേഴു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.
chapters.nkjv: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned seventeen years.
chapters.kjv: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ വിട്ടുമാറാതെ അവയിൽ തന്നേ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord by following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit, and he did not turn away from them.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin. He did not depart from them.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവയുടെ കോപം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവൻ അവരെ അരാംരാജാവായ ഹസായേലിന്റെ കയ്യിലും ഹസായേലിന്റെ മകനായ ബെൻ-ഹദദിന്റെ കയ്യിലും നിരന്തരം വിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel, and for a long time he kept them under the power of Hazael king of Aram and Ben-Hadad his son.
chapters.nkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against Israel, and He delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-Hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
chapters.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെഹോവാഹാസ് യഹോവയോടു കൃപെക്കായി അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അരാംരാജാവു യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഞെരുക്കിയ ഞെരുക്കം യഹോവ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Jehoahaz sought the Lord ’s favor, and the Lord listened to him, for he saw how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehoahaz pleaded with the Lord, and the Lord listened to him; for He saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD , and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഒരു രക്ഷകനെ കൊടുത്തതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ അരാമ്യരുടെ അധികാരത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോയി; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ പണ്ടത്തെപ്പോലെ തങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിൽ വസിപ്പാൻ സംഗതിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord provided a deliverer for Israel, and they escaped from the power of Aram. So the Israelites lived in their own homes as they had before.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord gave Israel a deliverer, so that they escaped from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents as before.
chapters.kjv: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച യൊരോബെയാം ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ അവർ വിട്ടുമാറാതെ അവയിൽ തന്നേ നടന്നു; അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠെക്കു ശമർയ്യയിൽ നീക്കം വന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: But they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit; they continued in them. Also, the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless they did not depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who had made Israel sin, but walked in them; and the wooden image also remained in Samaria.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്നു അമ്പതു കുതിരച്ചേവകരെയും പത്തു രഥങ്ങളെയും പതിനായിരം കാലാളുകളെയും അല്ലാതെ മറ്റു യാതൊരു പടജ്ജനത്തെയും ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചില്ല; അരാംരാജാവു അവരെ നശിപ്പിച്ചു മെതിക്കളത്തിലെ പൊടിപോലെ ആക്കിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Nothing had been left of the army of Jehoahaz except fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers, for the king of Aram had destroyed the rest and made them like the dust at threshing time.
chapters.nkjv: For He left of the army of Jehoahaz only fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers; for the king of Syria had destroyed them and made them like the dust at threshing.
chapters.kjv: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

chapters.ml: യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവന്റെ പരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തിയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoahaz, all he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: യെഹോവാഹാസ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവനെ ശമർയ്യയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ യോവാശ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jehoahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoash his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehoahaz rested with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. Then Joash his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യോവാശിന്റെ മുപ്പത്തേഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകനായ യോവാശ് യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ പതിനൊന്നു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
chapters.nkjv: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned sixteen years.
chapters.kjv: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബയാമിന്റെ സകലപാപങ്ങളെയും അവൻ വിട്ടുമാറാതെ അവയിൽ തന്നേ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he continued in them.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord. He did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin, but walked in them.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD ; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.

chapters.ml: യോവാശിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവോടു യുദ്ധത്തിൽ കാണിച്ച പരാക്രമവും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, all he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: യോവാശ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; യൊരോബെയാം സിംഹാസനം കയറി; യോവാശിനെ ശമർയ്യയിൽ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരോടു കൂടെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Jehoash rested with his ancestors, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So Joash rested with his fathers. Then Jeroboam sat on his throne. And Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു എലീശാ മരണഹേതുകമായ രോഗംപിടിച്ചു കിടന്നു; അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യോവാശ് അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവന്റെ മുഖത്തിന്മീതെ കുനിഞ്ഞു കരഞ്ഞു; എന്റെ പിതാവേ, എന്റെ പിതാവേ, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ തേരും തേരാളികളുമായുള്ളോവേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now Elisha had been suffering from the illness from which he died. Jehoash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. "My father! My father!" he cried. "The chariots and horsemen of Israel!"
chapters.nkjv: Elisha had become sick with the illness of which he would die. Then Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over his face, and said, "O my father, my father, the chariots of Israel and their horsemen!"
chapters.kjv: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.

chapters.ml: എലീശാ അവനോടു: അമ്പും വില്ലും എടുക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ അമ്പും വില്ലും എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Elisha said, "Get a bow and some arrows," and he did so.
chapters.nkjv: And Elisha said to him, "Take a bow and some arrows." So he took himself a bow and some arrows.
chapters.kjv: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിനോടു നിന്റെ കൈ വില്ലിന്മേൽ വെക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ കൈവെച്ചപ്പോൾ എലീശാ തന്റെ കൈ രാജാവിന്റെ കൈമേൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Take the bow in your hands," he said to the king of Israel. When he had taken it, Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to the king of Israel, "Put your hand on the bow." So he put his hand onit, and Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
chapters.kjv: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.

chapters.ml: കിഴക്കെ കിളിവാതിൽ തുറക്ക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അതു തുറന്നപ്പോൾ: എയ്ക എന്നു എലീശാ പറഞ്ഞു. എയ്താറെ അവൻ: അതു യഹോവയുടെ ജയാസ്ത്രം, അരാമ്യർക്കു നേരെയുള്ള ജയാസ്ത്രം തന്നേ; നീ അഫേക്കിൽവെച്ചു അരാമ്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചു അശേഷം സംഹരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Open the east window," he said, and he opened it. "Shoot!" Elisha said, and he shot. "The Lord ’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram!" Elisha declared. "You will completely destroy the Arameans at Aphek."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Open the east window"; and he opened it. Then Elisha said, "Shoot"; and he shot. And he said, "The arrow of the Lord’s deliverance and the arrow of deliverance from Syria; for you must strike the Syrians at Aphek till you have destroyed them."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it . Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD’s deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them .

chapters.ml: അമ്പു എടുക്ക എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ എടുത്തു; നിലത്തടിക്ക എന്നു അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം അടിച്ചു നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "Take the arrows," and the king took them. Elisha told him, "Strike the ground." He struck it three times and stopped.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Take the arrows"; so he took them. And he said to the king of Israel, "Strike the ground"; so he struck three times, and stopped.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them . And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദൈവപുരുഷൻ അവനോടു കോപിച്ചു; നീ അഞ്ചാറു പ്രവാശ്യം അടിക്കേണ്ടിയിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ നീ അരാമ്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചു അശേഷം സംഹരിക്കുമായിരുന്നു; ഇപ്പോഴോ നീ അരാമ്യരെ മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം മാത്രം തോല്പിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The man of God was angry with him and said, "You should have struck the ground five or six times; then you would have defeated Aram and completely destroyed it. But now you will defeat it only three times."
chapters.nkjv: And the man of God was angry with him, and said, "You should have struck five or six times; then you would have struck Syria till you had destroyed it! But now you will strike Syria only three times."
chapters.kjv: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എലീശാ മരിച്ചു; അവർ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; പിറ്റെ ആണ്ടിൽ മോവാബ്യരുടെ പടക്കൂട്ടങ്ങൾ ദേശത്തെ ആക്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Elisha died and was buried. Now Moabite raiders used to enter the country every spring.
chapters.nkjv: Then Elisha died, and they buried him. And the raiding bands from Moab invaded the land in the spring of the year.
chapters.kjv: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

chapters.ml: ചിലർ ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ ഒരു പടക്കൂട്ടത്തെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അയാളെ എലീശാവിന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ ഇട്ടു; അവൻ അതിൽ വീണു എലീശയുടെ അസ്ഥികളെ തൊട്ടപ്പോൾ ജീവിച്ചു കാലൂന്നി എഴുന്നേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb. When the body touched Elisha’s bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, as they were burying a man, that suddenly they spied a band ofraiders; and they put the man in the tomb of Elisha; and when the man was let down and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived and stood on his feet.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ കാലത്തൊക്കെയും അരാമ്യരാജാവായ ഹസായേൽ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ഞെരുക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.
chapters.nkjv: And Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
chapters.kjv: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു അവരോടു കരുണയും മനസ്സലിവും തോന്നി, അബ്രാഹാം, യിസ്ഹാക്, യാക്കോബ് എന്നവരോടുള്ള തന്റെ നിയമംനിമിത്തം അവൻ അവരെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു; അവരെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ അവന്നു മനസ്സായില്ല; ഇതുവരെ തന്റെ സമ്മുഖത്തുനിന്നു അവരെ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: But the Lord was gracious to them and had compassion and showed concern for them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. To this day he has been unwilling to destroy them or banish them from his presence.
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord was gracious to them, had compassion on them, and regarded them, because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not yet destroy them or cast them from His presence.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

chapters.ml: അരാംരാജാവായ ഹസായേൽ മരിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ മകനായ ബെൻ-ഹദദ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Hazael king of Aram died, and Ben-Hadad his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: Now Hazael king of Syria died. Then Ben-Hadad his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാശ് തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യെഹോവാഹാസിനോടു ഹസായേൽ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ പിടിച്ചിരുന്ന പട്ടണങ്ങളെ അവന്റെ മകനായ ബെൻ-ഹദദിനോടു തിരികെ പിടിച്ചു. മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം യോവാശ് അവനെ തോല്പിക്കയും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളെ വീണ്ടുകൊള്ളുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-Hadad son of Hazael the towns he had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Three times Jehoash defeated him, and so he recovered the Israelite towns.
chapters.nkjv: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz recaptured from the hand of Ben-Hadad, the son of Hazael, the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times Joash defeated him and recaptured the cities of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകനായ യോവാശിന്റെ രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യോവാശിന്റെ മകൻ അമസ്യാവു രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the second year of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.nkjv: In the second year of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, became king.
chapters.kjv: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഇരുപത്തൊമ്പതു സംവത്സരം വാണു. യെരൂശലേംകാരത്തിയായ അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു യെഹോവദ്ദാൻ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു. തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദ് എന്നപോലെ അല്ലതാനും; തന്റെ അപ്പനായ യോവാശ് ചെയ്തതു പോലെ ഒക്കെയും അവൻ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father David had done. In everything he followed the example of his father Joash.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, yet not like his father David; he did everything as his father Joash had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും പൂജാഗിരികൾക്കു നീക്കംവന്നില്ല; ജനം പൂജാഗിരികളിൽ യാഗംകഴിച്ചും ധൂപം കാട്ടിയും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
chapters.nkjv: However the high places were not taken away, and the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.

chapters.ml: രാജത്വം അവന്നു സ്ഥിരമായപ്പോൾ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ രാജാവിനെ കൊന്ന ഭൃത്യന്മാരെ അവൻ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, that he executed his servants who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പുത്രന്മാർക്കു പകരം പിതാക്കന്മാരും പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കു പകരം പുത്രന്മാരും മരണശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കരുതു; താന്താന്റെ പാപത്തിന്നു താന്താൻ മരണശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കേണം എന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചതായി മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു അനുസരിച്ചു അവൻ ആ കുലപാതകന്മാരുടെ മക്കളെ കൊല്ലാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Yet he did not put the children of the assassins to death, in accordance with what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses where the Lord commanded: "Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin."
chapters.nkjv: But the children of the murderers he did not execute, according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, in which the Lord commanded, saying, "Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor shall children be put to death for their fathers; but a person shall be put to death for his own sin."
chapters.kjv: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉപ്പുതാഴ്വരയിൽവെച്ചു എദോമ്യരിൽ പതിനായിരം പേരെ കൊന്നു, സേലയെ യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു പിടിച്ചു അതിന്നു യൊക്തെയേൽ എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു; അതു ഇന്നുവരെയും പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was the one who defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and captured Sela in battle, calling it Joktheel, the name it has to this day.
chapters.nkjv: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel to this day.
chapters.kjv: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു അമസ്യാവു യേഹൂവിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകൻ യെഹോവാശ് എന്ന യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: വരിക, നാം തമ്മിൽ ഒന്നു നോക്കുക എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, with the challenge: "Come, let us face each other in battle."
chapters.nkjv: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us face one another inbattle."
chapters.kjv: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യെഹോവാശ് യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവിന്നു മറുപടി പറഞ്ഞയച്ചതു: ലെബാനോനിലെ മുൾപ്പടർപ്പു ലെബാനോനിലെ ദേവദാരുവോടു: നിന്റെ മകളെ എന്റെ മകന്നു ഭാര്യയായി തരിക എന്നു ആളയച്ചു പറയിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ ലെബാനോനിലെ ഒരു കാട്ടുമൃഗം കടന്നുപോകയിൽ മുൾപ്പടർപ്പിനെ ചവിട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.
chapters.nkjv: And Jehoash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife’; and a wild beast that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

chapters.ml: എദോമ്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു നീ നിഗളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; പ്രശംസിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഇരുന്നുകൊൾക; നീയും നിന്നോടുകൂടെ യെഹൂദയും വീഴുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അനർത്ഥത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ചാടുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു? എന്നാൽ അമസ്യാവു കേട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: You have indeed defeated Edom and now you are arrogant. Glory in your victory, but stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"
chapters.nkjv: You have indeed defeated Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Glory inthat, and stay at home; for why should you meddle with trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?"
chapters.kjv: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this , and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാവായ യെഹോവാശ് പുറപ്പെട്ടുചെന്നു, യെഹൂദെക്കുള്ള ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശിൽവെച്ചു അവനും യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവും തമ്മിൽ നേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah, however, would not listen, so Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.
chapters.nkjv: But Amaziah would not heed. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went out; so he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
chapters.kjv: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു തോറ്റു ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
chapters.nkjv: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and every man fled to his tent.
chapters.kjv: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.

chapters.ml: അഹസ്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാശിന്റെ മകൻ അമസ്യാവു എന്ന യെഹൂദാരാജാവിനെ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യെഹോവാശ് ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശിൽവെച്ചു പിടിച്ചിട്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു വന്നു, യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ മതിൽ എഫ്രയീംപടിവാതിൽമുതൽ കോൺപടിവാതിൽവരെ നാനൂറു മുഴം ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh; and he went to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate—four hundred cubits.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലും രാജധാനിയിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിലും കണ്ട പൊന്നും വെള്ളിയുമൊക്കെയും സകലഉപകരങ്ങളും എടുത്തു ജാമ്യക്കാരെയും പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ശമർയ്യയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace. He also took hostages and returned to Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: And he took all the gold and silver, all the articles that were found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

chapters.ml: യെഹോവാശ് ചെയ്ത മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവന്റെ പരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തികളും അവൻ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തതും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, what he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did—his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യെഹോവാശ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു. അവനെ ശമർയ്യയിൽ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jehoash rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And Jeroboam his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehoash rested with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. Then Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാശിന്റെ മരണശേഷം യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യോവാശിന്റെ മകൻ അമസ്യാവു പതിനഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

chapters.ml: അമസ്യാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ അവന്നു വിരോധമായി ഒരു കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടായിട്ടു അവൻ ലാഖീശിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി; എന്നാൽ അവർ അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ലാഖീശിലേക്കു ആളയച്ചു അവിടെവെച്ചു അവനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They conspired against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.
chapters.nkjv: And they formed a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
chapters.kjv: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കുതിരപ്പുറത്തുവെച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു യെരൂശലേമിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He was brought back by horse and was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors, in the City of David.
chapters.nkjv: Then they brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the City of David.
chapters.kjv: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാജനമൊക്കെയും പതിനാറു വയസ്സു പ്രായമുള്ള അസർയ്യാവെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ അമസ്യാവിന്നു പകരം രാജാവാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
chapters.nkjv: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
chapters.kjv: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചശേഷം ഏലത്ത് പണിതതും അതിനെ യെഹൂദെക്കു വീണ്ടുകൊണ്ടതും ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: He built Elath and restored it to Judah, after the king rested with his fathers.
chapters.kjv: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യോവാശിന്റെ മകൻ അമസ്യാവിന്റെ പതിനഞ്ചാം ആണ്ടിൽ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യോവാശിന്റെ മകൻ യൊരോബെയാം രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ നാല്പത്തൊന്നു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel became king in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.
chapters.nkjv: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, became king in Samaria, andreigned forty-one years.
chapters.kjv: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു, യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളൊന്നും വിട്ടുമാറിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: ഗത്ത്-ഹേഫർകാരനായ അമിത്ഥായിയുടെ മകനായ യോനാപ്രവാചകൻ എന്ന തന്റെ ദാസൻ മുഖാന്തരം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനപ്രകാരം അവൻ ഹമാത്തിന്റെ അതിർമുതൽ അരാബയിലെ കടൽവരെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദേശത്തെ വീണ്ടും സ്വാധീനമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He was the one who restored the boundaries of Israel from Lebo Hamath to the Dead Sea, in accordance with the word of the Lord , the God of Israel, spoken through his servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.
chapters.nkjv: He restored the territory of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which He had spoken through His servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet who was from Gath Hepher.
chapters.kjv: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath-hepher.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കഷ്ടത എത്രയും കഠിനം, സ്വതന്ത്രനോ അസ്വതന്ത്രനോ ഇല്ല, യിസ്രായേലിന്നു സഹായം ചെയ്യുന്നവനുമില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ കണ്ടിട്ടു,
chapters.niv: The Lord had seen how bitterly everyone in Israel, whether slave or free, was suffering; there was no one to help them.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord saw that the affliction of Israel was very bitter; and whether bond or free, there was no helper for Israel.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പേർ ആകാശത്തിൻ കീഴിൽനിന്നു മായിച്ചുകളയും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യാതെ യോവാശിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാംമുഖാന്തരം അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And since the Lord had not said he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord did not say that He would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven; but He saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവൻ യുദ്ധംചെയ്തതും യെഹൂദെക്കു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന ദമ്മേശെക്കും ഹമാത്തും യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വീണ്ടുകൊണ്ടതിൽ അവൻ കാണിച്ച പരാക്രമവും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Jeroboam’s reign, all he did, and his military achievements, including how he recovered for Israel both Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did—his might, how he made war, and how he recaptured for Israel, from Damascus and Hamath, whathadbelonged to Judah—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരായ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകനായ സെഖർയ്യാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jeroboam rested with his ancestors, the kings of Israel. And Zechariah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Jeroboam rested with his fathers, the kings of Israel. Then Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ ഇരുപത്തേഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ അസർയ്യാവു രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.nkjv: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah the son of Amaziah, king of Judah, became king.
chapters.kjv: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു പതിനാറു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അമ്പത്തിരണ്ടു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; യെരൂശലേംകാരത്തിയായ അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു യെഖോല്യാ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ അമസ്യാവു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done,
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Amaziah had done;

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും പൂജാഗിരികൾക്കു നീക്കം വന്നില്ല; ജനംപൂജാഗിരികളിൽ യാഗം കഴിച്ചും ധൂപം കാട്ടിയും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
chapters.nkjv: except that the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
chapters.kjv: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ ഈ രാജാവിനെ ബാധിച്ചു. അവൻ ജീവപര്യന്തം കുഷ്ഠരോഗിയായി ഒരു പ്രത്യേകശാലയിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്നു; രാജകുമാരനായ യോഥാം രാജധാനിക്കു വിചാരകനായി ദേശത്തെ ജനത്തിന്നു ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. Jotham the king’s son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord struck the king, so that he was a leper until the day of his death; so he dwelt in an isolated house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the royal house, judging the people of the land.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.

chapters.ml: അസർയ്യാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Azariah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: അസർയ്യാവു തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവർ അവനെ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ യോഥാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Azariah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in the City of David. And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Azariah rested with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the City of David. Then Jotham his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അസർയ്യാവിന്റെ മുപ്പത്തെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ മകനായ സെഖർയ്യാവു യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ ആറു മാസം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned six months.
chapters.nkjv: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
chapters.kjv: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതുചെയ്തു; യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ വിട്ടുമാറിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his predecessors had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, as his fathers had done; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: യാബേശിന്റെ മകനായ ശല്ലൂം അവന്റെ നേരെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽവെച്ചു അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു അവന്നുപകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah. He attacked him in front of the people, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: Then Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck and killed him in front of the people; and he reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: സെഖർയ്യാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The other events of Zechariah’s reign are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യേഹൂവോടു: നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ നാലാം തലമുറവരെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനം ഇതാകുന്നു; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the word of the Lord spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: "Your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."
chapters.nkjv: This was the word of the Lord which He spoke to Jehu, saying, "Your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation." And so it was.
chapters.kjv: This was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation . And so it came to pass.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ഉസ്സീയാവിന്റെ മുപ്പത്തൊമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ യാബേശിന്റെ മകനായ ശല്ലൂം രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ ഒരു മാസം വാണു.
chapters.niv: Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.
chapters.nkjv: Shallum the son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
chapters.kjv: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഗാദിയുടെ മകനായ മെനഹേം തിസ്സയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ശമർയ്യയിൽ വന്നു, യാബേശിന്റെ മകനായ ശല്ലൂമിനെ ശമർയ്യയിൽവെച്ചു വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Then Menahem son of Gadi went from Tirzah up to Samaria. He attacked Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, and struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria and killed him; and he reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ശല്ലൂമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy he led, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and the conspiracy which he led, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

chapters.ml: മെനഹേം തിപ്സഹും അതിലുള്ള സകലവും തിർസ്സാതൊട്ടു അതിന്നു ചേർന്ന പ്രദേശങ്ങളും ശൂന്യമാക്കി; അവർ പട്ടണവാതിൽ തുറന്നു കൊടുക്കായ്കയാൽ അവൻ അതിനെ ശൂന്യമാക്കുകയും അതിലെ ഗർഭിണികളെയൊക്കെയും പിളർന്നുകളകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: At that time Menahem, starting out from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in the city and its vicinity, because they refused to open their gates. He sacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.
chapters.nkjv: Then from Tirzah, Menahem attacked Tiphsah, all who were there, and its territory. Because they did not surrender, therefore he attacked it. All the women there who were with child he ripped open.
chapters.kjv: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him , therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അസർയ്യാവിന്റെ മുപ്പത്തൊമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ ഗാദിയുടെ മകൻ മെനഹേം യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ പത്തു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.
chapters.nkjv: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi became king over Israel, andreigned ten years in Samaria.
chapters.kjv: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ ജീവപര്യന്തം വിട്ടുമാറിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . During his entire reign he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവായ പൂൽ ദേശത്തെ ആക്രമിച്ചു; പൂൽ തന്നെ സഹായിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും രാജത്വം തനിക്കു ഉറക്കേണ്ടതിന്നുമായി മെനഹേം അവന്നു ആയിരം താലന്തു വെള്ളികൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver to gain his support and strengthen his own hold on the kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: Pul king of Assyria came against the land; and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to strengthen the kingdom under his control.
chapters.kjv: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവിന്നു കൊടുപ്പാൻ മെനഹേം ഈ ദ്രവ്യം യിസ്രായേലിലെ ധനവാന്മാരോടൊക്കെയും അമ്പതു ശേക്കെൽ വെള്ളിവീതം പിരിപ്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു ദേശത്തു താമസിക്കാതെ മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Menahem exacted this money from Israel. Every wealthy person had to contribute fifty shekels of silver to be given to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria withdrew and stayed in the land no longer.
chapters.nkjv: And Menahem exacted the money from Israel, from all the very wealthy, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and did not stay there in the land.
chapters.kjv: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.

chapters.ml: മെനഹേമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Menahem’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

chapters.ml: മെനഹേം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകനായ പെക്കഹ്യാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Menahem rested with his ancestors. And Pekahiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Menahem rested with his fathers. Then Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അസർയ്യാവിന്റെ അമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ മെനഹേമിന്റെ മകനായ പെക്കഹ്യാവു യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned two years.
chapters.nkjv: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned two years.
chapters.kjv: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ വിട്ടുമാറിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Pekahiah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ അകമ്പടിനായകനായി രെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ പേക്കഫ് അവന്റെ നേരെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി, ഗിലെയാദ്യരിൽ അമ്പതുപേരെ തുണകൂട്ടി ശമർയ്യാരാജധാനിയുടെ കോട്ടയിൽവെച്ചു അവനെ അര്ഗ്ഗോബിനോടും അർയ്യേയോടുംകൂടെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: One of his chief officers, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him. Taking fifty men of Gilead with him, he assassinated Pekahiah, along with Argob and Arieh, in the citadel of the royal palace at Samaria. So Pekah killed Pekahiah and succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pekah the son of Remaliah, an officer of his, conspired against him and killed him in Samaria, in the citadel of the king’s house, along with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of Gilead. He killed him and reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

chapters.ml: പെക്കഹ്യാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The other events of Pekahiah’s reign, and all he did, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അസർയ്യാവിന്റെ അമ്പത്തിരണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ രെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ പേക്കഹ് യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ ഇരുപതു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twenty years.
chapters.nkjv: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned twenty years.
chapters.kjv: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു, യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെ വിട്ടുമാറിയതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ പേക്കഹിന്റെ കാലത്തു അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ തിഗ്ളത്ത്-പിലേസർ വന്നു ഈയോനും ആബേൽ-ബേത്ത്-മയഖയും യാനോവഹും കേദെശൂം ഹാസോരും ഗിലെയാദും ഗെലീലയും നഫ്താലിദേശം മുഴുവനും പിടിച്ചു നിവാസികളെ ബദ്ധരാക്കി അശ്ശൂരിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: In the time of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maakah, Janoah, Kedesh and Hazor. He took Gilead and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and deported the people to Assyria.
chapters.nkjv: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maachah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.
chapters.kjv: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏലാവിന്റെ മകനായ ഹോശേയരെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ പേക്കഹിന്റെ നേരെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി, അവനെ ഉസ്സീയാവിന്റെ മകനായ യോഥാമിന്റെ ഇരുപതാം ആണ്ടിൽ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Then Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah. He attacked and assassinated him, and then succeeded him as king in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hoshea the son of Elah led a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and struck and killed him; so he reigned in his place in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
chapters.kjv: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

chapters.ml: പേക്കഹിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Pekah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ രെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ പേക്കഹിന്റെ രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ഉസ്സീയാവിന്റെ മകൻ യോഥാം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the second year of Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.nkjv: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, began to reign.
chapters.kjv: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പതിനാറു സംവത്സരം വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു യെരൂശാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ സാദോക്കിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
chapters.nkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
chapters.kjv: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഉസ്സീയാവു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord; he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും പൂജാഗിരികൾക്കു നീക്കം വന്നില്ല; ജനം പൂജാഗിരികളിൽ യാഗം കഴിച്ചും ധൂപം കാട്ടിയും പോന്നു; അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ മേലത്തെ വാതിൽ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: However the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places. He built the Upper Gate of the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യോഥാമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Jotham’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യഹോവ അരാംരാജാവായ രെസീനെയും രെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ പേക്കഹിനെയും യെഹൂദെക്കു നേരെ അയച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: (In those days the Lord began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)
