chapters.nkjv: In those days the Lord began to send Rezin king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
chapters.kjv: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

chapters.ml: യോഥാം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്ര പ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ ആഹാസ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David, the city of his father. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Jotham rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father. Then Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: രെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ പേക്കഹിന്റെ പതിനേഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യോഥാമിന്റെ മകൻ ആഹാസ് രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.nkjv: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham, king of Judah, began to reign.
chapters.kjv: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പതിനാറു സംവത്സരം വാണു, തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദ്, ചെയ്തതുപോലെ തന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God.
chapters.nkjv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not do whatwas right in the sight of the Lord his God, as his father David haddone.
chapters.kjv: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വഴിയിൽ നടന്നു; യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞ ജാതികളുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛതകൾക്കൊത്തവണ്ണം തന്റെ മകനെ അഗ്നിപ്രവേശവും ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel; indeed he made his son pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had cast out from before the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൂജാഗിരികളിലും കുന്നുകളിലും പച്ചവൃക്ഷത്തിൻ കീഴിലൊക്കെയും ബലി കഴിച്ചും ധൂപം കാട്ടിയും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.
chapters.nkjv: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
chapters.kjv: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

chapters.ml: അക്കാലത്തു അരാംരാജാവായ രെസീനും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ രെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ പേക്കഹും യെരൂശലേമിന്നു നേരെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു ആഹാസിനെ നിരോധിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ അവനെ ജയിപ്പാൻ അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem and besieged Ahaz, but they could not overpower him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem to make war; and they besieged Ahaz but could not overcome him.
chapters.kjv: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him .

chapters.ml: അന്നു അരാംരാജാവായ രെസീൻ ഏലത്ത് വീണ്ടെടുത്തു അരാമിനോടു ചേർത്തു യെഹൂദന്മാരെ ഏലത്തിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അരാമ്യർ ഏലത്തിൽ വന്നു ഇന്നുവരെയും അവിടെ പാർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At that time, Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram by driving out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath and have lived there to this day.
chapters.nkjv: At that time Rezin king of Syria captured Elath for Syria, and drove the men of Judah from Elath. Then the Edomites went to Elath, and dwell there to this day.
chapters.kjv: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ തിഗ്ളത്ത്-പിലേസരിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ദാസനും നിന്റെ പുത്രനും ആകുന്നു; നീ വന്നു എന്നോടു എതിർത്തിരിക്കുന്ന അരാംരാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമെന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Ahaz sent messengers to say to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, "I am your servant and vassal. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Aram and of the king of Israel, who are attacking me."
chapters.nkjv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, saying, "I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hand of the king of Syria and from the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me."
chapters.kjv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നായിട്ടു ആഹാസ് യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലും രാജധാനിയിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിലും കണ്ട വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും എടുത്തു അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവിന്നു സമ്മാനമായി കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.
chapters.nkjv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasuries of the king’s house, and sent itas a present to the king of Assyria.
chapters.kjv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു അവന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടു; അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു ദമ്മേശെക്കിലേക്കു ചെന്നു അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു അതിലെ നിവാസികളെ കീരിലേക്കു ബദ്ധരായി കൊണ്ടുപോയി രെസീനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king of Assyria complied by attacking Damascus and capturing it. He deported its inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.
chapters.nkjv: So the king of Assyria heeded him; for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, carried itspeople captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ തിഗ്ളത്ത്-പിലേസരിനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽ ചെന്നു, ദമ്മേശെക്കിലെ ബലിപീഠം കണ്ടു; ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു ബലിപീഠത്തിന്റെ ഒരു പ്രതിമയും അതിന്റെ എല്ലാപണിയോടുംകൂടിയുള്ള മാതൃകയും ഊരീയാപുരോഹിതന്നു കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He saw an altar in Damascus and sent to Uriah the priest a sketch of the altar, with detailed plans for its construction.
chapters.nkjv: Now King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the design of the altar and its pattern, according to all its workmanship.
chapters.kjv: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

chapters.ml: ഊരീയാപുരോഹിതൻ ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിതു; ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽനിന്നു അയച്ചപ്രകാരമൊക്കെയും ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽനിന്നു വരുമ്പോഴെക്കു ഊരീയാപുരോഹിതൻ അതു പണിതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Uriah the priest built an altar in accordance with all the plans that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus and finished it before King Ahaz returned.
chapters.nkjv: Then Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus. So Urijah the priest made it before King Ahaz came back from Damascus.
chapters.kjv: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ദമ്മേശെക്കിൽനിന്നു വന്നപ്പോൾ ആ യാഗപീഠം കണ്ടു; രാജാവു യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ ചെന്നു അതിന്മേൽ കയറി.
chapters.niv: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.
chapters.nkjv: And when the king came back from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king approached the altar and made offerings on it.
chapters.kjv: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗവും ഭോജനയാഗവും ദഹിപ്പിച്ചു പാനീയയാഗവും പകർന്നു സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളുടെ രക്തവും യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ തളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He offered up his burnt offering and grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and splashed the blood of his fellowship offerings against the altar.
chapters.nkjv: So he burned his burnt offering and his grain offering; and he poured his drink offering and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
chapters.kjv: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിലെ താമ്രയാഗപീഠം അവൻ ആലയത്തിന്റെ മുൻ വശത്തു തന്റെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേനിന്നു നീക്കി തന്റെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ വടക്കുവശത്തു കൊണ്ടു പോയി വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As for the bronze altar that stood before the Lord , he brought it from the front of the temple—from between the new altar and the temple of the Lord —and put it on the north side of the new altar.
chapters.nkjv: He also brought the bronze altar which was before the Lord, from the front of the temple—from between the new altar and the house of the Lord—and put it on the north side of the new altar.
chapters.kjv: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the LORD , from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD , and put it on the north side of the altar.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് രാജാവു ഊരീയാ പുരോഹിതനോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: മഹായാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ നീ രാവിലത്തെ ഹോമയാഗവും വൈകുന്നേരത്തെ ഭോജനയാഗവും രാജാവിന്റെ ഹോമയാഗവും ഭോജനയാഗവും ദേശത്തെ സകലജനത്തിന്റെയും ഹോമയാഗവും ഭോജനയാഗവും ദഹിപ്പിക്കയും അവരുടെ പാനീയയാഗങ്ങൾ കഴിക്കയും ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളുടെയും ഹനനയാഗങ്ങളുടെയും രക്തമൊക്കെയും തളിക്കയും ചെയ്യേണം; താമ്രയാഗപീഠത്തെപ്പറ്റിയോ ഞാൻ ആലോചിച്ചു കൊള്ളാം.
chapters.niv: King Ahaz then gave these orders to Uriah the priest: "On the large new altar, offer the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their grain offering and their drink offering. Splash against this altar the blood of all the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar for seeking guidance."
chapters.nkjv: Then King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, "On the great new altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his grain offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their grain offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering and all the blood of the sacrifice. And the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by."
chapters.kjv: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by .

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും ഊരീയാപുരോഹിതൻ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had ordered.
chapters.nkjv: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.
chapters.kjv: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു പീഠങ്ങളുടെ ചട്ടപ്പലക കണ്ടിച്ചു തൊട്ടിയെ അവയുടെ മേൽനിന്നു നീക്കി; താമ്രക്കടലിനെയും അതിന്റെ കീഴെ നിന്ന താമ്രക്കാളപ്പുറത്തുനിന്നു ഇറക്കി ഒരു കല്ത്തളത്തിന്മേൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: King Ahaz cut off the side panels and removed the basins from the movable stands. He removed the Sea from the bronze bulls that supported it and set it on a stone base.
chapters.nkjv: And King Ahaz cut off the panels of the carts, and removed the lavers from them; and he took down the Sea from the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stones.
chapters.kjv: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

chapters.ml: ആലയത്തിങ്കൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന ശബ്ബത്ത് താഴ്വാരവും രാജാവിന്നു പ്രവേശിപ്പാനുള്ള പുറത്തെ നടയും അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിനെ വിചാരിച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിങ്കൽനിന്നു മാറ്റിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He took away the Sabbath canopy that had been built at the temple and removed the royal entryway outside the temple of the Lord , in deference to the king of Assyria.
chapters.nkjv: Also he removed the Sabbath pavilion which they had built in the temple, and he removed the king’s outer entrance from the house of the Lord, on account of the king of Assyria.
chapters.kjv: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് ചെയ്ത മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of the reign of Ahaz, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഹിസ്കീയാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Ahaz rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David. Then Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആഹാസിന്റെ പന്ത്രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ ഏലയുടെ മകനായ ഹോശേയ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി ശമർയ്യയിൽ ഒമ്പതു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned nine years.
chapters.nkjv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, andhereigned nine years.
chapters.kjv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; തനിക്കു മുമ്പുള്ള യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ അല്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, but not as the kings of Israel who were before him.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ നേരെ അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവായ ശൽമനേസെർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വന്നു; ഹോശേയ അവന്നു ആശ്രിതനായിത്തീർന്നു കപ്പം കൊടുത്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up to attack Hoshea, who had been Shalmaneser’s vassal and had paid him tribute.
chapters.nkjv: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his vassal, and paid him tribute money.
chapters.kjv: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹോശേയ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ സോവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയക്കയും അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്നു ആണ്ടുതോറുമുള്ള കപ്പം കൊടുത്തയക്കാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്തതുനിമിത്തം അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവു അവനിൽ ദ്രോഹം കണ്ടിട്ടു അവനെ പിടിച്ചു ബന്ധിച്ചു കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was a traitor, for he had sent envoys to So king of Egypt, and he no longer paid tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore Shalmaneser seized him and put him in prison.
chapters.nkjv: And the king of Assyria uncovered a conspiracy by Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So, king of Egypt, and brought no tribute to the king of Assyria, as hehaddone year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു രാജ്യത്തു എല്ലാടവും കൂടി കടന്നു ശമർയ്യയിലേക്കു വന്നു അതിനെ മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം നിരോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king of Assyria invaded the entire land, marched against Samaria and laid siege to it for three years.
chapters.nkjv: Now the king of Assyria went throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria and besieged it for three years.
chapters.kjv: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

chapters.ml: ഹോശേയയുടെ ഒമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു ശമർയ്യയെ പിടിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിനെ ബദ്ധരാക്കി അശ്ശൂരിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി, ഹലഹിലും ഗോസാൻ നദീതീരത്തിലെ ഹാബോരിലും മേദ്യരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും പാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and deported the Israelites to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in the towns of the Medes.
chapters.nkjv: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah and by the Habor, the River of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
chapters.kjv: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ തങ്ങളെ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോന്റെ കൈക്കീഴിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടടുവിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു പാപം ചെയ്തു അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ ഭജിക്കയും
chapters.niv: All this took place because the Israelites had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of Egypt from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods
chapters.nkjv: For so it was that the children of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and they had feared other gods,
chapters.kjv: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞിരുന്ന ജാതികളുടെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെയും അവയെ നടപ്പാക്കിയ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെയും അനുസരിച്ചുനടക്കയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു ഇങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and followed the practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before them, as well as the practices that the kings of Israel had introduced.
chapters.nkjv: and had walked in the statutes of the nations whom the Lord had cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
chapters.kjv: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു വിരോധമായി കൊള്ളരുതാത്തകാര്യങ്ങളെ രഹസ്യമായി ചെയ്തു കാവൽക്കാരുടെ ഗോപുരംമുതൽ ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണംവരെ തങ്ങളുടെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളിലും പൂജാഗിരികൾ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites secretly did things against the Lord their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city they built themselves high places in all their towns.
chapters.nkjv: Also the children of Israel secretly did against the Lord their God things that were not right, and they built for themselves high places in all their cities, from watchtower to fortified city.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഉയർന്ന കുന്നിന്മേലൊക്കെയും പച്ചവൃക്ഷത്തിൻ കീഴിലൊക്കെയും വിഗ്രഹസ്തംഭങ്ങളും അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠകളും സ്ഥാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They set up sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.
chapters.nkjv: They set up for themselves sacred pillars and wooden images on every high hill and under every green tree.
chapters.kjv: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു നീക്കക്കളഞ്ഞിരുന്ന ജാതികളെപ്പോലെ അവർ സകലപൂജാഗിരികളിലും ധൂപം കാട്ടി യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ദോഷമായുള്ള കാര്യങ്ങളെ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At every high place they burned incense, as the nations whom the Lord had driven out before them had done. They did wicked things that aroused the Lord ’s anger.
chapters.nkjv: There they burned incense on all the high places, like the nations whom the Lord had carried away before them; and they did wicked things to provoke the Lord to anger,
chapters.kjv: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:

chapters.ml: ഈ കാര്യം ചെയ്യരുതു എന്നു യഹോവ അവരോടു വിലക്കിയിരുന്ന വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ അവർ ചെന്നു സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They worshiped idols, though the Lord had said, "You shall not do this."
chapters.nkjv: for they served idols, of which the Lord had said to them, "You shall not do this thing."
chapters.kjv: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ സകലപ്രവാചകന്മാരും ദർശകന്മാരും മുഖാന്തരം യിസ്രായേലിനോടും യെഹൂദയോടും: നിങ്ങളുടെ ദുർമ്മാർഗ്ഗങ്ങളെ വിട്ടു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു കല്പിച്ചതും എന്റെ ദാസന്മാരായ പ്രവാചകന്മാർമുഖാന്തരം നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയച്ചുതന്നതുമായ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണമൊക്കെയും എന്റെ കല്പനകളും ചട്ടങ്ങളും പ്രമാണിച്ചുനടപ്പിൻ എന്നു സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through all his prophets and seers: "Turn from your evil ways. Observe my commands and decrees, in accordance with the entire Law that I commanded your ancestors to obey and that I delivered to you through my servants the prophets."
chapters.nkjv: Yet the Lord testified against Israel and against Judah, by all of His prophets, every seer, saying, "Turn from your evil ways, and keep My commandments and My statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by My servants the prophets."
chapters.kjv: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവർ കേൾക്കാതെ തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കാതിരുന്ന പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ ദുശ്ശാഠ്യം കാണിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: But they would not listen and were as stiff-necked as their ancestors, who did not trust in the Lord their God.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless they would not hear, but stiffened their necks, like the necks of their fathers, who did not believe in the Lord their God.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെയും അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു അവൻ ചെയ്ത നിയമത്തെയും അവൻ അവരോടു സാക്ഷീകരിച്ച സാക്ഷ്യങ്ങളെയും നിരസിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; അവർ വ്യാജത്തെ പിന്തുടർന്നു വ്യർത്ഥന്മാരായിത്തീർന്നു; അവരെപ്പോലെ ആചരിക്കരുതു എന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്ന ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ജാതികളെ തന്നേ അവർ പിന്തുടർന്നു.
chapters.niv: They rejected his decrees and the covenant he had made with their ancestors and the statutes he had warned them to keep. They followed worthless idols and themselves became worthless. They imitated the nations around them although the Lord had ordered them, "Do not do as they do."
chapters.nkjv: And they rejected His statutes and His covenant that He had made with their fathers, and His testimonies which He had testified against them; they followed idols, became idolaters, and went after the nations who were all around them, concerning whom the Lord had charged them that they should not do like them.
chapters.kjv: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനകളെ ഒക്കെയും ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു തങ്ങൾക്കു രണ്ടു കാളക്കുട്ടികളുടെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ വാർപ്പിച്ചു അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ആകാശത്തിലെ സർവ്വസൈന്യത്തെയും നമസ്കരിച്ചു ബാലിനെയും സേവിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They forsook all the commands of the Lord their God and made for themselves two idols cast in the shape of calves, and an Asherah pole. They bowed down to all the starry hosts, and they worshiped Baal.
chapters.nkjv: So they left all the commandments of the Lord their God, made for themselves a molded image and two calves, made a wooden image and worshiped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
chapters.kjv: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും അഗ്നിപ്രവേശം ചെയ്യിച്ചു പ്രശ്നവും ആഭിചാരവും പ്രയോഗിച്ചു യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്നു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്‍വാൻ തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ വിറ്റുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire. They practiced divination and sought omens and sold themselves to do evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.
chapters.nkjv: And they caused their sons and daughters to pass through the fire, practiced witchcraft and soothsaying, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
chapters.kjv: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

chapters.ml: അതുനിമിത്തം യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു ഏറ്റവും കോപിച്ചു അവരെ തന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; യെഹൂദാഗോത്രം മാത്രമല്ലാതെ ആരും ശേഷിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: So the Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah was left,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them from His sight; there was none left but the tribe of Judah alone.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയും തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനകളെ പ്രമാണിക്കാതെ യിസ്രായേൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ചട്ടങ്ങളെ അനുസരിച്ചു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: and even Judah did not keep the commands of the Lord their God. They followed the practices Israel had introduced.
chapters.nkjv: Also Judah did not keep the commandments of the Lord their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
chapters.kjv: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽസന്തതിയെ മുഴുവനും തള്ളി അവരെ താഴ്ത്തി, കൊള്ളയിടുന്നവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു, ഒടുവിൽ അവരെ തന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Therefore the Lord rejected all the people of Israel; he afflicted them and gave them into the hands of plunderers, until he thrust them from his presence.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord rejected all the descendants of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of plunderers, until He had cast them from His sight.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ദാവീദ് ഗൃഹത്തിങ്കൽനിന്നു പറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; അവർ നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിനെ രാജാവാക്കി; യൊരോബെയാം യിസ്രായേലിനെ യഹോവയെ വിട്ടുമാറുമാറാക്കി അവരെക്കൊണ്ടു വലിയോരു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam enticed Israel away from following the Lord and caused them to commit a great sin.
chapters.nkjv: For He tore Israel from the house of David, and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king. Then Jeroboam drove Israel from following the Lord, and made them commit a great sin.
chapters.kjv: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD , and made them sin a great sin.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ യൊരോബെയാം ചെയ്ത സകലപാപങ്ങളിലും നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites persisted in all the sins of Jeroboam and did not turn away from them
chapters.nkjv: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they did not depart from them,
chapters.kjv: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

chapters.ml: അവർ അവയെ വിട്ടുമാറായ്കയാൽ യഹോവ പ്രാവചകന്മാരായ തന്റെ സകലദാസന്മാരും മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തപ്രാകരം ഒടുവിൽ യിസ്രായേലിനെ തന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു. ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽ സ്വദേശം വിട്ടു അശ്ശൂരിലേക്കു പോകേണ്ടിവന്നു; ഇന്നുവരെ അവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: until the Lord removed them from his presence, as he had warned through all his servants the prophets. So the people of Israel were taken from their homeland into exile in Assyria, and they are still there.
chapters.nkjv: until the Lord removed Israel out of His sight, as He had said by all His servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away from their own land to Assyria, asitis to this day.
chapters.kjv: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവു ബാബേൽ, കൂഥാ, അവ്വ, ഹമാത്ത്, സെഫർവ്വയീം എന്നിവിടങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു ആളുകളെ വരുത്തി യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കു പകരം ശമർയ്യാപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ പാർപ്പിച്ചു; അവർ ശമർയ്യകൈവശമാക്കി അതിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Kuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took over Samaria and lived in its towns.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Ava, Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they took possession of Samaria and dwelt in its cities.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവിടെ പാർപ്പാൻ തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ യഹോവയെ ഭജിച്ചില്ല; അതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ സിംഹങ്ങളെ അയച്ചു; അവ അവരിൽ ചിലരെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they first lived there, they did not worship the Lord ; so he sent lions among them and they killed some of the people.
chapters.nkjv: And it was so, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they did not fear the Lord; therefore the Lord sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
chapters.kjv: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD : therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവിനെ അറിയിച്ചതു: നീ കുടിനീക്കി ശമർയ്യാപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ പാർപ്പിച്ച ജാതികൾ ആദേശത്തിലെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മാർഗ്ഗം അറിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ സിംഹങ്ങളെ അയച്ചു; അവർ ആ ദേശത്തിലെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മാർഗ്ഗം അറിയായ്കയാൽ അവ അവരെ കൊന്നുകളയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It was reported to the king of Assyria: "The people you deported and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know what the god of that country requires. He has sent lions among them, which are killing them off, because the people do not know what he requires."
chapters.nkjv: So they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, "The nations whom you have removed and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know the rituals of the God of the land; therefore He has sent lions among them, and indeed, they are killing them because they do not know the rituals of the God of the land."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവു: നിങ്ങൾ അവിടെനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ അവിടേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോകുവിൻ; അവർ ചെന്നു അവിടെ പാർക്കയും അവർ ആ ദേശത്തെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മാർഗ്ഗം അവരെ ഉപദേശിക്കയും ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the king of Assyria gave this order: "Have one of the priests you took captive from Samaria go back to live there and teach the people what the god of the land requires."
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, "Send there one of the priests whom you brought from there; let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the rituals of the God of the land."
chapters.kjv: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ശമർയ്യയിൽനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപോയിരുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ വന്നു ബേഥേലിൽ പാർത്തു; യഹോവയെ ഭജിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന വിധം അവർക്കു ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So one of the priests who had been exiled from Samaria came to live in Bethel and taught them how to worship the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear the LORD .

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അതതു ജാതി താന്താന്റെ ദേവന്മാരെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി, ഓരോ ജാതി പാർത്തുവന്ന പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ ശമർയ്യർ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന പൂജാഗിരിക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളിൽ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, each national group made its own gods in the several towns where they settled, and set them up in the shrines the people of Samaria had made at the high places.
chapters.nkjv: However every nation continued to make gods of its own, and put them in the shrines on the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in the cities where they dwelt.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

chapters.ml: ബാബേൽകാർ സുക്കോത്ത്-ബെനോത്തിനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; കൂഥക്കാർ നേർഗാലിനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ഹമാത്ത്കാർ അശീമയെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി;
chapters.niv: The people from Babylon made Sukkoth Benoth, those from Kuthah made Nergal, and those from Hamath made Ashima;
chapters.nkjv: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, the men of Cuth made Nergal, the men of Hamath made Ashima,
chapters.kjv: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

chapters.ml: അവ്വക്കാർ നിബ്ഹസിനെയും തർത്തക്കിനെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; സെഫർവ്വക്കാർ സെഫർവ്വയീംദേവന്മാരായ അദ്രമേലെക്കിന്നും അനമേലെക്കിന്നും തങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളെ അഗ്നിപ്രവേശനം ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire as sacrifices to Adrammelek and Anammelek, the gods of Sepharvaim.
chapters.nkjv: and the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
chapters.kjv: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

chapters.ml: അവർ യഹോവയെ ഭജിക്കയും തങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ പൂജാഗിരിപുരോഹിതന്മാരെ നിയമിക്കയും അവർ അവർക്കു വേണ്ടി പൂജാഗിരിക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളിൽ യാഗം കഴിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: They worshiped the Lord , but they also appointed all sorts of their own people to officiate for them as priests in the shrines at the high places.
chapters.nkjv: So they feared the Lord, and from every class they appointed for themselves priests of the high places, who sacrificed for them in the shrines of the high places.
chapters.kjv: So they feared the LORD , and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ യഹോവയെ ഭജിക്കയും തങ്ങൾ വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോന്ന ജാതികളുടെ മര്യാദപ്രകാരം സ്വന്ത ദേവന്മാരെ സേവിക്കയും ചെയ്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They worshiped the Lord , but they also served their own gods in accordance with the customs of the nations from which they had been brought.
chapters.nkjv: They feared the Lord, yet served their own gods—according to the rituals of the nations from among whom they were carried away.
chapters.kjv: They feared the LORD , and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

chapters.ml: ഇന്നുവരെയും അവർ മുമ്പിലത്തെ മര്യാദപ്രകാരം തന്നേ ചെയ്യുന്നു; യഹോവയെ ഭജിക്കുന്നില്ല; തങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്തചട്ടങ്ങളെയും മാർഗ്ഗവിധികളെയും ആകട്ടെ, യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽ എന്നു പേർവിളിച്ച യക്കോബിന്റെ മക്കളോടു കല്പിച്ച ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തെയും കല്പനയെയുമാകട്ടെ അനുസരിച്ചുനടക്കുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: To this day they persist in their former practices. They neither worship the Lord nor adhere to the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands that the Lord gave the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel.
chapters.nkjv: To this day they continue practicing the former rituals; they do not fear the Lord, nor do they follow their statutes or their ordinances, or the law and commandment which the Lord had commanded the children of Jacob, whom He named Israel,
chapters.kjv: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD , neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവരോടു ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്തു കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ ഭജിക്കയും അവെക്കു യാഗംകഴിക്കയും ചെയ്യാതെ
chapters.niv: When the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites, he commanded them: "Do not worship any other gods or bow down to them, serve them or sacrifice to them.
chapters.nkjv: with whom the Lord had made a covenant and charged them, saying: "You shall not fear other gods, nor bow down to them nor serve them nor sacrifice to them;
chapters.kjv: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെ മഹാശക്തികൊണ്ടും നീട്ടിയ ഭുജംകൊണ്ടും മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന യഹോവയെ മാത്രം ഭജിക്കയും അവനെ മാത്രം നമസ്കരിക്കയും അവന്നു മാത്രം യാഗംകഴിക്കയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: But the Lord , who brought you up out of Egypt with mighty power and outstretched arm, is the one you must worship. To him you shall bow down and to him offer sacrifices.
chapters.nkjv: but the Lord, who brought you up from the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm, Him you shall fear, Him you shall worship, and to Him you shall offer sacrifice.
chapters.kjv: But the LORD , who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എഴുതിത്തന്ന ചട്ടങ്ങളെയും ന്യായങ്ങളെയും ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തെയും കല്പനയെയും നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാനാളും പ്രമാണിച്ചുനടക്കേണം; അന്യദൈവങ്ങളെ ഭജിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: You must always be careful to keep the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands he wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.
chapters.nkjv: And the statutes, the ordinances, the law, and the commandment which He wrote for you, you shall be careful to observe forever; you shall not fear other gods.
chapters.kjv: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ചെയ്ത നിയമം നിങ്ങൾ മറക്കരുതു; അന്യ ദൈവങ്ങളെ ഭജിക്കയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you, and do not worship other gods.
chapters.nkjv: And the covenant that I have made with you, you shall not forget, nor shall you fear other gods.
chapters.kjv: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ മാത്രം നിങ്ങൾ ഭജിക്കേണം; എന്നാൽ അവൻ നിങ്ങളെ നിങ്ങളുടെ സകലശത്രുക്കളുടെയും കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Rather, worship the Lord your God; it is he who will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies."
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord your God you shall fear; and He will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies."
chapters.kjv: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവർ കേൾക്കാതെ തങ്ങളുടെ പണ്ടത്തെ മര്യാദ അനുസരിച്ചു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: They would not listen, however, but persisted in their former practices.
chapters.nkjv: However they did not obey, but they followed their former rituals.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഈ ജാതികൾ യഹോവയെ ഭജിക്കയും തങ്ങളുടെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ സേവിക്കയും ചെയ്തു; പിതാക്കന്മാർ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ പുത്രന്മാരും പൌത്രന്മാരും ഇന്നുവരെ ചെയ്തുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Even while these people were worshiping the Lord , they were serving their idols. To this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their ancestors did.
chapters.nkjv: So these nations feared the Lord, yet served their carved images; also their children and their children’s children have continued doing as their fathers did, even to this day.
chapters.kjv: So these nations feared the LORD , and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രയേൽരാജാവായ ഏലയുടെ മകനായ ഹോശേയയുടെ മൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ആഹാസിന്റെ മകൻ ഹിസ്കീയാവു രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea the son of Elah, king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz, king of Judah, began to reign.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഇരുപത്തൊമ്പതു സംവത്സരം വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു അബി എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ സെഖർയ്യാവിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.nkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.kjv: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദ് ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that David his father did.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൂജാഗിരികളെ നീക്കി വിഗ്രഹസ്തംഭങ്ങളെ തകർത്തു അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠയെ വെട്ടിമുറിച്ചു മോശെ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ താമ്രസർപ്പത്തെയും ഉടെച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; ആ കാലംവരെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ അതിന്നു ധൂപം കാട്ടിവന്നു; അതിന്നു നെഹുഷ്ഠാൻ എന്നു പേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He removed the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke into pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had been burning incense to it. (It was called Nehushtan. )
chapters.nkjv: He removed the high places and broke the sacred pillars, cut down the wooden image and broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made; for until those days the children of Israel burned incense to it, and called it Nehushtan.
chapters.kjv: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിൽ ആശ്രയിച്ചു; അവന്നു മുമ്പും പിമ്പും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന സകല യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരിലും ആരും അവനോടു തുല്യനായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel. There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, either before him or after him.
chapters.nkjv: He trusted in the Lord God of Israel, so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor who were before him.
chapters.kjv: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയോടു ചേർന്നിരുന്നു അവനെ വിട്ടു പിന്മാറാതെ യഹോവ മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ച അവന്റെ കല്പനകളെ പ്രമാണിച്ചുനടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He held fast to the Lord and did not stop following him; he kept the commands the Lord had given Moses.
chapters.nkjv: For he held fast to the Lord; he did not depart from following Him, but kept His commandments, which the Lord had commanded Moses.
chapters.kjv: For he clave to the LORD , and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ചെന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും കൃതാർത്ഥനായ്‍വന്നു; അവൻ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു അവനെ സേവിക്കാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the Lord was with him; he was successful in whatever he undertook. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord was with him; he prospered wherever he went. And he rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ ഗസ്സയോളം തോല്പിച്ചു; കാവൽക്കാരുടെ ഗോപുരംമുതൽ ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണംവരെയുള്ള അതിന്റെ പ്രദേശത്തെ ശൂന്യമാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: From watchtower to fortified city, he defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory.
chapters.nkjv: He subdued the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory, from watchtower to fortified city.
chapters.kjv: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ഏലയുടെ മകൻ ഹോശേയയുടെ ഏഴാം ആണ്ടായി ഹിസ്കീയാരാജാവിന്റെ നാലാം ആണ്ടിൽ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ ശല്മനേസെർ ശമർയ്യയുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വന്നു അതിനെ നിരോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In King Hezekiah’s fourth year, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea the son of Elah, king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം അവർ അതു പിടിച്ചു; ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്റെ ആറം ആണ്ടിൽ, യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ഹോശേയയുടെ ഒമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ തന്നേ, ശമർയ്യ പിടിക്കപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: At the end of three years the Assyrians took it. So Samaria was captured in Hezekiah’s sixth year, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And at the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is, the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
chapters.kjv: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു യിസ്രായേലിനെ അശ്ശൂരിലേക്കു പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുപോയി ഹലഹിലും ഗോസാൻ നദീതീരത്തുള്ള ഹാബോരിലും മേദ്യരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും പാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king of Assyria deported Israel to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in towns of the Medes.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Assyria carried Israel away captive to Assyria, and put them in Halah and by the Habor, the River of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,
chapters.kjv: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടനുസരിക്കാതെ അവന്റെ നിയമവും യഹോവയുടെ ദാസനായ മോശെ കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും ലംഘിച്ചുകളകയാൽ തന്നേ; അവർ അതു കേൾക്കയോ അനുസരിക്കയോ ചെയ്തിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: This happened because they had not obeyed the Lord their God, but had violated his covenant—all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded. They neither listened to the commands nor carried them out.
chapters.nkjv: because they did not obey the voice of the Lord their God, but transgressed His covenant and all that Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded; and they would neither hear nor do them.
chapters.kjv: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them , nor do them .

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്റെ പതിന്നാലാം ആണ്ടിൽ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ സൻ ഹേരീബ് യെഹൂദയിലെ ഉറപ്പുള്ള എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളുടെയും നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു അവയെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
chapters.nkjv: And in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
chapters.kjv: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ഹിസ്കീയാവു ലാഖീശിൽ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: ഞാൻ കുറ്റം ചെയ്തു; എന്നെ വിട്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകേണം; നീ എനിക്കു കല്പിക്കുന്ന പിഴ ഞാൻ അടെച്ചു കൊള്ളാം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു. അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്നു മുന്നൂറു താലന്തു വെള്ളിയും മുപ്പതു താലന്ത് പൊന്നും പിഴ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish: "I have done wrong. Withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand of me." The king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, "I have done wrong; turn away from me; whatever you impose on me I will pay." And the king of Assyria assessed Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലും രാജധാനിയിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിലും കണ്ട വെള്ളിയൊക്കെയും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace.
chapters.nkjv: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house.
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king’s house.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ഹിസ്കീയാവു യഹോവയുടെ മന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ വാതിലുകളിലും കട്ടളകളിലും താൻ പൊതിഞ്ഞിരുന്ന പൊന്നും പറിച്ചെടുത്തു അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്നു കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At this time Hezekiah king of Judah stripped off the gold with which he had covered the doors and doorposts of the temple of the Lord , and gave it to the king of Assyria.
chapters.nkjv: At that time Hezekiah stripped thegoldfrom the doors of the temple of the Lord, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
chapters.kjv: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവു തർത്ഥാനെയും റബ്-സാരീസിനെയും റബ്-ശാക്കേയെയും ലാഖീശിൽനിന്നു ഹിസ്കീയാരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരു വലിയ സൈന്യവുമായി യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ അയച്ചു; അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു യെരൂശലേമിൽ വന്നു. അവിടെ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവർ അലക്കുകാരന്റെ വയലിലെ പെരുവഴിക്കലുള്ള മേലത്തെ കുളത്തിന്റെ കല്പാത്തിക്കരികെ ചെന്നുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king of Assyria sent his supreme commander, his chief officer and his field commander with a large army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They came up to Jerusalem and stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman’s Field.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rabsaris, and the Rabshakeh from Lachish, with a great army against Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they went and stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool, which was on the highway to the Fuller’s Field.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

chapters.ml: അവർ രാജാവിനെ വിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഹിൽക്കീയാവിന്റെ മകൻ എല്യാക്കീം എന്ന രാജധാനിവിചാരകനും രായസക്കാരനായ ശെബ്നയും ആസാഫിന്റെ മകൻ യോവാഹ് എന്ന മന്ത്രിയും അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: They called for the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to them.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came out to them.
chapters.kjv: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

chapters.ml: റബ്-ശാക്കേ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നിങ്ങൾ ഫിസ്കീയാവോടു പറയേണ്ടതു: മഹാരാജാവായ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു ഇപ്രകാരം കല്പിക്കുന്നു: നീ ആശ്രിയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ ആശ്രയം എന്തു?
chapters.niv: The field commander said to them, "Tell Hezekiah: " ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?
chapters.nkjv: Then the Rabshakeh said to them, "Say now to Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: "What confidence is this in which you trust?
chapters.kjv: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടുന്ന ആലോചനയും ബലവും ഉണ്ടെന്നു നീ പറയുന്നതു വെറും വാക്കത്രേ. ആരെ ആശ്രയിച്ചിട്ടാകുന്നു നീ എന്നോടു മത്സരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു?
chapters.niv: You say you have the counsel and the might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?
chapters.nkjv: You speak of having plans and power for war; but theyare mere words. And in whom do you trust, that you rebel against me?
chapters.kjv: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

chapters.ml: ചതെഞ്ഞ ഓടക്കോലായ ഈ മിസ്രയീമിലല്ലോ നീ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്നതു; അതിന്മേൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ഊന്നിയാൽ അതു അവന്റെ ഉള്ളംകയ്യിൽ തറെച്ചുകൊള്ളും; മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോൻ തന്നിൽ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്ന ഏവർക്കും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേയാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.
chapters.nkjv: Now look! You are trusting in the staff of this broken reed, Egypt, on which if a man leans, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
chapters.kjv: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

chapters.ml: അല്ല, നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, അവന്റെ പൂജാഗിരികളും യാഗപീഠങ്ങളും ഹിസ്കീയാവു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞിട്ടല്ലോ യെഹൂദായോടും യെരൂശലേമ്യരോടും യെരൂശലേമിലുള്ള ഈ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നമസ്കരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: But if you say to me, "We are depending on the Lord our God"—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, "You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem"?
chapters.nkjv: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the Lord our God,’ is it not He whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?" ’
chapters.kjv: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

chapters.ml: ആകട്ടെ എന്റെ യജമാനനായ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവുമായി വാതുകെട്ടുക; നിനക്കു കുതിരച്ചേവകരെ കയറ്റുവാൻ കഴിയുമെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു രണ്ടായിരം കുതിരയെ തരാം.
chapters.niv: " ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, I urge you, give a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses—if you are able on your part to put riders on them!
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

chapters.ml: നീ പിന്നെ എങ്ങനെ എന്റെ യജമാനന്റെ എളിയ ദാസന്മാരിൽ ഒരു പട നായകനെയെങ്കിലും മടക്കും? രഥങ്ങൾക്കായിട്ടും കുതിരച്ചേവകർക്കായിട്ടും നീ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: How can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen ?
chapters.nkjv: How then will you repel one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
chapters.kjv: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ ഈ സ്ഥലം നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ യഹോവയെ കൂടാതെയോ അതിന്റെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു? യഹോവ എന്നോടു: ഈ ദേശത്തിന്റെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടുചെന്നു അതിനെ നശിപ്പിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this place without word from the Lord ? The Lord himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Have I now come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’ "
chapters.kjv: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഹിൽക്കീയാവിന്റെ മകനായ എല്യാക്കീമും ശെബ്നയും യോവാഹും റബ്-ശാക്കേയോടു: അടിയങ്ങളോടു അരാംഭാഷയിൽ സംസാരിക്കേണമേ; അതു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അറിയാം; മതിലിന്മേലുള്ള ജനം കേൾക്കെ ഞങ്ങളോടു യെഹൂദാഭാഷയിൽ സംസാരിക്കരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."
chapters.nkjv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people who are on the wall."
chapters.kjv: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews’ language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

chapters.ml: റബ്-ശാക്കേ അവരോടു: നിന്റെ യജമാനനോടും നിന്നോടും ഈ വാക്കു പറവാനോ എന്റെ യജമാനൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു? നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ സ്വന്ത മലം തിന്നുകയും സ്വന്തമൂത്രം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ മതിലിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്ന പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the commander replied, "Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?"
chapters.nkjv: But the Rabshakeh said to them, "Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat and drink their own waste with you?"
chapters.kjv: But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ റബ്-ശാക്കേ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു യെഹൂദാഭാഷയിൽ ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: മഹാരാജാവായ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
chapters.nkjv: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out with a loud voice in Hebrew, and spoke, saying, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
chapters.kjv: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ഇപ്രകാരം കല്പിക്കുന്നു: ഹിസ്കീയാവു നിങ്ങളെ ചതിക്കരുതു; നിങ്ങളെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു വിടുവിപ്പാൻ അവന്നു കഴികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you from my hand.
chapters.nkjv: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he shall not be able to deliver you from his hand;
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നമ്മെ നിശ്ചയമായി വിടുവിക്കും; ഈ നഗരം അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഹിസ്കീയാവു നിങ്ങളെ യഹോവയിൽ ആശ്രയിക്കുമാറാക്കുകയും അരുതു.
chapters.niv: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
chapters.nkjv: nor let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, "The Lord will surely deliver us; this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria." ’
chapters.kjv: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD , saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ചെവികൊടുക്കരുതു; അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു ഇപ്രകാരം കല്പിക്കുന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു സന്ധി ചെയ്തു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തുവരുവിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയുടെയും അത്തിവൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെയും ഫലം തിന്നുകയും താന്താന്റെ കിണറ്റിലെ വെള്ളം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,
chapters.nkjv: Do not listen to Hezekiah; for thus says the king of Assyria: ‘Make peace with me by a present and come out to me; and every one of you eat from his own vine and every one from his own fig tree, and every one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
chapters.kjv: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഞാൻ വന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ ദേശത്തിന്നു തുല്യമായി ധാന്യവും വിഞ്ഞും അപ്പവും മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടങ്ങളും ഒലിവെണ്ണയും തേനും ഉള്ള ഒരു ദേശത്തേക്കു നിങ്ങളെ കൊണ്ടുപോകും; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ മരിക്കാതെ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കും; യഹോവ നമ്മെ വിടുവിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു നിങ്ങളെ ചതിക്കുന്ന ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്നു ചെവികൊടുക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey. Choose life and not death! "Do not listen to Hezekiah, for he is misleading you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’
chapters.nkjv: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive groves and honey, that you may live and not die. But do not listen to Hezekiah, lest he persuade you, saying, "The Lord will deliver us."
chapters.kjv: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.

chapters.ml: ജാതികളുടെ ദേവന്മാർ ആരെങ്കിലും തന്റെ ദേശത്തെ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
chapters.nkjv: Has any of the gods of the nations at all delivered its land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
chapters.kjv: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

chapters.ml: ഹമാത്തിലെയും അർപ്പാദിലെയും ദേവന്മാർ എവിടെ? സെഫർവ്വയീമിലെയും ഹേനയിലെയും ഇവ്വയിലേയും ദേവന്മാർ എവിടെ? ശമർയ്യയെ അവർ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?
chapters.nkjv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim and Hena and Ivah? Indeed, have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
chapters.kjv: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യെരൂശലേമിനെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിപ്പാൻ ആ ദേശങ്ങളിലെ സകലദേവന്മാരിലും വെച്ചു ഒരുത്തൻ തന്റെ ദേശത്തെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചുവോ?
chapters.niv: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"
chapters.nkjv: Who among all the gods of the lands have delivered their countries from my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem from my hand?’ "
chapters.kjv: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനം മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു അവനോടു ഒന്നും ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞില്ല; അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറയരുതെന്നു കല്പന ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."
chapters.nkjv: But the people held their peace and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, "Do not answer him."
chapters.kjv: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

chapters.ml: ഹിൽക്കീയാവിന്റെ മകനായ എല്യാക്കീം എന്ന രാജധാനിവിചാരകനും രായസക്കാരനായ ശെബ്നയും ആസാഫിന്റെ മകനായ യോവാഹ് എന്ന മന്ത്രിയും വസ്ത്രം കീറി ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു റബ്-ശാക്കേയുടെ വാക്കു അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.
chapters.nkjv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.
chapters.kjv: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാരാജാവു അതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ വസ്ത്രം കീറി രട്ടുടുത്തുകെണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when King Hezekiah heard it, that he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ രാജധാനിവിചാരകനായ എല്യാക്കീമിനെയും രായസക്കാരനായ ശെബ്നയെയും പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ മൂപ്പന്മാരെയും രട്ടുടുത്തവരായി ആമോസിന്റെ മകനായ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
chapters.nkjv: Then he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
chapters.kjv: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഹിസ്കീയാവു ഇപ്രകാരം പറയുന്നു: ഇതു കഷ്ടവും ശാസനയും നിന്ദയും ഉള്ള ദിവസം അത്രേ; കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങൾ ജനിപ്പാറായിരിക്കുന്നു; പ്രസവിപ്പാനോ ശക്തിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.
chapters.nkjv: And they said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: ‘This day is a day of trouble, and rebuke, and blasphemy; for the children have come to birth, but thereis no strength to bring them forth.
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

chapters.ml: ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തെ നിന്ദിപ്പാൻ റബ്-ശാക്കേയെ അവന്റെ യജമാനനായ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു അയച്ചു പറയിക്കുന്ന വാക്കു ഒക്കെയും നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ പക്ഷെ കേൾക്കും; നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ കേട്ട വാക്കിന്നു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യും; ആകയാൽ ഇനിയും ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവർക്കു വേണ്ടി പക്ഷവാദം കഴിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: It may be that the Lord your God will hear all the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the Lord your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives."
chapters.nkjv: It may be that the Lord your God will hear all the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to reproach the living God, and will rebuke the words which the Lord your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’ "
chapters.kjv: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാരാജാവിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ യെശയ്യാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ യെശയ്യാവു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,
chapters.nkjv: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
chapters.kjv: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ യജമാനനോടു പറയേണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ എന്നെ നിന്ദിച്ചതായി നീ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന വാക്കുകൾനിമിത്തം ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ.
chapters.niv: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
chapters.nkjv: And Isaiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to your master, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Do not be afraid of the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
chapters.kjv: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD , Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്നു ഒരു മനോവിഭ്രമം വരുത്തും; അവൻ ഒരു ശ്രുതി കേട്ടിട്ടു സ്വദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകും; ഞാൻ അവനെ അവന്റെ സ്വന്തദേശത്തുവെച്ചു വാൾകൊണ്ടു വീഴുമാറാക്കും.
chapters.niv: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Surely I will send a spirit upon him, and he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land." ’ "
chapters.kjv: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

chapters.ml: റബ്-ശാക്കേ മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു അശ്ശൂർരാജാവു ലിബ്നയുടെ നേരെ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അവൻ ലാഖീശ് വിട്ടു പോയി എന്നു അവൻ കേട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
chapters.kjv: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

chapters.ml: കൂശ് രാജാവായ തിർഹാക്ക തന്റെ നേരെ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കേട്ടിട്ടു അവൻ പിന്നെയും ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു പറയിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:
chapters.nkjv: And the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, "Look, he has come out to make war with you." So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
chapters.kjv: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ ഹിസ്കീയാവോടു പറയേണ്ടതു: യെരൂശലേം അശ്ശൂർ രാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുകളകയില്ല എന്നു നീ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ ദൈവം നിന്നെ ചതിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: "Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’
chapters.nkjv: "Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, "Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."
chapters.kjv: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർരാജാക്കന്മാർ സകലദേശങ്ങളോടും ചെയ്തതും അവെക്കു ഉന്മൂലനാശം വരുത്തിയതും നീ കേട്ടിട്ടുണ്ടല്ലോ; നീ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകുമോ?
chapters.niv: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?
chapters.nkjv: Look! You have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by utterly destroying them; and shall you be delivered?
chapters.kjv: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

chapters.ml: ഗോസാൻ, ഹാരാൻ, രേസെഫ്, തെലസ്സാരിലെ എദേന്യർ എന്നിങ്ങനെ എന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ നശിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ജാതികളുടെ ദേവന്മാർ അവരെ വിടുവിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?
chapters.nkjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered those whom my fathers have destroyed, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?
chapters.kjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?

chapters.ml: ഹമാത്ത്‌രാജാവും അർപ്പാദ്‌രാജാവും സെഫർവ്വയീംപട്ടണം ഹേന ഇവ്വ എന്നവെക്കു രാജാവായിരുന്നവനും എവിടെ?
chapters.niv: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?"
chapters.nkjv: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?’ "
chapters.kjv: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവു ദൂതന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു എഴുത്തു വാങ്ങിവായിച്ചു: ഹിസ്കീയാവു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ അതു വിടർത്തി.
chapters.niv: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD , and spread it before the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവു യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: കെരൂബുകൾക്കുമീതെ അധിവസിക്കുന്ന യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, നീ ഒരുത്തൻ മാത്രം ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലരാജ്യങ്ങൾക്കും ദൈവം ആകുന്നു; നീ ആകാശത്തെയും ഭൂമിയെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
