chapters.niv: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord : " Lord , the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hezekiah prayed before the Lord, and said: "O Lord God of Israel, theOne who dwells between the cherubim, You are God, You alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD , and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ചെവിചായിച്ചു കേൾക്കേണമേ; യഹോവേ, തൃക്കണ്ണുതുറന്നു നോക്കേണമേ; ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തെ നിന്ദിപ്പാൻ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന സൻ ഹേരീബിന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Give ear, Lord , and hear; open your eyes, Lord , and see; listen to the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.
chapters.nkjv: Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, O Lord, and see; and hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to reproach the living God.
chapters.kjv: LORD , bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD , thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, അശ്ശൂർ രാജാക്കന്മാർ ആ ജാതികളെയും അവരുടെ ദേശത്തെയും ശൂന്യമാക്കിയതു സത്യം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "It is true, Lord , that the Assyrian kings have laid waste these nations and their lands.
chapters.nkjv: Truly, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,
chapters.kjv: Of a truth, LORD , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേവന്മാരെ അവർ തീയിലിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു; അവ ദേവന്മാരല്ല, മനുഷ്യരുടെ കൈപ്പണിയായ മരവും കല്ലും മാത്രം ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ; ആകയാൽ അവർ അവയെ നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.
chapters.nkjv: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were not gods, but the work of men’s hands—wood and stone. Therefore they destroyed them.
chapters.kjv: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴോ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, നീ ഒരുത്തൻ മാത്രം യഹോവയായ ദൈവം എന്നു ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലരാജ്യങ്ങളും അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Now, Lord our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone, Lord , are God."
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, O Lord our God, I pray, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You are the Lord God, You alone."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.

chapters.ml: ആമോസിന്റെ മകനായ യെശയ്യാവു ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നീ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ സൻ ഹേരീബിൻ നിമിത്തം എന്നോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘Because you have prayed to Me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, I have heard.’
chapters.kjv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

chapters.ml: അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനമാവിതു: സീയോൻ പുത്രിയായ കന്യക നിന്നെ നിന്ദിച്ചു പരിഹസിക്കുന്നു; യെരൂശലേംപുത്രി നിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ തല കുലുക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is the word that the Lord has spoken against him: " ‘Virgin Daughter Zion despises you and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.
chapters.nkjv: This is the word which the Lord has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin, the daughter of Zion, Has despised you, laughed you to scorn; The daughter of Jerusalem Has shaken her head behind your back!
chapters.kjv: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

chapters.ml: നീ ആരെയാകുന്നു നിന്ദിച്ചു ദുഷിച്ചതു? ആർക്കു വിരോധമായിട്ടാകുന്നു നീ ഒച്ച പൊക്കുകയും തല ഉന്നതമായി ഉയർത്തുകയും ചെയ്തതു? യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പരിശുദ്ധന്നു വിരോധമായിട്ടു തന്നേയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
chapters.nkjv: ‘Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice, And lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാർ മുഖാന്തരം നീ കർത്താവിനെ നിന്ദിച്ചു: എന്റെ അസംഖ്യരഥങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഞാൻ മലമുകളിലും ലെബാനോന്റെ ശിഖരങ്ങളിലും കയറിയിരിക്കുന്നു; അതിലെ പൊക്കമുള്ള ദേവദാരുക്കളും വിശേഷമായ സരളവൃക്ഷങ്ങളും ഞാൻ മുറിക്കും; അതിന്റെ അറ്റത്തെ പാർപ്പിടംവരെയും ചെഴിപ്പുള്ള കാടുവരെയും ഞാൻ കടന്നുചെല്ലും.
chapters.niv: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, "With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest parts, the finest of its forests.
chapters.nkjv: By your messengers you have reproached the Lord, And said: "By the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, To the limits of Lebanon; I will cut down its tall cedars And its choice cypress trees; I will enter the extremity of its borders, To its fruitful forest.
chapters.kjv: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അന്യജലം കുഴിച്ചെടുത്തു കുടിക്കും. എന്റെ കാലടികളാൽ മിസ്രയീമിലെ സകലനദികളെയും വറ്റിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt."
chapters.nkjv: I have dug and drunk strange water, And with the soles of my feet I have dried up All the brooks of defense."
chapters.kjv: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പണ്ടുപണ്ടേ അതിനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി, പൂർവ്വകാലത്തു തന്നേ അതിനെ നിർമ്മിച്ചു എന്നു നീ കേട്ടിട്ടില്ലയോ? നീ ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളെ ശൂന്യക്കൂമ്പാരങ്ങളാക്കുവാൻ ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ സംഗതി വരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Did you not hear long ago How I made it, From ancient times that I formed it? Now I have brought it to pass, That you should be For crushing fortified cities into heaps of ruins.
chapters.kjv: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അവയിലെ നിവാസികൾ ദുർബ്ബലന്മാരായി വിരണ്ടു അമ്പരന്നുപോയി; അവർ വയലിലെ പുല്ലും പച്ചച്ചെടിയും പുരപ്പുറങ്ങളിലെ പുല്ലും വളരുമ്മുമ്പെ കരിഞ്ഞുപോയ ധാന്യവുംപോലെ ആയ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore their inhabitants had little power; They were dismayed and confounded; They were as the grass of the field And the green herb, As the grass on the housetops And grain blighted before it is grown.
chapters.kjv: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ ഇരിപ്പും നിന്റെ ഗമനവും ആഗമനവും എന്റെ നേരെയുള്ള നിന്റെ കോപഭ്രാന്തും ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.
chapters.nkjv: ‘But I know your dwelling place, Your going out and your coming in, And your rage against Me.
chapters.kjv: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നേരെയുള്ള നിന്റെ കോപഭ്രാന്തുകൊണ്ടും നിന്റെ അഹങ്കാരം എന്റെ ചെവിയിൽ എത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടും ഞാൻ എന്റെ കൊളുത്തു നിന്റെ മൂക്കിലും എന്റെ കടിഞ്ഞാൺ നിന്റെ അധരങ്ങളിലും ഇട്ടു, നീ വന്ന വഴിക്കു നിന്നെ മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു പോകും.
chapters.niv: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.’
chapters.nkjv: Because your rage against Me and your tumult Have come up to My ears, Therefore I will put My hook in your nose And My bridle in your lips, And I will turn you back By the way which you came.
chapters.kjv: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇതു നിനക്കു അടയാളം ആകും; നിങ്ങൾ ഈ ആണ്ടിൽ പടുവിത്തുവിളയുന്നതും രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ താനേ കിളുർത്തു വിളയുന്നതും തിന്നും; മൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ നിങ്ങൾ വിതെച്ചു കൊയ്യുകയും മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടം ഉണ്ടാക്കി അവയുടെ പഴം തിന്നുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: "This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: "This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
chapters.nkjv: ‘This shallbe a sign to you: You shall eat this year such as grows of itself, And in the second year what springs from the same; Also in the third year sow and reap, Plant vineyards and eat the fruit of them.
chapters.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാഗൃഹത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു രക്ഷിതഗണം വീണ്ടും താഴെ വേരൂന്നി മീതെ ഫലം കായക്കും.
chapters.niv: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.
chapters.nkjv: And the remnant who have escaped of the house of Judah Shall again take root downward, And bear fruit upward.
chapters.kjv: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ശേഷിപ്പു യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നും ഒരു രക്ഷിതഗണം സീയോൻ പർവ്വതത്തിൽനിന്നും പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരും; യഹോവയുടെ തീക്ഷ്ണത അതിനെ അനുഷ്ഠിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. "The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.
chapters.nkjv: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, And those who escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.’
chapters.kjv: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: അവൻ ഈ നഗരത്തിലേക്കു വരികയില്ല; ഒരു അമ്പു അവിടെ എയ്കയില്ല. അതിന്റെ നേരെ പരിചയോടുകൂടെ വരികയില്ല; അതിന്നു എതിരെ വാടകോരുകയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the king of Assyria: " ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of Assyria: ‘He shall not come into this city, Nor shoot an arrow there, Nor come before it with shield, Nor build a siege mound against it.
chapters.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വന്ന വഴിക്കു തന്നേ മടങ്ങിപ്പോകും; ഈ നഗരത്തിലേക്കു വരികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city, declares the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: By the way that he came, By the same shall he return; And he shall not come into this city,’ Says the Lord.
chapters.kjv: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നിമിത്തവും എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നിമിത്തവും ഞാൻ ഈ നഗരത്തെ പാലിച്ചു രക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant.’ "
chapters.nkjv: ‘For I will defend this city, to save it For My own sake and for My servant David’s sake.’ "
chapters.kjv: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

chapters.ml: അന്നു രാത്രി യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അശ്ശൂർപാളയത്തിൽ ഒരു ലക്ഷത്തെണ്പത്തയ്യായിരം പേരെ കൊന്നു; ജനം രാവിലെ എഴുന്നേറ്റപ്പോൾ അവർ എല്ലാവരും ശവങ്ങളായി കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: That night the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass on a certain night that the angel of the Lord went out, and killed in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred and eighty-five thousand; and when people arose early in the morning, there were the corpses—all dead.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ സൻ ഹേരീബ് യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി നീനെവേയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.
chapters.nkjv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed and went away, returned home, and remained at Nineveh.
chapters.kjv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ദേവനായ നിസ്രോക്കിന്റെ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്ന സമയത്തു അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ അദ്രമേലെക്കും ശരേസെരും അവനെ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്നിട്ടു അരാരാത്ത് ദേശത്തേക്കു ഓടിപ്പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു. അവന്റെ മകനായ ഏസെർ-ഹദ്ദോൻ അവന്നുപകരം രാജാവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, as he was worshiping in the temple of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him down with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Then Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്നു മരിക്കത്തക്ക രോഗം പിടിച്ചു; ആമോസിന്റെ മകനായ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: നിന്റെ ഗൃഹകാര്യം ക്രമത്തിൽ ആക്കുക; നീ മരിച്ചുപോകും, ശേഷിക്കയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the Lord says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."
chapters.nkjv: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, went to him and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Set your house in order, for you shall die, and not live.’ "
chapters.kjv: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഹിസ്കീയാവു മുഖം ചുവരിന്റെ നേരെ തിരിച്ചു യഹോവയോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: Then he turned his face toward the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying,
chapters.kjv: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD , saying,

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ വിശ്വസ്തതയോടും ഏകാഗ്രഹൃദയത്തോടും കൂടെ തിരുമുമ്പിൽ നടന്നു നിനക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഓർക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഹിസ്കീയാവു ഏറ്റവും കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Remember, Lord , how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
chapters.nkjv: "Remember now, O Lord, I pray, how I have walked before You in truth and with a loyal heart, and have done whatwas good in Your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
chapters.kjv: I beseech thee, O LORD , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെശയ്യാവു നടുമുറ്റം വിട്ടു പോകുംമുമ്പെ അവന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Before Isaiah had left the middle court, the word of the Lord came to him:
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, before Isaiah had gone out into the middle court, that the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ പ്രഭുവായ ഹിസ്കീയാവോടു പറയേണ്ടതു: നിന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടു നിന്റെ കണ്ണുനീർ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കും; മൂന്നാം ദിവസം നീ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ പോകും.
chapters.niv: "Go back and tell Hezekiah, the ruler of my people, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: "Return and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people, ‘Thus says the Lord, the God of David your father: "I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; surely I will heal you. On the third day you shall go up to the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD , the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ആയുസ്സിനോടു പതിനഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം കൂട്ടും; ഞാൻ നിന്നെയും ഈ നഗരത്തെയും അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു വിടുവിക്കും. എന്റെ നിമിത്തവും എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നിമിത്തവും ഈ നഗരം ഞാൻ കാത്തു രക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for My own sake, and for the sake of My servant David." ’ "
chapters.kjv: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യെശയ്യാവു ഒരു അത്തിപ്പഴക്കട്ട കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അതു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പരുവിന്മേൽ ഇട്ടു അവന്നു സൌഖ്യമായി.
chapters.niv: Then Isaiah said, "Prepare a poultice of figs." They did so and applied it to the boil, and he recovered.
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaiah said, "Take a lump of figs." So they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
chapters.kjv: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവു യെശയ്യാവോടു: യഹോവ എന്നെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുകയും ഞാൻ മൂന്നാം ദിവസം യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ പോകയും ചെയ്യുമെന്നതിന്നു അടയാളം എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Hezekiah had asked Isaiah, "What will be the sign that the Lord will heal me and that I will go up to the temple of the Lord on the third day from now?"
chapters.nkjv: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "What is the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up to the house of the Lord the third day?"
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യെശയ്യാവു: യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത കാര്യം നിവർത്തിക്കുമെന്നുള്ളതിന്നു യഹോവയിങ്കൽനിന്നു ഇതു നിനക്കു അടയാളം ആകും: നിഴൽ പത്തു പടി മുമ്പോട പോകേണമോ? പത്തു പടി പിന്നോക്കം തിരിയേണമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Isaiah answered, "This is the Lord ’s sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised: Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it go back ten steps?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaiah said, "This is the sign to you from the Lord, that the Lord will do the thing which He has spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees or go backward ten degrees?"
chapters.kjv: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD , that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഹിസ്കീയാവു: നിഴൽ പത്തു പടി ഇറങ്ങിപ്പോകുന്നതു എളുപ്പം ആകുന്നു; അങ്ങനെയല്ല, നിഴൽ പത്തുപടി പിന്നോക്കം തിരിയട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "It is a simple matter for the shadow to go forward ten steps," said Hezekiah. "Rather, have it go back ten steps."
chapters.nkjv: And Hezekiah answered, "It is an easy thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees; no, but let the shadow go backward ten degrees."
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ യഹോവയെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അവൻ ആഹാസിന്റെ സൂര്യഘടികാരത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങിപ്പോയിരുന്ന നിഴലിനെ പത്തു പടി പിന്നോക്കം തിരിയുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then the prophet Isaiah called on the Lord , and the Lord made the shadow go back the ten steps it had gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.
chapters.nkjv: So Isaiah the prophet cried out to the Lord, and He brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.
chapters.kjv: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ബലദാന്റെ മകനായ ബെരോദാക്-ബലദാൻ എന്ന ബാബേൽരാജാവു ഹിസ്കീയാവു ദീനമായ്ക്കിടന്നിരുന്നു എന്നു കേട്ടിട്ടു ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്നു എഴുത്തും സമ്മാനവും കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of Hezekiah’s illness.
chapters.nkjv: At that time Berodach-Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
chapters.kjv: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവു അവരുടെ വാക്കു കേട്ടു തന്റെ ഭണ്ഡാരഗൃഹം മുഴുവനും പൊന്നും വെള്ളിയും സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗവും പരിമളതൈലവും തന്റെ ആയുധശാലയും തന്റെ ഭണ്ഡാരങ്ങളിൽ ഉള്ളതൊക്കെയും അവരെ കാണിച്ചു. രാജധാനിയിലും തന്റെ ആധിപത്യത്തിലും ഹിസ്കീയാവു അവരെ കാണിക്കാത്ത ഒരു വസ്തുവും ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Hezekiah received the envoys and showed them all that was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices and the fine olive oil—his armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.
chapters.nkjv: And Hezekiah was attentive to them, and showed them all the house of his treasures—the silver and gold, the spices and precious ointment, and all his armory—all that was found among his treasures. There was nothing in his house or in all his dominion that Hezekiah did not show them.
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ ഹിസ്കീയാരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: ഈ പുരുഷന്മാർ എന്തു പറഞ്ഞു? അവർ എവിടെ നിന്നു നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ഹിസ്കീയാവു: അവർ ദൂരദേശത്തുനിന്നു, ബാബേലിൽനിന്നു വന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came from Babylon."
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah, and said to him, "What did these men say, and from where did they come to you?" So Hezekiah said, "They came from a far country, from Babylon."
chapters.kjv: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

chapters.ml: അവർ രാജധാനയിൽ എന്തെല്ലാം കണ്ടു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ഹിസ്കീയാവു: രാജധാനിയിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അവർ കണ്ടു; എന്റെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽ ഞാൻ അവർക്കു കാണിക്കാത്ത ഒരു വസ്തുവും ഇല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "What have they seen in your house?" So Hezekiah answered, "They have seen all that is in my house; there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them."
chapters.kjv: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

chapters.ml: യെശയ്യാവു ഹിസ്കീയാവോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യഹോവയുടെ വചനം കേൾക്ക:
chapters.niv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord :
chapters.nkjv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord:
chapters.kjv: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: രാജധാനിയിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ഇന്നുവരെ ശേഖരിച്ചുവെച്ചതും ഒട്ടൊഴിയാതെ ബാബേലിലേക്കു എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു പോകുന്ന കാലം വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and what your fathers have accumulated until this day, shall be carried to Babylon; nothing shall be left,’ says the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD .

chapters.ml: നീ ജനിപ്പിച്ചവരായി നിന്നിൽനിന്നുത്ഭവിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിലും ചിലരെ അവർ കൊണ്ടുപോകും; അവർ ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അരമനയിൽ ഷണ്ഡന്മാരായിരിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
chapters.nkjv: ‘And they shall take away some of your sons who will descend from you, whom you will beget; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’ "
chapters.kjv: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഹിസ്കീയാവു യെശയ്യാവോടു: നീ പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയുടെ വചനം നല്ലതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; എന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തു സമാധാനവും സത്യവും ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കുമല്ലോ എന്നും അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The word of the Lord you have spoken is good," Hezekiah replied. For he thought, "Will there not be peace and security in my lifetime?"
chapters.nkjv: So Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord which you have spoken is good!" For he said, "Will there not be peace and truth at least in my days?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days?

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവന്റെ സകല പരാക്രമപ്രവൃത്തികളും അവൻ ഒരു കുളവും കല്പാത്തിയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി വെള്ളം നഗരത്തിന്നകത്തു വരുത്തിയതും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Hezekiah’s reign, all his achievements and how he made the pool and the tunnel by which he brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah—all his might, and how he made a pool and a tunnel and brought water into the city—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: ഹിസ്കീയാവു തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകനായ മനശ്ശെ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Hezekiah rested with his fathers. Then Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെ വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അമ്പത്തഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു ഹെഫ്സീബ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
chapters.nkjv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
chapters.kjv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞ ജാതികളുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛതകൾക്കൊത്തവണ്ണം അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹിസ്കീയാവു നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞിരുന്ന പൂജാഗിരികളെ അവൻ വീണ്ടും പണിതു; ബാലിന്നു ബലിപീഠങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ആഹാബ് ചെയ്തതു പോലെ ഒരു അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു ആകാശത്തിലെ സർവ്വസൈന്യത്തെയും നമസ്കരിച്ചു സേവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he also erected altars to Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.
chapters.nkjv: For he rebuilt the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; he raised up altars for Baal, and made a wooden image, as Ahab king of Israel had done; and he worshiped all the host of heaven and served them.
chapters.kjv: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഞാൻ എന്റെ നാം സ്ഥാപിക്കുമെന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്ന യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലും അവൻ ബലിപീഠങ്ങൾ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: He built altars in the temple of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem I will put my Name."
chapters.nkjv: He also built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem I will put My name."
chapters.kjv: And he built altars in the house of the LORD , of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ രണ്ടു പ്രാകാരങ്ങളിലും അവൻ ആകാശത്തിലെ സർവ്വസൈന്യത്തിന്നും ബലിപീഠങ്ങൾ പണിതു;
chapters.niv: In the two courts of the temple of the Lord , he built altars to all the starry hosts.
chapters.nkjv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ മകനെ അഗ്നി പ്രവേശം ചെയ്യിക്കയും മുഹൂർത്തം നോക്കുകയും ആഭിചാരം പ്രയോഗിക്കയും വെളിച്ചപ്പാടന്മാരെയും ലക്ഷണം പറയുന്നവരെയും നിയമിക്കയും ചെയ്തു. യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവന്നു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു പലതും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced divination, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.
chapters.nkjv: Also he made his son pass through the fire, practiced soothsaying, used witchcraft, and consulted spiritists and mediums. He did much evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
chapters.kjv: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

chapters.ml: ഈ ആലയത്തിലും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകലഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന യെരൂശലേമിലും ഞാൻ എന്റെ നാമം എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥാപിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവ ദാവീദിനോടും അവന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോനോടും അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത ആലയത്തിൽ താൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠ അവൻ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He took the carved Asherah pole he had made and put it in the temple, of which the Lord had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.
chapters.nkjv: He even set a carved image of Asherah that he had made, in the house of which the Lord had said to David and to Solomon his son, "In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever;
chapters.kjv: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും എന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ച സകല ന്യായപ്രമാണവും അനുസരിച്ചു നടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കമാത്രം ചെയ്താൽ ഇനി യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കാൽ, അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കു ഞാൻ കൊടുത്ത ദേശം വിട്ടലയുവാൻ ഇടവരുത്തുകയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites wander from the land I gave their ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them and will keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them."
chapters.nkjv: and I will not make the feet of Israel wander anymore from the land which I gave their fathers—only if they are careful to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that My servant Moses commanded them."
chapters.kjv: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ കേട്ടനുസരിച്ചില്ല; യഹോവ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നശിപ്പിച്ച ജാതികളെക്കാളും അധികം ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാൻ മനശ്ശെ അവരെ തെറ്റിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the people did not listen. Manasseh led them astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the Lord had destroyed before the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: But they paid no attention, and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than the nations whom the Lord had destroyed before the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവ, പ്രവാചകന്മാരായ തന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The Lord said through his servants the prophets:
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord spoke by His servants the prophets, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ മനശ്ശെ തനിക്കു മുമ്പെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന അമോർയ്യർ ചെയ്ത സകലത്തെക്കാളും അധികം ദോഷമായി ഈ മ്ളേച്ഛതകൾ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കയാലും തന്റെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ടു യെഹൂദയെയും പാപം ചെയ്യിക്കയാലും
chapters.niv: "Manasseh king of Judah has committed these detestable sins. He has done more evil than the Amorites who preceded him and has led Judah into sin with his idols.
chapters.nkjv: "Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations ( he has acted more wickedly than all the Amorites who were before him, and has also made Judah sin with his idols),
chapters.kjv: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: കേൾക്കുന്ന ഏവന്റെയും ചെവി രണ്ടും മുഴങ്ങത്തക്കവണ്ണമുള്ള അനർത്ഥം ഞാൻ യെരൂശലേമിന്നും യെഹൂദെക്കും വരുത്തും.
chapters.niv: Therefore this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.
chapters.nkjv: therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘Behold, I am bringing such calamity upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.
chapters.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യെരൂശലേമിന്മേൽ ശമർയ്യയുടെ അളവുനൂലും ആഹാബ് ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ തൂക്കുകട്ടയും പിടിക്കും; ഒരുത്തൻ ഒരു തളിക തുടെക്കയും തുടെച്ചശേഷം അതു കവിഴ്ത്തിവെക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതുപോലെ ഞാൻ യെരൂശലേമിനെ തുടെച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab. I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
chapters.nkjv: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the plummet of the house of Ahab; I will wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
chapters.kjv: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it , and turning it upside down.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ശേഷിപ്പു ഞാൻ ത്യജിച്ചു അവരെ അവരുടെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും; അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ സകലശത്രുക്കൾക്കും കവർച്ചയും കൊള്ളയും ആയ്തീരും.
chapters.niv: I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance and give them into the hands of enemies. They will be looted and plundered by all their enemies;
chapters.nkjv: So I will forsake the remnant of My inheritance and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become victims of plunder to all their enemies,
chapters.kjv: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട നാൾമുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെ അവർ എനിക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു എന്നെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: they have done evil in my eyes and have aroused my anger from the day their ancestors came out of Egypt until this day."
chapters.nkjv: because they have done evil in My sight, and have provoked Me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’ "
chapters.kjv: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

chapters.ml: അത്രയുമല്ല, യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു മനശ്ശെ യെഹൂദയെക്കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യിച്ച പാപം കൂടാതെ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഒരറ്റംമുതൽ മറ്റേഅറ്റംവരെ നിറെപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം കുറ്റമില്ലാത്ത രക്തവും ഏറ്റവും വളരെ ചിന്നിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, Manasseh also shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end—besides the sin that he had caused Judah to commit, so that they did evil in the eyes of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Moreover Manasseh shed very much innocent blood, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another, besides his sin by which he made Judah sin, in doing evil in the sight of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD .

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും അവന്റെ പാപവും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Manasseh’s reign, and all he did, including the sin he committed, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh—all that he did, and the sin that he committed—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അരമനയുടെ തോട്ടത്തിൽ, ഉസ്സയുടെ തോട്ടത്തിൽ തന്നേ, അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ ആമോൻ അവന്നുപകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Manasseh rested with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza. Then his son Amon reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ആമോൻ വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തിരണ്ടു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ രണ്ടു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു മെശൂല്ലേമെത്ത് എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ യൊത്ബക്കാരനായ ഹാരൂസിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz; she was from Jotbah.
chapters.nkjv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
chapters.kjv: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ മനശ്ശെ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു;
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his father Manasseh had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , as his father Manasseh did.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ അപ്പൻ നടന്ന വഴിയിലൊക്കെയും നടന്നു; തന്റെ അപ്പൻ സേവിച്ച വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും സേവിച്ചു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He followed completely the ways of his father, worshiping the idols his father had worshiped, and bowing down to them.
chapters.nkjv: So he walked in all the ways that his father had walked; and he served the idols that his father had served, and worshiped them.
chapters.kjv: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; യഹോവയുടെ വഴിയിൽ നടന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: He forsook the Lord , the God of his ancestors, and did not walk in obedience to him.
chapters.nkjv: He forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and did not walk in the way of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആമോന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ അവന്റെ നേരെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി രാജാവിനെ അരമനയിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated the king in his palace.
chapters.nkjv: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him, and killed the king in his own house.
chapters.kjv: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദേശത്തെ ജനം ആമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ നേരെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കിയവരെ ഒക്കെയും കൊന്നു; ദേശത്തെ ജനം അവന്റെ മകനായ യോശീയാവെ അവന്നുപകരം രാജാവാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.
chapters.nkjv: But the people of the land executed all those who had conspired against King Amon. Then the people of the land made his son Josiah king in his place.
chapters.kjv: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

chapters.ml: ആമോൻ ചെയ്ത മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Amon’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സയുടെ തോട്ടത്തിലെ അവന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു. അവന്റെ മകനായ യോശീയാവു അവന്നുപകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. And Josiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. Then Josiah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യോശീയാവു വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു എട്ടു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ മുപ്പത്തൊന്നു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു യെദീദാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ ബൊസ്കത്ത് കാരനായ അദായാവിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah; she was from Bozkath.
chapters.nkjv: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
chapters.kjv: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ വഴിയിലൊക്കെയും വലത്തോട്ടും ഇടത്തോട്ടും മാറാതെ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and followed completely the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

chapters.ml: യോശീയാരാജാവിന്റെ പതിനെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ രാജാവു മെശുല്ലാമിന്റെ മകനായ അസല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ ശാഫാൻ എന്ന രായസക്കാരനെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു അയച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the secretary, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the temple of the Lord . He said:
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the scribe, the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the house of the Lord, saying:
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD , saying,

chapters.ml: നീ മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ ഹിൽക്കീയാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുക. യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ പിരിഞ്ഞുവന്നതും വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാർ ജനത്തോടു പിരിച്ചെടുത്തതുമായ ദ്രവ്യം അവൻ കണകൂനോക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him get ready the money that has been brought into the temple of the Lord , which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.
chapters.nkjv: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which has been brought into the house of the Lord, which the doorkeepers have gathered from the people.
chapters.kjv: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

chapters.ml: അവർ അതു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ വിചാരകരായി പണിനടത്തുന്നവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുക്കട്ടെ; അവർ അതു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: Have them entrust it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. And have these men pay the workers who repair the temple of the Lord —
chapters.nkjv: And let them deliver it into the hand of those doing the work, who are the overseers in the house of the Lord; let them give it to those who are in the house of the Lord doing the work, to repair the damages of the house—
chapters.kjv: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD : and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD , to repair the breaches of the house,

chapters.ml: അതിൽ പണി ചെയ്യുന്ന ആശാരികൾക്കും ശില്പികൾക്കും കല്പണിക്കാർക്കും ആലയത്തിന്റെ അറ്റകുറ്റപ്പണിക്കു മരവും ചെത്തിയ കല്ലും മേടിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും കൊടുക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: the carpenters, the builders and the masons. Also have them purchase timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.
chapters.nkjv: to carpenters and builders and masons—and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
chapters.kjv: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദ്രവ്യം കയ്യേറ്റുവാങ്ങിയവരോടു കണക്കു ചോദിക്കേണ്ടാ; അവർ വിശ്വാസത്തിന്മേലല്ലോ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: But they need not account for the money entrusted to them, because they are honest in their dealings."
chapters.nkjv: However there need be no accounting made with them of the money delivered into their hand, because they deal faithfully."
chapters.kjv: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ ഹിൽക്കീയാവു രായസക്കാരനായ ശാഫാനോടു: ഞാൻ ന്യായപ്രമാണപുസ്തകം യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കണ്ടെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഹിൽക്കീയാവു ആ പുസ്തകം ശാഫാന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തു; അവൻ അതു വായിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the Lord ." He gave it to Shaphan, who read it.
chapters.nkjv: Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, "I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
chapters.kjv: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

chapters.ml: രായസക്കാരനായ ശാഫാൻ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു രാജാവിനോടു: ആലയത്തിൽ കണ്ട ദ്രവ്യം അടിയങ്ങൾ പെട്ടിയൊഴിച്ചെടുത്തു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ വിചാരകരായി പണിനടത്തുന്നവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു മറുപടി ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him: "Your officials have paid out the money that was in the temple of the Lord and have entrusted it to the workers and supervisors at the temple."
chapters.nkjv: So Shaphan the scribe went to the king, bringing the king word, saying, "Your servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of those who do the work, who oversee the house of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഹിൽക്കീയാപുരോഹിതൻ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഒരു പുസ്തകം തന്നു എന്നും രായസക്കാരനായ ശാഫാൻ രാജാവിനോടു ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു. ശാഫാൻ അതു രാജസന്നിധിയിൽ വായിച്ചുകേൾപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.
chapters.nkjv: Then Shaphan the scribe showed the king, saying, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read it before the king.
chapters.kjv: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ന്യായപ്രമാണപുസ്തകത്തിലെ വാക്യങ്ങളെ കേട്ടിട്ടു വസ്ത്രം കീറി;
chapters.niv: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his robes.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, when the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, that he tore his clothes.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു പുരോഹിതനായ ഹിൽക്കീയാവോടും ശാഫാന്റെ മകൻ അഹീക്കാമിനോടും മീഖായാവിന്റെ മകൻ അക്ബോരിനോടും രായസക്കാരനായ ശാഫാനോടും രാജഭൃത്യനായ അസായാവോടും:
chapters.niv: He gave these orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Akbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:
chapters.nkjv: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Michaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ചെന്നു കണ്ടെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിലെ വാക്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു എനിക്കും ജനത്തിന്നും എല്ലായെഹൂദെക്കും വേണ്ടി യഹോവയോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിപ്പിൻ; നമുക്കുവേണ്ടി എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും അനുസരിച്ചുനടപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിലെ വാക്യങ്ങളെ കേൾക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു നമ്മുടെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയുടെ കോപം വലിയതല്ലോ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Go and inquire of the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the Lord ’s anger that burns against us because those who have gone before us have not obeyed the words of this book; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written there concerning us."
chapters.nkjv: "Go, inquire of the Lord for me, for the people and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that has been found; for great is the wrath of the Lord that is aroused against us, because our fathers have not obeyed the words of this book, to do according to all that is written concerning us."
chapters.kjv: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഹിൽക്കീയാ പുരോഹിതനും അഹീക്കാമും അക്ബോരും ശാഫാനും അസായാവും അർഹസിന്റെ മകനായ തിക്വയുടെ മകനായി രാജവസ്ത്രവിചാരകനായ ശല്ലൂമിന്റെ ഭാര്യ ഹുൽദാപ്രവാചകിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു--അവൾ യെരൂശലേമിൽ രണ്ടാം ഭാഗത്തു പാർത്തിരുന്നു--അവളോടു സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.
chapters.nkjv: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. (She dwelt in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter.) And they spoke with her.
chapters.kjv: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നിങ്ങളെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചവനോടു നിങ്ങൾ പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: She said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,
chapters.nkjv: Then she said to them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel, ‘Tell the man who sent you to Me,
chapters.kjv: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഞാൻ ഈ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നും നിവാസികൾക്കും യെഹൂദാരാജാവു വായിപ്പിച്ച പുസ്തകത്തിൽ വിവരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അനർത്ഥം വരുത്തും.
chapters.niv: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people, according to everything written in the book the king of Judah has read.
chapters.nkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will bring calamity on this place and on its inhabitants—all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read—
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

chapters.ml: അവർ എന്നെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു തങ്ങളുടെ സകല പ്രവൃത്തികളാലും എനിക്കു കോപം വരത്തക്കവണ്ണം അന്യദേവന്മാർക്കു ധൂപം കാട്ടിയതു കൊണ്ടു എന്റെ കോപം ഈ സ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിക്കും; അതു കെട്ടുപോകയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all the idols their hands have made, my anger will burn against this place and will not be quenched.’
chapters.nkjv: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. Therefore My wrath shall be aroused against this place and shall not be quenched.’ " ’
chapters.kjv: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയോടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങളെ അയച്ച യെഹൂദാരാജാവിനോടു നിങ്ങൾ പറയേണ്ടതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന വാക്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:
chapters.nkjv: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord, in this manner you shall speak to him, ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Concerning the words which you have heard—
chapters.kjv: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD , thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

chapters.ml: അവർ സ്തംഭനത്തിന്നും ശാപത്തിന്നും വിഷയമായിത്തീരുമെന്നു ഞാൻ ഈ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നും നിവാസികൾക്കും വിരോധമായി അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു നീ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ നിന്റെ ഹൃദയം അലിഞ്ഞു, നീ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നിന്നെത്തന്നെ താഴ്ത്തുകയും നിന്റെ വസ്ത്രം കീറി എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കരകയും ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു ഞാനും നിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I have spoken against this place and its people—that they would become a curse and be laid waste—and because you tore your robes and wept in my presence, I also have heard you, declares the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they would become a desolation and a curse, and you tore your clothes and wept before Me, I also have heard you," says the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD , when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee , saith the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ചേർത്തുകൊള്ളും; നീ സമാധാനത്തോടെ നിന്റെ കല്ലറയിൽ അടക്കപ്പെടും; ഞാൻ ഈ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു വരുത്തുവാൻ പോകുന്ന അനർത്ഥമൊന്നും നിന്റെ കണ്ണു കാണുകയില്ല. അവർ രാജാവിനോടു ഈ മറുപടി ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Therefore I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place.’ " So they took her answer back to the king.
chapters.nkjv: "Surely, therefore, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace; and your eyes shall not see all the calamity which I will bring on this place." ’ " So they brought back word to the king.
chapters.kjv: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം രാജാവു ആളയച്ചു; അവർ യെഹൂദയിലും യെരൂശലേമിലുമുള്ള എല്ലാ മൂപ്പന്മാരെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now the king sent them to gather all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem to him.
chapters.kjv: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: രാജാവും സകലയെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരും യെരൂശലേമിലെ സകലനിവാസികളും പുരോഹിതന്മാരും പ്രവാചകന്മാരും ആബാലവൃദ്ധം ജനമൊക്കെയും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു ചെന്നു; യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽവെച്ചു കണ്ടുകിട്ടിയ നിയമപുസ്തകത്തിലെ വാക്യങ്ങളെയെല്ലാം അവർ കേൾക്കെ അവൻ വായിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He went up to the temple of the Lord with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the prophets—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: The king went up to the house of the Lord with all the men of Judah, and with him all the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests and the prophets and all the people, both small and great. And he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant which had been found in the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the king went up into the house of the LORD , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: രാജാവു തൂണിന്നരികെ നിന്നുംകൊണ്ടു താൻ യഹോവയെ അനുസരിച്ചുനടക്കയും അവന്റെ കല്പനകളും സാക്ഷ്യങ്ങളും ചട്ടങ്ങളും പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടുംകൂടെ പ്രമാണിക്കയും ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന നിയമത്തിന്റെ വാക്യങ്ങൾ നിവർത്തിക്കയും ചെയ്യാമെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്തു. ജനമൊക്കെയും ഈ നിയമത്തിൽ യോജിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king stood by the pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the Lord —to follow the Lord and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, thus confirming the words of the covenant written in this book. Then all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king stood by a pillar and made a covenant before the Lord, to follow the Lord and to keep His commandments and His testimonies and His statutes, with all his heart and all his soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people took a stand for the covenant.
chapters.kjv: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD , to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ ഹിൽക്കീയാവോടും രണ്ടാം തരത്തിലുള്ള പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടും വാതിൽ കാക്കുന്നവരോടും ബാലിന്നും അശേരെക്കും ആകാശത്തിലെ സർവ്വസൈന്യത്തിന്നും വേണ്ടി ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും യഹോവയുടെ മന്ദിരത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു; യെരൂശലേമിന്നു പുറത്തു കിദ്രോൻ പ്രദേശത്തുവെച്ചു അവയെ ചുട്ടു, ചാരം ബേഥേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests next in rank and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the Lord all the articles made for Baal and Asherah and all the starry hosts. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley and took the ashes to Bethel.
chapters.nkjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests of the second order, and the doorkeepers, to bring out of the temple of the Lord all the articles that were made for Baal, for Asherah, and for all the host of heaven; and he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.
chapters.kjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാപട്ടണങ്ങളിലും യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലുമുള്ള പൂജാഗിരികളിൽ ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാൻ യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാർ നിയമിച്ചിരുന്ന പൂജാഗിരികളെയും ബാലിന്നും സൂര്യന്നും ചന്ദ്രന്നും ഗ്രഹങ്ങൾക്കും ആകാശത്തിലെ സർവ്വസൈന്യത്തിന്നും ധൂപം കാട്ടിയവരെയും അവൻ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He did away with the idolatrous priests appointed by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the towns of Judah and on those around Jerusalem—those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations and to all the starry hosts.
chapters.nkjv: Then he removed the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense on the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places all around Jerusalem, and those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the constellations, and to all the host of heaven.
chapters.kjv: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

chapters.ml: അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠയെയും അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽനിന്നു യെരൂശലേമിന്നു പുറത്തു കിദ്രോൻ തോട്ടിങ്കലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു കിദ്രോൻ താഴ്വീതിയിൽവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുപൊടിയാക്കി പൊടി സാമാന്യജനത്തിന്റെ ശവക്കുഴികളിന്മേൽ ഇട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He took the Asherah pole from the temple of the Lord to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem and burned it there. He ground it to powder and scattered the dust over the graves of the common people.
chapters.nkjv: And he brought out the wooden image from the house of the Lord, to the Brook Kidron outside Jerusalem, burned it at the Brook Kidron and ground it to ashes, and threw its ashes on the graves of the common people.
chapters.kjv: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD , without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീകൾ അശേരെക്കു കൂടാരശീലകൾ നെയ്ത ഇടങ്ങളായി യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിങ്കലുള്ള പുരുഷമൈഥുനക്കാരുടെ വീടുകളെയും അവൻ ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the temple of the Lord , the quarters where women did weaving for Asherah.
chapters.nkjv: Then he tore down the ritual booths of the perverted persons that were in the house of the Lord, where the women wove hangings for the wooden image.
chapters.kjv: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the LORD , where the women wove hangings for the grove.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹൂദാപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു സകല പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും വരുത്തി, ഗേബമുതൽ ബേർ-ശേബവരെ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ധൂപം കാട്ടിയിരുന്ന പൂജാഗിരികളെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കി, പട്ടണവാതിൽപ്രവേശനത്തിങ്കൽ ഇടത്തുഭാഗത്തു നഗരാധിപതിയായ യോശുവയുടെ വാതിൽക്കലുള്ള പടിവാതിലുകളുടെ പൂജാഗിരികളെയും അവൻ ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Josiah brought all the priests from the towns of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He broke down the gateway at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, which was on the left of the city gate.
chapters.nkjv: And he brought all the priests from the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; also he broke down the high places at the gates which were at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were to the left of the city gate.
chapters.kjv: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പൂജാഗിരിപുരോഹിതന്മാർ യെരൂശലേമിലുള്ള യഹോവയുടെ യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ കയറിയില്ല; അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പം തിന്നതേയുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: Although the priests of the high places did not serve at the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brethren.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

chapters.ml: ആരും തന്റെ മകനെയോ മകളെയോ മോലെക്കിന്നു അഗ്നിപ്രവേശം ചെയ്യിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ബെൻ-ഹിന്നോംതാഴ്വരയിലെ ദഹനസ്ഥലവും അവൻ അശുദ്ധമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He desecrated Topheth, which was in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, so no one could use it to sacrifice their son or daughter in the fire to Molek.
chapters.nkjv: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter pass through the fire to Molech.
chapters.kjv: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രവേശനത്തിങ്കൽ വളപ്പിന്നകത്തുള്ള നാഥാൻ-മേലെക്ക് എന്ന ഷണ്ഡന്റെ അറെക്കരികെ യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാർ സൂര്യന്നു പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചിരുന്ന അശ്വബിംബങ്ങളെ അവൻ നീക്കി, സൂര്യരഥങ്ങളെ തീയിലിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He removed from the entrance to the temple of the Lord the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the room of an official named Nathan-Melek. Josiah then burned the chariots dedicated to the sun.
chapters.nkjv: Then he removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance to the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathan-Melech, the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
chapters.kjv: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD , by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാർ ആഹാസിന്റെ മാളികയുടെ മേൽപുരയിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന ബലിപീഠങ്ങളെയും മനശ്ശെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ രണ്ടു പ്രാകാരങ്ങളിലും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന ബലിപീഠങ്ങളെയും രാജാവു തകർത്തു അവിടെനിന്നു നീക്കി അവയുടെ പൊടി കിദ്രോൻ തോട്ടിൽ ഇട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He pulled down the altars the kings of Judah had erected on the roof near the upper room of Ahaz, and the altars Manasseh had built in the two courts of the temple of the Lord . He removed them from there, smashed them to pieces and threw the rubble into the Kidron Valley.
chapters.nkjv: The altars that were on the roof, the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, the king broke down and pulverized there, and threw their dust into the Brook Kidron.
chapters.kjv: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD , did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിന്നെതിരെ നാശപർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ വലത്തു ഭാഗത്തു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ശലോമോൻ സീദോന്യരുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛബിംബമായ അസ്തോരെത്തിന്നും മോവാബ്യരുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛബിംബമായ കെമോശിന്നും അമ്മോന്യരുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛബിംബമായ മിൽക്കോമിന്നും പണിതിരുന്ന പൂജാഗിരികളെയും രാജാവു അശുദ്ധമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: The king also desecrated the high places that were east of Jerusalem on the south of the Hill of Corruption—the ones Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the vile goddess of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the vile god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the people of Ammon.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king defiled the high places that were east of Jerusalem, which were on the south of the Mount of Corruption, which Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the people of Ammon.
chapters.kjv: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വിഗ്രഹസ്തംഭങ്ങളെ തകർത്തു അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠകളെ വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു, അവ നിന്നിരുന്ന സ്ഥലങ്ങളെ മനുഷ്യാസ്ഥികൾകൊണ്ടു നിറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Josiah smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles and covered the sites with human bones.
chapters.nkjv: And he broke in pieces the sacred pillars and cut down the wooden images, and filled their places with the bones of men.
chapters.kjv: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

chapters.ml: അത്രയുമല്ല, യിസ്രായേലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു പാപം ചെയ്യിച്ച നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാം ബേഥേലിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന യാഗപീഠവും പൂജാഗിരിയും അവൻ ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; പൂജാഗിരി അവൻ ചുട്ടു പൊടിയാക്കി, അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠയും ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Even the altar at Bethel, the high place made by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin—even that altar and high place he demolished. He burned the high place and ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole also.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and crushed it to powder, and burned the wooden image.
chapters.kjv: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോശീയാവു തിരിഞ്ഞു നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ അവിടെ മലയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന കല്ലറകൾ കണ്ടിട്ടു ആളയച്ചു കല്ലറകളിൽനിന്നു അസ്ഥികളെ എടുപ്പിച്ചു, ഈ കാര്യം മുന്നറിയിച്ചിരുന്ന ദൈവപുരുഷൻ പ്രസ്താവിച്ച യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം ആ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടു അതു അശുദ്ധമാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Josiah looked around, and when he saw the tombs that were there on the hillside, he had the bones removed from them and burned on the altar to defile it, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by the man of God who foretold these things.
chapters.nkjv: As Josiah turned, he saw the tombs that were there on the mountain. And he sent and took the bones out of the tombs and burned them on the altar, and defiled it according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
chapters.kjv: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കാണുന്ന ആ ജ്ഞാപകസ്തംഭം എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു ആ പട്ടണക്കാർ അവനോടു: അതു യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നു വരികയും നീ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന കാര്യങ്ങളെ ബേഥേലിലെ യാഗപീഠത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു മുന്നറിയിക്കയും ചെയ്ത ദൈവ പുരുഷന്റെ കല്ലറയാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king asked, "What is that tombstone I see?" The people of the city said, "It marks the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced against the altar of Bethel the very things you have done to it."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "What gravestone is this that I see?" So the men of the city told him, "Itis the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things which you have done against the altar of Bethel."
chapters.kjv: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: അതു ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; അവന്റെ അസ്ഥികളെ ആരും അനക്കരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അങ്ങനെ അവർ അവന്റെ അസ്ഥികളെയും ശമർയ്യയിൽനിന്നു വന്ന പ്രവാചകന്റെ അസ്ഥികളെയും വിട്ടേച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: "Leave it alone," he said. "Don’t let anyone disturb his bones." So they spared his bones and those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Let him alone; let no one move his bones." So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാർ ശമർയ്യാപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന സകലപൂജാഗിരിക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളെയും യോശീയാവു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു ബേഥേലിൽ അവൻ ചെയ്തതുപോലെയൊക്കെയും അവയോടും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Just as he had done at Bethel, Josiah removed all the shrines at the high places that the kings of Israel had built in the towns of Samaria and that had aroused the Lord ’s anger.
chapters.nkjv: Now Josiah also took away all the shrines of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger; and he did to them according to all the deeds he had done in Bethel.
