chapters.kjv: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെയുള്ള പൂജാഗിരിപുരോഹിതന്മാരെയൊക്കെയും ബലിപീഠങ്ങളിന്മേൽ വെട്ടിക്കൊല്ലിക്കയും അവയുടെ മേൽ മനുഷ്യാസ്ഥികൾ ചുടുകയും ചെയ്തിട്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലകൂ മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Josiah slaughtered all the priests of those high places on the altars and burned human bones on them. Then he went back to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: He executed all the priests of the high places who were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം രാജാവു സകലജനത്തോടും: ഈ നിയമപുസ്കത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന പ്രകാരം നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു പെസഹ ആചരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The king gave this order to all the people: "Celebrate the Passover to the Lord your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant."
chapters.nkjv: Then the king commanded all the people, saying, "Keep the Passover to the Lord your God, as itis written in this Book of the Covenant."
chapters.kjv: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തിരുന്ന ന്യായാധിപന്മാരുടെ കാലം മുതല്ക്കും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെയും കാലത്തും ഇതുപോലെ ഒരു പെസഹ ആചരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Neither in the days of the judges who led Israel nor in the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah had any such Passover been observed.
chapters.nkjv: Such a Passover surely had never been held since the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah.
chapters.kjv: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

chapters.ml: യോശീയാരാജാവിന്റെ പതിനെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെരൂശലേമിൽ യഹോവെക്കു ഈ പെസഹ ആചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the Lord in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah this Passover was held before the Lord in Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഹിൽക്കീയാപുരോഹിതൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കണ്ടെത്തിയ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരുന്ന ന്യായപ്രാമണത്തിന്റെ വാക്യങ്ങളെ നിവർത്തിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം യോശീയാവു വെളിച്ചപ്പാടന്മാരെയും ലക്ഷണം പറയുന്നവരെയും ഗൃഹബിംബങ്ങളെയും മറ്റുവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും യെഹൂദാദേശത്തും യെരൂശലേമിലും കണ്ട സകലമ്ളേച്ഛതകളെയും അശേഷം നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Furthermore, Josiah got rid of the mediums and spiritists, the household gods, the idols and all the other detestable things seen in Judah and Jerusalem. This he did to fulfill the requirements of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had discovered in the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Moreover Josiah put away those who consulted mediums and spiritists, the household gods and idols, all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവനെപ്പോലെ പൂർണ്ണ ഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടും പൂർണ്ണശക്തിയോടും കൂടെ മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണ പ്രകാരമൊക്കെയും യഹോവയിങ്കലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞ ഒരു രാജാവു മുമ്പുണ്ടായിട്ടില്ല, പിമ്പു ഒരുത്തൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റിട്ടുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Neither before nor after Josiah was there a king like him who turned to the Lord as he did—with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, in accordance with all the Law of Moses.
chapters.nkjv: Now before him there was no king like him, who turned to the Lord with all his heart, with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the Law of Moses; nor after him did any arise like him.
chapters.kjv: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും മനശ്ശെ യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിച്ച സകലകോപഹേതുക്കളും നിമിത്തം യെഹൂദയുടെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ച തന്റെ മഹാകോപത്തിന്റെ ഉഗ്രതയെ യഹോവ വിട്ടുമാറാതെ:
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, the Lord did not turn away from the heat of his fierce anger, which burned against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to arouse his anger.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless the Lord did not turn from the fierceness of His great wrath, with which His anger was aroused against Judah, because of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked Him.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞതുപോലെ യെഹൂദയെയും എന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു നീക്കുകയും ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത ഈ യെരൂശലേം നഗരത്തെയും എന്റെ നാമം അവിടെ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത ആലയത്തെയും ത്യജിച്ചുകളകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the Lord said, "I will remove Judah also from my presence as I removed Israel, and I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and this temple, about which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "I will also remove Judah from My sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’ "
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

chapters.ml: യോശീയാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Josiah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കാലത്തു മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോൻ-നെഖോ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്റെ നേരെ ഫ്രാത്ത് നദിക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; യോശീയാരാജാവു അവന്റെ നേരെ ചെന്നു; അവൻ അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു മെഗിദ്ദോവിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went up to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah marched out to meet him in battle, but Necho faced him and killed him at Megiddo.
chapters.nkjv: In his days Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went to the aid of the king of Assyria, to the River Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him. And PharaohNecho killed him at Megiddo when he confronted him.
chapters.kjv: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ മരിച്ചുപോയവനെ രഥത്തിൽ കയറ്റി മെഗിദ്ദോവിൽനിന്നു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവന്റെ സ്വന്തകല്ലറയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. പിന്നെ ദേശത്തെ ജനം യോശീയാവിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാഹാസിനെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വന്നു അഭിഷേകം കഴിപ്പിച്ചു അവന്റെ അപ്പന്നുപകരം രാജാവാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Josiah’s servants brought his body in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.
chapters.nkjv: Then his servants moved his body in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.
chapters.kjv: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹോവാഹാസ് വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തിമൂന്നു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ മൂന്നു മാസം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു ഹമൂതൽ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ ലിബ്നക്കാരനായ യിരെമ്യാവിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
chapters.kjv: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his fathers had done.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാഴാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഫറവോൻ-നെഖോ ഹമാത്ത് ദേശത്തിലെ രിബ്ളയിൽവെച്ചു അവനെ ബന്ധിച്ചു, ദേശത്തിന്നു നൂറു താലന്തു വെള്ളിയും ഒരു താലന്തു പൊന്നും പിഴ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh Necho put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he might not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
chapters.nkjv: Now Pharaoh Necho put him in prison at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and he imposed on the land a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

chapters.ml: ഫറവോൻ-നെഖോ യോശീയാവിന്റെ മകനായ എല്യാക്കീമിനെ അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ യോശീയാവിന്നു പകരം രാജാവാക്കി; അവന്റെ പേർ യെഹോയാക്കീം എന്നു മാറ്റി; യെഹോവാഹാസിനെ അവൻ കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവൻ മിസ്രയീമിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെവെച്ചു മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, and there he died.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. And Pharaoh took Jehoahaz and went to Egypt, and he died there.
chapters.kjv: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

chapters.ml: ആ വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും യെഹോയാക്കീം ഫറവോന്നു കൊടുത്തു; എന്നാൽ ഫറവോന്റെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം വെള്ളി കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ദേശത്തു വരിയിട്ടു; അവൻ ദേശത്തെ ജനത്തിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്റെയും പേരിൽ വരിയിട്ടതുപോലെ വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും അവരവരോടു പിരിച്ചെടുത്തു ഫറവോൻ-നെഖോവിന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh Necho the silver and gold he demanded. In order to do so, he taxed the land and exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land according to their assessments.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehoiakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give money according to the command of Pharaoh; he exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land, from every one according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necho.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാക്കീം വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ പതിനൊന്നു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു സെബീദാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ രൂമക്കാരനായ പെദായാവിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebudah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
chapters.kjv: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his fathers had done.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കാലത്തു ബാബേൽരാജാവായ നെബൂഖദ് നേസർ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു; യെഹോയാക്കീം മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം അവന്നു ആശ്രിതനായി ഇരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവൻ തിരിഞ്ഞു അവനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ കൽദയരുടെ പടക്കൂട്ടങ്ങളെയും അരാമ്യർ, മോവാബ്യർ, അമ്മോന്യർ എന്നിവരുടെ പടക്കൂട്ടങ്ങളെയും അവന്റെ നേരെ അയച്ചു;
chapters.niv: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. But then he turned against Nebuchadnezzar and rebelled.
chapters.nkjv: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
chapters.kjv: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

chapters.ml: പ്രവാചകന്മാരായ തന്റെ ദാസന്മാർമുഖാന്തരം യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരുന്ന വചനപ്രകാരം അവൻ അവരെ യെഹൂദയെ നശിപ്പിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം അതിന്റെ നേരെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord sent Babylonian, Aramean, Moabite and Ammonite raiders against him to destroy Judah, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by his servants the prophets.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord sent against him raiding bands of Chaldeans, bands of Syrians, bands of Moabites, and bands of the people of Ammon; He sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord which He had spoken by His servants the prophets.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by his servants the prophets.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെ ചെയ്ത സകലപാപങ്ങളും നിമിത്തം യെഹൂദയെ തന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളവാൻ ഇതു യഹോവയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം തന്നേ അവർക്കു ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Surely these things happened to Judah according to the Lord ’s command, in order to remove them from his presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all he had done,
chapters.nkjv: Surely at the commandment of the Lordthis came upon Judah, to remove them from His sight because of the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he had done,
chapters.kjv: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

chapters.ml: അവൻ കുറ്റമില്ലാത്ത രക്തം ചൊരിയിച്ചു യെരൂശലേമിനെ കുറ്റമില്ലാത്ത രക്തംകൊണ്ടു നിറെച്ചതും ക്ഷമിപ്പാൻ യഹോവെക്കു മനസ്സായില്ല.
chapters.niv: including the shedding of innocent blood. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord was not willing to forgive.
chapters.nkjv: and also because of the innocent blood that he had shed; for he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, which the Lord would not pardon.
chapters.kjv: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാക്കീമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവൻ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാക്കീം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോയാഖീൻ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jehoiakim rested with his ancestors. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehoiakim rested with his fathers. Then Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംരാജാവിന്നു മിസ്രയീംതോടുമുതൽ ഫ്രാത്ത് നദിവരെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതൊക്കെയും ബാബേൽരാജാവു പിടിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു മിസ്രയീംരാജാവു പിന്നെ തന്റെ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: The king of Egypt did not march out from his own country again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
chapters.nkjv: And the king of Egypt did not come out of his land anymore, for the king of Babylon had taken all that belonged to the king of Egypt from the Brook of Egypt to the River Euphrates.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാഖീൻ വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു പതിനെട്ടു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ മൂന്നുമാസം വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു നെഹുഷ്ഠാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ യെരൂശലേമ്യനായ എൽനാഥാന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പൻ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father had done.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ബാബേൽരാജാവായ നെബൂഖദ് നേസരിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു നഗരത്തെ നിരോധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem and laid siege to it,
chapters.nkjv: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
chapters.kjv: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ നിരോധിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ബാബേൽ രാജാവായ നെബൂഖദ് നേസരും നഗരത്തിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Nebuchadnezzar himself came up to the city while his officers were besieging it.
chapters.nkjv: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, as his servants were besieging it.
chapters.kjv: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോയാഖീനും അവന്റെ അമ്മയും അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ഷണ്ഡന്മാരും ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കു പുറത്തു ചെന്നു; ബാബേൽരാജാവു തന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ എട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his attendants, his nobles and his officials all surrendered to him. In the eighth year of the reign of the king of Babylon, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers went out to the king of Babylon; and the king of Babylon, in the eighth year of his reign, took him prisoner.
chapters.kjv: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ സകലനിക്ഷേപങ്ങളും രാജധാനിയിലെ നിക്ഷേപങ്ങളും അവിടെനിന്നു എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടു പോയി; യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ശലോമോൻ യഹോവയുടെ മന്ദിരത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കിവെച്ചിരുന്ന പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരുന്നതുപോലെ അവൻ ഖണ്ഡിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As the Lord had declared, Nebuchadnezzar removed the treasures from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace, and cut up the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And he carried out from there all the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house, and he cut in pieces all the articles of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.
chapters.kjv: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD , as the LORD had said.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാ യെരൂശലേമ്യരെയും സകലപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും സകല പരാക്രമശാലികളും ആയി പതിനായിരം പേരെയും എല്ലാ ആശാരിമാരെയും കൊല്ലന്മാരെയും അവൻ ബദ്ധരാക്കി കൊണ്ടുപോയി; ദേശത്തു എളിയജനം മാത്രമല്ലാതെ ആരും ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: He carried all Jerusalem into exile: all the officers and fighting men, and all the skilled workers and artisans—a total of ten thousand. Only the poorest people of the land were left.
chapters.nkjv: Also he carried into captivity all Jerusalem: all the captains and all the mighty men of valor, ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths. None remained except the poorest people of the land.
chapters.kjv: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാഖീനെ അവൻ ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി; രാജമാതാവിനെയും രാജഭാര്യമാരെയും അവന്റെ ഷണ്ഡന്മാരെയും ദേശത്തിലെ പ്രധാനികളെയും അവൻ ബദ്ധരാക്കി യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നു ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. He also took from Jerusalem to Babylon the king’s mother, his wives, his officials and the prominent people of the land.
chapters.nkjv: And he carried Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. The king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the mighty of the land he carried into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
chapters.kjv: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

chapters.ml: സകല ബലവാന്മാരുമായ ഏഴായിരംപേരെയും ആശാരിമാരും കൊല്ലന്മാരുമായ ആയിരം പേരെയും ഇങ്ങനെ യുദ്ധപ്രാപ്തന്മാരായ സകല വീരന്മാരെയും ബാബേൽരാജാവു ബദ്ധരാക്കി ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The king of Babylon also deported to Babylon the entire force of seven thousand fighting men, strong and fit for war, and a thousand skilled workers and artisans.
chapters.nkjv: All the valiant men, seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths, one thousand, all whowere strong and fit for war, these the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
chapters.kjv: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു പകരം ബാബേൽരാജാവു അവന്റെ ചിറ്റപ്പനായ മത്ഥന്യാവെ രാജാവാക്കി; അവന്നു സിദെക്കീയാവു എന്നു പേർ മാറ്റിയിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

chapters.ml: സിദെക്കീയാവു വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തൊന്നു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ പതിനൊന്നു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു ഹമൂതൽ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ ലിബ്നക്കാരനായ യിരെമ്യാവിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.nkjv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
chapters.kjv: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാക്കീം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.nkjv: He also did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കോപം ഹേതുവായി യെരൂശലേമിന്നും യെഹൂദെക്കും അങ്ങനെ ഭവിച്ചു; അവൻ ഒടുവിൽ അവരെ തന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ സിദെക്കീയാവും ബാബേൽരാജാവിനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: For because of the anger of the Lordthis happened in Jerusalem and Judah, that He finally cast them out from His presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.kjv: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ ഒമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ പത്താം മാസം പത്താം തിയ്യതി ബാബേൽരാജാവായ നെബൂഖദ് നേസർ തന്റെ സർവ്വസൈന്യവുമായി യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു പാളയം ഇറങ്ങി; അതിന്നെതിരെ ചുറ്റും വാടകോരി.
chapters.niv: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. He encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem and encamped against it; and they built a siege wall against it all around.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

chapters.ml: സിദെക്കീയാ രാജാവിന്റെ പതിനൊന്നാം ആണ്ടുവരെ നഗരം നിരോധിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
chapters.nkjv: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
chapters.kjv: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

chapters.ml: നാലാം മാസം ഒമ്പതാം തിയ്യതി നഗരത്തിൽ ക്ഷാമം കലശലായി ദേശത്തെ ജനത്തിന്നു ആഹാരം ഇല്ലാതെപോയി.
chapters.niv: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.
chapters.nkjv: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine had become so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
chapters.kjv: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ നഗരമതിൽ ഒരിടം പൊളിച്ചു കൽദയർ നഗരം വളഞ്ഞിരിക്കെ പടയാളികൾ ഒക്കെയും രാത്രിസമയത്തു രാജാവിന്റെ തോട്ടത്തിന്നരികെ രണ്ടു മതിലുകൾക്കും മദ്ധ്യേയുള്ള പടിവാതിൽവഴിയായി ഓടിപ്പോയി; രാജാവും അരാബയിലേക്കുള്ള വഴിയായി പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,
chapters.nkjv: Then the city wall was broken through, and all the men of war fled at night by way of the gate between two walls, which was by the king’s garden, even though the Chaldeans were still encamped all around against the city. And theking went by way of the plain.
chapters.kjv: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കൽദയരുടെ സൈന്യം രാജാവിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു യെരീഹോസമഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു അവനോടു എത്തി; അവന്റെ സൈന്യമൊക്കെയും അവനെ വിട്ടു ചിന്നിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: but the Babylonian army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,
chapters.nkjv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and they overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his army was scattered from him.
chapters.kjv: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

chapters.ml: അവർ രാജാവിനെ പിടിച്ചു രിബ്ളയിൽ ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു; അവർ അവന്നു വിധി കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where sentence was pronounced on him.
chapters.nkjv: So they took the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and they pronounced judgment on him.
chapters.kjv: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

chapters.ml: അവർ സിദെക്കീയാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ അവൻ കാൺകെ കൊന്നു; സിദെക്കീയാവിന്റെ കണ്ണു പൊട്ടിച്ചിട്ടു രണ്ടു ചങ്ങലകൊണ്ടു അവനെ ബന്ധിച്ചു ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: Then they killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, put out the eyes of Zedekiah, bound him with bronze fetters, and took him to Babylon.
chapters.kjv: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാം മാസം ഏഴാം തിയ്യതി, നെബൂഖദ് നേസർ രാജാവെന്ന ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ പത്തൊമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ തന്നേ, ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ ഭൃത്യനായി അകമ്പടി നായകനായ നെബൂസരദാൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽവന്നു.
chapters.niv: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, an official of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month (which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയവും രാജധാനിയും ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു; യെരൂശലേമിലെ എല്ലാവീടുകളും പ്രധാനഭവനങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അവൻ തീ വെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.
chapters.nkjv: He burned the house of the Lord and the king’s house; all the houses of Jerusalem, that is, all the houses of the great, he burned with fire.
chapters.kjv: And he burnt the house of the LORD , and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.

chapters.ml: അകമ്പടിനായകനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന കൽദയസൈന്യമൊക്കെയും യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള മതിലുകളെ ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The whole Babylonian army under the commander of the imperial guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And all the army of the Chaldeans who werewith the captain of the guard broke down the walls of Jerusalem all around.
chapters.kjv: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

chapters.ml: നഗരത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്ന ജനത്തെയും ബാബേൽരാജാവിനെ ശരണം പ്രാപിച്ചവരെയും പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചവരെയും അകമ്പടിനായകനായ നെബൂസരദാൻ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the rest of the populace and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who remained in the city and the defectors who had deserted to the king of Babylon, with the rest of the multitude.
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അകമ്പടിനായകൻ ദേശത്തെ എളിയവരിൽ ചിലരെ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടക്കാരായിട്ടും കൃഷിക്കാരായിട്ടും വിട്ടേച്ചു പോയി.
chapters.niv: But the commander left behind some of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
chapters.nkjv: But the captain of the guard left some of the poor of the land as vinedressers and farmers.
chapters.kjv: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ താമ്രസ്തംഭങ്ങളും പീഠങ്ങളും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ താമ്രംകൊണ്ടുള്ള കടലും കൽദയർ ഉടെച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു അവയുടെ താമ്രം ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried the bronze to Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: The bronze pillars that were in the house of the Lord, and the carts and the bronze Sea that were in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and carried their bronze to Babylon.
chapters.kjv: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD , and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD , did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

chapters.ml: കലങ്ങളും ചട്ടുകങ്ങളും കത്രികകളും തവികളും ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള താമ്രോപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും അവർ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.
chapters.nkjv: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the trimmers, the spoons, and all the bronze utensils with which the priests ministered.
chapters.kjv: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

chapters.ml: തീച്ചട്ടികളും കലശങ്ങളും പൊന്നും വെള്ളിയുംകൊണ്ടുള്ളതൊക്കെയും അകമ്പടിനായകൻ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The commander of the imperial guard took away the censers and sprinkling bowls—all that were made of pure gold or silver.
chapters.nkjv: The firepans and the basins, the things of solid gold and solid silver, the captain of the guard took away.
chapters.kjv: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്നുവേണ്ടി ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ രണ്ടു സ്തംഭം, ഒരു കടൽ, പീഠങ്ങൾ എന്നിങ്ങനെയുള്ള സകലഉപകരങ്ങളുടെയും താമ്രത്തിന്നു തൂക്കമില്ലാതെയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the movable stands, which Solomon had made for the temple of the Lord , was more than could be weighed.
chapters.nkjv: The two pillars, one Sea, and the carts, which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord, the bronze of all these articles was beyond measure.
chapters.kjv: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD ; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

chapters.ml: ഒരു സ്തംഭത്തിന്റെ ഉയരം പതിനെട്ടു മുഴം; അതിന്മേലുള്ള പോതിക താമ്രംകൊണ്ടു ആയിരുന്നു; പോതികയുടെ ഉയരം മൂന്നു മുഴം; പോതികയുടെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള വലപ്പണിയും മാതളപ്പഴവും ആസകലം താമ്രംകൊണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇതുപോലെ മറ്റെ സ്തംഭത്തിന്നും വലപ്പണിയും മറ്റും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high. The bronze capital on top of one pillar was three cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its network, was similar.
chapters.nkjv: The height of one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the capital on it was of bronze. The height of the capital was three cubits, and the network and pomegranates all around the capital were all of bronze. The second pillar was the same, with a network.
chapters.kjv: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

chapters.ml: അകമ്പടിനായകൻ മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ സെരായാവെയും രണ്ടാം പുരോഹിതനായ സെഫന്യാവെയും മൂന്നു ഉമ്മരപ്പടിക്കാവൽക്കാരെയും പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.nkjv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.kjv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

chapters.ml: നഗരത്തിൽ നിന്നു അവൻ യോദ്ധാക്കളുടെ മേൽവിചാരകനായ ഒരു ഷണ്ഡനെയും നഗരത്തിൽവെച്ചു കണ്ടെത്തിയ രാജപരിചാരകന്മാരിൽ അഞ്ചുപേരെയും ദേശത്തെ ജനത്തെ പടെക്കു സ്വരൂപിക്കുന്ന സേനാപതിയുടെ രായസക്കാരനെയും നഗരത്തിൽ കണ്ട ദേശത്തെ ജനത്തിൽ അറുപതുപേരെയും പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and five royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land and sixty of the conscripts who were found in the city.
chapters.nkjv: He also took out of the city an officer who had charge of the men of war, five men of the king’s close associates who were found in the city, the chief recruiting officer of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land whowere found in the city.
chapters.kjv: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

chapters.ml: ഇവരെ അകമ്പടിനായകനായ നെബൂസരദാൻ പിടിച്ചു രിബ്ളയിൽ ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.nkjv: So Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, took these and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.kjv: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

chapters.ml: ബാബേൽരാജാവു ഹാമത്ത് ദേശത്തിലെ രിബ്ളയിൽവെച്ചു അവരെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു. ഇങ്ങനെ യെഹൂദാ സ്വദേശം വിട്ടുപോകേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Babylon struck them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive from its own land.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

chapters.ml: ബാബേൽരാജാവായ നെബൂഖദ്നേസർ യെഹൂദാദേശത്തു ശേഷിപ്പിച്ചുവെച്ച ജനത്തിന്നു ശാഫാന്റെ മകനായ അഹീക്കാമിന്റെ മകനായ ഗെദല്യാവെ അധിപതിയാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to be over the people he had left behind in Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Then he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor over the people who remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left.
chapters.kjv: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

chapters.ml: ബാബേൽരാജാവു ഗെദല്യാവെ അധിപതിയാക്കി എന്നു നെഥന്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ യിശ്മായേൽ, കാരേഹിന്റെ മകൻ യോഹാനാൻ, നെതോഫാത്യനായ തൻഹൂമെത്തിന്റെ മകൻ സെരായ്യാവു, മാഖാത്യന്റെ മകൻ യാസന്യാവു എന്നിങ്ങനെ സകലസേനാപതികളും അവരുടെ ആളുകളും കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ മിസ്പെയിൽ ഗെദല്യാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When all the army officers and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.
chapters.nkjv: Now when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Careah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
chapters.kjv: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

chapters.ml: ഗെദല്യാവു അവരോടും അവരുടെ ആളുകളോടും സത്യം ചെയ്തു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ കൽദയരുടെ ദാസന്മാർനിമിത്തം ഭയപ്പെടരുതു; ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു ബാബേൽ രാജാവിനെ സേവിപ്പിൻ; അതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു നന്മയായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Gedaliah took an oath to reassure them and their men. "Do not be afraid of the Babylonian officials," he said. "Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you."
chapters.nkjv: And Gedaliah took an oath before them and their men, and said to them, "Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you."
chapters.kjv: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏഴാം മാസത്തിൽ രാജവംശക്കാരനായ എലീശയുടെ മകനായ നെഥന്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ യിശ്മായേൽ പത്തു ആളുമായി വന്നു ഗെദല്യാവെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ മിസ്പെയിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന യെഹൂദ്യരെയും കൽദയരെയും വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood, came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah and also the men of Judah and the Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.
chapters.nkjv: But it happened in the seventh month that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal family, came with ten men and struck and killed Gedaliah, the Jews, as well as the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
chapters.kjv: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആബാലവൃദ്ധം ജനമൊക്കെയും സേനാപതിമാരും കൽദയരെ ഭയപ്പെടുകയാൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പുറപ്പെട്ടു മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: At this, all the people from the least to the greatest, together with the army officers, fled to Egypt for fear of the Babylonians.
chapters.nkjv: And all the people, small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose and went to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
chapters.kjv: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോയാഖീന്റെ പ്രവാസത്തിന്റെ മുപ്പത്തേഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ പന്ത്രണ്ടാം മാസം ഇരുപത്തേഴാം തിയ്യതി ബാബേൽ രാജാവായ എവീൽ-മെരോദക്ക് താൻ രാജാവായ ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോയാഖീനെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചു
chapters.niv: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison. He did this on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, that Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

chapters.ml: അവനോടു ആദരവായി സംസാരിച്ചു അവന്റെ ആസനത്തെ തന്നോടുകൂടെ ബാബേലിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ ആസനങ്ങൾക്കു മേലായി വെച്ചു;
chapters.niv: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: He spoke kindly to him, and gave him a more prominent seat than those of the kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.kjv: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കാരാഗൃഹവസ്ത്രം മാറ്റി; അവൻ ജീവപര്യന്തം നിത്യം അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehoiachin changed from his prison garments, and he ate bread regularly before the king all the days of his life.
chapters.kjv: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അഹോവൃത്തിയോ, രാജാവു അവന്നു അവന്റെ മരണദിവസംവരെ അവന്റെ ജീവകാലമൊക്കെയും നിത്യവൃത്തിക്കു ദിവസംപ്രതിയുള്ള ഓഹരി കൊടുത്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Day by day the king gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived.
chapters.nkjv: And as for his provisions, therewas a regular ration given him by the king, a portion for each day, all the days of his life.
chapters.kjv: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

chapters.ml: ആദാം, ശേത്ത്, ഏനോശ്,
chapters.niv: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
chapters.nkjv: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
chapters.kjv: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,

chapters.ml: കേനാൻ, മഹലലേൽ, യാരേദ്,
chapters.niv: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
chapters.nkjv: Cainan, Mahalalel, Jared,
chapters.kjv: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

chapters.ml: ഹനോക്ക്, മെഥൂശേലഹ്, ലാമെക്ക്, നോഹ,
chapters.niv: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.
chapters.nkjv: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
chapters.kjv: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

chapters.ml: ശേം, ഹാം, യാഫെത്ത്. യാഫെത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ:
chapters.niv: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
chapters.nkjv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
chapters.kjv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

chapters.ml: ഗോമെർ, മാഗോഗ്, മാദായി, യാവാൻ, തൂബാൽ
chapters.niv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

chapters.ml: മേശെക്ക്, തീരാസ്. ഗോമെരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അശ്കേനസ്, രീഫത്ത്, തോഗർമ്മാ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

chapters.ml: യാവാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: എലീശാ, തർശീശ്, കിത്തീം, ദോദാനീം.
chapters.niv: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshishah, Kittim, and Rodanim.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

chapters.ml: ഹാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: കൂശ്, മിസ്രയീം, പൂത്ത്, കനാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

chapters.ml: കൂശിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സെബാ, ഹവീലാ, സബ്താ, രമാ, സബെഖാ. രമയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശെബാ, ദെദാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabtecha. The sons of Raama were Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

chapters.ml: കൂശ് നിമ്രോദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. അവൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ആദ്യത്തെ വീരനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on earth.
chapters.nkjv: Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമോ: ലൂദീം, അനാമീം, ലെഹാബീം,
chapters.niv: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
chapters.nkjv: Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
chapters.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

chapters.ml: നഫ്തൂഹീം, പത്രൂസീം, കസ്ളൂഹീം,--ഇവരിൽ നിന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഉത്ഭവിച്ചു--കഫ്തോരീം എന്നിവരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.
chapters.nkjv: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines and the Caphtorim).
chapters.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

chapters.ml: കനാൻ തന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ സീദോൻ,
chapters.niv: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
chapters.nkjv: Canaan begot Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth;
chapters.kjv: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

chapters.ml: ഹേത്ത്, യെബൂസി, അമോരി,
chapters.niv: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
chapters.nkjv: the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite;
chapters.kjv: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

chapters.ml: ഗിർഗ്ഗശി, ഹിവ്വി, അർക്കി, സീനി, അർവ്വാദി,
chapters.niv: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
chapters.nkjv: the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite;
chapters.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

chapters.ml: സെമാരി, ഹമാത്തി എന്നിവരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites.
chapters.nkjv: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
chapters.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

chapters.ml: ശേമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഏലാം, അശ്ശൂർ, അർപ്പക്ഷദ്, ലൂദ്, അരാം, ഊസ്, ഹൂൾ, ഗേഥെർ, മേശെക്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

chapters.ml: അർപ്പക്ഷദ് ശേലഹിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ശേലഹ് ഏബെരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
chapters.nkjv: Arphaxad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.
chapters.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

chapters.ml: ഏബെരിന്നു രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിച്ചു; ഒരുത്തന്നു പേലെഗ് എന്നു പേർ; അവന്റെ കാലത്തായിരുന്നു ഭൂവാസികൾ പിരിഞ്ഞുപോയതു; അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്നു യൊക്താൻ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.
chapters.nkjv: To Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
chapters.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.

chapters.ml: യൊക്താനോ: അല്മോദാദ്, ശേലെഫ്, ഹസർമ്മാവെത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.nkjv: Joktan begot Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

chapters.ml: ഹദോരാം, ഊസാൽ, ദിക്ളാ,
chapters.niv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.nkjv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.kjv: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

chapters.ml: എബാൽ, അബീമായേൽ, ശെബാ,
chapters.niv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.nkjv: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.kjv: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

chapters.ml: ഓഫീർ, ഹവീലാ, യോബാബ് എന്നിവരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഇവരെല്ലാവരും യൊക്താന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
chapters.nkjv: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
chapters.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

chapters.ml: ശേം, അർപ്പക്ഷദ്, ശേലഹ്, ഏബെർ,
chapters.niv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
chapters.nkjv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
chapters.kjv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

chapters.ml: പേലെഗ്, രെയൂ, ശെരൂഗ്,
chapters.niv: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
chapters.nkjv: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
chapters.kjv: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

chapters.ml: നാഹോർ, തേരഹ്, അബ്രാം;
chapters.niv: Serug, Nahor, Terah
chapters.nkjv: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
chapters.kjv: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ തന്നേ അബ്രാഹാം.
chapters.niv: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
chapters.nkjv: and Abram, who is Abraham.
chapters.kjv: Abram; the same is Abraham.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യിസ്ഹാക്ക്, യിശ്മായേൽ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ വംശപാരമ്പര്യമാവിതു: യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ നെബായോത്ത്,
chapters.niv: These were their descendants: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.nkjv: These are their genealogies: The firstborn of Ishmael was Nebajoth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.kjv: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

chapters.ml: കേദാർ, അദ്ബെയേൽ, മിബ്ശാം, മിശ്മാ, ദൂമാ,
chapters.niv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
chapters.nkjv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
chapters.kjv: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

chapters.ml: മസ്സാ, ഹദദ്, തേമാ, യെതൂർ, നാഫീഷ്, കേദമാ; ഇവർ യിശ്മായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
chapters.nkjv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
chapters.kjv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയായ കെതൂരയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സിമ്രാൻ, യൊക്ശാൻ, മേദാൻ, മിദ്യാൻ, യിശ്ബാക്, ശൂവഹ് എന്നിവരെ അവൾ പ്രസവിച്ചു. യോക്ശാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശെബാ, ദെദാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.nkjv: Now the sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine, were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.kjv: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

chapters.ml: മിദ്യാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഏഫാ, ഏഫെർ, ഹനോക്ക്, അബീദാ, എൽദായാ; ഇവരെല്ലാവരും കെതൂരയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാം യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഏശാവ്, യിസ്രായേൽ.
chapters.niv: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And Abraham begot Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

chapters.ml: ഏശാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: എലീഫാസ്, രെയൂവേൽ, യെയൂശ്, യലാം, കോരഹ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam and Korah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

chapters.ml: എലീഫാസിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: തേമാൻ, ഓമാർ, സെഫീ, ഗഥാം, കെനസ്, തിമ്നാ, അമാലേക്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz; by Timna: Amalek.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

chapters.ml: രെയൂവേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: നഹത്ത്, സേറഹ്, ശമ്മാ, മിസ്സാ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

chapters.ml: സേയീരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ലോതാൻ, ശോബാൽ, സിബെയോൻ, അനാ, ദീശോൻ, ഏസെർ, ദീശാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

chapters.ml: ലോതാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഹോരി, ഹോമാം; തിമ്നാ ലോതാന്റെ സഹോദരി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Homam; Lotan’s sister was Timna.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

chapters.ml: ശോബാലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അലീയാൻ, മാനഹത്ത്, ഏബാൽ, ശെഫി, ഓനാം. സിബേയോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അയ്യാ, അനാ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Shobal were Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon were Ajah and Anah.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

chapters.ml: അനയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ദീശോൻ. ദീശോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഹമ്രാൻ, എശ്ബാൽ, യിത്രാൻ, കെരാൻ.
chapters.niv: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.
chapters.nkjv: The son of Anah was Dishon. The sons of Dishon were Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

chapters.ml: ഏസെരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ബിൽഹാൻ, സാവാൻ, യാക്കാൻ. ദീശാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഊസ്, അരാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan. The sons of Dishan : Uz and Aran.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan were Uz and Aran.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെ രാജാവു വാഴുംമുമ്പെ ഏദോംദേശത്തു വാണ രാജാക്കന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: ബെയോരിന്റെ മകനായ ബേല; അവന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു ദിൻ ഹാബാ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned: Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.
chapters.nkjv: Now these were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before a king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
chapters.kjv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

chapters.ml: ബേല മരിച്ചശേഷം ബൊസ്രക്കാരനായ സേരഹിന്റെ മകൻ യോബാബ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യോബാബ് മരിച്ചശേഷം തേമാദേശക്കാരനായ ഹൂശാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ഹൂശാം മരിച്ചശേഷം ബദദിന്റെ മകൻ ഹദദ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി; അവൻ മോവാബ് സമഭൂമിയിൽ മിദ്യാനെ തോല്പിച്ചു; അവന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു അവീത്ത് എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.
chapters.nkjv: And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who attacked Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
chapters.kjv: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

chapters.ml: ഹദദ് മരിച്ചശേഷം മസ്രേക്കക്കാരനായ സമ്ളാഅവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: സമ്ളാ മരിച്ചശേഷം നദീതീരത്തുള്ള രെഹോബോത്ത് പട്ടണക്കാരനായ ശൌൽ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: And when Samlah died, Saul of Rehoboth-by-the-River reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ മരിച്ചശേഷം അക്ബോരിന്റെ മകൻ ബാൽഹാനാൻ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: When Saul died, Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ബാൽഹാനാൻ മരിച്ചശേഷം ഹദദ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി. അവന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പായീ എന്നും ഭാര്യക്കു മെഹേതബേൽ എന്നും പേർ. അവൾ മേസാഹാബിന്റെ മകളായ മത്രേദിന്റെ മകളായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Baal-Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.
chapters.nkjv: And when Baal-Hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
chapters.kjv: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

chapters.ml: ഹദദും മരിച്ചു. ഏദോമ്യ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരാവിതു: തിമ്നാ പ്രഭു, അല്യാപ്രഭു, യെഥേത്ത് പ്രഭു,
chapters.niv: Hadad also died. The chiefs of Edom were: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
chapters.nkjv: Hadad died also. And the chiefs of Edom were Chief Timnah, Chief Aliah, Chief Jetheth,
chapters.kjv: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

chapters.ml: ഒഹൊലീബാമാപ്രഭു, ഏലാ പ്രഭു,
chapters.niv: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
chapters.nkjv: Chief Aholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
chapters.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

chapters.ml: പീനോൻ പ്രഭു, കെനസ്പ്രഭു, തേമാൻ പ്രഭു,
chapters.niv: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
chapters.nkjv: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,
chapters.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

chapters.ml: മിബ്സാർപ്രഭു, മഗ്ദീയേൽപ്രഭു, ഈരാംപ്രഭു; ഇവരത്രേ ഏദോമ്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
chapters.nkjv: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
chapters.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരാവിതു: രൂബേൻ, ശിമെയോൻ, ലേവി, യെഹൂദാ,
chapters.niv: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
chapters.kjv: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാർ, സെബൂലൂൻ, ദാൻ, യോസേഫ്, ബെന്യാമീൻ, നഫ്താലി, ഗാദ്, ആശേർ.
chapters.niv: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
chapters.nkjv: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
chapters.kjv: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഏർ, ഓനാൻ, ശേലാ; ഇവർ മൂവരും കനാന്യസ്ത്രീയായ ബത്ശൂവയിൽനിന്നു അവന്നു ജനിച്ചു. യെഹൂദയുടെ ആദ്യജാതനായ ഏർ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടനായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവനെ കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by the daughter of Shua, the Canaanitess. Er, the firstborn of Judah, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; so He killed him.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD ; and he slew him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മരുമകൾ താമാർ അവന്നു പേരെസ്സിനെയും സേരഹിനെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു. യെഹൂദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആകെ അഞ്ചു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Judah’s daughter-in-law Tamar bore Perez and Zerah to Judah. He had five sons in all.
chapters.nkjv: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
chapters.kjv: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

chapters.ml: പേരെസ്സിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഹെസ്രോൻ, ഹാമൂൽ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

chapters.ml: സേരഹിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സിമ്രി, ഏഥാൻ, ഹേമാൻ, കൽക്കോൽ, ദാരാ; ഇങ്ങനെ അഞ്ചുപേർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol and Darda —five in all.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

chapters.ml: കർമ്മിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശപഥാർപ്പിതവസ്തുവിൽ അകൃത്യംചെയ്തു യിസ്രായേലിനെ കഷ്ടത്തിലാക്കിയ ആഖാൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The son of Karmi: Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by violating the ban on taking devoted things.
chapters.nkjv: The son of Carmi was Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the accursed thing.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

chapters.ml: ഏഥാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അസർയ്യാവു.
chapters.niv: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
chapters.nkjv: The son of Ethan was Azariah.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

chapters.ml: ഹെസ്രോന്നു ജനിച്ച പുത്രന്മാർ: യെരഹ്മയേൽ, രാം, കെലൂബായി.
chapters.niv: The sons born to Hezron were: Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb.
chapters.nkjv: Also the sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
chapters.kjv: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

chapters.ml: രാം അമ്മീനാദാബിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അമ്മീനാദാബ് യെഹൂദാമക്കൾക്കു പ്രഭുവായ നഹശോനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, the leader of the people of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Ram begot Amminadab, and Amminadab begot Nahshon, leader of the children of Judah;
chapters.kjv: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

chapters.ml: നഹശോൻ ശല്മയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ശല്മാ ബോവസിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, Salmon the father of Boaz,
chapters.nkjv: Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz;
chapters.kjv: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

chapters.ml: ബോവസ് ഓബേദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഓബേദ് യിശ്ശായിയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Boaz the father of Obed and Obed the father of Jesse.
chapters.nkjv: Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;
chapters.kjv: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

chapters.ml: യിശ്ശായി തന്റെ ആദ്യജാതൻ എലിയാബിനെയും രണ്ടാമൻ അബിനാദാബിനെയും മൂന്നാമൻ
chapters.niv: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; the second son was Abinadab, the third Shimea,
chapters.nkjv: Jesse begot Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
chapters.kjv: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

chapters.ml: ശിമെയയേയും നാലാമൻ നഥനയേലിനെയും
chapters.niv: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,
chapters.nkjv: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
chapters.kjv: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാമൻ രദ്ദായിയെയും ആറാമൻ ഓസെമിനെയും ഏഴാമൻ ദാവീദിനെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: the sixth Ozem and the seventh David.
chapters.nkjv: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh.
chapters.kjv: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ സഹോദരിമാർ സെരൂയയും അബീഗയിലും ആയിരുന്നു. സെരൂയയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അബീശായി, യോവാബ്, അസാഹേൽ; ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നുപേർ.
chapters.niv: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abishai, Joab and Asahel.
chapters.nkjv: Now their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel—three.
chapters.kjv: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

chapters.ml: അബീഗയിൽ അമാസയെ പ്രസവിച്ചു. അമാസയുടെ അപ്പൻ യിസ്മായേല്യനായ യേഥെർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
chapters.nkjv: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
chapters.kjv: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.

chapters.ml: ഹെസ്രോന്റെ മകൻ കാലേബ് തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ അസൂബയിലും യെരീയോത്തിലും മക്കളെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. അവളുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യേശെർ, ശോബാബ്, അർദ്ദോൻ.
chapters.niv: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah (and by Jerioth). These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab and Ardon.
chapters.nkjv: Caleb the son of Hezron had children by Azubah, his wife, and by Jerioth. Now these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
chapters.kjv: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

chapters.ml: അസൂബാ മരിച്ചശേഷം കാലേബ് എഫ്രാത്തിനെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവൾ അവന്നു ഹൂരിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
chapters.nkjv: When Azubah died, Caleb took Ephrath as his wife, who bore him Hur.
chapters.kjv: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

chapters.ml: ഹൂർ ഊരിയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഊരി ബെസലേലിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri the father of Bezalel.
chapters.nkjv: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezalel.
chapters.kjv: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം ഹെസ്രോൻ ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ അപ്പനായ മാഖീരിന്റെ മകളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവളെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ അവന്നു അറുപതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു. അവൾ അവന്നു സെഗൂബിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Later, Hezron, when he was sixty years old, married the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead. He made love to her, and she bore him Segub.
chapters.nkjv: Now afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
chapters.kjv: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

chapters.ml: സെഗൂബ് യായീരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അവന്നു ഗിലെയാദ് ദേശത്തു ഇരുപത്തിമൂന്നു പട്ടണം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: Segub begot Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഗെശൂരും അരാമും യായീരിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളെയും കെനാത്തിനെയും അതിന്റെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങളെയും ഇങ്ങനെ അറുപതു പട്ടണം അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു പിടിച്ചു. ഇവരെല്ലാവരും ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ അപ്പനായ മാഖിരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth Jair, as well as Kenath with its surrounding settlements—sixty towns.) All these were descendants of Makir the father of Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: (Geshur and Syria took from them the towns of Jair, with Kenath and its towns—sixty towns.) All these belongedto the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

chapters.ml: ഹെസ്രോൻ കാലെബ്-എഫ്രാത്തയിൽവെച്ചു മരിച്ചശേഷം ഹെസ്രോന്റെ ഭാര്യ അബീയാ അവന്നു തെക്കോവയുടെ അപ്പനായ അശ്ഹൂരിനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah the wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
chapters.nkjv: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Hezron’s wife Abijah bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
chapters.kjv: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

chapters.ml: ഹെസ്രോന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ യെരഹ്മയേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ആദ്യജാതൻ രാം, ബൂനാ, ഓരെൻ, ഓസെം, അഹിയാവു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram, the firstborn, and Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

chapters.ml: യെരഹ്മയേലിന്നു മറ്റൊരു ഭാര്യ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൾക്കു അതാരാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ ഓനാമിന്റെ അമ്മ.
chapters.niv: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
chapters.nkjv: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
chapters.kjv: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

chapters.ml: യെരഹ്മയേലിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ രാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മയസ്, യാമീൻ, ഏക്കെർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin and Eker.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

chapters.ml: ഓനാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശമ്മായി യാദാ. ശമ്മായിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: നാദാബ്, അബിശൂർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

chapters.ml: അബിശൂരിന്റെ ഭാര്യക്കു അബീഹയീൽ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ അവന്നു അഹ്ബാനെയും മോലീദിനെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.
chapters.nkjv: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
chapters.kjv: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

chapters.ml: നാദാബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സേലെദ്, അപ്പയീം; എന്നാൽ സേലെദ് മക്കളില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim; Seled died without children.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

chapters.ml: അപ്പയീമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യിശി. യിശിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശേശാൻ. ശേശാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ:
chapters.niv: The son of Appaim: Ishi, who was the father of Sheshan. Sheshan was the father of Ahlai.
chapters.nkjv: The son of Appaim was Ishi, the son of Ishi was Sheshan, and Sheshan’s son was Ahlai.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

chapters.ml: അഹ്ളയീം. ശമ്മായിയുടെ സഹോദരനായ യാദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യേഥെർ, യോനാഥാൻ; എന്നാൽ യേഥെർ മക്കളില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai, were Jether and Jonathan; Jether died without children.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

chapters.ml: യോനാഥാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: പേലെത്ത്, സാസാ. ഇവർ യെൽഹ്മയെലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

chapters.ml: ശേശാന്നു പുത്രിമാരല്ലാതെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു. ശേശാന്നു മിസ്രയീമ്യനായ ഒരു ഭൃത്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു യർഹാ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: Sheshan had no sons—only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
chapters.nkjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarha.
chapters.kjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

chapters.ml: ശേശാൻ തന്റെ മകളെ തന്റെ ഭൃത്യനായ യർഹെക്കു ഭാര്യയായി കൊടുത്തു; അവൾ അവന്നു അത്ഥായിയെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore him Attai.
chapters.nkjv: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife, and she bore him Attai.
chapters.kjv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

chapters.ml: അത്ഥായി നാഥാനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; നാഥാൻ സാബാദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan the father of Zabad,
chapters.nkjv: Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad;
chapters.kjv: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

chapters.ml: സാബാദ് എഫ്ളാലിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Zabad the father of Ephlal, Ephlal the father of Obed,
chapters.nkjv: Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed;
chapters.kjv: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

chapters.ml: എഫ്ളാൽ ഓബേദിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഓബേദ് യെഹൂവിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; യെഹൂ അസർയ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Obed the father of Jehu, Jehu the father of Azariah,
chapters.nkjv: Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah;
chapters.kjv: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

chapters.ml: അസർയ്യാവു ഹേലെസിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഹേലെസ് എലെയാശയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Azariah the father of Helez, Helez the father of Eleasah,
chapters.nkjv: Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah;
chapters.kjv: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

chapters.ml: എലെയാശാ സിസ്മായിയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; സിസ്മായി ശല്ലൂമിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
