chapters.niv: Eleasah the father of Sismai, Sismai the father of Shallum,
chapters.nkjv: Eleasah begot Sismai, and Sismai begot Shallum;
chapters.kjv: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

chapters.ml: ശല്ലൂം യെക്കമ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; യെക്കമ്യാവു എലീശാമയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Shallum the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah the father of Elishama.
chapters.nkjv: Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.
chapters.kjv: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

chapters.ml: യെരഹ്മയേലിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ കാലേബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനും സീഫിന്റെ അപ്പനുമായ മേശാ; ഹെബ്രോന്റെ അപ്പനായ മാരേശയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരും.
chapters.niv: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.
chapters.nkjv: The descendants of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha, his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
chapters.kjv: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were , Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: കോരഹ്, തപ്പൂഹ് രേക്കെം, ശേമാ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem and Shema.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Hebron were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

chapters.ml: ശേമാ യൊർക്കെയാമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ രഹമിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; രേക്കെം ശമ്മായിയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Shema was the father of Raham, and Raham the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.
chapters.nkjv: Shema begot Raham the father of Jorkoam, and Rekem begot Shammai.
chapters.kjv: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

chapters.ml: ശമ്മായിയുടെ മകൻ മാവോൻ. മാവോൻ ബെത്ത്-സൂറിന്റെ അപ്പനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
chapters.nkjv: And the son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
chapters.kjv: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

chapters.ml: കാലേബിന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയായ ഏഫാഹാരാനെയും മോസയെയും ഗാസേസിനെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു; ഹാരാൻ ഗാസേസിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
chapters.nkjv: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.
chapters.kjv: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

chapters.ml: യാദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: രേഗെം, യോഥാം, ഗേശാൻ, പേലെത്ത്, ഏഫാ, ശയഫ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah and Shaaph.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

chapters.ml: കാലേബിന്റെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയായ മയഖാ ശേബെരിനെയും തിർഹനയെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Caleb’s concubine Maakah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
chapters.nkjv: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
chapters.kjv: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

chapters.ml: അവൾ മദ്മന്നയുടെ അപ്പനായ ശയഫ്, മക്ബേനയുടെയും ഗിബെയയുടെയും അപ്പനായ ശെവാ എന്നിവരെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു; കാലേബിന്റെ മകൾ അക്സാ ആയിരുന്നു. ഇവരത്രോ കാലേബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: She also gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah and to Sheva the father of Makbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Aksah.
chapters.nkjv: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
chapters.kjv: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രാത്തയുടെ ആദ്യജാതനായ ഹൂരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശോബാൽ,
chapters.niv: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
chapters.nkjv: These were the descendants of Caleb: The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, were Shobal the father of Kirjath Jearim,
chapters.kjv: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,

chapters.ml: ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശല്മാ, ബേത്ത്-ഗാദേരിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹാരേഫ്.
chapters.niv: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
chapters.nkjv: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
chapters.kjv: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

chapters.ml: കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശോബാലിന്നു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു: ഹാരോവേ, മെനൂഹോത്തിന്റെ പാതി.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim were: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
chapters.nkjv: And Shobal the father of Kirjath Jearim had descendants: Haroeh, and half of the familiesof Manuhoth.
chapters.kjv: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

chapters.ml: കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീമിന്റെ കുലങ്ങളാവിതു: യിത്രീയർ, പൂത്യർ, ശൂമാത്യർ, മിശ്രായർ; ഇവരിൽനിന്നു സൊരാത്യരും എസ്താവോല്യരും ഉത്ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and the clans of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
chapters.nkjv: The families of Kirjath Jearim were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. From these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
chapters.kjv: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

chapters.ml: ശല്മയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ബേത്ത്ളേഹെം, നെതോഫാത്യർ, അത്രോത്ത്-ബേത്ത്-യോവാബ്, മാനഹത്യരിൽ പാതി സൊർയ്യർ.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Salma were Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half of the Manahethites, and the Zorites.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

chapters.ml: യബ്ബേസിൽ പാർത്തു വന്ന ശാസ്ത്രജ്ഞന്മാരുടെ കുലങ്ങളാവിതു: തിരാത്യർ, ശിമെയാത്യർ, സൂഖാത്യർ; ഇവർ രേഖാബ് ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹമാത്തിൽനിന്നുത്ഭവിച്ച കേന്യരാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and the clans of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the Rekabites.
chapters.nkjv: And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Suchathites. These were the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
chapters.kjv: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോനിൽവെച്ചു ദാവീദിന്നു ജനിച്ച പുത്രന്മാരാവിതു: യിസ്രെയേൽക്കാരത്തിയായ അഹീനോവാം പ്രസവിച്ച അമ്നോൻ ആദ്യജാതൻ; കർമ്മേൽക്കാരത്തിയായ അബിഗയിൽ പ്രസവിച്ച ദാനീയേൽ രണ്ടാമൻ;
chapters.niv: These were the sons of David born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second, Daniel the son of Abigail of Carmel;
chapters.nkjv: Now these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess;
chapters.kjv: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

chapters.ml: ഗെശൂർ രാജാവായ തൽമായിയുടെ മകളായ മയഖയുടെ മകൻ അബ്ശാലോം മൂന്നാമൻ; ഹഗ്ഗീത്തിന്റെ മകൻ അദോനീയാവു നാലാമൻ;
chapters.niv: the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
chapters.nkjv: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
chapters.kjv: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

chapters.ml: അബീതാൽ പ്രസവിച്ച ശെഫത്യാവു അഞ്ചാമൻ; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ എഗ്ളാ പ്രസവിച്ച യിഥ്‌രെയാം ആറാമൻ.
chapters.niv: the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital; and the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.
chapters.nkjv: the fifth, Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.
chapters.kjv: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

chapters.ml: ഈ ആറുപേരും അവന്നു ഹെബ്രോനിൽവെച്ചു ജനിച്ചു; അവിടെ അവൻ ഏഴു സംവത്സരവും ആറു മാസവും വാണു; യെരൂശലേമിൽ അവൻ മുപ്പത്തിമൂന്നു സംവത്സരം വാണു.
chapters.niv: These six were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
chapters.nkjv: These six were born to him in Hebron. There he reigned seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.
chapters.kjv: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽവെച്ചു അവന്നു ജനിച്ചവരാവിതു: അമ്മീയേലിന്റെ മകളായ ബത്ത്-ശൂവ പ്രസവിച്ച ശിമേയാ, ശോബാബ്, നാഥാൻ,
chapters.niv: and these were the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon. These four were by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
chapters.nkjv: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon—four by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel.
chapters.kjv: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ എന്നീ നാലുപേരും യിബ്ഹാർ, എലീശാമാ,
chapters.niv: There were also Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
chapters.nkjv: Also there were Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
chapters.kjv: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

chapters.ml: എലീഫേലെത്ത്, നോഗഹ്, നേഫെഗ്, യാഫീയാ,
chapters.niv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.nkjv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

chapters.ml: എലീശാമാ, എല്യാദാ എലീഫേലെത്ത് എന്നീ ഒമ്പതു പേരും.
chapters.niv: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet—nine in all.
chapters.nkjv: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet— nine inall.
chapters.kjv: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

chapters.ml: വെപ്പാട്ടികളുടെ പുത്രന്മാരൊഴികെ ദാവീദിൻ പുത്രന്മാരൊക്കെയും ഇവരത്രേ. താമാർ അവരുടെ സഹോദരി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
chapters.nkjv: Thesewere all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
chapters.kjv: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ മകൻ രെഹബെയാം; അവന്റെ മകൻ അബീയാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ ആസാ;
chapters.niv: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
chapters.nkjv: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam; Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
chapters.kjv: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത്; അവന്റെ മകൻ യഹോരാം; അവന്റെ മകൻ അഹസ്യാവു;
chapters.niv: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
chapters.nkjv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
chapters.kjv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ യോവാശ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ അമസ്യാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ അസർയ്യാവു. അവന്റെ മകൻ യോഥാം; അവന്റെ മകൻ ആഹാസ്;
chapters.niv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
chapters.nkjv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
chapters.kjv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ ഹിസ്കീയാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ മനശ്ശെ;
chapters.niv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
chapters.nkjv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
chapters.kjv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ ആമോൻ; അവന്റെ മകൻ യോശീയാവു.
chapters.niv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
chapters.nkjv: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
chapters.kjv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

chapters.ml: യോശീയാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ആദ്യജാതൻ യോഹാനാൻ; രണ്ടാമൻ യെഹോയാക്കീം; മൂന്നാമൻ സിദെക്കിയാവു; നാലാമൻ ശല്ലൂം.
chapters.niv: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second son, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Josiah were Johanan the firstborn, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Josiah were , the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാക്കീമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ മകൻ യെഖൊന്യാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ സിദെക്കിയാവു.
chapters.niv: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jehoiachin his son, and Zedekiah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Jehoiakim were Jeconiah his son and Zedekiah his son.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

chapters.ml: ബദ്ധനായ യെഖൊന്യാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ മകൻ ശെയല്ത്തീയേൽ,
chapters.niv: The descendants of Jehoiachin the captive: Shealtiel his son,
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Jeconiah were Assir, Shealtiel his son,
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

chapters.ml: മൽക്കീരാം, പെദായാവു, ശെനസ്സർ, യെക്കമ്യാവു, ഹോശാമാ, നെദബ്യാവു.
chapters.niv: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.
chapters.nkjv: and Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
chapters.kjv: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

chapters.ml: പെദായാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ: സെരുബ്ബാബേൽ, ശിമെയി. സെരുബ്ബാബേലിന്റെ മക്കൾ: മെശുല്ലാം, ഹനന്യാവു, അവരുടെ സഹോദരി ശെലോമീത്ത് എന്നിവരും
chapters.niv: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah. Shelomith was their sister.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam, Hananiah, Shelomith their sister,
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Pedaiah were , Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

chapters.ml: ഹശൂബാ, ഓഹെൽ, ബേരെഖ്യാവു, ഹസദ്യാവു, യൂശബ്-ഹേസെദ് എന്നീ അഞ്ചുപേരും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: There were also five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-Hesed.
chapters.nkjv: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-Hesed—five inall.
chapters.kjv: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

chapters.ml: ഹനന്യാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ: പെലത്യാവു, യെശയ്യാവു, രെഫായാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ, അർന്നാന്റെ മക്കൾ, ഓബദ്യാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ, ശെഖന്യാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah and of Shekaniah.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shechaniah.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

chapters.ml: ശെഖന്യാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ: ശെമയ്യാവു; ശെമയ്യാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ: ഹത്തൂശ്, യിഗാൽ, ബാരീഹ്, നെയർയ്യാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ:
chapters.niv: The descendants of Shekaniah: Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat—six in all.
chapters.nkjv: The son of Shechaniah was Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six inall.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

chapters.ml: എല്യോവേനായി, ഹിസ്കീയാവു, അസ്രീക്കാം ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നുപേർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam—three in all.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam—three inall.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

chapters.ml: എല്യോവേനായിയുടെ മക്കൾ: ഹോദവ്യാവു, എല്യാശീബ്, പെലായാവു, അക്കൂബ്, യോഹാനാൻ, ദെലായാവു, അനാനി ഇങ്ങനെ ഏഴുപേർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani—seven in all.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven inall.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Elioenai were , Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: പേരെസ്, ഹെസ്രോൻ, കർമ്മി, ഹൂർ, ശോബൽ.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur and Shobal.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

chapters.ml: ശോബലിന്റെ മകനായ രെയായാവു യഹത്തിനെ ജനപ്പിച്ചു; യഹത്ത് അഹൂമായിയെയും ലാഹദിനെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. ഇവർ സോരത്യരുടെ കുലങ്ങൾ.
chapters.niv: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
chapters.nkjv: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.
chapters.kjv: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

chapters.ml: ഏതാമിന്റെ അപ്പനിൽ നിന്നുത്ഭവിച്ചവർ ഇവർ: യിസ്രെയേൽ, യിശ്മാ, യിദ്ബാശ്; അവരുടെ സഹോദരിക്കു ഹസ്സെലൊല്പോനി എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
chapters.nkjv: These werethesonsof the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi;
chapters.kjv: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

chapters.ml: പെനൂവേൽ ഗെദോരിന്റെ അപ്പനും, ഏസെർ ഹൂശയുടെ അപ്പനും ആയിരുന്നു. ഇവർ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ എഫ്രാത്തയുടെ ആദ്യജാതനായ ഹൂരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and father of Bethlehem.
chapters.nkjv: and Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer wasthe father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah the father of Bethlehem.
chapters.kjv: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.

chapters.ml: തെക്കോവയുടെ അപ്പനായ അശ്ഹൂരിന്നു ഹേലാ, നയരാ എന്ന രണ്ടു ഭാര്യമാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
chapters.nkjv: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
chapters.kjv: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

chapters.ml: നയരാ അവന്നു അഹുസ്സാം, ഹേഫെർ, തേമനി, ഹായഹസ്താരി എന്നിവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു. ഇവർ നയരയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
chapters.nkjv: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
chapters.kjv: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

chapters.ml: ഹേലയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സേരെത്ത്, യെസോഹർ, എത്നാൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, and Ethnan;
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Helah were , Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

chapters.ml: കോസ് ആനൂബിനെയും സോബേബയെയും ഹാരൂമിന്റെ മകനായ അഹർഹേലിന്റെ കുലങ്ങളെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Hazzobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
chapters.nkjv: and Koz begot Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
chapters.kjv: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

chapters.ml: യബ്ബേസ് തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെക്കാൾ ഏറ്റവും മാന്യൻ ആയിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ അമ്മ: ഞാൻ അവനെ വ്യസനത്തോടെ പ്രസവിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു യബ്ബേസ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, "I gave birth to him in pain."
chapters.nkjv: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him in pain."
chapters.kjv: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

chapters.ml: യബ്ബേസ് യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവത്തോടു: നീ എന്നെ നിശ്ചയമായി അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു എന്റെ അതിർ വിസ്താരമാക്കുകയും നിന്റെ കൈ എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു അനർത്ഥം എനിക്കു വ്യസനകാരണമായി തീരാതവണ്ണം എന്നെ കാക്കുകയും ചെയ്താൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു. അവൻ അപേക്ഷിച്ചതിനെ ദൈവം അവന്നു നല്കി.
chapters.niv: Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, "Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain." And God granted his request.
chapters.nkjv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel saying, "Oh, that You would bless me indeed, and enlarge my territory, that Your hand would be with me, and that You would keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!" So God granted him what he requested.
chapters.kjv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

chapters.ml: ശൂഹയുടെ സഹോദരനായ കെലൂബ് മെഹീരിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഇവൻ എസ്തോന്റെ അപ്പൻ.
chapters.niv: Kelub, Shuhah’s brother, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
chapters.nkjv: Chelub the brother of Shuhah begot Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
chapters.kjv: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.

chapters.ml: എസ്തോൻ ബേത്ത്-രാഫയെയും പാസേഹയെയും ഈർനാഹാസിന്റെ അപ്പനായ തെഹിന്നയെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു. ഇവർ രേഖാനിവാസികൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These were the men of Rekah.
chapters.nkjv: And Eshton begot Beth-Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-Nahash. These were the men of Rechah.
chapters.kjv: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.

chapters.ml: കെനസ്സിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഒത്നീയേൽ, സെരായാവു; ഒത്നീയേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഹഥത്ത്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel were Hathath,
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

chapters.ml: മെയോനോഥയി ഒഫ്രയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; സെരായാവു ഗേ-ഹരാശീമിന്റെ അപ്പനായ യോവാബിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അവർ കൌശലപ്പണിക്കാർ ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge Harashim. It was called this because its people were skilled workers.
chapters.nkjv: and Meonothai who begot Ophrah. Seraiah begot Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
chapters.kjv: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

chapters.ml: യെഫുന്നെയുടെ മകനായ കാലേബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഈരൂ, ഏലാ, നായം; ഏലയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: കെനസ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah was Kenaz.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

chapters.ml: യെഹലലേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സീഫ്, സീഫാ, തീർയ്യാ, അസരെയേൽ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Jehallelel were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

chapters.ml: എസ്രയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യേഥെർ, മേരെദ്, ഏഫെർ, യാലോൻ എന്നിവരായിരുന്നു. അവൾ മിർയ്യാമിനെയും ശമ്മയെയും എസ്തെമോവയുടെ അപ്പനായ യിശ്ബഹിനെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Ezra were , Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ യെഹൂദീയ ഗെദോരിന്റെ അപ്പനായ യേരെദിനെയും സോഖോവിന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഹേബെരിനെയും സാനോഹയുടെ അപ്പനായ യെക്കൂഥീയേലിനെയും പ്രസവിച്ചു. ഇവരാകുന്നു മേരെദ് പരിഗ്രഹിച്ച ഫറവോന്റെ മകളായ ബിഥ്യയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: (His wife from the tribe of Judah gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soko, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah, whom Mered had married.
chapters.nkjv: (His wife Jehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Sochoh, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) And these were the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
chapters.kjv: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

chapters.ml: നഹമിന്റെ സഹോദരിയും ഹോദീയാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യയുമായവളുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഗർമ്മ്യനായ കെയീലയുടെ അപ്പനും മയഖാത്യനായ എസ്തെമോവയും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maakathite.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

chapters.ml: ശീമോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അമ്നോൻ, രിന്നാ, ബെൻ-ഹാനാൻ, തീലോൻ. യിശിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സോഹേത്ത്, ബെൻ-സോഹേത്ത്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Shimon were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Shimon were , Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were , Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയുടെ മകനായ ശേലയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ലേഖയുടെ അപ്പനായ ഏരും മാരേശയുടെ അപ്പനായ ലദയും ബേത്ത്-അശ്ബെയയിൽ ശണപടം നെയ്യുന്ന കൈത്തൊഴിൽക്കാരുടെ കുലങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lekah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth Ashbea,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of the linen workers of the house of Ashbea;
chapters.kjv: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were , Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

chapters.ml: യോക്കീമും കോസേബാനിവാസികളും മോവാബിൽ അധികാരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന യോവാശ്, സാരാഫ് എന്നിവരും യാശുബീ-ലേഹെമും തന്നേ. ഇവ പുരാണവൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ അല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Jokim, the men of Kozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi Lehem. (These records are from ancient times.)
chapters.nkjv: also Jokim, the men of Chozeba, and Joash; Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-Lehem. Now the records are ancient.
chapters.kjv: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ നെതായീമിലും ഗെദേരയിലും പാർത്ത കുശവന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ രാജാവിനോടുകൂടെ അവന്റെ വേല ചെയ്‍വാൻ അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: They were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah; they stayed there and worked for the king.
chapters.nkjv: These were the potters and those who dwell at Netaim and Gederah; there they dwelt with the king for his work.
chapters.kjv: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: നെമൂവേൽ, യാമീൻ, യാരീബ്, സേരഹ്, ശൌൽ;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah and Shaul;
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Simeon were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul,
chapters.kjv: The sons of Simeon were , Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ ശല്ലൂം; അവന്റെ മകൻ മിബ്ശാം; അവന്റെ മകൻ മിശ്മാ.
chapters.niv: Shallum was Shaul’s son, Mibsam his son and Mishma his son.
chapters.nkjv: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
chapters.kjv: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

chapters.ml: മിശ്മയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ മകൻ ഹമ്മൂവേൽ; അവന്റെ മകൻ സക്കൂർ; അവന്റെ മകൻ ശിമെയി;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zakkur his son and Shimei his son.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Mishma were Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, and Shimei his son.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയിക്കു പതിനാറു പുത്രന്മാരും ആറു പുത്രിമാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; എങ്കിലും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു അധികം മക്കളില്ലായ്കയാൽ അവരുടെ കുലമെല്ലാം യെഹൂദാമക്കളോളം വർദ്ധിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children; so their entire clan did not become as numerous as the people of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many children, nor did any of their families multiply as much as the children of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

chapters.ml: അവർ ബേർ-ശേബയിലും
chapters.niv: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar Shual,
chapters.nkjv: They dwelt at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar Shual,
chapters.kjv: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

chapters.ml: മോലാദയിലും ഹസർ-ശൂവാലിലും ബിൽഹയിലും
chapters.niv: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
chapters.nkjv: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
chapters.kjv: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

chapters.ml: ഏസെമിലും തോലാദിലും ബെഥൂവേലിലും
chapters.niv: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
chapters.nkjv: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
chapters.kjv: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

chapters.ml: ഹൊർമ്മയിലും സിക്ളാഗിലും ബേത്ത്-മർക്കാബോത്തിലും ഹസർ-സൂസീമിലും ബേത്ത്-ബിരിയിലും ശയരയീമിലും പാർത്തു. ഇവ ദാവീദിന്റെ വാഴ്ചവരെ അവരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biri and Shaaraim. These were their towns until the reign of David.
chapters.nkjv: Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
chapters.kjv: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ഗ്രാമങ്ങൾ: ഏതാം, അയീൻ, രിമ്മോൻ, തോഖെൻ, ആശാൻ ഇങ്ങനെ അഞ്ചു പട്ടണവും
chapters.niv: Their surrounding villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token and Ashan—five towns—
chapters.nkjv: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five cities—
chapters.kjv: And their villages were , Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

chapters.ml: ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങളുടെ ചുറ്റും ബാൽവരെ അവെക്കുള്ള സകലഗ്രാമങ്ങളും തന്നേ. ഇവ അവരുടെ വാസസ്ഥലങ്ങൾ. അവർക്കു സ്വന്തവംശാവലിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath. These were their settlements. And they kept a genealogical record.
chapters.nkjv: and all the villages that were around these cities as far as Baal. These were their dwelling places, and they maintained their genealogy:
chapters.kjv: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

chapters.ml: മെശോബാബ്, യമ്ളേക്, അമസ്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ യോശാ, യോവേൽ,
chapters.niv: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
chapters.nkjv: Meshobab, Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah;
chapters.kjv: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

chapters.ml: അസീയേലിന്റെ മകനായ സെരായാവിന്റെ മകനായ യോശിബ്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ യേഹൂ, എല്യോവേനായി,
chapters.niv: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
chapters.nkjv: Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel;
chapters.kjv: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

chapters.ml: യയക്കോബാ, യെശോഹായാവു, അസായാവു, അദീയേൽ, യസീമീയേൽ,
chapters.niv: also Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
chapters.nkjv: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, and Benaiah;
chapters.kjv: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

chapters.ml: ബെനായാവു, ശെമെയാവിന്റെ മകനായ ശിമ്രിയുടെ മകനായ യെദായാവിന്റെ മകനായ അല്ലോന്റെ മകനായ ശിഫിയുടെ മകനായ സീസാ;
chapters.niv: and Ziza son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.
chapters.nkjv: Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
chapters.kjv: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

chapters.ml: പേർ വിവരം പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന ഇവർ തങ്ങളുടെ കുലങ്ങളിൽ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരായിരുന്നു; അവരുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങൾ ഏറ്റവും വർദ്ധിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The men listed above by name were leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
chapters.nkjv: these mentioned by name were leaders in their families, and their father’s house increased greatly.
chapters.kjv: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടങ്ങൾക്കു മേച്ചൽ തിരയേണ്ടതിന്നു ഗെദോർപ്രവേശനത്തോളം താഴ്വരയുടെ കിഴക്കുവശംവരെ യാത്രചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: and they went to the outskirts of Gedor to the east of the valley in search of pasture for their flocks.
chapters.nkjv: So they went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
chapters.kjv: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുഷ്ടിയുള്ളതും നല്ലതുമായ മേച്ചൽ കണ്ടെത്തി; ദേശം വിസ്താരവും സ്വസ്ഥതയും സമാധാനവും ഉള്ളതായിരുന്നു; അവിടത്തെ പൂർവ്വനിവാസികൾ ഹാംവംശക്കാരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful and quiet. Some Hamites had lived there formerly.
chapters.nkjv: And they found rich, good pasture, and the land was broad, quiet, and peaceful; for some Hamites formerly lived there.
chapters.kjv: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

chapters.ml: പേർവിവരം എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന ഇവർ യെഹൂദ്യരാജാവായ യഹിസ്കീയാവിന്റെ കാലത്തു അവിടെ ചെന്നു അവരുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളെയും അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന മെയൂന്യരെയും ആക്രമിച്ചു, ഇന്നുവരെ അവർക്കു നിർമ്മൂലനാശം വരുത്തുകയും അവിടെ തങ്ങളുടെ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടങ്ങൾക്കു മേച്ചൽ ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു പകരം പാർക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The men whose names were listed came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings and also the Meunites who were there and completely destroyed them, as is evident to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
chapters.nkjv: These recorded by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and they attacked their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and utterly destroyed them, as it is to this day. So they dwelt in their place, because therewas pasture for their flocks there.
chapters.kjv: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോന്യരായ ഇവരിൽ അഞ്ഞൂറുപേർ, യിശിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരായ, പെലത്യാവു, നെയർയ്യാവു, രെഫായാവു, ഉസ്സീയേൽ എന്നീ തലവന്മാരോടുകൂടെ സേയീർപർവ്വതത്തിലേക്കു യാത്രചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And five hundred of these Simeonites, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, invaded the hill country of Seir.
chapters.nkjv: Now some of them, five hundred men of the sons of Simeon, went to Mount Seir, having as their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
chapters.kjv: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

chapters.ml: അവർ അമാലേക്യരിൽ ചാടിപ്പോയിരുന്ന ശിഷ്ടജനത്തെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു ഇന്നുവരെ അവിടെ പാർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They killed the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.
chapters.nkjv: And they defeated the rest of the Amalekites who had escaped. They have dwelt there to this day.
chapters.kjv: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ രൂബേന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ:--അവനല്ലോ ആദ്യജാതൻ; എങ്കിലും അവൻ തന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ശയ്യയെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശം യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മകനായ യോസേഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കു ലഭിച്ചു; വംശാവലി ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശപ്രകാരം എണ്ണുവാനുള്ളതുമല്ല.
chapters.niv: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (he was the firstborn, but when he defiled his father’s marriage bed, his rights as firstborn were given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel; so he could not be listed in the genealogical record in accordance with his birthright,
chapters.nkjv: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel— he was indeed the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel, so that the genealogy is not listed according to the birthright;
chapters.kjv: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെക്കാൾ പ്രബലനായ്തീർന്നു; അവനിൽ നിന്നു പ്രഭു ഉത്ഭവിച്ചു; ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശമോ യോസേഫിന്നു ലഭിച്ചു--
chapters.niv: and though Judah was the strongest of his brothers and a ruler came from him, the rights of the firstborn belonged to Joseph)—
chapters.nkjv: yet Judah prevailed over his brothers, and from him came a ruler, although the birthright was Joseph’s—
chapters.kjv: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ആദ്യജാതനായ രൂബേന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഹാനോക്ക്, പല്ലൂ, ഹെസ്രോൻ, കർമ്മി.
chapters.niv: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.
chapters.nkjv: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
chapters.kjv: The sons, I say , of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were , Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

chapters.ml: യോവേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ മകൻ ശെമയ്യാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഗോഗ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ ശിമെയി; അവന്റെ മകൻ മീഖാ;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Joel were Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
chapters.kjv: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ രെയായാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ ബാൽ;
chapters.niv: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
chapters.nkjv: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
chapters.kjv: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ ബെയേര; അവനെ അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ തിഗ്ളത്ത്-പിലേസർ ബദ്ധനാക്കി കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവൻ രൂബേന്യരിൽ പ്രഭുവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria took into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.
chapters.nkjv: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria carried into captivity. He was leader of the Reubenites.
chapters.kjv: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ വംശാവലി തലമുറതലമുറയായി എഴുതിയിരുന്ന പ്രകാരം കുലം കുലമായി അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ ആരെന്നാൽ: തലവനായ യയീയേൽ,
chapters.niv: Their relatives by clans, listed according to their genealogical records: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,
chapters.nkjv: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was registered: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
chapters.kjv: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

chapters.ml: സെഖർയ്യാവു, അരോവേരിൽ നെബോവും ബാൽ-മെയോനുംവരെ പാർത്ത ബേല; അവൻ യോവേലിന്റെ മകനായ ശേമയുടെ മകനായ ആസാസിന്റെ മകനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in the area from Aroer to Nebo and Baal Meon.
chapters.nkjv: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal Meon.
chapters.kjv: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ കന്നുകാലികൾ ഗിലെയാദ് ദേശത്തു പെരുകിയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ കിഴക്കോട്ടു ഫ്രാത്ത് നദിമുതൽ മരുഭൂമിവരെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: To the east they occupied the land up to the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: Eastward they settled as far as the entrance of the wilderness this side of the River Euphrates, because their cattle had multiplied in the land of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ കാലത്തു അവർ ഹഗ്രീയരോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു; അവർ അവരുടെ കയ്യാൽ പട്ടുപോയശേഷം അവർ ഗിലെയാദിന്നു കിഴക്കു എല്ലാടവും കൂടാരം അടിച്ചു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: During Saul’s reign they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands; they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the entire region east of Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout the entire area east of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.

chapters.ml: ഗാദിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ അവർക്കു എതിരെ ബാശാൻ ദേശത്തു സൽക്കാവരെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The Gadites lived next to them in Bashan, as far as Salekah:
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Gad dwelt next to them in the land of Bashan as far as Salcah:
chapters.kjv: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:

chapters.ml: തലവനായ യോവേൽ, രണ്ടാമനായ ശാഫാം, യനായി, ബാശാനിലെ ശാഫാത്ത്.
chapters.niv: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Janai and Shaphat, in Bashan.
chapters.nkjv: Joel was the chief, Shapham the next, then Jaanai and Shaphat in Bashan,
chapters.kjv: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിലെ സഹോദരന്മാർ: മീഖായേൽ, മെശുല്ലാം, ശേബ, യോരായി, യക്കാൻ, സീയ, ഏബെർ ഇങ്ങനെ ഏഴുപേർ.
chapters.niv: Their relatives, by families, were: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia and Eber—seven in all.
chapters.nkjv: and their brethren of their father’s house: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jachan, Zia, and Eber—seven inall.
chapters.kjv: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were , Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ ഹൂരിയുടെ മകനായ അബിഹയീലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായിരുന്നു. ഹൂരി യാരോഹയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ ഗിലെയാദിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ മീഖായേലിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ യെശീശയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ യഹദോവിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
chapters.nkjv: These were the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
chapters.kjv: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബൂസിന്റെ മകൻ; ഗൂനിയുടെ മകനായ അബ്ദീയേലിന്റെ മകൻ അഹി അവരുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽ തലവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
chapters.nkjv: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was chief of their father’s house.
chapters.kjv: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഗിലെയാദിലെ ബാശാനിലും അതിന്നുൾപ്പെട്ട പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും അവരുടെ അതിരുകളോളം ശാരോനിലെ എല്ലാപുല്പുറങ്ങളിലും പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its outlying villages, and on all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as they extended.
chapters.nkjv: And theGadites dwelt in Gilead, in Bashan and in its villages, and in all the common-lands of Sharon within their borders.
chapters.kjv: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

chapters.ml: ഇവരുടെ വംശാവലി ഒക്കെയും യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യോഥാമിന്റെ കാലത്തും യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ കാലത്തും എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All these were entered in the genealogical records during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: All these were registered by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
chapters.kjv: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

chapters.ml: രൂബേന്യരും ഗാദ്യരും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതി ഗോത്രക്കാരും ശൂരന്മാരും വാളും പരിചയും എടുപ്പാനും വില്ലുകുലെച്ചു എയ്‍വാനും പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ളവരും യുദ്ധസാമർത്ഥ്യമുള്ളവരുമായ പടച്ചേവകർ നാല്പത്തുനാലായിരത്തെഴുനൂറ്ററുപതു പേരുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 men ready for military service—able-bodied men who could handle shield and sword, who could use a bow, and who were trained for battle.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh had forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty valiant men, men able to bear shield and sword, to shoot with the bow, and skillful in war, who went to war.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഹഗ്രീയരോടും യെതൂർ, നാഫീശ്, നോദാബ് എന്നിവരോടും യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish and Nodab.
chapters.nkjv: They made war with the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
chapters.kjv: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ നേരെ അവർക്കു സഹായം ലഭിക്കയാൽ ഹഗ്രീയരും കൂടെയുള്ളവരെല്ലാവരും അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ അകപ്പെട്ടു; അവർ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ ദൈവത്തോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു അവനിൽ ആശ്രയം വെച്ചതു കൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവരുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടരുളി.
chapters.niv: They were helped in fighting them, and God delivered the Hagrites and all their allies into their hands, because they cried out to him during the battle. He answered their prayers, because they trusted in him.
chapters.nkjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them, for they cried out to God in the battle. He heeded their prayer, because they put their trust in Him.
chapters.kjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അമ്പതിനായിരം ഒട്ടകം, രണ്ടുലക്ഷത്തമ്പതിനായിരം ആടു, രണ്ടായിരം കഴുത എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവരുടെ കന്നുകാലികളെയും ഒരു ലക്ഷം ആളുകളെയും പിടിച്ചു കെണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys. They also took one hundred thousand people captive,
chapters.nkjv: Then they took away their livestock—fifty thousand of their camels, two hundred and fifty thousand of their sheep, and two thousand of their donkeys—also one hundred thousand of their men;
chapters.kjv: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധം ദൈവഹിതത്താൽ ഉണ്ടായതുകൊണ്ടു അധികംപേർ ഹതന്മാരായി വീണു. അവർ പ്രവാസകാലംവരെ അവർക്കു പകരം പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: and many others fell slain, because the battle was God’s. And they occupied the land until the exile.
chapters.nkjv: for many fell dead, because the war was God’s. And they dwelt in their place until the captivity.
chapters.kjv: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രക്കാർ ദേശത്തു പാർത്തു. ബാശാൻ മുതൽ ബാൽ-ഹെർമ്മോനും, സെനീരും, ഹെർമ്മോൻ പർവ്വതവും വരെ പെരുകി പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: The people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous; they settled in the land from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir (Mount Hermon).
chapters.nkjv: So the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land. Their numbers increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir, or Mount Hermon.
chapters.kjv: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങളുടെ തലവന്മാരാവിതു: ഏഫെർ, യിശി, എലീയേൽ, അസ്ത്രിയേൽ, യിരെമ്യാവു, ഹോദവ്യാവു, യഹദീയേൽ; ഇവർ ശൂരന്മാരും ശ്രുതിപ്പെട്ടവരും തങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങൾക്കു തലവന്മാരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, famous men, and heads of their families.
chapters.nkjv: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their fathers’ houses.
chapters.kjv: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവത്തോടു ദ്രോഹം ചെയ്തു, ദൈവം അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞ ദേശത്തെ ജാതികളുടെ ദേവന്മാരോടു ചേർന്നു പരസംഗമായി നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: But they were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and prostituted themselves to the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
chapters.nkjv: And they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
chapters.kjv: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവം അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ പൂലിന്റെയും അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ തിഗ്ളത്ത്-പിൽനേസരിന്റെയും മനസ്സുണർത്തി; അവൻ രൂബേന്യരെയും ഗാദ്യരെയും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതി ഗോത്രത്തെയും പിടിച്ചു ഹലഹിലേക്കും ഹാബോരിലേക്കും ഹാരയിലേക്കും ഗോസാൻ നദീതീരത്തേക്കും കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവിടെ അവർ ഇന്നുവരെയും ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.
chapters.nkjv: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He carried the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into captivity. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan to this day.
chapters.kjv: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

chapters.ml: ലേവിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഗേർശോൻ, കെഹാത്ത്, മെരാരി.
chapters.niv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അമ്രാം, യിസ്ഹാർ, ഹെബ്രോൻ, ഉസ്സീയേൽ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

chapters.ml: അമ്രാമിന്റെ മക്കൾ: അഹരോൻ, മോശെ, മിർയ്യാം, അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: നാദാബ്, അബീഹൂ, ഏലെയാസാർ, ഈഥാമാർ.
chapters.niv: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.nkjv: The children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

chapters.ml: എലെയാസാർ ഫീനെഹാസിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഫീനെഹാസ് അബീശൂവയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas the father of Abishua,
chapters.nkjv: Eleazar begot Phinehas, and Phinehas begot Abishua;
chapters.kjv: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

chapters.ml: അബിശൂവ ബുക്കിയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ബുക്കി ഉസ്സിയെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Abishua the father of Bukki, Bukki the father of Uzzi,
chapters.nkjv: Abishua begot Bukki, and Bukki begot Uzzi;
chapters.kjv: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സി സെരഹ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; സെരഹ്യാവു മെരായോത്തിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Uzzi the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,
chapters.nkjv: Uzzi begot Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begot Meraioth;
chapters.kjv: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

chapters.ml: മെരായോത്ത് അമർയ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Meraioth the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,
chapters.nkjv: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
chapters.kjv: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

chapters.ml: അമർയ്യാവു അഹിത്തൂബിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അഹീത്തൂബ് സാദോക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; സാദോക്ക് അഹീമാസിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Ahimaaz,
chapters.nkjv: Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz;
chapters.kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

chapters.ml: അഹിമാസ് അസർയ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അസർയ്യാവു യോഹാനാനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Ahimaaz the father of Azariah, Azariah the father of Johanan,
chapters.nkjv: Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan;
chapters.kjv: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

chapters.ml: യോഹാനാൻ അസർയ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഇവനാകുന്നു ശലോമോൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പണിത ആലയത്തിൽ പൌരോഹിത്യം നടത്തിയതു.
chapters.niv: Johanan the father of Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),
chapters.nkjv: Johanan begot Azariah (it was he who ministered as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem);
chapters.kjv: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

chapters.ml: അസർയ്യാവു അമർയ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; അമർയ്യാവു അഹീത്തൂബിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Azariah the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,
chapters.nkjv: Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
chapters.kjv: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

chapters.ml: അഹീത്തൂബ് സാദോക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; സാദോക്ക് ശല്ലൂമിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Shallum,
chapters.nkjv: Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum;
chapters.kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

chapters.ml: ശല്ലൂം ഹിൽക്കീയാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; ഹിൽക്കീയാവു അസർയ്യാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Shallum the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah the father of Azariah,
chapters.nkjv: Shallum begot Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begot Azariah;
chapters.kjv: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

chapters.ml: അസർയ്യാവു സെരായാവെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു; സെരായാവു യെഹോസാദാക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Azariah the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah the father of Jozadak.
chapters.nkjv: Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak.
chapters.kjv: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

chapters.ml: യഹോവാ നെബൂഖദ് നേസ്സർമുഖാന്തരം യെഹൂദയെയും യെരൂശലേമിനെയും പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയപ്പോൾ യെഹോസാദാക്കും പോകേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jozadak was deported when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
chapters.nkjv: Jehozadak went intocaptivity when the Lord carried Judah and Jerusalem into captivity by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
chapters.kjv: And Jehozadak went into captivity , when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

chapters.ml: ലേവിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഗേർശോം, കെഹാത്ത്, മെരാരി.
chapters.niv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ ആവിതു: ലിബ്നി, ശിമെയി.
chapters.niv: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
chapters.nkjv: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
chapters.kjv: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അമ്രാം, യിസ്ഹാർ, ഹെബ്രോൻ, ഉസ്സീയേൽ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Kohath were , Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മഹ്ളി, മൂശി.
chapters.niv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. Now these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers:
chapters.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങളിൻ പ്രകാരം അവരുടെ കുലങ്ങൾ ഇവ തന്നേ. ഗേർശോമിന്റെ മകൻ ലിബ്നി; അവന്റെ മകൻ യഹത്ത്; അവന്റെ മകൻ സിമ്മാ;
chapters.niv: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
chapters.nkjv: Of Gershon were Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
chapters.kjv: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ യോവാഹ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഇദ്ദോ; അവന്റെ മകൻ സേരഹ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ യെയഥ്രായി.
chapters.niv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son and Jeatherai his son.
chapters.nkjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
chapters.kjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ മകൻ അമ്മീനാദാബ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ കോരഹ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ അസ്സീർ;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Kohath were Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
chapters.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ എൽക്കാനാ; അവന്റെ മകൻ എബ്യാസാഫ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ അസ്സീർ;
chapters.niv: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
chapters.nkjv: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
chapters.kjv: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ തഹത്ത്; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഊരീയേൽ; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഉസ്സീയാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ ശൌൽ.
chapters.niv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son and Shaul his son.
chapters.nkjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
chapters.kjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

chapters.ml: എൽക്കാനയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ മകൻ അമാസായി; അവന്റെ മകൻ അഹിമോത്ത്.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Elkanah were Amasai and Ahimoth.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

chapters.ml: എൽക്കാനയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അവന്റെ മകൻ സോഫായി; അവന്റെ മകൻ നഹത്ത്;
chapters.niv: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
chapters.nkjv: Asfor Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah were Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
chapters.kjv: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ എലീയാബ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ യെരോഹാം; അവന്റെ മകൻ എൽക്കാനാ;
chapters.niv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son and Samuel his son.
chapters.nkjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
chapters.kjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

chapters.ml: ശമൂവേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ആദ്യജാതൻ യോവേൽ, രണ്ടാമൻ അബീയാവു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn and Abijah the second son.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Samuel were Joel the firstborn, and Abijah the second.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മഹ്ളി; അവന്റെ മകൻ ലിബ്നി; അവന്റെ മകൻ ശിമെയി; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഉസ്സാ;
chapters.niv: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
chapters.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ ശിമെയാ; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഹഗ്ഗീയാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ അസായാവു.
chapters.niv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son and Asaiah his son.
chapters.nkjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
chapters.kjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു വിശ്രമം ആയശേഷം ദാവീദ് യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ സംഗീതശുശ്രൂഷെക്കു നിയമിച്ചവർ ഇവരാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the Lord after the ark came to rest there.
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the men whom David appointed over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after the ark came to rest.
chapters.kjv: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD , after that the ark had rest.

chapters.ml: അവർ, ശലോമോൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം പണിതതുവരെ തിരുനിവാസമായ സാമഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ സംഗീതശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്തു; അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ മുറപ്രകാരം ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They ministered with music before the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, until Solomon built the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem. They performed their duties according to the regulations laid down for them.
chapters.nkjv: They were ministering with music before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of meeting, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they served in their office according to their order.
chapters.kjv: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ പുത്രന്മാരോടും കൂടെ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചവർ ആരെന്നാൽ: കെഹാത്യരുടെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ സംഗീതക്കാരനായ ഹേമാൻ; അവൻ യോവേലിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ ശമൂവേലിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: Here are the men who served, together with their sons: From the Kohathites: Heman, the musician, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
chapters.nkjv: And these are the ones who ministered with their sons: Of the sons of the Kohathites were Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
chapters.kjv: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

chapters.ml: അവൻ എൽക്കാനയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ യെരോഹാമിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ എലീയേലിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ തോഹയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ സൂഫിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
chapters.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

chapters.ml: അവൻ എൽക്കാനയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ മഹത്തിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ അമാസായിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ എൽക്കാനയുടെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
chapters.kjv: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോവേലിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ അസർയ്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ സെഫന്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
chapters.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

chapters.ml: അവൻ തഹത്തിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ അസ്സീരിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ എബ്യാസാഫിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ കോരഹിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
chapters.kjv: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്ഹാരിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ കെഹാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ ലേവിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel;
chapters.nkjv: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
chapters.kjv: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു നിന്ന അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ ആസാഫ്: ആസാഫ് ബെരെഖ്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ ശിമെയയുടെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: and Heman’s associate Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph son of Berekiah, the son of Shimea,
chapters.nkjv: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand, was Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
chapters.kjv: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

chapters.ml: അവൻ മീഖായേലിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ ബയശേയാവിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ മൽക്കിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ എത്നിയുടെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malkijah,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
chapters.kjv: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

chapters.ml: അവൻ സേരഹിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ അദായാവിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
chapters.kjv: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഏഥാന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ സിമ്മയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ ശിമെയിയുടെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
chapters.kjv: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹത്തിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ ഗേർശോമിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ ലേവിയുടെ മകൻ.
chapters.niv: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershon, the son of Levi;
chapters.nkjv: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershon, the son of Levi.
chapters.kjv: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ മെരാരിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഇടത്തുഭാഗത്തുനിന്നു; കീശിയുടെ മകൻ ഏഥാൻ; അവൻ അബ്ദിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ മല്ലൂക്കിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: and from their associates, the Merarites, at his left hand: Ethan son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluk,
chapters.nkjv: Their brethren, the sons of Merari, on the left hand, were Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
chapters.kjv: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹശബ്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ അമസ്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ ഹിൽക്കീയാവിന്റെ മകൻ;
chapters.niv: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
chapters.kjv: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

chapters.ml: അവൻ അംസിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ ബാനിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ ശാമെരിന്റെ മകൻ; അവൻ മഹ്ളിയുടെ മകൻ.
chapters.niv: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
chapters.nkjv: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
chapters.kjv: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂശിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ മെരാരിയുടെ മകൻ; അവൻ ലേവിയുടെ മകൻ.
chapters.niv: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
chapters.nkjv: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
chapters.kjv: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ലേവ്യർ ദൈവാലയമായ തിരുനിവാസത്തിലെ സകലശുശ്രൂഷെക്കും നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their fellow Levites were assigned to all the other duties of the tabernacle, the house of God.
chapters.nkjv: And their brethren, the Levites, were appointed to every kind of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
chapters.kjv: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അഹരോനും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും ഹോമയാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേലും ധൂപപീഠത്തിന്മേലും അർപ്പണം ചെയ്തു; അവർ അതിവിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തിലെ സകലശുശ്രൂഷെക്കും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെ കല്പിച്ചപ്രകാരമൊക്കെയും യിസ്രായേലിന്നുവേണ്ടി പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം വരുത്തുവാനും നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Aaron and his descendants were the ones who presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense in connection with all that was done in the Most Holy Place, making atonement for Israel, in accordance with all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
chapters.nkjv: But Aaron and his sons offered sacrifices on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
chapters.kjv: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരാവിതു: അവന്റെ മകൻ എലെയാസാർ; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഫീനെഹാസ്; അവന്റെ മകൻ അബീശൂവ;
chapters.niv: These were the descendants of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
chapters.kjv: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ ബുക്കി; അവന്റെ മകൻ ഉസ്സി; അവന്റെ മകൻ സെരഹ്യാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ മെരായോത്ത്;
chapters.niv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
chapters.nkjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
chapters.kjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ അമർയ്യാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ അഹീത്തൂബ്;
chapters.niv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
chapters.nkjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
chapters.kjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകൻ സാദോക്; അവന്റെ മകൻ അഹീമാസ്.
chapters.niv: Zadok his son and Ahimaaz his son.
chapters.nkjv: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
chapters.kjv: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശത്തിൽ ഗ്രാമംഗ്രാമമായി അവരുടെ വാസസ്ഥലങ്ങൾ ഏവയെന്നാൽ: കെഹാത്യരുടെ കുലമായ അഹരോന്യർക്കു--
chapters.niv: These were the locations of their settlements allotted as their territory (they were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clan, because the first lot was for them):
chapters.nkjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their settlements in their territory, for they were given by lot to the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathites:
chapters.kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കല്ലോ ഒന്നാമതു ചീട്ടു വീണതു--അവർക്കു യെഹൂദാദേശത്തു ഹെബ്രോനും ചുറ്റുമുള്ള പുല്പുറങ്ങളും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: They were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.
chapters.nkjv: They gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, with its surrounding common-lands.
chapters.kjv: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ വയലുകളും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും യെഫുന്നയുടെ മകനായ കാലേബിന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
chapters.nkjv: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
chapters.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു അവർ സങ്കേതനഗരമായ ഹെബ്രോനും ലിബ്നയും അതിന്റെ പുല്പുറങ്ങളും യത്ഥീരും എസ്തെമോവയും അവയുടെ പുല്പുറങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), and Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
chapters.nkjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave oneof the cities of refuge, Hebron; also Libnah with its common-lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its common-lands,
chapters.kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely , Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

chapters.ml: ഹിലോനും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും, ദെബീരും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: Hilen, Debir,
chapters.nkjv: Hilen with its common-lands, Debir with its common-lands,
chapters.kjv: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

chapters.ml: ആശാനും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും;
chapters.niv: Ashan, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.nkjv: Ashan with its common-lands, and Beth Shemesh with its common-lands.
chapters.kjv: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഗേബയും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും അല്ലേമെത്തും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും അനാഥോത്തും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും കൊടുത്തു. കുലംകുലമായി അവർക്കു കിട്ടിയ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ ആകെ പതിമ്മൂന്നു.
chapters.niv: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. The total number of towns distributed among the Kohathite clans came to thirteen.
chapters.nkjv: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its common-lands, Alemeth with its common-lands, and Anathoth with its common-lands. All their cities among their families were thirteen.
chapters.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്തിന്റെ ശേഷമുള്ള മക്കൾക്കു ഗോത്രത്തിന്റെ കുലത്തിൽ, മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രത്തിൽ തന്നേ, ചീട്ടിട്ടു പത്തു പട്ടണം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of half the tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.nkjv: To the rest of the family of the tribe of the Kohathites theygave by lot ten cities from half the tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോമിന്റെ മക്കൾക്കു കുലംകുലമായി യിസ്സാഖാർ ഗോത്രത്തിലും ആശേർഗോത്രത്തിലും; നഫ്താലിഗോത്രത്തിലും ബാശാനിലെ മനശ്ശെഗോത്രത്തിലും പതിമ്മൂന്നു പട്ടണം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Gershon, clan by clan, were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali, and from the part of the tribe of Manasseh that is in Bashan.
chapters.nkjv: And to the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, theygave thirteen cities from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
chapters.kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിയുടെ മക്കൾക്കു കുലംകുലമായി രൂബേൻ ഗോത്രത്തിലും ഗാദ്ഗോത്രത്തിലും സെബൂലൂൻ ഗോത്രത്തിലും ചീട്ടിട്ടു പന്ത്രണ്ടു പട്ടണം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, were allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.
chapters.nkjv: To the sons of Merari, throughout their families, theygave twelve cities from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.
chapters.kjv: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങളും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും ലേവ്യർക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and their pasturelands.
chapters.nkjv: So the children of Israel gave these cities with their common-lands to the Levites.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിലും ശിമെയോൻമക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിലും ബെന്യാമീൻ മക്കളുടെ ഗോത്രത്തിലും പേർ പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ പട്ടണങ്ങളെ ചീട്ടിട്ടു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they allotted the previously named towns.
chapters.nkjv: And they gave by lot from the tribe of the children of Judah, from the tribe of the children of Simeon, and from the tribe of the children of Benjamin these cities which are called by their names.
chapters.kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്ത് മക്കളുടെ ചില കുലങ്ങൾക്കോ എഫ്രയീം ഗോത്രത്തിൽ തങ്ങൾക്കു അധീനമായ പട്ടണങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
chapters.nkjv: Now some of the families of the sons of Kohath weregiven cities as their territory from the tribe of Ephraim.
chapters.kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു, സങ്കേതനഗരങ്ങളായ എഫ്രയീം മലനാട്ടിലെ ശെഖേമും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും ഗേസെരും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും യൊക്മെയാമും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge), and Gezer,
chapters.nkjv: And they gave them oneof the cities of refuge, Shechem with its common-lands, in the mountains of Ephraim, also Gezer with its common-lands,
chapters.kjv: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,

chapters.ml: ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോനും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: Jokmeam, Beth Horon,
chapters.nkjv: Jokmeam with its common-lands, Beth Horon with its common-lands,
chapters.kjv: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,

chapters.ml: അയ്യാലോനും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും ഗത്ത്-രിമ്മോനും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.nkjv: Aijalon with its common-lands, and Gath Rimmon with its common-lands.
chapters.kjv: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതി ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ആനേരും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും ബിലെയാമും പുല്പുറങ്ങളും കെഹാത്യരുടെ ശേഷം കുലങ്ങൾക്കും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands, to the rest of the Kohathite clans.
chapters.nkjv: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its common-lands and Bileam with its common-lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
