chapters.ml: ഇതു ചെയ്‍വാൻ എന്റെ ദൈവം എനിക്കു സംഗതി വരുത്തരുതേ; തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാണനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു പോയ പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ രക്തം ഞാൻ കുടിക്കയോ? അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാണനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചല്ലോ അതു കൊണ്ടുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്നു അതു കുടിപ്പാൻ മനസ്സായില്ല; ഇതാകുന്നു ഈ മൂന്നു വീരന്മാർ ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: "God forbid that I should do this!" he said. "Should I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives?" Because they risked their lives to bring it back, David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Far be it from me, O my God, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men whohaveput their lives injeopardy? For at the risk of their lives they brought it." Therefore he would not drink it. These things were done by the three mighty men.
chapters.kjv: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

chapters.ml: യോവാബിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബീശായി മൂവരിൽ തലവനായിരുന്നു; അവൻ മുന്നൂറുപേരുടെ നേരെ കുന്തം ഓങ്ങി, അവരെ കൊന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ആ മൂവരിൽവെച്ചു കീർത്തിപ്രാപിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.
chapters.nkjv: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of another three. He had lifted up his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name among these three.
chapters.kjv: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them , and had a name among the three.

chapters.ml: ഈ മൂവരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരെക്കാൾ അധികം മാനം അവൻ പ്രാപിച്ചു അവർക്കു നായകനായ്തീർന്നു; എന്നാൽ അവൻ മറ്റെ മൂവരോളം വരികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He was doubly honored above the Three and became their commander, even though he was not included among them.
chapters.nkjv: Of the three he was more honored than the other two men. Therefore he became their captain. However he did not attain to the first three.
chapters.kjv: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

chapters.ml: കബ്സേലിൽ ഒരു പരാക്രമശാലിയുടെ മകനായ യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവും വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികൾ ചെയ്തു അവൻ മോവാബിലെ അരീയേലിന്റെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരെ സംഹരിച്ചതല്ലാതെ ഹിമകാലത്തു ഒരു ഗുഹയിൽ ചെന്നു ഒരു സിംഹത്തെയും കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man from Kabzeel, who had done many deeds. He had killed two lion-like heroes of Moab. He also had gone down and killed a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.
chapters.kjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഞ്ചുമുഴം പൊക്കമുള്ള ദീർഘകായനായോരു മിസ്രയീമ്യനെയും സംഹരിച്ചു; ആ മിസ്രയീമ്യന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നെയ്ത്തുകാരന്റെ പടപ്പുതടിപോലെ ഒരു കുന്തം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇവനോ ഒരു വടിയുംകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു മിസ്രയീമ്യന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു കുന്തം പിടിച്ചു പറിച്ചു കുന്തംകൊണ്ടു അവനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he struck down an Egyptian who was five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s rod in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
chapters.nkjv: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of great height, five cubits tall. In the Egyptian’s hand therewas a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, wrested the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
chapters.kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

chapters.ml: ഇവ യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവു ചെയ്തു, മൂന്നു വീരന്മാരിൽവെച്ചു കീർത്തി പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.
chapters.nkjv: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and won a name among three mighty men.
chapters.kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മുപ്പതു പേരിലും മാനമേറിയവനായിരുന്നു; എങ്കിലും മറ്റേ മൂവരോളം വരികയില്ല. ദാവീദ് അവനെ അകമ്പടിനായകനാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
chapters.nkjv: Indeed he was more honored than the thirty, but he did not attain to the first three. And David appointed him over his guard.
chapters.kjv: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

chapters.ml: സൈന്യത്തിലെ വീരന്മാരോ യോവാബിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അസാഹേൽ, ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമ്യനായ ദോദോവിന്റെ മകൻ എൽഹാനാൻ,
chapters.niv: The mighty warriors were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,
chapters.nkjv: Also the mighty warriors were Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
chapters.kjv: Also the valiant men of the armies were , Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

chapters.ml: ഹരോർയ്യനായ ശമ്മോത്ത്, പെലോന്യനായ ഹേലെസ്,
chapters.niv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
chapters.nkjv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
chapters.kjv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

chapters.ml: തെക്കോവ്യനായ ഇക്കേശിന്റെ മകൻ ഈരാ, അനാഥോത്യനായ അബീയേസേർ,
chapters.niv: Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, Abiezer from Anathoth,
chapters.nkjv: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
chapters.kjv: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,

chapters.ml: ഹൂശാത്യനായ സിബെഖായി, അഹോഹ്യനായ ഈലായി, നെതോഫാത്യനായ മഹരായി,
chapters.niv: Sibbekai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
chapters.nkjv: Sibbechai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
chapters.kjv: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

chapters.ml: നെതോഫാത്യനായ ബാനയുടെ മകൻ ഹേലെദ്,
chapters.niv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,
chapters.nkjv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
chapters.kjv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

chapters.ml: ബെന്യാമീന്യരുടെ ഗിബെയയിൽ നിന്നുള്ള രീബായിയുടെ മകൻ ഈഥായി, പരാഥോന്യനായ ബെനായാവു,
chapters.niv: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
chapters.nkjv: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
chapters.kjv: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

chapters.ml: നഹലേഗാശിൽ നിന്നുള്ള ഹൂരായി, അർബ്ബാത്യനായ അബീയേൽ,
chapters.niv: Hurai from the ravines of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
chapters.nkjv: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
chapters.kjv: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

chapters.ml: ബഹരൂമ്യനായ അസ്മാവെത്ത്, ശയൽബോന്യനായ എല്യഹ്ബാ,
chapters.niv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
chapters.nkjv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
chapters.kjv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

chapters.ml: ഗീസോന്യനായ ഹശേമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ, ഹരാർയ്യനായ ശാഗേയുടെ മകൻ യോനാഥാൻ,
chapters.niv: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,
chapters.nkjv: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shageh the Hararite,
chapters.kjv: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

chapters.ml: ഹരാർയ്യനായ സാഖാരിന്റെ മകൻ അഹീയാം, ഊരിന്റെ മകൻ എലീഫാൽ,
chapters.niv: Ahiam son of Sakar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
chapters.nkjv: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
chapters.kjv: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

chapters.ml: മെഖേരാത്യനായ ഹേഫെർ, പെലോന്യനായ അഹീയാവു, കർമ്മേല്യനായ ഹെസ്രോ,
chapters.niv: Hepher the Mekerathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
chapters.nkjv: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
chapters.kjv: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

chapters.ml: എസ്ബായിയുടെ മകൻ നയരായി,
chapters.niv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
chapters.nkjv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
chapters.kjv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

chapters.ml: നാഥാന്റെ സഹോദരൻ യോവേൽ, ഹഗ്രിയുടെ മകൻ മിബ്ഹാർ,
chapters.niv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,
chapters.nkjv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
chapters.kjv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യനായ സേലെക്, സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ യോവാബിന്റെ ആയുധവാഹകനായ ബെരോത്യൻ നഹ്രായി,
chapters.niv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
chapters.nkjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armorbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),
chapters.kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

chapters.ml: യിത്രീയനായ ഈരാ, യിത്രീയനായ ഗാരേബ്,
chapters.niv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
chapters.nkjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
chapters.kjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

chapters.ml: ഹിത്യനായ ഊരീയാവു, അഹ്ളായിയുടെ മകൻ സാബാദ്, രൂബേന്യരുടെ സേനാപതിയും
chapters.niv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
chapters.nkjv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
chapters.kjv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതുപേർ അകമ്പടിയുള്ളവനുമായി രൂബേന്യനായ ശീസയുടെ മകൻ അദീനാ,
chapters.niv: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, who was chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,
chapters.nkjv: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites) and thirty with him,
chapters.kjv: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

chapters.ml: മയഖയുടെ മകൻ ഹാനാൻ, മിത്ന്യനായ യോശാഫാത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Hanan son of Maakah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
chapters.nkjv: Hanan the son of Maachah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
chapters.kjv: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

chapters.ml: അസ്തെരാത്യനായ ഉസ്സീയാവു, അരോവേർയ്യനായ ഹോഥാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരയ ശാമാ,
chapters.niv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
chapters.nkjv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
chapters.kjv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

chapters.ml: യെയീയേൽ, ശിമ്രിയുടെ മകനായ യെദീയയേൽ തീസ്യനായി അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യോഹാ, മഹവ്യനായ എലീയേൽ,
chapters.niv: Jediael son of Shimri, his brother Joha the Tizite,
chapters.nkjv: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
chapters.kjv: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

chapters.ml: എൽനാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ യെരീബായി, യോശവ്യാവു, മോവാബ്യൻ യിത്തമാ,
chapters.niv: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,
chapters.nkjv: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,
chapters.kjv: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

chapters.ml: എലീയേൽ, ഓബേദ്, മെസോബ്യനായ യാസീയേൽ എന്നിവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Eliel, Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
chapters.nkjv: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
chapters.kjv: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

chapters.ml: കീശിന്റെ മകനായ ശൌലിന്റെ നിമിത്തം ദാവീദ് ഒളിച്ചുപാർത്തിരുന്നപ്പോൾ സീക്ളാഗിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നർ ആവിതു--അവർ വീരന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ അവന്നു യുദ്ധത്തിൽ തുണചെയ്തു;
chapters.niv: These were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the warriors who helped him in battle;
chapters.nkjv: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag while he was still a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, helpers in the war,
chapters.kjv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

chapters.ml: അവർ വില്ലാളികളും വലങ്കൈകൊണ്ടും ഇടങ്കൈകൊണ്ടും കല്ലെറിവാനും വില്ലുകൊണ്ടു അമ്പെയ്‍വാനും സമർത്ഥന്മാരുമായിരുന്നു:-- ബെന്യാമീന്യരായ ശൌലിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ തലവനായ അഹീയേസെർ, യോവാശ്,
chapters.niv: they were armed with bows and were able to shoot arrows or to sling stones right-handed or left-handed; they were relatives of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin):
chapters.nkjv: armed with bows, using both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows with the bow. Theywere of Benjamin, Saul’s brethren.
chapters.kjv: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.

chapters.ml: ഗിബേയാത്യനായ ശെമായയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ, അസ്മാവെത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ യസീയേൽ, പേലെത്ത്, ബെരാഖാ, അനാഥോത്യൻ യേഹൂ.
chapters.niv: Ahiezer their chief and Joash the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Berakah, Jehu the Anathothite,
chapters.nkjv: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Berachah, and Jehu the Anathothite;
chapters.kjv: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതുപേരിൽ വീരനും മുപ്പതുപേർക്കു നായകനുമായി ഗിബെയോന്യനായ യിശ്മയ്യാവു, യിരെമ്യാവു, യഹസീയേൽ, യോഹാനാൻ, ഗെദേരാത്യനായ യോസാബാദ്,
chapters.niv: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty warrior among the Thirty, who was a leader of the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,
chapters.nkjv: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
chapters.kjv: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

chapters.ml: എലൂസായി, യെരീമോത്ത്, ബെയല്യാവു, ശെമർയ്യാവു, ഹരൂഫ്യനായ ശെഫത്യാവു,
chapters.niv: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
chapters.nkjv: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
chapters.kjv: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

chapters.ml: എൽക്കാനാ, യിശ്ശീയാവു, അസരേൽ, കോരഹ്യരായ യോവേസെർ, യാശൊബ്യാം;
chapters.niv: Elkanah, Ishiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites;
chapters.nkjv: Elkanah, Jisshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
chapters.kjv: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

chapters.ml: ഗെദോരിൽനിന്നുള്ള യെരോഹാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ യോവേലാ, സെബദ്യാവു,
chapters.niv: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
chapters.nkjv: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
chapters.kjv: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

chapters.ml: പരിചയും കുന്തവും എടുപ്പാൻ പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള വീരന്മാരും യുദ്ധാഭ്യാസികളും ഗാദ്യരെ പിരിഞ്ഞു വന്നു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ദുർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ദാവീദിനോടു ചേർന്നു; അവർ സിംഹമുഖന്മാരും മലകളിലെ മാൻ പേടകളെപ്പോലെ വേഗതയുള്ളവരുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness. They were brave warriors, ready for battle and able to handle the shield and spear. Their faces were the faces of lions, and they were as swift as gazelles in the mountains.
chapters.nkjv: Some Gadites joined David at the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for battle, who could handle shield and spear, whose faces werelike the faces of lions, and were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:
chapters.kjv: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

chapters.ml: അവരാരെന്നാൽ: തലവൻ ഏസെർ, രണ്ടാമൻ ഓബദ്യാവു, മൂന്നാമൻ എലീയാബ്,
chapters.niv: Ezer was the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,
chapters.nkjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
chapters.kjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

chapters.ml: നാലാമൻ മിശ്മന്നാ, അഞ്ചാമൻ യിരെമ്യാവു,
chapters.niv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
chapters.nkjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
chapters.kjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

chapters.ml: ആറാമൻ അത്ഥായി, ഏഴാമൻ എലീയേൽ,
chapters.niv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
chapters.nkjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
chapters.kjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

chapters.ml: എട്ടാമൻ യോഹാനാൻ, ഒമ്പതാമൻ, എൽസാബാദ്,
chapters.niv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
chapters.nkjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
chapters.kjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

chapters.ml: പത്താമൻ യിരെമ്യാവു, പതിനൊന്നാമൻ മഖ്ബന്നായി.
chapters.niv: Jeremiah the tenth and Makbannai the eleventh.
chapters.nkjv: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.
chapters.kjv: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ ഗാദ്യരിൽ പടനായകന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു; അവരിൽ ചെറിയവൻ നൂറുപേർക്കും വലിയവൻ ആയിരംപേർക്കും മതിയായവൻ.
chapters.niv: These Gadites were army commanders; the least was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
chapters.nkjv: These were from the sons of Gad, captains of the army; the least was over a hundred, and the greatest was over a thousand.
chapters.kjv: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒന്നാം മാസത്തിൽ യോർദ്ദാൻ കവിഞ്ഞൊഴുകുമ്പോൾ അതിനെ കടന്നു താഴ്വര നിവാസികളെയൊക്കെയും കിഴക്കോട്ടും പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടും ഓടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was they who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight everyone living in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
chapters.nkjv: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all those in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
chapters.kjv: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

chapters.ml: ചില ബെന്യാമീന്യരും യെഹൂദ്യരും ദുർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to David at the stronghold.
chapters.kjv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അവരെ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ സമാധാനത്തോടെ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ എന്റെ ഹൃദയം നിങ്ങളോടു ചേർന്നിരിക്കും; എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ അന്യായം ഒന്നും ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കെ എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾക്കു എന്നെ കാണിച്ചു കൊടുപ്പാനെങ്കിലോ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവം നോക്കി ശിക്ഷിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me in peace to help me, I am ready for you to join me. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free from violence, may the God of our ancestors see it and judge you."
chapters.nkjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, "If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, since thereis no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers look and bring judgment."
chapters.kjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon , and rebuke it .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മുപ്പതുപേരിൽ തലവനായ അമാസായിയുടെമേൽ ആത്മാവു വന്നു: ദാവീദേ, ഞങ്ങൾ നിനക്കുള്ളവർ, യിശ്ശായ്പുത്രാ, നിന്റെ പക്ഷക്കാർ തന്നേ; സമാധാനം, നിനക്കു സമാധാനം; നിന്റെ തുണയാളികൾക്കും സമാധാനം; നിന്റെ ദൈവമല്ലോ നിന്നെ തുണെക്കുന്നതു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. ദാവീദ് അവരെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു പടക്കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു തലവന്മാരാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty, and he said: "We are yours, David! We are with you, son of Jesse! Success, success to you, and success to those who help you, for your God will help you." So David received them and made them leaders of his raiding bands.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, chief of the captains, andhesaid: "Weare yours, O David; We are on your side, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, And peace to your helpers! For your God helps you." So David received them, and made them captains of the troop.
chapters.kjv: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said , Thine are we , David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടുകൂടെ ശൌലിന്റെ നേരെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു ചെന്നപ്പോൾ മനശ്ശേയരിൽ ചിലരും അവനോടു ചേർന്നു; അവർ അവർക്കു തുണ ചെയ്തില്ലതാനും; ഫെലിസ്ത്യപ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ആലോചിച്ചിട്ടു: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ തലയുംകൊണ്ടു തന്റെ യജമാനനായ ശൌലിന്റെ പക്ഷം തിരിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ അയച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some of the tribe of Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (He and his men did not help the Philistines because, after consultation, their rulers sent him away. They said, "It will cost us our heads if he deserts to his master Saul.")
chapters.nkjv: And some from Manasseh defected to David when he was going with the Philistines to battle against Saul; but they did not help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away by agreement, saying, "He may defect to his master Saul andendanger our heads."
chapters.kjv: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ സീക്ളാഗിൽ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ മനശ്ശെയിൽനിന്നു അദ്നാഹ്, യോസാബാദ്, യെദീയയേൽ, മീഖായേൽ, യോസാബാദ്, എലീഹൂ, സില്ലെഥായി എന്നീ മനശ്ശേയ സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാർ അവനോടു ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When David went to Ziklag, these were the men of Manasseh who defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu and Zillethai, leaders of units of a thousand in Manasseh.
chapters.nkjv: When he went to Ziklag, those of Manasseh who defected to him were Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of the thousands who were from Manasseh.
chapters.kjv: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒക്കെയും വീരന്മാരും പടനായകന്മാരും ആയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു കവർച്ചക്കൂട്ടത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ദാവീദിനെ സഹായിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They helped David against raiding bands, for all of them were brave warriors, and they were commanders in his army.
chapters.nkjv: And they helped David against the bands ofraiders, for they were all mighty men of valor, and they were captains in the army.
chapters.kjv: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിനെ സഹായിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദിവസംപ്രതി ആളുകൾ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു ഒടുവിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സൈന്യംപോലെ വലിയോരു സൈന്യമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Day after day men came to help David, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
chapters.nkjv: For at that time they came to David day by day to help him, until itwas a great army, like the army of God.
chapters.kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം ശൌലിന്റെ രാജത്വം ദാവീദിന്നു ആക്കുവാൻ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി ഹെബ്രോനിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്ന തലവന്മാരുടെ സംഖ്യകളാവിതു:
chapters.niv: These are the numbers of the men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, as the Lord had said:
chapters.nkjv: Now these were the numbers of the divisions thatwere equipped for war, and came to David at Hebron to turn over the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord:
chapters.kjv: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: പരിചയും കുന്തവും എടുത്തു യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായ യെഹൂദ്യർ ആറായിരത്തെണ്ണൂറുപേർ.
chapters.niv: from Judah, carrying shield and spear—6,800 armed for battle;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Judah bearing shield and spear, six thousand eight hundred armed for war;
chapters.kjv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോന്യരിൽ ശൌര്യമുള്ള യുദ്ധവീരന്മാർ എഴായിരത്തൊരുനൂറുപേർ.
chapters.niv: from Simeon, warriors ready for battle—7,100;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of valor fit for war, seven thousand one hundred;
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരിൽ നാലായിരത്തറുനൂറുപേർ
chapters.niv: from Levi—4,600,
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Levi four thousand six hundred;
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്യരിൽ പ്രഭു യെഹോയാദാ; അവനോടുകൂടെ മൂവായിരത്തെഴുനൂറുപേർ.
chapters.niv: including Jehoiada, leader of the family of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
chapters.nkjv: Jehoiada, the leader of the Aaronites, and with him three thousand seven hundred;
chapters.kjv: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

chapters.ml: പരാക്രമശാലിയായി യൌവനക്കാരനായ സാദോക്, അവന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിലെ ഇരുപത്തിരണ്ടു പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: and Zadok, a brave young warrior, with 22 officers from his family;
chapters.nkjv: Zadok, a young man, a valiant warrior, and from his father’s house twenty-two captains;
chapters.kjv: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

chapters.ml: ശൌലിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ബെന്യാമീന്യരിൽ മൂവായിരം പേർ; അവരിൽ ഭൂരിപക്ഷം അതുവരെ ശൌൽഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ കാര്യം നോക്കിവന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: from Benjamin, Saul’s tribe—3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to Saul’s house until then;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Benjamin, relatives of Saul, three thousand (until then the greatest part of them had remained loyal to the house of Saul);
chapters.kjv: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീമ്യരിൽ പരാക്രമശാലികളായി തങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങളിൽ ശ്രുതിപ്പെട്ടവരായ ഇരുപതിനായിരത്തെണ്ണൂറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: from Ephraim, brave warriors, famous in their own clans—20,800;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men throughout their father’s house;
chapters.kjv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

chapters.ml: മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രത്തിൽ പതിനെണ്ണായിരംപേർ. ദാവീദിനെ രാജാവാക്കുവാൻ ചെല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇവരെ പേരുപേരായി കുറിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: from half the tribe of Manasseh, designated by name to come and make David king—18,000;
chapters.nkjv: of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to come and make David king;
chapters.kjv: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

chapters.ml: യിസ്സാഖാർയ്യരിൽ യിസ്രായേൽ ഇന്നതു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു അറിവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം കാലജ്ഞന്മാരായ തലവന്മാർ ഇരുനൂറുപേർ; അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരൊക്കെയും അവരുടെ കല്പനെക്കു വിധേയരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: from Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do—200 chiefs, with all their relatives under their command;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Issachar who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their chiefs were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their command;
chapters.kjv: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലൂനിൽ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി സകലവിധ യുദ്ധായുധങ്ങളെ ധരിച്ചു നിരനിരയായി ഐകമത്യത്തോടെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടവർ അമ്പതിനായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: from Zebulun, experienced soldiers prepared for battle with every type of weapon, to help David with undivided loyalty—50,000;
chapters.nkjv: of Zebulun there were fifty thousand who went out to battle, expert in war with all weapons of war, stouthearted men who could keep ranks;
chapters.kjv: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

chapters.ml: നഫ്താലിയിൽ നായകന്മാർ ആയിരംപേർ; അവരോടുകൂടെ പരിചയും കുന്തവും എടുത്തവർ മുപ്പത്തേഴായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: from Naphtali—1,000 officers, together with 37,000 men carrying shields and spears;
chapters.nkjv: of Naphtali one thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear;
chapters.kjv: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

chapters.ml: ദാന്യരിൽ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധർ ഇരുപത്തെണ്ണായിരത്തറുനൂറുപേർ.
chapters.niv: from Dan, ready for battle—28,600;
chapters.nkjv: of the Danites who could keep battle formation, twenty-eight thousand six hundred;
chapters.kjv: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

chapters.ml: ആശേരിൽ യുദ്ധസന്നദ്ധരായി പടെക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടവർ നാല്പതിനായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: from Asher, experienced soldiers prepared for battle—40,000;
chapters.nkjv: of Asher, those who could go out to war, able to keep battle formation, forty thousand;
chapters.kjv: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

chapters.ml: യോർദ്ദാന്നു അക്കരെ രൂബേന്യരിലും ഗാദ്യരിലും മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രത്തിലും സകലവിധ യുദ്ധായുധങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ലക്ഷത്തിരുപതിനായിരം പേർ.
chapters.niv: and from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, armed with every type of weapon—120,000.
chapters.nkjv: of the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, from the other side of the Jordan, one hundred and twenty thousand armed for battle with every kind of weapon of war.
chapters.kjv: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

chapters.ml: അണിനിരപ്പാൻ കഴിവുള്ള യോദ്ധാക്കളായ ഇവരെല്ലാവരും ദാവീദിനെ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും രാജാവാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഏകാഗ്രമനസ്സോടെ ഹെബ്രോനിലേക്കു വന്നു; ശേഷമുള്ള യിസ്രായേലും എല്ലാം ദാവീദിനെ രാജാവാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഐകമത്യപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All these were fighting men who volunteered to serve in the ranks. They came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. All the rest of the Israelites were also of one mind to make David king.
chapters.nkjv: All these men of war, who could keep ranks, came to Hebron with a loyal heart, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel were of one mind to make David king.
chapters.kjv: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവിടെ ഭക്ഷിച്ചും പാനം ചെയ്തുംകൊണ്ടു ദാവീദിനോടുകൂടെ മൂന്നു ദിവസം പാർത്തു; അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാർ അവർക്കു വേണ്ടി വട്ടംകൂട്ടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The men spent three days there with David, eating and drinking, for their families had supplied provisions for them.
chapters.nkjv: And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their brethren had prepared for them.
chapters.kjv: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിൽ സന്തോഷമുണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു സമീപവാസികൾ, യിസ്സാഖാർ, സെബൂലൂൻ, നഫ്താലി എന്നിവർ കൂടെ, കഴുതപ്പുറത്തും ഒട്ടകപ്പുറത്തും കോവർകഴുതപ്പുറത്തും കാളപ്പുറത്തും, അപ്പം, മാവു, അത്തിപ്പഴക്കട്ട, ഉണക്കമുന്തിരിപ്പഴം, വീഞ്ഞ്, എണ്ണ എന്നിവയെയും കാളകളെയും വളരെ ആടുകളെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Also, their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen. There were plentiful supplies of flour, fig cakes, raisin cakes, wine, olive oil, cattle and sheep, for there was joy in Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover those who were near to them, from as far away as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing food on donkeys and camels, on mules and oxen—provisions of flour and cakes of figs and cakes of raisins, wine and oil and oxen and sheep abundantly, for therewas joy in Israel.
chapters.kjv: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്, സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരോടും ശതാധിപന്മാരോടും സകലനായകന്മാരോടും ആലോചിച്ചശേഷം
chapters.niv: David conferred with each of his officers, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
chapters.nkjv: Then David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
chapters.kjv: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സർവ്വസഭയോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമ്മതവും നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു ഹിതവും ആകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നാം യിസ്രായേൽദേശത്തെല്ലാടവുമുള്ള നമ്മുടെ ശേഷം സഹോദരന്മാരും അവരോടുകൂടെ പുൽപുറങ്ങളുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ലേവ്യരും നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുകൂടേണ്ടതിന്നു എല്ലാടവും ആളയക്കുക.
chapters.niv: He then said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you and if it is the will of the Lord our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our people throughout the territories of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites who are with them in their towns and pasturelands, to come and join us.
chapters.nkjv: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If itseems good to you, and if it is of the Lord our God, let us send out to our brethren everywhere whoare left in all the land of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites whoare in their cities and their common-lands, that they may gather together to us;
chapters.kjv: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം വീണ്ടും നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരിക; ശൌലിന്റെ കാലത്തു നാം അതിനെ ഗണ്യമാക്കിയില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we did not inquire of it during the reign of Saul."
chapters.nkjv: and let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we have not inquired at it since the days of Saul."
chapters.kjv: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

chapters.ml: ഈ കാര്യം സകലജനത്തിന്നും ബോധിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്യേണമെന്നു സർവ്വസഭയും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The whole assembly agreed to do this, because it seemed right to all the people.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
chapters.kjv: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീമിൽനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടതിന്നു മിസ്രയീമിലെ ശീഹോർ തുടങ്ങി ഹമാത്ത് പ്രദേശംവരെയുള്ള എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും കൂട്ടി വരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: So David assembled all Israel, from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.
chapters.nkjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor in Egypt to as far as the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath Jearim.
chapters.kjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

chapters.ml: കെരൂബുകളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ അധിവസിക്കുന്ന യഹോവയായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ തിരുനാമം വിളിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന പെട്ടകം കൊണ്ടു വരേണ്ടതിന്നു ദാവീദും യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും യെഹൂദയോടു ചേർന്നു കിർയ്യത്ത്-യെയാരീമെന്ന ബയലയിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: David and all Israel went to Baalah of Judah (Kiriath Jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord , who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.
chapters.nkjv: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kirjath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord, who dwells between the cherubim, where His name is proclaimed.
chapters.kjv: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is , to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD , that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it .

chapters.ml: അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം അബീനാദാബിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നെടുത്തു ഒരു പുതിയ വണ്ടിയിൽ കയറ്റി; ഉസ്സയും അഹ്യോവും വണ്ടിതെളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They moved the ark of God from Abinadab’s house on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding it.
chapters.nkjv: So they carried the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
chapters.kjv: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ പൂർണ്ണശക്തിയോടെ പാട്ടുപാടിയും കിന്നരം, വീണ, തപ്പു, കൈത്താളം, കാഹളം എന്നീ വാദ്യങ്ങൾ ഘോഷിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു നൃത്തംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: David and all the Israelites were celebrating with all their might before God, with songs and with harps, lyres, timbrels, cymbals and trumpets.
chapters.nkjv: Then David and all Israel played music before God with all their might, with singing, on harps, on stringed instruments, on tambourines, on cymbals, and with trumpets.
chapters.kjv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

chapters.ml: അവർ കീദോൻ കളത്തിന്നു സമീപം എത്തിയപ്പോൾ കാള വിരളുകകൊണ്ടു ഉസ്സാ പെട്ടകം പിടിപ്പാൻ കൈ നീട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When they came to the threshing floor of Kidon, Uzzah reached out his hand to steady the ark, because the oxen stumbled.
chapters.nkjv: And when they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
chapters.kjv: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ കോപം ഉസ്സയുടെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ കൈ പെട്ടകത്തിങ്കലേക്കു നീട്ടിയതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ ബാധിച്ചു, അവൻ അവിടെ ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The Lord ’s anger burned against Uzzah, and he struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
chapters.nkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against Uzza, and He struck him because he put his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.
chapters.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ഉസ്സയെ ഛേദിച്ച ഛേദംനിമിത്തം ദാവീദിന്നു വ്യസനമായി: അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു പേരെസ്-ഉസ്സാ എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.
chapters.nkjv: And David became angry because of the Lord’s outbreak against Uzza; therefore that place is called Perez Uzza to this day.
chapters.kjv: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഇന്നുവരെയും പറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു. അന്നു ദാവീദ് ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടുപോയി: ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം എങ്ങനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David was afraid of God that day and asked, "How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?"
chapters.nkjv: David was afraid of God that day, saying, "How can I bring the ark of God to me?"
chapters.kjv: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് പെട്ടകം തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരാതെ ഗിത്യനായ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മാറ്റി കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: He did not take the ark to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
chapters.nkjv: So David would not move the ark with him into the City of David, but took it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
chapters.kjv: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തോടുകൂടെ മൂന്നുമാസം അവന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഇരുന്നു; യഹോവ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെയും അവന്നുള്ള സകലത്തെയും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house for three months, and the Lord blessed his household and everything he had.
chapters.nkjv: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed-Edom and all that he had.
chapters.kjv: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.

chapters.ml: സോർരാജാവായ ഹീരാം, ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൂതന്മാരെയും അവന്നു ഒരു അരമന പണിയേണ്ടതിന്നു ദേവദാരുക്കളെയും കൽപ്പണിക്കാരെയും ആശാരിമാരെയും അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons and carpenters to build a palace for him.
chapters.nkjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.
chapters.kjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേൽ നിമിത്തം തന്റെ രാജത്വം ഉന്നതിപ്രാപിച്ചതിനാൽ തന്നെ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവായി സ്ഥിരപ്പെടുത്തി എന്നു ദാവീദിന്നു മനസ്സിലായി.
chapters.niv: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and that his kingdom had been highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of His people Israel.
chapters.kjv: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യെരൂശലേമിൽവെച്ചു വേറെയും ഭാര്യമാരെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു, വളരെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In Jerusalem David took more wives and became the father of more sons and daughters.
chapters.nkjv: Then David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David begot more sons and daughters.
chapters.kjv: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ വെച്ചു അവന്നു ജനിച്ച മക്കളുടെ പേരുകളാവിതു: ശമ്മൂവ, ശോബാബ്, നാഥാൻ,
chapters.niv: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
chapters.nkjv: And these are the names of his children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
chapters.kjv: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ, യിബ്ഹാർ, എലീശൂവ, എൽപേലെത്ത്,
chapters.niv: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
chapters.nkjv: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
chapters.kjv: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

chapters.ml: നോഗഹ്, നേഫെഗ്, യാഫീയ,
chapters.niv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.nkjv: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

chapters.ml: എലീശാമാ, ബെല്യാദാ, എലീഫേലെത്ത്.
chapters.niv: Elishama, Beeliada and Eliphelet.
chapters.nkjv: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
chapters.kjv: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും രാജാവായി അഭിഷേകം കഴിഞ്ഞു എന്നു ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ ഒക്കെയും ദാവീദിനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ ചെന്നു; ദാവീദ് അതു കേട്ടു അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went out to meet them.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. And David heard ofit and went out against them.
chapters.kjv: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it , and went out against them.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ വന്നു രെഫായീംതാഴ്വരയിൽ പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim;
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines went and made a raid on the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് ദൈവത്തോടു: ഞാൻ ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെടേണമോ? അവരെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുതരുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. യഹോവ അവനോടു: പുറപ്പെടുക; ഞാൻ അവരെ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: so David inquired of God: "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?" The Lord answered him, "Go, I will deliver them into your hands."
chapters.nkjv: And David inquired of God, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?" The Lord said to him, "Go up, for I will deliver them into your hand."
chapters.kjv: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ബാൽപെരാസീമിൽ ചെന്നു; അവിടെവെച്ചു ദാവീദ് അവരെ തോല്പിച്ചു: വെള്ളച്ചാട്ടംപോലെ ദൈവം എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ എന്റെ കയ്യാൽ തകർത്തുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു ബാൽ-പെരാസീം എന്നു പേർ പറഞ്ഞു വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David and his men went up to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, God has broken out against my enemies by my hand." So that place was called Baal Perazim.
chapters.nkjv: So they went up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. Then David said, "God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a breakthrough of water." Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
chapters.kjv: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ദേവന്മാരെ അവിടെ വിട്ടേച്ചുപോയി; അവയെ തീയിലിട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളവാൻ ദാവീദ് കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Philistines had abandoned their gods there, and David gave orders to burn them in the fire.
chapters.nkjv: And when they left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
chapters.kjv: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ പിന്നെയും താഴ്വരയിൽ വന്നു പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: Once more the Philistines raided the valley;
chapters.nkjv: Then the Philistines once again made a raid on the valley.
chapters.kjv: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പിന്നെയും ദൈവത്തോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിച്ചപ്പോൾ ദൈവം അവനോടു: അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ ചെല്ലാതെ അവരെ വിട്ടുതിരിഞ്ഞു ബാഖാവൃക്ഷങ്ങൾക്കെതിരെ അവരുടെ നേരെ ചെല്ലുക.
chapters.niv: so David inquired of God again, and God answered him, "Do not go directly after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore David inquired again of God, and God said to him, "You shall not go up after them; circle around them, and come upon them in front of the mulberry trees.
chapters.kjv: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

chapters.ml: ബാഖാവൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെ അഗ്രങ്ങളിൽകൂടി അണിയണിയായി നടക്കുന്ന ഒച്ച കേട്ടാൽ നീ പടെക്കു പുറപ്പെടുക; ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ സൈന്യത്തെ തോല്പിപ്പാൻ ദൈവം നിനക്കു മുമ്പായി പുറപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു;
chapters.niv: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move out to battle, because that will mean God has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be, when you hear a sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then you shall go out to battle, for God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines."
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ദാവീദ് ചെയ്തു; അവർ ഗിബെയോൻ മുതൽ ഗേസെർവരെ ഫെലിസ്ത്യ സൈന്യത്തെ തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So David did as God commanded him, and they struck down the Philistine army, all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
chapters.nkjv: So David did as God commanded him, and they drove back the army of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
chapters.kjv: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ കീർത്തി സകലദേശങ്ങളിലും പരക്കയും യഹോവ അവനെയുള്ള ഭയം സർവ്വജാതികൾക്കും വരുത്തുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So David’s fame spread throughout every land, and the Lord made all the nations fear him.
chapters.nkjv: Then the fame of David went out into all lands, and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.
chapters.kjv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തനിക്കു ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അരമനകളെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്നായി ഒരു സ്ഥലം ഒരുക്കി, അതിന്നു ഒരു കൂടാരവും അടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After David had constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
chapters.nkjv: David built houses for himself in the City of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.
chapters.kjv: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ദാവീദ്: ലേവ്യരല്ലാതെ ആരും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ചുമക്കേണ്ടതല്ല; അവരെയല്ലോ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം ചുമപ്പാനും തനിക്കു എന്നും ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്‍വാനും യഹോവ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then David said, "No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the Lord chose them to carry the ark of the Lord and to minister before him forever."
chapters.nkjv: Then David said, "No one may carry the ark of God but the Levites, for the Lord has chosen them to carry the ark of God and to minister before Him forever."
chapters.kjv: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം താൻ അതിന്നു ഒരുക്കിയ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും യെരൂശലേമിൽ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place he had prepared for it.
chapters.nkjv: And David gathered all Israel together at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had prepared for it.
chapters.kjv: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും ലേവ്യരെയും കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: He called together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:
chapters.nkjv: Then David assembled the children of Aaron and the Levites:
chapters.kjv: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്യരിൽ പ്രധാനിയായ ഊരിയേലിനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ നൂറ്റിരുപതുപേരെയും
chapters.niv: From the descendants of Kohath, Uriel the leader and 120 relatives;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and one hundred and twenty of his brethren;
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

chapters.ml: മെരാർയ്യരിൽ പ്രധാനിയായ അസായാവെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ഇരുനൂറ്റിരുപതുപേരെയും
chapters.niv: from the descendants of Merari, Asaiah the leader and 220 relatives;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brethren;
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോമ്യരിൽ പ്രധാനിയായ യോവേലിനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ നൂറ്റിമുപ്പതുപേരെയും
chapters.niv: from the descendants of Gershon, Joel the leader and 130 relatives;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and one hundred and thirty of his brethren;
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

chapters.ml: എലീസാഫാന്യരിൽ പ്രധാനിയായ ശെമയ്യാവെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ഇരുനൂറുപേരെയും
chapters.niv: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the leader and 200 relatives;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and two hundred of his brethren;
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോന്യരിൽ പ്രധാനിയായ എലീയേലിനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ എണ്പതു പേരെയും
chapters.niv: from the descendants of Hebron, Eliel the leader and 80 relatives;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and eighty of his brethren;
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയേല്യരിൽ പ്രധാനിയായ അമ്മീനാദാബിനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ നൂറ്റിപ്പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേരെയും തന്നെ.
chapters.niv: from the descendants of Uzziel, Amminadab the leader and 112 relatives.
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and one hundred and twelve of his brethren.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പുരോഹിതന്മാരായ സാദോക്കിനെയും അബ്യാഥാരിനെയും ഊരീയേൽ, അസായാവു, യോവേൽ, ശെമയ്യാവു, എലീയേൽ, അമ്മീനാദാബ് എന്നീ ലേവ്യരെയും വിളിപ്പിച്ചു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab the Levites.
chapters.nkjv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
chapters.kjv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ലേവ്യരുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങളിൽ തലവന്മാരല്ലോ; നിങ്ങളും നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം ഞാൻ അതിന്നു ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "You are the heads of the Levitical families; you and your fellow Levites are to consecrate yourselves and bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "You are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel to theplace I have prepared for it.
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

chapters.ml: ആദിയിൽ നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ അതു ചെയ്യായ്കകൊണ്ടു നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നമുക്കു ഛേദം ഉണ്ടാക്കി; നാം അവനെ നിയമപ്രകാരമല്ലല്ലോ അന്വേഷിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: It was because you, the Levites, did not bring it up the first time that the Lord our God broke out in anger against us. We did not inquire of him about how to do it in the prescribed way."
chapters.nkjv: For because you did not doit the first time, the Lord our God broke out against us, because we did not consult Him about the proper order."
chapters.kjv: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ലേവ്യരും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ തങ്ങളെ തന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves in order to bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
chapters.kjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം മോശെ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകത്തെ അതിന്റെ തണ്ടുകൾ തങ്ങളുടെ ചുമലിൽ കൊണ്ടു ചുമന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the Levites carried the ark of God with the poles on their shoulders, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God on their shoulders, by its poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD .

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് ലേവ്യരിലെ പ്രധാനന്മാരോടു വീണ, കിന്നരം, കൈത്താളം എന്നീ വാദ്യങ്ങളാൽ സന്തോഷനാദം ഉച്ചത്തിൽ ധ്വനിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു സംഗീതക്കാരായ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ നിറുത്തുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their fellow Levites as musicians to make a joyful sound with musical instruments: lyres, harps and cymbals.
chapters.nkjv: Then David spoke to the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brethren tobe the singers accompanied by instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, by raising the voice with resounding joy.
chapters.kjv: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ലേവ്യർ യോവേലിന്റെ മകനായ ഹേമാനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ ബേരെഖ്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ ആസാഫിനെയും അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ മെരാർയ്യരിൽ കൂശായാവിന്റെ മകനായ ഏഥാനെയും
chapters.niv: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his relatives, Asaph son of Berekiah; and from their relatives the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
chapters.nkjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of their brethren, the sons of Merari, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
chapters.kjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

chapters.ml: അവരോടുകൂടെ രണ്ടാം തരത്തിലെ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ സെഖർയ്യാവു, ബേൻ, യാസീയേൽ, ശെമീരാമോത്ത്, യെഹീയേൽ, ഉന്നി, എലീയാബ്, ബെനായാവു, മയസേയാവു, മത്ഥിഥ്യാവു, എലീഫെലേഹൂ, മിക്നേയാവു, ഓബേദ്-എദോം, യെയീയേൽ എന്നിവരെ വാതിൽ കാവൽക്കാരായും നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and with them their relatives next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
chapters.nkjv: and with them their brethren of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers;
chapters.kjv: And with them their brethren of the second degree , Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

chapters.ml: സംഗീതക്കാരായ ഹേമാനും ആസാഫും ഏഥാനും താമ്രംകൊണ്ടുള്ള കൈത്താളങ്ങളെയും
chapters.niv: The musicians Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals;
chapters.nkjv: the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were to sound the cymbals of bronze;
chapters.kjv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

chapters.ml: സെഖർയ്യാവു, അസീയേൽ, ശെമീരാമോത്ത്, യെഹീയേൽ, ഉന്നി, എലീയാബ്, മയസേയാവു, ബെനായാവു എന്നിവർ അലാമോത്ത് രാഗത്തിൽ വീണകളെയും ധ്വനിപ്പിപ്പാനും
chapters.niv: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah were to play the lyres according to alamoth,
chapters.nkjv: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with strings according to Alamoth;
chapters.kjv: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

chapters.ml: മത്ഥിഥ്യവു, എലീഫേലേഹൂ, മിക്നേയാവു, ഓബേദ്-എദോം, യെയീയേൽ, അസസ്യാവു എന്നിവർ ശെമീനീത്ത് രാഗത്തിൽ കിന്നരം വായിപ്പാനും നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel and Azaziah were to play the harps, directing according to sheminith.
chapters.nkjv: Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, to direct with harps on the Sheminith;
chapters.kjv: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

chapters.ml: വാഹകന്മാരായ ലേവ്യരിൽ പ്രധാനിയായ കെനന്യാവു പെട്ടകം വഹിക്കുന്നതിന്നു മേൽവിചാരകനായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അതിൽ സമർത്ഥനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Kenaniah the head Levite was in charge of the singing; that was his responsibility because he was skillful at it.
chapters.nkjv: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites, was instructor inchargeof the music, because he was skillful;
chapters.kjv: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

chapters.ml: ബേരെഖ്യാവും എൽക്കാനയും പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Berekiah and Elkanah were to be doorkeepers for the ark.
chapters.nkjv: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark;
chapters.kjv: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

chapters.ml: ശെബന്യാവു, യോശാഫാത്ത്, നെഥനയേൽ, അമാസായി, സെഖർയ്യാവു, ബെനായാവു, എലെയാസാർ എന്നീ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്മുമ്പിൽ കാഹളം ഊതി; ഓബേദ്-എദോമും യെഹീയാവും പെട്ടകത്തിന്നു വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer the priests were to blow trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were also to be doorkeepers for the ark.
chapters.nkjv: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah, doorkeepers for the ark.
chapters.kjv: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദും യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരും സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരും യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of units of a thousand went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-Edom, with rejoicing.
chapters.nkjv: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
chapters.kjv: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ വാഹകന്മാരായ ലേവ്യർക്കു ദൈവം സഹായിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ഏഴു കാളയെയും ഏഴു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും യാഗംകഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Because God had helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord , seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed.
chapters.nkjv: And so it was, when God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bulls and seven rams.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പെട്ടകവാഹകന്മാരായ ലേവ്യർ ഒക്കെയും സംഗീതക്കാരും സംഗീതക്കാരോടുകൂടെ വാഹകപ്രമാണിയായ കെനന്യാവും ശണപടം കൊണ്ടുള്ള അങ്കി ധരിച്ചു; ദാവീദ് ശണം കൊണ്ടുള്ള എഫോദ് ധരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now David was clothed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and as were the musicians, and Kenaniah, who was in charge of the singing of the choirs. David also wore a linen ephod.
chapters.nkjv: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the music master with the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
chapters.kjv: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേലൊക്കയും ആർപ്പോടും കാഹളനാദത്തോടും തൂർയ്യങ്ങളുടെയും കൈത്താളങ്ങളുടെയും ധ്വനിയോടുംകൂടി കിന്നരവും വീണയും വായിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouts, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and of cymbals, and the playing of lyres and harps.
chapters.nkjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting and with the sound of the horn, with trumpets and with cymbals, making music with stringed instruments and harps.
chapters.kjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകം ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ശൌലിന്റെ മകളായ മീഖൾ കിളിവാതിലിൽകൂടി നോക്കി, ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു നൃത്തം ചെയ്യുന്നതും പാടുന്നതും കണ്ടു ഹൃദയത്തിൽ അവനെ നിന്ദിച്ചു
chapters.niv: As the ark of the covenant of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David dancing and celebrating, she despised him in her heart.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the City of David, that Michal, Saul’s daughter, looked through a window and saw King David whirling and playing music; and she despised him in her heart.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പെട്ടകം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ദാവീദ് അതിന്നായിട്ടു അടിച്ചിരുന്ന കൂടാരത്തിന്നകത്തു വെച്ചു; പിന്നെ അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before God.
chapters.nkjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tabernacle that David had erected for it. Then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
chapters.kjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഹോമയാഗവും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും കഴിച്ചുതീർന്നശേഷം ജനത്തെ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിൽ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഓരോ പുരുഷന്നും സ്ത്രീക്കും ആളൊന്നിന്നു ഒരു അപ്പവും ഒരു ഖണ്ഡം ഇറച്ചിയും ഒരു മുന്തിരിങ്ങാക്കട്ടവീതം വിഭാഗിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each Israelite man and woman.
chapters.nkjv: Then he distributed to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a piece ofmeat, and a cake of raisins.
chapters.kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine .

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു കീർത്തനവും വന്ദനവും സ്തോത്രവും ചെയ്‍വാൻ ലേവ്യരിൽനിന്നു ശുശ്രൂഷകന്മാരെ നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord , to extol, thank, and praise the Lord , the God of Israel:
chapters.nkjv: And he appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the Lord God of Israel:
chapters.kjv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD , and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

chapters.ml: ആസാഫ് തലവൻ; രണ്ടാമൻ സെഖർയ്യാവു; പിന്നെ യെയീയേൽ, ശെമീരാമോത്ത്, യെഹീയേൽ, മത്ഥിഥ്യാവു, എലീയാബ്, ബെനായാവു, ഓബേദ്-എദോം, യെയീയേൽ എന്നിവർ വീണയും കിന്നരവും വായിച്ചു; ആസാഫ് കൈത്താളം കൊട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Asaph was the chief, and next to him in rank were Zechariah, then Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel. They were to play the lyres and harps, Asaph was to sound the cymbals,
chapters.nkjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, and Obed-Edom: Jeiel with stringed instruments and harps, but Asaph made music with cymbals;
chapters.kjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്മാരായ ബെനായാവും യെഹസീയേലും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നിയമപെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിരന്തരം കാഹളം ഊതി.
chapters.niv: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests regularly blew the trumpets before the ark of the covenant of God.
chapters.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

chapters.ml: അന്നു, ആ ദിവസം തന്നേ, ദാവീദ് ആസാഫും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും മുഖാന്തരം യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു ആദ്യം നിയമിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: That day David first appointed Asaph and his associates to give praise to the Lord in this manner:
chapters.nkjv: On that day David first delivered thispsalm into the hand of Asaph and his brethren, to thank the Lord:
chapters.kjv: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ നാമത്തെ ആരാധിപ്പിൻ; ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ അറിയിപ്പിൻ;
chapters.niv: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.
chapters.nkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord! Call upon His name; Make known His deeds among the peoples!
chapters.kjv: Give thanks unto the LORD , call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു പാടി കീർത്തനം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവന്റെ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളെ ഒക്കെയും വർണ്ണിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.
chapters.nkjv: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him; Talk of all His wondrous works!
chapters.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വിശുദ്ധനാമത്തിൽ പുകഴുവിൻ; യഹോവയെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവരുടെ ഹൃദയം സന്തോഷിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
chapters.nkjv: Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the Lord!
chapters.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെയും അവന്റെ ശക്തിയെയും തേടുവിൻ; അവന്റെ മുഖം നിരന്തരം അന്വേഷിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.
chapters.nkjv: Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face evermore!
chapters.kjv: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ദാസനായ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സന്താനമേ, അവന്റെ വൃതന്മാരായ യാക്കോബ് പുത്രന്മാരേ,
chapters.niv: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,
chapters.nkjv: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,
chapters.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെയ്ത അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത അടയാളങ്ങളും വിധികളും ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: you his servants, the descendants of Israel, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: O seed of Israel His servant, You children of Jacob, His chosen ones!
chapters.kjv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

chapters.ml: അവനല്ലോ നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ; അവന്റെ ന്യായവിധികൾ സർവ്വഭൂമിയിലുമുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
chapters.nkjv: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
chapters.kjv: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വചനം ആയിരം തലമുറയോളവും അവന്റെ നിയമം എന്നേക്കും ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,
chapters.nkjv: Remember His covenant forever, The word which He commanded, for a thousand generations,
chapters.kjv: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമോടു അവൻ ചെയ്ത നിയമവും യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു ചെയ്ത സത്യവും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.
chapters.nkjv: The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,
chapters.kjv: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

chapters.ml: അതിനെ അവൻ യാക്കോബിന്നു ഒരു പ്രമാണമായും യിസ്രായേലിന്നൊരു ശാശ്വതനിയമമായും ഉറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
chapters.nkjv: And confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,
chapters.kjv: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കു അവകാശമായി കനാൻ ദേശത്തെ തരും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."
chapters.nkjv: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എണ്ണം കുറഞ്ഞു ചുരുക്കംപേരും അവിടെ പരദേശികളും ആയിരിക്കുമ്പോഴും
chapters.niv: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,
chapters.nkjv: When you were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.
chapters.kjv: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒരു ജാതിയെ വിട്ടു മറ്റൊരു ജാതിയിലേക്കും ഒരു രാജ്യം വിട്ടു മറ്റൊരു വംശത്തിലേക്കും പോകുമ്പോഴും
chapters.niv: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
chapters.nkjv: When they went from one nation to another, And from one kingdom to another people,
chapters.kjv: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

chapters.ml: ആരും അവരെ പീഡിപ്പിപ്പാൻ അവൻ സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല; അവർനിമിത്തം രാജാക്കന്മാരെയും ശാസിച്ചതു:
chapters.niv: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:
chapters.nkjv: He permitted no man to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,
chapters.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തന്മാരെ തൊടരുതു; എന്റെ പ്രവാചകർക്കു ദോഷം ചെയ്കയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."
chapters.nkjv: Saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."
chapters.kjv: Saying , Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

chapters.ml: സർവ്വഭൂവാസികളേ, യഹോവെക്കു പാടുവിൻ; നാൾക്കുനാൾ അവന്റെ രക്ഷയെ പ്രസ്താവിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Sing to the Lord , all the earth; proclaim his salvation day after day.
chapters.nkjv: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
chapters.kjv: Sing unto the LORD , all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

chapters.ml: ജാതികളുടെ നടുവിൽ അവന്റെ മഹത്വവും സർവ്വവംശങ്ങളുടെയും മദ്ധ്യേ അവന്റെ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും കഥിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.
chapters.nkjv: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
chapters.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ വലിയവനും അത്യന്തം സ്തുത്യനും സർവ്വദേവന്മാരിലും അതിഭയങ്കരനുമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lordis great and greatly to be praised; He is also to be feared above all gods.
chapters.kjv: For great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

chapters.ml: ജാതികളുടെ സകലദേവന്മാരും വിഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ അത്രേ; യഹോവയോ ആകാശത്തെ ചമെച്ചവൻ.
chapters.niv: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
chapters.nkjv: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, But the Lord made the heavens.
chapters.kjv: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

chapters.ml: യശസ്സും തേജസ്സും അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിലും ബലവും ആനന്ദവും അവന്റെ വാസസ്ഥലത്തിലും ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his dwelling place.
chapters.nkjv: Honor and majesty are before Him; Strength and gladness are in His place.
chapters.kjv: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

chapters.ml: ജാതികളുടെ കുലങ്ങളേ, യഹോവെക്കു കൊടുപ്പിൻ;
chapters.niv: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
chapters.nkjv: Give to the Lord, O families of the peoples, Give to the Lord glory and strength.
chapters.kjv: Give unto the LORD , ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു അവന്റെ നാമത്തിന്റെ മഹത്വം കൊടുപ്പിൻ; കാഴ്ചയുമായി അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; വിശുദ്ധഭൂഷണം ധരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയെ നമസ്കരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come before him. Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.
chapters.nkjv: Give to the Lord the glory due His name; Bring an offering, and come before Him. Oh, worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness!
