chapters.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

chapters.ml: സർവ്വഭൂമിയേ, അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നടുങ്ങുക; ഭൂതലം കുലങ്ങാതവണ്ണം സ്ഥാപിതമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Tremble before him, all the earth! The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
chapters.nkjv: Tremble before Him, all the earth. The world also is firmly established, It shall not be moved.
chapters.kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗം ആനന്ദിക്കട്ടെ; ഭൂമി ഉല്ലസിക്കട്ടെ; യഹോവ വാഴുന്നു എന്നു ജാതികളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഘോഷിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns!"
chapters.nkjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; And let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns."
chapters.kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

chapters.ml: സമുദ്രവും അതിന്റെ പൂർണ്ണതയും മുഴങ്ങട്ടെ. വയലും അതിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ആഹ്ളാദിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Let the sea resound, and all that is in it; let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them!
chapters.nkjv: Let the sea roar, and all its fullness; Let the field rejoice, and all that is in it.
chapters.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

chapters.ml: അന്നു വനത്തിലെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ ആർക്കും; അവൻ ഭൂമിയെ വിധിപ്പാൻ വരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Let the trees of the forest sing, let them sing for joy before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Then the trees of the woods shall rejoice before the Lord, For He is coming to judge the earth.
chapters.kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD , because he cometh to judge the earth.

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവൻ നല്ലവനല്ലോ; അവന്റെ ദയ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
chapters.nkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
chapters.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ രക്ഷയായ ദൈവമേ, ഞങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ; തിരുനാമത്തെ വാഴ്ത്തി നിന്റെ സ്തുതിയിൽ പുകഴുവാൻ ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചു ശേഖരിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Cry out, "Save us, God our Savior; gather us and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and glory in your praise."
chapters.nkjv: And say, "Save us, O God of our salvation; Gather us together, and deliver us from the Gentiles, To give thanks to Your holy name, To triumph in Your praise."
chapters.kjv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിൻ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ എന്നും എന്നേക്കും വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ. സകലജനവും ആമേൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Then all the people said "Amen" and "Praise the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! And all the people said, "Amen!" and praised the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ദിവസംപ്രതിയുള്ള വേലയുടെ ആവശ്യംപോലെ നിത്യം ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആസാഫിനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെയും
chapters.niv: David left Asaph and his associates before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister there regularly, according to each day’s requirements.
chapters.nkjv: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister before the ark regularly, as every day’s work required;
chapters.kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

chapters.ml: ഒബേദ്-എദോമിനെയും അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ അറുപത്തെട്ടുപേരെയും യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകത്തിന്മുമ്പിലും യെദൂഥൂന്റെ മകനായ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിനെയും ഹോസയെയും വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാരായും നിർത്തി.
chapters.niv: He also left Obed-Edom and his sixty-eight associates to minister with them. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were gatekeepers.
chapters.nkjv: and Obed-Edom with his sixty-eight brethren, including Obed-Edom the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah, tobe gatekeepers;
chapters.kjv: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതനായ സാദോക്കിനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും ഗിബെയോനിലെ പൂജാഗിരിയിൽ യഹോവയുടെ തിരുനിവാസത്തിന്മുമ്പിൽ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള
chapters.niv: David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place in Gibeon
chapters.nkjv: and Zadok the priest and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place that was at Gibeon,
chapters.kjv: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന പ്രകാരമൊക്കെയും രാവിലെയും വൈകുന്നേരവും നിത്യം ഹോമപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യഹോവെക്കു
chapters.niv: to present burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, in accordance with everything written in the Law of the Lord , which he had given Israel.
chapters.nkjv: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly morning and evening, and todo according to all that is written in the Law of the Lord which He commanded Israel;
chapters.kjv: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD , which he commanded Israel;

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗം കഴിപ്പാനും അവരോടുകൂടെ ഹേമാൻ, യെദൂഥൂൻ മുതലായി പേർവിവരം പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന ശ്രേഷ്ഠന്മാരെയും അവന്റെ ദയ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു എന്നിങ്ങനെ യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്‍വാനും നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the Lord , "for his love endures forever."
chapters.nkjv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were designated by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because His mercy endures forever;
chapters.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD , because his mercy endureth for ever;

chapters.ml: അവരോടുകൂടെ ഹേമാനെയും യെദൂഥൂനെയും കാഹളം, കൈത്താളം എന്നിങ്ങനെ ദിവ്യസംഗീതത്തിന്നായുള്ള വാദ്യങ്ങളെ ധ്വനിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിയമിച്ചു; യെദൂഥൂന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാർ ആയിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Heman and Jeduthun were responsible for the sounding of the trumpets and cymbals and for the playing of the other instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
chapters.nkjv: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, to sound aloud with trumpets and cymbals and the musical instruments of God. Now the sons of Jeduthun were gatekeepers.
chapters.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ സർവ്വജനവും ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി; ദാവീദും തന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെ അനുഗ്രഹിപ്പാൻ മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then all the people left, each for their own home, and David returned home to bless his family.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the people departed, every man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
chapters.kjv: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തന്റെ അരമനയിൽ വസിച്ചിരിക്കുംകാലത്തു ഒരുനാൾ നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകനോടു: ഇതാ ഞാൻ ദേവദാരുകൊണ്ടുള്ള അരമനയിൽ വസിക്കുന്നു; യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകമോ തിരശ്ശീലകൾക്കു കീഴെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After David was settled in his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under a tent."
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when David was dwelling in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lordis under tent curtains."
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.

chapters.ml: നാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു: നിന്റെ താല്പര്യംപോലെയൊക്കെയും ചെയ്താലും; യഹോവ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Nathan replied to David, "Whatever you have in mind, do it, for God is with you."
chapters.nkjv: Then Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you."
chapters.kjv: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അന്നു രാത്രി നാഥാന്നു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying:
chapters.nkjv: But it happened that night that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു എന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിനോടു പറക: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു; എനിക്കു വസിപ്പാനുള്ള ആലയം പണിയേണ്ടതു നീയല്ല.
chapters.niv: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: You are not the one to build me a house to dwell in.
chapters.nkjv: "Go and tell My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord: "You shall not build Me a house to dwell in.
chapters.kjv: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ കൊണ്ടുവന്ന നാൾമുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെയും ഞാൻ ഒരു ആലയത്തിൽ വാസം ചെയ്യാതെ കൂടാരത്തിൽനിന്നു കൂടരത്തിലേക്കും നിവാസത്തിൽനിന്നു നിവാസത്തിലേക്കും സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt to this day. I have moved from one tent site to another, from one dwelling place to another.
chapters.nkjv: For I have not dwelt in a house since the time that I brought up Israel, even to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle toanother.
chapters.kjv: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another .

chapters.ml: എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനോടുംകൂടെ സഞ്ചരിച്ചുവന്ന സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ എവിടെവെച്ചെങ്കിലും എന്റെ ജനത്തെ മേയിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചാക്കിയ യിസ്രായേൽ ന്യായാധിപതിമാരിൽ ആരോടെങ്കിലും: നിങ്ങൾ എനിക്കു ദേവദാരുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയാതെയിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ഒരു വാക്കു ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their leaders whom I commanded to shepherd my people, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" ’
chapters.nkjv: Wherever I have moved about with all Israel, have I ever spoken a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar–’ " ’
chapters.kjv: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ എന്റെ ഭൃത്യനായ ദാവീദിനോടു പറയേണ്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ: സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നീ എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു പ്രഭുവായിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ പുല്പുറത്തുനിന്നു, ആടുകളെ നോക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "I took you from the sheepfold, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people Israel.
chapters.kjv: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

chapters.ml: നീ സഞ്ചരിച്ചുവന്ന എല്ലായിടത്തും ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു നിന്റെ സകലശത്രുക്കളെയും നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഛേദിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; ഭൂമിയിലുള്ള മഹാന്മാരുടെ നാമംപോലെ ഒരു നാമം ഞാൻ നിനക്കു ഉണ്ടാക്കും.
chapters.niv: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name like the names of the greatest men on earth.
chapters.nkjv: And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men who are on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഒരു സ്ഥലം കല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കയും അവർ സ്വന്തസ്ഥലത്തു പാർത്തു അവിടെനിന്നു ഇളകാതവണ്ണം അവരെ നടുകയും ചെയ്യും; പണ്ടത്തെപ്പോലെയും എന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഞാൻ ന്യായാധിപന്മാരെ കല്പിച്ചാക്കിയ കാലത്തെപ്പോലെയും ഇനി ദുഷ്ടന്മാർ അവരെ ക്ഷയിപ്പിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning
chapters.nkjv: Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own and move no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness oppress them anymore, as previously,
chapters.kjv: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ സകലശത്രുക്കളെയും അടക്കും; യഹോവ നിനക്കു ഒരു ഗൃഹം പണിയുമെന്നും ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു അറിയിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also subdue all your enemies. " ‘I declare to you that the Lord will build a house for you:
chapters.nkjv: since the time that I commanded judges tobe over My people Israel. Also I will subdue all your enemies. Furthermore I tell you that the Lord will build you a house.
chapters.kjv: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

chapters.ml: നീ നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്റെ ജീവകാലം തികയുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ശേഷം നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ഒരുവനായ നിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ എഴുന്നേല്പിക്കയും അവന്റെ രാജത്വം സ്ഥിരമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: When your days are over and you go to be with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled, when you must go tobe with your fathers, that I will set up your seed after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എനിക്കു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയും; ഞാൻ അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനം എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: He is the one who will build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.
chapters.nkjv: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
chapters.kjv: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്നു പിതാവും അവൻ എനിക്കു പുത്രനും ആയിരിക്കും; നിന്റെ മുൻവാഴ്ചക്കാരനോടു ഞാൻ എന്റെ കൃപ എടുത്തുകളഞ്ഞതുപോലെ അവനോടു അതിനെ എടുത്തുകളകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my love away from him, as I took it away from your predecessor.
chapters.nkjv: I will be his Father, and he shall be My son; and I will not take My mercy away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.
chapters.kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവനെ എന്റെ ആലയത്തിലും എന്റെ രാജത്വത്തിലും എന്നേക്കും നിലനിർത്തും; അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനവും എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will set him over my house and my kingdom forever; his throne will be established forever.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And I will establish him in My house and in My kingdom forever; and his throne shall be established forever." ’ "
chapters.kjv: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കുകളും ഈ ദർശനവും എല്ലാം നാഥാൻ ദാവീദിനോടു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
chapters.nkjv: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
chapters.kjv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവു അകത്തു ചെന്നു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഇരുന്നു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: യഹോവയായ ദൈവമേ, നീ എന്നെ ഇത്രത്തോളം കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ ഞാൻ ആർ? എന്റെ ഗൃഹവും എന്തുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, Lord God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
chapters.nkjv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord; and he said: "Who am I, O Lord God? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
chapters.kjv: And David the king came and sat before the LORD , and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

chapters.ml: ദൈവമേ, ഇതും പോരാ എന്നു തോന്നീട്ടു യഹോവയായ ദൈവമേ, വരുവാനുള്ള ദീർഘകാലത്തേക്കു അടിയന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും നീ അരുളിച്ചെയ്കയും ശ്രേഷ്ഠപദവിയിലുള്ള മനുഷ്യന്റെ അവസ്ഥെക്കൊത്തവണ്ണം എന്നെ ആദരിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And as if this were not enough in your sight, my God, you have spoken about the future of the house of your servant. You, Lord God, have looked on me as though I were the most exalted of men.
chapters.nkjv: And yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O God; and You have also spoken of Your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, O Lord God.
chapters.kjv: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

chapters.ml: അടിയന്നു ചെയ്ത ബഹുമാനത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ദാവീദ് ഇനി എന്തു പറയേണ്ടു? നീ അടിയനെ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant,
chapters.nkjv: What more can David say to You for the honor of Your servant? For You know Your servant.
chapters.kjv: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, അടിയൻ നിമിത്തവും നിന്റെ പ്രസാദപ്രകാരവും നീ ഈ മഹിമ ഒക്കെയും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു ഈ വങ്കാര്യം എല്ലാം അറിയിച്ചുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Lord . For the sake of your servant and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made known all these great promises.
chapters.nkjv: O Lord, for Your servant’s sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
chapters.kjv: O LORD , for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ സ്വന്തചെവികൊണ്ടു കേട്ടതൊക്കെയും ഓർത്താൽ യഹോവേ, നിന്നെപ്പോലെ ഒരുത്തനുമില്ല; നീ അല്ലാതെ ഒരു ദൈവവുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "There is no one like you, Lord , and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
chapters.nkjv: O Lord, thereis none like You, nor isthereany God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
chapters.kjv: O LORD , there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു നീ ഉദ്ധരിച്ച നിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ജാതികളെ നീക്കിക്കളകയിൽ വലിയതും ഭയങ്കരവുമായ കാര്യങ്ങളാൽ നിനക്കു ഒരു നാമം സമ്പാദിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു: ദൈവമേ നീ ചെന്നു നിനക്കു സ്വന്തജനമായി വിണ്ടെടുത്ത നിന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിനെപ്പോലെ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഏതൊരു ജാതിയുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth whose God went out to redeem a people for himself, and to make a name for yourself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?
chapters.nkjv: And who is like Your people Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people—to make for Yourself a name by great and awesome deeds, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You redeemed from Egypt?
chapters.kjv: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിനെ നീ എന്നേക്കും നിനക്കു സ്വന്തജനമാക്കുകയും യഹോവേ, നീ അവർക്കു ദൈവമായ്തീരുകയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You made your people Israel your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.
chapters.nkjv: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own people forever; and You, Lord, have become their God.
chapters.kjv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD , becamest their God.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവേ, ഇപ്പോൾ നീ അടിയനെയും അടിയന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനം എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കട്ടെ; അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ ചെയ്യേണമേ.
chapters.niv: "And now, Lord , let the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house be established forever. Do as you promised,
chapters.nkjv: "And now, O Lord, the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house, letit be established forever, and do as You have said.
chapters.kjv: Therefore now, LORD , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

chapters.ml: സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമാകുന്നു; യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ദൈവം തന്നേ എന്നിങ്ങനെ നിന്റെ നാമം എന്നേക്കും സ്ഥിരപ്പെട്ടു മഹത്വപ്പെടുകയും നിന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഗൃഹം നിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ നിലനിൽക്കയും ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: so that it will be established and that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty, the God over Israel, is Israel’s God!’ And the house of your servant David will be established before you.
chapters.nkjv: So let it be established, that Your name may be magnified forever, saying, ‘The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, is Israel’s God.’ And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.
chapters.kjv: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദൈവമേ, അടിയന്നു നീ ഒരു ഗൃഹം പണിയുമെന്നു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിത്തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അടിയൻ തിരുസന്നിധിയിൽ പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പാൻ ധൈര്യംപ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. So your servant has found courage to pray to you.
chapters.nkjv: For You, O my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house. Therefore Your servant has found it inhisheart to pray before You.
chapters.kjv: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യഹോവേ, നീ തന്നേ ദൈവം; അടിയന്നു ഈ നന്മയെ നീ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്തുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You, Lord , are God! You have promised these good things to your servant.
chapters.nkjv: And now, Lord, You are God, and have promised this goodness to Your servant.
chapters.kjv: And now, LORD , thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അടിയന്റെ ഗൃഹം തിരുമുമ്പാകെ എന്നേക്കും ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിനെ അനുഗ്രഹിപ്പാൻ നിനക്കു പ്രസാദം തോന്നിയിരിക്കുന്നു; യഹോവേ, നീ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു എന്നേക്കും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടും ഇരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Now you have been pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Lord , have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever."
chapters.nkjv: Now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue before You forever; for You have blessed it, O Lord, and itshallbe blessed forever."
chapters.kjv: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD , and it shall be blessed for ever.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെശേഷം ദാവീദ് ഫെലിസ്ത്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചു അടക്കി, ഗത്തും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its surrounding villages from the control of the Philistines.
chapters.nkjv: After this it came to pass that David attacked the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its towns from the hand of the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ മോവാബിനെ തോല്പിച്ചു; മോവാബ്യർ ദാവീദിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരായി കാഴ്ചകൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to him and brought him tribute.
chapters.nkjv: Then he defeated Moab, and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought tribute.
chapters.kjv: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

chapters.ml: സോബാരാജാവായ ഹദദേസെർ ഫ്രാത്ത് നദീതീരത്തിങ്കൽ തന്റെ ആധിപത്യം ഉറപ്പിപ്പാൻ പോയപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് അവനെയും ഹമാത്തിൽവെച്ചു തോല്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, in the vicinity of Hamath, when he went to set up his monument at the Euphrates River.
chapters.nkjv: And David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah asfaras Hamath, as he went to establish his power by the River Euphrates.
chapters.kjv: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വക ആയിരം രഥങ്ങളെയും ഏഴായിരം കുതിരപ്പടയാളികളെയും ഇരുപതിനായിരം കാലാളുകളെയും ദാവീദ് പിടിച്ചു; ദാവീദ് അവയിൽ നൂറു രഥകൂതിരകളെ വെച്ചുകൊണ്ടുശേഷം രഥകൂതിരകളെ ഒക്കെയും കുതിഞരമ്പു വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.
chapters.nkjv: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Also David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except that he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.
chapters.kjv: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

chapters.ml: സോബാരാജാവായ ഹദദേസെരിനെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ ദമ്മേശെക്കിലെ അരാമ്യർ വന്നപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ് അരാമ്യരിൽ ഇരുപതിനായിരം പേരെ നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.
chapters.nkjv: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand of the Syrians.
chapters.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദാവീദ് ദമ്മേശെക്കിനോടു ചേർന്ന അരാമിൽ കാവല്പട്ടാളങ്ങളെ പാർപ്പിച്ചു; അരാമ്യരും ദാവീദിന്നു ദാസന്മാരായി കാഴ്ചകൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ചെന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും യഹോവ അവന്നു ജയം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought him tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
chapters.nkjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought tribute. So the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
chapters.kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

chapters.ml: ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർക്കുണ്ടായിരുന്ന പൊൻപരിചകളെ ദാവീദ് എടുത്തു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: David took the gold shields carried by the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളായ തിബ്ഹാത്തിൽനിന്നും കൂനിൽനിന്നും അനവധി താമ്രവും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ശലോമോൻ താമ്രക്കടലും സ്തംഭങ്ങളും താമ്രപാത്രങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: From Tebah and Kun, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, David took a great quantity of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze Sea, the pillars and various bronze articles.
chapters.nkjv: Also from Tibhath and from Chun, cities of Hadadezer, David brought a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and the articles of bronze.
chapters.kjv: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് സോബാരാജാവായ ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ സൈന്യത്തെയെല്ലാം തോല്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു ഹമാത്ത്‌രാജാവായ തോവൂ കേട്ടപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
chapters.nkjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
chapters.kjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവിനോടു കുശലും ചോദിപ്പാനും അവൻ ഹദദേസെരിനോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു അവനെ തോല്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ അഭിനന്ദിപ്പാനും തന്റെ മകനായ ഹദോരാമിനെ അയച്ചു; ഹദദേസരും തോവൂവും തമ്മിൽ കൂടക്കൂടെ യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി താമ്രം ഇവകൊണ്ടുള്ള സകലവിധസാധനങ്ങളെയും കൊണ്ടു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold, of silver and of bronze.
chapters.nkjv: he sent Hadoram his son to King David, to greet him and bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him (for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou); and Hadorambroughtwithhim all kinds of articles of gold, silver, and bronze.
chapters.kjv: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു അവയെ താൻ ഏദോം, മോവാബ്, അമ്മോന്യർ, ഫെലിസ്ത്യർ, അമാലേക്ക് മുതലായ സകലജാതികളുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നും പിടിച്ചെടുത്ത വെള്ളിയോടും പൊന്നിനോടുംകൂടെ യഹോവെക്കു വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek.
chapters.nkjv: King David also dedicated these to the Lord, along with the silver and gold that he had brought from all these nations—from Edom, from Moab, from the people of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
chapters.kjv: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

chapters.ml: സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ അബീശായി ഉപ്പുതാഴ്വരയിൽവെച്ചു എദോമ്യരിൽ പതിനെണ്ണായിരംപേരെ സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
chapters.kjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് എദോമിൽ കാവല്പട്ടാളങ്ങളെ ആക്കി; എദോമ്യർ എല്ലാവരും അവന്നു ദാസന്മാർ ആയ്തീർന്നു. അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ചെന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും യഹോവ അവന്നു ജയം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: He put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
chapters.nkjv: He also put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became David’s servants. And the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
chapters.kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും രാജാവായി വാണു; തന്റെ സകലജനത്തിന്നും നീതിയും ന്യായവും നടത്തിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.
chapters.nkjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and administered judgment and justice to all his people.
chapters.kjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

chapters.ml: സെരൂയയുടെ മകനായ യോവാബ് സേനാധിപതി ആയിരുന്നു; അഹീലൂദിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോശാഫാത്ത് മന്ത്രിയും
chapters.niv: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
chapters.nkjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
chapters.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

chapters.ml: അഹീത്തൂബിന്റെ മകനായ സാദോക്കും അബ്യാഥാരിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമേലെക്കും പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശവ്ശാ രായസക്കാരനും
chapters.niv: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;
chapters.nkjv: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests; Shavsha was the scribe;
chapters.kjv: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകനായ ബെനായാവു ക്രേത്യർക്കും പ്ളേത്യർക്കും അധിപതിയും ആയിരുന്നു; ദാവീദിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പ്രധാനപരിചാരകന്മാരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.
chapters.nkjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers at the king’s side.
chapters.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവായ നാഹാശ് മരിച്ചു; അവന്റെ മകൻ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the course of time, Nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: It happened after this that Nahash the king of the people of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദാവീദ്: നാഹാശ് എനിക്കു ദയ കാണിച്ചതു കൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ മകനായ ഹാനൂന്നു ഞാനും ദയ കാണിക്കും എന്നു പറ്ഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവന്റെ അപ്പനെക്കുറിച്ചു അവനോടു ആശ്വാസവാക്കു പറവാൻ ദാവീദ് ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു. ദാവീദിന്റെ ദൂതന്മാർ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ ദേശത്തു ഹാനൂന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അവനെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാൻ വന്നപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s envoys came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to express sympathy to him,
chapters.nkjv: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David’s servants came to Hanun in the land of the people of Ammon to comfort him.
chapters.kjv: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ഹാനൂനോടു: ദാവീദ് നിന്റെ അപ്പനെ ബഹുമാനിച്ചിട്ടാകുന്നു നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കുന്നവരെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു നിനക്കു തോന്നുന്നുവോ? ദേശത്തെ പരിശോധിപ്പാനും മുടിപ്പാനും ഒറ്റുനോക്കുവാനും അല്ലയോ അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Haven’t his envoys come to you only to explore and spy out the country and overthrow it?"
chapters.nkjv: And the princes of the people of Ammon said to Hanun, "Do you think that David really honors your father because he has sent comforters to you? Did his servants not come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?"
chapters.kjv: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഹാനൂൻ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്യിച്ചു അവരുടെ അങ്കികളെ നടുവിൽ ആസനംവരെ മുറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു വിട്ടയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved them, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, at their buttocks, and sent them away.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

chapters.ml: ചിലർ ചെന്നു ആ പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ വസ്തുത ദാവീദിനെ അറിയിച്ചു; അവർ ഏറ്റവും ലജ്ജിച്ചിരിക്കയാൽ അവൻ അവരെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ആളയച്ചു; നിങ്ങളുടെ താടി വളരുന്നതുവരെ യെരീഹോവിൽ പാർത്തിട്ടു മടങ്ങിവരുവിൻ എന്നു രാജാവു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When someone came and told David about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."
chapters.nkjv: Then some went and told David about the men; and he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, "Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."
chapters.kjv: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾ ദാവീദിന്നു വെറുപ്പായി എന്നു അമ്മോന്യർ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ഹാനൂനും അമ്മോന്യരും മെസൊപൊതാമ്യയിൽനിന്നും മയഖയോടു ചേർന്ന അരാമിൽനിന്നും സോബയിൽനിന്നും രഥങ്ങളെയും കുതിരപ്പടയാളികളെയും ആയിരം താലന്ത് വെള്ളി കൊടുത്തു കൂലിക്കു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram Naharaim, Aram Maakah and Zobah.
chapters.nkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that they had made themselves repulsive to David, Hanun and the people of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Syrian Maacah, and from Zobah.
chapters.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.

chapters.ml: അവർ മുപ്പത്തീരായിരം രഥങ്ങളെയും മയഖാരാജാവിനെയും അവന്റെ പടജ്ജനത്തെയും കൂലിക്കു വാങ്ങി; അവർ വന്നു മെദേബെക്കു മുമ്പിൽ പാളയമിറങ്ങി; അമ്മോന്യരും അവരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു വന്നുകൂടി പടെക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots and charioteers, as well as the king of Maakah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba, while the Ammonites were mustered from their towns and moved out for battle.
chapters.nkjv: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, with the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped before Medeba. Also the people of Ammon gathered together from their cities, and came to battle.
chapters.kjv: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ യോവാബിനെയും വീരന്മാരുടെ സകലസൈന്യത്തെയും അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
chapters.nkjv: Now when David heard ofit, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
chapters.kjv: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ പടെക്കു അണിനിരന്നു; വന്ന രാജാക്കന്മാരോ തനിച്ചു വെളിൻ പ്രദേശത്തായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance to their city, while the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.
chapters.nkjv: Then the people of Ammon came out and put themselves in battle array before the gate of the city, and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ മുമ്പിലും പിമ്പിലും പട നിരന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യോവാബ് എല്ലായിസ്രായേൽവീരന്മാരിൽനിന്നും ആളുകളെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു അരാമ്യർക്കെതിരെ അണിനിരത്തി.
chapters.niv: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.
chapters.nkjv: When Joab saw that the battle line was against him before and behind, he chose some of Israel’s best and put them in battle array against the Syrians.
chapters.kjv: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

chapters.ml: ശേഷം പടജ്ജനത്തെ അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബീശായിയെ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അമ്മോന്യർക്കെതിരെ അണിനിരന്നു.
chapters.niv: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother, and they were deployed against the Ammonites.
chapters.nkjv: And the rest of the people he put under the command of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in battle array against the people of Ammon.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ: അരാമ്യർ എന്റെ നേരെ പ്രാബല്യം പ്രാപിച്ചാൽ നീ എനിക്കു സഹായം ചെയ്യേണം; അമ്മോന്യർ നിന്റെ നേരെ പ്രാബല്യം പ്രാപിച്ചാൽ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു സഹായം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to rescue me; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will rescue you.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the people of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
chapters.kjv: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

chapters.ml: ധൈര്യമായിരിക്ക; നാം നമ്മുടെ ജനത്തിന്നും നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങൾക്കും വേണ്ടി പുരുഷത്വം കാണിക്കുക; യഹോവയോ തനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടമായതു ചെയ്യുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."
chapters.nkjv: Be of good courage, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the Lord do whatis good in His sight."
chapters.kjv: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യോവാബും കൂടെയുള്ള ജനവും അരാമ്യരോടു പടെക്കു അടുത്തു; അവർ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി.
chapters.niv: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.
chapters.nkjv: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near for the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
chapters.kjv: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

chapters.ml: അരാമ്യർ ഓടിപ്പോയി എന്നു കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അമ്മോന്യരും അതുപോലെ അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അബീശായിയുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി, പട്ടണത്തിൽ കടന്നു; യോവാബ് യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they too fled before his brother Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fleeing, they also fled before Abishai his brother, and entered the city. So Joab went to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു തോറ്റുപോയി എന്നു അരാമ്യർ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു നദിക്കു അക്കരെയുള്ള അരാമ്യരെ വരുത്തി; ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ സേനാപതിയായ ശോഫക്ക് അവരുടെ നായകനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they sent messengers and had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River, with Shophak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought the Syrians who were beyond the River, and Shophach the commander of Hadadezer’s army went before them.
chapters.kjv: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

chapters.ml: അതു ദാവീദിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും കൂട്ടി യോർദ്ദാൻ കടന്നു അവർക്കെതിരെ ചെന്നു അവരുടെ നേരെ അണിനിരത്തി. ദാവീദ് അരാമ്യർക്കു നേരെ പടെക്കു അണിനിരത്തിയ ശേഷം അവർ അവനോടു പടയേറ്റു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan; he advanced against them and formed his battle lines opposite them. David formed his lines to meet the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.
chapters.nkjv: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel, crossed over the Jordan and came upon them, and set up in battle array against them. So when David had set up in battle array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
chapters.kjv: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അരാമ്യർ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി; ദാവീദ് അരാമ്യരിൽ ഏഴായിരം തേരാളികളെയും നാല്പതിനായിരം കാലാളുകളെയും നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു; സേനാപതിയായ ശോഫക്കിനെയും കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also killed Shophak the commander of their army.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers of the Syrians, and killed Shophach the commander of the army.
chapters.kjv: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

chapters.ml: ഹദദേസെരിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർ തങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു തോറ്റുപോയെന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു ദാവീദിനോടു സന്ധിചെയ്തു അവന്നു കീഴടങ്ങി; അമ്മോന്യരെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ അരാമ്യർ പിന്നെ തുനിഞ്ഞതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: When the vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the Ammonites anymore.
chapters.nkjv: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became his servants. So the Syrians were not willing to help the people of Ammon anymore.
chapters.kjv: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെയാണ്ടില്‍ രാജാക്കന്മാര്‍ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുന്ന കാലത്തു യോവാബ് സൈന്യബലത്തോടെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അമ്മോന്യരുടെ ദേശത്തെ ശൂന്യമാക്കീട്ടു ചെന്നു രബ്ബയെ വളഞ്ഞു. ദാവീദോ യെരൂശലേമില്‍ തന്നേ താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു. യോവാബ് രബ്ബയെ പിടിച്ചു നശിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, Joab led out the armed forces. He laid waste the land of the Ammonites and went to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and left it in ruins.
chapters.nkjv: It happened in the spring of the year, at the time kings go out tobattle, that Joab led out the armed forces and ravaged the country of the people of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. And Joab defeated Rabbah and overthrew it.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle , Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അവരുടെ രാജാവിന്റെ കിരീടം അവന്റെ തലയില്‍നിന്നു എടുത്തു; അതിന്റെ തൂക്കം ഒരു താലന്തു പൊന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടു; അതില്‍ രത്നങ്ങളും പതിച്ചിരുന്നു; അതു ദാവീദിന്റെ തലയില്‍ വെച്ചു; അവന്‍ ആ പട്ടണത്തില്‍ നിന്നു അനവധി കൊള്ളയും കൊണ്ടുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: David took the crown from the head of their king —its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones—and it was placed on David’s head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city
chapters.nkjv: Then David took their king’s crown from his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and therewere precious stones in it. And it was set on David’s head. Also he brought out the spoil of the city in great abundance.
chapters.kjv: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

chapters.ml: അവന്‍ അതിലെ ജനത്തെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ഈര്‍ച്ചവാളിന്നും മെതിവണ്ടിക്കും കോടാലിക്കും ആക്കി; ഇങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് അമ്മോന്യരുടെ എല്ലാപട്ടണങ്ങളോടും ചെയ്തു. പിന്നെ ദാവീദും സകലജനവും യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then David and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And he brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. So David did to all the cities of the people of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെശേഷം ഗേസെരില്‍വെച്ചു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായി; ആ സമയത്തു ഹൂശാത്യനായ സിബ്ബെഖായി മല്ലന്മാരുടെ മക്കളില്‍ ഒരുത്തനായ സിപ്പായിയെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു; പിന്നെ അവര്‍ കീഴടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: In the course of time, war broke out with the Philistines, at Gezer. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaites, and the Philistines were subjugated.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened afterward that war broke out at Gezer with the Philistines, at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Sippai, whowasone of the sons of the giant. And they were subdued.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായപ്പോള്‍ യായീരിന്റെ മകനായ എല്‍ഹാനാന്‍ ഗിത്യനായ ഗൊല്യാഥിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ലഹ്മിയെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു. അവന്റെ കുന്തത്തണ്ടു നെയ്ത്തുകാരന്റെ പടപ്പുതടിപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.
chapters.nkjv: Again there was war with the Philistines, and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
chapters.kjv: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver’s beam.

chapters.ml: വീണ്ടും ഗത്തില്‍വെച്ചു യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായി; അവിടെ ദീര്‍ഘകായനായ ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്‍ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു ഔരോ കൈകൂ ആറാറുവിരലും ഔരോ കാലിന്നു ആറാറു വിരലും ആകെ ഇരുപത്തിനാലു വിരല്‍ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവനും രാഫെക്കു ജനിച്ചവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.
chapters.nkjv: Yet again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, with twenty-four fingers and toes, six oneachhand and six oneachfoot; and he also was born to the giant.
chapters.kjv: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand , and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

chapters.ml: അവന്‍ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ധിക്കരിച്ചപ്പോള്‍ ദാവീദിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ശിമെയയുടെ മകനായ യോനാഥാന്‍ അവനെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
chapters.nkjv: So when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
chapters.kjv: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.

chapters.ml: ഇവര്‍ ഗത്തില്‍ രാഫെക്കു ജനിച്ചവര്‍ ആയിരുന്നു; അവര്‍ ദാവീദിന്റെയും അവന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെയും കയ്യാല്‍ പട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: These were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.
chapters.nkjv: These were born to the giant in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
chapters.kjv: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സാത്താന്‍ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വിരോധമായി എഴുന്നേറ്റു യിസ്രായേലിനെ എണ്ണുവാന്‍ ദാവീദിന്നു തോന്നിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യോവാബീനോടും ജനത്തിന്റെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരോടുംനിങ്ങള്‍ ചെന്നു ബേര്‍-ശേബമുതല്‍ ദാന്‍ വരെ യിസ്രായേലിനെ എണ്ണി അവരുടെ സംഖ്യ ഞാന്‍ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവരുവിന്‍ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, "Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan. Then report back to me so that I may know how many there are."
chapters.nkjv: So David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people, "Go, number Israel from Beersheba to Dan, and bring the number of them to me that I may know it."
chapters.kjv: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it .

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോവാബ്യഹോവ തന്റെ ജനത്തെ ഉള്ളതില്‍ നൂറിരട്ടിയായി വര്‍ദ്ധിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ; എങ്കിലും എന്റെ യജമാനനായ രാജാവേ, അവര്‍ ഒക്കെയും യജമാനന്റെ ദാസന്മാരല്ലയോ? യജമാനന്‍ ഈ കാര്യം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? യിസ്രായേലിന്നു കുറ്റത്തിന്റെ കാരണമായി തീരുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Joab replied, "May the Lord multiply his troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all my lord’s subjects? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?"
chapters.nkjv: And Joab answered, "May the Lord make His people a hundred times more than they are. But, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? Why then does my lord require this thing? Why should he be a cause of guilt in Israel?"
chapters.kjv: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

chapters.ml: എന്നാല്‍ യോവാബ് രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പന അനുസരിക്കേണ്ടിവന്നു. അതുകൊണ്ടു യോവാബ് പുറപ്പെട്ടു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിലുംകൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab; so Joab left and went throughout Israel and then came back to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel and came to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: യോവാബ് ജനത്തെ എണ്ണിയ സംഖ്യ ദാവീദിന്നു കൊടുത്തുയിസ്രായേലില്‍ ആയുധപാണികള്‍ എല്ലാംകൂടി പതിനൊന്നുലക്ഷംപേര്‍. യെഹൂദയില്‍ ആയുധപാണികള്‍ നാലുലക്ഷത്തെഴുപതിനായിരം പേര്‍.
chapters.niv: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who could handle a sword, including four hundred and seventy thousand in Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to David. All Israel had one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and Judah had four hundred and seventy thousand men who drew the sword.
chapters.kjv: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

chapters.ml: എന്നാല്‍ രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പന യോവാബിന്നു വെറുപ്പായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്‍ ലേവിയെയും ബെന്യാമീനെയും അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തില്‍ എണ്ണിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, because the king’s command was repulsive to him.
chapters.nkjv: But he did not count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
chapters.kjv: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്നു ഈ കാര്യം അനിഷ്ടമായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്‍ യിസ്രായേലിനെ ബാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so he punished Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore He struck Israel.
chapters.kjv: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel. concerning this thing

chapters.ml: അപ്പോള്‍ ദാവീദ് ദൈവത്തോടുഈ കാര്യം ചെയ്തതിനാല്‍ ഞാന്‍ മഹാപാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നുഎന്നാല്‍ അടിയന്റെ അകൃത്യം ക്ഷമിക്കേണമേഞാന്‍ വലിയ ഭോഷത്വം ചെയ്തുപോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by doing this. Now, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."
chapters.nkjv: So David said to God, "I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing; but now, I pray, take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have done very foolishly."
chapters.kjv: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദാവീദിന്റെ ദര്‍ശകനായ ഗാദിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതെന്തെന്നാല്‍
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Gad, David’s seer,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,

chapters.ml: നീ ചെന്നു ദാവീദിനോടുഞാന്‍ മൂന്നു കാര്യം നിന്റെ മുമ്പില്‍ വെക്കുന്നു; അവയില്‍ ഒന്നു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തുകൊള്‍ക; അതു ഞാന്‍ നിന്നോടു ചെയ്യും എന്നു യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറക.
chapters.niv: "Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "Go and tell David, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "I offer you three things; choose one of them for yourself, that I may do it to you." ’ "
chapters.kjv: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD , I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഗാദ് ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കല്‍ ചെന്നു അവനോടുയഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു
chapters.niv: So Gad went to David and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Take your choice:
chapters.nkjv: So Gad came to David and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Choose for yourself,
chapters.kjv: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Choose thee

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു സംവത്സരത്തെ ക്ഷാമമോ, നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ വാള്‍ നിന്നെ തുടര്‍ന്നെത്തി നീ മൂന്നു മാസം നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളാല്‍ നശിക്കയോ, ദേശത്തു മൂന്നു ദിവസം യഹോവയുടെ വാളായ മാഹാമാരി ഉണ്ടായി യിസ്രായേല്‍ദേശത്തൊക്കെയും യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതന്‍ സംഹാരം ചെയ്കയോ ഇവയില്‍ ഒന്നു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തുകൊള്‍ക. എന്നെ അയച്ചവനോടു ഞാന്‍ എന്തൊരു മറുപടി പറയേണ്ടു എന്നു ആലോചിച്ചുനോക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies, with their swords overtaking you, or three days of the sword of the Lord —days of plague in the land, with the angel of the Lord ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should answer the one who sent me."
chapters.nkjv: either three years of famine, or three months to be defeated by your foes with the sword of your enemies overtaking you, or else for three days the sword of the Lord—the plague in the land, with the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the territory of Israel.’ Now consider what answer I should take back to Him who sent me."
chapters.kjv: Either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD , even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഗാദിനോടുഞാന്‍ വലിയ വിഷമത്തിലായിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാന്‍ ഇപ്പോള്‍ യഹോവയുടെ കയ്യില്‍ തന്നേ വീഴട്ടെ; അവന്റെ കരുണ ഏറ്റവും വലിയതല്ലോ; മനുഷ്യന്റെ കയ്യില്‍ ഞാന്‍ വീഴരുതേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let me fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is very great; but do not let me fall into human hands."
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Please let me fall into the hand of the Lord, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hand of man."
chapters.kjv: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD ; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യഹോവ ഇസ്രായേലില്‍ മഹാമാരി അയച്ചു; യിസ്രായേലില്‍ എഴുപതിനായിരംപേര്‍ വീണുപോയി.
chapters.niv: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
chapters.kjv: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം യെരൂശലേമിനെ നശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഒരു ദൂതനെ അവിടെ അയച്ചു; അവന്‍ നശിപ്പിപ്പാന്‍ ഭാവിക്കുമ്പോള്‍ യഹോവ കണ്ടു ആ അനര്‍ത്ഥത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അനുതപിച്ചു നാശകദൂതനോടുമതി, നിന്റെ കൈ പിന്‍ വലിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു, യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതന്‍ യെബൂസ്യനായ ഒര്‍ന്നാന്റെ കളത്തിന്നരികെ നില്‍ക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But as the angel was doing so, the Lord saw it and relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the Lord was then standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
chapters.nkjv: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was destroying, the Lord looked and relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who was destroying, "It is enough; now restrain your hand." And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
chapters.kjv: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തല പൊക്കി, യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതന്‍ വാള്‍ ഊരി യെരൂശലേമിന്നു മീതെ നീട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടും ഭൂമിക്കും ആകാശത്തിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ നിലക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു ദാവീദും മൂപ്പന്മാരും രട്ടുടുത്തു സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു.
chapters.niv: David looked up and saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand extended over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
chapters.nkjv: Then David lifted his eyes and saw the angel of the Lord standing between earth and heaven, having in his hand a drawn sword stretched out over Jerusalem. So David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
chapters.kjv: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ദൈവത്തോടുജനത്തെ എണ്ണുവാന്‍ പറഞ്ഞവന്‍ ഞാനല്ലയോ? ദോഷം ചെയ്ത പാപി ഞാന്‍ ആകുന്നു; ഈ ആടുകള്‍ എന്തു ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു? യഹോവേ, എന്റെ ദൈവമേ, നിന്റെ കൈ ബാധക്കായിട്ടു നിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്മേല്‍ അല്ല, എന്റെമേലും എന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്മേലും ഇരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David said to God, "Was it not I who ordered the fighting men to be counted? I, the shepherd, have sinned and done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Lord my God, let your hand fall on me and my family, but do not let this plague remain on your people."
chapters.nkjv: And David said to God, "Was it not I who commanded the people to be numbered? I am the one who has sinned and done evil indeed; but these sheep, what have they done? Let Your hand, I pray, O Lord my God, be against me and my father’s house, but not against Your people that they should be plagued."
chapters.kjv: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോള്‍ യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതന്‍ ഗാദിനോടു ദാവീദ് ചെന്നു യെബൂസ്യനായ ഒര്‍ന്നാന്റെ കളത്തില്‍ യഹോവേക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിയേണമെന്നു ദാവീദിനോടു പറവാന്‍ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the angel of the Lord ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David that David should go and erect an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
chapters.kjv: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തില്‍ ഗാദ് പറഞ്ഞ വചനപ്രകാരം ദാവീദ് ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So David went up in obedience to the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: So David went up at the word of Gad, which he had spoken in the name of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഒര്‍ന്നാന്‍ തിരിഞ്ഞു ദൂതനെ കണ്ടു തന്റെ നാലു പുത്രന്മാരുമായി ഒളിച്ചു. ഒര്‍ന്നാന്‍ കോതമ്പു മെതിച്ചു കൊണ്ടിരിക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: While Araunah was threshing wheat, he turned and saw the angel; his four sons who were with him hid themselves.
chapters.nkjv: Now Ornan turned and saw the angel; and his four sons whowere with him hid themselves, but Ornan continued threshing wheat.
chapters.kjv: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഒര്‍ന്നാന്റെ അടുക്കല്‍ വന്നപ്പോള്‍ ഒര്‍ന്നാന്‍ നോക്കി ദാവീദിനെ കണ്ടു കളത്തില്‍നിന്നു പുറത്തുചെന്നു ദാവീദിന്റെ മുമ്പില്‍ സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then David approached, and when Araunah looked and saw him, he left the threshing floor and bowed down before David with his face to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: So David came to Ornan, and Ornan looked and saw David. And he went out from the threshing floor, and bowed before David with his face to the ground.
chapters.kjv: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഒര്‍ന്നാനോടുഈ കളത്തിന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തു ഞാന്‍ യഹോവേക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠം പണിയേണ്ടതിന്നു അതു എനിക്കു തരേണം; ബാധ ജനത്തെ വിട്ടുമാറേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ അതു മുഴുവിലെക്കു എനിക്കു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: David said to him, "Let me have the site of your threshing floor so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped. Sell it to me at the full price."
chapters.nkjv: Then David said to Ornan, "Grant me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar on it to the Lord. You shall grant it to me at the full price, that the plague may be withdrawn from the people."
chapters.kjv: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD : thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഒര്‍ന്നാന്‍ ദാവീദിനോടുഅതു എടുത്തുകൊള്‍ക; യജമാനനായ രാജാവിന്റെ പ്രസാദംപോലെ ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടാലും; ഇതാ ഞാന്‍ ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നു കാളകളെയും വിറകിന്നു മെതിവണ്ടികളെയും ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നു കോതമ്പിനെയും തരുന്നു; എല്ലാം ഞാന്‍ തരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Araunah said to David, "Take it! Let my lord the king do whatever pleases him. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give all this."
chapters.nkjv: But Ornan said to David, "Take it to yourself, and let my lord the king do whatis good in his eyes. Look, I also give you the oxen for burnt offerings, the threshing implements for wood, and the wheat for the grain offering; I give it all."
chapters.kjv: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് രാജാവു ഒര്‍ന്നാനോടുഅങ്ങനെ അല്ല; ഞാന്‍ മുഴുവിലെക്കേ അതു വാങ്ങുകയുള്ളു; നിനക്കുള്ളതു ഞാന്‍ യഹോവെക്കായിട്ടു എടുക്കയില്ല; ചെലവുകൂടാതെ ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കയും ഇല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But King David replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying the full price. I will not take for the Lord what is yours, or sacrifice a burnt offering that costs me nothing."
chapters.nkjv: Then King David said to Ornan, "No, but I will surely buy it for the full price, for I will not take what is yours for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings with thatwhich costs me nothing."
chapters.kjv: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD , nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് ആ സ്ഥലത്തിന്നു അറുനൂറു ശേക്കെല്‍ പൊന്നു ഒര്‍ന്നാന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So David paid Araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.
chapters.nkjv: So David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
chapters.kjv: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അവിടെ യഹോവേക്കു ഒരു യാഗപീഠംപണിതു ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളും കഴിച്ചു യഹോവയോടു പ്രാര്‍ത്ഥിച്ചു; അവന്‍ ആകാശത്തില്‍നിന്നു ഹോമപീഠത്തിന്മേല്‍ തീ ഇറക്കി അവന്നു ഉത്തരം അരുളി.
chapters.niv: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He called on the Lord , and the Lord answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
chapters.nkjv: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the Lord; and He answered him from heaven by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And David built there an altar unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ദൂതനോടു കല്പിച്ചു; അവന്‍ തന്റെ വാള്‍ വീണ്ടും ഉറയില്‍ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord commanded the angel, and he returned his sword to its sheath.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യെബൂസ്യനായ ഒര്‍ന്നാന്റെ കളത്തില്‍വെച്ചു യഹോവ തന്റെ പ്രാര്‍ത്ഥനെക്കു ഉത്തരമരുളി എന്നു ദാവീദ് കണ്ടിട്ടു അവിടെ യാഗം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
chapters.nkjv: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.
chapters.kjv: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

chapters.ml: മോശെ മരുഭൂമിയില്‍ വെച്ചു ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്ന യഹോവയുടെ തിരുനിവാസവും ഹോമപീഠവും അന്നു ഗിബെയോനിലെ പൂജാഗിരിയില്‍ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time on the high place at Gibeon.
chapters.nkjv: For the tabernacle of the Lord and the altar of the burnt offering, which Moses had made in the wilderness, were at that time at the high place in Gibeon.
chapters.kjv: For the tabernacle of the LORD , which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദൂതന്റെ വാളിനെ പേടിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവത്തോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവിടെ ചെല്ലുവാന്‍ ദാവീദിന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഇതു യഹോവയായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയം; ഇതു യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഹോമപീഠം എന്നു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then David said, "The house of the Lord God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
chapters.nkjv: Then David said, "This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
chapters.kjv: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ദാവീദ് യിസ്രായേൽദേശത്തിലെ അന്യജാതിക്കാരെ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയം പണിവാൻ ചതുരക്കല്ലു ചെത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ കല്പണിക്കാരെ നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So David gave orders to assemble the foreigners residing in Israel, and from among them he appointed stonecutters to prepare dressed stone for building the house of God.
chapters.nkjv: So David commanded to gather the aliens who were in the land of Israel; and he appointed masons to cut hewn stones to build the house of God.
chapters.kjv: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് പടിവാതിൽകതകുകളുടെ ആണികൾക്കായിട്ടും കൊളുത്തുകൾക്കായിട്ടും വളരെ ഇരിമ്പും തൂക്കമില്ലാതെ വളരെ താമ്രവും അനവധി ദേവദാരുവും ഒരുക്കി വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He provided a large amount of iron to make nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, and more bronze than could be weighed.
chapters.nkjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails of the doors of the gates and for the joints, and bronze in abundance beyond measure,
chapters.kjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

chapters.ml: സീദോന്യരും സോർയ്യരും അനവധി ദേവദാരു ദാവീദിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു. എന്റെ മകൻ ശലോമോൻ ചെറുപ്പവും ഇളംപ്രായവുമുള്ളവൻ ആകുന്നു; യഹോവെക്കായി പണിയേണ്ടുന്ന ആലയമോ കീർത്തിയും ശോഭയുംകൊണ്ടു സർവ്വദേശങ്ങൾക്കും അതിമഹത്വമുള്ളതായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: He also provided more cedar logs than could be counted, for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought large numbers of them to David.
chapters.nkjv: and cedar trees in abundance; for the Sidonians and those from Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
chapters.kjv: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ അതിന്നു തക്കവണ്ണം വട്ടംകൂട്ടും എന്നു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ദാവീദ് തന്റെ മരണത്തിന്നു മുമ്പെ ധാരാളം വട്ടംകൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: David said, "My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the Lord should be of great magnificence and fame and splendor in the sight of all the nations. Therefore I will make preparations for it." So David made extensive preparations before his death.
chapters.nkjv: Now David said, "Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the Lordmustbe exceedingly magnificent, famous and glorious throughout all countries. I will now make preparation for it." So David made abundant preparations before his death.
chapters.kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോനെ വിളിച്ചു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു ഒരു ആലയം പണിവാൻ കല്പന കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him to build a house for the Lord , the God of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Then he called for his son Solomon, and charged him to build a house for the Lord God of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ശലോമോനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: മകനേ, ഞാൻ തന്നേ എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിവാൻ താല്പര്യപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: David said to Solomon: "My son, I had it in my heart to build a house for the Name of the Lord my God.
chapters.nkjv: And David said to Solomon: "My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build a house to the name of the Lord my God;
chapters.kjv: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
