chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും എനിക്കു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ: നീ വളരെ രക്തം ചിന്തി വലിയ യുദ്ധങ്ങളും ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടു; നീ എന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയരുതു; നീ എന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഭൂമിയിൽ ബഹു രക്തം ചിന്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But this word of the Lord came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and have fought many wars. You are not to build a house for my Name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
chapters.nkjv: but the word of the Lord came to me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have made great wars; you shall not build a house for My name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in My sight.
chapters.kjv: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിനക്കു ഒരു മകൻ ജനിക്കും; അവൻ വിശ്രമപുരുഷനായിരിക്കും; ഞാൻ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള അവന്റെ സകലശത്രുക്കളെയും നീക്കി അവന്നു വിശ്രമം കൊടുക്കും; അവന്റെ പേർ ശലോമോൻ എന്നു ആയിരിക്കും; അവന്റെ കാലത്തു ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു സമാധാനവും സ്വസ്ഥതയും നല്കും.
chapters.niv: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace and rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side. His name will be Solomon, and I will grant Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies all around. His name shall be Solomon, for I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
chapters.kjv: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിയും; അവൻ എനിക്കു മകനായും ഞാൻ അവന്നു അപ്പനായും ഇരിക്കും; യിസ്രായേലിൽ അവന്റെ രാജാസനം ഞാൻ എന്നേക്കും നിലനില്ക്കുമാറാക്കും.
chapters.niv: He is the one who will build a house for my Name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
chapters.nkjv: He shall build a house for My name, and he shall be My son, and I willbe his Father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
chapters.kjv: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ എന്റെ മകനേ, യഹോവ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ; നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ നീ കൃതാർത്ഥനായി അവന്റെ ആലയം പണിക.
chapters.niv: "Now, my son, the Lord be with you, and may you have success and build the house of the Lord your God, as he said you would.
chapters.nkjv: Now, my son, may the Lord be with you; and may you prosper, and build the house of the Lord your God, as He has said to you.
chapters.kjv: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം നീ ആചരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ നിനക്കു ജ്ഞാനവും വിവേകവും തന്നു നിന്നെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു നിയമിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May the Lord give you discretion and understanding when he puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.
chapters.nkjv: Only may the Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and give you charge concerning Israel, that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.
chapters.kjv: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വേണ്ടി മോശെയോടു കല്പിച്ച ചട്ടങ്ങളും വിധികളും നീ പ്രമാണിച്ചാചരിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നീ കൃതാർത്ഥനാകും; ധൈര്യപ്പെട്ടു ഉറെച്ചിരിക്ക; ഭയപ്പെടരുതു, ഭ്രമിക്കയും അരുതു.
chapters.niv: Then you will have success if you are careful to observe the decrees and laws that the Lord gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
chapters.nkjv: Then you will prosper, if you take care to fulfill the statutes and judgments with which the Lord charged Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and of good courage; do not fear nor be dismayed.
chapters.kjv: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ എന്റെ കഷ്ടത്തിൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്നായി ഒരു ലക്ഷം താലന്ത് പൊന്നും പത്തു ലക്ഷം താലന്ത് വെള്ളിയും പെരുപ്പം നിമിത്തം തൂക്കമില്ലാത്ത താമ്രവും ഇരിമ്പും സ്വരൂപിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു; മരവും കല്ലുംകൂടെ ഞാൻ ഒരുക്കിവെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നിനക്കു ഇനിയും അതിനോടു ചേർത്തുകൊള്ളാമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "I have taken great pains to provide for the temple of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, a million talents of silver, quantities of bronze and iron too great to be weighed, and wood and stone. And you may add to them.
chapters.nkjv: Indeed I have taken much trouble to prepare for the house of the Lord one hundred thousand talents of gold and one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond measure, for it is so abundant. I have prepared timber and stone also, and you may add to them.
chapters.kjv: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സ്വാധീനത്തിൽ കല്ലുവെട്ടുകാർ, കല്പണിക്കാർ, ആശാരികൾ എന്നിങ്ങനെ അനവധി പണിക്കാരും സകലവിധ കൌശലപ്പണിക്കാരും ഉണ്ടല്ലോ;
chapters.niv: You have many workers: stonecutters, masons and carpenters, as well as those skilled in every kind of work
chapters.nkjv: Moreover thereare workmen with you in abundance: woodsmen and stonecutters, and all types of skillful men for every kind of work.
chapters.kjv: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

chapters.ml: പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, താമ്രം, ഇരിമ്പു എന്നിവ ധാരാളം ഉണ്ടു; ഉത്സാഹിച്ചു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചുകൊൾക; യഹോവ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and the Lord be with you."
chapters.nkjv: Of gold and silver and bronze and iron thereis no limit. Arise and begin working, and the Lord be with you."
chapters.kjv: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore , and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകലപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരോടും തന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോനെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
chapters.kjv: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying ,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ നിങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; അവൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ചുറ്റും വിശ്രമം വരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു. അവൻ ദേശനിവാസികളെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു ദേശം യഹോവെക്കും അവന്റെ ജനത്തിന്നും കീഴടങ്ങിയുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Is not the Lord your God with you? And has he not granted you rest on every side? For he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hands, and the land is subject to the Lord and to his people.
chapters.nkjv: "Is not the Lord your God with you? And has He not given you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land is subdued before the Lord and before His people.
chapters.kjv: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD , and before his people.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ അന്വേഷിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയവും മനസ്സും ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പിൻ. എഴുന്നേല്പിൻ; യഹോവയുടെ നിയമപെട്ടകവും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വിശുദ്ധപാത്രങ്ങളും യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തിന്നു പണിവാനുള്ള ആലയത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവയായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തെ പണിവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Now devote your heart and soul to seeking the Lord your God. Begin to build the sanctuary of the Lord God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the sacred articles belonging to God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God. Therefore arise and build the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy articles of God into the house that is to be built for the name of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് വയോധികനും കാലസമ്പൂർണ്ണനും ആയപ്പോൾ തന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോനെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു രാജാവാക്കി.
chapters.niv: When David was old and full of years, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
chapters.kjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെയും പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും ലേവ്യരെയും എല്ലാം കൂട്ടി വരുത്തി,
chapters.niv: He also gathered together all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
chapters.nkjv: And he gathered together all the leaders of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
chapters.kjv: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരിൽ മുപ്പതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടുള്ളവരെ എണ്ണി; ആളെണ്ണം പേരുപേരായി അവർ മുപ്പത്തെണ്ണായിരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Levites thirty years old or more were counted, and the total number of men was thirty-eight thousand.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and above; and the number of individual males was thirty-eight thousand.
chapters.kjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരം പേർ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ വേല നടത്തേണ്ടുന്നവരും ആറായിരംപേർ പ്രമാണികളും
chapters.niv: David said, "Of these, twenty-four thousand are to be in charge of the work of the temple of the Lord and six thousand are to be officials and judges.
chapters.nkjv: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to look after the work of the house of the Lord, six thousand were officers and judges,
chapters.kjv: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD ; and six thousand were officers and judges:

chapters.ml: ന്യായാധിപന്മാരും നാലായിരം പേർ വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാരും നാലായിരംപേർ സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു ദാവീദ് ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ വാദ്യങ്ങളാൽ യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിക്കുന്നവരും ആയിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Four thousand are to be gatekeepers and four thousand are to praise the Lord with the musical instruments I have provided for that purpose."
chapters.nkjv: four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the Lord with musical instruments, "which I made," saidDavid, "for giving praise."
chapters.kjv: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David , to praise therewith .

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അവരെ ലേവിപുത്രന്മാരായ ഗേർശോൻ, കെഹാത്ത്, മെരാരി എന്നീ ക്രമപ്രകാരം കൂറുകളായി വിഭാഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David separated the Levites into divisions corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.nkjv: Also David separated them into divisions among the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.kjv: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely , Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

chapters.ml: ഗേർശോന്യർ: ലദ്ദാൻ, ശിമെയി.
chapters.niv: Belonging to the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
chapters.nkjv: Of the Gershonites: Laadan and Shimei.
chapters.kjv: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan, and Shimei.

chapters.ml: ലദ്ദാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: തലവനായ യെഹീയേൽ, സേഥാം, യോവേൽ ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നുപേർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham and Joel—three in all.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Laadan: the first Jehiel, then Zetham and Joel—three inall.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശെലോമീത്ത്, ഹസീയേൽ, ഹാരാൻ ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നുപേർ; ഇവർ ലദ്ദാന്റെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങൾക്കു തലവന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, Haziel, and Haran—three inall. These were the heads of the fathers’ houses of Laadan.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യഹത്ത്, സീനാ, യെയൂശ്, ബെരീയാം; ഈ നാലുപേർ ശിമെയിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the four sons of Shimei.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Shimei were , Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

chapters.ml: യഹത്ത് തലവനും സീനാ രണ്ടാമനും ആയിരുന്നു; യെയൂശിന്നും ബെരിയെക്കും അധികം പുത്രന്മാർ ഇല്ലാതിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ഏകപിതൃഭവനമായി എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jahath was the first and Ziza the second, but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; so they were counted as one family with one assignment.
chapters.nkjv: Jahath was the first and Zizah the second. But Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; therefore they were assigned as one father’s house.
chapters.kjv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.

chapters.ml: കെഹാത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അമ്രാം, യിസ്ഹാർ, ഹെബ്രോൻ, ഉസ്സീയേൽ ഇങ്ങനെ നാലുപേർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel—four in all.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four inall.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

chapters.ml: അമ്രാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: അഹരോൻ, മോശെ; അഹരോനും പുത്രന്മാരും അതിവിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളെ ശുദ്ധീകരിപ്പാനും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ധൂപംകാട്ടുവാനും അവന്നു ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്‍വാനും എപ്പോഴും അവന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ അനുഗ്രഹിപ്പാനും സദാകാലത്തേക്കും വേർതിരിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his descendants forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices before the Lord , to minister before him and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was set apart, he and his sons forever, that he should sanctify the most holy things, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister to Him, and to give the blessing in His name forever.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD , to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

chapters.ml: ദൈവപുരുഷനായ മോശെയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരെയോ ലേവിഗോത്രത്തിൽ എണ്ണിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Moses the man of God were counted as part of the tribe of Levi.
chapters.nkjv: Now the sons of Moses the man of God were reckoned to the tribe of Levi.
chapters.kjv: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഗേർശോം, എലീയേസെർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Moses were Gershon and Eliezer.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Moses were , Gershom, and Eliezer.

chapters.ml: ഗെർശോമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ശെബൂവേൽ തലവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Gershom: Shubael was the first.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Gershon, Shebuel was the first.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

chapters.ml: എലീയേസെരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: രെഹബ്യാവു തലവൻ; എലീയേസെരിന്നു വേറെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; എങ്കിലും രെഹബ്യാവിന്നു വളരെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
chapters.nkjv: Of the descendants of Eliezer, Rehabiah was the first. And Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ശെലോമീത്ത് തലവൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Izhar, Shelomith was the first.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ യെരീയാവു തലവനും അമർയ്യാവു രണ്ടാമനും യഹസീയേൽ മൂന്നാമനും, യെക്കമെയാം നാലാമനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ മീഖാ തലവനും യിശ്ശീയാവു രണ്ടാമനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first and Ishiah the second.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah was the first and Jesshiah the second.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ മഹ്ളി, മൂശി. മഹ്ളിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: എലെയാസാർ, കീശ്.
chapters.niv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Eleazar and Kish.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

chapters.ml: എലെയാസാർ മരിച്ചു; അവന്നു പുത്രിമാരല്ലാതെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; കീശിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാർ അവരെ വിവാഹംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Eleazar died without having sons: he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
chapters.nkjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but only daughters; and their brethren, the sons of Kish, took them aswives.
chapters.kjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

chapters.ml: മൂശിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മഹ്ളി, ഏദെർ, യെരേമോത്ത് ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth—three in all.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth—three inall.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായി ആളെണ്ണം പേരുപേരായി എണ്ണപ്പെട്ടപ്രകാരം തങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനങ്ങൾക്കു തലവന്മാരായ ലേവിപുത്രന്മാർ; അവർ ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷയിൽ വേല ചെയ്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families as they were registered under their names and counted individually, that is, the workers twenty years old or more who served in the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: These were the sons of Levi by their fathers’ houses—the heads of the fathers’ houses as they were counted individually by the number of their names, who did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and above.
chapters.kjv: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD , from the age of twenty years and upward.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ തന്റെ ജനത്തിന്നു സ്വസ്ഥത കൊടുത്തു യെരൂശലേമിൽ എന്നേക്കും വസിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For David had said, "Since the Lord , the God of Israel, has granted rest to his people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever,
chapters.nkjv: For David said, "The Lord God of Israel has given rest to His people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever";
chapters.kjv: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ലേവ്യർക്കു ഇനി തിരുനിവാസവും അതിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒന്നും ചുമപ്പാൻ ആവശ്യമില്ല എന്നു ദാവീദ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles used in its service."
chapters.nkjv: and also to the Levites, "They shall no longer carry the tabernacle, or any of the articles for its service."
chapters.kjv: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ അന്ത്യകല്പനകളാൽ ലേവ്യരെ ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു എണ്ണിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: According to the last instructions of David, the Levites were counted from those twenty years old or more.
chapters.nkjv: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above;
chapters.kjv: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ മുറയോ, യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കായി പ്രാകാരങ്ങളിലും അറകളിലും സകലവിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളെയും ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കുന്നതിലും ദൈവാലയത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷയുടെ വേലെക്കു അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ സഹായിക്കുന്നതും
chapters.niv: The duty of the Levites was to help Aaron’s descendants in the service of the temple of the Lord : to be in charge of the courtyards, the side rooms, the purification of all sacred things and the performance of other duties at the house of God.
chapters.nkjv: because their duty was to help the sons of Aaron in the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts and in the chambers, in the purifying of all holy things and the work of the service of the house of God,
chapters.kjv: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD , in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

chapters.ml: കാഴ്ചയപ്പവും പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത ദോശകളായും ചട്ടിയിൽ ചുടുന്നതായും കുതിർക്കുന്നതായും അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഭോജനയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള നേരിയമാവും സകലവിധ പരിമാണവും അളവും നോക്കുന്നതും
chapters.niv: They were in charge of the bread set out on the table, the special flour for the grain offerings, the thin loaves made without yeast, the baking and the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
chapters.nkjv: both with the showbread and the fine flour for the grain offering, with the unleavened cakes and whatisbakedin the pan, with what is mixed and with all kinds of measures and sizes;
chapters.kjv: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

chapters.ml: രാവിലെയും വൈകുന്നേരവും യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തി സ്തുതിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഒരുങ്ങിനില്ക്കുന്നതും
chapters.niv: They were also to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord . They were to do the same in the evening
chapters.nkjv: to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at evening;
chapters.kjv: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise at even;

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു ശബ്ബത്തുകളിലും അമാവാസ്യകളിലും ഉത്സവങ്ങളിലും യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിരന്തരം അവയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള നിയമത്തിന്നനുസരണയായ സംഖ്യപ്രകാരം ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളെ അർപ്പിക്കുന്നതും
chapters.niv: and whenever burnt offerings were presented to the Lord on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals. They were to serve before the Lord regularly in the proper number and in the way prescribed for them.
chapters.nkjv: and at every presentation of a burnt offering to the Lord on the Sabbaths and on the New Moons and on the set feasts, by number according to the ordinance governing them, regularly before the Lord;
chapters.kjv: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD :

chapters.ml: സമാഗമനക്കുടാരത്തിന്റെ കാര്യവും വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ കാര്യവും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷയിൽ അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കാര്യവും വിചാരിക്കുന്നതും തന്നെ.
chapters.niv: And so the Levites carried out their responsibilities for the tent of meeting, for the Holy Place and, under their relatives the descendants of Aaron, for the service of the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: and that they should attend to the needs of the tabernacle of meeting, the needs of the holy place, and the needs of the sons of Aaron their brethren in the work of the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കൂറുകളോ: അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: നാദാബ്, അബീഹൂ, എലെയാസാർ, ഈഥാമാർ.
chapters.niv: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron: The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.nkjv: Now theseare the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
chapters.kjv: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

chapters.ml: നാദാബും അബീഹൂവും അവരുടെ അപ്പന്നു മുമ്പെ മരിച്ചുപോയി; അവർക്കു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുമില്ല; അതുകൊണ്ടു എലെയാസാരും ഈഥാമാരും പൌരോഹിത്യം നടത്തി.
chapters.niv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.
chapters.nkjv: And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priests.
chapters.kjv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് എലെയാസാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ സാദോക്, ഈഥാമാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ അഹീമേലെക്ക്, എന്നിവരുമായി അവരെ അവരുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷയുടെ മുറപ്രകാരം വിഭാഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: With the help of Zadok a descendant of Eleazar and Ahimelek a descendant of Ithamar, David separated them into divisions for their appointed order of ministering.
chapters.nkjv: Then David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to the schedule of their service.
chapters.kjv: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

chapters.ml: ഈഥാമാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിലുള്ളതിനെക്കാൾ എലെയാസാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ അധികം തലവന്മാരെ കണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടു എലെയാസാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ പതിനാറു പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാരും ഈഥാമാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ എട്ടു പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാരുമായി വിഭാഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A larger number of leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than among Ithamar’s, and they were divided accordingly: sixteen heads of families from Eleazar’s descendants and eight heads of families from Ithamar’s descendants.
chapters.nkjv: There were more leaders found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar were sixteen heads of their fathers’ houses, and eight heads of their fathers’ houses among the sons of Ithamar.
chapters.kjv: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

chapters.ml: എലെയാസാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിലും ഈഥാമാരിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിലും വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ദൈവാലയത്തിന്റെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു അവരെ തരഭേദം കൂടാതെ ചീട്ടിട്ടു വിഭാഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They divided them impartially by casting lots, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of God among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.nkjv: Thus they were divided by lot, one group as another, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials ofthehouse of God, from the sons of Eleazar and from the sons of Ithamar.
chapters.kjv: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരിൽ നെഥനയേലിന്റെ മകനായ ശെമയ്യാശാസ്ത്രി രാജാവിന്നും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർക്കും പുരോഹിതനായ സാദോക്കിന്നും അബ്യാഥാരിന്റെ മകനായ അഹീമേലെക്കിന്നും പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെയും ലേവ്യരുടെയും പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാർക്കും മുമ്പാകെ ഒരു പിതൃഭവനം എലെയാസാരിന്നും മറ്റൊന്നു ഈഥാമാരിന്നുമായി ചീട്ടുവന്നതു എഴുതിവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officials: Zadok the priest, Ahimelek son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar and then one from Ithamar.
chapters.nkjv: And the scribe, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel, oneof the Levites, wrote them down before the king, the leaders, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and Levites, one father’s house taken for Eleazar and one for Ithamar.
chapters.kjv: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തെ ചീട്ട് യെഹോയാരീബിന്നും രണ്ടാമത്തേതു യെദായാവിന്നും
chapters.niv: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
chapters.nkjv: Now the first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
chapters.kjv: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമത്തേതു ഹാരീമിന്നും നാലാമത്തേതു ശെയോരീമിന്നും
chapters.niv: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
chapters.nkjv: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
chapters.kjv: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാമത്തേതു മൽക്കീയാവിന്നും ആറാമത്തേതു മീയാമിന്നും
chapters.niv: the fifth to Malkijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
chapters.nkjv: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
chapters.kjv: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

chapters.ml: ഏഴാമത്തേതു ഹാക്കോസിന്നും എട്ടാമത്തേതു അബീയാവിന്നും
chapters.niv: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
chapters.nkjv: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
chapters.kjv: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

chapters.ml: ഒമ്പതാമത്തേതു യേശൂവെക്കും പത്താമത്തേതു ശെഖന്യാവിന്നും
chapters.niv: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shekaniah,
chapters.nkjv: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
chapters.kjv: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

chapters.ml: പതിനൊന്നാമത്തേതു എല്യാശീബിന്നും പന്ത്രണ്ടാമത്തേതു യാക്കീമിന്നും
chapters.niv: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
chapters.nkjv: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
chapters.kjv: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

chapters.ml: പതിമ്മൂന്നാമത്തേതു ഹുപ്പെക്കും പതിന്നാലാമത്തേതു യേശെബെയാമിന്നും
chapters.niv: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
chapters.nkjv: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
chapters.kjv: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

chapters.ml: പതിനഞ്ചാമത്തേതു ബിൽഗെക്കും പതിനാറാമത്തേതു ഇമ്മേരിന്നും
chapters.niv: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
chapters.nkjv: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
chapters.kjv: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

chapters.ml: പതിനേഴാമത്തേതു ഹേസീരിന്നും പതിനെട്ടാമത്തേതു ഹപ്പിസ്സേസിന്നും
chapters.niv: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
chapters.nkjv: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
chapters.kjv: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

chapters.ml: പത്തൊമ്പതാമത്തേതു പെതഹ്യാവിന്നും ഇരുപതാമത്തേതു യെഹെസ്കേലിന്നും
chapters.niv: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
chapters.nkjv: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
chapters.kjv: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തൊന്നാമത്തേതു യാഖീന്നും ഇരുപത്തിരണ്ടാമത്തേതു ഗാമൂലിന്നും
chapters.niv: the twenty-first to Jakin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
chapters.nkjv: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
chapters.kjv: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തിമൂന്നാമത്തേതു ദെലായാവിന്നും ഇരുപത്തിനാലാമത്തേതു മയസ്യാവിന്നും വന്നു.
chapters.niv: the twenty-third to Delaiah and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
chapters.nkjv: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
chapters.kjv: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അവരുടെ പിതാവായ അഹരോനോടു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവൻ അവർക്കു കൊടുത്ത നിയമപ്രകാരം അവരുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കായിട്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു അവർ വരേണ്ടുന്ന ക്രമം ഇതു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was their appointed order of ministering when they entered the temple of the Lord , according to the regulations prescribed for them by their ancestor Aaron, as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded him.
chapters.nkjv: This was the schedule of their service for coming into the house of the Lord according to their ordinance by the hand of Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
chapters.kjv: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD , according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

chapters.ml: ശേഷം ലേവിപുത്രന്മാരോ: അമ്രാമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ശൂബായേൽ; ശൂബായേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ യെഹ്ദെയാവു.
chapters.niv: As for the rest of the descendants of Levi: from the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
chapters.nkjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

chapters.ml: രെഹബ്യാവോ: രെഹബ്യാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ തലവൻ യിശ്യാവു.
chapters.niv: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: Ishiah was the first.
chapters.nkjv: Concerning Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
chapters.kjv: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാർയ്യരിൽ ശെലോമോത്ത്; ശലോമോത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ യഹത്ത്.
chapters.niv: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
chapters.nkjv: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
chapters.kjv: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യെരിയാവു തലവൻ; അമർയ്യാവു രണ്ടാമൻ; യഹസീയേൽ മൂന്നാമൻ; യെക്കമെയാം നാലാമൻ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah wasthefirst, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മീഖ; മീഖയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ:
chapters.niv: The son of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah; of the sons of Michah, Shamir.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

chapters.ml: ശാമീർ, മീഖയുടെ സഹോദരൻ യിശ്ശ്യാവു: യിശ്ശ്യാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ സെഖർയ്യാവു.
chapters.niv: The brother of Micah: Ishiah; from the sons of Ishiah: Zechariah.
chapters.nkjv: The brother of Michah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
chapters.kjv: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മഹ്ളി, മൂശി, യയസ്യാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ബെനോ.
chapters.niv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi; the son of Jaaziah, Beno.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: യയസ്യാവിൽനിന്നുത്ഭവിച്ച ബെനോ, ശോഹം, സക്കൂർ, ഇബ്രി.
chapters.niv: The sons of Merari: from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zakkur and Ibri.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

chapters.ml: മഹ്ളിയുടെ മകൻ എലെയാസാർ; അവന്നു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായില്ല.
chapters.niv: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
chapters.nkjv: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
chapters.kjv: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

chapters.ml: കീശോ: കീശിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ യെരഹ്മെയേൽ.
chapters.niv: From Kish: the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
chapters.nkjv: Of Kish: the son of Kish, Jerahmeel.
chapters.kjv: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

chapters.ml: മൂശിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: മഹ്ളി, ഏദെർ, യെരീമോത്ത്; ഇവർ പിതൃഭവനം പിതൃഭവനമായി ലേവിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth. These were the Levites, according to their families.
chapters.nkjv: Also the sons of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
chapters.kjv: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

chapters.ml: അവരും അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ ദാവീദ്‌രാജാവിന്നും സാദോക്കിന്നും അഹീമേലെക്കിന്നും പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെയും ലേവ്യരുടെയും പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാർക്കും മുമ്പാകെ അതതു പിതൃഭവനത്തിൽ ഓരോ തലവൻ താന്താന്റെ ഇളയസഹോദരനെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ ചീട്ടിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They also cast lots, just as their relatives the descendants of Aaron did, in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelek, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites. The families of the oldest brother were treated the same as those of the youngest.
chapters.nkjv: These also cast lots just as their brothers the sons of Aaron did, in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and Levites. The chief fathers did just as their younger brethren.
chapters.kjv: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദും സേനാധിപതിമാരും കിന്നരം, വീണ, കൈത്താളം എന്നിവകൊണ്ടു പ്രവചിക്കുന്നവരായ ആസാഫിന്റെയും ഹേമാന്റെയും യെദൂഥൂന്റെയും പുത്രന്മാരെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കായി വേർതിരിച്ചു; ഈ ശുശ്രൂഷയിൽ വേല ചെയ്തവരുടെ സംഖ്യയാവിതു:
chapters.niv: David, together with the commanders of the army, set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun for the ministry of prophesying, accompanied by harps, lyres and cymbals. Here is the list of the men who performed this service:
chapters.nkjv: Moreover David and the captains of the army separated for the service some of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, stringed instruments, and cymbals. And the number of the skilled men performing their service was:
chapters.kjv: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

chapters.ml: ആസാഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരോ: രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പനയാൽ പ്രവചിച്ച ആസാഫിന്റെ കീഴിൽ ആസാഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ സക്കൂർ, യോസേഫ്, നെഥന്യാവു, അശരേലാ.
chapters.niv: From the sons of Asaph: Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. The sons of Asaph were under the supervision of Asaph, who prophesied under the king’s supervision.
chapters.nkjv: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah; the sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.
chapters.kjv: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

chapters.ml: യെദൂഥൂന്യരോ: യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തി സ്തുതിക്കുന്നതിൽ കിന്നരംകൊണ്ടു പ്രവചിച്ച തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവായ യെദൂഥൂന്റെ കീഴിൽ ഗെദെല്യാവു, സെരി, യെശയ്യാവു, ഹശബ്യാവു, മത്ഥിഥയ്യാവു എന്നിങ്ങനെ യെദൂഥൂന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ആറു പേർ.
chapters.niv: As for Jeduthun, from his sons: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six in all, under the supervision of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied, using the harp in thanking and praising the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഹേമാന്യരോ: ബുക്കീയാവു; മത്ഥന്യാവു, ഉസ്സീയേൽ, ശെബൂവേൽ, യെരീമോത്ത്, ഹനന്യാവു, ഹനാനി, എലീയാഥാ, ഗിദ്ദൽതി, രോമംതി-ഏസെർ, യൊശ്ബെക്കാശാ, മല്ലോഥി, ഹോഥീർ, മഹസീയോത്ത് എന്നിവർ ഹേമാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: As for Heman, from his sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael and Jerimoth; Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-Ezer; Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir and Mahazioth.
chapters.nkjv: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
chapters.kjv: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:

chapters.ml: ഇവർ എല്ലാവരും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനങ്ങളിൽ രാജാവിന്റെ ദർശകനായ ഹേമാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ. അവന്റെ കൊമ്പുയർത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവം ഹേമാന്നു പതിന്നാലു പുത്രന്മാരെയും മൂന്നു പുത്രിമാരെയും കൊടുത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (All these were sons of Heman the king’s seer. They were given him through the promises of God to exalt him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.)
chapters.nkjv: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to exalt his horn. For God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
chapters.kjv: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ എല്ലാവരും ദൈവാലയത്തിലെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കു കൈത്താളങ്ങളാലും വീണകളാലും കിന്നരങ്ങളാലും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ സംഗീതത്തിന്നായി താന്താങ്ങളുടെ അപ്പന്റെ കീഴിലും ആസാഫും യെദൂഥൂനും ഹേമാനും നേരെ രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പനെക്കു കീഴിലും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All these men were under the supervision of their father for the music of the temple of the Lord , with cymbals, lyres and harps, for the ministry at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman were under the supervision of the king.
chapters.nkjv: All these were under the direction of their father for the music in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the authority of the king.
chapters.kjv: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD , with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു സംഗീതം ചെയ്‍വാൻ അഭ്യാസം പ്രാപിച്ച നിപുണന്മാരായവരുടെ സകലസഹോദരന്മാരുമായി അവരുടെ സംഖ്യ ഇരുനൂറ്റെണ്പത്തെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Along with their relatives—all of them trained and skilled in music for the Lord —they numbered 288.
chapters.nkjv: So the number of them, with their brethren who were instructed in the songs of the Lord, all who were skillful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.
chapters.kjv: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD , even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

chapters.ml: താന്താങ്ങളുടെ ഉദ്യോഗക്രമം നിശ്ചയിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർ ചെറിയവനും വലിയവനും ഗുരുവും ശിഷ്യനും ഒരുപോലെ ചീട്ടിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Young and old alike, teacher as well as student, cast lots for their duties.
chapters.nkjv: And they cast lots for their duty, the small as well as the great, the teacher with the student.
chapters.kjv: And they cast lots, ward against ward , as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തെ ചീട്ടു ആസാഫിന്നുവേണ്ടി യോസേഫിന്നു വന്നു; രണ്ടാമത്തേതു ഗെദല്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും സഹോദരന്മാരും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons and relatives 12 the second to Gedaliah,him and his relatives and sons 12
chapters.nkjv: Now the first lot for Asaph came out for Joseph; the second for Gedaliah, him with his brethren and sons, twelve;
chapters.kjv: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമത്തേതു സക്കൂരിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the third to Zakkur,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the third for Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The third to Zaccur, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: നാലാമത്തേതു യിസ്രിക്കു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the fourth to Izri, his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the fourth for Jizri, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The fourth to Izri, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാമത്തേതു കെഥന്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the fifth for Nethaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The fifth to Nethaniah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ആറാമത്തേതു ബുക്കീയാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the sixth for Bukkiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The sixth to Bukkiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ഏഴാമത്തേതു യെശരേലെക്കു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the seventh for Jesharelah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The seventh to Jesharelah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: എട്ടാമത്തേതു യെശയ്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the eighth to Jeshaiah,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the eighth for Jeshaiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ഒമ്പതാമത്തേതു മത്ഥന്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടു പേർ.
chapters.niv: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the ninth for Mattaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The ninth to Mattaniah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പത്താമത്തേതു ശിമെയിക്കു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the tenth for Shimei, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The tenth to Shimei, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പതിനൊന്നാമത്തേതു അസരേലിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the eleventh for Azarel, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The eleventh to Azareel, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പന്ത്രണ്ടാമത്തേതു ഹശബ്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the twelfth to Hashabiah,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the twelfth for Hashabiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പതിമ്മൂന്നാമത്തേതു ശൂബായേലിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരുംകൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the thirteenth to Shubael,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the thirteenth for Shubael, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The thirteenth to Shubael, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പതിനാലാമത്തേതു മത്ഥിഥ്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the fourteenth to Mattithiah,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the fourteenth for Mattithiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പതിനഞ്ചാമത്തേതു യെരീമോത്തിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടു പേർ.
chapters.niv: the fifteenth to Jerimoth,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the fifteenth for Jeremoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പതിനാറാമത്തേതു ഹനന്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the sixteenth to Hananiah,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the sixteenth for Hananiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പതിനേഴാമത്തേതു യൊശ്ബെക്കാശെക്കു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the seventeenth for Joshbekashah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പതിനെട്ടാമത്തേതു ഹനാനിക്കു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the eighteenth to Hanani,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the eighteenth for Hanani, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The eighteenth to Hanani, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: പത്തൊമ്പതാമത്തേതു മല്ലോഥിക്കുവന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the nineteenth to Mallothi,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the nineteenth for Mallothi, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ഇരുപതാമത്തേതു എലീയാഥെക്കു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the twentieth to Eliathah,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the twentieth for Eliathah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The twentieth to Eliathah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തൊന്നാമത്തേതു ഹോഥീരിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the twenty-first to Hothir,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the twenty-first for Hothir, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തിരണ്ടാമത്തേതു ഗിദ്ദൽതിക്കു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the twenty-second to Giddalti,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the twenty-second for Giddalti, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തിമൂന്നാമത്തേതു മഹസീയോത്തിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരുംകൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the twenty-third to Mahazioth,his sons and relatives 12
chapters.nkjv: the twenty-third for Mahazioth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
chapters.kjv: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തിനാലാമത്തേതു രോമംതി-ഏസെരിന്നു വന്നു; അവനും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer,his sons and relatives 12.
chapters.nkjv: the twenty-fourth for Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
chapters.kjv: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.

chapters.ml: വാതിൽ കാവൽക്കാരുടെ കൂറുകളോ: കോരഹ്യർ: ആസാഫിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ കോരെയുടെ മകനായ മെശേലെമ്യാവു.
chapters.niv: The divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.
chapters.nkjv: Concerning the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
chapters.kjv: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

chapters.ml: മെശേലെമ്യാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സെഖർയ്യാവു ആദ്യജാതൻ; യെദീയയേൽ രണ്ടാമൻ; സെബദ്യാവു മൂന്നാമൻ, യത്നീയേൽ നാലാമൻ, ഏലാം അഞ്ചാമൻ;
chapters.niv: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
chapters.nkjv: And the sons of Meshelemiah were Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
chapters.kjv: And the sons of Meshelemiah were , Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

chapters.ml: യെഹോഹാനാൻ ആറാമൻ; എല്യോഹോവേനായി ഏഴാമൻ.
chapters.niv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth and Eliehoenai the seventh.
chapters.nkjv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
chapters.kjv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

chapters.ml: ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ശെമയ്യാവു ആദ്യജാതൻ; യെഹോശാബാദ് രണ്ടാമൻ യോവാഹ് മൂന്നാമൻ; സാഖാർ നാലാമൻ; നെഥനയേൽ അഞ്ചാമൻ;
chapters.niv: Obed-Edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sakar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the sons of Obed-Edom were Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
chapters.kjv: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom were , Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

chapters.ml: അമ്മിയേൽ ആറാമൻ; യിസ്സാഖാർ ഏഴാമൻ; പെയൂലെഥായി എട്ടാമൻ. ദൈവം അവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh and Peullethai the eighth. (For God had blessed Obed-Edom.)
chapters.nkjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth; for God blessed him.
chapters.kjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മകനായ ശെമയ്യാവിന്നും പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിച്ചിരുന്നു; അവർ പരാക്രമശാലികളായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു തങ്ങളുടെ പിതൃഭവനത്തിന്നു പ്രമാണികൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Obed-Edom’s son Shemaiah also had sons, who were leaders in their father’s family because they were very capable men.
chapters.nkjv: Also to Shemaiah his son were sons born who governed their fathers’ houses, because they were men of great ability.
chapters.kjv: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

chapters.ml: ശെമയ്യാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഒത്നി, രെഫായേൽ, ഓബേദ്, എൽസാബാദ്;--അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ പ്രാപ്തന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു--എലീഹൂ, സെമഖ്യാവു.
chapters.niv: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad; his relatives Elihu and Semakiah were also able men.
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Shemaiah were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers Elihu and Semachiah were able men.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ എല്ലാവരും ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലുള്ളവർ; അവരും പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കു അതിപ്രാപ്തന്മാരായിരുന്നു. ഇങ്ങനെ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്നുള്ളവർ അറുപത്തിരണ്ടുപേർ;
chapters.niv: All these were descendants of Obed-Edom; they and their sons and their relatives were capable men with the strength to do the work—descendants of Obed-Edom, 62 in all.
chapters.nkjv: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom, they and their sons and their brethren, able men with strength for the work: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
chapters.kjv: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed-edom.

chapters.ml: മെശേലെമ്യാവിന്നു പ്രാപ്തന്മാരായ പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും പതിനെട്ടുപേർ.
chapters.niv: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, who were able men—18 in all.
chapters.nkjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, eighteen able men.
chapters.kjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

chapters.ml: മെരാരിപുത്രന്മാരിൽ ഹോസെക്കു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ശിമ്രി തലവൻ; ഇവൻ ആദ്യജാതനല്ലെങ്കിലും അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ അവനെ തലവനാക്കി;
chapters.niv: Hosah the Merarite had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him the first),
chapters.nkjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the first (for though he was not the firstborn, his father made him the first),
chapters.kjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

chapters.ml: ഹിൽക്കീയാവു രണ്ടാമൻ, തെബല്യാവു മൂന്നാമൻ, സെഖർയ്യാവു നാലാമൻ; ഹോസയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും എല്ലാം കൂടി പതിമ്മൂന്നുപേർ.
chapters.niv: Hilkiah the second, Tabaliah the third and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and relatives of Hosah were 13 in all.
chapters.nkjv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth; all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
chapters.kjv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

chapters.ml: വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാരുടെ ഈ കൂറുകൾക്കു, അവരുടെ തലവന്മാർക്കു തന്നേ, യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്‍വാൻ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു എന്നപോലെ ഉദ്യോഗങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their leaders, had duties for ministering in the temple of the Lord , just as their relatives had.
chapters.nkjv: Among these were the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, having duties just like their brethren, to serve in the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവർ ചെറിയവനും വലിയവനും ഒരുപോലെ പിതൃഭവനം പിതൃഭവനമായി അതതു വാതിലിന്നു ചീട്ടിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Lots were cast for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
chapters.nkjv: And they cast lots for each gate, the small as well as the great, according to their father’s house.
chapters.kjv: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

chapters.ml: കിഴക്കെ വാതിലിന്റെ ചീട്ടു ശേലെമ്യാവിന്നു വന്നു; പിന്നെ അവർ അവന്റെ മകനായി വിവേകമുള്ള ആലോചനക്കാരനായ സെഖർയ്യാവിന്നു വേണ്ടി ചീട്ടിട്ടു; അവന്റെ ചീട്ടു വടക്കെ വാതിലിന്നു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.
chapters.nkjv: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then they cast lots for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and his lot came out for the North Gate;
chapters.kjv: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

chapters.ml: തെക്കെ വാതിലിന്റെതു ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്നും പാണ്ടിശാലയുടേതു അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കും
chapters.niv: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-Edom, and the lot for the storehouse fell to his sons.
chapters.nkjv: to Obed-Edom the South Gate, and to his sons the storehouse.
chapters.kjv: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

chapters.ml: കയറ്റമുള്ള പെരുവഴിക്കൽ ശല്ലേഖെത്ത് പടിവാതിലിന്നരികെ പടിഞ്ഞാറെ വാതിലിന്റേതു ശുപ്പീമിന്നും ഹോസെക്കും വന്നു. ഇങ്ങനെ കാവലിന്നരികെ കാവലുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The lots for the West Gate and the Shalleketh Gate on the upper road fell to Shuppim and Hosah. Guard was alongside of guard:
chapters.nkjv: To Shuppim and Hosah thelotcameout for the West Gate, with the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway—watchman opposite watchman.
chapters.kjv: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

chapters.ml: കിഴക്കെ വാതിൽക്കൽ ആറു ലേവ്യരും വടക്കെ വാതിൽക്കൽ നാളൊന്നിന്നു നാലുപേരും തെക്കെ വാതിൽക്കൽ നാളൊന്നിന്നു നാലുപേരും പാണ്ടിശാലെക്കൽ ഈരണ്ടുപേരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There were six Levites a day on the east, four a day on the north, four a day on the south and two at a time at the storehouse.
chapters.nkjv: On the east were six Levites, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, and for the storehouse two by two.
chapters.kjv: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

chapters.ml: പർബാരിന്നു പടിഞ്ഞാറു പെരുവഴിയിൽ നാലുപേരും പർബാരിൽ തന്നേ രണ്ടുപേരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As for the court to the west, there were four at the road and two at the court itself.
chapters.nkjv: As for the Parbar on the west, therewere four on the highway and two at the Parbar.
chapters.kjv: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

chapters.ml: കോരഹ്യരിലും മെരാർയ്യരിലും ഉള്ള വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാരുടെ കൂറുകൾ ഇവ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.
chapters.nkjv: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Korah and among the sons of Merari.
chapters.kjv: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരായ ലേവ്യർ ദൈവലായത്തിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിന്നും വിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളുടെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിന്നും മേൽവിചാരകരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries for the dedicated things.
chapters.nkjv: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasuries of the house of God and over the treasuries of the dedicated things.
chapters.kjv: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

chapters.ml: ലയെദാന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ലയെദാന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിലുള്ള ഗേർശോന്യരുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ: ഗേർശോന്യനായ ലയെദാന്റെ പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാർ യെഹീയേല്യർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and who were heads of families belonging to Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Laadan, the descendants of the Gershonites of Laadan, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Laadan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
chapters.kjv: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

chapters.ml: യെഹിയേലിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ: സേഥാം; അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ യോവേൽ; ഇവർ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിന്നു മേൽവിചാരകരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: The sons of Jehieli, Zetham and Joel his brother, were over the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അമ്രാമ്യർ, യിസ്ഹാർയ്യർ, ഹെബ്രോന്യർ, ഉസ്സീയേല്യർ എന്നവരോ:
chapters.niv: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites and the Uzzielites:
chapters.nkjv: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
chapters.kjv: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ മകനായ ഗേർശോമിന്റെ മകൻ ശെബൂവേൽ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിന്നു മേല്വിചാരകനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Shubael, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the official in charge of the treasuries.
chapters.nkjv: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was overseer of the treasuries.
chapters.kjv: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

chapters.ml: എലീയേസെരിൽനിന്നുത്ഭവിച്ച അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോ: അവന്റെ മകൻ രെഹബ്യാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ യെശയ്യാവു; അവന്റെ മകൻ യോരാം; അവന്റെ മകൻ സിക്രി; അവന്റെ മകൻ ശെലോമീത്ത്.
chapters.niv: His relatives through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zikri his son and Shelomith his son.
chapters.nkjv: And his brethren by Eliezer were Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
chapters.kjv: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവും പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാരും സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരും ശതാധിപന്മാരും സേനാപതിമാരും നിവേദിച്ച വിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളുടെ സകലഭണ്ഡാരത്തിന്നും ശെലോമീത്തും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും മേൽവിചാരകരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Shelomith and his relatives were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and by the other army commanders.
chapters.nkjv: This Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things which King David and the heads of fathers’ houses, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
chapters.kjv: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധത്തിൽ കിട്ടിയ കൊള്ളയിൽ നിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം കേടുപോക്കുവാൻ അവർ അവയെ നിവേദിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some of the plunder taken in battle they dedicated for the repair of the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Some of the spoils won in battles they dedicated to maintain the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ദർശകനായ ശമൂവേലും കീശിന്റെ മകൻ ശൌലും നേരിന്റെ മകൻ അബ്നേരും സെരൂയയുടെ മകൻ യോവാബും നിവേദിച്ച സകലനിവേദിതവസ്തുക്കളും ശെലോമീത്തിന്റെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെയും വിചാരണയിൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: And everything dedicated by Samuel the seer and by Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner and Joab son of Zeruiah, and all the other dedicated things were in the care of Shelomith and his relatives.
chapters.nkjv: And all that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, every dedicated thing, was under the hand of Shelomith and his brethren.
chapters.kjv: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാർയ്യരിൽ കെനന്യാവും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും പുറമെയുള്ള പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു യിസ്രായേലിൽ പ്രമാണികളും ന്യായാധിപന്മാരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From the Izharites: Kenaniah and his sons were assigned duties away from the temple, as officials and judges over Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons performed duties as officials and judges over Israel outside Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോന്യരിൽ ഹശബ്യാവും അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുമായി ആയിരത്തെഴുനൂറു പ്രാപ്തന്മാർ യോർദ്ദാന്നിക്കരെ പടിഞ്ഞാറു യഹോവയുടെ സകലകാര്യത്തിന്നും രാജാവിന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കും യിസ്രായേലിൽ മേൽവിചാരകരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his relatives—seventeen hundred able men—were responsible in Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the king’s service.
chapters.nkjv: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, one thousand seven hundred able men, had the oversight of Israel on the west side of the Jordan for all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.
chapters.kjv: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD , and in the service of the king.

chapters.ml: ഹെബ്രോന്യരിൽ കുലംകുലമായും കുടുംബംകുടുംബമായുമുള്ള ഹെബ്രോന്യർക്കു യെരീയാവു തലവനായിരുന്നു; ദാവീദിന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ നാല്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ അവരുടെ വസ്തുത അനേഷിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഗിലെയാദിലെ യാസേരിൽ പ്രാപ്തന്മാരെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: As for the Hebronites, Jeriah was their chief according to the genealogical records of their families. In the fortieth year of David’s reign a search was made in the records, and capable men among the Hebronites were found at Jazer in Gilead.
chapters.nkjv: Among the Hebronites, Jerijah was head of the Hebronites according to his genealogy of the fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought, and there were found among them capable men at Jazer of Gilead.
chapters.kjv: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരായി പ്രാപ്തന്മാരും പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാരുമായി രണ്ടായിരത്തെഴുനൂറു പേരുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവരെ ദാവീദ്‍രാജാവു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സകലകാര്യത്തിന്നും രാജാവിന്റെ കാര്യാദികൾക്കും രൂബേന്യർ ഗാദ്യർ, മനശ്ശെയുടെ പാതിഗോത്രം എന്നിവർക്കു മേൽവിചാരകരാക്കിവച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jeriah had twenty-seven hundred relatives, who were able men and heads of families, and King David put them in charge of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
chapters.nkjv: And his brethren were two thousand seven hundred able men, heads of fathers’ houses, whom King David made officials over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God and the affairs of the king.
chapters.kjv: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽപുത്രന്മാർ ആളെണ്ണപ്രകാരം പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാരും സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരും ശതാധിപന്മാരും സംവത്സരത്തിലെ സകലമാസങ്ങളിലും മാസാന്തരം വരികയും പോകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന അതതു കൂറുകളുടെ ഓരോ പ്രവൃത്തിയിലും രാജാവിന്നു സേവ ചെയ്തുപോന്ന അവരുടെ പ്രമാണികളും ആകെ ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരം പേർ.
chapters.niv: This is the list of the Israelites—heads of families, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and their officers, who served the king in all that concerned the army divisions that were on duty month by month throughout the year. Each division consisted of 24,000 men.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel, according to their number, the heads of fathers’ houses, the captains of thousands and hundreds and their officers, served the king in every matter of the military divisions. Thesedivisions came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, each division having twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit , the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള ഒന്നാം കൂറിന്നു മേൽവിചാരകൻ സബ്ദീയേലിന്റെ മകൻ യാശോബെയാം: അവന്റെ കൂറിൽ ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരം പേർ.
chapters.niv: In charge of the first division, for the first month, was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel, and in his division were twenty-four thousand;
chapters.kjv: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പേരെസ്സിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ ഉള്ളവനും ഒന്നാം മാസത്തെ സകലസേനാപതികൾക്കും തലവനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army officers for the first month.
chapters.nkjv: hewas of the children of Perez, and the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
chapters.kjv: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള കൂറിന്നു അഹോഹ്യനായ ദോദായി മേൽവിചാരകനും അവന്റെ കൂറിൽ മിക്ളോത്ത് പ്രമാണിയും ആയിരുന്നു. അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: In charge of the division for the second month was Dodai the Ahohite; Mikloth was the leader of his division. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: Over the division of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his division Mikloth also was the leader; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള മൂന്നാമത്തെ സേനാപതി മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ യെഹോയാദയുടെ മകൻ ബെനായാവു; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The third army commander, for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. He was chief and there were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest, who was chief; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതു പേരിൽ വീരനും മുപ്പതുപേർക്കു തലവനുമായ ബെനായാവു ഇവൻ തന്നേ; അവന്റെ കൂറിന്നു അവന്റെ മകനായ അമ്മീസാബാദ് പ്രമാണിയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was the Benaiah who was a mighty warrior among the Thirty and was over the Thirty. His son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
chapters.nkjv: This was the Benaiah whowas mighty among the thirty, and was over the thirty; in his division was Ammizabad his son.
chapters.kjv: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

chapters.ml: നാലാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള നാലാമത്തവൻ യോവാബിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അസാഹേലും അവന്റെശേഷം അവന്റെ മകനായ സെബദ്യാവും ആയിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab; his son Zebadiah was his successor. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള അഞ്ചാമത്തവൻ യിസ്രാഹ്യനായ ശംഹൂത്ത്; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: ആറാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള ആറാമത്തവൻ തെക്കോവ്യനായ ഇക്കേശിന്റെ മകൻ ഈരാ; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള ഏഴാമത്തവൻ എഫ്രയീമ്യരിൽ പെലോന്യനായ ഹേലെസ്; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: എട്ടാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള എട്ടാമത്തവൻ സർഹ്യരിൽ ഹൂശാത്യനായ സിബ്ബെഖായി; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbekai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbechai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: ഒമ്പതാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള ഒമ്പതാമത്തവൻ ബെന്യാമീന്യരിൽ അനാഥോഥ്യനായ അബീയേസെർ; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abi-ezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: പത്താം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള പത്താമത്തവൻ സർഹ്യരിൽ നെതോഫാത്യനായ മഹരായി; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: പതിനൊന്നാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള പതിനൊന്നാമത്തവൻ എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരിൽ പിരാഥോന്യനായ ബെനായാവു; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: പന്ത്രണ്ടാം മാസത്തേക്കുള്ള പന്ത്രണ്ടാമത്തവൻ ഒത്നീയേലിൽനിന്നുത്ഭവിച്ച നെതോഫാത്യനായ ഹെൽദായി; അവന്റെ കൂറിലും ഇരുപത്തിനാലായിരംപേർ.
chapters.niv: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.nkjv: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
chapters.kjv: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽഗോത്രങ്ങളുടെ തലവന്മാർ: രൂബേന്യർക്കു പ്രഭു സിക്രിയുടെ മകൻ എലീയേസെർ; ശിമെയോന്യർക്കു മയഖയുടെ മകൻ ശെഫത്യാവു;
chapters.niv: The leaders of the tribes of Israel: over the Reubenites: Eliezer son of Zikri; over the Simeonites: Shephatiah son of Maakah;
