chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ സംഹരിക്കാതെ പിന്നീടും ദേശത്തു ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്ന അവരുടെ മക്കളെയും ശലോമോൻ ഇന്നുവരെയും ഊഴിയവേലക്കാരാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these people remaining in the land—whom the Israelites had not destroyed—to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.
chapters.nkjv: that is, their descendants who were left in the land after them, whom the children of Israel did not destroy—from these Solomon raised forced labor, as it is to this day.
chapters.kjv: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യരിൽനിന്നോ ശലോമോൻ ആരെയും തന്റെ വേലകൂ ദാസന്മാരാക്കിയില്ല; അവർ യോദ്ധാക്കളും അവന്റെ സേനാനായകശ്രേഷ്ഠന്മാരും രഥങ്ങൾക്കും കുതിരച്ചേവകർക്കും അധിപന്മാരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Solomon did not make slaves of the Israelites for his work; they were his fighting men, commanders of his captains, and commanders of his chariots and charioteers.
chapters.nkjv: But Solomon did not make the children of Israel servants for his work. Some were men of war, captains of his officers, captains of his chariots, and his cavalry.
chapters.kjv: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ പ്രധാന ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥന്മാരും ജനത്തിന്റെ മേൽവിചാരകന്മാരുമായ ഇവർ ഇരുനൂറ്റമ്പതുപേർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were also King Solomon’s chief officials—two hundred and fifty officials supervising the men.
chapters.nkjv: And others were chiefs of the officials of King Solomon: two hundred and fifty, who ruled over the people.
chapters.kjv: And these were the chief of king Solomon’s officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ ഫറവോന്റെ മകളെ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽനിന്നു താൻ അവൾക്കു വേണ്ടി പണിത അരമനയിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി പാർപ്പിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ അരമനയിൽ എന്റെ ഭാര്യ പാർക്കരുതു; യഹോവയുടെ പെട്ടകം അവിടെ വന്നിരിക്കയാൽ അതു വിശുദ്ധമല്ലോ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her, for he said, "My wife must not live in the palace of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the Lord has entered are holy."
chapters.nkjv: Now Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David to the house he had built for her, for he said, "My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because theplaces to which the ark of the Lord has come are holy."
chapters.kjv: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ താൻ മണ്ഡപത്തിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ പണിത യഹോവയുടെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ
chapters.niv: On the altar of the Lord that he had built in front of the portico, Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings to the Lord ,
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of the Lord which he had built before the vestibule,
chapters.kjv: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD , which he had built before the porch,

chapters.ml: അതതു ദിവസത്തേക്കു വേണ്ടിയിരുന്നതു പോലെ മോശെയുടെ കല്പനപ്രകാരം ശബ്ബത്തുകളിലും അമാവാസ്യകളിലും ഉത്സവങ്ങളിലും പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തിന്റെ ഉത്സവത്തിൽ, വാരോത്സവത്തിൽ, കൂടാരങ്ങളുടെ ഉത്സവത്തിൽ ഇങ്ങനെ ആണ്ടിൽ മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യവും യഹോവെക്കു ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളെ കഴിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for the Sabbaths, the New Moons and the three annual festivals—the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles.
chapters.nkjv: according to the daily rate, offering according to the commandment of Moses, for the Sabbaths, the New Moons, and the three appointed yearly feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles.
chapters.kjv: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നിയമപ്രകാരം പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ കൂറുകളെ അവരുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കും അതതു ദിവസം വേണ്ടിയിരുന്നതുപോലെ സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്‍വാനും പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷിപ്പാനും ലേവ്യരെ അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കും വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാരെ അവരുടെ കൂറുകൾക്കൊത്തവണ്ണം അതതു വാതിലിന്നു നിയമിച്ചു; ഇങ്ങനെയായിരുന്നു ദൈവപുരുഷനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ കല്പന.
chapters.niv: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day’s requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.
chapters.nkjv: And, according to the order of David his father, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their service, the Levites for their duties (to praise and serve before the priests) as the duty of each day required, and the gatekeepers by their divisions at each gate; for so David the man of God had commanded.
chapters.kjv: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

chapters.ml: യാതൊരു കാര്യത്തിലും ഭണ്ഡാരത്തെ സംബന്ധിച്ചും പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടും ലേവ്യരോടും ഉണ്ടായ രാജകല്പന അവർ വിട്ടുമാറിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: They did not deviate from the king’s commands to the priests or to the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.
chapters.nkjv: They did not depart from the command of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasuries.
chapters.kjv: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്നു അടിസ്ഥാനമിട്ടനാൾമുതൽ അതു തീരുംവരെ ശലോമോന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി ഒക്കെയും സാദ്ധ്യമായ്‍വന്നു; അങ്ങനെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം പണിതുതീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: All Solomon’s work was carried out, from the day the foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid until its completion. So the temple of the Lord was finished.
chapters.nkjv: Now all the work of Solomon was well-ordered from the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was completed.
chapters.kjv: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD , and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തും ശലോമോൻ എദോംദേശത്തു കടൽക്കരയിലുള്ള എസ്യോൻ-ഗേബെരിലേക്കും ഏലോത്തിലേക്കും പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the coast of Edom.
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the seacoast, in the land of Edom.
chapters.kjv: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

chapters.ml: ഹൂരാം തന്റെ ദാസന്മാർമുഖാന്തരം കപ്പലുകളെയും സമുദ്രപരിചയമുള്ള ആളുകളെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു; അവർ ശലോമോന്റെ ദാസന്മാരോടുകൂടെ ഓഫീരിലേക്കു ചെന്നു നാനൂറ്റമ്പതു താലന്ത് പൊന്നു വാങ്ങി ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own men, sailors who knew the sea. These, with Solomon’s men, sailed to Ophir and brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: And Hiram sent him ships by the hand of his servants, and servants who knew the sea. They went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and acquired four hundred and fifty talents of gold from there, and brought it to King Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

chapters.ml: ശെബാരാജ്ഞി ശലോമോന്റെ കീർത്തികേട്ടിട്ടു കടമൊഴികളാൽ ശലോമോനെ പരീക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിമഹത്തായ പരിവാരത്തോടും സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗവും അനവധി പൊന്നും രത്നവും ചുമന്ന ഒട്ടകങ്ങളോടും കൂടെ യെരൂശലേമിൽ വന്നു; അവൾ ശലോമോന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നശേഷം തന്റെ മനോരഥം ഒക്കെയും അവനോടു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to Jerusalem to test Solomon with hard questions, having a very great retinue, camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones; and when she came to Solomon, she spoke with him about all that was in her heart.
chapters.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ സകലചോദ്യങ്ങൾക്കും ശലോമോൻ സമാധാനം പറഞ്ഞു; സമാധാനം പറവാൻ കഴിയാതെ ഒന്നും ശലോമോന്നു മറപൊരുളായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.
chapters.nkjv: So Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing so difficult for Solomon that he could not explain it to her.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

chapters.ml: ശെബാരാജ്ഞി ശലോമോന്റെ ജ്ഞാനവും അവൻ പണിത അരമനയും
chapters.niv: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, as well as the palace he had built,
chapters.nkjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
chapters.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മേശയിലെ ഭക്ഷണവും അവന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരുടെ ഇരിപ്പും അവന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷകന്മാരുടെ നിലയും അവരുടെ ഉടുപ്പും അവന്റെ പാനപാത്രവാഹകന്മാരെയും അവരുടെ ഉടുപ്പിനെയും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കുള്ള അവന്റെ എഴുന്നെള്ളത്തും കണ്ടിട്ടു അമ്പരന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.
chapters.nkjv: the food on his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his waiters and their apparel, his cupbearers and their apparel, and his entryway by which he went up to the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.
chapters.kjv: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD ; there was no more spirit in her.

chapters.ml: അവൾ രാജാവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: നിന്റെ കാര്യങ്ങളെയും ജ്ഞാനത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു കേട്ട വർത്തമാനം സത്യംതന്നേ;
chapters.niv: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.
chapters.nkjv: Then she said to the king: "Itwas a true report which I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom.
chapters.kjv: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വന്നു സ്വന്തകണ്ണുകൊണ്ടു കാണുംവരെ ആ വർത്തമാനം വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല; എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ ജ്ഞാനമാഹാത്മ്യത്തിന്റെ പാതിപോലും ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നില്ല, ഞാൻ കേട്ട കേൾവിയെക്കാൾ നീ ശ്രേഷ്ഠനാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But I did not believe what they said until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half the greatness of your wisdom was told me; you have far exceeded the report I heard.
chapters.nkjv: However I did not believe their words until I came and saw with my own eyes; and indeed the half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me. You exceed the fame of which I heard.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഭാര്യമാർ ഭാഗ്യവതികൾ; നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ എല്ലായ്പോഴും നിന്നു നിന്റെ ജ്ഞാനം കേൾക്കുന്ന ഈ നിന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരും ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.nkjv: Happy are your men and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.kjv: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു വേണ്ടി രാജാവായിട്ടു തന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ നിന്നെ ഇരുത്തുവാൻ നിന്നിൽ പ്രസാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ; നിന്റെ ദൈവം യിസ്രായേലിനെ എന്നേക്കും നിലനില്ക്കുമാറാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരെ സ്നേഹിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു നീതിയും ന്യായവും നടത്തുവാൻ നിന്നെ അവർക്കു രാജാവാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the Lord your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness."
chapters.nkjv: Blessed be the Lord your God, who delighted in you, setting you on His throne tobe king for the Lord your God! Because your God has loved Israel, to establish them forever, therefore He made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness."
chapters.kjv: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

chapters.ml: അവൾ രാജാവിന്നു നൂറ്റിരുപതു താലന്തു പൊന്നും അനവധി സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗവും രത്നവും കൊടുത്തു; ശെബാരാജ്ഞി ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്നു കൊടുത്തതുപോലെയുള്ള സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം പിന്നെ ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: And she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones; there never were any spices such as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

chapters.ml: ഓഫീരിൽനിന്നു പൊന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ഹൂരാമിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരും ശലോമോന്റെ ദാസന്മാരും ചന്ദനവും രത്നവും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: (The servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon brought gold from Ophir; they also brought algumwood and precious stones.
chapters.nkjv: Also, the servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, brought algum wood and precious stones.
chapters.kjv: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ചന്ദനമരംകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്നും രാജധാനിക്കും അഴികളും സംഗീതക്കാർക്കു കിന്നരങ്ങളും വീണകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ഈ വക പണ്ടു യെഹൂദാദേശത്തു അശേഷം കണ്ടിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: The king used the algumwood to make steps for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like them had ever been seen in Judah.)
chapters.nkjv: And the king made walkways of the algum wood for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, also harps and stringed instruments for singers; and there were none such asthese seen before in the land of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD , and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

chapters.ml: ശെബാരാജ്ഞി രാജാവിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്നതിൽ പരമായി അവൾ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചതും ചോദിച്ചതുമൊക്കെയും ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു അവൾക്കു കൊടുത്തു; അങ്ങനെ അവൾ തന്റെ ബൃത്യന്മാരുമായി സ്വദേശത്തേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; he gave her more than she had brought to him. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.
chapters.nkjv: Now King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all she desired, whatever she asked, muchmore than she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

chapters.ml: സഞ്ചാരവ്യാപാരികളും കച്ചവടക്കാരും കൊണ്ടുവന്നതു കൂടാതെ ശലോമോന്നു ഓരോ ആണ്ടിൽ വന്നിരുന്ന പൊന്നിന്റെ തൂക്കം അറുനൂറ്ററുപത്താറു താലന്തു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,
chapters.nkjv: The weight of gold that came to Solomon yearly was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,
chapters.kjv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

chapters.ml: അരാബ്യരാജാക്കന്മാരൊക്കെയും ദേശാധിപതിമാരും ശലോമോന്നു പൊന്നും വെള്ളിയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: not including the revenues brought in by merchants and traders. Also all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the territories brought gold and silver to Solomon.
chapters.nkjv: besides what the traveling merchants and traders brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
chapters.kjv: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു പൊമ്പലകകൊണ്ടു ഇരുനൂറു വൻ പരിച ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ഓരോപരിചെക്കു അറുനൂറു ശേക്കെൽ പൊൻ പലക ചെലവായി.
chapters.niv: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
chapters.nkjv: And King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൊൻ പലക കൊണ്ടു മുന്നൂറു ചെറുപരിചയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി; ഓരോ ചെറുപരിചെക്കു മുന്നൂറു ശേക്കെൽ പൊന്നു ചെലവായി. രാജാവു അവയെ ലെബാനോൻ വനഗൃഹത്തിൽവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three hundred shekels of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.nkjv: He also made three hundred shields of hammered gold; three hundred shekels of gold went into each shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.kjv: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ദന്തംകൊണ്ടു ഒരു വലിയ സിംഹാസനം ഉണ്ടാക്കി തങ്കംകൊണ്ടു പൊതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
chapters.kjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

chapters.ml: സിംഹാസനത്തോടു ചേർത്തുറപ്പിച്ചതായി ആറു പതനവും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു പാദപീഠവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇരിപ്പിടത്തിന്റെ ഇരുഭാഗത്തും ഓരോ കൈത്താങ്ങലും കൈത്താങ്ങലിന്നരികെ നില്ക്കുന്ന രണ്ടു സിംഹവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.
chapters.nkjv: The throne had six steps, with a footstool of gold, whichwere fastened to the throne; there were armrests on either side of the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the armrests.
chapters.kjv: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

chapters.ml: ആറു പതനത്തിൽ ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തുമായി പന്ത്രണ്ടു സിംഹം നിന്നിരുന്നു. ഒരു രാജ്യത്തും ഇങ്ങനെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: Twelve lions stood there, one on each side of the six steps; nothing like this had been made for any other kingdom.
chapters.kjv: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ സകലപാനപാത്രങ്ങളും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടും ലെബാനോൻ ഗൃഹത്തിലെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളൊക്കെയും തങ്കംകൊണ്ടും ആയിരുന്നു; വെള്ളിക്കു ശലോമോന്റെ കാലത്തു വിലയില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s day.
chapters.nkjv: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Not onewas silver, for this was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
chapters.kjv: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

chapters.ml: രാജാവിന്റെ കപ്പലുകളെ ഹൂരാമിന്റെ ദാസന്മരോടുകൂടെ തർശീശിലേക്കു അയച്ചിരുന്നു; മൂവാണ്ടിലൊരിക്കൽ തർശീശ് കപ്പലുകൾ പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, ആനക്കൊമ്പു, കുരങ്ങു, മയിൽ എന്നിവയെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The king had a fleet of trading ships manned by Hiram’s servants. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.
chapters.nkjv: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram. Once every three years the merchant ships came, bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and monkeys.
chapters.kjv: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരിലുംവെച്ചു ധനംകൊണ്ടും ജ്ഞാനംകൊണ്ടും മികെച്ചവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
chapters.kjv: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ശലോമോന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ കൊടുത്ത ജ്ഞാനം കേൾപ്പാൻ ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരും അവന്റെ മുഖദർശനം അന്വേഷിച്ചുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the kings of the earth sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.
chapters.nkjv: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
chapters.kjv: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തനും ആണ്ടുതോറും താന്താന്റെ കാഴ്ചയായിട്ടു വെള്ളിപ്പാത്രം, പൊൻ പാത്രം, വസ്ത്രം, ആയുധം, സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം, കുതിര, കോവർ കഴുത എന്നിവയെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, and robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.
chapters.nkjv: Each man brought his present: articles of silver and gold, garments, armor, spices, horses, and mules, at a set rate year by year.
chapters.kjv: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്നു കുതിരകൾക്കും രഥങ്ങൾക്കും നാലായിരം ലായവും പന്തീരായിരം കുതിരച്ചേവകരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവരെ അവൻ രഥനഗരങ്ങളിലും യെരൂശലേമിൽ രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കലും പാർപ്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നദി മുതൽ ഫെലിസ്ത്യദേശംവരെയും മിസ്രയീമിന്റെ അതൃത്തിവരെയും ഉള്ള സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെമേലും വാണു.
chapters.niv: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: So he reigned over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു യെരൂശലേമിൽ വെള്ളിയെ പെരുപ്പംകൊണ്ടു കല്ലുപോലെയും ദേവദാരുവിനെ താഴ്വീതിയിലെ കാട്ടത്തിമരംപോലെയും ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
chapters.nkjv: The king made silver ascommon in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar trees as abundant as the sycamores which are in the lowland.
chapters.kjv: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നും സകലദേശങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും ശലോമോന്നു കുതിരകളെ വാങ്ങി കൊണ്ടുവരും.
chapters.niv: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from all other countries.
chapters.nkjv: And they brought horses to Solomon from Egypt and from all lands.
chapters.kjv: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ ആദ്യാവസാനം നാഥാൻ പ്രവാചകന്റെ വൃത്താന്തത്തിലും ശീലോന്യനായ അഹീയാവിന്റെ പ്രവാചകത്തിലും നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിനെപ്പറ്റിയുള്ള ഇദ്ദോ ദർശകന്റെ ദർശനങ്ങളിലും എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം രാജാവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
chapters.nkjv: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശലോമോൻ തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവനെ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ രെഹബെയാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: Then Solomon rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David his father. And Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാമിനെ രാജാവാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യിസ്രായേലെല്ലാം ശെഖേമിൽ വന്നിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവനും ശെഖേമിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
chapters.nkjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone to Shechem to make him king.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശലോമോൻ രാജാവിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോയി മിസ്രയീമിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാം അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു മടങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: So it happened, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard it (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), that Jeroboam returned from Egypt.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it , that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആളയച്ചു അവനെ വിളിപ്പിച്ചു; യൊരോബെയാമും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും വന്നു രെഹബെയാമിനോടു:
chapters.niv: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:
chapters.nkjv: Then they sent for him and called him. And Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
chapters.kjv: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം ഞങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ വെച്ചു; ആകയാൽ നിന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ കഠിനവേലയും അവൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഭാരമുള്ള നുകവും നീ ഭാരം കുറെച്ചുതരേണം; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ സേവിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."
chapters.nkjv: "Your father made our yoke heavy; now therefore, lighten the burdensome service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you."
chapters.kjv: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: മൂന്നു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു വീണ്ടും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ ജനം പോയി.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam answered, "Come back to me in three days." So the people went away.
chapters.nkjv: So he said to them, "Come back to me after three days." And the people departed.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ശലോമോൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിന്നിരുന്ന വൃദ്ധന്മാരോടു ആലോചിച്ചു: ഈ ജനത്തോടു ഉത്തരം പറയേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്താലോചന പറയുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who stood before his father Solomon while he still lived, saying, "How do you advise me to answer these people?"
chapters.kjv: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ അവനോടു നീ ജനത്തോടു ദയ കാണിച്ചു അവരെ പ്രസാദിപ്പിച്ചു അവരോടു നല്ല വാക്കു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അവർ എന്നും നിനക്കു ദാസന്മാരായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "If you will be kind to these people and please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."
chapters.nkjv: And they spoke to him, saying, "If you are kind to these people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants forever."
chapters.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വൃദ്ധന്മാർ തന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ ആലോചന അവൻ ത്യജിച്ചു, തന്നോടുകൂടെ വളർന്നവരായി തന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നില്ക്കുന്ന യൌവനക്കാരോടു ആലോചിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.
chapters.nkjv: But he rejected the advice which the elders had given him, and consulted the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
chapters.kjv: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നുകം ഭാരം കുറെച്ചു തരേണം എന്നിങ്ങനെ എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള ഈ ജനത്തോടും നാം ഉത്തരം പറയേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്താലോചന പറയുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?"
chapters.nkjv: And he said to them, "What advice do you give? How should we answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

chapters.ml: അവനോടു കൂടെ വളർന്നിരുന്ന യൌവനക്കാർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം ഞങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെച്ചു: നീ അതു ഭാരം കുറെച്ചുതരേണം എന്നു നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ ജനത്തോടു: എന്റെ ചെറുവിരൽ എന്റെ അപ്പന്റെ അരയേക്കാൾ വണ്ണമുള്ളതായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The young men who had grown up with him replied, "The people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
chapters.nkjv: Then the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, "Thus you should speak to the people who have spoken to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you make it lighter on us’—thus you shall say to them: ‘My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s waist!
chapters.kjv: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിങ്ങളുടെമേൽ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം വെച്ചിരിക്കെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ നുകത്തിന്നു ഭാരം കൂട്ടും; എന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിങ്ങളെ ചമ്മട്ടികൊണ്ടു ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചു; ഞാനോ നിങ്ങളെ തേളിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കും എന്നിങ്ങനെ നീ ഉത്തരം പറയേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And now, whereas my father put a heavy yoke on you, I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, but I willchastiseyou with scourges!’ "
chapters.kjv: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം ദിവസം വീണ്ടും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവിൻ എന്നു രാജാവു പറഞ്ഞതു പോലെ യൊരോബെയാമും സകലജനവും മൂന്നാം ദിവസം രെഹബെയാമിന്റെ അടുക്കൽവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."
chapters.nkjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had directed, saying, "Come back to me the third day."
chapters.kjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രാജാവു അവരോടു കഠിനമായിട്ടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു; രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു വൃദ്ധന്മാരുടെ ആലോചന ത്യജിച്ചു
chapters.niv: The king answered them harshly. Rejecting the advice of the elders,
chapters.nkjv: Then the king answered them roughly. King Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders,
chapters.kjv: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

chapters.ml: യൌവനക്കാരുടെ ആലോചനപ്രകാരം അവരോടു: എന്റെ അപ്പൻ ഭാരമുള്ള നുകം നിങ്ങളുടെമേൽ വെച്ചു; ഞാനോ അതിന്നു ഭാരം കൂട്ടും; എന്റെ അപ്പൻ നിങ്ങളെ ചമ്മട്ടികൊണ്ടു ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചു; ഞാനോ തേളിനെക്കൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."
chapters.nkjv: and he spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it; my father chastised you with whips, but I willchastiseyou with scourges!"
chapters.kjv: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ രാജാവു ജനത്തിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടില്ല; യഹോവ ശീലോന്യനായ അഹീയാമുഖാന്തരം നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനായ യൊരോബെയാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാകേണ്ടതിന്നു ഈ കാര്യം ദൈവഹിതത്താൽ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from God, to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
chapters.nkjv: So the king did not listen to the people; for the turn ofevents was from God, that the Lord might fulfill His word, which He had spoken by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
chapters.kjv: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു തങ്ങളുടെ അപേക്ഷ കേൾക്കയില്ല എന്നു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും കണ്ടപ്പോൾ ജനം രാജാവിനോടു: ദാവീദിങ്കൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തോഹരിയുള്ളു? യിശ്ശായിയുടെ പുത്രങ്കൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അവകാശം ഇല്ലല്ലോ; യിസ്രായേലേ, ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിലേക്കു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾവിൻ; ദാവീദേ, നിന്റെ ഗൃഹം നോക്കിക്കൊൾക എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു യിസ്രായേലൊക്കെയും തങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!" So all the Israelites went home.
chapters.nkjv: Now when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, saying: "What share have we in David? Wehave no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to your tents, O Israel! Now see to your own house, O David!" So all Israel departed to their tents.
chapters.kjv: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാനഗരങ്ങളിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്ന യിസ്രായേല്യർക്കോ രെഹബെയാം രാജാവായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.
chapters.nkjv: But Rehoboam reigned over the children of Israel who dwelt in the cities of Judah.
chapters.kjv: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു ഊഴിയവേലകൂ മേൽവിചാരകനായ ഹദോരാമിനെ അയച്ചു; എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേല്യർ അവനെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു കൊന്നു കളഞ്ഞു; രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു വേഗത്തിൽ രഥം കയറി യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was in charge of revenue; but the children of Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. Therefore King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste to flee to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽ ഇന്നുവരെ ദാവീദ് ഗൃഹത്തോടു മത്സരിച്ചുനില്ക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
chapters.nkjv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
chapters.kjv: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വന്നശേഷം യിസ്രായേലിനോടു യുദ്ധംചെയ്തു രാജത്വം രെഹബെയാമിന്നു വീണ്ടുകൊള്ളേണ്ടതിന്നു യെഹൂദയുടെയും ബെന്യാമീന്റെയും ഗൃഹത്തിൽനിന്നു ശ്രേഷ്ഠയോദ്ധാക്കളായ ലക്ഷത്തെണ്പതിനായിരം പേരെ ശേഖരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered Judah and Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled from the house of Judah and Benjamin one hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
chapters.kjv: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men , which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവപുരുഷനായ ശെമയ്യാവിന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: But this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God:
chapters.nkjv: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
chapters.kjv: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

chapters.ml: ശലോമോന്റെ മകനായി യെഹൂദാ രാജാവായ രെഹബെയാമിനോടും യെഹൂദയിലും ബെന്യാമീനിലും ഉള്ള എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനോടും പറക:
chapters.niv: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,
chapters.nkjv: "Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
chapters.kjv: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പുറപ്പെടരുതു; നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യരുതു; ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവിൻ; ഈ കാര്യം എന്റെ ഹിതത്താൽ സംഭവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നിപ്രകാരം യഹോവ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു. അവർ യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു അനുസരിക്കയും യൊരോബെയാമിന്റെ നേരെ ചെല്ലാതെ മടങ്ങിപ്പോകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your fellow Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ " So they obeyed the words of the Lord and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord: "You shall not go up or fight against your brethren! Let every man return to his house, for this thing is from Me." ’ " Therefore they obeyed the words of the Lord, and turned back from attacking Jeroboam.
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD , and returned from going against Jeroboam.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർത്തു യെഹൂദയിൽ ഉറപ്പിന്നായി പട്ടണങ്ങളെ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up towns for defense in Judah:
chapters.nkjv: So Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹൂദയിലും ബെന്യാമീനിലും ഉള്ള ബേത്ത്ളേഹെം ഏതാം, തെക്കോവ,
chapters.niv: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
chapters.nkjv: And he built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
chapters.kjv: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

chapters.ml: ബേത്ത്-സൂർ, സോഖോ, അദുല്ലാം
chapters.niv: Beth Zur, Soko, Adullam,
chapters.nkjv: Beth Zur, Sochoh, Adullam,
chapters.kjv: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

chapters.ml: ഗത്ത്, മാരേശാ, സീഫ്,
chapters.niv: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
chapters.nkjv: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
chapters.kjv: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

chapters.ml: അദോരയീം, ലാഖീശ്, അസേക്കാ,
chapters.niv: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
chapters.nkjv: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
chapters.kjv: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

chapters.ml: സോരാ, അയ്യാലോൻ, ഹെബ്രോൻ എന്നിവയെ ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളായി പണിതു.
chapters.niv: Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron. These were fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.
chapters.nkjv: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and Benjamin, fortified cities.
chapters.kjv: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കോട്ടകളെയും ഉറപ്പിച്ചു, അവയിൽ പടനായകന്മാരെ ആക്കി, ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങളും എണ്ണയും വീഞ്ഞും ശേഖരിച്ചുവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He strengthened their defenses and put commanders in them, with supplies of food, olive oil and wine.
chapters.nkjv: And he fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of food, oil, and wine.
chapters.kjv: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഓരോ പട്ടണത്തിലും വൻ പരിചകളും കുന്തങ്ങളും വെച്ചു അവയെ നല്ലവണ്ണം ഉറപ്പിച്ചു; യെഹൂദയും ബെന്യാമീനും അവന്റെ പക്ഷത്തു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.
chapters.nkjv: Also in every city heput shields and spears, and made them very strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
chapters.kjv: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

chapters.ml: എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിലും ഉള്ള പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ലേവ്യരും സകലദിക്കുകളിൽ നിന്നും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel sided with him.
chapters.nkjv: And from all their territories the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel took their stand with him.
chapters.kjv: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാമും പുത്രന്മാരും ലേവ്യരെ യഹോവയുടെ പൌരോഹിത്യത്തിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു, താൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ പൂജാഗിരികൾക്കും മേഷവിഗ്രഹങ്ങൾക്കും കാളക്കുട്ടികൾക്കും വേറെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ നിയമിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the Lord
chapters.nkjv: For the Levites left their common-lands and their possessions and came to Judah and Jerusalem, for Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them from serving as priests to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto the LORD :

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യർ തങ്ങളുടെ പുല്പുറങ്ങളും അവകാശങ്ങളും വിട്ടൊഴിഞ്ഞു യെഹൂദയിലേക്കും യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കും വന്നു.
chapters.niv: when he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.
chapters.nkjv: Then he appointed for himself priests for the high places, for the demons, and the calf idols which he had made.
chapters.kjv: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകല ഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ അന്വേഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മനസ്സുവെച്ചവരും തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു യാഗംകഴിപ്പാൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the Lord , the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: And after the Levites left, those from all the tribes of Israel, such as set their heart to seek the Lord God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the Lord God of their fathers.
chapters.kjv: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം ദാവീദിന്റെയും ശലോമോന്റെയും വഴിയിൽ നടന്നു മൂന്നു സംവത്സരത്തോളം യെഹൂദാരാജ്യത്തിന്നു ഉറപ്പുവരുത്തുകയും ശലോമോന്റെ മകനായ രെഹബെയാമിനെ ബലപ്പെടുത്തുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon three years, following the ways of David and Solomon during this time.
chapters.nkjv: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, because they walked in the way of David and Solomon for three years.
chapters.kjv: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം ദാവീദിന്റെ മകനായ യെരീമോത്തിന്റെ മകളായ മഹലാത്തിനെയും യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകനായ എലീയാബിന്റെ മകളായ അബീഹയീലിനെയും വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.
chapters.nkjv: Then Rehoboam took for himself as wife Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David, andof Abihail the daughter of Eliah the son of Jesse.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവന്നു യെയൂശ്, ശെമർയ്യാവു, സാഹം എന്നീ പുത്രന്മാരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.
chapters.nkjv: And she bore him children: Jeush, Shamariah, and Zaham.
chapters.kjv: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെശേഷം അവൻ അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ മകളായ മയഖയെ വിവാഹംകഴിച്ചു; അവൾ അവന്നു അബീയാവു, അത്ഥായി, സീസ, ശെലോമീത്ത് എന്നിവരെ പ്രസവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he married Maakah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.
chapters.nkjv: After her he took Maachah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
chapters.kjv: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം തന്റെ സകലഭാര്യമാരിലും വെപ്പാട്ടികളിലും വെച്ചു അബ്ശാലോമിന്റെ മകളായ മയഖയെ അധികം സ്നേഹിച്ചു; അവൻ പതിനെട്ടു ഭാര്യമാരെയും അറുപതു വെപ്പാട്ടികളെയും പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചിരുന്നു; ഇരുപത്തെട്ടു പുത്രന്മാരെയും അറുപതു പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam loved Maakah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
chapters.nkjv: Now Rehoboam loved Maachah the granddaughter of Absalom more than all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and begot twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം മയഖയുടെ മകനായ അബീയാവെ രാജാവാക്കുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ തലവനും പ്രധാനിയുമായി നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maakah as crown prince among his brothers, in order to make him king.
chapters.nkjv: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maachah as chief, tobe leader among his brothers; for he intended to make him king.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബുദ്ധിയോടെ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു: യെഹൂദയുടെയും ബെന്യാമീന്റെയും ദേശങ്ങളിലൊക്കെയും ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളിലേക്കെല്ലാം തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും പിരിച്ചയച്ചു, അവർക്കു ധാരാളം ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങൾ കൊടുക്കയും അവർക്കുവേണ്ടി അനവധി ഭാര്യമാരെ അന്വേഷിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He acted wisely, dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and took many wives for them.
chapters.nkjv: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the territories of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city; and he gave them provisions in abundance. He also sought many wives forthem.
chapters.kjv: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ രെഹബെയാമിന്റെ രാജത്വം ഉറെച്ചു അവൻ ബലം പ്രാപിച്ചശേഷം അവനും അവനോടുകൂടെ എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും യഹോവയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Rehoboam’s position as king was established and he had become strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the law of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom and had strengthened himself, that he forsook the law of the Lord, and all Israel along with him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD , and all Israel with him.

chapters.ml: അവർ യഹോവയോടു ദ്രോഹംചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു രെഹബെയാംരാജാവിന്റെ അഞ്ചാം ആണ്ടിൽ
chapters.niv: Because they had been unfaithful to the Lord , Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened in the fifth year of King Rehoboam that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the Lord,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD ,

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ശീശക്ക് ആയിരത്തിരുനൂറു രഥങ്ങളോടും അറുപതിനായിരം കുതിരച്ചേവകരോടും കൂടെ യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു; അവനോടുകൂടെ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു വന്നിരുന്ന ലൂബ്യർ, സൂക്യർ, കൂശ്യർ, എന്നിങ്ങനെയുള്ള പടജ്ജനം അസംഖ്യമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen and the innumerable troops of Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites that came with him from Egypt,
chapters.nkjv: with twelve hundred chariots, sixty thousand horsemen, and people without number who came with him out of Egypt— the Lubim and the Sukkiim and the Ethiopians.
chapters.kjv: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹൂദയോടു ചേർന്ന ഉറപ്പുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളെ പിടിച്ചു, യെരൂശലേംവരെയും വന്നു.
chapters.niv: he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And he took the fortified cities of Judah and came to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശെമയ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ രെഹബെയാമിന്റെയും ശീശക്ക് നിമിത്തം യെരൂശലേമിൽ കൂടിയിരുന്ന യെഹൂദാപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെയും അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവരോടു: യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാനും നിങ്ങളെ ശീശക്കിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the leaders of Judah who had assembled in Jerusalem for fear of Shishak, and he said to them, "This is what the Lord says, ‘You have abandoned me; therefore, I now abandon you to Shishak.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah, who were gathered together in Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, "Thus says the Lord: ‘You have forsaken Me, and therefore I also have left you in the hand of Shishak.’ "
chapters.kjv: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD , Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും രാജാവും തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ താഴ്ത്തി: യഹോവ നീതിമാൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The Lord is just."
chapters.nkjv: So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, "The Lordis righteous."
chapters.kjv: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ താഴ്ത്തി എന്നു യഹോവ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ശെമയ്യാവിന്നു ഉണ്ടായതു എന്തെന്നാൽ: അവർ തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ താഴ്ത്തിയിരിക്കയാൽ ഞാൻ അവരെ നശിപ്പിക്കാതെ അവർക്കു ഒരുവിധം രക്ഷ നല്കും; എന്റെ കോപം ശീശക്ക് മുഖാന്തരം യെരൂശലേമിന്മേൽ ചൊരികയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah: "Since they have humbled themselves, I will not destroy them but will soon give them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying, "They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance. My wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
chapters.kjv: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവർ എന്റെ സേവയും അന്യദേശങ്ങളിലെ രാജത്വത്തിന്റെ സേവയും തിരിച്ചറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർ അവന്നു അധീനന്മാരായ്തീരും.
chapters.niv: They will, however, become subject to him, so that they may learn the difference between serving me and serving the kings of other lands."
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may distinguish My service from the service of the kingdoms of the nations."
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ശീശക്ക് യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരവും രാജധാനിയിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരവും അപഹരിച്ചു ആസകലം എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി; ശലോമോൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ പൊൻ പരിചകളും അവൻ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem, he carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields Solomon had made.
chapters.nkjv: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house; he took everything. He also carried away the gold shields which Solomon had made.
chapters.kjv: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

chapters.ml: അവെക്കു പകരം രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു താമ്രംകൊണ്ടു പരിചകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി രാജധാനിയുടെ വാതിൽ കാക്കുന്ന അകമ്പടിനായകന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
chapters.nkjv: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the doorway of the king’s house.
chapters.kjv: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king’s house.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ അകമ്പടികൾ അവയെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പിടിക്കയും പിന്നെ അകമ്പടികളുടെ അറയിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി വെക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards went with him, bearing the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.
chapters.nkjv: And whenever the king entered the house of the Lord, the guard would go and bring them out; then they would take them back into the guardroom.
chapters.kjv: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD , the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ താഴ്ത്തിയപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ കോപം അവനെ മുഴുവനായി നശിപ്പിക്കാതെ വിട്ടുമാറി; യെഹൂദയിൽ ഏതാനും നന്മ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the Lord ’s anger turned from him, and he was not totally destroyed. Indeed, there was some good in Judah.
chapters.nkjv: When he humbled himself, the wrath of the Lord turned from him, so as not to destroy him completely; and things also went well in Judah.
chapters.kjv: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ രെഹബെയാംരാജാവു യെരൂശലേമിൽ തന്നെത്താൻ ബലപ്പെടുത്തി വാണു. വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ രെഹബെയാമിന്നു നാല്പത്തൊന്നു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; യഹോവ തന്റെ നാമം സ്ഥാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സകലഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത നഗരമായ യെരൂശലേമിൽ അവൻ പതിനേഴു സംവത്സരം വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു നയമാ എന്നു പേർ. അവൾ അമ്മോന്യസ്ത്രീ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and continued as king. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.
chapters.nkjv: Thus King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned. Now Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king; and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there. His mother’s name was Naamah, an Ammonitess.
chapters.kjv: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെ അന്വേഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മനസ്സു വെക്കാഞ്ഞതിനാൽ അവൻ ദോഷം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did evil because he had not set his heart on seeking the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And he did evil, because he did not prepare his heart to seek the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD .

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാമിന്റെ വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ ആദ്യാവസാനം ശെമയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്റെയും ഇദ്ദോദർശകന്റെയും വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളിൽ വംശാവലിയായി എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; രെഹബെയാമിന്നും യൊരോബെയാമിന്നും തമ്മിൽ എല്ലാകാലത്തും യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As for the events of Rehoboam’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer that deal with genealogies? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
chapters.nkjv: The acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And therewere wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
chapters.kjv: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

chapters.ml: രെഹബെയാം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്ര പ്രാപിച്ചു; ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ അബീയാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Rehoboam rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David. Then Abijah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാംരാജാവിന്റെ പതിനെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ അബീയാവു യെഹൂദയിൽ രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah became king of Judah,
chapters.nkjv: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah became king over Judah.
chapters.kjv: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു മീഖായാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ ഗിബെയക്കാരനായ ഊരീയേലിന്റെ മകൾ. അബീയാവിന്നും യൊരോബെയാമിന്നും തമ്മിൽ യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah, a daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
chapters.nkjv: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
chapters.kjv: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

chapters.ml: അബീയാവു നാലു ലക്ഷം ശ്രേഷ്ഠയുദ്ധവീരന്മാരുള്ളോരു സൈന്യത്തെ അണിനിരത്തി; യൊരോബെയാം അവന്റെ നേരെ എട്ടുലക്ഷം ശ്രേഷ്ഠയുദ്ധവീരന്മാരെ അണിനിരത്തി.
chapters.niv: Abijah went into battle with an army of four hundred thousand able fighting men, and Jeroboam drew up a battle line against him with eight hundred thousand able troops.
chapters.nkjv: Abijah set the battle in order with an army of valiant warriors, four hundred thousand choice men. Jeroboam also drew up in battle formation against him with eight hundred thousand choice men, mighty men of valor.
chapters.kjv: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അബീയാവു എഫ്രയീംമലനാട്ടിലെ സെമരായീം മലമുകളിൽ നിന്നുംകൊണ്ടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യെരോബെയാമും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലും ആയുള്ളോരേ, എന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!
chapters.nkjv: Then Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the mountains of Ephraim, and said, "Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:
chapters.kjv: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിലെ രാജത്വം ഒരു ലവണനിയമത്താൽ ദാവീദിന്നു, അവന്നും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർക്കും തന്നേ, സദാകാലത്തേക്കു നല്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയേണ്ടതല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Don’t you know that the Lord , the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?
chapters.nkjv: Should you not know that the Lord God of Israel gave the dominion over Israel to David forever, to him and his sons, by a covenant of salt?
chapters.kjv: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാവീദിന്റെ മകനായ ശലോമോന്റെ ദാസനും നെബാത്തിന്റെ മകനുമായ യൊരോബെയാം എഴുന്നേറ്റു തന്റെ യജമാനനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, an official of Solomon son of David, rebelled against his master.
chapters.nkjv: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up and rebelled against his lord.
chapters.kjv: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

chapters.ml: നീചന്മാരായ നിസ്സാരന്മാർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുകൂടി, ശലോമോന്റെ മകനായ രെഹബെയാമിനോടു ദാർഷ്ട്യം കാണിച്ചു; രെഹബെയാമോ യൌവനക്കാരനും മനോബലമില്ലാത്തവനുമായിരുന്നതിനാൽ അവരോടു എതിർത്തുനില്പാൻ അവന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Some worthless scoundrels gathered around him and opposed Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive and not strong enough to resist them.
chapters.nkjv: Then worthless rogues gathered to him, and strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and inexperienced and could not withstand them.
chapters.kjv: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ ദാവീദിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ കൈവശമുള്ള യഹോവയുടെ രാജത്വത്തോടു എതിർത്തുനില്പാൻ വിചാരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ വലിയോരു സമൂഹം തന്നേ; യൊരോബെയാം നിങ്ങൾക്കു ദൈവമായിട്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ പൊൻകാളക്കുട്ടികളും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "And now you plan to resist the kingdom of the Lord , which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.
chapters.nkjv: And now you think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord, which is in the hand of the sons of David; and you are a great multitude, and with you are the gold calves which Jeroboam made for you as gods.
chapters.kjv: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരായ യഹോവയുടെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും ലേവ്യരെയും തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു അന്യദേശങ്ങളിലെ ജാതികളുടെ മര്യാദപ്രകാരം നിങ്ങൾക്കു പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ ആക്കീട്ടില്ലയോ? ഒരു കാളക്കുട്ടിയോടും ഏഴു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരോടും കൂടെ കരപൂരണത്തിന്നു വന്ന ഏവനും ദൈവമല്ലാത്തവെക്കു പുരോഹിതനായ്തീരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But didn’t you drive out the priests of the Lord , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make priests of your own as the peoples of other lands do? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may become a priest of what are not gods.
chapters.nkjv: Have you not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made for yourselves priests, like the peoples of other lands, so that whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of thingsthatare not gods?
chapters.kjv: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമോ യഹോവയാകുന്നു; അവനെ ഞങ്ങൾ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചിട്ടില്ല: യഹോവെക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്യുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാരായിട്ടു അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഞങ്ങൾക്കുണ്ടു; ലേവ്യരും തങ്ങളുടെ വേല നോക്കിവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "As for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him. The priests who serve the Lord are sons of Aaron, and the Levites assist them.
chapters.nkjv: But as for us, the Lordis our God, and we have not forsaken Him; and the priests who minister to the Lordare the sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.
chapters.kjv: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD , are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

chapters.ml: അവർ ദിനംപ്രതി രാവിലെയും വൈകുന്നേരവും യഹോവെക്കു ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളും പരിമളധൂപവും അർപ്പിക്കുന്നു; കാഴ്ചയപ്പം വിശുദ്ധമേശമേൽ അടുക്കന്നു; പൊൻ നിലവിളക്കും അതിന്റെ ദീപങ്ങളും വൈകുന്നേരംതോറും കത്തിക്കുന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ ഞങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ആജ്ഞ പ്രമാണിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളോ അവനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Every morning and evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the Lord . They set out the bread on the ceremonially clean table and light the lamps on the gold lampstand every evening. We are observing the requirements of the Lord our God. But you have forsaken him.
chapters.nkjv: And they burn to the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense; they also set the showbread inorderon the pure gold table, and the lampstand of gold with its lamps to burn every evening; for we keep the command of the Lord our God, but you have forsaken Him.
chapters.kjv: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഞങ്ങളുടെ തലവനായി ദൈവവും നിങ്ങളുടെ നേരെ ധ്വനിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മഹാധ്വനികാഹളങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ അവന്റെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ഉണ്ടു; യിസ്രായേല്യരേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു നിങ്ങൾ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യരുതു; നിങ്ങൾ കൃതാർത്ഥരാകയില്ല;
chapters.niv: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. People of Israel, do not fight against the Lord , the God of your ancestors, for you will not succeed."
chapters.nkjv: Now look, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with sounding trumpets to sound the alarm against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the Lord God of your fathers, for you shall not prosper!"
chapters.kjv: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യൊരോബെയാം അവരുടെ പുറകിൽ വളഞ്ഞുചെല്ലുവാൻ പതിയിരിപ്പുകാരെ അയച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അവർ യെഹൂദ്യരുടെ മുമ്പിലും പതിയിരിപ്പുകാർ പുറകിലും ആയി.
chapters.niv: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.
chapters.nkjv: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to go around behind them; so they were in front of Judah, and the ambush was behind them.
chapters.kjv: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദ്യർ തിരിഞ്ഞുനോക്കിയപ്പോൾ പട മുമ്പിലും പുറകിലും കണ്ടു, യഹോവയോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു പുരോഹിതന്മാർ കാഹളം ഊതി, യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാർ ആർത്തുവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Judah turned and saw that they were being attacked at both front and rear. Then they cried out to the Lord . The priests blew their trumpets
chapters.nkjv: And when Judah looked around, to their surprise the battle line was at both front and rear; and they cried out to the Lord, and the priests sounded the trumpets.
chapters.kjv: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD , and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാർ ആർത്തുവിളിച്ചപ്പോൾ ദൈവം യൊരോബെയാമിനെയും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിനെയും അബീയാവിനോടും യെഹൂദ്യരോടും തോല്ക്കുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. At the sound of their battle cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Then the men of Judah gave a shout; and as the men of Judah shouted, it happened that God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
chapters.kjv: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ യെഹൂദ്യരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു ഓടി, ദൈവം അവരെ അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: The Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

chapters.ml: അബീയാവും അവന്റെ ജനവും അവരെ കഠിനമായി തോല്പിച്ചു; യിസ്രായേലിൽ അഞ്ചുലക്ഷം ശ്രേഷ്ഠയോദ്ധാക്കൾ ഹതന്മാരായി വീണു.
chapters.niv: Abijah and his troops inflicted heavy losses on them, so that there were five hundred thousand casualties among Israel’s able men.
chapters.nkjv: Then Abijah and his people struck them with a great slaughter; so five hundred thousand choice men of Israel fell slain.
chapters.kjv: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേല്യർക്കു ആ കാലത്തു താഴ്ച വന്നു; യെഹൂദ്യരോ തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയിൽ ആശ്രയിച്ചതു കൊണ്ടു ജയംപ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Israelites were subdued on that occasion, and the people of Judah were victorious because they relied on the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: Thus the children of Israel were subdued at that time; and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the Lord God of their fathers.
chapters.kjv: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

chapters.ml: അബീയാവു യൊരോബെയാമിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നുചെന്നു അവന്റെ പട്ടണങ്ങളെ പിടിച്ചു; ബേഥേലും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും യെശാനയും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും എഫ്രോനും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took from him the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, with their surrounding villages.
chapters.nkjv: And Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephrain with its villages.
chapters.kjv: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

chapters.ml: യൊരോബെയാം അബീയാവിന്റെ കാലത്തു ബലം പ്രാപിച്ചില്ല; യഹോവ അവനെ ബാധിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Jeroboam did not regain power during the time of Abijah. And the Lord struck him down and he died.
chapters.nkjv: So Jeroboam did not recover strength again in the days of Abijah; and the Lord struck him, and he died.
chapters.kjv: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി. എന്നാൽ അബീയാവു ബലവാനായ്തീർന്നു; അവൻ പതിന്നാലു ഭാര്യമാരെ വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചു ഇരുപത്തിരണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരെയും പതിനാറു പുത്രിമാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Abijah grew in strength. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
chapters.nkjv: But Abijah grew mighty, married fourteen wives, and begot twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
chapters.kjv: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

chapters.ml: അബീയാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവന്റെ നടപ്പും വാക്കുകളും ഇദ്ദോപ്രവാചകന്റെ ചരിത്രപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The other events of Abijah’s reign, what he did and what he said, are written in the annotations of the prophet Iddo.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the annals of the prophet Iddo.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

chapters.ml: അബീയാവു തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അവനെ അടക്കംചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ ആസാ അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി. അവന്റെ കാലത്തു ദേശത്തിന്നു പത്തു സംവത്സരം സ്വസ്ഥത ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. Asa his son succeeded him as king, and in his days the country was at peace for ten years.
chapters.nkjv: So Abijah rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David. Then Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet for ten years.
chapters.kjv: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

chapters.ml: ആസാ തന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദവും ഹിതവും ആയുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God.
chapters.nkjv: Asa did whatwas good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God,
chapters.kjv: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

chapters.ml: അവൻ അന്യദേവന്മാരുടെ ബലിപീഠങ്ങളും പൂജാഗിരികളും നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു, സ്തംഭവിഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ ഉടെച്ചു അശേരാപ്രതിഷ്ഠകളെ വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു,
chapters.niv: He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.
