chapters.ml: അമസ്യാവു വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു. അവൻ ഇരുപത്തൊമ്പതു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു യെഹോവദ്ദാൻ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ യെരൂശലേംകാരത്തിയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു; ഏകാഗ്രഹൃദയത്തോടെ അല്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not wholeheartedly.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a loyal heart.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , but not with a perfect heart.

chapters.ml: രാജത്വം അവന്നു ഉറെച്ചശേഷം അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ രാജാവിനെ കൊന്ന തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാർക്കു മരണശിക്ഷ നടത്തി.
chapters.niv: After the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as soon as the kingdom was established for him, that he executed his servants who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവരുടെ പുത്രന്മാരെ അവൻ കൊല്ലിച്ചില്ല; അപ്പന്മാർ പുത്രന്മാരുടെ നിമിത്തം മരിക്കരുതു; പുത്രന്മാർ അപ്പന്മാരുടെ നിമിത്തവും മരിക്കരുതു; ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ സ്വന്തപാപം നിമിത്തമേ മരിക്കാവു എന്നു യഹോവ കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതായി മോശെയുടെ പുസ്തകത്തിലെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു പോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Yet he did not put their children to death, but acted in accordance with what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the Lord commanded: "Parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor children be put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin."
chapters.nkjv: However he did not execute their children, but did as itis written in the Law in the Book of Moses, where the Lord commanded, saying, "The fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor shall the children be put to death for their fathers; but a person shall die for his own sin."
chapters.kjv: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അമസ്യാവു യെഹൂദയെ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി; എല്ലായെഹൂദയും ബെന്യാമീനുമായ അവരെ സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാർക്കും ശതാധിപന്മാർക്കും കീഴെ പിതൃഭവനം പിതൃഭവനമായി നിർത്തി. ഇരുപതു വയസ്സുമുതൽ മേലോട്ടുള്ളവരെ എണ്ണി, കുന്തവും പരിചയും എടുപ്പാൻ പ്രാപ്തിയുള്ള ശ്രേഷ്ഠയോദ്ധാക്കൾ മൂന്നു ലക്ഷം എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah called the people of Judah together and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin. He then mustered those twenty years old or more and found that there were three hundred thousand men fit for military service, able to handle the spear and shield.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and set over them captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, according to their fathers’ houses, throughout all Judah and Benjamin; and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them to be three hundred thousand choice men, able to go to war, who could handle spear and shield.
chapters.kjv: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിൽനിന്നും ഒരു ലക്ഷം പരാക്രമശാലികളെ നൂറു താലന്ത് വെള്ളി കൊടുത്തു കൂലിക്കു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: He also hired a hundred thousand fighting men from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.
chapters.nkjv: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor from Israel for one hundred talents of silver.
chapters.kjv: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒരു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: രാജാവേ, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ സൈന്യം നിന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരരുതു; യഹോവ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു കൂടെ, എല്ലാ എഫ്രയീമ്യരോടുംകൂടെ തന്നേ ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: But a man of God came to him and said, "Your Majesty, these troops from Israel must not march with you, for the Lord is not with Israel—not with any of the people of Ephraim.
chapters.nkjv: But a man of God came to him, saying, "O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the Lordis not with Israel—notwith any of the children of Ephraim.
chapters.kjv: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.

chapters.ml: നീ തന്നേ ചെന്നു യുദ്ധത്തിൽ ധൈര്യം കാണിക്ക; അല്ലാത്തപക്ഷം ദൈവം നിന്നെ ശത്രുവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വീഴിച്ചേക്കാം; സഹായിപ്പാനും വീഴിപ്പാനും ദൈവത്തിന്നു ശക്തിയുണ്ടല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Even if you go and fight courageously in battle, God will overthrow you before the enemy, for God has the power to help or to overthrow."
chapters.nkjv: But if you go, be gone! Be strong in battle! Evenso, God shall make you fall before the enemy; for God has power to help and to overthrow."
chapters.kjv: But if thou wilt go, do it , be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

chapters.ml: അമസ്യാവു ദൈവപുരുഷനോടു: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽപടക്കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു കൊടുത്ത നൂറു താലന്തിന്നു എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു ദൈവപുരുഷൻ: അതിനെക്കാൾ അധികം നിനക്കു തരുവാൻ യഹോവെക്കു കഴിയും എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah asked the man of God, "But what about the hundred talents I paid for these Israelite troops?" The man of God replied, "The Lord can give you much more than that."
chapters.nkjv: Then Amaziah said to the man of God, "But what shallwe do about the hundred talents which I have given to the troops of Israel?" And the man of God answered, "The Lord is able to give you much more than this."
chapters.kjv: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അമസ്യാവു അവരെ, എഫ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്ന പടക്കൂട്ടത്തെ തന്നേ, അവരുടെ നാട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു വേർതിരിച്ചു; അവരുടെ കോപം യെഹൂദെക്കു നേരെ ഏറ്റവും ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവർ അതികോപത്തോടെ തങ്ങളുടെ നാട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. They were furious with Judah and left for home in a great rage.
chapters.nkjv: So Amaziah discharged the troops that had come to him from Ephraim, to go back home. Therefore their anger was greatly aroused against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
chapters.kjv: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അമസ്യാവു ധൈര്യപ്പെട്ടു തന്റെ പടജ്ജനത്തെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ഉപ്പുതാഴ്വരയിൽ ചെന്നു സേയീർയ്യരിൽ പതിനായിരംപേരെ നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah then marshaled his strength and led his army to the Valley of Salt, where he killed ten thousand men of Seir.
chapters.nkjv: Then Amaziah strengthened himself, and leading his people, he went to the Valley of Salt and killed ten thousand of the people of Seir.
chapters.kjv: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

chapters.ml: വേറെ പതിനായിരംപേരെ യെഹൂദ്യർ ജീവനോടെ പിടിച്ചു പാറമുകളിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി പാറമുകളിൽനിന്നു തള്ളിയിട്ടു; അവരെല്ലാവരും തകർന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The army of Judah also captured ten thousand men alive, took them to the top of a cliff and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces.
chapters.nkjv: Also the children of Judah took captive ten thousand alive, brought them to the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were dashed in pieces.
chapters.kjv: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ തന്നോടുകൂടെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പോരാതെയിരിപ്പാൻ അമസ്യാവു മടക്കി അയച്ചിരുന്ന പടക്കൂട്ടത്തിലെ ആളുകൾ ശമർയ്യമുതൽ ബേത്ത്-ഹോരോൻ വരെയുള്ള യെഹൂദാനഗരങ്ങളെ ആക്രമിച്ചു മൂവായിരം ആളുകളെ കൊന്നു വളരെ കൊള്ളയിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had sent back and had not allowed to take part in the war raided towns belonging to Judah from Samaria to Beth Horon. They killed three thousand people and carried off great quantities of plunder.
chapters.nkjv: But as for the soldiers of the army which Amaziah had discharged, so that they would not go with him to battle, they raided the cities of Judah from Samaria to Beth Horon, killed three thousand in them, and took much spoil.
chapters.kjv: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അമസ്യാവു എദോമ്യരെ സംഹരിച്ചു മടങ്ങിവന്നശേഷം അവൻ സേയീർയ്യരുടെ ദേവന്മാരെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവയെ തനിക്കു ദേവന്മാരായി നിർത്തി അവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നമസ്കരിക്കയും അവെക്കു ധൂപം കാട്ടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down to them and burned sacrifices to them.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was so, after Amaziah came from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the people of Seir, set them up tobe his gods, and bowed down before them and burned incense to them.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ കോപം അമസ്യാവിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു അവൻ ഒരു പ്രവാചകനെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു; നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്തജനത്തെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കഴിയാത്ത ജാതികളുടെ ദേവന്മാരെ നീ അന്വേഷിച്ചതു എന്തു എന്നു അവനോടു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The anger of the Lord burned against Amaziah, and he sent a prophet to him, who said, "Why do you consult this people’s gods, which could not save their own people from your hand?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the anger of the Lord was aroused against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet who said to him, "Why have you sought the gods of the people, which could not rescue their own people from your hand?"
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?

chapters.ml: അവൻ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ രാജാവു അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ രാജാവിന്നു മന്ത്രിയാക്കി വെച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ? മതി; നീ വെറുതെ വെട്ടുകൊണ്ടു ചാകുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ പ്രവാചകൻ മതിയാക്കി: നീ എന്റെ ആലോചന കേൾക്കാതെ ഇതു ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവം നിന്നെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While he was still speaking, the king said to him, "Have we appointed you an adviser to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?" So the prophet stopped but said, "I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel."
chapters.nkjv: So it was, as he talked with him, that theking said to him, "Have we made you the king’s counselor? Cease! Why should you be killed?" Then the prophet ceased, and said, "I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not heeded my advice."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king’s counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവു ആലോചന കഴിച്ചിട്ടു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായി യേഹൂവിന്റെ മകനായ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകൻ യോവാശിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: വരിക, നാം തമ്മിൽ ഒന്നു നോക്കുക എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, he sent this challenge to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel: "Come, let us face each other in battle."
chapters.nkjv: Now Amaziah king of Judah asked advice and sent to Joash the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us face one another inbattle."
chapters.kjv: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യോവാശ് യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ: ലെബാനോനിലെ മുൾപടർപ്പു ലെബാനോനിലെ ദേവദാരുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: നിന്റെ മകളെ എന്റെ മകന്നു ഭാര്യയായി തരിക എന്നു പറയിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ ലെബാനോനിലെ ഒരു കാട്ടുമൃഗം കടന്നുചെന്നു മുൾപടർപ്പിനെ ചവിട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.
chapters.nkjv: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife’; and a wild beast that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle.
chapters.kjv: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

chapters.ml: എദോമ്യരെ തോല്പിച്ചു എന്നു നീ വിചാരിക്കുന്നു; വമ്പുപറവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിന്റെ മനസ്സു നിഗളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; വീട്ടിൽ അടങ്ങി പാർത്തുകൊൾക; നീയും യെഹൂദയും വീഴുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അനർത്ഥത്തിൽ ഇടപെടുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: You say to yourself that you have defeated Edom, and now you are arrogant and proud. But stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"
chapters.nkjv: Indeed you say that you have defeated the Edomites, and your heart is lifted up to boast. Stay at home now; why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall—you and Judah with you?"
chapters.kjv: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അമസ്യാവു കേട്ടില്ല; അവർ എദോമ്യദേവന്മാരെ ആശ്രയിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവരെ ശത്രുവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതു ദൈവഹിതത്താൽ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah, however, would not listen, for God so worked that he might deliver them into the hands of Jehoash, because they sought the gods of Edom.
chapters.nkjv: But Amaziah would not heed, for it came from God, that He might give them into the hand oftheirenemies, because they sought the gods of Edom.
chapters.kjv: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യോവാശ് പുറപ്പെട്ടുചെന്നു; അവനും യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവും യെഹൂദെക്കുള്ള ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശിൽവെച്ചു തമ്മിൽ നേരിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.
chapters.nkjv: So Joash king of Israel went out; and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
chapters.kjv: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ യിസ്രായേലിനോടു തോറ്റു ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ കൂടാരത്തിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
chapters.nkjv: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and every man fled to his tent.
chapters.kjv: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യോവാശ്, യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകനായ യോവാശിന്റെ മകനായി, യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ അമസ്യാവെ ബേത്ത്-ശെമെശിൽവെച്ചു പിടിച്ചു യെരൂശലേമിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ മതിൽ എഫ്രയീമിന്റെ പടിവാതിൽമുതൽ കോൺപടിവാതിൽവരെ നാനൂറുമുഴം ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joash the king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh; and he brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate—four hundred cubits.
chapters.kjv: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഓബേദ്-എദോമിന്റെ പക്കൽ കണ്ട എല്ലാപൊന്നും വെള്ളിയും സകലപാത്രങ്ങളും രാജധാനിയിലെ ഭണ്ഡാരവും എടുത്തു ജാമ്യക്കാരെയും പിടിച്ചു ശമർയ്യയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of God that had been in the care of Obed-Edom, together with the palace treasures and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: And hetook all the gold and silver, all the articles that were found in the house of God with Obed-Edom, the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ യെഹോവാഹാസിന്റെ മകൻ യോവാശ് മരിച്ചശേഷം യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യോവാശിന്റെ മകൻ അമസ്യാവു പതിനഞ്ചു സംവത്സരം ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അമസ്യാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ളവൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ ആദ്യാവസാനം യെഹൂദയിലെയും യിസ്രായേലിലെയും രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, from first to last, indeed are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

chapters.ml: അമസ്യാവു യഹോവയെ വിട്ടുമാറിയ കാലംമുതൽ അവർ യെരൂശലേമിൽ അവന്റെ നേരെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി; അതുനിമിത്തം അവൻ ലാഖീശിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി: എന്നാൽ അവർ ലാഖീശിലേക്കു അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ആളയച്ചു അവിടെവെച്ചു അവനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the Lord , they conspired against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.
chapters.nkjv: After the time that Amaziah turned away from following the Lord, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
chapters.kjv: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കുതിരപ്പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു യെഹൂദയുടെ മൂലനഗരത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He was brought back by horse and was buried with his ancestors in the City of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Then they brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.
chapters.kjv: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാജനമൊക്കെയും പതിനാറു വയസ്സുപ്രായമുള്ള ഉസ്സീയാവെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വന്നു അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ അമസ്യാവിന്നു പകരം രാജാവാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
chapters.nkjv: Now all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
chapters.kjv: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചശേഷം ഏലോത്തിനെ പണിതതും അതിനെ യെഹൂദെക്കു വീണ്ടുകൊണ്ടതും ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: He built Elath and restored it to Judah, after the king rested with his fathers.
chapters.kjv: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയാവു വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു പതിനാറു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു. അവൻ അമ്പത്തിരണ്ടു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു. അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു യെഖൊല്യാ എന്നു പേർ. അവൾ യെരൂശലേംകാരത്തി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ അമസ്യാവു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Amaziah did.

chapters.ml: ദൈവഭയത്തിൽ അവനെ ഉപദേശിച്ചുവന്ന സെഖർയ്യാവിന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലത്തു അവൻ ദൈവത്തെ അന്വേഷിച്ചു: അവൻ യഹോവയെ അന്വേഷിച്ച കാലത്തോളം ദൈവം അവന്നു അഭിവൃദ്ധി നല്കി.
chapters.niv: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. As long as he sought the Lord , God gave him success.
chapters.nkjv: He sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God; and as long as he sought the Lord, God made him prosper.
chapters.kjv: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഫെലിസ്ത്യരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു ഗത്തിന്റെ മതിലും യബ്നെയുടെ മതിലും അസ്തോദിന്റെ മതിലും ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; അസ്തോദ് നാട്ടിലും ഫെലിസ്ത്യരുടെ ഇടയിലും പട്ടണങ്ങൾ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: He went to war against the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. He then rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.
chapters.nkjv: Now he went out and made war against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities around Ashdod and among the Philistines.
chapters.kjv: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ഫെലിസ്ത്യർക്കും ഗൂർ-ബാലിൽ പാർത്ത അരാബ്യർക്കും മെയൂന്യർക്കും വിരോധമായി അവനെ സഹായിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabs who lived in Gur Baal and against the Meunites.
chapters.nkjv: God helped him against the Philistines, against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and against the Meunites.
chapters.kjv: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.

chapters.ml: അമ്മോന്യരും ഉസ്സീയാവിന്നു കാഴ്ചകൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവൻ അത്യന്തം പ്രബലനായിത്തീർന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ ശ്രുതി മിസ്രയീംവരെ പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, because he had become very powerful.
chapters.nkjv: Also the Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah. His fame spread as far as the entrance of Egypt, for he became exceedingly strong.
chapters.kjv: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയാവു യെരൂശലേമിൽ കോൺവാതിൽക്കലും താഴ്വരവാതിൽക്കലും തിരിവിങ്കലും ഗോപുരങ്ങൾ പണിതു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.
chapters.nkjv: And Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate, and at the corner buttress of the wall; then he fortified them.
chapters.kjv: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall , and fortified them.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു താഴ്വീതിയിലും സമഭൂമിയിലും വളരെ കന്നുകാലികൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഗോപുരങ്ങൾ പണിതു, അനേകം കിണറും കുഴിപ്പിച്ചു; അവൻ കൃഷിപ്രിയനായിരുന്നതിനാൽ അവന്നു മലകളിലും കർമ്മേലിലും കൃഷിക്കാരും മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടക്കാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He also built towers in the wilderness and dug many cisterns, because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain. He had people working his fields and vineyards in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.
chapters.nkjv: Also he built towers in the desert. He dug many wells, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains; healsohad farmers and vinedressers in the mountains and in Carmel, for he loved the soil.
chapters.kjv: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also , and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയാവിന്നു പടയാളികളുടെ ഒരു സൈന്യവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർ രായസക്കാരനായ യെയീയേലും പ്രമാണിയായ മയശേയാവും എടുത്ത എണ്ണപ്രകാരം ഗണംഗണമായി രാജാവിന്റെ സേനാപതികളിൽ ഒരുവനായ ഹനന്യാവിന്റെ കൈക്കീഴെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു പുറപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: Uzziah had a well-trained army, ready to go out by divisions according to their numbers as mustered by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officials.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by companies, according to the number on their roll as prepared by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
chapters.kjv: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

chapters.ml: യുദ്ധവീരന്മാരായ പിതൃഭവനത്തലവന്മാരുടെ ആകത്തുക രണ്ടായിരത്തറുനൂറു.
chapters.niv: The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.
chapters.nkjv: The total number of chief officers of the mighty men of valor was two thousand six hundred.
chapters.kjv: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അധികാരത്തിൻ കീഴിൽ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ നേരെ രാജാവിനെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ മഹാവീര്യത്തോടെ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തുവന്നവരായി മൂന്നുലക്ഷത്തേഴായിരത്തഞ്ഞൂറുപേരുള്ള ഒരു സൈന്യംബലം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.
chapters.nkjv: And under their authority was an army of three hundred and seven thousand five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
chapters.kjv: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയാവു അവർക്കു, സർവ്വ സൈന്യത്തിന്നും തന്നേ, പരിച, കുന്തം, തലക്കോരിക, കവചം, വില്ലു, കവിണക്കല്ലു, എന്നിവ ഉണ്ടാക്കിക്കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Uzziah provided shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and slingstones for the entire army.
chapters.nkjv: Then Uzziah prepared for them, for the entire army, shields, spears, helmets, body armor, bows, and slings tocast stones.
chapters.kjv: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അസ്ത്രങ്ങളും വലിയ കല്ലുകളും പ്രയോഗിപ്പാൻ ഗോപുരങ്ങളുടെയും കൊത്തളങ്ങളുടെയും മേൽ വെക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു കൌശലപ്പണിക്കാർ സങ്കല്പിച്ച യന്ത്രങ്ങൾ യെരൂശലേമിൽ തീർപ്പിച്ചു; അവൻ പ്രബലനായിത്തീരുവാന്തക്കവണ്ണം അതിശയമായി അവന്നു സഹായം ലഭിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ ശ്രുതി ബഹുദൂരം പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: In Jerusalem he made devices invented for use on the towers and on the corner defenses so that soldiers could shoot arrows and hurl large stones from the walls. His fame spread far and wide, for he was greatly helped until he became powerful.
chapters.nkjv: And he made devices in Jerusalem, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and the corners, to shoot arrows and large stones. So his fame spread far and wide, for he was marvelously helped till he became strong.
chapters.kjv: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ ബലവാനായപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ഹൃദയം അവന്റെ നാശത്തിന്നായിട്ടു നിഗളിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടു കുറ്റം ചെയ്തു ധൂപപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കടന്നുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: But after Uzziah became powerful, his pride led to his downfall. He was unfaithful to the Lord his God, and entered the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.
chapters.nkjv: But when he was strong his heart was lifted up, to his destruction, for he transgressed against the Lord his God by entering the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.
chapters.kjv: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

chapters.ml: അസർയ്യാപുരോഹിതനും അവനോടുകൂടെ ധൈര്യശാലികളായി യഹോവയുടെ എണ്പതു പുരോഹിതന്മാരും അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ അകത്തു ചെന്നു ഉസ്സീയാരാജാവിനെ തടുത്തു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: Azariah the priest with eighty other courageous priests of the Lord followed him in.
chapters.nkjv: So Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him were eighty priests of the Lord—valiant men.
chapters.kjv: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD , that were valiant men:

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയാവേ, യഹോവെക്കു ധൂപം കാട്ടുന്നതു നിനക്കു വിഹിതമല്ല; ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാൻ വിശുദ്ധീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ട അഹരോന്യരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കത്രേ; വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽനിന്നു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; ലംഘനമാകുന്നു നീ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതു; അതു നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നിനക്കു മാനമായിരിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They confronted King Uzziah and said, "It is not right for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord . That is for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who have been consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have been unfaithful; and you will not be honored by the Lord God."
chapters.nkjv: And they withstood King Uzziah, and said to him, "It is not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord, but for the priests, the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Get out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed! You shallhave no honor from the Lord God."
chapters.kjv: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD , but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from the LORD God.

chapters.ml: ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാൻ കയ്യിൽ ധൂപകലശം പിടിച്ചിരിക്കെ ഉസ്സീയാവു കോപിച്ചു; അവൻ പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടു കോപിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കയിൽ തന്നേ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ധൂപപീഠത്തിന്റെ അരികെ വെച്ചു പുരോഹിതന്മാർ കാൺകെ അവന്റെ നെറ്റിമേൽ കുഷ്ഠം പൊങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Uzziah, who had a censer in his hand ready to burn incense, became angry. While he was raging at the priests in their presence before the incense altar in the Lord ’s temple, leprosy broke out on his forehead.
chapters.nkjv: Then Uzziah became furious; and he had a censer in his hand to burn incense. And while he was angry with the priests, leprosy broke out on his forehead, before the priests in the house of the Lord, beside the incense altar.
chapters.kjv: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD , from beside the incense altar.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ അസർയ്യാവും സകലപുരോഹിതന്മാരും അവനെ നോക്കി, അവന്റെ നെറ്റിയിൽ കുഷ്ഠം പിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവനെ ക്ഷണം അവിടെനിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി; യഹോവ തന്നെ ബാധിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ തന്നേയും പുറത്തുപോകുവാൻ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests looked at him, they saw that he had leprosy on his forehead, so they hurried him out. Indeed, he himself was eager to leave, because the Lord had afflicted him.
chapters.nkjv: And Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and there, on his forehead, he was leprous; so they thrust him out of that place. Indeed he also hurried to get out, because the Lord had struck him.
chapters.kjv: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഉസ്സീയാരാജാവു ജീവപര്യന്തം കുഷ്ടരോഗിയായിരുന്നു; അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽനിന്നു ഭ്രഷ്ടനായിരുന്നതിനാൽ ഒരു പ്രത്യേകശാലയിൽ കുഷ്ഠരോഗിയായി താമസിച്ചു. അവന്റെ മകനായ യോഥാം രാജധാനിക്കു മേൽവിചാരകനായി ദേശത്തിലെ ജനത്തിന്നു ന്യായപാലനം ചെയ്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died. He lived in a separate house —leprous, and banned from the temple of the Lord . Jotham his son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
chapters.nkjv: King Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death. He dwelt in an isolated house, because he was a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the Lord. Then Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
chapters.kjv: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD : and Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയാവിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങൾ ആദ്യാവസാനം ആമോസിന്റെ മകനായ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The other events of Uzziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, from first to last, the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz wrote.
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

chapters.ml: ഉസ്സീയാവു അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവൻ കുഷ്ഠരോഗിയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവർ രാജാക്കന്മാർക്കുള്ള ശ്മശാനഭൂമിയിൽ അവന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അവനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ യോഥാം അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Uzziah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in a cemetery that belonged to the kings, for people said, "He had leprosy." And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Uzziah rested with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, "He is a leper." Then Jotham his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യോഥാം വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ പതിനാറു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു യെരൂശാ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ സാദോക്കിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
chapters.nkjv: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.
chapters.kjv: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ഉസ്സീയാവു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു എങ്കിലും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു അവൻ കടന്നില്ല; ജനമോ വഷളത്വം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done, but unlike him he did not enter the temple of the Lord . The people, however, continued their corrupt practices.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Uzziah had done (although he did not enter the temple of the Lord). But still the people acted corruptly.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD . And the people did yet corruptly.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ മേലത്തെ പടിവാതിൽ പണിതു; ഓഫേലിന്റെ മതിലും അവൻ വളരെ പണിതു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
chapters.nkjv: He built the Upper Gate of the house of the Lord, and he built extensively on the wall of Ophel.
chapters.kjv: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD , and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹൂദാമലനാട്ടിൽ പട്ടണങ്ങളും വനങ്ങളിൽ കോട്ടകളും ഗോപുരങ്ങളും പണിതു.
chapters.niv: He built towns in the hill country of Judah and forts and towers in the wooded areas.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.
chapters.kjv: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അമ്മോന്യരുടെ രാജാവിനോടു യുദ്ധവും ചെയ്തു അവരെ ജയിച്ചു; അമ്മോന്യർ അവന്നു ആ ആണ്ടിൽ തന്നേ നൂറു താലന്ത് വെള്ളിയും പതിനായിരം കോർ കോതമ്പും പതിനായിരം കോർ യവവും കൊടുത്തു; അത്രയും തന്നേ അമ്മോന്യർ രണ്ടാം ആണ്ടിലും മൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിലും കൊടുക്കേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and conquered them. That year the Ammonites paid him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley. The Ammonites brought him the same amount also in the second and third years.
chapters.nkjv: He also fought with the king of the Ammonites and defeated them. And the people of Ammon gave him in that year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand kors of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. The people of Ammon paid this to him in the second and third years also.
chapters.kjv: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ യോഥാം തന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ക്രമമായി നടന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ബലവാനായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the Lord his God.
chapters.nkjv: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.
chapters.kjv: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

chapters.ml: യോഥാമിന്റെ മറ്റുള്ള വൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും അവന്റെ സകലയുദ്ധങ്ങളും അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളും യിസ്രായേലിലെയും യെഹൂദയിലെയും രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The other events in Jotham’s reign, including all his wars and the other things he did, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, indeed they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

chapters.ml: വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ പതിനാറു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു.
chapters.niv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.
chapters.nkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: യോഥാം തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവനെ ദാവീദിന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ മകനായ ആഹാസ് അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Jotham rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David. Then Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് വാഴ്ചതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ പതിനാറു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; എന്നാൽ തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദ് ചെയ്തതുപോലെ യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not do whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, as his father David haddone.
chapters.kjv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD , like David his father:

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വഴികളിൽ നടന്നു ബാൽവിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ വാർത്തുണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and also made idols for worshiping the Baals.
chapters.nkjv: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made molded images for the Baals.
chapters.kjv: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബെൻ-ഹിന്നോം താഴ്വരയിൽ ധൂപം കാട്ടുകയും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു യഹോവ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞ ജാതികളുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛാചാരപ്രകാരം തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ അഗ്നിപ്രവേശം ചെയ്യിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He burned sacrifices in the Valley of Ben Hinnom and sacrificed his children in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: He burned incense in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൂജാഗിരികളിലും ഓരോ പച്ചവൃക്ഷത്തിൻ കീഴിലും ബലികഴിച്ചും ധൂപം കാട്ടിയും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.
chapters.nkjv: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
chapters.kjv: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അവനെ അരാംരാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ അവനെ തോല്പിച്ചു അവരിൽ അസംഖ്യംപേരെ പിടിച്ചു ദമ്മേശെക്കിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി. അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവിന്റെ കയ്യിലും ഏല്പിക്കപ്പെട്ടു; അവനും അവനെ അതികഠിനമായി തോല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Therefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hands of the king of Aram. The Arameans defeated him and took many of his people as prisoners and brought them to Damascus. He was also given into the hands of the king of Israel, who inflicted heavy casualties on him.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They defeated him, and carried away a great multitude of them as captives, and brought them to Damascus. Then he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who defeated him with a great slaughter.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു രെമല്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ പെക്കഹ് യെഹൂദയിൽ ഒരു ലക്ഷത്തിരുപതിനായിരംപേരെ ഒരേദിവസം സംഹരിച്ചു; അവരെല്ലാവരും പരാക്രമശാലികൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand soldiers in Judah—because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed one hundred and twenty thousand in Judah in one day, all valiant men, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers.
chapters.kjv: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

chapters.ml: എഫ്രയീമ്യവീരനായ സിക്രി രാജകുമാരനായ മയശേയാവെയും രാജധാനിവിചാരകനായ അസ്രീക്കാമിനെയും രാജാവിന്നു രണ്ടാമനായിരുന്ന എൽക്കാനയെയും കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Zikri, an Ephraimite warrior, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the officer in charge of the palace, and Elkanah, second to the king.
chapters.nkjv: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the officer over the house, and Elkanah whowas second to the king.
chapters.kjv: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേല്യർ തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരജനത്തിൽ സ്ത്രീകളും പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരുമായി രണ്ടുലക്ഷം പേരെ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോയി, വളരെ കൊള്ളയിട്ടു കൊള്ളയും ശമർയ്യയിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The men of Israel took captive from their fellow Israelites who were from Judah two hundred thousand wives, sons and daughters. They also took a great deal of plunder, which they carried back to Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters; and they also took away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഓദേദ് എന്ന പേരോടെ യഹോവയുടെ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ശമർയ്യയിലേക്കു വന്ന സൈന്യത്തെ എതിരേറ്റു ചെന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ യെഹൂദയോടു കോപിച്ചിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; നിങ്ങൾ അവരെ ആകാശപര്യന്തം എത്തുന്ന ക്രോധത്തോടെ സംഹരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But a prophet of the Lord named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army when it returned to Samaria. He said to them, "Because the Lord , the God of your ancestors, was angry with Judah, he gave them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches to heaven.
chapters.nkjv: But a prophet of the Lord was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out before the army that came to Samaria, and said to them: "Look, because the Lord God of your fathers was angry with Judah, He has delivered them into your hand; but you have killed them in a rage that reaches up to heaven.
chapters.kjv: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴോ നിങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദ്യരെയും യെരൂശലേമ്യരെയും ദാസീദാസന്മാരായി കീഴടക്കുവാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ പക്കലും നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയോടുള്ള അകൃത്യങ്ങൾ ഇല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: And now you intend to make the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves. But aren’t you also guilty of sins against the Lord your God?
chapters.nkjv: And now you propose to force the children of Judah and Jerusalem to be your male and female slaves; butare you not also guilty before the Lord your God?
chapters.kjv: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ പറയുന്നതു കേൾപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽനിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ബദ്ധന്മാരെ വിട്ടയപ്പിൻ; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ യഹോവയുടെ ഉഗ്രകോപം നിങ്ങളുടെമേൽ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Now listen to me! Send back your fellow Israelites you have taken as prisoners, for the Lord ’s fierce anger rests on you."
chapters.nkjv: Now hear me, therefore, and return the captives, whom you have taken captive from your brethren, for the fierce wrath of the Lordis upon you."
chapters.kjv: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD is upon you.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യോഹാനാന്റെ മകൻ അസർയ്യാവു, മെശില്ലേമോത്തിന്റെ മകൻ ബേരെഖ്യാവു, ശല്ലൂമിന്റെ മകൻ യെഹിസ്കീയാവു, ഹദ്ളായിയുടെ മകൻ അമാസാ എന്നിങ്ങനെ എഫ്രയീമ്യതലവന്മാരിൽ ചിലർ യുദ്ധത്തിൽനിന്നു വന്നവരോടു എതിർത്തുനിന്നു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: Then some of the leaders in Ephraim—Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—confronted those who were arriving from the war.
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,
chapters.kjv: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ബദ്ധന്മാരെ ഇവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവരരുതു; നാം തന്നേ യഹോവയോടു അകൃത്യം ചെയ്തിരിക്കെ നമ്മുടെ പാപങ്ങളോടും അകൃത്യത്തോടും ഇനിയും കൂട്ടുവാൻ നിങ്ങൾ ഭാവിക്കുന്നു; നമുക്കു വലിയൊരു അകൃത്യം ഉണ്ടു; ഉഗ്രകോപം യിസ്രായേലിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You must not bring those prisoners here," they said, "or we will be guilty before the Lord . Do you intend to add to our sin and guilt? For our guilt is already great, and his fierce anger rests on Israel."
chapters.nkjv: and said to them, "You shall not bring the captives here, for we already have offended the Lord. You intend to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and thereis fierce wrath against Israel."
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും സർവ്വസഭയും കാൺകെ ആയുധപാണികൾ ബദ്ധന്മാരെയും കൊള്ളയെയും വിട്ടയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the soldiers gave up the prisoners and plunder in the presence of the officials and all the assembly.
chapters.nkjv: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the leaders and all the assembly.
chapters.kjv: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

chapters.ml: പേർ ചൊല്ലി വിളിക്കപ്പെട്ട ആളുകൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ബദ്ധന്മാരെ കൂട്ടി അവരിൽ നഗ്നന്മാരായവരെ ഒക്കെയും കൊള്ളയിലെ വസ്ത്രം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു; അവരെ ഉടുപ്പിച്ചു ചെരിപ്പും ഇടുവിച്ചശേഷം അവർക്കു തിന്മാനും കുടിപ്പാനും കൊടുത്തു എണ്ണയും തേപ്പിച്ചു ക്ഷീണിച്ചുപോയവരെ ഒക്കെയും കഴുതപ്പുറത്തു കയറ്റി, ഈന്തപ്പട്ടണമായ യെരീഹോവിൽ അവരുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നാക്കി ശമർയ്യെക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: The men designated by name took the prisoners, and from the plunder they clothed all who were naked. They provided them with clothes and sandals, food and drink, and healing balm. All those who were weak they put on donkeys. So they took them back to their fellow Israelites at Jericho, the City of Palms, and returned to Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: Then the men who were designated by name rose up and took the captives, and from the spoil they clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them and gave them sandals, gave them food and drink, and anointed them; and they let all the feeble ones ride on donkeys. So they brought them to their brethren at Jericho, the city of palm trees. Then they returned to Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു തന്നെ സഹായിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അശ്ശൂർരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria for help.
chapters.nkjv: At the same time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.
chapters.kjv: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

chapters.ml: എദോമ്യർ പിന്നെയും വന്നു യെഹൂദ്യരെ തോല്പിക്കയും ബദ്ധന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away prisoners,
chapters.nkjv: For again the Edomites had come, attacked Judah, and carried away captives.
chapters.kjv: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.

chapters.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യരും താഴ്വീതിയിലും യെഹൂദയുടെ തെക്കും ഉള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളെ ആക്രമിച്ചു ബേത്ത്-ശേമെശും അയ്യാലോനും ഗെദേരോത്തും സോഖോവും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും തിമ്നയും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും ഗിംസോവും അതിനോടു ചേർന്ന ഗ്രാമങ്ങളും പിടിച്ചു അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: while the Philistines had raided towns in the foothills and in the Negev of Judah. They captured and occupied Beth Shemesh, Aijalon and Gederoth, as well as Soko, Timnah and Gimzo, with their surrounding villages.
chapters.nkjv: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Sochoh with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo with its villages; and they dwelt there.
chapters.kjv: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽരാജാവായ ആഹാസ് യെഹൂദയിൽ നിർമ്മർയ്യാദം കാണിച്ചു യഹോവയോടു മഹാദ്രോഹം ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ നിമിത്തം യഹോവ യെഹൂദയെ താഴ്ത്തി.
chapters.niv: The Lord had humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had promoted wickedness in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had encouraged moral decline in Judah and had been continually unfaithful to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD .

chapters.ml: അശ്ശൂർരാജാവായ തിൽഗത്ത്-പിൽനേസെർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിട്ടു അവനെ ബലപ്പെടുത്താതെ ഞെരുക്കിയതേയുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him, but he gave him trouble instead of help.
chapters.nkjv: Also Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him and distressed him, and did not assist him.
chapters.kjv: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് യെഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽനിന്നും രാജധാനിയിൽനിന്നും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നും കവർന്നെടുത്തു അശ്ശൂർരാജാവിന്നു കൊടുത്തു; എങ്കിലും ഇതിനാൽ അവന്നു സഹായം ഉണ്ടായില്ല.
chapters.niv: Ahaz took some of the things from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace and from the officials and presented them to the king of Assyria, but that did not help him.
chapters.nkjv: For Ahaz took part ofthetreasures from the house of the Lord, from the house of the king, and from the leaders, and he gave it to the king of Assyria; but he did not help him.
chapters.kjv: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the LORD , and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവ് തന്റെ കഷ്ടകാലത്തുകൂടെയും യഹോവയോടു അധികം ദ്രോഹം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: In his time of trouble King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Now in the time of his distress King Ahaz became increasingly unfaithful to the Lord. This isthat King Ahaz.
chapters.kjv: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD : this is that king Ahaz.

chapters.ml: എങ്ങനെയെന്നാൽ: അരാം രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദേവന്മാർ അവരെ സഹായിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ എന്നെയും സഹായിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അവർക്കു ബലികഴിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൻ തന്നെ തോല്പിച്ച ദമ്മേശെക്കിലെ ദേവന്മാർക്കു ബലികഴിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ അവ അവന്നും എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും നാശകാരണമായി ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He offered sacrifices to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him; for he thought, "Since the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them so they will help me." But they were his downfall and the downfall of all Israel.
chapters.nkjv: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him, saying, "Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, I will sacrifice to them that they may help me." But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.
chapters.kjv: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് ദൈവാലയത്തിലെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളെ എടുത്തു ദൈവാലയത്തിലെ ഉപകരണങ്ങളെ ഉടെച്ചു, യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ വാതിലുകൾ അടെച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ ഓരോ മൂലയിലും ബലിപീഠങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Ahaz gathered together the furnishings from the temple of God and cut them in pieces. He shut the doors of the Lord ’s temple and set up altars at every street corner in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: So Ahaz gathered the articles of the house of God, cut in pieces the articles of the house of God, shut up the doors of the house of the Lord, and made for himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD , and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അന്യദേവന്മാർക്കു ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാൻ അവൻ യെഹൂദയിലെ ഓരോ പട്ടണത്തിലും പൂജാഗിരികൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കി തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In every town in Judah he built high places to burn sacrifices to other gods and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of his ancestors.
chapters.nkjv: And in every single city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked to anger the Lord God of his fathers.
chapters.kjv: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മറ്റുള്ളവൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും സകലപ്രവൃത്തികളും ആദ്യവസാനം യെഹൂദയിലെയും യിസ്രായേലിലെയും രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The other events of his reign and all his ways, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Now the rest of his acts and all his ways, from first to last, indeed they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
chapters.kjv: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ് തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു; അവനെ യെരൂശലേംനഗരത്തിൽ അടക്കംചെയ്തു. യിസ്രായേൽരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ കല്ലറകളിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നില്ലതാനും; അവന്റെ മകനായ യെഹിസ്കീയാവു അവന്നു പകരം രാജാവായി.
chapters.niv: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.nkjv: So Ahaz rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem; but they did not bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel. Then Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
chapters.kjv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

chapters.ml: യെഹിസ്കീയാവു ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചാം വയസ്സിൽ വാഴ്ച തുടങ്ങി; ഇരുപത്തൊമ്പതു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു അബീയാ എന്നു പേർ. അവൾ സെഖയ്യാവിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.nkjv: Hezekiah became king whenhewas twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah the daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.kjv: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പനായ ദാവീദ് ചെയ്തതു പോലെ ഒക്കെയും യഹോവെക്കു പ്രസാദമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.
chapters.nkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that David his father had done.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ ഒന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ ഒന്നാം മാസത്തിൽ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ വാതിലുകൾ തുറന്നു അറ്റകുറ്റം തീർത്തു.
chapters.niv: In the first month of the first year of his reign, he opened the doors of the temple of the Lord and repaired them.
chapters.nkjv: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord and repaired them.
chapters.kjv: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD , and repaired them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും ലേവ്യരെയും വരുത്തി കിഴക്കെ വിശാലസ്ഥലത്തു ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂട്ടി അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: He brought in the priests and the Levites, assembled them in the square on the east side
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them in the East Square,
chapters.kjv: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യരേ, എന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾപ്പിൻ, ഇപ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തെയും ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽനിന്നു മലിനത നീക്കിക്കളവിൻ.
chapters.niv: and said: "Listen to me, Levites! Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the temple of the Lord , the God of your ancestors. Remove all defilement from the sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: and said to them: "Hear me, Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and carry out the rubbish from the holy place.
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place .

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ അകൃത്യം ചെയ്തു, നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു അവനെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയും യഹോവയുടെ നിവാസത്തിങ്കൽനിന്നു മുഖം തിരിച്ചു അതിന്നു പുറം കാട്ടുകയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Our parents were unfaithful; they did evil in the eyes of the Lord our God and forsook him. They turned their faces away from the Lord ’s dwelling place and turned their backs on him.
chapters.nkjv: For our fathers have trespassed and done evil in the eyes of the Lord our God; they have forsaken Him, have turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the Lord, and turned their backs onHim.
chapters.kjv: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD , and turned their backs.

chapters.ml: അവർ മണ്ഡപത്തിന്റെ വാതിലുകൾ അടെച്ചു, വിളക്കു കെടുത്തി, വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു ധൂപം കാണിക്കാതെയും ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കാതെയും ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They also shut the doors of the portico and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or present any burnt offerings at the sanctuary to the God of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: They have also shut up the doors of the vestibule, put out the lamps, and have not burned incense or offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ കോപം യെഹൂദയുടെയും യെരൂശലേമിന്റെയും മേൽ വന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ സ്വന്തകണ്ണാൽ കാണുന്നതുപോലെ അവൻ അവരെ നടുക്കത്തിന്നും അമ്പരപ്പിന്നും ഹാസ്യത്തിന്നും വിഷയമാക്കിത്തീർത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore, the anger of the Lord has fallen on Judah and Jerusalem; he has made them an object of dread and horror and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the wrath of the Lord fell upon Judah and Jerusalem, and He has given them up to trouble, to desolation, and to jeering, as you see with your eyes.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ വാളിനാൽ വീഴുകയും, നമ്മുടെ പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരും നമ്മുടെ ഭാര്യമാരും ഇതുനിമിത്തം പ്രവാസത്തിൽ ആകയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is why our fathers have fallen by the sword and why our sons and daughters and our wives are in captivity.
chapters.nkjv: For indeed, because of this our fathers have fallen by the sword; and our sons, our daughters, and our wives are in captivity.
chapters.kjv: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയുടെ ഉഗ്രകോപം നമ്മെ വിട്ടുമാറേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനോടു ഒരു നിയമം ചെയ്‍വാൻ എനിക്കു താല്പര്യം ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Now I intend to make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger will turn away from us.
chapters.nkjv: "Now itis in my heart to make a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that His fierce wrath may turn away from us.
chapters.kjv: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മക്കളേ, ഇപ്പോൾ ഉപേക്ഷ കാണിക്കരുതു; തന്നെ ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നില്പാനും തനിക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരായി ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാനും യഹോവ നിങ്ങളെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him and serve him, to minister before him and to burn incense."
chapters.nkjv: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and that you should minister to Him and burn incense."
chapters.kjv: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ കെഹാത്യരിൽ അമാസായിയുടെ മകൻ മഹത്ത്, അസർയ്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ യോവേൽ, മെരാർയ്യരിൽ അബ്ദിയുടെ മകൻ കീശ്, യെഹല്ലെലേലിന്റെ മകൻ അസർയ്യാവു; ഗേർശോന്യരിൽ സിമ്മയുടെ മകൻ യോവാഹ്,
chapters.niv: Then these Levites set to work: from the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the Merarites, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;
chapters.nkjv: Then these Levites arose: Mahath the son of Amasai and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah and Eden the son of Joah;
chapters.kjv: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

chapters.ml: യോവാഹിന്റെ മകൻ ഏദെൻ; എലീസാ ഫാന്യരിൽ സിമ്രി, യെയൂവേൽ; ആസാഫ്യരിൽ സെഖർയ്യാവു, മത്ഥന്യാവു;
chapters.niv: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; from the descendants of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
chapters.kjv: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

chapters.ml: ഹേമാന്യരിൽ യെഹൂവേൽ, ശിമെയി; യെദൂഥൂന്യരിൽ ശിമയ്യാവു, ഉസ്സീയേൽ എന്നീ ലേവ്യർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: from the descendants of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; from the descendants of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
chapters.nkjv: of the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
chapters.kjv: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ ഒന്നിച്ചു കൂട്ടി തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ വചനപ്രകാരം രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പന അനുസരിച്ചു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തെ വെടിപ്പാക്കുവാൻ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they had assembled their fellow Levites and consecrated themselves, they went in to purify the temple of the Lord , as the king had ordered, following the word of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And they gathered their brethren, sanctified themselves, and went according to the commandment of the king, at the words of the Lord, to cleanse the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD , to cleanse the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ അകം വെടിപ്പാക്കുവാൻ അതിൽ കടന്നു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ കണ്ട മലിനതയൊക്കെയും പുറത്തു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ പ്രാകാരത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ലേവ്യർ അതു കൊണ്ടു പോയി കിദ്രോൻ തോട്ടിൽ ഇട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The priests went into the sanctuary of the Lord to purify it. They brought out to the courtyard of the Lord ’s temple everything unclean that they found in the temple of the Lord . The Levites took it and carried it out to the Kidron Valley.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord to cleanse it, and brought out all the debris that they found in the temple of the Lord to the court of the house of the Lord. And the Levites took it out and carried it to the Brook Kidron.
chapters.kjv: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD , to cleanse it , and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD . And the Levites took it , to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം മാസം ഒന്നാം തിയ്യതി അവർ വിശുദ്ധീകരിപ്പാൻ തുടങ്ങി; എട്ടാം തിയ്യതി അവർ യഹോവയുടെ മണ്ഡപത്തിങ്കൽ എത്തി; ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ എട്ടുദിവസംകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു; ഒന്നാം മാസം പതിനാറാം തിയ്യതി തീർത്തു,
chapters.niv: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and by the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the Lord . For eight more days they consecrated the temple of the Lord itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.
chapters.nkjv: Now they began to sanctify on the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the vestibule of the Lord. So they sanctified the house of the Lord in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
chapters.kjv: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD : so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

chapters.ml: യെഹിസ്കീയാരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അകത്തു ചെന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയം മുഴുവനും ഹോമപീഠവും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും കാഴ്ചയപ്പത്തിന്റെ മേശയും അതിന്റെ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും വെടിപ്പാക്കി,
chapters.niv: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported: "We have purified the entire temple of the Lord , the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table for setting out the consecrated bread, with all its articles.
chapters.nkjv: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and said, "We have cleansed all the house of the Lord, the altar of burnt offerings with all its articles, and the table of the showbread with all its articles.
chapters.kjv: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD , and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

chapters.ml: ആഹാസ്‌രാജാവു തന്റെ വാഴ്ചകാലത്തു തന്റെ ദ്രോഹത്താൽ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും നന്നാക്കി വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവ യഹോവയുടെ യാഗപീഠത്തിൻ മുമ്പിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz removed in his unfaithfulness while he was king. They are now in front of the Lord ’s altar."
chapters.nkjv: Moreover all the articles which King Ahaz in his reign had cast aside in his transgression we have prepared and sanctified; and there they are, before the altar of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യെഹിസ്കീയാരാജാവു കാലത്തെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നഗരാധിപതികളെ കൂട്ടി യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലേക്കു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials together and went up to the temple of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Then King Hezekiah rose early, gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവർ രാജത്വത്തിന്നും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്നും യെഹൂദെക്കും വേണ്ടി ഏഴു കാളയെയും ഏഴു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞാടിനെയും പാപയാഗത്തിന്നായിട്ടു ഏഴു വെള്ളാട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവയെ യഹോവയുടെ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ യാഗംകഴിപ്പാൻ അവൻ അഹരോന്യരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാരോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven male lambs and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary and for Judah. The king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer these on the altar of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And they brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. Then he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ കാളകളെ അറുത്തു; പുരോഹിതന്മാർ രക്തം വാങ്ങി യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ തളിച്ചു; ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരെ അറുത്തു രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ തളിച്ചു. കുഞ്ഞാടുകളെ അറുത്തു രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ തളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and splashed it against the altar; next they slaughtered the rams and splashed their blood against the altar; then they slaughtered the lambs and splashed their blood against the altar.
chapters.nkjv: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. Likewise they killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
chapters.kjv: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള വെള്ളാട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരെ രാജാവിന്റെയും സഭയുടെയും മുമ്പിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവർ അവയുടെമേൽ കൈവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The goats for the sin offering were brought before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.
chapters.nkjv: Then they brought out the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.
chapters.kjv: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്മാർ അവയെ അറുത്തു എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം വരുത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു അവയുടെ രക്തം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ പാപയാഗമായി അർപ്പിച്ചു; എല്ലായിസ്രായേലിന്നും വേണ്ടി ഹോമയാഗവും പാപയാഗവും കഴിക്കേണം എന്നു രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The priests then slaughtered the goats and presented their blood on the altar for a sin offering to atone for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And the priests killed them; and they presented their blood on the altar as a sin offering to make an atonement for all Israel, for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering bemade for all Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
