chapters.nkjv: On that day the number of those who were killed in Shushan the citadel was brought to the king.
chapters.kjv: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ രാജാവു എസ്ഥേർരാജ്ഞിയോടു: യെഹൂദന്മാർ ശൂശൻ രാജധാനിയിൽ അഞ്ഞൂറുപേരെയും ഹാമാന്റെ പത്തു പുത്രന്മാരെയും കൊന്നുമടിച്ചു; രാജാവിന്റെ മറ്റു സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിൽ അവർ എന്തു ചെയ്തിരിക്കും? ഇനിയും നിന്റെ അപേക്ഷ എന്തു? അതു നിനക്കു ലഭിക്കും; ഇനിയും നിന്റെ ആഗ്രഹം എന്തു? അതു നിവർത്തിച്ചുതരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king said to Queen Esther, "The Jews have killed and destroyed five hundred men and the ten sons of Haman in the citadel of Susa. What have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? Now what is your petition? It will be given you. What is your request? It will also be granted."
chapters.nkjv: And the king said to Queen Esther, "The Jews have killed and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the citadel, and the ten sons of Haman. What have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? Now what is your petition? It shall be granted to you. Or what is your further request? It shall be done."
chapters.kjv: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു എസ്ഥേർ: രാജാവിന്നു തിരുവുള്ളമുണ്ടായി ശൂശനിലെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ ഇന്നത്തെ തീർപ്പുപോലെ നാളെയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ അനുവദിക്കയും ഹാമാന്റെ പത്തു പുത്രന്മാരെയും കഴുമരത്തിന്മേൽ തൂക്കിക്കയും ചെയ്യേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "If it pleases the king," Esther answered, "give the Jews in Susa permission to carry out this day’s edict tomorrow also, and let Haman’s ten sons be impaled on poles."
chapters.nkjv: Then Esther said, "If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Shushan to do again tomorrow according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows."
chapters.kjv: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തുകൊൾവാൻ രാജാവു കല്പിച്ചു ശൂശനിൽ തീർപ്പു പരസ്യമാക്കി; ഹാമാന്റെ പത്തു പുത്രന്മാരെ അവർ തൂക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the king commanded that this be done. An edict was issued in Susa, and they impaled the ten sons of Haman.
chapters.nkjv: So the king commanded this to be done; the decree was issued in Shushan, and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.
chapters.kjv: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

chapters.ml: ശൂശനിലെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ ആദാർമാസം പതിനാലാം തിയ്യതിയും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി ശൂശനിൽ മുന്നൂറുപേരെ കൊന്നു; എങ്കിലും കവർച്ചെക്കു അവർ കൈ നീട്ടിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Jews in Susa came together on the fourteenth day of the month of Adar, and they put to death in Susa three hundred men, but they did not lay their hands on the plunder.
chapters.nkjv: And the Jews who were in Shushan gathered together again on the fourteenth day of the month of Adar and killed three hundred men at Shushan; but they did not lay a hand on the plunder.
chapters.kjv: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.

chapters.ml: രാജാവിന്റെ സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിലെ ശേഷം യെഹൂദന്മാർ ആദാർ മാസം പതിമ്മൂന്നാം തിയ്യതി ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി തങ്ങളുടെ ജീവരക്ഷെക്കായി പൊരുതു ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞു വിശ്രമം പ്രാപിച്ചു. അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ വൈരികളിൽ എഴുപത്തയ്യായിരം പേരെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു എങ്കിലും കവർച്ചെക്കു കൈ നീട്ടിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, the remainder of the Jews who were in the king’s provinces also assembled to protect themselves and get relief from their enemies. They killed seventy-five thousand of them but did not lay their hands on the plunder.
chapters.nkjv: The remainder of the Jews in the king’s provinces gathered together and protected their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of their enemies; but they did not lay a hand on the plunder.
chapters.kjv: But the other Jews that were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,

chapters.ml: ആ മാസം പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതിയോ അവർ വിശ്രമിച്ചു വിരുന്നും സന്തോഷവുമുള്ള ദിവസമായിട്ടു അതിനെ ആചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This happened on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar, and on the fourteenth they rested and made it a day of feasting and joy.
chapters.nkjv: Thiswas on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar. And on the fourteenth of themonth they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
chapters.kjv: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

chapters.ml: ശൂശനിലെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ ആ മാസം പതിമ്മൂന്നാം തിയ്യതിയും പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതിയും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി; പതിനഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി അവർ വിശ്രമിച്ചു അതിനെ വിരുന്നും സന്തോഷവുമുള്ള ദിവസമായിട്ടു ആചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Jews in Susa, however, had assembled on the thirteenth and fourteenth, and then on the fifteenth they rested and made it a day of feasting and joy.
chapters.nkjv: But the Jews who were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day, as well as on the fourteenth; and on the fifteenth of themonth they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
chapters.kjv: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു മതിലില്ലാത്ത പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന നാട്ടുപുറങ്ങളിലെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ ആദാർമാസം പതിന്നാലാം തിയ്യതിയെ സന്തോഷവും വിരുന്നും ഉള്ള ദിവസവും ഉത്സവദിനവും ആയിട്ടു ആചരിക്കയും തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ സമ്മാനങ്ങൾ കൊടുത്തയക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That is why rural Jews—those living in villages—observe the fourteenth of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting, a day for giving presents to each other.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Jews of the villages who dwelt in the unwalled towns celebrated the fourteenth day of the month of Adar with gladness and feasting, as a holiday, and for sending presents to one another.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

chapters.ml: ആണ്ടുതോറും ആദാർമാസം പതിന്നാലും പതിനഞ്ചും തിയ്യതിയെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ തങ്ങളുടെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞു വിശ്രമിച്ച ദിവസങ്ങളായിട്ടു ദുഃഖം അവർക്കു സന്തോഷമായും വിലാപം ഉത്സവമായും തീർന്ന മാസമായിട്ടും ആചരിക്കേണമെന്നും
chapters.niv: Mordecai recorded these events, and he sent letters to all the Jews throughout the provinces of King Xerxes, near and far,
chapters.nkjv: And Mordecai wrote these things and sent letters to all the Jews, near and far, who were in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus,
chapters.kjv: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

chapters.ml: അവയെ വിരുന്നും സന്തോഷവുമുള്ള നാളുകളും തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ സമ്മാനങ്ങളും ദരിദ്രന്മാർക്കു ദാനധർമ്മങ്ങളും കൊടുക്കുന്ന നാളുകളും ആയിട്ടു ആചരിക്കേണമെന്നും
chapters.niv: to have them celebrate annually the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar
chapters.nkjv: to establish among them that they should celebrate yearly the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar,
chapters.kjv: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

chapters.ml: അഹശ്വേരോശ്‌രാജാവിന്റെ സകലസംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിലും സമീപത്തും ദൂരത്തും ഉള്ള സകലയെഹൂദന്മാർക്കും ചട്ടമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും മൊർദ്ദെഖായി ഈ കാര്യങ്ങൾ എഴുതി അവർക്കു എഴുത്തു അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: as the time when the Jews got relief from their enemies, and as the month when their sorrow was turned into joy and their mourning into a day of celebration. He wrote them to observe the days as days of feasting and joy and giving presents of food to one another and gifts to the poor.
chapters.nkjv: as the days on which the Jews had rest from their enemies, as the month which was turned from sorrow to joy for them, and from mourning to a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and joy, of sending presents to one another and gifts to the poor.
chapters.kjv: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ തങ്ങൾ തുടങ്ങിയിരുന്നതും മൊർദ്ദെഖായി തങ്ങൾക്കു എഴുതിയിരുന്നതുമായ കാര്യം ഒരു ചട്ടമായി കൈക്കൊണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: So the Jews agreed to continue the celebration they had begun, doing what Mordecai had written to them.
chapters.nkjv: So the Jews accepted the custom which they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,
chapters.kjv: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

chapters.ml: ആഗാഗ്യനായ ഹമ്മെദാഥയുടെ മകനായി എല്ലാ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെയും ശത്രുവായ ഹാമാൻ യെഹൂദന്മാരെ നശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ നേരെ ഉപായം ചിന്തിക്കയും അവരെ നശിപ്പിച്ചു മുടിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പൂരെന്ന ചീട്ടു ഇടുവിക്കയും
chapters.niv: For Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them and had cast the pur (that is, the lot) for their ruin and destruction.
chapters.nkjv: because Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to annihilate them, and had cast Pur (that is, the lot), to consume them and destroy them;
chapters.kjv: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is , the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

chapters.ml: കാര്യം രാജാവിന്നു അറിവു കിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ യെഹൂദന്മാർക്കു വിരോധമായി ചിന്തിച്ചിരുന്ന ഉപായം അവന്റെ തലയിലേക്കു തന്നെ തിരിയുവാനും അവനെയും അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും കഴുമരത്തിന്മേൽ തൂക്കിക്കളവാനും രാജാവു രേഖാമൂലം കല്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ആ നാളുകൾക്കു പൂര് എന്ന പദത്താൽ പൂരീം എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But when the plot came to the king’s attention, he issued written orders that the evil scheme Haman had devised against the Jews should come back onto his own head, and that he and his sons should be impaled on poles.
chapters.nkjv: but when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letter that this wicked plot which Haman had devised against the Jews should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
chapters.kjv: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

chapters.ml: ഈ എഴുത്തിലെ സകലവൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും ആ കാര്യത്തിൽ അവർ തന്നേ കണ്ടവയും അവർക്കു സംഭവിച്ചവയും നിമിത്തം
chapters.niv: (Therefore these days were called Purim, from the word pur.) Because of everything written in this letter and because of what they had seen and what had happened to them,
chapters.nkjv: So they called these days Purim, after the name Pur. Therefore, because of all the words of this letter, what they had seen concerning this matter, and what had happened to them,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ ഈ രണ്ടു ദിവസങ്ങളെ അവയുടെ ചട്ടവും കാലവും അനുസരിച്ചു ആണ്ടുതോറും വീഴ്ചകൂടാതെ ആചരിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണവും
chapters.niv: the Jews took it on themselves to establish the custom that they and their descendants and all who join them should without fail observe these two days every year, in the way prescribed and at the time appointed.
chapters.nkjv: the Jews established and imposed it upon themselves and their descendants and all who would join them, that without fail they should celebrate these two days every year, according to the written instructions and according to the prescribed time,
chapters.kjv: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;

chapters.ml: ഈ ദിവസങ്ങൾ തലമുറതലമുറയായി സകലവംശങ്ങളിലും സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിലും പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും ഓർക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണവും ഈ പൂരീംദിവസങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേനിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകയോ അവയുടെ ഓർമ്മ തങ്ങളുടെ സന്തതിയിൽനിന്നു വിട്ടു പോകയോ ചെയ്യാത്തപ്രകാരവും തങ്ങൾക്കും സന്തതികൾക്കും അവരോടു ചേരുവാനുള്ള എല്ലാവർക്കും ചട്ടമായി കൈക്കൊണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: These days should be remembered and observed in every generation by every family, and in every province and in every city. And these days of Purim should never fail to be celebrated by the Jews—nor should the memory of these days die out among their descendants.
chapters.nkjv: that these days shouldbe remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city, that these days of Purim should not fail tobeobserved among the Jews, and that the memory of them should not perish among their descendants.
chapters.kjv: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

chapters.ml: പൂരീം സംബന്ധിച്ച ഈ രണ്ടാം ലേഖനം സ്ഥിരമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അബീഹയീലിന്റെ മകളായ എസ്ഥേർരാജ്ഞിയും യെഹൂദനായ മൊർദ്ദെഖായിയും സർവ്വാധികാരത്തോടുംകൂടെ എഴുത്തു എഴുതി.
chapters.niv: So Queen Esther, daughter of Abihail, along with Mordecai the Jew, wrote with full authority to confirm this second letter concerning Purim.
chapters.nkjv: Then Queen Esther, the daughter of Abihail, with Mordecai the Jew, wrote with full authority to confirm this second letter about Purim.
chapters.kjv: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദനായ മൊർദ്ദെഖായിയും എസ്ഥേർരാജ്ഞിയും അവർക്കു ചട്ടമാക്കിയിരുന്നതുപോലെയും അവർ തന്നേ തങ്ങളുടെ ഉപവാസത്തിന്റെയും കരച്ചലിന്റെയും സംഗതികളെ തങ്ങൾക്കും സന്തതികൾക്കും ചട്ടമാക്കിയിരുന്നതുപോലെയും ഈ പൂരീംദിവസങ്ങളെ നിശ്ചിതസമയത്തു തന്നേ സ്ഥിരമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: And Mordecai sent letters to all the Jews in the 127 provinces of Xerxes’ kingdom—words of goodwill and assurance—
chapters.nkjv: And Mordecai sent letters to all the Jews, to the one hundred and twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,
chapters.kjv: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഹശ്വേരോശിന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിലുൾപ്പെട്ട നൂറ്റിരുപത്തേഴു സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിലെ സകല യെഹൂദന്മാർക്കും സമാധാനവും സത്യവുമായുള്ള വാക്കുകളോടു കൂടിയ എഴുത്തു അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: to establish these days of Purim at their designated times, as Mordecai the Jew and Queen Esther had decreed for them, and as they had established for themselves and their descendants in regard to their times of fasting and lamentation.
chapters.nkjv: to confirm these days of Purim at their appointed time, as Mordecai the Jew and Queen Esther had prescribed for them, and as they had decreed for themselves and their descendants concerning matters of their fasting and lamenting.
chapters.kjv: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed , according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ എസ്ഥേരിന്റെ ആജ്ഞയാൽ പൂരീംസംബന്ധിച്ച കാര്യങ്ങൾ ഉറപ്പായി അതു പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Esther’s decree confirmed these regulations about Purim, and it was written down in the records.
chapters.nkjv: So the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim, and it was written in the book.
chapters.kjv: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അഹശ്വേരോശ്‌രാജാവു ദേശത്തിന്നും സമുദ്രത്തിലെ ദ്വീപുകൾക്കും ഒരു കരം കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: King Xerxes imposed tribute throughout the empire, to its distant shores.
chapters.nkjv: And King Ahasuerus imposed tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.
chapters.kjv: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ബലത്തിന്റെയും പരാക്രമത്തിന്റെയും സകലവൃത്താന്തങ്ങളും രാജാവു മൊർദ്ദെഖായിയെ ഉയർത്തിയ ഉന്നത പദവിയുടെ വിവരവും മേദ്യയിലെയും പാർസ്യയിലെയും രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ വൃത്താന്തപുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And all his acts of power and might, together with a full account of the greatness of Mordecai, whom the king had promoted, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Media and Persia?
chapters.nkjv: Now all the acts of his power and his might, and the account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
chapters.kjv: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദനായ മൊർദ്ദെഖായി അഹശ്വേരോശ്‌രാജാവിന്റെ രണ്ടാമനും യെഹൂദന്മാരിൽവെച്ചു മഹാനും സഹോദരസംഘത്തിന്നു ഇഷ്ടനും സ്വജനത്തിന്നു ഗുണകാംക്ഷിയും തന്റെ സർവ്വവംശത്തിന്നും അനുകൂലവാദിയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Mordecai the Jew was second in rank to King Xerxes, preeminent among the Jews, and held in high esteem by his many fellow Jews, because he worked for the good of his people and spoke up for the welfare of all the Jews.
chapters.nkjv: For Mordecai the Jew was second to King Ahasuerus, and was great among the Jews and well received by the multitude of his brethren, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his countrymen.
chapters.kjv: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

chapters.ml: ഊസ് ദേശത്തു ഇയ്യോബ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു പുരുഷൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ നിഷ്കളങ്കനും നേരുള്ളവനും ദൈവഭക്തനും ദോഷം വിട്ടകലുന്നവനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the land of Uz there lived a man whose name was Job. This man was blameless and upright; he feared God and shunned evil.
chapters.nkjv: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God and shunned evil.
chapters.kjv: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു ഏഴു പുത്രന്മാരും മൂന്നു പുത്രിമാരും ജനിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He had seven sons and three daughters,
chapters.nkjv: And seven sons and three daughters were born to him.
chapters.kjv: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു ഏഴായിരം ആടും മൂവായിരം ഒട്ടകവും അഞ്ഞൂറു ഏർ കാളയും അഞ്ഞൂറു പെൺ കഴുതയുമായ മൃഗസമ്പത്തും ഏറ്റവും വളരെ ദാസജനവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ സകലപൂർവ്വദിഗ്വാസികളിലും മഹാനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and he owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen and five hundred donkeys, and had a large number of servants. He was the greatest man among all the people of the East.
chapters.nkjv: Also, his possessions were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very large household, so that this man was the greatest of all the people of the East.
chapters.kjv: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ ദിവസത്തിൽ താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വിരുന്നു കഴിക്കയും തങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഭക്ഷിച്ചു പാനം ചെയ്‍വാൻ തങ്ങളുടെ മൂന്നു സഹോദരിമാരെയും ആളയച്ചു വിളിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്ക പതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: His sons used to hold feasts in their homes on their birthdays, and they would invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
chapters.nkjv: And his sons would go and feast intheir houses, each on his appointed day, and would send and invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
chapters.kjv: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വിരുന്നുനാളുകൾ വട്ടംതികയുമ്പോൾ ഇയ്യോബ് പക്ഷെ എന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ പാപം ചെയ്തു ദൈവത്തെ ഹൃദയംകൊണ്ടു ത്യജിച്ചുപോയിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ആളയച്ചു അവരെ വരുത്തി ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കയും നന്നാ രാവിലെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരുടെ സംഖ്യക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളെ കഴിക്കയും ചെയ്യും. ഇങ്ങനെ ഇയ്യോബ് എല്ലായ്പോഴും ചെയ്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: When a period of feasting had run its course, Job would make arrangements for them to be purified. Early in the morning he would sacrifice a burnt offering for each of them, thinking, "Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts." This was Job’s regular custom.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the days of feasting had run their course, that Job would send and sanctify them, and he would rise early in the morning and offer burnt offerings accordingto the number of them all. For Job said, "It may be that my sons have sinned and cursed God in their hearts." Thus Job did regularly.
chapters.kjv: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദിവസം ദൈവപുത്രന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നില്പാൻ ചെന്നു; അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ സാത്താനും ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: One day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan also came among them.
chapters.kjv: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD , and Satan came also among them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സാത്താനോടു: നീ എവിടെനിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു സാത്താൻ യഹോവയോടു: ഞാൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഊടാടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചിട്ടു വരുന്നു എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the Lord , "From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "From where do you come?" So Satan answered the Lord and said, "From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking back and forth on it."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD , and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സാത്താനോടു: എന്റെ ദാസനായ ഇയ്യോബിന്മേൽ നീ ദൃഷ്ടിവെച്ചുവോ? അവനെപ്പോലെ നിഷ്കളങ്കനും നേരുള്ളവനും ദൈവഭക്തനും ദോഷം വിട്ടകലുന്നവനും ഭൂമിയിൽ ആരും ഇല്ലല്ലോ എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered My servant Job, that thereis none like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, one who fears God and shuns evil?"
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു സാത്താൻ യഹോവയോടു: വെറുതെയോ ഇയ്യോബ് ദൈവഭക്തനായിരിക്കുന്നതു?
chapters.niv: "Does Job fear God for nothing?" Satan replied.
chapters.nkjv: So Satan answered the Lord and said, "Does Job fear God for nothing?
chapters.kjv: Then Satan answered the LORD , and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

chapters.ml: നീ അവന്നും അവന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നും അവന്നുള്ള സകലത്തിന്നും ചുറ്റും വേലികെട്ടീട്ടില്ലയോ? നീ അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിയെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ മൃഗസമ്പത്തു ദേശത്തു പെരുകിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Have you not put a hedge around him and his household and everything he has? You have blessed the work of his hands, so that his flocks and herds are spread throughout the land.
chapters.nkjv: Have You not made a hedge around him, around his household, and around all that he has on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions have increased in the land.
chapters.kjv: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

chapters.ml: തൃക്കൈ നീട്ടി അവന്നുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ഒന്നു തൊടുക; അവൻ നിന്നെ മുഖത്തു നോക്കി ത്യജിച്ചുപറയും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But now stretch out your hand and strike everything he has, and he will surely curse you to your face."
chapters.nkjv: But now, stretch out Your hand and touch all that he has, and he will surely curse You to Your face!"
chapters.kjv: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം സാത്താനോടു: ഇതാ, അവന്നുള്ളതൊക്കെയും നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ മേൽ മാത്രം കയ്യേറ്റം ചെയ്യരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അങ്ങനെ സാത്താൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധി വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Satan, "Very well, then, everything he has is in your power, but on the man himself do not lay a finger." Then Satan went out from the presence of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, all that he has is in your power; only do not lay a hand on his person." So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദിവസം ഇയ്യോബിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരും മൂത്ത ജ്യേഷ്ഠന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ തിന്നുകയും വീഞ്ഞു കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: One day when Job’s sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a day when his sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house;
chapters.kjv: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദൂതൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽവന്നു: കാളകളെ പൂട്ടുകയും പെൺകഴുതകൾ അരികെ മേഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കയും ആയിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: a messenger came to Job and said, "The oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby,
chapters.nkjv: and a messenger came to Job and said, "The oxen were plowing and the donkeys feeding beside them,
chapters.kjv: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു ശെബായർ വന്നു അവയെ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോകയും വേലക്കാരെ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വെട്ടിക്കൊല്ലുകയും ചെയ്തു; വിവരം നിന്നെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ ഒരുത്തൻ മാത്രം വഴുതിപ്പോന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and the Sabeans attacked and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
chapters.nkjv: when the Sabeans raided them and took them away—indeed they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
chapters.kjv: And the Sabeans fell upon them , and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ വേറൊരുത്തൻ വന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ തീ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു വീണു കത്തി, ആടുകളും വേലക്കാരും അതിന്നു ഇരയായ്പോയി; വിവരം നിന്നെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ ഒരുത്തൻ മാത്രം വഴുതിപ്പോന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The fire of God fell from the heavens and burned up the sheep and the servants, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
chapters.nkjv: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "The fire of God fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
chapters.kjv: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ വന്നു: പെട്ടെന്നു കല്ദയർ മൂന്നു കൂട്ടമായി വന്നു ഒട്ടകങ്ങളെ പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പോകയും വേലക്കാരെ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വെട്ടിക്കൊല്ലുകയും ചെയ്തു; വിവരം നിന്നെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ ഒരുത്തൻ മാത്രം വഴുതിപ്പോന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The Chaldeans formed three raiding parties and swept down on your camels and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
chapters.nkjv: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "The Chaldeans formed three bands, raided the camels and took them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
chapters.kjv: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ വന്നു; നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരും മൂത്ത ജ്യേഷ്ഠന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ തിന്നുകയും വീഞ്ഞു കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: While he was still speaking, yet another messenger came and said, "Your sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,
chapters.nkjv: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
chapters.kjv: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു മരുഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ഒരു കൊടുങ്കാറ്റു വന്നു വീട്ടിന്റെ നാലു മൂലെക്കും അടിച്ചു: അതു യൌവനക്കാരുടെമേൽ വീണു; അവർ മരിച്ചുപോയി; വിവരം നിന്നെ അറിയിപ്പാൻ ഞാനൊരുത്തൻ മാത്രം വഴുതിപ്പോന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on them and they are dead, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
chapters.nkjv: and suddenly a great wind came from across the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young people, and they are dead; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഇയ്യോബ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു വസ്ത്രം കീറി തല ചിരെച്ചു സാഷ്ടാംഗം വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: At this, Job got up and tore his robe and shaved his head. Then he fell to the ground in worship
chapters.nkjv: Then Job arose, tore his robe, and shaved his head; and he fell to the ground and worshiped.
chapters.kjv: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

chapters.ml: നഗ്നനായി ഞാൻ എന്റെ അമ്മയുടെ ഗർഭത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു, നഗ്നനായി തന്നേ മടങ്ങിപ്പോകും, യഹോവ തന്നു, യഹോവ എടുത്തു, യഹോവയുടെ നാമം വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said: "Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will depart. The Lord gave and the Lord has taken away; may the name of the Lord be praised."
chapters.nkjv: And he said: "Naked I came from my mother’s womb, And naked shall I return there. The Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away; Blessed be the name of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഇതിലൊന്നിലും ഇയ്യോബ് പാപം ചെയ്കയോ ദൈവത്തിന്നു ഭോഷത്വം ആരോപിക്കയോ ചെയ്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: In all this, Job did not sin by charging God with wrongdoing.
chapters.nkjv: In all this Job did not sin nor charge God with wrong.
chapters.kjv: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ഒരു ദിവസം ദൈവപുത്രന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നില്പാൻ ചെന്നു; സാത്താനും അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നില്പാൻ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: On another day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them to present himself before him.
chapters.nkjv: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD , and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സാത്താനോടു: നീ എവിടെനിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു സാത്താൻ യഹോവയോടു: ഞാൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഊടാടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചിട്ടു വരുന്നു എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the Lord , "From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "From where do you come?" Satan answered the Lord and said, "From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking back and forth on it."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the LORD , and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സാത്താനോടു: എന്റെ ദാസനായ ഇയ്യോബിന്റെമേൽ നീ ദൃഷ്ടിവെച്ചുവോ? അവനെപ്പോലെ നിഷ്കളങ്കനും നേരുള്ളവനും ദൈവഭക്തനും ദോഷം വിട്ടകലുന്നവനും ഭൂമിയിൽ ആരും ഇല്ലല്ലോ; അവൻ തന്റെ ഭക്തിമുറുകെ പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; വെറുതെ അവനെ നശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ എന്നെ സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil. And he still maintains his integrity, though you incited me against him to ruin him without any reason."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered My servant Job, that thereis none like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, one who fears God and shuns evil? And still he holds fast to his integrity, although you incited Me against him, to destroy him without cause."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

chapters.ml: സാത്താൻ യഹോവയോടു: ത്വക്കിന്നു പകരം ത്വക്; മനുഷ്യൻ തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും തന്റെ ജീവന്നു പകരം കൊടുത്തുകളയും.
chapters.niv: "Skin for skin!" Satan replied. "A man will give all he has for his own life.
chapters.nkjv: So Satan answered the Lord and said, "Skin for skin! Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
chapters.kjv: And Satan answered the LORD , and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കൈ നീട്ടി അവന്റെ അസ്ഥിയും മാംസവും ഒന്നു തൊടുക; അവൻ നിന്നെ മുഖത്തു നോക്കി ത്യജിച്ചുപറയും എന്നുത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But now stretch out your hand and strike his flesh and bones, and he will surely curse you to your face."
chapters.nkjv: But stretch out Your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will surely curse You to Your face!"
chapters.kjv: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സാത്താനോടു: ഇതാ, അവൻ നിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ പ്രാണനെമാത്രം തൊടരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to Satan, "Very well, then, he is in your hands; but you must spare his life."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, he is in your hand, but spare his life."
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ സാത്താൻ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധി വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഇയ്യോബിനെ ഉള്ളങ്കാൽമുതൽ നെറുകവരെ വല്ലാത്ത പരുക്കളാൽ ബാധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord and afflicted Job with painful sores from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.
chapters.nkjv: So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord, and struck Job with painful boils from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head.
chapters.kjv: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു ഓട്ടിൻ കഷണം എടുത്തു തന്നെത്താൻ ചുരണ്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ചാരത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Job took a piece of broken pottery and scraped himself with it as he sat among the ashes.
chapters.nkjv: And he took for himself a potsherd with which to scrape himself while he sat in the midst of the ashes.
chapters.kjv: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ അവനോടു: നീ ഇനിയും നിന്റെ ഭക്തി മുറുകെ പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നുവോ? ദൈവത്തെ ത്യജിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു മരിച്ചുകളക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His wife said to him, "Are you still maintaining your integrity? Curse God and die!"
chapters.nkjv: Then his wife said to him, "Do you still hold fast to your integrity? Curse God and die!"
chapters.kjv: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളോടു: ഒരു പൊട്ടി സംസാരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ നീ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു; നാം ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു നന്മ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നു; തിന്മയും കൈക്കൊള്ളരുതോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഇതിൽ ഒന്നിലും ഇയ്യോബ് അധരങ്ങളാൽ പാപം ചെയ്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: He replied, "You are talking like a foolish woman. Shall we accept good from God, and not trouble?" In all this, Job did not sin in what he said.
chapters.nkjv: But he said to her, "You speak as one of the foolish women speaks. Shall we indeed accept good from God, and shall we not accept adversity?" In all this Job did not sin with his lips.
chapters.kjv: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം തേമാന്യനായ എലീഫസ്, ശൂഹ്യനായ ബിൽദാദ്, നയമാത്യനായ സോഫർ എന്നിങ്ങിനെ ഇയ്യോബിന്റെ മൂന്നു സ്നേഹിതന്മാർ ഈ അനർത്ഥമൊക്കെയും അവന്നു ഭവിച്ചതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തുനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു അവനോടു സഹതപിപ്പാനും അവനെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാനും പോകേണമെന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞൊത്തു.
chapters.niv: When Job’s three friends, Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite, heard about all the troubles that had come upon him, they set out from their homes and met together by agreement to go and sympathize with him and comfort him.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this adversity that had come upon him, each one came from his own place—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. For they had made an appointment together to come and mourn with him, and to comfort him.
chapters.kjv: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

chapters.ml: അവർ അകലെവെച്ചു നോക്കിയാറെ അവനെ തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞില്ല; അവർ ഉറക്കെ കരഞ്ഞു വസ്ത്രം കീറി പൊടി വാരി മേലോട്ടു തലയിൽ വിതറി.
chapters.niv: When they saw him from a distance, they could hardly recognize him; they began to weep aloud, and they tore their robes and sprinkled dust on their heads.
chapters.nkjv: And when they raised their eyes from afar, and did not recognize him, they lifted their voices and wept; and each one tore his robe and sprinkled dust on his head toward heaven.
chapters.kjv: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വ്യസനം അതികഠിനമെന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവർ ആരും ഒരു വാക്കും മിണ്ടാതെ ഏഴു രാപ്പകൽ അവനോടുകൂടെ നിലത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights. No one said a word to him, because they saw how great his suffering was.
chapters.nkjv: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.
chapters.kjv: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഇയ്യോബ് വായി തുറന്നു തന്റെ ജന്മദിവസത്തെ ശപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
chapters.nkjv: After this Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
chapters.kjv: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

chapters.ml: ഇയ്യോബ് പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: He said:
chapters.nkjv: And Job spoke, and said:
chapters.kjv: And Job spake, and said,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ജനിച്ച ദിവസവും ഒരു ആൺ ഉല്പാദിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞ രാത്രിയും നശിച്ചുപോകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "May the day of my birth perish, and the night that said, ‘A boy is conceived!’
chapters.nkjv: "May the day perish on which I was born, And the night inwhich it was said, ‘A male child is conceived.’
chapters.kjv: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

chapters.ml: ആ നാൾ ഇരുണ്ടുപോകട്ടെ; മേലിൽനിന്നു ദൈവം അതിനെ കടാക്ഷിക്കരുതേ; പ്രകാശം അതിന്മേൽ ശോഭിക്കയുമരുതേ.
chapters.niv: That day—may it turn to darkness; may God above not care about it; may no light shine on it.
chapters.nkjv: May that day be darkness; May God above not seek it, Nor the light shine upon it.
chapters.kjv: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

chapters.ml: ഇരുളും അന്ധതമസ്സും അതിനെ സ്വാധീനമാക്കട്ടെ; ഒരു മേഘം അതിന്മേൽ അമരട്ടെ; പകലിനെ ഇരുട്ടുന്നതൊക്കെയും അതിനെ പേടിപ്പിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May gloom and utter darkness claim it once more; may a cloud settle over it; may blackness overwhelm it.
chapters.nkjv: May darkness and the shadow of death claim it; May a cloud settle on it; May the blackness of the day terrify it.
chapters.kjv: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

chapters.ml: ആ രാത്രിയെ കൂരിരുൾ പിടിക്കട്ടെ; അതു ആണ്ടിന്റെ നാളുകളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ സന്തോഷിക്കരുതു; മാസങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തിൽ വരികയും അരുതു.
chapters.niv: That night—may thick darkness seize it; may it not be included among the days of the year nor be entered in any of the months.
chapters.nkjv: Asfor that night, may darkness seize it; May it not rejoice among the days of the year, May it not come into the number of the months.
chapters.kjv: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

chapters.ml: അതേ, ആ രാത്രി മച്ചിയായിരിക്കട്ടെ; ഉല്ലാസഘോഷം അതിലുണ്ടാകരുതു.
chapters.niv: May that night be barren; may no shout of joy be heard in it.
chapters.nkjv: Oh, may that night be barren! May no joyful shout come into it!
chapters.kjv: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.

chapters.ml: മഹാസർപ്പത്തെ ഇളക്കുവാൻ സമർത്ഥരായി ദിവസത്തെ ശപിക്കുന്നവർ അതിനെ ശപിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May those who curse days curse that day, those who are ready to rouse Leviathan.
chapters.nkjv: May those curse it who curse the day, Those who are ready to arouse Leviathan.
chapters.kjv: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ സന്ധ്യാനക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ ഇരുണ്ടു പോകട്ടെ. അതു വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നു കാത്തിരുന്നു കിട്ടാതെ പോകട്ടെ; അതു ഉഷസ്സിന്റെ കണ്ണിമ ഒരിക്കലും കാണരുതു.
chapters.niv: May its morning stars become dark; may it wait for daylight in vain and not see the first rays of dawn,
chapters.nkjv: May the stars of its morning be dark; May it look for light, but have none, And not see the dawning of the day;
chapters.kjv: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

chapters.ml: അതു എനിക്കു ഗർഭദ്വാരം അടെച്ചില്ലല്ലോ; എന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നു കഷ്ടം മറെച്ചില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: for it did not shut the doors of the womb on me to hide trouble from my eyes.
chapters.nkjv: Because it did not shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, Nor hide sorrow from my eyes.
chapters.kjv: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഗർഭപാത്രത്തിൽവെച്ചു മരിക്കാഞ്ഞതെന്തു? ഉദരത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ തന്നേ പ്രാണൻ പോകാതിരുന്നതെന്തു?
chapters.niv: "Why did I not perish at birth, and die as I came from the womb?
chapters.nkjv: "Why did I not die at birth? Why did I not perish when I came from the womb?
chapters.kjv: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

chapters.ml: മുഴങ്കാൽ എന്നെ ഏറ്റുകൊണ്ടതു എന്തിനു? എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ മുല ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതെന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: Why were there knees to receive me and breasts that I might be nursed?
chapters.nkjv: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breasts, that I should nurse?
chapters.kjv: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ കിടന്നു വിശ്രമിക്കുമായിരുന്നു; ഞാൻ ഉറങ്ങി വിശ്രാന്തി പ്രാപിക്കുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest
chapters.nkjv: For now I would have lain still and been quiet, I would have been asleep; Then I would have been at rest
chapters.kjv: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾക്കു ഏകാന്തനിവാസങ്ങൾ പണിത ഭൂരാജാക്കന്മാരോടും മന്ത്രിമാരോടും അഥവാ,
chapters.niv: with kings and rulers of the earth, who built for themselves places now lying in ruins,
chapters.nkjv: With kings and counselors of the earth, Who built ruins for themselves,
chapters.kjv: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;

chapters.ml: കനകസമ്പന്നരായി സ്വഭവനങ്ങൾ വെള്ളികൊണ്ടു നിറെച്ചുവെച്ച പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരോടും കൂടെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.
chapters.nkjv: Or with princes who had gold, Who filled their houses with silver;
chapters.kjv: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

chapters.ml: അല്ലെങ്കിൽ, ഗർഭം അലസിപ്പോയിട്ടു കുഴിച്ചിട്ടുകളഞ്ഞ പിണ്ഡംപോലെയും വെളിച്ചം കണ്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്ത പിള്ളകളെപ്പോലെയും ഞാൻ ഇല്ലാതെ പോകുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Or why was I not hidden away in the ground like a stillborn child, like an infant who never saw the light of day?
chapters.nkjv: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, Like infants who never saw light?
chapters.kjv: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ദുർജ്ജനം ഉപദ്രവിക്കാതെയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവിടെ ക്ഷീണിച്ചു പോയവർ വിശ്രമിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There the wicked cease from turmoil, and there the weary are at rest.
chapters.nkjv: There the wicked cease from troubling, And there the weary are at rest.
chapters.kjv: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ബദ്ധന്മാർ ഒരുപോലെ സുഖമായിരിക്കുന്നു; പീഡകന്റെ ശബ്ദം അവർ കേൾക്കാതിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Captives also enjoy their ease; they no longer hear the slave driver’s shout.
chapters.nkjv: There the prisoners rest together; They do not hear the voice of the oppressor.
chapters.kjv: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

chapters.ml: ചെറിയവനും വലിയവനും അവിടെ ഒരുപോലെ; ദാസന്നു യജമാനന്റെ കീഴിൽനിന്നു വിടുതൽ കിട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The small and the great are there, and the slaves are freed from their owners.
chapters.nkjv: The small and great are there, And the servant is free from his master.
chapters.kjv: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

chapters.ml: അരിഷ്ടനു പ്രകാശവും ദുഃഖിതന്മാർക്കു ജീവനും കൊടുക്കുന്നതെന്തിനു?
chapters.niv: "Why is light given to those in misery, and life to the bitter of soul,
chapters.nkjv: "Why is light given to him who is in misery, And life to the bitter of soul,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;

chapters.ml: അവർ മരണത്തിന്നായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു, അതു വരുന്നില്ലതാനും; നിധിക്കായി ചെയ്യുന്നതിലുമധികം അവർ അതിന്നായി കുഴിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: to those who long for death that does not come, who search for it more than for hidden treasure,
chapters.nkjv: Who long for death, but it does not come, And search for it more than hidden treasures;
chapters.kjv: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

chapters.ml: അവർ ശവക്കുഴി കണ്ടാൽ സന്തോഷിച്ചു ഘോഷിച്ചുല്ലസിക്കും
chapters.niv: who are filled with gladness and rejoice when they reach the grave?
chapters.nkjv: Who rejoice exceedingly, And are glad when they can find the grave?
chapters.kjv: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

chapters.ml: വഴി മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന പുരുഷന്നും ദൈവം നിരോധിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവന്നും ജീവനെ കൊടുക്കുന്നതെന്തിനു?
chapters.niv: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
chapters.nkjv: Whyislightgiven to a man whose way is hidden, And whom God has hedged in?
chapters.kjv: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

chapters.ml: ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നു മുമ്പെ എനിക്കു നെടുവീർപ്പു വരുന്നു; എന്റെ ഞരക്കം വെള്ളംപോലെ ഒഴുകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For sighing has become my daily food; my groans pour out like water.
chapters.nkjv: For my sighing comes before I eat, And my groanings pour out like water.
chapters.kjv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പേടിച്ചതു തന്നേ എനിക്കു നേരിട്ടു; ഞാൻ ഭയപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നതു എനിക്കു ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: What I feared has come upon me; what I dreaded has happened to me.
chapters.nkjv: For the thing I greatly feared has come upon me, And what I dreaded has happened to me.
chapters.kjv: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സ്വസ്ഥനായില്ല, വിശ്രമിച്ചില്ല, ആശ്വസിച്ചതുമില്ല; പിന്നെയും അതിവേദന എടുക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I have no peace, no quietness; I have no rest, but only turmoil."
chapters.nkjv: I am not at ease, nor am I quiet; I have no rest, for trouble comes."
chapters.kjv: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു തേമാന്യനായ എലീഫസ് ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
chapters.nkjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
chapters.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

chapters.ml: നിന്നോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞാൽ നീ മുഷിയുമോ? എന്നാൽ വാക്കടക്കുവാൻ ആർക്കു കഴിയും?
chapters.niv: "If someone ventures a word with you, will you be impatient? But who can keep from speaking?
chapters.nkjv: "If one attempts a word with you, will you become weary? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
chapters.kjv: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

chapters.ml: നീ പലരേയും ഉപദേശിച്ചു തളർന്ന കൈകളെ ശക്തീകരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Think how you have instructed many, how you have strengthened feeble hands.
chapters.nkjv: Surely you have instructed many, And you have strengthened weak hands.
chapters.kjv: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

chapters.ml: വീഴുന്നവനെ നിന്റെ വാക്കു താങ്ങി കുഴയുന്ന മുഴങ്കാൽ നീ ഉറപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Your words have supported those who stumbled; you have strengthened faltering knees.
chapters.nkjv: Your words have upheld him who was stumbling, And you have strengthened the feeble knees;
chapters.kjv: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ നിനക്കതു ഭവിച്ചിട്ടു നീ വിഷാദിക്കുന്നു; നിനക്കതു തട്ടീട്ടു നീ ഭ്രമിച്ചുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But now trouble comes to you, and you are discouraged; it strikes you, and you are dismayed.
chapters.nkjv: But now it comes upon you, and you are weary; It touches you, and you are troubled.
chapters.kjv: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഭക്തി നിന്റെ ആശ്രയമല്ലയോ? നിന്റെ നടപ്പിന്റെ നിർമ്മലത നിന്റെ പ്രത്യാശയല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Should not your piety be your confidence and your blameless ways your hope?
chapters.nkjv: Is not your reverence your confidence? And the integrity of your ways your hope?
chapters.kjv: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

chapters.ml: ഓർത്തു നോക്കുക: നിർദ്ദോഷിയായി നശിച്ചവൻ ആർ? നേരുള്ളവർ എവിടെ മുടിഞ്ഞുപോയിട്ടുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: "Consider now: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Where were the upright ever destroyed?
chapters.nkjv: "Remember now, who ever perished being innocent? Or where were the upright ever cut off?
chapters.kjv: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കണ്ടേടത്തോളം അന്യായം ഉഴുതു കഷ്ടത വിതെക്കുന്നവർ അതു തന്നേ കൊയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As I have observed, those who plow evil and those who sow trouble reap it.
chapters.nkjv: Even as I have seen, Those who plow iniquity And sow trouble reap the same.
chapters.kjv: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ശ്വാസത്താൽ അവർ നശിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ കോപത്തിന്റെ ഊത്തിനാൽ മുടിഞ്ഞുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At the breath of God they perish; at the blast of his anger they are no more.
chapters.nkjv: By the blast of God they perish, And by the breath of His anger they are consumed.
chapters.kjv: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

chapters.ml: സിംഹത്തിന്റെ ഗർജ്ജനവും കേസരിയുടെ നാദവും ബാലസിംഹങ്ങളുടെ ദന്തങ്ങളും അറ്റുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The lions may roar and growl, yet the teeth of the great lions are broken.
chapters.nkjv: The roaring of the lion, The voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions are broken.
chapters.kjv: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

chapters.ml: സിംഹം ഇരയില്ലായ്കയാൽ നശിക്കുന്നു; സിംഹിയുടെ കുട്ടികൾ ചിതറിപ്പോകുന്നു;
chapters.niv: The lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
chapters.nkjv: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, And the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
chapters.kjv: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരു ഗൂഢവചനം എത്തി; അതിന്റെ മന്ദസ്വരം എന്റെ ചെവിയിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: "A word was secretly brought to me, my ears caught a whisper of it.
chapters.nkjv: "Now a word was secretly brought to me, And my ear received a whisper of it.
chapters.kjv: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യർക്കു ഗാഢനിദ്ര പിടിക്കുന്നേരം രാത്രിദർശനങ്ങളാലുള്ള മനോഭാവനകളിൽ ഭയവും നടുക്കവും എന്നെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Amid disquieting dreams in the night, when deep sleep falls on people,
chapters.nkjv: In disquieting thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falls on men,
chapters.kjv: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അസ്ഥികൾ ഒക്കെയും കുലുങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: fear and trembling seized me and made all my bones shake.
chapters.nkjv: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones shake.
chapters.kjv: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

chapters.ml: ഒരാത്മാവു എന്റെ മുഖത്തിന്നെതിരെ കടന്നു എന്റെ ദേഹത്തിന്നു രോമഹർഷം ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body stood on end.
chapters.nkjv: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair on my body stood up.
chapters.kjv: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

chapters.ml: ഒരു പ്രതിമ എന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നെതിരെ നിന്നു; എങ്കിലും അതിന്റെ രൂപം ഞാൻ തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞില്ല; മന്ദമായോരു സ്വരം ഞാൻ കേട്ടതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: It stopped, but I could not tell what it was. A form stood before my eyes, and I heard a hushed voice:
chapters.nkjv: It stood still, But I could not discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes; Therewas silence; Then I heard a voice saying:
chapters.kjv: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying ,

chapters.ml: മർത്യൻ ദൈവത്തിലും നീതിമാൻ ആകുമോ? നരൻ സ്രഷ്ടാവിലും നിർമ്മലനാകുമോ?
chapters.niv: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can even a strong man be more pure than his Maker?
chapters.nkjv: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can a man be more pure than his Maker?
chapters.kjv: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, സ്വദാസന്മാരിലും അവന്നു വിശ്വാസമില്ല; തന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരിലും അവൻ കുറ്റം ആരോപിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: If God places no trust in his servants, if he charges his angels with error,
chapters.nkjv: If He puts no trust in His servants, If He charges His angels with error,
chapters.kjv: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

chapters.ml: പൊടിയിൽനിന്നുത്ഭവിച്ചു മണ്പുരകളിൽ പാർത്തു പുഴുപോലെ ചതെഞ്ഞു പോകുന്നവരിൽ എത്ര അധികം!
chapters.niv: how much more those who live in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who are crushed more readily than a moth!
chapters.nkjv: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before a moth?
chapters.kjv: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

chapters.ml: ഉഷസ്സിന്നും സന്ധ്യെക്കും മദ്ധ്യേ അവർ തകർന്നു പോകുന്നു; ആരും ഗണ്യമാക്കാതെ അവർ എന്നേക്കും നശിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Between dawn and dusk they are broken to pieces; unnoticed, they perish forever.
chapters.nkjv: They are broken in pieces from morning till evening; They perish forever, with no one regarding.
chapters.kjv: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it .

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ കൂടാരക്കയറു അറ്റുപോയിട്ടു അവർ ജ്ഞാനഹീനരായി മരിക്കുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Are not the cords of their tent pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’
chapters.nkjv: Does not their own excellence go away? They die, even without wisdom.’
chapters.kjv: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.

chapters.ml: വിളിച്ചുനോക്കുക; ഉത്തരം പറയുന്നവനുണ്ടോ? നീ വിശുദ്ധന്മാരിൽ ആരെ ശരണം പ്രാപിക്കും?
chapters.niv: "Call if you will, but who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
chapters.nkjv: "Call out now; Is there anyone who will answer you? And to which of the holy ones will you turn?
chapters.kjv: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

chapters.ml: നീരസം ഭോഷനെ കൊല്ലുന്നു; ഈർഷ്യ മൂഢനെ ഹിംസിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.
chapters.nkjv: For wrath kills a foolish man, And envy slays a simple one.
chapters.kjv: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

chapters.ml: മൂഢൻ വേരൂന്നുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു ക്ഷണത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പാർപ്പിടത്തെ ശപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: I myself have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly his house was cursed.
chapters.nkjv: I have seen the foolish taking root, But suddenly I cursed his dwelling place.
chapters.kjv: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മക്കൾ രക്ഷയോടകന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ രക്ഷകനില്ലാതെ വാതിൽക്കൽവെച്ചു തകർന്നുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: His children are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.
chapters.nkjv: His sons are far from safety, They are crushed in the gate, And thereis no deliverer.
chapters.kjv: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them .

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വിളവു വിശപ്പുള്ളവൻ തിന്നുകളയും; മുള്ളുകളിൽനിന്നും അതിനെ പറിച്ചെടുക്കും; അവരുടെ സമ്പത്തു ദാഹമുള്ളവർ കപ്പിക്കളയും.
chapters.niv: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from among thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
chapters.nkjv: Because the hungry eat up his harvest, Taking it even from the thorns, And a snare snatches their substance.
chapters.kjv: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

chapters.ml: അനർത്ഥം ഉത്ഭവിക്കുന്നതു പൂഴിയിൽനിന്നല്ല; കഷ്ടത മുളെക്കുന്നതു നിലത്തുനിന്നുമല്ല;
chapters.niv: For hardship does not spring from the soil, nor does trouble sprout from the ground.
chapters.nkjv: For affliction does not come from the dust, Nor does trouble spring from the ground;
chapters.kjv: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

chapters.ml: തീപ്പൊരി ഉയരെ പറക്കുംപോലെ മനുഷ്യൻ കഷ്ടതെക്കായി ജനിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
chapters.nkjv: Yet man is born to trouble, As the sparks fly upward.
chapters.kjv: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ ദൈവത്തിങ്കലേക്കു നോക്കുമായിരുന്നു; എന്റെ കാര്യം ദൈവത്തിങ്കൽ ഏല്പിക്കുമായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: "But if I were you, I would appeal to God; I would lay my cause before him.
chapters.nkjv: "But as for me, I would seek God, And to God I would commit my cause—
chapters.kjv: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

chapters.ml: അവൻ, ആരാഞ്ഞുകൂടാത്ത വങ്കാര്യങ്ങളും അസംഖ്യമായ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.
chapters.nkjv: Who does great things, and unsearchable, Marvelous things without number.
chapters.kjv: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭൂതലത്തിൽ മഴപെയ്യിക്കുന്നു; വയലുകളിലേക്കു വെള്ളം വിടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He provides rain for the earth; he sends water on the countryside.
chapters.nkjv: He gives rain on the earth, And sends waters on the fields.
chapters.kjv: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

chapters.ml: അവൻ താണവരെ ഉയർത്തുന്നു; ദുഃഖിക്കുന്നവരെ രക്ഷയിലേക്കു കയറ്റുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The lowly he sets on high, and those who mourn are lifted to safety.
chapters.nkjv: He sets on high those who are lowly, And those who mourn are lifted to safety.
chapters.kjv: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉപായികളുടെ സൂത്രങ്ങളെ അബദ്ധമാക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ കൈകൾ കാര്യം സാധിപ്പിക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: He thwarts the plans of the crafty, so that their hands achieve no success.
chapters.nkjv: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot carry out their plans.
chapters.kjv: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ജ്ഞാനികളെ അവരുടെ കൌശലത്തിൽ പിടിക്കുന്നു; വക്രബുദ്ധികളുടെ ആലോചന മറിഞ്ഞുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and the schemes of the wily are swept away.
chapters.nkjv: He catches the wise in their own craftiness, And the counsel of the cunning comes quickly upon them.
chapters.kjv: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

chapters.ml: പകൽസമയത്തു അവർക്കു ഇരുൾ നേരിടുന്നു; ഉച്ചസമയത്തു അവർ രാത്രിയിലെന്നപോലെ തപ്പിനടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Darkness comes upon them in the daytime; at noon they grope as in the night.
chapters.nkjv: They meet with darkness in the daytime, And grope at noontime as in the night.
chapters.kjv: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദരിദ്രനെ അവരുടെ വായെന്ന വാളിങ്കൽനിന്നും ബലവാന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും രക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth; he saves them from the clutches of the powerful.
chapters.nkjv: But He saves the needy from the sword, From the mouth of the mighty, And from their hand.
chapters.kjv: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ എളിയവന്നു പ്രത്യാശയുണ്ടു; നീതികെട്ടവനോ വായ്പൊത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
chapters.nkjv: So the poor have hope, And injustice shuts her mouth.
chapters.kjv: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ശാസിക്കുന്ന മനുഷ്യൻ ഭാഗ്യവാൻ; സർവ്വശക്തന്റെ ശിക്ഷ നീ നിരസിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: "Blessed is the one whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
chapters.nkjv: "Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects; Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
chapters.kjv: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

chapters.ml: അവൻ മുറിവേല്പക്കിയും മുറി കെട്ടുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവൻ ചതെക്കയും തൃക്കൈ പൊറുപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For he wounds, but he also binds up; he injures, but his hands also heal.
chapters.nkjv: For He bruises, but He binds up; He wounds, but His hands make whole.
chapters.kjv: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

chapters.ml: ആറു കഷ്ടത്തിൽനിന്നു അവൻ നിന്നെ വിടുവിക്കും; ഏഴാമത്തേതിലും തിന്മ നിന്നെ തൊടുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: From six calamities he will rescue you; in seven no harm will touch you.
chapters.nkjv: He shall deliver you in six troubles, Yes, in seven no evil shall touch you.
chapters.kjv: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷാമകാലത്തു അവൻ നിന്നെ മരണത്തിൽനിന്നും യുദ്ധത്തിൽ വാളിന്റെ വെട്ടിൽനിന്നും വിടുവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: In famine he will deliver you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.
chapters.nkjv: In famine He shall redeem you from death, And in war from the power of the sword.
chapters.kjv: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

chapters.ml: നാവെന്ന ചമ്മട്ടിക്കു നീ ഗുപ്തനാകും; നാശം വരുമ്പോൾ നീ ഭയപ്പെടുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: You will be protected from the lash of the tongue, and need not fear when destruction comes.
chapters.nkjv: You shall be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, And you shall not be afraid of destruction when it comes.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

chapters.ml: നാശവും ക്ഷാമവും കണ്ടു നീ ചിരിക്കും; കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളെ നീ പേടിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the wild animals.
chapters.nkjv: You shall laugh at destruction and famine, And you shall not be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
chapters.kjv: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

chapters.ml: വയലിലെ കല്ലുകളോടു നിനക്കു സഖ്യതയുണ്ടാകും; കാട്ടിലെ മൃഗങ്ങൾ നിന്നോടു ഇണങ്ങിയിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
chapters.nkjv: For you shall have a covenant with the stones of the field, And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you.
chapters.kjv: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കൂടാരം നിർഭയം എന്നു നീ അറിയും; നിന്റെ പാർപ്പിടം നീ പരിശോധിക്കും, ഒന്നും കാണാതെയിരിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: You will know that your tent is secure; you will take stock of your property and find nothing missing.
chapters.nkjv: You shall know that your tent is in peace; You shall visit your dwelling and find nothing amiss.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സന്താനം അസംഖ്യമെന്നും നിന്റെ പ്രജ നിലത്തെ പുല്ലുപോലെയെന്നും നീ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: You will know that your children will be many, and your descendants like the grass of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: You shall also know that your descendants shallbe many, And your offspring like the grass of the earth.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

chapters.ml: തക്ക സമയത്തു കറ്റക്കൂമ്പാരം അടുക്കിവെക്കുന്നതുപോലെ നീ പൂർണ്ണവാർദ്ധക്യത്തിൽ കല്ലറയിൽ കടക്കും.
chapters.niv: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like sheaves gathered in season.
chapters.nkjv: You shall come to the grave at a full age, As a sheaf of grain ripens in its season.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ അതു ആരാഞ്ഞുനോക്കി, അതു അങ്ങനെതന്നേ ആകുന്നു; നീ അതു കേട്ടു ഗ്രഹിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: "We have examined this, and it is true. So hear it and apply it to yourself."
chapters.nkjv: Behold, this we have searched out; It is true. Hear it, and know for yourself."
chapters.kjv: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഇയ്യോബ് ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then Job replied:
chapters.nkjv: Then Job answered and said:
chapters.kjv: But Job answered and said,

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ എന്റെ വ്യസനം ഒന്നു തൂക്കിനോക്കിയെങ്കിൽ! എന്റെ വിപത്തു സ്വരൂപിച്ചു തുലാസിൽ വെച്ചെങ്കിൽ!
chapters.niv: "If only my anguish could be weighed and all my misery be placed on the scales!
chapters.nkjv: "Oh, that my grief were fully weighed, And my calamity laid with it on the scales!
chapters.kjv: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

chapters.ml: അതു കടല്പുറത്തെ മണലിനെക്കാൾ ഭാരമേറുന്നതു. അതുകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ വാക്കു തെറ്റിപ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It would surely outweigh the sand of the seas— no wonder my words have been impetuous.
chapters.nkjv: For then it would be heavier than the sand of the sea— Therefore my words have been rash.
chapters.kjv: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

chapters.ml: സർവ്വശക്തന്റെ അസ്ത്രങ്ങൾ എന്നിൽ തറെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവയുടെ വിഷം എന്റെ ആത്മാവു കുടിക്കുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ഘോരത്വങ്ങൾ എന്റെ നേരെ അണിനിരന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The arrows of the Almighty are in me, my spirit drinks in their poison; God’s terrors are marshaled against me.
chapters.nkjv: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me; My spirit drinks in their poison; The terrors of God are arrayed against me.
chapters.kjv: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

chapters.ml: പുല്ലുള്ളേടത്തു കാട്ടുകഴുത ചിനെക്കുമോ? തീറ്റി തിന്നുമ്പോൾ കാള മുക്കുറയിടുമോ?
chapters.niv: Does a wild donkey bray when it has grass, or an ox bellow when it has fodder?
chapters.nkjv: Does the wild donkey bray when it has grass, Or does the ox low over its fodder?
chapters.kjv: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

chapters.ml: രുചിയില്ലാത്തതു ഉപ്പുകൂടാതെ തിന്നാമോ? മുട്ടയുടെ വെള്ളെക്കു രുചിയുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the sap of the mallow ?
chapters.nkjv: Can flavorless food be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
chapters.kjv: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

chapters.ml: തൊടുവാൻ എനിക്കു വെറുപ്പു തോന്നുന്നതു എനിക്കു അറെപ്പുള്ള ഭക്ഷണമായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I refuse to touch it; such food makes me ill.
chapters.nkjv: My soul refuses to touch them; They are as loathsome food to me.
chapters.kjv: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ, എന്റെ അപേക്ഷ സാധിച്ചെങ്കിൽ! എന്റെ വാഞ്ഛ ദൈവം എനിക്കു നല്കിയെങ്കിൽ!
chapters.niv: "Oh, that I might have my request, that God would grant what I hope for,
chapters.nkjv: "Oh, that I might have my request, That God would grant me the thing that I long for!
chapters.kjv: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

chapters.ml: എന്നെ തകർക്കുവാൻ ദൈവം പ്രസാദിച്ചെങ്കിൽ! തൃക്കൈ നീട്ടി എന്നെ ഖണ്ഡിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞെങ്കിൽ!
chapters.niv: that God would be willing to crush me, to let loose his hand and cut off my life!
chapters.nkjv: That it would please God to crush me, That He would loose His hand and cut me off!
chapters.kjv: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ എനിക്കു ആശ്വാസം ലഭിക്കുമായിരുന്നു; കനിവറ്റ വേദനയിൽ ഞാൻ ഉല്ലസിക്കുമായിരുന്നു. പരിശുദ്ധന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെ ഞാൻ നിഷേധിച്ചിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ;
chapters.niv: Then I would still have this consolation— my joy in unrelenting pain— that I had not denied the words of the Holy One.
chapters.nkjv: Then I would still have comfort; Though in anguish I would exult, He will not spare; For I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
chapters.kjv: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കാത്തിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ ശക്തി എന്തുള്ളു? ദീർഘക്ഷമ കാണിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ അന്തം എന്തു?
chapters.niv: "What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What prospects, that I should be patient?
chapters.nkjv: "What strength do I have, that I should hope? And what is my end, that I should prolong my life?
chapters.kjv: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ബലം കല്ലിന്റെ ബലമോ? എന്റെ മാംസം താമ്രമാകുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: Do I have the strength of stone? Is my flesh bronze?
chapters.nkjv: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh bronze?
chapters.kjv: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കേവലം തുണയില്ലാത്തവനല്ലയോ? രക്ഷ എന്നെ വിട്ടുപോയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Do I have any power to help myself, now that success has been driven from me?
chapters.nkjv: Is my help not within me? And is success driven from me?
chapters.kjv: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

chapters.ml: ദുഃഖിതനോടു സ്നേഹിതൻ ദയ കാണിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു; അല്ലാഞ്ഞാൽ അവൻ സർവ്വശക്തന്റെ ഭയം ത്യജിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Anyone who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
chapters.nkjv: "To him who is afflicted, kindness shouldbeshown by his friend, Even though he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
chapters.kjv: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ ഒരു തോടുപോലെ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു; വറ്റിപ്പോകുന്ന തോടുകളുടെ ചാൽപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: But my brothers are as undependable as intermittent streams, as the streams that overflow
chapters.nkjv: My brothers have dealt deceitfully like a brook, Like the streams of the brooks that pass away,
chapters.kjv: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

chapters.ml: നീർക്കട്ടകൊണ്ടു അവ കലങ്ങിപ്പോകുന്നു; ഹിമം അവയിൽ ഉരുകി കാണാതെപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: when darkened by thawing ice and swollen with melting snow,
chapters.nkjv: Which are dark because of the ice, And into which the snow vanishes.
chapters.kjv: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

chapters.ml: ചൂടുപിടിക്കുന്നേരം അവ വറ്റിപ്പോകുന്നു; ഉഷ്ണം ആകുമ്പോൾ അവ അവിടെനിന്നു പൊയ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but that stop flowing in the dry season, and in the heat vanish from their channels.
chapters.nkjv: When it is warm, they cease to flow; When it is hot, they vanish from their place.
chapters.kjv: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

chapters.ml: സ്വാർത്ഥങ്ങൾ വഴി വിട്ടുതിരിഞ്ഞു ചെല്ലുന്നു; അവ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ചെന്നു നശിച്ചുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go off into the wasteland and perish.
chapters.nkjv: The paths of their way turn aside, They go nowhere and perish.
chapters.kjv: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

chapters.ml: തേമയുടെ സ്വാർത്ഥങ്ങൾ തിരിഞ്ഞുനോക്കുന്നു; ശെബയുടെ യാത്രാഗണം അവെക്കായി പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The caravans of Tema look for water, the traveling merchants of Sheba look in hope.
chapters.nkjv: The caravans of Tema look, The travelers of Sheba hope for them.
chapters.kjv: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

chapters.ml: പ്രതീക്ഷിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ലജ്ജിക്കുന്നു; അവിടത്തോളം ചെന്നു നാണിച്ചു പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They are distressed, because they had been confident; they arrive there, only to be disappointed.
chapters.nkjv: They are disappointed because they were confident; They come there and are confused.
chapters.kjv: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളും ഇപ്പോൾ അതുപോലെ ആയി വിപത്തു കണ്ടിട്ടു നിങ്ങൾ പേടിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now you too have proved to be of no help; you see something dreadful and are afraid.
chapters.nkjv: For now you are nothing, You see terror and are afraid.
chapters.kjv: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു തരുവിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ സമ്പത്തിൽനിന്നു എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി കൈക്കൂലി കൊടുപ്പിൻ;
chapters.niv: Have I ever said, ‘Give something on my behalf, pay a ransom for me from your wealth,
chapters.nkjv: Did I ever say, ‘Bring something to me’? Or, ‘Offer a bribe for me from your wealth’?
chapters.kjv: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

chapters.ml: വൈരിയുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു എന്നെ വിടുവിപ്പിൻ; നിഷ്ഠൂരന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു എന്നെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പിൻ എന്നിങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: deliver me from the hand of the enemy, rescue me from the clutches of the ruthless’?
chapters.nkjv: Or, ‘Deliver me from the enemy’s hand’? Or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of oppressors’?
chapters.kjv: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

chapters.ml: എന്നെ ഉപദേശിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ മിണ്ടാതെയിരിക്കാം; ഏതിൽ തെറ്റിപ്പോയെന്നു എനിക്കു ബോധം വരുത്തുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Teach me, and I will be quiet; show me where I have been wrong.
chapters.nkjv: "Teach me, and I will hold my tongue; Cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
chapters.kjv: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

chapters.ml: നേരുള്ള വാക്കുകൾക്കു എത്ര ബലം! നിങ്ങളുടെ ശാസനെക്കോ എന്തു ഫലം?
chapters.niv: How painful are honest words! But what do your arguments prove?
chapters.nkjv: How forceful are right words! But what does your arguing prove?
chapters.kjv: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

chapters.ml: വാക്കുകളെ ആക്ഷേപിപ്പാൻ വിചാരിക്കുന്നുവോ? ആശയറ്റവന്റെ വാക്കുകൾ കാറ്റിന്നു തുല്യമത്രേ.
chapters.niv: Do you mean to correct what I say, and treat my desperate words as wind?
chapters.nkjv: Do you intend to rebuke my words, And the speeches of a desperate one, whichare as wind?
