chapters.nkjv: The Lord reigns; Let the peoples tremble! He dwells between the cherubim; Let the earth be moved!
chapters.kjv: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സീയോനിൽ വലിയവനും സകലജാതികൾക്കും മീതെ ഉന്നതനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Great is the Lord in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.
chapters.nkjv: The Lordis great in Zion, And He is high above all the peoples.
chapters.kjv: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പരിശുദ്ധൻ എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവർ നിന്റെ മഹത്തും ഭയങ്കരവുമായ നാമത്തെ സ്തുതിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.
chapters.nkjv: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy.
chapters.kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

chapters.ml: ന്യായതല്പരനായ രാജാവിന്റെ ബലത്തെ നീ നേരോടെ സ്ഥിരമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു. നീ യാക്കോബിൽ നീതിയും ന്യായവും നടത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The King is mighty, he loves justice— you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.
chapters.nkjv: The King’s strength also loves justice; You have established equity; You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
chapters.kjv: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ പുകഴ്ത്തുവിൻ; അവന്റെ പാദപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ നമസ്കരിപ്പിൻ; അവൻ പരിശുദ്ധൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.
chapters.nkjv: Exalt the Lord our God, And worship at His footstool— He is holy.
chapters.kjv: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരിൽ മോശെയും അഹരോനും, അവന്റെ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നവരിൽ ശമൂവേലും; ഇവർ യഹോവയോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അവൻ അവർക്കു ഉത്തരമരുളി.
chapters.niv: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the Lord and he answered them.
chapters.nkjv: Moses and Aaron were among His priests, And Samuel was among those who called upon His name; They called upon the Lord, and He answered them.
chapters.kjv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD , and he answered them.

chapters.ml: മേഘസ്തംഭത്തിൽനിന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു; അവർ അവന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യങ്ങളും അവൻ കൊടുത്ത ചട്ടവും പ്രമാണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.
chapters.nkjv: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; They kept His testimonies and the ordinance He gave them.
chapters.kjv: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, നീ അവർക്കുത്തരമരുളി; നീ അവർക്കു ക്ഷമ കാണിക്കുന്ന ദൈവവും അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കു പ്രതികാരകനും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Lord our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.
chapters.nkjv: You answered them, O Lord our God; You were to them God-Who-Forgives, Though You took vengeance on their deeds.
chapters.kjv: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയെ പുകഴ്ത്തുവിൻ; അവന്റെ വിശുദ്ധപർവ്വതത്തിൽ നമസ്കരിപ്പിൻ; നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ പരിശുദ്ധനല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the Lord our God is holy.
chapters.nkjv: Exalt the Lord our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the Lord our God is holy.
chapters.kjv: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

chapters.ml: സകല ഭൂവാസികളുമായുള്ളോരേ, യഹോവെക്കു ആർപ്പിടുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Make a joyful shout to the Lord, all you lands!
chapters.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD , all ye lands.

chapters.ml: സന്തോഷത്തോടെ യഹോവയെ സേവിപ്പിൻ; സംഗീതത്തോടെ അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വരുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
chapters.nkjv: Serve the Lord with gladness; Come before His presence with singing.
chapters.kjv: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്നേ ദൈവം എന്നറിവിൻ; അവൻ നമ്മെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി, നാം അവന്നുള്ളവർ ആകുന്നു; അവന്റെ ജനവും അവൻ മേയിക്കുന്ന ആടുകളും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Know that the Lord is God. It is he who made us, and we are his ; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
chapters.nkjv: Know that the Lord, He is God; Itis He who has made us, and not we ourselves; Weare His people and the sheep of His pasture.
chapters.kjv: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വാതിലുകളിൽ സ്തോത്രത്തോടും അവന്റെ പ്രാകാരങ്ങളിൽ സ്തുതിയോടും കൂടെ വരുവിൻ; അവന്നു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്തു അവന്റെ നാമത്തെ വാഴ്ത്തുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
chapters.nkjv: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise. Be thankful to Him, and bless His name.
chapters.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നല്ലവനല്ലോ, അവന്റെ ദയ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു; അവന്റെ വിശ്വസ്തത തലമുറതലമുറയായും ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lordis good; His mercy is everlasting, And His truth endures to all generations.
chapters.kjv: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദയയെയും ന്യായത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു പാടും; യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ നിനക്കു കീർത്തനം പാടും.
chapters.niv: I will sing of your love and justice; to you, Lord , I will sing praise.
chapters.nkjv: I will sing of mercy and justice; To You, O Lord, I will sing praises.
chapters.kjv: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD , will I sing.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിഷ്കളങ്കമാർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ശ്രദ്ധവെക്കും; എപ്പോൾ നീ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരും? ഞാൻ എന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ നിഷ്കളങ്കഹൃദയത്തോടെ പെരുമാറും.
chapters.niv: I will be careful to lead a blameless life— when will you come to me? I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.
chapters.nkjv: I will behave wisely in a perfect way. Oh, when will You come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
chapters.kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഒരു നീചകാര്യം എന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നു മുമ്പിൽ വെക്കുകയില്ല; ക്രമം കെട്ടവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിയെ ഞാൻ വെറുക്കുന്നു; അതു എന്നോടു ചേർന്നു പറ്റുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.
chapters.nkjv: I will set nothing wicked before my eyes; I hate the work of those who fall away; It shall not cling to me.
chapters.kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

chapters.ml: വക്രഹൃദയം എന്നോടു അകന്നിരിക്കും; ദുഷ്ടതയെ ഞാൻ അറികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The perverse of heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with what is evil.
chapters.nkjv: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will not know wickedness.
chapters.kjv: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person .

chapters.ml: കൂട്ടുകാരനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഏഷണി പറയുന്നവനെ ഞാൻ നശിപ്പിക്കും; ഉന്നതഭാവവും നിഗളഹൃദയവും ഉള്ളവനെ ഞാൻ സഹായിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.
chapters.nkjv: Whoever secretly slanders his neighbor, Him I will destroy; The one who has a haughty look and a proud heart, Him I will not endure.
chapters.kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

chapters.ml: ദേശത്തിലെ വിശ്വസ്തന്മാർ എന്നോടുകൂടെ വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ ദൃഷ്ടി അവരുടെമേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; നിഷ്കളങ്കമാർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നടക്കുന്നവൻ എന്നെ ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; the one whose walk is blameless will minister to me.
chapters.nkjv: My eyes shallbe on the faithful of the land, That they may dwell with me; He who walks in a perfect way, He shall serve me.
chapters.kjv: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

chapters.ml: വഞ്ചനചെയ്യുന്നവൻ എന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വസിക്കയില്ല; ഭോഷ്കു പറയുന്നവൻ എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഉറെച്ചുനിൽക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.
chapters.nkjv: He who works deceit shall not dwell within my house; He who tells lies shall not continue in my presence.
chapters.kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ നഗരത്തിൽനിന്നു സകല ദുഷ്‌പ്രവൃത്തിക്കാരെയും ഛേദിച്ചുകളയേണ്ടതിന്നു ദേശത്തിലെ ദുഷ്ടന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ രാവിലെതോറും നശിപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Early I will destroy all the wicked of the land, That I may cut off all the evildoers from the city of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, എന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേൾക്കേണമേ; എന്റെ നിലവിളി തിരുസന്നിധിയിൽ വരുമാറാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Hear my prayer, Lord ; let my cry for help come to you.
chapters.nkjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, And let my cry come to You.
chapters.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD , and let my cry come unto thee.

chapters.ml: കഷ്ടദിവസത്തിൽ നിന്റെ മുഖം എനിക്കു മറെക്കരുതേ; നിന്റെ ചെവി എങ്കലേക്കു ചായിക്കേണമേ; ഞാൻ വിളിക്കുന്ന നാളിൽ വേഗത്തിൽ എനിക്കു ഉത്തരമരുളേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.
chapters.nkjv: Do not hide Your face from me in the day of my trouble; Incline Your ear to me; In the day that I call, answer me speedily.
chapters.kjv: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നാളുകൾ പുകപോലെ കഴിഞ്ഞുപോകുന്നു; എന്റെ അസ്ഥികൾ തീക്കൊള്ളിപോല വെന്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.
chapters.nkjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, And my bones are burned like a hearth.
chapters.kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ഹൃദയം അരിഞ്ഞ പുല്ലുപോലെ ഉണങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ ഭക്ഷണംകഴിപ്പാൻ മറന്നുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.
chapters.nkjv: My heart is stricken and withered like grass, So that I forget to eat my bread.
chapters.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ഞരക്കത്തിന്റെ ഒച്ചനിമിത്തം എന്റെ അസ്ഥികൾ മാംസത്തോടു പറ്റുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In my distress I groan aloud and am reduced to skin and bones.
chapters.nkjv: Because of the sound of my groaning My bones cling to my skin.
chapters.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിലെ വേഴാമ്പൽപോലെ ആകുന്നു; ശൂന്യസ്ഥലത്തെ മൂങ്ങാപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
chapters.nkjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.
chapters.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഉറക്കിളെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; വീട്ടിന്മുകളിൽ തനിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന കുരികിൽ പോലെ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.
chapters.nkjv: I lie awake, And am like a sparrow alone on the housetop.
chapters.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾ ഇടവിടാതെ എന്നെ നിന്ദിക്കുന്നു; എന്നോടു ചീറുന്നവർ എന്റെ പേർ ചൊല്ലി ശപിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.
chapters.nkjv: My enemies reproach me all day long; Those who deride me swear an oath against me.
chapters.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അപ്പംപോലെ ചാരം തിന്നുന്നു; എന്റെ പാനീയത്തിൽ കണ്ണുനീർ കലക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears
chapters.nkjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
chapters.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കോപവും ക്രോധവും ഹേതുവായിട്ടു തന്നേ; നീ എന്നെ എടുത്തു എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.
chapters.nkjv: Because of Your indignation and Your wrath; For You have lifted me up and cast me away.
chapters.kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ആയുസ്സു ചാഞ്ഞുപോകുന്ന നിഴൽ പോലെയാകുന്നു; ഞാൻ പുല്ലുപോലെ ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
chapters.nkjv: My days are like a shadow that lengthens, And I wither away like grass.
chapters.kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

chapters.ml: നീയോ, യഹോവേ, എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളവൻ; നിന്റെ നാമം തലമുറതലമുറയായി നിലനില്ക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But you, Lord , sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.
chapters.nkjv: But You, O Lord, shall endure forever, And the remembrance of Your name to all generations.
chapters.kjv: But thou, O LORD , shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

chapters.ml: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സീയോനോടു കരുണ കാണിക്കും; അവളോടു കൃപ കാണിപ്പാനുള്ള കാലം, അതേ, അതിന്നു സമയം വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.
chapters.nkjv: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; For the time to favor her, Yes, the set time, has come.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർക്കു അവളുടെ കല്ലുകളോടു താല്പര്യവും അവളുടെ പൂഴിയോടു അലിവും തോന്നുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.
chapters.nkjv: For Your servants take pleasure in her stones, And show favor to her dust.
chapters.kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സീയോനെ പണികയും തന്റെ മഹത്വത്തിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷനാകയും
chapters.niv: The nations will fear the name of the Lord , all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.
chapters.nkjv: So the nations shall fear the name of the Lord, And all the kings of the earth Your glory.
chapters.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD , and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഗതികളുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കടാക്ഷിക്കയും അവരുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥന നിരസിക്കാതെയിരിക്കയും ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: For the Lord will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord shall build up Zion; He shall appear in His glory.
chapters.kjv: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

chapters.ml: ജാതികൾ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തെയും ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലരാജാക്കന്മാരും നിന്റെ മഹത്വത്തെയും ഭയപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.
chapters.nkjv: He shall regard the prayer of the destitute, And shall not despise their prayer.
chapters.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

chapters.ml: വരുവാനിരിക്കുന്ന തലമുറെക്കു വേണ്ടി ഇതു എഴുതിവെക്കും; സൃഷ്ടിക്കപ്പെടുവാനുള്ള ജനം യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the Lord :
chapters.nkjv: This will be written for the generation to come, That a people yet to be created may praise the Lord.
chapters.kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെ സേവിപ്പാൻ ജാതികളും രാജ്യങ്ങളും കൂടി വന്നപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: "The Lord looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,
chapters.nkjv: For He looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven the Lord viewed the earth,
chapters.kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

chapters.ml: സീയോനിൽ യഹോവയുടെ നാമത്തെയും യെരൂശലേമിൽ അവന്റെ സ്തുതിയെയും പ്രസ്താവിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."
chapters.nkjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, To release those appointed to death,
chapters.kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

chapters.ml: ബദ്ധന്മാരുടെ ഞരക്കം കേൾപ്പാനും മരണത്തിന്നു നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരെ വിടുവിപ്പാനും
chapters.niv: So the name of the Lord will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem
chapters.nkjv: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem,
chapters.kjv: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ വിശുദ്ധമായ ഉയരത്തിൽനിന്നു നോക്കി സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഭൂമിയെ തൃക്കൺപാർത്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
chapters.kjv: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD .

chapters.ml: അവൻ വഴിയിൽവെച്ചു എന്റെ ബലം ക്ഷയിപ്പിച്ചു; അവൻ എന്റെ നാളുകളെ ചുരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.
chapters.nkjv: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
chapters.kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദൈവമേ, ആയുസ്സിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യത്തിൽ എന്നെ എടുത്തുകളയരുതേ എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു; നിന്റെ സംവത്സരങ്ങൾ തലമുറതലമുറയായി ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So I said: "Do not take me away, my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.
chapters.nkjv: I said, "O my God, Do not take me away in the midst of my days; Your years are throughout all generations.
chapters.kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

chapters.ml: പൂർവ്വകാലത്തു നീ ഭൂമിക്കു അടിസ്ഥാനമായിട്ടു; ആകാശം നിന്റെ കൈകളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തി ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
chapters.nkjv: Of old You laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
chapters.kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

chapters.ml: അവ നശിക്കും നീയോ നിലനില്ക്കും; അവയെല്ലാം വസ്ത്രംപോലെ പഴകിപ്പോകും; ഉടുപ്പുപോലെ നീ അവയെ മാറ്റും; അവ മാറിപ്പോകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.
chapters.nkjv: They will perish, but You will endure; Yes, they will all grow old like a garment; Like a cloak You will change them, And they will be changed.
chapters.kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

chapters.ml: നീയോ അനന്യനാകുന്നു; നിന്റെ സംവത്സരങ്ങൾ അവസാനിക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.
chapters.nkjv: But You are the same, And Your years will have no end.
chapters.kjv: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ മക്കൾ നിർഭയം വസിക്കും; അവരുടെ സന്തതി നിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നിലനില്ക്കും.
chapters.niv: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you."
chapters.nkjv: The children of Your servants will continue, And their descendants will be established before You."
chapters.kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

chapters.ml: എൻ മനമേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുക; എന്റെ സർവ്വാന്തരംഗവുമേ, അവന്റെ വിശുദ്ധനാമത്തെ വാഴ്ത്തുക.
chapters.niv: Praise the Lord , my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.
chapters.nkjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name!
chapters.kjv: Bless the LORD , O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

chapters.ml: എൻ മനമേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുക; അവന്റെ ഉപകാരങ്ങൾ ഒന്നും മറക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Praise the Lord , my soul, and forget not all his benefits—
chapters.nkjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits:
chapters.kjv: Bless the LORD , O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിന്റെ അകൃത്യം ഒക്കെയും മോചിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ സകലരോഗങ്ങളെയും സൌഖ്യമാക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,
chapters.nkjv: Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases,
chapters.kjv: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിന്റെ ജീവനെ നാശത്തിൽനിന്നു വീണ്ടെടുക്കുന്നു; അവൻ ദയയും കരുണയും നിന്നെ അണിയിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,
chapters.nkjv: Who redeems your life from destruction, Who crowns you with lovingkindness and tender mercies,
chapters.kjv: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ യൌവനം കഴുകനെപ്പോലെ പുതുകിവരത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവൻ നിന്റെ വായക്കു നന്മകൊണ്ടു തൃപ്തിവരുത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
chapters.nkjv: Who satisfies your mouth with good things, Sothat your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
chapters.kjv: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സകലപീഡിതന്മാർക്കും വേണ്ടി നീതിയും ന്യായവും നടത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord executes righteousness And justice for all who are oppressed.
chapters.kjv: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ വഴികളെ മോശെയെയും തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളെയും അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:
chapters.nkjv: He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ കരുണയും കൃപയും നിറഞ്ഞവൻ ആകുന്നു; ദീർഘക്ഷമയും മഹാദയയും ഉള്ളവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The Lord is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.
chapters.nkjv: The Lordis merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abounding in mercy.
chapters.kjv: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എല്ലായ്പോഴും ഭർത്സിക്കയില്ല; എന്നേക്കും കോപം സംഗ്രഹിക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;
chapters.nkjv: He will not always strive withus, Nor will He keep Hisanger forever.
chapters.kjv: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ പാപങ്ങൾക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം നമ്മോടു ചെയ്യുന്നില്ല; നമ്മുടെ അകൃത്യങ്ങൾക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം നമ്മോടു പകരം ചെയ്യുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.
chapters.nkjv: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor punished us according to our iniquities.
chapters.kjv: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

chapters.ml: ആകാശം ഭൂമിക്കുമീതെ ഉയർന്നിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ അവന്റെ ദയ അവന്റെ ഭക്തന്മാരോടു വലുതായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;
chapters.nkjv: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward those who fear Him;
chapters.kjv: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

chapters.ml: ഉദയം അസ്തമയത്തോടു അകന്നിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ അവൻ നമ്മുടെ ലംഘനങ്ങളെ നമ്മോടു അകറ്റിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
chapters.nkjv: As far as the east is from the west, So far has He removed our transgressions from us.
chapters.kjv: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

chapters.ml: അപ്പന്നു മക്കളോടു കരുണ തോന്നുന്നതുപോലെ യഹോവെക്കു തന്റെ ഭക്തന്മാരോടു കരുണ തോന്നുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him;
chapters.nkjv: As a father pities his children, So the Lord pities those who fear Him.
chapters.kjv: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ പ്രകൃതി അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ; നാം പൊടി എന്നു അവൻ ഓർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.
chapters.nkjv: For He knows our frame; He remembers that we are dust.
chapters.kjv: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യന്റെ ആയുസ്സു പുല്ലുപോലെയാകുന്നു; വയലിലെ പൂപോലെ അവൻ പൂക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The life of mortals is like grass, they flourish like a flower of the field;
chapters.nkjv: Asfor man, his days are like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
chapters.kjv: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

chapters.ml: കാറ്റു അതിന്മേൽ അടിക്കുമ്പോൾ അതു ഇല്ലാതെപോകുന്നു; അതിന്റെ സ്ഥലം പിന്നെ അതിനെ അറികയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.
chapters.nkjv: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone, And its place remembers it no more.
chapters.kjv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദയയോ എന്നും എന്നേക്കും അവന്റെ ഭക്തന്മാർക്കും അവന്റെ നീതി മക്കളുടെ മക്കൾക്കും ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: But from everlasting to everlasting the Lord ’s love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children’s children—
chapters.nkjv: But the mercy of the Lordis from everlasting to everlasting On those who fear Him, And His righteousness to children’s children,
chapters.kjv: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ നിയമത്തെ പ്രാണിക്കുന്നവർക്കും അവന്റെ കല്പനകളെ ഓർത്തു ആചരിക്കുന്നവർക്കും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.
chapters.nkjv: To such as keep His covenant, And to those who remember His commandments to do them.
chapters.kjv: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തെ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ സ്ഥാപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ രാജത്വം സകലത്തെയും ഭരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has established His throne in heaven, And His kingdom rules over all.
chapters.kjv: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വചനത്തിന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടു അവന്റെ ആജ്ഞ അനുസരിക്കുന്ന വീരന്മാരായി അവന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരായുള്ളോരേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Praise the Lord , you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.
chapters.nkjv: Bless the Lord, you His angels, Who excel in strength, who do His word, Heeding the voice of His word.
chapters.kjv: Bless the LORD , ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്യുന്ന ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരായി അവന്റെ സകലസൈന്യങ്ങളുമായുള്ളോരേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുവിൻ;
chapters.niv: Praise the Lord , all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.
chapters.nkjv: Bless the Lord, all you His hosts, You ministers of His, who do His pleasure.
chapters.kjv: Bless ye the LORD , all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ആധിപത്യത്തിലെ സകലസ്ഥലങ്ങളിലുമുള്ള അവന്റെ സകലപ്രവൃത്തികളുമേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുവിൻ; എൻ മനമേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുക.
chapters.niv: Praise the Lord , all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the Lord , my soul.
chapters.nkjv: Bless the Lord, all His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless the Lord, O my soul!
chapters.kjv: Bless the LORD , all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD , O my soul.

chapters.ml: എൻ മനമേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുക; എന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, നീ ഏറ്റവും വലിയവൻ; മഹത്വവും തേജസ്സും നീ ധരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Praise the Lord , my soul. Lord my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.
chapters.nkjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul! O Lord my God, You are very great: You are clothed with honor and majesty,
chapters.kjv: Bless the LORD , O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

chapters.ml: വസ്ത്രം ധരിക്കുമ്പോലെ നീ പ്രകാശത്തെ ധരിക്കുന്നു; തിരശ്ശീലപോലെ നീ ആകാശത്തെ വിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent
chapters.nkjv: Who cover Yourself with light as with a garment, Who stretch out the heavens like a curtain.
chapters.kjv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ മാളികകളുടെ തുലാങ്ങളെ വെള്ളത്തിന്മേൽ നിരത്തുന്നു; മേഘങ്ങളെ തന്റെ തേരാക്കി, കാറ്റിൻ ചിറകിന്മേൽ സഞ്ചരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.
chapters.nkjv: He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, Who makes the clouds His chariot, Who walks on the wings of the wind,
chapters.kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

chapters.ml: അവൻ കാറ്റുകളെ തന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരും അഗ്നിജ്വാലയെ തന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷകന്മാരും ആക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.
chapters.nkjv: Who makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flame of fire.
chapters.kjv: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭൂമിയെ അതൊരിക്കലും ഇളകിപ്പോകാതവണ്ണം അതിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിന്മേൽ സ്ഥാപിച്ചരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.
chapters.nkjv: Youwho laid the foundations of the earth, So that it should not be moved forever,
chapters.kjv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

chapters.ml: നീ അതിനെ വസ്ത്രംകൊണ്ടെന്നപോലെ ആഴികൊണ്ടു മൂടി; വെള്ളം പർവ്വതങ്ങൾക്കു മീതെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
chapters.nkjv: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; The waters stood above the mountains.
chapters.kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

chapters.ml: അവ നിന്റെ ശാസനയാൽ ഓടിപ്പോയി; നിന്റെ ഇടിമുഴക്കത്താൽ അവ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു -
chapters.niv: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;
chapters.nkjv: At Your rebuke they fled; At the voice of Your thunder they hastened away.
chapters.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

chapters.ml: മലകൾ പൊങ്ങി, താഴ്വരകൾ താണു - നീ അവെക്കു നിശ്ചയിച്ച സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി;
chapters.niv: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.
chapters.nkjv: They went up over the mountains; They went down into the valleys, To the place which You founded for them.
chapters.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയെ മൂടുവാൻ മടങ്ങിവരാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ അവെക്കു കടന്നുകൂടാത്ത ഒരു അതിർ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.
chapters.nkjv: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, That they may not return to cover the earth.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉറവുകളെ താഴ്വരകളിലേക്കു ഒഴുക്കുന്നു; അവ മലകളുടെ ഇടയിൽകൂടി ഒലിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.
chapters.nkjv: He sends the springs into the valleys; They flow among the hills.
chapters.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

chapters.ml: അവയിൽനിന്നു വയലിലെ സകലമൃഗങ്ങളും കുടിക്കുന്നു; കാട്ടുകഴുതകളും തങ്ങളുടെ ദാഹം തീർക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
chapters.nkjv: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
chapters.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ തീരങ്ങളിൽ ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവകൾ വസിക്കയും കൊമ്പുകളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാടുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The birds of the sky nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.
chapters.nkjv: By them the birds of the heavens have their home; They sing among the branches.
chapters.kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ മാളികകളിൽ നിന്നു മലകളെ നനെക്കുന്നു; ഭൂമിക്കു നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളുടെ ഫലത്താൽ തൃപ്തിവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the land is satisfied by the fruit of his work.
chapters.nkjv: He waters the hills from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.
chapters.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൃഗങ്ങൾക്കു പുല്ലും മനുഷ്യന്റെ ഉപയോഗത്തിന്നായി സസ്യവും മുളെപ്പിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to cultivate— bringing forth food from the earth:
chapters.nkjv: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, And vegetation for the service of man, That he may bring forth food from the earth,
chapters.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു ആഹാരവും മനുഷ്യന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തെ സന്തോഷിപ്പിക്കുന്ന വീഞ്ഞും അവന്റെ മുഖത്തെ മിനുക്കുവാൻ എണ്ണയും മനുഷ്യന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തെ ബലപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന അപ്പവും ഉത്ഭവിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: wine that gladdens human hearts, oil to make their faces shine, and bread that sustains their hearts.
chapters.nkjv: And wine that makes glad the heart of man, Oil to make his face shine, And bread which strengthens man’s heart.
chapters.kjv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങൾക്കു തൃപ്തിവരുന്നു; അവൻ നട്ടിട്ടുള്ള ലെബാനോനിലെ ദേവദാരുക്കൾക്കു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The trees of the Lord are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
chapters.nkjv: The trees of the Lord are full ofsap, The cedars of Lebanon which He planted,
chapters.kjv: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

chapters.ml: അവിടെ പക്ഷികൾ കൂടുണ്ടാക്കുന്നു; പെരുഞാറെക്കു സരളവൃക്ഷങ്ങൾ പാർപ്പിടമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the junipers.
chapters.nkjv: Where the birds make their nests; The stork has her home in the fir trees.
chapters.kjv: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

chapters.ml: ഉയർന്നമലകൾ കാട്ടാടുകൾക്കും പാറകൾ കുഴിമുയലുകൾക്കും സങ്കേതമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the hyrax.
chapters.nkjv: The high hills are for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the rock badgers.
chapters.kjv: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കാലനിർണ്ണയത്തിന്നായി ചന്ദ്രനെ നിയമിച്ചു; സൂര്യൻ തന്റെ അസ്തമാനത്തെ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.
chapters.nkjv: He appointed the moon for seasons; The sun knows its going down.
chapters.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

chapters.ml: നീ ഇരുട്ടു വരുത്തുന്നു; രാത്രി ഉണ്ടാകുന്നു; അപ്പോൾ കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളൊക്കെയും സഞ്ചാരം തുടങ്ങുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.
chapters.nkjv: You make darkness, and it is night, In which all the beasts of the forest creep about.
chapters.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth .

chapters.ml: ബാലസിംഹങ്ങൾ ഇരെക്കായി അലറുന്നു; അവ ദൈവത്തോടു തങ്ങളുടെ ആഹാരം ചോദിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
chapters.nkjv: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
chapters.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ ഉദിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവ മടങ്ങുന്നു; തങ്ങളുടെ ഗുഹകളിൽ ചെന്നു കിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.
chapters.nkjv: When the sun rises, they gather together And lie down in their dens.
chapters.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ തന്റെ പണിക്കു പുറപ്പെടുന്നു; സന്ധ്യവരെയുള്ള തന്റെ വേലെക്കായി തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Then people go out to their work, to their labor until evening.
chapters.nkjv: Man goes out to his work And to his labor until the evening.
chapters.kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ എത്ര പെരുകിയിരിക്കുന്നു! ജ്ഞാനത്തോടെ നീ അവയെ ഒക്കെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഭൂമി നിന്റെ സൃഷ്ടികളാൽ നിറെഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: How many are your works, Lord ! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
chapters.nkjv: O Lord, how manifold are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all. The earth is full of Your possessions—
chapters.kjv: O LORD , how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

chapters.ml: വലിപ്പവും വിസ്താരവും ഉള്ള സമുദ്രം അതാ കിടക്കുന്നു! അതിൽ സഞ്ചരിക്കുന്ന ചെറിയതും വലിയതുമായ അസംഖ്യജന്തുക്കൾ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number— living things both large and small.
chapters.nkjv: This great and wide sea, In which are innumerable teeming things, Living things both small and great.
chapters.kjv: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

chapters.ml: അതിൽ കപ്പലുകൾ ഓടുന്നു; അതിൽ കളിപ്പാൻ നീ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ലിവ്യാഥാൻ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: There the ships go to and fro, and Leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.
chapters.nkjv: There the ships sail about; Thereis that Leviathan Which You have made to play there.
chapters.kjv: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

chapters.ml: തക്കസമയത്തു തീൻ കിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇവ ഒക്കെയും നിന്നെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All creatures look to you to give them their food at the proper time.
chapters.nkjv: These all wait for You, That You may give them their food in due season.
chapters.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

chapters.ml: നീ കൊടുക്കുന്നതിനെ അവ പെറുക്കുന്നു തൃക്കൈ തുറക്കുമ്പോൾ അവെക്കു നന്മകൊണ്ടു തൃപ്തിവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
chapters.nkjv: What You give them they gather in; You open Your hand, they are filled with good.
chapters.kjv: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

chapters.ml: തിരുമുഖത്തെ മറെക്കുമ്പോൾ അവ ഭ്രമിച്ചു പോകുന്നു; നീ അവയുടെ ശ്വാസം എടുക്കുമ്പോൾ അവ ചത്തു പൊടിയിലേക്കു തിരികെ ചേരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: When you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.
chapters.nkjv: You hide Your face, they are troubled; You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.
chapters.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

chapters.ml: നീ നിന്റെ ശ്വാസം അയക്കുമ്പോൾ അവ സൃഷ്ടിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു; നീ ഭൂമിയുടെ മുഖത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.
chapters.nkjv: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; And You renew the face of the earth.
chapters.kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ മഹത്വം എന്നേക്കും നില്ക്കുമാറാകട്ടെ; യഹോവ തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളിൽ സന്തോഷിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; may the Lord rejoice in his works—
chapters.nkjv: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; May the Lord rejoice in His works.
chapters.kjv: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭൂമിയെ നോക്കുന്നു, അതു വിറെക്കുന്നു; അവൻ മലകളെ തൊടുന്നു, അവ പുകയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.
chapters.nkjv: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the hills, and they smoke.
chapters.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ആയുഷ്കാലത്തൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ യഹോവെക്കു പാടും; ഞാൻ ഉള്ളേടത്തോളം എന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു കിർത്തനം പാടും.
chapters.niv: I will sing to the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
chapters.nkjv: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
chapters.kjv: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ധ്യാനം അവന്നു പ്രസാദകരമായിരിക്കട്ടെ; ഞാൻ യഹോവയിൽ സന്തോഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: May my meditation be pleasing to him, as I rejoice in the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: May my meditation be sweet to Him; I will be glad in the Lord.
chapters.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD .

chapters.ml: പാപികൾ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു മുടിഞ്ഞുപോകട്ടെ; ദുഷ്ടന്മാർ ഇല്ലാതെയാകട്ടെ; എൻ മനമേ, യഹോവയെ വാഴ്ത്തുക; യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the Lord , my soul. Praise the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: May sinners be consumed from the earth, And the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul! Praise the Lord!
chapters.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD , O my soul. Praise ye the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രംചെയ്‍വിൻ; തൻ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിപ്പിൻ; അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അറിയിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.
chapters.nkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord! Call upon His name; Make known His deeds among the peoples!
chapters.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD ; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു പാടുവിൻ; അവന്നു കീർത്തനം പാടുവിൻ; അവന്റെ സകലഅത്ഭുതങ്ങളെയും കുറിച്ചു സംസാരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.
chapters.nkjv: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him; Talk of all His wondrous works!
chapters.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വിശുദ്ധനാമത്തിൽ പ്രശംസിപ്പിൻ; യഹോവയെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവരുടെ ഹൃദയം സന്തോഷിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
chapters.nkjv: Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the Lord!
chapters.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെയും അവന്റെ ബലത്തെയും തിരവിൻ; അവന്റെ മുഖത്തെ ഇടവിടാതെ അന്വേഷിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.
chapters.nkjv: Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face evermore!
chapters.kjv: Seek the LORD , and his strength: seek his face evermore.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ദാസനായ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ സന്തതിയും അവൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത യാക്കോബിൻ മക്കളുമായുള്ളോരേ,
chapters.niv: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,
chapters.nkjv: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,
chapters.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെയ്ത അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും അവന്റെ അടയാളങ്ങളും അവന്റെ വായുടെ ന്യായവിധികളും ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: you his servants, the descendants of Abraham, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: O seed of Abraham His servant, You children of Jacob, His chosen ones!
chapters.kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവയാകുന്നു; അവന്റെ ന്യായവിധികൾ സർവ്വഭൂമിയിലും ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
chapters.nkjv: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
chapters.kjv: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ നിയമത്തെ എന്നേക്കും താൻ കല്പിച്ച വചനത്തെ ആയിരം തലമുറയോളവും ഓർക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,
chapters.nkjv: He remembers His covenant forever, The word which He commanded, for a thousand generations,
chapters.kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു ചെയ്ത നിയമവും യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടു ചെയ്ത സത്യവും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.
chapters.nkjv: Thecovenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,
chapters.kjv: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

chapters.ml: അതിനെ അവൻ യാക്കോബിന്നു ഒരു ചട്ടമായും യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഒരു നിത്യനിയമമായും നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
chapters.nkjv: And confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,
chapters.kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ഓഹരിയായി ഞാൻ നിനക്കു കനാൻ ദേശം തരും എന്നരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."
chapters.nkjv: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

chapters.ml: അവർ അന്നു എണ്ണത്തിൽ കുറഞ്ഞവരും ആൾ ചുരുങ്ങിയവരും അവിടെ പരദേശികളും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,
chapters.nkjv: When they were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.
chapters.kjv: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒരു ജാതിയെ വിട്ടു മറ്റൊരു ജാതിയുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കും ഒരു രാജ്യത്തെ വിട്ടു മറ്റൊരു ജനത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കും പോകും.
chapters.niv: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
chapters.nkjv: When they went from one nation to another, From one kingdom to another people,
chapters.kjv: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

chapters.ml: അവരെ പീഡിപ്പിപ്പാൻ അവൻ ആരെയും സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല; അവരുടെ നിമിത്തം അവൻ രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ശാസിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:
chapters.nkjv: He permitted no one to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,
chapters.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തന്മാരെ തൊടരുതു, എന്റെ പ്രവാചകന്മാർക്കു ഒരു ദോഷവും ചെയ്യരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."
chapters.nkjv: Saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."
chapters.kjv: Saying , Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദേശത്തു ഒരു ക്ഷാമം വരുത്തി. അപ്പമെന്ന കോലിനെ അശേഷം ഒടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;
chapters.nkjv: Moreover He called for a famine in the land; He destroyed all the provision of bread.
chapters.kjv: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു മുമ്പായി അവൻ ഒരാളെ അയച്ചു; യോസേഫിനെ അവർ ദാസനായി വിറ്റുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: and he sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
chapters.nkjv: He sent a man before them— Joseph—who was sold as a slave.
chapters.kjv: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാകയും അവന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടിനാൽ അവന്നു ശോധന വരികയും ചെയ്യുവോളം
chapters.niv: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,
chapters.nkjv: They hurt his feet with fetters, He was laid in irons.
chapters.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്റെ കാലുകളെ വിലങ്ങുകൊണ്ടു ബന്ധിക്കയും അവൻ ഇരിമ്പു ചങ്ങലയിൽ കുടുങ്ങുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the Lord proved him true.
chapters.nkjv: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the Lord tested him.
chapters.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ആളയച്ചു അവനെ വിടുവിച്ചു; ജാതികളുടെ അധിപതി അവനെ സ്വതന്ത്രനാക്കി.
chapters.niv: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.
chapters.nkjv: The king sent and released him, The ruler of the people let him go free.
chapters.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെ ഇഷ്ടപ്രകാരം ബന്ധിച്ചുകൊൾവാനും അവന്റെ മന്ത്രിമാർക്കു ജ്ഞാനം ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാനും
chapters.niv: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,
chapters.nkjv: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions,
chapters.kjv: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ഭവനത്തിന്നു അവനെ കർത്താവായും തന്റെ സർവ്വസമ്പത്തിന്നും അധിപതിയായും നിയമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
chapters.nkjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
chapters.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു ചെന്നു; യാക്കോബ് ഹാമിന്റെ ദേശത്തു വന്നു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob resided as a foreigner in the land of Ham.
chapters.nkjv: Israel also came into Egypt, And Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
chapters.kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ ജനത്തെ ഏറ്റവും വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കയും അവരുടെ വൈരികളെക്കാൾ അവരെ ബലവാന്മാരാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The Lord made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,
chapters.nkjv: He increased His people greatly, And made them stronger than their enemies.
chapters.kjv: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ജനത്തെ പകെപ്പാനും തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരോടു ഉപായം പ്രയോഗിപ്പാനും അവൻ അവരുടെ ഹൃദയത്തെ മറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
chapters.nkjv: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.
chapters.kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെയെയും താൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത അഹരോനെയും അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
chapters.nkjv: He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.
chapters.kjv: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ അവന്റെ അടയാളങ്ങളും ഹാമിന്റെ ദേശത്തു അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും കാണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They performed his signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.
chapters.nkjv: They performed His signs among them, And wonders in the land of Ham.
chapters.kjv: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇരുൾ അയച്ചു ദേശത്തെ ഇരുട്ടാക്കി; അവർ അവന്റെ വചനത്തോടു മറുത്തതുമില്ല;
chapters.niv: He sent darkness and made the land dark— for had they not rebelled against his words?
chapters.nkjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they did not rebel against His word.
chapters.kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ വെള്ളത്തെ രക്തമാക്കി, അവരുടെ മത്സ്യങ്ങളെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.
chapters.nkjv: He turned their waters into blood, And killed their fish.
chapters.kjv: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശത്തു തവള വ്യാപിച്ചു രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ പള്ളിയറകളിൽപോലും നിറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.
chapters.nkjv: Their land abounded with frogs, Even in the chambers of their kings.
chapters.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കല്പിച്ചപ്പോൾ നായീച്ചയും അവരുടെ ദേശത്തെല്ലാം പേനും വന്നു;
chapters.niv: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.
chapters.nkjv: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their territory.
chapters.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവർക്കു മഴെക്കു പകരം കൽമഴയും അവരുടെ ദേശത്തിൽ അഗ്നിജ്വാലയും അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;
chapters.nkjv: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
chapters.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ മുന്തിരിവള്ളികളും അത്തി വൃക്ഷങ്ങളും തകർത്തു; അവരുടെ ദേശത്തിലെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളും നശിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
chapters.nkjv: He struck their vines also, and their fig trees, And splintered the trees of their territory.
chapters.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കല്പിച്ചപ്പോൾ വെട്ടുക്കിളിയും തുള്ളനും അനവധിയായി വന്നു,
chapters.niv: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;
chapters.nkjv: He spoke, and locusts came, Young locusts without number,
chapters.kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശത്തിലെ സസ്യം ഒക്കെയും അവരുടെ വയലിലെ വിളയും തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.
chapters.nkjv: And ate up all the vegetation in their land, And devoured the fruit of their ground.
chapters.kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ ദേശത്തിലെ എല്ലാകടിഞ്ഞൂലിനെയും അവരുടെ സർവ്വവീര്യത്തിൻ ആദ്യഫലത്തെയും സംഹരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.
chapters.nkjv: He also destroyed all the firstborn in their land, The first of all their strength.
chapters.kjv: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ വെള്ളിയോടും പൊന്നിനോടും കൂടെ പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു; അവരുടെ ഗോത്രങ്ങളിൽ ഒരു ബലഹീനനും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.
chapters.nkjv: He also brought them out with silver and gold, And therewas none feeble among His tribes.
chapters.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ മിസ്രയീം സന്തോഷിച്ചു; അവരെയുള്ള പേടി അവരുടെമേൽ വീണിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.
chapters.nkjv: Egypt was glad when they departed, For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
chapters.kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തണലിന്നായി ഒരു മേഘം വിരിച്ചു; രാത്രിയിൽ വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നായി തീ നിറുത്തി.
chapters.niv: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.
chapters.nkjv: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.
chapters.kjv: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

chapters.ml: അവർ ചോദിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ കാടകളെ കൊടുത്തു; സ്വർഗ്ഗീയഭോജനംകൊണ്ടും അവർക്കു തൃപ്തിവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: They asked, and he brought them quail; he fed them well with the bread of heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Thepeople asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
chapters.kjv: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പാറയെ പിളർന്നു, വെള്ളം ചാടി പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അതു ഉണങ്ങിയ നിലത്തുകൂടി നദിയായി ഒഴുകി.
chapters.niv: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
chapters.nkjv: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; It ran in the dry places like a river.
chapters.kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ വിശുദ്ധവചനത്തെയും തന്റെ ദാസനായ അബ്രാഹാമിനെയും ഓർത്തു.
chapters.niv: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.
chapters.nkjv: For He remembered His holy promise, And Abraham His servant.
chapters.kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ജനത്തെ സന്തോഷത്തോടും താൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തവരെ ഘോഷത്തോടും കൂടെ പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;
chapters.nkjv: He brought out His people with joy, His chosen ones with gladness.
chapters.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

chapters.ml: അവർ തന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെ പ്രമാണിക്കയും തന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണങ്ങളെ ആചരിക്കയും ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for—
chapters.nkjv: He gave them the lands of the Gentiles, And they inherited the labor of the nations,
chapters.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ജാതികളുടെ ദേശങ്ങളെ അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു; അവർ വംശങ്ങളുടെ അദ്ധ്വാനഫലം കൈവശമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു. യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: That they might observe His statutes And keep His laws. Praise the Lord!
chapters.kjv: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിപ്പിൻ; യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവൻ നല്ലവനല്ലോ; അവന്റെ ദയ എന്നേക്കും ഉള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: Praise the Lord . Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
chapters.nkjv: Praise the Lord! Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
chapters.kjv: Praise ye the LORD . O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികളെ ആർ വർണ്ണിക്കും? അവന്റെ സ്തുതിയെ ഒക്കെയും ആർ വിവരിക്കും?
chapters.niv: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the Lord or fully declare his praise?
chapters.nkjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? Who can declare all His praise?
chapters.kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD ? who can shew forth all his praise?

chapters.ml: ന്യായത്തെ പ്രമാണിക്കുന്നവരും എല്ലായ്പോഴും നീതി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നവനും ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Blessed are those who act justly, who always do what is right.
chapters.nkjv: Blessed are those who keep justice, And he who does righteousness at all times!
chapters.kjv: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, നീ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തവരുടെ നന്മ ഞാൻ കാണേണ്ടതിന്നും നിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ സന്തോഷത്തിൽ സന്തോഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും നിന്റെ അവകാശത്തോടുകൂടെ പുകഴേണ്ടതിന്നും
chapters.niv: Remember me, Lord , when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,
chapters.nkjv: Remember me, O Lord, with the favor Youhavetoward Your people. Oh, visit me with Your salvation,
chapters.kjv: Remember me, O LORD , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ജനത്തോടുള്ള കടാക്ഷപ്രകാരം എന്നെ ഓർത്തു, നിന്റെ രക്ഷകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ സന്ദർശിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.
chapters.nkjv: That I may see the benefit of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, That I may glory with Your inheritance.
chapters.kjv: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ പാപം ചെയ്തു; ഞങ്ങൾ അകൃത്യവും ദുഷ്ടതയും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: We have sinned, even as our ancestors did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
chapters.nkjv: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, We have done wickedly.
chapters.kjv: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ മിസ്രയീമിൽവെച്ചു നിന്റെ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളെ ഗ്രഹിക്കാതെയും നിന്റെ മഹാദയയെ ഓർക്കാതെയും കടൽക്കരയിൽ, ചെങ്കടൽക്കരയിൽവെച്ചു തന്നേ മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When our ancestors were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.
chapters.nkjv: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; They did not remember the multitude of Your mercies, But rebelled by the sea—the Red Sea.
chapters.kjv: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

chapters.ml: എന്നിട്ടും അവൻ തന്റെ മഹാശക്തി വെളിപ്പെടുത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്റെ നാമംനിമിത്തം അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, to make his mighty power known.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless He saved them for His name’s sake, That He might make His mighty power known.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെങ്കടലിനെ ശാസിച്ചു, അതു ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയി; അവൻ അവരെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽകൂടി എന്നപോലെ ആഴിയിൽകൂടി നടത്തി.
chapters.niv: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.
chapters.nkjv: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it dried up; So He led them through the depths, As through the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പകയന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു; ശത്രുവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു അവരെ വീണ്ടെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.
chapters.nkjv: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
chapters.kjv: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം അവരുടെ വൈരികളെ മൂടിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും ശേഷിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.
chapters.nkjv: The waters covered their enemies; There was not one of them left.
chapters.kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെ വിശ്വസിച്ചു; അവന്നു സ്തുതിപാടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.
chapters.nkjv: Then they believed His words; They sang His praise.
chapters.kjv: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവർ വേഗത്തിൽ അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ മറന്നു; അവന്റെ ആലോചനെക്കു കാത്തിരുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his plan to unfold.
chapters.nkjv: They soon forgot His works; They did not wait for His counsel,
chapters.kjv: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

chapters.ml: മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു അവർ ഏറ്റവും മോഹിച്ചു; നിർജ്ജനപ്രദേശത്തു അവർ ദൈവത്തെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wilderness they put God to the test.
chapters.nkjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tested God in the desert.
chapters.kjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

chapters.ml: അവർ അപേക്ഷിച്ചതു അവൻ അവർക്കുകൊടുത്തു; എങ്കിലും അവരുടെ പ്രാണന്നു ക്ഷയം അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease among them.
chapters.nkjv: And He gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.
chapters.kjv: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

chapters.ml: പാളയത്തിൽവെച്ചു അവർ മോശെയോടും യഹോവയുടെ വിശുദ്ധനായ അഹരോനോടും അസൂയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: When they envied Moses in the camp, And Aaron the saint of the Lord,
chapters.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഭൂമി പിളർന്നു ദാഥാനെ വിഴുങ്ങി; അബീരാമിന്റെ കൂട്ടത്തെയും മൂടിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.
chapters.nkjv: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, And covered the faction of Abiram.
chapters.kjv: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ തീ കത്തി; അഗ്നിജ്വാല ദുഷ്ടന്മാരെ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.
chapters.nkjv: A fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
chapters.kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഹോരേബിൽവെച്ചു ഒരു കാളക്കുട്ടിയെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി; വാർത്തുണ്ടാക്കിയ വിഗ്രഹത്തെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.
chapters.nkjv: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshiped the molded image.
chapters.kjv: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ മഹത്വമായവനെ പുല്ലു തിന്നുന്ന കാളയോടു സദ്രശനാക്കി തീർത്തു.
chapters.niv: They exchanged their glorious God for an image of a bull, which eats grass.
chapters.nkjv: Thus they changed their glory Into the image of an ox that eats grass.
chapters.kjv: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ വലിയ കാര്യങ്ങളും ഹാമിന്റെ ദേശത്തു അത്ഭുതപ്രവൃത്തികളും
chapters.niv: They forgot the God who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,
chapters.nkjv: They forgot God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt,
chapters.kjv: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

chapters.ml: ചെങ്കടലിങ്കൽ ഭയങ്കരകാര്യങ്ങളും ചെയ്തവനായി തങ്ങളുടെ രക്ഷിതാവായ ദൈവത്തെ അവർ മറന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
chapters.nkjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Awesome things by the Red Sea.
chapters.kjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവരെ നശിപ്പിക്കുമെന്നു അവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ വൃതനായ മോശെ കോപത്തെ ശമിപ്പിപ്പാൻ അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ പിളർപ്പിൽ നിന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ അവൻ അവരെ നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളയുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he said he would destroy them— had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach, To turn away His wrath, lest He destroy them.
chapters.kjv: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them .

chapters.ml: അവർ മനോഹരദേശത്തെ നിരസിച്ചു; അവന്റെ വചനത്തെ വിശ്വസിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.
chapters.nkjv: Then they despised the pleasant land; They did not believe His word,
chapters.kjv: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിൽവെച്ചു പിറുപിറുത്തു; യഹോവയുടെ വചനം കേൾക്കാതെയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: But complained in their tents, And did not heed the voice of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ: മരുഭൂമിയിൽ അവരെ വീഴിക്കുമെന്നും അവരുടെ സന്തതിയെ ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ നശിപ്പിക്കുമെന്നും
chapters.niv: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the wilderness,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore He raised His hand inanoath against them, To overthrow them in the wilderness,
chapters.kjv: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

chapters.ml: അവരെ ദേശങ്ങളിൽ ചിതറിച്ചുകളയുമെന്നും അവർക്കു വിരോധമായി തന്റെ കൈ ഉയർത്തി സത്യംചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
chapters.nkjv: To overthrow their descendants among the nations, And to scatter them in the lands.
chapters.kjv: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ ബാൽപെയോരിനോടു ചേർന്നു; പ്രേതങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള ബലികളെ തിന്നു.
chapters.niv: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;
chapters.nkjv: They joined themselves also to Baal of Peor, And ate sacrifices made to the dead.
chapters.kjv: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ക്രിയകളാൽ അവനെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചു; പെട്ടെന്നു ഒരു ബാധ അവർക്കു തട്ടി.
chapters.niv: they aroused the Lord ’s anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
chapters.nkjv: Thus they provoked Him to anger with their deeds, And the plague broke out among them.
chapters.kjv: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഫീനെഹാസ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു ശിക്ഷ നടത്തി; ബാധ നിർത്തലാകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.
chapters.nkjv: Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, And the plague was stopped.
chapters.kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

chapters.ml: അതു എന്നേക്കും തലമുറതലമുറയായി അവന്നു നീതിയായിഎണ്ണിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
chapters.nkjv: And that was accounted to him for righteousness To all generations forevermore.
chapters.kjv: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

chapters.ml: മെരീബാവെള്ളത്തിങ്കലും അവർ അവനെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചു; അവരുടെനിമിത്തം മോശെക്കും ദോഷം ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: By the waters of Meribah they angered the Lord , and trouble came to Moses because of them;
chapters.nkjv: They angered Him also at the waters of strife, So that it went ill with Moses on account of them;
chapters.kjv: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്റെ മനസ്സിനെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അധരങ്ങളാൽ അവിവേകം സംസാരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses’ lips.
chapters.nkjv: Because they rebelled against His Spirit, So that he spoke rashly with his lips.
chapters.kjv: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തങ്ങളോടു നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർ ജാതികളെ നശിപ്പിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: They did not destroy the peoples as the Lord had commanded them,
chapters.nkjv: They did not destroy the peoples, Concerning whom the Lord had commanded them,
chapters.kjv: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

chapters.ml: അവർ ജാതികളോടു ഇടകലർന്നു അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ പഠിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
chapters.nkjv: But they mingled with the Gentiles And learned their works;
chapters.kjv: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെയും സേവിച്ചു; അവ അവർക്കൊരു കണിയായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
chapters.nkjv: They served their idols, Which became a snare to them.
chapters.kjv: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും അവർ ഭൂതങ്ങൾക്കു ബലികഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to false gods.
chapters.nkjv: They even sacrificed their sons And their daughters to demons,
chapters.kjv: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

chapters.ml: അവർ കുറ്റമില്ലാത്ത രക്തം, പുത്രീപുത്രന്മാരുടെ രക്തം തന്നേ ചൊരിഞ്ഞു; അവരെ അവർ കനാന്യവിഗ്രഹങ്ങൾക്കു ബലികഴിച്ചു, ദേശം രക്തപാതകംകൊണ്ടു അശുദ്ധമായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.
chapters.nkjv: And shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and daughters, Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
chapters.kjv: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ക്രിയകളാൽ മലിനപ്പെട്ടു, തങ്ങളുടെ കർമ്മങ്ങളാൽ പരസംഗം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.
chapters.nkjv: Thus they were defiled by their own works, And played the harlot by their own deeds.
chapters.kjv: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയുടെ കോപം തന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ജ്വലിച്ചു; അവൻ തന്റെ അവകാശത്തെ വെറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Therefore the Lord was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the wrath of the Lord was kindled against His people, So that He abhorred His own inheritance.
chapters.kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ ജാതികളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവരെ പകെച്ചവർ അവരെ ഭരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He gave them into the hands of the nations, and their foes ruled over them.
chapters.nkjv: And He gave them into the hand of the Gentiles, And those who hated them ruled over them.
chapters.kjv: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ശത്രുക്കൾ അവരെ ഞെരുക്കി; അവർ അവർക്കു കീഴടങ്ങേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.
chapters.nkjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.
chapters.kjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

chapters.ml: പലപ്പോഴും അവൻ അവരെ വിടുവിച്ചു; എങ്കിലും അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ ആലോചനയാൽ അവനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു; തങ്ങളുടെ അകൃത്യംനിമിത്തം അധോഗതിപ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Many times he delivered them, but they were bent on rebellion and they wasted away in their sin.
chapters.nkjv: Many times He delivered them; But they rebelled in their counsel, And were brought low for their iniquity.
chapters.kjv: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവരുടെ നിലവിളി കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരുടെ കഷ്ടതയെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Yet he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless He regarded their affliction, When He heard their cry;
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവർക്കായി തന്റെ നിയമത്തെ ഓർത്തു; തന്റെ മഹാദയപ്രകാരം അനുതപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.
chapters.nkjv: And for their sake He remembered His covenant, And relented according to the multitude of His mercies.
chapters.kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

chapters.ml: അവരെ ബദ്ധരാക്കി കൊണ്ടുപോയവർക്കെല്ലാം അവരോടു കനിവു തോന്നുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: He caused all who held them captive to show them mercy.
chapters.nkjv: He also made them to be pitied By all those who carried them away captive.
chapters.kjv: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവേ, ഞങ്ങളെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ; നിന്റെ വിശുദ്ധനാമത്തിന്നു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്‍വാനും നിന്റെ സ്തുതിയിൽ പ്രശംസിപ്പാനും ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ ശേഖരിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
chapters.nkjv: Save us, O Lord our God, And gather us from among the Gentiles, To give thanks to Your holy name, To triumph in Your praise.
chapters.kjv: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ എന്നും എന്നേക്കും വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ; ജനമെല്ലാം ആമേൻ എന്നു പറയട്ടെ. യഹോവയെ സ്തുതിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! And let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord!
chapters.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവെക്കു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവൻ നല്ലവനല്ലോ അവന്റെ ദയ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു!
chapters.niv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
chapters.nkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
chapters.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD , for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ വൈരിയുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വീണ്ടെടുക്കയും കിഴക്കും പടിഞ്ഞാറും വടക്കും കടലിലും ഉള്ള
chapters.niv: Let the redeemed of the Lord tell their story— those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,
chapters.nkjv: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, Whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,
chapters.kjv: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

chapters.ml: ദേശങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു കൂട്ടിച്ചേർക്കയും ചെയ്തവരായ അവന്റെ വിമുക്തന്മാർ അങ്ങനെ പറയട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
chapters.nkjv: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
