chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ നിഹതന്മാരേ, ബാബേൽ വീഴേണ്ടതാകുന്നു; ബാബേലിനോടുകൂടെ സർവ്വദേശവും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "Babylon must fall because of Israel’s slain, just as the slain in all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: As Babylon hascaused the slain of Israel to fall, So at Babylon the slain of all the earth shall fall.
chapters.kjv: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

chapters.ml: വാളിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോയവരേ, നിൽക്കാതെ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു യഹോവയെ ഓർപ്പിൻ; യെരൂശലേം നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഓർമ്മ വരട്ടെ!
chapters.niv: You who have escaped the sword, leave and do not linger! Remember the Lord in a distant land, and call to mind Jerusalem."
chapters.nkjv: You who have escaped the sword, Get away! Do not stand still! Remember the Lord afar off, And let Jerusalem come to your mind.
chapters.kjv: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്ദ കേട്ടു ലജ്ജിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അന്യന്മാർ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലങ്ങളിലേക്കു വന്നിരിക്കയാൽ ലജ്ജ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മുഖം മൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "We are disgraced, for we have been insulted and shame covers our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the Lord ’s house."
chapters.nkjv: We are ashamed because we have heard reproach. Shame has covered our faces, For strangers have come into the sanctuaries of the Lord’s house.
chapters.kjv: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’s house.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അതിലെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ സന്ദർശിപ്പാനുള്ള കാലം വരും എാന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു; അന്നു ദേശത്തെല്ലാടവും നിഹതന്മാർ കിടന്നു ഞരങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: "But days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "That I will bring judgment on her carved images, And throughout all her land the wounded shall groan.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

chapters.ml: ബാബേൽ ആകാശത്തോളം കയറിയാലും കോട്ട ഉയർത്തി ഉറപ്പിച്ചാലും, ഞാൻ വിനാശകന്മാരെ അതിലേക്കു അയക്കും എന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, I will send destroyers against her," declares the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Though Babylon were to mount up to heaven, And though she were to fortify the height of her strength, Yet from Me plunderers would come to her," says the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD .

chapters.ml: ബാബേലിൽനിന്നു നിലവിളിയും കല്ദയദേശത്തുനിന്നു മഹാനാശവും കേൾക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.
chapters.nkjv: The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, And great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans,
chapters.kjv: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

chapters.ml: യഹോവ ബാബേലിനെ നശിപ്പിച്ചു അതിൽ നിന്നു മഹാഘോഷം ഇല്ലാതെയാക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ തിരകൾ പെരുവെള്ളംപോലെ ഇരെക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ ആരവത്തിന്റെ മുഴക്കം കേൾക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord will destroy Babylon; he will silence her noisy din. Waves of enemies will rage like great waters; the roar of their voices will resound.
chapters.nkjv: Because the Lord is plundering Babylon And silencing her loud voice, Though her waves roar like great waters, And the noise of their voice is uttered,
chapters.kjv: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ നേരെ, ബാബേലിന്റെ നേരെ തന്നേ, വിനാശകൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അതിലെ വീരന്മാർ പിടിപെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ വില്ലു എല്ലാം ഒടിഞ്ഞുപോയി; യഹോവ പ്രതികാരത്തിന്റെ ദൈവമാകുന്നു; അവൻ പകരം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: A destroyer will come against Babylon; her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken. For the Lord is a God of retribution; he will repay in full.
chapters.nkjv: Because the plunderer comes against her, against Babylon, And her mighty men are taken. Every one of their bows is broken; For the Lordis the God of recompense, He will surely repay.
chapters.kjv: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അതിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെയും ജ്ഞാനികളെയും ദേശാധിപതിമാരെയും സ്ഥാനാപതികളെയും വീരന്മാരെയും മത്തുപിടിപ്പിക്കും; അവർ ഉണരാതവണ്ണം നിത്യനിദ്രകൊള്ളും എന്നു സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ എന്നു നാമമുള്ള രാജാവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, her governors, officers and warriors as well; they will sleep forever and not awake," declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.
chapters.nkjv: "And I will make drunk Her princes and wise men, Her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men. And they shall sleep a perpetual sleep And not awake," says the King, Whose name is the Lord of hosts.
chapters.kjv: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men , her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.

chapters.ml: സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ യഹോവ ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ബാബേലിന്റെ വിശാലമായ മതിലുകൾ അശേഷം ഇടിഞ്ഞുപോകും; അതിന്റെ ഉയർന്ന വാതിലുകൾ തീ പിടിച്ചു വെന്തുപോകും; അങ്ങനെ വംശങ്ങളുടെ അദ്ധ്വാനം വ്യർത്ഥമായും ജാതികളുടെ പ്രയത്നം തീക്കിരയായും തീരുകയും അവർ ക്ഷീണിച്ചുപോകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Babylon’s thick wall will be leveled and her high gates set on fire; the peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, the nations’ labor is only fuel for the flames."
chapters.nkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, And her high gates shall be burned with fire; The people will labor in vain, And the nations, because of the fire; And they shall be weary."
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ സിദെക്കീയാവിന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ നാലം ആണ്ടിൽ, അവനോടുകൂടെ മഹ്സേയാവിന്റെ മകനായ നേർയ്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ സെരായാവു പ്രയാണാദ്ധ്യക്ഷനായി ബാബേലിലേക്കു പോകുമ്പോൾ യിരെമ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ സെരായാവോടു കല്പിച്ചു വചനം--
chapters.niv: This is the message Jeremiah the prophet gave to the staff officer Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign.
chapters.nkjv: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And Seraiah was the quartermaster.
chapters.kjv: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.

chapters.ml: ബാബേലിന്നു വരുവാനിരിക്കുന്ന അനർത്ഥമൊക്കെയും, ബാബേലിനെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന സകലവചനങ്ങളും തന്നേ, യിരെമ്യാവു ഒരു പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതി --
chapters.niv: Jeremiah had written on a scroll about all the disasters that would come upon Babylon—all that had been recorded concerning Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that would come upon Babylon, all these words that are written against Babylon.
chapters.kjv: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

chapters.ml: യിരെമ്യാവു സെരായാവോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ ബാബേലിൽ എത്തിയശേഷം ഈ വചനങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും നോക്കി വായിച്ചിട്ടു:
chapters.niv: He said to Seraiah, "When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud.
chapters.nkjv: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, "When you arrive in Babylon and see it, and read all these words,
chapters.kjv: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ഈ സ്ഥലത്തു മനുഷ്യനോ മൃഗമോ ഒന്നും ശേഷിക്കാതെ അതു ശാശ്വതശൂന്യമായിരിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം നീ അതിനെ നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളയുമെന്നു അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറയേണം.
chapters.niv: Then say, ‘ Lord , you have said you will destroy this place, so that neither people nor animals will live in it; it will be desolate forever.’
chapters.nkjv: then you shall say, ‘O Lord, You have spoken against this place to cut it off, so that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but it shall be desolate forever.’
chapters.kjv: Then shalt thou say, O LORD , thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഈ പുസ്തകം വായിച്ചശേഷം നീ അതിന്നു ഒരു കല്ലു കെട്ടി ഫ്രാത്തിന്റെ നടുവിലേക്കു എറിഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates.
chapters.nkjv: Now it shall be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall tie a stone to it and throw it out into the Euphrates.
chapters.kjv: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ബാബേൽ ആണ്ടുപോകും; ഞാൻ അതിന്നു വരുത്തുന്ന അനർത്ഥത്തിൽനിന്നു അതു പൊങ്ങിവരികയില്ല; അവർ ക്ഷയിച്ചുപോകും എന്നു പറയേണം. ഇത്രത്തോളം യിരെമ്യാവിന്റെ വചനങ്ങൾ.
chapters.niv: Then say, ‘So will Babylon sink to rise no more because of the disaster I will bring on her. And her people will fall.’ " The words of Jeremiah end here.
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall say, ‘Thus Babylon shall sink and not rise from the catastrophe that I will bring upon her. And they shall be weary.’ " Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

chapters.ml: സിദെക്കീയാവു വാണുതുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു ഇരുപത്തൊന്നു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവൻ പതിനൊന്നു സംവത്സരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ വാണു; അവന്റെ അമ്മെക്കു ഹമൂതൽ എന്നു പേർ; അവൾ ലിബ്നക്കാരനായ യിരെമ്യാവിന്റെ മകൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.nkjv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
chapters.kjv: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാക്കീം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഒക്കെയും അവൻ യഹോവെക്കു അനിഷ്ടമായുള്ളതു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.nkjv: He also did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കോപം ഹേതുവായി യെരൂശലേമിന്നും യെഹൂദെക്കും അങ്ങനെ ഭവിച്ചു; അവൻ ഒടുവിൽ അവരെ തന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ സിദെക്കീയാവു ബാബേൽ രാജാവിനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: For because of the anger of the Lordthis happened in Jerusalem and Judah, till He finally cast them out from His presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.kjv: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ ഒമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ പത്താം മാസം പത്താം തിയ്യതി, ബാബേൽരാജാവായ നെബൂഖദ്നേസർ തന്റെ സർവ്വസൈന്യവുമായി യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു പാളയമിറങ്ങി അതിന്നെതിരെ ചുറ്റും കൊത്തളങ്ങൾ പണിതു.
chapters.niv: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. They encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem and encamped against it; and they built a siege wall against it all around.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ സിദെക്കീയാരാജാവിന്റെ പതിനൊന്നാം ആണ്ടുവരെ നഗരം നിരോധിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
chapters.nkjv: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
chapters.kjv: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

chapters.ml: നാലാം മാസം ഒമ്പതാം തിയ്യതി ക്ഷാമം നഗരത്തിൽ കലശലായി ദേശത്തെ ജനത്തിന്നു ആഹാരമില്ലാതെ ഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.
chapters.nkjv: By the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the famine had become so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
chapters.kjv: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ നഗരത്തിന്റെ മതിൽ ഒരിടം പൊളിച്ചുതുറന്നു; കല്ദയർ നഗരം വളഞ്ഞിരിക്കെ പടയാളികൾ ഒക്കെയും രാത്രിസമയത്തു രാജാവിന്റെ തോട്ടത്തിന്നരികെ രണ്ടു മതിലുകളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേയുള്ള പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ കൂടി നഗരം വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു അരാബയിലേക്കുള്ള വഴിയായി ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,
chapters.nkjv: Then the city wall was broken through, and all the men of war fled and went out of the city at night by way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden, even though the Chaldeans were near the city all around. And they went by way of the plain.
chapters.kjv: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കല്ദയരുടെ സൈന്യം രാജാവിനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു, യെരീഹോസമഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു സിദെക്കീയാവോടു എത്തി; അവന്റെ സൈന്യമൊക്കെയും അവനെ വിട്ടു ചിതറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: but the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,
chapters.nkjv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and they overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. All his army was scattered from him.
chapters.kjv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

chapters.ml: അവർ രാജാവിനെ പിടിച്ചു, ഹമാത്ത് ദേശത്തിലെ രിബ്ളയിൽ ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; അവൻ അവന്നു വിധി കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.
chapters.nkjv: So they took the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he pronounced judgment on him.
chapters.kjv: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

chapters.ml: ബാബേൽരാജാവു സിദെക്കീയാവിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെ അവൻ കാൺകെ കൊന്നു; യെഹൂദാപ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും അവൻ രിബ്ളയിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: There at Riblah the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he also killed all the officials of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. And he killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ സിദെക്കീയാവിന്റെ കണ്ണു പൊട്ടിച്ചു; ബാബേൽരാജാവു അവനെ ചങ്ങലകൊണ്ടു ബന്ധിച്ചു ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു ജീവപര്യന്തം കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon, where he put him in prison till the day of his death.
chapters.nkjv: He also put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in bronze fetters, took him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
chapters.kjv: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാം മാസം പത്താം തിയ്യതി, ബാബേൽരാജാവായ നെബൂഖദ്നേസരിന്റെ പത്തൊമ്പതാം ആണ്ടിൽ തന്നേ, ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ തിരുമുമ്പിൽ നില്ക്കുന്നവനും അകമ്പടിനായകനുമായ നെബൂസർ-അദാൻ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month ( which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

chapters.ml: അവൻ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയവും രാജധാനിയും ചുട്ടു, യെരൂശലേമിലെ എല്ലാ വീടുകളും പ്രധാനഭവനങ്ങളൊക്കെയും തീ വെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.
chapters.nkjv: He burned the house of the Lord and the king’s house; all the houses of Jerusalem, that is, all the houses of the great, he burned with fire.
chapters.kjv: And burned the house of the LORD , and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men , burned he with fire:

chapters.ml: അകമ്പടിനായകനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന കല്ദയസൈന്യമൊക്കെയും യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള മതിലുകളെല്ലാം ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The whole Babylonian army, under the commander of the imperial guard, broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And all the army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the guard broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.
chapters.kjv: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

chapters.ml: ജനത്തിൽ എളിയവരായ ചിലരെയും നഗരത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചിരുന്ന ജനശിഷ്ടത്തെയും ബാബേൽരാജാവിനെ ചെന്നു ശരണംപ്രാപിച്ചവരെയും പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ ശേഷിച്ചവരെയും അകമ്പടിനായകനായ നെബൂസർ-അദാൻ ബദ്ധരാക്കി കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the rest of the craftsmen and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive some of the poor people, the rest of the people who remained in the city, the defectors who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the craftsmen.
chapters.kjv: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അകമ്പടിനായകനായ നെബൂസർ-അദാൻ ദേശത്തെ എളിയവരിൽ ചിലരെ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടക്കാരായും കൃഷിക്കാരായും വിട്ടേച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But Nebuzaradan left behind the rest of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
chapters.nkjv: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left some of the poor of the land as vinedressers and farmers.
chapters.kjv: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ താമ്രസ്തംഭങ്ങളും പീഠങ്ങളും യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിലെ താമ്രംകൊണ്ടുള്ള കടലും കല്ദയർ ഉടെച്ചു താമ്രം ഒക്കെയും ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried all the bronze to Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: The bronze pillars that were in the house of the Lord, and the carts and the bronze Sea that were in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and carried all their bronze to Babylon.
chapters.kjv: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD , and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD , the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

chapters.ml: കലങ്ങളും ചട്ടുകങ്ങളും കത്രികകളും കിണ്ണങ്ങളും തവികളും ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള സകലതാമ്രോപകരണങ്ങളും അവർ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.
chapters.nkjv: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the trimmers, the bowls, the spoons, and all the bronze utensils with which the priests ministered.
chapters.kjv: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

chapters.ml: പാനപാത്രങ്ങളും തീച്ചട്ടികളും കിണ്ണങ്ങളും കലങ്ങളും വിളക്കുതണ്ടുകളും തവികളും കുടങ്ങളും പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടുള്ളതും വെള്ളികൊണ്ടുള്ളതും എല്ലാം അകമ്പടിനായകൻ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The commander of the imperial guard took away the basins, censers, sprinkling bowls, pots, lampstands, dishes and bowls used for drink offerings—all that were made of pure gold or silver.
chapters.nkjv: The basins, the firepans, the bowls, the pots, the lampstands, the spoons, and the cups, whatever was solid gold and whatever was solid silver, the captain of the guard took away.
chapters.kjv: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ രാജാവു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയംവകെക്കു ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ രണ്ടു സ്തംഭവും ഒരു കടലും പീഠങ്ങളുടെ കീഴെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പന്ത്രണ്ടു താമ്രക്കാളയും തന്നേ; ഈ സകലസാധനങ്ങളുടെയും താമ്രത്തിന്നു തൂക്കമില്ലാതെയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the twelve bronze bulls under it, and the movable stands, which King Solomon had made for the temple of the Lord , was more than could be weighed.
chapters.nkjv: The two pillars, one Sea, the twelve bronze bulls which were under it, and the carts, which King Solomon had made for the house of the Lord— the bronze of all these articles was beyond measure.
chapters.kjv: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD : the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

chapters.ml: സ്തംഭങ്ങളോ, ഓരോന്നു പതിനെട്ടു മുഴം ഉയരവും പന്ത്രണ്ടു മുഴം ചുറ്റളവും നാലു വിരൽ കനവും ഉള്ളതായിരുന്നു; അതു പൊള്ളയുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference ; each was four fingers thick, and hollow.
chapters.nkjv: Now concerning the pillars: the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits, a measuring line of twelve cubits could measure its circumference, and its thickness was four fingers; itwas hollow.
chapters.kjv: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

chapters.ml: അതിന്മേൽ താമ്രംകൊണ്ടു ഒരു പോതിക ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; പോതികയുടെ ഉയരം അഞ്ചു മുഴം പോതികമേൽ ചുറ്റും വലപ്പണിയും മാതളപ്പഴവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; സകലവും താമ്രംകൊണ്ടായിരുന്നു; രണ്ടാമത്തെ സ്തംഭത്തിന്നു ഇതുപോലെയുള്ള പണിയും മാതളപ്പഴവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The bronze capital on top of one pillar was five cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its pomegranates, was similar.
chapters.nkjv: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of one capital was five cubits, with a network and pomegranates all around the capital, all of bronze. The second pillar, with pomegranates was the same.
chapters.kjv: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.

chapters.ml: നാലുപുറത്തുംകൂടെ തൊണ്ണൂറ്റാറു മാതളപ്പഴവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു: വലപ്പണിയിൽ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള മാതളപ്പഴം ആകെ നൂറു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; the total number of pomegranates above the surrounding network was a hundred.
chapters.nkjv: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates, all around on the network, were one hundred.
chapters.kjv: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.

chapters.ml: അകമ്പടിനായകൻ മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ സെരായാവെയും രണ്ടാം പുരോഹിതനായ സെഫന്യാവെയും മൂന്നു വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാരെയും പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.nkjv: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.kjv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

chapters.ml: നഗരത്തിൽനിന്നു അവൻ യോദ്ധാക്കളുടെ വിചാരകനായ ഒരു ഷണ്ഡനെയും നഗരത്തിൽവെച്ചു കണ്ട ഏഴു രാജപരിചാരകന്മാരെയും ദേശത്തിലെ ജനത്തെ പടെക്കു ശേഖരിക്കുന്ന സേനാപതിയുടെ രായസക്കാരനെയും നഗരത്തിൽ കണ്ട അറുപതു നാട്ടുപുറക്കാരെയും പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and seven royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land, sixty of whom were found in the city.
chapters.nkjv: He also took out of the city an officer who had charge of the men of war, seven men of the king’s close associates who were found in the city, the principal scribe of the army who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the midst of the city.
chapters.kjv: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

chapters.ml: ഇവരെ അകമ്പടിനായകനായ നെബൂസർ-അദാൻ പിടിച്ചു രിബ്ളയിൽ ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.nkjv: And Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took these and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.kjv: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

chapters.ml: ബാബേൽരാജാവു ഹമാത്ത് ദേശത്തിലെ രിബ്ളയിൽവെച്ചു അവരെ വെട്ടിക്കൊന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ യെഹൂദാ സ്വദേശം വിട്ടു പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു പോകേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.
chapters.nkjv: Then the king of Babylon struck them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive from its own land.
chapters.kjv: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

chapters.ml: നെബൂഖദ്നേസർ പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയ ജനം: ഏഴാം ആണ്ടിൽ മൂവായിരത്തിരുപത്തുമൂന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാർ;
chapters.niv: This is the number of the people Nebuchadnezzar carried into exile: in the seventh year, 3,023 Jews;
chapters.nkjv: These are the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand and twenty-three Jews;
chapters.kjv: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

chapters.ml: നെബൂഖദ്നേസരിന്റെ പതിനെട്ടാം ആണ്ടിൽ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നു പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയ എണ്ണൂറ്റിമുപ്പത്തുരണ്ടു പേർ;
chapters.niv: in Nebuchadnezzar’s eighteenth year, 832 people from Jerusalem;
chapters.nkjv: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred and thirty-two persons;
chapters.kjv: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

chapters.ml: നെബൂഖദ്നേസരിന്റെ ഇരുപത്തുമൂന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ, അകമ്പടിനായകനായ നെബൂസർ-അദാൻ പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയ യെഹൂദന്മാർ എഴുനൂറ്റി നാല്പത്തഞ്ചുപേർ; ഇങ്ങനെ ആകെ നാലായിരത്തറുനൂറു പേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: in his twenty-third year, 745 Jews taken into exile by Nebuzaradan the commander of the imperial guard. There were 4,600 people in all.
chapters.nkjv: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred and forty-five persons. All the persons were four thousand six hundred.
chapters.kjv: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോയാഖീന്റെ പ്രവാസത്തിന്റെ മുപ്പത്തേഴാമാണ്ടിൽ പന്ത്രണ്ടാം മാസം ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി ബാബേൽരാജാവായ എവീൽ-മെരോദക്ക് തന്റെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ ഒന്നാം ആണ്ടിൽ യെഹൂദാരാജാവായ യെഹോയാഖീനെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah and freed him from prison.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth day of the month, that Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah and brought him out of prison.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,

chapters.ml: അവനോടു ആദരവായി സംസാരിച്ചു, അവന്റെ ആസനത്തെ തന്നോടു കൂടെ ബാബേലിൽ ഉള്ള രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ ആസനങ്ങൾക്കു മേലായി വെച്ചു,
chapters.niv: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: And he spoke kindly to him and gave him a more prominent seat than those of the kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.kjv: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കാരാഗൃഹവസ്ത്രം മാറ്റി, അവൻ ജീവപര്യന്തം നിത്യവും അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.
chapters.nkjv: So Jehoiachin changed from his prison garments, and he ate bread regularly before the king all the days of his life.
chapters.kjv: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അഹോവൃത്തിയോ ബാബേൽരാജാവു അവന്നു അവന്റെ മരണദിവസംവരെ അവന്റെ ജീവകാലമൊക്കെയും നിത്യവൃത്തിക്കു ദിവസം പ്രതിയുള്ള ഓഹരി കൊടുത്തുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Day by day the king of Babylon gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived, till the day of his death.
chapters.nkjv: And as for his provisions, there was a regular ration given him by the king of Babylon, a portion for each day until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
chapters.kjv: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ, ജനപൂർണ്ണയായിരുന്ന നഗരം ഏകാന്തയായിരിക്കുന്നതെങ്ങനെ? ജാതികളിൽ മഹതിയായിരുന്നവൾ വിധവയെപ്പോലെ ആയതെങ്ങനെ? സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളുടെ നായകിയായിരുന്നവൾ ഊഴിയവേലക്കാരത്തിയായതെങ്ങനെ?
chapters.niv: How deserted lies the city, once so full of people! How like a widow is she, who once was great among the nations! She who was queen among the provinces has now become a slave.
chapters.nkjv: How lonely sits the city Thatwas full of people! How like a widow is she, Who was great among the nations! The princess among the provinces Has become a slave!
chapters.kjv: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിൽ അവൾ കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു. അവളുടെ കവിൾത്തടങ്ങളിൽ കണ്ണുനീർ കാണുന്നു; അവളുടെ സകലപ്രിയന്മാരിലും അവളെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ല; അവളുടെ സ്നേഹിതന്മാരൊക്കെയും അവൾക്കു ശത്രുക്കളായി ദ്രോഹം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Bitterly she weeps at night, tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.
chapters.nkjv: She weeps bitterly in the night, Her tears are on her cheeks; Among all her lovers She has none to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; They have become her enemies.
chapters.kjv: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

chapters.ml: കഷ്ടതയും കഠിനദാസ്യവുംനിമിത്തം യെഹൂദാ പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു പോകേണ്ടിവന്നു; അവൾ ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർക്കുന്നു; വിശ്രാമം കണ്ടെത്തുന്നതുമില്ല; അവളെ പിന്തുടരുന്നവരൊക്കെയും ഇടുക്കിടങ്ങളിൽവെച്ചു അവളെ എത്തിപ്പിടിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After affliction and harsh labor, Judah has gone into exile. She dwells among the nations; she finds no resting place. All who pursue her have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
chapters.nkjv: Judah has gone into captivity, Under affliction and hard servitude; She dwells among the nations, She finds no rest; All her persecutors overtake her in dire straits.
chapters.kjv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

chapters.ml: ഉത്സവത്തിന്നു ആരും വരായ്കകൊണ്ടു സീയോനിലേക്കുള്ള വഴികൾ ദുഃഖിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ വാതിലുകളൊക്കെയും ശൂന്യമായി. പുരോഹിതന്മാർ നെടുവീർപ്പിടുന്നു; അവളുടെ കന്യകമാർ ഖേദിക്കുന്നു; അവൾക്കും വ്യസനം പിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The roads to Zion mourn, for no one comes to her appointed festivals. All her gateways are desolate, her priests groan, her young women grieve, and she is in bitter anguish.
chapters.nkjv: The roads to Zion mourn Because no one comes to the set feasts. All her gates are desolate; Her priests sigh, Her virgins are afflicted, And she is in bitterness.
chapters.kjv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ അതിക്രമബാഹുല്യംനിമിത്തം യഹോവ അവൾക്കു സങ്കടം വരുത്തിയതിനാൽ അവളുടെ വൈരികൾക്കു പ്രാധാന്യം ലഭിച്ചു, അവളുടെ ശത്രുക്കൾ ശുഭമായിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങൾ വൈരിയുടെ മുമ്പായി പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു പോകേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. The Lord has brought her grief because of her many sins. Her children have gone into exile, captive before the foe.
chapters.nkjv: Her adversaries have become the master, Her enemies prosper; For the Lord has afflicted her Because of the multitude of her transgressions. Her children have gone into captivity before the enemy.
chapters.kjv: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

chapters.ml: സീയോൻ പുത്രിയുടെ മഹത്വമൊക്കെയും അവളെ വിട്ടുപോയി; അവളുടെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ മേച്ചൽ കാണാത്ത മാനുകളെപ്പോലെ ആയി; പിന്തുടരുന്നവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ അവർ ശക്തിയില്ലാതെ നടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the splendor has departed from Daughter Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; in weakness they have fled before the pursuer.
chapters.nkjv: And from the daughter of Zion All her splendor has departed. Her princes have become like deer That find no pasture, That flee without strength Before the pursuer.
chapters.kjv: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

chapters.ml: കഷ്ടാരിഷ്ടതകളുടെ കാലത്തു യെരൂശലേം പണ്ടത്തെ മനോഹരവസ്തുക്കളെയൊക്കെയും ഓർക്കുന്നു; സഹായിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ലാതെ അവളുടെ ജനം വൈരിയുടെ കയ്യിൽ അകപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ, വൈരികൾ അവളെ നോക്കി അവളുടെ നാശത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ചിരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands, there was no one to help her. Her enemies looked at her and laughed at her destruction.
chapters.nkjv: In the days of her affliction and roaming, Jerusalem remembers all her pleasant things That she had in the days of old. When her people fell into the hand of the enemy, With no one to help her, The adversaries saw her And mocked at her downfall.
chapters.kjv: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേം കഠിനപാപം ചെയ്തിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു മലിനയായിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളെ ബഹുമാനിച്ചവരൊക്കെയും അവളുടെ നഗ്നത കണ്ടിട്ടു അവളെ നിന്ദിക്കുന്നു; അവളോ നെടുവീർപ്പിട്ടുകൊണ്ടു പിന്നോക്കം തിരിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jerusalem has sinned greatly and so has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, for they have all seen her naked; she herself groans and turns away.
chapters.nkjv: Jerusalem has sinned gravely, Therefore she has become vile. All who honored her despise her Because they have seen her nakedness; Yes, she sighs and turns away.
chapters.kjv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ മലിനത ഉടുപ്പിന്റെ വിളുമ്പിൽ കാണുന്നു; അവൾ ഭാവികാലം ഓർത്തില്ല; അവൾ അതിശയമാംവണ്ണം വീണുപോയി; അവളെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ല; യഹോവേ, ശത്രു വമ്പു പറയുന്നു; എന്റെ സങ്കടം നോക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Her filthiness clung to her skirts; she did not consider her future. Her fall was astounding; there was none to comfort her. "Look, Lord , on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed."
chapters.nkjv: Her uncleanness is in her skirts; She did not consider her destiny; Therefore her collapse was awesome; She had no comforter. "O Lord, behold my affliction, For the enemy is exalted!"
chapters.kjv: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD , behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself .

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ സകലമനോഹരവസ്തുക്കളിന്മേലും വൈരി കൈവെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ സഭയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കരുതെന്നു നീ കല്പിച്ച ജാതികൾ അവളുടെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ കടന്നതു അവൾ കണ്ടുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The enemy laid hands on all her treasures; she saw pagan nations enter her sanctuary— those you had forbidden to enter your assembly.
chapters.nkjv: The adversary has spread his hand Over all her pleasant things; For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary, Those whom You commanded Not to enter Your assembly.
chapters.kjv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ സർവ്വജനവും നെടുവീർപ്പിട്ടുകൊണ്ടു ആഹാരം തിരയുന്നു; വിശപ്പടക്കുവാൻ ആഹാരത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ മനോഹര വസ്തുക്കളെ കൊടുത്തുകളയുന്നു; യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ നിന്ദിതയായിരിക്കുന്നതു കടാക്ഷിക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: All her people groan as they search for bread; they barter their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. "Look, Lord , and consider, for I am despised."
chapters.nkjv: All her people sigh, They seek bread; They have given their valuables for food to restore life. "See, O Lord, and consider, For I am scorned."
chapters.kjv: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD , and consider; for I am become vile.

chapters.ml: കടന്നുപോകുന്ന ഏവരുമായുള്ളോരേ, ഇതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഏതുമില്ലയോ? യഹോവ തന്റെ ഉഗ്രകോപദിവസത്തിൽ ദുഃഖിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന എനിക്കു അവൻ വരുത്തിയ വ്യസനം പോലെ ഒരു വ്യസനം ഉണ്ടോ എന്നു നോക്കുവിൻ!
chapters.niv: "Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see. Is any suffering like my suffering that was inflicted on me, that the Lord brought on me in the day of his fierce anger?
chapters.nkjv: "Isit nothing to you, all you who pass by? Behold and see If there is any sorrow like my sorrow, Which has been brought on me, Which the Lord has inflicted In the day of His fierce anger.
chapters.kjv: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

chapters.ml: ഉയരത്തിൽനിന്നു അവൻ എന്റെ അസ്ഥികളിൽ തീ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു കടന്നുപിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ കാലിന്നു അവൻ വല വിരിച്ചു, എന്നെ മടക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അവൻ എന്നെ ശൂന്യയും നിത്യരോഗിണിയും ആക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "From on high he sent fire, sent it down into my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
chapters.nkjv: "From above He has sent fire into my bones, And it overpowered them; He has spread a net for my feet And turned me back; He has made me desolate And faint all the day.
chapters.kjv: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അതിക്രമങ്ങളുടെ നുകം അവൻ സ്വന്തകയ്യാൽ പിണെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു, അവ എന്റെ കഴുത്തിൽ പിണെഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ എന്റെ ശക്തി ക്ഷയിപ്പിച്ചു; എനിക്കു എതിർത്തുനില്പാൻ കഴിയാത്തവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ കർത്താവു എന്നെ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "My sins have been bound into a yoke ; by his hands they were woven together. They have been hung on my neck, and the Lord has sapped my strength. He has given me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
chapters.nkjv: "The yoke of my transgressions was bound; They were woven together by His hands, And thrust upon my neck. He made my strength fail; The Lord delivered me into the hands of thosewhom I am not able to withstand.
chapters.kjv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നടുവിലെ സകലബലവാന്മാരെയും കർത്താവു നിരസിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; എന്റെ യൌവനക്കാരെ തകർത്തുകളയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ എന്റെ നേരെ ഒരു ഉത്സവയോഗം വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി; യെഹൂദാപുത്രിയായ കന്യകയെ കർത്താവു ചക്കിൽ ഇട്ടു ചിവിട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The Lord has rejected all the warriors in my midst; he has summoned an army against me to crush my young men. In his winepress the Lord has trampled Virgin Daughter Judah.
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord has trampled underfoot all my mighty men in my midst; He has called an assembly against me To crush my young men; The Lord trampled as in a winepress The virgin daughter of Judah.
chapters.kjv: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.

chapters.ml: ഇതുനിമിത്തം ഞാൻ കരയുന്നു; എന്റെ കണ്ണു കണ്ണുനീരൊഴുക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ തണുപ്പിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന ആശ്വാസപ്രദൻ എന്നോടു അകന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ശത്രു പ്രബലനായിരിക്കയാൽ എന്റെ മക്കൾ നശിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "This is why I weep and my eyes overflow with tears. No one is near to comfort me, no one to restore my spirit. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed."
chapters.nkjv: "For these things I weep; My eye, my eye overflows with water; Because the comforter, who should restore my life, Is far from me. My children are desolate Because the enemy prevailed."
chapters.kjv: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

chapters.ml: സീയോൻ കൈ മലർത്തുന്നു; അവളെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ല; യഹോവ യാക്കോബിന്നു അവന്റെ ചുറ്റും വൈരികളെ കല്പിച്ചാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; യെരൂശലേം അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ മലിനയായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The Lord has decreed for Jacob that his neighbors become his foes; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
chapters.nkjv: Zion spreads out her hands, But no one comforts her; The Lord has commanded concerning Jacob That those around him become his adversaries; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
chapters.kjv: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നീതിമാൻ; ഞാൻ അവന്റെ കല്പനയോടു മത്സരിച്ചു; സകലജാതികളുമായുള്ളോരേ, കേൾക്കേണമേ, എന്റെ വ്യസനം കാണേണമേ; എന്റെ കന്യകമാരും യൌവനക്കാരും പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു പോയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The Lord is righteous, yet I rebelled against his command. Listen, all you peoples; look on my suffering. My young men and young women have gone into exile.
chapters.nkjv: "The Lord is righteous, For I rebelled against His commandment. Hear now, all peoples, And behold my sorrow; My virgins and my young men Have gone into captivity.
chapters.kjv: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ പ്രിയന്മാരെ വിളിച്ചു; അവരോ എന്നെ ചതിച്ചു; എന്റെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും വിശപ്പടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആഹാരം തിരഞ്ഞുനടക്കുമ്പോൾ നഗരത്തിൽ വെച്ചു പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: "I called to my allies but they betrayed me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
chapters.nkjv: "I called for my lovers, But they deceived me; My priests and my elders Breathed their last in the city, While they sought food To restore their life.
chapters.kjv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, നോക്കേണമേ; ഞാൻ വിഷമത്തിലായി എന്റെ ഉള്ളം കലങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ കഠിനമായി മത്സരിക്കകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ ഹൃദയം എന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ മറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; പുറമേ വാൾ സന്തതിനാശം വരുത്തുന്നു; വീട്ടിലോ മരണം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "See, Lord , how distressed I am! I am in torment within, and in my heart I am disturbed, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is only death.
chapters.nkjv: "See, O Lord, that I am in distress; My soul is troubled; My heart is overturned within me, For I have been very rebellious. Outside the sword bereaves, At home itis like death.
chapters.kjv: Behold, O LORD ; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നെടുവീർപ്പിടുന്നതു അവർ കേട്ടു; എന്നെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ല; എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളൊക്കെയും എന്റെ അനർത്ഥം കേട്ടു, നീ അതു വരുത്തിയതുകൊണ്ടു സന്തോഷിക്കുന്നു; നീ കല്പിച്ച ദിവസം നീ വരുത്തും; അന്നു അവരും എന്നെപ്പോലെയാകും.
chapters.niv: "People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my distress; they rejoice at what you have done. May you bring the day you have announced so they may become like me.
chapters.nkjv: "They have heard that I sigh, But no one comforts me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; They are glad that You have done it. Bring on the day You have announced, That they may become like me.
chapters.kjv: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദുഷ്ടതയൊക്കെയും തിരുമുമ്പിൽ വരട്ടെ; എന്റെ സകല അതിക്രമങ്ങളും നിമിത്തം നീ എന്നോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അവരോടും ചെയ്യേണമേ; എന്റെ നെടുവിർപ്പു വളരെയല്ലോ; എന്റെ ഹൃദയം രോഗാർത്തമായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Let all their wickedness come before you; deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my sins. My groans are many and my heart is faint."
chapters.nkjv: "Let all their wickedness come before You, And do to them as You have done to me For all my transgressions; For my sighs are many, And my heart is faint."
chapters.kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ! യഹോവ സീയോൻ പുത്രിയെ തന്റെ കോപത്തിൽ മേഘംകൊണ്ടു മറെച്ചതെങ്ങനെ? അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മഹത്വം ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു ഭൂമിയൽ ഇട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു; തന്റെ കോപദിവസത്തിൽ അവൻ തന്റെ പാദപീഠത്തെ ഓർത്തതുമില്ല,
chapters.niv: How the Lord has covered Daughter Zion with the cloud of his anger ! He has hurled down the splendor of Israel from heaven to earth; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
chapters.nkjv: How the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion With a cloud in His anger! He cast down from heaven to the earth The beauty of Israel, And did not remember His footstool In the day of His anger.
chapters.kjv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു കരുണ കാണിക്കാതെ യാക്കോബിന്റെ മേച്ചൽപുറങ്ങളെയൊക്കെയും നശിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; തന്റെ ക്രോധത്തിൽ അവൻ യെഹൂദാപുത്രിയുടെ കോട്ടകളെ ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; രാജ്യത്തെയും അതിലെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെയും അവൻ നിലത്തിട്ടു അശുദ്ധമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob; in his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of Daughter Judah. He has brought her kingdom and its princes down to the ground in dishonor.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has swallowed up and has not pitied All the dwelling places of Jacob. He has thrown down in His wrath The strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He has brought them down to the ground; He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
chapters.kjv: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ഉഗ്രകോപത്തിൽ അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ കൊമ്പു ഒക്കെയും വെട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു; തന്റെ വലങ്കയ്യെ അവൻ ശത്രുവിൻ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു പിൻവലിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; ചുറ്റും ദഹിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ജ്വാലപോലെ അവൻ യാക്കോബിനെ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: In fierce anger he has cut off every horn of Israel. He has withdrawn his right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
chapters.nkjv: He has cut off in fierce anger Every horn of Israel; He has drawn back His right hand From before the enemy. He has blazed against Jacob like a flaming fire Devouring all around.
chapters.kjv: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

chapters.ml: ശത്രു എന്നപോലെ അവൻ വില്ലു കുലെച്ചു, വൈരി എന്നപോലെ അവൻ വലങ്കൈ ഓങ്ങി; കണ്ണിന്നു കൌതുകമുള്ളതു ഒക്കെയും നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു. സീയോൻ പുത്രിയുടെ കൂടാരത്തിൽ തന്റെ ക്രോധം തീപോലെ ചൊരിഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: Like an enemy he has strung his bow; his right hand is ready. Like a foe he has slain all who were pleasing to the eye; he has poured out his wrath like fire on the tent of Daughter Zion.
chapters.nkjv: Standing like an enemy, He has bent His bow; With His right hand, like an adversary, He has slain all whowere pleasing to His eye; On the tent of the daughter of Zion, He has poured out His fury like fire.
chapters.kjv: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു ശത്രുവെപ്പോലെ ആയി, യിസ്രായേലിനെ മുടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; അവളുടെ അരമനകളെ ഒക്കെയും മുടിച്ചു, അവളുടെ കോട്ടകളെ നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; യെഹൂദാപുത്രിക്കു ദുഃഖവും വിലാപവും വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord is like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for Daughter Judah.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord was like an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel, He has swallowed up all her palaces; He has destroyed her strongholds, And has increased mourning and lamentation In the daughter of Judah.
chapters.kjv: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തിരുനിവാസം ഒരു തോട്ടംപോലെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; തന്റെ ഉത്സവസ്ഥലം നശിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; യഹോവ സീയോനിൽ ഉത്സവവും ശബ്ബത്തും മറക്കുമാറാക്കി, തന്റെ ഉഗ്രകോപത്തിൽ രാജാവിനെയും പുരോഹിതനെയും നിരസിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He has laid waste his dwelling like a garden; he has destroyed his place of meeting. The Lord has made Zion forget her appointed festivals and her Sabbaths; in his fierce anger he has spurned both king and priest.
chapters.nkjv: He has done violence to His tabernacle, Asifitwere a garden; He has destroyed His place of assembly; The Lord has caused The appointed feasts and Sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion. In His burning indignation He has spurned the king and the priest.
chapters.kjv: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു തന്റെ യാഗപീഠം തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു, തന്റെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരം വെറുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ അരമനമതിലുകളെ അവൻ ശത്രുവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു; അവർ ഉത്സവത്തിൽ എന്നപോലെ യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ ആരവം ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: The Lord has rejected his altar and abandoned his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hands of the enemy; they have raised a shout in the house of the Lord as on the day of an appointed festival.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has spurned His altar, He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has given up the walls of her palaces Into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in the house of the Lord As on the day of a set feast.
chapters.kjv: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD , as in the day of a solemn feast.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സീയോൻ പുത്രിയുടെ മതിൽ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ നിർണ്ണയിച്ചു; അവൻ അളന്നു നശിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിൽനിന്നു കൈ പിൻവലിച്ചില്ല; അവൻ കോട്ടയും മതിലും ദുഃഖത്തിലാക്കി; അവ ഒരുപോലെ ക്ഷയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord determined to tear down the wall around Daughter Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withhold his hand from destroying. He made ramparts and walls lament; together they wasted away.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has purposed to destroy The wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out a line; He has not withdrawn His hand from destroying; Therefore He has caused the rampart and wall to lament; They languished together.
chapters.kjv: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ വാതിലുകൾ മണ്ണിൽ പൂണ്ടുപോയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ ഓടാമ്പൽ അവൻ തകർത്തു നശിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ രാജാവും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ന്യായപ്രമാണം ഇല്ലാത്ത ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ രാജാവും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരും ന്യായപ്രമാണം ഇല്ലാത്ത ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ പ്രവാചകന്മാർക്കു യഹോവയിങ്കൽ നിന്നു ദർശനം ഉണ്ടാകുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Her gates have sunk into the ground; their bars he has broken and destroyed. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and her prophets no longer find visions from the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations; The Law is no more, And her prophets find no vision from the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD .

chapters.ml: സീയോൻ പുത്രിയുടെ മൂപ്പന്മാർ മിണ്ടാതെ നിലത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ തലയിൽ പൊടി വാരിയിട്ടു രട്ടുടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; യെരൂശലേം കന്യകമാർ നിലത്തോളം തല താഴ്ത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The elders of Daughter Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have sprinkled dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion Sit on the ground and keep silence; They throw dust on their heads And gird themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem Bow their heads to the ground.
chapters.kjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ജനത്തിൻ പുത്രിയുടെ നാശം നിമിത്തം ഞാൻ കണ്ണുനീർ വാർത്തു കണ്ണു മങ്ങിപ്പോകുന്നു; എന്റെ ഉള്ളം കലങ്ങി കരൾ നിലത്തു ചൊരിഞ്ഞുവീഴുന്നു; പൈതങ്ങളും ശിശുക്കളും നഗരവീഥികളിൽ തളർന്നുകിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: My eyes fail from weeping, I am in torment within; my heart is poured out on the ground because my people are destroyed, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
chapters.nkjv: My eyes fail with tears, My heart is troubled; My bile is poured on the ground Because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the children and the infants Faint in the streets of the city.
chapters.kjv: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

chapters.ml: അവർ നിഹതന്മാരെപ്പോലെ നഗരവീഥികളിൽ തളർന്നുകിടക്കുമ്പോഴും അമ്മമാരുടെ മാർവ്വിൽവെച്ചു പ്രാണൻ വിടുമ്പോഴും ആഹാരവും വീഞ്ഞും എവിടെ എന്നു അമ്മമാരോടു ചോദിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They say to their mothers, "Where is bread and wine?" as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives ebb away in their mothers’ arms.
chapters.nkjv: They say to their mothers, "Where is grain and wine?" As they swoon like the wounded In the streets of the city, As their life is poured out In their mothers’ bosom.
chapters.kjv: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേംപുത്രിയേ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു എന്തു സാക്ഷീകരിക്കേണ്ടു? എന്തൊന്നിനെ നിന്നോടു സദൃശമാക്കേണ്ടു? സീയോൻ പുത്രിയായ കന്യകേ, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിപ്പാൻ എന്തൊന്നു നിന്നോടുപമിക്കേണ്ടു? നിന്റെ മുറിവു സമുദ്രംപോലെ വലുതായിരിക്കുന്നു; ആർ നിനക്കു സൌഖ്യം വരുത്തും?
chapters.niv: What can I say for you? With what can I compare you, Daughter Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may comfort you, Virgin Daughter Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?
chapters.nkjv: How shall I console you? To what shall I liken you, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare with you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? For your ruin is spread wide as the sea; Who can heal you?
chapters.kjv: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പ്രവാചകന്മാർ നിനക്കു ഭോഷത്വവും വ്യാജവും ദർശിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ നിന്റെ പ്രവാസം മാറ്റുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം നിന്റെ അകൃത്യം വെളിപ്പെടുത്താതെ വ്യാജവും പ്രവാസകാരണവുമായ പ്രവാചകം ദർശിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The visions of your prophets were false and worthless; they did not expose your sin to ward off your captivity. The prophecies they gave you were false and misleading.
chapters.nkjv: Your prophets have seen for you False and deceptive visions; They have not uncovered your iniquity, To bring back your captives, But have envisioned for you false prophecies and delusions.
chapters.kjv: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

chapters.ml: കടന്നുപോകുന്ന ഏവരും നിന്നെ നോക്കി കൈ കൊട്ടുന്നു; അവർ യെരൂശലേംപുത്രിയെച്ചൊല്ലി ചൂളകുത്തി തലകുലുക്കി: സൌന്ദര്യപൂർത്തി എന്നും സർവ്വമഹീതലമോദം എന്നും വിളിച്ചുവന്ന നഗരം ഇതു തന്നേയോ എന്നു ചോദിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All who pass your way clap their hands at you; they scoff and shake their heads at Daughter Jerusalem: "Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?"
chapters.nkjv: All who pass by clap their hands at you; They hiss and shake their heads At the daughter of Jerusalem: "Is this the city that is called ‘The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth’?"
chapters.kjv: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളൊക്കെയും നിന്റെ നേരെ വായ്പിളർക്കുന്നു; അവർ ചൂളകുത്തി, പല്ലുകടിച്ചു: നാം അവളെ വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളഞ്ഞു. നാം കാത്തിരുന്ന ദിവസം ഇതുതന്നേ, നമുക്കു സാദ്ധ്യമായി നാം കണ്ടു രസിപ്പാൻ ഇടയായല്ലോ എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All your enemies open their mouths wide against you; they scoff and gnash their teeth and say, "We have swallowed her up. This is the day we have waited for; we have lived to see it."
chapters.nkjv: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you; They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, "We have swallowed her up! Surely this is the day we have waited for; We have found it, we have seen it!"
chapters.kjv: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it .

chapters.ml: യഹോവ നിർണ്ണയിച്ചതു അനുഷ്ടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; പുരാതനകാലത്തു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു നിവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. കരുണകൂടാതെ അവൻ ഇടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; അവൻ ശത്രുവിനെ നിന്നെച്ചൊല്ലി സന്തോഷിപ്പിച്ചു വൈരികളുടെ കൊമ്പു ഉയർത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord has done what he planned; he has fulfilled his word, which he decreed long ago. He has overthrown you without pity, he has let the enemy gloat over you, he has exalted the horn of your foes.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has done what He purposed; He has fulfilled His word Which He commanded in days of old. He has thrown down and has not pitied, And He has caused an enemy to rejoice over you; He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
chapters.kjv: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ഹൃദയം കർത്താവിനോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു; സീയോൻ പുത്രിയുടെ മതിലേ, രാവും പകലും ഓലോല കണ്ണുനീരൊഴുക്കുക; നിനക്കുതന്നേ സ്വസ്ഥത നല്കരുതു; നിന്റെ കണ്മണി വിശ്രമിക്കയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. You walls of Daughter Zion, let your tears flow like a river day and night; give yourself no relief, your eyes no rest.
chapters.nkjv: Their heart cried out to the Lord, "O wall of the daughter of Zion, Let tears run down like a river day and night; Give yourself no relief; Give your eyes no rest.
chapters.kjv: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിൽ, യാമാരംഭത്തിങ്കൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിലവിളിക്ക; നിന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തെ വെള്ളംപോലെ കർത്തൃ സന്നിധിയിൽ പകരുക; വീഥികളുടെ തലെക്കലൊക്കെയും വിശപ്പുകൊണ്ടു തളർന്നുകിടക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളുടെ ജീവരക്ഷെക്കായി അവങ്കലേക്കു കൈ മലർത്തുക.
chapters.niv: Arise, cry out in the night, as the watches of the night begin; pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint from hunger at every street corner.
chapters.nkjv: "Arise, cry out in the night, At the beginning of the watches; Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift your hands toward Him For the life of your young children, Who faint from hunger at the head of every street."
chapters.kjv: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ആരോടാകുന്നു നീ ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തതെന്നു ഓർത്തു കടാക്ഷിക്കേണമേ! സ്ത്രീകൾ ഗർഭഫലത്തെ, കയ്യിൽ താലോലിച്ചു പോരുന്ന കുഞ്ഞുളെ തന്നേ തിന്നേണമോ? കർത്താവിന്റെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ പുരോഹിതനും പ്രവാചകനും കൊല്ലപ്പെടേണമോ?
chapters.niv: "Look, Lord , and consider: Whom have you ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the children they have cared for? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
chapters.nkjv: "See, O Lord, and consider! To whom have You done this? Should the women eat their offspring, The children they have cuddled? Should the priest and prophet be slain In the sanctuary of the Lord?
chapters.kjv: Behold, O LORD , and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

chapters.ml: വീഥികളിൽ ബാലനും വൃദ്ധനും നിലത്തു കിടക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ കന്യകമാരും യൌവനക്കാരും വാൾകൊണ്ടു വീണിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ കോപദിവസത്തിൽ നീ അവരെ കൊന്നു കരുണകൂടാതെ അറുത്തുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets; my young men and young women have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered them without pity.
chapters.nkjv: "Young and old lie On the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men Have fallen by the sword; You have slain them in the day of Your anger, You have slaughtered and not pitied.
chapters.kjv: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

chapters.ml: ഉത്സവത്തിന്നു വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടുംപോലെ നീ എനിക്കു സർവ്വത്രഭീതികളെ വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നു; യഹോവയുടെ കോപദിവസത്തിൽ ആരും ചാടിപ്പോകയില്ല; ആരും ശേഷിച്ചതുമില്ല; ഞാൻ കയ്യിൽ താലോലിച്ചു വളർത്തിയവരെ എന്റെ ശത്രു മുടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "As you summon to a feast day, so you summoned against me terrors on every side. In the day of the Lord ’s anger no one escaped or survived; those I cared for and reared my enemy has destroyed."
chapters.nkjv: "You have invited as to a feast day The terrors that surround me. In the day of the Lord’s anger There was no refugee or survivor. Those whom I have borne and brought up My enemies have destroyed."
chapters.kjv: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’s anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്റെ കോപത്തിന്റെ വടികൊണ്ടു കഷ്ടം കണ്ട പുരുഷനാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord ’s wrath.
chapters.nkjv: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of His wrath.
chapters.kjv: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നെ വെളിച്ചത്തിലല്ല, ഇരുട്ടിലത്രേ നടത്തിക്കൊണ്ടു പോന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness rather than light;
chapters.nkjv: He has led me and made me walk In darkness and not in light.
chapters.kjv: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

chapters.ml: അതേ, അവൻ ഇടവിടാതെ പിന്നെയും പിന്നെയും തന്റെ കൈ എന്റെ നേരെ തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: indeed, he has turned his hand against me again and again, all day long.
chapters.nkjv: Surely He has turned His hand against me Time and time again throughout the day.
chapters.kjv: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മാംസത്തെയും ത്വക്കിനെയും അവൻ ജീർണ്ണമാക്കി, എന്റെ അസ്ഥികളെ തകർത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has made my skin and my flesh grow old and has broken my bones.
chapters.nkjv: He has aged my flesh and my skin, And broken my bones.
chapters.kjv: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്റെ നേരെ പിണിതു, നഞ്ചും പ്രയാസവും എന്നെ ചുറ്റുമാറാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
chapters.nkjv: He has besieged me And surrounded me with bitterness and woe.
chapters.kjv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

chapters.ml: ശാശ്വതമൃതന്മാരെപ്പോലെ അവൻ എന്നെ ഇരുട്ടിൽ പാർപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.
chapters.nkjv: He has set me in dark places Like the dead of long ago.
chapters.kjv: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

chapters.ml: പുറത്തു പോകുവാൻ കഴിയാതവണ്ണം അവൻ എന്നെ വേലികെട്ടിയടച്ചു എന്റെ ചങ്ങലയെ ഭാരമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; he has weighed me down with chains.
chapters.nkjv: He has hedged me in so that I cannot get out; He has made my chain heavy.
chapters.kjv: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ക്കുകി നിലവിളിച്ചാലും അവൻ എന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന തടുത്തുകളയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Even when I call out or cry for help, he shuts out my prayer.
chapters.nkjv: Even when I cry and shout, He shuts out my prayer.
chapters.kjv: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

chapters.ml: വെട്ടുകല്ലുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ എന്റെ വഴി അടെച്ചു, എന്റെ പാതകളെ വികടമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has barred my way with blocks of stone; he has made my paths crooked.
chapters.nkjv: He has blocked my ways with hewn stone; He has made my paths crooked.
chapters.kjv: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എനിക്കു പതിയിരിക്കുന്ന കരടിയെപ്പോലെയും മറഞ്ഞുനില്ക്കുന്ന സിംഹത്തെപ്പോലെയും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Like a bear lying in wait, like a lion in hiding,
chapters.nkjv: He hasbeen to me a bear lying in wait, Like a lion in ambush.
chapters.kjv: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്റെ വഴികളെ തെറ്റിച്ചു എന്നെ കടിച്ചുകീറി ശൂന്യമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: he dragged me from the path and mangled me and left me without help.
chapters.nkjv: He has turned aside my ways and torn me in pieces; He has made me desolate.
chapters.kjv: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വില്ലു കുലെച്ചു എന്നെ അമ്പിന്നു ലാക്കാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.
chapters.nkjv: He has bent His bow And set me up as a target for the arrow.
chapters.kjv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പൂണിയിലെ അമ്പുകളെ എന്റെ അന്തരംഗങ്ങളിൽ തറെപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He pierced my heart with arrows from his quiver.
chapters.nkjv: He has caused the arrows of His quiver To pierce my loins.
chapters.kjv: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ സർവ്വജനത്തിന്നും പരിഹാസവും ഇടവിടാതെ അവരുടെ പാട്ടും ആയിത്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I became the laughingstock of all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
chapters.nkjv: I have become the ridicule of all my people— Their taunting song all the day.
chapters.kjv: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നെ കൈപ്പുകൊണ്ടു നിറെച്ചു, കാഞ്ഞിരംകൊണ്ടു മത്തുപിടിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: He has filled me with bitter herbs and given me gall to drink.
chapters.nkjv: He has filled me with bitterness, He has made me drink wormwood.
chapters.kjv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കല്ലുകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ പല്ലു തകർത്തു, എന്നെ വെണ്ണീരിൽ ഇട്ടുരുട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has broken my teeth with gravel; he has trampled me in the dust.
chapters.nkjv: He has also broken my teeth with gravel, And covered me with ashes.
chapters.kjv: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ സമാധാനത്തിൽനിന്നു നീക്കി; ഞാൻ സുഖം മറന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I have been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
chapters.nkjv: You have moved my soul far from peace; I have forgotten prosperity.
chapters.kjv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മഹത്വവും യഹോവയിങ്കലുള്ള എന്റെ പ്രത്യാശയും പൊയ്പോയല്ലോ എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So I say, "My splendor is gone and all that I had hoped from the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: And I said, "My strength and my hope Have perished from the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD :

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ കഷ്ടതയും അരിഷ്ടതയും കാഞ്ഞിരവും കൈപ്പും ഓർക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: I remember my affliction and my wandering, the bitterness and the gall.
chapters.nkjv: Remember my affliction and roaming, The wormwood and the gall.
chapters.kjv: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പ്രാണൻ എന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ എപ്പോഴും അവയെ ഓർത്തു ഉരുകിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I well remember them, and my soul is downcast within me.
chapters.nkjv: My soul still remembers And sinks within me.
chapters.kjv: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഞാൻ ഓർക്കും; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ പ്രത്യാശിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Yet this I call to mind and therefore I have hope:
chapters.nkjv: This I recall to my mind, Therefore I have hope.
chapters.kjv: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

chapters.ml: നാം മുടിഞ്ഞുപോകാതിരിക്കുന്നതു യഹോവയുടെ ദയ ആകുന്നു; അവന്റെ കരുണ തീർന്നു പോയിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ;
chapters.niv: Because of the Lord ’s great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.
chapters.nkjv: Through the Lord’s mercies we are not consumed, Because His compassions fail not.
chapters.kjv: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

chapters.ml: അതു രാവിലെതോറും പുതിയതും നിന്റെ വിശ്വസ്ഥത വലിയതും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
chapters.nkjv: Theyare new every morning; Great is Your faithfulness.
chapters.kjv: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ എന്റെ ഓഹരി എന്നു എന്റെ ഉള്ളം പറയുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അവനിൽ പ്രത്യാശവെക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I say to myself, "The Lord is my portion; therefore I will wait for him."
chapters.nkjv: "The Lordis my portion," says my soul, "Therefore I hope in Him!"
chapters.kjv: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

chapters.ml: തന്നെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നവർക്കും തന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവന്നും യഹോവ നല്ലവൻ.
chapters.niv: The Lord is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him;
chapters.nkjv: The Lordis good to those who wait for Him, To the soul who seeks Him.
chapters.kjv: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ രക്ഷെക്കായി മിണ്ടാതെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നതു നല്ലതു.
chapters.niv: it is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Itis good that one should hope and wait quietly For the salvation of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD .

chapters.ml: ബാല്യത്തിൽ നുകം ചുമക്കുന്നതു ഒരു പുരുഷന്നു നല്ലതു.
chapters.niv: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young.
chapters.nkjv: Itis good for a man to bear The yoke in his youth.
chapters.kjv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതു അവന്റെ മേൽ വെച്ചിരിക്ക കൊണ്ടു അവൻ തനിച്ചു മൌനം ആയിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Let him sit alone in silence, for the Lord has laid it on him.
chapters.nkjv: Let him sit alone and keep silent, Because God has laid it on him;
chapters.kjv: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ മുഖത്തെ പൊടിയോളം താഴ്ത്തട്ടെ; പക്ഷെ പ്രത്യാശ ശേഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Let him bury his face in the dust— there may yet be hope.
chapters.nkjv: Let him put his mouth in the dust— There may yet be hope.
chapters.kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

chapters.ml: തന്നെ അടിക്കുന്നവന്നു അവൻ കവിൾ കാണിക്കട്ടെ; അവൻ വേണ്ടുവോളം നിന്ദ അനുഭവിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him, and let him be filled with disgrace.
chapters.nkjv: Let him give his cheek to the one who strikes him, And be full of reproach.
chapters.kjv: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു എന്നേക്കും തള്ളിക്കളകയില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For no one is cast off by the Lord forever.
chapters.nkjv: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
chapters.kjv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദുഃഖിപ്പിച്ചാലും തന്റെ മഹാദയെക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം അവന്നു കരുണതോന്നും.
chapters.niv: Though he brings grief, he will show compassion, so great is his unfailing love.
