chapters.nkjv: Though He causes grief, Yet He will show compassion According to the multitude of His mercies.
chapters.kjv: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

chapters.ml: മനസ്സോടെയല്ലല്ലോ അവൻ മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്മാരെ ദുഃഖിപ്പിച്ചു വ്യസനിപ്പിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For he does not willingly bring affliction or grief to anyone.
chapters.nkjv: For He does not afflict willingly, Nor grieve the children of men.
chapters.kjv: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലബദ്ധന്മാരെയും കാല്കീഴിട്ടു മെതിക്കുന്നതും.
chapters.niv: To crush underfoot all prisoners in the land,
chapters.nkjv: To crush under one’s feet All the prisoners of the earth,
chapters.kjv: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

chapters.ml: അത്യുന്നതന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ മനുഷ്യന്റെ ന്യായം മറിച്ചുകളയുന്നതും.
chapters.niv: to deny people their rights before the Most High,
chapters.nkjv: To turn aside the justice due a man Before the face of the Most High,
chapters.kjv: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യനെ വ്യവഹാരത്തിൽ തെറ്റിച്ചുകളയുന്നതും കർത്താവു കാണുകയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: to deprive them of justice— would not the Lord see such things?
chapters.nkjv: Or subvert a man in his cause— The Lord does not approve.
chapters.kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു കല്പിക്കാതെ ആർ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടാകുന്നു വല്ലതും സംഭവിക്കുന്നതു?
chapters.niv: Who can speak and have it happen if the Lord has not decreed it?
chapters.nkjv: Who is he who speaks and it comes to pass, When the Lord has not commanded it?
chapters.kjv: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

chapters.ml: അത്യുന്നതന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു നന്മയും തിന്മയും പുറപ്പെടുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that both calamities and good things come?
chapters.nkjv: Isit not from the mouth of the Most High That woe and well-being proceed?
chapters.kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ ജീവനുള്ളന്നു നെടുവീർപ്പിടുന്നതെന്തു? ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ പാപങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു നെടുവീർപ്പിടട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Why should the living complain when punished for their sins?
chapters.nkjv: Why should a living man complain, A man for the punishment of his sins?
chapters.kjv: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

chapters.ml: നാം നമ്മുടെ നടുപ്പു ആരാഞ്ഞു ശോധനചെയ്തു യഹോവയുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കു തിരിയുക.
chapters.niv: Let us examine our ways and test them, and let us return to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Let us search out and examine our ways, And turn back to the Lord;
chapters.kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD .

chapters.ml: നാം കൈകളെയും ഹൃദയത്തെയും സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ ദൈവത്തിങ്കലേക്കു ഉയർത്തുക.
chapters.niv: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven, and say:
chapters.nkjv: Let us lift our hearts and hands To God in heaven.
chapters.kjv: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ അതിക്രമം ചെയ്തു മത്സരിച്ചു; നീ ക്ഷമിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "We have sinned and rebelled and you have not forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: We have transgressed and rebelled; You have not pardoned.
chapters.kjv: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

chapters.ml: നീ കോപം പുതെച്ചു ഞങ്ങളെ പിന്തുടർന്നു, കരുണകൂടാതെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us; you have slain without pity.
chapters.nkjv: You have covered Yourself with anger And pursued us; You have slain and not pitied.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കടക്കാതവണ്ണം നീ മേഘംകൊണ്ടു നിന്നെത്തന്നേ മറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: You have covered yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can get through.
chapters.nkjv: You have covered Yourself with a cloud, That prayer should not pass through.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

chapters.ml: നീ ഞങ്ങളെ ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ചവറും എച്ചിലും ആക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
chapters.nkjv: You have made us an offscouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ശത്രുക്കളൊക്കെയും ഞങ്ങളുടെ നേരെ വായ്പിളർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "All our enemies have opened their mouths wide against us.
chapters.nkjv: All our enemies Have opened their mouths against us.
chapters.kjv: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

chapters.ml: പേടിയും കണിയും ശൂന്യവും നാശവും ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഭവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We have suffered terror and pitfalls, ruin and destruction."
chapters.nkjv: Fear and a snare have come upon us, Desolation and destruction.
chapters.kjv: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ജനത്തിൻ പുത്രിയുടെ നാശംനിമിത്തം നീർത്തോടുകൾ എന്റെ കണ്ണിൽനിന്നൊഴുകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed.
chapters.nkjv: My eyes overflow with rivers of water For the destruction of the daughter of my people.
chapters.kjv: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു നോക്കി കടാക്ഷിക്കുവോളം
chapters.niv: My eyes will flow unceasingly, without relief,
chapters.nkjv: My eyes flow and do not cease, Without interruption,
chapters.kjv: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ കണ്ണു ഇടവിടാതെ പൊഴിക്കുന്നു; ഇളെക്കുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees.
chapters.nkjv: Till the Lord from heaven Looks down and sees.
chapters.kjv: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നഗരത്തിലെ സകലസ്ത്രീജനത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു എന്റെ കണ്ണു എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ വ്യസനിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: What I see brings grief to my soul because of all the women of my city.
chapters.nkjv: My eyes bring suffering to my soul Because of all the daughters of my city.
chapters.kjv: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

chapters.ml: കാരണംകൂടാതെ എന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളായവർ എന്നെ ഒരു പക്ഷിയെപ്പോലെ വേട്ടയാടിയിരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me like a bird.
chapters.nkjv: My enemies without cause Hunted me down like a bird.
chapters.kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

chapters.ml: അവർ എന്റെ ജീവനെ കുണ്ടറയിൽ ഇട്ടു നശിപ്പിച്ചു, എന്റെ മേൽ കല്ലു എറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They tried to end my life in a pit and threw stones at me;
chapters.nkjv: They silenced my life in the pit And threw stones at me.
chapters.kjv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളം എന്റെ തലെക്കുമീതെ കവിഞ്ഞൊഴുകി; ഞാൻ നശിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: the waters closed over my head, and I thought I was about to perish.
chapters.nkjv: The waters flowed over my head; I said, "I am cut off!"
chapters.kjv: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ ആഴമുള്ള കുണ്ടറയിൽനിന്നു നിന്റെ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I called on your name, Lord , from the depths of the pit.
chapters.nkjv: I called on Your name, O Lord, From the lowest pit.
chapters.kjv: I called upon thy name, O LORD , out of the low dungeon.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നെടുവീർപ്പിന്നും എന്റെ നിലവിളിക്കും ചെവി പൊത്തിക്കളയരുതേ എന്നുള്ള എന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന നീ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You heard my plea: "Do not close your ears to my cry for relief."
chapters.nkjv: You have heard my voice: "Do not hide Your ear From my sighing, from my cry for help."
chapters.kjv: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിച്ച നാളിൽ നീ അടുത്തുവന്നു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You came near when I called you, and you said, "Do not fear."
chapters.nkjv: You drew near on the day I called on You, And said, "Do not fear!"
chapters.kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, നീ എന്റെ വ്യവഹാരം നടത്തി, എന്റെ ജീവനെ വീണ്ടെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You, Lord, took up my case; you redeemed my life.
chapters.nkjv: O Lord, You have pleaded the case for my soul; You have redeemed my life.
chapters.kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ഞാൻ അനുഭവിച്ച അന്യായം നീ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ വ്യവഹാരം തീർത്തുതരേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Lord , you have seen the wrong done to me. Uphold my cause!
chapters.nkjv: O Lord, You have seen how I am wronged; Judge my case.
chapters.kjv: O LORD , thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

chapters.ml: അവർ ചെയ്ത സകലപ്രതികാരവും എനിക്കു വിരോധമായുള്ള അവരുടെ സകലനിരൂപണങ്ങളും നീ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You have seen the depth of their vengeance, all their plots against me.
chapters.nkjv: You have seen all their vengeance, All their schemes against me.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, അവരുടെ നിന്ദയും എനിക്കു വിരോധമായുള്ള അവരുടെ സകലനിരൂപണങ്ങളും
chapters.niv: Lord , you have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
chapters.nkjv: You have heard their reproach, O Lord, All their schemes against me,
chapters.kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD , and all their imaginations against me;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ എതിരികളുടെ വാക്കുകളും ഇടവിടാതെ എനിക്കു വിരോധമായുള്ള നിനവും നീ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: what my enemies whisper and mutter against me all day long.
chapters.nkjv: The lips of my enemies And their whispering against me all the day.
chapters.kjv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ഇരിപ്പും എഴുന്നേല്പും നോക്കേണമേ; ഞാൻ അവരുടെ പാട്ടായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Look at them! Sitting or standing, they mock me in their songs.
chapters.nkjv: Look at their sitting down and their rising up; I am their taunting song.
chapters.kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം അവർക്കു പകരം ചെയ്യേണമേ;
chapters.niv: Pay them back what they deserve, Lord , for what their hands have done.
chapters.nkjv: Repay them, O Lord, According to the work of their hands.
chapters.kjv: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD , according to the work of their hands.

chapters.ml: നീ അവർക്കു ഹൃദയകാഠിന്യം വരുത്തും; നിന്റെ ശാപം അവർക്കു വരട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Put a veil over their hearts, and may your curse be on them!
chapters.nkjv: Give them a veiled heart; Your curse be upon them!
chapters.kjv: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

chapters.ml: നീ അവരെ കോപത്തോടെ പിന്തുടർന്നു, യഹോവയുടെ ആകാശത്തിൻ കീഴിൽനിന്നു നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: In Your anger, Pursue and destroy them From under the heavens of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD .

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ, പൊന്നു മങ്ങിപ്പോയി, നിർമ്മല തങ്കം മാറിപ്പോയി, വിശുദ്ധരത്നങ്ങൾ സകലവീഥികളുടെയും തലെക്കൽ ചൊരിഞ്ഞു കിടക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: How the gold has lost its luster, the fine gold become dull! The sacred gems are scattered at every street corner.
chapters.nkjv: How the gold has become dim! How changed the fine gold! The stones of the sanctuary are scattered At the head of every street.
chapters.kjv: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

chapters.ml: തങ്കത്തോടു തുല്യരായിരുന്ന സീയോന്റെ വിശിഷ്ടപുത്രന്മാരെ കുശവന്റെ പണിയായ മൺപാത്രങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ എണ്ണിയിരിക്കുന്നതെങ്ങനെ?
chapters.niv: How the precious children of Zion, once worth their weight in gold, are now considered as pots of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
chapters.nkjv: The precious sons of Zion, Valuable as fine gold, How they are regarded as clay pots, The work of the hands of the potter!
chapters.kjv: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

chapters.ml: കുറുനരികൾപോലും മുലകാണിച്ചു കുട്ടികളെ കുടിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ പുത്രിയോ മരുഭൂമിയിലെ ഒട്ടകപ്പക്ഷിയെപ്പോലെ ക്രൂരയായ്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു
chapters.niv: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but my people have become heartless like ostriches in the desert.
chapters.nkjv: Even the jackals present their breasts To nurse their young; But the daughter of my people is cruel, Like ostriches in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: മുലകുടിക്കുന്ന കുഞ്ഞിന്റെ നാവു ദാഹംകൊണ്ടു അണ്ണാക്കോടു പറ്റിയിരിക്കുന്നു; പൈതങ്ങൾ അപ്പം ചോദിക്കുന്നു; ആരും നുറുക്കിക്കൊടുക്കുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Because of thirst the infant’s tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth; the children beg for bread, but no one gives it to them.
chapters.nkjv: The tongue of the infant clings To the roof of its mouth for thirst; The young children ask for bread, But no one breaks it for them.
chapters.kjv: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

chapters.ml: സ്വാദുഭോജ്യങ്ങളെ അനുഭവിച്ചുവന്നവർ വീഥികളിൽ പട്ടിണികിടക്കുന്നു; ധൂമ്രവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു വളർന്നവർ കുപ്പകളെ ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those brought up in royal purple now lie on ash heaps.
chapters.nkjv: Those who ate delicacies Are desolate in the streets; Those who were brought up in scarlet Embrace ash heaps.
chapters.kjv: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

chapters.ml: കൈ തൊടാതെ പെട്ടെന്നു മറിഞ്ഞുപോയ സൊദോമിന്റെ പാപത്തെക്കാൾ എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ പുത്രിയുടെ അകൃത്യം വലുതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment without a hand turned to help her.
chapters.nkjv: The punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people Is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, Which was overthrown in a moment, With no hand to help her!
chapters.kjv: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ഹിമത്തിലും നിർമ്മലന്മാരും പാലിലും വെളുത്തവരുമായിരുന്നു; അവരുടെ ദേഹം പവിഴത്തിലും ചുവപ്പുള്ളതും അവരുടെ ശോഭ നീലക്കല്ലുപോലെയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their princes were brighter than snow and whiter than milk, their bodies more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like lapis lazuli.
chapters.nkjv: Her Nazirites were brighter than snow And whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, Like sapphire in their appearance.
chapters.kjv: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ മുഖം കരിക്കട്ടയെക്കാൾ കറുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; വീഥികളിൽ അവരെ കണ്ടിട്ടു ആരും അറിയുന്നില്ല; അവരുടെ ത്വക്ക് അസ്ഥികളോടു പറ്റി ഉണങ്ങി മരംപോലെ ആയിത്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But now they are blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
chapters.nkjv: Now their appearance is blacker than soot; They go unrecognized in the streets; Their skin clings to their bones, It has become as dry as wood.
chapters.kjv: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

chapters.ml: വാൾകൊണ്ടു മരിക്കുന്നവർ വിശപ്പുകൊണ്ടു മരിക്കുന്നവരിലും ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ; അവർ നിലത്തിലെ അനുഭവമില്ലയാകയാൽ ബാധിതരായി ക്ഷീണിച്ചുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of famine; racked with hunger, they waste away for lack of food from the field.
chapters.nkjv: Those slain by the sword are better off Than those who die of hunger; For these pine away, Stricken forlack of the fruits of the field.
chapters.kjv: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

chapters.ml: കരുണയുള്ള സ്ത്രീകൾ തങ്ങളുടെ പൈതങ്ങളെ സ്വന്തകൈകൊണ്ടു പാകം ചെയ്തു; അവർ എന്റെ ജനത്തിൻ പുത്രിയുടെ നാശത്തിങ്കൽ അവർക്കു ആഹാരമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: With their own hands compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food when my people were destroyed.
chapters.nkjv: The hands of the compassionate women Have cooked their own children; They became food for them In the destruction of the daughter of my people.
chapters.kjv: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

chapters.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ ക്രോധം നിവർത്തിച്ചു, തന്റെ ഉഗ്രകോപം ചൊരിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ സീയോനിൽ തീ കത്തിച്ചു: അതു അതിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങളെ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Lord has given full vent to his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion that consumed her foundations.
chapters.nkjv: The Lord has fulfilled His fury, He has poured out His fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion, And it has devoured its foundations.
chapters.kjv: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

chapters.ml: വൈരിയും ശത്രുവും യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ വാതിലുകൾക്കകത്തു കടക്കും എന്നു ഭൂരാജാക്കന്മാരും ഭൂവാസികൾ ആരും വിശ്വസിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the peoples of the world, that enemies and foes could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: The kings of the earth, And all inhabitants of the world, Would not have believed That the adversary and the enemy Could enter the gates of Jerusalem—
chapters.kjv: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ നടുവിൽ നീതിമാന്മാരുടെ രക്തം ചൊരിഞ്ഞിട്ടുള്ള പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ പാപങ്ങളും പുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ അകൃത്യങ്ങളും ഹേതുവായി.
chapters.niv: But it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed within her the blood of the righteous.
chapters.nkjv: Because of the sins of her prophets And the iniquities of her priests, Who shed in her midst The blood of the just.
chapters.kjv: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

chapters.ml: അവർ കുരടന്മാരായി വീഥികളിൽ ഉഴന്നു രക്തം പുരണ്ടു നടക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ വസ്ത്രം ആർക്കും തൊട്ടുകൂടാ.
chapters.niv: Now they grope through the streets as if they were blind. They are so defiled with blood that no one dares to touch their garments.
chapters.nkjv: They wandered blind in the streets; They have defiled themselves with blood, So that no one would touch their garments.
chapters.kjv: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

chapters.ml: മാറുവിൻ! അശുദ്ധൻ! മാറുവിൻ! മാറുവിൻ! തൊടരുതു! എന്നു അവരോടു വിളിച്ചുപറയും; അവർ ഓടി ഉഴലുമ്പോൾ: അവർ ഇനി ഇവിടെ വന്നു പാർക്കയില്ല എന്നു ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ പറയും.
chapters.niv: "Go away! You are unclean!" people cry to them. "Away! Away! Don’t touch us!" When they flee and wander about, people among the nations say, "They can stay here no longer."
chapters.nkjv: They cried out to them, "Go away, unclean! Go away, go away, Do not touch us!" When they fled and wandered, Those among the nations said, "They shall no longer dwell here."
chapters.kjv: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ നോട്ടം അവരെ ചിതറിച്ചു; അവൻ അവരെ കടാക്ഷിക്കയില്ല; അവർ പുരോഹിതന്മാരെ ആദരിച്ചില്ല, വൃദ്ധന്മാരോടു കൃപ കാണിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: The Lord himself has scattered them; he no longer watches over them. The priests are shown no honor, the elders no favor.
chapters.nkjv: The face of the Lord scattered them; He no longer regards them. Thepeople do not respect the priests Nor show favor to the elders.
chapters.kjv: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

chapters.ml: വ്യർത്ഥസഹായത്തിന്നായി നോക്കി ഞങ്ങളുടെ കണ്ണു ഇപ്പോഴും മങ്ങുന്നു; രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കഴിയാത്ത ജാതിക്കായി ഞങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളുടെ കാവൽമാളികയിൽ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, our eyes failed, looking in vain for help; from our towers we watched for a nation that could not save us.
chapters.nkjv: Still our eyes failed us, Watching vainly for our help; In our watching we watched For a nation that could not save us.
chapters.kjv: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ വീഥികളിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു നടന്നു കൂടാതവണ്ണം അവർ ഞങ്ങളുടെ കാലടികൾക്കു പതിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങളുടെ അവസാനം അടുത്തു, ഞങ്ങളുടെ കാലം തികഞ്ഞു, ഞങ്ങളുടെ അവസാനം വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: People stalked us at every step, so we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near, our days were numbered, for our end had come.
chapters.nkjv: They tracked our steps So that we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near; Our days were over, For our end had come.
chapters.kjv: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളെ പിന്തുടർന്നവർ ആകാശത്തിലെ കഴുക്കളിലും വേഗമുള്ളവർ; അവർ മലകളിൽ ഞങ്ങളെ പിന്തുടർന്നു, മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കായി പതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.
chapters.nkjv: Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the heavens. They pursued us on the mountains And lay in wait for us in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവശ്വാസമായി, യഹോവയുടെ അഭിഷിക്തനായവൻ അവരുടെ കുഴികളിൽ അകപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ നിഴലിൽ നാം ജാതികളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ജിവിക്കും എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ വിചാരിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Lord ’s anointed, our very life breath, was caught in their traps. We thought that under his shadow we would live among the nations.
chapters.nkjv: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, Was caught in their pits, Of whom we said, "Under his shadow We shall live among the nations."
chapters.kjv: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD , was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

chapters.ml: ഊസ് ദേശത്തു പാർക്കുന്ന എദോംപുത്രിയേ, സന്തോഷിച്ചു ആനന്ദിക്ക; പാനപാത്രം നിന്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കും വരും; നീ ലഹരിപിടിച്ചു നിന്നെത്തന്നേ നഗ്നയാക്കും.
chapters.niv: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.
chapters.nkjv: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, You who dwell in the land of Uz! The cup shall also pass over to you And you shall become drunk and make yourself naked.
chapters.kjv: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

chapters.ml: സീയോൻ പുത്രിയേ, നിന്റെ അകൃത്യം തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇനി അവൻ നിന്നെ പ്രവാസത്തിലേക്കു അയക്കയില്ല; എദോംപുത്രിയേ അവൻ നിന്റെ അകൃത്യം സന്ദർശിക്കയും നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Your punishment will end, Daughter Zion; he will not prolong your exile. But he will punish your sin, Daughter Edom, and expose your wickedness.
chapters.nkjv: Thepunishmentof your iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; He will no longer send you into captivity. He will punish your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; He will uncover your sins!
chapters.kjv: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ഞങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ഭവിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഓർക്കേണമേ; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു നേരിട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്ദ നോക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Remember, Lord , what has happened to us; look, and see our disgrace.
chapters.nkjv: Remember, O Lord, what has come upon us; Look, and behold our reproach!
chapters.kjv: Remember, O LORD , what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശം അന്യന്മാർക്കും ഞങ്ങളുടെ വീടുകൾ അന്യജാതിക്കാർക്കും ആയ്പോയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.
chapters.nkjv: Our inheritance has been turned over to aliens, And our houses to foreigners.
chapters.kjv: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ അനാഥന്മാരും അപ്പനില്ലാത്തവരും ആയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങളുടെ അമ്മമാർ വിധവമാരായ്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We have become fatherless, our mothers are widows.
chapters.nkjv: We have become orphans and waifs, Our mothers are like widows.
chapters.kjv: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ വെള്ളം ഞങ്ങൾ വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങി കുടിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങളുടെ വിറകു ഞങ്ങൾ വിലകൊടുത്തു മേടിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We must buy the water we drink; our wood can be had only at a price.
chapters.nkjv: We pay for the water we drink, And our wood comes at a price.
chapters.kjv: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളെ പിന്തുടരുന്നവർ ഞങ്ങളുടെ കഴുത്തിൽ എത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ തളർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വിശ്രാമവുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are weary and find no rest.
chapters.nkjv: They pursue at our heels; We labor and have no rest.
chapters.kjv: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

chapters.ml: അപ്പം തിന്നു തൃപ്തരാകേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ മിസ്രയീമ്യർക്കും അശ്ശൂർയ്യർക്കും കീഴടങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
chapters.nkjv: We have given our hand to the Egyptians And the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
chapters.kjv: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ പാപം ചെയ്തു ഇല്ലാതെയായിരിക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ അകൃത്യങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങൾ ചുമക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Our ancestors sinned and are no more, and we bear their punishment.
chapters.nkjv: Our fathers sinned andare no more, But we bear their iniquities.
chapters.kjv: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

chapters.ml: ദാസന്മാർ ഞങ്ങളെ ഭരിക്കുന്നു; അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ വിടുവിപ്പാൻ ആരുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Slaves rule over us, and there is no one to free us from their hands.
chapters.nkjv: Servants rule over us; Thereis none to deliver us from their hand.
chapters.kjv: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

chapters.ml: മരുഭൂമിയിലെ വാൾനിമിത്തം പ്രാണഭയത്തോടെ ഞങ്ങൾ ആഹാരം ചെന്നു കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the desert.
chapters.nkjv: We get our bread attherisk of our lives, Because of the sword in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷാമത്തിന്റെ കാഠിന്യം നിമിത്തം ഞങ്ങളുടെ ത്വക്ക് അടുപ്പുപോലെ കറുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.
chapters.nkjv: Our skin is hot as an oven, Because of the fever of famine.
chapters.kjv: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

chapters.ml: അവർ സീയോനിൽ സ്ത്രീകളെയും യെഹൂദാപട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ കന്യകമാരെയും വഷളാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Women have been violated in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: They ravished the women in Zion, The maidens in the cities of Judah.
chapters.kjv: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സ്വന്തകൈകൊണ്ടു പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെ തൂക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; വൃദ്ധന്മാരുടെ മുഖം ആദരിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.
chapters.nkjv: Princes were hung up by their hands, And elders were not respected.
chapters.kjv: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

chapters.ml: യൌവനക്കാർ തിരികല്ലു ചുമക്കുന്നു; ബാലന്മാർ വിറകുചുമടുംകൊണ്ടു വീഴുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Young men toil at the millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
chapters.nkjv: Young men ground at the millstones; Boys staggered under loadsof wood.
chapters.kjv: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

chapters.ml: വൃദ്ധന്മാരെ പട്ടണവാതിൽക്കലും യൌവനക്കാരെ സംഗീതത്തിന്നും കാണുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
chapters.nkjv: The elders have ceased gatheringat the gate, And the young men from their music.
chapters.kjv: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയസന്തോഷം ഇല്ലാതെയായി; ഞങ്ങളുടെ നൃത്തം വിലാപമായ്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joy is gone from our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
chapters.nkjv: The joy of our heart has ceased; Our dance has turned into mourning.
chapters.kjv: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ തലയിലെ കിരീടം വീണുപോയി; ഞങ്ങൾ പാപം ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം!
chapters.niv: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
chapters.nkjv: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
chapters.kjv: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

chapters.ml: ഇതുകൊണ്ടു ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയത്തിന്നു രോഗം പിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇതുനിമിത്തം ഞങ്ങളുടെ കണ്ണു മങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Because of this our hearts are faint, because of these things our eyes grow dim
chapters.nkjv: Because of this our heart is faint; Because of these things our eyes grow dim;
chapters.kjv: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

chapters.ml: സീയോൻ പർവ്വതം ശൂന്യമായി കുറുക്കന്മാർ അവിടെ സഞ്ചരിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: for Mount Zion, which lies desolate, with jackals prowling over it.
chapters.nkjv: Because of Mount Zion which is desolate, With foxes walking about on it.
chapters.kjv: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, നീ ശാശ്വതനായും നിന്റെ സിംഹാസനം തലമുറതലമുറയായും ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You, Lord , reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.
chapters.nkjv: You, O Lord, remain forever; Your throne from generation to generation.
chapters.kjv: Thou, O LORD , remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

chapters.ml: നീ സദാകാലം ഞങ്ങളെ മറക്കുന്നതും ദീർഘകാലം ഞങ്ങളെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നതും എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?
chapters.nkjv: Why do You forget us forever, And forsake us for so long a time?
chapters.kjv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

chapters.ml: യഹോവേ, ഞങ്ങൾ മടങ്ങിവരേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ നിങ്കലേക്കു മടക്കിവരുത്തേണമേ; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പണ്ടത്തെപ്പോലെ ഒരു നല്ല കാലം വരുത്തേണമേ;
chapters.niv: Restore us to yourself, Lord , that we may return; renew our days as of old
chapters.nkjv: Turn us back to You, O Lord, and we will be restored; Renew our days as of old,
chapters.kjv: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD , and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

chapters.ml: അല്ല, നീ ഞങ്ങളെ അശേഷം ത്യജിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നുവോ? ഞങ്ങളോടു നീ അതികഠിനമായി കോപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.
chapters.nkjv: Unless You have utterly rejected us, And are very angry with us!
chapters.kjv: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.

chapters.ml: മുപ്പതാം ആണ്ടു നാലാം മാസം അഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി ഞാൻ കെബാർനദീതീരത്തു പ്രവാസികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ സ്വർഗ്ഗം തുറന്നു ഞാൻ ദിവ്യദർശനങ്ങളെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: In my thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the River Chebar, that the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

chapters.ml: യെഹോയാഖീൻ രാജാവിന്റെ പ്രവാസത്തിന്റെ അഞ്ചാം ആണ്ടിൽ മേല്പറഞ്ഞ മാസം അഞ്ചാം തിയ്യതി തന്നേ,
chapters.niv: On the fifth of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
chapters.nkjv: On the fifth day of the month, which was in the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
chapters.kjv: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,

chapters.ml: കല്ദയദേശത്തു കെബാർനദീതീരത്തുവെച്ചു ബൂസിയുടെ മകൻ യെഹെസ്കേൽ പുരോഹിതന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായി; അവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ കയ്യും അവന്റെമേൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, by the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians. There the hand of the Lord was on him.
chapters.nkjv: the word of the Lord came expressly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was upon him there.
chapters.kjv: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ വടക്കുനിന്നു ഒരു കൊടുങ്കാറ്റും വലിയോരു മേഘവും പാളിക്കത്തുന്ന തീയും വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അതിന്റെ ചുറ്റും ഒരു പ്രകാശവും അതിന്റെ നടുവിൽ നിന്നു, തീയുടെ നടുവിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ, ശുക്ളസ്വർണ്ണംപോലെ ഒരു കാഴ്ചയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I looked, and I saw a windstorm coming out of the north—an immense cloud with flashing lightning and surrounded by brilliant light. The center of the fire looked like glowing metal,
chapters.nkjv: Then I looked, and behold, a whirlwind was coming out of the north, a great cloud with raging fire engulfing itself; and brightness was all around it and radiating out of its midst like the color of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
chapters.kjv: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ നടുവിൽ നാലു ജീവികളുടെ സാദൃശ്യം കണ്ടു; അവയുടെ രൂപമോ: അവെക്കു മനുഷ്യസാദൃശ്യം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and in the fire was what looked like four living creatures. In appearance their form was human,
chapters.nkjv: Also from within it came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man.
chapters.kjv: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

chapters.ml: ഓരോന്നിന്നു നന്നാലു മുഖവും നന്നാലു ചിറകും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but each of them had four faces and four wings.
chapters.nkjv: Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings.
chapters.kjv: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ കാൽ ചൊവ്വുള്ളതും കാലടി കാളക്കിടാവിന്റെ കുളമ്പുപോലെയും ആയിരുന്നു; മിനുക്കിയ താമ്രംപോലെ അവ മിന്നിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their legs were straight; their feet were like those of a calf and gleamed like burnished bronze.
chapters.nkjv: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the soles of calves’ feet. They sparkled like the color of burnished bronze.
chapters.kjv: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

chapters.ml: അവെക്കു നാലു ഭാഗത്തും ചിറകിന്റെ കീഴായി മനുഷ്യക്കൈ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; നാലിന്നും മുഖങ്ങളും ചിറകുകളും ഇങ്ങനെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four of them had faces and wings,
chapters.nkjv: The hands of a man were under their wings on their four sides; and each of the four had faces and wings.
chapters.kjv: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ ചിറകുകൾ ഒന്നോടൊന്നു തൊട്ടിരുന്നു; പോകുമ്പോൾ അവ തിരിയാതെ ഓരോന്നും നേരെ മുമ്പോട്ടു പോകും.
chapters.niv: and the wings of one touched the wings of another. Each one went straight ahead; they did not turn as they moved.
chapters.nkjv: Their wings touched one another. Thecreatures did not turn when they went, but each one went straight forward.
chapters.kjv: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ മുഖരൂപമോ: അവെക്കു മനുഷ്യമുഖം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; നാലിന്നും വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു സിംഹമുഖവും ഇടത്തുഭാഗത്തു കാളമുഖവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; നാലിന്നും കഴുകുമുഖവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their faces looked like this: Each of the four had the face of a human being, and on the right side each had the face of a lion, and on the left the face of an ox; each also had the face of an eagle.
chapters.nkjv: As for the likeness of their faces, each had the face of a man; each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, each of the four had the face of an ox on the left side, and each of the four had the face of an eagle.
chapters.kjv: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെയായിരുന്നു അവയുടെ മുഖങ്ങൾ; അവയുടെ ചിറകുകൾ മേൽഭാഗം വിടർന്നിരുന്നു; ഈരണ്ടു ചിറകു തമ്മിൽ തൊട്ടും ഈരണ്ടു ചിറകുകൊണ്ടു ശരീരം മറെച്ചും ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Such were their faces. They each had two wings spreading out upward, each wing touching that of the creature on either side; and each had two other wings covering its body.
chapters.nkjv: Thus were their faces. Their wings stretched upward; two wings of each one touched one another, and two covered their bodies.
chapters.kjv: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

chapters.ml: അവ ഓരോന്നും നേരെ മുമ്പോട്ടു പോകും; പോകുമ്പോൾ അവ തിരിയാതെ ആത്മാവിന്നു പോകേണ്ടിയ ഇടത്തേക്കു തന്നേ പോകും.
chapters.niv: Each one went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they went.
chapters.nkjv: And each one went straight forward; they went wherever the spirit wanted to go, and they did not turn when they went.
chapters.kjv: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

chapters.ml: ജീവികളുടെ നടുവിൽ കത്തിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്ന തീക്കനൽപോലെയും പന്തങ്ങൾ പോലെയും ഒരു കാഴ്ച ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതു ജീവികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ സഞ്ചരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; ആ തീ തേജസ്സുള്ളതായിരുന്നു. തീയിൽനിന്നു മിന്നൽ പുറപ്പെട്ടുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among the creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
chapters.nkjv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches going back and forth among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and out of the fire went lightning.
chapters.kjv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

chapters.ml: ജീവികൾ മിന്നൽപോലെ അങ്ങോട്ടും ഇങ്ങോട്ടും ഓടിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The creatures sped back and forth like flashes of lightning.
chapters.nkjv: And the living creatures ran back and forth, in appearance like a flash of lightning.
chapters.kjv: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ജീവികളെ നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ നിലത്തു ജീവികളുടെ അരികെ നാലു മുഖത്തിന്നും നേരെ ഓരോ ചക്രം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
chapters.nkjv: Now as I looked at the living creatures, behold, a wheel was on the earth beside each living creature with its four faces.
chapters.kjv: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

chapters.ml: ചക്രങ്ങളുടെ കാഴ്ചയും പണിയും പുഷ്പരാഗത്തിന്റെ കാഴ്ചപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; അവെക്കു നാലിന്നും ഒരു ഭാഷ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു; അവയുടെ കാഴ്ചയും പണിയും ചക്രത്തിൽകൂടി മറ്റൊരു ചക്രം ഉള്ളതുപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like topaz, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.
chapters.nkjv: The appearance of the wheels and their workings was like the color of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. The appearance of their workings was, as it were, a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
chapters.kjv: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

chapters.ml: അവെക്കു നാലുഭാഗത്തേക്കും പോകാം; തിരിവാൻ ആവശ്യമില്ല.
chapters.niv: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not change direction as the creatures went.
chapters.nkjv: When they moved, they went toward any one of four directions; they did not turn aside when they went.
chapters.kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ വട്ടു പൊക്കമേറിയതും ഭയങ്കരവും ആയിരുന്നു; നാലിന്റെയും വട്ടുകൾക്കു ചുറ്റും അടുത്തടുത്തു കണ്ണുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
chapters.nkjv: As for their rims, they were so high they were awesome; and their rims were full of eyes, all around the four of them.
chapters.kjv: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.

chapters.ml: ജീവികൾ പോകുമ്പോൾ ചക്രങ്ങളും ചേരത്തന്നേ പോകും; ജീവകൾ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു പൊങ്ങുമ്പോൾ ചക്രങ്ങളും പൊങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: When the living creatures moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
chapters.nkjv: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
chapters.kjv: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവിന്നു പോകേണ്ടിയ ഇടത്തൊക്കെയും അവ പോകും; ജീവികളുടെ ആത്മാവു ചക്രങ്ങളിൽ ആയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ചക്രങ്ങൾ അവയോടുകൂടെ പൊങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.nkjv: Wherever the spirit wanted to go, they went, because there the spirit went; and the wheels were lifted together with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.kjv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

chapters.ml: ജീവികളുടെ ആത്മാവു ചക്രങ്ങളിൽ ആയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു, അവ പോകുമ്പോൾ ഇവയും പോകും; അവ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ ഇവയും നില്ക്കും; അവ ഭൂമിയിൽനിന്നു പൊങ്ങുമ്പോൾ ചക്രങ്ങളും അവയോടുകൂടെ പൊങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: When the creatures moved, they also moved; when the creatures stood still, they also stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.nkjv: When those went, these went; when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up together with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.kjv: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

chapters.ml: ജീവികളുടെ തലെക്കു മീതെ ഭയങ്കരമായോരു പളുങ്കുപോലെയുള്ള ഒരു വിതാനത്തിന്റെ രൂപം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതു അവയുടെ തലെക്കു മീതെ വിരിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was what looked something like a vault, sparkling like crystal, and awesome.
chapters.nkjv: The likeness of the firmament above the heads of the living creatures was like the color of an awesome crystal, stretched out over their heads.
chapters.kjv: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

chapters.ml: വിതാനത്തിന്റെ കീഴെ അവയുടെ ചിറകുകൾ നേക്കുനേരെ വിടർന്നിരുന്നു; അതതിന്റെ ശരീരത്തെ ഈ ഭാഗവും ആ ഭാഗവും മൂടുവാൻ ഓരോന്നിന്നും ഈരണ്ടുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Under the vault their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.
chapters.nkjv: And under the firmament their wings spreadout straight, one toward another. Each one had two which covered one side, and each one had two which covered the other side of the body.
chapters.kjv: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

chapters.ml: അവ പോകുമ്പോൾ ചിറകുകളുടെ ഇരെച്ചൽ വലിയ വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഇരെച്ചൽപോലെയും സർവ്വശക്തന്റെ നാദംപോലെയും ഒരു സൈന്യത്തിന്റെ ആരവം പോലെയും ഉള്ള മുഴക്കമായി ഞാൻ കേട്ടു; നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ അവ ചിറകു താഴ്ത്തും.
chapters.niv: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
chapters.nkjv: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a tumult like the noise of an army; and when they stood still, they let down their wings.
chapters.kjv: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ തലെക്കു മീതെയുള്ള വിതാനത്തിന്മേൽ നിന്നു ഒരു നാദം പുറപ്പെട്ടു; നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ അവ ചിറകു താഴ്ത്തും.
chapters.niv: Then there came a voice from above the vault over their heads as they stood with lowered wings.
chapters.nkjv: A voice came from above the firmament that was over their heads; whenever they stood, they let down their wings.
chapters.kjv: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ തലെക്കു മീതെയുള്ള വിതാനത്തിന്നു മീതെ നീലക്കല്ലിന്റെ കാഴ്ചപോലെ സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ രൂപവും സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ രൂപത്തിന്മേൽ അതിന്നു മീതെ മനുഷ്യസാദൃശ്യത്തിൽ ഒരു രൂപവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Above the vault over their heads was what looked like a throne of lapis lazuli, and high above on the throne was a figure like that of a man.
chapters.nkjv: And above the firmament over their heads was the likeness of a throne, in appearance like a sapphire stone; on the likeness of the throne was a likeness with the appearance of a man high above it.
chapters.kjv: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അരമുതൽ മേലോട്ടു അതിന്നകത്തു ചുറ്റും തീക്കൊത്ത ശുക്ളസ്വർണ്ണംപോലെ ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അവന്റെ അരമുതൽ കീഴോട്ടു തീ പോലെ ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അതിന്റെ ചുറ്റും പ്രകാശവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I saw that from what appeared to be his waist up he looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire, and that from there down he looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded him.
chapters.nkjv: Also from the appearance of His waist and upward I saw, as it were, the color of amber with the appearance of fire all around within it; and from the appearance of His waist and downward I saw, as it were, the appearance of fire with brightness all around.
chapters.kjv: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള പ്രകാശം മഴയുള്ള ദിവസത്തിൽ മേഘത്തിൽ കാണുന്ന വില്ലിന്റെ കാഴ്ചപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു. യഹോവയുടെ മഹത്വത്തിന്റെ പ്രത്യക്ഷത ഇങ്ങനെ ആയിരുന്നു കണ്ടതു; അതു കണ്ടിട്ടു ഞാൻ കവിണ്ണുവീണു; സംസാരിക്കുന്ന ഒരുത്തന്റെ ശബ്ദവും ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the radiance around him. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord . When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of one speaking.
chapters.nkjv: Like the appearance of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day, so was the appearance of the brightness all around it. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. So when I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of One speaking.
chapters.kjv: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD . And when I saw it , I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, നിവിർന്നുനിൽക്ക; ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He said to me, "Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak to you."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചപ്പോൾ ആത്മാവു എന്നിൽ വന്നു എന്നെ നിവിർന്നുനില്ക്കുമാറാക്കി; അവൻ എന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit entered me when He spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard Him who spoke to me.
chapters.kjv: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, എന്നോടു മത്സരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന മത്സരികളായ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അയക്കുന്നു; അവരും അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരും ഇന്നുവരെ എന്നോടു അതിക്രമം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said: "Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their ancestors have been in revolt against me to this very day.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to me: "Son of man, I am sending you to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.

chapters.ml: മക്കളോ ധാർഷ്ട്യവും ദുശ്ശാഠ്യവും ഉള്ളവരത്രെ; അവരുടെ അടുക്കലാകുന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അയക്കുന്നതു; യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു നീ അവരോടു പറയേണം.
chapters.niv: The people to whom I am sending you are obstinate and stubborn. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’
chapters.nkjv: For theyare impudent and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God.’
chapters.kjv: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD .

chapters.ml: കേട്ടാലും കേൾക്കാഞ്ഞാലും--അവർ മത്സരഗൃഹമല്ലോ--തങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എന്നു അവർ അറിയേണം.
chapters.niv: And whether they listen or fail to listen—for they are a rebellious people—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
chapters.nkjv: As for them, whether they hear or whether they refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that a prophet has been among them.
chapters.kjv: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

chapters.ml: നീയോ, മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, അവരെ പേടിക്കരുതു; പറക്കാരയും മുള്ളും നിന്റെ അരികെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നാലും തേളുകളുടെ ഇടയിൽ നീ പാർത്താലും അവരുടെ വാക്കു പേടിക്കരുതു; അവർ മത്സരഗൃഹമല്ലോ; നീ അവരുടെ വാക്കു പേടിക്കരുതു; അവരുടെ നോട്ടം കണ്ടു ഭ്രമിക്കയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns are all around you and you live among scorpions. Do not be afraid of what they say or be terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people.
chapters.nkjv: "And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them nor be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you and you dwell among scorpions; do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
chapters.kjv: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

chapters.ml: അവർ കേട്ടാലും കേൾക്കാഞ്ഞാലും നീ എന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെ അവരോടു പ്രസ്താവിക്കേണം; അവർ മഹാമത്സരികൾ അല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen, for they are rebellious.
chapters.nkjv: You shall speak My words to them, whether they hear or whether they refuse, for they are rebellious.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.

chapters.ml: നീയോ, മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു കേൾക്ക; നീ ആ മത്സരഗൃഹംപോലെ മത്സരക്കാരനായിരിക്കരുതു; ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തരുന്നതു നീ വായ്തുറന്നു തിന്നുക.
chapters.niv: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious people; open your mouth and eat what I give you."
chapters.nkjv: But you, son of man, hear what I say to you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you."
chapters.kjv: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നോക്കിയപ്പോൾ: ഒരു കൈ എങ്കലേക്കു നീട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നതും അതിൽ ഒരു പുസ്തകച്ചുരുൾ ഇരിക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll,
chapters.nkjv: Now when I looked, there was a hand stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
chapters.kjv: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിനെ എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വിടർത്തി: അതിൽ അകത്തും പുറത്തും എഴുത്തുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; വിലാപങ്ങളും സങ്കടവും കഷ്ടവും അതിൽ എഴുതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: which he unrolled before me. On both sides of it were written words of lament and mourning and woe.
chapters.nkjv: Then He spread it before me; and therewas writing on the inside and on the outside, and written on it were lamentations and mourning and woe.
chapters.kjv: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, നീ കാണുന്നതു തിന്നുക: ഈ ചുരുൾ തിന്നിട്ടു ചെന്നു യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തോടു സംസാരിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the people of Israel."
chapters.nkjv: Moreover He said to me, "Son of man, eat what you find; eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel."
chapters.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വായ്തുറന്നു, അവൻ ആ ചുരുൾ എനിക്കു തിന്മാൻ തന്നു എന്നോടു:
chapters.niv: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.
chapters.nkjv: So I opened my mouth, and He caused me to eat that scroll.
chapters.kjv: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തരുന്ന ഈ ചുരുൾ നീ വയറ്റിൽ ആക്കി ഉദരം നിറെക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ അതു തിന്നു; അതു വായിൽ തേൻ പോലെ മധുരമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it." So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, feed your belly, and fill your stomach with this scroll that I give you." So I ate, and it was in my mouth like honey in sweetness.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, നീ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു എന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെ അവരോടു പ്രസ്താവിക്ക.
chapters.niv: He then said to me: "Son of man, go now to the people of Israel and speak my words to them.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to me: "Son of man, go to the house of Israel and speak with My words to them.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

chapters.ml: അവ്യക്തവാക്കും കനത്ത നാവും ഉള്ള ജാതിയുടെ അടുക്കൽ അല്ല, യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കലത്രേ നിന്നെ അയക്കുന്നതു;
chapters.niv: You are not being sent to a people of obscure speech and strange language, but to the people of Israel—
chapters.nkjv: For you are not sent to a people of unfamiliar speech and of hard language, but to the house of Israel,
chapters.kjv: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;

chapters.ml: അവ്യക്തവാക്കും കനത്ത നാവും ഉള്ളവരായി, നിനക്കു വാക്കു ഗ്രഹിച്ചുകൂടാത്ത അനേകം ജാതികളുടെ അടുക്കലല്ല; അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അയച്ചെങ്കിൽ അവർ നിന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: not to many peoples of obscure speech and strange language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
chapters.nkjv: not to many people of unfamiliar speech and of hard language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely, had I sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
chapters.kjv: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമോ നിന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കയില്ല; എന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾപ്പാൻ അവർക്കു മനസ്സില്ലല്ലോ; യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമൊക്കെയും കടുത്ത നെറ്റിയും കഠിനഹൃദയവും ഉള്ളവരത്രെ.
chapters.niv: But the people of Israel are not willing to listen to you because they are not willing to listen to me, for all the Israelites are hardened and obstinate.
chapters.nkjv: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, because they will not listen to Me; for all the house of Israel are impudent and hard-hearted.
chapters.kjv: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മുഖം അവരുടെ മുഖത്തിന്നു നേരെ കഠിനവും നിന്റെ നെറ്റി അവരുടെ നെറ്റിക്കു നേരെ കടുപ്പവും ആക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But I will make you as unyielding and hardened as they are.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your forehead strong against their foreheads.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ നെറ്റി തീക്കല്ലിനെക്കാൾ കടുപ്പമുള്ള വജ്രംപോലെ ആക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ മത്സരഗൃഹമെങ്കിലും നീ അവരെ പേടിക്കരുതു; അവരുടെ നോട്ടം കണ്ടു ഭ്രമിക്കയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: I will make your forehead like the hardest stone, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people."
chapters.nkjv: Like adamant stone, harder than flint, I have made your forehead; do not be afraid of them, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house."
chapters.kjv: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്ന വചനങ്ങളൊക്കെയും ചെവികൊണ്ടു കേട്ടു ഹൃദയത്തിൽ കൈക്കൊൾക.
chapters.niv: And he said to me, "Son of man, listen carefully and take to heart all the words I speak to you.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover He said to me: "Son of man, receive into your heart all My words that I speak to you, and hear with your ears.
chapters.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.

chapters.ml: നീ നിന്റെ ജനത്തിൻ പുത്രന്മാരായ പ്രവാസികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു, അവർ കേട്ടാലും കേൾക്കാഞ്ഞാലും അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറക.
chapters.niv: Go now to your people in exile and speak to them. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says,’ whether they listen or fail to listen."
chapters.nkjv: And go, get to the captives, to the children of your people, and speak to them and tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord God,’ whether they hear, or whether they refuse."
chapters.kjv: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആത്മാവു എന്നെ എടുത്തു: യഹോവയുടെ മഹത്വം സ്വസ്ഥലത്തുനിന്നു അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ എന്നു ഞാൻ വലിയ മുഴക്കത്തോടെ ഒരു ശബ്ദം എന്റെ പിറകിൽ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound as the glory of the Lord rose from the place where it was standing.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a great thunderous voice: "Blessed is the glory of the Lord from His place!"
chapters.kjv: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying , Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.

chapters.ml: ജീവികളുടെ ചിറകു തമ്മിൽ തട്ടുന്ന ഒച്ചയും അവയുടെ അരികെയുള്ള ചക്രങ്ങളുടെ ഇരെച്ചലും വലിയ മുഴക്കമുള്ളോരു ശബ്ദവും ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.
chapters.nkjv: I also heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, and a great thunderous noise.
chapters.kjv: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു എന്നെ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുപോയി; ഞാൻ വ്യസനത്തോടും മനസ്സിന്റെ ഉഷ്ണത്തോടും കൂടെ പോയി, യഹോവയുടെ കൈ ശക്തിയോടെ എന്റെ മേൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Spirit then lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the Lord on me.
chapters.nkjv: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the Lord was strong upon me.
chapters.kjv: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ കെബാർനദീതീരത്തു പാർത്ത തേൽ-ആബീബിലെ പ്രവാസികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ, അവർ പാർത്തെടത്തു തന്നേ എത്തി, അവരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഏഴു ദിവസം സ്തംഭിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: I came to the exiles who lived at Tel Aviv near the Kebar River. And there, where they were living, I sat among them for seven days—deeply distressed.
chapters.nkjv: Then I came to the captives at Tel Abib, who dwelt by the River Chebar; and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
chapters.kjv: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു എനിക്കുണ്ടായതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: At the end of seven days the word of the Lord came to me:
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass at the end of seven days that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തിന്നു കാവൽക്കാരനാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ എന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു വചനം കേട്ടു എന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ അവരെ പ്രബോധിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.
chapters.nkjv: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; therefore hear a word from My mouth, and give them warning from Me:
chapters.kjv: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദുഷ്ടനോടു: നീ മരിക്കും എന്നു കല്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ നീ അവനെ ഓർപ്പിക്കയോ ദുഷ്ടനെ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ തന്റെ ദുർമ്മാർഗ്ഗം വിടുവാൻ അവനെ ഓർപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടും ഒന്നും പറകയോ ചെയ്യാഞ്ഞാൽ, ദുഷ്ടൻ തന്റെ അകൃത്യത്തിൽ മരിക്കും; അവന്റെ രക്തമോ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ചോദിക്കും.
chapters.niv: When I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ and you do not warn them or speak out to dissuade them from their evil ways in order to save their life, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
chapters.nkjv: When I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood I will require at your hand.
chapters.kjv: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ ദുഷ്ടനെ ഓർപ്പിച്ചിട്ടും അവൻ തന്റെ ദുഷ്ടതയും ദുർമ്മാർഗ്ഗവും വിട്ടുതിരിയുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ അവൻ തന്റെ അകൃത്യത്തിൽ മരിക്കും; നീയോ നിന്റെ പ്രാണനെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But if you do warn the wicked person and they do not turn from their wickedness or from their evil ways, they will die for their sin; but you will have saved yourself.
chapters.nkjv: Yet, if you warn the wicked, and he does not turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
chapters.kjv: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

chapters.ml: അഥവാ, നീതിമാൻ തന്റെ നീതി വിട്ടുമാറി നീതികേടു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിട്ടു ഞാൻ അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഇടർച്ച വെക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ അവൻ മരിക്കും; നീ അവനെ ഓർപ്പിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ തന്റെ പാപത്തിൽ മരിക്കും; അവൻ ചെയ്ത നീതി അവന്നു കണക്കിടുകയുമില്ല; അവന്റെ രക്തമോ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ചോദിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Again, when a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before them, they will die. Since you did not warn them, they will die for their sin. The righteous things that person did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
chapters.nkjv: "Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die; because you did not give him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood I will require at your hand.
chapters.kjv: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീതിമാൻ പാപം ചെയ്യാതെയിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ നീതിമാനെ ഓർപ്പിച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ പാപം ചെയ്യാതെ ഇരുന്നാൽ, അവൻ പ്രബോധനം കൈക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കയാൽ അവൻ ജീവിക്കും; നീയും നിന്റെ പ്രാണനെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But if you do warn the righteous person not to sin and they do not sin, they will surely live because they took warning, and you will have saved yourself."
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man that the righteous should not sin, and he does not sin, he shall surely live because he took warning; also you will have delivered your soul."
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man , that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കൈ അവിടെ പിന്നെയും എന്റെമേൽ വന്നു; അവൻ എന്നോടു: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സമഭൂമിയിലേക്കു പോക; അവിടെവെച്ചു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The hand of the Lord was on me there, and he said to me, "Get up and go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you."
chapters.nkjv: Then the hand of the Lord was upon me there, and He said to me, "Arise, go out into the plain, and there I shall talk with you."
chapters.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സമഭൂമിയിലേക്കു പോയി; ഞാൻ കെബാർ നദീതീരത്തു കണ്ട മഹത്വംപോലെ അവിടെ യഹോവയുടെ മഹത്വം നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു ഞാൻ കവിണ്ണുവീണു.
chapters.niv: So I got up and went out to the plain. And the glory of the Lord was standing there, like the glory I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.
chapters.nkjv: So I arose and went out into the plain, and behold, the glory of the Lord stood there, like the glory which I saw by the River Chebar; and I fell on my face.
chapters.kjv: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആത്മാവു എന്നിൽ വന്നു എന്നെ നിവർന്നുനില്ക്കുമാറാക്കി, എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: നീ ചെന്നു നിന്റെ വീട്ടിന്നകത്തു കതകടെച്ചു പാർക്ക.
chapters.niv: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and spoke with me and said to me: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.
chapters.kjv: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, നിനക്കു അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പെരുമാറുവാൻ കഴിയാതവണ്ണം അവർ നിന്നെ കയറുകൊണ്ടു കെട്ടും.
chapters.niv: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes; you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.
chapters.nkjv: And you, O son of man, surely they will put ropes on you and bind you with them, so that you cannot go out among them.
chapters.kjv: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

chapters.ml: നീ ഊമനായി അവർക്കു ശാസകനാകാതെയിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ നാവിനെ നിന്റെ അണ്ണാക്കോടു പറ്റുമാറാക്കും; അവർ മത്സരഗൃഹമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious people.
chapters.nkjv: I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, so that you shall be mute and not be one to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious house.
chapters.kjv: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ വായി തുറക്കും; നീ അവരോടു: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറയേണം; കേൾക്കുന്നവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ; കേൾക്കാത്തവൻ കേൾക്കാതെ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ; അവർ മത്സരഗൃഹമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’ Whoever will listen let them listen, and whoever will refuse let them refuse; for they are a rebellious people.
chapters.nkjv: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.
chapters.kjv: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, നീ ഒരു ഇഷ്ടിക എടുത്തു നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു അതിൽ യെരൂശലേംനഗരം വരെച്ചു, അതിനെ നിരോധിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: "Now, son of man, take a block of clay, put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.
chapters.nkjv: "You also, son of man, take a clay tablet and lay it before you, and portray on it a city, Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെനേരെ കൊത്തളം പണിതു വാടകോരി പാളയം അടിച്ചു ചുറ്റും യന്ത്രമുട്ടികളെ വെക്കുക.
chapters.niv: Then lay siege to it: Erect siege works against it, build a ramp up to it, set up camps against it and put battering rams around it.
chapters.nkjv: Lay siege against it, build a siege wall against it, and heap up a mound against it; set camps against it also, and place battering rams against it all around.
chapters.kjv: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഒരു ഇരുമ്പുചട്ടി എടുത്തു നിനക്കും നഗരത്തിന്നും മദ്ധ്യേ ഇരിമ്പുമതിലായി വെക്കുക; നിന്റെ മുഖം അതിന്റെനേരെ വെച്ചു, അതു നിരോധത്തിൽ ആകേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിനെ നിരോധിക്ക; ഇതു യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തിന്നു ഒരടയാളം ആയിരിക്കട്ടെ;
chapters.niv: Then take an iron pan, place it as an iron wall between you and the city and turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the people of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover take for yourself an iron plate, and set it as an iron wall between you and the city. Set your face against it, and it shall be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This willbe a sign to the house of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ നീ ഇടത്തുവശം ചരിഞ്ഞുകിടന്നു യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ അകൃത്യം അതിന്മേൽ ചുമത്തുക; നീ ആ വശം കിടക്കുന്ന ദിവസങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തോളം അവരുടെ അകൃത്യം വഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the people of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side.
chapters.nkjv: "Lie also on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it. According to the number of the days that you lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
chapters.kjv: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവരുടെ അകൃത്യത്തിന്റെ സംവത്സരങ്ങളെ നിനക്കു ദിവസങ്ങളായി എണ്ണും; അങ്ങനെ മുന്നൂറ്റി തൊണ്ണൂറു ദിവസം നീ യിസ്രായേൽ ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ അകൃത്യം വഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: I have assigned you the same number of days as the years of their sin. So for 390 days you will bear the sin of the people of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: For I have laid on you the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days; so you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
chapters.kjv: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

chapters.ml: ഇതു തികെച്ചിട്ടു നീ വലത്തുവശം ചരിഞ്ഞു കിടന്നു യെഹൂദാഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ അകൃത്യം നാല്പതു ദിവസം വഹിക്കേണം; ഒരു സംവത്സരത്തിന്നു ഒരു ദിവസംവീതം ഞാൻ നിനക്കു നിയമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "After you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the sin of the people of Judah. I have assigned you 40 days, a day for each year.
chapters.nkjv: And when you have completed them, lie again on your right side; then you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days. I have laid on you a day for each year.
chapters.kjv: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.

chapters.ml: നീ യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ നിരോധത്തിന്നുനേരെ നിന്റെ മുഖവും നഗ്നമായ ഭുജവും വെച്ചു അതിന്നു വിരോധമായി പ്രവചിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem and with bared arm prophesy against her.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem; your arm shallbe uncovered, and you shall prophesy against it.
chapters.kjv: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ നിരോധകാലം തികയുവോളം നീ ഒരു വശത്തുനിന്നു മറുവശത്തേക്കു തിരിയാതെ ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ ഇതാ, കയറുകൊണ്ടു നിന്നെ കെട്ടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.
chapters.nkjv: And surely I will restrain you so that you cannot turn from one side to another till you have ended the days of your siege.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.

chapters.ml: നീ കോതമ്പും യവവും അമരയും ചെറുപയറും തിനയും ചോളവും എടുത്തു ഒരു പാത്രത്തിൽ ഇട്ടു അവകൊണ്ടു അപ്പം ഉണ്ടാക്കുക; നീ വശംചരിഞ്ഞു കിടക്കുന്ന ദിവസങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം മുന്നൂറ്റിതൊണ്ണൂറു ദിവസം അതു തിന്നേണം.
chapters.niv: "Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt; put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the 390 days you lie on your side.
