chapters.nkjv: Thus you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing wasof fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate pastryof fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and succeeded to royalty.
chapters.kjv: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അണിയിച്ച അലങ്കാരംകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ സൌന്ദര്യം പരിപൂർണ്ണമായതിനാൽ നിന്റെ കീർത്തി ജാതികളിൽ പരന്നു എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: And your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, because the splendor I had given you made your beauty perfect, declares the Sovereign Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Your fame went out among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through My splendor which I had bestowed on you," says the Lord God.
chapters.kjv: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ നിന്റെ സൌന്ദര്യത്തിൽ ആശ്രയിച്ചു, നിന്റെ കീർത്തിഹേതുവായി പരസംഗം ചെയ്തു, വഴിപോകുന്ന ഏവന്റെമേലും നിന്റെ പരസംഗം ചെലവഴിച്ചു; അതു അവന്നുള്ളതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.
chapters.nkjv: "But you trusted in your own beauty, played the harlot because of your fame, and poured out your harlotry on everyone passing by who wouldhave it.
chapters.kjv: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വസ്ത്രങ്ങളിൽ ചിലതു നീ എടുത്തു, പല നിറത്തിൽ പൂജാഗിരികളെ തീർത്തലങ്കരിച്ചു, അവയുടെമേൽ പരസംഗം ചെയ്തു; ഈവക സംഭവിച്ചിട്ടില്ല, സംഭവിക്കയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: You took some of your garments to make gaudy high places, where you carried on your prostitution. You went to him, and he possessed your beauty.
chapters.nkjv: You took some of your garments and adorned multicolored high places for yourself, and played the harlot on them. Such things should not happen, nor be.
chapters.kjv: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so .

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തന്ന പൊന്നും വെള്ളിയുംകൊണ്ടുള്ള ആഭരണങ്ങളെ നീ എടുത്തു, പുരുഷരൂപങ്ങളെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി അവയോടു പരസംഗം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: You also took the fine jewelry I gave you, the jewelry made of my gold and silver, and you made for yourself male idols and engaged in prostitution with them.
chapters.nkjv: You have also taken your beautiful jewelry from My gold and My silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself male images and played the harlot with them.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വിചിത്രവസ്ത്രങ്ങളെ നീ എടുത്തു അവയെ പുതപ്പിച്ചു, എന്റെ എണ്ണയും കുന്തുരുക്കവും അവയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And you took your embroidered clothes to put on them, and you offered my oil and incense before them.
chapters.nkjv: You took your embroidered garments and covered them, and you set My oil and My incense before them.
chapters.kjv: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തന്ന ആഹാരമായി, നിന്റെ പോഷണത്തിന്നുള്ള നേരിയ മാവും എണ്ണയും തേനും നീ അവയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ സൌരഭ്യവാസനയായി നിവേദിച്ചു; കാര്യം ഇങ്ങനെയായി എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: Also the food I provided for you—the flour, olive oil and honey I gave you to eat—you offered as fragrant incense before them. That is what happened, declares the Sovereign Lord .
chapters.nkjv: Also My food which I gave you—the pastry of fine flour, oil, and honey which I fed you—you set it before them as sweet incense; and so it was," says the Lord God.
chapters.kjv: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD .

chapters.ml: നീ എനിക്കു പ്രസവിച്ച നിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും നീ എടുത്തു അവെക്കു ഭോജനബലിയായി അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: " ‘And you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to me and sacrificed them as food to the idols. Was your prostitution not enough?
chapters.nkjv: "Moreover you took your sons and your daughters, whom you bore to Me, and these you sacrificed to them to be devoured. Were your acts of harlotry a small matter,
chapters.kjv: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പരസംഗം പോരാഞ്ഞിട്ടോ നീ എന്റെ മക്കളെ അറുത്തു അഗ്നിപ്രവേശം ചെയ്യിച്ചു അവെക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തതു?
chapters.niv: You slaughtered my children and sacrificed them to the idols.
chapters.nkjv: that you have slain My children and offered them up to them by causing them to pass through the fire?
chapters.kjv: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിന്റെ സകല മ്ളേച്ഛതകളിലും പരസംഗങ്ങളിലും നീ മുമ്പെ നഗ്നയും അനാവൃതയും ആയി രക്തത്തിൽ കിടന്നുരുണ്ട നിന്റെ യൌവനകാലം ഓർത്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: In all your detestable practices and your prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.
chapters.nkjv: And in all your abominations and acts of harlotry you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, struggling in your blood.
chapters.kjv: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദുഷ്ടതയൊക്കെയും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചശേഷമോ--നിനക്കുകഷ്ടം, കഷ്ടം! എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു--
chapters.niv: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, declares the Sovereign Lord . In addition to all your other wickedness,
chapters.nkjv: "Then it was so, after all your wickedness—‘Woe, woe to you!’ says the Lord God—
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD ;)

chapters.ml: നീ ഒരു കമാനം പണിതു, സകല വീഥിയിലും ഓരോ പൂജാഗിരി ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: you built a mound for yourself and made a lofty shrine in every public square.
chapters.nkjv: that you also built for yourself a shrine, and made a high place for yourself in every street.
chapters.kjv: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാ വഴിത്തലക്കലും പൂജാഗിരി പണിതു, നീ നിന്റെ സൌന്ദര്യത്തെ വഷളാക്കി, വഴി പോകുന്ന ഏവന്നും നിന്റെ കാലുകളെ അകത്തി നിന്റെ പരസംഗം വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At every street corner you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty, spreading your legs with increasing promiscuity to anyone who passed by.
chapters.nkjv: You built your high places at the head of every road, and made your beauty to be abhorred. You offered yourself to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your acts of harlotry.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.

chapters.ml: മാംസപുഷ്ടിയുള്ള മിസ്രയീമ്യരായ നിന്റെ അയൽക്കാരോടും നീ പരസംഗംചെയ്തു, എന്നെ കോപിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിന്റെ പരസംഗം വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your neighbors with large genitals, and aroused my anger with your increasing promiscuity.
chapters.nkjv: You also committed harlotry with the Egyptians, your very fleshly neighbors, and increased your acts of harlotry to provoke Me to anger.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്റെ നേരെ കൈ നീട്ടി, നിന്റെ നിത്യച്ചെലവു കുറെച്ചു, നിന്നെ ദ്വേഷിക്കയും നിന്റെ ദുർമ്മാർഗ്ഗത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ലജ്ജിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഫെലിസ്ത്യ പുത്രിമാരുടെ ഇഷ്ടത്തിന്നു നിന്നെ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.
chapters.nkjv: "Behold, therefore, I stretched out My hand against you, diminished your allotment, and gave you up to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd behavior.
chapters.kjv: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food , and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

chapters.ml: മതിവാരത്തവളാകയാൽ നീ അശ്ശൂർയ്യരോടും പരസംഗം ചെയ്തു; അവരുമായി പരസംഗം ചെയ്തിട്ടും നിനക്കു തൃപ്തിവന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.
chapters.nkjv: You also played the harlot with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; indeed you played the harlot with them and still were not satisfied.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

chapters.ml: നീ കനാൻ ദേശത്തും കല്ദയദേശംവരെയും നിന്റെ പരസംഗം വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു; എന്നിട്ടും അതിനാലും നിനക്കു തൃപ്തിവന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then you increased your promiscuity to include Babylonia, a land of merchants, but even with this you were not satisfied.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover you multiplied your acts of harlotry as far as the land of the trader, Chaldea; and even then you were not satisfied.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

chapters.ml: നാണം കെട്ട വേശ്യയുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിയായിരിക്കുന്ന ഇതൊക്കെയും ചെയ്തതിൽ, നീ എല്ലാവഴിത്തലെക്കലും കമാനം പണിതു, സമലവീഥിയിലും പൂജാഗിരി ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതിൽ,
chapters.niv: " ‘I am filled with fury against you, declares the Sovereign Lord , when you do all these things, acting like a brazen prostitute!
chapters.nkjv: "How degenerate is your heart!" says the Lord God, "seeing you do all these things, the deeds of a brazen harlot.
chapters.kjv: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD , seeing thou doest all these things , the work of an imperious whorish woman;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഹൃദയം എത്ര മാരമാൽ പൂണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു; നീ കൂലി നിരസിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു വേശ്യയെപ്പോലെയല്ല.
chapters.niv: When you built your mounds at every street corner and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were unlike a prostitute, because you scorned payment.
chapters.nkjv: "You erected your shrine at the head of every road, and built your high place in every street. Yet you were not like a harlot, because you scorned payment.
chapters.kjv: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;

chapters.ml: ഭർത്താവിന്നു പകരം അന്യന്മാരെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്യുന്ന സ്ത്രീയേ!
chapters.niv: " ‘You adulterous wife! You prefer strangers to your own husband!
chapters.nkjv: Youare an adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband.
chapters.kjv: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!

chapters.ml: സകല വേശ്യാസ്ത്രീകളും സമ്മാനം വാങ്ങുന്നു; നീയോ നിന്റെ സകലജാരന്മാർക്കും സമ്മാനം നല്കുകയും നീയുമായി പരസംഗം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു നാലുപുറത്തുനിന്നും നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ അവർക്കു കൈക്കൂലി കൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All prostitutes receive gifts, but you give gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.
chapters.nkjv: Men make payment to all harlots, but you made your payments to all your lovers, and hired them to come to you from all around for your harlotry.
chapters.kjv: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പരസംഗത്തിൽ നിനക്കു മറ്റു സ്ത്രീകളുമായി ഒരു വൈപരീത്യം ഉണ്ടു; നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പരസംഗത്തിന്നു ആരും വരുന്നില്ല; നീ സമ്മാനം വാങ്ങുകയല്ല, സമ്മാനം കൊടുക്കുകയത്രേ ചെയ്യുന്നതു; അതിലാകുന്നു വൈപരീത്യം ഉള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: So in your prostitution you are the opposite of others; no one runs after you for your favors. You are the very opposite, for you give payment and none is given to you.
chapters.nkjv: You are the opposite of other women in your harlotry, because no one solicited you to be a harlot. In that you gave payment but no payment was given you, therefore you are the opposite."
chapters.kjv: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ വേശ്യാസ്ത്രീയേ, യഹോവയുടെ വചനം കേൾക്ക.
chapters.niv: " ‘Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the Lord !
chapters.nkjv: ‘Now then, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord!
chapters.kjv: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD :

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ജാരന്മാരുമായുള്ള നിന്റെ പരസംഗങ്ങളാൽ നിന്റെ പണം ചെലവഴിക്കയും നിന്റെ നഗന്ത അനാവൃതമാകയും ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ സകലമ്ളേച്ഛ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളും നിമിത്തവും നീ അവെക്കു കൊടുത്ത നിന്റെ മക്കളുടെ രക്തംനിമിത്തവും
chapters.niv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you poured out your lust and exposed your naked body in your promiscuity with your lovers, and because of all your detestable idols, and because you gave them your children’s blood,
chapters.nkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "Because your filthiness was poured out and your nakedness uncovered in your harlotry with your lovers, and with all your abominable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;

chapters.ml: നീ രമിച്ച നിന്റെ സകലജാരന്മാരെയും നീ സ്നേഹിച്ച ഏവരെയും നീ പകെച്ച ഏവരെയും ഞാൻ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തും; ഞാൻ അവരെ നിനക്കു വിരോധമായി ചുറ്റും കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി, അവർ നിന്റെ നഗ്നത ഒക്കെയും കാണത്തക്കവണ്ണം നിന്റെ നഗ്നത അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ അനാവൃതമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: therefore I am going to gather all your lovers, with whom you found pleasure, those you loved as well as those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and will strip you in front of them, and they will see you stark naked.
chapters.nkjv: surely, therefore, I will gather all your lovers with whom you took pleasure, all those you loved, and all those you hated; I will gather them from all around against you and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
chapters.kjv: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

chapters.ml: വ്യഭിചരിക്കയും രക്തം ചിന്നുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന സ്ത്രീകളെ വിധിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ന്യായം വിധിച്ചു ക്രോധത്തിന്റെയും ജാരശങ്കയുടെയും രക്തം നിന്റെ മേൽ ചൊരിയും
chapters.niv: I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and who shed blood; I will bring on you the blood vengeance of my wrath and jealous anger.
chapters.nkjv: And I will judge you as women who break wedlock or shed blood are judged; I will bring blood upon you in fury and jealousy.
chapters.kjv: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും; അവർ നിന്റെ കമാനം പൊളിച്ചു, നിന്റെ പൂജാഗിരികളെ ഇടിച്ചുകളയും അവർ നിന്റെ വസ്ത്രം അഴിച്ചു ആഭരണങ്ങളെ എടുത്തു, നിന്നെ നഗ്നയും അനാവൃതയും ആക്കിവിടും.
chapters.niv: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will tear down your mounds and destroy your lofty shrines. They will strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry and leave you stark naked.
chapters.nkjv: I will also give you into their hand, and they shall throw down your shrines and break down your high places. They shall also strip you of your clothes, take your beautiful jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
chapters.kjv: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

chapters.ml: അവർ നിനക്കു വിരോധമായി ഒരു സഭയെ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി നിന്നെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു വാൾകൊണ്ടു വെട്ടിക്കളയും.
chapters.niv: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and hack you to pieces with their swords.
chapters.nkjv: "They shall also bring up an assembly against you, and they shall stone you with stones and thrust you through with their swords.
chapters.kjv: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

chapters.ml: അവർ നിന്റെ വീടുകളെ തീവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളയും; അനേകം സ്ത്രീകൾ കാൺകെ നിന്റെമേൽ ന്യായവിധി നടത്തും; നിന്റെ പരസംഗം ഞാൻ നിർത്തലാക്കും; നീ ഇനി ആർക്കും കൂലി കൊടുക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: They will burn down your houses and inflict punishment on you in the sight of many women. I will put a stop to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.
chapters.nkjv: They shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women; and I will make you cease playing the harlot, and you shall no longer hire lovers.
chapters.kjv: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ എന്റെ ക്രോധം നിന്നിൽ നിവർത്തിച്ചിട്ടു എന്റെ തീക്ഷ്ണത നിന്നെ വിട്ടുമാറും; പിന്നെ ഞാൻ കോപിക്കാതെ അടങ്ങിയിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then my wrath against you will subside and my jealous anger will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.
chapters.nkjv: So I will lay to rest My fury toward you, and My jealousy shall depart from you. I will be quiet, and be angry no more.
chapters.kjv: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

chapters.ml: നീ നിന്റെ യൌവനകാലം ഓർക്കാതെ ഇവയാൽ ഒക്കെയും എന്നെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു, ഞാനും നിന്റെ നടപ്പിന്നു തക്കവണ്ണം നിനക്കു പകരം ചെയ്യും എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു; നിന്റെ സകലമ്ളേച്ഛതകൾക്കും പുറമെ നീ ഈ ദുഷ്കർമ്മവും ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ലയോ.
chapters.niv: " ‘Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged me with all these things, I will surely bring down on your head what you have done, declares the Sovereign Lord . Did you not add lewdness to all your other detestable practices?
chapters.nkjv: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but agitated Me with all these things, surely I will also recompense your deeds on yourown head," says the Lord God. "And you shall not commit lewdness in addition to all your abominations.
chapters.kjv: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

chapters.ml: പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലു പറയുന്നവനൊക്കെയും: യഥാമാതാതഥാപുത്രീ എന്നുള്ള പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലു നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയും.
chapters.niv: " ‘Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: "Like mother, like daughter."
chapters.nkjv: "Indeed everyone who quotes proverbs will use this proverb against you: ‘Like mother, like daughter!’
chapters.kjv: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.

chapters.ml: നീ ഭർത്താവിനെയും മക്കളെയും വെറുക്കുന്ന അമ്മയുടെ മകളും ഭർത്താക്കന്മാരെയും മക്കളെയും വെറുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന സഹോദരിമാർക്കു നീ സഹോദരിയുമാകുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ അമ്മ ഹിത്യസ്ത്രീയും അപ്പൻ അമോർയ്യനും അത്രേ.
chapters.niv: You are a true daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are a true sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
chapters.nkjv: You are your mother’s daughter, loathing husband and children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and children; your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
chapters.kjv: Thou art thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠത്തി നിന്റെ ഇടത്തുഭാഗത്തു തന്റെ പുത്രിമാരുമായി പാർക്കുന്ന ശമർയ്യ; നിന്റെ അനുജത്തി നിന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു തന്റെ പുത്രിമാരുമായി പാർക്കുന്ന സൊദോം.
chapters.niv: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived to the north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you with her daughters, was Sodom.
chapters.nkjv: "Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells with her daughters to the north of you; and your younger sister, who dwells to the south of you, is Sodom and her daughters.
chapters.kjv: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

chapters.ml: നീ അവരുടെ വഴികളിൽ നടന്നില്ല; അവരുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛതകൾപോലെ ചെയ്തില്ല; അതു പോരാ എന്നുവെച്ചു നീ നിന്റെ എല്ലാവഴികളിലും അവരെക്കാൾ അധികം വഷളത്വം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: You not only followed their ways and copied their detestable practices, but in all your ways you soon became more depraved than they.
chapters.nkjv: You did not walk in their ways nor act according to their abominations; but, as ifthatwere too little, you became more corrupt than they in all your ways.
chapters.kjv: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

chapters.ml: എന്നാണ, നീയും നിന്റെ പുത്രിമാരും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ നിന്റെ സഹോദരിയായ സൊദോമും അവളുടെ പുത്രിമാരും ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.
chapters.nkjv: "As I live," says the Lord God, "neither your sister Sodom nor her daughters have done as you and your daughters have done.
chapters.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സഹോദരിയായ സൊദോമിന്റെ അകൃത്യമോ: ഗർവ്വവും തീൻ പുളെപ്പും നിർഭയസ്വൈരവും അവൾക്കും അവളുടെ പുത്രിമാർക്കും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; എളിയവനെയും ദരിദ്രനെയും അവൾ സഹായിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: " ‘Now this was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and unconcerned; they did not help the poor and needy.
chapters.nkjv: Look, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughter had pride, fullness of food, and abundance of idleness; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
chapters.kjv: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

chapters.ml: അവർ അഹങ്കാരികളായി എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ മ്ളേച്ഛത ചെയ്തു; അതുകൊണ്ടു എനിക്കു ബോധിച്ചതുപോലെ ഞാൻ അവരെ നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They were haughty and did detestable things before me. Therefore I did away with them as you have seen.
chapters.nkjv: And they were haughty and committed abomination before Me; therefore I took them away as I saw fit.
chapters.kjv: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good .

chapters.ml: ശമർയ്യയും നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളിൽ പാതിയോളം ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല; നീ അവരെക്കാൾ നിന്റെ മ്ളേച്ഛതകളെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു, നീ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന സകലമ്ളേച്ഛതകളാലും നിന്റെ സഹോദരിമാരെ നീതീകരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have done more detestable things than they, and have made your sisters seem righteous by all these things you have done.
chapters.nkjv: "Samaria did not commit half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all the abominations which you have done.
chapters.kjv: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരിമാരെ ന്യായം വിധിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നീയും നിന്റെ ലജ്ജ വഹിക്ക; നീ അവരെക്കാൾ അധികം മ്ളേച്ഛതയായി പ്രവർത്തിച്ചരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങളാൽ അവർ നിന്നെക്കാൾ നീതിയുള്ളവരല്ലോ; അതേ, നീ നിന്റെ സഹോദരിമാരെ നീതീകരിച്ചതിൽ നാണിച്ചു നിന്റെ ലജ്ജ വഹിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: Bear your disgrace, for you have furnished some justification for your sisters. Because your sins were more vile than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So then, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.
chapters.nkjv: You who judged your sisters, bear your own shame also, because the sins which you committed were more abominable than theirs; they are more righteous than you. Yes, be disgraced also, and bear your own shame, because you justified your sisters.
chapters.kjv: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

chapters.ml: നീ അവർക്കു ആശ്വാസമായി നിന്റെ ലജ്ജ വഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും നീ ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ള എല്ലാവറ്റെയും കുറിച്ചു ലജ്ജിക്കേണ്ടതിനും
chapters.niv: " ‘However, I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and of Samaria and her daughters, and your fortunes along with them,
chapters.nkjv: "When I bring back their captives, the captives of Sodom and her daughters, and the captives of Samaria and her daughters, then Iwillalsobringback the captives of your captivity among them,
chapters.kjv: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സൊദോമിന്റെയും അവളുടെ പുത്രിമാരുടെയും സ്ഥിതിയും ശമർയ്യയുടെയും അവളുടെ പുത്രിമാരുടെയും സ്ഥിതിയും അവരുടെ നടുവിൽ ഉള്ള നിന്റെ പ്രവാസികളുടെ സ്ഥിതിയും മാറ്റും.
chapters.niv: so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you have done in giving them comfort.
chapters.nkjv: that you may bear your own shame and be disgraced by all that you did when you comforted them.
chapters.kjv: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സഹോദരിയായ സൊദോമും അവളുടെ പുത്രിമാരും തങ്ങളുടെ പൂർവ്വാവസ്ഥയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവരും; ശമർയ്യവും അവളുടെ പുത്രിമാരും തങ്ങളുടെ പൂർവ്വാവസ്ഥയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവരും; നീയും നിന്റെ പുത്രിമാരും നിങ്ങളുടെ പൂർവ്വാവസ്ഥയിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിവരും.
chapters.niv: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to what they were before; and you and your daughters will return to what you were before.
chapters.nkjv: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters return to their former state, then you and your daughters will return to your former state.
chapters.kjv: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

chapters.ml: അരാമിന്റെ പുത്രിമാരും അവളുടെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ളവരൊക്കെയും നിന്റെ ചുറ്റും നിന്നു നിന്നെ നിന്ദിക്കുന്ന ഫെലിസ്ത്യപുത്രിമാരും നിന്നെ നിന്ദിച്ച കാലത്തു എന്നപോലെ നിന്റെ ദുഷ്ടത വെളിപ്പെടുന്നതിന്നു മുമ്പെ
chapters.niv: You would not even mention your sister Sodom in the day of your pride,
chapters.nkjv: For your sister Sodom was not a byword in your mouth in the days of your pride,
chapters.kjv: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഗർവ്വത്തിന്റെ നാളിൽ നിന്റെ സഹോദരിയായ സൊദോമിന്റെ പേരുപോലും നീ ഉച്ചരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: before your wickedness was uncovered. Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all her neighbors and the daughters of the Philistines—all those around you who despise you.
chapters.nkjv: before your wickedness was uncovered. It was like the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria and all those around her, and of the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you everywhere.
chapters.kjv: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദുഷ്കർമ്മവും നിന്റെ മ്ളേച്ഛതകളും നീ വഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your detestable practices, declares the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: You have paid for your lewdness and your abominations," says the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നിയമം ലംഘിച്ചു സത്യം തുച്ഛീകരിക്കുന്ന നീ ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have despised my oath by breaking the covenant.
chapters.nkjv: For thus says the Lord God: "I will deal with you as you have done, who despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
chapters.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിന്റെ യൌവനകാലത്തു നിന്നോടുള്ള എന്റെ നിയമം ഞാൻ ഓർത്തു ഒരു ശാശ്വതനിയമം നിന്നോടു ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
chapters.nkjv: "Nevertheless I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ജ്യേഷ്ഠത്തിമാരും അനുജത്തിമാരുമായ സഹോദരിമാരെ നീ കൈക്കൊള്ളുമ്പോൾ, അന്നു നീ നിന്റെ വഴികളെ ഓർത്തു നാണിക്കും; ഞാൻ അവരെ നിനക്കു പുത്രിമാരായി തരും; നിന്റെ നിയമപ്രകാരമല്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both those who are older than you and those who are younger. I will give them to you as daughters, but not on the basis of my covenant with you.
chapters.nkjv: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when you receive your older and your younger sisters; for I will give them to you for daughters, but not because of My covenant with you.
chapters.kjv: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

chapters.ml: നീ ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ക്ഷമിക്കുമ്പോൾ നീ ഓർത്തു ലജ്ജിച്ചു നാണംനിമിത്തം ഇനി ഒരിക്കലും വായ് തുറക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: So I will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: And I will establish My covenant with you. Then you shall know that I am the Lord,
chapters.kjv: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD :

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു എന്റെ നിയമം ചെയ്യും; ഞാൻ യഹോവ എന്നു നീ അറിയും എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: Then, when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your humiliation, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
chapters.nkjv: that you may remember and be ashamed, and never open your mouth anymore because of your shame, when I provide you an atonement for all you have done," says the Lord God.’ "
chapters.kjv: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു എനിക്കുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The word of the Lord came to me:
chapters.nkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
chapters.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, നീ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തോടു ഒരു കടങ്കഥ പറഞ്ഞു ഒരു ഉപമ പ്രസ്താവിക്കേണ്ടതു;
chapters.niv: "Son of man, set forth an allegory and tell it to the Israelites as a parable.
chapters.nkjv: "Son of man, pose a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
chapters.kjv: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: വലിയ ചിറകും നീണ്ട തൂവലും ഉള്ളതും പലനിറമായ പപ്പു നിറഞ്ഞതുമായ ഒരു വലിയ കഴുകൻ ലെബനോനിൽ വന്നു ഒരു ദേവദാരുവിന്റെ ശിഖരം എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon. Taking hold of the top of a cedar,
chapters.nkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "A great eagle with large wings and long pinions, Full of feathers of various colors, Came to Lebanon And took from the cedar the highest branch.
chapters.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിന്റെ ഇളഞ്ചില്ലികളുടെ അറ്റം മുറിച്ചു കച്ചവടമുള്ളോരു ദേശത്തു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു, കച്ചവടക്കാരുടെ പട്ടണത്തിൽ നട്ടു.
chapters.niv: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.
chapters.nkjv: He cropped off its topmost young twig And carried it to a land of trade; He set it in a city of merchants.
chapters.kjv: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദേശത്തിലെ തൈകളിൽ ഒന്നു എടുത്തു ഒരു വിളനിലത്തു നട്ടു; അവൻ അതിനെ വളരെ വെള്ളത്തിന്നരികെ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു അലരിവൃക്ഷംപോലെ നട്ടു.
chapters.niv: " ‘He took one of the seedlings of the land and put it in fertile soil. He planted it like a willow by abundant water,
chapters.nkjv: Then he took some of the seed of the land And planted it in a fertile field; He placed it by abundant waters And set it like a willow tree.
chapters.kjv: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.

chapters.ml: അതു വളർന്നു, പൊക്കം കുറഞ്ഞു പടരുന്ന മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയായിത്തീർന്നു; അതിന്റെ വള്ളി അവങ്കലേക്കു തിരിയേണ്ടതും അതിന്റെ വേർ അവന്നു കിഴ്പെടേണ്ടതും ആയിരുന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ അതു മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയായി കൊമ്പുകളെ പുറപ്പെടുവിക്കയും ചില്ലികളെ നീട്ടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.
chapters.nkjv: And it grew and became a spreading vine of low stature; Its branches turned toward him, But its roots were under it. So it became a vine, Brought forth branches, And put forth shoots.
chapters.kjv: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വലിയ ചിറകും വളരെ പപ്പും ഉള്ള മറ്റൊരു വലിയ കഴുകൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അതു നനെക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആ മുന്തിരിവള്ളി തന്റെ തടത്തിൽനിന്നു വേരുകളെ അവങ്കലേക്കു തിരിച്ചു കൊമ്പുകളെ അവങ്കലേക്കു നീട്ടി.
chapters.niv: " ‘But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. The vine now sent out its roots toward him from the plot where it was planted and stretched out its branches to him for water.
chapters.nkjv: "But there was another great eagle with large wings and many feathers; And behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, And stretched its branches toward him, From the garden terrace where it had been planted, That he might water it.
chapters.kjv: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

chapters.ml: കൊമ്പുകളെ പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു ഫലം കായിപ്പാനും നല്ലമുന്തിരിവള്ളി ആയിത്തീരുവാനും തക്കവണ്ണം അതിനെ വളരെ വെള്ളത്തിന്നരികെ നല്ലനിലത്തു നട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.’
chapters.nkjv: It was planted in good soil by many waters, To bring forth branches, bear fruit, And become a majestic vine." ’
chapters.kjv: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

chapters.ml: ഇതു സാധിക്കുമോ? അതു വാടിപ്പോകത്തക്കവണ്ണം, അതിന്റെ തളിർത്ത ഇലകളൊക്കെയും വാടിപ്പോകത്തക്കവണ്ണം തന്നേ, അവൻ അതിന്റെ വേരുകളെ മാന്തുകയും കായി പറിച്ചുകളകയും ചെയ്കില്ലയോ? അതിനെ വേരോടെ പിഴുതുകളയേണ്ടതിന്നു വലിയ ബലമോ വളരെ ജനമോ ആവശ്യമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Will it thrive? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it withers? All its new growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots.
chapters.nkjv: "Say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Will it thrive? Will he not pull up its roots, Cut off its fruit, And leave it to wither? All of its spring leaves will wither, And no great power or many people Will be needed to pluck it up by its roots.
chapters.kjv: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.

chapters.ml: അതു നട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു സത്യം; അതു തഴെക്കുമോ? കിഴക്കൻ കാറ്റു തട്ടുമ്പോൾ അതു തീരെ വാടിപ്പോകയില്ലയോ? വളർന്ന തടത്തിൽ തന്നേ അതു ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോകും എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു നീ പറക.
chapters.niv: It has been planted, but will it thrive? Will it not wither completely when the east wind strikes it—wither away in the plot where it grew?’ "
chapters.nkjv: Behold, itis planted, Will it thrive? Will it not utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the garden terrace where it grew." ’ "
chapters.kjv: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു എനിക്കുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
chapters.nkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
chapters.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

chapters.ml: ഇതിന്റെ അർത്ഥം നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നു നീ ആ മത്സരഗൃഹത്തോടു ചോദിച്ചിട്ടു അവരോടു പറയേണ്ടതു: ബാബേൽരാജാവു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു വന്നു അതിന്റെ രാജാവിനെയും പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെയും പിടിച്ചു തന്നോടുകൂടെ ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി;
chapters.niv: "Say to this rebellious people, ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Say to them: ‘The king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and carried off her king and her nobles, bringing them back with him to Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: "Say now to the rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these thingsmean?’ Tell them, ‘Indeed the king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and took its king and princes, and led them with him to Babylon.
chapters.kjv: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;

chapters.ml: രാജസന്തതിയിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ അവൻ എടുത്തു അവനുമായി ഒരു ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്തു അവനെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്യിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Then he took a member of the royal family and made a treaty with him, putting him under oath. He also carried away the leading men of the land,
chapters.nkjv: And he took the king’s offspring, made a covenant with him, and put him under oath. He also took away the mighty of the land,
chapters.kjv: And hath taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:

chapters.ml: രാജ്യം തന്നെത്താൻ ഉയർത്താതെ താണിരുന്നു അവന്റെ ഉടമ്പടി പ്രമാണിച്ചു നിലനിന്നുപോരേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ബലവാന്മാരെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to rise again, surviving only by keeping his treaty.
chapters.nkjv: that the kingdom might be brought low and not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
chapters.kjv: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവനോടു മത്സരിച്ചു ഇവൻ തനിക്കു കുതിരകളെയും വളരെ പടജ്ജനത്തെയും അയച്ചുതരേണമെന്നു പറവാൻ ദൂതന്മാരെ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു അയച്ചു: അവൻ കൃതാർത്ഥനാകുമോ? ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ തെറ്റി ഒഴിയുമോ? അല്ല, അവൻ ഉടമ്പടി ലംഘിച്ചിട്ടു വഴുതിപ്പോകുമോ?
chapters.niv: But the king rebelled against him by sending his envoys to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the treaty and yet escape?
chapters.nkjv: But he rebelled against him by sending his ambassadors to Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Can he break a covenant and still be delivered?
chapters.kjv: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things ? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

chapters.ml: എന്നാണ, അവനെ രാജാവാക്കിയ രാജാവിന്റെ സ്ഥലമായ ബാബേലിൽ, അവന്റെ അരികെ വെച്ചു തന്നേ, അവൻ മരിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു; അവനോടു ചെയ്ത സത്യം അവൻ ധിക്കരിക്കയും അവനുമായുള്ള ഉടമ്പടി ലംഘിക്കയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: " ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , he shall die in Babylon, in the land of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose treaty he broke.
chapters.nkjv: ‘As I live,’ says the Lord God, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke—with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
chapters.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

chapters.ml: ബഹുജനത്തെ നശിപ്പിച്ചുകളവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവർ വാടകോരി കൊത്തളം പണിയുമ്പോൾ ഫറവോൻ മഹാസൈന്യത്തോടും വലിയ കൂട്ടത്തോടും കൂടെ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി യുദ്ധത്തിൽ ഒന്നും പ്രവർത്തിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great horde will be of no help to him in war, when ramps are built and siege works erected to destroy many lives.
chapters.nkjv: Nor will Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company do anything in the war, when they heap up a siege mound and build a wall to cut off many persons.
chapters.kjv: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉടമ്പടി ലംഘിച്ചു സത്യം ധിക്കരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ കയ്യടിച്ചിട്ടും ഇതൊക്കെയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ അവൻ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his hand in pledge and yet did all these things, he shall not escape.
chapters.nkjv: Since he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, and in fact gave his hand and still did all these things, he shall not escape.’ "
chapters.kjv: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things , he shall not escape.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: എന്നാണ, അവൻ ധിക്കരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ സത്യവും ലംഘിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ ഉടമ്പടിയും ഞാൻ അവന്റെ തലമേൽ വരുത്തും.
chapters.niv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, I will repay him for despising my oath and breaking my covenant.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "As I live, surely My oath which he despised, and My covenant which he broke, I will recompense on his own head.
chapters.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ വല അവന്റെമേൽ വീശും; അവൻ എന്റെ കണിയിൽ അകപ്പെടും; ഞാൻ അവനെ ബാബേലിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു, അവൻ എന്നോടു ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന ദ്രോഹത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അവിടെവെച്ചു അവനോടു വ്യവഹരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment on him there because he was unfaithful to me.
chapters.nkjv: I will spread My net over him, and he shall be taken in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon and try him there for the treason which he committed against Me.
chapters.kjv: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശ്രേഷ്ഠ യോദ്ധാക്കൾ ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ എല്ലാപടക്കൂട്ടങ്ങളും വാളാൽ വീഴും; ശേഷിപ്പുള്ളവരോ നാലു ദിക്കിലേക്കും ചിതറിപ്പോകും; യഹോവയായ ഞാൻ അതു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I the Lord have spoken.
chapters.nkjv: All his fugitives with all his troops shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered to every wind; and you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken."
chapters.kjv: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഞാനും ഉയരമുള്ള ദേവദാരുവിന്റെ ഒരു ശിഖരം എടുത്തു നടും; അതിന്റെ ഇളഞ്ചില്ലികളുടെ അറ്റത്തുനിന്നു ഇളയതായിരിക്കുന്ന ഒന്നു ഞാൻ മുറിച്ചെടുത്തു ഉയരവും ഉന്നതവുമായുള്ള ഒരു പർവ്വതത്തിൽ നടും.
chapters.niv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
chapters.nkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "I will take also one of the highest branches of the high cedar and set it out. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and will plant it on a high and prominent mountain.
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ഉയർന്ന പർവ്വതത്തിൽ ഞാൻ അതു നടും; അതു കൊമ്പുകളെ പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു ഫലം കായിച്ചു ഭംഗിയുള്ളോരു ദേവദാരുവായിത്തീരും; അതിന്റെ കീഴിൽ പലവിധം ചിറകുള്ള പക്ഷികളൊക്കെയും പാർക്കും; അതിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളുടെ നിഴലിൽ അവ വസിക്കും.
chapters.niv: On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it; it will produce branches and bear fruit and become a splendid cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it; they will find shelter in the shade of its branches.
chapters.nkjv: On the mountain height of Israel I will plant it; and it will bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a majestic cedar. Under it will dwell birds of every sort; in the shadow of its branches they will dwell.
chapters.kjv: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ ഞാൻ ഉയരമുള്ള വൃക്ഷത്തെ താഴ്ത്തി താണിരുന്ന വൃക്ഷത്തെ ഉയർത്തുകയും പച്ചയായുള്ള വൃക്ഷത്തെ ഉണക്കി ഉണങ്ങിയ വൃക്ഷത്തെ തഴെപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കാട്ടിലെ സകലവൃക്ഷങ്ങളും അറിയും; യഹോവയായ ഞാൻ അതു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചും അനുഷ്ഠിച്ചും ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the trees of the forest will know that I the Lord bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. " ‘I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And all the trees of the field shall know that I, the Lord, have brought down the high tree and exalted the low tree, dried up the green tree and made the dry tree flourish; I, the Lord, have spoken and have done it."
chapters.kjv: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done it .

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു എനിക്കുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: The word of the Lord came to me:
chapters.nkjv: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
chapters.kjv: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,

chapters.ml: അപ്പന്മാർ പച്ചമുന്തിരിങ്ങാ തിന്നു മക്കളുടെ പല്ലു പുളിച്ചു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ യിസ്രായേൽദേശത്തു ഒരു പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലു പറയുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: "What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: " ‘The parents eat sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
chapters.nkjv: "What do you mean when you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
chapters.kjv: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?

chapters.ml: എന്നാണ, നിങ്ങൾ ഇനി യിസ്രായേലിൽ ഈ പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലു പറവാൻ ഇടവരികയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: "As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.
chapters.nkjv: "As I live," says the Lord God, "you shall no longer use this proverb in Israel.
chapters.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD , ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.

chapters.ml: സകല ദേഹികളും എനിക്കുള്ളവർ; അപ്പന്റെ പ്രാണനും മകന്റെ പ്രാണനും ഒരുപോലെ എനിക്കുള്ളതു; പാപം ചെയ്യുന്ന ദേഹി മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For everyone belongs to me, the parent as well as the child—both alike belong to me. The one who sins is the one who will die.
chapters.nkjv: "Behold, all souls are Mine; The soul of the father As well as the soul of the son is Mine; The soul who sins shall die.
chapters.kjv: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ നീതിമാനായിരുന്നു നീതിയും ന്യായവും പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ--
chapters.niv: "Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.
chapters.nkjv: But if a man is just And does what is lawful and right;
chapters.kjv: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

chapters.ml: പൂജാഗിരികളിൽവെച്ചു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കയോ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ നോക്കി നമസ്കരിക്കയോ കൂട്ടുകാരന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ വഷളാക്കുകയോ ഋതുവായ സ്ത്രീയുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുകയോ ആരോടും അന്യായം പ്രവർത്തിക്കയോ ചെയ്യാതെ
chapters.niv: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or have sexual relations with a woman during her period.
chapters.nkjv: If he has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor’s wife, Nor approached a woman during her impurity;
chapters.kjv: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,

chapters.ml: കടം വാങ്ങിയവന്നു പണയം മടക്കിക്കൊടുക്കയും ആരോടും പിടിച്ചുപറിക്കാതെ തന്റെ അപ്പം വിശപ്പുള്ളവന്നു കൊടുക്കയും നഗ്നനെ ഉടുപ്പിക്കയും
chapters.niv: He does not oppress anyone, but returns what he took in pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.
chapters.nkjv: If he has not oppressed anyone, But has restored to the debtor his pledge; Has robbed no one by violence, But has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing;
chapters.kjv: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

chapters.ml: പലിശെക്കു കൊടുക്കയോ ലാഭം വാങ്ങുകയോ ചെയ്യാതിരിക്കയും നീതികേടു ചെയ്യാതവണ്ണം കൈ മടക്കിക്കൊൾകയും മനുഷ്യർക്കു തമ്മിലുള്ള വ്യവഹാരത്തിൽ നേരോടെ വിധിക്കയും
chapters.niv: He does not lend to them at interest or take a profit from them. He withholds his hand from doing wrong and judges fairly between two parties.
chapters.nkjv: If he has not exacted usury Nor taken any increase, But has withdrawn his hand from iniquity And executed true judgment between man and man;
chapters.kjv: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെ അനുസരിക്കയും എന്റെ ന്യായങ്ങളെ പ്രമാണിക്കയും ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടു നേരോടേ നടക്കുന്നവൻ നീതിമാൻ - അവൻ നിശ്ചയമായി ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: He follows my decrees and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Sovereign Lord .
chapters.nkjv: If he has walked in My statutes And kept My judgments faithfully— He is just; He shall surely live!" Says the Lord God.
chapters.kjv: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്നു ഒരു മകൻ ജനിച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ നിഷ്കണ്ടകനായിരുന്നു രക്തം ചൊരിക, അവയിൽ ഏതെങ്കിലും ചെയ്ക,
chapters.niv: "Suppose he has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these other things
chapters.nkjv: "If he begets a son whois a robber Or a shedder of blood, Who does any of these things
chapters.kjv: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,

chapters.ml: ചെയ്യേണ്ടതൊന്നും ചെയ്യാതിരിക്ക, പൂജാഗിരികളിൽ വെച്ചു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്ക,
chapters.niv: (though the father has done none of them): "He eats at the mountain shrines. He defiles his neighbor’s wife.
chapters.nkjv: And does none of those duties, But has eaten on the mountains Or defiled his neighbor’s wife;
chapters.kjv: And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,

chapters.ml: കൂട്ടുകാരന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ വഷളാക്കുക, എളിയവനോടും ദരിദ്രനോടും അന്യായം ചെയ്ക, പിടിച്ചുപറിക്ക, പണയം മടക്കിക്കൊടുക്കാതിരിക്ക, വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ നോക്കി നമസ്കരിക്ക,
chapters.niv: He oppresses the poor and needy. He commits robbery. He does not return what he took in pledge. He looks to the idols. He does detestable things.
chapters.nkjv: If he has oppressed the poor and needy, Robbed by violence, Not restored the pledge, Lifted his eyes to the idols, Or committed abomination;
chapters.kjv: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

chapters.ml: മ്ളേച്ഛത പ്രവർത്തിക്ക, പലിശെക്കു കൊടുക്ക, ലാഭം വാങ്ങുക എന്നീവക ചെയ്യുന്നവനായാൽ അവൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുമോ? അവൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കയില്ല; അവൻ ഈ മ്ളേച്ഛതകളൊക്കെയും ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ; അവൻ മരിക്കും; അവന്റെ രക്തം അവന്റെ മേൽ വരും.
chapters.niv: He lends at interest and takes a profit. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he is to be put to death; his blood will be on his own head.
chapters.nkjv: If he has exacted usury Or taken increase— Shall he then live? He shall not live! If he has done any of these abominations, He shall surely die; His blood shall be upon him.
chapters.kjv: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്നു ഒരു മകൻ ജനിച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ തന്റെ അപ്പൻ ചെയ്ത സകല പാപങ്ങളും കണ്ടു പേടിച്ചു അങ്ങനെയുള്ളതിനെ ചെയ്യാതെ പർവ്വതങ്ങളിൽവെച്ചു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്ക,
chapters.niv: "But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father commits, and though he sees them, he does not do such things:
chapters.nkjv: "If, however, he begets a son Who sees all the sins which his father has done, And considers but does not do likewise;
chapters.kjv: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളെ നോക്കി നമസ്കരിക്ക, കൂട്ടുകാരന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ വഷളാക്കുക,
chapters.niv: "He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
chapters.nkjv: Who has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor’s wife;
chapters.kjv: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour’s wife,

chapters.ml: ആരോടെങ്കിലും അന്യായം ചെയ്ക, പണയം കൈവശം വെച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്ക, പിടിച്ചുപറിക്ക, എന്നീവകയൊന്നും ചെയ്യാതെ വിശപ്പുള്ളവന്നു അപ്പം കൊടുക്കയും നഗ്നനെ ഉടുപ്പിക്കയും
chapters.niv: He does not oppress anyone or require a pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.
chapters.nkjv: Has not oppressed anyone, Nor withheld a pledge, Nor robbed by violence, But has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing;
chapters.kjv: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

chapters.ml: നീതികേടു ചെയ്യാതവണ്ണം കൈ മടക്കിക്കൊൾകയും പലിശയും ലാഭവും വാങ്ങാതിരിക്കയും എന്റെ വിധികളെ നടത്തി എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെ അനുസരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ അപ്പന്റെ അകൃത്യംനിമിത്തം മരിക്കാതെ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: He withholds his hand from mistreating the poor and takes no interest or profit from them. He keeps my laws and follows my decrees. He will not die for his father’s sin; he will surely live.
chapters.nkjv: Who has withdrawn his hand from the poor And not received usury or increase, But has executed My judgments And walked in My statutes— He shall not die for the iniquity of his father; He shall surely live!
chapters.kjv: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അപ്പനോ ക്രൂരപീഡനംചെയ്തു, സഹോദരനോടു പിടിച്ചുപറിച്ചു, തന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ കൊള്ളരുതാത്തതു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു തന്റെ അകൃത്യത്താൽ മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But his father will die for his own sin, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother and did what was wrong among his people.
chapters.nkjv: "Asfor his father, Because he cruelly oppressed, Robbed his brother by violence, And did what is not good among his people, Behold, he shall die for his iniquity.
chapters.kjv: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മകൻ അപ്പന്റെ അകൃത്യം വഹിക്കേണ്ടതല്ലയോ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; മകൻ നീതിയും ന്യായവും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെ പ്രമാണിച്ചു നടക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, അവൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Yet you ask, ‘Why does the son not share the guilt of his father?’ Since the son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all my decrees, he will surely live.
chapters.nkjv: "Yet you say, ‘Why should the son not bear the guilt of the father?’ Because the son has done what is lawful and right, and has kept all My statutes and observed them, he shall surely live.
chapters.kjv: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

chapters.ml: പാപം ചെയ്യുന്ന ദേഹി മരിക്കും; മകൻ അപ്പന്റെ അകൃത്യം വഹിക്കേണ്ട; അപ്പൻ മകന്റെ അകൃത്യവും വഹിക്കേണ്ട; നീതിമാന്റെ നീതി അവന്റെമേലും ദുഷ്ടന്റെ ദുഷ്ടത അവന്റെമേലും ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The one who sins is the one who will die. The child will not share the guilt of the parent, nor will the parent share the guilt of the child. The righteousness of the righteous will be credited to them, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against them.
chapters.nkjv: The soul who sins shall die. The son shall not bear the guilt of the father, nor the father bear the guilt of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon himself.
chapters.kjv: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദുഷ്ടൻ താൻ ചെയ്ത സകല പാപങ്ങളെയും വിട്ടുതിരിഞ്ഞു എന്റെ ചട്ടങ്ങളെയൊക്കെയും പ്രമാണിച്ചു, നീതിയും ന്യായവും പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, അവൻ മരിക്കാതെ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "But if a wicked person turns away from all the sins they have committed and keeps all my decrees and does what is just and right, that person will surely live; they will not die.
chapters.nkjv: "But if a wicked man turns from all his sins which he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is lawful and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
chapters.kjv: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെയ്ത അതിക്രമങ്ങളിൽ ഓന്നിനെയും അവന്നു കണക്കിടുകയില്ല; അവൻ ചെയ്ത നീതിയാൽ അവൻ ജീവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: None of the offenses they have committed will be remembered against them. Because of the righteous things they have done, they will live.
chapters.nkjv: None of the transgressions which he has committed shall be remembered against him; because of the righteousness which he has done, he shall live.
chapters.kjv: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

chapters.ml: ദുഷ്ടന്റെ മരണത്തിൽ എനിക്കു അല്പമെങ്കിലും താല്പര്യം ഉണ്ടോ? അവൻ തന്റെ വഴികളെ വിട്ടുതിരിഞ്ഞു ജീവിക്കേണമെന്നല്ലയോ എന്റെ താല്പര്യം എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign Lord . Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?
chapters.nkjv: Do I have any pleasure at all that the wicked should die?" says the Lord God, "and not that he should turn from his ways and live?
chapters.kjv: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD : and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീതിമാൻ തന്റെ നീതി വിട്ടുതിരിഞ്ഞു നീതികേടു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു, ദുഷ്ടൻ ചെയ്യുന്ന സകലമ്ളേച്ഛതകളെയുംപോലെ ചെയ്യുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, അവൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുമോ? അവൻ ചെയ്ത നീതിയൊന്നും കണക്കിടുകയില്ല; അവൻ ചെയ്ത ദ്രോഹത്താലും അവൻ ചെയ്ത പാപത്താലും അവൻ മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "But if a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin and does the same detestable things the wicked person does, will they live? None of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness they are guilty of and because of the sins they have committed, they will die.
chapters.nkjv: "But when a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, shall he live? All the righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; because of the unfaithfulness of which he is guilty and the sin which he has committed, because of them he shall die.
chapters.kjv: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ: കർത്താവിന്റെ വഴി ചൊവ്വുള്ളതല്ല എന്നു പറയുന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമേ, കേൾപ്പിൻ; എന്റെ വഴി ചൊവ്വുള്ളതല്ലയോ നിങ്ങളുടെ വഴികൾ ചൊവ്വില്ലാത്തവയല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear, you Israelites: Is my way unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
chapters.nkjv: "Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ Hear now, O house of Israel, is it not My way which is fair, and your ways which are not fair?
chapters.kjv: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

chapters.ml: നീതിമാൻ തന്റെ നിതി വിട്ടുതിരിഞ്ഞു നീതികേടു പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ അവൻ അതുനിമിത്തം മരിക്കും; അവൻ ചെയ്ത നീതികേടു നിമിത്തം തന്നേ അവൻ മരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin, they will die for it; because of the sin they have committed they will die.
chapters.nkjv: When a righteous man turns away from his righteousness, commits iniquity, and dies in it, it is because of the iniquity which he has done that he dies.
chapters.kjv: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

chapters.ml: ദുഷ്ടൻ താൻ ചെയ്ത ദുഷ്ടത വിട്ടുതിരിഞ്ഞു നീതിയും ന്യായവും പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ ജീവനോടെ രക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But if a wicked person turns away from the wickedness they have committed and does what is just and right, they will save their life.
chapters.nkjv: Again, when a wicked man turns away from the wickedness which he committed, and does what is lawful and right, he preserves himself alive.
chapters.kjv: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഓർത്തു താൻ ചെയ്ത അതിക്രമങ്ങളെയൊക്കെയും വിട്ടുതിരിയുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ മരിക്കാതെ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കും
chapters.niv: Because they consider all the offenses they have committed and turn away from them, that person will surely live; they will not die.
chapters.nkjv: Because he considers and turns away from all the transgressions which he committed, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
chapters.kjv: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹം: കർത്താവിന്റെ വഴി ചൊവ്വുള്ളതല്ല എന്നു പറയുന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമേ, എന്റെ വഴികൾ ചൊവ്വുള്ളവയല്ലയോ? നിങ്ങളുടെ വഴികൾ ചൊവ്വില്ലാത്തവയല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Yet the Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are my ways unjust, people of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
chapters.nkjv: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ O house of Israel, is it not My ways which are fair, and your ways which are not fair?
chapters.kjv: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമേ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്നും അവനവന്റെ വഴിക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം ന്യായം വിധിക്കും എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു: അകൃത്യം നിങ്ങൾക്കു നാശകരമായി ഭവിക്കാതെയിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ മനന്തിരിഞ്ഞു നിങ്ങളുടെ അതിക്രമങ്ങളൊക്കെയും വിട്ടുതിരിവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Therefore, you Israelites, I will judge each of you according to your own ways, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent! Turn away from all your offenses; then sin will not be your downfall.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways," says the Lord God. "Repent, and turn from all your transgressions, so that iniquity will not be your ruin.
chapters.kjv: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD . Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന അതിക്രമങ്ങളൊക്കെയും നിങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു എറിഞ്ഞുകളവിൻ; നിങ്ങൾക്കു പുതിയോരു ഹൃദയത്തെയും പുതിയോരു ആത്മാവിനെയും സമ്പാദിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ; യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമേ നിങ്ങൾ എന്തിനു മരിക്കുന്നു?
chapters.niv: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, people of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Cast away from you all the transgressions which you have committed, and get yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. For why should you die, O house of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

chapters.ml: മരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ മരണത്തിൽ എനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടമില്ല എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു; ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ മനന്തിരിഞ്ഞു ജീവിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent and live!
chapters.nkjv: For I have no pleasure in the death of one who dies," says the Lord God. "Therefore turn and live!"
chapters.kjv: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD : wherefore turn yourselves , and live ye.

chapters.ml: നീ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ പ്രഭുവിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഒരു വിലാപം ചൊല്ലേണ്ടതു:
chapters.niv: "Take up a lament concerning the princes of Israel
chapters.nkjv: "Moreover take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
chapters.kjv: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അമ്മ ആരായിരുന്നു; ഒരു സിംഹി തന്നേ; അവൾ സിംഹങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ കിടന്നു തന്റെ കുട്ടികളെ ബാലസിംഹങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ വളർത്തി.
chapters.niv: and say: " ‘What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among them and reared her cubs.
chapters.nkjv: and say: ‘What is your mother? A lioness: She lay down among the lions; Among the young lions she nourished her cubs.
chapters.kjv: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

chapters.ml: അവൾ തന്റെ കുട്ടികളിൽ ഒന്നിനെ വളർത്തി; അതു ഒരു ബാലസിംഹമായിത്തീർന്നു; അതു ഇര തേടി പിടിപ്പാൻ ശീലിച്ചു, മനുഷ്യരെ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.
chapters.nkjv: She brought up one of her cubs, And he became a young lion; He learned to catch prey, And he devoured men.
chapters.kjv: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

chapters.ml: ജാതികൾ അവന്റെ വസ്തുത കേട്ടു; അവരുടെ കുഴിയിൽ അവൻ അകപ്പെട്ടു; അവർ അവനെ കൊളുത്തിട്ടു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The nations heard about him, and he was trapped in their pit. They led him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: The nations also heard of him; He was trapped in their pit, And they brought him with chains to the land of Egypt.
chapters.kjv: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൾ താൻ വെച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്ന ആശെക്കു ഭംഗംവന്നു എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു തന്റെ കുട്ടികളിൽ മറ്റൊന്നിനെ എടുത്തു ബാലസിംഹമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: " ‘When she saw her hope unfulfilled, her expectation gone, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.
chapters.nkjv: ‘When she saw that she waited, that her hope was lost, She took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
chapters.kjv: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

chapters.ml: അവനും സിംഹങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു ബാലസിംഹമായിത്തീർന്നു, ഇര തേടിപ്പിടിപ്പാൻ ശീലിച്ചു, മനുഷ്യരെ തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He prowled among the lions, for he was now a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.
chapters.nkjv: He roved among the lions, And became a young lion; He learned to catch prey; He devoured men.
chapters.kjv: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ രാജധാനികളെ അറിഞ്ഞു, അവരുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളെ ശൂന്യമാക്കി; അവന്റെ ഗർജ്ജനം ഹേതുവായി ദേശവും അതിലുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ശൂന്യമായ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and all who were in it were terrified by his roaring.
chapters.nkjv: He knew their desolate places, And laid waste their cities; The land with its fullness was desolated By the noise of his roaring.
chapters.kjv: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ജാതികൾ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു അവന്റെ നേരെ വന്നു അവന്റെ മേൽ വല വീശി അവൻ അവരുടെ കുഴിയിൽ അകപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the nations came against him, those from regions round about. They spread their net for him, and he was trapped in their pit.
chapters.nkjv: Then the nations set against him from the provinces on every side, And spread their net over him; He was trapped in their pit.
chapters.kjv: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ കൊളുത്തിട്ടു ഒരു കൂട്ടിൽ ആക്കി ബാബേൽരാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി; ഇനി അവന്റെ നാദം യിസ്രായേൽപർവ്വതങ്ങളിൽ കേൾക്കാതെയിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർ അവനെ ദുർഗ്ഗങ്ങളിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: With hooks they pulled him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: They put him in a cage with chains, And brought him to the king of Babylon; They brought him in nets, That his voice should no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ അമ്മ, മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിൽ വെള്ളത്തിന്നരികെ നട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന മുന്തിരിവള്ളിപോലെയാകുന്നു; വളരെ വെള്ളമുള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു അതു ഫലപ്രദവും തഴെച്ചതുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of abundant water.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Your mother was like a vine in your bloodline, Planted by the waters, Fruitful and full of branches Because of many waters.
chapters.kjv: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

chapters.ml: അതിൽ അധിപതികളുടെ ചെങ്കോലുകൾക്കായി ബലമുള്ള കൊമ്പുകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതു തിങ്ങിയ കൊമ്പുകളുടെ ഇടയിൽ വളർന്നു പൊങ്ങിയിരുന്നു; അതു പൊക്കംകൊണ്ടും കൊമ്പുകളുടെ പെരുപ്പം കൊണ്ടും പ്രസിദ്ധമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.
chapters.nkjv: She had strong branches for scepters of rulers. She towered in stature above the thick branches, And was seen in her height amid the dense foliage.
chapters.kjv: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അതിനെ ക്രോധത്തോടെ പറിച്ചു നിലത്തു തള്ളിയിട്ടു; കിഴക്കൻ കാറ്റു അതിന്റെ ഫലം ഉണക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അതിന്റെ ബലമുള്ള കൊമ്പുകൾ ഒടിഞ്ഞു ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയി തീക്കിരയായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: But it was uprooted in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind made it shrivel, it was stripped of its fruit; its strong branches withered and fire consumed them.
chapters.nkjv: But she was plucked up in fury, She was cast down to the ground, And the east wind dried her fruit. Her strong branches were broken and withered; The fire consumed them.
chapters.kjv: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ അതിനെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഉണങ്ങിവരണ്ട നിലത്തു നട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.
chapters.nkjv: And now she is planted in the wilderness, In a dry and thirsty land.
chapters.kjv: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിലെ ഒരു കോലിൽനിന്നു തീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അതിന്റെ ഫലം ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ആധിപത്യത്തിന്നു ചെങ്കോലായിരിപ്പാൻ തക്കബലമുള്ള കോൽ അതിൽനിന്നെടുപ്പാൻ ഇല്ലാതെപോയി; ഇതു ഒരു വിലാപം; ഒരു വിലാപമായിത്തീർന്നുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Fire spread from one of its main branches and consumed its fruit. No strong branch is left on it fit for a ruler’s scepter.’ "This is a lament and is to be used as a lament."
chapters.nkjv: Fire has come out from a rod of her branches And devoured her fruit, So that she has no strong branch— a scepter for ruling.’ " This is a lamentation, and has become a lamentation.
chapters.kjv: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം ആണ്ടു അഞ്ചാം മാസം പത്താം തിയ്യതി യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരിൽ ചിലർ യഹോവയോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ വന്നു എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the seventh year, in the fifth month on the tenth day, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord , and they sat down in front of me.
chapters.nkjv: It came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord, and sat before me.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month , the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD , and sat before me.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവയുടെ അരുളപ്പാടു എനിക്കുണ്ടായതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
chapters.nkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
chapters.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, നീ യിസ്രായേൽമൂപ്പന്മാരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു അരുളപ്പാടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നുവോ? നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു ചോദിച്ചാൽ, എന്നാണ, ഞാൻ ഉത്തരമരുളുകയില്ല എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു എന്നു അവരോടു പറയേണം.
