chapters.kjv: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.

chapters.ml: ഗോപുരത്തിന്നും പൂമുഖത്തിന്നും അകത്തേക്കു ചുറ്റിലും മാടങ്ങളിലും ഇടത്തൂണുകളിലും അഴിയുള്ള ജാലകങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ആ ജാലകങ്ങൾ അകത്തു ചുറ്റും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഓരോ ഇടത്തൂണിന്മേലും ഈന്തപ്പനകളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The alcoves and the projecting walls inside the gateway were surmounted by narrow parapet openings all around, as was the portico; the openings all around faced inward. The faces of the projecting walls were decorated with palm trees.
chapters.nkjv: Therewere beveled window frames in the gate chambers and in their intervening archways on the inside of the gateway all around, and likewise in the vestibules. Therewere windows all around on the inside. And on each gatepost were palm trees.
chapters.kjv: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നെ പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; അവിടെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നു ചുറ്റും മണ്ഡപങ്ങളും ഓരോ കല്തളവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; കല്തളത്തിങ്കൽ മുപ്പതു മണ്ഡപം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he brought me into the outer court. There I saw some rooms and a pavement that had been constructed all around the court; there were thirty rooms along the pavement.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought me into the outer court; and therewere chambers and a pavement made all around the court; thirty chambers faced the pavement.
chapters.kjv: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

chapters.ml: കല്തളം ഗോപുരങ്ങളുടെ നീളത്തിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം ഗോപുരങ്ങളുടെ പാർശ്വത്തിൽ ആയിരുന്നു; അതു താഴത്തെ കലളം.
chapters.niv: It abutted the sides of the gateways and was as wide as they were long; this was the lower pavement.
chapters.nkjv: The pavement was by the side of the gateways, corresponding to the length of the gateways; thiswas the lower pavement.
chapters.kjv: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ താഴത്തെ ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ മുൻഭാഗം മുതൽ അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ പുറത്തെ മുൻഭാഗംവരെയുള്ള അകലം അളന്നു; കിഴക്കോട്ടും വടക്കോട്ടും നൂറീതു മുഴമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.
chapters.nkjv: Then he measured the width from the front of the lower gateway to the front of the inner court exterior, one hundred cubits toward the east and the north.
chapters.kjv: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.

chapters.ml: വടക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ള പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ നീളവും വീതിയും അവൻ അളന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he measured the length and width of the north gate, leading into the outer court.
chapters.nkjv: On the outer court was also a gateway facing north, and he measured its length and its width.
chapters.kjv: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മാടങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പുറത്തു മൂന്നും അപ്പുറത്തു മൂന്നും ആയിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ഇടത്തൂണുകളും പൂമുഖവും ഒന്നാമത്തെ ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ അളവുപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ നീളം അമ്പതു മുഴവും വീതി ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു മുഴവുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its alcoves—three on each side—its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as those of the first gateway. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: Its gate chambers, three on this side and three on that side, its gateposts and its archways, had the same measurements as the first gate; its length was fifty cubits and its width twenty-five cubits.
chapters.kjv: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ജാലകങ്ങളും പൂമുഖവും ഈന്തപ്പനകളും കിഴക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ള ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ അളവുപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; ഏഴു പതനത്താൽ അതിലേക്കു കയറാം; അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖം അതിന്റെ അകത്തുഭാഗത്തായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its openings, its portico and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.
chapters.nkjv: Its windows and those of its archways, and also its palm trees, had the same measurements as the gateway facing east; it was ascended by seven steps, and its archway was in front of it.
chapters.kjv: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

chapters.ml: അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നു വടക്കോട്ടും കിഴക്കോട്ടും ഉള്ള ഗോപുരത്തിന്നു നേരെ ഒരു ഗോപുരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഒരു ഗോപുരം മുതൽ മറ്റെ ഗോപുരംവരെ അവൻ അളന്നു: നൂറു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured from one gate to the opposite one; it was a hundred cubits.
chapters.nkjv: A gate of the inner court was opposite the northern gateway, just as the eastern gateway; and he measured from gateway to gateway, one hundred cubits.
chapters.kjv: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നെ തെക്കോട്ടു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; തെക്കോട്ടു ഒരു ഗോപുരം; അതിന്റെ ഇടത്തൂണുകളും പൂമുഖവും അവൻ ഈ അളവുപോലെ തന്നേ അളന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he led me to the south side and I saw the south gate. He measured its jambs and its portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.
chapters.nkjv: After that he brought me toward the south, and there a gateway was facing south; and he measured its gateposts and archways according to these same measurements.
chapters.kjv: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

chapters.ml: ആ ജാലകങ്ങൾ പോലെ ഇതിന്നും അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖത്തിന്നും ചുറ്റും ജാലകങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; നീളം അമ്പതു മുഴവും വീതി ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു മുഴവും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The gateway and its portico had narrow openings all around, like the openings of the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: Therewere windows in it and in its archways all around like those windows; its length was fifty cubits and its width twenty-five cubits.
chapters.kjv: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

chapters.ml: അതിലേക്കു കയറുവാൻ ഏഴു പതനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖം അതിന്റെ അകത്തുഭാഗത്തായിരുന്നു; അതിന്നു അതിന്റെ ഇടത്തൂണുകളിന്മേൽ ഈന്തപ്പനകൾ ഇപ്പുറത്തൊന്നും അപ്പുറത്തൊന്നും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them; it had palm tree decorations on the faces of the projecting walls on each side.
chapters.nkjv: Seven steps led up to it, and its archway was in front of them; and it had palm trees on its gateposts, one on this side and one on that side.
chapters.kjv: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

chapters.ml: അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നു തെക്കോട്ടു ഒരു ഗോപുരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; തെക്കോട്ടു ഒരു ഗോപുരം മുതൽ മറ്റെഗോപുരംവരെ അവൻ അളന്നു: നൂറു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side; it was a hundred cubits.
chapters.nkjv: Therewas also a gateway on the inner court, facing south; and he measured from gateway to gateway toward the south, one hundred cubits.
chapters.kjv: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തെക്കെ ഗോപുരത്തിൽകൂടി എന്നെ അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു; അവൻ തെക്കെ ഗോപുരവും ഈ അളവുപോലെ തന്നേ അളന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought me to the inner court through the southern gateway; he measured the southern gateway according to these same measurements.
chapters.kjv: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മാടങ്ങളും ഇടത്തൂണുകളും പൂമുഖവും ഈ അളവുപോലെ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു; അതിന്നും അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖത്തിന്നും ചുറ്റും ജാലകങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതു അമ്പതു മുഴം നീളവും ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു മുഴം വീതിയും ഉള്ളതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: Also its gate chambers, its gateposts, and its archways were according to these same measurements; therewere windows in it and in its archways all around; itwas fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.kjv: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

chapters.ml: പൂമുഖങ്ങൾ ചുറ്റും ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു മുഴം നീളവും അഞ്ചുമുഴം വീതിയും ഉള്ളവയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (The porticoes of the gateways around the inner court were twenty-five cubits wide and five cubits deep.)
chapters.nkjv: Therewere archways all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
chapters.kjv: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖം പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ നേരെ ആയിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ഇടത്തൂണുകളിന്മേൽ ഈന്തപ്പനകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതിലേക്കു കയറുവാൻ എട്ടു പതനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.
chapters.nkjv: Its archways faced the outer court, palm trees were on its gateposts, and going up to it were eight steps.
chapters.kjv: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നെ കിഴക്കു അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; അവൻ ഗോപുരത്തെ ഈ അളവുപോലെ തന്നേ അളന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.
chapters.nkjv: And he brought me into the inner court facing east; he measured the gateway according to these same measurements.
chapters.kjv: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മാടങ്ങളും ഇടത്തൂണുകളും പൂമുഖവും ഈ അളവുപോലെ തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു; അതിന്നു അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖത്തിന്നും ചുറ്റും ജാലകങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതു അമ്പതു മുഴം നീളവും ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു മുഴം വീതിയും ഉള്ളതായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: Also its gate chambers, its gateposts, and its archways were according to these same measurements; and therewere windows in it and in its archways all around; itwas fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.kjv: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖം പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നു നേരെ ആയിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ഇടത്തൂണുകളിന്മേൽ ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തും ഈന്തപ്പനകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതിലേക്കു കയറുവാൻ എട്ടു പതനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.
chapters.nkjv: Its archways faced the outer court, and palm trees were on its gateposts on this side and on that side; and going up to it were eight steps.
chapters.kjv: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നെ വടക്കെ ഗോപുരത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു, ഈ അളവുപോലെ തന്നേ അതും അളന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others,
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought me to the north gateway and measured it according to these same measurements—
chapters.kjv: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിന്റെ മാടങ്ങളും ഇടത്തൂണുകളും പൂമുഖവും അളന്നു; ചുറ്റും അതിന്നു ജാലകങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ നീളം അമ്പതു മുഴവും വീതി ഇരുപത്തഞ്ചു മുഴവും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: as did its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico, and it had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: also its gate chambers, its gateposts, and its archways. It had windows all around; its length was fifty cubits and its width twenty-five cubits.
chapters.kjv: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ പൂമുഖം പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നു നേരെ ആയിരുന്നു; ഇടത്തൂണുകളിന്മേൽ ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തും ഈന്തപ്പനകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതിലേക്കു കയറുവാൻ എട്ടു പതനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.
chapters.nkjv: Its gateposts faced the outer court, palm trees were on its gateposts on this side and on that side, and going up to it were eight steps.
chapters.kjv: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ഒരു അറ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രവേശനം ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ പൂമുഖത്തിൽകൂടി ആയിരുന്നു; അവിടെ അവർ ഹോമയാഗം കഴുകും.
chapters.niv: A room with a doorway was by the portico in each of the inner gateways, where the burnt offerings were washed.
chapters.nkjv: Therewas a chamber and its entrance by the gateposts of the gateway, where they washed the burnt offering.
chapters.kjv: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.

chapters.ml: ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ പൂമുഖത്തു ഇപ്പുറത്തു രണ്ടു മേശയും അപ്പുറത്തു രണ്ടു മേശയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവയുടെ മേൽ ഹോമയാഗവും പാപയാഗവും അകൃത്യയാഗവും അറുക്കും.
chapters.niv: In the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered.
chapters.nkjv: In the vestibule of the gateway were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to slay the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
chapters.kjv: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

chapters.ml: ഗോപുരപ്രവേശനത്തിങ്കൽ കയറുമ്പോൾ പുറമെ വടക്കുവശത്തു രണ്ടുമേശയും പൂമുഖത്തിന്റെ മറുവശത്തു രണ്ടുമേശയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By the outside wall of the portico of the gateway, near the steps at the entrance of the north gateway were two tables, and on the other side of the steps were two tables.
chapters.nkjv: At the outer side of the vestibule, as one goes up to the entrance of the northern gateway, were two tables; and on the other side of the vestibule of the gateway were two tables.
chapters.kjv: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.

chapters.ml: ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വഭാഗത്തു ഇപ്പുറത്തു നാലും അപ്പുറത്തു നാലും ഇങ്ങിനെ എട്ടു മേശ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവയുടെ മേൽ അവർ യാഗങ്ങളെ അറുക്കും.
chapters.niv: So there were four tables on one side of the gateway and four on the other—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.
chapters.nkjv: Four tables were on this side and four tables on that side, by the side of the gateway, eight tables on which they slaughtered thesacrifices.
chapters.kjv: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices .

chapters.ml: ഹോമയാഗത്തിന്നുള്ള നാലു മേശയും ചെത്തിയ കല്ലുകൊണ്ടു ഒന്നര മുഴം നീളവും ഒന്നര മുഴം വീതിയും ഒരു മുഴം ഉയരവുമായി ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്നു; അവയുടെ മേൽ അവർ ഹോമയാഗവും ഹനനയാഗവും അറുപ്പാനുള്ള ആയുധങ്ങൾ വെക്കും.
chapters.niv: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offerings, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high. On them were placed the utensils for slaughtering the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.
chapters.nkjv: Therewere also four tables of hewn stone for the burnt offering, one cubit and a half long, one cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high; on these they laid the instruments with which they slaughtered the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
chapters.kjv: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

chapters.ml: അകത്തു ചുറ്റിലും നാലു വിരൽ നീളമുള്ള കൊളുത്തുകൾ തറെച്ചിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ മേശകളുടെ മേൽ നിവേദിതമാംസം വെക്കും.
chapters.niv: And double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were attached to the wall all around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.
chapters.nkjv: Inside were hooks, a handbreadth wide, fastened all around; and the flesh of the sacrifices was on the tables.
chapters.kjv: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.

chapters.ml: അകത്തെ ഗോപുരത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു, അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിൽ തന്നേ, രണ്ടു മണ്ഡപം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഒന്നു വടക്കെ ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വത്തു തെക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ളതായിരുന്നു; മറ്റേതു തെക്കെ ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വത്തു വടക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ളതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two rooms, one at the side of the north gate and facing south, and another at the side of the south gate and facing north.
chapters.nkjv: Outside the inner gate were the chambers for the singers in the inner court, one facing south at the side of the northern gateway, and the other facing north at the side of the southern gateway.
chapters.kjv: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: തെക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ള ഈ മണ്ഡപം ആലയത്തിന്റെ വിചാരകരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കുള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: He said to me, "The room facing south is for the priests who guard the temple,
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to me, "This chamber which faces south is for the priests who have charge of the temple.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

chapters.ml: വടക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ള മണ്ഡപം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ വിചാരകരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കുള്ളതു; ഇവർ യഹോവെക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു അടുത്തുചെല്ലുന്ന ലേവ്യരിൽ സാദോക്കിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and the room facing north is for the priests who guard the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who are the only Levites who may draw near to the Lord to minister before him."
chapters.nkjv: The chamber which faces north is for the priests who have charge of the altar; these are the sons of Zadok, from the sons of Levi, who come near the Lord to minister to Him."
chapters.kjv: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പ്രാകാരത്തെ അളന്നു; അതു നൂറു മുഴം നീളവും നൂറു മുഴം വീതിയും ഇങ്ങനെ ചതുരശ്രമായിരുന്നു; യാഗപീഠമോ ആലയത്തിന്റെ മുൻ വശത്തായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he measured the court: It was square—a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.
chapters.nkjv: And he measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, foursquare. The altar was in front of the temple.
chapters.kjv: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ പൂമുഖത്തു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; അവൻ പൂമുഖത്തിന്റെ മുറിച്ചുവർ അളന്നു, ഇപ്പുറത്തുള്ളതു അഞ്ചു മുഴം; അപ്പുറത്തുള്ളതു അഞ്ചു മുഴം; മുറിച്ചുവരിന്റെ വീതിയോ ഇപ്പുറത്തു മൂന്നു മുഴവും അപ്പുറത്തു മൂന്നു മുഴവും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the jambs of the portico; they were five cubits wide on either side. The width of the entrance was fourteen cubits and its projecting walls were three cubits wide on either side.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought me to the vestibule of the temple and measured the doorposts of the vestibule, five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side; and the width of the gateway was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.
chapters.kjv: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

chapters.ml: പൂമുഖത്തിന്റെ നീളം ഇരുപതു മുഴം, വീതി പന്ത്രണ്ടു മുഴം, അതിലേക്കു കയറുവാനുള്ള പതനം പത്തു; മുറിച്ചുവരുകൾക്കരികെ ഇപ്പുറത്തു ഒന്നും അപ്പുറത്തു ഒന്നുമായി തൂണുകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The portico was twenty cubits wide, and twelve cubits from front to back. It was reached by a flight of stairs, and there were pillars on each side of the jambs.
chapters.nkjv: The length of the vestibule was twenty cubits, and the width eleven cubits; and by the steps which led up to it therewere pillars by the doorposts, one on this side and another on that side.
chapters.kjv: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ എന്നെ മന്ദിരത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു, മുറിച്ചുവരുകളെ അളന്നു; മുറിച്ചുവരുകളുടെ വീതി ഇപ്പുറത്തു ആറു മുഴവും അപ്പുറത്തു ആറു മുഴവും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the man brought me to the main hall and measured the jambs; the width of the jambs was six cubits on each side.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought me into the sanctuary and measured the doorposts, six cubits wide on one side and six cubits wide on the other side—the width of the tabernacle.
chapters.kjv: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: പ്രവേശനത്തിന്റെ വീതി പത്തു മുഴവും പ്രവേശനത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വഭിത്തികൾ ഇപ്പുറത്തു അഞ്ചു മുഴവും അപ്പുറത്തു അഞ്ചു മുഴവും ആയിരുന്നു; അവൻ മന്ദിരം അളന്നു: അതിന്റെ നീളം നാല്പതു മുഴം, വീതി ഇരുപതു മുഴം,
chapters.niv: The entrance was ten cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were five cubits wide. He also measured the main hall; it was forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: The width of the entryway was ten cubits, and the side walls of the entrance were five cubits on this side and five cubits on the other side; and he measured its length, forty cubits, and its width, twenty cubits.
chapters.kjv: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അകത്തേക്കു ചെന്നു, പ്രവേശനത്തിന്റെ മുറിച്ചവരുകളെ അളന്നു: കനം രണ്ടു മുഴവും പ്രവേശനത്തിന്റെ വീതി ആറു മുഴവും മുറിച്ചുവരുകളുടെ വീതി ഏഴേു മുഴവുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the jambs of the entrance; each was two cubits wide. The entrance was six cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were seven cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: Also he went inside and measured the doorposts, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits high; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.
chapters.kjv: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിന്റെ നീളം അളന്നു: ഇരുപതുമുഴം; വീതി മന്ദിരത്തിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം ഇരുപതു മുഴം; ഇതു അതിവിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലം എന്നു അവൻ എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: And he measured the length of the inner sanctuary; it was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits across the end of the main hall. He said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."
chapters.nkjv: He measured the length, twenty cubits; and the width, twenty cubits, beyond the sanctuary; and he said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."
chapters.kjv: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place .

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ആലയത്തിന്റെ ചുവർ അളന്നു: കനം ആറു മുഴം: ആലയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള പുറവാരത്തിന്റെ വീതി നാലു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: Then he measured the wall of the temple; it was six cubits thick, and each side room around the temple was four cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: Next, he measured the wall of the temple, six cubits. The width of each side chamber all around the temple was four cubits on every side.
chapters.kjv: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പുറവാരമുറികൾ ഒന്നിന്റെ മേൽ ഒന്നായി മൂന്നു നിലയായും നിലയിൽ മുപ്പതു വീതവും ആയിരുന്നു; അവ ചുറ്റും ആലയത്തിന്നും പുറവാരമുറികൾക്കും ഇടയിലുള്ള ചുവരിന്മേൽ പിടിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ചേർന്നിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ തുലാങ്ങൾ ആലയഭിത്തിക്കകത്തു ചെന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: The side rooms were on three levels, one above another, thirty on each level. There were ledges all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms, so that the supports were not inserted into the wall of the temple.
chapters.nkjv: The side chambers were in three stories, one above the other, thirty chambers in each story; they rested on ledges which were for the side chambers all around, that they might be supported, but not fastened to the wall of the temple.
chapters.kjv: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

chapters.ml: പുറവാരമുറികൾ ആലയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റുപാടും മേലോട്ടു മേലോട്ടു വിസ്താരം ഏറും; ആലയത്തിന്നു ചുറ്റും മുറിക്കകത്തു മേലോട്ടു മേലോട്ടു വീതി കൂടും; അതുകൊണ്ടു പുരവാരത്തിന്റെ വിസ്താരം മേലോട്ടു മേലോട്ടു ഏറും; താഴത്തെ നിലയിൽനിന്നു നടുവിലത്തേതിൽകൂടി മേലത്തെ നിലയിൽ കയറാം.
chapters.niv: The side rooms all around the temple were wider at each successive level. The structure surrounding the temple was built in ascending stages, so that the rooms widened as one went upward. A stairway went up from the lowest floor to the top floor through the middle floor.
chapters.nkjv: As one went up from story to story, the side chambers became wider all around, because their supporting ledges in the wall of the temple ascended like steps; therefore the width of the structure increased as one went up from the lowest story to the highest by way of the middle one.
chapters.kjv: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ആലയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലും പൊക്കമുള്ളോരു തറ കണ്ടു; പുറവാരമുറികളുടെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ ഒരു മുഴു ദണ്ഡായിരുന്നു; പരിഗളംവരെ ആറുമുഴം.
chapters.niv: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it, forming the foundation of the side rooms. It was the length of the rod, six long cubits.
chapters.nkjv: I also saw an elevation all around the temple; it was the foundation of the side chambers, a full rod, thatis, six cubits high.
chapters.kjv: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.

chapters.ml: പുറവാരത്തിന്റെ പുറമെയുള്ള ചുവരിന്റെ കനം അഞ്ചു മുഴമായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick. The open area between the side rooms of the temple
chapters.nkjv: The thickness of the outer wall of the side chambers was five cubits, and so also the remaining terrace by the place of the side chambers of the temple.
chapters.kjv: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആലയത്തിന്റെ പുറവാരമുറികൾക്കും മണ്ഡപങ്ങൾക്കും ഇടയിൽ ആലയത്തിന്നു ചുറ്റും ഇരുപതുമുഴം വീതിയുള്ള മുറ്റം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and the priests’ rooms was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.
chapters.nkjv: And between itand the wall chambers was a width of twenty cubits all around the temple on every side.
chapters.kjv: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

chapters.ml: പുറവാരത്തിന്റെ വാതിലുകൾ തിണ്ണെക്കു നേരെ ഒരു വാതിൽ വടക്കോട്ടും ഒരു വാതിൽ തെക്കോട്ടും ആയിരുന്നു; തിണ്ണയുടെ വീതി ചുറ്റും അഞ്ചു മുഴമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There were entrances to the side rooms from the open area, one on the north and another on the south; and the base adjoining the open area was five cubits wide all around.
chapters.nkjv: The doors of the side chambers opened on the terrace, one door toward the north and another toward the south; and the width of the terrace was five cubits all around.
chapters.kjv: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.

chapters.ml: മുറ്റത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടുള്ള കെട്ടിടം എഴുപതു മുഴം വീതിയുള്ളതും കെട്ടിടത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ചുവർ അഞ്ചു മുഴം കനമുള്ളതും തൊണ്ണൂറു മുഴം നീളമുള്ളതും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The building facing the temple courtyard on the west side was seventy cubits wide. The wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length was ninety cubits.
chapters.nkjv: The building that faced the separating courtyard at its western end was seventy cubits wide; the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
chapters.kjv: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആലയം അളന്നു: നീളം നൂറു മുഴം; മുറ്റവും കെട്ടിടവും അതിന്റെ ചുവരുകളും അളന്നു; അതിന്നും നൂറു മുഴം നീളം.
chapters.niv: Then he measured the temple; it was a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.
chapters.nkjv: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separating courtyard with the building and its walls was one hundred cubits long;
chapters.kjv: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

chapters.ml: ആലയത്തിന്റെ മുൻഭാഗത്തിന്റെയും കിഴക്കുള്ള മുറ്റത്തിന്റെയും വീതിയും നൂറുമുഴമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The width of the temple courtyard on the east, including the front of the temple, was a hundred cubits.
chapters.nkjv: also the width of the eastern face of the temple, including the separating courtyard, was one hundred cubits.
chapters.kjv: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ മുറ്റത്തിന്റെ പിൻപുറത്തു അതിന്നെതിരെയുള്ള കെട്ടിടത്തിന്റെ നീളവും അതിന്നു ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തും ഉള്ള നടപ്പുരകളും അളന്നു; നൂറുമുഴം; അകത്തെ മന്ദിരത്തിന്നും പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ പൂമുഖങ്ങൾക്കും ഉമ്മരപ്പടികൾക്കും
chapters.niv: Then he measured the length of the building facing the courtyard at the rear of the temple, including its galleries on each side; it was a hundred cubits. The main hall, the inner sanctuary and the portico facing the court,
chapters.nkjv: He measured the length of the building behind it, facing the separating courtyard, with its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits, as well as the inner temple and the porches of the court,
chapters.kjv: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

chapters.ml: അഴിയുള്ള ജാലകങ്ങൾക്കും ഉമ്മരപ്പടിക്കു മേൽ മൂന്നു നിലയായി ചുറ്റും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന നടപ്പുരകൾക്കും നിലംതൊട ജാലകങ്ങളോളവും പലകയടിച്ചിരുന്നു; ജാലകങ്ങളോ മൂടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: as well as the thresholds and the narrow windows and galleries around the three of them—everything beyond and including the threshold was covered with wood. The floor, the wall up to the windows, and the windows were covered.
chapters.nkjv: their doorposts and the beveled window frames. And the galleries all around their three stories opposite the threshold were paneled with wood from the ground to the windows—the windows were covered—
chapters.kjv: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;

chapters.ml: അകത്തെ ആലയത്തിൻ വാതിലിന്റെ മേൽഭാഗംവരെയും പുറമെയും ചുറ്റും എല്ലാചുവരിന്മേലും അകത്തും പുറത്തും ചിത്രപ്പണി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary and on the walls at regular intervals all around the inner and outer sanctuary
chapters.nkjv: from the space above the door, even to the inner room, as well as outside, and on every wall all around, inside and outside, by measure.
chapters.kjv: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

chapters.ml: കെരൂബുകളും ഈന്തപ്പനകളും അതിന്മേൽ കൊത്തിയിരുന്നു; കെരൂബിന്നും കെരൂബിന്നും ഇടയിൽ ഓരോ ഈന്തപ്പനയും ഓരോ കെരൂബിന്നു ഈരണ്ടു മുഖവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: were carved cherubim and palm trees. Palm trees alternated with cherubim. Each cherub had two faces:
chapters.nkjv: And itwas made with cherubim and palm trees, a palm tree between cherub and cherub. Each cherub had two faces,
chapters.kjv: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യമുഖം ഇപ്പുറത്തുള്ള ഈന്തപ്പനയുടെ നേരെയും ബാലസിംഹമുഖം അപ്പുറത്തുള്ള ഈന്തപ്പനയുടെ നേരെയും ആയിരുന്നു; ആലയത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റും എല്ലാടവും ഇങ്ങനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: the face of a human being toward the palm tree on one side and the face of a lion toward the palm tree on the other. They were carved all around the whole temple.
chapters.nkjv: so that the face of a man was toward a palm tree on one side, and the face of a young lion toward a palm tree on the other side; thus itwas made throughout the temple all around.
chapters.kjv: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.

chapters.ml: നിലംമുതൽ വാതിലിന്റെ മേലറ്റംവരെ കെരൂബുകളും ഈന്തപ്പനകളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ ആയിരുന്നു മന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ ഭിത്തി.
chapters.niv: From the floor to the area above the entrance, cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the main hall.
chapters.nkjv: From the floor to the space above the door, and on the wall of the sanctuary, cherubim and palm trees were carved.
chapters.kjv: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

chapters.ml: മന്ദിരത്തിന്നു ചതുരമായുള്ള മുറിച്ചുവരുകളും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ യാഗപീഠംപോലെയുള്ളൊന്നും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The main hall had a rectangular doorframe, and the one at the front of the Most Holy Place was similar.
chapters.nkjv: The doorposts of the temple were square, aswas the front of the sanctuary; their appearance was similar.
chapters.kjv: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other .

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠം മരംകൊണ്ടുള്ളതും മൂന്നു മുഴം ഉയരവും രണ്ടുമുഴം നീളവും ഉള്ളതുമായിരുന്നു; അതിന്റെ കോണുകളും ചുവടും വശങ്ങളും മരംകൊണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ എന്നോടു: ഇതു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിലെ മേശയാകുന്നു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: There was a wooden altar three cubits high and two cubits square ; its corners, its base and its sides were of wood. The man said to me, "This is the table that is before the Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its length, and its sides were of wood; and he said to me, "This is the table that is before the Lord."
chapters.kjv: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the LORD .

chapters.ml: മന്ദിരത്തിന്നും അതിവിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്നും ഈരണ്ടു കതകു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Both the main hall and the Most Holy Place had double doors.
chapters.nkjv: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
chapters.kjv: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

chapters.ml: കതകുകൾക്കു ഈരണ്ടു മടകൂ കതകു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഒരു കതകിന്നു രണ്ടു മടക്കുകതകു; മറ്റെ കതകിന്നു രണ്ടു മടക്കുകതകു.
chapters.niv: Each door had two leaves—two hinged leaves for each door.
chapters.nkjv: The doors had two panels apiece, two folding panels: two panels for one door and two panels for the other door.
chapters.kjv: And the doors had two leaves apiece , two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door .

chapters.ml: ചുവരുകളിൽ എന്നപോലെ മന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ കതകുകളിന്മേലും കെരൂബുകളും ഈന്തപ്പനകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരുന്നു; പുറമെ പൂമുഖത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഒരു കനത്ത മരത്തുലാം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And on the doors of the main hall were carved cherubim and palm trees like those carved on the walls, and there was a wooden overhang on the front of the portico.
chapters.nkjv: Cherubim and palm trees were carved on the doors of the temple just as they were carved on the walls. A wooden canopy was on the front of the vestibule outside.
chapters.kjv: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

chapters.ml: പൂമുഖത്തിന്റെ പാർശ്വങ്ങളിൽ ഇപ്പുറത്തും അപ്പുറത്തും അഴിയുള്ള ജാലകങ്ങളും ഈന്തപ്പനകളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെയായിരുന്നു ആലയത്തിന്റെ പുറവാരമുറികളുടെയും തുലാങ്ങളുടെയും പണി.
chapters.niv: On the sidewalls of the portico were narrow windows with palm trees carved on each side. The side rooms of the temple also had overhangs.
chapters.nkjv: Therewere beveled window frames and palm trees on one side and on the other, on the sides of the vestibule—also on the side chambers of the temple and on the canopies.
chapters.kjv: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ എന്നെ വടക്കോട്ടുള്ള വഴിയായി പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി; മുറ്റത്തിന്നു നേരെയും വടക്കോട്ടുള്ള കെട്ടിടത്തിന്നെതിരെയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന മണ്ഡപത്തിലേക്കു എന്നെ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the man led me northward into the outer court and brought me to the rooms opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall on the north side.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought me out into the outer court, by the way toward the north; and he brought me into the chamber which was opposite the separating courtyard, and which was opposite the building toward the north.
chapters.kjv: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ മുൻഭാഗത്തിന്നു നൂറു മുഴം നീളവും വടക്കോട്ടു വാതിലും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; വീതി അമ്പതു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: The building whose door faced north was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: Facing the length, whichwas one hundred cubits (the width was fifty cubits), was the north door.
chapters.kjv: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.

chapters.ml: അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നുള്ള ഇരുപതു മുഴത്തിന്നെതിരെയും പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്നുള്ള കല്ത്തളത്തിന്നെതിരെയും മൂന്നു നിലയായി നടപ്പുരെക്കു നേരെ നടപ്പുര ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Both in the section twenty cubits from the inner court and in the section opposite the pavement of the outer court, gallery faced gallery at the three levels.
chapters.nkjv: Opposite the inner court of twenty cubits, and opposite the pavement of the outer court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
chapters.kjv: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories .

chapters.ml: മണ്ഡപങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ അകത്തോട്ടു പത്തു മുഴം വീതിയും നൂറു മുഴം നീളവുമുള്ളോരു നടപ്പുര ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവയുടെ വാതിലുകൾ വടക്കോട്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In front of the rooms was an inner passageway ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long. Their doors were on the north.
chapters.nkjv: In front of the chambers, toward the inside, was a walk ten cubits wide, at a distance of one cubit; and their doors faced north.
chapters.kjv: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

chapters.ml: കെട്ടിടത്തിന്റെ താഴത്തെ മണ്ഡപങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും നടുവിലത്തേവയിൽനിന്നും എടുത്തതിനെക്കാൾ അധികം സ്ഥലം മുകളിലത്തെ മണ്ഡപങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു നടപ്പുരകൾക്കു എടുത്തുപോന്നിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവ നീളം കുറഞ്ഞവ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the upper rooms were narrower, for the galleries took more space from them than from the rooms on the lower and middle floors of the building.
chapters.nkjv: Now the upper chambers were shorter, because the galleries took away space from them more than from the lower and middle stories of the building.
chapters.kjv: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

chapters.ml: അവ മൂന്നു നിലയായിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ അവെക്കു പ്രാകാരങ്ങളുടെ തൂണുകൾപോലെ തൂണുകൾ ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു താഴത്തേതിനെക്കാളും നടുവിലത്തേതിനെക്കാളും മേലത്തേതിന്റെ നിലം ചുരുങ്ങിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The rooms on the top floor had no pillars, as the courts had; so they were smaller in floor space than those on the lower and middle floors.
chapters.nkjv: For they were in three stories and did not have pillars like the pillars of the courts; therefore theupperlevel was shortened more than the lower and middle levels from the ground up.
chapters.kjv: For they were in three stories , but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

chapters.ml: പുറമെ മണ്ഡപങ്ങളുടെ നീളത്തിൽ പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ നേരെ മണ്ഡപങ്ങളുടെ മുൻ വശത്തെ മതിലിന്റെ നീളം അമ്പതു മുഴം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms and the outer court; it extended in front of the rooms for fifty cubits.
chapters.nkjv: And a wall which was outside ran parallel to the chambers, at the front of the chambers, toward the outer court; its length was fifty cubits.
chapters.kjv: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.

chapters.ml: പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിലേക്കു ദർശനമുള്ള മണ്ഡപങ്ങളുടെ നീളം അമ്പതു മുഴമായിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ മന്ദിരത്തിന്നെതിരെയുള്ള നീളം നൂറു മുഴമായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: While the row of rooms on the side next to the outer court was fifty cubits long, the row on the side nearest the sanctuary was a hundred cubits long.
chapters.nkjv: The length of the chambers toward the outer court was fifty cubits, whereas that facing the temple was one hundred cubits.
chapters.kjv: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.

chapters.ml: പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇവയിലേക്കു കടന്നാൽ കിഴക്കോട്ടു ഈ മണ്ഡപങ്ങൾക്കു താഴെ ഒരു പ്രവേശനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The lower rooms had an entrance on the east side as one enters them from the outer court.
chapters.nkjv: At the lower chambers was the entrance on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.
chapters.kjv: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

chapters.ml: കിഴക്കോട്ടുള്ള പ്രാകാരത്തിന്റെ മതിലിന്റെ തലെക്കൽ മുറ്റത്തിന്നെതിരായും കെട്ടിടത്തിന്നെതിരായും മണ്ഡപങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court, adjoining the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall, were rooms
chapters.nkjv: Also therewere chambers in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, opposite the separating courtyard and opposite the building.
chapters.kjv: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

chapters.ml: അവയുടെ മുമ്പിലുള്ള വഴി വടക്കോട്ടുള്ള മണ്ഡപങ്ങളുടെ അളവുപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; അവയുടെ നീളത്തിന്നൊത്ത നീളവും വീതിക്കൊത്ത വീതിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവയുടെ എല്ലാപുറപ്പാടുകളും വിധാനങ്ങളും അവയുടെ പ്രവേശനങ്ങളും ഒരുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: with a passageway in front of them. These were like the rooms on the north; they had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions. Similar to the doorways on the north
chapters.nkjv: Therewas a walk in front of them also, and their appearance was like the chambers which were toward the north; they were as long and as wide as the others, and all their exits and entrances were according to plan.
chapters.kjv: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

chapters.ml: തെക്കോട്ടുള്ള മണ്ഡപങ്ങളുടെ പ്രവേശനങ്ങൾ പോലെ ഒരു പ്രവേശനം വഴിയുടെ തലെക്കൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവയിലേക്കു കടന്നാൽ കിഴക്കോട്ടുള്ള മതിലിന്നു നേരെ മുമ്പിലുള്ള വഴിയുടെ തലെക്കൽ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: were the doorways of the rooms on the south. There was a doorway at the beginning of the passageway that was parallel to the corresponding wall extending eastward, by which one enters the rooms.
chapters.nkjv: And corresponding to the doors of the chambers that were facing south, as one enters them, therewas a door in front of the walk, the way directly in front of the wall toward the east.
chapters.kjv: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: മുറ്റത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിലുള്ള വടക്കെ മണ്ഡപങ്ങളും തെക്കെ മണ്ഡപങ്ങളും യഹോവയോടു അടുത്തുചെല്ലുന്ന പുരോഹിതന്മാർ അതിവിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളെ തിന്നുവാനുള്ള വിശുദ്ധമണ്ഡപങ്ങളാകുന്നു; അവിടെ അവർ അതിവിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളും ഭോജനയാഗവും പാപയാഗവും അകൃത്യയാഗവും വെക്കേണം. ആ സ്ഥലം വിശുദ്ധമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Then he said to me, "The north and south rooms facing the temple courtyard are the priests’ rooms, where the priests who approach the Lord will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings—the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings—for the place is holy.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to me, "The north chambers and the south chambers, which are opposite the separating courtyard, are the holy chambers where the priests who approach the Lord shall eat the most holy offerings. There they shall lay the most holy offerings— the grain offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering—for the place is holy.
chapters.kjv: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്മാർ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തുനിന്നു പുറത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിലേക്കു ചെല്ലാതെ വേണം അതിൽ പ്രവേശിപ്പാൻ; ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കുള്ള തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം അവർ അവിടെ വെച്ചേക്കേണം; അവ വിശുദ്ധമല്ലോ; വേറെ വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചിട്ടേ അവർ ജനത്തിന്നുള്ള സ്ഥലത്തു ചെല്ലാവു.
chapters.niv: Once the priests enter the holy precincts, they are not to go into the outer court until they leave behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they go near the places that are for the people."
chapters.nkjv: When the priests enter them, they shall not go out of the holy chamber into the outer court; but there they shall leave their garments in which they minister, for they are holy. They shall put on other garments; then they may approach that which is for the people."
chapters.kjv: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അകത്തെ ആലയം അളന്നു തീർന്നശേഷം, കിഴക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ള വാതിൽക്കൽ കൂടി എന്നെ കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു അവിടം ചുറ്റും അളന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he had finished measuring what was inside the temple area, he led me out by the east gate and measured the area all around:
chapters.nkjv: Now when he had finished measuring the inner temple, he brought me out through the gateway that faces toward the east, and measured it all around.
chapters.kjv: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കിഴക്കുഭാഗം ദണ്ഡുകൊണ്ടു അളന്നു; ആകെ അഞ്ഞൂറു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: He measured the east side with the measuring rod; it was five hundred cubits.
chapters.nkjv: He measured the east side with the measuring rod, five hundred rods by the measuring rod all around.
chapters.kjv: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വടക്കുഭാഗം ദണ്ഡുകൊണ്ടു അളന്നു; ആകെ അഞ്ഞൂറു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: He measured the north side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.
chapters.nkjv: He measured the north side, five hundred rods by the measuring rod all around.
chapters.kjv: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തെക്കുഭാഗം ദണ്ഡുകൊണ്ടു അളന്നു; ആകെ അഞ്ഞൂറു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: He measured the south side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.
chapters.nkjv: He measured the south side, five hundred rods by the measuring rod.
chapters.kjv: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പടിഞ്ഞാറോട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞു ദണ്ഡുകൊണ്ടു അളന്നു; അഞ്ഞൂറു മുഴം.
chapters.niv: Then he turned to the west side and measured; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.
chapters.nkjv: He came around to the west side and measured five hundred rods by the measuring rod.
chapters.kjv: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൻ നാലുപുറവും അളന്നു; വിശുദ്ധമായതും സാമാന്യമായതും തമ്മിൽ വേറുതിരിപ്പാൻ തവക്കവണ്ണം അഞ്ഞൂറു മുഴം നീളത്തിലും അഞ്ഞൂറുമുഴം വീതിയിലും ഒരു മതിൽ അതിന്നു ചുറ്റും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.
chapters.nkjv: He measured it on the four sides; it had a wall all around, five hundred cubits long and five hundred wide, to separate the holy areas from the common.
chapters.kjv: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ എന്നെ ഗോപുരത്തിലേക്കു, കിഴക്കോട്ടുള്ള ഗോപുരത്തിലേക്കു തന്നേ, കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു;
chapters.niv: Then the man brought me to the gate facing east,
chapters.nkjv: Afterward he brought me to the gate, the gate that faces toward the east.
chapters.kjv: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ തേജസ്സു കിഴക്കു വഴിയായി വന്നു; അതിന്റെ മുഴക്കം പെരുവെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഇരെച്ചൽപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; ഭൂമി അവന്റെ തേജസ്സുകൊണ്ടു പ്രകാശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of rushing waters, and the land was radiant with his glory.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth shone with His glory.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഞാൻ കണ്ട ദർശനംപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; നഗരത്തെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ വന്നപ്പോൾ കണ്ട ദർശനംപോലെ തന്നേ; ഈ ദർശനങ്ങൾ കെബാർ നദീതീരത്തുവെച്ചു ഞാൻ കണ്ട ദർശനംപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ കവിണ്ണുവീണു.
chapters.niv: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when he came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.
chapters.nkjv: Itwas like the appearance of the vision which I saw—like the vision which I saw when I came to destroy the city. The visions were like the vision which I saw by the River Chebar; and I fell on my face.
chapters.kjv: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു കിഴക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ള ഗോപുരത്തിൽ കൂടി ആലയത്തിലേക്കു പ്രവേശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The glory of the Lord entered the temple through the gate facing east.
chapters.nkjv: And the glory of the Lord came into the temple by way of the gate which faces toward the east.
chapters.kjv: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു എന്നെ എടുത്തു അകത്തെ പ്രാകാരത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു ആലയത്തെ നിറെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
chapters.nkjv: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
chapters.kjv: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.

chapters.ml: ആ പുരുഷൻ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ, ആലയത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒരുത്തൻ എന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.
chapters.nkjv: Then I heard Him speaking to me from the temple, while a man stood beside me.
chapters.kjv: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, ഇതു ഞാൻ എന്നേക്കും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ വസിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ സ്ഥലവും എന്റെ കാലടികളുടെ സ്ഥലവും ആകുന്നു; യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമെങ്കിലും അവരുടെ രാജാക്കന്മാരെങ്കിലും തങ്ങളുടെ പരസംഗംകൊണ്ടും പൂജാഗിരികളിലെ തങ്ങളുടെ രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ ശവങ്ങൾകൊണ്ടും
chapters.niv: He said: "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet. This is where I will live among the Israelites forever. The people of Israel will never again defile my holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings at their death.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, thisis the place of My throne and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel forever. No more shall the house of Israel defile My holy name, they nor their kings, by their harlotry or with the carcasses of their kings on their high places.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കും അവർക്കും ഇടയിൽ ഒരു ചുവർ മാത്രം ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം തങ്ങളുടെ ഉമ്മരപ്പടി എന്റെ ഉമ്മരപ്പടിയും തങ്ങളുടെ കട്ടള എന്റെ കട്ടളയും ആക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടും എന്റെ വിശുദ്ധനാമത്തെ ഇനി അശുദ്ധമാക്കേണ്ടതല്ല; അവർ ചെയ്ത മ്ളേച്ഛതകളാൽ അവർ എന്റെ വിശുദ്ധനാമത്തെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ എന്റെ കോപത്തിൽ അവരെ നശിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they placed their threshold next to my threshold and their doorposts beside my doorposts, with only a wall between me and them, they defiled my holy name by their detestable practices. So I destroyed them in my anger.
chapters.nkjv: When they set their threshold by My threshold, and their doorpost by My doorpost, with a wall between them and Me, they defiled My holy name by the abominations which they committed; therefore I have consumed them in My anger.
chapters.kjv: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പരസംഗവും രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ ശവങ്ങളും എങ്കൽനിന്നു ദൂരത്താക്കിക്കളയട്ടെ; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ അവരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ എന്നേക്കും വസിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Now let them put away from me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will live among them forever.
chapters.nkjv: Now let them put their harlotry and the carcasses of their kings far away from Me, and I will dwell in their midst forever.
chapters.kjv: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹം തങ്ങളുടെ അകൃത്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു ലജ്ജിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ ഈ ആലയം അവരെ കാണിക്ക; അവർ അതിന്റെ മാതൃക അളക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "Son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their sins. Let them consider its perfection,
chapters.nkjv: "Son of man, describe the temple to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
chapters.kjv: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

chapters.ml: അവർ ചെയ്ത സകലത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു അവർ ലജ്ജിച്ചാൽ നീ ആലയത്തിന്റെ ആകൃതിയും വിധാനവും പുറപ്പാടുകളും പ്രവേശനങ്ങളും അതിന്റെ ആകൃതി ഒക്കെയും സകല വ്യവസ്ഥകളും അതിന്റെ രൂപമൊക്കെയും അതിന്റെ സകല നിയമങ്ങളും അവരെ അറിയിച്ചു, അവർ അതിന്റെ എല്ലാ ചട്ടങ്ങളും വ്യവസ്ഥകളും പ്രമാണിച്ചു അനുഷ്ഠിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിനെ ഒക്കെയും അവർ കാൺകെ എഴുതിവെക്കുക.
chapters.niv: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the design of the temple—its arrangement, its exits and entrances—its whole design and all its regulations and laws. Write these down before them so that they may be faithful to its design and follow all its regulations.
chapters.nkjv: And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the design of the temple and its arrangement, its exits and its entrances, its entire design and all its ordinances, all its forms and all its laws. Write it down in their sight, so that they may keep its whole design and all its ordinances, and perform them.
chapters.kjv: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

chapters.ml: ഇതാകുന്നു ആലയത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള പ്രമാണം; പർവ്വതത്തിന്റെ മുകളിൽ അതിന്റെ അതൃത്തിക്കകമെല്ലാം അതി വിശുദ്ധമായിരിക്കേണം; അതേ, ഇതാകുന്നു ആലയത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള പ്രമാണം.
chapters.niv: "This is the law of the temple: All the surrounding area on top of the mountain will be most holy. Such is the law of the temple.
chapters.nkjv: This is the law of the temple: The whole area surrounding the mountaintop is most holy. Behold, this is the law of the temple.
chapters.kjv: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

chapters.ml: മുഴപ്രകാരം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ അളവു ആവിതു--മുഴം ഒന്നിന്നു ഒരു മുഴവും നാലു വിരലും--: ചുവടു ഒരു മുഴം; വീതി ഒരു മുഴം; അതിന്റെ അകത്തു ചുറ്റുമുള്ള വക്കുഒരു ചാൺ. യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ ഉയരമാവിതു:
chapters.niv: "These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits, that cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: Its gutter is a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around the edge. And this is the height of the altar:
chapters.nkjv: "These are the measurements of the altar in cubits (the cubit is one cubit and a handbreadth): the base one cubit high and one cubit wide, with a rim all around its edge of one span. This is the height of the altar:
chapters.kjv: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.

chapters.ml: നിലത്തെ ചുവടുമുതൽ താഴത്തെ തട്ടുവരെ രണ്ടു മുഴവും വീതി ഒരു മുഴവും; താഴത്തെ തട്ടുമുതൽ വലിയ തട്ടുവരെ നാലു മുഴവും വീതി ഒരു മുഴവും ആയിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge that goes around the altar it is two cubits high, and the ledge is a cubit wide. From this lower ledge to the upper ledge that goes around the altar it is four cubits high, and that ledge is also a cubit wide.
chapters.nkjv: from the base on the ground to the lower ledge, two cubits; the width of the ledge, one cubit; from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge, four cubits; and the width of the ledge, one cubit.
chapters.kjv: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മേലത്തെ യാഗപീഠം നാലു മുഴം; യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ അടുപ്പിൽനിന്നു മേലോട്ടു നാലു കൊമ്പു ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കേണം;
chapters.niv: Above that, the altar hearth is four cubits high, and four horns project upward from the hearth.
chapters.nkjv: The altar hearth is four cubits high, with four horns extending upward from the hearth.
chapters.kjv: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ അടുപ്പിന്റെ നീളം പന്ത്രണ്ടു മുഴവും വീതി പന്ത്രണ്ടു മുഴവുമായി സമചതുരമായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The altar hearth is square, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.
chapters.nkjv: The altar hearth is twelve cubits long, twelve wide, square at its four corners;
chapters.kjv: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ നാലു പുറവുമുള്ള തട്ടു പതിന്നാലു മുഴം നീളവും പതിന്നാലു മുഴം വീതിയും അതിന്റെ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള വക്കുഅര മുഴവും ചുവടു ചുറ്റും ഒരു മുഴവും ആയിരിക്കേണം; അതിന്റെ പതനങ്ങൾ കിഴക്കോട്ടായിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The upper ledge also is square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide. All around the altar is a gutter of one cubit with a rim of half a cubit. The steps of the altar face east."
chapters.nkjv: the ledge, fourteen cubits long and fourteen wide on its four sides, with a rim of half a cubit around it; its base, one cubit all around; and its steps face toward the east."
chapters.kjv: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: അവർ യാഗപീഠം ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്ന നാളിൽ അതിന്മേൽ ഹോമയാഗം കഴിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും രക്തം തളിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ചട്ടങ്ങൾ ആവിതു:
chapters.niv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: These will be the regulations for sacrificing burnt offerings and splashing blood against the altar when it is built:
chapters.nkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, thus says the Lord God: ‘These are the ordinances for the altar on the day when it is made, for sacrificing burnt offerings on it, and for sprinkling blood on it.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്നോടു അടുത്തു വരുന്ന സാദോക്കിന്റെ സന്തതിയിലുള്ള ലേവ്യരായ പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കു നീ പാപയാഗമായി ഒരു കാളക്കുട്ടിയെ കൊടുക്കേണം എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: You are to give a young bull as a sin offering to the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who come near to minister before me, declares the Sovereign Lord .
chapters.nkjv: You shall give a young bull for a sin offering to the priests, the Levites, who are of the seed of Zadok, who approach Me to minister to Me,’ says the Lord God.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD , a young bullock for a sin offering.

chapters.ml: നീ അതിന്റെ രക്തത്തിൽ കുറെ എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്റെ നാലു കൊമ്പിലും തട്ടിന്റെ നാലു കോണിലും ചുറ്റുമുള്ള വക്കിലും പുരട്ടി അതിന്നു പാപപരിഹാരവും പ്രായശ്ചിത്തവും വരുത്തേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar and on the four corners of the upper ledge and all around the rim, and so purify the altar and make atonement for it.
chapters.nkjv: ‘You shall take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and on the rim around it; thus you shall cleanse it and make atonement for it.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ നീ പാപയാഗത്തിന്നു കാളയെ എടുത്തു ആലയത്തിൽ നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ട സ്ഥലത്തു വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ പുറമെ വെച്ചു ദഹിപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the designated part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and burn it in the appointed place of the temple, outside the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം ദിവസം നീ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു കോലാട്ടുകൊറ്റനെ പാപയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം; അവർ കാളയെക്കൊണ്ടു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നു പാപപരിഹാരം വരുത്തിയതുപോലെ ഇതിനെക്കൊണ്ടും അതിന്നു പാപപരിഹാരം വരുത്തേണം.
chapters.niv: "On the second day you are to offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering, and the altar is to be purified as it was purified with the bull.
chapters.nkjv: On the second day you shall offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.
chapters.kjv: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പാപപരിഹാരം വരുത്തിത്തീർന്നശേഷം, നീ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു കാളക്കുട്ടിയെയും ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: When you have finished purifying it, you are to offer a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.
chapters.nkjv: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without blemish, and a ram from the flock without blemish.
chapters.kjv: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

chapters.ml: നീ അവയെ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണം; പുരോഹിതന്മാർ അവയുടെമേൽ ഉപ്പു വിതറിയശേഷം അവയെ യഹോവെക്കു ഹോമയാഗമായി അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You are to offer them before the Lord , and the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the Lord .
chapters.nkjv: When you offer them before the Lord, the priests shall throw salt on them, and they will offer them up as a burnt offering to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD , and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD .

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ദിവസം നീ ദിനംപ്രതി പാപയാഗമായി ഓരോ കോലാട്ടിനെ അർപ്പിക്കേണം; അവർ ഊനമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു കാളക്കുട്ടിയെയും ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ആട്ടുകൊറ്റനെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: "For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.
chapters.nkjv: Every day for seven days you shall prepare a goat for a sin offering; they shall also prepare a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without blemish.
chapters.kjv: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഏഴുദിവസം യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നു പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം വരുത്തിയും അതിനെ നിർമ്മലീകരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു പ്രതിഷ്ഠ കഴിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: For seven days they are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; thus they will dedicate it.
chapters.nkjv: Seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and purify it, and so consecrate it.
chapters.kjv: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

chapters.ml: ഈ ദിവസങ്ങൾ തികെച്ചശേഷം എട്ടാം ദിവസവും മുമ്പോട്ടും പുരോഹിതന്മാർ യാഗപീഠത്തിന്മേൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹോമയാഗങ്ങളെയും സമാധാനയാഗങ്ങളെയും അർപ്പിക്കേണം. അങ്ങനെ എനിക്കു നിങ്ങളിൽ പ്രസാദമുണ്ടാകും എന്നു യഹോവയായ കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
chapters.nkjv: When these days are over it shall be, on the eighth day and thereafter, that the priests shall offer your burnt offerings and your peace offerings on the altar; and I will accept you,’ says the Lord God."
chapters.kjv: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD .

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ എന്നെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിന്റെ കിഴക്കോട്ടു ദർശനമുള്ള പുറത്തെ ഗോപുരത്തിലേക്കു മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; എന്നാൽ അതു അടെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east, and it was shut.
chapters.nkjv: Then He brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary which faces toward the east, but it was shut.
chapters.kjv: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: ഈ ഗോപുരം തുറക്കാതെ അടെച്ചിരിക്കേണം; ആരും അതിൽകൂടി കടക്കരുതു; യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവ അതിൽകൂടി അകത്തു കടന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അതു അടെച്ചിരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to me, "This gate is to remain shut. It must not be opened; no one may enter through it. It is to remain shut because the Lord , the God of Israel, has entered through it.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to me, "This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter by it, because the Lord God of Israel has entered by it; therefore it shall be shut.
chapters.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD , the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

chapters.ml: പ്രഭുവോ അവൻ പ്രഭുവായിരിക്കയാൽ യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ ഭോജനം കഴിപ്പാൻ അവിടെ ഇരിക്കേണം; അവൻ ആ ഗോപുരത്തിന്റെ പൂമുഖത്തുകൂടി അകത്തു കടക്കയും അതിൽകൂടി പുറത്തു പോകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: The prince himself is the only one who may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the Lord . He is to enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way."
chapters.nkjv: Asfor the prince, because he is the prince, he may sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by way of the vestibule of the gateway, and go out the same way."
chapters.kjv: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നെ വടക്കെ ഗോപുരംവഴിയായി ആലയത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു; ഞാൻ നോക്കി, യഹോവയുടെ തേജസ്സു യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിൽ നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു കവിണ്ണുവീണു.
chapters.niv: Then the man brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked and saw the glory of the Lord filling the temple of the Lord , and I fell facedown.
chapters.nkjv: Also He brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple; so I looked, and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord; and I fell on my face.
chapters.kjv: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD : and I fell upon my face.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യഹോവ എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രാ, യഹോവയുടെ ആലയത്തിന്റെ സകല വ്യവസ്ഥകളെയും നിയമങ്ങളെയും കുറിച്ചു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും നീ നല്ലവണ്ണം ശ്രദ്ധവെച്ചു കണ്ണുകൊണ്ടു നോക്കി ചെവികൊണ്ടു കേൾക്ക; ആലയത്തിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രവേശനത്തെയും വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽനിന്നുള്ള പുറപ്പാടുകളെയും നീ നല്ലവണ്ണം കുറിക്കൊൾക.
chapters.niv: The Lord said to me, "Son of man, look carefully, listen closely and give attention to everything I tell you concerning all the regulations and instructions regarding the temple of the Lord . Give attention to the entrance to the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, mark well, see with your eyes and hear with your ears, all that I say to you concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord and all its laws. Mark well who may enter the house and all who go out from the sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD , and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹക്കരായ മത്സരികളോടു നീ പറയേണ്ടതു: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹമേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ സകല മ്ളേച്ഛതകളും മതിയാക്കുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Say to rebellious Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Enough of your detestable practices, people of Israel!
chapters.nkjv: "Now say to the rebellious, to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "O house of Israel, let Us have no more of all your abominations.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ ആഹാരമായ മേദസ്സും രക്തവും അർപ്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ, എന്റെ ആലയത്തെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഹൃദയത്തിലും മാംസത്തിലും അഗ്രചർമ്മികളായ അന്യജാതിക്കാരെ എന്റെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ ഇരിപ്പാൻ കൊണ്ടുവന്നതിനാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ സകല മ്ളേച്ഛതകൾക്കും പുറമെ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ നിയമവും ലംഘിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In addition to all your other detestable practices, you brought foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh into my sanctuary, desecrating my temple while you offered me food, fat and blood, and you broke my covenant.
chapters.nkjv: When you brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in My sanctuary to defile it—My house—and when you offered My food, the fat and the blood, then they broke My covenant because of all your abominations.
chapters.kjv: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ വിശുദ്ധവസ്തുക്കളുടെ കാര്യം വിചാരിക്കാതെ അവരെ എന്റെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ കാര്യവിചാരണെക്കു ആക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Instead of carrying out your duty in regard to my holy things, you put others in charge of my sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: And you have not kept charge of My holy things, but you have set others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you."
chapters.kjv: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

chapters.ml: യഹോവയായ കർത്താവു ഇപ്രകാരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു: യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ ഇടയിലുള്ള യാതൊരു അന്യജാതിക്കാരനും, ഹൃദയത്തിലും മാംസത്തിലും അഗ്രചർമ്മിയായ യാതൊരു അന്യജാതിക്കാരനും തന്നേ, എന്റെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh is to enter my sanctuary, not even the foreigners who live among the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart or uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter My sanctuary, including any foreigner who is among the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ തെറ്റിപ്പോയ കാലത്തു എന്നെ വിട്ടകന്നു പോയവരും എന്നെ വിട്ടു തെറ്റി വിഗ്രഹങ്ങളോടു ചേർന്നവരുമായ ലേവ്യർ തന്നേ തങ്ങളുടെ അകൃത്യം വഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: " ‘The Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray and who wandered from me after their idols must bear the consequences of their sin.
