chapters.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

chapters.ml: അദ്ധ്വാനിക്കുന്നവരും ഭാരം ചുമക്കുന്നവരും ആയുള്ളോരേ, എല്ലാവരും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവിൻ; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
chapters.nkjv: Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
chapters.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സൌമ്യതയും താഴ്മയും ഉള്ളവൻ ആകയാൽ എന്റെ നുകം ഏറ്റുകൊണ്ടു എന്നോടു പഠിപ്പിൻ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ആത്മാക്കൾക്കു ആശ്വാസം കണ്ടത്തും.
chapters.niv: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
chapters.nkjv: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
chapters.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നുകം മൃദുവും എന്റെ ചുമടു ലഘുവും ആകുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light."
chapters.nkjv: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light."
chapters.kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യേശു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ വിളഭൂമിയിൽകൂടി കടന്നുപോയി; അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ വിശന്നിട്ടു കതിർ പറിച്ചു തിന്നുതുടങ്ങി
chapters.niv: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick some heads of grain and eat them.
chapters.nkjv: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. And His disciples were hungry, and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
chapters.kjv: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.

chapters.ml: പരീശർ അതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഇതാ, ശബ്ബത്തിൽ വിഹിതമല്ലാത്തതു നിന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, "Look! Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath."
chapters.nkjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to Him, "Look, Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath!"
chapters.kjv: But when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ദാവീദ് തനിക്കും കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും
chapters.niv: He answered, "Haven’t you read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him:
chapters.kjv: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;

chapters.ml: വിശന്നപ്പോൾ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു. പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കു മാത്രമല്ലാതെ തനിക്കും കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും തിന്മാൻ വിഹിതമല്ലാത്ത കാഴ്ചയപ്പം തിന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread—which was not lawful for them to do, but only for the priests.
chapters.nkjv: how he entered the house of God and ate the showbread which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
chapters.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

chapters.ml: അല്ല, ശബ്ബത്തിൽ പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽവെച്ചു ശബ്ബത്തിനെ ലംഘിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിലും കുറ്റമില്ലാതെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Or haven’t you read in the Law that the priests on Sabbath duty in the temple desecrate the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
chapters.nkjv: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are blameless?
chapters.kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവാലയത്തെക്കാൾ വലിയവൻ ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
chapters.nkjv: Yet I say to you that in this place there is One greater than the temple.
chapters.kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

chapters.ml: യാഗത്തിലല്ല, കരുണയിൽ അത്രേ, ഞാൻ പ്രസാദിക്കുന്നു എന്നുള്ളതു എന്തു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കുറ്റമില്ലാത്തവരെ കുറ്റം വിധിക്കയില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: If you had known what these words mean, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
chapters.nkjv: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy and not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the guiltless.
chapters.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രനോ ശബ്ബത്തിന്നു കർത്താവാകുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
chapters.nkjv: For the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath."
chapters.kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടം വിട്ടു അവരുടെ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ, കൈ വരണ്ട ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Going on from that place, he went into their synagogue,
chapters.nkjv: Now when He had departed from there, He went into their synagogue.
chapters.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനിൽ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുന്നതു വിഹിതമോ എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and a man with a shriveled hand was there. Looking for a reason to bring charges against Jesus, they asked him, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"
chapters.nkjv: And behold, there was a man who had a withered hand. And they asked Him, saying, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"—that they might accuse Him.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒരുത്തന്നു ഒരു ആടുണ്ടു എന്നിരിക്കട്ടെ; അതു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ കുഴിയിൽ വീണാൽ അവൻ അതിനെ പിടിച്ചു കയറ്റുകയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: He said to them, "If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will you not take hold of it and lift it out?
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will not lay hold of it and lift it out?
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മനുഷ്യൻ ആടിനെക്കാൾ എത്ര വിശേഷതയുള്ളവൻ. ആകയാൽ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ നന്മ ചെയ്യുന്നതു വിഹിതം തന്നേ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: How much more valuable is a person than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
chapters.nkjv: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep? Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
chapters.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ആ മനുഷ്യനോടു: “കൈ നീട്ടുക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ നീട്ടി, അതു മറ്റേതുപോലെ സൌഖ്യമായി.
chapters.niv: Then he said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." So he stretched it out and it was completely restored, just as sound as the other.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched it out, and it was restored as whole as the other.
chapters.kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരോ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അവനെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ വേണ്ടി അവന്നു വിരോധമായി തമ്മിൽ ആലോചിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Pharisees went out and plotted against Him, how they might destroy Him.
chapters.kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അതു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവിടം വിട്ടുപോയി, വളരെ പേർ അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു; അവൻ അവരെ ഒക്കെയും സൌഖ്യമാക്കി,
chapters.niv: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. A large crowd followed him, and he healed all who were ill.
chapters.nkjv: But when Jesus knew it, He withdrew from there. And great multitudes followed Him, and He healed them all.
chapters.kjv: But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

chapters.ml: തന്നെ പ്രസിദ്ധമാക്കരുതു എന്നു അവരോടു ആജ്ഞാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He warned them not to tell others about him.
chapters.nkjv: Yet He warned them not to make Him known,
chapters.kjv: And charged them that they should not make him known:

chapters.ml: “ഇതാ, ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത എന്റെ ദാസൻ, എന്റെ ഉള്ളം പ്രസാദിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ പ്രിയൻ; ഞാൻ എന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെ അവന്റെമേൽ വെക്കും; അവൻ ജാതികൾക്കു ന്യായവിധി അറിയിക്കും.”
chapters.niv: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
chapters.nkjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying:
chapters.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

chapters.ml: അവൻ കലഹിക്കയില്ല, നിലവിളിക്കയില്ല; ആരും തെരുക്കളിൽ അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.
chapters.nkjv: "Behold! My Servant whom I have chosen, My Beloved in whom My soul is well pleased! I will put My Spirit upon Him, And He will declare justice to the Gentiles.
chapters.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

chapters.ml: ചതഞ്ഞ ഓട അവൻ ഒടിച്ചുകളകയില്ല; പുകയുന്ന തിരി കെടുത്തുകളകയില്ല; അവൻ ന്യായവിധി ജയത്തോളം നടത്തും.
chapters.niv: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear his voice in the streets.
chapters.nkjv: He will not quarrel nor cry out, Nor will anyone hear His voice in the streets.
chapters.kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ ജാതികൾ പ്രത്യാശവെക്കും”
chapters.niv: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out, till he has brought justice through to victory.
chapters.nkjv: A bruised reed He will not break, And smoking flax He will not quench, Till He sends forth justice to victory;
chapters.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

chapters.ml: എന്നിങ്ങനെ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു നിവൃത്തി ആകുവാൻ സംഗതിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: In his name the nations will put their hope."
chapters.nkjv: And in His name Gentiles will trust."
chapters.kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ചിലർ കുരുടനും ഊമനുമായോരു ഭൂതഗ്രസ്തനെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ഊമൻ സംസാരിക്കയും കാണ്കയും ചെയ്‍വാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അവൻ അവനെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.
chapters.nkjv: Then one was brought to Him who was demon-possessed, blind and mute; and He healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
chapters.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം ഒക്കെയും വിസ്മയിച്ചു: ഇവൻ ദാവീദ് പുത്രൻ തന്നേയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All the people were astonished and said, "Could this be the Son of David?"
chapters.nkjv: And all the multitudes were amazed and said, "Could this be the Son of David?"
chapters.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

chapters.ml: അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു പരീശന്മാർ: ഇവൻ ഭൂതങ്ങളുടെ തലവനായ ബെയെത്സെബൂലിനെക്കൊണ്ടല്ലാതെ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, "It is only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, that this fellow drives out demons."
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Pharisees heard it they said, "This fellow does not cast out demons except by Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons."
chapters.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ നിരൂപണം അറിഞ്ഞു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഒരു രാജ്യം തന്നിൽ തന്നേ ഛിദ്രിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ ശൂന്യമാകും;
chapters.niv: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

chapters.ml: ഒരു പട്ടണമോ ഗൃഹമോ തന്നിൽ തന്നേ ഛിദ്രിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ നിലനിൽക്കയില്ല. സാത്താൻ സാത്താനെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ അവൻ തന്നിൽ തന്നേ ഛിദ്രിച്ചു പോയല്ലോ; പിന്നെ അവന്റെ രാജ്യം എങ്ങനെ നിലനില്ക്കും?
chapters.niv: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
chapters.nkjv: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
chapters.kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ബെയെത്സെബൂലിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾ ആരെക്കൊണ്ടു പുറത്താക്കുന്നു? അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ന്യായാധിപന്മാർ ആകും.
chapters.niv: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your people drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
chapters.nkjv: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they shall be your judges.
chapters.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

chapters.ml: ദൈവാത്മാവിനാൽ ഞാൻ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നു എങ്കിലോ ദൈവരാജ്യം നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു സ്പഷ്ടം.
chapters.niv: But if it is by the Spirit of God that I drive out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
chapters.nkjv: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, surely the kingdom of God has come upon you.
chapters.kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

chapters.ml: ബലവാനെ പിടിച്ചു കെട്ടീട്ടല്ലാതെ ബലവാന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കടന്നു അവന്റെ കോപ്പു കവർന്നുകളവാൻ എങ്ങനെ കഴിയും? പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടിയാൽ പിന്നെ അവന്റെ വീടു കവർച്ച ചെയ്യാം.
chapters.niv: "Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and carry off his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
chapters.nkjv: Or how can one enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man? And then he will plunder his house.
chapters.kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു അനുകൂലമല്ലാത്തവൻ എനിക്കു പ്രതികൂലം ആകുന്നു; എന്നോടുകൂടെ ചേർക്കാത്തവൻ ചിതറിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
chapters.nkjv: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters abroad.
chapters.kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നതു: സകലപാപവും ദൂഷണവും മനുഷ്യരോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും; ആത്മാവിന്നു നേരെയുള്ള ദൂഷണമോ ക്ഷമിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: And so I tell you, every kind of sin and slander can be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore I say to you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും മനുഷ്യ പുത്രന്നു നേരെ ഒരു വാക്കു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അതു അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കും; പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിന്നു നേരെ പറഞ്ഞാലോ ഈ ലോകത്തിലും വരുവാനുള്ളതിലും അവനോടു ക്ഷമിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.
chapters.nkjv: Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age or in the age to come.
chapters.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നുകിൽ വൃക്ഷം നല്ലതു, ഫലവും നല്ലതു എന്നു വെപ്പിൻ; അല്ലായ്കിൽ വൃക്ഷം ചീത്ത, ഫലവും ചീത്ത എന്നു വെപ്പിൻ; ഫലം കൊണ്ടല്ലോ വൃക്ഷം അറിയുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: "Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is recognized by its fruit.
chapters.nkjv: "Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or else make the tree bad and its fruit bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.
chapters.kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

chapters.ml: സർപ്പസന്തതികളെ, നിങ്ങൾ ദുഷ്ടരായിരിക്കെ നല്ലതു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ എങ്ങനെ കഴിയും? ഹൃദയം നിറഞ്ഞു കവിയുന്നതിൽ നിന്നല്ലോ വായ് സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
chapters.nkjv: Brood of vipers! How can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
chapters.kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

chapters.ml: നല്ല മനുഷ്യൻ തന്റെ നല്ല നിക്ഷേപത്തിൽനിന്നു നല്ലതു പുറപ്പെടുവിക്കുന്നു; ദുഷ്ടമനുഷ്യൻ ദുർന്നിക്ഷേപത്തിൽനിന്നു തീയതു പുറപ്പെടുവിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in him, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in him.
chapters.nkjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth good things, and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.
chapters.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മനുഷ്യർ പറയുന്ന ഏതു നിസ്സാരവാക്കിന്നും ന്യായവിധിദിവസത്തിൽ കണക്കു ബോധിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടിവരും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But I tell you that everyone will have to give account on the day of judgment for every empty word they have spoken.
chapters.nkjv: But I say to you that for every idle word men may speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
chapters.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വാക്കുകളാൽ നീതീകരിക്കപ്പെടുകയും നിന്റെ വാക്കുകളാൽ കുറ്റം വിധിക്കപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്യും.”
chapters.niv: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned."
chapters.nkjv: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned."
chapters.kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരിലും പരീശന്മാരിലും ചിലർ അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, നീ ഒരു അടയാളം ചെയ്തുകാണ്മാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law said to him, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from you."
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered, saying, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from You."
chapters.kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

chapters.ml: “ദോഷവും വ്യഭിചാരവുമുള്ള തലമുറ അടയാളം തിരയുന്നു; യോനാപ്രവാചകന്റെ അടയാളമല്ലാതെ അതിന്നു അടയാളം ലഭിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: He answered, "A wicked and adulterous generation asks for a sign! But none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said to them, "An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
chapters.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

chapters.ml: യോനാ കടലാനയുടെ വയറ്റിൽ മൂന്നു രാവും മൂന്നു പകലും ഇരുന്നതു പോലെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മൂന്നു രാവും മൂന്നു പകലും ഭൂമിയുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
chapters.kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

chapters.ml: നീനെവേക്കാർ ന്യായവിധിയിൽ ഈ തലമുറയോടു ഒന്നിച്ചു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അതിനെ കുറ്റം വിധിക്കും; അവർ യോനയുടെ പ്രസംഗം കേട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടുവല്ലോ; ഇതാ, ഇവിടെ യോനയിലും വലിയവൻ.
chapters.niv: The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now something greater than Jonah is here.
chapters.nkjv: The men of Nineveh will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and indeed a greater than Jonah is here.
chapters.kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

chapters.ml: തെക്കെ രാജ്ഞി ന്യായവിധിയിൽ ഈ തലമുറയോടു ഒന്നിച്ചു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു അതിനെ കുറ്റം വിധിക്കും; അവൾ ശലോമോന്റെ ജ്ഞാനം കേൾപ്പാൻ ഭൂമിയുടെ അറുതികളിൽ നിന്നു വന്നുവല്ലോ; ഇവിടെ ഇതാ, ശലോമോനിലും വലിയവൻ.
chapters.niv: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, and now something greater than Solomon is here.
chapters.nkjv: The queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and indeed a greater than Solomon is here.
chapters.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

chapters.ml: അശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടശേഷം നീരില്ലാത്ത സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ കൂടി തണുപ്പു അന്വേഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു സഞ്ചരിക്കുന്നു; കണ്ടെത്തുന്നില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: "When an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
chapters.nkjv: "When an unclean spirit goes out of a man, he goes through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.
chapters.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോന്ന എന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെല്ലും എന്നു അവൻ പറയുന്നു; ഉടനെ വന്നു, അതു ഒഴിഞ്ഞതും അടിച്ചുവാരി അലങ്കരിച്ചതുമായി കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ When it arrives, it finds the house unoccupied, swept clean and put in order.
chapters.nkjv: Then he says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’ And when he comes, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
chapters.kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു, തന്നിലും ദുഷ്ടതയേറിയ വേറെ ഏഴു ആത്മാക്കളെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു; അവരും അവിടെ കയറി പാർക്കുന്നു; ആ മനുഷ്യന്റെ പിന്നത്തെ സ്ഥിതി മുമ്പിലത്തേതിലും വല്ലാതെ ആകും; ഈ ദുഷ്ടതലമുറെക്കും അങ്ങനെ ഭവിക്കും.”
chapters.niv: Then it goes and takes with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first. That is how it will be with this wicked generation."
chapters.nkjv: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter and dwell there; and the last state of that man is worse than the first. So shall it also be with this wicked generation."
chapters.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തോടു സംസാരിച്ചു കൊണ്ടിരിക്കയിൽ അവന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും അവനോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു പുറത്തു നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: While Jesus was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to him.
chapters.nkjv: While He was still talking to the multitudes, behold, His mother and brothers stood outside, seeking to speak with Him.
chapters.kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തൻ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും നിന്നോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു പുറത്തുനില്ക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to you."
chapters.nkjv: Then one said to Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, seeking to speak with You."
chapters.kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.

chapters.ml: അതു പറഞ്ഞവനോടു അവൻ: “എന്റെ അമ്മ ആർ എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ ആർ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He replied to him, "Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?"
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said to the one who told Him, "Who is My mother and who are My brothers?"
chapters.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ നേരെ കൈ നീട്ടി: “ഇതാ, എന്റെ അമ്മയും എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും.
chapters.niv: Pointing to his disciples, he said, "Here are my mother and my brothers.
chapters.nkjv: And He stretched out His hand toward His disciples and said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!
chapters.kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ എന്റെ സഹോദരനും സഹോദരിയും അമ്മയും ആകുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother."
chapters.nkjv: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother."
chapters.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യേശു വീട്ടിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു കടലരികെ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.
chapters.nkjv: On the same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.
chapters.kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

chapters.ml: വളരെ പുരുഷാരം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുകൂടുകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ പടകിൽ കയറി ഇരുന്നു; പുരുഷാരം എല്ലാം കരയിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Such large crowds gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people stood on the shore.
chapters.nkjv: And great multitudes were gathered together to Him, so that He got into a boat and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
chapters.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു പലതും ഉപമകളായി പ്രസ്താവിച്ചതെന്തന്നാൽ: “വിതെക്കുന്നവൻ വിതെപ്പാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then he told them many things in parables, saying: "A farmer went out to sow his seed.
chapters.nkjv: Then He spoke many things to them in parables, saying: "Behold, a sower went out to sow.
chapters.kjv: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

chapters.ml: വിതെക്കുമ്പോൾ ചിലതു വഴിയരികെ വിണു; പറവകൾ വന്നു അതു തിന്നു കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
chapters.nkjv: And as he sowed, some seed fell by the wayside; and the birds came and devoured them.
chapters.kjv: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

chapters.ml: ചിലതു പാറസ്ഥലത്തു ഏറെ മണ്ണില്ലാത്ത ഇടത്തു വീണു; മണ്ണിന്നു താഴ്ചയില്ലായ്കയാൽ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ മുളെച്ചുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.
chapters.nkjv: Some fell on stony places, where they did not have much earth; and they immediately sprang up because they had no depth of earth.
chapters.kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ ഉദിച്ചാറെ ചൂടുതട്ടി, വേർ ഇല്ലായ്കയാൽ അതു ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
chapters.nkjv: But when the sun was up they were scorched, and because they had no root they withered away.
chapters.kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു മുള്ളിന്നിടയിൽ വീണു; മുള്ളു മുളെച്ചു വളർന്നു അതിനെ ഞെരുക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants.
chapters.nkjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up and choked them.
chapters.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു നല്ല നിലത്തു വീണു, നൂറും അറുപതും മുപ്പതും മേനിയായി വിളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it produced a crop—a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.
chapters.nkjv: But others fell on good ground and yielded a crop: some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
chapters.kjv: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

chapters.ml: ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.”
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear."
chapters.nkjv: He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"
chapters.kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അടുക്കെ വന്നു: അവരോടു ഉപമകളായി സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The disciples came to him and asked, "Why do you speak to the people in parables?"
chapters.nkjv: And the disciples came and said to Him, "Why do You speak to them in parables?"
chapters.kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യത്തിന്റെ മർമ്മങ്ങളെ അറിവാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു വരം ലഭിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർക്കോ ലഭിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: He replied, "Because the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said to them, "Because it has been given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been given.
chapters.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

chapters.ml: ഉള്ളവന്നു കൊടുക്കും; അവന്നു സമൃദ്ധിയുണ്ടാകും; ഇല്ലാത്തവനോടോ അവന്നുള്ളതും കൂടെ എടുത്തുകളയും.
chapters.niv: Whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.
chapters.nkjv: For whoever has, to him more will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
chapters.kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ കണ്ടിട്ടു കാണാതെയും കേട്ടിട്ടു കേൾക്കാതെയും ഗ്രഹിക്കാതെയും ഇരിക്കയാൽ ഞാൻ ഉപമകളായി അവരോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is why I speak to them in parables: "Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand.
chapters.kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ചെവിയാൽ കേൾക്കും ഗ്രഹിക്കയില്ലതാനും; കണ്ണാൽ കാണും ദർശിക്കയില്ലതാനും; ഈ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഹൃദയം തടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ ചെവികൊണ്ടു മന്ദമായി കേൾക്കുന്നു; കണ്ണു അടെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ കണ്ണു കാണാതെയും ചെവി കേൾക്കാതെയും ഹൃദയം കൊണ്ടു ഗ്രഹിക്കാതെയും തിരിഞ്ഞുകൊള്ളാതെയും ഞാൻ അവരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കാതെയും ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്നേ
chapters.niv: In them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah: " ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
chapters.nkjv: And in them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says: ‘Hearing you will hear and shall not understand, And seeing you will see and not perceive;
chapters.kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

chapters.ml: എന്നു യെശയ്യാവു പറഞ്ഞ പ്രവാചകത്തിന്നു അവരിൽ നിവൃത്തിവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For this people’s heart has become calloused; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them.’
chapters.nkjv: For the hearts of this people have grown dull. Theirears are hard of hearing, And their eyes they have closed, Lest they should see withtheireyes and hear withtheirears, Lest they should understand withtheirhearts and turn, So that I should heal them.’
chapters.kjv: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ കണ്ണു കാണുന്നതുകൊണ്ടും നിങ്ങളുടെ ചെവി കേൾക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടും ഭാഗ്യമുള്ളവ.
chapters.niv: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
chapters.nkjv: But blessed are your eyes for they see, and your ears for they hear;
chapters.kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

chapters.ml: ഏറിയ പ്രവാചകന്മാരും നീതിമാന്മാരും നിങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നതു കാണ്മാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചിട്ടു കണ്ടില്ല; നിങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കുന്നതു കേൾപ്പാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചിട്ടും കേട്ടില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
chapters.nkjv: for assuredly, I say to you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see what you see, and did not see it, and to hear what you hear, and did not hear it.
chapters.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them ; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വിതെക്കുന്നവന്റെ ഉപമ കേട്ടുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Listen then to what the parable of the sower means:
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore hear the parable of the sower:
chapters.kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തൻ രാജ്യത്തിന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടിട്ടു ഗ്രഹിക്കാഞ്ഞാൽ ദുഷ്ടൻ വന്നു അവന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ടതു എടുത്തുകളയുന്നു; ഇതത്രെ വഴിയരികെ വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ടതു.
chapters.niv: When anyone hears the message about the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in their heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
chapters.nkjv: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom, and does not understand it, then the wicked one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is he who received seed by the wayside.
chapters.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

chapters.ml: പാറസ്ഥലത്തു വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ടതോ, ഒരുത്തൻ വചനം കേട്ടിട്ടു ഉടനെ സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കൈകൊള്ളുന്നതു ആകുന്നു എങ്കിലും വേരില്ലാതിരിക്കയാൽ അവൻ ക്ഷണികനത്രേ.
chapters.niv: The seed falling on rocky ground refers to someone who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
chapters.nkjv: But he who received the seed on stony places, this is he who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;
chapters.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

chapters.ml: വചനംനിമിത്തം ഞെരുക്കമോ ഉപദ്രവമോ നേരിട്ടാൽ അവൻ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ ഇടറിപ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
chapters.nkjv: yet he has no root in himself, but endures only for a while. For when tribulation or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
chapters.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

chapters.ml: മുള്ളിന്നിടയിൽ വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ടതോ, ഒരുത്തൻ വചനം കേൾക്കുന്നു എങ്കിലും ഈ ലോകത്തിന്റെ ചിന്തയും ധനത്തിന്റെ വഞ്ചനയും വചനത്തെ ഞെരുക്കീട്ടു നിഷ്ഫലനായി തീരുന്നതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The seed falling among the thorns refers to someone who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, making it unfruitful.
chapters.nkjv: Now he who received seed among the thorns is he who hears the word, and the cares of this world and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
chapters.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

chapters.ml: നല്ല നിലത്തു വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ടതോ ഒരുത്തൻ വചനം കേട്ടു ഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നതു ആകുന്നു അതു വിളഞ്ഞു നൂറും അറുപതും മുപ്പതും മേനി നല്കുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: But the seed falling on good soil refers to someone who hears the word and understands it. This is the one who produces a crop, yielding a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown."
chapters.nkjv: But he who received seed on the good ground is he who hears the word and understands it, who indeed bears fruit and produces: some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty."
chapters.kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it ; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മറ്റൊരു ഉപമ അവർക്കു പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുത്തു: “സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ തന്റെ നിലത്തു നല്ല വിത്തു വിതെച്ചതിനോടു സദൃശമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus told them another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
chapters.nkjv: Another parable He put forth to them, saying: "The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field;
chapters.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യർ ഉറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ശത്രു വന്നു, കോതമ്പിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ കള വിതെച്ചു പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But while everyone was sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and went away.
chapters.nkjv: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat and went his way.
chapters.kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

chapters.ml: ഞാറു വളർന്നു കതിരായപ്പോൾ കളയും കാണായ്‍വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the wheat sprouted and formed heads, then the weeds also appeared.
chapters.nkjv: But when the grain had sprouted and produced a crop, then the tares also appeared.
chapters.kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ വീട്ടുടയവന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: യജമാനനേ, വയലിൽ നല്ലവിത്തല്ലയോ വിതെച്ചതു? പിന്നെ കള എവിടെനിന്നു വന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
chapters.nkjv: So the servants of the owner came and said to him, ‘Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? How then does it have tares?’
chapters.kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

chapters.ml: ഇതു ശത്രു ചെയ്തതാകുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു. ഞങ്ങൾ പോയി അതു പറിച്ചുകൂട്ടുവാൻ സമ്മതമുണ്ടോ എന്നു ദാസന്മാർ അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: " ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. "The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ The servants said to him, ‘Do you want us then to go and gather them up?’
chapters.kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഇല്ല, പക്ഷേ കള പറിക്കുമ്പോൾ കോതമ്പും കൂടെ പിഴുതുപോകും.
chapters.niv: " ‘No,’ he answered, ‘because while you are pulling the weeds, you may uproot the wheat with them.
chapters.nkjv: But he said, ‘No, lest while you gather up the tares you also uproot the wheat with them.
chapters.kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടുംകൂടെ കൊയ്ത്തോളം വളരട്ടെ; കൊയ്ത്തു കാലത്തു ഞാൻ കൊയ്യുന്നവരോടു മുമ്പെ കളപറിച്ചു കൂട്ടി ചുട്ടുകളയേണ്ടതിന്നു കെട്ടുകളായി കെട്ടുവാനും കോതമ്പു എന്റെ കളപ്പുരയിൽ കൂട്ടിവെപ്പാനും കല്പിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.”
chapters.niv: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat and bring it into my barn.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Let both grow together until the harvest, and at the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, "First gather together the tares and bind them in bundles to burn them, but gather the wheat into my barn." ’ "
chapters.kjv: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു ഉപമ അവൻ അവർക്കു പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുത്തു: “സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം കടുകുമണിയോടു സദൃശം; അതു ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ എടുത്തു തന്റെ വയലിൽ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He told them another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field.
chapters.nkjv: Another parable He put forth to them, saying: "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field,
chapters.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

chapters.ml: അതു എല്ലാവിത്തിലും ചെറിയതെങ്കിലും വളർന്നു സസ്യങ്ങളിൽ ഏറ്റവും വലുതായി, ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവകൾ വന്നു അതിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽ വസിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം വൃക്ഷമായി തീരുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: Though it is the smallest of all seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds come and perch in its branches."
chapters.nkjv: which indeed is the least of all the seeds; but when it is grown it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches."
chapters.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മറ്റൊരു ഉപമ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു: “സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം പുളിച്ച മാവിനോടു സദൃശം; അതു ഒരു സ്ത്രീ എടുത്തു മൂന്നുപറ മാവിൽ എല്ലാം പുളിച്ചുവരുവോളം അടക്കിവെച്ചു.”
chapters.niv: He told them still another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough."
chapters.nkjv: Another parable He spoke to them: "The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal till it was all leavened."
chapters.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഒക്കെയും യേശു പുരുഷാരത്തോടു ഉപമകളായി പറഞ്ഞു; ഉപമ കൂടാതെ അവരോടു ഒന്നും പറഞ്ഞില്ല
chapters.niv: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowd in parables; he did not say anything to them without using a parable.
chapters.nkjv: All these things Jesus spoke to the multitude in parables; and without a parable He did not speak to them,
chapters.kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ ഉപമ പ്രസ്താവിപ്പാൻ വായ്തുറക്കും; ലോകസ്ഥാപനം മുതൽ ഗൂഢമായതു ഉച്ചരിക്കും” എന്നു പ്രവാചകൻ പറഞ്ഞതു നിവൃത്തിയാകുവാൻ സംഗതിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: "I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter things hidden since the creation of the world."
chapters.nkjv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying: "I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things kept secret from the foundation of the world."
chapters.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യേശു പുരുഷാരത്തെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചിട്ടു വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു, ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: വയലി കളയുടെ ഉപമ തെളിയിച്ചുതരേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Then he left the crowd and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, "Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away and went into the house. And His disciples came to Him, saying, "Explain to us the parable of the tares of the field."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

chapters.ml: “നല്ല വിത്തു വിതെക്കുന്നവൻ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ;
chapters.niv: He answered, "The one who sowed the good seed is the Son of Man.
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said to them: "He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
chapters.kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

chapters.ml: വയൽ ലോകം; നല്ലവിത്തു രാജ്യത്തിന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ;
chapters.niv: The field is the world, and the good seed stands for the people of the kingdom. The weeds are the people of the evil one,
chapters.nkjv: The field is the world, the good seeds are the sons of the kingdom, but the tares are the sons of the wicked one.
chapters.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one ;

chapters.ml: കള ദുഷ്ടന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ; അതു വിതെച്ച ശത്രു പിശാചു; കൊയ്ത്തു ലോകാവസാനം;
chapters.niv: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
chapters.nkjv: The enemy who sowed them is the devil, the harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are the angels.
chapters.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

chapters.ml: കൊയ്യുന്നവർ ദൂതന്മാർ കള കൂട്ടി തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുടുംപോലെ ലോകാവസാനത്തിൽ സംഭവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "As the weeds are pulled up and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the age.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore as the tares are gathered and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of this age.
chapters.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ തന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരെ അയക്കും; അവർ അവന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിൽനിന്നു എല്ലാ ഇടർച്ചകളെയും അധർമ്മം പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നവരെയും കൂട്ടിച്ചേർത്തു
chapters.niv: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will weed out of his kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.
chapters.nkjv: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will gather out of His kingdom all things that offend, and those who practice lawlessness,
chapters.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

chapters.ml: തീച്ചൂളയിൽ ഇട്ടുകളയുകയും, അവിടെ കരച്ചലും പല്ലുകടിയും ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: They will throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
chapters.nkjv: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
chapters.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

chapters.ml: അന്നു നീതിമാന്മാർ തങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവിന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിൽ സൂര്യനെപ്പോലെ പ്രകാശിക്കും. ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Whoever has ears, let them hear.
chapters.nkjv: Then the righteous will shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear!
chapters.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം വയലിൽ ഒളിച്ചുവെച്ച നിധിയോടു സദൃശം. അതു ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ കണ്ടു മറെച്ചിട്ടു, തന്റെ സന്തോഷത്താൽ ചെന്നു തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും വിറ്റു ആ വയൽ വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: "The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.
chapters.nkjv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field, which a man found and hid; and for joy over it he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
chapters.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം നല്ല മുത്തു അന്വേഷിക്കുന്ന ഒരു വ്യാപാരിയോടു സദൃശം.
chapters.niv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant looking for fine pearls.
chapters.nkjv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking beautiful pearls,
chapters.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

chapters.ml: അവൻ വിലയേറിയ ഒരു മുത്തു കണ്ടെത്തിയാറെ ചെന്നു തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും വിറ്റു അതു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When he found one of great value, he went away and sold everything he had and bought it.
chapters.nkjv: who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had and bought it.
chapters.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം കടലിൽ ഇടുന്നതും എല്ലാവക മീനും പിടിക്കുന്നതുമായോരു വലയോടു സദൃശം.
chapters.niv: "Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was let down into the lake and caught all kinds of fish.
chapters.nkjv: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some of every kind,
chapters.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

chapters.ml: നിറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവർ അതു വലിച്ചു കരെക്കു കയറ്റി, ഇരുന്നുകൊണ്ടു നല്ലതു പാത്രങ്ങളിൽ കൂട്ടിവെച്ചു, ചീത്ത എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When it was full, the fishermen pulled it up on the shore. Then they sat down and collected the good fish in baskets, but threw the bad away.
chapters.nkjv: which, when it was full, they drew to shore; and they sat down and gathered the good into vessels, but threw the bad away.
chapters.kjv: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ലോകാവസാനത്തിൽ സംഭവിക്കും; ദൂതന്മാർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു നീതിമാന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു ദുഷ്ടന്മാരെ വേർതിരിച്ചു തീച്ചൂളയിൽ ഇട്ടുകളയും;
chapters.niv: This is how it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous
chapters.nkjv: So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come forth, separate the wicked from among the just,
chapters.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

chapters.ml: അവിടെ കരച്ചലും പല്ലുകടിയും ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: and throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
chapters.nkjv: and cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth."
chapters.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

chapters.ml: ഇതെല്ലാം ഗ്രഹിച്ചുവോ?” എന്നതിന്നു അവർ ഉവ്വു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Have you understood all these things?" Jesus asked. "Yes," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "Have you understood all these things?" They said to Him, "Yes, Lord."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “അതുകൊണ്ടു സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യത്തിന്നു ശിഷ്യനായിത്തീർന്ന ഏതു ശാസ്ത്രിയും തന്റെ നിക്ഷേപത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുതിയതും പഴയതും എടുത്തു കൊടുക്കുന്ന ഒരു വീട്ടുടയവനോടു സദൃശനാകുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Therefore every teacher of the law who has become a disciple in the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "Therefore every scribe instructed concerning the kingdom of heaven is like a householder who brings out of his treasure things new and old."
chapters.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

chapters.ml: ഈ ഉപമകളെ പറഞ്ഞു തീർന്നശേഷം യേശു അവിടം വിട്ടു തന്റെ പിതൃനഗരത്തിൽ വന്നു, അവരുടെ പള്ളിയിൽ അവർക്കു ഉപദേശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus had finished these parables, he moved on from there.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, that He departed from there.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

chapters.ml: അവർ വിസ്മയിച്ചു: ഇവന്നു ഈ ജ്ഞാനവും വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികളും എവിടെ നിന്നു?
chapters.niv: Coming to his hometown, he began teaching the people in their synagogue, and they were amazed. "Where did this man get this wisdom and these miraculous powers?" they asked.
chapters.nkjv: When He had come to His own country, He taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, "Where did this Man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
chapters.kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ തച്ചന്റെ മകൻ അല്ലയോ ഇവന്റെ അമ്മ മറിയ എന്നവളല്ലയോ? ഇവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ യാക്കോബ്, യോസെ, ശിമോൻ, യൂദാ എന്നവർ അല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother’s name Mary, and aren’t his brothers James, Joseph, Simon and Judas?
chapters.nkjv: Is this not the carpenter’s son? Is not His mother called Mary? And His brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
chapters.kjv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

chapters.ml: ഇവന്റെ സഹോദരികളും എല്ലാം നമ്മോടുകൂടെയില്ലയോ? ഇവന്നു ഇതു ഒക്കെയും എവിടെ നിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവങ്കൽ ഇടറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Aren’t all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?"
chapters.nkjv: And His sisters, are they not all with us? Where then did this Man get all these things?"
chapters.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ തന്റെ പിതൃനഗരത്തിലും സ്വന്തഭവനത്തിലും അല്ലാതെ ബഹുമാനമില്ലാത്തവൻ അല്ല” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his own town and in his own home."
chapters.nkjv: So they were offended at Him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his own country and in his own house."
chapters.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അവിശ്വാസം നിമിത്തം അവിടെ വളരെ വീര്യപ്രവർത്തികളെ ചെയ്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: And he did not do many miracles there because of their lack of faith.
chapters.nkjv: Now He did not do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
chapters.kjv: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഇടപ്രഭുവായ ഹെരോദാവു യേശുവിന്റെ ശ്രുതി കേട്ടിട്ടു:
chapters.niv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus,
chapters.nkjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the report about Jesus
chapters.kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോഹന്നാൻ സ്നാപകൻ; അവൻ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തു; അതുകൊണ്ടാകുന്നു ഈ ശക്തികൾ അവനിൽ വ്യാപരിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു തന്റെ ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and he said to his attendants, "This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him."
chapters.nkjv: and said to his servants, "This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him."
chapters.kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവു തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഫീലിപ്പൊസിന്റെ ഭാര്യ ഹെരോദ്യ നിമിത്തം, അവൾ നിനക്കു ഭാര്യയായിരിക്കുന്നതു വിഹിതമല്ല എന്നു
chapters.niv: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
chapters.nkjv: For Herod had laid hold of John and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
chapters.kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു കൊണ്ടു തന്നേ, അവനെ പിടിച്ചു കെട്ടി തടവിൽ ആക്കിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: for John had been saying to him: "It is not lawful for you to have her."
chapters.nkjv: Because John had said to him, "It is not lawful for you to have her."
chapters.kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ മനസ്സുണ്ടായിട്ടു പുരുഷാരം അവനെ പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു എണ്ണുകയാൽ അവരെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Herod wanted to kill John, but he was afraid of the people, because they considered John a prophet.
chapters.nkjv: And although he wanted to put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
chapters.kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹെരോദാവിന്റെ ജനനദിവസം ആയപ്പോൾ ഹെരോദ്യയുടെ മകൾ സഭാമദ്ധ്യേ നൃത്തം ചെയ്തു ഹെരോദാവിനെ പ്രസാദിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On Herod’s birthday the daughter of Herodias danced for the guests and pleased Herod so much
chapters.nkjv: But when Herod’s birthday was celebrated, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod.
chapters.kjv: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു എന്തു ചോദിച്ചാലും അവൾക്കു കൊടുക്കും എന്നു അവൻ സത്യംചെയ്തു വാക്കുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she might ask.
chapters.kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

chapters.ml: അവൾ അമ്മയുടെ ഉപദേശപ്രകാരം: യോഹന്നാൻ സ്നാപകന്റെ തല ഒരു താലത്തിൽ തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Prompted by her mother, she said, "Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist."
chapters.nkjv: So she, having been prompted by her mother, said, "Give me John the Baptist’s head here on a platter."
chapters.kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ദുഃഖിച്ചു എങ്കിലും ചെയ്ത സത്യത്തെയും വിരുന്നുകാരെയും വിചാരിച്ചു അതു കൊടുപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: The king was distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he ordered that her request be granted
chapters.nkjv: And the king was sorry; nevertheless, because of the oaths and because of those who sat with him, he commanded it to be given to her.
chapters.kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her .

chapters.ml: ആളയച്ചു തടവിൽ യോഹന്നാനെ ശിരഃഛേദം ചെയ്യിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and had John beheaded in the prison.
chapters.nkjv: So he sent and had John beheaded in prison.
chapters.kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ തല ഒരു താലത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ബാലെക്കു കൊടുത്തു; അവൾ അമ്മെക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: His head was brought in on a platter and given to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
chapters.nkjv: And his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.
chapters.kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ചെന്നു ഉടൽ എടുത്തു കുഴിച്ചിട്ടു: പിന്നെ വന്നു യേശുവിനെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Then his disciples came and took away the body and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

chapters.ml: അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു യേശു അവിടംവിട്ടു പടകിൽ കയറി നിർജ്ജനമായോരു സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു വേറിട്ടു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി; പുരുഷാരം അതു കേട്ടു പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നു കാൽനടയായി അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus heard what had happened, he withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. Hearing of this, the crowds followed him on foot from the towns.
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus heard it, He departed from there by boat to a deserted place by Himself. But when the multitudes heard it, they followed Him on foot from the cities.
chapters.kjv: When Jesus heard of it , he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof , they followed him on foot out of the cities.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വന്നു വലിയ പുരുഷാരത്തെ കണ്ടു അവരിൽ മനസ്സലിഞ്ഞു അവരുടെ രോഗികളെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick.
chapters.nkjv: And when Jesus went out He saw a great multitude; and He was moved with compassion for them, and healed their sick.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

chapters.ml: വൈകുന്നേരമായപ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: ഈ സ്ഥലം മരുഭൂമിയല്ലോ; നേരവും വൈകി; പുരുഷാരം ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിൽ പോയി ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങൾ കൊള്ളേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As evening approached, the disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it’s already getting late. Send the crowds away, so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food."
chapters.nkjv: When it was evening, His disciples came to Him, saying, "This is a deserted place, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages and buy themselves food."
chapters.kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “അവർ പോകുവാൻ ആവശ്യമില്ല; നിങ്ങൾ അവർക്കു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കൊടുപ്പിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said to them, "They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat."
chapters.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: അഞ്ചു അപ്പവും രണ്ടു മീനും അല്ലാതെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഇവിടെ ഒന്നു ഇല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish," they answered.
chapters.nkjv: And they said to Him, "We have here only five loaves and two fish."
chapters.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

chapters.ml: “അതു ഇങ്ങുകൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ ” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Bring them here to me," he said.
chapters.nkjv: He said, "Bring them here to Me."
chapters.kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പുരുഷാരം പുല്ലിന്മേൽ ഇരിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു; ആ അഞ്ചു അപ്പവും രണ്ടു മീനും എടുത്തു, സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തേക്കു നോക്കി വാഴ്ത്തി, അപ്പം നുറുക്കി, ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ പക്കലും ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പുരുഷാരത്തിന്നും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And he directed the people to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
chapters.nkjv: Then He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass. And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും തിന്നു തൃപ്തരായി; ശേഷിച്ച കഷണം പന്ത്രണ്ടു കൊട്ട നിറച്ചെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
chapters.nkjv: So they all ate and were filled, and they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments that remained.
chapters.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

chapters.ml: തിന്നവരോ സ്ത്രീകളെയും പൈതങ്ങളെയും കൂടാതെ ഏകദേശം അയ്യായിരം പുരുഷന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The number of those who ate was about five thousand men, besides women and children.
chapters.nkjv: Now those who had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
chapters.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ യേശു താൻ പുരുഷാരത്തെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കുന്നതിന്നിടയിൽ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പടകിൽ കയറി, തനിക്കുമുമ്പായി അക്കരെക്കു പേകുവാൻ അവരെ നിർബന്ധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowd.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go before Him to the other side, while He sent the multitudes away.
chapters.kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചിട്ടു പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പാൻ തനിയെ മലയിൽ കയറിപ്പോയി; വൈകുന്നേരം ആയപ്പോൾ ഏകനായി അവിടെ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After he had dismissed them, he went up on a mountainside by himself to pray. Later that night, he was there alone,
chapters.nkjv: And when He had sent the multitudes away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. Now when evening came, He was alone there.
chapters.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

chapters.ml: പടകോ കരവിട്ടു പലനാഴിക ദൂരത്തായി, കാറ്റു പ്രതികൂലമാകകൊണ്ടു തിരകളാൽ വലഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and the boat was already a considerable distance from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
chapters.nkjv: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, tossed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
chapters.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിലെ നാലാം യാമത്തിൽ അവൻ കടലിന്മേൽ നടന്നു അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Shortly before dawn Jesus went out to them, walking on the lake.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went to them, walking on the sea.
chapters.kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കടലിന്മേൽ നടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഭ്രമിച്ചു: അതു ഒരു ഭൂതം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു പേടിച്ചു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified. "It’s a ghost," they said, and cried out in fear.
chapters.nkjv: And when the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, "It is a ghost!" And they cried out for fear.
chapters.kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ യേശു അവരോടു: “ധൈര്യപ്പെടുവിൻ; ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു; പേടിക്കേണ്ടാ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus immediately said to them: "Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid."
chapters.nkjv: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, "Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid."
chapters.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പത്രൊസ്: കർത്താവേ, നീ ആകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ വെള്ളത്തിന്മേൽ നിന്റെ അടുക്കെ വരേണ്ടതിന്നു കല്പിക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Lord, if it’s you," Peter replied, "tell me to come to you on the water."
chapters.nkjv: And Peter answered Him and said, "Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water."
chapters.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

chapters.ml: “വരിക” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. പത്രൊസ് പടകിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി, യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുവാൻ വെള്ളത്തിന്മേൽ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Come," he said. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: So He said, "Come." And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water to go to Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ കാറ്റു കണ്ടു പേടിച്ചു മുങ്ങിത്തുടങ്ങുകയാൽ: കർത്താവേ, എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, "Lord, save me!"
chapters.nkjv: But when he saw that the wind was boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink he cried out, saying, "Lord, save me!"
chapters.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഉടനെ കൈ നീട്ടി അവനെ പിടിച്ചു: “അല്പവിശ്വാസിയേ, നീ എന്തിന്നു സംശയിച്ചു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Immediately Jesus reached out his hand and caught him. "You of little faith," he said, "why did you doubt?"
chapters.nkjv: And immediately Jesus stretched out His hand and caught him, and said to him, "O you of little faith, why did you doubt?"
chapters.kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

chapters.ml: അവർ പടകിൽ കയറിയപ്പോൾ കാറ്റു അമർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when they climbed into the boat, the wind died down.
chapters.nkjv: And when they got into the boat, the wind ceased.
chapters.kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

chapters.ml: പടകിലുള്ളവർ: നീ ദൈവപുത്രൻ സത്യം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then those who were in the boat worshiped him, saying, "Truly you are the Son of God."
chapters.nkjv: Then those who were in the boat came and worshiped Him, saying, "Truly You are the Son of God."
chapters.kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

chapters.ml: അവർ അക്കരയെത്തി, ഗെന്നേസരെത്തു ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.
chapters.nkjv: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
chapters.kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

chapters.ml: അവിടത്തെ ജനങ്ങൾ അവൻ ആരെന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു ചുറ്റുമുള്ള നാട്ടിൽ എല്ലാം ആളയച്ചു ദീനക്കാരെ ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding country. People brought all their sick to him
chapters.nkjv: And when the men of that place recognized Him, they sent out into all that surrounding region, brought to Him all who were sick,
chapters.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രത്തിന്റെ തൊങ്ങൽ മാത്രം തൊടുവാൻ അനുവാദം ചോദിച്ചു. തൊട്ടവർക്കു ഒക്കെയും സൌഖ്യം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: and begged him to let the sick just touch the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.
chapters.nkjv: and begged Him that they might only touch the hem of His garment. And as many as touched it were made perfectly well.
chapters.kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നു പരീശന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു:
chapters.niv: Then some Pharisees and teachers of the law came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,
chapters.nkjv: Then the scribes and Pharisees who were from Jerusalem came to Jesus, saying,
chapters.kjv: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പൂർവ്വന്മാരുടെ സമ്പ്രദായം ലംഘിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? അവർ ഭക്ഷിക്കുമ്പോൾ കൈ കഴുകുന്നില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: "Why do your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They don’t wash their hands before they eat!"
chapters.nkjv: "Why do Your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands when they eat bread."
chapters.kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “നിങ്ങളുടെ സമ്പ്രദായംകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ ദൈവകല്പന ലംഘിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said to them, "Why do you also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?
chapters.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

chapters.ml: അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും ബഹുമാനിക്ക എന്നും അപ്പനെയോ അമ്മയെയോ ദുഷിക്കുന്നവൻ മരിക്കേണം എന്നും ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’
chapters.nkjv: For God commanded, saying, ‘Honor your father and your mother’; and, ‘He who curses father or mother, let him be put to death.’
chapters.kjv: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ ഒരുത്തൻ അപ്പനോടു എങ്കിലും അമ്മയോടു എങ്കിലും: നിനക്കു എന്നാൽ ഉപകാരമായി വരേണ്ടതു വഴിപാടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ
chapters.niv: But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is ‘devoted to God,’
chapters.nkjv: But you say, ‘Whoever says to his father or mother, "Whatever profit you might have received from me is a gift to God"—
chapters.kjv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

chapters.ml: അവൻ അപ്പനെ ബഹുമാനിക്കേണ്ടാ എന്നു പറയുന്നു; ഇങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ സമ്പ്രദായത്താൽ നിങ്ങൾ ദൈവവചനത്തെ ദുർബ്ബലമാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: they are not to ‘honor their father or mother’ with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
chapters.nkjv: then he need not honor his father or mother.’ Thus you have made the commandment of God of no effect by your tradition.
chapters.kjv: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരേ, നിങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു യെശയ്യാവു:
chapters.niv: You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you:
chapters.nkjv: Hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy about you, saying:
chapters.kjv: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

chapters.ml: “ഈ ജനം അധരം കൊണ്ടു എന്നെ ബഹുമാനിക്കുന്നു; എങ്കിലും അവരുടെ ഹൃദയം എന്നെ വിട്ടു അകന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: " ‘These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.
chapters.nkjv: ‘These people draw near to Me with their mouth, And honor Me withtheir lips, But their heart is far from Me.
chapters.kjv: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

chapters.ml: മാനുഷകല്പനകളായ ഉപദേശങ്ങളെ അവർ പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ വ്യർത്ഥമായി ഭജിക്കുന്നു” എന്നിങ്ങനെ പ്രവചിച്ചതു ഒത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They worship me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And in vain they worship Me, Teachingasdoctrines the commandments of men.’"
chapters.kjv: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തെ അരികെ വിളിച്ചു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “കേട്ടു ഗ്രഹിച്ചു കൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Jesus called the crowd to him and said, "Listen and understand.
chapters.nkjv: When He had called the multitude to Himself, He said to them, "Hear and understand:
chapters.kjv: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യന്നു അശുദ്ധിവരുത്തുന്നതു വായിക്കകത്തു ചെല്ലുന്നതു അല്ല, വായിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുന്നതത്രേ; അതു മനുഷ്യനെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: What goes into someone’s mouth does not defile them, but what comes out of their mouth, that is what defiles them."
chapters.nkjv: Not what goes into the mouth defiles a man; but what comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man."
chapters.kjv: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അടുക്കെ വന്നു: പരീശന്മാർ ഈ വാക്കു കേട്ടു ഇടറിപ്പോയി എന്നു അറിയുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the disciples came to him and asked, "Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?"
chapters.nkjv: Then His disciples came and said to Him, "Do You know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?"
chapters.kjv: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
