chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ എന്റെ പിതാവു നട്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്ത തൈ ഒക്കെയും വേരോടെ പറിഞ്ഞുപോകും.
chapters.niv: He replied, "Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said, "Every plant which My heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted.
chapters.kjv: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

chapters.ml: അവരെ വിടുവിൻ; അവർ കുരുടന്മാരായ വഴികാട്ടികൾ അത്രേ; കുരുടൻ കുരുടനെ വഴിനടത്തിയാൽ ഇരുവരും കുഴിയിൽ വീഴും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Leave them; they are blind guides. If the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit."
chapters.nkjv: Let them alone. They are blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind leads the blind, both will fall into a ditch."
chapters.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: ആ ഉപമ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തെളിയിച്ചുതരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter said, "Explain the parable to us."
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter answered and said to Him, "Explain this parable to us."
chapters.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: “നിങ്ങളും ഇന്നുവരെ ബോധമില്ലാത്തവരോ?
chapters.niv: "Are you still so dull?" Jesus asked them.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus said, "Are you also still without understanding?
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

chapters.ml: വായിക്കകത്തു കടക്കുന്നതു എല്ലാം വയറ്റിൽ ചെന്നിട്ടു മറപ്പുരയിൽ പോകുന്നു എന്നു ഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "Don’t you see that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then out of the body?
chapters.nkjv: Do you not yet understand that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and is eliminated?
chapters.kjv: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

chapters.ml: വായിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുന്നതോ ഹൃദയത്തിൽനിന്നു വരുന്നു; അതു മനുഷ്യനെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the things that come out of a person’s mouth come from the heart, and these defile them.
chapters.nkjv: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come from the heart, and they defile a man.
chapters.kjv: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

chapters.ml: എങ്ങനെയെന്നാൽ ദുശ്ചിന്ത, കുലപാതകം, വ്യഭിചാരം, പരസംഗം, മോഷണം, കള്ളസാക്ഷ്യം, ദൂഷണം എന്നിവ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For out of the heart come evil thoughts—murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.
chapters.nkjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies.
chapters.kjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യനെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കുന്നതു ഇതത്രേ; കഴുകാത്ത കൈകൊണ്ടു ഭക്ഷിക്കുന്നതോ മനുഷ്യനെ അശുദ്ധമാക്കുന്നില്ല.”
chapters.niv: These are what defile a person; but eating with unwashed hands does not defile them."
chapters.nkjv: These are the things which defile a man, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a man."
chapters.kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവിടം വിട്ടു, സോർ സീദോൻ എന്ന പ്രദേശങ്ങളിലേക്കു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus went out from there and departed to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

chapters.ml: ആ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു ഒരു കനാന്യസ്ത്രീ വന്നു, അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, ദാവീദ്പുത്രാ, എന്നോടു കരുണ തോന്നേണമേ; എന്റെ മകൾക്കു ഭൂതോപദ്രവം കഠിനമായിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: A Canaanite woman from that vicinity came to him, crying out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is demon-possessed and suffering terribly."
chapters.nkjv: And behold, a woman of Canaan came from that region and cried out to Him, saying, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David! My daughter is severely demon-possessed."
chapters.kjv: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളോടു ഒരു വാക്കും ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞില്ല; അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അടുക്കെ, വന്നു: അവൾ നമ്മുടെ പിന്നാലെ നിലവിളിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു വരുന്നു; അവളെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കേണമേ എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, "Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us."
chapters.nkjv: But He answered her not a word. And His disciples came and urged Him, saying, "Send her away, for she cries out after us."
chapters.kjv: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “യിസ്രായേൽ ഗൃഹത്തിലെ കാണാതെപോയ ആടുകളുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കല്ലാതെ എന്നെ അയച്ചിട്ടില്ല” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He answered, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel."
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said, "I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."
chapters.kjv: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൾ വന്നു: കർത്താവേ, എന്നെ സഹായിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The woman came and knelt before him. "Lord, help me!" she said.
chapters.nkjv: Then she came and worshiped Him, saying, "Lord, help me!"
chapters.kjv: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

chapters.ml: അവനോ: “മക്കളുടെ അപ്പം എടുത്തു നായകൂട്ടികൾക്കു ഇട്ടുകൊടുക്കുന്നതു നന്നല്ല” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs."
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said, "It is not good to take the children’s bread and throw it to the little dogs."
chapters.kjv: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൾ: അതേ, കർത്താവേ, നായക്കുട്ടികളും ഉടയവരുടെ മേശയിൽ നിന്നു വീഴുന്ന നുറുക്കുകൾ തിന്നുന്നുണ്ടല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Yes it is, Lord," she said. "Even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table."
chapters.nkjv: And she said, "Yes, Lord, yet even the little dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table."
chapters.kjv: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: “സ്ത്രീയേ, നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം വലിയതു; നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംപോലെ നിനക്കു ഭവിക്കട്ടെ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. ആ നാഴികമുതൽ അവളുടെ മകൾക്കു സൌഖ്യം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to her, "Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted." And her daughter was healed at that moment.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus answered and said to her, "O woman, great is your faith! Let it be to you as you desire." And her daughter was healed from that very hour.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവിടെ നിന്നു യാത്രയായി ഗലീലക്കടലരികെ ചെന്നു മലയിൽ കയറി അവിടെ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus departed from there, skirted the Sea of Galilee, and went up on the mountain and sat down there.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

chapters.ml: വളരെ പുരുഷാരം മുടന്തർ, കുരുടർ, ഊമർ, കൂനർ മുതലായ പലരെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വെച്ചു; അവൻ അവരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി;
chapters.niv: Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.
chapters.nkjv: Then great multitudes came to Him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others; and they laid them down at Jesus’ feet, and He healed them.
chapters.kjv: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:

chapters.ml: ഊമർ സംസാരിക്കുന്നതും കൂനർ സൌഖ്യമാകുന്നതും മുടന്തർ നടക്കുന്നതും കുരുടർ കാണുന്നതും പുരുഷാരം കണ്ടിട്ടു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി.
chapters.niv: The people were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So the multitude marveled when they saw the mute speaking, the maimed made whole, the lame walking, and the blind seeing; and they glorified the God of Israel.
chapters.kjv: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യേശു തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ അടുക്കെവിളിച്ചു: “ഈ പുരുഷാരം ഇപ്പോൾ മൂന്നു നാളായി എന്നോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കുന്നു; അവർക്കു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ഒന്നും ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവരെക്കുറിച്ചു എനിക്കു മനസ്സലിവു തോന്നുന്നു; അവരെ പട്ടിണിയായി വിട്ടയപ്പാൻ മനസ്സുമില്ല; അവർ വഴിയിൽവെച്ചു തളർന്നുപോയേക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, "I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way."
chapters.nkjv: Now Jesus called His disciples to Himself and said, "I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now continued with Me three days and have nothing to eat. And I do not want to send them away hungry, lest they faint on the way."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: ഇത്ര വലിയ പുരുഷാരത്തിന്നു തൃപ്തിവരുത്തുവാൻ മതിയായ അപ്പം ഈ കാട്ടിൽ നമുക്കു എവിടെ നിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His disciples answered, "Where could we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a crowd?"
chapters.nkjv: Then His disciples said to Him, "Where could we get enough bread in the wilderness to fill such a great multitude?"
chapters.kjv: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങളുടെ പക്കൽ എത്ര അപ്പം ഉണ്ടു” എന്നു യേശു ചോദിച്ചു; ഏഴു; കുറെ ചെറുമീനും ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "How many loaves do you have?" Jesus asked. "Seven," they replied, "and a few small fish."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "How many loaves do you have?" And they said, "Seven, and a few little fish."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തോടു നിലത്തു ഇരിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
chapters.nkjv: So He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

chapters.ml: ആ ഏഴു അപ്പവും മീനും എടുത്തു വാഴ്ത്തി നുറുക്കി ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ പക്കലും ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പുരുഷാരത്തിന്നും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.
chapters.nkjv: And He took the seven loaves and the fish and gave thanks, broke them and gave them to His disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitude.
chapters.kjv: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them , and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും തിന്നു തൃപ്തരായി; ശേഷിച്ച കഷണം അവർ ഏഴു വട്ടി നിറെച്ചെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
chapters.nkjv: So they all ate and were filled, and they took up seven large baskets full of the fragments that were left.
chapters.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

chapters.ml: തിന്നവരോ സ്ത്രീകളെയും പൈതങ്ങളെയും കൂടാതെ നാലായിരം പുരുഷന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The number of those who ate was four thousand men, besides women and children.
chapters.nkjv: Now those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.
chapters.kjv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പുരുഷാരത്തെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചിട്ടു പടകിൽ കയറി മഗദാദേശത്തു എത്തി.
chapters.niv: After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.
chapters.nkjv: And He sent away the multitude, got into the boat, and came to the region of Magdala.
chapters.kjv: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം പരീശന്മാരും സദൂക്യരും അടുക്കെ വന്നു: ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു ഒരു അടയാളം കാണിച്ചുതരേണമെന്നു അവനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing Him asked that He would show them a sign from heaven.
chapters.kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “സന്ധ്യാസമയത്തു ആകാശം ചുവന്നുകണ്ടാൽ നല്ല തെളിവാകും എന്നും
chapters.niv: He replied, "When evening comes, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,’
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said to them, "When it is evening you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red’;
chapters.kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ ആകാശം മൂടി ചുവന്നുകണ്ടാൽ ഇന്നു മഴക്കോൾ ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നും നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നു. ആകാശത്തിന്റെ ഭാവം വിവേചിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു; എന്നാൽ കാല ലക്ഷണങ്ങളെ വിവേചിപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.
chapters.nkjv: and in the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the face of the sky, but you cannot discern the signs of the times.
chapters.kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

chapters.ml: ദോഷവും വ്യഭിചാരവുമുള്ള തലമുറ അടയാളം തിരയുന്നു; യോനയുടെ അടയാള മല്ലാതെ അതിന്നു അടയാളം ലഭിക്കയില്ല;” പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരെ വിട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah." Jesus then left them and went away.
chapters.nkjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and no sign shall be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah." And He left them and departed.
chapters.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അക്കരെ പോകുമ്പോൾ അപ്പം എടുപ്പാൻ മറന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When they went across the lake, the disciples forgot to take bread.
chapters.nkjv: Now when His disciples had come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
chapters.kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യേശു അവരോടു: “നോക്കുവിൻ പരീശന്മാരുടെയും സദൂക്യരുടെയും പുളിച്ച മാവു സൂക്ഷിച്ചു കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.”
chapters.niv: "Be careful," Jesus said to them. "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the Sadducees."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

chapters.ml: അപ്പം കൊണ്ടുപോരായ്കയാൽ ആയിരിക്കും എന്നു അവർ തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They discussed this among themselves and said, "It is because we didn’t bring any bread."
chapters.nkjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "Itis because we have taken no bread."
chapters.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

chapters.ml: അതു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു യേശു പറഞ്ഞതു: അല്പവിശ്വാസികളേ, അപ്പം കൊണ്ടുവരായ്കയാൽ തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറയുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, "You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus, being aware of it, said to them, "O you of little faith, why do you reason among yourselves because you have brought no bread?
chapters.kjv: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴും നിങ്ങൾ തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നില്ലയോ? അയ്യായിരം പേർക്കു അഞ്ചു അപ്പം കൊടുത്തിട്ടു എത്ര കൊട്ട എടുത്തു എന്നും
chapters.niv: Do you still not understand? Don’t you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
chapters.nkjv: Do you not yet understand, or remember the five loaves of the five thousand and how many baskets you took up?
chapters.kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

chapters.ml: നാലായിരം പേർക്കു ഏഴു അപ്പം കൊടുത്തിട്ടു എത്ര വട്ടി എടുത്തു എന്നും ഓർക്കുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
chapters.nkjv: Nor the seven loaves of the four thousand and how many large baskets you took up?
chapters.kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരുടെയും സദൂക്യരുടെയും പുളിച്ച മാവു സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊള്ളേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു അപ്പത്തെക്കുറിച്ചല്ല എന്നു തിരിച്ചറിയാത്തതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: How is it you don’t understand that I was not talking to you about bread? But be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
chapters.nkjv: How is it you do not understand that I did not speak to you concerning bread?—but to beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
chapters.kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അപ്പത്തിന്റെ പുളിച്ച മാവല്ല, പരീശന്മാരുടെയും സദൂക്യരുടെയും ഉപദേശമത്രേ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവാൻ ” അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു അവർ ഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
chapters.nkjv: Then they understood that He did not tell them to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
chapters.kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഫിലിപ്പിന്റെ കൈസര്യയുടെ പ്രദേശത്തു എത്തിയശേഷം തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: “ജനങ്ങൾ മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെ ആർ എന്നു പറയുന്നു?” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say the Son of Man is?"
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, He asked His disciples, saying, "Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?"
chapters.kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

chapters.ml: ചിലർ യോഹന്നാൻ സ്നാപകൻ എന്നും മറ്റു ചിലർ ഏലീയാവെന്നും വേറെ ചിലർ യിരെമ്യാവോ പ്രവാചകന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനോ എന്നും പറയുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
chapters.nkjv: So they said, "Some say John the Baptist, some Elijah, and others Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങളോ എന്നെ ആർ എന്നു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ്:
chapters.niv: "But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?"
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?"
chapters.kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

chapters.ml: നീ ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുത്രനായ ക്രിസ്തുഎന്നും ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God."
chapters.nkjv: Simon Peter answered and said, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
chapters.kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “ബർയോനാശിമോനെ, നീ ഭാഗ്യവാൻ; ജഡരക്തങ്ങൾ അല്ല, സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ എന്റെ പിതാവത്രെ നിനക്കു ഇതു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിയതു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by my Father in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but My Father who is in heaven.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

chapters.ml: നീ പത്രൊസ് ആകുന്നു; ഈ പാറമേൽ ഞാൻ എന്റെ സഭയെ പണിയും; പാതാളഗോപുരങ്ങൾ അതിനെ ജയിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.
chapters.nkjv: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.
chapters.kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യത്തിന്റെ താക്കോൽ ഞാൻ നിനക്കു തരുന്നു; നീ ഭൂമിയിൽ കെട്ടുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ കെട്ടപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കും; നീ ഭൂമിയിൽ അഴിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ അഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കും” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."
chapters.nkjv: And I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."
chapters.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ താൻ ക്രിസ്തു ആകുന്നു എന്നു ആരോടും പറയാതിരിപ്പാൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he ordered his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: Then He commanded His disciples that they should tell no one that He was Jesus the Christ.
chapters.kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

chapters.ml: അന്നു മുതൽ യേശു താൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ ചെന്നിട്ടു, മൂപ്പന്മാർ, മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ, ശാസ്ത്രിമാർ എന്നിവരാൽ പലതും സഹിച്ചു കൊല്ലപ്പെടുകയും മൂന്നാം നാൾ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കയും വേണ്ടതു എന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
chapters.nkjv: From that time Jesus began to show to His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem, and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day.
chapters.kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവനെ വേറിട്ടു കൊണ്ടുപോയി: കർത്താവേ, അതു അരുതേ; നിനക്കു അങ്ങനെ ഭവിക്കരുതേ എന്നു ശാസിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. "Never, Lord!" he said. "This shall never happen to you!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, saying, "Far be it from You, Lord; this shall not happen to You!"
chapters.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

chapters.ml: അവനോ തിരിഞ്ഞു പത്രൊസിനോടു; “സാത്താനേ, എന്നെ വിട്ടുപോ; നീ എനിക്കു ഇടർച്ചയാകുന്നു; നീ ദൈവത്തിന്റേതല്ല മനുഷ്യരുടേതത്രെ കരുതുന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus turned and said to Peter, "Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns."
chapters.nkjv: But He turned and said to Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan! You are an offense to Me, for you are not mindful of the things of God, but the things of men."
chapters.kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യേശു ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഒരുത്തൻ എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചാൽ തന്നെത്താൻ ത്യജിച്ചു, തന്റെ ക്രൂശു എടുത്തു എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to His disciples, "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും തന്റെ ജീവനെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചാൽ അതിനെ കളയും; എന്റെ നിമിത്തം ആരെങ്കിലും തന്റെ ജീവനെ കളഞ്ഞാൽ അതിനെ കണ്ടെത്തും.
chapters.niv: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will find it.
chapters.nkjv: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
chapters.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

chapters.ml: ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ സർവ്വലോകവും നേടീട്ടും തന്റെ ജീവനെ നഷ്ടപ്പെടുത്തിയാൽ അവന്നു എന്തു പ്രയോജനം? അല്ല, തന്റെ ജീവനെ വീണ്ടുകൊൾവാൻ മനുഷ്യൻ എന്തു മറുവില കൊടുക്കും?
chapters.niv: What good will it be for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?
chapters.nkjv: For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul? Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?
chapters.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യ പുത്രൻ തന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ മഹത്വത്തിൽ തന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരുമായി വരും; അപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഓരോരുത്തന്നും അവനവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം പകരം നല്കും.
chapters.niv: For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father’s glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what they have done.
chapters.nkjv: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He will reward each according to his works.
chapters.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ തന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിൽ വരുന്നതു കാണുവോളം മരണം ആസ്വദിക്കാത്തവർ ചിലർ ഈ നില്ക്കുന്നവരിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom."
chapters.nkjv: "Assuredly, I say to you, there are some standing here who shall not taste death till they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom."
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

chapters.ml: ആറു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം യേശു പത്രൊസിനെയും യാക്കോബിനെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യോഹന്നാനെയും കൂട്ടി തനിച്ചു ഒരു ഉയർന്ന മലയിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി,.
chapters.niv: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
chapters.nkjv: Now after six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John his brother, led them up on a high mountain by themselves;
chapters.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ മുമ്പാകെ രൂപാന്തരപ്പെട്ടു, അവന്റെ മുഖം സൂര്യനെപ്പോലെ ശോഭിച്ചു അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം വെളിച്ചം പോലെ വെള്ളയായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.
chapters.nkjv: and He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
chapters.kjv: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

chapters.ml: മോശെയും ഏലിയാവും അവനോടു സംഭാഷിക്കുന്നതായി അവർ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Him.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് യേശുവിനോടു: കർത്താവേ, നാം ഇവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു നന്നു; നിനക്കു സമ്മതമെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ ഇവിടെ മൂന്നു കുടിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കാം ഒന്നു നിനക്കും ഒന്നു മോശെക്കും ഒന്നു ഏലീയാവിന്നും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter answered and said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here; if You wish, let us make here three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
chapters.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പറയുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ പ്രകാശമുള്ളോരു മേഘം അവരുടെ മേൽ നിഴലിട്ടു; മേഘത്തിൽ നിന്നു: ഇവൻ എന്റെ പ്രീയ പുത്രൻ, ഇവങ്കൽ ഞാൻ പ്രസാദിക്കുന്നു; ഇവന്നു ചെവികൊടുപ്പിൻ എന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദവും ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud covered them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!"
chapters.nkjv: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them; and suddenly a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Hear Him!"
chapters.kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു കവിണ്ണുവീണു.
chapters.niv: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.
chapters.nkjv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces and were greatly afraid.
chapters.kjv: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

chapters.ml: യേശു അടുത്തു ചെന്നു അവരെ തൊട്ടു: “എഴുന്നേല്പിൻ, ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus came and touched them. "Get up," he said. "Don’t be afraid."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus came and touched them and said, "Arise, and do not be afraid."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

chapters.ml: അവർ തലപൊക്കിയാറെ യേശുവിനെ മാത്രമല്ലാതെ ആരെയും കണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: When they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no one but Jesus only.
chapters.kjv: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മലയിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ യേശു അവരോടു: “മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കുംവരെ ഈ ദർശനം ആരോടും പറയരുതു” എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, "Don’t tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead."
chapters.nkjv: Now as they came down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, "Tell the vision to no one until the Son of Man is risen from the dead."
chapters.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: എന്നാൽ ഏലീയാവു മുമ്പെ വരേണ്ടതു എന്നു ശാസ്ത്രിമാർ പറയുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The disciples asked him, "Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"
chapters.nkjv: And His disciples asked Him, saying, "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
chapters.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “ഏലീയാവു വന്നു സകലവും യഥാസ്ഥാനത്താക്കും സത്യം.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "To be sure, Elijah comes and will restore all things.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Indeed, Elijah is coming first and will restore all things.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏലീയാവു വന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞു എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു; എങ്കിലും അവർ അവനെ അറിഞ്ഞുകൊള്ളാതെ തങ്ങൾക്കു തോന്നിയതു എല്ലാം അവനോടു ചെയ്തു. അവ്വണ്ണം മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്നും അവരാൽ കഷ്ടപ്പെടുവാനുണ്ടു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him everything they wished. In the same way the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands."
chapters.nkjv: But I say to you that Elijah has come already, and they did not know him but did to him whatever they wished. Likewise the Son of Man is also about to suffer at their hands."
chapters.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോഹന്നാൻ സ്നാപകനെക്കുറിച്ചു തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the disciples understood that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.
chapters.nkjv: Then the disciples understood that He spoke to them of John the Baptist.
chapters.kjv: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുരുഷാരത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നാറെ ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ വന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ മുട്ടുകുത്തി:
chapters.niv: When they came to the crowd, a man approached Jesus and knelt before him.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had come to the multitude, a man came to Him, kneeling down to Him and saying,
chapters.kjv: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, എന്റെ മകനോടു കരുണയുണ്ടാകേണമേ; അവൻ ചന്ദ്രരോഗം പിടിച്ചു പലപ്പോഴും തീയിലും പലപ്പോഴും വെള്ളത്തിലും വീണു വല്ലാത്ത കഷ്ടത്തിലായ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Lord, have mercy on my son," he said. "He has seizures and is suffering greatly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
chapters.nkjv: "Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is an epileptic and suffers severely; for he often falls into the fire and often into the water.
chapters.kjv: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവനെ നിന്റെ ശീഷ്യന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; എന്നാൽ സൌഖ്യം വരുത്തുവാൻ അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him."
chapters.nkjv: So I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not cure him."
chapters.kjv: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “അവിശ്വാസവും കോട്ടവുമുള്ള തലമുറയേ, എത്രത്തോളം ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ ഇരിക്കും? എത്രത്തോളം നിങ്ങളെ സഹിക്കും? അവനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞഞു.
chapters.niv: "You unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy here to me."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus answered and said, "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him here to Me."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഭൂതത്തെ ശാസിച്ചു, അതു അവനെ വിട്ടുപോയി, ബാലന്നു ആ നാഴികമുതൽ സൌഖ്യംവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed at that moment.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of him; and the child was cured from that very hour.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ സ്വകാര്യമായി യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അതിനെ പുറത്താക്കിക്കൂടാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and asked, "Why couldn’t we drive it out?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately and said, "Why could we not cast it out?"
chapters.kjv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങളുടെ അല്പവിശ്വാസം നിമിത്തമത്രേ;
chapters.niv: He replied, "Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you."
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus said to them, "Because of your unbelief; for assuredly, I say to you, if you have faith as a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങൾക്കു കടുകുമണിയോളം വിശ്വാസമുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഈ മലയോടു: ഇവിടെ നിന്നു അങ്ങോട്ടു നീങ്ങുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അതു നീങ്ങും; നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഒന്നും അസാദ്ധ്യമാകയുമില്ല. (എങ്കിലും പ്രാർത്ഥനയാലും ഉപവാസത്താലുമല്ലാതെ ഈ ജാതി നീങ്ങിപ്പോകുന്നില്ല) എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they came together in Galilee, he said to them, "The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men.
chapters.nkjv: However, this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting."
chapters.kjv: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഗലീലയിൽ സഞ്ചരിക്കുമ്പോൾ യേശു അവരോടു: “മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മനുഷ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കപ്പെടുവാറായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised to life." And the disciples were filled with grief.
chapters.nkjv: Now while they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men,
chapters.kjv: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ കൊല്ലുകയും മൂന്നാം നാൾ അവൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കയും ചെയ്യും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവരോ ഏറ്റവും ദുഃഖിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Jesus and his disciples arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma temple tax came to Peter and asked, "Doesn’t your teacher pay the temple tax?"
chapters.nkjv: and they will kill Him, and the third day He will be raised up." And they were exceedingly sorrowful.
chapters.kjv: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

chapters.ml: അവർ കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ എത്തിയാറെ ദ്വിദ്രഹ്മപ്പണം വാങ്ങുന്നവർ പത്രൊസിന്റെ അടക്കൽ വന്നു: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഗുരു ദ്വിദ്രഹ്മപ്പണം കൊടുക്കുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഉവ്വു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Yes, he does," he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. "What do you think, Simon?" he asked. "From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes—from their own children or from others?"
chapters.nkjv: When they had come to Capernaum, those who received the temple tax came to Peter and said, "Does your Teacher not pay the temple tax?"
chapters.kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

chapters.ml: അവൻ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ യേശു അവനോടു: “ശിമോനേ, നിനക്കു എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു? ഭൂമിയിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാർ ചുങ്കമോ കരമോ ആരോടു വാങ്ങുന്നു? പുത്രന്മാരോടോ അന്യരോടോ” എന്നു മുന്നിട്ടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അന്യരോടു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "From others," Peter answered. "Then the children are exempt," Jesus said to him.
chapters.nkjv: He said, "Yes." And when he had come into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, "What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth take customs or taxes, from their sons or from strangers?"
chapters.kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “എന്നാൽ പുത്രന്മാർ ഒഴിവുള്ളവരല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "But so that we may not cause offense, go to the lake and throw out your line. Take the first fish you catch; open its mouth and you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for my tax and yours."
chapters.nkjv: Peter said to Him, "From strangers." Jesus said to him, "Then the sons are free.
chapters.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നാം അവർക്കു ഇടർച്ച വരുത്താതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ കടലീലേക്കു ചെന്നു ചൂണ്ടൽ ഇട്ടു ആദ്യം കിട്ടുന്ന മീനിനെ എടുക്ക; അതിന്റെ വായ് തുറക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒരു ചതുർദ്രഹ്മപ്പണം കാണും; അതു എടുത്തു എനിക്കും നിനക്കും വേണ്ടി കൊടുക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless, lest we offend them, go to the sea, cast in a hook, and take the fish that comes up first. And when you have opened its mouth, you will find a piece of money; take that and give it to them for Me and you."
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

chapters.ml: ആ നാഴികയിൽ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കെ വന്നു. സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യത്തിൽ ഏറ്റവും വലിയവൻ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Who, then, is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"
chapters.nkjv: At that time the disciples came to Jesus, saying, "Who then is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"
chapters.kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു ശിശുവിനെ അടുക്കെ വിളിച്ചു അവരുടെ നടുവിൽ നിറുത്തി;
chapters.niv: He called a little child to him, and placed the child among them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus called a little child to Him, set him in the midst of them,
chapters.kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങൾ തിരിഞ്ഞു ശിശുക്കളെപ്പോലെ ആയ്‍വരുന്നില്ല എങ്കിൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he said: "Truly I tell you, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.nkjv: and said, "Assuredly, I say to you, unless you are converted and become as little children, you will by no means enter the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഈ ശിശുവിനെപ്പോലെ തന്നെത്താൻ താഴ്ത്തുന്നവൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യത്തിൽ ഏറ്റവും വലിയവൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore, whoever takes the lowly position of this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore whoever humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങിനെയുള്ള ശിശുവിനെ എന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ കൈകൊള്ളുന്നവൻ എന്നെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And whoever welcomes one such child in my name welcomes me.
chapters.nkjv: Whoever receives one little child like this in My name receives Me.
chapters.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

chapters.ml: എന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഈ ചെറിയവരിൽ ഒരുത്തന്നു ആരെങ്കിലും ഇടർച്ച വരുത്തിയാലോ അവന്റെ കഴുത്തിൽ വലിയോരു തിരിക്കല്ലു കെട്ടി അവനെ സമുദ്രത്തിന്റെ ആഴത്തിൽ താഴ്ത്തിക്കളയുന്നതു അവന്നു നന്നു.
chapters.niv: "If anyone causes one of these little ones—those who believe in me—to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
chapters.nkjv: "Whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to sin, it would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
chapters.kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

chapters.ml: ഇടർച്ച ഹേതുവായി ലോകത്തിന്നു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; ഇടർച്ച വരുന്നതു ആവശ്യം തന്നേ; എങ്കിലും ഇടർച്ച വരുത്തുന്ന മനുഷ്യന്നു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം.
chapters.niv: Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to stumble! Such things must come, but woe to the person through whom they come!
chapters.nkjv: Woe to the world because of offenses! For offenses must come, but woe to that man by whom the offense comes!
chapters.kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കയ്യോ കാലോ നിനക്കു ഇടർച്ച ആയാൽ അതിനെ വെട്ടി എറിഞ്ഞുകളക; രണ്ടു കയ്യും രണ്ടു കാലും ഉള്ളവനായി നിത്യാഗ്നിയിൽ വീഴുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ അംഗഹീനനായിട്ടോ മുടന്തനായിട്ടോ ജീവനിൽ കടക്കുന്നതു നിനക്കു നന്നു.
chapters.niv: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life maimed or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into eternal fire.
chapters.nkjv: "If your hand or foot causes you to sin, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life lame or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet, to be cast into the everlasting fire.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കണ്ണു നിനക്കു ഇടർച്ച ആയാൽ അതിനെ ചൂന്നെടുത്തു എറിഞ്ഞുകളക; രണ്ടു കണ്ണുള്ളവനായി അഗ്നിനരകത്തിൽ വീഴുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ ഒറ്റക്കണ്ണനായി ജീവനിൽ കടക്കുന്നതു നിനക്കു നന്നു.
chapters.niv: And if your eye causes you to stumble, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
chapters.nkjv: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes, to be cast into hell fire.
chapters.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

chapters.ml: ഈ ചെറിയവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെ തുച്ഛീകരിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "See that you do not despise one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: "Take heed that you do not despise one of these little ones, for I say to you that in heaven their angels always see the face of My Father who is in heaven.
chapters.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ അവരുടെ ദൂതന്മാർ സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ മുഖം എപ്പോഴും കാണുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "What do you think? If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?
chapters.nkjv: For the Son of Man has come to save that which was lost.
chapters.kjv: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു? ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്നു നൂറു ആടു ഉണ്ടു എന്നിരിക്കട്ടെ; അവയിൽ ഒന്നു തെറ്റി ഉഴന്നുപോയാൽ തൊണ്ണൂറ്റൊമ്പതിനെയും വിട്ടേച്ചു തെറ്റിപ്പോയതിനെ മലകളിൽ ചെന്നു തിരയുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he is happier about that one sheep than about the ninety-nine that did not wander off.
chapters.nkjv: "What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, does he not leave the ninety-nine and go to the mountains to seek the one that is straying?
chapters.kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

chapters.ml: അതിനെ കണ്ടെത്തിയാൽ തെറ്റിപ്പോകാത്ത തൊണ്ണൂറ്റമ്പതിലും അധികം അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു സന്തോഷിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
chapters.nkjv: And if he should find it, assuredly, I say to you, he rejoices more over that sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
chapters.kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെതന്നേ ഈ ചെറിയവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ നശിച്ചുപോകുന്നതു സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവിന്നു ഇഷ്ടമല്ല.
chapters.niv: "If your brother or sister sins, go and point out their fault, just between the two of you. If they listen to you, you have won them over.
chapters.nkjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
chapters.kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സഹോദരൻ നിന്നോടു പിഴെച്ചാൽ നീ ചെന്നു നീയും അവനും മാത്രം ഉള്ളപ്പോൾ കുറ്റം അവന്നു ബോധം വരുത്തുക; അവൻ നിന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടാൽ നീ സഹോദരനെ നേടി.
chapters.niv: But if they will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
chapters.nkjv: "Moreover if your brother sins against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone. If he hears you, you have gained your brother.
chapters.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

chapters.ml: കേൾക്കാഞ്ഞാലോ രണ്ടു മൂന്നു സാക്ഷികളുടെ വായാൽ സകല കാര്യവും ഉറപ്പാകേണ്ടതിന്നു ഒന്നു രണ്ടു പേരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ചെല്ലുക.
chapters.niv: If they still refuse to listen, tell it to the church; and if they refuse to listen even to the church, treat them as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
chapters.nkjv: But if he will not hear, take with you one or two more, that ‘by the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.’
chapters.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

chapters.ml: അവരെ കൂട്ടാക്കാഞ്ഞാൽ സഭയോടു അറിയിക്ക; സഭയെയും കൂട്ടാക്കാഞ്ഞാൽ അവൻ നിനക്കു പുറജാതിക്കാരനും ചുങ്കക്കാരനും എന്നപോലെ ഇരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: And if he refuses to hear them, tell it to the church. But if he refuses even to hear the church, let him be to you like a heathen and a tax collector.
chapters.kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഭൂമിയിൽ കെട്ടുന്നതെല്ലാം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലും കെട്ടപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കും; നിങ്ങൾ ഭൂമിയിൽ അഴിക്കുന്നതെല്ലാം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലും അഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Again, truly I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask for, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: "Assuredly, I say to you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു നിങ്ങളിൽ രണ്ടുപേർ യാചിക്കുന്ന ഏതു കാര്യത്തിലും ഐകമത്യപ്പെട്ടാൽ അതു സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ എന്റെ പിതാവിങ്കൽ നിന്നു അവർക്കു ലഭിക്കും;
chapters.niv: For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them."
chapters.nkjv: "Again I say to you that if two of you agree on earth concerning anything that they ask, it will be done for them by My Father in heaven.
chapters.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടോ മൂന്നോ പേർ എന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ കൂടിവരുന്നേടത്തൊക്കയും ഞാൻ അവരുടെ നടുവിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother or sister who sins against me? Up to seven times?"
chapters.nkjv: For where two or three are gathered together in My name, I am there in the midst of them."
chapters.kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: കർത്താവേ, സഹോദരൻ എത്രവട്ടം എന്നോടു പിഴെച്ചാൽ ഞാൻ ക്ഷമിക്കേണം?
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter came to Him and said, "Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Up to seven times?"
chapters.kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

chapters.ml: ഏഴുവട്ടം മതിയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. യേശു അവനോടു: “ഏഴുവട്ടമല്ല, എഴു എഴുപതു വട്ടം എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "I do not say to you, up to seven times, but up to seventy times seven.
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

chapters.ml: “സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുമായി കണക്കു തീർപ്പാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്ന ഒരു രാജാവിനോടു സദൃശം.
chapters.niv: As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand bags of gold was brought to him.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the kingdom of heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
chapters.kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കണക്കു നോക്കിത്തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ പതിനായിരം താലന്തു കടമ്പെട്ട ഒരുത്തനെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Since he was not able to pay, the master ordered that he and his wife and his children and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.
chapters.nkjv: And when he had begun to settle accounts, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
chapters.kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു വീട്ടുവാൻ വകയില്ലായ്കയാൽ അവന്റെ യജമാനൻ അവനെയും ഭാര്യയെയും മക്കളെയും അവന്നുള്ളതൊക്കെയും വിറ്റു കടം തീർപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "At this the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Be patient with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
chapters.nkjv: But as he was not able to pay, his master commanded that he be sold, with his wife and children and all that he had, and that payment be made.
chapters.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

chapters.ml: അതു കൊണ്ടു ആ ദാസൻ വീണു അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു: യജമാനനേ എന്നോടു ക്ഷമ തോന്നേണമേ; ഞാൻ സകലവും തന്നു തീർക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The servant’s master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.
chapters.nkjv: The servant therefore fell down before him, saying, ‘Master, have patience with me, and I will pay you all.’
chapters.kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ആ ദാസന്റെ യജമാനൻ മനസ്സലിഞ്ഞു അവനെ വിട്ടയച്ചു കടവും ഇളെച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred silver coins. He grabbed him and began to choke him. ‘Pay back what you owe me!’ he demanded.
chapters.nkjv: Then the master of that servant was moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.
chapters.kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

chapters.ml: ആ ദാസൻ പോകുമ്പോൾ തനിക്കു നൂറു വെള്ളിക്കാശു കടമ്പെട്ട ഒരു കൂട്ടുദാസനെ കണ്ടു തൊണ്ടെക്കു പിടിച്ചു ഞെക്കി: നിന്റെ കടം തീർക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "His fellow servant fell to his knees and begged him, ‘Be patient with me, and I will pay it back.’
chapters.nkjv: "But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii; and he laid hands on him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
chapters.kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കൂട്ടുദാസൻ: എന്നോടു ക്ഷമ തോന്നേണമേ; ഞാൻ തന്നു തീർക്കാം എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ച.
chapters.niv: "But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.
chapters.nkjv: So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.’
chapters.kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ ഉടനെ ചെന്നു കടം വീട്ടുവോളം അവനെ തടവിൽ ആക്കിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were outraged and went and told their master everything that had happened.
chapters.nkjv: And he would not, but went and threw him into prison till he should pay the debt.
chapters.kjv: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

chapters.ml: ഈ സംഭവിച്ചതു അവന്റെ കൂട്ടുദാസന്മാർ കണ്ടിട്ടു വളരെ ദുഃഖിച്ചു, ചെന്നു സംഭവിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും യജമാനനെ ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Then the master called the servant in. ‘You wicked servant,’ he said, ‘I canceled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.
chapters.nkjv: So when his fellow servants saw what had been done, they were very grieved, and came and told their master all that had been done.
chapters.kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ അവനെ വിളിച്ചു: ദുഷ്ടദാസനേ, നീ എന്നോടു അപേക്ഷിക്കയാൽ ഞാൻ ആ കടം ഒക്കെയും ഇളെച്ചുതന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?’
chapters.nkjv: Then his master, after he had called him, said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
chapters.kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു നിന്നോടു കരുണ തോന്നിയതുപോലെ നിനക്കും കൂട്ടുദാസനോടു കരുണ തോന്നേണ്ടതല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: In anger his master handed him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should pay back all he owed.
chapters.nkjv: Should you not also have had compassion on your fellow servant, just as I had pity on you?’
chapters.kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യജമാനൻ കോപിച്ചു, അവൻ കടമൊക്കെയും തീർക്കുവോളം അവനെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കുന്നവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു
chapters.niv: "This is how my heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother or sister from your heart."
chapters.nkjv: And his master was angry, and delivered him to the torturers until he should pay all that was due to him.
chapters.kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഓരോരുത്തൻ സഹോദരനോടു ഹൃദയപൂർവ്വം ക്ഷമിക്കാഞ്ഞാൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ എന്റെ പിതാവു അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ നിങ്ങളോടും ചെയ്യും.”
chapters.nkjv: "So My heavenly Father also will do to you if each of you, from his heart, does not forgive his brother his trespasses."
chapters.kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

chapters.ml: ഈ വചനങ്ങളെ പറഞ്ഞു തീർന്നിട്ടു യേശു ഗലീല വിട്ടു,
chapters.niv: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went into the region of Judea to the other side of the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these sayings, that He departed from Galilee and came to the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

chapters.ml: യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ യെഹൂദ്യദേശത്തിന്റെ അതിരോളം ചെന്നു, വളരെ പുരുഷാരം അവനെ പിൻചെന്നു: അവൻ അവിടെവെച്ചു അവരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
chapters.nkjv: And great multitudes followed Him, and He healed them there.
chapters.kjv: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: ഏതു കാരണം ചൊല്ലിയും ഭാര്യയെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നതു വിഹിതമോ എന്നു അവനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചുചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?"
chapters.nkjv: The Pharisees also came to Him, testing Him, and saying to Him, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?"
chapters.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “സൃഷ്ടിച്ചവൻ ആദിയിൽ അവരെ ആണും പെണ്ണുമായി സൃഷ്ടിച്ചു എന്നും
chapters.niv: "Haven’t you read," he replied, "that at the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
chapters.nkjv: And He answered and said to them, "Have you not read that He who madethem at the beginning ‘made them male and female,’
chapters.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

chapters.ml: അതു നിമിത്തം മനുഷ്യൻ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും വിട്ടു ഭാര്യയോടു പറ്റിച്ചേരും; ഇരുവരും ഒരു ദേഹമായി തീരും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു എന്നും നിങ്ങൾ വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’ ?
chapters.nkjv: and said, ‘For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh’?
chapters.kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ മേലാൽ രണ്ടല്ല, ഒരു ദേഹമത്രേ; ആകയാൽ ദൈവം യോജിപ്പിച്ചതിനെ മനുഷ്യൻ വേർപിരിക്കരുതു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate."
chapters.nkjv: So then, they are no longer two but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let not man separate."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: എന്നാൽ ഉപേക്ഷണപത്രം കൊടുത്തിട്ടു അവളെ ഉപേക്ഷിപ്പാൻ മോശെ കല്പിച്ചതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Why then," they asked, "did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?"
chapters.nkjv: They said to Him, "Why then did Moses command to give a certificate of divorce, and to put her away?"
chapters.kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയകാഠിന്യം നിമിത്തമത്രെ ഭാര്യമാരെ ഉപേക്ഷിപ്പാൻ മോശെ അനുവദിച്ചതു; ആദിയിൽ അങ്ങനെയല്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not this way from the beginning.
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, permitted you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it was not so.
chapters.kjv: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നതു: പരസംഗം നിമിത്തമല്ലാതെ ഭാര്യയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു മറ്റൊരുത്തിയെ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കുന്നവൻ വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഉപേക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ടവളെ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കുന്നവനും വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്യുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery."
chapters.nkjv: And I say to you, whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and whoever marries her who is divorced commits adultery."
chapters.kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: സ്ത്രീയെ സംബന്ധിച്ചു മനുഷ്യന്റെ അവസ്ഥ ഇങ്ങനെ എങ്കിൽ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കുന്നതു നന്നല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The disciples said to him, "If this is the situation between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry."
chapters.nkjv: His disciples said to Him, "If such is the case of the man with his wife, it is better not to marry."
chapters.kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “വരം ലഭിച്ചവർ അല്ലാതെ എല്ലാവരും ഈ വചനം ഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "All cannot accept this saying, but only those to whom it has been given:
chapters.kjv: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

chapters.ml: അമ്മയുടെ ഗർഭത്തിൽനിന്നു ഷണ്ഡന്മാരായി ജനിച്ചവർ ഉണ്ടു; മനുഷ്യർ ഷണ്ഡന്മാരാക്കിയ ഷണ്ഡന്മാരും ഉണ്ടു; സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യംനിമിത്തം തങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ ഷണ്ഡന്മാരാക്കിയ ഷണ്ഡന്മാരും ഉണ്ടു; ഗ്രഹിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നവൻ ഗ്രഹിക്കട്ടെ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For there are eunuchs who were born that way, and there are eunuchs who have been made eunuchs by others—and there are those who choose to live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it."
chapters.nkjv: For there are eunuchs who were born thus from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men, and there are eunuchs who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He who is able to accept it, let him accept it."
chapters.kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it , let him receive it.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കൈവെച്ചു പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ചിലർ ശിശുക്കളെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവരെ വിലക്കി.
chapters.niv: Then people brought little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples rebuked them.
chapters.nkjv: Then little children were brought to Him that He might put His hands on them and pray, but the disciples rebuked them.
chapters.kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ: “ശിശുക്കളെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ വിടുവിൻ; അവരെ തടുക്കരുതു; സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ളവരുടേതല്ലോ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said, "Let the little children come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of heaven."
chapters.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അവരുടെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചു പിന്നെ അവിടെ നിന്നു യാത്രയായി.
chapters.niv: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.
chapters.nkjv: And He laid His hands on them and departed from there.
chapters.kjv: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഒരുത്തൻ വന്നു അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, നിത്യജീവനെ പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ എന്തു നന്മ ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു
chapters.niv: Just then a man came up to Jesus and asked, "Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?"
chapters.nkjv: Now behold, one came and said to Him, "Good Teacher, what good thing shall I do that I may have eternal life?"
chapters.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

chapters.ml: അവൻ: “എന്നോടു നന്മയെക്കുറിച്ചു ചോദിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? നല്ലവൻ ഒരുത്തനേ ഉള്ളു. ജീവനിൽ കടപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കല്പനകളെ പ്രമാണിക്ക” എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Why do you ask me about what is good?" Jesus replied. "There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments."
chapters.nkjv: So He said to him, "Why do you call Me good?No one is good but One, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is , God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

chapters.ml: ഏവ എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യേശു: “കുല ചെയ്യരുതു, വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്യരുതു, മോഷ്ടിക്കരുതു, കള്ളസ്സാക്ഷ്യം പറയരുതു;
chapters.niv: "Which ones?" he inquired. Jesus replied, " ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony,
chapters.nkjv: He said to Him, "Which ones?" Jesus said, "‘You shall not murder,’ ‘You shall not commit adultery,’ ‘You shall not steal,’ ‘You shall not bear false witness,’
chapters.kjv: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

chapters.ml: അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും ബഹുമാനിക്ക; കൂട്ടുകാരനെ നിന്നെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ സ്നേഹിക്ക എന്നിവ തന്നേ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: honor your father and mother,’ and ‘love your neighbor as yourself.’ "
chapters.nkjv: ‘Honor your father andyourmother,’ and, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’"
chapters.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

chapters.ml: യൌവനക്കാരൻ അവനോടു: ഇവ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ പ്രമാണിച്ചു പോരുന്നു; ഇനി കുറവുള്ളതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "All these I have kept," the young man said. "What do I still lack?"
chapters.nkjv: The young man said to Him, "All these things I have kept from my youth. What do I still lack?"
chapters.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “സൽഗുണപൂർണ്ണൻ ആകുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നീ ചെന്നു നിനക്കുള്ളതു വിറ്റു ദരിദ്രർക്കു കൊടുക്ക; എന്നാൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിനക്കു നിക്ഷേപം ഉണ്ടാകും; പിന്നെ വന്നു എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me."
chapters.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

chapters.ml: യൌവനക്കാരൻ വളരെ സമ്പത്തുള്ളവനാകയാൽ ഈ വചനം കേട്ടിട്ടു ദുഃഖിച്ചു പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.
chapters.nkjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful, for he had great possessions.
chapters.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

chapters.ml: യേശു തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: “ധനവാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നതു പ്രയാസം തന്നേ എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "Truly I tell you, it is hard for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to His disciples, "Assuredly, I say to you that it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

chapters.ml: ധനവാൻ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ ഒട്ടകം സൂചിക്കുഴയൂടെ കടക്കുന്നതു എളുപ്പം എന്നും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: And again I say to you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: അതുകേട്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഏറ്റവും വിസ്മയിച്ചു: എന്നാൽ രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുവാൻ ആർക്കു കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, "Who then can be saved?"
chapters.nkjv: When His disciples heard it, they were greatly astonished, saying, "Who then can be saved?"
chapters.kjv: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരെ നോക്കി: “അതു മനുഷ്യർക്കു അസാദ്ധ്യം എങ്കിലും ദൈവത്തിന്നു സകലവും സാദ്ധ്യം” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus looked at them and said, "With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus looked at them and said to them, "With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."
chapters.kjv: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ സകലവും വിട്ടു നിന്നെ അനുഗമിച്ചുവല്ലോ; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു കിട്ടും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Peter answered him, "We have left everything to follow you! What then will there be for us?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter answered and said to Him, "See, we have left all and followed You. Therefore what shall we have?"
chapters.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “എന്നെ അനുഗമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നിങ്ങൾ പുനർജ്ജനനത്തിൽ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ തന്റെ മഹത്വത്തിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങളും പന്ത്രണ്ടു സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ ഗോത്രം പന്ത്രണ്ടിന്നും ന്യായം വിധിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "Truly I tell you, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus said to them, "Assuredly I say to you, that in the regeneration, when the Son of Man sits on the throne of His glory, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നാമംനിമിത്തം വീടുകളെയോ സഹോദരന്മാരെയോ സഹോദരികളെയോ അപ്പനെയോ അമ്മയെയോ മക്കളെയോ നിലങ്ങളെയോ വിട്ടു കളഞ്ഞവന്നു എല്ലാം നൂറുമടങ്ങു ലഭിക്കും; അവൻ നിത്യജീവനെയും അവകാശമാക്കും.
chapters.niv: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.
chapters.nkjv: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands, for My name’s sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and inherit eternal life.
chapters.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും മുമ്പന്മാർ പലർ പിമ്പന്മാരും പിമ്പന്മാർ മുമ്പന്മാരും ആകും.”
chapters.niv: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
chapters.nkjv: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.
chapters.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

chapters.ml: “സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം തന്റെ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിൽ വേലക്കാരെ വിളിച്ചാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പുലർച്ചെക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ട വീട്ടുടയവനോടു സദൃശം.
chapters.niv: "For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
chapters.nkjv: "For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
chapters.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

chapters.ml: വേലക്കാരോടു അവൻ ദിവസത്തേക്കു ഓരോ വെള്ളിക്കാശു പറഞ്ഞൊത്തിട്ടു, അവരെ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
chapters.nkjv: Now when he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
chapters.kjv: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം മണിനേരത്തും പുറപ്പെട്ടു, മറ്റു ചിലർ ചന്തയിൽ മിനക്കെട്ടു നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: "About nine in the morning he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
chapters.nkjv: And he went out about the third hour and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
chapters.kjv: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
