chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളും മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിൽ പോകുവിൻ; ന്യായമായതു തരാം എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ പോയി.
chapters.niv: He told them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.’
chapters.nkjv: and said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went.
chapters.kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആറാം മണിനേരത്തും ഒമ്പതാം മണി നേരത്തും ചെന്നു അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So they went. "He went out again about noon and about three in the afternoon and did the same thing.
chapters.nkjv: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
chapters.kjv: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

chapters.ml: പതിനൊന്നാം മണി നേരത്തും ചെന്നു, മറ്റു ചിലർ നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു; നിങ്ങൾ ഇവിടെ പകൽ മുഴുവൻ മിനക്കെട്ടു നില്ക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: About five in the afternoon he went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’
chapters.nkjv: And about the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle, and said to them, ‘Why have you been standing here idle all day?’
chapters.kjv: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളെ ആരും കൂലിക്കു വിളിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടത്രേ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ: നിങ്ങളും മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുവിൻ എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. "He said to them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard.’
chapters.nkjv: They said to him, ‘Because no one hired us.’ He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right you will receive.’
chapters.kjv: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യയായപ്പോൾ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഉടയവൻ തന്റെ വിചാരകനോടു: വേലക്കാരെ വിളിച്ചു, പിമ്പന്മാർ തുടങ്ങി മുമ്പന്മാർവരെ അവർക്കു കൂലി കൊടുക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first.’
chapters.nkjv: "So when evening had come, the owner of the vineyard said to his steward, ‘Call the laborers and give them their wages, beginning with the last to the first.’
chapters.kjv: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പതിനൊന്നാം മണിനേരത്തു വന്നവർ ചെന്നു ഓരോ വെള്ളിക്കാശു വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: "The workers who were hired about five in the afternoon came and each received a denarius.
chapters.nkjv: And when those came who were hired about the eleventh hour, they each received a denarius.
chapters.kjv: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

chapters.ml: മുമ്പന്മാർ വന്നപ്പോൾ തങ്ങൾക്കു അധികം കിട്ടും എന്നു നിരൂപിച്ചു; അവർക്കും ഓരോ വെള്ളിക്കാശു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.
chapters.nkjv: But when the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise received each a denarius.
chapters.kjv: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

chapters.ml: അതു വാങ്ങീട്ടു അവർ വീട്ടുടയവന്റെ നേരെ പിറുപിറുത്തു:
chapters.niv: When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had received it, they complained against the landowner,
chapters.kjv: And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house,

chapters.ml: ഈ പിമ്പന്മാർ ഒരു മണിനേരം മാത്രം വേല ചെയ്തിട്ടും നീ അവരെ പകലത്തെ ഭാരവും വെയിലും സഹിച്ച ഞങ്ങളോടു സമമാക്കിയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: ‘These who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the work and the heat of the day.’
chapters.nkjv: saying, ‘These last men have worked only one hour, and you made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the heat of the day.’
chapters.kjv: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനോടു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: സ്നേഹിതാ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു അന്യായം ചെയ്യുന്നില്ല; നീ എന്നോടു ഒരു പണം പറഞ്ഞൊത്തില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "But he answered one of them, ‘I am not being unfair to you, friend. Didn’t you agree to work for a denarius?
chapters.nkjv: But he answered one of them and said, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Did you not agree with me for a denarius?
chapters.kjv: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

chapters.ml: നിന്റേതു വാങ്ങി പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; നിനക്കു തന്നതുപോലെ ഈ പിമ്പന്നും കൊടുപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു മനസ്സു.
chapters.niv: Take your pay and go. I want to give the one who was hired last the same as I gave you.
chapters.nkjv: Take what is yours and go your way. I wish to give to this last man the same as to you.
chapters.kjv: Take that thine is , and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കുള്ളതിനെക്കൊണ്ടു മനസ്സുപോലെ ചെയ്‍വാൻ എനിക്കു ന്യായമില്ലയോ? ഞാൻ നല്ലവൻ ആകകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ കണ്ണു കടിക്കുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: Don’t I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
chapters.nkjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I wish with my own things? Or is your eye evil because I am good?’
chapters.kjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പിമ്പന്മാർ മുമ്പൻ മാരും മുമ്പന്മാർ പിമ്പന്മാരും ആകും.”
chapters.niv: "So the last will be first, and the first will be last."
chapters.nkjv: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few chosen."
chapters.kjv: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

chapters.ml: യേശു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു യാത്രചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ പന്ത്രണ്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാരെയും വേറിട്ടു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വഴിയിൽവെച്ചു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Now Jesus was going up to Jerusalem. On the way, he took the Twelve aside and said to them,
chapters.nkjv: Now Jesus, going up to Jerusalem, took the twelve disciples aside on the road and said to them,
chapters.kjv: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

chapters.ml: “നാം യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോകുന്നുവല്ലോ; അവിടെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കും ശാസ്ത്രിമാർക്കും ഏല്പിക്കപ്പെടും;
chapters.niv: "We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death
chapters.nkjv: "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and to the scribes; and they will condemn Him to death,
chapters.kjv: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്നു മരണശിക്ഷ കല്പിച്ചു, പരിഹസിപ്പാനും തല്ലുവാനും ക്രൂശിപ്പാനും അവനെ ജാതികൾക്കു ഏല്പിക്കും; എന്നാൽ മൂന്നാം നാൾ അവൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കും.”
chapters.niv: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!"
chapters.nkjv: and deliver Him to the Gentiles to mock and to scourge and to crucify. And the third day He will rise again."
chapters.kjv: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again.

chapters.ml: അന്നു സെബെദിപുത്രന്മാരുടെ അമ്മ പുത്രന്മാരുമായി അവന്റെ അടുക്കെ വന്നു നമസ്ക്കരിച്ചു അവനോടു ഒരു അപേക്ഷ കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.
chapters.nkjv: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Him with her sons, kneeling down and asking something from Him.
chapters.kjv: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons, worshipping him , and desiring a certain thing of him.

chapters.ml: “നിനക്കു എന്തു വേണം” എന്നു അവൻ അവളോടു ചോദിച്ചു. അവൾ അവനോടു: ഈ എന്റെ പുത്രന്മാർ ഇരുവരും നിന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ നിന്റെ വലത്തും ഒരുത്തൻ ഇടത്തും ഇരിപ്പാൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What is it you want?" he asked. She said, "Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to her, "What do you wish?" She said to Him, "Grant that these two sons of mine may sit, one on Your right hand and the other on the left, in Your kingdom."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഉത്തരമായി യേശു: “നിങ്ങൾ യാചിക്കുന്നതു ഇന്നതു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ല; ഞാൻ കുടിപ്പാനിരിക്കുന്ന പാനപാത്രം കുടിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കഴിയുമോ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. കഴിയും എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You don’t know what you are asking," Jesus said to them. "Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?" "We can," they answered.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answered and said, "You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?" They said to Him, "We are able."
chapters.kjv: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “എന്റെ പാനപാത്രം നിങ്ങൾ കുടിക്കും നിശ്ചയം; എങ്കിലും എന്റെ വലത്തും ഇടത്തും ഇരിപ്പാൻ വരം നല്കുന്നതു എന്റേതല്ല; എന്റെ പിതാവു ആർക്കു ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നുവോ അവർക്കു കിട്ടും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father."
chapters.nkjv: So He said to them, "You will indeed drink My cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on My right hand and on My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it is prepared by My Father."
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

chapters.ml: ശേഷം പത്തുപേർ അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു ആ രണ്ടു സഹോദരന്മാരോടു നീരസപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
chapters.nkjv: And when the ten heard it, they were greatly displeased with the two brothers.
chapters.kjv: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ അവരെ അടുക്കെ വിളിച്ചു: “ജാതികളുടെ അധിപന്മാർ അവരിൽ കർത്തൃത്വം ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നും മഹത്തുക്കൾ അവരുടെമേൽ അധികാരം നടത്തുന്നു എന്നും നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus called them to Himself and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those who are great exercise authority over them.
chapters.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him , and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിൽ അങ്ങനെ അരുതു: നിങ്ങളിൽ മഹാൻ ആകുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നവനെല്ലാം നിങ്ങളുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരൻ ആകേണം.
chapters.niv: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
chapters.nkjv: Yet it shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you, let him be your servant.
chapters.kjv: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നാമൻ ആകുവാൻ ഇചഛിക്കുന്നവനെല്ലാം നിങ്ങളുടെ ദാസൻ ആകേണം.
chapters.niv: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave—
chapters.nkjv: And whoever desires to be first among you, let him be your slave—
chapters.kjv: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യിപ്പാനല്ല ശുശ്രൂഷിപ്പാനും അനേകർക്കു വേണ്ടി തന്റെ ജീവനെ മറുവിലയായി കൊടുപ്പാനും വന്നതുപോലെ തന്നേ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
chapters.nkjv: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many."
chapters.kjv: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

chapters.ml: അവർ യെരീഹോവിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ വലിയോരു പുരുഷാരം അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.
chapters.nkjv: Now as they went out of Jericho, a great multitude followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ വഴിയരികെ ഇരിക്കുന്ന രണ്ടു കുരുടന്മാർ യേശു കടന്നുപോകുന്നതു കേട്ടു: കർത്താവേ, ദാവീദ് പുത്രാ, ഞങ്ങളോടു കുരുണതോന്നേണമേ എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
chapters.nkjv: And behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, saying, "Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David!"
chapters.kjv: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

chapters.ml: മിണ്ടാതിരിപ്പാൻ പുരുഷാരം അവരെ ശാസിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ: കർത്താവേ, ദാവീദ് പുത്രാ, ഞങ്ങളോടു കരുണ തോന്നേണമേ എന്നു അധികം നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the multitude warned them that they should be quiet; but they cried out all the more, saying, "Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David!"
chapters.kjv: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

chapters.ml: യേശു നിന്നു അവരെ വിളിച്ചു: “ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ചെയ്യേണമെന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus stopped and called them. "What do you want me to do for you?" he asked.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus stood still and called them, and said, "What do you want Me to do for you?"
chapters.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, ഞങ്ങൾക്കു കണ്ണു തുറന്നുകിട്ടേണം എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Lord," they answered, "we want our sight."
chapters.nkjv: They said to Him, "Lord, that our eyes may be opened."
chapters.kjv: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

chapters.ml: യേശു മനസ്സലിഞ്ഞു അവരുടെ കണ്ണു തൊട്ടു; ഉടനെ അവർ കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചു, അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus had compassion and touched their eyes. And immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed Him.
chapters.kjv: So Jesus had compassion on them , and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ യെരൂശലേമിനോടു സമീപിച്ചു ഒലിവുമലയരികെ ബേത്ത്ഫഗയിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ, യേശു രണ്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ അയച്ചു:
chapters.niv: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,
chapters.nkjv: Now when they drew near Jerusalem, and came to Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
chapters.kjv: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങൾക്കു എതിരെയുള്ള ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; അവിടെ കെട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു പെൺകഴുതയെയും അതിന്റെ കുട്ടിയെയും നിങ്ങൾ ഉടനെ കാണും; അവയെ അഴിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: saying to them, "Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.
chapters.nkjv: saying to them, "Go into the village opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Loose them and bring them to Me.
chapters.kjv: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them , and bring them unto me.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോടു ആരാനും വല്ലതും പറഞ്ഞാൽ: കർത്താവിന്നു ഇവയെക്കൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറവിൻ; തൽക്ഷണം അവൻ അവയെ അയയക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If anyone says anything to you, say that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away."
chapters.nkjv: And if anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord has need of them,’ and immediately he will send them."
chapters.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

chapters.ml: “സീയോൻ പുത്രിയോടു: ഇതാ, നിന്റെ രാജാവു സൌമ്യനായി കഴുതപ്പുറത്തും വാഹനമൃഗത്തിന്റെ കുട്ടിയുടെ പുറത്തും കയറി നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നു എന്നു പറവിൻ ”
chapters.niv: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
chapters.nkjv: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying:
chapters.kjv: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

chapters.ml: എന്നിങ്ങനെ പ്രവാചകൻ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിചെയ്തതിന്നു നിവൃത്തിവരുവാൻ ഇതു സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "Tell the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your King is coming to you, Lowly, and sitting on a donkey, A colt, the foal of a donkey.’ "
chapters.kjv: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു യേശു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ചെയ്തു,
chapters.niv: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.
chapters.nkjv: So the disciples went and did as Jesus commanded them.
chapters.kjv: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

chapters.ml: കഴുതയെയും കുട്ടിയെയും കൊണ്ടുവന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം അവയുടെ മേൽ ഇട്ടു; അവൻ കയറി ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They brought the donkey and the colt and placed their cloaks on them for Jesus to sit on.
chapters.nkjv: They brought the donkey and the colt, laid their clothes on them, and set Him on them.
chapters.kjv: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം മിക്കതും തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം വഴിയിൽ വിരിച്ചു: മറ്റു ചിലർ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നു കൊമ്പു വെട്ടി വഴിയിൽ വിതറി.
chapters.niv: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
chapters.nkjv: And a very great multitude spread their clothes on the road; others cut down branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
chapters.kjv: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

chapters.ml: മുന്നും പിന്നും നടന്ന പുരുഷാരം: ദാവീദ് പുത്രന്നു ഹോശന്നാ; കർത്താവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വരുന്നവൻ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ; അത്യുന്നതങ്ങളിൽ ഹോശന്നാ എന്നു ആർത്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Hosanna in the highest heaven!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the multitudes who went before and those who followed cried out, saying: "Hosanna to the Son of David! ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!’ Hosanna in the highest!"
chapters.kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ കടന്നപ്പോൾ നഗരം മുഴുവനും ഇളകി: ഇവൻ ആർ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, "Who is this?"
chapters.nkjv: And when He had come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, "Who is this?"
chapters.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ ഗലീലയിലെ നസറെത്തിൽനിന്നുള്ള പ്രവാചകനായ യേശു എന്നു പുരുഷാരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The crowds answered, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."
chapters.nkjv: So the multitudes said, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth of Galilee."
chapters.kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

chapters.ml: യേശു ദൈവലായത്തിൽ ചെന്നു, ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ വില്ക്കുന്നവരെയും കൊള്ളുന്നവരെയും എല്ലാം പുറത്താക്കി, പൊൻവാണിഭക്കാരുടെ മേശകളെയും പ്രാവുകളെ വില്ക്കുന്നവരുടെ പീഠങ്ങളെയും മറിച്ചു കളഞ്ഞു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus went into the temple of God and drove out all those who bought and sold in the temple, and overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who sold doves.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

chapters.ml: “എന്റെ ആലയം പ്രാർത്ഥാനാലയം എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടും എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളോ അതിനെ കള്ളന്മാരുടെ ഗുഹയാക്കിത്തിർക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "It is written," he said to them, " ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of thieves.’ "
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

chapters.ml: കുരുടന്മാരും മുടന്തന്മാരും ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അവൻ അവരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.
chapters.nkjv: Then the blind and the lame came to Him in the temple, and He healed them.
chapters.kjv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും അവൻ ചെയ്ത അത്ഭുതങ്ങളെയും ദാവീദ് പുത്രന്നു ഹോശന്നാ എന്നു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ആർക്കുന്ന ബാലന്മാരെയും കണ്ടിട്ടു നീരസപ്പെട്ടു;
chapters.niv: But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple courts, "Hosanna to the Son of David," they were indignant.
chapters.nkjv: But when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that He did, and the children crying out in the temple and saying, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" they were indignant
chapters.kjv: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ പറയുന്നതു കേൾക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു. യേശു അവരോടു: “ഉവ്വു: ശിശുക്കളുടെയും മുലകുടിക്കുന്നവരുടെയും വായിൽ നിന്നു നീ പുകഴ്ച ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നുള്ളതു നിങ്ങൾ ഒരിക്കലും വായിച്ചിട്ടല്ലയോ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Do you hear what these children are saying?" they asked him. "Yes," replied Jesus, "have you never read, " ‘From the lips of children and infants you, Lord, have called forth your praise’ ?"
chapters.nkjv: and said to Him, "Do You hear what these are saying?" And Jesus said to them, "Yes. Have you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of babes and nursing infants You have perfected praise’?"
chapters.kjv: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരെ വിട്ടു നഗരത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ബെഥാന്യയിൽ ചെന്നു അവിടെ രാത്രി പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.
chapters.nkjv: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and He lodged there.
chapters.kjv: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ അവൻ നഗരത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുന്ന സമയം വിശന്നിട്ടു വഴിയരികെ ഒരു അത്തിവൃക്ഷം കണ്ടു
chapters.niv: Early in the morning, as Jesus was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the morning, as He returned to the city, He was hungry.
chapters.kjv: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

chapters.ml: അടുക്കെ ചെന്നു, അതിൽ ഇലയല്ലാതെ ഒന്നും കാണായ്കയാൽ: “ഇനി നിന്നിൽ ഒരുനാളും ഫലം ഉണ്ടാകാതെ പോകട്ടെ” എന്നു അതിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു; ക്ഷണത്തിൽ അത്തി ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, "May you never bear fruit again!" Immediately the tree withered.
chapters.nkjv: And seeing a fig tree by the road, He came to it and found nothing on it but leaves, and said to it, "Let no fruit grow on you ever again." Immediately the fig tree withered away.
chapters.kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അതു കണ്ടാറെ: അത്തി ഇത്ര ക്ഷണത്തിൽ ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?" they asked.
chapters.nkjv: And when the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, "How did the fig tree wither away so soon?"
chapters.kjv: And when the disciples saw it , they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “നിങ്ങൾ സംശയിക്കാതെ വിശ്വാസം ഉള്ളവരായാൽ ഈ അത്തിയോടു ചെയ്തതു നിങ്ങളും ചെയ്യും; എന്നു മാത്രമല്ല, ഈ മലയോടു: നീങ്ങി കടലിലേക്കു ചാടിപ്പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അതും സംഭവിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and it will be done.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus answered and said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but also if you say to this mountain, ‘Be removed and be cast into the sea,’ it will be done.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പ്രാർത്ഥനയിൽ എന്തു യാചിച്ചാലും നിങ്ങൾക്കു ലഭിക്കും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer."
chapters.nkjv: And whatever things you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive."
chapters.kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ഉപദേശിക്കുമ്പോൾ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ജനത്തിന്റെ മൂപ്പന്മാരും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: നീ എന്തു അധികാരം കൊണ്ടു ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നു? ഈ അധികാരം നിനക്കു തന്നതു ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you this authority?"
chapters.nkjv: Now when He came into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people confronted Him as He was teaching, and said, "By what authority are You doing these things? And who gave You this authority?"
chapters.kjv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഞാനും നിങ്ങളോടു ഒരു വാക്കു ചോദിക്കും; അതു നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞാൽ എന്തു അധികാരം കൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നുള്ളതു ഞാനും നിങ്ങളോടു പറയും.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one thing, which if you tell Me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things:
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാന്റെ സ്നാനം എവിടെ നിന്നു? സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നോ മനുഷ്യരിൽ നിന്നോ?” അവർ തമ്മിൽ ആലോചിച്ചു: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ, പിന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ വിശ്വസിക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ നമ്മോടു ചോദിക്കും;
chapters.niv: John’s baptism—where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or of human origin?" They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’
chapters.nkjv: The baptism of John—where was it from? From heaven or from men?" And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say to us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
chapters.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരിൽ നിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാലോ, നാം പുരുഷാരത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടുന്നു; എല്ലാവരും യോഹന്നാനെ പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നല്ലോ എണ്ണുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’—we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet."
chapters.nkjv: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all count John as a prophet."
chapters.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ യേശുവിനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അറിഞ്ഞുകൂടാ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഇതു എന്തു അധികാരംകൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നുള്ളതു ഞാനും നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നില്ല.”
chapters.niv: So they answered Jesus, "We don’t know." Then he said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
chapters.nkjv: So they answered Jesus and said, "We do not know." And He said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
chapters.kjv: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു? ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്നു രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ ഒന്നാമത്തവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: മകനേ ഇന്നു എന്റെ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിൽ പോയി വേല ചെയ്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
chapters.nkjv: "But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first and said, ‘Son, go, work today in my vineyard.’
chapters.kjv: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു മനസ്സില്ല എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു; എങ്കിലും പിന്നത്തേതിൽ അനുതപിച്ചു അവൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: " ‘I will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he regretted it and went.
chapters.kjv: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തെവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അവൻ ചെന്നു അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ: ഞാൻ പോകാം അപ്പാ എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു; പോയില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: "Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he did not go.
chapters.nkjv: Then he came to the second and said likewise. And he answered and said, ‘I go, sir,’ but he did not go.
chapters.kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go , sir: and went not.

chapters.ml: ഈ രണ്ടുപേരിൽ ആർ ആകുന്നു അപ്പന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്തതു?” ഒന്നാമത്തവൻ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു. യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ചുങ്കക്കാരും വേശ്യമാരും നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പായി ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നു എന്നു സത്യമായിട്ടു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Which of the two did what his father wanted?" "The first," they answered. Jesus said to them, "Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.
chapters.nkjv: Which of the two did the will of his father?" They said to Him, "The first." Jesus said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you that tax collectors and harlots enter the kingdom of God before you.
chapters.kjv: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ നീതിമാർഗ്ഗം ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല; എന്നാൽ ചുങ്കക്കാരും വേശ്യമാരും അവനെ വിശ്വസിച്ചു; അതു കണ്ടിട്ടും നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ വിശ്വസിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം പിന്നത്തേതിൽ അനുതപിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
chapters.nkjv: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him; but tax collectors and harlots believed him; and when you saw it, you did not afterward relent and believe him.
chapters.kjv: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it , repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു ഉപമ കേൾപ്പിൻ. ഗൃഹസ്ഥനായോരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഒരു മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടം നട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി, അതിന്നു വേലികെട്ടി, അതിൽ ചകൂ കുഴിച്ചിട്ടു ഗോപുരവും പണിതു; പിന്നെ കുടിയാന്മാരെ പാട്ടത്തിന്നു ഏല്പിച്ചിട്ടു പരദേശത്തുപോയി.
chapters.niv: "Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.
chapters.nkjv: "Hear another parable: There was a certain landowner who planted a vineyard and set a hedge around it, dug a winepress in it and built a tower. And he leased it to vinedressers and went into a far country.
chapters.kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

chapters.ml: ഫലകാലം സമീപിച്ചപ്പോൾ തനിക്കുള്ള അനുഭവം വാങ്ങേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ദാസന്മാരെ കുടിയാന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.
chapters.nkjv: Now when vintage-time drew near, he sent his servants to the vinedressers, that they might receive its fruit.
chapters.kjv: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

chapters.ml: കുടിയാന്മാരോ അവന്റെ ദാസന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു, ഒരുവനെ തല്ലി, ഒരുവനെ കൊന്നു, മറ്റൊരുവനെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
chapters.nkjv: And the vinedressers took his servants, beat one, killed one, and stoned another.
chapters.kjv: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും മുമ്പിലത്തേതിലും അധികം ദാസന്മാരെ അയച്ചു; അവരോടും അവർ അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.
chapters.nkjv: Again he sent other servants, more than the first, and they did likewise to them.
chapters.kjv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

chapters.ml: ഒടുവിൽ അവൻ: എന്റെ മകനെ അവർ ശങ്കിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു, മകനെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Last of all, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
chapters.nkjv: Then last of all he sent his son to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
chapters.kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

chapters.ml: മകനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു കുടിയാന്മാർ: ഇവൻ അവകാശി; വരുവിൻ, നാം അവനെ കൊന്നു അവന്റെ അവകാശം കൈവശമാക്കുക എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു,
chapters.niv: "But when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and take his inheritance.’
chapters.nkjv: But when the vinedressers saw the son, they said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and seize his inheritance.’
chapters.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

chapters.ml: അവനെ പിടിച്ചു തോട്ടത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി കൊന്നു കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
chapters.nkjv: So they took him and cast him out of the vineyard and killed him.
chapters.kjv: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him .

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഉടയവൻ വരുമ്പോൾ ആ കുടിയാന്മാരോടു എന്തു ചെയ്യും?”
chapters.niv: "Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?"
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those vinedressers?"
chapters.kjv: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ വല്ലാത്തവരെ വല്ലാതെ നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു തക്കസമയത്തു അനുഭവം കൊടുക്കുന്ന വേറെ കുടിയാന്മാർക്കു തോട്ടം ഏല്പിക്കും എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "He will bring those wretches to a wretched end," they replied, "and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time."
chapters.nkjv: They said to Him, "He will destroy those wicked men miserably, and lease his vineyard to other vinedressers who will render to him the fruits in their seasons."
chapters.kjv: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “വീടുപണിയുന്നവർ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞ കല്ലു മൂലക്കല്ലായി തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇതു കർത്താവിനാൽ സംഭവിച്ചു നമ്മുടെ ദൃഷ്ടിയിൽ ആശ്ചര്യവുമായിരിക്കുന്നു' എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളിൽ ഒരിക്കലും വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures: " ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone. This was the Lord’s doing, And it is marvelous in our eyes’?
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവരാജ്യം നിങ്ങളുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നു എടുത്തു അതിന്റെ ഫലം കൊടുക്കുന്ന ജാതിക്കു കൊടുക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore I say to you, the kingdom of God will be taken from you and given to a nation bearing the fruits of it.
chapters.kjv: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

chapters.ml: ഈ കല്ലിന്മേൽ വീഴുന്നവൻ തകർന്നുപോകും; അതു ആരുടെ മേൽ എങ്കിലും വീണാൽ അവനെ ധൂളിപ്പിക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed."
chapters.nkjv: And whoever falls on this stone will be broken; but on whomever it falls, it will grind him to powder."
chapters.kjv: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഉപമകളെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും പരീശരും കേട്ടിട്ടു, തങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ടു പറയന്നു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു,
chapters.niv: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesus’ parables, they knew he was talking about them.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they perceived that He was speaking of them.
chapters.kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

chapters.ml: അവനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ അന്വേഷിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ പുരുഷാരം അവനെ പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു എണ്ണുകകൊണ്ടു അവരെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They looked for a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd because the people held that he was a prophet.
chapters.nkjv: But when they sought to lay hands on Him, they feared the multitudes, because they took Him for a prophet.
chapters.kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

chapters.ml: യേശു പിന്നെയും അവരോടു ഉപമകളായി പ്രസ്താവിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus answered and spoke to them again by parables and said:
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

chapters.ml: “സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം തന്റെ പുത്രന്നു വേണ്ടി കല്യാണസദ്യ കഴിച്ച ഒരു രാജാവിനോടു സദൃശം.
chapters.niv: "The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
chapters.nkjv: "The kingdom of heaven is like a certain king who arranged a marriage for his son,
chapters.kjv: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

chapters.ml: അവൻ കല്യാണത്തിന്നു ക്ഷണിച്ചവരെ വിളിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദാസന്മാരെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു; അവർക്കോ വരുവാൻ മനസ്സായില്ല.
chapters.niv: He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.
chapters.nkjv: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding; and they were not willing to come.
chapters.kjv: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും അവൻ മറ്റു ദാസന്മാരെ അയച്ചു: എന്റെ മുത്താഴം ഒരുക്കിത്തീർന്നു, എന്റെ കാളകളെയും തടിപ്പിച്ച മൃഗങ്ങളെയും അറുത്തു, എല്ലാം ഒരുങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു; കല്യാണത്തിന്നു വരുവിൻ എന്നു ക്ഷണിച്ചുവരോടു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Then he sent some more servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner: My oxen and fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
chapters.nkjv: Again, he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, "See, I have prepared my dinner; my oxen and fatted cattle are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding." ’
chapters.kjv: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

chapters.ml: അവർ അതു കൂട്ടാക്കാതെ ഒരുത്തൻ തന്റെ നിലത്തിലേക്കും മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ തന്റെ വ്യാപാരത്തിന്നും പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But they paid no attention and went off—one to his field, another to his business.
chapters.nkjv: But they made light of it and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his business.
chapters.kjv: But they made light of it , and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

chapters.ml: ശേഷമുള്ളവർ അവന്റെ ദാസന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു അപമാനിച്ചു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.
chapters.nkjv: And the rest seized his servants, treated themspitefully, and killed them.
chapters.kjv: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them .

chapters.ml: രാജാവു കോപിച്ചു സൈന്യങ്ങളെ അയച്ചു ആ കുലപാതകന്മാരെ മുടിച്ചു അവരുടെ പട്ടണം ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.
chapters.nkjv: But when the king heard about it, he was furious. And he sent out his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
chapters.kjv: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ദാസന്മാരോടു: കല്യാണം ഒരുങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ക്ഷണിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരോ യോഗ്യരായില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited were not worthy.
chapters.kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ വഴിത്തലെക്കൽ ചെന്നു കാണുന്നവരെ ഒക്കെയും കല്യാണത്തിന്നു വിളിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.’
chapters.nkjv: Therefore go into the highways, and as many as you find, invite to the wedding.’
chapters.kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

chapters.ml: ആ ദാസന്മാർ പെരുവഴികളിൽ പോയി, കണ്ട ദുഷ്ടന്മാരെയും നല്ലവരെയും എല്ലാം കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; കല്യാണശാല വിരുന്നുകാരെക്കൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, the bad as well as the good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
chapters.nkjv: So those servants went out into the highways and gathered together all whom they found, both bad and good. And the wedding hall was filled with guests.
chapters.kjv: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

chapters.ml: വിരുന്നുകാരെ നോക്കുവാൻ രാജാവു അകത്തു വന്നപ്പോൾ കല്യാണവസ്ത്രം ധരിക്കാത്ത ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ അവിടെ കണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: "But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.
chapters.nkjv: "But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw a man there who did not have on a wedding garment.
chapters.kjv: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

chapters.ml: സ്നേഹിതാ നീ കല്യാണവസ്ത്രം ഇല്ലാതെ ഇവിടെ അകത്തു വന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. എന്നാൽ അവന്നു വാക്കു മുട്ടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: He asked, ‘How did you get in here without wedding clothes, friend?’ The man was speechless.
chapters.nkjv: So he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here without a wedding garment?’ And he was speechless.
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരോടു: ഇവനെ കയ്യും കാലും കെട്ടി ഏറ്റവും പുറത്തുള്ള ഇരുട്ടിൽ തള്ളിക്കളവിൻ; അവിടെ കരച്ചലും പല്ലുകടിയും ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Then the king told the attendants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
chapters.nkjv: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
chapters.kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

chapters.ml: വിളിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ അനേകർ; തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കപ്പെട്ടവരോ ചുരുക്കം.”
chapters.niv: "For many are invited, but few are chosen."
chapters.nkjv: "For many are called, but few are chosen."
chapters.kjv: For many are called, but few are chosen.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം പരീശന്മാർ ചെന്നു അവനെ വാക്കിൽ കുടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആലോചിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Pharisees went and plotted how they might entangle Him in His talk.
chapters.kjv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ ഹെരോദ്യരോടു കൂടെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു: ഗുരോ, നീ സത്യവാനും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വഴി നേരായി പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നവനും മനുഷ്യരുടെ മുഖം നോക്കാത്തവൻ ആകയാൽ ആരെയും ശങ്കയില്ലാത്തവനും ആകുന്നു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know that you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are.
chapters.nkjv: And they sent to Him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, "Teacher, we know that You are true, and teach the way of God in truth; nor do You care about anyone, for You do not regard the person of men.
chapters.kjv: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു? കൈസർക്കു കരം കൊടുക്കുന്നതു വിഹിതമോ അല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുതരേണം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?"
chapters.nkjv: Tell us, therefore, what do You think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"
chapters.kjv: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരുടെ ദുഷ്ടത അറിഞ്ഞു: “കപട ഭക്തിക്കാരേ, എന്നെ പരീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, "You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, "Why do you test Me, you hypocrites?
chapters.kjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

chapters.ml: കരത്തിന്നുള്ള നാണയം കാണിപ്പിൻ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരു വെള്ളിക്കാശു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Show me the coin used for paying the tax." They brought him a denarius,
chapters.nkjv: Show Me the tax money." So they brought Him a denarius.
chapters.kjv: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഈ സ്വരൂപവും മേലെഴുത്തും ആരുടേതു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചുതിന്നു കൈസരുടേതു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and he asked them, "Whose image is this? And whose inscription?"
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Whose image and inscription is this?"
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

chapters.ml: “എന്നാൽ കൈസർക്കുള്ളതു കൈസർക്കും ദൈവത്തിനുള്ളതു ദൈവത്തിന്നും കൊടുപ്പിൻ” എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Caesar’s," they replied. Then he said to them, "So give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s."
chapters.nkjv: They said to Him, "Caesar’s." And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s."
chapters.kjv: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.

chapters.ml: അവർ കേട്ടു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു അവനെ വിട്ടു പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.
chapters.nkjv: When they had heard thesewords, they marveled, and left Him and went their way.
chapters.kjv: When they had heard these words , they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

chapters.ml: പുനരുത്ഥാനം ഇല്ല എന്നു പറയുന്ന സദൂക്യരും അന്നു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു:
chapters.niv: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
chapters.nkjv: The same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him and asked Him,
chapters.kjv: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

chapters.ml: ഗുരോ, ഒരുത്തൻ മക്കൾ ഇല്ലാതെ മരിച്ചാൽ അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ ദേവരവിവാഹം കഴിച്ചു തന്റെ സഹോദരന്നു സന്തതിയെ ജനിപ്പിക്കേണം എന്നു മോശെ കല്പിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Teacher," they said, "Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
chapters.nkjv: saying: "Teacher, Moses said that if a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
chapters.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഏഴു സഹോദരന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവരിൽ ഒന്നാമത്തവൻ വിവാഹം ചെയ്തശേഷം മരിച്ചു, സന്തതി ഇല്ലായ്കയാൽ തന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ സഹോദരന്നു വിട്ടേച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.
chapters.nkjv: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first died after he had married, and having no offspring, left his wife to his brother.
chapters.kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തവനും മൂന്നാമത്തവനും ഏഴാമത്തവൻ വരെയും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.
chapters.nkjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, even to the seventh.
chapters.kjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഒടുവിൽ സ്ത്രീയും മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Finally, the woman died.
chapters.nkjv: Last of all the woman died also.
chapters.kjv: And last of all the woman died also.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിൽ അവൾ ഏഴുവരിൽ ആർക്കു ഭാര്യയാകും? എാല്ലവർക്കും ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife of the seven will she be? For they all had her."
chapters.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “നിങ്ങൾ തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളെയും ദൈവശക്തിയെയും അറിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു തെറ്റിപ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

chapters.ml: പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിൽ അവർ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കുന്നില്ല, വിവാഹത്തിന്നു കൊടുക്കപ്പെടുന്നതുമില്ല; സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ ദൂതന്മാരെപ്പോലെ അത്രേ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels of God in heaven.
chapters.kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവരുടെ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തെക്കുറിച്ചോ ദൈവം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾ വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,
chapters.nkjv: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken to you by God, saying,
chapters.kjv: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദൈവവും യാക്കോബിന്റെ ദൈവവും ആകുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ അരുളി ച്ചെയ്യുന്നു; എന്നാൽ അവൻ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ദൈവമല്ല, ജീവനുള്ളവരുടെ ദൈവമത്രേ.”
chapters.niv: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ? He is not the God of the dead but of the living."
chapters.nkjv: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living."
chapters.kjv: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം ഇതു കേട്ടിട്ടു അവന്റെ ഉപദേശത്തിൽ വിസ്മയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.
chapters.nkjv: And when the multitudes heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.
chapters.kjv: And when the multitude heard this , they were astonished at his doctrine.

chapters.ml: സദൂക്യരെ അവൻ മിണ്ടാതാക്കിയപ്രകാരം കേട്ടിട്ടു പരീശന്മാർ ഒന്നിച്ചു കൂടി,
chapters.niv: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.
chapters.nkjv: But when the Pharisees heard that He had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.
chapters.kjv: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരു വൈദികൻ അവനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:
chapters.nkjv: Then one of them, a lawyer, asked Himaquestion, testing Him, and saying,
chapters.kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question , tempting him, and saying,

chapters.ml: ഗുരോ, ന്യാപ്രമാണത്തിൽ ഏതു കല്പന വലിയതു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?"
chapters.nkjv: "Teacher, which is the great commandment in the law?"
chapters.kjv: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവിനെ നീ പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണാത്മാവോടും പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടും കൂടെ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied: " ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
chapters.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

chapters.ml: ഇതാകുന്നു വലിയതും ഒന്നാമത്തേതുമായ കല്പന രണ്ടാമത്തേതു അതിനോടു സമം:
chapters.niv: This is the first and greatest commandment.
chapters.nkjv: This is the first and great commandment.
chapters.kjv: This is the first and great commandment.

chapters.ml: കൂട്ടുകാരനെ നിന്നെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
chapters.nkjv: And the second is like it: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
chapters.kjv: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

chapters.ml: ഈ രണ്ടു കല്പനകളിൽ സകലന്യായപ്രമാണവും പ്രവാചകന്മാരും അടങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments."
chapters.nkjv: On these two commandments hang all the Law and the Prophets."
chapters.kjv: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാർ ഒരുമിച്ചു കൂടിയിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ യേശു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
chapters.nkjv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
chapters.kjv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

chapters.ml: “ക്രിസ്തുവിനെക്കുറിച്ചു നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു?” അവൻ ആരുടെ പുത്രൻ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു”; ദാവീദിന്റെ പുത്രൻ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What do you think about the Messiah? Whose son is he?" "The son of David," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: saying, "What do you think about the Christ? Whose Son is He?" They said to Him, "The Son of David."
chapters.kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “എന്നാൽ ദാവീദ് ആത്മാവിൽ അവനെ ‘കർത്താവു’ എന്നു വിളിക്കുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ?”
chapters.niv: He said to them, "How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him ‘Lord’? For he says,
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord,’ saying:
chapters.kjv: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ നിന്റെ പാദപീഠം ആക്കുവോളത്തിന്നു എന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്ക എന്നു കർത്താവു എന്റെ കർത്താവിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു” എന്നു അവൻ പറയുന്നുവല്ലോ. “ദാവീദ് അവനെ ‘കർത്താവു’ എന്നു പറയുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ അവന്റെ പുത്രൻ ആകുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: " ‘The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet." ’
chapters.nkjv: ‘The Lordsaid to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool" ’?
chapters.kjv: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

chapters.ml: അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറവാൻ ആർക്കും കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല;
chapters.niv: If then David calls him ‘Lord,’ how can he be his son?"
chapters.nkjv: If David then calls Him ‘Lord,’ how is He his Son?"
chapters.kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

chapters.ml: അന്നുമുതൽ ആരും അവനോടു ഒന്നും ചോദിപ്പാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.
chapters.nkjv: And no one was able to answer Him a word, nor from that day on did anyone dare question Him anymore.
chapters.kjv: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യേശു പുരുഷാരത്തോടും തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടും പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to His disciples,
chapters.kjv: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

chapters.ml: “ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരും മോശെയുടെ പീഠത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
chapters.nkjv: saying: "The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
chapters.kjv: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവർ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും പ്രമാണിച്ചു ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ പോലെ ചെയ്യരുതു താനും. അവർ പറയുന്നതല്ലാതെ ചെയ്യുന്നില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: So you must be careful to do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore whatever they tell you to observe,that observe and do, but do not do according to their works; for they say, and do not do.
chapters.kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഘനമുള്ള ചുമടുകളെ കെട്ടി മനുഷ്യരുടെ തോളിൽ വെക്കുന്നു; ഒരു വിരൽ കെണ്ടുപോലും അവയെ തൊടുവാൻ അവർക്കു മനസ്സില്ല.
chapters.niv: They tie up heavy, cumbersome loads and put them on other people’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.
chapters.nkjv: For they bind heavy burdens, hard to bear, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
chapters.kjv: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ എല്ലാം മനുഷ്യർ കാണേണ്ടതിന്നത്രേ ചെയ്യുന്നതു; തങ്ങളുടെ മന്ത്രപ്പട്ട വീതിയാക്കി തൊങ്ങൽ വലുതാക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Everything they do is done for people to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;
chapters.nkjv: But all their works they do to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the borders of their garments.
chapters.kjv: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

chapters.ml: അത്താഴത്തിൽ പ്രധാനസ്ഥലവും പള്ളിയിൽ മുഖ്യാസനവും
chapters.niv: they love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues;
chapters.nkjv: They love the best places at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
chapters.kjv: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

chapters.ml: അങ്ങാടിയിൽ വന്ദനവും മനുഷ്യർ റബ്ബീ എന്നു വളിക്കുന്നതും അവർക്കു പ്രിയമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: they love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by others.
chapters.nkjv: greetings in the marketplaces, and to be called by men, ‘Rabbi, Rabbi.’
chapters.kjv: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ റബ്ബീ എന്നു പേർ എടുക്കരുതു. ഒരുത്തൻ അത്രേ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഗുരു;
chapters.niv: "But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
chapters.nkjv: But you, do not be called ‘Rabbi’; for One is your Teacher, the Christ, and you are all brethren.
chapters.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ എല്ലാവരും സഹോദരന്മാർ. ഭൂമിയിൽ ആരെയും പിതാവു എന്നു വിളിക്കരുതു; ഒരുത്തൻ അത്രേ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവു, സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Do not call anyone on earth your father; for One is your Father, He who is in heaven.
chapters.kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ നായകന്മാർ എന്നും പേർ എടുക്കരുതു, ഒരുത്തൻ അത്രേ നിങ്ങളുടെ നായകൻ, ക്രിസ്തു തന്നെ.
chapters.niv: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: And do not be called teachers; for One is your Teacher, the Christ.
chapters.kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിൽ ഏറ്റവും വലിയവൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരൻ ആകേണം.
chapters.niv: The greatest among you will be your servant.
chapters.nkjv: But he who is greatest among you shall be your servant.
chapters.kjv: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

chapters.ml: തന്നെത്താൻ ഉയർത്തുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം താഴ്ത്തപ്പെടും; തന്നെത്താൻ താഴ്ത്തുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം ഉയർത്തപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.
chapters.nkjv: And whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted.
chapters.kjv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരായ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ മനുഷ്യർക്കു സ്വർഗ്ഗരാജ്യം അടെച്ചുകളയുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ കടക്കുന്നില്ല, കടക്കുന്നവരെ കടപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിക്കുന്നതുമില്ല. (കപടഭക്തിക്കാരായ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ വിധവമാരുടെ വീടുകളെ വിഴുങ്ങുകയും ഉപായരൂപേണ ദീർഘമായി പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഇതു ഹേതുവായി നിങ്ങൾക്കു കടുമയേറിയ ശിക്ഷാവിധി വരും;)
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the door of the kingdom of heaven in people’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.
chapters.nkjv: "But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men; for you neither go in yourselves, nor do you allow those who are entering to go in.
chapters.kjv: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരായ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ ഒരുത്തനെ മതത്തിൽ ചേർക്കുവാൻ കടലും കരയും ചുറ്റി നടക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when you have succeeded, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.
chapters.nkjv: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

chapters.ml: ചേർന്നശേഷം അവനെ നിങ്ങളെക്കാൾ ഇരട്ടിച്ച നരകയോഗ്യൻ ആക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gold of the temple is bound by that oath.’
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel land and sea to win one proselyte, and when he is won, you make him twice as much a son of hell as yourselves.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും മന്ദിരത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്താൽ ഏതുമില്ല എന്നും മന്ദിരത്തിലെ സ്വർണ്ണത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നവനോ കടക്കാരൻ എന്നും പറയുന്ന കുരുടന്മാരായ വഴികാട്ടികളേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം.
chapters.niv: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you, blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obliged to perform it.’
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

chapters.ml: മൂഢന്മാരും കുരുടുന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, ഏതു വലിയതു? സ്വർണ്ണമോ സ്വർണ്ണത്തെ ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കുന്ന മന്ദിരമോ?
chapters.niv: You also say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gift on the altar is bound by that oath.’
chapters.nkjv: Fools and blind! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
chapters.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

chapters.ml: യാഗപീഠത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്താൽ ഏതുമില്ല; അതിന്മേലുള്ള വഴിപാടു ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നവനോ കടക്കാരൻ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
chapters.nkjv: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obliged to perform it.’
chapters.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

chapters.ml: കുരുടന്മാരായുള്ളോരേ, ഏതു വലിയതു? വഴിപാടോ വഴിപാടിനെ ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കുന്ന യാഗ പീഠമോ?
chapters.niv: Therefore, anyone who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
chapters.nkjv: Fools and blind! For which is greater, the gift or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
chapters.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യാഗപിഠത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ അതിനെയും അതിന്മേലുള്ള സകലത്തെയും ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And anyone who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore he who swears by the altar, swears by it and by all things on it.
chapters.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

chapters.ml: മന്ദിരത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ അതിനെയും അതിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവനെയും ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And anyone who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the one who sits on it.
chapters.nkjv: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by Him who dwells in it.
chapters.kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യംചെയ്യുന്നവൻ, ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തെയും അതിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവനെയും ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices—mint, dill and cumin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law—justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
chapters.nkjv: And he who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by Him who sits on it.
chapters.kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരായ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ തുളസി, ചതകുപ്പ, ജീരകം ഇവയിൽ പതാരം കൊടുക്കയും ന്യായം, കരുണ, വിശ്വസ്തത ഇങ്ങനെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ ഘനമേറിയവ ത്യജിച്ചുകളകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. അതു ചെയ്കയും ഇതു ത്യജിക്കാതിരിക്കയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have neglected the weightier matters of the law: justice and mercy and faith. These you ought to have done, without leaving the others undone.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

chapters.ml: കുരുടന്മാരായ വഴികാട്ടികളേ, നിങ്ങൾ കൊതുകിനെ അരിച്ചെടുക്കയും ഒട്ടകത്തെ വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
chapters.nkjv: Blind guides, who strain out a gnat and swallow a camel!
chapters.kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരായ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ കിണ്ടികിണ്ണങ്ങളുടെ പുറം വെടിപ്പാക്കുന്നു; അകത്തോ കവർച്ചയും അതിക്രമവും നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you cleanse the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of extortion and self-indulgence.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

chapters.ml: കുരുടനായ പരീശനെ, കിണ്ടികിണ്ണങ്ങളുടെ പുറം വെടിപ്പാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മുമ്പെ അവയുടെ അകം വെടിപ്പാക്കുക.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.
chapters.nkjv: Blind Pharisee, first cleanse the inside of the cup and dish, that the outside of them may be clean also.
chapters.kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരായ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം; വെള്ളതേച്ച ശവക്കല്ലറകളോടു നിങ്ങൾ ഒത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അവ പുറമെ അഴകായി ശോഭിക്കുന്നെങ്കിലും അകമെ ചത്തവരുടെ അസ്ഥികളും സകലവിധ അശുദ്ധിയും നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs which indeed appear beautiful outwardly, but inside are full of dead men’s bones and all uncleanness.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ പുറമെ നിങ്ങൾ നീതിമാന്മാർ എന്നു മനുഷ്യർക്കു തോന്നുന്നു; അകമെയോ കപടഭക്തിയും അധർമ്മവും നിറഞ്ഞവരത്രേ.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.
chapters.nkjv: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
chapters.kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരായ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഹാ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ കല്ലറകളെ പണിതും നീതിമാന്മാരുടെ കല്ലറകളെ അലങ്കരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you build the tombs of the prophets and adorn the monuments of the righteous,
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ കാലത്തു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെ കൊല്ലുന്നതിൽ കൂട്ടാളികൾ ആകയില്ലായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.
chapters.nkjv: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
chapters.kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെ കൊന്നവരുടെ മക്കൾ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore you are witnesses against yourselves that you are sons of those who murdered the prophets.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

chapters.ml: പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ അളവു നിങ്ങൾ പൂരിച്ചു കൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?
chapters.nkjv: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers’ guilt.
chapters.kjv: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

chapters.ml: പാമ്പുകളേ, സർപ്പസന്തതികളേ, നിങ്ങൾ നരകവിധി എങ്ങനെ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകും?
chapters.niv: Therefore I am sending you prophets and sages and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.
chapters.nkjv: Serpents, brood of vipers! How can you escape the condemnation of hell?
chapters.kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെയും ജ്ഞാനികളെയും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയക്കുന്നു; അവരിൽ ചിലരെ നിങ്ങൾ ക്രൂശിച്ചു കൊല്ലുകയും ചിലരെ നിങ്ങളുടെ പള്ളികളിൽ ചമ്മട്ടികൊണ്ടു അടിക്കയും പട്ടണത്തിൽ നിന്നു പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു ഓടിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, indeed, I send you prophets, wise men, and scribes: some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
