chapters.niv: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"
chapters.nkjv: And the high priest arose and said to Him, "Do You answer nothing? What isit these men testify against You?"
chapters.kjv: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു. മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ പിന്നെയും അവനോടു: നീ ദൈവപുത്രനായ ക്രിസ്തുതന്നേയോ? പറക എന്നു ഞാൻ ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തെക്കൊണ്ടു നിന്നോടു ആണയിട്ടു ചോദിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, "I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus kept silent. And the high priest answered and said to Him, "I put You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God!"
chapters.kjv: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു; ഇനി മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ സർവ്വശക്തന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നതും ആകാശമേഘങ്ങളെ വാഹനമാക്കി വരുന്നതും നിങ്ങൾ കാണും എന്നു ഞാൻ പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You have said so," Jesus replied. "But I say to all of you: From now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "It is as you said. Nevertheless, I say to you, hereafter you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Power, and coming on the clouds of heaven."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ വസ്ത്രം കീറി: ഇവൻ ദൈവദൂഷണം പറഞ്ഞു; ഇനി സാക്ഷികളെക്കൊണ്ടു നമുക്കു എന്തു ആവശ്യം? നിങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ ദൈവദൂഷണം കേട്ടുവല്ലോ:
chapters.niv: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, "He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
chapters.nkjv: Then the high priest tore his clothes, saying, "He has spoken blasphemy! What further need do we have of witnesses? Look, now you have heard His blasphemy!
chapters.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അവൻ മരണയോഗ്യൻ എന്നു അവർ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: What do you think?" "He is worthy of death," they answered.
chapters.nkjv: What do you think?" They answered and said, "He is deserving of death."
chapters.kjv: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ അവന്റെ മുഖത്തു തുപ്പി, അവനെ മുഷ്ടിചുരുട്ടി കുത്തി, ചിലർ അവനെ കന്നത്തടിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Then they spit in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him
chapters.nkjv: Then they spat in His face and beat Him; and others struck Him with the palms of their hands,
chapters.kjv: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

chapters.ml: ഹേ, ക്രിസ്തുവേ, നിന്നെ തല്ലിയതു ആർ എന്നു ഞങ്ങളോടു പ്രവചിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said, "Prophesy to us, Messiah. Who hit you?"
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Prophesy to us, Christ! Who is the one who struck You?"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പത്രൊസ് പുറത്തു നടുമുറ്റത്തു ഇരുന്നു. അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരു വേലക്കാരത്തി വന്നു: നീയും ഗലീലക്കാരനായ യേശുവിനോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. "You also were with Jesus of Galilee," she said.
chapters.nkjv: Now Peter sat outside in the courtyard. And a servant girl came to him, saying, "You also were with Jesus of Galilee."
chapters.kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: നീ പറയുന്നതു എനിക്കു തിരിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു എല്ലാവരും കേൾക്കെ തള്ളിപ്പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he denied it before them all. "I don’t know what you’re talking about," he said.
chapters.nkjv: But he denied it before them all, saying, "I do not know what you are saying."
chapters.kjv: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പടിപ്പുരയിലേക്കു പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ മറ്റൊരുത്തി അവനെ കണ്ടു അവിടെയുള്ളവരോടു: ഇവനും നസറായനായ യേശുവിനോടു കൂടെയായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: Then he went out to the gateway, where another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, "This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth."
chapters.nkjv: And when he had gone out to the gateway, another girl saw him and said to those whowere there, "This fellow also was with Jesus of Nazareth."
chapters.kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

chapters.ml: ആ മനുഷ്യനെ ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു അവൻ രണ്ടാമതും ആണയോടെ തള്ളിപ്പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He denied it again, with an oath: "I don’t know the man!"
chapters.nkjv: But again he denied with an oath, "I do not know the Man!"
chapters.kjv: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

chapters.ml: അല്പനേരം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവിടെ നിന്നവർ അടുത്തുവന്നു പത്രൊസിനോടു: നീയും അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ഉള്ളവൻ സത്യം; നിന്റെ ഉച്ചാരണവും നിന്നെ വെളിവാക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, "Surely you are one of them; your accent gives you away."
chapters.nkjv: And a little later those who stood by came up and said to Peter, "Surely you also are one of them, for your speech betrays you."
chapters.kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: ആ മനുഷ്യനെ ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു പ്രാകുവാനും ആണയിടുവാനും തുടങ്ങി; ഉടനെ കോഴി കൂകി.
chapters.niv: Then he began to call down curses, and he swore to them, "I don’t know the man!" Immediately a rooster crowed.
chapters.nkjv: Then he began to curse and swear, saying, "I do not know the Man!" Immediately a rooster crowed.
chapters.kjv: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying , I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ: “കോഴി കൂകുമുമ്പേ നീ മൂന്നു വട്ടം എന്നെ തള്ളിപ്പറയും” എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു പത്രൊസ് ഓർത്തു പുറത്തു പോയി അതി ദുഃഖത്തോടെ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: "Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times." And he went outside and wept bitterly.
chapters.nkjv: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus who had said to him, "Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times." So he went out and wept bitterly.
chapters.kjv: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

chapters.ml: പുലർച്ചെക്കു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ജനത്തിന്റെ മൂപ്പന്മാരും എല്ലാം യേശുവിനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ കൂടിവിചാരിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people made their plans how to have Jesus executed.
chapters.nkjv: When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people plotted against Jesus to put Him to death.
chapters.kjv: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

chapters.ml: അവനെ ബന്ധിച്ചു കെണ്ടുപോയി നാടുവാഴിയായ പീലാത്തൊസിനെ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate the governor.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had bound Him, they led Him away and delivered Him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
chapters.kjv: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ശിക്ഷെക്കു വിധിച്ചു എന്നു അവനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുത്ത യൂദാ കണ്ടു അനുതപിച്ചു, ആ മുപ്പതു വെള്ളിക്കാശ് മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെയും മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെയും അടുക്കൽ മടക്കി കൊണ്ടുവന്നു:
chapters.niv: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was seized with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judas, His betrayer, seeing that He had been condemned, was remorseful and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
chapters.kjv: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കുററമില്ലാത്ത രക്തത്തെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുത്തതിനാൽ പാപം ചെയ്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു? നീ തന്നേ നോക്കിക്കൊൾക എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I have sinned," he said, "for I have betrayed innocent blood." "What is that to us?" they replied. "That’s your responsibility."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "I have sinned by betraying innocent blood." And they said, "What isthat to us? You see toit!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that .

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ വെള്ളിക്കാശ് മന്ദിരത്തിൽ എറിഞ്ഞു, ചെന്നു കെട്ടിഞാന്നു ചത്തുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
chapters.nkjv: Then he threw down the pieces of silver in the temple and departed, and went and hanged himself.
chapters.kjv: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ ആ വെള്ളിക്കാശ് എടുത്തു: ഇതു രക്തവിലയാകയാൽ ശ്രീഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽ ഇടുന്നതു വിഹിതമല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു കൂടി ആലോചിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, "It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money."
chapters.nkjv: But the chief priests took the silver pieces and said, "It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, because they are the price of blood."
chapters.kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

chapters.ml: പരദേശികളെ കുഴിച്ചിടുവാൻ അതുകൊണ്ടു കുശവന്റെ നിലം വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.
chapters.nkjv: And they consulted together and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
chapters.kjv: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ആ നിലത്തിന്നു ഇന്നുവരെ രക്തനിലം എന്നു പേർ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore that field has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

chapters.ml: “യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ വിലമതിച്ചവന്റെ വിലയായ മുപ്പതു വെള്ളിക്കാശു അവർ എടുത്തു,
chapters.niv: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: "They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on him by the people of Israel,
chapters.nkjv: Then was fulfilled what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying, "And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the value of Him who was priced, whom they of the children of Israel priced,
chapters.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തുപോലെ കുശവന്റെ നിലത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി കൊടുത്തു.” എന്നു യിരെമ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതിന്നു അന്നു നിവൃത്തിവന്നു..
chapters.niv: and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me."
chapters.nkjv: and gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord directed me."
chapters.kjv: And gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യേശു നാടുവാഴിയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നിന്നു നീ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവോ എന്നു നാടുവാഴി ചോദിച്ചു; “ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു” എന്നു യേശു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?" "You have said so," Jesus replied.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jesus stood before the governor. And the governor asked Him, saying, "Are You the King of the Jews?" Jesus said to him, "It is as you say."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുകയിൽ അവൻ ഒന്നും ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.
chapters.nkjv: And while He was being accused by the chief priests and elders, He answered nothing.
chapters.kjv: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവനോടു: ഇവർ നിന്റെ നേരെ എന്തെല്ലാം സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു എന്നു കേൾക്കുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Pilate asked him, "Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate said to Him, "Do You not hear how many things they testify against You?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു വാക്കിന്നും ഉത്തരം പറയായ്കയാൽ നാടുവാഴി അത്യന്തം ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.
chapters.nkjv: But He answered him not one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
chapters.kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഉത്സവസമയത്തു പുരുഷാരം ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്ന ഒരു തടവുകാരനെ നാടുവാഴി വിട്ടയക്കപതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now it was the governor’s custom at the festival to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.
chapters.nkjv: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to releasing to the multitude one prisoner whom they wished.
chapters.kjv: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ബറബ്ബാസ് എന്ന ശ്രുതിപ്പെട്ടോരു തടവുകാരൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.
chapters.nkjv: And at that time they had a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.
chapters.kjv: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

chapters.ml: അവർ കൂടിവന്നപ്പോൾ പീലാത്തൊസ് അവരോടു: ബറബ്ബാസിനെയോ, ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു പറയുന്ന യേശുവിനെയോ, ആരെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു വിട്ടുതരേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you: Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when they had gathered together, Pilate said to them, "Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"
chapters.kjv: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?

chapters.ml: അവർ അസൂയകൊണ്ടാകുന്നു അവനെ ഏല്പിച്ചതു എന്നു അവൻ ഗ്രഹിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.
chapters.nkjv: For he knew that they had handed Him over because of envy.
chapters.kjv: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ന്യായാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ ആളയച്ചു: ആ നീതിമാന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ ഇടപെടരുതു; അവൻ നിമിത്തം ഞാൻ ഇന്നു സ്വപ്നത്തിൽ വളരെ കഷ്ടം സഹിച്ചു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: While Pilate was sitting on the judge’s seat, his wife sent him this message: "Don’t have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him."
chapters.nkjv: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, "Have nothing to do with that just Man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of Him."
chapters.kjv: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ബറബ്ബാസിനെ ചോദിപ്പാനും യേശുവിനെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാനും മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും പുരുഷാരത്തെ സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.
chapters.nkjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitudes that they should ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
chapters.kjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

chapters.ml: നാടുവാഴി അവരോടു: ഈ ഇരുവരിൽ ഏവനെ വിട്ടുതരേണമെന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു ബറബ്ബാസിനെ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" asked the governor. "Barabbas," they answered.
chapters.nkjv: The governor answered and said to them, "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" They said, "Barabbas!"
chapters.kjv: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവരോടു: എന്നാൽ ക്രിസ്തു എന്ന യേശുവിനെ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്കേണം എന്നു എല്ലാവരും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called the Messiah?" Pilate asked. They all answered, "Crucify him!"
chapters.nkjv: Pilate said to them, "What then shall I do with Jesus who is called Christ?" They all said to him, "Let Him be crucified!"
chapters.kjv: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെയ്ത ദോഷം എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു. അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്കേണം എന്നു അവർ ഏറ്റവും നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the governor said, "Why, what evil has He done?" But they cried out all the more, saying, "Let Him be crucified!"
chapters.kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

chapters.ml: ആരവാരം അധികമാകുന്നതല്ലാതെ ഒന്നും സാധിക്കുന്നില്ല എന്നു പീലാത്തൊസ് കണ്ടിട്ടുവെള്ളം എടുത്തു പുരുഷാരം കാൺകെ കൈ കഴുകി: ഈ നീതിമാന്റെ രക്തത്തിൽ എനിക്കു കുറ്റം ഇല്ല; നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ നോക്കിക്കൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. "I am innocent of this man’s blood," he said. "It is your responsibility!"
chapters.nkjv: When Pilate saw that he could not prevail at all, but rather that a tumult was rising, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, "I am innocent of the blood of this just Person. You see toit."
chapters.kjv: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it .

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ രക്തം ഞങ്ങളുടെമേലും ഞങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളുടെ മേലും വരട്ടെ എന്നു ജനം ഒക്കെയും ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All the people answered, "His blood is on us and on our children!"
chapters.nkjv: And all the people answered and said, "His blood be on us and on our children."
chapters.kjv: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ബറബ്ബാസിനെ അവർക്കു വിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു, യേശുവിനെ ചമ്മട്ടി കൊണ്ടടിപ്പിച്ചു ക്രൂശിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
chapters.nkjv: Then he released Barabbas to them; and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered Him to be crucified.
chapters.kjv: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം നാടുവാഴിയുടെ പടയാളികൾ യേശുവിനെ ആസ്ഥാനത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി പട്ടാളത്തെ എല്ലാം അവന്റെ നേരെ വരുത്തി,
chapters.niv: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.
chapters.nkjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole garrison around Him.
chapters.kjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers .

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം അഴിച്ചു ഒരു ചുവന്ന മേലങ്കി ധരപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
chapters.nkjv: And they stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.
chapters.kjv: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

chapters.ml: മുള്ളുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു കിരീടം മെടഞ്ഞു അവന്റെ തലയിൽ വെച്ചു, വലങ്കയ്യിൽ ഒരു കോലും കൊടുത്തു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ മുട്ടുകുത്തി: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവേ, ജയജയ എന്നു പരിഹസിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand. Then they knelt in front of him and mocked him. "Hail, king of the Jews!" they said.
chapters.nkjv: When they had twisted a crown of thorns, they put it on His head, and a reed in His right hand. And they bowed the knee before Him and mocked Him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
chapters.kjv: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവന്റെമേൽ തുപ്പി, കോൽ എടുത്തു അവന്റെ തലയിൽ അടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.
chapters.nkjv: Then they spat on Him, and took the reed and struck Him on the head.
chapters.kjv: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.

chapters.ml: അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചുതീർന്നപ്പോൾ മേലങ്കി നീക്കി അവന്റെ സ്വന്തവസ്ത്രം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു, ക്രൂശിപ്പാൻ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had mocked Him, they took the robe off Him, put His own clothes on Him, and led Him away to be crucified.
chapters.kjv: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him .

chapters.ml: അവർ പോകുമ്പോൾ ശീമോൻ എന്നു പേരുള്ള കുറേനക്കാരനെ കണ്ടു, അവന്റെ ക്രൂശ് ചുമപ്പാൻ നിർബന്ധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.
chapters.nkjv: Now as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name. Him they compelled to bear His cross.
chapters.kjv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

chapters.ml: തലയോടിടം എന്നർത്ഥമുള്ള ഗൊല്ഗോഥാ എന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവന്നു കൈപ്പു കലക്കിയ വീഞ്ഞു കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുത്തു;
chapters.niv: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means "the place of the skull").
chapters.nkjv: And when they had come to a place called Golgotha, that is to say, Place of a Skull,
chapters.kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

chapters.ml: അതു രുചിനോക്കിയാറെ അവന്നു കുടിപ്പാൻ മനസ്സായില്ല.
chapters.niv: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.
chapters.nkjv: they gave Him sour wine mingled with gall to drink. But when He had tasted it, He would not drink.
chapters.kjv: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof , he would not drink.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ക്രൂശിൽ തറെച്ചശേഷം അവർ ചീട്ടിട്ടു അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം പകുത്തെടുത്തു,
chapters.niv: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
chapters.nkjv: Then they crucified Him, and divided His garments, casting lots, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet: "They divided My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots."
chapters.kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ഇരുന്നുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ കാത്തു.
chapters.niv: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.
chapters.nkjv: Sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.
chapters.kjv: And sitting down they watched him there;

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവായ യേശു എന്നു അവന്റെ കുറ്റസംഗതി എഴുതി അവന്റെ തലെക്കുമീതെ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: this is jesus, the king of the jews.
chapters.nkjv: And they put up over His head the accusation written against Him: THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.kjv: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chapters.ml: വലത്തും ഇടത്തുമായി രണ്ടു കള്ളന്മാരെയും അവനോടു കൂടെ ക്രൂശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
chapters.nkjv: Then two robbers were crucified with Him, one on the right and another on the left.
chapters.kjv: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

chapters.ml: കടന്നുപോകുന്നുവർ തല കലുക്കി അവനെ ദുഷിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads
chapters.nkjv: And those who passed by blasphemed Him, wagging their heads
chapters.kjv: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

chapters.ml: മന്ദിരം പൊളിച്ചു മൂന്നു നാൾ കൊണ്ടു പണിയുന്നവനേ, നിന്നെത്തന്നേ രക്ഷിക്ക; ദൈവപുത്രൻ എങ്കിൽ ക്രൂശിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and saying, "You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!"
chapters.nkjv: and saying, "You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross."
chapters.kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും പരിഹസിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.
chapters.nkjv: Likewise the chief priests also, mocking with the scribes and elders, said,
chapters.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him , with the scribes and elders, said,

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ മറ്റുള്ളവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു, തന്നെത്താൻ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാവു ആകുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ക്രൂശിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവരട്ടെ; എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "He saved others," they said, "but he can’t save himself! He’s the king of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.
chapters.nkjv: "He saved others; Himself He cannot save. If He is the King of Israel, let Him now come down from the cross, and we will believe Him.
chapters.kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവത്തിൽ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്നു; അവന്നു ഇവനിൽ പ്രസാദമുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഇപ്പോൾ വിടുവിക്കട്ടെ; ഞാൻ ദൈവപുത്രൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ "
chapters.nkjv: He trusted in God; let Him deliver Him now if He will have Him; for He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ "
chapters.kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവനോടുകൂടെ ക്രൂശിച്ചിരുന്ന കള്ളന്മാരും അവനെ നിന്ദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
chapters.nkjv: Even the robbers who were crucified with Him reviled Him with the same thing.
chapters.kjv: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

chapters.ml: ആറാംമണി നേരംമുതൽ ഒമ്പതാംമണി നേരംവരെ ദേശത്തു എല്ലാം ഇരുട്ടുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.
chapters.nkjv: Now from the sixth hour until the ninth hour there was darkness over all the land.
chapters.kjv: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.

chapters.ml: ഏകദേശം ഒമ്പതാംമണി നേരത്തു യേശു: “ഏലീ, ഏലീ, ലമ്മാ ശബക്താനി” എന്നു ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു; “എന്റെ ദൈവമേ, എന്റെ ദൈവമേ, നീ എന്നെ കൈവിട്ടതു എന്തു” എന്നർത്ഥം.
chapters.niv: About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?" (which means "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?").
chapters.nkjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?" that is, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"
chapters.kjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നിരുന്നവരിൽ ചിലർ അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു; അവൻ ഏലീയാവെ വിളിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "He’s calling Elijah."
chapters.nkjv: Some of those who stood there, when they heard that, said, "This Man is calling for Elijah!"
chapters.kjv: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that , said, This man calleth for Elias.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ഓടി ഒരു സ്പോങ്ങ് എടുത്തു പുളിച്ച വീഞ്ഞു നിറെച്ചു ഓടത്തണ്ടിന്മേൽ ആക്കി അവന്നു കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with sour wine and put it on a reed, and offered it to Him to drink.
chapters.kjv: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

chapters.ml: ശേഷമുള്ളവർ: നിൽക്ക; ഏലീയാവു അവനെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ വരുമോ എന്നു നോക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The rest said, "Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him."
chapters.nkjv: The rest said, "Let Him alone; let us see if Elijah will come to save Him."
chapters.kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

chapters.ml: യേശു പിന്നെയും ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus cried out again with a loud voice, and yielded up His spirit.
chapters.kjv: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മന്ദിരത്തിലെ തിരശ്ശില മേൽതൊട്ടു അടിയോളം രണ്ടായി ചീന്തിപ്പോയി;
chapters.niv: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split
chapters.nkjv: Then, behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom; and the earth quaked, and the rocks were split,
chapters.kjv: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

chapters.ml: ഭൂമി കുലുങ്ങി, പാറകൾ പിളർന്നു, കല്ലറകൾ തുറന്നു, നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ച വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ ശരീരങ്ങൾ പലതും ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു
chapters.niv: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.
chapters.nkjv: and the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
chapters.kjv: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിന്റെ ശേഷം കല്ലറകളെ വിട്ടു, വിശുദ്ധനഗരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു പലർക്കും പ്രത്യക്ഷമായി.
chapters.niv: They came out of the tombs after Jesus’ resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.
chapters.nkjv: and coming out of the graves after His resurrection, they went into the holy city and appeared to many.
chapters.kjv: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

chapters.ml: ശതാധിപനും അവനോടുകൂടെ യേശുവിനെ കാത്തുനിന്നവരും ഭൂകമ്പം മുതലായി സംഭവിച്ചതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: അവൻ ദൈവ പുത്രൻ ആയിരുന്നു സത്യം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, "Surely he was the Son of God!"
chapters.nkjv: So when the centurion and those with him, who were guarding Jesus, saw the earthquake and the things that had happened, they feared greatly, saying, "Truly this was the Son of God!"
chapters.kjv: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

chapters.ml: ഗലീലയിൽ നിന്നു യേശുവിനെ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അനുഗമിച്ചുവന്ന പല സ്ത്രീകളും ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.
chapters.nkjv: And many women who followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to Him, were there looking on from afar,
chapters.kjv: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും യാക്കോബിന്റെയും യോസെയുടെയും അമ്മയായ മറിയയും സെബെദിപുത്രന്മാരുടെ അമ്മയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
chapters.nkjv: among whom were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
chapters.kjv: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യയായപ്പോൾ അരിമഥ്യക്കാരനായ യോസേഫ് എന്ന ധനവാൻ താനും യേശുവിന്റെ ശിഷ്യനായിരിക്കയാൽ വന്നു,
chapters.niv: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Now when evening had come, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who himself had also become a disciple of Jesus.
chapters.kjv: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathæa, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു യേശുവിന്റെ ശരീരം ചോദിച്ചു; പീലത്തൊസ് അതു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
chapters.nkjv: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given to him.
chapters.kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് ശരീരം എടുത്തു നിർമ്മലശീലയിൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞു,
chapters.niv: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
chapters.nkjv: When Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
chapters.kjv: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

chapters.ml: താൻ പാറയിൽ വെട്ടിച്ചിരുന്ന തന്റെ പുതിയ കല്ലറയിൽ വെച്ചു കല്ലറയുടെ വാതിൽക്കൽ ഒരു വലിയ കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടിവെച്ചിട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.
chapters.nkjv: and laid it in his new tomb which he had hewn out of the rock; and he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
chapters.kjv: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

chapters.ml: കല്ലറെക്കു എതിരെ മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും മറ്റെ മറിയയും ഇരുന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
chapters.nkjv: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
chapters.kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

chapters.ml: ഒരുക്കനാളിന്റെ പിറ്റെ ദിവസം മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും പരീശന്മാരും പീലാത്തൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നുകൂടി:
chapters.niv: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.
chapters.nkjv: On the next day, which followed the Day of Preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees gathered together to Pilate,
chapters.kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

chapters.ml: യജമാനനേ, ആ ചതിയൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ: മൂന്നുനാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഞാൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞപ്രകാരം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഓർമ്മ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Sir," they said, "we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Sir, we remember, while He was still alive, how that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise.’
chapters.kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ചെന്നു അവനെ മോഷ്ടിച്ചിട്ടു, അവൻ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു എന്നു ജനത്തോടു പറകയും ഒടുവിലത്തെ ചതിവു മുമ്പിലത്തേതിലും വിഷമമായിത്തീരുകയും ചെയ്യാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മൂന്നാം നാൾവരെ കല്ലറ ഉറപ്പാക്കുവാൻ കല്പിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore command that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest His disciples come by night and steal Him away, and say to the people, ‘He has risen from the dead.’ So the last deception will be worse than the first."
chapters.kjv: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവരോടു: കാവൽക്കൂട്ടത്തെ തരാം; പോയി നിങ്ങളാൽ ആകുന്നെടത്തോളം ഉറപ്പുവരുത്തുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Take a guard," Pilate answered. "Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how."
chapters.nkjv: Pilate said to them, "You have a guard; go your way, make it as secure as you know how."
chapters.kjv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

chapters.ml: അവർ ചെന്നു കല്ലിന്നു മുദ്രവെച്ചു കാവൽക്കൂട്ടത്തെ നിറുത്തി കല്ലറ ഉറപ്പാക്കി.
chapters.niv: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.
chapters.nkjv: So they went and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone and setting the guard.
chapters.kjv: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.

chapters.ml: ശബ്ബത്തു കഴിഞ്ഞു ആഴ്ചവട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം ദിവസം വെളുക്കുമ്പോൾ മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും മറ്റെ മറിയയും കല്ലറ കാണ്മാൻ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.
chapters.nkjv: Now after the Sabbath, as the first day of the week began to dawn, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
chapters.kjv: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു വലിയോരു ഭൂകമ്പം ഉണ്ടായി; കർത്താവിന്റെ ദൂതൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു, കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടിനീക്കി അതിന്മേൽ ഇരുന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat on it.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ രൂപം മിന്നലിന്നു ഒത്തതും അവന്റെ ഉടുപ്പു ഹിമം പോലെ വെളുത്തതും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
chapters.nkjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his clothing as white as snow.
chapters.kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

chapters.ml: കാവൽക്കാർ അവനെ കണ്ടു പേടിച്ചു വിറെച്ചു മരിച്ചവരെപ്പോലെ ആയി.
chapters.niv: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.
chapters.nkjv: And the guards shook for fear of him, and became like dead men.
chapters.kjv: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men .

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ സ്ത്രീകളോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ക്രൂശിക്കപ്പെട്ട യേശുവിനെ നിങ്ങൾ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു;
chapters.niv: The angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
chapters.nkjv: But the angel answered and said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.
chapters.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇവിടെ ഇല്ല; താൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു; അവൻ കിടന്ന സ്ഥലം വന്നുകാണ്മിൻ
chapters.niv: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
chapters.nkjv: He is not here; for He is risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
chapters.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു എന്നു വേഗം ചെന്നു അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു പറവിൻ; അവൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പെ ഗലീലെക്കു പോകുന്നു; അവിടെ നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ കാണും; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Now I have told you."
chapters.nkjv: And go quickly and tell His disciples that He is risen from the dead, and indeed He is going before you into Galilee; there you will see Him. Behold, I have told you."
chapters.kjv: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ വേഗത്തിൽ ഭയത്തോടും മഹാസന്തോഷത്തോടും കൂടി കല്ലറ വിട്ടു അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു അറിയിപ്പാൻ ഓടിപ്പോയി. എന്നാൽ യേശു അവരെ എതിരെറ്റു:
chapters.niv: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
chapters.nkjv: So they went out quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring His disciples word.
chapters.kjv: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങൾക്കു വന്ദനം” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ അടുത്തുചെന്നു അവന്റെ കാൽ പിടിച്ചു അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Suddenly Jesus met them. "Greetings," he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.
chapters.nkjv: And as they went to tell His disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, "Rejoice!" So they came and held Him by the feet and worshiped Him.
chapters.kjv: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ട; നിങ്ങൾ പോയി എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു ഗലീലെക്കു പോകുവാൻ പറവിൻ; അവിടെ അവർ എന്നെ കാണും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell My brethren to go to Galilee, and there they will see Me."
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോകുമ്പോൾ കാവൽക്കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ചിലർ നഗരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു സംഭവിച്ചതു എല്ലാം മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
chapters.nkjv: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests all the things that had happened.
chapters.kjv: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി മൂപ്പന്മാരുമായി ആലോചനകഴിച്ചിട്ടു പടയാളികൾക്കു വേണ്ടുവോളം പണം കൊടുത്തു;
chapters.niv: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,
chapters.nkjv: When they had assembled with the elders and consulted together, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,
chapters.kjv: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ രാത്രിയിൽ വന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ ഉറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ അവനെ കട്ടുകൊണ്ടുപോയി എന്നു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: telling them, "You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Tell them, ‘His disciples came at night and stole Him away while we slept.’
chapters.kjv: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

chapters.ml: വസ്തുത നാടുവാഴിയുടെ സന്നിധാനത്തിൽ എത്തി എങ്കിലോ ഞങ്ങൾ അവനെ സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചു നിങ്ങളെ നിർഭയരാക്കിക്കൊള്ളാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."
chapters.nkjv: And if this comes to the governor’s ears, we will appease him and make you secure."
chapters.kjv: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

chapters.ml: അവർ പണം വാങ്ങി ഉപദേശപ്രകാരം ചെയ്തു; ഈ കഥ ഇന്നുവരെ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പരക്കെ നടപ്പായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.
chapters.nkjv: So they took the money and did as they were instructed; and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
chapters.kjv: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പതിനൊന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഗലീലയിൽ യേശു അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചിരുന്ന മലെക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
chapters.nkjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, to the mountain which Jesus had appointed for them.
chapters.kjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ നമസ്കരിച്ചു; ചിലരോ സംശയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.
chapters.nkjv: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him; but some doubted.
chapters.kjv: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

chapters.ml: യേശു അടുത്തുചെന്നു: “സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലും ഭൂമിയിലും സകല അധികാരവും എനിക്കു നല്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, "All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു, പിതാവിന്റെയും പുത്രന്റെയും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിന്റെയും നാമത്തിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും പ്രമാണിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഉപദേശിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു സകലജാതികളെയും ശിഷ്യരാക്കിക്കൊൾവിൻ;
chapters.niv: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
chapters.nkjv: Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
chapters.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ ലോകാവസാനത്തോളം എല്ലാനാളും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു” എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age."
chapters.nkjv: teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age." Amen.
chapters.kjv: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

chapters.ml: ദൈവപുത്രനായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ സുവിശേഷത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭം:
chapters.niv: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,
chapters.nkjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
chapters.kjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ നിനക്കു മുമ്പായി എന്റെ ദൂതനെ അയക്കുന്നു; അവൻ നിന്റെ വഴി ഒരുക്കും.
chapters.niv: as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: "I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way" —
chapters.nkjv: As it is written in the Prophets: "Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, Who will prepare Your way before You."
chapters.kjv: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ വഴി ഒരുക്കുവിൻ അവന്റെ പാത നിരപ്പാക്കുവിൻ എന്നു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വിളിച്ചുപറയുന്നവന്റെ വാക്കു” എന്നിങ്ങനെ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്റെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ യോഹന്നാൻ വന്നു
chapters.niv: "a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; Make His paths straight.’ "
chapters.kjv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

chapters.ml: മരുഭൂമിയിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചും പാപമോചനത്തിന്നായുള്ള മാനസാന്തരസ്നാനം പ്രസംഗിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And so John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.nkjv: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
chapters.kjv: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ യെഹൂദ്യദേശം ഒക്കെയും യെരൂശലേമ്യർ എല്ലാവരും വന്നു പാപങ്ങളെ ഏറ്റുപറഞ്ഞു യോർദ്ദാൻ നദിയിൽ അവനാൽ സ്നാനം കഴിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the land of Judea, and those from Jerusalem, went out to him and were all baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.
chapters.kjv: And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാനോ ഒട്ടക രോമംകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഉടുപ്പും അരയിൽ തോൽ വാറും ധരിച്ചും വെട്ടുക്കിളിയും കാട്ടുതേനും ഉപജീവിച്ചും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: John wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
chapters.nkjv: Now John was clothed with camel’s hair and with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
chapters.kjv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

chapters.ml: എന്നിലും ബലമേറിയവൻ എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു; അവന്റെ ചെരിപ്പിന്റെ വാറു കുനിഞ്ഞഴിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ യോഗ്യനല്ല.
chapters.niv: And this was his message: "After me comes the one more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
chapters.nkjv: And he preached, saying, "There comes One after me who is mightier than I, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to stoop down and loose.
chapters.kjv: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ വെള്ളത്തിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; അവനോ നിങ്ങളെ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കും എന്നു അവൻ പ്രസംഗിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
chapters.nkjv: I indeed baptized you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
chapters.kjv: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യേശു ഗലീലയിലെ നസറെത്തിൽ നിന്നു വന്നു യോഹന്നാനാൽ യോർദ്ദാനിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
chapters.nkjv: It came to pass in those days that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളത്തിൽ നിന്നു കയറിയ ഉടനെ ആകാശം പിളരുന്നതും ആത്മാവു പ്രാവുപോലെ തന്റെ മേൽ വരുന്നതും കണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: Just as Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
chapters.nkjv: And immediately, coming up from the water, He saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending upon Him like a dove.
chapters.kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ പ്രിയപുത്രൻ; നിന്നിൽ ഞാൻ പ്രസാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദവും ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."
chapters.nkjv: Then a voice came from heaven, "You are My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."
chapters.kjv: And there came a voice from heaven, saying , Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ആത്മാവു അവനെ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ നിർബന്ധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,
chapters.nkjv: Immediately the Spirit drove Him into the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവൻ സാത്താനാൽ പരീക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ടു നാല്പതു ദിവസം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു; ദൂതന്മാർ അവനെ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: and he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.
chapters.nkjv: And He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan, and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered to Him.
chapters.kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യോഹന്നാൻ തടവിൽ ആയശേഷം യേശു ഗലീലയിൽ ചെന്നു ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിന്റെ സുവിശേഷം പ്രസംഗിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.
chapters.nkjv: Now after John was put in prison, Jesus came to Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
chapters.kjv: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

chapters.ml: “കാലം തികഞ്ഞു ദൈവരാജ്യം സമീപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടു സുവിശേഷത്തിൽ വിശ്വസിപ്പിൻ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The time has come," he said. "The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!"
chapters.nkjv: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand. Repent, and believe in the gospel."
chapters.kjv: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഗലീലക്കടല്പുറത്തു നടക്കുമ്പോൾ ശീമോനും അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അന്ത്രെയാസും കടലിൽ വല വീശുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അവർ മീൻ പിടിക്കുന്നവർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.
chapters.nkjv: And as He walked by the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
chapters.kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “എന്നെ അനുഗമിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ മനുഷ്യരെ പിടിക്കുന്നവരാക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Come, follow me," Jesus said, "and I will send you out to fish for people."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Follow Me, and I will make you become fishers of men."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവർ വല വിട്ടു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At once they left their nets and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: They immediately left their nets and followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നു അല്പം മുന്നോട്ടു ചെന്നപ്പോൾ സെബെദിയുടെ മകനായ യാക്കോബും അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യോഹന്നാനും പടകിൽ ഇരുന്നു വല നന്നാക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.
chapters.nkjv: When He had gone a little farther from there, He saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending their nets.
chapters.kjv: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവരെയും വിളിച്ചു; അവർ അപ്പനായ സെബെദിയെ കൂലിക്കാരോടുകൂടെ പടകിൽ വിട്ടു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: And immediately He called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after Him.
chapters.kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

chapters.ml: അവർ കഫർന്നഹൂമിലേക്കു പോയി; ശബ്ബത്തിൽ അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു ഉപദേശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.
chapters.nkjv: Then they went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath He entered the synagogue and taught.
chapters.kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഉപദേശത്തിങ്കൽ അവർ വിസ്മയിച്ചു; അവൻ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരെപ്പോലെയല്ല, അധികാരമുള്ളവനായിട്ടത്രേ അവരെ ഉപദേശിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority, not as the teachers of the law.
chapters.nkjv: And they were astonished at His teaching, for He taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
chapters.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പള്ളിയിൽ അശുദ്ധാത്മാവുള്ള ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ നിലവിളിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a man in their synagogue with an unclean spirit. And he cried out,
chapters.kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

chapters.ml: നസറായനായ യേശുവേ, ഞങ്ങൾക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? ഞങ്ങളെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ വന്നുവോ? നീ ആർ എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പിരിശുദ്ധൻ തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Let us alone! What have we to do with You, Jesus of Nazareth? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

chapters.ml: യേശു അതിനെ ശാസിച്ചു: “ മിണ്ടരുതു; അവനെ വിട്ടുപോ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Be quiet!" said Jesus sternly. "Come out of him!"
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!"
chapters.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അശുദ്ധാത്മാവു അവനെ ഇഴെച്ചു, ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു അവനെ വിട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.
chapters.nkjv: And when the unclean spirit had convulsed him and cried out with a loud voice, he came out of him.
chapters.kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു: ഇതെന്തു? ഒരു പുതിയ ഉപദേശം; അവൻ അധികാരത്തോടെ അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കളോടും കല്പിക്കുന്നു; അവ അവനെ അനുസരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തമ്മിൽ വാദിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The people were all so amazed that they asked each other, "What is this? A new teaching—and with authority! He even gives orders to impure spirits and they obey him."
chapters.nkjv: Then they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, "What is this? What new doctrine is this? For with authority He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him."
chapters.kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശ്രുതി വേഗത്തിൽ ഗലീലനാടു എങ്ങും പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.
chapters.nkjv: And immediately His fame spread throughout all the region around Galilee.
chapters.kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ പള്ളിയിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി യാക്കോബും യോഹന്നാനുമായി ശിമോന്റെയും അന്ത്രെയാസിന്റെയും വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
chapters.nkjv: Now as soon as they had come out of the synagogue, they entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
chapters.kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ശിമോന്റെ അമ്മാവിയമ്മ പനിപിടിച്ചു കിടന്നിരുന്നു; അവർ അവളെക്കുറിച്ചു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.
chapters.nkjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and they told Him about her at once.
chapters.kjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അടുത്തു ചെന്നു അവളെ കൈക്കുപിടിച്ചു എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു; പനി അവളെ വിട്ടുമാറി, അവൾ അവരെ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.
chapters.nkjv: So He came and took her by the hand and lifted her up, and immediately the fever left her. And she served them.
chapters.kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

chapters.ml: വൈകുന്നേരം സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിച്ചശേഷം അവർ സകലവിധദീനക്കാരെയും ഭൂതഗ്രസ്തരെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.
chapters.nkjv: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to Him all who were sick and those who were demon-possessed.
chapters.kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണം ഒക്കെയും വാതിൽക്കൽ വന്നു കൂടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The whole town gathered at the door,
chapters.nkjv: And the whole city was gathered together at the door.
chapters.kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

chapters.ml: നാനവ്യാധികളാൽ വലഞ്ഞിരുന്ന അനേകരെ അവൻ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി, അനേകം ഭൂതങ്ങളെയും പുറത്താക്കി; ഭൂതങ്ങൾ അവനെ അറികകൊണ്ടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ അവയെ സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.
chapters.nkjv: Then He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and He did not allow the demons to speak, because they knew Him.
chapters.kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

chapters.ml: അതികാലത്തു ഇരുട്ടോടെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഒരു നിർജ്ജനസ്ഥലത്തു ചെന്നു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the morning, having risen a long while before daylight, He went out and departed to a solitary place; and there He prayed.
chapters.kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

chapters.ml: ശിമോനും കൂടെയുള്ളവരും അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു,
chapters.niv: Simon and his companions went to look for him,
chapters.nkjv: And Simon and those whowere with Him searched for Him.
chapters.kjv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: എല്ലാവരും നിന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and when they found him, they exclaimed: "Everyone is looking for you!"
chapters.nkjv: When they found Him, they said to Him, "Everyone is looking for You."
chapters.kjv: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ അടുത്ത ഊരുകളിലും പ്രസംഗിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നാം അവിടേക്കു പോക; ഇതിന്നായിട്ടല്ലോ ഞാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Let us go somewhere else—to the nearby villages—so I can preach there also. That is why I have come."
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because for this purpose I have come forth."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ഗലീലയിൽ ഒക്കെയും അവരുടെ പള്ളികളിൽ ചെന്നു പ്രസംഗിക്കയും ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
chapters.nkjv: And He was preaching in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and casting out demons.
chapters.kjv: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

chapters.ml: ഒരു കുഷ്ഠരോഗി അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു മുട്ടുകുത്തി: നിനക്കു മനസ്സുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ എന്നെ ശുദ്ധമാക്കുവാൻ കഴിയും എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A man with leprosy came to him and begged him on his knees, "If you are willing, you can make me clean."
chapters.nkjv: Now a leper came to Him, imploring Him, kneeling down to Him and saying to Him, "If You are willing, You can make me clean."
chapters.kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

chapters.ml: യേശു മനസ്സലിഞ്ഞു കൈ നീട്ടി അവനെ തൊട്ടു:
chapters.niv: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus, moved with compassion, stretched out His hand and touched him, and said to him, "I am willing; be cleansed."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

chapters.ml: മനസ്സുണ്ടു, ശുദ്ധമാക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞ ഉടനെ കുഷ്ഠം വിട്ടുമാറി അവന്നു ശുദ്ധിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.
chapters.nkjv: As soon as He had spoken, immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.
chapters.kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനെ അമർച്ചയായി ശാസിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:
chapters.nkjv: And He strictly warned him and sent him away at once,
chapters.kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

chapters.ml: “നോക്കു, ആരോടും ഒന്നും പറയരുതു; എന്നാൽ ചെന്നു പുരോഹിതന്നു നിന്നെത്തന്നേ കാണിച്ചു, നിന്റെ ശുദ്ധീകരണത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി മോശെ കല്പിച്ചതു അവർക്കു സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്നായി അർപ്പിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ വിട്ടയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "See that you don’t tell this to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them."
chapters.nkjv: and said to him, "See that you say nothing to anyone; but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing those things which Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
chapters.kjv: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

chapters.ml: അവനോ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വളരെ ഘോഷിപ്പാനും വസ്തുത പ്രസംഗിപ്പാനും തുടങ്ങി; അതിനാൽ യേശുവിന്നു പരസ്യമായി പട്ടണത്തിൽ കടപ്പാൻ കഴിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ പുറത്തു നിർജ്ജനസ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ പാർത്തു; എല്ലാടത്തു നിന്നും ആളുകൾ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു കൂടി.
chapters.niv: Instead he went out and began to talk freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer enter a town openly but stayed outside in lonely places. Yet the people still came to him from everywhere.
chapters.nkjv: However, he went out and began to proclaim it freely, and to spread the matter, so that Jesus could no longer openly enter the city, but was outside in deserted places; and they came to Him from every direction.
chapters.kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

chapters.ml: ചില ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം അവൻ പിന്നെയും കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ ചെന്നു; അവൻ വീട്ടിൽ ഉണ്ടെന്നു ശ്രുതിയായി.
chapters.niv: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.
chapters.nkjv: And again He entered Capernaum after some days, and it was heard that He was in the house.
chapters.kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ വാതിൽക്കൽപോലും ഇടമില്ലാത്തവണ്ണം പലരും വന്നു കൂടി, അവൻ അവരോടു തിരുവചനം പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They gathered in such large numbers that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately many gathered together, so that there was no longer room to receive them, not even near the door. And He preached the word to them.
chapters.kjv: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ നാലാൾ ഒരു പക്ഷവാതക്കാരനെ ചുമന്നു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to Him, bringing a paralytic who was carried by four men.
chapters.kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം നിമിത്തം അവനോടു സമീപിച്ചു കൂടായ്കയാൽ അവൻ ഇരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തിന്റെ മേല്പുര പൊളിച്ചു തുറന്നു, പക്ഷവാതക്കാരനെ കിടക്കയോടെ ഇറക്കി വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus by digging through it and then lowered the mat the man was lying on.
chapters.nkjv: And when they could not come near Him because of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where He was. So when they had broken through, they let down the bed on which the paralytic was lying.
chapters.kjv: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരുടെ വിശ്വാസം കണ്ടിട്ടു പക്ഷവാതക്കാരനോടു: “മകനേ, നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾ മോചിച്ചുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, "Son, your sins are forgiven."
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven you."
chapters.kjv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ചില ശാസ്ത്രിമാർ ഇരുന്നു: ഇവൻ ഇങ്ങനെ ദൈവദൂഷണം പറയുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,
chapters.nkjv: And some of the scribes were sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
chapters.kjv: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ഒരുവൻ അല്ലാതെ പാപങ്ങളെ മോചിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നവൻ ആർ എന്നു ഹൃദയത്തിൽ ചിന്തിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
chapters.nkjv: "Why does this Man speak blasphemies like this? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
chapters.kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ ഉള്ളിൽ ചിന്തിക്കുന്നതു യേശു ഉടനെ മനസ്സിൽ ഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ ഇങ്ങനെ ചിന്തിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this was what they were thinking in their hearts, and he said to them, "Why are you thinking these things?
chapters.nkjv: But immediately, when Jesus perceived in His spirit that they reasoned thus within themselves, He said to them, "Why do you reason about these things in your hearts?
chapters.kjv: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

chapters.ml: പക്ഷവാതക്കാരനോടു നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾ മോചിച്ചുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയുന്നതോ, എഴുന്നേറ്റു കിടക്ക എടുത്തു നടക്ക എന്നു പറയുന്നതോ, ഏതാകുന്നു എളുപ്പം” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Which is easier: to say to this paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take your mat and walk’?
chapters.nkjv: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise, take up your bed and walk’?
chapters.kjv: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

chapters.ml: “എന്നാൽ ഭൂമിയിൽ പാപങ്ങളെ മോചിപ്പാൻ മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്നു അധികാരം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു” — അവൻ പക്ഷവാതക്കാരനോടു:
chapters.niv: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins." So he said to the man,
chapters.nkjv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins"—He said to the paralytic,
chapters.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

chapters.ml: “എഴുന്നേറ്റു കിടക്ക എടുത്തു വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോക എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home."
chapters.nkjv: "I say to you, arise, take up your bed, and go to your house."
chapters.kjv: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു കിടക്ക എടുത്തു എല്ലാവരും കാൺകെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അതുകൊണ്ടു എല്ലാവരും വിസ്മയിച്ചു: ഇങ്ങനെ ഒരു നാളും കണ്ടിട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി.
chapters.niv: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, "We have never seen anything like this!"
chapters.nkjv: Immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went out in the presence of them all, so that all were amazed and glorified God, saying, "We never saw anything like this!"
chapters.kjv: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും കടൽക്കരെ ചെന്നു; പുരുഷാരം ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അവൻ അവരെ ഉപദേശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.
chapters.nkjv: Then He went out again by the sea; and all the multitude came to Him, and He taught them.
chapters.kjv: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ കടന്നു പോകുമ്പോൾ അല്ഫായിയുടെ മകനായ ലേവി ചുങ്കസ്ഥലത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു: “എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collector’s booth. "Follow me," Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: As He passed by, He saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me." So he arose and followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വീട്ടിൽ പന്തിയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ പല ചുങ്കക്കാരും പാപികളും യേശുവിനോടും അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടും കൂടി പന്തിയിൽ ഇരുന്നു; അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചുവന്നവർ അനേകർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: While Jesus was having dinner at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as He was dining in Levi’s house, that many tax collectors and sinners also sat together with Jesus and His disciples; for there were many, and they followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചുങ്കക്കാരോടും പാപികളോടും കൂടെ തിന്നുകയും കൂടിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതു പരീശന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലുള്ള ശാസ്ത്രിമാർ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: അവൻ ചുങ്കക്കാരോടും പാപികളോടും കൂടെ തിന്നുകുടിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: "Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
chapters.nkjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw Him eating with the tax collectors and sinners, they said to His disciples, "How isit that He eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?"
chapters.kjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

chapters.ml: യേശു അതു കേട്ടു അവരോടു: “ദീനക്കാർക്കല്ലാതെ സൌഖ്യമുള്ളവർക്കു വൈദ്യനെക്കൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യമില്ല; ഞാൻ നീതിമാന്മാരെ അല്ല, പാപികളെ അത്രേ വിളിപ്പാൻ വന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners."
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus heard it, He said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."
chapters.kjv: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരും പരീശന്മാരും ഉപവസിക്ക പതിവായിരുന്നു; അവർ വന്നു അവനോടു: യോഹന്നാന്റെയും പരീശന്മാരുടെയും ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഉപവസിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; നിന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഉപവസിക്കാത്തതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
