chapters.niv: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, "How is it that John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?"
chapters.nkjv: The disciples of John and of the Pharisees were fasting. Then they came and said to Him, "Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but Your disciples do not fast?"
chapters.kjv: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “മണവാളൻ കൂടെ ഉള്ളപ്പോൾ തോഴ്മക്കാർക്കു ഉപവസിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുമോ? മണവാളൻ കൂടെ ഇരിക്കുംകാലത്തോളം അവർക്കു ഉപവസിപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല.”
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said to them, "Can the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them they cannot fast.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മണവാളൻ അവരെ വിട്ടുപിരിയേണ്ടുന്ന കാലം വരും; അന്നു, ആ കാലത്തു അവർ ഉപവസിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.
chapters.nkjv: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in those days.
chapters.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

chapters.ml: പഴയ വസ്ത്രത്തിൽ കോടിത്തുണിക്കണ്ടം ആരും ചേർത്തു തുന്നുമാറില്ല; തുന്നിയാൽ ചേർത്ത പുതുക്കണ്ടം പഴയതിൽ നിന്നു വലിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ചീന്തൽ ഏറ്റവും വല്ലാതെ ആകും.
chapters.niv: "No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.
chapters.nkjv: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; or else the new piece pulls away from the old, and the tear is made worse.
chapters.kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

chapters.ml: ആരും പുതിയ വീഞ്ഞു പഴയ തുരുത്തിയിൽ പകർന്നു വെക്കുമാറില്ല; വെച്ചാൽ പുതുവീഞ്ഞു തുരുത്തിയെ പൊളിക്കും; വീഞ്ഞു ഒഴുകിപ്പോകും; തുരുത്തി നശിച്ചുപോകും; പുതിയ വീഞ്ഞു പുതിയ തുരുത്തിയിലത്രേ പകർന്നു വെക്കേണ്ടതു.
chapters.niv: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins."
chapters.nkjv: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine bursts the wineskins, the wine is spilled, and the wineskins are ruined. But new wine must be put into new wineskins."
chapters.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ വിളഭൂമിയിൽകൂടി കടന്നുപോകുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ വഴിനടക്കയിൽ കതിർ പറിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened that He went through the grainfields on the Sabbath; and as they went His disciples began to pluck the heads of grain.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാർ അവനോടു: നോക്കു, ഇവർ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ വിഹിതമല്ലാത്തതു ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Pharisees said to him, "Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"
chapters.nkjv: And the Pharisees said to Him, "Look, why do they do what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
chapters.kjv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ദാവീദ് തനിക്കും കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും മുട്ടുണ്ടായി വിശന്നപ്പോൾ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു?”
chapters.niv: He answered, "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "Have you never read what David did when he was in need and hungry, he and those with him:
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

chapters.ml: അവ അബ്യാഥാർമഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ കാലത്തു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു, പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കല്ലാതെ ആർക്കും തിന്മാൻ വിഹിതമല്ലാത്ത കാഴ്ചയപ്പം തിന്നു കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും കൊടുത്തു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഒരിക്കലും വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions."
chapters.nkjv: how he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the showbread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and also gave some to those who were with him?"
chapters.kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു: “മനുഷ്യൻ ശബ്ബത്ത് നിമിത്തമല്ല; ശബ്ബത്ത് മനുഷ്യൻ നിമിത്തമത്രേ ഉണ്ടായതു;”
chapters.niv: Then he said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, and not man for the Sabbath.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ശബ്ബത്തിന്നും കർത്താവു ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Son of Man is also Lord of the Sabbath."
chapters.kjv: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു: അവിടെ വരണ്ടകയ്യുള്ള ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.
chapters.nkjv: And He entered the synagogue again, and a man was there who had a withered hand.
chapters.kjv: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ അവനെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുമോ എന്നു നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.
chapters.nkjv: So they watched Him closely, whether He would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse Him.
chapters.kjv: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

chapters.ml: വരണ്ടകയ്യുള്ള മനുഷ്യനോടു അവൻ: “നടുവിൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിൽക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, "Stand up in front of everyone."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to the man who had the withered hand, "Step forward."
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരോടു: “ശബ്ബത്തിൽ നന്മ ചെയ്കയോ, തിന്മചെയ്കയോ, ജീവനെ രക്ഷിക്കയോ, കൊല്ലുകയോ, ഏതു വിഹിതം” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അവരോ മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus asked them, "Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" But they remained silent.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" But they kept silent.
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ഹൃദയകാഠിന്യം നിമിത്തം അവൻ ദുഃഖിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു കോപത്തോടെ അവരെ ചുറ്റും നോക്കി, ആ മനുഷ്യനോടു: “കൈ നീട്ടുക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു: അവൻ നീട്ടി, അവന്റെ കൈ സൌഖ്യമായി.
chapters.niv: He looked around at them in anger and, deeply distressed at their stubborn hearts, said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out, and his hand was completely restored.
chapters.nkjv: And when He had looked around at them with anger, being grieved by the hardness of their hearts, He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored as whole as the other.
chapters.kjv: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ പരീശന്മാർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു, അവനെ നശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഹെരോദ്യരുമായി ആലോചന കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Pharisees went out and immediately plotted with the Herodians against Him, how they might destroy Him.
chapters.kjv: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

chapters.ml: യേശു ശിഷ്യന്മാരുമായി കടൽക്കരക്കു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി; ഗലീലയിൽനിന്നു വലിയോരു പുരുഷാരം അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea. And a great multitude from Galilee followed Him, and from Judea
chapters.kjv: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judæa,

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ നിന്നും യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നും എദോമിൽ നിന്നും യോർദാന്നക്കരെ നിന്നും സോരിന്റെയും സിദോന്റെയും ചുറ്റുപാട്ടിൽനിന്നും വലിയോരു കൂട്ടം അവൻ ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും കേട്ടിട്ടു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they heard about all he was doing, many people came to him from Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, and the regions across the Jordan and around Tyre and Sidon.
chapters.nkjv: and Jerusalem and Idumea and beyond the Jordan; and those from Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they heard how many things He was doing, came to Him.
chapters.kjv: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം തന്നെ ഞെരുക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ നിമിത്തം ഒരു ചെറു പടകു തനിക്കു ഒരുക്കി നിറുത്തുവാൻ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.
chapters.nkjv: So He told His disciples that a small boat should be kept ready for Him because of the multitude, lest they should crush Him.
chapters.kjv: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അനേകരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുകയാൽ ബാധകൾ ഉള്ളവർ ഒക്കെയും അവനെ തൊടേണ്ടതിന്നു തിക്കിത്തിരക്കി വന്നു.
chapters.niv: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.
chapters.nkjv: For He healed many, so that as many as had afflictions pressed about Him to touch Him.
chapters.kjv: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

chapters.ml: അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കളും അവനെ കാണുമ്പോൾ ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വീണു: നീ ദൈവപുത്രൻ എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു പറയും.
chapters.niv: Whenever the impure spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, "You are the Son of God."
chapters.nkjv: And the unclean spirits, whenever they saw Him, fell down before Him and cried out, saying, "You are the Son of God."
chapters.kjv: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

chapters.ml: തന്നെ പ്രസിദ്ധമാക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ അവരെ വളരെ ശാസിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.
chapters.nkjv: But He sternly warned them that they should not make Him known.
chapters.kjv: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ മലയിൽ കയറി തനിക്കു ബോധിച്ചവരെ അടുക്കൽ വിളിച്ചു; അവർ അവന്റെ അരികെ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.
chapters.nkjv: And He went up on the mountain and called to Him those He Himself wanted. And they came to Him.
chapters.kjv: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിപ്പാനും പ്രസംഗിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അയപ്പാനും
chapters.niv: He appointed twelve that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach
chapters.nkjv: Then He appointed twelve, that they might be with Him and that He might send them out to preach,
chapters.kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

chapters.ml: ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അധികാരം ഉണ്ടാകുവാനും പന്തിരുവരെ നിയമിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: and to have authority to drive out demons.
chapters.nkjv: and to have power to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
chapters.kjv: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

chapters.ml: ശിമോന്നു പത്രൊസ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു;
chapters.niv: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),
chapters.nkjv: Simon, to whom He gave the name Peter;
chapters.kjv: And Simon he surnamed Peter;

chapters.ml: സെബെദിയുടെ മകനായ യാക്കോബു, യക്കോബിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യോഹന്നാൻ: ഇവർക്കു ഇടിമക്കൾ എന്നർത്ഥമുള്ള ബൊവനേർഗ്ഗെസ് എന്നു പേരിട്ടു —
chapters.niv: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means "sons of thunder"),
chapters.nkjv: James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of James, to whom He gave the name Boanerges, that is, "Sons of Thunder";
chapters.kjv: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

chapters.ml: അന്ത്രെയാസ്, ഫിലിപ്പൊസ്, ബർത്തൊലോമായി, മത്തായി, തോമാസ്, അല്ഫായിയുടെ മകനായ യാക്കോബ്, തദ്ദായി, കനാന്യനായ ശിമോൻ,
chapters.niv: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot
chapters.nkjv: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Cananite;
chapters.kjv: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

chapters.ml: തന്നെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുത്ത ഈസ്കായ്യോർത്ത് യൂദാ എന്നിവരെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
chapters.nkjv: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him. And they went into a house.
chapters.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു; അവർക്കു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിപ്പാൻപോലും വഹിയാതവണ്ണം പുരുഷാരം പിന്നെയും തിങ്ങി കൂടി വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.
chapters.nkjv: Then the multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
chapters.kjv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ചാർച്ചക്കാർ അതു കേട്ടു, അവന്നു ബുദ്ധിഭ്രമം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, "He is out of his mind."
chapters.nkjv: But when His own people heard aboutthis, they went out to lay hold of Him, for they said, "He is out of His mind."
chapters.kjv: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നു വന്ന ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും: അവന്നു ബെയെത്സെബൂൽ ഉണ്ടു, ഭൂതങ്ങളുടെ തലവനെ കൊണ്ടു അവൻ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And the teachers of the law who came down from Jerusalem said, "He is possessed by Beelzebul! By the prince of demons he is driving out demons."
chapters.nkjv: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, "He has Beelzebub," and, "By the ruler of the demons He casts out demons."
chapters.kjv: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ അടുക്കെ വിളിച്ചു ഉപമകളാൽ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “സാത്താന്നു സാത്താനെ എങ്ങനെ പുറത്താക്കുവാൻ കഴിയും?
chapters.niv: So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables: "How can Satan drive out Satan?
chapters.nkjv: So He called them to Himself and said to them in parables: "How can Satan cast out Satan?
chapters.kjv: And he called them unto him , and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

chapters.ml: ഒരു രാജ്യം തന്നിൽതന്നേ ഛിദ്രിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ ആ രാജ്യത്തിനു നിലനില്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
chapters.nkjv: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
chapters.kjv: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

chapters.ml: ഒരു വീടു തന്നിൽ തന്നേ ഛിദ്രിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ ആ വീട്ടിന്നു നിലനില്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
chapters.nkjv: And if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
chapters.kjv: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

chapters.ml: സാത്താൻ തന്നോടുതന്നേ എതിർത്തു ഛിദ്രിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ അവന്നു നിലനില്പാൻ കഴിവില്ല; അവന്റെ അവസാനം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.
chapters.nkjv: And if Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but has an end.
chapters.kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

chapters.ml: ബലവാനെ പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടീട്ടല്ലാതെ അവന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കടന്നു അവന്റെ കോപ്പു കവർന്നുകളവാൻ ആർക്കും കഴികയില്ല; പിടിച്ചു കെട്ടിയാൽ പിന്നെ അവന്റെ വീടു കവർച്ച ചെയ്യാം.
chapters.niv: In fact, no one can enter a strong man’s house without first tying him up. Then he can plunder the strong man’s house.
chapters.nkjv: No one can enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man. And then he will plunder his house.
chapters.kjv: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരോടു സകല പാപങ്ങളും അവർ ദുഷിച്ചു പറയുന്ന സകല ദൂഷണങ്ങളും ക്ഷമിക്കും;
chapters.niv: Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter,
chapters.nkjv: "Assuredly, I say to you, all sins will be forgiven the sons of men, and whatever blasphemies they may utter;
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

chapters.ml: പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിന്റെ നേരെ ദൂഷണം പയുന്നവനോ ഒരുനാളും ക്ഷമ കിട്ടാതെ നിത്യശിക്ഷെക്കു യോഗ്യനാകും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin."
chapters.nkjv: but he who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation"—
chapters.kjv: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

chapters.ml: അവന്നു ഒരു അശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said this because they were saying, "He has an impure spirit."
chapters.nkjv: because they said, "He has an unclean spirit."
chapters.kjv: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും വന്നു പുറത്തു നിന്നു അവനെ വിളപ്പാൻ ആളയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.
chapters.nkjv: Then His brothers and His mother came, and standing outside they sent to Him, calling Him.
chapters.kjv: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം അവന്റെ ചുറ്റും ഇരുന്നിരുന്നു; അവർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും പുറത്തു നിന്നു നിന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവൻ അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, "Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you."
chapters.nkjv: And a multitude was sitting around Him; and they said to Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are outside seeking You."
chapters.kjv: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

chapters.ml: “എന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും ആർ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു ചുറ്റിലും ഇരിക്കുന്നവരെ നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: "Who are my mother and my brothers?" he asked.
chapters.nkjv: But He answered them, saying, "Who is My mother, or My brothers?"
chapters.kjv: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

chapters.ml: “എന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും ഇതാ.
chapters.niv: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers!
chapters.nkjv: And He looked around in a circle at those who sat about Him, and said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!
chapters.kjv: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ തന്നേ എന്റെ സഹോദരനും സഹോദരിയും അമ്മയും ആകുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother."
chapters.nkjv: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and My sister and mother."
chapters.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും കടൽക്കരെവെച്ചു ഉപദേശിപ്പാൻ തുടങ്ങി. അപ്പോൾ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ പുരുഷാരം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു കൂടുകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ പടകിൽ കയറി കടലിൽ ഇരുന്നു; പുരുഷാരം ഒക്കെയും കടലരികെ കരയിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Again Jesus began to teach by the lake. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it out on the lake, while all the people were along the shore at the water’s edge.
chapters.nkjv: And again He began to teach by the sea. And a great multitude was gathered to Him, so that He got into a boat and sat init on the sea; and the whole multitude was on the land facing the sea.
chapters.kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉപമകളാൽ അവരെ പലതും ഉപദേശിച്ചു, ഉപദേശത്തിൽ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:
chapters.nkjv: Then He taught them many things by parables, and said to them in His teaching:
chapters.kjv: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

chapters.ml: “കേൾപ്പിൻ; വിതെക്കുന്നവൻ വിതെപ്പാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: "Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
chapters.nkjv: "Listen! Behold, a sower went out to sow.
chapters.kjv: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

chapters.ml: വിതെക്കുമ്പോൾ ചിലതു വഴിയരികെ വിണു; പറവകൾ വന്നു അതു തിന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, as he sowed, that some seed fell by the wayside; and the birds of the air came and devoured it.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു പാറസ്ഥലത്തു ഏറെ മണ്ണില്ലാത്തേടത്തു വീണു; മണ്ണിന്നു താഴ്ച ഇല്ലായ്കയാൽ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ മുളെച്ചുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.
chapters.nkjv: Some fell on stony ground, where it did not have much earth; and immediately it sprang up because it had no depth of earth.
chapters.kjv: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ ഉദിച്ചാറെ ചൂടു തട്ടി, വേരില്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
chapters.nkjv: But when the sun was up it was scorched, and because it had no root it withered away.
chapters.kjv: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു മുള്ളിന്നിടയിൽ വീണു; മുള്ളു മുളെച്ചു വളർന്നു അതിനെ ഞെരുക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അതു വിളഞ്ഞതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.
chapters.nkjv: And some seed fell among thorns; and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no crop.
chapters.kjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു നല്ലമണ്ണിൽ വീണിട്ടു മുളെച്ചു വളർന്നു ഫലം കൊടുത്തു; മുപ്പതും അറുപതും നൂറും മേനി വിളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, some multiplying thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times."
chapters.nkjv: But other seed fell on good ground and yielded a crop that sprang up, increased and produced: some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some a hundred."
chapters.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

chapters.ml: “കേൾപ്പാൻ ചെവി ഉള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ” എന്നും അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said, "Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ തനിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവനോടുകൂടെയുള്ളവൻ പന്തിരുവരുമായി ആ ഉപമകളെക്കുറിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.
chapters.nkjv: But when He was alone, those around Him with the twelve asked Him about the parable.
chapters.kjv: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: “ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിന്റെ മർമ്മം നിങ്ങൾക്കു നല്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; പുറത്തുള്ളവർക്കോ സകലവും ഉപമകളാൽ ലഭിക്കുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: He told them, "The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "To you it has been given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God; but to those who are outside, all things come in parables,
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

chapters.ml: അവർ മനംതിരിയാതെയും അവരോടു ക്ഷമിക്കാതെയും ഇരിക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം അവർ കണ്ടിട്ടും അറിയാതിരിപ്പാനും കേട്ടിട്ടും ഗ്രഹിക്കാതിരിപ്പാനും സംഗതിവരും.
chapters.niv: so that, " ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven!’ "
chapters.nkjv: so that ‘Seeing they may see and not perceive, And hearing they may hear and not understand; Lest they should turn, Andtheirsins be forgiven them.’ "
chapters.kjv: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഈ ഉപമ ഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നില്ലയോ? പിന്നെ മറ്റെ ഉപമകൾ ഒക്കെയും എങ്ങനെ ഗ്രഹിക്കും?”
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to them, "Don’t you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Do you not understand this parable? How then will you understand all the parables?
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

chapters.ml: “വിതെക്കുന്നവൻ വചനം വിതെക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The farmer sows the word.
chapters.nkjv: The sower sows the word.
chapters.kjv: The sower soweth the word.

chapters.ml: വചനം വിതച്ചിട്ടു വഴിയരികെ വീണതു, കേട്ട ഉടനെ സാത്താൻ വന്നു ഹൃദയങ്ങളിൽ വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ട വചനം എടുത്തുകളയുന്നതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
chapters.nkjv: And these are the ones by the wayside where the word is sown. When they hear, Satan comes immediately and takes away the word that was sown in their hearts.
chapters.kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ പാറസ്ഥലത്തു വിതെച്ചതു വചനം കേട്ട ഉടനെ സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നവർ;
chapters.niv: Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
chapters.nkjv: These likewise are the ones sown on stony ground who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
chapters.kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവർ ഉള്ളിൽ വേരില്ലാതെ ക്ഷണികന്മാർ ആകുന്നു; വചനം നിമിത്തം ഉപദ്രവമോ പീഡയോ ഉണ്ടായാൽ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ ഇടറിപ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
chapters.nkjv: and they have no root in themselves, and so endure only for a time. Afterward, when tribulation or persecution arises for the word’s sake, immediately they stumble.
chapters.kjv: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.

chapters.ml: മുള്ളിന്നിടയിൽ വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ടതോ വചനം കേട്ടിട്ടു
chapters.niv: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;
chapters.nkjv: Now these are the ones sown among thorns; they are the ones who hear the word,
chapters.kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

chapters.ml: ഇഹലോകത്തിന്റെ ചിന്തകളും ധനത്തിന്റെ വഞ്ചനയും മറ്റുവിഷയ മോഹങ്ങളും അകത്തു കടന്നു, വചനത്തെ ഞെരുക്കി നഷ്ഫലമാക്കി തീർക്കുന്നതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.
chapters.nkjv: and the cares of this world, the deceitfulness of riches, and the desires for other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
chapters.kjv: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

chapters.ml: നല്ലമണ്ണിൽ വിതെക്കപ്പെട്ടതോ വചനം കേൾക്കയും അംഗീകരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നവർ തന്നേ; അവർ മുപ്പതും അറുപതും നൂറും മേനി വിളയുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: Others, like seed sown on good soil, hear the word, accept it, and produce a crop—some thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times what was sown."
chapters.nkjv: But these are the ones sown on good ground, those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit: some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some a hundred."
chapters.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it , and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “വിളക്കു കത്തിച്ചു പറയിൻ കീഴിലോ കട്ടിൽക്കീഴിലോ വെക്കുമാറുണ്ടോ? വിളക്കുതണ്ടിന്മേലല്ലയോ വെക്കുന്നതു?
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, don’t you put it on its stand?
chapters.nkjv: Also He said to them, "Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Is it not to be set on a lampstand?
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

chapters.ml: വെളിപ്പെടുവാനുള്ളതല്ലാതെ ഗൂഢമായതു ഒന്നും ഇല്ല; വെളിച്ചത്തു വരുവാനുള്ളതല്ലാതെ മറവായതു ഒന്നും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.
chapters.nkjv: For there is nothing hidden which will not be revealed, nor has anything been kept secret but that it should come to light.
chapters.kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

chapters.ml: കേൾപ്പാൻ ചെവി ഉള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear."
chapters.nkjv: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear."
chapters.kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു സൂക്ഷിച്ചു കൊൾവിൻ; നിങ്ങൾ അളക്കുന്ന അളവു കൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾക്കും അളന്നുകിട്ടും; അധികമായും കിട്ടും.
chapters.niv: "Consider carefully what you hear," he continued. "With the measure you use, it will be measured to you—and even more.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "Take heed what you hear. With the same measure you use, it will be measured to you; and to you who hear, more will be given.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

chapters.ml: ഉള്ളവന്നു കൊടുക്കും; ഇല്ലാത്തവനോടോ ഉള്ളതുംകൂടെ എടുത്തുകളയും” എന്നും അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them."
chapters.nkjv: For whoever has, to him more will be given; but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him."
chapters.kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: “ദൈവരാജ്യം ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ മണ്ണിൽ വിത്തു എറിഞ്ഞശേഷം
chapters.niv: He also said, "This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "The kingdom of God is as if a man should scatter seed on the ground,
chapters.kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

chapters.ml: രാവും പകലും ഉറങ്ങിയും എഴുന്നേറ്റും ഇരിക്കെ അവൻ അറിയാതെ വിത്തു മുളെച്ചു വളരുന്നതുപോലെ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.
chapters.nkjv: and should sleep by night and rise by day, and the seed should sprout and grow, he himself does not know how.
chapters.kjv: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമി സ്വയമായി മുമ്പെ ഞാറും പിന്നെ കതിരും പിന്നെ കതിരിൽ നിറഞ്ഞ മണിയും ഇങ്ങനെ വിളയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.
chapters.nkjv: For the earth yields crops by itself: first the blade, then the head, after that the full grain in the head.
chapters.kjv: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

chapters.ml: ധാന്യം വിളയുമ്പോൾ കൊയ്ത്തായതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ഉടനെ അരിവാൾ വെക്കുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come."
chapters.nkjv: But when the grain ripens, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come."
chapters.kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: “ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെ എങ്ങനെ ഉപമിക്കേണ്ടു? ഏതു ഉപമയാൽ അതിനെ വർണ്ണിക്കേണ്ടു?
chapters.niv: Again he said, "What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?
chapters.nkjv: Then He said, "To what shall we liken the kingdom of God? Or with what parable shall we picture it?
chapters.kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

chapters.ml: അതു കടുകുമണിയോടു സദൃശം; അതിനെ മണ്ണിൽ വിതെക്കുമ്പോൾ ഭൂമിയിലെ എല്ലാവിത്തിലും ചെറിയതു.
chapters.niv: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.
chapters.nkjv: It is like a mustard seed which, when it is sown on the ground, is smaller than all the seeds on earth;
chapters.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും വിതെച്ചശേഷം വളർന്നു, സകലസസ്യങ്ങളിലും വലുതായിത്തീർന്നു, ആകാശത്തിലെ പക്ഷികൾ അതിന്റെ നിഴലിൽ വസിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം വലുതായ കൊമ്പുകളെ വിടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Yet when planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all garden plants, with such big branches that the birds can perch in its shade."
chapters.nkjv: but when it is sown, it grows up and becomes greater than all herbs, and shoots out large branches, so that the birds of the air may nest under its shade."
chapters.kjv: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇങ്ങനെ പല ഉപമകളാൽ അവർക്കു കേൾപ്പാൻ കഴിയുംപോലെ അവരോടു വചനം പറഞ്ഞുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.
chapters.nkjv: And with many such parables He spoke the word to them as they were able to hear it.
chapters.kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it .

chapters.ml: ഉപമ കൂടാതെ അവരോടു ഒന്നും പറഞ്ഞതുമില്ല; തനിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു സകലവും വ്യാഖ്യാനിക്കും.
chapters.niv: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.
chapters.nkjv: But without a parable He did not speak to them. And when they were alone, He explained all things to His disciples.
chapters.kjv: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

chapters.ml: അന്നു സന്ധ്യയായപ്പോൾ: “നാം അക്കരെക്കു പോക” എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, "Let us go over to the other side."
chapters.nkjv: On the same day, when evening had come, He said to them, "Let us cross over to the other side."
chapters.kjv: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുരുഷാരത്തെ വിട്ടു, താൻ പടകിൽഇരുന്നപാടെ അവനെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി; മറ്റു ചെറുപടകുകളും കൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had left the multitude, they took Him along in the boat as He was. And other little boats were also with Him.
chapters.kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ വലിയ ചുഴലിക്കാറ്റു ഉണ്ടായി: പടകിൽ തിര തള്ളിക്കയറുകകൊണ്ടു അതു മുങ്ങുമാറായി.
chapters.niv: A furious squall came up, and the waves broke over the boat, so that it was nearly swamped.
chapters.nkjv: And a great windstorm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so that it was already filling.
chapters.kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അമരത്തു തലയണ വെച്ചു ഉറങ്ങുകയായിരുന്നു; അവർ അവനെ ഉണർത്തി: ഗുരോ, ഞങ്ങൾ നശിച്ചുപോകുന്നതിൽ നിനക്കു വിചാരം ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, "Teacher, don’t you care if we drown?"
chapters.nkjv: But He was in the stern, asleep on a pillow. And they awoke Him and said to Him, "Teacher, do You not care that we are perishing?"
chapters.kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

chapters.ml: അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു കാറ്റിനെ ശാസിച്ചു, കടലിനോടു: “അനങ്ങാതിരിക്ക, അടങ്ങുക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; കാറ്റു അമർന്നു, വലിയ ശാന്തത ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, "Quiet! Be still!" Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.
chapters.nkjv: Then He arose and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, "Peace, be still!" And the wind ceased and there was a great calm.
chapters.kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ ഇങ്ങനെ ഭീരുക്കൾ ആകുവാൻ എന്തു? നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഇപ്പോഴും വിശ്വാസമില്ലയോ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to his disciples, "Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?"
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "Why are you so fearful? Howis it that you have no faith?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

chapters.ml: അവർ വളരെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു: കാറ്റും കടലും കൂടെ ഇവനെ അനുസരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; ഇവൻ ആർ എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They were terrified and asked each other, "Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!"
chapters.nkjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said to one another, "Who can this be, that even the wind and the sea obey Him!"
chapters.kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

chapters.ml: അവർ കടലിന്റെ അക്കരെ ഗദരദേശത്തു എത്തി.
chapters.niv: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to the other side of the sea, to the country of the Gadarenes.
chapters.kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

chapters.ml: പടകിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിയ ഉടനെ അശുദ്ധാത്മാവുള്ള ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ കല്ലറകളിൽ നിന്നു വന്നു അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.
chapters.nkjv: And when He had come out of the boat, immediately there met Him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
chapters.kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പാർപ്പു കല്ലറകളിൽ ആയിരുന്നു; ആർക്കും അവനെ ചങ്ങലകൊണ്ടുപോലും ബന്ധിച്ചുകൂടാഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain.
chapters.nkjv: who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no one could bind him, not even with chains,
chapters.kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

chapters.ml: പലപ്പോഴും അവനെ വിലങ്ങും ചങ്ങലയുംകൊണ്ടു ബന്ധിച്ചിട്ടും അവൻ ചങ്ങല വലിച്ചുപൊട്ടിച്ചും വിലങ്ങു ഉരുമ്മി ഒടിച്ചും കളഞ്ഞു; ആർക്കും അവനെ അടക്കുവാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.
chapters.nkjv: because he had often been bound with shackles and chains. And the chains had been pulled apart by him, and the shackles broken in pieces; neither could anyone tame him.
chapters.kjv: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാവും പകലും കല്ലറകളിലും മലകളിലും ഇടവിടാതെ നിലവിളിച്ചും തന്നെത്താൽ കല്ലുകൊണ്ടു ചതെച്ചും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.
chapters.nkjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains and in the tombs, crying out and cutting himself with stones.
chapters.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യേശുവിനെ ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു ഓടിച്ചെന്നു അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.
chapters.nkjv: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and worshiped Him.
chapters.kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു: യേശുവേ, മഹോന്നതനായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുത്രാ, എനിക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? ദൈവത്താണ, എന്നെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കരുതേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He shouted at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God’s name don’t torture me!"
chapters.nkjv: And he cried out with a loud voice and said, "What have I to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I implore You by God that You do not torment me."
chapters.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

chapters.ml: “അശുദ്ധാത്മാവേ, ഈ മനുഷ്യനെ വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോക” എന്നു യേശു കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For Jesus had said to him, "Come out of this man, you impure spirit!"
chapters.nkjv: For He said to him, "Come out of the man, unclean spirit!"
chapters.kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

chapters.ml: “നിന്റെ പേരെന്തു” എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: എന്റെ പേർ ലെഗ്യോൻ; ഞങ്ങൾ പലർ ആകുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: Then Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" "My name is Legion," he replied, "for we are many."
chapters.nkjv: Then He asked him, "What is your name?" And he answered, saying, "My name is Legion; for we are many."
chapters.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

chapters.ml: നാട്ടിൽ നിന്നു തങ്ങളെ അയച്ചുകളയാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഏറിയോന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.
chapters.nkjv: Also he begged Him earnestly that He would not send them out of the country.
chapters.kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ മലയരികെ ഒരു വലിയ പന്നിക്കൂട്ടം മേഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.
chapters.nkjv: Now a large herd of swine was feeding there near the mountains.
chapters.kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

chapters.ml: ആ പന്നികളിൽ കടക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ അയക്കേണം എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: The demons begged Jesus, "Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them."
chapters.nkjv: So all the demons begged Him, saying, "Send us to the swine, that we may enter them."
chapters.kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അനുവാദം കൊടുത്തു; അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പന്നികളിൽ കടന്നിട്ടു കൂട്ടം കടുന്തൂക്കത്തൂടെ കടലിലേക്കു പാഞ്ഞു വീർപ്പുമുട്ടി ചത്തു. അവ ഏകദേശം രണ്ടായിരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He gave them permission, and the impure spirits came out and went into the pigs. The herd, about two thousand in number, rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
chapters.nkjv: And at once Jesus gave them permission. Then the unclean spirits went out and entered the swine (there were about two thousand); and the herd ran violently down the steep place into the sea, and drowned in the sea.
chapters.kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

chapters.ml: പന്നികളെ മേയക്കുന്നവർ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു പട്ടണത്തിലും നാട്ടിലും അറിയിച്ചു; സംഭവിച്ചതു കാണ്മാൻ പലരും പുറപ്പെട്ടു,
chapters.niv: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
chapters.nkjv: So those who fed the swine fled, and they told it in the city and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that had happened.
chapters.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

chapters.ml: യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു, ലെഗ്യോൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന ഭൂതഗ്രസ്തൻ വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചും സുബോധം പൂണ്ടും ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to Jesus, and saw the one whohadbeen demon-possessed and had the legion, sitting and clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.
chapters.kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

chapters.ml: കണ്ടവർ ഭൂതഗ്രസ്തന്നു സംഭവിച്ചതും പന്നികളുടെ കാര്യവും അവരോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.
chapters.nkjv: And those who saw it told them how it happened to him whohadbeen demon-possessed, and about the swine.
chapters.kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ അവനോടു തങ്ങളുടെ അതിർ വിട്ടുപോകുവാൻ അപേക്ഷിച്ചു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.
chapters.nkjv: Then they began to plead with Him to depart from their region.
chapters.kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പടകു ഏറുമ്പോൾ ഭൂതഗ്രസ്തനായിരുന്നവൻ താനും കൂടെ പോരട്ടെ എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.
chapters.nkjv: And when He got into the boat, he who had been demon-possessed begged Him that he might be with Him.
chapters.kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനെ അനുവദിക്കാതെ: “നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ നിനക്കുള്ളവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു, കർത്താവു നിനക്കു ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും നിന്നോടു കരുണകാണിച്ചതും പ്രസ്താവിക്ക” എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus did not let him, but said, "Go home to your own people and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you."
chapters.nkjv: However, Jesus did not permit him, but said to him, "Go home to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how He has had compassion on you."
chapters.kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോയി യേശു തനിക്കു ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും ദെക്കപ്പൊലിനാട്ടിൽ ഘോഷിച്ചു തുടങ്ങി; എല്ലാവരും ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.
chapters.nkjv: And he departed and began to proclaim in Decapolis all that Jesus had done for him; and all marveled.
chapters.kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

chapters.ml: യേശു വീണ്ടും പടകിൽ കയറി ഇക്കരെ കടന്നു കടലരികെ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ വലിയ പുരുഷാരം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുകൂടി.
chapters.niv: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Jesus had crossed over again by boat to the other side, a great multitude gathered to Him; and He was by the sea.
chapters.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

chapters.ml: പള്ളി പ്രമാണികളിൽ യായീറൊസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരുത്തൻ വന്നു, അവനെ കണ്ടു കാൽക്കൽ വീണു:
chapters.niv: Then one of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue came, Jairus by name. And when he saw Him, he fell at His feet
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ കുഞ്ഞുമകൾ അത്യാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; അവൾ രക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു ജീവിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ വന്നു അവളുടെമേൽ കൈ വെക്കേണമേ എന്നു വളരെ അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He pleaded earnestly with him, "My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live."
chapters.nkjv: and begged Him earnestly, saying, "My little daughter lies at the point of death. Come and lay Your hands on her, that she may be healed, and she will live."
chapters.kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി, വലിയ പുരുഷാരവും പിൻചെന്നു അവനെ തിക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus went with him, and a great multitude followed Him and thronged Him.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

chapters.ml: പന്ത്രണ്ടു സംവത്സരമായിട്ടു രക്തസ്രവമുള്ളവളായി
chapters.niv: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain woman had a flow of blood for twelve years,
chapters.kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

chapters.ml: പല വൈദ്യന്മാരാലും ഏറിയോന്നു സഹിച്ചു തനിക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും ചെലവഴിച്ചിട്ടും ഒട്ടും ഭേദം വരാതെ ഏറ്റവും പരവശയായി തീർന്നിരുന്ന
chapters.niv: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.
chapters.nkjv: and had suffered many things from many physicians. She had spent all that she had and was no better, but rather grew worse.
chapters.kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

chapters.ml: ഒരു സ്ത്രീ യേശുവിന്റെ വർത്തമാനം കേട്ടു:
chapters.niv: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,
chapters.nkjv: When she heard about Jesus, she came behind Him in the crowd and touched His garment.
chapters.kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം എങ്കിലും തൊട്ടാൽ ഞാൻ രക്ഷപ്പെടും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു പുരുഷാരത്തിൽകൂടി പുറകിൽ വന്നു അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം തൊട്ടു.
chapters.niv: because she thought, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed."
chapters.nkjv: For she said, "If only I may touch His clothes, I shall be made well."
chapters.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷണത്തിൽ അവളുടെ രക്തസ്രവം നിന്നു; ബാധ മാറി താൻ സ്വസ്ഥയായി എന്നു അവൾ ശരീരത്തിൽ അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately the fountain of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of the affliction.
chapters.kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ യേശു തങ്കൽനിന്നു ശക്തി പുറപ്പെട്ടു എന്നു ഉള്ളിൽ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ തിരിഞ്ഞു: “എന്റെ വസ്ത്രം തൊട്ടതു ആർ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, "Who touched my clothes?"
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in Himself that power had gone out of Him, turned around in the crowd and said, "Who touched My clothes?"
chapters.kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു പുരുഷാരം നിന്നെ തിരക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടും എന്നെ തൊട്ടതു ആർ എന്നു ചോദിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You see the people crowding against you," his disciples answered, "and yet you can ask, ‘Who touched me?’ "
chapters.nkjv: But His disciples said to Him, "You see the multitude thronging You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’ "
chapters.kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

chapters.ml: അവനോ അതു ചെയ്തവളെ കാണ്മാൻ ചുറ്റും നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.
chapters.nkjv: And He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
chapters.kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ തനിക്കു സംഭവിച്ചതു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഭയപ്പെട്ടും വിറെച്ചുകൊണ്ടു വന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വീണു വസ്തുത ഒക്കെയും അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.
chapters.nkjv: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him and told Him the whole truth.
chapters.kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളോടു: “മകളേ, നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം നിന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോയി ബാധ ഒഴിഞ്ഞു സ്വസ്ഥയായിരിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed of your affliction."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ പള്ളി പ്രമാണിയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ നിന്നു ആൾ വന്നു: നിന്റെ മകൾ മരിച്ചുപോയി; ഗുരുവിനെ ഇനി അസഹ്യപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. "Your daughter is dead," they said. "Why bother the teacher anymore?"
chapters.nkjv: While He was still speaking, some came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house who said, "Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the Teacher any further?"
chapters.kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

chapters.ml: യേശു ആ വാക്കു കാര്യമാക്കാതെ പള്ളിപ്രമാണിയോടു: “ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ, വിശ്വസിക്ക മാത്രം ചെയ്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, "Don’t be afraid; just believe."
chapters.nkjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, He said to the ruler of the synagogue, "Do not be afraid; only believe."
chapters.kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസും യാക്കോബും യാക്കോബിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യോഹന്നാനും അല്ലാതെ മറ്റാരും തന്നോടുകൂടെ ചെല്ലുവാൻ സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.
chapters.nkjv: And He permitted no one to follow Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
chapters.kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

chapters.ml: പള്ളിപ്രമാണിയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നാറെ ആരവാരത്തെയും വളരെ കരഞ്ഞു വിലപിക്കുന്നവരെയും കണ്ടു;
chapters.niv: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.
chapters.nkjv: Then He came to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and saw a tumult and those who wept and wailed loudly.
chapters.kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

chapters.ml: അകത്തു കടന്നു: “നിങ്ങളുടെ ആരവാരവും കരച്ചലും എന്തിന്നു? കുട്ടി മരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല, ഉറങ്ങുന്നത്രേ” എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു; അവരോ അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He went in and said to them, "Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep."
chapters.nkjv: When He came in, He said to them, "Why make this commotion and weep? The child is not dead, but sleeping."
chapters.kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എല്ലാവരെയും പുറത്താക്കി കുട്ടിയുടെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും തന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ളവരെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു കുട്ടി കിടക്കുന്ന ഇടത്തുചെന്നു കുട്ടിയുടെ കൈക്കു പിടിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: But they laughed at him. After he put them all out, he took the child’s father and mother and the disciples who were with him, and went in where the child was.
chapters.nkjv: And they ridiculed Him. But when He had put them all outside, He took the father and the mother of the child, and those whowere with Him, and entered where the child was lying.
chapters.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

chapters.ml: ബാലേ, എഴുന്നേൽക്ക എന്നു നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നു എന്ന അർത്ഥത്തോടെ “തലീഥാ കൂമി” എന്നു അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He took her by the hand and said to her, "Talitha koum!" (which means "Little girl, I say to you, get up!").
chapters.nkjv: Then He took the child by the hand, and said to her, "Talitha, cumi," which is translated, "Little girl, I say to you, arise."
chapters.kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

chapters.ml: ബാല ഉടനെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നടന്നു; അവൾക്കു പന്ത്രണ്ടു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു; അവർ അത്യന്തം വിസ്മയിച്ചു
chapters.niv: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately the girl arose and walked, for she was twelve years ofage. And they were overcome with great amazement.
chapters.kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ആരും അറിയരുതു എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു ഏറിയോന്നു കല്പിച്ചു. അവൾക്കു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കൊടുക്കേണം എന്നും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.
chapters.nkjv: But He commanded them strictly that no one should know it, and said that something should be given her to eat.
chapters.kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു, തന്റെ പിതൃനഗരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു; അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരും അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.
chapters.nkjv: Then He went out from there and came to His own country, and His disciples followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

chapters.ml: ശബ്ബത്തായപ്പോൾ അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽ ഉപദേശിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി; പലരും കേട്ടു വിസ്മയിച്ചു: ഇവന്നു ഇവ എവിടെനിന്നു? ഇവന്നു കിട്ടിയ ഈ ജ്ഞാനവും ഇവന്റെ കയ്യാൽ നടക്കുന്ന വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികളും എന്തു?
chapters.niv: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. "Where did this man get these things?" they asked. "What’s this wisdom that has been given him? What are these remarkable miracles he is performing?
chapters.nkjv: And when the Sabbath had come, He began to teach in the synagogue. And many hearing Him were astonished, saying, "Where did this Man get these things? And what wisdom is this which is given to Him, that such mighty works are performed by His hands!
chapters.kjv: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ മറിയയുടെ മകനും യാക്കോബ് യോസെ, യൂദാ, ശിമോൻ എന്നവരുടെ സഹോദരനുമായ തച്ചനല്ലയോ? ഇവന്റെ സഹോദരികളും ഇവിടെ നമ്മോടു കൂടെ ഇല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവങ്കൽ ഇടറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Isn’t this the carpenter? Isn’t this Mary’s son and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?" And they took offense at him.
chapters.nkjv: Is this not the carpenter, the Son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? And are not His sisters here with us?" So they were offended at Him.
chapters.kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ തന്റെ പിതൃനഗരത്തിലും ചാർച്ചക്കാരുടെ ഇടയിലും സ്വന്ത ഭവനത്തിലും അല്ലാതെ ബഹുമാനമില്ലാത്തവൻ അല്ല” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his own town, among his relatives and in his own home."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his own country, among his own relatives, and in his own house."
chapters.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

chapters.ml: ഏതാനും ചില രോഗികളുടെ മേൽ കൈ വെച്ചു സൌഖ്യം വരുത്തിയതു അല്ലാതെ അവിടെ വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തി ഒന്നും ചെയ്‍വാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.
chapters.nkjv: Now He could do no mighty work there, except that He laid His hands on a few sick people and healed them.
chapters.kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them .

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അവിശ്വാസം ഹേതുവായി അവൻ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു. അവൻ ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ഊരുകളിൽ ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു സഞ്ചരിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.
chapters.nkjv: And He marveled because of their unbelief. Then He went about the villages in a circuit, teaching.
chapters.kjv: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ പന്തിരുവരെ അടുക്കെ വിളിച്ചു, അവരെ ഈരണ്ടായി അയച്ചു തുടങ്ങി, അവർക്കു അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കളുടെ മേൽ അധികാരം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Calling the Twelve to him, he began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over impure spirits.
chapters.nkjv: And He called the twelve to Himself, and began to send them out two by two, and gave them power over unclean spirits.
chapters.kjv: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

chapters.ml: അവർ വഴിക്കു “വടി അല്ലാതെ ഒന്നും എടുക്കരുതു; അപ്പവും പൊക്കണവും മടിശ്ശീലയിൽ കാശും അരുതു; ചെരിപ്പു ഇട്ടുകൊള്ളാം;
chapters.niv: These were his instructions: "Take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.
chapters.nkjv: He commanded them to take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bag, no bread, no copper in their money belts—
chapters.kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു വസ്ത്രം ധരിക്കരുതു” എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.
chapters.nkjv: but to wear sandals, and not to put on two tunics.
chapters.kjv: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എവിടെയെങ്കിലും ഒരു വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നാൽ അവിടം വിട്ടു പുറപ്പെടുവോളം അതിൽ തന്നേ പാർപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.
chapters.nkjv: Also He said to them, "In whatever place you enter a house, stay there till you depart from that place.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളെ കൈക്കൊള്ളാതെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കാതെയും ഇരുന്നാൽ അവിടം വിട്ടു പോകുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ കാലിലെ പൊടി അവർക്കു സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്നായി കുടഞ്ഞുകളവിൻ” എന്നും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, leave that place and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them."
chapters.nkjv: And whoever will not receive you nor hear you, when you depart from there, shake off the dust under your feet as a testimony against them.Assuredly, I say to you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!"
chapters.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടേണം എന്നു പ്രസംഗിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: They went out and preached that people should repent.
chapters.nkjv: So they went out and preached that people should repent.
chapters.kjv: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

chapters.ml: വളരെ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുകയും അനേകം രോഗികൾക്കു എണ്ണതേച്ചു സൌഖ്യം വരുത്തുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.
chapters.nkjv: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many who were sick, and healed them.
chapters.kjv: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them .

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവന്റെ പേർ പ്രസിദ്ധമായി വരികയാൽ ഹെരോദാരാജാവു കേട്ടിട്ടു; യോഹന്നാൻസ്നാപകൻ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റിരിക്കുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഈ ശക്തികൾ അവനിൽ വ്യാപരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known. Some were saying, "John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him."
chapters.nkjv: Now King Herod heard ofHim, for His name had become well known. And he said, "John the Baptist is risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him."
chapters.kjv: And king Herod heard of him ; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഏലീയാവാകുന്നു എന്നു മറ്റു ചിലർ പറഞ്ഞു. വേറെ ചിലർ: അവൻ പ്രവാചകന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനെപ്പോലെ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Others said, "He is Elijah." And still others claimed, "He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago."
chapters.nkjv: Others said, "It is Elijah." And others said, "It is the Prophet, or like one of the prophets."
chapters.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

chapters.ml: അതു ഹെരോദാവു കേട്ടാറെ: ഞാൻ തലവെട്ടിച്ച യോഹന്നാൻ ആകുന്നു അവൻ; അവൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But when Herod heard this, he said, "John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!"
chapters.nkjv: But when Herod heard, he said, "This is John, whom I beheaded; he has been raised from the dead!"
chapters.kjv: But when Herod heard thereof , he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാ തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഫീലിപ്പോസിന്റെ ഭാര്യ ഹെരോദ്യയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവൾനിമിത്തം ആളയച്ചു, യോഹന്നാനെ പിടിച്ചു തടവിൽ ആക്കിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, whom he had married.
chapters.nkjv: For Herod himself had sent and laid hold of John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife; for he had married her.
chapters.kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ പരിഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നതു നിനക്കു വിഹിതമല്ല എന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ ഹെരോദാവോടു പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For John had been saying to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife."
chapters.nkjv: Because John had said to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife."
chapters.kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദ്യയോ അവന്റെ നേരെ പകവെച്ചു അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാനും ഇച്ഛിച്ചു; സാധിച്ചില്ല താനും.
chapters.niv: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Herodias held it against him and wanted to kill him, but she could not;
chapters.kjv: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ നീതിയും വിശുദ്ധിയുമുള്ള പുരുഷൻ എന്നു ഹെരോദാവു അറിഞ്ഞു അവനെ ഭയപ്പെടുകയും അവനെ കാത്തുകൊൾകയും ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടിട്ടു വളരെ കലങ്ങിയെങ്കിലും സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കേട്ടുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard John, he was greatly puzzled ; yet he liked to listen to him.
chapters.nkjv: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just and holy man, and he protected him. And when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
chapters.kjv: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഹെരോദാവു തന്റെ ജനനോത്സവത്തിൽ തന്റെ മഹത്തുക്കൾക്കും സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാർക്കും ഗലീലയിലെ പ്രമാണികൾക്കും വിരുന്നു കഴിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഒരു തരം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Finally the opportune time came. On his birthday Herod gave a banquet for his high officials and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
chapters.nkjv: Then an opportune day came when Herod on his birthday gave a feast for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
chapters.kjv: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദ്യയുടെ മകൾ അകത്തു ചെന്നു നൃത്തം ചെയ്തു ഹെരോദാവിനെയും വിരുന്നുകാരെയും പ്രസാദിപ്പിച്ച സമയം: മനസ്സുള്ളതു എന്തെങ്കിലും എന്നോടു ചോദിച്ചു കൊൾക; നിനക്കു തരാം എന്നു രാജാവു ബാലയോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the girl, "Ask me for anything you want, and I’ll give it to you."
chapters.nkjv: And when Herodias’ daughter herself came in and danced, and pleased Herod and those who sat with him, the king said to the girl, "Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you."
chapters.kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

chapters.ml: എന്തു ചോദിച്ചാലും, രാജ്യത്തിൽ പകുതിയോളം ആയാലും നിനക്കു തരാം എന്നു സത്യം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And he promised her with an oath, "Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom."
chapters.nkjv: He also swore to her, "Whatever you ask me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom."
chapters.kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

chapters.ml: അവൾ പുറത്തിറങ്ങി അമ്മയോടു: ഞാൻ എന്തു ചോദിക്കേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: യോഹന്നാൻ സ്നാപകന്റെ തല എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She went out and said to her mother, "What shall I ask for?" "The head of John the Baptist," she answered.
chapters.nkjv: So she went out and said to her mother, "What shall I ask?" And she said, "The head of John the Baptist!"
chapters.kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവൾ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു രാജാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നെ യോഹന്നാൻ സ്നാപകന്റെ തല ഒരു തളികളയിൽ തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At once the girl hurried in to the king with the request: "I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptist on a platter."
chapters.nkjv: Immediately she came in with haste to the king and asked, saying, "I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter."
chapters.kjv: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

chapters.ml: രാജാവു അതിദുഃഖിനായി എങ്കിലും ആണയെയും വിരുന്നുകാരെയും വിചാരിച്ചു അവളോടു നിഷേധിപ്പാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.
chapters.nkjv: And the king was exceedingly sorry; yet, because of the oaths and because of those who sat with him, he did not want to refuse her.
chapters.kjv: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ രാജാവു ഒരു അകമ്പടിയെ അയച്ചു, അവന്റെ തല കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring John’s head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,
chapters.nkjv: Immediately the king sent an executioner and commanded his head to be brought. And he went and beheaded him in prison,
chapters.kjv: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോയി തടവിൽ അവനെ ശിരഃഛേദം ചെയ്തു; അവന്റെ തല ഒരു തളികയിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ബാലെക്കു കൊടുത്തു; ബാല അമ്മെക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: and brought back his head on a platter. He presented it to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.
chapters.nkjv: brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.
chapters.kjv: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു വന്നു അവന്റെ ശവം എടുത്തു ഒരു കല്ലറയിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On hearing of this, John’s disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.
chapters.nkjv: When his disciples heard ofit, they came and took away his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
chapters.kjv: And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നുകൂടി തങ്ങൾ ചെയ്തതും ഉപദേശിച്ചതും എല്ലാം അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.
chapters.nkjv: Then the apostles gathered to Jesus and told Him all things, both what they had done and what they had taught.
chapters.kjv: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

chapters.ml: വരുന്നവരും പോകുന്നവരും വളരെ ആയിരുന്നതിനാൽ അവർക്കു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാമ്പോലും സമയം ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ ഒരു ഏകാന്തസ്ഥലത്തു വേറിട്ടുവന്നു അല്പം ആശ്വസിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then, because so many people were coming and going that they did not even have a chance to eat, he said to them, "Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Come aside by yourselves to a deserted place and rest a while." For there were many coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ പടകിൽ കയറി ഒരു ഏകാന്ത സ്ഥലത്തു വേറിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.
chapters.nkjv: So they departed to a deserted place in the boat by themselves.
chapters.kjv: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോകുന്നതു പലരും കണ്ടു അറിഞ്ഞു, എല്ലാ പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും കാൽനടയായി അവിടേക്കു ഓടി, അവർക്കു മുമ്പെ എത്തി.
