chapters.niv: He answered, "Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
chapters.nkjv: So He said to them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീയും ഭർത്താവിനെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു മറ്റൊരുത്തനുമായി വിവാഹം കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery."
chapters.nkjv: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery."
chapters.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തൊടേണ്ടതിന്നു ചിലർ ശിശുക്കളെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ശിഷ്യന്മാരോ അവരെ ശാസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples rebuked them.
chapters.nkjv: Then they brought little children to Him, that He might touch them; but the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
chapters.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them .

chapters.ml: യേശു അതു കണ്ടാറെ മുഷിഞ്ഞു അവരോടു: ശിശുക്കളെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ വിടുവിൻ; അവരെ തടുക്കരുതു; ദൈവരാജ്യം ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ളവരുടെതല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant. He said to them, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
chapters.nkjv: But when Jesus saw it, He was greatly displeased and said to them, "Let the little children come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of God.
chapters.kjv: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെ ശിശു എന്നപോലെ കൈക്കൊള്ളാത്തവൻ ആരും ഒരുനാളും അതിൽ കടക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it."
chapters.nkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will by no means enter it."
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരെ അണെച്ചു അവരുടെ മേൽ കൈ വെച്ചു, അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.
chapters.nkjv: And He took them up in His arms, laid His hands on them, and blessed them.
chapters.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു യാത്രചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ ഒരുവൻ ഓടിവന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ മുട്ടുകുത്തി: നല്ല ഗുരോ, നിത്യജീവനെ അവകാശം ആക്കുവാൻ ഞാൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus started on his way, a man ran up to him and fell on his knees before him. "Good teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
chapters.nkjv: Now as He was going out on the road, one came running, knelt before Him, and asked Him, "Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"
chapters.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: എന്നെ നല്ലവൻ എന്നു പറയുന്നതു എന്തു? ദൈവം ഒരുവൻ അല്ലാതെ നല്ലവൻ ആരുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus answered. "No one is good—except God alone.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus said to him, "Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is , God.

chapters.ml: കുലചെയ്യരുതു, വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്യരുതു, മോഷ്ടിക്കരുതു, കള്ളസ്സാക്ഷ്യം പറയരുതു, ചതിക്കരുതു, നിന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും ബഹുമാനിക്ക എന്നീ കല്പനകളെ നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, you shall not defraud, honor your father and mother.’ "
chapters.nkjv: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not bear false witness,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ "
chapters.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, ഇതു ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ ചെറുപ്പം മുതൽ പ്രമാണിച്ചുപോരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Teacher," he declared, "all these I have kept since I was a boy."
chapters.nkjv: And he answered and said to Him, "Teacher, all these things I have kept from my youth."
chapters.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനെ നോക്കി അവനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു: ഒരു കുറവു നിനക്കുണ്ടു; നീ പോയി നിനക്കുള്ളതു എല്ലാം വിറ്റു ദരിദ്രർക്കു കൊടുക്ക; എന്നാൽ നിനക്കു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിക്ഷേപം ഉണ്ടാകും; പിന്നെ വന്നു എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus looked at him and loved him. "One thing you lack," he said. "Go, sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus, looking at him, loved him, and said to him, "One thing you lack: Go your way, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, take up the cross, and follow Me."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വളരെ സമ്പത്തുള്ളവൻ ആകകൊണ്ടു ഈ വചനത്തിങ്കൽ വിഷാദിച്ചു ദുഃഖിതനായി പൊയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At this the man’s face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.
chapters.nkjv: But he was sad at this word, and went away sorrowful, for he had great possessions.
chapters.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

chapters.ml: യേശു ചുറ്റും നോക്കി തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: സമ്പത്തുള്ളവർ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നതു എത്ര പ്രയാസം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, "How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the kingdom of God!"
chapters.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഈ വാക്കിനാൽ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ വിസ്മയിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ യേശു പിന്നെയും: മക്കളേ, സമ്പത്തിൽ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്നവർ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നതു എത്ര പ്രയാസം.
chapters.niv: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again, "Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
chapters.nkjv: And the disciples were astonished at His words. But Jesus answered again and said to them, "Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the kingdom of God!
chapters.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

chapters.ml: ധനവാൻ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ ഒട്ടകം സൂചിക്കുഴയൂടെ കടക്കുന്നതു എളുപ്പം എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഏറ്റവും വിസ്മയിച്ചു: എന്നാൽ രക്ഷപ്രാപിപ്പാൻ ആർക്കു കഴിയും എന്നു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The disciples were even more amazed, and said to each other, "Who then can be saved?"
chapters.nkjv: And they were greatly astonished, saying among themselves, "Who then can be saved?"
chapters.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരെ നോക്കി; മനുഷ്യർക്കു അസാദ്ധ്യം തന്നേ, ദൈവത്തിന്നു അല്ലതാനും; ദൈവത്തിന്നു സകലവും സാദ്ധ്യമല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus looked at them and said, "With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus looked at them and said, "With men it is impossible, but not with God; for with God all things are possible."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: ഇതാ, ഞങ്ങൾ സകലവും വിട്ടു നിന്നെ അനുഗമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Then Peter spoke up, "We have left everything to follow you!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter began to say to Him, "See, we have left all and followed You."
chapters.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: എന്റെ നിമിത്തവും സുവിശേഷം നിമിത്തവും വീടോ സഹോദരന്മാരെയോ സഹോദരികളെയോ അമ്മയെയോ അപ്പനെയോ മക്കളെയോ നിലങ്ങളെയോ വിട്ടാൽ,
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you," Jesus replied, "no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the gospel
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus answered and said, "Assuredly, I say to you, there is no one who has left house or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands, for My sake and the gospel’s,
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,

chapters.ml: ഈ ലോകത്തിൽ തന്നേ, ഉപദ്രവങ്ങളോടും കൂടെ നൂറു മടങ്ങു വീടുകളെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും സഹോദരികളെയും അമ്മമാരെയും മക്കളെയും നിലങ്ങളെയും വരുവാനുള്ള ലോകത്തിൽ നിത്യജീവനെയും പ്രാപിക്കാത്തവൻ ആരുമില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age: homes, brothers, sisters, mothers, children and fields—along with persecutions—and in the age to come eternal life.
chapters.nkjv: who shall not receive a hundredfold now in this time—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and lands, with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
chapters.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും മുമ്പന്മാർ പലരും പിമ്പന്മാരും പിമ്പന്മാർ മുമ്പന്മാരും ആകും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But many who are first will be last, and the last first."
chapters.nkjv: But many who are first will be last, and the last first."
chapters.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

chapters.ml: അവർ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു യാത്രചെയ്കയായിരുന്നു; യേശു അവർക്കു മുമ്പായി നടന്നു; അവർ വിസ്മയിച്ചു; അനുഗമിക്കുന്നവരോ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു. അവൻ പിന്നെയും പന്തിരുവരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: They were on their way up to Jerusalem, with Jesus leading the way, and the disciples were astonished, while those who followed were afraid. Again he took the Twelve aside and told them what was going to happen to him.
chapters.nkjv: Now they were on the road, going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was going before them; and they were amazed. And as they followed they were afraid. Then He took the twelve aside again and began to tell them the things that would happen to Him:
chapters.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, നാം യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോകുന്നു; അവിടെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെയും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരുടെയും കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കപ്പെടും; അവർ അവനെ മരണത്തിനു വിധിച്ചു ജാതികൾക്കു ഏല്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "We are going up to Jerusalem," he said, "and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death and will hand him over to the Gentiles,
chapters.nkjv: "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and to the scribes; and they will condemn Him to death and deliver Him to the Gentiles;
chapters.kjv: Saying , Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ പരിഹസിക്കയും തുപ്പുകയും തല്ലുകയും കൊല്ലുകയും മൂന്നു നാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കയും ചെയ്യും എന്നിങ്ങനെ തനിക്കു സംഭവിക്കാനുള്ളതു പറഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: who will mock him and spit on him, flog him and kill him. Three days later he will rise."
chapters.nkjv: and they will mock Him, and scourge Him, and spit on Him, and kill Him. And the third day He will rise again."
chapters.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

chapters.ml: സെബെദിയുടെ മക്കളായ യാക്കോബും യോഹന്നാനും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നോടു യാചിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നതു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ചെയ്തുതരുവാൻ അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to him. "Teacher," they said, "we want you to do for us whatever we ask."
chapters.nkjv: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Him, saying, "Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask."
chapters.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ചെയ്തുതരുവാൻ നിങ്ങൾ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "What do you want me to do for you?" he asked.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "What do you want Me to do for you?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ മഹത്വത്തിൽ ഞങ്ങളിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ നിന്റെ വലത്തും ഒരുത്തൻ ഇടത്തും ഇരിക്കാൻ വരം നല്കേണം എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "Let one of us sit at your right and the other at your left in your glory."
chapters.nkjv: They said to Him, "Grant us that we may sit, one on Your right hand and the other on Your left, in Your glory."
chapters.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ യാചിക്കുന്നതു ഇന്നതു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ല; ഞാൻ കുടിക്കുന്നപാന പാത്രം കുടിപ്പാനും ഞാൻ ഏല്ക്കുന്ന സ്നാനം ഏല്പാനും നിങ്ങൾക്കു കഴിയുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു കഴിയും എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You don’t know what you are asking," Jesus said. "Can you drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?"
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said to them, "You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?"
chapters.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: ഞാൻ കുടിക്കുന്ന പാനപാത്രം നിങ്ങൾ കുടിക്കയും ഞാൻ ഏല്ക്കുന്ന സ്നാനം ഏൽക്കയും ചെയ്യും നിശ്ചയം.
chapters.niv: "We can," they answered. Jesus said to them, "You will drink the cup I drink and be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with,
chapters.nkjv: They said to Him, "We are able." So Jesus said to them, "You will indeed drink the cup that I drink, and with the baptism I am baptized with you will be baptized;
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വലത്തും ഇടത്തും ഇരിപ്പാൻ വരം നല്കുന്നതോ എന്റേതല്ല; ആർക്കു ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നുവോ അവർക്കു കിട്ടും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared."
chapters.nkjv: but to sit on My right hand and on My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it is prepared."
chapters.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

chapters.ml: അതു ശേഷം പത്തു പേരും കേട്ടിട്ടു യാക്കോബിനോടും യോഹന്നാനോടും നീരസപ്പെട്ടുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
chapters.nkjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be greatly displeased with James and John.
chapters.kjv: And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരെ അടുക്കെ വിളിച്ചു അവരോടു: ജാതികളിൽ അധിപതികളായവർ അവരിൽ കർത്തൃത്വം ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവരിൽ മഹത്തുക്കളായവർ അവരുടെ മേൽ അധികാരം നടത്തുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus called them together and said, "You know that those who are regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus called them to Himself and said to them, "You know that those who are considered rulers over the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
chapters.kjv: But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ അങ്ങനെ അരുതു; നിങ്ങളിൽ മഹാൻ ആകുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം നിങ്ങളുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരൻ ആകേണം;
chapters.niv: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
chapters.nkjv: Yet it shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.
chapters.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നാമൻ ആകുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാവർക്കും ദാസനാകേണം.
chapters.niv: and whoever wants to be first must be slave of all.
chapters.nkjv: And whoever of you desires to be first shall be slave of all.
chapters.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യിപ്പാനല്ല, ശുശ്രൂഷിപ്പാനും അനേകർക്കുവേണ്ടി തന്റെ ജീവനെ മറുവിലയായി കൊടുപ്പാനും അത്രെ വന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
chapters.nkjv: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many."
chapters.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

chapters.ml: അവർ യെരീഹോവിൽ എത്തി; പിന്നെ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടും വലിയ പുരുഷാരത്തോടും കൂടെ യെരീഹോവിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ തിമായിയുടെ മകനായ ബർത്തിമായി എന്ന കുരുടനായ ഒരു ഭിക്ഷക്കാരൻ വഴിയരികെ ഇരുന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then they came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples, together with a large crowd, were leaving the city, a blind man, Bartimaeus (which means "son of Timaeus"), was sitting by the roadside begging.
chapters.nkjv: Now they came to Jericho. As He went out of Jericho with His disciples and a great multitude, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the road begging.
chapters.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.

chapters.ml: നസറായനായ യേശു എന്നു കേട്ടിട്ടു അവൻ ദാവീദ് പുത്രാ, യേശുവേ, എന്നോടു കരുണ തോന്നേണമേ എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.nkjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out and say, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

chapters.ml: മിണ്ടാതിരിപ്പാൻ പലരും അവനെ ശാസിച്ചിട്ടും: ദാവീദുപുത്രാ, എന്നോടു കരുണ തോന്നേണമേ എന്നു അവൻ ഏറ്റവും അധികം നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.nkjv: Then many warned him to be quiet; but he cried out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യേശു നിന്നു: അവനെ വിളിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ധൈര്യപ്പെടുക, എഴുന്നേൽക്ക, നിന്നെ വിളിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു കുരുടനെ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." So they called to the blind man, "Cheer up! On your feet! He’s calling you."
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus stood still and commanded him to be called. Then they called the blind man, saying to him, "Be of good cheer. Rise, He is calling you."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ പുതപ്പു ഇട്ടും കളഞ്ഞു ചാടിയെഴുന്നേറ്റു യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And throwing aside his garment, he rose and came to Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “ഞാൻ നിനക്കു എന്തു ചെയ്തുതരേണമെന്നു നീ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: റബ്ബൂനീ, എനിക്കു കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിക്കേണമെന്നു കുരുടൻ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What do you want me to do for you?" Jesus asked him. The blind man said, "Rabbi, I want to see."
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus answered and said to him, "What do you want Me to do for you?" The blind man said to Him, "Rabboni, that I may receive my sight."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: പോക; നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം നിന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഉടനെ അവൻ കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചു യാത്രയിൽ അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Go," said Jesus, "your faith has healed you." Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to him, "Go your way; your faith has made you well." And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the road.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

chapters.ml: അവർ യെരൂശലേമിനോടു സമീപിച്ചു ഒലീവ് മലയരികെ ബേത്ത്ഫാഗയിലും ബേഥാന്യയിലും എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരെ അയച്ചു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,
chapters.nkjv: Now when they drew near Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples;
chapters.kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങൾക്കു എതിരെയുള്ള ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; അതിൽ കടന്നാൽ ഉടനെ ആരും ഒരിക്കലും കയറീട്ടില്ലാത്ത ഒരു കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെ കെട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നതു കാണും; അതിനെ അഴിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: saying to them, "Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
chapters.nkjv: and He said to them, "Go into the village opposite you; and as soon as you have entered it you will find a colt tied, on which no one has sat. Loose it and bring it.
chapters.kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him .

chapters.ml: ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ആരെങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളോടു ചോദിച്ചാൽ കർത്താവിന്നു ഇതിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറവിൻ; അവൻ ക്ഷണത്തിൽ അതിനെ ഇങ്ങോട്ടു അയക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And if anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it,’ and immediately he will send it here."
chapters.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോയി തെരുവിൽ പുറത്തു വാതിൽക്കൽ കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെ കെട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു അതിനെ അഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,
chapters.nkjv: So they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door outside on the street, and they loosed it.
chapters.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നവരിൽ ചിലർ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെ അഴിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: some people standing there asked, "What are you doing, untying that colt?"
chapters.nkjv: But some of those who stood there said to them, "What are you doing, loosing the colt?"
chapters.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

chapters.ml: യേശു കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ അവർ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ അവരെ വിട്ടയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.
chapters.nkjv: And they spoke to them just as Jesus had commanded. So they let them go.
chapters.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

chapters.ml: അവർ കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെ യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം അതിന്മേൽ ഇട്ടു; അവൻ അതിന്മേൽ കയറി ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, he sat on it.
chapters.nkjv: Then they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their clothes on it, and He sat on it.
chapters.kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

chapters.ml: അനേകർ തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം വഴിയിൽ വിരിച്ചു; മറ്റു ചിലർ പറമ്പുകളിൽ നിന്നു ചില്ലിക്കൊമ്പു വെട്ടി വഴിയിൽ വിതറി.
chapters.niv: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.
chapters.nkjv: And many spread their clothes on the road, and others cut down leafy branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
chapters.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

chapters.ml: മുമ്പും പിമ്പും നടക്കുന്നവർ: ഹോശന്നാ, കർത്താവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വരുന്നവൻ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ:
chapters.niv: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, "Hosanna! " "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"
chapters.nkjv: Then those who went before and those who followed cried out, saying: "Hosanna! ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!’
chapters.kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

chapters.ml: വരുന്നതായ രാജ്യം, നമ്മുടെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ രാജ്യം വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ; അത്യുന്നതങ്ങളിൽ ഹോശന്നാ എന്നു ആർത്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!" "Hosanna in the highest heaven!"
chapters.nkjv: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David That comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"
chapters.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ ദൈവാലയത്തിലേക്കു ചെന്നു സകലവും ചുറ്റും നോക്കിയ ശേഷം നേരം വൈകിയതുകൊണ്ടു പന്തിരുവരോടും കൂടെ ബേഥാന്യയിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus went into Jerusalem and into the temple. So when He had looked around at all things, as the hour was already late, He went out to Bethany with the twelve.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവർ ബേഥാന്യ വിട്ടു പോരുമ്പോൾ അവന്നു വിശന്നു;
chapters.niv: The next day as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
chapters.nkjv: Now the next day, when they had come out from Bethany, He was hungry.
chapters.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇലയുള്ളോരു അത്തിവൃക്ഷം ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു കണ്ടു, അതിൽ വല്ലതും കണ്ടുകിട്ടുമോ എന്നു വെച്ചു ചെന്നു, അതിന്നരികെ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഇല അല്ലാതെ ഒന്നും കണ്ടില്ല; അതു അത്തിപ്പഴത്തിന്റെ കാലമല്ലാഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to find out if it had any fruit. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.
chapters.nkjv: And seeing from afar a fig tree having leaves, He went to see if perhaps He would find something on it. When He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
chapters.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet .

chapters.ml: അവൻ അതിനോടു; ഇനി നിങ്കൽനിന്നു എന്നേക്കും ആരും ഫലം തിന്നാതിരിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to the tree, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again." And his disciples heard him say it.
chapters.nkjv: In response Jesus said to it, "Let no one eat fruit from you ever again." And His disciples heard it.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

chapters.ml: അവർ യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ കടന്നു, ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ വില്ക്കുന്നവരെയും വാങ്ങുന്നവരെയും പുറത്താക്കിത്തുടങ്ങി; പൊൻവാണിഭക്കാരുടെ മേശകളെയും പ്രാക്കളെ വില്ക്കുന്നവരുടെ പീഠങ്ങളെയും മറിച്ചിട്ടു കളഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: On reaching Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves,
chapters.nkjv: So they came to Jerusalem. Then Jesus went into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in the temple, and overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who sold doves.
chapters.kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

chapters.ml: ആരും ദൈവാലയത്തിൽകൂടി ഒരു വസ്തുവും കൊണ്ടു പോകുവാൻ സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
chapters.nkjv: And He would not allow anyone to carry wares through the temple.
chapters.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരെ ഉപദേശിച്ചു: എന്റെ ആലയം സകല ജാതികൾക്കും പ്രാർത്ഥനാലയം എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടും എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നില്ലയൊ? നിങ്ങളോ അതിനെ കള്ളന്മാരുടെ ഗുഹയാക്കിത്തീർത്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And as he taught them, he said, "Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’ ? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then He taught, saying to them, "Is it not written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it a ‘den of thieves.’"
chapters.kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

chapters.ml: അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും അവനെ നശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു അന്വേഷിച്ചു. പുരുഷാരം എല്ലാം അവന്റെ ഉപദേശത്തിൽ അതിശയിക്കയാൽ അവർ അവനെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The chief priests and the teachers of the law heard this and began looking for a way to kill him, for they feared him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.
chapters.nkjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it and sought how they might destroy Him; for they feared Him, because all the people were astonished at His teaching.
chapters.kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യായാകുമ്പോൾ അവൻ നഗരം വിട്ടു പോകും.
chapters.niv: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.
chapters.nkjv: When evening had come, He went out of the city.
chapters.kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

chapters.ml: രാവിലെ അവർ കടന്നുപോരുമ്പോൾ അത്തിവൃക്ഷം വേരോടെ ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
chapters.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസിന്നു ഓർമ്മവന്നു: റബ്ബീ, നീ ശപിച്ച അത്തി ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയല്ലോ എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!"
chapters.nkjv: And Peter, remembering, said to Him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree which You cursed has withered away."
chapters.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: ദൈവത്തിൽ വിശ്വാസമുള്ളവർ ആയിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Have faith in God," Jesus answered.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus answered and said to them, "Have faith in God.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും തന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ സംശയിക്കാതെ താൻ പറയുന്നതു സംഭവിക്കും എന്നു വിശ്വസിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു ഈ മലയോടു: നീ നീങ്ങി കടലിൽ ചാടിപ്പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ സംഭവിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.
chapters.nkjv: For assuredly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be removed and be cast into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that those things he says will be done, he will have whatever he says.
chapters.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുമ്പോൾ യാചിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും ലഭിച്ചു എന്നു വിശ്വസിപ്പിൻ; എന്നാൽ അതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I say to you, whatever things you ask when you pray, believe that you receive them, and you will have them.
chapters.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them , and ye shall have them .

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പാൻ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവു നിങ്ങളുടെ പിഴകളെയും ക്ഷമിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആരോടെങ്കിലും വല്ലതും ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അവനോടു ക്ഷമിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins."
chapters.nkjv: "And whenever you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive him, that your Father in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses.
chapters.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ക്ഷമിക്കാഞ്ഞാലോ സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവു നിങ്ങളുടെ പിഴകളെയും ക്ഷമിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: They arrived again in Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders came to him.
chapters.nkjv: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your trespasses."
chapters.kjv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

chapters.ml: അവർ പിന്നെയും യെരൂശലേമിൽ ചെന്നു. അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചുറ്റി നടക്കുമ്പോൾ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു;
chapters.niv: "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you authority to do this?"
chapters.nkjv: Then they came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to Him.
chapters.kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

chapters.ml: നീ എന്തു അധികാരംകൊണ്ടു ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നും ഇതു ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ള അധികാരം നിനക്കു തന്നതു ആർ എന്നും അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
chapters.nkjv: And they said to Him, "By what authority are You doing these things? And who gave You this authority to do these things?"
chapters.kjv: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ഒരു വാക്കു ചോദിക്കും; അതിന്നു ഉത്തരം പറവിൻ; എന്നാൽ ഇന്ന അധികാരംകൊണ്ടു ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു ഞാനും നിങ്ങളോടു പറയും.
chapters.niv: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin? Tell me!"
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one question; then answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things:
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാന്റെ സ്നാനം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നോ മനുഷ്യരിൽനിന്നോ ഉണ്ടായതു? എന്നോടു ഉത്തരം പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’
chapters.nkjv: The baptism of John—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me."
chapters.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

chapters.ml: അവർ തമ്മിൽ ആലോചിച്ചു: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ പിന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ വിശ്വസിക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ പറയും.
chapters.niv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’ …" (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)
chapters.nkjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
chapters.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരിൽ നിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാലോ-എല്ലാവരും യോഹന്നാനെ സാക്ഷാൽ പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു എണ്ണുകകൊണ്ടു അവർ ജനത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: So they answered Jesus, "We don’t know." Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."
chapters.nkjv: But if we say, ‘From men’ "—they feared the people, for all counted John to have been a prophet indeed.
chapters.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ യേശുവിനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അറിഞ്ഞുകൂടാ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. “എന്നാൽ ഞാനും ഇതു ഇന്ന അധികാരം കൊണ്ടു ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നില്ല” എന്നു യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.nkjv: So they answered and said to Jesus, "We do not know." And Jesus answered and said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
chapters.kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ഉപമകളാൽ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങിയതു: ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഒരു മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടം നട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി ചുറ്റും വേലികെട്ടി ചക്കും കുഴിച്ചുനാട്ടി ഗോപുരവും പണിതു കുടിയാന്മാരെ ഏല്പിച്ചിട്ടു പരദേശത്തു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Jesus then began to speak to them in parables: "A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.
chapters.nkjv: Then He began to speak to them in parables: "A man planted a vineyard and set a hedge around it, dug a place for the wine vat and built a tower. And he leased it to vinedressers and went into a far country.
chapters.kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it , and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

chapters.ml: കാലം ആയപ്പോൾ കുടിയാന്മാരോടു തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ അനുഭവം വാങ്ങേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ഒരു ദാസനെ കുടിയാന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.
chapters.nkjv: Now at vintage-time he sent a servant to the vinedressers, that he might receive some of the fruit of the vineyard from the vinedressers.
chapters.kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു തല്ലി വെറുതെ അയച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they seized him, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.nkjv: And they took him and beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.kjv: And they caught him , and beat him, and sent him away empty.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മറ്റൊരു ദാസനെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു; അവനെ അവർ തലയിൽ മുറിവേല്പിക്കയും അവമാനിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.
chapters.nkjv: Again he sent them another servant, and at him they threw stones, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
chapters.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മറ്റൊരുവനെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു; അവനെ അവർ കൊന്നു; മറ്റു പലരെയും ചിലരെ അടിക്കയും ചിലരെ കൊല്ലുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.
chapters.nkjv: And again he sent another, and him they killed; and many others, beating some and killing some.
chapters.kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു ഇനി ഒരുത്തൻ, ഒരു പ്രിയമകൻ, ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. എന്റെ മകനെ അവർ ശങ്കിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഒടുക്കം അവനെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "He had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
chapters.nkjv: Therefore still having one son, his beloved, he also sent him to them last, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
chapters.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

chapters.ml: ആ കുടിയാന്മാരോ: ഇവൻ അവകാശി ആകുന്നു; വരുവിൻ; നാം ഇവനെ കൊല്ലുക; എന്നാൽ അവകാശം നമുക്കാകും എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
chapters.nkjv: But those vinedressers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
chapters.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു കൊന്നു തോട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്നു എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
chapters.nkjv: So they took him and killed him and cast him out of the vineyard.
chapters.kjv: And they took him, and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഉടയവൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യും? അവൻ വന്നു ആ കുടിയാന്മാരെ നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു തോട്ടം മറ്റുള്ളവരെ ഏല്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore what will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the vinedressers, and give the vineyard to others.
chapters.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

chapters.ml: “വീടു പണിയുന്നവർ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞ കല്ലു മൂലക്കല്ലായിതീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: Haven’t you read this passage of Scripture: " ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
chapters.nkjv: Have you not even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone.
chapters.kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

chapters.ml: “ഇതു കർത്താവിനാൽ സംഭവിച്ചു. നമ്മുടെ ദൃഷ്ടിയിൽ ആശ്ചര്യവുമായിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്ന തിരുവെഴുത്തു നിങ്ങൾ വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?"
chapters.nkjv: This was the Lord’s doing, And it is marvelous in our eyes’?"
chapters.kjv: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

chapters.ml: ഈ ഉപമ തങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു ആകുന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്നു ഗ്രഹിച്ചിട്ടു അവർ അവനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ അന്വേഷിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ പുരുഷാരത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു അവനെ വിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.
chapters.nkjv: And they sought to lay hands on Him, but feared the multitude, for they knew He had spoken the parable against them. So they left Him and went away.
chapters.kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവനെ വാക്കിൽ കുടുക്കുവാൻ വേണ്ടി അവർ പരീശന്മാരിലും ഹെരോദ്യരിലും ചിലരെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.
chapters.nkjv: Then they sent to Him some of the Pharisees and the Herodians, to catch Him in His words.
chapters.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

chapters.ml: അവർ വന്നു: ഗുരോ, നീ മനുഷ്യരുടെ മുഖം നോക്കാതെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വഴി നേരായി പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നീ സത്യവാനും ആരെയും ഗണ്യമാക്കാത്തവനും എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു; കൈസർക്കു കരം കൊടുക്കുന്നതു വിഹിതമോ അല്ലയോ? ഞങ്ങൾ കൊടുക്കയോ കൊടുക്കാതിരിക്കയോ വേണ്ടതു എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They came to him and said, "Teacher, we know that you are a man of integrity. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are; but you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?
chapters.nkjv: When they had come, they said to Him, "Teacher, we know that You are true, and care about no one; for You do not regard the person of men, but teach the way of God in truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
chapters.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cæsar, or not?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ കപടം അറിഞ്ഞു: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ പരീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? ഒരു വെള്ളിക്കാശ് കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ; ഞാൻ കാണട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Should we pay or shouldn’t we?" But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. "Why are you trying to trap me?" he asked. "Bring me a denarius and let me look at it."
chapters.nkjv: Shall we pay, or shall we not pay?" But He, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, "Why do you test Me? Bring Me a denarius that I may see it."
chapters.kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it .

chapters.ml: അവർ കൊണ്ടു വന്നു. ഈ സ്വരൂപവും മേലെഴുത്തും ആരുടേതു എന്നു അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: കൈസരുടേതു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They brought the coin, and he asked them, "Whose image is this? And whose inscription?" "Caesar’s," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: So they brought it. And He said to them, "Whose image and inscription is this?" They said to Him, "Caesar’s."
chapters.kjv: And they brought it . And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cæsar’s.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: കൈസർക്കുള്ളതു കൈസർക്കും ദൈവത്തിനുള്ളതു ദൈവത്തിന്നും കൊടുപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ അവങ്കൽ വളരെ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to them, "Give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to God what is God’s." And they were amazed at him.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus answered and said to them, "Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s." And they marveled at Him.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.

chapters.ml: പുനരുത്ഥാനം ഇല്ല എന്നു പറയുന്ന സദൂക്യർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു ചോദിച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
chapters.nkjv: Then some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him; and they asked Him, saying:
chapters.kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

chapters.ml: ഗുരോ, ഒരുത്തന്റെ സഹോദരൻ മക്കളില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചു ഭാര്യ ശേഷിച്ചാൽ ആ ഭാര്യയെ അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു തന്റെ സഹോദരന്നു സന്തതിയെ ജനിപ്പിക്കേണം എന്നു മോശെ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
chapters.nkjv: "Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies, and leaves his wife behind, and leaves no children, his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
chapters.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏഴു സഹോദരന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവരിൽ മൂത്തവൻ ഒരു സ്ത്രീയെ വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചു സന്തതിയില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died without leaving any children.
chapters.nkjv: Now there were seven brothers. The first took a wife; and dying, he left no offspring.
chapters.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തവൻ അവളെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു സന്തതിയില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചു; മൂന്നാമത്തവനും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.
chapters.nkjv: And the second took her, and he died; nor did he leave any offspring. And the third likewise.
chapters.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

chapters.ml: ഏഴുവരും സന്തതിയില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചു; എല്ലാവർക്കും ഒടുവിൽ സ്ത്രീയും മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.
chapters.nkjv: So the seven had her and left no offspring. Last of all the woman died also.
chapters.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

chapters.ml: പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിൽ അവൾ അവരിൽ ഏവന്നു ഭാര്യയാകും? ഏഴുവർക്കും ഭാര്യ ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, in the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be? For all seven had her as wife."
chapters.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നിങ്ങൾ തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളെയും ദൈവശക്തിയെയും അറിയായ്കകൊണ്ടല്ലയോ തെറ്റിപ്പോകുന്നതു?
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Are you not therefore mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures nor the power of God?
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കുമ്പോൾ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കയില്ല വിവാഹത്തിന്നു കൊടുക്കപ്പെടുകയുമില്ല; സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ ദൂതന്മാരെപ്പോലെ ആകും.
chapters.niv: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
chapters.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മരിച്ചവർ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കുന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു മോശെയുടെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ മുൾപടർപ്പുഭാഗത്തു ദൈവം അവനോടു: ഞാൻ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദൈവവും യാക്കോബിന്റെ ദൈവവും എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തപ്രകാരം വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Now about the dead rising—have you not read in the Book of Moses, in the account of the burning bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ?
chapters.nkjv: But concerning the dead, that they rise, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the burning bush passage, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘Iamthe God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
chapters.kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

chapters.ml: അവൻ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ദൈവമല്ല, ജീവനുള്ളവരുടെ ദൈവമത്രേ; നിങ്ങൾ വളരെ തെറ്റിപ്പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!"
chapters.nkjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living. You are therefore greatly mistaken."
chapters.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

chapters.ml: ശാസ്ത്രിമാരിൽ ഒരുവൻ അടുത്തുവന്നു അവർ തമ്മിൽ തർക്കിക്കുന്നതു കേട്ടു അവൻ അവരോടു നല്ലവണ്ണം ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞപ്രകാരം ബോധിച്ചിട്ടു: എല്ലാറ്റിലും മുഖ്യകല്പന ഏതു എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു യേശു:
chapters.niv: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, "Of all the commandments, which is the most important?"
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, perceiving that He had answered them well, asked Him, "Which is the first commandment of all?"
chapters.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

chapters.ml: എല്ലാറ്റിലും മുഖ്യകല്പനയോ: “യിസ്രായേലേ, കേൾക്ക; നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവു ഏക കർത്താവു.
chapters.niv: "The most important one," answered Jesus, "is this: ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered him, "The first of all the commandments is: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is , Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവിനെ നീ പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണാത്മാവോടും പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടും പൂർണ്ണശക്തിയോടും കൂടെ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം, എന്നു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
chapters.nkjv: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’This is the first commandment.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തേതോ: “കൂട്ടുകാരനെ നിന്നെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം” എന്നത്രേ; ഇവയിൽ വലുതായിട്ടു മറ്റൊരു കല്പനയും എല്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no commandment greater than these."
chapters.nkjv: And the second, like it, is this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these."
chapters.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

chapters.ml: ശാസ്ത്രി അവനോടു: നന്നു, ഗുരോ, നീ പറഞ്ഞതു സത്യം തന്നേ; ഏകനേയുള്ളൂ; അവനല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊരുത്തനുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Well said, teacher," the man replied. "You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.
chapters.nkjv: So the scribe said to Him, "Well said, Teacher. You have spoken the truth, for there is one God, and there is no other but He.
chapters.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

chapters.ml: അവനെ പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണ മനസ്സോടും പൂർണ്ണശക്തിയോടുംകൂടെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നതും തന്നെപ്പോലെ കൂട്ടുകാരനെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നതും സകല സർവ്വാംഗഹോമങ്ങളെക്കാളും യാഗങ്ങളെക്കാളും സാരമേറിയതു തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: To love him with all your heart, with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices."
chapters.nkjv: And to love Him with all the heart, with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is more than all the whole burnt offerings and sacrifices."
chapters.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബുദ്ധിയോടെ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു യേശു കണ്ടിട്ടു: നീ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തോടു അകന്നവനല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവനോടു ആരും ഒന്നും ചോദിപ്പാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, "You are not far from the kingdom of God." And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Jesus saw that he answered wisely, He said to him, "You are not far from the kingdom of God." But after that no one dared question Him.
chapters.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

chapters.ml: യേശു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങിയതു: ക്രിസ്തു ദാവീദിന്റെ പുത്രൻ എന്നു ശാസ്ത്രിമാർ പറയുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ?
chapters.niv: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, he asked, "Why do the teachers of the law say that the Messiah is the son of David?
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus answered and said, while He taught in the temple, "How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

chapters.ml: “കർത്താവു എന്റെ കർത്താവിനോടു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ നിന്റെ പാദപീഠം ആക്കുവോളം എന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തിരിക്ക എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു” എന്നു ദാവീദ് താൻ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിലായി പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: David himself, speaking by the Holy Spirit, declared: " ‘The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet." ’
chapters.nkjv: For David himself said by the Holy Spirit: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool." ’
chapters.kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തന്നേ അവനെ കർത്താവു എന്നു പറയുന്നവല്ലോ; പിന്നെ അവന്റെ പുത്രൻ ആകുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ? എന്നാൽ വലിയ പുരുഷാരം അവന്റെ വാക്കു സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കേട്ടുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: David himself calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?" The large crowd listened to him with delight.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore David himself calls Him ‘Lord’; how is He then his Son?" And the common people heard Him gladly.
chapters.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ഉപദേശത്തിൽ അവരോടു: അങ്കികളോടെ നടക്കുന്നതും അങ്ങാടിയിൽ
chapters.niv: As he taught, Jesus said, "Watch out for the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and be greeted with respect in the marketplaces,
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them in His teaching, "Beware of the scribes, who desire to go around in long robes, love greetings in the marketplaces,
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

chapters.ml: വന്ദനവും പള്ളിയിൽ മുഖ്യാസനവും അത്താഴത്തിൽ പ്രധാനസ്ഥലവും ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്ന ശാസ്ത്രിമാരെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
chapters.nkjv: the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts,
chapters.kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

chapters.ml: അവർ വിധവമാരുടെ വീടുകളെ വിഴുങ്ങുകയും ഉപായത്താൽ നീണ്ട പ്രാർത്ഥന കഴിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവർക്കു ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ശിക്ഷാവിധി വരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They devour widows’ houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will be punished most severely."
chapters.nkjv: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation."
chapters.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യേശു ശ്രീഭണ്ഡാരത്തിന്നു നേരെ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ പുരുഷാരം ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽ പണം ഇടുന്നതു നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; ധനവാന്മാർ പലരും വളരെ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jesus sat opposite the treasury and saw how the people put money into the treasury. And many whowere rich put in much.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

chapters.ml: ദരിദ്രയായ ഒരു വിധവ വന്നു ഒരു പൈസക്കു ശരിയായ രണ്ടു കാശ് ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: But a poor widow came and put in two very small copper coins, worth only a few cents.
chapters.nkjv: Then one poor widow came and threw in two mites, which make a quadrans.
chapters.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ അടുക്കൽ വിളിച്ചു: ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽ ഇട്ട എല്ലാവരെക്കാളും ഈ ദരിദ്രയായ വിധവ അധികം ഇട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Calling his disciples to him, Jesus said, "Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more into the treasury than all the others.
chapters.nkjv: So He called His disciples to Himself and said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you that this poor widow has put in more than all those who have given to the treasury;
chapters.kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും തങ്ങളുടെ സമൃദ്ധിയിൽ നിന്നു ഇട്ടു; ഇവളോ തന്റെ ഇല്ലായ്മയിൽ നിന്നു തനിക്കുള്ളതു ഒക്കെയും തന്റെ ഉപജീവനം മുഴുവനും ഇട്ടു എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They all gave out of their wealth; but she, out of her poverty, put in everything—all she had to live on."
chapters.nkjv: for they all put in out of their abundance, but she out of her poverty put in all that she had, her whole livelihood."
chapters.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തെ വിട്ടു പോകുമ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ: ഗുരോ, ഇതാ, എങ്ങനെയുള്ള കല്ലു, എങ്ങനെയുള്ള പണി എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!"
chapters.nkjv: Then as He went out of the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, "Teacher, see what manner of stones and what buildings arehere!"
chapters.kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here !

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: നീ ഈ വലിയ പണി കാണുന്നുവോ? ഇടിക്കാതെ കല്ലിന്മേൽ കല്ലു ഇവിടെ ശേഷിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Do you see all these great buildings?" replied Jesus. "Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down."
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus answered and said to him, "Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone shall be left upon another, that shall not be thrown down."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ഒലീവ് മലയിൽ ദൈവാലയത്തിന്നു നേരെ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ പത്രൊസും യാക്കോബും യോഹന്നാനും അന്ത്രെയാസും സ്വകാര്യമായി അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately,
chapters.nkjv: Now as He sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
chapters.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

chapters.ml: അതു എപ്പോൾ സംഭവിക്കും? അതിന്നു എല്ലാം നിവൃത്തി വരുന്ന കാലത്തിന്റെ ലക്ഷണം എന്തു എന്നു ഞങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞാലും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?"
chapters.nkjv: "Tell us, when will these things be? And what willbe the sign when all these things will be fulfilled?"
chapters.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങിയതു: ആരും നിങ്ങളെ തെറ്റിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them: "Watch out that no one deceives you.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus, answering them, began to say: "Take heed that no one deceives you.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു അനേകർ എന്റെ പേരെടുത്തു വന്നു പലരെയും തെറ്റിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many.
chapters.nkjv: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
chapters.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ ; and shall deceive many.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ യുദ്ധങ്ങളെയും യുദ്ധശ്രുതികളെയും കുറിച്ചു കേൾക്കുമ്പോൾ ഭ്രമിച്ചുപോകരുതു. അതു സംഭവിക്കേണ്ടതു തന്നേ; എന്നാൽ അതു അവസാനമല്ല.
chapters.niv: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.
chapters.nkjv: But when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be troubled; for such things must happen, but the end is not yet.
chapters.kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

chapters.ml: ജാതി ജാതിയോടും രാജ്യം രാജ്യത്തോടും എതിർക്കും; അവിടവിടെ ഭൂകമ്പവും ക്ഷാമവും ഉണ്ടാകും; ഇതു ഈറ്റുനോവിന്റെ ആരംഭമത്രേ.
chapters.niv: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
chapters.nkjv: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. And there will be earthquakes in various places, and there will be famines and troubles. These are the beginnings of sorrows.
chapters.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ; അവർ നിങ്ങളെ ന്യായാധിപസംഘങ്ങളിൽ ഏല്പിക്കയും പള്ളികളിൽവെച്ചു തല്ലുകയും എന്റെ നിമിത്തം നാടുവാഴികൾക്കും രാജാക്കന്മാർക്കും മുമ്പാകെ അവർക്കു സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്നായി നിറുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: "You must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
chapters.nkjv: "But watch out for yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils, and you will be beaten in the synagogues. You will be brought before rulers and kings for My sake, for a testimony to them.
chapters.kjv: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സുവിശേഷം മുമ്പെ സകലജാതികളോടും പ്രസംഗിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.
chapters.nkjv: And the gospel must first be preached to all the nations.
chapters.kjv: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

chapters.ml: അവർ നിങ്ങളെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി ഏല്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ എന്തു പറയേണ്ടു എന്നു മുൻകൂട്ടി വിചാരപ്പെടരുതു. ആ നാഴികയിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ലഭിക്കുന്നതു തന്നേ പറവിൻ; പറയുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾ അല്ല, പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവത്രേ.
chapters.niv: Whenever you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given you at the time, for it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: But when they arrest you and deliver you up, do not worry beforehand, or premeditate what you will speak. But whatever is given you in that hour, speak that; for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
chapters.kjv: But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരൻ സഹോദരനെയും അപ്പൻ മകനെയും മരണത്തിന്നു ഏല്പിക്കും; മക്കളും അമ്മയപ്പന്മാരുടെ നേരെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരെ കൊല്ലിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.
chapters.nkjv: Now brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; and children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
chapters.kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നാമം നിമിത്തം എല്ലാവരും നിങ്ങളെ പകെക്കും; എന്നാൽ അവസാനത്തോളം സഹിച്ചു നില്ക്കുന്നവൻ രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.
chapters.nkjv: And you will be hated by all for My name’s sake. But he who endures to the end shall be saved.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൂന്യമാക്കുന്ന മ്ളേച്ഛത നില്ക്കുരുതാത്ത സ്ഥലത്തു നില്ക്കുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾ കാണുമ്പോൾ, - വായിക്കുന്നവൻ ചിന്തിച്ചുകൊള്ളട്ടെ - അന്നു യെഹൂദ്യദേശത്തു ഉള്ളവർ മലകളിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "When you see ‘the abomination that causes desolation’ standing where it does not belong—let the reader understand—then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
chapters.nkjv: "So when you see the ‘abomination of desolation,’spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not" (let the reader understand), "then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
chapters.kjv: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:

chapters.ml: വീട്ടിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ അകത്തേക്കു ഇറങ്ങിപോകയോ വീട്ടിൽ നിന്നു വല്ലതും എടുപ്പാൻ കടക്കയോ അരുതു.
chapters.niv: Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out.
chapters.nkjv: Let him who is on the housetop not go down into the house, nor enter to take anything out of his house.
chapters.kjv: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein , to take any thing out of his house:

chapters.ml: വയലിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ വസ്ത്രം എടുപ്പാൻ മടങ്ങിപ്പോകരുതു.
chapters.niv: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.
chapters.nkjv: And let him who is in the field not go back to get his clothes.
chapters.kjv: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഗർഭിണികൾക്കും മുലകുടിപ്പിക്കുന്നവർക്കും അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം!
chapters.niv: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!
chapters.nkjv: But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing babies in those days!
chapters.kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അതു ശീതകാലത്തു സംഭവിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Pray that this will not take place in winter,
chapters.nkjv: And pray that your flight may not be in winter.
chapters.kjv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

chapters.ml: ആ നാളുകൾ ദൈവം സൃഷ്ടിച്ച സൃഷ്ടിയുടെ ആരംഭംമുതൽ ഇന്നുവരെ സംഭവിച്ചിട്ടില്ലാത്തതും ഇനിമേൽ സംഭവിക്കാത്തതും ആയ കഷ്ടകാലം ആകും.
chapters.niv: because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now—and never to be equaled again.
chapters.nkjv: For in those days there will be tribulation, such as has not been since the beginning of the creation which God created until this time, nor ever shall be.
chapters.kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു ആ നാളുകളെ ചുരുക്കീട്ടില്ല എങ്കിൽ ഒരു ജഡവും രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുകയില്ല. താൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത വൃതന്മാർ നിമിത്തമോ അവൻ ആ നാളുകളെ ചുരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "If the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.
chapters.nkjv: And unless the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh would be saved; but for the elect’s sake, whom He chose, He shortened the days.
chapters.kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ആരെങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളോടു: ഇതാ ക്രിസ്തു ഇവിടെ എന്നോ അതാ അവിടെ എന്നോ പറഞ്ഞാൽ വിശ്വസിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.
chapters.nkjv: "Then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, He is there!’ do not believe it.
chapters.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

chapters.ml: കള്ളക്രിസ്തുക്കളും കള്ളപ്രവാചകന്മാരും എഴുന്നേറ്റു, കഴിയും എങ്കിൽ വൃതന്മാരെയും തെറ്റിപ്പാനായി അടയാളങ്ങളും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും കാണിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
chapters.nkjv: For false christs and false prophets will rise and show signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
chapters.kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ; ഞാൻ എല്ലാം നിങ്ങളോടു മുൻകൂട്ടി പറഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.
chapters.nkjv: But take heed; see, I have told you all things beforehand.
chapters.kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലോ ആ കാലത്തെ കഷ്ടം കഴിഞ്ഞ ശേഷം സൂര്യൻ ഇരുണ്ടുപോകയും ചന്ദ്രൻ പ്രകാശം കൊടുക്കാതിരിക്കയും
chapters.niv: "But in those days, following that distress, " ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
chapters.nkjv: "But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
chapters.kjv: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

chapters.ml: ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ വീണുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കയും ആകാശത്തിലെ ശക്തികൾ ഇളകിപ്പോകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’
chapters.nkjv: the stars of heaven will fall, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
chapters.kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ വലിയ ശക്തിയോടും തേജസ്സോടുംകൂടെ മേഘങ്ങളിൽ വരുന്നതു അവർ കാണും.
chapters.niv: "At that time people will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
chapters.nkjv: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
chapters.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

chapters.ml: അന്നു അവൻ തന്റെ ദൂതന്മരെ അയച്ചു, തന്റെ വൃതന്മാരെ ഭൂമിയുടെ അറുതിമുതൽ ആകാശത്തിന്റെ അറുതിവരെയും നാലു ദിക്കിൽ നിന്നും കൂട്ടിച്ചേർക്കും.
chapters.niv: And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.
chapters.nkjv: And then He will send His angels, and gather together His elect from the four winds, from the farthest part of earth to the farthest part of heaven.
chapters.kjv: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

chapters.ml: അത്തിയെ നോക്കി ഒരു ഉപമ പഠിപ്പിൻ; അതിന്റെ കൊമ്പു ഇളതായി ഇല തളിർക്കുമ്പോൾ വേനൽ അടുത്തു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.
chapters.nkjv: "Now learn this parable from the fig tree: When its branch has already become tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near.
chapters.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങളും ഇതു സംഭവിക്കുന്നതു കാണുമ്പോൾ അവൻ അടുക്കെ വാതിൽക്കൽ തന്നേ ആയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, right at the door.
chapters.nkjv: So you also, when you see these things happening, know that it is near—at the doors!
chapters.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഒക്കെയും സംഭവിക്കുവോളം ഈ തലമുറ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
