chapters.niv: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.nkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, this generation will by no means pass away till all these things take place.
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

chapters.ml: ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകും; എന്റെ വചനങ്ങളോ ഒഴിഞ്ഞു പോകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
chapters.nkjv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.
chapters.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

chapters.ml: ആ നാളും നാഴികയും സംബന്ധിച്ചോ പിതാവല്ലാതെ ആരും, സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ ദൂതന്മാരും, പുത്രനും കൂടെ അറിയുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: "But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
chapters.nkjv: "But of that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
chapters.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലം എപ്പോൾ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ; ഉണർന്നും പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചും കൊണ്ടിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Be on guard! Be alert ! You do not know when that time will come.
chapters.nkjv: Take heed, watch and pray; for you do not know when the time is.
chapters.kjv: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

chapters.ml: ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ വിടുവിട്ടു പരദേശത്തുപോകുമ്പോൾ ദാസന്മാർക്കു അധികാരവും അവനവന്നു അതതു വേലയും കൊടുത്തിട്ടു വാതിൽകാവൽക്കാരനോടു ഉണർന്നിരിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: It’s like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with their assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.
chapters.nkjv: It is like a man going to a far country, who left his house and gave authority to his servants, and to each his work, and commanded the doorkeeper to watch.
chapters.kjv: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ സന്ധ്യെക്കോ അർദ്ധരാത്രിക്കോ കോഴികൂകുന്ന നേരത്തോ രാവിലെയോ എപ്പോൾ വരും എന്നു അറിയായ്ക കൊണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: "Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.
chapters.nkjv: Watch therefore, for you do not know when the master of the house is coming—in the evening, at midnight, at the crowing of the rooster, or in the morning—
chapters.kjv: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

chapters.ml: അവൻ പെട്ടെന്നു വന്നു നിങ്ങളെ ഉറങ്ങുന്നവരായി കണ്ടെത്താതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഉണർന്നിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.
chapters.nkjv: lest, coming suddenly, he find you sleeping.
chapters.kjv: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നതോ എല്ലാവരോടും പറയുന്നു: ഉണർന്നിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: What I say to you, I say to everyone: ‘Watch!’ "
chapters.nkjv: And what I say to you, I say to all: Watch!"
chapters.kjv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു പെസഹയുടെയും പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തിന്റെയും ഉത്സവം ആയിരുന്നു. അപ്പോൾ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും അവനെ ഉപായത്താൽ പിടിച്ചു കൊല്ലേണ്ടതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു അന്വേഷിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread were only two days away, and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were scheming to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
chapters.nkjv: After two days it was the Passover and theFeast of Unleavened Bread. And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take Him by trickery and put Him to death.
chapters.kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

chapters.ml: ജനത്തിൽ കലഹം ഉണ്ടാകാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഉത്സവത്തിൽ അരുതു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But not during the festival," they said, "or the people may riot."
chapters.nkjv: But they said, "Not during the feast, lest there be an uproar of the people."
chapters.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബേഥാന്യയിൽ കുഷ്ഠരോഗിയായ ശിമോന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പന്തിയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ ഒരു വെൺകൽഭരണി വിലയേറിയ സ്വച്ഛജടാമാംസി തൈലുവുമായി വന്നു ഭരണി പൊട്ടിച്ചു അവന്റെ തലയിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: While he was in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head.
chapters.nkjv: And being in Bethany at the house of Simon the leper, as He sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster flask of very costly oil of spikenard. Then she broke the flask and poured it on His head.
chapters.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ചിലർ: തൈലത്തിന്റെ ഈ വെറും ചെലവു എന്തിന്നു?
chapters.niv: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, "Why this waste of perfume?
chapters.nkjv: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, and said, "Why was this fragrant oil wasted?
chapters.kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

chapters.ml: ഇതു മുന്നൂറ്റിൽ അധികം വെള്ളിക്കാശിന്നു വിറ്റു ദരിദ്രർക്കു കൊടുപ്പാൻ കഴിയുമായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നിങ്ങനെ ഉള്ളിൽ നീരസപ്പെട്ടു അവളെ ഭർത്സിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It could have been sold for more than a year’s wages and the money given to the poor." And they rebuked her harshly.
chapters.nkjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor." And they criticized her sharply.
chapters.kjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യേശു: ഇവളെ വിടുവിൻ; അവളെ അസഹ്യപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതു എന്തു? അവൾ എങ്കൽ നല്ല പ്രവൃത്തിയല്ലോ ചെയ്തതു.
chapters.niv: "Leave her alone," said Jesus. "Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said, "Let her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for Me.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

chapters.ml: ദരിദ്രർ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എല്ലായ്പോഴും അടുക്കെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; ഇച്ഛിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവർക്കു നന്മചെയ്‍വാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കഴിയും; ഞാനോ എല്ലായ്പോഴും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.
chapters.nkjv: For you have the poor with you always, and whenever you wish you may do them good; but Me you do not have always.
chapters.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

chapters.ml: അവൾ തന്നാൽ ആവതു ചെയ്തു; കല്ലറയിലെ അടക്കത്തിന്നായി എന്റെ ദേഹത്തിന്നു മുമ്പുകൂട്ടി തൈലം തേച്ചു.
chapters.niv: She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.
chapters.nkjv: She has done what she could. She has come beforehand to anoint My body for burial.
chapters.kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

chapters.ml: സുവിശേഷം ലോകത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും പ്രസംഗിക്കുന്നേടത്തെല്ലാം അവൾ ചെയ്തതും അവളുടെ ഓർമ്മെക്കായി പ്രസ്താവിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her."
chapters.nkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, wherever this gospel is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be told as a memorial to her."
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പന്തിരുവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനായി ഈസ്കര്യോത്താവായ യൂദാ അവനെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കു കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Him to them.
chapters.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

chapters.ml: അവർ അതു കേട്ടു സന്തോഷിച്ചു അവന്നു പണം കൊടുക്കാം എന്നു വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തു; അവനും അവനെ എങ്ങനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കാം എന്നു തക്കം അന്വേഷിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
chapters.nkjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. So he sought how he might conveniently betray Him.
chapters.kjv: And when they heard it , they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

chapters.ml: പെസഹകുഞ്ഞാടിനെ അറുക്കുന്നതായ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം നാളിൽ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: നീ പെസഹ കഴിപ്പാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ എവിടെ ഒരുക്കേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when it was customary to sacrifice the Passover lamb, Jesus’ disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go and make preparations for you to eat the Passover?"
chapters.nkjv: Now on the first day of Unleavened Bread, when they killed the Passover lamb, His disciples said to Him, "Where do You want us to go and prepare, that You may eat the Passover?"
chapters.kjv: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരെ അയച്ചു; നഗരത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; അവിടെ ഒരു കുടം വെള്ളം ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ നിങ്ങളെ എതിർപെടും.
chapters.niv: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, "Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.
chapters.nkjv: And He sent out two of His disciples and said to them, "Go into the city, and a man will meet you carrying a pitcher of water; follow him.
chapters.kjv: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു അവൻ കടക്കുന്നേടത്തു ആ വിട്ടുടയവനോടു: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുമായി പെസഹ കഴിപ്പാനുള്ള ശാല എവിടെ എന്നു ഗുരു ചോദിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Say to the owner of the house he enters, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’
chapters.nkjv: Wherever he goes in, say to the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, "Where is the guest room in which I may eat the Passover with My disciples?" ’
chapters.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

chapters.ml: അവൻ വിരിച്ചൊരുക്കിയ ഒരു വന്മാളിക കാണിച്ചുതരും; അവിടെ നമുക്കു ഒരുക്കുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there."
chapters.nkjv: Then he will show you a large upper room, furnished and prepared; there make ready for us."
chapters.kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു നഗരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു അവൻ തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ കണ്ടു പെസഹ ഒരുക്കി.
chapters.niv: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
chapters.nkjv: So His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found it just as He had said to them; and they prepared the Passover.
chapters.kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യയായപ്പോൾ അവൻ പന്തിരുവരോടും കൂടെ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
chapters.nkjv: In the evening He came with the twelve.
chapters.kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇരുന്നു ഭക്ഷിക്കുമ്പോൾ യേശു: നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒരുവൻ എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഭക്ഷിക്കുന്നവൻ തന്നേ, എന്നെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, "Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me."
chapters.nkjv: Now as they sat and ate, Jesus said, "Assuredly, I say to you, one of you who eats with Me will betray Me."
chapters.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

chapters.ml: അവർ ദുഃഖിച്ചു, ഓരോരുത്തൻ: ഞാനോ, ഞാനോ എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, "Surely you don’t mean me?"
chapters.nkjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say to Him one by one, "Is it I?" And another said, "Is it I?"
chapters.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: പന്തിരുവരിൽ ഒരുവൻ, എന്നോടുകൂടെ താലത്തിൽ കൈമുക്കുന്നവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "It is one of the Twelve," he replied, "one who dips bread into the bowl with me.
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said to them, "It is one of the twelve, who dips with Me in the dish.
chapters.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ പോകുന്നതു തന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ തന്നേ സത്യം; മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്ന മനുഷ്യന്നോ അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; ആ മനുഷ്യൻ ജനിക്കാതിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവന്നു കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born."
chapters.nkjv: The Son of Man indeed goes just as it is written of Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been good for that man if he had never been born."
chapters.kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഭക്ഷിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ അപ്പം എടുത്തു വാഴ്ത്തി നുറുക്കി അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു: വാങ്ങുവിൻ; ഇതു എന്റെ ശരീരം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, "Take it; this is my body."
chapters.nkjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them and said, "Take, eat; this is My body."
chapters.kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it , and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പാനപാത്രം എടുത്തു സ്തോത്രംചൊല്ലി അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു; എല്ലാവരും അതിൽനിന്നു കുടിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
chapters.nkjv: Then He took the cup, and when He had given thanks He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
chapters.kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

chapters.ml: ഇതു അനേകർക്കു വേണ്ടി ചൊരിയുന്നതായി നിയമത്തിന്നുള്ള എന്റെ രക്തം.
chapters.niv: "This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many," he said to them.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "This is My blood of the new covenant, which is shed for many.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

chapters.ml: മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയുടെ അനുഭവം ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ പുതുതായി അനുഭവിക്കുംനാൾവരെ ഞാൻ അതു ഇനി അനുഭവിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, I will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ സ്തോത്രം പാടിയശേഷം ഒലീവുമലക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും ഇടറിപ്പോകും; “ഞാൻ ഇടയനെ വെട്ടും, ആടുകൾ ചിതറിപ്പോകും” എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "You will all fall away," Jesus told them, "for it is written: " ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "All of you will be made to stumble because of Me this night, for it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, And the sheep will be scattered.’
chapters.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റശേഷം നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പെ ഗലീലെക്കു പോകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee."
chapters.nkjv: "But after I have been raised, I will go before you to Galilee."
chapters.kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: എല്ലാവരും ഇടറിയാലും ഞാൻ ഇടറുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter declared, "Even if all fall away, I will not."
chapters.nkjv: Peter said to Him, "Even if all are made to stumble, yet I will not be."
chapters.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: ഇന്നു, ഈ രാത്രിയിൽ തന്നേ, കോഴി രണ്ടു വട്ടം കൂകും മുമ്പെ നീ മൂന്നു വട്ടം എന്നെ തള്ളിപ്പറയും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായി നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you," Jesus answered, "today—yes, tonight—before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you that today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

chapters.ml: അവനോ: നീന്നോടുകൂടെ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവന്നാലും ഞാൻ നിന്നെ തള്ളിപ്പറകയില്ല എന്നു അധികമായി പറഞ്ഞു; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ എല്ലാവരും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Peter insisted emphatically, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the others said the same.
chapters.nkjv: But he spoke more vehemently, "If I have to die with You, I will not deny You!" And they all said likewise.
chapters.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഗെത്ത്ശേമന എന്നു പേരുള്ള തോട്ടത്തിൽ വന്നാറെ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: ഞാൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുതീരുവോളം ഇവിടെ ഇരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, "Sit here while I pray."
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to a place which was named Gethsemane; and He said to His disciples, "Sit here while I pray."
chapters.kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പത്രൊസിനെയും യാക്കോബിനെയും യോഹന്നാനെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ഭ്രമിപ്പാനും വ്യകുലപ്പെടുവാനും തുടങ്ങി:
chapters.niv: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.
chapters.nkjv: And He took Peter, James, and John with Him, and He began to be troubled and deeply distressed.
chapters.kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ഉള്ളം മരണവേദനപോലെ അതിദുഃഖിതമായിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇവിടെ പാർത്തു ഉണർന്നിരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death," he said to them. "Stay here and keep watch."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch."
chapters.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അല്പം മുമ്പോട്ടു ചെന്നു നിലത്തു വീണു, കഴിയും എങ്കിൽ ആ നാഴിക നീങ്ങിപ്പോകേണം എന്നു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.
chapters.nkjv: He went a little farther, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass from Him.
chapters.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

chapters.ml: അബ്ബാ, പിതാവേ, നിനക്കു എല്ലാം കഴിയും; ഈ പാനപാത്രം എങ്കൽ നിന്നു നീക്കേണമേ; എങ്കിലും ഞാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നതല്ല നീ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നതത്രേ ആകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Abba, Father," he said, "everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will."
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Abba, Father, all things are possible for You. Take this cup away from Me; nevertheless, not what I will, but what You will."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ വന്നു അവർ ഉറങ്ങുന്നതു കണ്ടു പത്രൊസിനോടു: ശിമോനേ, നീ ഉറങ്ങുന്നുവേ? ഒരു നാഴിക ഉണർന്നിരിപ്പാൻ നിനക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. "Simon," he said to Peter, "are you asleep? Couldn’t you keep watch for one hour?
chapters.nkjv: Then He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, "Simon, are you sleeping? Could you not watch one hour?
chapters.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

chapters.ml: പരീക്ഷയിൽ അകപ്പെടായ്‍വാൻ ഉണർന്നിരുന്നു പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പിൻ; ആത്മാവു ഒരുക്കമുള്ളതു, ജഡമോ ബലഹീനമത്രേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."
chapters.nkjv: Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."
chapters.kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും പോയി ആ വചനം തന്നെ ചൊല്ലി പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.
chapters.nkjv: Again He went away and prayed, and spoke the same words.
chapters.kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

chapters.ml: മടങ്ങിവന്നാറെ അവരുടെ കണ്ണുകൾക്കു ഭാരമേറിയിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ഉറങ്ങുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അവർ അവനോടു എന്തു ഉത്തരം പറയേണം എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞില്ല;
chapters.niv: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.
chapters.nkjv: And when He returned, He found them asleep again, for their eyes were heavy; and they did not know what to answer Him.
chapters.kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂന്നാമതു വന്നു അവരോടു: ഇനി ഉറങ്ങി ആശ്വസിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ; മതി, നാഴിക വന്നു; ഇതാ, മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ പാപികളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Returning the third time, he said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.
chapters.nkjv: Then He came the third time and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? It is enough! The hour has come; behold, the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
chapters.kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

chapters.ml: എഴുന്നേല്പിൻ; നാം പോക; ഇതാ, എന്നെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!"
chapters.nkjv: Rise, let us be going. See, My betrayer is at hand."
chapters.kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ, അവൻ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ, പന്തിരുവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനായ യൂദയും അവനോടുകൂടെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ, ശാസ്ത്രിമാർ, മൂപ്പന്മാർ എന്നവർ അയച്ച ഒരു പുരുഷാരവും വാളും വടിയുമായി വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Just as he was speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared. With him was a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.
chapters.nkjv: And immediately, while He was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, with a great multitude with swords and clubs, came from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
chapters.kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ: ഞാൻ ഏവനെ ചുംബിക്കുമോ അവൻ തന്നേ ആകുന്നു; അവനെ പിടിച്ചു സൂക്ഷമതയോടെ കൊണ്ടു പോകുവിൻ എന്നു അവർക്കു ഒരു അടയാളം പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: "The one I kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard."
chapters.nkjv: Now His betrayer had given them a signal, saying, "Whomever I kiss, He is the One; seize Him and lead Him away safely."
chapters.kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വന്നു ഉടനെ അടുത്തു ചെന്നു: റബ്ബീ, എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ ചുംബിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Rabbi!" and kissed him.
chapters.nkjv: As soon as he had come, immediately he went up to Him and said to Him, "Rabbi, Rabbi!" and kissed Him.
chapters.kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്റെമേൽ കൈവച്ചു അവനെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The men seized Jesus and arrested him.
chapters.nkjv: Then they laid their hands on Him and took Him.
chapters.kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

chapters.ml: അരികെ നില്ക്കുന്നവരിൽ ഒരുവൻ വാൾ ഊരി മഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ ദാസനെ വെട്ടി കാതു അറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
chapters.nkjv: And one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
chapters.kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: ഒരു കള്ളന്റെ നേരെ എന്നപോലെ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ പിടിപ്പാൻ വാളും വടിയുമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടു വന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: "Am I leading a rebellion," said Jesus, "that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus answered and said to them, "Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to take Me?
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദിവസേന ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ പിടിച്ചില്ല; എങ്കിലും തിരുവെഴുത്തുകൾക്കു നിവൃത്തി വരേണ്ടിതിന്നു ഇങ്ങനെ സംഭവിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled."
chapters.nkjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you did not seize Me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled."
chapters.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും അവനെ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then everyone deserted him and fled.
chapters.nkjv: Then they all forsook Him and fled.
chapters.kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരൻ വെറും ശരീരത്തിന്മേൽ പുതപ്പു പുതെച്ചും കൊണ്ടു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു; അവർ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain young man followed Him, having a linen cloth thrown around his naked body. And the young men laid hold of him,
chapters.kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body ; and the young men laid hold on him:

chapters.ml: അവനോ പുതപ്പു വിട്ടു നഗ്നനായി ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.
chapters.nkjv: and he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
chapters.kjv: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

chapters.ml: അവർ യേശുവിനെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി. അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും എല്ലാം വന്നു കൂടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders and the teachers of the law came together.
chapters.nkjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest; and with him were assembled all the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes.
chapters.kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് മഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ അരമനെക്കകത്തോളവും അവനെ ദൂരവേ അനുഗമിച്ചു, ഭൃത്യന്മാരോടു ചേർന്നു തീ കാഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.
chapters.nkjv: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. And he sat with the servants and warmed himself at the fire.
chapters.kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ന്യായാധിപസംഘം ഒക്കെയും യേശുവിനെ കൊല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്റെ നേരെ സാക്ഷ്യം അന്വേഷിച്ചു കണ്ടില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death, but they did not find any.
chapters.nkjv: Now the chief priests and all the council sought testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, but found none.
chapters.kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

chapters.ml: അനേകർ അവന്റെ നേരെ കള്ളസാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞിട്ടും സാക്ഷ്യം ഒത്തുവന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Many testified falsely against him, but their statements did not agree.
chapters.nkjv: For many bore false witness against Him, but their testimonies did not agree.
chapters.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

chapters.ml: ചിലർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവന്റെ നേരെ:
chapters.niv: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:
chapters.nkjv: Then some rose up and bore false witness against Him, saying,
chapters.kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കൈപ്പണിയായ ഈ മന്ദിരം പൊളിച്ചു മൂന്നു ദിവസംകൊണ്ടു കൈപ്പണിയല്ലാത്ത മറ്റൊന്നു പണിയും എന്നു ഇവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു ഞങ്ങൾ കേട്ടു എന്നു കള്ളസ്സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days will build another, not made with hands.’ "
chapters.nkjv: "We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.’ "
chapters.kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

chapters.ml: എന്നിട്ടും അവരുടെ സാക്ഷ്യം ഒത്തുവന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.
chapters.nkjv: But not even then did their testimony agree.
chapters.kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ നടുവിൽ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു യേശുവിനോടു: നീ ഒന്നും ഉത്തരം പറയുന്നില്ലയോ? ഇവർ നിന്റെ നേരെ സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"
chapters.nkjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst and asked Jesus, saying, "Do You answer nothing? What isit these men testify against You?"
chapters.kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

chapters.ml: അവനോ മിണ്ടാതെയും ഉത്തരം പറയാതെയും ഇരുന്നു. മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ പിന്നെയും അവനോടു: നീ വന്ദ്യനായവന്റെ പുത്രനായ ക്രിസ്തുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, "Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?"
chapters.nkjv: But He kept silent and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked Him, saying to Him, "Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?"
chapters.kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു; മുനഷ്യപുത്രൻ സർവ്വശക്തന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നതും ആകാശമേഘങ്ങളോടെ വരുന്നതും നിങ്ങൾ കാണും എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I am," said Jesus. "And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said, "I am. And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ വസ്ത്രം കീറി:
chapters.niv: The high priest tore his clothes. "Why do we need any more witnesses?" he asked.
chapters.nkjv: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, "What further need do we have of witnesses?
chapters.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

chapters.ml: ഇനി സാക്ഷികളെകൊണ്ടു നമുക്കു എന്തു ആവശ്യം? ദൈവദൂഷണം നിങ്ങൾ കേട്ടുവല്ലോ; നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അവൻ മരണയോഗ്യൻ എന്നു എല്ലാവരും വിധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?" They all condemned him as worthy of death.
chapters.nkjv: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?" And they all condemned Him to be deserving of death.
chapters.kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

chapters.ml: ചിലർ അവനെ തുപ്പുകയും അവന്റെ മുഖം മൂടി അവനെ മുഷ്ടി ചുരുട്ടി കുത്തുകയും പ്രവചിക്ക എന്നു അവനോടു പറകയും ചെയ്തു തുടങ്ങി; ചേവകർ അവനെ അടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു കയ്യേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, "Prophesy!" And the guards took him and beat him.
chapters.nkjv: Then some began to spit on Him, and to blindfold Him, and to beat Him, and to say to Him, "Prophesy!" And the officers struck Him with the palms of their hands.
chapters.kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് താഴെ നടുമുറ്റത്തു ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരത്തികളിൽ ഒരുത്തി വന്നു,
chapters.niv: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.
chapters.nkjv: Now as Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came.
chapters.kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് തീ കായുന്നതു കണ്ടു അവനെ നോക്കി: നീയും ആ നസറായനായ യേശുവിനോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. "You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus," she said.
chapters.nkjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, "You also were with Jesus of Nazareth."
chapters.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

chapters.ml: നീ പറയുന്നതു തിരിയുന്നില്ല, ബോദ്ധ്യമാകുന്നതുമില്ല എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവൻ തള്ളിപ്പറഞ്ഞു; പടിപ്പുരയിലേക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ കോഴി കൂകി.
chapters.niv: But he denied it. "I don’t know or understand what you’re talking about," he said, and went out into the entryway.
chapters.nkjv: But he denied it, saying, "I neither know nor understand what you are saying." And he went out on the porch, and a rooster crowed.
chapters.kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

chapters.ml: ആ ബാല്യക്കാരത്തി അവനെ പിന്നെയും കണ്ടു സമീപത്തു നില്ക്കുന്നവരോടു: ഇവൻ ആ കൂട്ടരിൽ ഉള്ളവൻ തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങി. അവൻ പിന്നെയും തള്ളിപ്പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, "This fellow is one of them."
chapters.nkjv: And the servant girl saw him again, and began to say to those who stood by, "This is one of them."
chapters.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

chapters.ml: കുറയനേരം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അരികെ നിന്നവർ പത്രൊസിനോടു: നീ ആ കൂട്ടരിൽ ഉള്ളവൻ സത്യം; ഗലീലക്കാരനല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, "Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean."
chapters.nkjv: But he denied it again. And a little later those who stood by said to Peter again, "Surely you are one of them; for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it."
chapters.kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto .

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്ന മനുഷ്യനെ ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു അവൻ പ്രാകുവാനും ആണയിടുവാനും തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: He began to call down curses, and he swore to them, "I don’t know this man you’re talking about."
chapters.nkjv: Then he began to curse and swear, "I do not know this Man of whom you speak!"
chapters.kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ കോഴി രണ്ടാമതും കൂകി; കോഴി രണ്ടുവട്ടം കൂകുംമുമ്പെ നീ മൂന്നു വട്ടം എന്നെ തള്ളിപ്പറയും എന്നു യേശു തന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു പത്രൊസ് ഓർത്തു അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിചാരിച്ചു കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken to him: "Before the rooster crows twice you will disown me three times." And he broke down and wept.
chapters.nkjv: A second time the rooster crowed. Then Peter called to mind the word that Jesus had said to him, "Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times." And when he thought about it, he wept.
chapters.kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അതികാലത്തു തന്നെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരുമായി ന്യായാധിപസംഘം ഒക്കെയും കൂടി ആലോചിച്ചു യേശുവിനെ കെട്ടി കൊണ്ടുപോയി പീലാത്തൊസിനെ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, made their plans. So they bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately, in the morning, the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council; and they bound Jesus, led Him away, and delivered Him to Pilate.
chapters.kjv: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവനോടു: നീ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Are you the king of the Jews?" asked Pilate. "You have said so," Jesus replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate asked Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered and said to him, "It is as you say."
chapters.kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it .

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ അവനെ ഏറിയോന്നു കുറ്റം ചുമത്തി.
chapters.niv: The chief priests accused him of many things.
chapters.nkjv: And the chief priests accused Him of many things, but He answered nothing.
chapters.kjv: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് പിന്നെയും അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു: നീ ഒരുത്തരവും പറയുന്നില്ലയോ? ഇതാ, അവർ നിന്നെ എന്തെല്ലാം കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So again Pilate asked him, "Aren’t you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of."
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate asked Him again, saying, "Do You answer nothing? See how many things they testify against You!"
chapters.kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

chapters.ml: യേശു പിന്നെയും ഉത്തരം ഒന്നും പറയായ്കയാൽ പീലാത്തൊസ് ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus still answered nothing, so that Pilate marveled.
chapters.kjv: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉത്സവംതോറും അവർ ചോദിക്കുന്ന ഒരു തടവുകാരനെ അവർക്കു വിട്ടുകൊടുക്ക പതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now it was the custom at the festival to release a prisoner whom the people requested.
chapters.nkjv: Now at the feast he was accustomed to releasing one prisoner to them, whomever they requested.
chapters.kjv: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഒരു കലഹത്തിൽ കുല ചെയ്തവരായ കലഹക്കാരോടുകൂടെ ബന്ധിച്ചിരുന്ന ബറബ്ബാസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരുത്തൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the insurrectionists who had committed murder in the uprising.
chapters.nkjv: And there was one named Barabbas, whowas chained with his fellow rebels; they had committed murder in the rebellion.
chapters.kjv: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം കയറി വന്നു, അവൻ പതിവുപോലെ ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The crowd came up and asked Pilate to do for them what he usually did.
chapters.nkjv: Then the multitude, crying aloud, began to ask himtodo just as he had always done for them.
chapters.kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ അസൂയകൊണ്ടു അവനെ ഏല്പിച്ചു എന്നു പീലാത്തൊസ് അറിഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: "Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?" asked Pilate,
chapters.nkjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, "Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"
chapters.kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവിനെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു വിട്ടുതരേണം എന്നു ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: knowing it was out of self-interest that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.
chapters.nkjv: For he knew that the chief priests had handed Him over because of envy.
chapters.kjv: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ ബറബ്ബാസിനെ വിട്ടുകൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ചോദിപ്പാൻ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ പുരുഷാരത്തെ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.
chapters.nkjv: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd, so that he should rather release Barabbas to them.
chapters.kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് പിന്നെയും അവരോടു: എന്നാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നവനെ ഞാൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?" Pilate asked them.
chapters.nkjv: Pilate answered and said to them again, "What then do you want me to do withHim whom you call the King of the Jews?"
chapters.kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

chapters.ml: അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്ക എന്നു അവർ വീണ്ടും നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Crucify him!" they shouted.
chapters.nkjv: So they cried out again, "Crucify Him!"
chapters.kjv: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവരോടു: അവൻ എന്തു ദോഷം ചെയ്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാറെ, അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്ക എന്നു അവർ അധികമായി നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate said to them, "Why, what evil has He done?" But they cried out all the more, "Crucify Him!"
chapters.kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് പുരുഷാരത്തിന്നു തൃപ്തിവരുത്തുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചു ബറബ്ബാസിനെ അവർക്കു വിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു യേശുവിനെ ചമ്മട്ടികൊണ്ടു അടിപ്പിച്ചു ക്രൂശിപ്പാൻ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
chapters.nkjv: So Pilate, wanting to gratify the crowd, released Barabbas to them; and he delivered Jesus, after he had scourged Him, to be crucified.
chapters.kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him , to be crucified.

chapters.ml: പടയാളികൾ അവനെ ആസ്ഥാനമായ മണ്ഡപത്തിന്നകത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി പട്ടാളത്തെ എല്ലാം വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.
chapters.nkjv: Then the soldiers led Him away into the hall called Praetorium, and they called together the whole garrison.
chapters.kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Prætorium; and they call together the whole band.

chapters.ml: അവനെ രക്താംബരം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു, മുള്ളുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു കിരീടം മെടഞ്ഞു അവനെ ചൂടിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.
chapters.nkjv: And they clothed Him with purple; and they twisted a crown of thorns, put it on His head,
chapters.kjv: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head ,

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവേ, ജയജയ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു വന്ദിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: And they began to call out to him, "Hail, king of the Jews!"
chapters.nkjv: and began to salute Him, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
chapters.kjv: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

chapters.ml: കോൽകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ തലയിൽ അടിച്ചു, അവനെ തുപ്പി, മുട്ടുകുത്തി അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.
chapters.nkjv: Then they struck Him on the head with a reed and spat on Him; and bowing the knee, they worshiped Him.
chapters.kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ച ശേഷം അവർ രക്താംബരം നീക്കി സ്വന്തവസ്ത്രം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു അവനെ ക്രൂശിപ്പാൻ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had mocked Him, they took the purple off Him, put His own clothes on Him, and led Him out to crucify Him.
chapters.kjv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

chapters.ml: അലക്സന്തരിന്റെയും രൂഫൊസിന്റെയും അപ്പനായി വയലിൽ നിന്നു വരുന്ന കുറേനക്കാരനായ ശിമോനെ അവന്റെ ക്രൂശ് ചുമപ്പാൻ അവർ നിർബന്ധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A certain man from Cyrene, Simon, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and they forced him to carry the cross.
chapters.nkjv: Then they compelled a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, the father of Alexander and Rufus, as he was coming out of the country and passing by, to bear His cross.
chapters.kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

chapters.ml: തലയോടിടം എന്നർത്ഥമുള്ള ഗൊല്ഗോഥാ എന്ന സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു അവനെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി;
chapters.niv: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means "the place of the skull").
chapters.nkjv: And they brought Him to the place Golgotha, which is translated, Place of a Skull.
chapters.kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

chapters.ml: കണ്ടിവെണ്ണ കലർത്തിയ വീഞ്ഞു അവന്നു കൊടുത്തു; അവനോ വാങ്ങിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.
chapters.nkjv: Then they gave Him wine mingled with myrrh to drink, but He did not take it.
chapters.kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ക്രൂശിച്ചശേഷം അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം ഇന്നവന്നു ഇന്നതു കിട്ടേണം എന്നു ചീട്ടിട്ടു പകുതി ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: And they crucified him. Dividing up his clothes, they cast lots to see what each would get.
chapters.nkjv: And when they crucified Him, they divided His garments, casting lots for them todetermine what every man should take.
chapters.kjv: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം മണി നേരമായപ്പോൾ അവനെ ക്രൂശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was nine in the morning when they crucified him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was the third hour, and they crucified Him.
chapters.kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവു എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവന്റെ കുറ്റം മീതെ എഴുതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The written notice of the charge against him read: the king of the jews.
chapters.nkjv: And the inscription of His accusation was written above: THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chapters.ml: അവർ രണ്ടു കള്ളന്മാരെ ഒരുത്തനെ വലത്തും ഒരുത്തനെ ഇടത്തുമായി അവനോടുകൂടെ ക്രൂശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They crucified two rebels with him, one on his right and one on his left.
chapters.nkjv: With Him they also crucified two robbers, one on His right and the other on His left.
chapters.kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

chapters.ml: (അധർമ്മികളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ അവനെ എണ്ണി എന്നുള്ള തിരുവെഴുത്തു നിവൃത്തിയായി.)
chapters.niv: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads and saying, "So! You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days,
chapters.nkjv: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "And He was numbered with the transgressors."
chapters.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

chapters.ml: കടന്നു പോകുന്നവർ തല കുലുക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു: ഹാ, ഹാ, മന്ദിരം പൊളിച്ചു മൂന്നു നാളുകൊണ്ടു പണിയുന്നവനേ,
chapters.niv: come down from the cross and save yourself!"
chapters.nkjv: And those who passed by blasphemed Him, wagging their heads and saying, "Aha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,
chapters.kjv: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

chapters.ml: നിന്നെത്തന്നേ രക്ഷിച്ചു ക്രൂശിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ ദുഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the same way the chief priests and the teachers of the law mocked him among themselves. "He saved others," they said, "but he can’t save himself!
chapters.nkjv: save Yourself, and come down from the cross!"
chapters.kjv: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു: ഇവൻ മറ്റുള്ളവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചു തന്നെത്താൻ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ വഹിയാ.
chapters.niv: Let this Messiah, this king of Israel, come down now from the cross, that we may see and believe." Those crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
chapters.nkjv: Likewise the chief priests also, mocking among themselves with the scribes, said, "He saved others; Himself He cannot save.
chapters.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

chapters.ml: നാം കണ്ടു വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ക്രിസ്തു എന്ന യിസ്രായേൽ രാജാവു ഇപ്പോൾ ക്രൂശിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവരട്ടെ എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു; അവനോടുകൂടെ ക്രൂശിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരും അവനെ പഴിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At noon, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.
chapters.nkjv: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe." Even those who were crucified with Him reviled Him.
chapters.kjv: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

chapters.ml: ആറാം മണിനേരമായപ്പോൾ ഒമ്പതാം മണിനേരത്തോളം ദേശത്തു എല്ലാം ഇരുട്ടു ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: And at three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" (which means "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?").
chapters.nkjv: Now when the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
chapters.kjv: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

chapters.ml: ഒമ്പതാം മണിനേരത്തു യേശു: എന്റെ ദൈവമേ, എന്റെ ദൈവമേ, നീ എന്നെ കൈവിട്ടതു എന്തു എന്നു അർത്ഥമുള്ള എലോഹീ, എലോഹീ ലമ്മാ ശബ്ബക്താനീ എന്നു അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When some of those standing near heard this, they said, "Listen, he’s calling Elijah."
chapters.nkjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?" which is translated, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"
chapters.kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

chapters.ml: അരികെ നിന്നവരിൽ ചിലർ കേട്ടിട്ടു: അവൻ ഏലീയാവെ വിളിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Someone ran, filled a sponge with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink. "Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to take him down," he said.
chapters.nkjv: Some of those who stood by, when they heard that, said, "Look, He is calling for Elijah!"
chapters.kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it , said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തൻ ഓടി ഒരു സ്പോങ്ങിൽ പുളിച്ചവീഞ്ഞു നിറെച്ചു ഒരു ഓടക്കോലിന്മേലാക്കി: നില്പിൻ; ഏലീയാവു അവനെ ഇറക്കുവാൻ വരുമോ എന്നു നമുക്കു കാണാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്നു കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: With a loud cry, Jesus breathed his last.
chapters.nkjv: Then someone ran and filled a sponge full of sour wine, put it on a reed, and offered it to Him to drink, saying, "Let Him alone; let us see if Elijah will come to take Him down."
chapters.kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and breathed His last.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ മന്ദിരത്തിലെ തിരശ്ശീല മേൽതൊട്ടു അടിയോളവും രണ്ടായി ചീന്തിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: And when the centurion, who stood there in front of Jesus, saw how he died, he said, "Surely this man was the Son of God!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
chapters.kjv: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു എതിരെ നിന്നിരുന്ന ശതാധിപൻ അവൻ ഇങ്ങനെ പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ ദൈവപുത്രൻ ആയിരുന്നു സത്യം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some women were watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joseph, and Salome.
chapters.nkjv: So when the centurion, who stood opposite Him, saw that He cried out like this and breathed His last, he said, "Truly this Man was the Son of God!"
chapters.kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീകളും ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; അവരിൽ മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും ചെറിയ യാക്കോബിന്റെയും യോസെയുടെയും അമ്മ മറിയയും ശലോമിയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In Galilee these women had followed him and cared for his needs. Many other women who had come up with him to Jerusalem were also there.
chapters.nkjv: There were also women looking on from afar, among whom were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the Less and of Joses, and Salome,
chapters.kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഗലീലയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവർ അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചും ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചും പോന്നു; അവനോടുകൂടെ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു വന്ന മറ്റു സ്ത്രീകളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath). So as evening approached,
chapters.nkjv: who also followed Him and ministered to Him when He was in Galilee, and many other women who came up with Him to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: വൈകുന്നേരമായപ്പോൾ ശബ്ബത്തിന്റെ തലനാളായ ഒരുക്കനാൾ ആകകൊണ്ടു ശ്രേഷ്ഠമന്ത്രിയും
chapters.niv: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body.
chapters.nkjv: Now when evening had come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
chapters.kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

chapters.ml: ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെ കാത്തിരുന്നവനുമായ അരിമത്ഥ്യയിലെ യോസേഫ് വന്നു ധൈര്യത്തോടെ പീലാത്തൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു യേശുവിന്റെ ശരീരം ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.
chapters.nkjv: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent council member, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, coming and taking courage, went in to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
chapters.kjv: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മരിച്ചുകഴിഞ്ഞുവോ എന്നു പീലാത്തൊസ് ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു ശതാധിപനെ വിളിച്ചു: അവൻ മരിച്ചിട്ടു ഒട്ടുനേരമായോ എന്നു ശതാധിപനോടു
chapters.niv: When he learned from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.
chapters.nkjv: Pilate marveled that He was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him if He had been dead for some time.
chapters.kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

chapters.ml: വസ്തുത ചോദിച്ചറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഉടൽ യോസേഫിന്നു നല്കി.
chapters.niv: So Joseph bought some linen cloth, took down the body, wrapped it in the linen, and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.
chapters.nkjv: So when he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
chapters.kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു ശീല വാങ്ങി അവനെ ഇറക്കി ശീലയിൽ ചുറ്റിപ്പൊതിഞ്ഞു, പാറയിൽ വെട്ടീട്ടുള്ള കല്ലറയിൽ വെച്ചു, കല്ലറവാതിൽക്കൽ ഒരു കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടിവെച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where he was laid.
chapters.nkjv: Then he bought fine linen, took Him down, and wrapped Him in the linen. And he laid Him in a tomb which had been hewn out of the rock, and rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
chapters.kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

chapters.ml: അവനെ വെച്ച ഇടം മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും യോസെയുടെ അമ്മ മറിയയും നോക്കിക്കണ്ടു.
chapters.nkjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary themother of Joses observed where He was laid.
chapters.kjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

chapters.ml: ശബ്ബത്തു കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും യാക്കോബിന്റെ അമ്മ മറിയയും ശലോമയും ചെന്നു അവനെ പൂശേണ്ടതിന്നു സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus’ body.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, Mary themother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint Him.
chapters.kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

chapters.ml: ആഴ്ചവട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം നാൾ അതികാലത്തു സൂര്യൻ ഉദിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ കല്ലറെക്കൽ ചെന്നു:
chapters.niv: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb
chapters.nkjv: Very early in the morning, on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
chapters.kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

chapters.ml: കല്ലറയുടെ വാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു നമുക്കു വേണ്ടി ആർ കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടിക്കളയും എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and they asked each other, "Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?"
chapters.nkjv: And they said among themselves, "Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?"
chapters.kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

chapters.ml: അവർ നോക്കിയാറെ കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞതായി കണ്ടു; അതു ഏറ്റവും വലുതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.
chapters.nkjv: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away—for it was very large.
chapters.kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

chapters.ml: അവർ കല്ലറെക്കകത്തു കടന്നപ്പോൾ വെള്ളനിലയങ്കി ധരിച്ച ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരൻ വലത്തു ഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു ഭ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
chapters.nkjv: And entering the tomb, they saw a young man clothed in a long white robe sitting on the right side; and they were alarmed.
chapters.kjv: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: ഭ്രമിക്കേണ്ടാ; ക്രൂശിക്കപ്പെട്ട നസറായനായ യേശുവിനെ നിങ്ങൾ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു; അവൻ ഇവിടെ ഇല്ല; അവനെ വെച്ച സ്ഥലം ഇതാ.
chapters.niv: "Don’t be alarmed," he said. "You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.
chapters.nkjv: But he said to them, "Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid Him.
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പോയി അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടും പത്രൊസിനോടും: അവൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പെ ഗലീലെക്കു പോകുന്നു എന്നു പറവിൻ; അവൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ അവിടെ അവനെ കാണും എന്നു പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: But go, tell His disciples—and Peter—that He is going before you into Galilee; there you will see Him, as He said to you."
chapters.kjv: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു വിറയലും ഭ്രമവും പിടിച്ചു അവർ കല്ലറ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയി; അവർ ഭയപ്പെടുകയാൽ ആരോടും ഒന്നും പറഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid. [The earliest manuscripts and some other ancient witnesses do not have verses 9–20.]
chapters.nkjv: So they went out quickly and fled from the tomb, for they trembled and were amazed. And they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.
chapters.kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man ; for they were afraid.

chapters.ml: [അവൻ ആഴ്ചവട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം നാൾ രാവിലെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റിട്ടു താൻ ഏഴു ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കിയിരുന്ന മഗദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയെക്കു ആദ്യം പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.
chapters.nkjv: Now when He rose early on the first day of the week, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had cast seven demons.
chapters.kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ചെന്നു അവനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നവരായി ദുഃഖിച്ചും കരഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടിരുന്നവരോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.
chapters.nkjv: She went and told those who had been with Him, as they mourned and wept.
chapters.kjv: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ജീവനോടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നും അവൾ അവനെ കണ്ടു എന്നും അവർ കേട്ടാറെ വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.
chapters.nkjv: And when they heard that He was alive and had been seen by her, they did not believe.
chapters.kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരിൽ രണ്ടുപേർ നാട്ടിലേക്കു പോകുമ്പോൾ അവൻ മറ്റൊരു രൂപത്തിൽ അവർക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.
chapters.nkjv: After that, He appeared in another form to two of them as they walked and went into the country.
chapters.kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോയി ശേഷമുള്ളവരോടു അറിയിച്ചു; അവരുടെ വാക്കും അവർ വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.
chapters.nkjv: And they went and told it to the rest, but they did not believe them either.
chapters.kjv: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നത്തേതിൽ പതിനൊരുവർ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ അവർക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി, തന്നെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റവനായി കണ്ടവരുടെ വാക്കു വിശ്വസിക്കായ്കയാൽ അവരുടെ അവിശ്വാസത്തെയും ഹൃദയ കാഠിന്യത്തെയും ശാസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
chapters.nkjv: Later He appeared to the eleven as they sat at the table; and He rebuked their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.
chapters.kjv: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഭൂലോകത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും പോയി സകല സൃഷ്ടിയോടും സുവിശേഷം പ്രസംഗിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസിക്കയും സ്നാനം ഏൽക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടും; വിശ്വസിക്കാത്തവൻ ശിക്ഷാവിധിയിൽ അകപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
chapters.nkjv: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned.
chapters.kjv: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവരാൽ ഈ അടയാളങ്ങൾ നടക്കും: എന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ അവർ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കും; പുതുഭാഷകളിൽ സംസാരിക്കും;
chapters.niv: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
chapters.nkjv: And these signs will follow those who believe: In My name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new tongues;
chapters.kjv: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

chapters.ml: സർപ്പങ്ങളെ പിടിച്ചെടുക്കും; മരണകരമായ യാതൊന്നു കുടിച്ചാലും അവർക്കു ഹാനി വരികയില്ല; രോഗികളുടെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചാൽ അവർക്കു സൌഖ്യം വരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well."
chapters.nkjv: they will take up serpents; and if they drink anything deadly, it will by no means hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover."
chapters.kjv: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ കർത്താവായ യേശു അവരോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തശേഷം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കു എടുക്കപ്പെട്ടു. ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.
chapters.nkjv: So then, after the Lord had spoken to them, He was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
chapters.kjv: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു എല്ലാടത്തും പ്രസംഗിച്ചു; കർത്താവു അവരോടുകൂടെ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചും അവരാൽ നടന്ന അടയാളങ്ങളാൽ വചനത്തെ ഉറപ്പിച്ചും പോന്നു.]
chapters.niv: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.
chapters.nkjv: And they went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word through the accompanying signs. Amen.
chapters.kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

chapters.ml: ശ്രീമാനായ തെയോഫിലോസേ, ആദിമുതൽ കണ്ട സാക്ഷികളും വചനത്തിന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷകന്മാരുമായവർ നമ്മെ ഭരമേല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ,
chapters.niv: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
chapters.nkjv: Inasmuch as many have taken in hand to set in order a narrative of those things which have been fulfilled among us,
chapters.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ഇടയിൽ പൂർണ്ണമായി പ്രമാണിച്ചു വരുന്ന കാര്യങ്ങളെ വിവരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു ചരിത്രം ചമെപ്പാൻ പലരും തുനിഞ്ഞിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.
chapters.nkjv: just as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word delivered them to us,
chapters.kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു ഉപദേശം ലഭിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന വാർത്തയുടെ നിശ്ചയം നീ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
chapters.nkjv: it seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write to you an orderly account, most excellent Theophilus,
chapters.kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

chapters.ml: അതു ക്രമമായി എഴുതുന്നതു നന്നെന്നു ആദിമുതൽ സകലവും സൂക്ഷ്മമായി പരിശോധിച്ചിട്ടു എനിക്കും തോന്നിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.
chapters.nkjv: that you may know the certainty of those things in which you were instructed.
chapters.kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദ്യരാജാവായ ഹെരോദാവിന്റെ കാലത്തു അബീയാക്കൂറിൽ സെഖര്യാവു എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു പുരോഹിതൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ അഹരോന്റെ പുത്രിമാരിൽ ഒരുത്തി ആയിരുന്നു; അവൾക്കു എലീശബെത്ത് എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah; his wife Elizabeth was also a descendant of Aaron.
chapters.nkjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the division of Abijah. His wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
chapters.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

chapters.ml: ഇരുവരും ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ നീതിയുള്ളവരും കർത്താവിന്റെ സകല കല്പനകളിലും ന്യായങ്ങളിലും കുററമില്ലാത്തവരായി നടക്കുന്നവരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, observing all the Lord’s commands and decrees blamelessly.
chapters.nkjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
chapters.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

chapters.ml: എലീശബെത്ത് മച്ചിയാകകൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു സന്തതി ഇല്ലാഞ്ഞു; ഇരുവരും വയസ്സു ചെന്നവരും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But they were childless because Elizabeth was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.
chapters.nkjv: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well advanced in years.
chapters.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കൂറിന്റെ ക്രമപ്രകാരം ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ പുരോഹിതനായി ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തുവരുമ്പോൾ:
chapters.niv: Once when Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
chapters.nkjv: So it was, that while he was serving as priest before God in the order of his division,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,

chapters.ml: പൌരോഹിത്യമര്യാദപ്രകാരം കർത്താവിന്റെ മന്ദിരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ധൂപം കാട്ടുവാൻ അവന്നു നറുക്കു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
chapters.nkjv: according to the custom of the priesthood, his lot fell to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

chapters.ml: ധൂപം കാട്ടുന്ന നാഴികയിൽ ജനസമൂഹം ഒക്കെയും പുറത്തു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.
chapters.nkjv: And the whole multitude of the people was praying outside at the hour of incense.
chapters.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ കർത്താവിന്റെ ദൂതൻ ധൂപപീഠത്തിന്റെ വലത്തു ഭാഗത്തു നിൽക്കുന്നവനായിട്ടു അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
chapters.nkjv: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
chapters.kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

chapters.ml: സെഖര്യാവു അവനെ കണ്ടു ഭ്രമിച്ചു ഭയപരവശനായി.
chapters.niv: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear.
chapters.nkjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
chapters.kjv: And when Zacharias saw him , he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: സെഖര്യാവേ, ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; നിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥനെക്കു ഉത്തരമായി: നിന്റെ ഭാര്യ എലീശബെത്ത് നിനക്കു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിക്കും; അവന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ എന്നു പേർ ഇടേണം.
chapters.niv: But the angel said to him: "Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.
chapters.nkjv: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zacharias, for your prayer is heard; and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
chapters.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു സന്തോഷവും ഉല്ലാസവും ഉണ്ടാകും; അവന്റെ ജനനത്തിങ്കൽ പലരും സന്തോഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,
chapters.nkjv: And you will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
chapters.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കർത്താവിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വലിയവൻ ആകും; വീഞ്ഞും മദ്യവും കുടിക്കയില്ല; അമ്മയുടെ ഗർഭത്തിൽവെച്ചു തന്നേ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവുകൊണ്ടു നിറയും.
chapters.niv: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he is born.
chapters.nkjv: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink. He will also be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
chapters.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളിൽ പലരെയും അവരുടെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവിങ്കലേക്കു തിരിച്ചുവരുത്തും.
chapters.niv: He will bring back many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.
chapters.nkjv: And he will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
chapters.kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അപ്പന്മാരുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങളെ മക്കളിലേക്കും വഴങ്ങാത്തവരെ നീതിമാന്മാരുടെ ബോധത്തിലേക്കും തിരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു ഒരുക്കമുള്ളോരു ജനത്തെ കർത്താവിന്നുവേണ്ടി ഒരുക്കുവാൻ അവന്നു മുമ്പായി ഏലീയാവിന്റെ ആത്മാവോടും ശക്തിയോടും കൂടെ നടക്കും.
