chapters.niv: And he will go on before the Lord, in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the parents to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."
chapters.nkjv: He will also go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

chapters.ml: സെഖര്യാവു ദൂതനോടു; ഇതു ഞാൻ എന്തൊന്നിനാൽ അറിയും? ഞാൻ വൃദ്ധനും എന്റെ ഭാര്യ വയസ്സുചെന്നവളുമല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Zechariah asked the angel, "How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years."
chapters.nkjv: And Zacharias said to the angel, "How shall I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years."
chapters.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ അവനോടു: ഞാൻ ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ നില്ക്കുന്ന ഗബ്രിയേൽ ആകുന്നു; നിന്നോടു സംസാരിപ്പാനും ഈ സദ്വർത്തമാനം നിന്നോടു അറിയിപ്പാനും എന്നെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The angel said to him, "I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news.
chapters.nkjv: And the angel answered and said to him, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and was sent to speak to you and bring you these glad tidings.
chapters.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

chapters.ml: തക്കസമയത്തു നിവൃത്തിവരുവാനുള്ള എന്റെ ഈ വാക്കു വിശ്വസിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു അതു സംഭവിക്കുവരെ നീ സംസാരിപ്പാൻ കഴിയാതെ മൌനമായിരിക്കും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their appointed time."
chapters.nkjv: But behold, you will be mute and not able to speak until the day these things take place, because you did not believe my words which will be fulfilled in their own time."
chapters.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

chapters.ml: ജനം സെഖര്യാവിന്നായി കാത്തിരുന്നു, അവൻ മന്ദിരത്തിൽ താമസിച്ചതിനാൽ ആശ്ചര്യപെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the temple.
chapters.nkjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marveled that he lingered so long in the temple.
chapters.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുറത്തു വന്നാറെ അവരോടു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല; അതിനാൽ അവൻ മന്ദിരത്തിൽ ഒരു ദർശനം കണ്ടു എന്നു അവർ അറിഞ്ഞു; അവൻ അവർക്കു ആഗ്യം കാട്ടി ഊമനായി പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.
chapters.nkjv: But when he came out, he could not speak to them; and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple, for he beckoned to them and remained speechless.
chapters.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷാകാലം തികഞ്ഞശേഷം അവൻ വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When his time of service was completed, he returned home.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, as soon as the days of his service were completed, that he departed to his own house.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

chapters.ml: ആ നാളുകൾ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ എലീശബെത്ത് ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: After this his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion.
chapters.nkjv: Now after those days his wife Elizabeth conceived; and she hid herself five months, saying,
chapters.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽ എനിക്കുണ്ടായിരുന്ന നിന്ദ നീക്കുവാൻ കർത്താവു എന്നെ കടാക്ഷിച്ച നാളിൽ ഇങ്ങനെ എനിക്കു ചെയ്തുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അഞ്ചു മാസം ഒളിച്ചു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: "The Lord has done this for me," she said. "In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people."
chapters.nkjv: "Thus the Lord has dealt with me, in the days when He looked on me, to take away my reproach among people."
chapters.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men.

chapters.ml: ആറാം മാസത്തിൽ ദൈവം ഗബ്രീയേൽദൂതനെ നസറെത്ത് എന്ന ഗലീലപട്ടണത്തിൽ,
chapters.niv: In the sixth month of Elizabeth’s pregnancy, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a town in Galilee,
chapters.nkjv: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
chapters.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് ഗൃഹത്തിലുള്ള യോസേഫ് എന്നൊരു പുരുഷന്നു വിവാഹം നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരുന്ന കന്യകയുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു; ആ കന്യകയുടെ പേർ മറിയ എന്നു ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named Joseph, a descendant of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.
chapters.nkjv: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.
chapters.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ അകത്തു ചെന്നു: കൃപലഭിച്ചവളേ, നിനക്കു വന്ദനം; കർത്താവു നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The angel went to her and said, "Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you."
chapters.nkjv: And having come in, the angel said to her, "Rejoice, highly favored one, the Lord is with you; blessed are you among women!"
chapters.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ആ വാക്കു കേട്ടു ഭ്രമിച്ചു: ഇതു എന്തൊരു വന്ദനം എന്നു വിചാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
chapters.nkjv: But when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and considered what manner of greeting this was.
chapters.kjv: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ അവളോടു: മറിയയേ, ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; നിനക്കു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കൃപ ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God.
chapters.nkjv: Then the angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
chapters.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

chapters.ml: നീ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചു ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിക്കും; അവന്നു യേശു എന്നു പേർ വിളിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, you will conceive in your womb and bring forth a Son, and shall call His name Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വലിയവൻ ആകും; അത്യുന്നതന്റെ പുത്രൻ എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടും; കർത്താവായ ദൈവം അവന്റെ പിതാവായ ദാവീദിന്റെ സിംഹാസനം അവന്നു കൊടുക്കും
chapters.niv: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
chapters.nkjv: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Highest; and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David.
chapters.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

chapters.ml: അവൻ യാക്കോബ് ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു എന്നേക്കും രാജാവായിരിക്കും; അവന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിന്നു അവസാനം ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and he will reign over Jacob’s descendants forever; his kingdom will never end."
chapters.nkjv: And He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and of His kingdom there will be no end."
chapters.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

chapters.ml: മറിയ ദൂതനോടു: ഞാൻ പുരുഷനെ അറിയായ്കയാൽ ഇതു എങ്ങനെ സംഭവിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "How will this be," Mary asked the angel, "since I am a virgin?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Mary said to the angel, "How can this be, since I do not know a man?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ദൂതൻ: പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിന്റെ മേൽ വരും; അത്യുന്നതന്റെ ശക്തി നിന്റെ മേൽ നിഴലിടും; ആകയാൽ ഉത്ഭവിക്കുന്ന വിശുദ്ധപ്രജ ദൈവപുത്രൻ എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: The angel answered, "The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called the Son of God.
chapters.nkjv: And the angel answered and said to her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Highest will overshadow you; therefore, also, that Holy One who is to be born will be called the Son of God.
chapters.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ചാർച്ചക്കാരത്തി എലീശബെത്തും വാർദ്ധക്യത്തിൽ ഒരു മകനെ ഗർഭം ധരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; മച്ചി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുവന്നവൾക്കു ഇതു ആറാം മാസം.
chapters.niv: Even Elizabeth your relative is going to have a child in her old age, and she who was said to be unable to conceive is in her sixth month.
chapters.nkjv: Now indeed, Elizabeth your relative has also conceived a son in her old age; and this is now the sixth month for her who was called barren.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്നു ഒരു കാര്യവും അസാദ്ധ്യമല്ലല്ലോ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For no word from God will ever fail."
chapters.nkjv: For with God nothing will be impossible."
chapters.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മറിയ: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ കർത്താവിന്റെ ദാസി; നിന്റെ വാക്കു പോലെ എനിക്കു ഭവിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; ദൂതൻ അവളെ വിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: "I am the Lord’s servant," Mary answered. "May your word to me be fulfilled." Then the angel left her.
chapters.nkjv: Then Mary said, "Behold the maidservant of the Lord! Let it be to me according to your word." And the angel departed from her.
chapters.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

chapters.ml: ആ നാളുകളിൽ മറിയ എഴുന്നേറ്റു മല നാട്ടിൽ ഒരു യെഹൂദ്യപട്ടണത്തിൽ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ചെന്നു,
chapters.niv: At that time Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea,
chapters.nkjv: Now Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, to a city of Judah,
chapters.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

chapters.ml: സെഖര്യാവിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ എത്തി എലീശബെത്തിനെ വന്ദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: where she entered Zechariah’s home and greeted Elizabeth.
chapters.nkjv: and entered the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
chapters.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

chapters.ml: മറിയയുടെ വന്ദനം എലീശബെത്ത് കേട്ടപ്പോൾ പിള്ള അവളുടെ ഗർഭത്തിൽ തുള്ളി; എലീശബെത്ത് പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിറഞ്ഞവളായി,
chapters.niv: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, that the babe leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

chapters.ml: ഉച്ചത്തിൽ വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: സ്ത്രീകളിൽ നീ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൾ; നിന്റെ ഗർഭ ഫലവും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടതു:
chapters.niv: In a loud voice she exclaimed: "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear!
chapters.nkjv: Then she spoke out with a loud voice and said, "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
chapters.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ കർത്താവിന്റെ മാതാവു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്ന മാനം എനിക്കു എവിടെ നിന്നു ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: But why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
chapters.nkjv: But why is this granted to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
chapters.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ വന്ദനസ്വരം എന്റെ ചെവിയിൽ വീണപ്പോൾ പിള്ള എന്റെ ഗർഭത്തിൽ ആനന്ദം കൊണ്ടു തുള്ളി.
chapters.niv: As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
chapters.nkjv: For indeed, as soon as the voice of your greeting sounded in my ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
chapters.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു തന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതിന്നു നിവൃത്തിയുണ്ടാകും എന്നു വിശ്വസിച്ചവൾ ഭാഗ്യവതി.
chapters.niv: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!"
chapters.nkjv: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of those things which were told her from the Lord."
chapters.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മറിയ പറഞ്ഞതു: “എന്റെ ഉള്ളം കർത്താവിനെ മഹിമപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു;
chapters.niv: And Mary said: "My soul glorifies the Lord
chapters.nkjv: And Mary said: "My soul magnifies the Lord,
chapters.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ആത്മാവു എന്റെ രക്ഷിതാവായ ദൈവത്തിൽ ഉല്ലസിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior,
chapters.nkjv: And my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.
chapters.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ദാസിയുടെ താഴ്ച കടാക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; ഇന്നുമുതൽ എല്ലാ തലമുറകളും എന്നെ ഭാഗ്യവതി എന്നു വാഴ്ത്തും.
chapters.niv: for he has been mindful of the humble state of his servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed,
chapters.nkjv: For He has regarded the lowly state of His maidservant; For behold, henceforth all generations will call me blessed.
chapters.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

chapters.ml: ശക്തനായവൻ എനിക്കു വലിയവ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു അവന്റെ നാമം പരിശുദ്ധം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: for the Mighty One has done great things for me— holy is his name.
chapters.nkjv: For He who is mighty has done great things for me, And holy is His name.
chapters.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ഭയപ്പെടുന്നവർക്കു അവന്റെ കരുണ തലമുറതലമുറയോളം ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: His mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.
chapters.nkjv: And His mercy is on those who fear Him From generation to generation.
chapters.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ഭുജംകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ബലം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു, ഹൃദയവിചാരത്തിൽ അഹങ്കരിക്കുന്നവരെ ചിതറിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.
chapters.nkjv: He has shown strength with His arm; He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
chapters.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

chapters.ml: പ്രഭുക്കന്മാരെ സിംഹാസനങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നു ഇറക്കി താണവരെ ഉയർത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has brought down rulers from their thrones but has lifted up the humble.
chapters.nkjv: He has put down the mighty from their thrones, And exalted the lowly.
chapters.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

chapters.ml: വിശന്നിരിക്കുന്നവരെ നന്മകളാൽ നിറെച്ചു, സമ്പന്നന്മാരെ വെറുതെ അയച്ചു കളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.
chapters.nkjv: He has filled the hungry with good things, And the rich He has sent away empty.
chapters.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അബ്രാഹാമിന്നും അവന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും എന്നേക്കും കരുണ ഓർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു,
chapters.niv: He has helped his servant Israel, remembering to be merciful
chapters.nkjv: He has helped His servant Israel, In remembrance of His mercy,
chapters.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ദാസനായ യിസ്രായേലിനെ തുണെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: to Abraham and his descendants forever, just as he promised our ancestors."
chapters.nkjv: As He spoke to our fathers, To Abraham and to his seed forever."
chapters.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

chapters.ml: മറിയ ഏകദേശം മൂന്നു മാസം അവളോടു കൂടെ പാർത്തിട്ടു വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.
chapters.nkjv: And Mary remained with her about three months, and returned to her house.
chapters.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

chapters.ml: എലീശബെത്തിന്നു പ്രസവിപ്പാനുള്ള കാലം തികഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവൾ ഒരു മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: When it was time for Elizabeth to have her baby, she gave birth to a son.
chapters.nkjv: Now Elizabeth’s full time came for her to be delivered, and she brought forth a son.
chapters.kjv: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു അവൾക്കു വലിയ കരുണ കാണിച്ചു എന്നു അയൽക്കാരും ചാർച്ചക്കാരും കേട്ടിട്ടു അവളോടുകൂടെ സന്തോഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they shared her joy.
chapters.nkjv: When her neighbors and relatives heard how the Lord had shown great mercy to her, they rejoiced with her.
chapters.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

chapters.ml: എട്ടാം നാളിൽ അവർ പൈതലിനെ പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്‍വാൻ വന്നു; അപ്പന്റെ പേർ പോലെ അവന്നു സെഖര്യാവു എന്നു പേർ വിളിപ്പാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him after his father Zechariah,
chapters.nkjv: So it was, on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him by the name of his father, Zacharias.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അമ്മയോ: അല്ല, അവന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ എന്നു പേരിടേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but his mother spoke up and said, "No! He is to be called John."
chapters.nkjv: His mother answered and said, "No; he shall be called John."
chapters.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so ; but he shall be called John.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവളോടു: നിന്റെ ചാർച്ചയിൽ ഈ പേരുള്ളവർ ആരും ഇല്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who has that name."
chapters.nkjv: But they said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവന്നു എന്തു പേർ വിളിപ്പാൻ വിചാരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അപ്പനോടു ആഗ്യംകാട്ടി ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the child.
chapters.nkjv: So they made signs to his father—what he would have him called.
chapters.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു എഴുത്തു പലക ചോദിച്ചു: അവന്റെ പേർ യോഹന്നാൻ എന്നു എഴുതി; എല്ലാവരും ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone’s astonishment he wrote, "His name is John."
chapters.nkjv: And he asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, saying, "His name is John." So they all marveled.
chapters.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവന്റെ വായും നാവും തുറന്നു, അവൻ സംസാരിച്ചു ദൈവത്തെ സ്തുതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue set free, and he began to speak, praising God.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, praising God.
chapters.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed , and he spake, and praised God.

chapters.ml: ചുറ്റും പാർക്കുന്നവർക്കു എല്ലാം ഭയം ഉണ്ടായി;, യെഹൂദ്യമലനാട്ടിൽ എങ്ങും ഈ വാർത്ത ഒക്കെയും പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the neighbors were filled with awe, and throughout the hill country of Judea people were talking about all these things.
chapters.nkjv: Then fear came on all who dwelt around them; and all these sayings were discussed throughout all the hill country of Judea.
chapters.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.

chapters.ml: കേട്ടവർ എല്ലാവരും അതു ഹൃദയത്തിൽ നിക്ഷേപിച്ചു: ഈ പൈതൽ എന്തു ആകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; കർത്താവിന്റെ കൈ അവനോടു കൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, "What then is this child going to be?" For the Lord’s hand was with him.
chapters.nkjv: And all those who heard them kept them in their hearts, saying, "What kind of child will this be?" And the hand of the Lord was with him.
chapters.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അപ്പനായ സെഖര്യാവു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിറഞ്ഞവനായി പ്രവചിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: His father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:
chapters.nkjv: Now his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying:
chapters.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

chapters.ml: “യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവു അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ. അവൻ തന്റെ ജനത്തെ സന്ദർശിച്ചു ഉദ്ധാരണം ചെയ്കയും
chapters.niv: "Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has come to his people and redeemed them.
chapters.nkjv: "Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, For He has visited and redeemed His people,
chapters.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

chapters.ml: ആദിമുതൽ തന്റെ വിശുദ്ധപ്രവാചകന്മാർ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ
chapters.niv: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
chapters.nkjv: And has raised up a horn of salvation for us In the house of His servant David,
chapters.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ വശത്തു നിന്നും നമ്മെ പകെക്കുന്ന ഏവരുടെയും കയ്യിൽ നിന്നും നമ്മെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ
chapters.niv: (as he said through his holy prophets of long ago),
chapters.nkjv: As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets, Who havebeen since the world began,
chapters.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽ നമുക്കു രക്ഷയുടെ കൊമ്പു ഉയർത്തുകയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതു,
chapters.niv: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us—
chapters.nkjv: That we should be saved from our enemies And from the hand of all who hate us,
chapters.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു കരുണ പ്രവർത്തിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും
chapters.niv: to show mercy to our ancestors and to remember his holy covenant,
chapters.nkjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers And to remember His holy covenant,
chapters.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ശത്രുക്കളുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ടു
chapters.niv: the oath he swore to our father Abraham:
chapters.nkjv: The oath which He swore to our father Abraham:
chapters.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

chapters.ml: നാം ആയുഷ്ക്കാലം ഒക്കെയും ഭയം കൂടാതെ തിരുമുമ്പിൽ വിശുദ്ധിയിലും നീതിയിലും തന്നെ ആരാധിപ്പാൻ നമുക്കു കൃപ നല്കുമെന്നു
chapters.niv: to rescue us from the hand of our enemies, and to enable us to serve him without fear
chapters.nkjv: To grant us that we, Being delivered from the hand of our enemies, Might serve Him without fear,
chapters.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

chapters.ml: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു സത്യവും തന്റെ വിശുദ്ധ നിയമവും ഓർത്തതുകൊണ്ടും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.
chapters.nkjv: In holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our life.
chapters.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

chapters.ml: നീയോ പൈതലേ, അത്യുന്നതന്റെ പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടും. കർത്താവിന്റെ വഴി ഒരുക്കുവാനും
chapters.niv: And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him,
chapters.nkjv: "And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Highest; For you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare His ways,
chapters.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആർദ്രകരുണയാൽ അവന്റെ ജനത്തിന്നു പാപമോചനത്തിൽ രക്ഷാപരിജ്ഞാനം കൊടുപ്പാനുമായി നീ അവന്നു മുമ്പായി നടക്കും.
chapters.niv: to give his people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,
chapters.nkjv: To give knowledge of salvation to His people By the remission of their sins,
chapters.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

chapters.ml: ഇരുളിലും മരണനിഴലിലും ഇരിക്കുന്നവർക്കു പ്രകാശിച്ചു, നമ്മുടെ കാലുകളെ സമാധാനമാർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നടത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven
chapters.nkjv: Through the tender mercy of our God, With which the Dayspring from on high has visited us;
chapters.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

chapters.ml: ആ ആർദ്രകരുണയാൽ ഉയരത്തിൽനിന്നു ഉദയം നമ്മെ സന്ദർശിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: to shine on those living in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace."
chapters.nkjv: To give light to those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death, To guide our feet into the way of peace."
chapters.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

chapters.ml: പൈതൽ വളർന്നു ആത്മാവിൽ ബലപ്പെട്ടു; അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു തന്നെത്താൻ കാണിക്കും നാൾവരെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the child grew and became strong in spirit ; and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to Israel.
chapters.nkjv: So the child grew and became strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his manifestation to Israel.
chapters.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ലോകം ഒക്കെയും പേർവഴി ചാർത്തേണം എന്നു ഓഗുസ്തൊസ് കൈസരുടെ ഒരു ആജ്ഞ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: In those days Caesar Augustus issued a decree that a census should be taken of the entire Roman world.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be registered.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

chapters.ml: കുറേന്യൊസ് സുറിയനാടു വാഴുമ്പോൾ ഈ ഒന്നാമത്തെ ചാർത്തൽ ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: (This was the first census that took place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.)
chapters.nkjv: This census first took place while Quirinius was governing Syria.
chapters.kjv: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും ചാർത്തപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു താന്താന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു യാത്രയായി.
chapters.niv: And everyone went to their own town to register.
chapters.nkjv: So all went to be registered, everyone to his own city.
chapters.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യോസേഫും ദാവീദിന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിലും കുലത്തിലും ഉള്ളവൻ ആകകൊണ്ടു തനിക്കു വിവാഹം നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരുന്ന മറിയ എന്ന ഗർഭിണിയായ ഭാര്യയോടും കൂടെ ചാർത്തപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു ഗലീലയിലെ നസറത്ത് പട്ടണം വിട്ടു,
chapters.niv: So Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to Bethlehem the town of David, because he belonged to the house and line of David.
chapters.nkjv: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David,
chapters.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ ബേത്ളേഹെം എന്ന ദാവീദിൻ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him and was expecting a child.
chapters.nkjv: to be registered with Mary, his betrothed wife, who was with child.
chapters.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവിടെ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൾക്കു പ്രസവത്തിനുള്ള കാലം തികെഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While they were there, the time came for the baby to be born,
chapters.nkjv: So it was, that while they were there, the days were completed for her to be delivered.
chapters.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ആദ്യജാതനായ മകനെ പ്രസവിച്ചു, ശീലകൾ ചുറ്റി വഴിയമ്പലത്തിൽ അവർക്കു സ്ഥലം ഇല്ലായ്കയാൽ പശുത്തൊട്ടിയിൽ കിടത്തി.
chapters.niv: and she gave birth to her firstborn, a son. She wrapped him in cloths and placed him in a manger, because there was no guest room available for them.
chapters.nkjv: And she brought forth her firstborn Son, and wrapped Him in swaddling cloths, and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
chapters.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ആ പ്രദേശത്തു ഇടയന്മാർ രാത്രിയിൽ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തെ കാവൽകാത്തു വെളിയിൽ പാർത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And there were shepherds living out in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks at night.
chapters.nkjv: Now there were in the same country shepherds living out in the fields, keeping watch over their flock by night.
chapters.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ കർത്താവിന്റെ ഒരു ദൂതൻ അവരുടെ അരികെ നിന്നു, കർത്താവിന്റെ തേജസ്സ് അവരെ ചുറ്റിമിന്നി, അവർ ഭയപരവശരായിതീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were greatly afraid.
chapters.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ അവരോടു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; സർവ്വജനത്തിന്നും ഉണ്ടാവാനുള്ളോരു മഹാസന്തോഷം ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു സുവിശേഷിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people.
chapters.nkjv: Then the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid, for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy which will be to all people.
chapters.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവായ ക്രിസ്തു എന്ന രക്ഷിതാവു ഇന്നു ദാവീദിന്റെ പട്ടണത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കായി ജനിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: For there is born to you this day in the city of David a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
chapters.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു അടയാളമോ; ശീലകൾ ചുറ്റി പശുത്തൊട്ടിയിൽ കിടക്കുന്ന ഒരു ശിശുവിനെ നിങ്ങൾ കാണും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: This will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger."
chapters.nkjv: And this willbe the sign to you: You will find a Babe wrapped in swaddling cloths, lying in a manger."
chapters.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗീയ സൈന്യത്തിന്റെ ഒരു സംഘം ദൂതനോടു ചേർന്നു ദൈവത്തെ പുകഴ്ത്തി.
chapters.niv: Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host appeared with the angel, praising God and saying,
chapters.nkjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God and saying:
chapters.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

chapters.ml: “അത്യുന്നതങ്ങളിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്നു മഹത്വം; ഭൂമിയിൽ ദൈവപ്രസാദമുള്ള മനുഷ്യർക്കു സമാധാനം” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests."
chapters.nkjv: "Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace, goodwill toward men!"
chapters.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

chapters.ml: ദൂതന്മാർ അവരെ വിട്ടു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ പോയശേഷം ഇടയന്മാർ: നാം ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമോളം ചെന്നു കർത്താവു നമ്മോടു അറിയിച്ച ഈ സംഭവം കാണേണം എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, "Let’s go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about."
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, that the shepherds said to one another, "Let us now go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has come to pass, which the Lord has made known to us."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

chapters.ml: അവർ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ചെന്നു, മറിയയെയും യോസേഫിനെയും പശുത്തൊട്ടിയിൽ കിടക്കുന്ന ശിശുവിനെയും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby, who was lying in the manger.
chapters.nkjv: And they came with haste and found Mary and Joseph, and the Babe lying in a manger.
chapters.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

chapters.ml: കണ്ടശേഷം ഈ പൈതലിനെക്കുറിച്ചു തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they had seen him, they spread the word concerning what had been told them about this child,
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had seen Him, they made widely known the saying which was told them concerning this Child.
chapters.kjv: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

chapters.ml: കേട്ടവർ എല്ലാവരും ഇടയന്മാർ പറഞ്ഞതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.
chapters.nkjv: And all those who heard it marveled at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
chapters.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

chapters.ml: മറിയ ഈ വാർത്ത ഒക്കെയും ഹൃദയത്തിൽ സംഗ്രഹിച്ചു ധ്യാനിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.
chapters.nkjv: But Mary kept all these things and pondered them in her heart.
chapters.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളോടു അറിയിച്ചതുപോലെ ഇടയന്മാർ കേട്ടതും കണ്ടതുമായ എല്ലാറ്റിനെയും കുറിച്ചു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തിയും പുകഴ്ത്തിയും കൊണ്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, which were just as they had been told.
chapters.nkjv: Then the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told them.
chapters.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

chapters.ml: പരിച്ഛേദന കഴിപ്പാനുള്ള എട്ടു ദിവസം തികെഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഗർഭത്തിൽ ഉല്പാദിക്കുംമുമ്പെ ദൂതൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ അവന്നു യേശു എന്നു പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the eighth day, when it was time to circumcise the child, he was named Jesus, the name the angel had given him before he was conceived.
chapters.nkjv: And when eight days were completed for the circumcision of the Child, His name was called Jesus, the name given by the angel before He was conceived in the womb.
chapters.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണപ്രകാരം അവളുടെ ശുദ്ധീകരണകാലം തികഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: When the time came for the purification rites required by the Law of Moses, Joseph and Mary took him to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
chapters.nkjv: Now when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were completed, they brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
chapters.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

chapters.ml: കടിഞ്ഞൂലായ ആണൊക്കെയും കർത്താവിന്നു വിശുദ്ധം ആയിരിക്കേണം എന്നു കർത്താവിന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ
chapters.niv: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord, "Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the Lord" ),
chapters.nkjv: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, "Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord"),
chapters.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

chapters.ml: അവനെ കർത്താവിന്നു അർപ്പിപ്പാനും ഒരു ഇണ കുറപ്രാവിനെയോ രണ്ടു പ്രാകൂഞ്ഞിനെയോ കർത്താവിന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ യാഗം കഴിപ്പാനും അവർ അവനെ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: and to offer a sacrifice in keeping with what is said in the Law of the Lord: "a pair of doves or two young pigeons."
chapters.nkjv: and to offer a sacrifice according to what is said in the law of the Lord, "A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons."
chapters.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ ശിമ്യോൻ എന്നു പേരുള്ളൊരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ നീതിമാനും യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ആശ്വാസത്തിന്നായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നവനും ആയിരുന്നു; പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവും അവന്റെ മേൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now there was a man in Jerusalem called Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon, and this man was just and devout, waiting for the Consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ ക്രിസ്തുവിനെ കാണുംമുമ്പെ മരണം കാണ്കയില്ല എന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനാൽ അവന്നു അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not die before he had seen the Lord’s Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: And it had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
chapters.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആത്മനിയോഗത്താൽ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു. യേശു എന്ന പൈതലിന്നു വേണ്ടി ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്റെ ചട്ടപ്രകാരം ചെയ്‍വാൻ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാർ അവനെ അകത്തു കൊണ്ടുചെന്നപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: Moved by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. When the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for him what the custom of the Law required,
chapters.nkjv: So he came by the Spirit into the temple. And when the parents brought in the Child Jesus, to do for Him according to the custom of the law,
chapters.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനെ കയ്യിൽ ഏന്തി ദൈവത്തെ പുകഴ്ത്തി:
chapters.niv: Simeon took him in his arms and praised God, saying:
chapters.nkjv: he took Him up in his arms and blessed God and said:
chapters.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

chapters.ml: “ഇപ്പോൾ നാഥാ തിരുവചനം പോലെ നീ അടിയനെ സമാധാനത്തോടെ വിട്ടയക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Sovereign Lord, as you have promised, you may now dismiss your servant in peace.
chapters.nkjv: "Lord, now You are letting Your servant depart in peace, According to Your word;
chapters.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

chapters.ml: ജാതികൾക്കു വെളിപ്പെടുവാനുള്ള പ്രകാശവും നിന്റെ ജനമായ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ മഹത്വവുമായി
chapters.niv: For my eyes have seen your salvation,
chapters.nkjv: For my eyes have seen Your salvation
chapters.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

chapters.ml: നീ സകല ജാതികളുടെയും മുമ്പിൽ ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്ന നിന്റെ രക്ഷയെ
chapters.niv: which you have prepared in the sight of all nations:
chapters.nkjv: Which You have prepared before the face of all peoples,
chapters.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ കണ്ണു കണ്ടുവല്ലോ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel."
chapters.nkjv: A light to bring revelation to the Gentiles, And the glory of Your people Israel."
chapters.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതിൽ അവന്റെ അപ്പനും അമ്മയും ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The child’s father and mother marveled at what was said about him.
chapters.nkjv: And Joseph and His mother marveled at those things which were spoken of Him.
chapters.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശിമ്യോൻ അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു അവന്റെ അമ്മയായ മറിയയോടു: അനേകഹൃദയങ്ങളിലെ വിചാരം വെളിപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇവനെ യിസ്രായേലിൽ പലരുടെയും വീഴ്ചെയക്കും എഴുന്നേല്പിന്നും മറുത്തുപറയുന്ന അടയാളത്തിന്നുമായി വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother: "This child is destined to cause the falling and rising of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,
chapters.nkjv: Then Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary His mother, "Behold, this Child is destined for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which will be spoken against
chapters.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സ്വന്തപ്രാണനിൽകൂടിയും ഒരു വാൾ കടക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed. And a sword will pierce your own soul too."
chapters.nkjv: (yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul also), that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed."
chapters.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

chapters.ml: ആശേർ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ഫനൂവേലിന്റെ മകളായ ഹന്നാ എന്നൊരു പ്രവാചകി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൾ കന്യാകാലത്തിൽ പിന്നെ ഭർത്താവിനോടുകൂടെ ഏഴു സംവത്സരം കഴിച്ചു എണ്പത്തുനാലു സംവത്സരം വിധവയും വളരെ വയസ്സു ചെന്നവളുമായി
chapters.niv: There was also a prophet, Anna, the daughter of Penuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was very old; she had lived with her husband seven years after her marriage,
chapters.nkjv: Now there was one, Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was of a great age, and had lived with a husband seven years from her virginity;
chapters.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

chapters.ml: ദൈവാലയം വിട്ടു പിരിയാതെ ഉപവാസത്തോടും പ്രാർത്ഥനയോടും കൂടെ രാവും പകലും ആരാധന ചെയ്തു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: and then was a widow until she was eighty-four. She never left the temple but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.
chapters.nkjv: and this woman was a widow of about eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
chapters.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

chapters.ml: ആ നാഴികയിൽ അവളും അടുത്തുനിന്നു ദൈവത്തെ സ്തുതിച്ചു, യെരൂശലേമിന്റെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പിനെ കാത്തിരുന്ന എല്ലാവരോടും അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Coming up to them at that very moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the child to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And coming in that instant she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of Him to all those who looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ കല്പിച്ചുരിക്കുന്നതൊക്കെയും നിവർത്തിച്ചശേഷം അവർ ഗലീലയിൽ തങ്ങളുടെ പട്ടണമായ നസറത്തിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When Joseph and Mary had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee to their own town of Nazareth.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
chapters.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

chapters.ml: പൈതൽ വളർന്നു ജ്ഞാനം നിറഞ്ഞു, ആത്മാവിൽ ബലപ്പെട്ടുപോന്നു; ദൈവകൃപയും അവന്മേൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.
chapters.nkjv: And the Child grew and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom; and the grace of God was upon Him.
chapters.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാർ ആണ്ടുതോറും പെസഹപെരുനാളിന്നു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോകും.
chapters.niv: Every year Jesus’ parents went to Jerusalem for the Festival of the Passover.
chapters.nkjv: His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.
chapters.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടു വയസ്സായപ്പോൾ അവർ പതിവുപോലെ പെരുനാളിന്നു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When he was twelve years old, they went up to the festival, according to the custom.
chapters.nkjv: And when He was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast.
chapters.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

chapters.ml: പെരുനാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞു മടങ്ങിപ്പോരുമ്പോൾ ബാലനായ യേശു യെരൂശലേമിൽ താമസിച്ചു; അമ്മയപ്പന്മാരോ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: After the festival was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but they were unaware of it.
chapters.nkjv: When they had finished the days, as they returned, the Boy Jesus lingered behind in Jerusalem. And Joseph and His mother did not know it;
chapters.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it .

chapters.ml: സഹയാത്രക്കാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കും എന്നു അവർ ഊഹിച്ചിട്ടു ഒരു ദിവസത്തെ വഴി പോന്നു; പിന്നെ അവനെ ബന്ധുക്കളുടെയും പരിചയക്കാരുടെയും ഇടയിൽ തിരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends.
chapters.nkjv: but supposing Him to have been in the company, they went a day’s journey, and sought Him among their relatives and acquaintances.
chapters.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

chapters.ml: കാണാഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവനെ അന്വേഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When they did not find him, they went back to Jerusalem to look for him.
chapters.nkjv: So when they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking Him.
chapters.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നു നാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഉപദേഷ്ടാക്കന്മാരുടെ നടുവിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നതും അവരുടെ ഉപദേശം കേൾക്കയും അവരോടു ചോദിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: After three days they found him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
chapters.nkjv: Now so it was that after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടവർക്കെല്ലാവർക്കും അവന്റെ വിവേകത്തിലും ഉത്തരങ്ങളിലും വിസ്മയം തോന്നി. അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവർ അതിശയിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers.
chapters.nkjv: And all who heard Him were astonished at His understanding and answers.
chapters.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

chapters.ml: അമ്മ അവനോടു: മകനേ, ഞങ്ങളോടു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? നിന്റെ അപ്പനും ഞാനും വ്യസനിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നിന്നെ തിരഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When his parents saw him, they were astonished. His mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for you."
chapters.nkjv: So when they saw Him, they were amazed; and His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You done this to us? Look, Your father and I have sought You anxiously."
chapters.kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “എന്നെ തിരഞ്ഞതു എന്തിന്നു? എന്റെ പിതാവിന്നുള്ളതിൽ ഞാൻ ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ.” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Why were you searching for me?" he asked. "Didn’t you know I had to be in my Father’s house?"
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Why did you seek Me? Did you not know that I must be about My Father’s business?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?

chapters.ml: അവൻ തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു അവർ ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.
chapters.nkjv: But they did not understand the statement which He spoke to them.
chapters.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടുകൂടെ ഇറങ്ങി, നസറെത്തിൽ വന്നു അവർക്കു കീഴടങ്ങിയിരുന്നു. ഈ കാര്യങ്ങൾ എല്ലാം അവന്റെ അമ്മ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ സംഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart.
chapters.nkjv: Then He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them, but His mother kept all these things in her heart.
chapters.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ ജ്ഞാനത്തിലും വളർച്ചയിലും ദൈവത്തിന്റെയും മനുഷ്യരുടെയും കൃപയിലും മുതിർന്നു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

chapters.ml: തീബെര്യൊസ് കൈസരുടെ വാഴ്ചയുടെ പതിനഞ്ചാം ആണ്ടിൽ പൊന്തിയൊസ് പീലാത്തൊസ് യെഹൂദ്യനാടു വാഴുമ്പോൾ, ഹെരോദാവു ഗലീലയിലും അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ഫീലിപ്പൊസ് ഇതുര്യത്രഖോനിത്തിദേശങ്ങളിലും ലുസാന്യാസ് അബിലേനയിലും
chapters.niv: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar—when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene—
chapters.nkjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
chapters.kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

chapters.ml: ഇടപ്രഭൂക്കന്മാരായും ഹന്നാവും കയ്യഫാവും മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരായും ഇരിക്കും കാലം സെഖര്യാവിന്റെ മകനായ യോഹന്നാന്നു മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: during the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: while Annas and Caiaphas were high priests, the word of God came to John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോർദ്ദാന്നരികെയുള്ള നാട്ടിൽ ഒക്കെയും വന്നു പാപമോചനത്തിനായുള്ള മാനസാന്തരസ്നാനം പ്രസംഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.nkjv: And he went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins,
chapters.kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

chapters.ml: “മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വിളിച്ചുപറയുന്നവന്റെ വാക്കാവിതു: കർത്താവിന്റെ വഴി ഒരുക്കുവിൻ; അവന്റെ പാത നിരപ്പാക്കുവിൻ.”
chapters.niv: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.
chapters.nkjv: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; Make His paths straight.
chapters.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാതാഴ്വരയും നികന്നുവരും; എല്ലാമലയും കുന്നും താഴും; വളഞ്ഞതു ചൊവ്വായും ദുർഘടമായതു നിരന്ന വഴിയായും തീരും;
chapters.niv: Every valley shall be filled in, every mountain and hill made low. The crooked roads shall become straight, the rough ways smooth.
chapters.nkjv: Every valley shall be filled And every mountain and hill brought low; The crooked places shall be made straight And the rough ways smooth;
chapters.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

chapters.ml: സകലജഡവും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ രക്ഷയെ കാണും” എന്നിങ്ങനെ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്റെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു പോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: And all people will see God’s salvation.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.’ "
chapters.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

chapters.ml: അവനാൽ സ്നാനം ഏല്പാൻ വന്ന പുരുഷാരത്തോടു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: സർപ്പസന്തതികളേ, വരുവാനുള്ള കോപത്തെ ഒഴിഞ്ഞ് ഓടിപ്പോകുവാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉപദേശിച്ചുതന്നതു ആർ?
chapters.niv: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to the multitudes that came out to be baptized by him, "Brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
chapters.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

chapters.ml: മാനസാന്തരത്തിന്നു യോഗ്യമായ ഫലം കായിപ്പിൻ. അബ്രാഹാം ഞങ്ങൾക്കു പിതാവായിട്ടുണ്ടു; എന്നു ഉള്ളം കൊണ്ടു പറവാൻ തുനിയരുതു; അബ്രാഹാമിന്നു ഈ കല്ലുകളിൽ നിന്നു മക്കളെ ഉളവാക്കുവാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്നു കഴിയും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore bear fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
chapters.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നേ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളുടെ ചുവട്ടിന്നു കോടാലി വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നല്ല ഫലം കായ്ക്കാത്ത വൃക്ഷം എല്ലാം വെട്ടി തീയിൽ ഇട്ടുകളയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."
chapters.nkjv: And even now the ax is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."
chapters.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു പുരുഷാരം അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "What should we do then?" the crowd asked.
chapters.nkjv: So the people asked him, saying, "What shall we do then?"
chapters.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: രണ്ടു വസ്ത്രമുള്ളവൻ ഇല്ലാത്തവന്നു കൊടുക്കട്ടെ; ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങൾ ഉള്ളവനും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്യട്ടെ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: John answered, "Anyone who has two shirts should share with the one who has none, and anyone who has food should do the same."
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said to them, "He who has two tunics, let him give to him who has none; and he who has food, let him do likewise."
chapters.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

chapters.ml: ചുങ്കക്കാരും സ്നാനം ഏല്പാൻ വന്നു: ഗുരോ, ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തുചെയ്യേണം എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. "Teacher," they asked, "what should we do?"
chapters.nkjv: Then tax collectors also came to be baptized, and said to him, "Teacher, what shall we do?"
chapters.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ചതിൽ അധികം ഒന്നും പിരിക്കരുതു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Don’t collect any more than you are required to," he told them.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to them, "Collect no more than what is appointed for you."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

chapters.ml: പടജ്ജനവും അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ആരെയും ബലാൽക്കാരം ചെയ്യാതെയും ചതിയായി ഒന്നും വാങ്ങാതെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ ശമ്പളം മതി എന്നു വെപ്പിൻ എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then some soldiers asked him, "And what should we do?" He replied, "Don’t extort money and don’t accuse people falsely—be content with your pay."
chapters.nkjv: Likewise the soldiers asked him, saying, "And what shall we do?" So he said to them, "Do not intimidate anyone or accuse falsely, and be content with your wages."
chapters.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

chapters.ml: ജനം കാത്തു നിന്നു; അവൻ ക്രിസ്തുവോ എന്നു എല്ലാവരും ഹൃദയത്തിൽ യോഹന്നാനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിചാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: Now as the people were in expectation, and all reasoned in their hearts about John, whether he was the Christ or not,
chapters.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ എല്ലാവരോടും ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടു സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; എന്നാൽ എന്നിലും ബലവാനായവൻ വരുന്നു; അവന്റെ ചെരിപ്പിന്റെ വാറു അഴിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ യോഗ്യനല്ല; അവൻ നിങ്ങളെ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവുകൊണ്ടും തീകൊണ്ടും സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: John answered them all, "I baptize you with water. But one who is more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
chapters.nkjv: John answered, saying to all, "I indeed baptize you with water; but One mightier than I is coming, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
chapters.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

chapters.ml: അവന്നു വീശുമുറം കയ്യിൽ ഉണ്ടു; അവൻ കളത്തെ മുറ്റും വെടിപ്പാക്കി കോതമ്പു കളപ്പുരയിൽ കൂട്ടിവെക്കയും പതിർ കെടാത്ത തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."
chapters.nkjv: His winnowing fan is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clean out His threshing floor, and gather the wheat into His barn; but the chaff He will burn with unquenchable fire."
chapters.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു പലതും അവൻ പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചു കൊണ്ടു ജനത്തോടു സുവിശേഷം അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And with many other words John exhorted the people and proclaimed the good news to them.
chapters.nkjv: And with many other exhortations he preached to the people.
chapters.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇടപ്രഭുവായ ഹെരോദാവു സഹോദരന്റെ ഭാര്യ ഹെരോദ്യനിമിത്തവും ഹെരോദാവു ചെയ്ത സകലദോഷങ്ങൾ നിമിത്തവും യോഹന്നാൻ അവനെ ആക്ഷേപിക്കയാൽ
chapters.niv: But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of his marriage to Herodias, his brother’s wife, and all the other evil things he had done,
chapters.nkjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being rebuked by him concerning Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
chapters.kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

chapters.ml: അതെല്ലാം ചെയ്തതു കൂടാതെ അവനെ തടവിൽ ആക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.
chapters.nkjv: also added this, above all, that he shut John up in prison.
chapters.kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

chapters.ml: ജനം എല്ലാം സ്നാനം ഏല്ക്കുകയിൽ യേശുവും സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുമ്പോൾ സ്വർഗ്ഗം തുറന്നു,
chapters.niv: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened
chapters.nkjv: When all the people were baptized, it came to pass that Jesus also was baptized; and while He prayed, the heaven was opened.
chapters.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

chapters.ml: പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ദേഹരൂപത്തിൽ പ്രാവു എന്നപോലെ അവന്റെമേൽ ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു. നീ എന്റെ പ്രിയ പുത്രൻ; നിന്നിൽ ഞാൻ പ്രസാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദവും ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."
chapters.nkjv: And the Holy Spirit descended in bodily form like a dove upon Him, and a voice came from heaven which said, "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased."
chapters.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

chapters.ml: യേശുവിന്നു താൻ പ്രവൃത്തി ആരംഭിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഏകദേശം മുപ്പതു വയസ്സായിരുന്നു. അവൻ യോസേഫിന്റെ മകൻ എന്നു ജനം വിചാരിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,
chapters.nkjv: Now Jesus Himself began Hisministryat about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, theson of Heli,
chapters.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് ഹേലിയുടെ മകൻ, ഹേലി മത്ഥാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ, മത്ഥാത്ത് ലേവിയുടെ മകൻ, ലേവി മെൽക്കിയുടെ മകൻ, മെൽക്കി യന്നായിയുടെ മകൻ, യന്നായി
chapters.niv: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melki, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Matthat, theson of Levi, theson of Melchi, theson of Janna, theson of Joseph,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

chapters.ml: യോസേഫിന്റെ മകൻ, യോസേഫ് മത്തഥ്യൊസിന്റെ മകൻ, മത്തഥ്യൊസ് ആമോസിന്റെ മകൻ, ആമോസ് നാഹൂമിന്റെ മകൻ, നാഹൂം എസ്ളിയുടെ മകൻ, എസ്ളി നഗ്ഗായിയുടെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Mattathiah, theson of Amos, theson of Nahum, theson of Esli, theson of Naggai,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

chapters.ml: നഗ്ഗായി മയാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ, മയാത്ത് മത്തഥ്യൊസിന്റെ മകൻ, മത്തഥ്യൊസ് ശെമയിയുടെ മകൻ, ശെമയി യോസേഫിന്റെ മകൻ, യോസേഫ് യോദയുടെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josek, the son of Joda,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Maath, theson of Mattathiah, theson of Semei, theson of Joseph, theson of Judah,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

chapters.ml: യോദാ യോഹന്നാന്റെ മകൻ, യോഹന്നാൻ രേസയുടെ മകൻ, രേസ സൊരൊബാബേലിന്റെ മകൻ, സൊരൊബാബേൽ ശലഥീയേലിന്റെ മകൻ, ശലഥീയേൽ നേരിയുടെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Joannas, theson of Rhesa, theson of Zerubbabel, theson of Shealtiel, theson of Neri,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

chapters.ml: നേരി മെൽക്കിയുടെ മകൻ, മെൽക്കി അദ്ദിയുടെ മകൻ, അദ്ദി കോസാമിന്റെ മകൻ, കോസാം എല്മാദാമിന്റെ മകൻ, എല്മാദാം ഏരിന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Melki, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Melchi, theson of Addi, theson of Cosam, theson of Elmodam, theson of Er,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

chapters.ml: ഏർ യോസുവിന്റെ മകൻ, യോശു എലീയേസരിന്റെ മകൻ, എലീയേസർ യോരീമിന്റെ മകൻ, യോരീം മത്ഥാത്തിന്റെ മകൻ, മത്ഥാത്ത് ലേവിയുടെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Jose, theson of Eliezer, theson of Jorim, theson of Matthat, theson of Levi,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

chapters.ml: ലേവി ശിമ്യോന്റെ മകൻ, ശിമ്യോൻ യെഹൂദയുടെ മകൻ, യെഹൂദാ യോസേഫിന്റെ മകൻ, യോസേഫ് യോനാമിന്റെ മകൻ, യോനാം എല്യാക്കീമിന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Simeon, theson of Judah, theson of Joseph, theson of Jonan, theson of Eliakim,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

chapters.ml: എല്യാക്കീം മെല്യാവിന്റെ മകൻ, മെല്യാവു മെന്നയുടെ മകൻ, മെന്നാ മത്തഥയുടെ മകൻ, മത്തഥാ നാഥാന്റെ മകൻ, നാഥാൻ ദാവീദിന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Melea, theson of Menan, theson of Mattathah, theson of Nathan, the son of David,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകൻ, യിശ്ശായി ഓബേദിന്റെ മകൻ, ഓബേദ് ബോവസിന്റെ മകൻ, ബോവസ് സല്മോന്റെ മകൻ, സല്മോൻ നഹശോന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Jesse, theson of Obed, theson of Boaz, theson of Salmon, theson of Nahshon,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

chapters.ml: നഹശോൻ അമ്മീനാദാബിന്റെ മകൻ, അമ്മീനാദാബ് അരാമിന്റെ മകൻ, അരാം എസ്രോന്റെ മകൻ, എസ്രോൻ പാരെസിന്റെ മകൻ, പാരെസ് യേഹൂദയുടെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Amminadab, the son of Ram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Amminadab, theson of Ram, theson of Hezron, theson of Perez, theson of Judah,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാ യാക്കോബിന്റെ മകൻ, യാക്കോബ് യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ മകൻ, യിസ്ഹാക്ക് അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ മകൻ, അബ്രാഹാം തേറഹിന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Jacob, theson of Isaac, theson of Abraham, theson of Terah, theson of Nahor,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

chapters.ml: തേറഹ് നാഹോരിന്റെ മകൻ, നാഹോർ സെരൂഗിന്റെ മകൻ, സെരൂഗ് രെഗുവിന്റെ മകൻ, രെഗു ഫാലെഗിന്റെ മകൻ, ഫാലെഗ് ഏബെരിന്റെ മകൻ, ഏബെർ ശലാമിന്റെ മകൻ, ശലാം കയിനാന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Serug, theson of Reu, theson of Peleg, theson of Eber, theson of Shelah,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

chapters.ml: കയിനാൻ അർഫക്സാദിന്റെ മകൻ, അർഫക്സാദ് ശേമിന്റെ മകൻ, ശേം നോഹയുടെ മകൻ, നോഹ ലാമേക്കിന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Cainan, theson of Arphaxad, theson of Shem, theson of Noah, theson of Lamech,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

chapters.ml: ലാമേക്ക്ക് മെഥൂശലയുടെ മകൻ, മെഥൂശലാ ഹാനോക്കിന്റെ മകൻ, ഹാനോക്ക്ക് യാരെദിന്റെ മകൻ, യാരെദ് മലെല്യേലിന്റെ മകൻ, മലെല്യേൽ കയിനാന്റെ മകൻ,
chapters.niv: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Kenan,
chapters.nkjv: theson of Methuselah, theson of Enoch, theson of Jared, theson of Mahalalel, theson of Cainan,
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

chapters.ml: കയിനാൻ എനോശിന്റെ മകൻ, എനോശ് ശേത്തിന്റെ മകൻ, ശേത്ത് ആദാമിന്റെ മകൻ, ആദാം ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മകൻ.
chapters.niv: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
chapters.nkjv: theson of Enosh, theson of Seth, theson of Adam, theson of God.
chapters.kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

chapters.ml: യേശു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിറഞ്ഞവനായി യോർദ്ദാൻ വിട്ടു മടങ്ങി; ആത്മാവു അവനെ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു നടത്തി; പിശാചു അവനെ നാല്പതു ദിവസം പരീക്ഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus, being filled with the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
chapters.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

chapters.ml: ആ ദിവസങ്ങളിൽ അവൻ ഒന്നും ഭക്ഷിച്ചില്ല; അവ കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവന്നു വിശന്നു.
chapters.niv: where for forty days he was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.
chapters.nkjv: being tempted for forty days by the devil. And in those days He ate nothing, and afterward, when they had ended, He was hungry.
chapters.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പിശാചു അവനോടു: നീ ദൈവ പുത്രൻ എങ്കിൽ ഈ കല്ലിനോടു അപ്പമായി ത്തീരുവാൻ കല്പിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread."
chapters.nkjv: And the devil said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread."
chapters.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “മനുഷ്യൻ അപ്പംകൊണ്ടു മാത്രമല്ല ജീവിക്കുന്നതു എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’ "
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answered him, saying, "It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’ "
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പിശാചു അവനെ മേലോട്ടു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി ലോകത്തിലെ സകല രാജ്യങ്ങളെയും ക്ഷണനേരത്തിൽ അവന്നു കാണിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
chapters.nkjv: Then the devil, taking Him up on a high mountain, showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
chapters.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

chapters.ml: ഈ അധികാരം ഒക്കെയും അതിന്റെ മഹത്വവും നിനക്കു തരാം; അതു എങ്കൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; എനിക്കു മനസ്സുള്ളവന്നു ഞാൻ കൊടുക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he said to him, "I will give you all their authority and splendor; it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to.
chapters.nkjv: And the devil said to Him, "All this authority I will give You, and their glory; for this has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I wish.
chapters.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്നെ നമസ്കരിച്ചാൽ അതെല്ലാം നിന്റെതാകും എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If you worship me, it will all be yours."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, if You will worship before me, all will be Yours."
chapters.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവിനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു അവനെ മാത്രമേ ആരാധിക്കാവു എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus answered and said to him, "Get behind Me, Satan!For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and Him only you shall serve.’"
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവനെ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോയി ദൈവാലയത്തിന്റെ അഗ്രത്തിന്മേൽ നിറുത്തി അവനോടു: നീ ദൈവപുത്രൻ എങ്കിൽ ഇവിടെ നിന്നു താഴോട്ടു ചാടുക.
chapters.niv: The devil led him to Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple. "If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down from here.
chapters.nkjv: Then he brought Him to Jerusalem, set Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here.
chapters.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

chapters.ml: “നിന്നെ കാപ്പാൻ അവൻ തന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരോടു നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു കല്പിക്കയും
chapters.niv: For it is written: " ‘He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully;
chapters.nkjv: For it is written: ‘He shall give His angels charge over you, To keep you,’
chapters.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ കാൽ കല്ലിനോടു തട്ടാതവണ്ണം അവർ നിന്നെ കയ്യിൽ താങ്ങിക്കൊള്ളുകയും ചെയ്യും” എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’ "
chapters.nkjv: and, ‘In their hands they shall bear you up, Lest you dash your foot against a stone.’ "
chapters.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവിനെ പരീക്ഷിക്കരുതു എന്നു അരുച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "It is said: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus answered and said to him, "It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’"
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പിശാചു സകല പരീക്ഷയും തികെച്ചശേഷം കുറെ കാലത്തേക്കു അവനെ വിട്ടുമാറി.
chapters.niv: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the devil had ended every temptation, he departed from Him until an opportune time.
