chapters.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

chapters.ml: യേശു ആത്മാവിന്റെ ശക്തിയോടെ ഗലീലെക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു; അവന്റെ ശ്രുതി ചുറ്റുമുള്ള നാട്ടിൽ ഒക്കെയും പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit to Galilee, and news of Him went out through all the surrounding region.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ പള്ളികളിൽ ഉപദേശിച്ചു; എല്ലാവരും അവനെ പ്രശംസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He was teaching in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.
chapters.nkjv: And He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
chapters.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വളർന്ന നസറെത്തിൽ വന്നു: ശബ്ബത്തിൽ തന്റെ പതിവുപോലെ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു വായിപ്പാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റുനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. He stood up to read,
chapters.nkjv: So He came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. And as His custom was, He went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
chapters.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

chapters.ml: യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്റെ പുസ്തകം അവന്നു കൊടുത്തു; അവൻ പുസ്തകം വിടർത്തി:
chapters.niv: and the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:
chapters.nkjv: And He was handed the book of the prophet Isaiah. And when He had opened the book, He found the place where it was written:
chapters.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

chapters.ml: “ദരിദ്രന്മാരോടു സുവിശേഷം അറിയിപ്പാൻ കർത്താവു എന്നെ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്കയാൽ അവന്റെ ആത്മാവു എന്റെമേൽ ഉണ്ടു; ബദ്ധന്മാർക്കു വിടുതലും കുരുടന്മാർക്കു കാഴ്ചയും പ്രസംഗിപ്പാനും പീഡിതന്മാരെ വിടുവിച്ചയപ്പാനും
chapters.niv: "The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free,
chapters.nkjv: "The Spirit of the Lordisupon Me, Because He has anointed Me To preach the gospel tothepoor; He has sent Me to heal the brokenhearted, To proclaim liberty tothecaptives And recovery of sight totheblind, To set at liberty those who are oppressed;
chapters.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ പ്രസാദവർഷം പ്രസംഗിപ്പാനും എന്നെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor."
chapters.nkjv: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord."
chapters.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പുസ്തകം മടക്കി ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരന്നു തിരികെ കൊടുത്തിട്ടു ഇരുന്നു; പള്ളിയിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരുടെയും കണ്ണു അവങ്കൽ പതിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him.
chapters.nkjv: Then He closed the book, and gave it back to the attendant and sat down. And the eyes of all who were in the synagogue were fixed on Him.
chapters.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഇന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ വചനം കേൾക്കയിൽ ഈ തിരുവെഴുത്തിന്നു നിവൃത്തി വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: He began by saying to them, "Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing."
chapters.nkjv: And He began to say to them, "Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing."
chapters.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും അവനെ പുകഴ്ത്തി, അവന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ട ലാവണ്യ വാക്കുകൾ നിമിത്തം ആശ്ചര്യപെട്ടു; ഇവൻ യോസേഫിന്റെ മകൻ അല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. "Isn’t this Joseph’s son?" they asked.
chapters.nkjv: So all bore witness to Him, and marveled at the gracious words which proceeded out of His mouth. And they said, "Is this not Joseph’s son?"
chapters.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “വൈദ്യാ, നിന്നെത്തന്നേ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുക എന്നുള്ള പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലും കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ ഉണ്ടായി കേട്ടതുഎല്ലാം ഈ നിന്റെ പിതൃനഗരത്തിലും ചെയ്കഎന്നും നിങ്ങൾ എന്നോടു പറയും നിശ്ചയം.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "Surely you will quote this proverb to me: ‘Physician, heal yourself!’ And you will tell me, ‘Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.’ "
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "You will surely say this proverb to Me, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in Your country.’ "
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

chapters.ml: ഒരു പ്രവാചകനും തന്റെ പിതൃനഗരത്തിൽ സമ്മതനല്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you," he continued, "no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said, "Assuredly, I say to you, no prophet is accepted in his own country.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

chapters.ml: “ഏലീയാവിന്റെ കാലത്തു ആകാശം മൂവാണ്ടും ആറു മാസവും അടഞ്ഞിട്ടു ദേശത്തു എങ്ങും മഹാ ക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടായപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേലിൽ പല വിധവമാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ യഥാർത്ഥമായി നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I assure you that there were many widows in Israel in Elijah’s time, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land.
chapters.nkjv: But I tell you truly, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, and there was a great famine throughout all the land;
chapters.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സിദോനിലെ സരെപ്തയിൽ ഒരു വിധവയുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കല്ലാതെ അവരിൽ ആരുടെയും അടുക്കലേക്കു ഏലീയാവിനെ അയച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon.
chapters.nkjv: but to none of them was Elijah sent except to Zarephath,in the region of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
chapters.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

chapters.ml: അവ്വണ്ണം എലീശാപ്രവാചകന്റെ കാലത്തു യിസ്രായേലിൽ പല കുഷ്ഠരോഗികൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. സുറിയക്കാരനായ നയമാൻ അല്ലാതെ അവരാരും ശുദ്ധമായില്ല.” എന്നും അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And there were many in Israel with leprosy in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian."
chapters.nkjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, and none of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian."
chapters.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

chapters.ml: പള്ളിയിലുള്ളവർ ഇതു കേട്ടിട്ടു എല്ലാവരും കോപം നിറഞ്ഞവരായി എഴുന്നേറ്റു
chapters.niv: All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this.
chapters.nkjv: So all those in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
chapters.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

chapters.ml: അവനെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി അവരുടെ പട്ടണം പണിതിരുന്ന മലയുടെ വക്കോളം കൊണ്ടുപോയി തലകീഴായി തള്ളിയിടുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff.
chapters.nkjv: and rose up and thrust Him out of the city; and they led Him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, that they might throw Him down over the cliff.
chapters.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

chapters.ml: അവനോ അവരുടെ നടുവിൽ കൂടി കടന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.
chapters.nkjv: Then passing through the midst of them, He went His way.
chapters.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ ഗലീലയിലെ ഒരു പട്ടണമായ കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ ചെന്നു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ അവരെ ഉപദേശിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath he taught the people.
chapters.nkjv: Then He went down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and was teaching them on the Sabbaths.
chapters.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വചനം അധികാരത്തോടെ ആകയാൽ അവർ അവന്റെ ഉപദേശത്തിൽ വിസ്മയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They were amazed at his teaching, because his words had authority.
chapters.nkjv: And they were astonished at His teaching, for His word was with authority.
chapters.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ പള്ളിയിൽ അശുദ്ധഭൂതം ബാധിച്ച ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,
chapters.nkjv: Now in the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon. And he cried out with a loud voice,
chapters.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

chapters.ml: അവൻ നസറായനായ യേശുവേ, വിടു; ഞങ്ങൾക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? ഞങ്ങളെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നുവോ? നീ ആർ എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പരിശുദ്ധൻ തന്നേ എന്നു ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Go away! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Let us alone! What have we to do with You, Jesus of Nazareth? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are— the Holy One of God!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

chapters.ml: “മിണ്ടരുതു; അവനെ വിട്ടുപോക” എന്നു യേശു അതിനെ ശാസിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഭൂതം അവനെ നടുവിൽ തള്ളിയിട്ടു കേടു ഒന്നും വരുത്താതെ അവനെ വിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: "Be quiet!" Jesus said sternly. "Come out of him!" Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!" And when the demon had thrown him in their midst, it came out of him and did not hurt him.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവർക്കും വിസ്മയം ഉണ്ടായി: ഈ വചനം എന്തു? അധികാരത്തോടും ശക്തിയോടുംകൂടെ അവൻ അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കളോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നു; അവ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോകുന്നു എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the people were amazed and said to each other, "What words these are! With authority and power he gives orders to impure spirits and they come out!"
chapters.nkjv: Then they were all amazed and spoke among themselves, saying, "What a word this is! For with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out."
chapters.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശ്രുതി ചുറ്റുമുള്ള നാടെങ്ങും പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.
chapters.nkjv: And the report about Him went out into every place in the surrounding region.
chapters.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി ശിമോന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു. ശിമോന്റെ അമ്മാവിയമ്മ കഠിനജ്വരംകൊണ്ടു വലഞ്ഞിരിക്കയാൽ അവർ അവൾക്കുവേണ്ടി അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.
chapters.nkjv: Now He arose from the synagogue and entered Simon’s house. But Simon’s wife’s mother was sick with a high fever, and they made request of Him concerning her.
chapters.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളെ കുനിഞ്ഞു നോക്കി, ജ്വരത്തെ ശാസിച്ചു; അതു അവളെ വിട്ടുമാറി; അവൾ ഉടനെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവനെ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.
chapters.nkjv: So He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. And immediately she arose and served them.
chapters.kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

chapters.ml: സൂര്യൻ അസ്തമിക്കുമ്പോൾ നാനാവ്യാധികൾ പിടിച്ച ദീനക്കാർ ഉള്ളവർ ഒക്കെയും അവരെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവൻ ഓരോരുത്തന്റെയും മേൽ കൈവെച്ചു അവരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: At sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them.
chapters.nkjv: When the sun was setting, all those who had any that were sick with various diseases brought them to Him; and He laid His hands on every one of them and healed them.
chapters.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

chapters.ml: പലരിൽ നിന്നും ഭൂതങ്ങൾ; നീ ദൈവപുത്രനായ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി; താൻ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു അവ അറികകൊണ്ടു മിണ്ടുവാൻ അവൻ സമ്മതിക്കാതെ അവയെ ശാസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: And demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, "You are the Christ, the Son of God!" And He, rebuking them, did not allow them to speak, for they knew that He was the Christ.
chapters.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

chapters.ml: നേരം വെളുത്തപ്പോൾ അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ഒരു നിർജ്ജനസ്ഥലത്തേക്കു പോയി. പുരുഷാരം അവനെ തിരഞ്ഞു അവന്റെ അരികത്തു വന്നു തങ്ങളെ വിട്ടു പോകാതിരിപ്പാൻ അവനെ തടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.
chapters.nkjv: Now when it was day, He departed and went into a deserted place. And the crowd sought Him and came to Him, and tried to keep Him from leaving them;
chapters.kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ മറ്റുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും ദൈവരാജ്യം സുവിശേഷിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു; ഇതിനായിട്ടല്ലോ എന്നെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he said, "I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent."
chapters.nkjv: but He said to them, "I must preach the kingdom of God to the other cities also, because for this purpose I have been sent."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ഗലീലയിലെ പള്ളികളിൽ പ്രസംഗിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
chapters.nkjv: And He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
chapters.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഗന്നേസരെത്ത് തടാകത്തിന്റെ കരയിൽ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ പുരുഷാരം ദൈവവചനം കേൾക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ തിക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കയിൽ
chapters.niv: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, as the multitude pressed about Him to hear the word of God, that He stood by the Lake of Gennesaret,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു പടകു കരെക്കു അടുത്തു നില്ക്കുന്നതു അവൻ കണ്ടു; അവയിൽ നിന്നു മീൻപിടിക്കാർ ഇറങ്ങി വല കഴുകുകയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.
chapters.nkjv: and saw two boats standing by the lake; but the fishermen had gone from them and were washing their nets.
chapters.kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

chapters.ml: ആ പടകുകളിൽ ശിമോന്നുള്ളതായ ഒന്നിൽ അവൻ കയറി “കരയിൽ നിന്നു അല്പം നീക്കേണം” എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ പടകിൽ ഇരുന്നു പുരുഷാരത്തെ ഉപദേശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
chapters.nkjv: Then He got into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. And He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
chapters.kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

chapters.ml: സംസാരിച്ചു തീർന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശിമോനോടു: “ആഴത്തിലേക്കു നീക്കി മീമ്പിടിത്തത്തിന്നു വല ഇറക്കുവിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch."
chapters.nkjv: When He had stopped speaking, He said to Simon, "Launch out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch."
chapters.kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ശിമോൻ: നാഥാ, ഞങ്ങൾ രാത്രി മുഴുവനും അദ്ധ്വാനിച്ചിട്ടും ഒന്നും കിട്ടിയില്ല; എങ്കിലും നിന്റെ വാക്കിന്നു ഞാൻ വല ഇറക്കാം എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Simon answered, "Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets."
chapters.nkjv: But Simon answered and said to Him, "Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless at Your word I will let down the net."
chapters.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

chapters.ml: അവർ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ പെരുത്തു മീൻകൂട്ടം അകപ്പെട്ടു വല കീറാറായി.
chapters.niv: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had done this, they caught a great number of fish, and their net was breaking.
chapters.kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

chapters.ml: അവർ മറ്റെ പടകിലുള്ള കൂട്ടാളികൾ വന്നു സഹായിപ്പാൻ അവരെ മാടിവിളിച്ചു. അവർ വന്നു പടകു രണ്ടും മുങ്ങുമാറാകുവോളും നിറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
chapters.nkjv: So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
chapters.kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ് അതു കണ്ടിട്ടു യേശുവിന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു: കർത്താവേ, ഞാൻ പാപിയായ മനുഷ്യൻ ആകകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ വിട്ടുപോകേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"
chapters.nkjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord!"
chapters.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു ഉണ്ടായ മീമ്പിടിത്തത്തിൽ അവന്നും അവനോടു കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കു എല്ലാവർക്കും സംഭ്രമം പിടിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
chapters.nkjv: For he and all who were with him were astonished at the catch of fish which they had taken;
chapters.kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

chapters.ml: ശിമോന്റെ കൂട്ടാളികളായ യാക്കോബ് യോഹന്നാൻ എന്ന സെബെദിമക്കൾക്കും അവ്വണ്ണം തന്നേ. യേശു ശിമോനോടു: “ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ ഇന്നു മുതൽ നീ മനുഷ്യരെ പിടിക്കുന്നവൻ ആകും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, "Don’t be afraid; from now on you will fish for people."
chapters.nkjv: and so also were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, "Do not be afraid. From now on you will catch men."
chapters.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ പടകുകളെ കരെക്കു അടുപ്പിച്ചിട്ടു സകലവും വിട്ടു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had brought their boats to land, they forsook all and followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ കുഷ്ഠം നിറഞ്ഞോരു മനുഷ്യൻ യേശുവിനെ കണ്ടു കവിണ്ണു വീണു: കർത്താവേ, നിനക്കു മനസ്സുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ എന്നെ ശുദ്ധമാക്കുവാൻ കഴിയും എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."
chapters.nkjv: And it happened when He was in a certain city, that behold, a man who was full of leprosy saw Jesus; and he fell on his face and implored Him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

chapters.ml: യേശു കൈ നീട്ടി അവനെ തൊട്ടു: “എനിക്കു മനസ്സുണ്ടു; ശുദ്ധമാക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഉടനെ കുഷ്ഠം അവനെ വിട്ടു മാറി.
chapters.niv: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" And immediately the leprosy left him.
chapters.nkjv: Then He put out His hand and touched him, saying, "I am willing; be cleansed." Immediately the leprosy left him.
chapters.kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: “ഇതു ആരോടും പറയരുതു; എന്നാൽ പോയി നിന്നെത്തന്നേ പുരോഹിതന്നു കാണിച്ചു, അവർക്കു സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്നായി മോശെ കല്പിച്ചതുപോലെ നിന്റെ ശുദ്ധീകരണത്തിന്നുള്ള വഴിപാടു അർപ്പിക്ക” എന്നു അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus ordered him, "Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them."
chapters.nkjv: And He charged him to tell no one, "But go and show yourself to the priest, and make an offering for your cleansing, as a testimony to them, just as Moses commanded."
chapters.kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള വർത്തമാനം അധികം പരന്നു. വളരെ പുരുഷാരം വചനം കേൾക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും തങ്ങളുടെ വ്യാധികൾക്കു സൌഖ്യം കിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നും കൂടി വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
chapters.nkjv: However, the report went around concerning Him all the more; and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by Him of their infirmities.
chapters.kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

chapters.ml: അവനോ നിർജ്ജനദേശത്തു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
chapters.nkjv: So He Himself often withdrew into the wilderness and prayed.
chapters.kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു ദിവസം ഉപദേശിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഗലീലയിലും യെഹൂദ്യയിലുമുള്ള സകലഗ്രാമത്തിൽനിന്നും യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നും വന്ന പരീശന്മാരും ന്യായശാസ്ത്രിമാരും അവിടെ ഇരുന്നിരുന്നു. സൌഖ്യമാക്കുവാൻ കർത്താവിന്റെ ശക്തി അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One day Jesus was teaching, and Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. They had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal the sick.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened on a certain day, as He was teaching, that there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every town of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judæa, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ചില ആളുകൾ പക്ഷവാതം പിടിച്ച ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ കിടക്കയിൽ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടുവന്നു; അവനെ അകത്തുകൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വെപ്പാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Then behold, men brought on a bed a man who was paralyzed, whom they sought to bring in and lay before Him.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം ഹേതുവായി അവനെ അകത്തു കൊണ്ടുചെല്ലുവാൻ വഴി കാണാഞ്ഞിട്ടു പുരമേൽ കയറി ഓടു നീക്കി അവനെ കിടക്കയോടെ നടുവിൽ യേശുവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഇറക്കിവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they could not find a way to do this because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And when they could not find how they might bring him in, because of the crowd, they went up on the housetop and let him down with his bed through the tiling into the midst before Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ വിശ്വാസം കണ്ടിട്ടു. അവൻ: “മനുഷ്യാ, നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾ മോചിച്ചുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, "Friend, your sins are forgiven."
chapters.nkjv: When He saw their faith, He said to him, "Man, your sins are forgiven you."
chapters.kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

chapters.ml: ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരും: ദൈവദൂഷണം പറയുന്ന ഇവൻ ആർ? ദൈവം ഒരുവൻ അല്ലാതെ പാപങ്ങളെ മോചിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നവൻ ആർ എന്നു ചിന്തിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, "Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
chapters.nkjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, "Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
chapters.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരുടെ ചിന്തകളെ അറിഞ്ഞു അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ ചിന്തിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, "Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?
chapters.nkjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, He answered and said to them, "Why are you reasoning in your hearts?
chapters.kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾ മോചിച്ചുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയുന്നതോ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നടക്ക എന്നു പറയുന്നതോ ഏതാകുന്നു എളുപ്പം” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
chapters.nkjv: Which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Rise up and walk’?
chapters.kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ഭൂമിയിൽ പാപങ്ങളെ മോചിപ്പാൻ മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്നു അധികാരം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു - അവൻ പക്ഷവാതക്കാരനോടു: “എഴുന്നേറ്റു കിടക്ക എടുത്തു വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോക എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins." So he said to the paralyzed man, "I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home."
chapters.nkjv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins"—He said to the man who was paralyzed, "I say to you, arise, take up your bed, and go to your house."
chapters.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവർ കാൺകെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു, താൻ കിടന്ന കിടക്ക എടുത്തു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വീകരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately he rose up before them, took up what he had been lying on, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
chapters.kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും വിസ്മയംപൂണ്ടു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി ഭയം നിറഞ്ഞവരായി: ഇന്നു നാം അപൂർവ്വ കാര്യങ്ങളെ കണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, "We have seen remarkable things today."
chapters.nkjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God and were filled with fear, saying, "We have seen strange things today!"
chapters.kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു, ലേവി എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു ചുങ്കകാരൻ ചുങ്കസ്ഥലത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; “എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക” എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. "Follow me," Jesus said to him,
chapters.nkjv: After these things He went out and saw a tax collector named Levi, sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me."
chapters.kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സകലവും വിട്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.
chapters.nkjv: So he left all, rose up, and followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

chapters.ml: ലേവി തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ അവന്നു ഒരു വലിയ വിരുന്നു ഒരുക്കി; ചുങ്കക്കാരും മറ്റും വലിയോരു പുരുഷാരം അവരോടുകൂടെ പന്തിയിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Levi gave Him a great feast in his own house. And there were a great number of tax collectors and others who sat down with them.
chapters.kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരും അവരുടെ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ചുങ്കക്കാരോടും പാപികളോടും കൂടെ തിന്നുകുടിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു പിറുപിറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"
chapters.nkjv: And their scribes and the Pharisees complained against His disciples, saying, "Why do You eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"
chapters.kjv: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ദീനക്കാർക്കല്ലാതെ സൌഖ്യമുള്ളവർക്കു വൈദ്യനെക്കൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യമില്ല;
chapters.niv: Jesus answered them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നീതിമാന്മാരെ അല്ല പാപികളെ അത്രേ മാനസാന്തരത്തിന്നു വിളിപ്പാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."
chapters.nkjv: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."
chapters.kjv: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: യോഹന്നാന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കൂടക്കൂടെ ഉപവസിച്ചു പ്രാർത്ഥനകഴിച്ചുവരുന്നു; പരീശന്മാരുടെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്യുന്നു; നിന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോ തിന്നുകയും കുടിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They said to him, "John’s disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to Him, "Why do the disciples of John fast often and make prayers, and likewise those of the Pharisees, but Yours eat and drink?"
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “മണവാളൻ തോഴ്മക്കാരോടുകൂടെ ഉള്ളപ്പോൾ അവരെ ഉപവാസം ചെയ്യിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുമോ?
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

chapters.ml: മണവാളൻ അവരെ വിട്ടുപിരിയേണ്ടുന്ന കാലം വരും; അന്നു, ആ കാലത്തു, അവർ ഉപവസിക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast."
chapters.nkjv: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them; then they will fast in those days."
chapters.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ഉപമയും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു: “ആരും കോടിത്തുണിക്കണ്ടം കീറിയെടുത്തു പഴയവസ്ത്രത്തോടു ചേർത്തു തുന്നുമാറില്ല. തുന്നിയാലോ പുതിയതു കീറുകയും പുതിയകണ്ടം പഴയതിനോടു ചേരാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: He told them this parable: "No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one. Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
chapters.nkjv: Then He spoke a parable to them: "No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old one; otherwise the new makes a tear, and also the piece that was taken out of the new does not match the old.
chapters.kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

chapters.ml: ആരും പുതുവീഞ്ഞു പഴയതുരുത്തിയിൽ പകരുമാറില്ല, പകർന്നാൽ പുതുവീഞ്ഞു തുരുത്തിയെ പൊളിച്ചു ഒഴുകിപ്പോകും; തുരുത്തിയും നശിച്ചുപോകും;
chapters.niv: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.
chapters.nkjv: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the wineskins and be spilled, and the wineskins will be ruined.
chapters.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

chapters.ml: പുതുവീഞ്ഞു പുതിയതുരുത്തിയിൽ അത്രേ പകർന്നുവെക്കേണ്ടതു.
chapters.niv: No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.
chapters.nkjv: But new wine must be put into new wineskins, and both are preserved.
chapters.kjv: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പഴയതു കുടിച്ചിട്ടു ആരും പുതിയതു ഉടനെ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നില്ല; പഴയതു ഏറെ നല്ലതു എന്നു പറയും.”
chapters.niv: And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And no one, having drunk old wine,immediately desires new; for he says, ‘The old is better.’ "
chapters.kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ അവൻ വിളഭൂമിയിൽ കൂടി കടന്നുപോകുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കതിർ പറിച്ചു കൈകൊണ്ടു തിരുമ്മിതിന്നു.
chapters.niv: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened on the second Sabbath after the first that He went through the grainfields. And His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate them, rubbing them in their hands.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരിൽ ചിലർ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ വിഹിതമല്ലാത്തതു നിങ്ങൾചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some of the Pharisees asked, "Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"
chapters.nkjv: And some of the Pharisees said to them, "Why are you doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath?"
chapters.kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ദാവീദ് തനിക്കും കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും വിശന്നപ്പോൾ ചെയ്തതു എന്തു? അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു
chapters.niv: Jesus answered them, "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answering them said, "Have you not even read this, what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him:
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

chapters.ml: പുരോഹിതന്മാർ മാത്രമല്ലാതെ ആരും തിന്നരുതാത്ത കാഴ്ചയപ്പം വാങ്ങി തിന്നുകയും കൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കു കൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്തു എന്നുള്ളതു നിങ്ങൾ വായിച്ചിട്ടില്ലയോ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions."
chapters.nkjv: how he went into the house of God, took and ate the showbread, and also gave some to those with him, which is not lawful for any but the priests to eat?"
chapters.kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

chapters.ml: “മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ശബ്ബത്തിന്നും കർത്താവു ആകുന്നു” എന്നും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "The Son of Man is also Lord of the Sabbath."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു ഉപദേശിക്കുമ്പോൾ വലങ്കൈ വറണ്ടുള്ളോരു മനുഷ്യൻ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened on another Sabbath, also, that He entered the synagogue and taught. And a man was there whose right hand was withered.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

chapters.ml: ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരും അവനെ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുവാൻ സംഗതി കിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുമോ എന്നു നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
chapters.nkjv: So the scribes and Pharisees watched Him closely, whether He would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against Him.
chapters.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ വിചാരം അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ വരണ്ട കൈയുള്ള മനുഷ്യനോടു: “എഴുന്നേറ്റു നടുവിൽ നിൽക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, "Get up and stand in front of everyone." So he got up and stood there.
chapters.nkjv: But He knew their thoughts, and said to the man who had the withered hand, "Arise and stand here." And he arose and stood.
chapters.kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിന്നു. യേശു അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ഒന്നു ചോദിക്കട്ടെ: ശബ്ബത്തിൽ നന്മ ചെയ്കയോ തിന്മ ചെയ്കയോ ജീവനെ രക്ഷിക്കയോ നശിപ്പിക്കയോ ഏതു വിഹിതം” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to them, "I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one thing: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it ?

chapters.ml: അവരെ എല്ലാം ചുറ്റും നോക്കീട്ടു ആ മനുഷ്യനോടു: “കൈ നീട്ടുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു”. അവൻ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു, അവന്റെ കൈക്കു സൌഖ്യം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He did so, and his hand was completely restored.
chapters.nkjv: And when He had looked around at them all, He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he did so, and his hand was restored as whole as the other.
chapters.kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

chapters.ml: അവരോ ഭ്രാന്തു നിറഞ്ഞവരായി യേശുവിനെ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു എന്നു തമ്മിൽ ആലോചന കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: But they were filled with rage, and discussed with one another what they might do to Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു അവൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഒരു മലയിൽ ചെന്നു ദൈവത്തോടുള്ള പ്രാർത്ഥനയിൽ രാത്രി കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass in those days that He went out to the mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

chapters.ml: നേരം വെളുത്തപ്പോൾ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ അടുക്കെ വിളിച്ചു, അവരിൽ പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു, അവർക്കു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ എന്നും പേർ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:
chapters.nkjv: And when it was day, He called His disciples to Himself; and from them He chose twelve whom He also named apostles:
chapters.kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

chapters.ml: അവർ ആരെന്നാൽ: പത്രൊസ് എന്നു അവൻ പേർവിളിച്ച ശിമോൻ, അവന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അന്ത്രെയാസ്, യാക്കോബ്, യോഹന്നാൻ, ഫിലിപ്പൊസ്, ബർത്തൊലൊമായി,
chapters.niv: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
chapters.nkjv: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and Andrew his brother; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew;
chapters.kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

chapters.ml: മത്തായി, തോമാസ്, അല്ഫായിയുടെ മകനായ യാക്കോബ്, എരിവുകാരനായ ശിമോൻ,
chapters.niv: Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,
chapters.nkjv: Matthew and Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called the Zealot;
chapters.kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon called Zelotes,

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യൂദാ, ദ്രോഹിയായ്തീർന്ന ഈസ്കായ്യോർത്ത് യൂദാ എന്നിവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
chapters.nkjv: Judas theson of James, and Judas Iscariot who also became a traitor.
chapters.kjv: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു കൂടെ ഇറങ്ങി സമഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു; അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടവും യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ എല്ലാടത്തുനിന്നും യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നും സോർ സീദോൻ എന്ന സമുദ്രതീരങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും അവന്റെ വചനം കേൾപ്പാനും രോഗശാന്തി കിട്ടുവാനും വന്ന ബഹു പുരുഷാരവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He went down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon,
chapters.nkjv: And He came down with them and stood on a level place with a crowd of His disciples and a great multitude of people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and from the seacoast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear Him and be healed of their diseases,
chapters.kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

chapters.ml: അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കൾ ബാധിച്ചവരും സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,
chapters.nkjv: as well as those who were tormented with unclean spirits. And they were healed.
chapters.kjv: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

chapters.ml: ശക്തി അവനിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു എല്ലാവരെയും സൌഖ്യമാക്കുകകൊണ്ടു പുരുഷാരം ഒക്കെയും അവനെ തൊടുവാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.
chapters.nkjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch Him, for power went out from Him and healed them all.
chapters.kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ നോക്കി പറഞ്ഞതു: “ദരിദ്രന്മാരായ നിങ്ങൾ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ, ദൈവരാജ്യം നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: Looking at his disciples, he said: "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
chapters.nkjv: Then He lifted up His eyes toward His disciples, and said: "Blessed are you poor, For yours is the kingdom of God.
chapters.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ വിശക്കുന്നവരായ നിങ്ങൾ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു തൃപ്തിവരും; ഇപ്പോൾകരയുന്നവരായ നിങ്ങൾ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ; നിങ്ങൾ ചിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
chapters.nkjv: Blessed are you who hunger now, For you shall be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, For you shall laugh.
chapters.kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ നിമിത്തം മനുഷ്യർ നിങ്ങളെ ദ്വേഷിച്ചു ഭ്രഷ്ടരാക്കി നിന്ദിച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ പേർ വിടക്കു എന്നു തള്ളുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.
chapters.nkjv: Blessed are you when men hate you, And when they exclude you, And revile you, and cast out your name as evil, For the Son of Man’s sake.
chapters.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company , and shall reproach you , and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.

chapters.ml: ആ നാളിൽ സന്തോഷിച്ചു തുള്ളുവിൻ; നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രതിഫലം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ വലിയതു; അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ പ്രവാചകന്മാരോടു അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their ancestors treated the prophets.
chapters.nkjv: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy! For indeed your reward is great in heaven, For in like manner their fathers did to the prophets.
chapters.kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ സമ്പന്നരായ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങളുടെ ആശ്വാസം നിങ്ങൾക്കു ലഭിച്ചുപോയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.
chapters.nkjv: "But woe to you who are rich, For you have received your consolation.
chapters.kjv: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ തൃപ്തന്മാരായ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾക്കു വിശക്കും. ഇപ്പോൾ ചിരിക്കുന്നവരായ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ ദുഃഖിച്ചു കരയും.
chapters.niv: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will go hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
chapters.nkjv: Woe to you who are full, For you shall hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, For you shall mourn and weep.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

chapters.ml: സകല മനുഷ്യരും നിങ്ങളെ പുകഴത്തിപ്പറയുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ കള്ളപ്രവാചകന്മാരെ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ”.
chapters.niv: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you, for that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.
chapters.nkjv: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, For so did their fathers to the false prophets.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കേൾക്കുന്നവരായ നിങ്ങളോടു ഞാൻ പറയുന്നതു: “നിങ്ങളുടെ ശത്രുക്കളെ സ്നേഹിപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളെ പകെക്കുന്നവർക്കു ഗുണം ചെയ്‍വിൻ.
chapters.niv: "But to you who are listening I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
chapters.nkjv: "But I say to you who hear: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
chapters.kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെ ശപിക്കുന്നവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിപ്പിൻ; നിങ്ങളെ ദുഷിക്കുന്നവർക്കു വേണ്ടി പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
chapters.nkjv: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who spitefully use you.
chapters.kjv: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

chapters.ml: നിന്നെ ഒരു ചെകിട്ടത്തു അടിക്കുന്നവന്നു മറ്റേതും കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്ക; നിന്റെ പുതപ്പു എടുത്തുകളയുന്നവന്നു വസ്ത്രവും തടുക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.
chapters.nkjv: To him who strikes you on the one cheek, offer the other also. And from him who takes away your cloak, do not withhold your tunic either.
chapters.kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.

chapters.ml: നിന്നോടു ചോദിക്കുന്ന ഏവന്നും കൊടുക്ക; നിനക്കുള്ളതു എടുത്തുകളയുന്നവനോടു മടക്കി ചോദിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.
chapters.nkjv: Give to everyone who asks of you. And from him who takes away your goods do not ask them back.
chapters.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യർ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ തന്നേ അവർക്കും ചെയ്‍വിൻ.
chapters.niv: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
chapters.nkjv: And just as you want men to do to you, you also do to them likewise.
chapters.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവരെ സ്നേഹിച്ചാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ഉപചാരം കിട്ടും? പാപികളും തങ്ങളെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവരെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.
chapters.nkjv: "But if you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
chapters.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു നന്മചെയ്യുന്നവർക്കു നന്മ ചെയ്താൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു ഉപചാരം കിട്ടും? പാപികളും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്യുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do that.
chapters.nkjv: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
chapters.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

chapters.ml: മടക്കി വാങ്ങിക്കൊള്ളാം എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ആശിക്കുന്നവർക്കു കടം കൊടുത്താൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എന്തു കിട്ടും? പാപികളും കുറയാതെ മടക്കിവാങ്ങേണ്ടതിന്നു പാപികൾക്കു കടം കൊടുക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.
chapters.nkjv: And if you lend to those from whom you hope to receive back, what credit is that to you? For even sinners lend to sinners to receive as much back.
chapters.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ ശത്രുക്കളെ സ്നേഹിപ്പിൻ; അവർക്കു നന്മ ചെയ്‍വിൻ; ഒന്നും പകരം ഇച്ഛിക്കാതെ കടം കൊടുപ്പിൻ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രതിഫലം വളരെ ആകും; നിങ്ങൾ അത്യുന്നതന്റെ മക്കൾ ആകും; അവൻ നന്ദികെട്ടവരോടും ദുഷ്ടന്മാരോടും ദയാലുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
chapters.nkjv: But love your enemies, do good, and lend, hoping for nothing in return; and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High. For He is kind to the unthankful and evil.
chapters.kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവു മനസ്സലിവുള്ളവൻ ആകുന്നതുപോലെ നിങ്ങളും മനസ്സലിവുള്ളവർ ആകുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore be merciful, just as your Father also is merciful.
chapters.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

chapters.ml: വിധിക്കരുതു; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളെയും വിധിക്കയില്ല; ശിക്ഷെക്കു വിധിക്കരുതു; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കും ശിക്ഷാവിധി ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല; വിടുവിൻ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളെയും വിടുവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: "Judge not, and you shall not be judged. Condemn not, and you shall not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
chapters.kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

chapters.ml: കൊടുപ്പിൻ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കിട്ടും; അമർത്തി കുലുക്കി കവിയുന്നൊരു നല്ല അളവു നിങ്ങളുടെ മടിയിൽ തരും; നിങ്ങൾ അളക്കുന്ന അളവിനാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കും അളന്നു കിട്ടും.
chapters.niv: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you."
chapters.nkjv: Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be put into your bosom. For with the same measure that you use, it will be measured back to you."
chapters.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരുപമയും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു: “കുരുടന്നു കരുടനെ വഴികാട്ടുവാൻ കഴിയുമോ? ഇരുവരും കുഴിയിൽ വീഴുകയില്ലയോ? ശിഷ്യൻ ഗുരുവിന്നു മീതെയല്ല,
chapters.niv: He also told them this parable: "Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?
chapters.nkjv: And He spoke a parable to them: "Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into the ditch?
chapters.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

chapters.ml: അഭ്യാസം തികഞ്ഞവൻ എല്ലാം ഗുരുവിനെപ്പോലെ ആകും.
chapters.niv: The student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.
chapters.nkjv: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is perfectly trained will be like his teacher.
chapters.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ സഹോദരന്റെ കണ്ണിലെ കരടു നോക്കുകയും സ്വന്തകണ്ണിലെ കോൽ വിചാരിക്കാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: "Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?
chapters.nkjv: And why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but do not perceive the plank in your own eye?
chapters.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

chapters.ml: അല്ല, സ്വന്തകണ്ണിലെ കോൽ നോക്കാതെ: സഹോദരാ, നില്ലു; നിന്റെ കണ്ണിലെ കരടു എടുത്തുകളയട്ടെ എന്നു സഹോദരനോടു പറവാൻ നിനക്കു എങ്ങനെ കഴിയും? കപടഭക്തിക്കാരാ, മുമ്പെ സ്വന്തകണ്ണിലെ കോൽ എടുത്തുകളക; എന്നാൽ സഹോദരന്റെ കണ്ണിലെ കരടു എടുത്തുകളവാൻ വെടിപ്പായി കണുമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
chapters.nkjv: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck that is in your eye,’ when you yourself do not see the plank that is in your own eye? Hypocrite! First remove the plank from your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck that is in your brother’s eye.
chapters.kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye.

chapters.ml: ആകാത്തഫലം കായ്കുന്ന നല്ല വൃക്ഷമില്ല; നല്ലഫലം കായ്കുന്ന ആകാത്ത വൃക്ഷവുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
chapters.nkjv: "For a good tree does not bear bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
chapters.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

chapters.ml: ഏതു വൃക്ഷത്തെയും ഫലംകൊണ്ടു അറിയാം. മുള്ളിൽനിന്നു അത്തിപ്പഴം ശേഖരിക്കുകയും ഞെരിഞ്ഞിലിൽ നിന്നു മുന്തിരിങ്ങാ പറിക്കയും ചെയ്യുമാറില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.
chapters.nkjv: For every tree is known by its own fruit. For men do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
chapters.kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

chapters.ml: നല്ലമനുഷ്യൻ തന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിലെ നല്ല നിക്ഷേപത്തിൽ നിന്നു നല്ലതു പുറപ്പെടുവിക്കുന്നു; ദുഷ്ടൻ ദോഷമായതിൽ നിന്നു ദോഷം പുറപ്പെടുവിക്കുന്നു. ഹൃദയത്തിൽ നിറഞ്ഞു കവിയുന്നതല്ലോ വായി പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
chapters.nkjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth evil. For out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
chapters.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ കർത്താവേ, കർത്താവേ എന്നു വിളിക്കയും ഞാൻ പറയുന്നതു ചെയ്യാതിരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: "Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?
chapters.nkjv: "But why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ and not do the things which I say?
chapters.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു എന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടു ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം ഇന്നവനോടു തുല്യൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ കാണിച്ചു തരാം.
chapters.niv: As for everyone who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like.
chapters.nkjv: Whoever comes to Me, and hears My sayings and does them, I will show you whom he is like:
chapters.kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

chapters.ml: ആഴെക്കുഴിച്ചു പാറമേൽ അടിസ്ഥാനം ഇട്ടു വീടു പണിയുന്ന മനുഷ്യനോടു അവൻ തുല്യൻ. വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കം ഉണ്ടായിട്ടു ഒഴുക്കു വീട്ടിനോടു അടിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ അതു നല്ലവണ്ണം പണിതിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അതു ഇളകിപ്പോയില്ല.
chapters.niv: They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
chapters.nkjv: He is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid the foundation on the rock. And when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently against that house, and could not shake it, for it was founded on the rock.
chapters.kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

chapters.ml: കേട്ടിട്ടു ചെയ്യാത്തവനോ അടിസ്ഥാനം കൂടാതെ മണ്ണിന്മേൽ വീടു പണിത മനുഷ്യനോടു തുല്യൻ. ഒഴുക്കു അടിച്ച ഉടനെ അതു വീണു; ആ വീട്ടിന്റെ വീഴ്ച വലിയതുമായിരുന്നു”.
chapters.niv: But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete."
chapters.nkjv: But he who heard and did nothing is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream beat vehemently; and immediately it fell. And the ruin of that house was great."
chapters.kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

chapters.ml: ജനം കേൾക്കെ തന്റെ വചനം ഒക്കെയും പറഞ്ഞുതീർന്ന ശേഷം അവൻ കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus had finished saying all this to the people who were listening, he entered Capernaum.
chapters.nkjv: Now when He concluded all His sayings in the hearing of the people, He entered Capernaum.
chapters.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ഒരു ശതാധിപന്നു പ്രിയനായ ദാസൻ ദീനം പിടിച്ചു മരിപ്പാറായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There a centurion’s servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.
chapters.nkjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and ready to die.
chapters.kjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യേശുവിന്റെ വസ്തുത കേട്ടിട്ടു, അവൻ വന്നു തന്റെ ദാസനെ രക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടിതിന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിപ്പാൻ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ മൂപ്പന്മാരെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.
chapters.nkjv: So when he heard about Jesus, he sent elders of the Jews to Him, pleading with Him to come and heal his servant.
chapters.kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു താല്പര്യമായി അപേക്ഷിച്ചു: നീ അതു ചെയ്തുകൊടുപ്പാൻ അവൻ യോഗ്യൻ;
chapters.niv: When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with him, "This man deserves to have you do this,
chapters.nkjv: And when they came to Jesus, they begged Him earnestly, saying that the one for whom He should do this was deserving,
chapters.kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

chapters.ml: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ ജനത്തെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു പള്ളിയും തീർപ്പിച്ചുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue."
chapters.nkjv: "for he loves our nation, and has built us a synagogue."
chapters.kjv: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടുകൂടെ പോയി, വീട്ടിനോടു അടുപ്പാറായപ്പോൾ ശതാധിപൻ സ്നേഹിതന്മാരെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു: കർത്താവേ, പ്രയാസപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; നി എന്റെ പുരെക്കകത്തു വരുവാൻ ഞാൻ പോരാത്തവൻ.
chapters.niv: So Jesus went with them. He was not far from the house when the centurion sent friends to say to him: "Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I do not deserve to have you come under my roof.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when He was already not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to Him, saying to Him, "Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy that You should enter under my roof.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ ഞാൻ യോഗ്യൻ എന്നു എനിക്കു തോന്നിട്ടില്ല. ഒരു വാക്കു കല്പിച്ചാൽ എന്റെ ബാല്യക്കാരന്നു സൌഖ്യംവരും.
chapters.niv: That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I did not even think myself worthy to come to You. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

chapters.ml: ഞാനും അധികാരത്തിന്നു കീഴ്പെട്ട മനുഷ്യൻ; എന്റെ കീഴിൽ പടയാളികൾ ഉണ്ടു; ഒരുവനോടു പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അവൻ പോകുന്നു; മറ്റൊരുവനോടു വരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അവൻ വരുന്നു; എന്റെ ദാസനോടു: ഇതു ചെയ്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ അവൻ ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and that one, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
chapters.nkjv: For I also am a man placed under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
chapters.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it .

chapters.ml: യേശു അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു അവങ്കൽ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞുനോക്കി, അനുഗമിക്കുന്ന കൂട്ടത്തോടു: “യിസ്രായേലിൽകൂടെ ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള വിശ്വാസം ഞാൻ കണ്ടിട്ടില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following him, he said, "I tell you, I have not found such great faith even in Israel."
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus heard these things, He marveled at him, and turned around and said to the crowd that followed Him, "I say to you, I have not found such great faith, not even in Israel!"
chapters.kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

chapters.ml: ശതാധിപൻ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചിരുന്നവർ വീട്ടിൽ മടങ്ങി വന്നപ്പോൾ ദാസനെ സൌഖ്യത്തോടെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.
chapters.nkjv: And those who were sent, returning to the house, found the servant well who had been sick.
chapters.kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവൻ നയിൻ എന്ന പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു പോകുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരും വളരെ പുരുഷാരവും കൂടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, the day after, that He went into a city called Nain; and many of His disciples went with Him, and a large crowd.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ വാതിലോടു അടുത്തപ്പോൾ മരിച്ചുപോയ ഒരുത്തനെ പുറത്തുകൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു; അവൻ അമ്മക്കു ഏകജാതനായ മകൻ; അവളോ വിധവ ആയിരുന്നു. പട്ടണത്തിലെ ഒരു വലിയ പുരുഷാരവും അവളോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As he approached the town gate, a dead person was being carried out—the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.
chapters.nkjv: And when He came near the gate of the city, behold, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother; and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the city was with her.
chapters.kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

chapters.ml: അവളെ കണ്ടിട്ടു കർത്താവു മനസ്സലിഞ്ഞു അവളോടു: “കരയേണ്ടാ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ അടുത്തു ചെന്നു മഞ്ചം തൊട്ടു ചുമക്കുന്നവർ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Lord saw her, his heart went out to her and he said, "Don’t cry."
chapters.nkjv: When the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said to her, "Do not weep."
chapters.kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

chapters.ml: “ബാല്യക്കാരാ എഴുന്നേൽക്ക എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he went up and touched the bier they were carrying him on, and the bearers stood still. He said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!"
chapters.nkjv: Then He came and touched the open coffin, and those who carried him stood still. And He said, "Young man, I say to you, arise."
chapters.kjv: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഇരുന്നു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ തുടങ്ങി; അവൻ അവനെ അമ്മെക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
chapters.nkjv: So he who was dead sat up and began to speak. And He presented him to his mother.
chapters.kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവർക്കും ഭയംപിടിച്ചു: ഒരു വലിയ പ്രവാചകൻ നമ്മുടെ ഇടയിൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റിരിക്കുന്നു; ദൈവം തന്റെ ജനത്തെ സന്ദർശിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They were all filled with awe and praised God. "A great prophet has appeared among us," they said. "God has come to help his people."
chapters.nkjv: Then fear came upon all, and they glorified God, saying, "A great prophet has risen up among us"; and, "God has visited His people."
chapters.kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

chapters.ml: അവനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ഈ ശ്രുതി യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ ഒക്കെയും ചുറ്റുമുള്ള നാടെങ്ങും പരന്നു.
chapters.niv: This news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding country.
chapters.nkjv: And this report about Him went throughout all Judea and all the surrounding region.
chapters.kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa, and throughout all the region round about.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഒക്കെയും യോഹന്നാന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: John’s disciples told him about all these things. Calling two of them,
chapters.nkjv: Then the disciples of John reported to him concerning all these things.
chapters.kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ യോഹന്നാൻ തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരെ വിളിച്ചു, കർത്താവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു: വരുവാനുള്ളവൻ നീയോ? അല്ല, ഞങ്ങൾ മറ്റൊരുത്തനെ കാത്തിരിക്കേണമോ എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: he sent them to the Lord to ask, "Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?"
chapters.nkjv: And John, calling two of his disciples to him, sent them to Jesus, saying, "Are You the Coming One, or do we look for another?"
chapters.kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

chapters.ml: ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: വരുവാനുള്ളവൻ നീയോ? അല്ല, ഞങ്ങൾ മറ്റൊരുത്തനെ കാത്തിരിക്കേണമോ എന്നു ചോദിപ്പാൻ യോഹന്നാൻസ്നാപകൻ ഞങ്ങളെ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the men came to Jesus, they said, "John the Baptist sent us to you to ask, ‘Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?’ "
chapters.nkjv: When the men had come to Him, they said, "John the Baptist has sent us to You, saying, ‘Are You the Coming One, or do we look for another?’ "
chapters.kjv: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

chapters.ml: ആ നാഴികയിൽ അവൻ വ്യാധികളും ദണ്ഡങ്ങളും ദുരാത്മാക്കളും പിടിച്ച പലരെയും സൌഖ്യമാക്കുകയും പല കുരുടന്മാർക്കു കാഴ്ച നല്കുകയും ചെയ്തിട്ടു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: At that very time Jesus cured many who had diseases, sicknesses and evil spirits, and gave sight to many who were blind.
chapters.nkjv: And that very hour He cured many of infirmities, afflictions, and evil spirits; and to many blind He gave sight.
chapters.kjv: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

chapters.ml: “കുരുടർ കാണുന്നു; മുടന്തർ നടക്കുന്നു; കുഷ്ഠരോഗികൾ ശുദ്ധരായിത്തീരുന്നു; ചെകിടർ കേൾക്കുന്നു; മരിച്ചവർ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കുന്നു; ദിരദ്രന്മാരോടു സുവിശേഷം അറിയിക്കുന്നു എന്നിങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ കാണുകയും കേൾക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നതു യോഹന്നാനെ ചെന്നു അറിയിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: So he replied to the messengers, "Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is proclaimed to the poor.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Go and tell John the things you have seen and heard: that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, the poor have the gospel preached to them.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എങ്കൽ ഇടറിപ്പോകാത്തവൻ ഭാഗ്യവാൻ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Blessed is anyone who does not stumble on account of me."
chapters.nkjv: And blessed is he who is not offended because of Me."
chapters.kjv: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാന്റെ ദൂതന്മാർ പോയശേഷം അവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തോടു യോഹന്നാനെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങിയതു: “നിങ്ങൾ എന്തു കാണ്മാൻ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു പോയി? കാറ്റിനാൽ ഉലയുന്ന ഓടയോ?
chapters.niv: After John’s messengers left, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swayed by the wind?
chapters.nkjv: When the messengers of John had departed, He began to speak to the multitudes concerning John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
chapters.kjv: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

chapters.ml: അല്ല, എന്തു കാണ്മാൻ പോയി? മാർദ്ദവവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ച മനുഷ്യനെയോ? മോടിയുള്ള വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു സുഖഭോഗികളായി നടക്കുന്നവർ രാജധാനികളിൽ അത്രേ.
chapters.niv: If not, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? No, those who wear expensive clothes and indulge in luxury are in palaces.
chapters.nkjv: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft garments? Indeed those who are gorgeously appareled and live in luxury are in kings’ courts.
chapters.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.

chapters.ml: അല്ല, എന്തു കാണ്മാൻ പോയി? ഒരു പ്രവാചകനെയൊ? അതേ, പ്രവാചകനിലും മികച്ചവനെ തന്നേ” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു:
chapters.niv: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
chapters.nkjv: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.
chapters.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദൂതനെ നിനക്കു മുമ്പായി അയക്കുന്നു; അവൻ നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിനക്കു വഴി ഒരുക്കും” എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു അവനെക്കുറിച്ചാകുന്നു”.
chapters.niv: This is the one about whom it is written: " ‘I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.’
chapters.nkjv: This is he of whom it is written: ‘Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, Who will prepare Your way before You.’
