chapters.kjv: This is he , of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീകളിൽ നിന്നു ജനിച്ചവരിൽ യോഹന്നാനെക്കാൾ വലിയവൻ ആരുമില്ല; ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ ഏറ്റവും ചെറിയവനോ അവനിലും വലിയവൻ” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.--
chapters.niv: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."
chapters.nkjv: For I say to you, among those born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist; but he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."
chapters.kjv: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനം ഒക്കെയും ചുങ്കക്കാരും കേട്ടിട്ടു യോഹന്നാന്റെ സ്നാനം ഏറ്റതിനാൽ ദൈവത്തെ നീതീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: (All the people, even the tax collectors, when they heard Jesus’ words, acknowledged that God’s way was right, because they had been baptized by John.
chapters.nkjv: And when all the people heard Him, even the tax collectors justified God, having been baptized with the baptism of John.
chapters.kjv: And all the people that heard him , and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

chapters.ml: “എങ്കിലും പരീശന്മാരും ന്യായശാസ്ത്രിമാരും അവനാൽ സ്നാനം ഏൽക്കാതെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലോചന തങ്ങൾക്കു വൃഥാവാക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു-
chapters.niv: But the Pharisees and the experts in the law rejected God’s purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.)
chapters.nkjv: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the will of God for themselves, not having been baptized by him.
chapters.kjv: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

chapters.ml: ഈ തലമുറയിലെ മനുഷ്യരെ ഏതിനോടു ഉപമിക്കേണ്ടു? അവർ ഏതിനോടു തുല്യം?
chapters.niv: Jesus went on to say, "To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "To what then shall I liken the men of this generation, and what are they like?
chapters.kjv: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കായി കുഴലൂതി, നിങ്ങൾ നൃത്തം ചെയ്തില്ല; ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കായി വിലാപം പാടി, നിങ്ങൾ കരഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നു ചന്തസ്ഥലത്തു ഇരുന്നു അന്യോന്യം വിളിച്ചു പറയുന്ന കുട്ടികളോടു അവർ തുല്യർ.
chapters.niv: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other: " ‘We played the pipe for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not cry.’
chapters.nkjv: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling to one another, saying: ‘We played the flute for you, And you did not dance; We mourned to you, And you did not weep.’
chapters.kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻസ്നാപകൻ അപ്പം തിന്നാതെയും വീഞ്ഞു കുടിക്കാതെയും വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്നു ഭൂതം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
chapters.nkjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
chapters.kjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ തിന്നും കുടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; തിന്നിയും കുടിയനും ആയ മനുഷ്യൻ ചുങ്കക്കാരുടെയും പാപികളുടെയും സ്നേഹിതൻ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’
chapters.nkjv: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look, a glutton and a winebibber, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
chapters.kjv: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

chapters.ml: ജ്ഞാനമോ തന്റെ എല്ലാ മക്കളാലും നീതീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But wisdom is proved right by all her children."
chapters.nkjv: But wisdom is justified by all her children."
chapters.kjv: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ തന്നോടുകൂടെ ഭക്ഷണം കഴിപ്പാൻ അവനെ ക്ഷണിച്ചു; അവൻ പരീശന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, he went to the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And He went to the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to eat.
chapters.kjv: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.

chapters.ml: ആ പട്ടണത്തിൽ പാപിയായ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ, അവൻ പരീശന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു അറിഞ്ഞു ഒരു വെൺകൽഭരണി പരിമളതൈലം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു,
chapters.niv: A woman in that town who lived a sinful life learned that Jesus was eating at the Pharisee’s house, so she came there with an alabaster jar of perfume.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at the table in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster flask of fragrant oil,
chapters.kjv: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

chapters.ml: പുറകിൽ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു നിന്നു കണ്ണിനീർകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ കാൽ നനെച്ചുതുടങ്ങി; തലമുടികൊണ്ടു തുടെച്ചു കാൽ ചുംബിച്ചു തൈലം പൂശി.
chapters.niv: As she stood behind him at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears. Then she wiped them with her hair, kissed them and poured perfume on them.
chapters.nkjv: and stood at His feet behind Him weeping; and she began to wash His feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head; and she kissed His feet and anointed them with the fragrant oil.
chapters.kjv: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ക്ഷണിച്ച പരീശൻ അതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഇവൻ പ്രവാചകൻ ആയിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, തന്നെ തൊടുന്ന സ്ത്രീ ആരെന്നും എങ്ങനെയുള്ളവൾ എന്നും അറിയുമായിരുന്നു; അവൾ പാപിയല്ലോ എന്നു ഉള്ളിൽ പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know who is touching him and what kind of woman she is—that she is a sinner."
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he spoke to himself, saying, "This Man, if He were a prophet, would know who and what manner of woman thisis who is touching Him, for she is a sinner."
chapters.kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it , he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

chapters.ml: “ശിമോനേ, നിന്നോടു ഒന്നു പറവാനുണ്ടു” എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: ഗുരോ, പറഞ്ഞാലും എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered him, "Simon, I have something to tell you." "Tell me, teacher," he said.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus answered and said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." So he said, "Teacher, say it."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

chapters.ml: കടം കൊടുക്കുന്ന ഒരുത്തന്നു രണ്ടു കടക്കാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഒരുത്തൻ അഞ്ഞൂറു വെള്ളിക്കാശും മറ്റവൻ അമ്പതു വെള്ളിക്കാശും കൊടുപ്പാനുണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Two people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
chapters.nkjv: "There was a certain creditor who had two debtors. One owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
chapters.kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

chapters.ml: വീട്ടുവാൻ അവർക്കു വക ഇല്ലായ്കയാൽ അവൻ ഇരുവർക്കും ഇളെച്ചുകൊടുത്തു; എന്നാൽ അവരിൽ ആർ അവനെ അധികം സ്നേഹിക്കും?
chapters.niv: Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"
chapters.nkjv: And when they had nothing with which to repay, he freely forgave them both. Tell Me, therefore, which of them will love him more?"
chapters.kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

chapters.ml: അധികം ഇളെച്ചുകിട്ടിയവൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ ഊഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ശിമോൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അവനോടു: “നീ വിധിച്ചതു ശരി” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Simon replied, "I suppose the one who had the bigger debt forgiven." "You have judged correctly," Jesus said.
chapters.nkjv: Simon answered and said, "I suppose the one whom he forgave more." And He said to him, "You have rightly judged."
chapters.kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രിയുടെ നേരെ തരിഞ്ഞു ശിമോനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഈ സ്ത്രീയെ കാണുന്നുവോ? ഞാൻ നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു, നീ എന്റെ കാലിന്നു വെള്ളം തന്നില്ല; ഇവളോ കണ്ണുനീർകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ കാൽ നനെച്ചു തലമുടികൊണ്ടു തുടെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
chapters.nkjv: Then He turned to the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no water for My feet, but she has washed My feet with her tears and wiped them with the hair of her head.
chapters.kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

chapters.ml: നീ എനിക്കു ചുംബനം തന്നില്ല; ഇവളോ ഞാൻ അകത്തു വന്നതു മുതൽ ഇടവിടാതെ എന്റെ കാൽ ചുംബിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.
chapters.nkjv: You gave Me no kiss, but this woman has not ceased to kiss My feet since the time I came in.
chapters.kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ തലയിൽ തൈലം പൂശിയില്ല; ഇവളോ പരിമള തൈലംകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ കാൽ പൂശി.
chapters.niv: You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.
chapters.nkjv: You did not anoint My head with oil, but this woman has anointed My feet with fragrant oil.
chapters.kjv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇവളുടെ അനേകമായ പാപങ്ങൾ മോചിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു; അവൾ വളരെ സ്നേഹിച്ചുവല്ലോ; അല്പം മോചിച്ചുകിട്ടിയവൻ അല്പം സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു”.
chapters.niv: Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven—as her great love has shown. But whoever has been forgiven little loves little."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I say to you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little."
chapters.kjv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവളോടു: “നിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾ മോചിച്ചു തിന്നിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു കൂടെ പന്തിയിൽ ഇരുന്നവർ: പാപമോചനവും കൊടുക്കുന്ന ഇവൻ ആർ എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: The other guests began to say among themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"
chapters.nkjv: And those who sat at the table with Him began to say to themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"
chapters.kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

chapters.ml: അവനോ സ്ത്രീയോടു: “നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം നിന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."
chapters.kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ ദൈവരാജ്യം പ്രസംഗിച്ചും സുവിശേഷിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു പട്ടണംതോറും സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, afterward, that He went through every city and village, preaching and bringing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God. And the twelve were with Him,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ പന്തിരുവരും അവൻ ദുരാത്മാക്കളെയും വ്യാധികളെയും നീക്കി സൌഖ്യം വരുത്തിയ ചില സ്ത്രീകളും ഏഴു ഭൂതങ്ങൾ വിട്ടുപോയ മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും
chapters.niv: and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;
chapters.nkjv: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities—Mary called Magdalene, out of whom had come seven demons,
chapters.kjv: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവിന്റെ കാര്യവിചാരകനായ കൂസയുടെ ഭാര്യ യോഹന്നയും ശൂശന്നയും തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്തുവകകൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തു പോന്ന മറ്റു പല സ്ത്രികളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Joanna the wife of Chuza, the manager of Herod’s household; Susanna; and many others. These women were helping to support them out of their own means.
chapters.nkjv: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others who provided for Him from their substance.
chapters.kjv: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ വലിയോരു പുരുഷാരവും ഓരോ പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നവരും ഒരുമിച്ചു കൂടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഉപമയായി പറഞ്ഞതു: “വിതെക്കുന്നവൻ വിത്തു വിതെപ്പാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:
chapters.nkjv: And when a great multitude had gathered, and they had come to Him from every city, He spoke by a parable:
chapters.kjv: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

chapters.ml: വിതെക്കുമ്പോൾ ചിലതു വഴിയരികെ വീണിട്ടു ചവിട്ടിപ്പോകയും ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവജാതി അതിനെ തിന്നുകളകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "A farmer went out to sow his seed. As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds ate it up.
chapters.nkjv: "A sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, some fell by the wayside; and it was trampled down, and the birds of the air devoured it.
chapters.kjv: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു പാറമേൽ വീണു മുളെച്ചു നനവില്ലായ്കയാൽ ഉണങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.
chapters.nkjv: Some fell on rock; and as soon as it sprang up, it withered away because it lacked moisture.
chapters.kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു മുള്ളിന്നിടയിൽ വീണു; മുള്ളുംകൂടെ മുളെച്ചു അതിനെ ഞെരുക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.
chapters.nkjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up with it and choked it.
chapters.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലതു നല്ല നിലത്തു വീണു മുളെച്ചു നൂറുമേനി ഫലം കൊടുത്തു. ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു: കേൾപ്പാൻ ചെവി ഉള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ” എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up and yielded a crop, a hundred times more than was sown." When he said this, he called out, "Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear."
chapters.nkjv: But others fell on good ground, sprang up, and yielded a crop a hundredfold." When He had said these things He cried, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"
chapters.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു ഈ ഉപമ എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.
chapters.nkjv: Then His disciples asked Him, saying, "What does this parable mean?"
chapters.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

chapters.ml: “ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിന്റെ മർമ്മങ്ങളെ അറിവാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു വരം ലഭിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ശേഷമുള്ളവർക്കോ കണ്ടിട്ടും കാണാതിരിപ്പാനും, കേട്ടിട്ടും ഗ്രഹിക്കാതിരിപ്പാനും ഉപമകളിലത്രേ.
chapters.niv: He said, "The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, " ‘though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.’
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "To you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘Seeing they may not see, And hearing they may not understand.’
chapters.kjv: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

chapters.ml: ഉപമയുടെ പൊരുളോ: വിത്തു ദൈവവചനം;
chapters.niv: "This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
chapters.nkjv: "Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
chapters.kjv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

chapters.ml: വഴിയരികെയുള്ളവർ കേൾക്കുന്നവർ എങ്കിലും അവർ വിശ്വസിച്ചു രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടാതിരിപ്പാൻ പിശാചു വന്നു അവരുടെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ നിന്നു വചനം എടുത്തുകളയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
chapters.nkjv: Those by the wayside are the ones who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
chapters.kjv: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

chapters.ml: പാറമേലുള്ളവരോ കേൾക്കുമ്പോൾ വചനം സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നവർ എങ്കിലും അവർക്കു വേരില്ല; അവർ തൽക്കാലം വിശ്വസിക്കയും പരീക്ഷാസമയത്തു പിൻവാങ്ങിപ്പോകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those on the rocky ground are the ones who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, but in the time of testing they fall away.
chapters.nkjv: But the ones on the rock are those who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who believe for a while and in time of temptation fall away.
chapters.kjv: They on the rock are they , which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

chapters.ml: മുള്ളിന്നിടയിൽ വീണതോ കേൾക്കുന്നവർ എങ്കിലും പോയി ചിന്തകളാലും ധനത്താലും സംസാരഭോഗങ്ങളാലും ഞെരുങ്ങി പൂർണ്ണമായി ഫലം കൊടുക്കാത്തവരത്രേ.
chapters.niv: The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life’s worries, riches and pleasures, and they do not mature.
chapters.nkjv: Now the ones that fell among thorns are those who, when they have heard, go out and are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.
chapters.kjv: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

chapters.ml: നല്ല മണ്ണിലുള്ളതോ വചനം കേട്ടു ഗുണമുള്ള നല്ല ഹൃദയത്തിൽ സംഗ്രഹിച്ചു ക്ഷമയോടെ ഫലം കൊടുക്കുന്നവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.
chapters.nkjv: But the ones that fell on the good ground are those who, having heard the word with a noble and good heart, keep it and bear fruit with patience.
chapters.kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it , and bring forth fruit with patience.

chapters.ml: വിളക്കു കൊളുത്തീട്ടു ആരും അതിനെ പാത്രംകൊണ്ടു മൂടുകയോ കട്ടിൽക്കീഴെ വെക്കയോ ചെയ്യാതെ അകത്തു വരുന്നവർ വെളിച്ചം കാണേണ്ടതിന്നു തണ്ടിന്മേൽ അത്രേ വെക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: "No one lights a lamp and hides it in a clay jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, they put it on a stand, so that those who come in can see the light.
chapters.nkjv: "No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a vessel or puts it under a bed, but sets it on a lampstand, that those who enter may see the light.
chapters.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

chapters.ml: വെളിപ്പെടാതെ ഗൂഢമായതു ഒന്നുമില്ല; പ്രസിദ്ധമായി വെളിച്ചത്തു വരാതെ മറവായിരിക്കുന്നതും ഒന്നുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.
chapters.nkjv: For nothing is secret that will not be revealed, nor anything hidden that will not be known and come to light.
chapters.kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എങ്ങനെ കേൾക്കുന്നു എന്നു സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ. ഉള്ളവന്നു കിട്ടും; ഇല്ലാത്തവനോടോ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു തോന്നുന്നതും കൂടെ എടുത്തുകളയും.
chapters.niv: Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they think they have will be taken from them."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore take heed how you hear. For whoever has, to him more will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he seems to have will be taken from him."
chapters.kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും
chapters.niv: Now Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.
chapters.nkjv: Then His mother and brothers came to Him, and could not approach Him because of the crowd.
chapters.kjv: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു, പുരുഷാരം നിമിത്തം അവനോടു അടുപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല. നിന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും നിന്നെ കാണ്മാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പുറത്തു നില്ക്കുന്നു എന്നു ചിലർ അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you."
chapters.nkjv: And it was told Him bysome, who said, "Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, desiring to see You."
chapters.kjv: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു അവൻ: “എന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും ദൈവ വചനം കേട്ടു ചെയ്യുന്നവരത്രേ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "My mother and brothers are those who hear God’s word and put it into practice."
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said to them, "My mother and My brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it."
chapters.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദിവസം അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുമായി പടകിൽ കയറി; “നാം തടാകത്തിന്റെ അക്കരെ പോക” എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: One day Jesus said to his disciples, "Let us go over to the other side of the lake." So they got into a boat and set out.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, on a certain day, that He got into a boat with His disciples. And He said to them, "Let us cross over to the other side of the lake." And they launched out.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

chapters.ml: അവർ നീക്കി ഓടുമ്പോൾ അവൻ ഉറങ്ങിപ്പോയി
chapters.niv: As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.
chapters.nkjv: But as they sailed He fell asleep. And a windstorm came down on the lake, and they were filling withwater, and were in jeopardy.
chapters.kjv: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy.

chapters.ml: തടാകത്തിൽ ഒരു ചുഴലിക്കാറ്റു ഉണ്ടായി പടകിൽ വെള്ളം നിറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവർ പ്രാണഭയത്തിലായി അടുക്കെ ചെന്നു: നാഥാ, നാഥാ, ഞങ്ങൾ നശിച്ചുപോകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ ഉണർത്തി; അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു കാറ്റിനെയും വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ കോപത്തെയും ശാസിച്ചു; അവ അമർന്നു ശാന്തത ഉണ്ടായി. പിന്നെ അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we’re going to drown!" He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.
chapters.nkjv: And they came to Him and awoke Him, saying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" Then He arose and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water. And they ceased, and there was a calm.
chapters.kjv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങളുടെ വിശ്വാസം എവിടെ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവരോ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു: ഇവൻ ആർ? അവൻ കാറ്റിനോടും വെള്ളത്തോടും കല്പിക്കയും അവ അനുസരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: "Where is your faith?" he asked his disciples. In fear and amazement they asked one another, "Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him."
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "Where is your faith?" And they were afraid, and marveled, saying to one another, "Who can this be? For He commands even the winds and water, and they obey Him!"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഗലീലക്കു നേരെയുള്ള ഗെരസേന്യദേശത്തു അണഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.
chapters.nkjv: Then they sailed to the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
chapters.kjv: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കരെക്കു ഇറങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ ബഹുകാലമായി ഭൂതങ്ങൾ ബാധിച്ചോരു മനുഷ്യൻ പട്ടണത്തിൽ നിന്നു വന്നു എതിർപെട്ടു; അവൻ ബഹുകാലമായി വസ്ത്രം ധരിക്കാതെയും വീട്ടിൽ പാർക്കാതെയും ശവക്കല്ലറകളിൽ അത്രേ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothes or lived in a house, but had lived in the tombs.
chapters.nkjv: And when He stepped out on the land, there met Him a certain man from the city who had demons for a long time. And he wore no clothes, nor did he live in a house but in the tombs.
chapters.kjv: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യേശുവിനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു നിലവിളിച്ചു അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു: യേശുവേ, മഹോന്നതനായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുത്രാ, എനിക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? എന്നെ ഉപദ്രവിക്കരുതേ എന്നു ഞാൻ അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉറക്കെ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell at his feet, shouting at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torture me!"
chapters.nkjv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, fell down before Him, and with a loud voice said, "What have I to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!"
chapters.kjv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനോടു ആ മനുഷ്യനെ വിട്ടുപോകുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചിരുന്നു. അതു വളരെ കാലമായി അവനെ ബാധിച്ചിരുന്നു; അവനെ ചങ്ങലയും വിലങ്ങും ഇട്ടു ബന്ധിച്ചു സൂക്ഷിച്ചിരുന്നിട്ടും അവൻ ബന്ധനങ്ങളെ തകർക്കയും ഭൂതം അവനെ കാടുകളിലേക്കു ഓടിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: For Jesus had commanded the impure spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was chained hand and foot and kept under guard, he had broken his chains and had been driven by the demon into solitary places.
chapters.nkjv: For He had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For it had often seized him, and he was kept under guard, bound with chains and shackles; and he broke the bonds and was driven by the demon into the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “നിന്റെ പേർ എന്തു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അനേകം ഭൂതങ്ങൾ അവനെ ബാധിച്ചിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു; ലെഗ്യോൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" "Legion," he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus asked him, saying, "What is your name?" And he said, "Legion," because many demons had entered him.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

chapters.ml: പാതാളത്തിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ കല്പിക്കരുതു എന്നു അവ അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And they begged Jesus repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.
chapters.nkjv: And they begged Him that He would not command them to go out into the abyss.
chapters.kjv: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ മലയിൽ വലിയൊരു പന്നിക്കൂട്ടം മേഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു. അവയിൽ കടപ്പാൻ അനുവാദം തരേണം എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അവൻ അനുവാദം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. The demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and he gave them permission.
chapters.nkjv: Now a herd of many swine was feeding there on the mountain. So they begged Him that He would permit them to enter them. And He permitted them.
chapters.kjv: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

chapters.ml: ഭൂതങ്ങൾ ആ മനുഷ്യനെ വിട്ടു പന്നികളിൽ കടന്നപ്പോൾ കൂട്ടം കടുന്തൂക്കത്തൂടെ തടാകഞ്ഞിലേക്കു പാഞ്ഞു വീർപ്പുമുട്ടി ചത്തു.
chapters.niv: When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
chapters.nkjv: Then the demons went out of the man and entered the swine, and the herd ran violently down the steep place into the lake and drowned.
chapters.kjv: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

chapters.ml: ഈ സംഭവിച്ചതു മേയക്കുന്നവർ കണ്ടിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോയി പട്ടണത്തിലും നാട്ടിലും അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside,
chapters.nkjv: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
chapters.kjv: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

chapters.ml: സംഭവിച്ചതു കാണ്മാൻ അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു, ഭൂതങ്ങൾ വിട്ടുപോയ മനുഷ്യൻ വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചും സുബോധം പൂണ്ടും യേശുവിന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: and the people went out to see what had happened. When they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
chapters.nkjv: Then they went out to see what had happened, and came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.
chapters.kjv: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

chapters.ml: ഭൂതഗ്രസ്തന്നു സൌഖ്യം വന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു കണ്ടവർ അവരോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.
chapters.nkjv: They also who had seen it told them by what means he who had been demon-possessed was healed.
chapters.kjv: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

chapters.ml: ഗെരസേന്യദേശത്തിലെ ജനസമൂഹം എല്ലാം ഭയപരവശരായി തങ്ങളെ വിട്ടുപോകേണം എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ പടകുകയറി മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them, because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.
chapters.nkjv: Then the whole multitude of the surrounding region of the Gadarenes asked Him to depart from them, for they were seized with great fear. And He got into the boat and returned.
chapters.kjv: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

chapters.ml: ഭൂതങ്ങൾ വിട്ടുപോയ ആൾ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഇരിപ്പാൻ അനുവാദം ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The man from whom the demons had gone out begged to go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
chapters.nkjv: Now the man from whom the demons had departed begged Him that he might be with Him. But Jesus sent him away, saying,
chapters.kjv: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “നീ വീട്ടിൽ മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു ദൈവം നിനക്കു ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും അറിയിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ അയച്ചു. അവൻ പോയി യേശു തനിക്കു ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും പട്ടണത്തിൽ എല്ലാടവും അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Return home and tell how much God has done for you." So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.
chapters.nkjv: "Return to your own house, and tell what great things God has done for you." And he went his way and proclaimed throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
chapters.kjv: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

chapters.ml: യേശു മടങ്ങിവന്നപ്പോൾ പുരുഷാരം അവനെ സന്തോഷത്തോടെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും അവന്നായിട്ടു കാത്തിരിക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now when Jesus returned, a crowd welcomed him, for they were all expecting him.
chapters.nkjv: So it was, when Jesus returned, that the multitude welcomed Him, for they were all waiting for Him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പള്ളിപ്രമാണിയായ യായീറൊസ് എന്നുപേരുള്ളോരു മനുഷ്യൻ വന്നു യേശുവിന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു.
chapters.niv: Then a man named Jairus, a synagogue leader, came and fell at Jesus’ feet, pleading with him to come to his house
chapters.nkjv: And behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. And he fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged Him to come to his house,
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus’ feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

chapters.ml: അവന്നു ഏകദേശം പന്ത്രണ്ടു വയസ്സുള്ള ഏകജാതയായോരു മകൾ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൾ മരിപ്പാറായതു കൊണ്ടു തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വരേണം എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അവൻ പോകുമ്പോൾ പുരുഷാരം അവനെ തിക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying. As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.
chapters.nkjv: for he had an only daughter about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as He went, the multitudes thronged Him.
chapters.kjv: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

chapters.ml: അന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടു സംവത്സരമായി രക്തസ്രവമുള്ളവളും മുതൽ എല്ലാം വൈദ്യന്മാർക്കു കൊടുത്തിട്ടും ആരാലും സൌഖ്യം വരുത്തുവാൻ കഴിയാത്തവളുമായോരു സ്ത്രീ
chapters.niv: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years, but no one could heal her.
chapters.nkjv: Now a woman, having a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her livelihood on physicians and could not be healed by any,
chapters.kjv: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

chapters.ml: പുറകിൽ അടുത്തു ചെന്നു അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രത്തിന്റെ തൊങ്ങൽ തൊട്ടു ഉടനെ അവളുടെ രക്തസ്രവം നിന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.
chapters.nkjv: came from behind and touched the border of His garment. And immediately her flow of blood stopped.
chapters.kjv: Came behind him , and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

chapters.ml: “എന്നെ തൊട്ടതു ആർ ” എന്നു യേശു ചോദിച്ചു. എല്ലാവരും ഞാനല്ല, ഞാനല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ: ഗുരോ, പുരുഷാരം നിന്നെ തിക്കിത്തിരക്കുന്നു എന്നു പത്രൊസും കൂടെയുള്ളവരും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Who touched me?" Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, "Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you."
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said, "Who touched Me?" When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, "Master, the multitudes throng and press You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’ "
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee , and sayest thou, Who touched me?

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ: “ഒരാൾ എന്നെ തൊട്ടു; എങ്കൽനിന്നു ശക്തി പുറപ്പെട്ടതു ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus said, "Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said, "Somebody touched Me, for I perceived power going out from Me."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

chapters.ml: താൻ മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നില്ല എന്നു സ്ത്രീകണ്ടു വിറെച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു വന്നു അവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വീണു, അവനെ തൊട്ട സംഗതിയും തൽക്ഷണം സൌഖ്യമായതും സകലജനവും കേൾക്കെ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the woman, seeing that she could not go unnoticed, came trembling and fell at his feet. In the presence of all the people, she told why she had touched him and how she had been instantly healed.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before Him, she declared to Him in the presence of all the people the reason she had touched Him and how she was healed immediately.
chapters.kjv: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവളോടു: “മകളേ, നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം നിന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to her, "Daughter, be of good cheer; your faith has made you well. Go in peace."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ പള്ളിപ്രമാണിയുടെ ഒരാൾ വന്നു: നിന്റെ മകൾ മരിച്ചുപോയി; ഗുരുവിനെ പ്രയാസപ്പെടുത്തേണ്ടാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. "Your daughter is dead," he said. "Don’t bother the teacher anymore."
chapters.nkjv: While He was still speaking, someone came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, "Your daughter is dead. Do not trouble the Teacher."
chapters.kjv: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house , saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

chapters.ml: യേശു അതുകേട്ടാറെ: “ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ, വിശ്വസിക്കമാത്രം ചെയ്ക; എന്നാൽ അവൾ രക്ഷപ്പെടും” എന്നു അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, "Don’t be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed."
chapters.nkjv: But when Jesus heard it, He answered him, saying, "Do not be afraid; only believe, and she will be made well."
chapters.kjv: But when Jesus heard it , he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

chapters.ml: വീട്ടിൽ എത്തിയാറെ പത്രൊസ്, യോഹന്നാൻ, യാക്കോബ് എന്നവരെയും ബാലയുടെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും അല്ലാതെ ആരെയും അവൻ തന്നോടുകൂടെ അകത്തു വരുവാൻ സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child’s father and mother.
chapters.nkjv: When He came into the house, He permitted no one to go in except Peter, James, and John, and the father and mother of the girl.
chapters.kjv: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും അവളെച്ചൊല്ലി കരകയും മുറയിടുകയും ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ: “കരയേണ്ടാ, അവൾ മരിച്ചില്ല, ഉറങ്ങുന്നത്രേ” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, all the people were wailing and mourning for her. "Stop wailing," Jesus said. "She is not dead but asleep."
chapters.nkjv: Now all wept and mourned for her; but He said, "Do not weep; she is not dead, but sleeping."
chapters.kjv: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

chapters.ml: അവരോ അവൾ മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു അറികകൊണ്ടു അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.
chapters.nkjv: And they ridiculed Him, knowing that she was dead.
chapters.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ അവളുടെ കൈക്കു പിടിച്ചു; “ബാലേ, എഴുന്നേൽക്ക” എന്നു അവളോടു ഉറക്കെ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he took her by the hand and said, "My child, get up!"
chapters.nkjv: But He put them all outside, took her by the hand and called, saying, "Little girl, arise."
chapters.kjv: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ ആത്മാവു മടങ്ങിവന്നു, അവൾ ഉടനെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു; അവൾക്കു ഭക്ഷണം കൊടുപ്പാൻ അവൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Her spirit returned, and at once she stood up. Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
chapters.nkjv: Then her spirit returned, and she arose immediately. And He commanded that she be given something to eat.
chapters.kjv: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാർ വിസ്മയിച്ചു. “സംഭവിച്ചതു ആരോടും പറയരുതു” എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Her parents were astonished, but he ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
chapters.nkjv: And her parents were astonished, but He charged them to tell no one what had happened.
chapters.kjv: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പന്തിരുവരെ അടുക്കൽ വിളിച്ചു, സകല ഭൂതങ്ങളുടെമേലും വ്യാധികളെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുവാനും അവർക്കു ശക്തിയും അധികാരവും കൊടുത്തു;
chapters.niv: When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,
chapters.nkjv: Then He called His twelve disciples together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
chapters.kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

chapters.ml: ദൈവരാജ്യം പ്രസംഗിപ്പാനും രോഗികൾക്കു സൌഖ്യം വരുത്തുവാനും അവരെ അയച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
chapters.nkjv: He sent them to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
chapters.kjv: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

chapters.ml: വഴിക്കു വടിയും പൊക്കണവും അപ്പവും പണവും ഒന്നും എടുക്കരുതു; രണ്ടു ഉടുപ്പും അരുതു.
chapters.niv: He told them: "Take nothing for the journey—no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra shirt.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Take nothing for the journey, neither staffs nor bag nor bread nor money; and do not have two tunics apiece.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഏതു വീട്ടിൽ എങ്കിലും ചെന്നാൽ അവിടം വിട്ടുപോകുംവരെ അവിടെത്തന്നെ പാർപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that town.
chapters.nkjv: "Whatever house you enter, stay there, and from there depart.
chapters.kjv: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളെ കൈക്കൊള്ളാതിരുന്നാൽ ആ പട്ടണം വിട്ടു അവരുടെ നേരെ സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്നായി നിങ്ങളുടെ കാലിൽനിന്നു പൊടി തട്ടിക്കളവിൻ.
chapters.niv: If people do not welcome you, leave their town and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them."
chapters.nkjv: And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet as a testimony against them."
chapters.kjv: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

chapters.ml: അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു എങ്ങും സുവിശേഷിച്ചും രോഗികളെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കിയും കൊണ്ടു ഊർതോറും സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So they set out and went from village to village, proclaiming the good news and healing people everywhere.
chapters.nkjv: So they departed and went through the towns, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.
chapters.kjv: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

chapters.ml: സംഭവിക്കുന്നതു എല്ലാം ഇടപ്രഭുവായ ഹെരോദാവു കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was going on. And he was perplexed because some were saying that John had been raised from the dead,
chapters.nkjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by Him; and he was perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
chapters.kjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു എന്നു ചിലരും ഏലീയാവു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി എന്നു ചിലരും പുരാതനപ്രവാചകന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു എന്നു മറ്റുചിലരും പറക കൊണ്ടു ഹെരോദാവു ചഞ്ചലിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.
chapters.nkjv: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
chapters.kjv: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാനെ ഞാൻ ശിരഃഛേദം ചെയ്തു; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ളതു കേൾക്കുന്ന ഇവൻ ആർ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ കാണ്മാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Herod said, "I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?" And he tried to see him.
chapters.nkjv: Herod said, "John I have beheaded, but who is this of whom I hear such things?" So he sought to see Him.
chapters.kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ മടങ്ങിവന്നിട്ടു തങ്ങൾ ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു. അവൻ അവരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു ബേത്ത്സയിദ എന്ന പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു തനിച്ചു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,
chapters.nkjv: And the apostles, when they had returned, told Him all that they had done. Then He took them and went aside privately into a deserted place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
chapters.kjv: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

chapters.ml: അതു പുരുഷാരം അറിഞ്ഞു അവനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു. അവൻ അവരെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അവരോടു സംസാരിക്കയും രോഗശാന്തി വേണ്ടിയവരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: but the crowds learned about it and followed him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed healing.
chapters.nkjv: But when the multitudes knew it, they followed Him; and He received them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who had need of healing.
chapters.kjv: And the people, when they knew it , followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

chapters.ml: പകൽ കഴിവാറായപ്പോൾ പന്തിരുവർ അടുത്തുവന്നു അവനോടു: ഇവിടെ നാം മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ആയിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു പുരുഷാരം ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ഊരുകളിലും കുടികളിലും പോയി രാത്രി പാർപ്പാനും ആഹാരം വാങ്ങുവാനും വേണ്ടി അവരെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Late in the afternoon the Twelve came to him and said, "Send the crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside and find food and lodging, because we are in a remote place here."
chapters.nkjv: When the day began to wear away, the twelve came and said to Him, "Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding towns and country, and lodge and get provisions; for we are in a deserted place here."
chapters.kjv: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ അവർക്കു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കൊടുപ്പിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: അഞ്ചപ്പവും രണ്ടുമീനും അല്ലാതെ അധികം ഞങ്ങളുടെ പക്കൽ ഇല്ല; ഞങ്ങൾ പോയി ഈ സകലജനത്തിന്നും വേണ്ടി ഭോജ്യങ്ങൾ കൊള്ളേണമോ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "You give them something to eat." They answered, "We have only five loaves of bread and two fish—unless we go and buy food for all this crowd."
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "You give them something to eat." And they said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we go and buy food for all these people."
chapters.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

chapters.ml: ഏകദേശം അയ്യായിരം പുരുഷന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. പിന്നെ അവർ തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: “അവരെ അമ്പതു വീതം പന്തിപന്തിയായി ഇരുത്തുവിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: (About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, "Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each."
chapters.nkjv: For there were about five thousand men. Then He said to His disciples, "Make them sit down in groups of fifty."
chapters.kjv: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

chapters.ml: അവർ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു എല്ലാവരെയും ഇരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: The disciples did so, and everyone sat down.
chapters.nkjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
chapters.kjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ അഞ്ചു അപ്പവും രണ്ടു മീനും എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തേക്കു നോക്കി അവയെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു നുറുക്കി പുരുഷാരത്തിന്നു വിളമ്പുവാൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke them. Then he gave them to the disciples to distribute to the people.
chapters.nkjv: Then He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.
chapters.kjv: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും തിന്നു തൃപ്തരായി, ശേഷിച്ച കഷണം പന്ത്രണ്ടു കൊട്ട എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
chapters.nkjv: So they all ate and were filled, and twelve baskets of the leftover fragments were taken up by them.
chapters.kjv: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തനിച്ചു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൻ അവരോടു: “പുരുഷാരം എന്നെ ആരെന്നു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, "Who do the crowds say I am?"
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, as He was alone praying, that His disciples joined Him, and He asked them, saying, "Who do the crowds say that I am?"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻസ്നാപകൻ എന്നും ചിലർ ഏലീയാവു എന്നും മറ്റു ചിലർ പുരാതന പ്രവാചകന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു എന്നും പറയുന്നു എന്നു അവർ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life."
chapters.nkjv: So they answered and said, "John the Baptist, but some say Elijah; and others say that one of the old prophets has risen again."
chapters.kjv: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say , Elias; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ആരെന്നു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു പത്രൊസ് ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?" Peter answered, "God’s Messiah."
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered and said, "The Christ of God."
chapters.kjv: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

chapters.ml: “ഇതു ആരോടും പറയരുതെന്നു” അവൻ അവരോടു അമർച്ചയായിട്ടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
chapters.nkjv: And He strictly warned and commanded them to tell this to no one,
chapters.kjv: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

chapters.ml: “മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ പലതും സഹിക്കയും മൂപ്പന്മാർ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ ശാസ്ത്രികൾ എന്നിവർ അവനെ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു കൊല്ലുകയും അവൻ മൂന്നാം നാൾ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കയും വേണം” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he said, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day."
chapters.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എല്ലാവരോടും പറഞ്ഞതു: “എന്നെ അനുഗമിപ്പാൻ ഒരുത്തൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചാൽ അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ നിഷേധിച്ചു നാൾതോറും തന്റെ ക്രൂശ് എടുത്തുംകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Then he said to them all: "Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them all, "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me.
chapters.kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും തന്റെ ജീവനെ രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചാൽ അതിനെ കളയും; എന്റെ നിമിത്തം ആരെങ്കിലും തന്റെ ജീവനെ കളഞ്ഞാലോ അതിനെ രക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will save it.
chapters.nkjv: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
chapters.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

chapters.ml: ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ സർവ്വലോകവും നേടീട്ടു തന്നെത്താൻ നഷ്ടമാക്കിക്കളകയോ ചേതം വരുത്തുകയോ ചെയ്താൻ അവന്നു എന്തു പ്രയോജനം?
chapters.niv: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, and yet lose or forfeit their very self?
chapters.nkjv: For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and is himself destroyed or lost?
chapters.kjv: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും എന്നെയും എന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെയും കുറിച്ചു നാണിച്ചാൽ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ തന്റെയും പിതാവിന്റെയും വിശുദ്ധദൂതന്മാരുടെയും മഹത്വത്തിൽ വരുമ്പോൾ നാണിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whoever is ashamed of me and my words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
chapters.nkjv: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, of him the Son of Man will be ashamed when He comes in His own glory, and in His Father’s, and of the holy angels.
chapters.kjv: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവരാജ്യം കാണുവോളം മരണം ആസ്വദിക്കാത്തവർ ചിലർ ഇവിടെ നിൽക്കുന്നവരിൽ ഉണ്ടു സത്യം” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: But I tell you truly, there are some standing here who shall not taste death till they see the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കുകളെ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഏകദേശം എട്ടുനാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവൻ പത്രൊസിനെയും യോഹന്നാനെയും യാക്കോബിനെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പാൻ മലയിൽ കയറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, about eight days after these sayings, that He took Peter, John, and James and went up on the mountain to pray.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുമ്പോൾ മുഖത്തിന്റെ ഭാവം മാറി, ഉടുപ്പു മിന്നുന്ന വെള്ളയായും തിർന്നു.
chapters.niv: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.
chapters.nkjv: As He prayed, the appearance of His face was altered, and His robe became white and glistening.
chapters.kjv: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു പുരുഷന്മാർ അവനോടു സംഭാഷിച്ചു; മോശെയും ഏലീയാവും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, two men talked with Him, who were Moses and Elijah,
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

chapters.ml: അവർ തേജസ്സിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷരായി അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പ്രാപിപ്പാനുള്ള നിര്യാണത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: who appeared in glory and spoke of His decease which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസും കൂടെയുള്ളവരും ഉറക്കത്താൽ ഭാരപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു; ഉണർന്നശേഷം അവന്റെ തേജസ്സിനെയും അവനോടു കൂടെ നില്ക്കുന്ന രണ്ടു പുരുഷന്മാരെയും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.
chapters.nkjv: But Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep; and when they were fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men who stood with Him.
chapters.kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ വിട്ടുപിരിയുമ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് യേശുവിനോടു: ഗുരോ, നാം ഇവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു നല്ലതു; ഞങ്ങൾ മൂന്നു കുടിൽ ഉണ്ടാക്കട്ടെ, ഒന്നു നിനക്കും ഒന്നു മോശെക്കും ഒന്നു ഏലീയാവിന്നും എന്നു താൻ പറയുന്നതു ഇന്നതു എന്നു അറിയാതെ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah." (He did not know what he was saying.)
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, as they were parting from Him, that Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"—not knowing what he said.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറയുമ്പോൾ ഒരു മേഘം വന്നു അവരുടെമേൽ നിഴലിട്ടു. അവർ മേഘത്തിൽ ആയപ്പോൾ പേടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and covered them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
chapters.nkjv: While he was saying this, a cloud came and overshadowed them; and they were fearful as they entered the cloud.
chapters.kjv: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

chapters.ml: മേഘത്തിൽനിന്നു: ഇവൻ എന്റെ പ്രിയപുത്രൻ, ഇവന്നു ചെവികൊടുപ്പിൻ എന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: A voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him."
chapters.nkjv: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!"
chapters.kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

chapters.ml: ശബ്ദം ഉണ്ടായ നേരത്തു യേശുവിനെ തനിയേ കണ്ടു; അവർ കണ്ടതു ഒന്നും ആ നാളുകളിൽ ആരോടും അറിയിക്കാതെ മൌനമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves and did not tell anyone at that time what they had seen.
chapters.nkjv: When the voice had ceased, Jesus was found alone. But they kept quiet, and told no one in those days any of the things they had seen.
chapters.kjv: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവർ മലയിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങി വന്നപ്പോൾ ബഹുപുരുഷാരം അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, that a great multitude met Him.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

chapters.ml: കൂട്ടത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരാൾ നിലവിളിച്ചു: ഗുരോ, എന്റെ മകനെ കടാക്ഷിക്കേണമെന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ എനിക്കു ഏകജാതൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A man in the crowd called out, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.
chapters.nkjv: Suddenly a man from the multitude cried out, saying, "Teacher, I implore You, look on my son, for he is my only child.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

chapters.ml: ഒരാത്മാവു അവനെ പിടിച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ പൊടുന്നനവേ നിലവിളിക്കുന്നു; അതു അവനെ നുരെപ്പിച്ചു പിടെപ്പിക്കുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവനെ ഞെരിച്ചിട്ടു പ്രയാസത്തോടെ വിട്ടുമാറുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams; it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It scarcely ever leaves him and is destroying him.
chapters.nkjv: And behold, a spirit seizes him, and he suddenly cries out; it convulses him so that he foams atthemouth; and it departs from him with great difficulty, bruising him.
chapters.kjv: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

chapters.ml: അതിനെ പുറത്താക്കുവാൻ നിന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു എങ്കിലും അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not."
chapters.nkjv: So I implored Your disciples to cast it out, but they could not."
chapters.kjv: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “അവിശ്വാസവും കോട്ടവുമുള്ള തലമുറയേ, എത്രത്തോളം ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു നിങ്ങളെ സഹിക്കും? നിന്റെ മകനെ ഇവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവരിക” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: "You unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you and put up with you? Bring your son here."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus answered and said, "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വരുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ ഭൂതം അവനെ തള്ളിയിട്ടു പിടെപ്പിച്ചു. യേശു അശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനെ ശാസിച്ചു ബാലനെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി, അപ്പനെ ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Even while the boy was coming, the demon threw him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the impure spirit, healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
chapters.nkjv: And as he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him. Then Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the child, and gave him back to his father.
chapters.kjv: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മഹിമയിങ്കൽ വിസ്മയിച്ചു. യേശു ചെയ്യുന്നതിൽ ഒക്കെയും എല്ലാവരും ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ അവൻ തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു:
chapters.niv: And they were all amazed at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
chapters.nkjv: And they were all amazed at the majesty of God. But while everyone marveled at all the things which Jesus did, He said to His disciples,
chapters.kjv: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,

chapters.ml: “നിങ്ങൾ ഈ വാക്കു ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചു കേട്ടുകൊൾവിൻ: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മനുഷ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കപ്പെടുവാൻ പോകുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men."
chapters.nkjv: "Let these words sink down into your ears, for the Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men."
chapters.kjv: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

chapters.ml: ആ വാക്കു അവർ ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല; അതു തിരിച്ചറിയാതവണ്ണം അവർക്കു മറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു; ആ വാക്കു സംബന്ധിച്ചു അവനോടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ അവർ ശങ്കിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.
chapters.nkjv: But they did not understand this saying, and it was hidden from them so that they did not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask Him about this saying.
chapters.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽവെച്ചു ആർ വലിയവൻ എന്നു ഒരു വാദം അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
chapters.nkjv: Then a dispute arose among them as to which of them would be greatest.
chapters.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരുടെ ഹൃദയവിചാരം കണ്ടു ഒരു ശിശുവിനെ എടുത്തു അരികെ നിറുത്തി:
chapters.niv: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a little child and set him by Him,
chapters.kjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

chapters.ml: “ഈ ശിശുവിനെ എന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും കൈക്കൊണ്ടാൽ എന്നെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നു; എന്നെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നവനോ എന്നെ അയച്ചവനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നു; നിങ്ങളെല്ലാവരിലും ചെറിയവനായവൻ അത്രേ വലിയവൻ ആകും” എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to them, "Whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For it is the one who is least among you all who is the greatest."
chapters.nkjv: and said to them, "Whoever receives this little child in My name receives Me; and whoever receives Me receives Him who sent Me. For he who is least among you all will be great."
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

chapters.ml: നാഥാ, ഒരുത്തൻ നിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നതു ഞങ്ങൾ കണ്ടു; ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ നിന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കായ്കയാൽ അവനെ വിരോധിച്ചു എന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു യേശു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: "Master," said John, "we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us."
chapters.nkjv: Now John answered and said, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we forbade him because he does not follow with us."
chapters.kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

chapters.ml: വിരോധിക്കരുതു; നിങ്ങൾക്കു പ്രതികൂലമല്ലാത്തവൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അനുകൂലമല്ലോ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Do not stop him," Jesus said, "for whoever is not against you is for you."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said to him, "Do not forbid him, for he who is not against us is on our side."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ആരോഹണത്തിന്നുള്ള കാലം തികയാറായപ്പോൾ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു യാത്രയാവാൻ മനസ്സു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു തനിക്കു മുമ്പായി ദൂതന്മാരെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, when the time had come for Him to be received up, that He steadfastly set His face to go to Jerusalem,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

chapters.ml: അവർ പോയി അവന്നായി വട്ടംകൂട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു ശമര്യക്കാരുടെ ഒരു ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;
chapters.nkjv: and sent messengers before His face. And as they went, they entered a village of the Samaritans, to prepare for Him.
chapters.kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചിരിക്കയാൽ അവർ അവനെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: But they did not receive Him, because His face was set for the journey to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അതു അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരായ യാക്കോബും യോഹന്നാനും കണ്ടിട്ടു: കർത്താവേ, (ഏലിയാവു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ) ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു തീ ഇറങ്ങി അവരെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നതു നിനക്കു സമ്മതമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, "Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them ?"
chapters.nkjv: And when His disciples James and John saw this, they said, "Lord, do You want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them, just as Elijah did?"
chapters.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this , they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

chapters.ml: അവൻ തിരിഞ്ഞു അവരെ ശാസിച്ചു: (“നിങ്ങൾ ഏതു ആത്മാവിന്നു അധീനർ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ല;
chapters.niv: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.
chapters.nkjv: But He turned and rebuked them, and said, "You do not know what manner of spirit you are of.
chapters.kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യ പുത്രൻ മനുഷ്യരുടെ പ്രാണങ്ങളെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാനല്ല രക്ഷിപ്പാനത്രേ വന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.) അവർ വേറൊരു ഗ്രാമത്തിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then he and his disciples went to another village.
chapters.nkjv: For the Son of Man did not come to destroy men’s lives but to save them." And they went to another village.
chapters.kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them . And they went to another village.

chapters.ml: അവർ വഴിപോകുമ്പോൾ ഒരുത്തൻ അവനോടു: നീ എവിടെപോയാലും ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, "I will follow you wherever you go."
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened as they journeyed on the road, that someone said to Him, "Lord, I will follow You wherever You go."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “കുറുനരികൾക്കു കുഴിയും ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവജാതിക്കു കൂടും ഉണ്ടു; മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്നോ തല ചായിപ്പാൻ സ്ഥലമില്ല ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head."
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said to him, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

chapters.ml: വേറൊരുത്തനോടു: “എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാറെ അവൻ: ഞാൻ മുമ്പെ പോയി എന്റെ അപ്പനെ കുഴിച്ചിടുവാൻ അനുവാദം തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to another man, "Follow me." But he replied, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to another, "Follow Me." But he said, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: “മരിച്ചവർ തങ്ങളുടെ മരിച്ചവരെ കുഴിച്ചിടട്ടെ; നീയോ പോയി ദൈവരാജ്യം അറിയിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and preach the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ: കർത്താവേ, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കാം; ആദ്യം എന്റെ വീട്ടിലുള്ളവരോടു യാത്ര പറവാൻ അനുവാദം തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Still another said, "I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say goodbye to my family."
chapters.nkjv: And another also said, "Lord, I will follow You, but let me first go and bid them farewell who are at my house."
chapters.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “കലപ്പെക്കു കൈ വെച്ച ശേഷം പുറകോട്ടു നോക്കുന്നവൻ ആരും ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിന്നു കൊള്ളാകുന്നവനല്ല ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said to him, "No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം കർത്താവു വേറെ എഴുപതു പേരെ നിയമിച്ചു, താൻ ചെല്ലുവാനുള്ള ഓരോ പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കും സ്ഥലത്തിലേക്കും അവരെ തനിക്കു മുമ്പായി ഈരണ്ടായി അയച്ചു, അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.
chapters.nkjv: After these things the Lord appointed seventy others also, and sent them two by two before His face into every city and place where He Himself was about to go.
chapters.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

chapters.ml: കൊയ്ത്തു വളരെ ഉണ്ടു സത്യം; വേലക്കാരോ ചുരുക്കം; ആകയാൽ കൊയ്ത്തിന്റെ യജമാനനോടു തന്റെ കൊയ്ത്തിന്നു വേലക്കാരെ അയക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അപേക്ഷിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: He told them, "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "The harvest truly is great, but the laborers are few; therefore pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.
chapters.kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

chapters.ml: പോകുവിൻ; ചെന്നായ്ക്കളുടെ നടുവിൽ കുഞ്ഞാടുകളെപ്പോലെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ അയക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.
chapters.nkjv: Go your way; behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
chapters.kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

chapters.ml: സഞ്ചിയും പൊക്കണവും ചെരിപ്പും എടുക്കരുതു; വഴിയിൽ വെച്ചു ആരെയും വന്ദനം ചെയ്കയുമരുതു;
chapters.niv: Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.
chapters.nkjv: Carry neither money bag, knapsack, nor sandals; and greet no one along the road.
chapters.kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

chapters.ml: ഏതു വീട്ടിൽ എങ്കിലും ചെന്നാൽ: ഈ വീട്ടിന്നു സമാധാനം എന്നു ആദ്യം പറവിൻ
chapters.niv: "When you enter a house, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’
chapters.nkjv: But whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’
chapters.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ ഒരു സമാധാനപുത്രൻ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ സമാധാനം അവന്മേൽ വസിക്കും; ഇല്ലെന്നുവരികിലോ നിങ്ങളിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോരും.
chapters.niv: If someone who promotes peace is there, your peace will rest on them; if not, it will return to you.
chapters.nkjv: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on it; if not, it will return to you.
chapters.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
