chapters.ml: അവർ തരുന്നതു തിന്നും കുടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു ആ വീട്ടിൽ തന്നേ പാർപ്പിൻ; വേലക്കാരൻ തന്റെ കൂലിക്കു യോഗ്യനല്ലോ; വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു വീട്ടിലേക്കു മാറിപ്പോകരുതു.
chapters.niv: Stay there, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.
chapters.nkjv: And remain in the same house, eating and drinking such things as they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Do not go from house to house.
chapters.kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

chapters.ml: ഏതു പട്ടണത്തിലെങ്കിലും ചെന്നാൽ അവർ നിങ്ങളെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ വെക്കുന്നതു ഭക്ഷിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: "When you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is offered to you.
chapters.nkjv: Whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you.
chapters.kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

chapters.ml: അതിലെ രോഗികളെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കി, ദൈവരാജ്യം നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമീപിച്ചുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’
chapters.nkjv: And heal the sick there, and say to them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’
chapters.kjv: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

chapters.ml: ഏതു പട്ടണത്തിലെങ്കിലും ചെന്നാൽ അവർ നിങ്ങളെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ അതിന്റെ തെരുക്കളിൽ പോയി:
chapters.niv: But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,
chapters.nkjv: But whatever city you enter, and they do not receive you, go out into its streets and say,
chapters.kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ പട്ടണത്തിൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങളുടെ കാലിന്നു പറ്റിയ പൊടിയും ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കുടഞ്ഞേച്ചുപോകുന്നു; എന്നാൽ ദൈവരാജ്യം സമീപിച്ചുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു. എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: ‘Even the dust of your town we wipe from our feet as a warning to you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God has come near.’
chapters.nkjv: ‘The very dust of your city which clings to us we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God has come near you.’
chapters.kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

chapters.ml: ആ പട്ടണത്തെക്കാൾ സൊദോമ്യർക്കു ആ നാളിൽ സഹിക്കാവതാകും” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.
chapters.nkjv: But I say to you that it will be more tolerable in that Day for Sodom than for that city.
chapters.kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

chapters.ml: കോരസീനേ, നിനക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം! ബേത്ത്സയിദേ, നിനക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം! നിങ്ങളിൽ നടന്ന വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികൾ സോരിലും സീദോനിലും നടന്നിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവർ പണ്ടുതന്നേ രട്ടിലും വെണ്ണീറിലും ഇരുന്നു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ന്യായവിധിയിൽ നിങ്ങളെക്കാൾ സോരിന്നും സീദോന്നും സഹിക്കാവതാകും.
chapters.niv: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
chapters.nkjv: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
chapters.kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

chapters.ml: നീയോ കഫർന്നഹൂമേ, സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തോളം ഉയർന്നിരിക്കുമോ? നീ പാതാളത്തോളം താണുപോകും.
chapters.niv: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades.
chapters.nkjv: And you, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
chapters.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കുന്നവൻ എന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളെ തള്ളുന്നവൻ എന്നെ തള്ളുന്നു; എന്നെ തള്ളുന്നവൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചവനെ തള്ളുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Whoever listens to you listens to me; whoever rejects you rejects me; but whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me."
chapters.nkjv: He who hears you hears Me, he who rejects you rejects Me, and he who rejects Me rejects Him who sent Me."
chapters.kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

chapters.ml: ആ എഴുപതുപേർ സന്തോഷത്തേടെ മടങ്ങിവന്നു: കർത്താവേ, നിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ ഭൂതങ്ങളും ഞങ്ങൾക്കു കീഴടങ്ങുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, "Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name."
chapters.nkjv: Then the seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in Your name."
chapters.kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “സാത്താൻ മിന്നൽപോലെ ആകാശത്തു നിന്നു വീഴുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

chapters.ml: പാമ്പുകളെയും തേളുകളെയും ശത്രുവിന്റെ സകല ബലത്തെയും ചവിട്ടുവാൻ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അധികാരം തരുന്നു; ഒന്നും നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരിക്കലും ദോഷം വരുത്തുകയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, I give you the authority to trample on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ഭൂതങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കീഴടങ്ങുന്നതിലല്ല. നിങ്ങളുടെ പേർ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതിലത്രേ സന്തോഷിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rather rejoice because your names are written in heaven."
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

chapters.ml: ആ നാഴികയിൽ അവൻ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിൽ ആനന്ദിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: “പിതാവേ, സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്നും ഭൂമിക്കും കർത്താവായുള്ളോവേ, നീ ഇവ ജ്ഞാനികൾക്കും വിവേകികൾക്കും മറെച്ചു ശിശുക്കൾക്കു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിയതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വാഴ്ത്തുന്നു. അതേ, പിതാവേ, ഇങ്ങനെ നിനക്കു പ്രസാദം തോന്നിയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: At that time Jesus, full of joy through the Holy Spirit, said, "I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.
chapters.nkjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in the Spirit and said, "I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and revealed them to babes. Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in Your sight.
chapters.kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിതാവു സകലവും എങ്കൽ ഭരമേല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. പുത്രൻ ഇന്നവൻ എന്നു പിതാവല്ലാതെ ആരും അറിയുന്നില്ല; പിതാവു ഇന്നവൻ എന്നു പുത്രനും പുത്രൻ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിക്കൊടുപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നവനും അല്ലാതെ ആരും അറിയുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: "All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."
chapters.nkjv: All things have been delivered to Me by My Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and the one to whom the Son wills to reveal Him."
chapters.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ നേരെ തിരിഞ്ഞു: “നിങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നതിനെ കാണുന്ന കണ്ണു ഭാഗ്യമുള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
chapters.nkjv: Then He turned to His disciples and said privately, "Blessed are the eyes which see the things you see;
chapters.kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നതിനെ കാണ്മാൻ ഏറിയ പ്രവാചകന്മാരും രാജാക്കന്മാരും ഇച്ഛിച്ചിട്ടും കണ്ടില്ല; നിങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കുന്നതിനെ കേൾപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചിട്ടും കേട്ടില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പ്രത്യേകം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it."
chapters.nkjv: for I tell you that many prophets and kings have desired to see what you see, and have not seen it, and to hear what you hear, and have not heard it."
chapters.kjv: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them ; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഒരു ന്യായശാസ്ത്രി എഴുന്നേറ്റു: ഗുരോ, ഞാൻ നിത്യജീവന്നു അവകാശി ആയിത്തീരുവാൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു അവനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. "Teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
chapters.nkjv: And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested Him, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
chapters.kjv: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: “ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ എന്തു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ എങ്ങനെ വായിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവൻ:
chapters.niv: "What is written in the Law?" he replied. "How do you read it?"
chapters.nkjv: He said to him, "What is written in the law? What is your reading of it?"
chapters.kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവിനെ നീ പൂർണ്ണഹൃദയത്തോടും പൂർണ്ണാത്മാവോടും പൂർണ്ണശക്തിയോടും പൂർണ്ണമനസ്സോടും കൂടെ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം എന്നും കൂട്ടുകാരനെ നിന്നെപ്പോലെതന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം എന്നും തന്നെ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He answered, " ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ ; and, ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ "
chapters.nkjv: So he answered and said, " ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind,’ and ‘your neighbor as yourself.’ "
chapters.kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: “നീ പറഞ്ഞ ഉത്തരം ശരി; അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്ക; എന്നാൽ നീ ജീവിക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You have answered correctly," Jesus replied. "Do this and you will live."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to him, "You have answered rightly; do this and you will live."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ നീതീകരിപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചിട്ടു യേശുവിനോടു: എന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരൻ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യേശു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
chapters.nkjv: But he, wanting to justify himself, said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
chapters.kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

chapters.ml: ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നു യെരീഹോവിലേക്കു പോകുമ്പോൾ കള്ളന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ അകപ്പെട്ടു; അവർ അവനെ വസ്ത്രം അഴിച്ചു മുറിവേല്പിച്ചു അർദ്ധപ്രാണനായി വിട്ടേച്ചു പോയി.
chapters.niv: In reply Jesus said: "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he was attacked by robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him and went away, leaving him half dead.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus answered and said: "A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, who stripped him of his clothing, wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him , and departed, leaving him half dead.

chapters.ml: ആ വഴിയായി യദൃച്ഛയാ ഒരു പുരോഹിതൻ വന്നു അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു മാറി കടന്നു പോയി.
chapters.niv: A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.
chapters.nkjv: Now by chance a certain priest came down that road. And when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
chapters.kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ഒരു ലേവ്യനും ആ സ്ഥലത്തിൽ എത്തി അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു മാറി കടന്നുപോയി.
chapters.niv: So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
chapters.nkjv: Likewise a Levite, when he arrived at the place, came and looked, and passed by on the other side.
chapters.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ശമര്യക്കാരനോ വഴിപോകയിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തി അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു മനസ്സലിഞ്ഞു അരികെ ചെന്നു
chapters.niv: But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.
chapters.nkjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was. And when he saw him, he had compassion.
chapters.kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him ,

chapters.ml: എണ്ണയും വീഞ്ഞും പകർന്നു അവന്റെ മുറിവുകളെ കെട്ടി അവനെ തന്റെ വാഹനത്തിൽ കയറ്റി വഴിയമ്പലത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി രക്ഷചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, brought him to an inn and took care of him.
chapters.nkjv: So he went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine; and he set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
chapters.kjv: And went to him , and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവൻ പുറപ്പെടുമ്പോൾ രണ്ടു വെള്ളിക്കാശ് എടുത്തു വഴിയമ്പലക്കാരന്നു കൊടുത്തു: ഇവനെ രക്ഷ ചെയ്യേണം; അധികം വല്ലതും ചെലവിട്ടാൽ ഞാൻ മടങ്ങിവരുമ്പോൾ തന്നു കൊള്ളാം എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Look after him,’ he said, ‘and when I return, I will reimburse you for any extra expense you may have.’
chapters.nkjv: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the innkeeper, and said to him, ‘Take care of him; and whatever more you spend, when I come again, I will repay you.’
chapters.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

chapters.ml: കള്ളന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ അകപ്പെട്ടവന്നു ഈ മൂവരിൽ ഏവൻ കൂട്ടുകാരനായിത്തീർന്നു എന്നു നിനക്കു തോന്നുന്നു?
chapters.niv: "Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?"
chapters.nkjv: So which of these three do you think was neighbor to him who fell among the thieves?"
chapters.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

chapters.ml: അവനോടു കരുണ കാണിച്ചവൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു. യേശു അവനോടു “നീയും പോയി അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ ചെയ്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "He who showed mercy on him." Then Jesus said to him, "Go and do likewise."
chapters.kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ യാത്രപോകയിൽ അവൻ ഒരു ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ എത്തി; മാർത്താ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു സ്ത്രീ അവനെ വീട്ടിൽ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha opened her home to him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened as they went that He entered a certain village; and a certain woman named Martha welcomed Him into her house.
chapters.kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

chapters.ml: അവൾക്കു മറിയ എന്ന ഒരു സഹോദരി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവൾ കർത്താവിന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ ഇരുന്നു അവന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what he said.
chapters.nkjv: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard His word.
chapters.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.

chapters.ml: മാർത്തയോ വളരെ ശുശ്രൂഷയാൽ കുഴങ്ങീട്ടു അടുക്കെവന്നു: കർത്താവേ, എന്റെ സഹോദരി ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കു എന്നെ തനിച്ചു വിട്ടിരിക്കുന്നതിൽ നിനക്കു വിചാരമില്ലയോ? എന്നെ സഹായിപ്പാൻ അവളോടു കല്പിച്ചാലും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations that had to be made. She came to him and asked, "Lord, don’t you care that my sister has left me to do the work by myself? Tell her to help me!"
chapters.nkjv: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she approached Him and said, "Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Therefore tell her to help me."
chapters.kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു അവളോടു: “മാർത്തയേ, മാർത്തയേ, നീ പലതിനെച്ചൊല്ലി വിചാരപ്പെട്ടും മനം കലങ്ങിയുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Martha, Martha," the Lord answered, "you are worried and upset about many things,
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus answered and said to her, "Martha, Martha, you are worried and troubled about many things.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അല്പമേ വേണ്ടു; അല്ല, ഒന്നു മതി. മറിയ നല്ല അംശം തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു ആരും അവളോടു അപഹരിക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: but few things are needed—or indeed only one. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her."
chapters.nkjv: But one thing is needed, and Mary has chosen that good part, which will not be taken away from her."
chapters.kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒരു സ്ഥലത്തു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; തീർന്നശേഷം ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, യോഹന്നാൻ തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ പഠിപ്പിച്ചതുപോലെ ഞങ്ങളെയും പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പാൻ പഠിപ്പിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, as He was praying in a certain place, when He ceased, that one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples."
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “നിങ്ങൾ പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുമ്പോൾ ചൊല്ലേണ്ടിയതു: (സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ ഞങ്ങളുടെ) പിതാവേ, നിന്റെ നാമം വിശുദ്ധീകരിക്കപ്പെടേണമേ; നിന്റെ രാജ്യം വരേണമേ; (നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെപ്പോലെ ഭൂമിയിലും ആകേണമേ;)
chapters.niv: He said to them, "When you pray, say: " ‘Father, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come.
chapters.nkjv: So He said to them, "When you pray, say: Our Father in heaven, Hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done On earth as it is in heaven.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ആവശ്യമുള്ള ആഹാരം ദിനംപ്രതി തരേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Give us each day our daily bread.
chapters.nkjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
chapters.kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പാപങ്ങളെ ഞങ്ങളോടു ക്ഷമിക്കേണമേ; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു കടംപെട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന ഏവനോടും ഞങ്ങളും ക്ഷമിക്കുന്നു; ഞങ്ങളെ പരീക്ഷയിൽ കടത്തരുതേ: (ദുഷ്ടങ്കൽനിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ വിടുവിക്കേണമേ.)
chapters.niv: Forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation. ’ "
chapters.nkjv: And forgive us our sins, For we also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And do not lead us into temptation, But deliver us from the evil one."
chapters.kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “നിങ്ങളിൽ ആർക്കെങ്കിലും ഒരു സ്നേഹതിൻ ഉണ്ടു എന്നിരിക്കട്ടെ; അവൻ അർദ്ധരാത്രിക്കു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: സ്നേഹിതാ, എനിക്കു മൂന്നപ്പം വായ്പ തരേണം;
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to them, "Suppose you have a friend, and you go to him at midnight and say, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread;
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Which of you shall have a friend, and go to him at midnight and say to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves;
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ഒരു സ്നേഹിതൻ വഴിയാത്രയിൽ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അവന്നു വിളമ്പിക്കൊടുപ്പാൻ എന്റെ പക്കൽ ഏതും ഇല്ല എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞാൽ:
chapters.niv: a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have no food to offer him.’
chapters.nkjv: for a friend of mine has come to me on his journey, and I have nothing to set before him’;
chapters.kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

chapters.ml: എന്നെ പ്രയാസപ്പെടുത്തരുതു; കതകു അടെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; പൈതങ്ങളും എന്നോടുകൂടെ കിടക്കുന്നു; എഴുന്നേറ്റു തരുവാൻ എനിക്കു കഴികയില്ല എന്നു അകത്തുനിന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞാലും
chapters.niv: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is already locked, and my children and I are in bed. I can’t get up and give you anything.’
chapters.nkjv: and he will answer from within and say, ‘Do not trouble me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give to you’?
chapters.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സ്നേഹിതാനാകകൊണ്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവന്നു കൊടുക്കയില്ലെങ്കിലും അവൻ ലജ്ജകൂടാതെ മുട്ടിക്കനിമിത്തം എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവന്നു വേണ്ടുന്നെടത്തോളം കൊടുക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I tell you, even though he will not get up and give you the bread because of friendship, yet because of your shameless audacity he will surely get up and give you as much as you need.
chapters.nkjv: I say to you, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence he will rise and give him as many as he needs.
chapters.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

chapters.ml: യാചിപ്പിൻ, എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കിട്ടും; അന്വേഷിപ്പിൻ, എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ കണ്ടെത്തും; മുട്ടുവിൻ എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തുറക്കും.
chapters.niv: "So I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.
chapters.nkjv: "So I say to you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
chapters.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

chapters.ml: യാചിക്കുന്നവന്നു ഏവന്നും ലഭിക്കുന്നു; അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവൻ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നു; മുട്ടുന്നവന്നു തുറക്കും” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.
chapters.nkjv: For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened.
chapters.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒരു അപ്പനോടു മകൻ അപ്പം ചോദിച്ചാൽ അവന്നു കല്ലു കൊടുക്കുമോ? അല്ല, മീൻ ചോദിച്ചാൽ മീനിന്നു പകരം പാമ്പിനെ കൊടുക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: "Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
chapters.nkjv: If a son asks for bread from any father among you, will he give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will he give him a serpent instead of a fish?
chapters.kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

chapters.ml: മുട്ട ചോദിച്ചാൽ തേളിനെ കൊടുക്കുമോ?
chapters.niv: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
chapters.nkjv: Or if he asks for an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
chapters.kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ദോഷികളായ നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾക്കു നല്ല ദാനങ്ങളെ കൊടുപ്പാൻ അറിയുന്നു എങ്കിൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ പിതാവു തന്നോടു യാചിക്കുന്നവർക്കു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനെ എത്ര അധികം കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!"
chapters.nkjv: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!"
chapters.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

chapters.ml: ഒരിക്കൽ അവൻ ഊമയായോരു ഭൂതത്തെ പുറത്താക്കി. ഭൂതം വിട്ടുപോയശേഷം ഊമൻ സംസാരിച്ചു, പുരുഷാരം ആശ്ചര്യപെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon left, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowd was amazed.
chapters.nkjv: And He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. So it was, when the demon had gone out, that the mute spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
chapters.kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ചിലരോ: ഭൂതങ്ങളുടെ തലവനായ ബെയെത്സെബൂലെക്കൊണ്ടാകുന്നു അവൻ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But some of them said, "By Beelzebul, the prince of demons, he is driving out demons."
chapters.nkjv: But some of them said, "He casts out demons by Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons."
chapters.kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

chapters.ml: വേറെ ചിലർ അവനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു ഒരടയാളം അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Others, testing Him, sought from Him a sign from heaven.
chapters.kjv: And others, tempting him , sought of him a sign from heaven.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ വിചാരം അറിഞ്ഞു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “തന്നിൽതന്നേ ഛിദ്രിച്ച രാജ്യം എല്ലാം പാഴായ്പോകും; വീടു ഓരോന്നും വീഴും.
chapters.niv: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them: "Any kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and a house divided against itself will fall.
chapters.nkjv: But He, knowing their thoughts, said to them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and a house divided against a house falls.
chapters.kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

chapters.ml: സാത്താനും തന്നോടു തന്നേ ഛിദ്രിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ, അവന്റെ രാജ്യം എങ്ങനെ നിലനില്ക്കും? ബെയെത്സെബൂലെക്കൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? I say this because you claim that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
chapters.nkjv: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? Because you say I cast out demons by Beelzebub.
chapters.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ബെയെത്സെബൂലെക്കൊണ്ടു ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾ ആരെക്കൊണ്ടു പുറത്താക്കുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ന്യായാധിപതികൾ ആകും.
chapters.niv: Now if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your followers drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
chapters.nkjv: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
chapters.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ശക്തികൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ ഭൂതങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ദൈവരാജ്യം നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു സ്പഷ്ടം.
chapters.niv: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
chapters.nkjv: But if I cast out demons with the finger of God, surely the kingdom of God has come upon you.
chapters.kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

chapters.ml: ബലവാൻ ആയുധം ധരിച്ചു തന്റെ അരമന കാക്കുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ വസ്തുവക ഉറപ്പോടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.
chapters.nkjv: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own palace, his goods are in peace.
chapters.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

chapters.ml: അവനിലും ബലവാനായവൻ വന്നു അവനെ ജയിച്ചു എങ്കിലോ അവൻ ആശ്രയിച്ചിരുന്ന സർവ്വായുധവർഗ്ഗം പിടിച്ചുപറിച്ചു അവന്റെ കൊള്ള പകുതി ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and divides up his plunder.
chapters.nkjv: But when a stronger than he comes upon him and overcomes him, he takes from him all his armor in which he trusted, and divides his spoils.
chapters.kjv: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു അനുകൂലമല്ലാത്തവൻ എനിക്കു പ്രതികൂലം ആകുന്നു; എന്നോടുകൂടെ ചേർക്കാത്തവൻ ചിതറിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
chapters.nkjv: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
chapters.kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

chapters.ml: അശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ വിട്ടുപോയിട്ടു നീരില്ലാത്ത പ്രദേശങ്ങളിൽ തണുപ്പു തിരഞ്ഞുനടക്കുന്നു. കാണാഞ്ഞിട്ടു: ഞാൻ വിട്ടുപോന്ന വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെല്ലും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ചെന്നു,
chapters.niv: "When an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’
chapters.nkjv: "When an unclean spirit goes out of a man, he goes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’
chapters.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

chapters.ml: അതു അടിച്ചുവാരിയും അലങ്കരിച്ചും കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.
chapters.nkjv: And when he comes, he finds it swept and put in order.
chapters.kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ പോയി തന്നിലും ദുഷ്ടത ഏറിയ ഏഴു ആത്മാക്കളെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു വരുന്നു; അവയും അതിൽ കടന്നു പാർത്തിട്ടു ആ മനുഷ്യന്റെ പിന്നത്തെ സ്ഥിതി മുമ്പിലത്തേതിനേക്കാൾ വല്ലാതെയായി ഭവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then it goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first."
chapters.nkjv: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter and dwell there; and the last state of that man is worse than the first."
chapters.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറയുമ്പോൾ പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ ഉച്ചത്തിൽ അവനോടു: നിന്നെ ചുമന്ന ഉദരവും നീ കുടിച്ച മുലയും ഭാഗ്യമുള്ളവ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd called out, "Blessed is the mother who gave you birth and nursed you."
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, as He spoke these things, that a certain woman from the crowd raised her voice and said to Him, "Blessed is the womb that bore You, and the breasts which nursed You!"
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ:“അല്ല, ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടു പ്രമാണിക്കുന്നവർ അത്രേ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it."
chapters.nkjv: But He said, "More than that, blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it!"
chapters.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം തിങ്ങിക്കൂടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങിയതു: “ഈ തലമുറ ദോഷമുള്ള തലമുറയാകുന്നു; അതു അടയാളം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; യോനയുടെ അടയാളമല്ലാതെ അതിന്നു ഒരു അടയാളവും കൊടുക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: As the crowds increased, Jesus said, "This is a wicked generation. It asks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
chapters.nkjv: And while the crowds were thickly gathered together, He began to say, "This is an evil generation. It seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
chapters.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

chapters.ml: യോനാ നീനെവേക്കാർക്കു അടയാളം ആയതു പോലെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ഈ തലമുറെക്കും ആകും.
chapters.niv: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.
chapters.nkjv: For as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so also the Son of Man will be to this generation.
chapters.kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

chapters.ml: തെക്കെ രാജ്ഞി ന്യായവിധിയിൽ ഈ തലമുറയിലെ ആളുകളോടു ഒന്നിച്ചു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരെ കുറ്റം വിധിക്കും; അവൾ ശലോമോന്റെ ജ്ഞാനം കേൾപ്പാൻ ഭൂമിയുടെ അറുതികളിൽനിന്നു വന്നുവല്ലോ. ഇവിടെ ഇതാ, ശലോമോനിലും വലിയവൻ.
chapters.niv: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the people of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon’s wisdom; and now something greater than Solomon is here.
chapters.nkjv: The queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and indeed a greater than Solomon is here.
chapters.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

chapters.ml: നീനെവേക്കാർ ന്യായവിധിയിൽ ഈ തലമുറയോടു ഒന്നിച്ചു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അതിനെ കുറ്റം വിധിക്കും; അവർ യോനയുടെ പ്രസംഗം കേട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടുവല്ലോ. ഇവിടെ ഇതാ, യോനയിലും വലിയവൻ.
chapters.niv: The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and now something greater than Jonah is here.
chapters.nkjv: The men of Nineveh will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and indeed a greater than Jonah is here.
chapters.kjv: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

chapters.ml: വിളക്കു കൊളുത്തീട്ടു ആരും നിലവറയിലോ പറയിൻ കീഴിലോ വെക്കാതെ അകത്തു വരുന്നവർ വെളിച്ചം കാണേണ്ടതിന്നു തണ്ടിന്മേൽ അത്രേ വെക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: "No one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light.
chapters.nkjv: "No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a secret place or under a basket, but on a lampstand, that those who come in may see the light.
chapters.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

chapters.ml: ശരീരത്തിന്റെ വിളക്കു കണ്ണാകുന്നു; കണ്ണു ചൊവ്വുള്ളതെങ്കിൽ ശരീരം മുഴുവനും പ്രകാശിതമായിരിക്കും; ദോഷമുള്ളതാകിലോ ശരീരവും ഇരുട്ടുള്ളതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are healthy, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are unhealthy, your body also is full of darkness.
chapters.nkjv: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore, when your eye is good, your whole body also is full of light. But when your eye is bad, your body also is full of darkness.
chapters.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിന്നിലുള്ള വെളിച്ചം ഇരുളാകാതിരിപ്പാൻ നോക്കുക.
chapters.niv: See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore take heed that the light which is in you is not darkness.
chapters.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ശരീരം അന്ധകാരമുള്ള അംശം ഒട്ടുമില്ലാതെ മുഴുവനും പ്രകാശിതമായിരുന്നാൽ വിളക്കു തെളക്കംകൊണ്ടു നിന്നെ പ്രകാശിപ്പിക്കുംപോലെ അശേഷം പ്രകാശിതമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, and no part of it dark, it will be just as full of light as when a lamp shines its light on you."
chapters.nkjv: If then your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, the whole body will be full of light, as when the bright shining of a lamp gives you light."
chapters.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ ഒരു പരീശൻ തന്നോടുകൂടെ മുത്താഴം കഴിപ്പാൻ അവനെ ക്ഷണിച്ചു; അവനും അകത്തു കടന്നു ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and reclined at the table.
chapters.nkjv: And as He spoke, a certain Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. So He went in and sat down to eat.
chapters.kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

chapters.ml: മുത്താഴത്തിന്നു മുമ്പേ കുളിച്ചില്ല എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു പരീശൻ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: But the Pharisee was surprised when he noticed that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.
chapters.nkjv: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that He had not first washed before dinner.
chapters.kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു അവനോടു: “പരീശന്മാരായ നിങ്ങൾ കിണ്ടികിണ്ണങ്ങളുടെ പുറം വെടിപ്പാക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉള്ളിലോ കവർച്ചയും ദുഷ്ടതയും നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the Lord said to him, "Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees make the outside of the cup and dish clean, but your inward part is full of greed and wickedness.
chapters.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

chapters.ml: മൂഢന്മാരേ, പുറം ഉണ്ടാക്കിയവൻ അല്ലയോ അകവും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതു?
chapters.niv: You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?
chapters.nkjv: Foolish ones! Did not He who made the outside make the inside also?
chapters.kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

chapters.ml: അകത്തുള്ളതു ഭിക്ഷയായി കൊടുപ്പിൻ; എന്നാൽ സകലവും നിങ്ങൾക്കു ശുദ്ധം ആകും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But now as for what is inside you—be generous to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.
chapters.nkjv: But rather give alms of such things as you have; then indeed all things are clean to you.
chapters.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരായ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ തുളസിയിലും അരൂതയിലും എല്ലാ ചീരയിലും പതാരം കൊടുക്കയും ന്യായവും ദൈവസ്നേഹവും വിട്ടുകളകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഇതു ചെയ്കയും അതു ത്യജിക്കാതിരിക്കയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you Pharisees, because you give God a tenth of your mint, rue and all other kinds of garden herbs, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without leaving the former undone.
chapters.nkjv: "But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass by justice and the love of God. These you ought to have done, without leaving the others undone.
chapters.kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരായ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾക്കു പള്ളിയിൽ മുഖ്യാസനവും അങ്ങാടിയിൽ വന്ദനവും പ്രിയമാകുന്നു. നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം;
chapters.niv: "Woe to you Pharisees, because you love the most important seats in the synagogues and respectful greetings in the marketplaces.
chapters.nkjv: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ കാണ്മാൻ കഴിയാത്ത കല്ലറകളെപ്പോലെ ആകുന്നു; അവയുടെ മീതെ നടക്കുന്ന മനുഷ്യർ അറിയുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, because you are like unmarked graves, which people walk over without knowing it."
chapters.nkjv: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like graves which are not seen, and the men who walk over them are not aware of them."
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

chapters.ml: ന്യായശാസ്ത്രിമാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, ഇങ്ങനെ പറയുന്നതിനാൽ നീ ഞങ്ങളെയും അപമാനിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: One of the experts in the law answered him, "Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also."
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the lawyers answered and said to Him, "Teacher, by saying these things You reproach us also."
chapters.kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: “ന്യായശാസ്ത്രിമാരായ നിങ്ങൾക്കും അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; എടുപ്പാൻ പ്രയാസമുള്ള ചുമടുകളെ നിങ്ങൾ മനുഷ്യരെക്കൊണ്ടു ചുമപ്പിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ ഒരു വിരൽ കൊണ്ടുപോലും ആ ചുമടുകളെ തൊടുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "And you experts in the law, woe to you, because you load people down with burdens they can hardly carry, and you yourselves will not lift one finger to help them.
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Woe to you also, lawyers! For you load men with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ കല്ലറകളെ പണിയുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ അവരെ കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you, because you build tombs for the prophets, and it was your ancestors who killed them.
chapters.nkjv: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

chapters.ml: അതിനാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കു നിങ്ങൾ സാക്ഷികളായിരിക്കയും സമ്മതിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവർ അവരെ കൊന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ അവരുടെ കല്ലറകളെ പണിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So you testify that you approve of what your ancestors did; they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
chapters.nkjv: In fact, you bear witness that you approve the deeds of your fathers; for they indeed killed them, and you build their tombs.
chapters.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ജ്ഞാനവും പറയുന്നതു: ഞാൻ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെയും അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരെയും അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയക്കുന്നു; അവരിൽ ചിലരെ അവർ കൊല്ലുകയും ഉപദ്രവിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Because of this, God in his wisdom said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and others they will persecute.’
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the wisdom of God also said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill and persecute,’
chapters.kjv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

chapters.ml: ഹാബേലിന്റെ രക്തം തുടങ്ങി യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നും ആലയത്തിന്നും നടുവിൽവെച്ചു പട്ടുപോയ സെഖര്യാവിന്റെ രക്തം വരെ
chapters.niv: Therefore this generation will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the beginning of the world,
chapters.nkjv: that the blood of all the prophets which was shed from the foundation of the world may be required of this generation,
chapters.kjv: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

chapters.ml: ലോക സ്ഥാപനം മുതൽ ചൊരിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന സകല പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെയും രക്തം ഈ തലമുറയോടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ ഇടവരേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്നേ. അതേ, ഈ തലമുറയോടു അതു ചോദിക്കും എന്നു” ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, this generation will be held responsible for it all.
chapters.nkjv: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah who perished between the altar and the temple. Yes, I say to you, it shall be required of this generation.
chapters.kjv: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

chapters.ml: ന്യായശാസ്ത്രിമാരായ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; നിങ്ങൾ പരിജ്ഞാനത്തിന്റെ താക്കോൽ എടുത്തുകളഞ്ഞു; നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ കടന്നില്ല; കടക്കുന്നവരെ തടുത്തുംകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Woe to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering."
chapters.nkjv: "Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in you hindered."
chapters.kjv: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടംവിട്ടുപോകുമ്പോൾ ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരും
chapters.niv: When Jesus went outside, the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to oppose him fiercely and to besiege him with questions,
chapters.nkjv: And as He said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to assail Him vehemently, and to cross-examine Him about many things,
chapters.kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

chapters.ml: അവനെ അത്യന്തം വിഷമിപ്പിപ്പാനും അവന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നു വല്ലതും പിടിക്കാമോ എന്നു വെച്ചു അവന്നായി പതിയിരുന്നുകൊണ്ടു പലതിനെയും കുറിച്ചു കുടുക്കുചോദ്യം ചോദിപ്പാനും തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: waiting to catch him in something he might say.
chapters.nkjv: lying in wait for Him, and seeking to catch Him in something He might say, that they might accuse Him.
chapters.kjv: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നിടെ പുരുഷാരം തമ്മിൽ ചവിട്ടുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ആയിരം ആയിരമായി തിങ്ങിക്കൂടിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ ആദ്യം ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങിതു: “പരീശന്മാരുടെ പുളിച്ചമാവായ കപടഭക്തി സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, when a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling on one another, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples, saying: "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
chapters.nkjv: In the meantime, when an innumerable multitude of people had gathered together, so that they trampled one another, He began to say to His disciples first ofall, "Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
chapters.kjv: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

chapters.ml: മൂടിവെച്ചതു ഒന്നും വെളിച്ചത്തു വരാതെയും ഗൂഢമായതു ഒന്നും അറിയാതെയും ഇരിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.
chapters.nkjv: For there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.
chapters.kjv: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഇരുട്ടത്തു പറഞ്ഞതു എല്ലാം വെളിച്ചത്തു കേൾക്കും; അറകളിൽ വെച്ചു ചെവിയിൽ മന്ത്രിച്ചതു പുരമുകളിൽ ഘോഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: What you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the roofs.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore whatever you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have spoken in the ear in inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
chapters.kjv: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എന്റെ സ്നേഹിതന്മാരായ നിങ്ങളോടു ഞാൻ പറയുന്നതു: “ദേഹത്തെ കൊന്നിട്ടു പിന്നെ അധികമായി ഒന്നും ചെയ്‍വാൻ കഴിയാത്തവരെ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ.
chapters.niv: "I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
chapters.nkjv: "And I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
chapters.kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

chapters.ml: ആരെ ഭയപ്പെടേണം എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കാണിച്ചുതരാം. കൊന്നിട്ടു നരകത്തിൽ തള്ളിക്കളവാൻ അധികാരമുള്ളവനെ ഭയപ്പെടുവിൻ: അതേ, അവനെ ഭയപ്പെടുവിൻ ” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear him who, after your body has been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
chapters.nkjv: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear Him who, after He has killed, has power to cast into hell; yes, I say to you, fear Him!
chapters.kjv: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു കാശിന്നു അഞ്ചു കുരികിലിനെ വില്ക്കുന്നില്ലയോ? അവയിൽ ഒന്നിനെപ്പോലും ദൈവം മറന്നുപോകുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
chapters.nkjv: "Are not five sparrows sold for two copper coins? And not one of them is forgotten before God.
chapters.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ തലയിലെ മുടിപോലും എല്ലാം എണ്ണിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഏറിയ കുരികിലിനെക്കാളും നിങ്ങൾ വിശേഷതയുള്ളവർ.
chapters.niv: Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
chapters.nkjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Do not fear therefore; you are of more value than many sparrows.
chapters.kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും എന്നെ ഏറ്റുപറഞ്ഞാൽ അവനെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രനും ദൈവദൂതന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ഏറ്റുപറയും.
chapters.niv: "I tell you, whoever publicly acknowledges me before others, the Son of Man will also acknowledge before the angels of God.
chapters.nkjv: "Also I say to you, whoever confesses Me before men, him the Son of Man also will confess before the angels of God.
chapters.kjv: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ എന്നെ തള്ളിപ്പറയുന്നവനെ ദൈവദൂതന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ തള്ളിപ്പറയും.
chapters.niv: But whoever disowns me before others will be disowned before the angels of God.
chapters.nkjv: But he who denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
chapters.kjv: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്റെ നേരെ ഒരു വാക്കു പറയുന്ന ഏവനോടും ക്ഷമിക്കും; പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിന്റെ നേരെ ദൂഷണം പറയുന്നവനോടോ ക്ഷമിക്കയില്ല ” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
chapters.nkjv: "And anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven.
chapters.kjv: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളെ പള്ളികൾക്കും കോയ്മകൾക്കും അധികാരങ്ങൾക്കും മുമ്പിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോകുമ്പോൾ എങ്ങനെയോ എന്തോ പ്രതിവാദിക്കേണ്ടു? എന്തു പറയേണ്ടു എന്നു വിചാരിപ്പെടേണ്ടാ;
chapters.niv: "When you are brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say,
chapters.nkjv: "Now when they bring you to the synagogues and magistrates and authorities, do not worry about how or what you should answer, or what you should say.
chapters.kjv: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

chapters.ml: പറയേണ്ടതു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ആ നാഴികയിൽ തന്നേ നിങ്ങളെ പഠിപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say."
chapters.nkjv: For the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say."
chapters.kjv: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, ഞാനുമായി അവകാശം പകുതിചെയ്‍വാൻ എന്റെ സഹോദരനോടു കല്പിച്ചാലും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Someone in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
chapters.nkjv: Then one from the crowd said to Him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
chapters.kjv: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു അവൻ: “മനുഷ്യാ, എന്നെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ന്യായകർത്താവോ പങ്കിടുന്നവനോ ആക്കിയതു ആർ ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?"
chapters.nkjv: But He said to him, "Man, who made Me a judge or an arbitrator over you?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരോടു: “സകലദ്രവ്യാഗ്രഹവും സൂക്ഷിച്ചു ഒഴിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ; ഒരുത്തന്നു സമൃദ്ധിഉണ്ടായാലും അവന്റെ വസ്തുവകയല്ല അവന്റെ ജീവന്നു ആധാരമായിരിക്കുന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to them, "Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; life does not consist in an abundance of possessions."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Take heed and beware of covetousness, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of the things he possesses."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

chapters.ml: ഒരുപമയും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ധനവാനായോരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ ഭൂമി നന്നായി വിളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he told them this parable: "The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest.
chapters.nkjv: Then He spoke a parable to them, saying: "The ground of a certain rich man yielded plentifully.
chapters.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: ഞാൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു? എന്റെ വിളവു കൂട്ടിവെപ്പാൻ സ്ഥലം പോരാ എന്നു ഉള്ളിൽ വിചാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’
chapters.nkjv: And he thought within himself, saying, ‘What shall I do, since I have no room to store my crops?’
chapters.kjv: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ ഇതു ചെയ്യും; എന്റെ കളപ്പുരകളെ പൊളിച്ചു അധികം വലിയവ പണിതു എന്റെ വിളവും വസ്തുവകയും എല്ലാം അതിൽ കൂട്ടിവെക്കും.
chapters.niv: "Then he said, ‘This is what I’ll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store my surplus grain.
chapters.nkjv: So he said, ‘I will do this: I will pull down my barns and build greater, and there I will store all my crops and my goods.
chapters.kjv: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

chapters.ml: എന്നിട്ടു എന്നോടുതന്നേ; നിനക്കു ഏറിയ ആണ്ടുകൾക്കു മതിയായ അനവധി വസ്തുവക സ്വരൂപിച്ചുവെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ആശ്വസിക്ക, തിന്നുക, കുടിക്ക, ആനന്ദിക്ക എന്നു പറയും. ദൈവമോ അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: And I’ll say to myself, "You have plenty of grain laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink and be merry." ’
chapters.nkjv: And I will say to my soul, "Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years; take your ease; eat, drink, and be merry." ’
chapters.kjv: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

chapters.ml: മൂഢാ, ഈ രാത്രിയിൽ നിന്റെ പ്രാണനെ നിന്നോടു ചോദിക്കും. പിന്നെ നീ ഒരുക്കിവെച്ചതു ആർക്കാകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?’
chapters.nkjv: But God said to him, ‘Fool! This night your soul will be required of you; then whose will those things be which you have provided?’
chapters.kjv: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

chapters.ml: ദൈവവിഷയമായി സമ്പന്നനാകാതെ തനിക്കു തന്നേ നിക്ഷേപിക്കുന്നവന്റെ കാര്യം ഇങ്ങനെ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "This is how it will be with whoever stores up things for themselves but is not rich toward God."
chapters.nkjv: "So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God."
chapters.kjv: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ആകയാൽ എന്തു തിന്നും എന്നു ജീവന്നായിക്കൊണ്ടും എന്തു ഉടുക്കും എന്നു ശരീരത്തിന്നായിക്കൊണ്ടും വിചാരപ്പെടരുതു” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to his disciples: "Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to His disciples, "Therefore I say to you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; nor about the body, what you will put on.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

chapters.ml: ആഹാരത്തെക്കാൾ ജീവനും ഉടുപ്പിനെക്കാൾ ശരീരവും വലുതല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
chapters.nkjv: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
chapters.kjv: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

chapters.ml: കാക്കയെ നോക്കുവിൻ; അതു വിതെക്കുന്നില്ല, കൊയ്യുന്നില്ല, അതിന്നു പാണ്ടികശാലയും കളപ്പുരയും ഇല്ല; എങ്കിലും ദൈവം അതിനെ പുലർത്തുന്നു. പറവജാതിയെക്കാൾ നിങ്ങൾ എത്ര വിശേഷമുള്ളവർ!
chapters.niv: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!
chapters.nkjv: Consider the ravens, for they neither sow nor reap, which have neither storehouse nor barn; and God feeds them. Of how much more value are you than the birds?
chapters.kjv: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ വിചാരപ്പെടുന്നതിനാൽ തന്റെ നീളത്തിൽ ഒരു മുഴം കൂട്ടുവാൻ നിങ്ങളിൽ ആർക്കു കഴിയും?
chapters.niv: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life ?
chapters.nkjv: And which of you by worrying can add one cubit to his stature?
chapters.kjv: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഏറ്റവും ചെറിയതിന്നുപോലും നിങ്ങൾ പോരാത്തവർ എങ്കിൽ ശേഷമുള്ളതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിചാരപ്പെടുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?
chapters.nkjv: If you then are not able to do the least, why are you anxious for the rest?
chapters.kjv: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

chapters.ml: താമര എങ്ങനെ വളരുന്നു എന്നു വിചാരിപ്പിൻ; അവ അദ്ധ്വാനിക്കുന്നില്ല നൂൽക്കുന്നതുമില്ല; എന്നാൽ ശലോമോൻ പോലും തന്റെ സകല മഹത്വത്തിലും ഇവയിൽ ഒന്നിനോളം ചമഞ്ഞിരുന്നില്ല ” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Consider how the wild flowers grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.
chapters.nkjv: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; and yet I say to you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
chapters.kjv: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

chapters.ml: ഇന്നുള്ളതും നാളെ അടുപ്പിൽ ഇടുന്നതുമായ വയലിലെ പുല്ലിനെ ദൈവം ഇങ്ങനെ ഉടുപ്പിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ, അല്പവിശ്വസികളേ, നിങ്ങളെ എത്ര അധികം?
chapters.niv: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today, and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, how much more will he clothe you—you of little faith!
chapters.nkjv: If then God so clothes the grass, which today is in the field and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith?
chapters.kjv: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

chapters.ml: എന്തു തിന്നും എന്തു കുടിക്കും എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ചിന്തിച്ചു ചഞ്ചലപ്പെടരുതു.
chapters.niv: And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.
chapters.nkjv: "And do not seek what you should eat or what you should drink, nor have an anxious mind.
chapters.kjv: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

chapters.ml: ഈ വക ഒക്കെയും ലോകജാതികൾ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവോ ഇവ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആവശ്യം എന്നു അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.
chapters.nkjv: For all these things the nations of the world seek after, and your Father knows that you need these things.
chapters.kjv: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ രാജ്യം അന്വേഷിപ്പിൻ; അതോടുകൂടെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഇതും കിട്ടും.
chapters.niv: But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.
chapters.nkjv: But seek the kingdom of God, and all these things shall be added to you.
chapters.kjv: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

chapters.ml: ചെറിയ ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടമേ, ഭയപ്പെടരുതു; നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവു രാജ്യം നിങ്ങൾക്കു നല്കുവാൻ പ്രസാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: "Do not fear, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
chapters.kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതു വിറ്റു ഭിക്ഷകൊടുപ്പിൻ; കള്ളൻ അടുക്കയോ പുഴു കെടുക്കയോ ചെയ്യാത്ത സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ പഴകിപ്പോകാത്ത മടിശ്ശീലകളും തീർന്നുപോകാത്ത നിക്ഷേപവും നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉണ്ടാക്കിക്കൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide purses for yourselves that will not wear out, a treasure in heaven that will never fail, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.
chapters.nkjv: Sell what you have and give alms; provide yourselves money bags which do not grow old, a treasure in the heavens that does not fail, where no thief approaches nor moth destroys.
chapters.kjv: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ നിക്ഷേപം ഉള്ളേടത്തു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയവും ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
chapters.nkjv: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
chapters.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ അര കെട്ടിയും വിളക്കു കത്തിയും കൊണ്ടിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "Be dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,
chapters.nkjv: "Let your waist be girded and your lamps burning;
chapters.kjv: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ കല്യാണത്തിന്നു പോയി വന്നു മുട്ടിയാൽ ഉടനെ വാതിൽ തുറന്നുകൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ എപ്പോൾ മടങ്ങിവരും വന്നു കാത്തുനില്ക്കുന്ന ആളുകളോടു നിങ്ങൾ തുല്യരായിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they can immediately open the door for him.
chapters.nkjv: and you yourselves be like men who wait for their master, when he will return from the wedding, that when he comes and knocks they may open to him immediately.
chapters.kjv: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ വരുന്നേരം ഉണർന്നിരിക്കുന്നവരായി കാണുന്ന ദാസന്മാർ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ; അവൻ അര കെട്ടി അവരെ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരുത്തുകയും വന്നു അവർക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്കയും ചെയ്യും” എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായി നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them watching when he comes. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve, will have them recline at the table and will come and wait on them.
chapters.nkjv: Blessed are those servants whom the master, when he comes, will find watching. Assuredly, I say to you that he will gird himself and have them sit down to eat, and will come and serve them.
chapters.kjv: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രണ്ടാം യാമത്തിൽ വന്നാലും മൂന്നാമതിൽ വന്നാലും അങ്ങനെ കണ്ടു എങ്കിൽ അവർ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the middle of the night or toward daybreak.
chapters.nkjv: And if he should come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
chapters.kjv: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

chapters.ml: കള്ളൻ ഇന്ന നാഴികെക്കു വരുന്നു എന്നു വിട്ടുടയവൻ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവൻ ഉണർന്നിരുന്നു തന്റെ വീടു തുരപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിക്കയില്ല എന്നറിവിൻ.
chapters.niv: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
chapters.nkjv: But know this, that if the master of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
chapters.kjv: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

chapters.ml: നിനയാത്ത നാഴികയിൽ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ വരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളും ഒരുങ്ങിയിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore you also be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect."
chapters.kjv: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, ഈ ഉപമ പറയുന്നതു ഞങ്ങളോടോ എല്ലാവരോടും കൂടെയോ എന്നു പത്രൊസ് ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു കർത്താവു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Peter asked, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter said to Him, "Lord, do You speak this parable only to us, or to all people?"
chapters.kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

chapters.ml: തക്കസമയത്തു ആഹാരവീതം കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യജമാനൻ തന്റെ വേലക്കാരുടെ മേൽ ആക്കുന്ന വിശ്വസ്തനും ബുദ്ധിമാനുമായ ഗൃഹവിചാരകൻ ആർ?
chapters.niv: The Lord answered, "Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their food allowance at the proper time?
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his master will make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?
chapters.kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ വരുമ്പോൾ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തുകാണുന്ന ദാസൻ ഭാഗ്യവാൻ.
chapters.niv: It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.
chapters.nkjv: Blessed is that servant whom his master will find so doing when he comes.
chapters.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തനിക്കുള്ള സകലത്തിന്നും അവനെ വിചാരകനാക്കിവെക്കും” എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
chapters.nkjv: Truly, I say to you that he will make him ruler over all that he has.
chapters.kjv: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദാസൻ: യജമാനൻ താമസിച്ചേ വരികയുള്ളു എന്നു ഹൃദയത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞു ബാല്യക്കാരെയും ബാല്യക്കാരത്തികളെയും തല്ലുവാനും തിന്നു കുടിച്ചു മദിപ്പാനും തുടങ്ങിയാൽ,
chapters.niv: But suppose the servant says to himself, ‘My master is taking a long time in coming,’ and he then begins to beat the other servants, both men and women, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
chapters.nkjv: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My master is delaying his coming,’ and begins to beat the male and female servants, and to eat and drink and be drunk,
chapters.kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

chapters.ml: അവൻ നോക്കിയിരിക്കാത്ത നാളിലും അറിയാത്ത നാഴികയിലും ആ ദാസന്റെ യജമാനൻ വന്നു അവനെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിക്കയും അവന്നു അവിശ്വാസികളോടുകൂടെ പങ്കു കല്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
chapters.nkjv: the master of that servant will come on a day when he is not looking for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in two and appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
chapters.kjv: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

chapters.ml: യജമാനന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഒരുങ്ങാതെയും അവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്യാതെയുമിരിക്കുന്ന ദാസന്നു വളരെ അടികൊള്ളും.
chapters.niv: "The servant who knows the master’s will and does not get ready or does not do what the master wants will be beaten with many blows.
chapters.nkjv: And that servant who knew his master’s will, and did not prepare himself or do according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
chapters.kjv: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself , neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes .

chapters.ml: അറിയാതെകണ്ടു അടിക്കു യോഗ്യമായതു ചെയ്തവന്നോ കുറയ അടി കൊള്ളും; വളരെ ലഭിച്ചവനോടു വളരെ ആവശ്യപ്പെടും; അധികം ഏറ്റുവാങ്ങിയവനോടു അധികം ചോദിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But the one who does not know and does things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and from the one who has been entrusted with much, much more will be asked.
chapters.nkjv: But he who did not know, yet committed things deserving of stripes, shall be beaten with few. For everyone to whom much is given, from him much will be required; and to whom much has been committed, of him they will ask the more.
chapters.kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes . For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ തീ ഇടുവാൻ ഞാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു ഇപ്പോഴേ കത്തിയെങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു എന്നല്ലാതെ ഞാൻ മറ്റെന്തു ഇച്ഛിക്കേണ്ടു?
chapters.niv: "I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
chapters.nkjv: "I came to send fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
chapters.kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും എനിക്കു ഒരു സ്നാനം ഏല്പാൻ ഉണ്ടു; അതു കഴിയുവോളം ഞാൻ എത്ര ഞെരുങ്ങുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But I have a baptism to undergo, and what constraint I am under until it is completed!
chapters.nkjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am till it is accomplished!
chapters.kjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിൽ സമാധാനം നല്കുവാൻ ഞാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു തോന്നുന്നുവോ? അല്ലല്ല, ഛിദ്രം വരുത്തുവാൻ അത്രേ” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.
chapters.nkjv: Do you suppose that I came to give peace on earth? I tell you, not at all, but rather division.
chapters.kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

chapters.ml: ഇനിമേൽ ഒരു വീട്ടിൽ ഇരുവരോടു മൂവരും മൂവരോടു ഇരുവരും ഇങ്ങനെ അഞ്ചുപേർ തമ്മിൽ ഛിദ്രിച്ചിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.
chapters.nkjv: For from now on five in one house will be divided: three against two, and two against three.
chapters.kjv: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൻ മകനോടും മകൻ അപ്പനോടും അമ്മ മകളോടും മകൾ അമ്മയോടും അമ്മാവിയമ്മ മരുമകളോടും മരുമകൾ അമ്മാവിയമ്മയോടും ഛിദ്രിച്ചിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."
chapters.nkjv: Father will be divided against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law."
chapters.kjv: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “പടിഞ്ഞാറുനിന്നു മേഘം പൊങ്ങുന്നതു കാണുമ്പോൾ പെരുമഴ വരുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഉടനെ പറയുന്നു; അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said to the crowd: "When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, ‘It’s going to rain,’ and it does.
chapters.nkjv: Then He also said to the multitudes, "Whenever you see a cloud rising out of the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming’; and so it is.
chapters.kjv: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

chapters.ml: തെക്കൻ കാറ്റു ഊതുന്നതു കണ്ടാലോ അത്യുഷ്ണം ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു പറയുന്നു; അതു സംഭവിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It’s going to be hot,’ and it is.
chapters.nkjv: And when you see the south wind blow, you say, ‘There will be hot weather’; and there is.
chapters.kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

chapters.ml: കപടഭക്തിക്കാരേ, ഭൂമിയുടെയും ആകാശത്തിന്റെയും ഭാവത്തെ വിവേചിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അറിയാം;
chapters.niv: Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don’t know how to interpret this present time?
chapters.nkjv: Hypocrites! You can discern the face of the sky and of the earth, but how is it you do not discern this time?
chapters.kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഈ കാലത്തെ വിവേചിപ്പാൻ അറിയാത്തതു എങ്ങനെ? ന്യായമായതു എന്തെന്നു നിങ്ങൾ സ്വയമായി വിധിക്കാത്തതും എന്തു?
chapters.niv: "Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
chapters.nkjv: "Yes, and why, even of yourselves, do you not judge what is right?
chapters.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
