chapters.kjv: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

chapters.ml: അകലെ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു: യേശൂ, നായക, ഞങ്ങളോടു കരുണയുണ്ടാകേണമേ എന്നു ഉറക്കെ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and called out in a loud voice, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"
chapters.nkjv: And they lifted up their voices and said, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"
chapters.kjv: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ കണ്ടിട്ടു: “നിങ്ങൾ പോയി പുരോഹിതന്മാർക്കു നിങ്ങളെ തന്നേ കാണിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; പോകയിൽ തന്നേ അവർ ശുദ്ധരായ്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he saw them, he said, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." And as they went, they were cleansed.
chapters.nkjv: So when He saw them, He said to them, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." And so it was that as they went, they were cleansed.
chapters.kjv: And when he saw them , he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ തനിക്കു സൌഖ്യംവന്നതു കണ്ടു ഉച്ചത്തിൽ ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തിക്കൊണ്ടു മടങ്ങിവന്നു അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ കവിണ്ണു വീണു അവന്നു നന്ദി പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.
chapters.nkjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, returned, and with a loud voice glorified God,
chapters.kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

chapters.ml: അവനോ ശമര്യക്കാരൻ ആയിരുന്നു
chapters.niv: He threw himself at Jesus’ feet and thanked him—and he was a Samaritan.
chapters.nkjv: and fell down on his face at His feet, giving Him thanks. And he was a Samaritan.
chapters.kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

chapters.ml: “പത്തുപേർ ശുദ്ധരായ്തീർന്നില്ലയോ? ഒമ്പതുപേർ എവിടെ?
chapters.niv: Jesus asked, "Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus answered and said, "Were there not ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

chapters.ml: ഈ അന്യജാതിക്കാരനല്ലാതെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു മഹത്വം കൊടുപ്പാൻ മടങ്ങിവന്നവരായി ആരെയും കാണുന്നില്ലല്ലോ ” എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: Has no one returned to give praise to God except this foreigner?"
chapters.nkjv: Were there not any found who returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?"
chapters.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

chapters.ml: “എഴുന്നേറ്റു പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം നിന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to him, "Rise and go; your faith has made you well."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to him, "Arise, go your way. Your faith has made you well."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

chapters.ml: ദൈവരാജ്യം എപ്പോൾ വരുന്നു എന്നു പരീശന്മാർ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: “ദൈവരാജ്യം കാണത്തക്കവണ്ണമല്ല വരുന്നതു;
chapters.niv: Once, on being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, "The coming of the kingdom of God is not something that can be observed,
chapters.nkjv: Now when He was asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered them and said, "The kingdom of God does not come with observation;
chapters.kjv: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

chapters.ml: ഇതാ ഇവിടെ എന്നും അതാ അവിടെ എന്നും പറകയും ഇല്ല; ദൈവരാജ്യം നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ തന്നേ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ ”എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: nor will people say, ‘Here it is,’ or ‘There it is,’ because the kingdom of God is in your midst."
chapters.nkjv: nor will they say, ‘See here!’ or ‘See there!’ For indeed, the kingdom of God is within you."
chapters.kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “നിങ്ങൾ മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്റെ ഒരു ദിവസം കാണ്മാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന കാലം വരും;
chapters.niv: Then he said to his disciples, "The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to the disciples, "The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it .

chapters.ml: കാണുകയില്ലതാനും. അന്നു നിങ്ങളോടു: ഇതാ ഇവിടെ എന്നും അതാ അവിടെ എന്നും പറയും; നിങ്ങൾ പോകരുതു, പിൻചെല്ലുകയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: People will tell you, ‘There he is!’ or ‘Here he is!’ Do not go running off after them.
chapters.nkjv: And they will say to you, ‘Look here!’ or ‘Look there!’ Do not go after them or follow them.
chapters.kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them , nor follow them .

chapters.ml: മിന്നൽ ആകാശത്തിങ്കീഴെ ദിക്കോടുദിക്കെല്ലാം തിളങ്ങി മിന്നുന്നതുപോലെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ തന്റെ ദിവസത്തിൽ ആകും.
chapters.niv: For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.
chapters.nkjv: For as the lightning that flashes out of one part under heaven shines to the other part under heaven, so also the Son of Man will be in His day.
chapters.kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആദ്യം അവൻ വളരെ കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിക്കയും ഈ തലമുറ അവനെ തള്ളിക്കളകയും വേണം.
chapters.niv: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
chapters.nkjv: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
chapters.kjv: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

chapters.ml: നോഹയുടെ കാലത്തു സംഭവിച്ചതുപോലെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്റെ നാളിലും ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: "Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.
chapters.nkjv: And as it was in the days of Noah, so it will be also in the days of the Son of Man:
chapters.kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

chapters.ml: നോഹ പെട്ടകത്തിൽ കടന്ന നാൾവരെ അവർ തിന്നും കുടിച്ചും വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചും വിവാഹത്തിന്നു കൊടുത്തും പോന്നു; ജലപ്രളയം വന്നു, അവരെ എല്ലാവരെയും മുടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
chapters.nkjv: They ate, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
chapters.kjv: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

chapters.ml: ലോത്തിന്റെ കാലത്തു സംഭവിച്ചതുപോലെയും തന്നേ; അവർ തിന്നും കുടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടും വിറ്റും നട്ടും പണിതും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: "It was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
chapters.nkjv: Likewise as it was also in the days of Lot: They ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
chapters.kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ലോത്ത് സൊദോം വിട്ട നാളിൽ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു തീയും ഗന്ധകവും പെയ്തു എല്ലാവരെയും മുടിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
chapters.nkjv: but on the day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven and destroyed them all.
chapters.kjv: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ വെളിപ്പെടുന്ന നാളിൽ അവ്വണ്ണം തന്നേ ആകും.
chapters.niv: "It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
chapters.nkjv: Even so will it be in the day when the Son of Man is revealed.
chapters.kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

chapters.ml: അന്നു വീട്ടിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ വീട്ടിന്നകത്തുള്ള സാധനം എടുപ്പാൻ ഇറങ്ങിപ്പോകരുതു; അവ്വണ്ണം വയലിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവനും പിന്നോക്കം തിരിയരുതു.
chapters.niv: On that day no one who is on the housetop, with possessions inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.
chapters.nkjv: "In that day, he who is on the housetop, and his goods are in the house, let him not come down to take them away. And likewise the one who is in the field, let him not turn back.
chapters.kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

chapters.ml: ലോത്തിന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Remember Lot’s wife!
chapters.nkjv: Remember Lot’s wife.
chapters.kjv: Remember Lot’s wife.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ജീവനെ നേടുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നവനെല്ലാം അതിനെ കളയും; അതിനെ കളയുന്നവനെല്ലാം അതിനെ രക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whoever tries to keep their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life will preserve it.
chapters.nkjv: Whoever seeks to save his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will preserve it.
chapters.kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

chapters.ml: ആ രാത്രിയിൽ രണ്ടുപേർ ഒരു കിടക്കമേൽ ആയിരിക്കും; ഒരുത്തനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളും; മറ്റവനെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.
chapters.nkjv: I tell you, in that night there will be two men in one bed: the one will be taken and the other will be left.
chapters.kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടുപേർ ഒന്നിച്ചു പൊടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കും; ഒരുത്തിയെ കൈക്കൊള്ളും;
chapters.niv: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left."
chapters.nkjv: Two women will be grinding together: the one will be taken and the other left.
chapters.kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

chapters.ml: മറ്റവളെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കും (രണ്ടുപേർ വയലിൽ ഇരിക്കും; ഒരുത്തനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളും; മറ്റവനെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കും)” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Where, Lord?" they asked. He replied, "Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather."
chapters.nkjv: Two men will be in the field: the one will be taken and the other left."
chapters.kjv: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: “ശവം ഉള്ളേടത്തു കഴുക്കൾ കൂടും” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.nkjv: And they answered and said to Him, "Where, Lord?" So He said to them, "Wherever the body is, there the eagles will be gathered together."
chapters.kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together.

chapters.ml: “മടുത്തുപോകാതെ എപ്പോഴും പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കേണം” എന്നുള്ളതിന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു ഒരുപമ പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.
chapters.nkjv: Then He spoke a parable to them, that men always ought to pray and not lose heart,
chapters.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തെ ഭയവും മനുഷ്യനെ ശങ്കയുമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ന്യായാധിപൻ ഒരു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said: "In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared what people thought.
chapters.nkjv: saying: "There was in a certain city a judge who did not fear God nor regard man.
chapters.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

chapters.ml: ആ പട്ടണത്തിൽ ഒരു വിധവയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവൾ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: എന്റെ പ്രതിയോഗിയോടു പ്രതിക്രിയ നടത്തി രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, ‘Grant me justice against my adversary.’
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a widow in that city; and she came to him, saying, ‘Get justice for me from my adversary.’
chapters.kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു കുറേ കാലത്തേക്കു മനസ്സില്ലായിരുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവൻ: എനിക്കു ദൈവത്തെ ഭയവും മനുഷ്യനെ ശങ്കയുമില്ല
chapters.niv: "For some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, ‘Even though I don’t fear God or care what people think,
chapters.nkjv: And he would not for a while; but afterward he said within himself, ‘Though I do not fear God nor regard man,
chapters.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും വിധവ എന്നെ അസഹ്യമാക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അവളെ പ്രതിക്രിയ നടത്തി രക്ഷിക്കും; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അവൾ ഒടുവിൽ വന്നു എന്നെ മുഖത്തടിക്കും എന്നു ഉള്ളുകൊണ്ടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will see that she gets justice, so that she won’t eventually come and attack me!’ "
chapters.nkjv: yet because this widow troubles me I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.’ "
chapters.kjv: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

chapters.ml: അനീതിയുള്ള ന്യായാധിപൻ പറയുന്നതു കേൾപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: And the Lord said, "Listen to what the unjust judge says.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Lord said, "Hear what the unjust judge said.
chapters.kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

chapters.ml: ദൈവമോ രാപ്പകൽ തന്നോടു നിലവിളിക്കുന്ന തന്റെ വൃതന്മാരുടെ കാര്യത്തിൽ ദീർഘക്ഷമയുള്ളവൻ ആയാലും അവരെ പ്രതിക്രിയ നടത്തി രക്ഷിക്കയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?
chapters.nkjv: And shall God not avenge His own elect who cry out day and night to Him, though He bears long with them?
chapters.kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

chapters.ml: വേഗത്തിൽ അവരെ പ്രതിക്രിയ നടത്തി രക്ഷിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു. എന്നാൽ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ വരുമ്പോൾ അവൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ വിശ്വാസം കണ്ടെത്തുമോ ” എന്നു കർത്താവു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?"
chapters.nkjv: I tell you that He will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He really find faith on the earth?"
chapters.kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾ നീതിമാന്മാർ എന്നു ഉറെച്ചു മറ്റുള്ളവരെ ധിക്കരിക്കുന്ന ചിലരെക്കുറിച്ചു അവൻ ഒരു ഉപമ പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everyone else, Jesus told this parable:
chapters.nkjv: Also He spoke this parable to some who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
chapters.kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു മനുഷ്യർ പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പാൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ പോയി; ഒരുത്തൻ പരീശൻ, മറ്റവൻ ചുങ്കക്കാരൻ.
chapters.niv: "Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
chapters.nkjv: "Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
chapters.kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

chapters.ml: പരീശൻ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു തന്നോടു തന്നെ: ദൈവമേ, പിടിച്ചുപറിക്കാർ, നീതികെട്ടവർ, വ്യഭിചാരികൾ മുതലായ ശേഷം മനുഷ്യരെപ്പോലെയോ ഈ ചുങ്കക്കാരനെപ്പോലെയോ ഞാൻ അല്ലായ്കയാൽ നിന്നെ വാഴ്ത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other people—robbers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
chapters.nkjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like other men—extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this tax collector.
chapters.kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are , extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

chapters.ml: ആഴ്ചയിൽ രണ്ടുവട്ടം ഉപവസിക്കുന്നു; നേടുന്നതിൽ ഒക്കെയും പതാരം കൊടുത്തുവരുന്നു; എന്നിങ്ങനെ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.’
chapters.nkjv: I fast twice a week; I give tithes of all that I possess.’
chapters.kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

chapters.ml: ചുങ്കക്കാരനോ ദൂരത്തു നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തേക്കു നോക്കുവാൻപോലും തുനിയാതെ മാറത്തടിച്ചു: ദൈവമേ, പാപിയായ എന്നോടു കരുണയുണ്ടാകേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner.’
chapters.nkjv: And the tax collector, standing afar off, would not so much as raise his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me a sinner!’
chapters.kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നീതീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ടവനായി വീട്ടിലേക്കു പോയി; മറ്റവൻ അങ്ങനെയല്ല. തന്നെത്താൻ ഉയർത്തുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം താഴ്ത്തപ്പെടും; തന്നെത്താൻ താഴ്ത്തുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം ഉയർത്തപ്പെടും” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."
chapters.nkjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."
chapters.kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തൊടേണ്ടതിന്നു ചിലർ ശിശുക്കളെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അതുകണ്ടു അവരെ ശാസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: People were also bringing babies to Jesus for him to place his hands on them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.
chapters.nkjv: Then they also brought infants to Him that He might touch them; but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
chapters.kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ അവരെ അരികത്തു വിളിച്ചു: “പൈതങ്ങളെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ വിടുവിൻ; അവരെ തടുക്കരുതു; ദൈവരാജ്യം ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ളവരുടേതു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Jesus called the children to him and said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus called them to Him and said, "Let the little children come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of God.
chapters.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him , and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെ ശിശുഎന്നപോലെ കൈക്കൊള്ളാത്തവൻ ആരും ഒരുനാളും അതിൽ കടക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it."
chapters.nkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will by no means enter it."
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

chapters.ml: ഒരു പ്രമാണി അവനോടു: നല്ല ഗുരോ, ഞാൻ നിത്യജീവനെ അവകാശമാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A certain ruler asked him, "Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain ruler asked Him, saying, "Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
chapters.kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “എന്നെ നല്ലവൻ എന്നു പറയുന്നതു എന്തു? ദൈവം ഒരുവനല്ലാതെ നല്ലവൻ ആരും ഇല്ല. വ്യഭിചാരം ചെയ്യരുതു:
chapters.niv: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus answered. "No one is good—except God alone.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus said to him, "Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is , God.

chapters.ml: കുല ചെയ്യരുതു; മോഷ്ടിക്കരുതു; കള്ളസ്സാക്ഷ്യം പറയരുതു; നിന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും ബഹുമാനിക്ക എന്നീ കല്പനകളെ നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.’ "
chapters.nkjv: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not bear false witness,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’"
chapters.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

chapters.ml: ഇവ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ ചെറുപ്പംമുതൽ കാത്തുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു കേട്ടിട്ടു
chapters.niv: "All these I have kept since I was a boy," he said.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "All these things I have kept from my youth."
chapters.kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

chapters.ml: യേശു: “ഇനി ഒരു കുറവു നിനക്കുണ്ടു; നിനക്കുള്ളതൊക്കെയും വിറ്റു ദരിദ്രന്മാർക്കു പകുത്തുകൊടുക്ക; എന്നാൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിനക്കു നിക്ഷേപം ഉണ്ടാകും; പിന്നെ വന്നു എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
chapters.nkjv: So when Jesus heard these things, He said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me."
chapters.kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എത്രയും ധനവാനാകകൊണ്ടു ഇതു കേട്ടിട്ടു അതിദുഃഖതിനായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was very wealthy.
chapters.nkjv: But when he heard this, he became very sorrowful, for he was very rich.
chapters.kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു: “സമ്പത്തുള്ളവർ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നതു എത്ര പ്രയാസം!
chapters.niv: Jesus looked at him and said, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
chapters.nkjv: And when Jesus saw that he became very sorrowful, He said, "How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the kingdom of God!
chapters.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

chapters.ml: ധനവാൻ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ ഒട്ടകം സൂചിക്കുഴയൂടെ കടക്കുന്നതു എളുപ്പം” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടവർ: എന്നാൽ രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുവാൻ ആർക്കു കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Those who heard this asked, "Who then can be saved?"
chapters.nkjv: And those who heard it said, "Who then can be saved?"
chapters.kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “മനുഷ്യരാൽ അസാദ്ധ്യമായതു ദൈവത്താൽ സാദ്ധ്യമാകുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "What is impossible with man is possible with God."
chapters.nkjv: But He said, "The things which are impossible with men are possible with God."
chapters.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ ഞങ്ങൾ സ്വന്തമായതു വിട്ടു നിന്നെ അനുഗമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പത്രൊസ് പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter said to him, "We have left all we had to follow you!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter said, "See, we have left all and followed You."
chapters.kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ദൈവരാജ്യം നിമിത്തം വീടോ ഭാര്യയെയോ സഹോദരന്മാരെയോ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാരെയോ മക്കളെയോ വിട്ടുകളഞ്ഞിട്ടു
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you," Jesus said to them, "no one who has left home or wife or brothers or sisters or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
chapters.nkjv: So He said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you, there is no one who has left house or parents or brothers or wife or children, for the sake of the kingdom of God,
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,

chapters.ml: ഈ കാലത്തിൽ തന്നേ പല മടങ്ങായും വരുവാനുള്ള ലോകത്തിൽ നിത്യജീവനെയും പ്രാപിക്കാത്തവൻ ആരും ഇല്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളാടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: will fail to receive many times as much in this age, and in the age to come eternal life."
chapters.nkjv: who shall not receive many times more in this present time, and in the age to come eternal life."
chapters.kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ പന്തിരുവരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു അവരോടു: “ഇതാ നാം യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോകുന്നു; മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെക്കുറിച്ചു പ്രവാചകന്മാർ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു എല്ലാം നിവൃത്തിയാകും.
chapters.niv: Jesus took the Twelve aside and told them, "We are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written by the prophets about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.
chapters.nkjv: Then He took the twelve aside and said to them, "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be accomplished.
chapters.kjv: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ജാതികൾക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കയും അവർ അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു അവമാനിച്ചു തുപ്പി തല്ലീട്ടു കൊല്ലുകയും
chapters.niv: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him and spit on him;
chapters.nkjv: For He will be delivered to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.
chapters.kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം നാൾ അവൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കയും ചെയ്യും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: they will flog him and kill him. On the third day he will rise again."
chapters.nkjv: They will scourge Him and kill Him. And the third day He will rise again."
chapters.kjv: And they shall scourge him , and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

chapters.ml: അവരോ ഇതു ഒന്നും ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല; ഈ വാക്കു അവർക്കു മറവായിരുന്നു; പറഞ്ഞതു അവർ തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.
chapters.nkjv: But they understood none of these things; this saying was hidden from them, and they did not know the things which were spoken.
chapters.kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരീഹോവിന്നു അടുത്തപ്പോൾ ഒരു കുരുടൻ ഇരന്നുകൊണ്ടു വഴിയരികെ ഇരുന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.
chapters.nkjv: Then it happened, as He was coming near Jericho, that a certain blind man sat by the road begging.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം കടന്നു പോകുന്നതു കേട്ടു: ഇതെന്തു എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
chapters.nkjv: And hearing a multitude passing by, he asked what it meant.
chapters.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

chapters.ml: നസറായനായ യേശു കടന്നുപോകുന്നു എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."
chapters.nkjv: So they told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
chapters.kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ: യേശുവേ, ദാവീദുപുത്രാ, എന്നോടു കരുണ തോന്നേണമേ എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He called out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.nkjv: And he cried out, saying, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

chapters.ml: മുൻനടക്കുന്നവർ അവനെ മിണ്ടാതിരിപ്പാൻ ശാസിച്ചു; അവനോ: ദിവീദുപുത്രാ എന്നോടു കരുണ തോന്നേണമേ എന്നു ഏറ്റവും അധികം നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.nkjv: Then those who went before warned him that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
chapters.kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

chapters.ml: യേശു നിന്നു, അവനെ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus stood still and commanded him to be brought to Him. And when he had come near, He asked him,
chapters.kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

chapters.ml: അവൻ അടുക്കെ വന്നപ്പോൾ: “ഞാൻ നിനക്കു എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു”. കർത്താവേ, എനിക്കു കാഴ്ച കിട്ടേണം എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord, I want to see," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: saying, "What do you want Me to do for you?" He said, "Lord, that I may receive my sight."
chapters.kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിക്ക; നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം നിന്നെ രക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has healed you."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has made you well."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷണത്തിൽ അവൻ കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വീകരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു; ജനം എല്ലാം കണ്ടിട്ടു ദൈവത്തിന്നു പുകഴ്ച കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they also praised God.
chapters.nkjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed Him, glorifying God. And all the people, when they saw it, gave praise to God.
chapters.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it , gave praise unto God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരീഹോവിൽ എത്തി കടന്നു പോകുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

chapters.ml: ചുങ്കക്കാരിൽ പ്രമാണിയും ധനവാനുമായ സക്കായി എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു പുരുഷൻ,
chapters.niv: A man was there by the name of Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was wealthy.
chapters.nkjv: Now behold, therewas a man named Zacchaeus who was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

chapters.ml: യേശു എങ്ങനെയുള്ളവൻ എന്നു കാണ്മാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു, വളർച്ചയിൽ കുറിയവൻ ആകകൊണ്ടു പുരുഷാരംനിമിത്തം കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but because he was short he could not see over the crowd.
chapters.nkjv: And he sought to see who Jesus was, but could not because of the crowd, for he was of short stature.
chapters.kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

chapters.ml: എന്നാറെ അവൻ മുമ്പോട്ടു ഓടി, അവനെ കാണേണ്ടിതിന്നു ഒരു കാട്ടത്തിമേൽ കയറി. യേശു ആ വഴിയായി വരികയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.
chapters.nkjv: So he ran ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see Him, for He was going to pass that way.
chapters.kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way .

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആ സ്ഥലത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ മേലോട്ടു നോക്കി: “സക്കായിയേ, വേഗം ഇറങ്ങിവാ; ഞാൻ ഇന്നു നിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പാർക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു” എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, "Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today."
chapters.nkjv: And when Jesus came to the place, He looked up and saw him, and said to him, "Zacchaeus, make haste and come down, for today I must stay at your house."
chapters.kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബദ്ധപ്പെട്ടു ഇറങ്ങി സന്തോഷത്തോടെ അവനെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.
chapters.nkjv: So he made haste and came down, and received Him joyfully.
chapters.kjv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

chapters.ml: കണ്ടവർ എല്ലാം: അവൻ പാപിയായോരു മനുഷ്യനോടുകൂടെ പാർപ്പാൻ പോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു പിറുപിറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: All the people saw this and began to mutter, "He has gone to be the guest of a sinner."
chapters.nkjv: But when they saw it, they all complained, saying, "He has gone to be a guest with a man who is a sinner."
chapters.kjv: And when they saw it , they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

chapters.ml: സക്കായിയോ നിന്നു കർത്താവിനോടു: കർത്താവേ, എന്റെ വസ്തുവകയിൽ പാതി ഞാൻ ദരിദ്രർക്കു കൊടുക്കുന്നുണ്ടു; വല്ലതും ചതിവായി വാങ്ങീട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നാലുമടങ്ങു മടക്കിക്കൊടുക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount."
chapters.nkjv: Then Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord, I give half of my goods to the poor; and if I have taken anything from anyone by false accusation, I restore fourfold."
chapters.kjv: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “ഇവനും അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ മകൻ ആകയാൽ ഇന്നു ഈ വീട്ടിന്നു രക്ഷ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham;
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

chapters.ml: കാണാതെ പോയതിനെ തിരഞ്ഞു രക്ഷിപ്പാനല്ലോ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ വന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost."
chapters.nkjv: for the Son of Man has come to seek and to save that which was lost."
chapters.kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇതു കേട്ടുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിന്നു സമീപിച്ചിരിക്കയാലും ദൈവരാജ്യം ക്ഷണത്തിൽ വെളിപ്പെടും എന്നു അവർക്കു തോന്നുകയാലും അവൻ ഒരു ഉപമയുംകൂടെ പറഞ്ഞതു എന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: While they were listening to this, he went on to tell them a parable, because he was near Jerusalem and the people thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear at once.
chapters.nkjv: Now as they heard these things, He spoke another parable, because He was near Jerusalem and because they thought the kingdom of God would appear immediately.
chapters.kjv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

chapters.ml: കുലീനനായോരു മനുഷ്യൻ രാജത്വം പ്രാപിച്ചു മടങ്ങിവരേണം എന്നുവെച്ചു ദൂരദേശത്തേക്കു യാത്രപോയി.
chapters.niv: He said: "A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore He said: "A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
chapters.kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പത്തു ദാസന്മാരെ വിളിച്ചു അവർക്കു പത്തു റാത്തൽ വെള്ളി കൊടുത്തു ഞാൻ വരുവോളം വ്യാപാരം ചെയ്തുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Put this money to work,’ he said, ‘until I come back.’
chapters.nkjv: So he called ten of his servants, delivered to them ten minas, and said to them, ‘Do business till I come.’
chapters.kjv: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പൌരന്മാരോ അവനെ പകെച്ചു അവന്റെ പിന്നൊലെ പ്രതിനിധികളെ അയച്ചു: അവൻ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്കുന്നതു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു സമ്മതമല്ല എന്നു ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We don’t want this man to be our king.’
chapters.nkjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a delegation after him, saying, ‘We will not have this man to reign over us.’
chapters.kjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാജത്വം പ്രാപിച്ചു മടങ്ങി വന്നപ്പോൾ താൻ ദ്രവ്യം കൊടുത്തിരുന്ന ദാസന്മാർ വ്യാപാരം ചെയ്തു എന്തു നേടി എന്നു അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരെ വിളിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "He was made king, however, and returned home. Then he sent for the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained with it.
chapters.nkjv: "And so it was that when he returned, having received the kingdom, he then commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തവൻ അടുത്തു വന്നു; കർത്താവേ, നീ തന്ന റാത്തൽകൊണ്ടു പത്തുറാത്തൽ സമ്പാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The first one came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned ten more.’
chapters.nkjv: Then came the first, saying, ‘Master, your mina has earned ten minas.’
chapters.kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: നന്നു നല്ല ദാസനേ, നീ അത്യല്പത്തിൽ വിശ്വസ്തൻ ആയതുകൊണ്ടു പത്തു പട്ടണത്തിന്നു അധികാരമുള്ളവൻ ആയിരിക്ക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Well done, my good servant!’ his master replied. ‘Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.’
chapters.nkjv: And he said to him, ‘Well done, good servant; because you were faithful in a very little, have authority over ten cities.’
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തവൻ വന്നു: കർത്താവേ, നീ തന്ന റാത്തൽകൊണ്ടു അഞ്ചു റാത്തൽ സമ്പാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The second came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned five more.’
chapters.nkjv: And the second came, saying, ‘Master, your mina has earned five minas.’
chapters.kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

chapters.ml: നീയും അഞ്ചു പട്ടണത്തിന്നു മേൽവിചാരകൻ ആയിരിക്ക എന്നു അവൻ അവനോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "His master answered, ‘You take charge of five cities.’
chapters.nkjv: Likewise he said to him, ‘You also be over five cities.’
chapters.kjv: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരുവൻ വന്നു: കർത്താവേ, ഇതാ നിന്റെ റാത്തൽ; ഞാൻ അതു ഒരു ഉറുമാലിൽ കെട്ടി വെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Then another servant came and said, ‘Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.
chapters.nkjv: "Then another came, saying, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have kept put away in a handkerchief.
chapters.kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

chapters.ml: നീ വെക്കാത്തതു എടുക്കുകയും വിതെക്കാത്തതു കൊയ്കയും ചെയ്യുന്ന കഠിനമനുഷ്യൻ ആകകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.’
chapters.nkjv: For I feared you, because you are an austere man. You collect what you did not deposit, and reap what you did not sow.’
chapters.kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: ദുഷ്ടദാസനേ, നിന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നു തന്നേ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ന്യായം വിധിക്കും. ഞാൻ വെക്കാത്തതു എടുക്കയും വിതെക്കാത്തതു കൊയ്കയും ചെയ്യുന്ന കഠിനമനുഷ്യൻ എന്നു നീ അറിഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "His master replied, ‘I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant! You knew, did you, that I am a hard man, taking out what I did not put in, and reaping what I did not sow?
chapters.nkjv: And he said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant. You knew that I was an austere man, collecting what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow.
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വന്നു എന്റെ ദ്രവ്യം പലിശയോടുകൂടെ വാങ്ങിക്കൊള്ളേണ്ടതിന്നു അതു നാണ്യപീഠത്തിൽ ഏല്പിക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Why then didn’t you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?’
chapters.nkjv: Why then did you not put my money in the bank, that at my coming I might have collected it with interest?’
chapters.kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അരികെ നില്ക്കുന്നവരോടു: ആ റാത്തൽ അവന്റെ പക്കൽ നിന്നു എടുത്തു പത്തു റാത്തലുള്ളവന്നു കൊടുപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Then he said to those standing by, ‘Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
chapters.nkjv: "And he said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina from him, and give it to him who has ten minas.’
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, അവന്നു പത്തു റാത്തൽ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: " ‘Sir,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’
chapters.nkjv: (But they said to him, ‘Master, he has ten minas.’)
chapters.kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

chapters.ml: ഉള്ളവന്നു ഏവന്നു കൊടുക്കും ഇല്ലാത്തവനോടു ഉള്ളതുംകൂടെ എടുത്തു കളയും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "He replied, ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what they have will be taken away.
chapters.nkjv: ‘For I say to you, that to everyone who has will be given; and from him who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
chapters.kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ തങ്ങൾക്കു രാജാവായിരിക്കുന്നതു സമ്മതമില്ലാത്ത ശത്രുക്കളായവരെ ഇവിടെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നുകളവിൻ എന്നു അവൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them—bring them here and kill them in front of me.’ "
chapters.nkjv: But bring here those enemies of mine, who did not want me to reign over them, and slay them before me.’ "
chapters.kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ മുമ്പായി നടന്നുകൊണ്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു യാത്ര ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: When He had said this, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒലീവ് മലയരികെ ബേത്ത്ഫാഗെക്കും ബേഥാന്യെക്കും സമീപിച്ചപ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരെ അയച്ചു:
chapters.niv: As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, when He drew near to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mountain called Olivet, that He sent two of His disciples,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു എതിരെയുള്ള ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുവിൻ; അതിൽ കടക്കുമ്പോൾ ആരും ഒരിക്കലും കയറീട്ടില്ലാത്ത ഒരു കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെ കെട്ടീയിരിക്കുന്നതു കാണും; അതിനെ അഴിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Go to the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Go into the village opposite you, where as you enter you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Loose it and bring it here.
chapters.kjv: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither .

chapters.ml: അതിനെ അഴിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ആരെങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളോടു ചോദിച്ചാൽ: കർത്താവിന്നു ഇതിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ "
chapters.nkjv: And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you loosing it?’ thus you shall say to him, ‘Because the Lord has need of it.’ "
chapters.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

chapters.ml: അയക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ പോയി തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു പോലെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.
chapters.nkjv: So those who were sent went their way and found it just as He had said to them.
chapters.kjv: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

chapters.ml: കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെ അഴിക്കുമ്പോൾ അതിന്റെ ഉടയവർ: കഴുതക്കുട്ടിയെ അഴിക്കന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു:
chapters.niv: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, "Why are you untying the colt?"
chapters.nkjv: But as they were loosing the colt, the owners of it said to them, "Why are you loosing the colt?"
chapters.kjv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിനു ഇതിനെക്കൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "The Lord needs it."
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "The Lord has need of him."
chapters.kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

chapters.ml: അതിനെ യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം കഴുതക്കുട്ടിമേൽ ഇട്ടു യേശുവിനെ കയറ്റി.
chapters.niv: They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.
chapters.nkjv: Then they brought him to Jesus. And they threw their own clothes on the colt, and they set Jesus on him.
chapters.kjv: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോകുമ്പോൾ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം വഴിയിൽ വിരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.
chapters.nkjv: And as He went, many spread their clothes on the road.
chapters.kjv: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഒലീവുമലയുടെ ഇറക്കത്തിന്നു അടുത്തപ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടം എല്ലാം തങ്ങൾ കണ്ട സകല വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികളെയും കുറിച്ചു സന്തോഷിച്ചു അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ ദൈവത്തെ പുകഴ്ത്തി:
chapters.niv: When he came near the place where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples began joyfully to praise God in loud voices for all the miracles they had seen:
chapters.nkjv: Then, as He was now drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen,
chapters.kjv: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വരുന്ന രാജാവു വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ; സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ സമാധാനവും അത്യുന്നതങ്ങളിൽ മഹത്വവും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
chapters.nkjv: saying: " ‘Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’ Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ ചില പരീശന്മാരോ അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, നിന്റെ ശീഷ്യന്മാരെ വിലക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples!"
chapters.nkjv: And some of the Pharisees called to Him from the crowd, "Teacher, rebuke Your disciples."
chapters.kjv: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “ഇവർ മണ്ടാതിരുന്നാൽ കല്ലുകൾ ആർത്തുവിളിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I tell you," he replied, "if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out."
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said to them, "I tell you that if these should keep silent, the stones would immediately cry out."
chapters.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നഗരത്തിന്നു സമീപിച്ചപ്പോൾ അതിനെ കണ്ടു അതിനെക്കുറിചു കരഞ്ഞു:
chapters.niv: As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it
chapters.nkjv: Now as He drew near, He saw the city and wept over it,
chapters.kjv: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

chapters.ml: ഈ നാളിൽ നിന്റെ സമാധാനത്തിന്നുള്ളതു നീയും അറിഞ്ഞു എങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു. ഇപ്പോഴോ അതു നിന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നു മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and said, "If you, even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace—but now it is hidden from your eyes.
chapters.nkjv: saying, "If you had known, even you, especially in this your day, the things that make for your peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.
chapters.kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ സന്ദർശനകാലം നീ അറിയാഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾ നിനക്കു ചുറ്റും വാടകോരി നിന്നെ വളഞ്ഞു നാലുപുറത്തും ഞെരുക്കി
chapters.niv: The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.
chapters.nkjv: For days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment around you, surround you and close you in on every side,
chapters.kjv: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

chapters.ml: നിന്നെയും നിന്നിലുള്ള നിന്റെ മക്കളെയും നിലത്തു തള്ളിയിട്ടു, നിങ്കൽ കല്ലിന്മേൽ കല്ലു ശേഷിപ്പിക്കാതിരിക്കുന്ന കാലം നിനക്കു വരും.
chapters.niv: They will dash you to the ground, you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of God’s coming to you."
chapters.nkjv: and level you, and your children within you, to the ground; and they will not leave in you one stone upon another, because you did not know the time of your visitation."
chapters.kjv: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു വിൽക്കുന്നവരെ പുറത്താക്കിത്തുടങ്ങി:
chapters.niv: When Jesus entered the temple courts, he began to drive out those who were selling.
chapters.nkjv: Then He went into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
chapters.kjv: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ആലയം പ്രാർത്ഥനാലയം ആകും എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളോ അതിനെ കള്ളന്മാരുടെ ഗുഹ ആക്കിത്തീർത്തു” എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "It is written," he said to them, " ‘My house will be a house of prayer’ ; but you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ "
chapters.nkjv: saying to them, "It is written, ‘My house isa house of prayer,’but you have made it a ‘den of thieves.’ "
chapters.kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദിവസേന ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഉപദേശിച്ചുപോന്നു; എന്നാൽ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും ജനത്തിൽ പ്രധാനികളായവരും അവനെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ തക്കം നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: Every day he was teaching at the temple. But the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the leaders among the people were trying to kill him.
chapters.nkjv: And He was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests, the scribes, and the leaders of the people sought to destroy Him,
chapters.kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ജനം എല്ലാം അവന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടു രഞ്ജിച്ചിരിക്കയാൽ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു എന്നു അവർ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.
chapters.nkjv: and were unable to do anything; for all the people were very attentive to hear Him.
chapters.kjv: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

chapters.ml: ആ ദിവസങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നിൽ അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ജനത്തോടു ഉപദേശിച്ചു സുവിശേഷം അറിയിക്കുമ്പോൾ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരുമായി അടുത്തു വന്നു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened on one of those days, as He taught the people in the temple and preached the gospel, that the chief priests and the scribes, together with the elders, confronted Him
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

chapters.ml: നീ എന്തു അധികാരംകൊണ്ടു ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നു? ഈ അധികാരം നിനക്കു തന്നതു ആർ? ഞങ്ങളോടു പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Tell us by what authority you are doing these things," they said. "Who gave you this authority?"
chapters.nkjv: and spoke to Him, saying, "Tell us, by what authority are You doing these things? Or who is he who gave You this authority?"
chapters.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഉത്തരമായി അവൻ: “ഞാനും നിങ്ങളോടു ഒരു വാക്കു ചോദിക്കും; അതു എന്നോടു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: He replied, "I will also ask you a question. Tell me:
chapters.nkjv: But He answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one thing, and answer Me:
chapters.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാന്റെ സ്നാനം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നോ മനുഷ്യരിൽനിന്നോ ഉണ്ടായതു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin?"
chapters.nkjv: The baptism of John—was it from heaven or from men?"
chapters.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

chapters.ml: അവർ തമ്മിൽ നിരൂപിച്ചു: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാൽ പിന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ വിശ്വസിക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിക്കും.
chapters.niv: They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
chapters.nkjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
chapters.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരിൽനിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാലോ ജനം ഒക്കെയും യോഹന്നാൻ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു ഉറെച്ചിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു നമ്മെ കല്ലെറിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു:
chapters.niv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin,’ all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet."
chapters.nkjv: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet."
chapters.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

chapters.ml: എവിടെനിന്നോ ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So they answered, "We don’t know where it was from."
chapters.nkjv: So they answered that they did not know where itwas from.
chapters.kjv: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was .

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നതു ഇന്ന അധികാരം കൊണ്ടാകുന്നു എന്നുള്ളതു ഞാനും നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നില്ല ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ ജനത്തോടു ഉപമ പറഞ്ഞതെന്തെന്നാൽ: “ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഒരു മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടം നട്ടുണ്ടാക്കി കുടിയാന്മാരെ പാട്ടത്തിന്നു ഏല്പിച്ചിട്ടു ഏറിയ കാലം പരദേശത്തു പോയി പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: He went on to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers and went away for a long time.
chapters.nkjv: Then He began to tell the people this parable: "A certain man planted a vineyard, leased it to vinedressers, and went into a far country for a long time.
chapters.kjv: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

chapters.ml: സമയമായപ്പോൾ കുടിയാന്മാരോടു തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ അനുഭവം വാങ്ങേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഒരു ദാസനെ അയച്ചു; അവനെ കുടിയാന്മാർ തല്ലി വെറുതെ അയച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants so they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.nkjv: Now at vintage-time he sent a servant to the vinedressers, that they might give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the vinedressers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മറ്റൊരു ദാസനെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു; അവനെയും അവർ തല്ലി അപമാനിച്ചു വെറുതെ അയച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.
chapters.nkjv: Again he sent another servant; and they beat him also, treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.kjv: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂന്നാമതു ഒരുത്തനെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു; അവർ അവനെയും മുറിവേല്പിച്ചു പുറത്താക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.
chapters.nkjv: And again he sent a third; and they wounded him also and cast him out.
chapters.kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മുന്തിരിത്തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഉടമസ്ഥൻ: ഞാൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു? എന്റെ പ്രിയ പുത്രനെ അയക്കും; പക്ഷേ അവർ അവനെ ശങ്കിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.’
chapters.nkjv: "Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. Probably they will respect him when they see him.’
chapters.kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

chapters.ml: കുടിയാന്മാർ അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഇവൻ അവകാശി; അവകാശം നമുക്കു ആകേണ്ടതിന്നു നാം അവനെ കൊന്നുകളക എന്നു തമ്മിൽ ആലോചിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "But when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. ‘This is the heir,’ they said. ‘Let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
chapters.nkjv: But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
chapters.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ തോട്ടത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു. എന്നാൽ തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഉടമസ്ഥൻ അവരോടു എന്തു ചെയ്യും?
chapters.niv: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. "What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
chapters.nkjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard and killed him. Therefore what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
chapters.kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

chapters.ml: അവൻ വന്നു ആ കുടിയാന്മാരെ നിഗ്രഹിച്ചു തോട്ടം അന്യന്മാർക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും”. അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു അവർ അങ്ങനെ ഒരുനാളും സംഭവിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others." When the people heard this, they said, "God forbid!"
chapters.nkjv: He will come and destroy those vinedressers and give the vineyard to others." And when they heard it they said, "Certainly not!"
chapters.kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it , they said, God forbid.

chapters.ml: അവനോ അവരെ നോക്കി: “എന്നാൽ വീടുപണിയുന്നവർ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞ കല്ലു മൂലക്കല്ലായിത്തീർന്നു” എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Jesus looked directly at them and asked, "Then what is the meaning of that which is written: " ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’ ?
chapters.nkjv: Then He looked at them and said, "What then is this that is written: ‘The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone’?
chapters.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

chapters.ml: ആ കല്ലിന്മേൽ വീഴുന്ന ഏവനും തകർന്നുപോകും; അതു ആരുടെ മേൽ എങ്കിലും വീണാൽ അവനെ ധൂളിപ്പിക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed."
chapters.nkjv: Whoever falls on that stone will be broken; but on whomever it falls, it will grind him to powder."
chapters.kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

chapters.ml: ഈ ഉപമ തങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ഗ്രഹിച്ചിട്ടു ആ നാഴികയിൽ തന്നേ അവന്റെ മേൽ കൈവെപ്പാൻ നോക്കി എങ്കിലും ജനത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The teachers of the law and the chief priests looked for a way to arrest him immediately, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they were afraid of the people.
chapters.nkjv: And the chief priests and the scribes that very hour sought to lay hands on Him, but they feared the people —for they knew He had spoken this parable against them.
chapters.kjv: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ അവനെ നാടുവാഴിയുടെ അധീനതയിലും അധികാരത്തിലും ഏല്പിപ്പാന്തക്കവണ്ണം അവനെ വാക്കിൽ പിടിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തക്കം നോക്കി നീതിമാന്മാർ എന്നു നടിക്കുന്ന ഒറ്റുകാരെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Keeping a close watch on him, they sent spies, who pretended to be sincere. They hoped to catch Jesus in something he said, so that they might hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.
chapters.nkjv: So they watched Him, and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, that they might seize on His words, in order to deliver Him to the power and the authority of the governor.
chapters.kjv: And they watched him , and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഗുരോ, നീ നേർ പറഞ്ഞു ഉപദേശിക്കയും മുഖപക്ഷം നോക്കാതെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വഴി യഥാർത്ഥമായി പഠിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the spies questioned him: "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
chapters.nkjv: Then they asked Him, saying, "Teacher, we know that You say and teach rightly, and You do not show personal favoritism, but teach the way of God in truth:
chapters.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any , but teachest the way of God truly:

chapters.ml: നാം കൈസർക്കു കരം കൊടുക്കുന്നതു വിഹിതമോ അല്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
chapters.nkjv: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
chapters.kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or no?

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ഉപായം ഗ്രഹിച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഒരു വെള്ളിക്കാശ് കാണിപ്പിൻ;
chapters.niv: He saw through their duplicity and said to them,
chapters.nkjv: But He perceived their craftiness, and said to them, "Why do you test Me?
chapters.kjv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

chapters.ml: അതിനുള്ള സ്വരൂപവും മേലെഴുത്തും ആരുടേതു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: കൈസരുടേതു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?" "Caesar’s," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?" They answered and said, "Caesar’s."
chapters.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cæsar’s.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കൈസർക്കുള്ളതു കൈസർക്കും ദൈവത്തിന്നുള്ളതു ദൈവത്തിന്നും കൊടുപ്പിൻ ” എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Then give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു അവനെ വാക്കിൽ പിടിപ്പാൻ കഴിയാതെ അവന്റെ ഉത്തരത്തിൽ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.
chapters.nkjv: But they could not catch Him in His words in the presence of the people. And they marveled at His answer and kept silent.
chapters.kjv: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

chapters.ml: പുനരുത്ഥാനം ഇല്ല എന്നു പറയുന്ന സദൂക്യരിൽ ചിലർ അടുത്തു വന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചതു:
chapters.niv: Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection, came to Him and asked Him,
chapters.kjv: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

chapters.ml: ഗുരോ, ഒരുത്തന്റെ സഹോദരൻ വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചിട്ടു മക്കളില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചുപോയാൽ അവന്റെ സഹോദരൻ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു സഹോദരന്നു സന്തതിയെ ജനിപ്പിക്കേണം എന്നു മോശെ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
chapters.nkjv: saying: "Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies, having a wife, and he dies without children, his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
chapters.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏഴു സഹോദരന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവരിൽ ഒന്നാമത്തവൻ ഒരു സ്ത്രീയെ വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചു മക്കളില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman and died childless.
chapters.nkjv: Now there were seven brothers. And the first took a wife, and died without children.
chapters.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തവനും മൂന്നാമത്തവനും അവളെ പരിഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The second
chapters.nkjv: And the second took her as wife, and he died childless.
chapters.kjv: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

chapters.ml: അവ്വണ്ണം ഏഴുപേരും ചെയ്തു മക്കളില്ലാതെ മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.
chapters.nkjv: Then the third took her, and in like manner the seven also; and they left no children, and died.
chapters.kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

chapters.ml: ഒടുവിൽ സ്ത്രീയും മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Finally, the woman died too.
chapters.nkjv: Last of all the woman died also.
chapters.kjv: Last of all the woman died also.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിൽ അവൾ അവരിൽ ഏവന്നു ഭാര്യയാകും? ഏഴുവർക്കും ഭാര്യയായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Now then, at the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife does she become? For all seven had her as wife."
chapters.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഈ ലോകത്തിന്റെ മക്കൾ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കയും വിവാഹത്തിന്നു കൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ആ ലോകത്തിന്നും മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നുള്ള പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിന്നും യോഗ്യരായവർ വിവാഹം കഴിയക്കയുമില്ല വിവാഹത്തിന്നു കൊടുക്കപ്പെടുകയുമില്ല; അവർക്കു ഇനി മരിപ്പാനും കഴികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: But those who are considered worthy of taking part in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,
chapters.nkjv: But those who are counted worthy to attain that age, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage;
chapters.kjv: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുനരുത്ഥാനപുത്രന്മാരാകയാൽ ദൈവദൂതതുല്യരും ദൈവ പുത്രന്മാരും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God’s children, since they are children of the resurrection.
chapters.nkjv: nor can they die anymore, for they are equal to the angels and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
chapters.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവർ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കുന്നു എന്നതോ മോശെയും മുൾപ്പടർപ്പുഭാഗത്തു കർത്താവിനെ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ ദൈവവും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെ ദൈവവും യാക്കോബിന്റെ ദൈവവും എന്നു പറയുന്നതിനാൽ സൂചിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But in the account of the burning bush, even Moses showed that the dead rise, for he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
chapters.nkjv: But even Moses showed in the burning bush passage that the dead are raised, when he called the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
chapters.kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

chapters.ml: ദൈവമോ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ദൈവമല്ല, ജീവനുള്ളവരുടെ ദൈവമത്രേ; എല്ലാവരും അവന്നു ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive."
chapters.nkjv: For He is not the God of the dead but of the living, for all live to Him."
chapters.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ചില ശാസ്ത്രിമാർ: ഗുരോ, നീ പറഞ്ഞതു ശരി എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some of the teachers of the law responded, "Well said, teacher!"
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the scribes answered and said, "Teacher, You have spoken well."
chapters.kjv: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവനോടു ഒന്നും ചോദിപ്പാൻ അവർ തുനിഞ്ഞതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: And no one dared to ask him any more questions.
chapters.nkjv: But after that they dared not question Him anymore.
chapters.kjv: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ അവരോടു: “ക്രിസ്തു ദാവീദിന്റെ പുത്രൻ എന്നു പറയുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ?
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to them, "Why is it said that the Messiah is the son of David?
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "How can they say that the Christ is the Son of David?
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David’s son?

chapters.ml: “കർത്താവു എന്റെ കർത്താവിനോടു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ നിന്റെ പാദപീഠമാക്കുവോളം എന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തിരിക്ക എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു”
chapters.niv: David himself declares in the Book of Psalms: " ‘The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand
chapters.nkjv: Now David himself said in the Book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand,
chapters.kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

chapters.ml: എന്നു സങ്കീർത്തനപുസ്തകത്തിൽ ദാവീദ് തന്നേ പറയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." ’
chapters.nkjv: Till I make Your enemies Your footstool." ’
chapters.kjv: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് അവനെ കർത്താവു എന്നു വിളിക്കുന്നു; പിന്നെ അവന്റെ പുത്രൻ ആകുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: David calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore David calls Him ‘Lord’; how is He then his Son?"
chapters.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ജനം ഒക്കെയും കേൾക്കെ അവൻ തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു:
chapters.niv: While all the people were listening, Jesus said to his disciples,
chapters.nkjv: Then, in the hearing of all the people, He said to His disciples,
chapters.kjv: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

chapters.ml: നിലയങ്കികളോടെ നടപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കയും അങ്ങാടിയിൽ വന്ദനവും പള്ളിയിൽ മുഖ്യാസനവും അത്താഴത്തിൽ പ്രധാനസ്ഥലവും പ്രിയപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ശാസ്ത്രിമാരെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Beware of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
chapters.nkjv: "Beware of the scribes, who desire to go around in long robes, love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts,
chapters.kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

chapters.ml: അവർ വിധവമാരുടെ വീടുകളെ വിഴുങ്ങുകയും ഉപായരൂപേണ ദീർഘമായി പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവർക്കു ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ശിക്ഷാവിധിവരും.
chapters.niv: They devour widows’ houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will be punished most severely."
chapters.nkjv: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation."
chapters.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തലപൊക്കി ധനവാന്മാർ ഭണ്ഡാരത്തിൽ വഴിപാടു ഇടുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: As Jesus looked up, he saw the rich putting their gifts into the temple treasury.
chapters.nkjv: And He looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,
chapters.kjv: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

chapters.ml: ദരിദ്രയായോരു വിധവ രണ്ടു കാശു ഇടുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവൻ:
chapters.niv: He also saw a poor widow put in two very small copper coins.
chapters.nkjv: and He saw also a certain poor widow putting in two mites.
chapters.kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

chapters.ml: “ഈ ദരിദ്രയായ വിധവ എല്ലാവരെക്കാളും അധികം ഇട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായി നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you," he said, "this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
chapters.nkjv: So He said, "Truly I say to you that this poor widow has put in more than all;
chapters.kjv: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും തങ്ങളുടെ സമൃദ്ധിയിൽ നിന്നല്ലോ വഴിപാടു ഇട്ടതു; ഇവളോ തന്റെ ഇല്ലായ്മയിൽ നിന്നു തനിക്കുള്ള ഉപജീവനം ഒക്കെയും ഇട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All these people gave their gifts out of their wealth; but she out of her poverty put in all she had to live on."
chapters.nkjv: for all these out of their abundance have put in offerings for God, but she out of her poverty put in all the livelihood that she had."
chapters.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

chapters.ml: ചിലർ ദൈവാലയത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു അതു മനോഹരമായ കല്ലുകളാലും വഴിപാടുകളാലും അലങ്കരിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ:
chapters.niv: Some of his disciples were remarking about how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and with gifts dedicated to God. But Jesus said,
chapters.nkjv: Then, as some spoke of the temple, how it was adorned with beautiful stones and donations, He said,
chapters.kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
