chapters.ml: ഈ കാണുന്നതിൽ ഇടിഞ്ഞുപോകാതെ കല്ലു കല്ലിന്മേൽ ശേഷിക്കാത്ത കാലം വരും” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one of them will be thrown down."
chapters.nkjv: "These things which you see—the days will come in which not one stone shall be left upon another that shall not be thrown down."
chapters.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

chapters.ml: ഗുരോ, അതു എപ്പോൾ ഉണ്ടാകും? അതു സംഭവിപ്പാറാകുമ്പോഴുള്ള ലക്ഷണം എന്തു എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Teacher," they asked, "when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?"
chapters.nkjv: So they asked Him, saying, "Teacher, but when will these things be? And what sign willtherebe when these things are about to take place?"
chapters.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “ആരും നിങ്ങളെ തെറ്റിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ. ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നും സമയം അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നും പറഞ്ഞു അനേകർ എന്റെ പേരെടുത്തു വരും; അവരെ അനുഗമിക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: He replied: "Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.
chapters.nkjv: And He said: "Take heed that you not be deceived. For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time has drawn near.’ Therefore do not go after them.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യുദ്ധങ്ങളെയും കലഹങ്ങളെയും കുറിച്ചു കേൾക്കുമ്പോൾ ഞെട്ടിപ്പോകരുതു; അതു ആദ്യം സംഭവിക്കേണ്ടതു തന്നേ. അവസാനം ഉടനെ അല്ലതാനും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When you hear of wars and uprisings, do not be frightened. These things must happen first, but the end will not come right away."
chapters.nkjv: But when you hear of wars and commotions, do not be terrified; for these things must come to pass first, but the end will not come immediately."
chapters.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ജാതി ജാതിയോടും രാജ്യം രാജ്യത്തോടും എതിർക്കും.
chapters.niv: Then he said to them: "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
chapters.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

chapters.ml: വലിയ ഭൂകമ്പവും ക്ഷാമവും മഹാവ്യാധികളും അവിടവിടെ ഉണ്ടാകും; ഭയങ്കരകാഴ്ചകളും ആകാശത്തിൽ മഹാ ലക്ഷ്യങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.
chapters.nkjv: And there will be great earthquakes in various places, and famines and pestilences; and there will be fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
chapters.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

chapters.ml: ഇതു എല്ലാറ്റിന്നും മുമ്പെ എന്റെ നാമംനിമിത്തം അവർ നിങ്ങളുടെമേൽ കൈവെച്ചു രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെയും നാടുവാഴികളുടെയും മുമ്പിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി ഉപദ്രവിക്കയും പള്ളികളിലും തടവുകളിലും ഏല്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: "But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. They will hand you over to synagogues and put you in prison, and you will be brought before kings and governors, and all on account of my name.
chapters.nkjv: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and prisons. You will be brought before kings and rulers for My name’s sake.
chapters.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.

chapters.ml: അതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു സാക്ഷ്യം പറവാൻ തരം ആകും.
chapters.niv: And so you will bear testimony to me.
chapters.nkjv: But it will turn out for you as an occasion for testimony.
chapters.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ പ്രതിവാദിപ്പാൻ മുമ്പുകൂട്ടി വിചാരിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മനസ്സിൽ ഉറെച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: But make up your mind not to worry beforehand how you will defend yourselves.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore settle it in your hearts not to meditate beforehand on what you will answer;
chapters.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ എതിരികൾക്കു ആർക്കും ചെറുപ്പാനോ എതിർപറവാനോ കഴിയാത്ത വാക്കും ജ്ഞാനവും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തരും.
chapters.niv: For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
chapters.nkjv: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to contradict or resist.
chapters.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും ചാർച്ചക്കാരും ചങ്ങാതികളും നിങ്ങളെ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കയും നിങ്ങളിൽ ചിലരെ കൊല്ലിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.
chapters.nkjv: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers, relatives and friends; and they will put some of you to death.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നാമം നിമിത്തം എല്ലാവരും നിങ്ങളെ പകെക്കും.
chapters.niv: Everyone will hate you because of me.
chapters.nkjv: And you will be hated by all for My name’s sake.
chapters.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ തലയിലെ ഒരു രോമംപോലും നശിച്ചുപോകയില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: But not a hair of your head will perish.
chapters.nkjv: But not a hair of your head shall be lost.
chapters.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ക്ഷമകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാണനെ നേടും.
chapters.niv: Stand firm, and you will win life.
chapters.nkjv: By your patience possess your souls.
chapters.kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.

chapters.ml: സൈന്യങ്ങൾ യെരൂശലേമിനെ വളഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നതു കാണുമ്പോൾ അതിന്റെ ശൂന്യകാലം അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "When you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.
chapters.nkjv: "But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is near.
chapters.kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യെഹൂദ്യയിലുള്ളവർ മലകളിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോകട്ടെ; അതിന്റെ നടുവിലുള്ളവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോകട്ടെ; നാട്ടുപുറങ്ങളിലുള്ളവർ അതിൽ കടക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.
chapters.nkjv: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those who are in the midst of her depart, and let not those who are in the country enter her.
chapters.kjv: Then let them which are in Judæa flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

chapters.ml: എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതെല്ലാം നിവൃത്തിയാകേണ്ടതിന്നു ആ നാളുകൾ പ്രതികാരകാലം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.
chapters.nkjv: For these are the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
chapters.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഗർഭിണികൾക്കും മുല കുടിപ്പിക്കുന്നവർക്കും അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം! ദേശത്തു വലിയ ഞെരുക്കവും ഈ ജനത്തിന്മേൽ ക്രോധവും ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers! There will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.
chapters.nkjv: But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing babies in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath upon this people.
chapters.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

chapters.ml: അവർ വാളിന്റെ വായ്ത്തലയാൽ വീഴുകയും അവരെ സകലജാതികളിലേക്കും ബദ്ധരായി കൊണ്ടുപോകയും ജാതികളുടെ കാലം തികയുവോളം ജാതികൾ യെരൂശലേം ചവിട്ടിക്കളകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
chapters.nkjv: And they will fall by the edge of the sword, and be led away captive into all nations. And Jerusalem will be trampled by Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
chapters.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

chapters.ml: സൂര്യനിലും ചന്ദ്രനിലും നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളിലും ലക്ഷ്യങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടാകും; കടലിന്റെയും ഓളത്തിന്റെയും മുഴക്കം നിമിത്തം ഭൂമിയിലെ ജാതികൾക്കു നിരാശയോടു കൂടിയ പരിഭ്രമം ഉണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: "There will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.
chapters.nkjv: "And there will be signs in the sun, in the moon, and in the stars; and on the earth distress of nations, with perplexity, the sea and the waves roaring;
chapters.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

chapters.ml: ആകാശത്തിന്റെ ശക്തികൾ ഇളകിപ്പോകുന്നതിനാൽ ഭൂലോകത്തിന്നു എന്തു ഭവിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു പേടിച്ചും നോക്കിപ്പാർത്തുംകൊണ്ടു മനുഷ്യർ നിർജ്ജീവന്മാർ ആകും.
chapters.niv: People will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.
chapters.nkjv: men’s hearts failing them from fear and the expectation of those things which are coming on the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
chapters.kjv: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ശക്തിയോടും മഹാതേജസ്സോടും കൂടെ മേഘത്തിൽ വരുന്നതു അവർ കാണും.
chapters.niv: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
chapters.nkjv: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
chapters.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

chapters.ml: ഇതു സംഭവിച്ചുതുടങ്ങുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പു അടുത്തുവരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നിവിർന്നു തല പൊക്കുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near."
chapters.nkjv: Now when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption draws near."
chapters.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

chapters.ml: ഒരുപമയും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “അത്തി മുതലായ സകല വൃക്ഷങ്ങളെയും നോക്കുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: He told them this parable: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
chapters.nkjv: Then He spoke to them a parable: "Look at the fig tree, and all the trees.
chapters.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

chapters.ml: അവ തളിർക്കുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾ കാണുമ്പോൾ വേനൽ അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു സ്വതവെ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
chapters.nkjv: When they are already budding, you see and know for yourselves that summer is now near.
chapters.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

chapters.ml: അവ്വണ്ണം തന്നേ ഇതു സംഭവിക്കുന്നതു കാണുമ്പോൾ ദൈവരാജ്യം അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഗ്രഹിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.
chapters.nkjv: So you also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
chapters.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

chapters.ml: സകലവും സംഭവിക്കുവോളം ഈ തലമുറ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകയില്ല ” എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായിട്ടു നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.nkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, this generation will by no means pass away till all things take place.
chapters.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

chapters.ml: ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകും; എന്റെ വചനങ്ങളോ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
chapters.nkjv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.
chapters.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയം അതിഭക്ഷണത്താലും മദ്യപാനത്താലും ഉപജീവനചിന്തകളാലും ഭാരപ്പെട്ടിട്ടു ആ ദിവസം നിങ്ങൾക്കു പെട്ടെന്നു കണിപോലെ വരാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു കൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Be careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you suddenly like a trap.
chapters.nkjv: "But take heed to yourselves, lest your hearts be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that Day come on you unexpectedly.
chapters.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

chapters.ml: അതു സർവ്വഭൂതലത്തിലും വസിക്കുന്ന ഏവർക്കും വരും.
chapters.niv: For it will come on all those who live on the face of the whole earth.
chapters.nkjv: For it will come as a snare on all those who dwell on the face of the whole earth.
chapters.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഈ സംഭവിപ്പാനുള്ള എല്ലാറ്റിന്നും ഒഴിഞ്ഞു പോകുവാനും മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നില്പാനും നിങ്ങൾ പ്രാപ്തരാകേണ്ടതിന്നു സദാകാലവും ഉണർന്നും പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man."
chapters.nkjv: Watch therefore, and pray always that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will come to pass, and to stand before the Son of Man."
chapters.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദിവസേന പകൽ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഉപദേശിച്ചുപോന്നു; രാത്രി ഓലിവ്മലയിൽ പോയി പാർക്കും.
chapters.niv: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,
chapters.nkjv: And in the daytime He was teaching in the temple, but at night He went out and stayed on the mountain called Olivet.
chapters.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

chapters.ml: ജനം എല്ലാം അവന്റെ വചനം കേൾക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അതികാലത്തു ദൈവലായത്തിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലും.
chapters.niv: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.
chapters.nkjv: Then early in the morning all the people came to Him in the temple to hear Him.
chapters.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

chapters.ml: പെസഹ എന്ന പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തിന്റെ പെരുനാൾ അടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
chapters.nkjv: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread drew near, which is called Passover.
chapters.kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും ജനത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടുകയാൽ അവനെ ഒടുക്കുവാൻ ഉപായം അന്വേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.
chapters.nkjv: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might kill Him, for they feared the people.
chapters.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പന്തിരുവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ഉള്ള ഈസ്കാര്യോത്തായൂദയിൽ സാത്താൻ കടന്നു:
chapters.niv: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.
chapters.nkjv: Then Satan entered Judas, surnamed Iscariot, who was numbered among the twelve.
chapters.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെന്നു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരോടും പടനായകന്മാരോടും അവനെ അവർക്കു കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്ന വഴിയെക്കുറിച്ചു സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: So he went his way and conferred with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray Him to them.
chapters.kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

chapters.ml: അവർ സന്തോഷിച്ചു അവന്നു ദ്രവ്യം കൊടുക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞൊത്തു.
chapters.niv: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
chapters.nkjv: And they were glad, and agreed to give him money.
chapters.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വാക്കു കൊടുത്തു, പുരുഷാരം ഇല്ലാത്ത സമയത്തു അവനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാൻ തക്കം അന്വേഷിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.
chapters.nkjv: So he promised and sought opportunity to betray Him to them in the absence of the multitude.
chapters.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

chapters.ml: പെസഹകുഞ്ഞാടിനെ അറുക്കേണ്ടുന്ന പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തിന്റെ പെരുനാൾ ആയപ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
chapters.nkjv: Then came the Day of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover must be killed.
chapters.kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പത്രൊസിനെയും യോഹന്നാനെയും അയച്ചു: “നിങ്ങൾ പോയി നമുക്കു പെസഹ കഴിപ്പാൻ ഒരുക്കുവിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover."
chapters.nkjv: And He sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat."
chapters.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ എവിടെ ഒരുക്കേണം എന്നു അവർ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു:
chapters.niv: "Where do you want us to prepare for it?" they asked.
chapters.nkjv: So they said to Him, "Where do You want us to prepare?"
chapters.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പട്ടണത്തിൽ എത്തുമ്പോൾ ഒരു കുടം വെള്ളം ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എതിർപെടും; അവൻ കടക്കുന്ന വീട്ടിലേക്കു പിൻചെന്നു വീട്ടുടയവനോടു:
chapters.niv: He replied, "As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Behold, when you have entered the city, a man will meet you carrying a pitcher of water; follow him into the house which he enters.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുമായി പെസഹ കഴിപ്പാനുള്ള ശാല എവിടെ എന്നു ഗുരു നിന്നോടു ചോദിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറവിൻ.
chapters.niv: and say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’
chapters.nkjv: Then you shall say to the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, "Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?" ’
chapters.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

chapters.ml: അവൻ വിരിച്ചൊരുക്കിയോരു വന്മാളിക കാണിച്ചുതരും; അവിടെ ഒരുക്കുവിൻ ”എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He will show you a large room upstairs, all furnished. Make preparations there."
chapters.nkjv: Then he will show you a large, furnished upper room; there make ready."
chapters.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോയി തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ കണ്ടു പെസഹ ഒരുക്കി.
chapters.niv: They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
chapters.nkjv: So they went and found it just as He had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
chapters.kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

chapters.ml: സമയം ആയപ്പോൾ അവൻ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുമായി ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നു ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.
chapters.nkjv: When the hour had come, He sat down, and the twelve apostles with Him.
chapters.kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിക്കും മുമ്പെ ഈ പെസഹ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ കഴിപ്പാൻ വാഞ്ഛയോടെ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And he said to them, "I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "With fervent desire I have desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer;
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

chapters.ml: അതു ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ നിവൃത്തിയാകുവോളം ഞാൻ ഇനി അതു കഴിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God."
chapters.nkjv: for I say to you, I will no longer eat of it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പാനപാത്രം എടുത്തു വാഴ്ത്തി: “ഇതു വാങ്ങി പങ്കിട്ടുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, "Take this and divide it among you.
chapters.nkjv: Then He took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, "Take this and divide it among yourselves;
chapters.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

chapters.ml: ദൈവരാജ്യം വരുവോളം ഞാൻ മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയുടെ അനുഭവം ഇന്നു മുതൽ കുടിക്കില്ല ” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For I tell you I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
chapters.nkjv: for I say to you,I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
chapters.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അപ്പം എടുത്തു വാഴ്ത്തി നുറുക്കി അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു: “ഇതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി നല്കുന്ന എന്റെ ശരീരം; എന്റെ ഓർമ്മെക്കായി ഇതു ചെയ്‍വിൻ ”എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me."
chapters.nkjv: And He took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is My body which is given for you; do this in remembrance of Me."
chapters.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it , and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

chapters.ml: അവ്വണ്ണം തന്നേ അത്താഴം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം അവൻ പാനപാത്രവും കൊടുത്തു: “ഈ പാനപാത്രം നിങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി ചൊരിയുന്ന എന്റെ രക്തത്തിലെ പുതിയ നിയമം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
chapters.nkjv: Likewise He also took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is shed for you.
chapters.kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എന്നെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നവന്റെ കൈ എന്റെ അരികെ മേശപ്പുറത്തു ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.
chapters.nkjv: But behold, the hand of My betrayer is with Me on the table.
chapters.kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

chapters.ml: നിർണ്ണയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ പോകുന്നു സത്യം; എങ്കിലും അവനെ കാണിച്ചു കൊടുക്കുന്ന മനുഷ്യന്നു അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം!” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed. But woe to that man who betrays him!"
chapters.nkjv: And truly the Son of Man goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!"
chapters.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

chapters.ml: ഇതു ചെയ്‍വാൻ പോകുന്നവൻ തങ്ങളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ആർ ആയിരിക്കും എന്നു അവർ തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ ചോദിച്ചു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.
chapters.nkjv: Then they began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
chapters.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ആരെ ആകുന്നു വലിയവനായി എണ്ണേണ്ടതു എന്നതിനെച്ചൊല്ലി ഒരു തർക്കവും അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: A dispute also arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was also a dispute among them, as to which of them should be considered the greatest.
chapters.kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

chapters.ml: അവനോ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ജാതികളുടെ രാജാക്കന്മാർ അവരിൽ കർത്തൃത്വം നടത്തുന്നു; അവരുടെ മേൽ അധികാരം നടത്തുന്നവരെ ഉപകാരികൾ എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them, and those who exercise authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ അങ്ങനെയല്ല; നിങ്ങളിൽ വലിയവൻ ഇളയവനെപ്പോലെയും നായകൻ ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കുന്നവനെപ്പോലെയും ആകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.
chapters.nkjv: But not so among you; on the contrary, he who is greatest among you, let him be as the younger, and he who governs as he who serves.
chapters.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

chapters.ml: ആരാകുന്നു വലിയവൻ? ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരിക്കുന്നവനോ ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കുന്നവനോ? ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നിരിക്കുന്നവനല്ലയോ? ഞാനോ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കുന്നവനെപ്പോലെ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
chapters.nkjv: For who is greater, he who sits at the table, or he who serves? Is it not he who sits at the table? Yet I am among you as the One who serves.
chapters.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ആകുന്നു എന്റെ പരീക്ഷകളിൽ എന്നോടുകൂടെ നിലനിന്നവർ.
chapters.niv: You are those who have stood by me in my trials.
chapters.nkjv: "But you are those who have continued with Me in My trials.
chapters.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിതാവു എനിക്കു രാജ്യം നിയമിച്ചുതന്നതുപോലെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കും നിയമിച്ചു തരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,
chapters.nkjv: And I bestow upon you a kingdom, just as My Father bestowed one upon Me,
chapters.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ രാജ്യത്തിൽ എന്റെ മേശയിങ്കൽ തിന്നുകുടിക്കയും സിംഹാസനങ്ങളിൽ ഇരുന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ ഗോത്രം പന്ത്രണ്ടിനെയും ന്യായം വിധിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel."
chapters.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

chapters.ml: ശിമോനേ, ശിമോനെ, സാത്താൻ നിങ്ങളെ കോതമ്പു പോലെ പാറ്റേണ്ടതിന്നു കല്പന ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you as wheat.
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord said, "Simon, Simon! Indeed, Satan has asked for you, that he may sift you as wheat.
chapters.kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ നിന്റെ വിശ്വാസം പൊയ്പോകാതിരിപ്പാൻ നിനക്കു വേണ്ടി അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ നീ ഒരു സമയം തിരിഞ്ഞു വന്നശേഷം നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ ഉറപ്പിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."
chapters.nkjv: But I have prayed for you, that your faith should not fail; and when you have returned to Me, strengthen your brethren."
chapters.kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ തടവിലാകുവാനും മരിപ്പാനും ഒരുങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he replied, "Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death."
chapters.nkjv: But he said to Him, "Lord, I am ready to go with You, both to prison and to death."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “പത്രൊസെ, നീ എന്നെ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു മൂന്നുവട്ടം തള്ളിപ്പറയുംമുമ്പെ ഇന്നു കോഴി കൂകുകയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said, "I tell you, Peter, the rooster shall not crow this day before you will deny three times that you know Me."
chapters.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ മടിശ്ശീലയും പൊക്കണവും ചെരിപ്പും കൂടാതെ അയച്ചപ്പോൾ വല്ല കുറവുമുണ്ടായോ ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഒരു കുറവുമുണ്ടായില്ല എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus asked them, "When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?" "Nothing," they answered.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "When I sent you without money bag, knapsack, and sandals, did you lack anything?" So they said, "Nothing."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ മടിശ്ശീലയുള്ളവൻ അതു എടുക്കട്ടെ; അവ്വണ്ണം തന്നേ പൊക്കണമുള്ളവനും; ഇല്ലാത്തവനോ തന്റെ വസ്ത്രം വിറ്റു വാൾ കൊള്ളട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: He said to them, "But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don’t have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "But now, he who has a money bag, let him take it, and likewise a knapsack; and he who has no sword, let him sell his garment and buy one.
chapters.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it , and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

chapters.ml: അവനെ അധർമ്മികളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ എണ്ണി എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതിന്നു ഇനി എന്നിൽ നിവൃത്തിവരേണം എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു; എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതിന്നു നിവൃത്തി വരുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: It is written: ‘And he was numbered with the transgressors’ ; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment."
chapters.nkjv: For I say to you that this which is written must still be accomplished in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For the things concerning Me have an end."
chapters.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, ഇവിടെ രണ്ടു വാൾ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: “മതി ” എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The disciples said, "See, Lord, here are two swords." "That’s enough!" he replied.
chapters.nkjv: So they said, "Lord, look, here are two swords." And He said to them, "It is enough."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പതിവുപോലെ ഒലീവ് മലെക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി; ശിഷ്യന്മാരും അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.
chapters.nkjv: Coming out, He went to the Mount of Olives, as He was accustomed, and His disciples also followed Him.
chapters.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ഥലത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷയിൽ അകപ്പെടാതിരിപ്പാൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പിൻ ”എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On reaching the place, he said to them, "Pray that you will not fall into temptation."
chapters.nkjv: When He came to the place, He said to them, "Pray that you may not enter into temptation."
chapters.kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

chapters.ml: താൻ അവരെ വിട്ടു ഒരു കല്ലേറുദൂരത്തോളം വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി മുട്ടുകുത്തി;
chapters.niv: He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,
chapters.nkjv: And He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and He knelt down and prayed,
chapters.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

chapters.ml: പിതാവേ, നിനക്കു മനസ്സുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഈ പാനപാത്രം എങ്കൽ നിന്നു നീക്കേണമേ; എങ്കിലും എന്റെ ഇഷ്ടമല്ല നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംതന്നെയാകട്ടെ” എന്നു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Father, if it is Your will, take this cup away from Me; nevertheless not My will, but Yours, be done."
chapters.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ശക്തിപ്പെടുത്തുവാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒരു ദൂതൻ അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.
chapters.nkjv: Then an angel appeared to Him from heaven, strengthening Him.
chapters.kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പ്രാണവേദനയിലായി അതിശ്രദ്ധയോടെ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു; അവന്റെ വിയർപ്പു നിലത്തു വീഴുന്ന വലിയ ചോരത്തുള്ളിപോലെ ആയി.
chapters.niv: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.
chapters.nkjv: And being in agony, He prayed more earnestly. Then His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
chapters.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പ്രാർത്ഥന കഴിഞ്ഞു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു, അവർ വിഷാദത്താൽ ഉറങ്ങുന്നതു കണ്ടു അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
chapters.nkjv: When He rose up from prayer, and had come to His disciples, He found them sleeping from sorrow.
chapters.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഉറങ്ങുന്നതു എന്തു? പരീക്ഷയിൽ അകപ്പെടാതിരപ്പാൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Why are you sleeping?" he asked them. "Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "Why do you sleep? Rise and pray, lest you enter into temptation."
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ ഇതാ, ഒരു പുരുഷാരം; പന്തിരുവരിൽ ഒരുവനായ യൂദാ അവർക്കു മുന്നടന്നു യേശുവിനെ ചുംബിപ്പാൻ അടുത്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,
chapters.nkjv: And while He was still speaking, behold, a multitude; and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them and drew near to Jesus to kiss Him.
chapters.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “യൂദയേ, മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെ ചുംബനംകൊണ്ടോ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but Jesus asked him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
chapters.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

chapters.ml: സംഭവിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നതു അവന്റെ കൂടെയുള്ളവർ കണ്ടു: കർത്താവേ, ഞങ്ങൾ വാൾകൊണ്ടു വെട്ടേണമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus’ followers saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"
chapters.nkjv: When those around Him saw what was going to happen, they said to Him, "Lord, shall we strike with the sword?"
chapters.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ ദാസനെ വെട്ടി അവന്റെ വലത്തെ കാതു അറുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
chapters.nkjv: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
chapters.kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യേശു; “ഇത്രെക്കു വിടുവിൻ ”എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവന്റെ കാതു തൊട്ടു സൌഖ്യമാക്കി.
chapters.niv: But Jesus answered, "No more of this!" And he touched the man’s ear and healed him.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answered and said, "Permit even this." And He touched his ear and healed him.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

chapters.ml: യേശു തന്റെ നേരെ വന്ന മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരോടും ദൈവാലയത്തിലെ പടനായകന്മാരോടും മൂപ്പന്മാരോടും: “ഒരു കള്ളന്റെ നേരെ എന്നപോലെ നിങ്ങൾ വാളും വടിയുമായി പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, "Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and the elders who had come to Him, "Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദിവസേന ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നിട്ടും എന്റെ നേരെ കൈ ഓങ്ങിയില്ല; എന്നാൽ ഇതു നിങ്ങളുടെ നാഴികയും ഇരുളിന്റെ അധികാരവും ആകുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns."
chapters.nkjv: When I was with you daily in the temple, you did not try to seize Me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness."
chapters.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി; പത്രൊസും അകലം വിട്ടു പിൻചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.
chapters.nkjv: Having arrested Him, they led Him and brought Him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed at a distance.
chapters.kjv: Then took they him, and led him , and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.

chapters.ml: അവർ നടുമുറ്റത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യേ തീ കത്തിച്ചു ഒന്നിച്ചിരുന്നപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസും അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And when some there had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat among them.
chapters.kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തീവെട്ടത്തിന്നടുക്കെ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരത്തി കണ്ടു അവനെ ഉറ്റു നോക്കി: ഇവനും അവനോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, "This man was with him."
chapters.nkjv: And a certain servant girl, seeing him as he sat by the fire, looked intently at him and said, "This man was also with Him."
chapters.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

chapters.ml: അവനോ; സ്ത്രിയേ, ഞാൻ അവനെ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു തള്ളിപ്പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he denied it. "Woman, I don’t know him," he said.
chapters.nkjv: But he denied Him, saying, "Woman, I do not know Him."
chapters.kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

chapters.ml: കുറഞ്ഞോന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു മറ്റൊരുവൻ അവനെ കണ്ടു: നീയും അവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലുള്ളവൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; പത്രൊസോ: മനുഷ്യാ, ഞാൻ അല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: A little later someone else saw him and said, "You also are one of them." "Man, I am not!" Peter replied.
chapters.nkjv: And after a little while another saw him and said, "You also are of them." But Peter said, "Man, I am not!"
chapters.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

chapters.ml: ഏകദേശം ഒരു മണി നേരം കഴിഞ്ഞാറെ വേറൊരുവൻ: ഇവനും അവനോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു സത്യം; ഇവൻ ഗലീലക്കാരനല്ലോ എന്നു നിഷ്കർഷിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."
chapters.nkjv: Then after about an hour had passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, "Surely this fellow also was with Him, for he is a Galilean."
chapters.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilæan.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യാ, നീ പറയുന്നതു എനിക്കു തിരിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു പത്രൊസ് പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ പെട്ടെന്നു കോഴി കൂകി.
chapters.niv: Peter replied, "Man, I don’t know what you’re talking about!" Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.
chapters.nkjv: But Peter said, "Man, I do not know what you are saying!" Immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
chapters.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ കർത്താവു തിരിഞ്ഞു പത്രൊസിനെ ഒന്നു നോക്കി: “ഇന്നു കോഴി കൂകുംമുമ്പെ നീ മൂന്നുവട്ടം എന്നെ തള്ളിപ്പറയും” എന്നു കർത്താവു തന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു പത്രൊസു ഓർത്തു
chapters.niv: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: "Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times."
chapters.nkjv: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, "Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times."
chapters.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

chapters.ml: പുറത്തിറങ്ങി അതിദുഃഖത്തോട കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he went outside and wept bitterly.
chapters.nkjv: So Peter went out and wept bitterly.
chapters.kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

chapters.ml: യേശുവിനെ പിടിച്ചവർ അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു കണ്ണുകെട്ടി തല്ലി:
chapters.niv: The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.
chapters.nkjv: Now the men who held Jesus mocked Him and beat Him.
chapters.kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him .

chapters.ml: പ്രവചിക്ക; നിന്നെ അടിച്ചവൻ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു
chapters.niv: They blindfolded him and demanded, "Prophesy! Who hit you?"
chapters.nkjv: And having blindfolded Him, they struck Him on the face and asked Him, saying, "Prophesy! Who is the one who struck You?"
chapters.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

chapters.ml: മറ്റു പലതും അവനെ ദുഷിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And they said many other insulting things to him.
chapters.nkjv: And many other things they blasphemously spoke against Him.
chapters.kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

chapters.ml: നേരം വെളുത്തപ്പോൾ ജനത്തിന്റെ മൂപ്പന്മാരായ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും വന്നുകൂടി അവനെ ന്യായാധിപസംഘത്തിൽ വരുത്തി: നീ ക്രിസ്തു എങ്കിൽ ഞങ്ങളോടു പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and the teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.
chapters.nkjv: As soon as it was day, the elders of the people, both chief priests and scribes, came together and led Him into their council, saying,
chapters.kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞാൽ നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കയില്ല;
chapters.niv: "If you are the Messiah," they said, "tell us." Jesus answered, "If I tell you, you will not believe me,
chapters.nkjv: "If You are the Christ, tell us." But He said to them, "If I tell you, you will by no means believe.
chapters.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ചോദിച്ചാൽ ഉത്തരം പറയുകയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: and if I asked you, you would not answer.
chapters.nkjv: And if I also ask you, you will by no means answer Me or let Me go.
chapters.kjv: And if I also ask you , ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇന്നുമുതൽ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ദൈവശക്തിയുടെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God."
chapters.nkjv: Hereafter the Son of Man will sit on the right hand of the power of God."
chapters.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ ദൈവപുത്രൻ തന്നെയോ എന്നു എല്ലാവരും ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: “നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നതു ശരി; ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They all asked, "Are you then the Son of God?" He replied, "You say that I am."
chapters.nkjv: Then they all said, "Are You then the Son of God?" So He said to them, "You rightly say that I am."
chapters.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ ഇനി സാക്ഷ്യംകൊണ്ടു നമുക്കു എന്തു ആവശ്യം? നാം തന്നേ അവന്റെ വാമൊഴി കേട്ടുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they said, "Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips."
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "What further testimony do we need? For we have heard it ourselves from His own mouth."
chapters.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ എല്ലാവരും കൂട്ടമേ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവനെ പീലാത്തൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി:
chapters.niv: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.
chapters.nkjv: Then the whole multitude of them arose and led Him to Pilate.
chapters.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജാതിയെ മറിച്ചുകളകയും താൻ ക്രിസ്തു എന്ന രാജാവാകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു കൈസർക്കു കരം കൊടുക്കുന്നതു വിരോധിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതായി ഞങ്ങൾ കണ്ടു എന്നു കുറ്റം ചുമത്തിത്തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: And they began to accuse him, saying, "We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Messiah, a king."
chapters.nkjv: And they began to accuse Him, saying, "We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to pay taxes to Caesar, saying that He Himself is Christ, a King."
chapters.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവനോടു: നീ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവൊ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: “ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു” എന്നു അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the king of the Jews?" "You have said so," Jesus replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate asked Him, saying, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered him and said, "It is as you say."
chapters.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it .

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരോടും പുരുഷാരത്തോടും: ഞാൻ ഈ മനുഷ്യനിൽ കുറ്റം ഒന്നും കാണുന്നില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."
chapters.nkjv: So Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no fault in this Man."
chapters.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: അവൻ ഗലീലയിൽ തുടങ്ങി യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ എങ്ങും ഇവിടത്തോളവും പഠിപ്പിച്ചു ജനത്തെ കലഹിപ്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിഷ്കർഷിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they insisted, "He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here."
chapters.nkjv: But they were the more fierce, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee to this place."
chapters.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടിട്ടു ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ ഗലീലക്കാരനോ എന്നു പീലാത്തൊസ് ചോദിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.
chapters.nkjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked if the Man were a Galilean.
chapters.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവിന്റെ അധികാരത്തിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു, അന്നു യെരൂശലേമിൽ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന ഹെരോദാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അവനെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.
chapters.nkjv: And as soon as he knew that He belonged to Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.
chapters.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവു യേശുവിനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അത്യന്തം സന്തോഷിച്ചു; അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു കേട്ടിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ കാണ്മാൻ വളരെക്കാലമായി ഇച്ഛിച്ചു, അവൻ വല്ല അടയാളവും ചെയ്യുന്നതു കാണാം എന്നു ആശിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform a sign of some sort.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad; for he had desired for a long time to see Him, because he had heard many things about Him, and he hoped to see some miracle done by Him.
chapters.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season , because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

chapters.ml: ഏറിയോന്നു ചോദിച്ചിട്ടും അവൻ അവനോടു ഉത്തരം ഒന്നും പറഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.
chapters.nkjv: Then he questioned Him with many words, but He answered him nothing.
chapters.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും കഠിനമായി അവനെ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തിക്കൊണ്ടു നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.
chapters.nkjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused Him.
chapters.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവു തന്റെ പടയാളികളുമായി അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു നിസ്സാരനാക്കി ശുഭ്രവസ്ത്രം ധരിപ്പിച്ചു പീലാത്തൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ മടക്കി അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.
chapters.nkjv: Then Herod, with his men of war, treated Him with contempt and mocked Him, arrayed Him in a gorgeous robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.
chapters.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ഹെരോദാവും പീലാത്തൊസും തമ്മിൽ സ്നേഹിതന്മാരായിത്തീർന്നു; മുമ്പെ അവർ തമ്മിൽ വൈരമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That day Herod and Pilate became friends—before this they had been enemies.
chapters.nkjv: That very day Pilate and Herod became friends with each other, for previously they had been at enmity with each other.
chapters.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും പ്രമാണികളെയും ജനത്തെയും വിളിച്ചു കൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
chapters.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

chapters.ml: അവരോടു: ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ ജനത്തെ മത്സരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നുവല്ലോ; ഞാനോ നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പാകെ വിസ്തരിച്ചിട്ടും നിങ്ങൾ ചുമത്തിയ കുറ്റം ഒന്നും ഇവനിൽ കണ്ടില്ല;
chapters.niv: and said to them, "You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.
chapters.nkjv: said to them, "You have brought this Man to me, as one who misleads the people. And indeed, having examined Him in your presence, I have found no fault in this Man concerning those things of which you accuse Him;
chapters.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവും കണ്ടില്ല; അവൻ അവനെ നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ മടക്കി അയച്ചുവല്ലോ; ഇവൻ മരണയോഗ്യമായതു ഒന്നും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചിട്ടില്ല സ്പഷ്ടം;
chapters.niv: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.
chapters.nkjv: no, neither did Herod, for I sent you back to him; and indeed nothing deserving of death has been done by Him.
chapters.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അവനെ അടിപ്പിച്ചു വിട്ടയക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him."
chapters.nkjv: I will therefore chastise Him and release Him"
chapters.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him .

chapters.ml: ഇവനെ നീക്കിക്കളക; ബറബ്ബാസിനെ വിട്ടു തരിക എന്നു എല്ലാവരുംകൂടെ നിലവിളിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: But the whole crowd shouted, "Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!"
chapters.nkjv: (for it was necessary for him to release one to them at the feast).
chapters.kjv: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

chapters.ml: (ഉത്സവന്തോറും ഒരുത്തനെ വിട്ടുകൊടുക്ക പതിവായിരുന്നു)
chapters.niv: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
chapters.nkjv: And they all cried out at once, saying, "Away with this Man, and release to us Barabbas"—
chapters.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas:

chapters.ml: അവനോ നഗരത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായ ഒരു കലഹവും കുലയും ഹേതുവായി തടവിലായവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.
chapters.nkjv: who had been thrown into prison for a certain rebellion made in the city, and for murder.
chapters.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് യേശുവിനെ വിടുവിപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചിട്ടു പിന്നെയും അവരോടു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"
chapters.nkjv: Pilate, therefore, wishing to release Jesus, again called out to them.
chapters.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

chapters.ml: അവരോ: അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്ക, ക്രൂശിക്ക എന്നു എതിരെ നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For the third time he spoke to them: "Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him."
chapters.nkjv: But they shouted, saying, "Crucify Him, crucify Him!"
chapters.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him , crucify him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂന്നാമതും അവരോടു: അവൻ ചെയ്ത ദോഷം എന്തു? മരണയോഗ്യമായതു ഒന്നും അവനിൽ കണ്ടില്ല; അതുകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ അവനെ അടിപ്പിച്ചു വിട്ടയക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to them the third time, "Why, what evil has He done? I have found no reason for death in Him. I will therefore chastise Him and let Him go."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

chapters.ml: അവരോ അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഉറക്കെ മുട്ടിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചു; അവരുടെ നിലവിളി ഫലിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: So Pilate decided to grant their demand.
chapters.nkjv: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices that He be crucified. And the voices of these men and of the chief priests prevailed.
chapters.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ അപേക്ഷപോലെ ആകട്ടെ എന്നു പീലാത്തൊസ് വിധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.
chapters.nkjv: So Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they requested.
chapters.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

chapters.ml: കലഹവും കുലയും ഹേതുവായി തടവിലായവനെ അവരുടെ അപേക്ഷപോലെ വിട്ടുകൊടുക്കയും യേശുവിനെ അവരുടെ ഇഷ്ടത്തിന്നു ഏല്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: As the soldiers led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And he released to them the one they requested, who for rebellion and murder had been thrown into prison; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
chapters.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കൊണ്ടുപോകുമ്പോൾ വയലിൽ നിന്നു വരുന്ന ശിമോൻ എന്ന ഒരു കുറേനക്കാരനെ അവർ പിടിച്ചു ക്രൂശ് ചുമപ്പിച്ചു യേശുവിന്റെ പിന്നാലെ നടക്കുമാറാക്കി.
chapters.niv: A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.
chapters.nkjv: Now as they led Him away, they laid hold of a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, who was coming from the country, and on him they laid the cross that he might bear it after Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

chapters.ml: ഒരു വലിയ ജനസമൂഹവും അവനെച്ചൊല്ലി വിലപിച്ചു മുറയിടുന്ന അനേകം സ്ത്രീകളും അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.
chapters.nkjv: And a great multitude of the people followed Him, and women who also mourned and lamented Him.
chapters.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

chapters.ml: യേശു തിരിഞ്ഞു അവരെ നോക്കി: “യെരൂശലേംപുത്രിമാരേ, എന്നെച്ചൊല്ലി കരയേണ്ടാ, നിങ്ങളെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളെയും ചൊല്ലി കരവിൻ.
chapters.niv: For the time will come when you will say, ‘Blessed are the childless women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!’
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus, turning to them, said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
chapters.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

chapters.ml: മച്ചികളും പ്രസവിക്കാത്ത ഉദരങ്ങളും കുടിപ്പിക്കാത്ത മുലകളും ഭാഗ്യമുള്ളവ എന്നു പറയുന്ന കാലം വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then " ‘they will say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!" ’
chapters.nkjv: For indeed the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, wombs that never bore, and breasts which never nursed!’
chapters.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

chapters.ml: അന്നു മലകളോടു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ വീഴുവിൻ എന്നും കുന്നുകളോടു: ഞങ്ങളെ മൂടുവിൻ എന്നും പറഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങും.
chapters.niv: For if people do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?"
chapters.nkjv: Then they will begin ‘to say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!" ’
chapters.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

chapters.ml: പച്ചമരത്തോടു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്താൽ ഉണങ്ങിയതിന്നു എന്തു ഭവിക്കും”എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed.
chapters.nkjv: For if they do these things in the green wood, what will be done in the dry?"
chapters.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

chapters.ml: ദുഷ്‌പ്രവൃത്തിക്കാരായ വേറെ രണ്ടുപേരെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ കൊല്ലേണ്ടതിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When they came to the place called the Skull, they crucified him there, along with the criminals—one on his right, the other on his left.
chapters.nkjv: There were also two others, criminals, led with Him to be put to death.
chapters.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

chapters.ml: തലയോടിടം എന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവർ അവിടെ അവനെയും ദുഷ്‌പ്രവൃത്തിക്കാരെയും, ഒരുത്തനെ വലത്തും ഒരുത്തനെ ഇടത്തുമായി, ക്രൂശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had come to the place called Calvary, there they crucified Him, and the criminals, one on the right hand and the other on the left.
chapters.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യേശു: “പിതാവേ, ഇവർ ചെയ്യുന്നതു ഇന്നതു എന്നു അറിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഇവരോടു ക്ഷമിക്കേണമേ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അനന്തരം അവർ അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം വിഭാഗിച്ചു ചീട്ടിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The people stood watching, and the rulers even sneered at him. They said, "He saved others; let him save himself if he is God’s Messiah, the Chosen One."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do." And they divided His garments and cast lots.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

chapters.ml: ജനം നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു നിന്നു. ഇവൻ മറുള്ളവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചുവല്ലോ; ദൈവം തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത ക്രിസ്തു എങ്കിൽ തന്നെത്താൻ രക്ഷിക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പ്രധാനികളും പരിഹസിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar
chapters.nkjv: And the people stood looking on. But even the rulers with them sneered, saying, "He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ, the chosen of God."
chapters.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him , saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

chapters.ml: പടയാളികളും അവനെ പരിഹസിച്ചു അടുത്തു വന്നു അവന്നു പുളിച്ചവീഞ്ഞു കാണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and said, "If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself."
chapters.nkjv: The soldiers also mocked Him, coming and offering Him sour wine,
chapters.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

chapters.ml: നീ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവു എങ്കിൽ നിന്നെത്തന്നേ രക്ഷിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: There was a written notice above him, which read: this is the king of the jews.
chapters.nkjv: and saying, "If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself."
chapters.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവു എന്നു ഒരു മേലെഴുത്തും അവന്റെ മീതെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: "Aren’t you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!"
chapters.nkjv: And an inscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chapters.ml: തൂക്കിയ ദുഷ്‌പ്രവൃത്തിക്കാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ: നീ ക്രിസ്തു അല്ലയോ? നിന്നെത്തന്നേയും ഞങ്ങളെയും രക്ഷിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ ദുഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But the other criminal rebuked him. "Don’t you fear God," he said, "since you are under the same sentence?
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the criminals who were hanged blasphemed Him, saying, "If You are the Christ, save Yourself and us."
chapters.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

chapters.ml: മറ്റവനോ അവനെ ശാസിച്ചു: സമശിക്ഷാവിധിയിൽ തന്നേ ആയിട്ടും നീ ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong."
chapters.nkjv: But the other, answering, rebuked him, saying, "Do you not even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
chapters.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

chapters.ml: നാമോ ന്യായമായിട്ടു ശിക്ഷ അനുഭവിക്കുന്നു; നാം പ്രവർത്തിച്ചതിന്നു യോഗ്യമായതല്ലോ കിട്ടുന്നതു; ഇവനോ അരുതാത്തതു ഒന്നും ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. "
chapters.nkjv: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward of our deeds; but this Man has done nothing wrong."
chapters.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ: യേശുവേ, നീ രാജത്വം പ്രാപിച്ചു വരുമ്പോൾ എന്നെ ഓർത്തുകൊള്ളേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered him, "Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “ഇന്നു നീ എന്നോടുകൂടെ പറുദീസയിൽ ഇരിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ സത്യമായി നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: It was now about noon, and darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon,
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

chapters.ml: ഏകദേശം ആറാം മണി നേരമായപ്പോൾ സൂര്യൻ ഇരുണ്ടുപോയിട്ടു ഒമ്പതാം മണിവരെ ദേശത്തു ഒക്കെയും അന്ധകാരം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was about the sixth hour, and there was darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
chapters.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

chapters.ml: ദൈവമന്ദിരത്തിലെ തിരശ്ശീല നടുവെ ചീന്തിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit." When he had said this, he breathed his last.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
chapters.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

chapters.ml: യേശു അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ “പിതാവേ, ഞാൻ എന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെ തൃക്കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു; ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The centurion, seeing what had happened, praised God and said, "Surely this was a righteous man."
chapters.nkjv: And when Jesus had cried out with a loud voice, He said, "Father, ‘into Your hands I commit My spirit.’ " Having said this, He breathed His last.
chapters.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

chapters.ml: ഈ സംഭവിച്ചതു ശതാധിപൻ കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ വാസ്തവമായി നീതിമാൻ ആയിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി.
chapters.niv: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.
chapters.nkjv: So when the centurion saw what had happened, he glorified God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous Man!"
chapters.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

chapters.ml: കാണ്മാൻ കൂടി വന്ന പുരുഷാരം ഒക്കെയും സംഭവിച്ചതു കണ്ടിട്ടു മാറത്തടിച്ചു കൊണ്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
chapters.nkjv: And the whole crowd who came together to that sight, seeing what had been done, beat their breasts and returned.
chapters.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പരിചയക്കാർ എല്ലാവരും ഗലീലയിൽ നിന്നു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചസ്ത്രീകളും ഇതു നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു ദൂരത്തു നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now there was a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, a good and upright man,
chapters.nkjv: But all His acquaintances, and the women who followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
chapters.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

chapters.ml: അരിമത്യ എന്നൊരു യെഹൂദ്യപട്ടണക്കാരനായി നല്ലവനും നീതിമാനും ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെ കാത്തിരുന്നവനുമായ യോസേഫ് എന്നൊരു മന്ത്രി —
chapters.niv: who had not consented to their decision and action. He came from the Judean town of Arimathea, and he himself was waiting for the kingdom of God.
chapters.nkjv: Now behold, therewas a man named Joseph, a council member, a good and just man.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ ആലോചനെക്കും പ്രവൃത്തിക്കും അനുകൂലമല്ലായിരുന്നു —
chapters.niv: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body.
chapters.nkjv: He had not consented to their decision and deed. Hewas from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who himself was also waiting for the kingdom of God.
chapters.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathæa, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു യേശുവിന്റെ ശരീരം ചോദിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in the rock, one in which no one had yet been laid.
chapters.nkjv: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
chapters.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

chapters.ml: അതു ഇറക്കി ഒരു ശീലയിൽ പൊതിഞ്ഞു പാറയിൽ വെട്ടിയിരുന്നതും ആരെയും ഒരിക്കലും വെച്ചിട്ടില്ലാത്തതുമായ കല്ലറയിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
chapters.nkjv: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a tomb thatwas hewn out of the rock, where no one had ever lain before.
chapters.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ഒരുക്കനാൾ ആയിരുന്നു, ശബ്ബത്തും ആരംഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and saw the tomb and how his body was laid in it.
chapters.nkjv: That day was the Preparation, and the Sabbath drew near.
chapters.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

chapters.ml: ഗലീലയിൽ നിന്നു അവനോടുകൂടെ പോന്ന സ്ത്രീകളും പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു കല്ലറയും അവന്റെ ശരീരം വെച്ച വിധവും കണ്ടിട്ടു
chapters.niv: Then they went home and prepared spices and perfumes. But they rested on the Sabbath in obedience to the commandment.
chapters.nkjv: And the women who had come with Him from Galilee followed after, and they observed the tomb and how His body was laid.
chapters.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

chapters.ml: മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗവും പരിമളതൈലവും ഒരുക്കി; കല്പന അനുസരിച്ചു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ സ്വസ്ഥമായിരന്നു.
chapters.nkjv: Then they returned and prepared spices and fragrant oils. And they rested on the Sabbath according to the commandment.
chapters.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒരുക്കിയ സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗം എടുത്തു ആഴ്ചവട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം ദിവസം അതികാലത്തു കല്ലറെക്കൽ എത്തി,
chapters.niv: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women took the spices they had prepared and went to the tomb.
chapters.nkjv: Now on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they, and certain otherwomen with them, came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared.
chapters.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

chapters.ml: കല്ലറയിൽ നിന്നു കല്ലു ഉരുട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞതായി കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
chapters.nkjv: But they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
chapters.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

chapters.ml: അകത്തു കടന്നാറെ കർത്താവായ യേശുവിന്റെ ശരീരം കണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Then they went in and did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

chapters.ml: അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അവർ ചഞ്ചലിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ മിന്നുന്ന വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ച രണ്ടു പുരുഷാന്മാർ അരികെ നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: While they were wondering about this, suddenly two men in clothes that gleamed like lightning stood beside them.
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, as they were greatly perplexed about this, that behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

chapters.ml: ഭയപ്പെട്ടു മുഖം കുനിച്ചു നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ അവർ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ജീവനുള്ളവനെ മരിച്ചവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: In their fright the women bowed down with their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, "Why do you look for the living among the dead?
chapters.nkjv: Then, as they were afraid and bowed their faces to the earth, they said to them, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?
chapters.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇവിടെ ഇല്ല ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റിരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: He is not here; he has risen! Remember how he told you, while he was still with you in Galilee:
chapters.nkjv: He is not here, but is risen! Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,
chapters.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

chapters.ml: മുമ്പെ ഗലീലയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ അവൻ നിങ്ങളോടു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെ പാപികളായ മനുഷ്യരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു ക്രൂശിക്കയും അവൻ മൂന്നാം നാൾ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കയും വേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered over to the hands of sinners, be crucified and on the third day be raised again.’ "
chapters.nkjv: saying, ‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.’ "
chapters.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്റെ വാക്കു ഓർത്തു,
chapters.niv: Then they remembered his words.
chapters.nkjv: And they remembered His words.
chapters.kjv: And they remembered his words,

chapters.ml: കല്ലറ വിട്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി പതിനൊരുവർ മുതലായ എല്ലാവരോടും ഇതു ഒക്കെയും അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they came back from the tomb, they told all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
chapters.nkjv: Then they returned from the tomb and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
chapters.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആരെന്നാൽ മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയ, യോഹന്നാ, യാക്കോബിന്റെ അമ്മ മറിയ എന്നവർ തന്നേ. അവരോടുകൂടെയുള്ള മറ്റു സ്ത്രീകളും അതു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the others with them who told this to the apostles.
chapters.nkjv: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary themother of James, and the other women with them, who told these things to the apostles.
chapters.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു അവർക്കു വെറും കഥപോലെ തോന്നി; അവരെ വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: But they did not believe the women, because their words seemed to them like nonsense.
chapters.nkjv: And their words seemed to them like idle tales, and they did not believe them.
chapters.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

chapters.ml: (എന്നാൽ പത്രൊസ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു കല്ലറെക്കൽ ഓടിച്ചെന്നു കുനിഞ്ഞു നോക്കി, തുണി മാത്രം കണ്ടു, സംഭവിച്ചതെന്തെന്നു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.)
