chapters.niv: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.
chapters.nkjv: But Peter arose and ran to the tomb; and stooping down, he saw the linen cloths lying by themselves; and he departed, marveling to himself at what had happened.
chapters.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

chapters.ml: അന്നു തന്നേ അവരിൽ രണ്ടുപേർ യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നു ഏഴു നാഴിക ദൂരമുള്ള എമ്മവുസ്സ് എന്ന ഗ്രാമത്തിലേക്കു പോകയിൽ
chapters.niv: Now that same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now behold, two of them were traveling that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was seven miles from Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

chapters.ml: ഈ സംഭവിച്ചതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഒക്കെയും തമ്മിൽ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
chapters.nkjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
chapters.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

chapters.ml: സംസാരിച്ചും തർക്കിച്ചും കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ യേശു താനും അടുത്തുചെന്നു അവരോടു ചേർന്നു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: As they talked and discussed these things with each other, Jesus himself came up and walked along with them;
chapters.nkjv: So it was, while they conversed and reasoned, that Jesus Himself drew near and went with them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

chapters.ml: അവനെ അറിയാതവണ്ണം അവരുടെ കണ്ണു നിരോധിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but they were kept from recognizing him.
chapters.nkjv: But their eyes were restrained, so that they did not know Him.
chapters.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ വഴിനടന്നു തമ്മിൽ വാദിക്കുന്ന ഈ കാര്യം എന്തു” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു; അവർ വാടിയ മുഖത്തോടെ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: He asked them, "What are you discussing together as you walk along?" They stood still, their faces downcast.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "What kind of conversation is this that you have with one another as you walk and are sad?"
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

chapters.ml: ക്ളെയൊപ്പാവു എന്നു പേരുള്ളവൻ; യെരൂശലേമിലെ പരദേശികളിൽ നീ മാത്രം ഈ നാളുകളിൽ അവിടെ സംഭവിച്ച കാര്യം അറിയാതിരിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, "Are you the only one visiting Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the one whose name was Cleopas answered and said to Him, "Are You the only stranger in Jerusalem, and have You not known the things which happened there in these days?"
chapters.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?

chapters.ml: “ഏതു” എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ദൈവത്തിന്നും സകലജനത്തിനും മുമ്പാകെ പ്രവൃത്തിയിലും വാക്കിലും ശക്തിയുള്ള പ്രവാചകനായിരുന്ന നസറായനായ യേശുവിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ളതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "What things?" he asked. "About Jesus of Nazareth," they replied. "He was a prophet, powerful in word and deed before God and all the people.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "What things?" So they said to Him, "The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a Prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും പ്രമാണികളും അവനെ മരണവിധിക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചു ക്രൂശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The chief priests and our rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him;
chapters.nkjv: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to be condemned to death, and crucified Him.
chapters.kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളോ അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിനെ വീണ്ടെടുപ്പാനുള്ളവൻ എന്നു ആശിച്ചിരുന്നു; അത്രയുമല്ല, ഇതു സംഭവിച്ചിട്ടു ഇന്നു മൂന്നാം നാൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but we had hoped that he was the one who was going to redeem Israel. And what is more, it is the third day since all this took place.
chapters.nkjv: But we were hoping that it was He who was going to redeem Israel. Indeed, besides all this, today is the third day since these things happened.
chapters.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ചില സ്ത്രീകൾ രാവിലെ കല്ലറെക്കൽ പോയി
chapters.niv: In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning
chapters.nkjv: Yes, and certain women of our company, who arrived at the tomb early, astonished us.
chapters.kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശരീരം കാണാതെ മടങ്ങിവന്നു അവൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞ ദൂതന്മാരുടെ ദർശനം കണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഞങ്ങളെ ഭ്രമിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: but didn’t find his body. They came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels, who said he was alive.
chapters.nkjv: When they did not find His body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels who said He was alive.
chapters.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ ചിലർ കല്ലറക്കൽ ചെന്നു സ്ത്രീകൾ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ തന്നേ കണ്ടു; അവനെ കണ്ടില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but they did not see Jesus."
chapters.nkjv: And certain of those whowere with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said; but Him they did not see."
chapters.kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “അയ്യോ, ബുദ്ധിഹീനരേ, പ്രവാചകന്മാർ പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നതു എല്ലാം വിശ്വസിക്കാത്ത മന്ദബുദ്ധികളേ,
chapters.niv: He said to them, "How foolish you are, and how slow to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
chapters.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തു ഇങ്ങനെ കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിച്ചിട്ടു തന്റെ മഹത്വത്തിൽ കടക്കേണ്ടതല്ലയോ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Did not the Messiah have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?"
chapters.nkjv: Ought not the Christ to have suffered these things and to enter into His glory?"
chapters.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

chapters.ml: മോശെ തുടങ്ങി സകലപ്രവാചകന്മാരിൽ നിന്നും എല്ലാതിരുവെഴുത്തുകളിലും തന്നെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ളതു അവർക്കു വ്യാഖ്യാനിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he explained to them what was said in all the Scriptures concerning himself.
chapters.nkjv: And beginning at Moses and all the Prophets, He expounded to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.
chapters.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

chapters.ml: അവർ പോകുന്ന ഗ്രാമത്തോടു അടുത്തപ്പോൾ അവൻ മുമ്പോട്ടു പോകുന്ന ഭാവം കാണിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus continued on as if he were going farther.
chapters.nkjv: Then they drew near to the village where they were going, and He indicated that He would have gone farther.
chapters.kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

chapters.ml: അവരോ: ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കുക; നേരം വൈകി അസ്തമിപ്പാറായല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ നിർബന്ധിച്ചു; അവൻ അവരോടുകൂടെ പാർപ്പാൻ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: But they urged him strongly, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over." So he went in to stay with them.
chapters.nkjv: But they constrained Him, saying, "Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent." And He went in to stay with them.
chapters.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

chapters.ml: അവരുമായി ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നു ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ അപ്പം എടുത്തു അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു നുറുക്കി അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, as He sat at the table with them, that He took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it , and brake, and gave to them.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവരുടെ കണ്ണു തുറന്നു അവർ അവനെ അറിഞ്ഞു; അവൻ അവർക്കു അപ്രത്യക്ഷനായി
chapters.niv: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.
chapters.nkjv: Then their eyes were opened and they knew Him; and He vanished from their sight.
chapters.kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വഴിയിൽ നമ്മോടു സംസാരിച്ചു തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളെ തെളിയിക്കുമ്പോൾ നമ്മുടെ ഹൃദയം നമ്മുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ കത്തിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നു അവർ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They asked each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?"
chapters.nkjv: And they said to one another, "Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us on the road, and while He opened the Scriptures to us?"
chapters.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

chapters.ml: ആ നാഴികയിൽ തന്നേ അവർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together
chapters.nkjv: So they rose up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven and those whowere with them gathered together,
chapters.kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു വാസ്തവമായി ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റു ശിമോന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി എന്നു കൂടിയിരുന്നു പറയുന്ന പതിനൊരുവരെയും കൂടെയുള്ളവരെയും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: and saying, "It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

chapters.ml: വഴിയിൽ സംഭവിച്ചതും അവൻ അപ്പം നുറുക്കുകയിൽ തങ്ങൾക്കു അറിയായ്‍വന്നതും അവർ വിവരിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.
chapters.nkjv: And they told about the things thathadhappened on the road, and how He was known to them in the breaking of bread.
chapters.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവർ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരുടെ നടുവിൽ നിന്നു: (“നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമാധാനം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു”.)
chapters.niv: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, "Peace be with you."
chapters.nkjv: Now as they said these things, Jesus Himself stood in the midst of them, and said to them, "Peace to you."
chapters.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഞെട്ടി ഭയപ്പെട്ടു; ഒരു ഭൂതത്തെ കാണുന്നു എന്നു അവർക്കു തോന്നി.
chapters.niv: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.
chapters.nkjv: But they were terrified and frightened, and supposed they had seen a spirit.
chapters.kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു “നിങ്ങൾ കലങ്ങുന്നതു എന്തു? നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ സംശയം പൊങ്ങുന്നതും എന്തു?
chapters.niv: He said to them, "Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Why are you troubled? And why do doubts arise in your hearts?
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ തന്നെ ആകുന്നു എന്നു എന്റെ കയ്യും കാലും നോക്കി അറിവിൻ; എന്നെ തൊട്ടുനോക്കുവിൻ; എന്നിൽ കാണുന്നതുപോലെ ഭൂതത്തിന്നു മാംസവും അസ്ഥിയും ഇല്ലല്ലോ ”എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have."
chapters.nkjv: Behold My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself. Handle Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see I have."
chapters.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

chapters.ml: (ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ കയ്യും കാലും അവരെ കാണിച്ചു.)
chapters.niv: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
chapters.nkjv: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.
chapters.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.

chapters.ml: അവർ സന്തോഷത്താൽ വിശ്വസിക്കാതെ അതിശയിച്ചു നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ അവരോടു: “തിന്നുവാൻ വല്ലതും ഇവിടെ നിങ്ങളുടെ പക്കൽ ഉണ്ടോ ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"
chapters.nkjv: But while they still did not believe for joy, and marveled, He said to them, "Have you any food here?"
chapters.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒരു ഖണ്ഡം വറുത്ത മീനും (തേൻ കട്ടയും) അവന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,
chapters.nkjv: So they gave Him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
chapters.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

chapters.ml: അതു അവൻ വാങ്ങി അവർ കാൺകെ തിന്നു.
chapters.niv: and he took it and ate it in their presence.
chapters.nkjv: And He took it and ate in their presence.
chapters.kjv: And he took it , and did eat before them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഇതാകുന്നു നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു. മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിലും പ്രവാചകപുസ്തകങ്ങളിലും സങ്കീർത്തനങ്ങളിലും എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും നിവൃത്തിയാകേണം എന്നുള്ളതു തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: He said to them, "This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "These are the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms concerning Me."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

chapters.ml: തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളെ തിരിച്ചറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ ബുദ്ധിയെ തുറന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.
chapters.nkjv: And He opened their understanding, that they might comprehend the Scriptures.
chapters.kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തു കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിക്കയും മൂന്നാം നാൾ മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കയും
chapters.niv: He told them, "This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to them, "Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ മാനസാന്തരവും പാപമോചനവും യെരൂശലേമിൽ തുടങ്ങി സകലജാതികളിലും പ്രസംഗിക്കയും വേണം എന്നിങ്ങനെ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and repentance for the forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in His name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഇതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You are witnesses of these things.
chapters.nkjv: And you are witnesses of these things.
chapters.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിതാവു വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തതിനെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ അയക്കും. നിങ്ങളോ ഉയരത്തിൽനിന്നു ശക്തി ധരിക്കുവോളം നഗരത്തിൽ പാർപ്പിൻ ”എന്നും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high."
chapters.nkjv: Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high."
chapters.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ അവരെ ബേഥാന്യയോളം കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി കൈ ഉയർത്തി അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
chapters.nkjv: And He led them out as far as Bethany, and He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
chapters.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

chapters.ml: അവരെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കയിൽ അവൻ അവരെ വിട്ടു പിരിഞ്ഞു (സ്വർഗ്ഗാരോഹണം ചെയ്തു).
chapters.niv: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, while He blessed them, that He was parted from them and carried up into heaven.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

chapters.ml: അവർ (അവനെ നമസ്ക്കരിച്ചു) മഹാസന്തോഷത്തോടെ യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു
chapters.niv: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.
chapters.nkjv: And they worshiped Him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
chapters.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

chapters.ml: എല്ലായ്പോഴും ദൈവലായത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു ദൈവത്തെ വാഴ്ത്തിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.
chapters.nkjv: and were continually in the temple praising and blessing God. Amen.
chapters.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

chapters.ml: ആദിയിൽ വചനം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; വചനം ദൈവത്തോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു; വചനം ദൈവം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
chapters.nkjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
chapters.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ആദിയിൽ ദൈവത്തോടു കൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was with God in the beginning.
chapters.nkjv: He was in the beginning with God.
chapters.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.

chapters.ml: സകലവും അവൻ മുഖാന്തരം ഉളവായി; ഉളവായതു ഒന്നും അവനെ കൂടാതെ ഉളവായതല്ല.
chapters.niv: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.
chapters.nkjv: All things were made through Him, and without Him nothing was made that was made.
chapters.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

chapters.ml: അവനിൽ ജീവൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ജീവൻ മനുഷ്യരുടെ വെളിച്ചമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.
chapters.nkjv: In Him was life, and the life was the light of men.
chapters.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

chapters.ml: വെളിച്ചം ഇരുളിൽ പ്രകാശിക്കുന്നു; ഇരുളോ അതിനെ പിടിച്ചടക്കിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
chapters.nkjv: And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not comprehend it.
chapters.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അയച്ചിട്ടു ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ വന്നു; അവന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.
chapters.nkjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
chapters.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സാക്ഷ്യത്തിന്നായി താൻ മുഖാന്തരം എല്ലാവരും വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വെളിച്ചത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം പറവാൻ തന്നേ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.
chapters.nkjv: This man came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all through him might believe.
chapters.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വെളിച്ചം ആയിരുന്നില്ല; വെളിച്ചത്തിന്നു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയേണ്ടുന്നവനത്രേ.
chapters.niv: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.
chapters.nkjv: He was not that Light, but wassent to bear witness of that Light.
chapters.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

chapters.ml: ഏതു മനുഷ്യനെയും പ്രകാശിപ്പിക്കുന്ന സത്യവെളിച്ചം ലോകത്തിലേക്കു വന്നുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.
chapters.nkjv: That was the true Light which gives light to every man coming into the world.
chapters.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ലോകത്തിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ലോകം അവൻ മുഖാന്തരം ഉളവായി; ലോകമോ അവനെ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.
chapters.nkjv: He was in the world, and the world was made through Him, and the world did not know Him.
chapters.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സ്വന്തത്തിലേക്കു വന്നു; സ്വന്തമായവരോ അവനെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
chapters.nkjv: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
chapters.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഏവർക്കും ദൈവമക്കൾ ആകുവാൻ അവൻ അധികാരം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—
chapters.nkjv: But as many as received Him, to them He gave the right to become children of God, to those who believe in His name:
chapters.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

chapters.ml: അവർ രക്തത്തിൽ നിന്നല്ല, ജഡത്തിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടത്താലല്ല, പുരുഷന്റെ ഇഷ്ടത്താലുമല്ല, ദൈവത്തിൽ നിന്നത്രേ ജനിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband’s will, but born of God.
chapters.nkjv: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
chapters.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

chapters.ml: വചനം ജഡമായി തീർന്നു, കൃപയും സത്യവും നിറഞ്ഞവനായി നമ്മുടെ ഇടയിൽ പാർത്തു. ഞങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ തേജസ്സ് പിതാവിൽ നിന്നു ഏകജാതനായവന്റെ തേജസ്സായി കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.
chapters.nkjv: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth.
chapters.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചു: എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നവൻ എനിക്കു മുമ്പനായി തീർന്നു; അവൻ എനിക്കു മുമ്പെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞവൻ ഇവൻ തന്നേ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: (John testified concerning him. He cried out, saying, "This is the one I spoke about when I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’ ")
chapters.nkjv: John bore witness of Him and cried out, saying, "This was He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me is preferred before me, for He was before me.’ "
chapters.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ നിറവിൽ നിന്നു നമുക്കു എല്ലാവർക്കും കൃപമേൽ കൃപ ലഭിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.
chapters.nkjv: And of His fullness we have all received, and grace for grace.
chapters.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

chapters.ml: ന്യായപ്രമാണം മോശെ മുഖാന്തരം ലഭിച്ചു; കൃപയും സത്യവും യേശുക്രിസ്തു മുഖാന്തരം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
chapters.nkjv: For the law was given through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
chapters.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തെ ആരും ഒരുനാളും കണ്ടിട്ടില്ല; പിതാവിന്റെ മടിയിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്ന ഏകജാതനായ പുത്രൻ അവനെ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.
chapters.nkjv: No one has seen God at any time. The only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, He has declared Him.
chapters.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

chapters.ml: നീ ആർ എന്നു യോഹന്നാനോടു ചോദിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാർ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നു പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും ലേവ്യരെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം എന്തെന്നാൽ: അവൻ മറുക്കാതെ ഏറ്റുപറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: Now this was John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.
chapters.nkjv: Now this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"
chapters.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ക്രിസ്തു അല്ല എന്നു ഏറ്റു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Messiah."
chapters.nkjv: He confessed, and did not deny, but confessed, "I am not the Christ."
chapters.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ എന്തു? നീ ഏലീയാവോ എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. നീ ആ പ്രവാചകനോ? എന്നതിന്നു: അല്ല എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They asked him, "Then who are you? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."
chapters.nkjv: And they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" And he answered, "No."
chapters.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: നീ ആരാകുന്നു? ഞങ്ങളെ അയച്ചവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറയേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു തന്നേ എന്തു പറയുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to him, "Who are you, that we may give an answer to those who sent us? What do you say about yourself?"
chapters.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ: കർത്താവിന്റെ വഴി നേരെ ആക്കുവിൻ എന്നു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വിളിച്ചുപറയുന്നവന്റെ ശബ്ദം ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, "I am the voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’ "
chapters.nkjv: He said: "I am ‘The voice of one crying in the wilderness: "Make straight the way of the Lord," ’ as the prophet Isaiah said."
chapters.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

chapters.ml: അയക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ പരീശന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലുള്ളവർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the Pharisees who had been sent
chapters.nkjv: Now those who were sent were from the Pharisees.
chapters.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നീ ക്രിസ്തുവല്ല, ഏലീയാവല്ല, ആ പ്രവാചകനും അല്ല എന്നു വരികിൽ നീ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു അവർ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: questioned him, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
chapters.nkjv: And they asked him, saying, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
chapters.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ: ഞാൻ വെള്ളത്തിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ അറിയാത്ത ഒരുത്തൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ നില്ക്കുന്നുണ്ടു;
chapters.niv: "I baptize with water," John replied, "but among you stands one you do not know.
chapters.nkjv: John answered them, saying, "I baptize with water, but there stands One among you whom you do not know.
chapters.kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നവൻ തന്നേ; അവന്റെ ചെരിപ്പിന്റെ വാറു അഴിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ യോഗ്യൻ അല്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie."
chapters.nkjv: It is He who, coming after me, is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose."
chapters.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

chapters.ml: ഇതു യോർദ്ദന്നക്കാരെ യോഹന്നാൻ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്ന ബേഥാന്യയിൽ സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
chapters.nkjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
chapters.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ യേശു തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നതു അവൻ കണ്ടിട്ടു: ഇതാ, ലോകത്തിന്റെ പാപം ചുമക്കുന്ന ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കുഞ്ഞാടു;
chapters.niv: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
chapters.nkjv: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
chapters.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ഒരു പുരുഷൻ വരുന്നു; അവൻ എനിക്കു മുമ്പെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു എനിക്കു മുമ്പനായി തീർന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞവൻ ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: This is the one I meant when I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’
chapters.nkjv: This is He of whom I said, ‘After me comes a Man who is preferred before me, for He was before me.’
chapters.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ അവനെ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല; എങ്കിലും അവൻ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു വെളിപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ വെള്ളത്തിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിപ്പാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel."
chapters.nkjv: I did not know Him; but that He should be revealed to Israel, therefore I came baptizing with water."
chapters.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ പിന്നെയും സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞതു: ആത്മാവു ഒരു പ്രാവുപോലെ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവരുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അതു അവന്റെ മേൽ വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.
chapters.nkjv: And John bore witness, saying, "I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and He remained upon Him.
chapters.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ അവനെ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല; എങ്കിലും വെള്ളത്തിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിപ്പാൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചവൻ എന്നോടു: ആരുടെമേൽ ആത്മാവു ഇറങ്ങുന്നതും വസിക്കുന്നതും നീ കാണുമോ അവൻ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കുന്നവൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And I myself did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.nkjv: I did not know Him, but He who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘Upon whom you see the Spirit descending, and remaining on Him, this is He who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ കാണുകയും ഇവൻ ദൈവപുത്രൻ തന്നേ എന്നു സാക്ഷ്യം പറകയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I have seen and I testify that this is God’s Chosen One."
chapters.nkjv: And I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God."
chapters.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ യോഹന്നാൻ പിന്നെയും തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരുമായി അവിടെ നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
chapters.nkjv: Again, the next day, John stood with two of his disciples.
chapters.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

chapters.ml: കടന്നുപോകുന്ന യേശുവിനെ നോക്കീട്ടു: ഇതാ, ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കുഞ്ഞാടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Lamb of God!"
chapters.nkjv: And looking at Jesus as He walked, he said, "Behold the Lamb of God!"
chapters.kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

chapters.ml: അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു ആ രണ്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കേട്ടു യേശുവിനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

chapters.ml: യേശു തിരിഞ്ഞു അവർ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ എന്തു അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.” അവർ: റബ്ബീ, എന്നു വെച്ചാൽ ഗുരോ, നീ എവിടെ പാർക്കുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, "What do you want?" They said, "Rabbi" (which means "Teacher"), "where are you staying?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus turned, and seeing them following, said to them, "What do you seek?" They said to Him, "Rabbi" (which is to say, when translated, Teacher), "where are You staying?"
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “വന്നു കാണ്മിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൻ വസിക്കുന്ന ഇടം അവർ കണ്ടു അന്നു അവനോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു; അപ്പോൾ ഏകദേശം പത്താംമണി നേരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Come," he replied, "and you will see." So they went and saw where he was staying, and they spent that day with him. It was about four in the afternoon.
chapters.nkjv: He said to them, "Come and see." They came and saw where He was staying, and remained with Him that day (now it was about the tenth hour).
chapters.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ പറഞ്ഞതു കേട്ടു അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ച രണ്ടുപേരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അന്ത്രെയാസ് ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: One of the two who heard John speak, and followed Him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
chapters.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak , and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ സഹോദരനായ ശിമോനെ ആദ്യം കണ്ടു അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ മശീഹയെ എന്നുവെച്ചാൽ ക്രിസ്തുവെ കണ്ടെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, "We have found the Messiah" (that is, the Christ).
chapters.nkjv: He first found his own brother Simon, and said to him, "We have found the Messiah" (which is translated, the Christ).
chapters.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

chapters.ml: അവനെ യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു; യേശു അവനെ നോക്കി: “നീ യോഹന്നാന്റെ പുത്രനായ ശിമോൻ ആകുന്നു; നിനക്കു കേഫാ എന്നു പേരാകും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതു പത്രൊസ് എന്നാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, "You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas" (which, when translated, is Peter ).
chapters.nkjv: And he brought him to Jesus. Now when Jesus looked at him, He said, "You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas" (which is translated, A Stone).
chapters.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ യേശു ഗലീലെക്കു പുറപ്പെടുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഫിലിപ്പോസിനെ കണ്ടു: “എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക” എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, "Follow me."
chapters.nkjv: The following day Jesus wanted to go to Galilee, and He found Philip and said to him, "Follow Me."
chapters.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പോസോ അന്ത്രെയാസിന്റെയും പത്രൊസിന്റെയും പട്ടണമായ ബേത്ത്സയിദയിൽ നിന്നുള്ളവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.
chapters.nkjv: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
chapters.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പോസ് നഥനയേലിനെ കണ്ടു അവനോടു: ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ മോശെയും പ്രവാചകന്മാരും എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നവനെ കണ്ടെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ യോസേഫിന്റെ പുത്രനായ യേശു എന്ന നസറെത്തുകാരൻ തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."
chapters.nkjv: Philip found Nathanael and said to him, "We have found Him of whom Moses in the law, and also the prophets, wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."
chapters.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

chapters.ml: നഥനയേൽ അവനോടു: നസറെത്തിൽനിന്നു വല്ല നന്മയും വരുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഫിലിപ്പോസ് അവനോടു: വന്നു കാൺക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?" Nathanael asked. "Come and see," said Philip.
chapters.nkjv: And Nathanael said to him, "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."
chapters.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

chapters.ml: നഥനയേൽ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നതു യേശു കണ്ടു: “ഇതാ, സാക്ഷാൽ യിസ്രായേല്യൻ; ഇവനിൽ കപടം ഇല്ല ” എന്നു അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him, and said of him, "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"
chapters.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

chapters.ml: നഥനയേൽ അവനോടു: എന്നെ എവിടെവെച്ചു അറിയും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: “ഫിലിപ്പോസ് നിന്നെ വിളിക്കുംമുമ്പെ നീ അത്തിയുടെ കീഴിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കണ്ടു” എന്നു യേശു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "How do you know me?" Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, "I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you."
chapters.nkjv: Nathanael said to Him, "How do You know me?" Jesus answered and said to him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."
chapters.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

chapters.ml: നഥനയേൽ അവനോടു: റബ്ബീ, നീ ദൈവപുത്രൻ, നീ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാവു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel."
chapters.nkjv: Nathanael answered and said to Him, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"
chapters.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അത്തിയുടെ കീഴിൽ കണ്ടു എന്നു നിന്നോടു പറകകൊണ്ടു നീ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നുവോ? നീ ഇതിനെക്കാൾ വലിയതു കാണും” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You will see greater things than that."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Because I said to you, ‘I saw you under the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

chapters.ml: “ആമേൻ ആമേൻ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: സ്വർഗ്ഗം തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്നതും മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ദൈവദൂതന്മാർ കയറുകയും ഇറങ്ങുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നതും നിങ്ങൾ കാണും” എന്നും അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He then added, "Very truly I tell you, you will see ‘heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on’ the Son of Man."
chapters.nkjv: And He said to him, "Most assuredly, I say to you, hereafter you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man."
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം നാൾ ഗലീലയിലെ കാനാവിൽ ഒരു കല്യാണം ഉണ്ടായി; യേശുവിന്റെ അമ്മ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
chapters.nkjv: On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.
chapters.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

chapters.ml: യേശുവിനെയും ശിഷ്യന്മാരെയും കല്യാണത്തിന്നു ക്ഷണിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
chapters.nkjv: Now both Jesus and His disciples were invited to the wedding.
chapters.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

chapters.ml: വീഞ്ഞു പോരാതെവരികയാൽ യേശുവിന്റെ അമ്മ അവനോടു: അവർക്കു വീഞ്ഞു ഇല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the wine was gone, Jesus’ mother said to him, "They have no more wine."
chapters.nkjv: And when they ran out of wine, the mother of Jesus said to Him, "They have no wine."
chapters.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: “സ്ത്രീയേ, എനിക്കും നിനക്കും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു? എന്റെ നാഴിക ഇതുവരെ വന്നിട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു”.
chapters.niv: "Woman, why do you involve me?" Jesus replied. "My hour has not yet come."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, what does your concern have to do with Me? My hour has not yet come."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അമ്മ ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരോടു: അവൻ നിങ്ങളോടു എന്തെങ്കിലും കല്പിച്ചാൽ അതു ചെയ്‍വിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."
chapters.nkjv: His mother said to the servants, "Whatever He says to you, do it."
chapters.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it .

chapters.ml: അവിടെ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ശുദ്ധീകരണനിയമം അനുസരിച്ചു രണ്ടോ മൂന്നോ പറവീതം കൊള്ളുന്ന ആറു കല്പാത്രം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.
chapters.nkjv: Now there were set there six waterpots of stone, according to the manner of purification of the Jews, containing twenty or thirty gallons apiece.
chapters.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ഈ കല്പാത്രങ്ങളിൽ വെള്ളം നിറെപ്പിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ വക്കൊളവും നിറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to the servants, "Fill the jars with water"; so they filled them to the brim.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "Fill the waterpots with water." And they filled them up to the brim.
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

chapters.ml: “ഇപ്പോൾ കോരിവിരുന്നുവാഴിക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി കൊടുപ്പിൻ ” എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ കൊണ്ടുപോയി കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then he told them, "Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet." They did so,
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Draw some out now, and take it to the master of the feast." And they took it.
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it .

chapters.ml: അതു എവിടെനിന്നു എന്നു വെള്ളം കോരിയ ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരല്ലാതെ വിരുന്നുവാഴി അറിഞ്ഞില്ല. വീഞ്ഞായിത്തീർന്ന വെള്ളം വിരുന്നുവാഴി രുചിനോക്കിയാറെ മണവാളനെ വിളിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
chapters.nkjv: When the master of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and did not know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the master of the feast called the bridegroom.
chapters.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും ആദ്യം നല്ല വീഞ്ഞും ലഹരി പിടിച്ചശേഷം ഇളപ്പമായതും കൊടുക്കുമാറുണ്ടു; നീ നല്ല വീഞ്ഞു ഇതുവരെയും സൂക്ഷിച്ചുവെച്ചുവല്ലോ എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said, "Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to him, "Every man at the beginning sets out the good wine, and when the guests have well drunk, then the inferior. You have kept the good wine until now!"
chapters.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഇതിനെ അടയാളങ്ങളുടെ ആരംഭമായി ഗലീലയിലെ കാനാവിൽ വെച്ചു ചെയ്തു തന്റെ മഹത്വം വെളിപ്പെടുത്തി; അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which he revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
chapters.nkjv: This beginning of signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and manifested His glory; and His disciples believed in Him.
chapters.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവനും അവന്റെ അമ്മയും സഹോദരന്മാരും ശിഷ്യന്മാരും കഫർന്നഹൂമിലേക്കു പോയി; അവിടെ ഏറനാൾ പാർത്തില്ല.
chapters.niv: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.
chapters.nkjv: After this He went down to Capernaum, He, His mother, His brothers, and His disciples; and they did not stay there many days.
chapters.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ പെസഹ സമീപം ആകകൊണ്ടു യേശു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

chapters.ml: ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ കാള, ആടു, പ്രാവു, എന്നിവയെ വില്ക്കുന്നവരെയും അവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്ന പൊൻവാണിഭക്കാരെയും കണ്ടിട്ടു,
chapters.niv: In the temple courts he found people selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.
chapters.nkjv: And He found in the temple those who sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the money changers doing business.
chapters.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

chapters.ml: കയറുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു ചമ്മട്ടി ഉണ്ടാക്കി ആടുമാടുകളോടും കൂടെ എല്ലാവരെയും ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി. പൊൻവാണിഭക്കാരുടെ നാണ്യം തൂകിക്കളഞ്ഞു മേശകളെ മറിച്ചിട്ടു;
chapters.niv: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
chapters.nkjv: When He had made a whip of cords, He drove them all out of the temple, with the sheep and the oxen, and poured out the changers’ money and overturned the tables.
chapters.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;

chapters.ml: പ്രാവുകളെ വില്ക്കുന്നവരോടു: “ഇതു ഇവിടെനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുപോകുവിൻ; എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ആലയത്തെ വാണിഭശാല ആക്കരുതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: To those who sold doves he said, "Get these out of here! Stop turning my Father’s house into a market!"
chapters.nkjv: And He said to those who sold doves, "Take these things away! Do not make My Father’s house a house of merchandise!"
chapters.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ: നിന്റെ ആലയത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള എരിവു എന്നെ തിന്നുകളയുന്നു എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു ഓർത്തു.
chapters.niv: His disciples remembered that it is written: "Zeal for your house will consume me."
chapters.nkjv: Then His disciples remembered that it was written, "Zeal for Your house has eaten Me up."
chapters.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനോടു: നിനക്കു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യാം എന്നതിന്നു നീ എന്തു അടയാളം കാണിച്ചു തരും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Jews then responded to him, "What sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?"
chapters.nkjv: So the Jews answered and said to Him, "What sign do You show to us, since You do these things?"
chapters.kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ഈ മന്ദിരം പൊളിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തിന്നകം അതിനെ പണിയും” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനോടു: ഈ മന്ദിരം നാല്പത്താറു സംവത്സരം കൊണ്ടു പണിതിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തിനകം അതിനെ പണിയുമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews said, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and will You raise it up in three days?"
chapters.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

chapters.ml: അവനോ തന്റെ ശരീരം എന്ന മന്ദിരത്തെക്കുറിച്ചത്രേ പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.
chapters.nkjv: But He was speaking of the temple of His body.
chapters.kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇതു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു അവൻ മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റ ശേഷം ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഓർത്തു തിരുവെഴുത്തും യേശു പറഞ്ഞ വചനവും വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when He had risen from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this to them; and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
chapters.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

chapters.ml: പെസഹപെരുന്നാളിൽ യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ ചെയ്ത അടയാളങ്ങൾ കണ്ടിട്ടു പലരും അവന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many people saw the signs he was performing and believed in his name.
chapters.nkjv: Now when He was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in His name when they saw the signs which He did.
chapters.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day , many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ എല്ലാവരെയും അറികകൊണ്ടു തന്നെത്താൻ അവരുടെ പക്കൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചേല്പിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus did not commit Himself to them, because He knew all men,
chapters.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men ,

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യനിലുള്ളതു എന്തു എന്നു സ്വതവെ അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കയാൽ തനിക്കു മനുഷ്യനെക്കുറിച്ചു യാതൊരുത്തന്റെയും സാക്ഷ്യം ആവശ്യമായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.
chapters.nkjv: and had no need that anyone should testify of man, for He knew what was in man.
chapters.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഒരു പ്രമാണിയായി നിക്കോദേമൊസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു മനുഷ്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.
chapters.nkjv: There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
chapters.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാത്രിയിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു അവനോടു: റബ്ബീ, നീ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നു ഉപദേഷ്ടാവായി വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു; ദൈവം തന്നോടു കൂടെ ഇല്ലെങ്കിൽ നീ ചെയ്യുന്ന ഈ അടയാളങ്ങളെ ചെയ്‍വാൻ ആർക്കും കഴികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He came to Jesus at night and said, "Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs you are doing if God were not with him."
chapters.nkjv: This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him."
chapters.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു; പുതുതായി ജനിച്ചില്ല എങ്കിൽ ദൈവരാജ്യം കാണ്മാൻ ആർക്കും കഴിയകയില്ല ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again. "
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless one is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: നിക്കോദെമൊസ് അവനോടു: മനുഷ്യൻ വൃദ്ധനായശേഷം ജനിക്കുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ? രണ്ടാമതും അമ്മയുടെ ഉദരത്തിൽ കടന്നു ജനിക്കാമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "How can someone be born when they are old?" Nicodemus asked. "Surely they cannot enter a second time into their mother’s womb to be born!"
chapters.nkjv: Nicodemus said to Him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?"
chapters.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു: വെള്ളത്താലും ആത്മാവിനാലും ജനിച്ചില്ല എങ്കിൽ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടപ്പാൻ ആർക്കും കഴികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: ജഡത്താൽ ജനിച്ചതു ജഡം ആകുന്നു; ആത്മാവിനാൽ ജനിച്ചതു ആത്മാവു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.
chapters.nkjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
chapters.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പുതുതായി ജനിക്കേണം എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറകയാൽ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടരുതു.
chapters.niv: You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’
chapters.nkjv: Do not marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born again.’
chapters.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

chapters.ml: കാറ്റു ഇഷ്ടമുള്ളേടത്തു ഊതുന്നു; അതിന്റെ ശബ്ദം നീ കേൾക്കുന്നു; എങ്കിലും അതു എവിടെനിന്നു വരുന്നു എന്നും എവിടേക്കു പോകുന്നു എന്നും അറിയുന്നില്ല; ആത്മാവിനാൽ ജനിച്ചവൻ എല്ലാം അതുപോലെ ആകുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit."
chapters.nkjv: The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear the sound of it, but cannot tell where it comes from and where it goes. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit."
chapters.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

chapters.ml: നിക്കോദേമൊസ് അവനോടു: ഇതു എങ്ങനെ സംഭവിക്കും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "How can this be?" Nicodemus asked.
chapters.nkjv: Nicodemus answered and said to Him, "How can these things be?"
chapters.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “നീ യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ഉപദേഷ്ടാവായിരുന്നിട്ടും ഇതു അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "You are Israel’s teacher," said Jesus, "and do you not understand these things?
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Are you the teacher of Israel, and do not know these things?
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു: ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നതു പ്രസ്താവിക്കയും കണ്ടതു സാക്ഷീകരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു: ഞങ്ങളുടെ സാക്ഷ്യം നിങ്ങൾ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, We speak what We know and testify what We have seen, and you do not receive Our witness.
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിലുള്ളതു നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലുള്ളതു നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞാൽ എങ്ങനെ വിശ്വസിക്കും?
chapters.niv: I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?
chapters.nkjv: If I have told you earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
chapters.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവന്ന (വനായി സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവനായ) മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ അല്ലാതെ ആരും സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ കയറീട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.
chapters.nkjv: No one has ascended to heaven but He who came down from heaven, that is, the Son of Man who is in heaven.
chapters.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

chapters.ml: മോശെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ സർപ്പത്തെ ഉയർത്തിയതുപോലെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെയും ഉയർത്തേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
chapters.nkjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
chapters.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

chapters.ml: അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഏവനും നിത്യജീവൻ പ്രാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him."
chapters.nkjv: that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life.
chapters.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ഏകജാതനായ പുത്രനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഏവനും നശിച്ചുപോകാതെ നിത്യജീവൻ പ്രാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവം അവനെ നല്കുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ലോകത്തെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
chapters.nkjv: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.
chapters.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ പുത്രനെ ലോകത്തിൽ അയച്ചതു ലോകത്തെ വിധിപ്പാനല്ല ലോകം അവനാൽ രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുവാനത്രേ.
chapters.niv: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.
chapters.nkjv: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world through Him might be saved.
chapters.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

chapters.ml: അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവന്നു ന്യായവിധി ഇല്ല; വിശ്വസിക്കാത്തവന്നു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ഏകജതാനായ പുത്രന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കായ്കയാൽ ന്യായവിധി വന്നുകഴിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
chapters.nkjv: "He who believes in Him is not condemned; but he who does not believe is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
chapters.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

chapters.ml: ന്യായവിധി എന്നതോ, വെളിച്ചം ലോകത്തിൽ വന്നിട്ടും മനുഷ്യരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തി ദോഷമുള്ളതു ആകയാൽ അവർ വെളിച്ചത്തെക്കാൾ ഇരുളിനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.
chapters.nkjv: And this is the condemnation, that the light has come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
chapters.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

chapters.ml: തിന്മ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം വെളിച്ചത്തെ പകെക്കുന്നു; തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു ആക്ഷേപം വരാതിരിപ്പാൻ വെളിച്ചത്തിങ്കലേക്കു വരുന്നതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed.
chapters.nkjv: For everyone practicing evil hates the light and does not come to the light, lest his deeds should be exposed.
chapters.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

chapters.ml: സത്യം പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നവനോ, തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി ദൈവത്തിൽ ചെയ്തിരിക്കയാൽ അതു വെളിപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു വെളിച്ചത്തിങ്കലേക്കു വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.
chapters.nkjv: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be clearly seen, that they have been done in God."
chapters.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യേശു ശിഷ്യന്മാരുമായി യെഹൂദ്യദേശത്തു വന്നു അവരോടുകൂടെ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.
chapters.nkjv: After these things Jesus and His disciples came into the land of Judea, and there He remained with them and baptized.
chapters.kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാനും ശലേമിന്നു അരികത്തു ഐനോനിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; അവിടെ വളരെ വെള്ളം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ആളുകൾ വന്നു സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were coming and being baptized.
chapters.nkjv: Now John also was baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there. And they came and were baptized.
chapters.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

chapters.ml: അന്നു യോഹന്നാനെ തടവിൽ ആക്കിയിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: (This was before John was put in prison.)
chapters.nkjv: For John had not yet been thrown into prison.
chapters.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ചിലർക്കു ഒരു യെഹൂദനുമായി ശുദ്ധീകരണത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ഒരു വാദം ഉണ്ടായി;
chapters.niv: An argument developed between some of John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.
chapters.nkjv: Then there arose a dispute between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purification.
chapters.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോഹന്നാന്റെ അടുക്കൽവന്നു അവനോടു: റബ്ബീ, യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നവൻ, നീ സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചുട്ടുള്ളവൻ തന്നേ, ഇതാ, സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; എല്ലാവരും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan—the one you testified about—look, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him."
chapters.nkjv: And they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, He who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified—behold, He is baptizing, and all are coming to Him!"
chapters.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു കൊടുത്തിട്ടല്ലാതെ മനുഷ്യന്നു ഒന്നും ലഭിപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: To this John replied, "A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.
chapters.nkjv: John answered and said, "A man can receive nothing unless it has been given to him from heaven.
chapters.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ക്രിസ്തു അല്ല, അവന്നു മുമ്പായി അയക്കപ്പെട്ടവനത്രേ എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ എനിക്കു സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു;
chapters.niv: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’
chapters.nkjv: You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before Him.’
chapters.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

chapters.ml: മണവാട്ടി ഉള്ളവൻ മണവാളൻ ആകുന്നു; മണവാളന്റെ സ്നേഹിതനോ നിന്നു മണവാളന്റെ സ്വരം കേട്ടിട്ടു അത്യന്തം സന്തോഷിക്കുന്നു; ഈ എന്റെ സന്തോഷം പൂർത്തിയായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
chapters.nkjv: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore this joy of mine is fulfilled.
chapters.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വളരേണം, ഞാനോ കുറയേണം എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He must become greater; I must become less."
chapters.nkjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
chapters.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.

chapters.ml: മേലിൽ നിന്നു വരുന്നവൻ എല്ലാവർക്കും മീതെയുള്ളവൻ; ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നുള്ളവൻ ഭൌമികൻ ആകുന്നു; ഭൌമികമായതു സംസാരിക്കുന്നു; സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു വരുന്നവൻ എല്ലാവർക്കും മീതെയുള്ളവനായി താൻ കാൺകെയും കേൾക്കയും ചെയ്തതു സാക്ഷീകരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.
chapters.nkjv: He who comes from above is above all; he who is of the earth is earthly and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
chapters.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം ആരും കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.
chapters.nkjv: And what He has seen and heard, that He testifies; and no one receives His testimony.
chapters.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നവൻ ദൈവം സത്യവാൻ എന്നുള്ളതിന്നു മുദ്രയിടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.
chapters.nkjv: He who has received His testimony has certified that God is true.
chapters.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അയച്ചവൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനം പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ ആത്മാവിനെ അളവുകൂടാതെയല്ലോ കൊടുക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
chapters.nkjv: For He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God does not give the Spirit by measure.
chapters.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .

chapters.ml: പിതാവു പുത്രനെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു; സകലവും അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കൊടുത്തുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.
chapters.nkjv: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into His hand.
chapters.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

chapters.ml: പുത്രനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവന്നു നിത്യജീവൻ ഉണ്ടു; പുത്രനെ അനുസരിക്കാത്തവനോ ജീവനെ കാണുകയില്ല; ദൈവക്രോധം അവന്റെമേൽ വസിക്കുന്നതേയുള്ള.
chapters.niv: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God’s wrath remains on them.
chapters.nkjv: He who believes in the Son has everlasting life; and he who does not believe the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abides on him."
chapters.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

chapters.ml: യേശു യോഹന്നാനെക്കാൾ അധികം ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ ചേർത്തു സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പരീശന്മാർ കേട്ടു എന്നു കർത്താവു അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ —
chapters.niv: Now Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that he was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John—
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John
chapters.kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അല്ലാതെ, യേശു തന്നേ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചില്ലതാനും —
chapters.niv: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.
chapters.nkjv: (though Jesus Himself did not baptize, but His disciples),
chapters.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെഹൂദ്യദേശം വിട്ടു പിന്നെയും ഗലീലെക്കു യാത്രയായി.
chapters.niv: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.
chapters.nkjv: He left Judea and departed again to Galilee.
chapters.kjv: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശമര്യയിൽകൂടി കടന്നുപോകേണ്ടിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now he had to go through Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: But He needed to go through Samaria.
chapters.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ സുഖാർ എന്നൊരു ശമര്യപട്ടണത്തിൽ യാക്കോബ് തന്റെ പുത്രനായയോസേഫിന്നു കൊടുത്ത നിലത്തിന്നരികെ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
chapters.nkjv: So He came to a city of Samaria which is called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
chapters.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ യാക്കോബിന്റെ ഉറവുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. യേശു വഴി നടന്നു ക്ഷീണിച്ചിട്ടു ഉറവിന്നരികെ ഇരുന്നു; അപ്പോൾ ഏകദേശം ആറാം മണിനേരം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about noon.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied from His journey, sat thus by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
chapters.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ശമര്യസ്ത്രീ വെള്ളം കോരുവാൻ വന്നു; യേശു അവളോടു: “എനിക്കു കുടിപ്പാൻ തരുമോ ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, "Will you give me a drink?"
chapters.nkjv: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give Me a drink."
chapters.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഭക്ഷണസാധനങ്ങളെ കൊള്ളുവാൻ പട്ടണത്തിൽ പോയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
chapters.nkjv: For His disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
chapters.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

chapters.ml: ശമര്യസ്ത്രീ അവനോടു: നീ യെഹൂദൻ ആയിരിക്കെ ശമര്യക്കാരത്തിയായ എന്നോടു കുടിപ്പാൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. യെഹൂദന്മാർക്കും ശമര്യർക്കും തമ്മിൽ സമ്പർക്കമില്ല —
chapters.niv: The Samaritan woman said to him, "You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?" (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans. )
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman of Samaria said to Him, "How is it that You, being a Jew, ask a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?" For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.
chapters.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “നീ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാനവും നിന്നോടു കുടിപ്പാൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നവൻ ആരെന്നും അറിഞ്ഞു എങ്കിൽ നീ അവനോടു ചോദിക്കയും അവൻ ജീവനുള്ള വെള്ളം നിനക്കു തരികയും ചെയ്യുമായിരുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give Me a drink,’ you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ അവനോടു: യജമാനനേ, നിനക്കു കോരുവാൻ പാത്രം ഇല്ലല്ലോ; കിണറു ആഴമുള്ളതാകുന്നു; പിന്നെ ജീവനുള്ള വെള്ളം നിനക്കു എവിടെ നിന്നു?
chapters.niv: "Sir," the woman said, "you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?
chapters.nkjv: The woman said to Him, "Sir, You have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. Where then do You get that living water?
chapters.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാവായ യാക്കോബിനെക്കാൾ നീ വലിയവനോ? അവൻ ആകുന്നു ഈ കിണറു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നതു; അവനും അവന്റെ മക്കളും മൃഗങ്ങളും ഇതിലെ വെള്ളം കുടിച്ചു പോന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?"
chapters.nkjv: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself, as well as his sons and his livestock?"
chapters.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: “ഈ വെള്ളം കുടിക്കുന്നവന്നു എല്ലാം പിന്നെയും ദാഹിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to her, "Whoever drinks of this water will thirst again,
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കൊടുക്കുന്ന വെള്ളം കുടിക്കുന്നവന്നോ ഒരുനാളും ദാഹിക്കയില്ല; ഞാൻ കൊടുക്കുന്ന വെള്ളം അവനിൽ നിത്യജീവങ്കലേക്കു പൊങ്ങിവരുന്ന നീരുറവായിത്തീരും” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life."
