chapters.nkjv: but whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him will never thirst. But the water that I shall give him will become in him a fountain of water springing up into everlasting life."
chapters.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ അവനാടു: യജമാനനേ, എനിക്കു ദാഹിക്കാതെയും ഞാൻ കോരുവാൻ ഇവിടത്തോളം വരാതെയുമിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ആ വെള്ളം എനിക്കു തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water so that I won’t get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water."
chapters.nkjv: The woman said to Him, "Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst, nor come here to draw."
chapters.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: “പോയി ഭർത്താവിനെ വിളിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുവരിക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He told her, "Go, call your husband and come back."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Go, call your husband, and come here."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു ഭർത്താവു ഇല്ല എന്നു സ്ത്രീ അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു: “എനിക്കു ഭർത്താവു ഇല്ല എന്നു നീ പറഞ്ഞതു ശരി.
chapters.niv: "I have no husband," she replied. Jesus said to her, "You are right when you say you have no husband.
chapters.nkjv: The woman answered and said, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You have well said, ‘I have no husband,’
chapters.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചു ഭർത്താക്കന്മാർ നിനക്കു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ ഉള്ളവനോ ഭർത്താവല്ല; നീ പറഞ്ഞതു സത്യം തന്നേ” എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true."
chapters.nkjv: for you have had five husbands, and the one whom you now have is not your husband; in that you spoke truly."
chapters.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ അവനോടു: യജമാനനേ, നീ പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Sir," the woman said, "I can see that you are a prophet.
chapters.nkjv: The woman said to Him, "Sir, I perceive that You are a prophet.
chapters.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ഈ മലയിൽ നമസ്കരിച്ചുവന്നു; നമസ്കരിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന സ്ഥലം യെരൂശലേമിൽ ആകുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem."
chapters.nkjv: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where one ought to worship."
chapters.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “സ്ത്രീയേ, എന്റെ വാക്കു വിശ്വസിക്ക; നിങ്ങൾ പിതാവിനെ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നതു ഈ മലയിലും അല്ല യെരൂശലേമിലും അല്ല എന്നുള്ള നാഴിക വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Woman," Jesus replied, "believe me, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe Me, the hour is coming when you will neither on this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, worship the Father.
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ അറിയാത്തതിനെ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നു. ഞങ്ങളോ അറിയുന്നതിനെ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നു; രക്ഷ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നല്ലോ വരുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
chapters.nkjv: You worship what you do not know; we know what we worship, for salvation is of the Jews.
chapters.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

chapters.ml: സത്യനമസ്കാരികൾ പിതാവിനെ ആത്മാവിലും സത്യത്തിലും നമസ്കരിക്കുന്ന നാഴിക വരുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ വന്നുമിരിക്കുന്നു. തന്നേ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നവർ ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ളവർ ആയിരിക്കേണം എന്നു പിതാവു ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.
chapters.nkjv: But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth; for the Father is seeking such to worship Him.
chapters.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ആത്മാവു ആകുന്നു; അവനെ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നവർ ആത്മാവിലും സത്യത്തിലും നമസ്കരിക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth."
chapters.nkjv: God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth."
chapters.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ അവനോടു: മശീഹ — എന്നുവെച്ചാൽ ക്രിസ്തു — വരുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; അവൻ വരുമ്പോൾ സകലവും അറിയിച്ചുതരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The woman said, "I know that Messiah" (called Christ) "is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us."
chapters.nkjv: The woman said to Him, "I know that Messiah is coming" (who is called Christ). "When He comes, He will tell us all things."
chapters.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: “നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്ന ഞാൻ തന്നേ മശീഹ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus declared, "I, the one speaking to you—I am he."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "I who speak to you am He."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

chapters.ml: ഇതിന്നിടയിൽ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ വന്നു അവൻ സ്ത്രീയോടു സംസാരിക്കയാൽ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു എങ്കിലും: നീ എന്തു ചോദിക്കുന്നു? അവളോടു എന്തു സംസാരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ആരും ചോദിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, "What do you want?" or "Why are you talking with her?"
chapters.nkjv: And at this point His disciples came, and they marveled that He talked with a woman; yet no one said, "What do You seek?" or, "Why are You talking with her?"
chapters.kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സ്ത്രീ പാത്രം വെച്ചിട്ടു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ജനങ്ങളോടു:
chapters.niv: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,
chapters.nkjv: The woman then left her waterpot, went her way into the city, and said to the men,
chapters.kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ വന്നുകാണ്മിൻ; അവൻ പക്ഷേ ക്രിസ്തു ആയിരിക്കുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?"
chapters.nkjv: "Come, see a Man who told me all things that I ever did. Could this be the Christ?"
chapters.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

chapters.ml: അവർ പട്ടണത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.
chapters.nkjv: Then they went out of the city and came to Him.
chapters.kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നിടയിൽ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: റബ്ബീ, ഭക്ഷിച്ചാലും എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, "Rabbi, eat something."
chapters.nkjv: In the meantime His disciples urged Him, saying, "Rabbi, eat."
chapters.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: “നിങ്ങൾ അറിയാത്ത ആഹാരം ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു ഉണ്ടു” എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he said to them, "I have food to eat that you know nothing about."
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "I have food to eat of which you do not know."
chapters.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ വല്ലവനും അവന്നു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കൊണ്ടുവന്നുവോ എന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then his disciples said to each other, "Could someone have brought him food?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the disciples said to one another, "Has anyone brought Him anything to eat?"
chapters.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “എന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്തു അവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി തികെക്കുന്നതു തന്നെ എന്റെ ആഹാരം.
chapters.niv: "My food," said Jesus, "is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me, and to finish His work.
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

chapters.ml: ഇനി നാലു മാസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു കൊയ്ത്തു വരുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നില്ലയോ? നിങ്ങൾ തല പൊക്കി നോക്കിയാൽ നിലങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നേ കൊയ്ത്തിന്നു വെളുത്തിരിക്കുന്നതു കാണും” എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Don’t you have a saying, ‘It’s still four months until harvest’? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.
chapters.nkjv: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months and then comes the harvest’? Behold, I say to you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are already white for harvest!
chapters.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

chapters.ml: “വിതെക്കുന്നവനും കൊയ്യുന്നവനും ഒരുമിച്ചു സന്തോഷിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം കൊയ്യുന്നവൻ കൂലി വാങ്ങി നിത്യജീവങ്കലേക്കു വിളവു കൂട്ടിവെക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Even now the one who reaps draws a wage and harvests a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.
chapters.nkjv: And he who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit for eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
chapters.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

chapters.ml: വിതെക്കുന്നതു ഒരുത്തൻ, കൊയ്യുന്നതു മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ എന്നുള്ള പഴഞ്ചൊൽ ഇതിൽ ഒത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
chapters.nkjv: For in this the saying is true: ‘One sows and another reaps.’
chapters.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ അദ്ധ്വാനിച്ചിട്ടില്ലാത്തതു കൊയ്‍വാൻ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; മറ്റുള്ളവർ അദ്ധ്വാനിച്ചു; അവരുടെ അദ്ധ്വാനഫലത്തിലേക്കു നിങ്ങൾ പ്രവേശിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor."
chapters.nkjv: I sent you to reap that for which you have not labored; others have labored, and you have entered into their labors."
chapters.kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു സ്ത്രീ സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു നിമിത്തം ആ പട്ടണത്തിലെ പല ശമര്യരും അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, "He told me everything I ever did."
chapters.nkjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed in Him because of the word of the woman who testified, "He told me all that I ever did."
chapters.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശമര്യർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു തങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ പാർക്കേണം എന്നു അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു; അവൻ രണ്ടുനാൾ അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.
chapters.nkjv: So when the Samaritans had come to Him, they urged Him to stay with them; and He stayed there two days.
chapters.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

chapters.ml: ഏറ്റവും അധികംപേർ അവന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടു വിശ്വസിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: And because of his words many more became believers.
chapters.nkjv: And many more believed because of His own word.
chapters.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;

chapters.ml: ഇനി നിന്റെ വാക്കുകൊണ്ടല്ല ഞങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നതു; ഞങ്ങൾ തന്നേ കേൾക്കയും അവൻ സാക്ഷാൽ ലോകരക്ഷിതാവു എന്നു അറികയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു സ്ത്രീയോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They said to the woman, "We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to the woman, "Now we believe, not because of what you said, for we ourselves have heard Him and we know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world."
chapters.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ അവിടം വിട്ടു ഗലീലെക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: After the two days he left for Galilee.
chapters.nkjv: Now after the two days He departed from there and went to Galilee.
chapters.kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

chapters.ml: പ്രവാചകന്നു തന്റെ പിതൃദേശത്തു ബഹുമാനം ഇല്ല എന്നു യേശു തന്നേ സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)
chapters.nkjv: For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
chapters.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഗലീലയിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഗലീലക്കാർ തങ്ങളും പെരുന്നാളിന്നു പോയി അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽവെച്ചു പെരുനാളിൽ ചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും കണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ അംഗീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, for they also had been there.
chapters.nkjv: So when He came to Galilee, the Galileans received Him, having seen all the things He did in Jerusalem at the feast; for they also had gone to the feast.
chapters.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും താൻ വെള്ളം വീഞ്ഞാക്കിയ ഗലീലയിലെ കാനാവിൽ വന്നു. അന്നു മകൻ രോഗിയായിരുന്നോരു രാജഭൃത്യൻ കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus came again to Cana of Galilee where He had made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
chapters.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

chapters.ml: യേശു യെഹൂദ്യദേശത്തുനിന്നു ഗലീലയിൽ വന്നു എന്നു അവൻ കേട്ടു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു, തന്റെ മകൻ മരിപ്പാറായിരിക്കകൊണ്ടു അവൻ വന്നു അവനെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.
chapters.nkjv: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and implored Him to come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
chapters.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ അടയാളങ്ങളും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും കണ്ടിട്ടല്ലാതെ വിശ്വസിക്കയില്ല ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Unless you people see signs and wonders," Jesus told him, "you will never believe."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to him, "Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will by no means believe."
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

chapters.ml: രാജഭൃത്യൻ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, പൈതൽ മരിക്കുംമുമ്പേ വരേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The royal official said, "Sir, come down before my child dies."
chapters.nkjv: The nobleman said to Him, "Sir, come down before my child dies!"
chapters.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “പൊയ്ക്കൊൾക; നിന്റെ മകൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. യേശു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു വിശ്വസിച്ചു ആ മനുഷ്യൻ പോയി.
chapters.niv: "Go," Jesus replied, "your son will live." The man took Jesus at his word and departed.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "Go your way; your son lives." So the man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോകയിൽ അവന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ അവനെ എതിരേറ്റു മകൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.
chapters.nkjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him and told him, saying, "Your son lives!"
chapters.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him , saying, Thy son liveth.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു ഭേദം വന്ന നാഴിക അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവർ അവനോടു: ഇന്നലെ ഏഴുമണിക്കു പനി വിട്ടുമാറി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, "Yesterday, at one in the afternoon, the fever left him."
chapters.nkjv: Then he inquired of them the hour when he got better. And they said to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him."
chapters.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിന്റെ മകൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞ നാഴികയിൽ തന്നേ എന്നു അപ്പൻ ഗ്രഹിച്ചു താനും കുടുംബം ഒക്കെയും വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, "Your son will live." So he and his whole household believed.
chapters.nkjv: So the father knew that itwas at the same hour in which Jesus said to him, "Your son lives." And he himself believed, and his whole household.
chapters.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

chapters.ml: യേശു യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ നിന്നു ഗലീലയിൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ ഇതു രണ്ടാമത്തെ അടയാളമായിട്ടു ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.
chapters.nkjv: This again is the second sign Jesus did when He had come out of Judea into Galilee.
chapters.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഒരു ഉത്സവം ഉണ്ടായിട്ടു യേശു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.
chapters.nkjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ ആട്ടുവാതിൽക്കൽ ബേഥെസ്ദാ എന്നു എബ്രായപേരുള്ള ഒരു കുളം ഉണ്ടു; അതിന്നു അഞ്ചു മണ്ഡപം ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.
chapters.nkjv: Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, which is called in Hebrew, Bethesda, having five porches.
chapters.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

chapters.ml: അവയിൽ വ്യാധിക്കാർ, കുരുടർ, മുടന്തർ, ക്ഷയരോഗികൾ ഇങ്ങനെ വലിയോരു കൂട്ടം (വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഇളക്കം കാത്തുകൊണ്ടു) കിടന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.
chapters.nkjv: In these lay a great multitude of sick people, blind, lame, paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water.
chapters.kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

chapters.ml: (അതതു സമയത്തു ഒരു ദൂതൻ കുളത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങി വെള്ളം കലക്കും; വെള്ളം കലങ്ങിയ ശേഷം ആദ്യം ഇറങ്ങുന്നവൻ ഏതു വ്യാധിപിടിച്ചവനായിരുന്നാലും അവന്നു സൌഖ്യം വരും)
chapters.niv: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
chapters.nkjv: For an angel went down at a certain time into the pool and stirred up the water; then whoever stepped in first, after the stirring of the water, was made well of whatever disease he had.
chapters.kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മുപ്പത്തെട്ടു ആണ്ടു രോഗം പിടിച്ചു കിടന്നോരു മനുഷ്യൻ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to get well?"
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain man was there who had an infirmity thirty-eight years.
chapters.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കിടക്കുന്നതു യേശു കണ്ടു, ഇങ്ങനെ ഏറിയ കാലമായിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നറിഞ്ഞു: “നിനക്കു സൌഖ്യമാകുവാൻ മനസ്സുണ്ടോ ” എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Sir," the invalid replied, "I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am trying to get in, someone else goes down ahead of me."
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he already had been inthatcondition a long time, He said to him, "Do you want to be made well?"
chapters.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

chapters.ml: രോഗി അവനോടു: യജമാനനേ, വെള്ളം കലങ്ങുമ്പോൾ എന്നെ കുളത്തിൽ ആക്കുവാൻ എനിക്കു ആരും ഇല്ല; ഞാൻ തന്നേ ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ എനിക്കു മുമ്പായി ഇറങ്ങുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said to him, "Get up! Pick up your mat and walk."
chapters.nkjv: The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another steps down before me."
chapters.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “എഴുന്നേറ്റു നിന്റെ കിടക്ക എടുത്തു നടക്ക” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "Rise, take up your bed and walk."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ആ മനുഷ്യൻ സൌഖ്യമായി കിടക്ക എടുത്തു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: and so the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat."
chapters.nkjv: And immediately the man was made well, took up his bed, and walked. And that day was the Sabbath.
chapters.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അന്നു ശബ്ബത്ത് ആയിരുന്നു. ആകയാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാർ സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിച്ചവനോടു: ഇന്നു ശബ്ബത്ത് ആകുന്നു; കിടക്ക എടുക്കുന്നതു വിഹിതമല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he replied, "The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ "
chapters.nkjv: The Jews therefore said to him who was cured, "It is the Sabbath; it is not lawful for you to carry your bed."
chapters.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: എന്നെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കിയവൻ: കിടക്ക എടുത്ത നടക്ക എന്നു എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So they asked him, "Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?"
chapters.nkjv: He answered them, "He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your bed and walk.’ "
chapters.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: കിടക്ക എടുത്തു നടക്ക എന്നു നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞ മനുഷ്യൻ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.
chapters.nkjv: Then they asked him, "Who is the Man who said to you, ‘Take up your bed and walk’?"
chapters.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവിടെ പുരുഷാരം ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കയാൽ യേശു മാറിക്കളഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ ആരെന്നു സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിച്ചവൻ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, "See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you."
chapters.nkjv: But the one who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a multitude being in that place.
chapters.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യേശു അവനെ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽവെച്ചു കണ്ടു അവനോടു: “നോകൂ, നിനക്കു സൌഖ്യമായല്ലോ; അധികം തിന്മയായതു ഭവിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഇനി പാപം ചെയ്യരുതു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had made him well.
chapters.nkjv: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, "See, you have been made well. Sin no more, lest a worse thing come upon you."
chapters.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

chapters.ml: ആ മനുഷ്യൻ പോയി തന്നെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കിയതു യേശു എന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാരോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.
chapters.nkjv: The man departed and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
chapters.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

chapters.ml: യേശു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ അതു ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനെ ഉപദ്രവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In his defense Jesus said to them, "My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working."
chapters.nkjv: For this reason the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill Him, because He had done these things on the Sabbath.
chapters.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “എന്റെ പിതാവു ഇന്നുവരെയും പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു; ഞാനും പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For this reason they tried all the more to kill him; not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answered them, "My Father has been working until now, and I have been working."
chapters.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ശബ്ബത്തിനെ ലംഘിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു മാത്രമല്ല, ദൈവം സ്വന്തപിതാവു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തന്നെത്താൻ ദൈവത്തോടു സമമാക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടും യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അധികമായി ശ്രമിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus gave them this answer: "Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill Him, because He not only broke the Sabbath, but also said that God was His Father, making Himself equal with God.
chapters.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: പിതാവു ചെയ്തു കാണുന്നതു അല്ലാതെ പുത്രന്നു സ്വതേ ഒന്നും ചെയ്‍വാൻ കഴികയില്ല; അവൻ ചെയ്യുന്നതു എല്ലാം പുത്രനും അവ്വണ്ണം തന്നേ ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus answered and said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself, but what He sees the Father do; for whatever He does, the Son also does in like manner.
chapters.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

chapters.ml: പിതാവു പുത്രനെ സ്നേഹിക്കയും താൻ ചെയ്യുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും അവന്നു കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടുമാറു ഇവയിൽ വലിയ പ്രവൃത്തികളും അവന്നു കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.
chapters.nkjv: For the Father loves the Son, and shows Him all things that He Himself does; and He will show Him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
chapters.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

chapters.ml: പിതാവു മരിച്ചവരെ ഉണർത്തി ജീവിപ്പിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ പുത്രനും താൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നവരെ ജീവിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,
chapters.nkjv: For as the Father raises the dead and gives life to them, even so the Son gives life to whom He will.
chapters.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them ; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും പിതാവിനെ ബഹുമാനിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ പുത്രനെയും ബഹുമാനിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പിതാവു ആരെയും ന്യായം വിധിക്കാതെ ന്യായവിധി എല്ലാം പുത്രന്നുകൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.
chapters.nkjv: For the Father judges no one, but has committed all judgment to the Son,
chapters.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

chapters.ml: പുത്രനെ ബഹുമാനിക്കാത്തവൻ അവനെ അയച്ച പിതാവിനെയും ബഹുമാനിക്കുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: "Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.
chapters.nkjv: that all should honor the Son just as they honor the Father. He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
chapters.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: എന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടു എന്നെ അയച്ചവനെ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവന്നു നിത്യജീവൻ ഉണ്ടു; അവൻ ന്യായവിധിയിൽ ആകാതെ മരണത്തിൽ നിന്നു ജീവങ്കലേക്കു കടന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.
chapters.nkjv: "Most assuredly, I say to you, he who hears My word and believes in Him who sent Me has everlasting life, and shall not come into judgment, but has passed from death into life.
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: മരിച്ചവർ ദൈവപുത്രന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കയും കേൾക്കുന്നവർ ജീവിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്ന നാഴികവരുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ വന്നുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, the hour is coming, and now is, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God; and those who hear will live.
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

chapters.ml: പിതാവിന്നു തന്നിൽതന്നേ ജീവനുള്ളതുപോലെ അവൻ പുത്രന്നും തന്നിൽതന്നേ ജീവനുള്ളവൻ ആകുമാറു വരം നല്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.
chapters.nkjv: For as the Father has life in Himself, so He has granted the Son to have life in Himself,
chapters.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

chapters.ml: അവൻ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ആകയാൽ ന്യായവിധിനടത്തുവാൻ അവന്നു അധികാരവും നല്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice
chapters.nkjv: and has given Him authority to execute judgment also, because He is the Son of Man.
chapters.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

chapters.ml: ഇതിങ്കൽ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടരുതു; കല്ലറകളിൽ ഉള്ളവർ എല്ലാവരും അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടു,
chapters.niv: and come out—those who have done what is good will rise to live, and those who have done what is evil will rise to be condemned.
chapters.nkjv: Do not marvel at this; for the hour is coming in which all who are in the graves will hear His voice
chapters.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

chapters.ml: നന്മ ചെയ്തവർ ജീവന്നായും തിന്മ ചെയ്തവർ ന്യായവിധിക്കായും പുനരുത്ഥാനം ചെയ്‍വാനുള്ള നാഴിക വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.
chapters.nkjv: and come forth— those who have done good, to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of condemnation.
chapters.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു സ്വതേ ഒന്നും ചെയ്‍വാൻ കഴിയുന്നതല്ല; ഞാൻ കേൾക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ന്യായം വിധിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ എന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം അല്ല, എന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടമത്രേ ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു എന്റെ വിധി നീതിയുള്ളതു ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.
chapters.nkjv: I can of Myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is righteous, because I do not seek My own will but the will of the Father who sent Me.
chapters.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു തന്നേ സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞാൽ എന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം സത്യമല്ല.
chapters.niv: There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is true.
chapters.nkjv: "If I bear witness of Myself, My witness is not true.
chapters.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

chapters.ml: എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നതു മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ ആകുന്നു; അവൻ എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയുന്ന സാക്ഷ്യം സത്യം എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.
chapters.nkjv: There is another who bears witness of Me, and I know that the witness which He witnesses of Me is true.
chapters.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ യോഹാന്നാന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു; അവൻ സത്യത്തിന്നു സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.
chapters.nkjv: You have sent to John, and he has borne witness to the truth.
chapters.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കോ മനുഷ്യന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യംകൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യമില്ല; നിങ്ങൾ രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുവാനത്രേ ഇതു പറയുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.
chapters.nkjv: Yet I do not receive testimony from man, but I say these things that you may be saved.
chapters.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ജ്വലിച്ചു പ്രകാശിക്കുന്ന വിളക്കു ആയിരുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ അല്പസമയത്തേക്കു അവന്റെ വെളിച്ചത്തിൽ ഉല്ലസിപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to finish—the very works that I am doing—testify that the Father has sent me.
chapters.nkjv: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.
chapters.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കോ യോഹന്നാന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യത്തിലും വലിയ സാക്ഷ്യം ഉണ്ടു; പിതാവു എനിക്കു അനുഷ്ഠിപ്പാൻ തന്നിരിക്കുന്ന പ്രവൃത്തികൾ, ഞാൻ ചെയ്യുന്ന പ്രവൃത്തികൾ തന്നേ, പിതാവു എന്നെ അയച്ചു എന്നു എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷീകരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,
chapters.nkjv: But I have a greater witness than John’s; for the works which the Father has given Me to finish—the very works that I do—bear witness of Me, that the Father has sent Me.
chapters.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ അയച്ച പിതാവുതാനും എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം ഒരുനാളും കേട്ടിട്ടില്ല, അവന്റെ രൂപം കണ്ടിട്ടില്ല;
chapters.niv: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.
chapters.nkjv: And the Father Himself, who sent Me, has testified of Me. You have neither heard His voice at any time, nor seen His form.
chapters.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വചനം നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ വസിക്കുന്നതുമില്ല അവൻ അയച്ചവനെ നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about me,
chapters.nkjv: But you do not have His word abiding in you, because whom He sent, Him you do not believe.
chapters.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളെ ശോധനചെയ്യുന്നു; അവയിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു നിത്യജീവൻ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ നിരൂപിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; അവ എനിക്കു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.
chapters.nkjv: You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; and these are they which testify of Me.
chapters.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ജീവൻ പ്രാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മനസ്സില്ല.
chapters.niv: "I do not accept glory from human beings,
chapters.nkjv: But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.
chapters.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ മനുഷ്യരോടു ബഹുമാനം വാങ്ങുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.
chapters.nkjv: "I do not receive honor from men.
chapters.kjv: I receive not honour from men.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉള്ളിൽ ദൈവസ്നേഹം ഇല്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.
chapters.nkjv: But I know you, that you do not have the love of God in you.
chapters.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നില്ല; മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ സ്വന്തനാമത്തിൽ വന്നാൽ അവനെ നിങ്ങൾ കൈക്കൊള്ളും.
chapters.niv: How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God ?
chapters.nkjv: I have come in My Father’s name, and you do not receive Me; if another comes in his own name, him you will receive.
chapters.kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

chapters.ml: തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ ബഹുമാനം വാങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ടു ഏകദൈവത്തിന്റെ പക്കൽ നിന്നുള്ള ബഹുമാനം അന്വേഷിക്കാത്ത നിങ്ങൾക്കു എങ്ങനെ വിശ്വസിപ്പാൻ കഴിയും?
chapters.niv: "But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.
chapters.nkjv: How can you believe, who receive honor from one another, and do not seek the honor that comes from the only God?
chapters.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പിതാവിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിങ്ങളെ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തും എന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു തോന്നരുതു. നിങ്ങളെ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുന്നവൻ ഉണ്ടു; നിങ്ങൾ പ്രത്യാശ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന മോശെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.
chapters.nkjv: Do not think that I shall accuse you to the Father; there is one who accuses you—Moses, in whom you trust.
chapters.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ മോശെയെ വിശ്വസിച്ചു എങ്കിൽ എന്നെയും വിശ്വസിക്കുമായിരുന്നു; അവൻ എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?"
chapters.nkjv: For if you believed Moses, you would believe Me; for he wrote about Me.
chapters.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ എഴുത്തു നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നില്ല എങ്കിൽ എന്റെ വാക്കു എങ്ങനെ വിശ്വസിക്കും
chapters.nkjv: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"
chapters.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യേശു തിബെര്യാസ് എന്ന ഗലീലക്കടലിന്റെ അക്കരെക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),
chapters.nkjv: After these things Jesus went over the Sea of Galilee, which is theSea of Tiberias.
chapters.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രോഗികളിൽ ചെയ്യുന്ന അടയാളങ്ങളെ കണ്ടിട്ടു ഒരു വലിയ പുരുഷാരം അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the signs he had performed by healing the sick.
chapters.nkjv: Then a great multitude followed Him, because they saw His signs which He performed on those who were diseased.
chapters.kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

chapters.ml: യേശു മലയിൽ കയറി ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടുകൂടെ അവിടെ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus went up on the mountain, and there He sat with His disciples.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ പെസഹ പെരുന്നാൾ അടുത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.
chapters.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

chapters.ml: യേശു വലിയൊരു പുരുഷാരം തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനോടു: “ഇവർക്കു തിന്നുവാൻ നാം എവിടെ നിന്നു അപ്പം വാങ്ങും” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus lifted up His eyes, and seeing a great multitude coming toward Him, He said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread, that these may eat?"
chapters.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

chapters.ml: ഇതു അവനെ പരീക്ഷിപ്പാനത്രേ ചോദിച്ചതു; താൻ എന്തു ചെയ്‍വാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു താൻ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.
chapters.nkjv: But this He said to test him, for He Himself knew what He would do.
chapters.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പൊസ് അവനോടു: ഓരോരുത്തന്നു അല്പമല്പം ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇരുനൂറു പണത്തിന്നു അപ്പം മതിയാകയില്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Philip answered him, "It would take more than half a year’s wages to buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!"
chapters.nkjv: Philip answered Him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may have a little."
chapters.kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനായി ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസിന്റെ സഹോദരനായ അന്ത്രെയാസ് അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up,
chapters.nkjv: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
chapters.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,

chapters.ml: ഇവിടെ ഒരു ബാലകൻ ഉണ്ടു; അവന്റെ പക്കൽ അഞ്ചു യവത്തപ്പവും രണ്ടു മീനും ഉണ്ടു; എങ്കിലും ഇത്രപേർക്കു അതു എന്തുള്ളു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?"
chapters.nkjv: "There is a lad here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what are they among so many?"
chapters.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

chapters.ml: “ആളുകളെ ഇരുത്തുവിൻ ” എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞു. ആ സ്ഥലത്തു വളരെ പുല്ലുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അയ്യായിരത്തോളം പുരുഷന്മാർ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." There was plenty of grass in that place, and they sat down (about five thousand men were there).
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said, "Make the people sit down." Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ യേശു അപ്പം എടുത്തു വാഴ്ത്തി, ഇരുന്നവർക്കു പങ്കിട്ടുകൊടുത്തു; അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ മീനും വേണ്ടുന്നേടത്തോളം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks He distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those sitting down; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു തൃപ്തിയായശേഷം അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: “ശേഷിച്ച കഷണം ഒന്നും നഷ്ടമാക്കാതെ ശേഖരിപ്പിൻ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, "Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted."
chapters.nkjv: So when they were filled, He said to His disciples, "Gather up the fragments that remain, so that nothing is lost."
chapters.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചു യവത്തപ്പത്തിൽ തിന്നു ശേഷിച്ച കഷണം അവർ ശേഖരിച്ചു പന്ത്രണ്ടു കൊട്ട നിറച്ചെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten.
chapters.kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെയ്ത അടയാളം ആളുകൾ കണ്ടിട്ടു: ലോകത്തിലേക്കു വരുവാനുള്ള പ്രവാചകൻ ഇവൻ ആകുന്നു സത്യം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After the people saw the sign Jesus performed, they began to say, "Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world."
chapters.nkjv: Then those men, when they had seen the sign that Jesus did, said, "This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world."
chapters.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

chapters.ml: അവർ വന്നു തന്നെ പിടിച്ചു രാജാവാക്കുവാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യേശു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു പിന്നെയും തനിച്ചു മലയിലേക്കു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore when Jesus perceived that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, He departed again to the mountain by Himself alone.
chapters.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

chapters.ml: സന്ധ്യയായപ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കടല്പുറത്തേക്കു ഇറങ്ങി
chapters.niv: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,
chapters.nkjv: Now when evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
chapters.kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

chapters.ml: പടകുകയറി കടലക്കരെ കഫർന്നഹൂമിലേക്കു യാത്രയായി; ഇരുട്ടായശേഷവും യേശു അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.
chapters.nkjv: got into the boat, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was already dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
chapters.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

chapters.ml: കൊടുങ്കാറ്റു അടിക്കയാൽ കടൽ കോപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sea arose because a great wind was blowing.
chapters.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

chapters.ml: അവർ നാലു അഞ്ചു നാഴിക ദൂരത്തോളം വലിച്ചശേഷം യേശു കടലിന്മേൽ നടന്നു പടകിനോടു സമീപിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു പേടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were frightened.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near the boat; and they were afraid.
chapters.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു; പേടിക്കേണ്ടാ ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But he said to them, "It is I; don’t be afraid."
chapters.nkjv: But He said to them, "It is I; do not be afraid."
chapters.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ പടകിൽ കയറ്റുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചു; ഉടനെ പടകു അവർ പോകുന്ന ദേശത്തു എത്തിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
chapters.nkjv: Then they willingly received Him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
chapters.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ കടൽക്കരെ നിന്ന പുരുഷാരം ഒരു പടകല്ലാതെ അവിടെ വേറെ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു എന്നും, യേശു ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടുകൂടെ പടകിൽ കയറാതെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ മാത്രം പോയിരുന്നു എന്നും ഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.
chapters.nkjv: On the following day, when the people who were standing on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except that one which His disciples had entered, and that Jesus had not entered the boat with His disciples, but His disciples had gone away alone—
chapters.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കർത്താവു വാഴ്ത്തീട്ടു അവർ അപ്പം തിന്ന സ്ഥലത്തിന്നരികെ തിബെര്യാസിൽനിന്നു ചെറുപടകുകൾ എത്തിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
chapters.nkjv: however, other boats came from Tiberias, near the place where they ate bread after the Lord had given thanks—
chapters.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

chapters.ml: യേശു അവിടെ ഇല്ല ശിഷ്യന്മാരും ഇല്ല എന്നു പുരുഷാരം കണ്ടപ്പോൾ തങ്ങളും പടകു കയറി യേശുവിനെ തിരഞ്ഞു കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: when the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they also got into boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
chapters.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

chapters.ml: കടലക്കരെ അവനെ കണ്ടെത്തിയപ്പോൾ: റബ്ബീ, നീ എപ്പോൾ ഇവിടെ വന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നുയേശു
chapters.niv: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, "Rabbi, when did you get here?"
chapters.nkjv: And when they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You come here?"
chapters.kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

chapters.ml: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ അടയാളം കണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടല്ല, അപ്പം തിന്നു തൃപ്തരായതുകൊണ്ടത്രേ എന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "Very truly I tell you, you are looking for me, not because you saw the signs I performed but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered them and said, "Most assuredly, I say to you, you seek Me, not because you saw the signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

chapters.ml: നശിച്ചുപോകുന്ന ആഹാരത്തിന്നായിട്ടല്ല, നിത്യജീവങ്കലേക്കു നിലനില്ക്കുന്ന ആഹാരത്തിന്നായിട്ടു തന്നേ പ്രവർത്തിപ്പിൻ; അതു മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തരും. അവനെ പിതാവായ ദൈവം മുദ്രയിട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on him God the Father has placed his seal of approval."
chapters.nkjv: Do not labor for the food which perishes, but for the food which endures to everlasting life, which the Son of Man will give you, because God the Father has set His seal on Him."
chapters.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു ദൈവത്തിന്നു പ്രസാദമുള്ള പ്രവൃത്തികളെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they asked him, "What must we do to do the works God requires?"
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to Him, "What shall we do, that we may work the works of God?"
chapters.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ദൈവത്തിന്നു പ്രസാദമുള്ള പ്രവൃത്തി അവൻ അയച്ചവനിൽ നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നതത്രേ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in Him whom He sent."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ കണ്ടു നിന്നെ വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ എന്തു അടയാളം ചെയ്യുന്നു? എന്തു പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു?
chapters.niv: So they asked him, "What sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they said to Him, "What sign will You perform then, that we may see it and believe You? What work will You do?
chapters.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ മന്നാ തിന്നു; അവർക്കു തിന്നുവാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു അപ്പം കൊടുത്തു എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Our fathers ate the manna in the desert; as it is written, ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ "
chapters.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നുള്ള അപ്പം മോശെയല്ല നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നതു, എന്റെ പിതാവത്രേ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നുള്ള സാക്ഷാൽ അപ്പം നിങ്ങൾക്കു തരുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "Very truly I tell you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but My Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അപ്പമോ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു ലോകത്തിന്നു ജീവനെ കൊടുക്കുന്നതു ആകുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
chapters.nkjv: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
chapters.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, ഈ അപ്പം എപ്പോഴും ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തരേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Sir," they said, "always give us this bread."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to Him, "Lord, give us this bread always."
chapters.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടുപറഞ്ഞതു: “ഞാൻ ജീവന്റെ അപ്പം ആകുന്നു; എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നവന്നു വിശക്കയില്ല; എന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവന്നു ഒരു നാളും ദാഹിക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus declared, "I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life. He who comes to Me shall never hunger, and he who believes in Me shall never thirst.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ കണ്ടിട്ടും വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.
chapters.nkjv: But I said to you that you have seen Me and yet do not believe.
chapters.kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

chapters.ml: പിതാവു എനിക്കു തരുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരും; എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നവനെ ഞാൻ ഒരുനാളും തള്ളിക്കളകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.
chapters.nkjv: All that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will by no means cast out.
chapters.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ഇഷ്ടമല്ല, എന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടമത്രേ ചെയ്‍വാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.
chapters.nkjv: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
chapters.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എനിക്കു തന്നതിൽ ഒന്നും ഞാൻ കളയാതെ എല്ലാം ഒടുക്കത്തെ നാളിൽ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിക്കേണം എന്നാകുന്നു എന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം.
chapters.niv: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all those he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.
chapters.nkjv: This is the will of the Father who sent Me, that of all He has given Me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.
chapters.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

chapters.ml: പുത്രനെ നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഏവന്നും നിത്യജീവൻ ഉണ്ടാകേണമെന്നാകുന്നു എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം; ഞാൻ അവനെ ഒടുക്കത്തെ നാളിൽ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: For my Father’s will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day."
chapters.nkjv: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him may have everlasting life; and I will raise him up at the last day."
chapters.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവന്ന അപ്പം എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതിനാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു പിറുപിറുത്തു:
chapters.niv: At this the Jews there began to grumble about him because he said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."
chapters.nkjv: The Jews then complained about Him, because He said, "I am the bread which came down from heaven."
chapters.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ യോസേഫിന്റെ പുത്രനായ യേശു അല്ലയോ? അവന്റെ അപ്പനെയും അമ്മയെയും നാം അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ; പിന്നെ ഞാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവന്നു എന്നു അവൻ പറയുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They said, "Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, ‘I came down from heaven’?"
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How is it then that He says, ‘I have come down from heaven’?"
chapters.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “നിങ്ങൾ തമ്മിൽ പിറുപിറുക്കേണ്ടാ;
chapters.niv: "Stop grumbling among yourselves," Jesus answered.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus therefore answered and said to them, "Do not murmur among yourselves.
chapters.kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ അയച്ച പിതാവു ആകർഷിച്ചിട്ടില്ലാതെ ആർക്കും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ കഴികയില്ല; ഞാൻ ഒടുക്കത്തെ നാളിൽ അവനെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: "No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.
chapters.nkjv: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up at the last day.
chapters.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും ദൈവത്താൽ ഉപദേശിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ ആകും എന്നു പ്രവാചകപുസ്തകങ്ങളിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു. പിതാവിനോടു കേട്ടുപഠിച്ചവൻ എല്ലാം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരും.
chapters.niv: It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from him comes to me.
chapters.nkjv: It is written in the prophets, ‘And they shall all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to Me.
chapters.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

chapters.ml: പിതാവിനെ ആരെങ്കിലും കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ടു എന്നല്ല, ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നു വന്നവൻ മാത്രമേ പിതാവിനെ കണ്ടിട്ടുള്ള.
chapters.niv: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.
chapters.nkjv: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except He who is from God; He has seen the Father.
chapters.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവന്നു നിത്യജീവൻ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me has everlasting life.
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ജീവന്റെ അപ്പം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I am the bread of life.
chapters.nkjv: I am the bread of life.
chapters.kjv: I am that bread of life.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ മന്നാ തിന്നിട്ടും മരിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
chapters.nkjv: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
chapters.kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

chapters.ml: ഇതോ തിന്നുന്നവൻ മരിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങുന്ന അപ്പം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.
chapters.nkjv: This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that one may eat of it and not die.
chapters.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിയ ജീവനുള്ള അപ്പം ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു; ഈ അപ്പം തിന്നുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം എന്നേക്കും ജീവിക്കും; ഞാൻ കൊടുപ്പാനിരിക്കുന്ന അപ്പമോ ലോകത്തിന്റെ ജീവന്നു വേണ്ടി ഞാൻ കൊടുക്കുന്ന എന്റെ മാംസം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world."
chapters.nkjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever; and the bread that I shall give is My flesh, which I shall give for the life of the world."
chapters.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാർ: നമുക്കു തന്റെ മാംസം തിന്നേണ്ടതിന്നു തരുവാൻ ഇവന്നു എങ്ങനെ കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തമ്മിൽ വാദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"
chapters.nkjv: The Jews therefore quarreled among themselves, saying, "How can this Man give us His flesh to eat?"
chapters.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്റെ മാംസം തിന്നാതെയും അവന്റെ രക്തം കുടിക്കാതെയും ഇരുന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉള്ളിൽ ജീവൻ ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you have no life in you.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മാംസം തിന്നുകയും എന്റെ രക്തം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നവന്നു നിത്യജീവൻ ഉണ്ടു; ഞാൻ ഒടുക്കത്തെ നാളിൽ അവനെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.
chapters.nkjv: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
chapters.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മാംസം സാക്ഷാൽ ഭക്ഷണവും എന്റെ രക്തം സാക്ഷാൽ പാനീയവും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.
chapters.nkjv: For My flesh is food indeed, and My blood is drink indeed.
chapters.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മാംസം തിന്നുകയും എന്റെ രക്തം കുടിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ എന്നിലും ഞാൻ അവനിലും വസിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.
chapters.nkjv: He who eats My flesh and drinks My blood abides in Me, and I in him.
chapters.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

chapters.ml: ജീവനുള്ള പിതാവു എന്നെ അയച്ചിട്ടു ഞാൻ പിതാവിൻമൂലം ജീവിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ എന്നെ തിന്നുന്നവൻ എൻമൂലം ജീവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.
chapters.nkjv: As the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
chapters.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങിവന്ന അപ്പം ഇതു ആകുന്നു; പിതാക്കന്മാർ തിന്നുകയും മരിക്കയും ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അല്ല; ഈ അപ്പം തിന്നുന്നവൻ എന്നേക്കും ജീവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your ancestors ate manna and died, but whoever feeds on this bread will live forever."
chapters.nkjv: This is the bread which came down from heaven—not as your fathers ate the manna, and are dead. He who eats this bread will live forever."
chapters.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കഫർന്നഹൂമിൽ ഉപദേശിക്കുമ്പോൾ പള്ളിയിൽവെച്ചു ഇതു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
chapters.nkjv: These things He said in the synagogue as He taught in Capernaum.
chapters.kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പലരും അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു: ഇതു കഠിനവാക്കു, ഇതു ആർക്കു കേൾപ്പാൻ കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, "This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore many of His disciples, when they heard this, said, "This is a hard saying; who can understand it?"
chapters.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this , said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അതിനെച്ചൊല്ലി പിറുപിറുക്കുന്നതു യേശു തന്നിൽതന്നേ അറിഞ്ഞു അവരോടു: “ഇതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഇടർച്ച ആകുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, "Does this offend you?
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus knew in Himself that His disciples complained about this, He said to them, "Does this offend you?
chapters.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മുമ്പെ ഇരുന്നേടത്തേക്കു കയറിപ്പോകുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾ കണ്ടാലോ?
chapters.niv: Then what if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!
chapters.nkjv: What then if you should see the Son of Man ascend where He was before?
chapters.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

chapters.ml: ജീവിപ്പിക്കുന്നതു ആത്മാവു ആകുന്നു; മാംസം ഒന്നിന്നും ഉപകരിക്കുന്നില്ല; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു സംസാരിച്ച വചനങ്ങൾ ആത്മാവും ജീവനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you—they are full of the Spirit and life.
chapters.nkjv: It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life.
chapters.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും വിശ്വസിക്കാത്തവർ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഉണ്ടു ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു — വിശ്വസിക്കാത്തവർ ഇന്നവർ എന്നും തന്നെ കാണിച്ചു കൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ ഇന്നവൻ എന്നും യേശു ആദിമുതൽ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു —
chapters.niv: Yet there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.
chapters.nkjv: But there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who did not believe, and who would betray Him.
chapters.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഹേതുവായിട്ടത്രേ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു: “പിതാവു കൃപ നല്കീട്ടല്ലാതെ ആർക്കും എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുവാൻ കഴികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു” എന്നും അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He went on to say, "This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled them."
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Therefore I have said to you that no one can come to Me unless it has been granted to him by My Father."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

chapters.ml: അന്നുമുതൽ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ പലരും പിൻവാങ്ങിപ്പോയി, പിന്നെ അവനോടു കൂടെ സഞ്ചരിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.
chapters.nkjv: From that time many of His disciples went back and walked with Him no more.
chapters.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യേശു പന്തിരുവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾക്കും പൊയ്ക്കൊൾവാൻ മനസ്സുണ്ടോ ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "You do not want to leave too, do you?" Jesus asked the Twelve.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to the twelve, "Do you also want to go away?"
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, ഞങ്ങൾ ആരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പോകും? നിത്യജീവന്റെ വചനങ്ങൾ നിന്റെ പക്കൽ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
chapters.nkjv: But Simon Peter answered Him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
chapters.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

chapters.ml: നീ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പരിശുദ്ധൻ എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിച്ചും അറിഞ്ഞും ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God."
chapters.nkjv: Also we have come to believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
chapters.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങളെ പന്ത്രണ്ടു പേരെ ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തില്ലയോ? എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ഒരു പിശാചു ആകുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. ഇതു അവൻ ശിമോൻ ഈസ്കര്യയ്യോർത്താവിന്റെ മകനായ യൂദയെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus replied, "Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!"
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?"
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ പന്തിരുവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ എങ്കിലും അവനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാനുള്ളവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)
chapters.nkjv: He spoke of Judas Iscariot, theson of Simon, for it was he who would betray Him, being one of the twelve.
chapters.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യേശു ഗലീലയിൽ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു; യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അന്വേഷിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ സഞ്ചരിപ്പാൻ അവന്നു മനസ്സില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea because the Jewish leaders there were looking for a way to kill him.
chapters.nkjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee; for He did not want to walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill Him.
chapters.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ കൂടാരപ്പെരുനാൾ അടുത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,
chapters.nkjv: Now the Jews’ Feast of Tabernacles was at hand.
chapters.kjv: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ അവനോടു: നീ ചെയ്യുന്ന പ്രവൃത്തികളെ നിന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരും കാണേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇവിടം വിട്ടു യെഹൂദ്യയിലേക്കു പോക.
chapters.niv: Jesus’ brothers said to him, "Leave Galilee and go to Judea, so that your disciples there may see the works you do.
chapters.nkjv: His brothers therefore said to Him, "Depart from here and go into Judea, that Your disciples also may see the works that You are doing.
chapters.kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

chapters.ml: പ്രസിദ്ധൻ ആകുവാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നവൻ ആരും രഹസ്യത്തിൽ ഒന്നും ചെയ്യുന്നില്ലല്ലോ; നീ ഇതു ചെയ്യുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ലോകത്തിന്നു നിന്നെത്തന്നേ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world."
chapters.nkjv: For no one does anything in secret while he himself seeks to be known openly. If You do these things, show Yourself to the world."
chapters.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരും അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
chapters.nkjv: For even His brothers did not believe in Him.
chapters.kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “എന്റെ സമയം ഇതുവരെ വന്നിട്ടില്ല; നിങ്ങൾക്കോ എല്ലയ്പോഴും സമയം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Therefore Jesus told them, "My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെ പകെപ്പാൻ ലോകത്തിന്നു കഴിയുന്നതല്ല; എന്നാൽ അതിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ ദോഷമുള്ളവ എന്നു ഞാൻ അതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അതു എന്നെ പകെക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.
chapters.nkjv: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me because I testify of it that its works are evil.
chapters.kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പെരുനാളിന്നു പോകുവിൻ; എന്റെ സമയം ഇതുവരെ വന്നിട്ടില്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ ഈ പെരുനാളിന്നു ഇപ്പോൾ പോകുന്നില്ല.
