chapters.niv: You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come."
chapters.nkjv: You go up to this feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, for My time has not yet fully come."
chapters.kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഗലീലയിൽ തന്നേ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.
chapters.nkjv: When He had said these things to them, He remained in Galilee.
chapters.kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർ പെരുനാളിന്നു പോയശേഷം അവനും പരസ്യമായിട്ടല്ല രഹസ്യത്തിൽ എന്നപോലെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.
chapters.nkjv: But when His brothers had gone up, then He also went up to the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
chapters.kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാർ പെരുനാളിൽ: അവൻ എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു അവനെ അന്വേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, "Where is he?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews sought Him at the feast, and said, "Where is He?"
chapters.kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു വളരെ കുശുകുശുപ്പു ഉണ്ടായി; അവൻ നല്ലവൻ എന്നു ചിലരും അല്ല, അവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തെ വഞ്ചിക്കുന്നു എന്നു മറ്റു ചിലരും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others replied, "No, he deceives the people."
chapters.nkjv: And there was much complaining among the people concerning Him. Some said, "He is good"; others said, "No, on the contrary, He deceives the people."
chapters.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും യെഹൂദന്മാരെ പേടിച്ചിട്ടു ആരും പ്രസിദ്ധമായി അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു സംസാരിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.
chapters.nkjv: However, no one spoke openly of Him for fear of the Jews.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

chapters.ml: പെരുനാൾ പാതി കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം യേശു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ഉപദേശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.
chapters.nkjv: Now about the middle of the feast Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
chapters.kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

chapters.ml: വിദ്യാഭ്യാസം ചെയ്യാത്ത ഇവൻ ശാസ്ത്രം അറിയുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാർ പറഞ്ഞു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The Jews there were amazed and asked, "How did this man get such learning without having been taught?"
chapters.nkjv: And the Jews marveled, saying, "How does this Man know letters, having never studied?"
chapters.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “എന്റെ ഉപദേശം എന്റേതല്ല, എന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റേതത്രേ.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered them and said, "My doctrine is not Mine, but His who sent Me.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നവൻ ഈ ഉപദേശം ദൈവത്തിൽ നിന്നുള്ളതോ ഞാൻ സ്വയമായി പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്നതോ എന്നു അറിയും.
chapters.niv: Anyone who chooses to do the will of God will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.
chapters.nkjv: If anyone wills to do His will, he shall know concerning the doctrine, whether it is from God or whether I speak on My own authority.
chapters.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

chapters.ml: സ്വയമായി പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്നവൻ സ്വന്തമഹത്വം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; തന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റെ മഹത്വം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവൻ സത്യവാൻ ആകുന്നു; നീതികേടു അവനിൽ ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Whoever speaks on their own does so to gain personal glory, but he who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.
chapters.nkjv: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory; but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is true, and no unrighteousness is in Him.
chapters.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

chapters.ml: മോശെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ന്യായപ്രമാണം തന്നിട്ടില്ലയോ? എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളിൽ ആരും ന്യായപ്രമാണം ആചരിക്കുന്നില്ല. നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?"
chapters.nkjv: Did not Moses give you the law, yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill Me?"
chapters.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പുരുഷാരം: നിനക്കു ഒരു ഭൂതം ഉണ്ടു; ആർ നിന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You are demon-possessed," the crowd answered. "Who is trying to kill you?"
chapters.nkjv: The people answered and said, "You have a demon. Who is seeking to kill You?"
chapters.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഞാൻ ഒരു പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്തു; അതിങ്കൽ നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "I did one work, and you all marvel.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

chapters.ml: മോശെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു പരിച്ഛേദന നിയമിച്ചിരിക്കയാൽ--അതു മോശെയുടെ കാലത്തല്ല പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ കാലത്തത്രെ തുടങ്ങിയതു--നിങ്ങൾ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ മനുഷ്യനെ പരിച്ഛേദന കഴിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.
chapters.nkjv: Moses therefore gave you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.
chapters.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്നു നീക്കം വരാതിരിപ്പാൻ ശബ്ബത്തിലും മനുഷ്യൻ പരിച്ഛേദന ഏല്ക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെ മുഴുവനും സൌഖ്യമാക്കിയതിനാൽ എന്നോടു ഈർഷ്യപ്പെടുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: Now if a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing a man’s whole body on the Sabbath?
chapters.nkjv: If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath, so that the law of Moses should not be broken, are you angry with Me because I made a man completely well on the Sabbath?
chapters.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

chapters.ml: കാഴ്ചപ്രകാരം വിധിക്കരുതു; നീതിയുള്ള വിധി വിധിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly."
chapters.nkjv: Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment."
chapters.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമ്യരിൽ ചിലർ: അവർ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവൻ ഇവൻ അല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, "Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
chapters.nkjv: Now some of them from Jerusalem said, "Is this not He whom they seek to kill?
chapters.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

chapters.ml: അവൻ ധൈര്യത്തോടെ സംസാരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ; അവർ അവനോടു ഒന്നും പറയുന്നില്ല; ഇവൻ ക്രിസ്തു ആകുന്നു എന്നു പ്രമാണികൾ യഥാർത്ഥമായി ഗ്രഹിച്ചുവോ?
chapters.niv: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Messiah?
chapters.nkjv: But look! He speaks boldly, and they say nothing to Him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is truly the Christ?
chapters.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ഇവൻ എവിടെനിന്നു എന്നു നാം അറിയുന്നു; ക്രിസ്തു വരുമ്പോഴോ അവൻ എവിടെനിന്നു എന്നു ആരും അറികയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But we know where this man is from; when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from."
chapters.nkjv: However, we know where this Man is from; but when the Christ comes, no one knows where He is from."
chapters.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യേശു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഉപദേശിക്കുമ്പോൾ: “നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ അറിയുന്നു; ഞാൻ എവിടെനിന്നെന്നും അറിയുന്നു. ഞാൻ സ്വയമായിട്ടു വന്നവനല്ല, എന്നെ അയച്ചവൻ സത്യവാൻ ആകുന്നു; അവനെ നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, "Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own authority, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus cried out, as He taught in the temple, saying, "You both know Me, and you know where I am from; and I have not come of Myself, but He who sent Me is true, whom you do not know.
chapters.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ നിന്നു വന്നതുകൊണ്ടും അവൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചതുകൊണ്ടും ഞാൻ അവനെ അറിയുന്നു” എന്നു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me."
chapters.nkjv: But I know Him, for I am from Him, and He sent Me."
chapters.kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ അവർ അവനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ അന്വേഷിച്ചു എങ്കിലും അവന്റെ നാഴിക വന്നിട്ടില്ലായ്കയാൽ ആരും അവന്റെ മേൽ കൈ വെച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they sought to take Him; but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
chapters.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ പലരും: ക്രിസ്തു വരുമ്പോൾ ഇവൻ ചെയ്തതിൽ അധികം അടയാളം ചെയ്യുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Still, many in the crowd believed in him. They said, "When the Messiah comes, will he perform more signs than this man?"
chapters.nkjv: And many of the people believed in Him, and said, "When the Christ comes, will He do more signs than these which this Man has done?"
chapters.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഇങ്ങനെ കുശുകുശുക്കുന്നു എന്നു പരീശന്മാർ കേട്ടാറെ അവനെ പിടിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും പരീശന്മാരും ചേവകരെ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.
chapters.nkjv: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things concerning Him, and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take Him.
chapters.kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ: “ഞാൻ ഇനി കുറെനേരം നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; പിന്നെ എന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "I shall be with you a little while longer, and then I go to Him who sent Me.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കും കണ്ടെത്തുകയില്ലതാനും; ഞാൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നേടത്തു നിങ്ങൾക്കു വരുവാൻ കഴികയുമില്ല ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come."
chapters.nkjv: You will seek Me and not find Me, and where I am you cannot come."
chapters.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me : and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

chapters.ml: അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു യെഹൂദന്മാർ: നാം കണ്ടെത്താതവണ്ണം ഇവൻ എവിടേക്കു പോകുവാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നു? യവനന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ചിതറിപ്പാർക്കുന്നവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പോയി യവനരെ ഉപദേശിപ്പാൻ ഭാവമോ?
chapters.niv: The Jews said to one another, "Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews said among themselves, "Where does He intend to go that we shall not find Him? Does He intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
chapters.kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കും, എന്നെ കണ്ടെത്തുകയില്ലതാനും; ഞാൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നേടത്തു നിങ്ങൾക്കു വരുവാൻ കഴികയുമില്ല എന്നു ഈ പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു എന്തു എന്നു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: What did he mean when he said, ‘You will look for me, but you will not find me,’ and ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?"
chapters.nkjv: What is this thing that He said, ‘You will seek Me and not find Me, and where I am you cannot come’?"
chapters.kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me : and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

chapters.ml: ഉത്സവത്തിന്റെ മഹാദിനമായ ഒടുക്കത്തെ നാളിൽ യേശുനിന്നുകൊണ്ടു: “ദാഹിക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു കുടിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: On the last and greatest day of the festival, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, "Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink.
chapters.nkjv: On the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, "If anyone thirsts, let him come to Me and drink.
chapters.kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

chapters.ml: എന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ നിന്നു തിരുവെഴുത്തു പറയുന്നതുപോലെ ജീവജലത്തിന്റെ നദികൾ ഒഴുകും” എന്നു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them."
chapters.nkjv: He who believes in Me, as the Scripture has said, out of his heart will flow rivers of living water."
chapters.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇതു തന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവർക്കു ലഭിപ്പാനുള്ള ആത്മാവിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ആകുന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു; യേശു അന്നു തേജസ്കരിക്കപ്പെട്ടിട്ടില്ലായ്കയാൽ ആത്മാവു വന്നിട്ടില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.
chapters.nkjv: But this He spoke concerning the Spirit, whom those believing in Him would receive; for the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
chapters.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ പലരും ആ വാക്കു കേട്ടിട്ടു: ഇവൻ സാക്ഷാൽ ആ പ്രവാചകൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On hearing his words, some of the people said, "Surely this man is the Prophet."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore many from the crowd, when they heard this saying, said, "Truly this is the Prophet."
chapters.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

chapters.ml: വേറെ ചിലർ: ഇവൻ ക്രിസ്തു തന്നേ എന്നും മറ്റു ചിലർ: ഗലീലയിൽ നിന്നോ ക്രിസ്തു വരുന്നതു?
chapters.niv: Others said, "He is the Messiah." Still others asked, "How can the Messiah come from Galilee?
chapters.nkjv: Others said, "This is the Christ." But some said, "Will the Christ come out of Galilee?
chapters.kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

chapters.ml: ദാവീദിന്റെ സന്തതിയിൽ നിന്നും ദാവീദ് പാർത്ത ഗ്രാമമായ ബേത്ത്ളേഹെമിൽനിന്നും ക്രിസ്തു വരുന്നു എന്നു തിരുവെഴുത്തു പറയുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നും പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Does not Scripture say that the Messiah will come from David’s descendants and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?"
chapters.nkjv: Has not the Scripture said that the Christ comes from the seed of David and from the town of Bethlehem, where David was?"
chapters.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ അവനെച്ചൊല്ലി ഭിന്നത ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: So there was a division among the people because of Him.
chapters.kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ചിലർ അവനെ പിടിപ്പാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു എങ്കിലും ആരും അവന്റെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.
chapters.nkjv: Now some of them wanted to take Him, but no one laid hands on Him.
chapters.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

chapters.ml: ചേവകർ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെയും പരീശന്മാരുടെയും അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവന്നപ്പോൾ അവർ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ കൊണ്ടുവരാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു:
chapters.niv: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and the Pharisees, who asked them, "Why didn’t you bring him in?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the officers came to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, "Why have you not brought Him?"
chapters.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

chapters.ml: ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ സംസാരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ആരും ഒരുനാളും സംസാരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല എന്നു ചേവകർ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "No one ever spoke the way this man does," the guards replied.
chapters.nkjv: The officers answered, "No man ever spoke like this Man!"
chapters.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാർ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങളും തെറ്റിപ്പോയോ?
chapters.niv: "You mean he has deceived you also?" the Pharisees retorted.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Pharisees answered them, "Are you also deceived?
chapters.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

chapters.ml: പ്രമാണികളിൽ ആകട്ടെ പരീശന്മാരിൽ ആകട്ടെ ആരെങ്കിലും അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: "Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?
chapters.nkjv: Have any of the rulers or the Pharisees believed in Him?
chapters.kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

chapters.ml: ന്യായപ്രമാണം അറിയാത്ത പുരുഷാരമോ ശപിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരാകുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them."
chapters.nkjv: But this crowd that does not know the law is accursed."
chapters.kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തനായി, മുമ്പെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരുന്ന നിക്കൊദേമൊസ് അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,
chapters.nkjv: Nicodemus (he who came to Jesus by night, being one of them) said to them,
chapters.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

chapters.ml: ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ വാമൊഴി ആദ്യം കേട്ടു, അവൻ ചെയ്യുന്നതു ഇന്നതു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടല്ലാതെ നമ്മുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം അവനെ വിധിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him to find out what he has been doing?"
chapters.nkjv: "Does our law judge a man before it hears him and knows what he is doing?"
chapters.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: നീയും ഗലീലക്കാരനോ? പരിശോധിച്ചുനോക്കുക; ഗലീലയിൽ നിന്നു പ്രവാചകൻ എഴുന്നേല്ക്കുന്നില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee." [The earliest manuscripts and many other ancient witnesses do not have John 7:53—8:11. A few manuscripts include these verses, wholly or in part, after John 7:36, John 21:25, Luke 21:38 or Luke 24:53.]
chapters.nkjv: They answered and said to him, "Are you also from Galilee? Search and look, for no prophet has arisen out of Galilee."
chapters.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then they all went home,
chapters.nkjv: And everyone went to his own house.
chapters.kjv: And every man went unto his own house.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ ഒലീവ് മലയിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

chapters.ml: അതികാലത്തു അവൻ പിന്നെയും ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു; ജനം ഒക്കെയും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു; അവൻ ഇരുന്നു അവരെ ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.
chapters.nkjv: Now early in the morning He came again into the temple, and all the people came to Him; and He sat down and taught them.
chapters.kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

chapters.ml: ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും പരീശന്മാരും വ്യഭിചാരത്തിൽ പിടിച്ചിരുന്ന ഒരു സ്ത്രീയെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു നടുവിൽ നിറുത്തി അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group
chapters.nkjv: Then the scribes and Pharisees brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. And when they had set her in the midst,
chapters.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

chapters.ml: ഗുരോ, ഈ സ്ത്രീയെ വ്യഭിചാരകർമ്മത്തിൽ തന്നേ പിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and said to Jesus, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
chapters.nkjv: they said to Him, "Teacher, this woman was caught in adultery, in the very act.
chapters.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ളവരെ കല്ലെറിയേണം എന്നു മോശെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ ഞങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ ഇവളെക്കുറിച്ചു എന്തു പറയുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?"
chapters.nkjv: Now Moses, in the law, commanded us that such should be stoned. But what do You say?"
chapters.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

chapters.ml: ഇതു അവനെ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുവാൻ സംഗതി കിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചതായിരുന്നു. യേശുവോ കുനിഞ്ഞു വിരൽകൊണ്ടു നിലത്തു എഴുതിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.
chapters.nkjv: This they said, testing Him, that they might have something of which to accuse Him. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with His finger, as though He did not hear.
chapters.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not .

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ നിവിർന്നു: “നിങ്ങളിൽ പാപമില്ലാത്തവൻ അവളെ ഒന്നാമതു കല്ലു എറിയട്ടെ” എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, "Let any one of you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her."
chapters.nkjv: So when they continued asking Him, He raised Himself up and said to them, "He who is without sin among you, let him throw a stone at her first."
chapters.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും കുനിഞ്ഞു വിരൽകൊണ്ടു നിലത്തു എഴുതിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.
chapters.nkjv: And again He stooped down and wrote on the ground.
chapters.kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

chapters.ml: അവർ അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു മനസ്സാക്ഷിയുടെ ആക്ഷേപം ഹേതുവായി മൂത്തവരും ഇളയവരും ഓരോരുത്തനായി വിട്ടുപോയി; യേശു മാത്രവും നടുവിൽ നില്ക്കുന്ന സ്ത്രീയും ശേഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.
chapters.nkjv: Then those who heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning with the oldest even to the last. And Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
chapters.kjv: And they which heard it , being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

chapters.ml: യേശു നിവിർന്നു അവളോടു: “സ്ത്രീയേ, അവർ എവിടെ? നിനക്കു ആരും ശിക്ഷ വിധിച്ചില്ലയോ ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു:
chapters.niv: Jesus straightened up and asked her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus had raised Himself up and saw no one but the woman, He said to her, "Woman, where are those accusers of yours? Has no one condemned you?"
chapters.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

chapters.ml: ഇല്ല കർത്താവേ, എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു. “ഞാനും നിനക്കു ശിക്ഷ വിധിക്കുന്നില്ല: പോക, ഇനി പാപം ചെയ്യരുതു” എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "No one, sir," she said. "Then neither do I condemn you," Jesus declared. "Go now and leave your life of sin."
chapters.nkjv: She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said to her, "Neither do I condemn you; go and sin no more."
chapters.kjv: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

chapters.ml: യേശു പിന്നെയും അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: “ഞാൻ ലോകത്തിന്റെ വെളിച്ചം ആകുന്നു; എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കുന്നവൻ ഇരുളിൽ നടക്കാതെ ജീവന്റെ വെളിച്ചമുള്ളവൻ ആകും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus spoke to them again, saying, "I am the light of the world. He who follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but have the light of life."
chapters.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാർ അവനോടു: നീ നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു തന്നേ സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു; നിന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം സത്യമല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Pharisees challenged him, "Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid."
chapters.nkjv: The Pharisees therefore said to Him, "You bear witness of Yourself; Your witness is not true."
chapters.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഞാൻ എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു തന്നേ സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞാലും എന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം സത്യം ആകുന്നു; ഞാൻ എവിടെ നിന്നു വന്നു എന്നും എവിടേക്കു പോകുന്നു എന്നും ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; നിങ്ങളോ, ഞാൻ എവിടെ നിന്നു വന്നു എന്നും എവിടേക്കു പോകുന്നു എന്നും അറിയുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Even if I bear witness of Myself, My witness is true, for I know where I came from and where I am going; but you do not know where I come from and where I am going.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ജഡപ്രകാരം വിധിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ ആരെയും വിധിക്കുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.
chapters.nkjv: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
chapters.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വിധിച്ചാലും ഞാൻ ഏകനല്ല, ഞാനും എന്നെ അയച്ച പിതാവും കൂടെയാകയാൽ എന്റെ വിധി സത്യമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But if I do judge, my decisions are true, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.
chapters.nkjv: And yet if I do judge, My judgment is true; for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent Me.
chapters.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടു മനുഷ്യരുടെ സാക്ഷ്യം സത്യം എന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിലും എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.
chapters.nkjv: It is also written in your law that the testimony of two men is true.
chapters.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു തന്നേ സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു; എന്നെ അയച്ച പിതാവും എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me."
chapters.nkjv: I am One who bears witness of Myself, and the Father who sent Me bears witness of Me."
chapters.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ പിതാവു എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യേശു: “നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ആകട്ടെ എന്റെ പിതാവിനെ ആകട്ടെ അറിയുന്നില്ല; എന്നെ അറിഞ്ഞു എങ്കിൽ എന്റെ പിതാവിനെയും അറിയുമായിരുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they asked him, "Where is your father?" "You do not know me or my Father," Jesus replied. "If you knew me, you would know my Father also."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to Him, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither Me nor My Father. If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also."
chapters.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ഉപദേശിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഭണ്ഡാരസ്ഥലത്തുവെച്ചു ഈ വചനം പറഞ്ഞു; അവന്റെ നാഴിക അതുവരെയും വന്നിട്ടില്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു ആരും അവനെ പിടിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.
chapters.nkjv: These words Jesus spoke in the treasury, as He taught in the temple; and no one laid hands on Him, for His hour had not yet come.
chapters.kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നെയും അവരോടു: “ഞാൻ പോകുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കും; നിങ്ങളുടെ പാപത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾ മരിക്കും; ഞാൻ പോകുന്ന ഇടത്തേക്കു നിങ്ങൾക്കു വരുവാൻ കഴികയില്ല ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Once more Jesus said to them, "I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come."
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them again, "I am going away, and you will seek Me, and will die in your sin. Where I go you cannot come."
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പോകുന്ന ഇടത്തേക്കു നിങ്ങൾക്കു വരുവാൻ കഴികയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു പക്ഷേ തന്നെത്താൻ കൊല്ലുമോ എന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: This made the Jews ask, "Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, ‘Where I go, you cannot come’?"
chapters.nkjv: So the Jews said, "Will He kill Himself, because He says, ‘Where I go you cannot come’?"
chapters.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ കീഴിൽനിന്നുള്ളവർ, ഞാൻ മേലിൽ നിന്നുള്ളവൻ; നിങ്ങൾ ഈ ലോകത്തിൽ നിന്നുള്ളവർ, ഞാൻ ഈ ലോകത്തിൽ നിന്നുള്ളവനല്ല.
chapters.niv: But he continued, "You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "You are from beneath; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ പാപങ്ങളിൽ നിങ്ങൾ മരിക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞു; ഞാൻ അങ്ങനെയുള്ളവൻ എന്നു വിശ്വസിക്കാഞ്ഞാൽ നിങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ പാപങ്ങളിൽ മരിക്കും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins; for if you do not believe that I am He, you will die in your sins."
chapters.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he , ye shall die in your sins.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: നീ ആർ ആകുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യേശു: “ആദിമുതൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു സംസാരിച്ചുപോരുന്നതു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "Who are you?" they asked. "Just what I have been telling you from the beginning," Jesus replied.
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to Him, "Who are You?" And Jesus said to them, "Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
chapters.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു വളരെ സംസാരിപ്പാനും വിധിപ്പാനും എനിക്കു ഉണ്ടു; എങ്കിലും എന്നെ അയച്ചവൻ സത്യവാൻ ആകുന്നു; അവനോടു കേട്ടതു തന്നേ ഞാൻ ലോകത്തോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is trustworthy, and what I have heard from him I tell the world."
chapters.nkjv: I have many things to say and to judge concerning you, but He who sent Me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I heard from Him."
chapters.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

chapters.ml: പിതാവിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ആകുന്നു അവൻ തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എന്നു അവർ ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.
chapters.nkjv: They did not understand that He spoke to them of the Father.
chapters.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യേശു: “നിങ്ങൾ മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെ ഉയർത്തിയശേഷം ഞാൻ തന്നേ അവൻ എന്നും ഞാൻ സ്വയമായിട്ടു ഒന്നും ചെയ്യാതെ പിതാവു എനിക്കു ഉപദേശിച്ചുതന്നതു പോലെ ഇതു സംസാരിക്കുന്നു എന്നും അറിയും.
chapters.niv: So Jesus said, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he and that I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father has taught me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing of Myself; but as My Father taught Me, I speak these things.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he , and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ അയച്ചവൻ എന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു; ഞാൻ എല്ലായ്പോഴും അവന്നു പ്രസാദമുള്ളതു ചെയ്യുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ എന്നെ ഏകനായി വിട്ടിട്ടില്ല ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him."
chapters.nkjv: And He who sent Me is with Me. The Father has not left Me alone, for I always do those things that please Him."
chapters.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇങ്ങനെ സംസാരിച്ചു കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ പലരും അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.
chapters.nkjv: As He spoke these words, many believed in Him.
chapters.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

chapters.ml: തന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ച യെഹൂദന്മാരോടു യേശു: “എന്റെ വചനത്തിൽ നിലനില്ക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ വാസ്തവമായി എന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരായി,
chapters.niv: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, "If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to those Jews who believed Him, "If you abide in My word, you are My disciples indeed.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

chapters.ml: സത്യം അറികയും സത്യം നിങ്ങളെ സ്വതന്ത്രന്മാരാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
chapters.nkjv: And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
chapters.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ സന്തതി; ആർക്കും ഒരുനാളും ദാസന്മാരായിരുന്നിട്ടില്ല; നിങ്ങൾ സ്വതന്ത്രന്മാർ ആകും എന്നു നീ പറയുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They answered him, "We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?"
chapters.nkjv: They answered Him, "We are Abraham’s descendants, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How can You say, ‘You will be made free’?"
chapters.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: പാപം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം പാപത്തിന്റെ ദാസൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, whoever commits sin is a slave of sin.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

chapters.ml: ദാസൻ എന്നേക്കും വീട്ടിൽ വസിക്കുന്നില്ല; പുത്രനോ എന്നേക്കും വസിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.
chapters.nkjv: And a slave does not abide in the house forever, but a son abides forever.
chapters.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

chapters.ml: പുത്രൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യം വരുത്തിയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ സാക്ഷാൽ സ്വതന്ത്രർ ആകും.
chapters.niv: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore if the Son makes you free, you shall be free indeed.
chapters.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ സന്തതി എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; എങ്കിലും എന്റെ വചനത്തിന്നു നിങ്ങളിൽ ഇടം ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I know that you are Abraham’s descendants. Yet you are looking for a way to kill me, because you have no room for my word.
chapters.nkjv: "I know that you are Abraham’s descendants, but you seek to kill Me, because My word has no place in you.
chapters.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

chapters.ml: പിതാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കണ്ടിട്ടുള്ളതു ഞാൻ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവിനോടു കേട്ടിട്ടുള്ളതു നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നു” ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I am telling you what I have seen in the Father’s presence, and you are doing what you have heard from your father. "
chapters.nkjv: I speak what I have seen with My Father, and you do what you have seen with your father."
chapters.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: അബ്രാഹാം ആകുന്നു ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു യേശു അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ മക്കൾ എങ്കിൽ അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ ചെയ്യുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Abraham is our father," they answered. "If you were Abraham’s children," said Jesus, "then you would do what Abraham did.
chapters.nkjv: They answered and said to Him, "Abraham is our father." Jesus said to them, "If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
chapters.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവത്തോടു കേട്ടിട്ടുള്ള സത്യം നിങ്ങളോടു സംസാരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന മനുഷ്യനായ എന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ കൊല്ലുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നു; അങ്ങനെ അബ്രാഹാം ചെയ്തില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As it is, you are looking for a way to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.
chapters.nkjv: But now you seek to kill Me, a Man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham did not do this.
chapters.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ നിങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ പരസംഗത്താൽ ജനിച്ചവരല്ല; ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു പിതാവേയുള്ളു; ദൈവം തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You are doing the works of your own father." "We are not illegitimate children," they protested. "The only Father we have is God himself."
chapters.nkjv: You do the deeds of your father." Then they said to Him, "We were not born of fornication; we have one Father—God."
chapters.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ദൈവം നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുമായിരുന്നു ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ സ്വയമായി വന്നതല്ല, അവൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on my own; God sent me.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I proceeded forth and came from God; nor have I come of Myself, but He sent Me.
chapters.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ഭാഷണം നിങ്ങൾ ഗ്രഹിക്കാത്തതു എന്തു? എന്റെ വചനം കേൾപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു മനസ്സില്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടത്രേ.
chapters.niv: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.
chapters.nkjv: Why do you not understand My speech? Because you are not able to listen to My word.
chapters.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പിശാചെന്ന പിതാവിന്റെ മക്കൾ; നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവിന്റെ മോഹങ്ങളെ ചെയ്‍വാനും ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു. അവൻ ആദിമുതൽ കുലപാതകൻ ആയിരുന്നു; അവനിൽ സത്യം ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു സത്യത്തിൽ നില്ക്കുന്നതുമില്ല. അവൻ ഭോഷ്കു പറയുമ്പോൾ സ്വന്തത്തിൽ നിന്നു എടുത്തു പറയുന്നു; അവൻ ഭോഷ്കു പറയുന്നവനും അതിന്റെ അപ്പനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
chapters.nkjv: You are of your father the devil, and the desires of your father you want to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own resources, for he is a liar and the father of it.
chapters.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ സത്യം പറയുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!
chapters.nkjv: But because I tell the truth, you do not believe Me.
chapters.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളിൽ ആർ എന്നെ പാപത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ബോധം വരുത്തുന്നു? ഞാൻ സത്യം പറയുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ വിശ്വസിക്കാത്തതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don’t you believe me?
chapters.nkjv: Which of you convicts Me of sin? And if I tell the truth, why do you not believe Me?
chapters.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

chapters.ml: ദൈവസന്തതിയായവൻ ദൈവവചനം കേൾക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ ദൈവസന്തതിയല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു കേൾക്കുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Whoever belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God."
chapters.nkjv: He who is of God hears God’s words; therefore you do not hear, because you are not of God."
chapters.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനോടു: നീ ഒരു ശമര്യൻ; നിനക്കു ഭൂതം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നതു ശരിയല്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Jews answered him, "Aren’t we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews answered and said to Him, "Do we not say rightly that You are a Samaritan and have a demon?"
chapters.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “എനിക്കു ഭൂതമില്ല; ഞാൻ എന്റെ പിതാവിനെ ബഹുമാനിക്ക അത്രേ ചെയ്യുന്നതു; നിങ്ങളോ എന്നെ അപമാനിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I am not possessed by a demon," said Jesus, "but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "I do not have a demon; but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ മഹത്വം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നില്ല; അന്വേഷിക്കയും വിധിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ ഒരുവൻ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.
chapters.nkjv: And I do not seek My own glory; there is One who seeks and judges.
chapters.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: എന്റെ വചനം പ്രമാണിക്കുന്നവൻ ഒരുനാളും മരണം കാൺകയില്ല ” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death."
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, if anyone keeps My word he shall never see death."
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനോടു: നിനക്കു ഭൂതം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഇപ്പോൾ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു മനസ്സിലായി; അബ്രാഹാമും പ്രവാചകന്മാരും മരിച്ചു; നീയോ എന്റെ വചനം പ്രമാണിക്കുന്നവൻ ഒരുനാളും മരണം ആസ്വദിക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At this they exclaimed, "Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that whoever obeys your word will never taste death.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews said to Him, "Now we know that You have a demon! Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and You say, ‘If anyone keeps My word he shall never taste death.’
chapters.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാമിനെക്കാൾ നീ വലിയവനോ? അവൻ മരിച്ചു, പ്രവാചകന്മാരും മരിച്ചു; നിന്നെത്തന്നെ നീ ആർ ആക്കുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യേശു:
chapters.niv: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"
chapters.nkjv: Are You greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? And the prophets are dead. Who do You make Yourself out to be?"
chapters.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ എന്നെത്തന്നെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തിയാൽ എന്റെ മഹത്വം ഏതുമില്ല; എന്നെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതു എന്റെ പിതാവു ആകുന്നു; അവനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവം എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "If I honor Myself, My honor is nothing. It is My Father who honors Me, of whom you say that He is your God.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ അറിയുന്നില്ല; ഞാനോ അവനെ അറിയുന്നു; അവനെ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞാൽ നിങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ ഭോഷ്കുപറയുന്നവൻ ആകും; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ അവനെ അറിയുന്നു; അവന്റെ വചനം പ്രമാണിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and obey his word.
chapters.nkjv: Yet you have not known Him, but I know Him. And if I say, ‘I do not know Him,’ I shall be a liar like you; but I do know Him and keep His word.
chapters.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാം എന്റെ ദിവസം കാണും എന്നുള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു ഉല്ലസിച്ചു; അവൻ കണ്ടു സന്തോഷിച്ചുമിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad."
chapters.nkjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day, and he saw it and was glad."
chapters.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it , and was glad.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനോടു: നിനക്കു അമ്പതു വയസ്സു ആയിട്ടില്ല; നീ അബ്രാഹാമിനെ കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "You are not yet fifty years old," they said to him, "and you have seen Abraham!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews said to Him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have You seen Abraham?"
chapters.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: അബ്രാഹാം ജനിച്ചതിന്നു മുമ്പേ ഞാൻ ഉണ്ടു ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Very truly I tell you," Jesus answered, "before Abraham was born, I am!"
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I AM."
chapters.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ അവനെ എറിവാൻ കല്ലു എടുത്തു; യേശുവോ മറഞ്ഞു ദൈവാലയം വിട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.
chapters.nkjv: Then they took up stones to throw at Him; but Jesus hid Himself and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
chapters.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കടന്നുപോകുമ്പോൾ പിറവിയിലെ കുരുടനായോരു മനുഷ്യനെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.
chapters.nkjv: Now as Jesus passed by, He saw a man who was blind from birth.
chapters.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: റബ്ബീ, ഇവൻ കുരുടനായി പിറക്കത്തക്കവണ്ണം ആർ പാപം ചെയ്തു? ഇവനോ ഇവന്റെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാരോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: His disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"
chapters.nkjv: And His disciples asked Him, saying, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"
chapters.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: “അവൻ എങ്കിലും അവന്റെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാരെങ്കിലും പാപം ചെയ്തിട്ടല്ല, ദൈവപ്രവൃത്തി അവങ്കൽ വെളിവാകേണ്ടതിന്നത്രേ.
chapters.niv: "Neither this man nor his parents sinned," said Jesus, "but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but that the works of God should be revealed in him.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ അയച്ചവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി പകൽ ഉള്ളേടത്തോളം നാം ചെയ്യേണ്ടതാകുന്നു; ആർക്കും പ്രവർത്തിച്ചുകൂടാത്ത രാത്രി വരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
chapters.nkjv: I must work the works of Him who sent Me while it is day; the night is coming when no one can work.
chapters.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ലോകത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ലോകത്തിന്റെ വെളിച്ചം ആകുന്നു” എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
chapters.nkjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
chapters.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ നിലത്തു തുപ്പി തുപ്പൽകൊണ്ടു ചേറുണ്ടാക്കി ചേറു അവന്റെ കണ്ണിന്മേൽ പൂശി
chapters.niv: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes.
chapters.nkjv: When He had said these things, He spat on the ground and made clay with the saliva; and He anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay.
chapters.kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

chapters.ml: “നീ ചെന്നു ശിലോഹാംകുളത്തിൽ കഴുകുക” എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു; ശിലോഹാം എന്നതിന്നു അയക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നർത്ഥം. അവൻ പോയി കഴുകി, കണ്ണു കാണുന്നവനായി മടങ്ങിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Go," he told him, "wash in the Pool of Siloam" (this word means "Sent"). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which is translated, Sent). So he went and washed, and came back seeing.
chapters.kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

chapters.ml: അയൽക്കാരും അവനെ മുമ്പെ ഇരക്കുന്നവനായി കണ്ടവരും: ഇവനല്ലയോ അവിടെ ഇരുന്നു ഭിക്ഷ യാചിച്ചവൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, "Isn’t this the same man who used to sit and beg?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the neighbors and those who previously had seen that he was blind said, "Is not this he who sat and begged?"
chapters.kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നേഎന്നു ചിലരും അല്ല, അവനെപ്പോലെയുള്ളവൻ എന്നു മറ്റുചിലരും പറഞ്ഞു; ഞാൻ തന്നേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some claimed that he was. Others said, "No, he only looks like him." But he himself insisted, "I am the man."
chapters.nkjv: Some said, "This is he." Others said, "He is like him." He said, "I am he."
chapters.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said , He is like him: but he said, I am he .

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ കണ്ണു തുറന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവൻ:
chapters.niv: "How then were your eyes opened?" they asked.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they said to him, "How were your eyes opened?"
chapters.kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

chapters.ml: യേശു എന്നു പേരുള്ള മനുഷ്യൻ ചേറുണ്ടാക്കി എന്റെ കണ്ണിന്മേൽ പൂശി: ശിലോഹാംകുളത്തിൽ ചെന്നു കഴുകുക എന്നു എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു; ഞാൻ പോയി കഴുകി കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see."
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said, "A Man called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went and washed, and I received sight."
chapters.kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എവിടെ എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Where is this man?" they asked him. "I don’t know," he said.
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to him, "Where is He?" He said, "I do not know."
chapters.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

chapters.ml: കുരുടനായിരുന്നവനെ അവർ പരീശന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
chapters.nkjv: They brought him who formerly was blind to the Pharisees.
chapters.kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

chapters.ml: യേശു ചേറുണ്ടാക്കി അവന്റെ കണ്ണു തുറന്നതു ശബ്ബത്ത് നാളിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man’s eyes was a Sabbath.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was a Sabbath when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.
chapters.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു പരീശന്മാരും അവനോടു ചോദിച്ചു. അവൻ അവരോടു: അവൻ എന്റെ കണ്ണിന്മേൽ ചേറു തേച്ചു ഞാൻ കഴുകി; കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. "He put mud on my eyes," the man replied, "and I washed, and now I see."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Pharisees also asked him again how he had received his sight. He said to them, "He put clay on my eyes, and I washed, and I see."
chapters.kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

chapters.ml: പരീശന്മാരിൽ ചിലർ: ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ ശബ്ബത്ത് പ്രമാണിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു വന്നവനല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. മറ്റു ചിലർ: പാപിയായോരു മനുഷ്യന്നു ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള അടയാളങ്ങൾ ചെയ്‍വാൻ എങ്ങനെ കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അങ്ങനെ അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഒരു ഭിന്നത ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath." But others asked, "How can a sinner perform such signs?" So they were divided.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore some of the Pharisees said, "This Man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath." Others said, "How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?" And there was a division among them.
chapters.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

chapters.ml: അവർ പിന്നെയും കുരുടനോടു: നിന്റെ കണ്ണു തുറന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നീ അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു എന്തു പറയുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: അവൻ ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then they turned again to the blind man, "What have you to say about him? It was your eyes he opened." The man replied, "He is a prophet."
chapters.nkjv: They said to the blind man again, "What do you say about Him because He opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."
chapters.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

chapters.ml: കാഴ്ചപ്രാപിച്ചവന്റെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാരെ വിളിച്ചു ചോദിക്കുവോളം അവൻ കുരുടനായിരുന്നു എന്നും കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചു എന്നും യെഹൂദന്മാർ വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: They still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man’s parents.
chapters.nkjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind and received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight.
chapters.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

chapters.ml: കുരുടനായി ജനിച്ചു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്ന നിങ്ങളുടെ മകൻ ഇവൻ തന്നെയോ? എന്നാൽ അവന്നു ഇപ്പോൾ കണ്ണു കാണുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു അവർ അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Is this your son?" they asked. "Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?"
chapters.nkjv: And they asked them, saying, "Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"
chapters.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാർ: ഇവൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെ മകൻ എന്നും കുരുടനായി ജനിച്ചവൻ എന്നും ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "We know he is our son," the parents answered, "and we know he was born blind.
chapters.nkjv: His parents answered them and said, "We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
chapters.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കണ്ണു കാണുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു അറിയുന്നില്ല; അവന്റെ കണ്ണു ആർ തുറന്നു എന്നും അറിയുന്നില്ല; അവനോടു ചോദിപ്പിൻ; അവന്നു പ്രായം ഉണ്ടല്ലോ അവൻ തന്നേ പറയും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself."
chapters.nkjv: but by what means he now sees we do not know, or who opened his eyes we do not know. He is of age; ask him. He will speak for himself."
chapters.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരെ ഭയപ്പെടുകകൊണ്ടത്രേ അവന്റെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാർ ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞതു; അവനെ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു ഏറ്റുപറയുന്നവൻ പള്ളിഭ്രഷ്ടനാകേണം എന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാർ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞൊത്തിരുന്നു
chapters.niv: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who already had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Messiah would be put out of the synagogue.
chapters.nkjv: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had agreed already that if anyone confessed that He was Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
chapters.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടത്രേ അവന്റെ അമ്മയപ്പന്മാർ: അവന്നു പ്രായം ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; അവനോടു ചോദിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: That was why his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
chapters.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

chapters.ml: കുരുടനായിരുന്ന മനുഷ്യനെ അവർ രണ്ടാമതും വിളിച്ചു: ദൈവത്തിന്നു മഹത്വം കൊടുക്ക; ആ മനുഷ്യൻ പാപി എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: A second time they summoned the man who had been blind. "Give glory to God by telling the truth," they said. "We know this man is a sinner."
chapters.nkjv: So they again called the man who was blind, and said to him, "Give God the glory! We know that this Man is a sinner."
chapters.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: അവൻ പാപിയോ അല്ലയോ എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല; ഒന്നു അറിയുന്നു; ഞാൻ കുരുടനായിരുന്നു, ഇപ്പോൾ കണ്ണു കാണുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He replied, "Whether he is a sinner or not, I don’t know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!"
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said, "Whether He is a sinner ornot I do not know. One thing I know: that though I was blind, now I see."
chapters.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: അവൻ നിനക്കു എന്തു ചെയ്തു? നിന്റെ കണ്ണു എങ്ങനെ തുറന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they asked him, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to him again, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"
chapters.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ; നിങ്ങൾ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചില്ല; വീണ്ടും കേൾപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? നിങ്ങൾക്കും അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ആകുവാൻ മനസ്സുണ്ടോ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He answered, "I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?"
chapters.nkjv: He answered them, "I told you already, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?"
chapters.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ അവനെ ശകാരിച്ചു: നീ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യൻ; ഞങ്ങൾ മോശെയുടെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Then they hurled insults at him and said, "You are this fellow’s disciple! We are disciples of Moses!
chapters.nkjv: Then they reviled him and said, "You are His disciple, but we are Moses’ disciples.
chapters.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.

chapters.ml: മോശെയോടു ദൈവം സംസാരിച്ചു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു; ഇവനോ എവിടെനിന്നു എന്നു അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don’t even know where he comes from."
chapters.nkjv: We know that God spoke to Moses; asfor this fellow, we do not know where He is from."
chapters.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow , we know not from whence he is.

chapters.ml: ആ മനുഷ്യൻ അവരോടു: എന്റെ കണ്ണു തുറന്നിട്ടും അവൻ എവിടെനിന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയാത്തതു ആശ്ചയ്യം.
chapters.niv: The man answered, "Now that is remarkable! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
chapters.nkjv: The man answered and said to them, "Why, this is a marvelous thing, that you do not know where He is from; yet He has opened my eyes!
chapters.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

chapters.ml: പാപികളുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥന ദൈവം കേൾക്കുന്നില്ല എന്നും ദൈവഭക്തനായിരുന്നു അവന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്യുന്നവന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേൾക്കുന്നു എന്നും നാം അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly person who does his will.
chapters.nkjv: Now we know that God does not hear sinners; but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does His will, He hears him.
chapters.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

chapters.ml: കുരുടനായി പിറന്നവന്റെ കണ്ണു ആരെങ്കിലും തുറന്നപ്രകാരം ലോകം ഉണ്ടായതുമുതൽ കേട്ടിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
chapters.nkjv: Since the world began it has been unheard of that anyone opened the eyes of one who was born blind.
chapters.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു വന്നവൻ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അവന്നു ഒന്നും ചെയ്‍വാൻ കഴികയില്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing."
chapters.nkjv: If this Man were not from God, He could do nothing."
chapters.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനോടു: നീ മുഴുവനും പാപത്തിൽ പിറന്നവൻ; നീ ഞങ്ങളെ ഉപദേശിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ പുറത്താക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: To this they replied, "You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!" And they threw him out.
chapters.nkjv: They answered and said to him, "You were completely born in sins, and are you teaching us?" And they cast him out.
chapters.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

chapters.ml: അവനെ പുറത്താക്കി എന്നു യേശു കേട്ടു; അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: “നീ ദൈവപുത്രനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നുവോ ” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"
chapters.nkjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when He had found him, He said to him, "Do you believe in the Son of God?"
chapters.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവൻ: യജമാനനേ, അവൻ ആർ ആകുന്നു? ഞാൻ അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കാം എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Who is he, sir?" the man asked. "Tell me so that I may believe in him."
chapters.nkjv: He answered and said, "Who is He, Lord, that I may believe in Him?"
chapters.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: “നീ അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ടു; നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നവൻ അവൻ തന്നേ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you."
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said to him, "You have both seen Him and it is He who is talking with you."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവൻ: കർത്താവേ, ഞാൻ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the man said, "Lord, I believe," and he worshiped him.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said, "Lord, I believe!" And he worshiped Him.
chapters.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

chapters.ml: “കാണാത്തവർ കാണ്മാനും കാണുന്നവർ കുരുടർ ആവാനും ഇങ്ങനെ ന്യായവിധിക്കായി ഞാൻ ഇഹലോകത്തിൽ വന്നു” എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind."
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus said, "For judgment I have come into this world, that those who do not see may see, and that those who see may be made blind."
chapters.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെയുള്ള ചില പരീശന്മാർ ഇതു കേട്ടിട്ടു ഞങ്ങളും കുരുടരോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, "What? Are we blind too?"
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these words, and said to Him, "Are we blind also?"
chapters.kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ കുരുടർ ആയിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു പാപം ഇല്ലായിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ: ഞങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളുടെ പാപം നില്ക്കുന്നു” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
chapters.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

chapters.ml: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു, ആട്ടിൻ തൊഴിത്തിൽ വാതിലൂടെ കടക്കാതെ വേറെ വഴിയായി കയറുന്നവൻ കള്ളനും കവർച്ചക്കാരനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Very truly I tell you Pharisees, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.
chapters.nkjv: "Most assuredly, I say to you, he who does not enter the sheepfold by the door, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

chapters.ml: വാതിലൂടെ കടക്കുന്നവനോ ആടുകളുടെ ഇടയൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
chapters.nkjv: But he who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
chapters.kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു വാതിൽ കാവൽക്കാരൻ തുറന്നുകൊടുക്കുന്നു; ആടുകൾ അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കുന്നു; തന്റെ ആടുകളെ അവൻ പേർ ചൊല്ലി വിളിച്ചു പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
chapters.nkjv: To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
chapters.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

chapters.ml: തനിക്കുള്ളവയെ ഒക്കെയും പുറത്തുകൊണ്ടു പോയശേഷം അവൻ അവെക്കു മുമ്പായി നടക്കുന്നു; ആടുകൾ അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം അറിഞ്ഞു അവനെ അനുഗമിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
chapters.nkjv: And when he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
chapters.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

chapters.ml: അന്യന്മാരുടെ ശബ്ദം അറിയായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവ അന്യനെ അനുഗമിക്കാതെ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോകും.
chapters.niv: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger’s voice."
chapters.nkjv: Yet they will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers."
chapters.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

chapters.ml: ഈ സാദൃശ്യം യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു; എന്നാൽ തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു ഇന്നതു എന്നു അവർ ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus used this illustration, but they did not understand the things which He spoke to them.
chapters.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

chapters.ml: യേശു പിന്നെയും അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: “ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: ആടുകളുടെ വാതിൽ ഞാൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore Jesus said again, "Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them again, "Most assuredly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു മുമ്പെ വന്നവർ ഒക്കെയും കള്ളന്മാരും കവർച്ചക്കാരും അത്രേ; ആടുകളോ അവരുടെ വാക്കു കേട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.
chapters.nkjv: All who ever came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.
chapters.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വാതിൽ ആകുന്നു; എന്നിലൂടെ കടക്കുന്നവൻ രക്ഷപ്പെടും; അവൻ അകത്തു വരികയും പുറത്തുപോകയും മേച്ചൽ കണ്ടെത്തുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture.
chapters.nkjv: I am the door. If anyone enters by Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.
chapters.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

chapters.ml: മോഷ്ടിപ്പാനും അറുപ്പാനും മുടിപ്പാനും അല്ലാതെ കള്ളൻ വരുന്നില്ല; അവർക്കു ജീവൻ ഉണ്ടാകുവാനും സമൃദ്ധിയായിട്ടു ഉണ്ടാകുവാനും അത്രേ ഞാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.
chapters.nkjv: The thief does not come except to steal, and to kill, and to destroy. I have come that they may have life, and that they may have it more abundantly.
chapters.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നല്ല ഇടയൻ ആകുന്നു; നല്ല ഇടയൻ ആടുകൾക്കു വേണ്ടി തന്റെ ജീവനെ കൊടുക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
chapters.nkjv: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives His life for the sheep.
chapters.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

chapters.ml: ഇടയനും ആടുകളുടെ ഉടമസ്ഥനുമല്ലാത്ത കൂലിക്കാരൻ ചെന്നായ് വരുന്നതു കണ്ടു ആടുകളെ വിട്ടു ഓടിക്കളയുന്നു; ചെന്നായ് അവയെ പിടിക്കയും ചിന്നിച്ചുകളകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The hired hand is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.
chapters.nkjv: But a hireling, he who is not the shepherd, one who does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees; and the wolf catches the sheep and scatters them.
chapters.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കൂലിക്കാരനും ആടുകളെക്കുറിച്ചു വിചാരമില്ലാത്തവനുമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.
chapters.nkjv: The hireling flees because he is a hireling and does not care about the sheep.
chapters.kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നല്ല ഇടയൻ; പിതാവു എന്നെ അറികയും ഞാൻ പിതാവിനെ അറികയും ചെയ്യുന്നതുപോലെ ഞാൻ എനിക്കുള്ളവയെ അറികയും എനിക്കുള്ളവ എന്നെ അറികയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me—
chapters.nkjv: I am the good shepherd; and I know My sheep, and am known by My own.
chapters.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep , and am known of mine.

chapters.ml: ആടുകൾക്കു വേണ്ടി ഞാൻ എന്റെ ജീവനെ കൊടുക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father—and I lay down my life for the sheep.
chapters.nkjv: As the Father knows Me, even so I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.
chapters.kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

chapters.ml: ഈ തൊഴുത്തിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടാത്ത വേറെ ആടുകൾ എനിക്കു ഉണ്ടു; അവയെയും ഞാൻ നടത്തേണ്ടതാകുന്നു; അവ എന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കും; ഒരാട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടവും ഒരിടയനും ആകും.
chapters.niv: I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd.
chapters.nkjv: And other sheep I have which are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they will hear My voice; and there will be one flock and one shepherd.
chapters.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ജീവനെ വീണ്ടും പ്രാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ അതിനെ കൊടുക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു പിതാവു എന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore My Father loves Me, because I lay down My life that I may take it again.
chapters.kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

chapters.ml: ആരും അതിനെ എന്നോടു എടുത്തുകളയുന്നില്ല; ഞാൻ തന്നേ അതിനെ കൊടുക്കുന്നു; അതിനെ കൊടുപ്പാൻ എനിക്കു അധികാരം ഉണ്ടു; വീണ്ടും പ്രാപിപ്പാനും അധികാരം ഉണ്ടു; ഈ കല്പന എന്റെ പിതാവിങ്കൽ നിന്നു എനിക്കു ലഭിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father."
chapters.nkjv: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of Myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This command I have received from My Father."
chapters.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
