chapters.ml: ഈ വചനം നിമിത്തം യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പിന്നെയും ഭിന്നത ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore there was a division again among the Jews because of these sayings.
chapters.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ പലരും; അവന്നു ഭൂതം ഉണ്ടു; അവൻ ഭ്രാന്തൻ ആകുന്നു; അവന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കുന്നതു എന്തിന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Many of them said, "He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?"
chapters.nkjv: And many of them said, "He has a demon and is mad. Why do you listen to Him?"
chapters.kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

chapters.ml: മറ്റു ചിലർ: ഇതു ഭൂതഗ്രസ്തന്റെ വാക്കല്ല; ഭൂതത്തിന്നു കുരുടന്മാരുടെ കണ്ണു തുറപ്പാൻ കഴിയുമോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But others said, "These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
chapters.nkjv: Others said, "These are not the words of one who has a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
chapters.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യെരൂശലേമിൽ പ്രതിഷ്ഠോത്സവം ആചരിച്ചു; അന്നു ശീതകാലമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,
chapters.nkjv: Now it was the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem, and it was winter.
chapters.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

chapters.ml: യേശു ദൈവലായത്തിൽ ശലോമോന്റെ മണ്ഡപത്തിൽ നടന്നുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.nkjv: And Jesus walked in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനെ വളഞ്ഞു: നീ എത്രത്തോളം ഞങ്ങളെ ആശിപ്പിക്കുന്നു? നീ ക്രിസ്തു എങ്കിൽ സ്പഷ്ടമായി പറക എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Jews who were there gathered around him, saying, "How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews surrounded Him and said to Him, "How long do You keep us in doubt? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly."
chapters.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: “ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ടു; എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നില്ല; എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ ഞാൻ ചെയ്യുന്ന പ്രവൃത്തികൾ എനിക്കു സാക്ഷ്യം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "I did tell you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me,
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered them, "I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in My Father’s name, they bear witness of Me.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ എന്റെ ആടുകളുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലുള്ളവരല്ലായ്കയാൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നില്ല. എന്റെ ആടുകൾ എന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.
chapters.nkjv: But you do not believe, because you are not of My sheep, as I said to you.
chapters.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവയെ അറികയും അവ എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
chapters.nkjv: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.
chapters.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവെക്കു നിത്യജീവൻ കൊടുക്കുന്നു; അവ ഒരുനാളും നശിച്ചു പോകയില്ല; ആരും അവയെ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു പിടിച്ചുപറിക്കയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.
chapters.nkjv: And I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; neither shall anyone snatch them out of My hand.
chapters.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

chapters.ml: അവയെ തന്നിരിക്കുന്ന എന്റെ പിതാവു എല്ലാവരിലും വലിയവൻ; പിതാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു പിടിച്ചുപറിപ്പാൻ ആർക്കും കഴികയില്ല
chapters.niv: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all ; no one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
chapters.nkjv: My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
chapters.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

chapters.ml: ഞാനും പിതാവും ഒന്നാകുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: I and the Father are one."
chapters.nkjv: I and My Father are one."
chapters.kjv: I and my Father are one.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനെ എറിവാൻ പിന്നെയും കല്ലു എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone Him.
chapters.kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “പിതാവിന്റെ കല്പനയാൽ ഞാൻ പല നല്ല പ്രവൃത്തികൾ നിങ്ങളെ കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവയിൽ ഏതു പ്രവൃത്തിനിമിത്തം നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ കല്ലെറിയുന്നു?” എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: but Jesus said to them, "I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?"
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered them, "Many good works I have shown you from My Father. For which of those works do you stone Me?"
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനോടു: നല്ല പ്രവൃത്തി നിമിത്തമല്ല, ദൈവദൂഷണം നിമിത്തവും നീ മനുഷ്യനായിരിക്കെ നിന്നെത്തന്നേ ദൈവം ആക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടുമത്രേ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ കല്ലെറിയുന്നതു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "We are not stoning you for any good work," they replied, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God."
chapters.nkjv: The Jews answered Him, saying, "For a good work we do not stone You, but for blasphemy, and because You, being a Man, make Yourself God."
chapters.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: “നിങ്ങൾ ദേവന്മാർ ആകുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are "gods" ’ ?
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your law, ‘I said, "You are gods" ’?
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു ഉണ്ടായിട്ടുള്ളവരെ ദേവന്മാർ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു എങ്കിൽ-തിരുവെഴുത്തിന്നു നീക്കം വന്നുകൂടായല്ലോ-
chapters.niv: If he called them ‘gods,’ to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be set aside—
chapters.nkjv: If He called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture cannot be broken),
chapters.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുത്രൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു: നീ ദൈവദൂഷണം പറയുന്നു എന്നു പിതാവു വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചു ലോകത്തിൽ അയച്ചവനോടു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?
chapters.nkjv: do you say of Him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
chapters.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്യുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ എന്നെ വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടാ;
chapters.niv: Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.
chapters.nkjv: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me;
chapters.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

chapters.ml: ചെയ്യുന്നു എങ്കിലോ എന്നെ വിശ്വസിക്കാതിരുന്നാലും പിതാവു എന്നിലും ഞാൻ പിതാവിലും എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഗ്രഹിച്ചു അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു പ്രവൃത്തിയെ വിശ്വസിപ്പിൻ”.
chapters.niv: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father."
chapters.nkjv: but if I do, though you do not believe Me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in Me, and I in Him."
chapters.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ പിന്നെയും പിടിപ്പാൻ നോക്കി; അവനോ അവരുടെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they sought again to seize Him, but He escaped out of their hand.
chapters.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

chapters.ml: അവൻ യോർദ്ദാന്നക്കരെ യോഹന്നാൻ ആദിയിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു പിന്നെയും ചെന്നു അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. There he stayed,
chapters.nkjv: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was baptizing at first, and there He stayed.
chapters.kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

chapters.ml: പലരും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: യോഹന്നാൻ അടയാളം ഒന്നും ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല; എന്നാൽ ഇവനെക്കുറിച്ചു യോഹന്നാൻ പറഞ്ഞതു ഒക്കെയും സത്യമായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and many people came to him. They said, "Though John never performed a sign, all that John said about this man was true."
chapters.nkjv: Then many came to Him and said, "John performed no sign, but all the things that John spoke about this Man were true."
chapters.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ പലരും അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And in that place many believed in Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And many believed in Him there.
chapters.kjv: And many believed on him there.

chapters.ml: മറിയയുടെയും അവളുടെ സഹോദരി മാർത്തയുടെയും ഗ്രാമമായ ബേഥാന്യയിലെ ലാസർ എന്ന ഒരുത്തൻ ദീനമായ്ക്കിടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
chapters.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

chapters.ml: ഈ മറിയ ആയിരുന്നു കർത്താവിനെ പരിമള തൈലം പൂശി തന്റെ തലമുടികൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ കാൽ തുടച്ചതു. അവളുടെ സഹോദരനായ ലാസർ ആയിരുന്നു ദീനമായ്ക്കിടന്നതു.
chapters.niv: (This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.)
chapters.nkjv: It was that Mary who anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and wiped His feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
chapters.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

chapters.ml: ആ സഹോദരിമാർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: കർത്താവേ, നിനക്കു പ്രിയനായവൻ ദീനമായ്ക്കിടക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, "Lord, the one you love is sick."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the sisters sent to Him, saying, "Lord, behold, he whom You love is sick."
chapters.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

chapters.ml: യേശു അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു: ഈ ദീനം മരണത്തിന്നായിട്ടല്ല, ദൈവപുത്രൻ മഹത്വപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മഹത്വത്തിന്നായിട്ടത്രേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When he heard this, Jesus said, "This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for God’s glory so that God’s Son may be glorified through it."
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus heard that, He said, "This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified through it."
chapters.kjv: When Jesus heard that , he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

chapters.ml: യേശു മാർത്തയെയും അവളുടെ സഹോദരിയെയും ലാസരിനെയും സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
chapters.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

chapters.ml: എന്നിട്ടും അവൻ ദീനമായ്ക്കിടക്കുന്നു എന്നു കേട്ടാറെ താൻ അന്നു ഇരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു രണ്ടു ദിവസം പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,
chapters.nkjv: So, when He heard that he was sick, He stayed two more days in the place where He was.
chapters.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: നാം വീണ്ടും യെഹൂദ്യയിലേക്കു പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and then he said to his disciples, "Let us go back to Judea."
chapters.nkjv: Then after this He said to the disciples, "Let us go to Judea again."
chapters.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: റബ്ബീ, യെഹൂദന്മാർ ഇപ്പോൾതന്നേ നിന്നെ കല്ലെറിവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചുവല്ലോ; നീ പിന്നെയും അവിടെ പോകുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "But Rabbi," they said, "a short while ago the Jews there tried to stone you, and yet you are going back?"
chapters.nkjv: The disciples said to Him, "Rabbi, lately the Jews sought to stone You, and are You going there again?"
chapters.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: പകലിന്നു പന്ത്രണ്ടു മണിനേരം ഇല്ലയോ? പകൽ സമയത്തു നടക്കുന്നവൻ ഈ ലോകത്തിന്റെ വെളിച്ചം കാണുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു ഇടറുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime will not stumble, for they see by this world’s light.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks in the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിൽ നടക്കുന്നവനോ അവന്നു വെളിച്ചം ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഇടറുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light."
chapters.nkjv: But if one walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him."
chapters.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ: നമ്മുടെ സ്നേഹിതനായ ലാസർ നിദ്രകൊള്ളുന്നു; എങ്കിലും ഞാൻ അവനെ ഉണർത്തുവാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up."
chapters.nkjv: These things He said, and after that He said to them, "Our friend Lazarus sleeps, but I go that I may wake him up."
chapters.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, അവൻ നിദ്രകൊള്ളുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അവന്നു സൌഖ്യം വരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: His disciples replied, "Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better."
chapters.nkjv: Then His disciples said, "Lord, if he sleeps he will get well."
chapters.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ അവന്റെ മരണത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ആയിരുന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു; ഉറക്കം എന്ന നിദ്രയെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു അവർക്കു തോന്നിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.
chapters.nkjv: However, Jesus spoke of his death, but they thought that He was speaking about taking rest in sleep.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യേശു സ്പഷ്ടമായി അവരോടു: ലാസർ മരിച്ചുപോയി;
chapters.niv: So then he told them plainly, "Lazarus is dead,
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them plainly, "Lazarus is dead.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവിടെ ഇല്ലാഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളെ വിചാരിച്ചു സന്തോഷിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിപ്പാൻ ഇടയാകുമല്ലോ; എന്നാൽ നാം അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him."
chapters.nkjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, that you may believe. Nevertheless let us go to him."
chapters.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

chapters.ml: ദിദിമൊസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ള തോമസ് സഹശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു: അവനോടു കൂടെ മരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നാമും പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Thomas (also known as Didymus ) said to the rest of the disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him."
chapters.nkjv: Then Thomas, who is called the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with Him."
chapters.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവിടെ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവനെ കല്ലറയിൽ വെച്ചിട്ടു നാലുദിവസമായി എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.
chapters.nkjv: So when Jesus came, He found that he had already been in the tomb four days.
chapters.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

chapters.ml: ബേഥാന്യ യെരൂശലേമിന്നരികെ ഏകദേശം രണ്ടു നാഴിക ദൂരത്തായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,
chapters.nkjv: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about two miles away.
chapters.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

chapters.ml: മാർത്തയെയും മറിയയെയും സഹോദരനെക്കുറിച്ചു ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പല യെഹൂദന്മാരും അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.
chapters.nkjv: And many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
chapters.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

chapters.ml: യേശു വരുന്നു എന്നു കേട്ടിട്ടു മാർത്ത അവനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ചെന്നു; മറിയയോ വീട്ടിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.
chapters.nkjv: Now Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met Him, but Mary was sitting in the house.
chapters.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

chapters.ml: മാർത്ത യേശുവിനോടു: കർത്താവേ, നീ ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ എന്റെ സഹോദരൻ മരിക്കയില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Lord," Martha said to Jesus, "if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
chapters.nkjv: Now Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
chapters.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴും നീ ദൈവത്തോടു എന്തു അപേക്ഷിച്ചാലും ദൈവം നിനക്കു തരും എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask."
chapters.nkjv: But even now I know that whatever You ask of God, God will give You."
chapters.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: നിന്റെ സഹോദരൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

chapters.ml: മാർത്ത അവനോടു: ഒടുക്കത്തെ നാളിലെ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിൽ അവൻ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Martha answered, "I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."
chapters.nkjv: Martha said to Him, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."
chapters.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: ഞാൻ തന്നേ പുനരുത്ഥാനവും ജീവനും ആകുന്നു; എന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവൻ മരിച്ചാലും ജീവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die;
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in Me, though he may die, he shall live.
chapters.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

chapters.ml: ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു എന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവൻ ആരും ഒരു നാളും മരിക്കയില്ല; ഇതു നീ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?"
chapters.nkjv: And whoever lives and believes in Me shall never die. Do you believe this?"
chapters.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

chapters.ml: അവൾ അവനോടു: ഉവ്വു, കർത്താവേ, ലോകത്തിൽ വരുവാനുള്ള ദൈവപുത്രനായ ക്രിസ്തു നീ തന്നേ എന്നു ഞാൻ വിശ്വസിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു
chapters.niv: "Yes, Lord," she replied, "I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is to come into the world."
chapters.nkjv: She said to Him, "Yes, Lord, I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who is to come into the world."
chapters.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

chapters.ml: പോയി തന്റെ സഹോദരിയായ മറിയയെ സ്വകാര്യമായി വിളിച്ചു: ഗുരു വന്നിട്ടുണ്ടു നിന്നെ വിളിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. "The Teacher is here," she said, "and is asking for you."
chapters.nkjv: And when she had said these things, she went her way and secretly called Mary her sister, saying, "The Teacher has come and is calling for you."
chapters.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

chapters.ml: അവൾ കേട്ട ഉടനെ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.
chapters.nkjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly and came to Him.
chapters.kjv: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly, and came unto him.

chapters.ml: യേശു അതുവരെ ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ കടക്കാതെ മാർത്ത അവനെ എതിരേറ്റ സ്ഥലത്തു തന്നേ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.
chapters.nkjv: Now Jesus had not yet come into the town, but was in the place where Martha met Him.
chapters.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

chapters.ml: വീട്ടിൽ അവളോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു അവളെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന യെഹൂദന്മാർ, മറിയ വേഗം എഴുന്നേറ്റു പോകുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവൾ കല്ലറെക്കൽ കരവാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു വിചാരിച്ചു പിൻചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and comforting her, when they saw that Mary rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, "She is going to the tomb to weep there."
chapters.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഇരിക്കുന്നേടത്തു മറിയ എത്തി അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു: കർത്താവേ, നീ ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ എന്റെ സഹോദരൻ മരിക്കയില്ലായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died."
chapters.nkjv: Then, when Mary came where Jesus was, and saw Him, she fell down at His feet, saying to Him, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died."
chapters.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

chapters.ml: അവൾ കരയുന്നതും അവളോടുകൂടെ വന്ന യെഹൂദന്മാർ കരയുന്നതും യേശു കണ്ടിട്ടു ഉള്ളം നൊന്തു കലങ്ങി:
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her weeping, He groaned in the spirit and was troubled.
chapters.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

chapters.ml: അവനെ വെച്ചതു എവിടെ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. കർത്താവേ, വന്നു കാൺക എന്നു അവർ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Where have you laid him?" he asked. "Come and see, Lord," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: And He said, "Where have you laid him?" They said to Him, "Lord, come and see."
chapters.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

chapters.ml: യേശു കണ്ണുനീർ വാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Jesus wept.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus wept.
chapters.kjv: Jesus wept.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാർ: കണ്ടോ അവനോടു എത്ര പ്രിയം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the Jews said, "See how he loved him!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the Jews said, "See how He loved him!"
chapters.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

chapters.ml: ചിലരോ: കുരുടന്റെ കണ്ണു തുറന്ന ഇവന്നു ഇവനെയും മരിക്കാതാക്കുവാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But some of them said, "Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?"
chapters.nkjv: And some of them said, "Could not this Man, who opened the eyes of the blind, also have kept this man from dying?"
chapters.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

chapters.ml: യേശു പിന്നെയും ഉള്ളംനൊന്തു കല്ലറെക്കൽ എത്തി; അതു ഒരു ഗുഹ ആയിരുന്നു; ഒരു കല്ലും അതിന്മേൽ വെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus, again groaning in Himself, came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
chapters.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

chapters.ml: കല്ലു നീക്കുവിൻ എന്നു യേശു പറഞ്ഞു മരിച്ചവന്റെ സഹോദരിയായ മാർത്ത: കർത്താവേ, നാറ്റം വെച്ചുതുടങ്ങി; നാലുദിവസമായല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Take away the stone," he said. "But, Lord," said Martha, the sister of the dead man, "by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to Him, "Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days."
chapters.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: വിശ്വസിച്ചാൽ നീ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മഹത്വം കാണും എന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞില്ലയോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus said, "Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?"
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Did I not say to you that if you would believe you would see the glory of God?"
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

chapters.ml: അവർ കല്ലു നീക്കി. യേശു മേലോട്ടു നോക്കി: പിതാവേ, നീ എന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേട്ടതിനാൽ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വാഴ്ത്തുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, "Father, I thank you that you have heard me.
chapters.nkjv: Then they took away the stone fromtheplace where the dead man was lying. And Jesus lifted up His eyes and said, "Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
chapters.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

chapters.ml: നീ എപ്പോഴും എന്റെ അപേക്ഷ കേൾക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; എങ്കിലും നീ എന്നെ അയച്ചു എന്നു ചുറ്റും നില്ക്കുന്ന പുരുഷാരം വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ നിമിത്തം ഞാൻ പറയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me."
chapters.nkjv: And I know that You always hear Me, but because of the people who are standing by I said this, that they may believe that You sent Me."
chapters.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ: ലാസരേ, പുറത്തുവരിക എന്നു ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"
chapters.nkjv: Now when He had said these things, He cried with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come forth!"
chapters.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവൻ പുറത്തുവന്നു; അവന്റെ കാലും കയ്യും ശീലകൊണ്ടു കെട്ടിയും മുഖം റൂമാൽകൊണ്ടു മൂടിയുമിരുന്നു. അവന്റെ കെട്ടു അഴിപ്പിൻ; അവൻ പോകട്ടെ എന്നു യേശു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, "Take off the grave clothes and let him go."
chapters.nkjv: And he who had died came out bound hand and foot with graveclothes, and his face was wrapped with a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Loose him, and let him go."
chapters.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

chapters.ml: മറിയയുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്ന യെഹൂദന്മാരിൽ പലരും അവൻ ചെയ്തതു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.
chapters.nkjv: Then many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen the things Jesus did, believed in Him.
chapters.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ചിലർ പരീശന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പോയി യേശു ചെയ്തതു അവരോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
chapters.nkjv: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things Jesus did.
chapters.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും പരീശന്മാരും സംഘം കൂടി: നാം എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു? ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ വളരെ അടയാളങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. "What are we accomplishing?" they asked. "Here is this man performing many signs.
chapters.nkjv: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered a council and said, "What shall we do? For this Man works many signs.
chapters.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ഇങ്ങനെ വിട്ടേച്ചാൽ എല്ലാവരും അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കും; റോമക്കാരും വന്നു നമ്മുടെ സ്ഥലത്തെയും ജനത്തെയും എടുത്തുകളയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation."
chapters.nkjv: If we let Him alone like this, everyone will believe in Him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and nation."
chapters.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ, ആ സംവത്സരത്തെ മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ കയ്യഫാവു തന്നേ, അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ ഒന്നും അറിയുന്നില്ല;
chapters.niv: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, "You know nothing at all!
chapters.nkjv: And one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all,
chapters.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

chapters.ml: ജനം മുഴുവനും നശിച്ചുപോകാതവണ്ണം ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ ജാതിക്കു വേണ്ടി മരിക്കുന്നതു നന്നു എന്നു ഓർക്കുന്നതുമില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish."
chapters.nkjv: nor do you consider that it is expedient for us that one man should die for the people, and not that the whole nation should perish."
chapters.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇതു സ്വയമായി പറഞ്ഞതല്ല, താൻ ആ സംവത്സരത്തെ മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ ആകയാൽ ജനത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി യേശു മരിപ്പാൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പ്രവചിച്ചതത്രേ.
chapters.niv: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,
chapters.nkjv: Now this he did not say on his own authority; but being high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
chapters.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

chapters.ml: ജനത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി മാത്രമല്ല ചിതറിയിരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവമക്കളെ ഒന്നായിട്ടു ചേർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.
chapters.nkjv: and not for that nation only, but also that He would gather together in one the children of God who were scattered abroad.
chapters.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

chapters.ml: അന്നു മുതൽ അവർ അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ആലോചിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.
chapters.nkjv: Then, from that day on, they plotted to put Him to death.
chapters.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു യേശു യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പിന്നെ പരസ്യമായി നടക്കാതെ അവിടം വിട്ടു മരുഭൂമിക്കരികെ എഫ്രയീം എന്ന പട്ടണത്തിലേക്കു വാങ്ങി ശിഷ്യന്മാരുമായി അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the people of Judea. Instead he withdrew to a region near the wilderness, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Jesus no longer walked openly among the Jews, but went from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim, and there remained with His disciples.
chapters.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ പെസഹ അടുത്തിരിക്കയാൽ പലരും തങ്ങൾക്കു ശുദ്ധിവരുത്തുവാൻ പെസഹെക്കു മുമ്പെ നാട്ടിൽ നിന്നു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.
chapters.nkjv: And the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went from the country up to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
chapters.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

chapters.ml: അവർ യേശുവിനെ അന്വേഷിച്ചു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു: എന്തു തോന്നുന്നു? അവൻ പെരുനാൾക്കു വരികയില്ലയോ എന്നു തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple courts they asked one another, "What do you think? Isn’t he coming to the festival at all?"
chapters.nkjv: Then they sought Jesus, and spoke among themselves as they stood in the temple, "What do you think—that He will not come to the feast?"
chapters.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും പരീശന്മാരും അവനെ പിടിക്കേണം എന്നു വെച്ചു അവൻ ഇരിക്കുന്ന ഇടം ആരെങ്കിലും അറിഞ്ഞാൽ അറിവു തരേണമെന്നു കല്പന കൊടുത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who found out where Jesus was should report it so that they might arrest him.
chapters.nkjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a command, that if anyone knew where He was, he should report it, that they might seize Him.
chapters.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it , that they might take him.

chapters.ml: യേശു മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർപ്പിച്ച ലാസർ പാർത്ത ബേഥാന്യയിലേക്കു യേശു പെസഹെക്കു ആറുദിവസം മുമ്പെ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
chapters.nkjv: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was who had been dead, whom He had raised from the dead.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവർ അവന്നു ഒരു അത്താഴം ഒരുക്കി; മാർത്ത ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തു, ലാസരോ അവനോടുകൂടെ പന്തിയിൽ ഇരുന്നവരിൽ ഒരുവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Here a dinner was given in Jesus’ honor. Martha served, while Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with him.
chapters.nkjv: There they made Him a supper; and Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with Him.
chapters.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മറിയ വിലയേറിയ സ്വച്ഛജടാമാംസിതൈലം ഒരു റാത്തൽ എടുത്തു യേശുവിന്റെ കാലിൽ പൂശി തന്റെ തലമുടികൊണ്ടു കാൽ തുവർത്തി; തൈലത്തിന്റെ സൌരഭ്യം കൊണ്ടു വീടു നിറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Mary took about a pint of pure nard, an expensive perfume; she poured it on Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
chapters.nkjv: Then Mary took a pound of very costly oil of spikenard, anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped His feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.
chapters.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനായി അവനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാനുള്ള യൂദാ ഈസ്കര്യോത്താവു:
chapters.niv: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,
chapters.nkjv: But one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, who would betray Him, said,
chapters.kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son , which should betray him,

chapters.ml: ഈ തൈലം മുന്നൂറു വെള്ളിക്കാശിന്നു വിറ്റു ദിരിദ്രന്മാർക്കു കൊടുക്കാഞ്ഞതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Why wasn’t this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year’s wages. "
chapters.nkjv: "Why was this fragrant oil not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?"
chapters.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

chapters.ml: ഇതു ദരിദ്രന്മാരെക്കുറിച്ചു വിചാരം ഉണ്ടായിട്ടല്ല, അവൻ കള്ളൻ ആകകൊണ്ടും പണസ്സഞ്ചി തന്റെ പക്കൽ ആകയാൽ അതിൽ ഇട്ടതു എടുത്തുവന്നതുകൊണ്ടും അത്രേ പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: He did not say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief; as keeper of the money bag, he used to help himself to what was put into it.
chapters.nkjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and had the money box; and he used to take what was put in it.
chapters.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ: അവളെ വിടുക; എന്റെ ശവസംസ്കാരദിവസത്തിന്നായി അവൾ ഇതു സൂക്ഷിച്ചു എന്നിരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "Leave her alone," Jesus replied. "It was intended that she should save this perfume for the day of my burial.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus said, "Let her alone; she has kept this for the day of My burial.
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

chapters.ml: ദരിദ്രന്മാർ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എല്ലായ്പോഴും അടുക്കെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ; ഞാൻ എല്ലായ്പോഴും അടുക്കെ ഇല്ലതാനും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me."
chapters.nkjv: For the poor you have with you always, but Me you do not have always."
chapters.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഒരു വലിയ പുരുഷാരം യേശുവിന്റെ നിമിത്തം മാത്രമല്ല, അവൻ മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർപ്പിച്ച ലാസരെ കാണ്മാനായിട്ടുംകൂടെ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews found out that Jesus was there and came, not only because of him but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.
chapters.nkjv: Now a great many of the Jews knew that He was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might also see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
chapters.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഹേതുവായി അനേകം യെഹൂദന്മാർ ചെന്നു
chapters.niv: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
chapters.nkjv: But the chief priests plotted to put Lazarus to death also,
chapters.kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

chapters.ml: യേശുവിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കയാൽ ലാസരെയും കൊല്ലേണം എന്നു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ ആലോചിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and believing in him.
chapters.nkjv: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
chapters.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റേന്നു പെരുന്നാൾക്കു വന്നോരു വലിയ പുരുഷാരം യേശു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു വരുന്നു എന്നു കേട്ടിട്ടു
chapters.niv: The next day the great crowd that had come for the festival heard that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: The next day a great multitude that had come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
chapters.kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

chapters.ml: ഈത്തപ്പനയുടെ കുരുത്തോല എടുത്തുംകൊണ്ടു അവനെ എതിരേല്പാൻ ചെന്നു: ഹോശന്നാ, യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ രാജാവായി കർത്താവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ വരുന്നവൻ വാഴ്ത്തപ്പെട്ടവൻ എന്നു ആർത്തു.
chapters.niv: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, "Hosanna! " "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Blessed is the king of Israel!"
chapters.nkjv: took branches of palm trees and went out to meet Him, and cried out: "Hosanna! ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!’ The King of Israel!"
chapters.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഒരു ചെറിയ കഴുതയെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അതിന്മേൽ കയറി.
chapters.niv: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it is written:
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus, when He had found a young donkey, sat on it; as it is written:
chapters.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

chapters.ml: “സീയോൻ പുത്രി, ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ; ഇതാ നിന്റെ രാജാവു കഴുതക്കുട്ടിപ്പുറത്തു കയറിവരുന്നു” എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "Do not be afraid, Daughter Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkey’s colt."
chapters.nkjv: "Fear not, daughter of Zion; Behold, your King is coming, Sitting on a donkey’s colt."
chapters.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.

chapters.ml: ഇതു അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ആദിയിൽ ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല; യേശുവിന്നു തേജസ്കരണം വന്നശേഷം അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഇങ്ങനെ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നും തങ്ങൾ അവന്നു ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു എന്നും അവർക്കു ഓർമ്മ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: At first his disciples did not understand all this. Only after Jesus was glorified did they realize that these things had been written about him and that these things had been done to him.
chapters.nkjv: His disciples did not understand these things at first; but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about Him and that they had done these things to Him.
chapters.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ലാസരെ കല്ലറയിൽ നിന്നു വിളിച്ചു മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവനോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്ന പുരുഷാരം സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now the crowd that was with him when he called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to spread the word.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the people, who were with Him when He called Lazarus out of his tomb and raised him from the dead, bore witness.
chapters.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഈ അടയാളം ചെയ്തപ്രകാരം പുരുഷാരം കേട്ടിട്ടു അവനെ എതിരേറ്റുചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Many people, because they had heard that he had performed this sign, went out to meet him.
chapters.nkjv: For this reason the people also met Him, because they heard that He had done this sign.
chapters.kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ പരീശന്മാർ തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ: നമുക്കു ഒന്നും സാധിക്കുന്നില്ലല്ലോ; ലോകം അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ആയിപ്പോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the Pharisees said to one another, "See, this is getting us nowhere. Look how the whole world has gone after him!"
chapters.nkjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, "You see that you are accomplishing nothing. Look, the world has gone after Him!"
chapters.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

chapters.ml: പെരുനാളിൽ നമസ്കരിപ്പാൻ വന്നവരിൽ ചില യവനന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the festival.
chapters.nkjv: Now there were certain Greeks among those who came up to worship at the feast.
chapters.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

chapters.ml: ഇവർ ഗലീലയിലെ ബേത്ത്സയിദക്കാരനായ ഫിലിപ്പൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടു: യജമാനനേ, ഞങ്ങൾക്കു യേശുവിനെ കാണ്മാൻ താല്പര്യമുണ്ടു എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, with a request. "Sir," they said, "we would like to see Jesus."
chapters.nkjv: Then they came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, "Sir, we wish to see Jesus."
chapters.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പൊസ് ചെന്നു അന്ത്രെയാസിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. അന്ത്രെയാസും ഫിലിപ്പൊസും കൂടെ ചെന്നു യേശുവിനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn Andrew and Philip told Jesus.
chapters.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു: മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ തേജസ്കരിക്കപ്പെടുവാനുള്ള നാഴിക വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
chapters.nkjv: But Jesus answered them, saying, "The hour has come that the Son of Man should be glorified.
chapters.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: കോതമ്പുമണി നിലത്തു വീണു ചാകുന്നില്ല എങ്കിൽ അതു തനിയേ ഇരിക്കും; ചത്തു എങ്കിലോ വളരെ വിളവുണ്ടാകും.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it produces much grain.
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ജീവനെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവൻ അതിനെ കളയും; ഇഹലോകത്തിൽ തന്റെ ജീവനെ പകെക്കുന്നവൻ അതിനെ നിത്യജീവന്നായി സൂക്ഷിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Anyone who loves their life will lose it, while anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
chapters.nkjv: He who loves his life will lose it, and he who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
chapters.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കട്ടെ; ഞാൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നേടത്തു എന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരനും ഇരിക്കും; എനിക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷചെയ്യുന്നവനെ പിതാവു മാനിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.
chapters.nkjv: If anyone serves Me, let him follow Me; and where I am, there My servant will be also. If anyone serves Me, him My Father will honor.
chapters.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ എന്റെ ഉള്ളം കലങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ എന്തു പറയേണ്ടു? പിതാവേ, ഈ നാഴികയിൽനിന്നു എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ; എങ്കിലും ഇതു നിമിത്തം ഞാൻ ഈ നാഴികയിലേക്കു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Now my soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.
chapters.nkjv: "Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? But for this purpose I came to this hour.
chapters.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

chapters.ml: പിതാവേ, നിന്റെ നാമത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തേണമേ. അപ്പോൾ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു; ഞാൻ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇനിയും മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തും എന്നൊരു ശബ്ദം ഉണ്ടായി:
chapters.niv: Father, glorify your name!" Then a voice came from heaven, "I have glorified it, and will glorify it again."
chapters.nkjv: Father, glorify Your name." Then a voice came from heaven, saying, "I have both glorified it and will glorify it again."
chapters.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again.

chapters.ml: അതുകേട്ടിട്ടു അരികെ നില്ക്കുന്ന പുരുഷാരം: ഇടി ഉണ്ടായി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; മറ്റു ചിലർ ഒരു ദൈവദൂതൻ അവനോടു സംസാരിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the people who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, "An angel has spoken to Him."
chapters.kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it , said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു: ഈ ശബ്ദം എന്റെ നിമിത്തമല്ല, നിങ്ങളുടെ നിമിത്തം അത്രേ ഉണ്ടായതു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "This voice was for your benefit, not mine.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said, "This voice did not come because of Me, but for your sake.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ ഈ ലോകത്തിന്റെ ന്യായവിധി ആകുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ ഈ ലോകത്തിന്റെ പ്രഭുവിനെ പുറത്തു തള്ളിക്കളയും.
chapters.niv: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.
chapters.nkjv: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
chapters.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

chapters.ml: ഞാനോ ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു ഉയർത്തപ്പെട്ടാൽ എല്ലാവരെയും എങ്കലേക്കു ആകർഷിക്കും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself."
chapters.nkjv: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all peoples to Myself."
chapters.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

chapters.ml: ഇതു താൻ മരിപ്പാനുള്ള മരണവിധം സൂചിപ്പിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതത്രേ.
chapters.niv: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.
chapters.nkjv: This He said, signifying by what death He would die.
chapters.kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരം അവനോടു: ക്രിസ്തു എന്നേക്കും ഇരിക്കും എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിൽ വായിച്ചുകേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; പിന്നെ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ഉയർത്തപ്പെടേണ്ടതെന്നു നീ പറയുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ? ഈ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The crowd spoke up, "We have heard from the Law that the Messiah will remain forever, so how can you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this ‘Son of Man’?"
chapters.nkjv: The people answered Him, "We have heard from the law that the Christ remains forever; and how can You say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?"
chapters.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു യേശു അവരോടു: ഇനി കുറെകാലം മാത്രം വെളിച്ചം നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഇരിക്കും; ഇരുൾ നിങ്ങളെ പിടിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു വെളിച്ചം ഉള്ളേടത്തോളം നടന്നുകൊൾവിൻ. ഇരുളിൽ നടക്കുന്നവൻ താൻ എവിടെ പോകുന്നു എന്നു അറിയുന്നില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus told them, "You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. Whoever walks in the dark does not know where they are going.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "A little while longer the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, lest darkness overtake you; he who walks in darkness does not know where he is going.
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ വെളിച്ചത്തിന്റെ മക്കൾ ആകേണ്ടതിന്നു വെളിച്ചം ഉള്ളടത്തോളം വെളിച്ചത്തിൽ വിശ്വസിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Believe in the light while you have the light, so that you may become children of light." When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.
chapters.nkjv: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become sons of light." These things Jesus spoke, and departed, and was hidden from them.
chapters.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

chapters.ml: ഇതു സംസാരിച്ചിട്ടു യേശു വാങ്ങിപ്പോയി അവരെ വിട്ടു മറഞ്ഞു. അവർ കാൺകെ അവൻ ഇത്ര വളരെ അടയാളങ്ങളെ ചെയ്തിട്ടും അവർ അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.
chapters.nkjv: But although He had done so many signs before them, they did not believe in Him,
chapters.kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

chapters.ml: “കർത്താവേ, ഞങ്ങൾ കേൾപ്പിച്ചതു ആർ വിശ്വസിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു? കർത്താവിന്റെ ഭുജം ആർക്കു വെളിപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു?” എന്നു യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകൻ പറഞ്ഞ വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാവാൻ ഇടവന്നു.
chapters.niv: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: "Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
chapters.nkjv: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: "Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
chapters.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

chapters.ml: അവർക്കു വിശ്വസിപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല; അതിന്റെ കാരണം യെശയ്യാവു വേറെ ഒരേടത്തു പറയുന്നതു:
chapters.niv: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they could not believe, because Isaiah said again:
chapters.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

chapters.ml: അവർ കണ്ണുകൊണ്ടു കാണുകയോ ഹൃദയംകൊണ്ടു ഗ്രഹിക്കയോ മനം തിരികയോ താൻ അവരെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുകയോ ചെയ്യാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരുടെ കണ്ണു അവൻ കുരുടാക്കി ഹൃദയം തടിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു”
chapters.niv: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn—and I would heal them."
chapters.nkjv: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, Lest they should see with their eyes, Lest they should understand with their hearts and turn, So that I should heal them."
chapters.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

chapters.ml: യെശയ്യാവു അവന്റെ തേജസ്സു കണ്ടു അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു സംസാരിച്ചതു കൊണ്ടാകുന്നു ഇതു പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about him.
chapters.nkjv: These things Isaiah said when he saw His glory and spoke of Him.
chapters.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

chapters.ml: എന്നിട്ടും പ്രമാണികളിൽ തന്നേയും അനേകർ അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു; പള്ളിഭ്രഷ്ടർ ആകാതിരിപ്പാൻ പരീശന്മാർ നിമിത്തം ഏറ്റുപറഞ്ഞില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not openly acknowledge their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless even among the rulers many believed in Him, but because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue;
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him , lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

chapters.ml: അവർ ദൈവത്താലുള്ള മാനത്തെക്കാൾ മനുഷ്യരാലുള്ള മാനത്തെ അധികം സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.
chapters.nkjv: for they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
chapters.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

chapters.ml: യേശു വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: എന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവൻ എന്നിലല്ല എന്നെ അയച്ചവനിൽ തന്നേ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus cried out, "Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus cried out and said, "He who believes in Me, believes not in Me but in Him who sent Me.
chapters.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

chapters.ml: എന്നെ കാണുന്നവൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചവനെ കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.
chapters.nkjv: And he who sees Me sees Him who sent Me.
chapters.kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

chapters.ml: എന്നിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവൻ ആരും ഇരുളിൽ വസിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ വെളിച്ചമായി ലോകത്തിൽ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.
chapters.nkjv: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in Me should not abide in darkness.
chapters.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വചനം കേട്ടു പ്രമാണിക്കാത്തവനെ ഞാൻ വിധിക്കുന്നില്ല; ലോകത്തെ വിധിപ്പാനല്ല, ലോകത്തെ രക്ഷിപ്പാനത്രേ ഞാൻ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: "If anyone hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge that person. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
chapters.nkjv: And if anyone hears My words and does not believe, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.
chapters.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വചനം കൈക്കൊള്ളാതെ എന്നെ തള്ളിക്കളയുന്നവനെ ന്യായം വിധിക്കുന്നവൻ ഉണ്ടു; ഞാൻ സംസാരിച്ച വചനം തന്നേ ഒടുക്കത്തെ നാളിൽ അവനെ ന്യായം വിധിക്കും.
chapters.niv: There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; the very words I have spoken will condemn them at the last day.
chapters.nkjv: He who rejects Me, and does not receive My words, has that which judges him— the word that I have spoken will judge him in the last day.
chapters.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സ്വയമായി സംസാരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല; എന്നെ അയച്ച പിതാവു തന്നേ ഞാൻ ഇന്നതു പറയേണം എന്നും ഇന്നതു സംസാരിക്കേണം എന്നും കല്പന തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For I did not speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me to say all that I have spoken.
chapters.nkjv: For I have not spoken on My own authority; but the Father who sent Me gave Me a command, what I should say and what I should speak.
chapters.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കല്പന നിത്യജീവൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; ആകയാൽ ഞാൻ സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു പിതാവു എന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ തന്നേ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say."
chapters.nkjv: And I know that His command is everlasting life. Therefore, whatever I speak, just as the Father has told Me, so I speak."
chapters.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

chapters.ml: പെസഹപെരുനാളിന്നു മുമ്പെ താൻ ഈ ലോകം വിട്ടു പിതാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോകുവാനുള്ള നാഴിക വന്നു എന്നു യേശു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു, ലോകത്തിൽ തനിക്കുള്ളവരെ സ്നേഹിച്ചതുപോലെ അവസാനത്തോളം അവരെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was just before the Passover Festival. Jesus knew that the hour had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
chapters.nkjv: Now before the Feast of the Passover, when Jesus knew that His hour had come that He should depart from this world to the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.
chapters.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

chapters.ml: അത്താഴം ആയപ്പോൾ പിശാചു, ശിമോന്റെ മകനായ യൂദാ ഈസ്കർയോത്തവിന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ അവനെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുപ്പാൻ തോന്നിച്ചിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: The evening meal was in progress, and the devil had already prompted Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And supper being ended, the devil having already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray Him,
chapters.kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son , to betray him;

chapters.ml: പിതാവു സകലവും തന്റെ കയ്യിൽ തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നും താൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു വന്നു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോകുന്നു എന്നും യേശു അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കെ
chapters.niv: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;
chapters.nkjv: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was going to God,
chapters.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

chapters.ml: അത്താഴത്തിൽ നിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു വസ്ത്രം ഊരിവെച്ചു ഒരു തുവർത്തു എടുത്തു അരയിൽ ചുറ്റി
chapters.niv: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
chapters.nkjv: rose from supper and laid aside His garments, took a towel and girded Himself.
chapters.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

chapters.ml: ഒരു പാത്രത്തിൽ വെള്ളം പകർന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ കാൽ കഴുകുവാനും അരയിൽ ചുറ്റിയിരുന്ന തുണികൊണ്ടു തുവർത്തുവാനും തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
chapters.nkjv: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel with which He was girded.
chapters.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, നീ എന്റെ കാൽ കഴുകുന്നുവോ, എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"
chapters.nkjv: Then He came to Simon Peter. And Peter said to Him, "Lord, are You washing my feet?"
chapters.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: ഞാൻ ചെയ്യുന്നതു നീ ഇപ്പോൾ അറിയുന്നില്ല; പിന്നെ അറിയും എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus replied, "You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but you will know after this."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

chapters.ml: നീ ഒരുനാളും എന്റെ കാൽ കഴുകുകയില്ല എന്നു പത്രൊസ് പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു യേശു: ഞാൻ നിന്നെ കഴുകാഞ്ഞാൽ നിനക്കു എന്നോടുകൂടെ പങ്കില്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു. അപ്പോൾ ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ്:
chapters.niv: "No," said Peter, "you shall never wash my feet." Jesus answered, "Unless I wash you, you have no part with me."
chapters.nkjv: Peter said to Him, "You shall never wash my feet!" Jesus answered him, "If I do not wash you, you have no part with Me."
chapters.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, എന്റെ കാൽ മാത്രമല്ല കയ്യും തലയും കൂടെ കഴുകേണമേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Then, Lord," Simon Peter replied, "not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!"
chapters.nkjv: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!"
chapters.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: കുളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവന്നു കാൽ അല്ലാതെ കഴുകുവാൻ ആവശ്യം ഇല്ല; അവൻ മുഴുവനും ശുദ്ധിയുള്ളവൻ; നിങ്ങൾ ശുദ്ധിയുള്ളവർ ആകുന്നു; എല്ലാവരും അല്ലതാനും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "Those who have had a bath need only to wash their feet; their whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "He who is bathed needs only to wash his feet, but is completely clean; and you are clean, but not all of you."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

chapters.ml: തന്നെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നവനെ അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കകൊണ്ടത്രേ എല്ലാവരും ശുദ്ധിയുള്ളവരല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.
chapters.nkjv: For He knew who would betray Him; therefore He said, "You are not all clean."
chapters.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ കാൽ കഴുകീട്ടു വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു വീണ്ടും ഇരുന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ചെയ്തതു ഇന്നതു എന്നു അറിയുന്നുവോ?
chapters.niv: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. "Do you understand what I have done for you?" he asked them.
chapters.nkjv: So when He had washed their feet, taken His garments, and sat down again, He said to them, "Do you know what I have done to you?
chapters.kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ഗുരുവെന്നും കർത്താവെന്നും വിളിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ അങ്ങനെ ആകകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങൾ പറയുന്നതു ശരി.
chapters.niv: "You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.
chapters.nkjv: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and you say well, for so I am.
chapters.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവും ഗുരുവുമായ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ കാൽ കഴുകി എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളും തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ കാൽ കഴുകേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
chapters.nkjv: If I then, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
chapters.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ നിങ്ങളും ചെയ്യേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ദൃഷ്ടാന്തം തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.
chapters.nkjv: For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.
chapters.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: ദാസൻ യജമാനനെക്കാൾ വലിയവൻ അല്ല; ദൂതൻ തന്നെ അയച്ചവനെക്കാൾ വലിയവനുമല്ല.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his master; nor is he who is sent greater than he who sent him.
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

chapters.ml: ഇതു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ചെയ്താൽ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ.
chapters.niv: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
chapters.nkjv: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
chapters.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെ എല്ലാവരെയും കുറിച്ചു പറയുന്നില്ല; ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തവരെ ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; എന്നാൽ “എന്റെ അപ്പം തിന്നുന്നവൻ എന്റെ നേരെ കുതികാൽ ഉയർത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നുള്ള തിരുവെഴുത്തിന്നു നിവൃത്തി വരേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill this passage of Scripture: ‘He who shared my bread has turned against me.’
chapters.nkjv: "I do not speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with Mehas lifted up his heel against Me.’
chapters.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

chapters.ml: അതു സംഭവിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഞാൻ തന്നേ മശീഹ എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ അതു സംഭവിക്കുംമുമ്പെ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.
chapters.nkjv: Now I tell you before it comes, that when it does come to pass, you may believe that I am He.
chapters.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he .

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: ഞാൻ അയക്കുന്നവനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നവൻ എന്നെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നു; എന്നെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നവൻ എന്നെ അയച്ചവനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me."
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, he who receives whomever I send receives Me; and he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me."
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു യേശു ഉള്ളം കലങ്ങി: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു: നിങ്ങളിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ എന്നെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും എന്നു സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, "Very truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray me."
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus had said these things, He was troubled in spirit, and testified and said, "Most assuredly, I say to you, one of you will betray Me."
chapters.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ആരെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയുന്നു എന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ സംശയിച്ചു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.
chapters.nkjv: Then the disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom He spoke.
chapters.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ വെച്ചു യേശു സ്നേഹിച്ച ഒരുത്തൻ യേശുവിന്റെ മാർവ്വിടത്തു ചാരിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved.
chapters.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു ആംഗ്യം കാട്ടി, അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു ആരെക്കൊണ്ടു എന്നു ചോദിപ്പാൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, "Ask him which one he means."
chapters.nkjv: Simon Peter therefore motioned to him to ask who it was of whom He spoke.
chapters.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യേശുവിന്റെ നെഞ്ചോടു ചാഞ്ഞു: കർത്താവേ, അതു ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, "Lord, who is it?"
chapters.nkjv: Then, leaning back on Jesus’ breast, he said to Him, "Lord, who is it?"
chapters.kjv: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അപ്പഖണ്ഡംമുക്കി കൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ തന്നേ എന്നു യേശു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു; ഖണ്ഡം മുക്കി ശിമോൻ ഈസ്കര്യോത്താവിന്റെ മകനായ യൂദെക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish." Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "It is he to whom I shall give a piece of bread when I have dipped it." And having dipped the bread, He gave it to Judas Iscariot, theson of Simon.
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it . And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

chapters.ml: ഖണ്ഡം വാങ്ങിയ ഉടനെ സാത്താൻ അവനിൽ കടന്നു; യേശു അവനോടു: നീ ചെയ്യുന്നതു വേഗത്തിൽ ചെയ്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. So Jesus told him, "What you are about to do, do quickly."
chapters.nkjv: Now after the piece of bread, Satan entered him. Then Jesus said to him, "What you do, do quickly."
chapters.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇതു ഇന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞുവെന്നു പന്തിയിൽ ഇരുന്നവരിൽ ആരും അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.
chapters.nkjv: But no one at the table knew for what reason He said this to him.
chapters.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

chapters.ml: പണസ്സഞ്ചി യൂദയുടെ പക്കൽ ആകയാൽ പെരുനാളിന്നു വേണ്ടുന്നതു മേടിപ്പാനോ ദരിദ്രർക്കു വല്ലതും കൊടുപ്പാനോ യേശു അവനോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ചിലർക്കു തോന്നി.
chapters.niv: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.
chapters.nkjv: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus had said to him, "Buy thosethings we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.
chapters.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

chapters.ml: ഖണ്ഡം വാങ്ങിയ ഉടനെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റുപോയി, അപ്പോൾ രാത്രി ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.
chapters.nkjv: Having received the piece of bread, he then went out immediately. And it was night.
chapters.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോയശേഷം യേശു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇപ്പോൾ മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ മഹത്വപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; ദൈവവും അവനിൽ മഹത്വപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: When he was gone, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in him.
chapters.nkjv: So, when he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
chapters.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവനിൽ മഹത്വപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ദൈവം അവനെ തന്നിൽ തന്നേ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തും; ക്ഷണത്തിൽ അവനെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തും.
chapters.niv: If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.
chapters.nkjv: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and glorify Him immediately.
chapters.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

chapters.ml: കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളേ, ഞാൻ ഇനി കുറഞ്ഞോന്നു മാത്രം നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കും; നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കും; ഞാൻ പോകുന്ന ഇടത്തു നിങ്ങൾക്കു വരുവാൻ കഴികയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ യെഹൂദന്മാരോടു പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ഇന്നു നിങ്ങളോടും പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.
chapters.nkjv: Little children, I shall be with you a little while longer. You will seek Me; and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come,’ so now I say to you.
chapters.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം എന്നു പുതിയോരു കല്പന ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു തരുന്നു; ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ സ്നേഹിച്ചതുപോലെ നിങ്ങളും തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ സ്നേഹിക്കേണം എന്നു തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
chapters.nkjv: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
chapters.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ സ്നേഹം ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്റെ ശീഷ്യന്മാർ എന്നു എല്ലാവരും അറിയും.
chapters.niv: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another."
chapters.nkjv: By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another."
chapters.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, നീ എവിടെ പോകന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: ഞാൻ പോകുന്ന ഇടത്തേക്കു നിനക്കു ഇപ്പോൾ എന്നെ അനുഗമിപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല; പിന്നെത്തേതിൽ നീ എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്കും എന്നു യേശു അവനോടു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
