chapters.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

chapters.ml: യേശു താൻ മരിപ്പാനുള്ള മരണവിധം സൂചിപ്പിച്ചവാക്കിന്നു ഇതിനാൽ നിവൃത്തിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.
chapters.nkjv: that the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled which He spoke, signifying by what death He would die.
chapters.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് പിന്നെയും ആസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ ചെന്നു യേശുവിനെ വിളിച്ചു: നീ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate entered the Praetorium again, called Jesus, and said to Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?"
chapters.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഉത്തരമായി യേശു: ഇതു നീ സ്വയമായി പറയുന്നതോ മറ്റുള്ളവർ എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു നിന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Is that your own idea," Jesus asked, "or did others talk to you about me?"
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered him, "Are you speaking for yourself about this, or did others tell you this concerning Me?"
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അതിന്നു ഉത്തരമായി: ഞാൻ യെഹൂദനോ? നിന്റെ ജനവും മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും നിന്നെ നിന്റെ പക്കൽ ഏല്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നീ എന്തു ചെയ്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യേശു:
chapters.niv: "Am I a Jew?" Pilate replied. "Your own people and chief priests handed you over to me. What is it you have done?"
chapters.nkjv: Pilate answered, "Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered You to me. What have You done?"
chapters.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ രാജ്യം ഐഹികമല്ല; എന്നു എന്റെ രാജ്യം ഐഹികം ആയിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ എന്നെ യഹൂദന്മാരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കാതവണ്ണം എന്റെ ചേവകർ പോരാടുമായിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ എന്റെ രാജ്യം ഐഹികമല്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jewish leaders. But now my kingdom is from another place."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would fight, so that I should not be delivered to the Jews; but now My kingdom is not from here."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവനോടു: എന്നാൽ നീ രാജാവു തന്നേയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു യേശു: നീ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ ഞാൻ രാജാവുതന്നേ; സത്യത്തിന്നു സാക്ഷിനിൽക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ ജനിച്ചു അതിന്നായി ലോകത്തിൽ വന്നുമിരിക്കുന്നു; സത്യതല്പരനായവൻ എല്ലാം എന്റെ വാക്കുകേൾക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You are a king, then!" said Pilate. Jesus answered, "You say that I am a king. In fact, the reason I was born and came into the world is to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me."
chapters.nkjv: Pilate therefore said to Him, "Are You a king then?" Jesus answered, "You say rightly that I am a king. For this cause I was born, and for this cause I have come into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth hears My voice."
chapters.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് അവനോടു: സത്യം എന്നാൽ എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു പിന്നെയും യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ പുറത്തു ചെന്നു അവരോടു: ഞാൻ അവനിൽ ഒരു കുറ്റവും കാണുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: "What is truth?" retorted Pilate. With this he went out again to the Jews gathered there and said, "I find no basis for a charge against him.
chapters.nkjv: Pilate said to Him, "What is truth?" And when he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, "I find no fault in Him at all.
chapters.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all .

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പെസഹയിൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരുത്തനെ വിട്ടുതരിക പതിവുണ്ടല്ലോ; യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവിനെ വിട്ടുതരുന്നതു സമ്മതമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവർ പിന്നെയും:
chapters.niv: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release ‘the king of the Jews’?"
chapters.nkjv: "But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Do you therefore want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"
chapters.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

chapters.ml: ഇവനെ വേണ്ടാ; ബറബ്ബാസിനെ മതി എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു; ബറബ്ബാസോ കവർച്ചക്കാരൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They shouted back, "No, not him! Give us Barabbas!" Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.
chapters.nkjv: Then they all cried again, saying, "Not this Man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.
chapters.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

chapters.ml: (null)
അനന്തരം പീലാത്തൊസ് യേശുവിനെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി വാറുകൊണ്ടു അടിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
chapters.nkjv: So then Pilate took Jesus and scourged Him.
chapters.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him .

chapters.ml: പടയാളികൾ മുള്ളുകൊണ്ടു ഒരു കിരീടം മെടഞ്ഞു അവന്റെ തലയിൽ വെച്ചു ധൂമ്രവസ്ത്രം ധിരിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe
chapters.nkjv: And the soldiers twisted a crown of thorns and put it on His head, and they put on Him a purple robe.
chapters.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവേ, ജയ ജയ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ കന്നത്തടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and went up to him again and again, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!" And they slapped him in the face.
chapters.nkjv: Then they said, "Hail, King of the Jews!" And they struck Him with their hands.
chapters.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് പിന്നെയും പുറത്തു വന്നു: ഞാൻ അവനിൽ ഒരു കുറ്റവും കാണുന്നില്ല എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഇതാ, പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews gathered there, "Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him."
chapters.nkjv: Pilate then went out again, and said to them, "Behold, I am bringing Him out to you, that you may know that I find no fault in Him."
chapters.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യേശു മുൾക്കിരീടവും ധൂമ്രവസ്ത്രവും ധരിച്ചു പുറത്തു വന്നു. പീലാത്തൊസ് അവരോടു: ആ മനുഷ്യൻ ഇതാ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, "Here is the man!"
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said to them, "Behold the Man!"
chapters.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ചേവകരും അവനെ കണ്ടപ്പോൾ: ക്രൂശിക്ക, ക്രൂശിക്ക, എന്നു ആർത്തുവിളിച്ചു. പീലാത്തൊസ് അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി ക്രൂശിപ്പിൻ: ഞാനോ അവനിൽ കുറ്റം കാണുന്നില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" But Pilate answered, "You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when the chief priests and officers saw Him, they cried out, saying, "Crucify Him, crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "You take Him and crucify Him, for I find no fault in Him."
chapters.kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him : for I find no fault in him.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു ന്യായപ്രമാണം ഉണ്ടു; അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ ദൈവപുത്രൻ ആക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു ആ ന്യായപ്രമാണപ്രകാരം അവൻ മരിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Jewish leaders insisted, "We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God."
chapters.nkjv: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and according to our law He ought to die, because He made Himself the Son of God."
chapters.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു കേട്ടിട്ടു പീലാത്തൊസ് ഏറ്റവും ഭയപ്പെട്ടു,
chapters.niv: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when Pilate heard that saying, he was the more afraid,
chapters.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയും ആസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ ചെന്നു; നീ എവിടെ നിന്നു ആകുന്നു എന്നു യേശുവിനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and he went back inside the palace. "Where do you come from?" he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.
chapters.nkjv: and went again into the Praetorium, and said to Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus gave him no answer.
chapters.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

chapters.ml: യേശു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞില്ല. പീലാത്തൊസ് അവനോടു: നീ എന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്നില്ലയോ? എനിക്കു നിന്നെ ക്രൂശിപ്പാൻ അധികാരമുണ്ടെന്നും, നിന്നെ വിട്ടയപ്പാൻ അധികാരമുണ്ടെന്നും നീ അറിയുന്നില്ലയോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു യേശു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: "Do you refuse to speak to me?" Pilate said. "Don’t you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Pilate said to Him, "Are You not speaking to me? Do You not know that I have power to crucify You, and power to release You?"
chapters.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

chapters.ml: മേലിൽനിന്നു നിനക്കു കിട്ടീട്ടില്ല എങ്കിൽ എന്റെ മേൽ നിനക്കു ഒരധികാരവും ഉണ്ടാകയില്ലായിരുന്നു; അതുകൊണ്ടു എന്നെ നിന്റെ പക്കൽ ഏല്പിച്ചവന്നു അധികം പാപം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus answered, "You could have no power at all against Me unless it had been given you from above. Therefore the one who delivered Me to you has the greater sin."
chapters.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

chapters.ml: ഇതു നിമിത്തം പീലാത്തൊസ് അവനെ വിട്ടയപ്പാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു. യഹൂദന്മാരോ: നീ ഇവനെ വിട്ടയച്ചാൽ കൈസരുടെ സ്നേഹിതൻ അല്ല; തന്നെത്താൻ രാജാവാക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം കൈസരോടു മത്സരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു ആർത്തു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jewish leaders kept shouting, "If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar."
chapters.nkjv: From then on Pilate sought to release Him, but the Jews cried out, saying, "If you let this Man go, you are not Caesar’s friend. Whoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar."
chapters.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cæsar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു കേട്ടിട്ടു പീലാത്തൊസ് യേശുവിനെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു, കല്ത്തളമെന്നും എബ്രായ ഭാഷയിൽ ഗബ്ബഥാ എന്നും പേരുള്ള സ്ഥലത്തു ന്യായാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge’s seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).
chapters.nkjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus out and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
chapters.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പെസഹയുടെ ഒരുക്കനാൾ ഏകദേശം ആറാം മണിനേരം ആയിരുന്നു. അവൻ യെഹൂദന്മാരോടു ഇതാ നിങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: It was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about noon. "Here is your king," Pilate said to the Jews.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, and about the sixth hour. And he said to the Jews, "Behold your King!"
chapters.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

chapters.ml: അവരോ: കൊന്നുകളക, കൊന്നുകളക; അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്ക എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു. നിങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവിനെ ഞാൻ ക്രൂശിക്കേണമോ എന്നു പീലാത്തൊസ് അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചു; അതിന്നു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു കൈസരല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊരു രാജാവില്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But they shouted, "Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!" "Shall I crucify your king?" Pilate asked. "We have no king but Caesar," the chief priests answered.
chapters.nkjv: But they cried out, "Away with Him, away with Him! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar!"
chapters.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him , away with him , crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവനെ ക്രൂശിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Then he delivered Him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led Him away.
chapters.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

chapters.ml: അവർ യേശുവിനെ കയ്യേറ്റു; അവൻ താൻ തന്നേ ക്രൂശിനെ ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു എബ്രായഭാഷയിൽ ഗൊല്ഗൊഥാ എന്നു പേരുള്ള തലയോടിടം എന്ന സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).
chapters.nkjv: And He, bearing His cross, went out to a place called thePlace of a Skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha,
chapters.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

chapters.ml: അവിടെ അവർ അവനെയും അവനോടു കൂടെ വേറെ രണ്ടു ആളുകളെയും ഒരുത്തനെ അപ്പുറത്തും ഒരുത്തനെ ഇപ്പുറത്തും യേശുവിനെ നടവിലുമായി ക്രൂശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: There they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.
chapters.nkjv: where they crucified Him, and two others with Him, one on either side, and Jesus in the center.
chapters.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

chapters.ml: പീലാത്തൊസ് ഒരു മേലെഴുത്തും എഴുതി ക്രൂശിന്മേൽ പതിപ്പിച്ചു; അതിൽ: നസറായനായ യേശു യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവു എന്നു എഴുതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews.
chapters.nkjv: Now Pilate wrote a title and put it on the cross. And the writing was: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chapters.ml: യേശുവിനെ ക്രൂശിച്ച സ്ഥലം നഗരത്തിന്നു സമീപം ആകയാൽ അനേകം യെഹൂദന്മാർ ഈ മേലെഴുത്തു വായിച്ചു. അതു എബ്രായ റോമ യവന ഭാഷകളിൽ എഴുതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.
chapters.nkjv: Then many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin.
chapters.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാർ പീലാത്തൊസിനോടു: യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവു എന്നല്ല, ഞാൻ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ രാജാവു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു എന്നത്രേ എഴുതേണ്ടതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, "Do not write ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘He said, "I am the King of the Jews." ’ "
chapters.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പീലാത്തൊസ്: ഞാൻ എഴുതിയതു എഴുതി എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
chapters.nkjv: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
chapters.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

chapters.ml: പടയാളികൾ യേശുവിനെ ക്രൂശിച്ച ശേഷം അവന്റെ വസ്ത്രം എടുത്തു ഓരോ പടയാളിക്കു ഓരോ പങ്കായിട്ടു നാലു പങ്കാക്കി; അങ്കിയും എടുത്തു; അങ്കിയോ തുന്നൽ ഇല്ലാതെ മേൽതൊട്ടു അടിയോളം മുഴുവനും നെയ്തതായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
chapters.nkjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took His garments and made four parts, to each soldier a part, and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top in one piece.
chapters.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കീറരുതു; ആർക്കു വരും എന്നു ചീട്ടിടുക എന്നു അവർ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു. എന്റെ വസ്ത്രം അവർ പകുത്തെടുത്തു എന്റെ അങ്കിക്കായി ചീട്ടിട്ടു എന്നുള്ളതിരുവെഴുത്തിന്നു ഇതിനാൽ നിവൃത്തി വന്നു. പടയാളികൾ ഇങ്ങനെ ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: "Let’s not tear it," they said to one another. "Let’s decide by lot who will get it." This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled that said, "They divided my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment." So this is what the soldiers did.
chapters.nkjv: They said therefore among themselves, "Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be," that the Scripture might be fulfilled which says: "They divided My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots." Therefore the soldiers did these things.
chapters.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

chapters.ml: യേശുവിന്റെ ക്രൂശിന്നരികെ അവന്റെ അമ്മയും അമ്മയുടെ സഹോദരിയും ക്ളെയോപ്പാവിന്റെ ഭാര്യ മറിയയും മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയയും നിന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
chapters.nkjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus His mother, and His mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
chapters.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

chapters.ml: യേശു തന്റെ അമ്മയും താൻ സ്നേഹിച്ച ശിഷ്യനും നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു: സ്ത്രീയേ, ഇതാ നിന്റെ മകൻ എന്നു അമ്മയോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, "Woman, here is your son,"
chapters.nkjv: When Jesus therefore saw His mother, and the disciple whom He loved standing by, He said to His mother, "Woman, behold your son!"
chapters.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശിഷ്യനോടു: ഇതാ നിന്റെ അമ്മ എന്നും പറഞ്ഞു. ആ നാഴികമുതൽ ആ ശിഷ്യൻ അവളെ തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: and to the disciple, "Here is your mother." From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to the disciple, "Behold your mother!" And from that hour that disciple took her to his own home.
chapters.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം സകലവും തികഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യേശു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു തിരുവെഴുത്തു നിവൃത്തിയാകുംവണ്ണം: എനിക്കു ദാഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, "I am thirsty."
chapters.nkjv: After this, Jesus, knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, "I thirst!"
chapters.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ പുളിച്ച വീഞ്ഞു നിറഞ്ഞോരു പാത്രം വെച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവർ ഒരു സ്പോങ്ങ് പുളിച്ചവീഞ്ഞു നിറെച്ചു ഈസോപ്പുതണ്ടിന്മേൽ ആക്കി അവന്റെ വായോടു അടുപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus’ lips.
chapters.nkjv: Now a vessel full of sour wine was sitting there; and they filled a sponge with sour wine, put it on hyssop, and put it to His mouth.
chapters.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

chapters.ml: യേശു പുളിച്ചവീഞ്ഞു കുടിച്ചശേഷം: നിവൃത്തിയായി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തല ചായ്ച്ചു ആത്മാവിനെ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, "It is finished." With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
chapters.nkjv: So when Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished!" And bowing His head, He gave up His spirit.
chapters.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ഒരുക്കനാളും ആ ശബ്ബത്ത് നാൾ വലിയതും ആകകൊണ്ടു ശരീരങ്ങൾ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ ക്രൂശിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കരുതു എന്നുവെച്ചു അവരുടെ കാൽ ഒടിച്ചു എടുപ്പിക്കേണം എന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാർ പീലാത്തൊസിനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jewish leaders did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, because it was the Preparation Day, that the bodies should not remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a high day), the Jews asked Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
chapters.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ പടയാളികൾ വന്നു ഒന്നാമത്തവന്റെയും അവനോടുകൂടെ ക്രൂശിക്കപ്പെട്ട മറ്റെവന്റെയും കാൽ ഒടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.
chapters.nkjv: Then the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with Him.
chapters.kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

chapters.ml: അവർ യേശുവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു, അവൻ മരിച്ചുപോയി എന്നു കാൺകയാൽ അവന്റെ കാൽ ഒടിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
chapters.nkjv: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
chapters.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും പടയാളികളിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ കുന്തംകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ വിലാപ്പുറത്തു കുത്തി; ഉടനെ രക്തവും വെള്ളവും പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus’ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
chapters.nkjv: But one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
chapters.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കണ്ടവൻ സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം സത്യം ആകുന്നു; നിങ്ങളും വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു താൻ സത്യം പറയുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.
chapters.nkjv: And he who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows that he is telling the truth, so that you may believe.
chapters.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

chapters.ml: “അവന്റെ ഒരു അസ്ഥിയും ഒടിഞ്ഞുപോകയില്ല” എന്നുള്ള തിരുവെഴുത്തു നിവൃത്തിയാകേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇതു സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: "Not one of his bones will be broken,"
chapters.nkjv: For these things were done that the Scripture should be fulfilled, "Not one of His bones shall be broken."
chapters.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

chapters.ml: “അവർ കുത്തിയവങ്കലേക്കു നോക്കും” എന്നു മറ്റൊരു തിരുവെഴുത്തും പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and, as another scripture says, "They will look on the one they have pierced."
chapters.nkjv: And again another Scripture says, "They shall look on Him whom they pierced."
chapters.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം, യെഹൂദന്മാരെ പേടിച്ചിട്ടു രഹസ്യത്തിൽ യേശുവിന്റെ ഒരു ശിഷ്യനായിരുന്ന അരിമത്യയിലെ യോസേഫ് യേശുവിന്റെ ശരീരം എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകുവാൻ പീലാത്തൊസിനോടു അനുവാദം ചോദിച്ചു. പീലാത്തൊസ് അനുവദിക്കയാൽ അവൻ വന്നു അവന്റെ ശരീരം എടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jewish leaders. With Pilate’s permission, he came and took the body away.
chapters.nkjv: After this, Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly, for fear of the Jews, asked Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus; and Pilate gave him permission. So he came and took the body of Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

chapters.ml: ആദ്യം രാത്രിയിൽ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്ന നിക്കൊദേമൊസും ഏകദേശം നൂറുറാത്തൽ മൂറും അകിലും കൊണ്ടുള്ള ഒരു കൂട്ടു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
chapters.nkjv: And Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.
chapters.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight .

chapters.ml: അവർ യേശുവിന്റെ ശരീരം എടുത്തു യെഹൂദന്മാർ ശവം അടക്കുന്ന മര്യാദപ്രകാരം അതിനെ സുഗന്ധവർഗ്ഗത്തോടുകൂടെ ശീലപൊതിഞ്ഞു കെട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Taking Jesus’ body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.
chapters.nkjv: Then they took the body of Jesus, and bound it in strips of linen with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
chapters.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

chapters.ml: അവനെ ക്രൂശിച്ച സ്ഥലത്തുതന്നേ ഒരു തോട്ടവും ആ തോട്ടത്തിൽ മുമ്പെ ആരെയും വെച്ചിട്ടില്ലാത്ത പുതിയോരു കല്ലറയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
chapters.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

chapters.ml: ആ കല്ലറ സമീപം ആകകൊണ്ടു അവർ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഒരുക്കനാൾ നിമിത്തം യേശുവിനെ അവിടെ വച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
chapters.nkjv: So there they laid Jesus, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day, for the tomb was nearby.
chapters.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

chapters.ml: ആഴ്ചവട്ടത്തിൽ ഒന്നാം നാൾ മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയ രാവിലെ ഇരുട്ടുള്ളപ്പോൾ തന്നേ കല്ലറെക്കൽ ചെന്നു കല്ലറവായ്ക്കൽ നിന്നു കല്ലു നീങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
chapters.nkjv: Now on the first day of the week Mary Magdalene went to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
chapters.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഓടി ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസിന്റെയും യേശുവിന്നു പ്രിയനായ മറ്റെ ശിഷ്യന്റെയും അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: കർത്താവിനെ കല്ലറയിൽ നിന്നു എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവനെ എവിടെ വെച്ചു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have put him!"
chapters.nkjv: Then she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him."
chapters.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു പത്രൊസും മറ്റെ ശിഷ്യനും പുറപ്പെട്ടു കല്ലറെക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
chapters.nkjv: Peter therefore went out, and the other disciple, and were going to the tomb.
chapters.kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

chapters.ml: ഇരുവരും ഒന്നിച്ചു ഓടി; മറ്റെ ശിഷ്യൻ പത്രൊസിനെക്കാൾ വേഗത്തിൽ ഓടി ആദ്യം കല്ലെറക്കൽ എത്തി;
chapters.niv: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
chapters.nkjv: So they both ran together, and the other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
chapters.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

chapters.ml: കുനിഞ്ഞുനോക്കി ശീലകൾ കിടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അകത്തു കടന്നില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.
chapters.nkjv: And he, stooping down and looking in, saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he did not go in.
chapters.kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in , saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പിന്നാലെ ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസും വന്നു കല്ലറയിൽ കടന്നു
chapters.niv: Then Simon Peter came along behind him and went straight into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,
chapters.nkjv: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb; and he saw the linen cloths lying there,
chapters.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

chapters.ml: ശീലകൾ കിടക്കുന്നതും അവന്റെ തലയിൽ ചുറ്റിയിരുന്നറൂമാൽ ശീലകളോടുകൂടെ കിടക്കാതെ വേറിട്ടു ഒരിടത്തു ചുരുട്ടി വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: as well as the cloth that had been wrapped around Jesus’ head. The cloth was still lying in its place, separate from the linen.
chapters.nkjv: and the handkerchief that had been around His head, not lying with the linen cloths, but folded together in a place by itself.
chapters.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

chapters.ml: ആദ്യം കല്ലെറക്കൽ എത്തിയ മറ്റെ ശിഷ്യനും അപ്പോൾ അകത്തു ചെന്നു കണ്ടു വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.
chapters.nkjv: Then the other disciple, who came to the tomb first, went in also; and he saw and believed.
chapters.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേൽക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു എന്നുള്ള തിരുവെഴുത്തു അവർ അതുവരെ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)
chapters.nkjv: For as yet they did not know the Scripture, that He must rise again from the dead.
chapters.kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.
chapters.nkjv: Then the disciples went away again to their own homes.
chapters.kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ മറിയ കല്ലെറക്കൽ പുറത്തു കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു നിന്നു. കരയുന്നിടയിൽ അവൾ കല്ലറയിൽ കുനിഞ്ഞുനോക്കി.
chapters.niv: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb
chapters.nkjv: But Mary stood outside by the tomb weeping, and as she wept she stooped down andlooked into the tomb.
chapters.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

chapters.ml: യേശുവിന്റെ ശരീരം കിടന്നിരുന്ന ഇടത്തു വെള്ളവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ച രണ്ടു ദൂതന്മാർ ഒരുത്തൻ തലെക്കലും ഒരുത്തൻ കാൽക്കലും ഇരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus’ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.
chapters.nkjv: And she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
chapters.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവളോടു: സ്ത്രീയേ, നീ കരയുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. എന്റെ കർത്താവിനെ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവനെ എവിടെ വെച്ചു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല എന്നു അവൾ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They asked her, "Woman, why are you crying?" "They have taken my Lord away," she said, "and I don’t know where they have put him."
chapters.nkjv: Then they said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him."
chapters.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൾ പിന്നോക്കം തിരിഞ്ഞു, യേശു നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു; യേശു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞില്ല താനും.
chapters.niv: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Now when she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, and did not know that it was Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: സ്ത്രീയേ, നീ കരയുന്നതു എന്തു? ആരെ തിരയുന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അവൻ തോട്ടക്കാരൻ എന്നു നിരൂപിച്ചിട്ടു അവൾ: യജമാനനേ, നീ അവനെ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു പോയി എങ്കിൽ അവനെ എവിടെ വെച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുതരിക; ഞാൻ അവനെ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപൊയ്ക്കൊള്ളാം എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He asked her, "Woman, why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?" Thinking he was the gardener, she said, "Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?" She, supposing Him to be the gardener, said to Him, "Sir, if You have carried Him away, tell me where You have laid Him, and I will take Him away."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവളോടു: മറിയയേ, എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൾ തിരിഞ്ഞു എബ്രായഭാഷയിൽ: റബ്ബൂനി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, "Rabboni!" (which means "Teacher").
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Mary!" She turned and said to Him, "Rabboni!" (which is to say, Teacher).
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഗുരു എന്നർത്ഥം. യേശു അവളോടു: എന്നെ തൊടരുതു; ഞാൻ ഇതുവരെ പിതാവിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കയറിപ്പോയില്ല; എങ്കിലും നീ എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു: എന്റെ പിതാവും നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവും എന്റെ ദൈവവും നിങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവവുമായവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ഞാൻ കയറിപ്പോകുന്നു എന്നു അവരോടു പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said, "Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to her, "Do not cling to Me, for I have not yet ascended to My Father; but go to My brethren and say to them, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, and to My God and your God.’ "
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

chapters.ml: മഗ്ദലക്കാരത്തി മറിയ വന്നു താൻ കർത്താവിനെ കണ്ടു എന്നും അവൻ ഇങ്ങനെ തന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നും ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: "I have seen the Lord!" And she told them that he had said these things to her.
chapters.nkjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that He had spoken these things to her.
chapters.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

chapters.ml: ആഴ്ചവട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം നാൾ ആയ ആ ദിവസം, നേരംവൈകിയപ്പോൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ ഇരുന്ന സ്ഥലത്തു യെഹൂദന്മാരെ പേടിച്ചു വാതിൽ അടെച്ചിരിക്കെ യേശു വന്നു നടുവിൽ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമാധാനം എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jewish leaders, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"
chapters.nkjv: Then, the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, "Peace be with you."
chapters.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ കയ്യും വിലാപ്പുറവും അവരെ കാണിച്ചു; കർത്താവിനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ സന്തോഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

chapters.ml: യേശു പിന്നെയും അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമാധാനം; പിതാവു എന്നെ അയച്ചതുപോലെ ഞാനും നിങ്ങളെ അയക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Again Jesus said, "Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you."
chapters.nkjv: So Jesus said to them again, "Peace to you! As the Father has sent Me, I also send you."
chapters.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞശേഷം അവൻ അവരുടെമേൽ ഊതി അവരോടു: പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനെ കൈക്കൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: And with that he breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: And when He had said this, He breathed on them, and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
chapters.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them , and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

chapters.ml: ആരുടെ പാപങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങൾ മോചിക്കുന്നവോ അവർക്കു മോചിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; ആരുടെ പാപങ്ങൾ നിർത്തുന്നുവോ അവർക്കു നിർത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: If you forgive anyone’s sins, their sins are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven."
chapters.nkjv: If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained."
chapters.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യേശു വന്നപ്പോൾ പന്തിരുവരിൽ ഒരുവനായ ദിദിമൊസ് എന്ന തോമാസ് അവരോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus ), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
chapters.nkjv: Now Thomas, called the Twin, one of the twelve, was not with them when Jesus came.
chapters.kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

chapters.ml: മറ്റേ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനോടു: ഞങ്ങൾ കർത്താവിനെ കണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞാറെ: ഞാൻ അവന്റെ കൈകളിൽ ആണിപ്പഴുതു കാണുകയും ആണിപ്പഴുതിൽ വിരൽ ഇടുകയും അവന്റെ വിലാപ്പുറത്തു കൈ ഇടുകയും ചെയ്തിട്ടല്ലാതെ വിശ്വസിക്കയില്ല എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe."
chapters.nkjv: The other disciples therefore said to him, "We have seen the Lord." So he said to them, "Unless I see in His hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into His side, I will not believe."
chapters.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

chapters.ml: എട്ടു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പിന്നെയും അകത്തു കൂടിയിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തോമാസും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. വാതിൽ അടെച്ചിരിക്കെ യേശു വന്നു നടുവിൽ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു: നിങ്ങൾക്കു സമാധാനം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"
chapters.nkjv: And after eight days His disciples were again inside, and Thomas with them. Jesus came, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, "Peace to you!"
chapters.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ തോമാസിനോടു: നിന്റെ വിരൽ ഇങ്ങോട്ടു നീട്ടി എന്റെ കൈകളെ കാൺക; നിന്റെ കൈ നീട്ടി എന്റെ വിലാപ്പുറത്തു ഇടുക; അവിശ്വാസി ആകാതെ വിശ്വാസിയായിരിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then he said to Thomas, "Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe."
chapters.nkjv: Then He said to Thomas, "Reach your finger here, and look at My hands; and reach your hand here, and put it into My side. Do not be unbelieving, but believing."
chapters.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

chapters.ml: തോമാസ് അവനോടു: എന്റെ കർത്താവും എന്റെ ദൈവവും ആയുള്ളോവേ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Thomas said to him, "My Lord and my God!"
chapters.nkjv: And Thomas answered and said to Him, "My Lord and my God!"
chapters.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: നീ എന്നെ കണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടു വിശ്വസിച്ചു; കാണാതെ വിശ്വസിച്ചവർ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Jesus told him, "Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "Thomas, because you have seen Me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

chapters.ml: ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതല്ലാതെ മറ്റു അനേകം അടയാളങ്ങളും യേശു തന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കാൺകെ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.
chapters.nkjv: And truly Jesus did many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book;
chapters.kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ യേശു ദൈവപുത്രനായ ക്രിസ്തുഎന്നു നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും വിശ്വസിച്ചിട്ടു അവന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ജീവൻ ഉണ്ടാകേണ്ടതിന്നും ഇതു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.
chapters.nkjv: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in His name.
chapters.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ ശേഷം യേശു പിന്നെയും തിബെര്യാസ് കടൽക്കരയിൽ വെച്ചു ശിഷ്യന്മാർക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി; പ്രത്യക്ഷനായതു ഈ വിധം ആയിരുന്നു:
chapters.niv: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Galilee. It happened this way:
chapters.nkjv: After these things Jesus showed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias, and in this way He showed Himself:
chapters.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself .

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസും ദിദിമൊസ് എന്ന തോമാസും ഗലീലയിലുള്ള കാനയിലെ നഥനയേലും സെബെദിമക്കളും അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ വേറെ രണ്ടുപേരും ഒരുമിച്ചു കൂടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Simon Peter, Thomas (also known as Didymus ), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
chapters.nkjv: Simon Peter, Thomas called the Twin, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together.
chapters.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ് അവരോടു: ഞാൻ മീൻ പിടിപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; ഞങ്ങളും പോരുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു. അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടു പടകു കയറി പോയി; ആ രാത്രിയിൽ ഒന്നും പിടിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: "I’m going out to fish," Simon Peter told them, and they said, "We’ll go with you." So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.
chapters.nkjv: Simon Peter said to them, "I am going fishing." They said to him, "We are going with you also." They went out and immediately got into the boat, and that night they caught nothing.
chapters.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

chapters.ml: പുലർച്ച ആയപ്പോൾ യേശു കരയിൽ നിന്നിരുന്നു; യേശു ആകുന്നു എന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അറിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: But when the morning had now come, Jesus stood on the shore; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
chapters.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളേ, കൂട്ടുവാൻ വല്ലതും ഉണ്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു; ഇല്ല എന്നു അവർ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He called out to them, "Friends, haven’t you any fish?" "No," they answered.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Children, have you any food?" They answered Him, "No."
chapters.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

chapters.ml: പടകിന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു വല വീശുവിൻ; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു കിട്ടും എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു; അവർ വീശി, മീനിന്റെ പെരുപ്പം ഹേതുവായി അതു വലിപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: He said, "Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some." When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." So they cast, and now they were not able to draw it in because of the multitude of fish.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

chapters.ml: യേശു സ്നേഹിച്ച ശിഷ്യൻ പത്രൊസിനോടു: അതു കർത്താവു ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; കർത്താവു ആകുന്നു എന്നു ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ് കേട്ടിട്ടു, താൻ നഗ്നനാകയാൽ അങ്കി അരയിൽ ചുറ്റി കടലിൽ ചാടി.
chapters.niv: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, "It is the Lord," he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it), and plunged into the sea.
chapters.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him , (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

chapters.ml: ശേഷം ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കരയിൽ നിന്നു ഏകദേശം ഇരുനൂറു മുഴത്തിൽ അധികം ദൂരത്തല്ലായ്കയാൽ മീൻ നിറഞ്ഞ വല ഇഴെച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു ചെറിയ പടകിൽ വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.
chapters.nkjv: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from land, but about two hundred cubits), dragging the net with fish.
chapters.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

chapters.ml: കരെക്കു ഇറെങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ അവർ തീക്കനലും അതിന്മേൽ മീൻ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതും അപ്പവും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.
chapters.nkjv: Then, as soon as they had come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.
chapters.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: ഇപ്പോൾ പിടിച്ച മീൻ ചിലതു കൊണ്ടുവരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish you have just caught."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish which you have just caught."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസ് കയറി നൂറ്റമ്പത്തുമൂന്നു വലിയ മീൻ നിറഞ്ഞ വല കരെക്കു വലിച്ചു കയറ്റി; അത്ര വളരെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നിട്ടും വല കീറിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: So Simon Peter climbed back into the boat and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.
chapters.nkjv: Simon Peter went up and dragged the net to land, full of large fish, one hundred and fifty-three; and although there were so many, the net was not broken.
chapters.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

chapters.ml: യേശു അവരോടു: വന്നു പ്രാതൽ കഴിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; കർത്താവാകുന്നു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തനും: നീ ആർ എന്നു അവനോടു ചോദിപ്പാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: Jesus said to them, "Come and have breakfast." None of the disciples dared ask him, "Who are you?" They knew it was the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to them, "Come and eat breakfast." Yet none of the disciples dared ask Him, "Who are You?"—knowing that it was the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

chapters.ml: യേശു വന്നു അപ്പം എടുത്തു അവർക്കു കൊടുത്തു; മീനും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ യേശു മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റശേഷം ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നാം പ്രാവശ്യം ശിഷ്യന്മാർക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus then came and took the bread and gave it to them, and likewise the fish.
chapters.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

chapters.ml: യേശു മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റശേഷം ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നാംപ്രവാശ്യം ശിഷ്യന്മാർക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.
chapters.nkjv: This is now the third time Jesus showed Himself to His disciples after He was raised from the dead.
chapters.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

chapters.ml: അവർ പ്രാതൽ കഴിച്ചശേഷം യേശു ശിമോൻ പത്രൊസിനോടു: യോഹന്നാന്റെ മകനായ ശിമോനേ, നീ ഇവരിൽ അധികമായി എന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൻ: ഉവ്വു, കർത്താവേ, എനിക്കു നിന്നോടു പ്രിയമുണ്ടു എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്റെ കുഞ്ഞാടുകളെ മേയ്ക്ക എന്നു അവൻ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they had finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon son of John, do you love me more than these?" "Yes, Lord," he said, "you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Feed my lambs."
chapters.nkjv: So when they had eaten breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me more than these?" He said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He said to him, "Feed My lambs."
chapters.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമതും അവനോടു: യോഹന്നാന്റെ മകനായ ശിമോനേ, നീ എന്നെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അതിന്നു അവൻ ഉവ്വു കർത്താവേ, എനിക്കു നിന്നോടു പ്രിയമുണ്ടു എന്നു നീ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. എന്റെ ആടുകളെ പാലിക്ക എന്നു അവൻ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Again Jesus said, "Simon son of John, do you love me?" He answered, "Yes, Lord, you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Take care of my sheep."
chapters.nkjv: He said to him again a second time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" He said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He said to him, "Tend My sheep."
chapters.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമതും അവനോടു: യോഹന്നാന്റെ മകനായ ശിമോനേ, നിനക്കു എന്നോടു പ്രിയമുണ്ടോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. എന്നോടു പ്രിയമുണ്ടോ എന്നു മൂന്നാമതും ചോദിക്കയാൽ പത്രൊസ് ദുഃഖിച്ചു: കർത്താവേ, നീ സകലവും അറിയുന്നു; എനിക്കു നിന്നോടു പ്രിയമുണ്ടു എന്നും നീ അറിയുന്നു എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു. യേശു അവനോടു: എന്റെ ആടുകളെ മേയ്ക്ക.
chapters.niv: The third time he said to him, "Simon son of John, do you love me?" Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, "Do you love me?" He said, "Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Feed my sheep.
chapters.nkjv: He said to him the third time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" Peter was grieved because He said to him the third time, "Do you love Me?" And he said to Him, "Lord, You know all things; You know that I love You." Jesus said to him, "Feed My sheep.
chapters.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

chapters.ml: ആമേൻ, ആമേൻ, ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു പറയുന്നു: നീ യൌവനക്കാരൻ ആയിരുന്നപ്പോൾ നീ തന്നേ അര കെട്ടി ഇഷ്ടമുള്ളേടത്തു നടന്നു; വയസ്സനായശേഷമോ നീ കൈ നീട്ടുകയും മറ്റൊരുത്തൻ നിന്റെ അര കെട്ടി നിനക്കു ഇഷ്ടമില്ലാത്ത ഇടത്തേക്കു നിന്നെ കൊണ്ടുപോകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Very truly I tell you, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go."
chapters.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, when you were younger, you girded yourself and walked where you wished; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will gird you and carry you where you do not wish."
chapters.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

chapters.ml: അതിനാൽ അവൻ ഇന്നവിധം മരണം കൊണ്ടു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തും എന്നു അവൻ സൂചിപ്പിച്ചു; ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു: എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക എന്നു അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, "Follow me!"
chapters.nkjv: This He spoke, signifying by what death he would glorify God. And when He had spoken this, He said to him, "Follow Me."
chapters.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് തിരിഞ്ഞു യേശു സ്നേഹിച്ച ശിഷ്യൻ പിൻചെല്ലുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അത്താഴത്തിൽ അവന്റെ നെഞ്ചോടു ചാഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു: കർത്താവേ, നിന്നെ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതു ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, "Lord, who is going to betray you?")
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter, turning around, saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also had leaned on His breast at the supper, and said, "Lord, who is the one who betrays You?"
chapters.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

chapters.ml: അവനെ പത്രൊസ് കണ്ടിട്ടു: കർത്താവേ, ഇവന്നു എന്തു ഭവിക്കും എന്നു യേശുവിനോടു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Peter saw him, he asked, "Lord, what about him?"
chapters.nkjv: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, "But Lord, what about this man?"
chapters.kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do ?

chapters.ml: യേശു അവനോടു: ഞാൻ വരുവോളം ഇവൻ ഇരിക്കേണമെന്നു എനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടം ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതു നിനക്കു എന്തു? നീ എന്നെ അനുഗമിക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Jesus answered, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me."
chapters.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "If I will that he remain till I come, what is that to you? You follow Me."
chapters.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ആ ശിഷ്യൻ മരിക്കയില്ല എന്നൊരു ശ്രുതി സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ ഇടയിൽ പരന്നു. യേശുവോ: അവൻ മരിക്കയില്ല എന്നല്ല, ഞാൻ വരുവോളം ഇവൻ ഇരിക്കേണം എന്നു എനിക്കു ഇഷ്ടമുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതു നിനക്കു എന്തു എന്നത്രേ അവനോടു പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: Because of this, the rumor spread among the believers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?"
chapters.nkjv: Then this saying went out among the brethren that this disciple would not die. Yet Jesus did not say to him that he would not die, but, "If I will that he remain till I come, what is that to you?"
chapters.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

chapters.ml: ഈ ശിഷ്യൻ ഇതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നവനും ഇതു എഴുതിയവനും ആകുന്നു; അവന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം സത്യം എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.
chapters.nkjv: This is the disciple who testifies of these things, and wrote these things; and we know that his testimony is true.
chapters.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

chapters.ml: യേശു ചെയ്തതു മറ്റു പലതും ഉണ്ടു; അതു ഓരോന്നായി എഴുതിയാൽ എഴുതിയ പുസ്തകങ്ങൾ ലോകത്തിൽ തന്നേയും ഒതുങ്ങുകയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ നിരൂപിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.
chapters.nkjv: And there are also many other things that Jesus did, which if they were written one by one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that would be written. Amen.
chapters.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

chapters.ml: തെയോഫിലൊസേ, ഞാൻ എഴുതിയ ഒന്നാമത്തെ ചരിത്രം യേശു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർക്കു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനാൽ കല്പന കൊടുത്തിട്ടു ആരോഹണം ചെയ്തനാൾവരെ അവൻ ചെയ്തും ഉപദേശിച്ചും തുടങ്ങിയ സകലത്തെയും കുറിച്ചു ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach
chapters.nkjv: The former account I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
chapters.kjv: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

chapters.ml: അവൻ കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിച്ചശേഷം നാല്പതു നാളോളം അവർക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി ദൈവരാജ്യം സംബന്ധിച്ച കാര്യങ്ങൾ
chapters.niv: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.
chapters.nkjv: until the day in which He was taken up, after He through the Holy Spirit had given commandments to the apostles whom He had chosen,
chapters.kjv: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

chapters.ml: പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു താൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അനേകം ദൃഷ്ടാന്തങ്ങളാൽ അവർക്കു കാണിച്ചു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: After his suffering, he presented himself to them and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
chapters.nkjv: to whom He also presented Himself alive after His suffering by many infallible proofs, being seen by them during forty days and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God.
chapters.kjv: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ അവരുമായി കൂടിയിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ യെരൂശലേമിൽനിന്നു വാങ്ങിപ്പോകാതെ എന്നോടു കേട്ട പിതാവിന്റെ വാഗ്ദത്തത്തിനായി കാത്തിരിക്കേണം;
chapters.niv: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: "Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.
chapters.nkjv: And being assembled together with them, He commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the Promise of the Father, "which,"Hesaid,"you have heard from Me;
chapters.kjv: And, being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he , ye have heard of me.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടു സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചു. നിങ്ങൾക്കോ ഇനി ഏറെനാൾ കഴിയുംമുമ്പെ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവുകൊണ്ടു സ്നാനം ലഭിക്കും എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit."
chapters.nkjv: for John truly baptized with water, but you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now."
chapters.kjv: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

chapters.ml: ഒരുമിച്ചു കൂടിയിരുന്നപ്പോൾ അവർ അവനോടു: കർത്താവേ, നീ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു ഈ കാലത്തിലോ രാജ്യം യഥാസ്ഥാനത്താക്കിക്കൊടുക്കുന്നതു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they gathered around him and asked him, "Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked Him, saying, "Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?"
chapters.kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരോടു: പിതാവു തന്റെ സ്വന്ത അധികാരത്തിൽ വെച്ചിട്ടുള്ള കാലങ്ങളെയോ സമയങ്ങളേയോ അറിയുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതല്ല.
chapters.niv: He said to them: "It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.
chapters.nkjv: And He said to them, "It is not for you to know times or seasons which the Father has put in His own authority.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ വരുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾ ശക്തി ലഭിച്ചിട്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലും യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ എല്ലാടത്തും ശമര്യയിലും ഭൂമിയുടെ അറ്റത്തോളവും എന്റെ സാക്ഷികൾ ആകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."
chapters.nkjv: But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be witnesses to Me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth."
chapters.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പറഞ്ഞശേഷം അവർ കാൺകെ അവൻ ആരോഹണം ചെയ്തു; ഒരു മേഘം അവനെ മൂടീട്ടു അവൻ അവരുടെ കാഴ്ചെക്കു മറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.
chapters.nkjv: Now when He had spoken these things, while they watched, He was taken up, and a cloud received Him out of their sight.
chapters.kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പോകുന്നേരം അവർ ആകാശത്തിലേക്കു ഉറ്റുനോക്കുമ്പോൾ വെള്ള വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ച രണ്ടു പുരുഷന്മാർ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽനിന്നു:
chapters.niv: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
chapters.nkjv: And while they looked steadfastly toward heaven as He went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel,
chapters.kjv: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

chapters.ml: ഗലീലാപുരുഷന്മാരേ, നിങ്ങൾ ആകാശത്തിലേക്കു നോക്കിനില്ക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? നിങ്ങളെ വിട്ടു സ്വർഗ്ഗാരോഹണം ചെയ്ത ഈ യേശുവിനെ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കു പോകുന്നവനായി നിങ്ങൾ കണ്ടതുപോലെ തന്നേ അവൻ വീണ്ടും വരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Men of Galilee," they said, "why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven."
chapters.nkjv: who also said, "Men of Galilee, why do you stand gazing up into heaven? This same Jesus, who was taken up from you into heaven, will so come in like manner as you saw Him go into heaven."
chapters.kjv: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

chapters.ml: അവർ യെരൂശലേമിന്നു സമീപത്തു ഒരു ശബ്ബത്ത് ദിവസത്തെ വഴിദൂരമുള്ള ഒലീവ് മലവിട്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day’s walk from the city.
chapters.nkjv: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey.
chapters.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവർ പാർത്ത മാളികമുറിയിൽ കയറിപ്പോയി, പത്രൊസ്, യോഹന്നാൻ, യാക്കോബ്, അന്ത്രെയാസ്, ഫിലിപ്പൊസ്, തോമസ്, ബർത്തൊലൊമായി, മത്തായി, അൽഫായുടെ മകനായ യക്കോബ്, എരിവുകരനായ ശിമോൻ, യാക്കോബിന്റെ മകനായ യൂദാ ഇവർ എല്ലാവരും
chapters.niv: When they arrived, they went upstairs to the room where they were staying. Those present were Peter, John, James and Andrew; Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew; James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had entered, they went up into the upper room where they were staying: Peter, James, John, and Andrew; Philip and Thomas; Bartholomew and Matthew; James theson of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot; and Judas theson of James.
chapters.kjv: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീകളോടും യേശുവിന്റെ അമ്മയായ മറിയയോടും അവന്റേ സഹോദരന്മാരോടും കൂടെ ഒരുമനപ്പെട്ടു പ്രാർത്ഥന കഴിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
chapters.nkjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
chapters.kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഏകദേശം നൂറ്റിരുപതു പേരുള്ള ഒരു സംഘം കൂടിയിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ നടുവിൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റുനിന്നു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)
chapters.nkjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples (altogether the number of names was about a hundred and twenty), and said,
chapters.kjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരായ പുരുഷന്മാരേ, യേശുവിനെ പിടിച്ചവർക്കു വഴികാട്ടിയായിത്തീർന്ന യൂദയെക്കുറിച്ചു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ദാവീദ് മുഖാന്തരം മുൻപറഞ്ഞ തിരുവെഴുത്തിന്നു നിവൃത്തിവരുവാൻ ആവശ്യമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and said, "Brothers and sisters, the Scripture had to be fulfilled in which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: "Men and brethren, this Scripture had to be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide to those who arrested Jesus;
chapters.kjv: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ടവനായി ഈ ശുശ്രൂഷയിൽ പങ്കുലഭിച്ചിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: He was one of our number and shared in our ministry."
chapters.nkjv: for he was numbered with us and obtained a part in this ministry."
chapters.kjv: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അനീതിയുടെ കൂലികൊണ്ടു ഒരു നിലം മേടിച്ചു തലകീഴായി വീണു നടുവെ പിളർന്നു അവന്റെ കുടലെല്ലാം തുറിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: (With the payment he received for his wickedness, Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines spilled out.
chapters.nkjv: (Now this man purchased a field with the wages of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst open in the middle and all his entrails gushed out.
chapters.kjv: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

chapters.ml: അതു യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരും അറിഞ്ഞതാകകൊണ്ടു ആ നിലത്തിന്നു അവരുടെ ഭാഷയിൽ രക്തനിലം എന്നർത്ഥമുള്ള അക്കൽദാമാ എന്നു പേർ ആയി.
chapters.niv: Everyone in Jerusalem heard about this, so they called that field in their language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
chapters.nkjv: And it became known to all those dwelling in Jerusalem; so that field is called in their own language, Akel Dama, that is, Field of Blood.)
chapters.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

chapters.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനപുസ്തകത്തിൽ: “അവന്റെ വാസസ്ഥലം ശുന്യമായിപ്പോകട്ടെ; അതിൽ ആരും പാർക്കാതിരിക്കട്ടെ” എന്നും “അവന്റെ അദ്ധ്യക്ഷസ്ഥാനം മാറ്റൊരുത്തന്നു ലഭിക്കട്ടെ” എന്നും എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "For," said Peter, "it is written in the Book of Psalms: " ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, " ‘May another take his place of leadership.’
chapters.nkjv: "For it is written in the Book of Psalms: ‘Let his dwelling place be desolate, And let no one live in it’; and, ‘Let another take his office.’
chapters.kjv: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ കർത്താവായ യേശു യോഹന്നാന്റെ സ്നാനം മുതൽ നമ്മെ വിട്ടു ആരോഹണം ചെയ്ത നാൾ വരെ നമ്മുടെ ഇടയിൽ സഞ്ചരിച്ചുപോന്ന
chapters.niv: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have been with us the whole time the Lord Jesus was living among us,
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore, of these men who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

chapters.ml: കാലത്തെല്ലൊം ഞങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ നടന്ന പുരുഷന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ഞങ്ങളോടു കൂടെ അവന്റെ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിനു സാക്ഷിയായിത്തീരേണം.
chapters.niv: beginning from John’s baptism to the time when Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of his resurrection."
chapters.nkjv: beginning from the baptism of John to that day when He was taken up from us, one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection."
chapters.kjv: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ യുസ്തൊസ് എന്നു മറുപേരുള്ള ബർശബാ എന്ന യോസേഫ്, മത്ഥിയാസ് എന്നീ രണ്ടുപേരെ നിറുത്തി:
chapters.niv: So they nominated two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
chapters.nkjv: And they proposed two: Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
chapters.kjv: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

chapters.ml: സകല ഹൃദയങ്ങളെയും അറിയുന്ന കർത്താവേ, തന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു പോകേണ്ടതിന്നു യൂദാ ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോയ ഈ ശുശ്രൂഷയുടെയും അപ്പൊസ്തലത്വത്തിന്റെയും സ്ഥാനം ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു
chapters.niv: Then they prayed, "Lord, you know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two you have chosen
chapters.nkjv: And they prayed and said, "You, O Lord, who know the hearts of all, show which of these two You have chosen
chapters.kjv: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

chapters.ml: ഈ ഇരുവരിൽ ഏവനെ നീ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കാണിച്ചുതരേണമേ എന്നു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു അവരുടെ പേർക്കു ചീട്ടിട്ടു:
chapters.niv: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs."
chapters.nkjv: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place."
chapters.kjv: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

chapters.ml: ചീട്ടു മത്ഥിയാസിന്നു വീഴുകയും അവനെ പതിനൊന്നു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിൽ എണ്ണുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.
chapters.nkjv: And they cast their lots, and the lot fell on Matthias. And he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
chapters.kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

chapters.ml: പെന്തെക്കൊസ്തനാൾ വന്നപ്പോൾ എല്ലാവരും ഒരു സ്ഥലത്തു ഒന്നിച്ചു കൂടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
chapters.nkjv: When the Day of Pentecost had fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
chapters.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു കൊടിയ കാറ്റടിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ആകാശത്തനിന്നു ഒരു മുഴക്കം ഉണ്ടായി, അവർ ഇരുന്നിരുന്ന വീടു മുഴുവനും നിറെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Suddenly a sound like the blowing of a violent wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
chapters.nkjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
chapters.kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

chapters.ml: അഗ്നിജ്വാലപോലെ പിളർന്നിരിക്കുന്ന നാവുകൾ അവർക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷമായി അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്റെ മേൽ പതിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
chapters.nkjv: Then there appeared to them divided tongues, as of fire, and one sat upon each of them.
chapters.kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിറഞ്ഞവരായി ആത്മാവു അവർക്കു ഉച്ചരിപ്പാൻ നല്കിയതുപോലെ അന്യഭാഷകളിൽ സംസാരിച്ചു തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
chapters.nkjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
chapters.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ആകാശത്തിൻ കീഴുള്ള സകല ജാതികളിൽ നിന്നും യെരൂശലേമിൽ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന യെഹൂദന്മാരായ ഭക്തിയുള്ള പുരുഷന്മാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
