chapters.niv: Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
chapters.nkjv: And there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under heaven.
chapters.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

chapters.ml: ഈ മുഴക്കം ഉണ്ടായപ്പോൾ പുരുഷാരം വന്നു കൂടി, ഓരോരുത്തൻ താന്താന്റെ ഭാഷയിൽ അവർ സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു കേട്ടു അമ്പരന്നു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When they heard this sound, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard their own language being spoken.
chapters.nkjv: And when this sound occurred, the multitude came together, and were confused, because everyone heard them speak in his own language.
chapters.kjv: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും ഭ്രമിച്ചു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു: ഈ സംസാരിക്കുന്നവർ എല്ലാം ഗലീലക്കാർ അല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Utterly amazed, they asked: "Aren’t all these who are speaking Galileans?
chapters.nkjv: Then they were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, "Look, are not all these who speak Galileans?
chapters.kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilæans?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ നാം ഓരോരുത്തൻ ജനിച്ച നമ്മുടെ സ്വന്ത ഭാഷയിൽ അവർ സംസാരിച്ചു കേൾക്കുന്നതു എങ്ങനെ?
chapters.niv: Then how is it that each of us hears them in our native language?
chapters.nkjv: And how isitthat we hear, each in our own language in which we were born?
chapters.kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

chapters.ml: പർത്ഥരും മേദ്യരും ഏലാമ്യരും മെസപ്പൊത്താമ്യയിലും യെഹൂദ്യയിലും കപ്പദോക്യയിലും
chapters.niv: Parthians, Medes and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
chapters.nkjv: Parthians and Medes and Elamites, those dwelling in Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
chapters.kjv: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judæa, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

chapters.ml: പൊന്തൊസിലും ആസ്യയിലും പ്രുഗ്യയിലും പംഫുല്യയിലും മിസ്രയീമിലും കുറേനെക്കു ചേർന്ന ലിബ്യാപ്രദേശങ്ങളിലും പാർക്കുന്നവരും റോമയിൽ നിന്നു വന്നു പാർക്കുന്നവരും യെഹൂദന്മാരും യെഹൂദമതാനുസാരികളും ക്രേത്യരും അറബിക്കാരുമായ നാം
chapters.niv: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome
chapters.nkjv: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya adjoining Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
chapters.kjv: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

chapters.ml: ഈ നമ്മുടെ ഭാഷകളിൽ അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വൻകാര്യങ്ങളെ പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്നതു കേൾക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: (both Jews and converts to Judaism); Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!"
chapters.nkjv: Cretans and Arabs—we hear them speaking in our own tongues the wonderful works of God."
chapters.kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും ഭ്രമിച്ചു ചഞ്ചലിച്ചു; ഇതു എന്തായിരിക്കും എന്നു തമ്മിൽ തമ്മിൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, "What does this mean?"
chapters.nkjv: So they were all amazed and perplexed, saying to one another, "Whatever could this mean?"
chapters.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

chapters.ml: ഇവർ പുതു വീഞ്ഞു കുടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു മറ്റു ചിലർ പരിഹസിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some, however, made fun of them and said, "They have had too much wine."
chapters.nkjv: Others mocking said, "They are full of new wine."
chapters.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് പതിനൊന്നുപേരോടുകൂടെ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു ഉറക്കെ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യെഹൂദാപുരുഷന്മാരും യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവരുമായുള്ളോരേ, ഇതു നിങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കട്ടെ; എന്റെ വാക്കു ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: "Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.
chapters.nkjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, raised his voice and said to them, "Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and heed my words.
chapters.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ഊഹിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ ഇവർ ലഹരി പിടിച്ചവരല്ല; പകൽ മൂന്നാംമണിനേരമേ ആയിട്ടുള്ളുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: These people are not drunk, as you suppose. It’s only nine in the morning!
chapters.nkjv: For these are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only the third hour of the day.
chapters.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

chapters.ml: ഇതു യോവേൽ പ്രവാചകൻ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതത്രേ; അതെന്തെന്നാൽ:
chapters.niv: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
chapters.nkjv: But this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
chapters.kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

chapters.ml: “അന്ത്യകാലത്തു ഞാൻ സകല ജഡത്തിന്മേലും എന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെ പകരും; നിങ്ങളുടെ പുത്രന്മാരും പുത്രിമാരും പ്രവചിക്കും; നിങ്ങളുടെ യൌവ്വനക്കാർ ദർശനങ്ങൾ ദർശിക്കും; നിങ്ങളുടെ വൃദ്ധന്മാർ സ്വപ്നങ്ങൾ കാണും.”
chapters.niv: " ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
chapters.nkjv: ‘And it shall come to pass in the last days, says God, That I will pour out of My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your young men shall see visions, Your old men shall dream dreams.
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെമേലും ദാസിമാരുടെമേലും കൂടെ ഞാൻ ആ നാളുകളിൽ എന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെ പകരും; അവരും പ്രവചിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
chapters.nkjv: And on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days; And they shall prophesy.
chapters.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ മീതെ ആകാശത്തിൽ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും താഴെ ഭൂമിയിൽ അടയാളങ്ങളും കാണിക്കും; രക്തവും തീയും പുകയാവിയും തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
chapters.nkjv: I will show wonders in heaven above And signs in the earth beneath: Blood and fire and vapor of smoke.
chapters.kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ വലുതും പ്രസിദ്ധവുമായ നാൾ വരുംമുമ്പേ സൂര്യൻ ഇരുളായും ചന്ദ്രൻ രക്തമായും മാറിപ്പോകും.
chapters.niv: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the coming of the great and awesome day of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കർത്താവിന്റെ നാമം വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നവൻ ഏവനും രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടും എന്നു ദൈവം അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.”
chapters.niv: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
chapters.nkjv: And it shall come to pass That whoever calls on the name of the Lord Shall be saved.’
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ പുരുഷന്മാരേ, ഈ വചനം കേട്ടു കൊൾവിൻ. നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ അറിയുംപോലെ ദൈവം അവനെക്കൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളുടെ നടുവിൽ ചെയ്യിച്ച ശക്തികളും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും അടയാളങ്ങളും കൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: "Fellow Israelites, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.
chapters.nkjv: "Men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a Man attested by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs which God did through Him in your midst, as you yourselves also know—
chapters.kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നിങ്ങൾക്കു കാണിച്ചു തന്ന പുരുഷനായി നസറായനായ യേശുവിനെ ദൈവം തന്റെ സ്ഥിര നിർണ്ണയത്താലും മുന്നറിവിനാലും ഏല്പിച്ചിട്ടു, നിങ്ങൾ അവനെ അധർമ്മികളുടെ കയ്യാൽ തറെപ്പിച്ചു കൊന്നു;
chapters.niv: This man was handed over to you by God’s deliberate plan and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.
chapters.nkjv: Him, being delivered by the determined purpose and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by lawless hands, have crucified, and put to death;
chapters.kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

chapters.ml: ദൈവമോ മരണപാശങ്ങളെ അഴിച്ചിട്ടു അവനെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു. മരണം അവനെ പിടിച്ചു വെക്കുന്നതു അസാദ്ധ്യമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.
chapters.nkjv: whom God raised up, having loosed the pains of death, because it was not possible that He should be held by it.
chapters.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ കർത്താവിനെ എപ്പോഴും എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ എന്റെ വലഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്കയാൽ ഞാൻ കുലുങ്ങിപോകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: David said about him: " ‘I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
chapters.nkjv: For David says concerning Him: ‘I foresaw the Lord always before my face, For He is at my right hand, that I may not be shaken.
chapters.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ട് എന്റെ ഹൃദയം സന്തോഷിച്ചു, എന്റെ നാവു ആനന്ദിച്ചു, എന്റെ ജഡവും പ്രത്യാശയോടെ വസിക്കും.”
chapters.niv: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest in hope,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my tongue was glad; Moreover my flesh also will rest in hope.
chapters.kjv: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ പാതാളത്തിൽ വിടുകയില്ല; നിന്റെ പരിശുദ്ധനെ ദ്രവത്വം കാണ്മാൻ സമ്മതിക്കയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, you will not let your holy one see decay.
chapters.nkjv: For You will not leave my soul in Hades, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.
chapters.kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

chapters.ml: നീ ജീവമാർഗ്ഗങ്ങളെ എന്നോടു അറിയിച്ചു; നിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ എന്നെ സന്തോഷ പൂർണ്ണനാക്കും” എന്നു ദാവീദ് അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.’
chapters.nkjv: You have made known to me the ways of life; You will make me full of joy in Your presence.’
chapters.kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരായ പുരുഷന്മാരേ, ഗോത്രപിതാവായ ദാവീദിനെക്കുറിച്ച് അവൻ മരിച്ചു അടക്കപ്പെട്ടു എന്നു എനിക്കു നിങ്ങളോടു ധൈര്യമായി പറയാം; അവന്റെ കല്ലറ ഇന്നുവരെ നമ്മുടെ ഇടയിൽ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Fellow Israelites, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.
chapters.nkjv: "Men and brethren, let me speak freely to you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
chapters.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ പ്രവാചകൻ ആകയാൽ ദൈവം അവന്റെ കടിപ്രദേശത്തിന്റെ ഫലത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഒരുത്തനെ അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുത്തും എന്നു തന്നോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു എന്നു അറഞ്ഞിട്ടു:
chapters.niv: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, He would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
chapters.kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

chapters.ml: അവനെ പാതാളത്തിൽ വിട്ടുകളഞ്ഞില്ല: അവന്റെ ജഡം ദ്രവത്വം കണ്ടതുമില്ല എന്നു ക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ പുനരുത്ഥാനം മുമ്പുകൂട്ടി കണ്ടു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു. ഈ യേശുവിനെ ദൈവം ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: Seeing what was to come, he spoke of the resurrection of the Messiah, that he was not abandoned to the realm of the dead, nor did his body see decay.
chapters.nkjv: he, foreseeing this, spoke concerning the resurrection of the Christ, that His soul was not left in Hades, nor did His flesh see corruption.
chapters.kjv: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it.
chapters.nkjv: This Jesus God has raised up, of which we are all witnesses.
chapters.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വല ഭാഗത്തേക്കു ആരോഹണം ചെയ്തു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു എന്ന വാഗ്ദത്തം പിതാവിനോടു വാങ്ങി, നിങ്ങൾ ഈ കാണുകയും കേൾക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നത് പകർന്നുതന്നു,
chapters.niv: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore being exalted to the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, He poured out this which you now see and hear.
chapters.kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് സ്വർഗ്ഗാരോഹണം ചെയ്തില്ലല്ലോ. എന്നാൽ അവൻ:
chapters.niv: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, " ‘The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand
chapters.nkjv: "For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he says himself: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand,
chapters.kjv: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ നിന്റെ പാദപീഠം ആക്കുവോളം നീ എന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്ക എന്നു കർത്താവു എന്റെ കർത്താവിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു” എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." ’
chapters.nkjv: Till I make Your enemies Your footstool." ’
chapters.kjv: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ക്രൂശിച്ച ഈ യേശുവിനെ തന്നേ ദൈവം കർത്താവും ക്രിസ്തുവുമാക്കിവെച്ചു എന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ ഗൃഹം ഒക്കെയും നിശ്ചയമായി അറിഞ്ഞുകൊള്ളട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: "Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah."
chapters.nkjv: "Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ."
chapters.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടിട്ടു അവർ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ കുത്തുകൊണ്ടു പത്രൊസിനോടും ശേഷം അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരോടും: സഹോദരന്മാരായ പുരുഷന്മാരേ, ഞങ്ങൾ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, "Brothers, what shall we do?"
chapters.nkjv: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, "Men and brethren, what shall we do?"
chapters.kjv: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവരോടു: നിങ്ങൾ മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടു നിങ്ങളുടെ പാപങ്ങളുടെ മോചനത്തിന്നായി ഓരോരുത്തൻ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ സ്നാനം ഏല്പിൻ; എന്നാൽ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു എന്ന ദാനം ലഭിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Peter replied, "Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter said to them, "Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins; and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
chapters.kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: വാഗ്ദത്തം നിങ്ങൾക്കും നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കൾക്കും നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവു വിളിച്ചു വരുത്തുന്ന ദൂരസ്ഥന്മാരായ ഏവർക്കും ഉള്ളതല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off—for all whom the Lord our God will call."
chapters.nkjv: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are afar off, as many as the Lord our God will call."
chapters.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

chapters.ml: മറ്റു പല വാക്കുകളാലും അവൻ സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞു അവരെ പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചു; ഈ വക്രതയുള്ള തലമുറയിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, "Save yourselves from this corrupt generation."
chapters.nkjv: And with many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, "Be saved from this perverse generation."
chapters.kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വാക്കു കൈക്കൊണ്ടവർ സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു; അന്നു മുവായിരത്തോളം പേർ അവരോടു ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.
chapters.nkjv: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized; and that day about three thousand souls were added tothem.
chapters.kjv: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

chapters.ml: അവർ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ ഉപദേശം കേട്ടും കൂട്ടായ്മ ആചരിച്ചും അപ്പം നുറക്കിയും പ്രാർത്ഥന കഴിച്ചും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
chapters.nkjv: And they continued steadfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and in prayers.
chapters.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവർക്കും ഭയമായി; അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരാൽ ഏറിയ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും അടയാളങ്ങളും നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Everyone was filled with awe at the many wonders and signs performed by the apostles.
chapters.nkjv: Then fear came upon every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
chapters.kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസിച്ചവർ എല്ലാവരും ഒരുമിച്ചിരുന്നു
chapters.niv: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
chapters.nkjv: Now all who believed were together, and had all things in common,
chapters.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

chapters.ml: സകലവും പൊതുവക എന്നു എണ്ണുകയും ജന്മഭൂമികളും വസ്തുക്കളും വിറ്റു അവനവന്നു ആവശ്യം ഉള്ളതുപോലെ എല്ലാവർക്കും പങ്കിടുകയും,
chapters.niv: They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need.
chapters.nkjv: and sold their possessions and goods, and divided them among all, as anyone had need.
chapters.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men , as every man had need.

chapters.ml: ഒരുമനപ്പെട്ടു ദിനംപ്രതി ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ കൂടിവരികയും വീട്ടിൽ അപ്പം നുറുക്കിക്കൊണ്ടു ഉല്ലാസവും ഹൃദയപരമാർത്ഥതയും പൂണ്ടു ഭക്ഷണം കഴിക്കയും
chapters.niv: Every day they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts,
chapters.nkjv: So continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, they ate their food with gladness and simplicity of heart,
chapters.kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തെ സ്തുതിക്കയും സകല ജനത്തിന്റെയും കൃപ അനുഭവിക്കയും ചെയ്തു. കർത്താവു രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുന്നവരെ ദിനംപ്രതി സഭയോടു ചേർത്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
chapters.nkjv: praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily those who were being saved.
chapters.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

chapters.ml: ഒരിക്കൽ പത്രൊസും യോഹന്നാനും ഒമ്പതാം മണിനേരം പ്രാർത്ഥനാസമയത്തു ദൈവാലയത്തിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ
chapters.niv: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.
chapters.nkjv: Now Peter and John went up together to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
chapters.kjv: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour .

chapters.ml: അമ്മയുടെ ഗർഭം മുതൽ മുടന്തനായ ഒരാളെ ചിലർ ചുമന്നു കൊണ്ടു വന്നു; അവനെ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുന്നവരോടു ഭിക്ഷ യാചിപ്പാൻ സുന്ദരം എന്ന ദൈവാലയഗോപുരത്തിങ്കൽ ദിനംപ്രതി ഇരുത്തുമാറുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Now a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.
chapters.nkjv: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms from those who entered the temple;
chapters.kjv: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

chapters.ml: അവൻ പത്രൊസും യോഹന്നാനും ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ കടപ്പാൻ പോകുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു ഭിക്ഷ ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
chapters.nkjv: who, seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, asked for alms.
chapters.kjv: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് യോഹന്നാനോടുകൂടെ അവനെ ഉറ്റുനോക്കി: ഞങ്ങളെ നോക്കു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, "Look at us!"
chapters.nkjv: And fixing his eyes on him, with John, Peter said, "Look at us."
chapters.kjv: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വല്ലതും കിട്ടും എന്നു കരുതി അവരെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.
chapters.nkjv: So he gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
chapters.kjv: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ്: വെള്ളിയും പൊന്നും എനിക്കില്ല; എനിക്കുള്ളതു നിനക്കു തരുന്നു: നസറായനായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ നടക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: Then Peter said, "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk."
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter said, "Silver and gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk."
chapters.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

chapters.ml: അവനെ വലങ്കൈക്കു പിടിച്ചു എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു; ക്ഷണത്തിൽ അവന്റെ കാലും നരിയാണിയും ഉറെച്ചു അവൻ കുതിച്ചെഴുന്നേറ്റു നടന്നു;
chapters.niv: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man’s feet and ankles became strong.
chapters.nkjv: And he took him by the right hand and lifted him up, and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
chapters.kjv: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.

chapters.ml: നടന്നും തുള്ളിയും ദൈവത്തെ പുകഴ്ത്തിയും കൊണ്ടു അവരോടുകൂടെ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ കടന്നു.
chapters.niv: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.
chapters.nkjv: So he, leaping up, stood and walked and entered the temple with them—walking, leaping, and praising God.
chapters.kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നടക്കുന്നതും ദൈവത്ത പുകഴ്ത്തുന്നതും ജനം ഒക്കെയും കണ്ടു,
chapters.niv: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
chapters.nkjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God.
chapters.kjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ സുന്ദരം എന്ന ദൈവാലയഗോപുരത്തിങ്കൽ ഭിക്ഷ യാചിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ഇരുന്നവൻ എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു അവന്നു സംഭവിച്ചതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു വിസ്മയവും പരിഭ്രമവും നിറഞ്ഞവരായീതീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
chapters.nkjv: Then they knew that it was he who sat begging alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
chapters.kjv: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പത്രൊസിനോടും യോഹന്നാനോടും ചേർന്നു നില്ക്കുമ്പോൾ ജനം എല്ലാം വിസ്മയംപൂണ്ടു ശലോമോന്റേതു എന്നു പേരുള്ള മണ്ഡപത്തിൽ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഓടിക്കൂടി.
chapters.niv: While the man held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.nkjv: Now as the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch which is called Solomon’s, greatly amazed.
chapters.kjv: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

chapters.ml: അതു കണ്ടിട്ടു പത്രൊസ് ജനങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: യിസ്രായേൽ പുരുഷന്മാരേ, ഇതിങ്കൽ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടുന്നതു എന്തു? ഞങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്ത ശക്തികൊണ്ടോ ഭക്തികൊണ്ടോ ഇവനെ നടക്കുമാറാക്കി എന്നപോലെ ഞങ്ങളെ ഉറ്റു നോക്കുന്നതും എന്തു?
chapters.niv: When Peter saw this, he said to them: "Fellow Israelites, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
chapters.nkjv: So when Peter saw it, he responded to the people: "Men of Israel, why do you marvel at this? Or why look so intently at us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
chapters.kjv: And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

chapters.ml: അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെയും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെയും യാക്കോബിന്റെയും ദൈവമായ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവം തന്റെ ദാസനായ യേശുവിനെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി; അവനെ നിങ്ങൾ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കയും അവനെ വിട്ടയപ്പാൻ വിധിച്ച പീലാത്തൊസിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽവെച്ചു തള്ളിപ്പറയുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.
chapters.nkjv: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, glorified His Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let Him go.
chapters.kjv: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

chapters.ml: പരിശുദ്ധനും നീതിമാനുമായവനെ നിങ്ങൾ തള്ളിപ്പറഞ്ഞു, കുലപാതകനായവനെ വിട്ടുതരേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു, ജീവനായകനെ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
chapters.nkjv: But you denied the Holy One and the Just, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
chapters.kjv: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

chapters.ml: അവനെ ദൈവം മരിച്ചവരിൽനിന്നു, എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു; അതിന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.
chapters.nkjv: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, of which we are witnesses.
chapters.kjv: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ നാമത്തിലെ വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അവന്റെ നാമം തന്നേ നിങ്ങൾ കാൺകയും അറികയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഇവൻ ബലം പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ കാരണമായി തീർന്നു; അവൻ മുഖാന്തരമുള്ള വിശ്വാസം ഇന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും കാൺകെ ഈ ആരോഗ്യം വരുവാൻ ഹേതുവായി തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through him that has completely healed him, as you can all see.
chapters.nkjv: And His name, through faith in His name, has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which comes through Him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
chapters.kjv: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രമാണികളെപ്പോലെ നിങ്ങളും അറിയായ്മകൊണ്ടു പ്രവർത്തിച്ചു എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Now, fellow Israelites, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
chapters.nkjv: "Yet now, brethren, I know that you did it in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
chapters.kjv: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers.

chapters.ml: ദൈവമോ തന്റെ ക്രിസ്തു കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിക്കും എന്നു സകല പ്രവാചകന്മാരും മുഖാന്തരം മുന്നറിയിച്ചതു ഇങ്ങനെ നിവർത്തിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Messiah would suffer.
chapters.nkjv: But those things which God foretold by the mouth of all His prophets, that the Christ would suffer, He has thus fulfilled.
chapters.kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ പാപങ്ങൾ മാഞ്ഞുകിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടു തിരിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ; എന്നാൽ കർത്താവിന്റെ സമ്മുഖത്തുനിന്നു
chapters.niv: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,
chapters.nkjv: Repent therefore and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord,
chapters.kjv: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

chapters.ml: ആശ്വാസകാലങ്ങൾ വരികയും നിങ്ങൾക്കു മുൻനിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ട ക്രിസ്തുവായ യേശുവിനെ അവൻ അയക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: and that he may send the Messiah, who has been appointed for you—even Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: and that He may send Jesus Christ, who was preached to you before,
chapters.kjv: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ലോകാരംഭം മുതൽ തന്റെ വിശുദ്ധപ്രവാചകന്മാർ മുഖാന്തരം അരുളിചെയ്തതു ഒക്കെയും യഥാസ്ഥാനത്താകുന്ന കാലം വരുവോളം സ്വർഗ്ഗം അവനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Heaven must receive him until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.
chapters.nkjv: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God has spoken by the mouth of all His holy prophets since the world began.
chapters.kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

chapters.ml: “ദൈവമായ കർത്താവു നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽനിന്നു എന്നെപ്പോലെ ഒരു പ്രവാചകനെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചുതരും; അവൻ നിങ്ങളോടു സംസാരിക്കുന്ന സകലത്തിലും നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കേണം.
chapters.niv: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.
chapters.nkjv: For Moses truly said to the fathers, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from your brethren. Him you shall hear in all things, whatever He says to you.
chapters.kjv: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

chapters.ml: ആ പ്രവാചകന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കാത്ത ഏവനും ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നു ഛേദിക്കപ്പെടും.” എന്നു മോശെ പറഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from their people.’
chapters.nkjv: And it shall be that every soul who will not hear that Prophet shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
chapters.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

chapters.ml: അത്രയുമല്ല ശമൂവേൽ ആദിയായി സംസാരിച്ച പ്രവാചകന്മാർ ഒക്കെയും ഈ കാലത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "Indeed, beginning with Samuel, all the prophets who have spoken have foretold these days.
chapters.nkjv: Yes, and all the prophets, from Samuel and those who follow, as many as have spoken, have also foretold these days.
chapters.kjv: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

chapters.ml: “ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലവംശങ്ങളും നിന്റെ സന്തതിയിൽ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കപ്പെടും.” എന്നു ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു അരുളി നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ചെയ്ത നിയമത്തിന്റെയും പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെയും മക്കൾ നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.’
chapters.nkjv: You are sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.’
chapters.kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആദ്യമേ ദൈവം തന്റെ ദാസനായ യേശുവിനെ എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു ഓരോരുത്തനെ അവനവന്റെ അകൃത്യങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നു തിരിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ നിങ്ങളെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവനെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."
chapters.nkjv: To you first, God, having raised up His Servant Jesus, sent Him to bless you, in turning away every one ofyou from your iniquities."
chapters.kjv: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

chapters.ml: അവർ ജനത്തോടു സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ദൈവാലയത്തിലെ പടനായകനും സദൂക്യരും
chapters.niv: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.
chapters.nkjv: Now as they spoke to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees came upon them,
chapters.kjv: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ നേരെ വന്നു, അവർ ജനത്തെ ഉപദേശിക്കയാലും മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നുള്ള പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തെ യേശുവിന്റെ ദൃഷ്ടാന്തത്താൽ അറിയിക്കയാലും നീരസപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people, proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
chapters.nkjv: being greatly disturbed that they taught the people and preached in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
chapters.kjv: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

chapters.ml: അവരെ പിടിച്ചു വൈകുന്നേരം ആകകൊണ്ടു പിറ്റെന്നാൾവരെ കാവലിലാക്കി.
chapters.niv: They seized Peter and John and, because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.
chapters.nkjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.
chapters.kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വചനം കേട്ടവരിൽ പലരും വിശ്വസിച്ചു; പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ എണ്ണംതന്നേ അയ്യായിരത്തോളം ആയി.
chapters.niv: But many who heard the message believed; so the number of men who believed grew to about five thousand.
chapters.nkjv: However, many of those who heard the word believed; and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവരുടെ പ്രമാണികളും മൂപ്പന്മാരും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരും യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി;
chapters.niv: The next day the rulers, the elders and the teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And it came to pass, on the next day, that their rulers, elders, and scribes,
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ ഹന്നാവും കയ്യഫാവും യോഹന്നാനും അലെക്സന്തരും മഹാപുരോഹിതവംശത്തിലുള്ളവർ ഒക്കെയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Annas the high priest was there, and so were Caiaphas, John, Alexander and others of the high priest’s family.
chapters.nkjv: as well as Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the family of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ അവരെ നടുവിൽ നിറുത്തി: ഏതു ശക്തികൊണ്ടോ ഏതു നാമത്തിലോ നിങ്ങൾ ഇതു ചെയ്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They had Peter and John brought before them and began to question them: "By what power or what name did you do this?"
chapters.nkjv: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, "By what power or by what name have you done this?"
chapters.kjv: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിറഞ്ഞവനായി അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ജനത്തിന്റെ പ്രമാണികളും മൂപ്പന്മാരും ആയുള്ളോരേ,
chapters.niv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: "Rulers and elders of the people!
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, "Rulers of the people and elders of Israel:
chapters.kjv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

chapters.ml: ഈ ബലഹീനമനുഷ്യന്നു ഉണ്ടായ ഉപകാരം നിമിത്തം ഇവൻ എന്തൊന്നിനാൽ സൌഖ്യമായി എന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ ഇന്നു വിസ്തരിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ ക്രൂശിച്ചവനും
chapters.niv: If we are being called to account today for an act of kindness shown to a man who was lame and are being asked how he was healed,
chapters.nkjv: If we this day are judged for a good deed done to a helpless man, by what means he has been made well,
chapters.kjv: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

chapters.ml: ദൈവം മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർപ്പിച്ചവനുമായി നസറായനായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ തന്നേ ഇവൻ സൌഖ്യമുള്ളവനായി നിങ്ങളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നില്ക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും യിസ്രായേൽ ജനം ഒക്കെയും അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
chapters.nkjv: let it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, by Him this man stands here before you whole.
chapters.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

chapters.ml: വീടുപണിയുന്നവരായ നിങ്ങൾ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞിട്ടു കോണിന്റെ മൂലക്കല്ലായിത്തീർന്ന കല്ലു ഇവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Jesus is " ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
chapters.nkjv: This is the ‘stone which was rejected by you builders, which has become the chief cornerstone.’
chapters.kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരുത്തനിലും രക്ഷ ഇല്ല; നാം രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുവാൻ ആകാശത്തിൻ കീഴിൽ മനുഷ്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽ നല്കപ്പെട്ട വേറൊരു നാമവും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."
chapters.nkjv: Nor is there salvation in any other, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved."
chapters.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

chapters.ml: അവർ പത്രൊസിന്റെയും യോഹന്നാന്റെയും ധൈര്യം കാണ്കയാലും ഇവർ പഠിപ്പില്ലാത്തവരും സാമാന്യരുമായ മനുഷ്യർ എന്നു ഗ്രഹിക്കയാലും ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു; അവർ യേശുവിനോടുകൂടെ ആയിരുന്നവർ എന്നും അറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated and untrained men, they marveled. And they realized that they had been with Jesus.
chapters.kjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

chapters.ml: സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിച്ച മനുഷ്യൻ അവരോടുകൂടെ നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടതുകൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു എതിർ പറവാൻ വകയില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.
chapters.nkjv: And seeing the man who had been healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
chapters.kjv: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

chapters.ml: അവരോടു ന്യായാധിപസംഘത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറത്തുപോകുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചിട്ടു അവർ തമ്മിൽ ആലോചിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
chapters.nkjv: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
chapters.kjv: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

chapters.ml: ഈ മനുഷ്യരെ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണ്ടു? പ്രത്യക്ഷമായോരു അടയാളം അവർ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു യെരൂശലേമിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവർക്കും പ്രസിദ്ധമല്ലോ; നിഷേധിപ്പാൻ നമുക്കു കഴിവില്ല.
chapters.niv: "What are we going to do with these men?" they asked. "Everyone living in Jerusalem knows they have performed a notable sign, and we cannot deny it.
chapters.nkjv: saying, "What shall we do to these men? For, indeed, that a notable miracle has been done through them is evident to all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we cannot deny it.
chapters.kjv: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it .

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അതു ജനത്തിൽ അധികം പരക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ അവർ യാതൊരു മനുഷ്യനോടും ഈ നാമത്തിൽ ഇനി സംസാരിക്കരുതെന്നു നാം അവരെ തർജ്ജനം ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them to speak no longer to anyone in this name."
chapters.nkjv: But so that it spreads no further among the people, let us severely threaten them, that from now on they speak to no man in this name."
chapters.kjv: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരെ വിളിച്ചിട്ടു: യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ അശേഷം സംസാരിക്കരുതു, ഉപദേശിക്കയും അരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: So they called them and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പത്രൊസും യോഹന്നാനും: ദൈവത്തെക്കാൾ അധികം നിങ്ങളെ അനുസരിക്കുന്നതു ദൈവത്തിന്റേ മുമ്പാകെ ന്യായമോ എന്നു വിധിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: But Peter and John replied, "Which is right in God’s eyes: to listen to you, or to him? You be the judges!
chapters.nkjv: But Peter and John answered and said to them, "Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you more than to God, you judge.
chapters.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾക്കോ ഞങ്ങൾ കണ്ടും കേട്ടുമിരിക്കുന്നതു പ്രസ്താവിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നതല്ല എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As for us, we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard."
chapters.nkjv: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard."
chapters.kjv: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഈ സംഭവിച്ച കാര്യംകൊണ്ടു എല്ലാവരും ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തുകയാൽ അവരെ ശിക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനു ജനംനിമിത്തം വഴി ഒന്നും കാണായ്കകൊണ്ടു അവർ പിന്നെയും തർജ്ജനം ചെയ്തു അവരെ വിട്ടയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way of punishing them, because of the people, since they all glorified God for what had been done.
chapters.kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

chapters.ml: ഈ അത്ഭുതത്താൽ സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിച്ച മനുഷ്യൻ നാല്പതിൽ അധികം വയസ്സുള്ളവനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
chapters.nkjv: For the man was over forty years old on whom this miracle of healing had been performed.
chapters.kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

chapters.ml: വിട്ടയച്ചശേഷം അവർ കൂട്ടാളികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും തങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞതു എല്ലാം അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On their release, Peter and John went back to their own people and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
chapters.nkjv: And being let go, they went to their own companions and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.
chapters.kjv: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

chapters.ml: അതു കേട്ടിട്ടു അവർ ഒരുമനപ്പെട്ടു ദൈവത്തോടു നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു: ആകശവും ഭൂമിയും സമുദ്രവും അവയിലുള്ള സകലവും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ നാഥനേ,
chapters.niv: When they heard this, they raised their voices together in prayer to God. "Sovereign Lord," they said, "you made the heavens and the earth and the sea, and everything in them.
chapters.nkjv: So when they heard that, they raised their voice to God with one accord and said: "Lord, You are God, who made heaven and earth and the sea, and all that is in them,
chapters.kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

chapters.ml: “ജാതികൾ കലഹിക്കുന്നതും വംശങ്ങൾ വ്യർത്ഥമായതു നിരൂപിക്കുന്നതും എന്തു?
chapters.niv: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: " ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
chapters.nkjv: who by the mouth of Your servant David have said: ‘Why did the nations rage, And the people plot vain things?
chapters.kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാർഅണിനിരക്കുകയും അധിപതികൾ കർത്താവിന്നു വിരോധമായും അവന്റെ അഭിഷിക്തന്നു വിരോധമായും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടുകയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു നിന്റെ ദാസനായ ദാവീദ് മുഖാന്തരം പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനാൽ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തവനേ,
chapters.niv: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed one. ’
chapters.nkjv: The kings of the earth took their stand, And the rulers were gathered together Against the Lord and against His Christ.’
chapters.kjv: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

chapters.ml: നീ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്ത യേശു എന്ന നിന്റെ പരിശുദ്ധദാസനു വിരോധമായി ഹെരോദാവും പൊന്തിയൊസ് പീലാത്തൊസും ജാതികളും യിസ്രായേൽ ജനവുമായി ഈ നഗരത്തിൽ ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടി,
chapters.niv: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.
chapters.nkjv: "For truly against Your holy Servant Jesus, whom You anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together
chapters.kjv: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

chapters.ml: സംഭവിക്കേണം എന്നു നിന്റെ കയ്യും നിന്റെ ആലോചനയും മുന്നിയമിച്ചതു ഒക്കെയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു സത്യം.
chapters.niv: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.
chapters.nkjv: to do whatever Your hand and Your purpose determined before to be done.
chapters.kjv: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴോ കർത്താവേ, അവരുടെ ഭീഷണികളെ നോക്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.
chapters.nkjv: Now, Lord, look on their threats, and grant to Your servants that with all boldness they may speak Your word,
chapters.kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

chapters.ml: സൌഖ്യമാക്കുവാൻ നിന്റെ കൈ നീട്ടുന്നതിനാലും നിന്റെ പരിശുദ്ധദാസനായ യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്താൽ അടയാളങ്ങളും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടാകുന്നതിനാലും നിന്റെ വചനം പൂർണ്ണധൈര്യത്തോടും കൂടെ പ്രസ്താവിപ്പാൻ നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർക്കു കൃപ നല്കേണമേ.
chapters.niv: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus."
chapters.nkjv: by stretching out Your hand to heal, and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of Your holy Servant Jesus."
chapters.kjv: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ കൂടിയിരുന്ന സ്ഥലം കുലുങ്ങി; എല്ലാവരും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിറഞ്ഞവരായി ദൈവവചനം ധൈര്യത്തോടെ പ്രസ്താവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had prayed, the place where they were assembled together was shaken; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
chapters.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസിച്ചവരുടെ കൂട്ടം ഏകഹൃദയവും ഏകമനസ്സും ഉള്ളവരായിരുന്നു; തനിക്കുള്ളതു ഒന്നും സ്വന്തം എന്നു ആരും പറഞ്ഞില്ല;
chapters.niv: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of their possessions was their own, but they shared everything they had.
chapters.nkjv: Now the multitude of those who believed were of one heart and one soul; neither did anyone say that any of the things he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
chapters.kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

chapters.ml: സകലവും അവർക്കു പൊതുവായിരുന്നു. അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ മഹാശക്തിയോടെ കർത്താവായ യേശുവിന്റെ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിനു സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞുവന്നു; എല്ലാവർക്കും ധാരാളം കൃപ ലഭിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And God’s grace was so powerfully at work in them all
chapters.nkjv: And with great power the apostles gave witness to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And great grace was upon them all.
chapters.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

chapters.ml: മുട്ടുള്ളവർ ആരും അവരിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; നിലങ്ങളുടെയോ വീടുകളുടെയോ ഉടമസ്ഥന്മാരായവർ ഒക്കെയും അവയെ വിറ്റു വില കൊണ്ടു വന്നു
chapters.niv: that there were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned land or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales
chapters.nkjv: Nor was there anyone among them who lacked; for all who were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
chapters.kjv: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

chapters.ml: അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ കാൽക്കൽ വെക്കും; പിന്നെ ഓരോരുത്തന്നു അവനവന്റെ ആവശ്യംപോലെ വിഭാഗിച്ചുകൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: and put it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to anyone who had need.
chapters.nkjv: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and they distributed to each as anyone had need.
chapters.kjv: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

chapters.ml: പ്രബോധനപുത്രൻ എന്നു അർത്ഥമുള്ള ബർന്നബാസ് എന്നു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ മറുപേർ വിളിച്ച കുപ്രദ്വീപുകാരനായ യോസേഫ്
chapters.niv: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means "son of encouragement"),
chapters.nkjv: And Joses, who was also named Barnabas by the apostles (which is translated Son of Encouragement), a Levite of the country of Cyprus,
chapters.kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

chapters.ml: എന്നൊരു ലേവ്യൻ തനിക്കുണ്ടായിരുന്ന നിലം വിറ്റു പണം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ കാൽക്കൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.nkjv: having land, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.kjv: Having land, sold it , and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അനന്യാസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു പുരുഷൻ തന്റെ ഭാര്യയായ സഫീരയോടു കൂടെ ഒരു നിലം വിറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.
chapters.nkjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession.
chapters.kjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

chapters.ml: ഭാര്യയുടെ അറിവോടെ വിലയിൽ കുറെ എടുത്തുവെച്ചു ഒരംശം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ കാല്കൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: With his wife’s full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.nkjv: And he kept back part of the proceeds, his wife also being aware ofit, and brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.kjv: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ്: അനന്യാസേ, പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനോടു വ്യാജം കാണിപ്പാനും നിലത്തിന്റെ വിലയിൽ കുറെ എടുത്തുവെപ്പാനും സാത്താൻ നിന്റെ ഹൃദയം കൈവശമാക്കിയതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Then Peter said, "Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?
chapters.nkjv: But Peter said, "Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and keep back part of the price of the land for yourself?
chapters.kjv: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

chapters.ml: അതു വില്ക്കും മുമ്പെ നിന്റേതായിരുന്നില്ലെയോ? വിറ്റശേഷവും നിന്റെ കൈവശം അല്ലാഞ്ഞുവോ? ഈ കാര്യത്തിനു നീ മനസ്സുവെച്ചതു എന്തു? മനുഷ്യരോടല്ല ദൈവത്തോടത്രേ നീ വ്യാജം കാണിച്ചതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Didn’t it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn’t the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied just to human beings but to God."
chapters.nkjv: While it remained, was it not your own? And after it was sold, was it not in your own control? Why have you conceived this thing in your heart? You have not lied to men but to God."
chapters.kjv: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു കേട്ടിട്ടു അനന്യാസ് വീണു പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു; ഇതു കേട്ടവർക്കു എല്ലാവർക്കും മഹാഭയം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and breathed his last. So great fear came upon all those who heard these things.
chapters.kjv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

chapters.ml: ബാല്യക്കാർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവനെ ശീലപൊതിഞ്ഞു പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി കുഴിച്ചിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then some young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
chapters.nkjv: And the young men arose and wrapped him up, carried him out, and buried him.
chapters.kjv: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him .

chapters.ml: ഏകദേശം മൂന്നു മണിനേരം കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ ഈ സംഭവിച്ചതു ഒന്നും അറിയാതെ അകത്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
chapters.nkjv: Now it was about three hours later when his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
chapters.kjv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവളോടു: ഇത്രെക്കോ നിങ്ങൾ നിലം വിറ്റതു? പറക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അതേ, ഇത്രെക്കു തന്നെ എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter asked her, "Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?" "Yes," she said, "that is the price."
chapters.nkjv: And Peter answered her, "Tell me whether you sold the land for so much?" She said, "Yes, for so much."
chapters.kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവളോടു: കർത്താവിന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെ പരീക്ഷിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങൾ തമ്മിൽ ഒത്തതു എന്തു? ഇതാ, നിന്റെ ഭർത്താവിനെ കുഴിച്ചിട്ടവരുടെ കാൽ വാതിൽക്കൽ ഉണ്ടു; അവർ നിന്നെയും പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Peter said to her, "How could you conspire to test the Spirit of the Lord? Listen! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also."
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter said to her, "How is it that you have agreed together to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out."
chapters.kjv: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവൾ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു; ബാല്യക്കാർ അകത്തു വന്നു അവൾ മരിച്ചു എന്നു കണ്ടു പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി ഭർത്താവിന്റെ അരികെ കുഴിച്ചിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
chapters.nkjv: Then immediately she fell down at his feet and breathed her last. And the young men came in and found her dead, and carrying her out, buried her by her husband.
chapters.kjv: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

chapters.ml: സർവസഭെക്കും ഇതു കേട്ടവർക്കു എല്ലാവർക്കും മഹാഭയം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.
chapters.nkjv: So great fear came upon all the church and upon all who heard these things.
chapters.kjv: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ കയ്യാൽ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിൽ പല അടയാളങ്ങളും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും നടന്നു; അവർ എല്ലാവരും ഏകമനസ്സോടെ ശലോമോന്റെ മണ്ഡപത്തിൽ കൂടിവരിക പതിവായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.nkjv: And through the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. And they were all with one accord in Solomon’s Porch.
chapters.kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

chapters.ml: മറ്റുള്ളവരിൽ ആരും അവരോടു ചേരുവാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞില്ല; ജനമോ അവരെ പുകഴ്ത്തിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.
chapters.nkjv: Yet none of the rest dared join them, but the people esteemed them highly.
chapters.kjv: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

chapters.ml: മേല്ക്കുമേൽ അനവധി പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളും കർത്താവിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു ചേർന്നുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.
chapters.nkjv: And believers were increasingly added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women,
chapters.kjv: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

chapters.ml: രോഗികളെ പുറത്തുകൊണ്ടുവന്നു, പത്രൊസ് കടന്നുപോകുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ നിഴൽ എങ്കിലും അവരിൽ വല്ലവരുടെയുംമേൽ വീഴേണ്ടതിന്നു വീഥികളിൽ വിരിപ്പിന്മേലും കിടക്കമേലും കിടത്തും.
chapters.niv: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
chapters.nkjv: so that they brought the sick out into the streets and laid them on beds and couches, that at least the shadow of Peter passing by might fall on some of them.
chapters.kjv: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

chapters.ml: അതുകൂടാതെ യെരൂശലേമിന്നു ചുറ്റുമുള്ള പട്ടണങ്ങളിൽനിന്നു പുരുഷാരം വന്നുകൂടി രോഗികളെയും അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കൾ ബാധിച്ചവരെയും കൊണ്ടുവരികയും അവർ എല്ലാവരും സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed.
chapters.nkjv: Also a multitude gathered from the surrounding cities to Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits, and they were all healed.
chapters.kjv: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ മഹാപുരോഹിതനും സദൂക്യരുടെ മതക്കാരായ അവന്റെ പക്ഷക്കാരൊക്കെയും
chapters.niv: Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.
chapters.nkjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with indignation,
chapters.kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

chapters.ml: അസൂയ നിറഞ്ഞു എഴുന്നേറ്റു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരെ പിടിച്ചു പൊതു തടവിൽ ആക്കി.
chapters.niv: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
chapters.nkjv: and laid their hands on the apostles and put them in the common prison.
chapters.kjv: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിലോ കർത്താവിന്റെ ദൂതൻ കാരാഗൃഹവാതിൽ തുറന്നു അവരെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടു വന്നു:
chapters.niv: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.
chapters.nkjv: But at night an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and brought them out, and said,
chapters.kjv: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ഈ ജീവന്റെ വചനം എല്ലാം ജനത്തോടു പ്രസ്താവിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Go, stand in the temple courts," he said, "and tell the people all about this new life."
chapters.nkjv: "Go, stand in the temple and speak to the people all the words of this life."
chapters.kjv: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

chapters.ml: അവർ കേട്ടു പുലർച്ചെക്കു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; മഹാപുരോഹിതനും കൂടെയുള്ളവരും വന്നു ന്യായാധിപസംഘത്തെയും യിസ്രയേൽമക്കളുടെ മൂപ്പന്മാരെയും എല്ലാം വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടി, അവരെ കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ തടവിലേക്കു ആളയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
chapters.nkjv: And when they heard that, they entered the temple early in the morning and taught. But the high priest and those with him came and called the council together, with all the elders of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
chapters.kjv: And when they heard that , they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

chapters.ml: ചേവകർ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ അവരെ കാരാഗൃഹത്തിൽ കാണാതെ മടങ്ങിവന്നു: കാരാഗൃഹം നല്ല സൂക്ഷമത്തോടെ പൂട്ടിയിരിക്കുന്നതും കാവൽക്കാർ വാതിൽക്കൽ നില്ക്കുന്നതും ഞങ്ങൾ കണ്ടു;
chapters.niv: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,
chapters.nkjv: But when the officers came and did not find them in the prison, they returned and reported,
chapters.kjv: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

chapters.ml: തുറന്നപ്പോഴോ അകത്തു ആരെയും കണ്ടില്ല എന്നു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Indeed we found the prison shut securely, and the guards standing outside before the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു കേട്ടിട്ടു ദൈവാലയത്തിലെ പടനായകനും മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരും ഇതു എന്തായിത്തീരും എന്നു അവരെക്കുറിച്ചു ചഞ്ചലിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were at a loss, wondering what this might lead to.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these things, they wondered what the outcome would be.
chapters.kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഒരുത്തൻ വന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ തടവിൽ ആക്കിയ പുരുഷന്മാർ ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു ജനത്തെ ഉപദേശിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then someone came and said, "Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people."
chapters.nkjv: So one came and told them, saying, "Look, the men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people!"
chapters.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

chapters.ml: പടനായകൻ ചേവകരുമായി ചെന്നു, ജനം കല്ലെറിയും എന്നു ഭയപ്പെടുകയാൽ ബലാൽക്കാരം ചെയ്യാതെ അവരെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.
chapters.nkjv: Then the captain went with the officers and brought them without violence, for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.
chapters.kjv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവരെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ന്യായാധിപസംഘത്തിന്മുമ്പാകെ നിറുത്തി; മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ അവരോടു:
chapters.niv: The apostles were brought in and made to appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest asked them,
chapters.kjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

chapters.ml: ഈ നാമത്തിൽ ഉപദേശിക്കരുതു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളോടു അമർച്ചയായി കല്പിച്ചുവല്ലോ; നിങ്ങളോ യെരൂശലേമിനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉപദേശംകൊണ്ടു നിറെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ആ മനുഷ്യന്റെ രക്തം ഞങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ വരുത്തുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നു. എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name," he said. "Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man’s blood."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Did we not strictly command you not to teach in this name? And look, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this Man’s blood on us!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പത്രൊസും ശേഷം അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും: മനുഷ്യരെക്കാൾ ദൈവത്തെ അനുസരിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Peter and the other apostles replied: "We must obey God rather than human beings!
chapters.nkjv: But Peter and the other apostles answered and said: "We ought to obey God rather than men.
chapters.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ മരത്തിൽ തൂക്കിക്കൊന്ന യേശുവിനെ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവം ഉയിർപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a cross.
chapters.nkjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus whom you murdered by hanging on a tree.
chapters.kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്നു മാനസാന്തരവും പാപമോചനവും നല്കുവാൻ ദൈവം അവനെ പ്രഭുവായും രക്ഷിതാവായും തന്റെ വലങ്കയ്യാൽ ഉയർത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might bring Israel to repentance and forgive their sins.
chapters.nkjv: Him God has exalted to His right hand tobe Prince and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.
chapters.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

chapters.ml: ഈ വസ്തുതെക്കു ഞങ്ങളും ദൈവം തന്നെ അനുസരിക്കുന്നവർക്കു നല്കിയ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവും സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him."
chapters.nkjv: And we are His witnesses to these things, and so also is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey Him."
chapters.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ കോപപരവശരായി അവരെ ഒടുക്കിക്കളവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.
chapters.nkjv: When they heard this, they were furious and plotted to kill them.
chapters.kjv: When they heard that , they were cut to the heart , and took counsel to slay them.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സർവ്വ ജനത്തിനും ബഹുമാനമുള്ള ധർമ്മോപദേഷ്ടാവായ ഗമാലീയേൽ എന്നൊരു പരീശൻ ന്യായധിപസംഘത്തിൽ എഴുന്നേറ്റു, അവരെ കുറെ നേരം പുറത്താക്കുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.
chapters.nkjv: Then one in the council stood up, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law held in respect by all the people, and commanded them to put the apostles outside for a little while.
chapters.kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ അവരോടു: യിസ്രായേൽ പുരുഷന്മാരെ, ഈ മനുഷ്യരുടെ കാര്യത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾ എന്തു ചെയ്യാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Then he addressed the Sanhedrin: "Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to them: "Men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what you intend to do regarding these men.
chapters.kjv: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

chapters.ml: ഈ നാളുകൾക്കു മുമ്പെ തദാസ് എന്നവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു താൻ മഹാൻ എന്നു നടിച്ചു; ഏകദേശം നാനൂറു പുരുഷന്മാർ അവനോടു ചേന്നുകൂടി; എങ്കിലും അവൻ നശിക്കയും അവനെ അനുസരിച്ചവർ എല്ലാവരും ചിന്നി ഒന്നുമില്ലാതാകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
chapters.nkjv: For some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody. A number of men, about four hundred, joined him. He was slain, and all who obeyed him were scattered and came to nothing.
chapters.kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശേഷം ഗലീലക്കാരനായ യൂദാ ചാർത്തലിന്റെ കാലത്തു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ജനത്തെ തന്റെ പക്ഷം ചേരുവാൻ വശീകരിച്ചു; അവനും നശിച്ചു, അവനെ അനുസരിച്ചവർ ഒക്കെയും ചിതറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
chapters.nkjv: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the census, and drew away many people after him. He also perished, and all who obeyed him were dispersed.
chapters.kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഈ മനുഷ്യരെ വിട്ടു ഒഴിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നു; ഈ ആലോചനയോ പ്രവൃത്തിയോ മാനുഷം എന്നു വരികിൽ അതു നശിച്ചുപോകും;
chapters.niv: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.
chapters.nkjv: And now I say to you, keep away from these men and let them alone; for if this plan or this work is of men, it will come to nothing;
chapters.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

chapters.ml: ദൈവികം എങ്കിലോ നിങ്ങൾക്കു അതു നശിപ്പിപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല; നിങ്ങൾ ദൈവത്തോടു പോരാടുന്നു എന്നു വരരുതല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God."
chapters.nkjv: but if it is of God, you cannot overthrow it—lest you even be found to fight against God."
chapters.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ അനുസരിച്ചു: അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരെ വരുത്തി അടിപ്പിച്ചു, ഇനി യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ സംസാരിക്കരുതു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു അവരെ വിട്ടയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: His speech persuaded them. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
chapters.nkjv: And they agreed with him, and when they had called for the apostles and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
chapters.kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

chapters.ml: തിരുനാമത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി അപമാനം സഹിപ്പാൻ യോഗ്യരായി എണ്ണപ്പെടുകയാൽ അവർ സന്തോഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ന്യായാധിപസംഘത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.
chapters.nkjv: So they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for His name.
chapters.kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ ദിനംപ്രതി ദൈവാലയത്തിലും വീടുതോറും വിടാതെ ഉപദേശിക്കയും യേശുവിനെ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു സുവിശേഷിക്കയും ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they did not cease teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ.
chapters.kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ പെരുകിവരുമ്പോൾ തങ്ങളുടെ വിധവമാരെ ദിനംപ്രതിയുള്ള ശുശ്രുഷയിൽ ഉപേക്ഷയായി വിചാരിച്ചു എന്നു യവനഭാഷക്കാർ എബ്രായഭാഷക്കാരുടെ നേരെ പിറുപിറുത്തു.
