chapters.niv: In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Hellenistic Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.
chapters.nkjv: Now in those days, when thenumberof the disciples was multiplying, there arose a complaint against the Hebrews by the Hellenists, because their widows were neglected in the daily distribution.
chapters.kjv: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

chapters.ml: പന്തിരുവർ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തെ വിളിച്ചുവരുത്തി: ഞങ്ങൾ ദൈവവചനം ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു മേശകളിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യുന്നതു യോഗ്യമല്ല.
chapters.niv: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, "It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.
chapters.nkjv: Then the twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, "It is not desirable that we should leave the word of God and serve tables.
chapters.kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ സഹോദരന്മാരേ, ആത്മാവും ജ്ഞാനവും നിറഞ്ഞു നല്ല സാക്ഷ്യമുള്ള ഏഴു പുരുഷന്മാരെ നിങ്ങളിൽ തന്നേ തിരഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ; അവരെ ഈ വേലെക്കു ആക്കാം.
chapters.niv: Brothers and sisters, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business;
chapters.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളോ പ്രാർത്ഥനയിലും വചനശുശ്രൂഷയിലും ഉറ്റിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word."
chapters.nkjv: but we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the word."
chapters.kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു ഒക്കെയും ബോദ്ധ്യമായി; വിശ്വാസവും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവും നിറഞ്ഞ പുരുഷനായ സ്തെഫാനൊസ്, ഫിലിപ്പൊസ്, പ്രൊഖൊരൊസ്, നിക്കാനോർ, തിമോൻ, പർമ്മെനാസ്, യെഹൂദമതാനുസാരിയായ അന്ത്യോക്യക്കാരൻ നിക്കൊലാവൊസ് എന്നിവരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു,
chapters.niv: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
chapters.nkjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte from Antioch,
chapters.kjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

chapters.ml: അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പാകെ നിറുത്തി; അവർ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു അവരുടെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
chapters.nkjv: whom they set before the apostles; and when they had prayed, they laid hands on them.
chapters.kjv: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

chapters.ml: ദൈവവചനം പരന്നു, യെരൂശലേമിൽ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ എണ്ണം ഏറ്റവും പെരുകി, പുരോഹിതന്മാരിലും വലിയോരു കൂട്ടം വിശ്വാസത്തിന്നു അധീനരായിത്തിർന്നു.
chapters.niv: So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.
chapters.nkjv: Then the word of God spread, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests were obedient to the faith.
chapters.kjv: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സ്തെഫാനൊസ് കൃപയും ശക്തിയും നിറഞ്ഞവനായി ജനത്തിൽ വലിയ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും അടയാളങ്ങളും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Now Stephen, a man full of God’s grace and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
chapters.nkjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.
chapters.kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

chapters.ml: ലിബർത്തീനർ എന്നു പേരുള്ള പള്ളിക്കാരിലും കുറേ നക്കാരിലും അലെക്സന്ത്രിയക്കാരിലും കിലിക്യ ആസ്യ എന്ന ദേശക്കാരിലും ചിലർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സ്തെഫനൊസിനോടു തർക്കിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)—Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia—who began to argue with Stephen.
chapters.nkjv: Then there arose some from what is called the Synagogue of the Freedmen (Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and those from Cilicia and Asia), disputing with Stephen.
chapters.kjv: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ സംസാരിച്ച ജ്ഞാനത്തോടും ആത്മാവോടും എതിർത്തുനില്പാൻ അവർക്കു കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: But they could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.
chapters.nkjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
chapters.kjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവർ ചില പുരുഷന്മാരെ വശത്താക്കി: ഇവൻ മോശെക്കും ദൈവത്തിന്നും വിരോധമായി ദൂഷണം പറയുന്നതു ഞങ്ങൾ കേട്ടു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, "We have heard Stephen speak blasphemous words against Moses and against God."
chapters.nkjv: Then they secretly induced men to say, "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God."
chapters.kjv: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

chapters.ml: ജനത്തേയും മൂപ്പന്മാരെയും ശാസ്ത്രിമാരെയും ഇളക്കി, അവന്റെ നേരെ ചെന്നു അവനെ പിടിച്ചു ന്യായാധിപസംഘത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടു പോയി
chapters.niv: So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.
chapters.nkjv: And they stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes; and they came upon him, seized him, and brought him to the council.
chapters.kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him , and caught him, and brought him to the council,

chapters.ml: കള്ളസ്സാക്ഷികളെ നിറുത്തി: ഈ മനുഷ്യൻ വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തിന്നും ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്നും വിരോധമായി ഇടവിടാതെ സംസാരിച്ചുവരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: They produced false witnesses, who testified, "This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
chapters.nkjv: They also set up false witnesses who said, "This man does not cease to speak blasphemous words against this holy place and the law;
chapters.kjv: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

chapters.ml: ആ നസറായനായ യേശു ഈ സ്ഥലം നശിപ്പിച്ചു മോശെ നമുക്കു ഏല്പിച്ച മാര്യാദകളെ മാറ്റിക്കളയും എന്നു അവൻ പറയുന്നതു ഞങ്ങൾ കേട്ടു എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us."
chapters.nkjv: for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs which Moses delivered to us."
chapters.kjv: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

chapters.ml: ന്യായധിപസംഘത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നവർ എല്ലാവരും അവനെ ഉറ്റുനോക്കി അവന്റെ മുഖം ഒരു ദൈവദൂതന്റെ മുഖം പോലെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
chapters.nkjv: And all who sat in the council, looking steadfastly at him, saw his face as the face of an angel.
chapters.kjv: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഉള്ളതു തന്നേയോ എന്നു മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Then the high priest asked Stephen, "Are these charges true?"
chapters.nkjv: Then the high priest said, "Are these things so?"
chapters.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരും പിതാക്കന്മാരുമായ പുരുഷന്മാരേ, കേൾപ്പിൻ. നമ്മുടെ പിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാം ഹാരനിൽ വന്നു പാർക്കും മുമ്പെ മെസൊപ്പൊത്താമ്യയിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ, തന്നേ തേജോമയനായ ദൈവം അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി:
chapters.niv: To this he replied: "Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Harran.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Brethren and fathers, listen: The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Haran,
chapters.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ദേശത്തെയും നിന്റെ ചാർച്ചക്കാരെയും വിട്ടു ഞാൻ നിനക്കു കാണിച്ചു തരുന്ന ദേശത്തിലേക്കു ചെല്ലുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അങ്ങനെ അവൻ കല്ദായരുടെ ദേശം വിട്ടു ഹാരാനിൽ വന്നു പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: ‘Leave your country and your people,’ God said, ‘and go to the land I will show you.’
chapters.nkjv: and said to him, ‘Get out of your country and from your relatives, and come to a land that I will show you.’
chapters.kjv: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ മരിച്ചശേഷം ദൈവം അവനെ അവിടെനിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ പാർക്കുന്ന ഈ ദേശത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പാർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "So he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Harran. After the death of his father, God sent him to this land where you are now living.
chapters.nkjv: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldeans and dwelt in Haran. And from there, when his father was dead, He moved him to this land in which you now dwell.
chapters.kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു അതിൽ ഒരു കാലടി നിലംപോലും അവകാശം കൊടുത്തില്ല; അവന്നു സന്തതിയില്ലാതിരിക്കെ അവന്നും അവന്റെ ശേഷം അവന്റെ സന്തതിക്കും അതിനെ കൈവശമായി നല്കുമെന്നു അവനോടു വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He gave him no inheritance here, not even enough ground to set his foot on. But God promised him that he and his descendants after him would possess the land, even though at that time Abraham had no child.
chapters.nkjv: And God gave him no inheritance in it, not even enough to set his foot on. But even when Abraham had no child, He promised to give it to him for a possession, and to his descendants after him.
chapters.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സന്തതി അന്യദേശത്തു ചെന്നു പാർക്കും; ആ ദേശക്കാർ അവരെ അടിമയാക്കി നാനൂറു സംവത്സരം പീഡീപ്പിക്കും എന്നു ദൈവം കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: God spoke to him in this way: ‘For four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated.
chapters.nkjv: But God spoke in this way: that his descendants would dwell in a foreign land, and that they would bring them into bondage and oppress them four hundred years.
chapters.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

chapters.ml: അവർ സേവിക്കുന്ന ജാതിയെ ഞാൻ ന്യായം വിധിക്കും; അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവർ പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു ഈ സ്ഥലത്തു എന്നെ സേവിക്കും എന്നു ദൈവം അരുളിചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come out of that country and worship me in this place.’
chapters.nkjv: ‘And the nation to whom they will be in bondage I will judge,’ said God, ‘and after that they shall come out and serve Me in this place.’
chapters.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവന്നു പരിച്ഛേദനയെന്ന നിയമം കൊടുത്തു; അങ്ങനെ അവൻ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു, എട്ടാം നാൾ പരിച്ഛേദന ചെയ്തു. യിസ്ഹാക്ക്ക് യാക്കോബിനെയും യാക്കോബ് പന്ത്രണ്ടു ഗോത്രപിതാക്കന്മാരെയും ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. And Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him eight days after his birth. Later Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
chapters.nkjv: Then He gave him the covenant of circumcision; and so Abraham begot Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day; and Isaac begot Jacob, and Jacob begot the twelve patriarchs.
chapters.kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

chapters.ml: ഗോത്രപിതാക്കന്മാർ യോസേഫിനോടു അസൂയപ്പെട്ടു അവനെ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു വിറ്റുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
chapters.nkjv: "And the patriarchs, becoming envious, sold Joseph into Egypt. But God was with him
chapters.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവം അവനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു സകലസങ്കടങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും അവനെ വിടുവിച്ചു മിസ്രയീംരാജാവായ ഫറവോന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അവന്നു കൃപയും ജ്ഞാനവും കൊടുത്തു: അവൻ അവനെ മിസ്രയീമിന്നും തന്റെ സർവ്വഗൃഹത്തിന്നും അധിപതിയാക്കിവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and rescued him from all his troubles. He gave Joseph wisdom and enabled him to gain the goodwill of Pharaoh king of Egypt. So Pharaoh made him ruler over Egypt and all his palace.
chapters.nkjv: and delivered him out of all his troubles, and gave him favor and wisdom in the presence of Pharaoh, king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
chapters.kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിലും കനാനിലും എല്ലാം ക്ഷാമവും മഹാകഷ്ടവും വന്നാറെ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കു ആഹാരം കിട്ടാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: "Then a famine struck all Egypt and Canaan, bringing great suffering, and our ancestors could not find food.
chapters.nkjv: Now a famine and great trouble came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers found no sustenance.
chapters.kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രായീമിൽ ധാന്യം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു കേട്ടിട്ടു യാക്കോബ് നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ ഒന്നാം പ്രാവശ്യം അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our forefathers on their first visit.
chapters.nkjv: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
chapters.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം പ്രാവശ്യം യോസേഫ് തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു തന്നെത്താൻ അറിയിച്ചു യോസേഫിന്റെ വംശം ഫറവോന്നു വെളിവായ്‍വന്നു.
chapters.niv: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.
chapters.nkjv: And the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family became known to the Pharaoh.
chapters.kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

chapters.ml: യോസേഫ് ആളയച്ചു തന്റെ പിതാവായ യാക്കോബിനെയും കുടുംബത്തെ ഒക്കെയും വരുത്തി; അവർ ആകെ എഴുപത്തഞ്ചുപേരായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.
chapters.nkjv: Then Joseph sent and called his father Jacob and all his relatives to him, seventy-five people.
chapters.kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him , and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

chapters.ml: യാക്കോബ്, മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു പോയി; അവനും നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരും മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.
chapters.nkjv: So Jacob went down to Egypt; and he died, he and our fathers.
chapters.kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

chapters.ml: അവരെ ശെഖേമിൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ശെഖേമിൽ എമ്മോരിന്റെ മക്കളോടു അബ്രഹാം വിലകൊടുത്തു വാങ്ങിയ കല്ലറയിൽ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.
chapters.nkjv: And they were carried back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a sum of money from the sons of Hamor, thefather of Shechem.
chapters.kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വാഗ്ദത്ത കാലം അടുത്തപ്പോൾ ജനം മിസ്രയീമിൽ വർദ്ധിച്ചു പെരുകി.
chapters.niv: "As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
chapters.nkjv: "But when the time of the promise drew near which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt
chapters.kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

chapters.ml: ഒടുവിൽ യോസേഫിനെ അറിയാത്ത വേറൊരു രാജാവു മിസ്രയീമിൽ വാണു.
chapters.niv: Then ‘a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.’
chapters.nkjv: till another king arose who did not know Joseph.
chapters.kjv: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നമ്മുടെ വംശത്തോടു ഉപായം പ്രയോഗിച്ചു നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ പീഡിപ്പിച്ചു, അവരുടെ ശിശുക്കൾ ജീവനോടെ ഇരിക്കരുതു എന്നുവെച്ച അവരെ പുറത്തിടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our ancestors by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.
chapters.nkjv: This man dealt treacherously with our people, and oppressed our forefathers, making them expose their babies, so that they might not live.
chapters.kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു മോശെ ജനിച്ചു, ദിവ്യസുന്ദരനായിരുന്നു; അവനെ മൂന്നു മാസം അപ്പന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പോറ്റി.
chapters.niv: "At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for by his family.
chapters.nkjv: At this time Moses was born, and was well pleasing to God; and he was brought up in his father’s house for three months.
chapters.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവനെ പുറത്തിട്ടപ്പോൾ ഫറവോന്റെ മകൾ അവനെ എടുത്തു തന്റെ മകനായി വളർത്തി.
chapters.niv: When he was placed outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
chapters.nkjv: But when he was set out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him away and brought him up as her own son.
chapters.kjv: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

chapters.ml: മോശെ മിസ്രയീമ്യരുടെ സകല ജ്ഞാനവും അഭ്യസിച്ചു വാക്കിലും പ്രവൃത്തിയിലും സമർത്ഥനായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and deeds.
chapters.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു നാല്പതു വയസ്സു തികയാറായപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളായ തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ ചെന്നു കാണേണം എന്നു മനസ്സിൽ തോന്നി.
chapters.niv: "When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites.
chapters.nkjv: "Now when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren, the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ അന്യായം ഏല്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു അവന്നു തുണ നിന്നു, മിസ്രയീമ്യനെ അടിച്ചു കൊന്നു, പീഡിതന്നു വേണ്ടി പ്രതിക്രിയ ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.
chapters.nkjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended and avenged him who was oppressed, and struck down the Egyptian.
chapters.kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

chapters.ml: ദൈവം താൻ മുഖാന്തരം അവർക്കു രക്ഷ നല്കും എന്നു സഹോദരന്മാർ ഗ്രഹിക്കും എന്നു അവൻ നിരൂപിച്ചു; എങ്കിലും അവർ ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.
chapters.nkjv: For he supposed that his brethren would have understood that God would deliver them by his hand, but they did not understand.
chapters.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവർ കലഹിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു: പുരുഷന്മാരെ, നിങ്ങൾ സഹോദരന്മാരല്ലോ; തമ്മിൽ അന്യായം ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവരെ സമാധാനപ്പെടുത്തുവാൻ നോക്കി.
chapters.niv: The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?’
chapters.nkjv: And the next day he appeared to twoof them as they were fighting, and triedto reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brethren; why do you wrong one another?’
chapters.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ കൂട്ടുകാരനോടു അന്യായം ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ അവനെ ഉന്തിക്കളഞ്ഞു: നിന്നെ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അധികാരിയും ന്യായകർത്താവും ആക്കിയതു ആർ?
chapters.niv: "But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
chapters.nkjv: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
chapters.kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

chapters.ml: ഇന്നലെ മിസ്രയീമ്യനെ കൊന്നതുപോലെ എന്നെയും കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഭാവിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
chapters.nkjv: Do you want to kill me as you did the Egyptian yesterday?’
chapters.kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കു കേട്ടിട്ടു മോശെ ഓടിപ്പോയി മിദ്യാൻ ദേശത്തു ചെന്നു പാർത്തു, അവിടെ രണ്ടു പുത്രന്മാരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.
chapters.nkjv: Then, at this saying, Moses fled and became a dweller in the land of Midian, where he had two sons.
chapters.kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.

chapters.ml: നാല്പതാണ്ടു കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ സീനായ്മലയുടെ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ ഒരു ദൈവദൂതൻ മുൾപടർപ്പിലെ അഗ്നിജ്വാലയിൽ അവന്നു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: "After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
chapters.nkjv: "And when forty years had passed, an Angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire in a bush, in the wilderness of Mount Sinai.
chapters.kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

chapters.ml: മോശെ ആ ദർശനം കണ്ടു ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു, സൂക്ഷിച്ചുനോക്കുവാൻ അടുത്തുചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ:
chapters.niv: When he saw this, he was amazed at the sight. As he went over to get a closer look, he heard the Lord say:
chapters.nkjv: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight; and as he drew near to observe, the voice of the Lord came to him,
chapters.kjv: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ ദൈവമായി അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെയും യിസ്ഹാക്കിന്റെയും യാക്കോബിന്റെയും ദൈവം ആകുന്നു എന്നു കർത്താവിന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടു. മോശെ വിറെച്ചിട്ടു നോക്കുവാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
chapters.nkjv: saying, ‘I am the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ And Moses trembled and dared not look.
chapters.kjv: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു അവനോടു: നീ നില്ക്കുന്ന സ്ഥലം വിശുദ്ധ ഭൂമിയാകയാൽ കാലിൽനിന്നു ചെരിപ്പു ഊരിക്കളക.
chapters.niv: "Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
chapters.nkjv: ‘Then the Lord said to him, "Take your sandals off your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
chapters.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിൽ എന്റെ ജനത്തിന്റെ പീഡ ഞാൻ കണ്ടു കണ്ടു, അവരുടെ ഞരക്കവും കേട്ടു, അവരെ വിടുവിപ്പാൻ ഇറങ്ങിവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ വരിക; ഞാൻ നിന്നെ മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു അയക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I have indeed seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to set them free. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
chapters.nkjv: I have surely seen the oppression of My people who are in Egypt; I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you to Egypt." ’
chapters.kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

chapters.ml: നിന്നെ അധികാരിയും ന്യായകർത്താവും ആക്കിയതാർ എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവർ തള്ളിപ്പറഞ്ഞ ഈ മോശെയെ ദൈവം മുൾപടർപ്പിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷനായ ദൂതൻ മുഖാന്തരം അധികാരിയും വീണ്ടെടുപ്പുകാരനും ആക്കി അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "This is the same Moses they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ He was sent to be their ruler and deliverer by God himself, through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
chapters.nkjv: "This Moses whom they rejected, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’ is the one God sent tobe a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the Angel who appeared to him in the bush.
chapters.kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മിസ്രയീമിലും ചെങ്കടലിലും നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം മരുഭൂമിയിലും അതിശയങ്ങളും അടയാളങ്ങളും ചെയ്തു അവരെ നടത്തിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: He led them out of Egypt and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.
chapters.nkjv: He brought them out, after he had shown wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
chapters.kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ നിന്നു എന്നെപ്പോലെ ഒരു പ്രവാചകനെ നിങ്ങൾക്കു എഴന്നേല്പിച്ചുതരും എന്നു യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കളോടു പറഞ്ഞ മോശെ അവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: "This is the Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people.’
chapters.nkjv: "This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from your brethren. Him you shall hear.’
chapters.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

chapters.ml: സീനായ്മലയിൽ തന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ച ദൂതനോടും നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടും കൂടെ മരുഭൂമിയിലെ സഭയിൽ ഇരുന്നവനും നമുക്കു തരുവാൻ ജീവനുള്ള അരുളപ്പാടു ലഭിച്ചവനും അവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: He was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors; and he received living words to pass on to us.
chapters.nkjv: "This is he who was in the congregation in the wilderness with the Angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, the one who received the living oracles to give to us,
chapters.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ അവന്നു കീഴ്പെടുവാൻ മനസ്സില്ലാതെ അവനെ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു ഹൃദയംകെണ്ടു മിസ്രയീമിലേക്കു പിന്തിരിഞ്ഞു, അഹരോനോടു:
chapters.niv: "But our ancestors refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
chapters.nkjv: whom our fathers would not obey, but rejected. And in their hearts they turned back to Egypt,
chapters.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾക്കു മുമ്പായി നടപ്പാൻ ദൈവങ്ങളെ ഉണ്ടാക്കിത്തരിക; ഞങ്ങളെ മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു നടത്തിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ആ മോശെക്കു എന്തു സംഭവിച്ചു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They told Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who led us out of Egypt—we don’t know what has happened to him!’
chapters.nkjv: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods to go before us; asfor this Moses who brought us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.’
chapters.kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

chapters.ml: അന്നേരം അവർ ഒരു കാളക്കുട്ടിയെ ഉണ്ടാക്കി, ആ ബിംബത്തിന്നു ബലി കഴിച്ചു തങ്ങളുടെ കൈപ്പണിയിൽ ഉല്ലസിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and reveled in what their own hands had made.
chapters.nkjv: And they made a calf in those days, offered sacrifices to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
chapters.kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

chapters.ml: ദൈവവും പിന്തിരിഞ്ഞു. ആകാശത്തിലെ സൈന്യത്തെ ആരാധിപ്പാൻ അവരെ കൈവിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the sun, moon and stars. This agrees with what is written in the book of the prophets: " ‘Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?
chapters.nkjv: Then God turned and gave them up to worship the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the Prophets: ‘Did you offer Me slaughtered animals and sacrifices during forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
chapters.kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

chapters.ml: “യിസ്രായേൽ ഗൃഹമേ, നിങ്ങൾ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ എനിക്കു നാല്പതു സംവത്സരം ഹനനയാഗങ്ങളും ഭോജനയാഗങ്ങളും അർപ്പിച്ചുവോ? നിങ്ങൾ നമസ്കരിപ്പാൻ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ സ്വരൂപങ്ങളായ മൊലോക്കിന്റെ കൂടാരവും രേഫാൻ ദേവന്റെ നക്ഷത്രവും നിങ്ങൾ എടുത്തു നടന്നുവല്ലോ; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളെ ബാബിലോന്നപ്പുറം പ്രവസിപ്പിക്കും” എന്നു പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You have taken up the tabernacle of Molek and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile’ beyond Babylon.
chapters.nkjv: You also took up the tabernacle of Moloch, And the star of your god Remphan, Images which you made to worship; And I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
chapters.kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

chapters.ml: നീ കണ്ട മാതിരിക്കൊത്തവണ്ണം അതിനെ തീർക്കേണം എന്നു മോശെയോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തവൻ കല്പിച്ചതു പോലെ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ സാക്ഷ്യകൂടാരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Our ancestors had the tabernacle of the covenant law with them in the wilderness. It had been made as God directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
chapters.nkjv: "Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as He appointed, instructing Moses to make it according to the pattern that he had seen,
chapters.kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ അതു ഏറ്റു വാങ്ങി ദൈവം നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പിൽനിന്നു നീക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞ ജാതികളുടെ അവകാശത്തിലേക്കു യോശുവയുമായി കൊണ്ടുവന്നു ദാവീദിന്റെ കാലംവരെ വെച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: After receiving the tabernacle, our ancestors under Joshua brought it with them when they took the land from the nations God drove out before them. It remained in the land until the time of David,
chapters.nkjv: which our fathers, having received it in turn, also brought with Joshua into the land possessed by the Gentiles, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers until the days of David,
chapters.kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കൃപലഭിച്ചു, യാക്കോബിന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു ഒരു വാസസ്ഥലം ഉണ്ടാക്കുവാൻ അനുവാദം അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: who enjoyed God’s favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
chapters.nkjv: who found favor before God and asked to find a dwelling for the God of Jacob.
chapters.kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

chapters.ml: ശലോമോൻ അവന്നു ഒരു ആലയം പണിതു.
chapters.niv: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.
chapters.nkjv: But Solomon built Him a house.
chapters.kjv: But Solomon built him an house.

chapters.ml: അത്യുന്നതൻ കൈപ്പണിയായതിൽ വസിക്കുന്നില്ലതാനും
chapters.niv: "However, the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
chapters.nkjv: "However, the Most High does not dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says:
chapters.kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

chapters.ml: “സ്വർഗ്ഗം എനിക്കു സിംഹാസനവും ഭൂമി എന്റെ പാദപീഠവും ആകുന്നു. നിങ്ങൾ എനിക്കു പണിയുന്ന ആലയം ഏതുവിധം?
chapters.niv: " ‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? says the Lord. Or where will my resting place be?
chapters.nkjv: ‘Heaven is My throne, And earth is My footstool. What house will you build for Me? says the Lord, Or what is the place of My rest?
chapters.kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വിശ്രമസ്ഥലവും ഏതു? ഇതൊക്കെയും എന്റെ കൈയല്ലയോ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയതു എന്നു കർത്താവു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു” എന്നു പ്രവാചകൻ പറയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Has not my hand made all these things?’
chapters.nkjv: Has My hand not made all these things?’
chapters.kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?

chapters.ml: ശാഠ്യക്കാരും ഹൃദയത്തിന്നും ചെവിക്കും പരിച്ഛേദന ഇല്ലാത്തവരുമായുള്ളോരേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെ തന്നേ നിങ്ങളും എല്ലായ്പോഴും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനോടു മറുത്തു നില്ക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "You stiff-necked people! Your hearts and ears are still uncircumcised. You are just like your ancestors: You always resist the Holy Spirit!
chapters.nkjv: "You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you.
chapters.kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did , so do ye.

chapters.ml: പ്രവാചകന്മാരിൽ ഏവനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ ഉപദ്രവിക്കാതിരുന്നിട്ടുള്ളു? നീതിമാനായവന്റെ വരവിനെക്കുറിച്ചു മുൻഅറിയിച്ചവരെ അവർ കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Was there ever a prophet your ancestors did not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One. And now you have betrayed and murdered him—
chapters.nkjv: Which of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? And they killed those who foretold the coming of the Just One, of whom you now have become the betrayers and murderers,
chapters.kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

chapters.ml: അവന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ ദ്രോഹികളും കുലപാതകരും ആയിത്തീർന്നു; നിങ്ങൾ ദൈവദൂതന്മാരുടെ നിയോഗങ്ങളായി ന്യായപ്രമാണം പ്രാപിച്ചു എങ്കിലും അതു പ്രമാണിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: you who have received the law that was given through angels but have not obeyed it."
chapters.nkjv: who have received the law by the direction of angels and have not kept it."
chapters.kjv: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ അവർ കോപപരവശരായി അവന്റെ നേരെ പല്ലുകടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the members of the Sanhedrin heard this, they were furious and gnashed their teeth at him.
chapters.nkjv: When they heard these things they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
chapters.kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

chapters.ml: അവനോ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിറഞ്ഞവനായി സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കു ഉറ്റുനോക്കി, ദൈവമഹത്വവും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു യേശു നില്ക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
chapters.nkjv: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God,
chapters.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, സ്വർഗ്ഗം തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്നതും മനുഷ്യപുത്രൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വലത്തു ഭാഗത്തു നില്ക്കുന്നതും ഞാൻ കാണുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Look," he said, "I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God."
chapters.nkjv: and said, "Look! I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!"
chapters.kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു, ചെവി പൊത്തിക്കൊണ്ടു ഒന്നിച്ചു അവന്റെ നേരെ പാഞ്ഞുചെന്നു,
chapters.niv: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,
chapters.nkjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, stopped their ears, and ran at him with one accord;
chapters.kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

chapters.ml: അവനെ നഗരത്തിൽനിന്നു തള്ളി പുറത്താക്കി കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു. സാക്ഷികൾ തങ്ങളുടെ വസ്ത്രം ശൌൽ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile, the witnesses laid their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
chapters.nkjv: and they cast him out of the city and stoned him. And the witnesses laid down their clothes at the feet of a young man named Saul.
chapters.kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവായ യേശുവേ, എന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളേണമേ എന്നു സ്തെഫാനോസ് വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കയിൽ അവർ അവനെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."
chapters.nkjv: And they stoned Stephen as he was calling on God and saying, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."
chapters.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God , and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

chapters.ml: അവനോ മുട്ടുകുത്തി: കർത്താവേ, അവർക്കു ഈ പാപം നിറുത്തരുതേ എന്നു ഉച്ചത്തിൽ നിലവിളിച്ചു. ഇതു പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ നിദ്രപ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then he fell on his knees and cried out, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them." When he had said this, he fell asleep.
chapters.nkjv: Then he knelt down and cried out with a loud voice, "Lord, do not charge them with this sin." And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
chapters.kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കുലചെയ്തതു ശൌലിന്നു സമ്മതമായിരുന്നു. അന്നു യെരൂശലേമിലെ സഭെക്കു ഒരു വലിയ ഉപദ്രവം നേരിട്ടു; അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ ഒഴികെ എല്ലാവരും യെഹുദ്യ ശമര്യ ദേശങ്ങളിൽ ചിതറിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: And Saul approved of their killing him. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: Now Saul was consenting to his death. At that time a great persecution arose against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
chapters.kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.

chapters.ml: ഭക്തിയുള്ള പുരുഷന്മാർ സ്തെഫാനൊസിനെ അടക്കം ചെയ്തു. അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു വലിയൊരു പ്രലാപം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Godly men buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him.
chapters.nkjv: And devout men carried Stephen tohisburial, and made great lamentation over him.
chapters.kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശൌൽ വീടുതോറും ചെന്നു പുരുഷന്മാരെയും സ്ത്രീകളെയും പിടിച്ചിഴച്ചു തടവിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു സഭയെ മുടിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off both men and women and put them in prison.
chapters.nkjv: As for Saul, he made havoc of the church, entering every house, and dragging off men and women, committing them to prison.
chapters.kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

chapters.ml: ചിതറിപ്പോയവർ വചനം സുവിശേഷിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു അവിടവിടെ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore those who were scattered went everywhere preaching the word.
chapters.kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പൊസ് ശമര്യപട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെന്നു അവരോടു ക്രിസ്തുവിനെ പ്രസംഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah there.
chapters.nkjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria and preached Christ to them.
chapters.kjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പൊസ് ചെയ്ത അടയാളങ്ങളെ പുരുഷാരങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കയും കാൺകയും ചെയ്കയാൽ അവൻ പറയുന്നതു ഏകമനസ്സോടെ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the crowds heard Philip and saw the signs he performed, they all paid close attention to what he said.
chapters.nkjv: And the multitudes with one accord heeded the things spoken by Philip, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
chapters.kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

chapters.ml: അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കൾ ബാധിച്ച പലരിൽനിന്നും അവ ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അനേകം പക്ഷവാതക്കാരും മുടന്തരും സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For with shrieks, impure spirits came out of many, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.
chapters.nkjv: For unclean spirits, crying with a loud voice, came out of many who were possessed; and many who were paralyzed and lame were healed.
chapters.kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ആ പട്ടണത്തിൽ വളരെ സന്തോഷം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: So there was great joy in that city.
chapters.nkjv: And there was great joy in that city.
chapters.kjv: And there was great joy in that city.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശിമോൻ എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു പുരുഷൻ ആ പട്ടണത്തിൽ ആഭിചാരം ചെയ്തു, താൻ മഹാൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ശമര്യജാതിയെ ഭ്രമിപ്പിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now for some time a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and amazed all the people of Samaria. He boasted that he was someone great,
chapters.nkjv: But there was a certain man called Simon, who previously practiced sorcery in the city and astonished the people of Samaria, claiming that he was someone great,
chapters.kjv: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ മഹതി എന്ന ദൈവശക്തി ആകുന്നു എന്നും പറഞ്ഞു ആബാലവൃദ്ധം എല്ലാവരും അവനെ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: and all the people, both high and low, gave him their attention and exclaimed, "This man is rightly called the Great Power of God."
chapters.nkjv: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, "This man is the great power of God."
chapters.kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ ആഭിചാരംകൊണ്ടു ഏറിയ കാലം അവരെ ഭ്രമിപ്പിക്കയാൽ അത്രേ അവർ അവനെ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: They followed him because he had amazed them for a long time with his sorcery.
chapters.nkjv: And they heeded him because he had astonished them with his sorceries for a long time.
chapters.kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെയും യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നാമത്തെയും കുറിച്ചുള്ള സുവിശേഷം അറിയിക്കുന്ന ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനെ അവർ വിശ്വസിച്ചപ്പോൾ പുരുഷന്മാരും സ്ത്രീകളും സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
chapters.nkjv: But when they believed Philip as he preached the things concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.
chapters.kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

chapters.ml: ശിമോൻ താനും വിശ്വസിച്ചു സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനോടു ചേർന്നു നിന്നു, വലിയ വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികളും അടയാളങ്ങളും നടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു ഭ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Simon himself believed and was baptized. And he followed Philip everywhere, astonished by the great signs and miracles he saw.
chapters.nkjv: Then Simon himself also believed; and when he was baptized he continued with Philip, and was amazed, seeing the miracles and signs which were done.
chapters.kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം യെരൂശലേമിലുള്ള അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ, ശമര്യർ ദൈവവചനം കൈക്കൊണ്ടു എന്നു കേട്ടു പത്രൊസിനെയും യോഹന്നാനെയും അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to Samaria.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
chapters.kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

chapters.ml: അവർ ചെന്നു, അവർക്കു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർക്കായി പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they arrived, they prayed for the new believers there that they might receive the Holy Spirit,
chapters.nkjv: who, when they had come down, prayed for them that they might receive the Holy Spirit.
chapters.kjv: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

chapters.ml: അന്നുവരെ അവരിൽ ആരുടെമേലും ആത്മാവു വന്നിരുന്നില്ല; അവർ കർത്താവായ യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ സ്നാനം ഏറ്റിരുന്നതേയുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: For as yet He had fallen upon none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.kjv: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

chapters.ml: അവർ അവരുടെമേൽ കൈ വെച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർക്കു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: Then they laid hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
chapters.kjv: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ കൈ വെച്ചതിനാൽ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ലഭിച്ചതു ശിമോൻ കണ്ടാറെ അവർക്കു ദ്രവ്യം കൊണ്ടു വന്നു:
chapters.niv: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given at the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money
chapters.nkjv: And when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,
chapters.kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ഒരുത്തന്റെ മേൽ കൈ വെച്ചാൽ അവന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ലഭിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഈ അധികാരം എനിക്കും തരേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said, "Give me also this ability so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Give me this power also, that anyone on whom I lay hands may receive the Holy Spirit."
chapters.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാനം പണത്തിന്നു വാങ്ങിക്കൊള്ളാം എന്നു നീ നിരൂപിക്കകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ പണം നിന്നോടുകൂടെ നശിച്ചുപോകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Peter answered: "May your money perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
chapters.nkjv: But Peter said to him, "Your money perish with you, because you thought that the gift of God could be purchased with money!
chapters.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

chapters.ml: നിന്റെ ഹൃദയം ദൈവ സന്നിധിയിൽ നേരുള്ളതല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഈ കാര്യത്തിൽ നിനക്കു പങ്കും ഓഹരിയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
chapters.nkjv: You have neither part nor portion in this matter, for your heart is not right in the sight of God.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

chapters.ml: നീ ഈ വഷളത്വം വിട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടു കർത്താവിനോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിക്ക; പക്ഷെ നിന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിലെ നിരൂപണം ക്ഷമിച്ചുകിട്ടുമായിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord in the hope that he may forgive you for having such a thought in your heart.
chapters.nkjv: Repent therefore of this your wickedness, and pray God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
chapters.kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

chapters.ml: നീ കൈപ്പുള്ള പകയിലും അനീതിയുടെ ബന്ധനത്തിലും അകപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin."
chapters.nkjv: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and bound by iniquity."
chapters.kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

chapters.ml: എന്നു ഞാൻ കാണുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അതിന്നു ശിമോൻ: നിങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞതു ഒന്നും എനിക്കു ഭവിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ കർത്താവിനോടു എനിക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പിൻ എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Simon answered, "Pray to the Lord for me so that nothing you have said may happen to me."
chapters.nkjv: Then Simon answered and said, "Pray to the Lord for me, that none of the things which you have spoken may come upon me."
chapters.kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

chapters.ml: അവർ കർത്താവിന്റെ വചനം സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചു പ്രസംഗിച്ചശേഷം ശമര്യക്കാരുടെ അനേക ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിൽ സുവിശേഷം അറിയിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: After they had further proclaimed the word of the Lord and testified about Jesus, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many Samaritan villages.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
chapters.kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം കർത്താവിന്റെ ദൂതൻ ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനോടു: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു തെക്കോട്ടു യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നു ഗസെക്കുള്ള നിർജ്ജനമായ വഴിയിലേക്കു പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, "Go south to the road—the desert road—that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza."
chapters.nkjv: Now an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, "Arise and go toward the south along the road which goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza." This is desert.
chapters.kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു ചെന്നപ്പോൾ കന്ദക്ക എന്ന ഐത്യോപ്യാ രാജ്ഞിയുടെ ഒരു ഷണ്ഡനും മഹാനും അവളുടെ സകലഭണ്ഡാരത്തിന്നും മേൽവിചാരകനുമായ ഒരു ഐത്യോപ്യനെ കണ്ടു. അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നമസ്കരിപ്പാൻ വന്നിട്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോകയിൽ
chapters.niv: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of the Kandake (which means "queen of the Ethiopians"). This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
chapters.nkjv: So he arose and went. And behold, a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace the queen of the Ethiopians, who had charge of all her treasury, and had come to Jerusalem to worship,
chapters.kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

chapters.ml: തേരിൽ ഇരുന്നു യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്റെ പുസ്തകം വായിക്കയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and on his way home was sitting in his chariot reading the Book of Isaiah the prophet.
chapters.nkjv: was returning. And sitting in his chariot, he was reading Isaiah the prophet.
chapters.kjv: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനോടു: നീ അടുത്തുചെന്നു തേരിനോടു ചേർന്നുനടക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Spirit told Philip, "Go to that chariot and stay near it."
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit said to Philip, "Go near and overtake this chariot."
chapters.kjv: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പൊസ് ഓടിച്ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ യെശയ്യാപ്രവാചകന്റെ പുസ്തകം വായിക്കുന്നതു കേട്ടു: നീ വായിക്കുന്നതു ഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നുവോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു:
chapters.niv: Then Philip ran up to the chariot and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. "Do you understand what you are reading?" Philip asked.
chapters.nkjv: So Philip ran to him, and heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, "Do you understand what you are reading?"
chapters.kjv: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

chapters.ml: ഒരുത്തൻ പൊരുൾ തിരിച്ചുതരാഞ്ഞാൽ എങ്ങനെ ഗ്രഹിക്കും എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു, ഫിലിപ്പൊസ് കയറി തന്നോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: "How can I," he said, "unless someone explains it to me?" So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "How can I, unless someone guides me?" And he asked Philip to come up and sit with him.
chapters.kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

chapters.ml: തിരുവെഴുത്തിൽ അവൻ വായിച്ച ഭാഗമാവിതു:
chapters.niv: This is the passage of Scripture the eunuch was reading: "He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before its shearer is silent, so he did not open his mouth.
chapters.nkjv: The place in the Scripture which he read was this: "He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; And as a lamb before its shearer is silent, So He opened not His mouth.
chapters.kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

chapters.ml: “അറുക്കുവാനുള്ള ആടിനെപ്പോലെ അവനെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി; രോമം കത്രിക്കുന്നവന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ മിണ്ടാതിരിക്കുന്ന കുഞ്ഞാടിനെപ്പോലെ അവൻ വായ് തുറക്കാതിരുന്നു. അവന്റെ താഴ്ചയിൽ അവന്നു ന്യായം കിട്ടാതെ പോയി; അവന്റെ തലമുറയെ ആർ വിവരിക്കും? ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു അവന്റെ ജീവനെ എടുത്തുകളയുന്നുവല്ലോ”
chapters.niv: In his humiliation he was deprived of justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth."
chapters.nkjv: In His humiliation His justice was taken away, And who will declare His generation? For His life is taken from the earth."
chapters.kjv: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

chapters.ml: ഷണ്ഡൻ ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനോടു: ഇതു പ്രവാചകൻ ആരെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയുന്നു? തന്നെക്കുറിച്ചോ മറ്റൊരുത്തനെക്കുറിച്ചോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുതരേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The eunuch asked Philip, "Tell me, please, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?"
chapters.nkjv: So the eunuch answered Philip and said, "I ask you, of whom does the prophet say this, of himself or of some other man?"
chapters.kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പൊസ് ഈ തിരുവെഴുത്തു ആധാരമാക്കി അവനോടു യേശുവിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള സുവിശേഷം അറിയിപ്പാൻ തുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning at this Scripture, preached Jesus to him.
chapters.kjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇങ്ങനെ വഴിപോകയിൽ വെള്ളമുള്ളോരു സ്ഥലത്തു എത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഷണ്ഡൻ: ഇതാ വെള്ളം ഞാൻ സ്നാനം ഏല്ക്കുന്നതിന്നു എന്തു വിരോധം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, "Look, here is water. What can stand in the way of my being baptized?"
chapters.nkjv: Now as they went down the road, they came to some water. And the eunuch said, "See, hereis water. What hinders me from being baptized?"
chapters.kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

chapters.ml: (അതിന്നു ഫിലിപ്പൊസ്: നീ പൂർണ്ണ ഹൃദയത്തോടെ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ആകാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. യേശുക്രിസ്തു ദൈവപുത്രൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു).
chapters.niv: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.
chapters.nkjv: Then Philip said, "If you believe with all your heart, you may." And he answered and said, "I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God."
chapters.kjv: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ തേർ നിർത്തുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു; ഫിലിപ്പൊസും ഷണ്ഡനും ഇരുവരും വെള്ളത്തിൽ ഇറങ്ങി, അവൻ അവനെ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on his way rejoicing.
chapters.nkjv: So he commanded the chariot to stand still. And both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and he baptized him.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

chapters.ml: അവർ വെള്ളത്തിൽ നിന്നു കയറിയപ്പോൾ കർത്താവിന്റെ ആത്മാവു ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനെ എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോയി; ഷണ്ഡൻ അവനെ പിന്നെ കണ്ടില്ല; അവൻ സന്തോഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു തന്റെ വഴിക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled about, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, so that the eunuch saw him no more; and he went on his way rejoicing.
chapters.kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

chapters.ml: ഫിലിപ്പൊസിനെ പിന്നെ അസ്തോദിൽ കണ്ടു; അവൻ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു എല്ലാ പട്ടണങ്ങളിലും സുവിശേഷം അറിയിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു കൈസര്യയിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.nkjv: But Philip was found at Azotus. And passing through, he preached in all the cities till he came to Caesarea.
chapters.kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Cæsarea.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ കർത്താവിന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ നേരെ ഭീഷണിയും കുലയും നിശ്വസിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു,
chapters.niv: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. He went to the high priest
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul, still breathing threats and murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
chapters.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

chapters.ml: ദമസ്കൊസിൽ ഈ മാർഗ്ഗക്കാരായ വല്ല പുരുഷന്മാരെയോ സ്ത്രീകളെയോ കണ്ടാൽ അവരെ പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടി യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുവരുവാന്തക്കവണ്ണം അവിടത്തെ പള്ളികൾക്കു അവനോടു അധികാരപത്രം വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: and asked letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, so that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പ്രയാണം ചെയ്തു ദമസ്കൊസിന്നു സമീപിച്ചപ്പോൾ പെട്ടെന്നു ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു ഒരു വെളിച്ചം അവന്റെ ചുറ്റും മിന്നി;
chapters.niv: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
chapters.nkjv: As he journeyed he came near Damascus, and suddenly a light shone around him from heaven.
chapters.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

chapters.ml: അവൻ നിലത്തു വീണു; ശൌലെ, ശൌലേ, നീ എന്നെ ഉപദ്രവിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു എന്നു തന്നോടു പറയുന്ന ഒരു ശബ്ദം കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, "Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?"
chapters.nkjv: Then he fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to him, "Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?"
chapters.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

chapters.ml: നീ ആരാകുന്നു, കർത്താവേ, എന്നു അവൻ ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: നീ ഉപദ്രവിക്കുന്ന യേശു ആകുന്നു ഞാൻ.
chapters.niv: "Who are you, Lord?" Saul asked. "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting," he replied.
chapters.nkjv: And he said, "Who are You, Lord?" Then the Lord said, "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.It is hard for you to kick against the goads."
chapters.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

chapters.ml: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുക; നീ ചെയ്യേണ്ടുന്നതു അവിടെ വെച്ചു നിന്നോടു പറയും എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do."
chapters.nkjv: So he, trembling and astonished, said, "Lord, what do You want me to do?" Then the Lord said to him, "Arise and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do."
chapters.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

chapters.ml: അവനോടുകൂടെ പ്രയാണം ചെയ്ത പുരുഷന്മാർ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടു എങ്കിലും ആരെയും കാണാതെ മരവിച്ചു നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless; they heard the sound but did not see anyone.
chapters.nkjv: And the men who journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice but seeing no one.
chapters.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ നിലത്തുനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റു കണ്ണു തുറന്നാറെ ഒന്നും കണ്ടില്ല; അവർ അവനെ കൈക്കു പിടിച്ചു ദമസ്കൊസിൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി;
chapters.niv: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened he saw no one. But they led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
chapters.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

chapters.ml: അവൻ മൂന്നു ദിവസം കണ്ണു കാണാതെയും തിന്നുകയോ കുടിക്കയോ ചെയ്യാതെയും ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.
chapters.nkjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither ate nor drank.
chapters.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അനന്യാസ് എന്നൊരു ശിഷ്യൻ ദമസ്കൊസിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു: അവനെ കർത്താവു ഒരു ദർശനത്തിൽ: അനന്യാസേ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു. കർത്താവേ, അടിയൻ ഇതാ എന്നു അവൻ വിളികേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, "Ananias!" "Yes, Lord," he answered.
chapters.nkjv: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias; and to him the Lord said in a vision, "Ananias." And he said, "Here I am, Lord."
chapters.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here , Lord.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു അവനോടു: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു നേർവ്വീഥി എന്ന തെരുവിൽ ചെന്നു, യൂദയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ തർസൊസുകാരനായ ശൌൽ എന്നു പേരുള്ളവനെ അന്വേഷിക്ക;
chapters.niv: The Lord told him, "Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
chapters.nkjv: So the Lord said to him, "Arise and go to the street called Straight, and inquire at the house of Judas for one called Saul of Tarsus, for behold, he is praying.
chapters.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

chapters.ml: അവൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുന്നു; അനന്യാസ് എന്നൊരു പുരുഷൻ അകത്തു വന്നു താൻ കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്റെ മേല കൈ വെക്കുന്നതു അവൻ കണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight."
chapters.nkjv: And in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and putting his hand on him, so that he might receive his sight."
chapters.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അനന്യാസ്: കർത്താവേ, ആ മനുഷ്യൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്റെ വിശുദ്ധന്മാർക്കു എത്ര ദോഷം ചെയ്തു എന്നു പലരും പറഞ്ഞു ഞാൻ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Lord," Ananias answered, "I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your holy people in Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Then Ananias answered, "Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

chapters.ml: ഇവിടെയും നിന്റെ നാമത്തെ വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നവരെ ഒക്കെയും പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടുവാൻ അവന്നു മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ അധികാരപത്രം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name."
chapters.nkjv: And here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on Your name."
chapters.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു അവനോടു: നീ പോക; അവൻ എന്റെ നാമം ജാതികൾക്കും രാജാക്കന്മാർക്കും യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾക്കും മുമ്പിൽ വഹിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നൊരു പാത്രം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the Lord said to Ananias, "Go! This man is my chosen instrument to proclaim my name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: But the Lord said to him, "Go, for he is a chosen vessel of Mine to bear My name before Gentiles, kings, and the children of Israel.
chapters.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

chapters.ml: എന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി അവൻ എന്തെല്ലാം കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു എന്നു ഞാൻ അവനെ കാണിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I will show him how much he must suffer for my name."
chapters.nkjv: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for My name’s sake."
chapters.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അനന്യാസ് ആ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു അവന്റെമേൽ കൈ വെച്ചു: ശൌലേ, സഹോദരാ, നീ കാഴ്ച പ്രാപിച്ചു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മപൂർണ്ണൻ ആകേണ്ടതിന്നു നീ വന്ന വഴിയിൽ നിനക്കു പ്രത്യക്ഷനായ യേശു എന്ന കർത്താവു എന്നെ അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Ananias went to the house and entered it. Placing his hands on Saul, he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord—Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here—has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
chapters.nkjv: And Ananias went his way and entered the house; and laying his hands on him he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
chapters.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ അവന്റെ കണ്ണിൽ നിന്നു ചെതുമ്പൽ പോലെ വീണു; കാഴ്ച ലഭിച്ചു അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു സ്നാനം ഏൽക്കയും ആഹാരം കൈക്കൊണ്ടു ബലം പ്രാപിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Immediately, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and he could see again. He got up and was baptized,
chapters.nkjv: Immediately there fell from his eyes something like scales, and he received his sight at once; and he arose and was baptized.
chapters.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദമസ്കൊസിലുള്ള ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു കൂടെ കുറെനാൾ പാർത്തു,
chapters.niv: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
chapters.nkjv: So when he had received food, he was strengthened. Then Saul spent some days with the disciples at Damascus.
chapters.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

chapters.ml: യേശു തന്നേ ദൈവപുത്രൻ എന്നു പള്ളികളിൽ പ്രസംഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately he preached the Christ in the synagogues, that He is the Son of God.
chapters.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

chapters.ml: കേട്ടവർ എല്ലാവരും വിസ്മയിച്ചു: യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഈ നാമം വിളിച്ചപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നവർക്കു നാശം ചെയ്തവൻ ഇവനല്ലയോ? ഇവിടെയും അവരെ പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടി മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടുപോകുവാനല്ലോ വന്നതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, "Isn’t he the man who raised havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?"
chapters.nkjv: Then all who heard were amazed, and said, "Is this not he who destroyed those who called on this name in Jerusalem, and has come here for that purpose, so that he might bring them bound to the chief priests?"
chapters.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

chapters.ml: ശൌലോ മേൽക്കുമേൽ ശക്തിപ്രാപിച്ചു, യേശു തന്നേ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു തെളിയിച്ചു ദമസ്കൊസിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന യെഹൂദന്മാരെ മിണ്ടാതാക്കി.
chapters.niv: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: But Saul increased all the more in strength, and confounded the Jews who dwelt in Damascus, proving that this Jesus is the Christ.
chapters.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

chapters.ml: കുറെനാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ആലോചിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After many days had gone by, there was a conspiracy among the Jews to kill him,
chapters.nkjv: Now after many days were past, the Jews plotted to kill him.
chapters.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

chapters.ml: ശൌൽ അവരുടെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടു അറിഞ്ഞു; അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ അവർ രാവും പകലും നഗര ഗോപുരങ്ങളിൽ കാവൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: but Saul learned of their plan. Day and night they kept close watch on the city gates in order to kill him.
chapters.nkjv: But their plot became known to Saul. And they watched the gates day and night, to kill him.
chapters.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവന്റെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ രാത്രിയിൽ അവനെ ഒരു കൊട്ടയിലാക്കി മതിൽവഴിയായി ഇറക്കിവിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.
chapters.nkjv: Then the disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall in a large basket.
chapters.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

chapters.ml: അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തിയാറെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടു ചേരുവാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ അവൻ ഒരു ശിഷ്യൻ എന്നു വിശ്വസിക്കാതെ എല്ലാവരും അവനെ പേടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.
chapters.nkjv: And when Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, and did not believe that he was a disciple.
chapters.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

chapters.ml: ബർന്നബാസോ അവനെ കൂട്ടി അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു; അവൻ വഴിയിൽ വെച്ചു കർത്താവിനെ കണ്ടതും കർത്താവു അവനോടു സംസാരിച്ചതും ദമസ്കൊസിൽ അവൻ യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ പ്രാഗത്ഭ്യത്തോടെ പ്രസംഗിച്ചതും എല്ലാം അവരോടു വിവരിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. And he declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the road, and that He had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
chapters.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ യെരൂശലേമിൽ അവരുമായി പെരുമാറുകയും കർത്താവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ പ്രാഗത്ഭ്യത്തോടെ പ്രസംഗിക്കയും ചെയ്തു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Saul stayed with them and moved about freely in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: So he was with them at Jerusalem, coming in and going out.
chapters.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: യവനഭാഷക്കാരായ യെഹൂദന്മാരോടും അവൻ സംഭാഷിച്ചു തർക്കിച്ചു; അവരോ അവനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ വട്ടംകൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: He talked and debated with the Hellenistic Jews, but they tried to kill him.
chapters.nkjv: And he spoke boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus and disputed against the Hellenists, but they attempted to kill him.
chapters.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാർ അതു അറിഞ്ഞു അവനെ കൈസര്യയിലേക്കു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി, അവിടെനിന്നു തർസൊസിലേക്കു അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the believers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
chapters.nkjv: When the brethren found out, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him out to Tarsus.
chapters.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cæsarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യെഹൂദ്യാ, ഗലീല, ശമര്യ എന്നീ ദേശങ്ങളിൽ ഒക്കെയും സഭെക്കു സമാധാനം ഉണ്ടായി, അതു ആത്മികവർദ്ധന പ്രാപിച്ചും കർത്താവിനോടുള്ള ഭക്തിയിലും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിന്റെ പ്രബോധനയിലും നടന്നും പെരുകിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace and was strengthened. Living in the fear of the Lord and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it increased in numbers.
chapters.nkjv: Then the churches throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were edified. And walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, they were multiplied.
chapters.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് എല്ലാടവും സഞ്ചരിക്കയിൽ ലുദ്ദയിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കലും ചെന്നു;
chapters.niv: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the Lord’s people who lived in Lydda.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, as Peter went through all partsofthecountry, that he also came down to the saints who dwelt in Lydda.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ പക്ഷവാതം പിടിച്ചു എട്ടു സംവത്സരമായി കിടപ്പിൽ ആയിരുന്ന ഐനെയാസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു മനുഷ്യനെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: There he found a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had been bedridden for eight years.
