chapters.nkjv: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden eight years and was paralyzed.
chapters.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Æneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവനോടു: ഐനെയാസേ, യേശുക്രിസ്തു നിന്നെ സൌഖ്യമാക്കുന്നു; എഴുന്നേറ്റു താനായി തന്നേ കിടക്ക വിരിച്ചുകൊൾക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; ഉടനെ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: "Aeneas," Peter said to him, "Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and roll up your mat." Immediately Aeneas got up.
chapters.nkjv: And Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus the Christ heals you. Arise and make your bed." Then he arose immediately.
chapters.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Æneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

chapters.ml: ലുദ്ദയിലും ശാരോനിലും പാർക്കുന്നവർ എല്ലാവരും അവനെ കണ്ടു കർത്താവിങ്കലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: So all who dwelt at Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

chapters.ml: യോപ്പയിൽ പേടമാൻ എന്നർത്ഥമുള്ള തബീഥാ എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു ശിഷ്യ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അവൾ വളരെ സൽപ്രവൃത്തികളും ധർമ്മങ്ങളും ചെയ്തുപോന്നവളായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (in Greek her name is Dorcas); she was always doing good and helping the poor.
chapters.nkjv: At Joppa there was a certain disciple named Tabitha, which is translated Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and charitable deeds which she did.
chapters.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്ത് അവൾ ദീനം പിടിച്ചു മരിച്ചു; അവർ അവളെ കുളിപ്പിച്ചു ഒരു മാളികമുറിയിൽ കിടത്തി.
chapters.niv: About that time she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
chapters.nkjv: But it happened in those days that she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

chapters.ml: ലുദ്ദ യോപ്പെക്കു സമീപമാകയാൽ പത്രൊസ് അവിടെ ഉണ്ടെന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാർ കേട്ടു: നീ താമസിയാതെ ഞങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കലോളം വരേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിപ്പാൻ രണ്ടു ആളെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Lydda was near Joppa; so when the disciples heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him and urged him, "Please come at once!"
chapters.nkjv: And since Lydda was near Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
chapters.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരോടുകൂടെ ചെന്നു. എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവർ അവനെ മാളികമുറിയിൽ കൊണ്ടുപോയി; അവിടെ വിധവമാർ എല്ലാവരും കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടും തബീഥാ തങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഉള്ളപ്പോൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ കുപ്പായങ്ങളും ഉടുപ്പുകളും കാണിച്ചുകൊണ്ടും അവന്റെ ചുറ്റും നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he had come, they brought him to the upper room. And all the widows stood by him weeping, showing the tunics and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
chapters.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവരെ ഒക്കെയും പുറത്തിറക്കി മുട്ടുകുത്തി പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു ശവത്തിന്റെ നേരെ തിരിഞ്ഞു: തബീത്ഥയേ, എഴുന്നേൽക്കൂ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു: അവൾ കണ്ണു തുറന്നു പത്രൊസിനെ കണ്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, "Tabitha, get up." She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.
chapters.nkjv: But Peter put them all out, and knelt down and prayed. And turning to the body he said, "Tabitha, arise." And she opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter she sat up.
chapters.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കൈ കൊടുത്തു അവളെ എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു, വിശുദ്ധന്മാരെയും വിധവമാരെയും വിളിച്ചു അവളെ ജീവനുള്ളവളായി അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നിറുത്തി.
chapters.niv: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called for the believers, especially the widows, and presented her to them alive.
chapters.nkjv: Then he gave her his hand and lifted her up; and when he had called the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
chapters.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

chapters.ml: ഇതു യോപ്പയിൽ എങ്ങും പ്രസിദ്ധമായി,
chapters.niv: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed on the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

chapters.ml: പലരും കർത്താവിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു. പിന്നെ അവൻ തോൽക്കൊല്ലനായ ശിമോൻ എന്ന ഒരുത്തനോടുകൂടെ വളരെ നാൾ യോപ്പയിൽ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.
chapters.nkjv: So it was that he stayed many days in Joppa with Simon, a tanner.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

chapters.ml: കൈസര്യയിൽ ഇത്താലിക എന്ന പട്ടാളത്തിൽ കൊർന്നേല്യൊസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു ശതാധിപൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.
chapters.nkjv: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
chapters.kjv: There was a certain man in Cæsarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭക്തനും തന്റെ സകല ഗൃഹത്തോടും കൂടെ ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടുന്നവനുമായി ജനത്തിന്നു വളരെ ധർമ്മം കൊടുത്തും എപ്പോഴും ദൈവത്തോടു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചും പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: He and all his family were devout and God-fearing; he gave generously to those in need and prayed to God regularly.
chapters.nkjv: a devout man and one who feared God with all his household, who gave alms generously to the people, and prayed to God always.
chapters.kjv: A devout man , and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പകൽ ഏകദേശം ഒമ്പതാം മണിനേരത്തു ഒരു ദർശനത്തിൽ ഒരു ദൈവദൂതൻ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അകത്തു വരുന്നതു സ്പഷ്ടമായി കണ്ടു കൊർന്നേല്യെസേ, എന്നു തന്നോടു പറയുന്നതും കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: One day at about three in the afternoon he had a vision. He distinctly saw an angel of God, who came to him and said, "Cornelius!"
chapters.nkjv: About the ninth hour of the day he saw clearly in a vision an angel of God coming in and saying to him, "Cornelius!"
chapters.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവനെ ഉറ്റു നോക്കി ഭയപരവശനായി: എന്താകുന്നു കർത്താവേ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു. അവൻ അവനോടു: നിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥനയും ധർമ്മവും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ എത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Cornelius stared at him in fear. "What is it, Lord?" he asked. The angel answered, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God.
chapters.nkjv: And when he observed him, he was afraid, and said, "What is it, lord?" So he said to him, "Your prayers and your alms have come up for a memorial before God.
chapters.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ യോപ്പയിലേക്കു ആളയച്ചു, പത്രൊസ് എന്നു മറുപേരുള്ള ശിമോനെ വരുത്തുക.
chapters.niv: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.
chapters.nkjv: Now send men to Joppa, and send for Simon whose surname is Peter.
chapters.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

chapters.ml: അവൻ തോൽക്കൊല്ലനായ ശിമോൻ എന്നൊരുവനോടു കൂടെ പാർക്കുന്നു. അവന്റെ വീടു കടല്പുറത്തു ആകുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea."
chapters.nkjv: He is lodging with Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the sea. He will tell you what you must do."
chapters.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു സംസാരിച്ച ദൂതൻ പോയ ശേഷം അവൻ തന്റെ വേലക്കാരിൽ രണ്ടുപേരെയും തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അകമ്പടി നില്ക്കുന്നവരിൽ ദൈവഭക്തനായോരു പടയാളിയേയും
chapters.niv: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.
chapters.nkjv: And when the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier from among those who waited on him continually.
chapters.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

chapters.ml: വിളിച്ചു സകലവും വിവരിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു യോപ്പയിലേക്കു അയച്ചു
chapters.niv: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.
chapters.nkjv: So when he had explained all these things to them, he sent them to Joppa.
chapters.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ അവർ യാത്രചെയ്തു പട്ടണത്തോടു സമീപിക്കുമ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് ആറാം മണിനേരത്തു പ്രാർത്ഥിപ്പാൻ വെണ്മാടത്തിൽ കയറി.
chapters.niv: About noon the following day as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
chapters.nkjv: The next day, as they went on their journey and drew near the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray, about the sixth hour.
chapters.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

chapters.ml: അവൻ വളരെ വിശന്നിട്ടു ഭക്ഷിപ്പാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അവർ ഒരുക്കുമ്പോഴേക്കു അവന്നു ഒരു വിവശത വന്നു.
chapters.niv: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
chapters.nkjv: Then he became very hungry and wanted to eat; but while they made ready, he fell into a trance
chapters.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

chapters.ml: ആകാശം തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്നതും വലിയൊരു തൂപ്പട്ടിപോലെ നാലു കോണും കെട്ടീട്ടു ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു ഇറക്കിവിട്ടോരു പാത്രം വരുന്നതും അവൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
chapters.nkjv: and saw heaven opened and an object like a great sheet bound at the four corners, descending to him and let down to the earth.
chapters.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

chapters.ml: അതിൽ ഭൂമിയിലെ സകലവിധ നാൽക്കാലിയും ഇഴജാതിയും ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവയും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.
chapters.nkjv: In it were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, creeping things, and birds of the air.
chapters.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസേ, എഴുന്നേറ്റു അറുത്തു തിന്നുക എന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then a voice told him, "Get up, Peter. Kill and eat."
chapters.nkjv: And a voice came to him, "Rise, Peter; kill and eat."
chapters.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പത്രൊസ്: ഒരിക്കലും പാടില്ല, കർത്താവേ, മലിനമോ അശുദ്ധമോ ആയതൊന്നും ഞാൻ ഒരുനാളും തിന്നിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: "Surely not, Lord!" Peter replied. "I have never eaten anything impure or unclean."
chapters.nkjv: But Peter said, "Not so, Lord! For I have never eaten anything common or unclean."
chapters.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

chapters.ml: ആ ശബ്ദം രണ്ടാംപ്രാവശ്യം അവനോടു: ദൈവം ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചതു നീ മലിനമെന്നു വിചാരിക്കരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The voice spoke to him a second time, "Do not call anything impure that God has made clean."
chapters.nkjv: And a voice spoke to him again the second time, "What God has cleansed you must not call common."
chapters.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം ഉണ്ടായി; ഉടനെ പാത്രം തിരികെ ആകാശത്തിലേക്കു വലിച്ചെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.
chapters.nkjv: This was done three times. And the object was taken up into heaven again.
chapters.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

chapters.ml: ഈ കണ്ട ദർശനം എന്തായിരിക്കും എന്നു പത്രൊസ് ഉള്ളിൽ ചഞ്ചലിച്ചു കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ കൊർന്നേല്യൊസ് അയച്ച പുരുഷന്മാർ ശിമോന്റെ വീടു ചോദിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു:
chapters.niv: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found out where Simon’s house was and stopped at the gate.
chapters.nkjv: Now while Peter wondered within himself what this vision which he had seen meant, behold, the men who had been sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate.
chapters.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് എന്നു മറു പേരുള്ള ശിമോൻ ഇവിടെ പാർക്കുന്നുണ്ടോഎന്നു വിളിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.
chapters.nkjv: And they called and asked whether Simon, whose surname was Peter, was lodging there.
chapters.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് ദർശനത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ചിന്തിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ആത്മാവു അവനോടു: മൂന്നു പുരുഷന്മാർ നിന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Simon, three men are looking for you.
chapters.nkjv: While Peter thought about the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Behold, three men are seeking you.
chapters.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

chapters.ml: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെല്ലുക; ഞാൻ അവരെ അയച്ചതാകകൊണ്ടു ഒന്നും സംശയിക്കാതെ അവരോടു കൂടെ പോക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them."
chapters.nkjv: Arise therefore, go down and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them."
chapters.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് ആ പുരുഷന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവൻ ഞാൻ തന്നെ; നിങ്ങൾ വന്ന സംഗതി എന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Peter went down and said to the men, "I’m the one you’re looking for. Why have you come?"
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter went down to the men who had been sent to him from Cornelius, and said, "Yes, I am he whom you seek. For what reason have you come?"
chapters.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു അവർ: നീതിമാനും ദൈവഭക്തനും യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ സകലജാതിയാലും നല്ല സാക്ഷ്യംകൊണ്ടവനും ആയ കൊർന്നേല്യൊസ് എന്ന ശതാധിപന്നു നിന്നെ വീട്ടിൽ വരുത്തി നിന്റെ പ്രസംഗം കേൾക്കേണം എന്നു ഒരു വിശുദ്ധദൂതനാൽ അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The men replied, "We have come from Cornelius the centurion. He is a righteous and God-fearing man, who is respected by all the Jewish people. A holy angel told him to ask you to come to his house so that he could hear what you have to say."
chapters.nkjv: And they said, "Cornelius the centurion, a just man, one who fears God and has a good reputation among all the nation of the Jews, was divinely instructed by a holy angel to summon you to his house, and to hear words from you."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെ അകത്തു വിളിച്ചു പാർപ്പിച്ചു; പിറ്റെന്നാൾ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരോടുകൂടെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; യോപ്പയിലെ സഹോദരന്മാർ ചിലരും അവനോടുകൂടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the believers from Joppa went along.
chapters.nkjv: Then he invited them in and lodged them. On the next day Peter went away with them, and some brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
chapters.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ കൈസര്യയിൽ എത്തി; അവിടെ കൊർന്നേല്യൊസ് ചാർച്ചക്കാരെയും അടുത്ത സ്നേഹിതന്മാരെയും കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി, അവർക്കായി കാത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
chapters.nkjv: And the following day they entered Caesarea. Now Cornelius was waiting for them, and had called together his relatives and close friends.
chapters.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അകത്തു കയറിയപ്പോൾ കൊർന്നേല്യൊസ് എതിരേറ്റു അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.
chapters.nkjv: As Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him and fell down at his feet and worshiped him.
chapters.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him .

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസോ: എഴുന്നേൽക്ക, ഞാനും ഒരു മനുഷ്യനാത്രെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Peter made him get up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man myself."
chapters.nkjv: But Peter lifted him up, saying, "Stand up; I myself am also a man."
chapters.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

chapters.ml: അവനോടു സംഭാഷിച്ചും കൊണ്ടു അകത്തു ചെന്നു, അനേകർ വന്നു കൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു അവനോടു:
chapters.niv: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.
chapters.nkjv: And as he talked with him, he went in and found many who had come together.
chapters.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

chapters.ml: അന്യജാതിക്കാരന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുന്നതും അവനുമായി പെരുമാറ്റം ചെയ്യുന്നതും യെഹൂദന്നു നിഷിദ്ധം എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ. എങ്കിലും ഒരു മനുഷ്യനെയും മലിനനോ അശുദ്ധനോ എന്നു പറയരുതെന്നു ദൈവം എനിക്കു കാണിച്ചു തന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said to them: "You are well aware that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit a Gentile. But God has shown me that I should not call anyone impure or unclean.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to them, "You know how unlawful it is for a Jewish man to keep company with or go to one of another nation. But God has shown me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടാകുന്നു നിങ്ങൾ ആളയച്ചപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ എതിർ പറയാതെ വന്നതു; എന്നാൽ എന്നെ വിളിപ്പിച്ച സംഗതി എന്തു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞാൽ കൊള്ളാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?"
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I came without objection as soon as I was sent for. I ask, then, for what reason have you sent for me?"
chapters.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു കൊർന്നേല്യൊസ്: നാലാകുന്നാൾ ഈ നേരത്തു ഞാൻ വീട്ടിൽ ഒമ്പതാം മണിനേരത്തെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കഴിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ ശുഭ്രവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചോരു പുരുഷൻ എന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു:
chapters.niv: Cornelius answered: "Three days ago I was in my house praying at this hour, at three in the afternoon. Suddenly a man in shining clothes stood before me
chapters.nkjv: So Cornelius said, "Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
chapters.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

chapters.ml: കൊർന്നേല്യൊസേ, ദൈവം നിന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടു നിന്റെ ധർമ്മം ഓർത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and said, ‘Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.
chapters.nkjv: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your alms are remembered in the sight of God.
chapters.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

chapters.ml: യോപ്പയിലേക്കു ആളയച്ചു പത്രൊസ് എന്നു മറുപേരുള്ള ശിമോനെ വിളിപ്പിക്ക; അവൻ കടല്പുറത്തു തോൽക്കൊല്ലനായ ശീമോന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പാർക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.’
chapters.nkjv: Send therefore to Joppa and call Simon here, whose surname is Peter. He is lodging in the house of Simon, a tanner, by the sea. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
chapters.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷണത്തിൽ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു; നീ വന്നതു ഉപകാരം. കർത്താവു നിന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചതൊക്കെയും കേൾപ്പാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും ഇവിടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കൂടിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So I sent for you immediately, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us."
chapters.nkjv: So I sent to you immediately, and you have done well to come. Now therefore, we are all present before God, to hear all the things commanded you by God."
chapters.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് വായി തുറന്നു പറഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങിയതു: ദൈവത്തിന്നു മുഖപക്ഷമില്ല എന്നും
chapters.niv: Then Peter began to speak: "I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism
chapters.nkjv: Then Peter opened his mouth and said: "In truth I perceive that God shows no partiality.
chapters.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

chapters.ml: ഏതു ജാതിയിലും അവനെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു നീതി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നവനെ അവൻ അംഗീകരിക്കുന്നു എന്നും ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ യാഥാർത്ഥമായി ഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right.
chapters.nkjv: But in every nation whoever fears Him and works righteousness is accepted by Him.
chapters.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എല്ലാവരുടെയും കർത്താവായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുമൂലം സമാധാനം സുവിശേഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു യിസ്രായേൽ മക്കൾക്കു അയച്ച വചനം,
chapters.niv: You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, announcing the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
chapters.nkjv: The word which God sent to the children of Israel, preaching peace through Jesus Christ— He is Lord of all—
chapters.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ പ്രസംഗിച്ച സ്നാനത്തിന്റെശേഷം ഗലീലയിൽ തുടങ്ങി യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ ഒക്കെയും ഉണ്ടായ വർത്തമാനം,
chapters.niv: You know what has happened throughout the province of Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached—
chapters.nkjv: that word you know, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, and began from Galilee after the baptism which John preached:
chapters.kjv: That word, I say , ye know, which was published throughout all Judæa, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

chapters.ml: നസറായനായ യേശുവിനെ ദൈവം പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനാലും ശക്തിയാലും അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തതും ദൈവം അവനോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ നന്മചെയ്തും പിശാചു ബാധിച്ചവരെ ഒക്കെയും സൌഖ്യമാക്കിയുംകൊണ്ടു സഞ്ചരിച്ചതുമായ വിവരം തന്നേ നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and power, and how he went around doing good and healing all who were under the power of the devil, because God was with him.
chapters.nkjv: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with Him.
chapters.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദ്യദേശത്തിലും യെരൂശലേമിലും അവൻ ചെയ്ത സകലത്തിനും ഞങ്ങൾ സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു. അവനെ അവർ മരത്തിന്മേൽ തൂക്കിക്കൊന്നു;
chapters.niv: "We are witnesses of everything he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a cross,
chapters.nkjv: And we are witnesses of all things which He did both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem, whom they killed by hanging on a tree.
chapters.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അവനെ മൂന്നാം നാൾ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.
chapters.nkjv: Him God raised up on the third day, and showed Him openly,
chapters.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

chapters.ml: സകല ജനത്തിന്നുമല്ല, ദൈവം മുമ്പുകൂട്ടി നിയമിച്ച സാക്ഷികളായി, അവൻ മരിച്ചവരിൽനിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേറ്റശേഷം അവനോടുകൂടെ തിന്നുകുടിച്ചവരായ ഞങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നേ പ്രത്യക്ഷനാക്കിത്തന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen—by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
chapters.nkjv: not to all the people, but to witnesses chosen before by God, even to us who ate and drank with Him after He arose from the dead.
chapters.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

chapters.ml: ജീവികൾക്കും മരിച്ചവർക്കും ന്യായാധിപതിയായി ദൈവത്താൽ നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ടവൻ അവൻ തന്നേ എന്നു ജനത്തോടു പ്രസംഗിച്ചു സാക്ഷീകരിപ്പാൻ അവൻ ഞങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.
chapters.nkjv: And He commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify that it is He who was ordained by God tobe Judge of the living and the dead.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

chapters.ml: അവനിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഏവന്നും അവന്റെ നാമം മൂലം പാപമോചനം ലഭിക്കും എന്നു സകല പ്രവാചകന്മാരും സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name."
chapters.nkjv: To Him all the prophets witness that, through His name, whoever believes in Him will receive remission of sins."
chapters.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

chapters.ml: ഈ വാക്കുകളെ പത്രൊസ് പ്രസ്താവിക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നേ വചനം കേട്ട എല്ലാവരുടെ മേലും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.
chapters.nkjv: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all those who heard the word.
chapters.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

chapters.ml: അവർ അന്യഭാഷകളിൽ സംസാരിക്കുന്നതും ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വീകരിക്കുന്നതും കേൾക്കയാൽ
chapters.niv: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on Gentiles.
chapters.nkjv: And those of the circumcision who believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out on the Gentiles also.
chapters.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസിനോടുകൂടെ വന്ന പരിച്ഛേദനക്കാരായ വിശ്വാസികൾ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു എന്ന ദാനം ജാതികളുടെ മേലും പകർന്നതു കണ്ടു വിസ്മയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,
chapters.nkjv: For they heard them speak with tongues and magnify God. Then Peter answered,
chapters.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

chapters.ml: നമ്മെപ്പോലെ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ലഭിച്ച ഇവരെ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചു കൂടാതവണ്ണം വെള്ളം വിലക്കുവാൻ ആർക്കു കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized with water. They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have."
chapters.nkjv: "Can anyone forbid water, that these should not be baptized who have received the Holy Spirit just as we have?"
chapters.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് അവരെ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു. അവൻ ചില ദിവസം അവിടെ താമസിക്കേണം എന്നു അവർ അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.
chapters.nkjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then they asked him to stay a few days.
chapters.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

chapters.ml: ജാതികളും ദൈവവചനം കൈകൊണ്ടു എന്നു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും യെഹൂദ്യയിലുള്ള സഹോദരന്മാരും കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The apostles and the believers throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
chapters.nkjv: Now the apostles and brethren who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
chapters.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ പരിച്ഛേദനക്കാർ അവനോടു വാദിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him
chapters.nkjv: And when Peter came up to Jerusalem, those of the circumcision contended with him,
chapters.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

chapters.ml: നീ അഗ്രചർമ്മികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവരോടുകൂടെ ഭക്ഷിച്ചു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and said, "You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!"
chapters.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് കാര്യം ആദിമുതൽ ക്രമമായി അവരോടു വിവരിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: Starting from the beginning, Peter told them the whole story:
chapters.nkjv: But Peter explained it to them in order from the beginning, saying:
chapters.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ യോപ്പാപട്ടണത്തിൽ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ വിവശതയിൽ ഒരുദർശനം കണ്ടു: ആകാശത്തിൽനിന്നു നാലു കോണും കെട്ടി ഇറക്കിയ വലിയ തുപ്പട്ടിപോലെ ഒരു പാത്രം എന്റെ അടുക്കലോളം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to where I was.
chapters.nkjv: "I was in the city of Joppa praying; and in a trance I saw a vision, an object descending like a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came to me.
chapters.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

chapters.ml: അതിൽ ഞാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുനോക്കിയപ്പോൾ ഭൂമിയിലെ നാൽക്കാലികളെയും കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളെയും ഇഴജാതികളെയും ആകാശത്തിലെ പറവകളെയും കണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: I looked into it and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles and birds.
chapters.nkjv: When I observed it intently and considered, I saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, creeping things, and birds of the air.
chapters.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസേ, എഴുന്നേറ്റു അറുത്തു തിന്നുക എന്നു എന്നോടു പറയുന്നോരു ശബ്ദവും കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I heard a voice telling me, ‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’
chapters.nkjv: And I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter; kill and eat.’
chapters.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു ഞാൻ: ഒരിക്കലും പാടില്ല, കർത്താവേ; മലിനമോ അശുദ്ധമോ ആയതൊന്നും ഒരിക്കലും എന്റെ വായിൽ ചെന്നിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "I replied, ‘Surely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
chapters.nkjv: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord! For nothing common or unclean has at any time entered my mouth.’
chapters.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

chapters.ml: ആ ശബ്ദം പിന്നെയും ആകാശത്തിൽ നിന്നു: ദൈവം ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചതു നീ മലിനം എന്നു വിചാരിക്കരുതു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "The voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
chapters.nkjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, ‘What God has cleansed you must not call common.’
chapters.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

chapters.ml: ഇതു മൂന്നു പ്രാവശ്യം ഉണ്ടായി; പിന്നെ എല്ലാം തിരികെ ആകാശത്തിലേക്കു വലിച്ചെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.
chapters.nkjv: Now this was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
chapters.kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ തന്നേ കൈസര്യയിൽ നിന്നു എന്റെ അടുക്കൽ അയച്ചിരുന്ന മൂന്നു പുരുഷന്മാർ ഞങ്ങൾ പാർത്ത വീട്ടിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: "Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
chapters.nkjv: At that very moment, three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent to me from Caesarea.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cæsarea unto me.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നും സംശയിക്കാതെ അവരോടുകൂടെ പോകുവാൻ ആത്മാവു എന്നോടു കല്പിച്ചു. ഈ ആറു സഹോദരന്മാരും എന്നോടുകൂടെ പോന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ ആ പുരുഷന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Spirit told me to have no hesitation about going with them. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s house.
chapters.nkjv: Then the Spirit told me to go with them, doubting nothing. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered the man’s house.
chapters.kjv: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ഒരു ദൂതൻ നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു എന്നും നീ യോപ്പയിലേക്കു ആളയച്ചു പത്രൊസ് എന്നു മറുപേരുള്ള ശിമോനെ വരുത്തുക;
chapters.niv: He told us how he had seen an angel appear in his house and say, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
chapters.nkjv: And he told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house, who said to him, ‘Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon whose surname is Peter,
chapters.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

chapters.ml: നീയും നിന്റെ ഗൃഹം മുഴുവനും രക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുവാനുള്ള വാക്കുകളെ അവൻ നിന്നോടു സംസാരിക്കും എന്നു ദൂതൻ പറഞ്ഞു എന്നും ഞങ്ങളോടു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.’
chapters.nkjv: who will tell you words by which you and all your household will be saved.’
chapters.kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സംസാരിച്ചു തുടങ്ങിയപ്പോഴേക്കു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ആദിയിൽ നമ്മുടെമേൽ എന്നപോലെ അവരുടെ മേലും വന്നു.
chapters.niv: "As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on us at the beginning.
chapters.nkjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, as upon us at the beginning.
chapters.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ: യോഹന്നാൻ വെള്ളംകൊണ്ടു സ്നാനം കഴിപ്പിച്ചു; നിങ്ങൾക്കോ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവുകൊണ്ടു സ്നാനം ലഭിക്കും എന്നു കർത്താവു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു ഓർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.nkjv: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, how He said, ‘John indeed baptized with water, but you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ കർത്താവായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചവരായ നമുക്കു തന്നതുപോലെ അതേ ദാനത്തെ അവർക്കും ദൈവം കൊടുത്തു എങ്കിൽ ദൈവത്തെ തടുപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഞാൻ ആർ?
chapters.niv: So if God gave them the same gift he gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to think that I could stand in God’s way?"
chapters.nkjv: If therefore God gave them the same gift as Hegave us when we believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could withstand God?"
chapters.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇതു കേട്ടപ്പോൾ മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു: അങ്ങനെ ആയാൽ ദൈവം ജാതികൾക്കും ജീവപ്രാപ്തിക്കായി മാനസാന്തരം നല്കിയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ദൈവത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി.
chapters.niv: When they heard this, they had no further objections and praised God, saying, "So then, even to Gentiles God has granted repentance that leads to life."
chapters.nkjv: When they heard these things they became silent; and they glorified God, saying, "Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life."
chapters.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

chapters.ml: സ്തെഫാനൊസ് നിമിത്തം ഉണ്ടായ ഉപദ്രവം ഹേതുവാൽ ചിതറിപ്പോയവർ യെഹൂദന്മാരോടല്ലാതെ മറ്റാരോടും വചനം സംസാരിക്കാതെ ഫൊയ്നിക്യാ, കുപ്രൊസ്, അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യ എന്നീ പ്രദേശങ്ങളോളം സഞ്ചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Now those who had been scattered by the persecution that broke out when Stephen was killed traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus and Antioch, spreading the word only among Jews.
chapters.nkjv: Now those who were scattered after the persecution that arose over Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to no one but the Jews only.
chapters.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ചിലർ കുപ്രൊസ്കാരും കുറേനക്കാരും ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിൽഎത്തിയശേഷം യവനന്മാരോടും കർത്താവായ യേശുവിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള സുവിശേഷം അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some of them, however, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began to speak to Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: But some of them were men from Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
chapters.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ കൈ അവരോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; വലിയൊരു കൂട്ടം വിശ്വസിച്ചു കർത്താവിങ്കലേക്കു തിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

chapters.ml: അവരെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ഈ വർത്തമാനം യെരൂശലേമിലെ സഭയുടെ ചെവിയിൽ എത്തിയപ്പോൾ അവർ ബർന്നബാസിനെ അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയോളം പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
chapters.nkjv: Then news of these things came to the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch.
chapters.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ചെന്നു ദൈവകൃപ കണ്ടു സന്തോഷിച്ചു. എല്ലാവരും ഹൃദയനിർണ്ണയത്തോടെ കർത്താവിനോടു ചേർന്നുനില്പാന്തക്കവണ്ണം പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When he arrived and saw what the grace of God had done, he was glad and encouraged them all to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts.
chapters.nkjv: When he came and had seen the grace of God, he was glad, and encouraged them all that with purpose of heart they should continue with the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

chapters.ml: അവൻ നല്ല മനുഷ്യനും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനാലും വിശ്വാസത്താലും നിറഞ്ഞവനും ആയിരുന്നു; വളരെ പുരുഷന്മാരും കർത്താവിനോടു ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: For he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were added to the Lord.
chapters.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ശൌലിനെ തിരവാൻ തർസൊസിലേക്കു പോയി, അവനെ കണ്ടെത്തിയാറെ അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിലേക്കു കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
chapters.nkjv: Then Barnabas departed for Tarsus to seek Saul.
chapters.kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒരു സംവത്സരം മുഴുവനും സഭായോഗങ്ങളിൽ കൂടുകയും ബഹുജനത്തെ ഉപദേശിക്കയും ചെയ്തു; ആദ്യം അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിൽവെച്ചു ശിഷ്യന്മാർക്കു ക്രിസ്ത്യാനികൾ എന്നു പേർ ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: and when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. So for a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.
chapters.nkjv: And when he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. So it was that for a whole year they assembled with the church and taught a great many people. And the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
chapters.kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു യെരൂശലേമിൽ നിന്നു പ്രവാചകന്മാർ അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിലേക്കു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
chapters.nkjv: And in these days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.
chapters.kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ അഗബൊസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളൊരുവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ലോകത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും മഹാക്ഷാമം ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു ആത്മാവിനാൽ പ്രവചിച്ചു; അതു ക്ളൌദ്യൊസിന്റെ കാലത്തു സംഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and through the Spirit predicted that a severe famine would spread over the entire Roman world. (This happened during the reign of Claudius.)
chapters.nkjv: Then one of them, named Agabus, stood up and showed by the Spirit that there was going to be a great famine throughout all the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius Caesar.
chapters.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cæsar.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ ഉതവിക്കായി ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തൻ പ്രാപ്തിപോലെ കൊടുത്തയപ്പാൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The disciples, as each one was able, decided to provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judea.
chapters.nkjv: Then the disciples, each according to his ability, determined to send relief to the brethren dwelling in Judea.
chapters.kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judæa:

chapters.ml: അവർ അതു നടത്തി, ബർന്നബാസിന്റെയും ശൌലിന്റെയും കയ്യിൽ മൂപ്പന്മാർക്കു കൊടുത്തയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.
chapters.nkjv: This they also did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
chapters.kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഹെരോദാരാജാവു സഭയിൽ ചിലരെ പീഡിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു കൈ നീട്ടി.
chapters.niv: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.
chapters.nkjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched out his hand to harass some from the church.
chapters.kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാന്റെ സഹോദരനായ യാക്കോബിനെ അവൻ വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
chapters.nkjv: Then he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
chapters.kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

chapters.ml: അതു യെഹൂദന്മാർക്കു പ്രസാദമായി എന്നു കണ്ടു അവൻ പത്രൊസിനെയും പിടിച്ചു. അപ്പോൾ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തിന്റെ പെരുനാൾ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he saw that this met with approval among the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.
chapters.nkjv: And because he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to seize Peter also. Now it was during the Days of Unleavened Bread.
chapters.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

chapters.ml: അവനെ പിടിച്ചശേഷം പെസഹ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിറുത്തുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു തടവിലാക്കി അവനെ കാപ്പാൻ നന്നാലു ചേവകർ ഉള്ള നാലു കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു ഏല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After arresting him, he put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out for public trial after the Passover.
chapters.nkjv: So when he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of soldiers to keep him, intending to bring him before the people after Passover.
chapters.kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പത്രൊസിനെ തടവിൽ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുവരുമ്പോൾ സഭ ശ്രദ്ധയോടെ അവന്നുവേണ്ടി ദൈവത്തോടു പ്രാർത്ഥന കഴിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was earnestly praying to God for him.
chapters.nkjv: Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church.
chapters.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവു അവനെ ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ നിറുത്തുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചതിന്റെ തലെരാത്രിയിൽ പത്രൊസ് രണ്ടു ചങ്ങലയാൽ ബന്ധിക്കപ്പെട്ടവനായി രണ്ടു പടയാളികളുടെ നടുവിൽ ഉറങ്ങുകയായിരുന്നു; വാതിലിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കാവൽക്കാർ കാരാഗൃഹം കാത്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries stood guard at the entrance.
chapters.nkjv: And when Herod was about to bring him out, that night Peter was sleeping, bound with two chains between two soldiers; and the guards before the door were keeping the prison.
chapters.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു കർത്താവിന്റെ ദൂതൻ അവിടെ പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി, അറയിൽ ഒരു വെളിച്ചം പ്രകാശിച്ചു. അവൻ പത്രൊസിനെ വിലാപ്പുറത്തു തട്ടി: വേഗം എഴുന്നേൽക്ക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു അവനെ ഉണർത്തി; ഉടനെ അവന്റെ ചങ്ങല കൈമേൽ നിന്നു വീണു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. "Quick, get up!" he said, and the chains fell off Peter’s wrists.
chapters.nkjv: Now behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the prison; and he struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, "Arise quickly!" And his chains fell off his hands.
chapters.kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ അവനോടു: അര കെട്ടി ചെരിപ്പു ഇട്ടു മുറുക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തു; നിന്റെ വസ്ത്രം പുതെച്ചു എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരിക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the angel said to him, "Put on your clothes and sandals." And Peter did so. "Wrap your cloak around you and follow me," the angel told him.
chapters.nkjv: Then the angel said to him, "Gird yourself and tie on your sandals"; and so he did. And he said to him, "Put on your garment and follow me."
chapters.kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നാലെ ചെന്നു, ദൂതൻ മുഖാന്തരം സംഭവിച്ചതു വാസ്തവം എന്നു അറിയാതെ താൻ ഒരു ദർശനം കാണുന്നു എന്നു നിരൂപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.
chapters.nkjv: So he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision.
chapters.kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒന്നാം കാവലും രണ്ടാമത്തേതും കടന്നു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുന്ന ഇരിമ്പു വാതിൽക്കൽ എത്തി. അതു അവർക്കു സ്വതവെ തുറന്നു; അവർ പുറത്തിറങ്ങി ഒരു തെരുവു കടന്നു, ഉടനെ ദൂതൻ അവനെ വിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.
chapters.nkjv: When they were past the first and the second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord; and they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
chapters.kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസിന്നു സുബോധം വന്നിട്ടു കർത്താവു തന്റെ ദൂതനെ അയച്ചു ഹെരോദാവിന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നും യെഹൂദജനത്തിന്റെ സകല പ്രതീക്ഷിയിൽനിന്നും എന്നെ വിടുവിച്ചു എന്നു ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ വാസ്തവമായി അറിയുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Peter came to himself and said, "Now I know without a doubt that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from Herod’s clutches and from everything the Jewish people were hoping would happen."
chapters.nkjv: And when Peter had come to himself, he said, "Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel, and has delivered me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people."
chapters.kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ഗ്രഹിച്ച ശേഷം അവൻ മർക്കൊസ് എന്നു മറുപേരുള്ള യോഹന്നാന്റെ അമ്മ മറിയയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു. അവിടെ അനേകർ ഒരുമിച്ചു കൂടി പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുകെണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When this had dawned on him, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.
chapters.nkjv: So, when he had considered this, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose surname was Mark, where many were gathered together praying.
chapters.kjv: And when he had considered the thing , he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പടിപ്പുരവാതിൽക്കൽ മുട്ടിയാറെ രോദാ എന്നൊരു ബാല്യക്കാരത്തി വിളികേൾപ്പാൻ അടുത്തുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer the door.
chapters.nkjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a girl named Rhoda came to answer.
chapters.kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസിന്റെ ശബ്ദം തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞു, സന്തോഷത്താൽ പടിവാതിൽ തുറക്കാതെ അകത്തേക്കു ഓടി, പത്രൊസ് പടിപ്പുരെക്കൽ നിൽക്കുന്നു എന്നു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, "Peter is at the door!"
chapters.nkjv: When she recognized Peter’s voice, because of her gladness she did not open the gate, but ran in and announced that Peter stood before the gate.
chapters.kjv: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവളോടു: നിനക്കു ഭ്രാന്തുണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; അവളോ: അല്ല, ഉള്ളതു തന്നേ എന്നു ഉറപ്പിച്ചുപറയുമ്പോൾ അവന്റെ ദൂതൻ ആകുന്നു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "You’re out of your mind," they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, "It must be his angel."
chapters.nkjv: But they said to her, "You are beside yourself!" Yet she kept insisting that it was so. So they said, "It is his angel."
chapters.kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

chapters.ml: പത്രൊസ് മുട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; അവർ തുറന്നപ്പോൾ അവനെ കണ്ടു വിസ്മയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.
chapters.nkjv: Now Peter continued knocking; and when they opened thedoor and saw him, they were astonished.
chapters.kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door , and saw him, they were astonished.

chapters.ml: അവർ മിണ്ടാതിരിപ്പാൻ അവൻ ആംഗ്യം കാട്ടി, കർത്താവു തന്നെ തടവിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ച വിവരം പറഞ്ഞു കേൾപ്പിച്ചു; ഇതു യാക്കോബിനോടും ശേഷം സഹോദരന്മാരോടും അറിയിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; പിന്നെ അവൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു വേറൊരു സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought him out of prison. "Tell James and the other brothers and sisters about this," he said, and then he left for another place.
chapters.nkjv: But motioning to them with his hand to keep silent, he declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, "Go, tell these things to James and to the brethren." And he departed and went to another place.
chapters.kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

chapters.ml: നേരം വെളുത്തപ്പോൾ പത്രൊസ് എവിടെ പോയി എന്നു പടയാളികൾക്കു അല്പമല്ലാത്ത പരിഭ്രമം ഉണ്ടായി
chapters.niv: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
chapters.nkjv: Then, as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
chapters.kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

chapters.ml: ഹെരോദാവു അവനെ അന്വേഷിച്ചിട്ടു കാണായ്കയാൽ കാവൽക്കാരെ വിസ്തരിച്ചു അവരെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ കല്പിച്ചു; പിന്നെ അവൻ യെഹൂദ്യ വിട്ടു കൈസര്യയിലേക്കു പോയി അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: After Herod had a thorough search made for him and did not find him, he cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then Herod went from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there.
chapters.nkjv: But when Herod had searched for him and not found him, he examined the guards and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
chapters.kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea, and there abode.

chapters.ml: അവൻ സോര്യരുടെയും സിദോന്യരുടെയും നേരെ ക്രുദ്ധിച്ചിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ രാജാവിന്റെ ദേശത്തുനിന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ ദേശത്തിന്നു ആഹാരം കിട്ടിവരികയാൽ അവർ ഏകമനസ്സോടെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു, രാജാവിന്റെ പള്ളിയറക്കാരനായ ബ്ളസ്തൊസിനെ വശത്താക്കി സന്ധിക്കായി അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon; they now joined together and sought an audience with him. After securing the support of Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king, they asked for peace, because they depended on the king’s country for their food supply.
chapters.nkjv: Now Herod had been very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon; but they came to him with one accord, and having made Blastus the king’s personal aide their friend, they asked for peace, because their country was supplied with food by the king’s country.
chapters.kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country .

chapters.ml: നിശ്ചയിച്ച ദിവസത്തിൽ ഹെരോദാവു രാജവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു ഭദ്രാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നു അവരോടു പ്രസംഗം കഴിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.
chapters.nkjv: So on a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat on his throne and gave an oration to them.
chapters.kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

chapters.ml: ഇതു മനുഷ്യന്റെ ശബ്ദമല്ല ഒരു ദേവന്റെ ശബ്ദം അത്രേ എന്നു ജനം ആർത്തു.
chapters.niv: They shouted, "This is the voice of a god, not of a man."
chapters.nkjv: And the people kept shouting, "The voice of a god and not of a man!"
chapters.kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവത്തിന്നു മഹത്വം കൊടുക്കായ്കയാൽ കർത്താവിന്റെ ദൂതൻ ഉടനെ അവനെ അടിച്ചു, അവൻ കൃമിക്കു ഇരയായി പ്രാണനെ വിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Immediately, because Herod did not give praise to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
chapters.nkjv: Then immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he did not give glory to God. And he was eaten by worms and died.
chapters.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദൈവ വചനം മേല്ക്കുമേൽ പരന്നുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.
chapters.nkjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
chapters.kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

chapters.ml: ബർന്നാബാസും ശൌലും ശുശ്രൂഷ നിവർത്തിച്ച ശേഷം മർക്കൊസ് എന്നു മറു പേരുള്ള യോഹന്നാനെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു യെരൂശലേം വിട്ടു മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.
chapters.nkjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their ministry, and they also took with them John whose surname was Mark.
chapters.kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

chapters.ml: അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിലെ സഭയിൽ ബർന്നബാസ്, നീഗർ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ശിമോൻ, കുറേനക്കാരനായ ലൂക്യൊസ്, ഇട പ്രഭുവമായ ഹെരോദാവോടുകൂടെ വളർന്ന മനായേൻ, ശൌൽ എന്നീ പ്രവാചകന്മാരും ഉപദേഷ്ടാക്കന്മാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch) and Saul.
chapters.nkjv: Now in the church that was at Antioch there were certain prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
chapters.kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

chapters.ml: അവർ കർത്താവിനെ ആരാധിച്ചും ഉപവസിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ: ഞാൻ ബർന്നബാസിനെയും ശൌലിനെയും വിളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന വേലെക്കായിട്ടു അവരെ എനിക്കു വേർതിരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."
chapters.nkjv: As they ministered to the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, "Now separate to Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."
chapters.kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ ഉപവസിച്ചു പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു അവരുടെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചു അവരെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.
chapters.nkjv: Then, having fasted and prayed, and laid hands on them, they sent them away.
chapters.kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

chapters.ml: പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു അവരെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചിട്ടു അവർ സെലൂക്യയിലേക്കു ചെന്നു; അവിടെ നിന്നു കപ്പൽ കയറി കുപ്രൊസ് ദ്വീപിലേക്കുപോയി
chapters.niv: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.
chapters.nkjv: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia, and from there they sailed to Cyprus.
chapters.kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

chapters.ml: സലമീസിൽ ചെന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ പള്ളിയിൽ ദൈവവചനം അറിയിച്ചു. യോഹന്നാൻ അവർക്കു ഭൃത്യനായിട്ടു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their helper.
chapters.nkjv: And when they arrived in Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. They also had John as their assistant.
chapters.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

chapters.ml: അവർ ദ്വീപിൽകൂടി പാഫൊസ് വരെ ചെന്നപ്പോൾ ബർയേശു എന്നു പേരുള്ള യെഹൂദനായി കള്ള പ്രവാചകനായോരു വിദ്വാനെ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar-Jesus,
chapters.kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ബുദ്ധിമാനായ സെർഗ്ഗ്യൊസ് പൌലൊസ് എന്ന ദേശാധിപതിയോടു കൂടെ ആയിരുന്നു; അവർ ബർന്നബാസിനെയും ശൌലിനെയും വരുത്തി ദൈവവചനം കേൾപ്പാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.
chapters.nkjv: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man. This man called for Barnabas and Saul and sought to hear the word of God.
chapters.kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ എലീമാസ് എന്ന വിദ്വാൻ - ഇതാകുന്നു അവന്റെ പേരിന്റെ അർത്ഥം - അവരോടു എതിർത്തുനിന്നു ദേശാധിപതിയുടെ വിശ്വാസം തടുത്തുകളവാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.
chapters.nkjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so his name is translated) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
chapters.kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പൌലൊസ് എന്നും പേരുള്ള ശൌൽ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മപൂർണ്ണനായി അവനെ ഉറ്റുനോക്കി:
chapters.niv: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,
chapters.nkjv: Then Saul, who also iscalled Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked intently at him
chapters.kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,

chapters.ml: ഹേ സകലകപടവും സകല ധൂർത്തും നിറഞ്ഞവനേ, പിശാചിന്റെ മകനേ, സർവ നീതിയുടെയും ശത്രുവേ, കർത്താവിന്റെ നേർവഴികളെ മറിച്ചുകളയുന്നത് നീ മതിയാക്കുകയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: "You are a child of the devil and an enemy of everything that is right! You are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?
chapters.nkjv: and said, "O full of all deceit and all fraud, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease perverting the straight ways of the Lord?
chapters.kjv: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ കർത്താവിന്റെ കൈ നിന്റെ മേൽ വീഴും; നീ ഒരു സമയത്തേക്കു സൂര്യനെ കാണാതെ കുരുടനായിരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഉടനെ ഒരു തിമിരവും ഇരുട്ടും അവന്റെ മേൽ വീണു; കൈപിടിച്ചു നടത്തുന്നവരെ തിരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ തപ്പിനടന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the hand of the Lord is against you. You are going to be blind for a time, not even able to see the light of the sun." Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
chapters.nkjv: And now, indeed, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a time." And immediately a dark mist fell on him, and he went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

chapters.ml: ഈ ഉണ്ടായത് ദേശാധിപതി കണ്ടിട്ടു കർത്താവിന്റെ ഉപദേശത്തിൽ വിസ്മയിച്ചു വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: Then the proconsul believed, when he saw what had been done, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസും കൂടെയുള്ളവരും പാഫൊസിൽനിന്നു കപ്പൽ നീക്കി, പംഫുല്യാദേശത്തിലെ പെർഗ്ഗെക്കു ചെന്നു. അവിടെവെച്ചു യോഹന്നാൻ അവരെ വിട്ടുപിരിഞ്ഞു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now when Paul and his party set sail from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia; and John, departing from them, returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവരോ പെർഗ്ഗയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പിസിദ്യാദേശത്തിലെ അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിൽ എത്തി ശബ്ബത്ത് നാളിൽ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു ഇരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.
chapters.nkjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
chapters.kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

chapters.ml: ന്യായപ്രമാണവും പ്രവാചകങ്ങളും വായിച്ചുതീർന്നപ്പോൾ പള്ളിപ്രമാണികൾ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, നിങ്ങൾക്കു ജനത്തോടു പ്രബോധനം വല്ലതും ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ പറവിൻ എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the leaders of the synagogue sent word to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have a word of exhortation for the people, please speak."
chapters.nkjv: And after the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, "Men and brethren, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, say on."
chapters.kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു ആംഗ്യം കാട്ടി പറഞ്ഞതു: യിസ്രായേൽ പുരുഷന്മാരും ദൈവഭക്തന്മാരും ആയുള്ളോരെ, കേൾപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: "Fellow Israelites and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me!
chapters.nkjv: Then Paul stood up, and motioning with his hand said, "Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen:
chapters.kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

chapters.ml: യിസ്രായേൽജനത്തിന്റെ ദൈവം നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു, മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തിലെ പ്രവാസകാലത്തു ജനത്തെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ചു, ഭുജവീര്യംകൊണ്ടു അവിടെനിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The God of the people of Israel chose our ancestors; he made the people prosper during their stay in Egypt; with mighty power he led them out of that country;
chapters.nkjv: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He brought them out of it.
chapters.kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

chapters.ml: മരുഭൂമിയിൽ നാല്പതു സംവത്സരകാലത്തോളം അവരുടെ സ്വഭാവം സഹിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: for about forty years he endured their conduct in the wilderness;
chapters.nkjv: Now for a time of about forty years He put up with their ways in the wilderness.
chapters.kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

chapters.ml: കനാൻ ദേശത്തിലെ ഏഴു ജാതികളെ ഒടുക്കി, അവരുടെ ദേശം അവർക്കു അവകാശമായി വിഭാഗിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു. അങ്ങനെ ഏകദേശം നാനൂറ്റമ്പതു സംവത്സരം കഴിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and he overthrew seven nations in Canaan, giving their land to his people as their inheritance.
chapters.nkjv: And when He had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, He distributed their land to them by allotment.
chapters.kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെശേഷം അവൻ അവർക്കു ശമൂവേൽ പ്രവാചകൻ വരെ ന്യായാധിപതിമാരെ കൊടുത്തു,
chapters.niv: All this took about 450 years. "After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
chapters.nkjv: "After that He gave them judges for about four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
chapters.kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവർ ഒരു രാജാവിനെ ചോദിച്ചു; ദൈവം അവർക്കു ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രക്കാരനായ കീശിന്റെ മകൻ ശൌലിനെ നാല്പതാണ്ടേക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.
chapters.nkjv: And afterward they asked for a king; so God gave them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
chapters.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

chapters.ml: അവനെ നീക്കീട്ടു ദാവീദിനെ അവർക്കു രാജാവായി വാഴിച്ചു: ഞാൻ യിശ്ശായിയുടെ മകനായ ദാവീദിനെ എനിക്കു ബോധിച്ച പുരുഷനായി കണ്ടു; അവൻ എന്റെ ഹിതം എല്ലാം ചെയ്യും എന്നു അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After removing Saul, he made David their king. God testified concerning him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.’
chapters.nkjv: And when He had removed him, He raised up for them David as king, to whom also He gave testimony and said, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after My own heart, who will do all My will.’
chapters.kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സന്തതിയിൽനിന്നു ദൈവം വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തതുപോലെ യിസ്രായേലിന്നു യേശു എന്ന രക്ഷിതാവിനെ കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: "From this man’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.
chapters.nkjv: From this man’s seed, according to the promise, God raised up for Israel a Savior—Jesus—
chapters.kjv: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വരവിന്നു മുമ്പെ യോഹന്നാൻ യിസ്രായേൽജനത്തിന്നു ഒക്കെയും മാനസാന്തരത്തിന്റെ സ്നാനം പ്രസംഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: after John had first preached, before His coming, the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
chapters.kjv: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ ജീവകാലം തികവാറായപ്പോൾ: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ ആർ എന്നു നിരൂപിക്കുന്നു? ഞാൻ മശീഹയല്ല; അവൻ എന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു; അവന്റെ കാലിലെ ചെരിപ്പു അഴിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ യോഗ്യനല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: As John was completing his work, he said: ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not the one you are looking for. But there is one coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’
chapters.nkjv: And as John was finishing his course, he said, ‘Who do you think I am? I am not He. But behold, there comes One after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to loose.’
chapters.kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he . But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, അബ്രാഹാംവംശത്തിലെ മക്കളും അവരോടു ചേർന്ന ദൈവഭക്തന്മാരുമായുള്ളാരേ, നമുക്കാകുന്നു ഈ രക്ഷാവചനം അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: "Fellow children of Abraham and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
chapters.nkjv: "Men and brethren, sons of the family of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, to you the word of this salvation has been sent.
chapters.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേം നിവാസികളും അവരുടെ പ്രമാണികളും അവനെയോ ശബ്ബത്തുതോറും വായിച്ചുവരുന്ന പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ വചനങ്ങളെയോ തിരിച്ചറിയാതെ അവനെ ശിക്ഷക്കു വിധിക്കയാൽ അവെക്കു നിവൃത്തിവരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
chapters.nkjv: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they did not know Him, nor even the voices of the Prophets which are read every Sabbath, have fulfilled them in condemning Him.
chapters.kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him .

chapters.ml: മരണത്തിന്നു ഒരു ഹേതുവും കാണാഞ്ഞിട്ടും അവനെ കൊല്ലേണം എന്നു അവർ പീലാത്തൊസിനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.
chapters.nkjv: And though they found no cause for death inHim, they asked Pilate that He should be put to death.
chapters.kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

chapters.ml: അവനെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു ഒക്കെയും തികെച്ചശേഷം അവർ അവനെ മരത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറക്കി ഒരു കല്ലറയിൽ വെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they had carried out all that was written about him, they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had fulfilled all that was written concerning Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.
chapters.kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

chapters.ml: ദൈവമോ അവനെ മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: But God raised him from the dead,
chapters.nkjv: But God raised Him from the dead.
chapters.kjv: But God raised him from the dead:

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നോടുകൂടെ ഗലീലയിൽനിന്നു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു വന്നവർക്കു ഏറിയ ദിവസം പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി; അവർ ഇപ്പോൾ ജനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അവന്റെ സാക്ഷികൾ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and for many days he was seen by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to our people.
chapters.nkjv: He was seen for many days by those who came up with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are His witnesses to the people.
chapters.kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ചെയ്ത വാഗ്ദത്തം യേശുവിനെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചതിനാൽ മക്കൾക്കു നിവർത്തിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളോടു സുവിശേഷിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "We tell you the good news: What God promised our ancestors
chapters.nkjv: And we declare to you glad tidings— that promise which was made to the fathers.
chapters.kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

chapters.ml: നീ എന്റെ പുത്രൻ; ഇന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചു എന്നു രണ്ടാം സങ്കീർത്തനത്തിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു വല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: " ‘You are my son; today I have become your father.’
