chapters.nkjv: God has fulfilled this for us their children, in that He has raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son, Today I have begotten You.’
chapters.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

chapters.ml: ഇനി ദ്രവത്വത്തിലേക്കു തിരിയാതവണ്ണം അവൻ അവനെ മരിച്ചവരിനിന്നു എഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു അവൻ: ദാവീദിന്റെ സ്ഥിരമായുള്ള വിശുദ്ധ കൃപകളെ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു നല്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു
chapters.niv: God raised him from the dead so that he will never be subject to decay. As God has said, " ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
chapters.nkjv: And that He raised Him from the dead, no more to return to corruption, He has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the sure mercies of David.’
chapters.kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു സങ്കിർത്തനത്തിലും: നിന്റെ പരിശുദ്ധനെ ദ്രവത്വം കാണ്മാൻ നീ വിട്ടുകൊടുക്കയില്ല എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So it is also stated elsewhere: " ‘You will not let your holy one see decay.’
chapters.nkjv: Therefore He also says in another Psalm: ‘You will not allow Your Holy One to see corruption.’
chapters.kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

chapters.ml: ദാവീദ് തന്റെ തലമുറയിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലോചനെക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തശേഷം നിദ്ര പ്രാപിച്ചു തന്റെ പിതാക്കന്മാരോടു ചേർന്നു ദ്രവത്വം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: "Now when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep; he was buried with his ancestors and his body decayed.
chapters.nkjv: "For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell asleep, was buried with his fathers, and saw corruption;
chapters.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചവനോ ദ്രവത്വം കണ്ടില്ല. ആകയാൽ സഹോദരന്മാരേ,
chapters.niv: But the one whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
chapters.nkjv: but He whom God raised up saw no corruption.
chapters.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ മൂലം നിങ്ങളോടു പാപമോചനം അറിയിക്കുന്നു എന്നും
chapters.niv: "Therefore, my friends, I want you to know that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore let it be known to you, brethren, that through this Man is preached to you the forgiveness of sins;
chapters.kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്താൽ നിങ്ങൾക്കു നീതീകരണം വരുവാൻ കഴിയാത്ത സകലത്തിൽ നിന്നും വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഏവനും ഇവനാൽ നീതീകരിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു എന്നും നിങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Through him everyone who believes is set free from every sin, a justification you were not able to obtain under the law of Moses.
chapters.nkjv: and by Him everyone who believes is justified from all things from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
chapters.kjv: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ, “ഹേ നിന്ദക്കാരേ, നോക്കുവിൻ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു നശിച്ചുപോകുവിൻ. നിങ്ങളുടെ കാലത്തു ഞാൻ ഒരു പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്യുന്നു; നിങ്ങളോടു വിവരിച്ചാൽ നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിക്കാത്ത പ്രവൃത്തി തന്നേ”
chapters.niv: Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to you:
chapters.nkjv: Beware therefore, lest what has been spoken in the prophets come upon you:
chapters.kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

chapters.ml: എന്നു പ്രവാചകപുസ്തകങ്ങളിൽ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഭവിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: " ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish, for I am going to do something in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’ "
chapters.nkjv: ‘Behold, you despisers, Marvel and perish! For I work a work in your days, A work which you will by no means believe, Though one were to declare it to you.’ "
chapters.kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

chapters.ml: അവർ പള്ളിവിട്ടു പോകുമ്പോൾ പിറ്റെ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ ഈ വചനം തങ്ങളോടു പറയേണം എന്നു അവർ അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.
chapters.nkjv: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
chapters.kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

chapters.ml: പള്ളി പിരിഞ്ഞശേഷം യെഹൂദന്മാരിലും ഭക്തിയുള്ള യെഹൂദമതാനുസാരികളിലും പലർ പൌലൊസിനെയും ബർന്നാബാസിനെയും അനുഗമിച്ചു; അവർ അവരോടു സംസാരിച്ചു ദൈവ കൃപയിൽ നിലനിൽക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവരെ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the congregation was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the congregation had broken up, many of the Jews and devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
chapters.kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെ ശബ്ബത്തിൽ ഏകദേശം പട്ടണം മുഴുവനും ദൈവവചനം കേൾപ്പാൻ വന്നു കൂടി.
chapters.niv: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city came together to hear the word of God.
chapters.kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരോ പുരുഷാരത്തെ കണ്ടു അസൂയ നിറഞ്ഞവരായി ദുഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പൌലൊസ് സംസാരിക്കുന്നതിന്നു എതിർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy. They began to contradict what Paul was saying and heaped abuse on him.
chapters.nkjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy; and contradicting and blaspheming, they opposed the things spoken by Paul.
chapters.kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പൌലൊസും ബർന്നബാസും ധൈര്യംപൂണ്ടു: ദൈവവചനം ആദ്യം നിങ്ങളോടു പറയുന്നതു ആവശ്യമായിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ അതിനെ തള്ളി നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നെ നിത്യജീവന്നു അയോഗ്യർ എന്നു വിധിച്ചുകളയുന്നതിനാൽ ഇതാ, ഞങ്ങൾ ജാതികളിലേക്കു തിരിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: "We had to speak the word of God to you first. Since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
chapters.nkjv: Then Paul and Barnabas grew bold and said, "It was necessary that the word of God should be spoken to you first; but since you reject it, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
chapters.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

chapters.ml: “നീ ഭൂമിയുടെ അറ്റത്തോളവും രക്ഷ ആകേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ജാതികളുടെ വെളിച്ചമാക്കി വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു കർത്താവു ഞങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: " ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’ "
chapters.nkjv: For so the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have set you as a light to the Gentiles, That you should be for salvation to the ends of the earth.’ "
chapters.kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

chapters.ml: ജാതികൾ ഇതു കേട്ടു സന്തോഷിച്ചു ദൈവവചനത്തെ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി, നിത്യജീവന്നായി നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ എല്ലാവരും വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of the Lord. And as many as had been appointed to eternal life believed.
chapters.kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിന്റെ വചനം ആ നാട്ടിൽ എങ്ങും വ്യാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.
chapters.nkjv: And the word of the Lord was being spread throughout all the region.
chapters.kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരോ ഭക്തിയുള്ള മാന്യസ്ത്രീകളെയും പട്ടണത്തിലെ പ്രധാനികളെയും ഇളക്കി പൌലൊസിന്റെയും ബർന്നബാസിന്റെയും നേരെ ഉപദ്രവമുണ്ടാക്കി അവരെ തങ്ങളുടെ അതിരുകളിൽ നിന്നു പുറത്താക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the Jewish leaders incited the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.
chapters.nkjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, raised up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.
chapters.kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ കാലിലെ പൊടി അവരുടെ നേരെ തട്ടിക്കളഞ്ഞു ഇക്കോന്യയിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: So they shook the dust off their feet as a warning to them and went to Iconium.
chapters.nkjv: But they shook off the dust from their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
chapters.kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാർ സന്തോഷവും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവും നിറഞ്ഞവരായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
chapters.kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: ഇക്കോന്യയിൽ അവർ ഒരുമിച്ചു യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാരിലും യവനന്മാരിലും വലിയോരു പുരുഷാരം വിശ്വസിപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: At Iconium Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue. There they spoke so effectively that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened in Iconium that they went together to the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of the Jews and of the Greeks believed.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസിക്കാത്ത യെഹൂദന്മാരോ ജാതികളുടെ മനസ്സു സഹോദരന്മാരുടെ നേരെ ഇളക്കി വഷളാക്കി.
chapters.niv: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the other Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
chapters.nkjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brethren.
chapters.kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവർ വളരെക്കാലം അവിടെ പാർത്തു, കർത്താവിൽ ആശ്രയിച്ചു പ്രാഗത്ഭ്യത്തോടെ പ്രസംഗിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു; അവൻ തന്റെ കൃപയുടെ വചനത്തിന്നു സാക്ഷിനിന്നു, അവരുടെ കയ്യാൽ അടയാളങ്ങളും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും ഉണ്ടാകുവാൻ വരം നല്കി.
chapters.niv: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who confirmed the message of his grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who was bearing witness to the word of His grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
chapters.kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പട്ടണത്തിലെ ജനസമൂഹം ഭിന്നിച്ചു ചിലര്‍ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ പക്ഷത്തിലും ചിലർ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെ പക്ഷത്തിലും ആയി.
chapters.niv: The people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.
chapters.nkjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
chapters.kjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

chapters.ml: അവരെ അവമാനിപ്പാനും കല്ലെറിവാനും ജാതികളും യെഹൂദന്മാരും അവിടത്തെ പ്രമാണികളോടുകൂടി ഒരു ആക്രമം ഭാവിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ അതു ഗ്രഹിച്ചു ലുസ്ത്ര,
chapters.niv: There was a plot afoot among both Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.
chapters.nkjv: And when a violent attempt was made by both the Gentiles and Jews, with their rulers, to abuse and stone them,
chapters.kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

chapters.ml: ദെർബ്ബ ഇന്ന ലുക്കവോന്യപട്ടണങ്ങളിലേക്കും ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ദേശത്തിലേക്കും
chapters.niv: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,
chapters.nkjv: they became aware of it and fled to Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and to the surrounding region.
chapters.kjv: They were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

chapters.ml: ഓടിപ്പോയി അവിടെ സുവിശേഷം അറിയിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: where they continued to preach the gospel.
chapters.nkjv: And they were preaching the gospel there.
chapters.kjv: And there they preached the gospel.

chapters.ml: ലുസ്ത്രയിൽ അമ്മയുടെ ഗർഭംമുതൽ മുടന്തനായി ഒരിക്കലും നടന്നിട്ടില്ലാതെയും കാലിന്നു ശക്തിയില്ലാതെയും ഉള്ളോരു പുരുഷൻ ഇരുന്നിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In Lystra there sat a man who was lame. He had been that way from birth and had never walked.
chapters.nkjv: And in Lystra a certain man without strength in his feet was sitting, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who had never walked.
chapters.kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:

chapters.ml: അവൻ പൌലൊസ് സംസാരിക്കുന്നതു കേട്ടു; അവൻ അവനെ ഉറ്റു നോക്കി, സൌഖ്യം പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ അവന്നു വിശ്വാസമുണ്ടു എന്നു കണ്ടിട്ടു:
chapters.niv: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed
chapters.nkjv: This man heard Paul speaking. Paul, observing him intently and seeing that he had faith to be healed,
chapters.kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

chapters.ml: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു കാലൂന്നി നിവിർന്നുനിൽക്ക എന്നു ഉറക്കെ പറഞ്ഞു; അവൻ കുതിച്ചെഴുന്നേറ്റു നടന്നു
chapters.niv: and called out, "Stand up on your feet!" At that, the man jumped up and began to walk.
chapters.nkjv: said with a loud voice, "Stand up straight on your feet!" And he leaped and walked.
chapters.kjv: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് ചെയ്തതു പുരുഷാരം കണ്ടിട്ടു: ദേവന്മാർ മനുഷ്യരൂപത്തിൽ നമ്മുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഇറങ്ങിവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ലുക്കവോന്യഭാഷയിൽ നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in human form!"
chapters.nkjv: Now when the people saw what Paul had done, they raised their voices, saying in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!"
chapters.kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

chapters.ml: ബർന്നബാസിന്നു ഇന്ദ്രൻ എന്നും പൌലൊസ് മുഖ്യപ്രസംഗിയാകയാൽ അവന്നു ബുധൻ എന്നു പേർവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes because he was the chief speaker.
chapters.nkjv: And Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul, Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
chapters.kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിലുള്ള ഇന്ദ്രക്ഷേത്രത്തിലെ പുരോഹിതൻ കാളകളെയും പൂമാലകളെയും ഗോപുരത്തിങ്കൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പുരുഷാരത്തോടുകൂടെ യാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates because he and the crowd wanted to offer sacrifices to them.
chapters.nkjv: Then the priest of Zeus, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, intending to sacrifice with the multitudes.
chapters.kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

chapters.ml: ഇതു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരായ ബർന്നബാസും പൌലൊസും കേട്ടിട്ടു വസ്ത്രം കീറിക്കൊണ്ടു പുരുഷാരത്തിന്റെ ഇടയിലേക്കു ഓടിച്ചെന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:
chapters.nkjv: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard this, they tore their clothes and ran in among the multitude, crying out
chapters.kjv: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of , they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

chapters.ml: പുരുഷന്മാരേ, നിങ്ങൾ ഈ ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്തു? ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളോടു സമസ്വഭാവമുള്ള മനുഷ്യർ അത്രെ; നിങ്ങൾ ഈ വ്യർത്ഥകാര്യങ്ങളെ വിട്ടു, ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും സമുദ്രവും അവയിലുള്ള സകലവും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തിങ്കലേക്കു തിരിയേണം എന്നുള്ള സുവിശേഷം ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളോടു അറിയിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Friends, why are you doing this? We too are only human, like you. We are bringing you good news, telling you to turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
chapters.nkjv: and saying, "Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men with the same nature as you, and preach to you that you should turn from these useless things to the living God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all things that are in them,
chapters.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

chapters.ml: കഴിഞ്ഞ കാലങ്ങളിൽ അവൻ സകലജാതികളെയും സ്വന്ത വഴികളിൽ നടപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the past, he let all nations go their own way.
chapters.nkjv: who in bygone generations allowed all nations to walk in their own ways.
chapters.kjv: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും അവൻ നന്മചെയ്കയും ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു മഴയും ഫലപുഷ്ടിയുള്ള കാലങ്ങളും നിങ്ങൾക്കു തരികയും ആഹാരവും സന്തോഷവും നല്കി നിങ്ങളെ തൃപ്തരാക്കുകയും ചെയ്തുപോന്നതിനാൽ തന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു സാക്ഷ്യം തരാതിരുന്നിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Yet he has not left himself without testimony: He has shown kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons; he provides you with plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy."
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless He did not leave Himself without witness, in that He did good, gave us rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness."
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞു തങ്ങൾക്കു യാഗം കഴിക്കാതവണ്ണം പുരുഷാരത്തെ പ്രയാസത്തോടെ തടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Even with these words, they had difficulty keeping the crowd from sacrificing to them.
chapters.nkjv: And with these sayings they could scarcely restrain the multitudes from sacrificing to them.
chapters.kjv: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിൽ നിന്നും ഇക്കോന്യയിൽ നിന്നും യെഹൂദന്മാർ വന്നു കൂടി പുരുഷാരത്തെ വശത്താക്കി പൌലൊസിനെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു; അവൻ മരിച്ചു എന്നു വിചാരിച്ചിട്ടു അവനെ പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പുറത്തേക്കു ഇഴെച്ചു കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowd over. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, thinking he was dead.
chapters.nkjv: Then Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there; and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing him to be dead.
chapters.kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനെ ചുറ്റിനിൽക്കയിൽ അവൻ എഴുന്നേറ്റു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ചെന്നു; പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ബർന്നബാസിനോടുകൂടെ ദെർബ്ബെക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.
chapters.nkjv: However, when the disciples gathered around him, he rose up and went into the city. And the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

chapters.ml: ആ പട്ടണത്തിലും സുവിശേഷം അറിയിച്ചു പലരെയും ശിഷ്യരാക്കിയശേഷം അവർ ലുസ്ത്ര, ഇക്കോന്യ, അന്ത്യോക്യ എന്ന പട്ടണങ്ങളിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു,
chapters.niv: They preached the gospel in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium and Antioch,
chapters.nkjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city and made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
chapters.kjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്തിൽ നില നിൽക്കേണം എന്നും നാം അനേകം കഷ്ടങ്ങളിൽകൂടി ദൈവരാജ്യത്തിൽ കടക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു എന്നും പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചു ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ മനസ്സു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. "We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God," they said.
chapters.nkjv: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and saying, "We must through many tribulations enter the kingdom of God."
chapters.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: അവർ സഭതോറും അവർക്കു മൂപ്പന്മാരെ നിയമിക്കയും ഉപവസിച്ചും പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു തങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിച്ച കർത്താവിങ്കൽ അവരെ ഭരമേല്പിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had appointed elders in every church, and prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord in whom they had believed.
chapters.kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

chapters.ml: അവർ പിസിദ്യയിൽകൂടി കടന്നു പംഫുല്യയിൽഎത്തി,
chapters.niv: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia,
chapters.nkjv: And after they had passed through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
chapters.kjv: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

chapters.ml: പെർഗ്ഗയിൽവചനം പ്രസംഗിച്ചശേഷം അത്തല്യെക്കു പോയി
chapters.niv: and when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
chapters.kjv: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നു കപ്പൽ കയറി അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിലേക്കു പോയി; തങ്ങൾ നിവർത്തിച്ച വേലക്കായി ദൈവകൃപയിൽ അവരെ ഭരമേല്പിച്ചയച്ചതു അവിടെനിന്നു ആയിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.
chapters.nkjv: From there they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work which they had completed.
chapters.kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ എത്തിയശേഷം സഭയെ ഒരുമിച്ചു കൂട്ടി, ദൈവം തങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു ചെയ്തതൊക്കെയും ജാതികൾക്കു വിശ്വാസത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽ തുറന്നുകൊടുത്തതും അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how he had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had come and gathered the church together, they reported all that God had done with them, and that He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
chapters.kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ ശിഷ്യന്മാരോടുകൂടെ കുറെക്കാലം അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: And they stayed there a long time with the disciples.
chapters.nkjv: So they stayed there a long time with the disciples.
chapters.kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദ്യയിൽനിന്നു ചിലർ വന്നു: നിങ്ങൾ മോശെ കല്പിച്ച ആചാരം അനുസരിച്ചു പരിച്ഛേദന ഏൽക്കാഞ്ഞാൽ രക്ഷ പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ കഴികയില്ല എന്നു സഹോദരന്മാരെ ഉപദേശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Certain people came down from Judea to Antioch and were teaching the believers: "Unless you are circumcised, according to the custom taught by Moses, you cannot be saved."
chapters.nkjv: And certain men came down from Judea and taught the brethren, "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved."
chapters.kjv: And certain men which came down from Judæa taught the brethren, and said , Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസിന്നും ബർന്നബാസിന്നും അവരോടു അല്പമല്ലാത്ത വാദവും തർക്കവും ഉണ്ടായിട്ടു പൌലൊസും ബർന്നബാസും അവരിൽ മറ്റു ചിലരും ഈ തർക്കസംഗതിയെപ്പറ്റി യെരൂശലേമിൽ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരുടെയും മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെയും അടുക്കൽ പോകേണം എന്നു നിശ്ചയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: This brought Paul and Barnabas into sharp dispute and debate with them. So Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and dispute with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them should go up to Jerusalem, to the apostles and elders, about this question.
chapters.kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

chapters.ml: സഭ അവരെ യാത്ര അയച്ചിട്ടു അവർ ഫൊയ്നീക്ക്യയിലും ശമര്യയിലും കൂടി കടന്നു ജാതികളുടെ മാനസാന്തരവിവരം അറിയിച്ചു സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു മഹാസന്തോഷം വരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: The church sent them on their way, and as they traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, they told how the Gentiles had been converted. This news made all the believers very glad.
chapters.nkjv: So, being sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, describing the conversion of the Gentiles; and they caused great joy to all the brethren.
chapters.kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

chapters.ml: അവർ യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തിയാറെ സഭയും അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും അവരെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു; ദൈവം തങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ ഇരുന്നു ചെയ്തതൊക്കയും അവർ അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they came to Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and elders, to whom they reported everything God had done through them.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the church and the apostles and the elders; and they reported all things that God had done with them.
chapters.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പരീശപക്ഷത്തിൽനിന്നു വിശ്വസിച്ചവർ ചിലർ എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരെ പരിച്ഛേദന കഴിപ്പിക്കയും മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം ആചരിപ്പാൻ കല്പിക്കയും വേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then some of the believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, "The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to keep the law of Moses."
chapters.nkjv: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, "It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses."
chapters.kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

chapters.ml: ഈ സംഗതിയെക്കുറിച്ചു വിചാരിപ്പാൻ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും വന്നു കൂടി. വളരെ തർക്കം ഉണ്ടയശേഷം പത്രൊസ് എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: The apostles and elders met to consider this question.
chapters.nkjv: Now the apostles and elders came together to consider this matter.
chapters.kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, കുറെ നാൾ മുമ്പെ ദൈവം നിങ്ങളിൽ വെച്ചു ഞാൻ മുഖാന്തരം ജാതികൾ സുവിശേഷവചനം കേട്ടു വിശ്വസിക്കേണം എന്നു നിശ്ചയിച്ചതു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: After much discussion, Peter got up and addressed them: "Brothers, you know that some time ago God made a choice among you that the Gentiles might hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
chapters.nkjv: And when there had been much dispute, Peter rose up and said to them: "Men and brethren, you know that a good while ago God chose among us, that by my mouth the Gentiles should hear the word of the gospel and believe.
chapters.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

chapters.ml: ഹൃദയങ്ങളെ അറിയുന്ന ദൈവം നമുക്കു തന്നതുപോലെ അവർക്കും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനെ കൊടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു സാക്ഷിനിന്നു വിശ്വാസത്താൽ
chapters.niv: God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he did to us.
chapters.nkjv: So God, who knows the heart, acknowledged them by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as Hedid to us,
chapters.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങളെ ശുദ്ധീകരിച്ചതിനാൽ നമുക്കും അവർക്കും തമ്മിൽ ഒരു വ്യത്യാസവും വെച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: He did not discriminate between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.
chapters.nkjv: and made no distinction between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
chapters.kjv: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നമ്മുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർക്കും നമുക്കും ചുമപ്പാൻ കിഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ലത്ത നുകം ശിഷ്യന്മാരുടെ കഴുത്തിൽ വെപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ ദൈവത്തെ പരീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?
chapters.niv: Now then, why do you try to test God by putting on the necks of Gentiles a yoke that neither we nor our ancestors have been able to bear?
chapters.nkjv: Now therefore, why do you test God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
chapters.kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

chapters.ml: കര്‍ത്താവായ യേശുവിന്റെ കൃപയാൽ രക്ഷപ്രാപിക്കും എന്നു നാം വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നതു പോലെ അവരും വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു
chapters.niv: No! We believe it is through the grace of our Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are."
chapters.nkjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved in the same manner as they."
chapters.kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

chapters.ml: ജനസമൂഹം എല്ലാം മിണ്ടാതെ ബർന്നബാസും പൌലൊസും ദൈവം തങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ടു ജാതികളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ചെയ്യിച്ച അടയാളങ്ങളും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും എല്ലാം വിവരിക്കുന്നതു കേട്ടുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The whole assembly became silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul telling about the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the multitude kept silent and listened to Barnabas and Paul declaring how many miracles and wonders God had worked through them among the Gentiles.
chapters.kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

chapters.ml: അവർ പറഞ്ഞു നിറുത്തിയശേഷം യാക്കോബ് ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: When they finished, James spoke up. "Brothers," he said, "listen to me.
chapters.nkjv: And after they had become silent, James answered, saying, "Men and brethren, listen to me:
chapters.kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, എന്റെ വാക്കു കേട്ടു കൊൾവിൻ; ദൈവം തന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നായി ജാതികളിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ജനത്തെ എടുത്തുകൊൾവാൻ ആദ്യമായിട്ടു കടാക്ഷിച്ചതു ശിമോൻ വിവരിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Simon has described to us how God first intervened to choose a people for his name from the Gentiles.
chapters.nkjv: Simon has declared how God at the first visited the Gentiles to take out of them a people for His name.
chapters.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

chapters.ml: ഇതിനോടു പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെ വാക്യങ്ങളും ഒക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The words of the prophets are in agreement with this, as it is written:
chapters.nkjv: And with this the words of the prophets agree, just as it is written:
chapters.kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

chapters.ml: “അനന്തരം ഞാൻ ദാവീദിന്റെ വീണുപോയ കൂടാരത്തെ വീണ്ടും പണിയും; അതിന്റെ ശൂന്യശിഷ്ടങ്ങളെ വീണ്ടും പണിതു അതിനെ നിവിർത്തും;
chapters.niv: " ‘After this I will return and rebuild David’s fallen tent. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,
chapters.nkjv: ‘After this I will return And will rebuild the tabernacle of David, which has fallen down; I will rebuild its ruins, And I will set it up;
chapters.kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരിൽ ശേഷിച്ചവരും എന്റെ നാമം വിളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന സകലജാതികളും കർത്താവിനെ അന്വേഷിക്കും എന്നു
chapters.niv: that the rest of mankind may seek the Lord, even all the Gentiles who bear my name, says the Lord, who does these things’ —
chapters.nkjv: So that the rest of mankind may seek the Lord, Even all the Gentiles who are called by My name, Says the Lord who does all these things.’
chapters.kjv: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

chapters.ml: ഇതു പൂർവ്വകാലം മുതൽ അറിയിക്കുന്ന കർത്താവു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു” എന്നു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: things known from long ago.
chapters.nkjv: "Known to God from eternity are all His works.
chapters.kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ജാതികളിൽനിന്നു ദൈവത്തിങ്കലേക്കു തിരിയുന്നവരെ നാം അസഹ്യപ്പെടുത്താതെ
chapters.niv: "It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not make it difficult for the Gentiles who are turning to God.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I judge that we should not trouble those from among the Gentiles who are turning to God,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

chapters.ml: അവർ വിഗ്രഹമാലിന്യങ്ങൾ, പരസംഗം, ശ്വാസംമുട്ടിച്ചത്തതു, രക്തം എന്നിവ വർജ്ജിച്ചിരിപ്പാൻ നാം അവർക്കു എഴുതേണം എന്നു ഞാൻ അഭിപ്രായപ്പെടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Instead we should write to them, telling them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals and from blood.
chapters.nkjv: but that we write to them to abstain from things polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from things strangled, and from blood.
chapters.kjv: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം ശബ്ബത്തുതോറും പള്ളികളിൽ വായിച്ചുവരുന്നതിനാൽ പൂർവ്വകാലംമുതൽ പട്ടണം തോറും അതു പ്രസംഗിക്കുന്നവർ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For the law of Moses has been preached in every city from the earliest times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath."
chapters.nkjv: For Moses has had throughout many generations those who preach him in every city, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath."
chapters.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ തങ്ങളിൽ ചില പുരുഷന്മാരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു പൌലൊസിനോടും ബർന്നബാസിനോടും കൂടെ അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിലേക്കു അയക്കേണം എന്നു അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും സർവ്വസഭയും നിർണ്ണയിച്ചു, സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ പ്രമാണപ്പെട്ട പുരുഷന്മാരായ ബർശബാസ് എന്ന യൂദയെയും ശീലാസിനെയും നിയോഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to choose some of their own men and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas (called Barsabbas) and Silas, men who were leaders among the believers.
chapters.nkjv: Then it pleased the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas, namely, Judas who was also named Barsabas, and Silas, leading men among the brethren.
chapters.kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely , Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ കൈവശം എഴുതി അയച്ചതെന്തെന്നാൽ: അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരായ സഹോദരന്മാരും അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിലും സൂറിയയിലും കിലിക്ക്യയിലും ജാതികളിൽ നിന്നു ചേർന്ന സഹോദരന്മാർക്കു വന്ദനം.
chapters.niv: With them they sent the following letter: The apostles and elders, your brothers, To the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria and Cilicia: Greetings.
chapters.nkjv: They wrote this letter by them: The apostles, the elders, and the brethren, To the brethren who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: Greetings.
chapters.kjv: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ കല്പന കൊടുക്കാതെ ചിലർ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു നിങ്ങളെ വാക്കുകളാൽ ഭ്രമിപ്പിച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങളെ കലക്കിക്കളഞ്ഞു എന്നു കേൾക്കകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: We have heard that some went out from us without our authorization and disturbed you, troubling your minds by what they said.
chapters.nkjv: Since we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, "Youmust be circumcised and keep the law" —to whom we gave no such commandment—
chapters.kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ ചില പുരുഷന്മാരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു നമ്മുടെ കർത്താവായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി പ്രാണത്യാഗം ചെയ്തവരായ നമ്മുടെ
chapters.niv: So we all agreed to choose some men and send them to you with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul—
chapters.nkjv: it seemed good to us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
chapters.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

chapters.ml: പ്രീയ ബർന്നബാസോടും പൌലൊസോടും കൂടെ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ അയക്കേണം എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ ഒരുമനപ്പെട്ടു നിശ്ചയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.nkjv: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.kjv: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ യൂദയെയും ശീലാസിനെയും അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ വാമൊഴിയായും ഇതുതന്നേ അറിയിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to confirm by word of mouth what we are writing.
chapters.nkjv: We have therefore sent Judas and Silas, who will also report the same things by word of mouth.
chapters.kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

chapters.ml: വിഗ്രഹാർപ്പിതം, രക്തം, ശ്വാസംമുട്ടിച്ചത്തതു, പരസംഗം എന്നിവ വർജ്ജിക്കുന്നതു ആവശ്യം എന്നല്ലാതെ അധികമായ ഭാരം ഒന്നും നിങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ ചുമത്തരുതു എന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിന്നും ഞങ്ങൾക്കും തോന്നിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond the following requirements:
chapters.nkjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things:
chapters.kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

chapters.ml: ഇവ വർജ്ജിച്ചു സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ടാൽ നന്നു; ശുഭമായിരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: You are to abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality. You will do well to avoid these things. Farewell.
chapters.nkjv: that you abstain from things offered to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality. If you keep yourselves from these, you will do well. Farewell.
chapters.kjv: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ വിടവാങ്ങി അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിൽ ചെന്നു ജനസമൂഹത്തെ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി ലേഖനം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they gathered the church together and delivered the letter.
chapters.nkjv: So when they were sent off, they came to Antioch; and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
chapters.kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

chapters.ml: അവർ ഈ ആശ്വാസവചനം വായിച്ചു സന്തോഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The people read it and were glad for its encouraging message.
chapters.nkjv: When they had read it, they rejoiced over its encouragement.
chapters.kjv: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

chapters.ml: യൂദയും ശീലാസും പ്രവാചകന്മാർ ആകകൊണ്ടു പല വചനങ്ങളാലും സഹോദരന്മാരെ പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചു ഉറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the believers.
chapters.nkjv: Now Judas and Silas, themselves being prophets also, exhorted and strengthened the brethren with many words.
chapters.kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them .

chapters.ml: കുറെനാൾ താമസിച്ചശേഷം സഹോദരന്മാർ അവരെ അയച്ചവരുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കു സമാധാനത്തോടെ പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the believers with the blessing of peace to return to those who had sent them.
chapters.nkjv: And after they had stayed there for a time, they were sent back with greetings from the brethren to the apostles.
chapters.kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പൌലൊസും ബർന്നബാസും അന്ത്യൊക്ക്യയിൽ പാർത്തു മറ്റു പലരോടും കൂടി കർത്താവിന്റെ വചനം ഉപദേശിച്ചും സുവിശേഷിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: However, it seemed good to Silas to remain there.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

chapters.ml: കുറെനാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു പൌലൊസ് ബർന്നബാസിനോടു: നാം കർത്താവിന്റെ വചനം അറിയിച്ച പട്ടണംതോറും പിന്നെയും ചെന്നു സഹോദരന്മാർ എങ്ങനെയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നോക്കുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us go back and visit the believers in all the towns where we preached the word of the Lord and see how they are doing."
chapters.nkjv: Paul and Barnabas also remained in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
chapters.kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

chapters.ml: മർക്കൊസ് എന്ന യോഹന്നാനെയും കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോകുവാൻ ബർന്നബാസ് ഇച്ഛിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them,
chapters.nkjv: Then after some days Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us now go back and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, andsee how they are doing."
chapters.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസോ പംഫുല്യയിൽനിന്നു തങ്ങളെ വിട്ടു പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു വരാതെ പോയവനെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോകുന്നതു യോഗ്യമല്ല എന്നു നിരൂപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: but Paul did not think it wise to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work.
chapters.nkjv: Now Barnabas was determined to take with them John called Mark.
chapters.kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവർ തമ്മിൽ ഉഗ്രവാദമുണ്ടായിട്ടു വേർ പിരിഞ്ഞു. ബർന്നബാസ് മർക്കൊസിനെ കൂട്ടി കപ്പൽകയറി കുപ്രൊസ് ദ്വീപിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: They had such a sharp disagreement that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,
chapters.nkjv: But Paul insisted that they should not take with them the one who had departed from them in Pamphylia, and had not gone with them to the work.
chapters.kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസോ ശീലാസിനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു സഹോദരന്മാരാൽ കർത്താവിന്റെ കൃപയിൽ ഭരമേല്പിക്കപ്പെട്ടിട്ടു
chapters.niv: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the believers to the grace of the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: Then the contention became so sharp that they parted from one another. And so Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus;
chapters.kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

chapters.ml: യാത്ര പുറപ്പെട്ടു സുറിയാ കിലിക്യാ ദേശങ്ങളിൽ കൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു സഭകളെ ഉറപ്പിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
chapters.nkjv: but Paul chose Silas and departed, being commended by the brethren to the grace of God.
chapters.kjv: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദെർബ്ബെയിലും ലുസ്ത്രയിലും ചെന്നു. അവിടെ വിശ്വാസമുള്ളോരു യെഹൂദസ്ത്രീയുടെ മകനായി തിമൊഥെയൊസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ള ഒരു ശിഷ്യൻ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ യവനനായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named Timothy lived, whose mother was Jewish and a believer but whose father was a Greek.
chapters.nkjv: Then he came to Derbe and Lystra. And behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a certain Jewish woman who believed, but his father was Greek.
chapters.kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ലുസ്ത്രയിലും ഇക്കോന്യയിലുമുള്ള സഹോദരന്മാരാൽ നല്ല സാക്ഷ്യം കൊണ്ടവൻ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The believers at Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.
chapters.nkjv: He was well spoken of by the brethren who were at Lystra and Iconium.
chapters.kjv: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

chapters.ml: അവൻ തന്നോടുകൂടെ പോരേണം എന്നു പൌലൊസ് ഇച്ഛിച്ചു; അവന്റെ അപ്പൻ യവനൻ എന്നു അവിടങ്ങളിലുള്ള യഹൂദന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നതിനാൽ അവരെ വിചാരിച്ചു അവനെ പരിച്ഛേദന കഴിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Paul wanted to take him along on the journey, so he circumcised him because of the Jews who lived in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
chapters.nkjv: Paul wanted to have him go on with him. And he took him and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in that region, for they all knew that his father was Greek.
chapters.kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

chapters.ml: അവർ പട്ടണം തോറും ചെന്നു യെരൂശലേമിലെ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും മൂപ്പന്മാരും വിധിച്ച നിർണ്ണയങ്ങൾ പ്രമാണിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവർക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: As they traveled from town to town, they delivered the decisions reached by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.
chapters.nkjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered to them the decrees to keep, which were determined by the apostles and elders at Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ സഭകൾ വിശ്വാസത്തിൽ ഉറെക്കയും എണ്ണത്തിൽ ദിവസേന പെരുകുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.
chapters.nkjv: So the churches were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
chapters.kjv: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആസ്യയിൽ വചനം പ്രസംഗിക്കരുതെന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു വിലക്കുകയാൽ ഫ്രുഗ്യയിലും ഗലാത്യദേശത്തിലും കൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Spirit from preaching the word in the province of Asia.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had gone through Phrygia and the region of Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to preach the word in Asia.
chapters.kjv: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

chapters.ml: മുസ്യയിൽ എത്തി ബിഥുന്യെക്കു പോകുവാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു; യേശുവിന്റെ ആത്മാവോ അവരെ സമ്മതിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: When they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not allow them to.
chapters.nkjv: After they had come to Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit did not permit them.
chapters.kjv: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

chapters.ml: അവർ മുസ്യ കടന്നു ത്രോവാസിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.
chapters.nkjv: So passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
chapters.kjv: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

chapters.ml: അവിടെവെച്ചു പൌലൊസ് രാത്രിയിൽ മക്കെദോന്യക്കാരനായൊരു പുരുഷൻ അരികെ നിന്നു: നീ മക്കെദോന്യെക്കു കടന്നുവന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ സഹായിക്ക എന്നു തന്നോടു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നതായി ഒരു ദർശനം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: During the night Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and begging him, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."
chapters.nkjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night. A man of Macedonia stood and pleaded with him, saying, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."
chapters.kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

chapters.ml: ഈ ദർശനം കണ്ടിട്ടു അവരോടു സുവിശേഷം അറിയിപ്പാൻ ദൈവം ഞങ്ങളെ വിളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിശ്ചയിച്ചു, ഞങ്ങൾ ഉടനെ മക്കെദോന്യെക്കു പുറപ്പെടുവാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After Paul had seen the vision, we got ready at once to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
chapters.nkjv: Now after he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the gospel to them.
chapters.kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ ഞങ്ങൾ ത്രോവാസിൽനിന്നു കപ്പൽ നീക്കി നേരെ സമൊത്രാക്കെയിലേക്കും പിറ്റെന്നാൾ നവപൊലിക്കും അവിടെ നിന്നു ഫിലിപ്പിയിലേക്കും ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: From Troas we put out to sea and sailed straight for Samothrace, and the next day we went on to Neapolis.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, sailing from Troas, we ran a straight course to Samothrace, and the next day came to Neapolis,
chapters.kjv: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

chapters.ml: ഇതു മക്കെദോന്യയുടെ ആ ഭാഗത്തെ ഒരു പ്രധാന പട്ടണവും റോമക്കാർ കുടിയേറിപ്പാർത്തതും ആകുന്നു. ആ പട്ടണത്തിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ ചില ദിവസം പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: From there we traveled to Philippi, a Roman colony and the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.
chapters.nkjv: and from there to Philippi, which is the foremost city of that part of Macedonia, a colony. And we were staying in that city for some days.
chapters.kjv: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

chapters.ml: ശബ്ബത്തുനാളിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ ഗോപുരത്തിന്നു പുറത്തേക്കു പോയി അവിടെ പ്രാർത്ഥനാസ്ഥലം ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കും എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ വിചാരിച്ചു പുഴവക്കത്തു ഇരുന്നു; അവിടെ കൂടിവന്ന സ്ത്രീകളോടു സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to the river, where we expected to find a place of prayer. We sat down and began to speak to the women who had gathered there.
chapters.nkjv: And on the Sabbath day we went out of the city to the riverside, where prayer was customarily made; and we sat down and spoke to the women who met there.
chapters.kjv: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

chapters.ml: തുയത്തൈരാപട്ടണക്കാരത്തിയും രക്താംബരം വില്ക്കുന്നവളുമായി ലുദിയ എന്നു പേരുള്ള ദൈവ ഭക്തയായോരു സ്ത്രീ കേട്ടുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു. പൌലൊസ് സംസാരിച്ചതു ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു കർത്താവു അവളുടെ ഹൃദയം തുറന്നു
chapters.niv: One of those listening was a woman from the city of Thyatira named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth. She was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain woman named Lydia heard us. She was a seller of purple from the city of Thyatira, who worshiped God. The Lord opened her heart to heed the things spoken by Paul.
chapters.kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us : whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

chapters.ml: അവളും കുടുംബവും സ്നാനം ഏറ്റ ശേഷം: നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെ കർത്താവിൽ വിശ്വസ്ത എന്നു എണ്ണിയിരിക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ എന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ വന്നു പാർപ്പിൻ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു ഞങ്ങളെ നിർബ്ബന്ധിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When she and the members of her household were baptized, she invited us to her home. "If you consider me a believer in the Lord," she said, "come and stay at my house." And she persuaded us.
chapters.nkjv: And when she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, "If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come to my house and stay." So she persuaded us.
chapters.kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us , saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there . And she constrained us.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ പ്രാർത്ഥനാസ്ഥലത്തേക്കു ചെല്ലുമ്പോൾ വെളിച്ചപ്പാടത്തിയായി ലക്ഷണം പറഞ്ഞു യജമാനന്മാർക്കു വളരെ ലാഭം വരുത്തുന്ന ഒരു ബാല്യക്കാരത്തി ഞങ്ങളെ എതിരേറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Once when we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a female slave who had a spirit by which she predicted the future. She earned a great deal of money for her owners by fortune-telling.
chapters.nkjv: Now it happened, as we went to prayer, that a certain slave girl possessed with a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much profit by fortune-telling.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

chapters.ml: അവൾ പൌലൊസിന്റെയും ഞങ്ങളുടെയും പിന്നാലെ വന്നു: ഈ മനുഷ്യർ അത്യുന്നതനായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർ, രക്ഷാമാർഗ്ഗം നിങ്ങളോടു അറിയിക്കുന്നവർ എന്നു വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: She followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, "These men are servants of the Most High God, who are telling you the way to be saved."
chapters.nkjv: This girl followed Paul and us, and cried out, saying, "These men are the servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us the way of salvation."
chapters.kjv: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവൾ പലനാൾ ചെയ്തുവന്നു. പൌലൊസ് മുഷിഞ്ഞു തിരിഞ്ഞു നോക്കി അവളിലുള്ള ഭൂതത്തോടു: അവളെ വിട്ടുപോകുവാൻ ഞാൻ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ നിന്നോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ആ നാഴികയിൽ തന്നേ അതു അവളെ വിട്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: She kept this up for many days. Finally Paul became so annoyed that he turned around and said to the spirit, "In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!" At that moment the spirit left her.
chapters.nkjv: And this she did for many days. But Paul, greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, "I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her." And he came out that very hour.
chapters.kjv: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ യജമാനന്മാര്‍ തങ്ങളുടെ ലാഭത്തിന്റെ ആശ പോയ്പോയതു കണ്ടിട്ടു പൌലൊസിനെയും ശീലാസിനെയും പിടിച്ചു, ചന്തസ്ഥലത്തു പ്രമാണികളുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കു വലിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുപോയി
chapters.niv: When her owners realized that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to face the authorities.
chapters.nkjv: But when her masters saw that their hope of profit was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to the authorities.
chapters.kjv: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

chapters.ml: അധിപതികളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നിർത്തി; യെഹൂദന്മാരായ ഈ മനുഷ്യർ നമ്മുടെ പട്ടണത്തെ കലക്കി,
chapters.niv: They brought them before the magistrates and said, "These men are Jews, and are throwing our city into an uproar
chapters.nkjv: And they brought them to the magistrates, and said, "These men, being Jews, exceedingly trouble our city;
chapters.kjv: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

chapters.ml: റോമാക്കാരായ നമുക്കു അംഗീകരിപ്പാനും അനുസരിപ്പാനും ന്യായമല്ലാത്ത ആചാരങ്ങളെ പ്രസംഗിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice."
chapters.nkjv: and they teach customs which are not lawful for us, being Romans, to receive or observe."
chapters.kjv: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

chapters.ml: പുരുഷാരവും അവരുടെ നേരെ ഇളകി; അധിപതികൾ അവരുടെ വസ്ത്രം പറിച്ചുരിഞ്ഞു കോൽകൊണ്ടു അവരെ അടിപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten with rods.
chapters.nkjv: Then the multitude rose up together against them; and the magistrates tore off their clothes and commanded them to be beaten with rods.
chapters.kjv: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them .

chapters.ml: അവരെ വളരെ അടിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം തടവിൽ ആക്കി കാരാഗൃഹപ്രമാണിയോടു അവരെ സൂക്ഷമത്തോടെ കാപ്പാൻ കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, commanding the jailer to keep them securely.
chapters.kjv: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള കല്പന കിട്ടുകയാൽ അവരെ അകത്തെ തടവിൽ ആക്കി അവരുടെ കാൽ ആമത്തിൽ ഇട്ടു പൂട്ടി.
chapters.niv: When he received these orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.
chapters.nkjv: Having received such a charge, he put them into the inner prison and fastened their feet in the stocks.
chapters.kjv: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

chapters.ml: അർദ്ധരാത്രിക്കു പൌലൊസും ശീലാസും പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു ദൈവത്തെ പാടി സ്തുതിച്ചു: തടവുകാർ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
chapters.nkjv: But at midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
chapters.kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

chapters.ml: പെട്ടെന്നു വലിയോരു ഭൂകമ്പം ഉണ്ടായി, കാരാഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനം കുലുങ്ങി വാതിൽ ഒക്കെയും തുറന്നുപോയി, എല്ലാവരുടെയും ചങ്ങല അഴിഞ്ഞുവീണു -
chapters.niv: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.
chapters.nkjv: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened and everyone’s chains were loosed.
chapters.kjv: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.

chapters.ml: കരാഗൃഹപ്രമാണി ഉറക്കുണർന്നു കാരാഗൃഹത്തിന്റെ വാതിലുകൾ ഉറന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടിട്ടു ചങ്ങലക്കാർ ഓടിപ്പോയ്ക്കളഞ്ഞു. എന്നു ഊഹിച്ചു വാളൂരി തന്നെത്താൻ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The jailer woke up, and when he saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself because he thought the prisoners had escaped.
chapters.nkjv: And the keeper of the prison, awaking from sleep and seeing the prison doors open, supposing the prisoners had fled, drew his sword and was about to kill himself.
chapters.kjv: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പൌലൊസ്: നിനക്കു ഒരു ദോഷവും ചെയ്യരുതു; ഞങ്ങൾ എല്ലാവരും ഇവിടെ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ എന്നു ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Paul shouted, "Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!"
chapters.nkjv: But Paul called with a loud voice, saying, "Do yourself no harm, for we are all here."
chapters.kjv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വെളിച്ചം ചോദിച്ചു അകത്തേക്കു ചാടി വിറെച്ചുകൊണ്ടു പൌലൊസിന്റെയും ശീലാസിന്റെയും മുമ്പിൽ വീണു.
chapters.niv: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.
chapters.nkjv: Then he called for a light, ran in, and fell down trembling before Paul and Silas.
chapters.kjv: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

chapters.ml: അവരെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു: യജമാനന്മാരേ, രക്ഷ പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ ഞാൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He then brought them out and asked, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
chapters.nkjv: And he brought them out and said, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
chapters.kjv: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

chapters.ml: കർത്താവായ യേശുവിൽ വിശ്വസിക്ക; എന്നാൽ നീയും നിന്റെ കുടുംബവും രക്ഷപ്രാപിക്കും എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They replied, "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household."
chapters.nkjv: So they said, "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household."
chapters.kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവർ കർത്താവിന്റെ വചനം അവനോടും അവന്റെ വീട്ടിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരോടും പ്രസംഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.
chapters.nkjv: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all who were in his house.
chapters.kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രാത്രിയിൽ, ആ നാഴികയിൽ തന്നേ, അവരെ കൂട്ടികൊണ്ടുപോയി അവരുടെ മുറിവുകളെ കഴുകി; താനും തനിക്കുള്ളവരെല്ലാവരും താമസിയാതെ സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: At that hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; then immediately he and all his household were baptized.
chapters.nkjv: And he took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes. And immediately he and all his family were baptized.
chapters.kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവരെ വീട്ടിൽ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു അവർക്കു ഭക്ഷണം കൊടുത്തു, ദൈവത്തിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചതിൽ വീടടക്കം ആനന്ദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The jailer brought them into his house and set a meal before them; he was filled with joy because he had come to believe in God—he and his whole household.
chapters.nkjv: Now when he had brought them into his house, he set food before them; and he rejoiced, having believed in God with all his household.
chapters.kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

chapters.ml: നേരം പുലർന്നപ്പോൾ അധിപതികൾ കോൽക്കാരെ അയച്ചു: ആ മനുഷ്യരെ വീട്ടയക്കേണം എന്നു പറയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When it was daylight, the magistrates sent their officers to the jailer with the order: "Release those men."
chapters.nkjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the officers, saying, "Let those men go."
chapters.kjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

chapters.ml: കാരാഗൃഹപ്രമാണി ഈ വാക്കു പൌലൊസിനോടു അറിയിച്ചു: നിങ്ങളെ വിട്ടയപ്പാൻ അധിപതികൾ ആളയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ആകയാൽ സമാധാനത്തോടെ പോകുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The jailer told Paul, "The magistrates have ordered that you and Silas be released. Now you can leave. Go in peace."
chapters.nkjv: So the keeper of the prison reported these words to Paul, saying, "The magistrates have sent to let you go. Now therefore depart, and go in peace."
chapters.kjv: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് അവരോടു: റോമപൌരന്മാരായ ഞങ്ങളെ അവർ വിസ്താരം കൂടാതെ പരസ്യമായി അടിപ്പിച്ചു തടവിലാക്കിയല്ലോ; ഇപ്പോൾ രഹസ്യമായി ഞങ്ങളെ പുറത്താക്കുന്നുവോ? അങ്ങനെ അല്ല; അവർ തന്നേ വന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുപോകട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But Paul said to the officers: "They beat us publicly without a trial, even though we are Roman citizens, and threw us into prison. And now do they want to get rid of us quietly? No! Let them come themselves and escort us out."
chapters.nkjv: But Paul said to them, "They have beaten us openly, uncondemned Romans, and have thrown us into prison. And now do they put us out secretly? No indeed! Let them come themselves and get us out."
chapters.kjv: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

chapters.ml: കോൽക്കാർ ആ വാക്കു അധിപതികളോടു ബോധിപ്പിച്ചാറെ അവർ റോമ പൌരന്മാർ എന്നു കേട്ടു അവർ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു ചെന്നു അവരോടു നല്ല വാക്കു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The officers reported this to the magistrates, and when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were alarmed.
chapters.nkjv: And the officers told these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans.
chapters.kjv: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

chapters.ml: അവരെ പുറത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു പട്ടണം വിട്ടുപോകേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They came to appease them and escorted them from the prison, requesting them to leave the city.
chapters.nkjv: Then they came and pleaded with them and brought them out, and asked them to depart from the city.
chapters.kjv: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

chapters.ml: അവർ തടവു വിട്ടു ലുദിയയുടെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു സഹോദരന്മാരെ കണ്ടു ആശ്വസിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house, where they met with the brothers and sisters and encouraged them. Then they left.
chapters.nkjv: So they went out of the prison and entered thehouseof Lydia; and when they had seen the brethren, they encouraged them and departed.
chapters.kjv: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

chapters.ml: അവർ അംഫിപൊലിസിലും അപ്പൊലോന്യയിലും കൂടി കടന്നു തെസ്സലൊനീക്കയിൽ എത്തി; അവിടെ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ ഒരു പള്ളി ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Paul and his companions had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
chapters.nkjv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a synagogue of the Jews.
chapters.kjv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് പതിവു പോലെ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു മൂന്നു ശബ്ബത്തിൽ തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളെ ആധാരമാക്കി അവരോടു വാദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
chapters.nkjv: Then Paul, as his custom was, went in to them, and for three Sabbaths reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
chapters.kjv: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തു കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിക്കയും മരിച്ചവരിൽ നിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്ക്കുയും ചെയ്യേണ്ടതു എന്നും ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു അറിയിക്കുന്ന ഈ യേശുതന്നേ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു തെളിയിച്ചു വിവരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: explaining and proving that the Messiah had to suffer and rise from the dead. "This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Messiah," he said.
chapters.nkjv: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, "This Jesus whom I preach to you is the Christ."
chapters.kjv: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ ചിലരും ഭക്തിയുള്ള യവനന്മാരിൽ ഒരു വലിയ കൂട്ടവും മാന്യസ്ത്രീകളിൽ അനേകരും വിശ്വസിച്ചു പൌലൊസിനോടും ശീലാസിനോടും ചേർന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few prominent women.
chapters.nkjv: And some of them were persuaded; and a great multitude of the devout Greeks, and not a few of the leading women, joined Paul and Silas.
chapters.kjv: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാരോ അസൂയപൂണ്ടു, മിനക്കെട്ടുനടക്കുന്ന ചില ദുഷ്ടന്മാരെ ചേർത്തു പുരുഷാരത്തെ ഇളക്കി പട്ടണത്തിൽ കലഹം ഉണ്ടാക്കി യാസോന്റെ വീടു വളഞ്ഞു അവരെ ജനസമൂഹത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുവാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But other Jews were jealous; so they rounded up some bad characters from the marketplace, formed a mob and started a riot in the city. They rushed to Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas in order to bring them out to the crowd.
chapters.nkjv: But the Jews who were not persuaded, becoming envious, took some of the evil men from the marketplace, and gathering a mob, set all the city in an uproar and attacked the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
chapters.kjv: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

chapters.ml: അവരെ കാണാഞ്ഞിട്ടു യാസോനെയും ചില സഹോദരന്മാരെയും നഗരാധിപന്മാരുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കു ഇഴെച്ചുകൊണ്ടു: ഭൂലോകത്തെ കലഹിപ്പിച്ചവർ ഇവിടെയും എത്തി;
chapters.niv: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some other believers before the city officials, shouting: "These men who have caused trouble all over the world have now come here,
chapters.nkjv: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some brethren to the rulers of the city, crying out, "These who have turned the world upside down have come here too.
chapters.kjv: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

chapters.ml: യാസോൻ അവരെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടും ഇരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ ഒക്കെയും യേശു എന്ന മറ്റൊരുവൻ രാജാവു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു കൈസരുടെ നിയമങ്ങൾക്കു പ്രതികൂലമായി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and Jason has welcomed them into his house. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, one called Jesus."
chapters.nkjv: Jason has harbored them, and these are all acting contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying there is another king—Jesus."
chapters.kjv: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cæsar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടിട്ടു പുരുഷാരവും നഗരാധിപന്മാരും ഭ്രമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When they heard this, the crowd and the city officials were thrown into turmoil.
chapters.nkjv: And they troubled the crowd and the rulers of the city when they heard these things.
chapters.kjv: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

chapters.ml: യാസോൻ മുതലായവരോടു ജാമ്യം വാങ്ങി അവരെ വിട്ടയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then they made Jason and the others post bond and let them go.
chapters.nkjv: So when they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
chapters.kjv: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാർ ഉടനെ, രാത്രിയിൽ തന്നേ, പൌലൊസിനെയും ശീലാസിനെയും ബെരോവെക്കു പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു. അവിടെ എത്തിയാറെ അവർ യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ പള്ളിയിൽ പോയി.
chapters.niv: As soon as it was night, the believers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.
chapters.nkjv: Then the brethren immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea. When they arrived, they went into the synagogue of the Jews.
chapters.kjv: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

chapters.ml: അവർ തെസ്സലോനീക്കയിലുള്ളവരെക്കാൾ ഉത്തമന്മാരായിരുന്നു. അവർ വചനം പൂർണ്ണജാഗ്രതയോടെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടതല്ലാതെ അതു അങ്ങനെ തന്നെയോ എന്നു ദിനംപ്രതി തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളെ പരിശോധിച്ചു പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the Berean Jews were of more noble character than those in Thessalonica, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if what Paul said was true.
chapters.nkjv: These were more fair-minded than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness, and searched the Scriptures daily tofindout whether these things were so.
chapters.kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

chapters.ml: അവരിൽ പലരും മാന്യരായ യവനസ്ത്രീകളിലും പുരുഷന്മാരിലും അനേകരും വിശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: As a result, many of them believed, as did also a number of prominent Greek women and many Greek men.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore many of them believed, and also not a few of the Greeks, prominent women as well as men.
chapters.kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് ബെരോവയിലും ദൈവവചനം അറിയച്ചതു തെസ്സലൊനീക്കയിലെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ അറിഞ്ഞു അവിടെയും വന്നു പുരുഷാരത്തെ ഇളക്കി ഭ്രമിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: But when the Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God at Berea, some of them went there too, agitating the crowds and stirring them up.
chapters.nkjv: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that the word of God was preached by Paul at Berea, they came there also and stirred up the crowds.
chapters.kjv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ സഹോദരന്മാർ പൌലൊസിനെ സമുദ്രതീരത്തേക്കു പറഞ്ഞയച്ചു; ശീലാസും തിമൊഥെയോസും അവിടെത്തന്നേ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The believers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed at Berea.
chapters.nkjv: Then immediately the brethren sent Paul away, to go to the sea; but both Silas and Timothy remained there.
chapters.kjv: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസിനോടുകൂടെ വഴിത്തുണ പോയവർ അവനെ അഥേനയോളം കൊണ്ടുപോയി; ശീലാസും തിമൊഥെയോസും കഴിയുന്ന വേഗത്തിൽ തന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരേണം എന്നുള്ള കല്പന വാങ്ങി മടങ്ങിപ്പോന്നു.
chapters.niv: Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then left with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.
chapters.nkjv: So those who conducted Paul brought him to Athens; and receiving a command for Silas and Timothy to come to him with all speed, they departed.
chapters.kjv: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

chapters.ml: അഥേനയിൽ പൌലൊസ് അവർക്കായി കാത്തിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ നഗരത്തിൽ ബിംബങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു മനസ്സിന്നു ചൂടുപിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was greatly distressed to see that the city was full of idols.
chapters.nkjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him when he saw that the city was given over to idols.
chapters.kjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽവെച്ചു യെഹൂദന്മാരോടും ദൈവഭക്തന്മാരോടും ചന്ത സ്ഥലത്തു ദിവസേന കണ്ടവരോടും സംഭാഷിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he reasoned in the synagogue with both Jews and God-fearing Greeks, as well as in the marketplace day by day with those who happened to be there.
