chapters.nkjv: Therefore he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and with the Gentile worshipers, and in the marketplace daily with those who happened to be there.
chapters.kjv: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

chapters.ml: എപ്പിക്കൂര്യരും സ്തോയിക്കരും ആയ തത്വജ്ഞാനികളിൽ ചിലർ അവനോടു വാദിച്ചു: ഈ വിടുവായൻ എന്തു പറവാൻ പോകുന്നു എന്നു ചിലരും അവൻ യേശുവിനെയും പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തെയും പ്രസംഗിക്ക കൊണ്ടു: ഇവൻ അന്യദേവതകളെ ഘോഷിക്കുന്നവൻ എന്നു തോന്നുന്നു മറ്റു ചിലരും പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: A group of Epicurean and Stoic philosophers began to debate with him. Some of them asked, "What is this babbler trying to say?" Others remarked, "He seems to be advocating foreign gods." They said this because Paul was preaching the good news about Jesus and the resurrection.
chapters.nkjv: Then certain Epicurean and Stoic philosophers encountered him. And some said, "What does this babbler want to say?" Others said, "He seems to be a proclaimer of foreign gods," because he preached to them Jesus and the resurrection.
chapters.kjv: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു അരയോപഗക്കുന്നിന്മേൽ കൊണ്ടുചെന്നു: നീ പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്ന ഈ നവീനോപദേശം ഇന്നതു എന്നു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു അറിയാമോ?
chapters.niv: Then they took him and brought him to a meeting of the Areopagus, where they said to him, "May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?
chapters.nkjv: And they took him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, "May we know what this new doctrine is of which you speak?
chapters.kjv: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is ?

chapters.ml: നീ ചില അപൂർവ്വങ്ങളെ ഞങ്ങളുടെ ചെവിയിൽ കടത്തുന്നുവല്ലോ; അതു എന്തു എന്നു അറിവാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: You are bringing some strange ideas to our ears, and we would like to know what they mean."
chapters.nkjv: For you are bringing some strange things to our ears. Therefore we want to know what these things mean."
chapters.kjv: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അഥേനർ ഒക്കെയും അവിടെ വന്നു പാർക്കുന്ന പരദേശികളും വല്ല പുതുമയും പറകയോ കേൾക്കയോ ചെയ്‍വാനല്ലാതെ മറ്റൊന്നിന്നും അവസരമുള്ളവരല്ല.
chapters.niv: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)
chapters.nkjv: For all the Athenians and the foreigners who were there spent their time in nothing else but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
chapters.kjv: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് അരയോപഗമദ്ധ്യേ നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു പറഞ്ഞതു. അഥേനപുരുഷന്മാരേ, നിങ്ങൾ എല്ലാറ്റിലും അതിഭക്തന്മാർ എന്നു ഞാൻ കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Paul then stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said: "People of Athens! I see that in every way you are very religious.
chapters.nkjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of the Areopagus and said, "Men of Athens, I perceive that in all things you are very religious;
chapters.kjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ചുറ്റിനടന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ പൂജാസ്ഥാനങ്ങളെ നോക്കുമ്പോൾ “അജ്ഞാത ദേവന്നു” എന്നു എഴുത്തുള്ള ഒരു വേദിക്കല്ലു കണ്ടു; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ അറിയാതെ പൂജിക്കുന്നതു തന്നേ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു അറിയിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For as I walked around and looked carefully at your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: to an unknown god. So you are ignorant of the very thing you worship—and this is what I am going to proclaim to you.
chapters.nkjv: for as I was passing through and considering the objects of your worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Therefore, the One whom you worship without knowing, Him I proclaim to you:
chapters.kjv: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

chapters.ml: ലോകവും അതിലുള്ളതു ഒക്കെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ദൈവം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്നും ഭൂമിക്കും നാഥനാകകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: "The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by human hands.
chapters.nkjv: "God, who made the world and everything in it, since He is Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made with hands.
chapters.kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

chapters.ml: കൈപ്പണിയായ ക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളിൽ വാസം ചെയ്യുന്നില്ല. താൻ എല്ലാവർക്കും ജീവനും ശ്വാസവും സകലവും കൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ ആകയാൽ വല്ലതിന്നും മുട്ടുള്ളവൻ എന്നപോലെ മാനുഷ്യകൈകളാൽ ശുശ്രൂഷ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: And he is not served by human hands, as if he needed anything. Rather, he himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
chapters.nkjv: Nor is He worshiped with men’s hands, as though He needed anything, since He gives to all life, breath, and all things.
chapters.kjv: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

chapters.ml: ഭൂതലത്തിൽ എങ്ങു കുടിയിരിപ്പാൻ അവൻ ഒരുത്തനിൽനിന്നു മനുഷ്യജാതിയെ ഒക്കെയും ഉളവാക്കി, അവരുടെ നിവാസത്തിന്നു അതിരുകളും കാലങ്ങളും നിശചയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and he marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands.
chapters.nkjv: And He has made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, and has determined their preappointed times and the boundaries of their dwellings,
chapters.kjv: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

chapters.ml: അവർ ദൈവത്തെ തപ്പിനോക്കി കണ്ടെത്തുമോ എന്നു വെച്ചു അവനെ അന്വേഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു തന്നേ. അവൻ നമ്മിൽ ആർക്കും അകന്നിരിക്കുന്നവനല്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: God did this so that they would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from any one of us.
chapters.nkjv: so that they should seek the Lord, in the hope that they might grope for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us;
chapters.kjv: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

chapters.ml: അവനിലല്ലോ നാം ജീവിക്കയും ചരിക്കയും ഇരിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നതു. അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ കവിവരന്മാരിലും ചിലർ “നാം അവന്റെ സന്താനമല്ലോ” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: ‘For in him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’
chapters.nkjv: for in Him we live and move and have our being, as also some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also His offspring.’
chapters.kjv: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

chapters.ml: നാം ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സന്താനം എന്നു വരികയാൽ ദൈവം മനുഷ്യന്റെ ശില്പവിദ്യയും സങ്കല്പവുംകൊണ്ടു കൊത്തിത്തീർക്കുന്ന പൊൻ, വെള്ളി, കല്ലു എന്നിവയോടു സദൃശം എന്നു നിരൂപിക്കേണ്ടതല്ല.
chapters.niv: "Therefore since we are God’s offspring, we should not think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone—an image made by human design and skill.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, since we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold or silver or stone, something shaped by art and man’s devising.
chapters.kjv: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അറിയായ്മയുടെ കാലങ്ങളെ ദൈവം ലക്ഷ്യമാക്കാതെ ഇപ്പോൾ എല്ലായിടത്തും എല്ലാവരും മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടേണമെന്നു മനുഷ്യരോടു കല്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In the past God overlooked such ignorance, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent.
chapters.nkjv: Truly, these times of ignorance God overlooked, but now commands all men everywhere to repent,
chapters.kjv: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

chapters.ml: താൻ നിയമിച്ച പുരുഷൻ മുഖാന്തരം ലോകത്തെ നീതിയിൽ ന്യായം വിധിപ്പാൻ അവൻ ഒരു ദിവസത്തെ നിശ്ചയിച്ചു അവനെ മരിച്ചവരിൽനിന്നു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിച്ചതിനാൽ എല്ലാവർക്കും അതിന്റെ ഉറപ്പു നല്കിയുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For he has set a day when he will judge the world with justice by the man he has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising him from the dead."
chapters.nkjv: because He has appointed a day on which He will judge the world in righteousness by the Man whom He has ordained. He has given assurance of this to all by raising Him from the dead."
chapters.kjv: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവരുടെ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു കേട്ടിട്ടു ചിലർ പരിഹസിച്ചു; മറ്റുചിലർ: ഞങ്ങൾ ഇതിനെപ്പറ്റി പിന്നെയും നിന്റെ പ്രസംഗം കേൾക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some of them sneered, but others said, "We want to hear you again on this subject."
chapters.nkjv: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked, while others said, "We will hear you again on this matter."
chapters.kjv: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter .

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ പൌലൊസ് അവരുടെ നടുവിൽ നിന്നു പോയി
chapters.niv: At that, Paul left the Council.
chapters.nkjv: So Paul departed from among them.
chapters.kjv: So Paul departed from among them.

chapters.ml: ചില പുരുഷന്മാർ അവനോടു ചേർന്നു വിശ്വസിച്ചു; അവരിൽ അരയോപഗസ്ഥാനിയായ ദിയൊനുസ്യോസും ദമരീസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു സ്ത്രീയും മറ്റു ചിലരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Some of the people became followers of Paul and believed. Among them was Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus, also a woman named Damaris, and a number of others.
chapters.nkjv: However, some men joined him and believed, among them Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
chapters.kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം അവൻ അഥേന വിട്ടു കൊരിന്തിൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
chapters.nkjv: After these things Paul departed from Athens and went to Corinth.
chapters.kjv: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ എല്ലാവരും റോമനഗരം വിട്ടു പോകണം എന്നു ക്ളൌദ്യൊസ് കല്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ഇത്തല്യയിൽ നിന്നു ആ ഇടെക്കു വന്നവനായി പൊന്തൊസ്കാരൻ അക്വിലാസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു യെഹൂദനെയും അവന്റെ ഭാര്യ പ്രിസ്കില്ലയെയും കണ്ടു അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: There he met a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them,
chapters.nkjv: And he found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla (because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome); and he came to them.
chapters.kjv: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

chapters.ml: തൊഴിൽ ഒന്നാകകൊണ്ടു അവൻ അവരോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു വേല ചെയ്തുപോന്നു; തൊഴിലോ കൂടാരപ്പണിയായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and because he was a tentmaker as they were, he stayed and worked with them.
chapters.nkjv: So, because he was of the same trade, he stayed with them and worked; for by occupation they were tentmakers.
chapters.kjv: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ശബ്ബത്ത്തോറും അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽ സംവാദിച്ചു യെഹൂദന്മാരെയും യവനന്മാരെയും സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.
chapters.nkjv: And he reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and persuaded both Jews and Greeks.
chapters.kjv: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

chapters.ml: ശീലാസും തിമൊഥെയൊസും മക്കെദോന്യയിൽ നിന്നു വന്നാറെ പൌലൊസ് വചനഘോഷണത്തിൽ ശുഷ്കാന്തിപൂണ്ടു യേശു തന്നേ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാർക്കു സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: When Silas and Timothy had come from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.
chapters.kjv: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

chapters.ml: അവർ എതിർ പറയുകയും ദുഷിക്കയും ചെയ്കയാൽ അവൻ വസ്ത്രം കുടഞ്ഞു: നിങ്ങളുടെ നാശത്തിന്നു നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ ഉത്തരവാദികൾ; ഞാൻ നിർമ്മലൻ: ഇനിമേൽ ഞാൻ ജാതികളുടെ അടുക്കൽ പോകും എന്നു അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But when they opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes in protest and said to them, "Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."
chapters.nkjv: But when they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook his garments and said to them, "Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."
chapters.kjv: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവിടം വിട്ടു തീത്തൊസ് യുസ്തൊസ് എന്ന ഒരു ദൈവഭക്തന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു; അവന്റെ വീടു പള്ളിയോടു തൊട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titius Justus, a worshiper of God.
chapters.nkjv: And he departed from there and entered the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
chapters.kjv: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man’s house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

chapters.ml: പള്ളി പ്രമാണിയായ ക്രിസ്പൊസ് തന്റെ സകല കുടുംബത്തോടുംകൂടെ കർത്താവിൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചു; കൊരിന്ത്യരിൽ അനേകർ വചനം കേട്ടു വിശ്വസിച്ചു സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his entire household believed in the Lord; and many of the Corinthians who heard Paul believed and were baptized.
chapters.nkjv: Then Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his household. And many of the Corinthians, hearing, believed and were baptized.
chapters.kjv: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

chapters.ml: രാത്രിയിൽ കർത്താവു ദർശനത്തിൽ പൌലൊസിനോടു: നീ ഭയപ്പെടാതെ പ്രസംഗിക്ക; മിണ്ടാതിരിക്കരുതു;
chapters.niv: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: "Do not be afraid; keep on speaking, do not be silent.
chapters.nkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Paul in the night by a vision, "Do not be afraid, but speak, and do not keep silent;
chapters.kjv: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്നോടുകൂടെ ഉണ്ടു; ആരും നിന്നെ കയ്യേറ്റം ചെയ്തു ദോഷപ്പെടുത്തുകയില്ല; ഈ പട്ടണത്തിൽ എനിക്കു വളരെ ജനം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city."
chapters.nkjv: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to hurt you; for I have many people in this city."
chapters.kjv: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ഒരാണ്ടും ആറുമാസവും അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽ ദൈവവചനം ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: So Paul stayed in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching them the word of God.
chapters.nkjv: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
chapters.kjv: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

chapters.ml: ഗല്ലിയോൻ അഖായയിൽ ദേശഅധിപതിയായി വാഴുമ്പോൾ യെഹൂദന്മാർ പൌലൊസിന്റെ നേരെ ഒരുമനപ്പെട്ടു എഴുന്നേറ്റു, അവനെ ന്യായാസനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ കൊണ്ടു ചെന്നു:
chapters.niv: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews of Corinth made a united attack on Paul and brought him to the place of judgment.
chapters.nkjv: When Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him to the judgment seat,
chapters.kjv: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്നു വിരോധമായി ദൈവത്തെ ഭജിപ്പാൻ മനുഷ്യരെ സമ്മതിപ്പിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "This man," they charged, "is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "This fellow persuades men to worship God contrary to the law."
chapters.kjv: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് വായ്തുറപ്പാൻ ഭാവിക്കുമ്പോൾ ഗല്ലിയോൻ യെഹൂദന്മാരോടു: യെഹൂദന്മാരേ, വല്ല അന്യായമോ വല്ലാത്ത പാതകമോ ആയിരുന്നെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ ക്ഷമയോടെ നിങ്ങളുടെ സങ്കടം കേൾക്കുമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to them, "If you Jews were making a complaint about some misdemeanor or serious crime, it would be reasonable for me to listen to you.
chapters.nkjv: And when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, "If it were a matter of wrongdoing or wicked crimes, O Jews, there would be reason why I should bear with you.
chapters.kjv: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

chapters.ml: വചനത്തെയും നാമങ്ങളെയും നിങ്ങളുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തെയും സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള തർക്കസംഗതികൾ എങ്കിലോ നിങ്ങൾ തന്നേ നോക്കിക്കൊൾവിൻ; ഈ വകെക്കു ന്യായാധിപതി ആകുവാൻ എനിക്കു മനസ്സില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു
chapters.niv: But since it involves questions about words and names and your own law—settle the matter yourselves. I will not be a judge of such things."
chapters.nkjv: But if it is a question of words and names and your own law, look toit yourselves; for I do not want to be a judge of such matters."
chapters.kjv: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it ; for I will be no judge of such matters .

chapters.ml: അവരെ ന്യായാസനത്തിങ്കൽനിന്നു പുറത്താക്കി.
chapters.niv: So he drove them off.
chapters.nkjv: And he drove them from the judgment seat.
chapters.kjv: And he drave them from the judgment seat.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും പള്ളിപ്രമാണിയായ സോസ്ഥനേസിനെ പിടിച്ചു ന്യായാസനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചു അടിച്ചു; ഇതു ഒന്നും ഗല്ലിയോൻ കൂട്ടാക്കിയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then the crowd there turned on Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the proconsul; and Gallio showed no concern whatever.
chapters.nkjv: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. But Gallio took no notice of these things.
chapters.kjv: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് പിന്നെയും കുറെനാൾ പാർത്തശേഷം സഹോദരന്മാരോടു യാത്ര പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു, തനിക്കു ഒരു നേർച്ച ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതിനാൽ കെംക്രയയിൽ വെച്ചു തല ക്ഷൌരം ചെയ്യിച്ചിട്ടു പ്രിസ്കില്ലയോടും അക്വിലാസിനോടും കൂടെ കപ്പൽ കയറി സുറിയയിലേക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു
chapters.niv: Paul stayed on in Corinth for some time. Then he left the brothers and sisters and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. Before he sailed, he had his hair cut off at Cenchreae because of a vow he had taken.
chapters.nkjv: So Paul still remained a good while. Then he took leave of the brethren and sailed for Syria, and Priscilla and Aquila were with him. He had his hair cut off at Cenchrea, for he had taken a vow.
chapters.kjv: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

chapters.ml: എഫെസോസിൽ എത്തി അവരെ അവിടെ വിട്ടു, അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു യെഹൂദന്മാരോടു സംഭാഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
chapters.nkjv: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there; but he himself entered the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
chapters.kjv: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

chapters.ml: കുറെ കൂടെ താമസിക്കേണം എന്നു അവർ അപേക്ഷിച്ചിട്ടു അവൻ സമ്മതിക്കാതെ:
chapters.niv: When they asked him to spend more time with them, he declined.
chapters.nkjv: When they asked him to stay a longer time with them, he did not consent,
chapters.kjv: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

chapters.ml: ദൈവഹിതമുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു വിടവാങ്ങി എഫെസൊസിൽനിന്നു കപ്പൽ നീക്കി,
chapters.niv: But as he left, he promised, "I will come back if it is God’s will." Then he set sail from Ephesus.
chapters.nkjv: but took leave of them, saying, "I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem; but I will return again to you, God willing." And he sailed from Ephesus.
chapters.kjv: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

chapters.ml: കൈസര്യയിൽ വന്നിറങ്ങി, യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു ചെന്നു, സഭയെ വന്ദനം ചെയ്തിട്ടു അന്തൊക്ക്യയിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When he landed at Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church and then went down to Antioch.
chapters.nkjv: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up and greeted the church, he went down to Antioch.
chapters.kjv: And when he had landed at Cæsarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ കുറെനാൾ താമസിച്ച ശേഷം പുറപ്പെട്ടു, ക്രമത്താലെ ഗലാത്യദേശത്തിലും ഫ്രുഗ്യയിലും സഞ്ചരിച്ചു ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ ഒക്കെയും ഉറപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul set out from there and traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
chapters.nkjv: After he had spent some time there, he departed and went over the region of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
chapters.kjv: And after he had spent some time there , he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

chapters.ml: അലക്സാന്ത്രിയക്കാരനായി വാഗ്വൈഭവവും തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളിൽ സാമർത്ഥ്യവുമുള്ള അപ്പൊല്ലോസ് എന്നു പേരുള്ളോരു യെഹൂദൻ എഫെസോസിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was a learned man, with a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures.
chapters.nkjv: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man and mighty in the Scriptures, came to Ephesus.
chapters.kjv: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

chapters.ml: അവൻ കർത്താവിന്റെ മാർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ഉപദേശം ലഭിച്ചവൻ ആയിരുന്നു; യോഹന്നാന്റെ സ്നാനത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു മാത്രം അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു എങ്കിലും ആത്മാവിൽ എരിവുള്ളവനാകയാൽ അവൻ യേശുവിന്റെ വസ്തുത സൂക്ഷമമായി പ്രസ്താവിക്കയും ഉപദേശിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord, and he spoke with great fervor and taught about Jesus accurately, though he knew only the baptism of John.
chapters.nkjv: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things of the Lord, though he knew only the baptism of John.
chapters.kjv: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽ പ്രാഗത്ഭ്യത്തോടെ പ്രസംഗിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി; അക്വിലാസും പ്രിസ്കില്ലയും അവന്റെ പ്രസംഗം കേട്ടാറെ അവനെ ചേർത്തുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മാർഗ്ഗം അധികം സ്പഷ്ടമായി അവന്നു തെളിയിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they invited him to their home and explained to him the way of God more adequately.
chapters.nkjv: So he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Aquila and Priscilla heard him, they took him aside and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
chapters.kjv: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഖായയിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചപ്പോൾ സഹോദരന്മാർ അവനെ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിക്കയും അവനെ കൈക്കൊള്ളേണ്ടിതിന്നു ശിഷ്യന്മാർക്കു എഴുതുകയും ചെയ്തു; അവിടെ എത്തിയാറെ അവൻ ദൈവകൃപയാൽ വിശ്വസിച്ചവർക്കു വളരെ പ്രയോജനമായിത്തിർന്നു.
chapters.niv: When Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, the brothers and sisters encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. When he arrived, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.
chapters.nkjv: And when he desired to cross to Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him; and when he arrived, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
chapters.kjv: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

chapters.ml: യേശു തന്നേ ക്രിസ്തു എന്നു അവൻ തിരുവെഴുത്തുകളാൽ തെളിയിച്ചു ബലത്തോടെ യെഹൂദന്മാരെ പരസ്യമായി ഖണ്ഡിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For he vigorously refuted his Jewish opponents in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus was the Messiah.
chapters.nkjv: for he vigorously refuted the Jews publicly, showing from the Scriptures that Jesus is the Christ.
chapters.kjv: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

chapters.ml: അപ്പൊല്ലോസ് കൊരിന്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ പൌലോസ് ഉൾപ്രദേശങ്ങളിൽ കൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു എഫെസോസിൽ എത്തി ചില ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ കണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at Ephesus. There he found some disciples
chapters.nkjv: And it happened, while Apollos was at Corinth, that Paul, having passed through the upper regions, came to Ephesus. And finding some disciples
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിച്ചിട്ടു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനെ പ്രാപിച്ചുവോ എന്നു അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ഉണ്ടെന്നുപോലും ഞങ്ങൾ കേട്ടിട്ടില്ല എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: and asked them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" They answered, "No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."
chapters.nkjv: he said to them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" So they said to him, "We have not so much as heard whether there is a Holy Spirit."
chapters.kjv: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഏതായിരുന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്നാനം എന്നു അവൻ അവരോടു ചോദിച്ചതിന്നു: യോഹന്നാന്റെ സ്നാനം എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So Paul asked, "Then what baptism did you receive?" "John’s baptism," they replied.
chapters.nkjv: And he said to them, "Into what then were you baptized?" So they said, "Into John’s baptism."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John’s baptism.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പൌലൊസ്: യോഹന്നാൻ മനസാന്തരസ്നാനമത്രേ കഴിപ്പിച്ചു തന്റെ പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നവനായ യേശുവിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കേണം എന്നു ജനത്തോടു പറഞ്ഞു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Paul said, "John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the one coming after him, that is, in Jesus."
chapters.nkjv: Then Paul said, "John indeed baptized with a baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe on Him who would come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus."
chapters.kjv: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടാറെ അവർ കർത്താവായ യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ സ്നാനം ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.kjv: When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് അവരുടെ മേൽ കൈവെച്ചപ്പോൾ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു അവരുടെമേൽ വന്നു അവർ അന്യഭാഷകളിൽ സംസാരിക്കയും പ്രവചിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.
chapters.nkjv: And when Paul had laid hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke with tongues and prophesied.
chapters.kjv: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

chapters.ml: ആ പുരുഷന്മാർ എല്ലാം കൂടി പന്ത്രണ്ടോളം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There were about twelve men in all.
chapters.nkjv: Now the men were about twelve in all.
chapters.kjv: And all the men were about twelve.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ പള്ളിയിൽ ചെന്നു ദൈവരാജ്യത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു സംവാദിച്ചും സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു മൂന്നു മാസത്തോളം പ്രാഗത്ഭ്യത്തോടെ പ്രസംഗിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.
chapters.nkjv: And he went into the synagogue and spoke boldly for three months, reasoning and persuading concerning the things of the kingdom of God.
chapters.kjv: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ചിലർ കഠിനപ്പെട്ടു അനുസരിക്കാതെ പുരുഷാരത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ ഈ മാർഗ്ഗത്തെ ദുഷിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരെ വിട്ടു ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ വേർതിരിച്ചു, തുറന്നൊസിന്റെ പാഠശാലയിൽ ദിനംപ്രതി സംവാദിച്ചുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: But some of them became obstinate; they refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way. So Paul left them. He took the disciples with him and had discussions daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
chapters.nkjv: But when some were hardened and did not believe, but spoke evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and withdrew the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
chapters.kjv: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

chapters.ml: അതു രണ്ടു സംവത്സരത്തോളം നടക്കയാൽ ആസ്യയിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന യെഹൂദന്മാരും യവനന്മാരും എല്ലാം കർത്താവിന്റെ വചനം കേൾപ്പാൻ ഇടയായി.
chapters.niv: This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: And this continued for two years, so that all who dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
chapters.kjv: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം പൌലൊസ് മുഖാന്തരം അസാധാരണയായ വീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികളെ ചെയ്യിക്കയാൽ
chapters.niv: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,
chapters.nkjv: Now God worked unusual miracles by the hands of Paul,
chapters.kjv: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ മെയ്മേൽനിന്നു റൂമാലും ഉത്തരീയവും രോഗികളുടെമേൽ കൊണ്ടുവന്നിടുകയും വ്യാധികൾ അവരെ വിട്ടുമാറുകയും ദുരാത്മാക്കൾ പുപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.
chapters.nkjv: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were brought from his body to the sick, and the diseases left them and the evil spirits went out of them.
chapters.kjv: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദേശാന്തരികളായി നടക്കുന്ന മന്ത്രവാദികളായ ചില യെഹൂദന്മാർ: പൌലൊസ് പ്രസംഗിക്കുന്ന യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളോടു ആണയിടുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു യേശുവിന്റെ നാമം ചൊല്ലുവാൻ തുനിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, "In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out."
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the itinerant Jewish exorcists took it upon themselves to call the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, "We exorcise you by the Jesus whom Paul preaches."
chapters.kjv: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തവർ മഹാപുരോഹിതനായ സ്കേവാ എന്ന ഒരു യെഹൂദന്റെ ഏഴു പുത്രന്മാർ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
chapters.nkjv: Also there were seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did so.
chapters.kjv: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.

chapters.ml: ദുരാത്മാവു അവരോടു: യേശുവിനെ ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; പൌലൊസിനെയും പരിചയമുണ്ടു; എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ആർ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One day the evil spirit answered them, "Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?"
chapters.nkjv: And the evil spirit answered and said, "Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are you?"
chapters.kjv: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദുരാത്മാവുള്ള മനുഷ്യൻ അവരുടെമേൽ ചാടി അവരെ ഇരുവരെയും കീഴടക്കി ജയിക്കയാൽ അവർ നഗ്നരും മുറിവേറ്റവരുമായി ആ വീട്ടിൽനിന്നു ഓടിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.
chapters.nkjv: Then the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
chapters.kjv: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

chapters.ml: ഇതു എഫേസൊസിൽ പാർക്കുന്ന സകല യെഹൂദന്മാരും യവനന്മാരും അറിഞ്ഞു; അവർക്കു ഒക്കെയും ഭയം തട്ടി, കർത്താവായ യേശുവിന്റെ നാമം മഹിമപ്പെട്ടു
chapters.niv: When this became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, they were all seized with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
chapters.nkjv: This became known both to all Jews and Greeks dwelling in Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
chapters.kjv: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസിച്ചവരിൽ അനേകരും വന്നു തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രവർത്തികളെ ഏറ്റുപറഞ്ഞു അറിയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Many of those who believed now came and openly confessed what they had done.
chapters.nkjv: And many who had believed came confessing and telling their deeds.
chapters.kjv: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

chapters.ml: ക്ഷുദ്രപ്രയോഗം ചെയ്തിരുന്ന പലരും തങ്ങളുടെ പുസ്തകങ്ങളെ കൊണ്ടുവന്നു എല്ലാവരും കാൺകെ ചുട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു; അവയുടെ വില കണക്കുകൂട്ടിയാറെ അമ്പതിനായിരം വെള്ളിക്കാശു എന്നു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: A number who had practiced sorcery brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly. When they calculated the value of the scrolls, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.
chapters.nkjv: Also, many of those who had practiced magic brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. And they counted up the value of them, and it totaled fifty thousand pieces of silver.
chapters.kjv: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ കർത്താവിന്റെ വചനം ശക്തിയോടെ പരന്നു പ്രബലപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.
chapters.nkjv: So the word of the Lord grew mightily and prevailed.
chapters.kjv: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു പൌലൊസ് മക്കെദോന്യയിലും അഖായയിലും കൂടി കടന്നു യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കും പോകേണം എന്നു മനസ്സിൽ നിശ്ചയിച്ചു: ഞാൻ അവിടെ ചെന്നശേഷം റോമയും കാണേണം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: After all this had happened, Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. "After I have been there," he said, "I must visit Rome also."
chapters.nkjv: When these things were accomplished, Paul purposed in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, "After I have been there, I must also see Rome."
chapters.kjv: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

chapters.ml: തനിക്കു ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യുന്നവരിൽ തിമൊഥെയൊസ്, എരസ്തൊസ് എന്ന രണ്ടുപേരെ മക്കെദോന്യയിലേക്കു അയച്ചിട്ടു താൻ കുറെക്കാലം ആസ്യയിൽ താമസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed in the province of Asia a little longer.
chapters.nkjv: So he sent into Macedonia two of those who ministered to him, Timothy and Erastus, but he himself stayed in Asia for a time.
chapters.kjv: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു ഈ മാർഗ്ഗത്തെച്ചൊല്ലി വലിയ കലഹം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.
chapters.nkjv: And about that time there arose a great commotion about the Way.
chapters.kjv: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

chapters.ml: വെള്ളികൊണ്ടു അർത്തെമിസ് ദേവിയുടെ ക്ഷേത്രരൂപങ്ങളെ തീർക്കുന്ന ദെമേത്രിയൊസ് എന്ന തട്ടാൻ തൊഴിൽക്കാർക്കു വളരെ ലാഭം വരുത്തി വന്നു.
chapters.niv: A silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought in a lot of business for the craftsmen there.
chapters.nkjv: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Diana, brought no small profit to the craftsmen.
chapters.kjv: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരെയും ആ വകയിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ട വേലക്കാരെയും കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി: പുരുഷന്മാരേ, നമ്മുടെ സമ്പാദ്യം ഈ തൊഴിൽകൊണ്ടു ആകുന്നു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ബോദ്ധ്യമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: He called them together, along with the workers in related trades, and said: "You know, my friends, that we receive a good income from this business.
chapters.nkjv: He called them together with the workers of similar occupation, and said: "Men, you know that we have our prosperity by this trade.
chapters.kjv: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഈ പൌലൊസ് എന്നവൻ കയ്യാൽ തീർത്തതു ദേവന്മാർ അല്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു എഫെസൊസിൽ മാത്രമല്ല, മിക്കവാറും ആസ്യയിൽ ഒക്കെയും വളരെ ജനങ്ങളെ സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചു മറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ കണ്ടും കേട്ടും ഇരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And you see and hear how this fellow Paul has convinced and led astray large numbers of people here in Ephesus and in practically the whole province of Asia. He says that gods made by human hands are no gods at all.
chapters.nkjv: Moreover you see and hear that not only at Ephesus, but throughout almost all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are not gods which are made with hands.
chapters.kjv: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

chapters.ml: അതിനാൽ നമ്മുടെ ഈ കാര്യം ആക്ഷേപത്തിൽ ആകുവാൻ അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നതുമല്ലാതെ അർത്തെമിസ് മഹാദേവിയുടെ ക്ഷേത്രം ഏതുമില്ല എന്നു വരികയും ആസ്യമുഴുവനും ഭൂതലവും ഭജിച്ചുപോരുന്നവളുടെ മാഹാത്മ്യം ഒടുങ്ങിപ്പോകയും ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: There is danger not only that our trade will lose its good name, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited; and the goddess herself, who is worshiped throughout the province of Asia and the world, will be robbed of her divine majesty."
chapters.nkjv: So not only is this trade of ours in danger of falling into disrepute, but also the temple of the great goddess Diana may be despised and her magnificence destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worship."
chapters.kjv: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഇതു കേട്ടു ക്രോധം നിറഞ്ഞവരായി: എഫെസ്യരുടെ അർത്തെമിസ് മഹാദേവി എന്നു ആർത്തു.
chapters.niv: When they heard this, they were furious and began shouting: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
chapters.nkjv: Now when they heard this, they were full of wrath and cried out, saying, "Great is Diana of the Ephesians!"
chapters.kjv: And when they heard these sayings , they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണം മുഴുവനും കലഹം കൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞു, അവർ പൌലൊസിന്റെ കൂട്ടുയാത്രക്കാരായ ഗായൊസ് അരിസ്തർഹോസ് എന്ന മക്കെദോന്യരെ പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു രംഗസ്ഥലത്തേക്കു ഒരുമനപ്പെട്ടു പാഞ്ഞു ചെന്നു.
chapters.niv: Soon the whole city was in an uproar. The people seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia, and all of them rushed into the theater together.
chapters.nkjv: So the whole city was filled with confusion, and rushed into the theater with one accord, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians, Paul’s travel companions.
chapters.kjv: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് ജനസമൂഹത്തിൽ ചെല്ലുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചാറെ ശിഷ്യന്മാർ അവനെ വിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but the disciples would not let him.
chapters.nkjv: And when Paul wanted to go in to the people, the disciples would not allow him.
chapters.kjv: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

chapters.ml: ആസ്യധിപന്മാരിൽ ചിലർ അവന്റെ സ്നേഹിതന്മാർ ആകയാൽ: രംഗസ്ഥലത്തു ചെന്നു പോകരുതു എന്നു അവരും അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ആളയച്ചു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Even some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, sent him a message begging him not to venture into the theater.
chapters.nkjv: Then some of the officials of Asia, who were his friends, sent to him pleading that he would not venture into the theater.
chapters.kjv: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

chapters.ml: ജനസംഘം കലക്കത്തിലായി മിക്കപേരും തങ്ങൾ വന്നുകൂടിയ സംഗതി എന്തെന്നു അറിയായ്കയാൽ ചിലർ ഇങ്ങനെയും ചിലർ അങ്ങനെയും ആർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The assembly was in confusion: Some were shouting one thing, some another. Most of the people did not even know why they were there.
chapters.nkjv: Some therefore cried one thing and some another, for the assembly was confused, and most of them did not know why they had come together.
chapters.kjv: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദന്മാർ മുമ്പോട്ടു ഉന്തിക്കൊണ്ടുവന്ന അലക്സന്തരിനെ പുരുഷാരത്തിൽ ചിലർ സംസാരിപ്പാൻ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിച്ചു; അലക്സാന്തർ ആംഗ്യം കാട്ടി ജനസമൂഹത്തോടു പ്രതിവാദിപ്പാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander to the front, and they shouted instructions to him. He motioned for silence in order to make a defense before the people.
chapters.nkjv: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander motioned with his hand, and wanted to make his defense to the people.
chapters.kjv: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ യെഹൂദൻ എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ: എഫെസ്യരുടെ അർത്തെമിസ് മഹാദേവി എന്നു എല്ലാവരും കൂടി രണ്ടു മണിനേരത്തോളം ഏകശബ്ദത്തോടെ ആർത്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
chapters.nkjv: But when they found out that he was a Jew, all with one voice cried out for about two hours, "Great is Diana of the Ephesians!"
chapters.kjv: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ പട്ടണമേനവൻ പുരുഷാരത്തെ അമർത്തി പറഞ്ഞതു: എഫെസ്യപുരുഷന്മാരേ, എഫെസോസ് പട്ടണം അർത്തെമിസ് മഹാദേവിക്കും ദ്യോവിൽനിന്നു വീണ ബിംബത്തിന്നും ക്ഷേത്രപലക എന്നു അറിയാത്ത മനുഷ്യൻ ആർ?
chapters.niv: The city clerk quieted the crowd and said: "Fellow Ephesians, doesn’t all the world know that the city of Ephesus is the guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?
chapters.nkjv: And when the city clerk had quieted the crowd, he said: "Men of Ephesus, what man is there who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is temple guardian of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
chapters.kjv: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

chapters.ml: ഇതു എതിർമൊഴിയില്ലാത്തതാകയാൽ നിങ്ങൾ തിടുക്കമായി ഒന്നും ചെയ്യാതെ അടങ്ങിപ്പാർക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you ought to calm down and not do anything rash.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, since these things cannot be denied, you ought to be quiet and do nothing rashly.
chapters.kjv: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

chapters.ml: ഈ പുരുഷന്മാരെ നിങ്ങൾ കൂട്ടികൊണ്ടുവന്നുവല്ലോ; അവർ ക്ഷേത്രം കവർച്ച ചെയ്യുന്നവരല്ല, നമ്മുടെ ദേവിയെ ദുഷിക്കുന്നവരുമല്ല.
chapters.niv: You have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed temples nor blasphemed our goddess.
chapters.nkjv: For you have brought these men here who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
chapters.kjv: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ദെമേത്രിയൊസിന്നും കൂടെയുള്ള തൊഴിൽക്കാർക്കും വല്ലവന്റെയും നേരെ ഒരു സംഗതി ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ വിസ്താരദിവസങ്ങൾ വെച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടു, ദേശാധിപതികളും ഉണ്ടു; തമ്മിൽ വ്യവഹരിക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: If, then, Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a grievance against anybody, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. They can press charges.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a case against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them bring charges against one another.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

chapters.ml: വേറെ കാര്യം ചൊല്ലി ആകുന്നു വാദം എങ്കിൽ ധർമ്മസഭയില്‍ തീർക്കാമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: If there is anything further you want to bring up, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
chapters.nkjv: But if you have any other inquiry to make, it shall be determined in the lawful assembly.
chapters.kjv: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

chapters.ml: ഇന്നത്തെ കലഹത്തിന്നു കാരണമില്ലായ്കയാൽ അതു നിമിത്തം നമ്മുടെ പേരിൽ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുവാൻ ഇടയുണ്ടു സ്പഷ്ടം; ഈ ആൾക്കൂട്ടത്തിന്നു ഉത്തരം പറവാൻ നമുക്കു വക ഒന്നുമില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: As it is, we are in danger of being charged with rioting because of what happened today. In that case we would not be able to account for this commotion, since there is no reason for it."
chapters.nkjv: For we are in danger of being called in question for today’s uproar, there being no reason which we may give to account for this disorderly gathering."
chapters.kjv: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day’s uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞു അവൻ സഭയയെ പിരിച്ചുവിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.
chapters.nkjv: And when he had said these things, he dismissed the assembly.
chapters.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

chapters.ml: കലഹം ശമിച്ചശേഷം പൌലൊസ് ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ കൂട്ടിവരുത്തി പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചിട്ടു യാത്രപറഞ്ഞു മക്കെദോന്യെക്കു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples and, after encouraging them, said goodbye and set out for Macedonia.
chapters.nkjv: After the uproar had ceased, Paul called the disciples to himself, embraced them, and departed to go to Macedonia.
chapters.kjv: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia.

chapters.ml: ആ പ്രദേശങ്ങളിൽ കൂടി സഞ്ചരിച്ചു അവരെ ഏറിയോന്നു പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചിട്ടു യവനദേശത്തു എത്തി.
chapters.niv: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,
chapters.nkjv: Now when he had gone over that region and encouraged them with many words, he came to Greece
chapters.kjv: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

chapters.ml: അവിടെ മൂന്നു മാസം കഴിച്ചിട്ടു സുറിയെക്കു കപ്പൽ കയറിപ്പോകുവാൻ ഭാവിക്കുമ്പോൾ യെഹൂദന്മാർ അവന്റെ നേരെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടു ഉണ്ടാക്കുകയാൽ മക്കെദോന്യവഴിയായി മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവാൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: where he stayed three months. Because some Jews had plotted against him just as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.
chapters.nkjv: and stayed three months. And when the Jews plotted against him as he was about to sail to Syria, he decided to return through Macedonia.
chapters.kjv: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.

chapters.ml: ബെരോവയിലെ പുറൊസിന്റെ മകൻ സോപത്രൊസും തെസ്സലോനിക്ക്യരായ അരിസ്തർഹൊസും സെക്കുന്തൊസും ദെർബ്ബെക്കാരനായ ഗായൊസും തിമൊഥെയൊസും ആസ്യക്കാരായ തുഹിക്കൊസും ത്രൊഫിമൊസും ആസ്യവരെ അവനോടു കൂടെ പോയി.
chapters.niv: He was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy also, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.
chapters.nkjv: And Sopater of Berea accompanied him to Asia—also Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
chapters.kjv: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

chapters.ml: അവർ മുമ്പെ പോയി ത്രോവാസിൽ ഞങ്ങൾക്കായി കാത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These men went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.
chapters.nkjv: These men, going ahead, waited for us at Troas.
chapters.kjv: These going before tarried for us at Troas.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളോ പുളിപ്പില്ലാത്ത അപ്പത്തിന്റെ പെരുനാൾ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഫിലിപ്പിയിൽ നിന്നു കപ്പൽ കയറി അഞ്ചു ദിവസംകൊണ്ടു ത്രോവാസിൽ അവരുടെ അടുക്കൽ എത്തി, ഏഴു ദിവസം അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: But we sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and five days later joined the others at Troas, where we stayed seven days.
chapters.nkjv: But we sailed away from Philippi after the Days of Unleavened Bread, and in five days joined them at Troas, where we stayed seven days.
chapters.kjv: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.

chapters.ml: ആഴ്ചവട്ടത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം ദിവസത്തിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ അപ്പം നുറുക്കുവാൻ കൂടിവന്നപ്പോൾ പൌലൊസ് പിറ്റെന്നാൾ പുറപ്പെടുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവരോടു സംഭാഷിച്ചു പാതിരവരെയും പ്രസംഗം നീട്ടി.
chapters.niv: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke to the people and, because he intended to leave the next day, kept on talking until midnight.
chapters.nkjv: Now on the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul, ready to depart the next day, spoke to them and continued his message until midnight.
chapters.kjv: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ കൂടിയിരുന്ന മാളികയിൽ വളരെ വിളക്കു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവിടെ യൂത്തിക്കൊസ് എന്ന യൌവനക്കാരൻ കിളിവാതിൽക്കൽ ഇരുന്നു ഗാഢനിദ്ര പിടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.
chapters.nkjv: There were many lamps in the upper room where they were gathered together.
chapters.kjv: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് വളരെ നേരം സംഭാഷിക്കയാൽ നിദ്രാവശനായി മൂന്നാം തട്ടിൽ നിന്നു താഴെ വീണു; അവനെ മരിച്ചവനായി എടുത്തു കൊണ്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Seated in a window was a young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell to the ground from the third story and was picked up dead.
chapters.nkjv: And in a window sat a certain young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep. He was overcome by sleep; and as Paul continued speaking, he fell down from the third story and was taken up dead.
chapters.kjv: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

chapters.ml: പൌലൊസ് ഇറങ്ങിച്ചെന്നു അവന്റെമേൽ വീണു തഴുകി ഭ്രമിക്കേണ്ടാ; അവന്റെ പ്രാണൻ അവനിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. "Don’t be alarmed," he said. "He’s alive!"
chapters.nkjv: But Paul went down, fell on him, and embracing him said, "Do not trouble yourselves, for his life is in him."
chapters.kjv: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ കയറിച്ചെന്നു അപ്പം നുറുക്കി തിന്നു പുലരുവോളം സംഭാഷിച്ചു പുറപ്പെട്ടു പോയി.
chapters.niv: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.
chapters.nkjv: Now when he had come up, had broken bread and eaten, and talked a long while, even till daybreak, he departed.
chapters.kjv: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആ ബാലനെ ജീവനുള്ളവനായി കൊണ്ടുവന്നു അത്യന്തം ആശ്വസിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.
chapters.nkjv: And they brought the young man in alive, and they were not a little comforted.
chapters.kjv: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ മുമ്പായി കപ്പല്‍ കയറി പൌലൊസിനെ അസ്സൊസിൽ വെച്ചു കയറ്റിക്കൊൾവാൻ വിചാരിച്ചു അവിടേക്കു ഓടി; അവൻ കാൽനടയായി വരുവാൻ വിചാരിച്ചു ഇങ്ങനെ ചട്ടംകെട്ടിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He had made this arrangement because he was going there on foot.
chapters.nkjv: Then we went ahead to the ship and sailed to Assos, there intending to take Paul on board; for so he had given orders, intending himself to go on foot.
chapters.kjv: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അസ്സൊസിൽ ഞങ്ങളോടു ചേർന്നപ്പോൾ അവനെ കയറ്റി മിതുലേനയിൽ എത്തി;
chapters.niv: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.
chapters.nkjv: And when he met us at Assos, we took him on board and came to Mitylene.
chapters.kjv: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

chapters.ml: അവിടെ നിന്നു നീക്കി, പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ഖിയൊസ് ദ്വീപിന്റെ തൂക്കിൽ എത്തി, മറുനാൾ സാമൊസ് ദ്വീപിൽ അണഞ്ഞു. പിറ്റേന്നു മിലേത്തൊസിൽ എത്തി.
chapters.niv: The next day we set sail from there and arrived off Chios. The day after that we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day arrived at Miletus.
chapters.nkjv: We sailed from there, and the next day came opposite Chios. The following day we arrived at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium. The next day we came to Miletus.
chapters.kjv: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

chapters.ml: കഴിയും എങ്കിൽ പെന്തകൊസ്തു നാളേക്കു യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തേണ്ടതിന്നു പൌലൊസ് ബദ്ധപ്പെടുകയാൽ ആസ്യയിൽ കാലതാമസം വരരുതു എന്നുവെച്ചു എഫെസൊസിൽ അടുക്കാതെ ഓടേണം എന്നു നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, for he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
chapters.nkjv: For Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus, so that he would not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hurrying to be at Jerusalem, if possible, on the Day of Pentecost.
chapters.kjv: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

chapters.ml: മിലേത്തൊസിൽ നിന്നു അവൻ എഫെസൊസിലേക്കു ആളയച്ചു സഭയിലെ മൂപ്പന്മാരെ വരുത്തി.
chapters.niv: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.
chapters.nkjv: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called for the elders of the church.
chapters.kjv: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നപ്പോൾ അവൻ അവരോടു പറഞ്ഞതു:
chapters.niv: When they arrived, he said to them: "You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I came into the province of Asia.
chapters.nkjv: And when they had come to him, he said to them: "You know, from the first day that I came to Asia, in what manner I always lived among you,
chapters.kjv: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ആസ്യയിൽ വന്ന ഒന്നാം നാൾ മുതൽ എല്ലായ്പോഴും നിങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ എങ്ങനെയിരുന്നു എന്നും വളരെ താഴ്മയോടും കണ്ണുനീരോടും യെഹൂദന്മാരുടെ കൂട്ടുകെട്ടുകളാൽ എനിക്കു ഉണ്ടായ കഷ്ടങ്ങളോടും കൂടെ
chapters.niv: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears and in the midst of severe testing by the plots of my Jewish opponents.
chapters.nkjv: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears and trials which happened to me by the plotting of the Jews;
chapters.kjv: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

chapters.ml: കർത്താവിനെ സേവിച്ചു വന്നു എന്നും പ്രായോജനമുള്ളതു ഒന്നും മറെച്ചുവെക്കാതെ പരസ്യമായും വീടുതോറും നിങ്ങളോടു അറിയക്കയും ഉപദേശിക്കയും ചെയ്തു എന്നും
chapters.niv: You know that I have not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful to you but have taught you publicly and from house to house.
chapters.nkjv: how I kept back nothing that was helpful, but proclaimed it to you, and taught you publicly and from house to house,
chapters.kjv: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിങ്കലേക്കുള്ള മാനസാന്തരവും നമ്മുടെ കർത്താവായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിലുള്ള വിശ്വാസവും യെഹൂദന്മാർക്കും യവനന്മാർക്കും സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചു എന്നും നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: I have declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in our Lord Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: testifying to Jews, and also to Greeks, repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.kjv: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ ഇതാ ഞാൻ ആത്മാവിനാൽ ബന്ധിക്കപ്പെട്ടവാനയി യേരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.
chapters.nkjv: And see, now I go bound in the spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing the things that will happen to me there,
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

chapters.ml: ബന്ധനങ്ങളും കഷ്ടങ്ങളും എനിക്കായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു പട്ടണം തോറും സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നതല്ലാതെ അവിടെ എനിക്കു നേരിടുവാനുള്ള ഒന്നും ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: I only know that in every city the Holy Spirit warns me that prison and hardships are facing me.
chapters.nkjv: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that chains and tribulations await me.
chapters.kjv: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ഞാൻ എന്റെ പ്രാണനെ വിലയേറിയതായി എണ്ണുന്നില്ല; എന്റെ ഓട്ടവും ദൈവകൃപയുടെ സുവിശേഷത്തിന്നു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയേണ്ടതിന്നു കർത്താവായ യേശുതന്ന ശുശ്രൂഷയും തികെക്കേണം എന്നേ എനിക്കുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me—the task of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
chapters.nkjv: But none of these things move me; nor do I count my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.
chapters.kjv: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ ദൈവരാജ്യം പ്രസംഗിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു നടന്നവനായ എന്റെ മുഖം നിങ്ങൾ ആരും ഇനി കാൺകയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Now I know that none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see me again.
chapters.nkjv: "And indeed, now I know that you all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, will see my face no more.
chapters.kjv: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു നിങ്ങളിൽ ആരെങ്കിലും നശിച്ചുപോയാൽ ഞാൻ കുറ്റക്കാരനല്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ ഇന്നേ ദിവസം നിങ്ങളോടു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore, I declare to you today that I am innocent of the blood of any of you.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all men.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men .

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലോചന ഒട്ടും മറെച്ചുവെക്കാതെ ഞാൻ മുഴുവനും അറിയിച്ചുതന്നിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole will of God.
chapters.nkjv: For I have not shunned to declare to you the whole counsel of God.
chapters.kjv: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേയും താൻ സ്വന്തരക്തത്താൽ സമ്പാദിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സഭയെ മേയ്പാൻ പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു നിങ്ങളെ അദ്ധ്യക്ഷരാക്കിവെച്ച ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടം മുഴുവനെയും സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Keep watch over yourselves and all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he bought with his own blood.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore take heed to yourselves and to all the flock, among which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God which He purchased with His own blood.
chapters.kjv: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പോയ ശേഷം ആട്ടിൻ കൂട്ടത്തെ ആദരിക്കാത്ത കൊടിയ ചെന്നായ്ക്കൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ കടക്കും എന്നു ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I know that after I leave, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.
chapters.nkjv: For I know this, that after my departure savage wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock.
chapters.kjv: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

chapters.ml: ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ തങ്ങളുടെ പിന്നാലെ വലിച്ചുകളവാനായി വിപരീതോപദേശം പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്ന പുരുഷന്മാർ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ നിന്നും എഴുന്നേല്ക്കും.
chapters.niv: Even from your own number men will arise and distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them.
chapters.nkjv: Also from among yourselves men will rise up, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after themselves.
chapters.kjv: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

chapters.ml: അതു കൊണ്ടു ഉണർന്നിരിപ്പിൻ; ഞാൻ മൂന്നു സംവത്സരം രാപ്പകൽ ഇടവിടാതെ കണ്ണുനീർ വാർത്തുംകൊണ്ടു ഓരോരുത്തന്നു ബുദ്ധിപറഞ്ഞുതന്നതു ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore watch, and remember that for three years I did not cease to warn everyone night and day with tears.
chapters.kjv: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആത്മികവർദ്ധന വരുത്തുവാനും സകല വിശുദ്ധന്മാരോടുംകൂടെ അവകാശം തരുവാനും കഴിയുന്ന ദൈവത്തിലും അവന്റെ കൃപയുടെ വചനത്തിലും ഞാൻ ഇപ്പോൾ നിങ്ങളെ ഭരമേല്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "Now I commit you to God and to the word of his grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
chapters.nkjv: "So now, brethren, I commend you to God and to the word of His grace, which is able to build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
chapters.kjv: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

chapters.ml: ആരുടെയും വെള്ളിയോ പൊന്നോ വസ്ത്രമോ ഞാൻ മോഹിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.
chapters.nkjv: I have coveted no one’s silver or gold or apparel.
chapters.kjv: I have coveted no man’s silver, or gold, or apparel.

chapters.ml: എന്റെ മുട്ടിനും എന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ളവർക്കും വേണ്ടി ഞാൻ ഈ കൈകളാൽ അദ്ധ്വാനിച്ചു എന്നു നങ്ങൾ തന്നേ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions.
chapters.nkjv: Yes, you yourselves know that these hands have provided for my necessities, and for those who were with me.
chapters.kjv: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പ്രയത്നം ചെയ്തു പ്രാപ്തിയില്ലാത്തവരെ സാഹായിക്കയും, വാങ്ങുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ കൊടുക്കുന്നതു ഭാഗ്യം എന്നു കർത്താവായ യേശുതാൻ പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കു ഓർത്തുകൊൾകയും വേണ്ടതു എന്നു ഞാൻ എല്ലാം കൊണ്ടും നിങ്ങൾക്കു ദൃഷ്ടാന്തം കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In everything I did, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words the Lord Jesus himself said: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ "
chapters.nkjv: I have shown you in every way, by laboring like this, that you must support the weak. And remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that He said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ "
chapters.kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു അവൻ മുട്ടുകുത്തി അവരെല്ലാവരോടും കൂടെ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
chapters.nkjv: And when he had said these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
chapters.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും വളരെ കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: They all wept as they embraced him and kissed him.
chapters.nkjv: Then they all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
chapters.kjv: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul’s neck, and kissed him,

chapters.ml: ഇനിമേൽ അവന്റെ മുഖം കാണുകയില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞ വാക്കിനാൽ അവർ ഏറ്റവും ദുഃഖിച്ചു പൌലൊസിന്റെ കഴുത്തിൽ കെട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചു അവനെ ചുംബിച്ചു കപ്പലോളം അവനോടുകൂടെ വന്നു അവനെ യാത്രയയച്ചു.
chapters.niv: What grieved them most was his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
chapters.nkjv: sorrowing most of all for the words which he spoke, that they would see his face no more. And they accompanied him to the ship.
chapters.kjv: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.

chapters.ml: അവരെ വിട്ടുപിരിഞ്ഞു നീക്കിയശേഷം ഞങ്ങൾ നേരെ ഓടി കോസിലും പിറ്റെന്നാൾ രൊദൊസിലും അവിടം വിട്ടു പത്തരയിലും എത്തി.
chapters.niv: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to Kos. The next day we went to Rhodes and from there to Patara.
chapters.nkjv: Now it came to pass, that when we had departed from them and set sail, running a straight course we came to Cos, the following day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
chapters.kjv: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

chapters.ml: ഫൊയ്നീക്ക്യയിലേക്കു പോകുന്ന ഒരു കപ്പൽ കണ്ടിട്ടു ഞങ്ങൾ അതിൽ കയറി ഓടി.
chapters.niv: We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, went on board and set sail.
chapters.nkjv: And finding a ship sailing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
chapters.kjv: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

chapters.ml: കുപ്രോസ് ദ്വീപു കണ്ടു അതിനെ ഇടത്തുപുറം വിട്ടു സുറിയയിലേക്കു ഓടി സോരിൽ വന്നിറങ്ങി; കപ്പൽ അവിടെ ചരക്കു ഇറക്കുവാനുള്ളതായിരുന്നു; ഞങ്ങൾ ശിഷ്യന്മാരെ കണ്ടെത്തി, ഏഴുനാൾ അവിടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.
chapters.nkjv: When we had sighted Cyprus, we passed it on the left, sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre; for there the ship was to unload her cargo.
chapters.kjv: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

chapters.ml: അവർ പൌലൊസിനോടു യെരൂശലേമിൽ പോകുരുതു എന്നു ആത്മാവിനാൽ പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: We sought out the disciples there and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they urged Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And finding disciples, we stayed there seven days. They told Paul through the Spirit not to go up to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അവിടത്തെ താമസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഞങ്ങൾ വിട്ടുപോകുമ്പോൾ അവർ എല്ലാവരും സ്ത്രീകളും കുട്ടികളുമായി
chapters.niv: When it was time to leave, we left and continued on our way. All of them, including wives and children, accompanied us out of the city, and there on the beach we knelt to pray.
chapters.nkjv: When we had come to the end of those days, we departed and went on our way; and they all accompanied us, with wives and children, till wewere out of the city. And we knelt down on the shore and prayed.
chapters.kjv: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

chapters.ml: പട്ടണത്തിന്നു പുറത്തോളം ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ വന്നു കടൽക്കരയിൽ മുട്ടുകുത്തി പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചു തമ്മിൽ യാത്ര പറഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഞങ്ങൾ കപ്പൽ കയറി; അവർ വീട്ടിലേക്കു മടങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: After saying goodbye to each other, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.
chapters.nkjv: When we had taken our leave of one another, we boarded the ship, and they returned home.
chapters.kjv: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ സോർ വിട്ടു കപ്പലോട്ടം തികെച്ചു പ്തൊലെമായിസിൽ എത്തി സഹോദരന്മാരെ വന്ദനം ചെയ്തു ഒരു ദിവസം അവരോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and sisters and stayed with them for a day.
chapters.nkjv: And when we had finished our voyage from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, greeted the brethren, and stayed with them one day.
chapters.kjv: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നാൾ ഞങ്ങൾ പുറപ്പെട്ടു കൈസര്യയിൽ എത്തി, ഏഴുവരിൽ ഒരുവനായ ഫിലപ്പൊസ് എന്ന സുവിശേഷകന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടുകൂടെ പാർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Leaving the next day, we reached Caesarea and stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven.
chapters.nkjv: On the next day we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea, and entered the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
chapters.kjv: And the next day we that were of Paul’s company departed, and came unto Cæsarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു കന്യകമാരും പ്രവചിക്കുന്നവരുമായ നാലു പുത്രിമാർ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
chapters.nkjv: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
chapters.kjv: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങൾ അവിടെ വളരെ ദിവസം പാർത്തിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അഗബൊസ് എന്ന ഒരു പ്രവാചകൻ യെഹൂദ്യയിൽ നിന്നു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: After we had been there a number of days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
chapters.nkjv: And as we stayed many days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
chapters.kjv: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judæa a certain prophet, named Agabus.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഞങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വന്നു പൌലൊസിന്റെ അരക്കച്ച എടുത്തു തന്റെ കൈകാലുകളെ കെട്ടി: ഈ അരക്കച്ചയുടെ ഉടമസ്ഥനെ യെഹൂദന്മാർ യെരൂശലേമിൽ ഇങ്ങനെ കെട്ടി ജാതികളുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിക്കും എന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു പറയുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, tied his own hands and feet with it and said, "The Holy Spirit says, ‘In this way the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and will hand him over to the Gentiles.’ "
chapters.nkjv: When he had come to us, he took Paul’s belt, bound his own hands and feet, and said, "Thus says the Holy Spirit, ‘So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt, and deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’ "
chapters.kjv: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul’s girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

chapters.ml: ഇതു കേട്ടാറെ യെരൂശലേമിൽ പോകരുതു എന്നു ഞങ്ങളും അവിടത്തുകാരും അവനോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: Now when we heard these things, both we and those from that place pleaded with him not to go up to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു പൌലൊസ്: നിങ്ങൾ കരഞ്ഞു എന്റെ ഹൃദയം ഇങ്ങനെ തകർക്കുന്നതു എന്തു? കർത്താവായ യേശുവിന്റെ നാമത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി ബന്ധിക്കപ്പെടുവാൻ മാത്രമല്ല യെരൂശലേമിൽ മരിപ്പാനും ഞാൻ ഒരുങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉത്തരം പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then Paul answered, "Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."
chapters.nkjv: Then Paul answered, "What do you mean by weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."
chapters.kjv: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

chapters.ml: അവനെ സമ്മതിപ്പിച്ചുകൂടായ്കയാൽ: കർത്താവിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം നടക്കട്ടെ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ഞങ്ങൾ മിണ്ടാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said, "The Lord’s will be done."
chapters.nkjv: So when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, "The will of the Lord be done."
chapters.kjv: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

chapters.ml: അവിടത്തെ താമസം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഞങ്ങൾ യാത്രെക്കു കോപ്പുകൂട്ടി യെരൂശലേമിലേക്കു പോയി.
chapters.niv: After this, we started on our way up to Jerusalem.
chapters.nkjv: And after those days we packed and went up to Jerusalem.
chapters.kjv: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.

chapters.ml: കൈസര്യയിലെ ശിഷ്യന്മാരിൽ ചിലരും ഞങ്ങളോടുകൂടെ പോന്നു, കുപ്രൊസ്കാരനായ മ്നാസോൻ എന്ന ഒരു പഴയശിഷ്യനോടുകൂടെ അതിഥികളായ്പാർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഞങ്ങളെ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.
chapters.nkjv: Also some of the disciples from Caesarea went with us and brought with them a certain Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we were to lodge.
chapters.kjv: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Cæsarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

chapters.ml: യെരൂശലേമിൽ എത്തിപ്പോൾ സഹോദരന്മാർ ഞങ്ങളെ സന്തോഷത്തോട കൈക്കൊണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: When we arrived at Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us warmly.
chapters.nkjv: And when we had come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
chapters.kjv: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

chapters.ml: പിറ്റെന്നു പൌലെസും ഞങ്ങളും യാക്കോബിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ പോയി; മൂപ്പന്മാരും എല്ലാം അവിടെ വന്നു കൂടി.
chapters.niv: The next day Paul and the rest of us went to see James, and all the elders were present.
chapters.nkjv: On the following day Paul went in with us to James, and all the elders were present.
