chapters.niv: In the past God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
chapters.nkjv: God, who at various times and in various ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,
chapters.kjv: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

chapters.ml: ഈ അന്ത്യകാലത്തു പുത്രൻ മുഖാന്തരം നമ്മോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു. അവനെ താൻ സകലത്തിന്നും അവകാശിയാക്കി വെച്ചു; അവൻ മുഖാന്തരം ലോകത്തെയും ഉണ്ടാക്കി.
chapters.niv: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, and through whom also he made the universe.
chapters.nkjv: has in these last days spoken to us by His Son, whom He has appointed heir of all things, through whom also He made the worlds;
chapters.kjv: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവന്റെ തേജസ്സിന്റെ പ്രഭയും തത്വത്തിന്റെ മുദ്രയും സകലത്തേയും തന്റെ ശക്തിയുള്ള വചനത്താൽ വഹിക്കുന്നവനും ആകകൊണ്ടു പാപങ്ങൾക്കു പരിഹാരം ഉണ്ടാക്കിയശേഷം ഉയരത്തിൽ മഹിമയുടെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്കയും
chapters.niv: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: who being the brightness of His glory and the express image of His person, and upholding all things by the word of His power, when He had by Himself purged our sins, sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
chapters.kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവദൂതന്മാരെക്കാൾ വിശിഷ്ടമായ നാമത്തിന്നു അവകാശിയായതിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം അവരെക്കാൾ ശ്രേഷ്ഠനായിത്തീരുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: So he became as much superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is superior to theirs.
chapters.nkjv: having become so much better than the angels, as He has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
chapters.kjv: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

chapters.ml: “നീ എന്റെ പുത്രൻ; ഞാൻ ഇന്നു നിന്നെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നും “ഞാൻ അവന്നു പിതാവും അവൻ എനിക്കു പുത്രനും ആയിരിക്കും” എന്നും ദൂതന്മാരിൽ ആരോടെങ്കിലും വല്ലപ്പോഴും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: For to which of the angels did God ever say, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father" ? Or again, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son" ?
chapters.nkjv: For to which of the angels did He ever say: "You are My Son, Today I have begotten You"? And again: "I will be to Him a Father, And He shall be to Me a Son"?
chapters.kjv: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

chapters.ml: ആദ്യജാതനെ പിന്നെയും ഭൂതലത്തിലേക്കു പ്രവേശിപ്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ: “ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സകലദൂതന്മാരും അവനെ നമസ്കരിക്കേണം” എന്നു താൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And again, when God brings his firstborn into the world, he says, "Let all God’s angels worship him."
chapters.nkjv: But when He again brings the firstborn into the world, He says: "Let all the angels of God worship Him."
chapters.kjv: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

chapters.ml: “അവൻ കാറ്റുകളെ തന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരും അഗ്നിജ്വാലയെ തന്റെ ശുശ്രൂഷകന്മാരും ആക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ദൂതന്മാരെക്കുറിച്ചു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In speaking of the angels he says, "He makes his angels spirits, and his servants flames of fire."
chapters.nkjv: And of the angels He says: "Who makes His angels spirits And His ministers a flame of fire."
chapters.kjv: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

chapters.ml: പുത്രനോടോ: “ദൈവമേ, നിന്റെ സിംഹാസനം എന്നും എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു; നിന്റെ രാജത്വത്തിന്റെ ചെങ്കോൽ നേരുള്ള ചെങ്കോൽ.
chapters.niv: But about the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.
chapters.nkjv: But to the Son Hesays: "Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; A scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your kingdom.
chapters.kjv: But unto the Son he saith , Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

chapters.ml: നീ നീതിയെ ഇഷ്ടപ്പെടുകയും ദുഷ്ടതയെ ദ്വേഷിക്കയും ചെയ്തിരിക്കയാൽ ദൈവമേ, നിന്റെ ദൈവം നിന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരിൽ പരമായി നിന്നെ ആനന്ദതൈലംകൊണ്ടു അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നും
chapters.niv: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy."
chapters.nkjv: You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of gladness more than Your companions."
chapters.kjv: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

chapters.ml: “കർത്താവേ, നീ പൂർവ്വകാലത്തു ഭൂമിക്കു അടിസ്ഥാനം ഇട്ടു, ആകാശവും നിന്റെ കൈകളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തി ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He also says, "In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
chapters.nkjv: And: "You, Lord, in the beginning laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
chapters.kjv: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

chapters.ml: അവ നശിക്കും; നീയോ നിലനില്ക്കും; അവ എല്ലാം വസ്ത്രംപോലെ പഴകിപ്പോകും;
chapters.niv: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
chapters.nkjv: They will perish, but You remain; And they will all grow old like a garment;
chapters.kjv: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

chapters.ml: ഉടുപ്പുപോലെ നീ അവയെ ചുരുട്ടും; വസ്ത്രംപോലെ അവ മാറിപ്പോകും; നീയോ അനന്യൻ; നിന്റെ സംവത്സരങ്ങൾ അവസാനിക്കയുമില്ല” എന്നും പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed. But you remain the same, and your years will never end."
chapters.nkjv: Like a cloak You will fold them up, And they will be changed. But You are the same, And Your years will not fail."
chapters.kjv: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ശത്രുക്കളെ നിനക്കു പാദപീഠമാക്കുവോളം നീ എന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തിരിക്ക” എന്നു ദൂതന്മാരിൽ ആരോടെങ്കിലും വല്ലപ്പോഴും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടോ?
chapters.niv: To which of the angels did God ever say, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet" ?
chapters.nkjv: But to which of the angels has He ever said: "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool"?
chapters.kjv: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

chapters.ml: അവർ ഒക്കെയും രക്ഷപ്രാപിപ്പാനുള്ളവരുടെ ശുശ്രൂഷെക്കു അയക്കപ്പെടുന്ന സേവകാത്മാക്കളല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
chapters.nkjv: Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who will inherit salvation?
chapters.kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു നാം വല്ലപ്പോഴും ഒഴുകിപ്പോകാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു കേട്ടതു അധികം ശ്രദ്ധയോടെ കരുതിക്കൊൾവാൻ ആവശ്യമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We must pay the most careful attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore we must give the more earnest heed to the things we have heard, lest we drift away.
chapters.kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

chapters.ml: ദൂതന്മാർമുഖാന്തരം അരുളിച്ചെയ്ത വചനം സ്ഥിരമായിരിക്കയും ഓരോരോ ലംഘനത്തിന്നും അനുസരണക്കേടിന്നും ന്യായമായ പ്രതിഫലം ലഭിക്കയും ചെയ്തു എങ്കിൽ
chapters.niv: For since the message spoken through angels was binding, and every violation and disobedience received its just punishment,
chapters.nkjv: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just reward,
chapters.kjv: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു താൻ പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങിയതും ദൈവം അടയാളങ്ങളാലും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളാലും വിവിധവീര്യപ്രവൃത്തികളാലും തന്റെ ഇഷ്ടപ്രകാരം പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനെ നല്കിക്കൊണ്ടും സാക്ഷി നിന്നതും കേട്ടവർ
chapters.niv: how shall we escape if we ignore so great a salvation? This salvation, which was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard him.
chapters.nkjv: how shall we escape if we neglect so great a salvation, which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed to us by those who heard Him,
chapters.kjv: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him ;

chapters.ml: നമുക്കു ഉറപ്പിച്ചുതന്നതുമായ ഇത്ര വലിയ രക്ഷ നാം ഗണ്യമാക്കാതെ പോയാൽ എങ്ങനെ തെറ്റി ഒഴിയും?
chapters.niv: God also testified to it by signs, wonders and various miracles, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to his will.
chapters.nkjv: God also bearing witness both with signs and wonders, with various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to His own will?
chapters.kjv: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

chapters.ml: നാം പ്രസ്താവിക്കുന്ന ഭാവിലോകത്തെ അവൻ ദൂതന്മാർക്കല്ലല്ലോ കീഴ്പെടുത്തിയതു.
chapters.niv: It is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.
chapters.nkjv: For He has not put the world to come, of which we speak, in subjection to angels.
chapters.kjv: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ “മനുഷ്യനെ നീ ഓർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ എന്തു? മനുഷ്യപുത്രനെ സന്ദർശിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ എന്തുമാത്രം?
chapters.niv: But there is a place where someone has testified: "What is mankind that you are mindful of them, a son of man that you care for him?
chapters.nkjv: But one testified in a certain place, saying: "What is man that You are mindful of him, Or the son of man that You take care of him?
chapters.kjv: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

chapters.ml: നീ അവനെ ദൂതന്മാരെക്കാൾ അല്പം മാത്രം താഴ്ത്തി; തേജസ്സും ബഹുമാനവും അവനെ അണിയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നിന്റെ കൈകളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കു നീ അവനെ അധിപതി ആക്കി,
chapters.niv: You made them a little lower than the angels; you crowned them with glory and honor
chapters.nkjv: You have made him a little lower than the angels; You have crowned him with glory and honor, And set him over the works of Your hands.
chapters.kjv: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

chapters.ml: സകലവും അവന്റെ കാൽക്കീഴാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു” എന്നു ഒരുവൻ ഒരേടത്തു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്നു. സകലവും അവന്നു കീഴാക്കിയതിൽ ഒന്നിനെയും കീഴ്പെടുത്താതെ വിട്ടിട്ടില്ല; എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ സകലവും അവന്നു കീഴ്പെട്ടതായി കാണുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: and put everything under their feet." In putting everything under them, God left nothing that is not subject to them. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to them.
chapters.nkjv: You have put all things in subjection under his feet." For in that He put all in subjection under him, He left nothing thatis not put under him. But now we do not yet see all things put under him.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ദൈവകൃപയാൽ എല്ലാവർക്കും വേണ്ടി മരണം ആസ്വദിപ്പാൻ ദൂതന്മാരിലും അല്പം ഒരു താഴ്ചവന്നവനായ യേശു മരണം അനുഭവിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു അവനെ മഹത്വവും ബഹുമാനവും അണിഞ്ഞവനായി നാം കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But we do see Jesus, who was made lower than the angels for a little while, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.
chapters.nkjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, for the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that He, by the grace of God, might taste death for everyone.
chapters.kjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

chapters.ml: സകലത്തിന്നും ലാക്കും സകലത്തിന്നും കാരണഭൂതനുമായവൻ അനേകം പുത്രന്മാരെ തേജസ്സിലേക്കു നടത്തുമ്പോൾ അവരുടെ രക്ഷാനായകനെ കഷ്ടാനുഭവങ്ങളാൽ തികഞ്ഞവനാക്കുന്നതു യുക്തം ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In bringing many sons and daughters to glory, it was fitting that God, for whom and through whom everything exists, should make the pioneer of their salvation perfect through what he suffered.
chapters.nkjv: For it was fitting for Him, for whom are all things and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
chapters.kjv: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധീകരിക്കുന്നവന്നും വിശുദ്ധീകരിക്കപ്പെടുന്നവർക്കും എല്ലാം ഒരുവനല്ലോ പിതാവു; അതു ഹേതുവായി അവൻ അവരെ സഹോദരന്മാർ എന്നു വിളിപ്പാൻ ലജ്ജിക്കാതെ:
chapters.niv: Both the one who makes people holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters.
chapters.nkjv: For both He who sanctifies and those who are being sanctified are all of one, for which reason He is not ashamed to call them brethren,
chapters.kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ നിന്റെ നാമത്തെ എന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു കീർത്തിക്കും; സഭാമദ്ധ്യേ ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സ്തുതിക്കും”
chapters.niv: He says, "I will declare your name to my brothers and sisters; in the assembly I will sing your praises."
chapters.nkjv: saying: "I will declare Your name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will sing praise to You."
chapters.kjv: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

chapters.ml: എന്നും “ഞാൻ അവനിൽ ആശ്രയിക്കും” എന്നും ഇതാ, ഞാനും ദൈവം എനിക്കു തന്ന മക്കളും” എന്നും പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And again, "I will put my trust in him." And again he says, "Here am I, and the children God has given me."
chapters.nkjv: And again: "I will put My trust in Him." And again: "Here am I and the children whom God has given Me."
chapters.kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

chapters.ml: മക്കൾ ജഡരക്തങ്ങളോടു കൂടിയവർ ആകകൊണ്ടു അവനും അവരെപ്പോലെ ജഡരക്തങ്ങളോടു കൂടിയവനായി മരണത്തിന്റെ അധികാരിയായ പിശാചിനെ
chapters.niv: Since the children have flesh and blood, he too shared in their humanity so that by his death he might break the power of him who holds the power of death—that is, the devil—
chapters.nkjv: Inasmuch then as the children have partaken of flesh and blood, He Himself likewise shared in the same, that through death He might destroy him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
chapters.kjv: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

chapters.ml: തന്റെ മരണത്താൽ നീക്കി ജീവപര്യന്തം മരണഭീതിയാൽ അടിമകളായിരുന്നവരെ ഒക്കെയും വിടുവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
chapters.nkjv: and release those who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
chapters.kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

chapters.ml: ദൂതന്മാരെ സംരക്ഷണചെയ്‍വാനല്ല അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ സന്തതിയെ സംരക്ഷണ ചെയ്‍വാനത്രേ അവൻ വന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For surely it is not angels he helps, but Abraham’s descendants.
chapters.nkjv: For indeed He does not give aid to angels, but He does give aid to the seed of Abraham.
chapters.kjv: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ജനത്തിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾക്കു പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം വരുത്തുവാൻ അവൻ കരുണയുള്ളവനും ദൈവകാര്യത്തിൽ വിശ്വസ്തമഹാപുരോഹിതനും ആകേണ്ടതിന്നു സകലത്തിലും തന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാരോടു സദൃശനായിത്തീരുവാൻ ആവശ്യമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For this reason he had to be made like them, fully human in every way, in order that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, and that he might make atonement for the sins of the people.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, in all things He had to be made like His brethren, that He might be a merciful and faithful High Priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

chapters.ml: താൻ തന്നേ പരീക്ഷിതനായി കഷ്ടമനുഭവിച്ചിരിക്കയാൽ പരീക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുന്നവർക്കു സഹായിപ്പാൻ കഴിവുള്ളവൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.
chapters.nkjv: For in that He Himself has suffered, being tempted, He is able to aid those who are tempted.
chapters.kjv: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു വിശുദ്ധ സഹോദരന്മാരേ, സ്വർഗ്ഗീയവിളിക്കു ഓഹരിക്കാരായുള്ളോരേ, നാം സ്വീകരിച്ചുപറയുന്ന അപ്പൊസ്തലനും മഹാപുരോഹിതനുമായ യേശുവിനെ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചുനോക്കുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Therefore, holy brothers and sisters, who share in the heavenly calling, fix your thoughts on Jesus, whom we acknowledge as our apostle and high priest.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Christ Jesus,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

chapters.ml: മോശെ ദൈവഭവനത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും വിശ്വസ്തനായിരുന്നതുപോല യേശുവും തന്നെ നിയമിച്ചാക്കിയവന്നു വിശ്വസ്തൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.
chapters.nkjv: who was faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also wasfaithful in all His house.
chapters.kjv: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

chapters.ml: ഭവനത്തെക്കാളും ഭവനം ചമെച്ചവന്നു അധികം മാനമുള്ളതുപോലെ യേശുവും മോശെയെക്കാൾ അധികം മഹത്വത്തിന്നു യോഗ്യൻ എന്നു എണ്ണിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Jesus has been found worthy of greater honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
chapters.nkjv: For this One has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as He who built the house has more honor than the house.
chapters.kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

chapters.ml: ഏതു ഭവനവും ചമെപ്പാൻ ഒരാൾ വേണം; സർവ്വവും ചമച്ചവൻ ദൈവം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: For every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
chapters.nkjv: For every house is built by someone, but He who built all things is God.
chapters.kjv: For every house is builded by some man ; but he that built all things is God.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ഭവനത്തിൽ ഒക്കെയും മോശെ വിശ്വസ്തനായിരുന്നതു അരുളിച്ചെയ്‍വാനിരുന്നതിന്നു സാക്ഷ്യം പറയുന്ന ഭൃത്യനായിട്ടത്രേ.
chapters.niv: "Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house," bearing witness to what would be spoken by God in the future.
chapters.nkjv: And Moses indeed was faithful in all His house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which would be spoken afterward,
chapters.kjv: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തുവോ അവന്റെ ഭവനത്തിന്നു അധികാരിയായ പുത്രനായിട്ടു തന്നേ; പ്രത്യാശയുടെ ധൈര്യവും പ്രശംസയും നാം അവസാനത്തോളം മുറുകെപ്പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടാൽ നാം തന്നേ അവന്റെ ഭവനം ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are his house, if indeed we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope in which we glory.
chapters.nkjv: but Christ as a Son over His own house, whose house we are if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.
chapters.kjv: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതുപോലെ:
chapters.niv: So, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you hear his voice,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you will hear His voice,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

chapters.ml: “ഇന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ മരുഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു പരീക്ഷാദിവസത്തിലെ മത്സരത്തിൽ എന്നപോലെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയം കഠിനമാക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion, during the time of testing in the wilderness,
chapters.nkjv: Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, In the day of trial in the wilderness,
chapters.kjv: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

chapters.ml: അവിടെവെച്ചു നിങ്ങളുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാർ എന്നെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു നാല്പതു ആണ്ടു എന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ കണ്ടിട്ടും എന്നെ ശോധനചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: where your ancestors tested and tried me, though for forty years they saw what I did.
chapters.nkjv: Where your fathers tested Me, tried Me, And saw My works forty years.
chapters.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു എനിക്കു ആ തലമുറയോടു നീരസം ഉണ്ടായി. അവർ എപ്പോഴും തെറ്റിപ്പോകുന്ന ഹൃദയമുള്ളവർ എന്നും എന്റെ വഴികളെ അറിയാത്തവർ എന്നും ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു;
chapters.niv: That is why I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known my ways.’
chapters.nkjv: Therefore I was angry with that generation, And said, ‘They always go astray in their heart, And they have not known My ways.’
chapters.kjv: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

chapters.ml: അവർ എന്റെ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ എന്റെ ക്രോധത്തിൽ സത്യം ചെയ്തു.”
chapters.niv: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ "
chapters.nkjv: So I swore in My wrath, ‘They shall not enter My rest.’ "
chapters.kjv: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

chapters.ml: സഹോദരന്മാരേ, ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തെ ത്യജിച്ചുകളയാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവിശ്വാസമുള്ള ദുഷ്ടഹൃദയം നിങ്ങളിൽ ആർക്കും ഉണ്ടാകാതിരിപ്പാൻ നോക്കുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: See to it, brothers and sisters, that none of you has a sinful, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.
chapters.nkjv: Beware, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief in departing from the living God;
chapters.kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ആരും പാപത്തിന്റെ ചതിയാൽ കഠിനപ്പെടാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു “ഇന്നു” എന്നു പറയുന്നേടത്തോളം നാൾതോറും അന്യോന്യം പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called "Today," so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.
chapters.nkjv: but exhort one another daily, while it is called "Today," lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
chapters.kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

chapters.ml: ആദ്യവിശ്വാസം അവസാനത്തോളം മുറുകെപ്പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടാൽ നാം ക്രിസ്തുവിൽ പങ്കാളികളായിത്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: We have come to share in Christ, if indeed we hold our original conviction firmly to the very end.
chapters.nkjv: For we have become partakers of Christ if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to the end,
chapters.kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

chapters.ml: “ഇന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ മത്സരത്തിൽ എന്നപോലെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങളെ കഠിനമാക്കരുതു” എന്നു പറയുന്നതിൽ ആരാകുന്നു
chapters.niv: As has just been said: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion."
chapters.nkjv: while it is said: "Today, if you will hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion."
chapters.kjv: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

chapters.ml: കേട്ടിട്ടു മത്സരിച്ചവർ? മിസ്രയീമിൽനിന്നു മോശെ മുഖാന്തരം പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നവർ എല്ലാവരുമല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Who were they who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
chapters.nkjv: For who, having heard, rebelled? Indeed, wasit not all who came out of Egypt, led by Moses?
chapters.kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

chapters.ml: നാല്പതു ആണ്ടു ആരോടു ക്രുദ്ധിച്ചു? പാപം ചെയ്തവരോടല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies perished in the wilderness?
chapters.nkjv: Now with whom was He angry forty years? Wasit not with those who sinned, whose corpses fell in the wilderness?
chapters.kjv: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ശവങ്ങൾ മരുഭൂമിയിൽ വീണുപോയി. എന്റെ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ആണയിട്ടതു അനുസരണംകെട്ടവരോടല്ലാതെ പിന്നെ ആരോടാകുന്നു?
chapters.niv: And to whom did God swear that they would never enter his rest if not to those who disobeyed?
chapters.nkjv: And to whom did He swear that they would not enter His rest, but to those who did not obey?
chapters.kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ അവിശ്വാസം നിമിത്തം അവർക്കു പ്രവേശിപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നു നാം കാണുന്നു.
chapters.niv: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.
chapters.nkjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
chapters.kjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ പ്രവേശിപ്പാനുള്ള വാഗ്ദത്തം ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കയാൽ നിങ്ങളിൽ ആർക്കെങ്കിലും അതു ലഭിക്കാതെപോയി എന്നു വരാതിരിപ്പാൻ നാം ഭയപ്പെടുക.
chapters.niv: Therefore, since the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be found to have fallen short of it.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, since a promise remains of entering His rest, let us fear lest any of you seem to have come short of it.
chapters.kjv: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

chapters.ml: അവരെപ്പോലെ നാമും ഒരു സദ്വർത്തമാനം കേട്ടവർ ആകുന്നു; എങ്കിലും കേട്ടവരിൽ വിശ്വാസമായി പരിണമിക്കായ്കകൊണ്ടു കേട്ട വചനം അവർക്കു ഉപകാരമായി വന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: For we also have had the good news proclaimed to us, just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, because they did not share the faith of those who obeyed.
chapters.nkjv: For indeed the gospel was preached to us as well as to them; but the word which they heard did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard it.
chapters.kjv: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസിച്ചവരായ നാമല്ലോ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്നു; ലോകസ്ഥാപനത്തിങ്കൽ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ തീർന്നുപോയശേഷവും: “അവർ എന്റെ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കയില്ല എന്നു ഞാൻ എന്റെ കോപത്തിൽ സത്യം ചെയ്തു” എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Now we who have believed enter that rest, just as God has said, "So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ " And yet his works have been finished since the creation of the world.
chapters.nkjv: For we who have believed do enter that rest, as He has said: "So I swore in My wrath, ‘They shall not enter My rest,’ " although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
chapters.kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാം നാളിൽ ദൈവം തന്റെ സകല പ്രവൃത്തികളിൽനിന്നു നിവൃത്തനായി” എന്നു ഏഴാം നാളിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഒരേടത്തു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in these words: "On the seventh day God rested from all his works."
chapters.nkjv: For He has spoken in a certain place of the seventh day in this way: "And God rested on the seventh day from all His works";
chapters.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

chapters.ml: “എന്റെ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ അവർ പ്രവേശിക്കയില്ല” എന്നു ഇവിടെ പിന്നെയും അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And again in the passage above he says, "They shall never enter my rest."
chapters.nkjv: and again in this place: "They shall not enter My rest."
chapters.kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ചിലർ അതിൽ പ്രവേശിപ്പാൻ ഇട ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കയാലും മുമ്പെ സദ്വർത്തമാനം കേട്ടവർ അനുസരണക്കേടുനിമിത്തം പ്രവേശിക്കാതെ പോകയാലും
chapters.niv: Therefore since it still remains for some to enter that rest, and since those who formerly had the good news proclaimed to them did not go in because of their disobedience,
chapters.nkjv: Since therefore it remains that some must enter it, and those to whom it was first preached did not enter because of disobedience,
chapters.kjv: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

chapters.ml: ഇത്ര കാലത്തിന്റെ ശേഷം ദാവീദ് മുഖാന്തരം: “ഇന്നു അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയം കഠിനമാക്കരുതു” എന്നു മുമ്പെ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ “ഇന്നു” എന്നൊരു ദിവസം പിന്നെയും നിശ്ചയിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: God again set a certain day, calling it "Today." This he did when a long time later he spoke through David, as in the passage already quoted: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts."
chapters.nkjv: again He designates a certain day, saying in David, "Today," after such a long time, as it has been said: "Today, if you will hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts."
chapters.kjv: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

chapters.ml: യോശുവ അവർക്കു സ്വസ്ഥത വരുത്തി എങ്കിൽ മറ്റൊരു ദിവസത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു പിന്നത്തേതിൽ കല്പിക്കയില്ലായിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
chapters.nkjv: For if Joshua had given them rest, then He would not afterward have spoken of another day.
chapters.kjv: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ജനത്തിന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ബത്തനുഭവം ശേഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God;
chapters.nkjv: There remains therefore a rest for the people of God.
chapters.kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളിൽനിന്നു എന്നപോലെ അവന്റെ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ പ്രവേശിച്ചവൻ താനും തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളിൽനിന്നു നിവൃത്തനായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: for anyone who enters God’s rest also rests from their works, just as God did from his.
chapters.nkjv: For he who has entered His rest has himself also ceased from his works as God did from His.
chapters.kjv: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ആരും അനുസരണക്കേടിന്റെ സമദൃഷ്ടാന്തത്തിന്നൊത്തവണ്ണം വീഴാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നാം ആ സ്വസ്ഥതയിൽ പ്രവേശിപ്പാൻ ഉത്സാഹിക്ക.
chapters.niv: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will perish by following their example of disobedience.
chapters.nkjv: Let us therefore be diligent to enter that rest, lest anyone fall according to the same example of disobedience.
chapters.kjv: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനം ജീവനും ചൈതന്യവുമുള്ളതായി ഇരുവായ്ത്തലയുള്ള ഏതു വാളിനെക്കാളും മൂർച്ചയേറിയതും പ്രാണനെയും ആത്മാവിനെയും സന്ധിമജ്ജകളെയും വേറുവിടുവിക്കുംവരെ തുളെച്ചുചെല്ലുന്നതും ഹൃദയത്തിലെ ചിന്തനങ്ങളെയും ഭാവങ്ങളെയും വിവേചിക്കുന്നതും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it penetrates even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart.
chapters.nkjv: For the word of God is living and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the division of soul and spirit, and of joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
chapters.kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

chapters.ml: അവന്നു മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു സൃഷ്ടിയുമില്ല; സകലവും അവന്റെ കണ്ണിന്നു നഗ്നവും മലർന്നതുമായി കിടക്കുന്നു; അവനുമായിട്ടാകുന്നു നമുക്കു കാര്യമുള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight. Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.
chapters.nkjv: And there is no creature hidden from His sight, but all things are naked and open to the eyes of Him to whom we mustgive account.
chapters.kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ദൈവപുത്രനായ യേശു ആകാശത്തിൽകൂടി കടന്നുപോയോരു ശ്രേഷ്ഠമഹാപുരോഹിതനായി നമുക്കു ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു നാം നമ്മുടെ സ്വീകാരം മറുകെപ്പിടിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess.
chapters.nkjv: Seeing then that we have a great High Priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.
chapters.kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

chapters.ml: നമുക്കുള്ള മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ നമ്മുടെ ബലഹീനതകളിൽ സഹതാപം കാണിപ്പാൻ കഴിയാത്തവനല്ല; പാപം ഒഴികെ സർവ്വത്തിലും നമുക്കു തുല്യമായി പരീക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ടവനത്രേ നമുക്കുള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to empathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who has been tempted in every way, just as we are—yet he did not sin.
chapters.nkjv: For we do not have a High Priest who cannot sympathize with our weaknesses, but was in all points tempted as weare, yet without sin.
chapters.kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു കരുണ ലഭിപ്പാനും തത്സമയത്തു സഹായത്തിന്നുള്ള കൃപ പ്രാപിപ്പാനുമായി നാം ധൈര്യത്തോടെ കൃപാസനത്തിന്നു അടുത്തു ചെല്ലുക.
chapters.niv: Let us then approach God’s throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
chapters.nkjv: Let us therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
chapters.kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു എടുക്കുന്ന ഏതു മഹാപുരോഹിതനും പാപങ്ങൾക്കായി വഴിപാടും യാഗവും അർപ്പിപ്പാൻ ദൈവകാര്യത്തിൽ മനുഷ്യർക്കു വേണ്ടി നിയമിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Every high priest is selected from among the people and is appointed to represent the people in matters related to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
chapters.nkjv: For every high priest taken from among men is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
chapters.kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

chapters.ml: താനും ബലഹീനത പൂണ്ടവനാകയാൽ അറിവില്ലാത്തവരോടും വഴി തെറ്റിപ്പോകുന്നവരോടും സഹതാപം കാണിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നവനും
chapters.niv: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and are going astray, since he himself is subject to weakness.
chapters.nkjv: He can have compassion on those who are ignorant and going astray, since he himself is also subject to weakness.
chapters.kjv: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

chapters.ml: ബലഹീനതനിമിത്തം ജനത്തിന്നു വേണ്ടി എന്നപോലെ തനിക്കു വേണ്ടിയും പാപയാഗം അർപ്പിക്കേണ്ടിയവനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is why he has to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
chapters.nkjv: Because of this he is required as for the people, so also for himself, to offer sacrifices for sins.
chapters.kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അഹരോനെപ്പോലെ ദൈവം വിളിക്കുന്നവനല്ലാതെ ആരും ആ സ്ഥാനം സ്വതവെ എടുക്കുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: And no one takes this honor on himself, but he receives it when called by God, just as Aaron was.
chapters.nkjv: And no man takes this honor to himself, but he who is called by God, just as Aaron was.
chapters.kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

chapters.ml: അവ്വണ്ണം ക്രിസ്തുവും മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ ആകുവാനുള്ള മഹത്വം സ്വതവെ എടുത്തിട്ടില്ല; “നീ എന്റെ പുത്രൻ; ഇന്നു ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ജനിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു”എന്നു അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തവൻ അവന്നു കൊടുത്തതത്രേ.
chapters.niv: In the same way, Christ did not take on himself the glory of becoming a high priest. But God said to him, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father."
chapters.nkjv: So also Christ did not glorify Himself to become High Priest, but itwas He who said to Him: "You are My Son, Today I have begotten You."
chapters.kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ മറ്റൊരേടത്തും: “നീ മൽക്കീസേദെക്കിന്റെ ക്രമപ്രകാരം എന്നേക്കും ഒരു പുരോഹിതൻ ” എന്നു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And he says in another place, "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."
chapters.nkjv: As He also says in another place: "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek";
chapters.kjv: As he saith also in another place , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തു തന്റെ ഐഹിക ജീവകാലത്തു തന്നെ മരണത്തിൽനിന്നു രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നവനോടു ഉറെച്ച നിലവിളിയോടും കണ്ണുനീരോടുംകൂടെ അപേക്ഷയും അഭയയാചനയും കഴിക്കയും ഭയഭക്തി നിമിത്തം ഉത്തരം ലഭിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: During the days of Jesus’ life on earth, he offered up prayers and petitions with fervent cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.
chapters.nkjv: who, in the days of His flesh, when He had offered up prayers and supplications, with vehement cries and tears to Him who was able to save Him from death, and was heard because of His godly fear,
chapters.kjv: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

chapters.ml: പുത്രൻ എങ്കിലും താൻ അനുഭവിച്ച കഷ്ടങ്ങളാൽ അനുസരണം പഠിച്ചു തികഞ്ഞവനായി
chapters.niv: Son though he was, he learned obedience from what he suffered
chapters.nkjv: though He was a Son, yet He learned obedience by the things which He suffered.
chapters.kjv: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

chapters.ml: തന്നെ അനുസരിക്കുന്ന ഏവർക്കും നിത്യരക്ഷയുടെ കാരണഭൂതനായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him
chapters.nkjv: And having been perfected, He became the author of eternal salvation to all who obey Him,
chapters.kjv: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

chapters.ml: മൽക്കീസേദെക്കിന്റെ ക്രമപ്രകാരം മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ എന്നുള്ള നാമം ദൈവത്താൽ ലഭിച്ചുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and was designated by God to be high priest in the order of Melchizedek.
chapters.nkjv: called by God as High Priest "according to the order of Melchizedek,"
chapters.kjv: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

chapters.ml: ഇതിനെക്കുറിച്ചു ഞങ്ങൾക്കു വളരെ പറവാനുണ്ടു; എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾ കേൾപ്പാൻ മാന്ദ്യമുള്ളവരായി തീർന്നതുകൊണ്ടു തെളിയിച്ചുതരുവാൻ വിഷമം.
chapters.niv: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to make it clear to you because you no longer try to understand.
chapters.nkjv: of whom we have much to say, and hard to explain, since you have become dull of hearing.
chapters.kjv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

chapters.ml: കാലം നോക്കിയാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഉപദേഷ്ടാക്കന്മാർ ആയിരിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന നിങ്ങൾക്കു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടുകളുടെ ആദ്യപാഠങ്ങളെ തന്നേ വീണ്ടും ഉപദേശിച്ചുതരുവാൻ ആവശ്യമായിരിക്കുന്നു; കട്ടിയായുള്ള ആഹാരമല്ല, പാലത്രേ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആവശ്യമെന്നു വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In fact, though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God’s word all over again. You need milk, not solid food!
chapters.nkjv: For though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you again the first principles of the oracles of God; and you have come to need milk and not solid food.
chapters.kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

chapters.ml: പാൽ കുടിക്കുന്നവൻ എല്ലാം നീതിയുടെ വചനത്തിൽ പരിചയമില്ലാത്തവനത്രേ; അവൻ ശിശുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Anyone who lives on milk, being still an infant, is not acquainted with the teaching about righteousness.
chapters.nkjv: For everyone who partakes only of milk is unskilled in the word of righteousness, for he is a babe.
chapters.kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

chapters.ml: കട്ടിയായുള്ള ആഹാരം നന്മതിന്മകളെ തിരിച്ചറിവാൻ തഴക്കത്താൽ അഭ്യസിച്ച ഇന്ദ്രിയങ്ങളുള്ളവരായി പ്രായം തികഞ്ഞവർക്കേ പറ്റുകയുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained themselves to distinguish good from evil.
chapters.nkjv: But solid food belongs to those who are of full age, thatis, those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
chapters.kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു നിർജ്ജീവപ്രവൃത്തികളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള മാനസാന്തരം, ദൈവത്തിങ്കലെ വിശ്വാസം, സ്നാനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ഉപദേശം, കൈവെപ്പു, മരിച്ചവരുടെ പുനരുത്ഥാനം,
chapters.niv: Therefore let us move beyond the elementary teachings about Christ and be taken forward to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from acts that lead to death, and of faith in God,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, leaving the discussion of the elementary principles of Christ, let us go on to perfection, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God,
chapters.kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

chapters.ml: നിത്യശിക്ഷാവിധി എന്നിങ്ങനെയുള്ള അടിസ്ഥാനം പിന്നെയും ഇടാതെ നാം ക്രിസ്തുവിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ആദ്യവചനം വിട്ടു പരിജ്ഞാനപൂർത്തി പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുക.
chapters.niv: instruction about cleansing rites, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
chapters.nkjv: of the doctrine of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
chapters.kjv: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അനുവദിക്കുന്ന പക്ഷം നാം അതു ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: And God permitting, we will do so.
chapters.nkjv: And this we will do if God permits.
chapters.kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.

chapters.ml: ഒരിക്കൽ പ്രകാശനം ലഭിച്ചിട്ടു സ്വർഗ്ഗീയദാനം ആസ്വദിക്കയും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിനെ പ്രാപിക്കയും
chapters.niv: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,
chapters.nkjv: For itis impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted the heavenly gift, and have become partakers of the Holy Spirit,
chapters.kjv: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നല്ല വചനവും വരുവാനുള്ള ലോകത്തിന്റെ ശക്തിയും ആസ്വദിക്കയും ചെയ്തവർ പിന്മാറിപ്പോയാൽ
chapters.niv: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age
chapters.nkjv: and have tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
chapters.kjv: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

chapters.ml: തങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നേ ദൈവപുത്രനെ വീണ്ടും ക്രൂശിക്കുന്നവരും അവന്നു ലോകാപവാദം വരുത്തുന്നവരും ആകകൊണ്ടു അവരെ പിന്നെയും മാനസാന്തരത്തിലേക്കു പുതുക്കുവാൻ കഴിവുള്ളതല്ല.
chapters.niv: and who have fallen away, to be brought back to repentance. To their loss they are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting him to public disgrace.
chapters.nkjv: if they fall away, to renew them again to repentance, since they crucify again for themselves the Son of God, and put Him to an open shame.
chapters.kjv: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

chapters.ml: പലപ്പോഴും പെയ്ത മഴ കുടിച്ചിട്ടു ഭൂമി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുന്നവർക്കു ഹിതമായ സസ്യാദികളെ വിളയിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹം പ്രാപിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is farmed receives the blessing of God.
chapters.nkjv: For the earth which drinks in the rain that often comes upon it, and bears herbs useful for those by whom it is cultivated, receives blessing from God;
chapters.kjv: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

chapters.ml: മുള്ളും ഞെരിഞ്ഞിലും മുളെപ്പിച്ചാലോ അതു കൊള്ളരുതാത്തതും ശാപത്തിന്നു അടുത്തതും ആകുന്നു; ചുട്ടുകളക അത്രേ അതിന്റെ അവസാനം.
chapters.niv: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and is in danger of being cursed. In the end it will be burned.
chapters.nkjv: but if it bears thorns and briers, itis rejected and near to being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
chapters.kjv: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ പ്രിയമുള്ളവരേ, ഞങ്ങൾ ഇങ്ങനെ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു ശുഭമേറിയതും രക്ഷെക്കു ഉതകുന്നതും വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Even though we speak like this, dear friends, we are convinced of better things in your case—the things that have to do with salvation.
chapters.nkjv: But, beloved, we are confident of better things concerning you, yes, things that accompany salvation, though we speak in this manner.
chapters.kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിയും വിശുദ്ധന്മാരെ ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചതിനാലും ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കുന്നതിനാലും തന്റെ നാമത്തോടു കാണിച്ച സ്നേഹവും മറന്നുകളവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അനീതിയുള്ളവനല്ല.
chapters.niv: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.
chapters.nkjv: For God is not unjust to forget your work and labor of love which you have shown toward His name, inthat you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
chapters.kjv: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഓരോരുത്തൻ പ്രത്യാശയുടെ പൂർണ്ണനിശ്ചയം പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ അവസാനത്തോളം ഒരുപോലെ ഉത്സാഹം കാണിക്കേണമെന്നു ഞങ്ങൾ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, so that what you hope for may be fully realized.
chapters.nkjv: And we desire that each one of you show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope until the end,
chapters.kjv: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങൾ മന്ദതയുള്ളവരാകാതെ വിശ്വാസത്താലും ദീർഘക്ഷമയാലും വാഗ്ദത്തങ്ങളെ അവകാശമാക്കുന്നവരുടെ അനുകാരികളായിത്തീരും.
chapters.niv: We do not want you to become lazy, but to imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
chapters.nkjv: that you do not become sluggish, but imitate those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
chapters.kjv: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

chapters.ml: ദൈവം അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ തന്നെക്കാൾ വലിയവനെക്കൊണ്ടു സത്യം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഇല്ലാഞ്ഞിട്ടു തന്നെക്കൊണ്ടു തന്നേ സത്യം ചെയ്തു:
chapters.niv: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater for him to swear by, he swore by himself,
chapters.nkjv: For when God made a promise to Abraham, because He could swear by no one greater, He swore by Himself,
chapters.kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

chapters.ml: “ഞാൻ നിന്നെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കയും നിന്നെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യും” എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: saying, "I will surely bless you and give you many descendants."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you."
chapters.kjv: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ അവൻ ദീർഘക്ഷമയൊടിരുന്നു വാഗ്ദത്തവിഷയം പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And so after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.
chapters.nkjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
chapters.kjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളെക്കാൾ വലിയവനെക്കൊണ്ടല്ലോ മനുഷ്യർ സത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നതു; ആണ അവർക്കു ഉറപ്പിന്നായി സകലവാദത്തിന്റെയും തീർച്ചയാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: People swear by someone greater than themselves, and the oath confirms what is said and puts an end to all argument.
chapters.nkjv: For men indeed swear by the greater, and an oath for confirmation is for them an end of all dispute.
chapters.kjv: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ദൈവം വാഗ്ദത്തത്തിന്റെ അവകാശികൾക്കു തന്റെ ആലോചന മാറാത്തതു എന്നു അധികം സ്പഷ്ടമായി കാണിപ്പാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചു ഒരു ആണയാലും ഉറപ്പുകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Because God wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of what was promised, he confirmed it with an oath.
chapters.nkjv: Thus God, determining to show more abundantly to the heirs of promise the immutability of His counsel, confirmed it by an oath,
chapters.kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ നമ്മുടെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചിട്ടുള്ള പ്രത്യാശ പിടിച്ചുകൊൾവാൻ ശരണത്തിന്നായി ഓടിവന്ന നാം മാറിപ്പോകാത്തതും ദൈവത്തിന്നു ഭോഷ്കുപറവാൻ കഴിയാത്തതുമായ രണ്ടു കാര്യങ്ങളാൽ ശക്തിയുള്ള പ്രബോധനം പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ ഇടവരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: God did this so that, by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be greatly encouraged.
chapters.nkjv: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we might have strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold of the hope set before us.
chapters.kjv: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

chapters.ml: ആ പ്രത്യാശ നമുക്കു ആത്മാവിന്റെ ഒരു നങ്കൂരം തന്നേ; അതു നിശ്ചയവും സ്ഥിരവും തിരശ്ശീലെക്കകത്തേക്കു കടക്കുന്നതുമാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
chapters.nkjv: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and which enters the Presence behind the veil,
chapters.kjv: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

chapters.ml: അവിടേക്കു യേശു മൽക്കീസേദെക്കിന്റെ ക്രമപ്രകാരം എന്നേക്കും മഹാപുരോഹിതനായി മുമ്പുകൂട്ടി നമുക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രവേശിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: where our forerunner, Jesus, has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.
chapters.nkjv: where the forerunner has entered for us, even Jesus, having become High Priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
chapters.kjv: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

chapters.ml: ശാലേംരാജാവും അത്യുന്നതനായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പുരോഹിതനുമായ ഈ മൽക്കീസേദെക്ക് രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ജയിച്ചു
chapters.niv: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the defeat of the kings and blessed him,
chapters.nkjv: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of the Most High God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
chapters.kjv: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

chapters.ml: മടങ്ങിവരുന്ന അബ്രാഹാമിനെ എതിരേറ്റു അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു; അബ്രാഹാം അവന്നു സകലത്തിലും പത്തിലൊന്നു കൊടുത്തു. അവന്റെ പേരിന്നു ആദ്യം നീതിയുടെ രാജാവെന്നും പിന്നെ ശാലേംരാജാവു എന്നുവെച്ചാൽ സമാധാനത്തിന്റെ രാജാവു എന്നും അർത്ഥം.
chapters.niv: and Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. First, the name Melchizedek means "king of righteousness"; then also, "king of Salem" means "king of peace."
chapters.nkjv: to whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all, first being translated "king of righteousness," and then also king of Salem, meaning "king of peace,"
chapters.kjv: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

chapters.ml: അവന്നു പിതാവില്ല, മാതാവില്ല, വംശാവലിയില്ല, ജീവാരംഭവും ജീവാവസാനവും ഇല്ല; അവൻ ദൈവപുത്രന്നു തുല്യനായി എന്നേക്കും പുരോഹിതനായിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Without father or mother, without genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, resembling the Son of God, he remains a priest forever.
chapters.nkjv: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, remains a priest continually.
chapters.kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

chapters.ml: ഇവൻ എത്ര മഹാൻ എന്നു നോക്കുവിൻ; ഗോത്രപിതാവായ അബ്രാഹാം കൂടെയും അവന്നു കൊള്ളയുടെ വിശേഷസാധനങ്ങളിൽ പത്തിലൊന്നു കൊടുത്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Just think how great he was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder!
chapters.nkjv: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave a tenth of the spoils.
chapters.kjv: Now consider how great this man was , unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

chapters.ml: ലേവിപുത്രന്മാരിൽ പൌരോഹിത്യം ലഭിക്കുന്നവർക്കു ന്യായപ്രാമാണപ്രകാരം ജനത്തോടു ദശാംശം വാങ്ങുവാൻ കല്പന ഉണ്ടു; അതു അബ്രാഹാമിന്റെ കടിപ്രദേശത്തിൽനിന്നു ഉത്ഭവിച്ച സഹോദരന്മാരോടു ആകുന്നു വാങ്ങുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: Now the law requires the descendants of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their fellow Israelites—even though they also are descended from Abraham.
chapters.nkjv: And indeed those who are of the sons of Levi, who receive the priesthood, have a commandment to receive tithes from the people according to the law, that is, from their brethren, though they have come from the loins of Abraham;
chapters.kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവരുടെ വംശാവലിയിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടാത്തവൻ അബ്രാഹാമിനോടു തന്നേ ദശാംശം വാങ്ങിയും വാഗ്ദത്തങ്ങൾ പ്രാപിച്ചവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചുമിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This man, however, did not trace his descent from Levi, yet he collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
chapters.nkjv: but he whose genealogy is not derived from them received tithes from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
chapters.kjv: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

chapters.ml: ഉയർന്നവൻ താണവനെ അനുഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു എന്നതിന്നു തർക്കം ഏതുമില്ലല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And without doubt the lesser is blessed by the greater.
chapters.nkjv: Now beyond all contradiction the lesser is blessed by the better.
chapters.kjv: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

chapters.ml: ഇവിടെ മരിക്കുന്ന മനുഷ്യർ ദശാംശം വാങ്ങുന്നു; അവിടെയോ ജീവിക്കുന്നു എന്ന സാക്ഷ്യം പ്രാപിച്ചവൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: In the one case, the tenth is collected by people who die; but in the other case, by him who is declared to be living.
chapters.nkjv: Here mortal men receive tithes, but there he receivesthem, of whom it is witnessed that he lives.
chapters.kjv: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

chapters.ml: ദശാംശം വാങ്ങുന്ന ലേവിയും അബ്രാഹാം മുഖാന്തരം ദശാംശം കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഒരു വിധത്തിൽ പറയാം.
chapters.niv: One might even say that Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham,
chapters.nkjv: Even Levi, who receives tithes, paid tithes through Abraham, so to speak,
chapters.kjv: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ പിതാവിനെ മൽക്കീസേദെക്ക് എതിരേറ്റപ്പോൾ ലേവി അവന്റെ കടിപ്രദേശത്തു ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: because when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the body of his ancestor.
chapters.nkjv: for he was still in the loins of his father when Melchizedek met him.
chapters.kjv: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

chapters.ml: ലേവ്യപൌരോഹിത്യത്താൽ സമ്പൂർണ്ണത വന്നെങ്കിൽ — അതിൻ കീഴല്ലോ ജനം ന്യായപ്രമാണം പ്രാപിച്ചതു — അഹരോന്റെ ക്രമപ്രകാരം എന്നു പറയാതെ മൽക്കീസേദെക്കിന്റെ ക്രമപ്രകാരം വേറൊരു പുരോഹിതൻ വരുവാൻ എന്തൊരാവശ്യം?
chapters.niv: If perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood—and indeed the law given to the people established that priesthood—why was there still need for another priest to come, one in the order of Melchizedek, not in the order of Aaron?
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, if perfection were through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the law), what further need wasthere that another priest should rise according to the order of Melchizedek, and not be called according to the order of Aaron?
chapters.kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

chapters.ml: പൌരോഹിത്യം മാറിപ്പോകുന്ന പക്ഷം ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്നുംകൂടെ മാറ്റം വരുവാൻ ആവശ്യം.
chapters.niv: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed also.
chapters.nkjv: For the priesthood being changed, of necessity there is also a change of the law.
chapters.kjv: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇതു ആരെക്കുറിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നുവോ അവൻ വേറൊരു ഗോത്രത്തിലുള്ളവൻ; ആ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ ആരും യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the altar.
chapters.nkjv: For He of whom these things are spoken belongs to another tribe, from which no man has officiated at the altar.
chapters.kjv: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദയിൽനിന്നു നമ്മുടെ കർത്താവു ഉദിച്ചു എന്നു സ്പഷ്ടമല്ലോ; ആ ഗോത്രത്തോടു മോശെ പൌരോഹിത്യം സംബന്ധിച്ചു ഒന്നും കല്പിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, and in regard to that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.
chapters.nkjv: For itis evident that our Lord arose from Judah, of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
chapters.kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

chapters.ml: ജഡസംബന്ധമായ കല്പനയുടെ പ്രമാണത്താൽ അല്ല, അഴിഞ്ഞുപോകാത്ത ജീവന്റെ ശക്തിയാൽ ഉളവായ വേറെ ഒരു പുരോഹിതൻ
chapters.niv: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
chapters.nkjv: And it is yet far more evident if, in the likeness of Melchizedek, there arises another priest
chapters.kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

chapters.ml: മൽക്കീസേദെക്കിന്നു സദൃശനായി ഉദിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ അതു ഏറ്റവും അധികം തെളിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a regulation as to his ancestry but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.
chapters.nkjv: who has come, not according to the law of a fleshly commandment, but according to the power of an endless life.
chapters.kjv: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

chapters.ml: നീ മൽക്കീസേദെക്കിന്റെ ക്രമപ്രകാരം എന്നേക്കും പുരോഹിതൻ എന്നല്ലോ സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For it is declared: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."
chapters.nkjv: For He testifies: "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."
chapters.kjv: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

chapters.ml: മുമ്പിലത്തെ കല്പനെക്കു അതിന്റെ ബലഹീനതയും നിഷ്‌പ്രയോജനവുംനിമിത്തം
chapters.niv: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless
chapters.nkjv: For on the one hand there is an annulling of the former commandment because of its weakness and unprofitableness,
chapters.kjv: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

chapters.ml: നീക്കവും — ന്യായപ്രമാണത്താൽ ഒന്നും പൂർത്തിപ്രാപിച്ചിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ — നാം ദൈവത്തോടു അടുക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള ഏറെനല്ല പ്രത്യാശെക്കു സ്ഥാപനവും വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.
chapters.nkjv: for the law made nothing perfect; on the other hand, thereisthe bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
chapters.kjv: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did ; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

chapters.ml: അവർ ആണ കൂടാതെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: And it was not without an oath! Others became priests without any oath,
chapters.nkjv: And inasmuch as Hewas not madepriest without an oath
chapters.kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest :

chapters.ml: ഇവനോ “നീ എന്നേക്കും പുരോഹിതൻ എന്നു കർത്താവു സത്യം ചെയ്തു, അനുതപിക്കയുമില്ല” എന്നു തന്നോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തവൻ ഇട്ട ആണയോടുകൂടെ തന്നെ
chapters.niv: but he became a priest with an oath when God said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’ "
chapters.nkjv: (for they have become priests without an oath, but He with an oath by Him who said to Him: "The Lord has sworn And will not relent, ‘You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek’ "),
chapters.kjv: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

chapters.ml: ആണ കൂടാതെയല്ല എന്നതിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം വിശേഷമേറിയ നിയമത്തിന്നു യേശു ഉത്തരവാദിയായി തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantor of a better covenant.
chapters.nkjv: by so much more Jesus has become a surety of a better covenant.
chapters.kjv: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

chapters.ml: മരണംനിമിത്തം അവർക്കു നിലനില്പാൻ മുടക്കം വരികകൊണ്ടു പുരോഹിതന്മാർ ആയിത്തീർന്നവർ അനേകർ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now there have been many of those priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office;
chapters.nkjv: Also there were many priests, because they were prevented by death from continuing.
chapters.kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

chapters.ml: ഇവനോ, എന്നേക്കും ഇരിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു മാറാത്ത പൌരോഹിത്യം ആകുന്നു പ്രാപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: but because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.
chapters.nkjv: But He, because He continues forever, has an unchangeable priesthood.
chapters.kjv: But this man , because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു താൻ മുഖാന്തരമായി ദൈവത്തോടു അടുക്കുന്നവർക്കു വേണ്ടി പക്ഷവാദം ചെയ്‍വാൻ സാദാ ജീവിക്കുന്നവനാകയാൽ അവരെ പൂർണ്ണമായി രക്ഷിപ്പാൻ അവൻ പ്രാപ്തനാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore He is also able to save to the uttermost those who come to God through Him, since He always lives to make intercession for them.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള മഹാപുരോഹിതനല്ലോ നമുക്കു വേണ്ടിയതു: പവിത്രൻ, നിർദ്ദോഷൻ, നിർമ്മലൻ, പാപികളോടു വേറുവിട്ടവൻ, സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തെക്കാൾ ഉന്നതനായിത്തീർന്നവൻ;
chapters.niv: Such a high priest truly meets our need—one who is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners, exalted above the heavens.
chapters.nkjv: For such a High Priest was fitting for us, whois holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and has become higher than the heavens;
chapters.kjv: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

chapters.ml: ആ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരെപ്പോലെ ആദ്യം സ്വന്തപാപങ്ങൾക്കായും പിന്നെ ജനത്തിന്റെ പാപങ്ങൾക്കായും ദിനംപ്രതി യാഗം കഴിപ്പാൻ ആവശ്യമില്ലാത്തവൻ തന്നേ. അതു അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ അർപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ഒരിക്കലായിട്ടു ചെയ്തുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices day after day, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. He sacrificed for their sins once for all when he offered himself.
chapters.nkjv: who does not need daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the people’s, for this He did once for all when He offered up Himself.
chapters.kjv: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

chapters.ml: ന്യായപ്രമാണം ബലഹിനമനുഷ്യരെ മഹാപുരോഹിതന്മാരാക്കുന്നു; ന്യായപ്രമാണത്തിന്നു പിമ്പുള്ള ആണയുടെ വചനമോ എന്നേക്കും തികെഞ്ഞവനായിത്തീർന്ന പുത്രനെ പുരോഹിതനാക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For the law appoints as high priests men in all their weakness; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.
chapters.nkjv: For the law appoints as high priests men who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints the Son who has been perfected forever.
chapters.kjv: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

chapters.ml: നാം ഈ പറയുന്നതിന്റെ സാരം എന്തെന്നാൽ: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ മഹിമാസനത്തിന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇുരുന്നവനായി,
chapters.niv: Now the main point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
chapters.nkjv: Now thisis the main point of the things we are saying: We have such a High Priest, who is seated at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
chapters.kjv: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലത്തിന്റെയും മനുഷ്യനല്ല കർത്താവു സ്ഥാപിച്ച സത്യകൂടാരത്തിന്റെയും ശുശ്രൂഷകനായ മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ നമുക്കുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: and who serves in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by a mere human being.
chapters.nkjv: a Minister of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord erected, and not man.
chapters.kjv: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

chapters.ml: ഏതു മഹാപുരോഹിതനും വഴിപാടും യാഗവും അർപ്പിപ്പാൻ നിയമിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു; ആകയാൽ അർപിപ്പാൻ ഇവന്നും വല്ലതും വേണം.
chapters.niv: Every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, and so it was necessary for this one also to have something to offer.
chapters.nkjv: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore itis necessary that this One also have something to offer.
chapters.kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭൂമിയിൽ ആയിരുന്നെങ്കിൽ പുരോഹിതൻ ആകയില്ലായിരുന്നു; ന്യായപ്രമാണപ്രകാരം വഴിപാടു അർപ്പിക്കുന്നവർ ഉണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest, for there are already priests who offer the gifts prescribed by the law.
chapters.nkjv: For if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;
chapters.kjv: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

chapters.ml: കൂടാരം തീർപ്പാൻ മോശെ ആരംഭിച്ചപ്പോൾ “പർവ്വതത്തിൽ നിനക്കു കാണിച്ച മാതൃക പ്രകാരം നീ സകലവും ചെയ്‍വാൻ നോക്കുക” എന്നു അവനോടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തതുപോലെ അവർ സ്വർഗ്ഗീയത്തിന്റെ ദൃഷ്ടാന്തവും നിഴലുമായതിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷ ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They serve at a sanctuary that is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: "See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain."
chapters.nkjv: who serve the copy and shadow of the heavenly things, as Moses was divinely instructed when he was about to make the tabernacle. For He said, "See that you make all things according to the pattern shown you on the mountain."
chapters.kjv: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

chapters.ml: അവനോ വിശേഷതയേറിയ വാഗ്ദത്തങ്ങളിന്മേൽ സ്ഥാപിക്കപ്പെട്ട നിയമത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യസ്ഥനാകയാൽ അതിന്റെ വിശേഷതെക്കു ഒത്തവണ്ണം വിശേഷതയേറിയ ശുശ്രൂഷയും പ്രാപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But in fact the ministry Jesus has received is as superior to theirs as the covenant of which he is mediator is superior to the old one, since the new covenant is established on better promises.
chapters.nkjv: But now He has obtained a more excellent ministry, inasmuch as He is also Mediator of a better covenant, which was established on better promises.
chapters.kjv: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തെ നിയമം കുറവില്ലാത്തതായിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ രണ്ടാമത്തേതിന്നു ഇടം അന്വേഷിക്കയില്ലായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For if there had been nothing wrong with that first covenant, no place would have been sought for another.
chapters.nkjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
chapters.kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ അവൻ അവരെ ആക്ഷേപിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു: “ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തോടും യഹൂദാഗൃഹത്തോടും പുതിയോരു നിയമം ചെയ്യുന്ന കാലം വരും എന്നു കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: But God found fault with the people and said : "The days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.
chapters.nkjv: Because finding fault with them, He says: "Behold, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah—
chapters.kjv: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവരുടെ പിതാക്കന്മാരെ കൈക്കു പിടിച്ചു മിസ്രയീംദേശത്തുനിന്നു കൊണ്ടുവന്ന നാളിൽ ഞാൻ അവരോടു ചെയ്ത നിയമംപോലെ അല്ല; അവർ എന്റെ നിയമത്തിൽ നിലനിന്നില്ല; ഞാൻ അവരെ ആദരിച്ചതുമില്ല എന്നു കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.
chapters.niv: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not remain faithful to my covenant, and I turned away from them, declares the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they did not continue in My covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.
chapters.kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

chapters.ml: ഈ കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം ഞാൻ യിസ്രായേൽഗൃഹത്തോടു ചെയ്‍വാനിരിക്കുന്ന നിയമം ഇങ്ങനെ ആകുന്നു: ഞാൻ എന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം അവരുടെ ഉള്ളിലാക്കി അവരുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങളിൽ എഴുതും; ഞാൻ അവർക്കു ദൈവമായും അവർ എനിക്കു ജനമായും ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: This is the covenant I will establish with the people of Israel after that time, declares the Lord. I will put my laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
chapters.nkjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws in their mind and write them on their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
chapters.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

chapters.ml: ഇനി അവരിൽ ആരും തന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരനെയും തന്റെ സഹോദരനെയും കർത്താവിനെ അറിക എന്നു ഉപദേശിക്കയില്ല; അവർ ആബാലവൃദ്ധം എല്ലാവരും എന്നെ അറിയും.
chapters.niv: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.
chapters.nkjv: None of them shall teach his neighbor, and none his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them.
chapters.kjv: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവരുടെ അകൃത്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചു കരുണയുള്ളവൻ ആകും; അവരുടെ പാപങ്ങളെ ഇനി ഓർക്കയുമില്ല എന്നു കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു.”
chapters.niv: For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."
chapters.nkjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more."
chapters.kjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

chapters.ml: പുതിയതു എന്നു പറയുന്നതിനാൽ ആദ്യത്തേതിനെ പഴയതാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു; എന്നാൽ പഴയതാകുന്നതും ജീർണ്ണിക്കുന്നതും എല്ലാം നീങ്ങിപ്പോകുവാൻ അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By calling this covenant "new," he has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and outdated will soon disappear.
chapters.nkjv: In that He says, "A new covenant," He has made the first obsolete. Now what is becoming obsolete and growing old is ready to vanish away.
chapters.kjv: In that he saith, A new covenant , he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ആദ്യനിയമത്തിന്നും ആരാധനെക്കുള്ള ചട്ടങ്ങളും ലൌകികമായ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
chapters.nkjv: Then indeed, even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and the earthly sanctuary.
chapters.kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

chapters.ml: ഒരു കൂടാരം ചമെച്ചു; അതിന്റെ ആദ്യഭാഗത്തു നിലവിളക്കും മേശയും കാഴ്ചയപ്പവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അതിന്നു വിശുദ്ധസ്ഥലം എന്നു പേർ.
chapters.niv: A tabernacle was set up. In its first room were the lampstand and the table with its consecrated bread; this was called the Holy Place.
chapters.nkjv: For a tabernacle was prepared: the first part, in which was the lampstand, the table, and the showbread, which is called the sanctuary;
chapters.kjv: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാം തിരശ്ശീലെക്കു പിന്നിലോ അതിവിശുദ്ധം എന്ന കൂടാരം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,
chapters.nkjv: and behind the second veil, the part of the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of All,
chapters.kjv: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

chapters.ml: അതിൽ പൊന്നുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ധൂപകലശവും മുഴുവനും പൊന്നു പൊതിഞ്ഞ നിയമപെട്ടകവും അതിന്നകത്തു മന്ന ഇട്ടുവെച്ച പൊൻപാത്രവും അഹരോന്റെ തളിർത്തവടിയും നിയമത്തിന്റെ കല്പലകകളും
chapters.niv: which had the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. This ark contained the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
