chapters.nkjv: which had the golden censer and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which were the golden pot that had the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
chapters.kjv: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

chapters.ml: അതിന്നു മിതെ കൃപാസനത്തെ മൂടുന്ന തേജസ്സിന്റെ കെരൂബുകളും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അതു ഇപ്പോൾ ഓരോന്നായി വിവരിപ്പാൻ കഴിവില്ല.
chapters.niv: Above the ark were the cherubim of the Glory, overshadowing the atonement cover. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
chapters.nkjv: and above it were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat. Of these things we cannot now speak in detail.
chapters.kjv: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

chapters.ml: ഇവ ഇങ്ങനെ തീർന്ന ശേഷം പുരോഹിതന്മാർ നിത്യം മുൻകൂടാരത്തിൽ ചെന്നു ശുശ്രൂഷ കഴിക്കും.
chapters.niv: When everything had been arranged like this, the priests entered regularly into the outer room to carry on their ministry.
chapters.nkjv: Now when these things had been thus prepared, the priests always went into the first part of the tabernacle, performing the services.
chapters.kjv: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God .

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തേതിലോ ആണ്ടിൽ ഒരിക്കൽ മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ മാത്രം ചെല്ലും; രക്തം കൂടാതെ അല്ല; അതു അവൻ തന്റെയും ജനത്തിന്റെയും അബദ്ധങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി അർപ്പിക്കും.
chapters.niv: But only the high priest entered the inner room, and that only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
chapters.nkjv: But into the second part the high priest went alone once a year, not without blood, which he offered for himself and for the people’s sins committed in ignorance;
chapters.kjv: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

chapters.ml: മുങ്കൂടാരം നില്ക്കുന്നേടത്തോളം വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലേക്കുള്ള വഴി വെളിപ്പെട്ടില്ല എന്നു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവു ഇതിനാൽ സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Holy Spirit was showing by this that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still functioning.
chapters.nkjv: the Holy Spirit indicating this, that the way into the Holiest of All was not yet made manifest while the first tabernacle was still standing.
chapters.kjv: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

chapters.ml: ആ കൂടാരം ഈ കാലത്തേക്കു ഒരു സാദൃശ്യമത്രേ. അതിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം ആരാധനക്കാരന്നു മനസ്സാക്ഷിയിൽ പൂർണ്ണ സമാധാനം വരുത്തുവാൻ കഴിയാത്ത വഴിപാടും യാഗവും അർപ്പിച്ചു പോരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: This is an illustration for the present time, indicating that the gifts and sacrifices being offered were not able to clear the conscience of the worshiper.
chapters.nkjv: It was symbolic for the present time in which both gifts and sacrifices are offered which cannot make him who performed the service perfect in regard to the conscience—
chapters.kjv: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

chapters.ml: അവ ഭക്ഷ്യങ്ങൾ, പാനീയങ്ങൾ, വിവിധ സ്നാനങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയോടു കൂടെ ഗുണീകരണകാലത്തോളം ചുമത്തിയിരുന്ന ജഡികനിയമങ്ങളത്രേ.
chapters.niv: They are only a matter of food and drink and various ceremonial washings—external regulations applying until the time of the new order.
chapters.nkjv: concerned only with foods and drinks, various washings, and fleshly ordinances imposed until the time of reformation.
chapters.kjv: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തുവോ വരുവാനുള്ള നന്മകളുടെ മഹാപുരോഹിതനായി വന്നിട്ടു: കൈപ്പണിയല്ലാത്തതായി എന്നുവെച്ചാൽ ഈ സൃഷ്ടിയിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടാത്തതായി വലിപ്പവും തികവുമേറിയ
chapters.niv: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that are now already here, he went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made with human hands, that is to say, is not a part of this creation.
chapters.nkjv: But Christ came as High Priest of the good things to come, with the greater and more perfect tabernacle not made with hands, that is, not of this creation.
chapters.kjv: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

chapters.ml: ഒരു കൂടാരത്തിൽകൂടി ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരുടെയും പശുക്കിടാക്കളുടെയും രക്തത്താലല്ല, സ്വന്ത രക്തത്താൽ തന്നേ ഒരിക്കലായിട്ടു വിശുദ്ധ മന്ദിരത്തിൽ പ്രവേശിച്ചു എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളോരു വീണ്ടെടുപ്പു സാധിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption.
chapters.nkjv: Not with the blood of goats and calves, but with His own blood He entered the Most Holy Place once for all, having obtained eternal redemption.
chapters.kjv: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us .

chapters.ml: ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരുടെയും കാളകളുടെയും രക്തവും മലിനപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ മേൽ തളിക്കുന്ന പശുഭസ്മവും
chapters.niv: The blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that they are outwardly clean.
chapters.nkjv: For if the blood of bulls and goats and the ashes of a heifer, sprinkling the unclean, sanctifies for the purifying of the flesh,
chapters.kjv: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

chapters.ml: ജഡികശുദ്ധി വരുത്തുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിത്യാത്മാവിനാൽ ദൈവത്തിന്നു തന്നെത്താൻ നിഷ്കളങ്കനായി അർപ്പിച്ച ക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ രക്തം ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തെ ആരാധിപ്പാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ മനസ്സാക്ഷിയെ നിർജ്ജീവപ്രവൃത്തികളെ പോക്കി എത്ര അധികം ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കും?
chapters.niv: How much more, then, will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God, cleanse our consciences from acts that lead to death, so that we may serve the living God!
chapters.nkjv: how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself without spot to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
chapters.kjv: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

chapters.ml: അതുനിമിത്തം ആദ്യനിയമത്തിലെ ലംഘനങ്ങളിൽനിന്നുള്ള വീണ്ടെടുപ്പിന്നായി ഒരു മരണം ഉണ്ടായിട്ടു നിത്യാവകാശത്തിന്റെ വാഗ്ദത്തം വിളിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർക്കു ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ പുതിയ നിയമത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യസ്ഥൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For this reason Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance—now that he has died as a ransom to set them free from the sins committed under the first covenant.
chapters.nkjv: And for this reason He is the Mediator of the new covenant, by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions under the first covenant, that those who are called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
chapters.kjv: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

chapters.ml: നിയമം ഉള്ളേടത്തു നിയമകർത്താവിന്റെ മരണം തെളിവാൻ ആവശ്യം.
chapters.niv: In the case of a will, it is necessary to prove the death of the one who made it,
chapters.nkjv: For where there is a testament, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
chapters.kjv: For where a testament is , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചശേഷമല്ലോ നിയമം സ്ഥിരമാകുന്നതു; നിയമകർത്താവിന്റെ ജീവകാലത്തോളം അതിന്നു ഉറപ്പില്ല.
chapters.niv: because a will is in force only when somebody has died; it never takes effect while the one who made it is living.
chapters.nkjv: For a testament is in force after men are dead, since it has no power at all while the testator lives.
chapters.kjv: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ആദ്യനിയമവും രക്തം കൂടാതെ പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ചതല്ല.
chapters.niv: This is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore not even the first covenant was dedicated without blood.
chapters.kjv: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

chapters.ml: മോശെ ന്യായപ്രമാണപ്രകാരം കല്പന ഒക്കെയും സകലജനത്തോടും പ്രസ്താവിച്ച ശേഷം പശുക്കിടാക്കളുടെയും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരുടെയും രക്തത്തെ വെള്ളവും ചുവന്ന ആട്ടുരോമവും ഈസോപ്പുമായി എടുത്തു പുസ്തകത്തിന്മേലും സകലജനത്തിന്മേലും തളിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: When Moses had proclaimed every command of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves, together with water, scarlet wool and branches of hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people.
chapters.nkjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and goats, with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
chapters.kjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

chapters.ml: “ഇതു ദൈവം നിങ്ങളോടു കല്പിച്ച നിയമത്തിന്റെ രക്തം” എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: He said, "This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you."
chapters.kjv: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അവൻ കൂടാരത്തിന്മേലും ആരാധനെക്കുള്ള ഉപകരണങ്ങളിന്മേലും എല്ലാം രക്തം തളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: In the same way, he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle and everything used in its ceremonies.
chapters.nkjv: Then likewise he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry.
chapters.kjv: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

chapters.ml: ന്യായപ്രമാണപ്രകാരം ഏകദേശം സകലവും രക്തത്താൽ ശുദ്ധീകരിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു; രക്തം ചൊരിഞ്ഞിട്ടല്ലാതെ വിമോചനമില്ല.
chapters.niv: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
chapters.nkjv: And according to the law almost all things are purified with blood, and without shedding of blood there is no remission.
chapters.kjv: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലുള്ളവയുടെ പ്രതിബിംബങ്ങളെ ഈവകയാൽ ശുദ്ധമാക്കുന്നതു ആവശ്യം. സ്വർഗ്ഗീയമായവെക്കോ ഇവയെക്കാൾ നല്ല യാഗങ്ങൾ ആവശ്യം.
chapters.niv: It was necessary, then, for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore itwas necessary that the copies of the things in the heavens should be purified with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
chapters.kjv: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തു വാസ്തവമായതിന്റെ പ്രതിബിംബമായി കൈപ്പണിയായ വിശുദ്ധ മന്ദിരത്തിലേക്കല്ല, ഇപ്പോൾ നമുക്കു വേണ്ടി ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷനാവാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കത്രേ പ്രവേശിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: For Christ did not enter a sanctuary made with human hands that was only a copy of the true one; he entered heaven itself, now to appear for us in God’s presence.
chapters.nkjv: For Christ has not entered the holy places made with hands, whichare copies of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
chapters.kjv: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ ആണ്ടുതോറും അന്യരക്തത്തോടുകൂടെ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ അവൻ തന്നെത്താൻ കൂടെക്കൂടെ അർപ്പിപ്പാൻ ആവശ്യമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Nor did he enter heaven to offer himself again and again, the way the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.
chapters.nkjv: not that He should offer Himself often, as the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood of another—
chapters.kjv: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെയായാൽ ലോകസ്ഥാപനം മുതല്ക്കു അവൻ പലപ്പോഴും കഷ്ടമനുഭവിക്കേണ്ടിയിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ അവൻ ലോകാവസാനത്തിൽ സ്വന്ത യാഗംകൊണ്ടു പാപപരിഹാരം വരുത്തുവാൻ ഒരിക്കൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷനായി.
chapters.niv: Otherwise Christ would have had to suffer many times since the creation of the world. But he has appeared once for all at the culmination of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of himself.
chapters.nkjv: He then would have had to suffer often since the foundation of the world; but now, once at the end of the ages, He has appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
chapters.kjv: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

chapters.ml: ഒരിക്കൽ മരിക്കയും പിന്നെ ന്യായവിധിയും മനുഷ്യർക്കു നിയമിച്ചിരിക്കയാൽ
chapters.niv: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,
chapters.nkjv: And as it is appointed for men to die once, but after this the judgment,
chapters.kjv: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

chapters.ml: ക്രിസ്തുവും അങ്ങനെ തന്നേ അനേകരുടെ പാപങ്ങളെ ചുമപ്പാൻ ഒരിക്കൽ അർപ്പിക്കപ്പെട്ടു തനിക്കായി കാത്തുനില്ക്കുന്നവരുടെ രക്ഷെക്കായി അവൻ പാപം കൂടാതെ രണ്ടാമതു പ്രത്യക്ഷനാകും.
chapters.niv: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.
chapters.nkjv: so Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many. To those who eagerly wait for Him He will appear a second time, apart from sin, for salvation.
chapters.kjv: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

chapters.ml: ന്യായപ്രമാണം വരുവാനുള്ള നന്മകളുടെ നിഴലല്ലാതെ കാര്യങ്ങളുടെ സാക്ഷാൽ സ്വരൂപമല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു ആണ്ടുതോറും ഇടവിടാതെ കഴിച്ചുവരുന്ന അതേ യാഗങ്ങളാൽ അടുത്തുവരുന്നവർക്കു സൽഗുണപൂർത്തി വരുത്തുവാൻ ഒരുനാളും കഴിവുള്ളതല്ല.
chapters.niv: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming—not the realities themselves. For this reason it can never, by the same sacrifices repeated endlessly year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
chapters.nkjv: For the law, having a shadow of the good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with these same sacrifices, which they offer continually year by year, make those who approach perfect.
chapters.kjv: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

chapters.ml: അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ആരാധനക്കാർക്കു ഒരിക്കൽ ശുദ്ധിവന്നതിന്റെ ശേഷം പാപങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള മനോബോധം പിന്നെ ഇല്ലായ്കകൊണ്ടു യാഗം കഴിക്കുന്നതു നിന്നുപോകയില്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Otherwise, would they not have stopped being offered? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt guilty for their sins.
chapters.nkjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? For the worshipers, once purified, would have had no more consciousness of sins.
chapters.kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

chapters.ml: ഇപ്പോഴോ ആണ്ടുതോറും അവയാൽ പാപങ്ങളുടെ ഓർമ്മ ഉണ്ടാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins.
chapters.nkjv: But in those sacrificesthereis a reminder of sins every year.
chapters.kjv: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

chapters.ml: കാളകളുടെയും ആട്ടുകൊറ്റന്മാരുടെയും രക്തത്തിന്നു പാപങ്ങളെ നീക്കുവാൻ കഴിയുന്നതല്ല.
chapters.niv: It is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
chapters.nkjv: For itis not possible that the blood of bulls and goats could take away sins.
chapters.kjv: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ലോകത്തിൽ വരുമ്പോൾ: “ഹനനയാഗവും വഴിപാടും നീ ഇച്ഛിച്ചില്ല; എന്നാൽ ഒരു ശരീരം നീ എനിക്കു ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, he said: "Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you prepared for me;
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, when He came into the world, He said: "Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, But a body You have prepared for Me.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

chapters.ml: സർവ്വാംഗ ഹോമങ്ങളിലും പാപയാഗങ്ങളിലും നീ പ്രസാദിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: with burnt offerings and sin offerings you were not pleased.
chapters.nkjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin You had no pleasure.
chapters.kjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞു: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ വരുന്നു; പുസ്തകച്ചുരുളിൽ എന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു; ദൈവമേ, നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഞാൻ വരുന്നു” എന്നു അവൻ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then I said, ‘Here I am—it is written about me in the scroll— I have come to do your will, my God.’ "
chapters.nkjv: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come— In the volume of the book it is written of Me— To do Your will, O God.’ "
chapters.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

chapters.ml: ന്യായപ്രമാണപ്രകാരം കഴിച്ചുവരുന്ന യാഗങ്ങളും വഴിപാടും സർവ്വാംഗഹോമങ്ങളും പാപയാഗങ്ങളും നീ ഇച്ഛിച്ചില്ല അവയിൽ പ്രസാദിച്ചതുമില്ല എന്നിങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞശേഷം:
chapters.niv: First he said, "Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not desire, nor were you pleased with them"—though they were offered in accordance with the law.
chapters.nkjv: Previously saying, "Sacrifice and offering, burnt offerings, and offerings for sin You did not desire, nor had pleasure inthem" (which are offered according to the law),
chapters.kjv: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein ; which are offered by the law;

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, ഞാൻ നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്‍വാൻ വരുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു അവൻ രണ്ടാമത്തേതിനെ സ്ഥാപിപ്പാൻ ഒന്നാമത്തേതിനെ നീക്കിക്കളയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he said, "Here I am, I have come to do your will." He sets aside the first to establish the second.
chapters.nkjv: then He said, "Behold, I have come to do Your will, O God." He takes away the first that He may establish the second.
chapters.kjv: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

chapters.ml: ആ ഇഷ്ടത്തിൽ നാം യേശുക്രിസ്തു ഒരിക്കലായി കഴിച്ച ശരീരയാഗത്താൽ വിശുദ്ധീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And by that will, we have been made holy through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
chapters.nkjv: By that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once forall.
chapters.kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .

chapters.ml: ഏതു പുരോഹിതനും ദിവസേന ശുശ്രൂഷിച്ചും പാപങ്ങളെ പരിഹരിപ്പാൻ ഒരുനാളും കഴിയാത്ത അതേ യാഗങ്ങളെ കൂടക്കൂടെ കഴിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു നില്ക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Day after day every priest stands and performs his religious duties; again and again he offers the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
chapters.nkjv: And every priest stands ministering daily and offering repeatedly the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
chapters.kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

chapters.ml: യേശുവോ പാപങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി ഏകയാഗം കഴിച്ചിട്ടു എന്നേക്കും ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വലത്തു ഭാഗത്തു ഇരുന്നുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: But when this priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God,
chapters.nkjv: But this Man, after He had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down at the right hand of God,
chapters.kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

chapters.ml: തന്റെ ശത്രുക്കൾ തന്റെ പാദപീഠം ആകുവോളം കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: and since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool.
chapters.nkjv: from that time waiting till His enemies are made His footstool.
chapters.kjv: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

chapters.ml: ഏകയാഗത്താൽ അവൻ വിശുദ്ധീകരിക്കപ്പെടുന്നവർക്കു സദാകാലത്തേക്കും സൽഗുണപൂർത്തി വരുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.
chapters.nkjv: For by one offering He has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
chapters.kjv: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

chapters.ml: അതു പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവും നമുക്കു സാക്ഷീകരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First he says:
chapters.nkjv: But the Holy Spirit also witnesses to us; for after He had said before,
chapters.kjv: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

chapters.ml: “ഈ കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം ഞാൻ അവരോടു ചെയ്‍വാനിരിക്കുന്ന നിയമം ഇങ്ങനെയാകുന്നു: എന്റെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം അവരുടെ ഉള്ളിലാക്കി അവരുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങളിൽ എഴുതും എന്നു കർത്താവിന്റെ അരുളപ്പാടു” എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തശേഷം:
chapters.niv: "This is the covenant I will make with them after that time, says the Lord. I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds."
chapters.nkjv: "This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws into their hearts, and in their minds I will write them,"
chapters.kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

chapters.ml: “അവരുടെ പാപങ്ങളെയും അകൃത്യങ്ങളെയും ഞാൻ ഇനി ഓർക്കയുമില്ല” എന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then he adds: "Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more."
chapters.nkjv: thenHeadds, "Their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more."
chapters.kjv: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഇവയുടെ മോചനം ഉള്ളേടത്തു ഇനിമേൽ പാപങ്ങൾക്കു വേണ്ടി ഒരു യാഗവും ആവശ്യമില്ല.
chapters.niv: And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary.
chapters.nkjv: Now where there is remission of these, thereis no longer an offering for sin.
chapters.kjv: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു സഹോദരന്മാരേ, യേശു തന്റെ ദേഹം എന്ന തിരശ്ശീലയിൽകൂടി നമുക്കു പ്രതിഷ്ഠിച്ച ജീവനുള്ള പുതുവഴിയായി,
chapters.niv: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, brethren, having boldness to enter the Holiest by the blood of Jesus,
chapters.kjv: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

chapters.ml: തന്റെ രക്തത്താൽ വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രവേശനത്തിന്നു
chapters.niv: by a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,
chapters.nkjv: by a new and living way which He consecrated for us, through the veil, that is, His flesh,
chapters.kjv: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

chapters.ml: ധൈര്യവും ദൈവാലയത്തിന്മേൽ ഒരു മഹാപുരോഹിതനും നമുക്കുള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
chapters.nkjv: and having a High Priest over the house of God,
chapters.kjv: And having an high priest over the house of God;

chapters.ml: നാം ദുർമ്മനസ്സാക്ഷി നീങ്ങുമാറു ഹൃദയങ്ങളിൽ തളിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരും ശുദ്ധവെള്ളത്താൽ ശരീരം കഴുകപ്പെട്ടവരുമായി വിശ്വാസത്തിന്റെ പൂർണ്ണനിശ്ചയം പൂണ്ടു പരമാർത്ഥഹൃദയത്തോടെ അടുത്തു ചെല്ലുക.
chapters.niv: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart and with the full assurance that faith brings, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.
chapters.nkjv: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
chapters.kjv: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

chapters.ml: പ്രത്യാശയുടെ സ്വീകാരം നാം മുറുകെ പിടിച്ചുകൊൾക; വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തവൻ വിശ്വസ്തനല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.
chapters.nkjv: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.
chapters.kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

chapters.ml: ചിലർ ചെയ്യുന്നതുപോലെ നമ്മുടെ സഭായോഗങ്ങളെ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കാതെ തമ്മിൽ പ്രബോധിപ്പിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു സ്നേഹത്തിന്നും സൽപ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കും ഉത്സാഹം വർദ്ധിപ്പിപ്പാൻ അന്യോന്യം സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds,
chapters.nkjv: And let us consider one another in order to stir up love and good works,
chapters.kjv: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

chapters.ml: നാൾ സമീപിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കാണുംതോറും അതു അധികമധികമായി ചെയ്യേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: not giving up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another—and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
chapters.nkjv: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting oneanother, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
chapters.kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is ; but exhorting one another : and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

chapters.ml: സത്യത്തിന്റെ പരിജ്ഞാനം ലഭിച്ചശേഷം നാം മനഃപൂർവ്വം പാപം ചെയ്താൽ പാപങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി ഇനി ഒരു യാഗവും ശേഷിക്കാതെ
chapters.niv: If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left,
chapters.nkjv: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
chapters.kjv: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

chapters.ml: ന്യായവിധിക്കായി ഭയങ്കരമായോരു പ്രതീക്ഷയും എതിരികളെ ദഹിപ്പിപ്പാനുള്ള ക്രോധാഗ്നിയുമേയുള്ളു.
chapters.niv: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume the enemies of God.
chapters.nkjv: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and fiery indignation which will devour the adversaries.
chapters.kjv: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

chapters.ml: മോശെയുടെ ന്യായപ്രമാണം അനുസരിക്കാത്തവന്നു കരുണ കൂടാതെ രണ്ടു മൂന്നു സാക്ഷികളുടെ വാമൊഴികേട്ടു മരണശിക്ഷ കല്പിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
chapters.nkjv: Anyone who has rejected Moses’ law dies without mercy on thetestimonyof two or three witnesses.
chapters.kjv: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

chapters.ml: ദൈവപുത്രനെ ചവിട്ടികളകയും തന്നെ വിശുദ്ധീകരിച്ച നിയമരക്തത്തെ മലിനം എന്നു നിരൂപിക്കയും കൃപയുടെ ആത്മാവിനെ നിന്ദിക്കയും ചെയ്തവൻ എത്ര കഠിനമേറിയ ശിക്ഷെക്കു പാത്രമാകും എന്നു വിചാരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: How much more severely do you think someone deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, who has treated as an unholy thing the blood of the covenant that sanctified them, and who has insulted the Spirit of grace?
chapters.nkjv: Of how much worse punishment, do you suppose, will he be thought worthy who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, counted the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified a common thing, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
chapters.kjv: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

chapters.ml: “പ്രതികാരം എനിക്കുള്ളതു, ഞാൻ പകരം വീട്ടും” എന്നും “കർത്താവു തന്റെ ജനത്തെ ന്യായം വിധിക്കും” എന്നും അരുളിച്ചെയ്തവനെ നാം അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: For we know him who said, "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," and again, "The Lord will judge his people."
chapters.nkjv: For we know Him who said, "Vengeance is Mine, I will repay," says the Lord. And again, "The Lord will judge His people."
chapters.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

chapters.ml: ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കയ്യിൽ വീഴുന്നതു ഭയങ്കരം.
chapters.niv: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
chapters.nkjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
chapters.kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ പ്രകാശനം ലഭിച്ചശേഷം നിന്ദകളാലും പീഡകളാലും കൂത്തുകാഴ്ചയായി ഭവിച്ചും
chapters.niv: Remember those earlier days after you had received the light, when you endured in a great conflict full of suffering.
chapters.nkjv: But recall the former days in which, after you were illuminated, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
chapters.kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

chapters.ml: ആ വക അനുഭവിക്കുന്നവർക്കു കൂട്ടാളികളായിത്തീർന്നും ഇങ്ങനെ കഷ്ടങ്ങളാൽ വളരെ പോരാട്ടം കഴിച്ച പൂർവ്വകാലം ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to insult and persecution; at other times you stood side by side with those who were so treated.
chapters.nkjv: partly while you were made a spectacle both by reproaches and tribulations, and partly while you became companions of those who were so treated;
chapters.kjv: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

chapters.ml: തടവുകാരോടു നിങ്ങൾ സഹതാപം കാണിച്ചതല്ലാതെ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിലനില്ക്കുന്ന ഉത്തമസമ്പത്തു നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉണ്ടു എന്നറിഞ്ഞു സമ്പത്തുകളുടെ അപഹാരവും സന്തോഷത്തോടെ സഹിച്ചുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: You suffered along with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, because you knew that you yourselves had better and lasting possessions.
chapters.nkjv: for you had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your goods, knowing that you have a better and an enduring possession for yourselves in heaven.
chapters.kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു മഹാ പ്രതിഫലമുള്ള നിങ്ങളുടെ ധൈര്യം തള്ളിക്കളയരുതു.
chapters.niv: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore do not cast away your confidence, which has great reward.
chapters.kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

chapters.ml: ദൈവേഷ്ടം ചെയ്തു വാഗ്ദത്തം പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ സഹിഷ്ണത നിങ്ങൾക്കു ആവശ്യം.
chapters.niv: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.
chapters.nkjv: For you have need of endurance, so that after you have done the will of God, you may receive the promise:
chapters.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

chapters.ml: “ഇനി എത്രയും അല്പകാലം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടു വരുവാനുള്ളവൻ വരും താമസിക്കയുമില്ല;”
chapters.niv: For, "In just a little while, he who is coming will come and will not delay."
chapters.nkjv: "For yet a little while, And He who is coming will come and will not tarry.
chapters.kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ “എന്റെ നീതിമാൻ വിശ്വാസത്താൽ ജീവിക്കും; പിൻമാറുന്നു എങ്കിൽ എന്റെ ഉള്ളത്തിന്നു അവനിൽ പ്രസാദമില്ല”.
chapters.niv: And, "But my righteous one will live by faith. And I take no pleasure in the one who shrinks back."
chapters.nkjv: Now the just shall live by faith; But if anyone draws back, My soul has no pleasure in him."
chapters.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

chapters.ml: നാമോ നാശത്തിലേക്കു പിന്മാറുന്നവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലല്ല, വിശ്വസിച്ചു ജീവരക്ഷ പ്രാപിക്കുന്നവരുടെ കൂട്ടത്തിലത്രേ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: But we do not belong to those who shrink back and are destroyed, but to those who have faith and are saved.
chapters.nkjv: But we are not of those who draw back to perdition, but of those who believe to the saving of the soul.
chapters.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസം എന്നതോ, ആശിക്കുന്നതിന്റെ ഉറപ്പും കാണാത്ത കാര്യങ്ങളുടെ നിശ്ചയവും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.
chapters.nkjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
chapters.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

chapters.ml: അതിനാലല്ലോ പൂർവ്വന്മാർക്കു സാക്ഷ്യം ലഭിച്ചതു.
chapters.niv: This is what the ancients were commended for.
chapters.nkjv: For by it the elders obtained a good testimony.
chapters.kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

chapters.ml: ഈ കാണുന്ന ലോകത്തിന്നു ദൃശ്യമായതല്ല കാരണം എന്നു വരുമാറു ലോകം ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനത്താൽ നിർമ്മിക്കപ്പെട്ടു എന്നു നാം വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
chapters.nkjv: By faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that the things which are seen were not made of things which are visible.
chapters.kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ ഹാബേൽ ദൈവത്തിന്നു കയീന്റേതിലും ഉത്തമമായ യാഗം കഴിച്ചു; അതിനാൽ അവന്നു നീതിമാൻ എന്ന സാക്ഷ്യം ലഭിച്ചു; ദൈവം അവന്റെ വഴിപാടിന്നു സാക്ഷ്യം കല്പിച്ചു. മരിച്ചശേഷവും അവൻ വിശ്വാസത്താൽ സംസാരിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By faith Abel brought God a better offering than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous, when God spoke well of his offerings. And by faith Abel still speaks, even though he is dead.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts; and through it he being dead still speaks.
chapters.kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ ഹനോക്ക് മരണം കാണാതെ എടുക്കപ്പെട്ടു; ദൈവം അവനെ എടുത്തുകൊണ്ടതിനാൽ കാണാതെയായി. അവൻ ദൈവത്തെ പ്രസാദിപ്പിച്ചു എന്നു അവൻ എടുക്കപ്പെട്ടതിന്നു മുമ്പെ സാക്ഷ്യം പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: By faith Enoch was taken from this life, so that he did not experience death: "He could not be found, because God had taken him away." For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Enoch was taken away so that he did not see death, "and was not found, because God had taken him"; for before he was taken he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
chapters.kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ വിശ്വാസം കൂടാതെ ദൈവത്തെ പ്രസാദിപ്പിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്നതല്ല; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കൽ വരുന്നവൻ ദൈവം ഉണ്ടു എന്നും തന്നെ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നവർക്കു പ്രതിഫലം കൊടുക്കുന്നു എന്നും വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.
chapters.nkjv: But without faith itis impossible to please Him, for he who comes to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.
chapters.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ നോഹ അതുവരെ കാണാത്തവയെക്കുറിച്ചു അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായിട്ടു ഭയഭക്തി പൂണ്ടു തന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിന്റെ രക്ഷക്കായിട്ടു ഒരു പെട്ടകം തീർത്തു; അതിനാൽ അവൻ ലോകത്തെ കുറ്റം വിധിച്ചു വിശ്വാസത്താലുള്ള നീതിക്കു അവകാശിയായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in holy fear built an ark to save his family. By his faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that is in keeping with faith.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Noah, being divinely warned of things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared an ark for the saving of his household, by which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
chapters.kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അബ്രഹാം തനിക്കു അവകാശമായി കിട്ടുവാനിരുന്ന ദേശത്തേക്കു യാത്രയാവാൻ വിളിക്കപ്പെട്ടാറെ അനുസരിച്ചു എവിടേക്കു പോകുന്നു എന്നറിയാതെ പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to the place which he would receive as an inheritance. And he went out, not knowing where he was going.
chapters.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അവൻ വാഗ്ദത്തദേശത്തു ഒരു അന്യദേശത്തു എന്നപോലെ ചെന്നു വാഗ്ദത്തത്തിന്നു കൂട്ടവകാശികളായ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനോടും യാക്കോബിനോടുംകൂടെ കൂടാരങ്ങളിൽ പാർത്തുകൊണ്ടു
chapters.niv: By faith he made his home in the promised land like a stranger in a foreign country; he lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
chapters.nkjv: By faith he dwelt in the land of promise as in a foreign country, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise;
chapters.kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

chapters.ml: ദൈവം ശില്പിയായി നിർമ്മിച്ചതും അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങളുള്ളതുമായ നഗരത്തിന്നായി കാത്തിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
chapters.nkjv: for he waited for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
chapters.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ സാറയും വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തവനെ വിശ്വസ്തൻ എന്നു എണ്ണുകയാൽ പ്രായം കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടും പുത്രോല്പാദനത്തിന്നു ശക്തി പ്രാപിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And by faith even Sarah, who was past childbearing age, was enabled to bear children because she considered him faithful who had made the promise.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Sarah herself also received strength to conceive seed, and she bore a child when she was past the age, because she judged Him faithful who had promised.
chapters.kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു ഒരുവന്നു, മൃതപ്രായനായവന്നു തന്നേ, പെരുപ്പത്തിൽ ആകാശത്തിലെ നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ പോലെയും കടല്പുറത്തെ എണ്ണിക്കൂടാത്ത മണൽപോലെയും സന്തതി ജനിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And so from this one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore from one man, and him as good as dead, were born asmany as the stars of the sky in multitude—innumerable as the sand which is by the seashore.
chapters.kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ എല്ലാവരും വാഗ്ദത്തനിവൃത്തി പ്രാപിക്കാതെ ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു അതു കണ്ടു അഭിവന്ദിച്ചും ഭൂമിയിൽ തങ്ങൾ അന്യരും പരദേശികളും എന്നു ഏറ്റുപറഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടു വിശ്വാസത്തിൽ മരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: All these people were still living by faith when they died. They did not receive the things promised; they only saw them and welcomed them from a distance, admitting that they were foreigners and strangers on earth.
chapters.nkjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off were assured of them, embraced them and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
chapters.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ പറയുന്നവർ ഒരു പിതൃദേശം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കാണിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: People who say such things show that they are looking for a country of their own.
chapters.nkjv: For those who say such things declare plainly that they seek a homeland.
chapters.kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

chapters.ml: അവർ വിട്ടുപോന്നതിനെ ഓർത്തു എങ്കിൽ മടങ്ങിപ്പോകുവാൻ ഇട ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
chapters.nkjv: And truly if they had called to mind that country from which they had come out, they would have had opportunity to return.
chapters.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

chapters.ml: അവരോ അധികം നല്ലതിനെ, സ്വർഗ്ഗീയമായതിനെ തന്നേ, കാംക്ഷിച്ചിരുന്നു; ആകയാൽ ദൈവം അവരുടെ ദൈവം എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടുവാൻ ലജ്ജിക്കുന്നില്ല; അവൻ അവർക്കായി ഒരു നഗരം ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Instead, they were longing for a better country—a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
chapters.nkjv: But now they desire a better, that is, a heavenly country. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
chapters.kjv: But now they desire a better country , that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അബ്രാഹാം താൻ പരീക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ യിസ്ഹാക്കിനെ യാഗം അർപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: By faith Abraham, when God tested him, offered Isaac as a sacrifice. He who had embraced the promises was about to sacrifice his one and only son,
chapters.nkjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac, and he who had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
chapters.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son ,

chapters.ml: യിസ്ഹാക്കിൽനിന്നു ജനിക്കുന്നവർ നിന്റെ സന്തതി എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടും എന്നു അരുളപ്പാടു ലഭിച്ചു വാഗ്ദത്തങ്ങളെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടവൻ തന്റെ ഏകജാതനെ അർപ്പിച്ചു;
chapters.niv: even though God had said to him, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."
chapters.nkjv: of whom it was said, "In Isaac your seed shall be called,"
chapters.kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു ഉയിർപ്പിപ്പാൻ ദൈവം ശക്തൻ എന്നു എണ്ണുകയും അവരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു എഴുന്നേറ്റവനെപ്പോലെ അവനെ തിരികെ പ്രാപിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: Abraham reasoned that God could even raise the dead, and so in a manner of speaking he did receive Isaac back from death.
chapters.nkjv: concluding that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead, from which he also received him in a figurative sense.
chapters.kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ യിസ്ഹാക്ക് യാക്കോബിനെയും ഏശാവിനെയും ഭാവികാലം സംബന്ധിച്ചു അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in regard to their future.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
chapters.kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ യാക്കോബ് മരണകാലത്തിങ്കൽ യോസേഫിന്റെ മക്കളെ ഇരുവരെയും അനുഗ്രഹിക്കയും തന്റെ വടിയുടെ അറ്റത്തു ചാരിക്കൊണ്ടു നമസ്കരിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons, and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
chapters.kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ യോസേഫ് താൻ മരിപ്പാറായപ്പോൾ യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ പുറപ്പാടിന്റെ കാര്യം ഓർപ്പിച്ചു, തന്റെ അസ്ഥികളെക്കുറിച്ചു കല്പനകൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt and gave instructions concerning the burial of his bones.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Joseph, when he was dying, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
chapters.kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ മോശെയുടെ ജനനത്തിങ്കൽ ശിശു സുന്ദരൻ എന്നു അമ്മയപ്പന്മാർ കണ്ടു: രാജാവിന്റെ കല്പന ഭയപ്പെടാതെ അവനെ മൂന്നു മാസം ഒളിപ്പിച്ചുവെച്ചു.
chapters.niv: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after he was born, because they saw he was no ordinary child, and they were not afraid of the king’s edict.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden three months by his parents, because they saw hewas a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s command.
chapters.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ മോശെ താൻ വളർന്നപ്പോൾ പാപത്തിന്റെ തൽക്കാലഭോഗത്തെക്കാളും ദൈവജനത്തോടു കൂടെ കഷ്ടമനുഭവിക്കുന്നതു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be known as the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
chapters.nkjv: By faith Moses, when he became of age, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
chapters.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;

chapters.ml: പ്രതിഫലം നോക്കിയതുകൊണ്ടു ഫറവോന്റെ പുത്രിയുടെ മകൻ എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടുന്നതു നിരസിക്കയും
chapters.niv: He chose to be mistreated along with the people of God rather than to enjoy the fleeting pleasures of sin.
chapters.nkjv: choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to enjoy the passing pleasures of sin,
chapters.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

chapters.ml: മിസ്രയീമിലെ നിക്ഷേപങ്ങളെക്കാൾ ക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ നിന്ദ വലിയ ധനം എന്നു എണ്ണുകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: He regarded disgrace for the sake of Christ as of greater value than the treasures of Egypt, because he was looking ahead to his reward.
chapters.nkjv: esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
chapters.kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അവൻ അദൃശ്യദൈവത്തെ കണ്ടതുപോലെ ഉറെച്ചുനിൽക്കയാൽ രാജാവിന്റെ കോപം ഭയപ്പെടാതെ മിസ്രയീം വിട്ടുപോന്നു.
chapters.niv: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw him who is invisible.
chapters.nkjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured as seeing Him who is invisible.
chapters.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അവൻ കടിഞ്ഞൂലുകളുടെ സംഹാരകൻ അവരെ തൊടാതിരിപ്പാൻ പെസഹയും ചോരത്തളിയും ആചരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: By faith he kept the Passover and the application of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch the firstborn of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, lest he who destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
chapters.kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അവർ കരയിൽ എന്നപോലെ ചെങ്കടലിൽ കൂടി കടന്നു; അതു മിസ്രയീമ്യർ ചെയ്‍വാൻ നോക്കീട്ടു മുങ്ങിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to do so, they were drowned.
chapters.nkjv: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as by dry land, whereas the Egyptians, attempting to do so, were drowned.
chapters.kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land : which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അവർ ഏഴു ദിവസം ചുറ്റിനടന്നപ്പോൾ യെരീഹോമതിൽ ഇടിഞ്ഞുവീണു.
chapters.niv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the army had marched around them for seven days.
chapters.nkjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they were encircled for seven days.
chapters.kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ റാഹാബ് എന്ന വേശ്യ ഒറ്റുകാരെ സമാധാനത്തോടെ കൈക്കൊണ്ടു അവിശ്വാസികളോടുകൂടെ നശിക്കാതിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies, was not killed with those who were disobedient.
chapters.nkjv: By faith the harlot Rahab did not perish with those who did not believe, when she had received the spies with peace.
chapters.kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

chapters.ml: ഇനി എന്തുപറയേണ്ടു? ഗിദ്യോൻ, ബാരാക്ക്, ശിംശോൻ, യിപ്താഹ്, ദാവീദ് എന്നവരെയും ശമൂവേൽ മുതലായ പ്രവാചകന്മാരെയും കുറിച്ചു വിവരിപ്പാൻ സമയം പോരാ.
chapters.niv: And what more shall I say? I do not have time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson and Jephthah, about David and Samuel and the prophets,
chapters.nkjv: And what more shall I say? For the time would fail me to tell of Gideon and Barak and Samson and Jephthah, also of David and Samuel and the prophets:
chapters.kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്താൽ അവർ രാജ്യങ്ങളെ അടക്കി, നീതി നടത്തി, വാഗ്ദത്തം പ്രാപിച്ചു, സിംഹങ്ങളുടെ വായ് അടെച്ചു
chapters.niv: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,
chapters.nkjv: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
chapters.kjv: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

chapters.ml: തീയുടെ ബലം കെടുത്തു, വാളിന്റെ വായക്കു തെറ്റി, ബലഹീനതയിൽ ശക്തി പ്രാപിച്ചു, യുദ്ധത്തിൽ വീരന്മാരായിതീർന്നു, അന്യന്മാരുടെ സൈന്യങ്ങളെ ഓടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: quenched the fury of the flames, and escaped the edge of the sword; whose weakness was turned to strength; and who became powerful in battle and routed foreign armies.
chapters.nkjv: quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, became valiant in battle, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
chapters.kjv: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീകൾക്കു തങ്ങളുടെ മരിച്ചവരെ ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പിനാൽ തിരികെ കിട്ടി; മറ്റു ചിലർ ഏറ്റവും നല്ലൊരു ഉയിർത്തെഴുന്നേല്പു ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഉദ്ധാരണം കൈക്കൊള്ളാതെ ഭേദ്യം ഏറ്റു.
chapters.niv: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. There were others who were tortured, refusing to be released so that they might gain an even better resurrection.
chapters.nkjv: Women received their dead raised to life again. Others were tortured, not accepting deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
chapters.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

chapters.ml: വേറെ ചിലർ പരിഹാസം, ചമ്മട്ടി, ചങ്ങല, തടവു ഇവയാലുള്ള പരീക്ഷ അനുഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Some faced jeers and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
chapters.nkjv: Still others had trial of mockings and scourgings, yes, and of chains and imprisonment.
chapters.kjv: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

chapters.ml: കല്ലേറു ഏറ്റു, ഈർച്ചവാളാൽ അറുക്കപ്പെട്ടു, പരീക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ടു, വാളാൽ കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ടു, ജടയാടുകളുടെയും കോലാടുകളുടേയും തോൽ ധരിച്ചു, ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടും ഉപദ്രവവും കഷ്ടവും സഹിച്ചു,
chapters.niv: They were put to death by stoning; they were sawed in two; they were killed by the sword. They went about in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, persecuted and mistreated—
chapters.nkjv: They were stoned, they were sawn in two, were tempted, were slain with the sword. They wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented—
chapters.kjv: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

chapters.ml: കാടുകളിലും മലകളിലും ഗുഹകളിലും ഭൂമിയുടെ പിളർപ്പുകളിലും ഉഴന്നു വലഞ്ഞു; ലോകം അവർക്കു യോഗ്യമായിരുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: the world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, living in caves and in holes in the ground.
chapters.nkjv: of whom the world was not worthy. They wandered in deserts and mountains, in dens and caves of the earth.
chapters.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

chapters.ml: അവർ എല്ലാവരും വിശ്വാസത്താൽ സാക്ഷ്യം ലഭിച്ചിട്ടും വാഗ്ദത്തനിവൃത്തി പ്രാപിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: These were all commended for their faith, yet none of them received what had been promised,
chapters.nkjv: And all these, having obtained a good testimony through faith, did not receive the promise,
chapters.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

chapters.ml: അവർ നമ്മെ കൂടാതെ രക്ഷാപൂർത്തി പ്രാപിക്കാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവം നമുക്കു വേണ്ടി ഏറ്റവും നല്ലതൊന്നു മുൻകരുതിയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: since God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.
chapters.nkjv: God having provided something better for us, that they should not be made perfect apart from us.
chapters.kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നാമും സാക്ഷികളുടെ ഇത്ര വലിയോരു സമൂഹം നമുക്കു ചുറ്റും നില്ക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു സകല ഭാരവും മുറുകെ പറ്റുന്ന പാപവും വിട്ടു നമുക്കു മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഓട്ടം സ്ഥിരതയോടെ ഓടുക.
chapters.niv: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which so easily ensnares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

chapters.ml: വിശ്വാസത്തിന്റെ നായകനും പൂർത്തിവരുത്തുന്നവനുമായ യേശുവിനെ നോക്കുക; തന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വെച്ചിരുന്ന സന്തോഷം ഓർത്തു അവൻ അപമാനം അലക്ഷ്യമാക്കി ക്രൂശിനെ സഹിക്കയും ദൈവസിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ വലത്തുഭാഗത്തു ഇരിക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
chapters.nkjv: looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
chapters.kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉള്ളിൽ ക്ഷീണിച്ചു മടുക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ പാപികളാൽ തനിക്കു നേരിട്ട ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള വിരോധം സഹിച്ചവനെ ധ്യാനിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Consider him who endured such opposition from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
chapters.nkjv: For consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners against Himself, lest you become weary and discouraged in your souls.
chapters.kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

chapters.ml: പാപത്തോടു പോരാടുന്നതിൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഇതുവരെ പ്രാണത്യാഗത്തോളം എതിർത്തു നിന്നിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
chapters.nkjv: You have not yet resisted to bloodshed, striving against sin.
chapters.kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

chapters.ml: “മകനേ, കർത്താവിന്റെ ശിക്ഷ നിരസിക്കരുതു; അവൻ ശാസിക്കുമ്പോൾ മുഷികയുമരുതു.
chapters.niv: And have you completely forgotten this word of encouragement that addresses you as a father addresses his son? It says, "My son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline, and do not lose heart when he rebukes you,
chapters.nkjv: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks to you as to sons: "My son, do not despise the chastening of the Lord, Nor be discouraged when you are rebuked by Him;
chapters.kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

chapters.ml: കർത്താവു താൻ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവനെ ശിക്ഷിക്കുന്നു; താൻ കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്ന ഏതു മകനെയും തല്ലുന്നു” എന്നിങ്ങനെ മക്കളോടു എന്നപോലെ നിങ്ങളോടു സംവാദിക്കുന്ന പ്രബോധനം നിങ്ങൾ മറന്നുകളഞ്ഞുവോ?
chapters.niv: because the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and he chastens everyone he accepts as his son."
chapters.nkjv: For whom the Lord loves He chastens, And scourges every son whom He receives."
chapters.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ബാലശിക്ഷ സഹിച്ചാൽ ദൈവം മക്കളോടു എന്നപോലെ നിങ്ങളോടു പെരുമാറുന്നു; അപ്പൻ ശിക്ഷിക്കാത്ത മകൻ എവിടെയുള്ളു?
chapters.niv: Endure hardship as discipline; God is treating you as his children. For what children are not disciplined by their father?
chapters.nkjv: If you endure chastening, God deals with you as with sons; for what son is there whom a father does not chasten?
chapters.kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരും പ്രാപിക്കുന്ന ബാലശിക്ഷ കൂടാതിരിക്കുന്നു എങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ മക്കളല്ല കൌലടേയന്മാരത്രേ.
chapters.niv: If you are not disciplined—and everyone undergoes discipline—then you are not legitimate, not true sons and daughters at all.
chapters.nkjv: But if you are without chastening, of which all have become partakers, then you are illegitimate and not sons.
chapters.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ജഡസംബന്ധമായ പിതാക്കന്മാർ നമ്മെ ശിക്ഷിച്ചപ്പോൾ നാം അവരെ വണങ്ങിപ്പോന്നുവല്ലോ; ആത്മാക്കളുടെ പിതാവിന്നു ഏറ്റവും അധികമായി കീഴടങ്ങി ജീവിക്കേണ്ടതല്ലയോ?
chapters.niv: Moreover, we have all had human fathers who disciplined us and we respected them for it. How much more should we submit to the Father of spirits and live!
chapters.nkjv: Furthermore, we have had human fathers who corrected us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much more readily be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
chapters.kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us , and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

chapters.ml: അവർ ശിക്ഷിച്ചതു കുറെക്കാലവും തങ്ങൾക്കു ബോധിച്ചപ്രകാരവുമത്രേ; അവനോ, നാം അവന്റെ വിശുദ്ധി പ്രാപിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നമ്മുടെ ഗുണത്തിന്നായി തന്നേ ശിക്ഷിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: They disciplined us for a little while as they thought best; but God disciplines us for our good, in order that we may share in his holiness.
chapters.nkjv: For they indeed for a few days chastened us as seemed best to them, but He for our profit, that we may be partakers of His holiness.
chapters.kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

chapters.ml: ഏതു ശിക്ഷയും തൽക്കാലം സന്തോഷകരമല്ല ദുഃഖകരമത്രേ എന്നു തോന്നും; പിന്നത്തേതിലോ അതിനാൽ അഭ്യാസം വന്നവർക്കു നീതി എന്ന സമാധാന ഫലം ലഭിക്കും.
chapters.niv: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.
chapters.nkjv: Now no chastening seems to be joyful for the present, but painful; nevertheless, afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
chapters.kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ തളർന്ന കയ്യും കുഴഞ്ഞ മുഴങ്കാലും നിവിർത്തുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Therefore, strengthen your feeble arms and weak knees.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore strengthen the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees,
chapters.kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

chapters.ml: മുടന്തുള്ളതു ഉളുക്കിപ്പോകാതെ ഭേദമാകേണ്ടതിന്നു നിങ്ങളുടെ കാലിന്നു പാത നിരത്തുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Make level paths for your feet," so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.
chapters.nkjv: and make straight paths for your feet, so that what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
chapters.kjv: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

chapters.ml: എല്ലാവരോടും സമാധാനം ആചരിച്ചു ശുദ്ധീകരണം പ്രാപിപ്പാൻ ഉത്സാഹിപ്പിൻ. ശുദ്ധീകരണം കൂടാതെ ആരും കർത്താവിനെ കാണുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Make every effort to live in peace with everyone and to be holy; without holiness no one will see the Lord.
chapters.nkjv: Pursue peace with all people, and holiness, without which no one will see the Lord:
chapters.kjv: Follow peace with all men , and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

chapters.ml: ആരും ദൈവകൃപ വിട്ടു പിൻമാറുകയും വല്ല കൈപ്പുള്ള വേരും മുളെച്ചു കലക്കമുണ്ടാക്കി അനേകർ അതിനാൽ മലിനപ്പെടുകയും ആരും ദുർന്നടപ്പുകാരനോ,
chapters.niv: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God and that no bitter root grows up to cause trouble and defile many.
chapters.nkjv: looking carefully lest anyone fall short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up cause trouble, and by this many become defiled;
chapters.kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled;

chapters.ml: ഒരു ഊണിന്നു ജ്യേഷ്ഠാവകാശം വിറ്റുകളഞ്ഞ ഏശാവിനെപ്പോലെ അഭക്തനോ ആയിത്തീരുകയും ചെയ്യാതിരിപ്പാൻ കരുതിക്കൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: See that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son.
chapters.nkjv: lest there be any fornicator or profane person like Esau, who for one morsel of food sold his birthright.
chapters.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിന്നത്തേതിൽ അനുഗ്രഹം ലഭിപ്പാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു കണ്ണുനീരോടുകൂടെ അപേക്ഷിച്ചിട്ടും തള്ളപ്പെട്ടു മാനസാന്തരത്തിന്നു ഇട കണ്ടില്ല എന്നു നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Afterward, as you know, when he wanted to inherit this blessing, he was rejected. Even though he sought the blessing with tears, he could not change what he had done.
chapters.nkjv: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, though he sought it diligently with tears.
chapters.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

chapters.ml: സ്ഥൂലമായതും തീ കത്തുന്നതുമായ പർവ്വതത്തിന്നും മേഘതമസ്സ്, കൂരിരുട്ടു, കൊടുങ്കാറ്റു, കാഹളനാദം, വാക്കുകളുടെ ശബ്ദം എന്നിവെക്കും അടുക്കൽ അല്ലല്ലോ നിങ്ങൾ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: You have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom and storm;
chapters.nkjv: For you have not come to the mountain that may be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness and darkness and tempest,
chapters.kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

chapters.ml: ആ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടവർ ഇനി ഒരു വചനവും തങ്ങളോടു പറയരുതേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: to a trumpet blast or to such a voice speaking words that those who heard it begged that no further word be spoken to them,
chapters.nkjv: and the sound of a trumpet and the voice of words, so that those who heard it begged that the word should not be spoken to them anymore.
chapters.kjv: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

chapters.ml: ഒരു മൃഗം എങ്കിലും പർവ്വതം തൊട്ടാൽ അതിനെ കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു കൊല്ലേണം എന്നുള്ള കല്പന അവർക്കു സഹിച്ചുകൂടാഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: because they could not bear what was commanded: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death."
chapters.nkjv: (For they could not endure what was commanded: "And if so much as a beast touches the mountain, it shall be stoned or shot with an arrow."
chapters.kjv: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അത്യന്തം പേടിച്ചു വിറെക്കുന്നു എന്നു മോശെയും പറയത്തക്കവണ്ണം ആ കാഴ്ച ഭയങ്കരമായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, "I am trembling with fear."
chapters.nkjv: And so terrifying was the sight that Moses said, "I am exceedingly afraid and trembling.")
chapters.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

chapters.ml: പിന്നെയോ സീയോൻ പർവ്വതത്തിന്നും ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നഗരമായ സ്വർഗ്ഗീയയെരൂശലേമിന്നും അനേകായിരം ദൂതന്മാരുടെ സർവ്വസംഘത്തിന്നും സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ പേരെഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന
chapters.niv: But you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to thousands upon thousands of angels in joyful assembly,
chapters.nkjv: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, to an innumerable company of angels,
chapters.kjv: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

chapters.ml: ആദ്യജാതന്മാരുടെ സഭെക്കും എല്ലാവരുടെയും ദൈവമായ ന്യായാധിപതിക്കും സിദ്ധന്മാരായ നീതിമാന്മാരുടെ ആത്മാക്കൾക്കും
chapters.niv: to the church of the firstborn, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
chapters.nkjv: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn whoare registered in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
chapters.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

chapters.ml: പുതുനിയമത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യസ്ഥനായ യേശുവിന്നും ഹാബെലിന്റെ രക്തത്തെക്കാൾ ഗുണകരമായി സംസാരിക്കുന്ന പുണ്യാഹരക്തത്തിന്നും അടുക്കലത്രേ നിങ്ങൾ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
chapters.nkjv: to Jesus the Mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better things than thatof Abel.
chapters.kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

chapters.ml: അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നവനെ നിരസിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ നോക്കുവിൻ. ഭൂമിയിൽ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തവനെ നിരസിച്ചവർ തെറ്റി ഒഴിയാതിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നവനെ നാം വിട്ടുമാറിയാൽ എത്ര അധികം.
chapters.niv: See to it that you do not refuse him who speaks. If they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, how much less will we, if we turn away from him who warns us from heaven?
chapters.nkjv: See that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if they did not escape who refused Him who spoke on earth, much more shallwenotescape if we turn away from Him who speaks from heaven,
chapters.kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape , if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം അന്നു ഭൂമിയെ ഇളക്കി; ഇപ്പോഴോ “ഞാൻ ഇനി ഒരിക്കൽ ഭൂമിയെ മാത്രമല്ല, ആകാശത്തെയും ഇളക്കും” എന്നു അവൻ വാഗ്ദത്തം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, "Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens."
chapters.nkjv: whose voice then shook the earth; but now He has promised, saying, "Yet once more I shake not only the earth, but also heaven."
chapters.kjv: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

chapters.ml: “ഇനി ഒരിക്കൽ” എന്നതു, ഇളക്കമില്ലാത്തതു നിലനിൽക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നിർമ്മിതമായ ഇളക്കമുള്ളതിന്നു മാറ്റം വരും എന്നു സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The words "once more" indicate the removing of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that what cannot be shaken may remain.
chapters.nkjv: Now this, "Yet once more," indicates the removal of those things that are being shaken, as of things that are made, that the things which cannot be shaken may remain.
chapters.kjv: And this word , Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ ഇളകാത്ത രാജ്യം പ്രാപിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നാം നന്ദിയുള്ളവരായി ദൈവത്തിന്നു പ്രസാദംവരുമാറു ഭക്തിയോടും ഭയത്തോടുകൂടെ സേവ ചെയ്ക.
chapters.niv: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe,
chapters.nkjv: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom which cannot be shaken, let us have grace, by which we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവം ദഹിപ്പിക്കുന്ന അഗ്നിയല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: for our "God is a consuming fire."
chapters.nkjv: For our God is a consuming fire.
chapters.kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.

chapters.ml: സഹോദരപ്രീതി നിലനിൽക്കട്ടെ, അതിഥിസൽക്കാരം മറക്കരുതു.
chapters.niv: Keep on loving one another as brothers and sisters.
chapters.nkjv: Let brotherly love continue.
chapters.kjv: Let brotherly love continue.

chapters.ml: അതിനാൽ ചിലർ അറിയാതെ ദൈവദൂതന്മാരെ സല്ക്കരിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have shown hospitality to angels without knowing it.
chapters.nkjv: Do not forget to entertain strangers, for by so doing some have unwittingly entertained angels.
chapters.kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളും തടവുകാർ എന്നപോലെ തടവുകാരെയും നിങ്ങളും ശരീരത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവരാകയാൽ കഷ്ടമനുഭവിക്കുന്നവരെയും ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Continue to remember those in prison as if you were together with them in prison, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.
chapters.nkjv: Remember the prisoners as if chained with them—those who are mistreated—since you yourselves are in the body also.
chapters.kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

chapters.ml: വിവാഹം എല്ലാവർക്കും മാന്യവും കിടക്ക നിർമ്മലവും ആയിരിക്കട്ടെ; എന്നാൽ ദുർന്നടപ്പുകാരെയും വ്യഭിചാരികളെയും ദൈവം വിധിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure, for God will judge the adulterer and all the sexually immoral.
chapters.nkjv: Marriage is honorable among all, and the bed undefiled; but fornicators and adulterers God will judge.
chapters.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ നടപ്പു ദ്രവ്യാഗ്രഹമില്ലാത്തതായിരിക്കട്ടെ; ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ടു തൃപ്തിപ്പെടുവിൻ; “ഞാൻ നിന്നെ ഒരുനാളും കൈ വിടുകയില്ല, ഉപേക്ഷിക്കയുമില്ല” എന്നു അവൻ തന്നെ അരുളിച്ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, "Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you."
chapters.nkjv: Letyour conduct be without covetousness; be content with such things as you have. For He Himself has said, "I will never leave you nor forsake you."
chapters.kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ “കർത്താവു എനിക്കു തുണ; ഞാൻ പേടിക്കയില്ല; മനുഷ്യൻ എന്നോടു എന്തു ചെയ്യും” എന്നു നമുക്കു ധൈര്യത്തോടെ പറയാം.
chapters.niv: So we say with confidence, "The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?"
chapters.nkjv: So we may boldly say: "The Lordis my helper; I will not fear. What can man do to me?"
chapters.kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോടു ദൈവവചനം പ്രസംഗിച്ചു നിങ്ങളെ നടത്തിയവരെ ഓർത്തുകൊൾവിൻ; അവരുടെ ജീവാവസാനം ഓർത്തു അവരുടെ വിശ്വാസം അനുകരിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
chapters.nkjv: Remember those who rule over you, who have spoken the word of God to you, whose faith follow, considering the outcome of their conduct.
chapters.kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

chapters.ml: യേശുക്രിസ്തു ഇന്നലെയും ഇന്നും എന്നെന്നേക്കും അനന്യൻ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
chapters.nkjv: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
chapters.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

chapters.ml: വിവിധവും അന്യവുമായ ഉപദേശങ്ങളാൽ ആരും നിങ്ങളെ വലിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുപോകരുതു; ആചരിച്ചുപോന്നവർക്കു പ്രയോജനമില്ലാത്ത ഭോജനനിയമങ്ങളാലല്ല, കൃപയാൽ തന്നേ ഹൃദയം ഉറപ്പിക്കുന്നതു നല്ലതു.
chapters.niv: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings. It is good for our hearts to be strengthened by grace, not by eating ceremonial foods, which is of no benefit to those who do so.
chapters.nkjv: Do not be carried about with various and strange doctrines. For itis good that the heart be established by grace, not with foods which have not profited those who have been occupied with them.
chapters.kjv: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

chapters.ml: കൂടാരത്തിൽ ശുശ്രൂഷിക്കുന്നവർക്കു അഹോവൃത്തി കഴിപ്പാൻ അവകാശമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു യാഗപീഠം നമുക്കുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: We have an altar from which those who minister at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
chapters.nkjv: We have an altar from which those who serve the tabernacle have no right to eat.
chapters.kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

chapters.ml: മഹാപുരോഹിതൻ പാപപരിഹാരമായി രക്തം വിശുദ്ധമന്ദിരത്തിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്ന മൃഗങ്ങളുടെ ഉടൽ പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തുവെച്ചു ചുട്ടുകളയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as a sin offering, but the bodies are burned outside the camp.
chapters.nkjv: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned outside the camp.
chapters.kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

chapters.ml: അങ്ങനെ യേശുവും സ്വന്തരക്തത്താൽ ജനത്തെ വിശുദ്ധീകരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നഗരവാതിലിന്നു പുറത്തുവെച്ചു കഷ്ടം അനുഭവിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy through his own blood.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore Jesus also, that He might sanctify the people with His own blood, suffered outside the gate.
chapters.kjv: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നാം അവന്റെ നിന്ദ ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടു പാളയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തു അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുക.
chapters.niv: Let us, then, go to him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace he bore.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore let us go forth to Him, outside the camp, bearing His reproach.
chapters.kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

chapters.ml: ഇവിടെ നമുക്കു നിലനില്ക്കുന്ന നഗരമില്ലല്ലോ, വരുവാനുള്ളതു അത്രേ നാം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതു.
chapters.niv: For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.
chapters.nkjv: For here we have no continuing city, but we seek the one to come.
chapters.kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
