chapters.nkjv: to execute judgment on all, to convict all who are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have committed in an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him."
chapters.kjv: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

chapters.ml: അവർ പിറുപിറുപ്പുകാരും തങ്ങളുടെ ഗതിയെക്കുറിച്ചു ആവലാധി പറയുന്നവരുമായി സ്വന്തമോഹങ്ങളെ അനുസരിച്ചു നടക്കുന്നു. അവരുടെ വായ് വമ്പുപറയുന്നു; കാര്യസാദ്ധ്യത്തിന്നായി അവർ മുഖസ്തുതി പ്രയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These people are grumblers and faultfinders; they follow their own evil desires; they boast about themselves and flatter others for their own advantage.
chapters.nkjv: These are grumblers, complainers, walking according to their own lusts; and they mouth great swelling words, flattering people to gain advantage.
chapters.kjv: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ, പ്രിയരേ, നമ്മുടെ കർത്താവായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ മുൻപറഞ്ഞ വാക്കുകളെ ഓർപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: But, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.
chapters.nkjv: But you, beloved, remember the words which were spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ:
chapters.kjv: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

chapters.ml: അന്ത്യകാലത്തു ഭക്തികെട്ട മോഹങ്ങളെ അനുസരിച്ചു നടക്കുന്ന പരിഹാസികൾ ഉണ്ടാകും എന്നു അവർ നിങ്ങളോടു പറഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: They said to you, "In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow their own ungodly desires."
chapters.nkjv: how they told you that there would be mockers in the last time who would walk according to their own ungodly lusts.
chapters.kjv: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഭിന്നത ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നവർ, പ്രാകൃതന്മാർ, ആത്മാവില്ലാത്തവർ.
chapters.niv: These are the people who divide you, who follow mere natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.
chapters.nkjv: These are sensual persons, who cause divisions, not having the Spirit.
chapters.kjv: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളോ, പ്രിയമുള്ളവരേ, നിങ്ങളുടെ അതിവിശുദ്ധ വിശ്വാസത്തെ ആധാരമാക്കി നിങ്ങൾക്കു തന്നേ ആത്മികവർദ്ധന വരുത്തിയും പരിശുദ്ധാത്മാവിൽ പ്രാർത്ഥിച്ചും നിത്യജീവന്നായിട്ടു
chapters.niv: But you, dear friends, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
chapters.nkjv: But you, beloved, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
chapters.kjv: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ കർത്താവായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ കരുണെക്കായി കാത്തിരുന്നുംകൊണ്ടു ദൈവസ്നേഹത്തിൽ നിങ്ങളെത്തന്നേ സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ.
chapters.niv: keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.
chapters.nkjv: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
chapters.kjv: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

chapters.ml: സംശയിക്കുന്നവരായ ചിലരോടു കരുണ ചെയ്‍വിൻ;
chapters.niv: Be merciful to those who doubt;
chapters.nkjv: And on some have compassion, making a distinction;
chapters.kjv: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

chapters.ml: ചിലരെ തീയിൽനിന്നു വലിച്ചെടുത്തു രക്ഷിപ്പിൻ; ജഡത്താൽ കറപിടിച്ച അങ്കിപോലും പകെച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ചിലർക്കു ഭയത്തോടെ കരുണ കാണിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: save others by snatching them from the fire; to others show mercy, mixed with fear—hating even the clothing stained by corrupted flesh.
chapters.nkjv: but others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire, hating even the garment defiled by the flesh.
chapters.kjv: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

chapters.ml: വീഴാതവണ്ണം നിങ്ങളെ സൂക്ഷിച്ചു, തന്റെ മഹിമാസന്നിധിയിൽ കളങ്കമില്ലാത്തവരായി ആനന്ദത്തോടെ നിറുത്തുവാൻ ശക്തിയുള്ളവന്നു,
chapters.niv: To him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy—
chapters.nkjv: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling, And to present you faultless Before the presence of His glory with exceeding joy,
chapters.kjv: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ കർത്താവായ യേശുക്രിസ്തുമുഖാന്തരം നമ്മുടെ രക്ഷിതാവായ ഏകദൈവത്തിന്നു തന്നേ, സർവ്വകാലത്തിന്നുമുമ്പും ഇപ്പോഴും സദാകാലത്തോളവും തേജസ്സും മഹിമയും ബലവും അധികാരവും ഉണ്ടാകുമാറാകട്ടെ. ആമേൻ.
chapters.niv: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.
chapters.nkjv: To God our Savior, Who alone is wise, Be glory and majesty, Dominion and power, Both now and forever. Amen.
chapters.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

chapters.ml: യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ വെളിപ്പാടു: വേഗത്തിൽ സംഭവിപ്പാനുള്ളതു തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരെ കാണിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവം അതു അവന്നു കൊടുത്തു. അവൻ അതു തന്റെ ദൂതൻ മുഖാന്തരം അയച്ചു തന്റെ ദാസനായ യോഹന്നാന്നു പ്രദർശിപ്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,
chapters.nkjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants—things which must shortly take place. And He sent and signified it by His angel to His servant John,
chapters.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനവും യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യവുമായി താൻ കണ്ടതു ഒക്കെയും സാക്ഷീകരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: who testifies to everything he saw—that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
chapters.nkjv: who bore witness to the word of God, and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, to all things that he saw.
chapters.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

chapters.ml: ഈ പ്രവചനത്തിന്റെ വാക്കുകളെ വായിച്ചു കേൾപ്പിക്കുന്നവനും കേൾക്കുന്നവരും അതിൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതു പ്രമാണിക്കുന്നവരും ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ; സമയം അടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near.
chapters.nkjv: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written in it; for the time is near.
chapters.kjv: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

chapters.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ ആസ്യയിലെ ഏഴു സഭകൾക്കും എഴുതുന്നതു: ഇരിക്കുന്നവനും ഇരുന്നവനും വരുന്നവനുമായവങ്കൽ നിന്നും അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിന്മുമ്പിലുള്ള ഏഴു ആത്മാക്കളുടെ പക്കൽനിന്നും
chapters.niv: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,
chapters.nkjv: John, to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from Him who is and who was and who is to come, and from the seven Spirits who are before His throne,
chapters.kjv: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

chapters.ml: വിശ്വസ്തസാക്ഷിയും മരിച്ചവരിൽ ആദ്യജാതനും ഭൂരാജാക്കന്മാർക്കു അധിപതിയും ആയ യേശുക്രിസ്തുവിങ്കൽ നിന്നും നിങ്ങൾക്കു കൃപയും സമാധാനവും ഉണ്ടാകട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,
chapters.nkjv: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler over the kings of the earth. To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood,
chapters.kjv: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

chapters.ml: നമ്മെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നവനും നമ്മുടെ പാപം പോക്കി നമ്മെ തന്റെ രക്തത്താൽ വിടുവിച്ചു തന്റെ പിതാവായ ദൈവത്തിന്നു നമ്മെ രാജ്യവും പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ആക്കിത്തീർത്തവനുമായവന്നു എന്നെന്നേക്കും മഹത്വവും ബലവും; ആമേൻ.
chapters.niv: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to serve his God and Father—to him be glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.
chapters.nkjv: and has made us kings and priests to His God and Father, to Him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
chapters.kjv: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

chapters.ml: ഇതാ, അവൻ മേഘാരൂഢനായി വരുന്നു; ഏതു കണ്ണും, അവനെ കുത്തിത്തുളെച്ചവരും അവനെ കാണും; ഭൂമിയിലെ ഗോത്രങ്ങൾ ഒക്കെയും അവനെച്ചൊല്ലി വിലപിക്കും. ഉവ്വു, ആമേൻ.
chapters.niv: "Look, he is coming with the clouds," and "every eye will see him, even those who pierced him"; and all peoples on earth "will mourn because of him." So shall it be! Amen.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, He is coming with clouds, and every eye will see Him, even they who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. Even so, Amen.
chapters.kjv: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അല്ഫയും ഒമേഗയും ആകുന്നു എന്നു ഇരിക്കുന്നവനും ഇരുന്നവനും വരുന്നവനുമായി സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവമായ കർത്താവു അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty."
chapters.nkjv: "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End," says the Lord, "who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty."
chapters.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സഹോദരനും യേശുവിന്റെ കഷ്ടതയിലും രാജ്യത്തിലും സഹിഷ്ണതയിലും കൂട്ടാളിയുമായ യോഹന്നാൻ എന്ന ഞാൻ ദൈവവചനവും യേശുവിന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യവും നിമിത്തം പത്മൊസ് എന്ന ദ്വീപിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: I, John, both your brother and companion in the tribulation and kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was on the island that is called Patmos for the word of God and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
chapters.kjv: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

chapters.ml: കർത്തൃദിവസത്തിൽ ഞാൻ ആത്മവിവശനായി:
chapters.niv: On the Lord’s Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
chapters.nkjv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s Day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, as of a trumpet,
chapters.kjv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

chapters.ml: നീ കാണുന്നതു ഒരു പുസ്തകത്തിൽ എഴുതി എഫെസൊസ്, സ്മുർന്നാ; പെർഗ്ഗമൊസ്, തുയഥൈര, സർദ്ദീസ്, ഫിലദെൽഫ്യ, ലവൊദിക്ക്യാ എന്ന ഏഴു സഭകൾക്കും അയക്കുക എന്നിങ്ങനെ കാഹളത്തിന്നൊത്ത ഒരു മഹാനാദം എന്റെ പുറകിൽ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: which said: "Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last," and, "What you see, write in a book and send it to the seven churches which are in Asia: to Ephesus, to Smyrna, to Pergamos, to Thyatira, to Sardis, to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea."
chapters.kjv: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

chapters.ml: എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ച നാദം എന്തു എന്നു കാണ്മാൻ ഞാൻ തിരിഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
chapters.nkjv: Then I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. And having turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
chapters.kjv: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;

chapters.ml: തിരിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ ഏഴു പൊൻനിലവിളക്കുകളെയും നിലവിളക്കുകളുടെ നടുവിൽ നിലയങ്കി ധരിച്ചു മാറത്തു പൊൻകച്ച കെട്ടിയവനായി മനുഷ്യപുത്രനോടു സദൃശനായവനെയും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest.
chapters.nkjv: and in the midst of the seven lampstands One like the Son of Man, clothed with a garment down to the feet and girded about the chest with a golden band.
chapters.kjv: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ തലയും തലമുടിയും വെളുത്ത പഞ്ഞിപോലെ ഹിമത്തോളം വെള്ളയും കണ്ണു അഗ്നിജ്വാലെക്കു ഒത്തതും
chapters.niv: The hair on his head was white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like blazing fire.
chapters.nkjv: His head and hair were white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes like a flame of fire;
chapters.kjv: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

chapters.ml: കാൽ ഉലയിൽ ചുട്ടു പഴുപ്പിച്ച വെള്ളോട്ടിന്നു സദൃശവും അവന്റെ ശബ്ദം പെരുവെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഇരെച്ചൽപോലെയും ആയിരുന്നു. അവന്റെ വലങ്കയ്യിൽ ഏഴു നക്ഷത്രം ഉണ്ടു;
chapters.niv: His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.
chapters.nkjv: His feet were like fine brass, as if refined in a furnace, and His voice as the sound of many waters;
chapters.kjv: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നു മൂർച്ചയേറിയ ഇരുവായ്ത്തലയുള്ള വാൾ പുറപ്പെടുന്നു; അവന്റെ മുഖം സൂര്യൻ ശക്തിയോടെ പ്രകാശിക്കുന്നതു പോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: In his right hand he held seven stars, and coming out of his mouth was a sharp, double-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.
chapters.nkjv: He had in His right hand seven stars, out of His mouth went a sharp two-edged sword, and His countenance was like the sun shining in its strength.
chapters.kjv: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

chapters.ml: അവനെ കണ്ടിട്ടു ഞാൻ മരിച്ചവനെപ്പോലെ അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു. അവൻ വലങ്കൈ എന്റെ മേൽ വെച്ചു: ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടാ, ഞാൻ ആദ്യനും അന്ത്യനും ജീവനുള്ളവനും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.
chapters.nkjv: And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet as dead. But He laid His right hand on me, saying to me, "Do not be afraid; I am the First and the Last.
chapters.kjv: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ മരിച്ചവനായിരുന്നു; എന്നാൽ ഇതാ, എന്നെന്നേക്കും ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; മരണത്തിന്റെയും പാതാളത്തിന്റെയും താക്കോൽ എന്റെ കൈവശമുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: I am the Living One; I was dead, and now look, I am alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.
chapters.nkjv: I am He who lives, and was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore. Amen. And I have the keys of Hades and of Death.
chapters.kjv: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

chapters.ml: നീ കണ്ടതും ഇപ്പോൾ ഉള്ളതും ഇനി സംഭവിപ്പാനിരിക്കുന്നതും
chapters.niv: "Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.
chapters.nkjv: Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will take place after this.
chapters.kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

chapters.ml: എന്റെ വലങ്കയ്യിൽ കണ്ട ഏഴു നക്ഷത്രത്തിന്റെ മർമ്മവും ഏഴു പൊൻനിലവിളക്കിന്റെ വിവരവും എഴുതുക. ഏഴു നക്ഷത്രം ഏഴു സഭകളുടെ ദൂതന്മാരാകുന്നു; ഏഴു നിലവിളക്കു ഏഴു സഭകൾ ആകുന്നു എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and of the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
chapters.nkjv: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands which you saw are the seven churches.
chapters.kjv: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

chapters.ml: എഫെസൊസിലെ സഭയുടെ ദൂതന്നു എഴുതുക: ഏഴു നക്ഷത്രം വലങ്കയ്യിൽ പിടിച്ചും കൊണ്ടു ഏഴു പൊൻനിലവിളക്കുകളുടെ നടുവിൽ നടക്കുന്നവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു:
chapters.niv: "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
chapters.nkjv: "To the angel of the church of Ephesus write, ‘These things says He who holds the seven stars in His right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:
chapters.kjv: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിയും പ്രയത്നവും സഹിഷ്ണതയും കൊള്ളരുതാത്തവരെ നിനക്കു സഹിച്ചുകൂടാത്തതും അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരല്ലാതിരിക്കെ തങ്ങൾ അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാർ എന്നു പറയുന്നവരെ നീ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു കള്ളന്മാർ എന്നു കണ്ടതും,
chapters.niv: I know your deeds, your hard work and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate wicked people, that you have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and have found them false.
chapters.nkjv: "I know your works, your labor, your patience, and that you cannot bear those who are evil. And you have tested those who say they are apostles and are not, and have found them liars;
chapters.kjv: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

chapters.ml: നിനക്കു സഹിഷ്ണതയുള്ളതും എന്റെ നാമംനിമിത്തം നീ സഹിച്ചതും തളന്നുപോകാഞ്ഞതും ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You have persevered and have endured hardships for my name, and have not grown weary.
chapters.nkjv: and you have persevered and have patience, and have labored for My name’s sake and have not become weary.
chapters.kjv: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിന്റെ ആദ്യസ്നേഹം വിട്ടുകളഞ്ഞു എന്നു ഒരു കുറ്റം നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു പറവാനുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Yet I hold this against you: You have forsaken the love you had at first.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless I have this against you, that you have left your first love.
chapters.kjv: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

chapters.ml: നീ ഏതിൽനിന്നു വീണിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഓർത്തു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടു ആദ്യത്തെ പ്രവൃത്തി ചെയ്ക; അല്ലാഞ്ഞാൽ ഞാൻ വരികയും നീ മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടാഞ്ഞാൽ നിന്റെ നിലവിളക്കു അതിന്റെ നിലയിൽനിന്നു നീക്കുകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: Consider how far you have fallen! Repent and do the things you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
chapters.nkjv: Remember therefore from where you have fallen; repent and do the first works, or else I will come to you quickly and remove your lampstand from its place—unless you repent.
chapters.kjv: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിക്കൊലാവ്യരുടെ നടപ്പു നീ പകെക്കുന്നു എന്നൊരു നന്മ നിനക്കുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: But you have this in your favor: You hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
chapters.nkjv: But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
chapters.kjv: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

chapters.ml: അതു ഞാനും പകെക്കുന്നു. ആത്മാവു സഭകളോടു പറയുന്നതു എന്തെന്നു ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ. ജയിക്കുന്നവന്നു ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പരദീസയിൽ ഉള്ള ജീവവൃക്ഷത്തിന്റെ ഫലം തിന്മാൻ കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.
chapters.nkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the Paradise of God." ’
chapters.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

chapters.ml: സ്മൂർന്നയിലെ സഭയുടെ ദൂതന്നു എഴുതുക: മരിച്ചവനായിരുന്നു വീണ്ടും ജീവിക്കയും ചെയ്ത ആദ്യനും അന്ത്യനുമായവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു:
chapters.niv: "To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.
chapters.nkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write, ‘These things says the First and the Last, who was dead, and came to life:
chapters.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ കഷ്ടതയും ദാരിദ്ര്യവും — നീ ധനവാനാകുന്നു താനും — തങ്ങൾ യെഹൂദർ എന്നു പറയുന്നുവെങ്കിലും യെഹൂദരല്ല, സാത്താന്റെ പള്ളിക്കാരായവരുടെ ദൂഷണവും അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I know your afflictions and your poverty—yet you are rich! I know about the slander of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
chapters.nkjv: "I know your works, tribulation, and poverty (but you are rich); and I know the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
chapters.kjv: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

chapters.ml: നീ സഹിപ്പാനുള്ളതു പേടിക്കേണ്ടാ; നിങ്ങളെ പരീക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു പിശാചു നിങ്ങളിൽ ചിലരെ തടവിൽ ആക്കുവാൻ പോകുന്നു; പത്തു ദിവസം നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഉപദ്രവം ഉണ്ടാകും; മരണ പര്യന്തം വിശ്വസ്തനായിരിക്ക; എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ജീവ കിരീടം നിനക്കു തരും.
chapters.niv: Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you will suffer persecution for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you life as your victor’s crown.
chapters.nkjv: Do not fear any of those things which you are about to suffer. Indeed, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and you will have tribulation ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
chapters.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു സഭകളോടു പറയുന്നതു എന്തെന്നു ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ. ജയിക്കുന്നവന്നു രണ്ടാം മരണത്താൽ ദോഷം വരികയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who is victorious will not be hurt at all by the second death.
chapters.nkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes shall not be hurt by the second death." ’
chapters.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

chapters.ml: പെർഗ്ഗമൊസിലെ സഭയുടെ ദൂതന്നു എഴുതുക: മൂർച്ചയേറിയ ഇരുവായ്ത്തലവാൾ ഉള്ളവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു:
chapters.niv: "To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of him who has the sharp, double-edged sword.
chapters.nkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write, ‘These things says He who has the sharp two-edged sword:
chapters.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;

chapters.ml: നീ എവിടെ പാർക്കുന്നു എന്നും അതു സാത്താന്റെ സിംഹാസനം ഉള്ളേടം എന്നും ഞാൻ അറിയുന്നു; നീ എന്റെ നാമം മുറുകെ പിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; നിങ്ങളുടെ ഇടയിൽ, സാത്താൻ പാർക്കുന്നേടത്തു തന്നേ, എന്റെ സാക്ഷിയും വിശ്വസ്തനുമായ അന്തിപ്പാസിനെ കൊന്ന കാലത്തുപോലും നീ എങ്കലുള്ള വിശ്വാസം നിഷേധിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: I know where you live—where Satan has his throne. Yet you remain true to my name. You did not renounce your faith in me, not even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death in your city—where Satan lives.
chapters.nkjv: "I know your works, and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. And you hold fast to My name, and did not deny My faith even in the days in which Antipas was My faithful martyr, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
chapters.kjv: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s seat is : and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു കുറഞ്ഞോരു കുറ്റം പറവാൻ ഉണ്ടു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കൾ വിഗ്രഹാർപ്പിതം തിന്നേണ്ടതിന്നും ദുർന്നടപ്പു ആചരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും അവരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ ഇടർച്ചവെപ്പാൻ ബാലാക്കിന്നു ഉപദേശിച്ചുകൊടുത്ത ബിലെയാമിന്റെ ഉപദേശം പിടിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവർ അവിടെ നിനക്കുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, I have a few things against you: There are some among you who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to entice the Israelites to sin so that they ate food sacrificed to idols and committed sexual immorality.
chapters.nkjv: But I have a few things against you, because you have there those who hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
chapters.kjv: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

chapters.ml: അവ്വണ്ണം നിക്കൊലാവ്യരുടെ ഉപദേശം കൈക്കൊള്ളുന്നവർ നിനക്കും ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Likewise, you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
chapters.nkjv: Thus you also have those who hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
chapters.kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടുക; അല്ലാഞ്ഞാൽ ഞാൻ വേഗത്തിൽ വന്നു എന്റെ വായിലെ വാളുകൊണ്ടു അവരോടു പോരാടും.
chapters.niv: Repent therefore! Otherwise, I will soon come to you and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
chapters.nkjv: Repent, or else I will come to you quickly and will fight against them with the sword of My mouth.
chapters.kjv: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു സഭകളോടു പറയുന്നതു എന്തെന്നു ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ. ജയിക്കുന്നവന്നു ഞാൻ മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന മന്ന കൊടുക്കും; ഞാൻ അവന്നു വെള്ളക്കല്ലും, ലഭിക്കുന്നവനല്ലാതെ ആരും അറിയാത്തതും ആ കല്ലിന്മേൽ എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നതുമായ പുതിയ പേരും കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.
chapters.nkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give some of the hidden manna to eat. And I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows except him who receives it." ’
chapters.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

chapters.ml: തുയഥൈരയിലെ സഭയുടെ ദൂതന്നു എഴുതുക: അഗ്നിജ്വാലെക്കു ഒത്ത കണ്ണും വെള്ളോട്ടിന്നു സദൃശമായ കാലും ഉള്ള ദൈവപുത്രൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു:
chapters.niv: "To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze.
chapters.nkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write, ‘These things says the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet like fine brass:
chapters.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തിയും നിന്റെ സ്നേഹം, വിശ്വാസം, ശുശ്രൂഷ, സഹിഷ്ണത എന്നിവയും നിന്റെ ഒടുവിലത്തെ പ്രവൃത്തി ആദ്യത്തേതിലും ഏറെയെന്നും അറിയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I know your deeds, your love and faith, your service and perseverance, and that you are now doing more than you did at first.
chapters.nkjv: "I know your works, love, service, faith, and your patience; and as for your works, the last are more than the first.
chapters.kjv: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും താൻ പ്രവാചകി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ദുർന്നടപ്പു ആചരിപ്പാനും വിഗ്രഹാർപ്പിതം തിന്മാനും എന്റെ ദാസന്മാരെ ഉപദേശിക്കയും തെറ്റിച്ചുകളകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഈസബേൽ എന്ന സ്ത്രീയെ നീ അനുവദിക്കുന്നു എന്നൊരു കുറ്റം നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചു പറവാൻ ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Nevertheless, I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she misleads my servants into sexual immorality and the eating of food sacrificed to idols.
chapters.nkjv: Nevertheless I have a few things against you, because you allowthat woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, to teach and seduce My servants to commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.
chapters.kjv: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവൾക്കു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടുവാൻ സമയം കൊടുത്തിട്ടും ദുർന്നടപ്പുവിട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടുവാൻ അവൾക്കു മനസ്സില്ല.
chapters.niv: I have given her time to repent of her immorality, but she is unwilling.
chapters.nkjv: And I gave her time to repent of her sexual immorality, and she did not repent.
chapters.kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവളെ കിടപ്പിലും അവളുമായി വ്യഭിചരിക്കുന്നവരെ അവളുടെ നടപ്പു വിട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടാതിരുന്നാൽ വലിയ കഷ്ടതയിലും ആക്കിക്കളയും.
chapters.niv: So I will cast her on a bed of suffering, and I will make those who commit adultery with her suffer intensely, unless they repent of her ways.
chapters.nkjv: Indeed I will cast her into a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of their deeds.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ മക്കളെയും ഞാൻ കൊന്നുകളയും; ഞാൻ ഉൾപൂവുകളെയും ഹൃദയങ്ങളെയും ആരായുന്നവൻ എന്നു സകലസഭകളും അറിയും; നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ഏവർക്കും പകരം ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am he who searches hearts and minds, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
chapters.nkjv: I will kill her children with death, and all the churches shall know that I am He who searches the minds and hearts. And I will give to each one of you according to your works.
chapters.kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഈ ഉപദേശം കൈക്കൊള്ളാതെയും അവർ പറയുംപോലെ സാത്താന്റെ ആഴങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ലാതെയും തുയഥൈരയിലെ ശേഷം പേരോടു: വേറൊരു ഭാരം ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ ചുമത്തുന്നില്ല.
chapters.niv: Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to you who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned Satan’s so-called deep secrets, ‘I will not impose any other burden on you,
chapters.nkjv: "Now to you I say, and to the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this doctrine, who have not known the depths of Satan, as they say, I will put on you no other burden.
chapters.kjv: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതു ഞാൻ വരുംവരെ പിടിച്ചുകൊൾവിൻ എന്നു ഞാൻ കല്പിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: except to hold on to what you have until I come.’
chapters.nkjv: But hold fast what you have till I come.
chapters.kjv: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.

chapters.ml: ജയിക്കയും ഞാൻ കല്പിച്ച പ്രവൃത്തികളെ അവസാനത്തോളം അനുഷ്ഠിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നവന്നു എന്റെ പിതാവു എനിക്കു തന്നതുപോലെ ഞാൻ ജാതികളുടെ മേൽ അധികാരം കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: To the one who is victorious and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations—
chapters.nkjv: And he who overcomes, and keeps My works until the end, to him I will give power over the nations—
chapters.kjv: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഇരിമ്പുകോൽകൊണ്ടു അവരെ മേയിക്കും; അവർ കുശവന്റെ പാത്രങ്ങൾപോലെ നുറുങ്ങിപ്പോകും.
chapters.niv: that one ‘will rule them with an iron scepter and will dash them to pieces like pottery’ —just as I have received authority from my Father.
chapters.nkjv: ‘He shall rule them with a rod of iron; They shall be dashed to pieces like the potter’s vessels’— as I also have received from My Father;
chapters.kjv: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്നു ഉദയനക്ഷത്രവും കൊടുക്കും.
chapters.niv: I will also give that one the morning star.
chapters.nkjv: and I will give him the morning star.
chapters.kjv: And I will give him the morning star.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു സഭകളോടു പറയുന്നതു എന്തെന്നു ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.nkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’
chapters.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

chapters.ml: സർദ്ദിസിലെ സഭയുടെ ദൂതന്നു എഴുതുക. ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ഏഴാത്മാവും ഏഴു നക്ഷത്രവും ഉള്ളവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയുന്നതു: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി അറിയുന്നു. ജീവനുള്ളവൻ എന്നു നിനക്കു പേർ ഉണ്ടു എങ്കിലും നീ മരിച്ചവനാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
chapters.nkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Sardis write, ‘These things says He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: "I know your works, that you have a name that you are alive, but you are dead.
chapters.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

chapters.ml: ഉണർന്നുകൊൾക; ചാവാറായ ശേഷിപ്പുകളെ ശക്തീകരിക്ക; ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി എന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ പൂർണ്ണതയുള്ളതായി കണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have found your deeds unfinished in the sight of my God.
chapters.nkjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die, for I have not found your works perfect before God.
chapters.kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ നീ പ്രാപിക്കയും കേൾക്കയും ചെയ്തതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നു ഓർത്തു അതു കാത്തുകൊൾകയും മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്ക. നീ ഉണരാതിരുന്നാൽ ഞാൻ കള്ളനെപ്പോലെ വരും; ഏതു നാഴികെക്കു നിന്റെമേൽ വരും എന്നു നീ അറികയും ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Remember, therefore, what you have received and heard; hold it fast, and repent. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.
chapters.nkjv: Remember therefore how you have received and heard; hold fast and repent. Therefore if you will not watch, I will come upon you as a thief, and you will not know what hour I will come upon you.
chapters.kjv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

chapters.ml: എങ്കിലും ഉടുപ്പു മലിനമാകാത്ത കുറേ പേർ സർദ്ദിസിൽ നിനക്കുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me, dressed in white, for they are worthy.
chapters.nkjv: You have a few names even in Sardis who have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with Me in white, for they are worthy.
chapters.kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

chapters.ml: അവർ യോഗ്യന്മാരാകയാൽ വെള്ളധരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു എന്നോടുകൂടെ നടക്കും. ജയിക്കുന്നവൻ വെള്ളയുടുപ്പു ധരിക്കും; അവന്റെ പേർ ഞാൻ ജീവപുസ്തകത്തിൽനിന്നു മാച്ചുകളയാതെ എന്റെ പിതാവിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിലും അവന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരുടെ മുമ്പിലും അവന്റെ പേർ ഏറ്റുപറയും.
chapters.niv: The one who is victorious will, like them, be dressed in white. I will never blot out the name of that person from the book of life, but will acknowledge that name before my Father and his angels.
chapters.nkjv: He who overcomes shall be clothed in white garments, and I will not blot out his name from the Book of Life; but I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.
chapters.kjv: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു സഭകളോടു പറയുന്നതു എന്തെന്നു ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.nkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’
chapters.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

chapters.ml: ഫിലദെൽഫ്യയിലെ സഭയുടെ ദൂതന്നു എഴുതുക: വിശുദ്ധനും സത്യവാനും ദാവീദിന്റെ താക്കോലുള്ളവനും ആയി ആരും അടെക്കാതവണ്ണം തുറക്കുകയും ആരും തുറക്കാതവണ്ണം അടെക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നതു:
chapters.niv: "To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
chapters.nkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write, ‘These things says He who is holy, He who is true, "He who has the key of David, He who opens and no one shuts, and shuts and no one opens":
chapters.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി അറിയുന്നു. ഇതാ ഞാൻ നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഒരു വാതിൽ തുറന്നുവെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അതു ആർക്കും അടെച്ചുകൂടാ. നിനക്കു അല്പമേ ശക്തിയുള്ളു എങ്കിലും നീ എന്റെ വചനം കാത്തു, എന്റെ നാമം നിഷേധിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut. I know that you have little strength, yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.
chapters.nkjv: "I know your works. See, I have set before you an open door, and no one can shut it; for you have a little strength, have kept My word, and have not denied My name.
chapters.kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദരല്ലാതിരിക്കെ യെഹൂദരെന്നു കളവായി പറയുന്ന ചിലരെ ഞാൻ സാത്താന്റെ പള്ളിയിൽ നിന്നു വരുത്തും; അവർ നിന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വന്നു നമസ്കരിപ്പാനും ഞാൻ നിന്നെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു എന്നു അറിവാനും സംഗതി വരുത്തും.
chapters.niv: I will make those who are of the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews though they are not, but are liars—I will make them come and fall down at your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.
chapters.nkjv: Indeed I will make those of the synagogue of Satan, who say they are Jews and are not, but lie—indeed I will make them come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

chapters.ml: സഹിഷ്ണതയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള എന്റെ വചനം നീ കാത്തുകൊണ്ടതിനാൽ ഭൂമിയിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവരെ പരീക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ഭൂതലത്തിൽ എങ്ങും വരുവാനുള്ള പരീക്ഷാകാലത്തു ഞാനും നിന്നെ കാക്കും.
chapters.niv: Since you have kept my command to endure patiently, I will also keep you from the hour of trial that is going to come on the whole world to test the inhabitants of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I also will keep you from the hour of trial which shall come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
chapters.kjv: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വേഗം വരുന്നു; നിന്റെ കിരീടം ആരും എടുക്കാതിരിപ്പാന്തക്കവണ്ണം നിനക്കുള്ളതു പിടിച്ചുകൊൾക.
chapters.niv: I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, I am coming quickly! Hold fast what you have, that no one may take your crown.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

chapters.ml: ജയിക്കുന്നവനെ ഞാൻ എന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയത്തിൽ ഒരു തൂണാക്കും; അവൻ ഒരിക്കലും അവിടെനിന്നു പോകയില്ല; എന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നാമവും എന്റെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പക്കൽനിന്നു, സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ, ഇറങ്ങുന്ന പുതിയ യെരൂശലേം എന്ന എന്റെ ദൈവത്തിൻ നഗരത്തിന്റെ നാമവും എന്റെ പുതിയ നാമവും ഞാൻ അവന്റെ മേൽ എഴുതും.
chapters.niv: The one who is victorious I will make a pillar in the temple of my God. Never again will they leave it. I will write on them the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which is coming down out of heaven from my God; and I will also write on them my new name.
chapters.nkjv: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he shall go out no more. I will write on him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the New Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God. And I will write on him My new name.
chapters.kjv: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു സഭകളോടു പറയുന്നതു എന്തെന്നു ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.nkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’
chapters.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

chapters.ml: ലവൊദിക്ക്യയിലെ സഭയുടെ ദൂതന്നു എഴുതുക: വിശ്വസ്തനും സത്യവാനുമായ സാക്ഷിയായി ദൈവസൃഷ്ടിയുടെ ആരംഭമായ ആമേൻ എന്നുള്ളവൻ അരുളിച്ചെയുന്നതു:
chapters.niv: "To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God’s creation.
chapters.nkjv: "And to the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write, ‘These things says the Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of the creation of God:
chapters.kjv: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി അറിയുന്നു; നീ ഉഷ്ണവാനുമല്ല; ശീതവാനുമല്ല; ശീതവാനോ ഉഷ്ണവാനോ ആയിരുന്നു എങ്കിൽ കൊള്ളായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either one or the other!
chapters.nkjv: "I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I could wish you were cold or hot.
chapters.kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

chapters.ml: ഇങ്ങനെ ശീതവാനുമല്ല ഉഷ്ണവാനുമല്ല, ശിതോഷ്ണവാനാകയാൽ നിന്നെ എന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നു ഉമിണ്ണുകളയും.
chapters.niv: So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
chapters.nkjv: So then, because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will vomit you out of My mouth.
chapters.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ധനവാൻ; സമ്പന്നനായിരിക്കുന്നു; എനിക്കു ഒന്നിനും മുട്ടില്ല എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു നീ നിർഭാഗ്യനും അരിഷ്ടനും ദരിദ്രനും കുരുടനും നഗ്നനും എന്നു അറിയാതിരിക്കയാൽ
chapters.niv: You say, ‘I am rich; I have acquired wealth and do not need a thing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind and naked.
chapters.nkjv: Because you say, ‘I am rich, have become wealthy, and have need of nothing’—and do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked—
chapters.kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

chapters.ml: നീ സമ്പന്നൻ ആകേണ്ടതിന്നു തീയിൽ ഊതിക്കഴിച്ച പൊന്നും നിന്റെ നഗ്നതയുടെ ലജ്ജ വെളിവാകാതവണ്ണം ധരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വെള്ളയുടുപ്പും നിനക്കു കാഴ്ച ലഭിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു കണ്ണിൽ എഴുതുവാൻ ലേപവും എന്നോടു വിലെക്കുവാങ്ങുവാൻ ഞാൻ നിന്നോടു ബുദ്ധിപറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined in the fire, so you can become rich; and white clothes to wear, so you can cover your shameful nakedness; and salve to put on your eyes, so you can see.
chapters.nkjv: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined in the fire, that you may be rich; and white garments, that you may be clothed, that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and anoint your eyes with eye salve, that you may see.
chapters.kjv: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

chapters.ml: എനിക്കു പ്രിയമുള്ളവരെ ഒക്കെയും ഞാൻ ശാസിക്കയും ശിക്ഷിക്കയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; ആകയാൽ നീ ജാഗ്രതയുള്ളവനായിരിക്ക; മാനസാന്തരപ്പെടുക.
chapters.niv: Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest and repent.
chapters.nkjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten. Therefore be zealous and repent.
chapters.kjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വാതിൽക്കൽ നിന്നു മുട്ടുന്നു; ആരെങ്കിലും എന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടു വാതിൽ തുറന്നാൽ ഞാൻ അവന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു അവനോടും അവൻ എന്നോടും കൂടെ അത്താഴം കഴിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.
chapters.nkjv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with Me.
chapters.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

chapters.ml: ജയിക്കുന്നവന്നു ഞാൻ എന്നോടുകൂടെ എന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിപ്പാൻ വരം നല്കും; ഞാനും ജയിച്ചു എന്റെ പിതാവിനോടുകൂടെ അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരുന്നതുപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I was victorious and sat down with my Father on his throne.
chapters.nkjv: To him who overcomes I will grant to sit with Me on My throne, as I also overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
chapters.kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

chapters.ml: ആത്മാവു സഭകളോടു പറയുന്നതു എന്തെന്നു ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
chapters.nkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’ "
chapters.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ഒരു വാതിൽ തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; കാഹളനാദംപോലെ എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചു കേട്ട ആദ്യത്തെ ശബ്ദം എന്നോടു: ഇവിടെ കയറിവരിക; മേലാൽ സംഭവിപ്പാനുള്ളതു ഞാൻ നിനക്കു കാണിച്ചുതരാം എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this."
chapters.nkjv: After these things I looked, and behold, a door standing open in heaven. And the first voice which I heard was like a trumpet speaking with me, saying, "Come up here, and I will show you things which must take place after this."
chapters.kjv: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ ഞാൻ ആത്മവിവശനായി സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ഒരു സിംഹാസനം വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതും സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഒരുവൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.
chapters.nkjv: Immediately I was in the Spirit; and behold, a throne set in heaven, and One sat on the throne.
chapters.kjv: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

chapters.ml: ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ കാഴ്ചെക്കു സൂര്യകാന്തത്തോടും പത്മരാഗത്തോടും സദൃശൻ; സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റും കാഴ്ചെക്കു മരതകത്തോടു സദൃശമായോരു പച്ചവില്ലു;
chapters.niv: And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and ruby. A rainbow that shone like an emerald encircled the throne.
chapters.nkjv: And He who sat there was like a jasper and a sardius stone in appearance; and therewas a rainbow around the throne, in appearance like an emerald.
chapters.kjv: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

chapters.ml: സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലും ഇരുപത്തുനാലു സിംഹാസനം; വെള്ളയുടുപ്പു ധരിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു സിംഹാസനങ്ങളിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്ന ഇരുപത്തുനാലു മൂപ്പന്മാർ; അവരുടെ തലയിൽ പൊൻകിരീടം;
chapters.niv: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads.
chapters.nkjv: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and on the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white robes; and they had crowns of gold on their heads.
chapters.kjv: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

chapters.ml: സിംഹാസനത്തിൽനിന്നു മിന്നലും നാദവും ഇടിമുഴക്കവും പുറപ്പെടുന്നു; ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ഏഴു ആത്മാക്കളായ ഏഴുദീപങ്ങൾ സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ജ്വലിച്ചുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു;
chapters.niv: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. In front of the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God.
chapters.nkjv: And from the throne proceeded lightnings, thunderings, and voices. Seven lamps of fire were burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
chapters.kjv: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

chapters.ml: സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ പളുങ്കിന്നൊത്ത കണ്ണാടിക്കടൽ; സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ നടുവിലും സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ ചുറ്റിലും നാലു ജീവികൾ; അവെക്കു മുമ്പുറവും പിമ്പുറവും കണ്ണു നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back.
chapters.nkjv: Before the throne there was a sea of glass, like crystal. And in the midst of the throne, and around the throne, were four living creatures full of eyes in front and in back.
chapters.kjv: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാം ജീവി സിംഹത്തിന്നു സദൃശം; രണ്ടാം ജീവി കാളെക്കു സദൃശം മൂന്നാംജീവി മനുഷ്യനെപ്പോലെ മുഖമുള്ളതും; നാലാം ജീവി പറക്കുന്ന കഴുകിന്നു സദൃശം.
chapters.niv: The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle.
chapters.nkjv: The first living creature was like a lion, the second living creature like a calf, the third living creature had a face like a man, and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.
chapters.kjv: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

chapters.ml: നാലു ജീവികളും ഒരോന്നിന്നു ആറാറു ചിറകുള്ളതായി ചുറ്റിലും അകത്തും കണ്ണു നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു. ഇരിക്കുന്നവനും ഇരുന്നവനും വരുന്നവനുമായി സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള കർത്താവായ ദൈവം പരിശുദ്ധൻ, പരിശുദ്ധൻ, പരിശുദ്ധൻ എന്നു അവർ രാപ്പകൽ വിശ്രമം കൂടാതെ പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying: " ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,’ who was, and is, and is to come."
chapters.nkjv: The four living creatures, each having six wings, were full of eyes around and within. And they do not rest day or night, saying: "Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, Who was and is and is to come!"
chapters.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him ; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

chapters.ml: എന്നെന്നേക്കും ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവനായി സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്നു ആ ജീവികൾ മഹത്വവും ബഹുമാനവും സ്തോത്രവും കൊടുക്കുമ്പോഴൊക്കെയും
chapters.niv: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne and who lives for ever and ever,
chapters.nkjv: Whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to Him who sits on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
chapters.kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തുനാലു മൂപ്പന്മാരും സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ വീണു, എന്നെന്നേക്കും ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവനെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു:
chapters.niv: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say:
chapters.nkjv: the twenty-four elders fall down before Him who sits on the throne and worship Him who lives forever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
chapters.kjv: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, നീ സർവ്വവും സൃഷ്ടിച്ചവനും എല്ലാം നിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടംഹേതുവാൽ ഉണ്ടായതും സൃഷ്ടിക്കപ്പെട്ടതും ആകയാൽ മഹത്വവും ബഹുമാനവും ശക്തിയും കൈക്കൊൾവാൻ യോഗ്യൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞുംകൊണ്ടു തങ്ങളുടെ കിരീടങ്ങളെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൻ മുമ്പിൽ ഇടും.
chapters.niv: "You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being."
chapters.nkjv: "You are worthy, O Lord, To receive glory and honor and power; For You created all things, And by Your will they exist and were created."
chapters.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ വലങ്കയ്യിൽ അകത്തും പുറത്തും എഴുത്തുള്ളതായി ഏഴു മുദ്രയാൽ മുദ്രയിട്ടൊരു പുസ്തകം കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I saw in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a scroll with writing on both sides and sealed with seven seals.
chapters.nkjv: And I saw in the right hand of Him who sat on the throne a scroll written inside and on the back, sealed with seven seals.
chapters.kjv: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

chapters.ml: ആ പുസ്തകം തുറപ്പാനും അതിന്റെ മുദ്ര പൊട്ടിപ്പാനും യോഗ്യൻ ആരുള്ളു എന്നു അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ ഘോഷിക്കുന്ന ശക്തനായോരു ദൂതനെയും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?"
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and to loose its seals?"
chapters.kjv: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

chapters.ml: പുസ്തകം തുറപ്പാനോ നോക്കുവാനോ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലും ഭൂമിയിലും ഭൂമിക്കു കീഴിലും ആർക്കും കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.
chapters.nkjv: And no one in heaven or on the earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll, or to look at it.
chapters.kjv: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

chapters.ml: പുസ്തകം തുറന്നു വായിപ്പാനെങ്കിലും അതു നോക്കുവാനെങ്കിലും യോഗ്യനായി ആരെയും കാണായ്കകൊണ്ടു ഞാൻ ഏറ്റവും കരഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: I wept and wept because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.
chapters.nkjv: So I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open and read the scroll, or to look at it.
chapters.kjv: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ മൂപ്പന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ എന്നോടു: കരയേണ്ട; യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിലെ സിംഹവും ദാവീദിന്റെ വേരുമായവൻ പുസ്തകവും അതിന്റെ ഏഴുമുദ്രയും തുറപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ജയം പ്രാപിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals."
chapters.nkjv: But one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep. Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the scroll and to loose its seven seals."
chapters.kjv: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സിംഹസനത്തിന്റെയും നാലു ജീവികളുടെയും നടുവിലും മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെ മദ്ധ്യത്തിലും ഒരു കുഞ്ഞാടു അറുക്കപ്പെട്ടതുപോലെ നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു: അതിന്നു ഏഴു കൊമ്പും സർവ്വഭൂമിയിലേക്കും അയച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഏഴു ദൈവാത്മാക്കൾ ആയ ഏഴു കണ്ണും ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I saw a Lamb, looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
chapters.nkjv: And I looked, and behold, in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
chapters.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ വന്നു സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ വലങ്കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു പുസ്തകം വാങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
chapters.nkjv: Then He came and took the scroll out of the right hand of Him who sat on the throne.
chapters.kjv: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

chapters.ml: വാങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ നാലുജീവികളും ഇരുപത്തുനാലു മൂപ്പന്മാരും ഓരോരുത്തൻ വീണയും വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥന എന്ന ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം നിറഞ്ഞ പൊൻകലശവും പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ വീണു.
chapters.niv: And when he had taken it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God’s people.
chapters.nkjv: Now when He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
chapters.kjv: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

chapters.ml: പുസ്തകം വാങ്ങുവാനും അതിന്റെ മുദ്ര പൊട്ടിപ്പാനും നീ യോഗ്യൻ; നീ അറുക്കപ്പെട്ടു നിന്റെ രക്തം കൊണ്ടു സർവ്വഗോത്രത്തിലും ഭാഷയിലും വംശത്തിലും ജാതിയിലും നിന്നുള്ളവരെ ദൈവത്തിന്നായി വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങി;
chapters.niv: And they sang a new song, saying: "You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased for God persons from every tribe and language and people and nation.
chapters.nkjv: And they sang a new song, saying: "You are worthy to take the scroll, And to open its seals; For You were slain, And have redeemed us to God by Your blood Out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation,
chapters.kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു അവരെ രാജ്യവും പുരോഹിതന്മാരും ആക്കിവെച്ചു; അവർ ഭൂമിയിൽ വാഴുന്നു എന്നൊരു പുതിയ പാട്ടു അവർ പാടുന്നു.
chapters.niv: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: And have made us kings and priests to our God; And we shall reign on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഞാൻ ദർശനത്തിൽ സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെയും ജീവികളുടെയും മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെയും ചുറ്റിലും ഏറിയ ദൂതന്മാരുടെ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടു; അവരുടെ എണ്ണം പതിനായിരം പതിനായിരവും ആയിരം ആയിരവും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels, numbering thousands upon thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They encircled the throne and the living creatures and the elders.
chapters.nkjv: Then I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands,
chapters.kjv: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

chapters.ml: അവർ അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ: അറുക്കപ്പെട്ട കുഞ്ഞാടു ശക്തിയും ധനവും ജ്ഞാനവും ബലവും ബഹുമാനവും മഹത്വവും സ്തോത്രവും ലഭിപ്പാൻ യോഗ്യൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: In a loud voice they were saying: "Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!"
chapters.nkjv: saying with a loud voice: "Worthy is the Lamb who was slain To receive power and riches and wisdom, And strength and honor and glory and blessing!"
chapters.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലും ഭൂമിയിലും ഭൂമിക്കു കീഴിലും സമുദ്രത്തിലും ഉള്ള സകല സൃഷ്ടിയും അവയിലുള്ളതു ഒക്കെയും: സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവനും കുഞ്ഞാടിനും സ്തോത്രവും ബഹുമാനവും മഹത്വവും ബലവും എന്നെന്നേക്കും ഉണ്ടാകട്ടെ എന്നു പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all that is in them, saying: "To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power, for ever and ever!"
chapters.nkjv: And every creature which is in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, I heard saying: "Blessing and honor and glory and power Be to Him who sits on the throne, And to the Lamb, forever and ever!"
chapters.kjv: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

chapters.ml: നാലു ജീവികളും: ആമേൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു; മൂപ്പന്മാർ വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The four living creatures said, "Amen," and the elders fell down and worshiped.
chapters.nkjv: Then the four living creatures said, "Amen!" And the twenty-four elders fell down and worshiped Him who lives forever and ever.
chapters.kjv: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

chapters.ml: കുഞ്ഞാടു മുദ്രകളിൽ ഒന്നു പൊട്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ: നീ വരിക എന്നു നാലു ജീവികളിൽ ഒന്നു ഇടി മുഴക്കം പോലെ പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, "Come!"
chapters.nkjv: Now I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals; and I heard one of the four living creatures saying with a voice like thunder, "Come and see."
chapters.kjv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ ഒരു വെള്ളക്കുതിരയെ കണ്ടു; അതിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഒരു വില്ലുണ്ടു; അവന്നു ഒരു കിരീടവും ലഭിച്ചു; അവൻ ജയിക്കുന്നവനായും ജയിപ്പാനായും പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: I looked, and there before me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.
chapters.nkjv: And I looked, and behold, a white horse. He who sat on it had a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and to conquer.
chapters.kjv: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രണ്ടാം മുദ്ര പൊട്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ: വരിക എന്നു രണ്ടാം ജീവി പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"
chapters.nkjv: When He opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, "Come and see."
chapters.kjv: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ചുവന്നതായ മറ്റൊരു കുതിര പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അതിന്റെ പുറത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്നു മനുഷ്യർ അന്യോന്യം കൊല്ലുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു സമാധാനം എടുത്തുകളയേണ്ടതിന്നു അധികാരം ലഭിച്ചു; ഒരു വലിയ വാളും അവന്നു കിട്ടി.
chapters.niv: Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. To him was given a large sword.
chapters.nkjv: Another horse, fiery red, went out. And it was granted to the one who sat on it to take peace from the earth, and that people should kill one another; and there was given to him a great sword.
chapters.kjv: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാം മുദ്രപൊട്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ: വരിക എന്നു മൂന്നാം ജീവി പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു. അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ ഒരു കറുത്ത കുതിരയെ കണ്ടു; അതിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ ഒരു തുലാസു കയ്യിൽ പിടിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come!" I looked, and there before me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.
chapters.nkjv: When He opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come and see." So I looked, and behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a pair of scales in his hand.
chapters.kjv: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

chapters.ml: ഒരു പണത്തിന്നു ഒരിടങ്ങഴി കോതമ്പു; ഒരു പണത്തിന്നു മൂന്നിടങ്ങഴി യവം; എന്നാൽ എണ്ണെക്കും വീഞ്ഞിന്നും കേടു വരുത്തരുതു എന്നു നാലു ജീവികളുടെയും നടുവിൽ നിന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദം ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, "Two pounds of wheat for a day’s wages, and six pounds of barley for a day’s wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!"
chapters.nkjv: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, "A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius; and do not harm the oil and the wine."
chapters.kjv: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

chapters.ml: നാലാം മുദ്ര പൊട്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ: വരിക എന്നു നാലാം ജീവി പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come!"
chapters.nkjv: When He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, "Come and see."
chapters.kjv: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ മഞ്ഞനിറമുള്ളോരു കുതിരയെ കണ്ടു; അതിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്നു മരണം എന്നു പേർ; പാതാളം അവനെ പിന്തുടർന്നു; അവർക്കു വാളുകൊണ്ടും ക്ഷാമംകൊണ്ടും മഹാവ്യാധികൊണ്ടും ഭൂമിയിലെ കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ടും കൊന്നുകളവാൻ ഭൂമിയുടെ കാലംശത്തിന്മേൽ അധികാരം ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: I looked, and there before me was a pale horse! Its rider was named Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: So I looked, and behold, a pale horse. And the name of him who sat on it was Death, and Hades followed with him. And power was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword, with hunger, with death, and by the beasts of the earth.
chapters.kjv: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഞ്ചാം മുദ്ര പൊട്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ: ദൈവവചനം നിമിത്തവും തങ്ങൾ പറഞ്ഞ സാക്ഷ്യം ഹേതുവായും അറുക്കപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ ആത്മാക്കളെ ഞാൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കീഴിൽ കണ്ടു;
chapters.niv: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.
chapters.nkjv: When He opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony which they held.
chapters.kjv: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധനും സത്യവാനും ആയ നാഥാ, ഭൂമിയിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവരോടു ഞങ്ങളുടെ രക്തത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു നീ എത്രത്തോളം ന്യായവിധിയും പ്രതികാരവും നടത്താതെയിരിക്കും എന്നു അവർ ഉറക്കെ നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They called out in a loud voice, "How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?"
chapters.nkjv: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, "How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?"
chapters.kjv: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ അവരിൽ ഓരോരുത്തന്നും വെള്ളനിലയങ്കി കൊടുത്തു; അവരെപ്പോലെ കൊല്ലപ്പെടുവാനിരിക്കുന്ന സഹഭൃത്യന്മാരും സഹോദരന്മാരും വന്നുതികയുവോളം അല്പകാലം കൂടെ സ്വസ്ഥമായി പാർക്കേണം എന്നു അവർക്കു അരുളപ്പാടുണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers and sisters, were killed just as they had been.
chapters.nkjv: Then a white robe was given to each of them; and it was said to them that they should rest a little while longer, until both thenumberof their fellow servants and their brethren, who would be killed as they were, was completed.
chapters.kjv: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled.

chapters.ml: ആറാം മുദ്ര പൊട്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ വലിയോരു ഭൂകമ്പം ഉണ്ടായി; സൂര്യൻ കരിമ്പടംപോലെ കറുത്തു; ചന്ദ്രൻ മുഴുവനും രക്തതുല്യമായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,
chapters.nkjv: I looked when He opened the sixth seal, and behold, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became like blood.
chapters.kjv: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

chapters.ml: അത്തിവൃക്ഷം പെരുങ്കാറ്റുകൊണ്ടു കുലുങ്ങീട്ടു കായി ഉതിർക്കുമ്പോലെ ആകാശത്തിലെ നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ ഭൂമിയിൽ വീണു.
chapters.niv: and the stars in the sky fell to earth, as figs drop from a fig tree when shaken by a strong wind.
chapters.nkjv: And the stars of heaven fell to the earth, as a fig tree drops its late figs when it is shaken by a mighty wind.
chapters.kjv: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.

chapters.ml: പുസ്തകച്ചുരുൾ ചുരുട്ടുംപോലെ ആകാശം മാറിപ്പോയി; എല്ലാമലയും ദ്വീപും സ്വസ്ഥാനത്തുനിന്നു ഇളകിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: The heavens receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sky receded as a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
chapters.kjv: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാരും മഹത്തുക്കളും സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരും ധനവാന്മാരും ബലവാന്മാരും സകലദാസനും സ്വതന്ത്രനും ഗുഹകളിലും മലപ്പാറകളിലും ഒളിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു മലകളോടും പാറകളോടും;
chapters.niv: Then the kings of the earth, the princes, the generals, the rich, the mighty, and everyone else, both slave and free, hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
chapters.nkjv: And the kings of the earth, the great men, the rich men, the commanders, the mighty men, every slave and every free man, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains,
chapters.kjv: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

chapters.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ മേൽ വീഴുവിൻ; സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ മുഖം കാണാതവണ്ണവും കുഞ്ഞാട്ടിന്റെ കോപം തട്ടാതവണ്ണവും ഞങ്ങളെ മറെപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: They called to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!
chapters.nkjv: and said to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of Him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!
chapters.kjv: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ മഹാകോപദിവസം വന്നു; ആർക്കു നില്പാൻ കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can withstand it?"
chapters.nkjv: For the great day of His wrath has come, and who is able to stand?"
chapters.kjv: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെശേഷം ഭൂമിമേലും കടലിന്മേലും യാതൊരു വൃക്ഷത്തിന്മേലും കാറ്റു ഊതാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു നാലു ദൂതന്മാർ ഭൂമിയിലെ നാലു കാറ്റും പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു ഭൂമിയുടെ നാലു കോണിലും നില്ക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.
chapters.nkjv: After these things I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, on the sea, or on any tree.
chapters.kjv: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു ദൂതൻ ജീവനുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുദ്രയുമായി കിഴക്കുനിന്നു കയറുന്നതും കണ്ടു. അവൻ ഭൂമിക്കും സമുദ്രത്തിന്നും കേടുവരുത്തുവാൻ അധികാരം ലഭിച്ച നാലു ദൂതന്മാരോടു:
chapters.niv: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God. And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was granted to harm the earth and the sea,
chapters.kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
