chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ നെറ്റിയിൽ ഞങ്ങൾ മുദ്രയിട്ടു കഴിയുവോളം ഭൂമിക്കും സമൂദ്രത്തിന്നും വൃക്ഷങ്ങൾക്കും കേടുവരുത്തരുതു എന്നു ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: "Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God."
chapters.nkjv: saying, "Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees till we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads."
chapters.kjv: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

chapters.ml: മുദ്രയേറ്റവരുടെ എണ്ണവും ഞാൻ കേട്ടു; യിസ്രായേൽമക്കളുടെ സകല ഗോത്രത്തിലും നിന്നു മുദ്രയേറ്റവർ നൂറ്റിനാല്പത്തിനാലായിരം പേർ.
chapters.niv: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.
chapters.nkjv: And I heard the number of those who were sealed. One hundred and forty-four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel were sealed:
chapters.kjv: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

chapters.ml: യെഹൂദാഗോത്രത്തിൽ മുദ്രയേറ്റവർ പന്തീരായിരം; രൂബേൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം; ഗാദ് ഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം;
chapters.niv: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,
chapters.nkjv: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand were sealed;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.

chapters.ml: ആശേർഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം; നപ്താലിഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം; മനശ്ശെഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം;
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,
chapters.nkjv: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand were sealed;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.

chapters.ml: ശിമെയോൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം; ലേവി ഗോത്രത്തില്‍ പന്തീരായിരം; യിസ്സാഖാർ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം;
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,
chapters.nkjv: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand were sealed;
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.

chapters.ml: സെബൂലോൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം; യോസേഫ് ഗോത്രത്തിൽ പന്തീരായിരം; ബെന്യാമീൻ ഗോത്രത്തിൽ മുദ്രയേറ്റവർ പന്തിരായിരം പേർ.
chapters.niv: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.
chapters.nkjv: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
chapters.kjv: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

chapters.ml: ഇതിന്റെ ശേഷം സകല ജാതികളിലും ഗോത്രങ്ങളിലും വംശങ്ങളിലും ഭാഷകളിലുംനിന്നു ഉള്ളതായി ആർക്കും എണ്ണിക്കൂടാത്ത ഒരു മഹാപുരുഷാരം വെള്ളനിലയങ്കി ധരിച്ചു കയ്യിൽ കുരുത്തോലയുമായി സിംഹാസനത്തിന്നും കുഞ്ഞാടിന്നും മുമ്പാകെ നില്ക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: After this I looked, and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and were holding palm branches in their hands.
chapters.nkjv: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could number, of all nations, tribes, peoples, and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palm branches in their hands,
chapters.kjv: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

chapters.ml: രക്ഷ എന്നുള്ളതു സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവനായ നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെയും കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെയും ദാനം എന്നു അവർ അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ ആർത്തുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And they cried out in a loud voice: "Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."
chapters.nkjv: and crying out with a loud voice, saying, "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
chapters.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

chapters.ml: സകലദൂതന്മാരും സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെയും മൂപ്പന്മാരുടെയും നാലു ജീവികളുടെയും ചുറ്റും നിന്നു സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ കവിണ്ണു വീണു; ആമേൻ;
chapters.niv: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
chapters.nkjv: All the angels stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
chapters.kjv: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

chapters.ml: നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു എന്നെന്നേക്കും സ്തുതിയും മഹത്വവും ജ്ഞാനവും സ്തോത്രവും ബഹുമാനവും ശക്തിയും ബലവും; ആമേൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ദൈവത്തെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: saying: "Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God for ever and ever. Amen!"
chapters.nkjv: saying: "Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom, Thanksgiving and honor and power and might, Be to our God forever and ever. Amen."
chapters.kjv: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

chapters.ml: മൂപ്പന്മാരിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ എന്നോടു: വെള്ളനിലയങ്കി ധരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഇവർ ആർ? എവിടെ നിന്നു വന്നു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then one of the elders asked me, "These in white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?"
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the elders answered, saying to me, "Who are these arrayed in white robes, and where did they come from?"
chapters.kjv: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

chapters.ml: യജമാനൻ അറിയുമല്ലോ എന്നു ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞതിന്നു അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇവർ മഹാകഷ്ടത്തിൽനിന്നു വന്നവർ; കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെ രക്തത്തിൽ തങ്ങളുടെ അങ്കി അലക്കി വെളുപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I answered, "Sir, you know." And he said, "These are they who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
chapters.nkjv: And I said to him, "Sir, you know." So he said to me, "These are the ones who come out of the great tribulation, and washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
chapters.kjv: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

chapters.ml: അതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൻ മുമ്പിൽ ഇരുന്നു അവന്റെ ആലയത്തിൽ രാപ്പകൽ അവനെ ആരാധിക്കുന്നു; സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ അവർക്കു കൂടാരം ആയിരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Therefore, "they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will shelter them with his presence.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and serve Him day and night in His temple. And He who sits on the throne will dwell among them.
chapters.kjv: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

chapters.ml: ഇനി അവർക്കു വിശക്കയില്ല ദാഹിക്കയും ഇല്ല; വെയിലും യാതൊരു ചൂടും അവരുടെ മേൽ തട്ടുകയുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: ‘Never again will they hunger; never again will they thirst. The sun will not beat down on them,’ nor any scorching heat.
chapters.nkjv: They shall neither hunger anymore nor thirst anymore; the sun shall not strike them, nor any heat;
chapters.kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

chapters.ml: സിംഹാസനത്തിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യേ ഉള്ള കുഞ്ഞാടു അവരെ മേച്ചു ജീവജലത്തിന്റെ ഉറവുകളിലേക്കു നടത്തുകയും ദൈവം താൻ അവരുടെ കണ്ണിൽനിന്നു കണ്ണുനീർ എല്ലാം തുടെച്ചുകളകയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; ‘he will lead them to springs of living water.’ ‘And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ "
chapters.nkjv: for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and lead them to living fountains of waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
chapters.kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഏഴാം മുദ്രപൊട്ടിച്ചപ്പോൾ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ഏകദേശം അര മണിക്കൂറോളം മൌനത ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
chapters.nkjv: When He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
chapters.kjv: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ ഏഴു ദൂതന്മാർ നില്ക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അവർക്കു ഏഴു കാഹളം ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
chapters.nkjv: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and to them were given seven trumpets.
chapters.kjv: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു ദൂതൻ ഒരു സ്വർണ്ണധൂപകലശവുമായി വന്നു യാഗപീഠത്തിന്നരികെ നിന്നു. സീംഹാസനത്തിൻ മുമ്പിലുള്ള സ്വർണ്ണപീഠത്തിൻ മേൽ സകലവിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെയും പ്രാർത്ഥനയോടു ചേർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വളരെ ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം അവന്നു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, with the prayers of all God’s people, on the golden altar in front of the throne.
chapters.nkjv: Then another angel, having a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
chapters.kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

chapters.ml: ധൂപവർഗ്ഗത്തിന്റെ പൂക വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ പ്രാർത്ഥനയോടുകൂടെ ദൂതന്റെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ദൈവസന്നിധിയിലേക്കു കയറി.
chapters.niv: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God’s people, went up before God from the angel’s hand.
chapters.nkjv: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, ascended before God from the angel’s hand.
chapters.kjv: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ ധൂപകലശം എടുത്തു യാഗപീഠത്തിലെ കനൽ നിറെച്ചു ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു എറിഞ്ഞു; ഉടനെ ഇടിമുഴക്കവും നാദവും മിന്നലും ഭൂകമ്പവും ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it on the earth; and there came peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning and an earthquake.
chapters.nkjv: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it to the earth. And there were noises, thunderings, lightnings, and an earthquake.
chapters.kjv: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു കാഹളമുള്ള ദൂതന്മാർ ഏഴുവരും കാഹളം ഊതുവാൻ ഒരുങ്ങിനിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
chapters.nkjv: So the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
chapters.kjv: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തവൻ ഊതി; അപ്പോൾ രക്തം കലർന്ന കല്മഴയും തീയും ഭൂമിമേൽ ചൊരിഞ്ഞിട്ടു ഭൂമിയിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു വെന്തുപോയി; വൃക്ഷങ്ങളിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു വെന്തുപോയി; എല്ലാ പച്ചപ്പുല്ലും വെന്തുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
chapters.nkjv: The first angel sounded: And hail and fire followed, mingled with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. And a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
chapters.kjv: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ ഊതി; അപ്പോൾ തീ കത്തുന്ന വൻമലപോലെയൊന്നു സമുദ്രത്തിലേക്കു എറിഞ്ഞിട്ടു കടലിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു രക്തമായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain, all ablaze, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,
chapters.nkjv: Then the second angel sounded: And something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.
chapters.kjv: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

chapters.ml: സമുദ്രത്തിൽ പ്രാണനുള്ള സൃഷ്ടികളിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു ചത്തുപോയി; കപ്പലുകളിലും മൂന്നിലൊന്നു ചേതം വന്നു.
chapters.niv: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
chapters.nkjv: And a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
chapters.kjv: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ ഊതി; അപ്പോൾ ദീപം പോലെ ജ്വലിക്കുന്ന ഒരു മഹാ നക്ഷത്രം ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു വീണു; നദികളിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നിന്മേലും നീരുറവുകളിന്മേലും ആയിരുന്നു വീണതു.
chapters.niv: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water—
chapters.nkjv: Then the third angel sounded: And a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
chapters.kjv: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

chapters.ml: ആ നക്ഷത്രത്തിന്നു കാഞ്ഞിരം എന്നു പേർ; വെള്ളത്തിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു കാഞ്ഞിരംപോലെ ആയി; വെള്ളം കൈപ്പായതിനാൽ മനുഷ്യരിൽ പലരും മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: the name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter, and many people died from the waters that had become bitter.
chapters.nkjv: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many men died from the water, because it was made bitter.
chapters.kjv: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

chapters.ml: നാലാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ ഊതി; അപ്പോൾ സൂര്യനിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നിനും ചന്ദ്രനിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നിന്നും നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നിന്നും ബാധ തട്ടി; അവയിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു ഇരുണ്ടുപോയി രാവും പകലും മൂന്നിലൊന്നു വെളിച്ചമില്ലാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.
chapters.nkjv: Then the fourth angel sounded: And a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them were darkened. A third of the day did not shine, and likewise the night.
chapters.kjv: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഒരു കഴുകു: ഇനി കാഹളം ഊതുവാനുള്ള മൂന്നു ദൂതന്മാരുടെ കാഹളനാദം ഹേതുവായി ഭൂവാസികൾക്കു കഷ്ടം, കഷ്ടം, കഷ്ടം എന്നു ഉറക്കെ പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടു ആകാശമദ്ധ്യേ പറക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കാൺകയും കേൾക്കയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: "Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!"
chapters.nkjv: And I looked, and I heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, "Woe, woe, woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the remaining blasts of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound!"
chapters.kjv: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ ഊതി; അപ്പോൾ ഒരു നക്ഷത്രം ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു ഭൂമിയിൽ വീണുകിടക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അവന്നു അഗാധകൂപത്തിന്റെ താക്കോൽ ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.
chapters.nkjv: Then the fifth angel sounded: And I saw a star fallen from heaven to the earth. To him was given the key to the bottomless pit.
chapters.kjv: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അഗാധകൂപം തുറന്നു; ഉടനെ പെരുഞ്ചൂളയിലെ പുകപോലെ കൂപത്തിൽനിന്നു പുകപൊങ്ങി; കൂപത്തിന്റെ പുകയാൽ സൂര്യനും ആകാശവും ഇരുണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: When he opened the Abyss, smoke rose from it like the smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the Abyss.
chapters.nkjv: And he opened the bottomless pit, and smoke arose out of the pit like the smoke of a great furnace. So the sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke of the pit.
chapters.kjv: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

chapters.ml: പുകയിൽനിന്നു വെട്ടുക്കിളി ഭൂമിയിൽ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അതിന്നു ഭൂമിയിലെ തേളിന്നുള്ള ശക്തി ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: And out of the smoke locusts came down on the earth and were given power like that of scorpions of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: Then out of the smoke locusts came upon the earth. And to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
chapters.kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

chapters.ml: നെറ്റിയിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുദ്രയില്ലാത്ത മനുഷ്യർക്കല്ലാതെ ഭൂമിയിലെ പുല്ലിന്നും പച്ചയായതൊന്നിന്നും യാതൊരു വൃക്ഷത്തിന്നും കേടുവരുത്തരുതു എന്നു അതിന്നു കല്പന ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
chapters.nkjv: They were commanded not to harm the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only those men who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
chapters.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

chapters.ml: അവരെ കൊല്ലുവാനല്ല, അഞ്ചുമാസം ദണ്ഡിപ്പിപ്പാനത്രേ അതിന്നു അധികാരം ലഭിച്ചതു; അവരുടെ വേദന, തേൾ മനുഷ്യനെ കുത്തുമ്പോൾ ഉള്ള വേദനപോലെ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: They were not allowed to kill them but only to torture them for five months. And the agony they suffered was like that of the sting of a scorpion when it strikes.
chapters.nkjv: And they were not given authority to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a man.
chapters.kjv: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

chapters.ml: ആ കാലത്തു മനുഷ്യർ മരണം അന്വേഷിക്കും; കാൺകയില്ലതാനും; മരിപ്പാൻ കൊതിക്കും; മരണം അവരെ വിട്ടു ഓടിപ്പോകും.
chapters.niv: During those days people will seek death but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.
chapters.nkjv: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
chapters.kjv: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.

chapters.ml: വെട്ടുക്കിളിയുടെ രൂപം യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു ചമയിച്ച കുതിരെക്കു സമം; തലയിൽ പൊൻകിരീടം ഉള്ളതുപോലെയും മുഖം മാനുഷമുഖംപോലെയും ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold, and their faces resembled human faces.
chapters.nkjv: The shape of the locusts was like horses prepared for battle. On their heads were crowns of something like gold, and their faces were like the faces of men.
chapters.kjv: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീകളുടെ മുടിപോലെ അതിന്നു മുടി ഉണ്ടു; പല്ലു സിംഹത്തിന്റെ പല്ലുപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.
chapters.nkjv: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.
chapters.kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

chapters.ml: ഇരിമ്പുകവചംപോലെ കവചം ഉണ്ടു; ചിറകിന്റെ ഒച്ച പടെക്കു ഓടുന്ന അനേകം കുതിരത്തേരുകളുടെ ഒച്ചപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
chapters.nkjv: And they had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots with many horses running into battle.
chapters.kjv: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

chapters.ml: തേളിന്നുള്ളതുപോലെ വാലും വിഷമുള്ളും ഉണ്ടു; മനുഷ്യരെ അഞ്ചുമാസം ഉപദ്രവിപ്പാൻ അതിന്നുള്ള ശക്തി വാലിൽ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They had tails with stingers, like scorpions, and in their tails they had power to torment people for five months.
chapters.nkjv: They had tails like scorpions, and there were stings in their tails. Their power was to hurt men five months.
chapters.kjv: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.

chapters.ml: അഗാധദൂതൻ അതിന്നു രാജാവായിരുന്നു; അവന്നു എബ്രായഭാഷയിൽ അബദ്ദോൻ എന്നും യവനഭാഷയിൽ അപ്പൊല്ലുവോൻ എന്നും പേർ.
chapters.niv: They had as king over them the angel of the Abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon and in Greek is Apollyon (that is, Destroyer).
chapters.nkjv: And they had as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon, but in Greek he has the name Apollyon.
chapters.kjv: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.

chapters.ml: കഷ്ടം ഒന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞു; ഇനി രണ്ടു കഷ്ടം പിന്നാലെ വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.
chapters.nkjv: One woe is past. Behold, still two more woes are coming after these things.
chapters.kjv: One woe is past; and , behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

chapters.ml: ആറാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ ഊതി; അപ്പോൾ ദൈവസന്നിധിയിലെ സ്വർണ്ണ പീഠത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുകളിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദം കാഹളമുള്ള ആറാം ദൂതനോടു:
chapters.niv: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar that is before God.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sixth angel sounded: And I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
chapters.kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

chapters.ml: യുഫ്രാത്തേസ് എന്ന മഹാനദീതീരത്തു ബന്ധിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന നാലു ദൂതന്മാരെയും അഴിച്ചുവിടുക എന്നു പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
chapters.nkjv: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
chapters.kjv: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.

chapters.ml: ഉടനെ മനുഷ്യരിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നിനെ കൊല്ലുവാൻ ഇന്ന ആണ്ടു, മാസം, ദിവസം, നാഴികെക്കു ഒരുങ്ങിയിരുന്ന നാലു ദൂതന്മാരെയും അഴിച്ചുവിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: And the four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.
chapters.nkjv: So the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, were released to kill a third of mankind.
chapters.kjv: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.

chapters.ml: കുതിരപ്പടയുടെ സംഖ്യപതിനായിരം മടങ്ങു ഇരുപതിനായിരം എന്നു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The number of the mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.
chapters.nkjv: Now the number of the army of the horsemen was two hundred million; I heard the number of them.
chapters.kjv: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കുതിരകളെയും കുതിരപ്പുറത്തു ഇരിക്കുന്നവരെയും ദർശനത്തിൽ കണ്ടതു എങ്ങനെ എന്നാൽ അവർക്കു തീനിറവും രക്തനീലവും ഗന്ധകവർണ്ണവുമായ കവചം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു; കുതിരകളുടെ തല സിംഹങ്ങളുടെ തലപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു; വായിൽ നിന്നു തീയും പുകയും ഗന്ധകവും പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The horses and riders I saw in my vision looked like this: Their breastplates were fiery red, dark blue, and yellow as sulfur. The heads of the horses resembled the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire, smoke and sulfur.
chapters.nkjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision: those who sat on them had breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of the horses were like the heads of lions; and out of their mouths came fire, smoke, and brimstone.
chapters.kjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

chapters.ml: വായിൽ നിന്നു പറപ്പെടുന്ന തീ, പുക, ഗന്ധകം എന്നീ മൂന്നു ബാധയാൽ മനുഷ്യരിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നു മരിച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke and sulfur that came out of their mouths.
chapters.nkjv: By these three plagues a third of mankind was killed—by the fire and the smoke and the brimstone which came out of their mouths.
chapters.kjv: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.

chapters.ml: കുതിരകളുടെ ശക്തി വായിലും വാലിലും ആയിരുന്നു; വാലോ സർപ്പത്തെപ്പോലെയും തലയുള്ളതും ആയിരുന്നു;
chapters.niv: The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails were like snakes, having heads with which they inflict injury.
chapters.nkjv: For their power is in their mouth and in their tails; for their tails are like serpents, having heads; and with them they do harm.
chapters.kjv: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

chapters.ml: ഇവയാലത്രേ കേടു വരുത്തുന്നതു. ഈ ബാധകളാൽ മരിച്ചുപോകാത്ത ശേഷം മനുഷ്യരോ ദുർഭൂതങ്ങളെയും, കാണ്മാനും കേൾപ്പാനും നടപ്പാനും വഹിയാത്ത പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, ചെമ്പു, കല്ലു, മരം ഇവകൊണ്ടുള്ള ബിംബങ്ങളെയും നമസ്കരിക്കാതവണ്ണം തങ്ങളുടെ കൈപ്പണി വിട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: The rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the work of their hands; they did not stop worshiping demons, and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood—idols that cannot see or hear or walk.
chapters.nkjv: But the rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and idols of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.
chapters.kjv: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

chapters.ml: തങ്ങളുടെ കുലപാതകം, ക്ഷുദ്രം, ദുർന്നടപ്പു, മോഷണം എന്നിവ വിട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic arts, their sexual immorality or their thefts.
chapters.nkjv: And they did not repent of their murders or their sorceries or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
chapters.kjv: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

chapters.ml: ബലവാനായ മറ്റൊരു ദൂതൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നിറങ്ങുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു. അവൻ മേഘം ഉടുത്തും തലയിൽ ആകാശവില്ലുധരിച്ചും മുഖം സൂര്യനെപ്പോലെയും കാൽ തീത്തൂണുപോലെയും ഉള്ളവൻ.
chapters.niv: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was robed in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like fiery pillars.
chapters.nkjv: I saw still another mighty angel coming down from heaven, clothed with a cloud. And a rainbow was on his head, his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
chapters.kjv: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കയ്യിൽ തുറന്നോരു ചെറുപുസ്തകം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അവൻ വലങ്കാൽ സമുദ്രത്തിന്മേലും
chapters.niv: He was holding a little scroll, which lay open in his hand. He planted his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,
chapters.nkjv: He had a little book open in his hand. And he set his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,
chapters.kjv: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,

chapters.ml: ഇടങ്കാൽ ഭൂമിമേലും വെച്ചു, സിംഹം അലറുംപോലെ അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ ആർത്തു; ആർത്തപ്പോൾ ഏഴു ഇടിയും നാദം മുഴക്കി.
chapters.niv: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.
chapters.nkjv: and cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roars. When he cried out, seven thunders uttered their voices.
chapters.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ഇടി നാദം മുഴക്കിയപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ എഴുതുവാൻ ഭാവിച്ചു; എന്നാൽ ഏഴു ഇടി മുഴക്കിയതു എഴുതാതെ മുദ്രയിട്ടേക്ക എന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരുശബ്ദം കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say, "Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down."
chapters.nkjv: Now when the seven thunders uttered their voices, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, "Seal up the things which the seven thunders uttered, and do not write them."
chapters.kjv: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

chapters.ml: സമുദ്രത്തിന്മേലും ഭൂമിമേലും നില്ക്കുന്നവനായി ഞാൻ കണ്ട ദൂതൻ വലങ്കൈ ആകാശത്തെക്കു ഉയർത്തി:
chapters.niv: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.
chapters.nkjv: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised up his hand to heaven
chapters.kjv: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,

chapters.ml: ഇനി കാലം ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല; ഏഴാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ കാഹളം ഊതുവാനിരിക്കുന്ന നാദത്തിന്റെ കാലത്തു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മർമ്മം അവൻ തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരായ പ്രവാചകന്മാർക്കു അറിയിച്ചു കൊടുത്തതുപോലെ നിവൃത്തിയാകുമെന്നു ആകാശവും അതിലുള്ളതും
chapters.niv: And he swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it, and said, "There will be no more delay!
chapters.nkjv: and swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there should be delay no longer,
chapters.kjv: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയും അതിലുള്ളതും സമുദ്രവും അതിലുള്ളതും സൃഷ്ടിച്ചവനായി എന്നെന്നേക്കും ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവനെച്ചൊല്ലി സത്യം ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets."
chapters.nkjv: but in the days of the sounding of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, the mystery of God would be finished, as He declared to His servants the prophets.
chapters.kjv: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു കേട്ട ശബ്ദം പിന്നെയും എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: നീ ചെന്നു സമുദ്രത്തിന്മേലും ഭൂമിമേലും നില്ക്കുന്ന ദൂതന്റെ കയ്യിൽ തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്ന പുസ്തകം വാങ്ങുക എന്നു കല്പിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me once more: "Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."
chapters.nkjv: Then the voice which I heard from heaven spoke to me again and said, "Go, take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദൂതന്റെ അടുക്കൽ ചെന്നു ആ ചെറുപുസ്തകം തരുവാൻ പറഞ്ഞു. അവൻ എന്നോടു: നീ ഇതു വാങ്ങി തിന്നുക; അതു നിന്റെ വയറ്റിനെ കൈപ്പിക്കും എങ്കിലും വായിൽ തേൻ പോലെ മധുരിക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, "Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach sour, but ‘in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.’ "
chapters.nkjv: So I went to the angel and said to him, "Give me the little book." And he said to me, "Take and eat it; and it will make your stomach bitter, but it will be as sweet as honey in your mouth."
chapters.kjv: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it , and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ദൂതന്റെ കയ്യിൽ നിന്നു ചെറുപുസ്തകം വാങ്ങിതിന്നു; അതു എന്റെ വായിൽ തേൻ പോലെ മധുരമായിരുന്നു; തിന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ എന്റെ വയറു കൈച്ചുപോയി.
chapters.niv: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.
chapters.nkjv: Then I took the little book out of the angel’s hand and ate it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. But when I had eaten it, my stomach became bitter.
chapters.kjv: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നോടു: നീ ഇനിയും അനേകം വംശങ്ങളെയും ജാതികളെയും ഭാഷകളെയും രാജാക്കന്മാരെയും കുറിച്ചു പ്രവചിക്കേണ്ടിവരും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then I was told, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings."
chapters.nkjv: And he said to me, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, tongues, and kings."
chapters.kjv: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ദണ്ഡുപോലെയുള്ള ഒരു കോൽ എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ കിട്ടി കല്പന ലഭിച്ചതു: നീ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ആലയത്തെയും യാഗപീഠത്തെയും അതിൽ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നവരെയും അളക്കുക.
chapters.niv: I was given a reed like a measuring rod and was told, "Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, with its worshipers.
chapters.nkjv: Then I was given a reed like a measuring rod. And the angel stood, saying, "Rise and measure the temple of God, the altar, and those who worship there.
chapters.kjv: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

chapters.ml: ആലയത്തിന്നു പുറത്തുള്ള പ്രാകാരം അളക്കാതെ വിട്ടേക്ക; അതു ജാതികൾക്കു കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ വിശുദ്ധനഗരത്തെ നാല്പത്തുരണ്ടു മാസം ചവിട്ടും.
chapters.niv: But exclude the outer court; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample on the holy city for 42 months.
chapters.nkjv: But leave out the court which is outside the temple, and do not measure it, for it has been given to the Gentiles. And they will tread the holy city underfoot for forty-two months.
chapters.kjv: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

chapters.ml: അന്നു ഞാൻ എന്റെ രണ്ടു സാക്ഷികൾക്കും വരം നല്കും; അവർ രട്ട് ഉടുത്തുകൊണ്ടു ആയിരത്തിരുനൂറ്ററുപതു ദിവസം പ്രവചിക്കും.
chapters.niv: And I will appoint my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth."
chapters.nkjv: And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred and sixty days, clothed in sackcloth."
chapters.kjv: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഭൂമിയുടെ കർത്താവിന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽ നില്ക്കുന്ന രണ്ടു ഒലീവ് വൃക്ഷവും രണ്ടു നിലവിളക്കും ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They are "the two olive trees" and the two lampstands, and "they stand before the Lord of the earth."
chapters.nkjv: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.
chapters.kjv: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

chapters.ml: ആരെങ്കിലും അവർക്കു ദോഷം ചെയ്‍വാൻ ഇച്ഛിച്ചാൽ അവരുടെ വായിൽ നിന്നു തീ പുറപ്പെട്ടു അവരുടെ ശത്രുക്കളെ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളയും; അവർക്കു ദോഷം വരുത്തുവാൻ ഇച്ഛിക്കുന്നവൻ ഇങ്ങനെ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവരും.
chapters.niv: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.
chapters.nkjv: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouth and devours their enemies. And if anyone wants to harm them, he must be killed in this manner.
chapters.kjv: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ പ്രവചനകാലത്തു മഴപെയ്യാതവണ്ണം ആകാശം അടെച്ചുകളവാൻ അവർക്കു അധികാരം ഉണ്ടു. വെള്ളത്തെ രക്തമാക്കുവാനും ഇച്ഛിക്കുമ്പോഴൊക്കെയും സകലബാധകൊണ്ടും ഭൂമിയെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിപ്പാനും അധികാരം ഉണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: They have power to shut up the heavens so that it will not rain during the time they are prophesying; and they have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.
chapters.nkjv: These have power to shut heaven, so that no rain falls in the days of their prophecy; and they have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to strike the earth with all plagues, as often as they desire.
chapters.kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

chapters.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ സാക്ഷ്യം തികെച്ചശേഷം ആഴത്തിൽ നിന്നു കയറി വരുന്ന മൃഗം അവരോടു പടവെട്ടി അവരെ ജയിച്ചു കൊന്നുകളയും.
chapters.niv: Now when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will attack them, and overpower and kill them.
chapters.nkjv: When they finish their testimony, the beast that ascends out of the bottomless pit will make war against them, overcome them, and kill them.
chapters.kjv: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ കർത്താവു ക്രൂശിക്കപ്പെട്ടതും ആത്മികമായി സൊദോം എന്നും മിസ്രയീം എന്നും പേരുള്ളതുമായ മഹാനഗരത്തിന്റെ വീഥിയിൽ അവരുടെ ശവം കിടക്കും.
chapters.niv: Their bodies will lie in the public square of the great city—which is figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where also their Lord was crucified.
chapters.nkjv: And their dead bodies willlie in the street of the great city which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
chapters.kjv: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

chapters.ml: സകലവംശക്കാരും ഗോത്രക്കാരും ഭാഷക്കാരും ജാതിക്കാരും അവരുടെ ശവം മൂന്നരദിവസം കാണും; അവരുടെ ശവം കല്ലറയിൽ വെപ്പാൻ സമ്മതിക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: For three and a half days some from every people, tribe, language and nation will gaze on their bodies and refuse them burial.
chapters.nkjv: Then those from the peoples, tribes, tongues, and nations will see their dead bodies three-and-a-half days, and not allow their dead bodies to be put into graves.
chapters.kjv: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.

chapters.ml: ഈ പ്രവാചകന്മാർ ഇരുവരും ഭൂമിയിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവരെ ദണ്ഡിപ്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു ഭൂവാസികൾ അവർ നിമിത്തം സന്തോഷിച്ചു ആനന്ദിക്കയും അന്യോന്യം സമ്മാനം കൊടുത്തയക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: The inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and will celebrate by sending each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.
chapters.nkjv: And those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, make merry, and send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നര ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം ദൈവത്തിൽനിന്നു ജീവശ്വാസം അവരിൽ വന്നു അവർ കാൽ ഉൂന്നിനിന്നു — അവരെ കണ്ടവർ ഭയപരവശരായിത്തീർന്നു —
chapters.niv: But after the three and a half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and terror struck those who saw them.
chapters.nkjv: Now after the three-and-a-half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell on those who saw them.
chapters.kjv: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.

chapters.ml: ഇവിടെ കയറിവരുവിൻ എന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരു മഹാശബ്ദം പറയുന്നതു കേട്ടു, അവർ മേഘത്തിൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കു കയറി; അവരുടെ ശത്രുക്കൾ അവരെ നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here." And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies looked on.
chapters.nkjv: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here." And they ascended to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
chapters.kjv: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

chapters.ml: ആ നാഴികയിൽ വലിയോരു ഭൂകമ്പം ഉണ്ടായി; നഗരത്തിൽ പത്തിലൊന്നു ഇടിഞ്ഞുവീണു; ഭൂകമ്പത്തിൽ ഏഴായിരം പേർ മരിച്ചുപോയി; ശേഷിച്ചവർ ഭയപരവശരായി സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ ദൈവത്തിന്നു മഹത്വം കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: At that very hour there was a severe earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
chapters.nkjv: In the same hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. In the earthquake seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were afraid and gave glory to the God of heaven.
chapters.kjv: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തെ കഷ്ടം കഴിഞ്ഞു; മൂന്നാമത്തെ കഷ്ടം വേഗം വരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The second woe has passed; the third woe is coming soon.
chapters.nkjv: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe is coming quickly.
chapters.kjv: The second woe is past; and , behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ ഊതിയപ്പോൾ: ലോകരാജത്വം നമ്മുടെ കർത്താവിന്നും അവന്റെ ക്രിസ്തുവിന്നും ആയിത്തീർന്നിരിക്കുന്നു; അവൻ എന്നെന്നേക്കും വാഴും എന്നു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ഒരു മഹാഘോഷം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, which said: "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign for ever and ever."
chapters.nkjv: Then the seventh angel sounded: And there were loud voices in heaven, saying, "The kingdoms of this world have become thekingdoms of our Lord and of His Christ, and He shall reign forever and ever!"
chapters.kjv: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

chapters.ml: ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ സിംഹാസനങ്ങളിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്ന ഇരുപത്തുനാലു മൂപ്പന്മാരും കവിണ്ണുവീണു ദൈവത്തെ നമസ്കരിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞതു.
chapters.niv: And the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
chapters.nkjv: And the twenty-four elders who sat before God on their thrones fell on their faces and worshiped God,
chapters.kjv: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

chapters.ml: സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള കർത്താവായ ദൈവമേ, ഇരിക്കുന്നവനും ഇരുന്നവനുമായുള്ളോവേ, നീ മഹാശക്തി ധരിച്ചു വാഴുകയാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ നിന്നെ സ്തുതിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: saying: "We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.
chapters.nkjv: saying: "We give You thanks, O Lord God Almighty, The One who is and who was and who is to come, Because You have taken Your great power and reigned.
chapters.kjv: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

chapters.ml: ജാതികൾ കോപിച്ചു: നിന്റെ കോപവും വന്നു: മരിച്ചവരെ ന്യായം വിധിപ്പാനും നിന്റെ ദാസന്മാരായ പ്രവാചകന്മാർക്കും വിശുദ്ധന്മാർക്കും ചെറിയവരും വലിയവരുമായി നിന്റെ ഭക്തന്മാർക്കും പ്രതിഫലം കൊടുപ്പാനും ഭൂമിയെ നശിപ്പിക്കുന്നവരെ നശിപ്പിപ്പാനും ഉള്ള കാലവും വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The nations were angry, and your wrath has come. The time has come for judging the dead, and for rewarding your servants the prophets and your people who revere your name, both great and small— and for destroying those who destroy the earth."
chapters.nkjv: The nations were angry, and Your wrath has come, And the time of the dead, that they should be judged, And that You should reward Your servants the prophets and the saints, And those who fear Your name, small and great, And should destroy those who destroy the earth."
chapters.kjv: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ ദൈവാലയം തുറന്നു, അവന്റെ നിയമപ്പെട്ടകം അവന്റെ ആലയത്തിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷമായി; മിന്നലും നാദവും ഇടിമുഴക്കവും ഭൂകമ്പവും വലിയ കന്മഴയും ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a severe hailstorm.
chapters.nkjv: Then the temple of God was opened in heaven, and the ark of His covenant was seen in His temple. And there were lightnings, noises, thunderings, an earthquake, and great hail.
chapters.kjv: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ വലിയൊരു അടയാളം കാണായി: സൂര്യനെ അണിഞ്ഞോരു സ്ത്രീ; അവളുടെ കാൽക്കീഴ് ചന്ദ്രനും അവളുടെ തലയിൽ പന്ത്രണ്ടു നക്ഷത്രംകൊണ്ടുള്ള കിരീടവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
chapters.nkjv: Now a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a garland of twelve stars.
chapters.kjv: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

chapters.ml: അവൾ ഗർഭിണിയായി നോവുകിട്ടി വേദനപ്പെട്ടു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.
chapters.nkjv: Then being with child, she cried out in labor and in pain to give birth.
chapters.kjv: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ മറ്റൊരു അടയാളം കാണായി: ഏഴു തലയും പത്തു കൊമ്പും തലയിൽ ഏഴു രാജമുടിയുമായി തീനിറമുള്ളോരു മഹാസർപ്പം.
chapters.niv: Then another sign appeared in heaven: an enormous red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on its heads.
chapters.nkjv: And another sign appeared in heaven: behold, a great, fiery red dragon having seven heads and ten horns, and seven diadems on his heads.
chapters.kjv: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ വാൽ ആകാശത്തിലെ നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളിൽ മൂന്നിലൊന്നിനെ വലിച്ചുകൂട്ടി ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു എറിഞ്ഞുകളഞ്ഞു. പ്രസവിപ്പാറായ സ്ത്രീ പ്രസവിച്ച ഉടനെ കുട്ടിയെ തിന്നുകളവാൻ മഹാസർപ്പം അവളുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and flung them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it might devour her child the moment he was born.
chapters.nkjv: His tail drew a third of the stars of heaven and threw them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was ready to give birth, to devour her Child as soon as it was born.
chapters.kjv: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.

chapters.ml: അവൾ സകലജാതികളെയും ഇരിമ്പുകോൽ കൊണ്ടു മേയ്പാനുള്ളോരു ആൺകുട്ടിയെ പ്രസവിച്ചു; കുട്ടി ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അടുക്കലേക്കും അവന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിലേക്കും പെട്ടെന്നു എടുക്കപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who "will rule all the nations with an iron scepter." And her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.
chapters.nkjv: She bore a male Child who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron. And her Child was caught up to God and His throne.
chapters.kjv: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.

chapters.ml: സ്ത്രീ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു ഓടിപ്പോയി; അവിടെ അവളെ ആയിരത്തിരുനൂറ്ററുപതു ദിവസം പോറ്റേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവം ഒരുക്കിയോരു സ്ഥലം അവൾക്കുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place prepared for her by God, where she might be taken care of for 1,260 days.
chapters.nkjv: Then the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that they should feed her there one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
chapters.kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ യുദ്ധം ഉണ്ടായി; മീഖായേലും അവന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരും മഹാസർപ്പത്തോടു പടവെട്ടി; തന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരുമായി മഹാസർപ്പവും പടവെട്ടി ജയിച്ചില്ലതാനും.
chapters.niv: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
chapters.nkjv: And war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought with the dragon; and the dragon and his angels fought,
chapters.kjv: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ അവരുടെ സ്ഥലം പിന്നെ കണ്ടതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: but they did not prevail, nor was a place found for them in heaven any longer.
chapters.kjv: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

chapters.ml: ഭൂതലത്തെ മുഴുവൻ തെറ്റിച്ചുകളയുന്ന പിശാചും സാത്താനും എന്ന മഹാസർപ്പമായ പഴയ പാമ്പിനെ ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു; അവന്റെ ദൂതന്മാരെയും അവനോടു കൂടെ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
chapters.nkjv: So the great dragon was cast out, that serpent of old, called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world; he was cast to the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
chapters.kjv: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ഞാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ ഒരു മഹാശബ്ദം പറഞ്ഞുകേട്ടതു: ഇപ്പോൾ നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ രക്ഷയും ശക്തിയും രാജ്യവും അവന്റെ ക്രിസ്തുവിന്റെ ആധിപത്യവും തുടങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു; നമ്മുടെ സഹോദരന്മാരെ രാപ്പകൽ ദൈവ സന്നിധിയിൽ കുറ്റം ചുമത്തുന്ന അപവാദിയെ തള്ളിയിട്ടുകളഞ്ഞുവല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: "Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Messiah. For the accuser of our brothers and sisters, who accuses them before our God day and night, has been hurled down.
chapters.nkjv: Then I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, "Now salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of His Christ have come, for the accuser of our brethren, who accused them before our God day and night, has been cast down.
chapters.kjv: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

chapters.ml: അവർ അവനെ കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെ രക്തം ഹേതുവായിട്ടും തങ്ങളുടെ സാക്ഷ്യവചനം ഹേതുവായിട്ടും ജയിച്ചു; മരണപര്യന്തം തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാണനെ സ്നേഹിച്ചതുമില്ല.
chapters.niv: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.
chapters.nkjv: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they did not love their lives to the death.
chapters.kjv: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

chapters.ml: ആകയാൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗവും അതിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവരുമായുള്ളോരേ, ആനന്ദിപ്പിൻ; ഭൂമിക്കും സമുദ്രത്തിനും അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം; പിശാചു തനിക്കു അല്പകാലമേയുള്ളു എന്നു അറിഞ്ഞു മഹാക്രോധത്തോടെ നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ഇറങ്ങിവന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you! He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short."
chapters.nkjv: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth and the sea! For the devil has come down to you, having great wrath, because he knows that he has a short time."
chapters.kjv: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

chapters.ml: തന്നെ ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു എന്നു മഹാസർപ്പം കണ്ടിട്ടു ആൺകുട്ടിയെ പ്രസവിച്ചസ്ത്രീയെ ഉപദ്രവിച്ചുതുടങ്ങി.
chapters.niv: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
chapters.nkjv: Now when the dragon saw that he had been cast to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male Child.
chapters.kjv: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child .

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ സ്ത്രീക്കു മരുഭൂമിയിൽ തന്റെ സ്ഥലത്തെക്കു പറന്നുപോകേണ്ടതിന്നു വലിയ കഴുകിന്റെ രണ്ടു ചിറകുലഭിച്ചു; അവിടെ അവളെ സർപ്പത്തോടു അകലെ ഒരുകാലവും ഇരുകാലവും അരക്കാലവും പോറ്റി രക്ഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent’s reach.
chapters.nkjv: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, where she is nourished for a time and times and half a time, from the presence of the serpent.
chapters.kjv: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

chapters.ml: സർപ്പം സ്ത്രീയെ ഒഴുക്കിക്കളയേണ്ടതിന്നു അവളുടെ പിന്നാലെ തന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നു നദിപോലെ വെള്ളം ചാടിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.
chapters.nkjv: So the serpent spewed water out of his mouth like a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away by the flood.
chapters.kjv: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

chapters.ml: എന്നാൽ ഭൂമി സ്ത്രീക്കു തുണനിന്നു; മഹാസർപ്പം വായിൽനിന്നു ചാടിച്ച നദിയെ ഭൂമി വായ്തുറന്നു വിഴുങ്ങിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.
chapters.nkjv: But the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the flood which the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.
chapters.kjv: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

chapters.ml: മഹാസർപ്പം സ്ത്രീയോടു കോപിച്ചു, ദൈവകല്പന പ്രമാണിക്കുന്നവരും യേശുവിന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം ഉള്ളവരുമായി അവളുടെ സന്തതിയിൽ ശേഷിപ്പുള്ളവരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവൻ കടല്പുറത്തെ മണലിന്മേൽ നിന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then the dragon was enraged at the woman and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring—those who keep God’s commands and hold fast their testimony about Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: And the dragon was enraged with the woman, and he went to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
chapters.kjv: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ പത്തുകൊമ്പും ഏഴു തലയും കൊമ്പുകളിൽ പത്തു രാജമുടിയും തലയിൽ ദൂഷ്ണനാമങ്ങളും ഉള്ളോരു മൃഗം സമുദ്രത്തിൽ നിന്നു കയറുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea. And I saw a beast coming out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on each head a blasphemous name.
chapters.nkjv: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast rising up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his horns ten crowns, and on his heads a blasphemous name.
chapters.kjv: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കണ്ട മൃഗം പുള്ളിപ്പുലിക്കു സദൃശവും അതിന്റെ കാൽ കരടിയുടെ കാൽപോലെയും വായ് സിംഹത്തിന്റെ വായ് പോലെയും ആയിരുന്നു. അതിന്നു മഹാസർപ്പം തന്റെ ശക്തിയും സിംഹാസനവും വലിയ അധികാരവും കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: The beast I saw resembled a leopard, but had feet like those of a bear and a mouth like that of a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
chapters.nkjv: Now the beast which I saw was like a leopard, his feet were like thefeetof a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.
chapters.kjv: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.

chapters.ml: അതിന്റെ തലകളിൽ ഒന്നു മരണകരമായ മുറിവേറ്റതുപോലെ ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അതിന്റെ മരണകരമായ മുറിവു പൊറുത്തുപോയി; സർവ്വഭൂമിയും മൃഗത്തെ കണ്ടു വിസ്മയിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was filled with wonder and followed the beast.
chapters.nkjv: And I saw one of his heads as if it had been mortally wounded, and his deadly wound was healed. And all the world marveled and followed the beast.
chapters.kjv: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

chapters.ml: മൃഗത്തിന്നു അധികാരം കൊടുത്തതുകൊണ്ടു അവർ മഹാസർപ്പത്തെ നമസ്ക്കരിച്ചു: മൃഗത്തോടു തുല്യൻ ആർ? അതിനോടു പൊരുവാൻ ആർക്കു കഴിയും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു മൃഗത്തെയും നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast and asked, "Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?"
chapters.nkjv: So they worshiped the dragon who gave authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, "Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?"
chapters.kjv: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?

chapters.ml: വമ്പും ദൂഷണവും സംസാരിക്കുന്ന വായ് അതിന്നു ലഭിച്ചു; നാല്പത്തിരണ്ടു മാസം പ്രവർത്തിപ്പാൻ അധികാരവും ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The beast was given a mouth to utter proud words and blasphemies and to exercise its authority for forty-two months.
chapters.nkjv: And he was given a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies, and he was given authority to continue for forty-two months.
chapters.kjv: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.

chapters.ml: അതു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നാമത്തെയും അവന്റെ കൂടാരത്തെയും സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവരെയും ദുഷിപ്പാൻ ദൈവദൂഷണത്തിന്നായി വായ്തുറന്നു.
chapters.niv: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.
chapters.nkjv: Then he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme His name, His tabernacle, and those who dwell in heaven.
chapters.kjv: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധന്മാരോടു യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു അവരെ ജയിപ്പാനും അതിന്നു അധികാരം ലഭിച്ചു; സകല ഗോത്രത്തിന്മേലും വംശത്തിന്മേലും ഭാഷമേലും ജാതിമേലും അധികാരവും ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: It was given power to wage war against God’s holy people and to conquer them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.
chapters.nkjv: It was granted to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. And authority was given him over every tribe, tongue, and nation.
chapters.kjv: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

chapters.ml: ലോകസ്ഥാപനം മുതൽ അറുക്കപ്പെട്ട കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെ ജീവപുസ്തകത്തിൽ പേർ എഴുതീട്ടില്ലാത്ത ഭൂവാസികൾ ഒക്കെയും അതിനെ നമസ്കരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb who was slain from the creation of the world.
chapters.nkjv: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, whose names have not been written in the Book of Life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
chapters.kjv: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

chapters.ml: ചെവിയുള്ളവൻ കേൾക്കട്ടെ.
chapters.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear.
chapters.nkjv: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
chapters.kjv: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

chapters.ml: അടിമയാക്കി കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നവൻ അടിമയായിപ്പോകും; വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊല്ലുന്നവൻ വാളാൽ മരിക്കേണ്ടിവരും; ഇവിടെ വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ സഹിഷ്ണതയും വിശ്വാസവും കൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യം.
chapters.niv: "If anyone is to go into captivity, into captivity they will go. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword they will be killed." This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God’s people.
chapters.nkjv: He who leads into captivity shall go into captivity; he who kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
chapters.kjv: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു മൃഗം ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു കയറുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അതിന്നു കുഞ്ഞാടിന്നുള്ളതുപോലെ രണ്ടു കൊമ്പുണ്ടായിരുന്നു; അതു മഹാ സർപ്പം എന്നപോലെ സംസാരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: Then I saw a second beast, coming out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth, and he had two horns like a lamb and spoke like a dragon.
chapters.kjv: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

chapters.ml: അതു ഒന്നാമത്തെ മൃഗത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ അതിന്റെ അധികാരം എല്ലാം നടത്തി ഭൂമിയെയും അതിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവരെയും മരണകരമായ മുറിവു പൊറുത്തുപോയ ഒന്നാം മൃഗത്തെ നമസ്കരിക്കുമാറാക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.
chapters.nkjv: And he exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence, and causes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
chapters.kjv: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

chapters.ml: അതു മനുഷ്യർ കാൺകെ ആകാശത്തുനിന്നു ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു തീ ഇറങ്ങുമാറു വലിയ അടയാളങ്ങൾ പ്രവൃത്തിക്കയും
chapters.niv: And it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to the earth in full view of the people.
chapters.nkjv: He performs great signs, so that he even makes fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men.
chapters.kjv: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,

chapters.ml: മൃഗത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ പ്രവൃത്തിപ്പാൻ തനിക്കു ബലം കിട്ടിയ അടയാളങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ടു ഭൂവാസികളെ തെറ്റിക്കുകയും വാളാൽ മുറിവേറ്റിട്ടും ജീവിച്ച മൃഗത്തിന്നു പ്രതിമ ഉണ്ടാക്കുവാൻ ഭൂവാസികളോടു പറകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Because of the signs it was given power to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the inhabitants of the earth. It ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
chapters.nkjv: And he deceives those who dwell on the earth by those signs which he was granted to do in the sight of the beast, telling those who dwell on the earth to make an image to the beast who was wounded by the sword and lived.
chapters.kjv: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

chapters.ml: മൃഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രതിമ സംസാരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നും മൃഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രതിമയെ നമസ്കരിക്കാത്തവരെ ഒക്കെയും കൊല്ലിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു മൃഗത്തിന്റെ പ്രതിമെക്കു ആത്മാവിനെ കൊടുപ്പാൻ അതിന്നു ബലം ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The second beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.
chapters.nkjv: He was granted power to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak and cause as many as would not worship the image of the beast to be killed.
chapters.kjv: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

chapters.ml: അതു ചെറിയവരും വലിയവരും സമ്പന്നന്മാരും ദരിദ്രന്മാരും സ്വതന്ത്രന്മാരും ദാസന്മാരുമായ എല്ലാവർക്കും വലങ്കൈമേലോ നെറ്റിയിലോ മുദ്ര കിട്ടുമാറും
chapters.niv: It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,
chapters.nkjv: He causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their foreheads,
chapters.kjv: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

chapters.ml: മൃഗത്തിന്റെ പേരോ പേരിന്റെ സംഖ്യയോ ആയ മുദ്രയുള്ളവനല്ലാതെ വാങ്ങുകയോ വിൽക്കുകയോ ചെയ്‍വാൻ വഹിയാതെയും ആക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.
chapters.nkjv: and that no one may buy or sell except one who has the mark or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
chapters.kjv: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

chapters.ml: ഇവിടെ ജ്ഞാനംകൊണ്ടു ആവശ്യം. ബുദ്ധിയുള്ളവൻ മൃഗത്തിന്റെ സംഖ്യ ഗണിക്കട്ടെ: അതു ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ സംഖ്യയത്രെ. അതിന്റെ സംഖ്യ അറുനൂറ്ററുപത്താറു.
chapters.niv: This calls for wisdom. Let the person who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. That number is 666.
chapters.nkjv: Here is wisdom. Let him who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man: His number is 666.
chapters.kjv: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഞാൻ സീയോൻ മലയിൽ കുഞ്ഞാടും അവനോടുകൂടെ നെറ്റിയിൽ അവന്റെ നാമവും പിതാവിന്റെ നാമവും എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്ന നൂറ്റിനാല്പത്തിനാലായിരം പേരും നില്ക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
chapters.nkjv: Then I looked, and behold, a Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him one hundred and forty-four thousand, having His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
chapters.kjv: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.

chapters.ml: പെരുവെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഇരെച്ചൽപോലെയും വലിയോരു ഇടിമുഴക്കംപോലെയും സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ഘോഷം കേട്ടു; ഞാൻ കേട്ട ഘോഷം വൈണികന്മാർ വീണമീട്ടുന്നതുപോലെ ആയിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.
chapters.nkjv: And I heard a voice from heaven, like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of loud thunder. And I heard the sound of harpists playing their harps.
chapters.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

chapters.ml: അവർ സിംഹാസനത്തിന്നും നാലു ജീവികൾക്കും മൂപ്പന്മാർക്കും മുമ്പാകെ ഒരു പുതിയ പാട്ടുപാടി; ഭൂമിയിൽ നിന്നു വിലെക്കു വാങ്ങിയിരുന്ന നൂറ്റിനാല്പത്തിനാലായിരം പേർക്കല്ലാതെ ആർക്കും ആ പാട്ടു പഠിപ്പാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
chapters.nkjv: They sang as it were a new song before the throne, before the four living creatures, and the elders; and no one could learn that song except the hundred and forty-four thousand who were redeemed from the earth.
chapters.kjv: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.

chapters.ml: അവർ കന്യകമാരാകയാൽ സ്ത്രീകളോടുകൂടെ മാലിന്യപ്പെടാത്തവർ. കുഞ്ഞാടുപോകുന്നേടത്തൊക്കെയും അവർ അവനെ അനുഗമിക്കുന്നു; അവരെ ദൈവത്തിന്നും കുഞ്ഞാടിന്നും ആദ്യഫലമായി മനുഷ്യരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു വീണ്ടെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they remained virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among mankind and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.
chapters.nkjv: These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These were redeemed from among men, being firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
chapters.kjv: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.

chapters.ml: ഭോഷ്കു അവരുടെ വായിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല; അവർ കളങ്കമില്ലാത്തവർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
chapters.nkjv: And in their mouth was found no deceit, for they are without fault before the throne of God.
chapters.kjv: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.

chapters.ml: വേറൊരു ദൂതൻ ആകാശമദ്ധ്യേ പറക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; ഭൂവാസികളായ സകലജാതിയും ഗോത്രവും ഭാഷയും വംശവും ആയവരോടു അറിയിപ്പാൻ അവന്റെ പക്കൽ ഒരു നിത്യസുവിശേഷം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language and people.
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw another angel flying in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach to those who dwell on the earth— to every nation, tribe, tongue, and people—
chapters.kjv: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തെ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു അവന്നു മഹത്വം കൊടുപ്പിൻ; അവന്റെ ന്യായവിധിയുടെ നാഴിക വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു. ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും സമുദ്രവും നീരുറവകളും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയവനെ നമസ്കരിപ്പിൻ എന്നു അവൻ അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water."
chapters.nkjv: saying with a loud voice, "Fear God and give glory to Him, for the hour of His judgment has come; and worship Him who made heaven and earth, the sea and springs of water."
chapters.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമതു വേറൊരു ദൂതൻ പിൻചെന്നു: വീണുപോയി; തന്റെ ദുർന്നടപ്പിന്റെ ക്രോധമദ്യം സകലജാതികളെയും കുടിപ്പിച്ച മഹതിയാം ബാബിലോൻ വീണുപോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: A second angel followed and said, " ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great,’ which made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her adulteries."
chapters.nkjv: And another angel followed, saying, "Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she has made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication."
chapters.kjv: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമതു വേറൊരു ദൂതൻ അവരുടെ പിന്നാലെ വന്നു അത്യുച്ചത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞതു: മൃഗത്തെയും അതിന്റെ പ്രതിമയെയും നമസ്കരിച്ചു നെറ്റിയിലോ കൈമേലോ മുദ്ര ഏൽക്കുന്നവൻ
chapters.niv: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or on their hand,
chapters.nkjv: Then a third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives his mark on his forehead or on his hand,
chapters.kjv: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,

chapters.ml: ദൈവകോപത്തിന്റെ പാത്രത്തിൽ കലർപ്പില്ലാതെ പകർന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവക്രോധമദ്യം കുടിക്കേണ്ടിവരും; വിശുദ്ധദൂതന്മാർക്കും കുഞ്ഞാടിന്നും മുമ്പാകെ അഗ്നിഗന്ധകങ്ങളിൽ ദണ്ഡനം അനുഭവിക്കും.
chapters.niv: they, too, will drink the wine of God’s fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
chapters.nkjv: he himself shall also drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out full strength into the cup of His indignation. He shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
chapters.kjv: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

chapters.ml: അവരുടെ ദണ്ഡനത്തിന്റെ പുക എന്നെന്നേക്കും പൊങ്ങും; മൃഗത്തെയും അതിന്റെ പ്രതിമയെയും നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നവർക്കും അതിന്റെ പേരിന്റെ മുദ്ര ഏല്ക്കുന്ന ഏവന്നും രാവും പകലും ഒരു സ്വസ്ഥതയും ഉണ്ടാകയില്ല.
