chapters.niv: And the smoke of their torment will rise for ever and ever. There will be no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name."
chapters.nkjv: And the smoke of their torment ascends forever and ever; and they have no rest day or night, who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name."
chapters.kjv: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.

chapters.ml: ദൈവകല്പനയും യേശുവിങ്കലുള്ള വിശ്വാസവും കാത്തുകൊള്ളുന്ന വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ സഹിഷ്ണതകൊണ്ടു ഇവിടെ ആവശ്യം.
chapters.niv: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the people of God who keep his commands and remain faithful to Jesus.
chapters.nkjv: Here is the patience of the saints; here are those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
chapters.kjv: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരു ശബ്ദംകേട്ടു; അതു പറഞ്ഞതു: എഴുതുക: ഇന്നുമുതൽ കർത്താവിൽ മരിക്കുന്ന മൃതന്മാർ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ; അതേ, അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രയത്നങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നു വിശ്രമിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു; അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തി അവരെ പിന്തുടരുന്നു എന്നു ആത്മാവു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them."
chapters.nkjv: Then I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, "Write: ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’ " "Yes," says the Spirit, "that they may rest from their labors, and their works follow them."
chapters.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഞാൻ വെളുത്തോരു മേഘവും മേഘത്തിന്മേൽ മനുഷ്യപുത്രന്നു സദൃശനായ ഒരുത്തൻ തലയിൽ പൊൻകിരീടവും കയ്യിൽ മൂർച്ചയുള്ള അരിവാളുമായി ഇരിക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like a son of man with a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
chapters.nkjv: Then I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and on the cloud sat One like the Son of Man, having on His head a golden crown, and in His hand a sharp sickle.
chapters.kjv: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു ദൂതൻ ദൈവാലത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു, മേഘത്തിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവനോടു: കൊയ്ത്തിന്നു സമയം വന്നതുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ അരിവാൾ അയച്ചു കൊയ്ക; ഭൂമിയിലെ വിളവു വിളഞ്ഞുണങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud, "Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."
chapters.nkjv: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to Him who sat on the cloud, "Thrust in Your sickle and reap, for the time has come for You to reap, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."
chapters.kjv: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

chapters.ml: മേഘത്തിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ അരിവാൾ ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു എറിഞ്ഞു ഭൂമിയിൽ കൊയ്ത്തു നടന്നു.
chapters.niv: So he who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
chapters.nkjv: So He who sat on the cloud thrust in His sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
chapters.kjv: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.

chapters.ml: മറ്റൊരു ദൂതൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ ആയലത്തിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു; അവൻ മൂർച്ചയുള്ളോരു കോങ്കത്തി പിടിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
chapters.nkjv: Then another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
chapters.kjv: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

chapters.ml: തീയുടെമേൽ അധികാരമുള്ള വേറൊരു ദൂതൻ യാഗപീഠത്തിങ്കൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു, മൂർച്ചയുള്ള കോങ്കത്തി പിടിച്ചിരുന്നവനോടു: ഭൂമിയിലെ മുന്തിരിങ്ങ പഴുത്തിരിക്കയാൽ നിന്റെ മൂർച്ചയുള്ള കോങ്കത്തി അയച്ചു മുന്തിരിവള്ളിയുടെ കുല അറുക്കുക എന്നു ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, "Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth’s vine, because its grapes are ripe."
chapters.nkjv: And another angel came out from the altar, who had power over fire, and he cried with a loud cry to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, "Thrust in your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for her grapes are fully ripe."
chapters.kjv: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ കോങ്കത്തി ഭൂമിയിലേക്കു എറിഞ്ഞു, ഭൂമിയിലെ മുന്തിരിക്കുല അറുത്തു, ദൈവകോപത്തിന്റെ വലിയ ചക്കിൽ ഇട്ടു.
chapters.niv: The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
chapters.nkjv: So the angel thrust his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
chapters.kjv: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

chapters.ml: ചക്കു നഗരത്തിന്നു പുറത്തുവെച്ചു മെതിച്ചു; ചക്കിൽനിന്നു രക്തം കുതിരകളുടെ കടിവാളങ്ങളോളം പൊങ്ങി ഇരുനൂറു നാഴിക ദൂരത്തോളം ഒഴുകി.
chapters.niv: They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses’ bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
chapters.nkjv: And the winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress, up to the horses’ bridles, for one thousand six hundred furlongs.
chapters.kjv: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വലുതും അത്ഭുതവുമായ മറ്റൊരു അടയാളം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ കണ്ടു; ഒടുക്കത്തെ ഏഴു ബാധയുമുള്ള ഏഴു ദൂതന്മാരെ തന്നേ; അതോടുകൂടെ ദൈവക്രോധം തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: I saw in heaven another great and marvelous sign: seven angels with the seven last plagues—last, because with them God’s wrath is completed.
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them the wrath of God is complete.
chapters.kjv: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

chapters.ml: തീ കലർന്ന പളുങ്കുകടൽ പോലെ ഒന്നും മൃഗത്തോടും അതിന്റെ പ്രതിമയോടും പേരിന്റെ സംഖ്യയോടും ജയിച്ചവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വീണകൾ പിടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു പളുങ്കുകടലിന്നരികെ നില്ക്കുന്നതും ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass glowing with fire and, standing beside the sea, those who had been victorious over the beast and its image and over the number of its name. They held harps given them by God
chapters.nkjv: And I saw something like a sea of glass mingled with fire, and those who have the victory over the beast, over his image and over his mark and over the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
chapters.kjv: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.

chapters.ml: അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാസനായ മോശെയുടെ പാട്ടും കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെ പാട്ടും പാടി ചൊല്ലിയതു: സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവമായ കർത്താവേ, നിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ വലുതും അത്ഭുതവുമായവ; സർവ്വജാതികളുടെയും രാജാവേ, നിന്റെ വഴികൾ നീതിയും സത്യവുമുള്ളവ:
chapters.niv: and sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: "Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.
chapters.nkjv: They sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying: "Great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the saints!
chapters.kjv: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.

chapters.ml: കർത്താവേ, ആർ നിന്റെ നാമത്തെ ഭയപ്പെടാതെയും മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്താതെയും ഇരിക്കും? നീയല്ലോ ഏകപരിശുദ്ധൻ; നിന്റെ ന്യായവിധികൾ വിളങ്ങിവന്നതിനാൽ സകല ജാതികളും വന്നു തിരുസന്നിധിയിൽ നമസ്കരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: Who will not fear you, Lord, and bring glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed."
chapters.nkjv: Who shall not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. For all nations shall come and worship before You, For Your judgments have been manifested."
chapters.kjv: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

chapters.ml: ഇതിന്റെ ശേഷം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ സാക്ഷ്യകൂടാരമായ ദൈവാലയം തുറന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: After this I looked, and I saw in heaven the temple—that is, the tabernacle of the covenant law—and it was opened.
chapters.nkjv: After these things I looked, and behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
chapters.kjv: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

chapters.ml: ഏഴു ബാധയുള്ള ഏഴു ദൂതന്മാരും ശുദ്ധവും ശുഭ്രവുമായുള്ള ശണവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചും മാറത്തു പൊൻകച്ച കെട്ടിയും കൊണ്ടു ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടുവന്നു.
chapters.niv: Out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues. They were dressed in clean, shining linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.
chapters.nkjv: And out of the temple came the seven angels having the seven plagues, clothed in pure bright linen, and having their chests girded with golden bands.
chapters.kjv: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ നാലു ജീവികളിൽ ഒന്നു എന്നെന്നേക്കും ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ക്രോധം നിറഞ്ഞ ഏഴു പൊൻകലശം ആ ഏഴു ദൂതന്മാർക്കു കൊടുത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God who lives forever and ever.
chapters.kjv: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ തേജസ്സും ശക്തിയും ഹേതുവായിട്ടു ദൈവാലയം പുകകൊണ്ടു നിറഞ്ഞു; ഏഴു ദൂതന്മാരുടെ ബാധ ഏഴും കഴിയുവോളം ദൈവാലയത്തിൽ കടപ്പാൻ ആർക്കും കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല.
chapters.niv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
chapters.nkjv: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power, and no one was able to enter the temple till the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
chapters.kjv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

chapters.ml: നിങ്ങൾ പോയി ക്രോധകലശം ഏഴും ഭൂമിയിൽ ഒഴിച്ചുകളവിൻ എന്നു ഒരു മഹാ ശബ്ദം ദൈവാലയത്തിൽനിന്നു ഏഴു ദൂതന്മാരോടും പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, "Go, pour out the seven bowls of God’s wrath on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the bowls of the wrath of God on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.

chapters.ml: ഒന്നാമത്തവൻ പോയി തന്റെ കലശം ഭൂമിയിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ മൃഗത്തിന്റെ മുദ്രയുള്ളവരും അതിന്റെ പ്രതിമയെ നമസ്കരിക്കുന്നവരുമായ മനുഷ്യർക്കു വല്ലാത്ത ദുർവ്രണം ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land, and ugly, festering sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
chapters.nkjv: So the first went and poured out his bowl upon the earth, and a foul and loathsome sore came upon the men who had the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image.
chapters.kjv: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.

chapters.ml: രണ്ടാമത്തവൻ തന്റെ കലശം സമുദ്രത്തിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ അതു മരിച്ചവന്റെ രക്തംപോലെ ആയിത്തീർന്നു; സമുദ്രത്തിലെ ജീവജന്തു ഒക്കെയും ചത്തുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
chapters.nkjv: Then the second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man; and every living creature in the sea died.
chapters.kjv: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man : and every living soul died in the sea.

chapters.ml: മൂന്നാമത്തെ ദൂതൻ തന്റെ കലശം നദികളിലും നീരുറവുകളിലും ഒഴിച്ചു; അവ രക്തമായിത്തീർന്നു.
chapters.niv: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
chapters.nkjv: Then the third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
chapters.kjv: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ ജലാധിപതിയായ ദൂതൻ ഇവ്വണ്ണം പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു: ഇരിക്കുന്നവനും ഇരുന്നവനുമായി പരിശുദ്ധനായുള്ളോവേ, നീ ഇങ്ങനെ ന്യായം വിധിച്ചതു കൊണ്ടു നീതിമാൻ ആകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: "You are just in these judgments, O Holy One, you who are and who were;
chapters.nkjv: And I heard the angel of the waters saying: "You are righteous, O Lord, The One who is and who was and who is to be, Because You have judged these things.
chapters.kjv: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെയും പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെയും രക്തം അവർ ചിന്നിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു നീ അവർക്കു രക്തം കുടിപ്പാൻ കൊടുത്തു; അതിന്നു അവർ യോഗ്യർ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: for they have shed the blood of your holy people and your prophets, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve."
chapters.nkjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, And You have given them blood to drink. For it is their just due."
chapters.kjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

chapters.ml: അവ്വണ്ണം യാഗപീഠവും: അതേ, സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവമായ കർത്താവേ, നിന്റെ ന്യായവിധികൾ സത്യവും നീതിയുമുള്ളവ എന്നു പറയുന്നതു ഞാൻ കേട്ടു.
chapters.niv: And I heard the altar respond: "Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments."
chapters.nkjv: And I heard another from the altar saying, "Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are Your judgments."
chapters.kjv: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.

chapters.ml: നാലാമത്തവൻ തന്റെ കലശം സൂര്യനിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ തീകൊണ്ടു മനുഷ്യരെ ചുടുവാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം അതിന്നു അധികാരം ലഭിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to scorch people with fire.
chapters.nkjv: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and power was given to him to scorch men with fire.
chapters.kjv: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.

chapters.ml: മനുഷ്യർ അത്യുഷ്ണത്താൽ വെന്തുപോയി; ഈ ബാധകളുടെമേൽ അധികാരമുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നാമത്തെ ദുഷിച്ചതല്ലാതെ അവന്നു മഹത്വം കൊടുപ്പാൻ തക്കവണ്ണം മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: They were seared by the intense heat and they cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues, but they refused to repent and glorify him.
chapters.nkjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and they blasphemed the name of God who has power over these plagues; and they did not repent and give Him glory.
chapters.kjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

chapters.ml: അഞ്ചാമത്തവൻ തന്റെ കലശം മൃഗത്തിന്റെ സിംഹാസനത്തിന്മേൽ ഒഴിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ അതിന്റെ രാജ്യം ഇരുണ്ടുപോയി.
chapters.niv: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in agony
chapters.nkjv: Then the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom became full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues because of the pain.
chapters.kjv: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

chapters.ml: അവർ കഷ്ടതനിമിത്തം നാവു കടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു കഷ്ടങ്ങളും വ്രണങ്ങളും ഹേതുവാൽ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ ദൈവത്തെ ദുഷിച്ചതല്ലാതെ തങ്ങളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ വിട്ടു മാനസാന്തരപ്പെട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they refused to repent of what they had done.
chapters.nkjv: They blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and did not repent of their deeds.
chapters.kjv: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

chapters.ml: ആറാമത്തവൻ തന്റെ കലശം യൂഫ്രാത്തേസ് എന്ന മഹാനദിയിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു; കിഴക്കു നിന്നു വരുന്ന രാജാക്കന്മാർക്കു വഴി ഒരുങ്ങേണ്ടതിന്നു അതിലെ വെള്ളം വറ്റിപ്പോയി.
chapters.niv: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.
chapters.nkjv: Then the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, so that the way of the kings from the east might be prepared.
chapters.kjv: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.

chapters.ml: മഹാസർപ്പത്തിന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നും മൃഗത്തിന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നും കള്ളപ്രവാചകന്റെ വായിൽനിന്നും തവളയെപ്പോലെ മൂന്നു അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കൾ പുറപ്പെടുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I saw three impure spirits that looked like frogs; they came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
chapters.nkjv: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
chapters.kjv: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

chapters.ml: ഇവ സർവ്വഭൂതത്തിലും ഉള്ള രാജാക്കന്മാരെ സർവ്വശക്തനായ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മഹാദിവസത്തിലെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നു കൂട്ടിച്ചേർപ്പാൻ അത്ഭുതങ്ങൾ ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടു അവരുടെ അടുക്കലേക്കു പറുപ്പെടുന്ന ഭൂതാത്മാക്കൾ തന്നേ. —
chapters.niv: They are demonic spirits that perform signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.
chapters.nkjv: For they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
chapters.kjv: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ കള്ളനെപ്പോലെ വരും; തന്റെ ലജ്ജകാണുമാറു നഗ്നനായി നടക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ തന്റെ ഉടുപ്പു സൂക്ഷിച്ചും ജാഗരിച്ചും കൊള്ളുന്നവൻ ഭാഗ്യവാൻ. —
chapters.niv: "Look, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and remains clothed, so as not to go naked and be shamefully exposed."
chapters.nkjv: "Behold, I am coming as a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked and they see his shame."
chapters.kjv: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.

chapters.ml: അവ അവരെ എബ്രായഭാഷയിൽ ഹർമ്മഗെദ്ദോൻ എന്നു പേരുള്ള സ്ഥലത്തിൽ കൂട്ടിച്ചേർത്തു.
chapters.niv: Then they gathered the kings together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
chapters.nkjv: And they gathered them together to the place called in Hebrew, Armageddon.
chapters.kjv: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.

chapters.ml: ഏഴാമത്തവൻ തന്റെ കലശം ആകാശത്തിൽ ഒഴിച്ചു; അപ്പോൾ സംഭവിച്ചുതീർന്നു എന്നു ഒരു മഹാശബ്ദം ദൈവലായത്തിലെ സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ നിന്നു വന്നു.
chapters.niv: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple came a loud voice from the throne, saying, "It is done!"
chapters.nkjv: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, "It is done!"
chapters.kjv: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.

chapters.ml: മിന്നലും നാദവും ഇടിമുഴക്കവും വലിയ ഭൂകമ്പവും ഉണ്ടായി; ഭൂമിയിൽ മനുഷ്യർ ഉണ്ടായതുമുതൽ അതുപോലെ അത്ര വലുതായോരു ഭൂകമ്പം ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and a severe earthquake. No earthquake like it has ever occurred since mankind has been on earth, so tremendous was the quake.
chapters.nkjv: And there were noises and thunderings and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such a mighty and great earthquake as had not occurred since men were on the earth.
chapters.kjv: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.

chapters.ml: മഹാനഗരം മൂന്നംശമായി പിരിഞ്ഞു; ജാതികളുടെ പട്ടണങ്ങളും വീണു പോയി; ദൈവകോപത്തിന്റെ ക്രോധമദ്യമുള്ള പാത്രം മഹാബാബിലോന്നു കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവളെ ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽ ഓർത്തു.
chapters.niv: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of the fury of his wrath.
chapters.nkjv: Now the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And great Babylon was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of His wrath.
chapters.kjv: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

chapters.ml: സകലദ്വീപും ഓടിപ്പോയി; മലകൾ കാണ്മാനില്ലാതെയായി.
chapters.niv: Every island fled away and the mountains could not be found.
chapters.nkjv: Then every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
chapters.kjv: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

chapters.ml: താലന്തോളം ഘനമുള്ള കല്ലായി വലിയ കല്മഴ ആകാശത്തു നിന്നു മനുഷ്യരുടെ മേൽ പെയ്തു; കന്മഴയുടെ ബാധ ഏറ്റവും വലുതാകകൊണ്ടു മനുഷ്യൻ ആ ബാധനിമിത്തം ദൈവത്തെ ദുഷിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: From the sky huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, fell on people. And they cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.
chapters.nkjv: And great hail from heaven fell upon men, eachhailstone about the weight of a talent. Men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, since that plague was exceedingly great.
chapters.kjv: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ഏഴു കലശമുള്ള ഏഴു ദൂതന്മാരിൽ ഒരുവൻ വന്നു എന്നോടു സംസാരിച്ചു: വരിക, ഭൂമിയിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാരോടു വേശ്യാവൃത്തി ചെയ്തു തന്റെ വേശ്യാവൃത്തിയുടെ മദ്യത്താൽ
chapters.niv: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits by many waters.
chapters.nkjv: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and talked with me, saying to me, "Come, I will show you the judgment of the great harlot who sits on many waters,
chapters.kjv: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:

chapters.ml: ഭൂവാസികളെ മത്തരാക്കിയവളായി പെരുവെള്ളത്തിന്മീതെ ഇരിക്കുന്ന മഹാവേശ്യയുടെ ന്യായവിധി ഞാൻ കാണിച്ചുതരാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: With her the kings of the earth committed adultery, and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her adulteries."
chapters.nkjv: with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth were made drunk with the wine of her fornication."
chapters.kjv: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.

chapters.ml: അവൻ എന്നെ ആത്മാവിൽ മരുഭൂമിയിലേക്കു കൊണ്ടുപോയി. അപ്പോൾ ഏഴു തലയും പത്തു കൊമ്പും ഉള്ളതായി ദൂഷണനാമങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞു കടുഞ്ചുവപ്പുള്ളോരു മൃഗത്തിന്മേൽ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ ഇരിക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
chapters.nkjv: So he carried me away in the Spirit into the wilderness. And I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast whichwas full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
chapters.kjv: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

chapters.ml: ആ സ്ത്രീ ധൂമ്രവർണ്ണവും കടുഞ്ചുവപ്പു നിറവും ഉള്ള വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു പൊന്നും രത്നവും മുത്തും അണിഞ്ഞവളായി തന്റെ വേശ്യവൃത്തിയുടെ മ്ളേച്ഛതയും അശുദ്ധിയും നിറഞ്ഞ സ്വർണ്ണപാനപാത്രം കയ്യിൽ പിടിച്ചിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominable things and the filth of her adulteries.
chapters.nkjv: The woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the filthiness of her fornication.
chapters.kjv: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:

chapters.ml: മർമ്മം: മഹതിയാം ബാബിലോൻ; വേശ്യമാരുടെയും മ്ളേച്ഛതകളുടെയും മാതാവു എന്നൊരു പേർ അവളുടെ നെറ്റിയിൽ എഴുതീട്ടുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: The name written on her forehead was a mystery: babylon the great the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.
chapters.nkjv: And on her forehead a name was written: MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
chapters.kjv: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

chapters.ml: വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ രക്തവും യേശുവിന്റെ സാക്ഷികളുടെ രക്തവും കുടിച്ചു സ്ത്രീ മത്തയായിരിക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അവളെ കണ്ടിട്ടു അത്യന്തം ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God’s holy people, the blood of those who bore testimony to Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.
chapters.nkjv: I saw the woman, drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. And when I saw her, I marveled with great amazement.
chapters.kjv: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.

chapters.ml: ദൂതൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ ആശ്ചര്യപ്പെടുന്നതു എന്തു? ഈ സ്ത്രീയുടെയും ഏഴു തലയും പത്തു കൊമ്പും ഉള്ളതായി അവളെ ചുമക്കുന്ന മൃഗത്തിന്റെയും മർമ്മം ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞുതരാം.
chapters.niv: Then the angel said to me: "Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
chapters.nkjv: But the angel said to me, "Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
chapters.kjv: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.

chapters.ml: നീ കണ്ട മൃഗമോ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതും ഇപ്പോൾ ഇല്ലാത്തതും ഇനി അഗാധത്തിൽനിന്നു കയറി നാശത്തിലേക്കു പോകുവാൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നതും ആകുന്നു; ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതും ഇല്ലാത്തതും വരുവാനുള്ളതുമായ മൃഗത്തെ ലോകസ്ഥാപനം മുതൽ ജീവപുസ്തകത്തിൽ പേർ എഴുതാതിരിക്കുന്ന ഭൂവാസികൾ കണ്ടു അതിശയിക്കും.
chapters.niv: The beast, which you saw, once was, now is not, and yet will come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. The inhabitants of the earth whose names have not been written in the book of life from the creation of the world will be astonished when they see the beast, because it once was, now is not, and yet will come.
chapters.nkjv: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and will ascend out of the bottomless pit and go to perdition. And those who dwell on the earth will marvel, whose names are not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world, when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
chapters.kjv: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

chapters.ml: ഇവിടെ ജ്ഞാന ബുദ്ധി ഉണ്ടു; തല ഏഴും സ്ത്രീ ഇരിക്കുന്ന ഏഴു മലയാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: "This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.
chapters.nkjv: "Here is the mind which has wisdom: The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
chapters.kjv: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.

chapters.ml: അവ ഏഴു രാജാക്കന്മാരും ആകുന്നു; അഞ്ചുപേർ വീണുപോയി; ഒരുത്തൻ ഉണ്ടു; മറ്റവൻ ഇതുവരെ വന്നിട്ടില്ല; വന്നാൽ പിന്നെ അവൻ കുറഞ്ഞോന്നു ഇരിക്കേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
chapters.nkjv: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. And when he comes, he must continue a short time.
chapters.kjv: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.

chapters.ml: ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നതും ഇല്ലാത്തതുമായ മൃഗം എട്ടാമത്തവനും ഏഴുവരിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ടവനും തന്നേ; അവൻ നാശത്തിലേക്കു പോകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The beast who once was, and now is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to his destruction.
chapters.nkjv: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also the eighth, and is of the seven, and is going to perdition.
chapters.kjv: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.

chapters.ml: നീ കണ്ട പത്തു കൊമ്പു പത്തു രാജാക്കന്മാർ; അവർ ഇതുവരെ രാജത്വം പ്രാപിച്ചിട്ടില്ല; മൃഗത്തോടു ഒന്നിച്ചു ഒരു നാഴിക നേരത്തേക്കു രാജാക്കന്മാരേപ്പോലെ അധികാരം പ്രാപിക്കും താനും.
chapters.niv: "The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.
chapters.nkjv: "The ten horns which you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority for one hour as kings with the beast.
chapters.kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

chapters.ml: ഇവർ ഒരേ അഭിപ്രായമുള്ളവർ; തങ്ങളുടെ ശക്തിയും അധികാരവും മൃഗത്തിന്നു ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: They have one purpose and will give their power and authority to the beast.
chapters.nkjv: These are of one mind, and they will give their power and authority to the beast.
chapters.kjv: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.

chapters.ml: അവർ കുഞ്ഞാടിനോടു പോരാടും; താൻ കർത്താധികർത്താവും രാജാധിരാജാവും ആകകൊണ്ടു കുഞ്ഞാടു തന്നോടുകൂടെയുള്ള വിളിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരും തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കപ്പെട്ടവരും വിശ്വസ്തരുമായി അവരെ ജയിക്കും.
chapters.niv: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings—and with him will be his called, chosen and faithful followers."
chapters.nkjv: These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those whoare with Him are called, chosen, and faithful."
chapters.kjv: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞതു: നീ കണ്ടതും വേശ്യ ഇരിക്കുന്നതുമായ വെള്ളം വംശങ്ങളും പുരുഷാരങ്ങളും ജാതികളും ഭാഷകളും അത്രേ.
chapters.niv: Then the angel said to me, "The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to me, "The waters which you saw, where the harlot sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and tongues.
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

chapters.ml: നീ കണ്ട പത്തു കൊമ്പും മൃഗവും വേശ്യയെ ദ്വേഷിച്ചു ശൂന്യവും നഗ്നവുമാക്കി അവളുടെ മാംസം തിന്നുകളയും; അവളെ തീകൊണ്ടു ദഹിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്യും.
chapters.niv: The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will bring her to ruin and leave her naked; they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
chapters.nkjv: And the ten horns which you saw on the beast, these will hate the harlot, make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
chapters.kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനം നിവൃത്തിയാകുവോളം തന്റെ ഹിതം ചെയ്‍വാനും ഒരേ അഭിപ്രായം നടത്തുവാനും തങ്ങടെ രാജത്വം മൃഗത്തിന്നു കൊടുപ്പാനും ദൈവം അവരുടെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ തോന്നിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: For God has put it into their hearts to accomplish his purpose by agreeing to hand over to the beast their royal authority, until God’s words are fulfilled.
chapters.nkjv: For God has put it into their hearts to fulfill His purpose, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
chapters.kjv: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

chapters.ml: നീ കണ്ട സ്ത്രീയോ ഭൂരാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ മേൽ രാജത്വമുള്ള മഹാനഗരം തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth."
chapters.nkjv: And the woman whom you saw is that great city which reigns over the kings of the earth."
chapters.kjv: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഞാൻ വലിയ അധികാരമുള്ള മറ്റൊരു ദൂതൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു ഇറങ്ങുന്നതു കണ്ടു; അവന്റെ തേജസ്സിനാൽ ഭൂമി പ്രകാശിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.
chapters.nkjv: After these things I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was illuminated with his glory.
chapters.kjv: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞതു: വീണുപോയി: മഹതിയാം ബാബിലോൻ വീണുപോയി; ദുർഭൂതങ്ങളുടെ പാർപ്പിടവും സകല അശുദ്ധാത്മാക്കളുടെയും തടവും അശുദ്ധിയും അറെപ്പുമുള്ള സകലപക്ഷികളുടെയും തടവുമായിത്തിർന്നു.
chapters.niv: With a mighty voice he shouted: " ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great!’ She has become a dwelling for demons and a haunt for every impure spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and detestable animal.
chapters.nkjv: And he cried mightily with a loud voice, saying, "Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and has become a dwelling place of demons, a prison for every foul spirit, and a cage for every unclean and hated bird!
chapters.kjv: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ വേശ്യാവൃത്തിയുടെ ക്രോധമദ്യം സകലജാതികളും കുടിച്ചു; ഭൂമിയിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാർ അവളോടു വേശ്യാസംഗം ചെയ്കയും ഭൂമിയിലെ വ്യാപാരികൾ അവളുടെ പുളെപ്പിന്റെ ആധിക്യത്താൽ സമ്പന്നരാകയും ചെയ്തു.
chapters.niv: For all the nations have drunk the maddening wine of her adulteries. The kings of the earth committed adultery with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from her excessive luxuries."
chapters.nkjv: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth have become rich through the abundance of her luxury."
chapters.kjv: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.

chapters.ml: വേറോരു ശബ്ദം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു പറയുന്നതായി ഞാൻ കേട്ടതു. എന്റെ ജനമായുള്ളോരേ, അവളുടെ പാപങ്ങളിൽ കൂട്ടാളികളാകാതെയും അവളുടെ ബാധകളിൽ ഓഹരിക്കാരാകാതെയുമിരിപ്പാൻ അവളെ വിട്ടു പോരുവിൻ.
chapters.niv: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: " ‘Come out of her, my people,’ so that you will not share in her sins, so that you will not receive any of her plagues;
chapters.nkjv: And I heard another voice from heaven saying, "Come out of her, my people, lest you share in her sins, and lest you receive of her plagues.
chapters.kjv: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.

chapters.ml: അവളുടെ പാപം ആകാശത്തോളം കുന്നിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവളുടെ അകൃത്യം ദൈവം ഓർത്തിട്ടുമുണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: for her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.
chapters.nkjv: For her sins have reached to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
chapters.kjv: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

chapters.ml: അവൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ നിങ്ങൾ അവൾക്കു പകരം ചെയ്‍വിൻ; അവളുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം അവൾക്കു ഇരട്ടിച്ചു കൊടുപ്പിൻ; അവൾ കലക്കിത്തന്ന പാനപാത്രത്തിൽ അവൾക്കു ഇരട്ടി കലക്കിക്കൊടുപ്പിൻ;
chapters.niv: Give back to her as she has given; pay her back double for what she has done. Pour her a double portion from her own cup.
chapters.nkjv: Render to her just as she rendered to you, and repay her double according to her works; in the cup which she has mixed, mix double for her.
chapters.kjv: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.

chapters.ml: അവൾ തന്നെത്താൻ മഹത്വപ്പെടുത്തി പുളെച്ചേടത്തോളം അവൾക്കു പീഡയും ദുഃഖവും കൊടുപ്പിൻ. രാജ്ഞിയായിട്ടു ഞാൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നു; ഞാൻ വിധവയല്ല; ദുഃഖം കാൺകയുമില്ല എന്നു അവൾ ഹൃദയംകൊണ്ടു പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Give her as much torment and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she boasts, ‘I sit enthroned as queen. I am not a widow; I will never mourn.’
chapters.nkjv: In the measure that she glorified herself and lived luxuriously, in the same measure give her torment and sorrow; for she says in her heart, ‘I sit as queen, and am no widow, and will not see sorrow.’
chapters.kjv: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

chapters.ml: അതുനിമിത്തം മരണം, ദുഃഖം, ക്ഷാമം എന്നിങ്ങനെ അവളുടെ ബാധകൾ ഒരു ദിവസത്തിൽ തന്നേ വരും; അവളെ തീയിൽ ഇട്ടു ചുട്ടുകളയും; അവളെ ന്യായം വിധിച്ച ദൈവമായ കർത്താവു ശക്തനല്ലോ.
chapters.niv: Therefore in one day her plagues will overtake her: death, mourning and famine. She will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.
chapters.nkjv: Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death and mourning and famine. And she will be utterly burned with fire, for strong is the Lord God who judges her.
chapters.kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.

chapters.ml: അവളോടു കൂടെ വേശ്യാസംഗം ചെയ്തു പുളെച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഭൂരാജാക്കന്മാർ അവളുടെ പീഡനിമിത്തം ഭയപ്പെട്ടു ദൂരത്തു നിന്നുകൊണ്ടു അവളുടെ ദഹനത്തിന്റെ പുക കാണുമ്പോൾ അവളെച്ചൊല്ലി കരഞ്ഞും മാറത്തടിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു:
chapters.niv: "When the kings of the earth who committed adultery with her and shared her luxury see the smoke of her burning, they will weep and mourn over her.
chapters.nkjv: "The kings of the earth who committed fornication and lived luxuriously with her will weep and lament for her, when they see the smoke of her burning,
chapters.kjv: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ, അയ്യോ, മഹാനഗരമായ ബാബിലോനേ, ബലമേറിയ പട്ടണമേ, ഒരു മണിക്കൂറുകൊണ്ടു നിന്റെ ന്യായവിധി വന്നല്ലോ എന്നു പറയും
chapters.niv: Terrified at her torment, they will stand far off and cry: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, you mighty city of Babylon! In one hour your doom has come!’
chapters.nkjv: standing at a distance for fear of her torment, saying, ‘Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! For in one hour your judgment has come.’
chapters.kjv: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

chapters.ml: ഭൂമിയിലെ വ്യാപാരികൾ പൊന്നു, വെള്ളി, രത്നം, മുത്തു, നേരിയ തുണി, ധൂമ്ര വസ്ത്രം, പട്ടു, കടുഞ്ചുവപ്പു, ചന്ദനത്തരങ്ങൾ,
chapters.niv: "The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her because no one buys their cargoes anymore—
chapters.nkjv: "And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise anymore:
chapters.kjv: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:

chapters.ml: ആനക്കൊമ്പുകൊണ്ടുള്ള സകലവിധ സാമാനങ്ങൾ, വിലയേറിയ മരവും പിച്ചളയും ഇരിമ്പും മർമ്മരക്കല്ലുംകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഓരോ സാമാനം,
chapters.niv: cargoes of gold, silver, precious stones and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk and scarlet cloth; every sort of citron wood, and articles of every kind made of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron and marble;
chapters.nkjv: merchandise of gold and silver, precious stones and pearls, fine linen and purple, silk and scarlet, every kind of citron wood, every kind of object of ivory, every kind of object of most precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
chapters.kjv: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,

chapters.ml: ലവംഗം, ഏലം, ധൂപവർഗ്ഗം, മൂറു, കുന്തുരുക്കം, വീഞ്ഞു, എണ്ണ, നേരിയ മാവു, കോതമ്പു, കന്നുകാലി, ആടു, കുതിര, രഥം, മാനുഷദേഹം, മാനുഷപ്രാണൻ എന്നീ ചരക്കു ഇനി ആരും വാങ്ങായ്കയാൽ അവളെച്ചൊല്ലി കരഞ്ഞു ദുഃഖിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: cargoes of cinnamon and spice, of incense, myrrh and frankincense, of wine and olive oil, of fine flour and wheat; cattle and sheep; horses and carriages; and human beings sold as slaves.
chapters.nkjv: and cinnamon and incense, fragrant oil and frankincense, wine and oil, fine flour and wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, and bodies and souls of men.
chapters.kjv: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.

chapters.ml: നീ കൊതിച്ച കായ്കനിയും നിന്നെ വിട്ടുപോയി; സ്വാദും ശോഭയും ഉള്ളതെല്ലാം നിനക്കു ഇല്ലാതെയായി; നീ ഇനി അവയെ ഒരിക്കലും കാണുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: "They will say, ‘The fruit you longed for is gone from you. All your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be recovered.’
chapters.nkjv: The fruit that your soul longed for has gone from you, and all the things which are rich and splendid have gone from you, and you shall find them no more at all.
chapters.kjv: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.

chapters.ml: ഈ വകകൊണ്ടു വ്യാപാരം ചെയ്തു അവളാൽ സമ്പന്നരായവർ അവൾക്കുള്ള പീഡ ഭയപ്പെട്ടു ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു:
chapters.niv: The merchants who sold these things and gained their wealth from her will stand far off, terrified at her torment. They will weep and mourn
chapters.nkjv: The merchants of these things, who became rich by her, will stand at a distance for fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
chapters.kjv: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,

chapters.ml: അയ്യോ, അയ്യോ, മഹാനഗരമേ, നേരിയ തുണിയും ധൂമ്രവർണ്ണവും കടുഞ്ചുവപ്പും ധരിച്ചു പൊന്നും രത്നവും മുത്തും അണിഞ്ഞവളേ, ഇത്രവലിയ സമ്പത്തു ഒരു മണിക്കൂറുകൊണ്ടു നശിച്ചുപോയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു കരഞ്ഞു ദുഃഖിക്കും.
chapters.niv: and cry out: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, dressed in fine linen, purple and scarlet, and glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls!
chapters.nkjv: and saying, ‘Alas, alas, that great city that was clothed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!
chapters.kjv: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!

chapters.ml: ഏതു മാലുമിയും ഓരോ ദിക്കിലേക്കു കപ്പലേറി പോകുന്ന ഏവനും കപ്പൽക്കാരും കടലിൽ തൊഴിൽ ചെയ്യുന്നവരൊക്കയും
chapters.niv: In one hour such great wealth has been brought to ruin!’ "Every sea captain, and all who travel by ship, the sailors, and all who earn their living from the sea, will stand far off.
chapters.nkjv: For in one hour such great riches came to nothing.’ Every shipmaster, all who travel by ship, sailors, and as many as trade on the sea, stood at a distance
chapters.kjv: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

chapters.ml: ദൂരത്തുനിന്നു അവളുടെ ദഹനത്തിന്റെ പുക കണ്ടു: മഹാനഗരത്തോടു തുല്യമായ നഗരം ഏതു എന്നു നിലവിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: When they see the smoke of her burning, they will exclaim, ‘Was there ever a city like this great city?’
chapters.nkjv: and cried out when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like this great city?’
chapters.kjv: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!

chapters.ml: അവർ തലയിൽ പൂഴി വാരിയിട്ടുംകൊണ്ടു: അയ്യോ, അയ്യോ, കടലിൽ കപ്പലുള്ളവർക്കു എല്ലാം തന്റെ ഐശ്വര്യത്താൽ സമ്പത്തു വർദ്ധിപ്പിച്ച മഹാനഗരം ഒരു മണിക്കൂറുകൊണ്ടു നശിച്ചു പോയല്ലോ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു കരഞ്ഞും ദുഃഖിച്ചുംകൊണ്ടു നിലവിളിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: They will throw dust on their heads, and with weeping and mourning cry out: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, where all who had ships on the sea became rich through her wealth! In one hour she has been brought to ruin!’
chapters.nkjv: "They threw dust on their heads and cried out, weeping and wailing, and saying, ‘Alas, alas, that great city, in which all who had ships on the sea became rich by her wealth! For in one hour she is made desolate.’
chapters.kjv: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗമേ, വിശുദ്ധന്മാരും അപ്പൊസ്തലന്മാരും പ്രവാചകന്മാരുമായുള്ളോരേ, ദൈവം അവളോടു നിങ്ങൾക്കുവേണ്ടി പ്രതികാരം നടത്തിയതുകൊണ്ടു അവളെച്ചൊല്ലി ആനന്ദിപ്പിൻ.
chapters.niv: "Rejoice over her, you heavens! Rejoice, you people of God! Rejoice, apostles and prophets! For God has judged her with the judgment she imposed on you."
chapters.nkjv: "Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets, for God has avenged you on her!"
chapters.kjv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ ശക്തനായോരു ദൂതൻ തിരികല്ലോളം വലുതായോരു കല്ലു എടുത്തു സമുദ്രത്തിൽ എറിഞ്ഞു പറഞ്ഞതു: ഇങ്ങിനെ ബാബിലോൻ മഹാനഗരത്തെ ഹേമത്തോടെ എറിഞ്ഞുകളയും; ഇനി അതിനെ കാണുകയില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, and said: "With such violence the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to be found again.
chapters.nkjv: Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, "Thus with violence the great city Babylon shall be thrown down, and shall not be found anymore.
chapters.kjv: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.

chapters.ml: വൈണികന്മാർ, വാദ്യക്കാർ, കുഴലൂത്തുകാർ, കാഹളക്കാർ എന്നിവരുടെ സ്വരം നിന്നിൽ ഇനി കേൾക്കയില്ല; യാതൊരു കൌശലപ്പണിയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരു ശില്പിയെയും നിന്നിൽ ഇനി കാണുകയില്ല; തിരികല്ലിന്റെ ഒച്ച ഇനി നിന്നിൽ കേൾക്കയില്ല.
chapters.niv: The music of harpists and musicians, pipers and trumpeters, will never be heard in you again. No worker of any trade will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.
chapters.nkjv: The sound of harpists, musicians, flutists, and trumpeters shall not be heard in you anymore. No craftsman of any craft shall be found in you anymore, and the sound of a millstone shall not be heard in you anymore.
chapters.kjv: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be , shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

chapters.ml: വിളക്കിന്റെ വെളിച്ചം ഇനി നിന്നിൽ പ്രകാശിക്കയില്ല; മണവാളന്റെയും മണവാട്ടിയുടെയും സ്വരം ഇനി നിന്നിൽ കേൾക്കയില്ല; നിന്റെ വ്യാപാരികൾ ഭൂമിയിലെ മഹത്തുക്കൾ ആയിരുന്നു; നിന്റെ ക്ഷുദ്രത്താൽ സകലജാതികളും വശീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.
chapters.niv: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voice of bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the world’s important people. By your magic spell all the nations were led astray.
chapters.nkjv: The light of a lamp shall not shine in you anymore, and the voice of bridegroom and bride shall not be heard in you anymore. For your merchants were the great men of the earth, for by your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
chapters.kjv: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.

chapters.ml: പ്രവാചകന്മാരുടെയും വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെയും ഭൂമിയിൽവെച്ചു കൊന്നുകളഞ്ഞ എല്ലാവരുടെയും രക്തം അവളിൽ അല്ലോ കണ്ടതു.
chapters.niv: In her was found the blood of prophets and of God’s holy people, of all who have been slaughtered on the earth."
chapters.nkjv: And in her was found the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who were slain on the earth."
chapters.kjv: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഞാൻ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ വലിയോരു പുരുഷാരത്തിന്റെ മഹാഘോഷം പോലെ കേട്ടതു: ഹല്ലെലൂയ്യാ! രക്ഷയും മഹത്വവും ശക്തിയും നമ്മുടെ ദൈവത്തിന്നുള്ളതു.
chapters.niv: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a great multitude in heaven shouting: "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
chapters.nkjv: After these things I heard a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, "Alleluia! Salvation and glory and honor and power belong to the Lord our God!
chapters.kjv: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:

chapters.ml: വേശ്യാവൃത്തികൊണ്ടു ഭൂമിയെ വഷളാക്കിയ മഹാവേശ്യക്കു അവൻ ശിക്ഷ വിധിച്ചു തന്റെ ദാസന്മാരുടെ രക്തം അവളുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു ചോദിച്ചു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്കകൊണ്ടു അവന്റെ ന്യായവിധികൾ സത്യവും നീതിയുമുള്ളവ.
chapters.niv: for true and just are his judgments. He has condemned the great prostitute who corrupted the earth by her adulteries. He has avenged on her the blood of his servants."
chapters.nkjv: For true and righteous are His judgments, because He has judged the great harlot who corrupted the earth with her fornication; and He has avenged on her the blood of His servants shed by her."
chapters.kjv: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

chapters.ml: അവർ പിന്നെയും: ഹല്ലെലൂയ്യാ! അവളുടെ പുക എന്നെന്നേക്കും പൊങ്ങുന്നു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: And again they shouted: "Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up for ever and ever."
chapters.nkjv: Again they said, "Alleluia! Her smoke rises up forever and ever!"
chapters.kjv: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

chapters.ml: ഇരുപത്തുനാലു മൂപ്പന്മാരും നാലു ജീവികളും: ആമേൻ, ഹല്ലെലൂയ്യാ! എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്ന ദൈവത്തെ വീണു നമസ്കരിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who was seated on the throne. And they cried: "Amen, Hallelujah!"
chapters.nkjv: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sat on the throne, saying, "Amen! Alleluia!"
chapters.kjv: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.

chapters.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സകലദാസന്മാരും ഭക്തന്മാരുമായി ചെറിയവരും വലിയവരും ആയുള്ളോരേ, അവനെ വാഴ്ത്തുവിൻ എന്നു പറയുന്നോരു ശബ്ദം സിംഹാസനത്തിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: "Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, both great and small!"
chapters.nkjv: Then a voice came from the throne, saying, "Praise our God, all you His servants and those who fear Him, both small and great!"
chapters.kjv: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

chapters.ml: അപ്പോൾ വലിയ പുരുഷാരത്തിന്റെ ഘോഷംപോലെയും പെരുവെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഇരെച്ചൽപോലെയും തകർത്ത ഇടിമുഴക്കംപോലെയും ഞാൻ കേട്ടതു; ഹല്ലെലൂയ്യാ! സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ കർത്താവു രാജത്വം ഏറ്റിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: "Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns.
chapters.nkjv: And I heard, as it were, the voice of a great multitude, as the sound of many waters and as the sound of mighty thunderings, saying, "Alleluia! For the Lord God Omnipotent reigns!
chapters.kjv: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

chapters.ml: നാം സന്തോഷിച്ചു ഉല്ലസിച്ചു അവന്നു മഹത്വം കൊടുക്കുക; കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെ കല്യാണം വന്നുവല്ലോ; അവന്റെ കാന്തയും തന്നെത്താൻ ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.
chapters.nkjv: Let us be glad and rejoice and give Him glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His wife has made herself ready."
chapters.kjv: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

chapters.ml: അവൾക്കു ശുദ്ധവും ശുഭ്രവുമായ വിശേഷവസ്ത്രം ധരിപ്പാൻ കൃപ ലഭിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; ആ വിശേഷവസ്ത്രം വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ നീതിപ്രവൃത്തികൾ തന്നേ.
chapters.niv: Fine linen, bright and clean, was given her to wear." (Fine linen stands for the righteous acts of God’s holy people.)
chapters.nkjv: And to her it was granted to be arrayed in fine linen, clean and bright, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
chapters.kjv: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

chapters.ml: പിന്നെ അവൻ എന്നോടു: കുഞ്ഞാടിന്റെ കല്യാണസദ്യെക്കു ക്ഷണിക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാർ എന്നു എഴുതുക എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു. ഇതു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ സത്യവചനം എന്നും എന്നോടു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: Then the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!" And he added, "These are the true words of God."
chapters.nkjv: Then he said to me, "Write: ‘Blessed are those who are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb!’ " And he said to me, "These are the true sayings of God."
chapters.kjv: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ അവനെ നമസ്കരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു അവന്റെ കാൽക്കൽ വീണു; അപ്പോൾ അവൻ എന്നോടു: അതരുതു: ഞാൻ നിനക്കും യേശുവിന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യം ഉള്ള നിന്റെ സഹോദരന്മാർക്കും സഹഭൃത്യനത്രേ; ദൈവത്തെ നമസ്കരിക്ക; യേശുവിന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യമോ പ്രവചനത്തിന്റെ ആത്മാവു തന്നേ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: At this I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers and sisters who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For it is the Spirit of prophecy who bears testimony to Jesus."
chapters.nkjv: And I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "See thatyoudo not dothat! I am your fellow servant, and of your brethren who have the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
chapters.kjv: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം സ്വർഗ്ഗം തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; ഒരു വെള്ളക്കുതിര പ്രത്യക്ഷമായി; അതിന്മേൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവന്നു വിശ്വസ്തനും സത്യവാനും എന്നും പേർ. അവൻ നീതിയോടെ വിധിക്കയും പോരാടുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
chapters.niv: I saw heaven standing open and there before me was a white horse, whose rider is called Faithful and True. With justice he judges and wages war.
chapters.nkjv: Now I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse. And He who sat on him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judges and makes war.
chapters.kjv: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

chapters.ml: അവന്റെ കണ്ണു അഗ്നിജ്വാല, തലയിൽ അനേകം രാജമുടികൾ; എഴുതീട്ടുള്ള ഒരു നാമവും അവന്നുണ്ടു; അതു അവന്നല്ലാതെ ആർക്കും അറിഞ്ഞുകൂടാ.
chapters.niv: His eyes are like blazing fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows but he himself.
chapters.nkjv: His eyes were like a flame of fire, and on His head were many crowns. He had a name written that no one knew except Himself.
chapters.kjv: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

chapters.ml: അവൻ രക്തം തളിച്ച ഉടുപ്പു ധരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു; അവന്നു ദൈവവചനം എന്നു പേർ പറയുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is the Word of God.
chapters.nkjv: He was clothed with a robe dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.
chapters.kjv: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

chapters.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ സൈന്യം നിർമ്മലവും ശുഭ്രവുമായ വിശേഷ വസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചു വെള്ളക്കുതിരപ്പുറത്തു കയറി അവനെ അനുഗമിച്ചു.
chapters.niv: The armies of heaven were following him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.
chapters.nkjv: And the armies in heaven, clothed in fine linen, white and clean, followed Him on white horses.
chapters.kjv: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

chapters.ml: ജാതികളെ വെട്ടുവാൻ അവന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നു മൂർച്ചയുള്ളവാൾ പുറപ്പെടുന്നു; അവൻ ഇരിമ്പുകോൽ കൊണ്ടു അവരെ മേയക്കും; സർവ്വശക്തിയുള്ള ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കോപവും ക്രോധവുമായ മദ്യത്തിന്റെ ചക്കു അവൻ മെതിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: Coming out of his mouth is a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. "He will rule them with an iron scepter." He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.
chapters.nkjv: Now out of His mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it He should strike the nations. And He Himself will rule them with a rod of iron. He Himself treads the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
chapters.kjv: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

chapters.ml: രാജാധിരാജാവും കർത്താധികർത്താവും എന്ന നാമം അവന്റെ ഉടുപ്പിന്മേലും തുടമേലും എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നു.
chapters.niv: On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: king of kings and lord of lords.
chapters.nkjv: And He has on His robe and on His thigh a name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
chapters.kjv: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

chapters.ml: ഒരു ദൂതൻ സൂര്യനിൽ നില്ക്കുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു; അവൻ ആകാശമദ്ധ്യേ പറക്കുന്ന സകല പക്ഷികളോടും:
chapters.niv: And I saw an angel standing in the sun, who cried in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midair, "Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the midst of heaven, "Come and gather together for the supper of the great God,
chapters.kjv: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

chapters.ml: രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ മാംസവും സഹസ്രാധിപന്മാരുടെ മാംസവും വീരന്മാരുടെ മാംസവും കുതിരകളുടെയും കുതിരപ്പുറത്തിരിക്കുന്നവരുടെയും മാംസവും സ്വതന്ത്രന്മാരും ദാസന്മാരും ചെറിയവരും വലിയവരുമായ എല്ലാവരുടെയും മാംസവും തിന്മാൻ മഹാദൈവത്തിന്റെ അത്താഴത്തിന്നു വന്നു കൂടുവിൻ എന്നു ഉറക്കെ വിളിച്ചുപറഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, generals, and the mighty, of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, great and small."
chapters.nkjv: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, both small and great."
chapters.kjv: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.

chapters.ml: കുതിരപ്പുറത്തിരിക്കുന്നവനോടും അവന്റെ സൈന്യത്തോടും യുദ്ധം ചെയ്‍വാൻ മൃഗവും ഭൂരാജാക്കന്മാരും അവരുടെ സൈന്യങ്ങളും ഒന്നിച്ചു വന്നു കൂടിയതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to wage war against the rider on the horse and his army.
chapters.nkjv: And I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against Him who sat on the horse and against His army.
chapters.kjv: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.

chapters.ml: മൃഗത്തെയും അതിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ താൻ ചെയ്ത അടയാളങ്ങളാൽ മനുഷ്യരെ ചതിച്ചു മൃഗത്തിന്റെ മുദ്ര ഏല്പിക്കയും അതിന്റെ പ്രതിമയെ നമസ്കരിപ്പിക്കയും ചെയ്ത കള്ളപ്രവാചകനെയും പിടിച്ചു കെട്ടി ഇരുവരെയും ഗന്ധകം കത്തുന്ന തീപ്പൊയ്കയിൽ ജീവനോടെ തള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞു.
chapters.niv: But the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed the signs on its behalf. With these signs he had deluded those who had received the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. The two of them were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
chapters.nkjv: Then the beast was captured, and with him the false prophet who worked signs in his presence, by which he deceived those who received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were cast alive into the lake of fire burning with brimstone.
chapters.kjv: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

chapters.ml: ശേഷിച്ചവരെ കുതിരപ്പുറത്തിരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ വായിൽ നിന്നു പുറപ്പെടുന്ന വാൾകൊണ്ടു കൊന്നു അവരുടെ മാംസം തിന്നു സകല പക്ഷികൾക്കും തൃപ്തിവന്നു.
chapters.niv: The rest were killed with the sword coming out of the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
chapters.nkjv: And the rest were killed with the sword which proceeded from the mouth of Him who sat on the horse. And all the birds were filled with their flesh.
chapters.kjv: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.

chapters.ml: അനന്തരം ഒരു ദൂതൻ അഗാധത്തിന്റെ താക്കോലും ഒരു വലിയ ചങ്ങലയും കയ്യിൽ പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഇറങ്ങുന്നതു ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key to the Abyss and holding in his hand a great chain.
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, having the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
chapters.kjv: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

chapters.ml: അവൻ പിശാചും സാത്താനും എന്നുള്ള പഴയ പാമ്പായ മഹാസർപ്പത്തെ പിടിച്ചു ആയിരം ആണ്ടേക്കു ചങ്ങലയിട്ടു.
chapters.niv: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil, or Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
chapters.nkjv: He laid hold of the dragon, that serpent of old, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years;
chapters.kjv: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

chapters.ml: ആയിരം ആണ്ടു കഴിയുവോളം ജാതികളെ വഞ്ചിക്കാതിരിപ്പാൻ അവനെ അഗാധത്തിൽ തള്ളിയിട്ടു അടെച്ചുപൂട്ടുകയും മീതെ മുദ്രയിടുകയും ചെയ്തു. അതിന്റെ ശേഷം അവനെ അല്പകാലത്തേക്കു അഴിച്ചു വിടേണ്ടതാകുന്നു.
chapters.niv: He threw him into the Abyss, and locked and sealed it over him, to keep him from deceiving the nations anymore until the thousand years were ended. After that, he must be set free for a short time.
chapters.nkjv: and he cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal on him, so that he should deceive the nations no more till the thousand years were finished. But after these things he must be released for a little while.
chapters.kjv: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ ന്യായാസനങ്ങളെ കണ്ടു; അവയിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവർക്കു ന്യായവിധിയുടെ അധികാരം കൊടുത്തു; യേശുവിന്റെ സാക്ഷ്യവും ദൈവവചനവും നിമിത്തം തല ഛേദിക്കപ്പെട്ടവരും മൃഗത്തെയോ അതിന്റെ പ്രതിമയെയോ നമസ്കരിക്കാതിരുന്നവരും നെറ്റിയിലും കൈമേലും അതിന്റെ മുദ്ര കൈക്കൊള്ളാതിരുന്നവരുമായവരുടെ ആത്മാക്കളെയും ഞാൻ കണ്ടു. അവർ ജീവിച്ചു ആയിരമാണ്ടു ക്രിസ്തുവിനോടുകൂടി വാണു.
chapters.niv: I saw thrones on which were seated those who had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony about Jesus and because of the word of God. They had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
chapters.nkjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was committed to them. Then Isaw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their witness to Jesus and for the word of God, who had not worshiped the beast or his image, and had not received his mark on their foreheads or on their hands. And they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
chapters.kjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവരിൽ ശേഷമുള്ളവർ ആയിരം ആണ്ടു കഴിയുവോളം ജീവിച്ചില്ല.
chapters.niv: (The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended.) This is the first resurrection.
chapters.nkjv: But the rest of the dead did not live again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
chapters.kjv: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

chapters.ml: ഇതു ഒന്നാമത്തെ പുനരുത്ഥാനം. ഒന്നാമത്തെ പുനരുത്ഥാനത്തിൽ പങ്കുള്ളവൻ ഭാഗ്യവാനും വിശുദ്ധനും ആകുന്നു; അവരുടെ മേൽ രണ്ടാം മരണത്തിന്നു അധികാരം ഇല്ല; അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്നും ക്രിസ്തുവിന്നും പുരോഹിതന്മാരായി ക്രിസ്തുവിനോടുകൂടെ ആയിരം ആണ്ടു വാഴും.
chapters.niv: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.
chapters.nkjv: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with Him a thousand years.
chapters.kjv: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

chapters.ml: ആയിരം ആണ്ടു കഴിയുമ്പോഴോ സാത്താനെ തടവിൽ നിന്നു അഴിച്ചുവിടും.
chapters.niv: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison
chapters.nkjv: Now when the thousand years have expired, Satan will be released from his prison
chapters.kjv: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

chapters.ml: അവൻ ഭൂമിയുടെ നാലു ദിക്കിലുമുള്ള ജാതികളായി സംഖ്യയിൽ കടല്പുറത്തെ മണൽപോലെയുള്ള ഗോഗ്, മാഗോഗ് എന്നവരെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്നായി കൂട്ടിച്ചേർക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു വശീകരിപ്പാൻ പുറപ്പെടും.
chapters.niv: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—and to gather them for battle. In number they are like the sand on the seashore.
chapters.nkjv: and will go out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
chapters.kjv: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

chapters.ml: അവർ ഭൂമിയിൽ പരക്കെ ചെന്നു വിശുദ്ധന്മാരുടെ പാളയത്തെയും പ്രിയനഗരത്തെയും വളയും; എന്നാൽ ആകാശത്തു നിന്നു തീ ഇറങ്ങി അവരെ ദഹിപ്പിച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: They marched across the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of God’s people, the city he loves. But fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
chapters.nkjv: They went up on the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And fire came down from God out of heaven and devoured them.
chapters.kjv: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.

chapters.ml: അവരെ വഞ്ചിച്ച പിശാചിനെ മൃഗവും കള്ളപ്രവാചകനും കിടക്കുന്ന ഗന്ധകത്തീപ്പൊയ്കയിലേക്കു തള്ളിയിടും; അവർ എന്നെന്നേക്കും രാപ്പകൽ ദണ്ഡനം സഹിക്കേണ്ടിവരും.
chapters.niv: And the devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
chapters.nkjv: The devil, who deceived them, was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone where the beast and the false prophet are. And they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
chapters.kjv: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are , and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ വലിയോരു വെള്ളസിംഹാസനവും അതിൽ ഒരുത്തൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു; അവന്റെ സന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു ഭൂമിയും ആകാശവും ഓടിപ്പോയി; അവയെ പിന്നെ കണ്ടില്ല.
chapters.niv: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. The earth and the heavens fled from his presence, and there was no place for them.
chapters.nkjv: Then I saw a great white throne and Him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. And there was found no place for them.
chapters.kjv: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

chapters.ml: മരിച്ചവർ ആബാലവൃദ്ധം സിംഹാസനത്തിൻ മുമ്പിൽ നില്ക്കുന്നതും കണ്ടു; പുസ്തകങ്ങൾ തുറന്നു; ജീവന്റെ പുസ്തകം എന്ന മറ്റൊരു പുസ്തകവും തുറന്നു; പുസ്തകങ്ങളിൽ എഴുതിയിരുന്നതിന്നു ഒത്തവണ്ണം മരിച്ചവർക്കു അവരുടെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കടുത്ത ന്യായവിധി ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to what they had done as recorded in the books.
chapters.nkjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, standing before God, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is theBook of Life. And the dead were judged according to their works, by the things which were written in the books.
chapters.kjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

chapters.ml: സമുദ്രം തന്നിലുള്ള മരിച്ചവരെ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു; മരണവും പാതാളവും തങ്ങളിലുള്ള മരിച്ചവരെ ഏല്പിച്ചുകൊടുത്തു; ഓരോരുത്തന്നു അവനവന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾക്കടുത്ത വിധി ഉണ്ടായി.
chapters.niv: The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them, and each person was judged according to what they had done.
chapters.nkjv: The sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades delivered up the dead who were in them. And they were judged, each one according to his works.
chapters.kjv: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

chapters.ml: മരണത്തെയും പാതാളത്തെയും തീപ്പൊയ്കയിൽ തള്ളിയിട്ടു; ഈ തീപ്പൊയ്ക രണ്ടാമത്തെ മരണം.
chapters.niv: Then death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.
chapters.nkjv: Then Death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
chapters.kjv: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

chapters.ml: ജീവപുസ്തകത്തിൽ പേരെഴുതിക്കാണാത്ത ഏവനെയും തീപ്പൊയ്കയിൽ തള്ളിയിടും.
chapters.niv: Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
chapters.nkjv: And anyone not found written in the Book of Life was cast into the lake of fire.
chapters.kjv: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

chapters.ml: ഞാൻ പുതിയ ആകാശവും പുതിയ ഭൂമിയും കണ്ടു; ഒന്നാമത്തെ ആകാശവും ഒന്നാമത്തെ ഭൂമിയും ഒഴിഞ്ഞുപോയി; സമുദ്രവും ഇനി ഇല്ല.
chapters.niv: Then I saw "a new heaven and a new earth," for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there was no longer any sea.
chapters.nkjv: Now I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away. Also there was no more sea.
chapters.kjv: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

chapters.ml: പുതിയ യെരൂശലേം എന്ന വിശുദ്ധനഗരം ഭർത്താവിന്നായി അലങ്കരിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള മണവാട്ടിയെപ്പോലെ ഒരുങ്ങി സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽനിന്നു, ദൈവസന്നിധിയിൽനിന്നു തന്നേ, ഇറങ്ങുന്നതും ഞാൻ കണ്ടു.
chapters.niv: I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.
chapters.nkjv: Then I, John, saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
chapters.kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

chapters.ml: സിംഹാസനത്തിൽനിന്നു ഒരു മഹാശബ്ദം പറയുന്നതായി ഞാൻ കേട്ടതു: ഇതാ, മനുഷ്യരോടു കൂടെ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കൂടാരം; അവൻ അവരോടുകൂടെ വസിക്കും; അവർ അവന്റെ ജനമായിരിക്കും; ദൈവം താൻ അവരുടെ ദൈവമായി അവരോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കും.
chapters.niv: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Look! God’s dwelling place is now among the people, and he will dwell with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God.
chapters.nkjv: And I heard a loud voice from heaven saying, "Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and He will dwell with them, and they shall be His people. God Himself will be with them andbe their God.
chapters.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.

chapters.ml: അവൻ അവരുടെ കണ്ണിൽ നിന്നു കണ്ണുനീർ എല്ലാം തുടെച്ചുകളയും.
chapters.niv: ‘He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away."
chapters.nkjv: And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes; there shall be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying. There shall be no more pain, for the former things have passed away."
